I climb out of bed.
Wait a minute.
I think she just said something terrible-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、ちょっとおまえ―――」
「あら、そんな体で立ち上がっていいの？
　兄さんはいつも貧血気味なんですから、夜は大人しくしていないといけないわ。
　今だって寝不足のようですし、ここ数日はお疲れだったんでしょう？
　ほら、ちゃんとご自分の身体の事を意識してあげなさい。
兄さんの体はとても弱いんです。
　なら、そんな無理をしていると今すぐ倒れてしまうんじゃない？」
「な―――――――」
―――――どくん、と。
　　　なんでもない秋葉の言葉に、暗りとした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, what the hell are you―――”
“Should you really be standing with a body like yours?
You’re always anemic, Brother, so you ought to keep quiet at night.
You look sleep-deprived, and you’ve been exhausted these past few days, haven’t you? You must pay proper attention to your health. Your body is terribly frail.
If you force yourself like that, won’t you collapse at any moment?”
“Wha―――――――”
―――――Thump.
At her perfectly ordinary words, my vision dims.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, what are---"
"Oh?
Is it okay for you to stand up with your body?
You have anemia, so you should be calm during the night.
You seem to be lacking sleep even now, and you were tired for the past few days, right?
Please pay more attention to your health, Nii-san.
Your body is very weak.
So, won't you collapse if you keep pushing yourself like this?"
"Wha------"
-----Thump.
Her words seem to affect me.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――なに言っているんだ。
いくら俺でも、こんな事ぐらいで、そんな―――」
「そう？
　そのわりにはひどく辛そうなお顔をしていますね。
　例えば……そうね。
呼吸は段々と乱れていって、血の巡りがおかしくなる。
ほら、兄さんは手足の先から少しずつ冷たくなっていくんです」
―――――どくん。
「ちょっと――――止めて、くれ。
そう言われると、なんだか――――」
　本当に、そんな気がして、眩暈がする―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What are you talking about. I’m not so weak that standing up will―――”
“Are you sure? You look terribly unwell.
For example, yes. Your breathing is becoming ragged, and your circulation is failing. There―――your hands and feet are already turning cold from the tips inward.”
―――――thump.
“Stop――――saying that. When you put it that way, somehow――――”
It really starts to feel true, and the room spins―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are you saying?
I'm fine---"
"Oh?
Funny, you're looking a little strained to me.
As if…… yes, your breathing is going to get wilder, your blood will feel sluggish in your veins, and see, your hands and feet are going to start feeling cold."
-----Thump.
"Hey----Stop, it.
If you say that-----"
I really… will feel… dizzy---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「いいえ、それは気のせいではありません。
先程から兄さんの体はおかしかった。
ただ兄さんがそれに気がついていないだけ。
　いい？
　琥珀が笑っていたのはそれを兄さんが気付いていなかったからよ。
　兄さんは今にも倒れてしまいそうなほど弱っているクセに、ご自分の体の事をまったく考慮にいれていないんだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it isn’t your imagination. Your body has been failing all along. You simply failed to notice.
Listen. Kohaku was laughing because you remained oblivious.
You’re weak enough to collapse at any moment, yet you never spare a thought for your own body.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it isn't just your imagination.
Your body was strange from when we came in, but you just never realized it, Nii-san.
See?
Kohaku was laughing earlier because you didn't even notice it yourself.
You're so weak that you might collapse at any time, but you don't ever think of your condition, Nii-san."
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「気付いていないのは本人だけなんて、まるでカカシね。
　ボロボロの服を着て、竹で出来た手足をつけて。
遠くから見れば人間だけど、近くで見れば作り物にすぎない人型みたい」
「な――――――」
　なにを、いきなり。
ワケのわからないコトを、言い出すんだ、秋葉は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“For the man himself to be the only one who doesn’t notice—why, you’re just like a scarecrow.
Dress it in rags and give it limbs of bamboo. From a distance it resembles a man, but up close it’s nothing more than a counterfeit human shape.”
“Wha――――――”
Why, all of a sudden. Why is Akiha saying these incomprehensible things――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You are like a scarecrow, you being the only one not noticing that.
Wearing old clothes, bamboo for arms and legs.
From far away he looks human… but once you look close, it's just something made up to take human form."
"Wha-----"
Why did she suddenly start talking about all this nonsense?-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「もう、まだ気がついてくださらないんですか？
　兄さんはさっきから顔色が真っ青で、思考も磨耗しきっているのよ。
　だっていうのにそれを認めようとしてくれないなんて、本当にカカシみたい。
琥珀もそう思うでしょう？
　兄さんなんて、いつ壊れてもおかしくない飾り物なんだって」
「ばっ……そんな、コト――――」
　ない。
ない、ハズなのに。
　どうして―――本当にくらくらと意識が、途切れて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“You still have not realized?”
“Your face has been deathly pale for some time, and your thoughts are worn to nothing.”
“Yet you refuse to admit it. You really are a scarecrow. Kohaku, do you not agree that Brother is an ornament ready to break at any moment?”
“That cannot be――――”
It isn’t. It can’t be.
Then why―――why is my awareness really spinning, breaking apart―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Really, you still don't understand?
Your face is pale and your mind is numb.
You really are like a scarecrow, that you don't even want to admit to that.
Don't you think so too, Kohaku?
That Nii-san is like an ornament that could break at any time."
"Stu…… That, can't----"
be true.
It can't, but…
Why----why am I really feeling dizzy----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「ほら、もう限界なのよ。
　無理はしないでベッドに倒れる。
　でも意識だけは残ったまま。
　兄さんは手足の自由は利かないけど、意識だけはキチンと残っているの」
「ば―――やめ………、ろって―――」
　ふらり、と体が倒れる。
　その先にはベッドがあって、俺は秋葉の言葉通りに、そのまま――――!w1000

「――――、」
　違う。
俺の体はおかしくなんかない。
　少なくとも今夜は貧血になるような兆候はなかったんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, you’ve reached your limit.
Don’t fight it; fall back onto the bed.
But remain conscious.
Your arms and legs won’t obey you, yet your mind will stay perfectly awake.”
“S―――stop saying that―――”
My body sways and falls.
The bed lies beneath me, and exactly as Akiha commanded, I――――!w1000
“――――”
No. Nothing is wrong with my body.
At least tonight there wasn’t a single warning that my anemia might return―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, you're already at your limit.
Stop pushing yourself and lie down.
But you will stay awake.
You won't be able to move your arms and legs, but you will still be conscious."
"Stu---sto……… p----"
My body collapses.
I'm falling towards the bed, just like Akiha said---

"----"
No.
My body isn't strange.
Because, I didn't have any symptoms of anemia earlier---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「だから、そんな事は関係ないわ。
兄さんの体はいつだって不自由じゃない。
　だから今夜も兄さんの自由になるなんてコトはない。
――――だって。
　兄さんは、元々私の人形なんですから」
「な――――――」
　どさり、とベッドに倒れこむ。
　……結局秋葉の言葉が正しかったのか。
　俺は眩暈に襲われた時のように、そのまま意識を失ってしまった―――!w500
entries.maoEnglish:
“That has nothing to do with it. Your body is perfectly sound, Brother.
But that does not mean it will be yours to command tonight.
――――Because.
Brother, you have always been my doll.”
“Wha――――――”
I collapse heavily onto the bed.
Perhaps Akiha was right after all.
As though overcome by one of my dizzy spells, I lose consciousness―――!w500
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I told you, it does not matter.
Your body is always under constraint.
So, you have no control tonight either.
----Because.
You've always been my puppet, Nii-san."
"Wha-----"
I fall onto the bed.
…… In the end, Akiha was right.
Just like whenever I have an anemic spell, I lose consciousness---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「あ――――れ」
　……いや、違う。
　確かに体は痺れたままで動かないけど、意識だけは残っている。
　ぼう、として物事がよく考えられないけど、確かに俺は起きている。
「いつも、の、貧血と、違う……」
　ぼんやりと天井を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh――――”
No, that isn’t it.
My body is numb and motionless, but my awareness remains.
My thoughts are fogged, yet I am unmistakably awake.
“This isn’t like my anemia”
I stare blankly at the ceiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hu----h?"
…… No, this time it's different.
My entire body is numb, but I'm still conscious.
I can't really concentrate, but I'm awake.
"Different, than my, usual, anemia……"
I stare blankly at the ceiling.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま？
　あの、少しやりすぎたのではないですか……？
　志貴さん、本当に貧血ぎみになってしまっていますけど……」
　……琥珀さん、の声。
「なに言ってるのよ琥珀。
夕食にあなたがクスリなんて混ぜるから、兄さんが前後不覚に陥っているんじゃない。
　私は少しだけ眠らせようと思っただけです。
それだけだったら私一人で十分ですもの」
　……秋葉の声はどこか不満そうだ。
「……ちょっと、二人、とも」
　横になったまま声をあげる。
　手足は動いてくれない。
なんとか首をまげて、秋葉と琥珀さんを見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha? Perhaps we overdid it a little? Master Shiki truly does seem anemic now.”
Kohaku’s voice.
“What are you talking about, Kohaku. He’s barely conscious because you put drugs in his dinner.
I only meant to let him sleep for a little while. I could have managed that much alone.”
Akiha sounds almost petulant.
“Hey, both of you”
With all my strength.
My limbs refuse to move. I manage to turn my head and look at Akiha and Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama?
Um, did we overdo it……?
He looks like he really has anemia……"
…… Kohaku-san's, voice.
"What are you talking about, Kohaku?
You're the one who put some drugs into his dinner, so he will be a little dazed.
I only wanted him to sleep a bit.
I could have done that myself."
…… Akiha sounds dissatisfied.
"…… Hey, you two."
I call out to them, still lying down.
My arms and legs won't work, but I somehow manage to turn my neck and look at both of them.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「はあ。
志貴さんは純真ですから暗示にかかりやすかったんですねー。
まあ、そこが志貴さんのいいところなんでしょうけど」
　……俺の声は無視されたみたいだ。
「そうね。
けど琥珀、あんまりに純真すぎるものって、こう、嗜虐心をかきたてられない？」
　……ちらり、と秋葉の目がこちらに向いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh dear. Master Shiki is so innocent that suggestion works especially well on him. Then again, that innocence is part of his charm.”
Apparently my voice has been ignored.
“True. But Kohaku, doesn’t such perfect innocence make you want to hurt it?”
Akiha glances toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san is very pure, so I guess suggestion seems to work easily on him.
I suppose that's a good trait about him too."
…… It seems they are ignoring me.
"Yes, but Kohaku, when they are too pure… don't they make you want to dominate them?"
…… She looks over at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　目が合った瞬間、ぞくりと、冷たい感覚が背中に走った。
　肌の下、肉の中、背骨の中心を冷たいモノが駆けあがる。
　脳髄が痺れたのか。
　秋葉のあの瞳に見つめられていると、時間が止まって、空間が凍死してしまったみたいに、全身が締めつけられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
The moment our eyes meet, cold races up my back.
Something cold climbs beneath the skin, through the flesh, along the very center of my spine.
Has my brain gone numb?
Under Akiha’s gaze, time seems to stop and the room itself freezes to death, constricting my entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
As soon as our eyes meet, I feel a chill run up my spine.
Coldness sinks into my skin, burrowing under my flesh and into my very core.
I feel as if my brain is becoming numb.
My body feels tied up as she looks at me with those eyes, as if time has stopped and the whole area has frozen up.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「あ――――秋、葉？」
「………………………」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　……どくん、と心臓が痙攣する。
　秋葉は無表情なのに、どうして―――あんな、獲物を狙うような冷たい目をしているように見えるのか―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha――――?”
“………………………”
She says nothing.
My heart spasms.
Her face is blank, so why―――why do her eyes seem so cold, like a predator sighting prey―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----Aki, ha?"
"………………"
She doesn't say a word.
…… Thump.
My heart beats loudly.
Her face is entirely devoid of expression, but her eyes---her eyes glow like a predator stalking her prey-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「うーん、嗜虐心、ですか。
わたしは志貴さんの困ったお顔も嬉しがってくださるお顔も大好きですから、秋葉さまのおっしゃられるコトは分かりかねますねー」
　……秋葉の横で首をかしげる琥珀さん。
　秋葉は琥珀さんを見る事さえせず、こっちを見つめたまま頷いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm, the urge to hurt him? I love Master Shiki’s troubled face and his happy one equally, so I’m afraid I don’t quite understand what you mean, Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku tilts her head beside her.
Without so much as looking at Kohaku, Akiha continues staring at me and nods.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Domination, huh?
Well, I like seeing his troubled face as much as his happy face, so I understand what you mean, Akiha-sama."
…… Next to Akiha, Kohaku-san tilts her head.
Akiha doesn't look at Kohaku-san, but she gives a small nod.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「そうね、例えるなら絵画かな。
　ねえ琥珀、素晴らしい、というわけではないけど、よく出来た作品があるとするでしょう？
　その絵はよく出来ているから不満はないのだけど、よく出来ているだけで面白みも何もないから好きになれない。
　そういう場合、どうしたらそれを自分の中で特別なモノにできるか、わかる？」
「うーん、そうですね……ちょっと、わたしには分かりません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Think of a painting.
Suppose you had one that wasn’t a masterpiece, but was very skillfully made. You could find no fault with it, yet mere skill has no charm, so you could never love it.
Do you know how you might make such a painting special to you?”
“Hmm, let me think; I’m afraid I don’t know.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's see, it's like a painting.
Hey Kohaku, let's say there's a painting that is well done, but not magnificent.
Because it's well done, you don't have any complaints, but you can't like it because it's just well done and doesn't have anything interesting about it.
In that case, do you know how to make it special for you, Kohaku?"
"Umm, let's see…… I don't know, Akiha-sama."
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「簡単よ。
そのよく出来た絵の上に絵の具を塗りたくって台無しにしてしまえばいい。
　結果、そのよく出来た絵は失われてただのガラクタになるでしょう。
けどその過程、自分のものであった『よく出来た作品』が壊れていく時間は素晴らしいものなんじゃないかしら。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s simple. Smear paint all over the finished picture and ruin it.
“The fine work would be lost, reduced to rubbish. But the time spent watching a fine work that belonged to you being destroyed—wouldn’t that be exquisite?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's simple.
You just have to paint over the painting and make it worthless.
As a result, that good painting will turn into trash.
But the process, breaking what is "good" for you, isn't it wonderful?
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――考えてみるだけでも美的じゃない？
　私にはその絵に対する愛着も後悔もある。
　その絵が醜くなっていく事への苦痛も、そうしてしまっている自分への怒りも、もう元に戻りえないという焦燥も、何よりそれを壊してしまえるのは自分だけという絶対性があるわ。
　所有する喜び、かしら。
ただ一つの物だからこそ、つけられていく傷痕が自分の爪痕だからこそ、壊していくたびによけい愛着が湧いてくるのよ。
　だって、決して消えない爪痕を残せば残すほど、それは自分のモノになっていくんだもの」
――――眉一つ。
　呼吸さえせず、能面のような無機質さで、秋葉は笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Isn’t the very thought beautiful?
I would feel affection for the painting, and regret.
I would suffer as it became ugly, rage at myself for doing it, despair because it could never be restored—and above all, possess the absolute certainty that I alone had the power to ruin it.
Perhaps it is the joy of ownership. Because it is unique, because every scar upon it came from my hand, I grow more attached with every wound I inflict.
The more indelible marks I leave, the more completely it becomes mine.”
――――Not so much as an eyebrow moves.
Without even seeming to breathe, Akiha smiles with the lifeless blankness of a Noh mask.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Isn't it beautiful just thinking about it?
I feel love and regret for that painting.
The pain as the painting gets ruined, anger at myself for ruining it, frustration because it's beyond repair, and more than anything else, the fact that I am the only one who can break it is absolute.
I think it is the happiness of owning it.
Because it is the only one, and because the wounds on it are put on there by me, you feel more attached to it.
Because the more marks you put on it, the more it becomes yours."
----Without any motion.
Like a machine, Akiha laughs.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「ね、琥珀。
アレを壊してみたくならない？
　それは、きっと愉しいわ」
「なっ――――ちょっと、秋葉…………！」
　声をあげる。
　けれど秋葉は答えないし、琥珀さんは笑顔のまま、
「はい。
かしこまりました、秋葉さま」
　なんて、とんでもない返答をしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Kohaku. Don’t you feel like breaking that?
I’m sure it would be delightful.”
“Wha――――wait, Akiha…!”
I raise my voice.
But Akiha gives no answer, and Kohaku, still smiling,
“Yes. As you wish, Miss Akiha.”
gives that appalling reply.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Kohaku.
Don't you want to break that?
I think it will be… enjoyable."
"Wha----Hey, Akiha…………!"
I shout.
But Akiha doesn't respond, and Kohaku-san with her smile,
"Yes.
I understand, Akiha-sama,"
responds like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「っっっっっ！」
　全身に力をいれる。
　感覚のない手足にムチをいれて、なんとか立ちあがろうと努力した。
「っ、ん～～～～～…………！！！！！」
　力をこめる。
　必死の努力が通じたのか、手足は少しずつ自由に動き出してくれ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nnngh!”
I tense every muscle.
I lash my numb limbs, struggling somehow to rise.
“Nnngh…………!”
I strain harder.
Perhaps desperation reaches them, because my hands and feet slowly begin to move again―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Erggh!"
I rally all of the strength in my body.
I strain as hard I can and order my lifeless limbs to stand.
"Tss,n~~~~~~~………!!!!!"
I strain.
I gradually feel my ability to move my arms and legs starting to return---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「もう、だめですよ志貴さん。
貧血ぎみなんですから、体に無理をさせちゃいけません」
　いつも通りの笑顔でそんな事を言って、琥珀さんはベッドのわきにしゃがみこんだ。
「琥珀さん、なにを――――」
「なにって、志貴さんが暴れないように縛るんです。
だいじょうぶ、手首と足首だけですからあんまり痛くないですよ」
「縛るって、なに考えて――――いっつぅ……！」
　突然の痛みにアゴがあがる。
　琥珀さんは慣れた手つきで、ベッドの足にロープのようなものを巻きつけて、俺の手足を拘束してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, Master Shiki. You’re anemic, so you mustn’t strain yourself.”
With her usual smile, Kohaku crouches beside the bed.
“Kohaku, what are you――――”
“I’m tying you down, Master Shiki, so you won’t thrash about. Don’t worry, it’s only your wrists and ankles, so it shouldn’t hurt very much.”
“Tie me down, what are you thinking――――agh…!” The sudden pain jerks my chin up.
With practiced hands, Kohaku loops rope around the bedposts and binds my wrists and ankles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That is enough, don't do that, Shiki-san.
You are anemic, so you shouldn't strain your body too much."
With her usual smile, Kohaku-san crouches beside the bed.
"Kohaku-san, what are----"
"What does it look like?
I am tying you down so you won't struggle.
It's okay, I'll only tie your wrists and ankles so it won't hurt that much."
"Tie?
What are you thinking----owww……!" I clench my jaw at the sudden pain.
As if she had a lot of practice, Kohaku-san expertly binds my hands and feet to the bed.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:

「志貴さまがどのような夢を見ていたのか、お聞かせ願えないでしょうか」
　じろり、とした視線。
　……まずい。
なんか、地獄的にまずい寝言を、口にしてしまったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. Please excuse me.”
Hisui bows and walks toward the door.
“――――――Hah”
Just as I begin to relax.
“One more matter, Master Shiki.”
Hisui turns, her face frighteningly stern.
“Would you tell me what sort of dream Master Shiki was having?”
Her stare bores into me.
This is bad. I must have said something catastrophically incriminating in my sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
Please excuse me."
She gives a bow and goes to leave.
I take a deep breath,
and relax.
"…… By the way, Shiki-sama."
She turns around with a fearsome expression.
"Could you please tell me what kind of dream you were having?"
She looks at me.
…… This isn't good.
I might have said something really bad in my sleep.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「……いや、別に人に言うほどの夢じゃないから。
　何か口走っていたかもしれないけど、それは遠野志貴とは関係のない所の言葉だと思っていただけると幸いなんだけど……」
「……結構です。
ですがこれからは、誰彼の胸が薄いといった事や、額が広いといった身体的な特徴をつらつらと繰り返すようなお眠りはお止めください。
　これでは志貴さまを起こすという勤めに支障が出てきてしまいますから」
　それでは、と翡翠は退室していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It wasn’t a dream worth telling anyone about.
I may have muttered a few things, but I’d be grateful if you regarded them as words entirely unrelated to Shiki Tohno…”
“That will suffice. In the future, however, please refrain from endlessly repeating remarks about one person’s flat chest or another’s broad forehead in your sleep.
Otherwise, it interferes with my duty of waking you, Master Shiki.”
With that, Hisui left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, it isn't much to talk about.
I may have spoke something in my sleep, but it would be great if you'd think it has nothing to do with me at all……"
"…… That is fine.
But from now on, please refrain from sleeping while talking about the smallness of someone's chest, or the wideness of their foreheads, or other characteristics of their body.
It makes my duty to wake you up a little more difficult."
"Please excuse me," Hisui says as she leaves the room.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
気持ちを十分に落ち着かせて居間に移動する。
　居間では、すでに秋葉がソファーに座って紅茶を優雅にすすっていた。

「あら、おはよう兄さん。
今朝は早いんですね」
　そんなにこっちが早起きしたことが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で声をかけてくる。
「ああ、おはよう。
今朝は、まあ色々とあってさ」
「？
　色々って、何が色々あったんです？」
「いや、だからそれは―――――」
――――と。
　不覚にも、翡翠との夢を明確に思い返してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once I had thoroughly composed myself, I went to the sitting room.
Akiha was already on the sofa, sipping tea with practiced elegance.
“Good morning, Brother. You’re early today.”
Perhaps my early rising pleased her that much; Akiha greeted me with a smile.
“Morning. A few things happened.”
“A few things? What things?”
“Well, that’s…”
――――And then.
Like a fool, I vividly remember the dream about Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After calming down enough, I head to the sitting room.
As usual, Akiha is sitting on the sofa, elegantly sipping tea.
"Oh, good morning Nii-san.
You are certainly up early this morning."
She must be happy I woke up early because she greets me with a smile.
"Yeah, good morning.
There were, well, a lot of things going on this morning."
"?
A lot of things?
What do you mean by that?"
"Um, well-----"
----And then,
I suddenly recall my dream about Hisui.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「うっ―――」
　まずい。
自分でもどうしようもないぐらい、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
「兄さん―――？」
　がた、という物音。
「どうしたの？
　顔が赤いけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　すぐ間近にやってきて、秋葉は下から俺の顔を覗きこむ。
　その角度。
　下から見上げてくる視線は、否応なしに昨夜の夢を彷彿とさせてしまう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urk―――”
This is bad. I can feel my face reddening beyond all control.
“Brother―――?”
A chair shifts.
“What is wrong? Your face is red, but do you have a fever?”
“―――――!”
Akiha comes right up and peers into my face from below.
That angle.
Her upturned gaze drags last night’s dream back without mercy――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh---"
This isn't good.
I can tell my face is blushing beyond my control.
"Nii-san---?"
A brief clamor.
"What's wrong?
Your face is red, do you have a fever?"
"-----!"
Rushing over to me, she looks up at me from below.
But, that angle,
Looking up at me like that, it resembles too much of the dream last night----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――はあ、本当に熱があるみたいですね。
琥珀、ちょっと来て。
兄さん、体の具合がよくないみたいなの」
　秋葉は食堂に向かって声をあげる。
　厨房では琥珀さんが俺の朝食を作っている最中なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hah, you really do seem feverish. Kohaku, come here. Brother does not seem well.”
Akiha calls toward the dining room.
Kohaku is presumably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sighs.
"You do seem to have a fever.
Kohaku, come quickly.
Nii-san doesn't seem to be well."
Akiha calls out to the dining room.
Kohaku-san has to be preparing my breakfast in the kitchen.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「いい―――！
　た、ただの風邪だから、そんなに気にしなくていい！」
「風邪ならなおさら放っておけませんっ。
些細な病気でも兄さんには大事でしょう。
免疫や抵抗力が人より低いんですから」
　秋葉は呆れながら、スッ、と自分の手を俺のひたいに当てた。
　ひやりと冷たい、華奢な手の平の感触。
　白くて、細い指。
　男の指なんかじゃとうてい及ばない、繊細で、キレイな、白い指―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am fine―――! I-it is only a cold, so do not worry!”
“A cold is even more reason not to ignore it. A minor illness can be serious for you, Brother. Your immunity and resistance are weaker than other people’s.”
With an exasperated look, Akiha places her hand against my forehead.
Her slender palm feels cool against me.
Pale, delicate fingers.
Fine, lovely white fingers beyond anything a man’s hand could possess―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine--!
It's just a minor cold, so don't worry!"
"If it is a cold, then I can't let it go by.
For you, a trivial illness is a big deal.
The strength of your immune system is much lower than most people's."
Akiha seems to be fed up and puts her hand on my forehead.
The sensation of her cool, delicate hand.
Her white, delicate fingers.
Completely different from a man's, those slender, pretty, white fingers------
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「っっっっっっっっ！」
　まずい。
　まずいので、秋葉の手を払って、ロビーへと走り出した。
　どたたたたたたたた。
「志貴さま？
　朝食はもうお済みになられたのですか？」
「いや、そうじゃないけど―――ええっと、俺の鞄は？」
「こちらですが、もう登校されるのですか？」
　こくん、と頷いて翡翠の手から鞄を奪い取る。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りはいいから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh!”
This is bad.
I knock Akiha’s hand aside and bolt for the foyer.
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
“Master Shiki? Have you finished breakfast already?”
“No, but―――where is my schoolbag?”
“Here, but are you leaving for school already?”
I nod, snatch it from Hisui’s hand, and head for the door.
“I’m off! You do not have to see me out!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah!"
This isn't good.
This isn't good at all, so I break loose and run out to the lobby.

The sound of my footsteps trails behind me.
"Shiki-sama?
Have you finished your breakfast already?"
"No, that's not it, but--um, where's my bag?"
"I have your bag here.
Are you already going to school?"
Nodding, I snatch my bag from Hisui.
"I'm going.
Don't worry about seeing me off!"
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、さっきからヘンです。
熱があるっていうのに何をしてるんですかっ」
「ああもう、なんでもないんだって！
　なんでもないんだから、俺はこのまま学校に行く！
　朝飯はかってになんとかするからほっといてくれ！」
「ほっとけって―――ちょっと、兄さん！？」
　どたたたたたたたた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, you have been acting strangely all morning. What are you doing when you have a fever?”
“I told you, it is nothing! Since it is nothing, I am going to school. I will find breakfast somewhere, so leave me alone!”
“Leave you alone―――wait, Brother!?”
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you've been acting strange.
What are you doing with that fever?"
"Geez, I told you it's nothing!
Since it's nothing, I'm going to school!
I'll have breakfast later, so leave me alone!"
"Leave you alone---hey, Nii-san!?"
The sound of my running footsteps is my only response.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――――」
　いくら秋葉でも、ここまできてしまえば追いかけてくるなんてコトはありえまい。
　子供じゃないんだから、登校するといった人間を捕まえにくることなんてしないはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Even Akiha will not chase me this far.
She is not a child, so surely she will not run after someone who already announced he was going to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
Even if it is Akiha, she wouldn't chase me this far.

Since we're not kids anymore, she won't stop me from going to school.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「――――ふう」
　大きく息をはいて、ようやく落ち着いた。
「………って、なんで逃げてるんだ、俺」
　落ち着いたら冷静になった。
　別段悪いことなんかしてないんだから、逃げるように出てくる必要なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Whew”
One long breath finally calms me.
“Why am I running away?”
Once calm, I can think again.
I have not done anything wrong, so there was no need to flee the house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Whew."
I take a deep breath and calm down.
"……… What am I running away for?"
Once I calm down, I can think clearly.
I didn't do anything wrong, so there was no need for me to run away like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
まるっきりバカみたいじゃないか、これじゃ」
　かといって、いまさら屋敷に戻って朝ごはんをいただくというのは、もっと間が抜けていると思う。
「―――学校に行くか」
　はあ、とため息をついて、住宅街に続く坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Unbelievable. I look like a complete idiot.”
Going back to the mansion now and meekly eating breakfast would look even more ridiculous.
“―――Might as well go to school.”
With a sigh, I start down the hill toward the residential district.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I don't believe it.
I look like a complete idiot."
But, to go back to the mansion to eat breakfast sounds more dumb.
"---School, then?"
Letting out a sigh, I go downhill along the residential street.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
……俺の部屋にやってくる者がいるとすれば、それは琥珀さんか翡翠、それか秋葉の三人ぐらいなものだろう。
　翡翠や琥珀さんだったらノックをして入ってくるだろうから、消去法であとは秋葉だけだと思うんだけど……。
「…………秋葉？」
　ベッドから体を起こして声をかける。
　月明かりは弱々しく、部屋の隅は暗がりになってよく見えない。
　目を凝らして様子を見てみたが、人影らしきものはなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
If anyone would come into my room, it could only be Kohaku, Hisui, or Akiha.
Hisui and Kohaku would knock first, leaving only Akiha by elimination.
“Akiha?”
I sit up in bed and call to her.
The moonlight is weak, leaving the corners of the room drowned in shadow.
I peer into them but see no figure anywhere.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… If someone is coming to my room, it either has to be Kohaku-san, Hisui or Akiha.
Hisui and Kohaku-san would probably knock so that leaves only Akiha……
"…………… Akiha?"
I sit up in bed and call out.
The moonlight only dimly illuminates the room, so I can hardly see.
I look around, but I don't see anyone's silhouette.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「……気のせい、かな……」
　眠れないものだから神経が過敏になっているのか。
　はあ、と大きく息を吐いてから、ベッドに横になろうとする。
　スタンドライトが勝手に灯った。
「―――――え？」
　いきなりの事でドキリと胸が鳴る。
「……おかしいな。
スイッチを押した覚えはないんだけど……」
　とりあえず電気を消した。
　明日は学校なんだから、いいかげん眠らないとまずいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe I imagined it.”
Has being unable to sleep made my nerves oversensitive?
I let out a long breath and start to lie back down.
The bedside lamp turns on by itself.
“―――――Huh?”
My heart jumps at the sudden light.
“That’s strange. I don’t remember touching the switch.”
I turn it off again.
I have school tomorrow, and I really need to get some sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Must be my imagination……"
My mind must be a little dull from lack of sleep.
I let out a breath and roll over onto my side.
The light on my nightstand comes on.
"------Eh?"
My heart skips a beat.
"…… That's strange.
I don't remember turning that on……"
I turn off the light.
I have school tomorrow, so I need to get some sleep.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「だめよ兄さん。
電気はそのままにしてくれないと」
　唐突に。
　背後から、落ちついた声が聞こえた。
「―――――！」
　振りかえる。
　と、そこには――――
　秋葉と、
　琥珀さんの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, Brother. You’ll have to leave the light on.”
Suddenly.
A calm voice speaks from behind me.
“―――――!”
I spin around.
And there――――
Akiha,
And Kohaku beside her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That won't do, Nii-san.
We'll need the lights on for this."
Suddenly,
from behind me, a calm voice calls out.
"-----!"
I turn around.
There, I see----
Akiha,
and Kohaku-san.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……？
　なんだよこんな夜更けに。
琥珀さんも一緒っていう事は何かあったのか？」
　ベッドから体を起こして問い掛ける。
　二人は軽く目配せをした後、おかしそうに微笑した。
「もう、志貴さんったらぼんやりしすぎですよ。
秋葉さまとわたしは何かあるからこうしてやってきているんじゃないですか」
　クスクスと琥珀さんは笑っている。
「……？」
　何がそんなにおかしいのか、俺にはよく解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…? What are you doing here this late? And with Kohaku—did something happen?”
I sit up and ask.
They exchange a quick glance, then smile as though sharing some private joke.
“Honestly, Master Shiki, you can be terribly slow. Miss Akiha and I came because something happened, didn’t we?”
Kohaku giggles.
“…?”
I can’t see what she finds so funny.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha……?
What are you doing here at this hour?
And why is Kohaku-san with you?
Did something happen?"
I slip out of bed as I speak.
After exchanging glances, they laugh.
"Geez Shiki-san, you're too out of it.
Akiha-sama and I are here because there is something."
Kohaku-san giggles.
"……?"
I don't understand what's so funny.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「琥珀、そんなに笑っては兄さんに失礼でしょう。
気持ちは解るけど、あまり兄さんを脅かしてはダメよ。
愉しみは後にとっておくものだっていうでしょう？」
「あ、すみません秋葉さま。
志貴さんがあんまりにも解ってらっしゃらないから、可愛くて、つい」
「……そうね。
確かに兄さんは間延びしすぎてるかな。
こんな夜更けに私たちが訪れた事の意味にも気がつかないし、ご自分の立場も解っていないようですし。
　そう、まるで悪意を知らない小動物みたい。
純粋で可愛いらしいけど、その分ひどく滑稽だわ」
　なにか、冷たい笑みをうかべて秋葉はこちらを流し見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku, it’s rude to laugh at Brother. I understand the temptation, but don’t frighten him too soon. Pleasure is best saved for later, isn’t it?”
“Oh, forgive me, Miss Akiha. Master Shiki understands so little that I couldn’t help finding him adorable.”
“You’re right. Brother is being exceptionally dull. Two women visit his bedroom in the middle of the night, and he neither grasps the meaning nor understands his own position.
He’s like some little animal that has never encountered malice. Innocent and adorable, and all the more ridiculous for it.”
Akiha gives me a sidelong look, a cold smile on her lips.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku, laughing like that is rude to Nii-san.
I understand how you feel, but you shouldn't surprise him too much.
We have to save the fun for later, right?"
"Oh, forgive me Akiha-sama.
He's just so cute when he doesn't understand simple things like this, so I couldn't help it."
"…… That's true.
Certainly Nii-san is a bit dense.
I mean, not even realizing why the two of us would come here this late at night, not even knowing his own position.
Yes, he's just like an innocent little puppy.
Cute, but clueless."
With a cold smile, Akiha looks my way.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋、葉…………？」
　それで、ようやく二人の態度がおかしい事に気がついた。
　……なんていうんだろう。
悪意は感じられないんだけど、何か企んでいそうな不信感、というんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha?”
Only then do I realize that something is wrong with the way they’re acting.
How should I put it? I don’t feel actual malice from them, but there is something conspiratorial in the air, something I can’t trust.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki, ha…………?"
Seeing her eyes finally makes me understand that there's something wrong with the way they are acting.
…… How should I say it.
I don't sense any hostility, but it feels like they are up to something.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
何か言いたい事があるなら聞くから、早く用件を済ませてくれないか。
明日は学校だし、お互い早く眠らないとまずいだろ」
　とにかく冷静になろう、と落ちついた声で秋葉に話しかける。
「………………」
　何が気に食わないのか、秋葉は黙って俺を睨んできた。
　いや、そればかりか、
「……はあ。
もう少し兄さんが慌ててくれると思ったのですけど、一向にその気になってくださらないなんてショックだわ」
　なんて、俺がここに居るっていう事を無視しているみたいな独り言をぼやいている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, if there’s something you want to say, I’ll listen. Just tell me what you came for. We both have school tomorrow, so we ought to get to sleep.”
Trying to remain calm, I address her in an even voice.
“…”
Whatever has displeased her, Akiha says nothing and glares at me.
No, more than that,
“…I expected Brother to be a little more flustered, but I’m rather hurt that he refuses to get into the proper spirit.”
She complains as though I weren’t even present.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, if you have something to say, I'll listen, so just go ahead.
We have school tomorrow, so we should go to bed early."
I tell her this as coolly as I can.
"………………"
She stares at me without saying a word; she's not happy with something.
No, more than that…
Akiha sighs.
"…… I thought Nii-san would be a little more flustered, but I'm a bit shocked that he's not getting in the mood."
She's talking as if I'm not even here.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「――――？
　あの、秋葉。
さっきから何を言いたいのかよく解らないんだけど……」
「もう。
兄さんは有間の家でどんな教育を受けていたんですか。
　いい？
　仮にも夜中に異性が部屋にやってきているのよ？
　年頃の殿方ならそれだけで気を昂ぶらせるのに、兄さんったらいつも通りなんですもの。
女としてショックを受けるのは当然でしょう」
　じろり、と睨みつけてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――? Akiha. I haven’t understood a word you’ve been saying.”
“Honestly. What did the Arimas teach you, Brother?
Listen. Two women have entered your room in the middle of the night. Any young man your age would be excited by that alone. Yet you are behaving exactly as usual, so of course I find that wounding as a woman.”
She fixes me with a glare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----?
Um, Akiha.
I still don't know what you are trying to say, but……"
"Geez, Nii-san.
Just what kind of upbringing did you have at the Arima household?
Look, someone of the opposite sex is in your room at night.
A gentleman of your age should be excited just by that, but you're acting like normal.
It's just natural for a woman like me to be shocked by that."
She glares at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「……あのな、秋葉。
そりゃあ俺だって女の子が部屋にいたら意識するけど、おまえや琥珀さんは別だろ。
俺たちは兄妹なんだから別にこんなのは特別なことじゃないし、琥珀さんだって毎晩見回りに来るじゃないか」
　そう、だからこんなコトは驚くべきことじゃない。
　秋葉は妹なんだし、琥珀さんは使用人だ。
　二人が俺の部屋にやってくる事なんて特別なコトじゃないんだから、別に俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, Akiha. Of course I would be conscious of a woman in my room, but you and Kohaku are different. You are my sister, and Kohaku makes her rounds every night, so this is nothing special.”
Exactly.
Akiha is my sister, and Kohaku is a servant.
Neither of them coming into my room is unusual, so I have no reason to――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a minute, Akiha.
I would notice if girls were in my room, but you guys are different.
We're brother and sister, so this isn't a big deal, and Kohaku-san comes to check around every night."
Yeah, that's why this isn't surprising.
Akiha is my little sister, and Kohaku-san is a servant.
It isn't a big deal for them to come here, day or night, so I really don't----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「つまり兄さんにとって、私や琥珀は異性である前に家族だというんですね。
　…………そう。
本当にそう思っていただけているのなら、いいんですけど」
　微笑をしながら秋葉は俺を流し見る。
　その、心まで見透かすような静かな視線。
「――――――――っ」
　どくん、と心臓が高鳴った。
　……なにか、おかしい。
　秋葉に見つめられていると、心の深い所で不安らしき影が広がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In other words, Kohaku and I are family to you before we are women.
Yes. If you truly believe that, I suppose there’s no problem.”
Akiha smiles and looks sidelong at me.
Her quiet gaze seems to see through my heart.
“――――――――”
My heart pounds.
Something is wrong.
Under Akiha’s eyes, a shadow of unease spreads through the deepest part of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"In other words, Nii-san, you see us more as family than you do as women?
………… I see.
It might be good for you if that was really true."
She looks me over again with that strange smile.
That quiet look that seems to look into my mind.
"--------"
Thump.
My heartbeat starts to quicken.
…… There's something, odd.
Being looked at like that by Akiha, I start to feel more and more uneasy.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
……例えば、それは。
　あんまりにも昔と違ってしまった秋葉を、まだ妹として受け入れられていない自分の本心とか。
　自分の世話をしてくれる琥珀さんや翡翠に使用人以上の好意を持ち始めている自分の本音とか。
　そんな、隠している自分の心が見透かれているようで、後ろめたくなってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
For instance.
Akiha has changed so much since childhood that, deep down, I still can’t fully accept her as my little sister.
—or the truth that I’m beginning to care for Kohaku and Hisui, who look after me, as more than servants.
It feels as though she can see every hidden feeling, and guilt forces my eyes away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… For example,
Like my true feelings of not being able to accept Akiha as my sister yet since she's changed so much since I last saw her.
Like my true feelings of me starting to feel more for Hisui and Kohaku-san than I should to just servants.
It feels like she is staring into my hidden feelings and I feel guilty.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「あら、どうしたんですか兄さん？
　急に視線を逸らすなんて、まるで隠し事があるみたい」
「なっ――――」
　カッ、と頬が赤くなるのがわかる。
「そ、そんなコトあるわけないだろ……！
　いいから早く用件を言えよ。
そろそろ眠らないと明日が辛くなるじゃないか」
　秋葉の視線に負けないように、気をしっかり持ち直して見つめ返す。
　と。
　どうしてか、秋葉はつまらなそうにため息をついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Brother? Looking away so suddenly makes it seem as though you have something to hide.”
“Wha――――”
Heat floods my cheeks.
“O-of course I don’t…! Just tell me what you want. If we don’t sleep soon, tomorrow will be miserable.”
I gather myself and meet her gaze, refusing to lose to it.
Then.
For some reason, Akiha gives a disappointed sigh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
What's wrong, Nii-san?
Suddenly looking away like that… you look like you're hiding something."
"Wha----"
I realize my cheeks are getting red.
"O-of course not……!
Just tell me what you want.
If we don't get some sleep soon, tomorrow will be difficult."
Not to be defeated, I match her stare.
And then,
For some reason, Akiha gives a bored sigh.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「がっかりね。
兄さんがどきまぎする顔を楽しみにしていたのに、これじゃつまらないわ。
　まあ、その分余計に兄さんの痴態を鑑賞する事で良しとしましょうか、琥珀」
「は―――――？」
　思わずベッドから立ちあがった。
　ちょっと待て。
　今、秋葉はなんかとんでもないコトを、口にした気がするんだけど――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a shame. I was looking forward to seeing you squirm, but this is no fun at all.
I suppose we will compensate by taking extra time to admire his disgrace, Kohaku.”
“Hah―――――?”
I leap out of bed.
Wait.
Did Akiha just say something completely outrageous――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How disappointing.
I was looking forward to seeing your confused face, Nii-san.
But this is boring.
Well, we'll watch you be embarrassed further, so I guess it will be okay."
"Huh------?"
I climb out of bed.
Wait a minute.
I think she just said something terrible-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、ちょっとおまえ―――」
「あら、そんな体で立ち上がっていいの？
　兄さんはいつも貧血気味なんですから、夜は大人しくしていないといけないわ。
　今だって寝不足のようですし、ここ数日はお疲れだったんでしょう？
　ほら、ちゃんとご自分の身体の事を意識してあげなさい。
兄さんの体はとても弱いんです。
　なら、そんな無理をしていると今すぐ倒れてしまうんじゃない？」
「な―――――――」
―――――どくん、と。
　　　なんでもない秋葉の言葉に、暗りとした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, what the hell are you―――”
“Should you really be standing with a body like yours?
You’re always anemic, Brother, so you ought to keep quiet at night.
You look sleep-deprived, and you’ve been exhausted these past few days, haven’t you? You must pay proper attention to your health. Your body is terribly frail.
If you force yourself like that, won’t you collapse at any moment?”
“Wha―――――――”
―――――Thump.
At her perfectly ordinary words, my vision dims.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, what are---"
"Oh?
Is it okay for you to stand up with your body?
You have anemia, so you should be calm during the night.
You seem to be lacking sleep even now, and you were tired for the past few days, right?
Please pay more attention to your health, Nii-san.
Your body is very weak.
So, won't you collapse if you keep pushing yourself like this?"
"Wha------"
-----Thump.
Her words seem to affect me.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――なに言っているんだ。
いくら俺でも、こんな事ぐらいで、そんな―――」
「そう？
　そのわりにはひどく辛そうなお顔をしていますね。
　例えば……そうね。
呼吸は段々と乱れていって、血の巡りがおかしくなる。
ほら、兄さんは手足の先から少しずつ冷たくなっていくんです」
―――――どくん。
「ちょっと――――止めて、くれ。
そう言われると、なんだか――――」
　本当に、そんな気がして、眩暈がする―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What are you talking about. I’m not so weak that standing up will―――”
“Are you sure? You look terribly unwell.
For example, yes. Your breathing is becoming ragged, and your circulation is failing. There―――your hands and feet are already turning cold from the tips inward.”
―――――thump.
“Stop――――saying that. When you put it that way, somehow――――”
It really starts to feel true, and the room spins―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are you saying?
I'm fine---"
"Oh?
Funny, you're looking a little strained to me.
As if…… yes, your breathing is going to get wilder, your blood will feel sluggish in your veins, and see, your hands and feet are going to start feeling cold."
-----Thump.
"Hey----Stop, it.
If you say that-----"
I really… will feel… dizzy---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「いいえ、それは気のせいではありません。
先程から兄さんの体はおかしかった。
ただ兄さんがそれに気がついていないだけ。
　いい？
　琥珀が笑っていたのはそれを兄さんが気付いていなかったからよ。
　兄さんは今にも倒れてしまいそうなほど弱っているクセに、ご自分の体の事をまったく考慮にいれていないんだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it isn’t your imagination. Your body has been failing all along. You simply failed to notice.
Listen. Kohaku was laughing because you remained oblivious.
You’re weak enough to collapse at any moment, yet you never spare a thought for your own body.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it isn't just your imagination.
Your body was strange from when we came in, but you just never realized it, Nii-san.
See?
Kohaku was laughing earlier because you didn't even notice it yourself.
You're so weak that you might collapse at any time, but you don't ever think of your condition, Nii-san."
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「気付いていないのは本人だけなんて、まるでカカシね。
　ボロボロの服を着て、竹で出来た手足をつけて。
遠くから見れば人間だけど、近くで見れば作り物にすぎない人型みたい」
「な――――――」
　なにを、いきなり。
ワケのわからないコトを、言い出すんだ、秋葉は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“For the man himself to be the only one who doesn’t notice—why, you’re just like a scarecrow.
Dress it in rags and give it limbs of bamboo. From a distance it resembles a man, but up close it’s nothing more than a counterfeit human shape.”
“Wha――――――”
Why, all of a sudden. Why is Akiha saying these incomprehensible things――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You are like a scarecrow, you being the only one not noticing that.
Wearing old clothes, bamboo for arms and legs.
From far away he looks human… but once you look close, it's just something made up to take human form."
"Wha-----"
Why did she suddenly start talking about all this nonsense?-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「もう、まだ気がついてくださらないんですか？
　兄さんはさっきから顔色が真っ青で、思考も磨耗しきっているのよ。
　だっていうのにそれを認めようとしてくれないなんて、本当にカカシみたい。
琥珀もそう思うでしょう？
　兄さんなんて、いつ壊れてもおかしくない飾り物なんだって」
「ばっ……そんな、コト――――」
　ない。
ない、ハズなのに。
　どうして―――本当にくらくらと意識が、途切れて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“You still have not realized?”
“Your face has been deathly pale for some time, and your thoughts are worn to nothing.”
“Yet you refuse to admit it. You really are a scarecrow. Kohaku, do you not agree that Brother is an ornament ready to break at any moment?”
“That cannot be――――”
It isn’t. It can’t be.
Then why―――why is my awareness really spinning, breaking apart―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Really, you still don't understand?
Your face is pale and your mind is numb.
You really are like a scarecrow, that you don't even want to admit to that.
Don't you think so too, Kohaku?
That Nii-san is like an ornament that could break at any time."
"Stu…… That, can't----"
be true.
It can't, but…
Why----why am I really feeling dizzy----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「ほら、もう限界なのよ。
　無理はしないでベッドに倒れる。
　でも意識だけは残ったまま。
　兄さんは手足の自由は利かないけど、意識だけはキチンと残っているの」
「ば―――やめ………、ろって―――」
　ふらり、と体が倒れる。
　その先にはベッドがあって、俺は秋葉の言葉通りに、そのまま――――!w1000

「――――、」
　違う。
俺の体はおかしくなんかない。
　少なくとも今夜は貧血になるような兆候はなかったんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, you’ve reached your limit.
Don’t fight it; fall back onto the bed.
But remain conscious.
Your arms and legs won’t obey you, yet your mind will stay perfectly awake.”
“S―――stop saying that―――”
My body sways and falls.
The bed lies beneath me, and exactly as Akiha commanded, I――――!w1000
“――――”
No. Nothing is wrong with my body.
At least tonight there wasn’t a single warning that my anemia might return―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, you're already at your limit.
Stop pushing yourself and lie down.
But you will stay awake.
You won't be able to move your arms and legs, but you will still be conscious."
"Stu---sto……… p----"
My body collapses.
I'm falling towards the bed, just like Akiha said---

"----"
No.
My body isn't strange.
Because, I didn't have any symptoms of anemia earlier---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「だから、そんな事は関係ないわ。
兄さんの体はいつだって不自由じゃない。
　だから今夜も兄さんの自由になるなんてコトはない。
――――だって。
　兄さんは、元々私の人形なんですから」
「な――――――」
　どさり、とベッドに倒れこむ。
　……結局秋葉の言葉が正しかったのか。
　俺は眩暈に襲われた時のように、そのまま意識を失ってしまった―――!w500
entries.maoEnglish:
“That has nothing to do with it. Your body is perfectly sound, Brother.
But that does not mean it will be yours to command tonight.
――――Because.
Brother, you have always been my doll.”
“Wha――――――”
I collapse heavily onto the bed.
Perhaps Akiha was right after all.
As though overcome by one of my dizzy spells, I lose consciousness―――!w500
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I told you, it does not matter.
Your body is always under constraint.
So, you have no control tonight either.
----Because.
You've always been my puppet, Nii-san."
"Wha-----"
I fall onto the bed.
…… In the end, Akiha was right.
Just like whenever I have an anemic spell, I lose consciousness---
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「あ――――れ」
　……いや、違う。
　確かに体は痺れたままで動かないけど、意識だけは残っている。
　ぼう、として物事がよく考えられないけど、確かに俺は起きている。
「いつも、の、貧血と、違う……」
　ぼんやりと天井を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh――――”
No, that isn’t it.
My body is numb and motionless, but my awareness remains.
My thoughts are fogged, yet I am unmistakably awake.
“This isn’t like my anemia”
I stare blankly at the ceiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hu----h?"
…… No, this time it's different.
My entire body is numb, but I'm still conscious.
I can't really concentrate, but I'm awake.
"Different, than my, usual, anemia……"
I stare blankly at the ceiling.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま？
　あの、少しやりすぎたのではないですか……？
　志貴さん、本当に貧血ぎみになってしまっていますけど……」
　……琥珀さん、の声。
「なに言ってるのよ琥珀。
夕食にあなたがクスリなんて混ぜるから、兄さんが前後不覚に陥っているんじゃない。
　私は少しだけ眠らせようと思っただけです。
それだけだったら私一人で十分ですもの」
　……秋葉の声はどこか不満そうだ。
「……ちょっと、二人、とも」
　横になったまま声をあげる。
　手足は動いてくれない。
なんとか首をまげて、秋葉と琥珀さんを見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha? Perhaps we overdid it a little? Master Shiki truly does seem anemic now.”
Kohaku’s voice.
“What are you talking about, Kohaku. He’s barely conscious because you put drugs in his dinner.
I only meant to let him sleep for a little while. I could have managed that much alone.”
Akiha sounds almost petulant.
“Hey, both of you”
With all my strength.
My limbs refuse to move. I manage to turn my head and look at Akiha and Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama?
Um, did we overdo it……?
He looks like he really has anemia……"
…… Kohaku-san's, voice.
"What are you talking about, Kohaku?
You're the one who put some drugs into his dinner, so he will be a little dazed.
I only wanted him to sleep a bit.
I could have done that myself."
…… Akiha sounds dissatisfied.
"…… Hey, you two."
I call out to them, still lying down.
My arms and legs won't work, but I somehow manage to turn my neck and look at both of them.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「はあ。
志貴さんは純真ですから暗示にかかりやすかったんですねー。
まあ、そこが志貴さんのいいところなんでしょうけど」
　……俺の声は無視されたみたいだ。
「そうね。
けど琥珀、あんまりに純真すぎるものって、こう、嗜虐心をかきたてられない？」
　……ちらり、と秋葉の目がこちらに向いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh dear. Master Shiki is so innocent that suggestion works especially well on him. Then again, that innocence is part of his charm.”
Apparently my voice has been ignored.
“True. But Kohaku, doesn’t such perfect innocence make you want to hurt it?”
Akiha glances toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san is very pure, so I guess suggestion seems to work easily on him.
I suppose that's a good trait about him too."
…… It seems they are ignoring me.
"Yes, but Kohaku, when they are too pure… don't they make you want to dominate them?"
…… She looks over at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　目が合った瞬間、ぞくりと、冷たい感覚が背中に走った。
　肌の下、肉の中、背骨の中心を冷たいモノが駆けあがる。
　脳髄が痺れたのか。
　秋葉のあの瞳に見つめられていると、時間が止まって、空間が凍死してしまったみたいに、全身が締めつけられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
The moment our eyes meet, cold races up my back.
Something cold climbs beneath the skin, through the flesh, along the very center of my spine.
Has my brain gone numb?
Under Akiha’s gaze, time seems to stop and the room itself freezes to death, constricting my entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
As soon as our eyes meet, I feel a chill run up my spine.
Coldness sinks into my skin, burrowing under my flesh and into my very core.
I feel as if my brain is becoming numb.
My body feels tied up as she looks at me with those eyes, as if time has stopped and the whole area has frozen up.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「あ――――秋、葉？」
「………………………」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　……どくん、と心臓が痙攣する。
　秋葉は無表情なのに、どうして―――あんな、獲物を狙うような冷たい目をしているように見えるのか―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha――――?”
“………………………”
She says nothing.
My heart spasms.
Her face is blank, so why―――why do her eyes seem so cold, like a predator sighting prey―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----Aki, ha?"
"………………"
She doesn't say a word.
…… Thump.
My heart beats loudly.
Her face is entirely devoid of expression, but her eyes---her eyes glow like a predator stalking her prey-----
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「うーん、嗜虐心、ですか。
わたしは志貴さんの困ったお顔も嬉しがってくださるお顔も大好きですから、秋葉さまのおっしゃられるコトは分かりかねますねー」
　……秋葉の横で首をかしげる琥珀さん。
　秋葉は琥珀さんを見る事さえせず、こっちを見つめたまま頷いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm, the urge to hurt him? I love Master Shiki’s troubled face and his happy one equally, so I’m afraid I don’t quite understand what you mean, Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku tilts her head beside her.
Without so much as looking at Kohaku, Akiha continues staring at me and nods.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Domination, huh?
Well, I like seeing his troubled face as much as his happy face, so I understand what you mean, Akiha-sama."
…… Next to Akiha, Kohaku-san tilts her head.
Akiha doesn't look at Kohaku-san, but she gives a small nod.
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「そうね、例えるなら絵画かな。
　ねえ琥珀、素晴らしい、というわけではないけど、よく出来た作品があるとするでしょう？
　その絵はよく出来ているから不満はないのだけど、よく出来ているだけで面白みも何もないから好きになれない。
　そういう場合、どうしたらそれを自分の中で特別なモノにできるか、わかる？」
「うーん、そうですね……ちょっと、わたしには分かりません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Think of a painting.
Suppose you had one that wasn’t a masterpiece, but was very skillfully made. You could find no fault with it, yet mere skill has no charm, so you could never love it.
Do you know how you might make such a painting special to you?”
“Hmm, let me think; I’m afraid I don’t know.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's see, it's like a painting.
Hey Kohaku, let's say there's a painting that is well done, but not magnificent.
Because it's well done, you don't have any complaints, but you can't like it because it's just well done and doesn't have anything interesting about it.
In that case, do you know how to make it special for you, Kohaku?"
"Umm, let's see…… I don't know, Akiha-sama."
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:
「簡単よ。
そのよく出来た絵の上に絵の具を塗りたくって台無しにしてしまえばいい。
　結果、そのよく出来た絵は失われてただのガラクタになるでしょう。
けどその過程、自分のものであった『よく出来た作品』が壊れていく時間は素晴らしいものなんじゃないかしら。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s simple. Smear paint all over the finished picture and ruin it.
“The fine work would be lost, reduced to rubbish. But the time spent watching a fine work that belonged to you being destroyed—wouldn’t that be exquisite?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's simple.
You just have to paint over the painting and make it worthless.
As a result, that good painting will turn into trash.
But the process, breaking what is "good" for you, isn't it wonderful?
entries.scriptLabel: 5 / Blue Mark of Sin · 5 / Red Remnants

entries.japanese:

I can get up, and I won't go back to sleep.
I'll change and go to the sitting room as soon as you leave."
"Shiki-sama--Are you hurt and unable to stand……?"
Hisui approaches me out of worry.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いや、そんなコトはない。
十分に立ってる、じゃなくて立てるから、気にしないでいい」
　ずりずり、とナメクジみたいにシーツを引きずって、四つんばいの姿勢で翡翠から離れていく。
　ベッドをバリケードにして、翡翠と十分に距離をとった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it is nothing like that. I am standing just fine―――I mean, I can stand just fine, so do not worry.”
Dragging the sheet behind me like a slug, I crawl away from Hisui on all fours.
Then I put the bed between us as a barricade and gain some much-needed distance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, that's not it.
I'm standing----I mean I can stand, so don't worry about it."
I crawl pulling my sheets like a slug, and gain some distance from her.
Using the bed as a barrier, I get far enough away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……では、失礼します。
食堂で朝食の準備をいたしますので、着替えてからおいでください」
　かなり疑問に思っただろうが、翡翠は一礼して部屋から出ていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I will excuse myself and prepare breakfast in the dining room, so please come once you are dressed.”
Though she must find the whole thing deeply puzzling, Hisui bows and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then, please excuse me.
I will prepare your breakfast, so please come after you change."
She has got to be suspicious, but she bows and leaves the room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　ああ、びっくりした。
　夢の内容にも驚きだったけど、翡翠にその時の寝顔を見られていたっていうのも心臓に悪い。
　……これというのも、アルクェイドがあんなコトをしてくるからいけないのだ。
「あいつ、いなくなった後でも迷惑かけるなんて、ほんとに―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Hah”
That nearly stopped my heart.
The dream itself was shocking enough, but learning that Hisui watched my face through it was even worse.
This is all Arcueid’s fault for doing those things to me.
“Causing trouble even after she is gone, she really is―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
I was so surprised.
The contents of my dream were surprising enough, but knowing Hisui saw me while I was dreaming is very troubling.
…… It's all Arcueid's fault for doing something like that.
"Even now she's being bothersome, really----"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
ほんとに―――なんだろう？
　そのあとの言葉が続かない。
「…………？」
　なんて言いたかったんだろう、俺。
　なんだか自分の感情さえ確かじゃなくて、胸にもやもやとしたものを感じながら、とりあえず着替えて居間に行くことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
What could I even call her―――?
The next words refuse to come.
“…?”
What was I trying to say?
Unable to trust even my own feelings, I dress and head to the sitting room with something vague and restless lodged in my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Really----really what?
I can't finish.
"………………?"
What did I want to say just now?
Not even able to confirm my own feelings, I decide to change and head to the sitting room with a vague feeling in my chest.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
気持ちを十分に落ち着かせて居間に移動する。
　居間では、やっぱりすでに秋葉がソファーに座って紅茶を優雅に飲んでいた。
「おはようございます兄さん。
今朝は早いんですね」
　そんなにこっちが早起きしたことが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で声をかけてくる。
「ああ、おはよう。
今朝は、まあ色々とあってさ」
　言って―――また、アルクェイドの肌の感触が蘇ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only after thoroughly composing myself do I enter the sitting room.
As expected, Akiha is already seated on the sofa, drinking tea with effortless elegance.
“Good morning, Brother. You are up early today.”
Apparently delighted by the mere fact that I rose early, Akiha greets me with a smile.
“Morning. A few things happened.”
At the words―――the feeling of Arcueid’s skin comes rushing back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After calming down sufficiently, I head to the sitting room.
As usual, Akiha is sitting on the sofa, elegantly sipping tea.
"Good morning, Nii-san.
You are certainly up early this morning."
She must be happy I woke up because she greets me with a smile.
"Yeah, good morning.
There were, well, a lot of things going on this morning."
As soon as I say that--I suddenly recall the memory of Arcueid's skin.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「うっ―――」
　まずい。
自分でもどうしようもないぐらい、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
「兄さん―――？」
　がた、という物音。
「どうしたの？
　顔が赤いけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　すぐ間近にやってきて、秋葉は下から俺の顔を覗きこむ。
　だから、下から見上げるっていうアングルは、その―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urk―――”
This is bad. I can feel my face reddening beyond all control.
“Brother―――?”
A chair shifts.
“What is wrong? Your face is red, but do you have a fever?”
“―――――!”
Akiha comes right up to me and peers into my face from below.
That angle, looking up at me from below, is, well―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh--"
This isn't good.
I can tell my face is blushing beyond my control.
"Nii-san--?"
A brief clamor.
"What's wrong?
Your face is red, do you have a fever?"
"-----!"
Rushing over to me, she looks up at me from below.
But--In doing so, from this angle, um----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――はあ、本当に熱があるみたいですね。
琥珀、ちょっと来て。
兄さん、体の具合がよくないみたいなの」
　秋葉は食堂に向かって声をあげる。
　厨房では琥珀さんが俺の朝食を作っている最中なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hah, you really do seem feverish. Kohaku, come here. Brother does not seem well.”
Akiha calls toward the dining room.
Kohaku is presumably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sighs.
"You do seem to have a fever.
Kohaku, come quickly.
Nii-san doesn't seem to be well."
Akiha calls out to the dining room.
Kohaku-san has to be preparing my breakfast in the kitchen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いい―――！
　た、ただの風邪だから、そんなに気にしなくていい！」
「風邪ならなおさら放っておけませんっ。
些細な病気でも兄さんには大事でしょう。
免疫や抵抗力が人より低いんですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am fine―――! I-it is only a cold, so do not worry!”
“If it is a cold, that is all the more reason not to ignore it. Even a minor illness can become serious for you, Brother. Your immune system is weaker than other people’s.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine--!
It's just a minor cold, so don't worry!"
"If it is a cold, then I can't let it go by.
For you, a trivial illness is a big deal.
The strength of your immune system is much lower than most people's."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
秋葉は呆れながら、スッ、と自分の手を俺のひたいに当てた。
　ひやりと冷たい、華奢な手のひらの感触―――
「っっっっっっっっ！」
　まずい。
　まずいので、秋葉の手を払って、ロビーへと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
With an exasperated look, Akiha places her hand against my forehead.
The cool touch of her slender palm―――
“――――――――!”
This is bad.
I knock Akiha’s hand away and bolt for the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha seems to be fed up and puts her hand on my forehead.
The sensation of her cool, delicate hand--
"!!!!!!!!"
This isn't good.
This isn't good at all, so I break loose and run out to the lobby.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
どたたたたたたたた。
「志貴さま？
　朝食はもうお済みになられたのですか？」
「いや、そうじゃないけど―――ええっと、俺の鞄は？」
「こちらですが、もう登校されるのですか？」
　こくん、と頷いて翡翠の手から鞄を奪い取る。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りはいいから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
“Master Shiki? Have you finished breakfast already?”
“No, but―――where is my schoolbag?”
“Here, but are you leaving for school already?”
I nod, snatch it from Hisui’s hand, and head for the door.
“I’m off! You do not have to see me out!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Footsteps echo as I dash off.
"Shiki-sama?
Have you finished your breakfast already?"
"No, that's not it, but--Um, where's my bag?"
"I have your bag here.
Are you already going to school?"
Nodding, I snatch my bag from Hisui.
"I'm going.
Don't worry about seeing me off!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、さっきからヘンです。
熱があるっていうのに何をしてるんですかっ」
「ああもう、なんでもないんだって！
　なんでもないんだから、俺はこのまま学校に行く！
　朝飯はかってになんとかするからほっといてくれ！」
「ほっとけって―――ちょっと、兄さん！？」
　どたたたたたたたた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, you have been acting strangely all morning. What are you doing when you have a fever?”
“I told you, it is nothing! Since it is nothing, I am going to school. I will find breakfast somewhere, so leave me alone!”
“Leave you alone―――wait, Brother!?”
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you've been acting strange.
What are you doing with a fever like that?"
"Geez, I told you it's nothing!
Since it's nothing, I'm going to school!
I'll have breakfast later, so leave me alone!"
"Leave you alone--hey, Nii-san!?"
The sound of my fleeing footsteps is my only response.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――――」
　いくら秋葉でも、ここまできてしまえば追いかけてくるなんてコトはありえまい。
　子供じゃないんだから、登校するといった人間を捕まえにくることなんてしないはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Even Akiha will not chase me this far.
She is not a child, so surely she will not run after someone who already announced he was going to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sigh----"
Even if it is Akiha, she wouldn't chase me this far.

Since we're not kids anymore, she won't stop me from going to school.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――ふう」
　大きく息をはいて、ようやく落ち着いた。
「………って、なんで逃げてるんだ、俺」
　落ち着いたら冷静になった。
　別段悪いことなんかしてないんだから、逃げるように出てくる必要なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Whew”
One long breath finally calms me.
“Why am I running away?”
Once calm, I can think again.
I have not done anything wrong, so there was no need to flee the house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Whew."
I take a deep breath and am finally able to calm down.
"……… What am I running away for?"
Once I calm down, I can think clearly.
I didn't do anything wrong, so there was no need for me to run away like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
まるっきりバカみたいじゃないか、これじゃ」
　かといって、いまさら屋敷に戻って朝ごはんをいただくというのは、もっと間が抜けていると思う。
「―――学校に行くか」
　はあ、とため息をついて、住宅街に続く坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Unbelievable. I look like a complete idiot.”
Going back to the mansion now and meekly eating breakfast would look even more ridiculous.
“―――Might as well go to school.”
With a sigh, I start down the hill toward the residential district.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I don't believe it.
I look like a complete idiot."
But, to go back to the mansion to eat breakfast sounds more dumb.
"--To school, then?"
Letting out a sigh, I go downhill along the residential street.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
………、………………、………………………。
「―――あ――さ」
　ぼんやりとしていた意識が目を覚ます。
　窓からは陽射しが差し込んできていて、部屋は暖かな雰囲気に包まれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
……………………….
“―――Morn――ing”
My hazy mind drifts awake.
Sunlight pours through the window, wrapping the room in warmth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………, ………………, ……………………
"--Mor--ning?"
I dazedly open my eyes.
Sunshine pours in from the window, enveloping the room with a warm atmosphere.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　じっと、自分の両手を見る。
　両手にはかすかな発汗。
体中に汗をかいていて、なんだか熱帯夜の中にいたみたいだ。
　くわえて、呼吸はなんだかぜいぜいと乱れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I stare at my hands.
My palms are damp. Sweat covers my whole body as though I spent the night in tropical heat.
My breathing comes in ragged gasps as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I stare down at my hands.
They are a little sweaty.
My body is drenched in sweat as well, as if last night was incredibly hot.
What's more, I'm panting heavily.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……………えっと」
　……オーケー、落ち着こう。
　まず呼吸を平静に整えて、目を閉じる。
　ここは自分の部屋。
　時間は朝の七時前。
　部屋にいるのは自分だけだし、先輩の姿なんか当然のようにない。
　先輩の言っていたとおり。
　さっきまでのコトはみんな夢だったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me see”
All right, calm down.
I steady my breathing and close my eyes.
This is my room.
It is just before seven in the morning.
I am alone, and of course Ciel is nowhere to be seen.
Just as Ciel told me.
Everything that happened was a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Um."
…… Alright, I need to calm down.
First, I catch my breath and then close my eyes.
This is my room.
It is before seven in the morning.
I am the only one here, and of course Senpai is nowhere to be found.
Just as she said,
it was all a dream.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　そう、わかっている。
　夢だってわかっている。
冷静になってみれば、そもそも先輩があんなコトをしにくるはずがないんだ。
　その時点で、昨日の出来事は破綻している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Yes, I know.
I know it was a dream. Calmly considered, Ciel could never have come to me and done such things.
That fact alone renders yesterday’s events impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
Yeah, I know.
I know it was a dream.
Now that I'm calm, I know she wouldn't ever do anything like that.
Then that means… what happened last night was not real.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　ほう、と胸の中にたまった空気を吐き出した。
　……それでもたしかに、体には先輩の感触がのこっている。
　下着姿で後ろから抱きついてきた胸の感触とか、股間にふれていた指の感触とか。
　夢だってわかってるのに―――感覚がリアルすぎて、なんだか現実のように思えてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah”
I let the air gathered in my chest escape.
Even so, my body still holds the sensation of Ciel.
Her breasts against my back as she embraced me in her underwear, and her fingers touching me between the legs.
Though I know it was a dream―――the sensations were so real that they feel like memory.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hhaa--ahhhh."
I let out a deep breath.
…… All the same, I definitely still feel vestiges of her touch lingering on my body.
Like the sensation of her breasts as she embraced me from behind in her underwear, and her dancing fingers on my penis.
I know it was a dream--but it felt too real; it makes me think it was real.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
……それでも、今のは間違いなく夢なんだ。
　それが喜ぶべきものなのか、それとも残念なことなのか、正直どっちだって判断できないけど、俺のかってな妄想にすぎない。
　けど、
entries.maoEnglish:
Even so, it was unquestionably a dream.
I cannot tell whether to feel relieved or disappointed, but it was nothing more than my own selfish fantasy.
But,
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… All the same, it has got to be a dream.
I can't tell if that's something I should be happy or disappointed about, but it's just all my imagination anyway.
But,
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――なんで―――」
　あんな夢を、見たんだろう。
　俺にとって、先輩はたしかに大切な友人だとは思うけど、あんな夢をみるぐらい、その――先輩を女として見ているんだろうか、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Why―――”
Why did I dream that?
Ciel is certainly a dear friend, but does a dream like that mean I, well――see her as a woman?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Why--"
Why did I see that kind of dream?
I know Senpai is my important friend; but does having a dream like that mean I see her as a woman too?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――――う」
　思い出して、やけにリアルだったシエル先輩の肌の感覚が甦る。
　これが現実なんだ、と確かめるために自分の腕を抱く。
　……ああ、たしかにこれが現実。
　シエル先輩の肌は、こんな男の肌とはもう根本的に違って、柔らかで、温かかったし。
「……おまけに、すっごくいじわるだった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Ugh”
The memory brings the uncannily real sensation of Ciel’s skin rushing back.
I grip my own arm to assure myself that this is reality.
Yes, this is real.
Ciel’s skin was fundamentally unlike a man’s, soft and warm in a way mine could never be.
“And she was unbelievably mean…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Uh."
Just thinking of it, the overly real memory of her skin rushes back.
To make sure I'm not still dreaming, I hug myself.
…… Yeah, this is definitely real.
Her skin was so fundamentally different from a guy's skin like this… so soft, so warm.

"…… And she was really mean."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
―――思い出すだけで呼吸が荒くなる。
　……まあ、いろいろとひどい目にあった気がするけど、たまらなく気持ちが良かったのは事実なわけで。
　先輩を夢の中で抱くなんて、それだけで先輩に対して後ろめたいっていうのに、俺はむにゃむにゃと夢の内容を思い出して呆、としてしまった。
　そこへ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The memory alone makes my breathing quicken.
I seem to recall being put through all manner of torment, but it also felt unbearably good.
Dreaming of embracing Ciel is shameful enough, yet I sit here dazed, savoring every hazy detail.
And then.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--Just thinking about it makes my breath go wild.
…… Well, maybe I went through a lot of bad things, but it's true that it did feel exceedingly good.
I should feel a bit guilty dreaming about doing that to Senpai, but I recall the dream and just sit there thinking about it.
But then,
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま」
「うわあああああ！」
　ばたばた、と逃げるようにベッドから転がり落ちた。
　いや、実際逃げようとしたんだけど、結果的にはシーツごと床に転げ落ちただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki.”
“Waaaaaaaaah!”
I flailed out of bed as though fleeing for my life.
I had, in fact, tried to flee; all I accomplished was rolling onto the floor tangled in the sheet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama."
"Uwaaaaaa!"
I flail around off my bed as if trying to escape.
No--in fact I was trying to escape, but it just ended up with me landing on the floor with the sheets.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「ひ、ひひ、翡翠……っ！？
　い、いったいいつからそこに！？」
「志貴さまがお目覚めになられる前からですが」
いつも通りの無表情さで翡翠は即答する。
　床の上、シーツにくるまったまま、立ちあがる事もできずに翡翠の顔を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H-H-Hisui?! H-how long have you been there?!”
“Since before Master Shiki awoke.”
Hisui answers at once, wearing her usual expressionless face.
Still wrapped in the sheet on the floor, I can only stare up at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi, Hihi, Hisui…… !?
H, how long have you been there!?"
"Since before you awoke, Shiki-sama."
She speaks with her usual lack of expression.
Still lying on the floor tangled in the sheets and unable to stand, I look up at Hisui's face.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……俺が起きる前、から……」
―――ということは、もしかして。
　俺は、あんな夢を見ている時の寝顔を、翡翠に見られてたっていうんだろうか―――
　ぼっ、と自分でも自分の顔が真っ赤になったのがわかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Before I woke up…”
―――Which meant, could it be?
Had Hisui been watching my sleeping face while I had that dream―――
Heat burst across my cheeks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Before I… woke up……"
--Then, that means…
Hisui saw my face when I was having that dream?
My face turns deep red.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
翡翠は相変わらず無表情で、自分からは何も話しかけてこようとしない。
「その……俺、なんかヘンだった……？」
「それは、わたしの口からご説明するのははばかられます」
「あ―――う」
　……やっぱり、なんかすごい寝姿をしていたみたいだ。
「ですが、志貴さまがどうしてもとおっしゃられるのなら、出来るだけ緻密にご説明いたしますが？」
「……いい。
説明しなくていいです、はい……」
　顔を赤くして、消え入りそうな声で答えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui remains impassive and makes no attempt to speak.
“Was I acting strangely…?”
“It would be improper for me to describe it.”
“Ah―――uh”
So I really was doing something spectacular in my sleep.
“However, if Master Shiki insists, I can describe it in as much detail as possible.” “No. Please do not explain…”
Red-faced, I answer in a voice that nearly fades away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui just stands there, expressionless as usual, and makes no attempt to speak.
"Um…… did I look… strange……?"
"I do not wish to describe it."
"Ah--h"
…… I knew it.
I must have looked really weird.
"But, if you insist, Shiki-sama, I can describe as accurately as I can."
"…… No, you don't have to do that……"
My face still flushed, I speak in a fading voice.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あの、翡翠さん？」
　コホン、と咳払いをして場を切り返す、
　……『さん』がついているのは、動物が自分のおなかを見せるのと同意語だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Miss Hisui?”
I clear my throat and try to reset the conversation,
Adding ‘Miss’ to her name is the same as an animal exposing its belly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Hisui-san?"
I give a cough to clear the silence.
…… Adding "san" to her name is a clear sign of my vulnerability.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「その、着替えるから外に出てもらえない？」
―――というか、とにかく気恥ずかしいので外に出てもらいたい。
　っていうのに、今日にかぎって翡翠はこっちの言い分を聞いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, Master Shiki?”
“I need to change, so could you wait outside?”
―――More to the point, I was mortified and simply wanted her out of the room.
Yet today of all days, Hisui refused to listen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it, Shiki-sama?"
"Um…… I'm going to change, so would you mind waiting outside?"
--Or rather, I'm so embarrassed I just want her to leave.
But Hisui doesn't obey today of all days.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまが起き上がられるのを見届けましたら退室させていただきますが」
「……！」
　じょっ、じょじょじょ冗談じゃない！
　なんだって俺がベッドから転げ落ちてもシーツなんかで体を包んでると思ってるんだ！
　それもこれも、まだいきり立っている股間のモノを隠してるからじゃないか！
entries.maoEnglish:
“I will leave once I have seen Master Shiki rise.”
“…!”
N-no, no, no, absolutely not!
Why did she think I was still huddled in this sheet after tumbling out of bed?
Because I was hiding the thing still standing rigid between my legs!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Once I can confirm you are awake, I will leave the room, Shiki-sama."
"……!"
Huh?
Is, is is is she joking!?
Why does she think I'm covering myself up in these sheets!?
It's to hide something that's still standing!
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「い、いいから外に出て。
ちゃんと一人で起きれるし、二度寝したりはしないから。
翡翠が外に出たらすぐに着替えて居間に行くよ」
「志貴さま―――お体を打たれてお立ちになれないのですか……？」
　翡翠は心配そうに近寄ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“J-just go outside. I can get up by myself, and I promise I will not fall asleep again. The moment you leave, I will change and come to the sitting room.”
“Master Shiki―――did you strike yourself and become unable to stand…?”
Hisui comes closer, looking concerned.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I'm fine, so please leave.
I can get up, and I won't go back to sleep.
I'll change and go to the sitting room as soon as you leave."
"Shiki-sama--Are you hurt and unable to stand……?"
Hisui approaches me out of worry.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いや、そんなコトはない。
十分に立ってる、じゃなくて立てるから、気にしないでいい」
　ずりずり、とナメクジみたいにシーツを引きずって、四つんばいの姿勢で翡翠から離れていく。
　ベッドをバリケードにして、翡翠と十分に距離をとった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it is nothing like that. I am standing just fine―――I mean, I can stand just fine, so do not worry.”
Dragging the sheet behind me like a slug, I crawl away from Hisui on all fours.
Then I put the bed between us as a barricade and gain some much-needed distance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, that's not it.
I'm standing----I mean I can stand, so don't worry about it."
I crawl pulling my sheets like a slug, and gain some distance from her.
Using the bed as a barrier, I get far enough away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……では、失礼します。
食堂で朝食の準備をいたしますので、着替えてからおいでください」
　かなり疑問に思っただろうが、翡翠は一礼して部屋から出ていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I will excuse myself and prepare breakfast in the dining room, so please come once you are dressed.”
Though she must find the whole thing deeply puzzling, Hisui bows and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then, please excuse me.
I will prepare your breakfast, so please come after you change."
She has got to be suspicious, but she bows and leaves the room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　ああ、びっくりした。
　夢の内容にも驚きだったけど、翡翠にその時の寝顔を見られていたっていうのも心臓に悪い。
　……これというのも、シエル先輩に対してあんな夢を見た自分がいけないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Hah”
That nearly stopped my heart.
The dream itself was shocking enough, but learning that Hisui watched my face through it was even worse.
Was this all my own fault for dreaming that way about Ciel?
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
I was so surprised.
The contents of my dream were surprising enough, but knowing Hisui saw me while I was dreaming is very troubling.
…… Or is it my own fault for having that kind of dream about Senpai?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……自業自得かな。
先輩みたいないい人を相手にして、なんて夢を見るんだろ、俺は」
　はあ、と自己嫌悪のため息をつく。
　けど、当分。
今夜の夢は忘れられないで残っていそうな予感がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I suppose I brought it on myself. How could I dream something like that about someone as kind as Ciel?”
I sigh in self-disgust.
Still, for some time. I have a feeling tonight’s dream will remain with me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I guess it is my fault.
With a good person like Senpai--why did I have a dream like that?"
I give a sigh of self-loathing.
But, I can tell that I won't forget that dream any time soon.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
気持ちを十分に落ち着かせて居間に移動する。
　居間では、やっぱりすでに秋葉がソファーに座って紅茶を優雅に飲んでいた。
「おはようございます兄さん。
今朝は早いんですね」
　そんなにこっちが早起きしたことが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で声をかけてくる。
「ああ、おはよう。
今朝は、まあ色々とあってさ」
　言って―――また、先輩の舌の感触が蘇ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only after thoroughly composing myself do I enter the sitting room.
As expected, Akiha is already seated on the sofa, drinking tea with effortless elegance.
“Good morning, Brother. You are up early today.”
Apparently delighted by the mere fact that I rose early, Akiha greets me with a smile.
“Morning. A few things happened.”
At the words―――the feeling of Ciel’s tongue comes rushing back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After calming down sufficiently, I head to the sitting room.
As usual, Akiha is sitting on the sofa, elegantly sipping tea.
"Good morning, Nii-san.
You are certainly up early this morning."
She must be happy I woke up because she greets me with a smile.
"Yeah, good morning.
There were, well, a lot of things going on this morning."
As soon as I say that--I suddenly recall the memory of Senpai's tongue.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「うっ―――」
　まずい。
自分でもどうしようもないぐらい、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
「兄さん―――？」
　がた、という物音。
「どうしたの？
　顔が赤いけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　すぐ間近にやってきて、秋葉は下から俺の顔を覗きこむ。
　だから、下から見上げるっていうアングルは、その―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urk―――”
This is bad. I can feel my face reddening beyond all control.
“Brother―――?”
A chair shifts.
“What is wrong? Your face is red, but do you have a fever?”
“―――――!”
Akiha comes right up to me and peers into my face from below.
That angle, looking up at me from below, is, well―――
