entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh--"
This isn't good.
I can tell my face is blushing beyond my control.
"Nii-san--?"
A brief clamor.
"What's wrong?
Your face is red, do you have a fever?"
"-----!"
Rushing over to me, she looks up at me from below.
But--In doing so, from this angle, um----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――はあ、本当に熱があるみたいですね。
琥珀、ちょっと来て。
兄さん、体の具合がよくないみたいなの」
　秋葉は食堂に向かって声をあげる。
　厨房では琥珀さんが俺の朝食を作っている最中なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hah, you really do seem feverish. Kohaku, come here. Brother does not seem well.”
Akiha calls toward the dining room.
Kohaku is presumably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sighs.
"You do seem to have a fever.
Kohaku, come quickly.
Nii-san doesn't seem to be well."
Akiha calls out to the dining room.
Kohaku-san has to be preparing my breakfast in the kitchen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いい―――！
　た、ただの風邪だから、そんなに気にしなくていい！」
「風邪ならなおさら放っておけませんっ。
些細な病気でも兄さんには大事でしょう。
免疫や抵抗力が人より低いんですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am fine―――! I-it is only a cold, so do not worry!”
“If it is a cold, that is all the more reason not to ignore it. Even a minor illness can become serious for you, Brother. Your immune system is weaker than other people’s.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine--!
It's just a minor cold, so don't worry!"
"If it is a cold, then I can't let it go by.
For you, a trivial illness is a big deal.
The strength of your immune system is much lower than most people's."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
秋葉は呆れながら、スッ、と自分の手を俺のひたいに当てた。
　ひやりと冷たい、華奢な手のひらの感触―――
「っっっっっっっっ！」
　まずい。
　まずいので、秋葉の手を払って、ロビーへと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
With an exasperated look, Akiha places her hand against my forehead.
The cool touch of her slender palm―――
“――――――――!”
This is bad.
I knock Akiha’s hand away and bolt for the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha seems to be fed up and puts her hand on my forehead.
The sensation of her cool, delicate hand--
"!!!!!!!!"
This isn't good.
This isn't good at all, so I break loose and run out to the lobby.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
どたたたたたたたた。
「志貴さま？
　朝食はもうお済みになられたのですか？」
「いや、そうじゃないけど―――ええっと、俺の鞄は？」
「こちらですが、もう登校されるのですか？」
　こくん、と頷いて翡翠の手から鞄を奪い取る。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りはいいから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
“Master Shiki? Have you finished breakfast already?”
“No, but―――where is my schoolbag?”
“Here, but are you leaving for school already?”
I nod, snatch it from Hisui’s hand, and head for the door.
“I’m off! You do not have to see me out!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Footsteps echo as I dash off.
"Shiki-sama?
Have you finished your breakfast already?"
"No, that's not it, but--Um, where's my bag?"
"I have your bag here.
Are you already going to school?"
Nodding, I snatch my bag from Hisui.
"I'm going.
Don't worry about seeing me off!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、さっきからヘンです。
熱があるっていうのになにしてるんですかっ」
「ああもう、なんでもないんだって！
　なんでもないんだから、俺はこのまま学校に行く！
　朝飯はかってになんとかするからほっといてくれ！」
「ほっとけって―――ちょっと、兄さん！？」
　どたたたたたたたた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, you have been acting strangely all morning. What are you doing when you have a fever?”
“I told you, nothing is wrong! I am going to school! I will find breakfast somewhere, so leave me alone!”
“Leave you alone―――Brother, wait!?”
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you've been acting strange.
What are you doing with a fever like that?"
"Geez, I told you it's nothing!
Since it's nothing, I'm going to school!
I'll have breakfast later, so leave me alone!"
"Leave you alone--hey, Nii-san!?"
The sound of my fleeing footsteps is my only response.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――――」
　いくら秋葉でも、ここまできてしまえば追いかけてくるなんてコトはありえまい。
　子供じゃないんだから、登校するといった人間を捕まえにくることなんてしないはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Even Akiha will not chase me this far.
She is not a child, so surely she will not run after someone who already announced he was going to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sigh----"
Even if it is Akiha, she wouldn't chase me this far.

Since we're not kids anymore, she won't stop me from going to school.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――ふう」
　大きく息をはいて、ようやく落ち着いた。
「………って、なんで逃げてるんだ、俺」
　落ち着いたら冷静になった。
　別段悪いことなんかしてないんだから、逃げるように出てくる必要なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Whew”
One long breath finally calms me.
“Why am I running away?”
Once calm, I can think again.
I have not done anything wrong, so there was no need to flee the house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Whew."
I take a deep breath and am finally able to calm down.
"……… What am I running away for?"
Once I calm down, I can think clearly.
I didn't do anything wrong, so there was no need for me to run away like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
まるっきりバカみたいじゃないか、これじゃ」
　かといって、いまさら屋敷に戻って朝ごはんをいただくというのは、もっと間が抜けていると思う。
「―――学校に行くか」
　はあ、とため息をついて、住宅街に続く坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Unbelievable. I look like a complete idiot.”
Going back to the mansion now and meekly eating breakfast would look even more ridiculous.
“―――Might as well go to school.”
With a sigh, I start down the hill toward the residential district.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I don't believe it.
I look like a complete idiot."
But, to go back to the mansion to eat breakfast sounds more dumb.
"--To school, then?"
Letting out a sigh, I go downhill along the residential street.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
………、………………、………………………。
「―――あ――さ」
　ぼんやりとしていた意識が目を覚ます。
　窓からは太陽の陽射しが差し込んできていて、部屋は温かな雰囲気に包まれている。
「――――――――」
　じっと、自分の両手を見る。
　両手にはかすかな発汗。
体中に汗をかいていて、なんだか熱帯夜の中にいたみたいだ。
　くわえて、呼吸はなんだかぜいぜいと乱れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
……………………….
“―――Morn――ing”
My hazy mind drifts awake.
Sunlight streams through the window, filling the room with warmth.
“――――――――”
I stare at my hands.
My palms are damp. Sweat covers my whole body as though I spent the night in tropical heat.
My breathing comes in ragged gasps as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………, ………………, ……………………
"--Mor--ning?"
I dazedly open my eyes.
Sunshine pours in from the window, enveloping the room with a warm atmosphere.

"--------"
I stare down at my hands.
They are a little sweaty.
My body is drenched in sweat as well, as if last night was incredibly hot.
What's more, I'm panting heavily.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――」
　もぞもぞと両手を動かす。
「……ちゃんと、動く……」
　手首には縄で縛られた跡もない。
　ベッドは汚れてなんかいないし、秋葉が座っていた椅子も、琥珀さんの姿もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――――”
I flex both hands.
“They move.”
There are no rope marks around my wrists.
The bed is clean, while the chair Akiha sat in and Kohaku herself are nowhere to be seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah--------"
I shake both my hands.
"…… I can… move……"
There isn't any mark left on my wrist from the ropes.
The bed is clean, and neither the chair Akiha was sitting on nor Kohaku-san are anywhere to be seen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――れ？」
　秋葉と、琥珀さん……？
「こ――――琥珀さん？」
　ばたん、とバネ仕掛けの人形のように、勢いよくベッドから起きて部屋を見渡す。
そこには―――
「………誰も、いない………」
　そう、誰もいない。
　ベッドは乱れた様子もないし、あんな―――子悪魔みたいな琥珀さんがいるわけでもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H―――――――uh?”
Akiha and Kohaku…?
“K――――Kohaku?”
I spring upright like a wind-up doll and sweep my eyes around the room.
There―――
“No one is here…”
Yes, no one is here.
The bed shows no sign of disturbance, and there is no mischievous little Kohaku waiting beside it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H------uh?"
Akiha, and Kohaku-san……?
"Ko----Kohaku-san?"
I look around wildly.
I see--
"……… There's… no one………"
Right, no one's here.
The bed doesn't look rumpled--and Kohaku-san who was acting like a mischievous devil isn't here.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「夢――――か」
　そうとわかった途端、ほう、と安堵の息がもれた。
呼吸を平静に整えて、目を閉じる。
　ここは自分の部屋。
　時間は朝の七時前。
　部屋にいるのは自分だけだし、琥珀さんと秋葉の姿なんか当然のようにない。
「は…………ぁ」
　そう、わかっている。
　夢だってわかっている。
冷静になってみれば、そもそも秋葉たちがあんなコトをしにくるはずがないんだ。
　その時点で、昨日の出来事は破綻している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A dream――――”
As soon as I realize it, a relieved breath escapes me. I steady my breathing and close my eyes.
This is my room.
It is just before seven in the morning.
I am alone, and of course neither Kohaku nor Akiha is here.
“Hah…”
Yes, I know.
I know it was a dream. Calmly considered, Akiha and the others could never have come to me and done such things.
That fact alone renders yesterday’s events impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----dream?"
As soon as I realize it, I heave a sigh of relief.
I shut my eyes and catch my breath.
This is my room.
It is before seven in the morning.
I am the only one here, and of course Kohaku-san and Akiha are nowhere to be seen.
"Ha……………… a."
Yeah, I know.
I know it was a dream.
Now that I'm calm, I know she wouldn't ever do anything like that.
In that instance, what happened last night was not real.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　ほう、と胸の中にたまった空気を吐き出した。
　……それでもたしかに、脳裏には昨夜の光景が残っている。
　夢だってわかってるのに―――感覚がリアルすぎて、なんだか現実のように思えてしまう。
　……それでも、今のは間違いなく夢なんだ。
　それが、かろうじて救いといえば救いといえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah”
I let the air gathered in my chest escape.
Even so, the scenes from last night remain vivid in my mind.
Though I know it was a dream―――the sensations were so real that they feel like memory.
Even so, it was unquestionably a dream.
That, at least, is some small salvation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--ah."
I let out a deep breath.
…… All the same, I definitely still remember what happened last night.
I know it was a dream--but it felt too real; it makes me think it was real.

…… All the same, it has got to be a dream.
But I guess that is good in a way.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「けど、なんで―――」
　あんな夢を見たんだろう。
　……そりゃあ確かに琥珀さんは可愛いと思う。
　この屋敷の中で一番心を許せる人だし、なんていうか、あの人の元気な姿を見ているとこっちも元気になれる。
　けど、だからといってあんなのは違う。
　俺は琥珀さんを家族みたいなものだと思ってるんだし、決して―――女の人として見た覚えはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But why―――”
Why did I dream something like that?
I do think Kohaku is cute.
She is the person in this mansion I trust most, and seeing her cheerful spirits lifts mine as well.
But that does not make what happened in the dream right.
I think of Kohaku as family and never―――saw her as a woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, why--"
Why did I see that dream?
…… Well, I really do think Kohaku-san is cute.
She seems to be the most free one here, and for some reason, whenever I see her, I feel more lively.
But, that's different.
I think of her as my family, certainly--not as a woman.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――――う」
だっていうのに、いたずらな琥珀さんの瞳を思い出してしまった。
「くそ―――なに考えてるんだ、俺は」
　夢の内容を振り払うように頭を振る。
　そこへ。
「志貴さま」
「うわあああああ！」
　ばたばた、と逃げるようにベッドから転がり落ちた。
　いや、実際逃げようとしたんだけど、結果的にはシーツごと床に転げ落ちただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Ugh”
And yet Kohaku’s teasing eyes come straight back to me.
“Damn it―――what am I thinking”
I shake my head as though trying to fling the dream away.
And then.
“Master Shiki.”
“Waaaaaaaaah!”
I flail backward and tumble out of bed as though trying to escape.
I had, in fact, tried to flee; all I accomplished was rolling onto the floor, sheet and all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Uh."
All the same, I keep remembering her mischievous eyes.
"Damn--what the hell am I thinking?"
I shake my head to clear out the remnants of the dream.
But then,

"Shiki-sama."
"Uwaaaaaa!"
I flail around off my bed as if trying to escape.
No--in fact I was trying to escape, but it just ended up with me landing on the floor with the sheets.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「ひ、ひひ、翡翠……っ！？
　い、いったいいつからそこに！？」
「志貴さまがお目覚めになられる前からですが」
　いつも通りの無表情さで翡翠は即答する。
　床の上、シーツにくるまったまま、立ちあがる事もできずに翡翠の顔を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H-H-Hisui?! H-how long have you been there?!”
“Since before Master Shiki awoke.”
Hisui answers at once, wearing her usual expressionless face.
Still wrapped in the sheet on the floor, I can only stare up at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi, Hihi, Hisui…… !?
H, how long have you been there!?"
"Since before you awoke, Shiki-sama."
She speaks with her usual lack of expression.
Still lying on the floor tangled in the sheets and unable to stand, I look up at Hisui's face.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……俺が起きる前、から……」
―――ということは、もしかして。
　俺は、あんな夢を見ている時の寝顔を、翡翠に見られてたっていうんだろうか―――
　ぼっ、と自分でも自分の顔が真っ赤になったのがわかった。
　翡翠は相変わらず無表情で、自分からは何も話しかけてこようとしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Before I woke up…”
―――Which meant, could it be?
Had Hisui been watching my sleeping face while I had that dream―――
Heat burst across my cheeks.
Hisui remained impassive and made no attempt to speak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Before I… woke up……"
--Then, that means…
Hisui saw my face when I was having that dream?
My face turns deep red.

Hisui just stands there, expressionless as usual, and makes no attempt to speak.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「その……俺、なんかヘンだった……？」
「それは、わたしの口からご説明するのははばかられます」
「あ―――う」
　……やっぱり、なんかすごい寝姿をしていたみたいだ。
「それでも、志貴さまがどうしてもとおっしゃられるのなら、出来るだけ緻密にご説明いたしますが？」
「……いい。
説明しなくていいです、はい……」
　顔を赤くして、消え入りそうな声で答えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was I acting strangely…?”
“It would be improper for me to describe it.”
“Ah―――uh”
So I really was doing something spectacular in my sleep.
“Even so, if Master Shiki insists, I can describe it in as much detail as possible.”
“No. Please do not explain…”
Red-faced, I answer in a voice that nearly fades away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… did I look… strange……?"
"I do not wish to describe it."
"Ah--h"
…… I knew it.
I must've looked really weird.
"But, if you insist, Shiki-sama, I can describe as accurately as I can."
"…… No, you don't have to do that……"
My face still flushed, I speak in a fading voice.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あの、翡翠さん？」
　コホン、と咳払いをして場を切り返す、
　……『さん』がついているのは、動物が自分のおなかを見せるのと同意語だ。
「なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「その、着替えるから外に出てもらえない？」
―――というか、とにかく気恥ずかしいので外に出てもらいたい。
　っていうのに、今日にかぎって翡翠はこっちの言い分を聞いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Miss Hisui?”
I clear my throat and try to reset the conversation,
Adding ‘Miss’ to her name is the same as an animal exposing its belly.
“Yes, Master Shiki?”
“I need to change, so could you wait outside?”
―――More to the point, I was mortified and simply wanted her out of the room.
Yet today of all days, Hisui refused to listen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Hisui-san?"
I give a cough to clear the silence.
…… Adding "san" to her name is a clear sign of my vulnerability.

"What is it, Shiki-sama?"
"Um…… I'm going to change, so would you mind waiting outside?"
--Or rather, I'm so embarrassed I just want her to leave.
But Hisui doesn't obey today of all days.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまが起き上がられるのを見届けましたら退室させていただきますが」
「……！」
　じょっ、じょじょじょ冗談じゃない！
　なんだって俺がベッドから転げ落ちてもシーツなんかで体を包んでると思ってるんだ！
　それもこれも、まだいきり立っている股間のモノを隠してるからじゃないか！
entries.maoEnglish:
“I will leave once I have seen Master Shiki rise.”
“…!”
N-no, no, no, absolutely not!
Why did she think I was still huddled in this sheet after tumbling out of bed?
Because I was hiding the thing still standing rigid between my legs!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Once I can confirm you are awake, I will leave the room, Shiki-sama."
"……!"
Huh?
Is, is is is she joking!?
Why does she think I'm covering myself up in these sheets!?
It's to hide something that's still standing!
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「い、いいから外に出て。
ちゃんと一人で起きれるし、二度寝したりはしないから。
翡翠が外に出たらすぐに着替えて居間に行くよ」
「志貴さま―――お体を打たれてお立ちになれないのですか……？」
　翡翠は心配そうに近寄ってくる。
「いや、そんなコトはない。
十分に立ってる、じゃなくて立てるから、気にしないでいい」
　ずりずり、とナメクジみたいにシーツを引きずって、四つんばいの資性で翡翠から離れていく。
　ベッドをバリゲードにして、翡翠と十分に距離をとった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“J-just go outside. I can get up by myself, and I promise I will not fall asleep again. The moment you leave, I will change and come to the sitting room.”
“Master Shiki―――did you strike yourself and become unable to stand…?”
Hisui comes closer, looking concerned.
“No, it is nothing like that. I am standing perfectly fine―――I mean, I can stand perfectly fine, so do not worry.”
Dragging the sheet behind me like a slug, I crawl away from Hisui on all fours.
Then I put the bed between us as a barricade and gain some much-needed distance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I'm fine, so please leave.
I can get up, and I won't go back to sleep.
I'll change and go to the sitting room as soon as you leave."
"Shiki-sama--Are you hurt and unable to stand……?"
Hisui approaches me out of worry.
"No, that's not it.
I'm standing----I mean I can stand, so don't worry about it."
I crawl pulling my sheets like a slug, and gain some distance from her.
Using the bed as a barrier, I get far enough away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……では、失礼します。
食堂で朝食の準備をいたしますので、着替えてからおいでください」
　かなり疑問に思っただろうが、翡翠は一礼して部屋から出ていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I will excuse myself and prepare breakfast in the dining room, so please come once you are dressed.”
Though she must find the whole thing deeply puzzling, Hisui bows and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then, please excuse me.
I will prepare your breakfast, so please come after you change."
She has got to be suspicious, but she bows and leaves the room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　ああ、びっくりした。
　夢の内容にも驚きだったけど、翡翠に寝顔をその時の見られていたっていうのも心臓に悪い。
　……これというのも、琥珀さんに対してあんな夢を見た自分がいけないのか。
「……自業自得だ。
琥珀さん相手になんて夢を見てるんだ、俺は」
　はあ、と自己嫌悪のため息をつく。
　これからも琥珀さんと気楽にやっていく為、今夜の夢は早々に忘れないといけないだろう。

気持ちを十分に落ち着かせて居間に移動する。
　居間では、やっぱり秋葉がソファーに座って紅茶を優雅にすすっていた。

「あら、おはよう兄さん。
今朝は早いんですね」
　そんなにこっちが早起きしたことが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で声をかけてくる。
「ああ、おはよう。
今朝は、まあ色々とあってさ」
　言って―――昨夜の冷たい視線を思い出してしまった。
「うっ―――」
　まずい。
自分でもどうしようもないぐらい、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
　……秋葉の前で痴態をさらしてしまった自分。
　それをずっと見つめていた秋葉の姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Hah”
That nearly stopped my heart.
The dream itself was shocking enough, but learning that Hisui watched my face through it was even worse.
Was this all my own fault for dreaming that way about Kohaku?
“Serves me right. What kind of dream was that to have about Kohaku?”
I sigh in self-disgust.
If I want to remain at ease around Kohaku, I need to forget last night’s dream as quickly as possible.
Only after thoroughly composing myself do I enter the sitting room.
As expected, Akiha is seated on the sofa, sipping tea with effortless elegance.
“Good morning, Brother. You’re early today.”
Perhaps my early rising pleased her that much; Akiha greeted me with a smile.
“Morning. A few things happened.”
At the words―――the memory of last night’s cold gaze returns.
“Ugh―――”
This is bad. I can feel my face reddening beyond all control.
Me, exposing myself so disgracefully in front of Akiha.
Akiha, watching every second of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
I was so surprised.
The contents of my dream were surprising enough, but knowing Hisui saw me while I was dreaming is very troubling.
…… Or is it my own fault for having that kind of dream about Kohaku-san?

"…… I guess it is my fault.
Just what was I thinking?
Having that kind of dream about Kohaku-san…?"
I give a sigh of self-loathing.
To feel relaxed around Kohaku-san again, I should just forget about this dream as soon as possible.

After calming down enough, I head to the sitting room.
As usual, Akiha is sitting on the sofa, elegantly sipping tea.
"Good morning, Nii-san.
You are certainly up early this morning."
She must be happy I woke up because she greets me with a smile.
"Yeah, good morning.
There were, well, a lot of things going on this morning."
As soon as I say that--I remember that cold stare from last night.
"Uh--"
This isn't good.
I can tell my face is blushing beyond my control.
…… I acted foolishly in front of Akiha.
Akiha, watching it all.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん―――？」
　がた、という物音。
「どうしたの？
　顔が赤いけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　すぐ間近にやってきて、秋葉は下から俺の顔を覗きこむ。
　だから、そう真剣に見つめられると、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother―――?”
A chair shifts with a clatter.
“What is wrong? Your face is red, but do you have a fever?”
“―――――!”
Akiha comes right up to me and peers into my face from below.
If she stares at me that earnestly, I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san--?"
A brief clamor.
"What's wrong?
Your face is red, do you have a fever?"
"-----!"
Rushing over to me, she looks up at me from below.
So, if you stare at me that seriously, I---
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――はあ、本当に熱があるみたいですね。
　琥珀、ちょっと来て。
兄さん、体の具合がよくないみたいなの」
　秋葉は食堂に向って声をあげる。
「こ―――琥珀さんって、それは、まずい」
　今琥珀さんと顔を会わせたら、それこそ恥ずかしくて失神しかねない。
「い、いい―――！
　た、ただの風邪だから、そんなに気にしなくていい！」
「風邪ならなおさら放っておけませんっ。
些細な病気でも兄さんには大事でしょう。
免疫や抵抗力が人より低いんですから」
　秋葉は呆れながら、スッ、と自分の手を俺のひたいに当てた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hah, you really do seem feverish.
Kohaku, come here. Brother does not seem well.”
Akiha calls toward the dining room.
“K―――Kohaku? That would be bad.”
If I face Kohaku now, I may actually faint from embarrassment.
“I am fine―――! I-it is only a cold, so do not worry!”
“If it is a cold, that is all the more reason not to ignore it. Even a minor illness can become serious for you, Brother. Your immune system is weaker than other people’s.”
With an exasperated look, Akiha places her hand against my forehead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sighs.
"You do seem to have a fever.
Kohaku, come quickly.
Nii-san doesn't seem to be well."
Akiha calls out to the dining room.
"Ko---Kohaku-san?
That's bad."
If I see Kohaku-san now, I might faint from being too embarrassed.
"I-I'm fine--!
It's just a minor cold, so don't worry!"
"If it is a cold, then I can't let it go by.
For you, a trivial illness is a big deal.
The strength of your immune system is much lower than most people's."
Akiha seems to be fed up and puts her hand on my forehead.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
ひやりと冷たい、華奢な手の平の感触。
　白くて、細い指。
　男の指なんかじゃとうてい及ばない、繊細で、キレイな、白い指―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Her slender palm feels cool against me.
Pale, delicate fingers.
Fine, lovely white fingers beyond anything a man’s hand could possess―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sensation of her cool, delicate hand.
White, slender fingers.
White, beautiful, fine fingers that men's fingers don't even come close to-----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「っっっっっっっっ！」
　まずい。
　まずいので、秋葉の手を払って、ロビーへと走り出した。
　どたたたたたたたた。
「志貴さま？
　朝食はもうお済みになられたのですか？」
「いや、そうじゃないけど―――ええっと、俺の鞄は？」
「こちらですが、もう登校されるのですか？」
　こくん、と頷いて翡翠の手から鞄を奪い取る。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りはいいから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――!”
This is bad.
I knock Akiha’s hand away and bolt for the foyer.
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
“Master Shiki? Have you finished breakfast already?”
“No, but―――where is my schoolbag?”
“Here, but are you leaving for school already?”
I nod, snatch it from Hisui’s hand, and head for the door.
“I’m off! You do not have to see me out!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"!!!!!!!!"
This isn't good.
This isn't good at all, so I break loose and run out to the lobby.

Footsteps echo as I dash off.
"Shiki-sama?
Have you finished your breakfast already?"
"No, that's not it, but--Um, where's my bag?"
"I have your bag here.
Are you already going to school?"
Nodding, I snatch my bag from Hisui.
"I'm going.
Don't worry about seeing me off!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、さっきからヘンです。
熱があるっていうのに何をしてるんですかっ」
「ああもう、なんでもないんだって！
　なんでもないんだから、俺はこのまま学校に行く！
　朝飯はかってになんとかするからほっといてくれ！」
「ほっとけって―――ちょっと、兄さん！？」
　どたたたたたたたた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, you have been acting strangely all morning. What are you doing when you have a fever?”
“I told you, it is nothing! Since it is nothing, I am going to school. I will find breakfast somewhere, so leave me alone!”
“Leave you alone―――wait, Brother!?”
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you've been acting strange.
What are you doing with that fever?"
"Geez, I told you it's nothing!
Since it's nothing, I'm going to school!
I'll have breakfast later, so leave me alone!"
"Leave you alone--hey, Nii-san!?"
The sound of my fleeing footsteps is my only response.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――――」
　いくら秋葉でも、ここまできてしまえば追いかけてくるなんてコトはありえまい。
　子供じゃないんだから、登校するといった人間を捕まえにくることなんてしないはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Even Akiha will not chase me this far.
She is not a child, so surely she will not run after someone who already announced he was going to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sigh----"
Even if it is Akiha, she wouldn't chase me this far.

Since we're not kids anymore, she won't stop me from going to school.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――ふう」
　大きく息をはいて、ようやく落ち着いた。
「………って、なんで逃げてるんだ、俺」
　落ち着いたら冷静になった。
　別段悪いことなんかしてないんだから、逃げるように出てくる必要なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Whew”
One long breath finally calms me.
“Why am I running away?”
Once calm, I can think again.
I have not done anything wrong, so there was no need to flee the house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Whew."
I take a deep breath and am finally able to calm down.
"……… What am I running away for?"
Once I calm down, I can think clearly.
I didn't do anything wrong, so there was no need for me to run away like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
まるっきりバカみたいじゃないか、これじゃ」
　かといって、いまさら屋敷に戻って朝ごはんをいただくというのは、もっと間が抜けていると思う。
「―――学校に行くか」
　はあ、とため息をついて、住宅街に続く坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Unbelievable. I look like a complete idiot.”
Going back to the mansion now and meekly eating breakfast would look even more ridiculous.
“―――Might as well go to school.”
With a sigh, I start down the hill toward the residential district.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I don't believe it.
I look like a complete idiot."
But, to go back to the mansion to eat breakfast sounds more dumb.
"--To school, then?"
Letting out a sigh, I go downhill along the residential street.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
………、………………、………………………。
「―――あ――さ」
　ぼんやりとしていた意識が目を覚ます。
　窓からは太陽の陽射しが差し込んできていて、部屋は暖かな雰囲気に包まれている。
「――――――――」
　じっと、自分の両手を見る。
　両手にはかすかな発汗。
体中に汗をかいていて、なんだか熱帯夜の中にいたみたいだ。
　くわえて、呼吸はなんだかぜいぜいと乱れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
……………………….
“―――Morn――ing”
My hazy mind drifts awake.
Sunlight streams through the window, filling the room with warmth.
“――――――――”
I stare at my hands.
My palms are damp. Sweat covers my whole body as though I spent the night in tropical heat.
My breathing comes in ragged gasps as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………, ………………, ……………………
"--Mor--ning?"
I dazedly open my eyes.
Sunshine pours in from the window, enveloping the room with a warm atmosphere.

"………………"
I stare down at my hands.
They are a little sweaty.
My body is drenched in sweat as well, as if last night was incredibly hot.
What's more, I'm panting heavily.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――」
　もぞもぞと両手を動かす。
「……ちゃんと、動く……」
　手首には縄で縛られた跡もない。
　ベッドは汚れてなんかいないし、秋葉が座っていた椅子も、琥珀さんの姿もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――――”
I flex both hands.
“They move.”
There are no rope marks around my wrists.
The bed is clean, while the chair Akiha sat in and Kohaku herself are nowhere to be seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah--------"
I shake both my hands.
"…… I can… move……"
There isn't any mark left on my wrist from the ropes.
The bed is clean, and neither the chair Akiha was sitting on nor Kohaku-san are anywhere to be seen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――れ？」
　秋葉と、琥珀さん……？
「あ――――秋葉っ！」
　ベッドから跳ね起きる。
　慌てて部屋を見渡す。
　そこには―――
「………誰も、いない………」
　そう、誰もいない。
　ベッドは乱れた様子もないし、あんな―――冷たい秋葉がいるわけでもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H―――――――uh?”
Akiha and Kohaku…?
“A――――Akiha!”
I spring out of bed.
I frantically look around the room.
There―――
“No one is here…”
No one.
The bed showed no sign of disturbance, and there was no cold, merciless Akiha waiting beside it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H------uh?"
Akiha, and Kohaku-san……?
"A----Akiha!"
I jump out of bed.
I wildly look around the room.
I see--
"……… There's… no one………"
Right, no one's here.
The bed doesn't look rumpled--and that cold Akiha isn't there either.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「夢――――か」
　そうとわかった途端、ほう、と安堵の息がもれた。
呼吸を平静に整えて、目を閉じる。
　ここは自分の部屋。
　時間は朝の七時前。
　部屋にいるのは自分だけだし、秋葉と琥珀さんの姿なんか当然のようにない。
「は…………ぁ」
　そう、わかっている。
　夢だってわかっている。
冷静になってみれば、そもそも秋葉があんなコトをしにくるはずがないんだ。
　その時点で、昨日の出来事は破綻している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A dream――――”
As soon as I realize it, a relieved breath escapes me. I steady my breathing and close my eyes.
This is my room.
It is just before seven in the morning.
I am alone, and of course neither Akiha nor Kohaku is here.
“Hah…”
Yes, I know.
I know it was a dream. Calmly considered, Akiha could never have come to me and done such things.
That fact alone renders yesterday’s events impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----dream?"
As soon as I realize it, I heave a sigh of relief.
I shut my eyes and catch my breath.
This is my room.
It is before seven in the morning.
I am the only one here, and of course Kohaku-san and Akiha are nowhere to be seen.
"Ha……………… a."
Yeah, I knew.
I know it was a dream.
Now that I'm calm, I know she wouldn't ever do anything like that.
In that instance, what happened last night was not real.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　ほう、と胸の中にたまった空気を吐き出した。
　……それでもたしかに、脳裏には昨夜の光景が残っている。
　夢だってわかってるのに―――感覚がリアルすぎて、なんだか現実のように思えてしまう。
　……それでも、今のは間違いなく夢なんだ。
　それが、かろうじて救いといえば救いといえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah”
I let the air gathered in my chest escape.
Even so, the scenes from last night remain vivid in my mind.
Though I know it was a dream―――the sensations were so real that they feel like memory.
Even so, it was unquestionably a dream.
That, at least, is some small salvation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--ah."
I let out a deep breath.
…… All the same, I definitely still remember what happened last night.
I know it was a dream--but it felt too real; it makes me think it was real.

…… But, it was without a doubt a dream.
That has to be true.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――なんで―――」
　あんな夢を見たんだろう。
　……そりゃあ確かに秋葉は厳しいし、遠野家の当主だからここで一番偉い人間だ。
　けど秋葉があんな真似をしてくる筈がない。
　俺にとって秋葉はたしかに大切な妹だけど、あんな夢をみるぐらい、その――秋葉を女として見ているんだろうか、俺は。
「――――――う」
　思い出して、氷のようだった秋葉の視線を思い出す。
　これが現実なんだ、と確かめるために自分の腕を抱く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Why―――”
Why did I dream that?
Akiha is certainly strict and, as head of the Tohno family, holds the highest position in this house.
But she would never do anything like that.
She is my precious little sister, but does such a dream mean that I, well――see Akiha as a woman?
“――――――Ugh”
Recalling it, I remember Akiha’s gaze, cold as ice.
I clutch my own arm to reassure myself that this is reality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Why--"
Why did I see that dream?
…… Well, certainly Akiha is strict, and she is the head of the Tohno household, so it makes her the most powerful person here.
But she wouldn't do that.
She is my dear sister, but seeing that dream--Does that mean I'm seeing her as a woman?
"------Uh."
I remember her cold stare, like ice.
I hug myself to make sure this is real.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「くそ―――なに考えてるんだ、俺は！」
　実の妹に欲情するなんて、本当にどうかしてる。
　……そりゃあ八年ぶりに会った秋葉はまるっきり別人で、妹っていうよりは見知らぬお嬢様みたいな印象のが強いけど―――
「……けど……かわい、かったよな」
―――思い出すと赤面してしまう。
　あれこそ夢の中で見た夢だったかもしれないけど、一心不乱に俺の名前を呼んで自分を慰めていた秋葉。
　本当はこんな事はいけないんだろうけど、俺はむにゃむにゃと夢の内容を思い出して呆、としてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it―――what am I thinking!”
It is truly sick to lust after my own sister. Yet after eight years apart, Akiha seems like a completely different person, more an unfamiliar young lady than my sister, but―――
“But―――she was cute”
―――The memory alone makes me blush.
Perhaps that vision was only a dream nested inside the dream: Akiha pleasuring herself in a frenzy and calling my name again and again.
I know I should not dwell on it, yet I sit here dazed, savoring every hazy detail.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn--what the hell am I thinking?"
Lusting after my sister, there really is something wrong.
…… Well, she is different after eight years, like a completely different person.
She seems more like a refined young lady I've never met.
But still--
"…… But…… she was… really cute."
--I blush furiously as I remember.
Maybe it was only a dream within a dream, but I remember Akiha feeling herself while wildly calling my name.
I know it truly is forbidden, but I recall the dream and just sit there thinking about it.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
そこへ。
「志貴さま」
「うわあああああ！」
　ばたばた、と逃げるようにベッドから転がり落ちた。
　いや、実際逃げようとしたんだけど、結果的にはシーツごと床に転げ落ちただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then.
“Master Shiki.”
“Waaaaaaaaah!”
I flailed out of bed as though fleeing for my life.
I had, in fact, tried to flee; all I accomplished was rolling onto the floor tangled in the sheet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And then,
"Shiki-sama."
"Uwaaaaaa!"
I flail around off my bed as if trying to escape.
No--in fact I was trying to escape, but it just ended up with me landing on the floor with the sheets.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「ひ、ひひ、翡翠……っ！？
　い、いったいいつからそこに！？」
「志貴さまがお目覚めになられる前からですが」
　いつも通りの無表情さで翡翠は即答する。
　床の上、シーツにくるまったまま、立ちあがる事もできずに翡翠の顔を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H-H-Hisui?! H-how long have you been there?!”
“Since before Master Shiki awoke.”
Hisui answers at once, wearing her usual expressionless face.
Still wrapped in the sheet on the floor, I can only stare up at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi, Hihi, Hisui…… !?
H, how long have you been there!?"
"Since before you awoke, Shiki-sama."
She speaks with her usual lack of expression.
Still lying on the floor tangled in the sheets and unable to stand, I look up at Hisui's face.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……俺が起きる前、から……」
―――ということは、もしかして。
　俺は、あんな夢を見ている時の寝顔を、翡翠に見られてたっていうんだろうか―――
　ぼっ、と自分でも自分の顔が真っ赤になったのがわかった。
　翡翠は相変わらず無表情で、自分からは何も話しかけてこようとしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Before I woke up…”
―――Which meant, could it be?
Had Hisui been watching my sleeping face while I had that dream―――
Heat burst across my cheeks.
Hisui remained impassive and made no attempt to speak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Before I… woke up……"
--Then, that means…
Hisui saw my face when I was having that dream?
My face turns deep red.

Hisui just stands there, expressionless as usual, and makes no attempt to speak.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「その……俺、なんかヘンだった……？」
「それは、わたしの口からご説明するのははばかられます」
「あ―――う」
　……やっぱり、なんかすごい寝姿をしていたみたいだ。
「それでも、志貴さまがどうしてもとおっしゃられるのなら、出来るだけ緻密にご説明いたしますが？」
「……いい。
説明しなくていいです、はい……」
　顔を赤くして、消え入りそうな声で答えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was I acting strangely…?”
“It would be improper for me to describe it.”
“Ah―――uh”
So I really was doing something spectacular in my sleep.
“Even so, if Master Shiki insists, I can describe it in as much detail as possible.”
“No. Please do not explain…”
Red-faced, I answer in a voice that nearly fades away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… did I look… strange……?"
"I do not wish to describe it."
"Ah--h"
…… I knew it.
I must've looked really weird.
"But, if you insist, Shiki-sama, I can describe as accurately as I can."
"…… No, you don't have to do that……"
My face still flushed, I speak in a fading voice.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あの、翡翠さん？」
　コホン、と咳払いをして場を切り返す、
　……『さん』がついているのは、動物が自分のおなかを見せるのと同意語だ。
「なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「その、着替えるから外に出てもらえない？」
―――というか、とにかく気恥ずかしいので外に出てもらいたい。
　っていうのに、今日にかぎって翡翠はこっちの言い分を聞いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Miss Hisui?”
I clear my throat and try to reset the conversation,
Adding ‘Miss’ to her name is the same as an animal exposing its belly.
“Yes, Master Shiki?”
“I need to change, so could you wait outside?”
―――More to the point, I was mortified and simply wanted her out of the room.
Yet today of all days, Hisui refused to listen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Hisui-san?"
I give a cough to clear the silence.
…… Adding "san" to her name is a clear sign of my vulnerability.

"What is it, Shiki-sama?"
"Um…… I'm going to change, so would you mind waiting outside?"
--Or rather, I'm so embarrassed I just want her to leave.
But Hisui doesn't obey today of all days.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまが起き上がられるのを見届けましたら退室させていただきますが」
「……！」
　じょっ、じょじょじょ冗談じゃない！
　なんだって俺がベッドから転げ落ちてもシーツなんかで体を包んでると思ってるんだ！
　それもこれも、まだいきり立っている股間のモノを隠してるからじゃないか！
entries.maoEnglish:
“I will leave once I have seen Master Shiki rise.”
“…!”
N-no, no, no, absolutely not!
Why did she think I was still huddled in this sheet after tumbling out of bed?
Because I was hiding the thing still standing rigid between my legs!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Once I can confirm you are awake, I will leave the room, Shiki-sama."
"……!"
Huh?
Is, is is is she joking!?
Why does she think I'm covering myself up in these sheets!?
It's to hide something that's still standing!
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「い、いいから外に出て。
ちゃんと一人で起きれるし、二度寝したりはしないから。
翡翠が外に出たらすぐに着替えて居間に行くよ」
「志貴さま―――お体を打たれてお立ちになれないのですか……？」
　翡翠は心配そうに近寄ってくる。
「いや、そんなコトはない。
十分に立ってる、じゃなくて立てるから、気にしないでいい」
　ずりずり、とナメクジみたいにシーツを引きずって、四つんばいの資性で翡翠から離れていく。
　ベッドをバリゲードにして、翡翠と十分に距離をとった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“J-just go outside. I can get up by myself, and I promise I will not fall asleep again. The moment you leave, I will change and come to the sitting room.”
“Master Shiki―――did you strike yourself and become unable to stand…?”
Hisui comes closer, looking concerned.
“No, it is nothing like that. I am standing perfectly fine―――I mean, I can stand perfectly fine, so do not worry.”
Dragging the sheet behind me like a slug, I crawl away from Hisui on all fours.
Then I put the bed between us as a barricade and gain some much-needed distance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I'm fine, so please leave.
I can get up, and I won't go back to sleep.
I'll change and go to the sitting room as soon as you leave."
"Shiki-sama--Are you hurt and unable to stand……?"
Hisui approaches me out of worry.
"No, that's not it.
I'm standing----I mean I can stand, so don't worry about it."
I crawl pulling my sheets like a slug, and gain some distance from her.
Using the bed as a barrier, I get far enough away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……では、失礼します。
食堂で朝食の準備をいたしますので、着替えてからおいでください」
　かなり疑問に思っただろうが、翡翠は一礼して部屋から出ていく。
「――――はあ」
　ああ、びっくりした。
　夢の内容にも驚きだったけど、翡翠に寝顔をその時の見られていたっていうのも心臓に悪い。
　……これというのも、秋葉に対してあんな夢を見た自分がいけないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I will excuse myself and prepare breakfast in the dining room, so please come once you are dressed.”
Though she must find the whole thing deeply puzzling, Hisui bows and leaves the room.
“――――Hah”
That nearly stopped my heart.
The dream itself was shocking enough, but learning that Hisui watched my face through it was even worse.
Was this all my own fault for dreaming that way about Akiha?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then, please excuse me.
I will prepare your breakfast, so please come after you change."
She has got to be suspicious, but she bows and leaves the room.

*sigh*
I was so surprised.
The contents of my dream were surprising enough, but knowing Hisui saw me while I was dreaming is very troubling.
…… Or is it my own fault for having that kind of dream about Akiha?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……自業自得だ。
妹相手になんて夢を見てるんだよ、俺は」
　はあ、と自己嫌悪のため息をつく。
　自分のためと秋葉の名誉のため、今夜の夢は早々に忘れないといけないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Serves me right. What kind of dream was that to have about my own sister?”
I sigh in self-disgust.
For my sake and Akiha’s honor alike, I need to forget last night’s dream as quickly as possible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I guess it is my fault.
Having a dream like that about my own sister."
I give a sigh of self-loathing.
For my sake and for Akiha's reputation, I should just forget about it as soon as possible.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
気持ちを十分に落ち着かせて居間に移動する。
　居間では、やっぱりすでに秋葉がソファーに座って紅茶を優雅にすすっていた。
「あら、おはよう兄さん。
今朝は早いんですね」
　そんなにこっちが早起きしたことが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で声をかけてくる。
「ああ、おはよう。
今朝は、まあ色々とあってさ」
　言って―――昨夜の冷たい視線を思い出してしまった。
「うっ―――」
　まずい。
自分でもどうしようもないぐらい、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
　……秋葉の前で痴態をさらしてしまった自分。
　それをずっと見つめていた秋葉の姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only after thoroughly composing myself do I enter the sitting room.
As expected, Akiha is already seated on the sofa, sipping tea with effortless elegance.
“Good morning, Brother. You are up early today.”
Apparently delighted by the mere fact that I rose early, Akiha greets me with a smile.
“Morning. A few things happened.”
At the words―――the memory of last night’s icy gaze returns.
“Ugh―――”
This is bad. I can feel my face reddening beyond all control.
Me, exposing myself so disgracefully in front of Akiha.
Akiha, watching every second of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After calming down enough, I head to the sitting room.
As usual, Akiha is sitting on the sofa, elegantly sipping tea.
"Oh?
Good morning Nii-san.
You're up early today."
She must be happy I woke up because she greets me with a smile.
"Yeah, good morning.
There were, well, a lot of things going on this morning."
As soon as I say that--I remember that cold stare from last night.
"Uh--"
This isn't good.
I can tell my face is blushing beyond my control.
…… Myself being made a complete fool.
And Akiha, who was always watching.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん―――？」
　がた、という物音。
「どうしたの？
　顔が赤いけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　すぐ間近にやってきて、秋葉は下から俺の顔を覗きこむ。
　だから、そう真剣に見つめられると、俺は―――
「―――はあ、本当に熱があるみたいですね。
　琥珀、ちょっと来て。
兄さん、体の具合がよくないみたいなの」
　秋葉は食堂に向かって声をあげる。
　厨房では琥珀さんが俺の朝食を作っている最中なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother―――?”
A chair shifts with a clatter.
“What is wrong? Your face is red, but do you have a fever?”
“―――――!”
Akiha comes right up to me and peers into my face from below.
If she stares at me that earnestly, I―――
“―――Hah, you really do seem feverish.
Kohaku, come here. Brother does not seem well.”
Akiha calls toward the dining room.
Kohaku is presumably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san--?"
A brief clamor.
"What's wrong?
Your face is red, do you have a fever?"
"-----!"
Rushing over to me, she looks up at me from below.
But, if she looks at me that seriously, I----

Akiha sighs.
"You do seem to have a fever.
Kohaku, come quickly.
Nii-san doesn't seem to be well."
Akiha calls out to the dining room.
Kohaku-san has to be preparing my breakfast in the kitchen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いい―――！
　た、ただの風邪だから、そんなに気にしなくていい！」
「風邪ならなおさら放っておけませんっ。
些細な病気でも兄さんには大事でしょう。
免疫や抵抗力が人より低いんですから」
　秋葉は呆れながら、スッ、と自分の手を俺のひたいに当てた。
　ひやりと冷たい、華奢な手の平の感触。
　白くて、細い指。
　男の指なんかじゃとうてい及ばない、繊細で、キレイな、白い指―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am fine―――! I-it is only a cold, so do not worry!”
“If it is a cold, that is all the more reason not to ignore it. Even a minor illness can become serious for you, Brother. Your immune system is weaker than other people’s.”
With an exasperated look, Akiha places her hand against my forehead.
Her slender palm feels cool against me.
Pale, delicate fingers.
Fine, lovely white fingers beyond anything a man’s hand could possess―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine--!
It's just a minor cold, so don't worry!"
"If it is a cold, then I can't let it go by.
For you, a trivial illness is a big deal.
The strength of your immune system is much lower than most people's."
Akiha seems to be fed up and puts her hand on my forehead.

The sensation of her cool, delicate hand.
White, slender fingers.
So different from those of a man.
Delicate, beautiful, white fingers------
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「っっっっっっっっ！」
　まずい。
　まずいので、秋葉の手を払って、ロビーへと走り出した。
　どたたたたたたたた。
「志貴さま？
　朝食はもうお済みになられたのですか？」
「いや、そうじゃないけど―――ええっと、俺の鞄は？」
「こちらですが、もう登校されるのですか？」
　こくん、と頷いて翡翠の手から鞄を奪い取る。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りはいいから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――!”
This is bad.
I knock Akiha’s hand away and bolt for the foyer.
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
“Master Shiki? Have you finished breakfast already?”
“No, but―――where is my schoolbag?”
“Here, but are you leaving for school already?”
I nod, snatch it from Hisui’s hand, and head for the door.
“I’m off! You do not have to see me out!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"!!!!!"
This isn't good.
This isn't good at all, so I break loose and run out to the lobby.

Footsteps echo as I dash off.
"Shiki-sama?
Have you finished your breakfast already?"
"No, that's not it, but--Um, where's my bag?"
"I have your bag here.
Are you already going to school?"
Nodding, I snatch my bag from Hisui.
"I'm going.
Don't worry about seeing me off!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、さっきからヘンです。
熱があるっていうのに何をしてるんですかっ」
「ああもう、なんでもないんだって！
　なんでもないんだから、俺はこのまま学校に行く！
　朝飯はかってになんとかするからほっといてくれ！」
「ほっとけって―――ちょっと、兄さん！？」
　どたたたたたたたた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, you have been acting strangely all morning. What are you doing when you have a fever?”
“I told you, it is nothing! Since it is nothing, I am going to school. I will find breakfast somewhere, so leave me alone!”
“Leave you alone―――wait, Brother!?”
Thud-thud-thud-thud-thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you've been acting strange.
What are you doing with that fever?"
"Geez, I told you it's nothing!
Since it's nothing, I'm going to school!
I'll have breakfast later, so leave me alone!"
"Leave you alone--hey, Nii-san!?"
The sound of my fleeing footsteps is my only response.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――――」
　いくら秋葉でも、ここまできてしまえば追いかけてくるなんてコトはありえまい。
　子供じゃないんだから、登校するといった人間を捕まえにくることなんてしないはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Even Akiha will not chase me this far.
She is not a child, so surely she will not run after someone who already announced he was going to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sigh----"
Even if it is Akiha, she wouldn't chase me this far.

Since we're not kids anymore, she won't stop me from going to school.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「――――ふう」
　大きく息をはいて、ようやく落ち着いた。
「………って、なんで逃げてるんだ、俺」
　落ち着いたら冷静になった。
　別段悪いことなんかしてないんだから、逃げるように出てくる必要なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Whew”
One long breath finally calms me.
“Why am I running away?”
Once calm, I can think again.
I have not done anything wrong, so there was no need to flee the house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Whew."
I take a deep breath and am finally able to calm down.
"……… What am I running away for?"
Once I calm down, I can think clearly.
I didn't do anything wrong, so there was no need for me to run away like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
まるっきりバカみたいじゃないか、これじゃ」
　かといって、いまさら屋敷に戻って朝ごはんをいただくというのは、もっと間が抜けていると思う。
「―――学校に行くか」
　はあ、とため息をついて、住宅街に続く坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Unbelievable. I look like a complete idiot.”
Going back to the mansion now and meekly eating breakfast would look even more ridiculous.
“―――Might as well go to school.”
With a sigh, I start down the hill toward the residential district.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I don't believe it.
I look like a complete idiot."
But, to go back to the mansion to eat breakfast sounds more dumb.
"--To school, then?"
Letting out a sigh, I go downhill along the residential street.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
―――いつもより三十分は早く到着した。
　正門に生徒の姿はまばらで、こんな半端な時間に登校するのは俺だけらしい
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I arrived a full half hour earlier than usual.
Only a scattering of students stood near the front gate; apparently I was the only one who came to school at such an awkward hour
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I arrive thirty minutes earlier than usual.
The figures of students around the school gate are sparse.
It seems I'm the only one who's arrived at this odd time.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
グランドでは運動系の部活が朝練をしている。
　……今はどこの部活にも入っていないけれど、実際、体を動かすことは好きな部類に入ると思う。
　運動神経もそれなりに、ちょっとは誇れるぐらいにはあると自負もしている。
　けれど部活に入ることはできなかった。
　俺の体は慢性的な貧血持ちだから、ここぞという時にまわりに迷惑をかけてしまうし―――頻繁に運動はしてはいけない、と医者からも堅く念をおされていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sports clubs were holding their morning practices on the field.
I wasn’t in any club now, but I did enjoy being active.
My coordination was good enough that I could take a little pride in it.
But joining a club had never been possible.
Chronic anemia meant I might let everyone down when they needed me most―――and my doctor had strictly forbidden me from exercising too often.
entries.mirrorMoon:
On the school grounds, the athletic clubs are holding their practices.
…… I'm not in any clubs right now, but truthfully, I like to move around a lot.
I know that I have some athletic ability, at least enough to be proud of.
But, I can't join any clubs.
My body always has this recurring anemia so I would just be a bother----and my doctor has told me that I should not exercise frequently.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
中学のころから部活に入らないか、と誘われたのは一回や二回じゃない。
　それを『ガラじゃないですから』と、何度断ったか数えきれない。
　断るたびに、なにか―――言いようのない隔たりを感じる事があった。
　あれは結局。
　どうやったってあっち側の仲間には混ざれないのだという、無意識下の壁だったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ever since middle school, I had been invited to join clubs more times than I could count.
Every time, I turned them down with the same line, “It is not really me.”
And every time I did―――I felt some nameless gulf open between us.
That was all.
Perhaps it had always been a wall buried deep inside me, the knowledge that no matter what I did, I could never truly join the people on the other side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since middle school, I've been asked more than a few times to join a club.
But I always have to say "it's not my thing" and refuse.
Every time I refused----I felt a sense of separation.
That might have been…
a subconscious wall that told me I will never be able to mix in with the people on the other side.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　ああ、やめやめ。
こんなの、それこそガラじゃない。
つまらない感傷を切り上げて、さっさと教室に向かう事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……………”
Enough. This is not like me. I cut the pointless sentimentality short and head for the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Ah, that's enough.
This really isn't my thing.
I'll stop thinking such thoughts and hurry on to the classroom.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「ありゃ―――」
　一番乗りだと思っていたのに、教室にはすでに何人かのクラスメイトがやってきていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh―――”
I expected to be first, but several classmates were already there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh----?"
I thought I was the first one, but it seems like some of my classmates are already here.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「よっ、早いな遠野」
「おはよう。
わりと暇人が多かったんだ、このクラス」
「わけないだろ。
俺たちは朝練が終わったばっかりだよ。
部活もやってないのにこんな時間にくるのは日直だけだろ、普通」
　なるほど、言われてみればその通りだ。
　教室にいる連中に軽く挨拶をして、自分の席に座る。
　ホームルームまであと三十分。
　こうして教室に少しずつクラスメイトが集まっていくのを眺めるのも、そう悪くはない趣向だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Tohno; you are early.”
“Morning. I never knew this class had so many people with nothing better to do.”
“Like hell. We just finished morning practice. Normally, the only person who comes this early without belonging to a club is whoever is on classroom duty.”
Put that way, he had a point.
I exchanged greetings with the others and sat down.
Homeroom was still half an hour away.
Watching the classroom gradually fill might not be such a bad way to pass the time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yo, you're early Tohno."
"Morning.
This class seems to have a lot of people with spare time."
"Nah.
Our practice just got over with.
Those that come here this early who aren't in clubs are usually only those with daily duties."
I see.
That does makes sense, now that he mentions it.
Greeting those around me, I take my seat.
It's half an hour before homeroom.
It's not a bad idea to just watch my classmates arrive.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
教室がざわざわとした喧騒に包まれだした午前七時五十分。
「―――あれ？」
　廊下に、先輩の姿がちらりと見えた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
At seven-fifty, the classroom begins to fill with chatter.
“―――Huh?”
I think I catch a glimpse of her in the hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The classroom starts to get busy around seven fifty.
"----Huh?"
I think I saw Senpai in the hallway.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「また一年の廊下にやってきて―――何してるんだ、あの人は」
　もしかして俺に用があるんだろうか。
　それなら―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Back in the first-year corridor again―――what is she doing?”
Maybe she came to see me.
If so―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"She's down at the first year hallway again----what is she doing?"
Maybe she came to see me?
Then----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
まあ、うちの教室のまわりでクルクルまわっているということは、俺に用があるのかもしれない。
「……なんだろ。
いつもは遠慮なく教室に入ってくるくせに」
　それとも、ようやく三年生が二年生の教室にやってくることがわりと珍しいことだって気がついてくれたんだろうか。
「―――ないな。
それだけは絶対にない」
　うん、と納得して、とりあえず廊下に足を運んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Well, if she kept circling around our classroom, she might have come to see me after all.
“What is she doing? She usually walks straight into the classroom without a second thought.”
Or had she finally realized how unusual it was for a third-year to visit a second-year classroom?
“―――No. Absolutely no chance of that.”
Satisfied with my conclusion, I head into the hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well, if she's walking around my classroom like that, maybe she does want to see me for something.
"…… I wonder.
She normally just walks in without hesitating."
Or did she finally realize it's strange for a third-year to come to a second-year's classroom?
"--No.
That definitely can't be it."
Nodding to myself, I go to the hallway.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「先輩」
「あれ―――遠野くん？」
　呼びとめられて、先輩はなんだか驚いたように口をぽかん、とあけた。
「なにしてるんだ。
もうすぐ授業が始まるっていうのに、こんなところで油をうって」
「―――――」
　先輩は呆然と俺を眺めると、なんだか機嫌を害したみたいに視線を逸らす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel.”
“Oh―――Tohno?”
When I call out, she stares at me with her mouth hanging open in surprise.
“What are you doing? Class is about to start, and you are loitering here.”
“―――――”
She gazes at me blankly, then looks away as though I have offended her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai."
"Huh--Tohno-kun?"
Senpai seems rather surprised I called her and stands there with her mouth open.
"What are you doing?
Class is about to start, so why are you still hanging around here?"
"-----"
Senpai looks at me in amazement, then looks away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「なにしてるんだって、そんなこと遠野くんには関係ありません」
「いや――まあ、たしかに関係はないんだけど」
「―――うそです。
関係は、ちょっとぐらいあります」
　視線を逸らしているかと思ったら、先輩はくんくん、とこちらの匂いをかいだりする。
「……あの、先輩……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What I am doing is none of your business.”
“Well――I suppose it is not.”
“―――That was a lie. It is a little bit your business.”
One moment she is looking away; the next, she leans toward me and begins sniffing.
“Um, Ciel?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What am I doing?
That is not any of your business, Tohno-kun."
"No--Well… maybe it isn't."
"--No, I was lying.
It is, a little."
I thought she was looking away, but she starts sniffing me.
"…… Um--Senpai……?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
廊下で誰かを探しているのか、先輩はうろうろと歩きまわっている。
　……冷静に観察してみると、どうもうちの教室に用があってきたわけじゃなさそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
She wanders up and down the hall, apparently searching for someone.
On closer inspection, our classroom does not seem to be her destination after all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Is she looking for someone in the hallway?
Senpai paces back and forth.
…… Looking at it calmly, she looks like she doesn't have anything to do with my classroom.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「……相変わらずわかんない人だな。
なにしてんだろ、あんなとこで」
　椅子に座って先輩の行動を観察してみる。
　先輩は廊下を歩いていく生徒たちをじーっと、見つめたり、腕を組んで物思いにふけったりしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She’s as impossible to read as ever. What is she doing out there?”
I sat and watched.
She stared intently at students passing through the corridor, then folded her arms and sank into thought.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… As usual, I don't understand her at all.
What the heck is she doing?"
I sit down in my chair and watch her.
Senpai crosses her arms as if thinking about something, and stares at the students passing by.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「落とし物でもしたのかな、先輩」
　……三年生である先輩が二年の廊下で落とし物をする、というのもヘンな話ではあるけど、校内を自由に闊歩しているあの人ならありえない話でもないだろう。
――――あれ？
　なんか、先輩がうちの教室に入ってきた。
　先輩はズンズンとこっちに向かって歩いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe she lost something.”
It would be odd for a third-year to lose something in the second-year corridor, but given how freely she roamed the school, it was hardly impossible.
――――Wait.
She has just walked into our classroom.
Now she is marching straight toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Maybe she dropped something."
…… It sounds weird for a third-year student to drop something in the second-year hallway, but this is the ever-roaming Senpai we're talking about.
----Huh?
Senpai suddenly enters into my classroom.
She strides directly to me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん！」
「！」
　と、いきなり怒鳴られた。
「な、なんですか先輩。
俺、先輩に目をつけられる悪さなんかしてないですけど」
「いいわけ無用ですっ。
いいから、ちょっと来てくださいっ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno!”
“!”
She shouts at me without warning.
“Wh-what is it? I have not done anything bad enough to wind up on your radar.”
“No excuses! Just come with me!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun!"
"!"
And she suddenly yells at me.
"Wh, what is it, Senpai?
I haven't done anything bad to make you angry."
"No excuses.
Just come over here, please."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
ぐい、と腕を引っ張られて、強引に廊下に連れ出されてしまった。
「ちょっ、ちょっと先輩、いきなりなんなんだよ。
何か捜し物があったんじゃないの！？」
「いいですから、そこでじっとしていてくださいっ！」
「……っ」
　先輩の勢いにつられて、びしっと姿勢をただす。
　と、先輩は昨日と同じようにくんくん、とこちらの匂いをかいだりする。
「……あの、先輩……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
She seizes my arm and hauls me into the hall.
“H-hey, what is this all of a sudden? Were you not looking for something?”
“Stand right there and do not move.”
“…!”
Swept up by her intensity, I snap to attention. Then, just as she did the day before, she leans in and begins sniffing me.
“Um, Ciel?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
She pulls my arm and drags me out into the hallway.
"H, hey, Senpai, what are you doing all of a sudden?
Weren't you looking for something!?"
"It's fine, just stay right there!"
"……"
Under Senpai's intensity, I quickly snap to attention.
And like yesterday, Senpai starts to sniff me.
"…… Um, Senpai……?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
……先輩は廊下できょろきょろとあたりを見渡している。
　捜し物をしているのか捜し人がいるのか知らないけど、挙動不審なことこの上ない。
「………ふ、ふふ、ふ」
　なんか、むらっときた。
　いつも先輩のペースに振りまわされているこっちとしては、たまに逆襲してやらないとバランスがとれないってものだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
She stands in the corridor, darting suspicious glances in every direction.
Whether she is searching for a person or an object, she could not look more conspicuous.
“Heh, heh heh.”
A wicked impulse comes over me.
She is always dragging me along at her pace; it is only fair that I strike back once in a while.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Senpai is glancing all around the hallway.
I don't know if she's looking for something or someone, but she looks really suspicious.
"………… He--hehe, he."
I get this sudden irresistible urge.
Senpai's always taking everything at her own pace; I think I can respond sometimes to balance things out.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
先輩は真剣に何かを捜している。
　その背後に回りこむ。
　……さいわい、先輩は気がついていない。
　せーの、
「わっ！」
「――――っ！」
　と、後から抱きついた、んだけ、ど―――
　……いつのまにか、俺一人でかってに廊下に転んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
She was intent on her search.
I slipped around behind her.
Fortunately, she had not noticed me.
Ready, and—
“Boo!”
“――――!”
I throw my arms around her from behind, but―――
Somehow, I end up sprawled alone on the hallway floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Senpai is seriously searching for something.
I sneak up behind her.
…… Luckily, Senpai doesn't sense me at all.
Here goes,
"Boo!"
"----!"
I grab her from behind, but----
…… before I know it, I'm lying on the ground.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あ―――遠野、くん？」
　こっちを気遣う先輩の声。
「うん、俺です先輩」
「もう、いきなりびっくりしたじゃないですか。
つい条件反射で逃げちゃいましたけど、大丈夫ですか？」
「え？
　あ、大丈夫だよ、かってに転んだだけだから」
　立ちあがる。
　……周囲の生徒から奇異の目で見られるのは、まあ仕方がないことだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh―――Tohno?”
Her voice is full of concern.
“Yep, it is me.”
“Honestly, you startled me! I jumped aside on reflex; are you all right?”
“Huh? Oh, sure; I just fell over on my own.”
I stand up.
The other students’ peculiar stares are probably unavoidable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh----Tohno… kun?"
Senpai sounds worried.
"Yeah--it's me, Senpai."
"Geez, don't surprise me like that!
I reflexively got away, but are you alright?"
"Eh?
I'm fine.
I just tripped."
I stand up.
…… I guess the strange looks from all the other students in the hallway are to be expected.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「いたたた……やば、腰をうったみたいだ。
やっぱりイタズラなんて慣れない事はするんじゃなかったか」
　反省。
「そのとおりです。
わたしもやりすぎちゃいましたけど、今回は遠野くんが悪いんですから謝りませんからね」
「あー、わかってるわかってる。
ごめんな先輩、捜し物の邪魔して。
それじゃいたずら坊主は自分の教室に戻ります」
　腰をさすりながら教室に戻ろうと歩き出す。
「あ、待って遠野くん。
今の罰としてちょっとそこに起立してくれますか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow, I think I landed on my hip. That settles it; I should not attempt pranks when I have no talent for them.”
Lesson learned.
“Exactly. I may have overreacted, but this time you were at fault, so I am not apologizing.”
“I know, I know. Sorry I interrupted your search. This little troublemaker will go back to his classroom now.”
Rubbing my hip, I start away.
“Wait, Tohno. As punishment, would you stand right there for a moment?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ooowowow…… Man, I think I hit my hip.
Guess I shouldn't pull pranks like that."
Regret.
"Exactly.
I think I overdid it, but since it was your fault I will not apologize."
"Ah, I know, I know.
Sorry Senpai, I interrupted your search.
Well, this mischievous boy will now go back to his classroom."
Rubbing my butt, I start to head to class.
"Oh, wait Tohno-kun.
Can you stand there as a punishment?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「？」
　今の罰に起立しろって、またヘンな事を言い出す人だ。
「いいですけど……なに？」
「いいから動かないでください」
　と、先輩は昨日と同じように、またしてもくんくん、とこちらの匂いをかいだりする。
「……あの、先輩……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“?”
Stand there as punishment; she is saying strange things again.
“All right, but why?”
“Never mind; just do not move.”
Then, just as she did the day before, she leans close and begins sniffing me again.
“Um, Ciel?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"?"
Stand here as a punishment?
As usual, she says something strange.
"Sure…… What is it?"
"Just don't move, please."
Like yesterday, she starts sniffing me again.
"…… Um, Senpai……?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、昨日はよく眠れました？」
「え？」
　先輩はまっすぐな目をして、そんなことを聞いてくる。
　……よく眠れたかなんて、そんな事言うまでもない。
昨夜は寝つけなかったし、なにより―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, did you sleep well last night?”
“Huh?”
She asks with an uncommonly direct gaze.
There is hardly any need to answer. I could not fall asleep, and more importantly―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, did you sleep well last night?"
"Eh?"
She looks directly into my eyes as she asks.
…… Sleep well?
That goes without saying.
I couldn't get to sleep easily last night, and also--
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「うっ……」
　鮮明に昨夜の記憶が思い出されて、顔が赤くなっていくのがわかる。
　そんな俺を、先輩は上目遣いでじーーっと見つめる。
「先輩、その―――」
「遠野くんのえっち」
「はい？」
　何か文句がありそうな眼差しをして、先輩はとことこと俺の前から去っていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh…”
The memory of the previous night returns in vivid detail, and I feel my face turning red.
She peers up at me, staring and staring.
“Ciel, the thing is―――”
“You’re a pervert, Tohno.”
“Excuse me?”
She gives me a look heavy with unspoken complaint, then marches away on quick little steps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh……"
I blush as the memories resurface.
With a piercing gaze, Senpai looks up at me.
"Senpai, um--"
"Tohno-kun, you pervert."
"Huh?"
With a look indicating she wants to say more, Senpai quickly walks away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「―――――あ」
　真っ正面から見られると、その―――昨夜の夢を、思い出してしまう。
「遠野くん？
　どうしたんですか、顔が赤いですよ」
「い、いや、なんでもない。
ちょっと、その、今朝は夢見が悪くてさ。
気分がよろしくないんだ」
　悪くない、と言わないあたり、自分は正直ものだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Ah.”
With her looking straight at me, I cannot help remembering―――last night’s dream.
“Tohno, what is wrong? Your face is red.”
“N-nothing. I had a bad dream this morning. I am not feeling very well.”
At least I have not lied and called the dream itself unpleasant; honest to a fault, that is me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
Having her stare right at me like this--makes me remember my dream.
"Tohno-kun?
What's wrong?
Your face is turning red."
"I, it's nothing.
Just, I had a bad dream.
I don't feel very well."
I think I'm honest as I don't say I don't feel bad at all.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「………遠野くん？」
　先輩は深刻な顔のまま、じっと俺を見つめている。
「……先輩……？」
　少し戸惑う。
なんだか、先輩に心を読まれているような気がして、ますます昨夜の夢を思い出してしまう。
「遠野くん、いま夢見がよくなかったって言いましたよね。
それってどういう意味ですか？」
「どういう意味も何も、別に先輩には関係ないっ。
俺の夢の話なんていいから、俺は先輩が何してるのかって聞いてるんだって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno?”
Her expression grave, she continues to stare.
“Ciel?”
I falter. It feels as though she can read my mind, which only brings the dream back more vividly.
“You just said you had a bad dream. What exactly did you mean?”
“It doesn’t mean anything, and it’s none of your business! Forget my dreams—I asked what you were doing here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Tohno-kun?"
She looks at me with a very serious expression.
"…… Senpai……?"
I'm perplexed.
I feel as if Senpai is reading my mind, and I remember more and more of last night's dream.
"Tohno-kun, you said you had a bad dream.
What does that mean?"
"It doesn't mean anything, and it's none of your business.
Don't worry about it, and I'm asking you what you're doing."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「関係ありますっ！
　遠野くん、昨日はよく眠れなかったんじゃないですか？」
「――――え？」
　いや、それは―――たしかに、その通りなんだけど。
「……先輩、どうしてそんなコトわかるの？」
「だって、遠野くん顔が真っ赤じゃないですか。
どんな病気かは知りませんけど、体調が悪そうです」
「あ―――そうゆうコト」
　一瞬、すごくドッキリした。
　先輩が昨夜の事を言い当てるものだから、まさかとは思うんだけど、てっきり―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is my business! You did not sleep properly last night, did you?”
“――――What?”
She is right―――certainly, she is.
“Ciel, how did you know that?”
“Because your face is bright red. I do not know what illness you have, but you clearly are not well.”
“Ah―――that is what you meant.”
For an instant, she gives me a terrible shock.
She guessed the truth about last night; impossible though it is, I almost think―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It is my business!
Tohno-kun, you didn't sleep well last night, did you?"
"----Eh?"
Well--she is right but.
"…… Senpai, how do you know about that?"
"Because your face is all red.
I don't know if you are sick, but you don't look well, Tohno-kun."
"Oh--I see."
I was surprised for a moment there.
She guessed right about last night, so I thought--
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「それより遠野くんの夢の話です。
どんな夢を見たんですか、聞かせてください」
　……諦めてなかったのか、先輩はまたそんなコトを聞いてくる。
「……もう。
本当に大したコトじゃないよ。
ただ……その、先輩が、ちょっと出てきただけ……だし」
　ぼそぼそと返答する。
　とたん。
「わ、わたしが出てきたんですかっ！？」
　先輩は、今までで一番、わかりやすく怒ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind that. Tell me what happened in your dream?”
She has not given up and asks me again.
“Honestly, it was nothing important. You just appeared in it for a little while… that is all.”
I mumble the answer under my breath.
The instant I do.
“I-I was in it?”
For once, her anger is impossible to miss.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About this dream, Tohno-kun.
Please tell me what kind of dream it was."
…… Senpai asks me again, as she hasn't given up.
"…… Fine.
It's not a big deal really.
Just…… Um, you were in it a little."
I answer reluctantly.
All of a sudden,
"I, I was in it!?"
Senpai gets mad.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「あの……先輩？」
「……………………」
　先輩はサッと俺から一歩引くと、じっ、と上目遣いで俺を見つめてくる。
「……………」
　先輩は何か言いたそうな顔をしたあと、ペコリ、とおじぎをして走り去ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Ciel?”
“……”
She darted a step away, then stared up at me from beneath her lashes.
“……”
After looking as though she desperately wants to say something, she gives me a quick bow and runs away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Senpai?"
"……………………"
Senpai quickly takes a step away and stares at me.
"…………"
Senpai looks like she wants to say something more, but she just gives a quick bow and runs away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
「………？」
　はて、と首をかしげる。
　直後、ホームルーム開始を告げる予鈴が鳴り響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……?”
I tilt my head.
A moment later, the warning bell for homeroom rings.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………?"
I tilt my head in confusion.
Then, the homeroom bell echoes through the hallway.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I · 6 / Bow of the Sky I

entries.japanese:
気がつくと病院のベッドにいた。
　カーテンがゆらゆらとゆれている。
　外はとてもいい天気で、
　かわいた風が、夏の終わりを告げていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I came to, I was lying in a hospital bed.
The curtains swayed back and forth.
Outside, the sky was beautifully clear,
and a dry wind announced the end of summer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When I came to, I was lying on a hospital bed.
The curtain on the nearby window sways gently.
It is a beautiful day outside,
and the dry wind signals the end of summer.

entries.japanese:
「はじめまして遠野志貴くん。
回復おめでとう」
　初めて見るおじさんは、そう言って握手を求めてきた。
　にこやかな笑顔と、四角いメガネがとても似合っている。
　清潔そうな白い服も、このおじさんにはぴったりだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Pleased to meet you, Shiki Tohno. Congratulations on your recovery.”
A man I had never seen before said that and offered me his hand.
His cheerful smile and square glasses suited him perfectly.
So did his spotless white coat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hello, Tohno Shiki-kun.
Congratulations on your recovery."
The unfamiliar old man extends his hand for a handshake.
His square-rimmed glasses and warm smile are very befitting.
His tidy-looking white clothes suit him perfectly, too.

entries.japanese:
「志貴くん。
先生の言っている事がわかるかい？」
「……いえ。
僕はどうして病院なんかにいるんですか」
「覚えていないんだね。
君は道を歩いている時、自動車の交通事故に巻き込まれたんだ。
　胸にガラスの破片が刺さってね、とても助かるような傷じゃなかったんだよ」
　白いおじさんはニコニコとした笑顔のまま、なにか、お医者さんらしくない事を言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, do you understand what I’m saying?”
“No… Why am I in a hospital?” “You don’t remember.
You were caught in a traffic accident while you were walking down the street.
A shard of glass went into your chest. It wasn’t the sort of wound anyone should have survived.”
Still smiling, the man in white said something that didn’t sound like a doctor at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Can you understand what I am saying, Shiki-kun?"
"…… No.
Why am I in a hospital?"
"You don't remember, do you?
You were involved in a car accident while you were walking.
Your chest was stabbed by a shard of glass, and it was unlikely that you would survive."
Very unbefitting of what a doctor would say, yet he says it while still smiling cheerfully.

entries.japanese:
――――――ひどく。
　　　　　　気分が、悪くなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――I felt horribly,
horribly sick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Terrible.
I feel terrible.

entries.japanese:
「……眠いです。
眠っていいですか」
「ああ、そうしなさい。
今は無理をせず、体の回復につとめるのがいい」
　お医者さんは笑顔のままだ。
　はっきりいって、とても見ていられない。
「先生、一つ聞いていいですか」
「何かな、志貴くん」
「どうして、そんなに体じゅうラクガキなんかしているんですか。
この部屋もところどころヒビだらけで、いまにも崩れちゃいそうですけど」
　お医者さんはほんの一瞬だけ笑顔を崩したけれど、すぐにまたニコニコとした笑顔に戻って、カツカツと歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sleepy. Can I go to sleep?” “Of course.
Don’t strain yourself. For now, you should concentrate on getting well.”
The doctor kept smiling.
I could hardly stand to look at him.
“Doctor, can I ask you something?”
“What is it, Shiki?”
“Why do you have scribbles all over your body? This room is full of cracks too. It looks like it might fall apart any second.”
For the briefest instant, the doctor’s smile slipped. Then it returned, as cheerful as ever, and he strode away with his heels clicking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm tired.
Can I go to sleep?"
"Yes, you should rest.
You must focus on recuperating, and not push yourself."
The doctor is still smiling.
To be honest, I can't stand that smile anymore…
"Can I ask you something, doctor?"
"What is it, Shiki-kun?"
"Why are there scribbles all over your body?
And there are cracks, all over the walls… Why are there cracks in the walls?"
The smile vanishes for just a brief moment, then returns to his face immediately.
He turns and walks away.

entries.japanese:
「―――やはり脳に異状があるようだ。
脳外科の芦家先生に連絡をいれなさい。
それと眼球にも損傷の疑いがあるな。
午後は眼の検査に回すように」
　お医者さんは、僕に聞こえないように、こっそりと看護婦さんに話しかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There does seem to be something wrong with his brain. Call Dr. Ashiya in neurosurgery. His eyes may be damaged as well; schedule an examination for this afternoon.”
The doctor whispered this to a nurse so that I wouldn’t hear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It seems there was some brain damage after all.
Get a hold of Dr. Ashiya in neurology.
I also suspect he may have suffered some damage to his eyes.
Spend the afternoon examining his eyes."
The doctor whispers to the nurse so that I won't hear him.

entries.japanese:
「………ヘンなの。
みんな体中にラクガキしてる」
　くろい、ぐちゃぐちゃした線が、病院じゅうに走ってる。
　意味はよくわからないけど、見ているだけでとても気持ちがわるい。
「……なんだろう、コレ」
　ベッドにもラクガキがある。
　指で触ってみたら、つぷり、と指先が沈み込んだ。
「―――あ」
　もっと細い物で触れたら奥まで沈みそうなので、棚におかれた果物ナイフでラクガキをなぞってみた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How strange… Everyone’s covered in scribbles.”
Black, tangled lines ran through the whole hospital.
I didn’t know what they meant, but just looking at them made me feel sick.
“What are these things…?”
There were scribbles on the bed too.
When I touched one, my fingertip sank softly into it.
“Oh.”
I thought something thinner might sink even deeper, so I took the fruit knife from the bedside cabinet and traced the scribble with it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Weird.
There are scribbles all over everyone's bodies."
The sloppy, zigzagging black lines, running all over the floors, walls, the ceiling…
I don't understand what they mean, but looking at them makes me feel sick.
"…… I wonder what it is."
The bed too, is covered in these scribbly lines.
When I touch the line with my finger, my fingertip sinks down into the crack.
"---Oh!"
It seems as if I could reach farther down with something narrower, so I trace the line with a fruit knife that was lying on the bedside table.

entries.japanese:
何の力もいれてないのに、ナイフは根元までベッドに沈み込む。
　面白かったから、そのままラクガキどおりにナイフを引いた。
　ごとん。
　重い音をたてて、ベッドはキレイに裂けてしまった。
「きゃあああああ！」
　となりのベッドにいる女の子が悲鳴をあげる。
　看護婦さんたちが走ってきて、果物ナイフを取りあげられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Without the slightest pressure, the knife sank into the bed all the way to the hilt.
It was fun, so I drew the blade along the rest of the scribble.
Thud.
The bed split cleanly in two with a heavy crash.
“Aaaaaah!”
The girl in the next bed screamed.
The nurses came running and took the fruit knife away from me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I didn't use any strength at all, yet the knife sinks into the bed, all the way up to the hilt.
It was fun, so I drag the knife along the scribbly line.
THUD!
With a heavy sound, the bed snaps cleanly in two.
"Kyaaaah!"
The girl in the bed next to mine screams.
The nurses run over and take the knife away from me.

entries.japanese:
「どうやってベッドを壊したんだね、志貴くん」
　お医者さんはベッドを壊した理由じゃなくて、その方法をしつこく聞いてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How did you break the bed, Shiki?”
The doctor kept asking how I had broken it, not why.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How did you break the bed, Shiki-kun?"
The doctors don't ask why, but curiously persist on HOW I did it.

entries.japanese:
「その線をなぞったら切れたんだよ。
ねえ、どうしてこの病院はヒビだらけなの？」
「いいかげんにしないか志貴くん。
そんな線なんてないんだ。
　それで、どうやってベッドを壊したんだい。
怒らないから教えてくれないかな」
「―――だから、その線をなぞっただけなんだ」
「……わかった。
このお話はまた明日にしよう」
　お医者さんは去っていく。
　けっきょく、誰ひとりとして僕の話を信じてはくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I traced that line, and it came apart. Why is this hospital covered in cracks?”
“That is enough, Shiki. There are no lines.
Now, how did you break the bed? I won’t be angry, so please tell me.”
“I told you—I only traced the line.” “…All right.
We’ll talk about this again tomorrow.”
The doctor left.
In the end, not one person believed me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I traced along that line and it broke.
Hey, just why is this hospital full of cracks?"
"You'd better stop with that, Shiki-kun.
There are no such cracks like that anywhere.
Now tell me, just how did you break the bed?
You can tell me, I promise I won't get mad."
"---I'm telling you, all I did was just trace the line with the knife…"
"…… I see.
Okay, we'll continue this conversation tomorrow."
The doctor leaves.
In the end, not a single person believed my story.

entries.japanese:
あのラクガキをナイフで切ると、それがなんであろうとキレイに切れた。
　力なんていらない。
　紙をハサミで切るみたいに、簡単に切ることができた。
　ベッドも。
イスも。
机も。
壁も。
床も。
　……試したことはないけれど、たぶん、きっと、にんげんも。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whenever I cut along one of those scribbles, whatever it was came apart cleanly.
I didn’t need any strength.
It was as easy as cutting paper with scissors. Beds.
Chairs. Desks. Walls. Floors.
…I never tried it, but probably—surely—people too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As long as I run the knife along the scribbles, I can cleanly cut anything.
I don't have to put any force into it.
It is as easy as cutting paper with scissors.
The bed, the chair, the desk, the walls, the floor.
……I've never tried, but probably… no, definitely, even people.

entries.japanese:
ラクガキはみんなには見えてないみたいだ。
　なぜか自分だけに見える黒い線。
　それがなんであるか、子供の自分にもなんとなく分かってきた。
　アレはきっと、ツギハギなんだ。
　手術をして傷口を縫ったあとのところみたいに、とても脆くなっているところだとおもう。
　だって、そうでもなければ子供の力で壁が切れるはずなんてない。
――――ああ、今まで知らなかった。
　セカイはこんなにもツギハギだらけで、とても壊れやすいトコロだったなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
Apparently, no one else could see the scribbles.
For some reason, the black lines were visible only to me.
Even though I was a child, I slowly began to understand what they were.
They had to be seams: weak places,
like the skin where an operation had been stitched closed.
Otherwise, there was no way a child like me could cut through a wall.
――――Oh. I never knew.
That the whole world was made of seams, and was such a terribly breakable place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But it seems that no one else can see these lines.
The black lines only I can see.
Despite being a kid, I gradually began to understand what the lines were.
They are probably like stitches.
Just like stitches that hold an open wound together after surgery, I think they are weak spots.
