It is an instinctive awe at the hopeless superiority of another creature’s physical ability.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It doesn't need to resort to verbal intimidation.
Most humans would become nervous just by looking at that kind of "hunting" beast.
As a fellow life form, it inspires awe by its dishearteningly superior athletic ability.

entries.japanese:
「……黒い、犬……？」
―――びくん、と体が震える。
　……こっちを見ているあの黒犬は野犬と言い捨てられる大きさじゃない。
　シェパードとかドーベルマンほどの大きさをした黒犬は、ただそこにいるだけでこちらを威圧しているようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A black dog?”
―――My body convulsed with a shudder.
The black dog staring at us was far too large to dismiss as a stray.
As big as a shepherd or Doberman, it seemed to menace us merely by standing there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… A black… dog?"
---I start to shake.
…… The black dog looking in our direction isn't small like a stray.
As big as a German Shepherd or a Doberman, it just stands there, menacing us.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　彼女は何も言わず、つまらなそうな目をして黒犬を見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
The woman said nothing, watching the black dog with a look of utter boredom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
The girl says nothing, but looks at the dog with disinterested eyes.

entries.japanese:
と。
　唐突に、黒犬は跳んだ。
　いや、走ってきた。
ただそのスピードが速すぎて、跳んだとしか認識できない。
「――――――え？」
　何もできない。
　黒い犬は、その予備動作さえ感じさせないまま俺の喉元へと飛びついてくる。

見えているのに。
　黒い肢体がやってくるのが見えているのに、自分は避ける事も、避けようという考えもうかばなかった。

ドン、という衝撃が体に走る。
「ぐっ―――――！」
　いきなり横殴りに弾き飛ばされた。
　黒犬に食いつかれた事による衝撃じゃない。
　俺の体は、黒い犬に首を噛み砕かれる前に、いきなり女に弾き飛ばされたらしい。
　その、まるでボールでも投げるような無造作な動作で、女は俺を片手で壁際まですっとばした。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then.
Without warning, the black dog leaped.
No—it ran. It was simply so fast that I could perceive it only as a leap.
“――――――What?”
I could do nothing.
Without even seeming to prepare itself, the black dog sprang at my throat.
I could see it.
I could see that black body rushing toward me, yet neither the act nor even the thought of dodging occurred to me.
A heavy impact jolted my body.
“Guh―――――!”
Something knocked me violently sideways.
It wasn’t the impact of the dog’s jaws.
Before the beast could crush my throat, the woman had apparently swatted me out of its path.
With one careless motion, as though tossing a ball, she flung me one-handed all the way to the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then…
Suddenly, the black dog jumps.
No, it's running, but with a speed that makes it seem like it's jumping.
"------Eh?"
I can't do anything.
The black dog jumps straight for my throat.

I can see it.
I can see its black body moving towards me, but I don't even have time to think about dodging it.

Thud!
I feel a shock on my body.
"Guh-----!"
I was hit hard from the side.
It's not the black dog.
It seems the girl pushed me before it could crush my throat.
With an easy movement, like someone throwing a ball, she hurls me into the wall using just one hand.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――！」
　ダン、と派手な音をたてて、俺は尻餅をついてしまっている。
「こ……のぉ！
　おまえ、いきなり何するんだ！」
「いいから前！」
　女が叫ぶ。
　見れば―――俺という標的を失った黒犬は、そのまま壁まで跳躍していた。
　ぴたり、と黒犬はトカゲのように壁に張り付いて、また跳んだ。
　タン、と壁からこちらに向かって反射してくる。
　黒犬の軌跡は、さながら黒い稲妻のようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
I hit the ground with a tremendous bang and landed hard on my backside.
“You… you—! What the hell was that for?”
“Look in front of you!”
The woman shouted.
When I looked―――the black dog, deprived of its target, had carried its leap all the way to the wall.
It clung there like a lizard, then sprang again and rebounded toward me with a tap.
Its path was a bolt of black lightning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
With a terrific "wham!", I fall on my rear.
"Why… you!
What in the world are you doing!?"
"Never mind that, keep your eyes in front!"
The girl yells.
I look---Having lost sight of me, its target, the black dog bounds towards the wall.
Sticking to the wall like a lizard, it jumps again.
It bounces from the wall towards me.
The dog's path is like black lightning.

entries.japanese:
「―――！」
　あまりに速すぎて反応できない。
　黒犬は牙と唾液にまみれた口をあけて、今度こそ、俺の喉笛へと食らいつく――――
「くっ………！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――!”
It was too fast to react to.
The black dog opened a mouth slick with fangs and saliva and lunged for my throat once more――――
“Urgh…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---!"
It's too fast; I can't react.
The black dog opens its mouth, filled with teeth and saliva.
This time, it clamps down towards my windpipe----

entries.japanese:
思わず目を閉じる。
　喉に、黒犬の牙が食い込む。
　が、その瞬間。
　きゃん、と鳴き声をあげて、黒犬の牙は俺の喉元から離れていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I closed my eyes without thinking.
I felt the black dog’s fangs sink into my throat.
But at that instant.
With a yelp, its fangs pulled away from my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuh……!"
I close my eyes.
The dog's teeth sink into my throat.
But in that instant,
the dog lets out a yelp and releases me.

entries.japanese:
「え―――？」
―――そんな、バカな。
　黒い犬は、鳴き声をあげて真上に跳ね上がっている。
　何もないのに、独りでに空高く舞い上がってしまっている。
　そのまま――――何メートルも空中に跳ね上げられた黒犬は、きゃん、とやけに可愛い鳴き声をあげて、そのままコンクリートの上に落下した。
　いや、正しくは。
　コンクリートの上に、激しく叩きつけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wha―――?”
―――That was impossible.
The black dog shot straight upward with a cry.
Nothing had struck it; it simply flew high into the air of its own accord.
Flung several meters overhead, it gave another absurdly cute yelp and fell toward the concrete.
No—that wasn’t quite right.
It was smashed violently into the concrete.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---?"
---That's… impossible.
The black dog lets out a scream and leaps straight up.
There is nothing there, but nonetheless it flies high into the sky by itself.
Just like that---the black dog, after going several meters into the sky, makes a scream and falls back down onto the concrete.
No, perhaps more accurately, it was hit into the concrete.

entries.japanese:
「――――なんだ、いまの」
「―――もう。
また無駄な力を使っちゃったじゃない」
　女は静かに黒犬へと近寄っていく。
　黒い犬はコンクリートの上で押し花のようにペシャンコになっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What was that?”
“―――Honestly. I’ve wasted more strength.”
The woman approached the black dog in silence.
It had been flattened against the concrete like a pressed flower.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----What was that?"
"Geez, you just made me waste more of my energy."
The girl quietly approaches the black dog.
It is crushed against the concrete like a pressed flower.

entries.japanese:
「―――とんでもなく雑種の使い魔ね。
……ようするに偵察役っていうことかしら」
　黒い犬は、そのままコールタールみたいな黒い液体になって、コンクリートに吸いこまれていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What a hopeless mongrel of a familiar. A scout, I suppose.”
The black dog dissolved into a tar-black liquid and seeped into the concrete.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That's quite a mongrel of a familiar.
…… I suppose it was some kind of scout."
The black dog liquifies into some kind of tar-like substance, and is absorbed into the concrete.

entries.japanese:
「……溶けた……ううん、今のってもしかして融けたのかな。
――――まさかね。
こんなところに混沌があるわけないか」
　ふう、と女は長い息をはいて、俺のほうへとやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Dissolved—no, was that melted? ――――No. There couldn’t be chaos in a place like this.”
The woman let out a long breath and came back toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It melted… no, maybe it's just dissolving.
----It can't be, can it?
There's no way Chaos would be in a place like this."
Heaving a long sigh, she approaches me.

entries.japanese:
「ふうん。
とりあえず傷はないようだし、問題はないわね」
　……女は何かぶつぶつと言っている。
　俺は―――たった今、自分の喉元に食いついていた犬の牙の感触に、今更になってゾクリとしたモノを感じていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm. You don’t appear to be injured, so there’s no problem.”
She muttered something to herself.
I―――only now did a chill run through me at the memory of the dog’s fangs against my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
You don't seem to be hurt, so there's no problem."
…… She's mumbling something.
My throat---I can still feel the dog's teeth sinking into it.

entries.japanese:
「おい―――今のは、なんだよ」
「敵の吸血鬼の使い魔よ。
貴方がはっきりしてくれないから見つかっちゃったわ」
「見つかったって―――えっと、さっきおまえが言ってた敵の吸血鬼っていうヤツにか……？」
「ええ、ちょっとまずい展開になってきた。
こうなったら本当に貴方には盾になってもらわないといけないみたいね」
　さらり、と。
　とんでもない事を、こいつは笑顔で言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey―――what was that?”
“A familiar belonging to the enemy vampire. You took so long to make up your mind that it found us.”
“Found us―――you mean that enemy vampire you mentioned knows we’re here?”
“Yes. This has become rather troublesome.
It seems I truly will need you as a shield.”
She said it with a smile as if it were nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---what was that thing?"
"A familiar of an enemy vampire.
We were discovered because you weren't being clear."
"Discovered---you mean… by that enemy vampire you mentioned?"
"Yeah, this isn't good.
It looks like I really will need you as a shield now."
She says it so casually, and with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――バカなこと言うなよ、このばかっ！
　今の見てたろ、俺に何ができるっていうんだ！
　俺なんかよりおまえ一人のほうがよっぽどマシなんじゃないのか……！」
「そうでもないわ。
だって、いま貴方を守るために力を使っちゃって、本当にカラッポになっちゃったから」
「なっ―――」
　なんだよ、それ。
　そりゃあとっさに庇ってくれて助かったけど、それにしたって―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“D-don’t be an idiot! You saw what happened—what could I possibly do? You’d be far better off alone than with me!”
“Not anymore. I used my remaining strength to save you just now, so I’m truly empty.”
“Wha―――”
What was that supposed to mean?
She had saved me without hesitation, and I was grateful, but even so―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"S---stop saying such crazy things, you idiot!
You saw me!
What do you think I can do!?
You're a lot better off by yourself…!"
"Not really.
With the power I just used to protect you, I really am empty now."
"Wha---!?"
What in the world?
I'm grateful she helped me just then, but still---
"…… I can't do it.
I can't.
I don't have the power to drive away something like that.
Sorry, but I can't even be a shield."

entries.japanese:
「……無理だ。
無理だよ、俺にはあんなのを追い払う力はない。
悪いけどさ、盾にだってなりゃしない」
「――――嘘よ。
貴方はわたしを殺したのよ。
その貴方がどうしてそんな嘘を言うの？」
「殺したって、アレは―――」
　自分でも、自分がわかっていなかった時の話じゃないか。
「―――ダメだ。
とにかく無理だ。
俺は普通の人間なんだ。
おまえの手伝いなんて、できない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t. I don’t have the power to drive away something like that. Sorry, but I wouldn’t even make a useful shield.”
“――――That’s a lie. You killed me. Why would someone capable of that tell such a lie?”
“Killed you? That was―――”
That had happened when I didn’t even understand myself.
“―――No. It’s impossible. I’m an ordinary human being. I can’t help you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Liar.
You killed me.
Why would you lie after doing something like that?"
"That was---"
That was something I don't even understand myself.
"---No.
Look, I can't do it.
I'm just a normal human.
I can't help you."
"…… Not true.
All you have to do is keep watch while I sleep, that's it.
You can do that much without any problems, right?"

entries.japanese:
「……ふうん。
それじゃあわたしが眠っているあいだ、まわりを見張ってくれてるだけでいい。
それぐらいなら問題ないでしょう？」
「それは―――」
　女はじっと、まっすぐに見つめてくる。
　……その目をされると、なぜか弱い。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then you can simply stand guard while I sleep. Surely even you can manage that?”
“That’s―――”
The woman looked me straight in the eye and didn’t look away.
For some reason, that gaze left me helpless.
I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's---"
She looks straight at me.
…… Somehow, those eyes are making me weaker.
I---

entries.japanese:
「俺は―――」
　……できない、とどうしても言いきれない。
　だって、俺はコイツを殺してしまって。
　そのせいでコイツは弱っていて、誰かの助けを求めているんだ。
　―――責任は、たしかに自分にある。
　それに本当に少しの間だけだったけど、コイツはそう悪いヤツじゃないって思える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I…”
I couldn’t bring myself to say no.
After all, I had killed her.
She was weak because of me, and now she needed someone’s help.
―――The responsibility was mine.
Besides, brief as our acquaintance had been, I had begun to think she might not be such a bad person.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I---"
…… For some reason, I can't decline.
I did kill her, after all.
It's my fault she's weak and has to ask others for help.
---It is my responsibility.
Besides, although I've only known her for a little while, she doesn't seem like a bad person.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ、どうなの？
　やっぱり人間の貴方としては、吸血鬼であるわたしに協力はできない？」
「――――まあ、それは当然の答えだけど」
「――――」
　ああ、だからそういう目をするなっていうんだ。
　……なんでか。
罪悪感に負けて、断りきれなくなってしまうから。
「けど、乗りかかった船だしな。
ここで知らんふりするのも目覚めが悪いし」
　―――ああ、もう。
絶対に後悔するんだろうな、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well? Can’t you, as a human, bring yourself to help a vampire?”
“That would be the natural answer, I suppose.”
“—” Oh, don’t look at me like that.
For some reason, guilt kept me from refusing her when she looked at me that way.
“But I’m involved already.
If I turn my back now, I’ll never sleep well again.”
―――Oh, hell. I was absolutely going to regret this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So how about it?
Can't a human like you cooperate with a vampire like me?"
"---Well, that would be the obvious answer, but…"
"----"
Argh, don't look at me with those eyes!
…… Why is it?
It's making me feel overcome with guilt and unable to refuse.
"But now that I've gotten myself into this mess, I won't be able to sleep at night if I just deny all responsibility."
---Man, I just know I'm going to regret this.

entries.japanese:
「……だから、いいよ。
それぐらいなら俺にもできそうだし、なにより相手は街で通り魔殺人なんかをやってるヤツなんだろ。
　ならさ、この街に住んでる人間として、おまえの手助けぐらいしないとバチがあたりそうだ」
「え――？
　それって、つまり―――」
「盾になるのはお断りだけど、見張りぐらいはしてやるってコト」
　そう口にした途端、自分のバカさ加減に本当に愛想がつきた。
　いや、愛想が尽きた、んだけど――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I can probably manage that much; besides, the enemy you’re after is the one committing these street murders, isn’t he?
As someone who lives in this town, I’d be tempting fate if I didn’t at least help you.”
“What?
You mean—” “I refuse to be your shield, but I’ll keep watch for you.”
The instant I said it aloud, I became thoroughly disgusted with my own stupidity.
I was disgusted—but then—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So, yeah.
I think I could probably do it.
The enemy's the serial killer, right?
As a resident of this town, I'd probably be struck with some kind of divine punishment if I refused to help you."
"Eh--?
You mean---"
"I'm not going to be your shield, but if it's just being your lookout, I'll do it."
I feel disgusted at how stupid I am as soon as those words are out of my mouth.
I feel disgusted, but----

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　その、こいつの。
心底驚いたような顔を見たとたん、なんていうか――――
「うわあ、本当にいいの！？
　わたし、本当に吸血鬼なんだよ！？」
「……あのな。
散々人を脅しておいて、今さら何を言ってるんだよ、おまえは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
That look on her face. The moment I saw how genuinely astonished she was, how should I put it—
“Wow, you really mean it? You know I’m an actual vampire, right?”
“After all the threats you made, isn’t it a little late to ask me that?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
There is something about her deeply shocked expression that's----

"Wow!
Are you serious!?
I'm really a vampire, you know!"
"…… Hey, listen.
Why are you saying all this now, after you've threatened me so much?"

entries.japanese:
「あ……うん、それはそうなんだけど―――」
「―――ま、いっか！
　協力してくれるんだから、感謝しないといけないよね！」
　……やけに嬉しそうな顔をして、女は壁際で尻餅をついている俺に近寄ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah… yes, I suppose it is, but—”
“Oh, never mind! You’re helping me, so I should be grateful!”
Looking oddly delighted, the woman approached where I sat against the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah… Hm.
That's true, but---"
"---Well, whatever!
If you're going to cooperate with me, then I should be grateful!"
…… With a very happy expression on her face, she approaches me as I lie there on my rear, up against the wall.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあこれで契約は成立、と」
　女はしゃがみこんでいる俺に手を差し伸べてくる。
「これでやっと自己紹介ができるわね。
　わたしはアルクェイド───うん、長い名前だからアルクェイドだけでいいわ。
真祖って区分けされる吸血鬼だけど、貴方はなんていう人？」
　今までお目にかかった事もない自己紹介をされて、重苦しいため息をついた。
　……諦めのため息というか、つまり、このデタラメな状況を受け入れてしまった証というか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That settles our contract.”
She crouched and reached out a hand to help me up.
“Now we can finally introduce ourselves.
I’m Arcueid—my full name is long, so just Arcueid is fine. I’m a vampire classified as a True Ancestor. And who are you?”
It was the strangest introduction I had ever heard, and I let out a long, heavy sigh.
A sigh of resignation—or maybe proof that I had accepted this ridiculous situation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Our contract is established."
She extends her hand towards me.
"I guess I can finally introduce myself now.
I'm Arcueid---hmm… my last name is really long, so just Arcueid is fine for now.
I'm a True Ancestor type vampire.
How about you?"
I heave a heavy sigh at her unprecedented introduction.
…… It's a sigh of resignation, evidence I've decided to accept this nonsensical situation.

entries.japanese:
「遠野志貴。
あいにくただの学生だよ。
……前もって言っておくけど、本当に何の役にもたたないからな」
　女───アルクェイドの手を握って立ち上がる。
　彼女はまじまじとこちらを眺めた後、改めて握手を求めてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki Tohno. Unfortunately, I’m only a student. I’m warning you now: I really won’t be much use.”
I took the woman’s hand—Arcueid’s hand—and stood.
She studied me intently, then offered her hand again for a proper shake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm Tohno Shiki.
Sadly, I'm just your everyday student.
…… I've said it before, but I'm really not going to be much use."
Grasping her---Arcueid's hand, I stand up.
She takes a long hard look at me, and then offers me her hand again.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあよろしくね、志貴。
　わたしを殺した責任、ちゃんととってもらうんだから」
　ニッコリと左手を差し出すアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll be counting on you, Shiki.
You’re going to take proper responsibility for killing me.”
Smiling brightly, Arcueid extended her left hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nice to meet you, Shiki.
I'll have you take responsibility for killing me."
Arcueid grins as she extends her left hand.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ」
　……世の中にはいろんな責任ってのがあると思うけど、殺した相手を手助けする責任を負うのは、たぶん俺が最初で最後なんじゃないだろうか。
「……くそ、ほんとにどうかしてる」
　けど、これじゃ他にどうしようもないじゃないか。
　嫌々ながら左手を差し出して、俺は、吸血鬼だという白い女と握手をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right…”
The world must contain every imaginable kind of responsibility, but I was probably the first and last person ever obliged to help someone he had murdered.
“Damn it. I really have lost my mind.”
But what other choice did I have?
Reluctantly, I extended my left hand and shook hands with the pale woman who claimed to be a vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
…… There are all sorts of responsibilities in this world, but this is probably the first and last time someone takes responsibility by helping someone they've killed.
"…… Damn it… this is seriously messed up."
But there's nothing else I can do.
I grudgingly extend my left hand and shake hands with the woman in white claiming to be a vampire.

entries.japanese:
「俺は―――」
　協力なんかできるはずがない。
　さっきの黒犬一匹に殺されかけているんだから、こんなヤツについていったら間違いなく死んでしまう。
「―――自殺するような真似は、できない」
　震える声で、なんとか女を睨みながら返答した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I…”
There was no way I could help her.
A single black dog had nearly killed me. Following this creature would guarantee my death.
“I can’t do something that suicidal.”
My voice shook, but I managed to answer while glaring at the woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I---"
There's no way I can help her.
I was almost killed by just that black dog.
If I go with her, I'll die for sure.
"---I can't do something like that.
It'd be suicide."
I manage to glare at her and reply, trembling.

entries.japanese:
女は不機嫌そうに俺を見つめている。
「自殺って、どうしてよ。
貴方ほどの殺害技術があるんなら恐いものなんてないと思うんだけど？」
「だからアレは違うんだ。
　悪いけど俺は普通の学生で、吸血鬼なんていう化け物とは違いすぎる。
普通の学生がさ、おまえみたいなヤツに協力なんかできるか」
「ふーん。
普通の学生っていうのは見ず知らずの女の子をバラバラに切断しちゃうんだ？」
「────う」
　それを言われると弱い。
entries.maoEnglish:
She stared at me, displeased.
“Suicide—why? With your talent for killing, I can’t imagine what you have to fear.”
“That wasn’t talent; I’m sorry, but I’m an ordinary student.
I’m nothing like a monster such as a vampire. How could an ordinary student possibly help someone like you?”
“Really? Ordinary students dismember girls they’ve never met?”
“Urgh.”
That was difficult to answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She looks at me with displeasure.
"Suicide?
Why?
With your killing abilities, I would think you have nothing to fear."
"That was different.
I'm sorry, but I'm just a normal student, not some kind of monster like a vampire.
A normal student can't cooperate with a person like you."
"Oh?
Do normal students usually cut up girls they don't even know?"
"----Ah."
I feel weakened by her comment.

entries.japanese:
「……けど、あれは特別だ。
今まであんな事はなくて、俺は普通に生きてたんだ。
俺は───」
「ああもう、うるさい！」
「え───」
　赤い瞳の瞳孔が開く。
　女の雰囲気が一変する。
　なんて悪寒。
　睨まれただけで、本当に心臓が止まるかと、思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was different. Nothing like it had ever happened before. I lived an ordinary life. I’m—”
“Oh, shut up already!”
“What—”
The pupils of her red eyes dilated.
The woman’s entire presence changed in an instant.
A deathly chill swept through me.
One glare, and I truly thought my heart might stop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But that was special.
I've never felt that way before, and I've lived a normal life---"
"Aahh enough, shut up!"
"Eh---"
The pupils in those red eyes open up.
Immediately, the feeling she exudes changes.
The chilling feeling is unbelievable.
I think my heart might stop beating just from her glare alone.

entries.japanese:
「勘違いしないで。
貴方はわたしを殺したの。
本来ならここでその首を引き抜いてるところを、貴方が使えそうだから助けてあげてるだけなのよ」
entries.maoEnglish: “Don’t misunderstand. You killed me. Ordinarily I would tear your head off here and now. I’m sparing you only because you look useful.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't get me wrong.
You killed me.
I'm saving you and not pulling off your head right now just because you might be useful."

entries.japanese:
ぎちり、と。
　首の後ろに、カッターの刃を刺しこまれて行くような、痺れが、する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Something grated at the back of my neck—a spreading numbness
like a box-cutter blade being driven into my flesh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My neck feels numb, like someone is slowly sinking a blade into it.
"-----"
My throat, which had been so hot a moment ago, is rapidly growing colder.

entries.japanese:
「─────」
　あんなに熱かった喉が、急速に冷えていく。
　吸い込む空気が重い。
　まるでこのあたりの空気が凍ってしまって、ボロボロと崩れてしまいそうな狭苦しさ。
　世界そのものに睨まれているような、絶望的なまでの威圧感。
　それらすべての重苦しさが一握りの大きさに凝縮されて、弾丸のように俺の脳髄にたたき込まれてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
My burning throat went cold.
The air became heavy in my lungs.
It was as if the air around me had frozen and was about to crumble apart, leaving me crushed and unable to breathe.
The pressure was absolute, as though the world itself had turned its gaze upon me.
All that crushing weight condensed to the size of a fist and struck my brain like a bullet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The air I breathe feels heavy.
As if the very air around here is freezing… I feel a cramped sensation that almost makes me collapse.
An oppressive feeling full of despair, like the world itself were glaring at me.
All that feeling of weight condenses and hammers into my brain like a bullet.

entries.japanese:
「あ─────え？」
　意識が白くなる。
　頭蓋骨に穴を開けられて、そのままアルコールを流し込まれてるようなおぞましさ。
　その痛み。
この感覚は、そうとしか思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah… what?”
My consciousness bleached white.
It felt as though a hole had been bored through my skull and alcohol poured directly inside.
The pain—the sensation—could be nothing else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----eh?"
Everything goes white.
A disgusting feeling.
Pain, like someone opened a hole in my skull and is pouring in alcohol.
That is the only way to describe this sensation.

entries.japanese:
「カ―――――――」
　悲鳴さえあげられない。
　口からもれる音は、すでに人間の言葉でさえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Khhh—”
I could not even scream.
The sound leaking from my mouth was no longer human speech.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah-------"
I can't even cry out.
The sounds leaking from my mouth are no longer human speech.

entries.japanese:
「亜───具」
　ココロが壊れる。
　キオクが崩れる。
　あの女に睨まれてるだけなのに、脳髄を素手でかき回されてるような感覚がする。
　これ以上こんなのが続いたら、俺はヌケガラになっちまう────
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aah… gh…”
My mind breaks.
My memories collapse.
She is only staring at me, yet it feels as though a bare hand is stirring my brain.
If this continues, there will be nothing left of me but an empty shell—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A---guhh."
My heart is breaking apart.
My memories are crumbling.
She's only glaring at me, but I feel like she's reaching into my skull and kneading my brain with her bare hands.
If this continues, I'm going to be empty----

entries.japanese:
「ヤ────メ、ロ」
　意識が廃人になる前に、それだけの言葉が言えた。
　とたん───頭の中に入ってきていた異物感がなくなっていく。

「は───あ」
　圧迫から解放されて、自分の体を抱きしめる。
───まだ、生きてる。
　俺は死んでない。
　こうして生きていて、ちゃんと呼吸をしてる。
―――涙が、出そうだった。
　そんな単純なことが、こんなにも感激するべきことなんて、今まで知らなかったぐらいに───
entries.maoEnglish:
“St—op…”
Before my mind was destroyed, I managed that one word.
At once, the alien presence inside my head began to withdraw.
“Haaah…”
Released from the pressure, I wrapped both arms around myself.
───I was still alive.
I wasn’t dead.
I was here, alive, breathing.
―――Tears nearly came.
Until that moment, I had never known that anything so simple could feel like such a miracle—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop----it."
That's all I can say before I lose my sanity.
Suddenly---the invasive feeling inside my head disappears.
"Hha---aghh."
Released from the oppressive aura, I hug myself.
---I'm still alive.
I'm not dead.
I'm still alive and breathing.
---I feel like I'm about to cry.
To feel such deep emotion at such a simple thing is something I hadn't experienced up until now---

entries.japanese:
「どう？
　自分の立場が少しはわかってくれたかしら」
「―――――――」
　……そんなもの、わかるもんか。
　俺はただ、ガタガタと震えている歯を必死に堪えて、こいつを見上げる事しかできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well?
Do you understand your position now?”
“—” How could I?
All I could do was fight the chattering of my teeth and look up at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How about it?
Maybe now you understand your position a little better."
"-------"
…… You think I can understand that?
All I can do is look up, tremble, and grit my teeth.

entries.japanese:
「貴方に許されている選択はわたしに協力するかしないかの二つだけ。
　簡単でしょ？
　わたしは単に、アナタに生きるか死ぬかを聞いているだけなんだから」
「ふ──────」
　声が、うまく出ない。
　ただ、死にたくないという本能だけが、俺にこくんとうなずかせていた。

「うん、これで契約は成立、と」
　さっきまでの殺気はどこにいったのか、気軽な口調で俺に手を差し伸べてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You have only two choices: help me or refuse.
Simple, isn’t it? I’m only asking whether you want to live or die.”
“Hh—”
My voice would not come.
Only the instinctive desire not to die made me give a tiny nod.
“Good. That settles our contract.”
All trace of her murderous presence gone, she casually offered me a hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There's only two choices.
You cooperate with me, or you don't.
Simple, isn't it?
All I'm asking you is whether you want to live or die."
"H------"
My voice doesn't work properly.
Only my basic survival instincts help me to avoid death by nodding in reply.
"Alright.
Then our contract is established."
Where did all that anger from just a moment ago disappear to?
Speaking in a cheerful tone, she extends her hand to me.

entries.japanese:
「これでやっと自己紹介ができるわね。
　わたしはアルクェイド───うん、長い名前だからアルクェイドだけでいいわ。
真祖って区分けされる吸血鬼だけど、貴方はなんていう人？」
　今までお目にかかった事もない自己紹介をされて、重苦しいため息をついた。
　……諦めのため息というか、つまり、このデタラメな状況を受け入れてしまった証というか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now we can finally introduce ourselves.
I’m Arcueid—my full name is long, so just Arcueid is fine. I’m a vampire classified as a True Ancestor. And who are you?”
It was the strangest introduction I had ever heard, and I let out a long, heavy sigh.
A sigh of resignation—or maybe proof that I had accepted this ridiculous situation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess I can finally introduce myself now.
I'm Arcueid---hmm…… my last name is really long, so just Arcueid is fine for now.
I'm a True Ancestor type vampire.
How about you?"
I heave a heavy sigh at her unprecedented introduction.
…… It's a sigh of resignation, evidence I've decided to accept this nonsensical situation.

entries.japanese:
「遠野志貴。
あいにくただの学生だよ。
……前もって言っておくけど、本当に何の役にもたたないからな」
　女───アルクェイドの手を握って立ち上がる。
　彼女はまじまじとこちらを眺めた後、改めて握手を求めてきた。
「それじゃあよろしくね、志貴。
　わたしを殺した責任、ちゃんととってもらうんだから」
　ニッコリと左手を差し出すアルクェイド。

……世の中にはいろんな責任ってのがあると思うけど、殺した相手を手助けする責任を負うのは、たぶん俺が最初で最後なんじゃないだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki Tohno. Unfortunately, I’m only a student. I’m warning you now: I really won’t be much use.”
I took the woman’s hand—Arcueid’s hand—and stood. She studied me intently, then offered her hand again for a proper shake.
“I’ll be counting on you, Shiki.
You’re going to take proper responsibility for killing me.”
Smiling brightly, Arcueid extended her left hand.
The world must contain every imaginable kind of responsibility, but I was probably the first and last person ever obliged to help someone he had murdered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm Tohno Shiki.
Sadly, I'm just your everyday student.
…… I've said it before, but I'm really not going to be much use."
Grasping her---Arcueid's hand, I stand up.
She takes a long hard look at me, and then offers me her hand again.
"Nice to meet you, Shiki.
I'll have you take responsibility for killing me."
Arcueid grins as she extends her left hand.
…… There are all sorts of responsibilities in this world, but this is probably the first and last time someone takes responsibility by helping someone they've killed.

entries.japanese:
「……くそ、もうどうにでもしてくれ」
　けど、これじゃ他にどうしようもない。
　嫌々ながら左手を差し出して、俺は、吸血鬼だという白い女と握手をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it. Do whatever you want with me.”
There was no other choice.
Reluctantly, I extended my left hand and shook hands with the pale woman who claimed to be a vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Damn it!
Do whatever you want."
But there's nothing else I can do.
I grudgingly extend my left hand and shake hands with the woman in white claiming to be a vampire.

entries.japanese:
「……………くっ」
　そんなの無理に決まってる。
　こっちはあの黒犬一匹にだって殺されそうになったんだ。
コイツの見張りなんてやったら、それこそ次はどうなるかわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
There was no way I could agree to this.
That one black dog had nearly killed me. If I stayed to watch her, God only knew what would happen next.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kuhh!"
It's impossible.
I was almost killed by just one black dog.
If I become her lookout, who knows what'll happen next.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、早く答えて。
わたし、あんまり無茶なことは言ってないと思うけどなぁ」
「…………」
　わかってない。
コイツは、自分自身が無茶の塊みたいなヤツなんだってわかってない。
　……これ以上関わり合いになったら、それこそ戻れないところまで引きずられていってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, answer me. I don’t think I’m asking anything too unreasonable.”
“…”
She didn’t understand. She didn’t understand that she herself was recklessness incarnate.
If I let her draw me in any deeper, she would drag me somewhere I could never come back from.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, hurry up and answer.
I don't think I'm being unreasonable here."
"……"
She doesn't understand.
It's evident she can't see that she's recklessness incarnate.
…… If I get involved further with her, she'll drag me past the point of no return.

entries.japanese: ここは――――隙を見てなんとか逃げ出すしかない。
entries.maoEnglish: I had no choice. I would wait for an opening, then somehow make a run for it.
entries.mirrorMoon: I've got to find a chance to escape.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
とりあえず話ぐらいは聞くよ」
　壁に手をついて、なんとか一人で立ちあがる。
　……ここから大通りに出るには、あの細い道を通らないといけない。
　幸い、この女よりこっちのほうが道には近い。
　話すふりをして駆け出せば、なんとか大通りに出られるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…All right. I’ll at least hear you out.”
Bracing one hand against the wall, I managed to stand on my own.
To reach the main road, I had to take that narrow passage.
Luckily, I was closer to it than she was.
If I pretended to talk and then bolted, I ought to make it to the main road.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright.
I'll listen to what you've got to say."
Putting my hand on the wall, I somehow manage to stand up on my own.
…… I've got to pass through that small road if I'm to get to the main street from here.
Fortunately, it's further away for her than it is for me.
If I set off while pretending to talk, I can probably make it to the main street.

entries.japanese:
「そっか、わたしたちまだお互いの名前も知らないんだっけ。
たしかに、これで協力しろっていうのはちょっと順番が違うよね」
　女はうんうん、と納得する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, that’s right. We don’t even know each other’s names yet. I suppose asking you to help me before we introduce ourselves is doing things in the wrong order.”
The woman nodded to herself, satisfied.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh yeah.
We still don't even know each other's names yet.
I guess it is a bit too fast to ask you to cooperate with me."
She nods in agreement.

entries.japanese:
「だろ？
　だからもうちょっと詳しい話をしてくれたら、俺も協力してやってもいい」
「そう？
　それじゃ何から話そうかな―――やっぱり街を騒がしてる吸血鬼の事のがいい？
　それともこれからのことを説明しよっか？」
　うーん、と女は真剣に考え込む。
――――それが、唯一にして絶対のチャンスだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. So tell me a little more, and then maybe I’ll consider helping you.”
“Really? Then where should I start? Do you want to hear about the vampire causing all the trouble in town, or should I explain what we’re going to do from here?”
The woman hummed thoughtfully, giving the question her full attention.
――――That was my one and only chance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't it?
If you tell me more details, I might agree to help."
"Really?
Then what should I talk about first?
---How about the vampire incident that's got this town in an uproar?
Or maybe I should explain what we'll be doing from now on?"
She makes a serious face while she thinks.
----This is my only chance.

entries.japanese:
―――全力で走る。
　女の隙をついて、大通りに通じる道まで一息で駆けぬける。
「―――あれ？」
　背後で女の声が聞こえた。
　だが、もう間に合わない。
　これなら確実に逃げ出せる――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I ran flat out.
Catching her off guard, I tore down the passage toward the main road without pausing for breath.
“Huh?”
Her voice came from behind me.
Too late.
I was going to get away for sure—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I run as fast as I can.
I run to the road that leads to the main road in one breath.
"---Huh?"
I can hear her voice from behind me.
But it's too late.
Now I'll definitely be able to escape---!

entries.japanese:
「――――あれ？」
　不思議だ。
　数歩踏み出したとたん、自分から地面に激突してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh?”
How strange.
I had taken only a few steps when I somehow pitched straight into the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Huh?"
That's strange.
As I take a few steps forward, I fall down hard on the ground.

entries.japanese:
「ねぇ、なにしてるの？」
　心配している……というか、呆れたような目つきで女がこっちにやってくる。
「……いや、別に。
ちょっと走ってみたくなっただけ」
　……女はこっちが逃げ出そうとした事に気がついていないようだ。
　なんとか場を取り繕って立ちあがる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you doing?”
The woman came over wearing a look that was less concerned than exasperated.
“…Nothing. I just felt like running for a second.”
Apparently she hadn’t realized I was trying to escape.
I struggled upright, doing my best to act as if nothing had happened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey.
What are you doing?"
She comes over, giving me a look more filled with amazement than concern.
"…… Nothing.
I just wanted to run for a bit."
…… It seems she hasn't realized I was trying to escape.

entries.japanese:
が。
「っ……！」
　痛い……！
　足の関節がすごく痛くて、とてもじゃないけど立ちあがれない―――！
entries.maoEnglish:
Except—
“Ngh…!”
Pain—! The joints in my legs hurt so badly there was no chance of standing—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get up.
But.
"……!"
Ow…!
I feel an incredible pain in the joints of my foot, I can't get up---!

entries.japanese:
「あ、やっぱりさっきのは強すぎたかな。
ごめんね、もう少し加減して突き飛ばせば、そんなふうに足にくることはなかったと思う」
「なかったと思う、って、おまえ――――」
　人を突き飛ばしておいて、と言いたいけど、コイツがそうしてくれなかったら、今ごろ俺は黒犬に首を食いちぎられてご臨終だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, I guess that shove was too hard. Sorry—if I’d held back a little more, I don’t think your legs would have ended up like that.”
“You ‘don’t think’—you…”
I wanted to ask what gave her the right to shove anyone, but if she hadn’t, that black dog would have torn out my throat and I would already be dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, I guess I was a bit too hard on you back there, sorry.
If I had softened the blow a bit when I pushed you, you might not have sprained your foot like that."
"Might not---!?
Listen, you----"
I wanted to complain about her pushing me, but if she hadn't, the black dog would be chewing on my neck by now and that would have been the end of me.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、感謝してるから、いいけど」
「そういってくれると助かるわ。
けど、どうしていきなり走ったりしたの？
　わたしと話をするって言ったのに」
「いや、それは―――」
　方便なんだ、とは口が裂けてもいえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…No, forget it. I’m grateful, so it’s fine.”
“That’s a relief. But why did you suddenly start running?
You said you’d talk to me.”
“Well, that was—” There was no possible way I could admit it had only been an excuse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay.
I'm grateful."
"Thank you.
But, why did you want to start running?
Weren't we having a conversation?"
"No, um, that's---"
I can't exactly say it was a matter of convenience.

entries.japanese:
「…………………ふぅん」
　女はじろり、と睨んでくる。
　……まずい。
そりゃあどんなに抜けていても、普通、俺が何を考えていたかぐらいは解るだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm…”
The woman fixed me with a hard stare.
This was bad. No matter how scatterbrained she was, anyone could work out what I had been thinking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Hmmmn?"
She stares at me.
…… This is bad.
You'd have to be a real idiot not to understand what I was doing.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ。
さっきのはわたしに協力するっていう意味だったんでしょう？」
「……………」
　答えられない。
　さっきのだって、話を聞く、といっただけで協力する、とは言っていない。
―――嘘は言いたくない。
　だから、女の質問に答えるとしたら、それは『ノー』というものになってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen. What you said before meant you were going to help me, didn’t it?”
“…”
I couldn’t answer.
All I had said was that I would listen. I had never said I would help.
―――I didn’t want to lie.
Which meant that if I answered her question at all, my answer would have to be no.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, that was an indication you wanted to cooperate with me back then, right?"
"………"
I can't answer.
I said I would listen to her, but not cooperate.
---I don't want to lie.
Answering her question requires a definite "no".

entries.japanese:
「一つ言っておくけど、わたしは貴方がどんな人間かそれなりにわかってる。
だから中途半端な返答だけはしないほうがいいわよ。
　だって、ここで貴方が逃げたら、次は貴方の家に行くことになるんだから」
「なっ―――――」
　それ、それはつまり―――俺がここから逃げ出しても、屋敷のほうにこいつが来るっていう事か！
entries.maoEnglish:
“One thing first. I already have a fair idea what kind of person you are, so you’d better not give me some halfhearted answer.
If you run away now, I’ll simply have to visit your house next.”
“What—?”
Did that mean that even if I escaped, she would come to the mansion after me?!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just so you know, I know what sort of person you are.
Don't give me a half-hearted response.
If you run away now, I'll just be going to your house next."
"Wh---!?"
That means that she's going to come to the mansion even if I escaped from here!

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　やられた。
　そうなると問題は俺だけじゃなくなる。
秋葉や翡翠、琥珀さんまでこんなワケの解らないヤツに襲われるかもしれない。
「くっ………」
　なんて事だ。
　これってつまり、初めから選択肢なんてなかったっていう事じゃないか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
She had me.
This was no longer only my problem. Akiha, Hisui—even Kohaku—might be attacked by this incomprehensible woman.
“Damn…”
What the hell?
Had there never been a choice in the first place—?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……"
She's got me.
If that were to happen, it wouldn't just be my problem.
Akiha, Hisui, and Kohaku-san might be attacked by this crazy person too.
"Cr…!"
What a mess.
It's like I never had a choice in the first place----

entries.japanese:
「ま、わたしはどっちでもいいんだけど。
どのみち貴方はもう吸血鬼の使い魔に見付かってしまったから、このままだとまず狙われる。
なら、わたしと別れて行動してくれれば少しは目くらましになってくれるかもしれないしね」
「な……それって、まさか」
「ええ。
さっきの使い魔は貴方とわたしを仲間だって認識したっていうことよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, either way is fine with me. A vampire’s familiar has already spotted you, so you’re almost certain to become a target now. If you go your own way instead of staying with me, you might at least make a useful diversion.”
“Wait… You can’t mean…”
“I do. That familiar took you and me for allies.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I don't mind either way.
The vampire's familiar has already seen you, so you'll be surely attacked.
If you go around by yourself, you might act as a decoy, too."
"Wh… hey, don't tell me that…"
"Yes, that familiar recognized you as being on my side."
"--------"
Then that means I'll be attacked by things like that even if I don't help her.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　それじゃあコイツに協力しなくても、さっきみたいなのに襲われるっていう事じゃないか。
「さ、どうするの。
わたしに協力して眠りの番をしてくれるのか、それとも一人でさっきみたいな使い魔を追い払うの？」
　……そんなの、結果が同じならうなずくしかないじゃないか。
「――――この、サギ師」
　ため息をついて、協力する、と頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—” So even if I refused to help her,
things like that could still attack me.
“Well? Will you help me and stand guard while I sleep, or would you rather drive off familiars like that all by yourself?”
If both choices led to the same place, all I could do was nod.
“You… con artist.”
With a sigh, I nodded my agreement.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, what's it gonna be?
Are you going to keep watch while I sleep, or are you going to drive off those familiars by yourself?"
…… If the results are going to be the same, I can't do anything but nod.
"----You swindler."
Sighing, I nod to indicate that I will help her.

entries.japanese:
「よし、これで契約は成立ね」
　さっきまでの殺気はどこにいったのか、気軽な口調で俺に手を差し伸べてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good. Then we have a deal.”
As if her murderous air had never existed, she spoke lightly and held out her hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Okay, our contract is established."
Where did all that anger from just a moment ago disappear to?
Speaking in a cheerful tone, she extends her hand to me.

entries.japanese:
「これでやっと自己紹介ができるわ。
　わたしはアルクェイド───うん、長い名前だからアルクェイドだけでいいわ。
真祖って区分けされる吸血鬼だけど、貴方はなんていう人？」
　今までお目にかかった事もない自己紹介をされて、重苦しいため息をついた。
　……諦めのため息というか、つまり、このデタラメな状況を受け入れてしまった証というか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now we can finally introduce ourselves.
I’m Arcueid—my full name is long, so just Arcueid is fine. I’m a vampire classified as a True Ancestor. And who are you?”
It was the strangest introduction I had ever heard, and I let out a long, heavy sigh.
A sigh of resignation—or maybe proof that I had accepted this ridiculous situation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess I can finally introduce myself now.
I'm Arcueid---hmm… my last name is really long, so just Arcueid is fine for now.
I'm a True Ancestor type vampire.
How about you?"
I heave a heavy sigh at her unprecedented introduction.
…… It's a sigh of resignation, evidence I've decided to accept this nonsensical situation.

entries.japanese:
「遠野志貴。
あいにくただの学生だよ。
……前もって言っておくけど、本当に何の役にもたたないからな」
　女───アルクェイドの手を握って立ち上がる。
　彼女はまじまじとこちらを眺めた後、改めて握手を求めてきた。
「それじゃあよろしくね、志貴。
　わたしを殺した責任、ちゃんととってもらうんだから」
　ニッコリと左手を差し出すアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki Tohno. Unfortunately, I’m only a student. I’m warning you now: I really won’t be much use.”
I took the woman’s hand—Arcueid’s hand—and stood. She studied me intently, then offered her hand again for a proper shake.
“I’ll be counting on you, Shiki.
You’re going to take proper responsibility for killing me.”
Smiling brightly, Arcueid extended her left hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm Tohno Shiki.
Sadly, I'm just your everyday student.
…… I've said it before, but I'm really not going to be much use."
Grasping her---Arcueid's hand, I stand up.
She takes a long hard look at me, and then offers me her hand again.
"Nice to meet you, Shiki.
I'll have you take responsibility for killing me."
Arcueid grins as she extends her left hand.

entries.japanese: ……世の中にはいろんな責任ってのがあると思うけど、殺した相手を手助けする責任を負うのは、たぶん俺が最初で最後なんじゃないだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish: The world must contain every imaginable kind of responsibility, but I was probably the first and last person ever obliged to help someone he had murdered.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… There are all sorts of responsibilities in this world, but this is probably the first and last time someone takes responsibility by helping someone they've killed.

entries.japanese:
「……くそ、もうどうにでもしてくれ」
　けど、これじゃ他にどうしようもない。
　嫌々ながら左手を差し出して、俺は、吸血鬼だという白い女と握手をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it. Do whatever you want with me.”
There was no other choice.
Reluctantly, I extended my left hand and shook hands with the pale woman who claimed to be a vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Damn it!
Do whatever you want."
But there's nothing else I can do.
I grudgingly extend my left hand and shake hands with the woman in white claiming to be a vampire.

entries.japanese:
「……ん？」
　路地裏から表通りに出た途端、彼女―――アルクェイドは不審そうに眉をよせた。
「ねえ志貴。
貴方ってもしかしてクリスチャン？」
　……アルクェイドの問いかけは、本当によくわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm?”
The moment we emerged from the alley onto the main street, Arcueid knit her brow in suspicion.
“Shiki, are you a Christian by any chance?”
Arcueid’s questions truly made no sense at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmmm?"
As we walk out of the back alley, she--Arcueid--knits her eyebrows and gives me a suspicious look.
"Hey, Shiki.
Are you a Christian, by any chance?"
…… I have no idea what she's talking about.
"Chris-chan…?
What's with that question, all of a sudden?
I don't know any girl who's got a name like that."

entries.japanese:
「クリスちゃん……？
　なんだよ突然。
そんな女の子の知り合いはいないけど？」
「そう。
じゃあわたしの勘違いね」
　あっさりと自分勝手に納得すると、アルクェイドはオフィス街にむかって踵を返した。
「それじゃ行きましょうか。
とりあえず安全なところを探さないとね」
　アルクェイドは歩き始める。
「――――はあ」
　いまさら引き返す事はできそうにない。
　ため息をついて、俺は彼女の後についていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A Christian…? You mean some guy named Christian? Why ask me that? I don’t know anyone by that name.”
“Oh. Then I was mistaken.”
Having settled the matter entirely to her own satisfaction, Arcueid turned toward the business district.
“Let’s go, then. First we need to find somewhere safe.”
Arcueid started walking.
“Haaah.”
It was much too late to turn back now.
With a sigh, I followed her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then I must have misunderstood."
After seeming to have made a decision, she turns towards the office district.
"Okay, let's go.
We've got to find a safe place for now."
Arcueid begins walking.
"----Okay."
There's no way I can back out now.
Sighing, I follow after her.

entries.japanese:
「うん、わりといい部屋ね。
これなら一晩過ごしても文句ないかな」
　楽しそうにホテルの部屋を見渡すアルクェイド。
「――――」
　こっちとしては、とりあえず言葉がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, this is a pretty nice room. I certainly can’t complain about spending the night here.”
Arcueid looked around the hotel room with delight.
“—”
For my part, I had no words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is a pretty nice room.
I'd have no problems spending the night here."
Arcueid looks around the hotel room.
"-----"
I've got nothing to say for now.

entries.japanese:
「わたしの部屋はもうバレてるだろうから、今夜はここに隠れましょ。
あ、お金のことは気にしなくていいよ。
わたしお金持ちだから、おごってあげる」
　陽気に言いつつ、アルクェイドは窓のカーテンを閉める。
　ついでに部屋の電気も消してしまって、部屋の中は夜中のような暗さになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“They probably know about my room already, so we’ll hide here tonight. Oh, don’t worry about the money. I’m rich, so it’s my treat.”
Still speaking cheerfully, Arcueid closed the curtains.
Then she switched off the lights as well, plunging the room into midnight darkness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"My room has probably already been discovered, so let's hide out here for the night.
Oh, you don't have to worry about money.
I'm rich, so I'll treat you."
Speaking cheerfully, Arcueid closes the curtains.
She also turns off the lights and the room becomes as dark as night.

entries.japanese:
はあ、とため息がもれる。
「……アルクェイド。
おまえ、なに考えてるんだ」
「なにって、別に色々考えてるけど」
「いや、そういうコトじゃなくて―――」
　どうしてホテルの、それも安っぽいホテルじゃなくて高級ホテルの、あまつさえ最上階を全部貸しきりにするような真似をするのかっていうコトだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
A sigh escaped me.
“…Arcueid, what the hell are you thinking?”
“What am I thinking? Lots of things.”
“No, that isn’t what I mean—”
I meant: why choose a hotel at all—and not some cheap place, but a luxury hotel—and then, to cap it all, rent out the entire top floor?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I sigh.
"…… What are you thinking, Arcueid?"
"I'm thinking about all sorts of stuff."
"No, that's not what I mean---"
I'm asking why you've rented a high-class hotel, not a cheap one--and why you rented out the whole top floor.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　そう言いかけて、やめた。
　今の自分の役割は、この自称吸血鬼の見張りをする事だけなんだ。
余分なことを聞くのはやめておこう。
「―――いや、いい。
好きにしてくれ」
「ヘンな志貴。
いきなり怒ったり黙ったりして、予測がつかないね」
　何が楽しいのかニコニコ顔のままアルクェイドはベッドに横になった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I stopped myself.
My sole duty now was to keep watch over this self-proclaimed vampire. Better not ask unnecessary questions.
“Forget it. Do whatever you like.”
“You’re strange, Shiki. One moment you’re angry, the next you’re silent; I never know what you’ll do.”
Still smiling for reasons beyond me, Arcueid lay down on the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
I try to say this, but I stop.
Right now, my job is to guard this so-called vampire and nothing more.
I'm not going to ask any useless questions.
"---No, forget it.
Do whatever you like."
"You're weird, Shiki, suddenly getting mad and going silent like that.
I just don't get you."
Arcueid lies on the bed, smiling like she's having fun.

entries.japanese:
「日が沈むまで眠るわ。
志貴もいまのうちに休んでおいたほうがいいわよ。
　吸血鬼は昼間には活動できないから、本格的に見張りをしてもらうのは夜になるんだし」
「……おまえね。
いま、自分自身の存在を全面否定するようなコトを言ったってわかってるか？」
「わたしはいいの。
―――っと、そろそろ限界みたい。
それじゃおやすみなさい、志貴。
日が沈んだら起こしてよね」
「お、おい」
「―――――――」
　アルクェイドは電池がきれた機械のように、唐突に眠ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m going to sleep until sunset. You should rest while you can too.
Vampires can’t act during the day, so your real watch won’t begin until night.”
“…You do realize you just said something that completely disproves your own existence?”
“I’m an exception. Oh—looks like I’m at my limit. Good night, Shiki. Wake me when the sun goes down.”
“H-hey.”
“—”
Like a machine whose battery had died, Arcueid fell asleep without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm going to sleep until the sun sets.
You'd better rest while you have the chance.
Vampires don't move about in the daytime, so you'll be on guard for real during the night."
"…… Do you realize you've just said something that completely contradicts your existence?"
"Oh, it's alright for me---oh, I guess it's almost my limit.
Good night, Shiki.
Wake me up when the sun sets."
"H--hey!"
"-------"
Like a machine whose power is cut off, Arcueid suddenly falls asleep.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――」
　なんていう、その、無防備さだろう。
「……逃げちゃってもいいってコトだぞ、それ」
　もともと無理やり連れてこられたようなものなんだし、いまなら楽勝で逃げられる。
　……それに、こっちにはもうそんな衝動は起きないけれど。
「仮にも―――俺は一度、おまえを殺してるっていうのに」
　なのに、どうしていきなり眠ってしまえるんだろうか、この女は。

「…………………」
　ベッドで眠るアルクェイドの顔を見つめる。
　……ふくよかな胸が上下しているところをみると、呼吸はしているようだ。
　その反面、体はぴくりとも動かない。
　アルクェイドの周囲の空気だけが止まってしまったいるかのような、見ているこっちまで停止してしまいそうな静謐。
―――なんて、安らかな眠り。
　まだ知りあって間もない俺のことを信頼しきっているような無防備さ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah.”
How could anyone be this defenseless?
“You know, I could just run away.”
She had practically dragged me here, and right now escaping would be effortless.
Not that the old impulse was stirring in me anymore.
“After all—I’ve already killed you once.”
So how could this woman simply fall asleep in front of me?
“…”
I studied Arcueid’s sleeping face.
The rise and fall of her full breasts showed that she was breathing, yet the rest of her body never stirred.
The air around her alone seemed to have stopped,
a stillness so absolute that merely looking at her threatened to stop me too.
―――What a peaceful sleep.
She lay utterly defenseless, as though she trusted me completely even though we had only just met.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha-----"
She's so… defenseless.
"…… Right now, I could run away if I wanted to."
She did force me to come with her, after all.
I could easily run away now.
…… And I don't have that impulse anymore, but…
"I even killed you once, yet…"
How is she able to suddenly fall asleep despite that?
"………"
I look at Arcueid's face as she sleeps on the bed.
…… Her plump chest rises and falls.
It looks like she's breathing.
But her body isn't moving at all.
It's like the air around her has stopped.
It's so tranquil even I might stop moving.
----What a peaceful slumber.
A kind of defenselessness as if she had absolute trust in me, even though we've only just met.

entries.japanese:
「―――――ばかだな、こいつ」
　……うん、ちょっと心配になるぐらい、ばか正直だと思う。
　ともあれ、ここは基点だ。
　自分が―――遠野志貴がまだ引き返せる最後のラインかもしれない。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What an idiot.”
Yes—she was honest to the point of making me worry.
In any case, this was the turning point.
Perhaps the final line before I—before Shiki Tohno—lost the chance to turn back.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---She's so stupid."
…… She is so stupidly honest I might start to worry.
But aside from that, this is a turning point.
This may very well be the point of no return for Tohno Shiki.
I----

entries.japanese:
「……約束、したからな」
　たとえそれがどんなモノでも、自分からは、決して破ってはいけないと思う。
　……アルクェイドは眠っている。
　その顔色は白くて、なんだか病人のようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I made a promise.”
Whatever the promise might be, I didn’t think I had the right to break it myself.
Arcueid slept on.
Her face was so pale that she looked ill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I did promise, after all."
No matter what it was I promised, I can't break it.
…… Arcueid is sleeping.
Her face is a pale white, like that of a sick person.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは自分が弱っている、と言った。
　さっきも限界だって言っていたから、ホントのところは俺がこの後どうするか、なんてコトを考える余裕はなかったのかもしれない。
　部屋は静かだ。
　ホテルの最上階である十一階には、他に客はいない。
このフロアを全てアルクェイドが借りきってしまったせいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid had said she was weakened.
She had called herself at the breaking point just before falling asleep; perhaps she simply hadn’t had the strength left to wonder what I would do afterward.
The room was silent.
There were no other guests on the eleventh floor, the hotel’s highest. Arcueid had rented the entire floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid said she was weak.
She said she was at her limit just a while ago, so I don't think she considered what I could do after she went to sleep.
The room is quiet.
We're on the eleventh floor, the top floor.
Since she rented out the whole floor, there are no other guests here.

entries.japanese:
部屋には、アルクェイドの呼吸の音しかない。
　こうして見ると―――アルクェイドは、やっぱり悪夢みたいに綺麗だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only Arcueid’s breathing disturbed the room.
Seen like this, she truly was as beautiful as a nightmare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The only sound is Arcueid's breathing.
When I see her like this---she really looks nightmarishly beautiful.

entries.japanese:
白くて滑らかな肌とか、さらさらと軽そうな金の髪とか。
　柔らかな身体のラインとか、シュッと墨を引いたような長いまつげとか。
　細部に至るまでここまで完璧な造形というものを、俺は今まで見たことがない。
　いや、正しくは。
　たぶん、一生見ることなんてないと思ってた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Smooth white skin. Fine golden hair that looked light enough to drift.
The soft curves of her body. Long lashes drawn in a single stroke of ink.
I had never seen anything fashioned so perfectly, down to the smallest detail.
No—to be precise,
I had never expected to see anything like her in my lifetime.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That white, smooth skin and that silky, light blonde hair,
The soft lines of her body and those long eyelashes that look like swift brushstrokes.
A perfect body--down to even the small details--the like of which I've never seen before.
No, to be more precise…
…… The kind I never would have seen in my entire life.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　吸血鬼だとか人間じゃないとかはともかく、アルクェイドは女の子だ。
　それが糸を切ったように眠ってしまうぐらいまで弱っていて、その責任が俺にあるというのなら。
「……自分でしでかしたコトの責任は、自分で取らないとな」
　……幼い頃の教えが、こんなところにも顔を出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Vampire or not, human or not, Arcueid was still a girl.
If she had been weakened until she slept as though her strings had been cut, and if I was responsible for it.
“…Then I have to take responsibility for what I did.”
A lesson from childhood had followed me even here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Vampire or not, Arcueid is a girl.
I have to take responsibility for the fact she's so weak now that she falls asleep instantly like she just did.
"…… You have to take responsibility for your own deeds."
…… A part of my childhood education makes an appearance in my head.

entries.japanese:
先生が言ってたっけ。
　俺の目はおかしなモノだから、おかしなモノを呼び寄せるって。
　なら、いいかげん覚悟をきめよう。
　とりあえず約束をした今夜ぐらいは、自分なりに、コイツを守ってやらないと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
My teacher had told me.
She said my strange eyes would draw strange things to me.
Then it was time to resign myself to that.
At least for the one night I had promised her, I would protect this girl as best I could—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sensei even told me.
My eyes are strange, so they would in turn attract strange things.
Then I should be prepared to take responsibility.
At the very least, I should keep my promise and protect her for tonight----

entries.japanese:
―――白。
　　　目の醒めるような白。
　　　そのいろは、懐かしい記憶を呼び起こす。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――White.
A brilliant, dazzling white.
That color called an old memory back to life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---White.
The kind you see when you wake up.
That color calls some nostalgic memories to mind.

entries.japanese:
夏の、暑い日。
　青い空と　大きな大きな入道雲。
　じりじりとゆらぐ風景と
　気が遠くなるような蝉の声。
　蝉の声。
entries.maoEnglish:
A hot summer day.
A blue sky and enormous, enormous thunderheads.
The landscape wavering in the scorching heat.
The cry of cicadas loud enough to make you faint.
The cicadas’ cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A hot summer day.
A blue sky and large, large columns of summer clouds.
The scenery slowly wavers in the heat.
The voice of cicadas.
The sound of cicadas.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　広場には蝉のぬけがら。
　たいようはすぐそばにあるようで、
　広場はじりじりと焦げていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Zeeeee, zee-zee.
Zeeeee, zee-zee.
Zeeeee, zee-zee.
The square is littered with cicada husks.
The sun feels close enough to touch,
and the square slowly scorches beneath it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Cicada shells are lying in the clearing.
As if the sun is right by my side,
the clearing is roasting.

entries.japanese:
真夏のあつい日。
　まるで、セカイがふらいぱんになったみたい。
　えーん　えんえん
　えーん　えんえん
　えーん　えんえん
　秋葉が泣いている。
　おとなしくて、いつもボクの後についてきていた秋葉が、ぽろぽろと泣いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
A hot midsummer day.
Like the whole WORLD has turned into a frying pan.
Waaah… waaah…
Waaah… waaah…
Waaah… waaah…
Akiha is crying.
Quiet little Akiha, who always followed right behind me, is weeping and weeping.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A hot midsummer's day.
As if the entire world became a frying pan.
waa, u, uwaaa.
waa, u, uwaaa.
waa, u, uwaaa.
Akiha is crying.

Akiha, who would always obediently stay close behind me, is brimming forth with tears.

entries.japanese:
秋葉の足元には子供がひとり倒れている。
　血にまみれた、殺されてしまった、自分と同い年ぐらいの子供の死体がある。
　蝉の、ぬけがら。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　この両手は、
　　倒れている子供の
　　　　　　血で、赤いのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
A child lies at Akiha’s feet.
A dead child, murdered and drenched in blood—a child about the same age as me.
A cicada’s empty husk.
These hands—
the blood of the child lying there—
is that why they are red?
entries.mirrorMoon:
A child lies collapsed at her feet.
Soaked in blood.
Killed.
The corpse of a child, about my age.
A cast-off cicada shell.
My two hands
Are red
with the blood of that collapsed child.

entries.japanese:
「シキ─────！」
　おとなたちがやってくる。
　倒れた子供は死んだまま。
　おとなたちはさけんでいる。
　おまえがコロシタのかとさけんでる――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI—!”
The grown-ups are coming.
The fallen child stays dead.
The grown-ups are screaming.
They’re screaming, Did you KILL the child?—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI-----!"
The adults are coming.
The fallen child is still dead.
The adults are yelling.
Did you kill him----!?

entries.japanese:
――――そんな、
　　　　夢の中でさえ忘れていた、ゆめを。
　　　　思い出したような、気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A dream like that,
a dream I had forgotten even inside the dream.
I think I remembered it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----That dream.
A dream I had forgotten even in my dreams.
I feel like… I remember.

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
ほら、目を覚まして。
もう日が落ちちゃってるじゃない」
　ゆさゆさ、と体がゆすられる。
　……あまり聞き覚えのない声と、肩にふれる冷たい手の感触。
「――――ん」
「――あれ？」
　目の前にはアルクェイドがいる。
　彼女はすでに目を覚ましていて、窓の外は真っ暗だ。
時計に目をやると、時刻はすでに夜の八時をまわってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Come on, wake up. The sun’s already gone down.”
My body rocked back and forth.
An unfamiliar voice, a cold hand touching my shoulder.
“Nn…”
“Huh?”
Arcueid was right in front of me.
She was already awake, and the window behind her was black. A glance at the clock showed that it was past eight at night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Hey, wake up.
The sun's already set."
Someone is shaking me.
…… A somewhat unfamiliar voice, and the touch of a cold hand on my shoulder.
"----Nn."
"--Huh?"
Arcueid is standing right in front of me.
She's already woken up, and it's pitch black outside.
I glance at the clock, and it says it's already eight.

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
「え、じゃないわ。
日が沈んだら起こしてって言ったのに、志貴ったら眠ってるんだもん」
「……ありゃ。
悪い、ぼけっとしてた」
　……自分自身でいつ眠ってしまったのか覚えてないけれど、たしかアルクェイドの寝顔をずっと見ていて、そのまま眠ってしまったんだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
“Don’t what me. I told you to wake me at sunset, and you went to sleep yourself.”
“…Whoops. Sorry. I must have nodded off.”
I couldn’t remember when I had fallen asleep, but I must have been watching Arcueid’s sleeping face until I drifted off myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
"It's not 'Eh?' I told you to wake me up when the sun went down, and you go and fall asleep!"
"…… Crap.
Sorry, I was feeling out of it."
…… I don't remember when I fell asleep, but I'm sure it was while I was staring at Arcueid's sleeping face.

entries.japanese:
「もう。
そんなんじゃ護衛失格よ。
二人とも眠ってたなんて、もし敵に襲われてたらわたしも志貴も死んでたかもしれないのに」
「―――だから悪いって言ってるだろ。
それに昼間は安全だって言ったのはおまえじゃないか」
「絶対とは言いきれないわ。
朝みたいに使い魔がやってくるコトだってあるんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, you’re a terrible bodyguard. We were both asleep. If the enemy had attacked, we might both be dead.”
“I said I was sorry. Besides, you were the one who said daytime was safe.”
“I couldn’t promise it was perfectly safe. A familiar might have come, like the one this morning.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez.
You'll lose your qualification as a bodyguard like that.
If the enemy had attacked while we were both sleeping, we could have both died, you know."
"---I said I'm sorry.
Besides, you said it was safe during the daytime."
"I can't say that for sure.
Familiars like the one we saw this morning could have come for us."

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは怒っている。
　……まあ、それも当然か。
見張り役の俺がアルクェイドと一緒に眠ってたんじゃお話にならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid was angry.
Fair enough. A guard who fell asleep beside the person he was watching was worse than useless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid is angry.
…… Well, she's got a right to be.
I've got no right to talk when I, the bodyguard, dozed off while she was sleeping.

entries.japanese:
「それにね、わたしって吸血鬼なんだよ、志貴。
なのにどうして、身の危険とかを感じずに眠っちゃったりできるのかなあ。
　そりゃあわたしだって無闇に恐がられるのはイヤだけど、少しは緊張して眠れないとか、そういう反応してもいいんじゃない？」
「――――」
　前言撤回。
　アルクェイドは見張り役をしてなかったという事ではなく、たんにこっちが眠っていた事が気に食わないようだ。

「体も少しは動くようになって目を覚ましてみれば、志貴ったら幸せそうに眠ってるじゃない。
あんまりに無防備だから、わたしって吸血種として威厳がないのかなって本気で不安になったんだから」
「…………」
　まあ、威厳は、あまりないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Besides, Shiki, I’m a vampire.
How could you sleep beside me without feeling the least bit threatened?
I don’t want you terrified of me for no reason, but couldn’t you at least be too nervous to sleep or something?”
“—”
I took that back.
She wasn’t upset because I had neglected my watch; she simply disliked the fact that I had managed to sleep at all.
“When I woke up feeling well enough to move a little, there you were sleeping so happily. You looked so defenseless that I honestly began to worry I had no dignity as a vampire.”
“…”
Well, I didn’t think she had much dignity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And besides.
I am a vampire, you know.
How can you just sleep there without feeling any danger?
I don't want you to be afraid for no reason, but it'd be nice if you were at least tense enough not to sleep."
"----"
I take that back.
Arcueid doesn't seem to care that I didn't do my job as a bodyguard.
She just doesn't seem to like the fact I fell asleep.
"I can move my body a little better and wake up, only to find you sleeping there happily.
You looked so vulnerable, I was seriously starting to feel uneasy that I might not have the dignity befitting a vampire."
"………"
Well, I don't think she has much dignity.

entries.japanese:
「無防備なのはそっちだって同じだろ。
俺だって一度はおまえを殺してるんだぞ。
今回だってそうしなかったとは限らないじゃないか」
「あ――――」
　アルクェイドはいま気がついた、とばかりに目を白黒させる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You were just as defenseless. I’ve already killed you once. How did you know I wouldn’t do it again?”
“Ah—”
Arcueid’s eyes went wide as though the thought had only just occurred to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You were just as vulnerable yourself.
I killed you once before, remember?
You can't guarantee I won't do it again, can you?"
"Ah----"
Arcueid gives a surprised look, as if she only just realized it.

entries.japanese:
「そういえばそうよね。
―――なんでだろう。
なんとなくね、路地裏で志貴と話しているうちに信頼しきってたみたい」
「……………」
　……まあ、悪い気はしない、けど。
「オーケー、信頼されてるからにはそれなりに努力はする。
で、あとはこれからずっと見張ってればいいのか？」
「ええ、とりあえず朝日が昇るまでの間ね。
わたしは部屋から出ないから、志貴は誰かがこのフロアにやってきたようだったら用心して」
　……用心してって、朝のような黒犬とかがやってきたら用心のしようもないんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now that you mention it, you’re right. I wonder why… Somewhere along the way, while we were talking in the alley, I simply came to trust you completely.”
“…”
It wasn’t an unpleasant thing to hear.
“All right. If you trust me, I’ll make a proper effort. Do I just keep watch from now on?”
“Yes, until sunrise. I won’t leave the room, so if it seems anyone has come onto this floor, be on your guard.”
Be on my guard—if another black dog like the one that morning appeared, no amount of caution would help.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Now that you mention it, you're right.
---I wonder why I did that?
I guess I just had complete confidence in you since we spoke in the alley."
"………"
…… Well, saying that doesn't make me feel bad for her…
"Okay.
Since you trust me so much, I'll try my best.
So, should I just keep watch from now on?"
"Yeah, until sunrise tomorrow.
I can't leave the room, so be on guard if someone comes up to this floor."
…… Be on guard, huh.
Being on guard is going to do me no good if one of those black dogs from this morning comes for us.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ」
　ため息がもれる。
やっぱり、これは俺には重すぎる役割だ。
「……聞いておくけど。
朝の時に襲ってきた黒犬っていうのは、おまえの敵が差し向けたヤツなのか？」
「差し向けた、っていうより街を監視するのがアイツの役割だったんだと思うわ。
アイツの巡回ルートでわたしと志貴が話しこんでいて、結果的にわたしが居るっていう事がバレちゃったみたい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah.”
A sigh escaped me. This job really was too much for me.
“Let me ask something. Did your enemy send that black dog after you this morning?”
“Rather than being sent, I think its job was to patrol the city. We happened to stand talking along its route, so it discovered I was here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
I let out a sigh.
As expected, this is too heavy a role for me.
"…… Let me ask you something.
Was the black dog that attacked us this morning something your enemy sent out?"
"I don't think so, it was probably for surveillance.
His patrol route happened to pass through where you and I were talking, and it seems my presence was revealed as a result."

entries.japanese:
「バレちゃったって、おまえの敵に？」
「そうね。
体調が万全ならむしろ手間が省けるんだけど、今のわたしじゃ襲われたら逆に消滅させられかねないわ。
とりあえず、力が戻るまでこうして身を隠すしかないっていうわけ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Discovered by your enemy?”
“Yes. If I were at full strength, that would save me the trouble of searching, but as I am now, an attack could erase me instead. Until my strength returns, I have no choice but to stay hidden.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Revealed?
To your enemy?"
"That's right.
If I had been in perfect condition, it would actually save me some time.
But right now, it's the opposite.
If I were attacked now, I'd be the one annihilated.
That's why I have to hide out like this for now until my power returns."

entries.japanese:
……アルクェイドの敵、というのは街を騒がしている連続殺人犯―――つまり吸血鬼だ。
「……アルクェイド。
俺、おまえに聞きたい事がある。
俺の質問に答えてくれるか？」
「話をするぶんにはかまわないけど、どうしたのよ、急にかしこまっちゃって」
「―――ああ、大事なことをまだまったく聞いてなかったからさ。
その、結局のところ、おまえの目的ってなんなんだ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid’s enemy was the serial killer terrorizing the city—in other words, a vampire.
“…Arcueid, there’s something I want to ask you. Will you answer?”
“I don’t mind talking, but why are you suddenly so solemn?”
“Because I still haven’t asked the most important question. What are you actually trying to accomplish?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Arcueid's enemy.
In other words, the serial killer who's been causing the stir in this town---a vampire.
"…… Arcueid.
I want to ask you something.
Will you answer my question?"
"I don't mind talking.
But why are you being so formal all of a sudden?"
"---Yeah, I haven't asked you the most important thing yet… So, what's your ultimate objective here?"

entries.japanese:
「わたし？
　わたしは吸血鬼を追ってるだけよ。
吸血鬼殺しがわたしの役割だから」
「ああ、たしかにそんな事をさっきから言ってる。
けどアルクェイド、おまえは吸血鬼なんだろ？」
「なに、志貴ったらまだわたしのこと信じてないの？」

「いやっていうほど信じてるから安心しろ。
　俺が言いたいのはそういう事じゃなくて、どうして吸血鬼であるおまえが吸血鬼を殺す、なんて物騒なことを言うのかってことだよ」
「あら、志貴は同族同士で殺し合うのは嫌いなんだ？」
　……嫌いもなにも、殺し合い自体好きな部類には入らない。
でも確かに、吸血鬼が吸血鬼を殺す、なんていうのはしっくりこないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Me? I’m hunting a vampire. Killing vampires is my role.”
“You have mentioned that. But Arcueid—you’re a vampire too, aren’t you?”
“What? You still don’t believe me, Shiki?”
“Unfortunately, I believe you more than enough, so don’t worry.
What I’m asking is why a vampire would talk so casually about killing another vampire.”
“Oh? You don’t like your own kind killing one another?”
Like or dislike had nothing to do with it. I wasn’t fond of killing in the first place. Still, a vampire killing a vampire simply felt wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Me?
I'm here to hunt down the vampire.
Killing vampires is my duty."
"Yeah, I do remember you saying something like that before.
But you're a vampire, right?"
"What?
You still don't believe me?"
"Oh, don't worry, I believe you so much it hurts.
I'm asking why would you, a vampire, claim to be doing something as odd as killing other vampires?"
"Oh?
You don't like the idea of beings from the same species killing each other?"
…… The act of killing doesn't exactly make my list of favorite things, but she is right.
I'm not comfortable with the idea of vampires killing vampires.

entries.japanese:
「いや、なんか想像できなくて。
吸血鬼っていうのは人間の血を吸うんだろ？
　なら殺す対象は人間であって、同じ吸血鬼じゃないじゃないか」
「血を吸う事と殺そうとする事は別物よ。
　ま、それでも志貴の言いたい事はわかるわ。
同じ種族同士助けあうべきだっていうんでしょ？
　けどね、吸血鬼は同類でありながらそれぞれが異なる生命種みたいなものなの。
だから人間でいうところの仲間意識は希薄なのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I just can’t picture it. Vampires drink human blood, right? Then their victims should be humans, not other vampires.”
“Drinking blood and trying to kill something are separate matters.
Still, I understand what you mean. You think members of one species ought to help one another.
But although vampires are broadly the same kind of being, each is almost a different species unto itself. We have very little of what humans would call solidarity.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it's just that I can't really imagine something like that happening.
Vampires drain the blood of humans, right?
So they should be killing humans, not other vampires."
"Drinking blood and killing are different things.
Well… Even so, I know what you're trying to say.
You think beings from the same species should help each other out, right?
But vampires can be of the same species and still be different life forms.
That's why they don't really have what you humans call 'camaraderie'."

entries.japanese:
「……？
　じゃあその、おまえが追ってる吸血鬼っていうのはおまえとどこか違うっていうのか？」
「そうよ。
わたしが追いかけているのは人間の吸血鬼だから、あなたたちの伝承に残っているものとほぼイメージは一緒ね。
　人間の血を吸って、吸い殺した者を死者として使役して勢力を増やしていく―――わたしが追いかけているのはそういった吸血鬼よ。
　この街に潜んでいるのは、そういった旧いタイプの吸血鬼なの」
 ───そういった吸血鬼って、吸血鬼にも種類があるらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Then is the vampire you’re chasing somehow different from you?”
“Yes. The one I’m chasing is a human vampire, much like the creatures in your legends.
It drinks human blood, commands those it kills as the Dead, and expands its power through them. That is the kind of vampire I’m hunting.
The one hiding in this city is that old-fashioned type.”
───That kind of vampire—apparently there was more than one kind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
Then you're saying something makes you different from the vampire you're hunting?"
"That's right.
The one I'm after is a human vampire, just like the stereotypical vampire from you humans' folklore.
He kills humans by draining their blood, turning them into The Dead, then uses them to increase his power and influence---that's the sort of vampire I hunt.
The one lurking in this town is that sort of old-style vampire."
---"That sort" of vampire?
It seems like there are different types.

entries.japanese:
「……まさかとは思うけど。
そいつをやっつけるから俺に盾になれ、だなんて事を言ってやがったのか、おまえ」
「───そうね、初めはそのつもりだった。
けど、志貴と話をしているうちに気が変わったわ。
「わたしはね、志貴。
てっきり貴方が教会の人間だって思ってたの。
　それなら敵の居場所をもう掴んでるんだろうなって期待してたんだけど、志貴ったらまるっきりふつうの人なんだもん。
　敵の棺の場所はおろか、吸血鬼のことをまるで知らないし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Don’t tell me you expected me to act as your shield while you killed that thing.”
“That was the idea at first. But I changed my mind while we were talking.
You see, Shiki, I was certain you belonged to the Church.
I expected you would already know where the enemy was hiding. But you turned out to be completely ordinary.
You don’t know the location of its coffin—or anything about vampires at all.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Don't tell me you want me to be your shield so you can get this guy."
"---Yeah, that was my original intent.
But after talking to you, I've changed my mind.
You see, at first, I thought you were someone from The Church.
So I thought you might have information about the location of the enemy, but you turned out to be a perfectly ordinary person.
You didn't even know about vampires, let alone the location of the enemy's coffin."

entries.japanese:
「……うん、そもそもあの連中がこんな極東の無神論者の国にエクソシストを派遣するわけないものね。
浅はかだったのはわたしのほうかな」
　ぶつぶつと独り言を言うアルクェイド。
　話が脱線してしまって、こっちはいい感じで置いてけぼりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Of course. They would never send an exorcist to an atheistic country in the Far East. I suppose I was the foolish one.”
Arcueid muttered to herself.
The conversation had wandered off without me, leaving me thoroughly behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, come to think of it, there's no way they'd send an exorcist to a Far East secular country like this one--I guess I didn't put enough thought into this."
Arcueid thinks aloud.
Her conversation derails, and I'm feeling a little left out.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、話が全然見えないんだけど」
「あ、ちょっと待って。
……ええっと、どう説明しようかな……」
　うーん、とアルクェイドは視線を泳がす。
　……こいつ、どうにもあんまり会話慣れしてないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, I’ve completely lost the thread.”
“Wait a moment. Let me think how to explain it…”
Arcueid’s gaze wandered as she pondered.
This girl really wasn’t accustomed to conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't follow you at all, Arcueid."
"Ah, hold on for a moment… let's see… How should I explain this…?"
With that, Arcueid's gaze begins drifting.
…… She doesn't seem used to holding a conversation.

entries.japanese:
「いいから、今の状況を片っ端から口にすれば？
　俺もわけがわからないけど、それなりになんとか話の筋を見極めるから」
「そう？
　ありがと、志貴」
「お礼はいいから、続けてくれ」
　うん、とアルクェイドは素直に頷く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then just tell me everything about the situation, one thing after another. I don’t understand any of it either, but I’ll do my best to piece it together.”
“Really? Thank you, Shiki.”
“Save the thanks and keep going.”
Arcueid nodded obediently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't worry about it and just explain everything about the current situation.
I don't understand any of this, but I might be able to see the general gist of things."
"Really?
Thanks, Shiki."
"You don't have to thank me.
Just keep talking."
Arcueid nods obediently.

entries.japanese:
「つまりね、この街にいる吸血鬼は旧いタイプの吸血鬼なの。
自分は城主として君臨して、配下にした死者たちを街に放って、少しずつ勢力を増やしていくタイプ。
　人間の血を吸って、吸った人間を自分と同じ吸血鬼にしてしまうっていう、普遍的な吸血種よ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In short, the vampire in this city is the old-fashioned type. It reigns like a lord in its castle, sends the Dead under its control out into the streets, and slowly expands its power.
It drinks human blood and turns its victims into vampires like itself—the most common kind of vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Basically, the vampire currently in this town is an old-style vampire.
He himself reigns as the lord and releases The Dead he made into the city.
By doing so, he increases his power bit by bit.
He's a typical vampire in that he drains the blood of humans, and those humans become vampires themselves.

entries.japanese:
今はまだ分身である死者たちの数が少ないから能力はたいした事がないんだけど、犠牲者が増えれば増えた分だけ本体である吸血鬼の力が増すわ。
　その前に本体を斃してしまえばいいんだけど、わたしはまだ敵の寝床を見付けてないのよ。
　今回はよっぽど巧妙に隠れてるのか、あいつの気配さえ感じなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
The Dead that serve as its extensions are still few in number, so it isn’t especially powerful yet; but each new victim makes the vampire itself stronger.
We could stop it by destroying the main body first, but I still haven’t found its lair.
It must be hiding exceptionally well this time; I haven’t sensed so much as a trace of it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
He's not very powerful right now as he doesn't have many Dead serving him, but as the victims increase, so does his power.
It would be best to destroy the main body before that happens, but I haven't found where he sleeps yet.
He's hidden so well right now I can't even feel his presence."

entries.japanese:
「それでも見付けさえすれば片付けるのは簡単なんだ。
だけどまったく手がかりがない状態だから、仕方なく昼間も街を歩いて調べてたんだけどねー。
　なんでかなあ、いきなり通りすがりの殺人鬼に襲われちゃって、今じゃ一時的にしろ『敵』である吸血鬼より能力が劣っちゃってる始末なのよね」
　ちらり、と冷たい眼差しを向けてくるアルクェイド。
たぶん、通りすがりの殺人鬼である俺へのあてつけなんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Once I find it, disposing of it will be easy. But I had no clues at all, so I was forced to search the city during the day.
Then, for some mysterious reason, a passing murderer attacked me, and now—even if only temporarily—I’m weaker than the enemy vampire.”
Arcueid shot me a cold sidelong glance. Presumably that last part was aimed at me, the passing murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Even so, it's easy to take care of things once I find it.
But I don't have any clues whatsoever, so I had no choice but to walk around town during the day to investigate.
But then I suddenly got attacked by a passing killer, and now, I'm temporarily weaker than the enemy vampire."
Arcueid shoots me a cold look.
I guess she wants to say something to the "passing killer".

entries.japanese:
「……なるほど、とりあえず話は見えてきたよ。
ようするにこの街には質の悪い化け物が巣くっていて、アルクェイドはそれを退治しにきた、と。
　けどそいつの居場所がわからないから捜している時に、その―――俺にやられて、いまは弱ってるから回復するまで隠れてる……そういうコト？」
「わかりやすく言うと、そうだと思う」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…All right. I think I understand now. A particularly nasty monster is hiding in this city, and you came to destroy it.
But while you were searching because you couldn’t find its lair, I… did what I did. Now you’re hiding until you recover. Is that the situation?”
“Put simply, yes.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
I kind of understand the situation now.
So in other words, some evil monsters are based in this town, and you're here to eliminate them.
Since you didn't know where they were, you went looking for them, and that's when I, uh---killed you.
So now you're weakened and hiding out while you recover… Is that about right?"
"To put it simply, I think so."

entries.japanese:
「―――じゃあ次、本題。
　アルクェイドは気軽に吸血鬼って言うけど、俺にはまだピンとこないんだ。
　……そりゃあたしかにおまえは人間じゃない。
それだけはわかるんだけど、だからって吸血鬼なんだって言われても実感がわかないんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then on to the real question.
You say vampire as if it explains everything, but the word still doesn’t feel real to me.
I know you aren’t human. That much is obvious. But being told you’re a vampire doesn’t make the idea any easier to grasp.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Then, next is the main topic.
You casually call yourself a vampire, but I still don't really understand that term.
…… It's obvious you're not a human, that much I can see, but I don't get the feeling that you're a vampire, either."

entries.japanese:
「そういえばそうね。
志貴たちの知ってる吸血鬼像とわたしはちょっと違うわ」
「だろうね。
俺は吸血鬼っていうのがホントにいるっていうことより、その吸血鬼がこんなヤツだなんて想像もしなかったし。
　で、その違いっていうのはどんなものなんだ？」
　んー、とアルクェイドは考え込む。
「そうね、少しぐらいは教えておいてあげたほうがいいのかもしれない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s true. I’m rather different from the vampires you humans imagine.”
“I’ll say. Finding out vampires exist is less surprising than finding out a vampire can be someone like you.
So what exactly is different?”
Arcueid thought for a moment.
“Perhaps I should teach you at least a little.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true.
I'm a little different from the type of vampire you know about."
"Indeed.
I hadn't considered that vampires even existed at all, let alone a vampire like you.
So, what makes you different?"
Arcueid thinks.
"Yes… I suppose it might be helpful to teach you a bit about us."

entries.japanese:
「いいわ、それじゃあ一時限目の授業は吸血鬼（１）についてにしましょう」
「……いいけどさ。
なんだよ、その（１）っていうのは」
「志貴は素人だから基本的な知識から入らないといけないでしょ？
　だからまず初歩から教えてあげるっていうことよ」
「―――まあ、どうでもいいけど。
とりあえず手短に頼むよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. Lesson one will be Vampires, Part One.”
“…Fine, but what’s with the Part One?”
“You’re a complete beginner, so we have to start with the fundamentals. I’m teaching you from the very beginning.”
“Whatever. Just keep it brief.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
Then the first period's lessons will be Vampires 101."
"…… Okay, but… What's with 'Vampires 101'?"
"You're an amateur at this, so we've got to start with the basics, right?
That's why I'm going to start teaching from the very beginning."
"---Okay, whatever.
Just keep it short."

entries.japanese:
「ええっと、努力はするわ」
　……アルクェイドは本当に話をする、というコトに慣れていないらしい。
　まあ、時間はいくらでもあるからとりあえず文句もいわず、アルクェイドの話に耳をかたむける事にしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um… I’ll try.”
Arcueid really didn’t seem used to conversation.
Still, we had all the time in the world; I decided not to complain and simply listen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well… I'll try my best."
…… It really does seem like she's not used to talking.
Well, we've got lots of time, so for now I guess I'll listen to Arcueid without complaint.

entries.japanese:
「一般に吸血鬼というけど、わたしたちは大きく二つのモノに分けられるわ。
　もとから吸血鬼であるモノと、吸血鬼になったモノ。
　前者を真祖といって、後者を死徒と呼ぶの。
　あなた達が吸血鬼って呼んでるほうは死徒のほうね。
人間の血を吸い、下僕にして、太陽の光に弱く、洗礼儀式の前に敗退する。
　わたしたちの敵も死徒に区別される吸血鬼よ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“We use the word vampire broadly, but there are two major kinds: those born as vampires, and those who became vampires.
The former are called True Ancestors; the latter are Dead Apostles.
The creatures humans usually call vampires are Dead Apostles.
They drink human blood, make their victims into thralls, weaken in sunlight, and succumb to baptismal rites.
Our enemy is a vampire classified as a Dead Apostle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Although we're typically called simply 'vampires', we're divided into two main categories.
Those who were vampires from the start, and those who become vampires.
The former are called True Ancestors, and the latter are called the Dead Apostles.
The ones you call vampires are the Dead Apostles.
They drain the blood of humans and turn them into their slaves.
They're weak against sunlight, and you can vanquish them with a baptism ritual.
Our enemy is one of these Dead Apostles."

entries.japanese:
いつのまにか『わたしの敵』から『わたしたちの敵』になっている。
　……まあ、こうなっちゃ間違いはないから別にいいんだけど。
「……ふぅん。
そのシトっていうのは初めから吸血鬼じゃないって言ったけどさ、それはどういうコト？」
entries.maoEnglish:
