Or mine, from the arm it was trying to sever?
―――Honestly, I didn’t care.
My head was too confused even to register the pain—
It simply didn’t matter whose blood it was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Y-you…!"
I feel something wet.
I can see blood spilling from the black dog's mouth.
Is it the black dog's blood, leaking from its knife wound to the head?
Or is the blood coming from my arm, about to be torn off?
---To be honest…
My head is too messed up to be feeling the pain,
so it isn't a big deal which one it is.

entries.japanese:
「はな―――せ」
　黒犬から逃げようとするのだが、黒犬は自分の腕に食いついているのだ。
　逃げるコトはできない。
　逃げられない。
　逃げたいのなら――――コイツを、『殺す』しかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let go.”
I tried to escape the dog, but it was fastened to my arm.
I couldn’t run.
There was no escape.
If I wanted to get away, I had no choice but to kill it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let--go!"
I try to wrestle away from the black dog, but it is firmly attached to my arm.
I can't escape.
I can't run away.
If I want to escape--I have no choice but to "kill" it.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ………！」
　でも、どうやって。
　片腕は食いちぎられようとしていて、ナイフだってそっちの腕が握ってる。
　俺は押し倒されていて、もしこのまま腕を引きぬけたとしても、次の瞬間には自由になった黒犬の牙がこっちの首を噛み砕く――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nngh…!”
But how?
One arm was about to be bitten off, and that was the hand holding the knife.
The dog had me pinned, and even if I pulled free, its liberated jaws would crush my throat the next instant—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----…!"
But how?
The hand it's biting off is the one holding the knife.
I'm on the ground, so even supposing I did pull my hand out, the very next instant the black dog's mouth will be free to bite through my throat----

entries.japanese:
「は――――――あ」
――――大丈夫だ、落ち着け志貴。
　まずよく見て、そのあとによく考える。
　そんな教えを、今までずっと守ってきたじゃないか。
　なら――――なんとかなる。
　例えば、こいつの頭のうしろには十分すぎるほど『線』が見えている。
　黒い『点』は、こいつの胸に見えている。
　生きのびるための方法はひどくシンプル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—”
――――Calm down, Shiki.
Look closely first, then think carefully.
You’ve followed that lesson all this time.
Then there was a way.
For example, there were more than enough lines behind its head.
The black point lay in its chest.
The way to survive was brutally simple.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----aaahhh."
----It's okay.
Calm down, Shiki.
First, you've got to examine the situation well, and then think calmly about it.
That's the kind of thinking you've always kept.
In that case--I can do something…
For example, there's plenty of 'lines' on the back of its head.
And I can see the black 'point' on its chest.
The way to survive is awfully simple.

entries.japanese:
……けれど、それを実行するのはためらいがある。
　どんなに強暴で、どんなに悪い生き物でも。
　こんな間近で、はあはあと、息苦しいぐらい生きている動物を殺すなんて―――とてもじゃないけどできやしない。
「ぐっ――――！」
　腕にかかる力がいっそう強くなる。
　このまま片腕を食いきられるっていうのに。
　どうしても、俺には、そんな残酷な真似はできそうにない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Yet I hesitated to do it.
It made no difference how vicious or evil the creature might be.
I couldn’t bring myself to kill an animal this close—gasping against me, so fiercely, suffocatingly alive.
“Ghh—!”
The pressure on my arm increased.
It would bite all the way through.
And still I couldn’t seem capable of such cruelty—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… But I have my doubts about executing this plan.
No matter how savage and evil a creature it is…
To do something like kill a panting and gasping creature that's so alive, this close to me--it's something I'm hesitant to do.
"Guh--!"
The pressure on my arm increases.
My entire arm is shortly going to be ripped off at this rate.
But even so, I just can't seem to do something so cruel--

entries.japanese:
ぼたり、と赤い血が顔に落ちてくる。
　赤い血が額にたれて、どろりと、目の中に入ってくる。
―――眼球の奥に、朱色の闇が、染みこんでくる。
「あか――――い」
　くらりと。
意識が、とんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
A heavy drop of red blood fell onto my face.
It ran down my forehead and oozed into my eye.
―――Scarlet darkness seeped behind my eyes.
“Red.”
The world reeled. My consciousness vanished.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The red blood drips down onto my face.
Going down my forehead, it drips into my eyes.
---Crimson darkness soaks into the back of my eyes.
"Re----d."
My consciousness sways, and then is gone.

entries.japanese: ……それでも俺には、生きているモノを、殺すことなんて出来ない。
entries.maoEnglish: Even so, I could never kill a living thing.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… But even so, I can't bring myself to kill a living creature.

entries.japanese:
―――なんて偽善。
　そういうおまえは、そんな犬畜生なんぞよりよっぽど大きな動物を殺しているじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――What hypocrisy.
You’ve already killed an animal far larger than this miserable cur.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---What hypocrisy.
You've killed something much bigger than a mere dog.

entries.japanese:
……ああ、そうだったけ。
　でもあの時は違う。
　アルクェイドの時の遠野志貴は正気じゃなかった。
　さっき黒犬を仕留めた時も、本当に、自分の意思とは無関係の出来事だった。
　けど、今は確実に俺自身の意思なんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh, right.
But that time was different.
The Shiki Tohno who killed Arcueid wasn’t sane.
Even when I dispatched the first dog, it had happened entirely apart from my own will.
Now, however, the choice was unmistakably mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yes, that's right.
But that time was different.
I wasn't sane when it was Arcueid.
Even when I killed the other black dog, just a moment ago--that was unrelated to my will.
But right now, this is very much my own will.

entries.japanese:
……先生が言ってたじゃないか、志貴。
　この力は、他の誰でもない、遠野志貴自身の意思で行使なさいって。
　だから。
　自分が自分である今は、決して、命を粗末にしてはいけないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Remember what my teacher said, Shiki.
This power must be wielded by Shiki Tohno’s own will, and no one else’s.
So.
Now, while I am truly myself, I must never treat a life lightly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Didn't Sensei say, Shiki?
Use this power according to your own will, and no one else's.
That's why…
As myself, right now, I could never take a life for granted.

entries.japanese:
―――それも偽善。
　　　なぜなら、おまえはとうのむかしに。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――More hypocrisy.
Because it had already happened long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That, too, is hypocrisy.
Because long ago, you…

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――――」
　……それは、こどものころの悪いユメ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
It was a bad dream from my childhood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
…… That is a nightmare from my childhood.

entries.japanese: ―――ほら、何をためらう。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――What are you hesitating for?
entries.mirrorMoon: ---See, what are you waiting for?

entries.japanese: ……あれは暑い、夏の日だった。
entries.maoEnglish: It was a hot summer day.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… It was a hot summer's day.

entries.japanese: ―――殺さなければ殺されるのだし
entries.maoEnglish: ―――If you do not kill, you will be killed, and
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Kill or be killed.

entries.japanese: ……目の前には、血にまみれた少年の影。
entries.maoEnglish: Before me stood the shadow of a boy drenched in blood.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Before my eyes, the blood-soaked shadow of a boy.

entries.japanese: ―――おまえは、すでに
entries.maoEnglish: ―――you have already—
entries.mirrorMoon: ---You've already…

entries.japanese: ……俺の手には、熱い熱い赤い血が。
entries.maoEnglish: My hands were covered in hot, hot, red blood.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Hot, hot, red blood on my hands.

entries.japanese: ――――一度、人を殺しているじゃないか―――！
entries.maoEnglish: ――――killed someone once!
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Haven't you killed someone once before---!

entries.japanese: 「あああああああああああああ！！！！！」
entries.maoEnglish: “Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Aaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!"

entries.japanese:
刺した。
　引き抜くのではなく、なお、黒犬の頭を刺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
I stabbed.
Rather than pull the knife free, I drove it farther into the black dog’s skull.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I thrust.
I don't pull, but rather thrust deeper into the black dog's head.

entries.japanese:
ギィギギギギ、なんていううめき声が、目の前から聞こえてくる。
　黒犬の叫びだと思う。
　口の中に腕をつっこまれて、まともに哭けないくせに泣いている。
　きっと、それぐらい痛いんだろう。
　かまわない。
　噛まれている腕ごと、ナイフをより深く突き刺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
A high, grinding whine came from right in front of me.
The black dog’s scream, I thought.
With my arm jammed into its mouth it could not even howl properly, but still it wept.
It must have hurt that badly.
I didn’t care.
With my arm still in its jaws, I drove the knife deeper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can hear its yelping right in front of me.
I think the black dog is crying out.
With my arm in its mouth, it could not properly cry, but it's crying anyway.
I'm sure that's how much it must hurt.
I don't care.
I plunge the knife in deeper, along with my arm.

entries.japanese:
音もたてず、ナイフの刃が黒犬の後頭部から出てくる。
　まるで角の生えた犬みたいだ。
　頭蓋を割って、皮をたやすく切断して。
　トロトロと血とか脳みそを撒き散らして、ナイフは完全に黒犬の後頭部から突き出てきた。
　ついでに言うと、ナイフを握った遠野志貴の腕も、もう完全に頭を突き破って出てきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Soundlessly, the blade emerged from the back of the dog’s head.
It looked almost as if the dog had grown a horn.
It split the skull and sliced easily through hide.
Blood and brain matter spilled in a sluggish stream until the knife jutted all the way out through the back of its head.
For that matter, Shiki Tohno’s arm, knife still clenched in its hand, had punched clean through the skull as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Without a sound, the blade of the knife punctures out the back of the black dog's head.
It's as if the dog has grown a horn.
Having split the skull, I easily slash through its skin.
Blood and brains spray out as the knife completely emerges from the back of the head.
Also, the hand gripping the knife travels completely through.

entries.japanese:
「は――――は、あ」
　それでも黒犬は生きている。
　ならやる事は一つだけだ。
　もう片方の腕を伸ばす。
　血だらけの指からナイフを引き剥がして、自由になっている腕でナイフを持ちなおす。
　そのまま、黒犬の胸の『点』を貫いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…
haaah…”
The dog was still alive.
Then only one task remained.
I reached over with my other arm, pried the knife from my blood-slick fingers, and took it in my free hand.
Then I pierced the point in the dog’s chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*gasp* *pant* *pant*
But even so, the black dog is still alive.
Then there's only one thing I have to do.
I reach around with my other hand.
Peeling the knife from my blood-drenched fingers, I grip the knife with my free hand.
And just like that, I thrust into the 'point' on the black dog's chest.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　黒犬はそれで死んだ。
　アゴにかかっていた力もなくなって、腕はあっけなく引きぬけた。
「なんだ―――全然食い込んでないじゃないか」
　血だらけの腕を見る。
　たしかに牙の形に傷はあるけれど、肉はまったくといっていいほど無傷だ。
　この血は頭を貫かれた黒犬のものだろう。
　噛まれている時の痛みなんて些細なもので、こちらの恐怖が痛みを何倍にも感じさせていただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
That killed it.
The strength left its jaws, and my arm slipped free with ridiculous ease.
“It barely broke the skin.”
I examined my blood-soaked arm.
The fangs had certainly left their marks, but the flesh itself was almost entirely unharmed.
The blood must have belonged to the dog whose skull I had pierced.
The bite had barely hurt; my terror had magnified the pain many times over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*gasp* *pant*
And with that, the black dog dies.
The strength drains from its jaws, and I easily pull my arm back out.
"Oh--it wasn't torn off at all."
I look at my blood-covered arm.
There are many teeth marks, but the flesh is almost free of wounds.
The blood must have been from the black dog when I impaled it through the head.
The pain from when I was being bitten was really quite trivial, but my fear must have amplified it many times over.

entries.japanese:
「は―――あ」
　地面に横になったまま、天井を見上げる。
　あたまが、いたい。
　世界はツギハギだらけになって、そこかしこに黒い死の点も視えてしまって。
　体中は冷え切っているのに、ただ理性だけが熱病にうなされている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
Still lying on the floor, I stared at the ceiling.
My head hurt.
The world had become a patchwork of seams, with black points of death visible everywhere.
My whole body was frozen, while reason alone burned in a delirious fever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*gasp* *pant*
Lying there on the ground, I look up at the ceiling.
My head hurts.
The world becomes a patchwork, and here and there, I can see the black points of death.
My body is freezing, but my mind is burning feverishly.

entries.japanese:
「―――く」
　すぐ近くには二匹の黒犬の死体。
　片腕は血にまみれていて、もう片腕には赤いナイフ。
　……ついでに言うのなら、床の下の階層には数え切れないほどの人の死体。
「――――は、はは、ははは」
　笑うしかない。
　だって、こんなのは現実じゃない。
　こんなのが現実であるはずがない。
　俺はいつから、瞳をあけたままで、悪い夢なんかを観てしまっているんだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kh.”
Two black dogs lay dead beside me.
One arm was drenched in blood; the other held a red knife.
And, incidentally, the floors beneath this one contained more human corpses than I could count.
“Hahahahaha.”
There was nothing to do but laugh.
This wasn’t reality.
Nothing like this could possibly be real.
How long had I been dreaming this nightmare with my eyes wide open?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Kuh!"
Right beside me lay the corpses of the two black dogs.
One of my arms is covered in blood, the other clutches a red knife.
…… Also, there are a quite uncountable number of dead bodies downstairs.
"----Ha, haha, hahaha."
All I can do is laugh.
Because this isn't real.
There's no way this can be real.
At what point did I, with my eyes wide open, start seeing a nightmare----?

entries.japanese:
キンコーン。
「え――――？」
　ひどく場違いな明るい音がした。
「くそ、なんだこの頭痛―――」
　刃物で突き刺されるような頭痛を堪えながら立ちあがる。
「エレ……ベーター……？」
　今のはもう一つのエレベーターが上がってきた音らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ding.
“Huh—?”
A bright, cheerful chime rang out, grotesquely out of place.
“Damn it, what is this headache—”
Enduring a pain like a blade through my skull, I struggled upright.
“The elevator?”
Apparently the other elevator had arrived.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ding dong.
"Eh--?"
A terribly out-of-place cheerful sound rings out.
"Damn it, what's with this headache--?"
I stand up, enduring the razor-like pain in my head.
"Ele… vator…?"
It seems the sound is the other elevator coming up.

entries.japanese:
扉が開く。
　その中には、黒いコートを着た男が一人。
　頭痛が、一段と強くなる。
「あいつ――――」
　そう、見たことがある。
　たしかに、自分はあの男を見たコトがあったはずだ。
「―――――――」
　男は無言で向かってくる。
「おまえ―――！」
　ナイフを構えて男を睨んだ。
「―――――――」
　けれど、男はまったく反応しないで歩いてくる。
　こちらのことなど、まるっきり眼中にないというふうに。
entries.maoEnglish:
The doors opened.
Inside stood a single man in a black coat.
The pain in my head intensified.
“That man—”
Yes.
I was certain I had seen him before.
“……”
The man approached in silence.
“You—!”
I raised my knife and glared.
“……”
But the man kept coming without the slightest reaction.
He walked as if I did not even exist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The door opens.
Inside stands a man wearing a black coat.
The headache worsens.
"He's--"
Yes, I've seen him before.
I'm sure I've seen that man before.
"-------"
Silently, he walks towards me.
"You--!"
I ready my knife as I glare at him.
"-------"
But he doesn't react at all as he walks towards me.
It's as if he doesn't notice me at all.

entries.japanese:
距離が迫る。
　あと少し―――ほんのあと一メートル、というところまで近づいて、ようやく男はこちらに気がついたようだった。
　その、血走った目。
　人間の持つ目とは逸脱したその目を見た瞬間、俺の体の自由は、まるっきりきかなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The distance narrowed.
He came within a single meter before he finally seemed to notice me.
Those bloodshot eyes.
The instant I saw eyes so far removed from anything human, every part of my body ceased to obey me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The distance between us shrinks.
Just a little more---when there is barely one meter between us, and the man finally seems to notice me.
Those bloodshot eyes.
The instant I see those eyes which no human should possess, I lose all freedom to move my body.

entries.japanese:
「皆殺しにしたはずだが、まだ残っていたか」
　男はぐるり、と廊下に転がる二匹の黒犬の死体を見た。
「――塵どもめ。
肉片ひとつ片づけられぬのでは、我が肉体である資格はない」
　不快げに呟いて、男はざあ、と片腕をあげた。
　コートがマントのように持ちあがる。
―――壊れてる。
　黒い犬たちは、びゅるん、と音をたてて、液体になって男のコートの中に消えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I thought I had slaughtered them all, but one remains.”
The man swept his gaze over the two black dogs sprawled in the corridor.
“Wretched refuse. If you cannot dispose of a single scrap of meat, you are unfit to be my flesh.”
He muttered in distaste and raised one arm.
His coat lifted like a great black cape.
―――Broken.
With a liquid rush, the black dogs dissolved and vanished beneath the man’s coat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I thought I killed everyone, but it seems like there's still someone left."
The man turns and looks at the corpses of the two black dogs.
"--You pieces of filth.
If you can't even take care of a scrap of meat, you're unworthy to be a part of my body."
The man voices his displeasure as he raises his hand.
His coat lifts like a mantle.
---Broken.
With a splash, the black dogs' remains liquify and disappear into the man's coat.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　叫び声さえ、あげられない。
　男のコートの下は真っ黒で、輪郭というものしか存在しなかった。
　そこにあるのは、ただ、泥のような闇だった。
「やば―――――――」
　やばい。
　ともかく、コイツはやばすぎる――――
　そう本能が危険信号をかき鳴らしているっていうのに、指先一つまともには動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
I couldn’t even scream.
Beneath his coat was pure black, nothing but an outline.
Nothing lay there but darkness as thick as mud.
“This is bad—”
Bad.
This thing was far too dangerous—
Every instinct shrieked its warning, yet I couldn’t properly move so much as a fingertip.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
I can't even scream.
Below the man's coat is pure darkness, without even the traces of an outline.
All that exists there is a mud-like darkness.
"Th----"
This is dangerous.
This guy is just too dangerous----
My instincts sound the alarm wildly in my head, but I can't even lift a finger.

entries.japanese:
黒いコートは近づいてくる。
「――――――！」
　このまま、ここにいては、やばい。
　さっきから止まない頭痛が、耐えきれないぐらい強くなって、ここが危険だと訴えつづける。
　どんな手段、どんな方法を用いても、すぐさまここから離れなくては命が亡いと。
―――――だが、とうに遅い。
　目の前には男がいる。
　その瞳はまったくこちらを見ていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The black coat drew nearer.
“—!”
I couldn’t remain here.
The unrelenting headache swelled beyond endurance.
It screamed that this place meant death—that by any means, at any cost, I had to get away at once.
―――――But it was already too late.
The man stood before me.
His eyes were not on me at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The man in the black coat approaches me.
"------!"
It's not good if I just stay here.
The unstopping headache grows to an unbearable level, telling me this place is dangerous.
Whatever the means, if I don't get out of here soon, I am going to lose my life.
-----But it's too late.
The man is right before me.
Those eyes aren't looking at me at all.

entries.japanese:
「食え」
　スラリ、とコートの片腕があがる。
　その下の混沌とした闇。
　そこから、何か巨大なモノが現れた。
　ごう、と。
　二つの風切り音が閉じられる。
　男のコートの下から現れたソレは、人間を軽く丸呑みできそうなワニの口だった。
「あ―――――――」
　死ぬ。
　ここで、紙くずを丸めるように、一瞬にして潰される。
　そう確信した矢先、俺の体は誰かの手によって後ろに引っ張られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Devour.”
One arm of the coat rose with elegant ease.
Beneath it lay churning, chaotic darkness.
Something enormous emerged from within.
With a roar.
Two currents of rushing air snapped shut.
What had emerged beneath the man’s coat was the maw of a crocodile large enough to swallow a human whole.
“Ah—”
I was going to die.
Crumpled in an instant like a sheet of wastepaper.
The moment certainty struck, someone’s hand wrenched me backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Feed."
He raises one of his arms.
Below it lies a chaotic darkness.
From there, something huge appears.
Whomp.
The sound of wind.
That which has appeared from below the man's coat is a crocodile's mouth, easily large enough to swallow a man whole.
"Ah------"
I'm going to die.
Right here, in an instant, crunched up like a ball of paper.
Just as I was convinced of this, someone pulls me back.

entries.japanese:
ぞぶり、という音。
「なっ―――」
　信じ、られない。
　ワニのアギトは俺ではなく、俺の体をひっぱってくれたアルクェイドの腹に食らいついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet crunch.
“Wha—”
Impossible.
The crocodile’s jaws had closed not on me, but around the abdomen of Arcueid—the one who had dragged me away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clomp.
"Wha--!?"
I… can't believe it.
Instead of me, the jaws of the crocodile clamp onto the stomach of Arcueid, who just pulled me out of the way.

entries.japanese:
「つ――――！」
　アルクェイドの顔が苦痛に歪む。
　彼女はワニの口に完全に食いつかれる前に後ろに引き下がった。
「…………」
　男は無言でアルクェイドを凝視する。
　アルクェイドは腹を真っ赤に染めたまま、苦しげに男を睨み返していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch—!”
Arcueid’s face twisted in pain.
Before the jaws could fasten completely, she pulled back.
“……”
The man stared at Arcueid in silence.
Her stomach stained scarlet, she returned his gaze through the pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ssstt--!"
Arcueid's face contorts in agony.
She draws back before she is completely devoured by the crocodile's maw.
"…………"
The man silently watches Arcueid.
Arcueid glares back at him with a pained expression, her mid-section stained in red.

entries.japanese:
「―――信じられない。
混沌とも名づけられた吸血種が、こんなくだらないゲームにのってくるなんて。
なんだか出来の悪い夢みたいだわ、ネロ・カオス」
「同感だな。
私も、真祖の生き残りを捕らえるなど、そのような無謀な祭りの執行者にしたてあげられるとは夢にも思わなかった。
私にとっても、これは悪夢だ」
　ネロ、とか呼ばれた男は静かに腕をさげる。
　コートはもとに戻って、ワニの口もその下に消えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Unbelievable. That a member of the vampiric species known as Chaos would stoop to playing such a pathetic game. This feels like a particularly bad dream, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
“On that, we agree. Never did I imagine I would be made the officiant of so reckless a festival—the capture of a surviving True Ancestor. This is a nightmare for me as well.”
The man she had called Nrvnqsr lowered his arm.
His coat settled into place, and the crocodile’s maw vanished beneath it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I can't believe a vampire named Chaos would play such trivial games.
It's like a poorly-scripted nightmare, Nrvnqsr Chaos."
"I feel the same way.
To catch one of the surviving True Ancestors… I never dreamed I would be a part of such a foolish festival.
This is a nightmare for me, too."
The man called Nrvnqsr quietly lowers his arm.
The coat returns to its former position, and the crocodile's mouth disappears underneath.

entries.japanese:
男はアルクェイドだけを視界に収めている。
　彼女に守られて、その後ろでナイフを構えている俺のことなんてまったく見えていないみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
The man’s vision held only Arcueid.
Sheltered behind her with my knife raised, I might as well have been invisible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The man looks only at Arcueid.
It's as if he's not concerned at all about me, standing behind her with my knife raised.

entries.japanese:
「しかし、これはどういう事だ？
　私の前の執行者は貴様に傷一つ付けられなかったという話だが、それはどのような間違いなのだ。
　今の貴様の存在規模は脆弱すぎる。
一介の亡者にも劣るその衰退―――私が来る前に教会の者たちに襲われたか、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド」
「………………」
　アルクェイドは何も言わない。
　男は、感情のない目でアルクェイドを凝視する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yet what is this? I was told my predecessor could not put so much as a scratch upon you; how am I to reconcile that claim with what I see?
The scale of your existence has withered beyond belief. You have fallen beneath even a common corpse—were you attacked by agents of the Church before my arrival, Arcueid Brunestud?”
“……”
Arcueid said nothing.
The man watched her with emotionless eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But what is going on?
I have heard that the previous executor could not even scratch you.
What kind of a mistake is this?
Right now, your presence is exceedingly weak.
Even weaker than a mere member of The Dead--were you attacked by The Church before I arrived, Arcueid Brunestud?"
"……………"
Arcueid says nothing.
The man fixes his emotionless stare on her.

entries.japanese:
「……解せぬな。
貴様を害せるほどの概念武装は限られている。
アレを保有しているのは教会の殺し屋どもだけだ。
このような極東の地に、埋葬機関が派遣されるとは思えぬが」
　男はかすかに瞳を細めると、くるりと背を向けた。
「だが、どちらにせよ私にとっては僥倖だ。
貴様がそこまで弱っている是非は問わぬ。
勝機があるうちに、その首を貰い受けるのみだ」
「っ……！」
　ナイフを構えて男の攻撃に備える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I do not understand. Few conceptual weapons can injure you to this degree, and only the Holy Church’s assassins possess that particular one. I cannot imagine the Burial Agency being dispatched to this remote corner of the Far East.”
His eyes narrowed almost imperceptibly, and he turned away.
“In any event, your condition is a stroke of fortune for me. How or why you became so weak is irrelevant. While victory lies within my reach, I need only claim your head.”
“Tch…!”
I raised my knife, bracing for his attack.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't understand.
There are only a limited number of conceptual weapons capable of harming you.
The only people in possession of those are The Church's assassins, and I don't think the Burial Agency would dispatch anyone this far east."
The man narrows his eyes slightly as he turns around.
"Either way, this is most fortunate for me.
I shall not ask why you have been weakened.
All I am going to do is claim your head while I have a chance of winning."
"Ts……!"
I hold up my knife, preparing for his attack.

entries.japanese:
―――が。
　その首を貰いうける、なんてコトを言っておきながら、男はエレベーターへと去っていく。
　男は急いだ様子もなく、悠然とエレベーターに乗って、そのままこの廊下から退場してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And yet.
After announcing that he would claim her head, the man simply walked back toward the elevator.
Without the slightest haste, he stepped inside and departed the corridor with stately composure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---But.
Having openly stated he was going to take her head, the man now disappears towards the elevator.
It seems despite this claim, the man in the black coat is now leaving the hallway for the elevator.

entries.japanese:
「――――――へ？」
　もう、これっぽっちもワケがわからない！
　さっきの男のことも、俺を襲った二匹の犬のことも、このホテルを襲った悪夢みたいな現実も！
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Huh?”
I understood absolutely nothing anymore!
Not that man, not the two dogs that attacked me, not the nightmarish reality that had descended upon this hotel!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Huh?"
Now I've got absolutely no idea what's going on!
About that man, the two dogs who attacked me, the nightmare-like reality of the attack on this hotel--none of it!

entries.japanese:
「志――――貴」
　どん、とアルクェイドが寄りかかってきた。
「あ――――」
　ひどい傷だ。
　腹からの出血は止まっているものの、彼女の顔は苦痛にゆがんでいる。
―――それは、たった数秒前。
　俺を、あの男から庇ってできた傷だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki.”
Arcueid collapsed against me.
“Ah—”
The wound was terrible.
The bleeding from her stomach had stopped, but her face remained contorted with pain.
―――It had happened only seconds ago.
She had suffered that wound protecting me from the man.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi--ki."
Arcueid leans on me.
"Ah----"
It's a terrible wound.
Though her stomach stopped bleeding, her face is scrunched up in pain.
---It happened mere seconds ago.
The wound she got from protecting me from that man.

entries.japanese:
「おまえ――――なんで」
「……うん、ちょっと甘く見てた。
あれぐらいなら志貴を助けて、わたしも軽くかわせると思ったんだけど―――さすがだね、志貴。
志貴にやられた傷、そんなに甘くなかったみたい」
　アルクェイドは苦痛にゆがんだ顔で、にこりと、冗談みたいに微笑んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you—?”
“I underestimated him. I thought I could save you and still dodge something like that easily. You really are incredible, Shiki; the wounds you gave me were more serious than I thought.”
Her face pinched with pain, Arcueid smiled as if delivering a joke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why--did you…?"
"…… Yes.
I, underestimated him slightly.
I thought I could help you and then dodge him, but--you did really well, Shiki.
I guess the wound I got from you wasn't so trifling after all."
Arcueid's face, twisted in pain, turns into a small, joking smile.

entries.japanese:
「ばっ――――」
―――見て、いられない。
　そんな―――俺を庇って出来た傷で、くわえてその原因も俺にあるっていうのに―――そんな馬鹿な笑顔、うかべられたら立場がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You id—”
―――I couldn’t bear to look.
That wound came from protecting me, and I was also the reason she had been weak enough to suffer it; how was I supposed to face a smile that foolish?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You id--"
---I can't watch her any longer.
The wound she got was from protecting me, and the reason she got it was because of me too--there is no place for that stupid smile of hers.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは俺に体を預けて、うっすらと目を閉じようとしている。
「……ちょっと待て、なに目を閉じてるんだばかっ！
　しっかりしろ、おまえは夜なら死なない吸血鬼なんだろ……！」
「……そうなんだけどね。
わたし、なんだか限界みたい」
「なっ――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid let her weight rest against me, her eyelids beginning to droop.
“Wait—don’t close your eyes, you idiot…! You’re a vampire; you said you can’t die at night…!”
“That’s true. But I think I’ve reached my limit.”
“Wha—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid leans onto me and lightly closes her eyes.
"…… Hold on, don't close your eyes, you idiot!
Get ahold of yourself!
You're a vampire who can't die at night, right…!?"
"…… Well, that's true, but it seems like I'm at my limit."
"Wha--!?"

entries.japanese:
「わるいんだけど、部屋まで連れてかえっておいて」
　がくん、とアルクェイドの体重がかかってくる。
「―――ちょっと待ってくれ、そんな―――」
　勝手に死なれたら、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, but take me back to my apartment.”
Arcueid’s whole weight suddenly sagged against me.
“Wait—you can’t just—”
If she went and died on me, I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sorry, but could you take me back to my room?"
Arcueid's weight falls on me.
"--Hold on!
That's--!"
If she dies, I'll--

entries.japanese:
「おい――――！」
　静かに目を閉じたアルクェイドに呼びかける。
　と。
「……くー」
　なんて、とても幸せそうな寝息が聞こえてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey—!”
I called to Arcueid, whose eyes had quietly closed.
Then.
“Mmm…”
A blissfully contented little snore answered me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey--!"
I call out to Arcueid, who has quietly closed her eyes.
And then,
"…… Zzz."
I can hear her happily breathing in her sleep.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　……はあ、心配して損した。
アルクェイドは眠っているだけらしい。
「……部屋まで連れてけって、また勝手なコト言いやがって―――」
　本当に勝手なコトだけど、この場合は仕方ない。
　それにこれ以上このホテルに居ると、何かとまずい事になりそうな気もする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
So much for worrying. Arcueid was only asleep.
“Carry you home—you always do whatever you please—”
It was selfish as hell, but under the circumstances I had little choice.
Besides, staying in this hotel any longer felt likely to cause trouble of an entirely different kind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
…… *sigh*
I shouldn't have bothered worrying.
Arcueid is only sleeping.
"…… Telling me to take her back to her room like that.
How selfish of her--"
It really was selfish of her, but there's no helping it in this situation.
Besides.
If we stay here in this hotel any longer, I have the feeling we'll be in a lot of trouble.

entries.japanese:
「…………ぐっ」
　頭痛はやまない。
　なんだかんだと、こっちも休まないとまいってしまいそうだった。
「……アルクェイドの部屋って―――ああ、あそこか」
　一度しか行ったことはないが、場所は確実に覚えていた。
―――なら長居は無用だ。
　俺はアルクェイドを抱きかかえて、早々にホテルを後にする事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh.”
The headache refused to stop.
After everything that had happened, I felt close to collapsing unless I rested too.
“Arcueid’s apartment—that was it.”
I had visited only once, but I remembered the location perfectly.
―――There was no reason to linger.
I gathered Arcueid into my arms and left the hotel as quickly as I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Guh!"
The headache won't stop.
I guess I have to rest too or I'll faint.
"…… Arcueid's room?
--Oh, that place."
I've only been there once, but I definitely remember it.
---In that case, there's no point staying here any longer.
Carrying Arcueid, I decide to quickly leave the hotel.

entries.japanese:
街はかすかに明るい。
　まだ誰も起きていない早朝という事が幸いして、アルクェイドの部屋に行くまで誰にも見られずにすんだ。
「……そうか、そういうコトか」
　そこでようやく、あの男が立ち去った理由を理解した。
　街にはうっすらと茜がかかりはじめている。
　いつのまにか、夜はとうに明けていてくれたらしい―――
entries.maoEnglish:
A faint light hung over the city.
Fortunately, no one else was awake at this hour, and I reached Arcueid’s apartment without being seen.
“So that was why.”
At last I understood why the man had left.
A pale crimson glow had begun to spread across the city.
Without my noticing, dawn had already broken—
entries.mirrorMoon:
The city is slightly lit up.
Fortunately, it's too early in the morning for anyone to be awake, so I get to Arcueid's room without being seen.
"…… I see, that's how it is."
Then, I finally realize why that man left.
The streets are beginning to become covered with a faint orange light.
I guess dawn is breaking already-----

entries.japanese:
「――――――よし」
　やる事なんて、初めから決まってる。
　ポケットからナイフを出して、部屋の扉まで歩いていく。
「――――志貴？」
「外の様子を見てくるよ。
俺が帰ってくるまで、部屋から出ないで」
　何か言いたげなアルクェイドの視線を振りきって、廊下へ出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—All right.”
There was never any question what I had to do.
I drew the knife from my pocket and walked to the door.
“—Shiki?”
“I’m going to look outside. Don’t leave this room until I get back.”
I tore myself away from Arcueid’s questioning gaze and stepped into the hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Alright."
I've decided what to do from the very beginning.
Taking the knife out of my pocket, I walk up to the door.
"----Shiki?"
"I'm going to go check things out.
Don't leave this room until I come back."
I step out into the hallway, shaking off Arcueid's look that she wants to say something.

entries.japanese:
廊下に人影はない。
　……部屋の中では聞こえなかったけれど、廊下はがやがやと騒がしかった。
　このフロアが騒がしい、のではない。
　騒音は足元から。
　下の階はごちゃごちゃと騒がしくて、なにやら何人もの人の話し声が響いてきている。
　……おかしい。
　時刻は午前四時をすぎた頃だ。
　早起きにしたって、こんな時間に大勢の人間が目を覚ましているのは普通じゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The corridor was deserted.
I hadn’t heard anything from inside the room, but out here there was a great deal of noise.
Not on this floor.
It rose from beneath my feet.
The floors below were in an uproar, the muddled voices of many people echoing upward.
Something was wrong.
It was a little past four in the morning.
No matter how early they rose, it wasn’t normal for so many people to be awake at this hour.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No one is in the hallway.
…… I couldn't hear from inside, but the hallway is noisy.
It's not that this floor is noisy.
Rather, the noise is coming from beneath my feet.
There is some kind of ruckus on the floor below; I can hear the noise of many people talking.
…… That's odd.
It's just past four in the morning.
Even under the assumption some people have woken up early, it's not normal for this many people to be up at this hour.

entries.japanese:
「…………異状は、ないよな」
　廊下を歩いく。
　下の階からのざわめきは、海の波の音に似ている。
　騒がしいのに―――ひどく孤独だと感じる、閑散とした騒音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nothing’s wrong.”
I started down the corridor.
The murmur from the floors below sounded like waves upon the sea.
Noise everywhere, yet strangely desolate—a sound that left me terribly alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Doesn't look strange so far."
I walk down the hallway.
The noise from downstairs is like the sound of ocean waves.
Noisy--and yet so very solitary and inactive.

entries.japanese:
「―――――つ」
　ナイフを持つ指先がかじかむ。
　ぶるりと首のうしろが寒い。
　なにか、こめかみのあたり。
　眼球の奥から、痛みがやってきているよう。
　堪えながら、さざなみのする廊下を歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch.”
My fingers stiffened around the knife.
A chill shivered across the back of my neck.
Something stirred near my temple.
The pain seemed to be approaching from behind my eyes.
I endured it and kept walking through the corridor’s soft, tidal murmur.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
My fingers gripping the knife feel numb.
A chill runs over the back of my neck.
There's something near my temple.
Pain emerges from the back of my eyes.
Enduring it, I walk down the hallway.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　いた、い。
　目が、いたい。
　あたまが重くなって、そのまま倒れてしまいそうな浮遊感。
　ああ、これは知ってる。
貧血で倒れる直前の感覚だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
It hurts.
My eyes hurt.
My head grows heavy, while the floor seems to drift beneath me as if I might collapse.
I know this feeling. It’s what comes just before I faint from anemia.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
It… hurts.
My eyes… hurt.
My head grows heavy, and I feel a drifting sensation, like I'm about to collapse right here.
Yeah, I know what this is.
This is the feeling I get right before I collapse from anemia.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――ぐ…………！」
　いたい。
　いたいから、耐えきれなくなって、メガネを外した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—ghh…!”
It hurt.
When I could bear it no longer, I took off my glasses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----gu………!"
It hurts.
It hurts.
Unable to withstand it any longer, I remove my glasses.

entries.japanese:
……エレベーターは二つある。
　一つは一階に、もう一つは五階で止まっていた。
「………」
　厭な空気がする。
　重苦しいような、張り詰めたような、そんな雰囲気。
　ボタンを押して、エレベーターを呼びつける。
　とにかく、下の階がなんで騒いでいるかを知りたい。
entries.maoEnglish:
There were two elevators.
One rested on the first floor, the other on the fifth.
“……”
The air felt wrong.
It was both oppressive and drawn tight.
I pressed the call button.
I needed to know what was causing the uproar below.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There are two elevators.
One is stopped on the first floor, the other on the fifth.
"………"
There is an unpleasant feeling in the air.
A suffocating, tense sensation.
I push the button to call the elevator.
I just want to know what's going on downstairs for now.

entries.maoEnglish:
The elevator began to rise.
Sixth floor.
Seventh floor.
Eighth floor.
Ninth floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The elevator rises.
…… Sixth floor.
…………… Seventh floor.
………………………… Eighth floor.
……………………………………… Ninth floor.

entries.japanese:
「―――くそ、なにやってんだ」
　エレベーターはひどくゆっくりしている。
　なにか―――致命的にとりかえしのつかない事になっているという予感だけが、正体のない影になって背中にのしかかってくる感覚―――
　…………………………………十階。
　あと一階で、ここまでエレベーターは上がってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it, what’s taking so long?”
The elevator was moving unbearably slowly.
A shapeless premonition pressed against my back—something fatal, something beyond repair, was happening even now—
Tenth floor.
Only one floor remained before the elevator reached me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Damn it, what's up with it?"
The elevator is awfully slow.
Something--a shapeless, shadow-like premonition of something fatally irrevocable clings to me--
………………………… Tenth floor.
Just one more floor until the elevator reaches this one.

entries.japanese:
「―――――早く」
　息がつまる。
　気がつけば。
あれほど聞こえていた下の階からの雑音は、とっくの昔になくなっていた。
　チーン、と間の抜けた電子音をあげて、エレベーターがやってきた。
　扉が開く。
　中には人がいない。
　狭い鉄の箱の中は、ぞっとするほど小綺麗だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hurry.”
My breath caught.
Only then did I realize it. The clamor from below had long since vanished.
The elevator arrived with a foolish little electronic chime.
The doors opened.
No one was inside.
The narrow iron box was so spotlessly clean it chilled me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Hurry up."
My breath catches.
I realize all the noise I heard from below is now long gone.
With a ridiculous electronic 'ding', the elevator arrives.
The door opens.
There is no one inside.
The interior of the narrow steel box is surprisingly clean and tidy.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　中に入って、十階のボタンを押した。
　ごうん、と重苦しい音をたてて、エレベーターは下がっていく。
　たった一階分の距離が、とても遠く感じる。
　現在位置を示すランプが十階にさしかかった。
「やっとついた、か―――」
　とたん―――
　世界は、一切の闇につつまれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I stepped in and pressed the button for the tenth floor.
With a heavy mechanical groan, the elevator descended.
A single floor felt impossibly distant.
The indicator light reached ten.
“Finally—”
At that instant—
The entire world plunged into darkness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I enter, and press the button for the tenth floor.
With a heavy noise, the elevator descends.
Just one floor down, but it feels awfully far.
The current floor display shifts to show the tenth floor.
"Finally--"
Suddenly---
The world is engulfed in darkness.

entries.japanese:
「…………！？」
　闇。
完全な闇。
　一切の光のない、完全な闇。
　その中で。
　うっすらと光る、死の『線』だけが確かだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…!?”
Darkness. Perfect darkness.
Not the faintest trace of light.
Within it.
The only things I could trust were the faintly glowing lines of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………!?"
Darkness.
Total darkness.
Pitch black, utterly without light.
In that,
all I can see is the faint glimmer of the 'lines' of death.

entries.japanese:
「な―――ん、で」
　息がつまる。
　周囲からは、なにか―――ガサガサと、虫が這いずり回っているような音が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why?”
My breath seized.
Something rustled around me, like insects crawling in every direction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why--?"
My breath freezes in my throat.
From all around, something--some kind of rustling sound, like the sound of insects crawling around--can be heard.

entries.japanese:
ガサ。
　ガサガサ。
　ガサガサガサガサガサ………………！
entries.maoEnglish:
Rustle.
Rustle, rustle.
Rustle-rustle-rustle-rustle…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
*rustle*
*rustle* *rustle*
*rustle* *rustle* *rustle* *rustle* ……!

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――！」
　叫び出しそうになって、なんとか声を堪えた。
「……まず、よく見て……」
　昔、先生が教えてくれたみたいに。
「……そのあとに、よく考える……」
　はあ、と大きく息を吸いこんで、なんとか思考を落ち着かせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
A scream rose in my throat, but I forced it down.
“Look carefully first.”
Just as my teacher had taught me long ago.
“Then think carefully.”
I drew a deep breath and somehow brought my thoughts under control.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
I am about to cry out, but I hold back my scream.
"…… First, I've got to examine the situation…"
Just like Sensei taught me long ago.
"…… And then, think carefully…"
Taking a huge breath, I manage to calm my thoughts.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか……停電、か」
　……けど、こういうホテルっていうのは非常時の電源が用意されているはずだ。
　それさえ働かない、という事はケーブルか何かのトラブルだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A blackout.”
But a hotel like this should have emergency power.
If even that wasn’t working, perhaps some cable had failed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see…… A blackout."
…… But a hotel like this should have a backup generator for occasions like this.
Something must be wrong with the cables, if even that's not working.

entries.japanese: ガサ、ガサ、ガササササササササ――――――
entries.maoEnglish: Rustle, rustle, scritchscritchscritch—
entries.mirrorMoon: *rustle* *rustle* *rustllllllle*

entries.japanese:
「ひっ………」
　ナイフを握り締めて、身を硬くする。
　虫が這いずり回るような音は、エレベーターの周りからしている。
　なにか、本当に。
　巨大なゴキブリとかそういったものが、何百匹とエレベーターの外側に張りついているような、そんな気配がしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eek…”
I clenched the knife and went rigid.
The insectile crawling came from all around the elevator.
Something was truly there.
It felt as though hundreds of enormous cockroaches—or things like them—were clinging to the outside of the car.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……!"
Gripping the knife, I tense up.
The sound of the crawling insects is coming from around the elevator.
It's like…
It feels like there are hundreds of giant cockroaches clinging to the outside of the elevator.

entries.japanese:
「―――ここにいても、ダメだ」
　たしかランプは十階で止まっていたはずだ。
　なら、扉さえ開ければそこは十階のフロアというコト。
「――――切るか」
　呟いたあと。
　唯一見えていた『線』にナイフを刺し入れ、エレベーターの扉を切断した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t stay here.”
The indicator had stopped at ten.
If I could only open the doors, the tenth-floor corridor would lie beyond them.
“I’ll cut them.”
I muttered the words.
I drove the knife into the one visible line and severed the elevator doors.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--There's no point in staying here."
The display stopped when the tenth floor was lit.
Then it means that if I open the door, I should be at the tenth floor.
"----Guess I'll cut it."
I whisper to myself.
Thrusting the knife into the only 'line' I can see, I cut apart the door of the elevator.

entries.japanese:
「っ…………！？」
　扉を開けた瞬間、なにか――――重苦しい臭いに包まれた。
　十階のフロアじゅうに、イヤな臭いが充満している。
　なんていうか―――吸っているだけで気管が塞がっていきそうなほど、濃密な臭い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch…!?”
The instant the doors opened, a dense, oppressive stench enveloped me.
The foul smell saturated the entire tenth floor.
It was so thick that merely breathing seemed to clog my windpipe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… !?"
The instant the door opens--I am enveloped by a suffocating stench.
The tenth floor is filled with it.
It's so thick just breathing it is enough to clog my airways.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　それでも、一歩踏み出せばそこは十階の廊下だ。
　遠くで非常階段のランプがともっていて、そこだけがぼんやりと明るい。
　それ以外は、ただ黒く塗りつぶされた世界だった。
　一歩、外に出る。
「………誰か」
　いませんか、と言おうとして、やめた。
　よくわからない。
けど、声をあげるのだけはまずい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
One step would carry me into the tenth-floor corridor.
Far away, an emergency-exit sign glowed, casting a dim pool of light.
Everything else had been painted solid black.
I stepped out.
“Is anyone—”
I stopped before asking if anyone was there.
I didn’t know why. But making a sound felt like the worst thing I could do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
But even so, if I were to take a step outside, I would be on the tenth floor's hallway.
In the distance, there is the faint glow of the lamp marking the fire escape.
Apart from that, the world is painted over in darkness.
I take a step outside.
"…… Is anyone…"
I'm about to say "there", but I stop.
I don't quite know why, but I feel as though it would be a bad idea to raise my voice.

entries.japanese:
さらに一歩。
　ゆっくりと廊下に出る。
　廊下には、厭なにおいが充満していた。
　生臭い。
獣の臭いがする。
　それと、どこからかゴリゴリという、何かを削るような音。
entries.maoEnglish:
Another step.
Slowly, I moved into the corridor.
The foul odor filled it.
It smelled raw. It smelled of animals.
From somewhere came a steady grinding sound, as though something hard were being scraped away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take another step.
Slowly, I enter the hallway.
The corridor reeks of the terrible smell.
A raw smell.
The smell of beasts.
That, and a grinding sound coming from somewhere.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　さっきから首筋がキィィン、と痛む。
　暗闇は、恐い。
　この静けさが、恐い。
　……ここで何が起きたのか、知ることがなにより恐い。
　後ろの首、背骨の頂点が痛いのは、あまりの緊張を堪えているせいだ。
　びりびりとするその痛みは、
　今にも叫び出して逃げたいという気持ちを、必死に押さえつけている代償だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
A high, needling pain had been ringing through the back of my neck.
The darkness frightened me.
The silence frightened me.
More than anything, I was terrified to learn what had happened here.
The base of my skull, at the very top of my spine, ached from the tension I was forcing myself to endure.
That electric pain was—
The price of suppressing my desperate need to scream and run.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
There's been a stinging pain in my neck for a while now.
The darkness is frightening.
This silence is frightening.
…… To find out what happened here is more frightening than anything else.
The pain from the back of my neck running to the top of my spine holds back my nervousness.
That throbbing pain,
it's the price of my desperate attempts to repress the urge to just scream and flee.

entries.japanese:
ガサ、ガサ、ガサ。
　ゴリ、ゴリ、ゴリ。
　ベリ、ベり、べり。
entries.maoEnglish:
Rustle, rustle, rustle.
Grind, grind, grind.
Rip, tear, peel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*rustle* *rustle* *rustle*
*grind* *grind* *grind*
*scratch* *scratch* *scratch*

entries.japanese:
「はっ…………」
　呼吸が乱れる。
　体中、汗でぬらぬらと湿っている。
　……ナイフを片手にして、俺は、一歩も動けないでいる。
　だって。
少しでも動いたら、なにか例えようもなく恐ろしいモノを見てしまいそうな気がするんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…”
My breathing broke apart.
Sweat slicked my entire body.
Knife in hand, I couldn’t move a single step.
There was a reason. If I moved, I felt certain I would see something too terrible to name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha…!"
My breathing goes wild.
My body is drenched in sweat.
…… Knife in hand, I am unable to take another step.
I have the feeling that if I were to move even a little, I would see something unimaginably horrible.

entries.japanese:
「はっ……はっ……」
　それでも―――上の階に戻らないと、まずい。
　……この階にこのまま留まっているのは、それ以上にまずい。
　こうして立ち止まっている一秒一秒が、自分の寿命を一年ずつ削っていっているぐらい、ものすごい速度で『死』が迫ってきている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah.”
Still, I had to get back upstairs.
Remaining on this floor was even worse.
Every second I stood still felt as though it shaved a year from my life, while death hurtled toward me with impossible speed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*  *pant*
But I'll really be in trouble if I don't get back upstairs.
…… To stay on this floor is worse.
It feels like each second passing is grinding a year off my life.
That's how fast I feel 'death' closing in on me.

entries.japanese:
「はっ……はっ……はっ―――は」
　幸い非常階段のランプのおかげで階段がある場所はわかる。
　この廊下の奥。
　あの緑の非常灯まで行けば、上の階へ行くことができる。
　ナイフを握り締めて、闇の廊下を歩きだした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah.”
Fortunately, the illuminated exit sign showed me where the stairs were.
At the far end of the corridor.
If I could reach that green light, I could climb back upstairs.
Clutching the knife, I started down the darkened corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My breath comes quicker and heavier.
Fortunately, I can see where the fire escape is, thanks to the lamp.
It's down the end of the hallway.
If I can reach that green emergency light, I can go back upstairs.
Gripping the knife, I set off down the dark hallway.

entries.japanese: ―――――ぴちゃり。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Splash.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----*splash*

entries.japanese:
、と。
足元で音がした。
entries.maoEnglish: Then. A sound came from beneath my foot.
entries.mirrorMoon: I can hear something from beneath my feet.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　廊下は水びたしになっているらしい。
　それ以外にも、歩いているとゴツゴツと何かに足があたる。
「―――――」
　それでも声はあげない。
　全身を包むイヤな臭いを堪えながら、とにかく非常灯を目指す。
　非常灯まで、あと、ほんの数メートル。
　その時、なにか非常灯の下でうごめいている物が見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
The corridor seemed to be flooded.
Hard objects knocked against my feet as I walked.
“……”
Still I made no sound.
Enduring the stench that wrapped my entire body, I pressed on toward the exit sign.
Only a few meters remained.
Then I saw something moving beneath the green light.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I guess the hallway is soaked in water.
In addition, my feet keep bumping into things as I walk.
"-----"
Even so, I stay silent.
Bearing with the terrible stench smothering me, I head for the emergency light.
Only a few more meters to go.
Then, I see something squirming beneath the emergency light.

entries.japanese:
「………………え？」
　殺していたはずの声があがった。
　ぐっちゃぐっちゃという生ぬるい音。
　ごり、という乾いた音。
　はあはあという荒い獣の息遣い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
The voice I had been strangling slipped free.
A warm, sodden squelching.
A dry crack.
The harsh panting of beasts.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Eh?"
I break my silence.
A squishing, lukewarm sound.
A dry, grinding sound.
The wild panting breath of beasts.

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　非常階段の緑色の明かりの下で。
　さまざまな動物たちが、人間らしきカタチのモノに、群がっている。
　どんな動物たちがヒトを食べているのかはわからない。
　廊下は暗くて、非常灯の明かりは弱すぎる。
　だから、こんなイメージしかわかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wha—”
Beneath the green emergency light.
All manner of animals swarmed over something shaped like a human being.
I couldn’t tell what kinds of animals were eating it.
The corridor was dark, and the emergency light too weak.
My mind could supply only one image.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wh--"
Under the green light of the fire escape…
All sorts of animals are swarming around some human-shaped object.
I can't tell what sorts of animals are eating it.
The hallway is dark, and the emergency light is too weak.
That's why all I can gather is this image.

entries.japanese:
―――何十匹というゴキブリが、わさわさと笑い声のように羽音をたてて、人間の死体を咀嚼している。
　俺にはそんなふうにしか、この悪夢が見て取れなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Dozens of cockroaches chewing on a human corpse, their wings rustling like laughter.
That was the only form in which I could comprehend the nightmare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Numerous cockroaches are devouring the human corpse while emitting a laughing buzzing sound.
That's the only way I can make sense of this nightmare.

entries.japanese:
ガサ、リ。
　やってきたエレベーターから、なにか、物音が。
entries.maoEnglish:
Scrape.
A sound came from the elevator that had brought me down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*rustle*
There is a noise coming from the direction of the elevator.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――」
　後ろに振りかえる。
　闇に目が慣れたせいだろうか。
　それとも非常階段の明かりのおかげなのか、いままで自分が通ってきた廊下がどのようなモノに変わっているか、わかってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—”
I looked back.
Perhaps my eyes had adjusted to the darkness.
Or perhaps the glow of the emergency light had shown me what the corridor I had crossed had become.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----"
I turn around.
Perhaps it's because my eyes have adjusted to the darkness?
Or maybe it's thanks to light from the fire escape, but I now see exactly what sort of condition the hallway I just passed through is in.

entries.japanese:
廊下は一面の赤い海。
　その海の中、人の腕やら足やらがころがっている。
　水浸しの廊下。
なにやらゴツゴツと足にあたった硬いもの。
　それらが、さっき俺が踏みしめてきたモノか。
「――――――」
　あたまが真っ白になる。
　廊下が赤いのは、地面だけだった。
　壁や天井にはべったりと、なにか黒いモノたちが張りついている。
entries.maoEnglish:
The corridor was a sea of red.
Human arms and legs floated in it.
The flooded floor. The hard things that had knocked against my feet.
Those were what I had been walking through.
“……”
My mind went white.
Only the floor was red.
The walls and ceiling were plastered with black things.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The hallway is a sea of red.
Lying around within that sea are human arms and legs.
The soaked hallway.
Scraggy, hard objects which I felt on my legs.
It must have been what I was stepping on.
"------"
My mind goes blank.
The hallway is red only on the floor.
Clinging to the ceiling and walls are all sorts of black things.

entries.japanese:
明かりがない故に黒く見えるんじゃない。
　もとから、ソイツらは真っ黒だった。
　ソイツらはカタチというものがなく、液体のように壁という壁、天井という天井に張りついている。
　ただ、それらが動物だとわかったのは、目だけが。
　爛々と輝くさまざまな形の獣の目が、自分というただ一人生きている人間に対して向けられていたからだ―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
They weren’t black because there was no light.
They were black to begin with.
They had no fixed shape, clinging like liquid to every wall and every inch of ceiling.
I knew they were animals only because of their eyes.
Bright, predatory eyes of countless shapes, all fixed upon me—the one living human left—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's not because there are no lights that they look black.
They are black to begin with.
They don't seem to have any solid shape, sticking to the ceiling and walls like some sort of liquid.
But I know they are animals from the eyes.
The glinting eyes of the many beast-like forms are trained on me, the only surviving human-----

entries.japanese:
「ひ………」
　悲鳴をなんとか押し殺す。
　獣たちはじっと俺を見つめている。
　声をあげた瞬間に襲いかかろうと、じっと息を潜めている。
「は、――――は」
　乱れる呼吸をなんとか整える。
　声をあげれば、一斉に襲いかかってくるのが、イヤというほど感じ取れた。
　壁にいるモノたちは、一様に同じ目をしていない。
　中には何の冗談か、サメらしきものの目まで、壁に張り付いているようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eek…”
I smothered the scream.
The beasts stared without moving, holding their breath as if waiting to pounce the moment I made a sound.
“Hah…
hah…”
I fought my ragged breathing under control.
I could feel with sickening certainty that one cry would bring them all down upon me.
The things on the walls did not share a single kind of eye.
Absurdly, some even seemed to be the eyes of sharks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hya……"
I manage to suppress my scream.
The beasts are staring at me intently.
They hold their breath, waiting to assault me the moment I scream out.
"Ha---hhh."
I manage to regulate my ragged breathing.
I can feel it, awfully so, that the moment I cry out, they'll all attack me at once.
None of the creatures on the wall possess the same eyes.
It's almost ridiculous to see even shark-like eyes clinging to the wall.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　動け、と足に命じるのに、手足はぴくりとも動いてくれない。
――――動けない。
　このセカイを見てしまった以上、もう足が動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I ordered my legs to move, but not one limb so much as twitched.
――――I couldn’t move.
Now that I had seen this world, my legs refused to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I order my feet to move, but they won't budge an inch.
----I can't move.
My feet will not move, after having seen a world like this.

entries.maoEnglish: Grind, grind, gr-ind—
entries.mirrorMoon: *grind* …… *grind* …… *gr* …… *ind* ……

entries.japanese:
非常灯の下で鳴っていた音が小さくなっていく。
　おそらくは―――あの獣たちが、最後の死体を食べ終えようとしているのだろう。
「……………」
　息がつまる。
　カサカサという音が近寄ってくる。
　どうやら―――あの連中は、遠野志貴という次の獲物を見つけたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sounds beneath the emergency light dwindled.
The beasts were probably finishing the last corpse.
“……”
My breath caught.
The skittering began to draw nearer.
It seemed they had found their next piece of prey: Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The noise from beneath the emergency light grows smaller.
Those beasts are probably finishing off the corpse.
"………"
My breath catches.
The rustling draws closer.
It seems--the creatures found their next prey called Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
「あ…………」
　けれど足が動かない。
　ここはもう違う世界すぎて、俺の意識はまともに働いてくれない。
―――失敗した。
　俺は間違っても、この階になんか来るんじゃなかったのだ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Still my feet would not move.
This place belonged so completely to another world that my mind could no longer function.
―――I had made a mistake.
I should never, under any circumstances, have come to this floor—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah………"
But my legs would not move.
This world is too different, my mind doesn't operate properly.
---I've made a mistake.
I shouldn't have come to this floor----

entries.japanese:
―――その時。
　かつかつかつ、なんていう、やけに聞きなれた音が聞こえてきた。
　いたって普通の、なんでもない、人間の足音。
　それはついさっきまで自分がいた、世界の常識みたいなナンの変哲もない音―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Then.
Click, click, click.
Then I heard a strangely familiar sound.
Ordinary human footsteps, utterly unremarkable—the commonplace sound of the world I had inhabited only moments ago—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Then.
I can hear a terribly familiar sound.
The very normal sound of human footsteps.
A completely normal, common-sense sound from the world I lived in until a moment ago.

entries.japanese:
「あああああああ―――――！」
　麻痺していたあたまが、凝固していた両足に力をこめる。
　走り出す。
　廊下に充満した赤い血を跳ね上げて、非常灯に向かって走り出した。
　逃げるんだ。
　早く、一分でも一秒でもはやく、この場所から離れなくっちゃ………！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaaaah—!”
My numbed mind sent strength into my frozen legs.
I ran.
Splashing scarlet blood across the corridor, I raced for the emergency light.
I had to escape.
I had to leave this place now, as fast as I possibly could…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aaaaaaah----!"
My numbed mind infuses strength into my paralyzed legs.
I run.
Kicking up soaked blood in the hallway, I dash towards the emergency light.
Run.
I have to get away from this place as fast as possible…!

entries.japanese:
けれど、それは間違いだった。
　俺が走るのに反応して、壁という壁、天井という天井に張りついていた黒いモノは、波になって迫ってきた。
「っっっっっ！」
　全力で階段へと走る。
　けれど、黒い波の速度は俺なんかより何倍も速くて、あっというまに俺の体を―――
entries.maoEnglish:
But running was a mistake.
At my movement, the black things covering every wall and ceiling gathered into a wave and surged after me.
“Nngh!”
I sprinted for the stairs with all my strength.
But the black wave was many times faster than I was, and in an instant, my body was—
entries.mirrorMoon:
But that was a mistake.
Reacting to my dash, the black things clinging to the wall and ceilings crash after me like a wave.
"----!"
I dash towards the stairs with everything I have.
But the black wave is so many times faster than I am, and in an instant, my body is--

entries.japanese:
――――飲み込んだ。
　ざぱあ、と音をたてて、それこそ大波のように俺をそのうねりに巻き込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――It swallowed me.
With a crash like a breaking wave, the surge caught me and dragged me under.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----swallowed.
With a splashing sound, I am engulfed in the surging, heaving wave.

entries.japanese:
その圧倒的なまでの侵食。
　蹂躙し。
陵辱し。
溶解する。
entries.maoEnglish:
That absolute invasion.
Trampling. Violating. Dissolving.
entries.mirrorMoon:
An oppressive invasion.
It violates, assaults, and dissolves.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　肉体、精神、魂といったものが、消えていく。
　殺されたのではない。
　融かされて、この黒い波の一部に組みこまれた、というのが正しいのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Body, mind, soul—everything that made me was vanishing.
I had not been killed.
It would be more accurate to say I had melted and been incorporated into this black tide.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Flesh, spirit, soul… all disappearing.
I am not killed.
It's more accurate to say I've been melted and absorbed as a part of this black wave.

entries.japanese: 自分というわたし、俺という自分が希薄になっていくうねりの中で、そんな事を、ぼんやりと観察していた――――
entries.maoEnglish: As the current thinned out everything that made me 'me,' I watched it happen dimly—
entries.mirrorMoon: I observe the me that is me disappear in the black wave----

entries.japanese:
―――飲み込ま、なかった。
　ぎ、ぎぎぎぎ、ぎ。
　そんなうなりをあげて、黒い波は俺の目の前で停止してしまっている。
「……？」
　わけがわからない。
　わけがわからないけど、きっと、これが最後のチャンス。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It did not swallow me.
Gg—ggggg—g.
With that grinding growl, the black wave stops directly before me.
“……?”
I do not understand.
I understand nothing—but this must be my last chance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---not consumed.
Squeak.
Squeeeeeee-aaak.
With a cry, the black wave halts before my eyes.
"……?"
I don't get it.
I don't get it, but this probably is my last chance.

entries.japanese:
走る。
階段に向かって走る。
　非常灯の下にいた動物たちは、俺ではなく、さっきまで俺がいたエレベーターの前―――かつかつと足音が聞こえてきた方へ走っていく。
　動物たちが走っていった先で、ザンザンザン、と包丁で野菜を切るような、そんな小気味いい音が聞こえる。
　なにか―――人影らしきモノが、黒いケモノたちを切り捨てている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Run. Run for the stairs.
The animals beneath the emergency lights do not come after me; they race toward the place I occupied moments ago, in front of the elevator, where the sharp footsteps had been approaching.
From that direction comes a crisp chop-chop-chop, almost cheerful, like a kitchen knife passing through vegetables.
Something shaped like a person is cutting down the black beasts—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I run.
I run towards the stairs.
Instead of running towards me, the beasts beneath the emergency light are heading towards the elevator I was just in--towards the sound of footsteps.
Ahead of the animals, I can hear what sounds like a kitchen knife slicing vegetables.
Something--a human silhouette is slashing the black animals--

entries.japanese:
「―――――？」
　けど、それを確認している余裕なんてこっちにはない。
　俺は這いつくばるように手足をつかって、犬のように非常階段を駆けあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……?”
I have no time to see what it is.
Nearly on all fours, using hands and feet alike, I scramble up the emergency stairs like a dog.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----?"
But I don't have time to discern its identity.
Using my hands and feet, I rush up the fire stairs like a dog.

entries.japanese:
……十一階にあがってきた。
　周囲はまだ闇。
　けど、ここにはあの臭いがしない。
　ケモノと、血と、臓物にまみれた、生臭い臭いがしない。
「は――――あ」
　なんとか立ちあがって、壁沿いにアルクェイドの部屋へ歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I reach the eleventh floor.
Darkness still surrounds me.
But that smell is absent here.
There is no raw stench of beasts, blood, and spilled entrails.
“Haaah……”
I somehow make myself stand and follow the wall toward Arcueid’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I climb back up to the eleventh floor.
The surroundings are still pitch black.
But here, there is no trace of that stench.
That raw stench of beasts, blood, and entrails.
"Haa----aah."
I manage to get up, and tracing along the wall, I walk back towards Arcueid's room.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　電気がついた。
　このフロアは、以前となにも変わっていない。
　変わっているものといえば、俺の体が―――ところどころ、人の血にまみれているというコトだけだった。
「は――――――」
　ズボンは、初めから真っ赤な色だったみたいに、一面の朱。
　腕や胸、顔にだって、赤いまだら模様がついてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
The lights come on.
This floor is exactly as it was before.
The only thing that has changed is my body, smeared here and there with other people’s blood.
“Haaah……”
My trousers are crimson from end to end, as though they had always been dyed that color.
Red blotches stain my arms, my chest, even my face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
The lights come back on.
This floor is still as it was before.
The only thing that's different is me---splattered here and there in human blood.
"Ha------"
My pants are completely red, as if they had been crimson to begin with.
Red flecks are all over me.
My arm and chest, even my face.

entries.japanese:
「はは――――――」
　そういう、コトだったんだ。
　エレベーターの前で、下の階からの物音が途絶えた時に気がつくべきだった。
　つまり、あの時。
　もう、生きている者は誰もいなかったということを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha—hah.”
So that was it.
I should have understood when the sounds from the lower floors fell silent while I stood before the elevator.
In other words, by then.
There had already been no one left alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha------"
So that's how it was.
I should have realized it when I was in front of the elevator, the moment the noises from downstairs ceased.
At that point,
there was no longer anyone else still alive.

entries.japanese:
「はは―――――は」
　それは、なんだ。
　今のはナンだったんだ。
　一面の血の海。
　下の階がああなっていたのなら、他の階はどうなってしまったのか。
　あの殺戮はなんだ。
　あの地獄はなんだ。
　これも――――あれもこれもそれも、ぜんぶアルクェイドのいう『敵』ってヤツの仕業だっていうのか―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha—ha—hah.”
What was that?
What in God’s name did I just see?
An ocean of blood.
If the floor below ended that way, what happened to all the others?
What was that slaughter?
What was that hell?
Was all of it—every last piece—the work of the thing Arcueid called her enemy?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha-----ha."
What was that?
What was that just now?
A sea of blood.
If the floor below this one was like that, what were the other floors like?
What was that scene of carnage?
What was that scene of hell?
This---and that and this and that… all of it has been the work of the "enemy" Arcueid was talking about-----!?

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　ぎり、と歯を鳴らす。
　このまま砕きそうなぐらい、歯と歯をかみ締める。
　まだ体は震えている。
　まだ意識は麻痺している。
　けど、それ以上に―――俺は、あの光景が認められない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
My teeth grind.
I clench them hard enough to shatter.
My body is still trembling.
My mind is still numb.
But more than either of those things, I cannot accept what I saw.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
My teeth grind together.
They clench together so tightly it feels like they're going to shatter.
My body is still trembling.
My consciousness is still numb.
But more than all of that---I can't accept that spectacle.

entries.japanese:
さっきのはなんだ。
　ようするにアレか。
あんなワケのわからない動物たちに、下の階に泊まっていた人間はみんな食い殺されたのか。
　食い殺されたのか。
　問答無用に、およそ一方的に、逃げる事も助けを呼ぶ事もできず、無意味に殺されたっていうのか……！
entries.maoEnglish:
What was that?
Is that it? Did those incomprehensible animals devour every person staying on the floor below?
Devour them?
Without warning, without mercy, overwhelmingly—killed for nothing before they could flee or even call for help?
entries.mirrorMoon:
What was that just then?
What, all those incomprehensible animals devoured all the guests staying on the lower floors?
Had they all been killed and eaten?
One-sidedly, pointlessly killed without a chance to argue, escape, or even call for help…!?

entries.japanese:
「ふざけ―――」
　ふざけ、やがって。
　ナイフを強く握り締める。
　と。
　チーン、と陽気な電子音をあげて、十階に止まったままだったエレベーターが上がってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve got to be—”
Fucking kidding me.
I tighten my grip on the knife.
Then.
With a bright electronic chime, the elevator that had remained on the tenth floor rises to meet me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You've got to be kiddi--"
You've gotta to be kidding me.
I clench the knife tightly.
And then.
With a cheerful electronic "ding!", the elevator which stopped on the tenth floor reaches this one.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　もう、十メートルは離れてしまったエレベーターへ振りかえる。
　ドアが開く。
　そこには―――二匹の黒い犬が、いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I turn toward the elevator, already ten meters behind me.
The doors open.
Inside stand two black dogs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I turn back to face the elevator, now about ten meters down the hall.
The door opens.
Within---are two black dogs.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……そうか。
俺を、追いかけてきたのか、おまえら。
「―――――は」
　ナイフを両手で握る。
　黒犬がエレベーターから飛び出してくる。
　二匹の黒犬は走りはじめた。
　当然、最後の獲物である俺に向かって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I see. So you followed me, did you?
“Hah.”
I clasp the knife in both hands.
The black dogs spring from the elevator.
The two black dogs break into a run.
Naturally, they charge toward me, their final prey.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… I see.
You guys came after me.
"-----Ha."
I grip the knife with both hands.
The black dogs burst out from the elevator.
They break into a run.
Of course, toward me, the last prey.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――！」
　黒犬が向かってくる。
　その体には無数の線と、その額には死の点が視えている。
――――ためらわずに。
　まず、俺に跳びかかってきた一匹目の額を突き刺した。
　断末魔もあげずに黒犬は床に落ちる。
　どろり、と黒い液体になって溶けていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah!”
A black dog charged.
Countless lines covered its body, and on its forehead I could see a point of death.
――――Without hesitation.
I drive the knife into the forehead of the first dog as it leaps.
It hits the floor without even a death cry.
Then it melts into a thick black liquid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha-----!"
The black dogs are coming for me.
On their bodies, I can see an infinite number of lines, and on their foreheads, the point of death.
----Without hesitating.
First, I stab the dog that leaps at me in the forehead.
The black dog falls to the floor without even giving a scream.
It melts into a black liquid.

entries.japanese:
そのあと。
　もう一匹の黒犬が、跳ねてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then.
The second black dog launches itself at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After that,
the other black dog bounds towards me.

entries.japanese:
黒犬が跳ねる。
　カレらの速さは人間の比ではない。
　十メートル程度の廊下なんて、それこそ二秒とかからなかった。
「く――――！」
　ナイフを構えなおすけど、間に合わない。
　黒犬の口が開く。
　俺が持っているナイフなんかより何倍も鋭い牙をそろえた口が、的確にこちらの喉元へと向かってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
The black dog springs.
They are incomparably faster than any human.
It covers the ten-meter corridor in less than two seconds.
“Kh—!”
I try to reset my guard, but I am too late.
The dog’s jaws open.
A mouth lined with fangs many times sharper than my knife bears down unerringly upon my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It leaps.
Its speed belies all human comparison.
It don't even take two seconds to cover the ten meters down the hallway.

"Kuh----!"
I line up the knife again, but not quickly enough.
The black dog opens his mouth.
That mouth is filled with fangs so many times sharper than the knife I have, and they are aimed straight at my throat.

entries.japanese:
確実かつ迅速。
　カレらが迫ってくる、と認識できた瞬間。
　黒犬の牙は、ガギリ、と音をたてて俺の喉に食いついた。
　遠野志貴は、死んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Certain.
Swift.
In the same instant I understand that it has reached me, its fangs clamp onto my throat with a splintering crunch.
Shiki Tohno died.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Accurate, and fast.
The instant I realize they are drawing upon me,
the fangs bite into my throat with a crunch.
I die.

entries.japanese:
それは間違っている。
　こんなコトぐらいでは殺されないし、死んでもやらない。
　オレは、この程度の惨劇じゃためらわない。
entries.maoEnglish:
That is wrong.
Something this trivial cannot kill me; I refuse to die.
I would not flinch at a little carnage like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But that's not right.
I can't be killed by something like this and I refuse to die.
This tragedy would not cause me to hesitate.

entries.japanese:
――――夏の、暑い日。
　ずっと昔、それとも八年も前の昔。
　オレは、もっとひどいコトを、目の当たりにしていたはずじゃないか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A hot summer day.
Long ago—or was eight years ago really so long?
I had witnessed something far worse than this—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----A hot summer's day.
It happened long ago, eight years ago.
I've seen something even more terrible----

entries.japanese:
ざく。
　首筋に噛みついた黒犬の額に、ナイフを突きたてた。
　黒犬が首に噛みついて、そのまま噛み切ろうとするよりわずかだけ先に、腕が動いてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The blade struck home.
I drive the knife into the forehead of the black dog clamped onto my neck.
My arm moves a fraction of a second before its jaws can bite through my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thrust.
I thrust my knife into the forehead of the black dog biting into my neck.
My arm moved just before the black dog ripped through my throat.

entries.japanese:
自分でもほれぼれする。
　まるでモノを斬る機能しかない機械みたいに、無駄なく目の前にある犬の眉間にナイフを刺した。
　そこが黒犬の『点』だったからだ。
　普通、脳が破損しても筋肉というものは脳の下した命令を実行しようとする。
　頭を貫いたところで、黒犬の口は俺の首を噛みきるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even I have to admire it.
I drove the knife into the dog’s brow without a wasted motion, like a machine built for nothing but cutting things down.
Because that was the black dog’s “point.”
Ordinarily, even with the brain destroyed, the muscles try to carry out its last command.
A blade through the skull would not stop those jaws from tearing out my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It was done rather perfectly, even for myself.
Like a machine whose sole function is to cut, I plunged the knife into the dog's forehead without any useless or wasted movement.
Because that is where the first dog's "point" was.
Normally, even if the brain is destroyed, the muscles try to execute the commands they have received from the brain.
The black dog would have probably ripped through my throat even if I had simply pierced its head.

entries.japanese: ああ、まあ―――その、普通なら。
entries.maoEnglish: Well—yes, normally.
entries.mirrorMoon: Well--normally, that would happen.

entries.japanese:
だが、黒犬は『死』んでいる。
　死は停止だ。
こいつは俺に殺された時点で、あらゆる効力を失った。
　二匹目の黒犬も床に落ちる。
　どろり、とそのまま黒い染みになって、ホテルの廊下を黒く染めていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
But the black dog is dead.
Death means stopping. From the instant I killed it, everything in it stopped.
The second black dog drops to the floor.
It collapses into a viscous black stain, darkness spreading across the hotel corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But the black dog is "dead".
Death is a complete stoppage.
At the point when I killed it, it lost every form of validity.

The second black dog also collapses onto the floor.
It becomes a black stain on the hotel's hallway.

entries.japanese:
「は―――あ」
　疲れた。
　ドン、と壁に背中を預けて、天井を見上げた。
―――あたまが、いたい。
　世界はツギハギだらけになって、そこかしこに黒い死の点も視えてしまって。
　体中は冷え切っているのに、ただ理性だけが熱病にうなされている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I am exhausted.
I slump back against the wall and stare up at the ceiling.
―――My head hurts.
The world has come apart at the seams, black points of death showing everywhere.
My whole body is ice-cold, while reason alone burns in a fever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--ah."
I'm tired.
With a thump, I lean my back against the wall and look up at the ceiling.
---My head… hurts.
The world becomes a patchwork, and here and there, I can see the black points of Death.
My body is freezing, but my mind is burning feverishly.

entries.japanese:
「―――く」
　すぐ近くには二匹の黒犬の死体。
　自分の片腕は血にまみれていて、もう片腕には赤いナイフ。
　……ついでに言うのなら、床の下の階層には数え切れないほどの人の死体。
「――――は、はは、ははは」
　笑うしかない。
　だって、こんなのは現実じゃない。
　こんなのが現実であるはずがない。
　俺はいつから、瞳をあけたままで、悪い夢なんかを観てしまっているんだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
The corpses of two black dogs lie beside me.
One of my arms is drenched in blood; the other holds a red knife.
And, while I am taking inventory, the floors beneath me hold more human corpses than I can count.
“Hahahahaha.”
There was nothing to do but laugh.
This wasn’t reality.
Nothing like this could possibly be real.
How long had I been dreaming this nightmare with my eyes wide open?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Kuh!"
Right beside me lie the corpses of the two black dogs.
One of my arms is covered in blood, the other clutches a red knife.
…… Also, there are a quite uncountable number of dead bodies downstairs.
"----Ha, haha, hahaha."
All I can do is laugh.
Because this isn't real.
There's no way this can be real.
At what point did I, with my eyes wide open, start seeing a nightmare----?

entries.japanese:
キンコーン。
「え――――？」
　ひどく場違いな明るい音がした。
「……くそ、なんだこの頭痛―――」
　刃物で突き刺されるような頭痛を堪えながら、物音がした方に向く。
「エレ……ベーター……？」
　今のはもう一つのエレベーターが上がってきた音らしい。
　扉が開く。
　その中には、黒いコートを着た男が一人。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ding.
“Huh…?”
A bright chime rings out, grotesquely out of place.
“Damn it, what is this headache?”
Fighting pain like a blade driven into my skull, I turn toward the sound.
“The ele—vator?”
Apparently the other elevator has just arrived.
The doors open.
Inside stands a single man in a black coat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ding dong.
"Eh--?"
A terribly out-of-place cheerful sound rings out.
"Damn it, what's with this headache--?"
I stand up, enduring the pain in my head and look toward the sound.
"Ele… vator…?"
It seems the sound is the other elevator coming up.

The door opens.
Inside stands a man wearing a black coat.

entries.japanese:
頭痛が、一段と強くなる。
「あいつ――――」
　そう、見たことがある。
　たしかに、自分はあの男を見たコトがあったはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The pain in my head surges.
“That man—”
Yes, I have seen him before.
I am certain of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The headache worsens.
"He's--"
Yes, I've seen him before.
I'm sure I've seen that man before.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　男は無言で向かってくる。
「おまえ―――！」
　ナイフを構えて男を睨んだ。
「―――――――」
　けれど、男はまったく反応しないで歩いてくる。
　こちらのことなど、まるっきり眼中にないというふうに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Without a word, the man comes toward me.
“You…!”
I raise the knife and glare at him.
“…”
He gives no reaction at all.
He simply keeps walking, as though I do not exist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Silently, he walks towards me.
"You--!"
I ready my knife as I glare at him.
"-------"
But he doesn't react at all as he walks towards me.
It's as if he doesn't notice me at all.

entries.japanese:
距離が迫る。
　あと少し―――ほんのあと一メートル、というところまで近づいて、ようやく男はこちらに気がついたようだった。
　その、血走った目。
　人間の持つ目とは隔絶したその目を見た瞬間、体の自由は、まるっきりきかなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The distance narrows.
He comes within a single meter before he finally seems to notice me.
Those bloodshot eyes.
The instant I meet that gaze—something wholly removed from the eyes of a human being—my body ceases to obey me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The distance between us shrinks.
Just a little more---when there is barely one meter between us, the man finally seem to notice me.
Those bloodshot eyes.
The instant I see those eyes which no human should possess, I lose all freedom to move my body.

entries.japanese:
「皆殺しにしたはずだが、まだ残っていたか」
　男はぐるり、と廊下に転がる二匹の黒犬の死体を見た。
「――塵どもめ。
肉片ひとつ片づけられぬのでは、我が肉体である資格はない」
　不快げに呟いて、男はざあ、と片腕をあげた。
　コートがマントのように持ちあがる。
―――どうかしてる。
　黒い犬たちは、びゅるん、と音をたてて、男のコートの中に消えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I thought they had all been killed, but was one left?”
The man sweeps his gaze across the two black dogs lying in the corridor.
“Filth. If you cannot dispose of a single scrap of meat, you are unfit to be my flesh.”
He muttered in distaste and raised one arm.
His coat lifted like a great black cape.
―――This is insane.
With a wet, whipping sound, the black dogs vanish into the man’s coat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I thought I killed everyone, but it seems like there's still someone left."
The man turns and looks at the corpses of the two black dogs.
"--You pieces of filth.
If you can't even take care of a scrap of meat, you're unworthy to be a part of my body."
The man voices his displeasure as he raises his hand.
His coat lifts like a mantle.
---Something's odd.
With a splash, the black dogs' remains liquify and disappear into the man's coat.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　叫び声さえ、あげられない。
　男のコートの下は真っ黒で、輪郭というものしか存在しなかった。
　そこにあるのは、ただ、泥のような闇だった。
「やば―――――――」
　やばい。
　ともかく、コイツはやばすぎる――――
　そう本能が危険信号をかき鳴らしているっていうのに、指先一つまともには動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
I cannot even scream.
Beneath the man's coat is pure black, a shape with nothing inside it.
Only darkness, thick as mud.
“This is ba—”
This is bad.
No—this thing is far too dangerous—
Every instinct I possess is shrieking a warning, yet I cannot move so much as a fingertip.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
I can't even scream.
Below the man's coat is pure darkness, without even the traces of an outline.
All that exists there is a mud-like darkness.
"Th----"
This is dangerous.
This guy is just too dangerous----
My instincts sound the alarm wildly in my head, but I can't even lift a finger.

entries.japanese:
黒いコートは近づいてくる。
「――――――！」
　このまま、ここにいては、やばい。
　さっきから止まない頭痛が、耐えきれないぐらい強くなって、ここが危険だと訴えつづける。
　どんな手段、どんな方法を用いても、すぐさまここから離れなくては命が亡いと。
―――――だが、とうに遅い。
　目の前には男がいる。
　その瞳はまったくこちらを見ていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The black coat drew nearer.
“—!”
I couldn’t remain here.
The unrelenting headache swelled beyond endurance.
It screamed that this place meant death—that by any means, at any cost, I had to get away at once.
―――――But it was already too late.
The man stood before me.
His eyes were not on me at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The man in the black coat approaches me.
"------!"
It's not good if I just stay here.
The unstopping headache grows to an unbearable level, telling me this place is dangerous.
Whatever the means, if I don't get out of here soon, I am going to lose my life.
----But it's too late.
The man is right before me.
Those eyes aren't looking at me at all.

entries.japanese:
「食え」
　スラリ、とコートの片腕があがる。
　その下の混沌とした闇。
　そこから、何か巨大なモノが現れた。
　ごう、と。
　二つの風切り音が閉じられる。
　男のコートの下から現れたソレは、人間を軽く丸呑みできそうなワニの口だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Devour.”
One arm of the coat rises with elegant ease.
Beneath it lies churning, chaotic darkness.
Something enormous emerges from within.
With a roar.
Two currents of rushing air snap shut.
What emerges beneath the man's coat is the maw of a crocodile large enough to swallow a human whole.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Feed."
He raises one of his arms.
Below it lies a chaotic darkness.
From there, something huge appears.
Whomp.
The sound of wind.
That which has appeared from below the man's coat is a crocodile's mouth, easily large enough to swallow a man whole.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――」
―――思考が、バーストした。
　とっさにワニの口めがけてナイフを振り下ろす。
　けれどそんなモノに何の効果もない。
　ぞぶり、という音。
「っ――――――！！！！！！！！！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
―――Thought itself bursts.
I bring the knife down at the crocodile’s maw by reflex.
It does nothing.
A wet crunch.
“———!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
---My consciousness bursts.
In panic, I slash at the crocodile's mouth.
But it's a futile act.
There is a squishing sound.
"-------!!!!!!!!!!"

entries.japanese:
床に倒れた。
「はっ―――はっ――――はっ」
　喉が壊れた。
　呼吸というより、吐血。
　心臓というポンプが、喉から、自分自身の血を吐き出させている。
「が――――あ、ああ、あ」
　思考／が割れる。
　痛みで　意思が　分断され／てる。
　見れば。
　俺の腹は、右半分が、まるっきり存在していなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I collapse to the floor.
“Hah—hah—hah.”
My throat is ruined.
It is not breathing but coughing blood.
The pump of my heart forces my own blood out through my throat.
“Ghh—aa, ah.”
My thoughts / are splitting.
Pain is chopping my will / apart.
I look.
The entire right half of my abdomen is gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fall onto the floor.
"Haa----hahhh-----hhhaaghh."
My throat is broken.
I'm not breathing, I'm throwing up blood.
Blood sprays from my throat in time with the beating of my heart.
"Gah--ah, aaah, aaah."
My consciousness/ is splitting.
The pain is   obliterating    my thou/ghts.
Looking,
I see that the right side of my stomach is basically nonexistent.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴！？」
　……声が、聞こえる。
　でも、あんまりよく聞こえない。
「貴様の番犬にしては不出来だな、ソレは」
　……男の声。
「―――信じられない。
混沌とも名づけられた吸血種が、こんなくだらないゲームにのってくるなんて。
なんだか出来の悪い夢みたいだわ、ネロ・カオス」
　……アルクェイドの声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!?”
I can hear a voice.
But not very clearly.
“A sorry watchdog, if that thing is yours.”
It is a man's voice.
“I can't believe it. A vampiric creature whose very name is Chaos, playing along with this pathetic little game. It feels like some third-rate nightmare, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
It is Arcueid's voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Shiki!?"
…… I can hear a voice.
But I can't hear it very well.
"Not very impressive for a guard dog of yours."
…… The man's voice.
"---I can't believe a vampire named Chaos would play such trivial games.
It's like a poorly-scripted nightmare, Nrvnqsr Chaos."
…… Arcueid's voice.

entries.japanese:
「同感だな。
私も、真祖の生き残りを捕らえるなど、そのような無謀な祭りの執行者にしたてあげられるとは夢にも思わなかった。
　私にとっても、これは悪夢だ」
　……男の、低い、声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The feeling is mutual. Never did I dream I would be made to officiate so foolhardy a spectacle as the capture of a surviving True Ancestor.
This is a nightmare for me as well.”
It is the man's low voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I feel the same way.
To catch one of the surviving True Ancestors… I never dreamed I would be a part of such a foolish festival.
This is a nightmare for me, too."
…… The man's.
deep.
voice.

entries.japanese:
「……しかし、これはどういう事だ？
　私の前の執行者は貴様に傷一つ付けられなかったという話だが、それはどのような間違いなのだ。
　今の貴様の存在規模は脆弱すぎる。
　一介の亡者にも劣るその衰退―――私が来る前に教会の者たちにでも襲われたか、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド」
　……アルクェイドの声は、聞こえない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“But what is this?
I was told my predecessor could not put so much as a scratch on you; what error accounts for the difference?
The scale of your existence is pitiful now.
You have fallen beneath even a common revenant; were you attacked by agents of the Church before I arrived, Arcueid Brunestud?”
I cannot hear Arcueid's voice—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But what is the meaning of this?
I have heard that the previous executor could not even scratch you.
What kind of a mistake is this?
Right now, your presence is exceedingly weak.
