Into the place where I had once been so badly hurt.
A place that hurt and terrified me, a place I hated without end.
―――That summer day, eight years ago.
Yes, I had hated it with everything I was.
Hated it so completely there had been no room left for trivial things like fear or pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah----"
Something like claws digs into my chest.
It's where the scar from my old wound is.
A really painful, frightening, only hateful place.
----Eight years ago----that summer day.
Yeah, it really was hateful.
There wasn't any room for pain or fear.

entries.japanese:
そうだ。
俺は、ただ、ひたすらに憎かった。
　ならばやる事は決まっている。
―――オマエが、オレを、殺すというのなら。
　全身はとうに麻痺している。
　残ったものは、未だナイフを離さない右手の感触だけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
That’s right. All I felt was hatred.
Which meant there was only one thing to do.
―――If you mean to kill me.
My body had long since gone numb.
All that remained was the sensation in my right hand, still refusing to release the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes.
I just… hated.
Then what is to be done is already decided.
----If you are going to kill me, then…
My whole body is already numb.
All that remains is the sensation of the knife I refused to drop in my right hand.

entries.japanese:
殺される―――殺される？
　誰が。
　何に？
entries.maoEnglish:
I’m going to be killed—Killed?
Who?
By what?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Be killed----be killed?
Who?
By what?

entries.japanese:
「はは、は―――――――」
　笑いが零れる。
　ああ、たしかにその通りだ。
　絶対に逃げられない。
　絶対に逃がさない。
　やるべき事は、ただひとつだけなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haha, ha―――――――”
The laughter slipped out.
Yes, that was exactly right.
There was no escape for me.
And I would never let him escape.
There was only one thing left to do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha, ha----------"
I laugh out.
Right, that's exactly how it is.
Running away is absolutely impossible.
Escape is absolutely impossible.
There's only one thing to be done.

entries.japanese:
殺される。
　殺される。
　きっと、間違いなく殺される。
　他の何にでもなく、
　他の誰にでもなく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Going to be killed.
Going to be killed.
Without question, I was going to be killed.
By nothing else,
by no one else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Be killed.
Be killed.
Definitely, without a doubt, be killed.
By nothing else,
and by no one else.

entries.japanese: ――――――ヤツは、この俺に、殺される。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――He will be killed by me.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------He will be killed by me.

entries.japanese:
「あははははははははは！」
　裂帛の気合のかわりに、白痴のごとき笑い声をあげた。
　おかしい。
　おかしくて、笑いがとまらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahahahahahahaha!”
Instead of a warrior’s cry, I let out the mindless laughter of an idiot.
It was funny.
So funny I couldn’t stop laughing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahahahahahahahahaha!"
In place of a yell, I start to laugh like an idiot.
Strange.
Strangely, I can't stop laughing.

entries.japanese:
ザンザンザンザンザン、と音をたててケモノたちは次々と死んでいく。
　脳髄が痛い。
　体じゅうの神経血管細胞血液、全てがどうかしちまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Slash, slash, slash, slash, slash—the beasts die one after another.
My brain is in agony.
Every nerve, every vein, every cell, every drop of blood in my body has gone wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slice.
Slice.
Slice.
Slice.
Slice.
With each sound, another beast dies.
My brain is in agony.
All throughout my body: my nerves, my blood vessels, my cells, my blood; everything has gone abnormal.

entries.japanese:
―――黒いドームはなくなった。
　この身をついばんでいた雑種どものうち七十匹ばかりを、とりあえずブチ殺した。
「な―――――に？」
　ネロの声が聞こえる。
　さあ―――立ちあがらないと、これ以上は殺せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The black dome was gone.
Of the mongrels pecking at this body, I had slaughtered seventy or so—for now.
“Wha—at?”
I hear Nrvnqsr’s voice.
Now—if I don’t stand, I won’t be able to kill any more of them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The black dome disappears.
I just killed about seventy beasts which were eating my body.
"Wh----at?"
I can hear Nrvnqsr's voice.
Alright----I have to stand, or I won't be able to kill any more.

entries.japanese:
立ちあがる。
「――――」
　問題ない。
　傷ついていない個所なんてないけれど、とりあえずこれならしばらくは動き回れる。
「貴様―――なにを」
「―――ああ、おまえの気持ちはよくわかったよ、吸血鬼」
entries.maoEnglish:
I stand.
“…”
No problem.
There isn’t a single uninjured place on my body, but I should still be able to move for a while.
“You—what have you done?”
“Ah—I understand exactly how you feel now, vampire.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I stand up.
"----"
There's no problem.
There's not a single place where I'm not wounded, but I can still move around for a while.
"What----did you--"
"----Yeah, I understand how you feel, vampire."

entries.japanese:
脳髄には火の感触。
　似てる―――アルクェイドを殺した時と同じで、まともに呼吸ができやしない。
　イッちまいそうなほどの頭痛と熱と引き換えに、
　吐き気がするほど、
　セカイに死が満ちている―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
My brain feels on fire.
It’s like when I killed Arcueid—I can’t even breathe properly.
In exchange for a headache and heat fierce enough to make me come,
with sickening clarity,
death floods the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My brain is on fire.
It's similar----just like when I killed Arcueid, I can't even breathe properly.
Along with the headache and heat which almost drives me insane,
almost enough to make me puke,
the world is saturated with death----

entries.japanese: 「俺を殺したいんだな、化け物」
entries.maoEnglish: “You want to kill me, don’t you, monster?”
entries.mirrorMoon: "So you want to kill me, monster?"

entries.japanese: なら、俺たちは似たもの同士だ。
entries.maoEnglish: Then we’re exactly alike.
entries.mirrorMoon: Then, we have something in common.

entries.japanese:
「いいだろう。
―――殺しあおうぜ、ネロ・カオス……！」
　あれだけ硬かった右手が自由に動く。
　くるん、とナイフをまわして逆手に構えて、ネロに向かって走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. Let’s kill each other, Nrvnqsr Chaos…!”
The right hand that had been locked so rigid moves freely.
I twirl the knife, reverse it into an underhand grip, and charge Nrvnqsr.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine.
----Let's fight to the death, Nrvnqsr Chaos……!"
With that, my stiff right hand moves freely.
Switching to a reverse grip on my knife, I run towards Nrvnqsr.

entries.japanese:
ネロの体から、一際大きいケモノが現れる。
　ようやくアルクェイドに出していた大物を出してきてくれたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
An especially large beast emerges from Nrvnqsr’s body.
At last, he has brought out one of the monsters he used against Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A bigger beast appears from his body.
Finally, he's letting out the big stuff he used for Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　だが、あまり長くは保たなかった。
　どんなに巨大で迅速で強暴でも、連中は基本的に直接触れなければ俺を殺せない。
　直接こちらに触れようとするのなら。
　その触れようとする部分を切断する。
　結局は、黒犬もライオンもトラもあまり変わらなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
It didn’t last long.
However huge, fast, or savage they might be.
The beasts can’t kill me without touching me.
And if they reach out to touch me, I cut away whatever reaches.
In the end, the black dog, the lion, and the tiger are all much the same.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
But, they don't last long.

No matter how large, fast or brutal they are, they basically cannot kill me unless they touch me.
If they try to touch me,
I slice whatever part tries.
In the end, it made no difference whether it was a black dog, a lion or a tiger.

entries.japanese:
二匹の大物が倒れて、黒い水に変わっていく。
　ネロまでは――まだいくらか距離が開いているか。
「―――馬鹿な。
姫君でさえ消滅させられなかった私たちが―――ことごとく、無に帰している」
　なにか、言ってる。
「―――不理解だ。
貴様、何をした」
　ネロの体を凝視する。
entries.maoEnglish:
The two great beasts collapse and dissolve into black water.
Nrvnqsr is still some distance away.
“Impossible. Even the princess could not annihilate us—yet every one of us is being reduced to nothing.”
He’s saying something.
“I do not understand. What have you done?”
I stare into Nrvnqsr’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Two of the large ones collapse and change into black water.
To get to Nrvnqsr--there's still some distance left to close.
"----How can this be?
Those of us even the princess could not eliminate----are returning to nothingness."
He's… saying something.
"----I do not understand.
What did you do?"
I fix my gaze on Nrvnqsr's body.

entries.japanese:
何十という無数の点。
　―――生き残りたいのなら。
　アイツを殺したいのなら、アレを、全て殺さなければいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Countless points—dozens upon dozens.
―――If I want to survive.
If I want to kill him, I have to kill every last one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Countless points.
----If I want to live.
If I want to kill him, I have to kill each and every one of them.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　流石にそれは不可能だろう。
　それでも―――このままじゃ終われない。
　黒い粘液に飲まれたアルクェイド。
　殺されてしまった何百という人たち。
―――そして、殺されかけたこの体。
「……………！」
　ギリ、と歯を噛んだ。
　恨み言を口にする余裕はない。
　あいにく動くだけで精一杯なんだ。
ネロの口上に付き合っている余裕はない。

―――否
　そんな余裕があるのなら、一秒でも早く―――
「―――よかろう。
おまえを、我が障害と認識する」

―――このケモノ臭い化け物の息の根を止めたほうが、幾分はましだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
That is surely impossible.
Even so—I can’t let it end here.
Arcueid, swallowed by the black slime.
The hundreds of people he killed.
―――And this body, nearly killed along with them.
“…!”
My teeth grind together.
I don’t have breath to spare on curses.
Unfortunately, moving at all is taking everything I have. I can’t waste time listening to Nrvnqsr’s speeches.
―――No
If I had breath to spare, I would rather use it to―――
“—Very well. I acknowledge you as an obstacle.”
―――stop this monster reeking of beasts from drawing another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
It's probably not possible.
Still----I can't finish like this.
Arcueid, who was swallowed by the black liquid.
All of those hundreds of people that were killed.
----And, this body being almost killed.
"………………!"
I grit my teeth.
There's no time to speak words of hatred.

Unfortunately, moving takes all of my power.
I don't have any extra energy to answer Nrvnqsr.

----No.
If I do have that sort of energy, as quickly as possible----
"----Very well.
I now recognize you as an obstacle to me."

entries.japanese:
ごっ、と黒いコートが大きくはだけた。
　品のないケモノの臭い。
　危機感は、今までの比ではない。
　コートの中から、どこか、子供のころに一度は見た覚えがあるようなケモノが飛び出してくる。
　額に角のある馬だの、翼の生えた大きなトカゲだの。
　それらは、たしかに厄介だった。
　とても簡単には殺せない。
　なにしろ『死に易い部分』がとても少ない。
　だから―――よけい、真剣になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a heavy rush, the black coat flares wide.
A rank, bestial stench rolls out.
The danger is beyond anything I have felt until now.
Beasts burst from the coat, creatures I seem to remember seeing once in childhood.
A horse with a horn in its brow, a huge lizard with wings.
They are troublesome, certainly.
They won’t die easily.
There are too few places on them where death comes readily.
And so—I grow all the more intent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----killing this beast-smelling monster would be far better.

His black coat opens wide.
The vile stench of beasts.
The sense of danger before was nothing compared to what it is now.
From inside his coat, things come out which I've seen at least once when I was a child.
Like this horse with a horn on its forehead, or this huge, winged lizard.
Those are troublesome.
It's not simple to kill them,
because they have very few "parts vulnerable to death".
So---I get more serious.

entries.japanese:
殺す、と言葉にしたせいだろうか。
　血の流れが痛い。
　神経がグラインドする。
　体中のあらゆるものが、あの障害を排除するために連結していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps it was speaking the word kill aloud.
The blood moving through me hurts.
My nerves grind against themselves.
Everything in my body begins linking together for the sole purpose of eliminating that obstacle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Is it because I said "kill"?
The pulsing of my blood is painful.
My nerves are grinding together.
Everything in my body links together to remove that which gets in my way.

entries.japanese:
角の生えた馬は、その角ごと、真っ二つにした。
　トカゲは、背中から右下腹部にかけて切り取った。
「――――あり得ん」
　障害の声が聞こえる。
　あいにく、こっちはもうまともに視界が働かない。
　視えているのは、ただ黒い点と線だけ。
「おのれ―――なぜ私が、たかだか人間風情に渾身でかからねばならぬのだ―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I split the horned horse in two, horn and all.
I cut through the lizard from its back to the lower right side of its belly.
“—Impossible.”
The obstacle’s voice reaches me.
My vision no longer works properly.
All I can see are black points and lines.
“Damn you—why must I exert my full strength against a mere human?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I slice in half the horned horse along with its horn.
I slice the lizard from its back to its lower-right abdomen.
"----Impossible."
I hear that obstacle's voice.
Unfortunately, I can't even see properly now.
All I can see are those black points and lines.
"Scum----why must I attack a mere human with my full force----!?"

entries.japanese:
びゅるん、という音。
　半分しかなかったネロの体が、ヒトとしての完全な形に戻る。
―――ようやくアルクェイドを捕まえていた半身を、自分の体に戻したらしい。
「―――殺す。
我が内なる系統樹には、貴様らの域を凌駕する生命が有ると知れ―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet, whipping sound.
Nrvnqsr’s half-formed body becomes fully human again.
―――At last, he seems to have reclaimed the half that had been holding Arcueid captive.
“—I will kill you. Know this: the phylogenetic tree within me holds life-forms beyond the limits of your kind—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
With a squishy, fleshy sound,
Nrvnqsr's half-body returns to its previous human shape.
----It seems he finally put back the half of his body binding Arcueid.
"----I will kill you.
You will find out that existence far superior to yours exists within me----"

entries.japanese:
ネロの両腕が、自らの胸を掻きむしる。
　闇を裂くように。
　ヤツは、自分の胸を自らの腕で裂いた。
　ネロの胸に空いた穴から。
　何か、奇怪なモノが這い出てくる―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Nrvnqsr’s hands claw at his own chest.
As though tearing open the darkness itself.
He rips his chest apart.
From the hole in Nrvnqsr’s chest.
Something grotesque begins to crawl―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
His arms tear into his own chest.
As if ripping apart darkness,
he rips into his own chest.
From the hole in Nrvnqsr,
something bizarre emerges----

entries.japanese:
一言で表現するなら、蟹のような蜘蛛。
　大きさ的には、アルクェイドが仕留めた巨象よりやや大きめ。
「―――――」
　視界が赤くてよく見えない。
ただ、奇怪なシルエットと『死』だけがみえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
In a word, it is a crablike spider.
It is somewhat larger than the giant elephant Arcueid killed.
“…”
My vision is too red to make it out clearly. I can see only its grotesque silhouette—and its death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I have to describe it simply, it's a crab-like spider.
A bit bigger than the giant elephant which Arcueid killed.
"------"
My vision has gone red; I can't see very well.
All I can see are their bizarre silhouettes and their "death".

entries.japanese:
指先が冷たい。
　血を流しすぎたのか、体中が冷えきっている。
　それでも―――まだ体は悲鳴をあげてない。
　そんな余力があるのなら、一秒でも早くアイツを殺せと命令してくる。
―――背骨がいたい。
　　　体がさむい。
　　　指先が凍てついていく。
　　　なのに、脳髄だけが火のように熱く。
entries.maoEnglish:
My fingertips are cold.
I must have lost too much blood; the chill has soaked through my whole body.
Yet my body still refuses to scream.
If it has strength left for that, it orders me to use it to kill him one second sooner.
―――My spine hurts.
My body is cold.
My fingertips are freezing.
And still my brain alone burns like fire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My fingers are cold.
Maybe I've lost too much blood.
My whole body is frigid.
But still----my body isn't screaming.
It orders me forward, saying that if I have enough strength to scream, use that energy to kill Nrvnqsr even faster.
----My spine hurts.
My body is cold.
My fingers are frozen.
Yet, my brain burns with fire.

entries.japanese:
蜘蛛とも蟹とも取れないケモノは次々とネロの体から這い出てくる。
　ネロまではあともう少し。
　ヤツの近づくためには、この生き物たちは邪魔だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
More beasts, neither quite spider nor crab, crawl from Nrvnqsr’s body.
I’m almost close enough to reach him.
These creatures are in my way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
These crab-spider beasts keep crawling out from Nrvnqsr.
Nrvnqsr is only a little bit away.
These things are in the way of me getting to him.

entries.japanese:
とりあえず三匹。
　出てきた分の邪魔者は、ことごとく殺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Three of them, for now.
I kill every obstacle that has emerged.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For now, these three.
I completely kill those emerged obstacles.

entries.japanese:
「――――有り得ん」
　ネロは眩暈でもおこしたように、よろりと後ずさる。
「―――私のあらゆる殺害方法が殺されるなど、そのような事実が有り得るはずがない……！
　私たちは不死身だ。
　私が存命しているかぎり死しても混沌となりて我に戻り転輪す不死のケモノたちが―――なぜ、貴様に刺されただけで、元の無に戻ってしまうのだ―――！」
　叫んでいる敵に歩み寄る。
　ネロは後ろに引こうとして、かろうじて、後退することを押しとめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Impossible.”
Nrvnqsr staggers backward as if overcome by vertigo.
“It cannot be—every means by which I kill, itself killed…!
We are immortal.
So long as I live, my undying beasts return to chaos when slain, flow back into me, and turn upon the wheel once more—so why does a mere wound from you return them to the nothing from which they came?!”
I walk toward the shouting enemy.
Nrvnqsr starts to shrink away, then barely manages to arrest his retreat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Impossible."
As if dizzy, Nrvnqsr moves back.
"----There is no way someone can destroy all my killing beasts.
Such a fact is impossible……!
We are immortal.
As long as I live, the immortal beasts return to chaos and are reborn----so then, why do they return to the original nothingness after only being stabbed by you----!?"
I walk towards my screaming enemy.
Nrvnqsr tries to pull back in retreat, but stops himself.

entries.japanese:
「―――無様」
　機械のようだった目に、赤い憎しみの感情が、ようやく燈った。
　ヤツのココロは理解できる。
―――おそらく。
　殺人鬼としてのネロは己に撤退を命じている。
　しかし吸血鬼としてのヤツは、自らがただの人間に敗退することを認めない。
　理解しない。
　撤退することさえ許さない。
　だから、それ以上後退することを可能としない。
　その精神、自身が無力だと悟るも認めぬ頑なさ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Pathetic.”
At last, red hatred kindles in eyes that had been as lifeless as a machine’s.
I understand what is happening inside him.
―――Probably.
The killer in Nrvnqsr orders him to retreat.
The vampire in him refuses to accept defeat at the hands of a mere human.
It will not comprehend it.
It will not permit even a retreat.
And so it makes another backward step impossible.
That is his spirit: an obstinacy that recognizes its own powerlessness and still refuses to admit it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Unsightly."
His previously machine-like eyes finally start to burn with crimson hatred.
I understand how he feels.
----Probably,
the killer in Nrvnqsr is ordering himself to retreat.
But, the vampire in him does not allow defeat from a mere human.
He doesn't understand.
He doesn't even let himself withdraw.
So, he does not allow himself to even take a single step back.
His mind stubbornly doesn't allow him to realize his powerlessness.

entries.japanese:
さらに一歩。
　これで、あとは跳びかかればナイフでヤツの体を裂けるところにきた。
「―――否、断じて否―――！
　我が名はネロ、朽ちずうごめく吸血種の中において、なお不死身と称された混沌だ！
　それがこのような無様を見せるなぞ、断じてありえぬ……！」
―――ネロの体が、カタチをもっていく。
　今まで闇でしかなかった体は、明らかに個として化肉していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
One more step.
Now a single leap will bring him within reach of my knife.
“―――No, absolutely not―――!
My name is Nrvnqsr, chaos itself, called immortal even among the deathless, crawling species of vampires! That I should display such disgrace is beyond all possibility……!”
―――Nrvnqsr’s body takes shape.
What had been nothing but darkness takes on the unmistakable flesh of an individual body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Another step forward.
From here, I can jump and slice his body with my knife.
"----No, never----!
My name is Nrvnqsr, the immortal called Chaos of the undecaying vampire race!
It is not possible for me to look this unsightly……!"
----His body starts to form a shape.
The body which was only darkness begins to transform.

entries.japanese:
「この身は不死身だ。
　死など、とうの昔に超越した―――！」
　ネロの体が跳ねる。
　ケモノたちではない。
　ヤツは、残っているケモノたちを極限まで凝縮し、自らを最高のケモノと成して、こちらの息の根を止めに来た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This body is immortal.
I transcended death long ago—!”
Nrvnqsr springs.
Not his beasts.
He has compressed every creature remaining within him to its utmost limit, made himself the supreme beast, and come to stop my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This body is immortal.
I have surpassed death long ago----!"
His body leaps forward.
Not his beasts.
Condensing all his remaining beasts to the limit, he transforms himself into the best Beast and moves in to kill me.

entries.japanese:
その速度、アルクェイドにも劣らない。
　触れればその場で首を粉砕されかねない腕が伸びてくる。
　それをかわして、すれ違いざまにヤツの腕にある『線』を断った。
entries.maoEnglish:
His speed is no less than Arcueid’s.
An arm reaches for me that could shatter my neck the instant it touches.
I slip past it and sever the line on his arm as we cross.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His speed is as fast as Arcueid's.
He reaches out with arms which would pulverize my neck if he contacted me.
Dodging that, I cut the 'line' on his arm.

entries.japanese:
ざざざ、という音。
　速すぎる速度が制御できないのか、ネロはすぐに止まれずに通りすぎていく。
―――また、距離が開いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A harsh scraping.
Unable to control his own speed, Nrvnqsr hurtles past before he can stop.
―――The distance between us has opened again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As if unable to control his speed, he rushes past me without stopping.
---The distance between us grows once again.

entries.japanese:
―――眩暈がする。
　　　震えが、とまらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My head is spinning.
I can’t stop shaking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I feel dizzy.
I can't stop shaking.

entries.japanese:
「―――――なんだ、これは」
　切られた腕を見て、ネロは愕然としている。
「なんなのだ、これは―――！
　何故――何故切られた個所が再生しない！？
　こんなたわけた話があるものか……！
　アレは魔術師でもなければ埋葬者でもないというのに、何故、ただ切られただけで私が滅びねばならんのだ―――！？」
「―――馬鹿ね。
そんなつまらない体面を気にしてると殺されるわよ、ネロ・カオス」
　ネロの傍らから、聞きなれた声がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—What is this?”
Nrvnqsr stares in shock at his severed arm.
“What is this?! Why—why will the wound not regenerate? Such absurdity cannot exist…! That thing is neither mage nor Burial Agent, so why must I perish merely because he cut me?!”
“You fool. Keep worrying about such petty matters of pride and he’ll kill you, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
A familiar voice comes from beside him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------What is this?"
Nrvnqsr stares at his severed arm in astonishment.
"What is this----!?
Why--why does this severed part not regenerate!?
How can such a ridiculous thing be occurring……!?
He isn't a magus or a Burier, so how can he destroy me just by cutting me------!?"
"----How stupid.
If you get too concerned over appearances like that, you'll get killed, Nrvnqsr Chaos."
I hear a familiar voice near Nrvnqsr.

entries.japanese:
「貴様―――！」
　ネロは血走った目を、傍らで優雅に佇んでいるアルクェイドに向ける。
―――ああ、そうか。
　ネロが半身じゃなくなった時点で、彼女も自由になっていたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You—!”
Nrvnqsr turns his bloodshot eyes toward Arcueid, standing serenely at his side.
―――Ah, of course.
Once Nrvnqsr reclaimed his missing half, she must have been freed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You----!"
With bloodshot eyes, Nrvnqsr stares at Arcueid standing elegantly to the side.
----Oh, I see.
When he ceased being only half a body, she became free.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、わたしのことは気にしなくていいわ。
あなたの始末は志貴がする。
邪魔をしたらわたしまで殺しかねないものね、今の彼は」
　クスクスという笑い声。
「苦しませて殺そうだなんて思うからこういう目にあうのよ。
　敵は初撃で、反撃の機会を与えずに倒すものでしょう？
　あなたはね、そこを間違えたのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, don’t worry about me. Shiki will finish you. If I interfered, the way he is now, he might kill me too.”
She laughs softly.
“This is what you get for trying to make him suffer before you killed him.
You dispose of an enemy with the first blow, before they ever have a chance to strike back, don’t you? That was where you went wrong.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, don't worry about me.
Shiki will take care of you.
Right now, he would even kill me if I got in the way."
A giggling voice.
"It's your fault for thinking you should kill him painfully.
You should kill your enemy quickly without allowing the opportunity for a counterstrike, right?
That was your mistake."

entries.japanese:
「―――黙れ。
私に間違いなどない。
現に私には未だ五百六十もの命がある。
　……待っていろ、ヤツをくびり殺した後、もう一度貴様を捕らえる」
「そう？
　期待しないで待ってるわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Silence. I made no mistake. Even now, five hundred and sixty lives remain within me.
Wait there; after I strangle him to death, I will take you captive again.”
“Will you? I’ll wait without getting my hopes up.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Silence.
I do not make mistakes.
I still have 560 lives remaining.
…… Just wait.
Once I kill him, I will get you once more."
"Really?
It won't happen, but I'll be waiting."

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドはネロには近寄らない。
　ネロはもうこちらしか見ていない。
―――やってくる。
　左手を右手にそえて、ナイフを両手で握った。
　ネロの体が低くなる。
　それは、獲物に跳びかかる時の、狩猟動物の予備動作。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid makes no move toward Nrvnqsr.
Nrvnqsr no longer sees anything but me.
―――He’s coming.
I brace my left hand against my right and grip the knife in both.
Nrvnqsr lowers himself.
It is a predator’s crouch before it springs upon its prey.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid doesn't go near him.
Nrvnqsr is only looking at me.
----He's coming.
I brace my right hand with my left as I grip my knife.
Nrvnqsr crouches.
It's the action of a predator preparing to pounce on his prey.

entries.japanese:
「そうそう、ひとつ言い忘れていたわ、ネロ」
　その前に、風のような彼女の声が流れた。
「今さら遅いかもしれないけど。
彼はね、一度わたしを殺しているのよ」
「な―――に？」
　今度こそ、本当に。
　愕然とするあまり、ネロは自身を見失った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh yes, there was one thing I forgot to mention, Nrvnqsr.”
Before he can leap, her voice drifts through the air like wind.
“It may be rather late to tell you now. But he has already killed me once.”
“Wha—at?”
This time, truly.
Nrvnqsr’s astonishment makes him lose all command of himself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, I forgot to tell you one more thing, Nrvnqsr."
Her voice flows like the wind before that.
"It may be a little late, but he's killed me once before."
"Wh----at?"
This time, it's for real.
In his astonishment, Nrvnqsr loses sight of his identity.

entries.japanese:
その間隙。
　忘我するヤツの思考が、それこそ呪いのように、俺の意識に流れてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
In that opening.
His disordered thoughts pour into my consciousness like a curse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For a moment,
his entranced thoughts flow into my mind like a curse.

entries.japanese:
―――それは、悪夢か。
　アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドを殺す？
　この、不死身などという言葉さえ生ぬるい怪物を、あの人間は殺したというのか？
　いや、それこそ否だ。
　だがもし。
仮釈、それが真実だとするならば。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Is this a nightmare?
Kill Arcueid Brunestud?
That human killed a monster for whom even the word immortal is woefully inadequate?
No, that above all is impossible.
But suppose. Suppose it were true…
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Is this a nightmare?
Kill Arcueid Brunestud?
This monster, for whom even the words immortality isn't enough to describe, was killed by that human?
No, that cannot be true.
But, wait.
Hypothetically, if it is true…

entries.japanese:
―――果たして。
　思いあがっていたのは、一体どちらだったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Then.
Which of us had truly been blinded by arrogance?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Then,
just which one of us was the pretentious one?

entries.japanese:
「そういうコト。
思いあがっていたのはあなたのほうだったみたいね、ネロ・カオス」
「く――――ふふ、はははははははは！」
　憎悪と混乱の果てに。
　ネロ・カオスは、心底愉快そうに、声をあげて嗤った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. It seems you were the arrogant one after all, Nrvnqsr Chaos.”
“Kh—heh, hahahahahaha!”
At the farthest limit of hatred and confusion.
Nrvnqsr Chaos throws back his head and laughs as though nothing in the world had ever delighted him more.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Exactly.
It seems the pretentious one is you, Nrvnqsr Chaos."
"Ku----huhu, hahahahahahaha!"
At the end of hatred and chaos.
Nrvnqsr laughs with pleasure from the bottom of his heart.

entries.japanese:
―――もう待てない。
　　　動かない標的に向かって走り始める。
「そうか、私を殺すのか、人間――――！」
―――ケモノが吠える。
　　　片腕で、
　　　一直線に俺の心臓を貫こうと疾走してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I can’t wait any longer.
I break into a run toward the motionless target.
“So—you mean to kill me, human?!”
―――The beast roars.
With one arm extended, he charges straight at my heart,
intent on piercing it through.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I can't wait any longer.
I start running towards my unmoving target.
"I see.
You are going to kill me, human----!"
----The Beast roars.
With one arm,
he dashes forth to pierce my heart.

entries.japanese:
その速さは文句のつけようがないほど、
　単純で、
　余分なものがない、
　この俺を殺そうとするだけの、
　綺麗すぎる活動だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The charge is flawless in its speed,
simple,
stripped of everything superfluous,
devoted solely to killing me—
an action too pure to be anything but beautiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His speed is so fast, you can't ask for any more.
A simple,
efficient,
motion to kill me.
A motion too beautiful.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　伸ばされた腕を切る。
　ヤツの体には、何百という『死の点』が存在する。
　けれど、そんなモノより。
　ヤツの深いところ、中心の最中にある『極点』が、確かに視えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I cut the outstretched arm.
Hundreds of Points of Death exist throughout his body.
More deeply than any of them.
At the very heart of him, I can see one absolute point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I slice his outstretched arm.
Hundreds of "points of death" are on his body.
But, more than that,
deep inside of him, in his very center, I can see his "Ultimate Point".

entries.japanese:
――――何百という命を持とうが、関係ない。
　俺が殺すのは、ネロ・カオスという『存在』のみだ。
　だから、ネロを殺すのではない。
　この男が内包したと言う、その混沌。
　一つの世界を抹殺する――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――It doesn’t matter how many hundreds of lives he possesses.
The only thing I mean to kill is the being known as Nrvnqsr Chaos.
I am not killing Nrvnqsr.
What I am killing is the chaos this man claims to contain.
I will annihilate an entire world――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It doesn't matter how many lives he has.
I am only going to kill the "existence" of Nrvnqsr Chaos.
So, it isn't killing Nrvnqsr,
but the chaos which is him.
I am going to kill one world-------

entries.japanese:
正面からぶつかりあう。
　トン、という軽い音。
――――ナイフは、確実にヤツの最中を貫通する。
　にやりと口の端をつりあげて、吸血鬼は声も無く笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
We collide head-on.
A soft tap.
――――The knife passes unerringly through his center.
One corner of the vampire’s mouth curls upward in a soundless laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I attack him head-on.
A light sound of impact.
----The knife pierces into his center.
Twisting his lips in a grin, the vampire laughs voicelessly.

entries.japanese: 「まさか、な」
entries.maoEnglish: “It cannot be.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "This can't be."

entries.japanese:
じくり、と。
　指先からバラバラと一つ一つに崩れていく黒い黒いケモノの躯。
entries.maoEnglish:
Slowly, inexorably.
The black, black carcass of the beast crumbles apart piece by piece, beginning at the fingertips.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Numbly,
The Black Beast starts to crumble from his fingertips.

entries.japanese: 「―――――おまえが、私の死か」
entries.maoEnglish: “—So you are my death.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "------You… are my death?"

entries.japanese:
体温が、急速に霧散していく。
　終わりは幕を引くように一瞬だった。
　この一撃のもと。
　残る五百六十の獣とともに、ネロ・カオスは死滅した。
entries.maoEnglish:
The warmth drains swiftly from his body.
The end comes in an instant, like the fall of a curtain.
With this single blow.
Nrvnqsr Chaos perishes together with the five hundred and sixty beasts that remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His body temperature rapidly dwindles.
The end is instantaneous like a dropping curtain.
With this one attack,
along with the remaining 560 beasts, Nrvnqsr Chaos is annihilated.

entries.japanese:
「つか―――れた」
　がくん、と地面に崩れ落ちる。
　尻餅をついて、両手で倒れようとする体を支える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m―――beat”
My legs gave way and I crumpled to the ground.
I landed hard on my backside, catching my collapsing body with both hands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm---exhausted…"
I collapse onto the ground.
I fall on my rear and try to keep my body up with my hands.

entries.japanese:
「―――さむ」
　とにかく寒い。
　痛みはとうに麻痺していて、むしろ心地いい。
　体のふしぶしには犬の歯形だの鳥のくちばしがつけたえぐり傷だの、盛大にやられたもんだ。
―――まあ、間違いなく。
このまま死んでしまうとは、思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So―――cold”
Cold was all I could feel.
The pain had gone numb long ago; now it was almost pleasant.
Dogs had left tooth marks all over me, birds had gouged me with their beaks—my body had taken a magnificent beating.
―――Well, yes. I was almost certainly going to die like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Cold."
I'm cold.
The pain is numbed; it feels almost comfortable.
My body is ripped with canine bite marks and beak marks.
----Well, there's no mistake that I'll probably die like this.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　はあ、と大きく息を吐く。
　あごが上がってしまって、ちょうど空を見上げる形になった。
「―――――月」
　夜空には、ただキレイな月がある。
　……なんだろう。
　ひどく懐かしい。
これと似たようなコトを、前にも一度ぐらい、夢に見た気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I let out a long breath.
My head lolled back, leaving me staring up at the sky.
“―――――The moon”
Nothing occupied the night sky but a beautiful moon.
What was this feeling?
It felt terribly familiar. I thought I had dreamed of something like this once before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I let out a deep breath.
I raise my chin and look up at the sky.
"-----The moon."
Only the pretty moon is in the night sky.
…… What is it?
It seems awfully familiar… like I saw a dream like this before.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、大丈夫？」
　何事もなかったように歩み寄ってくるアルクェイド。
「……この、バカヤロウ……これで大丈夫だったら、人間じゃない」
　息も絶え絶えで返答した。
　声を出すのも辛いんだから、返事なんかするんじゃなかったかもしれない。
「く――――――あ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, are you all right?”
Arcueid strolled toward me as though nothing had happened.
“You idiot—if I were all right after this, I wouldn’t be human.”
I forced the answer out between failing breaths.
Speaking hurt so much that perhaps I should not have answered at all.
“Kh――――――ah”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, are you okay?"
Arcueid walks toward me as if nothing happened just now.
"…… You… stupid idiot…… If I was okay… I wouldn't be human."
I speak and breathe haltingly.
Even talking is painful, so maybe I shouldn't have responded.
"Kk------ah."

entries.japanese:
意識が、途絶えていく。
　と。
　ぱかん、とアルクェイドに頭をたたかれて、強引に意識を戻された。
entries.maoEnglish:
My consciousness began to break apart.
And then.
Arcueid smacked me smartly on the head and dragged me back to consciousness by force.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My consciousness starts to fade.
And then,
Whack!
Arcueid hits me on the head and forcefully returns me to consciousness.

entries.japanese:
「……なんの、つもりだ」
「だめよ。
そんな傷で眠っちゃったら、間違いなく生命活動が停止するわ。
眠るのは傷を塞いでからにしなさい」
―――そりゃあまったくの正論だ。
　あんまりに正論すぎて、あたまにきた。
「……アルクェイド。
前から思っていた事、言っていいか」
「ん、なに？」
「―――あんまり無茶いうな、このばか女」
　ばたん、と地面に倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What was that for?”
“No. If you fall asleep with wounds like these, your vital functions will definitely stop. You may sleep after we close them.”
―――She was absolutely right.
So right, in fact, that it made me furious.
“Arcueid. Can I tell you something I’ve been thinking for a while?”
“What is it?”
“Stop demanding the impossible, you stupid woman.”
I toppled flat onto the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What… was that for?"
"That won't do.
If you sleep with those wounds, you'll definitely end up dying.
You can't sleep until we close them."
---Her argument is perfectly just.
It's so just, it makes me angry.
"…… Arcueid.
Can I say what I've always thought from before?"
"Hm, what?"
"----Don't say such unreasonable things, you idiot."
I crash onto the ground.

entries.japanese:
―――意識が遠のく。
　アルクェイドが何事か騒いでいるけど、もう目を開ける力もない。
　ひどく―――寒い。
「ちょっと志貴、本当に死んじゃうわよ……！」
　……だから、眠いんだって。
　死ぬ前に眠るから、朝になったらちゃんと起きるよ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My consciousness receded.
Arcueid was making a fuss about something, but I no longer had the strength even to open my eyes.
It was so terribly cold.
“Shiki, you really are going to die…!”
That was why I was so sleepy.
I’d sleep before I died, then wake up properly in the morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---My consciousness starts to fade.
Arcueid is raising a racket, but I don't have any strength to hold my eyes open any longer.
It's terribly----cold.
"Hey, Shiki.
You really will die……!"
…… I told you, I'm sleepy.
I'll sleep before I die, so I'll wake up in the morning.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、眠っちゃだめだって―――！
　せめて傷口を塞いで、血ぐらい補っておかないと目覚められないわよ……！」
　―――ああ、うるさいな。
　俺は眠るから、やりたかったらすきにしてくれ。
「え、いいのわたしが治しちゃって？
　なんだ、そういうコトなら早く言ってくれれば良かったのに」
　明るい声が聞こえたあと。
　冷たい、今の自分の体より冷たい指先が、いたわるように肌に触れていくのを感じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, I told you not to fall asleep! If we don’t at least close your wounds and replace some of your blood, you’ll never wake up…!”
―――God, she was noisy.
I was going to sleep, so if she wanted to do something, she could do as she pleased.
“Oh, I’m allowed to heal you? You should have said so in the first place.”
After that bright reply.
Fingers colder even than my body touched my skin with surprising tenderness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, you mustn't sleep----!
We have to at least close your wounds and stop the bleeding, otherwise you won't wake up……!"
---Man, she's loud.
I'm going to sleep, so just do whatever you want.
"Eh, it's okay if I heal you?
Why didn't you say that earlier?"
After she says this cheerfully,
I feel cold fingers, colder than even my body, touch my skin as if in sympathy.

entries.japanese:
「ま、他人の使い魔を受け入れるのはイヤだけど、この際仕方ないかな」
　……なにかを塗られているような感触。
　わけがわからないけれど、
　ただ、ひどく心地いい――
「さすがは原初の海ともいわれた吸血鬼ね。
大元であるネロが消滅しても、使い魔たちは蘇生可能域にまだ残ってる。
……うん、これならわたしが後押しするだけでなんとかなるかな。
　まずこっちに寄生させて―――元気になったら志貴に移せば、と――――」
　指先が、離れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I hate the idea of taking someone else’s familiar into me, but I suppose we don’t have much choice.”
It feels as though she is spreading something over me.
I can’t understand any of it,
only that it feels wonderful――
“He really was a vampire worthy of the name ‘primordial sea.’ Even with their source, Nrvnqsr, destroyed, his familiars remain within their resurrection range. Yes, I should be able to manage this with a little assistance.
First I’ll let them take root here, then move them into Shiki once they’ve recovered――――”
Her fingertips left my skin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I'm not too happy about using someone else's familiars, but in these circumstances, it can't be helped."
…… I feel like something is being plastered to me.
I don't know why,
but it feels awfully pleasant--
"As to be expected from the vampire called the primordial sea.
Even after the destruction of the source, Nrvnqsr, the familiars still have their regenerative ability…… hm, in this case, all I have to do is give it a little hand.
First, let it live on me----once it's back to normal I'll put it back on you, Shiki----"
The fingers pull away.

entries.japanese:
「こんな所かな。
どう？
　方向性のない命の種だから、すでに人間として形をもってる志貴の体にすんなり寄生してくれてるでしょう？
　って、眠っちゃった、志貴―――？」
―――ああ、眠ってる。
「しょうがないなあ。
志貴の家って坂の上の屋敷でしょ？
　なんとか送り届けてあげる」
―――眠ったまま、ただ、白い月だけを見てる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That should do it. See? They’re seeds of life without any fixed form, so they’ve taken readily to Shiki’s body now that it already possesses a human shape.
Wait, Shiki, did you fall asleep―――?”
―――Yes, I was asleep.
“I suppose I have no choice. Your house is that mansion at the top of the hill, isn’t it? I’ll find some way to get you home.”
―――Still asleep, I watched nothing but the white moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess this'll do.
How is it?
It's a non-polar life, so it can adapt itself easily to your body, right?
Hey, are you sleeping Shiki----?"
---Yeah, I'm asleep.
"Oh well.
Your house is the mansion on top of the hill, right, Shiki?
I'll make sure you get home."
---I look up only at the white moon as I sleep.

entries.japanese:
「……おつかれさま志貴。
それとありがと。
今夜は貴方のおかげで助かっちゃった」
　……なんだかこれっぽっちも重みが感じられない感謝の言葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You did well, Shiki. And thank you. You saved me tonight.”
Her words of thanks somehow felt utterly weightless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You really did well, Shiki.
And thanks.
You really saved me tonight."
…… She thanks me without the slightest hint of heaviness in her words.

entries.japanese:
……声はそれきり聞こえない。
　今度こそ誰にも邪魔はされずに、遠野志貴の意識は深い眠りに落ちていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
After that, I heard no more.
This time, with no one left to disturb him, Shiki Tohno sank into a deep sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can't hear her voice anymore.
I fall into a deep sleep without anyone interrupting me this time.

entries.japanese:
「つか―――れた」
　がくん、と地面に崩れ落ちる。
　尻餅をついて、両手で倒れようとする体を支える。
　右手はようやくナイフを離してくれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m―――beat”
My legs gave way and I crumpled to the ground.
I landed hard on my backside, catching my collapsing body with both hands.
At last, my right hand let go of the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm---exhausted."
I collapse onto the ground.
I fall on my rear and try to keep my body up with my hands.

My right hand finally lets go of my knife.

entries.japanese:
「―――さむ」
　とにかく寒い。
　痛みはとうに麻痺していて、むしろ心地いい。
　体のふしぶしには犬の歯形だの鳥のくちばしがつけたえぐり傷だの、盛大にやられたもんだ。
―――まあ、間違いなく。
このまま死んでしまうとは、思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So―――cold”
Cold was all I could feel.
The pain had gone numb long ago; now it was almost pleasant.
Dogs had left tooth marks all over me, birds had gouged me with their beaks—my body had taken a magnificent beating.
―――Well, yes. I was almost certainly going to die like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Cold."
I'm cold.
The pain is numbed; it feels almost comfortable.
My body is ripped with canine bite marks and beak marks.
---Well, there's no mistake that I'll probably die like this.

entries.japanese:
「――――志貴！」
　アルクェイドの声。
「―――逃げて、狙われてる！」
　声を上げながらアルクェイドは駆け寄ってくる。
「………え？」
　地面に座り込んだまま、夜空を見上げた。
　そこには。
　白い月と、
　蒼い鴉の姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!”
Arcueid’s voice.
“Run, it’s coming for you!”
Arcueid raced toward me as she shouted. “What…?”
Still sitting on the ground, I looked up into the night.
There.
The white moon, and――――
A blue-black crow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki!"
Arcueid's voice.
"----Run, you're getting targeted!"
Arcueid shouts as she dashes towards me.
"………… Eh?"
I stare up at the night sky as I sit.
There,
I see the white moon,
and the figure of a blue crow.

entries.japanese:
クワア、と鳴き声をあげて、蒼い鴉は一直線に落ちてくる。
　鋭いくちばしで、俺の脳天を貫こうと落下してくる。
「っ――――！」
　逃げようと立ちあがる。
　けれど、体はやっぱり限界だった。
　立ちあがるつもりが、地面に倒れこんでしまう。
　あお向けに倒れこんだせいで、よけいはっきりと蒼い鴉の姿が見えた。
　ソレは、本当に弾丸のように俺の顔めがけて落下してきて―――目の前で、ザン、と音をたてて絶命した。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a raucous cry, the crow plunged straight down.
Its sharp beak was aimed to pierce the crown of my skull.
“――――!”
I tried to scramble away.
But my body had truly reached its limit.
Meaning to stand, I only toppled backward.
Landing flat on my back gave me an even clearer view of the descending crow.
It fell toward my face like a bullet—and an instant before impact, something struck with a vicious crack and killed it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It screams as it falls straight towards me.
It drops down to pierce my brain with its sharp beak.
"----!"
I try and stand up to escape.
But, my body is at its limit.
I try to stand but only end up collapsing on the ground.
Because I fell on my back, I get a disturbingly clear view of the crow.
It dives just like a bullet towards my face---and with the sound of sliced flesh, it dies right before my eyes.

entries.japanese:
蒼い鴉は、突然飛んできた刀じみた強大な釘に、串刺しにされた。
　釘は上空から飛んできたとしか思えない。
「…………」
　夜空を見上げる。
　そこには、白い月と。
entries.maoEnglish:
The crow had been skewered on an enormous spike, more sword than nail.
The spike could only have come hurtling from above.
“…”
I stared into the night sky.
There was the white moon. And—
entries.mirrorMoon:
The blue crow was impaled by a flying nail which looks like a large sword.
It had to have come from somewhere above.
"…………"
I look up at the night sky.
There, is the white moon.

entries.japanese: 神父のような黒い服を着た、誰かの人影があった。
entries.maoEnglish: A human figure dressed in black like a priest.
entries.mirrorMoon: And, there's someone dressed in black, priest-like garments.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　街灯の上に立って、こっちを見下ろしている。
　危うく殺されるところだったっていうのに、ぼんやりと、編み上げブーツがかっこいいな、とか思った。
　人影は何も語らない。
　感情のない瞳が、月光の鋭さに似ている。
　似ている。
　すごく――――先輩に、似ている。
「……………」
　意識がゆらぐ。
　クアアアアアアアア、という鴉の断末魔。
　そのまま、静かに目を閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The figure stood atop a streetlamp, looking down at me.
Though I had nearly died, my dazed mind found itself admiring those tall lace-up boots.
The figure said nothing.
Those emotionless eyes had the same keen edge as the moonlight.
They looked like hers.
So very much like Ciel’s.
“…”
My consciousness swayed.
The crow’s long death scream tore through the night.
I quietly closed my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
The figure stands on a streetlight and stares down at me.
Despite just being almost killed, I vacantly think those high-laced boots look really cool.
The figure doesn't say anything.
The emotionless eyes resemble the sharp moonlight.
Resembles…
The figure----really resembles Senpai.
"………………"
My mind swims.
Caaaaaaawww.
The crow's death cry.
And, I close my eyes quietly.

entries.japanese:
……血が流れていく。
　朦朧とした意識の中。
　アルクェイドと誰かがいがみあっているような声が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
My blood continued to drain away.
In my fading consciousness.
I heard Arcueid and someone else arguing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I keep bleeding.
In my groggy state,
I can hear Arcueid and someone else arguing.

entries.japanese:
「貴女には任せておけません。
彼は、わたしが治療します」
　ひどく敵意に満ちた声。
「余計な真似をしないで。
コレはわたしのなんだから、あなたには関係ないわ」
　アルクェイドの声も負けてはいない。
　……いないけど、かってに人を自分の物扱いしないでほしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I cannot entrust him to you. I will treat him myself.”
The voice was thick with hostility.
“Don’t interfere. He’s mine, so this has nothing to do with you.”
Arcueid gave as good as she got.
I’m not hers, and I wish she would stop treating me like her property.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I cannot leave it to you.
I will heal him."
A horribly hostile voice.
"Don't do anything you shouldn't.
This is mine, so it doesn't concern you."
Arcueid sounds the same too.
…… She sounds the same, but I wish she wouldn't selfishly make me her object.

entries.japanese:
「ええ、たしかに今のところは無関係です。
　ですが、今の貴女にこれだけの傷が治療できるとは思えません。
このままでは見殺しにするだけでしょう。
　それとも―――この若者を貴女の下僕にするつもりですか、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド」
「……あなた、そんな真似をわたしがすると思っているの？」
　……二人の声からは敵意以上のものが感じられる。
　ともすれば、このまま殺し合いが始まるんじゃないかっていうぐらい、張り詰めた声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“For the moment, yes, he is no concern of mine.
But in your present condition, I doubt you can treat wounds this severe. You will merely stand by and watch him die.
Or do you intend to make this young man your thrall, Arcueid Brunestud?”
“Do you truly believe I would do such a thing?”
Their voices held something beyond hostility.
The tension was so sharp that I expected them to begin killing each other at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, this certainly does not concern me right now.
However, I do not think you can heal such wounds.
All you can do is watch him die.
Or----do you intend on making this young man one of your subordinates, Arcueid Brunestud?"
"…… Do you think I would do such a thing?"
…… I can hear more than hostility in their voices.
There's so much tension I expect another fight to the death to start.

entries.japanese:
「では黙っていてください。
この傷ではそう長くは保ちません」
「―――わたし、あなたのこと大嫌いなの。
殺されない内にさっさと消えて」
「わたしだって貴女の事は大嫌いです。
言われなくとも、彼の治療を終えたらすぐに立ち去ります。
　貴女こそわたしに殺されないうちにこの街から消えてください。
目障りですから」
　……なんか、鬼気迫る話し声。
　意識は、完全に真っ白になっていった――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then be quiet. With wounds like these, he has very little time.”
“I hate you. Get out of my sight before I kill you.”
“The feeling is mutual. I will leave the moment I finish treating him, with or without your permission.
You should be the one to leave this city before I kill you. Your presence offends me.”
Their conversation had become terrifyingly intense.
My consciousness faded completely into white――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then please be quiet.
With those wounds, he cannot last long."
"---I really hate you.
You should just disappear before I kill you."
"I really hate you as well.
You don't need to tell me anything; I plan on leaving once his wounds are healed.
You yourself should disappear before I kill you.
I can't stand seeing you around."
…… A conversation full of tension and hostility.
My mind goes totally blank----

entries.japanese:
「――――かた、い」
　そう、硬い。
　あんまりに背中にあたる感触が硬くて、スパッと目を覚ました。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hard.”
Yes, hard.
Whatever pressed against my back was so unforgiving that it snapped me wide awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Har… d."
Yeah, it's hard.
I feel something hard against my back, and it causes me to wake with a start.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
「あれ―――アルクェイド」
　はて、と周りを見渡す。
　ここは公園。
自分はベンチで横になっている。
　公園の時計を見るかぎり、時刻は午前一時すぎ。
　あれから一時間ほどしか経っていない、という事だろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“Huh—Arcueid?”
I looked around in confusion.
This was a park. I was lying on a bench.
The park clock read a little after one in the morning. Could only an hour have passed?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
"Huh?----Arcueid?"
I look around.
I'm in the park lying on a bench.
I look at the park's clock, and it's past one in the morning.
I guess it hasn't even been an hour since then.

entries.japanese:
「……………………」
　アルクェイドは、無言で俺を見つめている。
　……というか、睨んでいるような、気もする。
「アル……クェイド……？」
「…………………」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　原因は不明だけど、どうも彼女はいたくご立腹みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid stared at me without a word.
In fact, I had the distinct impression she was glaring.
“Arcueid…?”
“…”
She did not answer.
I had no idea why, but she appeared to be in a towering temper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Arcueid looks at me wordlessly.
…… Or maybe it's more like a glare.
"Ar…… cueid……?"
"……………………"
Arcueid doesn't respond.
I don't know why, but she seems really angry.

entries.japanese:
「……よっと」
　とりあえず、ベンチから立ちあがった。
「あ―――傷、塞がってる」
　あれだけボロボロに切り裂かれたっていうのに、体には一つの傷跡さえない。
　痛みも当然のようになくて、まるでネロとの一戦が夢だったみたいだ。
―――けど、あれは夢じゃない。
　と、なると―――これは、もしかして。
「アルクェイド。
おまえまさか、またネロの体を塗りつけたのか……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Up we go…”
For the moment, I got to my feet.
“My wounds—they’re closed.”
Though I had been torn to ribbons, not a single scar remained.
The pain was gone as well, as if the battle with Nrvnqsr had been nothing but a dream.
―――But it hadn’t been a dream.
Which meant—could it be?
“Arcueid. Don’t tell me you smeared Nrvnqsr’s flesh all over me again…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… There."
For now, I stand up.
"Oh----my wounds are healed."
I was so bloody and cut up, but there isn't a single scar anywhere.
There isn't any pain either, as if my fight with Nrvnqsr was all a dream.
---But, that was no dream.
Then, this---must be…
"Arcueid.
Don't tell me you used another part of Nrvnqsr's body again……?"

entries.japanese:
「いいえ、残念ながらはずれよ。
そのほうが手っ取り早いし、志貴も強くなれたんだけどね。
そもそも志貴がネロを完全に『殺』しちゃったから、ネロの体はもう使えないわ」
「へえ、それじゃあちゃんとあれ以外の方法で治してくれたんだ。
　……すごいな、ほんとに元通りだ。
痛みもないし眩暈もしない。
いったいどんなふうに治したんだ、アルクェイド」
「しらない。
志貴を治したのはわたしじゃないから」
　乱暴に言って、アルクェイドは不機嫌そうに顔をそむけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, sorry, wrong answer. That would have been quicker and might have made you stronger too. But you ‘killed’ Nrvnqsr completely, so his body can’t be used anymore.”
“Oh, so you healed me some other way.
That’s incredible. I’m completely back to normal—no pain, no dizziness. How did you do it, Arcueid?”
“I don’t know. I wasn’t the one who healed you.”
Arcueid delivered that answer sharply and turned her face away in a sulk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, unfortunately not.
It would've been a quick fix and you would've gotten stronger with it too.
But since you 'killed' Nrvnqsr completely, we can no longer use his body."
"Really?
I guess you healed me in another way then.
…… Wow, I really am back to normal.
I don't feel pain or dizziness.
Just how in the world did you do it, Arcueid?"
"I don't know.
I wasn't the one who healed you."
She exclaims and looks away, displeased.

entries.japanese:
「………？」
　アルクェイドが不機嫌なのは、どうもそのあたりが原因みたいだ。
　けど、俺を治したのはアルクェイドじゃないとしたら、いったい他に誰が―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…?”
That seemed to be the reason for her bad mood.
But if Arcueid hadn’t healed me, who else could have―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………?"
It seems that's the reason.
But… if she wasn't the one to heal me, then just who did----?

entries.japanese:
「――――――あ」
　いた。
　もう一人、誰かがいたんだ。
　すんでのところで自分を助けてくれた誰か。
　……シエル先輩に似すぎていた、あの黒い服の女の人。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh.”
There.
Someone else was there.
Someone who saved me at the last instant.
That woman in black who looked far too much like Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
There was.
There was another person.
Someone who helped me.
…… That woman in black garments who resembled Senpai far too much.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、さっきのヤツは！？」
「……………」
　アルクェイドは不機嫌な顔つきのまま、そっぽを向いて無視なんてしやがる。
「アルクェイド、おい！
　さっきの人はどうしたかって聞いてるんだけど！」
「知らない。
わたし、そんなヤツ見なかった」
　ぷい、と顔を背けてあくまでしらをきるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, where did that woman go?”
“…”
Arcueid, still wearing that sour expression, turned away and ignored me.
“Arcueid, hey! I’m asking what happened to the woman who was here!”
“I don’t know. I didn’t see anybody.”
She tossed her face aside and persisted in that transparent lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid… where is that person from before!?"
"………………"
Still looking displeased, she looks away and ignores me.
"Hey, Arcueid!
I'm asking you what happened to that person from before!"
"I don't know.
I didn't see anyone."
She turns away and pretends not to know anything.

entries.japanese:
「あのな―――さっき俺を治したのは自分じゃないって言ってただろ。
おまえじゃなかったら、他の誰が俺を助けてくれたっていうんだよ！」
「ああもうっ、知らないったら知らないのっ！」
　あ。
アルクェイドが、逆ギレした。
「だいたいね、どうして志貴があいつなんかのことを気にかけるのよ。
あいつが誰であろうと志貴には関係ないんじゃない？」
「ばっ―――関係なんか、ある。
……暗くてよくわからなかったけど、さっきの人影は、その……知ってる人に、似てた気がするんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You just said you weren’t the one who healed me. If it wasn’t you, then who else saved my life?”
“I said I don’t know!”
Ah. Now Arcueid was furious at me.
“Why do you even care about her? Whoever she is, she has nothing to do with you.”
“Of course she does! It was dark, so I couldn’t see clearly, but that figure looked like someone I know.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---you just said you weren't the one who helped me.
If it wasn't you, then who else could've done it?"
"Oh, enough already, I said I don't know, so I don't know!"
Oh.
It seems she's taking it out on me.
"In the first place, why are you so interested in that person?
It doesn't have anything to do with you, right?"
"Idi---there is something.
…… It was dark; I couldn't really tell, but that person looked like someone I know."

entries.japanese:
「――――そんなのただの偶然よ。
いいからあんなヤツのことは忘れて。
わたしの前であいつの話をしたら、本当に怒るからね」
　ぴしゃりと言いきって、アルクェイドは顔を背けた。
「……本当に怒るって、なんだよそれ」
　怒りたいのはこっちのほうだ。
　俺はただ、さっきの人影のことが知りたいだけなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was only a coincidence. Forget about her. If you mention her in front of me again, I’ll really get angry.”
With that flat declaration, Arcueid turned away.
“What do you mean, ‘really’ angry?”
I was the one who ought to be angry.
All I wanted was to know who that shadowy figure had been.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's just a coincidence.
Just forget about that person.
If you talk about it again in front of me, I'll really get mad."
Ending quickly, she looks away.
"…… Why are you so angry?"
I should be the one getting angry.
I just want to know who that person from before was, that's all.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、わかった。
もうなにも聞かないよ。
だいたいこれで俺とおまえの関係も終わりだからな」
「え―――？」
「当然だろ。
この街ですき放題やってた吸血鬼は倒したんだし、これで俺の責任ってヤツもなくなったんだ。
　俺だってそろそろ家に戻らないと秋葉のヤツになんて叱られるかわからないしな。
ここらが潮時なんじゃないか、アルクェイド」
「ん―――そうね、言われてみればそうかも。
時間もこんなになっちゃったし」
　うん、とアルクェイドは頷いてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. I won’t ask anything else. Besides, this is where our relationship ends.”
“What―――?”
“It’s obvious. We defeated the vampire who was running wild through this city, so my share of the responsibility is over.
I need to get home before Akiha decides on some horrible punishment. This seems like the right time to part ways, don’t you think, Arcueid?”
“Mm, I suppose you’re right. And it has gotten very late.”
Arcueid nodded in agreement.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Fine, I got it.
I won't ask anymore.
Besides, our partnership ends here anyway."
"Eh---?"
"Isn't it obvious?
We defeated the vampire who did as he pleased in this town, so my responsibility's gone now.
I have to get back home soon, or Akiha will yell at me.
I think it's about time to cut it off, Arcueid."
"Hm----you're right.
Now that you mention it, it's already this late, too."
Arcueid nods.

entries.japanese:
「よし」
　こっちも納得して頷く。
　……納得して頷いたんだけど。
　なにか、心のどこかでしこりがある。
　このままコイツと別れるのが残念なような、そんな、未練らしきものがある。
「―――――」
　そんなバカな。
　こいつは吸血鬼で、俺は普通の人間なんだ。
　これ以上関わると、それこそ取りかえしのつかない事になる………んだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good.”
Satisfied, I nodded as well.
I nodded, satisfied—or tried to be.
Something remained lodged deep inside me.
A lingering regret at the thought of leaving her here and never seeing her again.
“…”
Ridiculous.
She was a vampire, and I was an ordinary human being.
If we stayed involved any longer, something truly irreversible would happen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright."
I also nod in understanding.
…… I nodded out of understanding, but…
there's still something lingering.
As if I regret parting with her.
"-----"
That's ridiculous.
She's a vampire, and I'm a normal human.
If I associated with her anymore…… something will happen that I can't take back.

entries.japanese:
「……それじゃあな、アルクェイド」
　片手をあげて、アルクェイドから離れる。
「その、さ。
色々酷い目にもあったけど、わりと楽しくはあったよ。
えっと、だから―――おまえも元気でな」
「そうね。
今夜はもう遅いし、家に帰らないといけないか」
「おやすみ。
それじゃあまたね、志貴！」
「…………」
　……なんか今、あいつおかしな事を口走った気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye, Arcueid.”
I raised one hand and began to walk away.
“I mean… some terrible things happened, but it was fun too, in its way. So—take care of yourself.”
“You’re right. It’s late tonight, so you should go home.”
“Good night. See you again, Shiki!”
“…”
I had the odd feeling she had just said something very strange.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Bye, Arcueid."
Raising a hand, I step away.
"Um.
There were a lot of horrible things that happened, but it was pretty fun, too.
So---um, take care of yourself."
"Yeah.
It is late, and you have to get back home."
"Good night.
Till next time, Shiki!"
"…………"
…… I think she just said something odd.

entries.japanese:
走り去っていくあいつの背中に『これっきりだ、ばか』と言おうとして、やめた。
「……まあ、色々と問題はあるけど、面白いヤツなんだ、あいつは」
　なんて、自分自身を弁解するようなセリフを呟いてみる。
　けどそれは本当の話。
　だから、たまには。
　なにかの拍子で、もう一度ぐらいは会うことがあっても、悪くはない気がしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I almost called after her retreating back that this was the last time, but stopped myself.
“She has plenty of problems, but she is interesting.”
I muttered it as if making excuses to myself.
Yet it was true.
So, once in a while.
Seeing her once more by some accident might not be such a bad thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I try to say, "This is the last time, idiot," but I stop myself.
"…… Well, there are a lot of problems, but she is quite an interesting person."
I speak as if trying to convince myself.
But, it's the truth.
So, even if it is just once in a while…
I feel like--if by some chance we got to meet again--it wouldn't be a bad thing.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に帰ってきた。
　時刻は午前二時になったころで、屋敷には電灯一つついていない。
「……忍び込むしかないかな」
　鉄柵をよじ登って、庭に入る。
　幸い玄関の鍵は開いていて、誰も起こさずに中に入る事ができた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I returned to the mansion.
It was around two in the morning, and not a single light burned anywhere in the house.
“I suppose I’ll have to sneak in.”
I scaled the iron fence and dropped into the garden.
Fortunately, the front door was unlocked, and I slipped inside without waking anyone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion.
It's about two in the morning, and there's not a single light on in the mansion.
"…… I have to sneak in."
I climb over the fence and enter the garden.
Fortunately, the door is open and I am able to enter inside without waking anyone.

entries.japanese:
「はあ――――」
　自分の部屋に帰ってきて、大きく背伸びをする。
　終わった。
　この三日間に渡って起きた、おかしな出来事はこれで本当に終わったんだなって、実感できた。
「さて―――寝るか」
　疲れきった体をベッドに沈ませて、安らかな眠りに落ちていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
Back in my room, I stretched luxuriously.
It was over.
At last, I could truly believe that the strange events of the past three days had ended.
“Time for bed.”
I sank my exhausted body into the mattress and drifted toward peaceful sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
I get back to my room and take a deep breath.
It's over.
I truly feel all the events these past three days, all the strange things, are actually finished.
"Well then----time for bed."
I sink my tired body into bed and fall asleep.

entries.japanese:
―――いや、落ちるつもりだった。
「……………」
　なのに眠れない。
　体も心も疲れきっているのに、どうしてあの人影のことが気になって、眠れない。
「……先輩……のハズはないんだけど……」
　けど、どうしても先輩とイメージがだぶってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Or rather, I meant to.
“…”
But sleep would not come.
Body and mind were exhausted, yet that shadowy figure kept me awake.
“It couldn’t have been Ciel…”
Even so, I could not separate the two images.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Or at least, I intended to.
"……………………"
But, I just can't sleep.
My mind and body are tired, but I can't stop thinking about that figure and I can't sleep.
"…… It couldn't…… have been Senpai, but……"
But, she resembles Senpai so much.

entries.japanese:
はっきりと顔も見てないし、似ているのか、と問われたら断言できない。
　だから―――ただの勘違いだとは思う。
「……明日……学校で聞けば……いいか」
　そう―――だな。
　先輩とはいつでも学校で出会えるんだから、その時に聞いて、『そんなのはわたしじゃないです』っていう、当たり前の返答を聞けばいいんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had never clearly seen her face, and if asked whether they truly looked alike, I couldn’t say.
So it was probably a simple mistake.
“I can ask her at school tomorrow.”
Yes.
I could see Ciel at school whenever I liked, ask her then, and hear the obvious answer that it had not been her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I couldn't get a good look at her face, so I can't say for sure.
So---I think it's just my mistake.
"…… Tomorrow…… I'll ask her…… at school."
Yeah---that's right.
I can see her at school any time, so I'll ask her then.
Then, she can just say, "That wasn't me," and it'll all be alright.

entries.japanese:
「―――よし、そうしよう」
　決めた。
　さて、あとは―――なにかつまらない本でも読めば、いつのまにか眠ってしまっているだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good, I’ll do that.”
Decision made.
Now all I needed was a dull book, and before long I would fall asleep over it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Alright, that's what I'll do."
It's decided.
Now, then---if I just read a boring book, I'll probably fall asleep.

entries.japanese: 『不老不死』。
entries.maoEnglish: “Ageless Immortality.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Immortality".

entries.japanese:
その言葉が真実無二ならば、それは永遠を定義するものの一つとなろう。
　だが現実に、その域に達しているモノはいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
If those words could be made absolutely true, they would offer one possible definition of eternity.
Yet nothing in reality has ever attained such a state.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If those words are to be a grand reality, it would be one of the things which would define eternity.
But in reality, nothing in existence has reached that level.

entries.japanese:
例えば、伝承に時折顔を出す吸血鬼の類としても、不老不死ではありえない。
　彼らは所詮、他者からなにかを略奪しなければ存在していられない欠陥品だ。
　しかもその補充品が同種―――この場合、大半が人間という事になる―――でしかありえない、という点において、まったく汎用性というものがない。
　超越種、などと謳ってはいるが、それは進化ではなく退化であろう。
　単一種としての永久機関でなければ、それは永遠とは呼べまい。
　他者に依存しなければ不老でいられぬ命など、不老不死を名乗るもおこがましい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even the vampires who surface now and again in legend cannot possess ageless immortality.
They are defective things, unable to exist unless they plunder something from others.
Worse, what replenishes them must come from their own kind—which, in most cases, means human beings; they possess no adaptability whatsoever.
They may proclaim themselves a transcendent species, but theirs is not evolution, only regression.
Unless a species forms a perpetual motion machine unto itself, it cannot be called eternal.
A life that depends upon others to remain ageless has no right to claim immortality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For example, those vampires occasionally spoken of in legends are not immortal.
After all, they are defective because they require stealing from others to exist.
Furthermore, the fact that their supplemental parts have to be of the same species---in this case, generally referring to humans----means that they are not versatile at all.
They call themselves the transcendent race, but that is not evolution, it is degeneration.
That which cannot function independently in perpetuity cannot be called eternal.
It is presumptuous to call something immortal if it depends on others to halt its aging.

entries.japanese:
単一種としての永久機関には、すでに完璧に近い生物が存在する。
　自らを食料とし、それを糧に繁殖する。
寿命などというものもない。
古くなった細胞は栄養源として食料になり、新しい細胞を生み出し続ける。
　群体と呼ばれるもの。
例えばクラゲ。
　しかし、それは知性という余分な機能を持たないが故の永久機関だ。
　知性を持たないでいいというのなら、それは死をもって永遠とする所となんら変わりはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Creatures already exist that approach perfection as self-sustaining perpetual motion machines.
They consume themselves and reproduce from what they consume. They have no lifespan. Old cells become nourishment, while new cells are born without end.
Colonial organisms. Jellyfish, for example.
Yet such creatures function eternally only because they lack the superfluous faculty called intelligence.
If intelligence may be discarded, that is no different from seeking eternity in death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There already exists something close to perfection which can function independently in perpetuity.
It feeds on itself and multiplies.
It has no such thing as a lifespan.
Old cells become food as nutrients and new cells are produced from it.
Such as a jellyfish.
However, it is perpetual only because it has no intelligence.
If having no intelligence is fine, then it is no different from gaining eternity by death.

entries.japanese:
ヒトとしての形を保ちながら永遠でいたいのならば、不老不死という手段では不可能だ。
　長い年月は肉体を崩壊させ、思考の柔軟さを磨耗させていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
If one wishes to remain eternal while preserving human form, ageless immortality cannot provide the answer.
The passage of ages will erode the body and wear all suppleness from the mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If you want to be eternal living as a human, it is impossible by the method of immortality.
Long years destroy the body and wear away flexibility of the mind.

entries.japanese:
不老不死か、永遠か。
　手垢のついた不老不死になど、未練はない。
　個人に固執するのならば永遠はありえまい。
　一人の人間として生き続ける不老不死より。
　私は、永遠に存在し続ける無限を選んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Immortality, or eternity.
I have no attachment to that shopworn dream of deathlessness.
So long as one clings to the individual, eternity is impossible.
Rather than an immortality lived as one human being.
I chose an infinity that would continue to exist for all eternity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Immortality or eternity.
I have no attachment to stained immortality.
Persistently maintaining individuality makes eternity unattainable.
Instead of gaining immortality as a single human,
I chose the infinity in which I continue to exist eternally.

entries.japanese:
……なるほど、たしかにそれは私とは違うアプローチだ。
しかしな、その方法では人間が絶滅した場合、君は永遠ではなくならないか？
　君の手段には、どうしても自分以外の生まれていない胎児が必要となるではないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I see: your approach certainly differs from mine. But if humanity becomes extinct, will your method not cease to be eternal?
You invariably require the unborn child of another human being.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I see; certainly a different approach than I.
However, with your method, will you not lose eternity at the extinction of the human race?
Your method always requires an unborn child other than yourself.

entries.japanese:
ええ、そうですね。
けれど私は私以外の人間がいなければ自己を認識する事ができません。
　ですから―――人間が絶滅するのなら、自分だけ生き延びようとする事そのものが無価値でしょう。
　私の不老不死は、その時点で終わりです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, that is true. But without other human beings, I cannot recognize myself.
Therefore, if humanity perishes, my survival alone would be meaningless. My immortality will end at that moment.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, that is true.
But if no other humans existed, I would not be able to confirm my own self.
So----if humans become extinct, then continuing to live would be worthless.
At that point, my immortality would end.

entries.japanese:
……君の理論はわからんな。
それでは命題たる永遠には程遠いぞ、蛇よ。
entries.maoEnglish: I cannot understand your reasoning. That falls far short of the eternity we seek, Serpent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I do not understand your theory.
That is far from the thesis of eternity, Serpent.

entries.japanese:
いえ、永遠ですよ。
滅びる時はみな全て滅びればいい。
観測者がいなくなれば、それすなわち全てが不変。
　私が体現する永遠はね、その時までの仮初めのものです。
　私では全てを無にする事はできない。
ですからその時まで、こうして生き続けようとしているのです。
　……もっとも。
今では、それ以外に一つだけ楽しみというものが出来てしまいましたが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it is eternity. When destruction comes, let everything perish together. Without an observer, all things become changeless.
The eternity I embody is only a provisional one, meant to endure until that hour.
I cannot reduce everything to nothingness myself. And so, until then, I continue to live.
Admittedly. I have lately discovered one other pleasure.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
No, it is eternity.
When a time comes to perish, everything should perish.
If observers cease to exist, then that means everything is unchanging.
The eternity I embody is temporary until that time occurs.
I cannot turn everything into nothingness.
Therefore, I will continue living until it happens.
…… Although, I have found yet another amusement.

entries.japanese: わざわざ私を呼びつけた目的はそれか。
entries.maoEnglish: “Is that why you went to the trouble of summoning me?”
entries.mirrorMoon: Is that why you called me?

entries.japanese:
はい。
あなたの中のソレを、少しばかりカタチにできる神秘を教授いたしましょう。
その神代の御業をもって、あなたに捕らえてほしいひとがいるのです、混沌よ。
entries.maoEnglish: “Yes. I shall teach you a mystery capable of giving a little shape to that which dwells within you. There is someone I want you to capture with that art from the Age of Gods, Chaos.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes.
I will show you a mystic method which allows you to slightly shape what is inside of you.
There is someone I wish for you to catch using this achievement from the age of the gods, Chaos.

entries.japanese:
ボンジョワール！
　なんだかあっさりとデッドエンドを迎えてしまったお茶目な遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“おしえて！
知得留先生！
”のお時間です。
　さて、好評のがくがく動物ランドシリーズ、第三弾。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bonjour!
This little feature is for our mischievous Tohno, who somehow wandered into another dead end with ridiculous ease,
and now it’s time! “Teach Me, Ciel!” Class is in session!
And now, the wildly popular Trembling Animal Kingdom returns for part three.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonjour!
And now the hint corner for the sake of the mischievous Tohno-kun who quickly ended up in a Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
Well then, now for the third of the ever-popular series, "Shakes 'n Shivers Animal Land".

entries.japanese:
「うそつけー！
　ちっとも動物なんて出てこないぞー！」
　却下。
　人間失格（ペット名）、Ｇｏ！
「殺るジャンキー」
「きゃああーーーーーーーーー……………ふにゃ」
　さて、動物シリーズ第三弾。
　どうして遠野くんはデッドアウトしてしまったのか。
　この時間は特別講師として、さっき役回りが終わってブラブラ散歩していたこの方をお呼びしました。
　それではネロ教授、なにか一言。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Liar! There haven’t been any animals at all!”
Objection rejected.
No Longer Human—that’s the pet’s name—go!
“Murder junkie.”
“Aaaaaaaaaaah—nya.”
Now then, part three of our animal series.
Why did Tohno meet his untimely dead end?
As today’s guest instructor, we have invited someone who finished his role a moment ago and happened to be wandering around.
Professor Nrvnqsr, a few words, if you please.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Liar!
I don't see any animals coming out!"
Denied.
No Longer Human (Pet's Name), Go!
"Killing junkie~"
"Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaa………… hunyaa!"
Well then, the third in our animal series.
Why did Tohno-kun end up dying?
This time, we have brought a special guest lecturer.
I have called in this person who was wandering about after finishing his task earlier.
Professor Nrvnqsr, please go ahead.

entries.japanese:
「何もない」
　……あの。
「何もない。
私は勝利した時しか語らん」
　……あの、ですね、一応、ここにきたってコトはネロ教授の勝ちだったわけですが。
「―――なるほど、正論だな。
　だが言うべき事などない。
千載一遇の好機を逃す者など知らぬ。
　一度だけ前に戻ってやり直すがいい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I have none.”
Um…
“None. I speak only when I have won.”
Well, technically, Professor Nrvnqsr, Tohno’s presence here means that you did win.
“―――I see; a sound argument.
Nevertheless, there is nothing to say. I have no interest in a man who lets the chance of a lifetime escape him.
Go back one step and try again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nothing."
…… Um.
"Nothing.
I will only speak when I am victorious."
…… Um, if we're here, it means you have won in a way, Professor Nrvnqsr.
"---I see.
That is a sound argument.
But there is nothing to be said.
I do not know of anyone who would miss a once in a lifetime opportunity.
Return to the choice before and correct yourself."

entries.japanese:
えーっと……はい、ありがとうございました。
　それでは四時間目の授業はここまでです。
　引き続き、ゲーム本編をお楽しみください。
entries.maoEnglish:
Er—yes, thank you very much.
That concludes lesson four.
Please continue to enjoy the main game.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Um…… Yes, thank you very much.
This concludes our fourth period lesson.
Please continue enjoying the main storyline.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドの部屋は吸血鬼にあるまじき内装をしていた。
　……あの時はアルクェイドに夢中で部屋のことまで頭が回らなかったけど、こうして見ると実にまともな一般人っぽい部屋をしている。
「……新聞もちゃんととってるみたいだし。
なんなんだろうな、コイツ」
　ぼやきながらアルクェイドをベッドに寝かせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid’s room was decorated in a way no self-respecting vampire’s room ought to be.
The last time I was here, I was too consumed by Arcueid herself to notice the furnishings, but now it looks remarkably like an ordinary person’s room.
“She even gets the newspaper. What is she?”
Grumbling, I lay Arcueid on the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid's room isn't what you would expect for a vampire.
…… Back then, I was only worried about Arcueid so I didn't really notice it, but looking at it now, her room is completely ordinary.
"…… She even has a newspaper subscription.
What's that all about?"
I grumble as I put the sleeping Arcueid on her bed.

entries.japanese:
「は―――あ」
　床に腰を下ろして、大きく深呼吸をする。
　時刻はじき朝の六時になろうとしている。
　窓の外は明るくなってはいるものの、空模様はどんよりと曇っていた。
「……そっか。
カーテン、閉めてあげないと」
　けだるい体に鞭をうって立ちあがる。
　部屋じゅうのカーテンを閉めて、もう一度床に腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah……”
I lower myself to the floor and take a deep breath.
It will soon be six in the morning.
Daylight is growing beyond the windows, though the sky is thick with clouds.
“……Right.
I should close the curtains.”
I force my sluggish body upright, draw every curtain in the room, and sit on the floor again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hwaa----ahhhhh."
I take a deep breath as I sit on the floor.
It's almost six o'clock in the morning.
The sky outside the window is brightening but heavily laden with clouds.
"…… Right.
I should close the curtains."
I spur my tired body to stand up.
I close the curtains and sit back down again.

entries.japanese:
どすん。
　座ろうとした途中、膝から力が抜けて床に倒れこんだ。
「―――ありゃ。
俺も疲れてるみたいだ」
　情けないことに、起きあがることができない。
　そういえば昨夜はずっとアルクェイドと話をしていたし、まともな食事を一日以上摂っていない。
　くわえて―――メガネをしていても頭痛は消えてくれなくて、脳の神経はさっきからスプーンを投げまくっている状況だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud.
My knees give out halfway down, and I crumple to the floor.
“Huh. Guess I’m tired too.”
Pathetic as it is, I cannot get back up.
I spent all last night talking with Arcueid, and I have gone more than a day without a proper meal.
Worse, even the glasses cannot stop the headache, and every nerve in my brain has been throwing up its hands for a while now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thud.
As I lower myself the strength drains from my knees and I collapse on the floor.
"----Man, it seems like I'm exhausted too."
It's pitiful but I can't even stand.
Come to think of it, I spent all last night talking with Arcueid and I didn't eat for more than a day.
In addition----even though I put my glasses on, I still have a headache.
My brain is ringing with this headache.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド……傷、大丈夫かな……」
　出血は止まっていたし、バラバラにされても勝手に生き返るヤツなんだから、そんな心配なんて無用かもしれないけど。
「……なんで、かな」
　こうしているいまも、疲れで倒れてしまいそうだっていうのに。
　今は、自分のことよりアルクェイドの容体が気にかかってしまっている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid—is her wound all right?”
The bleeding had stopped, and she can reassemble herself after being cut to pieces, so perhaps worrying is pointless.
“Why?”
Even now, exhaustion has me on the verge of collapse.
Still, I care more about Arcueid’s condition than my own—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid…… I wonder if her wound is alright……"
Her bleeding has stopped, and she is someone who regenerates after being sliced apart… so maybe I don't have to worry.
"…… I wonder why."
Right now I'm so exhausted I could collapse.
Yet I'm more worried about Arcueid than myself----

entries.japanese:
『―――この衝突事故は被害者である高田陽一さんのオートバイのブレーキペダルが何らかの異常をきたしており、ブレーキがきかない状態で急な坂道を下りてしまったことが原因とされています。
　負傷者は二名、幸い死者はおりませんでした』
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――The collision is believed to have occurred after the brake pedal on victim Yoichi Takada’s motorcycle malfunctioned, leaving him unable to brake as he descended a steep hill.
Two people were injured, but fortunately there were no fatalities
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Investigators believe the cause of Takada Youichi's motorcycle accident was a malfunction in the brake pedal which occurred while he was descending a steep hill.
Fortunately, no one was killed in the accident."

entries.japanese: ……どこででも聴けるような、あまり特徴のない男性の声に起こされた。
entries.maoEnglish: I wake to an utterly unremarkable male voice, the sort one could hear anywhere.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… I wake up to a man's generic, uninflected voice.

entries.japanese:
「ん―――寝ちゃったのか、俺」
　気がつくと床に横になっていて、体にはシーツがかぶせられている。
　時刻はお昼をすぎたあたり。
　ベッドの上にアルクェイドの姿はなく、ただつけっぱなしのテレビがつまらないニュースをたれ流していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm—did I fall asleep?”
I find myself stretched out on the floor with a sheet draped over me.
It is sometime after noon.
Arcueid is no longer in bed, and the television, left on, is droning through some dull news report.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nng----Did I fall asleep?"
When I come to, I find myself lying on the floor under a sheet.
It's about past noon.
Arcueid is no longer on the bed and uninteresting news fills the room from the television.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド、どこに行ったんだろ」
　と、台所で人の気配がする。
「あの馬鹿。
あんな体でなに動きまわってるんだ」
　シーツをはらって立ちあがる。
　すぐ台所に行って、あいつの傷を確かめなくっちゃいけない。
『次のニュースです。
本日未明、南社木市にあるホテルで大規模な行方不明者が出るという事件が発生しました』
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where did Arcueid go?”
There is someone in the kitchen.
“That idiot. What is she doing on her feet in that condition?”
I throw off the sheet and rise.
I have to get into the kitchen and check her wound at once.
“In our next story: before dawn today, a mass disappearance was reported at a hotel in Minamishaki City.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Where did Arcueid go?"
And, I sense someone in the kitchen.
"That idiot, moving around with such a wound."
I get out from under the sheet and stand up.
I have to go to the kitchen and check up on her wound.
"Next on the news.
A massive number of people went missing in the early morning hours at a hotel in southern Minamiyashirogi city."

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　ぴたり、と足が止まる。
　目が、テレビのブラウン管に映るニュースキャスターにくぎ付けになった。
『ホテルに宿泊していた百三名の姿はいまだ発見されていません。
また、ホテル内のいたる所に血痕が見られる事から、警察では何らかの犯罪に巻き込まれたという見解を強めています』
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
My feet stop dead.
My eyes lock on the newscaster inside the television screen.
“None of the hotel’s 103 guests have yet been located; because bloodstains were discovered throughout the building, police increasingly suspect that they may have fallen victim to a crime.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I stop dead in my tracks.
My eyes become glued to the newscaster on the television set.
"One hundred and three people staying at the hotel are still unaccounted for.
Furthermore, bloodstains can be seen within the hotel and the police are beginning to suspect that they were involved in some kind of a crime."

entries.japanese:
「なに―――言ってるんだ。
血痕って、アレは―――そんな可愛いものじゃなかったのに」
　ニュースキャスターは淡々と情報を読み上げていく。
画面は一点して、さっきまで自分がいたホテルの外観と、行方不明になったとされる百三名の宿泊客の名前を一覧した。
―――俺とアルクェイドの名前は、当然のようにない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are they talking about? Calling that bloodstains makes it sound almost harmless.”
The newscaster reads the facts in an even voice. The picture changes to the hotel I left only hours ago, followed by a list naming the 103 guests now reported missing.
―――Naturally, neither my name nor Arcueid’s appears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What----are you saying?
Bloodstains?
It wasn't----something that small and cute."
The newscaster reads off the script with a disinterested tone.
The screen switches to the scene of the hotel I stayed at earlier and then lists the names of the 103 missing people.
----Of course neither my nor Arcueid's name are on the list.

entries.japanese:
『また、ホテル内からは野生動物の体毛が大量に検出されたとのことです。
宿泊客の行方不明に関わっている犯人の手によるものでしょうか、犬や狼、はては熊らしきものの体毛まで検出された模様です。
　検出された動物の体毛は何十種類とあるとのことで、何の冗談でしょうかサメの歯形まで検出――――』
　ぱちん、とテレビのスウィッチを切った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Large quantities of wild-animal hair were also recovered from inside the hotel. It is unclear whether whoever is responsible left it, but samples include hair from dogs, wolves, and even what may be a bear.
Dozens of species have been identified, and—bizarrely—even what appears to be a shark’s bite mark――――
I snap off the television.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Furthermore, a large amount of wild animal hair was found within the hotel.
It is presumed that the hair is connected with the suspect in some way.
Some of the confirmed hair samples appear to be from a large breed of dog, wolves, and there was also evidence of a bear.
There were numerous different hair samples found on the scene.
Ridiculously, what appeared to be shark bites were also reported from the scene----"
Click.
I switch off the television set.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　百人。
百人近くの人間が、あの時間、たった三十分の間に一方的に殺されたっていうのか。
　血痕――――？
　行方不明―――？
　なんでそこまで解っていて、はっきりと口にしない。
　わかりきってる。
　あのホテルに泊まっていた人間はみんな、あのワケのわからない獣たちに、肉片ひとつ残さず食われちまったっていうコトを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
A hundred people. Almost a hundred human beings, slaughtered helplessly in a mere thirty minutes.
Bloodstains?
Missing?
If they know that much, why won’t they say it?
The truth is obvious.
Every person in that hotel was eaten by those incomprehensible beasts until not one scrap of flesh remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
A hundred people.
About a hundred people back then.
In just half an hour, they were all brutally killed.
Blood stains----?
Unaccounted for----?
How can you say that when you have that much information?
I understand completely.
Everyone staying in the hotel was killed by those incomprehensible beasts and devoured without a trace.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――」
　吐き気を堪える。
　いちいち昨夜のことを思い出して嘔吐するなんてコト、俺にはできない。
　そんな脆弱な同情、豚にも劣る。
　あのホテルにいたのに自分だけ死んでいない俺には、その元凶を憎むこと以外は許されまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh—”
I force back the nausea.
I cannot vomit every time last night returns to me.
Pity that feeble is beneath even a pig.
I was in that hotel and alone survived, so I have no right to anything but hatred for the creature responsible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh----"
I resist the urge to throw up.
I can't allow myself to vomit when I recall each and every event which occurred last night.
Such a petty sympathy would set me lower than a filthy pig.
For me, the only one who escaped death in that hotel, I won't allow anything else other than hatred for the one behind it all.

entries.japanese:
百人だ。
　百人の人間が、人間の原形なんて留めないで、ただ血の跡だけを残して殺された。
　黒いコートの男の顔が思い浮かぶ。
　あいつが何者なのかは知らない。
　ただ、ヤツがあの出来事の元凶であることは間違いない。
―――心が、まだ麻痺しているのか。
　恐怖や嫌悪より、今は憎しみが勝っている。
　それとも―――この胸の中で渦巻いている感情さえも、恐怖というものの一種なのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
A hundred.
A hundred people were killed so completely that not even the shape of a human body remained—only traces of blood.
The man in the black coat rises in my mind.
I do not know what he is.
But I know beyond any doubt that he caused it.
