　そこまでしなくていいよ、たんに擦り剥いたところを消毒するだけなんだから！」
「なに言ってるんですっ。
擦り剥き傷だなんて言ってますけど、そんな生易しい傷じゃないですよ、これ」
「いや、でも大丈夫なんだって。
一人でやるからいいんだって」
「だめです。
背中にだってこんな―――」
　背中の傷を見て、琥珀さんは息を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait! You don’t have to go that far; they’re only scrapes, and I just need to disinfect them!”
“What are you talking about? You keep calling them scrapes, but these are far worse than that.”
“I told you, I’m fine. I can do it myself.”
“No. You even have wounds all across your back―――”
Seeing them, Kohaku catches her breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"W-Wait!
You don't have to go that far.
I just wanted to put a little disinfectant on a few scrapes, that's all!"
"What are you saying?
Even if you say you only have a few scratches, they don't look that minor."
"No, I'm fine.
I can do it by myself."
"That won't do.
The ones on your back----"
Seeing the wounds on my back, Kohaku-san gasps.

entries.japanese:
「―――ひどい。
志貴さんのケンカ相手ってドーベルマンだったんですか？」
「……うん。
まあ、似たようなもの」
「―――――――」
　琥珀さんは呆れたようにため息をついた。
「もう、なおさら志貴さんにはお任せできませんっ。
ほら、服を脱いでくださいな。
お洋服を着たままじゃ手当てなんてできないじゃないですかっ」
「いや、だからそんなのは自分で出来るんだって！
　そうたいした傷じゃないんだから、裸になる必要なんかないだろ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“These are terrible. Was the opponent in your ‘fight’ a Doberman, Shiki?”
“Yeah. Something like that.”
“…”
Kohaku sighs in exasperation.
“All the more reason I can’t leave this to you, Shiki. Come on, take your clothes off. I can hardly treat you through them.”
“I said I can do it myself! The wounds aren’t that serious, so there’s no reason for me to get naked!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----How terrible.
Did you get into a fight with a Doberman, Shiki-san?"
"…… Yeah.
Well, something like that."
"--------"
Kohaku-san sighs in amazement.
"Geez, now I really can't let you handle it, Shiki-san.
Come on, please hurry up and take off your clothes.
With your clothing on, I can't take care of you!"
"No, I said I can do it myself!
They aren't a big deal, I don't need to be naked……!"

entries.japanese:
「───ははあ。
照れてるんですね、志貴さん」
　琥珀さんはにんまりと笑うと、かまわず寝巻を脱がしにかかる。
「志貴さんのお体なんて見慣れてます。
いいからお洋服を脱いでください」
「……見慣れてるって、琥珀さん？」
「一度志貴さんの着替えをさせていただきましたから。
背中のほくろの位置までばっちりです」
「っな、っなな、っな」
「ほら、時間がありませんよ。
あんまり時間をかけると秋葉さまに気付かれてしまいます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aha. You’re embarrassed, aren’t you, Shiki?”
Kohaku grins and begins undressing me anyway.
“I’m quite accustomed to seeing your body, Shiki. Now be good and take off your clothes.”
“You’re accustomed to it, Kohaku?”
“I changed your clothes once before, Shiki. I even know exactly where the mole on your back is.”
“Wh-wh-wh-what?”
“Come along, we haven’t much time. If this takes too long, Miss Akiha will notice.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I see.
You must be embarrassed, Shiki-san."
With a smile, she goes ahead and tries to remove my pajamas anyway.
"I am already used to seeing your body, Shiki-san.
Please just take off your clothing."
"…… 'Used to', Kohaku-san?"
"I have already changed your clothing once so I know every detail of your body."
"W-W-Wha?"
"Let's go, we haven't much time.
If you take too long, Akiha-sama will notice."

entries.japanese:
───うっ。
　それを言われると弱い。
　弱いけど、琥珀さんの前で裸になるっていうのは、ちょっと………
「……仕方ありませんね。
それじゃあわたしが診るのは上半身だけにしましょう。
それなら恥ずかしいコトはないでしょう？」
　それでも十分気恥ずかしいが、それが精一杯の譲歩だろう。
「………そう、だね。
じゃあ、お願いします」
　ちょこん、とベッドに腰をおろしてシャツを脱ぐ。
entries.maoEnglish:
───Urgh.
She has me there.
Even so, getting naked in front of Kohaku is a little―――
“Very well. I’ll examine only your upper body. Surely there’s nothing embarrassing about that?”
It is still plenty embarrassing, but this must be the furthest she is willing to compromise.
“All right. Please.”
I perch on the edge of the bed and remove my shirt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Ugh.
I can't argue with that.
But, to get naked in front of Kohaku-san, it's……
"…… I guess it can't be helped.
Then, I will only examine your upper body.
This way, there isn't anything to be embarrassed about, right?"
Even that's embarrassing, but I guess that's the best compromise.
"………… I guess so.
Then, please do."
I sit down on my bed and take off my shirt.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんは慣れた様子で傷の手当てを始めた。
　腕や肩は言うにおよばす、背中の傷まで丁寧に看てくれる。
　消毒薬は傷にしみた。
　しみたが、時折おこる貧血や古傷の痛みに比べればどうって事はない。
　消毒薬をぬるたびに
「わあ、男の子なんですねー」
　なんて琥珀さんは喜んでくれたから、余計痛みを我慢できたのかもしれないが。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku begins treating me with practiced ease.
She tends not only my arms and shoulders, but every wound across my back.
The antiseptic stings.
Even so, compared with my bouts of anemia or the pain from my old scar, it is nothing.
Each time she applies it―――
“Oh, you really are a boy.”
—Kohaku sounds so delighted that perhaps it makes the pain easier to bear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san expertly tends to my wounds.
She carefully tends the wounds on my arms, shoulders and back.
The disinfectant sinks into the wounds.
They sink in, but compared to my occasional dizziness or the pain from my old scar, it's nothing.
While applying the disinfectant,
"Wow, you really are a boy."
Kohaku-san says happily, so it probably helped me to put up with all the pain.

entries.japanese:
「ここは湿布を貼っておきますね。
剥がれるかもしれませんから包帯を巻いておきましょうか」
　痣になっている胸の部分に湿布をはって、くるくると流れるように包帯を巻く。
「はい、これでおしまいです。
両足の手当て、本当にしなくていいんですか？」
「ああ、それぐらいは自分でやるよ。
……ありがと、琥珀さん。
忙しいのに時間をとっちゃって」
「いえいえ、そんなのは気にしないでください。
それじゃあ厨房に戻りますから、手当てが終わりしだい食堂にきてくださいね」
　琥珀さんはドアへ歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll put a compress here. It may come loose, so let’s bandage it in place.”
She lays the compress over the bruise on my chest, then winds the bandage around me in smooth, swift loops.
“There, all finished. Are you certain you don’t want me to treat your legs?”
“Yeah, I can handle those. Thanks, Kohaku. Sorry for taking up your time when you’re busy.”
“Please don’t concern yourself with that. I’ll return to the kitchen now, so come to the dining room once you’ve finished.”
Kohaku starts toward the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Now we have to stick on this compress patch.
It may rub off, so let's bandage it."
She puts a compress over my bruised chest and wraps a bandage around it.
"All finished.
Are you sure you don't want me to do your legs?"
"Yeah, I can do the rest.
…… Thanks, Kohaku-san.
I know you're busy and all."
"No, no.
Please do not worry about it.
Then I'll be going back to the kitchen.
When you are finished, please come to the dining room, okay?"
Kohaku-san walks to the door.

entries.japanese:
「あっ、琥珀さん」
「はい？」
「その───ごめん。
琥珀さんの言うとおり、殴りあいなんて馬鹿げてた。
迷惑をかけてばっかりでさ、いい事なんて一つもないし」
「─────」
　琥珀さんは驚いたように俺を見ると、突然嬉しそうに笑いだした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Kohaku.”
“Yes?”
“I’m sorry. You were right; fighting was stupid. All I did was cause trouble, and nothing good came of it.”
“…”
Kohaku looks at me in surprise, then suddenly breaks into a delighted smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Kohaku-san."
"Yes?"
"Um----sorry.
Like you said, fighting is just stupid.
It's just a big bother, and nothing good ever comes from it."
"------"
Kohaku-san looks at me in amazement and then suddenly starts to laugh happily.

entries.japanese:
「はい、わかりました。
今日のことは大目にみてさしあげますね」
　本当に楽しそうにそう言って、琥珀さんは部屋から静かに退室していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I’ll let you off this once.”
Still looking genuinely pleased, Kohaku quietly leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
I will let it go this time, okay?"
She happily says that and exits the room quietly.

entries.japanese:
―――さて、やってきてしまった。
　ここから扉一枚隔てて、秋葉が待っているという居間がある。
　どんな事情があったにしても、学校を無断欠席して、あまつさえ二日も家に帰ってこなかった事実は弁解のしようがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And now I’m here.
Beyond this single door lies the sitting room where Akiha is waiting.
Whatever my reasons, there is no excuse for skipping school without permission and then failing to come home for two whole days.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Alright, I'm here.
Now only a door separates me from the sitting room where Akiha awaits.
No matter what the circumstance was, there's no excuse for skipping school and not coming home for two days.

entries.japanese: ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish: I should—
entries.mirrorMoon: Now--

entries.japanese:
「……そうだな。
それが一番いいと思う」
　アルクェイドやネロといった『人間外のもの』のことなんて話しても通じないだろうし、本当のことが話せないのなら、せめて素直に謝るべきだ。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah… that’s probably best.”
There is no point trying to explain inhuman beings like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, and if I can’t tell the truth, the least I can do is apologize honestly.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
I think that's the best choice."
I don't think Akiha will understand about non-humans like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, and since I can't tell the truth, I should at least sincerely apologize.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
「―――おはようございます、兄さん」
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「えーと、その……おはよう、秋葉」
「挨拶はいいですから、そこに座ってください。
兄さんに話があります」
「――――――」
　秋葉の言葉には、なにか有無を言わせない迫力がある。
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
“―――Good morning, Brother.”
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Um, well―――good morning, Akiha.”
“We can dispense with the greetings. Sit there, please—I have something to discuss with you.”
“――――――”
Something in Akiha’s voice brooks no refusal.
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"--Good morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me, "I am angry."
"Um, uh…… Morning, Akiha."
"Let's dispense with greetings.
Please sit there.
I wish to speak with you, Nii-san."
"------"
Her words are so forceful, I can't say no.
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from her.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――う」
　聞かせてくれませんか、なんて丁寧口調で言っているものの、秋葉のそれは間違いなく脅迫だ。
　だが、お兄ちゃんはそんなお話を聞かせてあげるわけにはいかないのだ。
「それなんだけど、秋葉」
「はい、なんでしょう」
「悪いんだけど、事情は説明できないんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Shall we begin with an account of where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Urgh”
She phrases it as a courteous request, but make no mistake: this is a threat.
Unfortunately, her big brother cannot possibly tell his little sister any of that.
“About that, Akiha…”
“Yes?”
“I’m sorry, but I can’t explain the circumstances.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"----Ugh."
Despite her polite language, Akiha's words are unmistakably a threat.
But, her Onii-chan cannot tell her such a story.

"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it?"
"I'm sorry, but I can't tell you."

entries.japanese:
がちゃん。
　と、秋葉の持っていたティーカップがテーブル
に落ちた。
　いや、意図的に落とした、という表現の方が近かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crash.
Akiha’s teacup drops
onto the table.
No—saying she deliberately slammed it down would be closer to the truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Crash.
The teacup that Akiha was holding falls to the table.
Rather, I think she dropped it intentionally.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま―――」
「ああ、ごめんなさい翡翠。
急いで片付けてもらえる？」
　翡翠が無言でこぼれた紅茶とか、割れた（とても高級そうな）ティーカップを片付けていく。
　その様子を、こっちは秋葉に睨まれながら気まずく見つめていた。
　片付けを終えて、翡翠が厨房に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha―――”
“Oh, I’m sorry, Hisui. Would you clean that up at once?”
Without a word, Hisui clears away the spilled tea and the broken—and very expensive-looking—teacup.
I watch awkwardly under Akiha’s glare.
Once she has finished, Hisui carries everything into the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama---"
"Oh, I'm sorry, Hisui.
Would you please clean it up?"
Hisui silently cleans up the spilled tea and the shards of the (very expensive-looking) teacup.
I uneasily watch her do so while Akiha is glaring at me.
Once done cleaning, Hisui goes to the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
「―――それで、兄さん」
「……なに？」
「もう一度、お聞きしていいでしょうか？」
　秋葉は諦めていない。
　意地でも俺から話を聞こうとしている気迫がありありと感じ取れる。
　それでも、やっぱり話すわけにはいかないと思う。
　自分のためという事もあるけど、秋葉のためにもこんな話はするべきじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Now then, Brother.”
“―――What?”
“May I ask you once more?”
Akiha has not given up.
I can feel her determination to drag the story out of me by sheer force.
Even so, I still can’t tell her.
Partly for my own sake—but also because Akiha should never be burdened with any of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Then, Nii-san."
"…… Yes?"
"Could I ask you again?"
Akiha doesn't give up.
I can feel her drive to get the story out of me no matter what.
But still, I don't think I can tell her about it.
Of course not just for my sake, but hers as well.

entries.japanese:
「……だめだ。
何度聞かれたって話せないものは話せない。
秋葉にはいらない心配をかけさせて悪いと思ってる。
けど、話せない事は話せないんだ」
「―――悪い、と思っているのに話せないんですね、兄さんは」
「そうだよ。
連絡をいれなかったり、事情を話せない事はすまないと思ってる。
でもこの二日間、悪いコトはしていない。
……あれが間違っていた事だなんて、思いたくない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. Ask as many times as you want; I can’t tell you. I’m sorry I’ve made you worry for nothing, Akiha. But some things simply can’t be said.”
“―――You feel sorry, and yet you still refuse to tell me, Brother?”
“That’s right. I’m sorry I didn’t contact you, and I’m sorry I can’t explain. But I did nothing wrong during those two days. I don’t want to believe that what happened was a mistake.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
No matter how many times you ask me, I can't tell you.
I feel sorry that I made you worry, but I can't tell you about it."
"--Even though you are sorry, you can't tell me, Nii-san."
"That's right.
I'm sorry I haven't contacted you and for not being able to talk about it.
But I haven't done anything wrong the past two days.
…… I don't even want to think that was a wrong thing to do."

entries.japanese:
―――そう。
　殺したり殺されたり、そんな意味合いしかなかった二日間だったけど、あれは――正しいことだったのだと思いたい。
　アルクェイドを助けるためというのもあったけど、なにより―――俺は、あの人食いの怪物を殺したことを後悔はしてない。
　少なくとも、これ以上街で血を吸われて殺されてる、なんていう犠牲者が出るという事はなくなるんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes.
Those two days were filled with nothing but killing and nearly being killed, yet I want to believe that what we did was right.
I want to believe that going to help Arcueid was the right thing to do, and more than anything―――I do not regret it in the least.
At the very least, no one else in this city will be drained of blood and murdered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's right.
Even these past two days were simply kill or be killed--I want to believe it was the right thing to do.
I did it to help Arcueid, but most of all… I do not regret killing that cannibalistic monster.
At least, there will be no more victims killed by having their blood drained.

entries.japanese:
「―――ごめんな、秋葉。
迷惑をかけてすまないけど、これ以上は聞かないでくれ」
「―――――――」
　秋葉はじっとこっちの目を見つめてくる。
　しばらく、そんな息苦しい時間が続いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I’m sorry, Akiha. I know I’ve caused trouble, but please don’t ask me anything more.”
“―――――――”
Akiha stares into my eyes.
The suffocating silence continues for some time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I'm sorry, Akiha.
I'm sorry to make you worry, but please don't ask me anymore."
"------"
Akiha stares at my eyes.
For a while, she stays like that.

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
考えてみれば兄さんにも兄さんの事情があるんでしょうし、私がそれに深く干渉することはできませんものね」
「……悪い。
そう言ってもらえると、助かる」
「――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. Now that I consider it, you must have circumstances of your own, and it isn’t my place to pry too deeply into them.”
“I’m sorry. It helps to hear you say that.”
“――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
Thinking about it, you must have your reasons, so I won't press you on this anymore, Nii-san."
"…… I'm sorry.
Thanks for understanding."
"-----"

entries.japanese:
もう、なんとか誤魔化すしかないだろう。
　そもそもアルクェイドやネロといった『人間外のもの』のことなんて話しても通じないだろうし、それなら出来るだけ嘘を言わないで、かといって真実も言わない、という方針でいくしかない。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I’ll simply have to bluff my way through.
There is no chance she would understand talk of inhuman beings like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, so my only option is to avoid lying as much as possible while revealing none of the truth.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well, I just have to deceive her somehow.
I don't think Akiha will understand about non-humans like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, so I'll have to minimize my lying without telling the truth.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
「―――おはようございます、兄さん」
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「えーと、その……おはよう、秋葉」
「挨拶はいいですから、そこに座ってください。
兄さんに話があります」
「――――――」
　秋葉の言葉には、なにか有無を言わせない迫力がある。
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
“―――Good morning, Brother.”
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Um, well―――good morning, Akiha.”
“We can dispense with the greetings. Sit there, please—I have something to discuss with you.”
“――――――”
Something in Akiha’s voice brooks no refusal.
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"--Good morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me, "I am angry."
"Um, uh…… Morning, Akiha."
"Let's dispense with greetings.
Please sit there.
I wish to speak with you, Nii-san."
"------"
Her words are so forceful, I can't say no.
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――う」
　聞かせてくれませんか、なんて丁寧口調で言っているものの、秋葉のそれは間違いなく脅迫だ。
　だが、お兄ちゃんはそんなお話を聞かせてあげるわけにはいかないのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Shall we begin with an account of where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Urgh”
She phrases it as a courteous request, but make no mistake: this is a threat.
Unfortunately, her big brother cannot possibly tell his little sister any of that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"----Ugh."
Despite her polite language, Akiha's words are unmistakably a threat.
But, her Onii-chan cannot tell her such a story.

entries.japanese:
「それなんだけど、秋葉」
「はい、なんでしょう」
「実は、ちょっとした知り合いとばったり再会して、そいつに街を案内してやってたんだ」
「へえ。
ちょっとした知り合い、ですか」
「ああ、最近知り合ったヤツなんだけど、そいつと学校の前で会っちゃってさ。
その、日曜日まででいいからどうしても付き合ってほしいっていうから、その―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“About that, Akiha…”
“Yes?”
“The truth is, I ran into an acquaintance I hadn’t seen in a while and ended up showing them around town.”
“Oh? Just an acquaintance?”
“Yeah, someone I met recently; we ran into each other outside the school. They said they desperately needed me to stay with them until Sunday, so―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it?"
"The truth is, I ran into a minor acquaintance of mine and I showed that person around the city."
"Oh?
A minor acquaintance?"
"Yeah, I got to know the person just recently, and we met just outside of school.
I was asked to keep this acquaintance company until Sunday, so--"

entries.japanese:
「学校を休んで、無断外泊をした、という事ですね」
　……うう、秋葉の視線が冷たい。
　あれは怒っている、っていうより呆れてるぞ、ぜったい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you skipped school and spent the night away without permission.”
Urgh—Akiha’s stare is glacial.
That isn’t anger so much as utter exasperation—I’m sure of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So you skipped school and stayed away from home without even notifying me or asking permission."
…… Akiha's gaze is extremely frigid.
She seems even more shocked than angry.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
「…………………」
　黙り込む俺と、無言で視線を向けてくる秋葉。
「それで、誰なんですか」
「え？」
「その知り合いというのは誰なんですか、と聞いたんです、私は」
　まっすぐに秋葉はこっちの目を見据えてくる。
　『絶対に誤魔化されませんから』という意思が、ありありと伝わってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“…”
I say nothing while Akiha stares at me in silence.
“And who was it?”
“What?”
“I asked who this acquaintance was.”
Akiha looks me straight in the eye.
Her expression could not make it clearer: You will not wriggle out of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
"…………………"
I remain quiet as Akiha stares at me wordlessly.
"And, who was it?"
"Eh?"
"I asked who this acquaintance of yours is."
She looks at me directly in the eye.
I can feel her thinking, "I will not be deceived".

entries.japanese:
「―――いや、それは―――」
「言えない、という事は何か後ろめたい事がある、という事よ、兄さん」
　じっ、と秋葉の視線が突き刺さる。
　目を逸らすと余計いじめられそうなので、負けじと秋葉の顔を見つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Well, that is―――”
“If you cannot tell me, then you must have something to feel guilty about, Brother.”
Her gaze pierces straight through me.
Looking away would only encourage her to torment me, so I stare stubbornly back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Well, I--"
"If you can't tell me, that means you feel guilty about it, Nii-san."
Her gaze shoots right through me.
I get the feeling she'll attack me more if I look away, so I stare back at her.

entries.japanese:
……いや、まったく関係ないけど。
　こう見ると秋葉には昔の面影がまったくない。
　凛と伸びた背筋、はっきりとした口調、ゆらぐ事のない瞳。
　不謹慎な話だけど、純粋に、美人になったな、なんて思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
This has nothing to do with anything, but looking at her now, I can find no trace of the Akiha I remember.
Her proud, straight back.
Her crisp voice; those unwavering eyes.
It is a wildly inappropriate thought at the moment, but she really has grown into a beautiful woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, this is totally random, but…
She does not remind me of the Akiha from back then.
Her stretched back, her perfect posture, her unwavering eyes.
Perhaps this is imprudent, but I honestly think she has become very beautiful.

entries.japanese:
「あのさ、秋葉」
「なに？」
「おまえ、眉わりと太いんだな」
「――――――！？」
　がたん、とテーブルに足をひっかけて、秋葉と立ちあがった。
「…………あ」
　なんていうか、ものすごい驚きっぷりだ。
「……わかんないヤツだな。
いまの、驚くところじゃないだろ」
「―――――――――」
　はあー、と深呼吸をして、秋葉は肩をすくめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Akiha.”
“What?”
“You’ve got pretty thick eyebrows, don’t you?”
“――――――!?”
Akiha jerks to her feet and catches the table with her leg.
“―――Oh.”
That is an astonishing reaction.
“You’re impossible to understand. That wasn’t something to be shocked about.”
“―――――――――”
Akiha draws a long breath and lets her shoulders drop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, Akiha."
"What?"
"Your eyebrows are pretty thick."
"------!?"
Bam!
Akiha's leg smacks the table as she jumps up.
"………… Ah."
How do I say this--she's surprisingly surprised?
"…… I don't get you at all.
That wasn't something to be surprised about."
"---------"
With a deep breath, Akiha slumps her shoulders.

entries.japanese:
「兄さんには、真面目に答えようとする意思がないみたいですね」
「……そんなコトないぞ。
誓っていうけど、俺は秋葉に嘘はつかないよ。
ただ、ちょっと言えないことが多いだけなんだ」
「もうっ。
ほんっとーに、昔から誠実なんだか不誠実なんだかわからない人なんですから、兄さんは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It seems you have no intention of answering me seriously.”
“That’s not true. I swear, I won’t lie to you, Akiha. There just happen to be a great many things I can’t tell you.”
“Honestly! Ever since we were children, I’ve never been able to tell whether you’re sincere or insincere, Brother.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, it seems like you do not wish to answer me seriously."
"…… That's not right.
Honestly, I won't lie to you.
It's just that I have a lot of things I can't say to you."
"Geez.
Really, ever since we were small I was never able to tell if you were an honest or dishonest person, Nii-san."

entries.japanese:
「……そうなの？
　俺、子供のころの自分ってよく覚えてないんだけど」
「覚えてなくていいです。
なんか、私も変わってない。
どうせこうなるってわかってるのに兄さんを問い詰めるなんて、成長がないのかしら」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Really? I don’t remember myself very well as a child.”
“You’re better off not remembering. It seems I haven’t changed either. Perhaps I haven’t grown at all, interrogating you even though I know perfectly well how this will end.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?
I don't really remember how I was when I was small."
"You don't have to remember.
But, I haven't changed either.
Pressing you like this even when I know how it will turn out… maybe I haven't grown up at all."

entries.japanese:
―――本当の事を話してみよう。
　秋葉に嘘をつくのが嫌だし、誠心誠意をこめて説明すれば秋葉も分かってくれるかもしれない。
　……まあ、宝くじに当たるか当たらないかぐらいの確率で。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll try telling her the truth.
I hate lying to Akiha, and if I explain everything with complete sincerity, perhaps she will understand.
The odds are roughly the same as winning the lottery, but still.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'll try telling the truth.
I don't want to lie to Akiha, and if I explain everything sincerely, Akiha may understand.
…… Well, the possibility of that is like winning a lottery.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「やっ。
おはよう秋葉」
　開き直った人間は強い。
　いじめっ子のような秋葉の視線に負けじと明るい挨拶を返せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Hey. Good morning, Akiha!”
Once a man has resigned himself to disaster, nothing can frighten him.
I return her bullying stare with the brightest greeting I can muster.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"---Good morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me, "I am angry."
"Yo, morning, Akiha."
A defiant person is strong.
I give a cheerful greeting to Akiha's bullying gaze.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　こっちの陽気さに面食らったのか、秋葉はじっと見つめてくる。
「兄さん、挨拶はいいですからそこに座ってください。
話したいことがあるんです」
「わかった。
できるだけ手短にな」
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
Perhaps my cheerfulness catches her off guard, because Akiha merely stares.
“Brother, enough greetings. Sit down, please. I have something to discuss with you.”
“All right, but keep it brief.”
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
She might be confused with my cheerfulness, as she just stares at me.
"Nii-san, let's dispense with the greetings.
Please sit here; I wish to speak with you."
"Sure.
Let's keep it short though."
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「それでは兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――ん」
　……やっぱりそうきたか。
　二日間も家を留守にしてしまった以上、どんな言い訳もきかない。
　正直に、アルクェイドと過ごした二日間を打ち明けよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let us begin. Would you tell me where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Mm.”
Just as I expected.
After staying away from home for two days, no excuse could possibly save me.
I will tell her honestly about the two days I spent with Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"-----Hm."
…… I knew it.
Since I left the house for two days, there's no excuse.
Time to honestly tell her all about Arcueid and these past two days.

entries.japanese:
「それなんだけどな、秋葉」
「はい、なんですか兄さん」
「この二日間、俺は吸血鬼を退治していたんだ。
この街に連続殺人事件が起きているのは知ってるだろう？
　その犯人が吸血鬼だっていうんで、ちょこっと知りあった『いい吸血鬼』に手をかして、『悪い吸血鬼』と戦ったんだよ」
―――――とまあ、実に簡潔に説明した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“About that, Akiha.”
“Yes, Brother?”
“For the last two days, I was exterminating a vampire. You know about the serial murders in town, right? The killer turned out to be a vampire, so I joined forces with a ‘good vampire’ I happened to meet and fought the ‘bad vampire.’”
―――――There: a remarkably concise explanation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it, Nii-san?"
"These past two days, I was hunting a vampire.
You know about the recent killings, right?
They were the work of a vampire, so I helped the 'good vampire' I met recently, and I fought with the 'bad vampire'."
----Like that, I explain concisely.

entries.japanese:
「なっ―――――――」
　秋葉は物の見事に固まってしまっている。
　……まあ、まずは順当な反応といえるかもしれない。
　秋葉の中では今、俺に馬鹿にされているという考えが渦巻いていて、次の瞬間にも
「バカにしてるんですか、兄さんはっ！！！！」
　なんて、怒鳴ってくるに決まって―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――――――”
Akiha freezes dead still.
A reasonable first reaction, I suppose.
Right now, her mind must be seething with the conviction that I am making a fool of her, and at any moment she will
“Are you making fun of me, Brother?!”
Yes, she is bound to shout something like that―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
Akiha is taken completely by surprise.
…… Well, I guess it is a natural reaction.
In her head, she's probably thinking I'm making a fool of her, and anytime in the next instant,
"Are you making a fool out of me, Nii-san!!!!???"
She'll shout something like that to me--

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　………あれ？
　怒っていることは怒っているみたいだけど、秋葉は何も言ってこない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
What?
She certainly looks angry, but Akiha says nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
……… Huh?
She seems upset, but she doesn't say anything.

entries.japanese:
「あの……秋葉？」
「……兄さん。
今のは、質の悪い冗談ですか」
「――――――う」
　秋葉は静かに、こっちの心を見通しかねない眼差しを向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Akiha?”
“Brother. Was that some particularly tasteless joke?”
“――――――Urgh.”
Akiha regards me quietly, her gaze threatening to see straight through my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Akiha?"
"…… Nii-san, is this some sort of a bad joke?"
"------Uh…"
Akiha looks at me quietly, like she was seeing directly into my heart.

entries.japanese:
「いや……その、なんていうか」
「冗談、でしょう？」
「……まあ、そうとられても仕方がない、けど」
「―――いえ、冗談に決まっています。
ですから、今後はたとえ冗談だとしても、そのような事は口にしないでください」
　じっ、と怒っている、というよりは不安そうな目で秋葉は俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—I mean, well.”
“It was a joke, wasn’t it?”
“I suppose I can’t blame you for taking it that way, but…”
“―――No, it was unquestionably a joke. In the future, please do not say such things, even in jest.”
Akiha stares at me, looking less angry now than deeply uneasy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No…… well, how should I put this…"
"A joke, right?"
"…… Well, I know it sounds like one, but…"
"---No, it has to be a joke.
So please do not say such things in the future, even if it is a joke."
She stares at me, more uneasy than angry.

entries.japanese:
その眼差しがあんまりにも真摯だったから、
「……………ん」
　と、曖昧に頷く事しか、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her gaze is so painfully earnest that
“Mm”
is all I can manage as I give her an uncertain nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since her stare looks so serious,
"……………… Yeah."
I can only nod to her.

entries.japanese:
「わかりました。
今回のことはこれ以上はお聞きしません。
けれど、今後はこのような事は控えてください。
兄さんは遠野家の長男なんですから、もう少しご自分の立場というものを理解していただかないと困ります」
「―――む。
なんだよ、それは関係ないだろ。
だいたい遠野の跡取りは秋葉に決まったんだから、俺がなにをしようがいいじゃないか。
家の事を思うなら、遠野の家に相応しい婿養子でも見つければいいのに」
「―――――」
　……？
　なぜか秋葉は黙り込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I won’t question you any further about this. But please refrain from doing anything like it again. You are the eldest son of the Tohno family, Brother. You must show some awareness of your position.”
“―――What does that have to do with anything? You’re already the Tohno heir, so what I do shouldn’t matter. If you’re worried about the family, find some suitable man to marry into it.”
“―――――”
What?
For some reason, Akiha falls silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
Then, I will no longer ask about this.
But, please refrain from doing anything like this ever again.
Nii-san, you are the eldest son of the Tohno family; if you do not understand your position better, it will be very troubling."
"--Hey, that has nothing to do with this.
Besides, you're the successor to the Tohno family, so it doesn't really matter what I do.
If you're so worried about the future of the Tohno family, you should go find a husband appropriate for the Tohno household."
"-----"
……?
For some reason, Akiha descends into silence.

entries.japanese:
「どうした？
　気分でも悪いのか、秋葉」
「――なんでもありません。
私のことを気遣う余裕があるのでしたら、ご自分の体調を気にしてください。
慢性的な貧血持ちなんですから、兄さんは」
「………む」
　……そりゃあたしかに、こっちは頻繁に貧血で倒れたりするけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Akiha? Are you feeling ill?”
“――It’s nothing. If you have time to worry about me, spend it worrying about your own health. You suffer from chronic anemia, Brother.”
“Right.”
She has a point, since I do collapse from anemia rather frequently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's wrong?
Are you feeling alright, Akiha?"
"--It's nothing.
If you have enough time to worry about me, please pay more attention to yourself.
You have your chronic anemia to worry about, Nii-san."
"……… Hmph."
…… Well, it is true that I frequently collapse from anemia.

entries.japanese:
「ともかく、あまりお一人で屋敷を出ないでください。
それでなくとも近頃の街は物騒なんですから。
　兄さんみたいにぼう、としている人は通り魔に襲ってください、と言っているようなものです」
「通り魔って―――ああ、例の連続殺人か」
　たしか九人ぐらいの犠牲者が出ている、という連続殺人事件。
　死体はすべて血液を搾取されているところから現代の吸血鬼か、なんて言われていたけど――
entries.maoEnglish:
“In any case, please don’t leave the mansion alone so often. The city has become dangerous lately.
Someone as absentminded as you might as well hang a sign asking to be attacked.”
“Attacked―――oh, you mean those serial murders.”
The serial murders with nine victims, if I remember correctly.
Every corpse was drained of blood, prompting lurid talk of a modern-day vampire—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, please do not leave the mansion by yourself often.
Even without that, the city is dangerous recently.
Someone like you, who meanders about in a daze is just asking to be attacked by that serial killer."
"Serial killer?--Oh, those serial killings."
Those serial killings where nine victims have been found.
Their bodies were all drained of blood, so they call it the modern day vampire, but--

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それなら大丈夫。
あんな事件、二度と起きないから」
「――――は？」
「吸血鬼はいないっていうことだよ。
その犯人は、もう捕まったんだ」
「そうなんですか……？
　兄さん、よくそんなことを知っていますね」
「ま、たまたま見ただけだけど、たしかに、もうあんな事件は起きないんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, you don’t need to worry about that. It won’t happen again.”
“――――What?”
“I mean the vampire is gone. The killer has already been caught.”
“Has he…? Brother, how could you possibly know that?”
“I only happened to see it, but I’m certain there won’t be another murder like that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, that's okay.
Those incidents, they won't ever happen again."
"----Huh?"
"It means the vampire isn't around anymore.
That killer--is caught already."
"Is that so……?
Nii-san, how do you know about that?"
"Well, I just happened to see it, but for sure, such things will not happen again."

entries.japanese:
……そう、少なくともこれ以上ネロに殺される人はいない。
　アルクェイドと過ごした二日間は、そりゃあ色々ありすぎて何が正しくて何が悪かったか、なんて言えない。
　けど、その事実だけは―――胸を張って良かったって言える事だと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes—at least no one else will die at Nrvnqsr’s hands.
Too much happened during those two days with Arcueid for me to say what was right and what was wrong.
But that one fact―――I can hold my head high and call it a good thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yeah, at least there won't be any more people killed by Nrvnqsr.
These past two days spent with Arcueid… so many things happened I really can't say just what is right and what is wrong.
But, the simple truth remains--I can say it was all for the best.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん―――？
　どうしたんです、急に嬉しそうな顔をして」
　秋葉は不思議そうにこちらの顔を覗いてくる。
「べつになんでもない。
ただ、終わったんだなって、ようやく実感できただけだから」
　知らずに笑顔で、俺はそんな返答をしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Why do you suddenly look so pleased?”
Akiha peers at me, puzzled.
“It’s nothing. I’ve only just realized that it’s finally over.”
Before I know it, I am smiling as I answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san----?
What happened?
You suddenly seem very happy."
Akiha looks strangely at my face.
"It's nothing.
I just feel that it's finally, finally over."
A smile unconsciously creeps over my lips as I answer.

entries.japanese:
時刻は七時半になった。
　秋葉は俺より二十分も先に（しかも車で！
）登校している。
　琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食をおいしくいただいて、学校に向かう事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is half past seven.
Akiha left for school twenty minutes before me. And by car, no less!
I enjoy the breakfast Kohaku prepared, then set off for school myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's half past seven.
Akiha left twenty minutes earlier than me, by car!
After eating Kohaku-san's delicious breakfast, I decide to head for school.

entries.japanese:
翡翠は鞄を持って門まで付き添ってくる。
「それじゃ行ってきます。
見送りありがとうな、翡翠」
　翡翠は無言で鞄を手渡してくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui carries my bag and accompanies me to the gate.
“I’m off, then. Thanks for seeing me out, Hisui.”
She silently places the bag in my hands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui walks with me to the gate, carrying my bag.
"Well, I'll be going.
Thanks for seeing me off, Hisui."
Hisui wordlessly hands me my bag.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お帰りは何時ごろでしょうか？」
「俺も信用がないんだな。
大丈夫、今日はちゃんと夕方までには帰ってくるから」
「―――かしこまりました。
それでは行ってらっしゃいませ」
　翡翠はふかぶかとおじぎをする。
　それに照れくさいものを感じつつ、屋敷の門を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What time should we expect you home, Master Shiki?”
“I really have lost everyone’s trust, haven’t I? Don’t worry—I’ll be back by evening today.”
“―――Very well. Have a safe day.”
Hisui bows deeply.
Feeling more than a little self-conscious, I leave the mansion gates behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, around what time will you be returning?"
"You don't trust me either?
It's okay.
I'll definitely be back in the afternoon."
"--I understand.
Then please be careful on your way."
Hisui bows deeply.
Feeling a bit embarrassed about it, I leave the mansion's gate.

entries.japanese:
交差点にはうちの高校の生徒たちしかいない。
　あの時のように、ガードレールに腰を下ろして誰かを待っている女性の姿はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The intersection is occupied only by students from my school.
There is no woman sitting on the guardrail, waiting for someone as she did before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At the intersection there are only the figures of my fellow high school students.
No young woman sitting on the guardrail like that one time.

entries.japanese:
「―――ま、当たり前か」
　あいつとはもう会う事はないだろう。
　そもそもあいつの目的は吸血鬼を退治する事だったらしいから、ネロが消えた今この街に残っている理由がない。
―――少し、胸に残ってる。
　後悔とか、未練とか、そういったものが。
　そりゃああいつは厄介ごとしか持ち出さないヤツだったけど、それでも少しは……まあ、一緒にいれて楽しかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Well, of course not.”
I will probably never see her again.
Her purpose seems to have been hunting vampires, and with Nrvnqsr gone, she has no reason to remain in this city.
―――Still, something lingers in my chest.
Regret, perhaps, or reluctance to let go.
She brought me nothing but trouble, certainly, but I still enjoyed being with her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Well, of course."
I probably won't ever see her again.
First of all, her goal was to execute the vampire, and with Nrvnqsr gone, there's no reason for her to stay around here any longer.
--Just a little bit, in my chest.
Things like regret… and lingering affection.
It is true she only brought trouble, but even still…… it was fun being with her.

entries.japanese:
「……って、バカか俺は」
　一度殺されかけたっていうのに、何が未練なんだか。
　昨夜の傷は体をキリキリと痛ませている。
　……ネロのケモノたちのエサになりかけた時のことを思い出せ。
遠野志貴は、もう二度とあんな目にあうのはゴメンな筈だ。
　学校の予鈴が鳴り響く。
「―――やばっ、遅刻する」
　つまらない雑念を振り払って、正門に向かって走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What am I, an idiot?”
She nearly got me killed, and I’m standing here feeling wistful?
Last night’s wounds still gnaw at my body.
Remember how close you came to being fed to Nrvnqsr’s beasts. Shiki Tohno wants no part of anything like that ever again.
The warning bell rings through the school.
“―――Damn, I’m going to be late!”
I shake off the useless thoughts and sprint for the main gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What, am I stupid?"
I almost got killed… What part of that would make me feel lingering affection?
The wounds from last night still hurt.
…… Remember back to when you almost became Nrvnqsr's food.
You certainly don't want something like that to ever happen again.
The school bell rings.
"----Crap, I'll be late."
Shaking off my idle thoughts, I run to the school gate.

entries.japanese:
教室に駆け込む。
　ホームルーム五分前、教室の中は未だにがやがやと騒がしい。
「―――ふう」
　一息をついて机に向かう。
　この分なら、別段走る必要はなかったかもしれない。
「いょぉう、さぼり魔」
「…………」
　背後から、聞きなれたあまりよろしくない声がかけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I rush into the classroom.
Homeroom is still five minutes away, and the room remains full of noise.
“Whew.”
I catch my breath and head for my desk.
At this rate, I probably never needed to run.
“Well, look who finally decided to show up.”
“…”
A familiar and thoroughly unwelcome voice calls from behind me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fly into my classroom.
It's still five minutes before class, so it's very noisy inside.
"--Whew."
I take a breath and head to my seat.
With this much time left, I didn't even need to run at all.
"Yo, Duke of Delinquency."
"………"
From behind, I hear the voice I never look forward to.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんだよ遠野。
おまえが学校をさぼるなんて聞いてないぞオレ。
こまるじゃんか、ちゃんと今日はさぼって遊びに行くぞって報告してくれなくちゃ！」
　やけに嬉しそうな顔で、有彦はたわけた言葉を吐き出してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened, Tohno? Nobody told me you were cutting class. That’s a serious problem—if you’re going to ditch school and have fun, you’re supposed to notify me in advance!”
Arihiko spouts this nonsense with an absurdly delighted grin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's going on, Tohno?
I never heard you were skipping class.
It's a lot of trouble.
You have to tell me when you skip school and go play!"
Arihiko says those preposterous words with an unbelievably happy expression.

entries.japanese:
「……あのさ。
なんで俺が学校を休むってことをいちいちおまえに報告しなくちゃいけないんだ」
「あったりまえだろ。
遠野が来ないってコトは先輩もうちの教室にやってこないんだから、事前に手をうっておかないとまずいじゃねえか」
　……だから、一体何がまずいんだろうか、この男は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on. Why should I have to report every absence to you?”
“Isn’t it obvious? If you don’t show up, she doesn’t visit our classroom either, so I need advance warning to make other arrangements.”
What exactly he needs to arrange remains a mystery.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why should I have to tell you when I don't go to school?"
"Isn't it obvious?
When you don't show, neither does Senpai, so it's bad unless I think of something ahead of time."
…… What's bad for this guy?

entries.japanese:
「しっかしさ、ホントのところはどうなんだよ。
おまえは中学からこっち、貧血持ちのくせに学校だけは休まなかっただろ。
まあ、そりゃあ登校した瞬間に帰るっていう離れ技は何度かあったけどな」
「それと似たようなものだよ。
交差点あたりまでは登校したんだけど、そこで気分が悪くなって帰ったんだ」
「ふーん。
弓塚といいおまえといい、最近素行が悪いんじゃないか？」
「――まあ、素行が悪いっていうのは否定しないけど……弓塚さん、どうかしたの？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Seriously, though, what happened? You’ve had anemia since middle school, but you never actually missed class. Sure, you pulled that stunt where you arrived and went straight home a few times.”
“This was much the same. I made it as far as the intersection, felt sick, and turned back.”
“Huh. First Yumizuka, now you—both of you have been acting up lately.”
“――I won’t deny that, but did something happen to Yumizuka?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But seriously--What happened?
Since middle school, you've had anemia, but never skipped school.
Well, you did that cool trick several times, leaving as soon as you arrived."
"It's kind of like that.
I made it to the intersection and felt bad, so I went back home."
"Hmmm… Both you and Yumizuka seem to be acting like bad students lately."
"--Well, I'm guilty as charged, but…… is something wrong with Yumizuka-san?"

entries.japanese:
「うん？
　ああ、ここんとこずっと欠席。
あいつもずっと優等生してたからさ、いいかげんテンパッてたんじゃないか？
　だけどフリテンだから上がれないんだぜ、きっと」
「……………」
　有彦の例え話は、なんというか独特だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm? Oh, she’s been absent for days. Maybe playing model student for so long finally left her one tile from a breakdown. But I bet she already discarded her winning tile, so now she can’t go out.”
“…”
Arihiko’s metaphors occupy a world entirely their own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Her?
She's been absent lately.
She was always such an honor student, so I think she might have been stressed out.
But I bet she can't call a raise 'cause she has a bad hand."
"……………"
Arihiko's words are always… very unique.

entries.japanese:
と、ホームルーム開始のチャイムが鳴り響いた。
「おっと、んじゃオレはこれで。
土曜日さぼった分、まじめに勉学に励むんだぞ」
　有彦はいそいそと教室を出ていった。
　つまり、今日はあいつが学校をさぼるという事らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
The homeroom bell rings.
“Oops—I’ll leave you to it, then. Make up for skipping Saturday by applying yourself to your studies.”
Arihiko hurries out of the classroom.
In other words, he intends to cut school today.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The homeroom chime rings out.
"Well, I'm off.
Since you skipped Saturday, make sure you study hard today."
Arihiko leaves the room quickly.
In other words, he's going to skip class today.

entries.japanese:
午前の部、終了。
　昼休みを告げる予鈴とともに、教室の人口は半分ほどに減ってしまった。
「……さて、どうしようかな」
　有彦もいないし、今日はゆっくり昼飯をとることにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The morning session ends.
At the bell for lunch, half the classroom empties almost at once.
“Now what?”
Arihiko is gone, so I may as well take my time over lunch today.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Morning classes end.
With the bell announcing lunchtime, half the people in the classroom clear out.
"…… Well then, what should I do?"
Arihiko isn't here, so I should take my time and eat lunch.

entries.japanese:
「あれ？
　遠野くん一人なんですか？」
「そうだけど―――先輩、もしかして昼飯食べにきたの？」
「はい、みんなで食べようと思って急いでやってきたんですけど―――」
　じっ、と。
　なんの前触れもなく、先輩は俺の顔を真剣に見つめてきた。
　何を思ったのか、先輩はそのまま俺にぴたりと寄り添ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh? Are you all alone, Tohno?”
“Yes―――did you come here for lunch, Ciel?”
“Yes—I hurried over because I thought we could all eat together, but―――”
Her gaze locks on me.
Without warning, Ciel studies my face in deadly earnest.
Whatever has come over her, she moves in until her body is pressed close against mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
Tohno-kun, you're by yourself?"
"Yeah----Senpai, did you come here to eat?"
"Yes, I thought I would eat with everyone so I hurried over here, but----"
She stares.
Without any warning, she looks at my face intently.
I don't know what she's thinking, but she suddenly draws close to me.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ――せ、先輩……？」
　すぐ近くに先輩の体がある。
　ほとんど抱き合っているような身近さ。
　これじゃあ心臓がドキドキしないほうがどうかしてる。
「―――――」
　先輩は何も言わない。
　ただ俺の体に寄り添って―――くんくん、と匂いをかいでいたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait――Ciel?”
Her body is right there.
We are practically embracing.
Anyone’s heart would start hammering at this distance.
“―――――”
Ciel says nothing.
She merely nestles close―――and starts sniffing me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey--Se, Senpai……?"
She's right next to me.
Almost embracing distance.
Something would be wrong with my heart if it wasn't beating quickly.
"------"
Senpai doesn't say anything.
She only stands right next to me----and sniffs.

entries.japanese:
「――――はい？」
　……なにしてるんだろ、この人は。
　先輩はそのまま、ぱっと俺から離れる。
「……あの、先輩？」
「遠野くん、なにかありました？」
　じっ、と真剣な眼差しで尋ねられる。
　はっきりいって、これっぽっちもワケがわからない。
「何かって……その、何が？」
「わかりません。
わからないから聞いているんです」
　先輩は上目遣いで、なんだか怒っているようにも見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
What on earth is she doing?
Then Ciel abruptly steps away.
“Um, Ciel?”
“Did something happen to you, Tohno?”
She asks with absolute seriousness.
I have no idea what she means.
“Something―――like what?”
“I don’t know. That’s why I’m asking.”
She peers up at me and somehow looks almost angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Huh?"
…… What is she doing?
Senpai then gets away.
"…… Um, Senpai?"
"Tohno-kun, did something happen?"
She asks me with a serious look.
To be blunt, I don't know what's going on.
"Something…… uh, like what?"
"I don't know.
I don't know, that's why I'm asking."
She looks up at me as if she was angry.

entries.japanese:
「別に――俺はいつも通りだけど。
なに、なにかおかしいの、今日の俺って？」
「うーん、それがわたしにもよくわかりません。
なんとなく思っただけですから、気のせいなのかもしれませんね」
「………？」
　はて、と首をかしげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nothing happened—I’m the same as always. Why—do I seem strange today?”
“I can’t explain it either. It was only a feeling, so perhaps I imagined it.”
“…?”
I cock my head in confusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nothing--I'm just as always.
Do… do I seem strange today?"
"Hmmm, I'm not sure either.
I just thought so, so perhaps I was just imagining things."
"………?"
I tilt my head in confusion.

entries.japanese:
「さ、お昼ごはんにしましょうか。
遠野くん、今日は学食でしょう？
　早く行かないと席が埋まっちゃいますよ」
「ああ、そっか。
そういう先輩も、今日は学食？」
「はい、今日はおいしいものが食べたくなる日なんです」
　先輩はにこやかに答えて、こっちの手を引いて歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, let’s have lunch. You’re eating in the cafeteria today, aren’t you? We need to hurry before every seat is taken.”
“Oh, right. Are you eating there too?”
“Yes—today feels like a day for something delicious.”
Smiling brightly, Ciel takes my hand and leads me away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, shall we get lunch?
You are eating at the cafeteria today, right Tohno-kun?
If we don't hurry, the seats will all be taken."
"Ah, yeah.
You're eating at the cafeteria too, Senpai?"
"Yes, I want to eat something good today."
She grins and pulls me by the hand as she starts walking.

entries.japanese:
結局、昼食は先輩と二週間後の体育祭と、その後にある文化祭の事を話して終わった。
　……実をいうと、そんな事より『おいしいものを食べたい』、なんて言っておきながらカレーを注文していた先輩のことのほうが、ひどく印象に残っていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
In the end, we spend lunch discussing the athletics festival in two weeks and the school festival afterward.
Though to be honest, what sticks with me most is that after announcing she wanted something delicious, Ciel promptly ordered curry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the end, I talk with Senpai about the athletic festival in two weeks and the culture festival shortly thereafter over lunch.
…… To tell the truth, Senpai saying, "I want to eat something good," and ordering curry leaves more of an impression in my mind than what we talked about.

entries.japanese:
今日一日の授業が終わって、放課後になった。
　さて、これからどうしようか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Classes end for the day, and afternoon gives way to after school.
Now, what should I do―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Classes end and school is over.
Well, what should I do now?----

entries.japanese:
目的もなく街に出てきてしまった。
　なんだって、俺はこんなところで意味もなく歩いているっていうんだろう。
「―――あ」
　見間違いだ。
　あいつがまだいるはずがないんだし、俺にはあいつに話しかける理由なんて、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have wandered into town without any real purpose.
What am I doing, walking around out here for no reason?
“―――Ah”
I imagined it.
She cannot possibly still be here, and I have no reason to speak to her anyway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go out in town aimlessly.
Why the heck am I walking around here for no reason?
"----Ah."
It's just a mistake.
There's no way she'll still be around, and it's not like I have any reason to talk to her.

entries.japanese:
なのに、どうしてそんな見間違いなんかをしてしまったんだろう。
　どうして―――意味もなく、一人で街を歩いていたりしているんだ。
「……屋敷に戻らなくっちゃな」
　酔いをさますように頭をふって、ありもしないアルクェイドの幻に背を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then why did I mistake someone for her?
Why―――am I wandering through town alone for no reason at all?
“I should get back to the mansion.”
I shake my head as if clearing away a drunken haze, then turn my back on a phantom Arcueid who was never there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
So why did I think it was her?
Why----am I walking around town pointlessly like this?
"…… I have to go back to the mansion."
I shake my head as if trying to clear my head of drunkenness and turn away from the nonexistent illusion of Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「…………はあ」
　そのまま屋敷に帰る気になれなくて、教室でぼんやりと時間をつぶす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah.”
Unable to make myself go straight home, I sit in the classroom and let the time drift by.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…………… *sigh*
I don't feel like going back to the mansion, so I kill time spacing out in the classroom.

entries.japanese:
外は夕暮れ。
　グラウンドからの部活動の掛け声が聞こえてきて、こうして椅子に座っているだけで平和だ、という気分になれる。
　それはきっと、昨日と一昨日が異常すぎる世界だったためだろう。
―――と。
「よかった。
遠野くん、まだ教室に残っていたんですね」
　突然、ぴょこん、と先輩が顔を出してきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Outside, evening is falling.
The calls of the sports clubs carry in from the field, and merely sitting here in my chair is enough to make the world feel peaceful.
Probably because yesterday and the day before were so monstrously abnormal.
―――And then.
“Oh, good. Tohno, you’re still here.”
Without warning, she pops her head around the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Outside, the sun is setting.
I can hear the voices of those practicing in athletic clubs; I'm quite comfortable with sitting at my desk peacefully.
It's probably because yesterday and the day before were out of some extraordinary world.
----And then,
"Good.
I see you're still here, Tohno-kun."
Senpai's face suddenly comes into view.

entries.japanese:
「あれ、先輩……？
　どうしたの、二年の教室になんてきて。
何か特別な用事ですか？」
「ええ、遠野くんがまだ残ってるかなって、ちょっと様子を見にきたんです」
　笑顔で、先輩は嬉しくなるような事を言ってくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel…? What brings you to a second-year classroom? Did you need something?”
“Yes, I came by to see whether you might still be here.”
She says something irresistibly flattering and smiles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm?
Senpai……?
What makes you come down to a second year classroom?
Is there something special you had in mind?"
"Yes, I was wondering if you were still here, so I came to take a look."
Senpai says something that makes me happy.

entries.japanese:
「ええ、まだ残ってますけど、なんですか？」
「昼休みに言い忘れてしまった事があったんですよ。
明日でも良かったんですけど、やっぱりできるだけ早いほうがいいかなって」
「……はあ。
言い忘れたこと、ですか」
「はい。
遠野くん、最近夜に出歩いているみたいですから、注意しておこうと思って。
最近の街は物騒なんですから、あんまり夜更かしはしちゃダメですよ」
「あ――――えっと、その……」
　……？
　先輩はなんでそんな事を知っているんだろう。
寝不足で顔色が悪いからとか、俺が夜出歩いているところを見かけたりしたんだろうか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am still here, but what is it?”
“There was something I forgot to tell you at lunch. It could have waited until tomorrow, but I thought sooner might be better.”
“I see. Something you forgot?”
“Yes. You seem to have been going out at night lately, Tohno, so I wanted to warn you. The city has been dangerous recently, so you really shouldn’t stay out so late.”
“Ah――――well, I”
Why does Ciel know? Is it because my lack of sleep shows in my face? Or did she see me out at night?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I'm here… What is it?"
"There is something I forgot to say during lunch.
I was thinking of waiting until tomorrow, but I thought I should just say it as soon as possible."
"…… Hm.
Something you forgot to say?"
"Yes.
Tohno-kun, you seem to be going out at night lately, so I wanted to warn you.
There have been a lot of dangerous things going on, so you shouldn't stay out too late."
"Ah----um, well……"
……?
How does Senpai know that?
Do I look pale from a lack of sleep?
Or, maybe she saw me walking around at night……?

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ遠野くん、ちゃんと伝えましたからね。
あんまり危ないことしちゃだめですよ」
　唐突に現れた先輩は、風のように立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, Tohno. I’ve warned you properly now, so please don’t do anything too dangerous.”
As abruptly as she appeared, she is gone again like a gust of wind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well Tohno-kun, I let you know.
You shouldn't involve yourself in dangerous things."
As quickly as she arrived, Senpai disappears like a gust of wind.

entries.japanese:
一時間ほど教室でぼんやりしてから帰路につく事にした。
　時刻は夕方の五時すぎ。
　あんまり遅いと翡翠が心配するだろうし、いいかげん帰らないとまずいだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
After idling in the classroom for another hour, I finally set out for home.
It is a little after five.
Hisui will worry if I stay out much later, so I had better get going――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
After spending an hour doing nothing in the classroom, I decide to go home.
It's past five o'clock.
If I'm too late, Hisui will worry, so I should head back soon----

entries.japanese:
……そうだな、あんまり翡翠や琥珀さんに迷惑をかけるのも申し訳ない。
　ここ数日まっすぐ屋敷に帰らなかった事だし、今日ぐらいは寄り道をせずに帰宅したほうがいいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I would feel guilty making Hisui and Kohaku worry any more than I already have.
I have failed to come straight home for the past several days; today, at least, I should skip the detours.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yeah.
I would feel bad if I kept causing trouble for Hisui and Kohaku-san.
Since I wasn't able to go home for the past few days, I should at least go straight home today.

entries.japanese:
坂道を上がりきって、屋敷のまわりを歩いていく。
　しばらく歩いて屋敷の正門に回りこむと、そこに翡翠が一人で立っているのが見えた。
「……？
　なにしてるんだろ、翡翠」
　首をかしげながら正門に向かう。
　と、翡翠はこちらに気がついて、ペコリと頭をさげてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
At the top of the hill, I follow the road around the mansion.
When I finally reach the main gate, I see Hisui standing there alone.
“What is Hisui doing?”
Puzzled, I approach the gate.
She notices me and bows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I head up the road and draw near the mansion.
After a little more walking, I see Hisui standing by herself at the front gate.
"……?
I wonder what Hisui is doing?"
Tilting my head to the side, I head for the front gate.
Hisui realizes I'm here and bows her head.

entries.japanese:
「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
「―――あ、うん―――ただいま、翡翠」
　うやうやしく出迎えをされて、戸惑いながらもなんとか返答する。
「あの―――もしかして、俺が帰ってくるのを待っててくれたの？」
「はい。
主人の出迎えをするのは使用人の務めですから」
　さも当然のように、翡翠は眉ひとつ動かさずに言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
“―――Ah, right―――I’m home, Hisui.”
Her ceremonious greeting flusters me, but I manage an answer.
“Um―――were you waiting here for me to come back?”
“Yes. It is a servant’s duty to welcome home the master of the house.”
Hisui says it as though it were obvious, without so much as raising an eyebrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Welcome back, Shiki-sama."
"---Ah, yeah---thanks, Hisui."
I can barely reply since I'm bewildered by the respectfulness of it all.
"Um---were you waiting for me to come home?"
"Yes.
Greeting the master is a servant's duty."
Answering very matter-of-factly, she doesn't even bat an eyelash.

entries.japanese:
「いや、あのさ翡翠。
出迎えてくれるのは正直嬉しいんだけど、わざわざ外で待ってなくていいよ。
　俺は勝手に帰ってくるから、帰ってきたなって気づいた時だけ声をかけてくれればいいから」
「―――――」
　翡翠はわずかに顔をくもらせる。
　……もしかすると。
　土曜日も日曜日も、翡翠はこうしてずっと俺の帰りを待っていたのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Hisui. I’m honestly glad you want to welcome me home, but you don’t have to wait outside.
I’ll come back on my own. Just say something whenever you happen to notice I’m here.”
“―――――”
A faint shadow crosses Hisui’s face.
Maybe.
She may have waited here like this all through Saturday and Sunday too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Hisui, I'm truly happy you waited to greet me, but there's really no need to wait outside.
I'll come back on my own, so you can just greet me whenever you realize I'm back."
"-----"
Hisui's face clouds slightly.
…… Oh, maybe…
Maybe she was waiting for me to return like this on Saturday and Sunday.

entries.japanese:
「――翡翠、あのさ――」
「わかりました。
明日からはロビーで志貴さまのお帰りをお待ちいたします」
　ぺこり、と頭をさげて翡翠は屋敷の門を開けた。
　翡翠は門に手をかけたまま、こちらに背中を向けている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――Hisui, listen――”
“Understood. Beginning tomorrow, I shall await Master Shiki’s return in the foyer.”
Hisui bows and opens the gate.
With one hand still on it, she turns her back to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Hisui, um--"
"I understand.
Starting from tomorrow, I will await your return in the lobby."
Hisui gives a quick bow and opens the mansion gate.
Hisui turns around as she does so.

entries.japanese:
「…………はあ」
　なんだか、話しかけられる雰囲気じゃない。
　屋敷の門をくぐると、翡翠は門を閉めて玄関まで歩いていき、やっぱり無言で扉を開けて俺をロビーまで先導した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……Haaah.”
She does not seem inclined to talk.
Once I pass through, Hisui closes the gate, walks to the front door, and silently opens it before leading me into the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………… *sigh*
For some reason, the atmosphere isn't exactly conducive to conversation.
Hisui closes the gate after I pass through, then she silently walks to the entrance to open the door and leads me into the lobby.

entries.japanese:
自室に帰ってきた。
　秋葉は習い事から帰っておらず、琥珀さんは夕食の支度、翡翠は屋敷の掃除があるとのことだ。
「―――まいったな、やることがない」
　いや、学生なんだから勉強とか復習とか暗記とかやらなくちゃいけない事はたくさんある。
　ただ、なんとなくなーんにもやる気にならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to my room.
Akiha is still at her lessons, Kohaku is preparing dinner, and Hisui has the mansion to clean.
“―――Damn, I have nothing to do.”
No, I’m a student; I have plenty I should be doing—studying, reviewing, memorizing.
I just do not feel like doing any of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get to my room.
Akiha isn't back yet from her lessons, Kohaku-san is preparing dinner, and Hisui is cleaning the mansion.
"---Geez, there's nothing to do."
Well, there's quite a mountain of studying, reviewing, and memorizing a student like me has to do.
But, I just don't feel like doing anything.

entries.japanese:
ちらり、とアルクェイドの顔を思い浮かべた。
　良きにつけ悪きにつけ、忙しい二日間だったことの反動だろうか。
　しばらくは、何かをするよりぼんやりとしていたほうが、心が休まるような気がしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid’s face flits through my mind.
Maybe this is the backlash from two frantic days, for better or worse.
For a while, doing nothing at all seems more restful than trying to occupy myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Suddenly, Arcueid's face flashes in my mind.
Whether good or bad, it's probably just a reaction to the crazy two days I just had.
Perhaps spacing out here in my room will be good, giving my mind and heart a break.

entries.japanese:
だだっ広い食堂で一人の夕食を終えた後、琥珀さんに傷口の手当てをしてもらって自室に戻ってきた。
　夕食時になっても秋葉は帰ってこなかった。
習い事が長引いているので、外食をすることになったらしい。
　時計の針は夜の十時を大きく回っている。
　少し早いが体の疲れもあることだし、今夜は早めに眠るとしよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
After eating alone in the cavernous dining room, I have Kohaku tend my wounds and return to my room.
Akiha still has not come home. Apparently her lesson ran late, so she decided to eat out.
It is well past ten.
A little early, perhaps, but I am exhausted, so I think I will turn in for the night―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
After eating dinner by myself in the large dining room, Kohaku-san treats my wounds and I go back to my room.
Akiha didn't make it back in time for dinner.
Her lesson was apparently going to last a while, so she was going to eat away from home.
It's past ten at night now.
It's a bit too early, but since I'm exhausted, I should sleep early tonight--

entries.japanese:
昼休みになったとたん、今まで授業に一時間も出てなかった男がやってきた。
「よう！
　メシ食おうぜ、メシ！」
　何が嬉しいのか、有彦はとにかく威勢がいい。
「そりゃあメシは当然のように食べるけど、えらく機嫌がいいじゃないか。
なにかあったのか、有彦」
「おう。
ついさっきそこで先輩に昼メシいっしょにどうっすかって声をかけたらさ、断られたんだ」
「………………」
　不思議だ。
　先輩っていうとシエル先輩のことだろうけど、誘いを断られると嬉しいらしい、この友人は。
entries.maoEnglish:
The instant lunch break begins, a certain boy who has not attended a single class all morning finally shows up.
“Yo! Let’s eat—lunch, lunch!”
Whatever has him so delighted, Arihiko is bursting with energy.
“Obviously I am going to eat, but you are in a suspiciously good mood. What happened, Arihiko?”
“Yeah. I just asked Ciel if she wanted to have lunch with us, and she turned me down.”
“………………”
Strange.
He clearly means Ciel, but apparently this friend of mine enjoys being turned down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At lunch break, that guy who didn't even show up for a single class arrives.
"Yo Tohno!
Food, let's get some food!"
He's happy about something, being even more energetic than usual.

"Of course, food.
But you seem to be in a great mood.
Did something happen, Arihiko?"
"Yup.
I just asked Senpai if she wanted to eat lunch together, and she refused."
"………………"
That's odd.
"Senpai" must be referring to Ciel-senpai, but this guy seems to get happy when his offer is refused.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あのさ。
有彦、そういう趣味だったっけ」
「いやいや、話は最後まで聞けって。
でな、先輩にどうしてダメなんだよう、って聞いたら『遠野くんが一緒だと、イヤです』だってさ！
　うわははははははははは！
　愉快だろう、遠野！」
「………………」
　不思議だ。
　どうして、俺はこうゆう友達甲斐のない男と、中学時代から友人だったりするんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me something, Arihiko. Have you always been into that?”
“No, no, hear the whole story. I asked her why not, and she said, ‘Not if Tohno is coming too.’ Wahahahahahaha! Is that not priceless, Tohno?”
“………………”
Strange.
Why have I kept this lousy excuse for a friend around since middle school?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Arihiko, you have that sort of taste?"
"No, no, I'm not finished.
So I asked Senpai why not, and she said 'If Tohno-kun is there, then I don't want to come'!!
Uwahahahahahahahaha!
Isn't that great, Tohno!?"
"……………"
That's odd.
Why have I been friends with this guy since middle school?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「いやあ、嫌われたもんだな遠野！
　ライバルが減って嬉しいので、今日の昼メシはオレがおごってやろう！」
　ばんばん、とオレの背中を楽しそうに叩く有彦。
「……そっか。
先輩、まだ朝のこと怒ってるのか」
　どうして怒られるのかまったく覚えはないのだけど、たしかに先輩は怒っていたように見えた。
「ほら、行くぞ遠野。
食堂の席は利用客の半分しかないんだからな」
　ずるずる、と有彦は人の腕を強引に引きずっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Boy, she really hates you, Tohno! I am so happy to have one less rival that lunch is on me today!”
Arihiko gleefully pounds me on the back.
“I see. Ciel is still angry about this morning.”
I have no idea what I did to deserve it, but she certainly looked angry.
“Come on, Tohno. The cafeteria has half as many seats as it has customers.”
Arihiko seized my arm and dragged me away by force.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh man, she really hates you Tohno!
A rival's loss is my gain, so I'll treat you to lunch today!"
Arihiko happily slaps my back.
"…… I see.
Senpai's still mad at me about this morning."
I have no idea why she's angry at me, but she definitely is angry.
"Hey, let's go Tohno.
There's only seats enough for half the people using the cafeteria."
Arihiko takes me by the arm and drags me off.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
有彦と席を並べて昼食をとる。
　うちの学校の食堂にはテレビが置かれていて、その日の朝のニュースをビデオで流す、という教育にいいんだか悪いんだか紙一重のことをやっている。
　とりあえず、いま流れているニュースはコンビニエンスストアで酔っ払い客が店員を刺殺した、という、とりあえずむこう三日間ぐらいはコンビニに行きたくなくなるような内容だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arihiko and I sat down side by side for lunch.
Our cafeteria had a television, and they played recordings of the morning news—one of those ideas poised exactly between educational and appalling.
The current story was about a drunk customer stabbing a convenience-store clerk to death, which was enough to keep me out of convenience stores for the next three days or so.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I sit next to Arihiko and eat my lunch.
My school's cafeteria has a television, and for better or worse for our education, they play back the morning news they recorded this morning.
At any rate, the news they are playing back is talking about a drunk customer stabbing to death a convenience store employee, something that makes me not want to go to a convenience store for a few days at least.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ぶっそうな世の中だねえ。
無差別に人を殺してる通り魔はいるわ、酔っ払いは人を刺すわ。
こんなんじゃ安心して夜遊びもできねえってもんだよな、ほんと」
　有彦は、わりと真剣にニュースを見ているようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a dangerous world. We have a maniac killing strangers and drunks stabbing people. A guy cannot even go out at night in peace.”
Arihiko seems to be watching the news with surprising seriousness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What a dangerous world we live in.
Indiscriminate serial killers, drunken people stabbing people.
A man can't even feel safe playing around at night anymore."
Arihiko seems like he is seriously watching the news.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、たしかに物騒だけど。
とりあえず通り魔事件はもう起きないんだから、いつも通りっていうことじゃないのか」
「そなの？
　通り魔って捕まったんだ？」
「いや、捕まってはいないだろうけど」
―――とりあえず、もうこの世にはいないのだ。
　だから現代の吸血鬼なんていう俗な見出しがテレビに映ることもないし、もう、意味もなく殺される『誰か』がでることもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s dangerous, sure. But the random killings are over, so I’d say things are back to normal.”
“Really? They catch the guy?”
“No, I don’t think anyone caught him.”
―――At any rate, the one behind it is no longer in this world.
There will be no more lurid MODERN-DAY VAMPIRE headlines on television and no more nameless victims murdered for no reason.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, certainly it is dangerous.
But at least those serial killings won't happen anymore, so things should be like usual."
"Oh really?
Did they catch the serial killer?"
"No, they haven't caught him…"
---But Nrvnqsr is no longer in this world.
So the stupid title of the modern day vampire killings shouldn't be showing up in the news anymore and there will be no more of those meaningless killings.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ともかく、もうあんなふざけた事件は起きないし、犠牲者もでないってこと。
この街もようやく元に戻ったんだよ」
「いや―――犠牲者は出ると思うぜ、遠野」
「―――む。
なんで断言できるんだよ、有彦」
「だって、ほら。
今朝で十人目の死体が発見されたって、いまニュースで流れてるもん」
―――――え？
「うわっ、マジかよ……。
いつも行ってる映画館の裏じゃんか、あそこ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The point is, those insane killings are over. This city is finally back to normal, with no more victims.”
“No―――I am sure there will be more victims, Tohno.”
“―――What? How can you be so sure, Arihiko?”
“Because look. The news says they found the tenth body this morning.”
―――――What?
“Whoa, seriously…? That’s right behind the movie theater I always go to.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, those terrible incidents won't happen anymore.
There won't be any more victims, and the streets will be back to normal."
"No----I think there'll actually be another victim, Tohno."
"----What?
How can you be so sure, Arihiko?"
"Well look for yourself.
The news says they've found the tenth dead body."
-----Eh?
"Aw really…… that's right behind the movie theater I always go to."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ――――ちょっと、待て」
　有彦を押しのけてテレビを見る。
　そこには、たしかに。
　昨夜、通り魔殺人による十人目の犠牲者が出た、というニュースがたれ流されていた。
「そんな―――ばかな」
　あいつは。
ネロは、たしかに死んだ。
　なのにどうして―――体内の血液が大量に搾取されている死体、なんてものが出てくるっていうんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait――――”
I shove Arihiko aside and stare at the television.
There it is.
The news drones on: last night, a tenth victim was claimed by the serial killer.
“That cannot be―――”
He was gone. Nrvnqsr was definitely dead.
So why―――had another body turned up with most of its blood drained away?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey----hey, wait."
I push Arihiko and look at the TV.
What I see is without a doubt,
the news reporting that the tenth victim of the serial killings was found last night.
"That----can't be."
He, Nrvnqsr, is dead.
So why----is there another dead body with most of its blood drained?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「現代の吸血鬼ねえ。
どんなもんか知らないけど、相手が美人のお姉さんだっていうんなら吸われてやってもいいかもな、うむ」
「―――――」
　美人のお姉さんなら、吸われてやってもいい。
　有彦のくだらない戯言は、たしかに―――まあ、的を射ているのかもしれない。
「―――まさか」
　考えたくはないけれど。
　ネロがいなくなっても、吸血鬼は、まだ一人残っているじゃないか、志貴――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A modern-day vampire, huh? No idea what one is like, but if it is a gorgeous older woman, I might let her suck me dry.”
“―――――”
If she were a beautiful woman, he’d let her drink his blood.
Idiotic as Arihiko’s remark is, it might―――well, have struck the mark.
“―――It cannot be.”
I do not want to consider it.
But even with Nrvnqsr gone, there is still one vampire left, is there not, Shiki――――.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm, this modern vampire guy.
I don't know anything about the person, but if it's like a sexy chick, I maybe wouldn't mind getting my blood sucked."
"------"
If it's like a sexy chick, he maybe wouldn't mind getting his blood sucked?
His stupid talk----might be right.
"----No way."
I don't want to think about it, but…
Even with Nrvnqsr gone, there's still one more vampire left, Shiki----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
授業が終わって、放課後になった。
　いや、いつのまにか放課後になっていた、というのが正しいだろう。
　悪い考えばかりが頭の中をかけまわって、気がつけばまわりには誰もいなくなっていたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Classes end; it is after school.
No—that is not quite right; before I know it, it is after school.
Dark thoughts chase one another through my head; when I finally look around, everyone else is gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Classes end and school is over.
Actually, it's more like at some point, school was over.
Wrapped up in my bad thoughts, I look up and suddenly find myself alone.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――通り魔殺人は、まだ続いている」
　それがどういう意味なのか、解らない。
　答えを知っているのは、きっとアルクェイド本人だけだ。
　わからない。
　もう、あんな事件は遠野志貴とは無関係だ。
　俺はネロと決着をつけた時点でこっち側に戻ってきた。
　なら―――自分から好き好んで、あんな異常な世界に足を踏み入れるなんて気が狂っているとしか思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――The killings are still happening.”
I do not know what that means.
Arcueid herself is probably the only one who knows the answer.
I do not know.
Those murders no longer have anything to do with Shiki Tohno.
When I settled things with Nrvnqsr, I returned to this side of the world.
Then―――to go willingly back into that nightmare would be sheer madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----The serial killings are still happening."
I don't know what that means.
The only one who knows the answer is probably Arcueid.
I don't know.
I'm not involved in any of those incidents anymore.
Once I settled things with Nrvnqsr, I came back to the ordinary world.
Then----I can only be insane to want to go back to that abnormal world once again.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「もう――――関わるべきじゃない」
　そんな事、口に出すまでもなく理解している。
　たぶんそれが最後から二番目ぐらいに正しい選択だ。
　けれど、遠野志貴は一番目の選択を、ずっとむかしに教えられている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I should not――――get involved again.”
I understood that without needing to say it aloud.
It was probably the second-worst choice.
But Shiki Tohno had been taught the best one a long, long time ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I shouldn't----be involved."
I understand even if I don't say it.
That's probably my second most correct choice.
But a long, long time ago, someone taught me the most correct choice.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――志貴、どんな人間だって人生っていうのは落とし穴だらけなのよ。
　君は人よりそれをなんとかできる力があるんだから、もっとシャンとしなくちゃね――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Shiki, everyone’s life is riddled with pitfalls.
You have more power to do something about them than most, so hold your head up and act like it――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Listen, Shiki.
Every person's life is filled with pitfalls.
You have more power to do something about it than most people, so you've got to get it together----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　だから、見て見ぬふりだけは出来ない。
　事件はまだ終わっていない。
　一度関わってしまった以上、遠野志貴は最後までこの厄介ごとに付き合わなくちゃいけないらしい――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
That is why I cannot simply look away.
The case is not over.
Once Shiki Tohno becomes involved, it seems he must see the whole miserable business through――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
So I just can't pretend I didn't see it.
This incident isn't over yet.
It seems once I got involved in this incident, I have to see this out to the very end--
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
学校を出た。
　とりあえず、アルクェイドのマンションに行ってみよう。
　マンションの部屋はそのままだったけれど、アルクェイドの姿はなかった。
　……まあ、簡単にあいつが掴まるとは思っていない。
街に出て、手当たりしだいに捜すしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I leave school.
First, I will try Arcueid’s apartment.
The apartment was just as I remembered it, but Arcueid was nowhere to be seen.
Well, I never expected her to be that easy to find. I would have to go into the city and search everywhere I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave school.
First, let's go to Arcueid's place.
Her room is still the same, but Arcueid isn't there.
…… Well, I didn't think I'd find her this easy.
Looks like I have to go out into the city and look for her.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
日が沈んで、街はそろそろ本格的に夜を迎えようとしている。
　街の主だったところを探し回ってはみたものの、アルクェイドの姿は片鱗さえ見つからなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sun had gone down, and the city was settling into night.
I had searched every major part of town and found not the slightest trace of Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sun sinks and the city is really starting to get dark.
I looked around the major places in the city, but I didn't even catch a glimpse of her.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――くそ。
どうでもいい時はひょこひょこ歩いてたくせに、どうしてこういう時に見つからないんだ、あいつは」
　……どうするか。
　夜はまだ始まったばかりだし、ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Damn it. She wanders around everywhere when it does not matter, so why can I not find her now?”
What should I do?
The night has only just begun, so perhaps I should―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Damn it.
She was around when it didn't matter, so why can't I find her when I do need her?"
…… What should I do?
The night is just beginning, so---
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
屋敷の門は静まり返っている。
　時刻は夜の七時。
　そろそろ秋葉も帰ってきて、居間で紅茶でも飲んでいる頃だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The estate gates stand silent.
It is seven in the evening.
Akiha should be home by now, probably taking tea in the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's quiet at the mansion gate.
The time is seven o'clock at night.
Akiha should be back, probably having tea in the sitting room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「…………はぁ」
　のんびり夕食なんて食べている気分じゃないけど、また屋敷に帰らずにいたら秋葉たちを心配させてしまう。
　アルクェイドを捜すのは夕食が終わって、秋葉たちが寝静まった後にしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah.”
I’m in no mood for a leisurely dinner, but if I stay away again, I’ll only worry Akiha and the others.
I can search for Arcueid after dinner, once everyone has gone to bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………… *sigh*
I don't really feel like leisurely eating dinner at all, but if I don't go back, Akiha and the others will probably worry about me again.
Looking for Arcueid will have to wait until after dinner.
I'll leave when Akiha and everyone else go to sleep.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――秋葉との夕食が終わって、部屋に戻ってきた。
　食後に琥珀さんたちと居間でお茶も飲んでいたが、あいにくと何をしていたのかは記憶にない。
「―――どこにいってるんだろう、アイツは」
　頭の中にあるのは金髪の吸血鬼のことだけだったからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Dinner with Akiha is over, and I am back in my room.
I even had tea with Kohaku and the others afterward, but I couldn’t say what we did.
“―――Where could she have gone?”
The blond vampire is the only thing on my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Dinner with Akiha is over and I head back to my room.
I had some tea after dinner with Kohaku-san and the others, but I don't even remember what went on.
"----Where the heck is she?"
My head is only filled with thoughts of that golden-haired vampire.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
十時になって、屋敷の電気が落ちた。
　就寝時間になってみんなが部屋に引きこんだあと、見付からないように屋敷を抜け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
At ten, the lights in the estate go out.
Once everyone has retired for the night, I slip outside without being seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At ten o'clock, the lights in the mansion are turned off.
At bedtime, everyone goes back to their rooms, so I slip out of the mansion undetected.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……いるとしたら街、か」
　……考えたくないが、吸血鬼事件の犠牲者はたいてい路地裏で発見される。
　アルクェイドを―――まだ続いている吸血鬼殺人の犯人を捜すのなら、街を中心に探しまわるしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If she is anywhere, it will be downtown.”
I do not like thinking about it, but most victims of the vampire killings are found in back alleys.
If I want to find Arcueid―――whoever is still committing those murders, I will have to concentrate my search there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… She's, probably in the city?"
…… I don't want to think about it, but most of the victims are usually found in alleys.
If I want to find Arcueid----if I want to find the vampire killer who's continuing to murder, then I have to search the streets.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――――はあ」
　どさり、とガードレールに腰を下ろす。
　あれから数時間。
　あてもなく探しまわってみたはいいが、アルクェイドの姿は影も形も見当たらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Haaah.”
I drop heavily onto a guardrail.
Hours have passed.
I have searched everywhere without the faintest idea where to look, and found no trace of Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------*sigh*
I sit down on the guard rail.
It's been several hours already.
I looked around aimlessly, and I didn't even catch a single glimpse of Arcueid.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「…………くそ」
　すごく、悔しい。
　そりゃあ街の中でなんのアテもなく人を見つけ出すのがどれだけ困難かわかってはいたけど、アイツにかぎってはあっさりと見付かるって、心のどこかで楽観していた。
「どこいったんだよ、アイツ……」
　……どうしてだろう。
　別にアイツには吸血鬼殺人の話を聞くだけなのに、会えないとわかると、ひどく―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it…”
The frustration is unbearable.
I knew how nearly impossible it would be to find one person in a city without a lead, but somewhere inside I assumed that she, of all people, would simply turn up.
“Where the hell did she go…?”
Why, I wonder.
All I need from her is an answer about the vampire killings, yet now that I cannot find her, I feel so terribly―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Damn it."
It's so, frustrating.
Of course, I knew it isn't easy to just randomly find someone in town, but I still felt optimistic I would find her.
"Where did she go……?"
…… Why?
I just wanted to ask her about the serial killings, but once I find out I can't see her, I----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ああ、やめやめ。
こんなのはもう止めだ」
　ガードレールから立ちあがって歩き出す。
　いいかげん時刻も午前零時になろうとしている。
　これ以上はアルクェイドを捜す、なんていう無駄な事はやっていられない。
「……………」
　でもまあ、ここまできたらもう少しだけ。
　最後にもう一箇所だけ様子を見てみて、それで見付からなかったら屋敷に帰ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget it. I am done with this.”
I rise from the guardrail and start walking.
It is nearly midnight. I cannot keep wasting my time searching for Arcueid.
“……………”
Still, after coming this far, I might as well look a little longer.
One last place; if she is not there, I will go back to the estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, stop.
Stop.
I should just stop."
I stand up from the guardrail and start walking.
It'll be midnight soon.
Searching for Arcueid any longer really is just useless.
"…………"
But, if I've gone this far, I can do just a little more.
There's one last place I need to check.
If she's not there, then I'll go back to the mansion.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……人気のない公園。
　あの夜、アルクェイドに協力して、ネロという吸血鬼を倒した場所にやってきた。
　街を捜してばかりいたから、今夜はここには立ち寄っていない。
「……まあ、見付かりっこないんだけど……」
　ぼやいて、公園の中へ足を踏み入れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
The deserted park.
I have come to the place where Arcueid and I defeated the vampire called Nrvnqsr that night.
I have spent all evening searching downtown, so this is the one place I have not checked.
“Not that she will actually be here…”
Grumbling, I step into the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The deserted park.
I arrive at the place where I cooperated with Arcueid and defeated Nrvnqsr.
Having only looked in town, I've yet to search here.
"…… Well, not that I'll find anything……"
Grumbling to myself, I enter the park.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
夜の十二時。
　さすがにこの時間になると、公園に人気はない。
　ここまで誰もいないと、逆にさっぱりとするぐらいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Midnight.
At this hour, naturally, the park is deserted. The emptiness is so complete it almost feels refreshing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Midnight.
As expected, there's no one here this late at night.
With this much silence, it rather feels refreshing.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……そうだよな。
そう都合よく見付かるはずなんてなかった」
　はあ、と両肩を落とす。
「………バカだな。
なにがっかりしてるんだろ、俺」
　自分でもわからない。
　ただ、もう一度ぐらい―――アイツの笑顔とか、見ておきたかったのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course… it was never going to be that easy.”
My shoulders sag with a sigh.
“What an idiot. Why am I so disappointed?”
I do not even know.
Maybe I only wanted to see her smile once more―――perhaps that was it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
It's not like I can conveniently find her."
I let out a sigh and slump my shoulders.
"…… How stupid.
Why am I so disappointed?"
