I don't understand it myself.
Just, once more----I think maybe I wanted to see her smile.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あ、いたいた。
こんばんは、志貴」
　……そう、こんなふうに、吸血鬼なんて信じられないぐらいの気軽さで話しかけてくるアイツの顔を――――
「ア、	アルクェイド―――！？」
　思わず。
そのまま、アルクェイドの両肩を掴まえていた。
「えっ―――」
　
　びくっ、と驚くアルクェイド。
　掴まえたアルクェイドの肩は確かに現実で、あわてて両手を離す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, there you are. Good evening, Shiki.”
That face of hers, greeting me with a breeziness that made it impossible to believe she was a vampire――――
“A-Arcueid―――!?”
Without thinking. I seize her by both shoulders.
“What―――?”
Arcueid flinches in surprise.
Her shoulders are solid and real beneath my hands, and I hastily let her go.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, there you are.
Good evening, Shiki."
…… Yeah, just like this.
Her face that's so cheerful and carefree you can't believe it belongs to a vampire----
"A,      Arcueid----!?"
Without even thinking, I grab both of her shoulders.
"Eh----?"
Arcueid flinches in surprise.

Her shoulders are indeed real, and I quickly pull my arms back.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「お、おまえ、なんで――――」
　ずっと捜していた相手が目の前にいるっていうのに、混乱した俺の頭はそんな事しか喋らせてくれない。
「なんでって、おかしいかな。
志貴のことを捜してたんだから、こうして会うのは偶然じゃないと思うけど」
「え―――俺を捜してたって、なんで？」
「なんでって―――別に理由なんてないけど」
　きっぱりと、理由のない事を堂々と言いきるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y-you, why――――”
The person I have searched for all night is standing before me, yet in my confusion, that is all I can manage to say.
“What is strange about that? I was looking for you, so I would not call our meeting a coincidence.”
“You were looking for me―――why?”
“Why―――there was no particular reason.”
Arcueid declares her complete lack of a reason with magnificent certainty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y, you, why----"
Even though the one I've been searching for so long is right before me, I can't do anything but stumble over my words.
"Why?
That's odd.
I was looking for you, so I don't think it's coincidence we met here."
"Eh----You, were looking for me?
Why?"
"Why?----Oh, no reason."
She says straight out that she has no reason to be looking for.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　……忘れてた。
コイツは、そういう猫みたいなヤツだったんだっけ。
「……まあ、ちょうど良かった。
実をいうとさ、俺もアルクェイドに会いたかったんだ。
ここで会えて、その――――」
　本当に嬉しい、なんて言いそうになって、慌てて言葉を飲む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……………”
I had forgotten… she was that kind of creature, more cat than person.
“Well, the timing works out. To tell the truth, I wanted to see you too. I found you, and――――”
I nearly say that I am truly happy, then hurriedly swallow the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… I forgot.
She really is kind of like a cat this way.
"…… Well, I guess it works out.
To be honest, I wanted to see you too.
So meeting here, um----"
I was about to say it makes me really happy, but I frantically choke those words off.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――ともかくだ、真剣に話たいことがある。
ここじゃ落ち着かないから場所を変えたいんだけど、いいか？」
「いいけど―――話ってなによ」
「すぐにわかる。
……もう少し奥のほうに移動しよう」
　行くよ、と声をかけて歩き始める。
　アルクェイドは首をかしげながら、大人しくこちらの後についてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Anyway, I need to talk to you about something serious. I cannot talk comfortably here, so can we go somewhere else?”
“All right, but―――what do you want to talk about?”
“You will see. Let us go farther into the park.”
I tell her to come along and start walking.
Arcueid tilts her head, then obediently follows me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Anyway, I want to have a serious talk.
I want to talk about it somewhere else since I feel uneasy here, so is that okay?"
"Sure----but talk about what?"
"You'll see.
…… Let's go more to the back of the park."
Telling her to come on, I start walking.
Tilting her head in curiosity, she follows me obediently.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
屋敷の門は静まり返っている。
　時刻は夜の七時。
　そろそろ秋葉も帰ってきて、居間で紅茶でも飲んでいる頃だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The estate gates stand silent.
It is seven in the evening.
Akiha should be home by now, probably taking tea in the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's quiet at the mansion gate.
The time is seven o'clock at night.
Akiha should be back, probably having tea in the sitting room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……？
　なんだろう、居間のほうから話し声が聞こえてくる。
そろそろ夕食の時間だろうから、話し声がするのはおかしい。
　琥珀さんは厨房、翡翠は秋葉と会話をするようなキャラクターではないと思う。
「……琥珀さんと秋葉がお茶でも飲んでるのかな」
　ま、おそらくはそんなところだろう。
　とりあえず、屋敷の玄関を押しあけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hm?
Voices are coming from the sitting room. That’s odd when it’s almost time for dinner.
Kohaku should be in the kitchen, and Hisui isn’t exactly the sort to sit chatting with Akiha.
“Maybe Kohaku and Akiha are having tea.” That must be it.
I push open the front door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……?
I'm not sure what's going on, but I hear voices coming from the sitting room.
It's almost time for dinner, so it's strange for people to be just talking at this time.
Kohaku-san should be in the kitchen, and I think a conversation between Hisui and Akiha would be out of character.
"…… Kohaku-san and Akiha are drinking tea, perhaps." Well, I guess that's most likely.
First thing's first.
I open the mansion's front door.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
ロビーには翡翠が立っていた。
「遅くなったけど、ただいま」
「………………」
　翡翠は無表情で俺を見据えている。
　いつもの「おかえりなさいませ」
という言葉もなくて、なんだか不機嫌そうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui is standing in the foyer.
“I’m late, but I’m home.”
“…”
Hisui fixes me with a blank stare.
She does not give her usual “welcome home.” Somehow, she looks displeased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui is standing in the lobby.
"I'm a little late, but I'm back."
"………………"
Hisui silently greets me devoid of any expression.
She does not say her usual "Welcome back", and looks like she's in a bad mood.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「何かあったの？
　気のせいか怒っているように見えるんだけど」
「……志貴さまにお客さまです。
先ほどから居間のほうでお待ちですので、どうぞお急ぎください」
「俺に客？」
　はい、と翡翠はうなずく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did something happen? Maybe it’s my imagination, but you look angry.”
“You have a visitor, Master Shiki. The guest has been waiting in the sitting room for some time, so please go at once.”
“A visitor for me?”
Hisui nods.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Did something happen?
I might be imagining it, but you seem a little angry."
"…… There is a guest for you, Shiki-sama.
She has been waiting in the sitting room, so please hurry there."
"A guest for me?"
Hisui nods.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「誰だろう、俺を訪ねにくるやつなんて一人もいないんだけど────」
　いや、まて。
　なにか、とても悪い予感がする。
「翡翠。
それ、どんなヤツ……？」
「金色の髪をした、綺麗な女の方です」
　翡翠の返答は実に率直だ。
　無言で居間へと駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who could it be when no one ever comes here to see me────”
Wait.
I have an extremely bad feeling about this.
“Hisui… what does this visitor look like?”
“She is a beautiful woman with golden hair.”
Hisui’s answer could not be more direct.
Without another word, I sprint for the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I wonder who.
There isn't anyone who would come visit me----"
Oh, wait.
I have this terrible, terrible feeling.
"Hisui.
What, kind of person is it……?"
"A pretty woman with golden hair."
Hisui's response is straightforward.
I wordlessly dash towards the sitting room.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
────遅かった。
　事態は、もう誤魔化しようのない展開を迎えてしまっている真っ最中だったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
────Too late.
Apparently, the situation was already well past the point where it could be explained away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Too late.
It seems the current state of affairs is already at a level I can't escape from.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「────お帰りなさい、兄さん」
「あ、やっと帰ってきたな、こいつめ」
　二人はまったく正反対の様子で、やってきた俺に声をかけてきた。
「……………………」
　なんて、コトだ。
　よりにもよって、アルクェイドと秋葉が向かい合ってうちの居間で対峙してしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“────Welcome home, Brother.”
“Oh, there you are; took you long enough.”
The two greet me in utterly opposite tones.
“……………………”
This cannot be happening.
Of all people, Arcueid and Akiha are sitting face-to-face in our sitting room, locked in a standoff.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Welcome home, Nii-san."
"Oh, you're finally back."
They both greet me in completely opposite manners.
"………………"
What, is this?
Arcueid and Akiha seem to be confronting each other.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは平然としていて、秋葉も同じように平然と座っている。
　けれどあくまで自然……というか天然のアルクェイドと違って、秋葉の平然とした態度はアルクェイドに対する敵視の裏返しなのがみえみえだった。
　ちらり、と秋葉が俺のコトを流し見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid looks perfectly at ease, and so does Akiha.
But while Arcueid’s composure is natural—or simply oblivious—Akiha’s is an obvious mask for open hostility.
Akiha cuts me a sidelong glance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
They are both sitting down calmly.
But while Arcueid's calmness is natural, Akiha's calmness is from her hostility toward Arcueid.
Akiha takes a look at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんですか兄さん。
そんなところで立っていないで、どうぞこちらに来て座ってください」
　うう、いったらそのままナイフでトスっと刺されそうな気がする。
「いや、いいんだ。
それより秋葉、こいつはだな、その────」
　その────なんて説明すればいいんだろう？
　学校のクラスメイトだなんてのは通用しないし、街で知り合ったなんていうのは火に油を注ぐようなものだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is the matter, Brother? Do not stand there; please come and sit with us.”
Ugh, if I go over there, I have the distinct feeling she will calmly stick a knife into me.
“No, I am fine. More importantly, Akiha, she is, well────”
Well────how am I supposed to explain her?
Calling her a classmate will not work, and saying we met downtown would be pouring oil on the fire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is the matter, Nii-san?
You do not have to stand there, please have a seat here."
Uh, I feel like I'll get stabbed if I go over there.
"Uh, I'm fine.
Anyway, Akiha, this person is, well----"
Hmm----how should I explain this?
Akiha would not believe me if I say she's a classmate of mine, and telling her I met her in town would be like throwing oil on a fire.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「その、なんですか？」
「いや、だからだな、えっと────」
　ええい、こうなってしまってはもう何を言っても無駄な気がするけど、とにかくうまい言い訳をして誤魔化さなくてはいけない。
　いけないんだけど────そもそもアルクェイドはなんて言ってここまでやってきたんだろう？
「えっと───コイツ、なんて言ってやってきたの？」
　アルクェイドを指差して、俺は自爆した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She is what?”
“Well, you see, um────”
Damn it, anything I say now will probably be useless, but I still have to invent some convincing excuse and smooth this over.
I have to────but before that, what on earth did Arcueid tell them when she arrived?
“Um───what did she say when she came here?”
Pointing at Arcueid, I promptly dig my own grave.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well?
What is it?"
"Um, that's, uh----"
Now that we're in this situation, I think it doesn't matter what I say, but I have to make a good excuse and get out of it.
That's what I have to do, but----why did Arcueid come here in the first place?
"Um----did she say why she came here?"
I point to Arcueid in a desperate suicide gamble.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ん？」
　アルクェイドは不思議そうに首をかしげている。
「……兄さんのご友人ではないんですか？
　この方はそうおっしゃいましたが」
「ああ───うん、友人といえば、友人」
「そうですか。
私にもご紹介していただけると嬉しいわ。
兄さんのご友人でしたら、無下にお帰りいただくわけにはいきませんし」
「あの───それはですね、秋葉さん」
　ムニャムニャと言葉を濁す俺。
　と、ずっと黙っていて我慢できなくなったのか、アルクェイドが兄妹水入らずの会話に断りもなく割って入ってきやがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm?”
Arcueid tilts her head in puzzlement.
“Is she not a friend of yours, Brother? That is what she told me.”
“Yes───well, I suppose you could call us friends.”
“I see. Then I would be delighted if you introduced us. I could hardly turn away a friend of my brother’s.”
“Ah───well, about that, Akiha…”
I mumble incoherently.
Evidently tired of keeping quiet, Arcueid barges into our private exchange without the slightest invitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm?"
She tilts her head, confused.
"…… Isn't she one of your friends, Nii-san?
That is what she told me."
"Well---yeah, you can say she's a friend."
"I see.
I really would like for her to be introduced to me.
If she is your friend, Nii-san, I can't push her out of our house."
"Ah---well, Akiha-san."
I start to stammer again.
Then Arcueid, unable to sit quietly during our sibling conversation, joins in without my permission.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「どうぞおかまいなく。
わたしは志貴を誘いにきただけだから、すぐに出掛けるわ。
ね、そうでしょ志貴？」
　くらっ。
 ───まずい。
　これ以上こいつに喋らせては、遠野志貴の身の破滅だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please don’t trouble yourself. I only came to ask Shiki out, so we’ll be leaving right away. Isn’t that right, Shiki?”
The room tilts around me.
───This is bad.
If I let her keep talking, Shiki Tohno’s life as he knows it is over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please don't worry about it.
I just came here to get Shiki, so we'll be on our way.
Isn't that right, Shiki?"
…… My whole world jolts.
------This is bad.
If I let her keep talking, she'll lead me to an early grave.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ふふ、あははははは！」
　やけくそ気味に笑いながらアルクェイドに走りよって腕を掴む。
「ちょっと志貴、急になにするのよ」
　アルクェイドの文句を聞いている余裕はない。
　俺はアルクェイドの腕をひっぱって、呆然としている秋葉を残して居間から飛び出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hahahahaha!”
Laughing with desperate abandon, I rush to Arcueid and seize her arm.
“Hey, Shiki, what are you doing?”
I have no time to listen to Arcueid complain.
Dragging Arcueid by the arm, I bolt from the room and leave a stunned Akiha behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huhu, ahahahaha!"
Laughing desperately, I run to Arcueid and grab her arm.
"Hey, Shiki, what are you doing all of a sudden?"
There's no time to listen to her complaints.
I pull on her arm and dash out of the sitting room, leaving a stunned Akiha behind.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
ロビーには翡翠がいる。
　翡翠はアルクェイドを引っ張って走ってくる俺を、いつも以上に冷たい目で見つめてくる。
「お出かけですか、志貴さま」
「―――ああ、帰りは遅くなる。
その、すっごく申し訳ないんだけど、屋敷の門は開けといてほしい」
「―――はい、かしこまりました」
　慇懃におじぎをする翡翠の横を駆け抜けて、逃げるように屋敷から外に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui is still in the foyer.
Her gaze turns colder than ever as I come running toward her, towing Arcueid behind me.
“Are you going out, Master Shiki?”
“―――Yes. I will be back late; I am truly sorry to ask, but could you leave the gates open?”
“―――Certainly.”
Hisui gives me an exquisitely formal bow as I race past her and flee the estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui is in the lobby.
She looks at me with somewhat colder eyes than usual as I run with Arcueid.
"Are you leaving, Shiki-sama?"
"----Yeah, I'll be back late.
I really am sorry, but can you leave the gate open?"
"----Yes, as you wish."
I dash past Hisui's courteously bowing figure and escape the mansion.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「いったいなあ。
いったいなんのつもりよ、いきなり外に連れ出すなんて」
「それはこっちの台詞だろ……！
　おまえな、一体なんのつもりなんだよ。
真正面からうちの屋敷にやって来るなんて正気じゃないぞ！
　もしかして俺の生活をぶっ壊すつもりなのか、このばか女……！」
　ぎり、と歯を軋ませながらアルクェイドを睨みつける。
「ばっ───ばか女って、貴方わたしを罵迦にしてるの！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow! What do you think you’re doing, dragging me outside like that?”
“That’s my line! What the hell were you thinking, walking straight up to my front door? You’ve lost your mind!
Are you trying to destroy my entire life, you stupid woman?”
Grinding my teeth, I glare at Arcueid.
“St───stupid woman, are you calling me stupid?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ow.
Just what in the world were you thinking, taking me outside so quickly like that?"
"That's my line……!
What in the world were you thinking!?
Coming into my house like that is just insane!
Are you trying to destroy my life, you idiot……!"
I grit my teeth as I glare at Arcueid.
"I---idiot!?
Are you calling me an idiot!?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ばかをばかって言ってんだから、それ以外なにがあるっていうんだばか！
　何か反論があったら聞いてやるから言ってみろ！」
「え───あ、う？」
　とにかくもう、完全に頭にきた。
　こんなに頭にきたのは久しぶりで、怒ったからには相手がなんであれ真っ正面から文句を言わなくちゃ気が済まない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am calling an idiot an idiot, so what else could I mean, idiot? If you have an argument, let us hear it!”
“Wh───uh?”
I am well and truly furious.
I have not been this angry in years, and now that I am, I will not be satisfied until I tell her exactly what I think, no matter who she is.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm calling an idiot an idiot, so what else is there, idiot!
If you want to argue, I'm listening!"
"Eh----ah, huh?"
I'm completely infuriated.
It's been a while since I've been this mad, and once I'm mad, I have to say everything I want to the person I'm mad at, no matter who it is.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「なによ、わたしは志貴に会いに来ただけじゃない。
そんなに怒られるようなコトはしてないわ！」
「……ちょっと待て。
会いにきただけって、アルクェイド、おまえ本気で言ってるのか」
「だって、わたし別におかしなコトは言ってないわ。
志貴の妹さんには志貴の目のことも、わたしのコトもちゃんと黙っててあげてたんだから」
「そんなのは当然だ。
そんな事まで口にしてたらこうして話なんかしてない。
ためらわずにあの場で屋敷の外にほうりだしてた」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All I did was come to see you, so why are you this angry? I did nothing to deserve it!”
“Wait, you only came to see me? Arcueid, are you serious?”
“I did not say anything strange. I even kept quiet about your eyes and about myself when I talked to your sister.”
“Of course you did. If you had mentioned any of that, we would not be standing here talking. I would have thrown you off the estate on the spot.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, I just came to see you.
I didn't do anything to make you mad!"
"…… Wait.
Are you serious, Arcueid?
You only came to see me?"
"I didn't even say anything weird.
I didn't say anything to your sister about your eyes or about me or anything."
"Of course.
If you did, we wouldn't be talking like this.
I would not have hesitated and thrown you out if you did."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……わっかんないなあ。
それじゃなんでそんなに怒ってるのよ、貴方は」
「そっちがあんまりにも考えなしだからだろっ！
　いいか、おまえは居るだけで目立つんだ。
この際だから言っておくけど、おまえはもう少し自分が厄介な存在なんだって気がついたほうがいいぞ……！」
　と、とりあえず言いたい事を全部口にした。
　そうなるとスッキリとして冷静になれるのだけど、言われたい放題のアルクェイドは当然のようにスッキリしない。
　アルクェイドは猫のようにむーっと、不機嫌そうに睨んでくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not get it… then why are you so angry?”
“Because you never think anything through!
Listen, you stand out just by being there. While we are at it, you need to realize that your very presence causes trouble…!”
There, I have finally said everything I wanted to say.
The release clears my head, but Arcueid, having endured the whole tirade, is understandably no happier.
She glares at me with a catlike pout.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't get it.
Then why are you so mad?"
"That's because you don't ever think!
Look, you already stand out just being here.
I'll say it now, but you should realize that just by being here you cause trouble……!"
For the time being, I said it all.
Getting it all out of my system calms me down, but obviously Arcueid isn't so calm.
Looking like a cat, she stares at me ill-temperedly.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――なによ、かってなことばっかり言って。
だいたい居るだけで目立つってどうしてよ。
わたし、外見は人間と変わらないでしょう？」
「だから、美人は居るだけで目立つものなんだって。
人間であるかどうかなんて関係ない」
　きっぱりと言い返す。
　あんまりにあっさりした返答だったからか、アルクェイドもそっか、とあっさり納得したようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You are the one saying whatever you please. And why would I stand out just by being there? I look no different from a human.”
“Because beautiful women stand out wherever they are. Whether you are human has nothing to do with it.”
I answer without hesitation.
Perhaps because the answer comes so readily, Arcueid accepts it just as readily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----What, saying things like that… What do you mean I stand out?
Don't I look like any other human?"
"No, beautiful women always stand out.
It doesn't have anything to do with being human."
I answer directly.
I answer so flatly that Arcueid understands flatly, too.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「───まあ、こっちも言い過ぎた。
こういう修羅場っていうのは初めてだったから、気が動転してたんだ」
「……別にいいよ。
悪かったのはわたしの方みたいだから」
　アルクェイドはやけに素直にうなずいた。
　なんか、それはそれで裏がありそうで恐いな、と思ってしまう自分が後ろめたい。
　……そもそも、どうしてアルクェイドはうちにやってきたりしたんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“───Anyway, I went too far. I have never been caught in a scene like that before, and I panicked.”
“It is fine. It sounds like I was the one at fault.”
Arcueid nods with disconcerting meekness.
I feel guilty for finding even that suspicious.
But why did she come to my house in the first place?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Well, I said too much.
It was the first time that's happened to me, so I kind of panicked."
"…… That's okay.
It seems like I was the one to blame."
Arcueid nods meekly.
I feel a little guilty because I think there's something more to it than that.
…… In the first place, why did she come to my house……?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ところでさ、どうしてうちに来たりしたんだよ。
……まあ、こっちもおまえに話があったから、ちょうど良かったっていえば良かったんだけど」
「そうなの？
　わたしはただ、志貴はどうしてるのかなって様子を見に来ただけなんだけど」
「……そうか。
頼むから、次はどこか目立たないところでこっそり見に来てくれ。
できるだけ誰にもみつからないようにな」
　……なんだか、どっと疲れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“By the way, why did you come to my house? I suppose the timing worked out, since I needed to talk to you too.”
“Oh, you did? I only came by to see how you were doing.”
“I see… next time, please observe me secretly from somewhere inconspicuous. Try not to let anyone find you.”
All at once, I feel exhausted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, why did you come over?
…… Well, I wanted to talk to you, too, so I guess it's a good thing."
"Really?
I was just… wondering how you were doing, so I swung by to see you."
"…… I see.
Next time, please do so in a different place.
And as stealthily as possible, too."
…… I'm worn out.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――ともかくだ、真剣に話したいことがある。
ここじゃ落ち着かないから場所を変えたいんだけど、いいか？」
「いいけど―――話ってなによ」
「すぐにわかる。
……そうだな、そろそろ人気もなくなるし、公園あたりがいいかもしれない」
　行くよ、と声をかけて歩き始める。
　アルクェイドは首をかしげながら、大人しく後についてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Anyway, I need to talk to you about something serious. I cannot talk comfortably here, so can we go somewhere else?”
“All right, but―――what do you want to talk about?”
“You will see. It should be empty soon, so the park might be best.”
I tell her to come along and start walking.
Arcueid tilts her head, then obediently follows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Anyway, I want to have a serious talk.
I want to talk about it somewhere else since I feel uneasy here, so is that okay?"
"Sure----but talk about what?"
"You'll see.
…… There'll be less people around, so let's go more towards the middle of the park."
Telling her to come on, I start walking.
Tilting her head in curiosity, she follows me obediently.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――夜は始まったばかりだ。
　いや、正確に言うのなら、アルクェイドが出歩いているとしたら日中よりは夜、それも深夜に近い時間帯だろう。
「……やっぱり街を中心に探しまわったほうが効率的か」
　……考えたくないが、吸血鬼事件の犠牲者はたいてい路地裏で発見される。
　アルクェイドを―――いや、まだ続いている吸血鬼殺人の犯人を探すのなら、街を地道に探しまわるしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The night has only just begun.
More precisely, if Arcueid is out roaming, she is far likelier to appear at night than in daylight—and later at night, at that.
“I will have better odds if I concentrate on downtown.”
I do not like thinking about it, but most victims of the vampire killings are found in back alleys.
If I want to find Arcueid―――no, whoever is still committing those murders, I will have to search the city street by street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The night has just begun.
No, to be more exact, if Arcueid would be walking around, it would most likely be during the night rather than during the day.
"…… I guess it would be more efficient to search around town."
…… I don't want to think about it, but most of the victims are usually found in alleys.
If I want to find Arcueid----if I want to find the vampire killer who's continuing to murder, then I have to stick to searching the streets.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――くそ。
なにやってるんだろう、俺は！」
　自分で自分の気持ちがわからず、悪態をついてまたあてもなく走り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Damn it. What the hell am I doing?”
Unable to make sense of my own feelings, I curse and start running aimlessly again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Damn it.
What am I doing!?"
Not understanding my own feelings, I curse and start to run around aimlessly.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――――はあ」
　どさり、とガードレールに腰を下ろす。
　あれから数時間。
　あてもなく探しまわってみたはいいが、アルクェイドの姿は影も形も見当たらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Haaah.”
I drop heavily onto a guardrail.
Hours have passed.
I have searched everywhere without the faintest idea where to look, and found no trace of Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------*sigh*
I sit down on the guard rail.
It's been several hours already.
I looked around aimlessly, and I didn't even catch a single glimpse of Arcueid.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「…………くそ」
　すごく、悔しい。
　そりゃあ街の中でなんのアテもなく人を見つけ出すのがどれだけ困難かわかってはいたけど、アイツにかぎってはあっさりと見付かるって、心のどこかで楽観していた。
「どこいったんだよ、アイツ……」
　……どうしてだろう。
　別にアイツには吸血鬼殺人の話を聞くだけなのに、会えないとわかると、ひどく―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it…”
The frustration is unbearable.
I knew how nearly impossible it would be to find one person in a city without a lead, but somewhere inside I assumed that she, of all people, would simply turn up.
“Where the hell did she go…?”
Why, I wonder.
All I need from her is an answer about the vampire killings, yet now that I cannot find her, I feel so terribly―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Damn it."
It's so, frustrating.
Of course, I knew it isn't easy to just randomly find someone in town, but I still felt optimistic I would find her.
"Where did she go……?"
…… Why?
I just wanted to ask her about the serial killings, but once I find out I can't see her, I----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ああ、やめやめ。
こんなのはもう止めだ」
　ガードレールから立ちあがって歩き出す。
　いいかげん時刻も午前零時になろうとしている。
　これ以上はアルクェイドを捜す、なんていう無駄な事はやっていられない。
「……………」
　でもまあ、ここまできたらもう少しだけ。
　最後にもう一箇所だけ様子を見てみて、それで見付からなかったら屋敷に帰ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget it. I am done with this.”
I rise from the guardrail and start walking.
It is nearly midnight. I cannot keep wasting my time searching for Arcueid.
“……………”
Still, after coming this far, I might as well look a little longer.
One last place; if she is not there, I will go back to the estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, stop.
Stop.
I should just stop."
I stand up from the guardrail and start walking.
It'll be midnight soon.
Searching for Arcueid any longer really is just useless.
"…………"
But, if I've gone this far, I can do just a little more.
There's one last place I need to check.
If she's not there, then I'll go back to the mansion.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……人気のない公園。
　あの夜、アルクェイドに協力して、ネロという吸血鬼を倒した場所にやってきた。
　街を捜してばかりいたから、今夜はここには立ち寄っていない。
「……まあ、見付かりっこないんだけど……」
　ぼやいて、公園の中へ足を踏み入れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
The deserted park.
I have come to the place where Arcueid and I defeated the vampire called Nrvnqsr that night.
I have spent all evening searching downtown, so this is the one place I have not checked.
“Not that she will actually be here…”
Grumbling, I step into the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The deserted park.
I arrive at the place where I cooperated with Arcueid and defeated Nrvnqsr.
Having only looked in town, I've yet to search here.
"…… Well, not that I'll find anything……"
Grumbling to myself, I enter the park.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
夜の十二時。
　さすがにこの時間になると、公園に人気はない。
　ここまで誰もいないと、逆にさっぱりとするぐらいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Midnight.
At this hour, naturally, the park is deserted. The emptiness is so complete it almost feels refreshing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Midnight.
As expected, there's no one here this late at night.
With this much silence, it rather feels refreshing.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……そうだよな。
そう都合よく見付かるはずなんてなかった」
　はあ、と両肩を落とす。
「………バカだな。
なにがっかりしてるんだろ、俺」
　自分でもわからない。
　ただ、もう一度ぐらい―――アイツの笑顔とか、見ておきたかったのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course… it was never going to be that easy.”
My shoulders sag with a sigh.
“What an idiot. Why am I so disappointed?”
I do not even know.
Maybe I only wanted to see her smile once more―――perhaps that was it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
It's not like I can conveniently find her."
I breathe out a sigh and slump my shoulders.
"…… How stupid.
Why am I so disappointed?"
I don't understand it myself.
Just, once more----I think maybe I wanted to see her smile.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あ、いたいた。
こんばんは、志貴」
　……そう、こんなふうに、吸血鬼なんて信じられないぐらいの気軽さで話しかけてくるアイツの顔を――――
「ア、	アルクェイド―――！？」
　思わず。
そのまま、アルクェイドの両肩を掴まえていた。
「えっ―――」
　
　びくっ、と驚くアルクェイド。
　掴まえたアルクェイドの肩は確かに現実で、あわてて両手を離す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, there you are. Good evening, Shiki.”
That face of hers, greeting me with a breeziness that made it impossible to believe she was a vampire――――
“A-Arcueid―――!?”
Without thinking. I seize her by both shoulders.
“What―――?”
Arcueid flinches in surprise.
Her shoulders are solid and real beneath my hands, and I hastily let her go.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, there you are.
Good evening, Shiki."
…… Yeah, just like this.
Her face that's so cheerful and carefree you can't believe it belongs to a vampire----
"A,      Arcueid----!?"
Without even thinking, I grab both of her shoulders.
"Eh----?"
Arcueid flinches in surprise.

Arcueid's shoulders are indeed real, and I quickly pull my arms back.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「お、おまえ、なんで――――」
　ずっと捜していた相手が目の前にいるっていうのに、混乱した俺の頭はそんな事しか喋らせてくれない。
「なんでって、おかしいかな。
志貴のことを捜してたんだから、こうして会うのは偶然じゃないと思うけど」
「え―――俺を捜してたって、なんで？」
「なんでって―――別に理由なんてないけど」
　きっぱりと、理由のない事を堂々と言いきるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y-you, why――――”
The person I have searched for all night is standing before me, yet in my confusion, that is all I can manage to say.
“What is strange about that? I was looking for you, so I would not call our meeting a coincidence.”
“You were looking for me―――why?”
“Why―――there was no particular reason.”
Arcueid declares her complete lack of a reason with magnificent certainty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y, you, why----"
Even though the one I've been searching for so long is right before me, I can't do anything but stumble over my words.
"Why?
That's odd.
I was looking for you, so I don't think it's coincidence we met here."
"Eh----You, were looking for me?
Why?"
"Why?
----Oh, no reason."
She says straight out that she has no reason to be looking for me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　……忘れてた。
コイツは、そういう猫みたいなヤツだったんだっけ。
「……まあ、ちょうど良かった。
実をいうとさ、俺もアルクェイドに会いたかったんだ。
ここで会えて、その――――」
　本当に嬉しい、なんて言いそうになって、慌てて言葉を飲む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……………”
I had forgotten… she was that kind of creature, more cat than person.
“Well, the timing works out. To tell the truth, I wanted to see you too. I found you, and――――”
I nearly say that I am truly happy, then hurriedly swallow the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… I forgot.
She really is kind of like a cat this way.
"…… Well, I guess it works out.
To be honest, I wanted to see you too.
So meeting here, um----"
I was about to say it makes me really happy, but I frantically choke those words off.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――ともかくだ、真剣に話たいことがある。
ここじゃ落ち着かないから場所を変えたいんだけど、いいか？」
「いいけど―――話ってなによ」
「すぐにわかる。
……もう少し奥のほうに移動しよう」
　行くよ、と声をかけて歩き始める。
　アルクェイドは首をかしげながら、大人しくこちらの後についてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Anyway, I need to talk to you about something serious. I cannot talk comfortably here, so can we go somewhere else?”
“All right, but―――what do you want to talk about?”
“You will see. Let us go farther into the park.”
I tell her to come along and start walking.
Arcueid tilts her head, then obediently follows me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Anyway, I want to have a serious talk.
I want to talk about it somewhere else since I feel uneasy here, so is that okay?"
"Sure----but talk about what?"
"You'll see.
…… Let's go more to the back of the park."
Telling her to come on, I start walking.
Tilting her head in curiosity, she follows me obediently.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「それで話ってなんなの、志貴？」
「吸血鬼のこと。
おまえ、前に言ったよな。
巷を騒がしている通り魔殺人は吸血鬼の仕業だって」
　ええ、とアルクェイドは頷く。
「それじゃあ、今朝のニュースでまた新しい犠牲者が出たっていうのは知ってるか？
　昨日の夜に通り魔に殺されて、血を抜かれたらしいんだけど」
「―――――」
　……アルクェイドの瞳が細まる。
　なにか。
　背筋が凍えるような、緊迫感。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what did you want to talk about, Shiki?”
“Vampires. You said it before. Those random killings everyone is talking about are the work of a vampire.”
Arcueid nods.
“Then did you hear this morning’s report? Apparently another victim was killed last night and drained of blood.”
“―――――”
Arcueid’s eyes narrow.
Something changes.
The tension chills my spine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What did you want to talk about, Shiki?"
"About vampires.
You said it before.
That the recent serial killings were the work of a vampire."
Arcueid nods.
"Then do you know the morning news said another victim was found?
She was killed last night and drained of blood."
"-----"
…… Arcueid's eyes narrow.
Something…
Something like a freezing tension races down my spine.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ふぅん、それで？」
「それでって―――おまえ」
　ごくり、と唾を飲みこむ。
　アルクェイドの視線は、まっすぐに俺を捉えている。
　まるで―――こっちが少しでも動けば、即座に襲いかかってきそうな、そんな視線。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm, and?”
“And―――Arcueid, you”
I swallow.
Arcueid’s gaze fixes squarely on me.
It is as though―――if I move even slightly, she will attack at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
And?"
"And?---you……"
I swallow hard.
She stares right at me.
Almost---a stare which says she will attack me immediately if I move even the slightest bit.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「お―――おかしいじゃないか、アルクェイド。
　ネロは死んだはずだろ。
なのに、どうしてまだ吸血鬼騒ぎがおこっているんだ。
まさかとは思うけど、あれは、おまえが―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This―――this makes no sense, Arcueid.
Nrvnqsr is supposed to be dead. So why are vampire killings still happening? Do not tell me you are―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is---isn't it strange, Arcueid?
Nrvnqsr is dead.
So why are these incidents still happening?
Don't tell me, that, you---"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そんなワケないでしょ。
それはわたしじゃなくて、他の吸血種の仕業よ」
　あっさりと緊張を解いて、呆れたようにアルクェイドは即答した。
　けれどこっちは納得がいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. It was another member of a vampiric species.”
The tension leaves her at once, and Arcueid answers with open exasperation.
I am not convinced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's not it at all.
That's not me, but another vampire."
Arcueid responds immediately, loosening the tension.
But I'm not satisfied.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「なんだよそれ。
他の吸血種の仕業って、そう次から次へと吸血鬼が出てくるっていうのか」
「まさか。
あの連続殺人事件っていうのは初めから一人の吸血種の仕業だもの。
新しい吸血種なんてのはやってこないし、ネロだってあの事件にはまったく関係がないわ」
――――え？
　ネロだって、関係ない……？
「な―――それ、どういう意味だよ」
「言ったとおりの意味だけど。
……もう、志貴ってキレるようでいてどこか抜けてるのね。
いい？
　たしかにネロは吸血種だったけど、あいつは人の血を吸っていた？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What does that mean? Are you saying vampires will keep appearing one after another?”
“Don’t be ridiculous. Those serial murders have been the work of a single member of a vampiric species from the beginning. No new member has arrived, and Nrvnqsr had nothing to do with the case at all.”
――――What?
Even Nrvnqsr had nothing to do with them?
“Wh―――what do you mean?”
“Exactly what I said. Honestly, Shiki, you are sharp in some ways and astonishingly dense in others. Listen. Nrvnqsr may have belonged to a vampiric species, but did you ever see him drink anyone’s blood?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you mean?
The work of another vampire?
So they just keep coming?"
"Of course not.
The serial killings were always the work of just one vampire from the very beginning.
So no new vampires will come, and Nrvnqsr was unrelated to those incidents."
----Eh?
Nrvnqsr was, unrelated……?
"Wha---what do you mean?"
"It's just like I said.
…… You're normally pretty sharp, but you're lost at some points.
Think back, Shiki.
Nrvnqsr was a vampire, but did he ever suck human blood?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「吸っていたかって、あいつは人間をバリバリと頭から食ってただろ―――って、あ」
　そう、か。
　なんでそんな単純な間違いに気がつかなかったっていうんだろう。
　通り魔殺人の被害者たちは、血を抜かれた遺体として発見されている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Drink blood, when he ate people whole, crunching them up from the head―――oh”
I see.
How did I miss something so simple?
The victims of these killings have all been found drained of blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Suck blood?
He ate humans and---oh."

I see.
Why didn't I notice such a simple mistake?
The victims of the serial killings are found with their bodies drained of blood.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
けれどネロは違う。
　あいつは一切死体を残さない。
血を吸うどころか肉さえ食らって、その痕跡を無くしてしまう。
　現に、ホテルでアイツに食われてしまった人たちは殺人事件としてではなく、行方不明者として扱われていた。
　なら―――それは、明らかに巷で起こっている事件とは違うものだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nrvnqsr was different.
He left no corpses. He did not merely drink blood—he devoured even flesh, erasing every trace.
The people he ate at the hotel were treated as missing persons, not murder victims.
Then―――his acts were plainly different from the killings taking place around the city.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But Nrvnqsr was different.
He didn't leave any dead bodies behind.
He not only drank the blood, but also ate the meat, leaving no trace.
To prove it, the people eaten by him in the hotel were treated as missing people, not killed people.
So---that means, it is something completely different.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「まってくれ。
それじゃあ今起きている殺人事件はなんなんだ。
いったいどこの誰があんな真似をしているっていうんだよ」
「だから、あの事件はネロと別の吸血種の仕業なのよ。
正確にいうとソイツがいるからわたしがこの街にやってきて、ネロはわたしを追いかけてこの街にやってきた、っていう相関図かな」
「―――な。
そ、それじゃあおまえが追っている敵っていうのはネロじゃなかったのか！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. Then what are these murders? Who the hell has been doing them?”
“Like I said, another member of a vampiric species, one other than Nrvnqsr, is responsible; to be exact, I came to this city because that creature was here, and Nrvnqsr came because he was chasing me. That is the chain of events.”
“―――What? Then the enemy you were hunting was not Nrvnqsr?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait.
Then what is the serial killing going on right now?
Just who is doing it?"
"That's a different vampire than Nrvnqsr.
To be more specific, that vampire is why I came here, and Nrvnqsr came here following me.
It's that sort of correlation."
"---Wha… So the one you're after wasn't Nrvnqsr after all……!?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
わたし、初めから自分の標的がネロだなんて言わなかったでしょ？
　ネロにとっての標的はわたしだったけど、わたしにとっての標的はネロじゃなくて、この街で通り魔って言われている吸血鬼だけよ。
「……志貴。
まさかとは思うけど、もしかしてすごく単純な勘違いしてたとか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right. I never said Nrvnqsr was my target, did I?
I was his target, but he was never mine; my only target was the vampire this city calls its serial murderer.”
“…Shiki, don’t tell me you made some incredibly basic mistake.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I didn't ever say he was my initial target.
I was his target, but he was never my target; my target is the one called the 'serial killer' in this city."
"…… Shiki.
I don't quite believe it, but don't tell me you made such a simple mistake?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　愕然と息を飲む。
　けど―――たしかにアルクェイドの言うとおりだ。
　アルクェイドの目的が吸血鬼殺しだというから、俺は完全に早とちりして、こいつはネロを倒すためにいるんだってばかり思ってた――――
「……それじゃあ何か？
　あの夜ネロと殺しあったのは、実はまったく無意味なことだったっていうのか………！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――――”
I suck in a stunned breath.
But―――Arcueid is right.
When she said she was here to kill a vampire, I jumped to the conclusion that she meant Nrvnqsr――――
“…Then are you saying that fighting Nrvnqsr that night was completely pointless?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha-----"
I gasp in shock.
But---it really is just as she says.
She said her purpose is to kill vampires, so I just thought it was Nrvnqsr she was after----

"…… So what is it?
Killing Nrvnqsr that night, was pointless………!?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「無意味じゃないわ。
志貴はわたしの代わりに戦ってくれたんじゃない。
ま、もっとも志貴さえわたしを殺さなかったら、あんな事にはならなかったでしょうけどね」
「――――――」
　くらり、と目眩がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It wasn’t pointless. You fought him in my place, didn’t you? Though none of it would have happened if you hadn’t killed me first.”
“――――――”
The world tilts around me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It wasn't pointless, you fought in my place.
Well, if you didn't kill me, you probably wouldn't have had to in the first place."
"------"
I feel a little dizzy.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……つまり、ネロは吸血鬼殺人にはまったく関係なくて、ここ一ヶ月街を騒がしているのは別の吸血鬼の仕業ってこと……？」
「うん、そうゆうこと。
でも、これはわたしが済ませる問題だから志貴は気にしないでいいよ。
そんなコトより、ねえ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So Nrvnqsr had nothing to do with the vampire murders, and another vampire has been terrorizing the city this entire month?”
“Yes, exactly. But that is my problem to handle, so you need not worry about it. More importantly, Shiki”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… In other words, those vampire killings had nothing at all to do with Nrvnqsr and it was the work of another vampire……?"
"Yeah, that's right.
But, that's my problem so you don't have to worry about it.
But more than that, hey."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
やけに楽しそうな笑顔をうかべて、アルクェイドは呆然としている俺を見上げてくる。
「昨夜はどうだった？
　誰が出てきた？」
entries.maoEnglish:
With a strangely delighted smile, Arcueid looks up at me as I stand there dumbfounded.
“How was last night? Who showed up?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
With an extremely happy smile, Arcueid looks up at me as I still stand there in surprise.
"How was last night?
Who came?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「は？」
　昨夜って、なんのコトだろう。
　アルクェイドの言っている事は、よくわからない。
　どうせ俺はアルクェイドの言葉をかってに勘違いして、見当違いのことばっかり考えていたお間抜けさんだ。
　そんなヤツにアルクェイドの言っているコトなんて解るはずがないだろうけど―――って、あれ？
　昨夜誰が出てきたのか、とアルクェイドは聞いてきたのか―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh?”
What does she mean, last night?
I can’t make sense of anything Arcueid says.
Then again, I’m the dimwit who keeps misunderstanding her and chasing every wrong idea that enters my head.
Someone like me could hardly understand a thing Arcueid says―――wait, what?
Did Arcueid just ask who appeared last night―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?"
What does she mean by last night?
I don't understand what she's talking about.
After all, I'm the idiot who mistook Arcueid's words and made such a stupid mistake, so of course I don't understand what she is saying, and---huh?
Did Arcueid ask me who came last night---?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
昨夜って、なに」
「あれ？
　おっかしいなあ、ちゃんと夢魔を送っておいたんだけど」
「待った。
なに、そのムマって」
「えーと、ようするにその本人が望むような夢を見せる使い魔のことよ。
志貴は男性だからサキュバスを送っておいたんだけど、いい夢見れたでしょ？」
「お―――――」
　いい夢見れたでしょ、って、アレは。
　現実としか思えないぐらいリアルな夢を思い出して、カッと赤面するのがわかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. What do you mean by ‘last night’?”
“That’s strange. I know I sent a dream demon to you.”
“Hold it. A what demon?”
“Basically, it is a familiar that shows people the dreams they desire. Since you are a man, Shiki, I sent you a succubus; you had a nice dream, did you not?”
“Oh―――――”
That was supposed to be a nice dream?
The memory of a dream so vivid it felt real rushes back, and heat floods my face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
What do you mean by 'last night'?"
"Hm?
That's strange, I know I sent you a dream familiar."
"Wait, what's that dream familiar thing?"
"Um, it's like a familiar that lets you see a dream about what you desire the most.
You're a male, so I sent you a succubus.
Wasn't it a good dream?"
"I-----"
A good dream?
That was…
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ア、アレはおまえの仕業かッ―――！」
　にんまり、とアルクェイドが笑う。
―――しまった。
　黙っていればこんな話題はすぐに終わったっていうのに、わざわざ自分で認めるなんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Th-that was your doing―――!”
Arcueid breaks into a wicked grin.
―――Damn it.
If I had kept quiet, the subject would have died on its own; instead, I went and admitted it myself―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I remember the realistic dream I had and my face turns red.
"You, that was your doing---!"
Arcueid grins even more.
---Crap.
If I stayed quiet this conversation would have been over, but since I reacted so strongly---
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あ、やっぱり届いてたんだ。
ね、それで誰が出たの？
　やっぱり妹さんが相手？」
「あ、あ、秋葉のはずがあるかーーーーっ！
　おまえ、俺をなんだと思ってるんだ！
　実の妹を襲うほどイカレてないぞ、俺は！」
「ふーん。
妹さんじゃないとすると、屋敷にいたメイドさん？」
　下から、さも楽しそうにアルクェイドは見上げてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, so it did reach you. Tell me, who was in it? Your little sister?”
“A-Akiha?! Of course it was not Akiha! What kind of lunatic do you think I am; I am not sick enough to go after my own sister!”
“Hmm. If it was not your sister, was it one of the maids at the estate?”
Arcueid peers up at me from below, looking thoroughly amused.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, so you did get it.
So, who came?
I know, it was your sister, right?"
"N, n, not Akiha----!
What kind of a guy do you think I am!
I'm not crazy to do that to a sister!"
"Hmm.
If it wasn't your sister, then was it the maids at the mansion?"
Arcueid looks up at me full of amusement.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「うっ――――」
　それは、昨日の夢のアルクェイドに、似てる。
「か、関係ないだろ。
ほっといてくれ」
　アルクェイドから目を逸らして、つっぱねる。
　だっていうのに、ねーねー、とアルクェイドはしつこく聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh――――”
That look resembles the Arcueid from my dream.
“N-none of your business. Just drop it.”
I turn away and try to shut her down.
She only follows, pestering me with an endless chorus of “Come on.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh----"
She's acting like the Arcueid from last night's dream.
"It doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
I look away from her and refuse.
But Arcueid keeps saying "Come on, come on," over and over.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ね、教えてよ。
志貴が誰といい夢をみたかぐらい、教えてくれてもいいじゃない」
　アルクェイドは興味本位の子供みたいに問いただしてくる。
　いくら視線をそらしてもすぐに視線の先に回りこんできて、ねーねーと声をあげる。
　……ひどい拷問だ。
　これじゃあ、まるっきり昨日の焼き直しみたいじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. You can at least tell me who you had your nice dream with.”
She questions me with the naked curiosity of a child.
Every time I look away, she darts around into my line of sight and starts pleading again.
This is torture.
It is yesterday all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Come on, tell me.
You can at least tell me who you dreamed about."
She asks like a curious kid.
Every time I turn away she keeps jumping in front of me, saying "Come on, come on."
…… This is pure torture.
She's as mischievous as last night's dream.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
ぺたり、と手の平で自分の顔を覆う。
「ねえ志貴、黙ってないで教えてよ」
　そんな俺を、アルクェイドは上目遣いに見つめてくる。
―――だめです、かみさま。
　これ以上は、限界です。
「……おまえ」
　ためらいがちに、小さく口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
I slap a palm over my face.
“Come on, Shiki; do not just stand there—tell me.”
She gazes up at me through her lashes.
―――No, God.
I can’t take any more.
“You.”
The word comes out soft and hesitant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I bury my face in my hands.
"Hey Shiki, don't be quiet and tell me."
Arcueid keeps looking at me with those upturned eyes.
---I can't, God.
This is my limit.
"…… You."
I hesitatingly let it out in a quiet voice.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――え？
　わたしがどうかした？」
「二回も言わせるな。
だから、出てきたのはおまえだったって言ってるの！」
　視線を逸らして怒鳴る。
　きょとん、とアルクェイドは目を点にした。
「わたしって、わたし……？」
「そうだよ。
なんの冗談か、おまえが出てきて、その――――」
　さすがにその先は口にできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Me? What about me?”
“Don’t make me say it twice! You were the one in the dream!”
I shout without looking at her.
Arcueid stares blankly.
“Me, as in me?”
“Yes. For some absurd reason, you appeared, and then――――”
I can’t bring myself to say the rest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Eh?
What about me?"
"Don't make me say it again.
I'm saying that it was you who came!"
I shout angrily as I look away.
Arcueid's eyes widen in surprise.
"M, me……?"
"Yeah, it's not a joke.
You came, and----"
There's no way I can finish.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　アルクェイドも気まずそうに、ようやく、俺から視線をそらしてくれた。
「……………」
「……………」
　お互い、なにを言っていいものかわからない。
　そのまま黙ったままの、ひどく居心地の悪い沈黙が続いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
At last, Arcueid looks away too, every bit as awkward as I feel.
“…”
“…”
Neither of us knows what to say.
A hideously uncomfortable silence stretches between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Now Arcueid looks away from me, looking very uncomfortable.
"………………"
"………………"
Neither of us know what to say.
The uncomfortable silence continues.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……。
　…………。
　……………………。
　……………………………。
　……………………………………ごほん。
　耐えきれなくなって、無理やり、そんな咳払いをした。
「……だいたいな。
夢魔だかなんだかしらないけど、なんだってそんな事しやがったんだ。
もしかして、まだ俺に殺されたことを恨んでるってわけか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………
…………
……………… Ahem
Unable to bear it any longer, I force out a theatrical cough.
“…Anyway, dream demon or whatever—why the hell did you do that? Are you still holding a grudge because I killed you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
…………………
…………………………
………………………………… *ahem*
I can't bear the silence any longer and force out that cough.

"…… In the first place, why did you send me that dream familiar thing?
Are you still angry at me for killing you?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そんなわけないでしょ。
夢魔を送ったのはネロを倒してくれたお礼よ。
志貴には感謝してるから、喜んでくれたらいいなって」
「お礼って―――あんなお礼はお断りだよ。
悪趣味な真似をして、いったい何考えてんだ、吸血鬼っていう連中は」
　呆れて肩をすくめる。
　と、アルクェイドはなにが不満なのか、ますます不機嫌そうにこっちを睨みつけた。
「なによ、志貴のいじわる。
どうせわたしは人間じゃないですよーだ」
　ぷん、とそっぽを向くと、スタスタと歩き始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. I sent it as a reward for defeating Nrvnqsr. I’m grateful to you, Shiki, and I wanted to give you something you’d enjoy.”
“A reward―――? Keep that to yourself; what goes through the minds of vampires, pulling a tasteless stunt like this?”
I shrug in exasperation.
For some reason, that only makes Arcueid glare at me more fiercely.
“You are so mean, Shiki. Fine, I am not human anyway—so there.”
She turns away in a huff and marches off.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's not it at all.
I sent it as thanks for defeating Nrvnqsr.
I really am grateful to you, I thought you'd be extremely happy."
"As thanks?---I'll pass on that kind of thanks.
Having that kind of poor taste, just what are vampires thinking?"
I slump my shoulders.
I don't know what she's mad about, but she looks at me with a dissatisfied expression.
"What's that all about, you meanie?
I know I'm not human."
She turns away, then starts walking off.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「おい、ちょっと待て。
どこ行く気だよ」
「志貴には関係ないわ。
ついてこないで」
　本当にご立腹なのか、アルクェイドは振り返りもせずに歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, wait. Where are you going?”
“None of your business, Shiki. Don’t follow me.”
Apparently truly furious, Arcueid walks on without even looking back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, hold on.
Where are you going?"
"It has nothing to do with you.
Don't follow me!"
Is she really that angry?
Arcueid walks away without even turning around.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　あいつ、どこに行くつもりなんだろう。
「…………」
　ちょっと、今のは言いすぎたかな。
　結果や手段はどうあれ、アルクェイドは善意でお礼をしてきたんだから、その気持ちはちゃんと喜んで受け取るべきなんじゃないかな、なんて今更ながら罪悪感がわいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Where is she going?
“…”
Maybe I went too far.
Whatever the result and however bizarre the method, Arcueid meant the gift kindly, and belated guilt begins to gnaw at me for failing to accept the feeling behind it with a little gratitude.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Where does she plan on going anyway?
"…………"
Maybe I did say too much.
No matter what the results were or the methods used, she really thanked me with good intentions.
I start to feel intense regret and think that maybe I should have just accepted her gift happily.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　くそ、なんでこんなに放っておけないんだろう、あのアルクェイドっていうヤツは……！
「ああもう―――ちょっと待てって言ってるだろ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
Damn it, why is Arcueid so impossible to leave alone?
“Oh, come on―――I said wait!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Damn it.
Why is it that I just can't leave Arcueid alone……!?
"Aw---Hey, I said wait!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――そんなコト、死んでも言えない。
「アルクェイドには関係ないだろ。
いいからほっといてくれ」
　アルクェイドから目を逸らして、つっぱねる。
　だっていうのに、ねーねー、とアルクェイドはしつこく聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I would rather die than tell her that.
“It has nothing to do with you, Arcueid. Just leave me alone.”
I turn my face away and rebuff her.
Arcueid refuses to give up, pestering me with an endless chorus of come on, come on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'd die before I'd say it.
"Arcueid, it doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
I look away from her and refuse.
But Arcueid keeps saying "Come on, come on," over and over.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ね、教えてよ。
志貴がどんな夢を見たかぐらい、教えてくれてもいいじゃない」
　アルクェイドは興味本位の子供みたいに問いただしてくる。
　いくら視線をそらしてもすぐに視線の先に回りこんできて、ねーねーと声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. You can at least tell me what kind of dream you had, can’t you?”
She badgers me with the open curiosity of a child.
No matter where I turn, she immediately darts into my line of sight and starts pleading again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Come on, tell me.
You can at least tell me who you dreamed about."
She asks like a curious kid.
Every time I turn away she keeps jumping in front of me, saying "Come on, come on."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……頼むから、かんべんしてくれ。
あの夢はどうかしてたんだ。
……いまだって、あんな―――」
　あんな夢を見た理由がわからない。
　アルクェイドは俺の願望だっていうけど、アレが自分の願望だなんて思いたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please, just spare me. That dream was insane. Even now, something like that―――”
I still do not know why I had a dream like that.
Arcueid says the dream reflected my desires, but I refuse to believe I could desire that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please, just let it go.
There was something wrong with that dream.
…… Even now, that---"
I don't know why I saw that dream.
Arcueid says it's my greatest desire, but I don't want to think that's what it was.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「あ、それとももしかして悪夢になっちゃったとか。
あの子、相手のことを気にいると勝手に脚色しちゃうのよね。
まだ半人前だから仕方ないかもしれないけど」
　ぶつぶつとアルクェイドは呟く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, did it turn into a nightmare? When that girl takes a liking to her subject, she starts embellishing the dream however she pleases. I suppose it can’t be helped—she’s still only half-trained.”
Arcueid mutters this to herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, maybe it turned into a nightmare?
She does tend to write the story to her liking when fond of her target.
She's only a novice, so I guess it couldn't be helped."
Arcueid mumbles to herself.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……？
　かってに脚色するって、どういうこと」
「対象の願望を自己流に解釈するのよ。
志貴に送った夢魔はまだ子供だから、いたずら好きなんでしょうね」
「――――そう、か」
　……安心した。
　そうだよな、いくらなんでもあんな夢―――自分から見るはずがないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What do you mean, she embellishes it?” “She interprets the subject’s desires in her own peculiar way. The dream demon I sent you is still immature, so she must enjoy playing pranks.”
“――――I see.”
Relief washes over me.
Of course; something like that could never have been my own dream―――not by choice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
Writes the story to her liking?
What do you mean?"
"I'm saying she interprets your desire in her own way.
That dream familiar I sent you is just a child, so she likes to play pranks."
"----I see."
…… That's a relief.
That's right, that dream---It couldn't have been what I wanted.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
ホッと胸を撫で下ろす。
　これで俺の潔白はそれなりに証明されたわけだけど―――
「アルクェイド。
おまえ、どうしてそんな物騒なヤツを送りつけたんだ。
嫌がらせにしてもホドがあるぞ、アレ」
「むっ。
嫌がらせなんかしないわ。
　志貴に夢魔を送ったのは、ネロを倒してくれたお礼じゃない。
貴方には感謝してるから、喜んでくれたらいいなって思ったのに！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I breathe a sigh of relief.
That more or less proves my innocence, but―――
“Arcueid, why did you send such a dangerous creature after me? Even harassment has its limits. That thing went far beyond them.”
“Hmph. I wasn’t harassing you.
I sent you the dream demon as a reward for defeating Nrvnqsr. I’m grateful to you, so I thought it might make you happy!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let out a sigh of relief.
With this, my innocence has been proved but---
"Arcueid.
Why did you send me such a thing?
That's too much even for harassment."
"Hmph.
I wouldn't harass you.
I sent you the dream familiar to thank you for defeating Nrvnqsr.
I really am grateful to you, so I thought it'll be great if it made you happy."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「お礼って―――いや、感謝してもらえるのは嬉しいけど、その」
　いくらなんでも、ああいうお礼はお断りしたい。
「なによ。
人の好意を受け取れないっていうの、志貴は」
「……あのね。
人じゃなくて吸血鬼だろ、アルクェイドは」
「……それは……そうだけど」
　しゅん、とアルクェイドは肩をすくめる。
　……なんていうか、アルクェイドの感情表現はストレートだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A reward―――I mean, I am glad you appreciate what I did, but…”
Even so, I would prefer not to receive that particular kind of reward.
“What? Can’t you accept a person’s kindness, Shiki?”
“Listen. You are not a person, Arcueid; you are a vampire.”
“Well, yes, but…”
Arcueid’s shoulders droop.
Arcueid makes no attempt to hide what she feels.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank me?---Well, I'm happy you were grateful, but…"
But no matter what, I'll pass on that sort of thanks.
"Oh come on.
Are you saying you can't accept a person's goodwill?"
"…… Hey, you're not a person, you're a vampire, Arcueid."
"…… That's…… true but."
Arcueid slumps her shoulders.
…… How do I say this… Arcueid is very open in expressing her emotions.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
喜んだり怒ったり反省したり、ともかくくるくると表情が変わって―――その、すごく魅力的だと思う。
　……口では吸血鬼だろ、なんて言っておきながら。
　俺自身、そんな事実を忘れてしまうぐらい、アルクェイドは人間らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Delight, anger, remorse―――her expression shifts with every feeling, and, well, I find it incredibly attractive.
…For all that I called her a vampire to her face,
Arcueid is so human that I keep forgetting the truth myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Being happy, being angry, she changes her expressions so quickly---It's actually kind of charming.
…… I said she was a vampire, but,
she really does seem like a human, enough to even make me forget that fact.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……だいたいな。
夢魔だかなんだかしらないけど、なんだってそんな事しやがったんだ。
もしかして、まだ俺に殺されたことを恨んでるってわけか？」
entries.maoEnglish: “…Anyway, dream demon or whatever—why the hell did you do that? Are you still holding a grudge because I killed you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… In the first place, why did you send me that dream familiar thing?
Are you still angry at me for killing you?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そんなわけないでしょ。
夢魔を送ったのはネロを倒してくれたお礼よ。
志貴には感謝してるから、喜んでくれたらいいなって」
「お礼って―――あんなお礼はお断りだよ。
悪趣味な真似をして、いったい何考えてんだ、吸血鬼っていう連中は」
　呆れて肩をすくめる。
　と、アルクェイドはなにが不満なのか、ますます不機嫌そうにこっちを睨みつけた。
「なによ、志貴のいじわる。
どうせわたしは人間じゃないですよーだ」
　ぷん、とそっぽを向くと、スタスタと歩き始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. I sent it as a reward for defeating Nrvnqsr. I’m grateful to you, Shiki, and I wanted to give you something you’d enjoy.”
“A reward―――? Keep that to yourself; what goes through the minds of vampires, pulling a tasteless stunt like this?”
I shrug in exasperation.
For some reason, that only makes Arcueid glare at me more fiercely.
“You are so mean, Shiki. Fine, I am not human anyway—so there.”
She turns away in a huff and marches off.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's not it at all.
I sent it as thanks for defeating Nrvnqsr.
I really am grateful to you, I thought you'd be extremely happy."
"As thanks?---I'll pass on that kind of thanks.
Having that kind of poor taste, just what are vampires thinking?"
I slump my shoulders.
I don't know what she's mad about, but she looks at me with a dissatisfied expression.
"What's that all about, you meanie?
I know I'm not human."
She turns away, then starts walking off.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「おい、ちょっと待て。
どこ行く気だよ」
「志貴には関係ないわ。
ついてこないで」
　本当にご立腹なのか、アルクェイドは振り返りもせずに歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, wait. Where are you going?”
“None of your business, Shiki. Don’t follow me.”
Apparently truly furious, Arcueid walks on without even looking back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, hold on.
Where are you going?"
"It has nothing to do with you.
Don't follow me!"
Is she really that angry?
Arcueid walks away without even turning around.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　あいつ、どこに行くつもりなんだろう。
「…………」
　ちょっと、今のは言いすぎたかな。
　結果や手段はどうあれ、アルクェイドは善意でお礼をしてきたんだから、その気持ちはちゃんと喜んで受け取るべきなんじゃないかな、なんて今更ながら罪悪感がわいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Where is she going?
“…”
Maybe I went too far.
Whatever the result and however bizarre the method, Arcueid meant the gift kindly, and belated guilt begins to gnaw at me for failing to accept the feeling behind it with a little gratitude.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Where does she plan on going anyway?
"…………"
Maybe I did say too much.
No matter what the results were or the methods used, she really thanked me with good intentions.
I start to feel intense regret and think that maybe I should have just accepted her gift happily.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　くそ、なんでこんなに放っておけないんだろう、あのアルクェイドっていうヤツは……！
「ああもう―――ちょっと待てって言ってるだろ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
Damn it, why is Arcueid so impossible to leave alone?
“Oh, come on―――I said wait!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Damn it.
Why is it that I just can't leave Arcueid alone……!?
"Aw---Hey, I said wait!"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは夜の街を歩いていく。
　ただ前だけを見て、金の髪をなびかせる白い影。
　その姿は、初めて彼女を見た時のイメージとひどく一致している。
　いや、それとも。
　夜の公園で、ネロと対峙していた時のアルクェイドそのものかもしれない。
　……なにか、厭な予感がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid walks through the nighttime city.
A white figure with golden hair streaming behind her, eyes fixed only ahead.
She looks exactly as I imagined her the first time I saw her.
Or perhaps.
She looks like Arcueid when she faced Nrvnqsr in the park at night.
A sense of foreboding crawls over me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Surrounded by the night, Arcueid walks down the street.
She looks straight ahead, her white figure with golden hair fluttering.
It bears a horrible resemblance to the first time I saw her.
No, or perhaps…
Perhaps it's like the time she faced off with Nrvnqsr.
…… For some reason I have a bad feeling about this.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「おい、アルクェイド」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドは振り向きもしないで歩いていく。
「話を聞けって。
なにをしているかぐらい教えてくれてもいいだろう」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドはやっぱり振り向かずに歩いていく。
　……ここで引き下がるのも情けない。
　情けないけど、とりあえず無言で後を付いていくことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Arcueid.”
“――――――”
Arcueid keeps walking without so much as a glance back.
“Listen to me. The least you can do is tell me what you’re doing.”
“――――――”
Still she walks on without turning.
Retreating now would be pathetic.
Following her in sullen silence is probably just as pathetic, but that’s what I do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Arcueid!"
"------"
Arcueid continues to walk without turning around.
"I want to talk to you.
You can at least tell me what you're going to do."
"------"
Of course, Arcueid just continues walking without turning around.
…… It'd be miserable if I left it like this.
I decide to follow her silently for now.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
カツカツカツカツ、と足音を響かせて無言の散歩が続く。
―――と。
　ピタリ、と立ち止まってアルクェイドは振り向いた。
「ついてこないで。
後ろに貴方みたいな普通の人にいられると迷惑だって、わからない？」
「―――だから、なにをしてるのか教えてくれたら帰るって」
「……志貴には関係ないから、ほっといて」
　ぷい、とアルクェイドは前を向いて歩き始める。
　……まいったな。
　また無言の徘徊が始まるみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Our silent walk continues to the hard, unbroken rhythm of her footsteps.
―――Then.
Arcueid stops dead and turns around.
“Stop following me. Can’t you understand that having an ordinary human like you behind me is a nuisance?”
“I told you―――I’ll go home once you tell me what you’re doing.”
“It has nothing to do with you, Shiki, so leave me alone.”
She turns away with a petulant toss of her head and starts walking again.
This is getting ridiculous.
It seems our silent wandering is about to begin all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The footsteps echo through the night air.
---And then,
Arcueid suddenly stops and turns around.
"Don't follow me.
Don't you understand it's troubling for a normal person like you to follow me around?"
"---So tell me what you're going to do and I'll go back."
"…… It doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
Arcueid strides off once more.
…… Crap.
It seems like our wordless wandering is going to continue.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
大通りにさしかかった時、アルクェイドはぴたりと足を止めた。
「―――見つけた」
「え………？」
　アルクェイドの声が、別人のように冷たい。
「――――あ」
　……背筋が震える。
　背中ごしにも、今のアルクェイドがどれくらいの敵意を帯びているのかが、はっきりと感じ取れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
When we reach the main avenue, Arcueid abruptly stops.
“―――Found you.”
“What…?”
Her voice is cold enough to belong to someone else.
“――――Ah…”
A shiver runs down my spine.
Even from behind her, I can feel the sheer hostility pouring from Arcueid’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When we approach the main street, Arcueid freezes.
"---Found it."
"Eh……… ?"
Her voice is cold, like a totally different person's.
"----Ah."
…… A chill runs up my spine.
Even from behind, I can feel the hostility manifesting itself in her.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド―――おまえ、なにを――」
　するつもりだ、とは言えない。
　だって彼女が何をしようとしているのか、言葉にするまでもなく解りきっている。
　アルクェイドの体から放たれているのは紛れもない、一点の濁りもない『殺意』に他ならないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid―――what are you――”
I cannot finish by asking what she intends to do.
There is no need to put it into words; I already know.
What radiates from her is unmistakable, pure and unsullied: murderous intent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid---What, are you--"
I can't even finish.
It's clear what she intends to do without saying anything.
Without a doubt, there is nothing but the pure, unadulterated intent to kill.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「おい―――なに考えてるんだ、おまえ……！」
「――――」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　その視線の先には、なんでもない、背広姿の男性が歩いているだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell are you thinking―――?”
“――――”
Arcueid gives no answer.
Ahead of her, an utterly ordinary man in a business suit walks down the street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---What are you, thinking……!?"
"----"
Arcueid doesn't answer.
Her eyes are fixed solely on a man in a business suit walking by.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
メガネを外してあの人間を見てみなさい」
「あの人間って―――あのサラリーマンのこと？」
「早く。
わたしが何をしているか知りたいのなら、質問はあとよ」
「――――わかった。
あんまり街中で視たくはないんだけど―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Take off your glasses and look at that human.”
“That human―――you mean the office worker?”
“Quickly. If you want to know what I’m doing, save your questions.”
“――――All right. I hate using these eyes in the middle of town, but―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Take off your glasses and look at that person."
"That person---you mean that business man?"
"Hurry.
If you want to know what I'm doing, then leave the questions for later."
"----Alright.
I don't like to look while in town, but---"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
メガネを外す。
「………く」
　こめかみには軽い頭痛。
　その痛みと引き換えに、うっすらと、地面や壁に『線』が視える。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remove my glasses.
“Ghh…”
A dull ache stirs in my temples.
In exchange for that pain, faint lines emerge across the ground and the walls.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take off my glasses.
"…… Gah."
Instantly a light headache springs forth.
In exchange for the pain, I can see "lines" running all along the walls and the ground.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「聞いておくけど。
志貴、貴方が普通の状態で『点』を視れるのは生物だけでしょ」
「え―――？
　ああ、そういえばそうみたいだ。
建物には線しか見えない」
　……ホテルの時は視えていたけど、アレは気絶しそうな程の頭痛を伴なった結果だったし。
「でしょうね。
貴方は生物だから、鉱物の死を理解できないのよ。
　だから鉱物の死を『視る』ためには、まず彼らと同じ指向性を持つための回線に繋がらないといけない。
『視る』ためには『理解』しないといけないから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me make sure of something. Under normal conditions, living things are the only things whose ‘points’ you can see, right?”
“Huh? Oh―――now that you mention it, yes. Buildings only have lines.”
I saw points at the hotel, but only with a headache so violent I nearly lost consciousness.
“I thought so. You’re alive, so you can’t comprehend the death of minerals.
To ‘see’ their death, you must first connect yourself to a channel that gives you the same orientation they possess. You cannot ‘see’ something without first understanding it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Another question, Shiki.
You only see "points" on living things, right?"
"Eh---?
Yeah, that seems to be true.
Things like buildings only have lines."
…… I saw them back during the time in that hotel, but at the cost of a headache that almost caused me to pass out.
"Right, since you are a living being, you can't comprehend the death of inanimate objects.
So in order to "see" the death of inanimate objects, you must first connect to a circuit of the same orientation as them.
To "see", you have to "comprehend" them first.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあついでに聞くけど、今の志貴からみて、あの人間はどんな感じ？」
「――――？」
　そんなの、いつもと変わらないと思うけど―――
「――――！？」
　思わず、足が後ろに引いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then while we’re at it, how does that human look to you now?”
“――――What…?”
He looks the same as anyone else―――
“――――!?”
I recoil without meaning to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then another question.
Shiki, how does that person look to you?"

"----?"
It'll just be the same as always---
"----!?"
Without thinking, I step backwards.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……なんだ、アレ。
　たしかに、どんな人間だって『線』はある。
　けどそれは数えられる程度の数で、ある意味幾何学模様みたいなものなんだ。
　なのに―――アレは、なんだ。
　体中に『線』が走っている。
『線』は静脈動脈のように浮き出ていて、『線』に塗りつぶされてあの男性がどんな風貌をしているのかさえ、見えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
What is that?
Every human has lines, of course.
But there are few enough to count, arranged almost like a geometric pattern.
But that thing―――what is it?
Lines crawl over every inch of its body, raised like arteries and veins. They cover the man so completely that I can no longer make out his face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What is that?
Certainly, all humans have "lines" on them.
But they only have countable amounts and they also look like geometric patterns.
But---what is that?
There are "lines" running all through him.
Those "lines" are all over him like blood vessels… so much that I can't even make out his appearance.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――ぐっ」
　吐きそうになる。
　その、黒い『線』―――ラクガキがヒトの形をしたモノのいたるところに、血を流しているような『黒い点』が視えている――――
「志貴にはどう見える？
　わたしとしては、志貴には普通の人間に見えていてほしいんだけど」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドの言葉に答えられない。
　今は―――吐き気を堪えるだけで精一杯だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Ghh”
Bile rises in my throat.
Across that man-shaped thing, amid the black scrawl of lines―――I can see black points everywhere, bleeding darkness――――
“What does he look like to you, Shiki? I was hoping you would see an ordinary human.”
“――――――”
I cannot answer her.
For now―――enduring the nausea takes everything I have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gah."
I want to puke.
Those, black "lines"---scribbles making a human shape… everywhere throughout it, I can see "black points" that look like they are flowing blood----
"Shiki, how does it look?
I was hoping it would look normal to you."
"------"
I can't answer.
Right now---it takes all my strength just not to vomit.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――そう。
残念ね、志貴はアレにも死を視てしまっているなんて」
「ああ……なんか普通、とは違う、けど……線は、視え、てる……」
「やっぱり───死者さえ殺せるのね、貴方は。
命が有る無しの問題さえ無関係。
動いているもの、破壊できるものなら例外なく停止させる───なによ、ほんとの化け物は貴方のほうじゃない」
「え─────」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I see. What a pity—you can see death even in that.”
“Yeah—it isn’t normal, but I can see the lines…”
“So it is true───you can kill even something already dead. Whether it possesses life is irrelevant. If it moves, if it can be destroyed, you can stop it without exception───honestly, the true monster here is you.”
“What─────”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
How unfortunate that you can even see death on that thing."
"Yeah…… it's not, normal, but…… I can, still see, the lines……"
"I knew it---you can even kill The Dead.
The fact that they don't have any life has no meaning for you.
Something that moves, something that breaks, you can stop it completely without exception---You're more of a monster, Shiki."
"Eh-----"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「見たとおり、アレはもう人間とは呼べないわ。
自らの死という負債を、他人の血を吸い上げることで誤魔化し続ける吸血鬼だから」
　アルクェイドは歩を速める。
　一直線に、どこにでもいるような男性に向かって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“As you can see, that can no longer be called human. It’s a vampire, staving off the debt of its own death by draining the blood of others.”
Arcueid quickens her pace.
She heads straight toward the perfectly ordinary-looking man.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"As you saw, you can't call that thing human anymore.
It's a vampire that deceives death by sucking the blood of other people."
Arcueid quickens her steps.
She walks straight towards the man.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「おい、アルクェイド―――」
「志貴はそこにいて」
　男性はアルクェイドに気がついたのか、逃げるように路地裏へ走っていく。
　アルクェイドはゆらり、と足音もたてずに歩いていく。
　月明かりの下、彼女の体は路地裏へと消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Arcueid―――”
“Stay there, Shiki.”
Perhaps noticing her, the man breaks into a run and flees down an alley.
Arcueid glides after him without a sound.
Beneath the moonlight, her white figure vanishes into the dark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Arcueid---"
"Stay there Shiki!"
Did that young man realize Arcueid was there?
He starts running towards a back alley.
Arcueid strides silently.
Underneath the moonlight, she disappears into that alley.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　心臓の音が、やけに近くで聞こえた。
　まだ夜も深くないという時間。
　賑やかな繁華街のただ中にいるのに、自分以外の人の気配が、まったく感じられなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
My heartbeat sounds unnaturally close.
The night is still young.
I stand in the heart of a bustling entertainment district—yet every human presence but my own has disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
The sound of my heartbeat is awfully close.
It's not even real late at night.
Even though I'm in the midst of a bustling shopping district, I can't sense anyone besides myself.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――ドクン。
　メガネ―――メガネを早くかけなくっちゃ。
　そうしないと、厭なものを見てしまう。
　今まで視えていたものなんて入り口にすぎないぐらいの闇を、見ることになってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――THUMP.
My glasses―――I have to put them back on.
Otherwise I will see something hideous.
A darkness so vast that everything my eyes have shown me before was only its threshold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---THUMP.
My glasses---I have to put on my glasses.
If I don't do that, I'll see terrible things.

I'll see something so terrible that everything I've seen so far would be nothing in comparison to it.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――ど、く、ん。
　でも体が動かない。
　ツギハギだらけのセカイを視る裸眼は、魅了されたように、アルクェイドが入っていった路地裏を、壁越しに見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Th—ump.
But my body will not move.
My naked eyes see a world stitched together from broken pieces and, as though enthralled, stare through the wall into the alley Arcueid entered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Th, u, mp.
But my body won't move.
My eyes that can see this patchwork world look towards that alley in fascination.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「───────」
　唐突に、音が消えた。
　人の気配も、
　風の音も、
　土の匂いも。
　すべて、ピタリと凍りついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───────”
Without warning, all sound ceases.
Every human presence,
the sound of the wind,
even the smell of earth.
Everything freezes in place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Suddenly, sounds vanish.
And the presence of other people,
the sound of the wind,
and the smell of the dirt.
All of it freezes.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I
6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
絶対零度の月の下。
　壁のむこうで、何か、異質な音がしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beneath a moon at absolute zero.
An alien sound comes from beyond the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Under the frozen moon.
A bizarre noise sounds from the other side of the wall.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I
6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
見えるはずがないし、
　音なんて聞こえてこない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no possible way to see it,
no sound could possibly reach me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No way I can see it,
I can't hear anything.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.maoEnglish: ──────Shhk, squelch
entries.mirrorMoon: ------A sickening sound
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
なのに、視えた。
　死と死が衝突する音を、この眼が確かに視た。
entries.maoEnglish:
And yet I see it.
These eyes unmistakably see the sound of death colliding with death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But I can see it.
My eyes definitely see the sound of death and death crashing.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ぐ――――」
　視界が朱い。
　なんで―――見えないはずのものの、『死』を視てしまっているんだ、この目は。
「――――」
　メガネ。
メガネをかけないと、頭がどうにかなってしまう。
　喉元までせりあがった嘔吐感をこらえながら、震える手でメガネをかけなおした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――”
My vision floods crimson.
Why are these eyes seeing the death of something that should be invisible―――?
“――――”
My glasses. If I don’t put them on, I’ll lose my mind.
Holding back the vomit rising into my throat, I replace my glasses with a trembling hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah----"
My vision turns crimson.
Why---do my eyes see "death", something that shouldn't be able to be seen?
"----"
My glasses.
I have to put on my glasses or I'll go insane.
I hold back the rising gorge in my throat and use my shaking hand to put on my glasses.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
音と光が戻る。
　気をしっかりと持ってあたりを見渡せば、繁華街に異状はない。
　雑多な喧騒と、まわりを歩いていく人々の姿。
　飾り付けられた店のショーウィンドウの明るさや、道路を走る自動車のエンジン音が溢れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Sound and light return.
When I force myself to look around, nothing is wrong with the entertainment district.
Pedestrians stream through the familiar din.
Decorated shop windows blaze with light, and car engines fill the road with noise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sound and light return.
Now that I'm calm, I glance around and see nothing out of the ordinary in the shopping district.
The bustling of many people passing by.
The brightness of a store's decorated show window and the sound of rushing car engines.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「はあ――はあ、はあ―――」
　呼吸がうまく出来ない。
　メガネをかけていても、どこか視界のすみにさっきの『死』が残っていそうで、気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――hah, hah―――”
I can’t breathe properly.
Even through the glasses, the thought that some remnant of that death may still lurk at the edge of my vision sickens me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm panting excessively.
I can hardly breathe.
Even though I put my glasses back on, I can still feel a lingering remnant of that "death" and it makes me sick.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「アル――クェイド……？」
　路地裏から出てきたアルクェイドは、俺以上に息をきらして、おぼつかない足取りだった。
「―――志貴……そっか、まだ残ってたんだ」
　はあはあ、と肩で息をしながら、ゆらりと、アルクェイドは俺の横をすり抜けていく。
　体をかすかにゆらして、まるで病人のように、弱々しく歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar――cueid…?”
Arcueid stumbles out of the alley, breathing even harder than I am, her steps unsteady.
“―――Shiki, so you are still here”
Her shoulders heaving with every breath, she sways past me.
Her body rocks faintly as she walks, frail as an invalid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar--cueid……?"
Arcueid walks out from the alley with faltering steps, breathing even harder than I am.
"---Shiki…… I see, you were, still here."
Shoulders heaving up and down, she passes by me.
Her body sways back and forth, and she walks weakly as if she was sick.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――正直、こっちだって吐き気が止まっていない。
　けど、あんなに苦しげなアルクェイドを前にして、そんな生易しいコトはいってられない。
「待てよ、一体どうしたんだおまえ……！」
「大丈夫よ。
すこし疲れただけだから、かまわないで。
―――志貴には、ぜんぜん関係がないんだから」
「ばか、疲れているなら休め！
　そんな青い顔して、ぜんぜん大丈夫そうじゃないじゃないか!」
　ハア、とまだうまく出来ない呼吸を押さえつけながら、アルクェイドの腕を掴む。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――To be honest, my own nausea has not eased.
But beside Arcueid’s obvious suffering, it seems too trivial to mention.
“Wait, what happened to you…!?”
“I’m fine. Just a little tired, so leave me alone. ―――It has nothing at all to do with you, Shiki.”
“Idiot, if you’re tired, then rest! You’re white as a sheet—you don’t look fine at all!”
Still fighting for breath, I catch her by the arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---To be honest, I still feel nauseous.
But, seeing Arcueid in pain like that makes me bear it.
"Wait, what in the world……!"
"I'm fine, just a little tired so don't worry.
