---It really doesn't concern you Shiki."
"Idiot, if you're tired then rest!
With such a pale face, you can't be fine!"
Even as I breathe shallowly for air, I grab Arcueid's arm.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……なによ。
そういう志貴だって、今にも倒れそうな顔してる」
「俺のはただの貧血だよ。
人のことを気にしてる余裕があるなら、自分の体を気遣ってやれよ」
「―――いいのよ。
どうせ気遣っても無駄なんだから」
　アルクェイドの呼吸は、本当に、切ないぐらいに弱々しい。
「まさか―――おまえ、あの時の傷―――」
　治ってないのか、とは聞けなかった。
　それは、俺を庇って出来た傷だからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Look who’s talking. You look ready to collapse yourself.”
“Mine’s just anemia. If you have enough energy to worry about me, use it to look after yourself.”
“―――There’s no point. Looking after myself won’t change anything.”
Arcueid’s breathing is heartbreakingly weak.
“Don’t tell me―――those wounds from before―――”
I cannot ask whether they have failed to heal.
She received those wounds protecting me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey now.
You say that, but you look like you'll collapse too."
"It's just my anemia.
If you have time to worry about me, worry about your health."
"---It's fine.
There's no point in worrying about it anyway."
Her breathing really is weak.
"Don't tell me---that wound from that time---"
It hasn't healed?
But I can't bring myself to finish.
It's because she got it saving me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　アルクェイドは俯いたまま答えない。
　それは、否定ではなく肯定の意味合いだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
Arcueid keeps her head lowered and says nothing.
Her silence is an admission.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
She doesn't answer and looks down.
That is affirmation rather than disagreement.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ばっ――――そんな体で何してるんだよ！
　傷が治るまで大人しくしてないとダメじゃないか！
「大人しく、してるつもり、なんだけどな」
「全然してないだろっ！
　いくらおまえが人間離れしてるからって、そんな体でさっきは何をしてたっていうんだよ、一体―――」
　……放っておけない。
　やっぱり、俺はこのどうしようもなく手のかかるヤツを、放っておけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You id――――what are you doing in that condition? You should be resting until your wounds heal!”
“I thought I was taking it easy…”
“You haven’t taken it easy at all! I don’t care how inhuman you are—what were you doing back there in that state―――”
I can’t leave her alone.
No matter what, I can’t abandon this hopelessly troublesome woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stu----What are you doing in your condition!?
You have to take it easy until you're fully healed!"
"I do think I'm, taking it, easy."
"No you're not!
Even if you are at a level beyond humans, what in the world were you doing earlier in your condition---"
…… I just can't leave her be.

I knew it.
I just can't leave this person who's always getting into trouble alone.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「黙ってないで答えろ。
おまえが話してくれるまで、俺はおまえから離れないからな……！」
　ぐっ、とアルクェイドの両肩を強く掴む。
　アルクェイドは俯いたまま、こくん、とかすかに頷いたように見えた。
「……もう。
わりとしつこいのね、貴方って。
いいわ、それじゃ場所を変えましょう」
　アルクェイドはこちらの腕を払って、ゆるやかに歩き始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me. I’m not leaving your side until you tell me what’s going on.”
I grab Arcueid firmly by both shoulders.
Still looking down, she seemed to give the faintest nod.
“Honestly, you’re awfully persistent. Fine. Let’s go somewhere else.”
She brushed my arms away and set off at an easy pace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't be silent and answer me.
Until you tell me, I won't go away……!"
I grasp both of her shoulders.
Still looking down, she gives a slight nod.
"…… Geez, you really are persistent.
Fine, let's go somewhere else to talk."
Releasing herself, she waveringly starts to walk away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
公園に戻ってきた。
　アルクェイドは歩いているうちに体力が回復したのか、すっかり元気な顔になってしまってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
We return to the park.
Perhaps the walk has restored her strength, because Arcueid looks perfectly healthy again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We come to the park.
As if walking restored her strength, her face looks as cheerful as always.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「さて。
それじゃあ志貴のお望み通り、なんでも話してあげようじゃない」
　さっきまでの弱々しさはどこに行ったのか、アルクェイドはとても偉そうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well then. Since you insisted, I suppose I’ll tell you anything you want to know.”
All trace of her earlier weakness is gone; Arcueid looks unbearably smug.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, as you wish, Shiki, I'll talk about whatever you want."
I don't know where her previous weakness went, but she looks really haughty all of a sudden.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……それじゃ聞くけど、さっきのヤツはなんだったんだ。
おまえは吸血鬼って言ってたけど、アレがおまえの標的だったのか？」
「違うわ。
たしかにアレも処刑する対象だけど、あんな死者を塵に還すことが目的じゃない。
アレはわたしの『敵』の下僕だから始末しただけ。
　あんなのでもね、ほっとくと人を殺して力を蓄えられてしまうから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then tell me what that thing was. You called it a vampire, but was it your target?”
“It was not my target, though it was marked for execution. My purpose is not to reduce every member of the Dead to dust. It was a servant of my ‘enemy,’ so I disposed of it.
Even something like that will kill people and gather strength if left alone.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then I'll ask, but just what was that guy earlier?
You said he was a vampire, was he what you were after?"
"No, he certainly is part of my target, but putting The Dead back into the grave isn't my goal.
I only got him because he was a minion of my 'enemy'.
If I left him alone, he would kill more people to increase his power."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
その、もっと俺にも分かるように説明してくれないか。
俺にはさっきの、あのおかしなヤツが人間なのかどうかもわからないんだ」
「そっか。
志貴にはまともに吸血鬼について話した事がなかったものね。
ネロは吸血鬼の中でも特異すぎた吸血種だから、説明する必要がなかったんだけど」
「……？
　まともな吸血鬼って、なにさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Could you explain this in a way I can understand? I don’t even know whether that strange thing back there was human.”
“Oh, right. I’ve never properly explained vampires to you. Nrvnqsr was such an aberrant member of a vampiric species that using him as an example would not have taught you much.”
“The usual kind of vampire? What’s that supposed to mean?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, could you explain it so I can understand?
I don't even know if that guy was even human or not."
"Oh.
I guess I never really did explain to you in detail about vampires.
Nrvnqsr was sort of an aberration amongst the vampire race, so I didn't really need to explain it at that time."
"……?
What is a normal vampire then?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「だから、あなた達が想像しているような吸血鬼のことよ。
不老不死で、人間の血を吸って、吸った者も吸血鬼にして使役し、太陽の光の前に敗退するっていうごく当たり前の吸血鬼。
　わたしの『敵』はね、そういう旧いタイプの吸血鬼なの」
「……えっと、つまりその『敵』っていうのが街で通り魔殺人をおこしてるヤツの事だよな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The kind humans imagine: ageless and immortal, drinking human blood, turning their victims into vampires and commanding them, then fleeing before the sun. A perfectly ordinary vampire.
My ‘enemy’ is one of those old-fashioned types.”
“So this ‘enemy’ is the one behind the killings around town?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What I mean is what you all think of vampires.
Immortal, never aging, sucking human blood, turning that human into a vampire, being destroyed by sunlight, all of that.
My 'enemy' is that old type of vampire."
"…… Um, so you mean this 'enemy' of yours is the one behind all the recent serial killings?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……どうかしらね。
実際に人を殺して血を吸っているのは、さっき始末したような『死者』の仕事かもしれない。
　志貴、ネロが体内に山ほどの使い魔を装備していたのは覚えてるでしょ？」
「―――ああ。
そう簡単に忘れられることじゃないよ、あれは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who knows? The actual killing and blood-drinking may be done by members of the Dead like the one I just destroyed.
You remember how Nrvnqsr carried a whole army of familiars inside his body, don’t you?”
“―――Yeah. That’s not something I’m likely to forget.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I suppose.
But the killing of all those people by sucking their blood might be the work of "The Dead" like the one you saw earlier.
Shiki, you remember how Nrvnqsr's body was made of all those familiars, right?"
"---Yeah, that's not exactly something I can easily forget."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「さっきの死者はそれと同じよ。
　いい？
　吸血鬼に血を吸われて、その時に吸血鬼に血を送られるとその人間は死んでいるにも拘わらず現世に残ってしまうの。
　これを死者といって、吸血鬼の一般的な使い魔とされるわ。
　あ、志貴にはゾンビっていったほうがわかりやすいかな。
アレは死体に寄生するハイチの白蛇のことだけど、動く死体っていったらゾンビが有名なんでしょ？」
―――まあ、そう言われたほうがしゃっきりとイメージはできる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The Dead are much the same.
Listen. If a vampire drains someone’s blood and sends some of its own blood back into the victim, that person remains in this world despite being dead.
We call them the Dead, and they are the common familiars of vampires.
Though perhaps ‘zombie’ would make more sense to you, Shiki. Strictly speaking that refers to the Haitian white serpent said to inhabit a corpse, but ‘zombie’ is the famous word for a walking corpse, isn’t it?”
―――Well, that did give me a much clearer picture.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The Dead are like that.
When humans have their blood sucked by a vampire, they can also receive some of the vampire's blood.
They die, but remain in this world as a servant of the vampire.
They are called The Dead and they are like the vampire's familiars.
Ah, maybe it's easier to understand if I use the word zombie.
It's closer to the voodoo belief in Haiti where the white serpent-god Damballah is invoked to control a dead body, but let's just say a dead body that moves is a zombie, okay?"
---Yeah, I can visualize it better that way.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「わかった、つまりさっきの男はとっくの昔に吸血鬼に殺されていて、そのあとでゾンビにされてこき使われてるってコトなんだな？」
　そうそう、と満足そうに頷くアルクェイド。
「―――わかんないな。
吸血鬼ってのはどうしてそんなコトするんだよ。
　殺した人間を―――殺しちまった人間をさ、そのまま生きかえらせてアゴで使うなんて、趣味が悪すぎる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that man was killed by a vampire a long time ago, then turned into a zombie and forced to work like a slave?”
Arcueid nods in satisfaction.
“―――I still don’t understand. Why would a vampire do something like that?
Killing someone―――dragging someone you killed back to life and ordering them around is simply vile.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I get it, so that man was killed by a vampire, who uses him as a zombie?"
"Yes, yes," Arcueid nods happily.
"---I'm still confused though.
Why would a vampire do that?
Killing people---not letting them die but controlling them, what bad taste."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そうね。
吸血鬼が悪趣味なのは認めるわ。
でもそれは死徒に限った話よ。
初めから吸血種だったものはあまりそういうコトはしないもの」
「――――？」
　初めから、吸血鬼だったもの……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is. Vampires have atrocious taste. But that’s mainly true of Dead Apostles. Those who belonged to a vampiric species from birth rarely do such things.”
“――――”
Born as vampires?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're right, those vampires do have bad taste.
But that's something only the Dead Apostles do.
Those that were always vampires from the very beginning do not do such things."
"----?"
Always vampires from the very beginning ……?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――思い出した。
そういえば言ってたな、吸血鬼には二種類あるって。
初めから吸血鬼だったのと、人間から吸血鬼になった吸血鬼。
　……前に聞いた時、その話がひっかかってたんだ。
なんかおかしいなって。
そもそもさ、初めから吸血鬼じゃないって、それはどういうコトなんだ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Oh. Now I remember. You said there were two kinds of vampire: those born that way, and humans who became vampires.
That bothered me the first time I heard it. It didn’t sound right. What does it mean for a vampire not to have been one from the beginning?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I remember.
You said there's two types of vampires, those who were vampires originally, and those who were humans.
…… When I heard that before, it kind of stuck in my head, I thought it was a little odd.
So what exactly do you mean by those who weren't originally vampires?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「どういうコトもなにも、死徒はもともと人間だった者達よ。
魔術の果てに不老になったものと、真祖に血を吸われて下僕となったものとがいるわ。
　……志貴、貴方はさっき殺した人間を使役するのが悪趣味だと言ったけど、それでもまだマシなほうなのよ。
中にはもっと理解不能な遊びを考案する吸血鬼もいるんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Dead Apostles were originally human, exactly as the name suggests. Some attained agelessness at the farthest reaches of magecraft; others had their blood taken by a True Ancestor and became that Ancestor’s servants.
You called it grotesque to command people you’ve killed, but that is almost tame by their standards. Some vampires devise amusements far more incomprehensible than that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Simple, I'm just saying that Dead Apostles used to be humans.
They either gained immortality through magic or became servants of the True Ancestors that sucked their blood.
…… Shiki, you said it was bad taste to use killed humans, but that's just the least of it.
There are other vampires who think up worse games."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――遊びって―――なんだよ、それ。
おまえたちは遊びで人間を殺して、その死体を玩具にしてるっていうのか……！」
「……否定はしないわ。
　吸血鬼にとって『娯楽』は呼吸と同じことなのよ。
人間という連環種でありながら、不完全ながらも不老不死に近付いた彼らにとって最大の敵は“退屈”だったの。
　もともとわたし達と違って目的がないくせに“不老不死”になった彼らは、不老不死を手にいれた瞬間にあらゆる物欲がなくなってしまったのよ。
　目的が不老不死だったんだから、まあ仕方がないっていえば仕方がないんだろうけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Amusements―――what the hell does that mean? You kill humans for fun and turn their corpses into toys…!?”
“I won’t deny it.
To vampires, amusement is as necessary as breathing. Though they came from humanity—a species bound to the cycle of life—they drew close, however imperfectly, to ageless immortality, and boredom became their greatest enemy.
Unlike us, they had no purpose beyond attaining immortality; the instant they achieved it, every material desire vanished.
Immortality had been their only goal, so perhaps that result was inevitable.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---A game---what is that?
You guys kill for fun, and use their dead bodies as toys……!?"

"…… I won't deny that.
For vampires, "amusement" is the same as breathing.
For those who were once human but gain imperfect immortality, their greatest enemy is boredom.
They didn't have a reason to become immortal to start with, so once they gained immortality, they lost all kinds of greed.
Their goal was immortality itself, so I guess that's just the way things are."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「───退屈だから遊びたい、なんてふざけた事は言わないでくれよ。
だいたいさ、歳もとらないで死にもしないっていうんなら、もうそれで十分じゃないか。
他の楽しみなんていらないだろ」
entries.maoEnglish: “───Don’t give me that nonsense about needing games because they’re bored. If they never age and never die, isn’t that enough? What more could they possibly need?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---They're bored so they want to play?
Don't be ridiculous.
Isn't it enough that they won't age or die?
Do they really need anything else?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「だから、それで十分になってしまったのよ、彼らは。
　けれどそれでは存在の意味がない。
自らを無価値と―――停止してしまったのだと認識した生命は、そこで存在している価値がなくなってしまう。
不老不死というのはね、死の別名でもあるのよ。
　だから彼らは段々と磨耗していって、自分たちから娯楽を作る事にした。
生きているんだって、自分たちはまだ楽しみがあるんだって自らを弁護するように。
　―――それが、貴族の発端よ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That became enough for them—and that was the problem.
An existence without purpose has no meaning. Once a living being recognizes itself as worthless―――as something that has stopped, there is no longer any value in its continued existence. Immortality is merely another name for death.
They gradually wore away, and so began inventing diversions. They needed to reassure themselves that they were alive, that pleasure remained to them.
―――That was the birth of the vampire aristocracy.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's what I said, they got everything they wanted.
After that, there is no meaning to existence.
As soon as someone realizes they have no value---that their life is stopped, then their meaning of existence disappears too.
Immortality is also another word for death.

So they started to wear down and they started to create their own amusement, as if to tell themselves they could have fun as long as they lived.
---That's their beginning.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「彼らは人間の真似ごとをして、自分を城主にみたてて自らの勢力を広げるゲームを始めたわ。
　ありていに言ってしまえば死者の王国ね。
思いの外、それは彼らにとって刺激的だったみたい」
　……他人ごとのようにアルクェイドは言う。
　そういうアルクェイドだってその一人のはずなのに、どうも彼女にはそういった趣味はないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Imitating human society, they cast themselves as lords of castles and began a game of expanding their domains.
Put simply, they built kingdoms of the Dead. It proved more stimulating than they expected.”
Arcueid speaks as if none of this concerns her.
She ought to be one of them herself, yet she seems to have no taste for such games.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"They copy humans and see themselves in a game as lords of a castle expanding their territory.
I guess you could call it a country of The Dead.
It seems they got more enjoyment out of that than they expected."
…… She speaks as if she was talking of other people.
Arcueid should be one of those, but she certainly doesn't seem like she has that sort of hobby.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「さて、ここで話は前後するけど、死徒というものは元は人間なの。
　魔術を究めてその果てに吸血鬼となった稀なケースもあるけど、大部分は血を吸われた人間が死徒になる。
　死徒はたしかに不老不死だけれど、彼らは永久機関じゃないわ。
だからたえず他者から命を吸い上げないと不老不死ではいられない。
　前に、彼らは不完全な不老不死だと言ったでしょ？
　死徒は結局、人間という捕食対象がいないと“不老不死”ではいられない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, this takes us backward a little, but Dead Apostles were originally human.
A rare few became vampires after mastering magecraft, but most were humans whose blood was taken.
Dead Apostles truly are ageless and immortal, but they are not perpetual motion machines. They must constantly drain life from others to preserve that immortality.
I told you theirs was imperfect, remember? Without humans to prey upon, a Dead Apostle cannot retain immortality.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, we'll change the topic, but the Dead Apostles were originally human.
There are a few cases where they became vampires through their own magical research, but the majority of them were humans who had their blood sucked.
They are immortal, but they can't last forever.
They can only be immortal if they drink the blood of others.
Didn't I say their immortality was imperfect?
If they can't feed on humans then their immortality is gone."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっと待った。
それ、おかしいよ。
　そうなると死徒っていうのは不老不死でいるために人間から血を吸うけど、そのたびに新しい死徒ってのを生み出してるって事になるじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. That doesn’t make sense.
If Dead Apostles drink human blood to remain immortal, but each feeding creates another Dead Apostle, then their numbers should multiply every time.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a minute, isn't that odd?
In order to become immortal they drink the blood of humans, but doesn't that mean new Dead Apostles will be born every time they do that?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そうなんだけど、ここからが複雑でね。
　血を吸われた人間は死んでしまう。
けどこの時、死徒が自らの血をその死体に残しておくと、殺された人間は死にきれなくなる。
　この死にきれない遺体が墓場の中で数年たって、脳が腐敗して魂が肉体に完全に“固定”した状態になると屍食鬼（グール）になるの。
　グールになれるのは百人に一人ぐらいの割合だから、なにも全ての人間が“残れる”わけではないわ。
　……まあ、中には生まれた時から上位種へステップアップできる資格をもっている人間がいて、そういう人たちは即座に新種の吸血種になるんだけど、それは本当に稀だから論外ね。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s where it becomes complicated.
A human whose blood is taken dies. But if the Dead Apostle leaves some of its own blood in the corpse, the victim cannot finish dying.
After this half-dead body spends several years in the grave—until the brain decays and the soul becomes completely ‘fixed’ to the flesh—it turns into a ghoul.
Only about one person in a hundred can become a ghoul, so most victims do not remain.
A very few people are born qualified to advance directly into a higher species and become a new kind of vampiric creature at once, but this is so rare we can ignore it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true, but things get complex from here.
The people who have their blood sucked die.
But at that time, if the Dead Apostles place a little of their blood inside the corpse, the body cannot die.
Those bodies that were unable to die stay a number of years in the grave and when the brain decays and the soul is "fixated" in the body, they become a flesh-eating corpse (ghoul).
Only one out of every hundred people have this potential, so not everyone gets to 'stay'.
…… Well, there are those that have a natural ability to 'step up' this progress and become a vampire immediately, but this is so rare it's out of the question.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「で、グールになったモノは死体であった頃の数年の歳月によって腐敗した自分の肉体を補うため、他の遺体の肉を食べる。
　そうして腐敗した肉体を元に戻して、ようやくゾンビ……生きる死体（リビングデッド）の仲間入りができるのよ」
「───ふうん。
じゃあそのリビングデッドっていうのが、さっきの『死者』ってヤツなんだ」
「まさか。
『死者』はただの人形よ。
リビングデッドは死者よりは格段に弱いけど、ちゃんと自分の意思と魂をもって活動する一人前の吸血種だもの。
操り死体にすぎない『死者』とはレベルが違うわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Once it becomes a ghoul, it eats the flesh of other corpses to replace the body that rotted during its years in the grave.
When its flesh has finally been restored, it joins the ranks of the zombies—the living dead.”
“───I see. So those living dead are the ‘Dead’ you were talking about?”
“Of course not. The Dead are only puppets. The living dead may be vastly weaker than the Dead, but they possess wills and souls of their own and act as full-fledged members of a vampiric species. They are nothing like the Dead, which are merely corpses pulled by strings.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, the dead bodies that became ghouls eat the flesh of other corpses in order to sustain their decayed body parts.
After restoring their bodies fully, they can become zombies…… members of the class of living corpses (The Living Dead)."
"---Hm.
So these Living Dead, is that the 'The Dead' from before?"
"Not at all.
"The Dead" are just puppets.
The Living Dead are much weaker than The Dead, but they are members of the vampire race with a will of their own.
They are a on a different level than those manipulated "Dead"."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「で、リビングデッドからさらに数年たって、人間としての知識を取り戻した者が吸血鬼、ヴァンパイヤと呼ばれる者達。
　ここまで残れる人間は一万人に一人ぐらい。
さっきもちらりと言ったけど、もって生まれた肉体に宿るポテンシャルが高いほど残れる確率は高くなるわ。
　このヴァンパイヤ達の生みの親となった一族の大本のヴァンパイヤをね、わたしたちは死徒と呼ぶの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“After several more years, those living dead who regain the knowledge they possessed as humans become what people call vampires.
Only about one in ten thousand survives that far. As I mentioned, the greater the potential of the body one is born with, the better the odds.
We call the original vampire at the root of each bloodline—the progenitor of all those lesser vampires—a Dead Apostle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And after many years, once a Living Dead is able to restore its intelligence, it becomes a vampire.
There's probably about only one out of every ten thousand who have this ability.
I said it before, but the more potential you have, the higher the success rate to stay.
We call the Dead Apostles the ones that make all these kinds of vampires."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……やっぱりおかしいじゃないか。
そんな倍々ゲームじゃ化け物は増える一方だろ。
それじゃ今ごろ俺たちのまわりは吸血鬼で溢れてることになる」
entries.maoEnglish: “That still doesn’t add up. At that rate the monsters would multiply forever. The world ought to be crawling with vampires by now.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's still odd.
If this game goes on, then won't the world be overflowing with vampires eventually?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そうでもないわ。
死徒はね、自ら生み出したヴァンパイヤにいずれ討たれてしまうのよ。
　言ったでしょう？
　彼らは人間の真似事をしてるって。
死徒は娯楽のために、自らが吸い殺した人間に自らの血を分け与える。
　分け与えられた遺体は何万分の一という確率をくぐりぬけてヴァンパイヤに成長して、いずれ親である死徒を殺して、自らが新しい死徒になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Not necessarily. A Dead Apostle is eventually slain by one of the vampires it created.
I told you they imitate humans. Remember? For amusement, a Dead Apostle shares its blood with the humans it drains to death.
One corpse in tens of thousands survives the process and matures into a vampire; eventually that child kills its parent and becomes the new Dead Apostle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Not necessarily.
The Dead Apostles usually get killed by the new vampires they created.
Didn't I say it before?
They act like humans.
For their own enjoyment, they place their own blood inside the humans they preyed upon.
One out of tens of thousands of these corpses become vampires and eventually kill their parent vampires, becoming a new Dead Apostle themselves.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「騎士が武勲をたてて君主となり、やがて王を墜とすように────彼らもそういうゲームでもしなければ存在してられないの。
　……うん、理由はよくわからないけど、そうしないと退屈で死んじゃうんだって。
　悪魔的なるものの存在の軽さ、かな。
たとえ不老不死だとしても、存在意義がなければ空気と変わらないんだもの」
　バカみたいね、とアルクェイドは肩をすくめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Like a knight winning glory, becoming a lord, and finally overthrowing the king────they cannot bear to exist without games like that.
I do not really understand why, but apparently boredom would kill them otherwise.
Perhaps that is how little weight a demonic existence carries. Even an immortal amounts to no more than air without a reason to exist.”
Arcueid shrugs and calls it idiotic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Like knights becoming lords through strength of arms, and killing the king----they can only survive by playing those sorts of games.
…… Yeah, I don't really understand why, but I guess that stops them from dying of boredom.
The whims of an existence close to a devil, I suppose.
Even if they are immortal, if they can't hold onto their meaning for existence, it is an empty immortality."
Arcueid remarks how silly it is as she slumps her shoulders.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
じゃあ、さっきアルクェイドが、その……始末した死者っていうのは死徒っていうヤツの兵士っていうわけなのか？」
「兵士というよりは人形ね。
本来なら血を吸われた人間が自力で吸血種として蘇生する過程を無視して、完全に死徒の分身として操られているものを死者と呼ぶの。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then was that member of the Dead you disposed of one of a Dead Apostle’s soldiers?”
“More a puppet than a soldier. A corpse forced past the natural revival process and controlled entirely as an extension of a Dead Apostle is what we call one of the Dead.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Then, that Dead that you killed earlier…… that was something like a soldier of the Dead Apostles?"
"Not so much a soldier as a puppet.
The Dead Apostles control the dead bodies by skipping the process of becoming a vampire.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「死者は親である死徒と繋がっているわ。
　死者だって自らが生存するためのエネルギーを必要とするから人間を襲い、肉をすする。
けど、その半分以上は親元である死徒に流れていくのよ。
　ようするに女王蜂を養う働き蜂みたいなものね。
　死者を操る死徒は、自分の棺の中で眠っているだけで力を蓄えてしまえるのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The Dead remain connected to the Dead Apostle that created them.
They need energy to persist, so they attack humans and gorge on flesh. More than half of what they consume flows back to their master.
Think of worker bees feeding a queen. A Dead Apostle that commands the Dead can gather strength while doing nothing but sleeping in its coffin.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The Dead are completely connected to their parent vampire.
In order for them to survive, they attack others to eat their flesh, but more than half of that energy goes to their master.
Like a queen bee nourished by the worker bees, the Dead Apostles can use The Dead to increase their power while they sleep."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……わたしの『敵』が簡単には見つからないのは、『敵』が死者を多く使っているから。
　あいつが自分の手を汚すのは一回だけ。
　あとは死者にした人間を操って、自分は眠っているだけで領地を広げていく。
―――通り魔殺人による遺体が何体も発見されてるって言うけど、あんなのは偽造に失敗しただけのものよ。
　実際、この街の犠牲者は百人をこえているわ。
　ひっそりと人知れずいなくなってしまっている人達の一部分が、あなたたちが騒いでいる犠牲者っていうことね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The reason my ‘enemy’ is so difficult to find is that it commands a great many of the Dead.
It only needs to dirty its own hands once.
After that, it controls the human it converted and expands its territory while it sleeps.
―――They say several victims of the serial killings have been discovered, but those were merely failed attempts to conceal the bodies.
In truth, more than a hundred people in this city have fallen victim.
The corpses everyone is making such a fuss over are only a fraction of all the people who quietly vanished without anyone ever knowing why.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… My 'enemy' can't be found easily because he's using a lot of The Dead.
He only dirties his hands once.
After that, he simply controls The Dead while he sleeps and expands his territory.
---They say many bodies are found in the recent supposed serial killings, but those are actually just failures.
To tell the truth, there are over a hundred victims in this city.
But only a small amount, the ones discovered, are the victims in the news."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「な――――」
　百人単位―――？
　その、吸血鬼に血を吸われて殺された人間がそんなにいるっていうのか？
　しかも、血を吸われた人間も同じように血を吸う化け物になって、さっきみたいに何気なく街を徘徊してるなんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What――――”
More than a hundred―――?
Had that many people been drained and killed by the vampire?
And had the victims themselves become blood-drinking monsters, roaming the streets as casually as that man had―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
Over a hundred---?
There are that many that had their blood sucked?
And all those people suck the blood of others to make them into monsters like themselves, like that wandering, lifeless thing earlier---
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「………ふざけ、てる」
　三日前。
　ホテルに泊まっていた人々が、それこそ何の意味もなく殺され尽くしたのを、思い出す。
　俺はあのホテルにいたけれど、その場面を見ていない。
だから言葉の上でしか想像できず、ソレがどんなに憎むべき暴力であったかを肌で感じ取れなかった。
　今だってそれは同じだ。
　人間の血を吸う吸血鬼がいて、そいつが少しずつ自分の領地を広げているなんて聞いても、実感はわかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is sick.”
Three nights ago.
I remember every guest in that hotel being slaughtered for no reason at all.
I had been in the hotel, but I had not witnessed the massacre itself. I could imagine it only in words, unable to feel in my flesh how hateful that violence had been.
The same is true now.
Even hearing that a vampire is drinking human blood and slowly expanding its territory does not make it feel real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… That's ridiculous."
Three days ago.
I remember how all those people in the hotel were killed for no reason.
I was there but I didn't see it, so I can only visualize and can't really tell what kind of violence it was.
It's still the same.
I can't fathom the existence of vampires that suck human blood, just to increase their own territory.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――ただ。
　何の理由も、どんな前触れもなく、例えば自分のもっとも身近な人間がそんなふうに殺されたら、俺はどうなってしまうだろうか。
　想像したくもないのに、ほんのわずかだけ。
　血を吸われて、それこそゴミのようにうち捨てられている秋葉の姿を想像する。
「くっ――――」
　あたまにくるのは―――そんな最悪な出来事がもう今にだって起きえるのだというこの街の状況と、それに気がつきもしなかった自分自身の平和さだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――But.
What would become of me if, without reason or warning, someone dearest to me were killed that way?
I do not want to imagine it, even for an instant.
I picture Akiha drained of blood and discarded like rubbish.
“Ghh――――”
What enrages me is―――that such a horror could happen at any moment in this city, and the complacency that kept me from noticing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Just,
without reason, without even recognition, if someone close to me died like that, how would I act?
I don't want to imagine it, but for a brief instant…
I imagine Akiha being drained of blood and discarded like trash.
"K----"
What makes me mad---is that this worst case scenario could happen at any minute in this town and I didn't even have a clue about it before.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「やっぱり怒ったわね、志貴。
　……わたしがあんまり話したくなかったのは、これは捕食される側――あなたたちにとっては一切の言い訳も許さない『悪』そのものだからよ。
　志貴たちにしてみれば、吸血鬼の行為は許せないものでしょうから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I knew you would be angry, Shiki.
I did not want to tell you because, to the prey――to humans, this is evil itself, beyond excuse.
There is no way you could forgive what vampires do.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I knew you would be angry, Shiki.
…… I didn't want to talk about it, because for the prey---for you guys, this is an inexcusable evil.
For people like you, the actions of the vampires are inexcusable."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……それはそうだろう。
そんなのは、ふざけてる。
　たとえ顔も知らない人でも、その人にはそれまで生きてきた過去とか、生きてきた分と同じぐらいに夢見てる未来とかがあるんだ。
　俺だって―――そんな、ただ遊び気分で殺されたくない。
そんなのは悔しすぎる。
そんなのは無意味すぎる。
　そんなのは―――無念すぎるじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. It’s sick.
Even a stranger I have never met has a whole past behind them, and a future they have spent just as long dreaming about.
I don’t want to die―――just because someone is playing a game. It would be too bitter. It would be too meaningless.
To die with everything unfinished―――it would be unbearable.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
That's just all so ridiculous.
Even if it's people I don't know about, they have their past and even the dreams they hoped for.
Even I---don't want to be killed just for the fun of it.
That's just too regretful.
It's too meaningless.
That's all just so---so regretful, isn't it?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
――そうだ。
　ネロに殺された人たちだって、恐怖や混乱の中で死んでしまっただろうけど。
　その最後にくるものは、ただ無念だという、どうしようもないぐらいの悲しさじゃなかったのか。
　あの時、夜の公園で。
　ただ偶然、あの場所に居合わせただけでネロに殺されてしまった少女。
　あの子は、自分が殺されるのだという事さえ気づかずに絶命した。
entries.maoEnglish:
――Yes.
The people Nrvnqsr killed must have died in terror and confusion.
But at the very end, hadn’t there been something worse—a helpless grief that everything had been left unfinished?
That night, in the park.
A girl died simply because chance placed her there.
Nrvnqsr killed her before she even realized death was coming.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--That's right.
All those people were killed by Nrvnqsr in the midst of fear and chaos.
Weren't their last thoughts full of regretful sadness?
That night at the park.
That girl who was killed by Nrvnqsr when she passed by the park by sheer coincidence.
She didn't even realize when she died.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
その無意味さ。
　唐突に終わってしまった時間。
　誰にも見届けられることのない死。
　その理不尽さに、あの時の自分は壊れた。
　ネロに対する恐怖もなくなって、ただ、そんな真似をしたネロが憎かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The senselessness of it.
A lifetime severed without warning.
A death witnessed by no one.
The injustice had broken something in me.
My fear of Nrvnqsr had vanished, leaving only hatred for what he had done.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That meaninglessness.
The abruptness of its ending.
A death no one else even knows about.
When it happened, I was broken apart by the complete irrationality of it all.
My fear of Nrvnqsr disappeared and more than anything else, I hated him.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……そんなの認めない。
どんな理由があったって、そんなのは認められない」
　ぎり、と歯を噛む。
「志貴、それに理由なんてないのよ。
彼らにとって、これは遊びにすぎないんだから」
「―――だからふざけるなっていうんだ。
おまえたちにとってはただの遊びだって……？
　ネロといいそいつといい、人の命を一体何だと思ってやがる……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I won’t accept it. Whatever the reason, I can’t.”
I grit my teeth.
“There is no reason, Shiki. To them, it is only a game.”
“―――That is exactly what makes it unforgivable. Just a game to you? Nrvnqsr, this other monster—what the hell do you think a human life is?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't accept it.
No matter what the reason, I can't accept it."
I grit my teeth.
"Shiki, there is no reason.
For them, it's just a game."
"---That's why it's ridiculous.
It's just a game to you all……!?
Nrvnqsr and this other guy, what do they think human life is……!?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「何とも思っていないからこんなゲームを考え付くのよ。
　わたしだって彼らの考えは理解できないし、理解するつもりもないわ。
　けど、どちらが悪かと問われるのなら、それは力の無いほうでしょう？
　結局は殺される側が悪いのよ。
自分の身も自分で守れない生命なら、殺されてしまうのは自然の摂理でしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“They can devise such games precisely because they think nothing of it.
I do not understand them either, and I have no desire to.
But if you insist on asking which side is evil, is it not the powerless one? In the end, the fault lies with whatever gets killed. A life unable to defend itself is destroyed—that is simply nature.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"They come up with such games because they think it's nothing.
Even I can't understand how they think, nor do I intend do.
But, if you ask who is at fault here, it's the weaker one, right?
In the end, those that are killed are at fault.
It's all the will of nature that those who are unable to protect themselves are killed."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「なっ――――」
「でもね、志貴。
そういった点で言うのなら、人間という生命種は例えようもなく強いわ。
　種として劣っている部分を自分たち以外のモノで補う、なんていうのはある意味『最強』の証よ。
　きっと、世界という最大の生物を殺してしまえるのは人間という種だけでしょうね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What――――”
“And yet, Shiki. By that measure, humanity is an unimaginably powerful species.
Compensating for every natural weakness with things outside yourselves is, in a sense, proof of humanity's status as the strongest species.
Humanity may be the only species capable of killing the greatest living thing of all—the world itself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
"But, Shiki.
If you talk about it that way, your human species is really strong.
The ability to make up for their weakness as a species with other things, that makes them the strongest in a way.
Probably, the only ones that can kill the greatest creature called the 'world' are you humans."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「けど人間は種としては優れている反面、一個の生命として考えると弱すぎる。
　自分たち以外のあらゆるものを犠牲にしなければ生きていけないなんていう弱さは、絶対的な『悪』に他ならないわ。
　知性の有無の違い、生態としての違いはあれ、あなたたちは何かを捕食することで生きている生物でしょう？
　なら―――殺す側の行為はいつだって正しいのよ。
罪があるとすれば、それはそのルールの中で生きているくせに自分を守れないあなた達のほうでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But while humanity is strong as a species, each individual life is terribly weak.
The inability to survive without sacrificing everything around you is nothing less than absolute evil.
Whatever the differences in intelligence or ecology, humans live by consuming other lives, do they not?
Then―――the act of killing is always right. If there is guilt, it belongs to you: you live under that rule, yet cannot defend yourselves within it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But even though they are strong as a species, they are weak as individuals.
They can't live without sacrificing the lives of those not of their race, which is the ultimate 'evil', is it not?
It doesn't matter if they have intelligence or not, for you guys, everything is fair game for food, is it not?
So---the ones doing the killings are always right.
If there is a sin, then it is you guys not being able to protect yourself under that rule."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そんなの―――そんなのは、強いヤツの理屈じゃないか。
人間はおまえたちみたいに強くはないんだ。
　自分の身だって満足に守れないから、こうやって集まって、助けあって生きているのに―――そこにおまえたちみたいなのに紛れ込まれたら、どうしていいかわからない―――！」
「そうね。
それがあなたたちの防衛手段。
　群れの中に入られたら自分たちを守れないから、人間以上の種が群れの中に入れないようなルールを作り上げた。
　……ええ、志貴の言うとおりではあるわ。
　だから、本来ならこの街みたいなケースは起こらないのよ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That―――that is only the logic of the strong. Humans are not powerful like you.
We cannot even protect ourselves properly, so we gather together and keep one another alive; when something like you slips into that community―――we do not know what we can possibly do―――!”
“Yes. That is how humans defend themselves.
Because you are helpless once a superior species enters the herd, you created rules to keep such species outside it.
You are right, Shiki.
Under normal circumstances, what has happened in this city could never occur.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That---that's just the argument of the strong.
Humans aren't as strong like you all.
Because we can't protect ourselves fully, that's why we have to live together, to help each other---I don't know what to do if somebody like you guys came in and---"
"That's true.
That is your defense mechanism.
Since you can't protect yourself when those kinds of species enter your group, you guys make rules to ensure they are unable to enter.
…… Yes, it's just like you say, Shiki.
So usually, this town's case doesn't happen.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「志貴は知らないだろうけど、人間という種はとても強いの。
あなたたちは自分たちを超越する種に対する防衛手段をきちんと作ってある。
　それがちゃんと機能していれば、八年間もこの街が吸血種の住処になっていた、なんてコトはなかったのに」
「防衛……手段？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You may not know it, but humanity is extraordinarily strong. Your species has established defenses against creatures that surpass it.
Had those defenses functioned properly, this city would never have remained a nest of the vampiric kind for eight years.”
“Defenses…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You may not know it, but your human race is really strong.
You have erected a defense mechanism against those races which far exceed yours.
If it was functioning properly, this city would not have had a vampire these last eight years."
"Defense…… mechanism?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そう。
吸血鬼たちが死体を隠したり派手に動いたりしないのはね、人間たちに自分の存在を知られたくないからじゃないわ。
　彼らは自らの命を守るために、自分という存在を隠蔽して領地を増やしていく。
　吸血鬼がいる、なんてことを知られたくないのよ。
派手に動くと防衛手段がやってくるから。
　ま、今回みたいに『現代の吸血鬼か』なんてニュースが報道されたにも拘わらず連中がやってこないのは、ここが無神論者の国だからだろうけど」
「…………？」
　アルクェイドの言うことは、あまりにも特殊すぎて、いまいちよく把握できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Vampires hide bodies and avoid drawing attention, but not because they fear humans learning that they exist.
They conceal themselves and expand their domains to protect their own lives.
They do not want anyone to know vampires exist. Conspicuous activity summons those defenses.
Though in this case, even after the news asked whether this was ‘a modern-day vampire,’ no one came, perhaps because this is a nation of unbelievers.”
“…”
What Arcueid is describing is so far outside ordinary life that I can barely follow it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
The reason vampires hide the bodies of their victims and stay out of sight isn't because they don't want to be known to humans.
To protect their own lives, they conceal their identity and expand their territory.
They don't want it to be known that vampires exist at all.
If they moved freely about, the defense mechanism would arrive.
Well, they probably haven't arrived even though that "Modern Day Vampire" news is going on because this is an atheist country."
"…………?"
Her word choice is too unique and I can't really grasp what she's saying.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「でも安心していいよ、志貴。
　吸血鬼たちの天敵はこの国にはいないみたいだけど、今はわたしがちゃんといるんだから。
　言ったでしょ、わたしの目的は吸血鬼を退治するこことだって」
　さっきまでの淡々とした雰囲気はどこにいったのか、アルクェイドは一変して明るくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But do not worry, Shiki.
Their natural enemies may not be in this country, but I am here now.
I told you I came to destroy vampires, did I not?”
Her cool detachment vanishes, and Arcueid brightens all at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But you can relax, Shiki.
Even if their avowed enemies are not in this country, I'm here right now.
Didn't I say earlier my purpose was to execute vampires?"
I don't know where that heavy atmosphere went because Arcueid instantly becomes cheerful.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それは聞いてる。
……けど、アルクェイドだって吸血鬼なんだろ。
どうしてそんな、人間の味方みたいなことをしてるんだ」
「わたし、別に人間の味方をしてるわけじゃないよ。
ただ、それ以外にやる事がないからやってるだけだもの」
「――――？」
　それ以外にやる事がないって、ますますアルクェイドがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I remember. But you’re a vampire too, aren’t you? Why are you acting like an ally of humanity?”
“I’m not on humanity’s side or anything. I only do this because there’s nothing else for me to do.”
“――――?”
The claim that she has nothing else to do only makes Arcueid harder to understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I remember.
…… But, you're a vampire too, right?
Why do you side with us humans?"
"I'm not really siding with you humans, but I'm doing it because I don't have anything else to do."
"----?"
She doesn't have anything else to do?
I still don't understand her.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ま、そんなコトをやっているから死徒たちに狙われているんだけど、その追っ手であるネロも志貴が倒してくれたでしょう？」
「だから、あとは当初の予定どおりこの街に潜んでいる『敵』を見つけて、なんとか始末してみせるわ。
　だから志貴は今までどおり普通の生活に戻って、わたしたちなんかに関わらなくていいんだよ」
　何が嬉しいのか、アルクェイドはまっすぐな笑顔を向けて、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course, doing this makes Dead Apostles come after me, but you defeated Nrvnqsr, the one they sent to hunt me, remember?”
“So all that remains is to find the ‘enemy’ hiding in this city and dispose of it as planned.
You can return to your ordinary life and never involve yourself with creatures like us again.”
For some reason, Arcueid delivered those words with a bright, guileless smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, doing that does bring the Dead Apostles after me, but you beat Nrvnqsr who was pursuing me, didn't you Shiki?"

"So now I can go back to the original plan and defeat my 'enemy'.
You can go back to living your normal life now, and you don't have to associate with me anymore."
She smiles as if she is happy about something.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ああ――うん。
そりゃあ嬉しい、けど――」
　けど―――おまえは、一人でいいのか？
　そんな言葉が脳裏に浮かんで、ぶんぶんと頭をふった。
　……どうかしてる。
こいつ一人で危険な真似をさせるのが後ろめたく感じるなんて、どうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah――yes. That should make me happy, but――”
But―――will you really be all right alone?
The thought rose unbidden, and I shook my head hard.
I had to be losing my mind. Feeling guilty about letting her face danger alone—what was wrong with me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah--yeah.
That makes me happy, but--"
But---are you okay by yourself?
Those words float in the back of my head.
…… There's something wrong with me.

Feeling guilty about letting her face danger all by herself.
There really has to be something wrong with me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……………」
「志貴？
　なによ、また難しい顔しちゃって」
「そりゃあ難しい顔ぐらいする。
だって、これは俺たちの住んでいる街の問題なんだから」
「だから気にしなくていいんだって。
二三日じゅうになんとかするから、もうこれ以上は犠牲者は出させないわ」
　ああ、正直こっちだって関わり合いになんかなりたくない。
―――でも、その台詞は。
　この街を守るようなその台詞は、アルクェイドではなくこの街に住んでいる俺が、言わなくちゃいけないコトじゃないんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“Shiki? Why the serious face again?”
“Because this is serious. It is happening in the city where we live.”
“I told you not to worry. I will settle it within two or three days and allow no more victims.”
Honestly, I don’t want anything more to do with this either.
―――But those words.
That promise to protect this city should have come from me, one of the people who lived here, rather than from Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
"Shiki?
Why are you making that troubled face again?"
"Because I'm troubled.
This is something that involves the city I live in."
"I said you shouldn't worry.
In two or three days it'll all be over, and there won't be any more victims."
Yeah, honestly, I don't want to be involved.
---But, saying that line…
Shouldn't I, the one actually living in this city, say that line instead of Arcueid?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
その、一つ聞くけど。
おまえの言ってる『敵』っていうのは強いのか？」
「さっきの死者よりは格段に優れているでしょうね。
今回はまだ出会っていないからわからないけど、八年間も潜んでいたんだから第五階級ぐらいにはなってるんじゃないかな」
「―――さっきの死者より格段に強いって、おまえ」
　その死者を一人相手にするだけであんなに苦しんでいたっていうのに、なにを気軽に言うんだ、こいつは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Let me ask you something. Is this ‘enemy’ of yours strong?”
“Far superior to the Dead we just encountered. I have not met it this time, so I cannot be sure, but after hiding here for eight years it must have reached about the fifth rank.”
“―――Far stronger than that thing?”
She had suffered that badly against a single member of the Dead, yet she said it as casually as if it meant nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, can I ask a question?
This 'enemy' you speak of, is he strong?"
"Well, he should be many times superior to The Dead earlier.
I haven't met him this time, but he has been latent for eight years so maybe he's a Class Five by now."
"---You're saying he's stronger than The Dead before?"
Looking like she was in so much pain from fighting just him, isn't she taking him a little lightly?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「第五階級って、よくわからないけど。
もしかしてネロより強いのか、そいつ」
「まさか。
ネロは別格よ。
あいつは私がまともな時でも倒しきれない最高純度の吸血種だもの。
　それに比べれば、わたしの敵はいくぶん格が落ちるわ」
「――――はあ。
そうか、ならおまえがやられるっていう事はないんだな」
　安堵のためか、はあ、と大きく息をはいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not know what ‘fifth rank’ means. Is it stronger than Nrvnqsr?”
“Hardly. Nrvnqsr is exceptional. He belongs to a vampiric species of the purest kind, one even I could not completely destroy at full strength.
My enemy is somewhat beneath him.”
“――――Oh. Then there is no chance it could kill you.”
Relief escapes me in a long breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Class Five?
I don't get it, but does that mean he's stronger than Nrvnqsr?"
"Not a chance.
Nrvnqsr was special.
He was a pure, supreme vampire that would be difficult to defeat even with my full power.
Compared to him, this enemy is pretty weak."

"----Oh.
Then there's no way you'll be defeated."
I breathe out in relief.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「さあ、どうでしょうね。
ちょっと前までのわたしなら問題なかったと思うけど、今のわたしは病み上がりだもの。
アイツのほうが力をつけている可能性は高いわ」
「……病み上がりって、風邪でもひいたのかアルクェイド」
「うん、どうにも志貴に殺された後遺症がぬけきらなくて。
このぶんじゃあと何日かはダメみたい」
「――――あ」
　そうか――アルクェイドが弱っているのは、他の誰でもなく、この俺の責任だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who can say? Before all this, it would have posed no problem. But I am still recovering, and it has probably grown stronger.”
“Recovering from what, a cold?”
“Mm-hm. I still have not shaken the aftereffects of being killed by you, and at this rate I will be useless for several more days.”
“――――Ah.”
Of course――no one else was responsible for Arcueid's weakness; I was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm, who knows?
A few days earlier and he wouldn't be a problem, but now I'm just recovering.
The possibility that he has more power is actually high."
"…… Recovering?
Are you sick or something, Arcueid?"
"Yeah, I still have the effects from when you killed me and I don't think I'll be fine for at least a few more days."
"----Ah."
That's right--the reason why Arcueid is weak… it isn't anyone's fault but mine.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは自分の腹部に軽く触れる。
「いつもならすぐに復元する傷も治ってくれないしね。
外はなんとかなったけど、中身はまだ出来てないんだ」
　―――その傷も。
　俺を庇って受けてしまった、余分な傷だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid lightly touches her stomach.
“Even wounds that normally restore themselves at once refuse to heal. I managed to put the outside back together, but my insides still aren’t finished.”
―――And those wounds.
They were the unnecessary wounds she had suffered while protecting me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid lightly touches her side.
"It seems the wounds don't heal like usual.
I could manage the outside, but I can't seem to heal the inside."
---That wound as well.
The one she received to save me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「う―――――」
　言葉がない。
　アルクェイドをこんな状況にしてしまったのは、紛れもなくこっちの責任だ。
　だっていうのに。
　どうしてコイツは恨み言さえ言わず、俺に対して、こんな無防備な笑みを向けるんだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I―――――”
I have no words.
It is indisputably my fault that Arcueid is in this state.
And yet.
Why does she offer me such an unguarded smile, without a single word of blame―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"U-----"
I'm at a loss for words.
It's completely my fault she's in that position.
So why?
Why doesn't she hold it against me?
Why does she just give that innocent smile---?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……やめろよ。
せめて傷が治るまで、どっかで休んでればいいじゃないか。
いまさら一日や二日休んだって変わらないだろ。
なら―――」
「だめよ。
ネロが来たせいで、『敵』もわたしが来てるって気づいているはずだもの。
休んでたりしたら、それこそわたしが弱ってるって知らせるようなものだわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop this. At least go somewhere and rest until you heal. After eight years, another day or two cannot make any difference. Then―――”
“I can’t. Nrvnqsr’s arrival must have warned my ‘enemy’ that I’m here. If I stop moving now, I may as well announce that I’m weak.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You need to stop.
Until you heal up, you should just rest.
If you take a day or two off, things won't be that bad, so---"
"That's no good.
Thanks to Nrvnqsr coming, 'the enemy' knows I'm here.
If I rest, that's like telling him I'm weakened."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「だからって、今夜みたいな真似を続けていくっていうのか」
「ええ。
『敵』の居場所がわからない以上、あいつに血を送っている死者を片っ端から潰していくしかないわ。
　血の供給源を断てば、本体が直に血を吸いに街に出てくるしかなくなるもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you’re going to keep doing what you did tonight?”
“Yes. Until I know where my enemy is, I have no choice but to destroy every member of the Dead feeding it blood.
Once I cut off its supply, the creature itself will have to come into the city and feed directly.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So you're saying you're going to keep on going like this?"
"Yes.
Since I don't know where 'the enemy's' lair is, I have to keep destroying his blood supply.
If I cut that off, it will force him to come out."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――アルクェイド。
それがもし明日だったらどうするんだ。
そんな体じゃ逆に殺されるようなものなんだろ……！
　なら―――」
　そんなコトはやめろ、と言いかけて、止めた。
　アルクェイドの言うとおり――そんな弱みを見せたら、『敵』とやらのほうからアルクェイドを殺しにくるかもしれないし。
　なにより俺は、この四日間で思い知ってる。
　アルクェイドが自分で決めた事をとり止めるような半端なヤツじゃないって、痛いぐらいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Arcueid. What if that happens tomorrow? In your condition, you would be the one getting killed. Then―――”
I almost told her to abandon the whole thing, but stopped.
Arcueid is right――if she lets that weakness show, her ‘enemy’ might come hunting her instead.
More than that, the last four days have taught me one thing painfully well.
Once Arcueid makes up her mind, she is not the sort to stop halfway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Arcueid.
What if that's tomorrow?
Wouldn't you be killed instead……!?
Then---"
I want to tell her to stop, but I halt mid-sentence.
Like Arcueid says--if 'the enemy' sees that weakness, Arcueid might be killed.
More than anything else, I learned from the past four days.
Arcueid isn't someone to stop half-way once she's decided to do something, no matter how much it hurts.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「く――――」
　アルクェイドは止まらない。
　放っておけば―――こうして話をすることもできなくなるだろう。
　彼女は、自分の死を、頭にくるぐらい、恐れていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn――――”
Arcueid will not stop.
If I leave her alone―――the day will come when I can no longer stand here talking to her.
Her utter lack of fear for her own death makes me furious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn----"
Arcueid won't stop.
If I leave her alone---she probably won't even be able to talk like this anymore.
It makes me mad, but she's not even afraid of her own death.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――そ」
　……なんで、笑顔なんかうかべるんだ。
　そんな顔さえしなければ―――コイツが、本当にもっと吸血鬼っぽかったら、こんな気持ちには、ならないのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Then”
Why does she have to smile?
If she did not make a face like that―――if she were even a little more like a real vampire, I would not feel this way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Is that so?"
…… Why does she smile like that?
If she doesn't smile like that---If she acted more like a real vampire, I wouldn't have to feel like this.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「どうしたの志貴？
　体ふるわせちゃって、もしかしてトイレ？」
「――おまえってヤツは、どうしてそう――」
　無意味に、緊張感がないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is wrong, Shiki? Are you shaking because you need the bathroom?”
“――Why do you always have to be so――”
She has absolutely no sense of urgency.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's wrong, Shiki?
Your body is shaking, do you need to go to the bathroom?"
"--You, why are you--"
Why are you so relaxed?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……く………そ」
　……失いたくない。
　これがどんな感情なのかは知らない。
　ただ、コイツと過ごした四日間は、そう忘れられることじゃない。
　だから―――いまここで別れて、明日の夜には死なれてるかもしれないなんて何度も何度も何度も何度も後悔するのは―――きっと、とても辛いことだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it…”
I don’t want to lose her.
I don’t know what kind of feeling this is.
I only know that the four days I have spent with her are not something I can easily forget.
So―――if I leave her now and learn tomorrow night that she is dead, regretting it over and over and over and over would―――surely be unbearable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Damn………… it."
…… I don't want to lose her.
I don't know what this feeling is.
But these past four days are not something I can just forget about.
So---to part here, with the possibility she may die tomorrow, the regret would be completely, utterly, unbearably---difficult.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……かんべんしてくれ。
ただでさえ両目が壊れてるっていうのに、心まで壊れかけてる」
　アルクェイドは吸血鬼だし、自分はもうあんな出来事には関わりたくない。
　ネロとの一戦を思い出す。
　それだけで背筋に悪寒が走るほど、殺される一歩手前の恐怖は残っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Give me a break. My eyes are already broken, and now my heart is going too.”
Arcueid is a vampire, and I do not want to be caught up in anything like this again.
I remember the battle with Nrvnqsr.
The terror of coming within a hair of death still sends a chill down my spine whenever I think of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Give me a break.
My eyes are already broken, but my heart's going to break as well."
Arcueid is a vampire, and I don't want to be involved in something like that again.
I remember the fight with Nrvnqsr.
Just thinking about it sends chills down my spine.
The fear of being one step away from death still remains.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
それと同じだ。
　きっと、今度の相手だってまともじゃない。
　俺が関わる必要はまったくない。
　アルクェイドがなんとかするって言ってるんだから、それにまかせておけばいい。
　だっていうのに、そこまでわかっているっていうのに。
　……それでも、俺は、こいつをほおっておけそうにない。
entries.maoEnglish:
This is no different.
This opponent will surely be just as monstrous.
There is absolutely no reason for me to get involved.
Arcueid says she will handle it, so I should leave it to her.
And yet, even though I understand all of that.
And still, I cannot bring myself to leave her alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This is the same.
Definitely, the opponent this time isn't normal.
There's really no need for me to be involved.
Since Arcueid is saying she'll handle it, I can rely on her.
But even knowing all of that.
…… I can't, I just can't leave her alone.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「―――くそ、どうかしちまったのか俺は！」
　だん、と地面をけった。
　どんな理屈も、どんな理由も受け入れられない自分自身にハラがたつ。
「な、なに？
　どうしたの志貴、いきなり怒り出しちゃって」
「ああ、自分の馬鹿さ加減に頭にきてるところ。
なんだって俺は、あんな目にあったっていうのにこんな事を口にしようとしているのかってさ！」
　ああもう、口にしたら余計クラクラしてきた。
　こんな馬鹿みたいな自分―――鏡があったら間違いなく叩き割ってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Damn it, what the hell is wrong with me!”
Thud—I kicked the ground.
I am furious with myself for rejecting every argument, every sensible reason.
“Wh-what? Why are you suddenly angry, Shiki?”
“I am angry at how stupid I am! After everything I went through, why am I still trying to say something like this?”
Saying it aloud only makes my head spin worse.
I feel like such an idiot―――if there were a mirror nearby, I would smash it without hesitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Damn, what the hell is wrong with me!?"
I kick the ground.
I'm angry at myself for not accepting any reasoning or excuses.
"Wh, what?
What's wrong, Shiki?
Getting so angry like that all of a sudden."
"Yeah, I'm just angry at my stupidity.
Why I want to say this after all that which happened to me!"
I feel more mad now that I actually say it.
Being this stupid---I know if I could see myself in a mirror I'd break it to pieces.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ねえ、ほんとうにどうしたの志貴―――？
　ちょっと普通じゃないわよ」
「ああ、じゃないさ！
　普通だったらこんな事、とても口にはできないだろ……！」
　くそ、と忌々しげに唾をはいた。
　認めたくないけど、こりゃあもう決定だ。
　だって今、自分自身の口で認めてしまったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Seriously, what is wrong with you, Shiki―――? You are not acting normal.”
“Of course I am not! If I were normal, there is no way I could say this!”
I spit a bitter curse.
I do not want to admit it, but that settles it.
I have just admitted it in my own words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, really what's wrong, Shiki---?
You're not acting normal."
"Yeah, I'm not!
If I was acting normal, I really wouldn't say this……!"
I spit.
I really don't want to admit it, but it's already a done deal.
Because my mouth has already confirmed it for me.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、ぜんぜんわかんない！
　どうしたのよ志貴、さっきからこんな事こんな事って言ってるけど、なにがこんな事だっていうの！？」
「ばか、そんなの決まってるだろ！
　おまえの体が治りきるまで手伝ってやるって、そう言いたいらしいんだよ、この遠野志貴の大馬鹿ヤロウは！」
「―――――え？」
　アルクェイドは呆然と俺の顔を見る。
　こっちはと言うと、ついに、というかやっと、というか、とにかく言いたい事をはっきりと口にして気分がようやく落ち着いてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t understand at all! You keep saying ‘this’ and ‘this,’ but what is ‘this’ supposed to mean?”
“Idiot, isn’t it obvious?
This colossal fool named Shiki Tohno is trying to say he’ll help you until your body has healed!”
“―――――What?”
Arcueid stares at me in astonishment.
As for me, now that I have finally—at long last—forced out the words I meant to say, my turmoil begins to settle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh I just can't understand it Shiki!
What is it!?
You keep saying you're going to say something, but what is it!?"
"Stupid, isn't it obvious!?
Until your body heals I'll help you.
That's what the stupid fool Tohno Shiki wants to say!"
"-----Eh?"
Arcueid looks at me in total surprise.
As for me, finally saying it kind of calms me down.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
今の、ほんとう？」
「…………」
　むむー、とうなる。
「わたし、ちょっと聞きそこねちゃった。
お願いだから、もう一度言って」
「………………」
　むむむー、とうなる。
　後悔しても、いまさら後の祭りなんだ。
　自分の気持ちを言葉にしてしまった時点で―――もう、俺は自分に対して嘘をつくことなんて、できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Did you mean that?”
“…”
I answer with a low groan.
“I did not quite hear you. Please say it again.”
“…”
My groan deepens.
Regret is useless now.
The moment I put my feelings into words―――I can no longer lie to myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Is that, for real?"
"…………"
I groan.
"I didn't hear it.
Please, can you say it again?"
"………………"
I groan more.
No matter how much I regret it, it's done.
The instant I formed my feelings into words---I can't lie to myself any longer.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「早く。
わたし、今の台詞もう一回聞きたい」
　静かにねだってくるアルクェイド。
　あさっての方向を見ながら、できるだけ不機嫌そうな声を出す。
「……仕方ないだろ。
アルクェイドが弱ってるのは俺の責任だし、街にはびこってる化け物をほおっておけないし。
　弱っているおまえ一人じゃ頼りないから、俺でよかったら手伝ってやるって言ったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hurry. I want to hear that again.”
Arcueid pleads softly.
I look off in a completely different direction and make my voice as sour as possible.
“I can’t help it. You’re weak because of me, and I can’t ignore the monsters overrunning this city.
You’re too unreliable on your own in that condition, so I said I’d help—if you’re willing to settle for me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hurry.
I want to hear those words again."
Arcueid asks softly.
Looking off in the distance, I try to sound reluctant.
"…… I guess it can't be helped.
It's my fault that you are weakened now and I can't leave the monster roaming the streets alone either.
I can't rely on you taking care of it by yourself, so if you let me, I want to help you… that's what I said."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「志貴――――！」
　アルクェイドは、ぱあ、と目を輝かした。
　そのまま、嬉しそうにこっちの手を握って、ぶんぶんと握手をしたりする。
「……まあ、俺じゃたいして役にはたたないだろうけど。
こんなんでもいないよりはマシだろ」
「うん……！
　志貴が手伝ってくれるなら、恐いものなんて何もないんだから！」
　ぶんぶん、とアルクェイドはまだ握手した手を離さない。
　……なんていうか。
　彼女は、本当に嬉しそうだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki――――!”
Arcueid’s eyes light up.
Beaming, she takes my hand and shakes it vigorously.
“I probably will not be much use. Still, even I am better than no help at all.”
“Yes! If you are helping me, Shiki, there is nothing left for me to fear!”
She keeps pumping my hand without letting go.
There is no other way to put it.
She looks truly, radiantly happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki----!"
Arcueid's eyes are suddenly alight.
She grabs my hand and happily shakes it up and down.
"…… Well, I may not be that helpful, but it has to be better than nothing."
"Yeah……!
If you are helping me, there's nothing to be afraid of!"
She keeps shaking my hand up and down.
…… How do I say this?
She really does seem happy.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「けどさ、これからどうするんだ。
またさっきみたいに街を歩いて死者を探すのか？」
「そうね、今はそれぐらいしか手はないかな。
　さっきので十二人目だから、そろそろ死者も打ち止めだと思う。
　この街にいる死者を全員潰してしまえば親元の吸血鬼が出てこざるをえなくなるから、それまでは残りの死者を探すって方針だけど」
　それでもいい？
　とアルクェイドは視線で問いただしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what do we do now? Walk around town looking for more of the Dead?”
“That is about our only option for now.
The one tonight was the twelfth, so there cannot be many left.
Once every member of the Dead in the city is gone, the parent vampire will have no choice but to emerge, so until then we hunt down the survivors.”
Her eyes fix on me. Is that all right?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, what do we do now?
Do you want to search for more of The Dead like before?"
"Yeah, I think that's all we can do for now.
The one before was the twelfth, so I don't think there's many more.
The parent vampire will have to come out once they all are destroyed, so we have to hunt the remaining ones for now.
Is that still okay?", she asks.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「いいもなにも、俺はアルクェイドに付き合うだけだよ。
アルクェイドがそうするっていうんなら、大人しくしたがうさ。
　――じゃ、もう一度街に行くか」
「あ、今夜はもういいの。
効率よく死者を操るためにはね、それなりの活動ルートを定めているもので、一晩に複数の死者は活動させないと思う。
　ただでさえ数が減ってきているんだから、むこうも無闇に活動させないでしょうし」
「―――そうなの？
　でも、それじゃあアルクェイドから死者を隠そうとするんじゃないのか、その『敵』ってヤツは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am only coming along with you. If that is what you have decided, I will follow without complaining.
――So, shall we head back into town?”
“Oh, we are finished for tonight; to control the Dead efficiently, their master gives each one a fixed route. I doubt it activates more than one per night.
Their numbers are already dwindling, so it will not risk them recklessly.”
“―――Really? But would your ‘enemy’ not simply hide the Dead from you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anything is fine, I'm just with you.
If you lead, then I'll follow.
--well, shall we start again?"
"Ah, no, that's good for tonight.
They usually follow a fixed route, and the other Dead will probably not be out tonight.
Since they are fewer in number, I don't think he'll let them all come out at once."
"---Oh really?
But, doesn't that mean this 'enemy' will try to hide The Dead from you, Arcueid?"
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「基本的にはね。
けど、『敵』が吸血鬼である以上、どうしても他者から血や精を搾取しないと存在してられないのよ。
　だから、むこうはわたしに狙われてるってわかっていても、最低限の食料を得るために死者を出すしかないっていうわけ」
―――はあ。
で、その最低限の死者がさっきの男だったわけか。
「そういうこと。
だから今夜は、これ以上探し回っても無駄だと思う」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That would be the sensible thing. But a vampire can’t survive without draining blood and vital essence from others.
Even knowing I’m hunting it, our enemy still has to send out the Dead to secure the bare minimum of food.”
―――Right. So that man was the one it sent out to secure the bare minimum of food.
“Exactly. So there’s no point searching any further tonight.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Basically.
But since this 'enemy' is a vampire, he needs to steal the blood and energy of others.
So, even though he knows I'm searching for them, he has to send The Dead out to get the minimal blood he needs."
---*sigh*
Then, the minimal Dead he sent out was that man from before, huh.

"So, searching further tonight will be useless, I think."
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、俺はどうでもいいけど。
なんだかまだるっこしいな、それ」
「ええ。
もともと吸血鬼退治は面倒なものなの。
この街のどこかにある『敵』の棺を探しあてるんだから、そう簡単には終わらないわ」
　アルクェイドは俺から手を離すと、タン、という軽い足取りでうしろに跳んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I suppose I don’t mind. It sounds awfully slow, though.”
“Vampire hunting is always tedious. We have to find my enemy’s coffin somewhere in this city. It was never going to end quickly.”
Arcueid releases my hand and springs lightly backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I don't mind.
But it is tedious though."
"Yeah, hunting vampires is tedious work.
We have to find the coffin of this 'enemy' somewhere in this city, so it won't be easy."
Arcueid lets go of my hand and jumps back softly.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド……？」
「今夜はここでお別れにしましょう。
どうせ、またすぐ明日に会えるんだから」
　アルクェイドは踊るようなステップで、こっちを見たまま遠ざかっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…?”
“Let us say good night here. We will see each other again tomorrow anyway.”
Keeping her eyes on me, Arcueid dances backward in buoyant steps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid……?"
"Let's say goodbye for tonight.
We'll meet tomorrow.
With her dance-like steps, she watches me as she gets farther away.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「明日って―――ちょっと待て、待ち合わせ場所とかどうするんだよ、おい！」
「ここでいいよ。
時間は―――そうね、十時ごろがちょうどいいかな」
　笑顔で、実にかってに約束をする。
「おやすみなさい、志貴。
また明日、ここでね！」
　と。
　手をふって、アルクェイドは去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tomorrow―――wait, where are we meeting?”
“Here is fine. As for the time―――ten o’clock should be about right.”
Smiling, she arranges the whole thing without consulting me.
“Good night, Shiki. I will see you here tomorrow!”
And with that.
Arcueid waves and leaves.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tomorrow---wait, where should we meet……!?"
"Here's fine.
The time---yeah, around ten o'clock should be fine."
With a smile, she makes that promise.

"Good night, Shiki.
I'll see you here tomorrow!"
And,
waving her hand, Arcueid disappears.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
―――屋敷に帰ってきた。
　深夜ということもあって、屋敷の明かりは完全に消え去っている。
「………まずい、かな」
　屋敷の門に手をかける。
　がちん、という音。
　門には頑丈そうな錠が内側からかけられていた。
「―――まいったな。
切るわけにもいかないし」
　少し悩む。
　悩んでから、門を自力でよじのぼる事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I am back at the estate.
It is past midnight, and every light has gone out.
“This could be bad…”
I put a hand on the front gate.
Clang.
A sturdy lock has been fastened from inside.
“―――Wonderful. It is not as if I can cut through it.”
I think for a moment.
Then I decide to climb over under my own power.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I get back to the mansion.
As it is very late, the mansion is completely dark.
"……… This can't be good."
I put my hand on the mansion gate.
Ka-chang.
A sturdy chain holds it closed.
"---Dang.
I shouldn't cut this."
I think a bit.
Then, I decide to climb over the gate.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
……疲れた。
　ドロボウさんよろしくで門をよじ登って、玄関にたどり着く。
　門は鍵がかかっていたが、玄関の扉は開いていた。
「……翡翠、ちゃんと開けててくれたんだ」
　ほう、と感謝の吐息がもれる。
　秋葉や琥珀さんたちを起こさないように、抜き足で屋敷の中へと入っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I am exhausted.
After scaling the gate like a burglar, I reach the front entrance.
The gate is locked, but the door itself stands open.
“Hisui remembered to leave it open for me.”
I breathe out in gratitude.
Careful not to wake Akiha, Kohaku, or anyone else, I creep into the estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm exhausted.
After sneaking over the wall like a thief, I quietly make my way to the doorway.
The gate was locked, but the door isn't.
"…… It must have been Hisui."
I give a sigh of thanks.
So as not to wake Akiha, Kohaku-san or Hisui, I sneak my way through the mansion.
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「――――――ふう」
　一息ついて、ベッドに腰をかける。
「………………」
　アルクェイドとの約束。
　なんの因果か、また厄介なコトに足を踏み入れた遠野志貴。
「――――仕方ないじゃないか。
だってさ、放っておけなかったんだから」
　それとも、放っておきたくなかったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Whew”
I catch my breath and sit down on the bed.
“…”
My promise to Arcueid.
And here is Shiki Tohno, by some twist of fate neck-deep in trouble again.
“――――I could not help it. I could not just leave her alone.”
Or perhaps I had not wanted to leave her alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Whew."
Letting out a breath, I lay down on my bed.
"………………"
My promise to Arcueid.
Maybe it's fate, but you've gotten yourself tangled up in trouble again, Tohno Shiki.
"----Could I help it?
I just can't leave her alone."
Or maybe I didn't want to leave her alone?
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
「そりゃあ……まあ、綺麗だと思うけど」
　自分の気持ちがよく解らない。
　善悪定まらない、というのはこういうコトなんだろうか。
　ともかく、明日からまたアルクェイドの手伝いをする事になったんだ。
　今は余計なことは考えず、ゆっくりと体を休めて明日にそなえるとしよう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I suppose she is beautiful.”
I do not understand my own feelings.
Is this what it means to have no idea whether something is right or wrong?
Whatever the answer, I was going to be helping Arcueid again starting tomorrow.
For now, I would put every other thought aside, rest properly, and save my strength for tomorrow――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well…… I do think she is pretty."
I don't understand my feelings right now.
Right now, I'm not too sure what is right and what is wrong.
At any rate, it looks like I'll be helping Arcueid once again starting tomorrow.
So for now, I shouldn't think of anything else but getting a good night's sleep----
entries.scriptLabel: 6 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception I

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない閉じた箱庭の世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, the estate was one enormous playground.
A garden as deep as a forest.
A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Back then, the whole mansion was like a giant playground.
The garden, a deep forest.
The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
毎日は楽しかった。
　おとなになるなんてこともしらなかったし、
　朝と夜はおんなじようにくりかえされるんだってうたがいもしなかった。
　それは、ただ、子犬のようにはしゃぎまわった幼年期。
　ボクらはとても気が合って、最高の遊び仲間だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Every day was fun.
We didn’t even know we would grow up someday,
and never doubted that morning and night would go on repeating themselves forever.
It was childhood, nothing more: the years when we tumbled about like puppies.
We understood each other perfectly and were the best playmates in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Every day was fun.
No one thought about ever growing up,
and we believed that days and nights would always be the same.
It was just a childhood spent playing like puppies.
We got along wonderfully, and were the best of playmates.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
ふりむけばいつもあきはがいて、手をふるとはずかしがって隠れてしまう。
　うん、そんなのもいつもどおり。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whenever I looked back, Akiha was there, and if I waved, she grew shy and hid.
Yes, that was the way it always was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Whenever I turned back, Akiha would be there, waving her hands and hiding shyly.
Yes, always the same.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない箱庭の閉じた世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, the estate was one enormous playground.
A garden as deep as a forest.
A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At that time, the mansion was a giant playground.
The garden, a deep forest.
The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
うっすらと意識が覚醒する。
　朝の光が体を包んで、眠りが少しずつ覚めていく。
　その中で。
　なにか、懐かしい夢をみた気がしていた。
「―――――――」
　目を覚ましたとたん、厭なモノが視界に入ってくる。
　ずきり、とこめかみには銃創のような頭痛。
「く――――」
　急いで枕もとのメガネをかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awareness slowly returns.
Morning light enfolds my body, easing me little by little out of sleep.
In that half-waking haze.
I felt as though I had dreamed of something long ago.
“―――――――”
The instant I open my eyes, something hateful enters my sight.
Pain punches through my temple like a gunshot wound.
“Ghh――――”
I hastily put on the glasses beside my pillow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I slowly awaken and open my eyes.
The morning light wraps around me and my sleepiness starts to lift.
As the last vestiges clear,
I sense that I had a very nostalgic dream.
"-------"
As soon as I open my eyes, I start to see those terrible things jump into my vision.
My head stabs with pain.
"Gg----"
I scramble for the glasses by my pillow and put them on.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「は―――――あ」
　深く深呼吸をして、なんとか気分を落ち着けた。
「なんだって―――朝から、こんな」
　こんな、はっきりと線を見てしまったのか。
　建物の死の線は見えにくい。
　見えていてもそれはうっすらとしているし、今のようにはっきりと見える事は稀だったのに。
「…………」
　くわえて、今は『点』まで見えてしまっていた。
　なんだか頭痛も鋭くなっている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――ah”
I take a deep breath and somehow steady myself.
“Why―――am I seeing them this clearly first thing in the morning?”
Why did I see the lines so clearly?
The lines of death on buildings are hard to see.
Even when visible, they are faint; it is rare for them to stand out as sharply as they do now.
“…”
Now I can even see the “points.”
The headache feels sharper too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take in some air.
After taking a few deep breaths, I manage to calm down.
"Why did I----so early…"
See those lines so clearly this early in the morning?
It's difficult to see the lines of death in buildings.
It's usually hard to see them, and seeing them so clearly like I just did now is rare.
"…………"
What's more, I even saw those "points".
I think my headache is getting worse too.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
先生は、この目がよくないものを呼び寄せる、と言っていた。
　アルクェイドや吸血鬼といったものは、確かによくないものだと思う。
　なら、相乗効果というヤツでこの両目も力を増していってしまっているのかもしれない。
「――――まさか」
　たぶん、ただ疲れているだけだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
My teacher once told me these eyes would draw dangerous things to me.
Arcueid and vampires certainly qualify.
Maybe some kind of vicious feedback is making the eyes themselves grow stronger.
“――――No way”
I am probably just tired.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sensei said these eyes would attract things that weren't good.
I think Arcueid and these vampires are certainly not good.
So, maybe it's all affecting my eyes and making them stronger.
"----Can't be."
I'm probably just tired.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あれ────？」
　そういえば、翡翠の姿がない。
　時刻は朝の七時過ぎだ。
　いつもなら翡翠がやってきていて、起きるように呼びかけている時間なのに。
「……寝坊したのかな、翡翠」
　そのわりには、机の上にキチンと着替えの制服が用意されていたりする。
「なんだろ。
なにか他の仕事でもあったのかな」
　気にはなるが自分には関係のない事かもしれない。
　今朝は時間もないし、手早く制服に着替えて居間にむかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh────?”
Come to think of it, Hisui is not here.
It is already past seven.
Ordinarily she would have arrived by now and be trying to wake me.
“Did Hisui oversleep…?”
And yet my uniform has been laid out with perfect care on the desk.
“I wonder what happened. Maybe she had some other work to do.”
It bothers me, but it may have nothing to do with me.
I’m short on time this morning, so I dress quickly and head downstairs to the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh----?"
Come to think of it, Hisui isn't here.
It's already past seven.
Normally she would have already come in and woke me up.
"…… Maybe Hisui slept in."
But I see my freshly prepared uniform on my desk.
"What's this?
Maybe she had some other duties."
I'm a little curious, but I guess it doesn't concern me.
I don't have time this morning, so I should just hurry up, change and go to the sitting room.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――――あ」
　ロビーから居間に入ろうとして、とんでもない事を失念していた事に気がついた。
　扉を開けて、居間に一歩も足を踏み入れられず立ち尽くす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Oh”
Just as I am about to enter the sitting room from the foyer, I remember the catastrophe I had somehow forgotten.
I open the door—and freeze on the threshold, unable to take a single step inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
As I go from the lobby towards the sitting room, I realize I forgot something terribly important.
I open the door and stand there, without taking a single step forward.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がいた。
　傍らには琥珀さんもいて、二人は無言で紅茶を飲んでいる。
　いつもはどんなに刺があろうが
「おはようごさいます、兄さん」
　と挨拶をしてくる秋葉さんは、今朝にかぎってこっちを見てもくれない。
「あ…………う」
　言うまでもなく。
　昨夜、アルクェイドが屋敷にやってきた一件が尾を引いている結果である。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is in the sitting room.
Kohaku is beside her, and the two of them are drinking tea in silence.
No matter how barbed her mood,
Akiha always greets me: “Good morning, Brother.”
This morning, she will not even look my way.
“Ah, uh”
There is no need to ask why.
Arcueid’s visit to the estate last night is still casting a very long shadow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is in the sitting room.
Kohaku-san is nearby and the two of them are drinking tea silently.
Normally she would say,
"Good morning, Nii-san,"
no matter how angry she might be, but she doesn't even look at me this morning.
"Ah……… uh."
It goes without saying.
Arcueid's coming here last night has some very lasting repercussions.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
秋葉のいらいら加減はハンパじゃなくて、居間は打てば響くような緊張感に支配されている。
「おはようございます、志貴さん」
　……まあ、それもこの人だけにはまるで影響を与えていないみたいだけど。
「あ…うん、おはよう琥珀さん」
　琥珀さんに片手をあげて、居間に入る。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s irritation is off the scale, and the tension in the room is so taut it would ring if struck.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
None of this seems capable of troubling Kohaku.
“Ah, yes, good morning, Kohaku.”
I raise one hand to her and venture into the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha's irritation is permeating the air.
You could practically cut the tension with a knife.
"Good morning, Shiki-san."
