…… Well, it seems like she's remained unaffected, at least.
"Ah… yeah, good morning Kohaku-san."
Raising a hand to Kohaku-san, I enter the sitting room.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
とことこと足音を忍ばせて歩く俺に、秋葉はじろりとした流し目を向けてきた。
 ───うう、無言の圧力なんかに負けないぞ。
entries.maoEnglish:
As I creep forward on tiptoe, Akiha cuts me a murderous sideways glance.
───I will not be cowed by a little silent pressure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha glares at me as I shuffle into the sitting room.
---Ugh, I'm not going to succumb to this silent pressure!
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない閉じた箱庭の世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, the estate was one enormous playground.
A garden as deep as a forest.
A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Back then, the whole mansion was like a giant playground.
The garden, a deep forest.
The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
毎日は楽しかった。
　おとなになるなんてこともしらなかったし、
　朝と夜はおんなじようにくりかえされるんだってうたがいもしなかった。
　それは、ただ、子犬のようにはしゃぎまわった幼年期。
　ボクらはとても気が合って、最高の遊び仲間だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Every day was fun.
We didn’t even know we would grow up someday,
and never doubted that morning and night would go on repeating themselves forever.
It was childhood, nothing more: the years when we tumbled about like puppies.
We understood each other perfectly and were the best playmates in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Every day was fun.
No one thought about ever growing up,
and we believed that days and nights would always be the same.
It was just a childhood spent playing like puppies.
We got along wonderfully, and were the best of playmates.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
ふりむけばいつもあきはがいて、手をふるとはずかしがって隠れてしまう。
　うん、そんなのもいつもどおり。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whenever I looked back, Akiha was there, and if I waved, she grew shy and hid.
Yes, that was the way it always was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Whenever I turned back, Akiha would be there, waving her hands and hiding shyly.
Yes, always the same.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない箱庭の閉じた世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。

A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.

The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.

entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
「あ、おはよう翡翠」
「はい、おはようございます志貴さま」
　……翡翠はいつもの調子で俺の着替えを用意してくれる。
　が、翡翠の態度がどことなくピリピリしているのははっきりとわかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
“Oh, morning, Hisui.”
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui prepares my clothes with her customary composure.
Even so, there is no mistaking the edge in her manner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please excuse me."
Hisui enters and greets me with a bow.
"Ah, morning Hisui."
"Yes, good morning Shiki-sama."
…… Hisui brings my uniform as usual.
But, I can tell she is a bit angry.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……理由はいうまでもない。
　昨日、夜遅くまで屋敷に帰らず、いつのまにか自分の部屋に戻って眠っていた俺に対して怒っているんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The reason is obvious.
She must be angry because I stayed out late last night, then somehow returned to my room and went to sleep without anyone noticing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The reason doesn't need to be said.
She must be angry over yesterday because I didn't get back until very late, worked my way into my room and slept.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、昨日は、その……」
「志貴さま、わたしなどに弁明をされる必要はありません」
　スパッと返答して、翡翠はドアまで歩いていく
「それでは失礼します。
朝食の支度をするよう姉さんに伝えますので、早めに居間に下りてきてください」
「ああ、そのつもりだけど……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, about yesterday…”
“You have no need to explain yourself to someone in my position, Master Shiki.”
With that sharp answer, Hisui walks to the door
“I shall leave you, then. I’ll ask Kohaku to prepare breakfast, so please come down to the sitting room promptly.”
“Yeah, I was going to, but…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, last night, um……"
"Shiki-sama, there is no need to give me any excuses."
Answering quickly, she starts walking towards the door.
"Then please excuse me.
Nee-san has prepared your breakfast, so please hurry to the sitting room."
"Yeah, I planned on doing so……"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「それと、志貴さま。
　昨日、志貴さまが帰宅されなかった事について秋葉さまがお話があるとの事です。
それでは、お早めに居間に下りてきてくださいませ」
　ばたん、と無情に扉は閉められた。
「う―――――」
　……まあ、順当に考えるとこういう結果になるのである。
entries.maoEnglish:
“One more thing, Master Shiki.
Miss Akiha wishes to speak with you about not returning home last night. Please come down promptly.”
The door shuts with a heartless thud.
“Ugh―――――”
Well, this is the obvious outcome.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And Shiki-sama,
Akiha-sama would like to talk to you about your late return last night.
So please hurry to the sitting room."
She shuts the door emotionlessly.
"U-----"
…… Well, come to think of it, this is a perfectly natural result.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉の姿しかない。
　厨房からは琥珀さんの、調子のはずれた鼻歌が響いてきてる。
「……………」
　秋葉は俺を見ても何も言わず、無言で紅茶を飲んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is alone in the sitting room.
From the kitchen comes Kohaku’s tuneless humming.
“…”
Akiha sees me, says nothing, and continues drinking her tea in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is the only one in the sitting room.
Kohaku-san is in the kitchen, humming away.
"………………"
Akiha doesn't say anything when she sees me and sips her tea quietly.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「やあ。
おはよう、秋葉」
　できるだけ自然に挨拶なんかをしてみたりする。
　秋葉はぴくっ、と眉を上下させてからティーカップをテーブルに置いて、ゆっくりと俺に視線を向けてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey. Morning, Akiha.”
I attempt the most natural greeting I can manage; one eyebrow twitches. Akiha sets her cup on the table and slowly turns her eyes upon me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey.
Good morning, Akiha."
I try to greet her as naturally as I can.
Akiha's eyebrow twitches as she places her teacup down and slowly looks at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます兄さん。
昨夜はずいぶんと遅いお帰りだったようですね」
「……いや、そんなことないんじゃないかな。
たかだか夜の一時過ぎ、健康な高校生男子ならじゅうぶんに起きてる時間だよ」
「そうね。
私も就寝は日が変わってからだから、その時間は起きてるわ。
もっとも家に帰ってくる時間はもっと早いんですけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother. You seem to have come home awfully late last night.”
“It was not that late, was it? Barely past one is still a perfectly normal hour for a healthy high-school boy to be awake.”
“True. I rarely retire before midnight myself, so I am awake at that hour too. I simply make a point of returning home much earlier.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning Nii-san.
It was quite late when you came home last night, wasn't it?"
"…… No, not really.
It was at most a little past one o'clock, quite normal for a healthy young man in high school to be up, right?"
"I see.
My bedtime is also past midnight so I was up at that time.
But I would come home much earlier than that."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「うっ……いや、昨日はこみいった事情があって、屋敷に帰って来れなかったんだ。
それでも一応は帰ってきたんだから、その―――」
「ええ、深夜に帰ってきて、ご自分のお部屋に戻られたのですよね。
それも無断で、足音一つ立てずに。
　……まったく、何か後ろめたいことをしていたとしか思えない行動ね」
「うっ………」
　秋葉の視線は、ものすっごく冷たい。
　……こうして注意されるのは二回目だから、冷静そうに見えて秋葉は本当に呆れているのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Something complicated came up yesterday, and I could not make it back to the estate. But I did come home eventually, so―――”
“Yes. You came home in the middle of the night and slipped into your room without permission or so much as a footstep.
Frankly, it is difficult to imagine such behavior unless you had something to hide.”
“Ugh…”
Akiha’s gaze is glacial.
Since this is the second time she has had to lecture me, her calm exterior may only hide how thoroughly exasperated she is.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… well, there were some pressing circumstances and I couldn't get back.
But I did return, so---"
"Yes, very late at night and you went back to your room.
Without saying anything or even making a noise.
…… Goodness, you acted like you were out doing something you felt guilty over."
"Uh………"
Her stare is pure ice.
…… This is the second time, and I'm sure even though Akiha looks calm, she is quite angry.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――兄さん。
　有間の家ではどうだったかしらないけど、ここでの門限は午後八時までです。
これは絶対に守ってもらう規則なんです。
　それ以降は屋敷の門を閉めますから、昨夜のようによじのぼって侵入するなんて事はしないでください」
「うっ───知ってたのか、おまえ」
「……あのですね、知っていたもなにも、監視カメラにきっかり映っていました。
　琥珀があわてて警報機を切ったからよかったものの、もし兄さんだって気がつかなかったら今頃留置所の中にいるでしょうね、遠野志貴は」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――Brother.
I do not know what rules the Arima family kept, but curfew here is eight o’clock. That rule is absolute.
The gates are locked after eight, so do not climb over them and break in as you did last night.”
“Urk───you knew?”
“For heaven’s sake, the security cameras caught you perfectly.
Fortunately, Kohaku recognized you and switched off the alarm; otherwise Shiki Tohno would be sitting in a police cell right now.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Nii-san.
I don't know what went on at the Arima house, but here the curfew is eight o'clock.
It is a rule that must not be broken.
The gate will be locked after that, so please don't climb in like a robber."
"Oh---You knew?"
"…… The surveillance camera showed me quite clearly.
It is a good thing Kohaku realized it was you and turned off the alarm system because otherwise you would probably be detained right now."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
そりゃあ琥珀さんに感謝しないといけないな。
　その、秋葉もごめん。
昨日は黙ってでかけて悪かった」
「……わかっていただければいいんです。
これにこりたら門限は厳守してくださいね。
今までのことは大目にみてあげますから」
「……それなんだけど、秋葉」
「なんですか？」
「……その、言いにくいんだけどさ。
俺、今日も夜に用事があるんだ。
帰りも何時になるかわからないんだけど、決して悪いことをしてるわけじゃなくて―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. I owe Kohaku a great deal, then.
And I am sorry, Akiha. I should not have left without telling you.”
“As long as you understand. Let this be a lesson and observe the curfew from now on. I will overlook everything that has happened so far.”
“About that, Akiha.”
“What is it?”
“This is hard to say. I have somewhere to be tonight too. I do not know when I will be back, but I swear I am not doing anything wrong―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh.
I should thank Kohaku-san then.
And, um, Akiha, I'm sorry.
I shouldn't have kept quiet about it."

"…… If you understand, then it is fine.
Please make sure you observe your curfew from now on.
I will overlook it this time."
"…… About that, Akiha."
"What is it?"
"…… This is a little hard to say.
I… have something to do tonight too.
I don't know when I will be back, but I'm not going to do anything bad---"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「─────────」
　秋葉の視線がツメタイ。
「琥珀！」
　突然、秋葉は立ち上がった。
　名前を呼ばれて琥珀さんが厨房からやってくる。
「はい、なんでしょうか秋葉さま」
「学校に行きます。
支度をなさい」
「はあ、ですが志貴さんの朝食の支度がまだできてませんよ」
「こんな人の朝食なんてほっといていいです。
ご自分でなんでも出来るそうですから！」
　秋葉はずかずかとロビーへと行進していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“─────────”
Akiha’s stare turns colder still.
“Kohaku!”
She shoots to her feet.
At the sound of her name, Kohaku emerges from the kitchen.
“Yes, Miss Akiha?”
“We’re leaving for school. Get ready.”
“But Master Shiki’s breakfast isn’t ready yet.”
“Forget breakfast for someone like him. Apparently he can do everything perfectly well by himself!”
Akiha marches out toward the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Akiha's gaze tightens.
"Kohaku!"
She suddenly stands up.
Kohaku-san comes in from the kitchen.

"Yes, what is it Akiha-sama?"
"I will be going to school, get the preparations ready."
"Huh?
But I have not yet made Shiki-san's breakfast."
"You can leave this person alone.
It seems he can do everything by himself."
Akiha strides towards the lobby.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「はあ……志貴さん、あんまり秋葉さまを怒らせちゃだめですよ。
お兄さんなんですから、ちゃんとかまってあげてくださいね」
　そんな事を言いつつ、琥珀さんは秋葉の後を追いかけていく。
　居間にはまだ、湯気をたててるティーカップが一つきり。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh dear, Master Shiki, you really should not make Miss Akiha so angry. You are her big brother, so give her a little attention, will you?”
With that, Kohaku hurries after her.
One solitary cup remains in the sitting room, still giving off steam.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san sighs.
"…… Shiki-san, you should not make Akiha-sama so upset.
You are her big brother, so please treat her better okay?"
Saying that, she walks after Akiha.
The teacup sits, still steaming.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「───まあ、ようするに」
　一人残されて、冷静に状況を判断する。
「今日は朝メシ抜きっていうことかな」
　うん、間違いない。
　……行きがけにコンビニにでもよって、パンでも買っていくことにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───So, in summary”
Left alone, I assess the situation with perfect objectivity.
“I am not getting breakfast today.”
There is no doubt about it.
I will stop by a convenience store on the way and buy some bread.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Well, in short…"
I'm left by myself to calmly consider my situation.
"Guess I'm skipping breakfast today."
Yeah, no doubt.
…… I should stop by a convenience store on the way and buy some bread.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない閉じた箱庭の世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, the estate was one enormous playground.
A garden as deep as a forest.
A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Back then, the whole mansion was like a giant playground.
The garden, a deep forest.
The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
毎日は楽しかった。
　おとなになるなんてこともしらなかったし、
　朝と夜はおんなじようにくりかえされるんだってうたがいもしなかった。
　それは、ただ、子犬のようにはしゃぎまわった幼年期。
　ボクらはとても気が合って、最高の遊び仲間だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Every day was fun.
We didn’t even know we would grow up someday,
and never doubted that morning and night would go on repeating themselves forever.
It was childhood, nothing more: the years when we tumbled about like puppies.
We understood each other perfectly and were the best playmates in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Every day was fun.
No one thought about ever growing up,
and we believed that days and nights would always be the same.
It was just a childhood spent playing like puppies.
We got along wonderfully, and were the best of playmates.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
ふりむけばいつもあきはがいて、手をふるとはずかしがって隠れてしまう。
　うん、そんなのもいつもどおり。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whenever I looked back, Akiha was there, and if I waved, she grew shy and hid.
Yes, that was the way it always was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Whenever I turned back, Akiha would be there, waving her hands and hiding shyly.
Yes, always the same.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない箱庭の閉じた世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, the estate was one enormous playground.
A garden as deep as a forest.
A house as tall as a castle.
We ran wild through that little walled-off world, too vast to explore even if we spent days trying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At that time, the mansion was a giant playground.
The garden, a deep forest.
The house, a tall castle.
We played in our own little world, which would take days to explore.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
うっすらと意識が覚醒する。
　朝の光が体を包んで、眠りが少しずつ覚めていく。
　その中で。
　なにか、懐かしい夢をみた気がしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awareness slowly returns.
Morning light enfolds my body, easing me little by little out of sleep.
In that half-waking haze.
I felt as though I had dreamed of something long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I slowly awaken and open my eyes.
The morning light wraps around me and my sleepiness starts to lift.
As the last vestiges clear,
I sense that I had a very nostalgic dream.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　目を覚ましたとたん、厭なモノが視界に入ってくる。
　ずきり、とこめかみには銃創のような頭痛。
「く――――」
　急いで枕もとのメガネをかける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
The instant I open my eyes, something hateful enters my sight.
Pain punches through my temple like a gunshot wound.
“Ghh――――”
I hastily put on the glasses beside my pillow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
As soon as I open my eyes, I start to see those terrible things jump into my vision.
My head stabs with pain.
"Gg----"
I scramble for the glasses by my pillow and put them on.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「は―――――あ」
　深く深呼吸をして、なんとか気分を落ち着けた。
「なんだって―――朝から、こんな」
　こんな、はっきりと線を見てしまったのか。
　建物の死の線は見えにくい。
見えていてもそれはうっすらとしているし、今のようにはっきりと見える事は稀だったのに。
「…………」
　くわえて、今は『点』まで見えてしまっていた。
　なんだか頭痛も鋭くなっている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――ah”
I draw a deep breath and somehow steady myself. “Why―――am I seeing them this clearly first thing in the morning?”
Why did I see the lines so clearly?
The lines of death on buildings are hard to see. Even when visible, they are faint, and it is rare for them to stand out this sharply.
“…”
Now I can even see the “points.” The headache feels sharper too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take in some air.
After taking a few deep breaths, I manage to calm down.
"Why did I---so early…"
See those lines so clearly this early in the morning?
It's difficult to see the lines of death in buildings.
It's usually hard to see them, and seeing them so clearly like I just did now is rare.
"…………"
What's more, I even saw those "points".
I think my headache is getting worse too.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
先生は、この目がよくないものを呼び寄せる、と言っていた。
　アルクェイドや吸血鬼といったものは、確かによくないものだと思う。
　なら、相乗効果というヤツでこの両目も力を増していってしまっているのかもしれない。
「――――まさか」
　たぶん、ただ疲れているだけだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
My teacher once told me these eyes would draw dangerous things to me.
Arcueid and vampires certainly qualify.
Maybe some kind of vicious feedback is making the eyes themselves grow stronger.
“――――No way”
I am probably just tired.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sensei said these eyes would attract things that weren't good.
I think Arcueid and these vampires are certainly not good.
So, maybe it's all affecting my eyes and making them stronger.
"----Can't be."
I'm probably just tired.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
「あ、おはよう翡翠」
「はい、おはようございます志貴さま」
　……翡翠はいつもの調子で俺の着替えを用意してくれる。
　けど、なんだろう。
　心なしか、翡翠の態度がどことなくピリピリしているように思えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
“Oh, morning, Hisui.”
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui prepares my clothes with her customary composure.
Still, something is wrong.
Unless I’m imagining it, there is a distinct edge to Hisui’s manner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please excuse me."
Hisui enters, greeting me with a bow.
"Ah, morning Hisui."
"Yes, good morning Shiki-sama."
…… Hisui brings my uniform as usual.
But what is it?
I think she is a bit angry.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、今朝はなにかあったのか？
　なんか、機嫌が悪そうだけど」
「………………」
　翡翠は何か言いたそうな顔をして、無言でドアまで歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did something happen this morning, Hisui? You seem upset.”
“…”
Hisui looks as if she wants to say something, but walks to the door in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, did something happen this morning?
You seem, to be in a bad mood."
"………………"
Hisui looks at me as though she wants to say something, and then walks silently to the door.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「それでは失礼します。
朝食の支度をするよう姉さんに伝えますので、早めに居間に下りてきてください」
「ああ、そのつもりだけど……」
　どうして翡翠が怒っているのか、ちょっと気になる。
「一つ、言い忘れておりました。
昨夜、志貴さまが無断外出した事について、秋葉さまがお話があるとの事です。
志貴さま、早めに居間に下りてきてくださいませ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I shall leave you, then. I’ll ask Kohaku to prepare breakfast, so please come down to the sitting room promptly.”
“Yeah, I was going to, but…”
I can’t help wondering why she is angry.
“I nearly forgot one thing. Miss Akiha wishes to speak with you about your unauthorized outing last night. Please come down to the sitting room promptly, Master Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then please excuse me.
I will tell Nee-san to prepare your breakfast, so please hurry to the sitting room."
"Yeah, I planned on doing so……"

I am a bit curious why Hisui is mad.
" I forgot to say one thing.
Akiha-sama would like to talk to you about your sneaking out last night.
So please hurry to the sitting room."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
ばたん、と無情に扉は閉められた。
「ま―――――」
　まずい。
昨日、秋葉たちの目を盗んで外に出て、人知れず自分の部屋に戻ってきたことが、バレてる。
「……居間におりてこいって、ようするにそこに秋葉が待ってるわけか……」
　はあ……どうしてこう、悪いことっていうのは隠し通せないんだろう、ほんと。
entries.maoEnglish:
The door shuts with a heartless thud.
“Oh―――――”
This is bad. They know I slipped out under their noses last night and crept back to my room without anyone noticing.
“If she told me to come downstairs, that means Akiha is waiting for me there…”
Honestly, why is wrongdoing always so impossible to hide?
entries.mirrorMoon:
She shuts the door emotionlessly.
"Cr-----"
Crap.
They know about me sneaking out last night.
"…… Go to the sitting room means Akiha is waiting there……?"
Man…… Why can't bad things be just kept a secret?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉の姿しかない。
　厨房からは琥珀さんの、調子のはずれた鼻歌が響いてきてる。
「……………」
　秋葉は俺を見ても何も言わず、無言で紅茶を飲んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is alone in the sitting room.
From the kitchen comes Kohaku’s tuneless humming.
“…”
Akiha sees me, says nothing, and continues drinking her tea in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is the only one in the sitting room.
Kohaku-san is in the kitchen, humming away.
"………………"
Akiha doesn't say anything when she sees me and sips her tea quietly.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「やあ。
おはよう、秋葉」
　できるだけ自然に挨拶なんかをしてみたりする。
　秋葉はぴくっ、と眉を上下させてからティーカップをテーブルに置いて、ゆっくりと俺に視線を向けてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey. Morning, Akiha.”
I attempt the most natural greeting I can manage; one eyebrow twitches. Akiha sets her cup on the table and slowly turns her eyes upon me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey.
Good morning, Akiha."
I try to greet her as naturally as I can.
Akiha's eyebrow twitches as she places her teacup down and slowly looks at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます兄さん。
昨夜はずいぶんと遅いお帰りだったようですね」
「……いや、そんなことないんじゃないかな。
　たかだか夜の一時過ぎ、健康な高校生男子ならじゅうぶんに起きてる時間だよ」
「そうね。
私も就寝は日が変わってからだから、その時間は起きてるわ。
もっとも家に帰ってくる時間はもっと早いんですけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother. You seem to have come home awfully late last night.”
“It was not that late, was it?
Barely past one is still a perfectly normal hour for a healthy high-school boy to be awake.”
“True. I rarely retire before midnight myself, so I am awake at that hour too. I simply make a point of returning home much earlier.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning Nii-san.
It was quite late when you came home last night, wasn't it?"
"…… No, not really.
It was at most a little past one o'clock, quite normal for a healthy young man in high school to be up, right?"
"I see.
My bedtime is also past midnight so I was up at that time.
But I would come home much earlier than that."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああ、俺だって昨日は早くから家にいたじゃないか。
……ただちょっと、たまたま夜中に用事が出来たから外に出たわけだけど―――」
「無断で、ですか。
何か後ろめたいことをしに行くとしか思えない行動ですね」
「うっ………」
　秋葉の視線は、ものすっごく冷たい。
　……こうして注意されるのは二回目だから、冷静そうに見えて秋葉は本当に呆れているのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was home early too, wasn’t I? Something just happened to come up in the middle of the night, so I stepped out for a while―――”
“Without telling anyone. Behavior like that can only suggest you were going out to do something shameful.”
“Ugh…”
Akiha’s gaze is glacial.
Since this is the second time she has had to lecture me, her calm exterior may only hide how thoroughly exasperated she is.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, even I was home earlier, wasn't I?
…… I just had something to do, so I was out for a little bit---"
"Without permission?
You acted like you were out doing something you felt guilty over."
"Uh……"
Her stare is pure ice.
…… This is the second time, and I'm sure even though Akiha looks calm, she is quite angry.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――兄さん。
　有間の家ではどうだったかしらないけど、ここでの門限は午後八時までです。
これは絶対に守ってもらう規則なんです。
　それ以降は屋敷の門を閉めますから、昨夜のようによじのぼって侵入するなんて事はしないでください」
「うっ───知ってたのか、おまえ」
「……あのですね、知っていたもなにも、監視カメラにきっかり映っていました。
　琥珀があわてて警報機を切ったからよかったものの、もし兄さんだって気がつかなかったら今頃留置所の中にいるでしょうね、遠野志貴は」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――Brother.
I do not know what rules the Arima family kept, but curfew here is eight o’clock. That rule is absolute.
The gates are locked after eight, so do not climb over them and break in as you did last night.”
“Urk───you knew?”
“For heaven’s sake, the security cameras caught you perfectly.
Fortunately, Kohaku recognized you and switched off the alarm; otherwise Shiki Tohno would be sitting in a police cell right now.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Nii-san.
I don't know what went on at the Arima house, but here the curfew is eight o'clock.
It is a rule that must not be broken.
The gate will be locked after that, so please don't climb in like a robber."
"Oh---You knew?"

"…… The surveillance camera showed me quite clearly.
It is a good thing Kohaku-san realized it was you and turned off the alarm system because otherwise you would probably be detained right now, Tohno Shiki."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

「……そうか。
そりゃあ琥珀さんに感謝しないといけないな。
　その、秋葉もごめん。
昨日は黙ってでかけて悪かった」
「……わかっていただければいいんです。
これにこりたら門限は厳守してくださいね。
今までのことは大目にみてあげますから」

I shouldn't have kept quiet about it."

I will overlook it this time."

"What is it?"
"…… This is a little hard to say.
I… have something to do tonight too.
I don't know when I will be back, but I'm not going to do anything bad---"

You are her big brother, so please treat her better okay?"
Saying that, she walks after Akiha.
The teacup sits, still steaming.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「───まあ、ようするに」
　一人残されて、冷静に状況を判断する。
「今日は朝メシ抜きっていうことかな」
　うん、間違いない。
　……行きがけにコンビニにでもよって、パンでも買っていくことにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───So, in summary”
Left alone, I assess the situation with perfect objectivity.
“I am not getting breakfast today.”
There is no doubt about it.
I will stop by a convenience store on the way and buy some bread.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Well, in short…"
I'm left by myself to calmly consider my situation.
"I guess I'm skipping breakfast today."
Yeah, no doubt.
…… I should stop by a convenience store on the way and buy some bread.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
とにかく、緊迫した空気を変えねばなるまい。
　いつもの調子では秋葉の無言の圧力に負けてしまいそうなので、ここはちょっと趣向を変えてアプローチをしてみよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whatever else happens, I have to break this suffocating mood.
My usual approach will only crumble under Akiha’s silent pressure, so it is time to try something new.
entries.mirrorMoon:
First of all, I have to change the mood.
It seems like I'll lose to her silent pressure if I act normally, so I'll have to switch my approach.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「グモニー。
いい朝だね、秋葉」
　ＨＡＨＡＨＡ、とフランクな挨拶をしてみた。
「………………」
　心無しか、秋葉の視線はよけいきつくなったようだ。
　……いたい。
　これ以上ここで秋葉の無言の圧力を受けていると、間違いなく胃に穴があく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“G'mornin'. Nice morning, Akiha.”
With a cheery ha-ha-ha, I try my breeziest, most casual greeting.
“…”
If anything, Akiha’s stare grows even harsher.
It hurts.
If I endure any more of Akiha's silent pressure, I am definitely going to develop an ulcer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning," I say to her in English.
"What a great morning, isn't it, Akiha?"
Hahaha.
I greet her frankly.
"………………"
I think she's staring at me harder.
…… Ouch.
If I keep receiving her silent pressure, without a doubt she'll bore a hole right through me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……えっと、それじゃあ俺は朝メシを食べるから食堂に行くぞ」
　そうゆうコトで、と食堂に撤退しようとする。
「――――兄さん」
　ぴしゃり、と秋葉の声が俺の足を止める。
　……ま、逃がしてはくれないか、普通。
「なに？
　何か俺に用でもあるの？」
　この後におよんで白々しくとぼけてみせた。
　秋葉は眉ひとつ動かさない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well then, I am going to the dining room for breakfast.”
With that settled, I attempt a tactical retreat.
“――――Brother.”
Akiha's voice cracks like a whip and stops me cold.
Naturally, she is not going to let me escape.
“What? Did you need something?”
Even now, I brazenly pretend ignorance.
Akiha does not move so much as an eyebrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, I'm going to get some breakfast so I'm off to the dining room."
Yup.
I should retreat to the dining room.
"----Nii-san."
Her voice stops me dead in my tracks.
…… Well, of course she wouldn't let me go like that.
"What?
Did you need anything from me?"
I try and play dumb.
She doesn't even bat an eyelash.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「食事の前に話があります。
どうぞ、ソファーに座ってください」
「……わかった、出来るかぎり手短に頼む」
　ちょこん、と秋葉の向かいのソファーに座る。
　すると琥珀さんが俺の分のティーカップを差し出してくれた。
『頑張ってくださいね』、と琥珀さんの笑顔が言ってくれているようで、少しだけ勇気がわいてくる。
　くっ、と紅茶を一口飲んで、秋葉と視線を合わした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We need to speak before breakfast. Sit on the sofa, please.”
“Fine, but keep it as brief as possible.”
I perch meekly on the sofa opposite her.
Kohaku brings me a cup of tea.
Her smile seems to say, You can do this, and gives me a tiny measure of courage.
I take one bracing sip and meet Akiha's eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I have something to discuss with you before breakfast.
Please, sit there on the sofa."
"…… Got it.
Please keep it as short as possible."
I plop down on the sofa across from her.
Kohaku-san brings me a teacup.
Her smile seems to say "Hang in there, okay?" and I'm able to gather up at least a little courage.
I drink a mouthful of tea and meet her gaze.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「で、話っていうのはなんだ秋葉」
「昨夜の女の方は、兄さんの何なんですか」
　───ごぶっ！
　あぶないあぶない。
　秋葉のヤツ、普段は遠回しな物言いばっかりするクセに、今回はなんて直球なんだ。
　びっくりして、あやうく口に含んだ紅茶を噴射するところだったじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what did you want to discuss, Akiha?”
“What exactly is your relationship with the woman who was here last night?”
───Ghk!
That was close.
Akiha usually speaks in circles; why did she throw such a fastball this time?
That caught me so off guard I almost sprayed tea across the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, what'd you want to talk about, Akiha?"
"That woman last night, just what is she to you?"
---Guh!
That was close.
Akiha's normally so roundabout, but this time she asks straight on.
I'm taken so much by surprise I almost sprayed tea everywhere.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、私の話を聞いてます？」
「聞いてるよ。
うん、よく聞こえてる」
「それでは答えてください。
昨夜のあの女の方は兄さんの何なんですか」
「………何なのかって言われると困るんだけど、その、協力しあってるっていうか、友達っていうか───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, are you listening to me?”
“I am. I can hear you perfectly well.”
“Then answer me. What is that woman to you?”
“That is difficult to answer; we are helping each other, or perhaps we are friends───”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, did you hear me?"
"Yeah, I hear you.
Loud and clear."
"Then please answer.
That woman from last night, just what is she to you, Nii-san?"
"……… Um, that is a troubling question, um, she's a friend, a person I agreed to help---"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「夜中に外にでかけるほどのお友達なんですね。
ええ、私だって兄さんが将来どなたと関係を持とうと意見する気はありませんけど、兄さんはいま学生でしょう？
　遠野家の長男が、その、どこの者ともわからない女性と夜な夜な逢い引きをしているだなんて、そんな恥知らずなコトは止めてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Friends close enough to go out together in the middle of the night, I see. I have no intention of dictating whom you become involved with in the future, but you are still a student, Brother, aren’t you?
The eldest son of the Tohno family holding secret rendezvous night after night with some woman of unknown background—please put an end to such shameless behavior.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A friend so important you had to leave in the middle of the night?
Yes, I don't intend to have to approve of all the relationships you have, but you are in school now, correct?
The eldest son of the Tohno-family, going to places with some strange woman in the middle of the night… please stop doing such shameless things."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
秋葉は話の途中から頬を赤くして目をそらす。
───なるほど、秋葉は俺とアルクェイドがそういう関係だと思っているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Partway through her speech, Akiha’s cheeks redden and she turns away.
───So Akiha thinks Arcueid and I are lovers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As she speaks, her cheeks flush and she looks away.
---I see, Akiha thinks my relationship with Arcueid is like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「待て秋葉。
いっとくけどな、俺とアイツの間には何もないぞ。
ただアイツの探しモノに手を貸してやってるだけなんだ。
用が済めば二度と会わない関係なんだよ、俺たちは」
「へえ。
そのわりにはずいぶんと親しそうでしたけど、それは私の気のせいだって言うんですね、兄さんは」
　秋葉の視線は冷たい。
　……そんなコトはない、なんて嘘を言ってしまえば楽なんだろうけど―――秋葉に嘘を言うのは気が引けるし、なにより、アルクェイドとは親しくないなんていうのは、なんかすっごくイヤだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Akiha, there is nothing between us. I am only helping her find something. Once that is done, we will never see each other again. That is all there is between us.”
“Really? You seemed remarkably close, yet you are telling me I imagined it, Brother?”
Akiha's gaze is cold.
It would be easy to lie and deny it―――but I hate lying to Akiha, and more than anything, I hate the idea of claiming Arcueid and I are not close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait, Akiha.
There's really nothing between us.
I'm just helping her find something.
After that, we won't even see each other again."
"Oh really?
You certainly seem very close.
That must be my imagination, right Nii-san?"
Her gaze is cold.
…… If I lie with something like "That's not it," things will be much easier, but---more than the fact that I don't want to lie to Akiha, I really don't want to say that we aren't close.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――う。
それは、その……秋葉の気のせいじゃ、ないかも」
「でしょうね。
兄さんは今までみた事もないほどあわててたもの。
何事も真剣になってくださらない兄さんが感情を顕にするなんて、どういう風の吹き回しなんでしょうね」
「そんな事はないよ。
ただアイツが家に来るなんてまったくの不意打ちだったから驚いていただけだろ」
「あの女の人は落ち着いた様子で兄さんの事をずっと待ってましたけど」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうに横目で俺を睨む。
　どうも秋葉は俺とアルクェイドが付き合っている、と信じ込んでしまっているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Urk. Well, perhaps you did not imagine it.”
“I thought not. I have never seen you so flustered. You never take anything seriously, so what on earth made you show your feelings so openly?”
“It was not like that. I was only shocked because her arrival at the estate caught me completely off guard.”
“She looked perfectly composed while she waited for you.”
Akiha glares sideways at me.
She seems utterly convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That, may not…… be your imagination, maybe."
"Right.
You were panicking like I've never seen you before.
You were never serious about anything and now you show all this emotion, just what's gotten into you?"
"That's not it.
I was just totally caught off guard that she'd actually come here."
"That woman calmly waited for you the whole time, Nii-san."
She casts a sideways glare at me.
She really seems convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あのな、秋葉。
勘違いもそこまでにしとけよ。
そもそも俺とアイツが知り合ったのは───」
　俺がアイツを殺したからなんだ、と言おうとして口を塞いだ。
　……いくらなんでも本当の事を言うのはあまりにバカげてる。
　かといって他にうまい言い訳も考えつかず、昨夜に引き続きムニャムニャと言葉を濁すしかなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Akiha, that is enough. You have got this all wrong. The whole reason she and I met was───”
I nearly say that I killed her, then clamp my mouth shut.
The truth is far too absurd to tell.
Unable to invent a convincing excuse, I mumble and trail off as I did last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, Akiha.
You're getting it completely wrong.
In the first place, we first met---"
by me killing her, but I swallow the rest of those words.
…… It'll be too stupid to tell the truth.
But I can't even think of a good excuse, and I can only stammer.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「答えられないのでしたら質問を変えましょうか。
さきほどから兄さんはアイツアイツと繰り返していますが、あの人の名前はなんていうんです？」
「……その、アルクェイドっていうんだけど」
「そうですか。
という事はお知り合いになったのは学校ではありませんね。
兄さんの高校には留学生はいませんから」
「……うっ」
　秋葉の言うとおり、うちの高校には外国からの留学生なんてのはいやしない。
　いやしないんだけど、どうして秋葉はそんなことまで知ってるんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you cannot answer, shall I change the question? You have called her ‘that woman’ over and over; what is her name?”
“Her name is Arcueid.”
“I see. Then you did not meet her at school. There are no foreign exchange students at your high school.”
“Urk.”
Akiha is right; our school has no foreign exchange students.
But how does she know even that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you cannot answer then let's change the question.
You've been calling that woman "her" this whole time, what is her name?"
"…… Um, Arcueid."
"I see.
So you did not meet at school.
There are no foreign exchange students at your high school."
"…… Uh."
Like Akiha says, there's no one from overseas at my school.
It's right, but why does she know that much?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「それで、兄さんはあのような方といったいどこで知り合ったんです？」
「街で知り合ったんだよ。
その、偶然」
「ふぅん、偶然ですか。
ではアルクェイドさんの方から声をかけてきたんですね」
「あ───いや、声をかけたのは、俺のほうだけど……」
　実際は声をかけたわけじゃないけど、知り合うきっかけを作ったのはこっちのほうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then where did you meet a woman like her?”
“In town. It was a coincidence.”
“A coincidence, was it? Then Arcueid must have approached you.”
“Ah───no, I was the one who approached her…”
Strictly speaking, I did not call out to her, but I created the occasion for us to meet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So Nii-san, just where in the world did you meet a person like that?"
"In the city.
Just, a coincidence."
"Oh, a coincidence?
Then Arcueid must have talked to you?"
"Ah---No, I was the one, who talked to her……"
Well, not quite talked, but I was the one that initiated our contact.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「どうして声をかけたんです？
　兄さんはアルクェイドさんとは何もないのに。
それとも初めはそういうおつもりだったんですか？」
　秋葉の質問は、実に的確だ。
　一歩ずつ確実にこっちの急所へ近付いてくる。
　これじゃあ蛇に睨まれたカエルみたいなもんで、じき誤魔化しのきかないところまで追い込まれてしまうだろう。
　ここはもう、強引にでも話を終わらせるしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you approach her? You say there’s nothing between you and Arcueid. Or was that what you wanted from the beginning?”
Akiha’s questions are unerringly precise.
Step by step, she is closing in on the most vulnerable point.
I am a frog transfixed by a snake; before long, she will have me cornered where no evasion can save me.
I have no choice but to force an end to this conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why did you talk to her?
I thought Arcueid-san was nothing to you.
Or did you only intend it like that from the beginning?"
Her questions are right on the mark.
Step by step, she draws closer to my secret.
Like a snake staring at a frog, she ignores all my excuses and is trying to drive me into a corner.
I can now only use force to end this conversation.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、とにかくアイツとは何でもないんだって！
　だいたいな、俺が何をしようが秋葉には関係ないだろ。
俺が誰と付き合おうが文句を言われる筋合いはないはずだ」
　びしっ、と秋葉を指差して言い捨てる。
　秋葉はむっ、と顔をしかめた後────すぅ、と音もなく立ち上がった。
「────？」
　……おかしいな。
　てっきり怒鳴り返してくると思ったんだけど、秋葉は逆に気まずそうに視線をそらした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough; there is nothing between us!
Besides, whatever I do is none of your business. You have no right to complain about whom I choose to date.”
I thrust an accusing finger at her and deliver the verdict.
Akiha scowls, then────rises soundlessly to her feet.
“────?”
That is strange.
I expected her to shout back, but instead she looks away, oddly self-conscious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's enough.
I said she's nothing to me!
Besides, whatever I do doesn't concern you.
You don't have any right to complain about who I date, anyway."
I point at her directly.
After giving an angered face----she stands up without a sound.
"----?"
…… That's odd.
I thought she would yell back at me, but instead she appears very uncomfortable and looks away.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……私だって、こんな事を言いたくありません。
ただ、あの人は厭な感じがするんです。
　他の相手なら仕方がないって諦める。
けど、兄さんがあの人に懸想しているっていうんなら、なんだか私が罵迦みたいじゃないですか」
　……どうしてだろう。
　秋葉は悔しそうに、唇をかんで、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not want to say any of this either. There is simply something about that woman I cannot stand.
If it were anyone else, I would accept it and give up. But if you have truly fallen for her, then I feel like an utter fool.”
Why?
Akiha bites her lip and says it, looking bitterly frustrated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Even I, didn't want to say this.
But it's just, I get a bad feeling from her.
If it was anyone else, I would just be resigned to it.
But, for you to be ensnared by her, doesn't that make me just a big fool?"
…… I don't know why.
But she regretfully bites her lip as she says these words.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「だから、俺とアイツは別にそういう関係じゃないって言ってるだろ。
どうしたんだ秋葉、なんだかおまえおかしいぞ」
「もういいですっ。
兄さんは兄さんのなさりたいよう、ご自由になさってください……！」
　ズカズカと乱暴な足音をたてて、秋葉はロビーへと去っていく。
「………？」
　もう、まるっきりワケがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I keep telling you she and I are not like that, so what has gotten into you, Akiha? You are acting strange.”
“Enough! Do whatever you please, Brother…!”
Akiha stamps away into the lobby, every footfall sharp with anger.
“…?”
I don’t understand any of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why I'm saying she's nothing special.
What's wrong Akiha, you seem a little strange."
"That's enough.
If you want to do as you please, then feel free, Nii-san……!"
Akiha storms noisily out the lobby.
"………?"
I don't understand anything at all.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「もう。
志貴さん、今のはひどいですよ」
　琥珀さんはがっかりとため息をついて歩きだす。
「秋葉さまがおかわいそうです。
恋人を連れてくるのでしたら、もっと普通のひとを連れて来てあげてくださいな。
そうすれば秋葉さまも納得してくださったでしょうに」
　琥珀さんは秋葉の後を追いかけるようにロビーへと去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Master Shiki, that was cruel.”
Kohaku sighs in disappointment and starts after her.
“I feel so sorry for Miss Akiha. If you intend to bring home a lover, you should at least choose someone a little more ordinary. Then perhaps Miss Akiha could have accepted her.”
Kohaku leaves for the lobby, hurrying after Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Shiki-san, that was horrible of you."
Kohaku-san gives a disappointed sigh and starts walking after her.
"Poor Akiha-sama.
If you are going to bring your lover, please bring someone more normal.
If you did that, Akiha-sama would have understood."
Kohaku-san disappears towards the lobby after Akiha.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……と言っても、秋葉の威圧感はいままでの比じゃない。
　凍った炎っていうか、ともかく、下手な事をいったとたんにすごいカウンターが返ってきそうだ。
　ここは一つ、大人しく反省している態度を示そう。
「―――おはよう秋葉。
今朝も早いんだな」
　静かに、できるだけ柔らかな口調で挨拶をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Still, Akiha's presence is more oppressive than ever.
She is like a flame burning inside ice; one wrong word and I am liable to be flattened by the counterattack.
I should sit quietly and show her that I am properly contrite.
“―――Good morning, Akiha. You are up early again.”
I greet her quietly, keeping my voice as gentle as possible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I say that, but her pressure is now on a completely different level than before.
If I say anything wrong in the face of this frozen heat, she will give a devastating counter.
I'll show a calm, reflective manner.
"---Good morning, Akiha.
You're up early as usual."
I say this quietly and as gently as possible.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
昨夜の一件が後を引いてしまって、一睡もできませんでしたから」
　口元に笑みさえうかべて、とんでもない事を言ってくる。
　……これは、本当にまずい。
　怒っていながらあんなふうに笑えるなんて、秋葉のヤツとても正気とは思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. What happened last night left me too upset to sleep a wink.”
She says this appalling thing with an actual smile on her lips.
This is truly bad.
Anyone who can smile like that while seething with rage cannot possibly be sane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Thanks to what happened last night, I was unable to sleep at all."
She says something so outrageous while still smiling sweetly.
…… This, really isn't good.
She can't be sane, being so angry yet smiling like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
そりゃあ、気の毒なんで、お大事にしてほしいな、とか」
　君子あやうに近寄らず。
　なんとかうまいことを言って居間から離脱しなくてはなるまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. That is a shame; do take care of yourself.”
Discretion is the better part of valor.
I need to find the right excuse and get out of this sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh.
Well, I hope you feel a little better, or something."
I should stay away from danger.
I have to say something and then escape from here.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「えっと、それじゃあ俺は朝食があるから食堂に行くよ」
　そうゆうコトで、と食堂に撤退しようとする。
「――――兄さん」
　ぴしゃり、と秋葉の声が俺の足を止める。
　……ま、逃がしてはくれないか、普通。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I’ve got breakfast waiting, so I’d better get to the dining room.”
And with that, I attempt a strategic retreat.
“――――Brother.”
Akiha's voice cracks like a whip and stops me in my tracks.
Of course she was not going to let me escape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, then I'll be off to have some breakfast in the dining room."
Yup.
I should retreat to the dining room.
"----Nii-san."
Her voice stops me dead in my tracks.
…… Well, of course she wouldn't let me go like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
なんでしょう、秋葉さん」
　ちなみに『さん』を付けるのは、白旗をあげているという意思表示だ。
　秋葉は眉ひとつ動かさない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, ma'am. What is it, Akiha?”
The ma'am is my way of raising a white flag.
Akiha does not so much as twitch an eyebrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
What is it, Akiha-san?"
By the way, adding "san" to her name means waving my white flag.
She doesn't even bat an eyelash.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「食事の前に話があります。
どうぞ、ソファーに座ってください」
「……わかった、出来るかぎり手短に頼む」
　ちょこん、と秋葉の向かいのソファーに座る。
　すると琥珀さんが俺の分のティーカップを差し出してくれた。
『頑張ってくださいね』、と琥珀さんの笑顔が言ってくれているようで、少しだけ勇気がわいてくる。
　くっ、と紅茶を一口飲んで、秋葉と視線を合わした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We need to speak before breakfast. Sit on the sofa, please.”
“Fine, but keep it as brief as possible.”
I perch meekly on the sofa opposite her.
Kohaku brings me a cup of tea.
Her smile seems to say, You can do this, and gives me a tiny measure of courage.
I take one bracing sip and meet Akiha's eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I have something to discuss with you before breakfast.
Please, sit there on the sofa."
"…… Got it.
Please keep it as short as possible."
I plop down on the sofa across from her.
Kohaku-san brings me a teacup.
Her smile seems to say "Hang in there, okay?" and I'm able to gather up at least a little courage.
I drink a mouthful of tea and meet her gaze.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「で、話っていうのはなんだ秋葉」
「昨夜の女の方は、兄さんの何なんですか」
　───ごぶっ！
　あぶないあぶない。
　秋葉のヤツ、普段は遠回しな物言いばっかりするクセに、今回はなんて直球なんだ。
　びっくりして、あやうく口に含んだ紅茶を噴射するところだったじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what did you want to discuss, Akiha?”
“What exactly is your relationship with the woman who was here last night?”
───Ghk!
That was close.
Akiha usually speaks in circles; why did she throw such a fastball this time?
That caught me so off guard I almost sprayed tea across the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, what'd you want to talk about, Akiha?"
"That woman last night, just what is she to you?"
---Guh!
That was close.
Akiha's normally so roundabout, but this time she asks straight on.
I'm taken so much by surprise I almost sprayed tea everywhere.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、私の話を聞いてます？」
「聞いてるよ。
うん、よく聞こえてる」
「それでは答えてください。
昨夜のあの女の方は兄さんの何なんですか」
「………何なのかって言われると困るんだけど、その、協力しあってるっていうか、友達っていうか───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, are you listening to me?”
“I am. I can hear you perfectly well.”
“Then answer me. What is that woman to you?”
“That is difficult to answer; we are helping each other, or perhaps we are friends───”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, did you hear me?"
"Yeah, I hear you.
Loud and clear."
"Then please answer.
That woman from last night, just what is she to you, Nii-san?"
"……… Um, that is a troubling question, um, she's a friend, a person I agreed to help---"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「夜中に外にでかけるほどのお友達なんですね。
ええ、私だって兄さんが将来どなたと関係を持とうと意見する気はありませんけど、兄さんはいま学生でしょう？
　遠野家の長男が、その、どこの者ともわからない女性と夜な夜な逢い引きをしているだなんて、そんな恥知らずなコトは止めてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Friends close enough to go out together in the middle of the night, I see. I have no intention of dictating whom you become involved with in the future, but you are still a student, Brother, aren’t you?
The eldest son of the Tohno family holding secret rendezvous night after night with some woman of unknown background—please put an end to such shameless behavior.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A friend so important you had to leave in the middle of the night?
Yes, I don't intend to have to approve of all the relationships you have, but you are in school now, correct?
The eldest son of the Tohno-family, going to places with some strange woman in the middle of the night… please stop doing such shameless things."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
秋葉は話の途中から頬を赤くして目をそらす。
───なるほど、秋葉は俺とアルクェイドがそういう関係だと思っているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Partway through her speech, Akiha’s cheeks redden and she turns away.
───So Akiha thinks Arcueid and I are lovers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As she speaks, her cheeks flush and she looks away.
---I see, Akiha thinks my relationship with Arcueid is like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「待て秋葉。
いっとくけどな、俺とアイツの間には何もないぞ。
ただアイツの探しモノに手を貸してやってるだけなんだ。
用が済めば二度と会わない関係なんだよ、俺たちは」
「へえ。
そのわりにはずいぶんと親しそうでしたけど、それは私の気のせいだって言うんですね、兄さんは」
　秋葉の視線は冷たい。
　……そんなコトはない、なんて嘘を言ってしまえば楽なんだろうけど―――秋葉に嘘を言うのは気が引けるし、なにより、アルクェイドとは親しくないなんていうのは、なんかすっごくイヤだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Akiha, there is nothing between us. I am only helping her find something. Once that is done, we will never see each other again. That is all there is between us.”
“Really? You seemed remarkably close, yet you are telling me I imagined it, Brother?”
Akiha's gaze is cold.
It would be easy to lie and deny it―――but I hate lying to Akiha, and more than anything, I hate the idea of claiming Arcueid and I are not close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait Akiha.
There's really nothing between us.
I'm just helping her find something.
After that, we won't even see each other again."
"Oh really?
You certainly seem very close.
That must be my imagination, right Nii-san?"
Her gaze is cold.
…… If I lie with something like "That's not it," things will be much easier, but---more than the fact that I don't want to lie to Akiha, I really don't want to say that we aren't close.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――う。
それは、その……秋葉の気のせいじゃ、ないかも」
「でしょうね。
兄さんは今まで見た事もないほど慌ててたもの。
何事も真剣になってくださらない兄さんが感情を顕にするなんて、どういう風の吹き回しなんでしょうね」
「そんな事はないよ。
ただアイツが家に来るなんてまったくの不意打ちだったから驚いていただけだろ」
「あの女の人は落ち着いた様子で兄さんの事をずっと待ってましたけど」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうに横目で俺を睨む。
　どうも秋葉は俺とアルクェイドが付き合っている、と信じ込んでしまっているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Urk. Well, perhaps you did not imagine it.”
“I thought not. I have never seen you so flustered. You never take anything seriously, so what on earth made you show your feelings so openly?”
“It was not like that. I was only shocked because her arrival at the estate caught me completely off guard.”
“She looked perfectly composed while she waited for you.”
Akiha glares sideways at me.
She seems utterly convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That, may not…… be your imagination, maybe."
"Right.
You were panicking like I've never seen you before.
You were never serious about anything and now you show all this emotion, just what's gotten into you?"
"That's not it.
I was just totally caught off guard that she'd actually come here."
"That woman calmly waited for you the whole time, Nii-san."
She casts a sideways glare at me.
She really seems convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あのな、秋葉。
勘違いもそこまでにしとけよ。
そもそも俺とアイツが知り合ったのは───」
　俺がアイツを殺したからなんだ、と言おうとして口を塞いだ。
　……いくらなんでも本当の事を言うのはあまりにバカげてる。
　かといって他にうまい言い訳も考えつかず、昨夜に引き続きムニャムニャと言葉を濁すしかなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Akiha, that is enough. You have got this all wrong. The whole reason she and I met was───”
I nearly say that I killed her, then clamp my mouth shut.
The truth is far too absurd to tell.
Unable to invent a convincing excuse, I mumble and trail off as I did last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, Akiha.
You're getting it completely wrong.
In the first place, we first met---"
by me killing her, but I swallow the rest of those words.
…… It'll be too stupid to tell the truth.
But I can't even think of a good excuse, and I can only stammer.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「答えられないのでしたら質問を変えましょうか。
さきほどから兄さんはアイツアイツと繰り返していますが、あの人の名前はなんていうんです？」
「……その、アルクェイドっていうんだけど」
「そうですか。
という事はお知り合いになったのは学校ではありませんね。
兄さんの高校には留学生はいませんから」
「……うっ」
　秋葉の言うとおり、うちの高校には外国からの留学生なんてのはいやしない。
　いやしないんだけど、どうして秋葉はそんなことまで知ってるんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you cannot answer, shall I change the question? You have called her ‘that woman’ over and over; what is her name?”
“Her name is Arcueid.”
“I see. Then you did not meet her at school. There are no foreign exchange students at your high school.”
“Urk.”
Akiha is right; our school has no foreign exchange students.
But how does she know even that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you cannot answer then let's change the question.
You've been calling that woman "her" this whole time, what is her name?"
"…… Um, Arcueid."
"I see.
So you did not meet at school.
There are no foreign exchange students at your high school."
"…… Uh."
Like Akiha says, there's no one from overseas at my school.
It's right, but why does she know that much?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「それで、兄さんはあのような方といったいどこで知り合ったんです？」
「街で知り合ったんだよ。
その、偶然」
「ふぅん、偶然ですか。
ではアルクェイドさんの方から声をかけてきたんですね」
「あ───いや、声をかけたのは、俺のほうだけど……」
　実際は声をかけたわけじゃないけど、知り合うきっかけを作ったのはこっちのほうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then where did you meet a woman like her?”
“In town. It was a coincidence.”
“A coincidence, was it? Then Arcueid must have approached you.”
“Ah───no, I was the one who approached her…”
Strictly speaking, I did not call out to her, but I created the occasion for us to meet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So Nii-san, just where in the world did you meet a person like that?"
"In the city.
Just, a coincidence."
"Oh, a coincidence?
Then Arcueid must have talked to you?"
"Ah---No, I was the one, who talked to her……"
Well, not quite talked, but I was the one that initiated our contact.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「どうして声をかけたんです？
　兄さんはアルクェイドさんとは何もないのに。
それとも初めはそういうおつもりだったんですか？」
　秋葉の質問は、実に的確だ。
　一歩ずつ確実にこっちの急所へ近付いてくる。
　これじゃあ蛇に睨まれたカエルみたいなもんで、じき誤魔化しのきかないところまで追い込まれてしまうだろう。
　ここはもう、強引にでも話を終わらせるしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you approach her? You say there’s nothing between you and Arcueid. Or was that what you wanted from the beginning?”
Akiha’s questions are unerringly precise.
Step by step, she is closing in on the most vulnerable point.
I am a frog transfixed by a snake; before long, she will have me cornered where no evasion can save me.
I have no choice but to force an end to this conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why did you talk to her?
I thought Arcueid-san was nothing to you.
Or did you only intend it like that from the beginning?"
Her questions are right on the mark.
Step by step, she draws closer to my secret.
Like a snake staring at a frog, she ignores all my excuses and is trying to drive me into a corner.
I can now only use force to end this conversation.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、とにかくアイツとは何でもないんだって！
　だいたいな、俺が何をしようが秋葉には関係ないだろ。
俺が誰と付き合おうが文句を言われる筋合いはないはずだ」
　びしっ、と秋葉を指差して言い捨てる。
　秋葉はむっ、と顔をしかめた後────すぅ、と音もなく立ち上がった。
「────？」
　……おかしいな。
　てっきり怒鳴り返してくると思ったんだけど、秋葉は逆に気まずそうに視線をそらした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough; there is nothing between us!
Besides, whatever I do is none of your business. You have no right to complain about whom I choose to date.”
I thrust an accusing finger at her and deliver the verdict.
Akiha scowls, then────rises soundlessly to her feet.
“────?”
That is strange.
I expected her to shout back, but instead she looks away, oddly self-conscious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's enough.
I said she's nothing to me!
Besides, whatever I do doesn't concern you.
You don't have any right to complain about who I date, anyway."
I point at her directly.
After giving an angered face---she stands up without a sound.
"----?"
…… That's odd.
I thought she would yell back at me, but instead she appears very uncomfortable and looks away.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……私だって、こんな事を言いたくありません。
ただ、あの人は厭な感じがするんです。
　他の相手なら仕方がないって諦める。
けど、兄さんがあの人に懸想しているっていうんなら、なんだか私が罵迦みたいじゃないですか」
　……どうしてだろう。
　秋葉は悔しそうに、唇をかんで、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not want to say any of this either. There is simply something about that woman I cannot stand.
If it were anyone else, I would accept it and give up. But if you have truly fallen for her, then I feel like an utter fool.”
Why?
Akiha bites her lip and says it, looking bitterly frustrated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Even I, didn't want to say this.
But it's just, I get a bad feeling from her.
If it was anyone else, I would just be resigned to it.
But, for you to be ensnared by her, doesn't that make me just a big fool?"
…… I don't know why.
But she regretfully bites her lip as she says these words.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「だから、俺とアイツは別にそういう関係じゃないって言ってるだろ。
どうしたんだ秋葉、なんだかおまえおかしいぞ」
「もういいですっ。
兄さんは兄さんのなさりたいよう、ご自由になさってください……！」
　ズカズカと乱暴な足音をたてて、秋葉はロビーへと去っていく。
「………？」
　もう、まるっきりワケがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I keep telling you she and I are not like that, so what has gotten into you, Akiha? You are acting strange.”
“Enough! Do whatever you please, Brother…!”
Akiha stamps away into the lobby, every footfall sharp with anger.
“…?”
I don’t understand any of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why I'm saying she's nothing special.
What's wrong Akiha, you seem a little strange."
"That's enough.
If you want to do as you please, then feel free, Nii-san……!"
Akiha storms noisily out the lobby.
"………?"
I don't understand anything at all.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「もう。
志貴さん、今のはひどいですよ」
　琥珀さんはがっかりとため息をついて歩きだす。
「秋葉さまがおかわいそうです。
恋人を連れてくるのでしたら、もっと普通のひとを連れて来てあげてくださいな。
そうすれば秋葉さまも納得してくださったでしょうに」
　琥珀さんは秋葉の後を追いかけるようにロビーへと去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Master Shiki, that was cruel.”
Kohaku sighs in disappointment and starts after her.
“I feel so sorry for Miss Akiha. If you intend to bring home a lover, you should at least choose someone a little more ordinary. Then perhaps Miss Akiha could have accepted her.”
Kohaku leaves for the lobby, hurrying after Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Shiki-san, that was horrible of you."
Kohaku-san gives a disappointed sigh and starts walking after her.
"Poor Akiha-sama.
If you are going to bring your lover, please bring someone more normal.
If you did that, Akiha-sama would have understood."
Kohaku-san disappears towards the lobby after Akiha.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
昨夜の事は、もうどうあっても言い逃れはできない事だ。
　かくなる上は秋葉が何か言ってくる前に謝って、事をうやむやにするしか方法はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no possible way to talk my way out of what happened last night.
My only chance is to apologize before Akiha says anything and somehow make the whole thing go away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No matter what, I can't talk myself out of what happened last night.
The only method I have left is to apologize before Akiha can do anything.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、昨夜のことだけど、あれは―――」
「兄さん、一つだけ忠告してよろしいですか？」
―――と。
　こっちが謝る前に、秋葉はぞっとするぐらい怖い声で俺の言葉をさえぎった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, about last night, that was―――”
“Brother, may I offer you one piece of advice?”
―――At that moment.
Before I can apologize, Akiha cuts me off in a voice chilling enough to make my blood run cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, about last night, that---"
"Nii-san, can I warn you about something?"
---And then,
before I can apologize, Akiha speaks those words in a frightening voice.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「兄さんは遠野家の長男なんですから、いたずらに謝罪の言葉は口になさらないほうがいいですよ。
　謝る、という事は自分が悪い、と認める事です。
　その場合、遠野家の長男に相応の罰則を与えなくてはいけなくなるでしょう？」
「―――――えっと、秋葉、それは」
「私、兄さんにそんな事をしたくないんです。
ですから兄さん？
　私、これから素晴らしい弁明を聞かせてもらえるって期待してるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“As the eldest son of the Tohno family, you should not offer apologies lightly, because an apology admits that you are at fault.
In that event, I would be obliged to impose a punishment befitting the eldest son of this family. Would I not?”
“―――――Um, Akiha, that is…”
“I have no wish to do such a thing to you. So tell me, Brother: what is your defense? I am looking forward to hearing something splendid.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You are the eldest son of the Tohno family, so it is better if you do not apologize for wayward actions.
Apologizing is admitting you did something wrong.
In that situation, the eldest son has to receive a proper punishment, yes?"
"-----Um, Akiha, well…"
"Nii-san, I don't want to have to do that to you.
So Nii-san, I'm waiting for a wonderful excuse."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……あくまだ。
　ここにあくまがいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
A demon.
There is a demon in this room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… A devil.
I see a devil.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、その前に朝食をとりに食堂に行きたいんだけど、いいかな」
　そろそろと食堂に撤退する。
「――――兄さん」
　ぴしゃり、と秋葉の声が俺の足を止める。
　うぅ……。
どうあっても秋葉は逃がしてはくれないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, before that, could I go to the dining room and have breakfast?”
I begin edging toward the dining room.
“――――Brother.”
Akiha's voice cracks like a whip and stops me in my tracks.
Ugh… She plainly has no intention of letting me escape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, before that, I'd like to eat some breakfast in the dining room.
Is that okay?"
I retreat to the dining room.
"----Nii-san."
Her voice stops me dead in my tracks.
Uh-oh…… whatever happens, it seems like she won't let me get away.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「食事の前に話があります。
どうぞ、ソファーに座ってください」
「……わかった、出来るかぎり手短に頼む」
　ちょこん、と秋葉の向かいのソファーに座る。
　すると琥珀さんが俺の分のティーカップを差し出してくれた。
『頑張ってくださいね』、と琥珀さんの笑顔が言ってくれているようで、少しだけ勇気がわいてくる。
　くっ、と紅茶を一口飲んで、秋葉と視線を合わした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We need to speak before breakfast. Sit on the sofa, please.”
“Fine, but keep it as brief as possible.”
I perch meekly on the sofa opposite her.
Kohaku brings me a cup of tea.
Her smile seems to say, You can do this, and gives me a tiny measure of courage.
I take one bracing sip and meet Akiha's eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I have something to discuss with you before breakfast.
Please, sit there on the sofa."
"…… Got it.
Please keep it as short as possible."
I plop down on the sofa across from her.
Kohaku-san brings me a teacup.
Her smile seems to say "Hang in there, okay?" and I'm able to gather up at least a little courage.
I drink a mouthful of tea and meet her gaze.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「で、話っていうのはなんだ秋葉」
「昨夜の女の方は、兄さんの何なんですか」
　───ごぶっ！
　あぶないあぶない。
　秋葉のヤツ、普段は遠回しな物言いばっかりするクセに、今回はなんて直球なんだ。
　びっくりして、あやうく口に含んだ紅茶を噴射するところだったじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what did you want to discuss, Akiha?”
“What exactly is your relationship with the woman who was here last night?”
───Ghk!
That was close.
Akiha usually speaks in circles; why did she throw such a fastball this time?
That caught me so off guard I almost sprayed tea across the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, what'd you want to talk about, Akiha?"
"That woman last night, just what is she to you?"
---Guh!!
That was close.
Akiha's normally so roundabout, but this time she asks straight on.
I'm taken so much by surprise I almost sprayed tea everywhere.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、私の話を聞いてます？」
「聞いてるよ。
うん、よく聞こえてる」
「それでは答えてください。
昨夜のあの女の方は兄さんの何なんですか」
「………何なのかって言われると困るんだけど、その、協力しあってるっていうか、友達っていうか───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, are you listening to me?”
“I am. I can hear you perfectly well.”
“Then answer me. What is that woman to you?”
“That is difficult to answer; we are helping each other, or perhaps we are friends───”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, did you hear me?"
"Yeah, I hear you.
Loud and clear."
"Then please answer.
That woman from last night, just what is she to you, Nii-san?"
"……… Um, that is a troubling question, um, she's a friend, a person I agreed to help---"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「夜中に外にでかけるほどのお友達なんですね。
ええ、私だって兄さんが将来どなたと関係を持とうと意見する気はありませんけど、兄さんはいま学生でしょう？
　遠野家の長男が、その、どこの者ともわからない女性と夜な夜な逢い引きをしているだなんて、そんな恥知らずなコトは止めてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Friends close enough to go out together in the middle of the night, I see. I have no intention of dictating whom you become involved with in the future, but you are still a student, Brother, aren’t you?
The eldest son of the Tohno family holding secret rendezvous night after night with some woman of unknown background—please put an end to such shameless behavior.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A friend so important you had to leave in the middle of the night?
Yes, I don't intend to have to approve of all the relationships you have, but you are in school now, correct?
The eldest son of the Tohno-family, going to places with some strange woman in the middle of the night… please stop doing such shameless things."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
秋葉は話の途中から頬を赤くして目をそらす。
───なるほど、秋葉は俺とアルクェイドがそういう関係だと思っているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Partway through her speech, Akiha’s cheeks redden and she turns away.
───So Akiha thinks Arcueid and I are lovers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As she speaks, her cheeks flush and she looks away.
---I see, Akiha thinks my relationship with Arcueid is like that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「待て秋葉。
いっとくけどな、俺とアイツの間には何もないぞ。
ただアイツの探しモノに手を貸してやってるだけなんだ。
用が済めば二度と会わない関係なんだよ、俺たちは」
「へえ。
そのわりにはずいぶんと親しそうでしたけど、それは私の気のせいだって言うんですね、兄さんは」
　秋葉の視線は冷たい。
　……そんなコトはない、なんて嘘を言ってしまえば楽なんだろうけど―――秋葉に嘘を言うのは気が引けるし、なにより、アルクェイドとは親しくないなんていうのは、なんかすっごくイヤだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Akiha, there is nothing between us. I am only helping her find something. Once that is done, we will never see each other again. That is all there is between us.”
“Really? You seemed remarkably close, yet you are telling me I imagined it, Brother?”
Akiha's gaze is cold.
It would be easy to lie and deny it―――but I hate lying to Akiha, and more than anything, I hate the idea of claiming Arcueid and I are not close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait Akiha.
There's really nothing between us.
I'm just helping her find something.
After that, we won't even see each other again."
"Oh really?
You certainly seem very close.
That must be my imagination, right Nii-san?"
Her gaze is cold.
…… If I lie with something like "That's not it," things will be much easier, but---more than the fact that I don't want to lie to Akiha, I really don't want to say that we aren't close.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――う。
それは、その……秋葉の気のせいじゃ、ないかも」
「でしょうね。
兄さんは今までみた事もないほどあわててたもの。
何事も真剣になってくださらない兄さんが感情を顕にするなんて、どういう風の吹き回しなんでしょうね」
「そんな事はないよ。
ただアイツが家に来るなんてまったくの不意打ちだったから驚いていただけだろ」
「あの女の人は落ち着いた様子で兄さんの事をずっと待ってましたけど」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうに横目で俺を睨む。
　どうも秋葉は俺とアルクェイドが付き合っている、と信じ込んでしまっているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Urk. Well, perhaps you did not imagine it.”
“I thought not. I have never seen you so flustered. You never take anything seriously, so what on earth made you show your feelings so openly?”
“It was not like that. I was only shocked because her arrival at the estate caught me completely off guard.”
“She looked perfectly composed while she waited for you.”
Akiha glares sideways at me.
She seems utterly convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That, may not…… be your imagination, maybe."
"Right.
You were panicking like I've never seen you before.
You were never serious about anything and now you show all this emotion, just what's gotten into you?"
"That's not it.
I was just totally caught off guard that she'd actually come here."
"That woman calmly waited for you the whole time, Nii-san."
She casts a sideways glare at me.
She really seems convinced that Arcueid and I are dating.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あのな、秋葉。
勘違いもそこまでにしとけよ。
そもそも俺とアイツが知り合ったのは───」
　俺がアイツを殺したからなんだ、と言おうとして口を塞いだ。
　……いくらなんでも本当の事を言うのはあまりにバカげてる。
　かといって他にうまい言い訳も考えつかず、昨夜に引き続きムニャムニャと言葉を濁すしかなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Akiha, that is enough. You have got this all wrong. The whole reason she and I met was───”
I nearly say that I killed her, then clamp my mouth shut.
The truth is far too absurd to tell.
Unable to invent a convincing excuse, I mumble and trail off as I did last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, Akiha.
You're getting it completely wrong.
In the first place, we first met---"
by me killing her, but I swallow the rest of those words.
…… It'll be too stupid to tell the truth.
But I can't even think of a good excuse, and I can only stammer.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「答えられないのでしたら質問を変えましょうか。
さきほどから兄さんはアイツアイツと繰り返していますが、あの人の名前はなんていうんです？」
「……その、アルクェイドっていうんだけど」
「そうですか。
という事はお知り合いになったのは学校ではありませんね。
兄さんの高校には留学生はいませんから」
「……うっ」
　秋葉の言うとおり、うちの高校には外国からの留学生なんてのはいやしない。
　いやしないんだけど、どうして秋葉はそんなことまで知ってるんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you cannot answer, shall I change the question? You have called her ‘that woman’ over and over; what is her name?”
“Her name is Arcueid.”
“I see. Then you did not meet her at school. There are no foreign exchange students at your high school.”
“Urk.”
Akiha is right; our school has no foreign exchange students.
But how does she know even that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you cannot answer then let's change the question.
You've been calling that woman "her" this whole time, what is her name?"
"…… Um, Arcueid."
"I see.
So you did not meet at school.
There are no foreign exchange students at your high school."
"…… Uh."
Like Akiha says, there's no one from overseas at my school.
It's right, but why does she know that much?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「それで、兄さんはあのような方といったいどこで知り合ったんです？」
「街で知り合ったんだよ。
その、偶然」
「ふぅん、偶然ですか。
ではアルクェイドさんの方から声をかけてきたんですね」
「あ───いや、声をかけたのは、俺のほうだけど……」
　実際は声をかけたわけじゃないけど、知り合うきっかけを作ったのはこっちのほうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then where did you meet a woman like her?”
“In town. It was a coincidence.”
“A coincidence, was it? Then Arcueid must have approached you.”
“Ah───no, I was the one who approached her…”
Strictly speaking, I did not call out to her, but I created the occasion for us to meet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So Nii-san, just where in the world did you meet a person like that?"
"In the city.
Just, a coincidence."
"Oh, a coincidence?
Then Arcueid must have talked to you?"
"Ah---No, I was the one, who talked to her……"
Well, not quite talked, but I was the one that initiated our contact.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「どうして声をかけたんです？
　兄さんはアルクェイドさんとは何もないのに。
それとも初めはそういうおつもりだったんですか？」
　秋葉の質問は、実に的確だ。
　一歩ずつ確実にこっちの急所へ近付いてくる。
　これじゃあ蛇に睨まれたカエルみたいなもんで、じき誤魔化しのきかないところまで追い込まれてしまうだろう。
　ここはもう、強引にでも話を終わらせるしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you approach her? You say there’s nothing between you and Arcueid. Or was that what you wanted from the beginning?”
Akiha’s questions are unerringly precise.
Step by step, she is closing in on the most vulnerable point.
I am a frog transfixed by a snake; before long, she will have me cornered where no evasion can save me.
I have no choice but to force an end to this conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why did you talk to her?
I thought Arcueid-san was nothing to you.
Or did you only intend it like that from the beginning?"
Her questions are right on the mark.
Step by step, she draws closer to my secret.
Like a snake staring at a frog, she ignores all my excuses and is trying to drive me into a corner.
I can now only use force to end this conversation.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、とにかくアイツとは何でもないんだって！
　だいたいな、俺が何をしようが秋葉には関係ないだろ。
俺が誰と付き合おうが文句を言われる筋合いはないはずだ」
　びしっ、と秋葉を指差して言い捨てる。
　秋葉はむっ、と顔をしかめた後────すぅ、と音もなく立ち上がった。
「────？」
　……おかしいな。
　てっきり怒鳴り返してくると思ったんだけど、秋葉は逆に気まずそうに視線をそらした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough; there is nothing between us!
Besides, whatever I do is none of your business. You have no right to complain about whom I choose to date.”
I thrust an accusing finger at her and deliver the verdict.
Akiha scowls, then────rises soundlessly to her feet.
“────?”
That is strange.
I expected her to shout back, but instead she looks away, oddly self-conscious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's enough.
I said she's nothing to me!
Besides, whatever I do doesn't concern you.
You don't have any right to complain about who I date, anyway."
I point at her directly.
After giving an angered face----she stands up without a sound.
"----?"
…… That's odd.
I thought she would yell back at me, but instead she appears very uncomfortable and looks away.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……私だって、こんな事を言いたくありません。
ただ、あの人は厭な感じがするんです。
　他の相手なら仕方がないって諦める。
けど、兄さんがあの人に懸想しているっていうんなら、なんだか私が罵迦みたいじゃないですか」
　……どうしてだろう。
　秋葉は悔しそうに、唇をかんで、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not want to say any of this either. There is simply something about that woman I cannot stand.
If it were anyone else, I would accept it and give up. But if you have truly fallen for her, then I feel like an utter fool.”
Why?
Akiha bites her lip and says it, looking bitterly frustrated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Even I, didn't want to say this.
But it's just, I get a bad feeling from her.
If it was anyone else, I would just be resigned to it.
But, for you to be ensnared by her, doesn't that make me just a big fool?"
…… I don't know why.
But she regretfully bites her lip as she says these words.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「だから、俺とアイツは別にそういう関係じゃないって言ってるだろ。
どうしたんだ秋葉、なんだかおまえおかしいぞ」
「もういいですっ。
兄さんは兄さんのなさりたいよう、ご自由になさってください……！」
　ズカズカと乱暴な足音をたてて、秋葉はロビーへと去っていく。
「………？」
　もう、まるっきりワケがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I keep telling you she and I are not like that, so what has gotten into you, Akiha? You are acting strange.”
“Enough! Do whatever you please, Brother…!”
Akiha stamps away into the lobby, every footfall sharp with anger.
“…?”
I don’t understand any of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why I'm saying she's nothing special.
What's wrong Akiha, you seem a little strange."
"That's enough.
If you want to do as you please, then feel free, Nii-san……!"
Akiha storms noisily out the lobby.
"………?"
I don't understand anything at all.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「もう。
志貴さん、今のはひどいですよ」
　琥珀さんはがっかりとため息をついて歩きだす。
「秋葉さまがおかわいそうです。
恋人を連れてくるのでしたら、もっと普通のひとを連れて来てあげてくださいな。
そうすれば秋葉さまも納得してくださったでしょうに」
　琥珀さんは秋葉の後を追いかけるようにロビーへと去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Master Shiki, that was cruel.”
Kohaku sighs in disappointment and starts after her.
“I feel so sorry for Miss Akiha. If you intend to bring home a lover, you should at least choose someone a little more ordinary. Then perhaps Miss Akiha could have accepted her.”
Kohaku leaves for the lobby, hurrying after Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Shiki-san, that was horrible of you."
Kohaku-san gives a disappointed sigh and starts walking after her.
"Poor Akiha-sama.
If you are going to bring your lover, please bring someone more normal.
If you did that, Akiha-sama would have understood."
Kohaku-san disappears towards the lobby after Akiha.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
四時限目の授業は現代社会だ。
　昼休み前ということで教室の雰囲気はどこか浮き足だっている。
　今日は水曜日だから、授業はいつもより一時間少ない。
　昼休みが終わったあとの授業はホームルームで、一時間かけて文化祭の出し物を決める、とのことだ。
　くわえて明日は学校の創立記念日で休みなものだから、この四時限目が終われば、あとは休みに突入したも同然なのである。
　クラスの連中が今か今かと終了のベルを待っているのは当然といえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Fourth period is Contemporary Society.
With lunch so close, the whole classroom has grown restless.
It is Wednesday, so we have one fewer lesson than usual.
After lunch comes homeroom, when we are supposedly spending an hour choosing our class project for the cultural festival.
Better still, tomorrow is the school’s founding anniversary, so once fourth period ends, the holiday has effectively begun.
No wonder everyone is waiting so eagerly for the bell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Fourth period class is about modern society.
The mood in the classroom is somewhat lighter than usual before lunch.
Today is Wednesday, so there's one less hour of classes than usual.
After lunch, there's homeroom and an hour of deciding what to do for the Culture Festival.
What's more, tomorrow is a school holiday, so after this fourth period is over, it's practically vacation already.
It's only natural for everyone to be waiting for the end-of-class bell to ring.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――ねむ」
　ふぁう、とあくびを押しとめる。
　授業は何の変化もなく、一日は何の異状もなく進んでいる。
　考えてみると、あれだけ異常な出来事を体験してきたっていうのに、のんびりと授業をうけている自分はおかしいのかもしれない。
　実際、学校が終わって夜になれば、今夜からまたアルクェイドと一緒に行動する。
　それを考えたら、こんなのんびりと授業を受けている余裕なんて本当はないんだろうし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――So sleepy.”
I smother a yawn.
The lesson passes without incident, and the day continues without the slightest irregularity.
Come to think of it, perhaps I am the strange one for sitting through class so peacefully after everything abnormal I have experienced.
Once school ends and night falls, I will be working with Arcueid again.
If I think about what that means, I probably have no business taking it this easy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Sleepy."
I give a big yawn.
The class is completely unchanged, the whole day progresses with nothing out of the ordinary.
Come to think of it, I've been through so many strange experiences, I almost feel odd just sitting in class.
And after classes are over and night falls, I'll have to go out once more with Arcueid.
Thinking of that, I really don't have the time to be fooling around here.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
窓ガラスの映った自分の顔を見る。
　遠野志貴は、なぜか楽しそうに顔をほころばせていたりした。
「――――む」
　キッ、と口元をひきしめる。
　アルクェイドと夜の街を徘徊するのが楽しいってワケでもあるまいし、なにをわくわくしているっていうんだろ、自分は。
「……アルクェイド……」
　本当に、どうかしてる。
　窓越しに見下ろせる裏庭に、やっほーっ、なんて手をふっているあいつの幻が見えるなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
I study my reflection in the window.
For some reason, Shiki Tohno is smiling as if he is enjoying himself.
“――――Hmph.”
I sternly tighten my mouth.
It cannot be that I enjoy roaming the streets at night with Arcueid, so what exactly am I so excited about?
“Arcueid.”
I really have lost my mind.
Now I am imagining her down in the rear courtyard, waving up at me and calling, “Yoo-hoo!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I look at my reflection in the window glass.
Tohno Shiki's face seems to be happy for some reason.
"----Grr."
I tighten my expression.
It's not like roaming the streets with Arcueid is fun, so why am I acting like this?
"…… Arcueid……"
There's really, something wrong.
Looking out the window and into the rear courtyard, I can see an illusion of her waving her hand at me and saying "Hey".
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese: ――――って、ちょっと待て……！
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Wait…!
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Hey, wait a minute……!
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「なっ、なっ、なっ――――」
　ひしっ、と窓ガラスに張りついて裏庭を見下ろす。
　うちの教室からでは裏庭の端っこのほうにチラリとしか見えないが、
　そこには、たしかに。
　いつもの格好のままで学校に入ってきている、アルクェイドの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh-wh-wh――――!”
I plaster myself against the window and stare down into the rear courtyard.
