From our classroom I can see only a sliver of its far edge,
and sure enough, there she is.
Arcueid stands inside the school grounds, dressed exactly as usual.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha, wha, wha----"
I push myself onto the window and look down.
I can only see the very edge of the rear courtyard,
but without a doubt,
Arcueid, in her usual manner, is at my school.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「っっっっ！」
　きょろきょろと教室を見渡す。
―――幸い、うちのクラスには中庭に立って、こっちに向かって手をふっている正体不明の外人さんに気がついている生徒はいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…!”
I whip my head around and scan the classroom.
―――Fortunately, not one person in the class has noticed the mysterious foreign woman standing in the courtyard and waving up at us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"!!!!!"
I look around the classroom.
----Fortunately, there's no one who noticed the strange foreigner waving to me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あいつ、なに考えてるんだ……！」
　頭を抱えて、そんな恨み言を呟く。
　が、呟いたところでおそらくは何も解決はしないだろう。
　……昼休みまで、あと二十分弱。
　どうするんだ志貴、アイツを放っておいたら何をしでかすかまったく解らないぞ……！？
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is she thinking…?”
I clutch my head and mutter the accusation under my breath.
Not that muttering will solve anything.
There are just under twenty minutes until lunch.
What are you going to do, Shiki, when there is no telling what she might do if you leave her alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is she thinking……!?"
I moan to myself as I clutch my head.
But, complaining does me no good.
…… There's about twenty minutes till lunch.
What are you going to do Shiki?
If you leave her alone, who knows what she'll do……!?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
―――そうだな。
　災害の芽はできるだけ早くにつまないといけない。
　アイツが何かおもしろおかしいトラブルを起こす前に、とにかく裏庭から連れ出すべきだと思う。
「先生、気分が貧血なので保健室に行ってきます！」
　手を挙げて、有無を言わさずに現代社会の教師に許可をもらって、教室を飛び出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Right.
Disaster is best stopped before it can begin.
I need to drag her out of the rear courtyard before she creates some ludicrous catastrophe.
“Sir, I’m feeling anemic, so I’m going to the infirmary!”
I shoot up my hand, obtain permission from the Contemporary Society teacher before he can object, and bolt from the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's right.
Preventable disasters should be stopped before they happen.
Before she can start any "interesting" trouble, I have to take her off the school grounds.
"Sensei, I feel my anemia coming, so I need to leave!"
I raise my hand, and after getting permission from the teacher, fly out of the classroom.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　……開いた口が塞がらない。
　中庭に駆けつけた俺を見るなり、アルクェイドは陽気にそんな感想をもらしてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
I can only stare with my mouth hanging open.
The instant I reach the courtyard, Arcueid cheerfully begins sharing her impressions.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, you're here.
That was a pretty fast sprint!
You're looking pretty lively this morning, Shiki."
"-----"
…… My jaw hangs wide open.
As I sprint into the courtyard, Arcueid greets me with her usual radiance.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「思ったより狭いところなんだね。
学校だっていうから、わたしもっと大きなところだって―――きゃっ！」
　がし、とアルクェイドの腕を掴む。
「――――おまえ、ちょっと来い」
　そのまま、逃げるようにアルクェイドを引っ張って人目につかない場所まで走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is smaller than I expected. When you said school, I imagined somewhere much bigger―――eep!”
I seize Arcueid by the arm.
“――――You, come with me.”
Then I flee with her in tow, running until we reach somewhere hidden from view.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's smaller than I expected.
I thought a 'school' would be much bigger than this----kyaa!"
I grab Arcueid's arm.
"----You, come with me."
Dragging Arcueid behind me, I dash to a place where people won't see us.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと、急にこんなところに連れこんでどういうつもり？
　ここ、ぜんぜん面白くない」
　アルクェイドはこの場所がご不満のようだが、元来学校というのは特に面白い建物ではない。
「―――どういうつもりかってな、そりゃあこっちの台詞だアルクェイド」
　掴んでいた手を離して、びっ、と人差し指をアルクェイドの鼻先につきつける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you suddenly drag me into a place like this? There’s nothing interesting here at all.”
Arcueid appears dissatisfied with our surroundings, but schools are not generally designed to be exciting buildings.
“―――You are asking me that, Arcueid?”
I release her arm and thrust an accusing finger beneath her nose.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey!
What are you doing, taking me here all of a sudden?
This place is no fun at all."
Arcueid seems to be disappointed in this place, but it's not like school is a really interesting place to begin with.
"---'What are you doing?' That's my line, Arcueid."
I let go of her arm and thrust my index finger towards her face.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「えっ？
　どういうつもりかって、なにが？」
「なんだって昼間から歩きまわって、かつ俺の学校になんかやってきてるんだって聞いてるんだ。
体だって治りきってないっていうのに、どうしてそう大人しくできないんだよ、おまえってヤツは……！」
「どうしてって、だって志貴が手伝ってくれるって言うから、昼間のうちに手がかりを見つけておこうかなって。
志貴に無駄なこと、させるわけにはいかないなって―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh? What do you mean?”
“I mean, why are you wandering around in broad daylight and why did you come to my school? Your body has not recovered yet, so why can you not sit quietly and behave yourself?”
“Because you said you would help me. I thought I should look for clues during the day so I would not waste your time―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh?
What do you mean?"
"I'm asking why you're walking around during daytime, and why you came to my school.
You haven't even healed yet, so why can't you just settle down and rest……!"
"But, since you said you would help me, I thought I would look for clues during the day.
I didn't want to… make you do any extra work---"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「そんな事は気にしなくていいです！
　協力するって言った以上、どんな無駄な作業だって一緒にやるんだから、よけいな気は使わなくていいんだ。
　……ったく、ただでさえ弱ってるのに昼間に出て来るなんて、俺を心配させて楽しいのか、おまえは」
「あ―――うん、ごめんなさい」
「いや、分かればいいんだけど―――っって、アルクェイド？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You do not need to worry about that! I promised to help, so no matter how pointless the work is, we will do it together, and you should stop trying to spare me the trouble.
Honestly, you are already weak, yet you came out in daylight; do you enjoy making me worry?”
“Ah―――yes, I am sorry.”
“Well, as long as you understand―――wait, Arcueid?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't worry about that!
Since I said I'd help, any extra work we'll do together, so just forget about it.
…… Geez.
You're weakest during the middle of the day yet you still leave.
Do you just enjoy making me worry?"
"Ah---I'm, sorry."
"No, as long as you understand, it's okay---uh, Arcueid?"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「だから心配させて、ごめんなさい」
「いや……うん、ありがとう」
　どくん、と心臓が鳴った気がする。
　アルクェイドが素直に謝ってくるなんて――拍子抜けっていうか、その――ひどく、可愛い気が、する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I said I am sorry for making you worry.”
“Yes, thank you.”
My heart gives a heavy thump.
Arcueid apologizing so meekly is disarming―――or rather, she seems terribly cute.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm sorry, for making you worry."
"No…… actually, thanks."
I think my heart beats loudly.
Arcueid apologizing like this--is a bit out of ordinary, or--I think, terribly cute.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「でも志貴も悪いわよ。
ずっと中庭から見てたのに、わたしに気がついてくれないんだもの。
　どこから中に入っていいのか分からなかったから、いっそのこと志貴がいるトコまで駆けあがろうかなって悩んだんだから」
「駆けあがろうって、三階にあるうちの教室まで？」
「ええ、ベランダもあって足場には困りそうにないし、跳びやすいでしょ、あそこ」
「――――――」
　前言撤回。
　コイツは、相変わらずの非常識だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But this is partly your fault, Shiki. I watched you from the courtyard forever, and you never noticed me.
I could not work out how to get inside, so I nearly ran straight up to where you were.”
“Ran straight up to my classroom on the third floor?”
“Yes; there are balconies, so footholds would not be a problem and it looked easy to jump.”
“――――――”
I take back everything I just thought.
She has not changed; common sense still means nothing to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But you're at fault too, Shiki.
I was watching for the longest time from the courtyard, but you never noticed me.
I didn't know how to get inside, so I was thinking about dashing up to where you were."
"Dash up?
You mean to my classroom on the third floor?"
"Yes, footing wouldn't be difficult on the veranda, and it's really easy to jump up there."
"------"
I take it all back.
As usual, she completely lacks any common sense.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……良かった。
そんなことされてたら授業どころの話じゃなかった」
　はあ、と安堵の息をもらす。
　さっきの中庭での事も、アルクェイドに気がついた生徒は少ないと思う。
　もともと中庭が窓から見える教室は限られているのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Thank God.
If you’d done that, class would have been the least of my problems.”
I breathe a sigh of relief.
Probably only a few students noticed her in the courtyard; not many classrooms have windows overlooking it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Good.
That wouldn't have been pretty if you did that."
I breathe a sigh of relief.
I don't think many people noticed her.
In the first place, there's only a few desks that can look out into the courtyard.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――それで。
一体うちの学校に何の用なんだよ。
さっきは手がかりを探しているとか言ってたけど」
「ちょっとね、このあたりに気配を感じたから。
それであたりを歩いているうちに志貴の匂いがして、ここが志貴の通ってる学校なんだって気がついたの」
「……はあ。
それで思わず、何の用もなくやってきたっていうわけか？」
　犬か君は、と顔をしかめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――So. Why did you come to my school? You said something about looking for clues.”
“I sensed something around here, and while searching the area I caught your scent. That was how I realized this was your school.”
“Right. So you came wandering in without any actual reason?”
I grimace and wonder whether she is a dog.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---And?
So why the heck did you come to my school?
You said you were looking for clues."
"I just felt something from around here.
Then I picked up your scent and realized it was your school."
"…… So you weren't thinking and you just came for no reason?"
I give a frown.
Is she a dog or something?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「失礼ね、ちゃんと確証があったからやってきたのよ。
他の場所に比べて、ここはあんまりにも死者の気配がないんだもの。
どんなものかなって、実際に見てみようって思ったんだから」
「そうなの？
　けど、死者の気配っていうのがないんなら関係ないってことじゃないのか？
　実際、学校は夜になると誰もいないんだから、死者が獲物を欲しがるとしたら学校なんかじゃなくて街に出るだろうし」
「………まあ、そう言えばそうだけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How rude; I had a perfectly good reason to investigate. Compared with everywhere else, this place has far too little trace of the Dead. I wanted to see for myself what it was like.”
“But if there is no trace of the Dead here, does that not mean the school is irrelevant? It is empty at night. If the Dead were hunting prey, they would go into town rather than come here.”
“Well, when you put it that way…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well excuse me!
I came here for a reason.
There's hardly any traces of The Dead here, so I wanted to see it for myself."
"Really?
But if there's no traces of The Dead here, then shouldn't this place be unimportant?
There's no one at school at night, so if The Dead wanted some prey, they would go downtown, not to a school."
"…… Well, that does make sense."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ここに異状なんかないよ。
死者の気配なんてもの、俺にはわからないけどさ。
俺だってこれでも死を視る目を持ってるんだ。
死者が歩いてればメガネをつけていても異状だって気がつく」
「わかった。
志貴がそう言うんなら、ここに異状はないかもしれない」
「ないかもしれない、じゃなくてないんだって、実際」
　アルクェイドは納得のいかない顔をしたままだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is nothing wrong here. I cannot sense the Dead. But I do have eyes that see death. If one of them were walking around, I would notice something was wrong even with my glasses on.”
“All right. If you say so, then perhaps there is nothing wrong here.”
“Not perhaps; there really is not.”
Arcueid still looks unconvinced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There's nothing strange here.
I can't really sense The Dead, but since my eyes see death, I can tell without taking off my glasses."
"I see.
If you say so, Shiki, then there's nothing strange about this place, perhaps."
"Not 'perhaps', definitely."
Arcueid looks like she doesn't believe me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
――――と。
　四時限目の終わりを告げるチャイムが鳴った。
「―――やば、昼休みになっちゃったか」
　いくら裏庭の林が人気がないっていっても、昼休みになれば通りかかる生徒が出てくるかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――At that moment.
The bell rings to mark the end of fourth period.
“―――Damn, it is lunchtime already.”
The grove behind the school may be deserted, but during lunch someone could easily wander through.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And then,
the chime rings announcing the end of fourth period.
"---Oh no, is it lunch already?"
Even though most people don't stay by this grove, since it's lunchtime, there'll be lots of people walking by.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「とにかく、これ以上ここにいられると他の連中に見つかるだろ。
　ちゃんと約束は守るから、おまえは早く帰って体を休めておくこと。
今日の夜にも大本の『敵』とやらに出会うかもしれないんだから」
「ふぅーん。
なんだかわたしをここから追い出したいみたいな口ぶりをするのね、志貴」
　いかにも不満そうにアルクェイドは視線を泳がせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, if you stay here, someone will find you.
I’ll keep my promise, so go home and rest. We may run into the real enemy as early as tonight.”
“Hmm. You’re talking as though you want to drive me away, Shiki.”
Arcueid’s gaze drifts aside in obvious displeasure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, if we stay here any longer, people will see us.
I'll keep my promise for sure, so just go home and rest.
We may see the 'enemy' tonight."
"Oh?
You sound like you want me out of here, Shiki?"
She starts to look angry again.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それは気のせいだって。
気のせいだから、早く外に出てくれ。
このままじゃますます複雑な立場に追い込まれるだろ」
　ほらほら、とアルクェイドの背中を押す。
「………………」
　アルクェイドは特に何も言わず、最後まで何か言いたそうな目をして立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are imagining it. So please, hurry up and leave. Otherwise, this will put me in an even more complicated position.”
I push her insistently from behind.
“…”
Arcueid leaves without a word, though to the very end her eyes seem to say there is something she wants to tell me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, that's just your imagination, so hurry on back.
Otherwise things might get a little hairy."
Go, go.
I push her from behind.
"………………"
Though her eyes indicate she wants to say something, she just leaves silently.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドが学校の敷地から出ていったのを見届けてから中庭に戻る。
「―――ん？」
　なんだろう。
　誰かが、こっちを見てる。
「先……輩？」
　間違いない、シエル先輩だ。
　けど―――なんて目をしてるんだろう。
　本当に先輩なのかって疑いたくなるぐらい、恐い目をしてこっちを見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
After making sure Arcueid has left the school grounds, I return to the courtyard.
“―――Hm?”
What is it?
Someone is watching me.
“Ciel?”
There is no mistaking her.
But―――what is that look in her eyes?
She is staring at me so coldly that I almost doubt it is really Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After watching Arcueid leave, I return to the courtyard.
"----Hm?"
What is it?
Someone is looking this way.
"Sen…… pai?"
No mistake, it's Ciel-senpai.
But---why is she making that expression?
She has a fearsome expression that almost makes me doubt it's actually her.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――先輩！」
　声をかけて近寄っていく。
　先輩は立ち尽くしたまま、ずっとこっちを見つめていた。
「なにやってるんです、こんなところで」
「そういう遠野くんこそ、あんなところで何をしてたんですか？
　お昼休みは始まったばっかりなのに裏庭にいるなんて、四時限目をさぼっちゃったんですね」
「まさか。
ちょっとフライングして教室を出ただけだって」
　はあ、と先輩は気のない返事をする。
　いつもどおりの笑顔なんだけど、どうもこんな時間に裏庭にいた俺を訝しんでいるみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Ciel!”
I call to her and walk over.
She remains motionless, watching me approach.
“What are you doing out here?”
“I might ask you the same thing, Tohno. Lunch has only just begun, yet you were already in the rear courtyard, so you skipped fourth period, did you not?”
“Of course not. I just got a little head start leaving the classroom.”
Ciel answers with a listless sigh.
Her smile is the same as ever, but she plainly finds my presence here at this hour suspicious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Senpai!"
I call out to her as I run.
Senpai simply stands there, watching me.
"What are you doing here?"
"The same for you, Tohno-kun.
What were you doing there?
Lunch has just began, so for you to be back here you must have skipped fourth period class."
"Of course not.
I just flew out of the classroom, that's all."
"Oh," Senpai answers without any enthusiasm.
It's her normal smile, but it seems like she's glaring at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「そんなことよりさ、先輩は昼メシ食べた？
　まだだったら一緒に食べない？」
　などと、当たり障りのない誤魔化しをしてみる。
「ごめんなさい、今日は先約があるからダメです。
もし、また機会があったら誘ってください」
　言って、先輩は一瞬だけ俯いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget that—have you eaten lunch yet? If not, want to eat together?”
I try the safest possible diversion.
“I’m sorry, but I already have plans today. Please ask me again if you have the chance.”
After saying that, Ciel lowers her head for just a moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"More than that, did you eat lunch yet?
If not, would you like to eat with me?"
I try and play it all off casually.
"I'm sorry, I already have someone else.
Please ask me some other time."
For an instant, she looks incredibly down as she says that.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……先輩？
　どうしたんだ、元気ないみたいだけど」
「いえ、そんなコトないですよ。
ただ、楽しいことはすぐに終わるって、ほんとうなんですね遠野くん」
　ニコリ、と今までで一番いい笑顔をして。
　先輩は一人で、校舎の中へ戻っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel? You seem a little down; is something wrong?”
“No, nothing is wrong. It is true that happy things are over before you know it, Tohno.”
She gives me the loveliest smile I have ever seen from her.
Then she returns to the school building alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai?
What's wrong?
You don't look too well."
"No, that isn't it.
It's just that… it's true that fun things end rather quickly, Tohno-kun."
She gives a brilliant smile in contrast to before.
With that, she walks inside by herself.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
―――かといって授業中に堂々と早退するなんてできない。
「………頼む」
　あと二十分、授業が終わるのでアイツが何かおもしろおかしいトラブルを起こさないようにと、両手を合わせて祈ってみた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Still, I can’t simply stand up and walk out in the middle of class.
“Please.”
I press my palms together and pray she can make it through the next twenty minutes without causing some ridiculous disaster.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---But I can't just leave in the middle of class.
"……… Please."
I bring my hands together and pray silently that she won't start any "interesting" trouble for twenty minutes.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
授業が終わった。
　昼休みという事で騒ぎ出した教室をダッシュで抜け出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
Class ends.
As the room erupts into its usual lunchtime clamor, I bolt for the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Class ends.
I dash out of the classroom engulfed in the lunchtime commotion.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
にわかに混雑しだした廊下を駆けぬける。
　……アルクェイドは裏庭にいる。
　昼休みなんだから、生徒の一人や二人は裏庭にだって行くだろう。
　その前に、なんとかアルクェイドを掴まえて学校の外に追い返さないといけない……！
entries.maoEnglish:
I race through the halls as they begin to fill.
Arcueid is behind the school.
It is lunchtime; sooner or later, at least one or two students are bound to wander back there.
I have to catch her first and drive her off campus somehow…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
I bolt down through the hallway.
…… Arcueid is out back.
Because it's lunchtime, there may be one or two students going there.
Before that, I have to send her away from school……!
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、はぁ――――」
　食堂に通じる渡り廊下から中庭に出る。
　幸い、まだ外に出てきている生徒はいない。
　あとは裏庭にいたアルクェイドを掴まえるだけ、なんだ、けど。
「……最悪」
　裏庭について、思わずそんなグチを呟いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah――――!”
I burst into the courtyard from the covered walkway leading to the cafeteria.
Luckily, no other students have come outside yet.
All that remains is to grab Arcueid from behind the school.
“This is the worst.”
The words escape me the moment I reach the back courtyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I pant with exertion.
I exit the hallway and out into the courtyard.
Fortunately, no one else has gone outside.
All that's left is to grab Arcueid, but…
"…… The worst."
Entering the back of the school, I unthinkingly voice my thoughts.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
裏庭には、
　不幸にもアルクェイドに因縁をつけられているシエル先輩がいたりした。
　裏庭に現れた正体不明の外人を注意しにきたのか、先輩はアルクェイドに睨まれてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
There, behind the school
is Ciel, an upperclassman of mine, with the rotten luck to have Arcueid picking a fight with her.
Ciel must have come to warn off the unidentified foreign woman trespassing behind the school; now Arcueid has her pinned beneath a murderous glare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the back,
I can see a very hostile Arcueid and…
through the worst twist of fate, Ciel-senpai is also present.
As if facing an invader, Senpai is staring at Arcueid.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド……！」
　声をかけて、二人を振り向かせる。
「志貴」
「―――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…!”
I call out, and they both turn toward me.
“Shiki.”
“―――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid……!"
Both of them turn around.
"Shiki."
"-------"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……よかった。
話しかけた事で、アルクェイドの殺気が薄れていっている。
　先輩はというと、ちらりとアルクェイドを見たあと、俺がやって来た方とは別方向に立ち去って行ってしまった。
「あ……先輩」
　アルクェイドに睨まれて、よっぽど不快な思いをしたんだろう。
　あの先輩が何も言わずに立ち去るなんて、ちょっとただ事じゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank God. My interruption takes the edge off Arcueid’s bloodlust.
Ciel glances at her, then walks away in a direction other than the one I came from.
“Ah, Ciel.”
Arcueid’s glare must have upset her badly.
Ciel, of all people, leaving without a word is no small thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Thank goodness.
Arcueid's hostility seems to fade.
After looking back at Arcueid, Senpai leaves in another direction.
"Ah…… Senpai."
She must've been offended by being glared at by Arcueid.
For Senpai to just disappear like that without saying anything must mean something.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、おまえ……！」
　アルクェイドに駆け寄る。
「もう、志貴ったらおそいっ！」
　と、駆け寄るなり怒鳴られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, you…!”
I hurry over to her.
“Honestly, Shiki, you took forever!”
she shouts the instant I reach her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, you……!"
I run over to her.
"Shiki you slowpoke!"
She yells at me as I get to her.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「おまえ……遅いって、あのな」
「だってそうでしょう！？
　ちゃんとわたしと目があったのに、志貴ったら全然下りてこないんだもの。
志貴がもっと早く来てくれたら、あんなヤツに見つかることもなかったのに！」
　……あんなヤツ、とは先輩の事だろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You say I took forever?”
“Well, you did! We looked straight at each other, and then you never came down. If you’d gotten here sooner, that woman wouldn’t have found me!”
Does she mean Ciel?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey…… slow?
Hey now."
"But weren't you?
I know you saw me, but you never came down.
If you came earlier, I wouldn't have been seen by that person!"
…… "That person" must mean Senpai.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「仕方ないだろ、こっちにだって都合があるんだ。
俺はアルクェイドと違って普通の学生なんだぞ。
だいたいな、一体うちの学校に何の用なんだよ、おまえ」
「ちょっとね、このあたりに気配を感じたから。
それであたりを歩いているうちに志貴の匂いがして、ここが志貴の通ってる学校なんだって気がついたの」
「……はあ。
それで思わず、何の用もなくやってきたっていうわけか？」
　犬か君は、と顔をしかめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I couldn’t help it; I have a life of my own. Unlike you, I’m an ordinary student. More importantly, what are you doing at my school?”
“I sensed something around here, and while searching the area I caught your scent. That was how I realized this was your school.”
“Right. So you came wandering in without any actual reason?”
I grimace and wonder whether she is a dog.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It couldn't be helped, I have my circumstances.
I'm different from you, I'm just a normal student.
In the first place, why the heck did you come here?"
"I just felt something from around here.
Then I picked up your scent and realized it was your school."
"…… So you weren't thinking and you just came for no reason?"
I give a frown.
Is she a dog or something?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「失礼ね、ちゃんと確証があったからやってきたのよ。
他の場所に比べて、ここはあんまりにも死者の気配がないんだもの。
どんなものかなって、実際に見てみようって思ったんだから」
「そうなの？
　けど、死者の気配っていうのがないんなら関係ないってことじゃないのか？
　実際、学校は夜になると誰もいないんだから、死者が獲物を欲しがるとしたら学校なんかじゃなくて街に出るだろうし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How rude; I had a perfectly good reason to investigate. Compared with everywhere else, this place has far too little trace of the Dead. I wanted to see for myself what it was like.”
“But if there is no trace of the Dead here, does that not mean the school is irrelevant? It is empty at night. If the Dead were hunting prey, they would go into town rather than come here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well excuse me!
I came here for a reason.
There's hardly any traces of The Dead here, so I wanted to see it for myself."
"Really?
But if there's no traces of The Dead here, then shouldn't this place be unimportant?
There's no one at school at night, so if The Dead wanted some prey, they would go downtown, not to a school."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「………まあ、そう言えばそうだけど」
「ここに異状なんかないよ。
死者の気配なんてものは俺にはわからないけど、俺だってこれでも死を視る目を持ってるんだ。
　死者が歩いてればメガネをつけていても異状だって気がつくよ」
「わかった。
志貴がそう言うんなら、ここに異状はないかもしれない」
「ないかもしれない、じゃなくてないんだって、実際」
　アルクェイドは納得のいかない顔をしたままだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, when you put it that way…”
“There is nothing wrong here. I may not be able to sense the Dead, but I do have eyes that see death.
Even with my glasses on, I would notice if one of them were walking around.”
“All right. If you say so, then perhaps there is nothing wrong here.”
“Not perhaps; there really is not.”
Arcueid still looks unconvinced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, that does make sense."

"There's nothing strange here.
I can't really sense The Dead, but since my eyes see death, I can tell without taking off my glasses."
"I see.
If you say so, Shiki, then there's nothing strange about this place, perhaps."
"Not 'perhaps', definitely."
Arcueid looks like she doesn't believe me.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「とにかく、これ以上ここにいられると他の連中に見つかるだろ。
　ちゃんと約束は守るから、おまえは早く帰って体を休めておくこと。
今日の夜にも大本の『敵』とやらに出会うかもしれないんだから」
「ふぅーん。
なんだかわたしをここから追い出したいみたいな口ぶりをするのね、志貴」
　いかにも不満そうにアルクェイドは視線を泳がせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, if you stay here, someone will find you.
I’ll keep my promise, so go home and rest. We may run into the real enemy as early as tonight.”
“Hmm. You’re talking as though you want to drive me away, Shiki.”
Arcueid’s gaze drifts aside in obvious displeasure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, if we stay here any longer, people will see us.
I'll keep my promise for sure, so just go home and rest.
We may see the 'enemy' tonight."
"Oh?
You sound like you want me out of here, Shiki?"
She starts to look angry again.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それは気のせいだって。
気のせいだから、早く外に出てくれ。
このままじゃますます複雑な立場に追い込まれるだろ」
　ほらほら、とアルクェイドの背中を押す。
「………………」
　アルクェイドは特に何も言わず、最後まで何か言いたそうな目をして立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are imagining it. So please, hurry up and leave. Otherwise, this will put me in an even more complicated position.”
I push her insistently from behind.
“…”
Arcueid leaves without a word, though to the very end her eyes seem to say there is something she wants to tell me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, that's just your imagination, so hurry on back.
Otherwise things might get a little hairy."
Go, go.
I push her from behind.
"………………"
Though her eyes indicate she wants to say something, she just leaves silently.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……はあ。
先輩に会ったら、アルクェイドの事を謝らないといけないな」
　独りごちて、こっちも裏庭を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Great. Next time I see Ciel, I’ll have to apologize for Arcueid.”
Muttering to myself, I leave the back courtyard too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Man.
If I see Senpai, I have to apologize to her about Arcueid."
Thinking aloud, I go back.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
――――無視しよう。
　下手にアルクェイドのところに駆けつけて、人に見られると事だ。
　アルクェイドが何をやらかしても他人のフリをしていれば、とりあえずこっちに被害はない。
　……まあ、今夜にでも『どうして無視したんだ』って責められかねないけど、ここは仕方がない。
　唯一の平和の場である学校ぐらいは、何事もなく過ごしたいんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I’ll ignore her.
If I run down to Arcueid and someone sees us together, I’ll be in serious trouble.
Whatever she does, I can pretend I don’t know her and avoid the fallout for now.
She might corner me tonight and demand to know why I ignored her, but that can’t be helped.
School is the one peaceful refuge I have left, so I want to get through a day here without incident.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'll ignore her.
If I just run down to her and people see me, it'll be a problem.
No matter what she does, if I act like a stranger, it won't hurt me.
…… Well, tonight she'll probably say "Why did you ignore me?" But, it can't be helped.
All I want is for the school to remain peaceful and not do anything.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
昼休みになった。
　パン食、という気分でもないし、今日は学食に行くとしよう。
「………あれ？」
　なにか忘れているような気がしないでもないけど、ま、いっか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunchtime arrives.
I’m not in the mood for bread, so I decide to eat in the cafeteria.
“Huh?”
I have the faintest feeling I’m forgetting something, but oh well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's lunchtime.
I'm not in the mood for bread for lunch, so I'll go to the cafeteria.
"…… Huh?"
I feel like I forgot something, but, whatever.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
食堂は相変わらず混雑している。
　テーブルはほとんど埋まっていて、急がないと席がなくなってしまいそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The cafeteria is as crowded as ever.
Nearly every table is taken; if I don’t hurry, there will be nowhere left to sit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The cafeteria is in chaos as usual.
Most of the tables are filled, so if I don't hurry, I won't have a seat.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あ、先輩」
　ふと、上級生の一団の中にいるシエル先輩の姿が目に入った。
　クラスの友人なのだろう、何人かの女生徒と話しながら、先輩は真剣にカレーうどんを食べていた。
　……思い返してみると、先輩はいつだってカレー関係のものばかり食べている気がする。
「カレー、好きなのかな、あの人」
　今度機会があったら聞いてみよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Ciel.”
I spot her among a group of older students.
Probably classmates, several girls chat with her while Ciel applies herself with grave concentration to a bowl of curry udon.
Come to think of it, she always seems to be eating something involving curry.
“Does she really like curry that much?”
I’ll have to ask her sometime.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Senpai."
I see Ciel-senpai sitting in a group.
Are those her friends from class?
While talking with a group of girls, she's seriously eating curry udon.
…… Come to think of it, she's always eating a "curry-something".
"She, really likes curry, I guess."
I'll have to ask her about it.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「………」
　けど、なんかひっかかる。
　すごく大事な、放っておくと危なっかしい問題を忘れている気がする。
「……まあ、思い出せないのは大した事じゃないか」
　それがすごく大した事のような気がするんだけど、とりあえず今は目の前の昼食に専念する事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Still, something bothers me.
It feels as though I’ve forgotten a terribly important problem, the kind that becomes dangerous when left unattended.
“If I can’t remember it, it can’t be that important.”
It feels extremely important, actually, but for the moment I choose to concentrate on the lunch in front of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
But, something pulls at me.
I feel like I forgot something important.
Something, dangerous if left alone.
"…… Well, if I don't remember, it can't be that important."
Even though it seems really important, I just turn all my attention to my lunch for now.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……文化祭の出し物を決めるホームルームは、予想に反して難航した。
　様々な意見が飛びかい、教室中の全生徒の意見が対立した結果、決定は来週に延期になった。
　終わってみれば時計はとっくに夕方になっていて、みな疲れ果てた様子で教室を後にしていく。
「――――さて」
　教室でぼんやりとしていても仕方がない。
　夜にそなえて屋敷に戻るとしよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Contrary to all expectations, homeroom’s attempt to choose an attraction for the school festival dragged on.
Suggestions flew from every corner, the entire class split into opposing camps, and in the end the decision was postponed until next week.
By the time it was over, evening had long since arrived, and everyone filed out of the classroom looking exhausted.
“Well…”
There’s no point sitting here in a daze.
I should head back to the mansion and prepare for tonight—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… As expected, the debate over what to do for the Culture Festival is a stormy one.
Since everyone's opinions are different, the decision gets postponed till next week.
By the time it's over, it's late in the afternoon.
Everyone gets up tiredly from their chairs and leaves the classroom.
"----Well then."
There's nothing to do in the classroom.
I should get ready for tonight and go back to the mansion---
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
久しぶりに寄り道をせず、まっすぐ屋敷に帰ってきた。
　日もまだ沈みきっていないし、秋葉はまだ帰ってきていないだろう。
「秋葉のやつ、まだ今朝のまま怒ってるのかな……」
　……まあ、こればっかりは仕方がない。
　秋葉に本当のことを話すわけにはいかないんだから、しばらくはだらしのない兄貴として憎まれ役をするしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
For once, I come straight home without stopping anywhere.
The sun hasn’t fully set, so Akiha probably isn’t back yet.
“I wonder if she’s still angry about this morning…”
There’s nothing I can do about that.
I can’t tell Akiha the truth, so for a while I’ll have to play the feckless older brother and let her hate me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't swing by anywhere else and head right back to the mansion.
The sun hasn't quite set so Akiha probably isn't back yet.

"That Akiha.
I wonder if she's still mad like this morning……"
…… Well, that can't be helped either.
I can't tell her the truth, so I'll probably just continue to be hated as a terrible older brother.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
　屋敷に入るなり、翡翠はふかぶかとおじぎをしてきた。
「……ああ、ただいま翡翠。
出迎えてくれて、どうも」
　―――こっちに帰ってきてから一週間ばかり経つっていうのに、やっぱりこういうのには慣れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
The moment I enter, Hisui greets me with a deep bow.
“Thanks, Hisui. I’m home.”
―――It’s been about a week since I returned, but I still can’t get used to this sort of reception.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Welcome back, Shiki-sama."
Hisui bows as I enter the mansion.
"…… Yeah, I'm back.
Thanks for greeting me, Hisui."
---It's been a week since I've come back, but I'm not used to this yet.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「えーっと、秋葉はまだ帰ってきてない？」
「はい。
今夜は特別遅くなる、とのことですので、ご夕食は志貴さま一人で済ませるように、と言付かっています」
　……やっぱり朝のことをまだ怒っているんだろうな、秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um—Akiha isn’t home yet?”
“No. She sent word that she will be unusually late tonight and that Master Shiki should dine without her.”
So Akiha really is still angry about this morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Akiha isn't back yet?"
"No.
She told me to tell you she would be back especially late tonight so please eat dinner on your own, Shiki-sama."
…… I knew she'd still be angry from this morning.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　がっくり、と両肩に重いものを感じて自分の部屋に戻ろうとする。
　―――と。
「志貴さま」
　翡翠はちらり、とロビーを見渡してから改まって声をかけてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
My shoulders sag beneath an invisible weight as I turn toward my room.
―――Then.
“Master Shiki.”
Hisui glances around the lobby, then addresses me with sudden formality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Sigh."
I slump my shoulders as I start to walk to my room.
---And then,
"Shiki-sama."
Hisui looks around the lobby before she speaks again.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「つかぬことをお伺いいたしますが、志貴さまは今夜もお出かけになるのでしょうか？」
「え――――？」
　翡翠は感情のない目で、まっすぐに俺を見据えてくる。
　あくまで使用人として、俺の帰ってくる時間を知りたがっているのだと思うんだけど、翡翠に知らせるということは秋葉に知られる、というコトだ。
　ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forgive the impertinent question, but will Master Shiki be going out again tonight?”
“What…?”
Hisui fixes me with her unreadable stare.
She probably wants to know when I will return purely as a matter of household duty—but telling Hisui means telling Akiha.
So—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Forgive me for asking an awkward question, but will you be leaving tonight again, Shiki-sama?"
"Eh----?"
She fixates her emotionless eyes on me.
I think she simply wants to know what time I'll be back because she's so dedicated of a servant, but letting her know means Akiha would know.
I should---
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
――そうだな。
　どんなに誤魔化しても、屋敷の管理を任されている翡翠と琥珀さんに隠し通す事はできない。
　なら、せめてこれから何日か夜は留守にするって伝えておこう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――Right.
No matter what excuse I made, I could never hide it indefinitely from Hisui and Kohaku, who managed the mansion.
At the very least, I should warn them that I would be out at night for the next few days.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--That's right.
No matter how hard I try, I can't hide it from Hisui and Kohaku-san who are in charge of maintaining the mansion.
So, the least I can do is let them know when I'll be gone every night in the following days.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……うん、実はこれから何日か夜に出掛ける事になるんだ。
でも誓って悪い遊びをしてるわけじゃない。
秋葉には嫌われる一方だろうけど、今更やめるわけにはいかなくなった」
　そう、この街に得体の知れない吸血鬼がいて、何人もの人達が犠牲になってしまっているなら。
　知ってしまった以上、俺は同じ街に住む者として見過ごすわけにはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The truth is, I’ll be going out at night for the next few days. But I swear I’m not up to anything bad. Akiha will probably hate me more for it, but it’s too late for me to stop now.”
There was an unknown vampire somewhere in this city, and people were already dying.
As a resident of this city, I couldn’t turn a blind eye now that I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, to tell the truth, I'll probably leave for a number of nights starting now.
I swear I'm not just playing around or doing anything bad.
Akiha will probably end up hating me, but I can't stop now."
Yeah.
The vampire is still somewhere in town preying on victims.
As a person who lives here, I just can't pretend like I didn't see it.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「───翡翠にも迷惑をかけるけど、しばらくは見過ごしてくれると助かる。
出掛けたら勝手に帰ってくるから、屋敷の門だけ開けといてくれ」
「志貴さまはわたしたちに理由は話せない、というのですね」
「……ああ、ごめんな翡翠。
だらしないヤツだって思ってくれていいからさ、今は何も聞かないでくれ。
きっと、何を言っても嘘になる」
「……いえ。
志貴さまはわたしの主人です。
主人をだらしない方と蔑む使用人はおりません」
　無表情で、淡々と翡翠は語る。
　それきり会話はなくなって、自分の部屋に戻ろうと階段を昇っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This will make trouble for you too, Hisui, but I’d be grateful if you’d overlook it for a while. I’ll make my own way back, so just leave the gate unlocked.”
“You mean you cannot tell us why, Master Shiki.”
“Yes—I’m sorry, Hisui. You can think me irresponsible if you like, but please don’t ask me anything now. Anything I said would be a lie.”
“No. You are my master, Master Shiki. No servant would look down upon her master as irresponsible.”
Hisui spoke in the same calm, expressionless manner as ever.
The conversation ended there, and I started upstairs toward my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I know it's a burden to you, Hisui, but please overlook it.
I don't know what time I'll be back, so please just leave the gate unlocked."
"Shiki-sama, are you saying you will not tell us why?"
"…… Yeah, sorry Hisui.
You can think I'm totally irresponsible, but please don't ask.
I, don't want to have to lie."
"…… No.
You are my master.
A servant does not despise her master like that."
She speaks plainly and without any expression.
The conversation ends and I go up to return to my room.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「お待ちください」
「……その、差し出がましい事なのですが」
　翡翠は一度言葉をきってから、ぐっ、と両手を握り締めてこちらに視線を向けてきた。
「志貴さまさえよろしければ、夜に出掛ける事を秋葉さまにお隠しする事ができます」
「え？
　それって、つまり───口裏を合わせてくれるってこと？」
「───はい。
夕食後、秋葉さまはお部屋からお出になる事は稀です。
就寝前の見回りはわたしと姉さんがしておりますから、その報告に虚言をまぜてしまえば志貴さまが出掛けられた事は知られません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please wait.”
“…Forgive me for presuming.”
Hisui paused, clenched both hands, then made herself look directly at me.
“If you wish, Master Shiki, I can conceal your nightly outings from Miss Akiha.”
“What? You mean you’ll cover for me?”
“Yes. Miss Akiha rarely leaves her room after dinner. My sister and I conduct the final rounds before bedtime, so if we include a falsehood in our report, she will never know that Master Shiki left.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please wait."
"…… Forgive, my impertinence, but…"
After cutting off, she tightens both of her hands as she looks over at me.
"If you would like me to, Shiki-sama, I can keep your leaving a secret from Akiha-sama."
"Eh?
You mean, you're not---going to tell?"
"---Yes.
After dinner, it is extremely rare for Akiha-sama to leave her room.
Nee-san and I are responsible for conducting a patrol right before she sleeps, so if I do not tell the truth, she will not know."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「いや、そりゃあ助かる。
助かるけど……その、いいの？
　秋葉は二人の雇い主じゃないか」
「わたしの主人は志貴さまだと申しあげたはずですが」
 ───う……なんか、嬉しい。
　普段は『さま』づけなんてやめてくれ、なんて言っておきながら、こういう時にラッキーと思う自分が後ろめたいけど、嬉しいことは嬉しいのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That would be a tremendous help, but… are you sure? Akiha employs both of you.”
“I believe I already told you, Master Shiki: you are the one I serve.”
───Oh. That actually made me happy.
I was always telling her she didn’t have to be so formal with me, and now I felt guilty for being pleased when that devotion happened to work in my favor. Still, there was no denying how happy it made me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, that helps.
It helps, but…… is that okay?
Isn't she your employer?"
"I told you you are my master, Shiki-sama."
---uh…… I'm, kind of happy.
I always have to tell her to stop adding "sama", but at times like this, I think I'm incredibly lucky.
How can I help but be happy?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「うん―――助かる、ぜひそうしてくれ」
「それでは今夜からは裏口をご利用ください。
屋敷の正門は施錠いたしますが、裏手の使用人用の扉はカギがあれば気付かれずに出入りできます」
「へえ、使用人用の出入口なんてあったんだ。
どうりで翡翠が門から出掛けるのを見ないと思った」
「いえ、そちらを利用しているのは姉さんだけです。
鍵は姉さんが持っていますので、後程お届けにまいります」
　では、と一礼して翡翠は立ち去っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes—that would help enormously. Please do it.”
“Then beginning tonight, please use the rear entrance. The main gate will be locked, but with a key you can pass unnoticed through the servants’ door at the back.”
“I never knew there was a servants’ entrance. No wonder I’ve never seen you leave by the gate.”
“Only my sister uses it. She has the key, so I shall bring it to you later.”
With a brief “If you’ll excuse me,” Hisui bowed and departed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah----that helps, so if you can, please do so."
"Then please use the rear entrance tonight.
The front entrance will be locked, but if you have the key and use the servant's entrance, you can come and leave undetected."
"Oh?
There's a servant's entrance?
No wonder I never saw you leave through the gate."
"No, the only one who uses that is Nee-san.
She has the key, so I will get it to you later."
"Well then", she says, after which she bows and disappears.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「─────やった」
　思わぬところで救いの手が入ってくれた。
　これでこの先、秋葉に心配をかけることなくアルクェイドとの約束を守ることができそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes!”
Help had come from an unexpected quarter.
Now I could keep my promise to Arcueid without giving Akiha any further cause to worry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Alright!"
Help just came from an unexpected source.
With this, it seems I can keep my promise with Arcueid without worrying Akiha.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
夕食が終わって、部屋に閉じこもる。
　時刻はそろそろ夜の十時。
　夕食をとっている間、翡翠は俺の机の上に裏手の扉のカギを置いておいてくれた。
「よし―――行くか」
　ポケットにナイフをしまいこんで、できるだけ物音を立てないように部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
After dinner, I shut myself in my room.
It was nearly ten.
While I had been eating, Hisui had left the key to the rear door on my desk.
“All right—time to go.”
I slipped the knife into my pocket and left the room as quietly as I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After dinner, I go back to my room.
It's almost ten o'clock.
While I was eating, Hisui placed the key on my desk.
"Now then---shall I go?"
Placing my knife in my pocket, I leave my room as quietly as I can.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
―――翡翠には悪いけど、やっぱり本当の事は言えない。
　アルクェイドとの事は自分だけの秘密にするべきだし、俺が街を騒がしている殺人鬼を探している、なんて事は翡翠や琥珀さん、秋葉に知られてはいけない事だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I felt bad for Hisui, but I still couldn’t tell her the truth.
Whatever existed between Arcueid and me had to remain my secret. Hisui, Kohaku, and Akiha could never be allowed to discover that I was hunting the murderer terrorizing the city.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I feel bad doing this to Hisui, but I can't let her know.
I have to keep Arcueid a secret, and it's not like I can let Hisui or Kohaku-san, or Akiha know that I'm looking for the serial killer.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「いや、もう夜に出歩くなんていう用事はないよ。
今朝も秋葉にお小言をもらったし、しばらくは大人しくしてる」
「かしこまりました。
それでは、今夜も通常通りに門を閉めさせていただきます」
　無表情で、淡々と翡翠は語る。
　それきり会話はなくなって、自分の部屋に戻ることになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I don’t have any more reason to go wandering at night. Akiha lectured me about it this morning, so I’ll behave myself for a while.”
“Understood. Then I shall lock the gates at the usual time tonight.”
Hisui delivered the answer with her customary calm, expressionless face.
That ended the conversation, and I returned to my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I don't have any reason to go out.
Akiha scolded me today, so I'll stay put for a while."
"I understand.
Then I will close the gate at the normal time."
She speaks plainly, without any expression.
The conversation ends and I go up to return to my room.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
夕食が終わって、部屋に閉じこもる。
　時刻はそろそろ夜の十時。
　今日こそは見付からないように、細心の注意をもって外に出よう。
「よし―――行くか」
　ポケットにナイフをしまいこんで、できるだけ物音を立てないように部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
After dinner, I shut myself in my room.
It was nearly ten.
This time I would exercise the utmost caution and make certain no one saw me leave.
“All right—time to go.”
I slipped the knife into my pocket and left the room as quietly as I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After dinner, I go back to my room.
It's almost ten o'clock.
So as not to be discovered, I should go outside as discreetly as possible.
"Now then---shall I go?"
Placing my knife in my pocket, I leave my room as quietly as I can.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
通り魔事件の影響だろう、夜も十時ごろになれば公園はまったくの無人となる。
　誰もいない夜の公園。
　そこに、ぽつんと白い女のシルエットが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The serial killings had probably driven everyone indoors; by ten at night, the park was utterly deserted.
An empty park at night.
In it stood the solitary white silhouette of a woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's probably because of all the recent murders, but it's only ten o'clock and there's no one in the park.
The empty night hangs overhead.
There, a white figure stands.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「志貴！」
　顔を合わせるなり、アルクェイドは人を怒鳴りつけてくる。
「もう、何時だと思ってるのよ。
約束の時間を二十分もすぎちゃってるじゃない！」
「…………」
　どうも、アルクェイドは時間ぴったりに来ていたようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!”
Arcueid started shouting the instant she saw me.
“Do you have any idea what time it is? You’re twenty minutes late!”
“…”
Apparently she had arrived precisely on time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki!"
As soon as she sees me, Arcueid angrily yells at me.
"Hey, what time do you think it is?
You're twenty minutes late!"
"…………"
It seems she came here right on time.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ああ、悪かったよ。
こっちもちゃんと十時に家を出たんだけどさ、秋葉に気づかれないようにこっそり出てきたから時間がかかったんだ。
　次からはちゃんと時間を厳守するから、今回は大目に見てくれ」
「―――もう。
これから殺し合いに行くっていう自覚がないみたいね、貴方には」
　ぷんぷん、という擬音が似合いそうなぐらい、アルクェイドはご機嫌ななめだ。
　もしかして、約束の時間よりもっと前から待っていたんだろうか？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah, sorry. I left home at ten, but sneaking out without Akiha noticing took longer than I expected.
I’ll be punctual from now on, so let this one go.”
“Honestly. You don’t seem to understand that we’re about to go fight someone to the death.”
Arcueid was so cross that you could almost see her huffing in indignation.
Had she been waiting since long before our appointed time?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, sorry.
I left before ten o'clock, but it took some time trying to leave the mansion without Akiha noticing.
I'll definitely be on time the next time, so please forgive me."
"---Geez.
You don't seem to realize we are going to go killing."
Arcueid practically pouts.
Don't tell me, she was waiting long before the promised time?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド。
おまえさ、何時からここで待ってたんだ？」
「わたし？
　わたしは起きてからすぐここに来たから、ええっと――――」
　ふむ、と考え込むアルクェイド。
「―――七時ぐらいから居たみたい」
「七時って、それじゃあ三時間以上も待ってたっていうのか、おまえ」
　っていうか、約束の時間より三時間も前にやってきてどういうつもりなんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. What time did you get here?”
“Me? I came as soon as I woke up, so—”
Arcueid paused to think.
“I think it was around seven.”
“Seven? You’ve been waiting more than three hours?”
More to the point, why had she arrived three hours early in the first place?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid.
Since what time were you waiting for me?"
"Me?
I came here as soon as I woke up, so----"
"Hmm," Arcueid thinks this over.
"----Probably since seven o'clock."
"Seven?
You were waiting for more than three hours?"
What in the world was she thinking, coming three hours early?
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「なんか、わたしおかしいみたい」
　自分でも呆れているのか、アルクェイドはそんな独り言をもらす。
「―――まあ、遅れた俺も悪いけど、そっちにだって問題はあるぞ。
約束の時間より先に来て、かってに待たれても困る」
「む―――それとこれとは別問題でしょ。
志貴が遅れたっていうコトには変わらないんだから」
「……まあ、それはそうなんだけど。
しっかし、なんだって三時間も待ってたんだ。
それだけ時間があれば部屋に戻っていても良かったじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There’s something wrong with me.”
Even Arcueid sounded baffled by herself.
“I know I was late, but you’re at fault too. You can’t turn up hours early, decide to wait, and then blame me for it.”
“Hmph—that’s a separate issue. You were still late.”
“Well, yes. But why wait three whole hours? With that much time, you could have gone back to your room.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It seems I'm strange."
As if truly amazed, Arcueid mumbles to herself.
"---Well, I'm partly to blame because I was late, but don't you have some issues too?
If you come before the agreed time, then of course you'll have to wait."
"Hey---that's something entirely different.
The fact you were late doesn't change."
"…… Well, that is true.
But, why did you wait three hours?
If you had that much time, couldn't you have just gone back to your room?"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「そんなの、わたしにだって分からないわ。
なんとなく楽しかったから、このまま志貴を待っていてもいいかなって思ってたら、いつのまにか十時になってただけなんだから」
「？
　楽しかったって、なんで？」
「さあ。
自分にだって分からないって言ったでしょ。
……志貴に殺されたせいかしらね。
わたし、体のどこかが壊れて治ってないみたい。
自分でおかしいって思うんだけど、どこが、どうしておかしいのかてんで分からないんだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How should I know? I was enjoying myself somehow, so I thought I might as well keep waiting for you. Then, before I knew it, it was ten.”
“Enjoying yourself? Why?”
“I don’t know. I just told you I don’t understand it myself. Maybe it’s because you killed me. Something inside my body must have broken and never healed. I know I’m behaving strangely, but I have no idea what’s wrong with me, or why.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I… don't know why either.
It somehow was fun and while I was thinking it was nice waiting for you, it was already ten o'clock."
"?
Fun?
Why?"
"Who knows.
Didn't I say I didn't understand it myself?
…… Maybe because you killed me.
At that time, something broke that couldn't be healed.
I think it's strange myself, but I can't understand what's broken inside me."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「…………う」
　そう言われると、返答に困る。
　アルクェイドを十七個に解体してしまった手前、身体に異状があるといわれたら、こっちはもう平謝りするしかないじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh…”
Put that way, there wasn’t much I could say.
After carving Arcueid into seventeen pieces, if she told me something was wrong with her body, all I could do was bow and apologize.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Uh."
Having her say that is very troubling.
Having sliced her into seventeen pieces, if she says there's something wrong, all I can do is to apologize.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――ま、いいわ。
時間もなくなっちゃったし、無駄話をしている暇なんてないものね」
　うん、そう言ってもらえると実に助かる。
「でも、もし次も遅れるようなコトになったら、その時は直接志貴の家に迎えに行くからね。
約束を守れないのは志貴のほうなんだから、その時は文句はないでしょ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, never mind. We’ve lost enough time already, and we can’t afford to stand here chatting.”
Yes. I was immensely grateful to hear that.
“But if you’re late again, I’m coming straight to your house to collect you. You’ll be the one who broke our promise, so you won’t have any right to complain. Agreed?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It's okay.
We don't have much time, so we can't waste time talking about pointless things, Shiki."
Yeah, saying that really helps me out.
"But, if you're ever late again, I'll just have to go to your house and pick you up.
You're the one who couldn't keep the promise, so you have no complaints, right?"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――それはダメ！
　約束はちゃんと守るけど、今日みたいに不測の事態っていうのはいつでも起きえるんだ。
時間に遅れる、なんてのはその最たるもんじゃないか！
　いいか、まかり間違ってもうちに来るんじゃないぞ。
――ただでさえ秋葉には誤解されたままなんだから、これ以上俺の立場をややこしくしないでくれ」
「ふーん……あきはって、志貴に全然似てない妹さんのコト？」
「似てないっていうのは余計だけど、そうだよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh—no! I’ll keep our appointments, but unexpected things can always happen, just like tonight. Being late is the most obvious example!
Listen, no matter what happens, do not come to my house. Akiha already has the wrong idea about us. Please don’t make my position any worse than it is.”
“Hmm… Akiha is that little sister who looks nothing like you?”
“The part about us looking nothing alike was unnecessary, but yes.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stu---no way!
I'll keep it, but random unfortunate circumstances like today could happen at any time.
If I'm late, that'd be the last thing you should do!
Look, don't come to my house even if it's a mistake.
--What's more, Akiha doesn't know about all this, so please don't make things more complicated than they are!"
"Hmm?
…… Akiha?
Your sister that doesn't look at all like you?"
"You've said a little too much, but yes."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「そうなんだ。
志貴はそんなに妹さんが恐いの？」
「───うるさいな、妹には余計な心配をさせたくないだけだ。
……ただでさえあいつには迷惑をかけてんだから、これ以上疲れさせられないだろ」
「ふーん。
妹さんには優しいのね、志貴は」
「基本的に俺は誰にでも優しいんです。
ただ最近になって例外が一人できてしまいましたが」
「あはは、それってわたしのことだー」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Are you really that afraid of your sister?”
“Shut up—I just don’t want to worry her. I’ve already caused her enough trouble, so I can’t make things any harder for her.”
“Hmm. You’re very kind to your sister, Shiki.”
“As a rule, I’m kind to everyone. It’s only recently that I’ve acquired one exception.”
“Ahaha! That means me!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
You're that scared of your little sister?"
"---Shut up.
I just don't want to worry her.
…… At the very best, I'm a bother to her, so I don't want to tire her out even further."
"Hmm.
You really are sweet to your sister, Shiki."
"I'm basically nice to everyone.
Well, recently there's been an exception to that."
"Ahaha, that's me!"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……わかんないヤツだな。
いまのは皮肉で言ったんだ。
誉めたんじゃなくて悪口を言ったんだぞ、俺」
「そんなことないよ。
わたしは志貴の例外ってことでしょ？
　わたしね、そうゆうの嫌いじゃないんだ」
　まだアルクェイドは笑っている。
　子供みたいに屈託のない、明るい笑顔。
「…………」
　なんか、これ以上見ているとこっちの毒気が抜かれてしまいそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really don’t understand anything. That was sarcasm. I was insulting you, not praising you.”
“That’s not true. It means I’m your exception, doesn’t it? I don’t mind being that.”
Arcueid was still smiling.
A bright, guileless smile, like a child’s.
“…”
If I kept looking at that smile, I was going to lose the will to stay angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're always dense.
That was an insult, not a compliment."
"Not at all.
To you, I'm an exception, right?
How could I not like that?"
She smiles again.
A child's smile, bright and carefree.
"………"
If I keep seeing that, I'll lose all my venom.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――いいや、なんか疲れた。
　いいかげん吸血鬼探しを始めよう、アルクェイド」
「そうね、時間的にも頃合だし。
それじゃこれから街を歩きまわってみるんだけど―――」
「志貴。
貴方にはメガネを外して付いてきてほしいんだけど、いいかしら？」
「メガネを外してって……なんで？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget it. I’m tired.
Let’s start hunting the vampire already, Arcueid.”
“All right. The timing should be about right. We’ll start by walking around town, but—”
“Shiki, I want you to take off your glasses before you come with me. Is that all right?”
“Take off my glasses… why?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I'm tired all of a sudden.
Let's start looking for the vampire, Arcueid."
"Yes, it's about time.
Then we'll start walking around town---"
"Shiki.
I want you to take off your glasses, but is that alright?"
"Take off my glasses?
…… Why?"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「わたしだけじゃ見つけにくいからよ。
　人間と人間じゃないものの気配は分かるけど、それだけじゃいつまでたっても本体である吸血鬼は見つけ出せない。
　わたしが分かるのは気配だけ。
けど、志貴なら目で見て生者か死者かを判別できる。
それを利用しないのは勿体ないでしょう？」
「―――――」
　……アルクェイドの言っているコトは、まあそれなりに納得できる。
　けど、メガネを外して行動するのは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because I’ll have trouble finding it alone.
I can sense whether something is human or not, but that won’t lead me to the vampire itself. All I can sense is presence.
You, on the other hand, can look at someone and distinguish the living from the dead. It would be foolish not to use that.”
“…”
What Arcueid said made a certain amount of sense.
But walking around without my glasses—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's hard to notice them with just me.
I can sense the presence of humans and non-humans, but that won't help me find the vampire.
All I can sense is the presence, but with your eyes, you can quickly tell between living and dead things.
So it's a waste if we don't use what we have, right?"
"-----"
…… Certainly I can understand what she's saying.
But, taking off my glasses means---
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「わかってる。
ここ数日、志貴の目が強くなってるのはわたしだって感じてるわ。
だからここでそんなことをしたら、志貴の体に大きく負担をかける事になるでしょうね。
　わたしはそれを承知で言ってるのよ。
けど、あくまで決定権は志貴にあるから強制はしない。
志貴が大丈夫だって判断するのなら、メガネを外してついてきて」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I know. Even I can feel that your eyes have grown stronger these past few days. Doing this now will put a terrible strain on your body.
I’m asking despite knowing that, but the choice is still yours. I won’t force you. If you decide you can bear it, take off your glasses and come with me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I know.
Even I could feel your eyes getting stronger these past few days.
And if you keep doing this, it may not be good for your health.
I'm still saying despite that.
But, the choice lies up to you, so I'm not going to force you.
If you think it's alright to do so, take your glasses off and follow me."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……メガネを外して街を歩く、か。
　そんなコト、このメガネをもらってからの八年間、一度もやったことがない。
　そもそもメガネを外してモノを見るだけで頭痛が走るっていうのに、その状態で街を歩いたらどうなるのかは容易に想像できる。
　それでも。
　傷が塞がっていないのにこうしているアルクェイドのように、遠野志貴も何らかの負債を払わなければいけないというのなら――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Walking through town without my glasses…
In all eight years since I was given them, I had never done such a thing.
Looking at anything bare-eyed was enough to bring on a headache. It wasn’t hard to imagine what walking through an entire city that way would do to me.
Even so.
If Arcueid was out here despite her unhealed wounds, then Shiki Tohno had a debt of his own to pay—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Take off my glasses and walk around town?
I haven't done that since I received these glasses eight years ago.
In the first place, the things I see without my glasses give me such a headache, it'd be easy to imagine what would happen if I walked around town.
But still.
Just like Arcueid who keeps going even though her wound hasn't healed, Tohno Shiki should do the same and pay back his debt----
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、俺は―――」
―――大丈夫、たかだか頭痛じゃないか。
　体の痛みを堪えているアルクェイドに比べれば、その程度は大した問題にはならないだろう。
「いいよ、メガネを外してついていく。
それでカタがつくっていうんなら安いもんだろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, I—”
―――I would be fine. It was only a headache.
Compared with the pain Arcueid was enduring throughout her body, that was nothing.
“All right. I’ll take them off and come with you. If that settles this, it’s a small price.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, I---"
---I'm fine, isn't it just a headache?
Compared to the pain her body must be feeling, this is nothing.
"It's fine, I can take off my glasses.
It's a small price to pay to make our search easier."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――そう。
なら行きましょう、志貴」
　アルクェイドは背中を向けて歩き始める。
　メガネを外して、アルクェイドの後に付いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then let’s go, Shiki.”
Arcueid turned and began to walk.
I removed my glasses and followed her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
Then let's go, Shiki."
Arcueid turns around and starts walking.
I take off my glasses as I follow her.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……アルクェイドの後をついていく。
　こうしてラクガキだらけの風景を歩くのなんて、入院していた時以来だ。
「――――」
　不思議と頭痛はしていない。
　ただ視るだけならそう頭痛はしないらしい。
　ただ、建物にある薄い線ではなく、道を歩いていく人間の『線』を見るたびに気分が悪くなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I followed behind Arcueid.
I hadn’t walked through this scribbled-over world since the days when I was in the hospital.
“…”
Strangely, my head didn’t hurt.
Merely looking seemed to cause little pain.
But whenever I saw the ‘lines’ on people walking past—not the pale ones on buildings—nausea rose in me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I follow Arcueid.
I haven't walked in scenery so riddled with lines since my hospitalization back then.
"----"
Strangely enough, I don't get a headache.
It seems just seeing them won't cause it.
It's not the thin lines in the buildings, but seeing the "lines" on the people walking by makes me sick.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
以前はただ、アレが切れやすい線だと思っていた。
　けれど今はアレがモノの『死』なのだと知ってしまった。
　だから、嫌悪感が先にくる。
　体中にラクガキがある人の姿が気色悪いんじゃない。
　そんなにも―――人間というのはそんなにも死に易い生き物なのかと知らされているようで、ただ、吐き気がするだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once, I had thought they were simply lines that could be cut.
Now I knew they were the ‘death’ inherent in things.
Revulsion came first.
It wasn’t the sight of people covered from head to toe in scribbles that sickened me.
It was being shown just how easily—how terribly easily—a human being could die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Before, I thought they were just lines that were easy to cut along.
But now I know they are the "death" of things.
That's why I feel disgust first.
It's not that those figures of people scribbled over with lines are disgusting.
Just seeing---that humans are an existence so close to death makes me feel like throwing up.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
……夜の街を歩く。
　アルクェイドは何も言わずに、何か目的でもあるように迷うことなく歩いていく。
　数時間かけて、街じゅうを歩きまわって。
　結局、ただの一つも、異状な『死』を内包した人間を見つける事はできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We walked through the city at night.
Arcueid said nothing and moved without hesitation, as though she had a destination in mind.
We spent several hours ranging across the city.
In the end, we failed to find a single person who harbored an abnormal ‘death.’
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… We walk the nighttime streets.
Arcueid doesn't say anything, she just continues to stride forth resolutely.
We walk for hours in the midst of town.
In the end, we don't see one aberration, not one person wrapped in "death".
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「志貴、メガネをつけていいわ。
どうやら今夜は探し回っても無駄みたい」
　はあ、とため息をついて、アルクェイドは結論を下した。
　メガネをかける。
　視界が健全なものに戻って、ホッと胸を撫で下ろした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, you can put your glasses back on. It looks like searching any longer tonight would be pointless.”
With a sigh, Arcueid pronounced the hunt over.
I put my glasses on.
My vision returned to sanity, and relief loosened my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, you can put your glasses back on.
It seems like no matter how much we search tonight, it'll be useless."
Arcueid concludes with a sigh.
I put my glasses back on.
My vision returns back to normal and I relax.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「今夜は無駄みたいって、そんな簡単に見きりをつけていいのかよ。
まだ一回しか街を見まわってないじゃないか」
「ううん、一回見まわれば十分よ。
気配っていうのはね、多少はその場所に残留するものなの。
今夜は死者の気配がどこにもなかったから、活動している死者はいないわ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Pointless tonight? Aren’t you giving up awfully quickly? We’ve only made one circuit of the city.”
“No, once is enough. A presence leaves traces behind in a place. There was no trace of the Dead anywhere tonight, so none of them are active.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Useless?
Is it okay to just decide that all of a sudden?
We've only looked everywhere once, right?"
"No, just once is enough.
The presence of The Dead tends to linger around a place.
I haven't sensed any of them around at all, so there aren't any that are active."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……敵もほとんどの死者を倒されて警戒してるんでしょうね。
　まったく、どこまで小心者なんだか。
てっきり今晩あたりにでも決着をつけにくるって予想してたのに、まだ隠れんぼを続けたいみたい」
　アルクェイドは不満そうに唇を噛む。
「不機嫌そうだな、アルクェイド」
「当然でしょう。
せっかく志貴が手伝ってくれてるのに、これじゃ意味がないじゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The enemy must be wary after losing nearly all of the Dead under its control.
What a coward. I expected it to come settle matters tonight, but apparently it wants to keep playing hide-and-seek.”
Arcueid bit her lip in frustration.
“You look upset, Arcueid.”
“Of course I am. You went to all this trouble to help me, and it was completely wasted.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… The enemy is alert now that most of his Dead are defeated.
Seriously, he really is a coward.
I was so prepared to finish it all tonight, but it appears he still wants to play hide and seek."
Arcueid bites her lip, dissatisfied.
"You look like you're in a bad mood, Arcueid."
"Of course I am.
You went through such trouble to help me, but it's all meaningless now."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――まあ、俺はかまわないんだけどさ。
そんなにご不満なら、もう一度街を見てまわってもかまわないよ。
俺も今度は意識を集中して視るからさ、もしかしたら何か見つけられるかもしれない」
「ダメよ。
これ以上志貴に無理はさせられない」
「無理って、別に俺は無理なんかしてないけど？」
「してるのよ。
志貴本人は気がついてないでしょうけど、これ以上脳を酷使したら廃人になりかねないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t really mind. If you’re that dissatisfied, we can make another circuit. This time I’ll concentrate harder when I look. Maybe I’ll find something.”
“No. I’m not letting you push yourself any further.”
“Push myself? I’m not pushing myself at all.”
“You are. You may not notice it, but if you work your brain any harder, you could reduce yourself to a vegetable.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Well, I don't really mind.
If you're that dissatisfied, I don't mind going out to look again.
Maybe if I concentrate more we can find something."
"That's no good.
I can't strain you any more."
"Strain?
I'm not really straining."
"You are.
You might not realize it, but if you abuse your brain anymore, you might end up disabled."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……？
　廃人って、誰が？」
「貴方がよ。
―――そっか、志貴は自分の目がどうゆうふうに働いているものだか知らないんだっけ」
「いい？
　志貴は生物の死は視やすくて、鉱物の死は視にくいって言ってたでしょ？
　それはね、結局は貴方の脳の回線の問題なの。
　モノの死。
その因果を視る、ということは、実際は見ているではなく読んでいる、という意味合いに近いわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…? Me?”
“You. That’s right—you don’t know how your eyes actually work, do you?”
“Listen carefully. You said the death of living creatures is easy to see, while the death of minerals is difficult, remember?
That comes down to the circuitry in your brain.
When you perceive the death of a thing—when you see the chain of cause and effect leading to its end—you aren’t truly looking at it so much as reading it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
Disabled?
Who?"
"You.
---That's right, you don't exactly know how your eyes work."
"Okay?
You said yourself it was easier to see the death of living things than non-living things, right?
Basically, it's a problem of the circuitry of your brain.
The death of things.
Being able to see that cause and effect, it's closer to reading than seeing."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「……物事には大本になった原因、絶対の一があるの。
ええーと、ドイツの学者さんがアカシックレコードとか名づけたものと同じね。
　ようするに、事象の中心には『全てを記録したモノ』がある。
記録、というよりは『有る』ものだから、情報っていうわけじゃない。
ただ『有る』だけ。
それ自体に意思はないし、方向性もありえない。
　ただ原因を垂れ流しているだけの、根源の渦みたいなものね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Everything has a first cause, an absolute One. It’s something like what a German scholar called the Akashic Records.
In other words, at the heart of all phenomena is ‘that which records everything.’ Though ‘record’ isn’t quite right, because it isn’t information. It simply exists. It has no will of its own, and no possible direction.
Think of it as a vortex at the Root that does nothing but spill causes into existence.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Everything has a main reason, the one source.
Um, it's the same thing that a German scientist called the Akashic Record.
In other words, in the core of all phenomenon, there is something that "records all things".
It's less of a record than an "existence", so it isn't information.
It just exists.
It doesn't have any purpose in and of itself, or any direction.
It's like a root swirl from which flows out all reasons."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「この世界にあるものは、その渦から流れ、派生して、今のカタチを保っている。
わたしも志貴も、吸血種も人間も、もとはそこから始まったものなの。
　……もう複雑に離れすぎてしまって、原因である始まりに戻ることはできないけど、とにかくそういった“一”があるのは分かるでしょう？
　
　でもね、たとえどんなに大本からかけ離れたカタチになってしまったとしても、そこから派生した存在である以上、とても細い線だけど糸はつながっているのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Everything in this world flowed out of that vortex, branched away from it, and assumed its present form. You and I, humans and every vampiric species—we all began there.
We’ve grown too complex and wandered too far to return to that first cause, but you understand that this One exists, don’t you?
And however far a thing’s present form may have strayed from the source, if it arose from there, a thread still connects them—infinitely fine, but unbroken.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Things in this world flowed from that, derived from that, and preserve their current form.
You and I, vampires and humans, we all originated from that.
…… Things became more complex and separate, and cannot return to that original source, the beginning.
But you understand that there exists "The One", right?
But, no matter how different a form something takes from the great source, it is still a derivative.
So even if it is only a slender line, there is a thread connecting to the source."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「全ての根源、全ての始まりと終わりを記録したレコード。
それと繋がっているものは、物事の終わりを『識っている』ことになる。
　もともと脳っていうのは受信と送信をつかさどる機能なんだけど、たいていの人間はみんなその回線が自分に対してのみで閉じてしまっている。
　けど、中には潜在的に回線が開けてしまっている人間がいるわ。
なんの魔術回路も利用せず、超越種でさえないのに超常現象を可能とする人間。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The Root of everything: a record containing every beginning and every end. Anything connected to it ‘knows’ how things end.
The brain is fundamentally an organ for transmitting and receiving, but in most people its circuitry is closed upon the self.
But some people are born with those circuits open. They can cause supernatural phenomena without using a single Magic Circuit, despite not belonging to any transcendent species.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The source of all things, the record that records the beginning and the end of all things.
Being connected to that means knowing the end of all things.
Originally the brain has the ability to control reception and transmission, but most humans close off all of these circuits except for themselves.
But, there are those people who have their circuits open latently.
Without a single use of Magic Circuits, there are humans who, despite not being of a transcendental race, have the potential to create transcendent phenomena.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「これをね、魔術師たちは超能力者って区分している。
人間でありながら、生まれついて何らかの魔術回路そのものという突然変異体。
―――例えば何の神秘も学んでいないのに『物の死』を視てしまう人間とか、ね」
「――――――」
　……いや、申し訳ないんだけど、アルクェイド。
　せっかくのお話を、どうも俺の脳みそはまったく理解してくれてなさそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mages classify those people as psychics. They’re human mutants born as something equivalent to a Magic Circuit in their own right.
―――Someone who can see the ‘death of things’ without ever studying the mysteries, for example.”
“…”
I was sorry, Arcueid, truly.
But despite all the trouble she had taken, my brain seemed to have understood none of that whatsoever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Magi classify them as being psychics.
While still human, they are mutants who are born with Magic Circuits.
---Such as, without any learning of the occult, someone who can see the 'death of things'."
"------"
…… Um, I'm sorry, Arcueid.
It appears I can't understand this kind of conversation at all.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「いいわよ、志貴は理解なんかしなくて。
　ただ言っておきたいのは、あんまり視えにくいモノを自分から視ようとしちゃダメっていうこと。
　たぶん、志貴はその気になれば鉱物の『死』を確実に視るコトができる。
　けどそのために脳が生物という範疇から鉱物の範疇に回線を開いて、鉱物の死を識ろうとしてしまう。
―――それは、本来ありえない運動よ。
　だから脳が過負荷をおこして、志貴は間違いなく使い物にならなくなる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s fine. You don’t need to understand.
What you do need to remember is never to force yourself to see the death of something that won’t come into focus.
If you truly tried, you could probably see the ‘death’ of minerals with perfect clarity.
But to do it, your brain would have to open its circuitry beyond living things and into the category of minerals, then attempt to comprehend mineral death.
―――That operation should be impossible.
Your brain would overload, and you would unquestionably destroy yourself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's okay if you can't understand.
But what I want to tell you is you shouldn't try to see things that are hard to see.
Probably, if you want to, you can see the "death" of non-living things.
But in order to do that, your brain has to open its circuits from the classification of living things to the classification of non-living things in order to understand.
---That is normally an impossible process.
As a result, it overloads your brain, and you'll end up being useless."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「使い物にならなくなるって―――その、この目が死を視なくなってくれるっていう事？」
「―――まさか。
ねえ志貴、無理をしてオーバーブロウしたエンジンっていうのはどうなるかしら」
「そりゃあジャンク行きだろ。
一度でも壊れたエンジンは二度と使い物にならな――――」
　ああ、そういうコト。
　つまりは、死を見ている時の頭痛は、スピードをあげすぎて悲鳴をあげているエンジンと同じだったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Destroy myself… Do you mean these eyes would stop seeing death?”
“Of course not. Shiki, what happens to an engine that’s pushed until it blows?”
“It goes to the scrapyard. Once an engine breaks, it’s never useful again—”
Oh. So that was what she meant.
The headaches I felt when I looked at death were like an engine screaming because it had been driven too fast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Useless---you mean, these eyes won't be able to perceive death anymore?"
"---Of course not.
Hey Shiki, what happens to an engine that blows up from overload?"
"It goes to the junk yard.
Once an engine breaks, you can't use it agai----"
Oh, that's it.
In other words, the headache I get from seeing death is like the screaming of an engine that is working too fast.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
「わかった？
　ただ視えているだけなら問題はないでしょうけど、視えないモノを視ようとするのだけは止めて。
脳内の血管が破裂して、それこそ取り返しのつかない事になるから」
　……言葉がない。
　そんな大変なことを知らずに、俺は今まで生きてきたっていうんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
“Do you understand now? Merely seeing what presents itself should be safe, but never strain to see what you can’t. A blood vessel in your brain could rupture, and then there would be no undoing the damage.”
I had no answer.
I had lived all this time without knowing something so serious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
"You understand?
If you can just see it, it won't be a problem.
But stop trying to see things you can't perceive.
The blood vessels in your brain will burst, and it'll all be over."
…… I'm speechless.
I've been living like this without realizing the seriousness of it all.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「そのメガネを作ってくれた魔術師には感謝しないとね。
たいていの超能力者は、自分の力がどんなに危険なものか知らずに使用して、自分から廃人になってしまう。
　……まあ、人間でありながら人間たちの社会にはいきられない存在不適合者だから、そのほうが幸せなのかもしれないけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You should be grateful to the mage who made those glasses. Most psychics use their powers without understanding the danger and reduce themselves to wrecks.
Though perhaps that’s kinder in the end. They’re human, yet fundamentally unfit to live in human society.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You really have to thank the magus who gave you those glasses.
Most psychics use their abilities without realizing how dangerous they are and end up disabling themselves.
…… Well, those kinds of people are often incompatible with society, so maybe that's just for the best."
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
―――それが、私がここにきた理由のようだし。
　　　あなたを元の普通の生活に戻してあげる。
　先生はそう言って、このメガネを作ってくれた。
　……感謝すべきことが多すぎて、胸がつまる。
　あの人は、本当に色んな意味で、あの時に今の遠野志貴を救っていてくれたんだ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――That seems to be why I came here.
I’ll give you back your ordinary life.
My teacher had said that, and made these glasses for me.
There was so much to thank her for that my chest tightened.
In every sense of the word, she had saved the Shiki Tohno I was now, all those years ago—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
---It seems like that's the reason I'm here.
I'll let you go back to living the life you had before.
Sensei said that, and gave me these glasses.
…… I have so much to thank her for, my chest tightens.
That person, in so many ways, really did save me---
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「あ、れ―――？」
　ずきり、と何か感触がした。
　痛みではなく、どちらかといえば痒みのような、おかしな感触。
「志貴？」
「いや―――なんだ、これ」
　ほんの一瞬だけの感触は、胸に起きた物のようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Something twinged.
It wasn’t pain, but closer to an itch—an odd, nameless sensation.
“Shiki?”
“No… what is this?”
The fleeting sensation seemed to have come from my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H, uh---?"
I feel a, sharp sensation.
Not pain, but something strange, like an itch.
"Shiki?"
"What---what is this?"
It was really only just for an instant, but it was like something was in my chest.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「ん―――？」
　わけもわからず、首元からシャツの中に手をいれた。
―――ぬるり。
　何か。
　胸には、絵の具のようなものが、付着している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm…?”
Without knowing why, I slipped a hand through my collar and into my shirt.
―――Something wet and slick.
Something.
Something like paint clung to my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm---?"
Not understanding, I place my hand inside my shirt.
---Wetness.
Something.
Something is sticking to my chest, like ink.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「なんだろ……なんか、濡れてる」
　シャツの中から手を引っ張り出す。
　開いた手の平には。
　真っ赤な血が、べったり、と。
「え―――――」
　ちくん。
　またおかしな感触がする。
　それが胸の古傷からしているものなのだと理解するのに、ひどく時間がかかってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is this—it’s wet.”
I drew my hand out of my shirt.
In my open palm.
It was plastered with brilliant red blood.
“What—”
A tiny sting.
That strange sensation again.
It took me far too long to realize that it came from the old scar on my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is this…… something's, wet?"
I pull out my hand from my shirt.
On my open palms,
is bright red blood.
"Eh------"
Sting.
Another strange sensation.
It takes me a horribly long time to understand that it's coming from the old scar on my chest.
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
「志貴、それ――――」
「ああ……ヘンだな、痛くもないし傷も開いてないのに―――胸から血がにじんでる」
　なんて、赤い。
　綺麗で、濁りのない、目を奪うセキショク。
「ま、痛みはないんだしとりあえずは大丈夫かな。
血もこれしか滲んでないみたいだし、気にする必要は―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, that—”
“Yeah—it’s strange; it doesn’t hurt and the wound hasn’t opened, but blood is seeping from my chest.”
So red.
A pure, unclouded, irresistible RED.
“Well, it doesn’t hurt, so I’m probably fine for now. That seems to be all the blood, too. There’s no need to—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, that----"
"Yeah…… that's weird.
It doesn't hurt and it's not even an open wound----but there's blood all over my chest."
It's so, red.
A beautiful, unmuddied, red that steals my eyesight.
"Well, it doesn't hurt so it's gotta be okay.
It seems to have stopped bleeding, so there's no need to----"
entries.scriptLabel: 7 / Mystic Eyes of Death Perception II

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは呆然と俺の手を見ている。
　いや、正しくは。
　俺の手にべったりと付着した、赤い血を見つめている。
「―――アルクェイド？」
「――――――――」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　ただ、その呼吸が荒々しく乱れ出している。
　はあ、はあ、と痛みを堪えるように、乱れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid was staring blankly at my hand.
No—not at my hand.
At the red blood smeared thickly across it.
“Arcueid?”
“…”
Arcueid didn’t answer.
Her breathing grew ragged and violent.
Hah, hah—ragged as though she were enduring terrible pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
