I fell abruptly asleep, as if succumbing to one of my usual anemic spells.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it's nothing.
Just talking about a dream."
"Is that so?
Then, good night, Nii-san.
Please rest well."
"Yeah, I'll do that."
As soon as I answer her,
I fall asleep as fast as if I had passed out again.

entries.japanese:
……秋葉が俺の体を心配してくれるのは嬉しい。
けど、アルクェイドとの約束を破るわけにはいかない。
　昨日、アルクェイドは三時間も俺を待っていた。
　だからっていうわけじゃないけど、こんないつもの貧血ぐらいであいつに待ちぼうけをさせるのはイヤだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
…I was glad Akiha cared about my health. But I couldn’t break my promise to Arcueid.
Yesterday she had waited three hours for me. That wasn’t the only reason, but I couldn’t stand the thought of leaving her there again over one of my routine anemic spells.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm happy she's so worried about me.
But I can't break my promise with Arcueid.
Yesterday, she waited three hours for me.
That's not the whole reason, but with just my usual anemia, I don't want her to keep on waiting.

entries.japanese:
「わかった、今日はおとなしく眠るコトにする」
　言って、ベッドに体を横たえた。
「ほんとう……？
　あとになって部屋を抜け出したりするのもナシですよ？」
「……あのな。
こんな体で、秋葉たちの目を盗んで外に出れると思うか？」
「――――ええ、言われてみればそうですね」
　ほう、と肩をおとして秋葉は息をはく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll be good and go to sleep tonight.”
With that, I stretched out on the bed.
“Really…? You won’t sneak out later?”
“…Look at me. Do you honestly think I could slip past all of you and get outside in this condition?”
“Yes… now that you mention it.”
Akiha’s shoulders sagged as she let out a long breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright.
I'll go to sleep for today."
saying that, I lie down.
"Really……?
You're not going to sneak out of the room later?"
"…… Hey now.
Do you think I could sneak out in this shape?"
"----Yes, come to think of it, that is true."
Akiha breathes out and visibly relaxes.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、琥珀に兄さんが目を覚ました事を伝えにいって。
兄さん、夕食はどうしますか？」
「……いや、琥珀さんには悪いけど、食べられそうにない。
今夜はこのまま眠るから、俺のことは放っておいていいよ」
「……わかりました。
じゃあ翡翠、そう琥珀に伝えてきて」
　翡翠はうつむいたままコクン、とうなずいて部屋から出て行く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, go tell Kohaku that Brother is awake. Brother, would you like dinner?”
“…No. I feel bad for Kohaku, but I don’t think I could eat. I’m going to sleep through the night, so you can leave me alone.”
“…Very well. Hisui, please tell Kohaku that.”
Still looking down, Hisui gave a small nod and left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, tell Kohaku that Nii-san is awake.
Nii-san, what about dinner?"
"…… Oh yeah.
No, tell Kohaku-san I'm sorry, but I don't think I can eat right now.
I'm just going to go to sleep."
"…… I understand.
Then Hisui, tell Kohaku that."
Still looking downcast, Hisui nods and leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「じゃあ私も退室しますね。
なにかありましたら遠慮なく呼んでください。
何時だろうとすぐに駆けつけますから」
entries.maoEnglish: “Then I’ll leave as well. If you need anything, please call me without hesitation. Whatever the hour, I’ll come at once.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then I will go back to my room.
If anything happens, please call for me.
No matter what time it is, I'll come right away."

entries.japanese:
部屋の電気を消して秋葉は立ち去っていった。
「……すまない、秋葉」
　呟いて、体を起こす。
「くっ………」
　体を起こしただけで、くらりと意識が遠のく。
　……今回の貧血はただの貧血じゃない。
　それは解っているけど、アルクェイドをいつまでも待たせるわけにはいかない。
　アイツの事だから、放っておいたらバカ正直に何時間も待つに決まってるんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha switched off the light and left.
“…I’m sorry, Akiha.”
Murmuring the apology, I sat up.
“Ngh…”
Merely sitting up made my consciousness waver.
This episode wasn’t ordinary anemia.
I knew that, but I couldn’t leave Arcueid waiting forever.
Knowing her, she would stand there with idiotic honesty for hours if I never came.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha turns off the lights and leaves the room.
"…… Sorry, Akiha."
Saying that, I lift myself up.
"Ggh………"
Just lifting myself up causes my consciousness to swim.
…… This isn't like my normal anemia.
I know that, but I can't keep Arcueid waiting forever.
Knowing her, even if I left her there, she'll wait forever.

entries.japanese:
おぼつかない足取りで机までたどり着く。
　引き出しからナイフを取って、上着を羽織る。
「はっ……まいったな、これじゃ本当に、秋葉たちの目は、盗めない」
　……あと少し、せめて満足に走れるぐらい体力を回復させないと、翡翠に見付かって部屋に戻されてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I staggered to the desk.
I took the knife from its drawer and pulled on my jacket.
“Hah… this is bad. I really can’t slip past them like this.”
…I needed a little longer—at least enough strength to run properly—or Hisui would find me and march me straight back to bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wobble to my desk.
I take my knife out of the drawer and put on my jacket.
"Heh…… dang, like this, I really, won't be able to, sneak out."
…… I have to gather up my strength just a little more until I can at least run comfortably or Hisui will find me and take me back to my room.

entries.japanese:
「……わるいアルクェイド。
今日は、昨日より遅刻しそうだ」
　床に腰を下ろす
　一時間。
あと一時間体を休めれば、なんとか屋敷を出れるだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Sorry, Arcueid. I’m going to be even later than yesterday.”
I lowered myself to the floor.
One hour. If I rested for one more hour, I might just manage to leave the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry Arcueid.
It looks like I'll be even later than last night."
I sit down on the floor.
One hour.
If I rest for another hour, I'm sure I can leave----

entries.japanese:
公園に着いたのは十二時前だった。
　結局、一時間程度の休憩じゃ体は回復してくれず、おぼつかない足取りでここまで来るのに一時間近くかかってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was nearly midnight when I reached the park.
An hour’s rest hadn’t restored me after all, and the walk there on unsteady legs had taken almost another hour.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I make it to the park before midnight.
In the end, even after waiting an hour my body still hadn't recovered, so it took me an hour to get there.

entries.japanese:
「……はぁ……は……」
　肩で呼吸をしながら周囲を見渡す。
　夜の公園。
待ち合わせ場所である休憩所に、ぽつんと白い人影が立ち尽くしている。
「……やっぱり、待ってた」
　はあ、と大きく息を吐く。
　と、アルクェイドもやってきた俺に気がついたようだ。
　カツカツと足音をたてて、アルクェイドは一直線にこっちに歩いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah…”
Panting hard, I looked around.
The park lay dark around me. A solitary white figure stood at the shelter where we had agreed to meet.
“…I knew she’d wait.”
I let out a long breath.
Then Arcueid noticed me.
Her heels struck out a hard rhythm as she came straight toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I pant heavily.
As my chest heaves rapidly, I look around me.
Night hangs over the park.
Near the place we decided to meet, there's a white figure standing.
"…… I knew she'd be waiting."
I let out a large breath.
It seems like Arcueid notices I'm here.
She walks straight towards me.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと志貴、約束の時間を二時間もオーバーするなんてどうゆう―――」
　人の顔を見るなり、アルクェイドは絶句している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, what do you mean turning up two hours—”
The moment she saw my face, Arcueid fell speechless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki, it's already two hours past the agreed time.
What were----"
She cuts off as soon as she sees my face.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと、どうしたの志貴……？
　顔は真っ青だし、生気だってこれっぽっちも感じられないなんて、普通じゃないわよ」
「ああ、ちょっと貧血ぎみなんだ。
時々こういうふうになるから、そう驚かなくてもいい。
　……それよりごめんな、二時間も待たせちまって」
「え―――ううん、わたしは別にかまわないけど……志貴、そんな体で出てくるなんて、ヘンだよ」
　ついさっきまで本気で怒っていたくせに、今度は本気で俺の体の心配をしているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, what happened to you…? You’re white as a sheet. I can barely feel any life in you at all. This isn’t normal.”
“It’s just a little anemia. This happens sometimes, so you don’t need to panic.
…More importantly, I’m sorry I made you wait two hours.”
“What? Oh… I don’t mind, but… Shiki, coming out in this condition is crazy.”
She had been genuinely furious only moments ago, yet now she seemed genuinely worried about me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, what's wrong, Shiki……?
Your face is so pale, and I can't even sense life in you.
This isn't normal."
"Yeah, my anemia acted up again.
It happens like that every now and then, nothing to be surprised about.
…… more importantly, sorry for making you wait for two hours."
"Eh----No, I really don't mind, but…… Shiki, for you to come out in your condition is just weird."
Even though she was really angry earlier, now it seems she's really worried.

entries.japanese:
「―――だって約束だろ。
アルクェイドの手伝いをするって言ったんだから、これぐらいじゃさぼれないよ」
「……それは嬉しいけど……志貴、貴方自分の体のことぜんぜんわかってないのね」
「アルクェイドに言われるまでもないよ。
俺だって八年間も慢性的な貧血持ちをやってるんだから、自分の体のことぐらいわかってる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I made a promise. I said I’d help you, and this isn’t enough to make me skip out.”
“…I’m glad, but… Shiki, you don’t understand your own body at all.”
“I don’t need you to tell me about my body. I’ve lived with chronic anemia for eight years. I know what I can handle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I made a promise, didn't I?
I said I'd help you, so I'm not going to skip out on you."
"…… That makes me happy but…… Shiki, you don't seem to understand your body at all."
"You don't need to tell me that, Arcueid.
I've been carrying this recurring anemia for eight years now, I'm pretty sure I understand my body."

entries.japanese:
「―――いいえ。
志貴は自分がどんなに不安定な命をしているか分かってない。
前からそんな気はしてたけど、これではっきりしたわ。
　志貴、貴方は普段からとても死に近い所に立っている。
　それが直死の魔眼の反動かは解らないけど、とにかく波のように生と死の境界を行き来してるのよ。
　だから―――貴方の貧血とやらは、前も大丈夫だったから今回も大丈夫、なんていうのは間違ってる」
　冷たい目をして、アルクェイドはじっと俺の目を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. You don’t understand how precarious your hold on life is. I suspected it before, but now I’m certain.
Shiki, you always stand terribly close to death.
I don’t know whether it’s a consequence of the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, but you keep crossing back and forth over the boundary between life and death like a tide. So you can’t assume this spell of ‘anemia’ is safe merely because the last one was.”
Arcueid fixed me with a cold, unwavering stare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No.
You don't understand how unstable your life is.
I sensed it earlier, but now I know clearly.
Shiki, you are always standing close to death.
I don't know if it's a reaction to your Mystic Eyes of Death Perception or not, but you are walking on the thin line in between life and death.
Saying that your anemia this time isn't a big deal because it wasn't a big deal before is a big mistake."
She looks directly into my eyes coldly.

entries.japanese:
「いい、志貴。
貴方は普通の人より外的要因からの死には抵抗がある。
きっと一度、そういった要因の臨死を体験したからでしょうね。
　けどその反面、内的要因の死には抵抗力がまるでないわ。
その貧血だって、一歩間違えれば死んでいてもおかしくない衝撃よ」
「な―――なんだよ、それ。
ようするに病気とかでコロッと逝きやすいって言いたいのか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Shiki. You’re more resistant than an ordinary person to death from outside causes—probably because you once came close to dying that way.
But in exchange, you have almost no resistance to death from within. Even that anemia is a shock severe enough to kill you if it takes one wrong turn.”
“Wh-what’s that supposed to mean? That some illness could make me drop dead without warning?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, Shiki.
Your resistance to death by external means is higher than that of most people.
That is probably because you've already faced death once before.
But on the other hand, you almost have no resistance to death from internal causes.
That anemia of yours, it wouldn't be strange if you die from it."
"Wha---What are you saying?
Are you saying I'll get killed by something like a cold?"

entries.japanese:
「志貴、わたしは本気で忠告してるの！
　来てくれたのは嬉しいけど、貴方は自分の体を第一に考えるべきでしょう！？
　なら今夜はもう帰って、ゆっくり体を休めなさい！」
　ぐっ、と体を寄せてくるアルクェイド。
　本気で俺の事を心配してくれているのか、無防備に体を近づける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, I’m being serious!
I’m happy you came, but you should put your own health first! Go home tonight and rest properly!”
Arcueid pressed in close.
Perhaps because she was sincerely worried, she brought her body near mine with no trace of caution.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, I'm trying to warn you seriously!
I'm glad you came, but you have to think about your health first!
So just go back for now and rest!"
She draws me closer to her.
She really must be worried about me because she's totally defenseless as we get closer.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　体を引こうとするより先に、アルクェイドの胸がこっちの胸に触れる。
　……どくん、と。
　いつもの眩暈とは違った立ち眩みが、あたまのなかを駆けまわる。
　今まで意識してなかった、アルクェイドの胸の柔らかさとか、肌の白さとか、キレイな金の髪とか、そういった女性的な艶かしさを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Before I could draw back, Arcueid’s breasts touched my chest.
…Thump.
A rush unlike my familiar dizziness tore through my head.
For the first time, I became aware of the softness of Arcueid’s breasts, the whiteness of her skin, her beautiful golden hair—of all her sensual allure as a woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Before I can pull back, her chest touches mine.
…… Thump.
My head is assailed with another different kind of dizziness than usual.
All the things I didn't realize before, the softness of her breasts, the whiteness of her skin, her beautiful, golden hair, her womanly charm.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド―――ちょっと、離れてくれ」
「なによ、わたしみたいな吸血鬼の言葉なんて信用できないっていうの？」
「ばか、なにいまさらそんなこと言ってるんだ。
アルクェイドのことを信じないわけがないだろ」
「うそ。
ならどうしてわたしから視線を逸らしてるのよ」
「だから、あくまで俺の個人的な理由でちょっと離れてほしい。
……そう近くに来られると、俺も男だから、困る」
　あ、と短い声をあげて、アルクェイドは下がる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid—move back a little.”
“What? You don’t trust the word of a vampire like me?”
“Idiot, why would you bring that up now? Of course I trust you.”
“Liar. Then why won’t you look at me?”
“This is personal. I just need you to back up a little. …When you come that close, I’m still a man. It makes things difficult.”
Arcueid gave a short cry and stepped away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid----Please, get away."
"What, you're saying you can't trust the word of a vampire like me?"
"Why are you saying that all of a sudden, idiot?
There's no way I won't trust you."
"Liar.
Then why can't you look at me?"
"Could you get away from me because of a personal issue?
…… I'm a guy, so if you get this close, it's a little, troubling."
Giving a small voice of surprise, Arcueid steps back.

entries.japanese:
――――はあ。
　とりあえず、貧血の眩暈とアルクェイドに対する眩暈っていう、二重の拷問は去ってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Haa…
At least the double torture—the dizziness from anemia and the dizziness from Arcueid—had finally passed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Whew.
For the time being, the racking dual dizziness brought about by my anemia and Arcueid subsides.

entries.japanese:
俺の動揺をようやく察したのか、アルクェイドは照れたような視線を向けてくる。
「――――――う」
　ばか。
そんな仕草をされると、よけいアルクェイドを可愛く思えてしまって、困る。
entries.maoEnglish:
Apparently she had finally understood my agitation, because Arcueid looked at me with sudden shyness.
“…”
Idiot. If she acted like that, I would only find her even cuter, which made everything worse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I guess she finally realized our situation, and she looks at me embarrassedly.
"-------Uh."
That idiot.
Seeing her do that, makes me think she's incredibly cute.
This is, troubling.

entries.japanese:
「だから―――やめろ、って」
　聞こえないように、小さく呟いた。
　それはアルクェイドに対するものじゃなくて、アルクェイドにどきまぎしてしまっている自分に対するものだ。
　……本当にどうかしてる。
　どんなにキレイでも、アルクェイドは吸血鬼なんだ。
　それを忘れて、なにを意識しているんだろうか、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So—stop it.”
I muttered too softly for her to hear.
The words weren’t meant for Arcueid, but for the part of me that kept losing its composure around her.
…Something was seriously wrong with me.
No matter how beautiful she was, Arcueid was a vampire.
How could I forget that and start thinking of her this way?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I--said stop."
I mumble that quietly, so not be heard.
Those words are not directed to her, but to me for being excited by her.
…… There really is something wrong.
No matter how pretty she is, she's a vampire.
Just what am I thinking, forgetting something like that?

entries.japanese:
「―――とにかく、アルクェイドに心配してもらうほど俺の体にボロはきてないよ。
　だいたいな、昨日の夜みたいに襲われたら今度こそ殺されるかもしれないんだから、こっちも悠長にやってるわけにはいかないだろ」
「え――？
　志貴、今なんて言ったの？」
「だから、昨日の夜みたいに敵に襲われたらたまらないって言ったんだよ。
　あっちもその気になってるんだから、一日でも早く吸血鬼を見つけ出さないと――――」
　と。
いいかけて、思い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, my body isn’t falling apart badly enough for you to worry.
Besides, if we’re attacked again like last night, I might really die this time, so we can’t afford to take things slowly.”
“What? Shiki, what did you just say?”
“I said I don’t want the enemy attacking me again like last night.
They’ve made their move, so we need to find the vampire as soon as possible—”
Halfway through the sentence, I remembered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Anyways, I'm not that beat to have you start worrying about me.
Besides, if I was attacked like I was last night again, I might really die.
So I can't take my time doing this."
"Eh--?
Shiki, what did you just say?"
"I said if I was attacked like I was last night again, I might really die.
He is trying too, so we have to find him as soon as possible----"
Saying that, I suddenly remember.

entries.japanese:
「……忘れてた。
俺、昨日の夜に死者っていうのに襲われたんだ」
「昨日の夜って、わたしと別れた後のこと！？」
「ああ。
全身包帯巻きで、屋敷の前で待ち構えてたんだ」
　アルクェイドの表情が険しくなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I forgot. Last night, one of the Dead attacked me.”
“Last night? After we separated?!”
“Yeah. His whole body was wrapped in bandages, and he was waiting outside the mansion.”
Arcueid’s expression hardened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I forgot.
Last night, I was attacked by one of those Dead."
"Last night?
After we parted!?"
"Yeah.
He was entirely wrapped in bandages and was waiting for me by the mansion."
Arcueid's expression suddenly turns serious.

entries.japanese:
「……信じられない。
どうしてそんな大事なことを忘れてられるのよ、貴方は」
「……う」
　仕方ないだろ。
今日は今日で、それ以上におかしな目にあったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I don’t believe you. How could you forget something that important?”
“…Ugh.”
It wasn’t my fault. Even stranger things had happened to me today.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't believe it.
How could you forget something so important?"
"…… Uh."
I couldn't help it.
I've been through stranger things today.

entries.japanese:
「……まあいいわ。
それより詳しい話を聞かせて、志貴」
　真剣な眼差しでアルクェイドは問い詰めてくる。
「ええっと、たしか――」
　気を落ち着かせて、できるだけ克明に、前日の夜に起こった出来事をアルクェイドに説明する。
　……ただ、あの包帯の男が『死の線』を視ていた、という事だけは黙っておいた。
　確かな証拠はないし、もしかすると俺だけの勘違いだったかもしれないからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Never mind that. Tell me exactly what happened, Shiki.”
Arcueid pressed me with a grave stare. “Let me think…”
I calmed myself and recounted the events of the previous night in as much detail as I could.
…I left out only the possibility that the bandaged man had seen the Lines of Death.
I had no proof, and it might have been nothing more than my imagination.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh well.
More than that, please tell me in detail what happened, Shiki."
With serious eyes, Arcueid interrogates me on what happened.
"Um, let's see--"
I calm down and I describe as clearly as I can what happened last night.
…… But, I don't tell her that the bandaged man was seeing the "lines of death".
I can't prove it, so maybe it might have been just my mistake.

entries.japanese:
「……と、いうわけなんだけど―――――」
　ひとしきり説明を終えて、アルクェイドの顔色をうかがう。
　話が始まってからこっち、アルクェイドの目は鋭いままで和らぐことがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…And that’s what happened.”
Once I had finished, I searched Arcueid’s face for a reaction.
Her eyes had remained sharp from the moment I began and had never once softened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, that's how it was------"
Finishing my explanation, I read Arcueid's expression.
From when I started until now, her eyes remained sharp without any gentleness.

entries.japanese:
「どうなんだアルクェイド。
あの包帯の男と、神父みたいな服を着たヤツっていうのはおまえの敵なのか？」
「……そうね。
両方ともわたしの『敵』よ。
その包帯の男は何者だか知らないけど、カソックを着た女のことなら見当はつく」
　アルクェイドは不機嫌そうに目を細める。
　いや、不機嫌というより神経質そうにいらだっているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what do you think? Are that bandaged man and the person dressed like a priest both enemies of yours?”
“Yes. They’re both my ‘enemies.’ I don’t know who the bandaged man is, but I have a good idea who the woman in the cassock must be.”
Arcueid narrowed her eyes.
She seemed less displeased than tense—almost nervously agitated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So what is it Arcueid?
That bandaged man, and that person wearing those robes like some priest, are they enemies of yours?"
"…… Yes.
Both of them are 'enemies'.
I don't know just who or what that bandaged man is, but that woman wearing those Catholic robes, I have an idea about."
She narrows her eyes as if she was in a bad mood.
No, she looks less like she was in a bad mood and more like she's irritated.

entries.japanese:
「志貴を助けたヤツはわたしとは顔見知りかもしれない。
……まいったわね。
たしかにあの女ならわたしより先に『敵』を見つけ出せるわ」
　きっ、とアルクェイドは悔しそうに唇を噛む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The one who saved you may be an old acquaintance of mine. …This is bad. That woman really could find the ‘enemy’ before I do.”
Arcueid bit her lip in frustration.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I may know the person who helped you, Shiki.
…… Man.
If it's really her, she'll probably be able to find the enemy before me."
She bites her lip vexedly.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待った。
俺、別にその人が女だって言った覚えはないんだけど？」
「いえ、間違いないわ。
異端狩りを単独で行う権限をもっていて、火葬式典と鉄甲作用を複合させた黒鍵を使う代行者はあの女だけだもの」
　アルクェイドの苛立ちは、ほとんど敵意に近いものだ。
　ネロのことを話していた時だって、アルクェイドがここまで感情を露にしたことはなかったっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. I don’t remember telling you that person was a woman.”
“There’s no mistake. She’s the only executor authorized to hunt heretics alone who uses Black Keys combining the Cremation Rite with the Ironclad Effect.”
Arcueid’s irritation was nearly open hostility.
She hadn’t shown this much emotion even when discussing Nrvnqsr.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute.
I didn't say that person was a woman though."
"No, there's no mistake.
That woman is the only agent given authority to hunt heretics alone and who uses Black Keys that combine the Cremation Rite and the Steel Shell Effect."
Her irritability is almost like hostility.
Even when she spoke about Nrvnqsr, her voice was never saturated with emotion to this extent.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
あの、俺を助けてくれた人も吸血鬼なのか……？」
「まさか。
そいつは吸血鬼を目の仇にしている連中の一人よ。
　この国には存在しないんだけど、吸血鬼や獣人を異端者とみなして手当たり次第殺してまわる組織というものがあるの。
志貴を助けたヤツはそこで一番厄介な部署のエクソシストでしょうね。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Was the person who saved me a vampire too?”
“Of course not. She belongs to a group that considers vampires its mortal enemy.
They don’t operate in this country, but the organization brands vampires and werebeasts as heretics and kills them wherever it finds them. The one who saved you is probably an exorcist from its most troublesome division.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, that person who helped me, is she a vampire……?"
"Of course not.
She's a member of those who see vampires as their enemy.
It doesn't exist in this country, but there is an organization that considers vampires or beastmen as heretics and goes around killing them.
The one who helped you was the most troublesome of that kind, Exorcists.

entries.japanese:
「……けどおかしいな。
埋葬機関がこんなに早く代行者を送ってくるハズはないんだけど」
　ぶつぶつと独り言をこぼすアルクェイド。
俺にはてんで解らない事ばかりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…But that doesn’t make sense. The Burial Agency shouldn’t have been able to send an executor this quickly.”
Arcueid muttered to herself. None of it meant anything to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But that's strange.
The Burial Agency wouldn't have sent an agent this soon."
Arcueid speaks softly to herself.
I can't understand what the hell she's talking about.

entries.japanese:
「エクソシストって……その、神父さんみたいな人のこと？」
「え？
　んー、間違いじゃないけど、正解でもないかな。
まあ説明すると長くなるから、ともかく吸血鬼を退治してまわっている人間がいる、っていうコトだけ理解しておいて」
「……………」
　いや、理解しておいてって言われても。
entries.maoEnglish:
“An exorcist… You mean someone like a priest?”
“Hm? Well, that isn’t exactly wrong, but it isn’t quite right either. The explanation would take forever, so for now just understand that there are humans who travel around destroying vampires.”
“…”
She said to understand it, but how was I supposed to do that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Exorcist?
…… Um, like a priest or something?"
"Eh?
Hm, it's not wrong, but it's not quite right either.
Well, it would take a long time to explain, so just know for now that there are those who go around exterminating vampires."
"………………"
Um, she tells me to just understand, but…

entries.japanese:
「そんな事より、志貴はどうして闘ったりしたの？
　志貴はわたしに協力してくれるって言ったけど、一人で闘うとは言わなかったわ」
　じろり、とアルクェイドは俺を睨みつけてくる。
　……それは一人で危険な真似をした俺の身を案じている―――
「もう、ずるいわよ志貴！
　わたしに内緒で、一人でそんな楽しそうなコトするなんて！」
――――というワケでもなさそうだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“More importantly, why did you fight? You agreed to help me, but you never said you would go fighting alone.”
Arcueid glared at me.
So she really was worried that I had put myself in danger alone—
“That was so unfair, Shiki! You went off and did something that exciting all by yourself without telling me!”
――――or perhaps not.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"More importantly, why did you fight?
You said you'd team up with me, but you never said you'd fight by yourself."
She glares at me.
…… She seems seriously concerned about my safety----
"That's not fair Shiki!
Keeping it a secret, having all that fun by yourself!"
----or not.

entries.japanese:
「……あのな。
どこをどうとったらそんなぶっとんだ結論に辿り着くんだよ、おまえは！」
「あれ？
　わたしに隠れて獲物を独り占めしようとしたんじゃないの？」
　しれっとした顔でとんでもないコトを言ってくる。
「ばか、そんなワケあるわけないだろ。
……アイツと闘う事になったのはなりゆきだよ、なりゆき。
　俺はおまえ抜きで死者とか吸血鬼とかと闘うつもりなんてないんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…How could you possibly twist the story into a conclusion that insane?”
“Oh? Weren’t you trying to keep all the prey for yourself?”
She said something outrageous with an utterly innocent face.
“Idiot, of course not. Fighting him just… happened.
I have no intention of fighting the Dead or vampires without you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Now how did you jump to that insane conclusion!?"
"Huh?
You weren't trying to hide your monopoly on prey from me?"
She says something so absurd with a straight face.
"Idiot, that's not it at all.
…… Fighting him was just a turn of events.
Just a turn of events.
I don't plan to fight with The Dead or vampires without you."

entries.japanese:
「……ふーん。
なりゆきって、どんな？」
「世間一般でいうところの正義感……なのかもしれない。
今は、少し後悔してる」
「正義感？」
　なにそれ？
　とアルクェイドは首をかしげる。
　……ああ、俺だってそんなものがただの大義名分なんだって事は昨日、痛いほど思い知らされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hmm. And how did it ‘just happen’?”
“Maybe it was what people call a sense of justice. I’m beginning to regret it.”
“A sense of justice?”
What’s that? Arcueid’s tilted head seemed to ask.
…Yesterday had taught me painfully well that mine had been nothing but a pretext.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh?
What kind of turn of events?"
"My sense of justice as a normal person…… or something like that.
I kind of regret it now."
"Justice?"
She tilts her head as if to say "What's that?"
…… Yeah, I was painfully shown yesterday it is just a justification.

entries.japanese:
―――あの時。
　目の前に人影があると気付いた時、俺の中にあった感情は恐怖しかなかった。
　アレが―――アイツが普通じゃないって事ぐらいすぐに解ったっていうのに、俺はただ動揺するだけだった。
　そうして、アイツに合わせるようにナイフを取り出して、殺し合いを始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Back then.
When I noticed the figure standing before me, the only emotion inside me was fear.
I had understood at once that it—that he—wasn’t normal, yet all I did was panic.
Then I drew my knife as though answering his invitation, and we began trying to kill each other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Back then.
When I realized there was a figure in front of me, there was only fear.
That thing----that guy, I knew right away he wasn't normal, but all I could do was tremble.
And then, I brought out my knife to meet him and began a fight to the death.

entries.japanese:
……安っぽい正義感なんかじゃ人は殺せない。
　人間は自らの命を守る為に何かを殺す。
　それはもっとも原始的で、シンプルなケモノの論理だ。
　それを───あの時、先輩に似た誰かがやってこなかったら、俺はためらうことなく実行していたかもしれない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
…Cheap heroism cannot make a person kill.
People kill to protect their own lives.
It is the simplest and most primitive law of the beast.
And if the person who resembled Ciel hadn’t appeared, I might have obeyed that law without a moment’s hesitation—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… You can't kill someone using a cheap notion like justice.
People kill to preserve their own life.
That's the most primitive, simple logic of the beasts.
That logic---at that time, if that person resembling Senpai hadn't come, I probably would have executed that action without hesitating----

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
俺を助けてくれたヤツの事を、もう少し教えてくれないか」
「教えるもなにも、そいつは教会の異端審問者よ。
さっき話した、吸血鬼の天敵みたいな連中のコト。
　埋葬機関っていう、エクソシストというよりマーダー、いえキラーマシーンといった異端者専門の処理係なんだけど───こんな極東の地にも目が届いてるなんて、本当に意外だったわ」
　アルクェイドは腕を組んで考え込む。
　その様子はさっきまでのアルクェイドとは違って、感情というものが感じられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Arcueid. Will you tell me more about the person who saved me?”
“There’s little more to tell. She’s an inquisitor of the Church—one of those people I mentioned who are the natural enemies of vampires. She belongs to the Burial Agency, a disposal unit specializing in heretics. ‘Exorcist’ is too mild; they’re murderers—no, killing machines. I’m genuinely surprised their reach extends all the way to this corner of the Far East.”
Arcueid folded her arms and sank into thought.
Unlike the Arcueid of moments before, she seemed entirely devoid of emotion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
That person who came to help me, can you tell me a little more about her?"
"There's nothing more to tell, she's an Inquisitor for The Church.
What I said earlier, the group that's like a nemesis to all vampires.
This Burial Agency, not so much exorcists as murderers, no, killing machines, are a specialized group responsible for dealing with heretics----I'm very surprised that their eyes reach even in the Far East."
Arcueid crosses her arms while deep in thought.
She looks devoid of emotion, entirely different from before.

entries.japanese:
───アルクェイドは真剣だ。
　ともすれば、彼女の追っている『敵』なんかよりもっと深刻に思案しているような。
entries.maoEnglish:
───Arcueid was serious—perhaps giving this even more
thought than the “enemy” she had come here to hunt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---She's serious.
She might be thinking more seriously about this than the enemy she's after.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
よくわからないけど、そのエクソシストっていうのは吸血鬼を狙うんだろ？
　それじゃあおまえだって狙われているんじゃないのか」
　心配になって声をかける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Arcueid, I don’t understand the details, but these exorcists hunt vampires, right? Wouldn’t that mean they’re after you too?”
I found myself asking out of concern.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
I don't quite understand, but those exorcists hunt vampires, right?
Then aren't you their target too?"
I ask her that because I'm a little worried.

entries.japanese:
「え───？
　まさか、彼らが天敵たりえるのは死徒が相手の時だけよ。
わたしと彼らは根本からして噛み合わないから戦いにもならない。
　ただ────もしソイツがアイツだとしたら、必ず第七聖典で倫理武装しているわ。
そうなると先をこされる危険性があるわね」
「……先を越される……？」
　アルクェイドの言っている事はよく解らない。
　ただ細かい事情は別にしても、アルクェイドにとってあの先輩に似た誰かの登場は都合が悪いらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? Don’t be absurd. They’re natural enemies only to Dead Apostles. They and I are fundamentally incompatible; there wouldn’t even be anything one could call a battle.
But if that person is who I think she is, she’ll certainly be ethically armed with the Seventh Holy Scripture. In that case, there’s a real danger she could beat me to my target.”
“…Beat you to it?”
I still didn’t understand what Arcueid meant.
Whatever the details, the arrival of someone resembling Ciel was clearly bad news for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---?
Of course not.
They are only natural enemies of the Dead Apostles.
We don't fundamentally mess with each other, so there cannot even be a fight.
But----if she is who I think she is, then she has to be armed with the Seventh Holy Scripture.
There is the danger of her getting there first."
"…… Getting there first……?"
I can't quite grasp what she's saying.
I don't get the details, but it seems like Arcueid doesn't appreciate the emergence of this person who resembles Senpai entering the stage.

entries.japanese:
「……ま、俺には関係のない話か。
さて、それじゃ一段落ついたところで始めないか。
せっかく来たんだから、街を徘徊してる死者の一人でも見つけ出さないと勿体ない」
「もう、そんな青い顔をしてなに言ってるのよ。
志貴がおかしな事を言い出すから話がそれたけど、もっと自分の体を大切にしなさいってさっき言ったでしょう！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Well, I suppose none of that concerns me. Shall we get started now that we’ve settled everything? I came all this way; it would be a waste not to find at least one member of the Dead wandering the city.”
“Honestly, what are you saying with a face that pale? Your strange story distracted us, but I told you to take better care of yourself!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I guess it doesn't concern me.
Well then, now that we're calmed down, shall we begin?
I didn't come here for nothing, so maybe we should find at least one of The Dead."
"Geez, what are you saying with such a pale face?
We got off topic because you said something weird, but didn't I tell you to pay more attention to your body!?"

entries.japanese:
キッ、と見据えてくるアルクェイド。
　……さっきはまさかと思ったけど、どうも本当にアルクェイドは俺の体を心配してくれているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid pinned me with a fierce stare.
…I’d doubted it before, but apparently she truly was worried about me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid glares at me.
…… I didn't think she was before, but she does seem honestly concerned about me.

entries.japanese:
「いい？
　志貴の体は人より不安定なんだから、今みたいに激しく体調が乱れた時は休んでいないと命にかかわるのよ。
　貴方が頻繁に気を失うのだって、貧血で倒れるんじゃなくて体のほうが危険を察して倒れているだけ。
　志貴の体はね、志貴本人より早く危険を察して、それ以上体調が乱れないように自ら身体の運動を最小限に留めてくれているんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen. Your body is less stable than most, so when it falls this violently out of balance, you need to rest or your life is at risk.
When you keep losing consciousness, it isn’t the anemia making you collapse. Your body senses the danger and shuts you down.
It notices the threat before you do and reduces your physical activity to the bare minimum so your condition won’t deteriorate any further.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Okay?
Your body is more unstable than most people's, so if you don't rest at a time like this, you're risking your life.
You pass out a lot, not because of anemia, but because your body understands it's in danger.
Your body senses the danger before you do, so it stops working to prevent your body from getting any worse."

entries.japanese:
「え―――それって、本当？」
「わたしが嘘を言っても意味はないでしょう。
とにかく、忠告だけはしたからね。
信じるかどうかは志貴次第よ」
「……俺次第って、そりゃあおまえが俺を騙しても得なんてないだろうし……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is that… really true?”
“What would I gain by lying? In any case, I’ve warned you. Whether you believe me is your decision.”
“…My decision? Well, I suppose you wouldn’t gain anything by deceiving me…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh----for real?"
"There's no reason for me to lie, right?
Anyway, I warned you.
Whether you believe me or not is up to you, Shiki."
"…… Up to me?
Well, I don't think there's any reason for you to lie to me……"

entries.japanese:
口にして、つい考え込んでしまった。
　今まで貧血のたびに気を失っていた自分の体を虚弱なものだと思っていたけど、アレは逆に俺自身の命を守る安全装置みたいなものだったんだろうか、なんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once I’d said it, I found myself thinking.
I’d always considered the body that blacked out during every anemic spell to be weak. But perhaps those spells had been a safety mechanism protecting my life instead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As I speak, I sink deep into thought.
I always thought I passed out because my body was weak from anemia, but now she's saying it's because my body is trying to protect me like a safety switch?
What is this?

entries.japanese:
「とにかく、今夜の探索はなしにするわ。
　どのみち敵も昨夜の傷が治りきらないうちは街に現れないだろうし、死者を使わずに志貴のところに現れたところを見ると、手持ちの死者もいなくなったようだし」
　アルクェイドは厳しい視線のまま断言した。
　……そう言われると、こっちも同意せざるをえない。
もとから俺一人きりで吸血鬼を探す、なんていうのは不可能な事なんだし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In any case, we aren’t searching tonight.
The enemy won’t appear in the city until last night’s wounds have healed. And since he came for you himself instead of sending the Dead, he must have exhausted the servants he had left.”
Arcueid delivered the verdict without relaxing her stern gaze.
…When she put it that way, I had no choice but to agree. Searching for a vampire alone had been impossible from the start.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, we won't go investigating tonight.
I don't think the enemy will reappear until his wound is healed, and if he appeared by your house without using The Dead, that means he doesn't have any left."
She says this all severely.
…… If she says so, I can't argue.
In the first place, it's impossible for me to go look for vampires by myself.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
アルクェイドがそこまで言うんなら、今夜はおとなしく休む事にするよ」
「ええ、そうしてくれると助かる。
志貴は昨夜襲われただけじゃなくて、そんなに体が弱っているんだもの。
　今晩はぐっすり眠って、明日までにはいつもの志貴に戻ってもらわないと困るわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…All right. If you insist, I’ll go home and rest tonight.”
“Good. You weren’t only attacked last night; you’re terribly weak as well.
Sleep soundly tonight. I need you back to your usual self by tomorrow.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright.
If you say so, Arcueid, I'll rest for tonight."
"Yes, please do.
Not only did you get attacked last night, but your body is so weak now.
It'll be troublesome if you don't sleep tonight and return to your normal self by tomorrow."

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
たしかにこんなんじゃアルクェイドに協力するどころか足手まといになるだけだもんな。
　オッケー、明日までにはちゃんと体力を回復させておくよ」
「んー、そういうコトじゃないよ。
元気のない志貴と話していてもつまらないから、いつもの志貴に戻ってほしいだけだし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I see. In this condition, I’d only get in your way instead of helping.
All right, I’ll make sure I’m recovered by tomorrow.”
“Mm, that isn’t quite what I meant. Talking to you when you have no energy is boring. I just want the usual Shiki back.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
It's true that I can't really help you in this condition.
Okay, I'll get myself fixed by tomorrow."
"No, that's not it.
It's boring talking to you when you're like this, so I just want you to be back to normal, that's all."

entries.japanese:
どこか不満そうに首をかしげるアルクェイド。
　……やっぱり、こいつの性格はいまいちよく解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid tilted her head, somehow dissatisfied.
…I really couldn’t make sense of her personality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She almost seems disappointed.
…… I knew it was useless to try and understand her.

entries.japanese:
「じゃあ俺は屋敷に戻るよ。
また明日な、アルクェイド」
　片手をあげて屋敷への帰途につこうとする。
「ね、志貴」
　と、アルクェイドに呼び止められた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I’ll head back to the mansion. See you tomorrow, Arcueid.”
I raised one hand and started home.
“Shiki.”
Arcueid called me back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll be heading back to the mansion.
See you tomorrow, Arcueid."
Raising a hand, I start my walk back.
"Hey, Shiki."
Arcueid stops me.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、まだ何かあるのか？」
「わたし、送っていこうか？」
　アルクェイドはどこか視線をそらしながら、遠慮がちにそんな事を言った。
 ──―アルクェイドはアルクェイドなりに、昨日の事を心配してくれているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You still need something?”
“Do you want me to walk you home?”
Arcueid looked away as she made the hesitant offer.
──―In her own way, Arcueid seemed worried about what had happened the night before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
Is there something else?"
"Should I escort you home?"
She averts her gaze and speaks hesitantly.
----In her own way, she really is worried about what happened last night.

entries.japanese:
そう思うと送っていってもらうのも悪くない。
「あ────」
　そうだな、と言いかけて、ピタリと止まる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thinking of it that way, accepting her offer didn’t sound bad.
“Ah—”
I began to agree, then stopped dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thinking that, I guess it's not that bad…
"Oh----"
Before I can say "Yeah", I suddenly stop.

entries.japanese:
待て待て、さっきの誓いを忘れたのか志貴。
　どんなにキレイでもアルクェイドは吸血鬼なんだ。
それを忘れちゃいけない。
　必要以上にアルクェイドに関わると、それこそ俺は―――越えてはいけない一線を越えてしまう気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wait, wait—have you already forgotten what you swore, Shiki?
No matter how beautiful Arcueid might be, she was a vampire. I couldn’t forget that.
If I became any more involved with her than necessary, I had the feeling I would cross a line that could never be uncrossed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Wait.
Wait.
Aren't you forgetting your vow you made just now, Shiki?
No matter how pretty she is, Arcueid is a vampire.
I can't forget that.
If I relate myself to Arcueid more than necessary----I feel I'll cross a line that I should never cross.

entries.japanese:
「よせやい。
おまえに心配される謂れはないよ。
似合わないことするな、ばか」
「あ───うん」
　少しだけ───ほんの一瞬、アルクェイドはうつむいてから顔をあげる。
「それじゃ、また明日ね！」
　ばいばいと元気に手をふってから、白い服の吸血鬼は夜の闇の中へ歩み去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget it. I don’t need you worrying about me. It doesn’t suit you, idiot.”
“Oh—all right.”
For just an instant, Arcueid lowered her head before looking up again.
“Then I’ll see you tomorrow!”
She waved brightly, and the vampire in white walked away into the darkness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Cut it out.
I don't need to be worried by you.
Don't do things that don't suit you, stupid."
"Ah----yeah."
Just a little----for just an instant, Arcueid looks down, but then raises her head.
"Then, see you tomorrow!"
Waving her hand goodbye energetically, the white-clothed vampire walks off into the darkness of the night.

entries.japanese:
チチ、チチチ、チチチチチ
　……窓が開けっぱなしになっているんだろうか。
　庭のほうから小鳥の鳴き声が聞こえてきている。
　ひんやりと冷たい風が頬にあたる。
　目蓋には淡い陽の光。
　静かで、ゆるやかな周囲の色合い。
　柔らかな朝の訪れ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Chirp, chirrup, chirrup-chirrup
Had the window been left open?
Small birds were calling from the garden.
A cool breeze brushed my cheek.
Pale sunlight lay against my eyelids.
The world around me was quiet, its colors soft and slow.
Morning arrived gently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tweet, Tweet, Tweet
…… Is the window open?
I can hear the soft singing of birds from the garden.
A cool breeze blows across my face.
I feel the sunlight hitting my eyelids.
A quiet, gentle atmosphere.
A gentle morning.

entries.japanese:
朝、か。
　昨夜、秋葉に看病されたまま眠って、そのまま朝を迎えてしまったらしい。
　体はベッドに横になったままで、体のふしぶしが微かに重かった。
　それでも昨夜よりは体は回復している。
　目を開けて、体を起こす事にした。
　と――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Morning, huh.
I must have fallen asleep while Akiha was tending me last night and slept straight through until dawn.
I was still lying in bed, my joints faintly heavy.
Even so, I felt better than I had the night before.
I decided to open my eyes and sit up.
And then—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Morning?
I guess I fell asleep last night as Akiha cared for me, and slept till now.
Lying down, my body feels heavy.
But I feel much better than I did yesterday.
I decide to open my eyes and sit up.
And----

entries.japanese:
「あ。
やっと起きたな、こいつめ」
entries.maoEnglish: “Oh. Look who finally woke up.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah.
The little rascal finally woke up."

entries.japanese: ――――目の前には、アルクェイドの顔があった。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Arcueid’s face was right in front of mine.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… I see Arcueid's face right in front of mine.

entries.japanese:
「――――――！？」
　あまりの出来事に、頭は真っ白になってろくに働いてくれない。
　口はぱくぱくと正体不明の声を出している。
―――本気で、事態がどうなっているのかわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!?”
My mind went white, too overwhelmed to function.
My mouth opened and closed, producing sounds no one could have identified.
―――I honestly had no idea what was happening.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………!?"
My brain goes blank and stops working due to this unexpected event.
My mouth opens and closes, but my voice seems to be missing.
---Seriously, what's going on?

entries.japanese:
ただ目前にはアルクェイドがいて、
　ここは自分の部屋で、
　時刻はちょうど朝の九時すぎで、
　おまけにアルクェイドは土足であがりこんでいるって事ぐらいしか分からない。
entries.maoEnglish:
All I could grasp was that Arcueid was in front of me,
that this was my room, that it was a little past nine in the morning—and,
to make matters worse,
that Arcueid had come inside without taking off her shoes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid is in front of me.
This is my room.
It's past nine o'clock in the morning,
She's come inside, still wearing her shoes; that's all I know for now.

entries.japanese:
「お、お、お、ま、え」
「うそつき。
また明日って約束したのに」
　かなりご機嫌ななめなのか、アルクェイドの赤い瞳は本来の美しさを損ねている。
―――いや、損ねてなんかいないか。
　こんなに間近で見てしまっている分、むしろ普段より鮮明に、美しいと感じられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y-you—you…”
“Liar. You promised you’d see me tomorrow.”
Arcueid must have been in a foul mood; indignation clouded the usual beauty of her red eyes.
―――No, it didn’t.
At this distance, if anything, her beauty was only sharper and more vivid than usual.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y-Y-Y-You!"
"Liar.
We promised to meet again yesterday."
She must be in a pretty bad mood as her red eyes have lost their usual beauty.
---No, not lost at all.
Being this close, her beauty is more vivid than usual.

entries.japanese:
じぃぃい、とアルクェイドは横になったままの俺をにらんでいる。
「―――ちょっ、ちょっと待てアルクェイド。
どうして、どうしておまえが朝から俺の部屋にいるんだ……！」
　怒鳴ろうとして、声を極力小さくした。
　ここで大声を出して翡翠が部屋にやってきたら、それこそ終わりだ。
―――状況は依然として混沌としたままだけど、それぐらいの理性はちゃんと働いてくれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid fixed me with a long, smoldering glare as I lay there.
“W-wait a second, Arcueid. Why—why are you in my room this early in the morning…!”
I nearly shouted, then forced my voice as low as it would go.
If Hisui heard me and came in now, it would all be over.
―――The situation was still pure chaos, but at least that much of my reason remained intact.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid glares at me as I lay in bed.
"…… W-Wait, Arcueid.
W-Why are you in my room this morning……!?"
I start to shout, but I stop myself.
If I shouted now, Hisui would come here and it would all be over.
---Everything is still chaotic, but my brain can grasp that much.

entries.japanese:
「と、とにかくどいてくれ……！
　人の部屋にかってにあがって、眠ってる人間を脅かすなんてサイテーだってわかってるのか……！？」
「なによ、その態度。
わたしがこんなところにやってきたのは、志貴が約束を破ったからでしょ。
人のことを待たせておいて自分はずっと眠ってるなんて、いったいどういうつもりなのよ」
　むーっ、と不機嫌そうにアルクェイドは俺を睨む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“J-just get off me…! You barge into someone’s room and scare him awake—do you have any idea how awful that is…!?”
“What’s with that attitude? I only came here because you broke your promise. You left me waiting while you slept—what did you think you were doing?”
Arcueid glared at me, cheeks practically puffed with displeasure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A-Anyway, move……!
Just going into someone's room, threatening a sleeping person, don't you know how awful that is……!?"
"What's with that attitude?
I came here because you broke your promise.
Sleeping while making someone wait, just what in the world were you planning?"
She stares at me ill-temperedly.

entries.japanese:
……ちょっと、冷静に考えてみる。
　っと、そうか。
昨夜のアルクェイドとの待ち合わせを、俺は破ってしまったんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
All right—think calmly.
Oh, right. I had missed my meeting with Arcueid last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I calm down.
That's right.
I really did break my promise to meet Arcueid last night.

entries.japanese:
「――――む」
　ようやく事情が飲み込めた。
　アルクェイドが怒っている理由はわかった。
　わかったけど、それにしたって―――土足で人の部屋にやってくるのはどういう了見なんだろうか、こいつはっ。
　窓が開けっぱなしというところを見ると、どうにもそこから忍び込んできたみたいだし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
At last I understood.
I knew why Arcueid was angry.
Even so—what kind of lunatic climbed into another person’s room with her shoes on?
Judging by the open window, that was apparently how she had sneaked inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Mmmm."
I finally understand the situation.
I understand why Arcueid's angry.
I understand, but to do this… to come into someone's room still wearing shoes like that, what does she intend to do?
Seeing that the window is open, she probably came in through there.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか、約束を破ったんだから、そりゃあ確かにこっちが悪い。
けど、そんな事でひとんちに侵入するのはやりすぎだぞ」
「ここ、志貴の家じゃないわ」
　アルクェイドはきっぱりと言い返してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, I broke my promise, so I was in the wrong. But breaking into someone’s house over it is going way too far.”
“This isn’t your house.”
Arcueid shot the correction back without hesitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see, since I broke my promise, I'm at fault here.
But sneaking in here is going a little far, you know."
"This isn't your house, Shiki."
She gives a quick retort.

entries.japanese:
「それにね、ほんとはわたし、もっと怒ってたんだから。
何時間も待ち惚けで、約束を反古にされたんだって気づいた時は自分でも驚くぐらいに頭に血がのぼったわ。
　もう、絶対にこのままじゃすまさない、乗り込んでいって志貴の首根っこぐらい引き千切ってやるって思ったぐらい」
　むっとした瞳のまま、アルクェイドは淡々と語る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Besides, I was much angrier before. I waited for hours, and when I finally realized you weren’t coming, I got so furious I surprised even myself.
I swore I wasn’t going to let you get away with it—that I’d march in here and tear your head off by the roots.”
Her eyes still sulking, Arcueid delivered this account in an utterly matter-of-fact tone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, I really was angry before.
I waited for many hours, and as soon as I realized you weren't coming, I got so incredibly angry.
I was thinking I would never let this happen again and I'd rip your throat out."
She speaks, still looking ill-tempered.

entries.japanese:
「わかる、志貴？
　ああいう気持ちってね、たまらないのよ。
自分でも冷静になろうって思うんだけど、思えば思うほど頭にきちゃうような泥沼なんだから」
　今でもそういう気分なのか、アルクェイドの赤い瞳は俺に対して非難の色を示している。
「ああ―――たしかにたまらないな、それは」
　自分の首が無事なのをかみさまに感謝しながら、そんな相づちをうった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You understand, Shiki? It’s unbearable. You tell yourself to calm down, but the harder you try, the angrier you get—it just drags you deeper.”
Perhaps she still felt that way; accusation remained bright in her red eyes.
“Yeah—that does sound unbearable.”
I nodded along while privately thanking God that my neck was still attached.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you get it, Shiki?
That feeling, I couldn't resist it.
Even though I know I should calm down, the more I thought about it, the angrier I got."
As if she still felt that way, her red eyes seem to blame me.
"Yeah… I guess you can't help yourself."
Giving thanks to God my neck is still attached, I keep the conversation going.

entries.japanese:
「でしょ？
　そうしてここに忍び込んだんだけど、志貴が眠ってるから待ってあげる事にしたのよ。
言い訳ぐらいは聞いてみたかったから。
　で、やる事もなかったし、しばらく貴方の寝顔を見てた。
……うん、志貴の寝顔はね、恐いくらい、静かだった。
　死んでいるみたいに眠っていて、もう起き上がる事はないんじゃないかって不安になったぐらい」
「……はあ。
不安だったら起こしてくれればよかったのに。
こっちはおまえに横にいられるほうがよっぽど不安だ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right? So I sneaked in here, but you were asleep, and I decided to wait. I wanted to hear your excuse, at least.
I had nothing else to do, so I watched you sleeping for a while. You know, Shiki, your face was almost frighteningly peaceful.
You slept so much like the dead that I began to worry you might never wake up.”
“…If you were worried, you could’ve woken me. Having you beside me was much more alarming.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't it?
And I snuck in here, but since you were sleeping I decided to wait.
At least I wanted to hear your excuse.
And, since I didn't have anything to do, I watched your sleeping face.
…… Yeah, your sleeping face was very quiet, it was almost scary.
Sleeping like you were dead, I started feeling uneasy because I thought that maybe you would never wake up."
I sigh.
"If you were uneasy then you should've woke me.
I'm uneasy when you're next to me."

entries.japanese:
「けど、起こすのももったいなくって。
　……わたし、自分の眠っている姿はしらないけど、志貴みたいに眠れるのなら幸せかもしれないなって。
　どうして志貴はこんなに穏やかなんだろうって、ずっと考えながら見つめてた。
　そうしていたらね、あれだけ怒っていた気持ちも収まっていて、そのあとに志貴が目を覚ましたの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But it seemed such a waste to wake you.
I don’t know what I look like asleep, but I thought that if I could sleep the way you do, maybe that would be happiness.
I kept watching you, wondering how you could look so peaceful.
After a while all that anger faded away—and then you woke up.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I thought it would be a waste.
…… I don't know what I look like when I sleep, but I thought it would be real good if I slept like you did.
I wondered why you look so peaceful while I watched you sleep.
While I was doing that, my anger disappeared, and then you woke up."

entries.japanese:
「……それじゃあ夜から今までの間、ずっとそこにいたっていうのか、おまえ」
「うん。
何度か家の人がやってきたけど、見つからないようにしておいたから大丈夫よ。
　さっきも志貴のことを起こしに女の人が来たんだけど、気に食わないから追い返しちゃった」
　あはは、とアルクェイドは能天気に笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mean you’ve been sitting there since last night?”
“Yes. People from the house came in a few times, but I made sure they didn’t find me.
A woman came to wake you a little while ago, too, but I didn’t like her, so I sent her away.”
Arcueid laughed without a care in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then you've been here this whole time?
From last night until now?"
"Yeah.
People from this house came in a few times, but I hid myself so it was okay.
A girl also came to wake you up, but I didn't like her so I sent her away."
Arcueid laughs brightly.

entries.japanese:
「待て、追い返したってなにを―――」
「手荒なまねはしてないわ。
ほら、前に吸血鬼には魅了の魔眼があるって言ったでしょ？
　あの女の人には『志貴はもう学校に行った』って暗示をかけて追い返しただけだから、わたしの事も記憶に残ってないよ」
「記憶に残ってないよって、おまえね……」
　ほんと、なんてはた迷惑なヤツなんだ。
　……まあ、それでもはた迷惑なヤツははた迷惑なヤツなりに、こっちの家庭環境に対して気を使ってくれてるみたいだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait—what do you mean, sent her away?”
“I didn’t hurt her. Remember when I told you vampires possess Mystic Eyes of Enchantment? I merely planted the suggestion that ‘Shiki has already left for school’ and sent her away, so she won’t remember me either.”
“You say that like it makes everything fine…”
Honestly, what a spectacular nuisance.
Even so, this spectacular nuisance appeared to be making some allowance for my situation at home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait, you sent her away?
How?"
"I wasn't rough.
Didn't I tell you before that vampires have Mystic Eyes of Enchantment?
I merely used suggestion on her, saying that 'Shiki has already gone to school' and didn't leave any memory of her meeting me."
"No memory?
You……"
Really are a troublesome person.
…… Well, even if she is troublesome, at least she took care not to be detected.

entries.japanese:
はあ、と額を押さえてため息をつく。
「わかった。
昨日の事はすまなかったよ、アルクェイド。
そのかわりって言っちゃなんだけど、俺は二度とおまえとの約束は破らない。
うん、約束する」
　はっきりとアルクェイドの顔を見つめながら断言する。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pressed a hand to my forehead and sighed.
“All right. I’m sorry about last night, Arcueid. This may not make up for it, but I’ll never break another promise to you. I mean it—I promise.”
I looked her squarely in the face as I said it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I bring my hands to my head as I sigh.
"Alright.
Sorry for yesterday, Arcueid.
I don't know if this is making up for it, but I won't break any more promises.
Yeah, I promise."
I look her right in the eye as I declare this.

entries.japanese:
「反省してる？」
「反省してる。
……なにしろあとの報復が恐ろしいって、いま思い知った」
　ベッドに横になったまま、降参します、と両手をあげるジェスチャーをする。
　と、さっきまでの不機嫌そうな素振りはどこにいったのか、よろしい、と満足そうにアルクェイドは頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you sorry?”
“I’m sorry. I’ve just learned how terrifying the punishment can be.”
Still flat on my back, I raised both hands in surrender.
Her earlier sulk vanished without a trace as Arcueid nodded in satisfaction, as if to say, Very good.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Are you sure?"
"I'm sure.
Because I now realize your revenge is scary……"
Still lying down, I raise my hands in surrender.
All of a sudden, her bad mood disappears completely.
Arcueid gives a satisfied nod and says 'alright'.

entries.japanese:
ようやくアルクェイドはベッドから離れてくれた。
「……まったく、無断で人のベッドに乗っかるなんて。
シーツに足跡でもついたら洗濯が大変だな、とか思わないのかな」
　文句を言いつつ、ベッドから体を起こす。
　アルクェイドは部屋の真ん中で、のそのそとベッドから出る俺を眺めている。
「……あのさ。
おまえ、何してるの」
entries.maoEnglish:
At last Arcueid moved away from the bed.
“Honestly, climbing onto someone’s bed without permission. Did it never occur to you how hard footprints would be to wash out of the sheets?”
Grumbling, I pushed myself upright.
Arcueid stood in the middle of the room, watching me clamber sluggishly out of bed.
“…What are you doing?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid finally gets away from the bed.
"…… Geez, sneaking onto someone's bed like that.
Didn't you think about how hard the sheets would be to clean if you left a mess from your shoes?"
Complaining, I get up from bed.
Arcueid stands in the center of the room watching me as I slowly rouse myself from bed.
"…… Hey, what are you doing?"

entries.japanese:
「なにって、志貴が着替えるのを待ってるんだけど。
まさかその格好のまま出かけるわけにはいかないでしょ？」
「そりゃあ寝巻のままで外を歩くほどのんびりしてないけど―――って、アルクェイド？」
「うん、今日は一日志貴と行動しようと思って。
約束を破った埋め合わせ、してくれるんでしょ？」
　アルクェイドはさも当然のように言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Waiting for you to get dressed. You can’t be planning to go out in that, can you?”
“I’m not relaxed enough to walk around town in my pajamas, but—wait, Arcueid?”
“Yes, I thought I’d spend the whole day with you. You’re going to make up for breaking your promise, aren’t you?”
Arcueid spoke as though this were the most obvious thing in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What am I doing?
I'm just waiting for you to change.
You're not going to go out in those clothes, right?"
"Well, yeah.
No one walks around in pajamas… Wait, Arcueid?"
"Yeah, I was thinking we'd spend the day together, Shiki.
You said you'd make it up for breaking your promise, didn't you?"
Arcueid says this casually, as if it was the most natural thing in the world.

entries.japanese:
「今日一日って―――なに言ってるんだ、こっちには学校がある―――」
「なによ。
反省してるって言ったのに、わたしより学校のほうをとるの、貴方は」
「―――う」
　それを言われると弱い。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“The whole day—what are you talking about, I have school—”
“What? You said you were sorry, and now you’re choosing school over me?”
“Urgh…”
She had me there.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Today, all day… What are you saying?
I have school…"
"Hey, you even said you were sure.
Are you choosing school over me, Shiki?"
"Uh……"
She's got me there.
I…

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　ちらり、と時計を見る。
　時刻は午前九時をまわってしまっている。
　今から学校に言っても遅刻だし―――正直に言ってしまえば、学校に行くよりアルクェイドに付き合ったほうが楽しいだろうし………。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I glanced at the clock.
It was already past nine.
I would be late for school now—and, if I was honest, spending the day with Arcueid sounded far more enjoyable anyway…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I glance at the clock.
It's already past nine.
I'd be late even if I went to school now---and to be honest, going with Arcueid is more fun than going to school……

entries.japanese:
「わかった、今日一日は付き合うけどさ。
昼間に街に出ても、死者たちも出歩いてないんじゃないか？」
「そんなのかまわないよ。
街を散歩するだけなら昼でも関係ないじゃない」
「……？
　なんだよ、昨日の夜できなかった分、これから吸血鬼探しをするんじゃないのか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, I’ll spend today with you. But even if we go into town during the day, the Dead won’t be walking around, will they?”
“That doesn’t matter. Daylight won’t stop us from taking a walk through town.”
“…? Aren’t we going to hunt the vampire, since we missed our chance last night?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
I'll spend the day with you.
But if we go into the city during the day, I don't think there'll be any Dead around?"
"I don't care about that.
I just wanted to walk around, so even if it is daytime, it doesn't matter."
"……?
What, aren't we making up for last night and going to look for vampires?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ、もちろん夜になったら街を調べるわ。
けど一日じゅう志貴に手伝ってもらうのも大変でしょうから、お昼ぐらいは休んでもいいと思うの」
「そりゃあ俺だってそのほうが楽だけどさ。
でも、ただ二人で街を歩くなんて、それって……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course we’ll search the city after dark. But helping me all day would be tiring for you, so I thought we could rest during the afternoon.”
“I’d certainly prefer that. But if the two of us simply walk around town, isn’t that…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, of course we'll look tonight.
But to have you help me all day and night would be hard, so during the day I thought we could relax."
"I think that'd be more fun too.
But, just the two of us walking around, that's……"

entries.japanese:
世間一般ではデート、とか言うものじゃないんだろうか。
　……吸血鬼であるアルクェイドにそんな考えはないだろうから、ようするに遊びに連れて行け、と言っているんだろうけど。
　俺としては、その―――ちょっとした心構えが、必要なわけで。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wouldn’t most people call it a date?
Arcueid was a vampire, so the idea probably hadn’t occurred to her; she was merely demanding that I take her somewhere entertaining.
But I still needed a moment to prepare myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
like what they call a date in the real world.
…… Maybe you can't say that with a vampire like Arcueid, but I suppose she's telling me to take her out for some fun.
For me, I----I need to get ready mentally and…

entries.japanese:
「……？
　どうしたの志貴。
顔、赤いわよ？」
「―――――う」
　あわてて顔を手で隠して、アルクェイドから視線を逸らす。
　……そりゃあ、今まで何度もこいつとは二人きりになった。
　けど、あれは緊急時のことで、男と女である前に協力者同士っていう枠組みがあったんだ。
　だから―――アルクェイドをどんなにキレイだなって思っても、意識することを避けていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…? What’s wrong, Shiki? Your face is red.”
“Urgh.”
I hurriedly covered my face and looked away from her.
We had been alone together many times before.
But those had been emergencies; before we were a man and a woman, we had been allies with a shared purpose.
So however beautiful I found Arcueid, I had always avoided thinking of her that way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
What's wrong, Shiki?
Your face, it's turning red."
"------Uh."
I cover my face with my hands and look away.
…… Certainly it's been just the two of us many times before.
But, those were emergency situations, and it was more like a pact of cooperation than anything between a man and a woman.
That's why----no matter how pretty I thought she was, I tried not to notice it.

entries.japanese:
けれど、もし。
　何の危険も何の目的もなしでこいつと二人きりでいたら、気づいてはいけないものに気づいてしまう気がして、何かためらってしまう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
But if we were alone without danger or purpose.
I might notice something I had no right to notice, and that thought made me hesitate—
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, if…
Without any danger, without any purpose, if the two of us just walk around, I might notice something I never noticed before, and it makes me hesitate----

entries.japanese:
「志貴？
　ね、やっぱり学校に行くの……？」
「……わけないだろ。
オッケーしたんだから付き合うよ。
どんな気まぐれか知らないけど、街を散歩するぐらいなら問題ないだろうし」
「決まりね。
それじゃさっさく行きましょう」
　アルクェイドは忍び込んできたであろう窓へ歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki? Are you going to school after all…?”
“Of course not. I already said yes, so I’m coming with you. I don’t know what whim brought this on, but there can’t be any harm in walking around town.”
“Then it’s settled. Let’s go.”
Arcueid walked toward the window she had presumably used to enter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki?
Hey, are you going to school after all……?"
"…… No way.
I said I'd do it, so I will.
I don't know what you're thinking, but walking around shouldn't be a problem."
"Then it's decided.
Then let's go."
She walks toward the window she snuck in earlier.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待った。
すぐに着替えるから、そこで外でも見てろ」
「なに、呼んだ？」
　
「あー、呼んだけど呼んでない！
　いいから大人しく外に出ててくれ。
すぐに行くから」
「うん、屋敷の外で待ってる。
今までさんざん待ったんだから、これ以上待たせないでね、志貴」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. I’ll change in a minute, so stand there and look outside.”
“Did you call me?”
“I did, but I didn’t! Just go outside and wait quietly. I’ll be right there.”
“Fine, I’ll wait outside the mansion. I’ve waited long enough already, so don’t keep me there much longer, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute.
I'm going to change, so can you just look outside for a while?"
"What, did you call me?"
"Oh, yes, no!
Just go outside, I'll be there soon."
"Okay, I'll wait outside.
I've waited this long, so don't make me wait any longer, Shiki…"

entries.japanese:
タン、と猫みたいな身軽さでアルクェイドは窓から出て行った。
　とん、とん、と庭の木々がしなっていく。
　あいつは庭の地面ではなく、庭の木の枝を足場に外に出ていってしまった。
　……まあ、あの身のこなしならこの部屋に忍び込むのなんて造作もなかったことだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a light tap, Arcueid sprang through the window as nimbly as a cat.
One after another, the garden trees bent beneath her feet.
Rather than touch the ground, she bounded out of the estate along their branches.
With agility like that, sneaking into my room must have been effortless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She jumps out the window with the lightness of a cat.
I hear the rustling of the trees outside.
She didn't jump to the ground, but along the tree branches.
…… With a body like that, it should have been easy getting in here undetected.

entries.japanese:
「……感心してる場合じゃないか。
俺も翡翠に見つからないように外に出なくちゃな」
　寝巻から普段着に着替える。
　ドアを少しだけ開けて、廊下に誰もいないことを確認してから、早足で裏口から外に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is no time to be impressed. I need to get outside without Hisui seeing me.”
I changed from my pajamas into everyday clothes.
I opened the door a crack to make sure the hall was empty, then hurried out through the back entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… This isn't the time to be impressed.
I too have to sneak out without Hisui noticing."
I change into some normal clothes.
Cracking open the door slightly, I look around to make sure no one's in the hallway and tip-toe outside.

entries.japanese:
運良く誰にも見つからずに外に出れた。
　アルクェイドはこちらに背を向けて、なにやらぶつぶつと独り言を繰り返している。
「お待たせ。
ほら、とりあえず行こうぜアルクェイド。
いつまでも屋敷の周りにいると琥珀さんに見つかっちまう」
「え？
　あ、うん、行くなら早く行こっか」
　さっきまでのはっきりした様子と違って、アルクェイドの返事は上の空だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
By good fortune, I made it outside unseen.
Arcueid stood with her back to me, muttering something over and over to herself.
“Sorry to keep you waiting. Come on, let’s get moving, Arcueid. If we stay near the mansion, Kohaku will find us.”
“What? Oh, yes—if we’re going, let’s hurry.”
Unlike her crisp certainty before, Arcueid sounded distracted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Luckily, no one saw me as I made my way out.
Arcueid is looking the other way as she mumbles to herself.
"Thanks for waiting.
C'mon, let's go Arcueid.
If we stick around here, Kohaku-san will find us."
"Eh?
Ah, yeah, we should go."
Completely different from before, her words seem very empty.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ、らしくないな。
俺を待ってる間にまた何かあったのか？」
「……ううん、別に何もなかったけど」
　また、という部分を力強く発音しておいたのだが、やっぱりアルクェイドの返事は上の空だ。
―――なんか、何かたくらんでいそうでこわい。
「……もしかして昼間だから体調が悪いのか？
　別に無理をしてまで街を出歩く必要なんてないんだから、苦しいんならやめにしよう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong—this isn’t like you. Did something else happen while you were waiting?”
“No, nothing happened.”
I had put particular weight on else, but her answer remained absentminded.
―――Somehow, that made me afraid she was plotting something.
“Does daylight make you ill? There’s no reason to force yourself to walk around town, so if you’re suffering, we can call it off.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it?
This isn't like you at all.
Did something happen again just now?"
"…… No, nothing really."
I said the 'again' part strong, but her words are still hollow.
----It seems like she's planning something.
I feel kind of scared.
"…… Are you feeling sick because it's daytime?
There's no need to force yourself to go out.
If it's hard for you, we can stop."

entries.japanese:
「んー、別に体調は良好なんだけどね。
ちょっとこの塀を見てたら昨日のこと思い出しちゃって」
「……？
　昨日のことって、公園で俺をずっと待ってたってこと？」
　そう、とアルクェイドは神妙な顔でうなずく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I feel perfectly well. Looking at this wall just reminded me of last night.”
“…? You mean waiting for me in the park?”
Arcueid nodded gravely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Mmh, I feel fine right now.
But seeing this wall reminded me of last night."
"……?
About last night, you mean while you waited for me at the park?"
"Yes," Arcueid nods meekly.

entries.japanese:
「わたし、昨日の夜はここを全力で飛び越えて、そのまま志貴の部屋に忍び込んだんだけど……今にして思うと不思議だなって。
　どうしてわたし、あの時あんなに怒ってたんだろ。
約束のひとつぐらい、今まで何度も果たせなかったっていうのに」
　わかんないなぁ、とアルクェイドは両手を組んで考え込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Last night I cleared this wall at full speed and sneaked straight into your room, but now that I think about it, it seems strange.
Why was I so angry? I’ve failed to keep promises plenty of times before.”
Arcueid clasped her hands and frowned in thought, murmuring that she didn’t understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I dashed here with all my strength and snuck into your room…… but it seems strange when I think about it now.
Why was I so angry back then?
It was just a little promise."
Saying she doesn't get it, Arcueid crosses her arms in thought.

entries.japanese:
「あ、そうだ。
志貴ならわかるかな？
　いつもわたしのことをばかばかって言い伏せるんだから、これぐらいわかるでしょ？」
「あのね……」
　アルクェイド本人に分からないものが、他人である俺に分かるはずもない。
　わかるはずもないけど、あえて答えろうというんなら――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, I know. Maybe you can tell me, Shiki. You’re always calling me an idiot and lecturing me, so surely you can figure this out.”
“Listen…”
If Arcueid herself did not know, how could an outsider like me?
But if I were to venture an answer anyway—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, that's right.
Maybe you get it, Shiki?
You always tell me I'm so stupid, so maybe you can understand?"
"Hey……"
If she doesn't understand herself, then how does she expect me to?
There's no way I understand, but if I have to respond----

entries.japanese:
「単にアルクェイドは怒りやすいだけなんじゃないか？
　基本的にわがままな性格しているからな」
　きっぱりと、思ったままの意見を告げた。
「そっかー、言われてみればそうかもね。
わたし、志貴に殺されてからすっごく感情的になってるみたいだし」
　うんうんと満足そうにアルクェイドはうなずく。
　……まあ、事の真偽はどうあれアルクェイドが納得したのなら問題は解決だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe Arcueid simply has a short temper. She’s selfish by nature, after all.”
I gave her my honest opinion without hesitation.
“Oh, that might be it. Come to think of it, I’ve been much more emotional ever since you killed me, Shiki.”
Arcueid nodded repeatedly, looking thoroughly satisfied.
Whether my theory was true hardly mattered; if Arcueid was satisfied, the problem was solved.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aren't you just easily angered?
You're a pretty selfish person at heart, after all."
I clearly voice my thoughts on the matter.
"Really?
Now that you mention it, you could be right.
It seems like I've become really emotional since you killed me."
Arcueid nods in a satisfied manner.
…… Well, whether that was the truth or not, the problem is resolved as long as Arcueid is convinced.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだな、俺のことが嫌いだからじゃないか？
　待ち合わせ時間も守れてないし、そもそも一度アルクェイドにひどいことをしてるだろ、俺は」
　……俺のアルクェイドに対する感情はとりあえず置いておいて、冷静に分析してみる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe it’s because you hate me. I failed to show up when we agreed, and I did something terrible to you once.”
Setting aside how I felt about Arcueid, I tried to analyze the question objectively.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Let's see, isn't it because you hate me?
I haven't been able to meet you on time, and I've done a lot of horrible things to you."
…… Leaving my feelings about Arcueid aside, I calmly analyze the situation.

entries.japanese:
「――――そうなのかな。
わたし、誰かに感情を持つなんて初めてだからよく解らないけど……」
　と、アルクェイドは少しのあいだだけ黙り込んで、顔をあげた。
「……その、志貴はわたしのこと、嫌いなのかな……？」
　なんて事を、聞いてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Could that be it? I’ve never felt anything for another person before, so I’m not sure…”
Arcueid fell silent for a moment, then raised her face.
“So—do you hate me, Shiki…?”
Of all the things she could have asked me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Is that so?
This is the first time I've ever felt emotion towards someone, so I don't really understand it myself……"
After being quiet for a few moments, she raises her head.
"…… Um, Shiki, do you hate me……?"
And asks me such a question.

entries.japanese:
「お、俺……？
　俺は、その――――」
「………………」
　アルクェイドはじっと、無言で見つめてくる。
「俺は―――嫌いじゃないから、アルクェイドに協力してる」
　……とりあえず、それは嘘偽りのない真実だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“M-me? I…”
“……”
Arcueid stared silently into my eyes.
“I’m helping you because I don’t hate you.”
At least that much was the unvarnished truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"M, me……?
I, um----"
"………………"
Arcueid stares at me silently.
"I----I don't hate you, that's why I'm helping you."
…… For now, that's the honest truth.

entries.japanese:
「……なるほど。
じゃあわたしも志貴と同じなのかもしれないな」
　納得したのかしないのか、アルクェイドは曖昧に頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then maybe I feel the same way about you.”
Whether convinced or not, Arcueid gave an uncertain nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Then maybe I feel the same way too."
Arcueid gives an ambiguous nod.
I'm not sure if she understands.

entries.japanese:
「さあ、俺に聞かれても解らないよ。
アルクェイドは吸血鬼なんだから、俺たちとは考え方が違うんだろうし」
「むっ……！
　なによそれ、わたしの思考の雛形は人間と同じなんだから、少ししか違ってないわ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How should I know? You’re a vampire, Arcueid, so you probably don’t think the way we do.”
“Hey…! What’s that supposed to mean—my mind is modeled on a human one, so I’m hardly different at all!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How the heck am I supposed to know?
You're a vampire, so I bet you think a lot differently than we do."
"Hey……!
What do you mean!?
My thought processes are basically the same as a human's, so there's only a little difference!"

entries.japanese:
「でも違うんだろ？
　まあそんな事は別にしても、他人の感情なんてわからないよ。
自分の感情さえ確かじゃないんだから、吸血鬼であるアルクェイドの感情は理解の範疇を超えてるよ」
「そうねっ！
　わたしだって志貴がどんな人かわからないし、わかる必要なんてないもの！
　えーえー、志貴なんかに聞いたわたしが浅はかでした！」
　ふん、とアルクェイドは顔を背ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hardly still means different. Besides, no one can truly understand another person’s feelings. I’m not even sure of my own, so understanding the feelings of a vampire is far beyond me.”
“Fine! I don’t know what kind of person you are either, Shiki, and I don’t need to!
Yes, yes, how foolish of me to ask you!”
Arcueid turned away with an indignant huff.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But still different, right?
Well, leaving that aside, it's impossible to understand another's feelings.
I'm not too sure about my own emotions, so it's impossible for me to understand a vampire's train of thought.
"Yeah!
I don't understand you either; there's no need to understand!
Yeah, yeah, I'm just an idiot for asking you!"
Arcueid turns away with a "hmph!"

entries.japanese: ……なんか怒らせてしまったけど、ともあれそれなりに納得はしてくれたようだ。
entries.maoEnglish: I seemed to have made her angry, but at least she had accepted my answer after a fashion.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… She's gotten a little angry, but at least she seems convinced.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　ちらり、と時計を見る。
　時刻は午前九時をまわってしまっている。
　学校には完全に遅刻だが、それでも遅すぎる、というわけでもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I glanced at the clock.
It was already past nine.
I would unquestionably be late, but it was not so late that going to school had become pointless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I glance at the clock.
It's already past nine.
I'm late as it is, but it's not too late yet.

entries.japanese:
「いや、やっぱりダメだ。
アルクェイドには協力するけど、だからって自分の生活を崩すことはできない。
俺がアルクェイドに協力するのは夜だけだって決めてるんだから」
「………ふぅん」
　いかにも文句を言いたげな視線で、アルクェイドはじっとりと俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I can’t. I’ll help you, Arcueid, but I can’t let that destroy my own life. I decided from the start that I would only help you at night.”
“Is that so.”
Arcueid stared at me with a long, reproachful gaze, plainly brimming with complaints.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I'd better not.
I'll help you, but I can't let that affect my daily life.
I've already decided we'll only work at night."
"…… Oh?"
Looking like she wants to complain, she stares at me.

entries.japanese:
「ま、たしかに志貴の言い分には一理あるかな。
志貴は自分の生活を守るためにわたしに協力してくれてるんだから、そのために自分の生活サイクルから外れるのは矛盾してるものね」
　さっぱりと、アルクェイドはこっちの言い分を受け入れる。
　……感情的なくせに整然とした理路をたどるアルクェイドは、らしいといえば実にらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I suppose you have a point. You’re helping me to protect your ordinary life, so ruining that routine in order to help me would be contradictory.”
Arcueid accepted my reasoning with surprising ease.
Emotional though she was, Arcueid followed any orderly chain of logic through to the end, which was very like her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, you have a point.
You're helping me to protect your way of living, so it wouldn't make any sense to go out of your normal life to do so."
She takes in my point rather easily.
…… She's emotional yet logical, I guess that would be like her.

entries.japanese:
「志貴は好きなだけ自分の生活を楽しめばいいわ。
それでわたしとの約束は忘れないでいてくれるなら、問題はないもの」
　言って、アルクェイドは窓際まで歩いていく。
「それじゃあね。
今夜もこんな事になったら、その時は殺しちゃうから」
　冗談っぽく、掛け値なしの本音を口にしてアルクェイドは消えた。
　窓から外に飛び出して、木の枝から枝へと飛び移っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Enjoy your own life as much as you want. As long as you don’t forget your promises to me, there’s no problem.”
With that, Arcueid walked to the window.
“See you tonight. If the same thing happens again, I’ll kill you.”
Arcueid disappeared after delivering an entirely sincere threat in a joking voice.
She leaped through the window and bounded from branch to branch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You can enjoy your life all you want.
As long as you don't forget your promise, there's no problem."
Saying that, she walks over to the window.
"Later.
If it happens again tonight, I'll kill you."
Arcueid tells the truth jokingly as she disappears.
Jumping out the window, she bounds from tree branch to tree branch.

entries.japanese:
「…………怒ってたな、アイツ」
　けど、こっちだって学校は大切なんだ。
　夜はアイツに付き合っているんだから、昼間ぐらいはゆっくりさせてくれてもいいと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She was angry.”
But school mattered to me, too.
If I spent my nights helping her, she could at least let me have the daylight hours to myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… She was pretty angry."
But, school is important for me too.
I spend the nights with her, so I think it's alright if I relax during the day.

entries.japanese:
「さて。
学校に行くか」
　一晩眠って、体はすっかり回復している。
　すばやく学生服に着替えて、翡翠と琥珀さんに見付からないように屋敷を出ないといけないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right. Time for school.”
A full night’s sleep had restored me completely.
I would have to change quickly into my uniform and slip out before Hisui or Kohaku found me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, shall I go to school?"
Because I slept all night, my body's completely recovered.
I have to quickly change into my uniform and sneak out so Hisui and Kohaku-san don't see me.

entries.japanese:
「ん――――」
　軽い眩暈がした。
　……昨日の後遺症だろう。
体のいたるところが重くて、ちょっとした頭痛がする。
「……ま、これぐらいなら大丈夫だよな」
　この程度の不具合なら、学校で椅子に座ってればすぐに良くなる。
　気を取り直して、小走りで学校に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
A faint wave of dizziness passed through me.
Aftereffects from yesterday, probably. My whole body felt heavy, and a slight headache throbbed behind my eyes.
“This much is nothing.”
If I sat quietly at school, a minor problem like this would soon clear up.
I pulled myself together and jogged toward school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm----"
I'm a little dizzy.
…… It's probably the after-effects of yesterday.
My body feels a bit heavy and I have a slight headache.
"…… Well, I guess this much is okay."
Just a small amount of dizziness.
I can always take it easy once I sit down at my desk in school.
I get myself together and jog towards school.

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　三時限目が始まる前に、なんとか教室に滑りこむ。
　パッと見た感じ、有彦の姿はなかった。
欠席なんだろうけど、おかげで今日は静かに過ごせそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…”
I managed to slip into the classroom before third period began.
One glance told me Arihiko wasn’t there. He must have been absent, which at least promised me a quiet day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----*sigh*
I manage to make it into class before third period.
Looking around, Arihiko's seat is empty.
He's probably absent, but that means today will be quiet.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになった。
　有彦は休みらしい。
　……今日の欠席者は乾有彦と弓塚さつきの二人だ。
弓塚さつきのほうは風邪をこじらせたとかでここのところずっと欠席している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunchtime came.
Apparently Arihiko was absent.
Today’s absentees were Arihiko Inui and Satsuki Yumizuka. Yumizuka had supposedly come down with a stubborn cold and had been away for several days now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Lunch time.
It looks like Arihiko's not coming.
…… Inui Arihiko and Yumizuka Satsuki are the two people absent today.
Yumizuka Satsuki has caught a cold or something and she will be absent for a while.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩も来そうにないし、一人でメシにするか」
　ぼんやりと呟いてみたが、食欲はまったくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel doesn’t look like she’s coming either, so I guess I’ll eat alone.”
I muttered absently, though I had no appetite at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai doesn't seem to be coming too, so I guess I'll eat by myself."
I say that, but I'm not hungry.

entries.japanese:
……なんだろう。
　朝から調子は悪かったけど、学校に来てから余計に気持ちが悪くなった気がする。
　それも体の重さだけじゃない。
胸の古傷がチリチリして、痒いような煩わしいような、そんな感覚がしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
What was wrong with me?
I had felt ill since morning, but coming to school seemed to have made it worse.
It was more than the heaviness in my body. The old scar on my chest prickled with an irritating sensation, almost like an itch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What is it?
I didn't feel so good to begin with, but after coming to school, I feel a lot worse.
It's not just my body feeling heavy.
The scar on my chest is irritating; it's an annoying sensation.

entries.japanese:
「……学校、休んだほうが良かったかな」
　……一瞬だけ翡翠と秋葉の不安そうな顔が浮かんだ。
　ただ座っているだけで疲れてしまって、俺はよく解らない違和感にさいなまれてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe I should’ve stayed home.”
For an instant, Hisui’s and Akiha’s worried faces rose in my mind.
Merely sitting upright exhausted me, while an incomprehensible sense of wrongness tormented my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe I shouldn't have come to school."
…… For a brief moment, I see the worrying faces of Hisui and Akiha in my mind.
Being worn out by just sitting, I start to feel a strange uneasiness.

entries.japanese:
「疑問は氷解しましたか。
ならさっさと行こう……って、アルクェイド。
おまえ、何処か行きたいところがあるのか？」
「んー、わからないから志貴にまかせる。
どこか適当なところに連れていって」
　……自分から散歩するだなんて言っておいてそれか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mystery solved? Then let’s get moving. Wait, Arcueid—is there somewhere you want to go?”
“Hmm, I don’t know, so I’ll leave it to you, Shiki. Take me somewhere.”
So much for being the one who suggested a walk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Does that clear it up?
Then let's go…… Arcueid, do you have anywhere in mind?"
"Hmm, I don't know so I'll let you decide.
Just take me wherever?"
…… So she told me we're going somewhere and now it's this?

entries.japanese:
仕方ないな――俺もアルクェイドが喜ぶような場所なんて見当がつかないけど、とりあえず遊び場と呼ばれる場所に連れて行くか。
　さて、それじゃあ――
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh well—I had no idea what sort of place Arcueid would enjoy, but I could at least take her somewhere people went for fun.
In that case—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh well--I'm not sure what kind of place she likes, but I'll take her to a good hangout place.
Well then--

entries.japanese:
とりあえず、定番というか安定というか、観るべき物さえ面白ければ退屈はしない映画を観る事にした。
「ここはいつも賑やかね。
なにがあるのかはよく知らないけど」
　アルクェイドは俺の横についてきている。
「―――――」
　途中―――というか今も現在進行形で、周りの人たちからチラチラと視線を送られている。
　……その、言うまでもなく、アルクェイドがそう簡単にはお目にかかれないぐらいの美人のせいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
For our first stop I chose the safest classic—a movie that could hardly bore us as long as the film itself was good.
“This part of town is always lively. I don’t really know what’s here, though.”
Arcueid walked beside me.
“……”
All along the way—and even now—people kept stealing glances at us.
Needless to say, it was because Arcueid was the sort of beauty most people never saw in their lives.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For the time being, the movie theater is always a safe bet.
As long as the movie you choose is good, it can't be boring.
"This place is always pretty lively, although I don't know what's here."
Arcueid walks right next to me.
"------"
On the way----actually even now, everyone around us keeps casting glances our way.
…… It doesn't need to be said, but it's probably because Arcueid really stands out.

entries.japanese:
自分でも少しは意識していたけれど、まわりからそういう反応をされると余計に意識してしまって、困る。
　アルクェイドは今までとなんら変わることなく接してきているのに、こっちだけがアルクェイドを女性として意識してしまっているもんだから、さっきから会話がまったく上の空だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had already been a little conscious of her, but other people’s reactions made it impossible not to be, which was a problem.
Arcueid treated me no differently than before; I was the only one suddenly conscious of her as a woman, and I had barely heard a word she had said all morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm aware of it a little, but everyone else's reactions make me even more conscious of it, and it's a bit troubling.
Arcueid acts just like she normally does, but since I can't help but be overwhelmed by her femininity, I can't seem to make any meaningful conversation.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ、聞いているの志貴？
　これからどこに行くのかって聞いてるんだけど、わたし」
「あ―――その、どうするもこうするも、ここにきたカップルはたいてい映画館に入るのだ」
　びし、と目前の映画館を指差す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you listening, Shiki? I asked where we’re going.”
“Ah—well, couples who come here generally go to the movies.”
I pointed decisively at the theater ahead.
