entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, do you hear me Shiki?
I'm asking you where we're going."
"Ah----um, well most couples here usually go to the movie theater."
I point to the movie theater in front of us.

entries.japanese:
「映画館……ふぅん、映画を観ようってことなんだ」
　……お姫さまは明らかに気が乗らないみたいだった。
　しかし、ここまで来たからには他の選択肢なんてない。
　だいたい俺に吸血鬼の女の子が喜ぶような場所なんてわかるはずがないのだ。
　ここまできたら、つまんなーい、と文句を言われるのを覚悟するしかないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A theater—so we’re watching a movie.”
The princess was obviously unimpressed.
But now that we were here, there were no other options.
How was I supposed to know what kind of place a vampire girl would enjoy?
I could only brace myself for her to complain that it was boring.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Movie theater…… hmm, so watching a movie then."
…… The princess does not seem to be pleased.
But, after coming this far, I don't have a choice.
It's not like I have any clue what would please a vampire girl in the first place.
Because I've gone this far, I just have to prepare myself for her to say "Boring."

entries.japanese:
「いいから入るよ。
不満があるのならここで別行動すればいいだろ」
「まあ、不満はないけど」
　はあ、とため息をついてアルクェイドは付いてくる。
　しょぼん、と落ちた肩が『この甲斐性なし』と訴えてきているようで、背中が痛い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, we’re going in. If you hate the idea, we can split up here.”
“I don’t hate it.”
Arcueid sighed and followed.
Her dejected shoulders seemed to accuse me of being a hopeless excuse for a date, and I could feel the reproach between my shoulder blades.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just go in.
If you're dissatisfied, we can always split up here."
"I'm not really… dissatisfied."
Giving a sigh, Arcueid follows me.
She slumps her shoulders as if to say "you good-for nothing guy!".

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあチケットを買ってくるけど、なにを観る？
　えーと、今やってるのは恋愛ものと恋愛ものと恋愛ものだな。
……なんていうか、実にふざけた映画館だ」
　っていうか、こっちも帰りたくなってきた。
「どれでもいいわ。
なんかどれも同じみたいだもの」
「そうだな。
それじゃあ適当に選んでみるか」
　短い行列に並んで、二人分のチケットを買ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll buy the tickets—what do you want to see? Let’s see—the choices are a romance, a romance, and a romance. What a ridiculous theater.”
Now I wanted to go home too.
“Any of them. They all look the same.”
“True. I’ll pick one at random.”
I joined the short line and bought two tickets.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm going to go buy tickets, but what do you want to see?
Let's see, there's a romance, and a romance, and a romance…… this theater kind of stinks."
To be honest, I want to go back too.
"Any one of them is fine.
They really all look the same."
"Yeah.
Then let's just buy one."
I get in the shortest line and buy two tickets.

entries.japanese:
「あいよ。
その券を中に入る時に見せればいいから。
券の半分を取られるけど、それが決まりなんだから怒ったりしちゃダメだぞ」
「それぐらい知ってるわ。
志貴はわたしのこと、なんにも知らない女だって思ってるのね」
「あ……いや、なんとなく。
あんまり人間社会のこと知らないのかなって」
「知識だけならきちんと蓄えているって言わなかったかしら。
わたし、映画館のことぐらい知ってるわ」
　ぷい、と顔をそむけてアルクェイドは映画館へ歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Here. Show that when we go in. They’ll tear off half, but that’s the rule, so don’t get angry.”
“I know that much. You think I’m completely ignorant, don’t you?”
“No. I only thought you might not know much about human society.”
“Didn’t I tell you I have all the necessary knowledge? I know about movie theaters, at least.”
Arcueid turned her face away and marched toward the entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here you go.
Just show this ticket when we go in.
They'll take half of the ticket, but that's how it's supposed to be so don't get angry."
"I know that much.
You really think I don't know anything, Shiki."
"Ah…… no, that's not it.
I just thought maybe you didn't know much about human society."
"I have some knowledge of it stored away.
I know at least about a movie theater."
Giving a small "hmph", she turns her face away and walks towards the theater.

entries.japanese:
……失敗した。
　やっぱり吸血鬼を映画館に連れてきても、退屈に思われるだけだったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had failed.
Bringing a vampire to the movies had apparently done nothing but bore her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It was a mistake.
I knew taking a vampire to a movie theater would be too dull.

entries.japanese:
―――映画館から出てきた。
　二人で観た映画は恋愛もので、つまらなくはなかったがとりたてて面白くもなかった。
　典型的なフランス映画で、うわっと盛り上がる場面よりはしっとりとした雰囲気に重きを置いた作品だった。
　映画館から出てきて、アルクェイドは無言で俺のとなりを歩いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――We emerged from the theater.
The romance we saw wasn’t bad, but it wasn’t especially good either.
It was a typical French film, more concerned with quiet atmosphere than dramatic excitement.
After we left the theater, Arcueid walked beside me without a word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----We exit the theater.
We watched a romance… it wasn't exactly boring, but not terribly interesting either.
It was a typical French movie.
It focused less on breathtaking scenes and concentrated more on creating a calm atmosphere.
As we leave the theater, Arcueid walks with me wordlessly.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　……沈黙が気まずい。
　せめてアクションものとかホラーものだったら、もうちょっとはこう、アルクェイドも喜んだかもしれないのに。
「あのさ、アルクェイド」
「うん、おもしろかったね志貴！」
　は、はいいいい………！？
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
The silence was awkward.
If only I had picked an action or horror film, perhaps she would have enjoyed herself a little.
“Hey, Arcueid—”
“That was wonderful, Shiki!”
W-whaaaaaat…!?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
…… An uncomfortable silence.
Maybe she would've been happier if it was an action flick or a horror movie.
"Hey, Arcueid."
"Yeah, it was really fun, Shiki!"
Wh, wh, wha, what……!?

entries.japanese:
「いや、面白かったって、アルクェイド？」
「まいったなぁ、聞くのと観るのとじゃ大違いなんだもん。
そりゃあ知識として映画館がどんなところか知ってたけど、そんなものは瑣末な空想でしかなかったみたい」
　……その、アルクェイドは心底嬉しそうに笑っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You thought it was wonderful?”
“Knowing about movies and actually seeing one are completely different! I knew what a theater was, but that knowledge was nothing more than a paltry little daydream.”
Arcueid was smiling with unfeigned delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh, fun, Arcueid?"
"Man, hearing about it and seeing it were two entirely different things.
Even though I knew some background information about what a movie theater was, my imagination fell short of reality."
…… Arcueid gives a happy, heartfelt smile.

entries.japanese:
「暗がりっていうのがいいのかな。
大きい音なのにうるさくなかったし、志貴が隣にいるっていうのも楽しかったし。
　でも、そんなことより内容が良かったよね！
　よくもまあ、架空の話をあそこまで作り上げられるもんだなって驚いたわ。
あの情景の細かさに比べたら、わたしの創るイメージなんて子供だましみたいなものだし、ほんとに感心しちゃった」
「……あ、そ、そうですか」
「あれ？
　志貴ったらさえない顔してる。
もしかしてつまんなかった？」
「いや、つまらないっていうより、普通だなって。
アレだったら他にもっと面白いものがあるから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe it was the darkness. The sound was loud, but it didn’t feel noisy, and having you beside me was fun.
More than that, though, the story was wonderful! I can’t believe humans can construct an imaginary world in such detail. Compared with scenery that precise, the images I create are childish; I’m honestly impressed.”
“O-oh, I see.”
“What? Why the long face, Shiki? Didn’t you like it?”
“It wasn’t bad, just ordinary. There are much better movies than that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The darkness was really nice, and even though the sounds were loud, they weren't noisy.
And having you next to me was also fun.
But more than that, the subject matter was really good!
I was surprised they would go so far to make up a story.
It's so detailed, my imagination was nothing like that.
I was really moved."
"…… Ah, is… is that so?"
"Huh?
You look like you don't agree.
Was it boring?"
"No, not really boring, just ordinary.
There's way more interesting things than that."

entries.japanese:
「うそ。
だってさっきの、すごく良かったよ！？」
「まあ、通はああいう映画がいいっていうらしいけど、単純にもっといいものだってあるの。
　今は時期を外しているからやってないけど、大作って呼ばれるもんはさっきの数倍は退屈しないぞ。
　はっきり言って、さっき観たのは中の下ぐらいのランクだよ」
「……びっくり」
「……わかりやすい感情表現をするんだね、アルクェイド」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No! That one was amazing!”
“Film buffs might praise that kind of thing, but there are simply better movies.
None of the big productions are showing right now, but they’re several times more entertaining.
Honestly, what we just saw was below average.”
“Wow.”
“You certainly make your emotions easy to read, Arcueid.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No way.
That was really good, you know!?"
"Well, I guess movie experts like that kind of movie, but there's a ton of better ones.
They are not out right now, but there are epics out there many times better than that.
To be blunt, what we just saw was pretty low quality."
"…… I'm surprised."
"…… It's so easy to read your expressions Arcueid."

entries.japanese:
驚いたというより、呆れた。
　アルクェイドのやつ、観る前までは冷めていたからさぞかし文句を言ってくるかと思えば、この程度の映画で子供みたいにはしゃいでいる。
「……残念だな。
もうちょっと前なら文句なしにいい映画がやってたのに。
そんなに喜ぶってわかってたら連れて来てやればよかった」
　ありがとう、と感謝されるためじゃない。
ただ純粋にアルクェイドを喜ばしてやろうと思ってみたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
I was less surprised than exasperated.
Before the film she had been so cool toward the idea that I expected endless complaints, yet now she was giddy as a child over a mediocre movie.
“That’s a shame. A little while ago they were showing a genuinely great film. If I’d known you would enjoy it this much, I would have brought you then.”
It wasn’t that I wanted her gratitude. I simply found myself wishing I could make Arcueid happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Not just surprised, but amazed.
That Arcueid, she looked so not into it, so I thought she was going to complain… but now she's like an excited kid.
"…… Too bad.
If it was earlier, we could've seen a better movie.
If I knew you would have liked it, I would have taken you."
It's not so she thanks me, but I genuinely do want to make her happy.

entries.japanese:
「そっかあ。
間が悪いんだね、わたしと志貴って」
　がっかり、と肩をおとすアルクェイド。
「ほんとだな。
なんだかカラぶってばっかりだ」
　がっかり、と俺も肩をおとす。
　……うん、本当に。
　もうちょっとぐらいアルクェイドが楽しそうに笑う姿を、見ていてもよかったっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. You and I have terrible timing, Shiki.”
Arcueid’s shoulders fell.
“We really do. Everything we try seems to miss.”
My shoulders fell with hers.
Yes, truly.
I wouldn’t have minded watching her smile like that a little longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, I see.
I guess we don't have much luck."
Arcueid slumps her shoulders in disappointment.
"Yeah, we just keep missing the opportunities."
I slump my shoulders in disappointment too.
…… Yeah, really.
It really would have been nice to see her happy, smiling face a little longer.

entries.japanese:
とりあえず街中に出た。
　あとは大通りから離れて、人気のない路地裏に出るだけなんだけど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
We went downtown first.
All that remained was to leave the main avenue and find a deserted alley, but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
For the time being, we go into town.
All that's left is to branch off the main street and go to the empty alley----

entries.japanese:
「なに？
　どうかした、志貴？」
「いや、いつもと様子が違うから、戸惑ってるだけ」
「？」
　アルクェイドはかすかに首をかしげる。
　……どうも、本人はまったく気がついていないようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Shiki? Something wrong?”
“No—things just feel different than usual, and it’s throwing me off.”
“?”
Arcueid tilted her head slightly.
Apparently she hadn’t noticed anything herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
What is it, Shiki?"
"Nothing.
It's different that normal, so I was just a little confused."
"?"
Arcueid perplexedly cocks her head to the side.
…… It seems like she doesn't notice at all.

entries.japanese:
率直にいうと、ものすごく視線を感じる。
　道を歩いているだけで周りの人たちからチラチラと視線を送られている。
　……その、言うまでもなく、アルクェイドがそう簡単にはお目にかかれないぐらいの美人のせいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
To be blunt, I could feel people staring.
Everywhere we walked, passersby stole glances at us.
Needless to say, it was because Arcueid was the sort of beauty most people never saw in their lives.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can feel the weight of stares all around me.
Just walking down the street causes people all around to cast glances at us.
…… It doesn't need to be said, but it's probably because Arcueid really stands out.

entries.japanese:
自分でも少しは意識していたけど、まわりからこういう反応をされると余計に意識してしまって、困る。
　アルクェイドは今までとなんら変わることなく接してきているのに、こっちだけがアルクェイドを女性として意識してしまっているもんだから、さっきから会話がまったく上の空だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had already been conscious of her, but everyone else’s reaction made it much worse.
Arcueid treated me exactly as she always had, while I alone had started seeing her as a woman, leaving me unable to follow our conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm a little aware of it, but everyone else's reactions make me even more conscious of it, and it's a bit troubling.
Arcueid acts just like she normally does, but since I can't help but be overwhelmed by her femininity, I can't seem to make any meaningful conversation.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ、聞いているの志貴？
　これからどこに行くのかって聞いてるんだけど、わたし」
「ああ、もうすぐだから我慢してくれ。
アルクェイドが落ちつける所に向かってるから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you listening, Shiki? I asked where we’re going.”
“We’re almost there, so be patient. I’m taking you somewhere you can relax.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, do you hear me Shiki?
I'm asking you where we're going."
"We're almost there so hold on.
We're going somewhere you can relax."

entries.japanese: ―――というわけで、路地裏に到着した。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――And so we arrived in an alley.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----And we arrive at the alley.

entries.japanese:
「待たせたな。
ここなら人気もないし、アルクェイドも落ちつける―――」
「…………………………」
　あれ―――？
　
　心なしか、アルクェイドの視線に、殺気がこもっているような気が、する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry for the wait. There’s no one around here, so you can relax—”
“……”
Huh?
Was it my imagination, or had murderous intent entered Arcueid’s stare?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here we are.
People don't normally come by here, so you can relax here----"
"……………………"
Huh----?
Her gaze suddenly turns heartless, almost deadly.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド……？
　もしかして、ここは気に入らないのか……？」
「…………………………」
　……よっぽど気に入らないのか、アルクェイドは口さえ利いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…? You don’t like it here?”
“……”
Apparently she hated it so much she wouldn’t even speak to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid……?
Don't tell me, you're not happy with this place……?"
"……………………"
…… She seems so angry she can't even speak.

entries.japanese:
「おかしいな……アルクェイドは吸血鬼だから、人込みよりこういう所のほうが好みかなって思ったんだけど――――」
「―――――――――！」
　ぎらり、とアルクェイドの眼光が鋭くなる。
　……まずい。
なんか、ここまで怒っているアルクェイドを見るのは初めてかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s strange—you’re a vampire, so I thought you’d prefer somewhere like this to a crowd—”
“—!”
Arcueid’s eyes flashed.
This was bad. I might never have seen her this angry before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's odd…… You're a vampire, so I thought you would like a place like this better than somewhere crowded----"
"----------!"
The light in her eyes sharpens.
…… This isn't good.
This might be the first time I've seen her this angry.

entries.japanese:
はあ、と大きくため息をついて、アルクェイドは顔をあげた。
「ね、志貴。
これ、何の冗談かな？」
「あ――――う」
　こわい。
なにが恐いって、これ以上恐いことはないっていうぐらい、アルクェイドの笑顔はこわい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid heaved a long sigh and raised her face.
“Tell me, Shiki. What kind of joke is this?”
“Ah—uh.”
Terrifying. Nothing in the world could have been more frightening than Arcueid’s smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Giving a deep sigh, Arcueid looks up again.
"Hey, Shiki.
What kind of a joke is this?"
"Ah----uh."
Frightening.
Her smiling face is really frightening.

entries.japanese:
「いや、あの……もうしわけ、ございません。
完全にこっちの手違いだった」
　両手を合わせて拝み倒す。
　アルクェイドは笑顔のままだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m terribly sorry. This was entirely my mistake.”
I pressed my palms together and begged.
Arcueid kept smiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, um…… I'm really sorry.
I really messed up."
I bring my hands together and implore forgiveness.
She keeps smiling.

entries.japanese:
「そうだよね、こんなところに来ても遊ぶものなんてないし、出来ることっていったら志貴と初めて会った時のやり直しぐらいだもの」
　初めて会った時って、その―――
「うん、今ならあの時とはちょっと違った展開になるかも。
それはそれで楽しいかな、志貴？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right—there’s nothing to do in a place like this, and the only entertainment would be reenacting our first meeting.”
Our first meeting—that meant—
“It might turn out a little differently this time. Wouldn’t that be fun, Shiki?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right, there's really nothing to do here.
The only thing we could do here is to replay the time we first met."
When we first met!?
That means----
"Yeah, the results may turn out a little different from back then, but that might be fun too, right Shiki?"

entries.japanese:
―――これは、脅迫だ。
　アルクェイドのヤツ、笑顔で逆襲をしてきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――This was a threat.
Arcueid was smiling as she took her revenge.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----This is a threat.
She counterattacks with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「……だから悪かったって。
反省してるから、その笑顔だけはやめてくれ。
次はもっとマシなところに連れていくから」
「そう？
　けっこうその気になってたんだけどな、わたし」
　残念そうに首をかしげるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I said I was sorry. I’ve learned my lesson, so please stop smiling like that. Next time I’ll take you somewhere better.”
“Really? I was beginning to like the idea.”
Arcueid tilted her head in disappointment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I said I'm sorry.
I'll make it up to you, so please stop smiling like that.
I'll take you somewhere better."
"Really?
I was getting in the mood for it too."
She looks disappointed.

entries.japanese:
……本当に反省しよう。
　いくらアルクェイドが吸血鬼だからって、デート先に路地裏を選ぶなんてどうかしていたとしか思えない……
entries.maoEnglish:
I really did need to reflect.
Vampire or not, choosing an alley for a date had been indefensible—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I really must contemplate my actions.
Even though Arcueid is a vampire, I must have been really stupid to take her to an alley for a date……

entries.japanese:
それから四時間ばかり。
　好奇心の塊みたいなアルクェイドの要望に応えて、駅前のデパートをはしごする結果となった。
entries.maoEnglish:
For the next four hours.
I catered to the whims of that embodiment of curiosity and ended up making the rounds of the department stores by the station.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For four hours…
Appropriate for the ball of curiosity that is Arcueid, we end up going to the department store in front of the station.

entries.japanese: アルクェイドは俺を困らせるために連れまわしていたらしいが、途中から楽しくなってきたのか機嫌もそれなりに直してくれて、まあ、疲れはしたけどそれなりに充実した時間を過ごせたと思う。
entries.maoEnglish: Apparently Arcueid had meant to punish me by running me ragged, but somewhere along the way she started enjoying herself and her mood improved; it was exhausting, but I had to admit the time felt well spent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems like Arcueid made me take her there just to trouble me, but somewhere along the way, I guess it started to be pretty fun for her and she became happy again.
It was a little tiring, but I think it was a good time.

entries.japanese:
天気もいい事だし、公園に連れ出す事にした。
　とりあえず公園でのんびりとしてから、街に戻って適当な遊び場に行くのが適切だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The weather was fine, so I decided to take her to the park.
We could relax there for a while, then return downtown and find somewhere more entertaining.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The weather's great so I decide to go to the park.
We can relax there and then go somewhere else more appropriate later.

entries.japanese:
公園に入る。
　平日の午前中だっていうのに、なぜかあたりには俺たちと同年輩の若者がちらほらと歩いていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
We entered the park.
Though it was a weekday morning, a surprising number of people our age were wandering around.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We enter the park.
It's still midmorning but there's a bunch of people my age here.

entries.japanese:
「ふうん、昼間だと人が多いんだ。
志貴とは何度も来てるところだけど、なんだか別の場所みたい」
　アルクェイドはわりと上機嫌だ。
　公園を散歩するだけ、というコースに不満はないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There are so many people during the day. I’ve come here with you several times, but it feels like a different place.”
Arcueid was in a good mood.
Apparently she had no objection to a simple walk through the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm, there's a lot of people here during the day.
I've met you here a lot, but it seems like a totally different place."
Arcueid seems to be in a good mood.
I just planned to walk around the park, but she doesn't seem discontent at all.

entries.japanese:
「あ、あんなところにお店が開いてる。
志貴、あれは何を売ってるところ？」
　興味深そうに露店を指差すアルクェイド。
　噴水から離れた道には、車で移動できるアイスクリームの露店があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, there’s a shop open over there. What do they sell, Shiki?”
Arcueid pointed eagerly toward a vendor.
Down the path beyond the fountain was a mobile ice-cream stand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, there's a store in a place like this.
Shiki, what does that sell?"
Arcueid points excitedly at a vendor's stand.
The path from the fountain leads to a wheeled ice cream stand.

entries.japanese:
「あれは季節はずれのアイスクリーム屋さん。
冷たいものは体に悪いので、とりあえず我慢してくれ」
　物欲しげなアルクェイドを、ぴしゃりと先に封じておく。
　いかにも不満そうな顔をされても、秋空の下でアイスクリームを食べても美味しくはないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“An ice-cream truck that’s open out of season. Cold food is bad for you, so control yourself.” I preemptively crushed the longing in Arcueid’s eyes.
She could look as aggrieved as she pleased, but ice cream under an autumn sky couldn’t possibly taste good.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's an ice cream seller out of season.
Cold things aren't good for the body, so we should just pass it up for now." I stop Arcueid's question before she asks.
No matter how unhappy a face she makes, I don't think eating ice cream in the fall would be good at all.

entries.japanese:
――――しかし、なんだろうこの違和感は。
　歩いているだけでぎくしゃくするっていうか、周りから視線を感じるっていうか……
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Still, what was this strange discomfort?
Merely walking felt awkward, as though people were watching us—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----But, what is this strange feeling?
I feel weird just walking, I feel everyone's watching us……

entries.japanese:
「ねえ志貴、ここの人たちって志貴の知り合い？」
「いや、平日に学校をさぼって遊びまわるような知り合いは一人しかいないけど、どうして？」
「んー、なんていうかみんなわたしたちを見てるから、志貴の知り合いなのかなって」
「……なるほど。
違和感の正体はそれか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, do you know these people?” “I only know one person who skips school to fool around on weekdays—why?”
“Everyone keeps looking at us, so I wondered if they knew you.”
“…So that’s what felt strange.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki, do you know all these people?"
"No, there's only one person I know who'd skip school to hang around like that.
Why?"
"Hm, a lot of people seem to be looking at us, so I thought maybe you knew them."
"…… I see.
So that's what felt strange."

entries.japanese:
納得した。
　適当に座れる芝生を探して歩きまわっていたんだけど、それだけで周りの連中がチラチラと俺たちを盗み見てくる。
　連中の目的は言うまでもないだろうけど、俺じゃなくてアルクェイドだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
That explained it.
As we wandered around looking for a patch of grass to sit on, people kept sneaking looks at us.
Their object was obvious—and it was Arcueid, not me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get it now.
I was just walking around to find a good spot on the grass to sit down on, but everyone is stealing glances at us.
It doesn't need to be said, but they're looking at Arcueid, not me.

entries.japanese:
俺はできるだけ意識しないように努力しているけど、アルクェイドはとんでもない美人である。
そりゃあ、こうして公園を歩いていれば人目も引くっていうものだ。
　公園で暇を潰している男たちの視線がアルクェイドに集まっている。
　……なんか、理由もなくカチンときた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I made a deliberate effort not to dwell on it, but Arcueid was spectacularly beautiful. Of course she attracted attention merely by walking through the park.
Every idle man in the park was staring at her.
For no reason I could name, that infuriated me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I've been doing my best not to be conscious of it, but Arcueid is just unbelievably beautiful.
And walking in the park is just asking for stares.
The guys killing time in the park all start to look at her.
…… For some reason, I feel angry.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、場所を変えよう」
　アルクェイドの手を握って、半ば強引に公園の奥へと歩き出した。
　待ち合わせ場所に利用される休憩所は、噴水前にくらべると人気がない。
　……まあ、ここならさっきよりは幾分ましだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, let’s go somewhere else.”
I took her hand and half dragged her deeper into the park.
The rest area used as a meeting spot was much quieter than the fountain.
At least it was better than where we had been.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, let's go somewhere else."
Grabbing her hand, I pull her as I walk towards the back of the park.
The place we usually meet has much less people than right in front of the fountain.
…… This should be little better than before, at least.

entries.japanese:
「しばらくここで時間を潰そう。
飲み物がほしいなら何か買ってくるけど、リクエストはある？」
　繋いでいた手を離して、アルクェイドに振りかえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let’s stay here awhile. If you want a drink, what should I get you?”
Releasing her hand, I turned to face her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"We'll kill time here a little bit.
I'm going to get something to drink, you have any requests?"
I let go of her hand and turn towards her.

entries.japanese:
「え……えっと、水が飲みたいけど、いい？」
「あいよ。
それじゃあそこらへんのベンチに座っててくれ。
……と、そこいらのヤツに声をかけられたら適当に聞き流すようにな」
　言って、近くの自動販売機まで走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’d like some water, if that’s all right.”
“Sure. Sit on one of those benches. And if some guy tries talking to you, just ignore him.”
With that, I ran toward the nearest vending machine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"U…… um, is water okay?"
"Sure.
Go ahead and sit on that bench…… if some guy starts to talk to you, just don't listen to him."
Saying that, I run to a nearby vending machine.

entries.japanese:
正午すぎになっても、俺たちは公園から移動する事はなかった。
　……なんでか知らないけど、ここに来てからアルクェイドはぽーっと黙り込んでいる。
　せっかく買ってきたミネラルウォーターだって一口も飲んでいないし、何をするでもなく公園の様子を眺めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even after noon, we still hadn’t left the park.
For some reason Arcueid had fallen into a daze as soon as we arrived.
She hadn’t touched the mineral water I bought her; she simply watched the park without doing anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though it's now past noon, we don't leave the park.
…… I'm not sure why, but Arcueid's been quiet since we came here.
She hasn't even drank the water I got for her, and she just looks around the park doing nothing.

entries.japanese: 俺たちの視線の先にあるのは、大群で道を歩いている鳩と、母親に連れられて無邪気に走りまわっている子供たちの姿だった。
entries.maoEnglish: Before us, a great flock of pigeons marched along the path, while children brought there by their mothers ran about innocently.
entries.mirrorMoon: We watch the flocks of pigeons around the park and the happily running figures of children accompanied by their mothers.

entries.japanese:
「ね、志貴」
「ん？
　ぼうっとしてるのは飽きた？
　なら街に戻ってメシでも食べようか」
「ううん、別にそういうんじゃないけど……さっきの、一体なんなのかなって思って」
「……？」
　さっきのって……何の事を言ってるんだろう、アルクェイドは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki.”
“Hmm? Tired of sitting around? We can go back downtown and get lunch.”
“No, it isn’t that—I was wondering what that was earlier.”
“?”
What on earth did she mean?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Shiki."
"Hm?
Are you bored just spacing out?
We can go somewhere and get something to eat if you want."
"No, that isn't it…… I was just wondering about what happened before."
"……?"
Before?
…… What is she talking about?

entries.japanese:
「わからないな。
さっきのって何のこと？」
「だから、志貴がわたしの手を握ったでしょ。
そりゃあ志貴には何度か触れられてるけど、それは理由があっての事でしょう？
　けどさっきのは理由がなかったから、何だったのかなって」
「何だったのかなって―――別に理由なんて、なかったけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t understand. What do you mean by earlier?”
“You held my hand. You’ve touched me before, but there was always a reason, wasn’t there? This time there wasn’t, so I wondered what it meant.”
“What it meant—there wasn’t any reason.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't get it.
What do you mean?"
"I'm talking about when you grabbed my hand earlier.
We've come into contact before, but there was always a reason.
But just now, there wasn't a reason, so I was wondering just what it was."
"What it was?----There really wasn't a reason or anything."

entries.japanese:
言って、自分でも首をひねってしまった。
　……そういえば、さっきはごく自然に、何の理由もなくアルクェイドを引っ張った。
　言われてみると、どうしてあんな事をしたのか自分でもわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even as I answered, I puzzled over it myself.
She was right: I had taken her hand and pulled her along as naturally as breathing, with no reason at all.
Now that she mentioned it, I couldn’t explain why.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that, I also get confused.
…… Come to think of it, I pulled her along naturally for no reason.
That being said, I don't even understand why.

entries.japanese:
「ま、どうでもいいじゃないか。
手を握るなんていまさら大した事じゃないだろ。
ああゆう、突発的なことってわりとあるんだよ、人間っていうのは」
「そうなんだ。
理由がないっていう事がわりと多いなんて、志貴って無駄が多いんだね」
　感心しているような、呆れているような相づちをうつアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It doesn’t matter. Holding hands is hardly a big deal at this point. Humans do things on impulse all the time.”
“I see. If you often do things for no reason, you must do a lot of pointless things, Shiki.”
Arcueid sounded caught between admiration and disbelief.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It doesn't really matter.
It's not that big of a deal.
Something sudden like that, is just human."
"I see.
Having lots of things done for no reason… you've done a lot of useless things."
Arcueid replies, amazed.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ志貴。
関係のない事を聞くけど、志貴にもああゆう時があったの？」
　本当に、まったく関係のない事を聞いてくる。
　アルクェイドの視線の先には遊んでいる子供たちがいるから、彼女の聞きたい事はそうゆう事なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is unrelated, Shiki. Were you ever like that?”
It truly had nothing to do with our conversation.
But she was watching the children, so her meaning was obvious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki.
It's kind of off topic, but did you ever have a time like that?"
She really is asking about random things.
She's looking at the playing children, so she's probably asking about that.

entries.japanese:
「……さあ、どうかな。
たしかに子供のころは遊びまわってたけど、それは屋敷の中だけの話でさ。
こういう公園で遊んだ事は少なかったな」
　……そう、遊び仲間といったら秋葉たちで、あの子供たちのように見知らぬ誰かと遊ぶような事はなかった。
　俺は、どちらかというと。
　わりと無菌室のような環境で育てられた子供だったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. I ran around a lot when I was little, but mostly inside the estate. I rarely played in parks like this.”
My playmates had been Akiha and the others; unlike those children, I had never played with strangers.
As for me.
Perhaps I had been raised in something like a sterile room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm, Maybe.
I played around a lot as a kid, but that was only inside the mansion.
I rarely ever played in a park like this."
…… That's right.
My only playmates were Akiha and the others.
I never played with people I didn't know like these kids.
I might have been more like…
A kid who led an insulated life.

entries.japanese:
「そういうアルクェイドはどうなんだよ。
……その、言いにくかったらいわなくていいけど」
　……その、吸血鬼に子供時代っていうものがなかったら、アルクェイドに聞くのは失礼だから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What about you? You don’t have to answer if it’s uncomfortable.”
If vampires had no childhood, asking her might be cruel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What about you, Arcueid?
…… Um, you don't have to talk about it if you don't want to."
…… Um, if vampires didn't have a childhood, asking her would be rude.

entries.japanese:
「そうね。
志貴が考えている通り、わたしには幼年期はなかったわ。
個体として弱い時代は眠って過ごして、わたしという生命が一番優れている今しか活動しなかったから。
　だから、ちょっと不思議に思ったんだ。
幼年期や老年期なんていう無駄な時間を、どうしてあなたたちは過ごせるんだろうって」
　その言葉は、俺に対する問いというよりアルクェイド本人に対する問いのように聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right. I had no childhood. I slept through the years when this body was weak and became active only now, at the height of my existence.
So I wondered. Why do humans spend such useless periods as childhood and old age?”
The question sounded directed less at me than at Arcueid herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah.
Like you're thinking, I never had a childhood.
While I was weak as an individual, I slept through it, and I was active only when my existence was at its peak.
That's why I thought it was strange.
Infancy and old age are such useless times, why do people manage to live through it?"
She seems to be almost asking herself, not me.

entries.japanese:
「………アルクェイド？」
「なんでもない。
こんなふうに無為に時間を浪費するのなんて初めてだから、思考が誤作動しちゃったみたい」
　言って、アルクェイドはベンチから立ちあがった。
　つられてこっちも立ちあがる。
　……まあ、二時間近く日向ぼっこをしていたんだから、そろそろ街のほうに移動する頃だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…?”
“It’s nothing. I’ve never squandered time so aimlessly before, so I suppose it made my thoughts malfunction.”
Arcueid rose from the bench.
I stood up with her.
We had spent nearly two hours basking in the sun, so it was probably time to head downtown.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid?"
"It's nothing.
This is the first time I ever spent time doing nothing, so my thoughts seem to be malfunctioning."
Saying that, Arcueid stands up from the bench.
I stand up with her.
…… Well, we've already been in the sun for about two hours, so we should probably head into the city.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんだ、退屈だったんなら退屈だって言ってくれればよかったのに」
「んー、確かに退屈だったけど、つまらなくはなかったから。
　こういう退屈だったらまたしてもいいかなって思ってるけど、志貴はそうじゃなかったの？」
「え………」
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you were bored, you should have said so.”
“I was bored, but it wasn’t unpleasant.
I think I wouldn’t mind being bored like this again—didn’t you feel the same?”
“What…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Oh, if it was dull you should've told me so."
"Hm, maybe it is dull, but it wasn't boring.
I was even thinking I'd like to spend more time if it's this kind of dull, but you didn't like it?"
"Eh……?"

entries.japanese:
……そうだな、確かに退屈ではあったけど、それがつまらなかったというワケでもなかった。
　考えてみればアルクェイドと日向ぼっこをするなんて、滅多にない事なんだし。
entries.maoEnglish:
She was right—it had been boring, but that didn’t make it unpleasant.
When would I ever again have the chance to sit in the sun with Arcueid?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That's right, even if it was uneventful, it wasn't boring.
Come to think of it, spending time sunbathing with Arcueid is something pretty rare.

entries.japanese:
「―――そうだな、たまにはこういうのも悪くない。
でもま、今はメシにしようぜ。
朝から何も食べてなくてさ、いいかげん腹ペコなんだ」
　言って、公園から歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it wasn’t bad; once in a while, this is nice. But right now, let’s get food. I haven’t eaten since morning, and I’m starving.”
I started out of the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's right, it wasn't bad at all.
But, let's get something to eat.
I haven't had anything since this morning, so I'm pretty hungry."
Saying that, we start to walk from the park.

entries.japanese:
「ん―――――」
　ほんの一瞬、アルクェイドの手を握ろうかと思って、すぐに止めた。
　さっきのは理由がなかったから、ただそれだけの行為がすごく自然だった。
　けど理由が出来てしまった今は、手を握るという行為はひどく無粋な気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm—”
For a moment I thought of taking Arcueid’s hand, then stopped.
Before, because I had no reason, the gesture had come naturally.
Now that I had found one, taking her hand felt horribly contrived.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm------"
For a brief moment, I think about holding her hand but I stop right away.
There wasn't any reason for it before, so it felt natural to do so.
But now that I have a reason to do so, to hold her hand seems very senseless.

entries.japanese:
……無粋というのは、そんな事に気がつく理性というか思考が純粋ではないということ。
「理屈ばっかりだな、俺」
　まったく。
アルクェイドの言う通り、どうやら俺には無駄なものが多すぎるみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
What made it contrived was the calculating mind that noticed such things at all—the thought itself was no longer innocent.
“I think too much.”
Honestly. Arcueid was right: I seemed to be full of useless things.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… To be senseless means that taking notice is the result of less-than-pure thoughts.
"I'm full of theories today."
Geez.
Just like Arcueid says, I guess I do a lot of useless things.

entries.japanese:
時間も午後二時をすぎて、いいかげん腹が減ってきたので手ごろなファーストフード店に入った。
　……アルクェイドがこういったものを食べるのかどうかは疑問だったのだが、アルクェイドはむー、とメニューとにらめっこしたあと、結局俺と同じセットメニューを注文した。
entries.maoEnglish:
By the time two in the afternoon rolled around, hunger finally drove us into the first decent fast-food place we found.
I wasn’t sure Arcueid even ate this sort of thing, but after scowling thoughtfully at the menu for a while, she finally ordered the same meal I did.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's now past two, so to ease my hunger I take us to a fast food restaurant.
…… I don't even know if she eats this kind of food, but after Arcueid stares long and hard at the menu, she ends up ordering the same thing I did.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　席に座って、アルクェイドと向かい合う。
　アルクェイドのやつはきょろきょろと周囲を見渡したあと、慣れたかんじでフライドポテトを口に運んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
We took our seats across from each other.
Arcueid glanced all around the restaurant, then popped a french fry into her mouth with practiced ease.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I sit down across from her.
After Arcueid looks around quickly, she pops a french fry in her mouth like she's done it before many times.

entries.japanese:
「……へえ、慣れてるんだな。
俺はてっきり、こういうところは初めてだと思ってた」
「ええ、こうゆう所は初めてよ。
前からどういった所から知っていたけど、それは知識だけのものだしね」
「知識だけって……そっか、ニュースを見るんだから、雑誌ぐらいは目を通すってわけか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh—you look like you’ve done this before. I figured it would be your first time in a place like this.”
“It is. I already knew what places like this were, but only in theory.”
“In theory—oh, right; if you watch the news, I guess you’d read magazines too.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wow, you seem pretty used to it.
I thought maybe it was your first time."
"Yeah, this is the first time I've done it.
I've known about places like these, but it was only from information sources."
"Just information…… I see, you watch the news so I guess you read magazines too."

entries.japanese:
「んー、そういうわけでもないけど、時代に即した常識は必要でしょう？
　だから起きた時はその時代の情報を覚えてから行動するの。
　ま、たいていは一日や二日で決着がつくから無駄になるんだけどね」
「……？」
　アルクェイドは時々、こういった分かり難い事を言う。
「ふーん……無駄になるって、どうして？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Not exactly—I need enough common knowledge to fit into whatever era I wake up in, don’t I? So whenever I wake, I learn about the age before I do anything else.
Most of the time it all ends in a day or two, though, so the knowledge goes to waste.”
“……?”
Arcueid said things like this sometimes—things I couldn’t begin to follow.
“Why does it go to waste?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm, not quite like that, I need knowledge to fit in with the times, right?
So when I wake up, I study the information of that time and then go into action.
Well, it's usually over in a few days so it usually ends up being useless."
"……?"
She says things that are hard to understand like this from time to time.
"Hmm…… why does it end up useless?"

entries.japanese:
「だから、すぐに眠るからでしょ。
次の目覚めが何年先になるか分からないんだから、覚えた知識を使ってる余分なんてないわ。
事が済めば眠るだけだもの。
　……ん、でもそれって損をしてたみたい。
　わたしはね、今まで知識でしか世界を知らなかった。
こういう人間たちの集まりがあるって知っていても、それを経験する事はしなかったのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because I go straight back to sleep. I never know how many years it will be until I wake again, so there’s no time to make use of anything I’ve learned. Once my work is done, I sleep.
But now I think I’ve been missing out.
Until now, I only knew the world as knowledge. I knew that gatherings of humans like this existed, but I never experienced one for myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because I go to sleep right away.
I don't know how many years later I wake up the next time, so I can't use much of what I remember.
After it is over, all I do is sleep.
…… Hm, but maybe I've been missing out.
I only knew the world through those sources.
I knew about how people would gather like this, but I never experienced it."

entries.japanese:
「なるほど……けど知ってるんならそれでいいんじゃないのか？
　現にさっきだって、慣れたふうにメニューを見て注文していたじゃないか」
「それは当然よ。
そういうふうに対応できるように知識を得ているんだから。
　でも、それはただそれだけのことなのよね。
経験は理論を凌駕するわ。
何億っていう単語を覚えていても、実際にやってみないと何も手に入らないんだなって」
　はあ、と切なそうにアルクェイドはため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see—but if you already know about them, isn’t that enough? You read the menu and ordered like an old hand just now.”
“Of course I did. That’s exactly why I learn these things—to be able to manage situations like this.
But that’s all knowledge can do. Experience surpasses theory. You can learn a hundred million words and still possess nothing until you’ve actually lived them.”
Arcueid sighed, her face forlorn.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see…… But isn't knowing just enough?
Just now, you ordered some food like it was perfectly natural."
"Of course.
I studied, so I can act that way.
But, that's all.
Experience is far greater than theory.
Even if I know about zillions of things, it's useless if I've never done them."
Arcueid sighs.

entries.japanese:
「そんなものかなあ……理論は経験を補う、っていう逆もあるとは思うけど」
「それは理論だけしか知らない人の言葉でしょう。
……それ、ちょっと前までのわたしそのものだけど」
　ますますアルクェイドの顔は暗くなっていく。
　はっきりとした理由はないのに、アルクェイドのそういった顔を見るのはイヤだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Does it really work that way—couldn’t you just as easily say that theory makes up for what you haven’t experienced?”
“Only someone who knows nothing but theory would say that. Which describes me perfectly, until very recently.”
Arcueid’s face darkened further.
I couldn’t have said why, but I hated seeing her look like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that so…… I think some people say theory makes up for a lack of experience."
"That's something those who only know theories say.
…… I used to think that way until just recently."
Arcueid's expression starts to cloud.
For some unknown reason, I don't like seeing her face like that.

entries.japanese:
「そんなものかな。
たんにさ、理論だけで経験を補えるヤツと、経験で理論を覆せるヤツっていうのがいるだけだと思うけど？
　いろんなヤツがいるんだからさ、誰もが自分と同じじゃないだろ」
「うわあ、志貴がマジメな言葉を喋ってる」
「あのねえ、アルクェイドさん。
そっちがマジメな話をしたから、こっちもそれに付き合ってるんじゃないか。
話のコシを折らないでくれ」
　その、せっかくおまえが珍しく自分の話をしてくれているんだから、さ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know—maybe some people can fill the gaps in experience with theory, while others can overturn theory through experience. There are all kinds of people. You can’t expect everyone to work the same way you do.”
“Wow—Shiki’s saying something serious.”
“Now listen here, Arcueid. You started the serious conversation, and I’m making the effort to meet you halfway. Don’t wreck the mood.”
I mean, you almost never talk about yourself, and now that you finally are…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that so?
I think there's just those for whom theory can make up for lack of experience and those for whom experience trumps theory.
There's a lot of people out there in the world, so not everyone is the same."
"Wow, you got really deep and serious, Shiki."
"Hey now, Arcueid-san.
You're the one who started being all serious, I was just going along.
Don't kill the conversation like that."
Um, since you're telling me all that stuff about yourself.

entries.japanese:
「うん、しってる。
志貴ってわたしの話したいコトを、話したいときにちゃんと付き合ってくれるって。
いつもはわたしに怒鳴り散らすけど、深刻な時はこういうふうに話をしてくれるんだ」
　あははー、とアルクェイドは陽気に笑う。
　……ふん。
　そんなの、そっちの勝手な思い違いだろうけど。
　やっぱりこいつには、こういった純粋な笑顔が似合っていると思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I know. When I really want to talk about something, Shiki always stays and listens. You spend most of the time yelling at me, but when it matters, you talk to me like this.”
Arcueid laughed brightly.
Hmph.
That was nothing but her own convenient misunderstanding.
Still, a pure smile like that suited her best.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I know.
You always listen to me when I want to talk.
You always yell at me, but you listen to me when it's serious."
"Ahaha," Arcueid laughs brightly.
…… Hmph.
That's what she thinks, anyway.
But, I think such a genuine smile suits her best.

entries.japanese:
「でもさっきの志貴の話、ちょっと考えさせられた。
わたしって視野が狭いんだ。
自分がこう、と決めたらそれ以外のものは見えなくなるのよ。
　自分だけしかいらないって。
　自分だけが正しいんだって、そんなふうにしかわたしは考えられない。
　―――そうよね。
いろんなココロがあるんだから、わたしに出来ない事を当たり前のようにやってしまえる人だって、世の中にはたくさんいるんだわ」
　なんでか、優しい口調でアルクェイドは反省してみたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What you said did make me think, though. My view of things is so narrow. Once I decide how something must be, I stop seeing everything else.
I decide that I need no one but myself.
That only I can be right—that’s the only way I know how to think.
―――But you’re right. There are so many different hearts in the world, and plenty of people can do as naturally as breathing the things I could never do.”
For some reason, Arcueid offered this self-reproach in an unusually gentle voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I was thinking about what you said earlier.
I really am narrow-minded.
I can't really see anything else after I make up my mind.
Not needing anyone but myself.
I'm the only one who is right.
I can only think in those terms.
----That's right.
There are a lot of hearts out there, so there's a lot of people that can do easily what I can't."
She somehow seems very gentle as she contemplates.

entries.japanese:
「あ、でも、反省したところでわたしの性格は変わりはしないんだけどね。
　わたし、今の自分が一番好きだし、やっぱり正しいんだって信じてるから」
　笑顔で勇ましい事を言うと、またもきょろきょろと周囲を見渡してから、ぱくり、とハンバーガーを食べる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Not that reflecting on it will change my personality.
I like myself best exactly as I am, and I still believe I’m right.”
Having made that bold declaration with a smile, she surveyed the room once more and took another bite of her hamburger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, but, even if I contemplate it, my personality won't change.
I like this me the best, and I believe it is the correct way."
She smiles as she says those courageous words.
Then she looks around like before and takes a bite of her hamburger.

entries.japanese:
ぱくり、ぱくり。
　吸血鬼のイメージを払拭するように、ジャンクフードを食べていくアルクェイド。
「…………」
　なんでだろう。
　ハンバーガーを食べる、なんていう、どう繕ったって上品には見えない行為なのに、アルクェイドがやると、ひどく綺麗なことのように見えるのは。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bite after bite.
Arcueid steadily ate her junk food, demolishing every image the word vampire conjured.
“……”
Why was it?
There was no graceful way to eat a hamburger, no matter how you dressed it up—yet when Arcueid did it, the act looked almost unbearably beautiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chomp.
Chomp.
As if to erase any image of her being a vampire, Arcueid chows down on her junk food.
"…………"
How come?
It seems impossible to look elegant while eating a hamburger, but Arcueid makes it look beautiful.

entries.japanese:
「なに……？
　人のことじろじろ見て。
あ、これってこういうふうに食べるものじゃないの……！？」
　慌ててハンバーガーをトレイに戻すアルクェイド。
　紙のナプキンで口もとを拭くのだが、なんというか、そんな単純な仕草がこのうえなくしなやかで、気品がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…? Why are you staring at me? Wait, is this not how you’re supposed to eat one…!?”
Arcueid hastily put the hamburger back on her tray.
She dabbed at her mouth with a paper napkin, and even that simple gesture looked impossibly graceful and refined.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What……?
Staring at me like that.
Ah, is this not how you eat it……!?"
Arcueid hurriedly puts her hamburger back on her tray.
She then wipes her mouth with a paper napkin.
But even that simple action seems so elegant.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、それで合ってる。
合ってるけど、なんかヘンだ、おまえの場合。
似合わないから食べるな」
　ぱくり、とハンバーガーをハンバーガーらしく食べながら、自分でもわけのわからない文句を言った。
「なによそれ。
似合わないってどういう意味？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you’re doing it right. It just looks wrong when you do it. It doesn’t suit you, so stop.”
I took a perfectly ordinary bite of my own hamburger while voicing a complaint even I didn’t understand.
“What is that supposed to mean? How does it not suit me?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, it's right.
It's right, but it's strange.
In your case, it doesn't suit you, so don't do it."
I don't even know why I say that as I chomp on my hamburger like a hamburger should be eaten.
"What do you mean it doesn't suit me?"

entries.japanese:
「イメージの問題だよ。
おまえみたいに口が小さいヤツはファーストフードには向かない。
大人しくポテトをかじってる分には問題ないから、俺の分もやる」
　アルクェイドのトレイに自分のフライドポテトを置く。
　……その、なんていうか自分でもよく分からない行動だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s the image. Fast food doesn’t suit someone with a little mouth like yours. You look fine nibbling on fries, so you can have mine too.”
I set my fries on Arcueid’s tray.
I had no idea what had possessed me to do that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's an image problem.
That small mouth of yours isn't fit to eat fast food.
Fries aren't a problem, so you can have my share."
I put my french fries on her tray.
…… I really don't know what I'm doing at all.

entries.japanese:
「いらないっ。
そんなものばっかりじゃモノを食べてるって気がしないもの」
　むー、とうなって、アルクェイドはハンバーガーに口をつけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t want them! If I eat nothing but those, it doesn’t even feel like a meal.”
With a stubborn little growl, Arcueid returned to her hamburger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't want them.
I don't feel like eating just those."
After saying that, she brings the hamburger to her mouth once more.

entries.japanese:
……今度は俺の目を気にしているのか、さっきよりは普通っぽくて、まあ我慢できる範囲だ。
　……しっかし、ハンバーガーを食べる吸血鬼っていうのはなんなんだろう。
　何かを食べて、活動するのに必要となる栄養がなければ生き物は生きていけない。
　以前、アルクェイドは血を吸わない、と断言した。
　なら、アルクェイドの栄養源は俺たちと同じ、人並みの食事なんだろうか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
Conscious of my gaze now, she ate more normally than before, tolerably so at least.
Still, what was I supposed to make of a vampire eating a hamburger?
Living things had to eat and take in nutrients, or they couldn’t stay alive.
Arcueid had flatly declared that she never drank blood.
Did that mean she lived on ordinary food, the same as the rest of us…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… She might be worried about my stare, as she eats it more normally.
Well, I can live with that.
…… But a hamburger-eating vampire?
All living things need nutrition to live, so they eat.
Before, Arcueid declared she doesn't drink blood.
So, in order to gain that nutrition, does she eat food just like us normal humans……?

entries.japanese:
「……なあ、アルクェイド」
「なによ、いじわる」
「いや、もう文句は言わないって。
聞きたいことが出来たんだけど、いいか？」
「いいけど―――なに？」
「あのさ、おまえは吸血鬼だろ？
　なら食事って呼べるものは血液だけじゃないのかなって、そう疑問に思った」
　アルクェイドは目を見開いて俺を見る。
　……やっぱり、これはぶしつけな質問だったみたいだ。
　ほら、アルクェイドだってみるまに表情を強ばらせて……ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Arcueid.”
“What do you want, bully?”
“I said I’m done complaining. Something just occurred to me—can I ask you about it?”
“All right—what is it?”
“You’re a vampire, right? So I was wondering whether blood is the only thing you could really call food.”
Arcueid stared at me, eyes wide.
So it had been a rude question after all.
Any second now, her face would stiffen with offense—except it didn’t.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey, Arcueid."
"What, you meanie?"
"No, I wasn't going to criticize you.
I just had a question, if that's okay."
"Sure----what is it?"
"Um, you're a vampire, right?
Then I was wondering maybe if food for you… was only blood."
Her eyes widen.
…… I knew it.
It was a rude question.
See, even Arcueid's facial expression is getting angry…… or not.

entries.japanese:
「あのね、志貴。
基本的にわたしは食事をとらないんだ。
　たしかにこういうふうにモノを口にすれば自分の力だけで動けるけど、それは気分の問題なの。
　わたしは食事をとる、つまり栄養分を補充するっていう方法が志貴とは違う。
　たしかに食欲はあるけど、それは性欲と同じかな。
　食べないとイライラするけど、わたしはあんまり食事に重きをおいていないから、反転衝動に襲われることは少ないよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Shiki. As a rule, I don’t eat.
Food like this does let me move using my own energy, but eating it is more a matter of mood.
You and I replenish ourselves in different ways.
I do feel hunger, but it’s rather like sexual desire.
Going without food makes me irritable, but I don’t place much importance on eating, so I’m rarely seized by an inversion impulse.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki, normally, I don't eat food.
Certainly eating like this allows me to move on my own, but it's more of a mental thing.
For me to eat, in other words,taking in nutrition, is a different process than the one you have.
I do have an appetite, but maybe it's more akin to lust.
If I don't eat, I get irritated, but since I don't put much priority on it, inversion impulses rarely happen."

entries.japanese:
あっさりと、アルクェイドは血液食事説を否定した。
　ああ、つまりはアレだ。
　本当に、アルクェイドは血を飲まなくてもいいらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Just like that, Arcueid dismissed my theory that blood was her food.
So that was it.
She truly didn’t need to drink blood at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She easily denies the blood as food theory.
Yeah, that's what it is.
She really seems to be okay with not drinking blood.

entries.japanese:
「そうか――――」
　良かった。
アルクェイドが人間を食事のために殺してしまうようなヤツじゃなくて、本当に良かった。
　……まったく。
アルクェイドも初めから『自分は血を吸わない吸血鬼だよ』って言ってくれたのなら、俺だって初めから素直に協力してやってたの……に………
「……って、ちょっと待った！
　おまえ、そりゃあ吸血鬼って言わないぞ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see—”
Thank God. Thank God Arcueid wasn’t the kind of creature who killed humans for food.
Honestly, if she’d simply told me from the start, ‘I’m a vampire who doesn’t drink blood,’ I would have agreed to help her without all that resistance—wait.
“Hold it right there! If you don’t drink blood, you’re not a vampire!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see----"
That's good.
Arcueid isn't someone that kills humans to feed.
It really is a good thing.
…… Geez.
If Arcueid just said from the beginning "I'm a vampire that doesn't suck human blood", then I would have agreed to help her from the…… start……
"…… Hey, wait a minute!
You don't call that a vampire!"

entries.japanese:
「言うわよ。
志貴だって一日食事を抜いたら耐えられなくなるでしょう？
　真祖である吸血種――わたしの場合は、その欲求を満たしてくれる最上級の食べ物が血液なの。
　だから『活動する』『欲求を満たす』という事であるのなら、こういうものでなんとか代用はきくわけ」
「これが死徒――人間から吸血種になった吸血鬼になると別問題になるわ。
彼らは自己が存在するためにどうしても他者の血液が必要になるから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course I am. You couldn’t stand going a whole day without eating, could you?
For a True Ancestor—a member of the vampiric species like me—blood is simply the finest food there is for satisfying that appetite.
But if all I need is to keep moving and quiet the urge, things like this make an adequate substitute.”
“Dead Apostles—vampires who began as humans before becoming one of the vampiric species—are different. They absolutely require the blood of others to sustain their own existence.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You do.
Even you can't resist eating for one day, right?
For those vampires who are True Ancestors--like me, the highest class of food, the thing that can satisfy our desires the most is blood.
So in order to "live" and "fulfill our desires", we can substitute blood with other things."
"But when it comes to the Dead Apostles--vampires that were originally human, it is a different matter.
In order to maintain their existence, they need the blood of others."

entries.japanese:
「……？
　ええっと、つまりおまえにとっては空腹を満たすのに一番適したものが血液って事か。
　……けどアルクェイドは血を吸うのは嫌いだって言ったよな。
　もしかして人間に食べ物の好き嫌いがあるように、アルクェイドも血の味が嫌いだっていうコト？」
　長いこと解けなかった問題が解けたような、とにかく会心の気分で言い当てる。
　しかし。
　そんなものは、こっちのかってな思い込みだったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…So blood is simply the best thing for satisfying your hunger.
But you said you hated drinking it.
Is it like humans disliking certain foods—that you just don’t like the taste?”
I delivered my brilliant deduction with all the satisfaction of solving a mystery that had plagued me for ages.
However.
I had only been indulging another baseless assumption.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
Um, in other words the best way to satisfy your hunger is blood?
…… But you said you hated drinking blood.
So just like people who don't like certain food, you hate the taste of blood?"
I take a guess at a satisfactory simplification for the long explanation she gave.
However.
It seems like I was a little off.

entries.japanese:
「……わからない。
血の味なんて、わたし知らないもの」
「―――へ？」
「わたしは吸血種としては半人前だって言ったでしょう。
血の味は知らない。
それがどんなものなのか、まだわからない。
　ただわかるのは―――血を吸うという事は、その相手を人と認識しなくなるっていう事だけ」
　アルクェイドは視線をそらして、俺のほうを見ようともしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. I’ve never tasted blood.”
“What?”
“I told you I’m still half-formed as a member of the vampiric species. I don’t know the taste of blood. I still don’t know what it’s like.
All I know is that to drink someone’s blood is to stop recognizing them as a person.”
Arcueid turned her eyes away and refused even to look at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't know.
I don't know what blood tastes like."
"----Huh?"
"I told you I'm not a full vampire.
Not knowing the taste of blood.
I still don't know that.
All I know----is to drink human blood is to refuse to recognize them as people."
She looks away, not even trying to look at me.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ志貴。
もしもよ。
もしも鳥や魚に貴方と同じぐらいの知性と寿命があったら、あなたは食べられる？
　どんなに知性があったって食べ物は食べ物だからって、わりきって食べられる？」
「――――――いや、それは」
　食べられる―――んだろうか？
　わからない。
わからないけど、それだったらとりあえず、知性をもっていない、違う食べ物を食べるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. Suppose birds and fish were as intelligent as you and lived just as long. Could you still eat them? Could you tell yourself that food is food, no matter how intelligent it may be, and eat them anyway?”
“No, I—”
Could I?
I didn’t know. But if that were the case, I would probably choose something else—something without intelligence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki.
What if?
What if birds or fish had the same amount of intelligence and life span as you did?
Could you eat them?
Could you justify it to yourself by saying no matter how much intelligence they have, they are still food?
And then eat them?"
"------No, that's…"
Could I----eat them?
I don't know.
I don't know, but first off, I'd try and eat other food, things that didn't have intelligence.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、そういうコト。
わたしが血を嫌っているのはそういう理由なんだ。
……まあ、志貴のいうとおり好き嫌いはあるのかもしれない。
　わたし、できることなら血は見たくないもの。
　だけど―――そうね、もしも人間に自分と同格の知性や価値観がなかったら、ためらうことなく血を吸ってしまってるかもしれないなあ。
　だって生きるために他の生命を奪うコトは、自然界じゃ当然の摂理なんだし」
　でしょ？
とアルクェイドは賛同なんかを求めてきた。
　そんなことを――他の誰でもない、アルクェイドから聞かれても俺は否定するしかない。
　……肯定なんか、したくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There—that’s what I mean. That’s why I hate blood. Though perhaps you’re right, and it is a kind of preference.
I’d rather not even see blood if I can help it.
Yes, if humans possessed neither intelligence nor values equal to my own, perhaps I would drink their blood without hesitation.
Taking another life to preserve your own is simply the law of nature.”
Right? Arcueid asked, actually seeking my agreement.
But hearing that from Arcueid—of all people—I could only deny it.
I didn’t want to agree.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See?
Just like that.
That's why I hate the thought of drinking blood.
…… Well, maybe there are likes and dislikes as you said too.
If I could, I like to avoid the sight of blood.
But----Yes, but if… if humans didn't have the same worth, intelligence, or values than I did, then maybe I would drink blood.
Isn't providence of nature taking the lives of other things to protect your own?"
Right?
Arcueid asks me for agreement.
But that--even if Arcueid says it, I can only deny it.
…… I don't want to agree to that.

entries.japanese:
「たしかにそうかもしれないけど、とりあえず人間とおまえは似たようなモンじゃないか。
……だから、そういう例え話はやめてくれ。
もしもの話はあんまり好きじゃないんだ」
「そう？
　わたしはイフって好きだけどな。
どんな結果になるか分からないけど、とりあえずその時は救いがあるような気がするじゃない」
　イフ……もしも、か。
　じゃあ、もしも―――コイツが他の吸血鬼のように血を吸うようなヤツだったら、俺はこうして向かい合って話なんかしていただろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe that’s true, but humans and you are alike enough as things stand. So stop with the hypotheticals. I don’t much care for them.”
“Really? I like ‘what if.’ You never know how it will turn out, but for that moment, it feels as though salvation might still be possible.”
What if—so that was how she saw it.
If she drank blood like any other vampire, would I still be sitting here across from her, talking like this?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Certainly that may be true, but in the first place, humans are like you.
…… So let's just cut short this kind of conversation.
I don't like talking about 'what ifs'."
"Really?
I like 'What ifs'.
Not knowing how things will turn out, yet still having hope at least for that moment."
If…… what if.
Then, what if----she drank blood like other vampires, would we be talking like this?

entries.japanese:
「どうしたの志貴、いきなり暗い顔しちゃって。
あ、もしかしてトイレとか？」
「……あのな。
人がまじめに悩んでるっていうのに、よりにもよってソレですか、きみは」
　はあ、とため息をつく。
　こっちがいくら深刻に考えてみたところで、血を吸うか吸わないかはアルクェイドにとってどうでもいい問題みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why the long face, Shiki? Do you need the bathroom?”
“…Here I am wrestling with a serious moral question, and that is where your mind goes?”
I sighed.
No matter how seriously I considered it, whether she drank blood or not seemed to be a trivial distinction to Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's wrong, Shiki?
Your face got dark all of a sudden.
Ah, do you have to go to the bathroom?"
"…… Hey.
You come up with that when someone is thinking seriously?"
I sigh.
Even though I'm seriously thinking about it, Arcueid doesn't seem to think much about drinking blood.

entries.japanese:
「そうだよな―――俺には、関係ない話じゃないか」
「もう、さっきから一人でぶつぶつ言っちゃって。
隠しごとは男らしくないわよ、志貴！」
　むー、とまたも猫のようにうなるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right—it has nothing to do with me anyway.”
“Honestly, you’ve been muttering to yourself this whole time. Keeping secrets isn’t very manly, Shiki!”
Arcueid growled like a cat again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah----it doesn't concern me."
"Geez, just mumbling to yourself like that.
Trying to hide something isn't manly, Shiki!"
Arcueid looks like an angry cat again.

entries.japanese:
「別に隠し事なんかしてない。
そもそも隠し事だらけなのはそっちのほうだろ。
いつも俺には解らない話をして面白がってるんだから」
「面白がってるって――そんなコト、ないけど」
　さっきまでの不機嫌さはどこにいったのか、一変して大人しくなるアルクェイド。
　ホントのことを言い当てられて怯むような、そんな目をしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m not keeping any secrets. You’re the one who’s full of them. You’re always saying things I can’t understand and enjoying my confusion.”
“I’m not enjoying it.”
Her ill temper vanished, and Arcueid went meek in an instant.
She had the look of someone flinching because the accusation had struck home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm not really hiding anything.
Besides, you're the one with all the secrets.
You're just having fun saying things I can't understand."
"Having fun--I'm not trying to do that."
I don't know where her bad mood went, but she suddenly calms down.
She looks like she's uneasy with me nailing it on the head.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ、本当にこっちが頭を抱えてる姿を面白がってたのか。
いたずら好きっていうか、秘密主義っていうか。
　ま、どうせ俺はおまえとは違う生き物だから、どうでもいいけど」
「そ、そんなコトない……！
　わたし、ちゃんと志貴には話してあげてるよ。
隠し事が多いように見えるのは、志貴があんまり聞いてこないだけなんじゃないかな……？」
「ふうん―――聞けば教えてくれるんだ、なんでも」
「ええ。
わたしたち、協力しあってるチームだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you really did enjoy watching me tie myself in knots. I can’t decide whether you’re a prankster or simply secretive.
Well, we’re different kinds of creature anyway, so I suppose it doesn’t matter.”
“Th-that’s not true…! I do tell you things, Shiki. Maybe it only seems as though I keep secrets because you hardly ever ask me anything…?”
“So if I ask, you’ll tell me anything.”
“Yes. We’re a team, after all.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?
You really were having fun seeing me stumped like earlier?
Do you like teasing, or is it secrecy?
Well, we are two different kinds of life forms, so I don't care."
"Th, that's not it……!
I was just trying to answer you.
It probably looks like I'm hiding a lot of things because you never ask……"
"Hmm----so whatever I ask, you'll tell me?"
"Yes.
We are a team after all."

entries.japanese:
よし。
　それならお望みどおり、いまいちはっきりしない疑問点を聞いてやろうじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Good.
Then I would take her at her word and clear up one of the many things she’d left so frustratingly vague.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Alright.
Then as she wishes, I shall ask questions to clear things up.

entries.japanese: アルクェイドが昼間に外に出よう、なんて言い出すから忘れていたけど、俺にはアルクェイドに問いたださなければいけない事があったハズだ。
entries.maoEnglish: I’d forgotten because Arcueid had suddenly insisted on going out in broad daylight, but there was something I was supposed to confront her about.
entries.mirrorMoon: I forgot because she started telling me to take her out to play, but there was something I had to ask her about.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ聞くけど。
アルクェイド、俺は二日前の夜にヘンにヤツに襲われたんだ」
「え？
　ヘンなヤツって、どんなヤツ？」
「ああ、それが――――」
　気を落ち着かせて、できるだけ克明に、二日前の夜に起こった出来事をアルクェイドに説明する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let me ask you something. Arcueid, two nights ago I was attacked by a very strange man.”
“Huh? What kind of man?”
“Well…”
I steadied myself and described what had happened that night in as much detail as I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then I'll ask.
Arcueid, I was attacked two nights ago by a strange person."
"Eh?
A strange person?
What kind?"
"Well, that is----"
I calm down and I describe as clearly as I can what happened two nights ago.

entries.japanese:
「……と、いうわけなんだけど―――――」
　ひとしきり説明を終えて、アルクェイドの顔色をうかがう。
　話が始まってからこっち、アルクェイドの目は鋭いままで和らぐことがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And that’s what happened.”
When I finished, I studied Arcueid’s face for a reaction.
From the moment I began, her eyes had stayed sharp and never once softened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, that's how it was------"
Finishing my explanation, I read Arcueid's expression.
From when I started until now, her eyes remained sharp without any gentleness.

entries.japanese:
「どうなんだよアルクェイド。
その包帯の男と、神父みたいな服を着たヤツっていうのはおまえの敵なのか？」
「……そうね。
両方ともわたしの『敵』よ。
その包帯の男は何者だか知らないけど、カソックを着た女のことなら見当はつく」
　アルクェイドは不機嫌そうに目を細める。
　いや、不機嫌というより神経質そうにいらだっているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, Arcueid? Are the bandaged man and the one dressed like a priest enemies of yours?”
“Yes. They’re both my ‘enemies.’ I don’t know who the bandaged man was, but I have a good idea who the woman in the cassock might be.”
Arcueid narrowed her eyes.
She looked less sulky than taut with nervous irritation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So what is it Arcueid?
That bandaged man, and that person wearing those robes like some priest, are they enemies of yours?"
"…… Yes.
Both of them are 'enemies'.
I don't know just who or what that bandaged man is, but that woman wearing those Catholic robes, I have an idea about."
She narrows her eyes as if she was in a bad mood.
No, she looks less like she was in a bad mood and more like she's irritated.

entries.japanese:
「志貴を助けたやつはわたしとは顔見知りかもしれない。
……まいったわね。
たしかにあの女ならわたしより先に『敵』を見つけ出せるかもしれない」
　きっ、とアルクェイドは悔しそうに唇を噛む。
「ちょっと待った。
俺、別にその人が女だって言った覚えはないんだけど？」
「いえ、間違いないわ。
異端狩りを単独で行う権限をもっていて、火葬式典と鉄甲作用を複合させた黒鍵を使う代行者はあの女だけだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The person who saved you may be an acquaintance of mine. This is a problem. That woman might very well find my ‘enemy’ before I do.”
Arcueid bit her lip in frustration.
“Wait. I don’t remember telling you that person was a woman.”
“There’s no mistake. She’s the only executor authorized to hunt heretics alone who uses Black Keys combining the Cremation Rite with the Ironclad Effect.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I may know the person who helped you, Shiki.
…… Man.
If it's really her, she'll probably be able to find the enemy before me."
She bites her lip vexedly.

"Wait a minute.
I didn't say that person was a woman though."
"No, there's no mistake.
That woman is the only agent given authority to hunt heretics alone and who uses Black Keys that combine the Cremation Rite and the Steel Shell Effect."

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドの苛立ちは、ほとんど敵意に近いものだ。
　ネロのことを話していた時だって、アルクェイドがここまで感情を露にしたことはなかったっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid’s irritation bordered on open hostility.
Even when she spoke of Nrvnqsr, I had never seen her display this much emotion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her irritability is almost like hostility.
Even when she spoke about Nrvnqsr, her voice was never saturated with emotion to this extent.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
あの、俺を助けてくれた人も吸血鬼なのか……？」
「いえ、そういうワケじゃないんだけど―――そうね、志貴にはもう一つだけ、大事なことを教えてあげていなかったわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Was the person who saved me a vampire too…?”
“No—not exactly, but there is one more important thing I haven’t told you, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, that person who helped me, is she a vampire……?"
"No, that's not it----that's right, I have yet to tell you about something else that's very important."

entries.japanese:
「前に説明したと思うけど、この街に巣くっている吸血鬼みたいに、人間を自分の下僕にして領地を増やしていく吸血鬼はね、極力自己の存在を隠蔽しようとするの。
　犠牲者を出しても、周囲がそれを異状だと気がつかないように様々な魔術を働かせる。
　これ、どうしてだか解る？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I think I explained this before, but vampires like the one nesting in this city—vampires who make humans their servants and expand their territory—take enormous pains to conceal their existence.
Even when they claim victims, they use all kinds of magecraft to keep the people around them from noticing anything wrong.
Do you know why?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I think I explained it before, but vampires like the one making his lair in this town turn humans into their minions and expand their territory.
At the same time, they try their utmost to conceal their existence.
Even though victims appear, they use various magical techniques to make things appear not out of the ordinary.
You know why?"

entries.japanese:
「……そりゃあ、人間だってバカじゃないからな。
自分たちの住んでいるところにそんな化け物がいるってわかれば反撃するだろ。
いくら人間が弱いっていったって、警察とかがあるんだから自分たちでなんとかできるかもしれないし」
「―――まあ、たしかにそれもあるけど、警察は人間に対する法律組織でしょう。
わたしたちはそんなのは考慮にいれない。
　けどまあ、自己保身のために自らの痕跡を隠蔽する、というのは正しいわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Humans aren’t stupid. If they discovered a monster like that living among them, they’d fight back. Humans may be weak, but with the police and everything, we might be able to deal with it ourselves.”
“That is part of it, I suppose, but the police are an institution of human law. Creatures like us don’t take them into account.
Still, you are right that vampires erase their traces to protect themselves.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, it's because humans aren't stupid.
If they find out monsters like that exist where they live, they'd attack them.
Even though humans are weak, they do have things like police, so they might be able to do something."
"---Well, I guess that's true, but police are only a law-enforcement group against humans.
We don't consider them at all.
But, it's correct to say that vampires hide their presence for the sake of self-preservation."

entries.japanese:
「志貴、吸血鬼には天敵がいるのよ。
それも今ではパワーバランスはあっちのほうが上っていう、殺し屋みたいな集団がね。
　……他の超越種たちもそうだけど、とくに吸血種は自らの存在を明かしては命とりになる。
　たとえ小さな、文明社会から隔離された山村一つを支配して秘密の王国を作っても、犠牲者が増えればかならず『彼ら』が嗅ぎ付けるから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Vampires have a natural enemy, Shiki. They are a band of killers who now hold the advantage in the balance of power.
This is true of other transcendent species as well, but revealing their existence is especially fatal for the vampiric species.
A vampire might take over some tiny mountain village cut off from civilization and build a secret kingdom there, but once enough victims accumulate, ‘they’ will inevitably catch the scent.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, there is a natural enemy of the vampires.
A group of something like professional killers that now have the power balance in their favor.
…… It's true for other transcendent species, but especially for vampires, it is fatal for them to reveal themselves.
Even if a vampire made a secret kingdom in a village somewhere in the mountains away from all civilization, this natural enemy would definitely notice if victims keep increasing.

entries.japanese:
「吸血鬼たちが秘密裏に人間を搾取するのは何のためでもない、ただ自己保身のためだけよ。
　吸血鬼は社会的な風聞ではなく、その天敵に嗅ぎ付けられる事を嫌って自然に死体を隠蔽するの」
「……はあ。
吸血鬼たちの天敵って、またわけのわからない化け物が出てきたな」
　普通の人間のこっちとしては、これ以上常識はずれのモノが乱入してくるのはやめてほしいんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Vampires prey on humans in secret for one reason alone: self-preservation.
They hide the bodies not because they fear public rumor, but because they don’t want their natural enemy finding them.”
“Wonderful. Now there’s some other incomprehensible monster that even vampires are afraid of.”
Speaking as an ordinary human, I’d really prefer no more violations of common sense to come barging into my life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Vampires exploit the humans in secret, for no reason other than self-preservation.
The vampires hide their dead victim's bodies, not out of fear of human society finding out, but in fear of these natural enemies discovering them."
"…… Huh?
The natural enemy of vampires?
Yet another group of monsters I don't know about."
For a normal guy like me, I just want all these unnatural things to stop appearing.

entries.japanese:
「何いってるのよ。
その天敵っていうのはあなたたち人間の事じゃない」
「────？
　天敵って、俺たちが？」
「そう。
もうずっと昔、人間は様々な魔術、神秘学、式典儀礼をもとに組織体系を作り、人間以外の霊長類を排除しはじめたの。
　その最たる物が基督教───法王庁が誇るエクシシストの集団よ。
旧教（カトリック）は昔っから『人間でないモノ』を徹底的に淘汰してきたけど、その中でも吸血鬼に対する敵視はどうかしてるわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about? Their natural enemy is humanity.”
“What? We are the natural enemy?”
“Yes. Long ago, humans built organizations upon magecraft, mysticism, and ceremonial rites, then began exterminating every primate that wasn’t human.
The foremost example is Christianity—the exorcist order of which the Holy See is so proud. The Catholic Church has always ruthlessly purged ‘things that are not human,’ but even by those standards, its hatred of vampires is deranged.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying?
Their natural enemy is without a doubt you humans."
"-----?
Natural enemies, us?"
"Yeah.
Starting from a long time ago, humans used many kinds of magic, the occult, magical ceremonies to create an organization and started to eliminate primates other than humans.
The greatest of these is Christianity---the pride of the Vatican, the Exorcists.
The Catholic Church always viewed "nonhumans" as impurities, but vampires are considered the most dangerous."

entries.japanese:
「世界中のどんな宗教をみたって、カトリック以上に吸血鬼を敵視している宗教はない。
　あれはね、すでに憑かれてる。
病的すぎてわたしでさえ彼らには関わりたくないぐらいだもの」
　はあ、とアルクェイドはため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There isn’t a religion anywhere in the world more hostile to vampires than Catholicism.
It’s beyond obsession. Their hatred is so pathological that even I want nothing to do with them.”
Arcueid sighed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There are many religious groups in the world, but the Catholic Church looks at vampires with more hostility than the rest.
You know, it's almost an obsession.
They are so insane, I don't even want to mess with them."
Arcueid lets out a sigh.

entries.japanese:
「志貴を助けたのはその中でも異端狩りを専門としている連中の一員よ。
　埋葬機関っていう、キリスト教の矛盾点を法ではなく力で処理していく連中でね。
決して表には出てこない、殺し屋みたいなエクソシスト」
「…………」
　吸血鬼を退治する神父さん、か。
　なんていうか、あんまりにもはまりすぎてて言葉がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The one who saved you belongs to a group among them that specializes in hunting heretics.
They’re called the Burial Agency. When Christianity runs into a contradiction, they settle it with force instead of law—exorcists who work like assassins and never show themselves in public.”
“……”
A priest who killed vampires.
The image fit so perfectly that I had nothing to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The one who helped you was a member of an elite organization that hunts heretics.
"This group, the Burial Agency, is part of The Church.
They use their own strength rather than law to deal with contradictions to Christianity.
These hidden exorcists are more like professional killers."
"…………"
Priests that go around exterminating vampires, huh?
It's so fitting, I'm not really sure what to say.

entries.japanese:
「でもさ、それってつまり仲間ってことじゃないのか？
　その埋葬機関っていう連中も吸血鬼退治が目的なら、一緒に吸血鬼を探せるかもしれない」
「―――だめよ。
連中は吸血鬼であるのならなんでもいいの。
　彼らにとって、ヒトではない霊長類はそれだけで『悪』なのよ。
人間の血を吸おうが吸うまいが関係ない。
　そのエクソシストだって、この街に巣くった吸血鬼じゃなくて、わたしを封印するためにきたのかもしれないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But doesn’t that make them allies? If the Burial Agency hunts vampires too, we might be able to search together.”
“Absolutely not. To them, any vampire will do.
Every nonhuman primate is ‘evil’ simply for being nonhuman. Whether it drinks human blood is irrelevant.
That exorcist may have come not for the vampire nesting in this city, but to seal me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then aren't they like us?
If this Burial Agency is a group whose purpose is to hunt vampires too, can't we search together?"
"----That won't work.
For them, it's enough that someone is a vampire.
To them, non-human primates are just "Evil".
It doesn't matter if they suck blood or not.
This exorcist may have even come here just to seal me rather than fight the vampire who lives in this city."

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　なんだか、色々とこみいってきた。
　アルクェイドの敵は仲間である吸血鬼に狙われて、吸血鬼を敵視する連中にも狙われている。
「……なんだよ。
それじゃ一人きりじゃないか、おまえ」
「ええ、それが吸血種だもの。
　ネロの時に言ったでしょ、吸血鬼っていうのは同族であってもその性質が大きく異なるから、結局は一人きりなんだって」
　ぱくり、とハンバーガーをかじるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
This was becoming hopelessly complicated.
Arcueid’s target was hunted by fellow vampires and by people who hated all vampires.
“What? That leaves you completely alone.”
“Yes—that’s what it means to belong to the vampiric species.
I told you when we faced Nrvnqsr: even members of the same kind differ so radically in nature that every vampire is alone in the end.”
Arcueid took another bite of her hamburger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Things have gotten quite complicated.
Arcueid's enemy is sought after by both a vampire, and a group that hunts vampires.
"…… What is this?
Then you're all by yourself?"
"Yes, that is the life of a vampire.
Didn't Nrvnqsr say so himself?
Even though vampires belong in the same species, their natures are so different that in the end, they are all alone."
Arcueid takes another bite of her hamburger.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは当然のように自分が一人だっていう事を口にする。
「…………」
　それを釈然としない気持ちのまま、仏頂面で聞き流した。
entries.maoEnglish:
She spoke of her solitude as though it were the most natural fact in the world.
“……”
I let the words pass with a scowl, unable to accept them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She speaks of being all alone so casually.
"…………"
Not feeling satisfied, I continue to listen with a sour expression.

entries.japanese:
……そうだな。
　こうしてアルクェイドに手伝って彼女の『敵』とやらを探しているけど、俺はそいつがどんなヤツなのかさえ、未だ教えてもらっていなかった。
「それじゃあ質問。
アルクェイド、おまえの言う『敵』って、結局どんな吸血鬼なんだ？
　ここまで追ってきたっていうコトは、それなりに面識はあるんだろ？」
「それは―――その―――」
　アルクェイドは視線を逸らす。
entries.maoEnglish:
That was true.
I was helping Arcueid hunt this ‘enemy’ of hers, yet she still hadn’t told me the first thing about what kind of creature we were chasing.
“Here’s my question, then. What sort of vampire is this ‘enemy’ of yours? If you followed it all the way here, you must have met it before.”
“Well—that is…”
Arcueid looked away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That's right.
I've been helping Arcueid look for this "enemy", but I don't even know what kind of guy he is yet.
"Then I'll ask.
Arcueid, your 'enemy', what kind of vampire is he?
You've been chasing him this long, so you know what he looks like, right?"
"Well----I----"
Arcueid looks away.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ。
俺には隠し事はしないんだって、さっき言ったばかりじゃないか」
「そうなんだけど、怒らないで聞いてね。
　この街に吸血鬼が潜んでるっていうのが解ったのはつい最近のことなの。
この国のこの街に『敵』がいるって判明してすぐにやってきたんだけど、まだ本体には出会っていないのよ。
　そういった事情で、正直わたしにも今回の『敵』がどんなヤツなのかぜんぜん解らないんだ」
「わからないって―――ネロの時はあの鴉を見ただけで解ってたような素振りだったのに？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong? You only just promised not to keep secrets from me.”
“I know, but promise you won’t be angry.
I only learned recently that a vampire was hiding in this city. I came as soon as I discovered my ‘enemy’ was here in this country, but I haven’t encountered the main body yet.
So, honestly, I have no idea what this particular ‘enemy’ is like.”
“Yet with Nrvnqsr, you seemed to recognize him from a single crow?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it?
Didn't you just say you wouldn't hide anything from me?"
"Yes, but please listen without getting angry.
I only knew just recently that the vampire in this city was here.
I came here as soon as I knew the 'enemy' was in this city in this country, but I have never met him.
So to be honest, I don't know anything about the 'enemy' this time."
"You don't know?----Didn't you recognize Nrvnqsr on sight?"

entries.japanese:
「ネロは有名だし、その有り方もずっと変化してないからね。
　けど、わたしの追っている『敵』はそう強力な吸血鬼じゃないし、今回はなにが得意でどんな人間になっているか見当もつかないぐらい、幅が広いヤツなの。
　志貴には悪いんだけど―――本当に、わたしにはこんなコトぐらいしか言えないわ」
　……アルクェイドが嘘を言ってはいないことはわかる。
わかるけど、やっぱり、なにか核になるような事を隠しているような気がする。
　例えば、それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nrvnqsr was famous, and the nature of his existence never changed.
The ‘enemy’ I’m hunting isn’t that powerful a vampire, but it can take so many forms that this time I can’t even guess what it specializes in or what sort of person it has become.
I’m sorry, Shiki, but that truly is all I can tell you.”
I knew Arcueid wasn’t lying. I knew that, yet I still felt that she was hiding something essential.
Something like—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nrvnqsr was famous, and he never changed his appearance.
While the "enemy" I'm pursuing isn't as strong of a vampire, his traits fall within a broad range and I have no idea of his specialties or features this time.
I'm really sorry Shiki---but I really can only tell you this much."
…… I know she's not lying.
I know, but still, I feel like she's hiding something.
Like----

entries.japanese:
「いいよ、アルクェイドにも解らないんなら仕方がないだろ。
　けど―――いくらなんでも、その『敵』ってヤツの名前ぐらいは知ってるはずだろ」
「名―――前」
「そう、名前」
　アルクェイドは俯いて黙り込んでしまった。
　なにか事情があって俺に名前を教えるコトができず、困っている。
　そう、思っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine—if even you don’t know, there’s nothing to be done.
But surely you at least know this ‘enemy’s’ name.”
“Its name.”
“Yes, its name.”
Arcueid lowered her head and fell silent.
I thought some circumstance prevented her from telling me, and she was struggling over what to do.
That was what I thought.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's okay.
You can't help it if you don't know.
But----at least you know the name of this 'enemy', right?"
"N----name?"
"Yeah, his name."
She gets downcast, descending into silence.
She cannot tell me his name for some reason, and she is troubled.
Well, that's what I thought, anyway.

entries.japanese:
「――――アイツの、名前」
　ぞくり、と。
　急激に、この店のすべてが凍結してしまったような、そんな悪寒が、した。
「アイツの名前はね、志貴」
　アルクェイドは、困ってなんかいない。
「……あいつの名前はミハイル。
ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォン。
　ウロボロスって呼ばれてる、人間から吸血鬼になった死徒の一人よ」
　俯いたまま、アルクェイドの唇が動く。
　そこにあるのは、ただ、血を吐くような憎悪だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“His name.”
A shiver ran through me.
It felt as though everything in the restaurant had frozen solid in an instant.
“His name, Shiki—”
Arcueid wasn’t struggling at all.
“His name is Michael. Michael Roa Valdamjong.
One of the Dead Apostles who began as a human and became a vampire, called Ouroboros.”
Arcueid’s lips moved while her head remained bowed.
There was nothing in her voice but hatred so raw it might have coughed up blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----His name."
Coldness.
Rapidly, I feel a chill so great it seems like it could freeze the entire room.
"Shiki, his name is……"
Arcueid isn't having any trouble saying it.
"…… His name is Michael.
Michael Roa Valdamjong.
Called Uroboros, a Dead Apostle who used to be human."
She speaks while still looking down.
Pure enmity, as if she was spitting forth blood.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、おまえ―――」
「―――――」
　アルクェイドの肩は震えている。
　今にも暴れ出したい感情をなんとか自分の中だけで堪えようとしている。
「……わるい。
つまんないコトを聞いて、悪かった。
いいから、今のは忘れてくれ」
　アルクェイドは微かに、ふるふると首を横にふった。
　忘れるコトなんてできない、と言うかのように。
　しばらく、無言のまま時間が経った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, you…”
“……”
Her shoulders trembled.
She was barely containing an emotion that wanted to tear its way out of her.
“…I’m sorry. It was a stupid question.
Forget I asked.”
Arcueid gave the faintest shake of her head, as if to say she could never forget.
For a while, time passed in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, you----"
"------"
Her shoulders are shaking.
It looks like she's trying to hold herself back from going on a rampage.
"…… Sorry.
I shouldn't have asked.
It's okay, just forget about it."
Arcueid shakes her head slightly.
As if trying to say she could never forget.
A period of silence ensues between us.

entries.japanese:
「―――――ごめん」
　ぽつりと、俯いたままのアルクェイドから声が聞こえてきた。
「―――ん」
　それに自然に頷いたあと、やっぱりごく自然に、俺たちはファーストフード店の椅子から立ちあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry.”
The words came softly from Arcueid, still sitting with her head bowed.
“Mm.”
I nodded without thinking, and just as naturally, the two of us rose from our seats.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------I'm sorry."
Arcueid says this, still looking down.
"----Mm."
I give a noncommittal response.
Both of us rise automatically from our seats and leave the restaurant.

entries.japanese:
――――ふむ。
　こんな真昼間からファーストフード店でアルクェイドと話をする機会なんて二度とないだろうし、吸血鬼の事とは外れた、常識的な質問をすることにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Hmm.
I would probably never again have the chance to sit with Arcueid in a fast-food restaurant in broad daylight, so I decided to ask some ordinary questions for once—nothing to do with vampires.
entries.mirrorMoon:
