I avert my eyes as I speak.
“Honestly, Shiki. I can’t tell whether you’re open-minded or impossibly stubborn. I don’t care, but what you just said is a terrible insult. Tell me what grounds you have for saying it.”
I have no grounds.
But then, I have just as little proof that you are a vampire.
So—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A vampire?--what's with that all of a sudden, Shiki?"
"It's not all of a sudden.
I was just thinking."
I look away.
"Huh?
I can't tell if you're really stubborn or not.
I don't really mind, but that's pretty insulting.
Tell me why you're asking that."
There's no reason.
But----at the same time, there's no real proof she's a vampire either.
So----

entries.japanese:
「……だって、おまえは血を見るのもイヤなんだろ。
そんな吸血鬼がいるもんか。
自分で半人前だって言ってたけど、血を吸ったことのない吸血鬼なんて半人前以下だと思う」
　―――そうじゃなくて。
　たんに。
こいつに、吸血鬼でなんか、いてほしくないんじゃないのか、遠野志貴の本心は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You hate even seeing blood, don’t you? What kind of vampire does that? You said you were still a novice, but one who has never drunk blood doesn’t even qualify as that.”
―――No—that isn’t it.
Doesn’t Shiki Tohno simply want her not to be a vampire at all? Isn’t that the truth in his heart?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, you said you don't even like to see blood.
What kind of vampire is that?
You even said you weren't a full vampire, but a vampire that hasn't sucked blood isn't a vampire, is it?"
----That's not it.
Isn't it just that Tohno Shiki, deep inside, wishes she wasn't a vampire?

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
ちょっと立って」
　アルクェイドがベンチによってくる。
　言われるままに、立ちあがった。
「――――」
　アルクェイドと視線が合う。
　ちょうど距離にして二メートルぐらい、俺とアルクェイドは離れている。
　はあ、とアルクェイドは大きくため息をつくと、いきなりにこりと微笑んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Stand up for a moment.”
Arcueid approaches the bench.
I rise as she asks.
“—”
Our eyes meet.
There are about two meters between us.
Arcueid releases a long sigh, then abruptly smiles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Stand up."
Arcueid approaches the park bench.
I stand up.
"----"
Our eyes meet.
We're about two meters apart.
Arcueid gives a huge sigh, and suddenly grins.

entries.japanese:
「そうだよねー。
わたしもホントはそう思ってたんだ。
アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドはほんとうに吸血鬼なのでしょうか？
　って」
　あはは、とアルクェイドは笑う。
　……ホッとした。
　なにか、この質問はアルクェイドを傷つけるんじゃないかと―――そう思っていたから、アルクェイドが冗談のように受け止めてくれて、助かった。
「―――だよな。
アルクェイドはどう見ても吸血鬼らしくない」
　あはは、とアルクェイドは笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right. I’ve secretly thought so too. I ask myself the same question. Is Arcueid Brunestud really a vampire?”
She laughs brightly.
Relief washes through me.
I’d feared the question might hurt her, so having Arcueid take it as a joke feels like a reprieve.
“—Exactly. No matter how I look at you, there’s nothing vampiric about you.”
Arcueid laughs again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess you're right.
I even thought about it myself.
I wondered, is Arcueid Brunestud really a vampire?
Ahaha," she laughs.

…… That's a relief.
I thought this question would insult her----but thankfully, she seems to have taken it as a joke.
"----Yeah.
You really don't look like a vampire at all."
"Ahaha," Arcueid laughs again.

entries.japanese:
「じゃ、試してみよっか」
　笑いながら、アルクェイドはそんな言葉を口にした。
「試すって―――え？」
「わたしがホントに血を吸えるのかどうか、試そっか。
もし出来たらなにかご褒美くれる、志貴？」
「な――――」
　アルクェイドは笑顔のまま、一歩ずつ俺の方へと歩いてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then shall we test it?”
Still laughing, Arcueid lets the words fall casually.
“Test it—what?”
“Let’s see whether I really can drink blood. If I manage it, will you give me a reward, Shiki?”
“Wha—”
Arcueid begins walking toward me one step at a time, her smile unchanged.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then, shall we try?"
She says this, still smiling.
"Try----eh?"
"Shall we see if I can really drink blood?
If I could, can you give me a prize, Shiki?"
"Wha----"
With that smile still on her face, she takes a step closer.

entries.japanese:
かつんかつん、と。
　アルクェイドは足音をたてて近寄ってくる。
　冗談だっていうコトは、お互いに解っている。
　解っているのに――――体が、まったく、動かなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Click, click.
Her footsteps draw closer.
We both know it is a joke.
We know—and yet my body will not move at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tap, tap.
Her footsteps echo in the air.
I know she's joking.
Still----I can't move, at all.

entries.japanese:
「ま――――」
　て、と言おうとして、言えなかった。
　アルクェイドの力じゃなくて―――俺自身、その言葉を飲み込んでいた。
　アルクェイドは近づいてくる。
　一歩。
また一歩。
　うつむいたまま、少しずつ。
　俺は――――指一本も動かせないまま、彼女の唇を、見つめている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wai—”
I try to say wait, but cannot.
It isn’t Arcueid’s power stopping me—I swallow the word myself.
Arcueid comes closer.
One step. Then another.
Slowly, her face lowered.
Unable to move even one finger, I stare at her lips—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wa----"
--it.
But I can't even finish.
It's not her power----but me who stops.
Closer.
One step.
Another step.
Looking down, bit by bit.
I----not even able to lift a single finger, am transfixed by her lips----

entries.japanese:
「志貴は、わたしのことを半人前だって言ったけど」
　頭の後ろに響くような、甘い声。
　かつん、と足音が間近で止まる。
―――ほんとはね。
血を吸うのなんて、簡単だよ。
　そんな声が、耳元で、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You said I was only half a vampire, Shiki…”
Her sweet voice seems to resonate inside the back of my skull.
One final footstep clicks to a halt beside me.
―――Here’s the truth. Drinking blood is easy.
I hear those words beside my ear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, you said I wasn't a full vampire, but……"
A sweet voice that seems to echo in the back of my head.
Another step, and the footsteps stop.
---You know, drinking blood is very easy.
I hear that voice right by my ear.

entries.japanese:
がたん、と。
　アルクェイドの体重が首元にかかる。
「―――――――」
　喉が凍り付いて、言葉が出ない。
　ただ、首元には、彼女の吐息だけがかかる。
―――それが、火のように熱いだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a jolt.
Arcueid’s weight settles against my neck.
“―――――――”
My frozen throat refuses to form words.
Only her breath touches my neck.
―――And it is hot as flame.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her body weight presses up against me.
"------"
My throat freezes and I can't even speak.
I can only feel her breath on my neck.
----It's hot like a burning fire.

entries.japanese:
「アル―――――」
　名前を呼ぼうとして、やめた。
　自分の意思で、止めた。
　アルクェイドの名前を呼んでしまえば、彼女がすぐに離れるとわかっていたから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arc—”
I begin to call her name, then stop.
I choose to stop.
I know that if I speak Arcueid’s name, she will pull away at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar-----"
I stop calling her name.
With my own will, I stop.
Because I know if I call out her name, she'll pull away.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　アルクェイドの吐息が、こんなにも近い。
　肩をつかむ白い指が、カタカタと震えている。
―――恐がって、いる。
　俺の思考はまっさらで、恐怖も何もない。
　ただ、アルクェイドだけがカタカタと震えていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Arcueid’s breath is impossibly close.
The white fingers gripping my shoulders tremble.
―――She is afraid.
My mind is perfectly blank.
There is no fear in me at all; Arcueid alone is trembling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Her breath is so close.
Her white fingers on my shoulders are trembling.
----She's, scared.
My mind is blank and I'm not scared at all.
But, Arcueid is the only one shaking.

entries.japanese:
顔は見えない。
　首筋にかかる吐息だけが、彼女の体の震えに重なっていく。
　はあ、という弱さから、はあはあ、という荒々しさに。
entries.maoEnglish:
I can’t see her face.
The breath upon my neck keeps time with the shivering of her body.
A faint exhalation grows into harsh, ragged panting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't see her face.
Just the swirling of her breath around my neck, and the feel of her trembling body against mine.
It changes from a weak breeze to heavy breathing.

entries.japanese:
「アル―――クェイド？」
「冗談―――――なのに」
　アルクェイドの声が震えている。
　俺の肩をつかむ指は、もう震えていない。
　そのかわりに―――鳥の爪のように、肩口に深く食い込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—cueid?”
“It was only a joke―――――and yet…”
Her voice is shaking.
The fingers on my shoulders have stopped trembling.
Instead, they dig deep into me like a bird’s talons.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar---cueid?"
"It was------supposed to be a joke."
Her voice shakes.
The fingers on my shoulder cease their trembling.
Instead----they dig into my shoulders like a bird's talons.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――！」
　痛みに声があがる。
　アルクェイドの爪はそれでも弱まらない。
　離れようとする俺の体を逃がすまいと、万力のように食い込んでくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—!”
Pain forces a cry from me.
Arcueid’s grip does not loosen.
As I instinctively try to draw away, her fingers bite like a vise, refusing to let me escape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah-----!"
A pained gasp escapes me.
But her claws do not let up.
They sink in as if not allowing me to escape.

entries.japanese:
「アルク―――ごめん、悪ふざけがすぎた。
からかって……悪かったから。
―――離れて、くれないか」
「志――――貴」
　アルクェイドの指が離れない。
―――まずいと。
　理性が警鐘を鳴らして、両腕に力がこもった。
　アルクェイドの体を押しのけようと腕が動く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid—I’m sorry I took the joke too far. I shouldn’t have teased you… so please, let me go.”
“Shi—ki.”
Her fingers will not release me.
―――This is bad.
Reason sounds the alarm, and strength floods both arms.
They move to shove Arcueid away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arc----I'm sorry, I guess I joked around too much.
I'm sorry----so can you, let go?"
"Shi----ki."
Her fingers don't move.
----This isn't good.
My mind screams in warning and I gather up all my strength.
My arms move to push her away.

entries.japanese:
その前に。
　ぐっ、と、両肩に痛みが走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Before they can.
Fresh pain lances through both shoulders.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Before that,
Pain shoots through my shoulders.

entries.japanese:
「…………っっっ！！」
　両腕が動かない。
　両肩に食い込んだアルクェイドの指が、一層強く肩を掴んで腕が痺れてしまった。
「―――、―――、―――――――」
　……首筋にかかるアルクェイドの吐息が乱れている。
　狂しい。
　アルクェイドの歯が、首筋に触れようとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Agh!!”
My arms won’t move.
Arcueid tightens the fingers buried in my shoulders until both arms go numb.
“―――, ―――, ―――――――”
Her breath against my neck is ragged.
Maddening.
Her teeth are about to touch my skin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………!!!"
My arms can't move at all.
Her vice-like grip on my shoulders causes my arms to go numb.
"----,----,--------"
…… I can feel her breath grow even wilder against my neck.
Maddening.
Her teeth almost touch my neck.

entries.japanese:
「だ――――め……！」
　ぎり、と肩をつかむ白い指に力がこもった後。
　悲鳴のような呼吸をして、アルクェイドは俺から飛びのいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No――――…!”
Her white fingers clamp down once more.
Then, breathing as though she has screamed, Arcueid hurls herself away from me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N----No……!"
After the grip increases one more time from her white fingers,
Arcueid flies back, practically screaming.

entries.japanese:
はあ―――はあ―――はあ―――
　切なげな呼吸が公園に響く。
　荒々しい呼吸は俺と―――目の前でがくがくと体を震わせているアルクェイドのものだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Haa—haa—haa—
Agonized breathing echoes through the park.
Those ragged gasps belong to me—and to Arcueid, whose whole body is shaking violently before me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Panting fills the air.
Hard breathing echoes through the park.
My ragged breathing-----Arcueid's trembling breaths.

entries.japanese:
「志――――貴」
　全身を震わせて、まるで空気が吸えないみたいにはあはあと息をはいて、アルクェイドは呆然と自分の両手を見つめている。
　白い指先は、俺の血で濡れていた。
　赤い血が、指先を伝って手の平に、そうして腕へと滴っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shi—ki.”
Trembling from head to toe and panting as if no air will enter her lungs, Arcueid stares blankly at her own hands.
Her white fingertips are wet with my blood.
Red trickles over her fingers into her palms, then runs down her arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi------ki."
Her entire body shaking, she gasps as if to suck in the entire atmosphere as she stares in disbelief at her two hands.
Her white fingertips are now dripping with my blood.
The redness flows from her fingers to her palms, and then along her arms.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　それを苦しそうに、今にも倒れそうな体でアルクェイドは見つめている。
「……アルクェイド、今のは、その―――」
　声をかける。
　アルクェイドは手の平に伝う血の筋から視線をあげて、俺を見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
Arcueid stares at the blood in anguish, looking ready to collapse.
“Arcueid, that was…”
I call to her.
Her eyes rise from the trail of blood across her palm and find me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
She looks at it, and seems to be on the verge of collapse.
"…… Arcueid, just now, was----"
I call out to her.
Looking up from the blood on her hands, she meets my gaze.

entries.japanese:
「志―――貴？」
「……ああ、ここにいる。
今のは、その―――冗談にしては、度がすぎてた、よな」
　本当にただの悪ふざけという事にしておきたくて、そんな言葉を口にした。
　けれどそれは逆効果だったらしい。
「志貴―――わたし、すごく――――」
　アルクェイドの目が焦点を失っていく。
「喉が―――乾いてて――――」
　体の震えはいっそう大きくなっていて、アルクェイドは今にも―――崩れてしまいそうなほど、不安定に見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shi―――ki?”
“I’m here. That was―――too much for a joke, wasn’t it?”
I say it because I desperately want what happened to be nothing more than horseplay.
Apparently, that only makes things worse.
“Shiki―――I’m so――――”
The focus drains from Arcueid’s eyes.
“My throat―――is so dry――――”
Her trembling worsens, and Arcueid looks so unsteady she might simply come apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi----ki?"
"…… Yeah, I'm here.
Just now, was----a joke, but it seems like it went a little far."
I say that, wanting to let this end just as a joke.
But I guess it didn't work out.
"Shiki----I, just----"
Her eyes lose sanity.
"Got----very thirsty----"
Her convulsions become deeper, and even now----she seems like she'll crumble to the ground.

entries.japanese:
「お願い―――今夜は、志貴は帰って」
「おい、アルクェイド……！？」
　そのまま、アルクェイドは走り出した。
　あっというまに遠くなっていく。
　さっきのように俺のことを気にしての速度じゃない。
　俺なんかが全力で走っても追いつけないスピードで、アルクェイドは夜の街へ消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please―――go home tonight, Shiki.”
“Wait, Arcueid…!?”
She breaks into a run.
In seconds, she dwindles into the distance.
She isn’t holding back for my sake as she did before.
Moving faster than I could ever follow even at a sprint, Arcueid disappears into the night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please----go home, Shiki."
"Hey, Arcueid……!?"
With that, she starts to run.
She disappears fast.
Not like she ran before, where she was taking me into account.
With a speed I couldn't even match if I sprinted with all my strength, she vanishes into the night towards the city.

entries.japanese:
「――――な」
　帰ってって、あんなものを見せられたあとでそう簡単に帰れるもんか。
「あいつ―――あんな苦しそうな体でどこ行くっていうんだ、ばか………！」
　このまま家に帰ることなんて、できない。
　見つけられるアテなんてないってわかっていながら、俺も夜の街へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
After seeing that, how could I possibly just go home?
“Where does that idiot―――think she’s going in that condition…?”
I can’t return to the mansion like this.
Knowing I have no hope of finding her, I run into the city after her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Wha…"
She thinks I can just go back after seeing her like that?
"That idiot----where is she going when she's in that much pain……!?"
I can't just go back home.
Even though I don't know where to find her, I start to run after her into town.

entries.japanese:
―――アルクェイドの姿は見当たらない。
　街は広すぎて、何の手がかりもなしで一人の人間を捜し当てるのなんて、不可能に近い。
　こうして闇雲に捜すよりは、あいつの行き先を予想してヤマをかけたほうが幾分見つけられる可能性は高まるだろう。
　それなら―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――There is no sign of Arcueid.
The city is far too large; finding one person without a single clue is almost impossible.
I’ll have better odds if I guess where she went rather than searching blindly.
In that case—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I don't see her anywhere.
The city is too big, and it's nearly impossible for a single person to track her down when she leaves no trace behind.
I'd be much more likely to find her if I predict where she's going to go rather than blindly searching.
Then----

entries.japanese:
―――アルクェイドのマンションに行こう。
　何が原因か知らないけど、あんなに苦しそうに呼吸を乱していたんだ。
　今夜は死者を狩り出すことを諦めて、自分の部屋に戻っているかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll go to Arcueid’s apartment.
I don’t know what caused it, but she was breathing as though every breath hurt.
She may have abandoned tonight’s hunt for the Dead and returned to her room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'll go to Arcueid's apartment.
I don't know what's behind it all, but she was breathing so painfully.
Rather than trying to hunt The Dead, she might have just gone back to her room.

entries.japanese:
……呼び鈴を押す。
　アルクェイドが出てくる気配はない。
「―――くそ、帰ってないのか、あいつ」
　呼び鈴を何度押したところで、部屋の扉が開く事はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I press the bell.
There is no sign that Arcueid will answer.
“―――Damn, she hasn’t come home.”
No matter how many times I ring, the door remains closed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I press the doorbell.
It doesn't seem like anyone's coming out.
"----Shit, she hasn't come back?"
No matter how many times I push the button, her door doesn't open.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　帰ってきていないのか、それとも出てこないだけなのか。
―――ためらったあと、中に入る事にした。
　ドアの鍵なんて、『線』を切れば簡単に開けられる。
　その前に、いちおうノブに手をかけてみた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Either she hasn't returned, or she simply isn't coming to the door.
―――After hesitating, I decide to go inside.
A door lock is easy enough to open if I cut its ‘line.’
Before doing that, I try the knob just in case.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
Did she not come back, or is she just not coming out?
----After hesitating, I decide to go inside.
It'd be a simple thing to cut the "lines" on the door.
But, I should just check the knob first.

entries.japanese:
「……あれ？」
　ドアに鍵はかかっていない。
　ノブはがちゃり、と音をたてて、簡単に開いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh…?”
The door is unlocked.
The knob rattles, and the door opens without resistance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?"
It's not locked.
The door opens simply with a turn.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド、いるのか？」
　……返事はない。
　もともと鍵はかけていなかったのか、部屋には人の気配は皆無だ。
「あいつ、あんな体でどこほっつき歩いてるんだ……！」
　ガン、と壁を殴りつける。
「……っ」
　……何をやっているんだ、俺は。
　壁に八つ当たりをする暇があるんなら、街に出てあいつを探さないと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, are you here…?”
No answer.
Maybe the door was never locked; either way, there isn’t the slightest sign of anyone inside.
“Where is that idiot wandering around in her condition…!?”
I slam my fist into the wall.
“Ngh…”
What am I doing?
If I have time to take my anger out on a wall, I should be back in the streets searching for her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid, are you here?"
…… No response.
Did she not lock it in the first place?
There's no one around.
"Where does she think she's going in that condition……!?"
I slam my fist against the wall.
"…… Grr."
…… what am I doing?
If I have time to let it out on the wall, I have to go out and look for her----

entries.japanese:
……アルクェイドの姿は見付からない。
　考えてみれば、あいつが本気で身を隠そうとしたら、俺なんかが見つけられるハズがないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no trace of Arcueid.
When I think about it, if she seriously intends to hide, someone like me could never find her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can't find her.
Come to think of it, if she really intends not to be found, there's no chance of me finding her at all.

entries.japanese:
「……また明日って言ってたよな、あいつ」
　こうなったらそれを信じて、また明日の夜を待つしかない。
「…………」
　言いようのない焦燥感を胸に抱えたまま、屋敷への帰途についた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She said she’d see me tomorrow.”
All I can do now is believe her and wait until tomorrow night.
“…”
With an anxiety I cannot put into words lodged in my chest, I begin the journey back to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… She said we'd meet again tomorrow."
All I can do in this situation is to trust her and wait for tomorrow night.
"………………"
With a great uneasiness in my chest, I return to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
―――繁華街に的をしぼろう。
　アルクェイドはあんなに苦しそうだったけど、苦しいからって休むようなヤツじゃない。
　あいつは、志貴は帰って、と言った。
逆に言えば自分は帰らない、ということだろう。
　アルクェイドは一人で吸血鬼探しを行うつもりだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll concentrate on the downtown district.
Arcueid was suffering, but she isn't the sort to rest simply because she's in pain.
She told me to go home. Put another way, that must mean she isn't going home herself.
I think she means to keep hunting the vampire alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'll search the shopping district.
Even though she was in so much pain, she's not the kind of person to rest because of it.
She told me to go back.
In other words, she was saying she won't be going back.
I think she plans on finding the vampire by herself.

entries.japanese:
それなら―――繁華街に行って、こっちから先に吸血鬼だろうが死者だろうが見つけてやる。
　アルクェイドは見つけられないけど、メガネさえ外せば死者を見分けることはできる。
「―――――よし」
　メガネを外して、軽い頭痛に耐えながら、繁華街へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then I’ll go downtown and find the vampire—or one of the Dead—before she does.
I may not be able to find Arcueid, but if I remove my glasses, I can distinguish the Dead from ordinary people.
“―――――All right.”
I remove my glasses and run toward downtown, enduring the mild pain in my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then----I'll go to the shopping district and find the vampire or The Dead before she does.
Arcueid can't find them, but I can spot The Dead if I take off my glasses.
"------Alright."
Taking off my glasses and grimacing from the slight headache, I run to the shopping district.

entries.japanese:
「うっ――――」
　ずきり、とこめかみに痛みが走る。
　……別段、意識して『線』を視ているわけではないけど、裸眼のまま街を歩くだけで、やはり脳に負担がかかるみたいだ。
「くそ―――だっていうのに、影も形も見あたらない」
　……繁華街を歩いていく人達は、みな普通の『線』をしている。
　以前に見た、全身がラクガキで塗りつぶされたような人影はどこにも見当たらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ugh――――”
Pain stabs through my temple.
I’m not deliberately looking for the ‘lines,’ but merely walking through town with my naked eyes still seems to burden my brain.
“Damn it—there isn't a trace of them anywhere.”
Everyone walking through downtown bears ordinary ‘lines.’ Nowhere can I find a figure whose whole body looks blackened by frantic scribbles,
like the one I saw before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh----"
The pain races through my forehead.
…… I'm not particularly concentrating on looking for "lines", but it seems running through town without my glasses on is a huge burden on my brain.
"Damn it----still, I'm not finding anything."
…… All the people walking through the shopping district have normal "lines" on them.
I don't see anyone painted with the disjointed scribbles I saw before.

entries.japanese:
「……痛ぅ」
　こめかみを指で押さえる。
　メガネを外している限り、頭痛は強まっていく一方だろう。
　それでも――そう簡単に諦めるわけにはいかない。
　大きく深呼吸をしてから、もう一度繁華街を走りまわることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow…”
I press two fingers to my temple.
As long as my glasses remain off, the headache will only worsen.
Even so, I can’t give up this easily.
After one deep breath, I begin searching downtown all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ow"
I rub my temples with my fingers.
As long as I have my glasses off, this headache will only get worse.
But still--I can't give up this easily.
Taking a deep breath, I start to run through the shopping district once more.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ、はあ――――」
　走り回った疲れと、頭の痛みで吐き気がする。
　何度走り回っても、死者はおろか異状なものさえ見つからない。
　額に手をやると、異常なぐらいに熱を帯びていた。
　質の悪い風邪にかかって、四十度近い熱を出しているみたいだ。
「……くそ、まだまだ――――」
　自分に言い聞かせて巡回を再開する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa―――haa, haa――――”
Exhaustion and pain make me nauseous.
No matter how often I circle the district, I can’t find one of the Dead or anything else abnormal.
When I touch my forehead, it is unnaturally hot.
I feel as though I’ve caught a vicious fever approaching forty degrees.
“Damn it, not yet――――”
I force myself to resume the search.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start to pant from exertion.
The exhaustion from running coupled with the pain in my head makes me nauseous.
No matter how many times I run around, I can't find any Dead or anything out of the ordinary.
Lifting up my hand to my forehead, I feel a feverish heat.
It really does feel like I have a high fever.
"…… Damn it, I'm not done yet----"
I tell myself this as I start to run once more.

entries.japanese:
――――と。
「……………あ」
　ここじゃなくて、もっと離れたところ。
　ビルとビルの狭間にある狭い路地裏で、なにか、バチバチと火花が散っているのが視えた。
　いや、正確には。
　死の『点』がパチンと弾けて、そのまま消えていくような感じ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Then.
“Ah…”
Not here, but farther away.
In a narrow alley between two buildings, I see something crackling like a shower of sparks.
No—that isn’t quite it.
It feels as though a ‘point’ of death is snapping apart and vanishing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And then.
"…………… Ah."
Not here, but somewhere farther away.
In a narrow alley between two buildings, I can see something like sparks flying in the air.
No, more accurately,
it feels like the "points" of death are shooting forth and disappearing.

entries.japanese:
「――――あれは」
　……間違いない。
　以前、アルクェイドが死者を倒した時と同じモノだ。
　あいつ―――あんな体だっていうのに、やっぱり一人で戦ってやがった……！
「―――見つけた………！」
　疲れも頭痛も忘れて、路地裏へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What is that?”
There can be no mistake.
It is the same thing I saw when Arcueid killed one of the Dead.
That idiot―――she really is fighting alone, even in that condition…!
“―――Found you…!”
Forgetting both fatigue and pain, I race toward the alley.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's…"
…… There's no mistake.
It's exactly the same as when Arcueid defeated The Dead before.
She----in that condition, is fighting by herself……!
"----Found her……!"
Forgetting my pain and weariness, I dash towards the alley.

entries.japanese:
路地裏の入り口。
　ビルとビルの間にある細い道を走っていく。
『死』は、パチンパチンと弾けては消えていく。
　……よっぽど多くの死者と戦っているのか、この量は異常だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The mouth of the alley.
I run down the narrow passage between the buildings.
‘Death’ keeps bursting with sharp little snaps, then vanishing.
There are far too many; she must be fighting a horde of the Dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The entrance to the alley.
I run to the narrow path between the buildings.
"Death" is flying through the air and fading away.
…… How many is she fighting?
There's an enormous amount of it.

entries.japanese:
「――――――くっ」
　耐えられないのは。
　路地裏に近づくたびに、ぎっ、ぎっ、と音をたてる背骨の軋みだった。
「はっ―――――あ」
　まるで、ノコギリで少しずつ骨を切断されていくよう。
　それは自分自身が出している痛みだ。
　本能が叫んでいる。
　この先に行くのは危険だから今すぐひき返せ、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Ngh.”
What I cannot bear.
It is the creaking of my spine, growing louder with every step toward the alley.
“Hah―――――ah.”
It feels as though a saw is cutting slowly through my bones.
The pain comes from within me.
My instincts scream.
Danger lies ahead; turn back now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Gh."
I can hardly bear it.
As I run to the alley, my spine groans in protest.
"Ha------agh."
As if a saw was slowly but surely slicing through my spine,
a pain works its way from inside me.
My instincts scream at me.
They say where I'm going is too dangerous, and I have to go back.

entries.japanese:
「うる―――さい」
　でも、そんなコトは言われなくてもわかっている。
　この死の量は尋常じゃない。
　この奥。
路地裏で、なにか、ヤバイ事が起きているのはわかっている。
　けど、今更引き返せない。
　アルクェイドを放っておけない。
　もし―――ここで自分が逃げ帰ったら、あいつは勝手に死んでしまう。
　そんな予感がどうしても消えてくれなくて、自分から死が充満する路地裏へ足を踏み入れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shut―――up.”
I don’t need instinct to tell me.
This much death is not normal.
Deeper in the alley. Something terrible is happening there.
But I can’t turn back now.
I can’t abandon Arcueid.
If I run home from here, she will go and die on her own.
Unable to shake that premonition, I step willingly into the alley saturated with death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shut----up."
But, that goes without saying.
The amount of death there isn't normal.
Inside.
I know something terrible is happening inside this alley.
But I can't turn back now.
I can't leave Arcueid alone.
If----I run away here, she might go off and die.
I can't shake off that feeling, and I enter the alley filled with death.

entries.japanese:
「な――――――」
　意識が、凍りついた。
　そこに広がっている光景は、マトモじゃなかった。
　地面に転がっている、何人ものヒトの形。
　顔がなく、腕も潰され、はらわたを引き裂かれ、全身を真っ赤な色に染めた死体たち。
　壁も、床も、ともすれば頭上の月さえも。
　ここでは、ただ、赤かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wha――――――”
My consciousness freezes.
There is nothing sane about the scene spread before me.
Human shapes lie scattered across the ground.
Faceless corpses with crushed arms and torn-open entrails, every inch of them dyed scarlet.
The walls, the pavement—perhaps even the moon overhead.
Here, everything is simply red.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
My mind freezes.
What I see is surreal.
Scattered all across the ground are the figures of numerous people.
Faceless, limbless, their stomachs sliced open, the corpses bathed entirely in crimson.
On the wall, the ground, even on the moon overhead.
Everything here is just… red.

entries.japanese:
ずしゃ、という鈍い音。
　最後の一人だったのか、全身をラクガキに塗りつぶされたヒトガタは、彼女の手によって絶命した。

　アルクェイドは気まずそうに視線を逸らして、そう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
There are no words.
Arcueid has straightened her clothes and risen.
How can I possibly apologize?
What I did cannot be forgiven with a simple I’m sorry.
“―――Arcueid, I――――”
“Don’t worry about it. I’m the one who ought to apologize.”
Arcueid looks away awkwardly as she speaks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I don't know what to say.
Arcueid adjusts her clothes and stands up.
I----don't know how to apologize.
Just saying sorry… how can that make it up?
"----Arcueid, I----"
"Don't worry about it…… I'm the one who should apologize."
She looks away uncomfortably.

entries.japanese:
「なっ――なに言ってるんだ、悪いのは俺のほうだ。
俺が―――もっとしっかりしていれば、こんなコトには、ならなかった」
「無駄よ。
志貴の力じゃ抑えることはできなかったと思う。
志貴はわたしの『魔眼』を見てしまったんだから」
「え―――？
　魔眼って、ネロみたいな、あの目のことか……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh-what are you saying—I’m the one at fault. If I’d only been stronger, none of this would have happened.”
“It wouldn’t have mattered. I don’t think you had the strength to resist. You looked into my Mystic Eyes.”
“What? Mystic Eyes—like Nrvnqsr’s?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha--what are you saying?
I was the one who did something wrong.
If only----I had been stronger, that never would have happened."
"No.
I don't think it was something you could have resisted because you saw my 'Mystic Eyes'."
"Eh----?
Mystic Eyes?
Like, Nrvnqsr's eyes……?"

entries.japanese:
「……そうよ。
わたし、さっきは正気じゃなかったの。
どうしようもなく乾いてて、自分じゃ解決できなかった。
　だから―――死者たちを見つけて、ある衝動を破壊衝動に置き換えて、なんとか持ちこたえようとしたの。
　その時、わたしは自分を抑えていなかったから―――やってきた志貴が、わたしの魔眼を見てしまったのよ」
「……たしかに俺がおかしくなったのもアルクェイドの金の瞳を見てからだけど―――けど、やっぱりそれだけじゃないか。
俺は、自分で――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I wasn’t myself earlier. The thirst was unbearable, and I couldn’t ease it on my own.
So I found the Dead and turned one impulse into a destructive one, hoping that would let me endure.
I wasn’t restraining myself then, so when you arrived, you saw my Mystic Eyes.”
“It’s true that I lost control after I saw your golden eyes, but that still doesn’t excuse me. I chose to―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Exactly.
I wasn't sane earlier.
I was so thirsty, I couldn't control myself.
That's why----I found some of The Dead, and tried to replace that urge with the urge to destroy to stave it off.
Back then, I was unable to hold myself back----so that's why you saw my Mystic Eyes when you came."
"…… Certainly I felt odd from the time I saw your golden eyes----but that's just that.
I, with my own will--"

entries.japanese:
「それが違うのよ。
　志貴、わたしの魔眼は魅了の魔眼っていって、見たものを自分の虜にするものなの。
……志貴がわたしに性的欲求を感じたのも、きっとそのせいなんだと思う」
「――それは―――違うと、思うけど」
　だって、アルクェイドに操られていなくても。
　俺はこいつのことを、好きかも、しれないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s where you’re wrong.
Shiki, mine are called the Mystic Eyes of Enchantment. Anyone who sees them becomes enthralled to me, and I think that must be why you felt such sexual desire for me.”
“――That―――isn’t true, I think.”
Because even without Arcueid controlling me.
I may already have feelings for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, that's wrong.
Shiki, my Mystic Eyes of Enchantment completely captivate whoever looks upon them.
…… I think that's why you started to feel all those sexual desires."
"--That----can't be right."
Because even if she wasn't controlling me.
I, I might, still like her.

entries.japanese:
「とにかく、今回のことはわたしの不注意だったわ。
……ごめんなさい、志貴。
貴方の心とは関係なく、貴方の体を操ってしまって」
　アルクェイドは目を反らしながら言う。
　……そんなふうに謝られると、胸が痛い。
　だって俺には操られていた意識なんかまったくなかった。
　むしろ―――それをよしとして、自分から欲望に従ったようなものだったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In any case, this happened because I was careless. I’m sorry, Shiki. I forced your body to act against your heart.”
Arcueid says it without meeting my eyes.
Hearing her apologize that way hurts.
I never once felt as though I were being controlled.
If anything, I welcomed it and surrendered to my desire of my own accord.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, this was all because of my carelessness.
…… I'm sorry, Shiki.
I manipulated your body without any regards to your feelings."
Her gaze shift away as she says this.
…… Being apologized to like this hurts my heart.
Because I didn't feel like I was manipulated at all.
Rather----it seems like I used it to obey my own lust.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、俺は――――」
「謝らないで。
……志貴、これは事故よ。
わたしも忘れるから、貴方も忘れて。
そうしたほうが、きっとお互いのためになるわ」
　アルクェイドはそう言うと、静かに歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, I――――”
“Don’t apologize. Shiki, this was an accident. I’ll forget it, so you should too. That will be better for both of us.”
With that, Arcueid quietly starts walking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, I----"
"Don't apologize.
…… Shiki, this was all an accident.
I'll forget about it, so please forget about it too.
I think it's better for the both of us that way."
Saying that, she starts to walk quietly.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド……？」
「―――今夜はこれで終わりにしましょう。
これで死者たちはみんな殺してしまったから、これ以上歩きまわるのは無意味だわ」
「……それはいいけど、この死体の山はどうするんだよ。
人に見られたら大変だぞ」
「心配する必要はないわ。
一度吸血種になったモノの遺体は残らない。
土に還ることを拒んだ彼らは、消滅すれば灰になって空に散るだけよ。
しばらくすれば独りでに塵に還ってくれるから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…?”
“―――Let’s stop for tonight. We’ve killed all the Dead here, so there’s no point wandering farther.”
“Fine, but what about this mountain of corpses? If anyone sees it, we’re in serious trouble.”
“There is no need to worry. Once something becomes part of the vampiric species, no corpse remains. They rejected their return to the earth; when destroyed, they become ash and scatter into the sky. In a little while, they will crumble into dust on their own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid……?"
"----I think this is enough for tonight.
I killed all these Dead tonight, so it's probably useless to search any further."
"…… That's fine, but what do we do with that mountain of dead bodies?
If someone finds it, there'll be trouble."
"There's no need to worry.
Once something becomes a vampire and dies, it won't leave a trace.
Those who refused to return to the Earth become ash to be scattered in the wind once they die.
They will return and disperse on their own in a while."

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは振りかえらず、どこか弱々しい足取りで路地裏から立ち去っていった。
「………………」
　それを引き止めることなんて、今の自分にはできない。
　両手には、まだアルクェイドの感触が残ってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Without looking back, Arcueid leaves the alley on strangely unsteady feet.
“…”
I cannot bring myself to stop her.
My hands still remember the feel of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Without turning around, she disappears from the alley with weak steps.
"………………"
I can't stop her now.
I still feel the sensation of Arcueid on both my hands.

entries.japanese:
「―――ばか。
なんて大馬鹿野郎なんだ、俺は」
　一人、そう呟いて。
　惨劇の舞台となった路地裏で、懺悔するように月だけを見上げていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Idiot. What a goddamned idiot I am.”
I mutter it alone.
In the alley where the carnage took place, I look up at the moon as if in penitence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Idiot.
What a stupid idiot I am."
I groan to myself.
In the alley which became a stage of tragedy, I look up at the moon in remorse.

entries.japanese:
―――夕方の一件が気になって、学校にやってきた。
　……思い返してみると、学校でのアルクェイドはどこかおかしかった。
　なんの脈絡もないけど、あいつがアテもなく走り去った先があるとしたら、それはこの校舎のように思える。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Troubled by what happened that evening, I come to the school.
Looking back, there was something strange about Arcueid at school.
There is no logical reason for it, but if her aimless flight led anywhere, I feel it must have been this building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Concerned about what happened this afternoon, I come to my school.
…… Thinking back, Arcueid was strange when we were here earlier.
There's no logic to it, but if she's just wandering around, I think she may end up here.

entries.japanese:
あたりには人の気配はおろか、物音一つさえしない。
「…………っ」
　だっていうのに、校舎の中に、何かがいるような、予感がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no sign of anyone nearby—not even the faintest sound.
“…”
And yet I have the premonition that something is inside the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no sign of anyone; not even a single sound.
"…………"
But still, I feel like there's someone in the building.

entries.japanese:
何か。
　日の落ちたこの校舎は、不吉な『場』と、
　化している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Something.
After sunset, this school has become an ominous—
place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Something.
Without the presence of the sun,
the school building has changed into an ominous "place".

entries.japanese:
「……入るぞ、志貴」
　ためらっていても時間の無駄だ。
　自分に言い聞かせるように呟いて、校舎の中へと歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Go in, Shiki.”
Hesitation only wastes time.
I whisper the words to steel myself, then enter the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Let's go in, Shiki."
I don't have time to hesitate.
Encouraging myself verbally, I walk inside the building.

entries.japanese: ――――一階に、人影はない。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――There is no one on the first floor.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----There's no one on the first floor.

entries.japanese:
――――ズキリ、と首の後が痺れる。
　それを堪えて、二階にあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Pain crackles through the back of my neck, leaving it numb.
I endure it and climb the stairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I feel a numb sensation behind my neck.
Ignoring it, I walk up to the second floor.

entries.japanese:
――――二階にあがる。
　人影はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I climb to the second floor.
No one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I arrive on the second floor.
No one here.

entries.japanese:
人影はない。
　人影は、ない。
　だが。
　背中に、ぬめりと。
　蛇の腹のような、冷たいくせに柔らかい、感触がのしかかってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
No one.
No one at all.
But then.
Something slick settles against my back.
It is cold yet yielding, like the belly of a snake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No one here.
No one, here.
But.
On my back,
A soft, cold sensation like the belly of a snake covers me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――誰だ！」
　振りかえる。
　そこには、たしか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Who’s there!?”
I turn.
And there, unmistakably…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Who's there!?"
I whirl around.
I think there was…

entries.japanese:
「え――――？」
　トス、という音。
　次の、瞬間。
　俺の胸が、切開された。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What――――?”
A soft thud.
The next instant.
My chest is laid open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh----?"
I hear a stabbing sound.
In the next instant,
My chest is sliced open.

entries.japanese:
血が流れる。
　胸の古傷が開くように、突然、背後から胸をナイフで貫かれた。
「あ―――――」
　ずるり、と体が落ちる。
――――ワケが解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Blood flows.
A knife suddenly drives through me from behind, as though reopening the old scar on my chest.
“Ah―――――”
My body slips downward.
――――I don’t understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Blood flows forth.
I'm stabbed from behind, as if to open my old wound.
"Ah----"
My body falls.
----I don't know what's going on.

entries.japanese:
意識が薄れる。
　その最後の瞬間。
　いつかの、遠い夏の日の映像が、繰り返された。
entries.maoEnglish:
My consciousness fades.
In that final instant.
an image from a distant summer day plays once more.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Everything fades.
In the last instant,
I see a scene from a distant summer day, repeating in my mind.

entries.japanese:
こんにちは。
本教室の担任、知得留です。
　六時間目は人捜しの基本、というものを皆さんで考えてみましょう。
　ズバリ、率直にいって遠野くんは人捜しというものが解っていません。
　アルクェイドが走り去っていった理由を考察し、彼女は何故、何処へ、何をしに行ったのか、と推理をめぐらせていけば答えはおのずと出てきます。
　つまり彼女はお腹が減ったので、路地裏にチューチューしにいったのです！
entries.maoEnglish:
Hello, everyone. I’m Ciel, your teacher for this class.
For lesson six, let’s consider the fundamentals of tracking someone down.
To be perfectly blunt, Tohno has no idea how to look for someone.
Think about why Arcueid ran off—why she left, where she went, and what she meant to do—and the answer will reveal itself.
In short, she got hungry and went into an alley for a little sip-sip!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hello.
I am the teacher of this classroom, Ciel.
For the sixth period class, let's think about the basics of finding people.
To be straightforward, Tohno-kun does not know how to find people.
Please consider the reason why she ran away; why, where, and to do what.
If you piece these together, you will find an answer.
In other words, she got hungry, so she went into the alley to do some sucking.

entries.japanese:
「でたらめー！
　シエル横暴ー！
　メガネー！
　インドじんー！」
　………………。
　それでは今回はここまで。
　引き続きゲーム本編をお楽しみください。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Liar! Tyrant Ciel! Four-eyes! Indian!”
…
That concludes today’s lesson.
Please continue enjoying the game.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nonsense!
Violent Ciel!
Glasses!
Indian!"
………………
This session is finished.
Please continue enjoying the main storyline.

entries.japanese:
「にゃ？
　どうしたシエル？
　ショットガンとかマシンガンとか皆殺しバルカンなんか持ち出しちゃって」
　アルクッ！
　インドは関係ないでしょう、インドは！
「メガネが怒ったにゃー！
　ばひゅー（擬音）」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Meow? What’s wrong, Ciel? Why are you bringing out shotguns and machine guns and that Total-Annihilation Vulcan?”
Arc! India has nothing to do with this—nothing!
“Four-eyes is mad! Vwoosh—that was a sound effect.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nya?
What is it, Ciel?
Why are you pulling out something like a shotgun, and a machine gun, and a vulcan cannon?"
Arc!
India has nothing to do with it.
Nothing!
"Oh my, Glasses got pissed off-nyaa!
Whoosh (sound effect)"

entries.japanese:
―――朝になった。
　目が覚めて、枕元のメガネをかける。
　窓越しに見える空は、雲一つない青空だった。
「………………」
　非の打ち所のない朝を迎えたっていうのに、気分は暗く沈んでいる。
　理由は考えるまでもない。
　昨夜のアルクェイドとの一件が脳裏から離れてくれず、そのたびに罪悪感にさいなまれてしまうせいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Morning.
I wake, put on the glasses beside my pillow,
and look through the window at a blue sky without a cloud in it.
“……”
The morning is flawless, yet my spirits are leaden.
I don’t need to ask why.
What happened with Arcueid last night will not leave my mind, and every recollection brings the guilt gnawing back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It's morning.
I open my eyes and put on the glasses near my bed.
Looking out the window, I see a cloudless blue sky.
"………………"
Even though a flawless morning greets me, I can't help but feel down.
There's no need to wonder why.
What happened with Arcueid last night sticks in the back of my mind, and the accompanying guilt troubles me.

entries.japanese:
「……お互い忘れましょうって―――忘れられるわけないだろ、あれが」
　じっと両手を見つめる。
　この指はまだアルクェイドの体を覚えている。
　今もあいつの肌の手触りとか、冷たく滑るような体温を思い出せる。
　あの時は何も考えられなかったけれど、こうして振り返ってみればはっきりとわかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“‘Let’s both forget it’…
How am I supposed to forget that?”
I stare at my hands.
These fingers still remember Arcueid’s body: the texture of her skin, the cool, silken glide of her warmth.
I could think of nothing then, but looking back, I understand perfectly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… She said we should just forget it----but I can't forget such a thing."
I look at both my hands.
Those fingers still remember how Arcueid felt.
Even now I remember the texture of her skin and her cool, gliding body temperature.
I wasn't thinking at all back then, but I understand it all now.

entries.japanese:
あんなコトをしておいて。
　アルクェイドは忘れましょうと、無かったコトにしてくれたっていうのに、俺はそれを悔いると同時に、これっぽっちも忘れられないでいる。
　悔いることがあるとすれば、あの時どうして自分はまともな理性を持てなかったのか、という事だけだ。
　あんな動物みたいに触れるんじゃなくて、もっと人間として触れていれば、それはどんなに―――
entries.maoEnglish:
After what I did, Arcueid still offered to treat it as though it had never happened, simply telling me to forget.
Yet even as I regret it, I cannot forget a single part.
My only real regret is that I had no sane human reason left in me at the time.
If I had touched her as a human being instead of an animal, how much more—
entries.mirrorMoon:
After doing such a thing.
Arcueid said to forget and pretend like it never happened.
But while I regret it totally, I can't even forget one little bit of it.
What I regret is not being able to control myself back then.
If I didn't touch her like some animal, if I touched her more like a human, how would things have----

entries.japanese:
―――わかってた。
　俺はアルクェイドの金色の目を見て我を失ったんじゃない。
　ただ自分自身で気がつかなかっただけで、もうずっと以前から、遠野志貴はあいつ自身にいかれていたんだ。
　そんな単純なことを、俺は今になって気がつくなんて――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I had known.
I didn’t lose myself because I looked into Arcueid’s golden eyes.
I simply hadn’t realized that Shiki Tohno had been crazy about her—about Arcueid herself—for a long, long time.
And I’m only discovering something so simple now—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I knew it.
I didn't lose myself by looking into her golden eyes.
I didn't realize it, but I was caught up in her a long time ago.
To realize such a simple thing just now----

entries.japanese:
屋敷の朝の光景はいつもと変わらない。
　翡翠が起こしにきてくれて、居間に行くと秋葉と琥珀さんがいて、学校に行く前に軽い挨拶をかわす。
　いつもと何も変わらない。
　なのに気分はどうしようもなく空っぽで、誰に話しかけられてもまともに返事をする事もできず、上の空で屋敷を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Morning at the mansion is unchanged.
Hisui wakes me; Akiha and Kohaku are waiting in the sitting room; we exchange a few words before school.
Nothing is different.
Yet I feel hopelessly hollow. I can’t answer properly when anyone speaks to me, and I leave the mansion in a daze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The morning in the Tohno mansion is the same as always.
Hisui comes to wake me.
Akiha and Kohaku-san are in the sitting room, and we greet each other briefly before we go to school.
The same as always.
Yet I feel so empty, I can't even respond properly when people talk to me, and I leave the mansion vacantly.

entries.japanese:
正門をくぐる生徒たちはみな陽気そうだった。
「そっか。
今日は土曜日だったっけ」
　ここ数日間、アルクェイドに振りまわされていたせいでまるっきり曜日の感覚がなくなっている。
　曜日といえば、初めてあいつと出会ったのは金曜日だったけど。
　あいつは一週間前の朝、学校の前の交差点で俺を待っていたんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The students streaming through the front gate all seem cheerful.
“Oh. Right. It’s Saturday.”
After several days of being dragged around by Arcueid, I’ve lost all sense of the week.
Speaking of days, I first met her on a Friday.
One week ago this morning, she was waiting for me at the intersection outside school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The students streaming through the gate are all bright and cheerful.
"Oh yeah.
Today is Saturday."
My sense of time has totally disappeared since Arcueid came into my life.
The first time I met her was on a Friday.
A week ago in the morning, she was waiting for me at the intersection in front of school.

entries.japanese:
「……あいつ、笑ってたよな、たしか」
　そういえば、たしかに笑っていた。
　自分を殺した相手を待ち伏せしていたっていうのに、楽しそうに目を輝かせて遠野志貴っていう殺人者を待っていた。
「……なんでだろうな。
もし今夜あいつが来るなら、理由ぐらいは聞いてみようか」
　呟いて、よけい気が重くなった。
　たぶんアルクェイドは公園にはやってこない。
　思い返せば思い返すほど、昨日の夜は最後の夜だったんだと実感する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…She was smiling, wasn’t she?”
Yes. She definitely was.
Though she was lying in wait for the man who had killed her, her eyes shone with delight as she waited for the murderer called Shiki Tohno.
“…Why, I wonder. If she comes tonight, maybe I’ll ask.”
Muttering it only weighs me down further.
Arcueid probably won’t come to the park.
The more I remember last night, the more certain I become that it was our last.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… She was smiling, I think."
Come to think of it, she was smiling.
Even though she was waiting for the one who killed her, she was waiting for the killer Tohno Shiki with excitement in her eyes.
"…… I wonder why?
If she comes tonight, maybe I'll ask her."
After thinking aloud, my spirits sink further.
She probably won't come to the park.
The feeling that last night was our final meeting turns over in my mind.

entries.japanese:
こんなにも気が重くて、何もかもが上の空なのはそういうコトだ。
　俺はもうアルクェイドには出会えないかもしれない。
そんな後悔が、重い鎖のように体に纏わりついてしまっている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
That is why I feel so heavy, why nothing can hold my attention.
I may never see Arcueid again. The regret winds around my body like a length of iron chain—
entries.mirrorMoon:
My heart is heavy and everything else simply feels empty.
I may not ever see her again.
The regret hangs around me like a leaden chain----

entries.japanese:
自分の机に座る。
　ホームルームまであとほんの五分ほど。
　何をするでもなく、ただぼんやりと校庭を眺めていた。
「…………」
　はあ、と重苦しいため息をもらす。
　いつもなら相手をしてもいいんだけど、今日にかぎっては有彦の相手をするほど元気がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I sit at my desk.
Homeroom is barely five minutes away.
With nothing else to do, I stare blankly across the schoolyard.
“……”
A leaden sigh escapes me.
Ordinarily I might humor him, but today I don’t have the strength for Arihiko.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I sit at my desk.
It's about five minutes until homeroom starts.
I stare outside blankly, not wanting to do anything.
"Yo, delinquent.
You skipped class yesterday.
What the heck were you doing, Tohno-kun?"
"…………"
I let out a heavy sigh.
Usually I would, but today I don't feel like talking with Arihiko at all.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、またえらく元気がないな。
昨日は学校にはこない、来たら来たでヌケガラとはね。
やだやだ、遠野がそんなんだと学校にきても面白くもなんともない」
　有彦は大げさに肩をすくめる。
「―――有彦。
悪いけど今日は一人にしてくれ。
いいだろ、俺なんかがいなくてもおまえには先輩がいるんだから。
いや、むしろ俺がいないほうがラッキーなんじゃないか？」
「は―――？
　先輩って、オレ三年に知り合いなんかいねえけど？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What's with you? You skipped school yesterday, then show up today as an empty shell. Honestly, Tohno, if you're going to mope like that, there's no fun in coming to school at all.”
Arihiko gives an extravagant shrug.
“Arihiko, sorry, but leave me alone today. You’ll be fine without me—you’ve got that upperclassman of yours. If anything, you’re lucky I’m not around, right?”
“Huh? What upperclassman? I don’t know anybody in third year.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's with you?
You don't look happy at all.
You didn't come to school yesterday and now you come back an empty shell.
If you're like that, school's no fun."
Arihiko slumps his shoulders exaggeratedly.
"-----Arihiko.
Sorry, but can you leave me alone today?
If I'm not here, you can always talk with Senpai.
Actually, isn't that better for you?"
"Huh----?
Senpai?
I don't know any third year students."

entries.japanese:
「……なに言ってるんだおまえ。
シエル先輩は二年生じゃなくて三年生だぞ。
……そりゃあまあ、時々あの人は下級生なんじゃないかって思う時もあるけど、基本的に先輩は先輩だよ」
「しえる先輩って……誰それ？
　うちの学校に留学生なんかいたっけか？」
　有彦は真剣に首をかしげている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about? Ciel’s in third year, not second. Sure, sometimes she seems younger than us, but she is our senior.”
“Ciel…? Who’s that? Did our school have an exchange student?”
Arihiko tilts his head in genuine confusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What are you saying?
Ciel-senpai's in third year, not second.
…… Well, sometimes you think she's younger, but Senpai is a senpai after all."
"Shiel-Senpai?
…… Who's that?
Are there any foreign students at our school?"
He seriously tilts his head in thought.

entries.japanese:
「なに言ってるんだ、先輩はれっきとした日本人……」
　いや、待て。
　あの人が日本人だなんて、誰も言ってない。
「……そりゃあ誰も言ってないけど、でも、みんな当たり前にあの人のことをシエル先輩って呼んでたじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about? She’s unmistakably Japanese…”
Wait.
No one ever said she was Japanese.
“…Maybe no one said it, but everybody called her Ciel as though that were the most natural thing in the world.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying, Senpai is Japanese……"
No, wait.
No one ever said she was Japanese.
"…… Well, no one said she was, but everyone called her Ciel-senpai."

entries.japanese:
「だーかーらー、誰だよそのらるく先輩って。
どうしたんだ遠野、病み上がりであたまイッちまってるのか？」
　有彦の軽口も、よく聞こえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“For the last time, who’s this L’Arc-en-Ciel you keep talking about? What’s wrong with you, Tohno? Did your brain get fried while you were sick?”
Arihiko’s joke barely reaches me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's what I'm saying, who is this senpai?
What's wrong Tohno, are you sick or something?"
I can't hear his banter.

entries.japanese:
「な……………」
　そうだ。
どうしてそんな明白な違和感に気がつかなかったんだろう。
　シエルなんていう名前、どう考えたって日本人じゃないじゃないか。
　俺はあの人と知り合いだったのに、フルネームさえ知らない。
それどころかあの人が何年何組の先輩なのかって事さえ知らない。
　そもそも。
　俺はあの人と初めて出会った時、どうして昔っからの知り合いだなんて思い込んだんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Of course. How did I miss something so obvious?
Ciel isn’t remotely a Japanese name.
I knew her, yet I never learned her full name. I don’t even know her class.
More fundamentally—why did I assume,
the first time we met, that I had known her for years…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha………………"
That's right.
Why didn't I realize such an obvious inconsistency?
Ciel isn't a Japanese name at all.
Even though I know her, I don't even know her full name.
I don't even know what class she's in.
To begin with,
when I first met her, why did I feel like I knew her for a long time……?

entries.japanese:
「――――――！」
　ガタン、と音をたてて椅子から立ちあがる。
「？
　どうした遠野、おまえさっきから愉快すぎるぞ」
「ちょっと職員室に行ってくる。
わるいけど担任にはうまく言っておいてくれ」
　首をかしげる有彦に背を向けて、教室から駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My chair crashes back as I spring to my feet.
“What’s wrong, Tohno? You’ve been hilarious all morning.”
“I’m going to the faculty office. Cover for me with the teacher, all right?”
I turn my back on Arihiko’s baffled stare and race from the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
My chair clatters as I quickly stand up.
"?
What's wrong, Tohno?
You've been acting too funny."
"I'm going to the office.
Sorry, but please say that I'm here during attendance."
Turning away from Arihiko whose head is tilted in confusion, I dash out of the classroom.

entries.japanese:
職員室にいって三年生の名簿を調べてみれば、やはりシエルなんていう生徒は存在していなかった。
　念のため職員室にいる教師にも聞いてみたが、シエル先輩の事を覚えている教師は一人としていなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The third-year register in the faculty office confirms it: there is no student called Ciel.
To make sure, I ask every teacher present. Not one of them remembers her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I investigate the third year roster for the name Ciel, but as expected, it isn't anywhere to be seen.

To be sure, I ask the teachers in the office, but none of them remember Ciel-senpai.

entries.japanese:
放課後。
　土曜日という事もあって、ホームルームが終わるやいなや、クラスメイトたちは蜘蛛の子を散らすように教室から出ていった。
「――――」
　せっかくの土曜日だっていうのに、何もやる気が起きない。
　それこそ死者のような生気のなさで、一人屋敷への帰路についた。
entries.maoEnglish:
After school.
Since it is Saturday, the class scatters the instant homeroom ends.
“……”
Saturday or not, I have no desire to do anything.
With all the vitality of a corpse, I set off for the mansion alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The end of classes.
Being a Saturday, right after homeroom all my classmates scatter and run out of the room.
"----"
Saturday is finally here, but I don't feel like doing anything.
Feeling like The Dead, I walk home by myself.

entries.japanese:
「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
　屋敷に帰ってくるなり、翡翠が出迎えてくれる。
　わざわざ待っていてくれたっていうのに、そんな翡翠に空返事しかできず、自分の部屋に引きこもった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
Hisui was waiting to greet me the moment I returned.
She had gone to the trouble of waiting, yet I could only mumble a hollow reply before shutting myself away in my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Welcome back, Shiki-sama."
Hisui greets me as I return.
Even though she's waited all this time, I can't even return a greeting and I go to my room.

entries.japanese:
―――夕食が済ませて、部屋に戻る。
　アルクェイドとの約束の時間まで、あと少し。
「……そろそろ行くか」
　あいつが来るかどうかは分からない。
　それでも、もう二度と約束は破らないと誓った以上、自分から約束を破棄するわけにはいかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――After dinner, I return to my room.
It is nearly time for my meeting with Arcueid.
“…I should go.”
I don’t know whether she will come.
But I swore never to break another promise, so I cannot be the one to abandon it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----After dinner, I return to my room.
It's close to the promised time with Arcueid.
"…… Shall I be going?"
I don't even know if she's coming.
But still, I swore never to break a promise again, so I have to go.

entries.japanese:
十時より少し前に公園に着いた。
　あたりに人影はまったくない。
　ベンチに座って、時計の秒針を数えるように、ただアルクェイドが来るのを待った。
entries.maoEnglish:
I reach the park shortly before ten.
There isn’t another soul in sight.
I sit on a bench and wait for Arcueid, counting the seconds as though I can hear the hand of a clock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I arrive at the park shortly before ten.
There's absolutely no one here.
Sitting on the bench, I stare at the clock and wait for Arcueid to come.

entries.japanese:
十一時になった。
　……公園は凍りついたように停止している。
　新しい空気の流れ、やってくる人の気配なんて皆無だ。
　アルクェイドがやってくるような気配はない。
　時間だけが、ただ無為に過ぎていく。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Eleven o’clock.
…The park has frozen into stillness.
No breath of new air, no hint of anyone approaching.
Nothing suggests Arcueid will come.
Only time moves, passing to no purpose.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's now eleven o'clock.
…… The park is completely still, as if entirely frozen.
There's no fresh flow of air, nor the presence of anyone approaching.
There's no sign of Arcueid coming.
Time passes by meaninglessly.
I--

entries.japanese:
――――時計の針は二つとも頂点に差し掛かろうとしている。
　ここにきてから二時間。
アルクェイドがやってくるような気配はない。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Both hands of the clock are nearing the top.
I have been here two hours, and there is still no sign that Arcueid will come.
I――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
--Both hands on the clock approach the top of the dial.
It's been two hours since I came here, yet there's no sign of Arcueid.
I--

entries.japanese:
…………公園の時計は十二時を指している。
　約束の十時から二時間が経ってしまった。
「―――ふう」
　ベンチにうなだれて、ため息なんかをついてみる。
「……やっぱり来ないのかな、あいつ」
　分からない。
　分からないけど、このまま帰る気にはなれない。
「―――ああ、こうなったら朝になるまで待ってやろうじゃないか、くそ」
　ほとんど自棄になってベンチに踏ん反りかえる。
――――と。
entries.maoEnglish:
…The park clock points to midnight.
Two hours have passed since our ten o'clock meeting time.
“—Haaah.”
I slump on the bench and let out a sigh.
“…Maybe she really isn't coming.”
I don't know.
I just can't bring myself to leave.
“Fine. Damn it. I'll wait until morning if I have to.”
Almost past caring, I throw myself back across the bench.
――――And then.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……… The clock's hands point to twelve.
It's two hours past the promised time.
"---Whew."
I slouch on the bench and sigh.
"…… She might not come after all."
I don't know.
I don't know, but I don't feel like going back.
"---Yeah, I'll wait until the morning.
Damn it."
I lie on the bench in frustration.
----And then.

entries.japanese:
「………あれ？」
　ちょっと待った。
　休憩所の裏手に、いま、白い影がチラッと見えた気がする。
　……あまつさえ、こっちと目が合った瞬間に引っこんだような、そんな動き。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Huh?”
Wait.
I could swear I just glimpsed a white shape behind the shelter.
What is more, it seemed to duck away the instant our eyes met.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Huh?"
Wait a minute.
I think I saw a flash of white behind the rest area.
…… Besides, it moves back as soon as I saw it.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　ベンチから立ちあがって、ずかずかと休憩所まで歩いていく。
　……隠れきれない、と判断したのか、白い影はひょっこり顔を出してきた。
「あははー、見つかっちゃったー」
　もう、これ以上ないっていうぐらいの陽気さで、アルクェイドは現れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I rise and march toward the shelter.
Apparently deciding she cannot remain hidden, the white shape peeks around the corner.
“Ahaha! You found me.”
Arcueid emerges with impossible cheer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I stand up from the bench and stride towards the rest area.
…… As if it knew it couldn't hide anymore, the white figure shows its face.
"Ahaha, you found me~"
Arcueid appears more cheerfully than ever.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、おまえ―――」
「ん？
　なに？」
「―――ほんとに、来たのか」
　まだ信じられなくて、そんなコトを言ってしまった。
「来たのかって、約束なんだから来るわよ。
それも志貴より十分ぐらい早く来てたんだから」
　ふーんだ、とアルクェイドはそっぽを向く。
「……十分早くって、その、俺は―――」
　十時前に来てたんだけど、それより先に来てたっていうことなのか？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, you…”
“Mm? What?”
“…You really came.”
Still unable to believe it, I hear myself say it.
“What do you mean, really? We had a promise. I was here ten minutes before you, too.”
Arcueid turns away with an offended huff.
“Ten minutes before me? But I…”
I arrived before ten. Was she truly here even earlier?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, you---"
"Hm?
What?"
"---You really came?"
I blurt that out because I still can't believe it.
"Of course, we promised.
I came about ten minutes before you did."
She looks the other way.
"…… Ten minutes before, but, I---"
I came before ten o'clock, and she came earlier?

entries.japanese:
「なんで……？
　俺より先に来てたなら、どうして声もかけずにそんなところで待ってたんだよ」
「なにって、隠れて志貴の様子を見てたに決まってるでしょ」
「―――――」
　……そうか。
　いつもと変わらないような素振りをしているけど、アルクェイドも昨日の事を気にしているんだ。
　だから―――顔を合わせづらくて、そんなところで隠れていたのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…? If you arrived first, why didn’t you say anything? Why hide there all this time?”
“Obviously I was hiding so I could watch you.”
“……”
…Of course.
She is pretending nothing has changed, but last night must be troubling Arcueid too.
Perhaps she hid because she found it difficult to face me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why……?
If you were here before me, why didn't you tell me you were waiting there?"
"I wanted to watch you while I was hiding."
"-----"
…… I see.
Even though she doesn't act any different, she must be bothered by what happened last night.
That's why----she couldn't face me directly and was hiding.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん。
そうだよな、やっぱりそう簡単には―――」
「ほんとよ。
志貴ったらこっちにぜんぜん気がついてくれないんだもの。
　わたし、いつ見つかるかなってどきどきして待ってたのよ。
　たまには違った趣向で待ち合わせをしてあげたっていうのに、志貴がぼんやりしているおかげで台無しになっちゃったわ」
「――――え？」
　台無しって、なにが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Sorry. I understand.
Something like that isn’t so easy to—” “You’re telling me! You never noticed me at all.
I was waiting with my heart pounding, wondering when you’d find me.
I went to all the trouble of arranging a more interesting sort of rendezvous for once, and you ruined it by staring into space.”
“…What?”
Ruined what?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
That's right, it's not that simple---"
"Yeah.
You never even knew I was here.
I was waiting for you to notice.
I was planning on meeting in a different way this time, but you ruined it by just spacing out."
"----Eh?"
Ruined what?

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド―――おまえ、気まずいから隠れてたんじゃないのか……？」
「なんで？
　たんに退屈だから志貴で遊ぼうって思っただけよ、わたし」
　本当にあっさりと、こっちの焦燥なんて微塵も知らずにアルクェイドは言いきった。
「……俺で遊ぼうって、おまえ―――」
　会えた、という嬉しさは一瞬にして消え去った。
　会えた後どうしようか、なんてコトを悩む雰囲気でもない。
　……っていうか、こいつは相変わらず、こっちの気持ちなんてわからないで自分勝手に飛びまわる極楽とんぼだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid… You weren’t hiding because things felt awkward between us?”
“Why would I? I was bored, so I thought I'd amuse myself with you.”
Arcueid says it as casually as that, without the faintest idea how frantic I've been.
“Amuse yourself with me? You…”
My joy at seeing her evaporates.
This is hardly the atmosphere for worrying about what comes next.
She is the same carefree idiot as ever, flitting wherever she pleases without the faintest idea how I feel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid---you weren't hiding because you felt awkward……?"
"Why?
I was a little bored so I wanted to play around."
She says it lightly, not even knowing an inkling of the frustration I felt.
"…… Play around with me, you---"
The joy I felt from meeting her fades away instantly.
It's not a mood where I have to think about what I should do after seeing her.
…… As usual, she's acting at her own pace without even understanding how I feel.

entries.japanese:
「―――――は」
　夜空をあおいで、大きく胸に息を吸い込む。
　あたまにきたっていうより、呆れた。
　あんまりにアルクェイドがいつも通りなんで、安心したのかもしれない。
　その証拠に、あれだけ重く濁っていた心がすっきりと洗浄されてしまったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Hah.”
I look up at the night sky and fill my lungs.
I’m less angry than astounded.
Perhaps seeing Arcueid so perfectly unchanged has reassured me.
The heaviness and murk inside my heart have been washed clean.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Ha."
I fill my lungs with a deep breath of night air.
I'm less angry than surprised.
Maybe I'm just relieved she is acting normally.
Well, normal for her.
As proof, it feels like my heart laden with impurities has just been cleaned anew.

entries.japanese:
「……まいった。
おまえには、敵わない」
「そう？
　たんに志貴がぼんやりしてただけなんだけどな」
「いや、隠れんぼのことじゃなくて」
　……まあ、口にしても仕方がないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I surrender. I’ll never win against you.”
“Really? I thought you were just too absentminded to find me.”
“I don’t mean the hide-and-seek.”
…There is no use trying to explain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Man.
You win."
"Really?
I thought you were just zoned out."
"No, not about the hide-and-go-seek."
…… Oh well, it's useless putting it into words.

entries.japanese:
「それより、会えてよかった。
正直に言うと、もう会えないかなって思ってたから」
「―――え？
　志貴ったら、たった二時間待たされただけなのにそんなコト思ってたの？」
「……違う。
昨日、あんなコトがあったから。
俺は、もう会えないってずっと思ってたんだ」
「――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, I’m glad I saw you. Honestly, I thought I might never see you again.”
“What? You thought that just because I kept you waiting two hours?”
“No. Because of what happened yesterday. I spent all day thinking I’d never see you again.”
“……”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm glad you came.
To be honest, I thought I'd never see you again."
"---Eh?
You thought so after only waiting two hours?"
"…… That's not it.
It's because of last night.
I thought we would never meet again."
"----"

entries.japanese:
「……だめだよ、志貴。
あのコトは忘れましょうって、言ったのに」
　アルクェイドの声は弱々しい。
「あ―――――」
　……バカ。
　もう、これ以上ないっていうぐらい、俺は馬鹿だ。
　アルクェイドがいつも通りだなんて、勝手に、自分の都合のいいように思っていた。
　けど、それは違う。
　アルクェイドはアルクェイドなりに、俺の事を気遣っていつもと変わらないように接してくれていたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…You shouldn’t say that, Shiki. I told you we should forget it.”
Arcueid’s voice is faint.
“Ah…”
…Idiot.
I am a greater fool than words can express.
I decided, for my own convenience, that Arcueid was acting normally because nothing troubled her.
But I was wrong.
This was merely her way of sparing me—pretending everything was unchanged.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That won't do, Shiki.
I said to just forget about it."
Arcueid says this weakly.
"Ah-----"
…… Idiot.
I am such an idiot.
I selfishly thought she was acting completely normal.
But, I was wrong.
She was acting that way so I wouldn't feel bad.

entries.japanese:
「……悪い。
俺が馬鹿だった。
これじゃおまえのことを怒鳴る資格なんかないよな」
「もういいって言ってるのに。
責任があるとしたらそれはわたしのほうなのよ。
だから忘れて。
そのほうがお互いに都合がいいでしょ？」
　アルクェイドは明るい口調でごまかそうとする。
　昨夜の事とか、それを気にしている自分とかを。
　けれど。
　そんな顔をして忘れろ、と言われても、よけいに忘れられるはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Sorry. I'm an idiot. That means I have no right to yell at you.”
“I told you, it’s all right. If anyone was responsible, it was me.
So forget it.
That would be easier for both of us, wouldn’t it?”
Arcueid tries to hide behind a bright voice—hide last night and the fact that it still troubles her.
But when she wears that face and asks me to forget, forgetting only becomes more impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
I was an idiot.
I don't have any right to yell at you anymore."
"I said it's okay.
If anyone is to blame, it's me.
So just forget about it.
Isn't that better for the both of us?"
She tries to fool us both by speaking cheerfully.
Fool us about last night, fool us about how bothered she is.
But.
Telling me to forget with that expression, how can I forget?

entries.japanese:
「―――違う。
俺が悪いって言ってるのは、昨夜のことじゃない。
俺が俺自身を馬鹿だっていっているのは、忘れるべきことをどうしても忘れられないからだ」
「え―――志貴？」
「今日だって朝からずっとおまえのことを考えてた。
おまえに会えたらなんて謝って、なんて言ったらいいだろうって、ずっと考えてたんだ。
　それを、いまさら―――忘れることなんて、できるわけないだろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I’m not calling myself an idiot because of last night. I’m an idiot because I cannot forget what I’m supposed to.”
“Shiki…?”
“I thought about you all day. I kept wondering how I could apologize, what I could possibly say if I saw you.
How can I suddenly forget all of that now?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
I wasn't apologizing for last night.
I'm an idiot because I can't forget about something I should forget."
"Eh---Shiki?"
"Since this morning, all I thought about was you.
All I could think about was how I should apologize to you and what to say after I saw you.
So, I can't---just forget about it now."

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　アルクェイドは俺から視線を逸らす。
　俺も―――彼女を正面から見ることはできなかった。
言ってはいけない事を言ってしまった気がして、彼女と目が合わせられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Arcueid looks away.
I cannot face her either. It feels as though I have said something forbidden, and I can no longer meet her eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Arcueid looks away.
I---can't look at her either.
After sensing I said something I shouldn't have, I can't look into her eyes now.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドからの返答はない。
　お互い、相手の次の台詞を待って、結果として、長い沈黙が訪れた。
―――どのくらいの時間、そうして二人きりで立ち尽くしていたのかわからない。
　ただ、アルクェイドはかすかに頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid gives no answer.
Each of us waits for the other to speak, until an immense silence settles between us.
―――I don’t know how long we stand there alone together.
At last, Arcueid gives the smallest nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She doesn't respond.
I can't either, and a long silence begins.
---I don't know how long the two of us stood there.
Arcueid nods slightly.

entries.japanese:
「……うん、ほんとうのことを言えばね。
「わたしだって忘れられなかったよ、志貴」
　頬を赤らめて、言いにくそうにアルクェイドはそう言った。
「アルクェイド――――」
　その姿がどうしようもなく、可愛い。
　そう思えた瞬間―――アルクェイドはザッとまわりを見渡した。
　いつのまにか周囲には何人もの人影が集まっていて、こちらを取り囲むように、じっと息を殺している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Yes. If I'm honest—
“I couldn’t forget either, Shiki.”
Blushing, Arcueid admits it with difficulty.
“Arcueid――――”
She is unbearably adorable.
The moment I think it, Arcueid whips her gaze around us.
Several figures have gathered without my noticing. They surround us in perfect silence, scarcely breathing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, to tell the truth.
I couldn't forget about it either, Shiki."
Arcueid blushes as she says this with some difficulty.
"Arcueid----"
She looks so cute doing that.
As soon as I think that---Arcueid looks around her.
I don't know when this happened, but we're surrounded by human shapes.

entries.japanese:
「な………！」
　突然のことで思考が働かない。
「囲まれてるわ。
志貴、準備をして。
戦わなければ殺されるだけよ」
「戦うって、それじゃあこいつら―――」
「志貴もメガネを外せば解るでしょう。
彼らは、指の一本にだって正常な血が流れていない“死者”の群れよ」
「…………！」
　急いでナイフを取り出して、メガネを外す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
The shock empties my mind.
“We’re surrounded. Get ready, Shiki. If we don’t fight, they’ll kill us.”
“Fight? Then these people are—”
“Take off your glasses and you’ll understand. Not one finger among them carries living blood. They are a pack of the Dead.”
“…!”
I pull out my knife and tear off my glasses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha………!?"
I can't think since it was so sudden.
"We're surrounded.
Get ready Shiki.
If you don't fight, you'll just die."
"Fight?
Then they---"
"If you take off your glasses, you'll get it, won't you?
They are 'The Dead' without even a finger's worth of normal blood."
"…………!"
I quickly take out my knife and take off my glasses.

entries.japanese:
たしかに。
　俺とアルクェイドを取り囲む五人ほどの人間は、人のカタチをしたラクガキの線だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She is right.
The five people surrounding us are only scribbled lines arranged in human shapes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Like she says,
The five people surrounding us are just scribbled lines making a human shape.

entries.japanese:
「なんで―――！
　死者はもう打ち止めだって昨日言ったじゃないか、アルクェイド！」
「―――ええ。
このヒトガタたちは昨日の夜、わたしが滅ぼした死者たちよ」
　アルクェイドは目を細めてまわりの死者たちを睨む。
　じり、と緩慢な動作で死者たちは近寄ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How!? You said last night there wouldn’t be any more of the Dead, Arcueid!”
“Yes. These human-shaped things are the Dead I destroyed last night.”
Arcueid narrows her eyes at them.
Inch by sluggish inch, they close in.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why---!?
You said you killed them all yesterday, Arcueid!"
"---Yes.
These are the ones I destroyed yesterday."
She narrows her eyes and glares at them.
They advance sluggishly.

entries.japanese:
「昨日って、それじゃあ死んだふりをしてたっていうのか……！？」
「まさか。
わたし、そんな事を見逃すほど弱ってないわ。
……けど、気が抜けてるのは弁解のしようがないかな。
こいつらが灰になって消え去るのを見届けなかったんだから」
　じり。
　さらに包囲網を縮めてくる死者たち。
　ナイフを構える自分の指が、かすかに震えている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then they were pretending to be dead!?”
“Of course not. I’m not so weakened that I’d miss something like that. But I can’t deny I let my guard down. I didn’t stay to see them crumble into ash.”
Another inch.
The circle tightens.
My fingers tremble faintly around the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then were they only pretending to be dead……!?"
"Of course not.
I'm not weakened enough to be fooled by such tricks.
…… But, the fact that I made a mistake can't be excused.
I didn't make sure they dissolved into ashes at the end."
Shuffle.
They close the circle around us.
My fingers grasping my knife tremble a bit.

entries.japanese:
はっきりいって、ここにいるどの死者からも重圧は感じない。
　ネロっていう怪物に比べれば、こんな連中はカカシと言ってさえいい。
―――けれど、五人。
　俺は、こんな多くの死者を―――もともとは人間だったモノを、相手にすることが出来るのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Honestly, none of them exerts any pressure at all.
Beside the monster called Nrvnqsr, they might as well be scarecrows.
―――But there are five.
Can I truly face this many of the Dead—things that were once human beings?
entries.mirrorMoon:
To be blunt, there's no pressure coming from these Dead.
Compared to a monster like Nrvnqsr, they're practically nothing.
---But, five of them.
Can I fight this many Dead---this many things who were once human?

entries.japanese:
「――志貴、ためらえば死ぬのよ。
こいつらはもう生き物じゃない。
吸血鬼に血を吸われ、死者となったあとにわたしに二度目の生も無に帰されて――それでも無くなる事を許されずに使役される、ただの人形。
これを殺すことは罪ではないわ」
　背中越しにアルクェイドの声が聞こえる。
　いつのまにか、無防備な俺の背中にまわりこんでくれていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hesitate and you die, Shiki. These things are no longer alive. A vampire drained their blood and made them members of the Dead; then I erased their second lives as well. Even so, they were denied oblivion and forced into service as puppets. There is no sin in killing them.”
Arcueid’s voice comes from behind me.
Without my noticing, she has moved to guard my exposed back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Shiki, if you hesitate you'll die.
They are no longer alive.
Once they have their blood sucked by a vampire and become The Dead, they can no longer return--they are just dolls used by the vampire.
There's no sin in killing them."
I hear her voice from behind me.
It seems she moved to protect my vulnerable back.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれ。
どういう事だよ、それ」
「……世界には亡骸を操る魔術は多いっていうこと。
人間の死体っていうのは動物や無形のものより魔力を込めやすいから便利に使われるものなんだけど―――ざんねん、詳しく説明する余裕はないみたい。
　来るわよ、こいつら」
　アルクェイドの気配が離れる。
　同時に、死者たちが襲いかかってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. What does that mean?”
“It means there are many kinds of magecraft that manipulate corpses. Human bodies are easier to fill with magical energy than animals or formless things, so they’re useful. Unfortunately, I don’t think we have time for the full explanation.
Here they come.”
Arcueid moves away.
At once, the Dead attack.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait.
What do you mean?"
"…… I mean there are many ways to magically control a dead body.
It's easier to infuse a human corpse with magical energy than animals or intangible objects, so it's very convenient---unfortunately, I don't have time to go over the details.
They're coming."
I sense her moving away.
At the same time, they attack.

entries.japanese:
死のカタチが、襲いかかってくる。
　両手をあげて、ただ無造作に飛びかかってくる。
「――――くっ！」
　大きく横に跳んで、死者の突進をやりすごす。
　と、背後にイヤな気配を感じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Shapes of death rush me, arms raised,
simply hurling themselves forward.
“—Damn!”
I leap aside and let the first one pass.
Then I feel something foul behind me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The shapes of death attack.
They simply fly forward, arms outstretched.
"----K!"
I take a huge leap to the side and evade their attack.
Then, I sense something terrible behind me.

entries.japanese:
「こ―――の………！」
　全力で振り向く。
　そこには同じように、無造作に殴りかかってこようとする死者がいた。
――――死者の体には、『線』がない個所がないぐらいに死が満ちている。
　故に、どこを狙ってもナイフはたやすく彼らの肉体を切断するだろう。
　しかも死者の動きは緩慢だ。
　ネロが出してきた、どんなケモノよりも劣っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… bastard…!”
I spin with all my strength.
Another of the Dead stands there, swinging a careless fist.
――――Their bodies are so saturated with death
that there is nowhere without a “line.”
Wherever I aim, the knife should part their flesh with ease.
And they are slow—slower than any beast Nrvnqsr ever loosed upon me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why---you……!"
I whirl around with all my strength.
There, one of The Dead is trying to punch me.
----The Dead's body is almost devoid of places without "lines".
Which lets me slice anywhere on it's body.
What's more, it's movements are incredibly sluggish.
Far easier than anything that came out of Nrvnqsr.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　死者が襲いかかってくる。
　彼らは、簡単に、殺せる。
　振り上げられた腕をかわして、その無防備な左下腹部。
　『線』という血管が蠢く中にある、
　『点』という心臓を直視する――――
「く―――そぉ………！！！！」
　ざくん、という音。
　ナイフは、死者の左下腹部ではなく、振り上げられた腕だけを切断した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
One attacks.
I can kill it easily.
I slip beneath its raised arm. The left side of its abdomen lies open.
Amid the writhing blood vessels of the “lines,” I
stare directly at the heart called the “point”—
“Damn… it!”
The knife bites.
Instead of striking the lower abdomen, I sever only the raised arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
The Dead charge me.
I can kill them with ease.
Evading the swinging arm, I aim for the first one's unprotected lower left abdomen.
In the "line" of blood vessels there.
I stare at the heart called its "point"----
"Damn---it……!!!!"
Thrash.
The knife doesn't reach it's target, only slicing through its upraised arm.

entries.japanese:
片腕になった死者は、なんら躊躇うことなく襲いかかってくる。
　もう一人の死者も、恐れることなくやってくる。
　片腕の死者が襲いかかってくる。
　それをやり過ごした隙をついて、もう一人の死者が後ろから覆い被さってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The one-armed corpse attacks without an instant’s hesitation.
Another comes behind it, equally without fear.
The one-armed creature lunges.
As I evade it, the second drops onto my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The one-armed Dead doesn't even pause its attack.
The other Dead also comes in showing no fear.
The one-armed Dead attacks.
Right when I evade that Dead, the other Dead jumps on me from behind.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　ごりっ。
　後ろから、こちらにおんぶをする姿勢になって。
　死者は、俺の首筋に噛みついてきた。
　血を吸うとか、そういった行為じゃない。
　これは動物が獲物を即死させるために、首を噛みきろうとする行為と同じだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—” Crunch.
Clinging to my back like a rider,
it bites into the side of my neck.
This is not an attempt to drink blood.
It is the way an animal bites through
its prey’s neck to kill it instantly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Grind.
From behind, like a piggy-back stance.
The Dead bites on my neck.
Not to suck my blood or anything like that.
Just like a beast trying to kill its prey by biting its neck off.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――！」
　人間の口で首筋を噛みきれるものなのだろうか。
　食い込んだ死者の口は浅い。
奥歯ではなく前歯で噛みついてきている。
　結果、ぱきっと音をたてて、死者の歯のほうが折れた。
　それでも―――まったいらになった口で、死者はこちらの首を噛みきろうとしてくる。
　痛みはあまりない。
　ただ、おぞましかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
Can a human mouth truly bite through a neck?
The corpse has caught me shallowly with its front teeth rather than its molars.
Something cracks; its teeth break first.
Even so, it keeps gnawing at my neck with its flattened mouth.
It barely hurts.
It is simply revolting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah----!"
Can a human mouth bite through a neck?
The Dead's mouth is shallow.
It bites with its front teeth rather than its back.
As a result, The Dead's teeth actually break off.
Even still---it tries to bite through my neck with its flat mouth.
It doesn't really hurt.
It's just disgusting.

entries.japanese:
「あ……あ、あ―――」
　前からは片腕の死者が歩いてくる。
　とにかく、後ろからしがみついた死者を殺さなければ、殺されてしまう。
　方法はたやすい。
　いまだ噛みきろうと無駄な行為を続けている死者の顔を、さっくりとナイフで切断すればいいだけの話だから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…
ah…
aaah—” The one-armed corpse advances from the front.
Unless I kill the thing on my back, it will kill me.
The method is simple: draw the knife across the face that is still uselessly worrying at my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… ah, ah---"
The one-armed dead walks toward me.
I have to kill The Dead behind me or I'll die.
The method is simple.
As it tries to continue biting my neck, I can just slice my knife through its face.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　でも―――それは、人を殺すということだ。
　わかってる。
　彼らはもう人間じゃないって、生きてさえいないんだってわかってるのに―――それは、いけない気がするんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
But that would mean killing a person.
I know they are no longer human.
I know they are not even alive. Yet it still feels wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
But---that means I am going to kill.
I understand.
They aren't human, they aren't even living---but I still feel it's wrong.

entries.japanese:
―――なんて甘さ。
　たとえ死人だとしても。
　人のカタチをしたもの、そうやって動いているものを。
　同じ人間である俺が殺してしまうのは、何か、決定的に間違っている気がして――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――What pathetic softness.
Dead or not, they have human shapes.
They move like human beings.
For me, another human, to kill them feels decisively, irreparably wrong—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---How naive.
Even if they are corpses.
They have the shapes of humans, and they move like them.
It still seems mistaken to kill them as another human being----

entries.japanese:
「志貴―――！？」
　遠くで、死者たち三人を相手にしているアルクェイドの声がした。
　思わず、もう目の前に死者がいるっていうのに、声の方向に視線を移す。
―――と。
　そこには、信じがたい光景が広がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!?”
Arcueid calls from a distance, where she is fighting the other three.
Though a corpse is already before me, I turn toward her voice.
―――And see something
impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki---!?"
I hear Arcueid's voice as she deals with the other three Dead.
Without thinking, despite the one in front of me, I look over at her.
---And.
I see something terribly unbelievable.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　アルクェイドが、傷を負ってる。
　あんな緩慢な動きの、あいつだったらそれこそ一秒とかからずに仕留めてしまうような死者たち相手に、アルクェイドが追いこまれている。
　彼女の呼吸は荒い。
　足取りもおぼつかなくて、あんな―――俺でさえ簡単にやりすごせる死者の一撃を、まともにくらっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Arcueid is wounded.
These creatures are so slow that she should destroy them in less than a second, yet they are driving her back.
Her breathing is ragged, her steps unsteady.
Even blows I could evade with ease are striking her cleanly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Arcueid is wounded.
Even though they move so sluggishly and would only take her a second to kill, Arcueid is being pushed by those Dead.
She breathes heavily.
Her footwork is also unsteady---and she's having difficulty evading those attacks even I can evade.

entries.japanese:
どん、と死者の腕がアルクェイドの腕を引き裂く。
　アルクェィドの反撃。
　彼女は傷つけられた反動で死者の体を頭から腰まで、強引に二つに裂いた。
　地面に二つになって崩れ落ちる死者。
　同時に―――死者にわだかまっていた黒い死の波が、アルクェイドに乗り移っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
A corpse’s arm rips open Arcueid’s arm.
She retaliates with the force of the impact,
ripping its body apart from head to waist.
The two halves collapse to the ground.
At that same instant, the black tide of death pooled inside it pours into Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The Dead rips into her arm.
She counters.
She tears the body in two from the head to its waist.
Both halves crumble to the ground.
At the same time---the other waiting shades of death pounce on her.

entries.japanese:
「ア―――」
　がたり、とアルクェイドはひざまずいた。
　ここからでも解るぐらい、はあはあと呼吸を荒だたせて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—” Arcueid drops heavily to her knees,
panting hard enough for
me to hear from here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A---"
With a crash she lands on her knees.
I can tell she's breathing wildly from this distance.

entries.japanese:
そこへ―――二人の死者が襲いかかった。
　ひざまずいて動けないアルクェイドの顔を蹴りつけて、地面に倒れこませる。
「や―――」
　そのあとに、連中は。
　表情がないくせに、下卑た笑いをうかべて、アルクェイドの体にのしかかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The remaining two fall upon her.
They kick her in the face while she kneels helplessly, knocking her to the ground.
“No—”
Then, though their faces hold no expression,
they wear leering smiles as they throw themselves on top of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There---the two Dead attack.

They kick her kneeling figure in the face and makes her collapse on the ground.
"St---"
After that,
they carry a dull, expressionless smile as they get on top of her.

entries.japanese:
「やめ―――」
　……十字架に張りつけるみたいに。
　昨日の夜、俺が、そうして彼女を陵辱した時みたいに。
「やめろ、てめえら―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop—”
…They pin her as though to a cross.
Just as I pinned her when I raped her last night.
“Get off her, you bastards!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop---"
…… She lies there arms outspread like a cross.
Like when I did those disgraceful things to her last night.
"Stop it, you fucking bastards---!"

entries.japanese:
トスン。
　後ろから噛みついてきていた死者の顔を切断する。
　俺の目の前でなぜか停止していた死者の左下腹部を突く。
　そこが死者の『死』だ。
　ざあ、と音をたてて崩れ落ちる死者を見る事もせず、振り返って顔のない死者も、殺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thk.
I slice through the face of the corpse biting me from behind.
