「だって彼女は余分な事はしないんです。
　昔から―――もう何百年も昔から、彼女はそうやって生きてきた。
あの山間の古城に生を受けた時から、ずっと永遠に変わることなく」
entries.maoEnglish:
“She never does anything unnecessary.
That is how she has lived for centuries, ever since she was born in that old castle in the mountains—unchanging, forever.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because she never does anything extra.
From long ago---for the past hundreds of years, she has lived that way.
Ever since she was born in the old castle amongst the mountains, never changing."

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　心臓の音と、暗い眩暈。
　……どういう事だろう。
　知らないはずの景色、見えないはずの記憶が、くらりと視界に広がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
My heartbeat, and a plunge into darkness.
…What was happening?
Places I had never known, memories I could never have seen, reeled across my vision.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
My heartbeat, and this dark dizziness.
…… What is this?
This unknown scenery, these memories I've never had, they start to fill my vision.

entries.japanese:
広い、城の中庭。
　ただあるものは飾り気のない野原だけという、一人きりの城のなか。
　白い彼女は、ただぼんやりと空を見上げている。
entries.maoEnglish:
A vast castle courtyard.
An empty castle whose only ornament was a plain field of grass.
Alone in it, the girl in white gazed absently up at the sky.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The wide, castle courtyard.
The unadorned grassy field inside the solitary castle.
The white girl stares blankly up at the sky.

entries.japanese:
「彼女には余分な知識も、目的以外のことを許された自由もありませんでした。
　倒すべき対象が決定された時だけ、彼女は外に出されるんです。
　その時の相手に応じた知識を教え込まれて、確実に敵を処刑できるように」
entries.maoEnglish:
“She was allowed neither needless knowledge nor any freedom beyond her assigned purpose.
Only when a target had been selected was she released into the world.
She would be taught whatever was required for that particular enemy, so that the execution could not fail.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"She did not have any extra knowledge, or freedom beyond what was needed for her purpose.
She only goes outside when her target is determined.
She gets taught only the information needed to definitely destroy the enemy."

entries.japanese:
誰もいない。
　話すべき相手もいない。
　顔を合わせる相手もいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
No one else was there.
No one to speak to.
No one whose face she might see.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No one is there.

No one to talk to.
Not even another face to see.

entries.japanese:
「定められた吸血鬼を殺して城に帰ってきた彼女は、教え込まれた知識を全て洗い流されて眠りにつかされます。
　何もしらないまま、吸血鬼を殺すという事以外は知らないままで」
entries.maoEnglish:
“After killing the appointed vampire and returning to the castle, every scrap of knowledge she had been given was washed away, and she was put back to sleep.
She knew nothing—nothing except how to kill vampires.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After killing her target and when she returns to the castle, her taught knowledge is washed out and she is taken to sleep.
Without knowing anything, nothing other than killing vampires."

entries.japanese:
何もない。
　誰かと話をするという楽しみとか。
　誰かと顔をあわせておはようって言いあうことの大切さとか。
　そんなものは、彼女の存在から排除されつくしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nothing.
The pleasure of talking to someone.
The precious little ritual of meeting another person’s eyes and saying good morning.
Every such thing had been stripped from her existence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's nothing.
Such as the fun of speaking with someone else.
The precious moments of seeing someone else and greeting them.
She was excluded from all of it.

entries.japanese:
「彼女の力は堕ちた真祖たちさえ滅ぼせるほど強力だった。
……けど、皮肉ですよね。
あまりに強大すぎる能力が災いして、彼女は真祖の間でも疎まれていたんです。
　姫とたたえていながら、誰も彼女には近寄らなかった。
　城を与えられていながら、彼女の世界は薄暗い地下室だけだった。
　だから、彼女に感情を与えてくれるモノは他のどこにもいなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Her power was great enough to destroy even fallen True Ancestors. …Ironically, that very power made the others shun her.
They praised her as a princess, but no one dared approach.
They gave her a castle, yet her entire world was a dim underground chamber.
There was no one, anywhere, who might teach her what it meant to feel.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Her power was strong enough to defeat the fallen True Ancestors.
…… But, it's ironic.
She was so powerful that she was shunned by the rest of the True Ancestors.
Even while praising her as the princess, no one approached her.
Even while giving her a castle, her world was only the dark basement.
So there was nothing to give her any feelings."

entries.japanese:
それは。
　むしろ生きている事が哀れに思えるぐらい。
　滑稽な、生の在りかた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A way of living so absurd that
merely being alive
seemed pitiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's,
almost enough to make me pity her for living.
A parody of life.

entries.japanese:
「彼女には自分の言葉も、自由になる時間もなかったそうです。
――真祖たちは兵器の手入れをするような気持ちで彼女を扱っていたんでしょうね。
　兵器には余分な機能は必要ないですから。
パンを焼く機能も、洗濯物を洗ってくれる機能もいりません。
　そんな余分なものを付属させるなら、もっと兵器らしい機能を付属させるでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m told she had neither words of her own nor a moment she could call her own. The True Ancestors must have treated her the way one maintains a weapon.
Weapons have no need for superfluous functions. There is no point teaching one to bake bread or wash clothes.
If you were going to add anything at all, you would give it a function more appropriate to a weapon, wouldn’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"She apparently had no words or even time of her own.
--The True Ancestors treated her only as a weapon.
A weapon has no need for extra functions, such as baking bread or doing laundry.
If you're going to put on extra functions, you would put on something more fit for a weapon, right?"

entries.japanese: ――余分なコトはしちゃいけないんだなって、ずっと教えられてきたの。
entries.maoEnglish: ――All my life, they taught me I mustn’t do anything unnecessary.
entries.mirrorMoon: --I was always taught never to do extra things.

entries.japanese:
あいつは、そう、歌うように言っていた。
　今まで自分だけで全てを決めてきたと、空虚な目をしていた理由。
　だから、他者はいらなかったのか。
　いや、単に知らなかっただけなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
She had said it almost like a song.
Now I understood the emptiness in her eyes when she told me she had always decided everything alone.
Was that why she had needed no one else?
No—had she simply never known there could be anyone else?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, she has said that before.
The reason for deciding everything for herself, for having those empty eyes.
That's why she never needed anyone else.
No, maybe she never knew about it.

entries.japanese:
「真祖たちが彼女に求めたものは、ただ性能のいい殺傷能力だけだったんです。
　だから、彼女は何も知らない。
生きている意味とは何か、なんて大きなものじゃなくて、生きてるっていうことの当たり前の楽しさを知ることができない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The True Ancestors wanted only one thing from her: the ability to kill efficiently.
So she knows nothing. Not grand questions like the meaning of life—she cannot even know the simple, ordinary pleasure of being alive.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"All they wanted of her was to be a superior killing machine.
That's why she doesn't know anything.
I don't mean something big like the meaning of life, but not even the small joy of just living normally."

entries.japanese:
あいつは、いつもあんなに陽気で。
　些細なことでも嬉しそうに笑っていた。
　だからもとからああいうヤツなんだと思ってた。
entries.maoEnglish:
She was always so cheerful.
The smallest thing could make her smile with delight.
I had assumed that was simply the way she had always been.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She was always so cheerful.
Even trivial things made her so happy.
So I thought she was always like that.

entries.japanese:
……なんて残酷な勘違いだったんだろう。
　あいつは、ただ―――そんな当たり前のことが、本当に楽しくて。
　自分でもその、わからないぐらいに楽しかったに違いない。
entries.maoEnglish:
…What a cruel mistake.
Those ordinary little things truly delighted her—more deeply,
perhaps, than she herself could ever understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… But I was horribly wrong.
She really was---just enjoying those simple things.
She must have enjoyed those things so much.

entries.japanese:
―――だって、すごく楽しいんだもの。
　生きているっていうのがただそれだけで嬉しいなんて、今まで考えたこともなかったよ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Because it’s so much fun.
I never knew that simply being alive could make me this happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Because it's so fun.
I never thought about how life could be fun just by living.

entries.japanese:
それが理解できない不安のように。
　控えめな声で相談してきた、夕暮れの教室。
entries.maoEnglish:
The classroom at sunset.
Her quiet voice, confiding in me as though her own incomprehensible happiness frightened her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Like it was an uneasiness she couldn't understand,
The classroom filled with the red setting sun where she asked me those questions with a reserved voice.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイドは長く長く存在しているくせに、生きるという意味合いをわたしたちより知り得ていない。
　彼女が行動を許されていたのは、活動時間に換算すると驚くほど短いんです。
　彼女の生涯は、ほぼ全てが睡眠だった。
　それもおそらくは、闇のような眠りだったんだと思います」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid has existed for an age, yet understands what it means to live far less than we do.
The total time she was allowed to spend awake
and acting for herself is astonishingly brief.
Almost her entire life was sleep—and I imagine it was a sleep as black as darkness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Even though Arcueid has existed for so long, she knows less about living than we do.
If you convert it to the time she was allowed to move freely, it is amazingly short.
Her lifetime was spent almost entirely in sleep.
Most likely a deep, dark sleep."

entries.japanese:
―――そう？
　わたしは話してるだけで楽しいんだけどなあ。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Really? I have fun just talking to you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Really?
I have enough fun just talking, you know.

entries.japanese:
「堕ちた真祖たちを全て処断したあと、彼女は城から出る事がなくなりました。
いちおうの目的が済んだわけですから、真祖たちも彼女をまともに教育しようとしたんです。
　けれど、彼女は自由にはなれなかった。
本当に些細な間違いで、城に残った真祖たちを、彼女はすべて殺してしまったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Once she had executed every fallen True Ancestor, she ceased leaving the castle. Her original purpose had been fulfilled, so the others attempted to educate her properly.
But freedom never came. Because of one truly trivial mistake, she killed every True Ancestor remaining in the castle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After dealing with all the fallen True Ancestors, she did not leave the castle.
Having fulfilled her purpose, the True Ancestors sought to educate her properly.
However, she could not be free.
Because of a slight mistake, she ended up killing all the True Ancestors remaining in the castle."

entries.japanese:
吸血鬼殺しだけを教えられたモノは、律儀に、きちんと命令通りに、最後まで仕事を果たしてしまったのかもしれない。
　一人残って、結局、あいつは。
entries.maoEnglish:
A creature taught nothing but the killing of vampires may simply have obeyed her orders with perfect diligence and carried the work through to its end.
And when she was left alone, in the end, she…
entries.mirrorMoon:
Maybe the one that was taught how to kill vampires really did finish her job until the very end.
In the end, she was left alone.

entries.japanese:
「真祖たちを一人のこらず処刑したあとで、彼女は自分から城に閉じこもりました。
もう誰もいなくなった真祖たちの城の真ん中で、城壁から伸びた千の鎖に繋がれて。
　ロアという吸血鬼が転生するたびに、眠りから覚めてわずかな間だけ活動する」
entries.maoEnglish:
“After executing every last True Ancestor, she shut herself inside the castle of her own accord. In the heart of that empty stronghold, a thousand chains from its walls bound her in place.
Whenever the vampire Roa reincarnated, she would wake and act for only a little while.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After killing all the True Ancestors, she sealed herself up in the castle.
In the empty castle of the True Ancestors, bound with a thousand chains.
Whenever Roa is reborn, she awakens from her sleep and moves around for a short time."

entries.japanese:
その定められた世界の中で。
　ただの一言も、言葉を口にすることがなかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Within that ordained, unchanging world,
she never once spoke a single word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the middle of that fixed world,
She never said a single word.

entries.japanese:
「だから、彼女は根っからの処刑人なんです。
　自分を縛っていた真祖たちがいなくなったっていうのに、まだ吸血鬼殺しだけを目的にして徘徊してる。
　きっと、彼女にはそれ以外の楽しみがないんでしょうね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is why she is an executioner to her very core.
The True Ancestors who bound her are gone, yet she still wanders the world with no purpose but killing vampires.
Perhaps she simply has no other pleasure.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why she is a killer down to her very core.
Even though the True Ancestors which bound her are now gone, she still wanders around with the sole purpose of killing vampires.
She probably does not have any other fun."

entries.japanese:
それは、うそだ。
　あいつが喜んでいたのは、そんなコトじゃないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
That was a lie.
Killing vampires wasn’t what had made her happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's… a lie.
That's not what made her happy.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　俺は、何も見てなかった。
「――――だ」
　あいつの言葉とか、喜ぶ顔とか。
　もっとよく見ていてやれば―――わかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I hadn’t seen anything.
“……Lie.”
Her words. The joy in her face.
If only I had looked a little more closely—I would have understood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I wasn't… watching anything.
"----it."
Like her words, or her happy face.
If only I looked closer----I would have known.

entries.japanese:
「―――――そ、だ」
　あいつが今までどんなに独りだったか、気づけなかった。
　俺たちが当たり前みたいに感じてること。
　気の合う友人と何の価値もないばか話をして、なんとなく時間を忘れる程度の楽しさとか。
　一日の終わり、ばたんとベッドに横になって、ただのんびりとした時間を過ごす時のあんまり大事に思えないような安らぎとか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……A lie.”
I had never noticed how utterly alone she had always been.
All the things we take for granted.
Losing track of time while trading worthless jokes with a friend who understands you.
The unremarkable peace of falling onto your bed at the end of the day and doing nothing for a while.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----of it."
I never realized how alone she was until now.
All the things we feel and take for granted.
Such as talking with a friend about meaningless things or the fun that lets you forget time.
At the end of a day, lying down on a bed and the peacefulness of just staring at the ceiling.

entries.japanese: そんなどうでもいいことが、あいつにとっては、本当にかけがえのない倖せだったなんて。
entries.maoEnglish: To think those meaningless little things had been irreplaceable happiness to her.
entries.mirrorMoon: To her, those unimportant things were priceless moments of happiness.

entries.japanese:
「―――――うそ、だ」
　なにが悲惨かって―――それは、あいつ自身が、自分がどんなに哀れなのかっていうコトを、これっぽっちも感じてないっていうこと。
　そんな酷い――そんな道化みたいな孤独が、あってたまるか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……It’s a lie.”
And the most wretched part was this—she herself had never felt even the faintest pity for how she had lived.
No one should have to endure loneliness so cruel—so absurd.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----all of it."
What is misery?
It's her not even knowing how miserable she is.
Such a terrible--almost comical solitude should not exist.

entries.japanese:
「―――――全部、うそだ」
　……もう、難しいことなんてどうでもいい。
　ただ、あいつが当たり前のことを、倖せなんだって感じずに。
　そんなもの、いつだって手に入る当たり前のことなんだって、感じられるようにしてやれたのなら、それはどんなに――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all a lie.”
…I didn’t care about the complicated details anymore.
If only I could give her enough that she no longer had to call ordinary things happiness—so she could take them for granted,
certain they would always be there—how wonderful that would be…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Lies, all of it."
…… Enough with all these difficult things.
I never knew she felt such happiness from trivial things.
If I could let her know that such things were things she could always enjoy, that would have been such a great----

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん――――？」
　先輩の声で、視界がはっきりとした。
「どうしたんですか？
　急にぼんやりしちゃって、わたしの話聞いてました？」
「いや―――ごめん、記憶にない。
先輩が話してたようにも聞こえたし、他の誰かが話してるようにも聞こえてた」
　はあ、と先輩は納得いかなそうに頷く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno…?”
Her voice snapped the world back into focus.
“What’s wrong? You suddenly went blank. Were you listening to me?”
“No—sorry. I don’t remember. Sometimes it sounded like you were speaking, and sometimes it sounded like someone else.”
Ciel gave a doubtful sigh and nodded.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun----?"
Her voice returns my vision to normal.
"What's wrong?
You suddenly went quiet and spaced out.
Were you listening?"
"No---sorry, I don't remember.
I heard you speaking, but it felt like someone else was talking."
Senpai nods doubtfully.

entries.japanese:
「えっと、つまりですね、彼女は――――」
「いいよ。
アルクェイドが何をしていようが、どんなヤツであろうがどうでもいい。
　これ以上あいつを一人にしておけないから、そろそろ行くよ」
　先輩に背を向けて、夜の街に向かって歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, what I’m saying is that she—” “That’s enough.
I don’t care what Arcueid has done or what she is.
I can’t leave her alone any longer, so I’m going.”
I turned my back on her and started toward the city at night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, in other words, she----"
"It's okay.
I don't care what she did or what she's like.
I can't leave her alone any longer, so I'll be going."
Turning away from Senpai, I start to walk towards the city.

entries.japanese:
「―――遠野くん。
一度吸血衝動を抑えられなかった真祖は、絶対に立ち直れない。
もし彼女が貴方の前に現れたとしたら、それは貴方の血を吸いに来た、というコトです」
　先輩の台詞は、きっと、彼女にとっての真実だと思う。
　けど、それは俺のとは違う真実だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. Once a True Ancestor loses control of the vampiric impulse, there is no recovery. If she appears before you again, it will be because she has come to drink your blood.”
I was sure that, for her, those words were the truth.
But her truth was not mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Tohno-kun.
Once a True Ancestor fails to suppress the vampiric impulse, there is no hope for recovery.
If she appears in front of you, it means she came to drink your blood."
I think what she says is the truth for her.
But it's a different truth than mine.

entries.japanese:
「そんなコトないよ。
だって、アルクェイドはまだ血を吸ってないんだから」
「いいえ。
わたしが止めていなければ、遠野くんは吸われていました」
「……違う。
だって、止まったんだ。
アルクェイドは大丈夫だったんだよ。
だから――先輩があいつを弾き飛ばさなくても、結果は変わりはしなかったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s not true. Arcueid still hasn’t drunk anyone’s blood.”
“If I hadn’t stopped her, she would have drunk yours.”
“……No. She stopped. Arcueid was all right. So—even if you hadn’t knocked her away, nothing would have changed.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's not true.
Because she hasn't drunk blood yet."
"No.
If I had not have stopped her, she would have drunk your blood."
"…… You're wrong, because she stopped.
Arcueid was fine.
That's why even if you didn't stop her, the result would have been the same."

entries.japanese:
そう、たしかに。
　ちゃんと、アルクェイドの牙は止まっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes. I knew it.
Arcueid’s fangs had stopped.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, certainly.
She stopped right then.

entries.japanese:
「……あくまで彼女の味方をする、というんですね、志貴くん」
「ああ。
先輩には悪いけど」
　先輩は答えない。
　ただ、ため息だけが聞こえた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……So you mean to stand by her no matter what, Shiki?”
“Yeah. Sorry, but I am.”
She made no reply.
I thought I heard only a sigh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So you're going to be on her side no matter what, Tohno-kun?"
"Yeah.
Sorry, Senpai."
Senpai doesn't answer.
I think I hear her sigh.

entries.japanese:
「―――わたしたち、争うことになるかもしれませんね」
「そうだね。
けど、俺は謝らないからな、先輩」
「……………」
　先輩からの返答はない。
ただ、気配が遠くなっていく。
　去っていく足音。
それに振り向かず、そのまま夜の街へ走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We may find ourselves fighting one another.”
“Maybe. But I’m not going to apologize.” “……”
No answer came.
Her presence simply receded, followed by the sound of departing footsteps.
Without looking back, I ran into the night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---We may end up fighting, you know."
"Maybe.
But, I won't apologize, Senpai."
"……………"
There's no response from Senpai.
Just her presence getting farther away.
Disappearing footsteps.
Without turning around, I head towards town, shrouded by night.

entries.japanese:
―――大通りに人影はない。
　アルクェイドの姿はおろか、道を行く人々の姿さえ見られない。
「く――――――」
　これじゃ昨日の夜とまったく同じだ。
　俺にはアルクェイドを見つけ出す手段がない。
　いま、こんなにもあいつに会いたいっていうのに、俺にはなんの手段もない。
―――あいつが。
　あいつが、あんなにも苦しそうだったっていうのに、俺には、何の手助けも、できない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The main avenue was deserted.
Not only was Arcueid nowhere to be seen, there wasn’t another pedestrian in sight.
“Damn…”
It was exactly like last night.
I had no way to find her.
Even now, when I wanted so desperately to see her, I had no way at all.
―――She.
She had been suffering so badly, and there was nothing, nothing I could do to help her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---There's no one on the main street.
Not Arcueid, not even just regular people.
"Damn------"
This is the same as last night.
I don't have any way of finding her.
Right now, even though I want to see her so badly, I don't have any means.
---She,
Even though she's in so much pain, I can't help her, at all----

entries.japanese:
「――――くそぉ！」
　心が苛立ってどうにかしてしまいそうだ。
　なんとかして―――なんとかしてあいつを探し出さないと、もう、遠野志貴は一歩だって前に進めない―――
「はあ……はあ……はあ……」
　街中を走り回っても、アルクェイドの姿はない。
　体は疲れきって、呼吸も満足に定まらない。
「はあ……はあ……はあ―――」
　胸の傷が、どくんどくんと心臓に負担をかける。
　今ほど―――このポンコツみたいな体が恨めしいと思ったことはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it!”
The frustration was driving me out of my mind.
Somehow—I had to find her somehow, or Shiki Tohno would never be able to take another step forward—
“Hah… hah… hah…”
I had run all over the city without finding Arcueid.
My body was spent, my breathing hopelessly ragged.
“Hah… hah… hah…”
The wound in my chest throbbed with every tortured beat of my heart.
Never had I hated this broken-down body more.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Damn it!"
I'm so irritated, it drives me nuts.
Somehow---I have to find her somehow, or else I can't move forward---
I gasp painfully.
Even though I ran all through the city, I don't see her.
My body is exhausted, and I can't get enough air.
I breathe harder.
The scar on my chest throbs with my heartbeat.
Until now---I've never hated this fragile body this much.

entries.japanese:
「はあ……はあ……は……あ」
　………見つからない。
　ただ闇雲に走り回るだけじゃ、あいつを見つけることなんて出来ない。
「……は………あ」
　もし。
もしあいつを見つけられるとしたら、それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… hah… ha… ah…”
…I couldn’t find her.
Running blindly through the city would never lead me to her.
“…Hah… ah…”
If there was any place where I might find her, it would be—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hungrily breathe in air.
…… I can't find her.
I won't find her just running around aimlessly like this.
I struggle for breath.
If, if I have any chance of finding her, it would be---

entries.japanese:
―――昨日、アルクェイドが走り去った先の路地裏に行ってみよう。
　あいつが人目を逃れて行く先は、とりあえず路地裏しか思いつかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll try the alley Arcueid ran toward yesterday.
If she wants to go somewhere unseen, an alley is the only place I can think of.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'll check in the alley she was in last night.
If she's running away from people, that's the only place I can think of.

entries.japanese:
「……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……！」
　公園から全速力でやってきた。
　無理な運動をしているせいだろう、さっきから心臓が悲鳴をあげている。
　それを無視して、一刻でも早く、アルクェイドの姿を見つけるために走り続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah—!”
I sprinted here from the park at full speed.
My heart had been screaming since I began this reckless run.
I ignored it and kept running, desperate to find Arcueid even one second sooner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I still have no control over my breathing.
I run with all my strength from the park.
My heart screams from overexertion.
Ignoring it, I continue to run to find her as soon as possible.

entries.japanese:
「――――アルクェイド！」
　路地裏に辿り着くなり、ただ無心で名前を呼んだ。
「いるんだろ、出てこいよアルクェイド……！」
　月の下、路地裏に俺の声だけが響き渡る。
「……アルクェイド……！
　頼むから出てきてくれ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid!”
The instant I reach the alley, I shout her name without thinking.
“You’re here, aren’t you? Come out, Arcueid…!”
Beneath the moon, only my voice echoes between the walls.
“…Arcueid…! Please, just come out…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Arcueid!"
As soon as I get to the alley, I call out her name.
"You're here, aren't you?
Come out, Arcueid……!"
Under the moonlight, my solitary voice echoes in the alley.
"…… Arcueid……!
Please, come out……!"

entries.japanese:
……返事はない。
　ここにあるのは、ただ無人という寂しさだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
No answer.
Only the desolation of an empty alley remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There's no response.
There's only an empty loneliness here.

entries.japanese:
「くっ…………！」
　ここにアルクェイドはいない。
　けど、それじゃあ他に何処があるっていうんだ。
　闇雲に捜してもアルクェイドを見つける事なんてできない。
　俺は、このまま――――二度と、アルクェイドには会えないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn…!”
Arcueid is not here.
But if not here, then where else can she be?
I will never find her by searching at random.
Is this how it ends? Will I never see Arcueid again?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn…………!"
Arcueid isn't here.
Then where else is there?
I can't find her running around aimlessly.
At this rate I'll never----never see her again.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――っ」
　いや、まだだ。
　まだ俺はアルクェイドと約束を果たしていない。
　吸血鬼を倒す手伝いをするっていう事も、今夜も、二人で待ち合わせて戦おうっていう約束も。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!” No.
Not yet.
I still have promises to keep with Arcueid.
I promised to help her defeat the vampire. I promised we would meet tonight and fight together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
No, I'm not done yet.
I still haven't fulfilled my promise with Arcueid.
The promise to help her defeat the vampire, and the promise to meet tonight so we can fight together.

entries.japanese:
「……約……束……」
　……そうか。
まだ、約束が残っている。
　ここで途方にくれているのなら、俺は―――俺だけでも、約束を守らないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Prom…ise…”
Of course. The promise still remains.
If standing here helplessly will accomplish nothing, then I have to keep it—even if I must keep it alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Pro…… mise……"
…… That's right.
There's still our promise.
Even if it's just one-sided, I----even if it's just me, I'll fulfill our promise.

entries.japanese:
公園に戻ってきた。
　ここにはまだ約束が残っている。
　果たされてない今夜の約束が残っている。
―――だから。
　俺にとってこの約束が反古できないもので、アルクェイドもそれを大事に思っていてくれるなら。
　あいつはここに帰ってくる。
　それを信じて、今はもう待ち続けることしかできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to the park.
Our promise still lives here—the promise
for tonight that we have yet to fulfill.
―――So if this promise is something I cannot break,
and if Arcueid treasures it too—
then she will come back here.
All I can do now is believe that and wait.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the park.
Our promise still remains here.
Our unfulfilled promise for tonight remains here.
----So,
If I can't break this promise, and if she thinks it's important too,
Arcueid will come back here.
I can only continue to believe in her and wait here.

entries.japanese:
……ここに、残ろう。
　約束なんだ。
ここで待ち合わせるっていう約束があるんだ。
　俺たちは、まだ今夜の約束を果たしてない。
　ここで待ち合わせて、一緒に戦おうっていうことをしていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I’ll stay here.
We made a promise to meet here.
We still have not fulfilled tonight’s promise—we have
not met at this place and gone to fight together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'll stay here.
We promised.
We promised to meet here.
We still haven't fulfilled our promise for tonight.
To meet here, and to fight together.

entries.japanese:
―――だから。
　俺にとってこの約束が反古できないもので、アルクェイドもそれを大事に思っていてくれるなら。
　あいつはここに帰ってくる。
　それを信じて、今はもう待ち続けることしかできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――So if this promise is something I cannot break,
and if Arcueid treasures it too—
then she will come back here.
All I can do now is believe that and wait.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----So,
If I can't break this promise, and if she thinks it's important too,
Arcueid will come back here.
I can only continue to believe in her and wait here.

entries.japanese:
―――アルクェイドの部屋に行こう。
　先輩が言うようにアルクェイドが弱っているのなら、自分の部屋に戻って体を休めるか何かするはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll go to Arcueid’s apartment.
If Arcueid was as weak as Ciel said, she should have returned to her room to rest or recover somehow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'll go to Arcueid's room.
If Arcueid is as weak as Senpai says, she had to have returned to her room to rest.

entries.japanese:
「―――――は」
　ここまで全力で走ってきた足が止まった。
　はぁ、はぁ、という乱れに乱れた自分の呼吸をなんとか整えながら、マンションの中に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—” My legs, which carried me here at a dead sprint, finally stop.
Fighting to steady my ragged breathing,
I enter the apartment building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I gasp for air.
My legs, which ran as hard as they could, finally stop.
Trying to catch my breath, I enter the apartment.

entries.japanese:
……ドアのノブに手をかける。
　ドアに鍵はかかっていない。
　ためらわずにノブを回してドアを開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I put my hand on her doorknob.
It is unlocked.
Without hesitating, I turn it and open the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I grab the doorknob.
It isn't locked.
Without hesitating, I turn it and open the door.

entries.japanese:
……鍵がかかっていなかったのに、部屋の中には誰もいなかった。
「アルクェイド……いないのか？」
　返事はない。
　もとから鍵をかける習慣のないヤツなのか、アルクェイドが部屋に戻ってきた痕跡はなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The door was unlocked, yet no one was inside.
“Arcueid… aren’t you here?”
No answer.
Perhaps she was simply the sort of person who never locked her door. There was no sign that Arcueid had come back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Even though it wasn't locked, there's no one here.

"Arcueid…… are you here?"
There's no response.
Does she never lock her door?
There's no sign of her having even returned here.

entries.japanese:
「くっ……それじゃまだ街にいるっていうのか、アイツは……！」
　だん、と壁を叩く。
　だがそんな八つ当たりをしたところでアルクェイドが出てきてくれるハズもない。
「……どこに……どこに行ってるんだよ、アルクェイド……！」
―――本当に、神様がいるんだったらすがりたい気分だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it… Does that mean she’s still somewhere in the city…?”
I slam my fist into the wall.
Taking my anger out on it will hardly make Arcueid appear.
“…Where are you…? Where did you go, Arcueid…?”
―――If there really is a god, I feel like begging for help.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn…… Then she's still in town……!?"
I hit the wall.
But letting it out on the wall is not going to get Arcueid to come out.
"…… Where did you go…… where did you go, Arcueid……!?"
------If there really is a God, I want to ask him for help.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドはここにはいない。
　だからって街を闇雲に捜してもアルクェイドを見つける事なんてできない。
　俺は、このまま――――二度と、アルクェイドには会えないのか。
「―――――――っ」
　いや、まだだ。
　まだ俺はアルクェイドと約束を果たしていない。
　吸血鬼を倒す手伝いをするっていう事も、今夜も、二人で待ち合わせて戦おうっていう約束も。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid is not here.
Yet searching the city blindly will never lead me to her.
Is this how it ends? Will I never see Arcueid again?
“—!” No.
Not yet.
I still have promises to keep with Arcueid: to help her defeat the vampire, and to meet her tonight so that we can fight together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid isn't here.
But I can't find her just running around aimlessly.
At this rate I'll never----never see her again.
"------"
No, I'm not done yet.
I still haven't fulfilled my promise with Arcueid.
The promise to help her defeat the vampire, and the promise to meet tonight so we can fight together.

entries.japanese:
「……約……束……」
　……そうか。
まだ、約束が残っている。
　ここで途方にくれているのなら、俺は―――俺だけでも、約束を守らないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Prom…ise…”
Of course. The promise still remains.
If standing here helplessly will accomplish nothing, then I have to keep it—even if I must keep it alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Pro…… mise……"
…… That's right.
There's still our promise.
Even if it's just one-sided, I----even if it's just me, I'll fulfill our promise.

entries.japanese:
公園に戻ってきた。
　ここにはまだ約束が残っている。
　果たされてない今夜の約束が残っている。
―――だから。
　俺にとってこの約束が反古できないもので、アルクェイドもそれを大事に思っていてくれるなら。
　あいつはここに帰ってくる。
　それを信じて、今はもう待ち続けることしかできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to the park.
Our promise still lives here—the promise
for tonight that we have yet to fulfill.
―――So if this promise is something I cannot break,
and if Arcueid treasures it too—
then she will come back here.
All I can do now is believe that and wait.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the park.
Our promise still remains here.
Our unfulfilled promise for tonight remains here.
----So,
If I can't break this promise, and if she thinks it's important too,
Arcueid will come back here.
I can only continue to believe in her and wait here.

entries.japanese:
時間が過ぎていく。
　時計の針は正確に、意思などなく、丁寧に秒を刻む。
「―――――――」
　こんな時間、息がつまる。
　体はたったの一分だって待っていられない。
　ボウ、と白痴のように佇んでいるだけなら、今すぐに走り出して、あいつを探しださなくっちゃ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time passes.
The clock’s hands, exact and indifferent, parcel out each second with care.
“—”
This waiting suffocates me.
My body cannot endure another minute.
If I am only going to stand here in a witless daze, I should run out now and find her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Time passes by.
The clock ticks mechanically, recording the passing of each second.
"--------"
I feel like I'm drowning.
My body doesn't want to wait a minute longer.
Just sitting here waiting seems like the utmost in idiocy and I want to run off and search for her again.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　なのに、心は落ち着いている。
　一分だって待っていられないぐらい体は急いているのに、気持ちは落ち着いている。
　夜の中、月だけを見つめて待ち続ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
And yet my heart is calm.
Even while my body strains forward, unable to wait another minute, my feelings remain perfectly still.
I keep watch beneath the night sky, gazing only at the moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
But, my heart is calm.
Even though my body urges me to hurry, my heart remains calm.
I continue waiting, staring up at the moon.

entries.japanese:
―――ひどく、静かだ。
　どんな音もない、なにもかもが凍ったような夜。
　まるで世界に自分とアルクェイド以外は誰もいなくなったような静けさ。
　そんな中で待ち続けられるのなら、いつまでも、何時間だって苦痛じゃない。
　だから、こんな時間。
　幸福で、息がつまる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It is terribly quiet.
A soundless night, as though everything has frozen.
The silence makes it seem as if Arcueid and I are the only two people left in the world.
If I can wait for her here, then no number of hours could hurt me.
That is why I can bear this waiting.
The happiness is almost suffocating.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It's horribly quiet.
No sounds, as if the night froze everything.
A quiet stillness as if Arcueid and I were the only ones in the entire world.
If I can stay in such a place, then it isn't painful at all to wait for any amount of time.
So, right now,
I'm drowning in bliss.

entries.japanese:
時間だけが過ぎていく。
　夜明けまではあと二時間ぐらい。
　夜が明けてしまったら、アルクェイドも今の自分も、二度とは訪れはしないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only time moves on.
Dawn is perhaps two hours away.
Once it comes, neither Arcueid nor the person I am tonight will ever return.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Only time passes by.
Just two hours until dawn.
If the day breaks, Arcueid and I will probably never see each other again.

entries.japanese:
そうして時間だけが過ぎていって。
　それこそ雪原で白いうさぎに出会うように、
　彼女はひょっこりと公園にやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
And so time alone slips by.
Then, as unexpectedly as spotting a white rabbit in a field of snow,
she appears in the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And time just passes by.
And then like a white rabbit in the snow,
she unexpectedly arrives in the park.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　アルクェイドは何も言わない。
　目を伏せたまま、決してこちらに近寄ろうとしない。
「――――アルクェイド」
　声をかける。
　アルクェイドは返事はおろか、俺を見ようともしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid says nothing.
Her eyes remain lowered, and she makes no move to approach me.
“Arcueid.”
I call to her.
She neither answers nor even looks my way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Arcueid doesn't say anything.
With downcast eyes, she doesn't make a move to come closer.
"----Arcueid."
I call out to her.
She doesn't respond or even look in my direction.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　言葉がかけられない。
　なんて言えばあいつをまた笑顔に戻せるのか、俺にはわからない。
　今は。
なにを口にしても、あいつをよけい悲しませるだけになりそうで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I can find no words.
I don’t know what might bring her smile back.
Not now. Anything I say seems likely only to make her sadder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
I can't speak.
I don't know what I can say to make her smile again.
Right now, I feel like any words coming out of my mouth will only make her sadder.

entries.japanese:
………。
　…………………。
　………………………………。
　錯覚には永遠にも感じられる時間。
　実際ではおそらく千に満たない秒針が動いて。
　アルクェイドは、何か眩しいものを見るような仕草で顔をあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
…
…
…
The silence feels eternal.
In truth, fewer than a thousand seconds probably pass.
Then Arcueid raises her face as though looking into some dazzling light.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………
………………
………………………
Time seems to stretch to eternity.
In reality, the ticking of the clock can't have happened even close to a thousand times.
Arcueid lifts her head, looking like she's watching a dream.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、いつまでも帰らないんだもの。
放っておけなくて来ちゃったわ。
……ほんとは、このまま部屋に帰ろうって思ってたのに」
　口調は、ところどころつぎはぎだらけだったけど、とりあえず普段の彼女と同じ明るさだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You wouldn’t go home, Shiki. I couldn’t just leave you here, so I came. Though I had meant to go straight back to my room.”
Her delivery is patched together in places, but for the moment she manages something like her usual brightness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You wouldn't go home at all, Shiki.
So I came here because I couldn't leave you alone.
…… Even though I really was thinking of going back to my room."
She hesitates as she speaks, but she says this in her usual cheerful manner.

entries.japanese:
「……そりゃあ帰らないよ。
おまえとの約束は破らないって言っただろ。
今夜はまだ、おまえの手助けをしてないじゃないか」
「―――いいよ。
もう、そんなのはいいの」
「いいって――なにがいいんだ、アルクェイド……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I couldn’t go home. I told you I wouldn’t break my promise. I still haven’t helped you tonight.”
“—It’s all right. None of that matters anymore.”
“What do you mean, it doesn’t matter, Arcueid—?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Of course I wouldn't go back.
Didn't I say I'd keep my promise?
I still haven't been any help tonight."
"----That's enough.
You don't have to do that anymore."
"Enough?--Just what's enough, Arcueid……!?"

entries.japanese:
「言うまでもないでしょう。
やっぱりわたしは吸血鬼で、志貴は人間だっていうことよ。
　わたしは志貴に助けてもらう資格なんてなかった。
そんなことも解らないで、もうすこしで志貴を台無しにしてしまうところだった。
　だから―――」
　もういいの、と彼女は呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You know what I mean. I’m a vampire, and you’re human.
I never had the right to ask for your help. I was too blind even to see that, and I nearly ruined you.
So…”
It doesn’t matter anymore, she whispers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Doesn't it go without saying?
It's just that I'm a vampire and you're a human, Shiki.
I didn't have any right to receive help from you.
I didn't understand that earlier, and I would have ruined you if I went a bit farther.
That's why----"
it's enough, she whispers.

entries.japanese:
―――なにを、いまさら。
　そんなこと、こっちはおまえに協力するって言った時から覚悟していた。
　おまえが吸血鬼だっていうことは、おまえ以上にちゃんとわかってる。
　わかっている上で、おまえの手助けをするって言ったのに。
　こんなの―――俺には、何一つだってよくはない……！
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Now she says that?
I was ready for all of that from the moment I agreed to help.
I know you’re a vampire even better than you do.
I knew, and I still chose to help you.
And now—none of it is acceptable to me, not a single part.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----What are you saying, all of a sudden?
I was ready for that from the time I agreed to help you.
I understood far better than you that you were a vampire.
Knowing that, I still said I'd help you.
This----is nothing I can agree with……!

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
さっきの事なら気にする必要なんかないだろ。
おまえは体が弱ってて、ただ、疲れただけなんだ。
　俺はバカだからさ、おまえの嘘に気づいてやれなかった。
　おまえを苦しめてたのは体の傷なんかじゃなくて、吸血衝動っていうヤツだったんだろ。
　……全部、先輩に教えてもらった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, if you mean what happened earlier, you don’t have to worry about it. Your body is weak. You were exhausted, that’s all.
I’m an idiot, so I didn’t realize you were lying to me.
It wasn’t your wounds that were tormenting you—it was that vampiric impulse, wasn’t it?
Ciel told me everything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid, you don't need to worry about what happened earlier.
You were just tired and weak.
I'm an idiot, so I couldn't realize your lie.
You weren't in pain because of your wounds, but because of your vampiric impulses, right?
…… Senpai told me all about it."

entries.japanese:
「……あの女。
埋葬機関はいつからそんなにお喋りになったのかしらね」
　憎たらしい、というよりは疲れた、という顔をして、アルクェイドはため息をもらす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That woman… When did the Burial Agency become so talkative?”
Arcueid sighs, looking weary rather than angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That woman.
Since when did agents from the Burial Agency become so talkative?"
Less with hate and more with exhaustion, Arcueid gives a deep sigh.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩に全部聞いた。
全部聞いた上で、はっきり言ってやる。
　おまえには問題なんてないよ、アルクェイド。
　今は苦しいけど、何日かすれば元に戻るんだろう？
　それなら気にする必要なんかない。
　それにさっきだって―――あんなに苦しそうだったのに、ちゃんと我慢できたじゃないか。
　だから大丈夫だよ。
これからも今までみたいにやっていこう」
「………………」
　アルクェイドは辛そうに、弱々しく、笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel told me everything. Now I can tell you plainly.
There is nothing wrong with you, Arcueid.
You are suffering now, but you’ll recover in a few days, won’t you? Then there is no reason to worry.
Even before—you were in agony, but you still restrained yourself.
You’ll be fine. We can go on the way we have been.”
“…”
Arcueid answers with a weak, aching smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I heard it all from Senpai.
So I'll be direct.
I don't see any problem, Arcueid.
You're in pain now, but you'll return to normal in a few days, right?
So you don't need to worry.
And about before----even though you were in so much pain, you held yourself back, didn't you?
So it's alright.
Let's just continue like we were until now."
"………………"
With some difficulty, Arcueid smiles weakly.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴はぜんぜんわかってない。
無理なのよ、こうなっちゃったら。
わたしは今でも、志貴の血が欲しいって思ってるんだから」
「―――思ってるだけだろ。
なら気合いれて我慢しろ。
……今までだって、そうやって頑張ってきたんじゃないのか、おまえは」
「……そうよね、今までそうやって自分を抑えてきた。
いえ、抑えてこれた。
　けど、もうダメみたい。
わたしは浅はかで、吸血鬼殺しだけがわたしの意味なのに、余分なことをたくさんしちゃった。
　何も知らなければ、何かを欲しいだなんて思うこともなかった。
志貴なんかに頼らず、自分だけで敵を追っていれば良かったのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You don’t understand anything, Shiki. Once I’m like this, it’s impossible. Even now, I want your blood.”
“Wanting it is not the same as taking it. So grit your teeth and hold back. Isn’t that what you have always done?”
“Yes. Until now, I kept myself under control; I was able to.
But I do not think I can anymore. I was foolish; killing vampires was my only purpose, yet I let myself do too many unnecessary things.
If I had never learned anything else, I would never have begun to want anything. I should have hunted my enemy alone instead of relying on you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki, you don't understand at all.
It's useless to do this.
Even now, I want to drink your blood."
"----But you only think that.
Then try hard and resist it.
…… Haven't you tried so hard like that until now?"
"…… That's true, until now I've held myself back, no I was able to.
But I guess it's useless now.
Even though the only meaning for my existence is to hunt other vampires, I did a lot of extra things.
If I didn't know anything, I never would have thought of wanting anything.
If I didn't rely on you and pursued the enemy by myself, it would have been alright."

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　一人でやっていけば良かった……？
　本気で？
　本気で、そんなことを口走ってやがるのか、コイツは？
　そんな悲しそうな顔で？
　泣くような声で？
　今にも崩れそうな、その孤独なカタチで？
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
She should have stayed alone?
Is she serious? Is she seriously spouting that crap?
With that miserable face?
In a voice on the verge of tears?
Standing there in that lonely shape as though she might collapse at any moment?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
It would've been okay if she was by herself……?
Is she serious?
Does she seriously believe that?
With such a sad face?
With such a sad voice?
With such a solitary appearance and on the verge of collapse?

entries.japanese:
「―――ああ、もうあったまくる！
　いいかげんにしろってんだ、このばかおんなっ……！」
「なっ………」
「ふざけんな……！
　何が自分だけで敵を追ってれば良かった、だ！
　一人じゃ無理だから―――一人じゃできない事があるってやっと気がついたから、俺に手を貸せって言い出したんだろう！？
　なら最後まで頼れよ……！
　俺が助ける。
なにがあっても俺が助けてやるから――――」
　そんな、顔を。
「―――二度と……もういいなんて、言うな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“God, that pisses me off! Enough already, you idiot!”
“Wh—?”
“Don’t give me that!
What do you mean, you should have hunted alone? You asked for my help because you finally realized there were things you couldn’t do by yourself!
So rely on me to the end! I’ll help you. No matter what happens, I’ll be there, so—”
That look on her face.
“—Never say it does not matter again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That just pisses me off!
Snap out of it, you idiot……!"
"Wha………"
"Don't be ridiculous……!
What do you mean if you pursued the enemy by yourself, it would have been alright!?
Because it was impossible by yourself----because you finally realized there are things you can't do by yourself, you asked me for help, right!?
Then rely on me until the very end……!
I'll help you.
No matter what happens, I'll help you, so----"
Don't look like that.
"----Don't say those… things."

entries.japanese:
……やっと。
　やっと、生きていることが楽しいって、思えたんなら。
　その当たり前の倖せを、簡単に手放すなんてコトだけは、しないでくれ。
entries.maoEnglish:
At last.
If at last you have learned that being alive can bring you happiness.
Then please—do not throw away that ordinary happiness so easily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Finally.
If you've finally realized that life is fun,
please don't simply give up on such happiness.

entries.japanese:
「志貴―――あなた、泣いてるの……？」
「わけないだろ……！
　なんで俺が、おまえのために泣かなくちゃいけないんだ……！」
　ただ、アルクェイドがあんまりにもバカにコトを言い出すから。
　
　あったまにきて、感情がどうかしてしまったのかもしれないけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—are you crying?”
“Of course not! Why would I cry over you?”
It’s only that Arcueid started saying such impossibly stupid things.
Maybe I became so angry that something inside me went wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki----are you, crying……?"
"Like hell I am……!
Why would I cry over you……!?"
It's just… she's saying such stupid things.
It makes me so angry, that my emotions are going crazy.

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、とにかく吸血鬼探しは続けるからなっ！
　その、ロアとかいうヤツをさっさとこの街から追い出せばおまえだって休めるんだ。
そうすれば万事解決だろ、問題なんて一つもない……！」
　アルクェイドは静かに、ひどく穏やかな目をして、そうね、とうなずいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, we’re going to keep hunting that vampire! Once we drive this Roa bastard out of the city, you can rest. Then everything will be solved, and there won’t be a single problem left!”
Arcueid nods and says yes, her eyes quiet and unbearably gentle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, we'll continue searching for this vampire, okay!?
If we can defeat this Roa guy, then you can get some rest.
Then, everything's solved.
There aren't any problems at all……!"
With terribly peaceful eyes, she gives a quiet nod.

entries.japanese:
「でも―――やっぱりだめなんだ、志貴。
　志貴はわたしがさっき我慢できたって言ってくれたけど、わたしは我慢できなかった。
　さっきね。
わたしが一瞬だけ止まったのは、志貴がわたしのことを怖がったからよ。
　わたし、今まで何人もの人間たちに化け物って怖がられてきた。
だから自分に向けられる嫌悪の念なんていうのには、もう何も感じなくなってた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But it still won’t work, Shiki.
You said I managed to hold back before, but I didn’t.
I stopped for one instant. It was because you were afraid of me.
So many humans have feared me as a monster. Their disgust stopped meaning anything to me long ago.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But----It's too late for me, Shiki.
You said I held myself back before, but I really didn't.
Back then, I only stopped because you became afraid of me.
Many people have been afraid of me, like a monster.
So I didn't feel anything when hated or feared.

entries.japanese:
「……なのに、おかしいよね。
志貴がわたしを化け物みたいに見るのだけは、すごくイヤだったんだ。
　わたしはどうやったって志貴にとって化け物なのにね」
　あはは、と。
　乾いた笑いを、彼女は無理やりこぼしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But isn’t it strange? I couldn’t bear it when you looked at me like a monster. Even though, whatever I do, that is what I am to you.”
She laughs.
Arcueid forces out the dry sound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But it really is strange, you know?
I really didn't want you to look at me like I was a monster.
But I am a monster no matter how you look at me."
Ahaha.
She forces out a dry laugh.

entries.japanese:
「……そんな―――アレは、いきなりのことだったから、驚いて―――」
　……嘘だ。
　それは、自分さえ騙せない嘘だ。
　アルクェイドは辛そうに目をふせる。
　……先生が、言っていたのに。
　自分さえ騙せない嘘は、相手を傷つけるだけだっていうことを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—that was only because it happened so suddenly; it startled me—”
A lie.
A lie too feeble even to fool myself.
Arcueid lowers her eyes in pain.
My teacher warned me.
A lie too weak to fool even yourself only hurts the person you tell it to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No----it just happened so fast, I was just surprised----"
…… That's a lie.
That's a lie I can't even fool myself with.
Arcueid painfully looks away.
…… Sensei told me before.
That you'll only hurt the other person when you tell lies that you can't even deceive yourself with.

entries.japanese:
「……わたしが一瞬だけ止まったのは、そのせい。
志貴にそんな目で見られるのが怖かった。
この先も、あんな目で見られたらわたしはきっと壊れてしまう。
　だから―――志貴とは、もう会わない」
「な―――――――」
「ここでお別れにしましよう、志貴。
　わたしたちね、きっと馴れ合いすぎちゃったんだ」
　くるり、と背中を向けて。
　俺の顔を見ないようにして、アルクェイドはそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is why I stopped. I was afraid to see you look at me that way. If it happened again, I think I would break.
So I won’t see you anymore, Shiki.”
“Wh—?”
“Let’s say goodbye here, Shiki.
I think we let ourselves grow too close.”
Arcueid turns her back.
She says it without looking at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's why I stopped for an instant.
I was scared of you looking at me like that.
I would break apart if you look at me like that in the future too.
So----I won't see you anymore."
"Wha------"
"Let's say goodbye here, Shiki.
We probably associated too much with each other."
She turns around swiftly.
She says this while trying not to look at me.

entries.japanese:
……馴れ合いすぎた、か。
　それは、たしかにそのとおりだ。
　俺もアルクェイドも。
　こうやってお互いのことを深く知らずにいたら、こんなコトにはならなかった。
　俺はあっさりとアルクェイドから手をきって日常に戻って、アルクェイドはまた一人でやっていけただろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
We grew too close.
She is right about that.
Both of us did.
If we had never come to know each other so deeply, none of this would have happened.
I could have left her without a second thought and returned to my ordinary life, while Arcueid went on alone as before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… associated too much, huh?
Maybe that's true.
For both me and Arcueid.
If we never knew much about each other, this would have never happened.
I would have just returned to my normal life, and she'd have probably kept going by herself.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだな。
たしかに馴れ合いすぎた。
　けど、俺はそれでいいと思うよ。
だってさ、いつまでも一人きりっていうのは淋しいだろ」
「――――」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　あいつの背中は、ひどく弱々しくて。
　このまま、抱きしめて支えてやりたくなるぐらい、切なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right. We did grow too close.
But I am glad we did. Being alone forever is lonely.”
“—”
Arcueid doesn’t answer.
Her back looks heartbreakingly frail.
I want to put my arms around her and hold her upright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're right.
Maybe we have associated too much already.
But, I think we're fine like that.
Because, isn't always being by yourself lonely?"
"----"
Arcueid doesn't answer.
She looks so vulnerable.
I want to embrace her and support her.

entries.japanese:
「それにな、正直に言うとここ数日は楽しかったんだ。
死ぬような目にもあったけど、イヤなことばっかりだったわけじゃない。
　……だから、最後まで協力させろよ。
このまま放っておかれたら気になって眠れそうにないじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And honestly, I enjoyed these last few days. I nearly died more than once, but not all of it was terrible.
So let me help you through to the end. If you leave me behind now, I’ll worry too much to sleep.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And to be honest, I really enjoyed these past few days.
I almost died, but it wasn't all bad.
…… So let me help you until the very end.
How could I sleep if I knew I left you alone?"

entries.japanese:
「……ううん、その点は心配しないでいいよ。
　わたしは絶対にロアを殺す。
相討ちになっても必ず仕留める。
……だから志貴はもういいの。
この街はすぐにもとのカタチに戻って、心配するようなことはなくなるから」
　背中ごしの声には、いつもの明るさはまったくない。
　……もう、耐えられない。
　これ以上、おとなしくしているのは、やめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You don’t need to worry about that.
I will kill Roa. Even if it kills me too, I’ll finish him. So you’ve done enough, Shiki. The city will soon return to normal, and there will be nothing left for you to worry about.”
Her voice, reaching me over her shoulder, holds none of its usual brightness.
I can’t bear another moment.
I’m done standing obediently by.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, you don't have to worry about me.
I will kill Roa no matter what.
I will destroy him even if it kills me.
…… You've done enough already, Shiki.
This city will soon return to normal, so you don't have to worry anymore."
Her voice as she faces away from me has no trace of her usual brightness.
…… I can't bear this anymore.
I'm going to stop acting like this.

entries.japanese:
「……馬鹿。
俺が心配してんのはそんなことじゃない」
　言って、アルクェイドに詰め寄っていく。
「あ――――」
　逃げようとするアルクェイド。
　その腕を後ろからつかんで、強引に振り向かせた。
「志―――貴」
「はっきり言わなくちゃわからないんなら口にする。
　……いいか、俺が手助けするって言ったのは、街を騒がしている吸血鬼を倒すためじゃない。
自分が住んでいる街を守るとか、そんなご大層な理由なんて、ホントはなかったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot. That isn’t what I’m worried about.”
I close the distance between us.
“Ah—”
Arcueid tries to flee.
I seize her arm from behind and wrench her around to face me.
“Shi—ki.”
“If you won’t understand until I say it plainly, then I’ll say it.
I didn’t agree to help because I wanted to defeat the vampire terrorizing the city. Protecting the place I live—nothing so noble was ever my real reason.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Idiot.
That's not what I'm worried about."
Saying that, I draw closer to her.
"Ah----"
Arcueid tries to escape.
I grab her arm from behind and make her turn around.
"Shi----ki."
"Since you don't understand me unless I'm direct, I'll be direct.
…… Look, I didn't agree to help you to stop the vampire in this city.
I really don't have any fine ideals such as protecting this city I live in."

entries.japanese:
そう、口ではそう言ってごまかして、自分自身にもそう言い聞かせていたけど、そんな理由なんて大義名分にすぎない。
　俺は、ただ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had used that excuse aloud and repeated it to myself, but it was only a pretext.
I had only one reason.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Right, I was only fooling myself.
The reason isn't anywhere near to being that noble.
I just…

entries.japanese:
「ただ単純に、おまえが好きだから。
おまえの力になりたかったから、協力するって言ったんだ。
　それを今さら―――無かったことになんて、できるわけないだろ」
　はっきりと告げて。
　正面から、アルクェイドを抱きしめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It was simple. I liked you. I wanted to be there for you, and that is why I agreed to help.
And now, after all this, you can’t ask me to pretend none of it ever happened.”
I tell her plainly.
Then I take Arcueid into my arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I just like you.
I wanted to help you, so I agreed to help you.
So now----I just can't leave you."
I reveal it all.
And I embrace Arcueid straight on.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　アルクェイドの声は、抵抗の意思がない。
　ただ呆然と立ち尽くしたまま、抱きしめる俺を受け止めている。
　とくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
There is no resistance in her voice.
She merely stands frozen in bewilderment, accepting my embrace.
Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh----"
Her gasp isn't one of resistance.
She simply stands there in astonishment, accepting my embrace.
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「おまえが、俺の血を欲しいって思っていることなら、何も悪くなんかない」
　とくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is nothing wrong with wanting my blood.”
Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There's nothing wrong with you wanting to drink my blood."
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴、いたい―――腕、いたいよ―――」
　とくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—that hurts; my arm hurts—”
Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki, it hurts----my arms, hurt----"
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「そんなものおあいこだ。
だって、それなら―――」
　とくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then we’re even. Because in that case—”
Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That'll make it even.
Because I----"
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「俺だって、ずっと、おまえが欲しいって思ってた。
こうしている今も―――アルクェイドの心音をきいて、気が狂いそうなぐらい、欲情してる」
　とくん、と。
　抱きしめた腕から、重なり合った体から、
　アルクェイドの鼓動が、感じられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve wanted you all along. Even now, holding you, listening to your heart—I want you so badly I could lose my mind.”
Thump.
Through my arms around her, through our bodies pressed together,
I feel Arcueid’s heartbeat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I have always wanted you too.
Even now----I'm consumed with passion just hearing your heartbeat."
Thump.
From her arms I hold, from her body up against mine,
I can feel the beating of her heart.

entries.japanese:
「……ちがうよ、志貴。
それは……ただこの瞬間だけ、わたしに、気がふれてる、だけだもの……」
　とくん、とくん。
　その音だけで、こんなにも―――抱き殺してしまいたいほど、どうかしてるっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, Shiki. This is only madness for this one moment—you have only lost yourself over me—”
Thump, thump.
The sound alone has already driven me so far beyond reason that I want to crush her to death in my embrace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, Shiki.
That's just…… for right now, it's only a whim of yours…"
Thump, Thump.
Just hearing this sound----makes me want to hug her to death.

entries.japanese:
「―――それでもいい。
今、アルクェイドを愛してるなら、それが遠野志貴の真実だ。
そのあとのことなんて、知らない」
　とく、ん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then so be it. If I love you now, that is Shiki Tohno’s truth. I don’t care what comes afterward.”
Thum—p.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Even so, if I love you right now Arcueid, that is my truth.
I don't care about what happens later."
Thu, mp.

entries.japanese:
「それとも―――俺のこと、嫌いか」
　とく、ん。
　心音が、乱れて止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Or do you hate me?”
Thum—p.
Her heartbeat stumbles, then stops.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Or do you----hate me?"
Thu, mp.
The heartbeat skips.

entries.japanese:
「……だめ。
その質問には、答えられない」
　心音が、途絶える。
　その代償に。
　そっと、降りかかる雨のように、アルクェイドの両腕が俺の背中にまわってきた。
　はじめは優しく。
　あとは、ただ応えるように激しく。
　アルクェイドの両腕が、ぎゅっと、俺の体を引き寄せていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No… I can’t answer that question.”
Her heartbeat vanishes.
In its place.
Gentle as falling rain, Arcueid’s arms slip around my back.
Gently at first.
Then fiercely, as if in answer.
Arcueid’s arms tighten and pull me close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
I can't answer that."
The heartbeat stops.
In its place,
her arms wrap around my back like falling rain.
At first, just gently.
Then, hard as if answering me.
Her arms squeeze my body into hers.

entries.japanese:
抱擁は一瞬だった。
　どちらから離れたのかは、自分でもよくわからない。
　ただ申し合わせたように、俺たちは互いの腕を解きあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The embrace lasts only an instant.
I don’t know which of us lets go first.
As if by agreement, we release each other at the same time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Our embrace lasted only an instant.
I don't even know which one of us separated first.
But as if we planned it, we both let go.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　アルクェイドはうつむいたまま、ただ頬を赤らめている。
「――――――」
　夜明けまで、あと一時間ほどしかない。
　夜は明ける。
アルクェイドの時間が終わる。
　けど―――俺はもう、このままアルクェイドと別れるなんて耐えられない。
　許されるのなら、この場で彼女を――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid keeps her head bowed, her cheeks scarlet.
“—”
Only an hour remains until dawn.
Morning will come. Arcueid’s time will end.
But I can no longer endure parting from her like this.
If she will allow it, here and now, I want to—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
She blushes, looking away.
"------"
There is only about an hour until dawn.
As the night ends, so does Arcueid's time.
But----I can't bear parting with her anymore.
If it can be forgiven, right now, I want to----

entries.japanese:
「―――わたしの部屋」
「え？」
「……その、わたしの部屋に、行かない……？
　わたしを守ってくれるっていうんなら―――今日は、帰ってほしく、ない」
　途切れ途切れに繰り出される声。
　……いくら俺でも、アルクェイドの言葉の意味は理解できる。
　無言でうなずいて、あとはもう熱にうかされたような状態のまま、アルクェイドの部屋へと歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My room.”
“What?”
“Would you come to my room? If you really mean to protect me, I do not want you to go home tonight.”
She forces the words out in halting fragments.
Even I understand what she is asking.
I nod without a word, and then, moving as if fever-struck, we set out for her room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----My room."
"Eh?"
"…… Um, can we go, to my room……?
If you say you're going to protect me----I don't want you, to go back."
A hesitant voice.
…… Even I can understand what she means.
Nodding wordlessly, I walk with Arcueid to her room.

entries.japanese:
先に部屋にあがった。
　……背中には、アルクェイドの気配だけを感じている。
　振り向けば、もうそのままどうにかしてしまいそうなほど、感情が昂ぶっている。
　だっていうのに、驚くぐらい思考は冷静だった。
　よく、俺にはわからないけれど。
　何かを愛するっていうコトは、狂っていながら正気だっていう、矛盾した衝動のことを言うのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I enter first.
Behind me, I feel nothing but Arcueid’s presence.
My emotions are pitched so high that if I turn around, I may lose all control.
Yet my thoughts remain astonishingly calm.
I don’t really understand it.
Perhaps loving someone is precisely this contradiction: an impulse both mad and perfectly sane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I enter before her.
…… Behind me, I can sense Arcueid.
If I turn around, I know my feelings will rise out of control.
But still, my mind is almost surprisingly calm.
I don't quite understand it myself,
but perhaps it is the contradicting impulse of being insane yet sane that loving someone brings.

entries.japanese:
「――――アルクェイド」
　後ろに振り返ろうとする。
　その矢先―――とん、と軽く、アルクェイドの手が背中に触れた。
「振り向かないで。
……しばらく、このままで、いて」
　……アルクェイドの声は落ち着いている。
　背中に触れた手は、何かを確かめるようにじっとして動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid.”
I start to turn.
Before I can, her hand comes to rest lightly against my back.
“Don’t turn around. Stay like this for a while.”
Arcueid’s voice is calm.
The hand against my back remains motionless, as if confirming that I am truly there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Arcueid."
I try to turn around.
Before I finish----I feel her hand lightly rest on my back.
"Don't turn around.
…… Wait just like this for a while."
…… Her voice is exceedingly calm.
The hand on my back doesn't move, as if making sure of something.

entries.japanese:
「……ねえ志貴。
わたしが、初めて貴方を待っていた時のこと、覚えてる？」
「覚えてるよ。
自分が殺した相手がニコニコ顔で待ち伏せてたんだ。
忘れられるわけがないだろ」
「うん―――あの時ね。
わたし、貴方のことがすごく憎かった」
　言葉とは裏腹に、アルクェイドの声はとても優しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Do you remember the first time I waited for you?”
“Of course. The person I had killed was lying in wait with a cheerful smile. How could I forget?”
“Yes—back then. I hated you more than anything.”
Despite her words, her voice is achingly tender.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey Shiki.
Do you remember when I first waited for you?"
"Yeah, I remember.
The one I killed was waiting with a smiling face.
How could I forget?"
"Yeah----back then, I really hated you."
Despite her words, her voice is very gentle.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド？」
「――もう自分でも吸血衝動は抑えられないってわかってて。
きっと、これが最後のチャンスだって覚悟してロアを追いかけて。
　ようやく見つけたって思った時に、見ず知らずの誰かに殺されて、何もかも台無しにされてしまった。
　その時のわたしの感情は、ただ、憎しみしかなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid?”
“I already knew I couldn’t suppress my vampiric impulse much longer. I had resigned myself to this being my final chance and was hunting Roa with everything I had.
Then, just when I thought I had finally found him, a complete stranger killed me and ruined everything.
All I felt then was hatred.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid?"
"--I knew I wouldn't be able to suppress my vampiric impulses by myself any longer, and I knew this probably would be my chance, and I pursued Roa.
I thought I finally found him, and then someone I didn't even know killed me and ruined everything.
Back then, all I could feel was hatred."

entries.japanese:
「そうして、自分を殺した誰かを探し出して、貴方が来るのをね、あの道でずっと待っていたの。
　早く、早く来なさい。
わたしに気がついた瞬間に、寸分たがわず同じ目にあわせてあげるからって。
　……本当に、貴方のことが憎かった。
憎くて憎くて、胸が張り裂けそうになるぐらい、ずっと待ちつづけてた」
　ぐっ、と背中にかかる手に力がこもる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I found the person who killed me and waited for you on that road.
Come quickly. The moment you recognized me, I would do precisely the same thing to you.
I truly hated you. I waited and waited, hating you so fiercely I thought my heart would tear apart.”
Her hand digs more firmly into my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And I found the one who killed me and waited at that road for such a long time.
I was thinking you should just hurry up.
Hurry up and come here.
Once I saw you, I'd make you suffer the same fate.
…… I really did hate you.
I hated you so much I thought my chest would burst with hatred as I waited."
The pressure on my back increases.

entries.japanese:
「……アル……クェイド……？」
「でもね、わたしをあんなふうに殺した相手なんて、今までいなかった。
少しだけ、どんなヤツなんだろうって興味もあった。
　それに―――あんなふうに、誰かを強く思うなんてコト、今までなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—cueid?”
“But no one had ever killed me that way before. Part of me became curious about what sort of person could have done it.
And I had never felt anything so intensely for anyone.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ar…… cueid……?"
"But, no one has ever killed me like that before.
I was a bit curious about what kind of person you were too.
And----I never thought so strongly about someone before."

entries.japanese:
「初めは、ただ憎しみしかなかった。
けど貴方がどんな人間なのかなって思った時、くるって反転したんだ。
　ともかく、どんな人間なのか会ってみたくなったわ。
わたしをあんなふうに殺したヤツ、わたしが初めて、自分を見失うぐらいに―――ずっと、思い続けている誰かに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“At first there was nothing but hatred. But the moment I wondered what kind of person you were, everything turned over inside me.
Suddenly I wanted to meet you. I wanted to see the man who had killed me like that, the first person I had ever thought about so relentlessly that I lost myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"In the beginning, it was just hatred.
But it started to slip when I wondered what kind of human you were.
Soon, I wanted to meet you to find out about you.
The one who killed me like that, and for the first time I almost lost track of myself----and I kept wondering."

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴、さっき言ったよね。
一人は寂しいだろうって。
　わたし、そんなコトはないと思ってた。
　けど―――あんなにも狂おしく誰かのことを思って、貴方を今か今かと待ち続けた時の気持ちは、すごく幸せだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. You said earlier that being alone was lonely.
I never believed that.
But when I was waiting for you, thinking about someone with such desperate intensity, I was so happy.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki, what you said before.
About how being by yourself is lonely.
I thought that wasn't true.
But----when I waited for you, the one who I madly thought about, I felt happy.

entries.japanese:
「本当は今すぐにでも会いに行きたかったけど、我慢して、貴方がやって来るのを待っていて、良かった。
　あの時間は楽しかったよ。
すごくドキドキして、志貴がどんな人なんだろうって、かってに想像したりもした」
　……アルクェイドの手が、背中から離れる。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I wanted to go find you at once, but I forced myself to wait for you to come, and I am glad I did.
That time was wonderful. My heart raced, and I imagined all sorts of things about the person you might be.”
Arcueid’s hand leaves my back.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I wanted to meet you right away, but it turned out great that I held on and waited for you.
It was really fun.
I was so excited, I kept imagining what kind of person you were."
…… She pulls her hand from my back.
I----

entries.japanese:
「―――思えばね。
その時からわたしは誰かを必要としてしまって、自分が一人だっていうのが物足りなく感じてしまった。
　志貴はわたしの事を好きだって言ってくれたけど。
　……わたしは、志貴に会う前から、あなた自身に恋をしてたんだなって―――」
　アルクェイドの声は、ただ、いとおしい。
　……もうためらう必要なんてない。
　振り返って、そのままアルクェイドを抱き寄せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Looking back, I think that was when I began to need someone. Being alone stopped feeling complete.
You told me you liked me, Shiki, but…
I think I had fallen in love with you before we ever met.”
There is nothing in Arcueid’s voice but tenderness.
I have no reason to hesitate now.
I turn and draw her into my arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Thinking back, I started to feel the need for someone else from that time, and I felt unsatisfied with just being by myself.
You said you liked me,
…… but I think I fell in love with you before we even met----"
Her voice is… just so… lovely.
…… There's no need for hesitation.
Turning around, I embrace her.

entries.japanese:
「ん………」
　自然に、唇が重なり合った。
　どちらかが求めたわけでもないし、どちらもが求めたのかもしれない。
　ただ、本当に優しく。
　互いの存在をより近くに感じあおうとして、唇を重ねあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm…”
Our lips meet as naturally as breathing.
Perhaps neither of us sought the kiss—or perhaps we both did.
Our kiss is exquisitely gentle.
We want only to feel each other’s existence more closely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N……"
Our lips come together naturally.
I don't know who started it, maybe we both did.
We just did it gently.
We kissed to feel each other's presence just a bit closer.

entries.japanese:
――――は………あ。
　呼吸をとめて、アルクェイドを実感する。
　やわらかな唇。
決して触れ合うことのない肌が、こうして触れ合っている。
　そう思うだけで頭の中がはじけそうなのに、実際の彼女の感触は温かくて、ホッとする。
　アルクェイドの体は微かに震えている。
　けれど脅えているような様子はまったくない。
　閉じられたまぶた、上気した桜色の頬がたまらなくかわいらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Ah…
I stop breathing and feel Arcueid.
Her lips are soft. Skin that should never have touched mine is touching me now.
The thought alone should make my mind burst, yet the reality of her is warm and strangely reassuring.
Her body trembles faintly.
Yet she shows no fear.
Her closed eyes and flushed pink cheeks are unbearably lovely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Hha…… ah.
Holding my breath, I take in everything about the way she feels.
Her soft lips.
The skin that would never touch anything… is touching me right now.
Just thinking about it makes my head spin, yet touching her is so warm and relaxing.
Her body is trembling lightly.
But she doesn't seem to be scared at all.
Her closed eyes, the shade of red on her cheeks is so adorable.

entries.japanese:
……本当に、信じられない。
　あんなに愛しかったアルクェイドが。
　ただこうするだけで、もっともっと、何倍も愛しく感じられるなんて、想像もできなかった―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I can hardly believe it.
Arcueid was already so precious to me.
I never imagined that this simple touch could make her feel dearer still—many times dearer than before—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I really can't believe it.
This Arcueid is the one I love so much.
I couldn't even imagine that just doing this would make me feel more love toward her----

entries.japanese:
そっと、離れる。
　体は抱き合ったまま、気恥ずかしそうに、お互いを見つめ合った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Our lips part softly.
Still holding each other, we exchange shy, uncertain looks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We pull back.
Still holding each other, we look at each other in embarrassment.

entries.japanese:
「……いまの、キス、だったね……」
　頬を赤く染めて、恥ずかしそうに、彼女は言った。
　上目遣いに見つめてくる赤い瞳。
　目の前でさらりとゆれる金色の髪。
「アルクェイド……こういうの、イヤか」
「―――ううん。
わたし、すごくどきどきしてる
　どくん、と。
　たしかに、彼女の心音はとても大きくなってきている。
　それとも―――それは、俺の心音だったのか。
　アルクェイドはまっすぐに俺の目を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was a kiss, wasn’t it?”
Arcueid says it with a shy blush.
Her red eyes peer up into mine.
Her golden hair sways softly before me.
“Arcueid… did you dislike it?”
“No. My heart is pounding.”
Thump.
Her heartbeat certainly is growing louder.
Or is that my own?
Arcueid looks directly into my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That was a… kiss… wasn't it?"
She says this with a deep blush.
Her red eyes looking up at me imploringly.
Her golden hair waving before my eyes.
"Arcueid…… you don't like this kind of thing?"
"----That's not it.
My heart's beating fast right now."
Thump.
Certainly, her heart is beating loudly.
Or----is it my heartbeat?
She looks straight into my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「でも、ちょっと困っちゃった。
……わたし、いいのかなって」
「いいのかなって、なにが？」
「だってね、志貴。
唇を重ねあったりする吸血鬼なんて、いないよ」
　頬を赤らめて。
　照れくさそうに、彼女は笑った。
「――――――――」
　その仕草が、もう完全に王手だった。
　メガネを外して、もう一度アルクェイドを抱きしめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But now I’m a little troubled. I’m not sure this is all right.”
“What isn’t?”
“But, Shiki. There aren’t any vampires who kiss like this.”
Her cheeks turn pink.
She gives me an embarrassed smile.
“—”
That shy little smile is checkmate.
I remove my glasses and pull Arcueid into my arms again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, this is troubling.

entries.mirrorMoon:

entries.mirrorMoon:

entries.japanese:

entries.mirrorMoon:

If tiredness is any indication of how good it was, I'm so exhausted I can't even walk now.

entries.japanese:
「――――ふぁ」

entries.maoEnglish:

I really do love her.

Arcueid may not feel it in the same way I do, but she needs me too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hwah."

…… I really do love her.
She answered my selfish love.
It might be a different form than the love I'm feeling, but Arcueid needs me too.

entries.japanese:

entries.maoEnglish:

Not because I’m the one she needs.
Because she—because Arcueid, who has always been utterly alone—has finally found it in herself to need someone other than herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Just that.
Just that makes me extremely happy.
Not the fact that I'm needed.
But for her----who until now was always alone, for her to need someone else makes me happy.

entries.japanese:
「―――そうすれば、さ。
おまえは、もう一人きりじゃなくなるんだから」

　アルクェイドが眠っているベッドに背中を預けて、はあ、と大きく息をはいて。

　アルクェイドが先に目を覚まして、なにか、よくない事をしている夢を見た。

アルクェイドは一人でこそこそやっている。

　いや……起きてるっていうより、ぼんやりとしてる。
アルクェイドのおかげで、まだ体が言うコトをきかないからさ。
entries.maoEnglish:

My consciousness sways and dims.

Deep in that sleep.
I dream that Arcueid wakes first and does something she ought not to do.
Arcueid is sneaking around, doing something on her own.

No—not awake, exactly; more like drifting. Thanks to you, my body still won’t do what I tell it.
entries.mirrorMoon:

What are you doing?
I ask.
"Oh.
You're awake, Shiki?"
Not really, I'm more asleep than awake.
Thanks to you, my body isn't quite doing what I tell it to.

entries.japanese:

entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Something, desperately ends.
She will settle things with Roa and disappear by herself.
…… No, I think she's already finished and left the city.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　気が狂う前に、何も考えられなくなった。
　……みーん、と。
耳の奥で、蝉の声が聞こえる。
　蝉の、ぬけがら。
　自分の体が軽くて、中には何も入っていなくて、考えることさえ出来なくなった。
　魂が抜けるというのはこういうコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Before madness can take me, thought itself shuts down.
…A cicada drones somewhere deep inside my ears.
A cicada’s empty shell.
My body feels weightless and hollow, without even the power to think.
So this is what it means to lose your soul.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I stop thinking before I go crazy.
…… I hear the voices of cicadas in the back of my ear.
The discarded shells of cicadas.
My body becomes light with nothing inside it, and I cannot think anymore.
So this is what it means to be truly empty.

entries.japanese:
涙さえ湧いてこない。
　ぬけがらのまま、足が動く。
　動物の帰省本能、というヤツだろう。
　何も残っていないクセに、自分は自分の家にむかって歩き出していた――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
Not even tears will come.
My legs carry the empty shell onward.
An animal’s homing instinct, I suppose.
Though nothing remains inside me, I find myself walking home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Not even tears come forth.
Still an empty shell, my legs move.
I guess it's just like an animal's instinctual sense to go home.
Even though I have nothing left in me, I am walking towards my house----

entries.japanese:
メルシー！
　クライマックスでデッドエンドを迎えてしまった残念な遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
　よせばいいのにこのコーナーもすでに二日目。
　この分だと三日目ぐらいまでいきそうで吐き気がしますね。
　それでは一時間目の授業を始めましょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Merci!
It’s time for Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for poor unfortunate Tohno,
who managed to hit a dead end right at the climax.
Against all good sense, we’ve already reached day two of these lessons.
At this rate we may make it to day three, and the thought turns my stomach.
Now, let’s begin our first lesson.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Merci!
Now for the hint corner for the poor Tohno-kun who reached a Dead End in midst of the climax,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
It would have been better to quit, but this corner is already into the second day.
At this rate, we might go on until the third day, which makes me feel a little sick.
Then, let's begin the first period lesson.

entries.japanese:
あーあ。
　だから言ったじゃないですか遠野くん。
　アルクェイドなんかを信用しちゃいけないんだって。
「違うよう。
アレはわたしのせいじゃないよう」
　誰がどう見ても貴女の所為です。
「うにゃー！」
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh dear.
I warned you, didn’t I, Tohno?
I told you not to trust someone like Arcueid.
“That’s not fair. It wasn’t my fault.”
Anyone with eyes can see it was entirely your fault.
“Mreow!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh geez.
That's why I told you, Tohno-kun.
You shouldn't trust Arcueid.
"No.
That's not my fault."
It's your fault no matter how you look at it.
"Unyaa!"

entries.japanese:
――――さて。
　ここに来てしまった遠野くん。
　言いにくいんですが、かなり前から再提出。
　アルクェイドに生まれていた遠野くんへの感情は、残念ながら彼女の吸血衝動には及びませんでした。
　一日、二日前からやりなおして絆を深めてみたりしてください。
　ああ、あとそうですね。
　遠野くん、いくら魅入られたからって簡単にキレちゃうのはどうかと思いますよー。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Now, then.
So, Tohno, you’ve ended up here.
I’m afraid you’ll have to resubmit your work from quite a long way back.
Sadly, the feelings Arcueid had begun to develop for you weren’t strong enough to overcome her vampiric impulse.
Restart from a day or two earlier and try deepening your bond.
Oh, and one other thing.
Even if you’d been bewitched, Tohno, losing control that easily was rather ill-advised.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Well then.
To the Tohno-kun who came here.
It's hard to say, but you have to resubmit from quite a while back.
The feelings for you that were born inside of Arcueid were unfortunately weaker than her urges as a vampire.
Please go back one or two days and try strengthening the bond with her.
Oh yes, and one more thing.
Tohno-kun, even though you were enchanted, I don't think it's good to easily go crazy.

entries.japanese:
「わたしのせいじゃないのに……」
「志貴のばかー！
　どんかんー！
　とーへんぼくー！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But it wasn’t my fault…”
“Shiki, you idiot! You insensitive jerk! You blockhead!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's nyaat my fault……"
"Shiki, you idiot!
Blockhead!
Insensitive oaf!"

entries.japanese:
翡翠の声で目が覚めた。
　あれから―――屋敷に帰ってきたあと、自分の部屋に引き込んで眠ったのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s voice wakes me.
Afterward—after returning to the mansion—I must have shut myself in my room and fallen asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wake up to the sound of Hisui's voice.
Since then----after returning to the mansion, I must have made my way to my room somehow and slept.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、なにかご気分がすぐれないのですか？」
「――――いや。
別に、何も」
　返答して、ベッドから起きあがる。
　……自分でも、呆れるぐらい。
　何も口にしたくないのに、体はいつも通りに生活をしようとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you feeling unwell?”
“—No. I’m fine.”
I answer and get out of bed.
Even I can hardly believe it.
I don’t want to say a word, yet my body insists on going through life as usual.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you not feeling well?"
"----No, I'm fine."
Answering, I sit up in bed.
…… I'm almost amazed at myself.
I don't even feel like talking, but my body tries to start my day as always.

entries.japanese:
「朝食だろ。
すぐに行くよ」
「………はい。
それではお待ちしております」
　何か言いたそうな顔をして翡翠は退室する。
　着替えて、居間にむかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Breakfast, right? I’ll be there in a minute.”
“Very well. We shall be waiting.”
Hisui leaves with something unspoken on her face.
I dress and make my way to the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Breakfast?
I'll be down soon."
"……… Yes.
I will be waiting."
Looking as if she still wants to say something, Hisui leaves the room.
I change my clothes and head to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉と琥珀がいた。
「おはよう」
　いつも通りの挨拶をして、食堂に向かう。
　朝食を口にして、居間に戻る。
　そのままソファーに座って、ぼんやりと時計を眺めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and Kohaku are in the sitting room.
“Good morning.”
I offer the usual greeting and go into the dining room.
I eat breakfast and return to the sitting room.
I sit on the sofa and stare vacantly at the clock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha and Kohaku are there.
"Morning."
Giving my usual greeting, I go to the dining room.
I eat breakfast and return to the sitting room.
I sit on the sofa and stare at the clock.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん？
　その、今日は学校があるってわかってますよね？」
「うん―――？
　ああ、そっか。
学校には、行かないといけないよな」
　忘れていた。
　なにもやる事がなくなったから、あとはこのまま、ずっとヌケガラのまま生きていくんだって、ぼんやりと思っていたけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Brother? You do realize there is school today, don’t you?”
“Mm—? Oh. Right. I have to go to school.”
I had forgotten.
With nothing left for me to do, I had vaguely imagined that I would go on living like an empty shell forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san?
Um, you know you have school today, right?"
"Hm----?
Yeah, that's right.
I guess I should go to school."
I forgot.
I didn't feel like doing anything, and I thought I would keep living like this empty shell.

entries.japanese:
「……俺には遠野志貴の生活があるもんな。
何もやる事がないなら、学校に行くのも悪くない」
「兄さん……？」
　秋葉が不審げな眼差しを向けてくる。
　……何か言いつくろうのも面倒くさい。
　何も言わず、登校することにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I still have Shiki Tohno’s life to live, after all. If I have nothing else to do, I may as well go to school.”
“Brother?”
Akiha gives me a suspicious look.
I can’t even be bothered to make up an excuse.
Without another word, I leave for school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I do have my life as Tohno Shiki.
If I don't have anything to do, it won't hurt to go to school."
"Nii-san……?"
Akiha looks at me uneasily.
…… Speaking is just a pain.
Without saying anything, I go to school.

entries.japanese:
何の異状もなく時間は流れていく。
　こうして何時間めかの授業を、何の目的もなく受けている。
　かつかつ、というチョークの音。
　黒板にせわしなく書かれていく数式を、無意識にノートに書き写していく。
　ふと、窓の外から裏庭を見た。
　当然のように、そこには誰もいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The hours pass without incident.
I sit through yet another class with no purpose at all.
Chalk taps against the board.
My hand copies the equations appearing there in a hurried stream, though my mind takes in none of them.
On impulse, I look through the window at the rear courtyard.
Naturally, no one is there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Time passes by uneventfully.
I emptily attend my lessons.
The sound of the chalk.
I mindlessly write down what's written on the board into my notes.
I look out the window into the rear courtyard.
Of course there's no one there.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　―――何をしているんだろう、俺は。
　こんなところで、おとなしく授業なんか受けたりして。
　あいつを探しもしないで、普通の学生に戻ってしまって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“————”
―――What am I doing?
Sitting obediently in a classroom.
Not even searching for her, simply returning to life as an ordinary student.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
----What am I doing?
Just calmly attending my lessons like this.
Not searching for her and just returning to my normal life.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　けど、俺にはアルクェイドを捜す方法も手段もない。
　あいつが自分から消えた以上、あいつを探し出せる可能性は皆無だろう。
　だから、本当に。
　俺は、アルクェイドを失ったんだ―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
“————”
But I have neither a method nor a lead for finding Arcueid.
If she chose to disappear, there is almost no chance I could ever track her down.
So it’s true.
I have lost Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
But, there's no way for me to search for Arcueid.
Since she left on her own, there's probably no possibility of me finding her.
That's why…
I've really lost Arcueid---.

entries.japanese:
ばき。
「…………」
　自分の机の上で音がした。
　……ああ、なんていうことはない。
　ただ、シャープペンを強くにぎりすぎて、また折ってしまっただけの話だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crack.
“…………”
The sound came from my desk.
It’s nothing.
I merely gripped my mechanical pencil too hard and snapped it again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*snap*
"…………"
A sound comes from above my desk.
…… Ah, it's nothing.
I was just gripping my mechanical pencil so hard that I snapped another one.

entries.japanese:
授業が終わった。
　ざわざわと教室が騒がしくなる中、俺だけが授業中と変わらずに机に座っている。
「遠野、ちょっと来なさい」
　教壇から数学の教師が声をかけてくる。
「―――はい、なんですか」
　返事をして教壇に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Class ends.
The room fills with noise, but I remain at my desk exactly as I was during the lesson.
“Tohno, come here a moment.”
The mathematics teacher calls from the lectern.
“—Yes? What is it?”
I answer and walk to the front.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Classes end.
In the commotion of the classroom, I still remain seated.
"Tohno, can you come here for a moment?"
My math teacher speaks up from the podium.
"----Yes, what is it?"
I respond and walk towards him.

entries.japanese:
「遠野、おまえ最近素行が乱れてるらしいじゃないか。
おまえがな、夜遅くに街に出歩いているという報告が届いている。
どうだ、覚えはあるか？」
「……あります。
ここ数日、深夜の街に用がありましたから」
「―――そうか」
　数学の教師―――まあ、うちの担任なのだが―――は難しい顔をしたあと、すまなさそうな顔をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, I hear your conduct has become rather disorderly lately. We’ve received reports that you’ve been wandering around town late at night. Do you know anything about that?”
“…I do. I had business in town after midnight these past few days.”
“—I see.”
The mathematics teacher—who is also our homeroom teacher—frowns, then looks almost apologetic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno, hasn't your recent behavior been a little wild?
I have received information that you have been going out late at night.
Does it ring a bell?"
"…… Yes.
These past few days, I had things to do in town at night."
"----I see."
My math teacher----well, my homeroom teacher as well----looks a bit concerned, then looks a little sorry.

entries.japanese:
「遠野が夜遊びするような生徒じゃないとはわかっているんだが、職員会議で多少問題にあがってな。
生徒指導部の先生方が遠野と話がしたいそうだ。
　そういった理由だから、放課後は生徒指導室に行ってくれ。
運が悪かったと思って我慢しなさい」
