　死を避ける君と、死を受け入れた私。
それがアルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドと、ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォンの質の違いだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Human beings instinctively fear the unknown. Even transcendent beings such as the True Ancestors are no exception. No amount of mystery studied, no span of life endured, can give a living being the experience of death.
You gain your immense power by rejecting death, but in doing so you create your own weakness.
You flee death; I have accepted it. That is the essential difference between Arcueid Brunestud and Michael Roa Valdamjong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Humans are instinctually afraid of the unknown.
This does not change even for transcendent races like the True Ancestors.
No matter how much of the occult you study, no matter how long-lived you are, you cannot experience death.
You all gain so much power by resisting death, but at the same time it is the source of your weakness.
You run away from death whereas I accept it.
That is the difference in nature between you, Arcueid Brunestud, and I, Michael Roa Valdamjong.

entries.japanese:
「私は今も人として人の時代に生きている。
時代から外れた亡霊にすぎぬ君に、私を罰する権利はない」
　ぱりん、と。
　渡り廊下の窓ガラスが砕けていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I still live as a man within the age of man. You are only a ghost forsaken by the age. You have no right to pass judgment on me.”
A crystalline crash.
The windows along the walkway shattered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Even now I live as a human in this age.
An out-of-place ghost like yourself has no right to judge me."
Crack.
The glass along the passageway starts to break.

entries.japanese:
「―――私は知っている。
死を。
あの闇を。
何十回とくぐり抜けたあの虚無を―――！
　故に、私にとってこの場の死などただの通過儀礼にすぎぬ。
　仮にこの場でこの肉体が死滅しようと、ロアはまた人の世に孵ってくる。
この場で私と差しちがえるコトは無意味だと、なぜ解らないのだ君は」
　たかだかと両手を広げるロア。
　アルクェイドは答えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I know death—the darkness, the void I have crossed scores of times!
Death here is no more than a rite of passage to me.
Even if this body perishes tonight, Roa will hatch once more into the human world. Why can’t you understand that dying with me here will accomplish nothing?”
Roa flung both arms wide.
Arcueid did not answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I know.
About death.
About the darkness.
The nothingness which I have journeyed through so many times----!
To me, death is little more than a common ritual.
Let's say you destroy this body right here.
I'll still remain in this world.
Why don't you understand it's useless to fight me?"
Roa spreads his arms higher.
Arcueid doesn't answer.

entries.japanese:
「―――まあ仕方あるまい。
それでも私に挑むというのなら止めはしない。
その時こそ、君は千年の代償を受ける事になるだろう」
　両手を下げて、ロアは腰を低くする。
　アルクェイドの周囲の揺らぎは、今すぐにでも弾けそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So be it. If you still insist on challenging me, I won’t stop you. But then you will pay the price of your thousand years.”
Roa lowered his arms and sank into a fighting crouch.
The distortion around Arcueid looked ready to burst.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Alright.
If you still insist on challenging me, I will not stop you.
Your resistance will be rewarded."
Roa lowers his arms and crouches.
Everything around Arcueid seems on the verge of bursting apart.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　声が、出ない。
　まずいと。
　このままじゃまずいって、頭の中で警告が鳴り響いているのに。
　理由もわからないし、確証さえない。
　ただ、今まで多くの死を視てきた自分にはわかるんだ。
　ロアとアルクェイド。
そのどちらが、より死に近いかっていう危うさが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
I couldn’t make a sound.
This was bad.
Every instinct in my head was screaming that this could not be allowed to happen.
I had no reason and no proof.
But I had seen too many deaths not to know.
Roa and Arcueid. Which of them stood closer to death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A------"
I can't speak.
This isn't good.
My brain screams to me.
I shouldn't let this happen.
I don't know why, I don't even have proof.
Just, I, someone who has seen lots of death, can tell.
Roa and Arcueid.
Which one of them is closer to death.

entries.japanese:
「や――――め」
　……声が出ない。
出て、くれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“S-sto…”
No voice. It would not come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"St----op."
…… I can't speak.
I, can't.

entries.japanese:
――――ドン、と。
　大気を割るような音がした。
　アルクェイドの周囲にあった歪みが、廊下全体に侵食する。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Boom.
The sound split the air.
The distortion surrounding Arcueid engulfed the entire walkway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Crack!
The sound of the air itself ripping apart.
The warping of Arcueid's surroundings propagates along the entire passageway.

entries.japanese:
どくどくと、廊下全体が脈をうつ。
　窓ガラスも壁も、アルクェイドの前にある廊下や校舎そのものが。
　まるで野菜を千切りにするように何十、何百、何千と、それこそ数え切れないぐらいの数の断層になって、波のようにうねっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The corridor began to pulse like a living artery.
The windows, walls, the passage before Arcueid, and the school building itself.
They split into tens, hundreds, thousands—countless strata like shredded vegetables—then buckled in rolling waves.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The entire hallway pulses.
The glass windows, the walls, the hallway, the whole building.
They become roiling waves, as if they were a shredder with tens, hundreds, thousands, no, a countless number of blades.

entries.japanese:
「ギ――――――！」
　ロアの体が一瞬にして無くなっていく。
　歪曲して、切断されて、圧縮されて。
　それこそ残ったものは足首だけになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
Roa’s body vanished in an instant.
Warped, severed, compressed.
Until nothing remained but his ankles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gi------!"
In a single instant, Roa's body disappears.
Distorted, sliced, compressed.
All that remains are his ankles.

entries.japanese:
廊下のズレはすぐに消えた。
　今のは瞬間的なズレだったらしい。
　渡り廊下は元のままだ。
　ただ、そこにロアの足首だけが残っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
The displacement disappeared as quickly as it had come.
It must have lasted only an instant.
The walkway looked exactly as before.
Only Roa’s ankles remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sliding of the hallway ceases.
Maybe it only lasted a moment.
The passageway is like it was before.
Only all that's left are Roa's ankles.

entries.japanese: けれど、それで終わってはくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish: But it refused to end there.
entries.mirrorMoon: But, it didn't end there.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　足首が動く。
　カツカツと足首がアルクェイドへと走っていく。
　その過程。
　一歩進むたびに足首から腿が、腰が、もう一本の足が、胴が、両腕が、生えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
The ankles moved.
They clacked across the floor toward Arcueid.
Along the way.
With every step, thighs, hips, a second leg, a torso, and both arms sprouted from the ankles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A------"
The ankles start to move.
They start to run towards Arcueid.
As they do,
with each step, a leg, his hips, his other leg, his torso, his arms sprout to life.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　アルクェイドは床にひざまずいたまま動かない。
　その彼女の前で。
　ロアの顔が、首からぞぶりと生えてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid remained motionless on her knees.
Before her.
Roa’s face bulged wetly from the end of his neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Arcueid is still kneeling, not moving.
Directly in front of her,
Roa's neck and head come back into being.

entries.japanese:
「アル――――――」
　呼びかける声は届かない。
　完全に元通りに蘇生したロアは、そのまま、アルクェイドの腹を切った。
『線』を切るようにあっさりと、肉を裂く事もなく、血を流すこともなく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid—!”
My cry never reached her.
Fully restored, Roa swept his hand across her abdomen.
It was as effortless as cutting a “line”: no torn flesh, no flowing blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar------"
I couldn't warn her in time.
The completely regenerated Roa slices through her stomach.
Like cutting cleanly through the "line", with no slicing of flesh, no flowing of blood.

entries.japanese:
「―――危ない危ない。
やはり今夜を選んでおいて正解だったな。
月が欠けている状態だったのなら、さすがに足首からの蘇生など出来はしない」
「―――――――」
「そして姫君。
君はこの傷からの蘇生はできない。
私の爪は、そこにいる男と同じ能力だからな」
　どさり、と。
　アルクェイドは床に崩れ落ちる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was close. I chose tonight wisely. Had the moon been even partly waning, regenerating from my ankles would have been beyond me.”
“…”
“And you, Princess, cannot recover from this wound. My claws possess the same power as that man’s.”
With a thud.
Arcueid crumpled to the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That was close.
I knew it was correct to choose tonight.
If the moon was waning even the slightest bit, I could not have regenerated from just an ankle."
"--------"
"And princess, you cannot regenerate from that wound.
My claws have the same ability as that man over there."
Thud.
Arcueid collapses to the floor.

entries.japanese:
「―――これが死を体験した末に得た力だ。
　皮肉な話だが、私自身もこれの使い道はわからなかった。
教授してくれたのは彼でね。
死を見てきた私にとって、モノの死をカタチにする事はそう難しい事ではなかった」
　誇らしげに語ると、ロアはアルクェイドの体を蹴りつけた。
　ざざ、とこちらに向かって弾き飛ばされてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is the power I acquired through the experience of death.
Ironically, even I did not know how to use it until this boy showed me. After witnessing death so many times, giving shape to the death of a thing proved simple enough.”
With that proud declaration, Roa kicked Arcueid’s body.
She skidded across the floor toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----This is the power I got from experiencing death.
Ironically, I did not know how to use this myself.
But he taught me.
For someone who has seen death, perceiving its form was not difficult."
Roa boasts as he kicks Arcueid.
Her body tumbles towards me.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド……！」
　体が動く。
―――それは、アルクェイドの魔眼の力が無くなったということ。
　……アルクェイドの力が、もう、働いていないということ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid!”
My body moved.
―――Which meant the power of Arcueid’s Mystic Eyes was gone.
…It meant Arcueid’s power was no longer working at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid……!"
I can move again.
----It's because the power behind her Mystic Eyes has vanished.

…… It means her power is no longer working.

entries.japanese:
「――――く！」
　そんな思考を振り払って、アルクェイドの体を抱きとめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh!”
I tore the thought from my mind and caught her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Damn!"
Shaking the thought from my mind, I hold her close.

entries.japanese:
―――抱きとめた瞬間、ぞっとした。
　アルクェイドの体は、ひどく冷たい。
　かろうじて残っている熱は、蝋燭の火に似ている。
　
　目の前にはまだロアがいる。
　けれど、そんなコトどうでもよかった。
　今はただ―――アルクェイドを、助けたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The instant I held her, horror ran through me.
Arcueid’s body was terribly cold.
The scant warmth remaining in her was no more than a candle flame.
Roa was still in front of us.
But I no longer cared.
All I wanted was to save her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----A chill runs through me the instant I hold her.
Her body is terribly cold.
The only heat left within her is like a candle about to go out.
Roa still stands before us.
But, I don't care about that.
Right now----I just want to help Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド――――！」
　呼びかける。
　閉じられた目蓋は、眠りから覚めた時みたいに、元気よく開かれた。
「あは―――かっこわるいとこ、見せちゃっ、た」
　ツギハギだらけの明るさで。
　アルクェイドは、うっとりとした笑顔をうかべた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid!”
I called her name.
Her closed eyes flew open with the vigor of someone waking from sleep.
“Ahaha—you caught me looking pretty pathetic.”
With brightness patched together from scraps.
Arcueid gave me a dreamy smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid----!"
I call out to her.
Her closed eyes open energetically, as if waking from a dream.
"Aha----that was very lame, wasn't it?"
With patchwork brightness,
Arcueid puts forth a strained smile.

entries.japanese:
「この……なにばかなこと言ってるんだ、おまえ。
どうして―――どうして、こんな―――」
　……言葉がうかばない。
　もっと、もっといい言葉を言ってやりたいのに、あたまがどうかしてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You idiot… What are you saying? Why—why did you—?”
No words came.
I wanted to give her something better, something worthy of her, but my mind had stopped working.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You…… what kind of stupid things are you saying?
Why----why did----"
…… I can't speak clearly.
I wanted to say something more, something better, but my brain doesn't work.

entries.japanese:
だって、とても冷静じゃいられない。
　抱いているアルクェイドの体温は、もう絶望的だ。
　今メガネを外せば―――もっと絶望的なモノが、見えてしまうに違いない。
―――そんなのは。
　そんなのは、絶対に視たくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
How could I possibly stay calm?
The cold of Arcueid’s body was already beyond hope.
If I removed my glasses now, I knew I would see something even more hopeless.
―――No.
I never wanted to see that. Never.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't be calm now.
As I hold her, the lack of lingering warmth in her body tells me it's hopeless.
If I took off my glasses----there's no doubt I would see something even more hopeless.
----More than anything else,
I don't want to see that.

entries.japanese:
「どうして―――どうして、どうして―――」
　そんな言葉しか言えない。
　自分自身に苛だたしくなって、ぐっ、と。
　今までで一番強く、アルクェイドを抱きしめた。
　……抱き返してくる力はない。
　アルクェイドの体には、もうどんな力だって残ってない。
　彼女はただ、嬉しそうに、笑みをうかべるだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why—why, why—”
Those were the only words I could find.
Furious with myself, I pulled her close.
I held her more tightly than I ever had before.
…No strength answered my embrace.
There was no strength of any kind left in Arcueid’s body.
She could only smile, looking so very happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why----why, why----"
It's all I can manage to say.
Exasperated at myself,
I hold her tightly.
…… There's no embrace in response.
She doesn't have any strength left in her.
All she does is smile happily.

entries.japanese:
「うそだ―――――！」
　そう。
こんなのは、うそだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is a lie!”
Yes. None of this could be real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No------!"
This can't be happening.

entries.japanese:
「―――どうして―――どうしてこんな―――どうして一人で、コトするんだよ……！
　俺たちは仲間だろ、協力するって―――最後まで助けてやるって、ちゃんと言ったのに……！」
「……そっか……そういえば、そうだったね。
なんか……忘れちゃった」
「忘れるなよそんなコト……！
　これじゃ――これじゃ俺は最低じゃないか。
おまえを助けるって、言ったのに。
ちゃんと助けるって言ったのに―――ただの少しも、助けて、やれなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why—why do this alone!? We were partners who agreed to work together, and I told you I’d help you to the very end!”
“Oh—right, we did, didn’t we? I suppose I forgot.”
“Don’t forget something like that! This makes me the worst kind of liar. I said I’d save you. I promised I would, yet I couldn’t help you at all—not even a little.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Why----why did----why did you do it all by yourself……!
We're partners, we said we'd help each other----to the very end……!
"…… Oh yeah…… that's right, yeah.
I…… kind of forgot."
"How can you forget……!
This--this makes me useless.
I said I would help you.
I said I would definitely help you----but I couldn't even help one bit."

entries.japanese:
「……ううん、そんなコトないよ志貴。
わたし、貴方にいっぱい助けてもらったもの。
……だから助けてもらうのは……もう、いい、んだ」
　こふ、と。
　唇から血をこぼして、彼女は苦しげに笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No… that isn’t true, Shiki. You saved me so many times. So I don’t… need you to save me… anymore.”
She coughed.
Blood spilled over her lips as she smiled through the pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, that's not it at all Shiki.
You've helped me more than enough.
…… That's why… it's… enough… already."
Cough.
She coughs up blood and smiles painfully.

entries.japanese:
「……だから、お礼に、これぐらいは、しなくちゃって。
最後に、ロアから志貴を守れて、良かった」
「―――――――」
　息を飲んだ。
　……アルクェイドの目は、何も見てない。
　自分の傷口のことも、ロアがまだ生きているということも。
　……彼女の時間は。
　さっきの一撃を行った時点で、もう終わりを告げていたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I thought—I should do at least this much to thank you. I’m glad I could protect you from Roa at the end.”
“…”
My breath caught.
Arcueid’s eyes no longer saw anything.
Not her own wound, nor that Roa was still alive.
Her time.
It had already ended when she unleashed that final attack.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So… I wanted to… thank you.
In the end, I'm glad… I was able… to protect you… from Roa."
"------"
I gasp.
…… Arcueid's glazed over eyes don't see anything.
Not her wound, or even Roa who still lives.
…… Her time.
Since attacking a while ago, ended right then.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――あ、あ。
ありがと、う。
助かっ、た、」
　なんてコト。
　そんな嘘さえ、俺は、うまく言えない。
　……アルクェイドの目の色が薄れていく。
　体温が、段々とゼロになっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah… th-thank you. You saved me.”
What a pitiful thing.
I couldn’t even tell that lie properly.
…The color faded from Arcueid’s eyes.
The warmth of her body sank slowly toward nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----y-yeah.
Thanks.
Than… ks."
I can't.
I can't even lie properly.
…… The light in her eyes is fading.
Her body warmth is rapidly approaching zero.

entries.japanese:
―――失う。
　このまま彼女を喪うのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Lose her.
Was I going to lose her like this?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I'm going to lose.
Am I going to lose her like this?

entries.japanese:
「……アル、クェイド」
「―――な、に？」
「……俺の血を飲め。
そうすれば力が戻るんだろう、おまえは……！」
　……何も考えず。
ただ、そんな事を叫んでいた。
「…………」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　ただ、見落としてしまいそうなほど微かに。
　首を、横にふった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar… cueid.”
“Wh… at?”
“Drink my blood. That will restore your strength, won’t it…?”
I shouted it without thinking.
“…”
Arcueid gave no answer.
She only made the faintest movement, so slight I might have missed it.
She shook her head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ar… cueid."
"----Y, yes?"
"…… Drink my blood.
If you do that, you'll get your power back……!"
…… Not even thinking, I scream that out.
"…………"
She doesn't answer.
But slightly,
she shakes her head.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんで！？
　まさか、まだ恐いとか言ってるのか！？
　いいか、よく聞けよ。
前に言ってたよな、もしも鳥や魚に自分と同じぐらいの知性があったら食べられるかって。
　俺は食うぞ。
食わなきゃ生きていけないからな。
生きるために何かを奪うことは、自然界じゃ当たり前のことなんだろう……！」
　それは、アルクェイド自身が言った言葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why!?
Are you still afraid? Listen to me. You once asked whether I could eat birds or fish if they were as intelligent as I was.
I would. I’d have to, or I couldn’t live. Taking something else so you can survive is natural, isn’t it…?”
Those were Arcueid’s own words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Why!?
Don't tell me you're still scared?
Look, you said it before, right?
You asked what if birds or fish had the same amount of intelligence, could I eat them?
I would.
If it meant I would live, I would.
Isn't stealing things from others to live a natural law of the world……!?"
That's what she said herself back then.

entries.japanese:
なのに。
　彼女は哀しい目をして、首をふった。
entries.maoEnglish:
And yet.
She looked at me with sorrowful eyes and shook her head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
So why?
Why does she just shake her head with those pitiful eyes?

entries.japanese:
「わたし、もしもの話って、好きじゃ、ない」
　拒絶の台詞。
　それは―――俺の、口癖だったのに。
　アルクェイドは言ってたのに。
　イフは。
もしもの話は好きだって。
そこに、救いがあるような気がするからって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t like what-ifs.”
A refusal.
Even though that had always been my phrase.
Arcueid had always said the opposite.
What-ifs. She had said she liked them. They made her feel there might be some salvation in them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I… don't like… talking about 'what ifs'."
A denial.
But that was----my line back then.
But she said before…
She likes playing 'What if'.
Because it feels like there's hope.

entries.japanese:
「―――そう、か？
　おれ、俺は好きだぞ。
　たとえ詭弁っぽくてもさ。
それなりに、どこか――救いがあるような、気が」
　するじゃないか、と、言いたかった。
　けど、喉がふるえて。
　うまく発音することが、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is that so? I like them.
Even if they sound like sophistry. They still feel as if they hold some kind of salvation—”
That was what I wanted to say.
But my throat trembled.
I could not form the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Really?
I, like what ifs.
Even if it is sugarcoating things.
I feel--there's always… some hope…"
isn't there?
But I can't finish.
My throat is just so tight.
I can't… speak properly.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだったね……けど、今はそれより、もっと欲しいものが、あるんだ」
　なんだ、とふるえる声で尋ねた。
「うん……志貴にね、キスして、ほしい」
―――なんだ。
　そんな簡単なことで、いいのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right… But there’s something I want even more now.”
I asked what it was, my voice trembling.
“I want… Shiki to kiss me.”
―――Was that all?
Was something so simple truly enough?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's true…… But right now, there's… something else I want more."
With a wavering voice, I ask her what it is.
"Yeah…… I want… you to kiss me… Shiki…"
----What?
Such a simple thing?
Is that alright?

entries.japanese:
唇を重ねる。
　それは、いつかのように甘いものでもなかったし、優しいものでもなかった。
　ただ。
　冷たい唇に、自分の唇を合わせただけの、何の温かみもない、口づけ。
　そのあとに。
　本当に嬉しそうに、彼女はわらった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pressed my lips to hers.
It was neither sweet nor tender like the time before.
Only.
A kiss without warmth: my lips resting against lips gone cold.
Afterward.
She smiled with pure, unfeigned joy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I press my lips to hers.
It isn't sweet like before, or gentle.
Just,
a kiss where I press my lips against her cold lips without any warmth.
After that,
she smiles as if extremely happy.

entries.japanese:
「……よかった。
憧れてたから、こうゆうの」
「……そっか。
ヘンなものに憧れてたんだな、おまえ」
「……うん、なんだか嬉しい。
たったそれだけのことなのに、すごく気持ち良かった。
ずっと長く生きてきたけど、今ぐらい幸せに時間はなかったよ」
――――だから
「このまま消えてなくなっても、いいかなって、思えちゃった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m glad. I always dreamed of doing that.”
“I see. You dreamed about strange things.”
“Yes—now I’m happy. It was such a little thing, but it felt wonderful. I’ve lived for such a long time, yet I’ve never known a moment as happy as this one.”
――――And so—
“I think I’d be all right with simply fading away now.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I always… wanted to do… something like that."
"…… Oh?
You really like strange things."
"…… Yes, but I'm still happy.
Just that… felt so good.
I've lived for so long… but I've never been this happy like I am now."
----So
"I kind of thought to myself… maybe… disappearing like this might be good."

entries.japanese:
そんなコトを、呟いて。
　それきり、彼女の体温はなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She whispered those words.
Then all warmth left her body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After murmuring such a thing,
all warmth disappears from her body.

entries.japanese:
「アル……クェイド……？」
　返事はない。
　体は、あるのに。
　まだこんなにも柔らかいのに。
　鼓膜は、ちゃんとアルクェイドの声を覚えているのに。
―――もう、二度と。
　それらが、繰り返されるコトがなくなったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—cueid?”
There was no answer.
Her body was still here.
Still so soft in my arms.
My ears still remembered her voice perfectly.
―――Never again.
Would any of those things repeat?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar…… cueid……?"
There's no response.
Even though her body is still here…
Even though her body is still this soft…
Even though I still remember the sound of her voice in my ears…
----Never again.
None of this will ever happen again.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――――」
　何をしていたんだろう、俺は。
　……こいつを、幸せにしてやりたかったのに。
　色々なことを教えてやりたかったのに。
　色々な場所に連れまわしたかったのに。
　ずっと、一緒にいたかったのに。
　それは、永遠に叶わない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
What had I been doing?
I had wanted to make her happy.
I had wanted to show her so many things.
I had wanted to take her to so many places.
I had wanted to stay with her forever.
Now that wish could never come true.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----------"
What have I been doing?
…… I wanted to make her happy.
I wanted to teach her so many things.
I wanted to take her to so many places.
I wanted to be with her forever.
But, it can never happen.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　やられた。
　いくらなんでも、今のはない。
　唐突に、何の気の利いた言葉も言えずに、ひとりで勝手に逝かれてしまった。
　こんなんじゃ―――――一生、自分は忘れられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
She had done it to me.
Even for her, this was too cruel.
She had gone off and died without warning, all by herself, before I could find a single worthy thing to say.
After this, I would never forget her for as long as I lived.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
She's done it.
No matter how you look at it, there's nothing more.
Suddenly, before I could say the right thing, she went off and passed away by herself.
For my entire life------I won't be able to forget this.

entries.japanese:
この死を。
　気が狂ってしまったのかもしれないぐらいの、この静かな気持ちを。
　俺は、一生忘れられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I would never forget this death.
Or this terrible stillness inside me, so complete that I wondered if I had lost my mind.
I would never forget either as long as I lived.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This death.
This maddening calmness.
I'll never forget it.

entries.japanese:
かつん、と。
　今まで静観していた男の足音が聞こえた。
「終わったかい、志貴？」
「ああ、終わっちまった」
――――答えて。
　俺は、自らの敵へと振りかえった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A hard footstep clicked against the floor.
I heard the man who had watched in silence begin to approach.
“Are you finished, Shiki?”
“Yeah. It’s over.”
――――I answered.
Then I turned to face my enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tap.
I hear the footsteps of the man who was watching it all.
"Finished, Shiki?"
"Yeah, it's finished."
----Answering,
I turn towards my enemy.

entries.japanese:
月明かりの廊下で、俺たちは向かい合った。
　ロアはさっきまで彼女がいた場所から動きもしない。
　今まで黙って見ていたのも、ヤツのほうが圧倒的に優れている余裕の表れか。
entries.maoEnglish:
We confronted each other in the moonlit corridor.
Roa had not moved from the place where she had been.
Had his silence until now simply been the easy confidence of someone overwhelmingly stronger?
entries.mirrorMoon:
We face each other in the moonlit hallway.
Roa doesn't move from the spot where Arcueid was before.
He was watching everything silently, probably because he knew he was in a dominant position.

entries.japanese:
「まさか、生きているとはね」
　何事もなかったように、ロアは語りかけてくる。
―――メガネを外して、ナイフを構えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I never expected you to survive.”
Roa addressed me as casually as though nothing had happened.
―――I removed my glasses and raised the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I didn't think you were still alive."
Roa says this casually as if nothing has happened.
----I take off my glasses and ready my knife.

entries.japanese:
「死が視える人間というのは死から逃れる術に長けているらしい。
生命力の強い弱いの問題ではなくね。
―――だが。
そういうのを、一般には往生際が悪いというんだぞ」
「……生き汚いのはお互いさまだ。
俺もおまえも、一度は死にぞこなったんだからな」
　その通りだ、とロアはおかしそうに笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Perhaps a man who sees death becomes unusually adept at evading it. It has nothing to do with the strength of his life force.
―――Still. Common people would say you simply don’t know when to die.”
“Neither of us knows when to die. We’ve both failed at it once already.”
Roa laughed in amusement, conceding the point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It seems those who can see death are good at escaping death.
It isn't a matter of the strength or weakness of your life.
----However.
Normally, people call that useless effort."
"…… You're one to talk.
You and I, we've already died once."
"Exactly," Roa says as he smiles.

entries.japanese:
「死から帰ってきたものは死というものを理解できる。
私とおまえは、その中でもさらに特別な能力があったケースだ。
　私はここに到達するのに十七回もの死を体験してきたが―――おまえはただの一度だけか。
正直、才能の違いだろうな。
もしおまえに転生していたらどれほどの能力になったのか、興味深くはある」
―――余裕に満ちた、耳障りな声。
　聞いているだけで頭が痛む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Those who return from death gain an understanding of it. You and I are rarer still: our experiences produced extraordinary abilities.
I endured death seventeen times before reaching this point, while one was enough for you. Frankly, it must be a difference in talent. I confess I’m curious what power I might have acquired had I reincarnated into you.”
―――That grating voice, so swollen with confidence.
Just hearing it made my head ache.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Those returning from the dead can understand death.
You and I are special cases of that kind.
I've experienced death seventeen times before I got to this----but you've only done it once.
Honestly, it must be the difference in our latent ability.
I am really curious what kind of ability it would have been if I had reincarnated in your body."
----A bothersome, overly-composed voice.
Just hearing it makes my head hurt.

entries.japanese:
「……二つだけ聞くことがあって、一つだけ教えてやることがある」
　痛みでいっぱいになりつつある頭で、そんな事を口にした。
「―――ほう。
よかろう、言ってみろ」
　絶対的な優位からの余裕だろう。
　ロアは、楽しそうにそう返答した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I have two questions for you—and one thing to teach you.”
I said it as pain rapidly filled my head.
“Indeed? Very well—say it.”
It was the confidence of absolute advantage.
Roa answered with evident delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I have two things to ask you, and one thing to tell you."
I manage to say this while my head fills with pain.
"----Oh?
Alright, go ahead."
Probably because he's so absolutely confident in his dominating position,
Roa responds amusedly.

entries.japanese:
「……一つ目に聞くことが一番大事なんだけどさ。
　おまえ―――なんで、アルクェイドを殺した」
「何故も何もあるまい。
自分の命が狙われているんだ。
殺し返すのは当然だろう？
　もっとも―――私が欲しかったのはそんな弱りきった姫君ではなかったがね。
　今回の私なら、間違いなく姫君を生きたまま解体できたろう。
だというのに、そんな一介の吸血鬼と変わらぬ真祖をとりこんでも意味がない。
　よってとりこむ価値がないと判断し、そのまま始末をつける事にした。
こんな結果に終わったのは、私だって残念だよ」
　くく、と。
　口元をゆがめて、『敵』は笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The first question is the one that matters.
Why did you kill Arcueid?”
“Why? She intended to kill me. It was only natural that I kill her in return.
“Admittedly, I had no desire for a Princess reduced to that state.
As I am now, I could certainly have dissected her alive. But there was no value in absorbing a True Ancestor no better than an ordinary vampire.
I judged her not worth absorbing and disposed of her instead. I, too, regret that matters ended this way.”
A low chuckle.
The enemy twisted his mouth and laughed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… The first question is the most important.
You----why did you kill Arcueid?"
"Why?
She was trying to kill me, so wasn't it natural to kill her back?
Well----the one I desired wasn't this weak princess who came here.
My current self could have taken apart the princess while she lived.
But there's no point in taking in a True Ancestor no different from a regular vampire.
So I figured there was no value in taking her in, and decided to settle it.
Even I'm disappointed with the way things have turned out."
Kuku.
Twisting his lips, the "enemy" laughs.

entries.japanese:
―――頭が、痛い。
　早く―――一刻も早く、息の根を止める。
　こいつが一秒でも長く『存る』ことが、我慢できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My head hurt.
Quickly. I had to kill him—now.
I could not endure another second in which this thing continued to “exist.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
----My head, hurts.
Hurry----I have to kill him as fast as possible.
I can't stand him "existing" a single second longer.

entries.japanese:
「さて。
それで、これからどうするつもりなんだ？
　まさかその体で私とやりあおうというハラでもあるまい。
抵抗は無意味だぞ、志貴」
　……そんなコト、自分が一番わかっている。
　くらり、と眩暈がして、床にひざまずいた。
　それでも―――もう起きあがる力さえないっていうのに、凝視する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, what do you intend to do? Surely you don’t mean to fight me with that body. Resistance is meaningless, Shiki.”
…No one knew that better than I did.
Dizziness swept over me, and I fell to my knees.
Even without enough strength to rise again, I kept staring.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, what do you plan on doing now?
Don't tell me you think you can fight me in your condition?
Resisting is useless, Shiki."
…… I know that more than anyone else.
Dizziness causes me to collapse to my knees.
But still----even if I don't have any power left to even stand, I gaze at him.

entries.japanese:
「よせよせ。
いくら私の『死』を視たところで、触れられなければ意味はない。
　私はな、志貴。
おまえの能力を高く買っているんだ。
　……ふむ、どうもシキとしての人格は消えつつあるらしい。
おまえへの恨みを晴らしたものだから、今の私はシキよりではなくロアよりというコトか。
　ま、瑣末なことはどうでもいいがね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Enough. Seeing my ‘death’ is useless if you cannot reach it.
I’m telling you, Shiki. I hold your ability in the highest regard.
Hmm. SHIKI’s personality seems to be fading now; having avenged his grudge against you, perhaps I incline more toward Roa than SHIKI at present.
No matter—such details are trivial.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Enough, enough.
Even if you see my 'death', if you can't touch me it's meaningless.
You know, Shiki.
I'm rating your ability rather highly.
…… Yes, it seems SHIKI's personality is fading away.
Since he has avenged you, I'm more Roa than SHIKI now.
Well, it doesn't really matter."

entries.japanese: ロアが、かつん、と近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish: Roa came closer, each step ringing against the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon: Roa takes another step forward.

entries.japanese:
「この力は素晴らしいだろう、志貴。
　喜んでいい、直死の魔眼を持っているのは世界でも私とおまえぐらいなものだ。
その稀少能力を無くしてしまうのは惜しいし、なにより私達は同じものだ。
誰よりも互いを理解できるだろう。
　パートナーとして、これほど心強いモノはいまい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This power is magnificent, isn’t it, Shiki?
Rejoice. You and I may be the only people in the world who possess the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. It would be a pity to lose so rare an ability. More importantly, we are alike. We can understand each other as no one else can.
I could ask for no more formidable partner.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't this power wonderful, Shiki?
You should be happy.
We're probably the only ones who possess the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception in the entire world.
It would be a shame to lose such a rare ability, and more than anything else, we're the same entity.
We can understand each other more than anyone else.
There's no other partner who would assure me as you."

entries.japanese:
「……仲間になれ、っていいたいのか」
「いや。
仲間になれ、と言っているのではない。
私の仲間にしてやるんだ、この私がな。
おまえの意思なぞ知らんよ。
むしろそんなものは邪魔だろう。
　安心したまえ―――その血を吸い上げ、魂まで略奪したあと。
おまえが何のためらいもなく、自分の力を行使できる存在に昇げてやる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You want me to join you?”
“No. I am not asking you to join me. I will make you mine. Your wishes mean nothing; indeed, they would only interfere. Rest easy.
Once I have drained your blood and stolen your soul, I will elevate you into a being capable of wielding your power without the slightest hesitation.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're trying to tell me to be your partner?"
"No, not asking, I'm letting.
I don't care about what you want.
That would only get in the way.
You can relax----After I drink your blood and plunder even your soul, I'll make you into an existence where you won't hesitate to use your power."

entries.maoEnglish: ―――My teeth ground together.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The gritting of my teeth.

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
それじゃあもう一つ聞くけど。
　おまえが見ているものは、線か点のどっちだ。
いや、もっと簡単に聞く。
おまえが視えるモノは生き物だけだろ。
それ以外には視えないハズだ」
「……ん？
　当然だろう、生物でなければ命はない。
命の源である“個所”は、生き物にしかありえまい」
「――――やっぱり。
合点がいったよ、吸血鬼」
　ナイフを握る。
　頭痛は頭の中を支配してしまって、もう、視えているものは一つだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then one more question.
What do you see, lines or points? No—let me make it simpler. You only see them on living creatures, don’t you? You can’t see them on anything else.”
“What? Of course: things without life have no life to begin with. The place life comes from can exist only in a living thing.”
“I thought so. Now it all makes sense, vampire.”
I tightened my grip on the knife.
Pain had conquered my mind. There was only one thing left in my sight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Then the next question.
What you see, are they lines or points?
No, I'll make it simpler.
You can only see it on living things, right?
You can't possibly see it on anything else."
"…… Hm?
Of course, non-living things don't have any life.
Only living things have this 'place' indicating the source of life."
"----I thought so.
I understand completely, vampire."
I grip my knife.
The headache completely governs the inside of my brain, and all I can see is one thing.

entries.japanese:
「……腑に落ちんな、生きているうちの最後の言葉にしてはおまえの発言は不相応だが……まあいい、お喋りはおしまいだ。
どこぞに隠れている教会の女の始末もある。
―――喜べよ志貴。
私の下僕にしたあとの最初の相手は、おまえが頼りにしているあの女だ」
　ロアが、やってくる。
　ゆがむ視界はロアの姿を捉えていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Strange—those are hardly suitable last words, but no matter; our conversation is over. I still have that Church woman to find and dispose of.
―――Rejoice, Shiki. Once I have made you my thrall, she will be your first victim.”
Roa was coming.
My distorted vision could no longer make out his shape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're not being clear and those aren't really fitting final words…… but enough talk.
There's also the hiding woman from The Church I have to deal with.
----You're lucky, Shiki.
Once I make you my subordinate, your first opponent will be that woman you trust."
Roa approaches.
My wavering vision isn't fixated on his figure.

entries.japanese:
「――俺とおまえが視ているものは違うよ、シキ」
　頭の奥で。
　かちり、とスウィッチが入った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You and I don’t see the same thing, SHIKI.”
Deep inside my head.
A switch clicked on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--What you and I see are totally different, SHIKI."
In the back of my head,
a switch turns on.

entries.japanese:
「おまえは、ただ命を視ているだけだ。
死を理解なんかしていない。
だから俺も殺せず、弱りきった女しか殺せない」
　脳髄が、白熱する。
「―――な、に？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All you see is life. You understand nothing about death. That’s why you couldn’t kill me, and why you could only kill a woman already at death’s door.”
My brain burned white-hot.
“What…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"All you're seeing is life.
You don't understand death at all.
That's why you can't kill me, and you're only able to kill a weakened woman."
My brain reaches a white heat.
"----Wha… t?"

entries.japanese:
「死が視えているのなら、正気でなんかいられない。
おまえに解るのは物を生かしている部分だけなんだよ。
　死が視えるのなら―――とても、立ってなんていられない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you truly saw death, you couldn’t stay sane. All you recognize are the places that keep things alive.
If you saw death—there’s no way you could remain standing.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you could see death, you couldn't maintain your sanity.
All you can perceive is the part which keeps things alive.
If you could see death----you couldn't even manage to stand."

entries.japanese:
―――例えるのなら、それは月世界。
　なにもかもが死に絶えた荒野に似ている。
　目に見えるものすべてに存る死の綻び。
　触れれば消え去ってしまう世界の事象。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The nearest comparison was a world on the moon.
A wilderness where everything had died.
Every visible thing bore a fatal flaw.
The whole world was made of things that would vanish at a touch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----To give an example, it is the world on the moon.
Everything is like a desolate wasteland.
The seam of death on everything I see.
Events of the world which disappear when I touch them.

entries.japanese:
「おまえ―――なにを」
「……物事の『死』が視えるという事は、この世界すべてがあやふやで脆いという事実に投げ込まれることだ。
　地面なんて無いに等しいし、空なんて今にも落ちてきそう」
「なにを―――何の事を言っているんだ、おまえ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… what are you—?”
“To see the ‘death’ of things is to be cast into the knowledge that everything in this world is uncertain and fragile.
The ground may as well not exist. The sky looks ready to fall at any moment.”
“What are you talking about? What does any of that mean?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What----are you……"
"…… Being able to see the 'death' of things means you are forced to see the world's uncertainty and fragility.
The ground is like it's not there, and the sky seems about to fall at any moment."
"What are----what are you talking about?"

entries.japanese:
ロアの声が、動揺している。
　……それはそうだろう。
　だって、俺が言っていることを、あいつは一ミリだって理解できない。
　それはつまり―――ヤツと俺の目は、よく似ているだけでまったくの別物だという事だから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa’s voice had begun to shake.
Of course it had.
He could not understand even a fraction of what I was saying.
That proved it: his eyes and mine only resembled each other. In truth, they were entirely different things.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa's voice falters.
…… Of course.
Because he can't even understand the slightest bit of what I'm saying.
In other words----his eyes and mine may be similar, but they're completely different things.

entries.japanese:
「―――やめろ。
その目で―――その目で私を見るな」
　ロアの声に恐れが交じる。
　いみじくもヤツ自身が言っていた。
　ヒトは、未知なるものを本能的に恐れる生き物だって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop. Don’t look at me with those eyes!”
Fear entered Roa’s voice.
He had said it himself.
Human beings instinctively fear the unknown.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Stop it.
Those eyes----don't look at me with those eyes."
Fear mixes into Roa's voice.
He even said it himself.
Humans are instinctually afraid of the unknown.

entries.japanese:
「……一秒先にも世界すべてが死んでしまいそうな錯覚を、おまえは知らない。
―――それが、死を視るという事なんだ。
　この目はさ、おまえみたいに得意げに語れる力なんかじゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You don’t know the illusion that the whole world might die one second from now.
―――That is what it means to see death.
These eyes aren’t some wonderful power I could ever boast of, the way you do.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You don't know of the illusion that the whole world could perish in an instant.
----That is what it means to see death.
These eyes, this power isn't something you can boast about like you did."

entries.japanese:
そう、歩くことさえ、恐ろしかったあの頃。
　俺だって―――あの人に出会っていなければ、とうの昔にどうかしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, even taking a step had terrified me.
If I had never met that person, I would have lost my mind long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, back then, I was even scared of walking.
Even I would----If I hadn't met that person, I would have long since been insane.

entries.japanese:
「それがおまえの勘違いだ、吸血鬼。
　命と死は背中合わせでいるだけで、永遠に、顔を合わせることはないものだろ」
「だから―――その目で私を見るなと言っているだろう……！」
　走ってくる足音。
　けど、俺のほうが何倍も早い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s where you’re mistaken, vampire.
Life and death stand back to back. They can never, for all eternity, look each other in the face.”
“I told you—stop looking at me with those eyes!”
His footsteps rushed toward me.
But I was many times faster.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's your mistake, vampire.
Life and death may be back to back, but they will never face each other."
"I'm telling you----don't look at me with those eyes……!"
The sound of running footsteps.
But, I'm many times faster.

entries.japanese:
「―――教えてやる。
　これが、モノを殺すっていうことだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll teach you.
This is what it means to kill something.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I'll show you.
This is what it means to kill something."

entries.japanese:
告げて。
　たん、と廊下の『点』を突き刺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Having said it.
I drove the knife into the corridor’s “point.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that,
I thrust through the hallway's "point" on the floor.

entries.japanese:
瞬間――――渡り廊下に張り巡らされていた線が、瞬時にうねる。
「な―――――！」
　ロアの叫び声も、崩れていくガレキの音にかき消される。
entries.maoEnglish:
In that instant, every line veining the walkway writhed.
“What—!”
Roa’s cry vanished beneath the roar of collapsing debris.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Instantaneously----the lines racing through the passageway undulate.
"Wha------!"
Even the sound of Roa's screaming voice is buried amidst the crashing rubble.

entries.japanese:
渡り廊下は、文字通り殺された。
　意味をなくした塊は、瞬時に瓦解して崩れ去っていく。
　ロアにとってみれば、完全な不意打ちだったのか。
　廊下の崩壊にまきこまれ、瓦礫に潰されながら、ロアは地上へと落下していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The walkway had quite literally been killed.
Reduced to a mass without meaning, it disintegrated and fell apart in an instant.
For Roa, it must have been a complete surprise.
Caught in the collapse and crushed beneath the rubble, he plunged toward the ground below.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The passageway is literally killed.
The blocks which lost their meaning break apart and crumble away.
For Roa, it must have been a total surprise attack.
Pulled down by the destruction of the hallway and the collapsing rubble, Roa falls to the earth.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　目の前からすべて、渡り廊下は崩れ落ちた。
　痛む頭と、硝る体をこらえて、階段に向かう。
「……………」
　アルクェイドの亡骸を通りすぎて、中庭に急いだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The entire walkway had fallen away before me.
Enduring the agony in my head and my failing body, I turned toward the stairs.
“…”
I passed Arcueid’s remains and hurried down to the courtyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
In front of my very eyes, the passageway crumbles away.
Enduring the pain in my head and the burning in my body, I head to the stairs.
"……………"
I head past Arcueid's corpse and hurry to the courtyard.

entries.japanese:
……月明かりの下。
　渡り廊下のあった中庭は、一面の瓦礫の海と化していた。
　その中心に、ガラガラと動くモノがある。
「……………」
　ほんとうに、生き汚い。
　倒れこむ一歩手前の体を引きずって、そこへ移動した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beneath the moonlight.
The courtyard where the walkway had stood was now a sea of rubble.
Something shifted and rattled at its center.
“…”
He truly did not know when to die.
Dragging a body on the verge of collapse, I made my way toward him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Under the moonlight.
The courtyard under the passageway has become a sea of rubble.
In its center, something moves.
"………………"
He really is sly when dealing with death.
I pull my almost collapsing body towards it.

entries.japanese:
……たいしたものだ。
　ロアの下半身は、まるで存在していない。
　だというのに瓦礫から這い出てきたロアの上半身は、そんな事とか無関係に活動している。
　その生命力には、純粋に敬意を表するべきかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was almost impressive.
Roa’s lower body had ceased to exist.
Yet his upper half crawled from the rubble and continued functioning as though that were irrelevant.
His life force might almost have deserved my sincere respect.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… He's really something.
The lower half of Roa's body is almost completely gone.
Yet coming out from underneath the rubble, the upper half of his body still moves, ignoring that fact.
This amount of life may almost be something worthy of respect.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんだ、今のは」
　震えながら、ロアはそんなことを呟く。
　瓦礫の上を歩いて、ロアの目の前へと歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What… was that?”
Roa whispered, trembling.
I picked my way over the rubble until I stood before him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----What, was that?"
Quivering, Roa wonders aloud.
Walking on top of the rubble, I move directly in front of him.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴」
　ロアは顔をあげてこちらを見上げてくる。
　その目には、眼球から溢れ出しそうなほど、憎しみが満ちていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…”
Roa raised his face toward me.
His eyes held so much hatred it seemed ready to spill from their sockets.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki."
Roa lifts his head to look at me.
His eyes seem to practically ooze with hatred.

entries.japanese:
「―――化け物、め」
　憎々しげな怨嗟の声。
「どっちが」
　返答して、ロアの前に立った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… monster.”
The words were thick with loathing.
“Look who’s talking.”
I stopped in front of him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----You, monster."
His voice equally full of indignant hatred.
"Who is?"
Replying, I stand in front of him.

entries.japanese:
ロアの『死』は心臓のやや右よりにある。
　ナイフでとん、と突き刺す。
　紙を貫くような感覚。
その感触こそが『死』だ。
　あ
　、とロアは短い声をあげた。
　……彼も死を体験してきた男だ。
その感触をよく知っているんだろう。
「……恐ろしくはないだろう？
　おまえにとっては馴染んだ道だ。
違うところがあるとすれば、それは一つだけ」
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa’s “death” lay just to the right of his heart.
I gave the knife a light push.
It passed through with the feeling of piercing paper. That sensation was “death.”
“Ah…”
The brief sound escaped Roa.
…He, too, had experienced death. He must have known that sensation well.
“It isn’t frightening, is it? You’ve traveled this road many times before. There is only one difference.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa's "death" is just a little right of his heart.
I lightly thrust my knife forward.
A sensation like piercing paper.
That feeling is indeed "death".
Ah
Roa gives a small scream.
…… He's someone who has experienced death.
He should know this feeling really well.
"…… You're not scared, are you?
It's a path you're quite familiar with.
If there's a difference, it's only one thing."

entries.japanese: 「―――今度は、帰ってこれない」
entries.maoEnglish: “This time, you won’t return.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "----This time, you can't come back."

entries.japanese:
ナイフを抜いて、ロアに背を向けた。
　ロアはまだ死に至っていない。
　アルクェイド同様、長く生きた分死に至る過程が多少長いのだろう。
「は…………あ」
　意識が眩む。
　体も限界なら、頭はもっと限界だ。
　……アルクェイドが言っていたっけ。
　鉱物の死は、無理をして見てはいけないって。
そうすれば脳の血管が焼き切れるとかなんとか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pulled out the knife and turned my back on him.
Roa had not yet completed his death.
Like Arcueid, he had lived so long that the process took a little more time.
“Hah—ah.”
My consciousness dimmed.
If my body was at its limit, my mind had passed beyond it.
Arcueid had mentioned it.
Don’t force yourself to see the death of minerals. Something about the blood vessels in your brain burning out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I pull out my knife and turn away from Roa.
Roa isn't dead yet.
Like Arcueid, someone as long-lived as him will linger just a little longer.
I breathe weakly.
My mind wavers.
If my body is at its limits, then my head is past its limits.
…… Arcueid even said back then,
I shouldn't force myself to look at the death of non-living things.
If I do it too much, the blood vessels in my brain will burn away.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　―――そんなの、どうでもいい。
　こんなコトで良かったのなら。
　俺が廃人になるぐらいのコトでよかったのなら、もっと早く、ロアを仕留めておくんだった。
　それなら、おまえだって、あんなコトには、ならなかったのに――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――None of that mattered.
If this was all it took.
If ruining my mind was all it took, I should have finished Roa much sooner.
Then you would never have ended up like that—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
----I don't care about that.
It would have been alright.
Even if I turned myself into a vegetable, it would've been worth it to stop Roa sooner.
That way, you wouldn't… had to have----

entries.japanese:
「………！？」
　倒れた。
地面に、自分が倒れている。
　足首には痛み。
　振りかえれば、そこには――――
　上半身だけで這いずってきている、ロアの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…!?”
I had fallen. I was lying on the ground.
Pain in my ankle.
When I looked back—
Roa was there, dragging himself toward me on what remained of his upper body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………!?"
I collapse.
I fall on the ground.
My ankles are in pain.
I turn around and see----
The upper half of Roa's body which crawled this far.

entries.japanese:
「キッ、キキ、キサ、マ―――――」
　血走った目で、ずるずると、倒れた俺の体にのしかかってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y-you… you…!”
With bloodshot eyes, he hauled himself over my fallen body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y, you, you------"
With bloodshot eyes, he makes his way onto my collapsed body.

entries.japanese:
「消絵、消江る、ワタ、、、シが、キエ、留――――」
　血にまみれた両腕を、俺の首にまきつけてくる。
「ナにヲ、ナニヲ、シタ―――キエル、ナゼ、ドウ、ヤッ、テ、ワタ死を、殺シ、シシ死死し死し死、たた、たた、たたたたタたたタたた――――」
　のこぎりの刃めいた口をあけて、俺の喉へと噛みつこうとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Vanish—vanishing—I am—vanishing—”
His blood-drenched arms wound around my neck. “What—what did you do—vanishing—why—how—did you kill my death—d-deathdeathdeathdeath—did—did—dididididid—”
His mouth opened like the blade of a saw and descended toward my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fading, Disappearing, I…… am, dis, app----"
His bloody arms wrap around my neck.
"Why, why, I----disappear, hoW, DId, yoU, kILl, ME, mEeeE, mee, mEeE mEEEME EEee----"
Opening his saw-like mouth, he moves to bite my neck.

entries.japanese:
「消エ・ナイ、ワタしとオマエは、繋ガッて、いい、ル。
オマ、エニ、移レバ、マ、ダ、存在ノ鎖ハ、切れナイ………！」
　
―――牙が。
　喉に突き刺さる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I won’t vanish… You and I are con… nected. If I pass into you, the chain of my existence still won’t break…!”
―――His fangs.
Pierced my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I WoN't… disAPpeAr, yOU, aND i, ARe CoNNEcted, You SEe.
Y, ou, tRAn, sFer, mY eXisTEnce, LInks, caN nOt, be… cUT………!"
----His teeth
dig into my neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　消えた。
　ロアの体は、一瞬にしてバラバラに断ち切られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Then he was gone.
Roa’s body was hacked to pieces in a single instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
He vanishes.
Roa's body falls apart in a single instant.

entries.japanese:
「―――はい。
これで、この人を殺したのはわたしです」
　剣を手にして、息を弾ませて、先輩がそこにいる―――。
「……え？」
　ちょっと、よく、先輩の意図がわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There. Now I’m the one who killed him.”
She stood there with a sword in her hand, breathing hard.
“What…?”
I couldn’t quite understand what she meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Yes, with this, it means I'm the one who killed him."
Senpai says this, sword in hand and breathing happily----.
"…… Eh?"
I don't quite understand.

entries.japanese:
「ですから、ロアを殺したのはわたしです。
　……相手がどんなものであれ、人殺しはいけません。
あなたは、こっち側に来ちゃいけない人です。
　だから、殺したのはわたしなんです」
　両手を腰にあてて、とても偉そうに、先輩はそう言いきった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I said I killed Roa.
Taking a life is wrong, no matter what the victim may be. You must never cross over to this side. That’s why I killed him.”
She planted both hands on her hips and delivered the declaration with tremendous authority.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm saying, I'm the one who killed Roa.
…… No matter who your opponent is, you should not kill humans.
You are not someone who should come to my world.
So I'm the one who killed him."
Senpai says this haughtily as she places her hands on her hips.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
それ、詭弁だよ」
「詭弁、かな。
でも優しい嘘なら、それもいいと思います。
たとえ偽善でも、なんとなく救いがありそうじゃないですか」
「――――――」
　その言葉は、似ている。
　もしもの話なんてするなって言った時に、あいつが答えていた台詞に、似てる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel. That’s sophistry.”
“Sophistry, perhaps. But I think a gentle lie can be worthwhile. Even if it’s hypocritical, doesn’t it feel as though some small salvation might remain?”
“――――――”
Those words were familiar.
They echoed what Arcueid had said when I told her not to talk about what-ifs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
That's just sugarcoating it."
"Maybe it is.
But it is a kind lie, so isn't it okay?
Even if it is hypocrisy, doesn't it allow room for hope somehow?"
"------"
Those words are similar.
When I told her not to talk about "what ifs", she answered with something like that.

entries.japanese:
「……そう、だね。
……なんとなく―――どこか救いが、残っているのかも、しれないなら」
　それは、どんなに幸せなことだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes… I suppose so. If there might still be… some small salvation left somewhere…”
How happy that would make me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, that's right…… somehow----somewhere, if there's hope, then."
How happy can that be?

entries.japanese:
「って、そんな事はどうでもいいですよね。
大丈夫ですか遠野くん、噛まれませんでした！？」
　倒れこんだ俺を先輩は看病してくれる。
「――――――」
　意識が遠のく。
　もうこれ以上は活動したくない、と脳が休みたがっている。

「……くん……志貴…………ってば……！」
　……段々と遠くなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But never mind that! Are you all right? Did he bite you?”
She knelt to tend me where I had fallen.
“――――――”
My consciousness receded.
My brain pleaded for rest, refusing to function for another moment.
“Shiki… Shiki, come on…!”
Her voice drifted farther and farther away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, that isn't really important, is it?
Are you okay Tohno-kun?
Were you bitten!?"
Senpai rushes quickly to care for me.
"------"
My consciousness fades away.
I don't want to move anymore and my brain wants to rest.

entries.japanese:
目を開けたまま。
　ガラス細工のような月を頭上に、
　意識は完全に途絶えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
With my eyes still open.
The glasswork moon hanging overhead,
my consciousness broke off completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… kun…… Shiki………… hey…!"
…… farther and farther away.

entries.japanese:
直前に。
　パチン、とテレビのスウィッチを切った時にそっくりだな、なんてことを思いながら。
entries.maoEnglish:
Just before that happened.
I thought it felt exactly like the snap of a television being switched off.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Eyes still open,
with the glass-like moon overhead,
my consciousness completely ceases.

As it happens,
I think to myself how it seems just like a television being switched off.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、朝です。
お目覚めください」
　……聞きなれた声がする。
「志貴さま……どうかお目覚めください。
昨日に引き続き遅刻をなされると、秋葉さまとのお約束を破ることになってしまいます」
　……切迫しているのか落ち着いているのか、なかなかに判別がつきにくい声がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it’s morning. Please wake up.”
A familiar voice reaches me.
“Master Shiki—please wake up. If you are late again today, you will break your promise to Miss Akiha.”
The voice was somehow too composed to sound urgent and too urgent to sound composed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, it is morning.
Please wake up."
…… I hear a familiar voice.

"Shiki-sama…… Please wake up.
If you are late like yesterday, you will break your promise with Akiha-sama."
…… A voice partly tense, partly relaxed.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま。
よろしいのですね、今朝も秋葉さまにお叱りをうけるということで」
　……そんなの、よろしいハズがない。
「……起きる。
起きるから、ちょっと待って」
　シーツをかぶったままその返答をして、ゆっくりと目を覚ますことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Am I to understand that you wish to be scolded by Miss Akiha again this morning?”
No, that is certainly not all right.
“I’m getting up. Just give me a minute.”
I answered from beneath the sheet and began the slow process of waking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
Is it okay?
Akiha-sama will end up scolding you again."
…… No, it's not okay at all.
"…… I'm up.
I'm up, so hold on."
Still under the sheets, I respond as I slowly open my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あい、おはよう」
　ねぼけた頭で挨拶を返して、メガネをかける。
　時刻は朝の七時すぎ。
　いつも通りの時間に翡翠が起こしにきて、めずらしく目を覚ました自分がいる。
「それでは朝食の支度をいたします。
着替えがすみしだい、食堂にいらしてください」
　一礼をして、翡翠は部屋から立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Mornin’.”
I returned the greeting through the fog in my head and put on my glasses.
It was a little after seven.
Hisui had come to wake me at the usual time, and, unusually, I had actually awakened.
“I will prepare breakfast. Please come to the dining room once you have dressed.”
Hisui bowed and left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"Ah, mornin'."
I give a sleepy greeting in response and put on my glasses.
It's past seven in the morning.
Hisui came at her usual time and managed to wake me.
"I will prepare your breakfast.
After changing, please head towards the dining room."
Hisui disappears from the room after a bow.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　大きく伸びをして、ベッドから置きあがる。
　制服に着替えて、ふと、机の上に視線を投げた。
　……机の上には、あれ以来使われる事のないナイフが置かれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I gave one long stretch and climbed out of bed.
Once I had changed into my uniform, my eyes strayed to the desk.
The knife lay there, untouched since that night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I give a big yawn.
After a nice stretch, I get up from bed.
I change into my school uniform and cast a glance at my desk.
…… On top is the knife I will not ever use again.

entries.japanese:
ふわり、とカーテンがゆらいだ。
　翡翠が開けていったのだろう、窓越しの空は気持ちいいぐらいに晴れあがっている。
　ただ、吹き込む風が肌寒い。
　窓を閉めようと、窓ガラスに近づいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The curtains stirred softly.
Hisui must have opened the window; beyond it, the sky was brilliantly clear.
The breeze coming through was cold against my skin.
I walked over to close the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The curtains sway in the wind.
Hisui must have opened the window; the sky is refreshingly clear.
It's just a little cold, though.
I approach the window to close it.

entries.japanese:
―――結局。
　あの後、俺が目を覚ましたのは自分の部屋だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――In the end.
After everything that happened, I woke in my own room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----As it turned out,
I ended up waking in my own room.

entries.japanese:
先輩が運んでくれたらしく、幸いにも秋葉たちには俺が部屋を出ていったという事は知られていなかった。
　あの夜から一週間。
　遠野志貴の生活は、以前とまったく変わりがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Apparently Ciel had carried me home without Akiha or the others ever discovering that I had left my room.
A week had passed since that night.
The life of Shiki Tohno was exactly as it had been before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems Senpai carried me here.
Fortunately, Akiha and the others didn't know I left.
It's been one week since that night.
Tohno Shiki's life hasn't changed a bit from what it was before.

entries.japanese:
秋葉との関係は、多少、なんとなく気まずいものがあるものの、やっぱり兄と妹なわけで。
　学校のほうは渡り廊下を修理中という事を除けば以前と何一つ変わっていない。
　……いや、変わったか。
　学校には、シエルなんていう名前の先輩はどこにもいないし、誰も覚えてさえいない。
　街を騒がしていた通り魔事件もあれから一件だって起きていない。
犯人が捕まったわけではないので相変わらず夜の街は寂しいけれど、あと一ヶ月もすればもとの夜に戻るだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Things with Akiha were a little awkward in ways neither of us could quite name, but we were still brother and sister.
School was unchanged too, apart from the enclosed walkway being under repair.
No—something had changed.
There was no upperclassman named Ciel anywhere in the school, and no one even remembered her.
Nor had there been a single new killing in the series that had terrorized the city. The culprit had never been caught, so the streets remained deserted at night, but in another month they would probably return to normal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My relationship with Akiha is a bit uneasy at times, but of course we're brother and sister.
Except for that passageway being repaired, the school has not changed at all.
…… No, it did change.
At school, there's no senpai called Ciel anywhere, nor does anyone remember her.
The instances of serial murders haven't occurred once since then.
Since there's been no official arrest, the city streets are still relatively empty at night, but it'll probably return to normal in a month.

entries.japanese:
俺は、結局。
　胸の中に埋めようのない穴を持ったまま、それでも以前のようにやっていけている。
　……というか、耐えていけている。
　時折、何の拍子もなく思い出してしまうとそれこそどうしようもなくなるけど、まだ気が触れる事はなさそうだ。
　いつか。
　この思いに耐えきれなくなってどうにかなってしまうのか、それともそれにさえ慣れて、普通に暮らしていけるようになるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
And I was still here.
There was a hole in my chest that nothing could ever fill, yet somehow I continued living as before.
Or rather, I endured.
Sometimes a stray thought brought everything back and left me helpless—but I did not seem to be losing my mind just yet.
Someday, perhaps the grief would become unbearable and break me.
Or perhaps I would grow accustomed even to this and learn to live an ordinary life again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As for me,
I carry an unfillable void in my heart, but I continue on as I did before.
…… Or rather, I can bear it all.
At times, I get overwhelmed when I am assailed by memories, but I don't think I'll go insane or anything for now.
Some day.
Will I go crazy after not being able to bear these memories, or will I just return to living normally after getting used to them?

entries.japanese:
まあ、確率は半分半分だと思う。
―――ただ、それまでは。
　女々しいだろうけど、あいつとの最後の約束を毎日のように守っている自分がいたりするわけだ。
「――――秋も、じき終わりかな」
　外は、息がつまりそうなほど蒼い空。
　一度だけ大きく深呼吸をして、窓ガラスをぱたんと閉めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I gave either outcome even odds.
―――But until then.
Pathetic as it might be, I found myself keeping my final promise to her almost every day.
“――――Autumn will soon be over.”
Outside, the sky was blue enough to steal my breath.
I drew one deep lungful of air, then gently shut the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Perhaps it's about a fifty-fifty chance.
---But until then,
even if it is a little girlish, I keep the final promise I made with her every day.
"----Autumn is drawing to a close, isn't it?"
The blue sky outside is enough to take my breath away.
Taking a large, deep breath, I shut the window.

entries.japanese:
授業が終わって、教室に誰も居なくなっても、日が落ちるまでは屋敷には帰らない。
　赤い教室。
　窓の向こうには燃えるような夕暮れが広がっている。
　深空に沈むように、真っ赤な太陽がとけていく。
「―――――」
　ずっと、こうして待っている。
　彼女との約束を覚えていて、それを忘れられないかぎり、ずっとここで待ち続ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even after classes ended and the classroom emptied, I never returned to the mansion before sunset.
A red classroom.
Beyond the windows, the evening burned.
The scarlet sun dissolved as if sinking into the deepest reaches of the sky.
“…”
I waited here day after day.
As long as I remembered my promise to her—as long as I could not forget it—I would go on waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Classes end and the classroom empties, but I won't leave until the sun sets completely.
The red classroom.
The burning sunset spreads outside the window.
The sun flushes red as it sinks deep in the sky.
"------"
I'll always be waiting here.
I'll remember my unforgettable promise; I'll continue waiting here forever.

entries.japanese:
一つだけ、果たせなかった約束がある。
「全部終わったあと―――吸血鬼を倒し終わったらさ。
別れる前に、もう一回だけこうして遊ばないか？」
　彼女は、不思議そうに首をかしげていたっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was one promise I had been unable to keep.
“When everything is over—after we defeat the vampire—why don’t we spend another day like this before we part?”
She had tilted her head, puzzled.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's still one promise I haven't been able to fulfill.
"When this is all over----when we're done defeating this vampire… Before we part, can't we do something like this just once more?"
Back then, she tilted her head to the side in confusion.

entries.japanese:
「だからさ―――本当に、何の義務もなくなったあとでさ、ただ意味もなく会えたらどうなるかなって、そう思っただけ」
　……言葉では、そんな事を口にして。
　心の中では、ただ、彼女のことだけを考えていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I wondered… once there are no obligations left between us, what it would be like to meet again for no reason at all.”
…That was what I had said aloud.
In my heart, I had been thinking only of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So----I really was wondering, what would happen if we were to meet again without any responsibilities… if we just met for no particular reason."
…… When I said those words,
I was only thinking about her.

entries.japanese:
「おまえが忙しいっていうんなら別にいいけど。
俺もたんに思いついただけだからさ」
　……ただ。
　協力しあう者同士とかいうんじゃなくて。
　気が合う友人同士として、本当になにげなく、
　ただ当たり前の思い出を作ってやれたら。
　きっと、彼女は喜ぶって思えたあの時。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you’ll be busy, forget it. It only occurred to me just now.”
Only.
Not as partners bound by a common task.
But as friends who liked each other, meeting casually—
If only we could make an ordinary memory together.
In that moment, I had been certain it would make her happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----If you're too busy, then it's okay.
I only thought of it just now, anyway."
…… Just…
Not as two people cooperating,
but as two friends who got along, not doing anything in particular.
If we could create some normal memories like that,

I knew she would be happy.

entries.japanese:
うん―――！
　ぜんぶ終わったら、またここに来ようね志貴！
　なんの意味もないけど、それはきっと、きっとすごく楽しいよ―――
　呆然と目を見開かせたあと、こくん、と頷いて。
　夕焼けの教室の中。
　彼女は、まっすぐな笑顔をしてそう約束した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes—! When it’s all over, let’s come back here, Shiki!
It won’t mean anything, but it’ll surely—surely be so much fun—
After staring at me in astonishment, she had nodded.
There in the sunset classroom.
She gave me that promise with an open, radiant smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Okay----!
When everything's over, let's come here again, Shiki!
It won't have any meaning, but I'm sure it will be really, really fun!
---
After her eyes widened in surprise, she nodded.
In the classroom bathed by the sunset,
Arcueid smiled and made that promise with me.

entries.japanese:
―――その約束を、覚えている。
―――その笑顔を、覚えている。
―――なにもかも、覚えている。
　忘れられない。
　忘れてなんかやらない。
　燃えるような教室の中、ここにまた来ようって約束したのを、ずっとずっと覚えている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I remembered the promise.
―――I remembered that smile.
―――I remembered everything.
I could not forget.
I would not let myself forget.
In that blazing classroom, we had promised to meet here again, and I would remember it forever—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I remember that promise.
---I remember that smile.
---I remember everything.
I can't forget.
I won't forget.
I'll always, always remember the promise we made in the room ablaze with the sunset to meet here again----

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　深く沈んでいく。
　この朱色が消え去るまでの数時間。
　真紅の空気がなくなるまでの静かな時間。
　永遠にも一瞬にも感じられる、止まった世界。
　もしかすると、とっくに自分は気が触れているのかもしれない。
　来るはずのない相手を待っているっていうのに、心はひどく落ち着いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I sank deeper into the stillness.
For the few hours until the vermilion faded.
For the quiet span until the crimson drained from the air.
A motionless world that felt at once eternal and fleeting.
Perhaps I had already gone mad.
I was waiting for someone who could never come, yet my heart was utterly calm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
The sun sinks further.
These hours until the vermillion fades completely,
the quiet time until the crimson sky disappears.
This eternal, fleeting instant of a world standing still.
Maybe I am already crazy.
Even though I'm waiting for someone who will never come, my heart is horribly calm.

entries.japanese:
―――カタン。
　何かが机に触れる音。
　視線を移す。
　窓ガラスが開いている。
　気がつけば。
　赤い陽射しに染まった、彼女が窓際に立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Clack.
Something touched a desk.
I looked over.
The window was open.
Before I knew it.
She stood at the window, dyed red by the setting sun.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Clatter.
The sound of something touching a desk.
I look.
A window is open.
I realize that,
painted in red sunlight, she is standing by the window.

entries.japanese:
彼女は、決して窓際から動こうとはせず、そこにいた。
　ちゃんと目の前にいるのに、
　幻なんかじゃないのに、
　絶対に手が届くことがない隔たりを感じさせて。
「―――――――」
　声が出ない。
　けど、気持ちはひどく落ち着いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
She remained by the window, making no move to come closer.
She was truly before me,
No illusion at all,
Yet she felt separated by a distance I could never cross. “―――――――”
I could not speak.
But my heart was strangely calm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She doesn't move at all, but she's there.
She's right in front of me;
she's not an illusion.
But, I feel like there is a distance which can never be spanned between us.
"------"
I can't speak.
But, I feel so terribly calm now.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったなあ。
本当はそっと消えるつもりだったんだけど、志貴、いつまでも待ってるんだもん。
放っておけないから、出てきちゃった」
　照れたように、彼女ははにかんだ笑顔をする。
「……まあな。
言っただろ、おまえとの約束は二度と破らないって」
「そうだったね。
ありがと、約束を守ってくれて」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is embarrassing. I meant to disappear quietly, but you kept waiting and waiting. I couldn’t leave you like that, so here I am.”
She smiled, shy and flustered.
“Of course I waited. I told you I’d never break another promise to you.”
“You did. Thank you for keeping it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
I really was planning on disappearing, Shiki, but you'd just wait forever.
I couldn't just leave you alone like that, so I came here."
She smiles bashfully.
"…… Well, you know.
I did say I was never going to break a promise with you again."
"That's true.
Thanks for keeping that promise."

entries.japanese:
「でも、ごめんね。
今度はわたしのほうが約束を守れない」
「……なんで？」
　……自分でも驚く。
　怒るのでもなく縋るのでもなく、本当に優しい声で、彼女にそう問いただせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I’m sorry. This time, I’m the one who can’t keep the promise.”
“Why?”
I surprised myself.
There was no anger in my voice and no pleading—only genuine tenderness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I'm sorry.
It seems this time that I'm the one who won't be able to keep it."
"…… Why?"
…… I'm surprised myself.
I ask her this in a truly gentle voice, without any anger at all.

entries.japanese:
「……うん。
志貴にはわたしがロアを追いかけている理由を話してなかったよね。
　その、実はね。
わたし、ずっと昔に一度だけ人間の血を吸ったことがあったの。
その時に自分の力の一部をその人間に奪られてしまって、そいつはすごく強力な死徒になって。
　結局、わたし以外の真祖はみんなそいつに殺されちゃった」
―――それは、つまり。
「……それが、ロア？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I never told you why I was hunting Roa, did I?
A very long time ago, I drank human blood once. That human stole part of my power and became an extraordinarily powerful Dead Apostle.
In the end, he killed every other True Ancestor.”
―――That meant—
“That was Roa?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I never did tell you my reason for pursuing Roa.
Actually, a long time ago, I once drank human blood.
At that time, the human stole some of my powers and became an incredibly strong Dead Apostle.
In the end, he ended up killing all the other True Ancestors except for me."
---Then, that means…
"…… You mean, Roa?"

entries.japanese:
「そう。
その時まで、わたしは吸血衝動っていうものを知らなかった。
他の真祖たちも、わたしにだけは無いんだって信じてたみたい。
　けど、わたしは単に来るのが遅かっただけ。
その時まで―――わたし、自分が吸血種だなんてことを知らなかった。
　だから―――アレが、いけないコトなんだっていうことも、わからなかった」
　……そうか。
　何一つ余分なことを教えられなかった彼女は、自分が殺してまわる相手と同じものだということさえ、教えられなかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Until then, I had never known a vampiric impulse. The other True Ancestors believed I alone had been born without one.
But mine had simply come late. Until that day, I never even knew I belonged to a vampiric species.
So I didn’t understand that what I did was wrong.”
Of course.
They had taught her nothing beyond what they considered necessary—not even that she was the same kind of creature as those she had been made to hunt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Until that time, I never knew about the vampiric impulse.
The other True Ancestors also believed I did not have it.
But, it was too late.
Until then----I didn't even know I was a vampire.
So----I didn't even know it was something I shouldn't do."
…… I see.
Never having been taught anything extra, she wasn't even taught she was the same as those she killed.

entries.japanese:
「たった一度の過ちで、わたしはみんな壊してしまった。
……だから二度と人の血は吸わない。
　けど一度でも血を吸ってしまった真祖は、人の血を吸わないと正気でいられなくなってしまう」
「――――」
「……わたしがこうしていられるのはね、志貴がロアを完全に『殺』してくれたから。
　今までわたしが何度あいつを消滅させても、消えるのは肉体だけで魂までは殺せなかった。
　けど、志貴はあいつの存在そのものを殺してくれた。
だから―――あいつに奪われていた力が戻ってきて、なんとか蘇生することができたんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“One mistake destroyed all of them. So I will never drink human blood again.
But once a True Ancestor has tasted blood, she can no longer remain sane without it.”
“…”
“The only reason I can stand here now is that you completely ‘killed’ Roa.
Every time I destroyed him before, I could erase his body but never kill his soul.
You killed his very existence. The power he had stolen returned to me, and with it I barely managed to regenerate.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because of just one mistake, I destroyed everyone.
…… So I won't drink human blood again.
But, a True Ancestor that has drank blood once cannot remain sane without doing it again."
"----"
"…… I can only be here because you completely "killed" Roa.
Even though I annihilated him so many times, it was only his flesh and not his soul.
But you killed his existence completely, Shiki.
So----the power he stole returned to me and I somehow managed to revive."

entries.japanese:
「―――そ――――な、コト」
「でも、それが精一杯。
わたしの中の吸血衝動は、もう抑えきれないところにまでやってきちゃった。
　だから――――」
「―――そんなコト―――どうでも、いい」
「……志貴とは、もう会えない。
約束、破っちゃって、ごめん」
　……そんなコトは、どうでもいいんだ。
　ただ俺は―――おまえに、傍にいてほしいだけで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That… can’t…”
“But that was the limit. My vampiric impulse has grown beyond anything I can suppress. So—”
“I don’t care about any of that.”
“I can’t see you again, Shiki. I’m sorry I broke our promise.”
…None of that mattered.
I only wanted her to stay beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That----doesn't……"
"But, that's all I can do.
I can no longer resist the vampiric impulse inside of me.
So----"
"---That---doesn't, matter."
"…… Shiki, I can't see you again.
Sorry for breaking our promise."
…… That doesn't matter to me.
I just---want you to be by my side, that's all.

entries.japanese:
「……約束、守れるよ」
「志貴……？」
「俺の血を吸え。
そうすれば――おまえは約束を守れる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You can still keep it.”
“Shiki…?”
“Drink my blood. Then you can keep your promise.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can keep your promise."
"Shiki……?"
"Drink my blood.
If you do--you can keep your promise."

entries.japanese:
ただ、時間だけが流れる。
　お互い、何も言えない。
　本当にどうかしてしまいそうな沈黙のあと。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time passed.
Neither of us could speak.
After a silence long enough to drive us mad—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Time passes by.
Neither of us says anything.
And after a truly maddening silence…

entries.japanese:
「―――そっか。
けど、やっぱりいいや。
志貴の血はいらないよ」
「なんで。
俺の血じゃだめなのか。
俺の血を吸えない理由なんか、あるのか」
　うん、と頷いて。
「好きだから、吸わない」
　そう、彼女は咲き誇る花のような笑顔で告げた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. But no. I don’t want your blood after all.”
“Why? Is my blood not good enough? What possible reason could keep you from drinking it?”
She nodded.
“Because I love you, I won’t.”
She said it with a smile like a flower in full bloom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I see.
But, I can't.
I don't need your blood, Shiki."
"Why?
Is my blood not good?
Do you have a reason for not drinking it?"
She nods.
"I like you, so I won't."
She smiles like a flower blooming triumphantly.

entries.japanese:
「…………………っ」
　大きく息を吸いこんで。
　ただ、気持ちだけを抑えつけた。
　止めたかった。
　止めたかった。
　止めたかった。
　止めたかった。
――――例え殺してでも、止めたかった。
　けど、その笑顔があまりにも華やかすぎて。
　俺のわがままな思いで、汚すことだけはできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I drew a deep breath.
And forced my feelings down.
I wanted to stop her.
I wanted to stop her.
I wanted to stop her.
I wanted to stop her.
――――I wanted to stop her even if I had to kill her.
But her smile was too brilliant.
I could not stain it with my own selfish longing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I suck in a large amount of air,
and just try to suppress this feeling.
I want to stop her.
I want to stop her.
I want to stop her.
I want to stop her.
----Even if I have to kill her, I want to stop her.
But, her smile is just too gorgeous.
I can't selfishly bring myself to ruin it.

entries.japanese:
「――さよなら。
今まで本当にありがとう、志貴」
「………………」
　喉がふるえて、声が出ない。
　それでも―――お別れを、言わないと。
「……俺は、嘘つきだ」
「どうして？
　志貴は約束を守ってくれたよ」
「―――どうしようもない嘘つきだ。
　おまえを……幸せにするって、言ったのに」
　そう、誓ったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye. Thank you for everything, Shiki.”
“…”
My throat shook, and no voice came.
Even so, I had to say goodbye.
“I’m a liar.”
“Why? You kept your promise.”
“I’m a hopeless liar.
I said… I would make you happy.”
I had sworn it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Goodbye.
I really am grateful for everything, Shiki."
"………………"
My throat trembles, and no sound comes out.
But still----I have to say goodbye.
"…… I'm, a liar."
"Why?
You kept your promise, Shiki."
"----Just a worthless liar.
I…… said I would make you happy."
Yes, I vowed to.

entries.japanese:
「……ううん、そんなコトない。
　わたしはこれから眠り続けるけど、その間に志貴の夢を見る。
貴方と過ごした時間はすごく楽しかった。
だから、その時の夢をずっと見るの」
「――――――」
「なんの意味もないけど、それはきっと、きっとすごく楽しいよ。
　だからね、志貴。
わたしは幸せだよ。
志貴はちゃんと、わたしに幸せをくれたんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you aren’t.
I’m going to sleep now, and I’ll go on sleeping—but while I sleep, I’ll dream of you. Every moment I spent with you was wonderful, so I’ll dream of those days forever.”
“…”
“It won’t mean anything, but it’ll surely—surely be so much fun.
So, Shiki, I am happy. You truly did give me happiness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, not at all.
I will sleep from now on, but I will always be dreaming of you.
I enjoyed our time together so much, I will always be dreaming about it."
"------"
"It won't have any meaning, but I'm sure it will be really, really fun.
So Shiki, I really am happy.
You really did make me happy."

entries.japanese:
「く………………っ！」
　喉がつまる。
　そんなもの―――そんなものを、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
My throat closed.
That—that was not what I wanted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn…………"
My throat is filled up.
I don't----I don't want such a…

entries.japanese:
「……優しいね、志貴。
うん、やっぱり最後にお別れを言いに来てよかった。
　わたし、志貴のことを愛してる。
正直で、ぼんやりしてて、わたしにだけうるさくて、前向きだった貴方を愛してる。
　だから、お願い。
これからもずっと、そのままで生きていってね」
　ほんの一瞬。
　哀しそうに、彼女は笑って。
　ばいばいと手をふって、夕暮れに融けるように、俺の前から消え去った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re so kind, Shiki. Yes, I’m glad I came to say goodbye.
I love you, Shiki. I love how honest and absentminded you are, how you nag only at me, and how you always keep moving forward.
So I’m asking you. Go on living exactly as you are.”
For one brief instant.
She smiled sadly.
Then she waved goodbye and vanished from before me, dissolving into the sunset.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You really are kind, Shiki.
Yeah, I knew coming here to say goodbye was a good thing.
I love you, Shiki.
Your honesty, how you are always spaced out, how I'm the only one you yell at, how you always look forward to the future… I love all of you.
So please, keep living like that, okay?"
For just an instant,
she smiles sadly.
She waves her hand, and as if fading into the sunset itself, she disappears before my very eyes.

entries.japanese:
「…………………っ」
　必死に歯を噛んで、堪えた。
　彼女が最後まで笑顔だったから、せめて、涙を流すことなんて、したくなかった。
―――教室には誰も居ない。
「………そっか。
約束、守ったじゃないか、おまえ」
　この教室で。
　夕暮れの教室でまた会おうっていう約束は、ちゃんと守られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I clenched my teeth and endured.
She had smiled until the very end. At the very least, I did not want to cry.
―――The classroom was empty.
“I see… You did keep your promise after all.”
Here in this classroom.
Our promise to meet again here at sunset had been kept.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I grit my teeth, trying to hold it in.
She was smiling until the very end, so at least I didn't want to cry.
---The classroom is empty.
"……… I see.
You, really did keep your promise."
In this classroom.
Our promise to meet again in the classroom as the sun set.
She definitely kept it.

entries.japanese:
……失ったものがあるけれど、これで、終わったんだ。
　あいつと知りあって、駆けぬけるような時間が、ここできちんと幕を下ろした。
　考えてみれば、別れはいつだってある。
　俺とあいつの場合、それが早かったということだけ。
　そう思えば、これは満足のいく別れだった。
　あいつは生きていたんだし、幸せだと、言ってくれた、の、だ、し。
entries.maoEnglish:
…Something had been lost, but now it was over.
The breathless days that began when I met her had finally come to a proper close here.
When I thought about it, every meeting ended in parting.
Ours had simply come sooner than most.
Seen that way, perhaps it had been a farewell I could accept.
She had been alive. She had said she was happy. She had… said…
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There are some things I lost, but it is now over.
The curtain has fallen cleanly over the time I knew her, the time I ran through with her.
Come to think of it, a farewell is always there.
In our case, our farewell was only early.
Thinking of it that way, this was a really satisfying farewell.
She was still alive, and she told… me… she's… still… happy…

entries.japanese:
「……うそだ……！
　そんなんじゃない、そんなモノを―――俺は、望んだんじゃない………！」
―――そう。
　もっと―――
　もっと、一緒にいたかった。
　もっと話をしたかった。
　もっと体温を感じたかった。
　もっと――――もっと、あの笑顔を、見ていたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s a lie…! This isn’t right. This isn’t what I wanted…!”
―――That’s right.
I wanted more.
More time beside her.
More conversations.
More of her warmth.
More—more of that smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No……!
Not like this, this isn't----what I wanted……!"
---Right.
More---
I wanted to be with her more.

I wanted to talk with her more.
I wanted to feel the warmth of her body more.
More----I wanted to see her smile more.

entries.japanese:
ずっと。
　今なんかよりずっと――――彼女を、幸せに、してやりたかったのに。
　なのに、あいつは。
　最後まで笑顔で、俺に、生きていけだなんて、残していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Forever.
I had wanted to make her happier—far happier than this.
And yet.
She had smiled until the end and left me with nothing but an order to keep living.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Always.
Not like this, but always----I wanted to make her happy.
But, she…
Smiling to the end, she left me behind, telling me to live.

entries.japanese:
「……ばか……やろう……」
　それが彼女の最後の望みだった。
　どんなに辛くても―――今は誤魔化して誤魔化して、いつか思い出と振りかえれる時まで、前向きに生きていってと、笑顔で残した。
「っ……………！」
　そんな事、できるはずがない。
　俺には―――そうやって生きていく自信なんて、これっぽっちもないっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… idiot…”
That had been her final wish.
No matter how much it hurt, she had left me with a smile and asked me to keep muddling through for now—to face forward and go on living until I could someday look back on this as a memory.
“Ghh…!”
Impossible.
I had no confidence at all that I could live that way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That stupid…… idiot……"
That was her final wish.
With a smile, she told me no matter how hard it is----even if I have to deceive myself right now, until I can finally see it all as simply a memory, to keep looking forward to the future and live.
"Tch…………!"
There's no way I can do that.
I---I don't have the slightest confidence to live like that.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　それでも彼女が幸せな夢を見ていられるように。
　せめて、それぐらいは叶えてやらなくちゃ、いけないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Even if only to let her dream happily.
Did I have to grant her at least that much?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Still, so that she can see a happy dream,
I have to at least grant her wish.

entries.japanese:
「…………あ」
　気がつけば、とっくに日は沈んでいる。
　真紅だった空気は消えて、空は青く青く染まっていた。
　暗い夜空。
　螺旋を描くような雲と、ただ白く輝く月。
―――残ったものはそれだけ。
　けど、とても美しい、記憶。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
By the time I noticed, the sun had long since set.
The crimson had drained from the air, leaving the sky steeped in blue.
A dark night sky.
Clouds curling in a spiral, and a moon that shone pure white.
―――That was all that remained.
And yet it was a memory of extraordinary beauty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Ah."
I realize the sun has long since sank.
The crimson sky is painted over in a dark blue.
The dark night sky.
The spiral wisps of clouds and a bright, white moon.
---They are all that's left.
But, an extremely beautiful memory.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　はあ、と。
　長く、祈るように、大きく息をはいた。
　もう彼女はいないけれど。
　言い忘れていた事を、口にしないといけない。
「じゃあな。
……俺も、すごく、楽しかった」
　随分と遅れた別れの言葉が教室に残響する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
A sigh.
I let out one long breath, deep as a prayer.
She was gone.
But I still had to say what I had forgotten to tell her.
“Goodbye. I had… a wonderful time too.”
The belated farewell echoed through the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
*sigh*
I exhale slowly, as if praying.
She may no longer be here,
but I have to say what I forgot to say earlier.
"Goodbye.
…… I had a lot of fun too."
Those extremely late words of farewell echo through the classroom.

entries.japanese:
夜空には、ガラスのような月だけがある。
　遠い、触れれば壊れそうな蒼い月。
　それをいつまでも―――夜が明けるまで、いつまでも見上げていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only the glasslike moon remained in the night sky.
A distant blue moon that looked ready to shatter at a touch.
