I gazed up at it without end—until the night gave way to dawn.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Only the glass-like moon hangs in the night sky.
The distant blue moon looking as if it would shatter if touched.
For a long time---until dawn, I keep looking up at it.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイド・トゥルーエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　トゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングがそれです。
　どちらかのエンディングに辿り着いた後、少しだけ戻ってもう一度物語を進めてみてください。
　なにか違った展開が待っている事でしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Arcueid’s True Ending.
Each heroine has two endings, with one exception.
They are the True Ending and the Good Ending.
Once you reach either one, go back a little and play through the story again.
A different turn of events should be waiting for you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Arcueid's True Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings,
a True Ending and a Good Ending.
After reaching one of the endings, please go back a little and readvance through the story.
A different event should await you.

entries.japanese:
さて、それではここまでプレイしていただいてありがとうございました。
　また“月姫”のどこかでお会いしましょう！
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for playing this far.
I hope we meet again somewhere in TSUKIHIME!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well then, thank you very much for playing up to this point.
Let's meet again somewhere in Tsukihime.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイド・グッドエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　トゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングがそれです。
　どちらかのエンディングに辿り着いた後、少しだけ戻ってもう一度物語を進めてみてください。
　なにか違った展開が待っているかもしれませんよー
entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Arcueid’s Good Ending.
Each heroine has two endings, with one exception:
a True Ending and a Good Ending.
Once you reach either one, go back a little and play through the story again.
There just might be a different turn of events waiting for you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Arcueid's Good Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings,
a True Ending and a Good Ending.
After reaching one of the endings, please go back a little and readvance through the story.
A different event should await you.

entries.japanese:
あ、その他にですね。
　一人でもクリアしたデータがあるのなら、一日目からやり直して見るのもいいかもしれません。
　何か違った選択肢が増えていたりいなかったり。
　それでは、ここまでプレイしていただいてありがとうございました。
　また“月姫”のどこかでお会いしましょう！
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh, and one more thing.
Once you have completion data for even one heroine, you may want to start over from day one.
There might—or might not—be a new choice waiting for you.
Thank you for playing this far.
I hope we meet again somewhere in TSUKIHIME!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh, and another thing.
If you have save data where you cleared at least one heroine, it may be a good idea to restart from the first day.
You may have more choices than before.
Well then, thank you very much for playing up to this point.
Let's meet again somewhere in Tsukihime.

entries.japanese:
坂の上の屋敷から、学校に向かって歩いていく。
　日常はさしたる変化もなく、朝は平穏な空気に包まれている。
　じき秋も終わって、冬がやってくる。
　夏のように暑いわけでもなく、冬のように寒いわけでもない、この曖昧な季節が変われば。
　少しは、この透明なままの気持ちも変わってくれるのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I walk down from the estate on the hill toward school.
Nothing much has changed in my daily life, and the morning air is peaceful.
Autumn will soon be over, and winter will come.
Perhaps this uncertain season—neither hot like summer nor cold like winter—will finally change.
Then perhaps this crystalline numbness inside me will change a little too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start walking from the mansion atop the hill towards school.
Like any other day, the morning is wrapped in tranquility.
Autumn is almost over and winter is close by.
Perhaps when this vague season in between the heat of summer and the chill of winter changes,
maybe this transparent feeling will also change.

entries.japanese:
学校に近付くにつれ、学生服姿の生徒たちを多く見かけるようになってくる。
　今日は土曜日ということもあって、たいていの生徒は笑顔で道を歩いていっている。
　この交差点を抜けてしばらくすれば正門だ。
　遠野の屋敷に引っ越してから、じき一ヶ月。
　この登校路もいいかげん馴染んでしまった。
　信号器が赤になって、横断歩道の前で立ち止まる。
「…………」
　ここでこうやって信号で止まるたびに思い出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
The closer I get to school, the more students I see in uniform.
Since it’s Saturday, most of them are walking along smiling.
Once I cross this intersection, the front gate is only a little farther.
It has been almost a month since I moved into the Tohno mansion.
By now, even this route to school has become familiar.
The signal turned red, and I stopped at the crosswalk.
“…”
Every time the light stops me here, I remember.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I see more figures of students in uniforms the closer I get to school.
Today is Saturday so most of them are smiling as they walk along the road.
Once I pass this intersection, I'll reach the front gate.
It will soon be a month since I came back to the Tohno mansion.
I've already become well used to this route by now.
The traffic light turns red and I stand in front of the crosswalk.
"…………"
Every time I stop here, I remember.

entries.japanese:
思えば、あの時。
　この交差点で、あそこに今あいつが待ってるみたいに、アルクェイドはガードレールに腰をかけて遠野志貴を待っていたんだ。
「―――――え？」
　思わず、声をあげた。
　車がせわしなく走っていく道路に、いつかとまったく同じ光景が広がってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back then, at this very intersection.
Arcueid had sat on the guardrail waiting for Shiki Tohno—just as she seemed to be waiting there now.
“―――――What?”
The sound escapes me before I know it.
Beyond the stream of impatient traffic lies exactly the same sight I saw that day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That one time.
At this intersection, Arcueid was waiting for Tohno Shiki back then as she sat on the guardrail, just like she is doing now.
"-----Eh?"
I say without even thinking.
Between the cars rushing by, a scene unfolds just like before.

entries.japanese:
「─────な」
　そこにいたのは、彼女だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh—”
She was there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Wha……"
She's there.

entries.japanese:
肩口までの金の髪に白い服。
　細く長い眉と赤い瞳。
―――もう、何があったって見間違えるはずのない、消えてしまったはずの姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
Golden hair brushing her shoulders, and white clothes.
Long, fine brows and red eyes.
―――The figure I could never mistake again, no matter what happened—the figure that was supposed to have vanished.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Dressed in white, with golden hair down to her shoulders.
Long, slender eyebrows over crimson eyes.
---Her figure I could never mistake for anyone else no matter what.
This figure that has already vanished long ago.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　信号が青に変わる。
　生徒たちが流れていく。
　その中で。
　俺だけが立ち止まって、彼女だけが、俺に気がついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
The light turns green.
Students pour across the street.
Amid them all.
Only I remain still—and only she notices me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
The light turns green.
The students around me start moving.
In the midst of it.
I am the only one who stands still and she is the only one who notices I am here.

entries.japanese:
やっほー、なんて声が似合いそうな笑顔をして、アルクェイドは道路を横断してくる。
「――――――」
　声が出ない。
　気持ちがいっぱいで、何をしていいか、わからない。
―――例え、これが質の悪い幻でも。
　もう一度あいつの姿を見れて、涙が出るくらい、喜んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid crosses the road with a smile that seems to call out a cheerful hello.
“…”
I can’t speak.
My heart is too full for me to know what to do.
―――Even if this is some cruel hallucination.
The sight of her again makes me so happy I could cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She has her typical smile as she crosses the intersection.
"------"
I can't speak.
I'm so overwhelmed with emotion I don't even know what to do.
---Even if, this is just some sort of bad illusion,
I'm so happy just to see her again I could cry.

entries.japanese:
「こんにちは。
これから学校なの、学生さん？」
　……信じられない。
　幻は、声までうりふたつだった。
「志貴？
　ねえ、なんで黙ってるのよ。
もしかしてわたしのこと忘れちゃった？」
　下から、上目遣いで覗きこんでくる赤い瞳。
　……忘れるはずが、ない。
　けど、それと同じぐらいに、彼女が、こうして生きているはずがないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hello. On your way to school, young man?”
I can’t believe it.
Even the hallucination’s voice is exactly hers.
“Shiki? Hey, why aren’t you saying anything? Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten me.”
Red eyes peer up into mine from below.
I could never forget her.
But just as surely, she cannot possibly be standing here alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hello.
Are you heading to school, Student-san?"
…… I can't believe it.
The illusion even has her voice down perfectly.
"Shiki?
Hey, why are you so quiet?
Don't tell me you forgot about me?"
Those red eyes looking up at me…
…… There's no way I could forget.
But, at the same time, there's no way she can be here, alive.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　声が出ない。
　彼女は不機嫌な猫のように、むっー、と眉をよせて睨んでくる。
「もうっ、なによ。
会いに行くのを我慢してここで待ってたのに。
……もしかして、志貴ったら怒ってるの？」
「う―――――」
　……信じ、られない。
　今、俺の目の前にいるのは幻でもなんでもなくて、本当に、ホントに――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
No sound comes.
She knits her brows and glares at me like a disgruntled cat.
“Honestly, what’s wrong with you? I made myself wait here instead of coming to see you. Are you angry with me or something?”
“Ugh―――――”
I can’t believe it.
What stands before me is no vision at all, but the real, living Arcueid――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I can't speak.
She wrinkles her eyebrows together and glares at me like an angry cat.
"Geez, what gives.
I put up with not going to see you and was waiting here so long.
…… Don't tell me, you're angry, Shiki?"
"U------"
…… I just can't believe it.
This isn't an illusion in front of me.
It really is-----

entries.japanese:
「……アル……クェイド……？」
「ええそうよ。
―――よかった、志貴ったらロアとの一戦で廃人になっちゃったのかなって、本気で心配しちゃったじゃない」
「――――」
――ちょっと、待った。
　その―――混乱していて、何を言っていいのか、何から喜んでいいのか、何をするべきなのか。
　本当に―――胸がいっぱいすぎて、わからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…?”
“Yes, that’s right. ―――Thank goodness; I was seriously worried your fight with Roa had left you a vegetable.”
“――――”
――Wait a moment.
I’m so confused I don’t know what to say, what to be happy about first, what I’m supposed to do.
My heart is simply too full for me to understand anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ar…… cueid……?"
"Yes it's me.
------Thank goodness.
I thought you became a vegetable after fighting Roa.
I really was worried you know."
"----"
--Wait a minute.
Um----I'm so confused, what do I say?
What should I be happy about?
Is there something I need to do?
I----really am just so overwhelmed I don't know.

entries.japanese:
「志貴……？
　ね、さっきからヘンよ。
口をあんぐりあけて、目をぱちくりさせちゃって。
　……まあ、わたしとしては面白いから見ていて飽きないんだけど」
「――――アル、クェイド」
「だからそうだってば。
……もうっ、さっきからわたしの名前ばっかりじゃない。
せっかく再会したんだから、もうちょっと気の利いたセリフとか言えない？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…? You’ve been acting strange this whole time. Your mouth is hanging open and you keep blinking at me.
Though I have to admit, you’re so funny I could watch all day.”
“――――Arcueid.”
“I keep telling you, yes. Honestly, all you’ve said since I got here is my name. We’ve finally been reunited—can’t you come up with something a little more charming?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki……?
Hey, you're acting funny.
Your mouth is wide open, and so are your eyes.
…… Well, it's kind of interesting for me so I'll keep watching."
"----Ar, cueid."
"That's what I mean.
…… Geez, you keep just saying my name.
We finally managed to meet again, so can't you find anything more fitting to say?"

entries.japanese:
――――ああ、本当に間違いない。
　こんなふざけたセリフ、言えるのはこいつぐらいしかいないじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Yes, there can be no mistake.
Who else could possibly say something that ridiculous?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Yeah, there's no mistake.
There's only one person who could say such ridiculous things.

entries.japanese:
「………なんで」
「ん？
　なに、よく聞こえない。
もっと大きな声で言って」
　ほらほら、とカタチのいい耳を向けてくるアルクェイド。
「―――なんで生きてるんだよ、おまえ！」
　できるだけ大声で、とりあえず今の気持ちを口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…?”
“Hm? I can’t hear you. Say it louder.”
Arcueid turns one shapely ear toward me, urging me on.
“―――Why are you still alive?!”
At the top of my lungs, I blurt out the first thing in my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why?"
"Hm?
I can't hear you, please say it a little louder."
She tells me c'mon, c'mon as she points her ear closer to me.
"----Why are you still alive!?"
I scream and voice my feelings as loud as I can.

entries.japanese:
「いったぁ――――志貴、こえ大きすぎ～」
「おまえな……こえ大きすぎー、じゃないだろっ！
　なんで、なんで生きてるんだ……！
　俺は―――おまえはもういないんだって、もう、二度と会えないんだって、ずっと―――――」
　後悔していたっていうのに、どうして。
　そんな陽気に、まるで昨日別れたあとみたいに、簡単に挨拶なんて出来るんだ……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow――――Shiki, you’re too loud~”
“Don’t give me ‘too loud’! Why—why are you alive…!
I―――I thought you were gone, that I’d never see you again, all this time―――――”
And yet I had been living with that regret.
How could she greet me so cheerfully, so easily, as though we had only parted yesterday…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ow----Not so loud, Shiki."
"You…… don't say 'not so loud'!
Why are you alive……!

"I----thought you were gone, that I would never see you, that I would always------"
regret it.
But why?
This cheerfully, as if we only said goodbye yesterday, how can she greet me so simply……!?

entries.japanese:
「あ、そっか。
志貴には言ってなかったんだっけ」
　ぽん、とアルクェイドは手を叩く。
「わたしがロアを追ってた理由。
わたし、あいつに自分の力の一部を横取りされてたのよ。
　それをとり返すためにずっと追いかけていたんだけど、あいつ志貴に完全に消されちゃったでしょ？
　で、ロアから解放されたわたしの力が戻ってきて、なんとか蘇生することができたんだ」
「そ―――そんなこと、俺は全然聞いてないっ！」
「言ってないわよ、そんなこと。
志貴にはあんまり関係ない話だから」
「お―――」
　おまえは、どうしてそう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, right. I never told you, did I?”
Arcueid claps her hands together.
“Why I was chasing Roa. He had stolen part of my power.
I kept hunting him because I wanted it back, but then you erased him completely, remember? Once my power was freed from him, it returned to me, and I managed to revive.”
“Y-you never told me anything about that!”
“Of course I didn’t. It didn’t have much to do with you.”
“Y-you―――”
How can you be so――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, I see.
I never did tell you, Shiki."
Arcueid drops a fist to her other hand in realization.
"…… Yeah, I never did tell you my reason for pursuing Roa.
He stole some of my power.
In order to take it back,I pursued him but you completely destroyed him, right?
And the power that was freed from Roa returned to me and I managed to come back to life."
"Y----you never told me about that!"
"No, I didn't.
It didn't really concern you."
"Y----"
You, why did----

entries.japanese:
「でね、とりあえず蘇生できたんだけど、吸血衝動が抑えられないぐらい高ぶっちゃってて。
　そのまま志貴に会いにいったらきっととんでもないコトになるだろうから、力が戻るまで眠ってたんだ。
　そうゆうわけで、こうして元通りになって、衝動を抑えられるようになるのに七日間もかかっちゃった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, I managed to revive, but my vampiric impulse was so intense I couldn’t control it.
If I’d gone to see you like that, something terrible would definitely have happened, so I slept until my strength returned.
That’s why it took me a whole seven days to get back to normal and bring the impulse under control.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, I revived, but I could barely resist the vampiric impulse inside of me.
I probably would have done something terrible if I went to see you, so I slept until I regained my power.
Because of that I was able to return to normal, but it took seven days to suppress my impulse."

entries.japanese:
「え―――じゃ、じゃあ本当にもう大丈夫なのか、アルクェイド……？」
「もっちろん！
　そうでなかったら志貴の前にはやってこないよ」
　にこりと、満面の笑みをうかべて。
　アルクェイドは俺の手を握ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait―――then, you’re really all right now, Arcueid…?”
“Of course! Otherwise I wouldn’t have come to see you.”
She beams from ear to ear.
Arcueid takes my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh----then, then you're really okay now, Arcueid……?"
"Of course!
If I wasn't, I wouldn't be here."
She flashes me a full smile.
Arcueid takes my hand.

entries.japanese:
「わたしね、志貴。
眠っている間、こうして会えるのをすごく楽しみにしてた。
　だって、志貴の前に出れるようなったら色々連れまわしてもらえるんだもの。
　早く、すこしでも早く体が元通りになってくれればいいなって思ってた」
　一点の濁りもない微笑みをこぼして、アルクェイドは俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You know, Shiki. While I was asleep, I couldn’t wait to see you like this.
Once I was well enough to come to you, you’d take me all sorts of places.
I kept wishing my body would recover soon—just a little sooner.”
With an utterly guileless smile, Arcueid gazes into my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, Shiki.
While I was asleep, I was really looking forward to meeting again like this.
Because once I did, we could go around and do so many things.
I was thinking it would be so nice to get better even just a little quicker."
Arcueid looks at me with a pure, unadulterated smile.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　言葉がない。
　それは悪い意味なんかじゃなくて―――本当に、嬉しくて。
　アルクェイドの笑顔を見れることも、これから先のことも。
　いつか先輩に言ったように、こいつを独りきりにしたくないっていう、俺の望みも。
　何一つ―――自分は、失ってはいなかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
I had no words.
Not for any bad reason―――I was simply, truly happy.
To see Arcueid smile, and for everything still ahead.
And for the wish I once confessed to Ciel—not to leave her all alone.
I had lost nothing―――nothing at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I'm speechless.
Not in a bad way----I'm just… so happy.
Being able to see her smile again, all the things we can do from now on,
how I told Senpai that my wish was never to leave Arcueid alone again…
Not one----not one of them was lost.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　言いたい事、伝えたい事は山ほどある。
　けど、今はただ素直な心が口に出る。
「――――おかえり。
おまえのこと、ずっと、待ってた」
　握られた手を握り返して、短く、それだけを伝えた。
　アルクェイドはきょとんと目を白黒させると、
「……うん」
　なんて言って、恥ずかしそうに俯いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
There are a thousand things I want to say, a thousand things I need her to know.
But for now, only the simplest truth rises to my lips.
“――――Welcome home. I’ve been waiting for you all this time.”
I close my fingers around the hand holding mine and tell her only that.
Arcueid stares, blinking in astonishment, then—
“Yeah…”
she murmurs, lowering her head in embarrassment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
There's so many things I want to say and tell her right now.
But, right now I'll just speak honestly from the heart.
"----Welcome back.
I've… been waiting for a long time."
I squeeze her hand in return, and briefly tell her just that.
She looks a little bewildered at first.
"…… Yeah."
Saying that, she looks away in embarrassment.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド？」
　呼びかける。
　と、すこし間をおいてから、彼女は満面の笑みをうかべて顔をあげた。
「ええ、ただいま志貴。
貴方が貴方のままでいてくれて、よかった」
「――――――」
　胸がつまる。
　ここが通学路じゃなかったら、抱きしめてキスの一つぐらいしてしまうぐらい、アルクェイドの笑顔は、愛らしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…?”
I call her name.
After a moment, she lifts her face with a radiant smile.
“I’m home, Shiki. I’m glad you’re still yourself.”
“――――――”
My chest tightens.
Arcueid’s smile is so lovely that if we weren’t standing on the road to school, I might have swept her into my arms and kissed her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid?"
I call out to her.
After a brief pause, she faces me with a full smile.
"Yes, I'm back.
I'm glad you were still yourself, Shiki."
"------"
My chest tightens.
If this wasn't right on the way to school, I would embrace and kiss her.
Her smile is just so adorable.

entries.japanese:
「よし、それじゃあ行こっか志貴。
わたしのこと、色々連れていってくれるんでしょ？」
　するり、と手をほどいてアルクェイドはぴょん、とうさぎのように跳ねる。
　……その姿は直視することができないぐらい眩しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, let’s go, Shiki. You’re going to take me all sorts of places, aren’t you?”
Arcueid slips her hand free and bounds away like a rabbit.
She is so dazzling I can scarcely look at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright, let's go Shiki.
You're going to take me to many places, right?"
Arcueid releases my hand and jumps like a rabbit.
…… She's so radiant I can barely look at her directly.

entries.japanese:
「けど、その―――行くって、どこに？」
「どこでも。
志貴が楽しいって思えるところ」
　笑顔で、なんでもない事のようにアルクェイドは返答してくる。
　けど、それは、ちょっと困る。
「……あのさ。
俺はこれから学校があるんだけど」
「なによ。
今日ぐらいは、志貴の一日をわたしにくれてもいいんじゃない？」
　不満そうな目をするアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But, um―――when you say go, where exactly?”
“Anywhere. Somewhere you think is fun.”
Arcueid answers with a smile, as though it were the most obvious thing in the world.
There is one small problem.
“Um. I’m on my way to school.”
“Oh, come on. Can’t you give me today, at least?”
Arcueid gives me a dissatisfied look.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, um----where?"
"Anywhere.
Somewhere you think is fun, Shiki."
Smiling, Arcueid replies like it's nothing.
But, that's a little troubling.
"…… Um, you know, I do have school."
"Hey.
Can't you at least spend a day with me today?"
Arcueid looks dissatisfied.

entries.japanese:
「……う」
　……どうやら、こいつのこういう顔に、俺はとことん弱くなってるみたいだ。
　……まあ、どのみちこんな気持ちのままじゃ学校に行っても上の空だろうし、なにより―――自分自身がアルクェイドと一緒にいたがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh…”
Apparently I’m completely helpless against that face.
In any case, I’d only stare into space at school in this state; more than anything―――I wanted to be with Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Uh."
…… Evidently, I'm extremely weak against that face of hers.
…… Well, even if I went to school like this, I wouldn't be able to concentrate there, and more than anything else----I want to be with Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「……うん、そうだな。
つまらない世間体なんかこのさいうっちゃっておくか。
　オーケー、アルクェイド。
今日は一日、お姫さまのわがままに付き合うよ」
「やったー！」
　どん、と。
　唐突に、アルクェイドは体を寄せ付けてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah, all right. To hell with appearances for once.
Okay, Arcueid. Today I’ll indulge my princess’s every whim.”
“Hooray!”
A thump.
Arcueid abruptly presses herself against me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hm, you're right.
Who cares about boring reputation.
Okay, Arcueid.
I will indulge your selfishness for the day, my princess."
"Yay!"
Bump.
She suddenly presses her body up against mine.

entries.japanese:
「ね、志貴。
あの夜、シエルに言った時の気持ち、変わってない？」
　下から覗きこむように、アルクェイドが問いかけてくる。
「……あの夜の気持ちって―――その、なに？」
「わたしのこと、愛してるっていうアレ」
「――――――！」
　思わず咳き込んだ。
　こんな間近で、アルクェイド本人にそんな事を聞かれると照れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Shiki. Do you still feel the same way you did when you spoke to Ciel that night?”
Arcueid peers up at me.
“What I felt that night―――what do you mean?”
“That part about loving me.”
“――――――!”
I choke.
Hearing Arcueid herself ask me that from inches away is mortifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Shiki.
That night, what you were talking about with Ciel, your feelings haven't changed?"
She looks up imploringly at me as she asks.
"…… My feelings that night----what do you mean?"
"About you saying you loved me."
"------!"
I start to splutter.
It's too embarrassing for her to ask me this question when she's this close to me.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだ、忘れてた。
盗み聞きはよくないぞ、アルクェイド」
「聞こえちゃったんだから仕方ないでしょ。
ね、それより聞かせて。
あの時の言葉は、今でも変わらないままでいてくれてる？」
――――ばか。
　そんなの言うまでもないじゃないか。
「……ああ、変わってない。
保証はできないけど、たぶん、ずっと変わらない」
　さすがに恥ずかしいので、あさっての空を見ながら、歯のうくような返答をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, right—I’d forgotten. Eavesdropping is rude, Arcueid.”
“I couldn’t help hearing. Never mind that—tell me. Do you still mean what you said back then?”
――――Idiot.
As if she even needs to ask.
“Yeah, nothing’s changed. I can’t promise, but I don’t think it ever will.”
Too embarrassed to face her, I gaze at an empty patch of sky and deliver the hopelessly sentimental answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh, I forgot.
You shouldn't eavesdrop, Arcueid."
"I can't help it if I overheard.
Anyway, c'mon, answer me.
Your words that night, they haven't changed?"
----Idiot.
I don't even need to say that.
"…… Yeah, they haven't changed.
I can't make any guarantees, but they'll probably never change."
I'm so embarrassed I look up at the sky and answer.

entries.japanese:
ぐっ、と。
　体をよせていたアルクェイドが、こちらの片腕を抱き寄せる。
「そっか。
それじゃあ、これから覚悟してよね志貴」
「覚悟って、なんの覚悟だよ」
　なんだか一抹の不安を感じて聞き返した。
　アルクェイドは俺の片腕を掴んで、にっこりと笑って、言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
A squeeze.
Arcueid hugs the arm nearest her tight against her body.
“I see. Then you’d better prepare yourself, Shiki.”
“Prepare myself for what?”
A thread of unease enters my voice.
Still clutching my arm, Arcueid smiles sweetly and says.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid wraps her arms around mine.
"Oh.
Then you should prepare yourself, Shiki."
"Prepare?
Prepare for what?"
I can't help but let a tinge of uneasiness creep in my voice.
She holds onto my arms and speaks with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「だから、ずっと一緒だっていう約束。
　一番初めに言ったでしょ？
　わたしの責任、ちゃんととってもらうからって」
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
“For our promise to stay together forever.
Remember what I told you at the very beginning?
I’m going to have you take proper responsibility for me.”!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because you promised to be with me forever.
Didn't I say so when we first met?
I'll have you take responsibility for me."

Then she starts to walk, still holding onto my arm.

entries.japanese:
そうして、アルクェイドは俺の腕を掴んだまま歩き出した。
　早く早く、と遊び場に行くのを待ちきれない子供のような元気さで。
「は―――なるほど、たしかに覚悟がいるね、それ」
　誰に聞かせるでもなく呟いて、彼女と一緒に歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then Arcueid starts walking, still holding fast to my arm.
She tugs me along with the breathless energy of a child who can’t reach the playground quickly enough.
“Hah―――I see; that really does take some resolve.”
Murmuring it to no one in particular, I fall into step beside her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She's as energetic as a little child urging me to hurry up to get to a playground.
"Oh---I see.
Certainly I would have to prepare."
Speaking to no one in particular, I start to walk with her.

entries.japanese:
登校していく生徒たちの中を逆行して、どこでもいい場所へと向かっていく。
　何処まで行こうか。
　まあ、行けないところなんかないと思う。
　連れ立っている月のお姫さまには、太陽の光だって似合っているのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
We go against the stream of students headed for school, bound for anywhere at all.
How far should we go?
I don’t think anywhere is beyond our reach.
Even sunlight suits the princess of the moon walking beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I head towards some random place, going against the flow of students going to school.
Where to?
Well, there's no place we can't go.
The sunlight really suits this princess of the moon accompanying me.

entries.japanese:
―――天気は、とりあえず文句の付け所がなさそうな蒼い空。
　俺たちは手を繋いだまま、二人にとって初めてになる何処かに向かって歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――For now, at least, the weather was perfect: a clear blue sky.
Hand in hand, we set out for somewhere neither of us has ever been.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The weather is a perfect blue sky.
Hand in hand, we walk towards a new beginning for the two of us.

entries.japanese:
朝の光を感じる。
　まぶたを閉じて眠りに落ちていても、柔らかな陽射しは混濁する意識を目覚めさせようとする。
―――意識が、だんだんと自分を取り戻す。
　静かな雰囲気。
　空気はほどよく冷たく、陽射しはそれを緩和するぐらいに温かい。
　どうやら、今日はこれ以上ないっていうぐらいいい天気みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I feel the morning light.
Though my eyes are closed and I am sunk in sleep, the gentle sun coaxes my muddled consciousness toward waking.
―――Little by little, my awareness becomes my own again.
Everything is quiet.
The air is pleasantly cool, while the sun is warm enough to soften its chill.
It seems today is going to be as beautiful as any day could possibly be.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel the morning sunlight.
I keep my eyes closed as I try to fall asleep again, but the gentle sunlight keeps urging me to open my eyes.
---Slowly, I start to awaken.

A quiet atmosphere.
The air is comfortably cold, and the sunlight is warm enough.
I guess the weather will be great today.

entries.japanese:
―――なら、起きて学校に行かなくちゃ――
　そう、学校に行かないと。
　なにしろこの三日間、自分が学生なんだって忘れるぐらいにメチャクチャな生活を送っていたんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Then I have to get up and go to school—
I have to go to school.
For the past three days, my life has been so completely insane that I almost forgot I was a student—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Then, I should get up and go to school.
That's right, I have to go to school.
The past three days, my life was chaos and it made me forget I was a student.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　目が覚めた。
　体はベッドに横たわっていて、枕元にはメガネがある。
　何の思考もしないままにメガネをかけて、視線を泳がせる。
　さあ、という音が聞こえてきそうなほど、窓からさしこんでくる陽射しは清らかだ。
「――――」
　はあ、と静かに呼吸をする。
　肺が新鮮な空気をとりこんで、胸の中が洗浄されていくよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I wake.
I’m lying in bed, my glasses beside the pillow.
Without thinking, I put them on and let my gaze drift around the room.
The sunlight pouring through the window is so pure it seems to whisper, Come on.
“…”
I breathe out softly.
Fresh air fills my lungs, washing the inside of my chest clean.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I wake up.
I'm lying on my bed, and my glasses are on the bedside.
I automatically put them on and look around.
The sunlight streams so strongly in through the window, I almost expect to hear it pouring through.
"----"
I take a quiet breath.
I fill my lungs with fresh air, and it feels like my chest is purified.

entries.japanese:
時計の針はカッチコッチと音をたてて。
　外の林からは小鳥の鳴き声が聞こえてくる。
　自分は暖かなベッドに横になっていて、何をするのでもなく緩やかな時間を感じている。
―――――それは、紛れもなく平穏な日常だ。
「……………」
　なのに、それを少しだけ物足りなく感じてしまっている。
　こんな清らかな朝に戻ってこれたっていうのに、俺は―――なにか、おかしな違和感を感じてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
The clock ticks.
Birds call from the woods outside.
I lie in my warm bed, doing nothing, immersed in the slow passage of time.
―――――This is unmistakably a peaceful, ordinary life.
“…”
And yet I find it faintly unsatisfying.
Even though I’ve returned to such a pristine morning, something in me feels strangely out of place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hear the clock ticking.
Small birds chirp in the woods outside.
I stay on my warm bed, aimlessly feeling the relaxed passage of time.
-----This is, of course, another peaceful day.
"……………"
But, I feel a bit unsatisfied.

Although I'm back in this calm morning, I---feel that there is something that seems out of place.

entries.japanese:
あの黒いコートの吸血鬼を倒して、もう何もかも元通りになったっていうのに―――何か、足りないと感じてしまっている。
「……そんなバカな。
どうかしてるよ、それは」
　ふるふると頭をふって、つまらない思いつきを振り払う。
―――と。
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
entries.maoEnglish:
We defeated the vampire in the black coat and put everything back as it was—yet something still seems to be missing.
“That’s ridiculous. There must be something wrong with me.”
I shake my head and drive the foolish notion away.
―――And then.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though I killed that vampire with the black coat and everything is back the way it was---I'm feeling that something is missing.
"…… That's ridiculous."
I shake my head, and shake off that unimportant thought.
---And then.
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."

entries.japanese:
「うわああああ！」
　思わずベッドから上半身を跳ね起こす。
　見れば、ベッドの足元のほうに翡翠が静かに立っていた。
「ひ、ひひ、翡翠―――」
「……申し訳ありません。
志貴さまが中々お気づきになられませんので、こちらからお声をおかけしました」
「あ―――うん、いや、こっちこそ、ゴメン」
　翡翠はうやうやしく一礼する。
―――び、びっくりした。
　まだ心臓がばくんばくんって驚いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Waaaaah!”
I bolt upright in bed.
Hisui is standing motionless at its foot.
“H-H-Hisui―――”
“My apologies. You did not appear to notice me, Master Shiki, so I took the liberty of addressing you.”
“Ah―――right, no, I’m the one who should apologize.”
Hisui bows with grave formality.
―――That scared me half to death.
My heart is still pounding in panic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uwaaaa!"
I jump up in my bed.
Now that I look, Hisui is standing quietly at the side of my bed.
"Hi-HiHi-Hisui---"
"…… Please excuse me, Shiki-sama, but since you did not notice, I spoke."
"Ah---well, I mean, I'm sorry, too."
Hisui respectfully bows to me.
---Sh-she surprised me.
My heart is still pounding rapidly.

entries.japanese:
「―――あれ？
　まだ七時前だよね、翡翠」
「はい。
志貴さまがお目覚めになられるには、少しばかり早い時間ですね」
「そうなんだけど―――それじゃあ翡翠は何しにきたんだ？」
「志貴さまを起こしきたのです。
秋葉さまがここ二日間のお話を聞きたいので志貴さまをテコを使ってでも連れて来るように、との事です」
「―――――あ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. Isn’t it still before seven, Hisui?”
“Yes. It is somewhat earlier than you usually wake, Master Shiki.”
“Then what are you doing here?”
“I came to wake Master Shiki. Miss Akiha wishes to hear about the past two days and instructed me to bring Master Shiki to her, even if I had to use a lever.”
“Ah―――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Huh?
But it's still before seven o'clock, Hisui."
"Yes.
It is a bit earlier than your usual waking time, Shiki-sama."
"Well, yes---then why are you here, Hisui?"
"I came to wake you up.
Akiha-sama wants to know what have you been doing these last two days so she wanted me to bring you no matter what."
"-----Ah."

entries.japanese:
……忘れてた。
　そういえば土曜は学校を休んで、その次の日曜日はアルクェイドにつきっきりだったんだ。
　しかも、昨夜は夜遅くに帰ってきて、ドロボウのように自分の部屋に忍び込んで眠ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had forgotten.
I skipped school on Saturday, then spent all of Sunday with Arcueid.
Worse, I returned late last night and crept into my own room like a burglar before falling asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I forgot.
Come to think of it, I skipped school last Saturday and was with Arcueid through all of Sunday.
What's more, I came back late last night, snuck in like a burglar, and then went to sleep.

entries.japanese:
「……もしかして、秋葉のヤツ怒ってる……？」
「さあ、どうでしょうか。
それは志貴さまがじかにお会いしてお確かめください」
―――翡翠の声は、ものすっごく冷たい。
「……翡翠は、俺が帰ってきたの、知ってたの？」
「はい。
志貴さまが昨夜の午前二時過ぎにお帰りになられた事には気がつきました。
防犯カメラが、門をよじのぼっている志貴さまの姿を捉えていましたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is Akiha angry, by any chance?”
“I could not say, Master Shiki. You may judge that for yourself when you see her.”
―――Hisui’s voice is positively glacial.
“Hisui, did you know I’d come home?”
“Yes. I noticed that Master Shiki returned shortly after two last night. The security camera recorded Master Shiki climbing over the gate.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Don't tell me, Akiha's angry……?"
"I do not know.
Please confirm for yourself, Shiki-sama."
---Hisui's voice sounds very cold.
"…… Hisui, you knew I came back?"
"Yes.
I noticed when you returned early this morning around two o'clock.
We saw you on the security camera when you were climbing the gate, Shiki-sama."

entries.japanese:
「―――えっと。
それは、秋葉は知ってるのかな」
「いいえ、それはわたしと姉さんしか知りませんが」
「それは―――良かった」
　
　……とりあえず、最悪の事態はさけられたか。
　けど、それにしたってまずいぞ。
　二日間も音信不通にしておいて、しかも夜中に帰ってきたなんてバツが悪すぎる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um. Does Akiha know about that?”
“No, only my sister and I are aware of it.”
“What a relief.”
At least the very worst has been avoided.
Still, this is bad enough.
Vanishing for two days and then slinking home in the middle of the night puts me in an appalling position.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Um, does Akiha know this?"
"No, only Nee-san and I know this."
"That's---good."
…… Anyway, I think I avoided the worst possible situation.
However, it's still pretty bad.
Not informing her what I've been doing these last two days and returning in the middle of the night, it's pretty bad.

entries.japanese:
「―――わかった。
すぐに行くから、秋葉には、その……できるだけ落ち着くように言っておいてくれると、嬉しいかな」
「秋葉さまは十分落ち着いているようです。
わたしからのお言葉では、これ以上落ち着いていただくのは難しいかと」
「―――」
　うう、一難さってまた一難か。
　ネロなんていう怪物をどうにかした後だっていうのに、間髪いれずに死闘が待っているなんて思いもしなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll be there in a minute, so could you tell Akiha to remain as calm as possible?”
“Miss Akiha already appears entirely calm. I doubt any words of mine could make her calmer still.”
“…”
Great, out of one disaster and into the next.
I never imagined that immediately after surviving a death match with a monster like Nrvnqsr, another mortal struggle would be waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Alright.
I'll head down immediately.
Umm…… and, if possible, I'd be happy if you tried to calm her down as much as possible."
"Akiha-sama already appears calm.
I think it will be difficult for my words to calm her even more."
"---"
Ugh, one problem after another?
I just got done with Nrvnqsr, so I never thought I would face another life and death battle without even a rest break.

entries.japanese:
まあ、ともかく起きよう。
　いつまでもベッドに眠っていても始まらない。
「着替えたら行くから、翡翠は先に行っててくれ。
……大丈夫、すっぽかしたりしないから」
「―――はい。
それではお待ちしております」
　……はあ。
　それじゃあ、さっさと着替えて秋葉お嬢さまにお目通りに行くとしようか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Well, first things first: get up.
Nothing will improve while I lie here hiding in bed.
“I’ll come after I change, so go on ahead. Don’t worry, I won’t run away.”
“Very well. We shall be waiting.”
I sigh.
Time to get dressed and present myself before Her Ladyship Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well, time to get up.
I can't do anything staying in bed.
"I'll go after I change, so please go ahead, Hisui.
…… It's alright, I won't run."
"---Well then, we will be waiting for you."
…… *sigh*
Well then, I should change quickly so Mistress Akiha may pass judgment on me.

entries.japanese:
―――さて、やってきてしまった。
　ここから扉一枚隔てて、秋葉が待っているという居間がある。
　どんな事情があったにしても、学校を無断欠席して、あまつさえ二日も家に帰ってこなかった事実は弁解のしようがない。
　ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And now I’m here.
Beyond this single door lies the sitting room where Akiha is waiting.
Whatever my reasons, there is no excuse for skipping school without permission and then failing to come home for two whole days.
I should—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Alright, I'm here.
Now only a door separates me from the sitting room where Akiha awaits.
No matter what the circumstance was, there's no excuse for skipping school and not coming home for two days.
Now---

entries.japanese:
「……そうだな。
それが一番いいと思う」
　アルクェイドやネロといった『人間外のもの』のことなんて話しても通じないだろうし、本当のことが話せないのなら、せめて素直に謝るべきだ。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah… that’s probably best.”
There is no point trying to explain inhuman beings like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, and if I can’t tell the truth, the least I can do is apologize honestly.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
I think that's the best choice."
I don't think Akiha will understand about non-humans like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, and since I can't tell the truth, I should at least sincerely apologize.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
「―――おはようございます、兄さん」
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「えーと、その……おはよう、秋葉」
「挨拶はいいですから、そこに座ってください。
兄さんに話があります」
「――――――」
　秋葉の言葉には、なにか有無を言わせない迫力がある。
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
“―――Good morning, Brother.”
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Um, well―――good morning, Akiha.”
“We can dispense with the greetings. Sit there, please—I have something to discuss with you.”
“――――――”
Something in Akiha’s voice brooks no refusal.
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"--Good morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me "I am angry."
"Um, uh…… Morning, Akiha."
"Let's dispense with greetings.
Please sit there.
I wish to speak with you, Nii-san."
"------"
Her words are so forceful, I can't say no.
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from her.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――う」
　聞かせてくれませんか、なんて丁寧口調で言っているものの、秋葉のそれは間違いなく脅迫だ。
　だが、お兄ちゃんはそんなお話を聞かせてあげるわけにはいかないのだ。
「それなんだけど、秋葉」
「はい、なんでしょう」
「悪いんだけど、事情は説明できないんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Shall we begin with an account of where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Urgh”
She phrases it as a courteous request, but make no mistake: this is a threat.
Unfortunately, her big brother cannot possibly tell his little sister any of that.
“About that, Akiha…”
“Yes?”
“I’m sorry, but I can’t explain the circumstances.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"----Ugh."
Despite her polite language, Akiha's words are unmistakably a threat.
But, her Onii-chan cannot tell her such a story.

"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it?"
"I'm sorry, but I can't tell you."

entries.japanese:
がちゃん。
　と、秋葉の持っていたティーカップがテーブル
に落ちた。
　いや、意図的に落とした、という表現の方が近かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crash.
Akiha’s teacup drops
onto the table.
No—saying she deliberately slammed it down would be closer to the truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Crash.
The teacup that Akiha was holding falls to the table.
Rather, I think she dropped it intentionally.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま―――」
「ああ、ごめんなさい翡翠。
急いで片付けてもらえる？」
　翡翠が無言でこぼれた紅茶とか、割れた（とても高級そうな）ティーカップを片付けていく。
　その様子を、こっちは秋葉に睨まれながら気まずく見つめていた。
　片付けを終えて、翡翠が厨房に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha―――”
“Oh, I’m sorry, Hisui. Would you clean that up at once?”
Without a word, Hisui clears away the spilled tea and the broken—and very expensive-looking—teacup.
I watch awkwardly under Akiha’s glare.
Once she has finished, Hisui carries everything into the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama---"
"Oh, I'm sorry Hisui.
Would you please clean it up?"
Hisui silently cleans up the spilled tea and the shards of the (very expensive-looking) teacup.
I uneasily watch her do so while Akiha is glaring at me.
Once done cleaning, Hisui goes to the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
「―――それで、兄さん」
「……なに？」
「もう一度、お聞きしていいでしょうか？」
　秋葉は諦めていない。
　意地でも俺から話を聞こうとしている気迫がありありと感じ取れる。
　それでも、やっぱり話すわけにはいかないと思う。
　自分のためという事もあるけど、秋葉のためにもこんな話はするべきじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Now then, Brother.”
“―――What?”
“May I ask you once more?”
Akiha has not given up.
I can feel her determination to drag the story out of me by sheer force.
Even so, I still can’t tell her.
Partly for my own sake—but also because Akiha should never be burdened with any of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Then, Nii-san."
"…… Yes?"
"Could I ask you again?"
Akiha doesn't give up.
I can feel her drive to get the story out of me no matter what.
But still, I don't think I can tell her about it.
Of course not just for my sake, but hers as well.

entries.japanese:
「……だめだ。
何度聞かれたって話せないものは話せない。
秋葉にはいらない心配をかけさせて悪いと思ってる。
けど、話せない事は話せないんだ」
「―――悪い、と思っているのに話せないんですね、兄さんは」
「そうだよ。
連絡をいれなかったり、事情を話せない事はすまないと思ってる。
でもこの二日間、悪いコトはしていない。
……あれが間違っていた事だなんて、思いたくない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. Ask as many times as you want; I can’t tell you. I’m sorry I’ve made you worry for nothing, Akiha. But some things simply can’t be said.”
“―――You feel sorry, and yet you still refuse to tell me, Brother?”
“That’s right. I’m sorry I didn’t contact you, and I’m sorry I can’t explain. But I did nothing wrong during those two days. I don’t want to believe that what happened was a mistake.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
No matter how many times you ask me, I can't tell you.
I feel sorry that I made you worry, but I can't tell you about it."
"--Even though you are sorry, you can't tell me, Nii-san."
"That's right.
I'm sorry I haven't contacted you and for not being able to talk about it.
But I haven't done anything wrong the past two days.
…… I don't even want to think that was a wrong thing to do."

entries.japanese:
―――そう。
　殺したり殺されたり、そんな意味合いしかなかった二日間だったけど、あれは――正しいことだったのだと思いたい。
　アルクェイドを助けるためというのもあったけど、なにより―――俺は、あの人食いの怪物を殺したことを後悔はしてない。
　少なくとも、これ以上街で血を吸われて殺されてる、なんていう犠牲者が出るという事はなくなるんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes.
Those two days were filled with nothing but killing and nearly being killed, yet I want to believe that what we did was right.
I want to believe that going to help Arcueid was the right thing to do, and more than anything―――I do not regret it in the least.
At the very least, no one else in this city will be drained of blood and murdered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's right.
Even these past two days were simply kill or be killed--I want to believe it was the right thing to do.
I did it to help Arcueid, but most of all… I do not regret killing that cannibalistic monster.
At the very least, there will be no more victims killed by having their blood drained.

entries.japanese:
「―――ごめんな、秋葉。
迷惑をかけてすまないけど、これ以上は聞かないでくれ」
「―――――――」
　秋葉はじっとこっちの目を見つめてくる。
　しばらく、そんな息苦しい時間が続いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry, Akiha. I know I’ve caused trouble, but please don’t ask me anything more.”
“―――――――”
Akiha stares into my eyes.
The suffocating silence continues for some time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I'm sorry, Akiha.
I'm sorry to worry you, but please don't ask me anymore."
"------"
Akiha looks me in the eye.
For a while, she stays like that.

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
考えてみれば兄さんにも兄さんの事情があるんでしょうし、私がそれに深く干渉することはできませんものね」
「……悪い。
そう言ってもらえると、助かる」
「――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. Now that I consider it, you must have circumstances of your own, and it isn’t my place to pry too deeply into them.”
“I’m sorry. It helps to hear you say that.”
“――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
After thinking about it, you must have your reasons, so I won't press you on this anymore, Nii-san."
"…… I'm sorry.
Thanks for understanding."
"-----"

entries.japanese:
もう、なんとか誤魔化すしかないだろう。
　そもそもアルクェイドやネロといった『人間外のもの』のことなんて話しても通じないだろうし、それなら出来るだけ嘘を言わないで、かといって真実も言わない、という方針でいくしかない。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I’ll simply have to bluff my way through.
There is no chance she would understand talk of inhuman beings like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, so my only option is to avoid lying as much as possible while revealing none of the truth.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well, I just have to deceive her somehow.
I don't think Akiha will understand about non-humans like Arcueid and Nrvnqsr, so I'll have to minimize my lying without telling the truth.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
「―――おはようございます、兄さん」
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「えーと、その……おはよう、秋葉」
「挨拶はいいですから、そこに座ってください。
兄さんに話があります」
「――――――」
　秋葉の言葉には、なにか有無を言わせない迫力がある。
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
“―――Good morning, Brother.”
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Um, well―――good morning, Akiha.”
“We can dispense with the greetings. Sit there, please—I have something to discuss with you.”
“――――――”
Something in Akiha’s voice brooks no refusal.
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"--Good morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me "I am angry."
"Um, uh…… Morning, Akiha."
"Let's dispense with greetings.
Please sit there.
I wish to speak with you, Nii-san."
"------"
Her words are so forceful, I can't say no.
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――う」
　聞かせてくれませんか、なんて丁寧口調で言っているものの、秋葉のそれは間違いなく脅迫だ。
　だが、お兄ちゃんはそんなお話を聞かせてあげるわけにはいかないのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Shall we begin with an account of where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Urgh”
She phrases it as a courteous request, but make no mistake: this is a threat.
Unfortunately, her big brother cannot possibly tell his little sister any of that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"----Ugh."
Despite her polite language, Akiha's words are unmistakably a threat.
But, her Onii-chan cannot tell her such a story.

entries.japanese:
「それなんだけど、秋葉」
「はい、なんでしょう」
「実は、ちょっとした知り合いとばったり再会して、そいつに街を案内してやってたんだ」
「へえ。
ちょっとした知り合い、ですか」
「ああ、最近知り合ったヤツなんだけど、そいつと学校の前で会っちゃってさ。
その、日曜日まででいいからどうしても付き合ってほしいっていうから、その―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“About that, Akiha…”
“Yes?”
“The truth is, I ran into an acquaintance I hadn’t seen in a while and ended up showing them around town.”
“Oh? Just an acquaintance?”
“Yeah, someone I met recently; we ran into each other outside the school. They said they desperately needed me to stay with them until Sunday, so―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it?"
"The truth is, I ran into a minor acquaintance of mine and I showed that person around the city."
"Oh?
A minor acquaintance?"
"Yeah, I got to know the person just recently, and we met just outside of school.
I was asked to keep this acquaintance company until Sunday, so--"

entries.japanese:
「学校を休んで、無断外泊をした、という事ですね」
　……うう、秋葉の視線が冷たい。
　あれは怒っている、っていうより呆れてるぞ、ぜったい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you skipped school and spent the night away without permission.”
Urgh—Akiha’s stare is glacial.
That isn’t anger so much as utter exasperation—I’m sure of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So you skipped school and stayed away from home without even notifying me or asking permission."
…… Akiha's gaze is extremely frigid.
She seems even more shocked than angry.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
「…………………」
　黙り込む俺と、無言で視線を向けてくる秋葉。
「それで、誰なんですか」
「え？」
「その知り合いというのは誰なんですか、と聞いたんです、私は」
　まっすぐに秋葉はこっちの目を見据えてくる。
　『絶対に誤魔化されませんから』という意思が、ありありと伝わってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“…”
I say nothing while Akiha stares at me in silence.
“And who was it?”
“What?”
“I asked who this acquaintance was.”
Akiha looks me straight in the eye.
Her expression could not make it clearer: You will not wriggle out of this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
"…………………"
I remain quiet as Akiha stares at me wordlessly.
"And, who was it?"
"Eh?"
"I asked who this acquaintance of yours is."
She looks at me directly in the eye.
I can feel her thinking "I will not be deceived".

entries.japanese:
「―――いや、それは―――」
「言えない、という事は何か後ろめたい事がある、という事よ、兄さん」
　じっ、と秋葉の視線が突き刺さる。
　目を逸らすと余計いじめられそうなので、負けじと秋葉の顔を見つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Well, that is―――”
“If you cannot tell me, then you must have something to feel guilty about, Brother.”
Her gaze pierces straight through me.
Looking away would only encourage her to torment me, so I stare stubbornly back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Well, I--"
"If you can't tell me, that means you feel guilty about it, Nii-san."
Her gaze shoots right through me.
I get the feeling she'll attack me more if I look away, so I stare back at her.

entries.japanese:
……いや、まったく関係ないけど。
　こう見ると秋葉には昔の面影がまったくない。
　凛と伸びた背筋、はっきりとした口調、ゆらぐ事のない瞳。
　不謹慎な話だけど、純粋に、美人になったな、なんて思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
This has nothing to do with anything, but looking at her now, I can find no trace of the Akiha I remember.
Her proud, straight back.
Her crisp voice; those unwavering eyes.
It is a wildly inappropriate thought at the moment, but she really has grown into a beautiful woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, this is totally random, but…
She does not remind me of the Akiha from back then.
Her stretched back, her perfect posture, her unwavering eyes.
Perhaps this is imprudent, but I honestly think she has become very beautiful.

entries.japanese:
「あのさ、秋葉」
「なに？」
「おまえ、眉わりと太いんだな」
「――――――！？」
　がたん、とテーブルに足をひっかけて、秋葉と立ちあがった。
「…………あ」
　なんていうか、ものすごい驚きっぷりだ。
「……わかんないヤツだな。
いまの、驚くところじゃないだろ」
「―――――――――」
　はあー、と深呼吸をして、秋葉は肩をすくめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Akiha.”
“What?”
“You’ve got pretty thick eyebrows, don’t you?”
“――――――!?”
Akiha jerks to her feet and catches the table with her leg.
“―――Oh.”
That is an astonishing reaction.
“You’re impossible to understand. That wasn’t something to be shocked about.”
“―――――――――”
Akiha draws a long breath and lets her shoulders drop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, Akiha."
"What?"
"Your eyebrows are pretty thick."
"------!?"
Bam!
Akiha's leg smacks the table as she jumps up.
"………… Ah."
How do I say this--she's surprisingly surprised?
"…… I don't get you at all.
That wasn't something to be surprised about."
"---------"
With a deep breath, Akiha slumps her shoulders.

entries.japanese:
「兄さんには、真面目に答えようとする意思がないみたいですね」
「……そんなコトないぞ。
誓っていうけど、俺は秋葉に嘘はつかないよ。
ただ、ちょっと言えないことが多いだけなんだ」
「もうっ。
ほんっとーに、昔から誠実なんだか不誠実なんだかわからない人なんですから、兄さんは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It seems you have no intention of answering me seriously.”
“That’s not true. I swear, I won’t lie to you, Akiha. There just happen to be a great many things I can’t tell you.”
“Honestly! Ever since we were children, I’ve never been able to tell whether you’re sincere or insincere, Brother.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, it seems like you do not wish to answer me seriously."
"…… That's not right.
Honestly, I won't lie to you.
It's just that I have a lot of things I can't say to you."
"Geez.
Really, ever since we were small I was never able to tell if you were an honest or dishonest person, Nii-san."

entries.japanese:
「……そうなの？
　俺、子供のころの自分ってよく覚えてないんだけど」
「覚えてなくていいです。
なんか、私も変わってない。
どうせこうなるってわかってるのに兄さんを問い詰めるなんて、成長がないのかしら」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Really? I don’t remember myself very well as a child.”
“You’re better off not remembering. It seems I haven’t changed either. Perhaps I haven’t grown at all, interrogating you even though I know perfectly well how this will end.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?
I don't really remember how I was when I was small."
"You don't have to remember.
But, I haven't changed either.
Pressing you like this even when I know how it will turn out… maybe I haven't grown up at all."

entries.japanese:
―――本当の事を話してみよう。
　秋葉に嘘をつくのが嫌だし、誠心誠意をこめて説明すれば秋葉も分かってくれるかもしれない。
　……まあ、宝くじに当たるか当たらないかぐらいの確率で。
「―――よし、行くぞ」
　大きく深呼吸をして、居間に通じる扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll try telling her the truth.
I hate lying to Akiha, and if I explain everything with complete sincerity, perhaps she will understand.
The odds are roughly the same as winning the lottery, but still.
“―――All right, here goes.”
I fill my lungs and open the sitting-room door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'll try telling the truth.
I don't want to lie to Akiha, and if I explain everything sincerely, Akiha may understand.
…… Well, the possibility of that is like winning a lottery.
"--Alright, let's go."
Taking a deep breath, I open the sitting room door.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉がソファーに、翡翠が壁際に立って待っていた。
　じろり、と秋葉はいかにも『私、怒ってます』なんていう視線を向けてくる。
「やっ。
おはよう秋葉」
　開き直った人間は強い。
　いじめっ子のような秋葉の視線に負けじと明るい挨拶を返せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is waiting on the sofa, while Hisui stands against the wall.
Akiha fixes me with a glare that all but declares, I am furious.
“Hey. Good morning, Akiha!”
Once a man has resigned himself to disaster, nothing can frighten him.
I return her bullying stare with the brightest greeting I can muster.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa and Hisui is standing by the wall.
"--Morning, Nii-san."
Her gaze is telling me "I am angry."
"Yo, morning, Akiha."
A defiant person is strong.
I give a cheerful greeting to Akiha's bullying gaze.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　こっちの陽気さに面食らったのか、秋葉はじっと見つめてくる。
「兄さん、挨拶はいいですからそこに座ってください。
話したいことがあるんです」
「わかった。
できるだけ手短にな」
　しずしずと、大人しく秋葉の前にあるソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
Perhaps my cheerfulness catches her off guard, because Akiha merely stares.
“Brother, enough greetings. Sit down, please. I have something to discuss with you.”
“All right, but keep it brief.”
Meek as a lamb, I lower myself onto the sofa opposite her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
She might be confused with my cheerfulness, as she just stares at me.
"Nii-san, let's dispense with the greetings.
Please sit here, I wish to speak with you."
"Sure.
Let's keep it short though."
I solemnly and calmly sit down on the sofa across from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「それでは兄さん。
早速ですけど、一昨日と昨日のお話を聞かせてくれませんか？」
「―――――ん」
　……やっぱりそうきたか。
　二日間も家を留守にしてしまった以上、どんな言い訳もきかない。
　正直に、アルクェイドと過ごした二日間を打ち明けよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let us begin. Would you tell me where you were the day before yesterday and yesterday?”
“―――――Mm.”
Just as I expected.
After staying away from home for two days, no excuse could possibly save me.
I will tell her honestly about the two days I spent with Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, Nii-san.
This is very abrupt, but may I ask about these past two days?"
"-----Hm."
…… I knew it.
Since I left the house for two days, there's no excuse.
Time to honestly tell her all about Arcueid and these past two days.

entries.japanese:
「それなんだけどな、秋葉」
「はい、なんですか兄さん」
「この二日間、俺は吸血鬼を退治していたんだ。
この街に連続殺人事件が起きているのは知ってるだろう？
　その犯人が吸血鬼だっていうんで、ちょこっと知りあった『いい吸血鬼』に手をかして、『悪い吸血鬼』と戦ったんだよ」
―――――とまあ、実に簡潔に説明した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“About that, Akiha.”
“Yes, Brother?”
“For the last two days, I was exterminating a vampire. You know about the serial murders in town, right? The killer turned out to be a vampire, so I joined forces with a ‘good vampire’ I happened to meet and fought the ‘bad vampire.’”
―――――There: a remarkably concise explanation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About that, Akiha."
"Yes, what is it, Nii-san?"
"These past two days, I was hunting a vampire.
You know about the recent killings, right?
They were the work of a vampire, so I helped the 'good vampire' I met recently, and I fought with the 'bad vampire'."
----Like that, I explain concisely.

entries.japanese:
「なっ―――――――」
　秋葉は物の見事に固まってしまっている。
　……まあ、まずは順当な反応といえるかもしれない。
　秋葉の中では今、俺に馬鹿にされているという考えが渦巻いていて、次の瞬間にも
「バカにしてるんですか、兄さんはっ！！！！」
　なんて、怒鳴ってくるに決まって―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――――――”
Akiha freezes dead still.
A reasonable first reaction, I suppose.
Right now, her mind must be seething with the conviction that I am making a fool of her, and at any moment she will
“Are you making fun of me, Brother?!”
Yes, she is bound to shout something like that―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
Akiha is taken completely by surprise.
…… Well, I guess it is a natural reaction.
In her head, she's probably thinking I'm making a fool of her, and anytime in the next instant,
"Are you making a fool out of me, Nii-san!!!???"
She'll shout something like that to me--

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　………あれ？
　怒っていることは怒っているみたいだけど、秋葉は何も言ってこない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
What?
She certainly looks angry, but Akiha says nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
……… Huh?
She seems upset, but she doesn't say anything.

entries.japanese:
「あの……秋葉？」
「……兄さん。
今のは、質の悪い冗談ですか」
「――――――う」
　秋葉は静かに、こっちの心を見通しかねない眼差しを向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Akiha?”
“Brother. Was that some particularly tasteless joke?”
“――――――Urgh.”
Akiha regards me quietly, her gaze threatening to see straight through my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Akiha?"
"…… Nii-san, is this some sort of a bad joke?"
"------Uh."
Akiha looks at me quietly, like she was seeing directly into my heart.

entries.japanese:
「いや……その、なんていうか」
「冗談、でしょう？」
「……まあ、そうとられても仕方がない、けど」
「―――いえ、冗談に決まっています。
ですから、今後はたとえ冗談だとしても、そのような事は口にしないでください」
　じっ、と怒っている、というよりは不安そうな目で秋葉は俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—I mean, well.”
“It was a joke, wasn’t it?”
“I suppose I can’t blame you for taking it that way, but…”
“―――No, it was unquestionably a joke. In the future, please do not say such things, even in jest.”
Akiha stares at me, looking less angry now than deeply uneasy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No…… well, how should I put this."
"A joke, right?"
"…… Well, I know it sounds like one, but…"
"---No, it has to be a joke.
So please do not say such things in the future, even if it is a joke."
She stares at me, more uneasy than angry.

entries.japanese:
その眼差しがあんまりにも真摯だったから、
「……………ん」
　と、曖昧に頷く事しか、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her gaze is so painfully earnest that
“Mm”
is all I can manage as I give her an uncertain nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since her stare looks so serious,
"……………… Yeah."
I can only nod to her.

entries.japanese:
「わかりました。
今回のことはこれ以上はお聞きしません。
けれど、今後はこのような事は控えてくださいね。
兄さんは遠野家の長男なんですから、もう少しご自分の立場というものを理解していただかないと困ります」
「―――む。
なんだよ、それは関係ないだろ。
だいたい遠野の跡取りは秋葉に決まったんだから、俺がなにをしようがいいじゃないか。
家のことを思うなら、遠野の家に相応しい婿養子でも見つければいいのに」
「―――――」
　……？
　なぜか秋葉は黙り込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. I won’t question you any further about this. But please refrain from doing anything like it again. You are the eldest son of the Tohno family, Brother. You must show some awareness of your position.”
“―――What does that have to do with anything? You’re already the Tohno heir, so what I do shouldn’t matter. If you’re worried about the family, find some suitable man to marry into it.”
“―――――”
What?
For some reason, Akiha falls silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
Then I will no longer ask about this.
But, please refrain from doing anything like this ever again.
Nii-san, you are the eldest son of the Tohno family; if you do not understand your position better, it will be very troubling."
"--Hey, that has nothing to do with this.
Besides, you are now the successor to the Tohno family, so it doesn't really matter what I do.
If you're so worried about the future of the Tohno family, you should go find a husband appropriate for the Tohno household."
"-----"
……?
For some reason, Akiha descends into silence.

entries.japanese:
「どうした？
　気分でも悪いのか、秋葉」
「――なんでもないです。
私のことを気遣う余裕があるのでしたら、ご自分の体調を気にしてください。
慢性的な貧血持ちなんですから、兄さんは」
「………む」
　……そりゃあたしかに、こっちは頻繁に貧血で倒れたりするけど。
「ともかく、あまりお一人で屋敷を出ないでください。
それでなくとも近頃の街は物騒なんですから。
　兄さんみたいにぼう、としている人は通り魔に襲ってください、と言っているようなものです」
「通り魔って―――ああ、例の連続殺人か」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Akiha? Are you feeling ill?”
“――It’s nothing. If you have time to worry about me, spend it worrying about your own health. You suffer from chronic anemia, Brother.”
“Right.”
She has a point, since I do collapse from anemia rather frequently.
“In any case, please don’t leave the mansion alone so often. The city has become dangerous lately. Someone as absentminded as you might as well hang a sign asking to be attacked.”
“Attacked―――oh, you mean those serial murders.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's wrong?
Are you feeling alright, Akiha?"
"--It's nothing.
If you have enough time to worry about me, please pay more attention to yourself.
You have your chronic anemia to worry about, Nii-san."
"……… Hmph."
…… Well, it is true that I frequently collapse from anemia.

"Anyway, please do not leave the mansion by yourself often.
Even without that, the city is dangerous recently.
Someone like you, who meanders about in a daze is just asking to be attacked by that serial killer."
"Serial killer?--Oh, those serial killings."

entries.japanese:
たしか九人ぐらいの犠牲者が出ている、という連続殺人事件。
　死体はすべて血液を搾取されているところから現代の吸血鬼か、なんて言われていたけど――
「ああ、それなら大丈夫。
あんな事件、二度と起きないから」
「――――は？」
「吸血鬼はいないっていうことだよ。
その犯人は、もう捕まったんだ」
「そうなんですか……？
　兄さん、よくそんなことを知っていますね」
「ま、たまたま見ただけだけど、たしかに、もうあんな事件は起きないんだ」
　……そう、少なくともこれ以上ネロに殺される人はいない。
　アルクェイドと過ごした二日間は、そりゃあ色々ありすぎて何が正しくて何が悪かったか、なんて言えない。
　けど、その事実だけは―――胸をはって良かったって言える事だと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
The serial murders with nine victims, if I remember correctly.
Every corpse was drained of blood, prompting lurid talk of a modern-day vampire――
“Oh, you don’t need to worry about that. It won’t happen again.”
“――――What?”
“I mean the vampire is gone. The killer has already been caught.”
“Has he…? Brother, how could you possibly know that?”
“I only happened to see it, but I’m certain there won’t be another murder like that.”
Yes—at least no one else will die at Nrvnqsr’s hands.
Too much happened during those two days with Arcueid for me to say what was right and what was wrong.
But that one fact―――I can hold my head high and call it a good thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Those serial killings where nine victims have been found.
Their bodies were all drained of blood, so they call it the modern day vampire, but--

"Oh, that's okay.
Those incidents, they won't ever happen again."
"----Huh?"
"It means the vampire isn't around anymore.
That killer--is caught already."
"Is that so……?
Nii-san, how do you know about that?"
"Well, I just happened to see it, but for sure, such things will not happen again."
…… Yeah, at least there won't be any more people killed by Nrvnqsr.
These past two days spent with Arcueid… so many things happened I really can't say just what is right and what is wrong.
But, the simple truth remains--I can say it was all for the best.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん―――？
　どうしたんです、急に嬉しそうな顔をして」
　秋葉は不思議そうにこちらの顔を覗いてくる。
「べつになんでもない。
ただ、終わったんだなって、ようやく実感できただけだから」
　知らずに笑顔で、俺はそんな返答をしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother―――? Why do you suddenly look so pleased?”
Akiha peers at me, puzzled.
“It’s nothing. I’ve only just realized that it’s finally over.”
Before I know it, I am smiling as I answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san----?
What happened?
You suddenly seem very happy."
Akiha looks strangely at my face.
"It's nothing.
I just feel that it is finally, finally over."
A smile unconsciously creeps over my lips as I answer.

entries.japanese:
時刻は七時すぎになった。
「志貴さーん、朝ごはんの支度、できましたよー」
　なんて、食堂から琥珀さんの元気のいい声が聞こえてくる。
「それじゃ朝ごはん食べてくるから。
秋葉もそろそろ時間だろ。
俺に気を使わないで先に行けよ」
「ええ、わかってるわ兄さん」
　しばらく話しをしていたせいか、秋葉は上機嫌だ。
　席をたって、食堂に移動した。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is a little past seven.
“Breakfast is ready, Master Shiki!”
Kohaku’s cheerful voice carries from the dining room.
“I’m going to eat, then. You should be leaving soon too, Akiha. Don’t wait on my account.”
“Yes, I know, Brother.”
Perhaps our long conversation has put her in a good mood.
I get up and go to the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's half past seven.
"Shiki-san, breakfast is ready!"
Kohaku-san's cheerful voice rings out from the dining room.
"Well, I'll go eat breakfast.
Isn't it almost time, Akiha?
Don't mind me and go ahead."
"Yes, I know, Nii-san."
Maybe it's because of our conversation, but Akiha is in a good mood.
Rising from my seat, I head to the dining room.

entries.japanese:
食欲がまったくない。
　なぜって、そりゃあ白いごはんに赤い血のふりかけがかかっていたら、誰だって食欲をなくす。
「────」
　ぶんぶん、と頭をふる。
　そんなのはもちろん錯覚で、琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食はいつもどおり素晴らしいものだった。
　気を取り直して朝食を口に運ぶ。
　───とたん、俺は吐き出してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have no appetite whatsoever.
Anyone would lose it if their white rice looked as though it had been sprinkled with red blood.
“────”
I shake my head hard.
It is an illusion, of course; the breakfast Kohaku prepared is as splendid as ever.
Pulling myself together, I raise a bite to my mouth.
───The instant I do, I spit it back out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I really don't have an appetite.
How come?
Well, having white rice with something blood-red all over it would make anyone lose their appetite.
"-----"
I shake my head.
It's certainly just an illusion, and Kohaku-san's cooking looks excellent as always.
Getting a hold of myself, I take a bite of the breakfast.
----I instantly spit it out.

entries.japanese:
すぐに食堂から出てきた俺に、秋葉は不審げな眼差しを向けてきた。
「兄さん、なにか忘れ物ですか？」
「いや、なんでもない。
ちょっとした事だから」
「志貴さん、今朝は食欲がないんだそうです。
お食事を口に運んでも戻されてしまうので、お薬だけ服用していただきました」
「え────？」
「いや、クスリっていってもただのビタミン剤だよ。
今朝はちょっとさ、夢見が悪かったんだ。
しばらくしたら気分が落ち着くから、メシは学校で食べる事にする」
　琥珀さんにではなく、目に見えて何かいいたそうな秋葉にそう告げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I emerge from the dining room almost immediately, Akiha gives me a suspicious look.
“Did you forget something, Brother?”
“No, it’s nothing. Just something minor.”
“Master Shiki has no appetite this morning. He couldn’t keep his food down, so I had him take some medicine instead.”
“What────?”
“It was only a vitamin supplement. I just had a bad dream this morning. I’ll feel better once I settle down, so I’ll eat at school.”
I address Akiha rather than Kohaku; Akiha is plainly bursting to say something.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha looks at me questioningly as I came out of the dining room so soon after I went in.
"Nii-san, did you forget something?"
"No, it's nothing.
It's just something really trivial."
"Shiki-san doesn't seem to have an appetite this morning.
He just throws anything he eats back up, so I got him to take some medicine."
"Eh-----?"
"She said medicine, but it's really just some vitamins… I had a bad dream last night.
I should settle down in a bit so I'll eat at school."
I didn't say this to Kohaku-san, but to Akiha's eyes telling me she wants to say something.

entries.japanese:
「そんなわけなんで、そろそろ行くよ。
散歩がてらに街を歩いてれば頭もスッキリするだろうし」
「ちょっと、兄さん───」
　背中に秋葉の声がかかる。
「行ってくる。
今日は早く帰ってくるから、小言はそん時にしてくれ」
　秋葉の心配そうな声をふりきって、屋敷の外へと出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, I should get going. A walk through town will probably clear my head.”
“Wait, Brother───”
Akiha calls after me.
“I’m off. I’ll be home early, so save the lecture until then.”
Leaving her worried voice behind, I walk out of the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So I'll head out soon.
My head should clear up once I start walking to school."
"Wait, Nii-san---"
Akiha's voice comes from behind me.
"I'm going.
I'll be back early today, so you can scold me then."
Ignoring Akiha's worried voice, I exit the mansion.

entries.japanese:
翡翠は鞄を持って門まで付き添ってくる。
「それじゃ行ってきます。
見送りありがとうな、翡翠」
　翡翠は無言で鞄を手渡してくれる。
「志貴さま、お帰りは何時ごろでしょうか？」
「俺も信用がないんだな。
大丈夫、今日はちゃんと夕方までには帰ってくるから」
「―――かしこまりました。
それでは行ってらっしゃいませ」
　翡翠はふかぶかとおじぎをする。
　それに照れくさいものを感じつつ、屋敷の門を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui carries my bag and accompanies me to the gate.
“I’m off, then. Thanks for seeing me out, Hisui.”
She silently places the bag in my hands.
“What time should we expect you home, Master Shiki?”
“I really have lost everyone’s trust, haven’t I? Don’t worry—I’ll be back by evening today.”
“―――Very well. Have a safe day.”
Hisui bows deeply.
Feeling more than a little self-conscious, I leave the mansion gates behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui walks with me to the gate, carrying my bag.
"Well, I'll be going.
Thanks for seeing me off, Hisui."
Hisui wordlessly hands me my bag.

"Shiki-sama, around what time will you be returning?"
"You don't trust me either?
It's okay.
I'll definitely be back in the afternoon."
"--I understand.
Then please be careful on your way."
Hisui bows deeply.
Feeling a bit embarrassed about it, I leave the mansion's gate.

entries.japanese:
交差点にはうちの高校の生徒たちしかいない。
　あの時のように、ガードレールに腰を下ろして誰かを待っている女性の姿はない。
「―――ま、当たり前か」
　あいつとはもう会う事はないだろう。
　そもそもあいつの目的は吸血鬼を退治する事だったらしいから、ネロが消えた今この街に残っている理由がない。
―――少し、胸に残ってる。
　後悔とか、未練とか、そういったものが。
　そりゃああいつは厄介ごとしか持ち出さないヤツだったけど、それでも少しは……まあ、一緒にいれて楽しかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The intersection is occupied only by students from my school.
There is no woman sitting on the guardrail, waiting for someone as she did before.
“―――Well, of course not.”
I will probably never see her again.
Her purpose seems to have been hunting vampires, and with Nrvnqsr gone, she has no reason to remain in this city.
―――Still, something lingers in my chest.
Regret, perhaps, or reluctance to let go.
She brought me nothing but trouble, certainly, but I still enjoyed being with her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At the intersection there are only the figures of my fellow high school students.
No young woman sitting on the guardrail like that one time.

"--Well, of course."
I probably won't ever see her again.
First of all, her goal was to execute the vampire, and with Nrvnqsr gone, there's no reason for her to stay around here any longer.
--Just a little bit, in my chest.
Things like regret… and lingering affection.
It is true she only brought trouble, but even still…… it was fun being with her.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　自分で自分がどうかしているとは思う。
　あんな危険な目にあったっていうのに、無意識にアルクェイドの姿を思い出そうとしてしまう自分がいる。
　……なんだか、まるであいつに片思いをしているみたいだ。
　遠野志貴はもう二度と、あんな危険な目に遭うのはゴメンだっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I know there must be something wrong with me.
After all that danger, some part of me is still trying to summon Arcueid’s face from memory.
It is almost as if I have an unrequited crush on her.
Even though Shiki Tohno wants no part of anything so dangerous ever again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
I think there must be something wrong with me.
Even though I was in such danger the whole time, there's still a part of me that unconsciously tries to remember her.
…… It's almost like I'm in love with her.
Even though I would never want to be exposed to that kind of danger again.

entries.japanese:
朝食を抜いたおかげか、ゆったりと歩いても正門が閉められる十分前に到着できた。
　この時間は朝の部活をしていない生徒が登校してくる時間帯だ。
　進学校であるうちの高校の部活は、おもだった体育系の部活しか朝錬はしていない。
　自然、校門は群がる生徒たちでごった返すことになる。
「────あ」
　校門をくぐっていく後ろ姿に見知ったものがあった。
　自分でも何をしたいのか分からないまま、その後ろ姿を追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps because I skipped breakfast, even an unhurried walk brings me to the main gate ten minutes before it closes.
This is when students without morning practice arrive.
At our college-prep school, only the major sports clubs practice before class.
Naturally, the gate is choked with students.
“────Ah.”
I recognize a figure passing through it.
Without knowing what I intend, I hurry after her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Because I skipped breakfast, I arrive at the front gate ten minutes before it closes.
Everyone who doesn't have club activities before school arrives at this time.
The only clubs that meet in the morning are the sports clubs.
So naturally, the entrance gets crowded with students.
"----Ah."
By the gate I see a familiar figure.
Not even knowing what I plan on doing, I chase after her.

entries.japanese:
「あ、おはようございます遠野くん。
めずらしいですね、校庭で会うなんて」
「……うん。
先輩の後ろ姿が見えたから走ってきたんだ。
その……ちょっと聞きたい事があってさ」
　ちら、と先輩の顔を盗み見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Tohno. How unusual to meet you in the schoolyard.”
“Morning. I saw you ahead of me and ran to catch up. There’s something I wanted to ask.”
I steal a glance at Ciel’s face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, good morning Tohno-kun.
It's strange to meet you out here."
"…… Yeah, I saw you from behind, so I ran after you.
Um…… there was something I wanted to ask."
I sneak a look at her face.

entries.japanese:
「はい、なんでしょう」
　先輩はいつもの柔らかな笑顔を向けてくる。
　俺は───
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes—what is it?”
Ciel gives me her usual gentle smile.
I───
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, what is it?"
She faces me with her usual, gentle smile.
I---

entries.japanese:
……ちょっと待った。
　あんな事があったっていうのに、先輩はいつも通りの笑顔を向けてくる。
　昨夜の事――――俺とネロとの一戦を観ていたのなら、こんなふうに自然に挨拶を返してきてくれるハズがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wait a minute.
After everything that happened, Ciel is still smiling at me exactly as she always does.
Last night――――if she witnessed my battle with Nrvnqsr, there is no way she could return my greeting so naturally.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Wait a minute.
All of that happened, and Senpai still greeted me with her usual smile.
Last night----if she saw me fighting Nrvnqsr, then she definitely can't just greet me like this.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　お話があるんじゃないんですか？」
「いや、ちょっと待って」
　……よく思い返してみれば、昨夜助けてくれた誰かは別段シエル先輩に似ていた、というわけでもない。
　顔も夜だったからよく見えなかったし、雰囲気なんてまるっきり別物だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? Didn’t you have something to say?”
“No—wait.”
Thinking back carefully, the person who rescued me last night did not particularly resemble Ciel.
It was too dark to see her face clearly, and her entire manner was different.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
Did you want to say something?"
"Um, hold on."
…… If I think back, that person who helped me last night may not have looked like Ciel-senpai at all.
I couldn't get a good look at her face because it was dark, and her atmosphere was completely different.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、よく顔を見せてくれる？」
「はい？」
　と、不思議そうに首をかしげて、上目遣いでこっちを見つめてくる先輩。
　……やっぱりそうだ。
　冷静になればなるほど、あの人影は先輩とは似ていないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, could I get a good look at your face?”
“Pardon?”
She tilts her head in confusion and gazes up at me.
I knew it.
The more calmly I consider it, the less that shadow resembles her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, could I get a good look at your face?"
"Uh, yes?"
She curiously tilts her head and looks up at me.
…… Of course.
Once I think it through calmly, that person didn't resemble Senpai at all.

entries.japanese:
「……わるい、ただの勘違いだった。
なんでもない事だから、いまのは忘れてくれ」
「はあ、勘違いですか。
なにをどう勘違いしたのかちょっと興味ありますね」
　じぃ、となおも上目遣いで俺の顔を覗きこんでくる。
「う……それが、その」
　先輩から視線を逸らして、赤面しているであろう顔を隠す。
　……朝っぱらから正門で、こんなに近づかれると、照れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, I was mistaken. It’s nothing, so forget I asked.”
“Mistaken? Now I’m rather curious what you mistook me for.”
She continues peering up into my face.
“Uh, well…”
I avert my eyes, hiding what must be a furious blush.
Having her stand this close at the school gates first thing in the morning is mortifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, it's just a mistake.
It's nothing, so please forget about it."
"A mistake?
I'm a little interested--Mistake about what?"
She still stares up into my face.
"Uh…… It's, ummm."
Looking away, I try to hide my blushing face.
…… Having her so close to me at the school gate is embarrassing.

entries.japanese:
「なんでも、ないんです。
たんに昨日の深夜、先輩に似た人を見かけただけの話で、それもただの勘違いだってはっきり解ったから」
「……はあ、わたしに似た人、ですか？」
　先輩は興味深そうに頷いたりしている。
　どうも忘れてくれる、というわけにはいかなさそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s really nothing. I only saw someone who looked like you late last night, and now I know I was mistaken.”
“Someone who looked like me?”
She nods thoughtfully, clearly intrigued.
It appears she has no intention of forgetting this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N, nothing.
I just thought I saw someone that looked like you last night, but it must have been a mistake."
"…… Hmm, a person that looked like me?"
Senpai gives a very interested nod.
It seems she isn't going to just forget about it.

entries.japanese:
───おもいきって、昨夜の事を聞いてみた。
「……あのさ先輩。
昨日の夜、公園のほうにいなかった？
　黒いコートみたいな服を着て、スカートをこうばさばさーとなびかせて」
「……？
　なんですか、それ」
「だから……！
　えっと、それと――そう、編み上げブーツがすごく似合ってたじゃないか。
ちょっと見惚れるぐらい、かっこ良かった」
　……はい？
　と先輩は首をかしげる。
　俺が何を言ってるのか皆目見当がつかない、というように顔をしかめてから、先輩はきっぱりと否定した。
entries.maoEnglish:
───I take the plunge and ask her about last night.
“Listen… Were you near the park last night? Wearing something like a black coat, with your skirt whipping around all dramatically?”
“…What are you talking about?”
“That’s what I mean…! And――yes, those lace-up boots suited you perfectly. You looked so cool I could hardly stop staring.”
“Excuse me?” Ciel tilts her head.
After frowning in utter bewilderment, she gives me a flat denial.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I gather up my courage and ask her about last night.
"…… Uh--Senpai.
Last night, were you in the park?
I thought I saw you wearing something like a black coat, with your skirt flowing in the wind."
"…… What is that?"
"Um……!
well--yeah, the high-laced boots suited you.
I was kind of fascinated, you looked… really cool."

……"Huh?" Senpai tilts her head.
She frowns like she doesn't understand my words completely, and then denies it.

entries.japanese:
「えっと、よくわかりませんけど、昨日の夜にわたしが公園にいて、そうゆうカッコウをしていたんですか？」
「ああ。
あれ、先輩だろ？」
「わけありませんっ。
遠野くん、わたしってそんなに暇な人に見えるんですか？」
　―――先輩は、本気で怒ってしまった。
　そこにしらをきっているとか嘘をついているとか、そういったものは一切ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m not sure I follow; were you in the park last night dressed like that?”
“Yes. That was you, wasn’t it?”
“Of course it wasn’t! Tohno, do I look as though I have that much time to waste?”
―――She is genuinely angry.
There is no trace of evasion or deceit in her reaction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, I don't quite understand, but you're saying that I was near your house two nights ago, looking like that?"
"Yeah.
Senpai, that was you, right?"
"No way.
Tohno-kun, are you saying I look like I really have that much free time?"
---Senpai is really angry.
She can't be playing ignorant or lying.

entries.japanese:
「あ───いや、そんな事はないんだけど、その……昨日、先輩に似た人を公園で見かけたから、それで―――」
　はあ、と先輩はため息をつく。
「遠野くん、それわたしじゃないです。
わたし、そういう趣味はないですから」
「あ───うん、わかってる。
ただちょっと聞きたかっただけなんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah───no, nothing like that; I only asked because I saw someone who looked like you yesterday―――”
Ciel sighs.
“Tohno, that was not me. I have no interest in dressing that way.”
“Ah───yes, I understand. I only wanted to ask.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----No, that's not it, but I just…… saw someone that looked like you in park last night, so---"
Senpai gives a sigh.
"Tohno-kun, that wasn't me.
I don't have that kind of hobby."
"Ah---Yeah, I know.
I just wanted to ask."

entries.japanese:
そう、言われて見ればその通りだ。
　シエル先輩と昨日の夜の人物はぜんぜん結びつかない。
　そもそも先輩は普通の人だし、もしあの場に居合わせたのなら───俺がナイフをもって吸血鬼を殺したところを見たはずだ。
　あんな凄惨な場面を見てしまったのなら、俺とこうして今までどおり話なんか出来るはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Now that she says it, the truth is obvious.
Ciel and the person from last night simply do not belong together.
Ciel is an ordinary person, and if she had been there───she would have seen me kill a vampire with a knife.
No one who witnessed something so horrific could stand here afterward and talk to me as though nothing had changed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Certainly after having her say that, she is right.
Ciel-senpai and the person that night aren't related at all.
In the first place, Senpai's just a normal person, and if she was actually there---she had to have seen me kill that vampire with my knife.
If she saw such a gruesome scene, there'd be no way she could talk with me normally like this.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん、今のは忘れて。
なんか他人の空似だったみたいだ」
「いいですけど……そんなにわたしに似てたんですか、そのヘンな人」
「そう言われると自信ないな。
夜だったし、遠かったし………って、あれ？」
　そう、遠くて顔だってよく見えなかった。
　なのにどうして、俺はアレが先輩に似てる、なんて思ったんだろう……？
「……なんだかなぁ。
やっぱりどうかしてたのかもしんない」
　うーん、と腕をくんでうなだれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, forget I asked. It seems I mistook a stranger for you.”
“All right, but did this strange person really look so much like me?”
“Now that you ask, I’m not sure. It was dark and she was far away, but wait?”
Yes, she was too far away for me even to see her face.
So why did I ever decide that thing resembled Ciel?
“I don’t know. Maybe I really was out of my mind.”
I fold my arms and hang my head, thinking hard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, please forget about it.
I guess it was just someone else."
"That's fine, but…… did that person really look like me?
That weird person?"
"Well, I'm not too sure.
It was dark, and far away………… huh?"
Yeah, it was far and I couldn't make out her face.
So why did I think it looked like Senpai……?
"…… Hmm… Maybe there is something wrong with me."
I cross my arms and think.

entries.japanese:
と、門限十分前の予鈴が鳴り響いた。
「―――やばっ、遅刻する。
それじゃ先輩、またあとで！」
「はい、お昼休みにお邪魔しますね」
entries.maoEnglish:
Then the warning bell rings, ten minutes before the gates close.
“Damn, I’ll be late. See you later!”
“All right, I’ll visit at lunch.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The ten minute bell rings.
"--Uh-oh, we'll be late.
Well, bye Senpai, see you later!"
"Yes, I'll come see you during lunchtime."

entries.japanese:
教室に駆け込む。
　ホームルーム五分前、教室の中はいまだにがやがやと騒がしい。
「―――ふう」
　一息をついて机に向かう。
　この分なら、別段走る必要はなかったかもしれない。
「いょぉう、さぼり魔」
「…………」
　背後から、聞きなれたあまりよろしくない声がかけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I race into the classroom.
With five minutes left before homeroom, it is still humming with chatter.
“Whew.”
I catch my breath and head for my desk.
Judging from the atmosphere, there was no need to run.
“Yo, truant.”
“…”
An all-too-familiar and thoroughly unwelcome voice addresses me from behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fly into my classroom.
It's still five minutes before class, so it's very noisy inside.
"--Whew."
I take a breath and head to my seat.
With this much time left, I didn't even need to run at all.
"Yo, Duke of Delinquency."
"………"
From behind, I hear the voice I never look forward to.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんだよ遠野。
おまえが学校をさぼるなんて聞いてないぞオレ。
こまるじゃんか、ちゃんと今日はさぼって遊びに行くぞって報告してくれなくちゃ！」
　やけに嬉しそうな顔で、有彦はたわけた言葉を吐き出してくる。
「……あのさ。
なんで俺が学校を休むってことをいちいちおまえに報告しなくちゃいけないんだ」
「あったりまえだろ。
遠野が来ないってコトは先輩もうちの教室にやってこないんだから、事前に手をうっておかないとまずいじゃないか」
　……何がまずいんだろうか、この男は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened, Tohno? Nobody told me you were skipping school. That’s a problem—you’ve got to report in properly when you ditch class for a day of fun!”
Arihiko delivers this idiocy with a delighted grin.
“Listen. Why should I have to report every absence to you?”
“Obviously. If Tohno isn’t here, Ciel won’t come to our class either, so I need advance warning to make other arrangements.”
What could possibly be such a problem to this man?
