　そうしてちょっとした沈黙が続いたあと、先輩はキッと俺を見つめてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well. I am not entirely sure. I do not pay very much attention to myself.”
She says it almost apologetically.
“―――I suppose I do not like myself very much.”
“Ciel?”
She falls silent and refuses to look at me.
After a brief silence, she suddenly fixes me with a fierce stare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She sighs.
"I'm a little unsure.
I'm not usually concerned with myself."
Senpai almost sounds apologetic.
"---Probably, I don't like myself."
"…… Senpai?"
Senpai sits in silence without looking at me.
After a short moment of silence, she suddenly glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「そんな事より、遠野くん」
「……はい」
　姿勢を正して先輩の瞳を見つめ返す。
　……先輩が、これからすごく深刻な話をしてくるのがわかったから。
「あの……なんですか、先輩」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind that, Tohno.”
“Yes.”
I sit up straight and meet her eyes.
I can tell she is about to say something desperately serious.
“Um, what is it, Ciel?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"More importantly, Tohno-kun."
"…… Yes?"
Straightening up, I look back into her eyes.
…… Since I know she's about to begin a very serious conversation.
"Uh…… what is it, Senpai?"

entries.japanese:
「カレーパン、ください」
「な、なんですかいきなり！
　だいたい先輩、さっきは食べ物にはつられないって言ってたじゃないか！」
「それとこれとは別問題ですっ。
遠野くん、自分が言った事をいまさら反古にする気なんですか！？」
　……先輩は怒っている。
　俺にとっては冗談だったけど、先輩にとってさっきのは大真面目な取引だったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“May I have the curry bread?”
“W-what brought that on?! You just said food couldn’t tempt you!”
“That is an entirely separate matter! Tohno, do you mean to go back on your word now?!”
Ciel is genuinely angry.
I was only joking, but apparently she considered our exchange a solemn bargain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Could I have that curry bread?"
"Wh, what's with that all of a sudden!?
Didn't you just say you won't be bought out by food!?"
"That's a different matter.
Tohno-kun, are you trying to take back what you said earlier!?"
…… Senpai is really angry.
It was just a joke for me, but I guess she took it very seriously.

entries.japanese:
「……はいはい。
わかりましたよ、どうぞお納めください将軍さま」
　ずい、とカレーパンを渡す。
　こうなると、こちらの手元に残ったのはソーセージパンだけだ。
　わーい、と先輩は喜んでカレーパンを手に取った。
　……子供なんだろうか、このひとは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, yes. I understand; please accept your tribute, Your Excellency.”
I thrust the curry bread at her.
That leaves me with nothing but the sausage roll.
Delighted, Ciel takes the curry bread with a cry of “Yay!”
Is this woman a child?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, yes, I understand.
Please accept this, Your Highness."
I hand over the curry bread.
Giving that up, I only have some sausage bread left.
"Yay!" Senpai happily takes it from me.
…… Is she a kid or something?

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ遠野くんにはハンバーグを分けてあげます」
　はいどうぞ、とお弁当箱のハンバーグを二つに割って、半月ハンバーグが渡された。
「…………」
　物々交換にしては、レートに差がありすぎると思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I will share my hamburger patty with you.”
With a cheerful offer, she splits the patty in her lunch box and hands me one half-moon patty.
“…”
As barter goes, the exchange rate seems badly skewed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then I will give you some of this hamburger.
Here you go," Senpai says as she gives me half of it from her lunch.
"………"
I think the difference in the barter exchange rate was a little high…

entries.japanese:
お互い昼食を終えて、お茶をすすりながらぼんやりと時間を過ごす。
　まったりとした、平穏な時間が流れる。
　先輩は俺のことを意識していないみたいだし、こっちも先輩のことは特別意識していない。
　ただ、ゆったりと。
　同性の友人みたいな感覚で、残りの休み時間を過ごしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once we finish eating, we sip our tea and let the time drift by.
It is a warm, peaceful lull.
She doesn’t seem self-conscious around me, and I’m not particularly self-conscious around her either.
We simply relax.
We spend the rest of lunch as casually as if she were another male friend.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After we finish our meals, we pass the time while sipping tea.
A perfectly tranquil passing of time.
It seems like she's not conscious of my presence, and I'm not especially conscious of her presence either.
Just, a calmness.
Like two friends of the same gender, we pass the remaining break time like this.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ、遠野くん」
「はい？
　なんですか先輩」
「前から思ってたんですけど、遠野くんのメガネって度が入ってないんじゃないですか？」
「……へえ。
すごいな先輩、ドンピシャだ。
実はこのメガネは伊達でかけてるんだ」
　やっぱり、と先輩は得意げに頷いたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Say, Tohno.”
“Yes? What is it, Ciel?”
“I have wondered about this for a while; your glasses do not have prescription lenses, do they?”
“Wow. Exactly right. They are just for show.”
Ciel nods triumphantly, plainly pleased to have guessed right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Tohno-kun."
"Yes?
What is it, Senpai?"
"I've been thinking about this for a while, but your glasses aren't used to correct your vision, right?"
"…… Wow, you're amazing Senpai, bullseye.
They're just for show."
"I knew it," Senpai nods.

entries.japanese:
「ね、遠野くん。
お願いがあるんですけど、いいかな」
　先輩は期待のこもった目で、じっと俺の目を見る。
……っていうより、俺のメガネを見ている。
「一度でいいですから、そのメガネ、とってみてくれません？」
「―――――――――」
　それは、困る。
　このメガネをとるっていう事は『線』を視るっていう事だし、なにより―――俺は身近な人の『死』なんてモノ、視たくはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, I have a favor to ask. Would that be all right?”
She gazes expectantly into my eyes. Or rather, she is staring at my glasses.
“Just once, would you take them off for me?”
“―――――――――”
That is a problem.
Taking off my glasses means seeing the ‘lines’; more than anything―――I do not want to see the ‘death’ of anyone close to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Tohno-kun, could I ask a favor?"
Senpai looks expectantly at my eyes.
…… Not so much my eyes, but my glasses.
"Just once, could you take off those glasses?"
"---------"
That would be troubling.
Taking these glasses off means I would see those "lines" and more importantly---I don't want to see the "death" of this person close to me.

entries.japanese:
「それはダメですね。
残念ながら、このメガネは人前でとったコトはないんです。
ちょっとした願掛けですから、先輩のお願いは却下します」
　きっぱりと返答する。
　先輩は残念そうにうなだれた。
「はあ。
遠野くんがそう断言するからにはダメなんでしょうね」
「はい。
なにしろこの八年間、決して――――」
　……人前ではとっていなかった、けど。
「――――」
　そうか。
もう、そうじゃなくなったのか。
　俺は、この目で。
　色々なモノの、死を視てきてしまったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am afraid not. I have never taken these glasses off in front of anyone. It is part of a vow I made, so your request is denied.”
I answer without hesitation.
She hangs her head, visibly disappointed.
“Oh. If you are that firm about it, I suppose there is no persuading you.”
“Right. For eight years, I have never once――――”
I had never taken them off in front of anyone, true.
“――――”
I see. That is no longer true.
With these eyes.
Because I have seen the death of so many things.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I can't do that.
Unfortunately, I've never taken these off in front of others.
It's kind of like a vow, so I'll reject your request."
I answer clearly.
Senpai slumps disappointedly.
"Huh, if you say so, then I guess it's not possible."
"Yes, because these past eight years, I never---"
…… never took them off in front of other people, but.
"----"
That's right.
That ended.
With these eyes.
I saw the death of many, many things.
"-------Tohno-kun?"

entries.japanese:
「あ―――うん、なに先輩？」
「なに、じゃないですよ。
急にぼーっとしちゃってびっくりしました。
休み時間、もう終わっちゃいますよ」
「……あ、本当だ。
なんだ、あと十分ぐらいあると思ったんだけどな」
「ええ、十分ぐらいありましたよ。
遠野くんがずぅーっとぼんやりしてただけです」
　先輩は二人分の湯呑みを片付けはじめる。
「あれ……十分も経ったかな……」
　微かに首をかしげながら、俺も先輩の手伝いをして、茶道室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――yes, what is it, Ciel?”
“Do not ask me that. You suddenly went blank and startled me. Lunch break is almost over.”
“Oh, you are right. Strange, I thought we still had about ten minutes.”
“We did have ten minutes. You spent them aaaaall staring into space.”
She begins putting away both our teacups.
“Has it really been ten minutes…?”
Still faintly puzzled, I help her clean up and leave the tea ceremony room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---yeah, what is it Senpai?"
"What do you mean, 'what is it?' Suddenly spacing out like that, lunch break is almost over you know."
"…… Oh, that's true.
I thought we had about ten more minutes."
"Yes, we did have ten minutes.
But you were just spaced out for that long."
Senpai gathers up the cups.
"Huh…… Was it really ten minutes……?"
While I'm still tilting my head in curiosity, I help Senpai tidy up the tea ceremony room and then leave.

entries.japanese:
+
　今日も確実にひまを持て余しながら授業が終わった。
　さて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
+
Another day of lessons ends, every bit as boring as expected.
Well then―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
+
Classes end again with plenty of time to spare.
Well---

entries.japanese:
とりわけやる事もないし、まっすぐ屋敷に帰る事にしよう。
　坂をのぼりきって、屋敷に帰ってきた。
　時刻はまだ夕方の五時前。
　夕食まであと二時間、部屋で時間を潰すとしようか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
There is nothing in particular I need to do, so I decide to head straight home.
I climb the hill and return to the estate.
It is not yet five.
With two hours until dinner, I might as well kill time in my room―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I have nothing in particular to do, so I decide to just head straight back to the mansion.
Climbing the hill, I return to the mansion.
It's not even five o'clock yet.
There's still two hours until dinner, so I'll kill some time in my room---

entries.japanese:
茶道室へ急ぐ。
　と、ちょうど先輩が茶道室の扉に手をかけているところだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hurry to the tea-ceremony room.
I arrive just as Ciel reaches for the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hurry to the tea ceremony room.
Senpai has her hand on the door as I arrive.

entries.japanese:
「先輩！」
「あ、遠野くん。
これからお帰りですか？」
「いや、ちょっと先輩と話していこうと思って。
これから茶道室でお茶するんだろ？
　俺もごちそうになろうかなって」
「いえ、今日は帰るところなんです。
用事もあるし、そろそろ今月の部費も底をついてしまいまして」
「―――あ。
そっか、茶道室にある和菓子って茶道部の部費で買ってるんだっけ」
　……しかし部費でお菓子が買える部活っていうのも、考えてみると素晴らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
“Oh, Tohno. Are you going home now?”
“No, I thought I’d stay and talk with you. You were about to have tea, right? I thought I might let you treat me to a cup.”
“Actually, I am leaving today. I have an errand, and the club has nearly exhausted this month’s budget.”
“―――Oh. Right—the tea ceremony club buys those sweets with club funds.”
Come to think of it, any club allowed to spend its budget on sweets is a magnificent institution.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai!"
"Ah, Tohno-kun.
Are you going home now?"
"No, I thought I'd talk with you a little bit.
You're going to have some tea now, right?
I was thinking of joining you."
"No, I'm going home now.
I have something to do, and this month club funding is getting a little low."
"---Ah.
I see, all those tea snacks were bought with club money."
…… But, come to think of it, a club that can buy snacks with its own funds has to be wonderful.

entries.japanese:
「そういうわけですから、遠野くんにはお付き合いできません。
……遠野くん、この後なにか予定が入ってますか？」
「俺？
　いや、今なくなったけど」
「それでしたらわたしにお付き合いしてください。
校門まで一緒に帰りましょう」
「ええ、喜んでお付き合いします」
　先輩はにっこりと頷くと、俺の横について歩き出す。
　校門までの、わずか五分たらずの帰り道を一緒に帰ることになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In that case, I’m afraid I cannot keep you company. Tohno, do you have any plans after this?”
“Me? No—they just disappeared.”
“Then keep me company instead. Let us walk to the school gates together.”
“Gladly.”
Ciel nods with a smile and falls into step beside me.
We share the scant five-minute walk to the gates.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So I can't keep you company…… Tohno-kun, do you have any plans after this?"
"Me?
No, not anymore."
"Well then, care to walk with me to the front gate?"
"Yeah, it would be my pleasure."
Senpai grins and nods, and walks by my side.
We decide to walk together for five minutes to the school gate.

entries.japanese:
たいした会話もなく正門に到着した。
「それじゃあまた明日な、先輩」
　片手をあげて、先輩とは正反対の道へ歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
With little of consequence said between us, we reach the front gate.
“See you tomorrow, Ciel.”
I raise one hand and start down the road opposite hers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Without any serious talk between us, we arrive at the school gate.
"Well then, see ya tomorrow, Senpai."
Raising one hand, I start off down the road in the opposite direction from her.

entries.japanese:
「あ、ちょっと待ってください。
わたし、遠野くんに聞きたいことがあったんです」
「？
　なに、聞きたい事って」
「昨日遠野くんが言っていた、わたしに良く似た誰かの話です。
なんだか気になっちゃって、もうすこし詳しく話が聞きたいなって」
　好奇心旺盛、とばかりに先輩は目を輝かせている。
　……けど、俺にしてみるとあの出来事はあんまり思い出したくない部類のものだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait a moment. There was something I wanted to ask you.”
“What? What did you want to ask?”
“The person you mentioned yesterday—the one who looked so much like me. It has been on my mind, and I would like to hear more.”
Her eyes light up with curiosity.
For my part, that incident belongs firmly among the things I prefer not to remember.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, please wait.
I have something I wanted to ask you, Tohno-kun."
"?
What is it?"
"Yesterday, you said there was someone that looked like me.
I kind of got curious, so I wanted to hear a bit more about it."
Her eyes burn with curiosity.
…… But to me, that's not something I really want to recall.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん、その話はしたくないんだ。
アレは俺の見間違いだったんだから、それでいいじゃないか」
　先輩から視線を逸らして、曖昧な言い訳をする。
「そうですか」
　先輩はあっさりと質問をとりやめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, but I do not want to talk about it. I was seeing things, so can we leave it at that?”
I look away and offer the vague excuse.
“All right.”
Ciel abandons the question without protest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, I don't want to talk about it.
It was just a mistake I made, so it's okay."
I look away from Senpai as I give a vague excuse.
"Is that so?"
Senpai quickly ends her questioning.

entries.japanese:
「でもその人を見たのは夜中なんですよね。
　……遠野くん、あんまり夜遅くに出歩くのは危ないと思います。
この街では通り魔殺人が続いているんですよ。
そんな、夜中に出歩いて通り魔に出会ってしまったら大変でしょう？」
「……先輩、もしかして俺が夜出歩いているっていうの、心配してくれたのか？」
「―――はい。
遠野くんは人がいいですから。
なんか、あっさり騙されて危ない目にあうタイプです」
　真剣に先輩は心配してくれているみたいだ。
「―――――ん」
　うん、そういう心遣いは、すごく嬉しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But you saw that person late at night, did you not?
Tohno, I do not think you should wander around so late. The killings in this city have not stopped. It would be terrible if you went out at night and ran into the murderer, would it not?”
“Ciel, were you worried about me going out at night?”
“―――Yes. You are too trusting. You seem like the sort who could be lured into danger without a second thought.”
She really does seem concerned.
“―――――Mm”
That kind of consideration makes me very happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But you saw that person late at night, right?
…… Tohno-kun, I think walking around late at night like that is pretty dangerous.
Those serial killings have been continuing, you know?
If you meet that serial killer, that would be terrible, wouldn't it?"
"…… Senpai, you're worried about me walking out late at night?"
"---Yes.
You're a good person, so you're the type that'll get easily tricked and put in danger."
Senpai looks like she is seriously worried.
"-----Nn."
Yes, her concern makes me extremely happy.

entries.japanese:
「ありがと先輩。
けど大丈夫だって。
あの事件の張本人はもういないんだから」
「え？
　もういないって、なんですそれ？」
　……しまった、ネロの事は俺とアルクェイドだけの秘密だ。
　先輩に言うことはできないし、第一あんな話をしても仕方がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thanks, Ciel. But I’ll be fine. The killer is gone now.”
“Gone? What do you mean?”
Damn it; Nrvnqsr is a secret known only to Arcueid and me.
I cannot tell Ciel, and even if I did, what good would such a story do?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks Senpai.
But it's alright, the one behind those incidents is gone."
"Eh?
Gone?
What do you mean?"
…… Crap, Nrvnqsr is a secret between just me and Arcueid.
I can't talk to Senpai about it, and besides, it's no use telling her about it.

entries.japanese:
「いや、うん、そうだな、夜中に出歩くのは危ないよな、実際」
「……。
とにかく、今夜から出歩くのはやめてください。
遠野くんはまじめな学生さんなんですから」
「ああ、わかってるって。
真面目かどうかはしらないけど、先輩のいうとおり夜遊びは控えるよ」
「………………」
　先輩はじーっ、と見つめてくる。
―――信用がないのか、先輩は納得してくれないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you are right; going out in the middle of the night really is dangerous.”
“In any case, please stop going out at night. Starting tonight. You’re supposed to be a responsible student.”
“All right, all right. I don’t know about responsible, but I’ll take your advice and cut out the late-night adventures.”
“…”
Ciel stares at me.
―――Apparently she trusts me so little that she is not convinced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, yeah, that's right.
It is dangerous to walk around at night, really."
"…… Anyway, from now on, please stop walking around at night.
You're a good student."
"Yeah, I know.
I'm not sure about being a good student, but I won't play around at night anymore like you say."
"…………………"
Senpai stares at me.
---Does she not believe me?
She doesn't seem convinced.

entries.japanese:
「……わかったよ。
それじゃ、約束」
　スッ、と片手を差し出す。
「先輩には一回、とんでもなく大きい借りがあるからさ。
先輩の言いつけはちゃんと守るよ。
だから、約束しよう」
「えっと……………握手、するんですか？」
「そっ。
指きりって歳じゃないから、握手して約束しよう」
「………………」
　先輩はすこし戸惑ったあと、差し出した手を握り返してきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. Then let’s make it a promise.”
I hold out a hand.
“I owe you a tremendous debt. I’ll do as you ask, Ciel. So let’s make it a promise.”
“Um, you want to shake hands?”
“Exactly. We are a little old for pinky promises, so we will seal it with a handshake.”
“…”
After a moment’s hesitation, Ciel takes my offered hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I get it.
Then, I promise."
I stick out a hand.
"Senpai, I owe you one for that time, so I'll do as you ask.
So it's a promise."
"Um……………… you want to, shake hands?"
"Yeah.
We're a bit too old for pinkie promises, so we'll shake hands."
"…………………"
After standing there a little perplexedly, Senpai takes my outstretched hand.

entries.japanese:
「わかりました。
約束ですからね、遠野くん」
　ぶんぶん、と先輩は握った手を上下に振る。
「それじゃさよなら。
また明日、学校で会いましょう」
　先輩の姿が夕焼けの中、遠くなっていく。
　それを見届けてから、こっちも帰途につくことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. It is a promise, Tohno.”
She pumps our joined hands enthusiastically.
“Goodbye, then. I’ll see you at school tomorrow.”
I watch Ciel recede into the sunset.
Once she is out of sight, I start home myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
It's a promise, Tohno-kun."
She shakes my hand up and down.
"Well then, goodbye.
Let's meet again at school tomorrow."
Wrapped up in the sunset, Senpai disappears.
After watching her go, I decide to head home, too.

entries.japanese:
坂をのぼりきって、屋敷に帰ってきた。
　時刻はまだ夕方の六時前。
　夕食まであと一時間、部屋で時間を潰すとしようか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I climb the hill and return to the estate.
It is not yet six.
With an hour until dinner, I might as well kill time in my room―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk up the road and back to the mansion.
It's not quite six o'clock yet.
There's still an hour until dinner, so I'll kill some time in my room---

entries.japanese: このまままっすぐ屋敷に戻るのもなんだし、街をぶらついてみよう。
entries.maoEnglish: Going straight home seems dull, so I decide to wander around town.
entries.mirrorMoon: I don't feel like returning to the mansion directly, so I'll wander around the city for a bit.

entries.japanese:
―――かといって、アテもなく駅前にやってきても何があるというワケでもない。
　遠野の屋敷に引っ越してからの遠野志貴の財政事情はとても厳しいので、ここで散布をするのも気が引ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Then again, arriving at the station with no destination does not magically provide anything to do.
Since moving into the Tohno estate, Shiki Tohno’s finances have become so tight that squandering money here is out of the question.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I arrive in front of the station for no apparent reason.
Ever since I was invited back to live in the Tohno mansion, I've been low on money, so I really don't want to spend any money here.

entries.japanese:
有間の家にいたころは啓子さんから幾ばくかのお小遣い……華道で使用する和室の掃除や庭の手入れの報酬……を貰っていたけど、屋敷に帰ってからはそんな収入は望めないだろう。
　アルバイトぐらいしたいんだけど、それはきっと秋葉のヤツが許してはくれまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I lived with the Arima family, Keiko gave me a little pocket money for cleaning the flower-arranging room and tending the garden; no such income is possible now that I have returned to the estate.
I would gladly take a part-time job, but Akiha would never allow it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When I lived at the Arimas', Keiko-san would always give me some money for cleaning or tending the garden…… but now that I'm at the mansion, I don't think I can hope for that kind of income.
I'd like to do a part time job, but Akiha would never allow it.

entries.japanese:
「……………はあ」
　今更ながら自分の複雑な立場を思い知って、ため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah.”
The complications of my position sink in all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………… *sigh*
Reflecting on my complicated situation, I let out a sigh.

entries.japanese:
何をするわけでもなく、通りすぎていく人々を眺めていた。
　それも一時間ほどたって、はた、と自分が無意味な事をしている事に気がつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I do nothing but watch people pass.
An hour slips by before it strikes me how utterly pointless this is.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Not doing anything, I watch the people passing by.
I pass the time like that for an hour until I realize how pointless it is.

entries.japanese:
「……何してるんだろ、俺」
　自分でもよくわからない。
　ただこうして人の流れを眺めていれば、その中に金の髪をなびかせて歩く誰かの姿を見つけ出せるかもしれない、とでも思ったのだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What am I doing?”
I do not know myself.
Have I imagined that if I watch the crowd long enough, I might glimpse someone with golden hair streaming behind her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What the heck am I doing?"
I don't know for sure myself.
Was I thinking that I would see someone with golden hair walking by if I watched all these people?

entries.japanese:
「……バカらしい。
アルクェイドとはもう会わないんだろ、志貴」
　寄りかかっていた壁から離れて、未練を断つように屋敷への帰途についた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is stupid. You are never seeing Arcueid again, remember?”
I push away from the wall and turn toward the estate as though tearing myself free of the lingering hope.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… How stupid.
You'll never see Arcueid again, Shiki."
I stop leaning on the wall and head back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
坂をのぼりきって、屋敷に帰ってきた。
　時刻はまだ夕方の六時前。
　夕食まであと一時間、部屋で時間を潰すとしようか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I climb the hill and return to the estate.
It is not yet six.
With an hour until dinner, I might as well kill time in my room―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk up the road and back to the mansion.
It's not quite six o'clock yet.
There's still an hour until dinner, so I'll kill some time in my room---

entries.japanese:
―――夕食が終わって、夜。
　居間には珍しく秋葉、琥珀さん、翡翠というフルメンバーが残っていて、俺も食後の紅茶をいただくことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Night, after dinner.
For once, the full complement—Akiha, Kohaku, and Hisui—has remained in the sitting room, so I join them for tea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Dinner is over, and it is now nighttime.
A rare event, Akiha, Kohaku-san, and Hisui are all in the sitting room, so I join them for some after-meal tea.

entries.japanese:
「そうでしょうか。
わたし、一番目より二番目のほうが好きですね。
あっちのほうが味に品があるとは思いますけど」
「難しいわね。
味は格段に違うんだけど、濃度の違いをどうとるかは人それぞれだから。
けど、どのみち琥珀は日本茶のほうが好きなんでしょう？
　紅茶党は翡翠のほうだったと思うけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Really? I prefer the second one to the first. The other may have a more refined flavor, but still.”
“It’s difficult to say. The flavors are worlds apart, but whether you prefer one strength to the other is a matter of taste. In any case, Kohaku, don’t you favor green tea? I thought Hisui was the black-tea enthusiast.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that so?
I like the second one rather than the first one.
I think the taste is more refined."
"It's a difficult choice.
The difference in taste is great, but everyone handles the different concentrations in varied ways.
But, Kohaku, you like Japanese tea better, right?
I think Hisui prefers English tea."

entries.japanese:
「翡翠ちゃんはあんまりブランドにこだわりませんよ。
神経質そうに見えますけど、翡翠ちゃんはわりと―――」
「姉さん」
「―――見た目どおりに神経質なんですから。
ほら、お掃除とかお裁縫とか、できない事ってないんですよ、志貴さん」
　と、唐突に琥珀さんは俺に話をふってくる。
　翡翠の眼差しは、なんだか恐いし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui does not care much about brands. She may look fussy, but she is actually rather―――”
“Kohaku.”
“―――as fussy as she looks. Why, whether it is cleaning or sewing, there is nothing she cannot do, Master Shiki.”
Without warning, Kohaku brings me into the conversation.
And Hisui’s stare is frankly terrifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui-chan does not mind blands that much.
She may look sensitive, but Hisui-chan is---"
"Nee-san."
"---sensitive like she looks.
See, there isn't anything she can't do like cleaning or sewing, Shiki-san."
Kohaku-san suddenly engages me in conversation.
Hisui's glance seems… somewhat scary too.

entries.japanese:
「……そこでなんで俺にふるかな、琥珀さんは」
「だって志貴さんは翡翠ちゃんと一緒ですから。
翡翠ちゃんの神経質なところは知っているでしょう？」
「いや、それは―――」
　ちらり、と翡翠のほうを見る。
「……………………」
　……翡翠は無言で、なにか攻撃色を発しているし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why would you drag me into this, Kohaku?”
“Because Hisui looks after you, Master Shiki. Surely you know how particular she can be?”
“No, I would not say―――”
I glance at Hisui.
“…”
She silently radiates open hostility.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why are you suddenly telling me that, Kohaku-san?"
"Because Hisui-chan is your servant.
You surely know about her sensitiveness, right?"
"Um, well---"
I quickly look over at Hisui.
"……………………"
…… Hisui stands there quietly with something like an air of attack around her.

entries.japanese:
「―――いや、別に神経質っていうコトはないんじゃないかな。
俺がポカやってもすぐに片付けてくれるし、夜遅くに帰っても誰かさんみたいに怒らないし」
「兄さん。
門限を守れない人は怒られて当然なんだって、わかってる？」
「……承知してる。
けどさ、いくらなんでも八時っていうのは早すぎないか？
　子供じゃないんだから、このさい十時ぐらいに決めなおそう」
「却下です。
兄さんにはそんな時間まで外にいる理由なんてないでしょう。
塾にかよっている訳でも部活をしている訳でもないんですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No, I would not call her fussy. Whenever I make a mess, she cleans it up right away, and when I come home late, she does not get angry like a certain someone.”
“Brother. You do understand that anyone who breaks curfew deserves to be scolded?”
“I understand. But is eight o’clock not absurdly early for someone who is no longer a child? Let us revise it to ten.”
“Denied. You have no reason to remain out that late. You neither attend cram school nor belong to a club.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No, I don't think she's that sensitive.
She takes care of things quickly even when I mess something up, and she doesn't get angry like someone else when I come home late."
"Nii-san, don't you know it is perfectly natural for someone who breaks curfew to be scolded?"
"…… I know, but isn't eight o'clock a bit too early?
I'm not a little kid, so let's make it like ten o'clock from now on."
"I refuse.
You don't have any reason to stay out that late anyway.
It's not like you have a cram school or a club to attend."

entries.japanese:
「……………む」
　そう言われると、こっちとしては立場が弱い。
　俺のような自由人が家に帰ってこない、という理由はその大部分が遊びになってしまうからだ。
「志貴さん、秋葉さまの言うとおりですよ。
近頃は物騒なんですから、あんまり夜の街を出歩かないでくださいね」
「―――物騒って、例の通り魔のこと？」
　はい、と琥珀さんは頷く。
　……なんか、つい笑ってしまう。
　通り魔殺人をしでかしていたネロはもういない。
　けどそれを知っているのは俺とアルクェイドだけで、世間の人たちはもはや不在になった通り魔という影に怯えているなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh.”
Put that way, I do not have much ground to stand on.
For a free spirit like me, staying out late usually amounts to nothing more defensible than having fun.
“Miss Akiha is right, Master Shiki. Since the city has been dangerous lately, please do not wander around at night.”
“―――By dangerous, do you mean that serial killer?”
Kohaku nods.
I almost laugh.
Nrvnqsr, the creature behind those random killings, is gone.
But only Arcueid and I know that; everyone else is still afraid of the shadow of a killer who no longer exists.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Hmph."
I can't really rebut her when she brings that up.
Someone free like me coming home late means that I'm out playing around.
"Shiki-san, it is as Akiha-sama says.
It's dangerous out there recently, so please don't go out at night, okay?"
"---Dangerous, you mean those serial killings?"
"Yes," Kohaku-san nods.
…… It almost makes me laugh.
The one doing that, Nrvnqsr, is no more.
But the only ones who know that are me and Arcueid, and other people are still frightened about the shadows of the dead killer.

entries.japanese:
「今朝も繁華街のほうで被害者が発見されたそうですから。
これで十一人目ですよ、十一人目」
「……へえ、十一人目か。
そりゃあすごいな、野球ができ―――」
―――――ちょっと、待った。
「琥珀さん！」
「はい？」
「今の話、本当なのか！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“They found another victim downtown this morning. That makes eleven now—eleven.”
“The eleventh, huh. Impressive—enough for a baseball team―――”
―――――Wait.
“Kohaku!”
“Yes?”
“Is that true?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This morning they found another victim in the shopping district.
That's the eleventh victim you know, the eleventh victim."
"…… Wow, eleventh?
That's amazing, that's a baseball te----"
-----Wait a minute.
"Kohaku-san!"
"Yes?"
"What you just said, is that true!?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ、本当ですよ。
今朝のニュースでやってましたから。
なんでも昨夜殺されてしまったらしいんですけど、やっぱり全身の血を抜かれてしまっている猟奇殺人だとか」
「な――――――」
　それは、おかしい。
　だってネロはとっくに死んでる。
　二日前に死んだハズのあいつが、どうして次の日の夜に被害者を出せるっていうんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, it was on the morning news. Apparently the victim was killed last night. Another grotesque murder, with all the blood drained from the body.”
“Wha――――――”
That makes no sense.
Nrvnqsr is dead.
He died two days ago, so how could he claim another victim the following night?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, it's true.
It was in this morning's news.
It seems like it happened last night, but just like all the others, all the blood was drained completely."
"Wha------"
That's, weird.
Because Nrvnqsr is dead.
How can someone who died two days ago kill someone the day after?

entries.japanese:
「まさか―――」
　死んでいなかったのか。
……いや、それは絶対にない。
あいつは紛れもなく消え去った。
　なら、どうして―――
「―――――」
　まさか、とは思う。
　けど街を騒がしている吸血鬼が消えて、それでも事件がまた起こったっていうのなら。
　あと、この街に残っている吸血鬼は、あいつ以外にはいないじゃないか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do not tell me―――”
Was he still alive? No, that is impossible. I saw him vanish completely.
Then why―――
“―――――”
It seems impossible.
But if the vampire terrorizing the city is gone and the killings have continued.
Then no vampire but that one remains in this city―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No way---"
Did he not die?
…… No, that's definitely not it.
He definitely died.
So, how come---
"-----"
Then maybe.
If the vampire roaming the streets disappeared, but these incidents are still happening…
Then, the only vampire left in this city is her---

entries.japanese:
「おやすみなさいませ、志貴さま」
「……ああ。
おやすみ、翡翠」
　ぱたん、とドアが閉まって、部屋に一人きりになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good night, Master Shiki.”
“Yeah. Good night, Hisui.”
The door clicks shut, leaving me alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good night, Shiki-sama."
"…… Yeah, good night, Hisui."
The door shuts softly and I'm left in the room alone.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　犠牲者が出ている。
　吸血鬼による死体が、また一つ出てしまった。
「アルクェイド……のハズはない、よな」
　あいつは人の血は吸わないって言ってたし、なにより―――あんなに人間くさいヤツが、そんなコトをするなんて思えない。
　あいつとはたった二日しか一緒にいなかったけど、悪いヤツじゃないって信じてる。
　あんなにキレイで、あんないい顔で笑うヤツが人の血を吸って、死体を道に捨てていくなんて酷いことをするハズがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
There is another victim.
Another body left by a vampire.
“It could not have been Arcueid, could it?”
She said she never drinks human blood, and above all―――I cannot imagine anyone so human doing such a thing.
I only spent two days with her, but I believe she is not a bad person.
Someone so beautiful, someone who smiles with such open delight, could never drink a person’s blood and discard the body in the street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Another victim appeared.
Another victim, killed by a vampire.
"It can't be…… Arcueid, right?"
She said she doesn't suck blood, and more than that---I don't think anyone who acts that human could do that.
I only spent two days with her, but I can't believe she would do anything bad.
With her prettiness, her great smiling face, she can't suck someone's blood and discard them on the street.

entries.japanese:
「――――――けど」
　けど、新しい死体があがってしまった。
「……もう一度あいつに会って、話を聞くしかないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――But”
But there is another body.
“I suppose I have no choice but to find her and ask.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------But…"
But, there's been another dead body found.
"…… I should just meet her once more and ask her about it."

entries.japanese:
言葉にしてみると、あとの行動は早かった。
　ネロとの一戦以来しまっておいたナイフを取り出して、足音を立てないように屋敷から外に抜け出す。
　夜の街に出て、アルクェイドの姿を探しはじめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once I say it aloud, the rest comes quickly.
I retrieve the knife I put away after the fight with Nrvnqsr and slip out of the estate without a sound.
Then I take to the night streets and begin searching for Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that aloud, I quickly act on it.
I take the knife I used to fight Nrvnqsr and sneak quietly out of the mansion.
Going out into the street, I start to search for Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「―――はあ、はあ、はあ」
　足を止めて、呼吸を整える。
　今まで走りづめだった体が、ぜいぜいと貪欲に酸素を取り入れようとする。
「はあ―――はあ―――はあ」
　……だめだ、見つからない。
　街中を走りまわって、アルクェイドの部屋にも行ってみたけれど、あいつの姿はてんで見つからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hah, hah, hah”
I stop and try to catch my breath.
After running without pause, my lungs claw greedily for air.
“Hah―――hah―――hah”
I cannot find her.
I have run all over the city and even checked her room, but there is no sign of Arcueid anywhere.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My lungs feel like they're going to burst.
I stop running and catch my breath.
My body which was running non-stop until now wheezes to try to suck in more oxygen.
My panting fills the air.
…… This is no good, I can't find her.

I ran down the street and to her place, but I still couldn't find her.

entries.japanese:
「……あいつ……どうでもいい時はひょこひょこ歩いてるクセに、どうして肝心な時はどこにもいないんだ……！」
　つい、身勝手にぐちを言ってしまう。
　あれから四時間。
時刻はじき午前零時になろうっていうのに、アルクェイドは見つからない。
　……なんとなく。
　なんとなく、捜せばすぐに見つかるだろう、なんて楽観をしていた。
　俺はあいつに会いたかったし、あいつだって別れ際に『またね』なんて言ってたし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why is she always strolling around when it does not matter, only to disappear whenever I actually need her…?”
The selfish complaint slips out.
Four hours have passed. It is nearly midnight, and I still have not found Arcueid.
For some reason.
I had simply assumed I would find her as soon as I looked.
I wanted to see her, and when we parted she had said, “See you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That Arcueid…… She's always around when you don't need her, but when you try to find her……!"
I speak those words selfishly.
It's been four hours.
It's almost midnight, but I still don't see Arcueid anywhere.
…… For some reason.
For some reason, I thought optimistically that I'd find her easily once I started looking for her.
I want to see her, and when we last parted, she said "See you later."

entries.japanese:
「くそ……何処いったんだよ、アルクェイド……！」
　なにか、すごく苛々する。
　せっかくまた会えるって思ったのに会えないなんて、これじゃ生殺しみたいなものじゃないか。
「……せっかく……また、会えるって………」
―――？
　なんだろう、それは。
　それじゃまるで、その……俺が、アルクェイドに片思いでもしてるみたいじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it, where are you, Arcueid…?”
I am furious, absurdly so.
I thought I would finally see her again, and being denied at the last moment is unbearable.
“I thought I would finally see you again…”
―――?
What was that supposed to mean?
That makes it sound as though I am in love with Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shit…… Where did you go, Arcueid……!"
For some reason, I'm getting very annoyed.
I keep thinking I'll see her soon but I don't.
This is killing me.

"…… I…… thought…… we'd see each other again………"
---?
What is that?
It's like…… I'm in love with her.

entries.japanese:
「―――そんな」
「―――ばかな」
　無理やりに苦笑して、つまらない考えを振り払う。
「……最後に公園を見て、それで見つからなかったら帰るか」
　ふう、と大きく息をはいて公園へ歩き出す。
　二日前の夜。
　アルクェイドと別れた、いわくつきの公園へ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――That cannot be”
“―――That is idiotic”
I force a crooked smile and shake off the ridiculous thought.
“I will check the park one last time and go home if she is not there.”
With a long breath, I start walking.
Two nights ago.
Toward the park where Arcueid and I parted, a place already heavy with bad memories.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But that---"
"---That's stupid."
Forcing a grim smile, I shake that thought from my mind.
"…… I'll check out the park, and if I don't see her there, I'll go back."
Taking a deep breath, I walk to the park.
Two nights ago.
That park where so much happened, the park where I parted with Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「―――ん？」
　何か、公園の様子がいつもと違う。
「………街灯がついてない」
　公園中の街灯が消えてしまっている。
　月明かりでうっすらと見える公園は、いつにもまして活気というものがなかった。
「なんだろ……停電かな」
　きょろきょろとあたりを見渡す。
　……公園の外の街灯はきちんとついている。
　街灯がついていないのは、公園の中だけらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hm?”
Something about the park is different.
“The lights are out.”
Every lamp inside the park is dark.
Beneath the thin moonlight, the grounds look even more lifeless than usual.
“Could it be a blackout?”
I scan the area.
The streetlamps outside are working normally.
Only the lights within the park have failed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hm?"
There's something different about the park.
"……… The lamp posts are off."
The lamp posts throughout the park are all turned off.
The moonlit park seems more solitary than usual.
"Hmm…… is it a power outage?"
I look around me.
…… Outside the park, the lights are all working.
The only lamps not working are within the park itself.

entries.japanese:
――――キィィィン―――――
「え――――なんだ、いまの」
　なにか、耳をすますと音が聞こえてくる。
　ケンカとか争いごととか、そんなような事をしているような雑多な音の群れ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Keeeeen―――――
“Wha――――what was that?”
When I listen closely, I can hear something.
A confused tangle of noises, like a brawl or some other violent struggle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Clang-----
"Eh----What was that just now?"
I can hear something.
The clamor sounds like it's coming from a fight.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　気にかかる。
　根拠なんてまったくないけれど、こんな夜更けに、なにやらトラブルくさいことを起こしているのはアイツぐらいだと思うのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
I cannot ignore it.
I have no evidence at all, but at this hour there is only one person I can imagine stirring up that kind of trouble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I'm curious.
There's no basis for this, but this late at night, if there's any sort of trouble going on, I think it has to involve her.

entries.japanese:
「………よし」
　できるだけ物音をたてないように、そろそろと物音がする方へ向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right.”
Moving as quietly as I can, I creep toward the noise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Alright."
Trying as hard as I can to be silent, I head towards the source of the sound.

entries.japanese:
「――――！」
　向こうで二つの人影が争っている。
　一人は真っ黒い服装をしていてよくわからない。
　けどもう一人ははっきりとわかる。
　白い服装に、月明かりだけでもはっきりと見てとれる金の髪。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――!”
Two figures are fighting in the distance.
One is dressed entirely in black, too indistinct to make out. The other is unmistakable.
White clothes and golden hair bright even beneath the moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!"
I can see two figures facing off.
Someone is wearing dark black garments and I can't tell who it is.
But I can easily tell the other one.
White garments, and golden hair that can be easily spotted even in just the moonlight.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド……！」
　アルクェイドは、何か黒い人影に襲われていた。
　黒い人影は剣のようなものを持っていて、とてもケンカとかいったレベルの争いじゃない。
　人影は剣を構えてアルクェイドへと跳びかかる。
　アルクェイドは自分の胸に突き刺さろうとする剣を手で弾くと、そのまま剣を持った人影の胸にトン、と軽く触れた。
　次の瞬間。
　剣を持った人影は、サッカーボールか何かのように大きく弾き飛ばされていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid…!”
A black figure is attacking her.
The figure in black carries something like a sword, so this is far beyond a mere fight.
The figure raises the blade and springs at Arcueid.
She bats aside the thrust aimed at her chest, then gives her attacker’s breast the lightest tap.
The next instant.
The blade-wielding figure goes flying like a soccer ball.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid……!"
Arcueid is being attacked by this black human shape.

That black human shadow is carrying something like a sword, and it isn't something like a simple fight.
Sword in hand, it jumps towards Arcueid.
Arcueid deflects the blade coming in towards her chest with her hand and lightly contacts the chest of that black shape.
In the next instant,
that sword-wielding shape flies through the air like a soccer ball.

entries.japanese:
ダン、ダ、ごろごろごろごろ。
　公園のレンガ道の上に落下して、そのまま受身をとるように転がっていく。
　いや、正しくは。
　そのまま、俺の目の前に転がってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bam, ba-bump-bump-bump.
The figure crashes onto the park’s brick path.
It rolls with the impact.
No—to be precise, it comes rolling straight to my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Th-thump, roll, roll, roll.
Falling down on the brick pathway in the park, it keeps rolling as if easing the fall.
No, to be more accurate,
it rolls right toward me.

entries.japanese:
「……？」
　暗くてよく解らないけど、人影はちょうど俺の目の前で転がるのをやめて、素早く態勢をたてなおす。
「くっ――――！」
　という、切迫した声。
「は……あ」
　その動きに見惚れて、思わず感嘆の息をつく俺。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…?”
It is too dark to see clearly, but the figure’s tumble ends directly before me and the attacker instantly regains balance.
“Ghh――――!”
The voice is sharp with urgency.
“Ha…”
I can only stare, breath escaping me in wonder at the grace of that recovery.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?"
It's dark and I can't tell, but in front of me the shape stops rolling and regains its feet.
"Ku-----!"
A sharp, cut-off voice.
"Haa…… ah."
Fascinated by this display, I let out a breath of admiration.

entries.japanese:
ぴたり、と。
　剣を持った人影の動きが止まった。
「見られた――――！？」
　人影は目の前に立っている俺に、いまさら気がついたみたいだ。
　そのまま―――チャッ、と剣を構えなおして、俺の目の前に踏み込んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then, perfect stillness.
The blade-wielding figure freezes.
“You saw me――――!?”
Only now does the figure seem to notice me standing there.
Without another word―――the blade snaps back into guard, and its wielder lunges into my space.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Suddenly,
the sword-carrying figure ceases all movement.
"I'm seen----!?"
The figure finally seems to realize I'm here.
And then---it leaps towards me with sword in hand.

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
　刀の切っ先が、こちらの喉に伸びてくる。
　その速さ。
踏み込んでくるスピード、的確な急所への一撃は、ネロのケモノどころの話じゃない。
　人影の動きは、ネロのケモノたちを蹴散らしていた時のアルクェイドに動きに匹敵していた。
　チッ、と剣の切っ先が、喉に突き刺さる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
The point streaks toward my throat.
The speed of that step is overwhelming. The precise strike at a vital point leaves Nrvnqsr’s beasts looking trivial.
The figure moves as fast as Arcueid did when she tore those creatures apart.
With a tiny snick, the sword’s point pricks my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
The cutting blade of the sword rapidly arcs towards my throat.
This speed.
This flying speed, this accuracy, surpasses that of Nrvnqsr's beasts.
The shadow's movement is as fast as Arcueid's when she was tearing apart Nrvnqsr's beasts.
The sword pokes lightly at my neck.

entries.japanese:
――――どくん。
　心臓が一際高く振動する。
　危ないとか避けようとか考える暇さえなく、死んだかと、思った。
　けれど俺の喉は貫かれる事もなく、剣は、ピタリと見事に静止してくれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Thump.
My heart gives one tremendous beat.
Before I can even think of danger or dodging, one thought flashes through my mind: I am dead.
My throat is not pierced, however, because the sword stops dead with flawless precision.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thump.
My heart accelerates to a feverish pitch.
I don't even have time to think of the danger or to evade; my thoughts are filled only with death.
The sword doesn't pierce my throat, but stops suddenly.

entries.japanese:
「志貴……くん―――？」
「――――――先、輩」
　声が、はもった。
　お互い、信じられない、といったふうな声が混ざって―――呆然と、俺とシエル先輩は見つめ合う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki―――?”
“――――――Ci, el”
Our voices overlap.
The same disbelief colors both voices as they mingle―――and Ciel and I stare at one another in shock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno…… kun---?"
"------Sen, pai."
Our voices overlap.
Both of our voices are drowned in disbelief---Ciel-senpai and I stare at each other in amazed shock.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、そいつから離れて！」
　遠くからアルクェイドの声。
「―――――――」
　アルクェイドが駆け寄ってくる。
　先輩は別人のような目で俺を睨んで―――
　―――そのまま、背中を見せて走り去っていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, get away from her!”
Arcueid’s voice rings out from across the park.
“―――――――”
Arcueid races toward us.
Ciel glares at me with a stranger’s eyes―――
―――She turns her back and runs away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, get away from her!"
Arcueid's voice calls from far away.
"-------"
Arcueid dashes towards us.
Senpai glares at me with eyes that seem to belong to another person---
---Like that, she turns around and runs off.

entries.japanese:
「な……なん、で？」
　先輩の姿はもうない。
　黒い人影。
黒い服を着た先輩。
……二日前の夜、蒼い鴉に殺されかかった俺を助けてくれた誰か。
　でも―――ちゃんと、別人だって先輩は言ってのに、どうして―――
「志貴―――！」
　……気がつけば、目の前にはアルクェイドが駆け寄ってきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…?”
Ciel is already gone.
The black silhouette. Ciel dressed in black. The stranger who saved me two nights ago when the blue crow nearly killed me.
But―――Ciel told me herself they were different people; then why―――
“Shiki―――!”
By the time I come to myself, Arcueid is rushing up to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wh…… why?"
Senpai is completely gone.
That black figure, Senpai wearing those dark clothes.
…… That person who saved me two days ago when I was nearly killed by Nrvnqsr's crows.
But---Senpai, she said that wasn't her, so why---
"Shiki---!"
…… I suddenly realize Arcueid is in front of me.

entries.japanese:
「あ――アル、クェイド――」
「大丈夫！？
　あいつに何もされなかった？」
　さっきの先輩と同じく、アルクェイドもキッと厳しい目で睨んでくる。
　けど、そんなコトは、どうでもよかった。
「何もされなかったって……」
　呟いて、さっきまで剣をつき立てられていた喉に手をふれてみた。
　チクリ、と軽い痛みがはしる。
　喉に触れた指は、かすかに赤く染まっていた。
　先輩の剣はほんの数ミリ、俺の喉に傷をつけたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――Arc, ueid――”
“Are you all right? Did she do anything to you?”
Arcueid fixes me with the same fierce stare Ciel wore moments ago.
But none of that matters.
“Do anything to me…?”
Murmuring the words, I touch the throat where the sword had rested.
A tiny sting answers me.
My fingertips come away faintly red.
Ciel’s blade cut several millimeters into my skin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A--Ar, cueid--"
"Are you alright!?
Did she do anything to you?"
Just like Senpai before, she looks at me intensely.
But that doesn't matter.
"Did she do anything to me……?"
I touch my neck that had a sword on it until now.
There's a light, sharp pain.
The finger that touched my neck is faintly painted red.
Senpai's sword has cut my throat only a few millimeters deep.

entries.japanese:
「……わけが、わからない。
なんで俺が、先輩に襲われなくっちゃいけないんだ」
　本当にどうして―――先輩に、あんな目で睨まれなくっちゃいけないのか。
「それは当然でしょ。
わたしたちが殺しあってる所を見たんだもの。
あいつらは機密厳守だから、志貴みたいな一般人に自分たちの事を見られる事を嫌うのよ」
　アルクェイドはとんでもない事をきっぱりと言ってくる。
「―――殺し……あってたって、どうして。
　なんで―――どうして先輩とおまえが、そんなコト、してるんだよ」
　呆然として、そんなコトしか口にできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand. Why would Ciel attack me?”
Why―――did she have to look at me that way?
“Is it not obvious? You saw us trying to kill each other. Her people are fanatical about secrecy and hate being seen by ordinary civilians like you.”
Arcueid delivers this appalling statement as if it were self-evident.
“―――You were trying to kill each other—why?
Why―――why were you and Ciel doing that?”
I am too stunned to say anything else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What is, going on?
Why would, Senpai attack me?"
Why---really, why would she glare at me like that?
"Isn't it obvious?
You saw us trying to kill each other.
She is someone who operates in complete secrecy, so she hates for an ordinary person like you to see what was happening."
Arcueid says that unbelievable statement.
"---Kill each other…… why?
How come---why would you and Senpai do something like that?"
Lost in pure shock, I can only manage those words.

entries.japanese:
だいたい俺はそんな事を聞きに来たんじゃない。
　俺はこいつに―――アルクェイドに聞きたいことがあって、ただ、こうして夜の街を捜しまわっていただけなのに。
entries.maoEnglish: I did not come here to ask about any of this. I only searched the night streets because there was something I wanted to ask her―――to ask Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the first place, I didn't come here to ask that.
I wanted to ask her---Arcueid about something, which is why I was out here in the first place.

entries.japanese:
「……わからない。
俺はおまえに会いに来ただけなのに、どうして―――どうしておまえが、先輩と殺しあってたりしなくちゃいけないんだ」
「え？
　志貴、わたしに会いに来たの？」
「―――そうだよ。
どうしても話したいことがあったから、ずっと捜してたのに―――なんで、どうしてこんなコトになってるんだ。
　……わからない。
頭にくるぐらい、わからない。
　頼むから―――事情を説明してくれないか、アルクェイド」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand. I only came here to see you, so why―――why did I have to find you and Ciel trying to kill each other?”
“What? Shiki, you came to see me?”
“―――Yes. There was something I had to talk to you about, and I have been searching all night―――so why did everything turn into this?
I do not understand. It is driving me insane. Please―――tell me what is going on, Arcueid.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't know.
I only came to see you, so why---why are you and Senpai trying to kill each other?"
"Eh?
Shiki, you came to see me?"
"---Yes.
I had something I wanted to talk about, so I was just looking for you---so why did it end up this way?
…… I don't know.
My head is just spinning.
Please---could you tell me what's going on, Arcueid?"

entries.japanese:
「事情って言われても、単に教会の人間とわたしが戦ってただけなんだけど。
志貴には関係のないコトだから、さっきのは忘れていいよ」
「――――関係はあるんだ。
そもそもその教会の人間っていうのはどういう意味なんだ。
俺にわかるように説明してくれ」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　彼女はしばらく一人で考え込んでから、『ま、いっか』とこれまた一人で頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is not much to tell: I was fighting someone from the Church. It has nothing to do with you, so forget what you saw.”
“――――It does have something to do with me. What do you mean by someone from the Church? Explain it in words I can understand.”
Arcueid does not answer.
After thinking it over for a while, she nods to herself as if to say, “Well, whatever.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I was just simply fighting with that person from The Church.
It isn't something that concerns you, so just forget about it Shiki."
"----It does concern me.
But first, what do you mean by 'The Church'?
Explain it so I can understand."
Arcueid doesn't answer.
She mulls it over until she nods.
"Sure, why not?"

entries.japanese:
「志貴がそこまで言うんなら教えてあげる。
けど、本当に志貴には関係のない話よ。
そんなつまらない話、わたしがしていいの？」
「ああ。
どんな話だろうと、おまえに文句は言わないよ」
「ふーん、熱心なのね。
わたしは、志貴がわたしに会いに来てくれた理由のほうが気になるんだけどな」
「……いいから、早くしてくれ。
聞きたいんだ、さっきの人のことを」
　むっ、アルクェイドは不機嫌そうに顔をしかめる。
　どうしてアルクェイドがそんな顔をするのか疑問に思う余裕が、今の自分にはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you insist, I’ll tell you. But it truly has nothing to do with you. Are you sure you want to hear me ramble about something so dull?”
“Yes. Whatever it is, I won’t complain.”
“Hmm, you are very determined. I am more curious about why you came looking for me.”
“Never mind that. I want to know about the person who was just here, so please hurry.”
Arcueid scowls, plainly displeased.
I have no room in my mind to wonder why.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Since you're that worried, I'll tell you.
It really doesn't concern you though, do you really want to hear it?"
"Yeah.
No matter what it is, I won't mind."
"Oh?
How enthusiastic.
I'm actually a little curious about why you came to see me though."
"…… Come on, please hurry.
I want to hear about that person."
"Hmph," Arcueid looks a little angry.
I don't even think about why she would look like that all of a sudden.

entries.japanese:
……ずきり、と喉が痛む。
　先輩―――シエル先輩が、俺に剣を、向けた。
　その事実が頭に張りついて、それ以外のことなんてとてもじゃないけど考えられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My throat throbs.
Ciel―――Ciel pointed a sword at me.
That fact has lodged itself in my mind, leaving no space for anything else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My throat still hurts.
Senpai---Ciel-senpai pointed a sword at me.
All I can think about is why Ciel-senpai would do that.

entries.japanese:
「……いいわ、それじゃ話してあげる。
　死徒と呼ばれる吸血鬼はね、極力自己の存在を隠蔽しようとする。
　彼らは生きる為に人間の血を吸わないといけない。
だから彼らが存在しているかぎり、犠牲者は必ず出てくる。
けど、吸血鬼に殺されたなんていう人の話なんて滅多に出てこないでしょう？
　これ、どうしてだか解る？」
「……アルクェイド。
俺が聞きたいのは吸血鬼の話じゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, I will explain.
Vampires called Dead Apostles go to great lengths to conceal their existence.
They must drink human blood to survive. Wherever they exist, there will inevitably be victims. Yet you almost never hear of anyone being killed by a vampire, do you?
Why do you think that is?”
“…Arcueid, I did not ask about vampires.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Fine, then I'll tell you.
The Dead Apostles are vampires that try the utmost to conceal their existence.
In order to live, they must suck the blood of humans, so victims will always appear as long as they exist.
But there's not too many stories of people being killed by vampires, right?
Do you know why that is?"
"…… Arcueid.
I didn't ask about vampires."

entries.japanese:
「もう、志貴のために順序だてて説明してあげてるんだから、ちゃんと答えてよね。
　いい？
　吸血鬼たちは犠牲者を出しても、周囲――つまり志貴たちがいる一般社会ね。
それらにその犠牲者が発見されないように、人間たちの社会に異状だと気がつかれないように様々な魔術を行使して事実を隠蔽する。
　これ、どうしてだか解る？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am laying this out step by step for your sake, so answer me properly.
Listen. Even when vampires claim victims, they use all kinds of magecraft to hide the evidence. They keep the surrounding world――the ordinary society where people like you live――from finding the bodies or realizing anything is wrong.
Do you understand why?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sheesh, I'm trying to explain it to you in order Shiki, so please answer, okay?
Look, even when the vampires kill people, they try to hide it from the surrounding--society that people like you live in.
They seek to hide themselves and try as much as possible using magic and other things to camouflage their victims and make it appear natural.
Do you know why?"

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、そりゃあ人間だってバカじゃないからな。
自分たちの住んでいるところにそんな化け物がいるってわかれば反撃する。
　いくら人間が弱いっていったって警察とかがあるんだ。
吸血鬼なんてものがいれば、これ以上犠牲者を出さないように身を守るよ。
……そうなると今のこの街みたいにさ、夜出歩く人間がいなくなるじゃないか。
それが厄介だから自分のことをバレないようにするんだろ、吸血鬼は」
「―――まあ、たしかにそれもあるけど、警察はあくまで人間に対する法律組織でしょう。
わたしたちはそんなのは考慮にいれない。
　けどまあ、自己保身のために自らの痕跡を隠蔽する、というのは正しいわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because humans are not stupid. If they knew monsters like that lived among them, they would fight back.
Humans may be weak, but we have the police and plenty of other ways to defend ourselves. If vampires were exposed, people would take precautions to prevent more deaths. They would stop going out at night, like they have in this city. That would make hunting difficult, so vampires hide what they are.”
“―――That is part of it, but the police are an institution of human law meant to deal with humans. Creatures like us do not take them into account.
Still, you are right that vampires erase their traces to protect themselves.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, it's because humans aren't stupid.
If they find out monsters like that exist where they live, they'd attack them.
Even though humans are weak, they do have things like police.
If there are such thing as vampires, an effort would be made to protect people from them.
…… Then people would stop walking around at night like what's going on right now.
I think they try to hide themselves because that's inconvenient for them."
"---Well, I guess that's true, but police are only a law-enforcing group against humans.
We don't consider them at all.
But, it's correct to say that vampires hide their presence for the sake of self-preservation."

entries.japanese:
「志貴、吸血鬼には天敵がいるのよ。
それも今ではパワーバランスはそっちのほうが上っていう、殺し屋みたいな集団がね。
　……他の超越種たちもそうだけど、とくに吸血種は自らの存在を明かしては命とりになる。
　たとえ小さな、文明社会から隔離された山村一つを支配して秘密の王国を作っても、犠牲者が増えればかならず彼らが嗅ぎ付けるから。
　吸血鬼たちが秘密裏に人間を搾取するのは何のためでもない、ただ自己保身のためだけよ。
彼らは社会的な風聞ではなく、その天敵に嗅ぎ付けられる事を嫌って自然に死体を隠蔽するの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Vampires have natural enemies, Shiki. A whole band of killers, and these days the balance of power favors them.
Other transcendent species face the same danger, but for a vampiric species in particular, revealing its existence can be fatal.
A vampire might rule one tiny mountain village cut off from civilization and build a secret kingdom there, but once enough victims accumulate, those enemies will inevitably catch the scent.
Vampires prey on humanity in secret for one reason alone: self-preservation. They hide bodies not to avoid rumors, but to keep their natural enemies from finding them.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, there is a natural enemy of the vampires.
A group of something like professional killers that now have the power balance in their favor.
…… It's true for other transcendent species, but especially for vampires, it is fatal for them to reveal themselves.
Even if a vampire made a secret kingdom in a village somewhere in the mountains away from all civilization, this natural enemy would definitely notice if victims keep increasing.

Vampires exploit the humans in secret, for no reason other than self-preservation.
The vampires hide their dead victim's bodies, not out of fear of human society finding out, but in fear of these natural enemies discovering them."

entries.japanese:
「……吸血鬼の……天敵？」
　つまり吸血鬼と敵対するもの。
　……さっき、アルクェイドに対して剣をふるっていた先輩のように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A vampire’s natural enemy?”
Something that hunts vampires.
Someone like Ciel, who had been swinging a sword at Arcueid moments ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Their…… natural enemy?"
She means someone that fights against vampires.
…… Like Senpai, who was wielding a sword against Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「……それも人間じゃない生き物なのか？」
「何いってるのよ。
その天敵っていうのは紛れもなくあなたたち人間の事よ」
「────？
　天敵って、俺たちが？」
「そう。
もうずっと昔、人間は様々な魔術、神秘学、式典儀礼をもとに組織体系を作り、人間以外の霊長類を排除しはじめたの。
　その最たる物が基督教───法王庁が誇るエクシシストの集団よ。
旧教（カトリック）は昔っから『人間でないモノ』を徹底的に淘汰してきたけど、その中でも吸血鬼に対する敵視はどうかしてるわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are they another kind of nonhuman creature?”
“What are you talking about? Their natural enemy is unquestionably humanity.”
“────? Humans are?”
“Yes. Long ago, humans built organizations upon various forms of magecraft, mysticism, and religious ritual, then began exterminating nonhuman primates.
The foremost example is Christianity───the corps of exorcists maintained by the Holy See. Catholicism has always purged anything ‘not human’ with ruthless thoroughness, but its hatred of vampires is deranged even by those standards.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So, they aren't human either?"
"What are you saying?
Their natural enemy is without a doubt you humans."
"-----?
Natural enemies, us?"
"Yeah.
Starting from a long time ago, humans used many kinds of magic, the occult, magical ceremonies to create an organization and started to eliminate primates other than humans.
The greatest of these is Christianity---the pride of the Vatican, the Exorcists.
The Catholic Church always viewed "nonhumans" as impurities, but vampires are considered the most dangerous."

entries.japanese:
「世界中のどんな宗教をみたって、カトリック以上に吸血鬼を敵視している宗教はない。
　あれはね、すでに憑かれてる。
病的すぎてわたしでさえ彼らには関わりたくないぐらいだもの」
　はあ、とアルクェイドはため息をつく。
「ここまでいえば解るでしょう？
　さっき志貴を殺そうとしたのは、その中でも異端狩りを専門としている連中の一員よ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No religion on earth despises vampires more than Catholicism.
They’re obsessed—possessed, even. It’s so pathological that not even I want anything to do with them.”
Arcueid sighs.
“You understand now, don’t you?
The woman who tried to kill you belongs to the branch that specializes in heretic hunting.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There are many religious groups in the world, but the Catholic Church looks at vampires with more hostility than the rest.
You know, it's almost an obsession.
They are so insane, I don't even want to mess with them."
Arcueid lets out a sigh.
"You should know what I'm getting at by now.
The one who tried to kill you was a member of an elite organization that hunts heretics.

entries.japanese:
「埋葬機関っていう、キリスト教の矛盾点を法ではなく力で処理していく連中でね。
決して表には出てこない、殺し屋みたいなエクソシスト。
　矛盾を潰していくっていう、その存在自体が闇である彼らは決して人前には出てこない。
彼らはキリスト教っていう組織の中には本来存在してはいけない機関。
だから―――自分たちを知ってしまった人間は、例外なく抹殺してしまう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“They are called the Burial Agency: people who dispose of the contradictions within Christianity through force rather than law. They are exorcists like assassins, never seen in public.
Their very purpose is to erase contradictions, so their existence belongs to the darkness. Strictly speaking, no such agency should exist within a Christian institution at all. That is why―――anyone who discovers them is eliminated without exception.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
This group, the Burial Agency, is part of The Church.
They use their own strength rather than law to deal with contradictions to Christianity.
These hidden exorcists are more like professional killers.
Being the ones which crush contradictions, their existence is a shadow, and so they do not come out in front of people.
They are a section that should not exist within the organization called Christianity, so they kill all those that discover their existence indiscriminately."

entries.japanese:
「あの女―――今はシエルっていう名前らしいけど、きっとこの街に巣くった吸血鬼を処理しにきたんでしょうね。
あいつは、わたし以上に『敵』に関する嗅覚が鋭いから」
　苛だたしそうにアルクェイドは顔をしかめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That woman―――who apparently calls herself Ciel now must have come to dispose of the vampire nesting in this city. Her nose for an enemy is even sharper than mine.”
Arcueid grimaces in irritation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That woman---it seems she is now called Ciel, probably came here to hunt down the vampire in this city.
Her sense for the 'enemy' is far better than mine."
She says this in an irritated manner.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　言葉がない。
　先輩が―――吸血鬼を殺しにきたエクソシストとかいうヤツだなんて―――そんな話、いくらなんでも信じられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I have no words.
Ciel―――an exorcist who came here to kill vampires―――that is too absurd to believe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
I don't have any words to say.
Senpai---is some sort of an exorcist who's hunting vampires---I just can't believe that at all.

entries.japanese:
だって先輩は、すごくお人よしで
　とても殺し合いなんて―――俺みたいにこんな異常な出来事に対応できるようなひとじゃ、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel is such a softhearted person—
not someone who could kill―――not someone equipped to handle horrors like these the way I somehow am.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Because Senpai has such a gentle, good nature,
she can't kill---she's not someone that can handle such things, unlike me.

entries.japanese:
「―――嘘だ。
そんなのは嘘だ、アルクェイド。
だって、先輩は俺の学校の先輩なんだぞ。
それがどうして、教会なんていうところの人間だっていうんだよ……！」
「むっ。
志貴、あいつと知り合いなの？」
　許せない、とばかりにアルクェイドは詰め寄ってくる。
「あたりまえじゃないか。
知り合いもなにも、先輩は俺の学校の三年生で、俺は一年のころから――」
――――一年の、ころから？
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――That is a lie. It has to be, Arcueid. Ciel is a third-year at my school. How could she possibly belong to some organization called the Church…?”
“Wait. Shiki, you know her?”
Arcueid closes in on me as though this were unforgivable.
“Of course I know her. She is a third-year at my school, and I have known her since my first――”
――――Since my first year?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That's a lie.
That's a lie, Arcueid.
Because Senpai's an upperclassman at my school.
So why would you say she's some member of The Church……!?"
"Hey now.
Shiki, you know her?"
Arcueid draws near as if telling me she won't allow that.
"Of course!
She's a third year at my school, I've known her since I was a first year--"
----Since I was, a first year?

entries.japanese:
「―――あ――れ」
　……なんか、ヘンだ。
　言われてみれば、先輩はいつからいた先輩なんだろう。
　俺はあの人がどこのクラスなのかも知らない。
　思い出だって―――あの日、中庭で添え木を修理していた前のものは、存在しない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Wait――what”
Something is wrong.
Now that I think about it, when did Ciel become someone I knew?
I do not even know what class she belongs to.
And as for memories―――none exist before the day she was repairing that tree support in the courtyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hu--h?"
…… Something's wrong.
Come to think of it, how long have I known her?
I don't even know which class she is in.
I try and remember---but I don't have any memories of her before that day when I found her mending those splints.

entries.japanese:
―――ありがとうございました、遠野くん。
　先輩が笑顔でそういうものだから。
　俺はなんだか、あの人とはずっと知り合いだったような気がしてた。
「―――う――――そ」
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thank you, Tohno.
Ciel said it with a smile.
So I somehow felt we had known each other forever.
“―――No――――way”
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thank you very much, Tohno-kun.
Because she smiled as she said it.
For some reason, I felt like I had always known her.
"---This can't----be true."

entries.japanese:
そもそも、一番の違和感は。
　先輩は当たり前のようにシエルって呼ばれていたけど、それ以外の名前を誰も口にしない。
　ただシエルとだけ呼ばれていて。
　どうして誰も、そんな名前に疑問を持たなかったんだろう―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
The strangest thing of all.
Everyone called her Ciel as though it were perfectly natural, yet no one ever spoke another name for her.
Only Ciel.
Why had none of us ever questioned a name like that―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
First of all, the strangest thing is that…
Senpai was called "Ciel" like it was natural to be called so, but no one calls her with a different name.
She was only called Ciel,
how come no one doubted such a name---?

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド―――先輩は……あの人、いったい……」
「だから埋葬機関の一人だって言ってるでしょう。
八年前に入った新参者だけど、才能は随一だったんでしょうね。
今じゃ第七なんていう、完全数の席にいる代行者よ」
「――――」
　アルクェイドの言っている事はよく解らない。
　ただ、七という数字は、たしかに完全数だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid―――who is Ciel really…?”
“I told you, she’s a member of the Burial Agency. She may have joined only eight years ago, but her talent must have been unrivaled. Now she is an Executor holding the Seventh seat—a perfect number.”
“――――”
I do not understand what Arcueid is saying.
But seven is indeed a perfect number.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid---about Senpai…… about that person, who is she……"
"Didn't I tell you?
She's a member of the Burial Agency.
She is a newcomer who entered only eight years ago, but maybe she has great abilities.
She's an agent already having a seat in the perfect number, the Seventh."
"----"
I don't quite get what Arcueid is saying.
But, the number seven certainly is a perfect number.

entries.japanese:
数字の中でも孤立した数字。
　孤独で、行き場のない数字。
　孤立、孤立。
完結しているが故に、その数を冠する外典は転生を否定する。
　……よく、解らないけど。
　なぜか、そんな言葉が、頭の中で繰り返された。
entries.maoEnglish:
A number isolated from all the others.
Lonely, with nowhere to go.
Isolated, isolated. Because it is complete, the apocryphon that bears that number denies reincarnation.
I do not understand.
Yet for some reason, those words repeat themselves inside my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A number isolated from the others.
In its solitude, it has nowhere to go.
Isolation, isolation.
Since it is perfect, the Apocrypha named with that number refuses reincarnation.
…… I don't quite get it, but,
for some reason, those words repeat inside my head.

entries.japanese:
「……そうね、埋葬機関のメンバーは形の上だけでもアデプトのはずだから、奇跡に何の耐性もない一般人に暗示をかけるのは簡単か。
　あの女はね、志貴たちを騙して志貴の学校に紛れこんでいたんでしょう」
「……暗示……その、催眠術みたいなもの？」
「ええ。
暗示っていうのはそう複雑な命令は送れない。
きっと『シエルのことを疑問に思わない』っていうシンプルな刷り込みなんじゃないかな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even nominal members of the Burial Agency are adepts, so placing ordinary people with no resistance to miracles under suggestion would be easy.
She must have deceived everyone and slipped into your school.”
“Suggestion, you mean something like hypnosis?”
“Yes. Suggestion cannot implant complicated commands. It was probably no more than a simple instruction never to question Ciel.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right, the members of the Burial Agency are highly skilled, so I guess it's easy for them to use suggestion against someone who can't even resist.
That woman probably was deceiving you all in order to stay in your high school."
"…… Suggestion…… like hypnosis?"
"Yes, it can't be a very complex order.
She probably used something simple like 'Don't doubt Ciel'."

entries.japanese:
……ああ、そうだ。
　俺だって初めは違和感があったけど、会うたびにそんな疑問は消えていった。
　そこにいても、それが当然だと思うこと。
　それが先輩の特徴だったじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Of course.
I felt something was wrong at first, but the doubt faded every time I saw her.
No matter where she appeared, her presence seemed perfectly natural.
That had always been Ciel’s most peculiar quality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yeah, that's it.
I always felt something was wrong from the beginning, but as soon as I would see her again, those doubts would disappear.
Feeling it is natural for her to be there,
wasn't that one of Senpai's characteristics?

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
けど、腑に落ちない。
　先輩がその埋葬機関っていうところの人間だとして、どうしておまえと争ってるんだ。
教会のエクソシストっていうのは悪い吸血鬼しか退治しないんだろ。
なら―――おまえと先輩が殺しあう必要なんて、ぜんぜんないじゃないか」
―――悪い、吸血鬼しか、退治しない。
　それは例えば、人間の血を吸って、路上に死体を放り捨てる、といったふうな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I understand. But something still does not add up.
Even if Ciel belongs to this Burial Agency, why was she fighting you? The Church’s exorcists only hunt evil vampires, do they not? Then―――you and Ciel have no reason to be trying to kill each other.”
―――They only hunt evil vampires.
Vampires who drink human blood, for example, then throw the bodies into the street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand, but there's still something else.
You said Senpai is a member of that Burial Agency, so why is she fighting you?
They only fight bad vampires, right?
So---there isn't any need for you two to fight, right?"
---They only fight… bad… vampires.
Such as, those that suck the blood of humans and cast their bodies away.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド、おまえ―――」
「ん？
　なに、わたしがどうかした？」
　アルクェイドはまっすぐに俺を見つめてくる。
　……思えない。
　こいつが人の血を吸うなんて、思いたくない。
　けど、実際に殺人事件は起きてしまった。
　くわえて、教会のエクソシストだっていう先輩がアルクェイドを殺そうとしていたという事は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, you―――”
“Hm? What about me?”
Arcueid looks straight into my eyes.
I cannot believe it.
I do not want to believe she would drink human blood.
But a murder did happen.
And if Ciel truly is a Church exorcist, her attempt to kill Arcueid means…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid, you---"
"Hm?
What, did I do something?"
Arcueid looks directly at me.
…… I can't think it.
I don't want to think that this person, would ever suck human blood.
But the truth is, the incidents are still occurring.
Furthermore, Senpai, an exorcist from The Church, is trying to kill Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「―――アルクェイド。
　まさか、昨日の殺人事件はおまえの仕業なのか。
　だから先輩はおまえのことを殺そうって―――」
　ぎり、と歯をかんで。
　まるで片思いの女の子に告白するような重苦しさで、アルクェイドに問いただした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Arcueid.
Was last night’s murder your doing? Is that why Ciel was trying to kill you―――”
I grind my teeth.
The question feels as heavy as confessing to a girl I have loved in secret.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Arcueid.
Don't tell me the killing yesterday was your doing?
That's why you and Senpai were fighting---"
I grit my teeth.
I speak those heavy, painful words as if confessing love toward a girl I like.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、それ本気？」
「俺だってそんなこと信じたくない。
けど、そうじゃなければなんだっていうんだ。
ネロはもう死んだんだろ。
　なら……あとは、その、おまえしか……いないじゃ、ないか」
　……こんなコトを口にする事が、悔しかった。
　俺はアルクェイドを気に入ってる。
　こいつには命を助けられたし、あの二日間は楽しかった。
　だから―――これでアルクェイドと決別する事になるのが、イヤだった。
　でも、こいつが人食いの吸血鬼であるんなら、俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, are you serious?”
“I do not want to believe it either. But what else could it be? Nrvnqsr is already dead.
Then, well, that only leaves you.”
I hate myself for saying it.
I like Arcueid.
She saved my life, and those two days with her were fun.
That is why―――I do not want this to be where we part forever.
But if she is a vampire who feeds on human beings, then I――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, are you serious?"
"Even I don't want to believe it.
But then, who did it?
Nrvnqsr is dead already.
So…… that leaves, um, only…… you, right?"
…… I'm filled with regret as soon as I say those words.
I still like her.
She saved my life, and those two days were still a lot of fun.
So---I don't want to separate with her like this.
But, if she is the killer vampire, I----

entries.japanese:
――――――と。
　ぱかん、とぐーで頭をはたかれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――And then.
She bonks me on the head with her fist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------And then,
Smack.
My head is hit with a fist.

entries.japanese:
「志貴のばか」
「え……アルクェイド……？」
「本来ならこんなんじゃすまさないけど、いまの志貴の顔に免じて、それで許してあげるわ」
　笑顔で言って、アルクェイドはタン、と軽く後ろに下がった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot, Shiki.”
“Huh, Arcueid?”
“Ordinarily you would get much worse, but given the look on your face, I will forgive you with one knock.”
She smiles and springs lightly backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, you idiot."
"Eh…… Arcueid……?"
"I wouldn't normally let it be settled with just this, but since you look so pitiful, I'll let that be enough."
Smiling, Arcueid hops back.

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
あなた、いい人ね」
「なっ――――」
　いきなりそんな事を言われて、かっと頬が熱くなった。
「おまけにすっごく正直者。
わたし、貴方のそういうトコロ、気に入っちゃった」
　アルクェイドは嬉しそうに笑う。
　そこには、その―――やっぱりどう見ても、彼女が人を殺して血を吸うようなイメージはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. You are a good person.”
“Wha――――”
The words come from nowhere, and my face burns.
“And you are incredibly honest. I think I really like that about you.”
Arcueid beams at me.
Even looking at her like this―――I still cannot imagine her killing people and drinking their blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, you're a great person."
"Wha----"
Having her say that so suddenly makes my cheeks flush.
"And in addition, you're so honest.
I like those things about you."
Arcueid smiles happily.
Seeing her like that---I can't imagine her sucking on someone's blood.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、それじゃあ―――」
「ええ。
志貴の言っている通り魔はわたしじゃないわ。
アレはわたしじゃなくて、他の吸血種の仕業よ」
「――――――――」
　さあ、と胸のもやもやが消えていく。
　そうか―――やっぱり、アルクェイドはそんなコトはしてなかったんだ。
「そっか―――おまえ以外の吸血鬼の仕業なのか」
　それなら安心だっ……って、それ、なんかヘンだぞ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, then―――”
“Yes. The serial killer you mean is not me. That was the work of another vampire.”
“――――――――”
The haze in my chest clears in a rush.
I knew it―――Arcueid had not done anything like that.
“I see―――so it was another vampire.”
That is a relief, but no, wait, something about that is wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, so---"
"Yes.
I'm not the killer.
It's the work of some other vampire and not me."
"--------"
The knot in my chest disappears.
I see---I knew it, Arcueid didn't do those things.
"I see---it's the work of another vampire.
That's a relief…… Wait, that's weird.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれアルクェイド。
他の吸血種の仕業っていうけど、そう次から次へと吸血鬼が出てくるのって、おかしくない？」
「なに言ってるの？
　新しい吸血鬼なんて出てきてないわよ」
「―――なっ。
だってもうネロはいないんだぞ。
ネロ以外であんなコトをするヤツなんて、他にはもういないじゃないか」
「……そっか。
志貴、すごい勘違いをしてたんだね」
　はあ、と呆れたようにアルクェイドはため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Arcueid. You say it was another vampire, but is it not strange for them to keep appearing one after another?”
“What are you talking about? No new vampire has appeared.”
“―――What? But Nrvnqsr is gone. There is no one else left who would do something like that.”
“I see. Shiki, you have gotten the wrong idea entirely.”
Arcueid sighs in exasperation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hold on Arcueid.
You said it's another vampire, but isn't it odd for vampires to come out one after another?"
"What are you saying?
There aren't any new vampires."
"---Wha… But Nrvnqsr isn't alive anymore.
There isn't anyone else that does something like that."
"…… Oh, I see.
Shiki, you really made a big mistake."
Arcueid gives an amazed sigh.

entries.japanese:
「いい？
　志貴の言っている連続殺人事件っていうのはね、初めから一人の吸血種の仕業なのよ。
　新しい吸血種なんてのはやってこないし、ネロだってあの事件にはまったく関係がないわ」
――――え？
　ネロだって、関係ない……？
「な―――それ、どういう意味だよ」
「言ったとおりの意味だけど。
……もう、志貴ってキレるようでいてどこか抜けてるのね。
　思い出して志貴。
たしかにネロは吸血種だったけど、あいつは人の血を吸っていた？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Shiki. The serial murders you mean were the work of one vampire from the very beginning.
No new vampire has come to the city, and Nrvnqsr had nothing at all to do with those killings.”
――――What?
Even Nrvnqsr had nothing to do with them?
“―――What do you mean?”
“Exactly what I said. Honestly, Shiki, you seem sharp until you miss something enormous.
Think back. Nrvnqsr may have been a vampire, but did he drink anyone's blood?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You see?
The serial killings you're talking about were always the work of just one vampire from the very beginning.
So no new vampires will appear, as Nrvnqsr was unrelated to those incidents."
----Eh?
Nrvnqsr is unrelated……?
"Wha---what do you mean?"
"It's just like I said.
…… You're normally pretty sharp, but you're lost at some points.
Think back, Shiki.
Nrvnqsr was a vampire, but did he ever suck human blood?"

entries.japanese: 「吸っていたかって、あいつは人間をバリバリと頭から食ってただろ―――って、あ」
entries.maoEnglish: “As for drinking blood, he crunched people up whole, headfirst―――oh.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Suck blood?
He ate humans and---oh."

entries.japanese:
そう、か。
　なんでそんな単純な間違いに気がつかなかったっていうんだろう。
　通り魔殺人の被害者たちは、血を抜かれた遺体として発見されている。
　けれどネロは違う。
　あいつは一切死体を残さない。
血を吸うどころか肉さえ食らって、その痕跡を無くしてしまう。
　現に、ホテルでアイツに食われてしまった人たちは殺人事件としてではなく、行方不明者として扱われていた。
　なら―――それは、明らかに巷でおこっている事件とは違うものだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Of course.
How did I miss something so obvious?
The serial killer's victims were found as corpses drained of blood.
Nrvnqsr was different.
He left no bodies at all. He devoured flesh as well as blood, erasing every trace of his victims.
The people eaten at the hotel were treated as missing persons, not murder victims.
So―――his killings were plainly different from the crimes happening across the city.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I see.
Why didn't I notice such a simple mistake?
The victims of the serial killings are found with their bodies drained of blood.
But Nrvnqsr was different.
He didn't leave any dead bodies behind.
He not only drank the blood, but also ate the meat, leaving no trace.
To prove it, the people eaten by him in the hotel were treated as missing people, not killed people.
So---that means, it is something completely different.

entries.japanese:
「まってくれ。
それじゃあ今おきている殺人事件はなんなんだ。
いったいどこの誰があんな真似をしているっていうんだよ」
「だから、あの事件はネロとは別の吸血種の仕業なのよ。
正確にいうとソイツがいるからわたしがこの街にやってきて、ネロはわたしを追いかけてこの街にやってきた、っていう相関図かな」
「―――な。
そ、それじゃあおまえが追っている敵っていうのはネロじゃなかったのか……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. Then what are the murders happening now? Who in the world is doing such a thing?”
“That is what I have been telling you: those murders were the work of a different vampire. More precisely, it was here first; I came because of it, and Nrvnqsr followed me, which is how everything connects.”
“―――What? Then the enemy you were hunting was not Nrvnqsr…!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait.
Then what is the serial killing going on right now?
Just who is doing it?"
"That's a different vampire than Nrvnqsr.
To be more specific, that vampire is why I came here, and Nrvnqsr came here following me.
It's that sort of correlation."
"---Wha… So the one you're after wasn't Nrvnqsr after all……!?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
わたし、初めから自分の標的がネロだなんて言わなかったでしょ？
　ネロにとっての標的はわたしだったけど、わたしにとっての標的はネロじゃなくて、この街で『通り魔』って言われている吸血鬼だけよ」
「な―――――」
　愕然と息を飲む。
　けど―――たしかにアルクェイドの言うとおりだ。
　アルクェイドの目的が吸血鬼殺しだというから、俺は完全に早とちりして、こいつはネロを倒すためにいるんだってばかり思ってた――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I never said Nrvnqsr was my target. I was his target, but my target was never Nrvnqsr, only the vampire this city calls its ‘serial killer.’”
“Wha―――――”
I draw a stunned breath.
But―――Arcueid is right.
When she said her purpose was to kill a vampire, I jumped to the conclusion that she had come to defeat Nrvnqsr――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I didn't ever say he was my initial target.
I was his target, but he was never my target; my target is the one called the 'serial killer' in this city."
"Wha-----"
I gasp in shock.
But---it really is just as she says.
She said her purpose is to kill vampires, so I just thought it was Nrvnqsr she was after----

entries.japanese:
「……それじゃあ何か？
　あの夜ネロと殺しあったのは、実はまったく無意味なことだったっていうのか………！？」
「無意味じゃないわ。
志貴はわたしの代わりに戦ってくれたんじゃない。
ま、もっとも志貴さえわたしを殺さなかったら、あんな事にはならなかったでしょうけどね」
「――――――」
　くらり、と眩暈がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Then are you saying our fight to the death with Nrvnqsr that night was completely pointless…!?”
“It was not pointless. You fought in my place. Of course, none of it would have happened if you had not killed me first.”
“――――――”
The world sways beneath me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So what is it?
Killing Nrvnqsr that night, was pointless………!?"
"It wasn't pointless, you fought in my place.
Well, if you didn't kill me, you probably wouldn't have had to in the first place."
"------"
I feel a little dizzy.

entries.japanese:
「……つまり、ネロは吸血鬼殺人にはまったく関係なくて、ここ一ヶ月街を騒がしているのは別の吸血鬼の仕業ってこと……？」
「うん、そうゆうこと。
でも、これはわたしが済ませる問題だから志貴は気にしないでいいよ。
そんなコトより、ねえ」
　やけに楽しそうな笑顔をうかべて、アルクェイドは呆然としている俺を見上げてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So Nrvnqsr had nothing to do with the vampire murders, and some other vampire has been terrorizing the city for the past month?”
“Yes, exactly. But this is my problem to settle, so you do not need to worry about it. More importantly, Shiki…”
Arcueid looks up at my dazed face with a smile far too delighted for comfort.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… In other words, those vampire killings had nothing at all to do with Nrvnqsr and it was the work of another vampire……?"
"Yeah, that's right.
But, that's my problem so you don't have to worry about it.
But more than that, hey."

With an extremely happy smile, Arcueid looks up at me as I still stand there in surprise.

entries.japanese:
「昨夜はどうだった？
　誰が出てきた？」
「は？」
　昨夜って、なんのコトだろう。
　アルクェイドの言っている事は、よくわからない。
　どうせ俺はアルクェイドの言葉をかってに勘違いして見当違いのことばっかり考えてたお間抜けさんだから、アルクェイドの言ってることなんて解るはずがないだろうけど―――って、あれ？
　昨夜誰が出てきたのか、とアルクェイドは聞いてきたのか―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“How was last night? Who appeared?”
“Huh?”
What does she mean by last night?
I cannot follow her at all.
Then again, I am apparently the idiot who twists everything she says into the wrong conclusion, so naturally I would not understand―――but wait.
Did Arcueid just ask who appeared last night―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How was last night?
Who came?"

"Huh?"
What does she mean by last night?
I don't understand what she's talking about.
After all, I'm the idiot who mistook Arcueid's words and made such a stupid mistake, so of course I don't understand what she is saying, and---huh?
Did Arcueid ask me who came last night---?

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
昨夜って、なに」
「あれ？
　おっかしいなあ、ちゃんと夢魔を送っておいたんだけど」
「まった。
なに、そのムマって」
「えーと、ようするにその本人が望むような夢を見せる使い魔のことよ。
志貴は男性だからサキュバスを送っておいたんだけど、いい夢見れたでしょ？」
「お―――――」
　いい夢見れたでしょ、って、アレは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. What do you mean by last night?”
“That is strange. I know I sent the dream familiar properly.”
“Wait. What is a dream familiar?”
“Basically, it is a familiar that shows people the dreams they desire. Since you are a man, Shiki, I sent you a succubus; you had a nice dream, did you not?”
“Oh―――――”
A nice dream, she says, but that was…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
What do you mean by 'last night'?"
"Hm?
That's strange, I know I sent you a dream familiar."
"Wait, what's that dream familiar thing?"
"Um, it's like a familiar that lets you see a dream about what you desire the most.
You're a male, so I sent you a succubus.
Wasn't it a good dream?"
"I-----"
A good dream?
That was…

entries.japanese:
現実としか思えないぐらいリアルな夢を思い出して、カッと自分が赤面するのがわかる。
「おまえ、アレはおまえの仕業かッ―――！」
　にんまり、とアルクェイドが笑う。
―――しまった。
　黙っていればこんな話題はすぐに終わったっていうのに、わざわざ自分で認めるなんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember the dream, vivid enough to pass for reality, and feel my face burn.
“You mean that was your doing―――!”
Arcueid grins.
―――Damn it.
If I had kept quiet, this would have blown over, but I went and admitted it myself―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I remember the realistic dream I had and my face turns red.
"You, that was your doing---!"
Arcueid grins even more.
---Crap.
If I stayed quiet this conversation would have been over, but since I reacted so strongly---

entries.japanese:
「あ、やっぱり届いてたんだ。
ね、それでどんな夢だったの？
　夢魔は志貴の願望をカタチにしてくれるから、気持ち良かったでしょ？」
「どんな夢かって、そんな―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, so it did reach you! Tell me, what kind of dream was it? Dream demons give form to a person’s desires, so it must have felt wonderful.”
“A dream like that is not something I can―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, so you did get it.
So, what kind of dream was it?
