The dream familiar was supposed to take the shape of your greatest desire, so it felt really good, right?"
"What kind of dream?
That's---"

entries.japanese: 下から、さも楽しそうにアルクェイドは見上げてくる。
entries.maoEnglish: Arcueid peers up at me from below, looking thoroughly amused.
entries.mirrorMoon: Arcueid looks up at me full of amusement.

entries.japanese:
「うっ――――」
　それは、昨日の夢のアルクェイドに、似てる。
「か、関係ないだろ。
ほっといてくれ」
　アルクェイドから目を逸らして、つっぱねる。
　だっていうのに、ねーねー、とアルクェイドはしつこく聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Urgh――――”
That look resembles the Arcueid from my dream.
“N-none of your business. Just drop it.”
I turn away and try to shut her down.
She only follows, pestering me with an endless chorus of “Come on.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh----"
She's acting like the Arcueid from last night's dream.
"It doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
I look away from her and refuse.
But Arcueid keeps saying "Come on, come on," over and over.

entries.japanese:
「ね、教えてよ。
志貴が誰といい夢を見たかぐらい、教えてくれてもいいじゃない」
　アルクェイドは興味本位の子供みたいに問いただしてくる。
　いくら視線をそらしてもすぐに視線の先に回りこんできて、ねーねーと声をあげる。
　……ひどい拷問だ。
　これじゃあ、まるっきり昨日の焼き直しみたいじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. You can at least tell me who you had that nice dream with, can’t you?”
She badgers me with the open curiosity of a child.
No matter where I turn, she immediately darts into my line of sight and starts pleading again.
This is torture.
It is yesterday all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Come on, tell me.
You can at least tell me who you dreamed about."
She asks like a curious kid.
Every time I turn away she keeps jumping in front of me, saying "Come on, come on."
…… This is pure torture.
She's as mischievous as last night's dream.

entries.japanese:
ぺたり、と手の平で自分の顔を覆う。
「ねえ志貴、黙ってないで教えてよ」
　そんな俺を、アルクェイドは上目遣いに見つめてくる。
―――だめです、かみさま。
　これ以上は、限界です。
「……おまえ」
　ためらいがちに、小さく口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
I slap a palm over my face.
“Come on, Shiki, stop keeping quiet and tell me.”
Arcueid looks up at me through her lashes.
―――God, no.
I cannot take any more.
“You.”
The word comes out soft and hesitant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I bury my face in my hands.
"Hey Shiki, don't be quiet and tell me."
Arcueid keeps looking at me with those upturned eyes.
---I can't, God.
This is my limit.
"…… You."
I hesitatingly let it out in a quiet voice.

entries.japanese:
「―――え？
　わたしがどうかした？」
「二回も言わせるな。
だから、出てきたのはおまえだったって言ってるの！」
　視線を逸らして怒鳴る。
　きょとん、とアルクェイドは目を点にした。
「わたしって、わたし……？」
「そうだよ。
なんの冗談か、おまえが出てきて、その――――」
　さすがにその先は口にできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Huh? What about me?”
“Do not make me say it twice. I am telling you that you were the one who appeared!”
I shout while staring anywhere but at her.
Arcueid blinks at me in blank astonishment.
“Me, as in me?”
“Yes. For some absurd reason, you appeared, and then――――”
I can’t bring myself to say the rest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Eh?
What about me?"
"Don't make me say it again.
I'm saying that it was you who came!"
I shout angrily as I look away.
Arcueid's eyes widen in surprise.
"M, me……?"
"Yeah, it's not a joke.
You came, and----"
There's no way I can finish.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　アルクェイドも気まずそうに、ようやく、俺から視線をそらしてくれた。
「……………」
「……………」
　お互い、なにを言っていいものかわからない。
　そのまま黙ったままの、ひどく居心地の悪い沈黙が続いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
At last, Arcueid looks away too, every bit as awkward as I feel.
“…”
“…”
Neither of us knows what to say.
A hideously uncomfortable silence stretches between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Now Arcueid looks away from me, looking very uncomfortable.
"………………"
"………………"
Neither of us know what to say.
The uncomfortable silence continues.

entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………
…………
……………Ahem
Unable to bear it any longer, I force myself to clear my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
…………………
…………………………
………………………………… *ahem*
I can't bear the silence any longer and force out that cough.

entries.japanese:
―――そんなコト、死んでも言えない。
「アルクェイドには関係ないだろ。
いいからほっといてくれ」
　アルクェイドから目を逸らして、つっぱねる。
　だっていうのに、ねーねー、とアルクェイドはしつこく聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I would rather die than tell her that.
“It has nothing to do with you, Arcueid. Just leave me alone.”
I turn my face away and rebuff her.
Arcueid refuses to give up, pestering me with an endless chorus of come on, come on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'd die before I'd say it.
"Arcueid, it doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
I look away from her and refuse.
But Arcueid keeps saying "Come on, come on," over and over.

entries.japanese:
「ね、教えてよ。
志貴がどんな夢を見たかぐらい、教えてくれてもいいじゃない」
　アルクェイドは興味本位の子供みたいに問いただしてくる。
　いくら視線をそらしてもすぐに視線の先に回りこんできて、ねーねーと声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. You can at least tell me what kind of dream you had, can’t you?”
She badgers me with the open curiosity of a child.
No matter where I turn, she immediately darts into my line of sight and starts pleading again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Come on, tell me.
You can at least tell me who you dreamed about."
She asks like a curious kid.
Every time I turn away she keeps jumping in front of me, saying "Come on, come on."

entries.japanese:
「……頼むから、かんべんしてくれ。
あの夢はどうかしてたんだ。
……今だって、あんな―――」
　あんな夢を見た理由がわからない。
　アルクェイドは俺の願望だっていうけど、アレが自分の願望だなんて思いたくない。
「あ、それとももしかして悪夢になっちゃったとか。
あの子、相手のことを気にいると勝手に脚色しちゃうのよね。
まだ半人前だから仕方ないかもしれないけど」
　ぶつぶつとアルクェイドは呟く。
「……？
　かってに脚色するって、どういうこと」
「対象の願望を自己流に解釈するのよ。
志貴に送った夢魔はまだ子供だから、いたずら好きなんでしょうね」
「――――そう、か」
　……安心した。
　そうだよな、いくらなんでもあんな夢―――自分から見るはずがないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please, have mercy. That dream was insane. Even now, something like that―――”
I have no idea why I saw such a thing.
Arcueid claims dreams are wish fulfillment, but I refuse to believe that was one of my wishes.
“Oh, unless it turned into a nightmare? When that little thing takes a liking to someone, she starts embellishing on her own. I suppose she cannot help it, since she is still only half-trained.”
Arcueid mutters to herself.
“What do you mean by embellishing on her own?” “She interprets her subject's desires in her own way. The dream demon I sent you is still a child. I imagine she likes mischief.”
“――――I see.”
What a relief.
Of course I would never choose to dream something like that―――not on my own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please, just let it go.
There was something wrong with that dream.
…… Even now, that---"
I don't know why I saw that dream.
Arcueid says it's my greatest desire, but I don't want to think that's what it was.
"Oh, maybe it turned into a nightmare?
She does tend to write the story to her liking when fond of her target.
She's only a novice, so I guess it couldn't be helped."
Arcueid thinks aloud.
"……?
Writes the story to her liking?
What do you mean?"
"I'm saying she interprets your desire in her own way.
That dream familiar I sent you is just a child, so she likes to play pranks."
"----I see."
…… That's a relief.
That's right, that dream---It couldn't have been what I wanted.

entries.japanese:
ホッと胸を撫で下ろす。
　これで俺の潔白はそれなりに証明されたわけだけど―――
「アルクェイド。
おまえ、どうしてそんな物騒なヤツを送りつけたんだ。
嫌がらせにしてもホドがあるぞ、アレ」
「むっ。
嫌がらせなんかしないわ。
　志貴に夢魔を送ったのは、ネロを倒してくれたお礼じゃない。
貴方には感謝してるから、喜んでくれたらいいなって思ったのに！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I breathe a sigh of relief.
That more or less proves my innocence, but―――
“Arcueid, why did you send such a dangerous creature after me? Even harassment has its limits. That thing went far beyond them.”
“Hmph. I wasn’t harassing you.
I sent you the dream demon as a reward for defeating Nrvnqsr. I’m grateful to you, so I thought it might make you happy!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let out a sigh of relief.
With this, my innocence has been proved but---
"Arcueid.
Why did you send me such a thing?
That's too much even for harassment."
"Hmph.
I wouldn't harass you.
I sent you the dream familiar to thank you for defeating Nrvnqsr.
I really am grateful to you, so I thought it'll be great if it made you happy."

entries.japanese:
「お礼って―――いや、感謝してもらえるのは嬉しいけど、その」
　いくらなんでも、ああいうお礼はお断りしたい。
「なによ。
人の好意を受け取れないっていうの、志貴は」
「……あのね。
人じゃなくて吸血鬼だろ、アルクェイドは」
「……それは……そうだけど」
　しゅん、とアルクェイドは肩をすくめる。
　……なんていうか、アルクェイドの感情表現はストレートだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A reward―――I mean, I am glad you appreciate what I did, but…”
Even so, I would prefer not to receive that particular kind of reward.
“What? Can’t you accept a person’s kindness, Shiki?”
“Listen. You are not a person, Arcueid; you are a vampire.”
“Well, yes, but…”
Arcueid’s shoulders droop.
Arcueid makes no attempt to hide what she feels.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank me?---Well, I'm happy you were grateful, but…"
But no matter what, I'll pass on that sort of thanks.
"Oh come on.
Are you saying you can't accept a person's goodwill?"
"…… Hey, you're not a person, you're a vampire, Arcueid."
"…… That's…… true but."
Arcueid slumps her shoulders.
…… How do I say this… Arcueid is very open in expressing her emotions.

entries.japanese:
喜んだり怒ったり反省したり、ともかくくるくると表情が変わって―――その、すごく魅力的だと思う。
　……口では吸血鬼だろ、なんて言っておきながら。
　俺自身、そんな事実を忘れてしまうぐらい、アルクェイドは人間らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Delight, anger, remorse―――her expression shifts with every feeling, and, well, I find it incredibly attractive.
…For all that I called her a vampire to her face,
Arcueid is so human that I keep forgetting the truth myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Being happy, being angry, she changes her expressions so quickly---it's actually kind of charming.
…… I said she was a vampire, but…
she really does seem like a human; enough to even make me forget that fact.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――街灯がついた」
　さっきまで消えていた街灯が灯っていく。
　月明かりしかなかった公園で、これで多少は明るくなってくれたみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh―――the streetlights came on.”
One after another, the lamps that had been dark begin to glow.
Until now the park had only moonlight; this makes it a little brighter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---the lamp posts are turning back on."
The previously dark lamp posts spring back to life.
The park lit only by the moonlight gradually becomes brighter.

entries.japanese:
「あの女が結界を解除したんでしょうね。
誰も公園に入ろうって思わせない暗示だったけど、志貴には通用しなかったわけか」
「ん？
　なんだ、さっきまでの停電って先輩の仕業だったのか？」
「ええ、連中得意の人よけ。
わたしや志貴には関係のないコトよ」
「ところで志貴。
一つ聞くけど、貴方はシエルのことをどう思ってるの？」
　アルクェイドは冷たい声で、突然にそんな事を聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That woman must have lowered her barrier. It was a suggestion that made people unwilling to enter the park, though apparently it had no effect on you.”
“Hm? You mean that power outage was Ciel’s doing?”
“Yes, keeping people away is their specialty. It has no effect on either of us.”
“By the way, Shiki, I want to ask you something. What do you think of Ciel?”
Arcueid springs the question on me in a voice gone suddenly cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It seems that woman lifted her barrier.
It was supposed to prevent anyone from entering the park, but it seems like you could pass right through."
"Hm?
You mean that power outage was Senpai's doing?"
"Yeah, it's one of their specialties, letting people stay away.
It really has nothing to do with us."
"By the way Shiki.
I wanna ask, but what do you think of Ciel?"
With a cold voice, Arcueid suddenly asks that.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩のことって……なんでそんな事聞くんだよ、アルクェイドは」
「なんでもよ。
わたし、あの女は嫌いなの。
さっきもね、お互いの情報を交換しようって事で会ってみたんだけど、話してるうちにムカムカしてきちゃって、結局殺し合いになっちゃったし」
「こ、殺し合いって―――どうしてそう物騒なコトを口にするんだおまえはっ！
　だいたい先輩は吸血鬼じゃないじゃないか。
どうしてアルクェイドが先輩を殺す、なんてコトを言うんだよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why are you asking me about Ciel, Arcueid?”
“No reason. I hate that woman. We met earlier to exchange information, but the longer we talked, the angrier I got, until we ended up trying to kill each other.”
“T-trying to kill each other―――why do you say things like that so casually!? Ciel is not a vampire. Why would you talk about killing her?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… About Senpai?
…… Why do you ask about that, Arcueid?"
"Oh nothing.
I just hate that woman.
We were supposed to meet and exchange information, but I got irritated during the conversation and we ended up trying to kill each other."
"K-kill each other---why did you end up doing that!?
In the first place, Senpai isn't a vampire.
Why did you try to kill Senpai?"

entries.japanese:
「それはこっちの台詞よ。
いっとくけどね、先に手を出してきたのはあいつのほうなんだから」
「――――え？」
　……先に手を出したのは、先輩のほう……？
「そうよ。
『やっぱり止めます。
わたし、あなたの存在が認められません』なんていって、いきなり襲いかかってきたんだから。
おとなしい顔してるけど、埋葬機関の人間はみんな好戦的なの。
志貴も騙されちゃだめだからね」
「な―――――」
　好戦的って、あの先輩に限ってそんな―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I should be asking you that. She was the one who attacked first, I’ll have you know.”
“――――What?”
Ciel attacked first?
“That is right. She said, ‘I have changed my mind. I cannot allow you to exist,’ and attacked me without warning. She may look mild-mannered, but everyone in the Burial Agency is belligerent. Do not let her deceive you, Shiki.”
“Wh―――――at?”
Ciel could never be like that―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's my line.
She was the one who struck first!"
"----Eh?"
…… The one who struck first, was Senpai……?
"That's right.
She said 'I knew it was pointless, I just can't allow your existence', and then she attacked me.
She may look very calm, but all the members of the Burial Agency enjoy fighting.
You can't let her fool you too, Shiki."
"Wha-----"
Enjoy fighting?
Does Senpai really---

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴。
貴方、あいつに今まで騙されてたんでしょう？
　なのにどうしてあいつの肩を持つようなことをいうのよ。
　あいつはね、何も知らない志貴を騙して、一般人のふりをしてたのよ。
利用されて悔しいとか思わないの？」
　じろり、とアルクェイドは睨んでくる。
「……………」
　それは。
　たしかに先輩がアルクェイドみたいに、俺たちとは違った側の人だったのはショックだったけど。
　けど、騙されていたとかいう感覚はまったくない。
逆に何度も先輩には助けてもらった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Shiki. She has been deceiving you all this time, has she not? Then why are you taking her side?
She lied to you when you knew nothing and pretended to be an ordinary person. Do you not resent being used?”
Arcueid glares at me.
“……………”
The thought catches.
It is true that learning Ciel belonged to the same hidden world as Arcueid came as a shock.
But I do not feel deceived at all. On the contrary, she has saved me again and again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shiki.
You were fooled by her up to now, right?
So why are you saying things to help her out?
You know, she was tricking you, since you didn't know anything, and pretended to be a normal person.
Don't you feel a little angry at being used?"
Arcueid glares at me.
"……………"
That is,
certainly I'm shocked that Senpai is different from normal people, kind of like Arcueid.
But, I don't feel like I've been tricked.
On the contrary, Senpai has helped me so many times.

entries.japanese:
「俺は――――」
　……先輩のことは、正体を知った今でも先輩だって思ってる。
　あの人と昼食を一緒に食べたり、有彦と三人でバカな話をして盛り上がったり、校門まで一緒に帰ったりするのは、楽しいんだ。
　だから―――出来ることなら。
　先輩の正体なんて、知らないほうが良かったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I――――!”
Even now that I know the truth, Ciel is still Ciel to me.
I enjoy eating lunch with her, getting carried away trading stupid jokes with her and Arihiko, and walking with her to the school gate.
So―――if I could choose.
I wish I had never learned the truth about her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I----"
…… Even though I know about Senpai's identity now, I still think of her as Senpai.
Eating lunch with her, talking about stupid things with her and Arihiko, walking with her to the school gate, all of it is so much fun.
So---if I could.
It would have been better if I didn't find out about her.

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
貴方、あの女とわたし、どっちの味方？」
　じろり、と。
　アルクェイドの目が、ゆらいでいる。
　今までの人間らしいものじゃなくて、獲物を狩る肉食動物みたいに感情のない瞳。
　アルクェイドにとって、シエル先輩はどうしても許せない敵なんだ。
　だからそんな、敵意に満ちた視線をする。
　俺が。
彼女の敵に味方をするのなら、その時点で遠野志貴さえも敵だというように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Whose side are you on, hers or mine?”
Her gaze bores into me.
Arcueid’s eyes waver.
They no longer look human, but emotionless, like the eyes of a predator stalking prey.
To Arcueid, Ciel is an enemy she can never forgive.
That is why her stare is so full of hostility.
Me. If I side with her enemy, then Shiki Tohno is her enemy as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Whose side are you on, mine or that woman's?"
I feel pressure.
Her eyes are the source.
Now she isn't like a human, but more like an animal hunting its prey.
It seems Ciel-senpai is an unforgivable enemy for Arcueid.
That's why she glares at me with such fierce, hostile eyes.
As if saying, if I am her enemy's friend, I will be Arcueid's enemy as well.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド……」
　言葉がつまる。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid.”
The words catch in my throat.
I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid……"
I have trouble answering.
I---

entries.japanese:
―――俺は、どうなんだろう。
　たしかに先輩は大切な人だ。
シエル先輩が何者であろうと、あの人と過ごした学校での時間は得がたいものだって思っている。
　けど、それでも――――俺にとって先輩は先輩なんだ。
　敵とか味方とか、男とか女とか言う前に頼りになる先輩っていう感情しかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――What do I really feel?
Ciel is undeniably precious to me. Whatever she might truly be, the hours we have shared at school are something irreplaceable.
Even so――――Ciel is still Ciel to me.
Whether enemy or ally, man or woman, before any of that, she is simply the upperclassman I have always relied on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---How do I feel?
Certainly Senpai is dear to me.
No matter who she is, the time we spent at school together is precious to me.
But, even still------to me, Senpai is Senpai.
Friend or foe, man or woman, before all of that, I only feel that she is my dependable Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
「なによ。
沈黙なんかじゃ誤魔化されないからね、わたしは」
　睨んでくるアルクェイド。
　……考えてみれば、先輩が何者であろうとコイツのほうが何倍も恐ろしいヤツなんだ。
　つい忘れがちだけど吸血鬼なんだし、どこか道徳観念っていうものが欠如してる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“What? You can’t wriggle out of this by keeping quiet.”
Arcueid glares at me.
Come to think of it, whatever Ciel might be, this woman is many times more frightening.
I tend to forget she is a vampire and that somewhere inside her, something like ordinary morality is simply missing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
"Come on!
You can't fool me by being quiet, you know."
Arcueid continues glaring at me.
…… Come to think of it, no matter what kind of person Senpai is, this person is much, much scarier.
I've been forgetting, but she is a vampire, and she seems to lack knowledge of moral concepts.

entries.japanese:
――――けど、たしかに惹かれてる。
　今夜だって、こいつを捜そうって思って、けど中々見つからなくて苛々していた。
　それは、惚れた相手にやきもきするような感情だったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――And yet I am drawn to her.
Even tonight, I had set out to find her, growing more and more frustrated when I couldn’t.
It was the restless misery of waiting for someone you’d fallen for.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----But, I am still attracted to her.
Even tonight, I was simply looking for her, but I was getting so frustrated when I couldn't find her.
It was, something like feeling worried about a loved one.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、これが最後よ。
貴方はわたしとあの女、どっちの味方だっていうの？」
　苛だたしげに睨んでくるアルクェイド。
「……あのな、そんなの決まってるだろ。
俺はここに残ってるんだぞ。
先輩の味方をしてるんなら、とっくに先輩を追いかけてる」
「えっと、それってつまり―――どういうこと？」
　はて、と首をかしげるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, this is the last time I’m asking. Whose side are you on, mine or that woman’s?”
Arcueid glares at me in open irritation.
“Isn’t it obvious? I’m still standing here. If I’d chosen Ciel, I would’ve gone after her ages ago.”
“Um, so that means―――what, exactly?”
Arcueid tilts her head, mystified.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, I'll ask you one more time.
Whose side are you on, mine or that woman's?"
Arcueid glares at me in irritation.

"…… Hey now, isn't that already decided?
I'm still here.
If I was on Senpai's side, I would have gone after her."
"Um, in other words---what do you mean?"
Arcueid tilts her head to the side questioningly.

entries.japanese:
「どういうことって、おまえ」
―――どうしてこう、こういった当たり前の会話だと理解力が下がるんだろう、コイツは。
　これじゃあハッキリ口にする以外、こっちの気持ちは伝わらないじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you mean, what does it mean?”
―――Why do her powers of comprehension always collapse during the most ordinary conversations?
At this rate, she will never understand how I feel unless I say it outright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do I mean?"
---Why doesn't she just understand simple conversations?
If she's like this, unless I don't just say it directly, she'll never understand.

entries.japanese:
「わからないヤツだな。
俺がここに残ってるっていうのは、ようするに――――」
　ようするに、どういう事なんだ？
　惹かれてるっていうのは、もう自分でも誤魔化しようのない事実だ。
　けどそれは、決して口にしてはいけない事だ。
　いくらアルクェイドが綺麗だっていっても、コイツが吸血鬼だっていうコトは変わらないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really don’t get it, do you? The fact that I stayed means――――”
Means what, exactly?
I can no longer deceive myself about being drawn to her.
But that is something I can never say aloud.
No matter how beautiful Arcueid is, she is still a vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're pretty dense.
Saying I'm still here means that----"
Means what?
The fact that I'm attracted to her is an undoubtable truth.
But I know that is something I must not say.
No matter how beautiful she is, it still doesn't change the fact that she's a vampire.

entries.japanese:
「また黙り込んじゃって、どういうつもりよ。
そんなにシエルがいいっていうんならはっきり口にすればいいのに」
「ち、違うって言ってるだろ！
　どうしてここまで言って解らないんだ、おまえは……！」
「そんなの、わたしにわかるわけないでしょ！」
　理不尽に怒鳴ったら、それ以上に理不尽に怒鳴り返された。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve gone quiet again; what is that supposed to mean? If Ciel is so wonderful, why don’t you just say so?”
“I-I’ve told you, that isn’t it! How can you still not understand after everything I’ve said?”
“How am I supposed to know?”
I shout at her without cause, and she shouts back with even less.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're going silent again, what are you trying to say?
If you want to choose Ciel, then just say so!"
"I, I said that's not it!
I keep saying it, but why don't you understand……!?"
"How can I know!"
Being screamed at irrationally, she screams back at me irrationally.

entries.japanese:
「もういい、志貴なんか知らない！」
「おい、ちょっと待てったら。
どこに行く気だよ」
「志貴には関係ないわ。
ついてこないで！」
本当にご立腹なのか、アルクェイドは振り返りもせずに歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, I’m through with you, Shiki!”
“Hey, wait. Where are you going?” “It’s none of your business. Don’t follow me!”
Whether she is truly furious or merely acting it, Arcueid walks away without once looking back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine!
Then I don't know you at all, Shiki!"
"Hey, hold on.
Where are you going?"
"It has nothing to do with you.
Don't follow me!"
Is she really that angry?
Arcueid walks away without even turning around.

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　一人公園に残されて、呆然と立ち尽くす。
　……アルクェイドは一人で怒ってどっか行ってしまったし、こっちだって聞きたい事は聞いたんだから、後は屋敷に帰るだけだってわかってる。
　……けど、足は屋敷に少しも帰ろうとしてくれない。
　理性はちゃんと理路整然としているのに、心がついてきてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――――?”
Left alone in the park, I stand there dumbfounded.
Arcueid has stormed off alone, and since I have heard everything I wanted to ask, I know I should simply go home.
But my feet refuse to take a single step toward the estate.
My reason has everything arranged in neat, logical order, but my heart refuses to follow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha-----"
I stand in shock by myself in the park.
…… Arcueid got mad and went somewhere by herself, and I asked her what I wanted, so I know I should go back to the mansion.
…… But, my feet don't even move one step back.

My logic tells me where I should go, but my heart doesn't listen.

entries.japanese:
―――よく言われる話だけど。
　好き嫌いの感情っていうのは、どうにも理屈じゃないってコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It is a cliché.
But perhaps liking and disliking someone truly have nothing to do with reason.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It's been said a million times, but.
The feelings of love and hate, they have nothing to do with logic.

entries.japanese:
「―――――ああ、もう！」
　くそ、なんでこんなに放っておけないんだろう、あのアルクェイドっていうヤツは……！
「アルクェイド！
　ちょっと待てって言ってるだろ！」
　声をあげて、振りかえりもせずに歩いていくアルクェイドを追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Oh, damn it!”
Why the hell can’t I leave Arcueid alone…!
“Arcueid! I said wait!”
I shout and run after her as she marches away without looking back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Man, geez!"
Damn it.
Why is it that I just can't leave Arcueid alone……!?
"Arcueid!
I said wait!"
Raising my voice, I chase after Arcueid who keeps on walking.

entries.japanese:
俺は、それでも――――先輩のことを、敵とかそういうふうに、思いたくない。
「……先輩は大切な友人だ。
味方とか敵とか、そういう割り振りはできない」
「なによ。
それじゃあわたしはどういう割り振りなの？」
「おまえは―――ほっとけないヤツっていうか、その……」
　ぽりぽり、と頬をかく。
　ほっとけないっていうか―――先輩とはまた別の意味で気になっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even so――――I don’t want to think of Ciel as an enemy.
“Ciel is a dear friend. I can’t sort her into some little box marked ally or enemy.”
“Then what about me? What little box do I go in?”
“You’re―――someone I can’t leave alone, or, well…”
I scratch my cheek.
It isn’t only that I can’t leave her alone―――she occupies my thoughts in a different way from Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I… despite all this----don't even want to think that Senpai is my enemy.
"…… Senpai is my dear friend.
Enemy or ally, I can't label her like that."
"What is this?
Then what am I to you?"
"You---you're someone I can't leave alone, and um……"
I scratch my cheek.
Someone I can't leave alone---and I'm concerned about her in a completely different way than Senpai.

entries.japanese:
今夜だって、こいつを捜そうって思って、けど中々見つからなくて苛々していた。
　それは、惚れた相手にやきもきするような感情に近かったと思う。
「―――――あ」
　……いや、そんなハズないっ！
　たしかにこいつは美人だけど、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Even tonight, I had gone looking for her, growing increasingly frustrated when I couldn’t find her.
It had felt almost like the anxious impatience of being in love.
“―――――Ah.”
No, that can’t be it!
She is certainly beautiful, but I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even tonight, I was simply looking for her, but I was getting so frustrated when I couldn't find her.
It was, something like feeling worried about a loved one.

"-----Ah."
…… No, there's no way that's true!
Certainly she is beautiful, but I---

entries.japanese:
「ああ、もういいだろ！
　なんだってそんな事を聞くんだ、おまえは！」
「そんなの、わたしにわかるわけないでしょ！」
　理不尽に怒鳴ったら、それ以上に理不尽に怒鳴り返された。
「もういい、志貴なんか知らない！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough already! Why are you even asking me something like that?”
“How am I supposed to know?”
I shout at her without cause, and she shouts back with even less.
“Fine, I’m through with you, Shiki!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, just give it a rest!
Why do you ask me about that anyway!?"
"How can I know!"
Being screamed at irrationally, she screams back at me irrationally.
"Fine!
Then I don't know you at all, Shiki!"

entries.japanese:
「おい、ちょっと待てったら。
どこに行く気だよ」
「志貴には関係ないわ。
ついてこないで！」
　本当にご立腹なのか、アルクェイドは振り返りもせずに歩いていってしまった。
　アルクェイドの姿は段々と遠くなっていく。
「…………あ」
　あいつ、どこに行くつもりなんだろう。
「……なんだよ、いきなり逆ギレしやがって」
　うん。
夢魔ってヤツを送りこまれたんだから、怒りたいのはこっちのほうなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, wait. Where are you going?”
“It’s none of your business. Don’t follow me!”
Whether she is truly furious or merely acting it, Arcueid walks away without once looking back.
She dwindles into the distance.
“Ah.”
Where is she going?
“What the hell, why did she suddenly turn on me?”
Exactly. I should be angry after she sent that dream demon after me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, hold on.
Where are you going?"
"It has nothing to do with you.
Don't follow me!"
Is she really that angry?
Arcueid walks away without even turning around.
Her figure quickly fades into the distance.
"…………… Ah."
Just where does she plan on going?
"…… What is this, taking it out on me like that?"
Yeah.
She's the one who sent me that dream familiar, so I'm the one who should be angry."

entries.japanese:
「……俺、なんか怒らせるようなコト、したのかな……」
　わからない。
　もともと吸血鬼の考えることなんてわかるもんか。
「―――――」
　アルクェイドは一人で怒ってどっか行ってしまったし、こっちだって聞きたい事は聞いたんだから家に帰ろう。
　……けど、足は屋敷に少しも帰ろうとしてくれない。
　理性はちゃんと理路整然としているのに、心がついてきてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did I do something to make her angry?”
I have no idea.
How can I possibly understand the way a vampire thinks?
“―――――”
Arcueid has stormed off alone, and since I’ve already heard everything I wanted to ask, I should go home.
But my feet refuse to take a single step toward the estate.
My reason has everything arranged in neat, logical order, but my heart refuses to follow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Did I do something, to make her angry……?"
I don't know.
In the first place, there's no way I can understand how vampires think.
"-----"
…… Arcueid got mad and went somewhere by herself, and I asked her what I wanted, so I know I should go back to the mansion.
…… But, my feet don't even move one step back.

My logic tells me where I should go, but my heart doesn't listen.

entries.japanese:
―――よく言われる話だけど。
　好き嫌いの感情っていうのは、理屈じゃないのか。
「―――――ああ、もう！」
　くそ、なんでこんなに放っておけないんだろう、あのアルクェイドっていうヤツは……！
「アルクェイド！
　ちょっと待てって言ってるだろ！」
　声をあげて、振りかえりもせずに歩いていくアルクェイドを追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It is a cliché.
But perhaps liking and disliking someone truly have nothing to do with reason.
“―――――Oh, damn it!”
Why the hell can’t I leave Arcueid alone…!
“Arcueid! I said wait!”
I shout and run after her as she marches away without looking back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It's been said a million times, but.
The feelings of love and hate, they have nothing to do with logic.
"-----Man, geez!"
Damn it.
Why is it that I just can't leave Arcueid alone……!?
"Arcueid!
I said wait!"
Raising my voice, I chase after Arcueid who keeps on walking.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは夜の街を歩いていく。
　ただ前だけを見て、金の髪をなびかせる白い影。
　その姿は、初めて彼女を見た時のイメージとひどく一致している。
　いや、それとも。
　夜の公園で、ネロと対峙していた時のアルクェイドそのものかもしれない。
　……なにか、厭な予感がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid walks through the nighttime city.
A white figure with golden hair streaming behind her, eyes fixed only ahead.
She looks exactly as I imagined her the first time I saw her.
Or perhaps.
She looks like Arcueid when she faced Nrvnqsr in the park at night.
A sense of foreboding crawls over me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Surrounded by night, Arcueid walks down the street.
She looks straight ahead, her white figure with golden hair fluttering.
It bears a horrible resemblance to the first time I saw her.
No, or perhaps…
Perhaps it's like the time she faced off with Nrvnqsr.
…… For some reason I have a bad feeling about this.

entries.japanese:
「おい、アルクェイド」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドは振り向きもしないで歩いていく。
「話を聞けって。
なにをしているかぐらい教えてくれてもいいだろう」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドはやっぱり振り向かずに歩いていく。
　……ここで引き下がるのも情けない。
　情けないけど、とりあえず無言で後を付いていくことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Arcueid.”
“――――――”
Arcueid keeps walking without so much as a glance back.
“Listen to me. The least you can do is tell me what you’re doing.”
“――――――”
Still she walks on without turning.
Retreating now would be pathetic.
Following her in sullen silence is probably just as pathetic, but that’s what I do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Arcueid!"
"------"
Arcueid continues to walk without turning around.
"I want to talk to you.
You can at least tell me what you're going to do."
"------"
Of course, Arcueid just continues walking without turning around.
…… It'd be miserable if I left it like this.
I decide to follow her silently for now.

entries.japanese:
カツカツカツカツ、と足音を響かせて無言の散歩が続く。
―――と。
　ピタリ、と立ち止まってアルクェイドは振り向いた。
「ついてこないで。
後ろに貴方みたいな普通の人にいられると迷惑だって、わからない？」
「―――だから、なにをしてるのか教えてくれたら帰るって」
「……志貴には関係ないから、ほっといて」
　ぷい、とアルクェイドは前を向いて歩き始める。
　……まいったな。
　また無言の徘徊が始まるみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Our silent walk continues to the hard, unbroken rhythm of her footsteps.
―――Then.
Arcueid stops dead and turns around.
“Stop following me. Can’t you understand that having an ordinary human like you behind me is a nuisance?”
“I told you―――I’ll go home once you tell me what you’re doing.”
“It has nothing to do with you, Shiki, so leave me alone.”
She turns away with a petulant toss of her head and starts walking again.
This is getting ridiculous.
It seems our silent wandering is about to begin all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The footsteps echo through the night air.
---And then,
Arcueid suddenly stops and turns around.
"Don't follow me.
Don't you understand it's troubling for a normal person like you to follow me around?"
"---So tell me what you're going to do and I'll go back."
"…… It doesn't concern you, so leave me alone."
Arcueid strides off once more.
…… Crap.
It seems like our wordless wandering is going to continue.

entries.japanese:
大通りにさしかかった時、アルクェイドはぴたりと足を止めた。
「―――見つけた」
「え………？」
　アルクェイドの声が、別人のように冷たい。
「――――あ」
　……背筋が震える。
　背中ごしにも、今のアルクェイドがどれくらいの敵意を帯びているのかが、はっきりと感じ取れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
When we reach the main avenue, Arcueid abruptly stops.
“―――Found you.”
“What…?”
Her voice is cold enough to belong to someone else.
“――――Ah…”
A shiver runs down my spine.
Even from behind her, I can feel the sheer hostility pouring from Arcueid’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When we approach the main street, Arcueid freezes.
"---Found it."
"Eh……… ?"
Her voice is cold, like a totally different person's.
"----Ah."
…… A chill runs up my spine.
Even from behind, I can feel the hostility manifesting itself in her.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド―――おまえ、なにを――」
　するつもりだ、とは言えない。
　だって彼女が何をしようとしているのか、言葉にするまでもなく解りきっている。
　アルクェイドの体から放たれているのは紛れもない、一点の濁りもない『殺意』に他ならないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid―――what are you――”
I cannot finish by asking what she intends to do.
There is no need to put it into words; I already know.
What radiates from her is unmistakable, pure and unsullied: murderous intent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid---What, are you--"
I can't even finish.
It's clear what she intends to do without saying anything.
Without a doubt, there is nothing but the pure, unadulterated intent to kill.

entries.japanese:
「おい―――なに考えてるんだ、おまえ……！」
「――――」
　アルクェイドは答えない。
　その視線の先には、なんでもない、背広姿の男性が歩いているだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell are you thinking―――?”
“――――”
Arcueid gives no answer.
Ahead of her, an utterly ordinary man in a business suit walks down the street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---what are you, thinking……!?"
"----"
Arcueid doesn't answer.
Her eyes are fixed solely on a man in a business suit walking by.

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
メガネを外してあの人間を見てみなさい」
「あの人間って―――あのサラリーマンのこと？」
「早く。
わたしが何をしているか知りたいのなら、質問はあとよ」
「――――わかった。
あんまり街中で視たくはないんだけど―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Take off your glasses and look at that human.”
“That human―――you mean the office worker?”
“Quickly. If you want to know what I’m doing, save your questions.”
“――――All right. I hate using these eyes in the middle of town, but―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki.
Take off your glasses and look at that person."
"That person---you mean that business man?"
"Hurry.
If you want to know what I'm doing, then leave the questions for later."
"----Alright.
I don't like to look while in town, but---"

entries.japanese:
メガネを外す。
「………く」
　こめかみには軽い頭痛。
　その痛みと引き換えに、うっすらと、地面や壁に『線』が視える。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remove my glasses.
“Ghh…”
A dull ache stirs in my temples.
In exchange for that pain, faint lines emerge across the ground and the walls.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take off my glasses.
"…… Gah."
Instantly a light headache springs forth.
In exchange for the pain, I can see "lines" running all along the walls and the ground.

entries.japanese:
「聞いておくけど。
志貴、貴方が普通の状態で『点』を視れるのは生物だけでしょ」
「え―――？
　ああ、そういえばそうみたいだ。
建物には線しか見えない」
　……ホテルの時は視えていたけど、アレは気絶しそうな程の頭痛を伴なった結果だったし。
「でしょうね。
貴方は生物だから、鉱物の死を理解できないのよ。
　だから鉱物の死を『視る』ためには、まず彼らと同じ指向性を持つための回線に繋がらないといけない。
『視る』ためには『理解』しないといけないから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me make sure of something. Under normal conditions, living things are the only things whose ‘points’ you can see, right?”
“Huh? Oh―――now that you mention it, yes. Buildings only have lines.”
I saw points at the hotel, but only with a headache so violent I nearly lost consciousness.
“I thought so. You’re alive, so you can’t comprehend the death of minerals.
To ‘see’ their death, you must first connect yourself to a channel that gives you the same orientation they possess. You cannot ‘see’ something without first understanding it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Another question, Shiki.
You only see "points" on living things, right?"
"Eh---?
Yeah, that seems to be true.
Things like buildings only have lines."
…… I saw them back during the time in that hotel, but at the cost of a headache that almost caused me to pass out.
"Right, since you are a living being, you can't comprehend the death of inanimate objects.
So in order to "see" the death of inanimate objects, you must first connect to a circuit of the same orientation as them.
To "see", you have to "comprehend" them first.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあついでに聞くけど、今の志貴からみて、あの人間はどんな感じ？」
「――――？」
　そんなの、いつもと変わらないと思うけど―――
「――――！？」
　思わず、足が後ろに引いてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now that we’ve established that, how does that human look to you?”
“――――What…?”
He looks the same as anyone else―――
“――――!?”
I recoil without meaning to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then another question.
Shiki, how does that person look to you?"

"----?"
It'll just be the same as always---
"----!?"
Without thinking, I step backwards.

entries.japanese:
……なんだ、アレ。
　たしかに、どんな人間だって『線』はある。
　けどそれは数えられる程度の数で、ある意味幾何学模様みたいなものなんだ。
　なのに―――アレは、なんだ。
　体中に『線』が走っている。
『線』は静脈動脈のように浮き出ていて、『線』に塗りつぶされてあの男性がどんな風貌をしているのかさえ、見えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
What is that?
Every human has lines, of course.
But there are few enough to count, arranged almost like a geometric pattern.
But that thing―――what is it?
Lines crawl over every inch of its body, raised like arteries and veins. They cover the man so completely that I can no longer make out his face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What is that?
Certainly, all humans have "lines" on them.
But they only have countable amounts and they also look like geometric patterns.
But---what is that?
There are "lines" running all through him.
Those "lines" are all over him like blood vessels… so much that I can't even make out his appearance.

entries.japanese:
「――――ぐっ」
　吐きそうになる。
　その、黒い『線』―――ラクガキがヒトの形をしたモノのいたるところに、血を流しているような『黒い点』が視えている――――
「志貴にはどう見える？
　わたしとしては、志貴には普通の人間に見えていてほしいんだけど」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドの言葉に答えられない。
　今は―――吐き気を堪えるだけで精一杯だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…”
I nearly vomit.
Amid those black lines—those scribbles covering the human-shaped thing—I can see black points everywhere, as though they were bleeding darkness.
“What does he look like to you, Shiki? I was hoping you would see an ordinary human.”
“――――――”
I cannot answer her.
For now―――enduring the nausea takes everything I have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gah."
I want to puke.
Those, black "lines"----scribbles making a human shape… everywhere throughout it, I can see "black points" that look like they are flowing blood---
"Shiki, how does it look?
I was hoping it would look normal to you."
"------"
I can't answer.
Right now---it takes all my strength just not to vomit.

entries.japanese:
「―――そう。
残念ね、志貴はアレにも死を視てしまっているなんて」
「ああ……なんか普通、とは違う、けど……線は、視え、てる……」
「やっぱり───死者さえ殺せるのね、貴方は。
命が有る無しの問題さえ無関係。
動いているもの、破壊できるものなら例外なく停止させる───なによ、ほんとの化け物は貴方のほうじゃない」
「え─────」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I see. What a pity—you can see death even in that.”
“Yeah—it isn’t normal, but I can see the lines…”
“So it is true───you can kill even something already dead. Whether it possesses life is irrelevant. If it moves, if it can be destroyed, you can stop it without exception───honestly, the true monster here is you.”
“What─────”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
How unfortunate that you can even see death on that thing."
"Yeah…… it's not, normal, but…… I can, still see, the lines……"
"I knew it---you can even kill The Dead.
The fact that they don't have any life has no meaning for you.
Something that moves, something that breaks, you can stop it completely without exception---You're more of a monster, Shiki."
"Eh-----"

entries.japanese:
「見たとおり、アレはもう人間とは呼べないわ。
自らの死という負債を、他人の血を吸い上げることで誤魔化し続ける吸血鬼だから」
　アルクェイドは歩を速める。
　一直線に、どこにでもいるような男性に向かって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“As you can see, that can no longer be called human. It’s a vampire, staving off the debt of its own death by draining the blood of others.”
Arcueid quickens her pace.
She heads straight toward the perfectly ordinary-looking man.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"As you saw, you can't call that thing human anymore.
It's a vampire that deceives death by sucking the blood of other people."
Arcueid quickens her steps.
She walks straight towards the man.

entries.japanese:
「おい、アルクェイド―――」
「志貴はそこにいて」
　男性はアルクェイドに気がついたのか、逃げるように路地裏へ走っていく。
　アルクェイドはゆらり、と足音もたてずに歩いていく。
　月明かりの下、彼女の体は路地裏へと消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Arcueid―――”
“Stay there, Shiki.”
Perhaps noticing her, the man breaks into a run and flees down an alley.
Arcueid glides after him without a sound.
Beneath the moonlight, her white figure vanishes into the dark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Arcueid---"
"Stay there Shiki!"
Did that young man realize Arcueid was there?
He starts running towards a back alley.
Arcueid strides silently.
Underneath the moonlight, she disappears into that alley.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　心臓の音が、やけに近くで聞こえた。
　まだ夜も深くないという時間。
　賑やかな繁華街のただ中にいるのに、自分以外の人の気配が、まったく感じられなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
My heartbeat sounds unnaturally close.
The night is still young.
I stand in the heart of a bustling entertainment district—yet every human presence but my own has disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
The sound of my heartbeat is awfully close.
It's not even real late at night.
Even though I'm in the midst of a bustling shopping district, I can't sense anyone besides myself.

entries.japanese:
―――ドクン。
　メガネ―――メガネを早くかけなくっちゃ。
　そうしないと、厭なものを見てしまう。
　今まで視えていたものなんて入り口にすぎないぐらいの闇を、見ることになってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――THUMP.
My glasses―――I have to put them back on.
Otherwise I will see something hideous.
A darkness so vast that everything my eyes have shown me before was only its threshold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---THUMP.
My glasses---I have to put on my glasses.
If I don't do that, I'll see terrible things.

I'll see something so terrible that everything I've seen so far would be nothing in comparison to it.

entries.japanese:
―――ど、く、ん。
　でも体が動かない。
　ツギハギだらけのセカイを視る裸眼は、魅了されたように、アルクェイドが入っていった路地裏を、壁越しに見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Th—ump.
But my body will not move.
My naked eyes see a world stitched together from broken pieces and, as though enthralled, stare through the wall into the alley Arcueid entered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Th, u, mp.
But my body won't move.
My eyes that can see this patchwork world look towards that alley in fascination.

entries.japanese:
「───────」
　唐突に、音が消えた。
　人の気配も、
　風の音も、
　土の匂いも。
　すべて、ピタリと凍りついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───────”
Without warning, all sound ceases.
Every human presence,
the sound of the wind,
even the smell of earth.
Everything freezes in place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Suddenly, sounds vanish.
And the presence of other people,
the sound of the wind,
and the smell of the dirt.
All of it freezes.

entries.japanese:
絶対零度の月の下。
　壁のむこうで、何か、異質な音がしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beneath a moon at absolute zero.
An alien sound comes from beyond the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Under the frozen moon.
A bizarre noise sounds from the other side of the wall.

entries.japanese:
見えるはずがないし、
　音なんて聞こえてこない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no possible way to see it,
no sound could possibly reach me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No way I can see it,
I can't hear anything.

entries.maoEnglish: ──────Shhk, squelch
entries.mirrorMoon: ------A sickening sound

entries.japanese:
なのに、視えた。
　死と死が衝突する音を、この眼が確かに視た。
entries.maoEnglish:
And yet I see it.
These eyes unmistakably see the sound of death colliding with death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But I can see it.
My eyes definitely see the sound of death and death crashing.

entries.japanese:
「ぐ――――」
　視界が朱い。
　なんで―――見えないはずのものの、『死』を視てしまっているんだ、この目は。
「――――」
　メガネ。
メガネをかけないと、頭がどうにかなってしまう。
　喉元までせりあがった嘔吐感をこらえながら、震える手でメガネをかけなおした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――”
My vision floods crimson.
Why are these eyes seeing the death of something that should be invisible―――?
“――――”
My glasses. If I don’t put them on, I’ll lose my mind.
Holding back the vomit rising into my throat, I replace my glasses with a trembling hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah---"
My vision turns crimson.
Why---do my eyes see "death", something that shouldn't be able to be seen?
"----"
My glasses.
I have to put on my glasses or I'll go insane.
I hold back the rising gorge in my throat and use my shaking hand to put on my glasses.

entries.japanese:
音と光が戻る。
　気をしっかりと持ってあたりを見渡せば、繁華街に異状はない。
　雑多な喧騒と、まわりを歩いていく人々の姿。
　飾り付けられた店のショーウィンドウの明るさや、道路を走る自動車のエンジン音が溢れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Sound and light return.
When I force myself to look around, nothing is wrong with the entertainment district.
Pedestrians stream through the familiar din.
Decorated shop windows blaze with light, and car engines fill the road with noise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sound and light return.
Now that I'm calm, I glance around and see nothing out of the ordinary in the shopping district.
The bustling of many people passing by.
The brightness of a store's decorated show window and the sound of rushing car engines.

entries.japanese:
「はあ――はあ、はあ―――」
　呼吸がうまく出来ない。
　メガネをかけていても、どこか視界のすみにさっきの『死』が残っていそうで、気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――hah, hah―――”
I can’t breathe properly.
Even through the glasses, the thought that some remnant of that death may still lurk at the edge of my vision sickens me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm panting excessively.
I can hardly breathe.
Even though I put my glasses back on, I can still feel a lingering remnant of that "death" and it makes me sick.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドが路地裏から出てきた。
　そこにはさっきまでの殺気が微塵もなくて、どことなく上機嫌のように見える。
「アル――クェイド……？」
「あれ？
　あ、そっか。
志貴ったらまだ残ってたんだ」
「残ってたって、おまえな……」
　あんなモノ視せられて、そう簡単に帰れるもんか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid emerges from the alley.
Not a trace remains of the murderous presence she carried before; if anything, she looks rather pleased.
“Ar…cueid…?”
“Oh? Right, Shiki. You’re still here.”
“Still here…? You…”
After making me see something like that, how could she expect me simply to leave?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid comes out of the alley.
There isn't even a trace of her previous hostility and she seems to be in a good mood.
"Ar---cueid……?"
"Huh?
Oh, I see.
I guess you really did stay here."
"Stay here, you……"
I can't go home after seeing something like that.

entries.japanese:
「あれ、どうしたの志貴？
　貴方、ぜんぜん生気がないけど」
「―――気にしないでくれ、ただの貧血だ。
それよりアルクェイド。
いまの、どういうコトなんだ」
　アルクェイドの腕を掴んで睨みつける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong, Shiki? You look completely drained of life.”
“Never mind. It’s only anemia.
More importantly, Arcueid—what just happened?”
I seize her arm and glare at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh, what's wrong, Shiki?
You don't look very lively."
"---Don't worry about it, it's just my anemia.
More importantly Arcueid, what was that all about?"
I look at Arcueid as I grab her arms.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ―――志貴、いきなり何するのよ。
苦しいんなら家まで送っていってあげよっか？」
「いらない。
そんなのはいいから、今のヤツがなんなのか答えてくれ。
ここまで視せていて、いまさら関係ないだなんて言ったら殴るからな、アルクェイド……！」
　ぜいぜい、と呼吸が苦しいのも無視して、アルクェイドに詰め寄る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey—what are you doing, Shiki? If you feel that awful, should I take you home?”
“No. Forget that and tell me what that thing was. After showing me this much, if you try saying it’s none of my business, I’ll hit you, Arcueid…!”
Gasping for breath, I press closer to her anyway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wh---Shiki, what are you doing all of a sudden?
If you're hurt, I can take you to your house."
"No thanks, I'm fine, so tell me what was that person?
You've shown me this much, so if you say this has nothing to do with me, I'll punch you, Arcueid……!"
I approach her, ignoring the fact I can barely breathe.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　アルクェイドは一転して厳しい顔つきになる。
　けど、俺も引き下がるつもりはまったくない。
　しばらくの睨み合いの末、アルクェイドははあ、とため息をついた。
「もう。
わりとしつこいんだね、志貴って」
「……………悪かったな、しつこくて」
「ばかね、誉め言葉よ。
　――さて。
それじゃ場所を変えましょうか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Arcueid’s expression turns severe.
I have no intention of backing down.
After a long contest of glares, she sighs.
“Honestly, Shiki, you can be surprisingly persistent.”
“Sorry for being persistent.”
“Silly. That was a compliment.
――Now then… let’s go somewhere else.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Arcueid's expression instantly turns serious.
But, I have no intention of backing down.
After a brief stare-off, she gives a sigh.
"Fine, you're awfully persistent, Shiki."
"………………… Well forgive me for being so persistent."
"Idiot, that was a compliment.
--Then, shall we go somewhere else to talk?"

entries.japanese:
「場所を変えるって、なんで」
「志貴に話をしてあげるためでしょ。
こんな場所じゃなんだから、公園に戻ろっか。
志貴、歩ける？」
「あ……ば、ばかにするな。
こんな貧血、日常茶飯事だ」
　なんだあ、と残念そうに笑って、アルクェイドは歩き出す。
　立ち眩みをこらえながら、その後についていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why do we have to go anywhere?”
“So I can explain everything to you. This isn’t the place for it, so let’s go back to the park. Can you walk?”
“D-Don’t patronize me. Anemia like this is an everyday occurrence.”
“Oh, what a shame,” Arcueid says with a disappointed smile, then starts walking.
Fighting down my dizziness, I follow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Somewhere else?
Why?"
"You want me to tell you about it, right?
So not here, let's go back to the park.
Shiki, can you walk?"
"Oh…… D, don't make fun of me.
This anemia is just an everyday thing."
"Awwww," Arcueid says regretfully as she smiles and starts to walk.
I walk behind her and resist the urge to pass out.

entries.japanese:
「さて。
それじゃあ志貴のお望み通り、なんでも話してあげるわね。
聞きたい事があるんなら遠慮せずに聞いていいよ」
「それじゃ聞くけど、さっきのヤツはなんだったんだ。
おまえは吸血鬼って言ってたけど、アレがおまえの標的だったのか？」
「違うわ。
たしかにアレも処刑する対象だけど、あんな死者を塵に還すことが目的じゃない。
アレはわたしの『敵』の下僕だから始末しただけ。
　あんなのでもね、ほっとくと人を殺して力を蓄えられてしまうから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. As requested, I’ll tell you everything. Ask whatever you like.”
“Then what was that thing? You called it a vampire. Was it the enemy you’re hunting?”
“No. That thing was certainly marked for execution, but returning one of the Dead like that to dust is not my objective. I disposed of it because it was my enemy’s thrall.
Even a creature like that will kill people and accumulate power if left alone.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, as you wish, Shiki, let's talk about anything.
If you want to ask something, feel free."
"Then I'll ask, but just what was that guy earlier?
You said he was a vampire, was he what you were after?"
"No, he certainly is part of my target, but putting The Dead back into the grave isn't my goal.
I only got him because he was a minion of my 'enemy'.
If I left him alone, he would kill more people to increase his power."

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
その、もっと俺にもわかるように説明してくれないか。
俺にはさっきの、あのおかしなヤツが人間なのかどうかもわからないんだ」
「そっか。
志貴にはまともに吸血鬼について話した事がなかったものね。
ネロは吸血鬼の中でも特異すぎた吸血種だから、説明する必要がなかったんだけど」
「……？
　まともな吸血鬼って、なにさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid… could you explain this in a way I can understand? I don’t even know whether that bizarre thing was human.”
“Oh, right. I’ve never properly explained vampires to you. Nrvnqsr was such an aberrant member of a vampiric species that using him as an example would not have taught you much.”
“The usual kind of vampire? What’s that supposed to mean?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, could you explain it so I can understand?
I don't even know if that guy was even human or not."
"Oh.
I guess I never really did explain to you in detail about vampires.
Nrvnqsr was sort of an aberration amongst the vampire race, so I didn't really need to explain it at that time."
"……?
What is a normal vampire then?"

entries.japanese:
「だから、あなた達が想像しているような吸血鬼のことよ。
不老不死で、人間の血を吸って、吸った者も吸血鬼にして使役し、太陽の光の前に敗退するっていうごく当たり前の吸血鬼。
　わたしの『敵』はね、そういう旧いタイプの吸血鬼なの」
「……えっと、つまりその『敵』っていうのが街で通り魔殺人をおこしてるヤツの事だよな」
「……どうかしらね。
実際に人を殺して血を吸っているのは、さっき始末したような『死者』の仕事かもしれない。
　志貴、ネロが体内に山ほどの使い魔を装備していたのは覚えてるでしょ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The sort of vampire humans imagine. Ageless and immortal, drinking human blood, turning their victims into vampires and commanding them, then falling helpless before the sun—the perfectly conventional kind.
My enemy is one of those old-fashioned vampires.”
“So this ‘enemy’ is the one behind the killings in town, right?”
“Who knows? The actual killing and blood-drinking may be done by members of the Dead like the one I just destroyed.
You remember how Nrvnqsr carried hordes of familiars inside his body, don’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What I mean is what you all think of vampires.
Immortal, never aging, sucking human blood, turning that human into a vampire, being destroyed by sunlight, all of that.
My 'enemy' is that old type of vampire."
"…… Um, so you mean this 'enemy' of yours is the one behind all the recent serial killings?"
"…… I suppose.
But the killing of all those people by sucking their blood might be the work of "The Dead" like the one you saw earlier.
Shiki, you remember how Nrvnqsr's body was made of all those familiars, right?"

entries.japanese:
「―――ああ。
そう簡単に忘れられることじゃないよ、あれは」
「さっきの死者はそれと同じよ。
いい？
　吸血鬼に血を吸われ、その時に吸血鬼に血を送られると、その人間は死んでいるにもかかわらず現世に残ってしまうの。
これを死者といって、吸血鬼の一般的な使い魔とされるわ。
　あ、志貴にはゾンビっていったほうがわかりやすいかな。
アレは死体に寄生するハイチの白蛇のことだけど、動く死体っていったらゾンビが有名なんでしょ？」
―――うん、そう言われたほうがしゃっきりとイメージできる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course. That isn’t something I’m likely to forget.”
“The Dead you saw works on the same principle. When a vampire drinks a human’s blood and then feeds that person some of its own, the victim remains in this world despite being dead. We call such a creature one of the Dead, and it serves as a vampire’s most common familiar.
Perhaps ‘zombie’ would be easier for you. Strictly speaking, that refers to the Haitian white serpent that inhabits corpses, but zombies are your culture’s famous walking dead, aren’t they?”
―――Yes. Put that way, the image snaps instantly into focus.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yeah, that's not exactly something I can easily forget."
"The Dead are like that.
When humans have their blood sucked by a vampire, they can also receive some of the vampire's blood.
They die, but remain in this world as a servant of the vampire.
They are called The Dead and they are like the vampire's familiars.
Ah, maybe it's easier to understand if I use the word zombie.
It's closer to the voodoo belief in Haiti where the white serpent-god Damballah is invoked to control a dead body, but let's just say a dead body that moves is a zombie, okay?"
---Yeah, I can visualize it better that way.

entries.japanese:
「わかった、つまりさっきの男はとっくの昔に吸血鬼に殺されてて、そのあとでゾンビにされてこき使われてるっていうコトなんだな？」
　そうそう、と満足そうに頷くアルクェイド。
「―――わかんないな。
吸血鬼ってのはどうしてそんなコトするんだよ。
殺した人間を―――殺しちまった人間をさ、そのまま生きかえらせてアゴで使うなんて、趣味が悪すぎる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I understand. So that man was killed by a vampire long ago, turned into a zombie, and worked like a slave ever since?”
Arcueid nods, delighted that I finally understand.
“Why would vampires do something like that? Killing a person, dragging the corpse back to its feet, and ordering it around is grotesque.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I get it, so that man was killed by a vampire, who uses him as a zombie?"
"Yes, yes," Arcueid nods happily.
"---I'm still confused though.
Why would a vampire do that?
Killing people---not letting them die but controlling them, what bad taste."

entries.japanese:
「そうね。
吸血鬼が悪趣味なのは認めるわ。
でもそれは死徒に限った話よ。
初めから吸血種だったものはあまりそういうコトはしないもの」
「――――？」
　初めから、吸血鬼だったもの……？
「―――思い出した。
そういえば言ってたな、吸血鬼には二種類あるって。
初めから吸血鬼だったのと、人間から吸血鬼になった吸血鬼。
　……前に聞いた時、その話がひっかかってたんだ。
なんかおかしいなって。
そもそもさ、初めから吸血鬼じゃないって、それはどういうコトなんだ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll concede that vampires have appalling taste. But that particular habit belongs to Dead Apostles. Those who were vampiric from birth rarely do such things.”
“What…?”
Vampiric from birth?
“―――Oh. Now I remember. You said there were two kinds of vampire: those born that way, and humans who became vampires.
That bothered me the first time I heard it. It didn’t sound right. What does it mean for a vampire not to have been one from the beginning?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're right, those vampires do have bad taste.
But that's something only the Dead Apostles do.
Those that were always vampires from the very beginning do not do such things."
"----?"
Always vampires from the very beginning ……?
"---I remember.
You said there's two types of vampires, those who were vampires originally, and those who were humans.
…… When I heard that before, it kind of stuck in my head, I thought it was a little odd.
So what exactly do you mean by those who weren't originally vampires?"

entries.japanese:
「どういうコトもなにも、死徒はもともと人間だった者達よ。
魔術の果てに不老になったものと、真祖に血を吸われて下僕となったものとがいるわ。
　……志貴、貴方はさっき殺した人間を使役するのが悪趣味だと言ったけど、それでもまだマシなほうなのよ。
中にはもっと理解不能な遊びを考案する吸血鬼もいるんだから」
「―――遊びって―――なんだよ、それ。
おまえたちは遊びで人間を殺して、その死体を玩具にしてるっていうのか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Dead Apostles were human originally. Some attained agelessness at the furthest reaches of magecraft; others became thralls after a True Ancestor drank their blood.
You called it grotesque to command the people you kill, Shiki, but that is one of their milder diversions. Some vampires invent games far less comprehensible.”
“Games…? Are you saying you kill humans for amusement and make toys of their corpses?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Simple, I'm just saying that Dead Apostles used to be humans.
They either gained immortality through magic or became servants of the True Ancestors that sucked their blood.
…… Shiki, you said it was bad taste to use killed humans, but that's just the least of it.
There are other vampires who think up worse games."
"---A game---what is that?
You guys kill for fun, and use their dead bodies as toys……!?"

entries.japanese:
「……否定はしないわ。
　吸血鬼にとって『娯楽』は呼吸と同じことなのよ。
人間という連環種でありながら、不完全ながらも不老不死に近付いた彼らにとって最大の敵は“退屈”だったの。
　もともとわたし達と違って目的がないくせに“不老不死”になった彼らは、不老不死を手にいれた瞬間にあらゆる物欲がなくなってしまったのよ。
　目的が不老不死だったんだから、まあ仕方がないっていえば仕方がないんだろうけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I won’t deny it.
To vampires, amusement is as necessary as breathing. Though they came from humanity—a species bound to the cycle of life—they drew close, however imperfectly, to ageless immortality, and boredom became their greatest enemy.
Unlike us, they had no purpose beyond attaining immortality; the instant they achieved it, every material desire vanished.
Immortality had been their only goal, so perhaps that result was inevitable.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I won't deny that.
For vampires, "amusement" is the same as breathing.
For those who were once human but gain imperfect immortality, their greatest enemy is boredom.
They didn't have a reason to become immortal to start with, so once they gained immortality, they lost all kinds of greed.
Their goal was immortality itself, so I guess that's just the way things are."

entries.japanese:
「───退屈だから遊びたい、なんてふざけた事は言わないでくれよ。
だいたいさ、歳もとらないで死にもしないっていうんなら、もうそれで十分じゃないか。
他の楽しみなんていらないだろ」
「だから、それで十分になってしまったのよ、彼らは。
けれどそれでは存在の意味がない。
　自らを無価値と―――停止してしまったのだと認識した生命は、そこで存在している価値がなくなってしまう。
　不老不死というのはね、死の別名でもあるのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t give me that nonsense about playing because they’re bored. If they never age and never die, isn’t that enough? Why would they need any other pleasure?”
“Because it became enough. And that left their existence without meaning.
Once a living thing recognizes itself as valueless—as something that has stopped—there is no longer any reason for it to exist.
Ageless immortality is only another name for death.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----They're bored so they want to play?
Don't be ridiculous.
Isn't it enough that they won't age or die?
Do they really need anything else?"

"That's what I said, they got everything they wanted.
After that, there is no meaning to existence.
As soon as someone realizes they have no value---that their life is stopped, then their meaning of existence disappears too.
Immortality is also another word for death."

entries.japanese:
「だから彼らは段々と磨耗していって、自分たちから娯楽を作る事にした。
生きているんだって、自分たちはまだ楽しみがあるんだって自らを弁護するように。
―――それが、貴族の発端。
「彼らは人間の真似ごとをして、自分を城主にみたてて自らの勢力を広げるゲームを始めたわ。
　ありていに言ってしまえば死者の王国ね。
思いの外、それは彼らにとって刺激的だったみたい」
　……他人ごとのようにアルクェイドは言う。
　そういうアルクェイドだってその一人のはずなのに、どうも彼女にはそういった趣味はないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So they slowly wore away and began manufacturing amusements for themselves, as if to insist that they were still alive, that there were still pleasures open to them. That was the beginning of their aristocracy.”
“Imitating human society, they cast themselves as lords of castles and began a game of expanding their domains.
Put simply, they built kingdoms of the Dead. It proved more stimulating than they expected.”
Arcueid speaks as if none of this concerns her.
She ought to be one of them herself, yet she seems to have no taste for such games.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So they started to wear down and they started to create their own amusement, as if to tell themselves they could have fun as long as they lived.
---That's their beginning.

"They copy humans and see themselves in a game as lords of a castle expanding their territory.
I guess you could call it a country of The Dead.
It seems they got more enjoyment out of that than they expected."
…… She speaks as if she was talking of other people.
Arcueid should be one of those, but she certainly doesn't seem like she has that sort of hobby.

entries.japanese:
「さて、ここで話は前後するけど、死徒というものは元は人間なの。
　魔術を究めて、その果てに吸血鬼となった稀なケースもあるけど、大部分は血を吸われた人間が死徒になる。
　死徒はたしかに不老不死だけれど、彼らは永久機関じゃないわ。
たえず他者から命を吸い上げないと不老不死ではいられない。
　不完全な不老不死だと言ったでしょ？
　死徒は結局、人間という捕食対象がいないと“不老不死”ではいられない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, this takes us backward, but Dead Apostles began as humans.
A rare few became vampires after mastering magecraft, but most are victims whose blood was drunk.
They are indeed ageless and immortal, but they are not perpetual motion machines. They must continually drain life from others to preserve that immortality.
I told you it was imperfect. Without humans to prey upon, a Dead Apostle cannot remain immortal.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, we'll change the topic, but the Dead Apostles were originally human.
There are a few cases where they became vampires through their own magical research, but the majority of them were humans who had their blood sucked.
They are immortal, but they can't last forever.
They can only be immortal if they drink the blood of others.
Didn't I say their immortality was imperfect?
If they can't feed on humans then their immortality is gone."

entries.japanese:
「けど、無闇に人間を捕食していると“吸血鬼”という自分の存在が明るみになってしまう。
そうでなくても死徒は活動しているだけで場を歪ませてしまうから、いずれシエルのような教会の代行者を呼び寄せてしまう」
「……えっと、それはつまり、吸血鬼は自分の好きなように活動できないっていうコト？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But feeding indiscriminately exposes the vampire’s existence. Even without that, a Dead Apostle distorts its surroundings merely by acting, and sooner or later that draws an executor of the Church—someone like Ciel.”
“So vampires can’t simply do whatever they please?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, if they openly fed on humans, then the existence of "vampires" would be revealed.
Even if they don't, just by being there, they distort the world around them.
That would attract the attention of agents of The Church, like Ciel."
"…… Um, so you mean that vampires can't do what they want?"

entries.japanese:
「そうね。
教会との契約を破って好き勝手に活動すれば、即座に発見されて消滅させられてしまう。
　だから死徒の大部分は、自分が眠ったままでも自分に人間の血肉を注ぎ込んでくれる分身を作り出す。
　血を吸って、自分の血を死体に送りこんで、自分の操り下僕として活動させる生者の擬態。
これをわたしたちは単純に“死者”って呼ぶのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. If they break their pact with the Church and act as they please, they’re discovered and destroyed at once.
Most Dead Apostles therefore create extensions of themselves—creatures that can continue supplying them with human blood and flesh while they sleep.
They drain a victim, inject their own blood into the corpse, then set that counterfeit of the living to work as an obedient thrall. We simply call those creatures the Dead.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, if they break their agreement with The Church and move about freely, they would be immediately discovered and annihilated.
So the majority of the Dead Apostles make subordinates that can bring them blood as they sleep.
Sucking blood and giving the dead body some blood of their own, they create their minions who do their work for them.
We simply call those "The Dead."

entries.japanese:
「……ふうん……それじゃあさっきアルクェイドが、その、始末した死者っていうのは死徒っていうヤツの兵士みたいなものなんだ」
「兵士っていうよりは人形ね。
本来なら血を吸われた人間が自力で吸血種として蘇生する過程を無視して、完全に死徒の分身として操っているんだから。
　死者は親である死徒と繋がっているわ。
　死者だって自らが生存するためのエネルギーを必要とするから人間を襲い、肉をすする。
けど、その半分以上は親元である死徒に流れていくのよ。
　ようするに女王蜂を養う働き蜂みたいなものね。
死者を操る死徒は、自分の棺の中で眠っているだけで力を蓄えてしまえるのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see… So the Dead you disposed of was something like a soldier serving a Dead Apostle.”
“More like a puppet. Ordinarily, a person drained of blood must pass through the process of reviving as a vampiric being under their own power. The Dead bypass that process and are controlled entirely as extensions of their parent Dead Apostle.
Each remains connected to its parent. It attacks humans and devours flesh for the energy it needs to survive, but more than half of what it takes flows back to the Dead Apostle.
Think of worker bees feeding a queen. The master can gather strength without doing anything but sleeping in its coffin.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm…… So what you killed before was kind of like a soldier for the Dead Apostles?"
"Not so much a soldier as a puppet.
The Dead Apostles control the dead bodies by skipping the process of becoming a vampire.
The Dead are completely connected to their parent vampire.
In order for them to survive, they attack others to eat their flesh, but more than half of that energy goes to their master.
Like a queen bee nourished by the worker bees, the Dead Apostles can use The Dead to increase their power while they sleep."

entries.japanese:
「……わたしの『敵』が簡単には見つからないのは、『敵』が死者を多く使っているから。
　あいつが自分の手を汚すのは一回だけ。
あとは死者にした人間を操って、自分は眠っているだけで領地を広げていく。
―――通り魔殺人による遺体が何体も発見されてるって言うけど、あんなのは偽造に失敗しただけのものよ。
　実際、この街の犠牲者は百人を超えているわ。
ひっそりと、人知れずいなくなってしまっている人達の一部分が、あなたたちが騒いでいる犠牲者っていうことね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My enemy is difficult to find because it employs so many of the Dead.
It soils its own hands only once. After that, it controls the human it has turned and expands its territory while it sleeps.
―――You’ve heard that several bodies from the serial killings have been discovered, but those are merely bodies from botched attempts at concealment.
In truth, this town has suffered more than a hundred victims. The handful of bodies causing such a commotion are only a fraction of all the people who have vanished quietly, without anyone knowing why.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… My 'enemy' can't be found easily because he's using a lot of The Dead.
He only dirties his hands once.
After that, he simply controls The Dead while he sleeps and expands his territory.
---They say many bodies are found in the recent supposed serial killings, but those are actually just failures.
To tell the truth, there are over a hundred victims in this city.
But only a small amount, the ones discovered, are the victims in the news."

entries.japanese:
「な――――」
　百人単位―――？
　その、吸血鬼に血を吸われて殺された人間がそんなにいるっていうのか？
　しかも、血を吸われた人間も同じように血を吸う化け物になって、さっきみたいに何気なく街を徘徊してるなんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh—”
More than a hundred?
That many people have been drained and killed by a vampire?
And those victims become blood-drinking monsters themselves, strolling casually through town like that man did?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
Over a hundred---?
There are that many that had their blood sucked?
And all those people suck the blood of others to make them into monsters like themselves, like that wandering, lifeless thing earlier---

entries.japanese:
「………ふざけ、てる」
　三日前。
　ホテルに泊まっていた人々が、それこそ何の意味もなく殺され尽くしたのを、思い出す。
　俺はあのホテルにいたけれど、その場面を見ていない。
だから言葉の上でしか想像できず、ソレがどんなに憎むべき暴力であったかを肌で感じ取れなかった。
　今だってそれは同じだ。
　人間の血を吸う吸血鬼がいて、そいつが少しずつ自分の領地を広げているなんて聞いても、実感はわかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s sick.”
Three days ago.
I remember the hotel, where every guest had been slaughtered for no reason at all.
I was there, but I never saw the massacre itself. I could imagine it only through words, never feel for myself how hateful that violence had been.
Even now, it is the same.
Hearing that a vampire drinks human blood and is slowly expanding its territory through the city doesn’t feel real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… That's ridiculous."
Three days ago.
I remember how all those people in the hotel were killed for no reason.
I was there but I didn't see it, so I can only visualize and can't really tell what kind of violence it was.
It's still the same.
I can't fathom the existence of vampires that suck human blood, just to increase their own territory.

entries.japanese:
―――ただ。
　何の理由も、どんな前触れもなく、例えば自分のもっとも身近な人間がそんなふうに殺されたら、俺はどうなってしまうだろうか。
　想像したくもないのに、ほんのわずかだけ。
　血を吸われて、それこそゴミのようにうち捨てられている秋葉の姿を想像する。
「くっ――――」
　あたまにくるのは―――そんな最悪な出来事がもう今にだって起きえるのだというこの街の状況と、それに気がつきもしなかった自分自身の平和さだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――But.
What would become of me if someone closest to me were murdered that way, without reason or warning?
I don’t want to imagine it, yet for a moment.
I picture Akiha drained of blood and discarded like garbage.
“Ghh――――”
What enrages me is―――that such a horror could happen at any moment in this city, and the complacency that kept me from noticing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Just,
without reason, without even recognition, if someone close to me died like that, how would I act?
I don't want to imagine it, but for a brief instant…
I imagine Akiha being drained of blood and discarded like trash.
"K----"
What makes me mad---is that this worst case scenario could happen at any minute in this town and I didn't even have a clue about it before.

entries.japanese:
「やっぱり怒ったわね、志貴。
　……わたしがあんまり話したくなかったのは、これは捕食される側――あなたたちにとっては一切の言い訳も許さない『悪』そのものだからよ。
　志貴にとっては気持ちのいい話じゃなかったでしょう？」
「――――まあ、な。
そんな話を聞いたら、これからどうしていいのかわからなくなる」
　……そう。
　明日にでも親しい人が犠牲者になるかもしれない街で、今までどおり平和に暮らしていけるハズがない。
　知ってしまったのなら。
　俺は、ネロの時みたいに戦わなくちゃいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I knew you would be angry, Shiki.
I didn’t want to tell you because, to the prey—to humans—this is evil itself, beyond any possible excuse.
It wasn’t pleasant to hear, was it?”
“Yeah. Hearing all this makes it impossible to know what I should do next.”
That’s right.
I can’t go on living peacefully as before in a town where someone dear to me may become tomorrow’s victim.
Now that I know.
I have to fight, just as I did against Nrvnqsr.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I knew you would be angry, Shiki.
…… I didn't want to talk about it, because for the prey---for you guys, this is an inexcusable evil.
This is not something you want to hear, is it?"
"…… That's right.
After hearing this, I don't know what to do now."
…… That's right.
There's no way I can live in peace like I did until now, knowing that someone I know may become a victim tomorrow.
Since I found out about it,
I have to fight this vampire just like I did Nrvnqsr.

entries.japanese:
「……………くっ」
　あんな。
　気がふれる直前まで追いこまれるような戦いを、まだしなくちゃいけないって、いうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…”
Another battle like that.
Do I truly have to face one that drives me to the very brink of madness?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Da--"
Such a fight.
Do I have to fight again like that when it almost makes me go insane?

entries.japanese:
「ほら、志貴ったらまたそんな顔しちゃって」
　いいよ、志貴は安心して。
吸血鬼たちの天敵はこの国にはいないみたいだけど、今はわたしがちゃんといるんだから。
　言ったでしょ、わたしの目的は吸血鬼を退治するこことだって」
　さっきまでの淡々とした雰囲気はどこにいったのか、アルクェイドは一変して明るくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There you go, making that face again.
It’s all right, Shiki. Don’t worry. The vampires’ natural enemies don’t seem to exist in this country, but I’m here now.
I told you, didn’t I? My purpose is to destroy vampires.”
All her cool detachment vanishes, and Arcueid is suddenly bright again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Shiki, you're making that face again.
You can relax.
Even though the avowed enemies of the vampires do not have a presence in this country, I'm still here.
Didn't I say earlier my purpose was to execute vampires?"
I don't know where that heavy atmosphere went because Arcueid instantly becomes cheerful.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それは聞いてる。
……けど、アルクェイドだって吸血鬼なんだろ。
どうしてそんな、人間の味方みたいなことをしてるんだ」
「わたし、別に人間の味方をしてるわけじゃないよ。
ただ、それ以外にやる事がないからやってるだけだもの」
「――――？」
　それ以外にやる事がないって、ますますアルクェイドがわからない。
「ま、そんなコトをやっているから死徒たちに狙われているんだけど、その追っ手であるネロも志貴が倒してくれたでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I heard you. But you’re a vampire too, aren’t you? Why do you act as though you’re on humanity’s side?”
“I’m not. I simply have nothing else to do.”
“What…?”
That answer makes her more incomprehensible than ever.
“It’s because I do this that the Dead Apostles hunt me. But you already defeated Nrvnqsr, the one they sent after me, remember?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I remember.
…… But, you're a vampire too, right?
Why do you side with us humans?"
"I'm not really siding with you humans, but I'm doing it because I don't have anything else to do."
"----?"
She doesn't have anything else to do?
I still don't understand her.
"Well, doing that does bring the Dead Apostles after me, but you beat Nrvnqsr who was pursuing me, didn't you Shiki?"

entries.japanese:
「だから、あとは当初の予定どおりこの街に潜んでいる『敵』を見つけて、なんとか始末してみせるわ。
　志貴は今までどおり普通の生活に戻って、わたしたちなんかに関わらなくていいんだよ」
　何が嬉しいのか、アルクェイドはまっすぐな笑顔を向けて、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So all that remains is to follow my original plan: find the enemy hiding in this town and destroy it somehow.
You can return to your ordinary life, Shiki. You don’t need to involve yourself with creatures like us anymore.”
For some reason, she says it with a perfectly open smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So now I can go back to the original plan and defeat my 'enemy'.
You can go back to living your normal life now, and you don't have to associate with me anymore."
She smiles as if she is happy about something.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
「志貴？
　なによ、また難しい顔しちゃって」
「そりゃあ難しい顔ぐらいする。
だって、これは俺たちの住んでる街の問題なんだから」
「だから気にしなくていいんだって。
二三日じゅうになんとかするから、もうこれ以上は犠牲者は出させないわ」
　ああ、正直こっちだって関わり合いになんかなりたくない。
―――でも、その台詞は。
　この街を守るようなその台詞は、アルクェイドではなくこの街に住んでいる俺が、言わなくちゃいけないコトじゃないんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“Shiki? Why the serious face again?”
“Because this is serious. It’s happening in the town where we live.”
“That’s why I said you don’t need to worry. I’ll settle it within two or three days. I won’t allow any more victims.”
Honestly, I want nothing to do with this.
―――But those words—words about protecting this town—shouldn’t they be spoken by someone who lives here, rather than by Arcueid?
Shouldn’t they be mine?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
"Shiki?
Why are you making that troubled face again?"
"Because I'm troubled.
This is something that involves the city I live in."
"I said you shouldn't worry.
In two or three days it'll all be over, so there won't be any more victims."
Yeah, honestly, I don't want to be involved.
---But, saying that line…
Shouldn't I, the one actually living in this city, say that line instead of Arcueid?

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
その、一つ聞くけど。
おまえの言ってる『敵』っていうのは強いのか？」
「さっきの死者よりは格段に優れているでしょうね。
今回はまだ出会っていないからわからないけど、八年間も潜んでいたんだから第五階級ぐらいにはなってるんじゃないかな」
「……第五階級って、よくわからないけど。
もしかしてネロより強いのか、そいつ」
「まさか。
ネロは別格よ。
あいつは私がまともな時でも倒しきれない最高純度の吸血種よ。
それに比べれば、わたしの敵はいくぶん格が落ちるわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Let me ask one thing. Is this enemy of yours strong?”
“Far stronger than the Dead you saw. I haven’t encountered it yet this time, so I can’t be certain, but after hiding for eight years, it has probably reached the fifth rank.”
“I don’t know what the fifth rank means. Is it stronger than Nrvnqsr?”
“Not a chance. Nrvnqsr was exceptional. He was a vampiric being of the highest purity whom I could not reliably defeat even at full strength. My enemy is several grades beneath him.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Um, can I ask a question?
This 'enemy' you speak of, is he strong?"
"Well, he should be many times superior to The Dead earlier.
I haven't met him this time, but he has been latent for eight years so maybe he's a Class Five by now."
"…… Class Five?
I don't get it, but does that mean he's stronger than Nrvnqsr?"
"Not a chance.
Nrvnqsr was special.
He was a pure, supreme vampire that would be difficult to defeat even with my full power.
Compared to him, this enemy is pretty weak."

entries.japanese:
「――――そうか。
それなら―――おまえがやられるっていう事、ないよな」
　安堵のためか、はあ、と大きく息をはいた。
「さあ、どうでしょうね。
ちょっと前までのわたしなら問題なかったと思うけど、今のわたしは病み上がりだもの。
アイツのほうが力をつけている可能性は高いわ」
「……病み上がりって、風邪でもひいたのかアルクェイド」
「うん、どうにも志貴に殺された後遺症がぬけきらなくて。
このぶんじゃあと何日かはダメみたい」
「――――あ」
　そうか――アルクェイドが弱っているのは、他の誰でもなく、この俺の責任だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then… there’s no chance it could kill you.”
Relief escapes me in a long breath.
“Who knows? A short while ago, I would have had no trouble. But I’m still recovering, and there’s a good chance my enemy has grown stronger.”
“Recovering—did you catch a cold or something?”
“Yeah—I just can’t seem to shake off the effects of being killed by you. At this rate, I’ll be in poor condition for several more days.”
“Ah…”
Of course—Arcueid’s weakness is no one’s fault but mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Oh.
Then---there's no way you'll be defeated."
I breathe out in relief.
"Hm, who knows?
A few days earlier and he wouldn't be a problem, but now I'm just recovering.
The possibility that he has more power is actually high."
"…… Recovering?
Are you sick or something, Arcueid?"
"Yeah, I still have the effects from when you killed me and I don't think I'll be fine for at least a few more days."
"----Ah."
That's right--the reason why Arcueid is weak… it isn't anyone's fault but mine.

entries.japanese:
「けど大丈夫よ。
差し違えても倒してみせる。
必ず吸血鬼は始末するから、志貴がこの街のことを心配することはないわ」
「……ばか。
俺が心配してるのはおまえのことだ」
「え？
　なんで志貴がわたしの心配をするの？」
　心から不思議そうに、アルクェイドは目を白黒させている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But don’t worry. Even if it costs my life, I’ll destroy it. I promise I’ll eliminate the vampire, so you needn’t fear for this town.”
“Idiot. You’re the one I’m worried about.”
“What? Why would you worry about me?”
Utterly bewildered, Arcueid blinks at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But it's okay.
I'll defeat him for sure even if it kills me, so you don't need to worry about this city."
"…… Idiot, the one I'm worried about is you."
"Eh?
Why are you worried about me, Shiki?"
Her eyes display true confusion.

entries.japanese:
……だって、そりゃあ心配する。
　相手がネロより弱いって聞いて安堵したのは、それならアルクェイドがやられるコトがないって思ったからだ。
　こいつが。
　アルクェイドが傷つくところなんて、俺は想像ができないし、したくもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Why wouldn’t I worry?
I felt relieved when I heard the enemy was weaker than Nrvnqsr because I thought that meant Arcueid would be safe.
This girl.
I can’t imagine Arcueid being hurt, and I don’t want to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, of course I'm worried.
I was relieved to hear that this enemy was weaker than Nrvnqsr, because I thought there would be no chance of Arcueid being defeated.
Arcueid…
I don't even want to imagine Arcueid getting hurt.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　たしかに不思議だ。
　どうしてこう―――俺は、こいつのことが放っておけないんだろう。
　たしかに俺はこいつを殺してしまった責任がある。
俺のせいで彼女が弱っているっていう負い目もある。
　けど、そんなコトがなくったって、俺はアルクェイドを放っておけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
It really is strange.
Why can’t I leave her alone?
Certainly I bear responsibility for killing her. I also feel guilty because she remains weak on my account.
But even without any of that, I still wouldn’t be able to abandon Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
It really is weird.
Why---why can I not leave her alone?
Certainly I have the responsibility to bear for killing her.
I also feel guilty that she is weak right now because of that.
But, even if that wasn't the case, I still couldn't leave her alone.

entries.japanese:
―――さっきも思ったけど。
　やっぱり、こういうのは理屈じゃないのかもしれない。
　……自分が死ぬかもしれないっていう恐れより。
　今は、アルクェイドの力になってやりたいっていう気持ちのが強いんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I thought this before.
Perhaps feelings like these simply have no logic.
More than the fear that I may die.
Right now, my desire to help Arcueid is stronger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I thought about it before too, but……
as expected, this might have nothing to do with logic.
…… More than the fear that I may even die…

The emotion that I want to help Arcueid is much stronger.

entries.japanese:
「さっきの話だけどな、アルクェイド」
「さっきの話って、なに？」
「だからさ。
俺が先輩とおまえ、どっちの味方かって話」
「待て、最後までちゃんと聞いてくれ。
　あのさ、その―――おまえはたしかに常識外れで我がままで手におえないヤツだ」
　アルクェイドはますますま不機嫌そうに目を細める。
　それでもかまわず、もう勢いにまかせて、自分の今の気持ちを口にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“About what we were discussing earlier, Arcueid.”
“What part?”
“That’s what I mean. Whether I was on your side or Ciel’s.”
“Wait—hear me out before you react.
You have no common sense; you’re hopelessly selfish and almost impossible to manage.”
Arcueid narrows her eyes, looking more displeased by the second.
I press on anyway, surrendering to momentum and saying exactly what I feel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About what we talked about before, Arcueid."
"About what?"
"You know, about whether I was Senpai's or your ally."
"Wait, please hear me out.
You know, um---you certainly don't have any common sense, you're selfish, and you're hard to handle."
Arcueid looks at me with a sour expression.
Ignoring it, I let my true feelings out.

entries.japanese:
「……でもまあ、おまえと一緒にいると退屈はしないんだ。
俺は、アルクェイドのことが気に入ってる。
　だから、その敵とやらをやっつけるのを見届けさせてくれないか。
……その、ようするに俺は先輩じゃなくて、おまえの味方っていうことなんだけど……」
　ちらり、とアルクェイドの顔を盗み見る。
「―――――――ほんと？」
　アルクェイドはびっくりしたリスみたいな仕草で、遠慮がちに俺の目を見つめ返してきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I’m never bored when I’m with you. I like you, Arcueid.
So let me stay until you’ve defeated this enemy. What I’m trying to say is that I’m on your side, not Ciel’s…”
I steal a glance at Arcueid’s face.
“Do you… mean it?”
Like a startled squirrel, Arcueid peers timidly back into my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, well, it really isn't boring when I'm with you.
I like you.
So, can I see it out until you defeat this enemy …… What I mean to say is that, I won't be Senpai's ally, but yours…"
I steal a glance at Arcueid's face.
"------Really?"
Looking very surprised, she hesitantly returns my gaze.

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、そういうこと。
自分でもどうかしてるって思ってるんだけど、乗りかかった船だしさ。
自分の住んでいる街の問題を見過ごす事もできないだろ」
「それじゃあ、もしかして―――」
「ああ。
おまえがまだ弱ってて、俺の力を必要だっていうんなら協力するよ。
　……その、足手まといになるかもしれないけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I know I must be out of my mind, but I’m already involved. And I can’t ignore a threat to my own town.”
“Then—does that mean…?”
“Yes. If you’re still weakened and need my power, I’ll help.
Though I may only get in your way.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, yeah.
Even I think there's something wrong with me, but I'm already a part of this.
And, I can't just overlook the problems going on in the city I live in."
"So, you mean---"
"Yeah.
If you're still weak, and if you say you need my power, I'll work with you.
…… Um, I might be just a burden, but…"

entries.japanese:
「うん―――！
　志貴が手を貸してくれるなら、出来ないコトなんて何もないよ―――！」
