His exceptional point is that he took this soul, which is incalculable and something that disperses as soon as it leaves the envelope of the body, and processed it as something that could be transmitted."

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　先輩の話は、なにか実感が沸かない。
　いや、話としては理解できてる。
　ようするにその蛇っていうヤツは、死んだらまたどこかの赤ん坊として生まれてきて、成人したら蛇っていう吸血鬼になるんだろうけど……。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Her explanation did not feel real.
No, I understood the idea well enough.
The Serpent died, was born again as some baby, and became the vampire called the Serpent when that child grew up, but…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Her words don't seem quite real.
I do understand what she is saying.
This serpent guy is reborn as a baby when he dies and this baby turns into this Serpent vampire when it becomes an adult, but……

entries.japanese:
「……先輩の話を鵜呑みにするとさ、そいつって本当に死なないじゃないか。
そりゃあ不死身ってワケじゃないけど、それ以上に質が悪いよ。
　殺しても違う人間として生まれてくるなんて、それじゃ永遠に生き続けてるようなものじゃないか」
「ええ、その通りです。
　『蛇』が死徒として吸血種に成ったのは、今から八百年ほど前です。
　それから現代まで、『蛇』が転生した回数は十七回。
そのことごとくを、アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドは殺害しています」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…If I accept what you’re saying, then he really never dies. He may not be invulnerable, but this is worse.
If killing him only makes him return as someone else, then he might as well live forever.”
“Precisely.
The ‘Serpent’ became a Dead Apostle roughly eight hundred years ago.
Since then, he has reincarnated seventeen times. Arcueid Brunestud has killed every single incarnation.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… If I believe your story, it means that he will never die.
It's not immortality, but it's worse than that.
Being killed and reborn as someone else, that's like living forever."
"Yes, exactly.
It was eight hundred years ago when 'The Serpent' first became a Dead Apostle.
Since then, 'The Serpent' has been reborn seventeen times.
Every time, Arcueid Brunestud has killed him."

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイドが……？」
「はい。
彼女にとって『蛇』は特別な吸血鬼なんです。
……わたしにとっても『蛇』は特別な吸血鬼なんですけど」
「……でもさ、そいつは結局死んでもまた生まれてくるんだろ？
　なら―――何回殺したところで意味なんかないじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid has…?”
“Yes. The ‘Serpent’ is a special vampire to her. …He is special to me as well.”
“…But he just comes back whenever he dies, right? Then killing him over and over doesn’t accomplish anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid did……?"
"Yes.
To her, 'The Serpent' is a special vampire.
…… Well, 'The Serpent' has a special meaning to me as well."
"…… But, even if he dies he will just be reborn, right?
So---killing him over and over is pointless, isn't it?"

entries.japanese:
「――――そうですね。
　『蛇』は彼女に殺され、そのたびに転生し、また彼女に殺される。
　そんな繰り返しをもうずっとしてきたんです。
　……もしアルクェイドに『肉体』ではなく、その『意味』を消滅させられるような力があればこんなコトにはなっていないんでしょうけど」
　先輩はかすかにうつむいて、ぎり、と歯を噛んだようだった。
　……理由はわからないけど。
　アルクェイドと同じように、先輩もその『蛇』とやらになんらかの恨みをもっているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it does not.
She kills the ‘Serpent’; he reincarnates; she kills him again.
They have repeated that cycle for centuries.
…If Arcueid possessed the power to erase not his body but the very meaning of his existence, none of this would have happened.”
She lowered her head slightly. I thought I heard her teeth grind.
…I did not know why, but like Arcueid,
she seemed to bear some personal hatred for this ‘Serpent.’
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Yes.
He is killed by her, reincarnates, and is killed by her again.
That cycle has repeated itself over and over.
…… If Arcueid had the power to kill not the 'body' but the 'meaning', then this probably would not be happening."
Senpai looks down a little and she seems to be gritting her teeth.
…… I don't know why.
However, it seems that Senpai also has some grudge against the "enemy" like Arcueid does.

entries.japanese:
「……殺してもまた生まれてくる吸血鬼……」
　それがアルクェイドと先輩の『敵』っていうことか。
「……先輩。
その蛇っていうのはどんなヤツなんだ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“A vampire that is born again every time he is killed.”
So that was the enemy shared by Arcueid and Ciel.
“Ciel. What sort of person is this Serpent?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… A vampire that is reborn every time it is killed……"
That's Arcueid's and Senpai's "enemy".
"…… Senpai.
This Serpent guy, what kind of a guy is he?"

entries.japanese:
「いちおう男性ですが、転生先の肉体によって性別は変化します。
　この死徒の厄介なところは、その発見が極めて困難という共通点があるんです。
　なにしろちゃんとした赤子として生まれて、両親がいるんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“He is fundamentally male, though the sex of each incarnation depends upon the body he takes.
What makes this Dead Apostle so troublesome is that every incarnation is almost impossible to find.
He is born as a perfectly ordinary baby, with parents of his own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"He was originally a man, but that can change depending on the body he reincarnates into.
The troublesome part of this Dead Apostle is that they are all hard to find.

Because he is properly born as a human baby, and has parents.

entries.japanese:
「『蛇』が吸血鬼として肉体と意識を変貌させるのは、『蛇』が満足に活動できる歳になります。
　ですからそれまでは吸血鬼としての片鱗をまったく見せません。
そのくせ一度『蛇』として目覚めたら、今まで培った人間関係を利用して完全に社会に融け込むんです。
　教会が『蛇』に気がついた時には、たいていが一つの街がそのまま死都になった後だったと聞いています」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The ‘Serpent’s’ body and mind do not transform into those of a vampire until he reaches an age at which he can act freely.
Before that, he displays no trace of vampirism at all. Once he awakens, however, he exploits every human relationship his host has built and disappears seamlessly into society.
I am told that by the time the Church discovered him, an entire city had usually already become a city of the dead.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The Serpent transforms into a vampire only when he reaches the age where he can do everything at a satisfactory level.

Until then, that human shows no hint of being a vampire.
But once 'The Serpent' awakens, he uses the relationships he gained until that time to blend perfectly into society.
I heard that The Church detects the 'Serpent's' presence usually after a whole town is turned into The Dead."

entries.japanese:
……そっか。
　例えば俺がその蛇っていうヤツに転生させられていたとするんなら、蛇になっても遠野志貴のふりをして生活する。
　よほどのヘマさえしなければ、周囲に気づかれることなく人間の血を吸い続けられるだろう。
――――それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
…I see.
Suppose I had been chosen as the Serpent’s next incarnation. Even after awakening, I would continue living under the guise of Shiki Tohno.
Unless I made a spectacular mistake, I could go on drinking human blood without anyone around me noticing.
――――That was…
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I see.
For example, if this serpent guy were reincarnated in me, he would live as Tohno Shiki even after he becomes the serpent.
Unless he makes a big mistake, he would be free to suck blood without people realizing it.
----That is.

entries.japanese:
「……恐いね。
あ、もちろん周囲の人たちも危ないけどさ。
　そいつに転生させられた人間は、成人したら消えてなくなるってコトなんだろ？
　自分がそんな怪物だって気づかないまま、ある日突然『蛇』ってヤツにとってかわられるっていうんなら、それは恐いよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s terrifying. Of course, the people around him are in danger too.
The person chosen as his next incarnation disappears when they grow up, don’t they?
The thought of being suddenly replaced by the ‘Serpent’ one day without ever knowing there was a monster inside you—that’s terrifying.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Scary.
Of course those around him are in danger too.
But that human whom he reincarnated into, he would just disappear after maturing, right?
One moment that person is living normally and the next moment he suddenly turns into 'The Serpent'.
That's very frightening."

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
けど、一つの肉体に二つの人格が共存しているっていうワケじゃなくて、人間としての赤子も、やっぱり『蛇』なんです。
　ただ生まれた環境によって、それがいい人格だったり悪い人格だったりするだけ。
　……それも大本である『蛇』が覚醒した時点でなくなってしまいます。
　ようするにですね、『蛇』は次の肉体に生まれ変わって、その肉体が知性を持つに至った時点で前世の自分の人格を取り戻し、吸血鬼としての自分に成ってしまうんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, but this is not a case of two personalities sharing one body. Even as a human infant, the child is still the ‘Serpent.’
Its upbringing merely produces a kind personality in one life and a cruel one in another.
Even that personality disappears when the original ‘Serpent’ awakens.
He is reborn into a new body; once that body develops intelligence, he recovers the personality of his former life and becomes himself as a vampire.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, but it isn't like two people sharing one body.
The human baby is still 'The Serpent'.
Depending on its environment, it's either a good or a bad person.
…… But even that disappears the instant 'The Serpent' awakens.
To sum it up, once 'The Serpent' dies, he is reborn into the next body, and once that body gains intelligence, it gains the previous life's self and becomes a vampire."

entries.japanese:
「……おかしいよ、それ。
　いくら転生したっていっても、その赤ん坊はちゃんとした人間じゃないか。
なら、いくら前世の人格とやらが目覚めても、体は吸血鬼にはならないでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…That doesn’t make sense.
Reincarnation or not, the baby is a real human being. Even if some past-life personality awakens, why would its body turn into a vampire?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's, strange.
Even if he did reincarnate, that baby is still human.
So, even if it does gain the self of a previous life, the body shouldn't turn into a vampire, right?"

entries.japanese:
「転生するのは人格ではなく魂なんです。
　ですから人格は毎回、『蛇』がどんな家庭で、どんなふうに育ったかで変化します。
けれど大本の魂に変化はありません。
　一度真祖に血を吸われた人間は、その肉体のみならず魂まで汚染されます。
肉体を変貌させるのは魂なんです。
　『蛇』は魂という情報すべてを引き継がせるわけですから、とりあえず『蛇』が目覚めた時点で肉体も吸血鬼のそれになるんですけど――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because what reincarnates is not the personality, but the soul.
His personality changes with every family and every upbringing, but the underlying soul does not.
When a True Ancestor drinks a human’s blood, the corruption reaches not only the body but the soul.
The soul is what transforms the flesh. Since the ‘Serpent’ passes on the complete information of his soul, his body becomes vampiric the moment he awakens. However—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Reincarnation isn't the transmitting of personality, it is the transmission of a soul.
So the personality differs every time depending on their families and upbringings.
But the soul itself does not change.
Once bitten by a True Ancestor, not only is the body forever soiled, but the soul as well.
What changes the body is the soul.
'The Serpent' transmits all his information called his soul, so when 'The Serpent' awakens, the body becomes one of a vampire but----"

entries.japanese:
「ですけど、なに」
「遠野くんの言うとおり、それでは弱いんです。
　ですから『蛇』次の転生先を生きているうちに決定します。
　転生先に選ばれる家柄は二つの条件があって、一つは富豪であること。
　社会的地位も高く、財産も豊かな家の子供として生まれれば、そのあとに街すべてを吸血鬼化させるのに便利ですから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“However what?”
“As you said, that alone leaves him weak.
So while alive, the ‘Serpent’ chooses his next host.
A family must meet two conditions. First, it must be wealthy.
Being born to a household with status and abundant resources makes it much easier to turn the entire city into vampires afterward.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, but…"

"As you said, just that is too weak.
So he selects his next host while he is alive.
The family he is born into must meet two conditions, the first being one of wealth.
Being born into a family of high social standing, property and money makes it easier to make the whole town into vampires later on.

entries.japanese:
「それともう一つ、これが大事なんですけど、わたしたちのような普通の人間の中にも、特別な力を持つ人たちがいるんです。
　魔術と呼ばれる、学べば修得できるという神秘ではなく、生まれついてその肉体が持ってしまう特異能力。
　―――一般に超能力者とか鬼子と差別される人たちです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The second condition is more important. Among ordinary human beings like us, some are born with special powers.
Not magecraft, which can be studied and learned, but innate abilities possessed by the body from birth.
―――Such people are commonly singled out as psychics—or reviled as demon children.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And there is another, this is the important one, but amongst normal people like us, there are also people that carry special powers.
Not like magic, which is a mystic power that can be learned, but rather special abilities from birth.
---Such people are normally called Demonic Children or psychics.

entries.japanese:
「特異能力というのは肉体的なものですから、もちろん家系―――血筋で遺伝します。
　『蛇』は自分の新しい肉体にそういった『人間ではないもの』の家系を選ぶんです。
　富と名声があり、その裏で人間外の力をもつ家系。
　それが『蛇』が転生先に選ぶ条件なんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because an innate ability belongs to the body, it is naturally inherited through bloodlines.
The ‘Serpent’ chooses his new body from one of those inhuman lineages.
A family with wealth and status, and powers beyond humanity hidden beneath the surface.
Those are the conditions he looks for in his next incarnation.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"These special abilities are genetic, so they are inherited---passed on by blood.
He chooses those families that have 'something not human' in their lineages.
A family with wealth and influence, and inhuman power.
Those are the requirements for his host."

entries.japanese:
「…………ずいぶんと用意周到なヤツなんだな、その蛇っていう吸血鬼は」
「ええ。
なにしろ蛇ですから。
執念深くて細かいんです」
「………………」
　なにか。
　この話は、聞いていて、おもしろくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…That vampire plans remarkably far ahead.”
“Yes. He is a serpent, after all. Patient, obsessive, and very particular.”
“…”
Something about it.
This story was unpleasant to hear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… This serpent vampire, he seems to be quite prepared."
"Yes, since he is a serpent, he has a very slithering intellect."
"……………"
There's something…
Something about this story I don't like.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　今の冗談だったんですけど、聞いてました？」
「え―――？
　あ、うん、先輩の冗談はつまらないな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? That was a joke—were you listening?”
“What? Oh, yes—your jokes aren’t very funny, Ciel.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
That was just a joke, but are you listening?"
"Eh---?
Ah, yeah, it wasn't very funny."

entries.japanese:
先輩は黙ってしまう。
　けど―――本当に、今はあんまり笑える気分じゃなくなってる。
　なんだってこう、俺はいきなり気持ちが沈んでしまったんだろう………？
entries.maoEnglish:
She fell silent.
But the truth was, I no longer felt much like laughing.
Why had my mood suddenly sunk so low…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Senpai goes quiet.
But---I really don't feel like laughing right now.
Why do I suddenly feel so down………?

entries.japanese:
「……けど、ようやく解ったよ。
そいつが俺たちの敵なんだな、先輩」
「―――違います。
アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドと、わたしの敵です。
遠野くんは『蛇』に関わる必要なんかありません。
　ですからこれ以上、アルクェイドとは行動しないでください。
　『蛇』はわたしか彼女、どちらかが必ず仕留めます。
遠野くんが危険な目にあう必要なんてない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Still, I finally understand. That vampire is our enemy, Ciel.”
“No. He is Arcueid Brunestud’s enemy and mine. You have no need to become involved with the ‘Serpent.’
Do not act with Arcueid again.
One of us will destroy him. There is no reason for you to put yourself in danger.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I understand now.
That's our enemy, right Senpai?"
"---No.
Arcueid Brunestud's and my enemy.
There is no need for you to worry about 'The Serpent', Tohno-kun.
So please don't go with Arcueid any longer.
Either I or that woman will destroy him.
There is no need for you to face any danger."

entries.japanese:
「危険って―――もう、この街に住んでるだけで十分危険じゃないか！
　先輩だってアルクェイドだって、この街を守るために戦ってるんだろ？
　なら俺だって、見て見ぬふりなんかできない」
「―――いいえ。
彼女はこの街のことは考えていません。
彼女が『蛇』を追うのは個人的な問題なんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Danger? Just living in this city is dangerous now! You and Arcueid are both fighting to protect it, aren’t you?
I can’t simply pretend I see nothing.”
“No. She has no concern for this city. Her pursuit of the ‘Serpent’ is entirely personal.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Danger---look, isn't just living in this city dangerous enough?
Even you, even Arcueid is fighting to protect this city!
So I can't overlook this either."
"---No.
She isn't thinking about this city.
She is only after 'The Serpent' for her own reasons."

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん。
死徒というものはもとは人間なんです。
　彼らが吸血種になる方法は二つあります。
　真祖と呼ばれる、初めから吸血種として生まれてきた人間ではないモノに血を吸われるか、
　魔術を究めて自らの肉体を永久機関に変革するか。
　『蛇』は、真祖に血を吸われて死徒となりました。
わかりますね。
『蛇』は真祖という、ヒトでさえなかった超越種の犠牲者なんです」
　じっ、と先輩が見つめてくる。
　その感情のない瞳が、次に何を言おうとしているのかを告げてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. Dead Apostles were once human.
There are two ways for them to become a vampiric species.
They may have their blood drunk by a nonhuman being born vampiric—a True Ancestor—or
perfect magecraft and transform their own body into a perpetual motion machine.
The ‘Serpent’ became a Dead Apostle after a True Ancestor drank his blood. Do you understand? He is the victim of a transcendent species that was never even human.”
She stared into my eyes.
Her empty gaze told me what she meant to say next.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun.
The Dead Apostles were once human.
There are two ways for them to become vampires.
Either they would have their blood sucked by the True Ancestors, who were originally born as vampires,
or they change their own bodies through their magical research in their quest for immortality.
'The Serpent' had his blood sucked by a True Ancestor to become a Dead Apostle.
Do you understand?
'The Serpent' was a victim of the True Ancestors, a race beyond ours."
Senpai stares at me.
Those emotionless eyes tell me what she is going to say next.

entries.japanese:
「……まさか。
その、真祖っていうのは」
「アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド。
八百年前にただ一度だけ過ちをおかした真祖の王族。
　彼女が『蛇』を作り出した張本人なんですよ」
「え―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. You don’t mean that True Ancestor was—”
“Arcueid Brunestud. Royalty among the True Ancestors, who committed a single mistake eight hundred years ago.
She is the one who created that vampire—the Serpent.”
“What—?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Don't tell me, that True Ancestor was……"
"Arcueid Brunestud.
The royalty of the True Ancestors who made her only mistake eight hundred years ago.
She is the one who made 'The Serpent'."
"Eh-----"

entries.japanese:
「……もともと真祖というものは、わたしたちとは大きくかけ離れた存在です。
　死徒はたしかに吸血種として絶大な能力を持っていますが、それらは所詮『人間の延長』でしありません。
　死徒というのは長い寿命を得たからこそ、自己の能力を向上させていって、結果としてあのような『超』能力を持つに至ります。
　言いかえれば、長い寿命さえあれば誰だって吸血鬼程度の能力は修得できるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“True Ancestors are beings vastly removed from us.
Dead Apostles certainly possess tremendous vampiric power, but they remain no more than extensions of humanity.
Their long lives allow them to cultivate their abilities until those abilities become superhuman.
Put another way, given enough time, anyone could acquire powers on the level of a vampire.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… From the very beginning, the True Ancestors were an existence far separated from ours.
The Dead Apostles certainly are vampires that wield immense ability, but that ability is only an extension of human capacity.
Because they have managed to attain a long life, they are able to develop their abilities, and manage to refine it to those 'super' abilities as a result.
In other words, anyone can develop abilities equal to the vampires if they have a long time."

entries.japanese:
……ああ、そういえば何かで読んだっけ。
　不老不死不老不死っていうけど、吸血鬼なんていうのはそう大したものじゃないんだって。
entries.maoEnglish:
…I remembered reading something like that.
Immortality this, immortality that—but vampires themselves were not so extraordinary.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yeah, I think I've read that somewhere.
They say immortality, but being a vampire isn't something that great.

entries.japanese:
「ですが、真祖は違います。
彼らは生まれた時からすでに人知の及ばない力を保有してくる。
　もともと真祖というものは、わたしたち人間よりではなくこの世界よりの存在なんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“True Ancestors are different. They are born already possessing power beyond human understanding.
They stand closer to the world itself than they do to humanity.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But the True Ancestors are different.
From the moment they are born, they possess power beyond human comprehension.
From the beginning, these True Ancestors are an existence closer to the world than humans.

entries.japanese:
「わたしたち人間は、自然から独立することによってここまで繁栄してきました。
　自然の恩恵を受けながらも自然から略奪し、自然が滅びようとわたしたちは滅びない。
　わたしたちが地球上でもっとも優れた存在になれたのは、おそらくこの一点のみが、人間だけが持ってしまった罪だからです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Humanity prospered by separating itself from nature.
We enjoy nature’s gifts even as we plunder it, and even if nature perishes, we intend to survive.
Perhaps the only reason we became the dominant species on Earth is that humanity alone acquired that particular sin.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"We humans have flourished this much by isolating ourselves from nature.
While we receive blessings from nature, we steal from it, and even if nature is destroyed, we will not be destroyed.
We became the most superior race on this planet probably because of this one sin only we humans carry."

entries.japanese:
「わたしたちは自然とはもう融け合えない。
そのかわりに自然、つまりこの星さえ破壊しえる業を手に入れました。
　けれど、自然にしてみればそれは悪です。
世界だって一つの生命なんですから、自身をわたしたちから守ろうという意思が働きます。
　けれど世界には触覚がない。
　だから―――わたしたちをいさめる分身を、わたしたちと同じように自然と乖離したカタチとして生み出します」
entries.maoEnglish:
“We can no longer merge with nature. In exchange, we gained the means to destroy nature—even the planet itself.
To nature, that makes us evil. The world is a living thing as well, and so it possesses the will to defend itself against us.
But the world has no senses of its own.
It therefore creates avatars to restrain humanity, giving them independent forms severed from nature just as we are.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"We can no longer be a part of nature.
In its place, we have gained ways to even destroy nature, this whole planet.
However, from the nature's perspective, this is evil.
The world itself is a form of life, so it has the will to protect itself from us.
But it does not have senses.
So---it creates a presence, separated from nature like us, to remonstrate us."

entries.japanese:
……先輩はおかしい。
　自然に意思なんかあるわけない。
　そう、あるわけがない―――だが、それは単に感じ取れないだけではないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
…She was talking nonsense.
Nature could not possess a will.
Of course it couldn’t—and yet, perhaps the truth was simply that I could not perceive it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Senpai is weird.
Nature doesn't have a will of its own.
Yeah, it can't---but, can it be that we just can't feel it?

entries.japanese:
自然に、世界に意思はある。
だからこそ今も存在していて、美しく保とうとする。
　問題は、それが感じとれないというコトではなく。
　自然が美しいと思う基準と、人間が美しいと思う基準が同じだということだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nature—the world—possessed a will. That was why it still endured, why it strove to preserve its beauty.
The question was not whether humanity could sense it.
The question was why nature’s idea of beauty should resemble our own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Nature, the earth, possesses a will.
That is why it still exists and tries to stay beautiful.
The problem isn't that we can't feel it.
It's that the standard of what nature thinks is beautiful and the standard of what humans believe is beautiful are the same.

entries.japanese:
「自然、世界が自らの触覚として独立させた存在。
それが一般に神霊、精霊と呼ばれるモノたちです。
　動物霊が現世に残り続けて『霊体』として残ったモノとはそもそも存在の次元が違う超越種たち。
　真祖というのはその一種族なんです。
　もとから人間をいさめる役割として生まれた彼らは、人間を悪としか思っていない。
　わたしたちが人間を捕食する吸血鬼を『悪』と思うように、彼らにとって自然を食い物にする人間は『悪』なんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The independent beings nature created as its senses are commonly called Divine Spirits and Elementals. They are transcendent beings on an entirely different plane from animal ghosts that linger in this world as spiritual bodies.
True Ancestors are one such species.
Born to restrain humanity, they see us only as evil.
Just as we call vampires evil for preying upon humans, they call humans evil for feeding upon nature.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"An existence which the world created to sense for it.
These are what we usually call spirits.
They are a transcendental species existing on another plane different from the remaining spirits of animals in the present world.
The True Ancestors are one type of these spirits.
They are born with the purpose to punish humans, so they only see humans as evil.
Much as we think vampires who prey upon humans are evil, they view humans who prey upon nature as evil."

entries.japanese:
だが滑稽だ。
　ならば何故、連中は悪たる人間を食い物にしなければ存在できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
How absurd.
If humanity was evil to them, why did they need to feed upon us in order to exist?
entries.mirrorMoon:
But that's funny.
Then why can't they exist unless they feed on us humans, the evil existence?

entries.japanese:
「―――真祖にとって人間は敵にすぎません。
　もともと自然の一部、いえこの世界そのものとリンクしている彼らの能力は、それこそ際限というものがないんです。
　……教会の長い歴史の中でも、真祖と戦った記録は数えるほどしかありません。
　彼らは世界そのものから力を引き上げる。
　だから、彼らを倒すということは世界を倒すほどの概念武装が必要になります。
　……もちろん、そんな武装はありません。
　ですから彼らには、外的要因による『死』を与えることができない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“To True Ancestors, humans are merely enemies.
Their power is linked to nature—to the world itself—and therefore knows no limit.
In all the Church’s long history, there are only a handful of recorded battles against them.
They draw their strength directly from the world.
To defeat one would require a conceptual weapon capable of defeating the world itself.
No such weapon exists.
Thus no outside force can impose ‘death’ upon them.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Humans are only enemies to the True Ancestors.
As part of nature, no, as those whose power is linked to nature itself, their power has no limits.
…… In the long history of The Church, there are only a few records of fighting against the True Ancestors.
They get their powers from the world itself.
Therefore in order to kill them, a conceptual weapon with the power to kill the world is needed.
…… Of course, such a weapon does not exist.
So that means their 'death' cannot be caused by external factors."

entries.japanese:
あの夜。
　ホテルの一室で彼女は言った。
　遠野志貴が彼女を殺そうとしたときが夜であったのなら、たとえこの目でも彼女から死を視るコトはできなかった、と。
　つまり。
　それは、死なないというコトだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
That night.
In the hotel room, she had told me.
That if Shiki Tohno had tried to kill her after dark, even these eyes would have been unable to see death upon her.
In other words.
She would not die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That night.
She said in that hotel.
That if I had tried to kill her during nighttime, these eyes would not even have been able to see her death.
In other words.
It means she cannot die.

entries.japanese:
「いいですか、遠野くん。
　アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドが『蛇』を追っているのは、『蛇』に与えてしまった自分の力を取り戻すためなんです。
　それは決して人間のためなんかじゃない。
　どうして今の彼女があんなに弱っているかは知りませんけど、もし力が戻れば―――遠野くんに手を貸してもらう必要なんてなくなる。
　その時、彼女が遠野くんを無事に帰すと思いますか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen carefully, Tohno.
Arcueid Brunestud pursues the ‘Serpent’ so she can reclaim the power she gave him.
She is not doing this for humanity.
I don’t know why she is presently so weak, but once her power returns, she will no longer need your help.
When that happens, do you truly believe she will let you walk away unharmed?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you understand, Tohno-kun?
Arcueid Brunestud is pursuing 'The Serpent' in order to recover her power he took away from her.
It's not for the sake of any humans.
I don't know why she is weakened now, but if she regains her power---she will not need your help, Tohno-kun.
When that happens, do you think she will let you leave safely?"

entries.japanese:
「……………帰すに決まってる、だろ。
　だって―――あいつが俺をどうにかするなんて、そんな理由ないんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course she’ll let me go.
She has no reason to do anything to me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Of course she would.
Because---she doesn't have any reason to hurt me."

entries.japanese:
「彼女は吸血鬼です。
それも死徒たちのように、自分が生き延びるために他人の血を必要とする吸血種じゃない。
　いいですか遠野くん。
真祖たちが人間から血を吸わなければ、そもそも吸血鬼なんていう存在は生まれなかった。
　彼らは―――人間の血なんか吸わなくても生きていけるくせに、ただ吸いたいっていう衝動だけで人間の血を吸って、人間を人間外のものにしてしまうんです。
　そんなモノの傍に、一般人である貴方を歩かせるわけにはいきません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“She is a vampire—but unlike the Dead Apostles, she does not need human blood to survive.
Understand this, Tohno: if the True Ancestors had never drunk human blood, vampires would never have existed.
They can live perfectly well without it, yet they drink from human beings solely because the impulse takes them, transforming their victims into things no longer human.
I cannot allow an ordinary person like you to walk beside such a creature.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"She is a vampire.
She isn't like the Dead Apostles who suck blood in order to prolong their own life.
Look, Tohno-kun.
If the True Ancestors didn't suck human blood, vampires would never exist in the first place.
They---can survive without sucking human blood, but they still do suck blood because they have the urge to do so, and make humans into an existence outside of human nature.
I can't let some ordinary person like you be with her."

entries.japanese:
―――先輩の話は、それで終わった。
　俺は―――なんだかさっきからクラクラと眩暈がする頭のせいか、先輩の言っていた事を他人事のように感じてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And with that, Ciel had said her piece.
Maybe it was the dizziness that had been swimming through my head, but everything she’d said seemed to concern somebody else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Senpai's talk ends like that.
I---it might be because of my dizziness, but it seems like everything she's talking about is totally unrelated to me.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん。
これで彼女がどれほど危険な存在なのか、わかってもらえましたか」
「うん、まあ、額面通りには、なんとか」
「それじゃあ彼女にはもう協力しないでくださいね」
「それは―――」
　それは、できない。
　先輩の言っている事は納得できない。
　だって。
先輩はアルクェイドを知らない。
　あいつがいいヤツなんだって、知らないクセに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. Do you understand now just how dangerous she is?”
“Yeah. I mean, I understand the words, more or less.”
“Then please don’t help her anymore.”
“That’s—”
I couldn’t do that.
What Ciel was saying didn’t sit right with me.
Because. Ciel didn’t know Arcueid.
She didn’t know what a good person Arcueid really was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun.
Does that show you how dangerous she is?"
"Yeah, well, I get the gist."
"So please don't cooperate with her anymore, okay?"
"I---"
I can't do that.
I can't consent to what Senpai is saying.
Because Senpai doesn't know Arcueid.
She doesn't know how good of a person she is.

entries.japanese:
「―――遠野くん」
　むーっ、と先輩はうなる。
　けど、そんな顔されたって自分に嘘はつけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno.”
Ciel made a low, frustrated sound.
But no matter what kind of face she made, I couldn’t lie to myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Tohno-kun."
Senpai groans.
But, even if she makes that face, I can't lie to myself.

entries.japanese:
「……悪い、先輩。
俺にも事情があってさ、あいつに協力してやりたいんだ。
　たしかに逆らえば何してくるかわからないって事もある。
けどあいつを放っておけないのも本当だから」
「……ばかいわないでください。
遠野くんは普通の男の子じゃないですか。
だから―――こんな危険なマネ、しちゃいけないです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, Ciel. I’ve got my reasons, and I want to help her.
Sure, part of it is that I don’t know what she’d do if I refused. But it’s also true that I can’t just abandon her.”
“Don’t be ridiculous. You’re an ordinary boy, Tohno. You shouldn’t be doing anything this dangerous.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, Senpai.
I also have my reasons, so I want to help her.
It's true that I don't know what she'll do if I turn against her.
But it's also true that I just can't leave her alone."
"…… Please don't say stupid things.
Tohno-kun, you're just a normal boy.
So---you shouldn't do such dangerous things."

entries.japanese:
「……うん、そう言ってくれるのはありがたい。
　けど、守れるのなら守りたかったコトだってあるんだ。
この街の事とか、先輩と穏やかに過ごせる学校とかをさ。
　……まあ、実際は先輩に守られたわけだけど」
「……でも、やっぱり危険すぎます。
『混沌』の時だって、遠野くんは死にそうだったじゃないですか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah, I’m grateful you feel that way.
But if there was something I could protect, I wanted to protect it. This city, and the school where I can spend quiet days with you.
Though in the end, you were the one who protected me.”
“But it’s still much too dangerous. You nearly died when we fought Chaos…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I'm grateful for your concern.
But, there are some things that I want to protect if I can.
Such as this city, and my peaceful time with you at school, Senpai.
…… Well, even though you ended up protecting me."
"…… But, it is just too dangerous.
You were nearly dead when you fought with 'Chaos'……!"

entries.japanese:
「ああ、それは大丈夫なんじゃない？
　だってさ、アルクェイドがそれだけぶっとんだヤツなら、蛇なんていう吸血鬼なんて簡単に始末できるだろ」
「ですから、その彼女自身が危険なんです！
　いいかげん目を覚ましてください！
　彼女は人間じゃないんです。
いつ気紛れで人間の血を吸うかわからない、死徒以上の怪物なんですよ……！」
「な―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wouldn’t that make it safer? If Arcueid is really that far beyond anything human, then one vampire called the Serpent should be nothing to her.”
“Arcueid herself is the danger! Please, open your eyes!
She isn’t human. She’s a monster beyond even the Dead Apostles, one who might drink human blood on a whim at any moment…!”
“What—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't that alright?
Besides, if Arcueid is really that strong, shouldn't defeating this serpent vampire be simple?"
"I'm telling you that she is the dangerous one!
Please open your eyes already!
She isn't human.
You don't know when she'll suck blood, she is more of a monster than the Dead Apostles……!"
"Wha-----"

entries.japanese:
……わかってる。
　先輩が本気で俺の事を心配してくれてるのは解ってる。
　けど――――その言葉は、許せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
…I knew.
I knew Ciel was genuinely worried about me.
But that was one thing I could never forgive her for saying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I know.
I know that Senpai is really worried about me.
But----I can't allow those words.

entries.japanese:
「―――やめてくれ先輩。
あいつは怪物なんかじゃないよ。
ちゃんとあいつと話してもいないくせに、そんなこと言わないでくれ」
「……それは、たしかにそうですけど。
　だけど彼女は吸血鬼なんです。
それだけはちゃんと理解してください……！」
「だから、それは違うんだって……！
　いいか先輩、アルクェイドは血を吸わないんだ。
　あいつは自分でそう言ったし、それに嘘があったとは、俺には思えない。
　真祖っていうのがどんなヤツらかは知らないけど、アルクェイドは別だ。
　あいつだけは、きっと―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop it, Ciel. She isn’t a monster. You’ve never even had a real conversation with her, so don’t call her that.”
“…You’re right about that.
But she is a vampire. Please, at least understand that…!”
“That’s what I’m telling you—you’re wrong…!
Listen, Ciel. Arcueid doesn’t drink blood.
She told me so herself, and I don’t believe she was lying.
I don’t know what the other True Ancestors are like, but Arcueid is different.
She, at least, would never—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Just stop Senpai.
She isn't a monster.
You shouldn't say those things when you haven't even talked to her."
"…… That is true.
But she is a vampire.
Please understand that……!"
"No, that's wrong……!
Look Senpai, Arcueid doesn't suck blood.
She told me herself, and I don't think she is lying.
I don't know how these other True Ancestors are, but Arcueid is different.
Just her, she is definitely---"

entries.japanese:
「きっと、なんだっていうんです？
　いいですか、たとえ彼女が危険でないとしても、遠野くんが戦うコト自体が危険じゃないですか。
　遠野くんは彼女のように、傷ついてもかってに治ってくれる体なんかもってない。
傷つけば死んでしまうんです、貴方は……！
　わたしが許せないのは、それを知っているくせに彼女が遠野くんを戦わせている事なんです。
　それじゃまるで、遠野くんを道具としてしか見ていないってコトじゃないですか！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Would never what?
Even if she herself isn’t dangerous, fighting beside her certainly is.
You don’t have a body that heals itself whenever it’s hurt. If you’re wounded, you die…!
That’s what I can’t forgive: she knows that, yet she still lets you fight.
It’s as though she sees you as nothing but a tool!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Definitely, what?
Look, even if she isn't dangerous, it's dangerous enough for you to fight.
You can't recover from injuries like she can.
If you get wounded, you will die……!
What I can't forgive is she knows this and still lets you fight.
It's like she's just seeing you as a tool, Tohno-kun!"

entries.japanese:
怒鳴るように先輩はそう言った。
　……わかってる。
　先輩が正しいっていうのはちゃんと理解できてる。
　けど、だからこそ―――その声が、うとましかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel’s voice rose almost to a shout.
…I knew.
I understood perfectly well that she was right.
And that was precisely why her voice became unbearable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Senpai screams this last part.
…… I know.
I understand she is right.
But, because I understand---her voice annoys me.

entries.japanese:
「……うる、さい」
「志貴……くん？」
「―――先輩はうるさい！
　アルクェイドは俺を道具扱いなんかしていない……！
　知らないのに―――アルクェイドの事を知らないくせに、あいつを怪物扱いしかできないくせに、先輩にそんな事をいう資格はない……！」
「ですから、冷静になってください。
　確かにわたしは彼女の事をよく知らない。
けど彼女が遠野くんを騙している可能性だって―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Shut… up.”
“Shiki…?”
“Just shut up! Arcueid doesn’t treat me like a tool…!
You don’t know her—you don’t know anything about her, and all you can see is a monster. You have no right to say that…!”
“Please calm down.
You’re right that I don’t know her well. But there’s still a chance she may be deceiving you—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shut, up."
"Tohno…… kun?"
"---Just shut up Senpai!
Arcueid doesn't see me as a tool at all……!
You don't know---you don't know anything about her, you just think she's some sort of monster, so you have no right to say any of that……!"
"Please calm down.
I know I don't know very much about her.
But there is a possibility that she could be deceiving you---"

entries.japanese:
「うるさい、俺を騙してたのは先輩のほうだろう！」
「………………あ」
　しまっ―――た。
　なんで、俺は。
　そんな―――酷いことを、ムキになって言い返したんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shut up! You’re the one who deceived me!”
“…Ah.”
Oh no.
Why had I—
Why had I lashed out with something so cruel?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shut up!
Weren't you the one deceiving me!?"
"……………… Ah."
Oh---crap.
Why, did I?
Why did I---say that, terrible, thing?

entries.japanese:
「………先輩、いまのは………」
　言いすぎた、とは、言えなかった。
　先輩の顔があんまりにも壊れそうで。
　何か口にしただけで、今にも崩れてしまいそうだったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, what I just said…”
I couldn’t make myself say I’d gone too far.
Her face looked as though it might shatter.
As though a single word might make it crumble at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Senpai, I………"
Said too much.
But I can't say it.
Her expression looks very fragile.
And it looks like it's going to break down the moment I say something.

entries.japanese:
「そうですねー、言われてみればその通りです」
「先………輩？」
「ええ、そうでした。
わたし、遠野くんを騙してますから。
信用なんてされませんよね」
　さっきまでの顔はどこにいったのか、先輩は本当に笑顔をうかべている。
　作り笑いには見えない。
　作り笑いのはずなのに。
　俺には、本当の笑顔としか、見破れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, now that you mention it, you’re absolutely right.”
“Ci—el?”
“Yes, of course. I’ve been deceiving you, Tohno. How could I expect you to trust me?”
The fragile expression from a moment ago had vanished.
Ciel was smiling—really smiling.
It didn’t look false.
It had to be false, yet no matter how I searched it, all I could see was a genuine smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're right, you know.
You're right now that you mention it."
"Sen……… pai?"
"Yes, that's right.
I have been deceiving you Tohno-kun.
So there's no reason for you to believe me."
She suddenly smiles as if her previous expression never existed.
There's no trace of it being faked.
Even though it has to be fake.
I can't see anything but a true smile.

entries.japanese:
「お時間をとっちゃってごめんなさいでした。
　えっと、それじゃあ―――わたし、消えますね」
「――――え？」
　ざあ、と風が吹いた。
　たったそれだけの間に。
　シエル先輩は、俺の前から姿を消してしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry I took up so much of your time.
Well, then… I’ll disappear now.”
“What?”
The wind rushed past.
In that single instant.
Ciel vanished from before my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I apologize for taking your time.
Um, Then---I'll just disappear now."
"----Eh?"
The wind rushes by.
In that very instant,
Ciel-senpai disappears from right before my eyes.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになった。
　教室はあわだたしくなって、それ以上にあわだたしい友人がやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunchtime came.
The classroom burst into commotion, followed by a friend even more frantic than the room itself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's now lunchtime.
The room gets loud, and my louder friend appears.

entries.japanese:
「遠野、今日はどこで昼メシにする？」
「………どこでも。
学食でも教室でもかまわない」
「んじゃま、パン食にすっか。
教室にいれば先輩もやってくるだろうし。
購買に行ってくるけど、リクエストあるか？」
「……カレーパン以外ならなんでも。
ああ、あと牛乳」
「あいよ、りょーかい」
　有彦は軽い足取りで教室から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where are we eating today, Tohno?”
“Anywhere. Cafeteria or classroom—I don’t care.” “Then let’s get some bread and eat here. Ciel might come by if we stay put. I’m heading to the school store; want anything?”
“Anything but curry bread. Oh, and milk.”
“Got it.”
Arihiko left the classroom with a spring in his step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno, where are you eating today?"
"……… Wherever.
I don't care if it's here or the cafeteria."
"Alrighty, then lets have some bread.
If we're here, Senpai might come.
I'll go buy some, any requests?"
"…… As long as it's not curry bread, then anything's fine.
Oh, and some milk."
"Roger."
Arihiko walks out of the classroom happily.

entries.japanese:
「あいよ、カレーパン二つと牛乳、お待たせー、しました」
「………………」
　カレーパン以外、という説明は、こいつにとっては逆効果だったみたいだ。
　ごくろうさん、と買い出しのねぎらいをして、お代を渡す。
　あとは、もくもくとカレーパンを食べた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Here we are: two curry breads and one milk. Thank you for waiting.”
“…”
Apparently, telling him anything but curry bread had produced the opposite effect.
I thanked him for the errand and paid him back.
Then I ate my curry bread in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here you go, two curry breads and some milk.
Thanks for waitin'."
"………………"
I told him anything but curry bread, but I guess that had the opposite effect.
I thank him and toss him some money.
I start to chew on my curry bread.

entries.japanese:
「なあ遠野。
先輩、来た？」
　いや、と首をふる。
「ちぇっ。
今日は学食のほうだったか」
「有彦。
先輩ならもうこないよ」
「えぇー！？
　なんで、おまえ先輩にケンカでも売ったのか！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Tohno. Has Ciel been by?”
I shook my head.
“Damn. Guess she went to the cafeteria today.”
“Arihiko. She isn’t coming.”
“What?! Why not? Did you pick a fight with her or something?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Tohno, did Senpai come?"
I shake my head no.
"Damn.
Maybe she's in the cafeteria today."
"Arihiko, she won't come anymore."
"Whaaat!?
Did you get in a fight with her!?"

entries.japanese:
「そういうわけじゃないけど、愛想つかれされた。
　悪いな有彦。
もし先輩に会えたら、ごめんって言っておいてくれ」
　……口にして、はっきりと実感した。
　俺はすごく先輩を傷つけた。
　先輩はもう俺の前には出てきてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Not exactly. She just got fed up with me. Sorry, Arihiko. If you see her, tell her I’m sorry.”
…Saying it aloud made the truth inescapable.
I’d hurt Ciel badly.
She would never come to see me again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's not it, but she doesn't like me anymore.
I'm sorry Arihiko.
If you see her, tell her I'm sorry."
…… I really do feel it now that I mention it.
I hurt her badly.
She won't come see me ever again.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ遠野。
もしかしてオレに抜け駆けして告白して、ごめんなさいっていうオチか？」
「―――それだったらまだ良かった」
　そう、ゴメンナサイとかサヨナラとかのほうが、まだ希望がある。
　たしかに、俺だってアレは失言だったと思うけど。
「……けどさあ。
消えますね、はないよな、有彦」
　言って、そのまま机につっぷした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s this, Tohno? You went behind my back, confessed to her, and got rejected?”
“I wish that were all it was.”
Even being told she was sorry or that it was goodbye would have left some room for hope.
I knew what I’d said had been a terrible blunder, but still…
“But still. ‘I’ll disappear’ is a little much, don’t you think, Arihiko?”
With that, I let my head fall onto the desk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's this Tohno?
Are you telling me sorry for asking her out without asking me?"
"---If that was the case, it'd be much better."
Yeah, if it was sorry or goodbye, there would be some hope left.
Certainly, I think that was a pretty bad thing to say.
"…… But, 'I'll just disappear'?
That's too much, right Arihiko?"
I say this and put my head down on my desk.

entries.japanese:
放課後。
　水曜日という事もあって、ホームルームが終わるやいなや、クラスメイトたちは蜘蛛の子を散らすように教室から出ていった。
　せっかくの水曜日だっていうのに、何もやる気が起きない。
　茶道部に行っても、シエル先輩の姿はありはしないだろう。
「―――――」
　それこそ死者のような生気のなさで、一人屋敷への帰路についた。
entries.maoEnglish:
After school.
Since it was Wednesday, the instant homeroom ended my classmates scattered from the classroom like startled spiders.
It was Wednesday, and I still couldn’t summon the will to do anything.
Even if I went to the tea-ceremony club, Ciel wouldn’t be there.
“…”
With all the life of a corpse, I set out alone for the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Classes are over.
It's a Wednesday so the rest of my classmates run out of the room as soon as classes end.
It's a Wednesday like any other, but I don't feel like doing anything.
Even if I went to the tea ceremony room, Ciel-senpai probably wouldn't be there.
"-----"
As lifeless as The Dead, I go back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
　屋敷に帰ってくるなり、翡翠が出迎えてくれる。
　わざわざ待っていてくれたっていうのに、そんな翡翠に空返事しかできず、自分の部屋に引きこもった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
Hisui was waiting to greet me the moment I returned.
She had gone to the trouble of waiting, yet I could only mumble a hollow reply before shutting myself away in my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Welcome back, Shiki-sama."
Hisui greets me as soon as I get back to the mansion.
Even though Hisui was waiting for me this whole time, I can't even bring myself to greet her and I make my way to my room.

entries.japanese:
夕食が済ませて、部屋に戻る。
　アルクェイドとの約束の時間まで、あと少し。
―――ばかいわないでください。
　遠野くんは普通の男の子じゃないですか。
　だからこんな危険なマネ、しちゃいけないです。
entries.maoEnglish:
After dinner, I returned to my room.
It was almost time to meet Arcueid.
―――Don’t be ridiculous.
You’re an ordinary boy, Tohno.
You shouldn’t be doing anything this dangerous.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After dinner, I return to my room.
There's still a little time before I'm supposed to meet Arcueid.
---Please don't say stupid things.
Tohno-kun, you're just a normal boy.
So you shouldn't do such dangerous things.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　先輩は、ただ俺の心配をしてくれていだけなのに。
　俺は結局、先輩よりアルクェイドのほうを大事にしたっていうコトなんだろうか。
「……なんで自分の気持ちが自分でわからないんだろうな、志貴」
　窓ガラスに映った自分に、そんなグチをこぼしてみた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
All Ciel had done was worry about me.
Had I ultimately chosen Arcueid over her?
“…How can you not even understand your own feelings, Shiki?”
I muttered the complaint to my reflection in the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
Senpai was just worrying about me.
In the end, is it just that I chose Arcueid over Senpai?
"…… Why don't you understand your own feelings, Shiki?"
I ask my reflection in the window glass.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――く」
　軽い頭痛。
　ここのところ頭痛が多くなってきてる。
　貧血による影響は、今までは眩暈だった。
それが頭痛に変わってしまったのはメガネを外して『死』を視はじめたせいだろうか。
「……時間か」
　アルクェイドとの約束の時間だ。
　どのみち、先輩がなんて言おうと約束したからには守らないといけない。
　ナイフをポケットにいれて、自分の部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—”
A faint headache.
I’d been getting more of them lately.
The anemia had always brought dizziness before. Had it turned into pain because I’d begun taking off my glasses and seeing ‘death’ again?
“…It’s time.”
Time to meet Arcueid.
Whatever Ciel might say, I’d made a promise, and a promise had to be kept.
I slipped the knife into my pocket and left my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Tch."
My light headache returns.
Recently, I've been having more headaches.
Up until now, the effects of my anemia have only been dizziness.
It probably changed to these headaches because I've started taking off my glasses and seeing "death".
"…… It's time."
It's the time I promised to meet Arcueid.
No matter what Senpai said, I have to keep a promise I made.
Putting my knife in my pocket, I exit my room.

entries.japanese:
外に出た。
　もともと屋敷の周りは人通りが少ないのに、通り魔殺人のせいであたりは余計に静まり返っている。
　まだ夜の十時前だっていうのに、もう午前一時になったような寂しさだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I stepped outside.
The streets around the mansion saw little traffic even at the best of times, and the serial killings had stilled them further. It wasn’t even ten, yet the loneliness belonged to one in the morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go outside.
There were never many people around the mansion to begin with, but because of all these serial killings, it is unnaturally quiet.
It's not even ten o'clock yet, but the emptiness makes it feel more like past one o'clock.

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　十月も下旬にさしかかって、風もわずかに冷たさを含みはじめている。
　じき秋も終わるだろう、なんて感傷を抱きながら誰もいない道を歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
October was entering its final days, and the wind had begun to carry a slight chill.
With the idle melancholy of knowing autumn would soon be over, I started down the empty road.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----*sigh*
It is well into October and the wind is starting to blow colder.
Fall is nearly over as well.
I walk down the empty street holding these sentimental thoughts.

entries.japanese:
屋敷の周囲を歩く。
　ここを越えて坂道を下れば、アルクェイドとの待ち合わせ場所である公園にたどり着く。
―――と。
　その途中、屋敷の塀に黒い人影がよりかかっているのが見えた。
　道を行く俺の邪魔をする、というわけじゃなくて、まるで見送るように壁によりかかっている、黒い法衣を着た女の人。
entries.maoEnglish:
I followed the road around the mansion.
Once I passed this stretch and descended the hill, I would reach the park where Arcueid was waiting.
―――Then.
Halfway there, I saw a black figure leaning against the mansion wall.
A woman in a black cassock leaned there as though she had come to see me off, not to block my path.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I make my way around the mansion wall.
Past here and down the hill is the park where Arcueid is waiting.
---And then,
I see a black figure leaning on the mansion wall.
A woman clothed in black stands not to block my way, but just to watch me go by.

entries.japanese:
「こんな夜更けに何処に行くんですか」
　拗ねているような声で、先輩は俺の顔に見ずにそんな事を言ってきた。
「先、輩――――」
　ぴたりと足が止まる。
　先輩同様、俺も先輩の顔はまっすぐに見れない。
　朝の先輩との一件が気まずくて、先輩にあわせる顔がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where are you going at this hour?”
Ciel asked in a sulky voice without looking at me.
“Ci—el.”
My feet stopped dead.
Like Ciel, I couldn’t bring myself to look her in the face.
After what had happened that morning, I was too ashamed to face her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Where are you going this late at night?"
Senpai doesn't even look at my face as she says this without the slightest inflection in her voice.
"Sen, pai----"
I freeze dead in my tracks.
I can't look at her face either.
I feel uneasy about what happened this morning, so I can't bring myself to directly look at her.

entries.japanese:
「あれだけ言ったのに彼女のところに行くっていうんですね、遠野くんは」
「……仕方ないだろ。
アルクェイドを一人にしておけないし、やっぱり街に巣くっている吸血鬼のことは無視できないんだから」
「―――そうですね。
遠野くんの言い分はもっともです」
　先輩は口を閉ざす。
　壁によりかかっている先輩の横を、通りすぎた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“After everything I said, you’re still going to her, Tohno.”
“…I can’t help it. I can’t leave Arcueid alone, and I can’t ignore the vampire nesting in this city.”
“Yes. Your reasoning is perfectly sound.”
Ciel fell silent.
I walked past her where she leaned against the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Even after I said all that, you're still going to see her, Tohno-kun?"
"…… It can't be helped.
I can't leave her alone, and I can't ignore the vampire in this city either."
"---I see, you've got a point there."
She closes her mouth.
I pass her figure on the wall.

entries.japanese:
「ごめんな、先輩。
……その、いろいろ」
「気にしないでください。
遠野くんは間違ったことはしてないんですから」
　……背中に先輩の声がかかる。
　アルクェイドのところに行こうとするのを止めよう、という意思は感じられない。
　これで本当に、俺は先輩に呆れられたみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry, Ciel. For… everything.”
“Please don’t trouble yourself. You haven’t done anything wrong.”
Her voice reached me from behind.
There was nothing in it to suggest she meant to stop me from going to Arcueid.
It seemed Ciel truly had given up on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sorry, Senpai…… about a lot of things…"
"Please don't worry.
You weren't mistaken."
…… I hear her voice behind me.
It doesn't seem like she intends to stop me from seeing Arcueid at all.
I guess Senpai has completely given up on me.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ。
俺、行くから」
「はい、どうぞ遠野くんのお好きなようにしてください」
　声だけが聞こえてくる。
　それでも振り向けずに、俺は屋敷から離れていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well… I’m going.”
“Yes. Please do whatever you like, Tohno.”
Only her voice reached me.
Even then I couldn’t turn around, and I walked away from the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I'll be going."
"Yes, please do as you like, Tohno-kun."
I can still only hear her voice.
Yet, I walk away from the mansion without even turning around.

entries.japanese:
トコトコトコトコ。
　夜の住宅街に、固い足音が響いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap-tap-tap-tap.
Hard-soled footsteps rang through the sleeping neighborhood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tap, tap, tap, tap.
The footsteps echo in the night along the residential street.

entries.japanese:
トコトコトコトコ。
　夜の住宅街に、固い足音が響いていく。
　それは重い男の足音じゃなくて、もっと軽やかな体の足音だ。
　くわえていうんなら、俺のスニーカーじゃこんな音は出ない。
　底の固い、例えるなら編み上げブーツじゃないとこんな軽快な音はたてられない。
　……というか、例える必要なんかない。
　さっきからトコトコとついてくる足音は、紛れもなく編み上げブーツによるものなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap-tap-tap-tap.
Hard-soled footsteps rang through the sleeping neighborhood.
They weren’t the heavy tread of a man, but the brisk steps of someone lighter.
And my sneakers couldn’t possibly make that sound.
It took hard soles—lace-up boots, perhaps—to produce a rhythm so crisp.
…Not that I needed to speculate.
The footsteps pattering after me had unquestionably come from lace-up boots.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tap, tap, tap, tap.
The footsteps echo in the night along the residential street.
They aren't the footsteps of a heavy man, but of a much lighter body.
In addition, I'm wearing sneakers so they don't make such sounds.
Only shoes with a hard bottom can make this sound.
For example, shoes like high-laced boots.
…… Actually, I don't even need to give an example.
Without a doubt, those footsteps belong to high-laced boots.

entries.japanese:
ぴたり、と足を止める。
　トコ、と足音も止まる。
「…………」
　ダメだ。
　これ以上無視して歩いていくと、じき公園に着いてしまう。
　ここは一つ、はっきり言ってやらなければなるまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
I stopped dead.
One last tap sounded behind me, then stopped as well.
“…”
This wasn’t working.
If I kept pretending not to notice, we would reach the park in no time.
I had to turn around and settle this plainly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I stop.
The footsteps cease at the same time.
"…………"
This isn't any good.
If I just ignore her like this, we'll reach the park soon.
I should just go out and say it.

entries.japanese:
くるり、と背後に振りかえる。
「―――なあ、先輩」
「はい？」
「……その、先輩の家ってこっちのほうだったけ」
「いえ、まったく逆方向ですね。
遠野くん、一度来たことあるでしょう。
忘れちゃったんですか？」
「いや、覚えてるよ。
でもさ、ちょっと記憶に自信がなくなったんだ」
「いえ、自信をもっていいです。
わたしの家、あっちのほうですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
I wheeled around.
“Listen, Ciel.”
“Yes?”
“…Your house isn’t this way, is it?”
“No, it’s in precisely the opposite direction. You’ve visited once, Tohno. Have you forgotten?”
“No, I remember. I was just beginning to doubt my memory.”
“You may trust it. My house is over that way.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I turn around.
"---Hey, Senpai."
"Yes?"
"…… Um, is your house this way?"
"No, it's in the completely opposite direction.
You went there once, Tohno-kun, did you forget already?"
"No, I remember.
I just didn't have that much confidence in my memory."
"You should, because my house is that way."

entries.japanese:
そっか、そうだよね、ととりあえず笑ってみた。
　先輩はそうですよー、と笑い返してくる。
entries.maoEnglish: I managed a strained smile and told her she was right. Ciel smiled back and agreed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, that's right," I say with a smile.
"Yes, it is," she says, returning my smile.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ俺はこっちだから」
「はい。
どうぞ、遠野くんのお好きなように」
　にっこりとした笑顔で、先輩は俺を送り出そうとしている。
　……けど、なんか……すごく、イヤな予感がしてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I’m going this way.”
“Certainly. Please do whatever you like, Tohno.”
Ciel tried to send me on my way with a beaming smile.
But now I had a very, very bad feeling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I'm going this way."
"Yes, please do as you wish, Tohno-kun."
Still smiling, she seems to be seeing me off.
…… But, for some reason…… I have an incredibly bad feeling about this.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　すう、と息を吸いこむ。
「どうしました、行かないんですか？」
　先輩が問いかけてくる。
　その一瞬の隙をついて、俺は夜道を走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I drew a slow breath.
“What’s the matter—aren’t you going?”
Ciel asked.
I seized the momentary opening and sprinted down the dark road.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I suck in a deep breath.
"What's wrong, aren't you going?"
Senpai asks.
In that instant, I dash down the street.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ―――」
　ここまで。
　ここまで全力で走ってくれば、これ以上付いてくるなんて事は―――
「遠野くん、あんまり慌てちゃ危ないですよ」
　ぽん、と背後から肩を叩かれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah—”
This far.
After running flat out this far, there was no chance she could still be—
“You’ll hurt yourself if you rush like that, Tohno.”
A hand patted my shoulder from behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start to pant heavily.
This far.
Running full strength this far, she couldn't have followed me---
"Tohno-kun, going wild like that is dangerous you know."
A hand pats my shoulder from behind.

entries.japanese:
「うわあああ！」
　思わず跳びすさる。
　先輩はそれこそ当然のように俺の後に付いてきていた。
「な、なんでついてくるんだよ先輩！」
「なんでもなにも、遠野くんひとりじゃ不安じゃないですか」
　またもきっぱりと言いきられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaah!”
I leapt away on instinct.
Ciel had followed me as though it were the most natural thing in the world.
“W-why are you following me?”
“Because I’d worry if you went alone.”
Once again, she delivered the answer with absolute finality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uwaaaa!"
I instinctively jump back.
Senpai stands behind me as if it was perfectly natural to do so.
"Wh, why are you following me, Senpai!?"
"Well, I feel uneasy leaving you by yourself."
She speaks very matter-of-factly.

entries.japanese:
「あー、うー」
　そう言いきられると、こっちとしても返答に困る。
　返答に困るけど、ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Uh… well…”
When she put it that firmly, I had no idea how to answer.
But answer or not, this was where I had to—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, uh."
I don't even know how to respond.
I don't know, but I should---

entries.japanese: もう、はっきりと言い返して帰ってもらうしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish: There was no choice now; I would have to tell her plainly and make her go home.
entries.mirrorMoon: I should just tell her directly to go home.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、俺の心配なんてしなくていいから帰ってくれ。
このままじゃタイヘンな事になるだろ」
「はあ。
タイヘンって、どんなふうにタイヘンになるんですか？」
　……先輩の俺の言い分なんてまるで聞いていない。
右から左にスルーっと聞き流してしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, you don’t need to worry about me, so please go home. If this keeps up, something terrible is going to happen.”
“Oh? What sort of terrible thing?”
…Ciel wasn’t listening to a word I said, letting it go in one ear and out the other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, you don't have to worry about me so please go back.
Things will get ugly if we go on like this."
"Huh?
Ugly?
What do you mean by that?"
…… She doesn't even seem to be listening to me.

entries.japanese:
「―――もう、なんで人の話を聞いてくれないんだ！
　先輩、俺の好きにしていいってさっき言ってくれたじゃないか！
　なのになんでこっちの邪魔をしようっていうんだよ！」
「ですから、遠野くんは好きに行動してください。
わたしも遠野くんを見習って、自分の好きに行動しているだけですから」
　きっぱりと笑顔で言って、先輩はトコトコと先を歩き出してしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why won’t you listen to me? You just said I could do as I pleased! So why are you trying to get in my way?”
“You may do exactly as you please, Tohno. I’m merely following your example and doing as I please too.”
She said it with a decisive smile, then pattered off ahead of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Look, why don't you listen to me?
Senpai, didn't you say I could do as I wanted?
So why are you still getting in my way!?"
"Like I said, please do as you wish.
I'm also just doing as I wish myself."
Still smiling, Senpai walks ahead of me.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ―――先輩！」
「はあ。
なんでしょうか、遠野くん」
「なんでしょうか、じゃないだろ……！
　もう、そんなに俺を困らせて楽しいっていうのか！」
　ニッコリと笑う先輩。
　……どうも、俺を困らせて本当に楽しいらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait, Ciel!”
“Yes? What is it, Tohno?”
“Don’t ask me that…! Is tormenting me really this much fun?”
Ciel beamed.
It seemed she really did enjoy tormenting me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---Senpai!"
"Huh?
What is it, Tohno-kun?"
"What is it!?
Do you enjoy troubling me like this!?"
She smiles.
…… It seems she really does enjoy it.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
先輩がいじわるな人だっていうのはわかったから、今日はもう勘弁してくれ。
これ以上付いてこられると俺だけじゃなくて先輩まで危ない目にあうんだぞ」
「そうなんですか？
　わたしは別に遠野くんについてきているわけじゃありませんけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine—I get it. You’re mean, so have mercy on me and leave it at that. If you come any farther, it won’t just be me in danger—you’ll be at risk too.”
“Will I? I’m not following you, Tohno.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I get it.
I understand that you're quite a mean person, but let me off the hook for today.
If you keep following me, things will not only be dangerous for me, but for you as well."
"Oh really?
I'm not really following you or anything."

entries.japanese:
「え―――？」
「わたし、公園に用があるだけです。
遠野くんがこれから何処に行くのかは知りませんけど、行き先が公園でないのならここでお別れですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
“I simply have business at the park. I don’t know where you’re going, but if it isn’t the park, this is where we part ways.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---?"
"I simply have something to do in the park.
I don't know where you are going, Tohno-kun, but if you're not going to the park, then this is where we say goodbye."

entries.japanese:
「―――ちょっと待ってよ。
先輩、さっき俺の好きにしていいよ、って言ってくれたよね……？」
「はい、どうぞ遠野くんのお好きなようにしてください」
　先輩は笑顔で頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. You said I could do as I pleased, didn’t you…?”
“Yes—please do whatever you like, Tohno.”
Ciel nodded with a smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Wait a minute.
Senpai, didn't you say I can do as I wish……?"
"Yes, please do as you wish, Tohno-kun."
Senpai nods and smiles.

entries.japanese:
「……よかった、俺の幻聴ってわけじゃなかったんだ。
それじゃ、ここでお別れだ。
これ以上付いてきちゃダメだからな」
「はあ。
わたし、遠野くんについてきているわけじゃありませんけど」
「―――あの、先輩？」
「わたし、公園に用があるだけです。
遠野くんがこれから何処に行くのかは知りませんけど、行き先が公園でないのならここでお別れですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good, so I wasn’t hearing things. Then this is goodbye. Don’t follow me any farther.”
“Oh? I’m not following you, Tohno.”
“Ciel…?”
“I simply have business at the park. I don’t know where you’re going, but if it isn’t the park, this is where we part ways.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Good, I wasn't just imagining it.
Then, this is goodbye.
You shouldn't be following me anymore."
"Huh?
I'm not really following you or anything."
"---Um, Senpai?"
"I simply have something to do in the park.
I don't know where you are going, Tohno-kun, but if you're not going to the park, then this is where we say goodbye."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　そうきたか。
　確かにそれは、俺がとやかく言える筋合いじゃない。
　筋合いじゃないけど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
So that was her answer.
She was right: it was none of my business.
It wasn’t—but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
I see.
Certainly, I don't really have the right to say anything about that.
I don't have the right, but---

entries.japanese:
「ああもうっ、それでもダメ！
　公園にはアルクェイドがいるんだ！
　あいつが先輩のこと毛嫌いしてるのは知ってるだろ？
　なら、このまま先輩とあいつを会わせるワケにはいかないじゃないか！」
「あら。
わたしのこと心配してくれるんですか？」
「そんなのあたりまえだろ、俺は先輩とアルクェイドが争うところなんか見たくない。
もう、頼むからおとなしくこのまま帰ってくれ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, to hell with it—you still can’t go! Arcueid is in the park!
You know how much she hates you, don’t you? I can’t just let the two of you meet like this!”
“Oh? Are you worried about me?” “Of course I am! I don’t want to see you and Arcueid fighting, so please just turn around and go home!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, just don't go!
Arcueid is in the park!
You know how she detests you, right?
So I can't let the two of you meet!"
"Oh?
Are you worried about me?"
"Of course, I don't want to see the two of you fight.
I'm begging you, please just go back!"

entries.japanese:
「――はあ。
そうですか、わたしの心配じゃなくて彼女の心配をしているんですねー、遠野くんは」
　あさっての夜空を見つめながら、先輩はこっちの言い分を完全に無視した。
　……なんか、これは。
　先輩はわざと、意図的に、俺を困らせて楽しんでいるような、気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So it isn’t me you’re worried about but her, is it, Tohno?”
Ciel gazed off into the night sky, completely ignoring my argument.
…Somehow,
I had the feeling she was deliberately giving me a hard time—and enjoying every second of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Oh.
I see, you're not worried about me, but you're worried about her, right?"
Looking off into the distance, she completely ignores what I say.
…… For some reason,
it seems she is doing all this intentionally because she enjoys teasing me.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
もしかして、朝のことすごく根に持ってない……？」
　先輩はにっこりと笑うだけで、何も言わない。
　……怒ってる。
　あれは、間違いなく根に持っている顔だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel. Are you still that angry about this morning?”
She only smiled sweetly and said nothing.
She was angry.
That was unquestionably the face of someone nursing a grudge.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
Don't tell me, you're still carrying a grudge from this morning……?"
She just smiles and doesn't say anything.
…… She's angry.
That face is unmistakably carrying a grudge.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった、朝の事はこっちが一方的に悪かったよ。
アレは失言だったって謝る。
　だから―――」
「だから帰ってくれ、なんていったらはったおしますよ、遠野くん」
「………へ？」
「遠野くん。
わたしたち、いま絶交中なんです。
けんかしてるんです。
わたしも拗ねてるみたいですから、生半可なコトじゃ素直になれません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, what I said this morning was completely out of line. I’m sorry for saying it.”
“So—”
“If the next words are ‘please go home,’ I will slap you, Tohno.”
“What?”
“Tohno. We are presently not speaking to each other. We’re having a fight. Apparently I’m sulking as well, so a halfhearted apology won’t make me nice again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I get it, everything this morning was completely my fault.
I'm sorry.
So---"
"If you tell me to go back because of that, I'll beat you down Tohno-kun."
"……… Huh?"
"Tohno-kun.
We're still fighting right now.
It seems I'm still angry, so it isn't easy to just talk calmly."

entries.japanese:
「あの……先輩？」
「遠野くんが帰ってくれるんなら仲直りできるんですけど、それは無理だってわかってます。
　ですから、こんな話をしていても無意味です。
　貴方がわたしに謝る必要もありません。
わたし、朝の事は気にしていませんから」
　感情のない目をして、先輩はまっすぐに俺を見つめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel…?”
“If you went home, we could make up, but I already know you won’t.
So there is no point discussing it.
You have no need to apologize. I am not at all concerned about what happened this morning.”
Ciel looked directly at me, her eyes devoid of emotion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Senpai?"
"If you went back, we could make up, but I know that's impossible.
So this conversation is meaningless.
There is no need for you to apologize.
I'm not concerned with what happened this morning."
She looks at me with those eyes devoid of any emotion.

entries.japanese:
「わたしの役割は吸血鬼を退治すること。
それ以外のことなんて、瑣末です」
　先輩はカツカツと足音をたてて公園へ入っていく。
「ちょっ―――先輩！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My duty is to exterminate vampires. Everything else is trivial.”
Her shoes struck the pavement in brisk, hard taps as she entered the park.
“W-wait, Ciel!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"My duty is to hunt down vampires.
Anything else is trivial."
Senpai walks into the park.
"Hey---Senpai!"

entries.japanese:
先輩は公園を横断していく。
　向かう先は、やっぱり俺とアルクェイドの待ち合わせ場所みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel crossed the park.
Just as I had feared, she seemed to be heading for the place where Arcueid and I were supposed to meet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She crosses through the park.
As expected, she's heading right towards where Arcueid is waiting.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待てって、どうしてそんなにムキになってるんだよ、先輩！」
「―――わたし、ムキになんかなっていません。
貴方のほうこそ、わたしと一緒にいると彼女に誤解されるんじゃないですか」
「誤解って―――何を誤解されるっていうんだよ」
「貴方は彼女が好きなんでしょう？
　なら、彼女の敵であるわたしと一緒にいるのは立場的にまずいと思いますけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait—why are you getting so worked up over this, Ciel?”
“I am not getting worked up. You should worry that she’ll get the wrong idea if she sees you with me.”
“The wrong idea about what?”
“You like her, don’t you? In that case, being seen with her enemy would put you in a rather awkward position.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute.
Why are you so angry, Senpai!?"
"---I'm not angry.
How about yourself?
If you come with me, won't she misunderstand things?"
"Misunderstand---misunderstand what?"
"Don't you like her?
Then, I don't think you should be with me, someone who is her enemy."

entries.japanese:
「な……別に俺は、あいつの事が好きってわけじゃ……」
　わけじゃない、とは断言できなかった。
　自分自身、この感情の正体はわからないけど、たしかにアルクェイドに惹かれていると思うから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It isn’t as if I like her—”
I could not bring myself to finish the denial.
I didn’t understand my own feelings, but I knew I was drawn to Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha…… it's not like I like her……"
I can't say for sure though.
I don't know for sure what I truly feel, but I'm sure I am attracted to her.

entries.japanese:
「ほんと、自分自身にも嘘をつけないんですね貴方は。
なんか正直者すぎてまいっちゃいます」
　能面みたいだった先輩の顔が、はあ、と感情を顕にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You truly can’t lie, even to yourself. You’re so painfully honest that I don’t know what to do with you.”
Ciel’s masklike face finally cracked, releasing a weary sigh and the emotion beneath it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You really can't lie even to yourself, can you?
I think you are far too honest."
For a brief instant, her mask reveals a sigh.

entries.japanese:
「けど、本当にここで別れたほうがいいですよ。
わたしたちは絶交中なんですし、こんなところをアルクェイドに見られたら―――」
「ふうん。
見られたらどうなるのかしらね、シエル」
「――――！」
　背後から聞こえてきた声に、二人して振り向く。
　そこには―――なんか、すごく不機嫌そうなアルクェイドの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But we really should part here. We are in the middle of a quarrel, after all, and if Arcueid saw us together—”
“Oh? And what would happen if I did see you, Ciel?”
“—!”
At the voice behind us, we both turned. There stood Arcueid—looking, for some reason, spectacularly displeased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it really is better if we separate here.
We are no longer friends, and if Arcueid were to see us---"
"Hm?
What would happen, Ciel?"
"----!"
We both turn around towards the voice behind us.
There we see---Arcueid, who seems to be in a particularly bad mood.

entries.japanese:
「驚いたわ。
志貴の声が聞こえたから来てみれば、まさか貴方が一緒だなんてね。
　昨日でお互いの情報は交換しあったでしょう。
もうわたしに用はないと思うけど？」
「ええ、貴方に用などありません。
わたしは彼があんまりにも危なっかしいので指導してあげているだけです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a surprise. I heard Shiki’s voice and came over, never expecting to find you with him.
We exchanged all the information we had yesterday. You shouldn’t have any further business with me.”
“I have none. He is simply so reckless that I have been giving him some instruction.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How surprising.
I came because I heard Shiki's voice and I find you here.
Didn't we already share our information yesterday?
I don't believe you have anything to do with me anymore."
"Yes, I don't have anything to do with you anymore.
I was just pointing things out to him."

entries.japanese:
「ふーん。
人のパートナーを横取りするつもり？」
「……ええ、それもいいですね。
貴方には一度、大きな痛手をもらったままですし」
entries.maoEnglish: “Is that so? Are you planning to steal someone else’s partner?” “That might be pleasant. You still owe me for the considerable injury you dealt me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh really?
You intend on stealing my partner?"
"…… That sounds good too.
I still owe you from that one injury you gave me."

entries.japanese:
先輩とアルクェイドは、まさに一触即発状態だ。
　二人の間に立たされている者として、このまま見ているわけにはいかない。
　……実際問題として、先輩、俺、アルクェイドという位置関係だ。
　このまま二人が争いだしたら、俺はまず間違いなく巻き込まれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel and Arcueid were one breath away from violence.
As the person trapped between them, I could hardly stand and watch.
More literally, the arrangement was Ciel, me, then Arcueid.
If they started fighting, I was almost certain to be caught in the middle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The situation is critical between the two of them.
As the one standing between them, I can't just watch.
…… Looking at this problem, our relative locations are Senpai, me, then Arcueid.
And if the two of them fight, I would be right in the middle of it.

entries.japanese:
「二人とも、何睨み合ってるんだよ。
お互い目的は同じなんだから、もうちょっと冷静に……」
「志貴は黙ってて！」
「遠野くんは黙っててください！」
「―――――――」
　……失敗した。
　俺が声をかけても逆効果にしかならないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why are you two glaring at each other? You want the same thing, so try to calm down a little…”
“Stay out of this, Shiki!”
“Please stay out of this, Tohno!”
“…”
That had been a mistake.
Anything I said would only make matters worse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You two, why are you glaring at each other?
Your goal is the same, so calm down and……"
"Be quiet Shiki!"
"Please be quiet Tohno-kun!"
"-------"
…… I failed.
I tried to talk to them but it doesn't seem to have worked.

entries.japanese:
「――いいわ。
志貴は貴方のことが大事らしいから、見逃してあげる。
　手は出さないから今すぐここから消えなさい」
「……驚きましたね。
貴方にとって彼はそんなに重要な人間なんですか。
　アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドは吸血鬼殺し以外になんの関心ももたないと思っていましたが」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. Shiki apparently cares about you, so I’ll let you go.
I won’t touch you, so leave now.”
“I am surprised. Is he truly so important to you?
I thought Arcueid Brunestud took no interest in anything beyond killing vampires.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Fine.
Shiki seems to care for you, so I will let you go.
I won't attack you so just disappear."
"…… That's surprising.
Is he that important to you?
I didn't think Arcueid Brunestud could be concerned with anything other than killing vampires."

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
「貴方にしてみれば、人間なんて思い通りに操れるでしょう。
　彼に協力させるならいっそ下僕にしてしまえばいいのに、どうしてそれをしないんです、アルクェイド」
「―――出来の悪い冗談はやめて。
志貴はわたしのパートナーよ。
　そんなコトをしなくても、わたしの手助けをしてくれるって言ったもの」
　気まずそうにアルクェイドは視線をそらす。
　そこには、さっきまで満ちていた殺気がまるでなくなってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“Humans should be easy for you to bend to your will.
If you require his help, why not make him your thrall instead, Arcueid?”
“That isn’t even a good joke. Shiki is my partner.
He said he would help me without any of that.”
Arcueid looked away, suddenly uncomfortable.
Every trace of the murderous tension that had filled her a moment ago was gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
"For you, controlling humans comes easily.
It would be better for you to just make him your servant if you wanted help, Arcueid, but why haven't you done that?"
"---Don't joke about such things.
Shiki is my partner.
Even if I don't do that, he still says he will help me."
Arcueid looks away uneasily.
That murderous intent seems to have disappeared.

entries.japanese:
「―――アルクェイド。
貴方、まさか」
「ほんとうに―――彼の血を欲しがってしまってるんですね」
　カチャリ、と。
　先輩のほうから、硬い金属音が聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid. Don’t tell me…”
“You truly do crave his blood.”
There was a hard metallic click.
It came from Ciel’s direction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Arcueid.
Don't tell me, you…"
"You---really want to suck his blood?"
Cling.
From Senpai's direction I hear the sound of solid metal.

entries.japanese:
「……そうですか。
貴方が人間に興味を持つなんて意外でしたけど、まあわたしにとってはどうでもいい問題です。
　ただ、貴方が人の血を欲しているのなら、やる事は一つだけです」
　キン、と先輩の手の平が音をたてる。
　そこには何本もの長い釘みたいな剣があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. I never expected you to take an interest in a human, but that is no concern of mine.
If you desire human blood, however, there is only one thing for me to do.”
Metal rang in Ciel’s palm.
Several long, nail-like swords had appeared there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
I was surprised you were interested in humans, but that does not really matter.
If you desire the blood of humans, then there is only one thing to do."
Cling.
The sound springs forth from her hand.
Numerous swords, like long nails, are there.

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっ、先輩……！？」
「遠野くんは下がっていてください。
　たったいま、彼女を吸血鬼と確認しました。
たとえ教会に協力している真祖といえど、血を吸うモノになったのならわたしたちの害敵です。
　この場で、犠牲者を出す前に処理します」
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait, Ciel…!?”
“Stay back, Tohno.
I have just confirmed that she is a vampire. Even a True Ancestor who cooperates with the Holy Church becomes our enemy once she begins to drink blood.
I will dispose of her here, before she can claim a victim.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey, Senpai……!?"
"Tohno-kun, please back away.
Just now, I have confirmed that she truly is a vampire.
Even if she is a True Ancestor that cooperates with The Church, once she desires blood, she becomes our enemy.
Before any victims appear, I will terminate her here."

entries.japanese:
「―――黙って聞いていれば言いたい放題いってくれるわねシエル。
　いいわ、死にたいっていうんなら望み通り殺してあげる。
同じ人間を二回殺すなんて滅多にないことだしね」
　アルクェイドの目に殺気がともる。
　先輩も剣を構えたまま、アルクェイドの視線を受け止めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve listened quietly while you said whatever you pleased, Ciel.
Fine—if you want to die, I’ll grant your wish. One rarely gets to kill the same human twice.”
Murder kindled in Arcueid’s eyes.
Ciel held her swords ready and met that gaze without flinching.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---You really do speak nonsense when people do not answer you, Ciel.
Very well, if you want to die, then I will grant your wish and kill you.
It's not often I get to kill the same person twice."
Her eyes flare with the intent to kill.
Senpai receives Arcueid's stare in her fighting stance, swords at the ready.

entries.japanese:
キィン、と。
　公園中の空気が凍りつくような、息苦しいまでの緊張感。
―――まずい。
　このままだと二人は本当に殺しあう。
entries.maoEnglish:
A high metallic note rang out.
The air throughout the park froze beneath a tension so dense it was hard to breathe.
―――This was bad.
In another moment, they would truly try to kill each other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Freezing.
The air feels like it is freezing, and I can hardly breathe.
---This isn't good.
They really will kill each other like this.

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっと待ってくれ二人とも。
少しは冷静になれって言ってるだろ……！」
　張り詰めた空気に気おされないよう、腹に力をこめて怒鳴る。
「――――」
「――――」
　二人の呼吸が、一瞬だけ止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Both of you, wait. I told you to calm down…!”
Bracing myself against the pressure in the air, I drew breath from deep in my belly and shouted.
“…”
“…”
For one instant, both of them stopped breathing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait you two, please.
I said to calm down……!"
Ignoring the tension in the air, I yell out.
"----"
"----"
For an instant, they both stop.

entries.japanese:
その後に、ダン、と地面を蹴る音が二つ。
―――俺の怒声が最後の引き金になったのか。
　白い影と黒い影は、寄せ合う磁極のように衝突した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then came two simultaneous cracks as their feet struck the ground.
―――Perhaps my shout had pulled the final trigger.
The white shadow and the black collided like opposite magnetic poles snapping together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After that, the sound of two feet kicking the earth.
---My shout must have triggered the start.
The white and black figures crash into each other as if they were two magnets of opposite polarity.

entries.japanese:
二人の戦いは、正直俺の理解の及ぶところではなかった。
　アルクェイドの体の動きは、とてもじゃないけど目で追っていけない。
　ただ、夜の闇に白い残像が流れていっているようにしか見えない。
　驚くべきなのは、そんなアルクェイドを前にして一歩も引かない先輩の姿だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Their battle lay frankly beyond my comprehension.
Arcueid moved far too quickly for my eyes to follow.
All I saw was a stream of white afterimages through the night.
What astonished me was that Ciel refused to yield a single step before her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The fight between the two of them is beyond me.
Arcueid's body movement isn't something I can track with my eyes.
All I can see is a white blur running through the night.
What's surprising is that Senpai does not even back off seeing Arcueid's speed.

entries.japanese:
先輩は別段、アルクェイドのように常識外れのスピードとか動きをするわけじゃない。
　ちゃんと地面に足をつけて、的確に矢のようなアルクェイドの猛攻をさばいている。
　第三者的に見て、二人の戦闘能力は伯仲している。
　けれど、先輩自身が口にしていたとおり、アルクェイドの能力というものに限界はないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel possessed none of Arcueid’s impossible speed or motion.
Her feet remained firmly on the ground as she met and deflected every stroke of that arrow-fast assault.
From where I stood, they seemed evenly matched.
But as Ciel herself had said, there appeared to be no ceiling to Arcueid’s power.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's not like Senpai moves with Arcueid's amazing speed.
But she accurately deflects Arcueid's blazing attacks while standing on the ground.
As a third person looking on, their strengths are equal.
However, just like Senpai said, Arcueid's power seems limitless.

entries.japanese:
いくら先輩がすごいって言っても、それは一定以上に伸びていくものじゃない。
　なのにアルクェイドのヤツときたら、まるで際限というものがない。
　初めは先輩に圧されていたくせに、すぐに先輩と互角になって、今では先輩の力を軽く上回ってしまっている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
However extraordinary Ciel was, her strength could not continue rising forever.
Arcueid, on the other hand, seemed to possess no limit at all.
Ciel had driven her back at first, only for Arcueid to match her and now surpass her with ease—
entries.mirrorMoon:
No matter how amazing Senpai is, her power is not something that goes beyond a certain point.
In contrast, Arcueid seems limitless.
In the beginning, Senpai was overwhelming her, but Arcueid matches her quickly and is now easily surpassing her powers---

entries.japanese:
勝敗はすぐに決した。
　先輩の体が軽く宙にういて、ダン、とゴミのように地面に転がる。
entries.maoEnglish:
The battle was decided almost immediately.
Ciel’s body floated lightly into the air, then struck the ground and rolled like a piece of refuse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The fight is quickly decided.
Senpai's body flies lightly on the air and strikes the ground rolling, like a piece of trash.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――」
　うめき声をあげて先輩は立ちあがる。
　でも、それも無駄な抵抗。
　先輩の体は見えない何かに弾かれたように、一層大きく宙に浮いて、地面に倒れこむ。
　先輩は倒れこんだまま動かない。
　じわりと。
公園のレンガ道に広がっていく、赤い血液。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kh—”
Ciel groaned and forced herself upright.
But even that was futile.
As though struck by something invisible, Ciel was hurled still higher and crashed back to earth.
She lay where she had fallen, motionless.
Slowly. Red blood spread across the park’s brick path.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ka---"
Senpai lets out a cry and stands up.
But that is a useless thing to do.
Senpai's body seems to be shot out by an invisible cannon and flies into the air once more, and hits the ground.
She lies there, not moving.
Blood flows along the park's brick pathway.

entries.japanese:
「先―――輩？」
　返事はない。
　先輩は倒れこんだまま、意識がない。
　そこへ――――容赦なく、それこそ先輩の首でもかき切るような冷酷な目をして、アルクェイドが走りよっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ci—el?”
No answer.
Ciel lay unconscious.
Arcueid rushed toward her without mercy, her eyes cold enough to cut her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sen---pai?"
There's no response.
She seems unconscious.
Arcueid runs towards her----without any mercy, with terrible eyes seemingly bent on slicing Senpai's neck.

entries.japanese:
「――――――あ」
　声が出ない。
　アルクェイドは間違いなく先輩を『殺す』つもりだ。
　そして、先輩にはそれを防ぐ力がない。
「――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
My voice would not come.
Arcueid unquestionably meant to “kill” Ciel,
and Ciel no longer had the power to stop her.
“…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
I can't speak.
There can be no mistake that Arcueid intends to kill her.
And Senpai can't defend herself.
"------"

entries.japanese:
そんなコト、俺は。
　許せるはずが、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
That—I could not.
I could never allow it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't.
I can't allow that.

entries.japanese:
「―――やめろ、この大馬鹿ヤロウ……！」
　ただもう、夢中になって先輩の前に走りよった。
　目前まで迫っていたアルクェイドの動きがピタリと止まる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop, you goddamn idiot…!”
Without thinking, I ran and threw myself in front of Ciel. Arcueid had nearly reached us, but now she stopped dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Stop it, you stupid idiot……!"
I frantically run towards Senpai.
Arcueid suddenly stops in front of her.

entries.japanese:
「志貴！？」
　あれだけ殺気を帯びていたアルクェイドが、一瞬にしてもとの顔つきに戻る。
　彼女にとって、俺が先輩を庇うというのはそれだけ意外なことだったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!?”
In an instant, the murderous cast vanished from Arcueid’s face.
Had the idea that I might shield Ciel truly been so inconceivable to her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki!?"
Arcueid's murderous intent instantly vanishes and she returns to her original look.
She seems completely taken aback that I was protecting Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「なんで？
　どうして志貴がそいつを庇うの……！？」
「……言っただろ。
先輩は俺にとって大事な人なんだ。
いくらおまえでも―――これ以上先輩に手をあげたら許さないからな」
　ぎゅっ、とポケットの中のナイフを握り締めてアルクェイドを睨みつける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why? Why are you protecting her…!?”
“I told you. Ciel matters to me. Even if it’s you—I won’t forgive you if you hurt her again.”
I closed my hand tightly around the knife in my pocket and glared at Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why?
How come you're protecting her……!?"
"…… Didn't I say it earlier?
Senpai is a very dear person to me.
Even if it's you---I won't allow you to go on."
I tighten the grip on the knife in my pocket and glare at Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴、あなた―――」
　アルクェイドの目が殺気を帯びていく。
「退いて。
今ならまだ許してあげる。
　早く。
そんなヤツを庇うのはやめて、わたしにそのナイフを向けないで」
　アルクェイドの赤い目が、蝋燭の火みたいにゆらいでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, you—”
Murder returned to Arcueid’s eyes.
“Move. I’ll still forgive you if you move now.
Hurry. Stop protecting her, and don’t point that knife at me.”
Her red eyes wavered like candle flames.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki, you---"
