Her eyes are bathed again with hostility.
"Step aside and I'll forgive you this time.
Now.
Stop defending her and don't wield that knife against me."
Her crimson eyes waver like burning candles.

entries.japanese:
彼女の殺気は先輩にではなく、今は俺に、向けられようとしている。
　ごくり、と喉が動く。
　いますぐ退かないととり返しのつかないコトになるって本能が警告を鳴らしている。
　けど、それでも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Her murderous intent was leaving Ciel and turning toward me.
I swallowed.
Instinct screamed that unless I moved now, something irreversible would happen.
Even so—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her intent to kill is about to be directed towards me instead of Senpai.
I gulp.
My mind is warning me that it's over if I don't step aside at once.
But, even still---

entries.japanese:
「………ダメだ。
おまえが先輩に手をあげないって言うまで、退かない」
「―――退きなさい、志貴！」
「おまえこそ引けアルクェイド……！
　おまえは俺に言ったじゃないか、人間は殺さないって。
　それとも、あれは俺を安心させるための嘘だったっていうのか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I won’t move until you promise you won’t hurt her.”
“Move, Shiki!”
“You back down, Arcueid…! You told me you don’t kill humans.
Or was that only a lie to put me at ease…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… I can't.
I won't pull back until you say you won't do anything to Senpai."
"---Step aside, Shiki!"
"No, you step aside, Arcueid……!
Didn't you tell me that you don't kill humans?
Or, was that just a lie……!?"

entries.japanese:
「――――ええ。
わたしは人間は殺さない。
　けど人間の規格を大きくはずれたヤツには敬意を表してる。
だから対等の存在として殺すこともいとわないわ。
　例えば貴方や、そこの女みたいな相手はね」
　一歩。
　アルクェイドが、踏み込んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I do not kill humans.
But I respect those who fall far outside human limits. I recognize them as equals, and I have no objection to killing an equal.
People like you—or that woman behind you.”
One step.
Arcueid advanced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No, I don't kill humans.
But I honor those who surpass human capacity.
So I don't mind killing them as something that is my equal.
Such as you, or that woman right there."
A step.
Arcueid comes closer.

entries.japanese:
「そう―――貴方はまたわたしにナイフを向けるんだ、志貴」
　さらに一歩。
　アルクェイドは無造作に近寄ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So—you’re pointing a knife at me again, Shiki.”
Another step.
Arcueid approached without the slightest caution.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see---you're wielding that knife against me again."
Another step.
She draws closer.

entries.japanese:
「一度目は許した。
けど二度目を許せる自信はないわ。
……もっとも、貴方のナイフじゃわたしは傷つかないでしょうけどね。
　いくら貴方の直死の眼でも、今のわたしから死を読み取ることはできないでしょう？」
　真正面から。
　金の瞳が、俺の眼球に飛び込んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I forgave you once. I’m not sure I can forgive you twice. Though that knife of yours probably can’t hurt me now.
Even with your Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, you can’t read death from me as I am now, can you?”
Straight ahead.
Her golden eyes drove into mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I forgave you the first time.
But I don't think I can forgive you the second time.
…… In the first place, I don't think I can be hurt with your knife.
Even with your Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, you shouldn't be able to see my death right now."
From directly in front of me,
her golden eyes enter my vision.

entries.japanese:
「――――ア」
　心臓が止まったかと思うほどの、緊張。
　背骨がまるごと引き剥がされるような悪寒。
　ネロの時なんかとは比べ物にならない、自分以外のもの全てに睨まれているような、圧倒的な絶望感。
　……何も、できない。
　これが―――アルクェイドを敵に回すっていう、コトなの、か―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Tension so absolute I thought my heart had stopped.
A chill like my entire spine being ripped from my body.
Despair beyond anything Nrvnqsr had inspired—the crushing sensation that everything in existence except me had turned its gaze upon me.
I could do nothing.
So this was what it meant to make an enemy of Arcueid—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
My heart feels like it's stopped.
A chill races up my spine.
This crushing despair that feels like everything is bearing down on me is far greater than anything during my fight with Nrvnqsr.
…… I can't, do anything.
This is---what it means, to fight, Arcueid?---

entries.japanese:
「志貴、これが最後よ。
まだ貴方の意識が残っているあいだにそこから離れて。
　わたし、そんな女のために初めて気に入った相手を、失いたくなんかない」
――――ぞくん、と首筋に悪寒が集中する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, this is your last chance. Move away while you still have enough consciousness to do it.
I don’t want to lose the first person I’ve ever taken a liking to because of a woman like her.”
――――A violent chill gathered at the nape of my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, this is your last chance.
While I can still think, get back.
I don't want to lose the first person I've liked, just because of that woman."
----The chills collect in my neck.

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドは、もうすぐさま俺を殺せる位置にいる。
　その腕が動けば、俺のナイフなんかより早くこの首を斬断する。
　それでも―――こんなのは、違う。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid was already close enough to kill me instantly.
If her arm moved, it would sever my neck before my knife could reach her.
Even so—this was wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid is in the perfect position to kill me.
If that arm moves, she can rip off my neck before I could use my knife.
Even still---this is wrong.

entries.japanese:
「……なんで。
俺にはわからない、アルクェイド。
どうして先輩にだけ、おまえはそんなに酷いヤツになっちまうんだ。
　そりゃあたしかにおまえは一般道徳が欠けてたけど、そんな簡単に人を殺すとか、そんな事を口にするヤツじゃなかっただろう……！？」
「志貴――――」
　アルクェイドの殺気が薄れた。
　彼女はそのまま、ふらりと、俺と先輩から離れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why? I don’t understand, Arcueid. Why do you become so cruel only when it comes to Ciel?
Your sense of ordinary morality was missing a few pieces, sure, but you weren’t someone who talked so easily about killing people…!”
“Shiki…”
Arcueid’s murderous intent ebbed.
Unsteadily, she drifted back from Ciel and me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why, I just don't understand, Arcueid.
Why are you such a horrible person only to Senpai?
I know you're not the most aware of moral principles, but you're not one to speak about killing people so easily……!"
"Shiki----"
Arcueid's hostility starts to lessen.
She walks away from the both of us.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
その女の肩を持つのなら、志貴なんか知らない」
「あ―――アルクェイド……？」
「せいぜい気をつけることね、志貴。
　志貴が庇ったその女は、志貴が思っているようなまっとうな人間じゃないんだから」
「なにを―――なにを言ってるんだよ、おまえ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. If you’re taking that woman’s side, then I’m done with you.”
“Arcueid?”
“You had better watch yourself, Shiki.
That woman you protected is not the decent human being you think she is.”
“What are you—what are you talking about?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
If you support her this much, then I don't know you."
"A---Arcueid……?"
"Just be careful, Shiki.
That woman you are protecting, she isn't the person you think she is."
"What---what are you saying?"

entries.japanese:
「ふんだ、志貴なんかその女に騙されて血を吸われちゃえばいいんだ。
　じゃあね！
　あとでわたしに泣きついてきても聞いてあげないんだから！」
　アルクェイドは振りかえらずに公園から消えていく。
　あとに残ったのは俺と、傷ついて倒れこんでいる先輩だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmph, go ahead and let her deceive you and suck your blood.
Goodbye! And don’t come crying to me afterward, because I won’t listen!”
Arcueid left the park without looking back.
Only Ciel and I remained, Ciel wounded and crumpled on the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmph.
You can be tricked and get your blood sucked by her.
So long!
Don't come crying back to me!"
Arcueid walks away without even looking back.
The only ones left are me and the wounded, collapsed Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「――――あいつ、なにを――――」
　ばかなコトを、言ってたんだ。
　先輩が俺の血を吸うって……？
「―――なにつまんないウソを、言ってるんだ」
　それじゃあまるで。
「―――先輩が、吸血鬼みたいじゃないか」
　呟いて、思わず笑ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What was she talking about—”
What a ridiculous thing to say.
Ciel, drinking my blood…?
“What a stupid lie.”
That would make it sound as though.
“Ciel were some kind of vampire.”
I murmured it—and despite myself, I laughed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----What was she?----"
Saying such stupid things.
Senpai would suck my blood……?
"---What a, ridiculous, lie."
That sounds like…
"---Senpai is a vampire or something."
Saying that, I laugh aloud.

entries.japanese:
だってそんなコト、万に一つもありえない。
　先輩は昼間でもちゃんと歩いていた。
　そりゃあアルクェイドも昼間に歩ける吸血鬼だけど、あいつでさえ昼間は弱くなる。
　その点、先輩は昼間も夜も変わらない。
　第一、先輩は教会っていうところの人間じゃないか。
　吸血鬼退治の組織に、吸血鬼がいるなんて矛盾している。
entries.maoEnglish:
There wasn’t one chance in ten thousand that it could be true.
Ciel walked around perfectly well in daylight.
Arcueid was a vampire who could do the same, but even she grew weaker during the day.
Ciel never changed, whether by day or night.
Besides, Ciel belonged to that organization called the Church.
A vampire in an institution devoted to hunting vampires would be a contradiction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Because that isn't possible.
Senpai walks around during the day.
Well, Arcueid is a vampire that walks around at daytime, but even she gets weak then.
But for Senpai, she doesn't change whether it's night or day.
First of all, isn't Senpai a member of The Church?
It's contradicting for a vampire to be in an organization whose purpose is to terminate vampires.

entries.japanese:
「―――って、そんな事より先輩！」
　振り返って先輩の容体を確かめる。
　さっきまで地面を血に染めていたぐらいだから、今すぐ病院につれていかない、と………
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, forget that—Ciel!”
I turned to check her condition.
She had spilled enough blood to stain the ground, so if I didn’t take her to a hospital immediately—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!
More importantly, Senpai!"
I turn around to check on Senpai.
The ground was soaked in blood , so I have to get her to a hospital………

entries.japanese:
「………………え」
　血が―――消えてる。
　あんなに、先輩の黒い法衣が真っ赤に染まるぐらい流れていた血だまりが、キレイさっぱりなくなっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
The blood was gone.
The pool had been vast enough to dye Ciel’s black habit scarlet, yet now it had vanished without a trace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Eh?"
The blood---has disappeared.
Her black robes that were painted red with flowing blood are now spotless.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　先輩は何事もなかったように立ちあがっている。
　ここにあるのは、ただ無傷なままの先輩の姿だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Ciel was rising as though nothing had happened. All that remained before me was her unharmed body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Senpai stands up as if nothing even happened and she looks completely unharmed.

entries.japanese:
「先輩――これ、どうし、て」
「……遠野くん。
どうしてわたしを庇ったんですか。
彼女が本気で遠野くんを殺そうとしてたって、わかっていた筈なのに」
　先輩の目には感情というものがない。
　俺の質問なんて。
俺の姿さえ見えていない、人形のような虚ろな目。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel—how did…?”
“Tohno. Why did you protect me? You must have known she truly meant to kill you.”
Ciel’s eyes held no emotion.
My question meant nothing to her. Her eyes were as vacant as a doll’s, seeing neither it nor even my presence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai--what is going on?"
"…… Tohno-kun.
Why did you protect me?
Didn't you know she really almost killed you?"
Her eyes have no emotion whatsoever.
With those vacant eyes, like a lifeless doll, she doesn't even hear my question.

entries.japanese:
「どうしてって、先輩が殺されかけたんだ。
誰だって庇うだろ、あの場合は」
「自分が殺されるっていうのに？
　遠野くん、献身とは自分の命を投げ出す事ではありません。
　自分の命を蔑ろにして他者の命を救おうというのは、献身でも犠牲でもなく、ただの自己愛です。
　貴方は―――どうして、そう――――」
　先輩の声は厳しい。
　厳しく俺に忠告している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why? Anyone would’ve protected you when you were about to be killed.”
“Even at the cost of your own death? Tohno, devotion does not mean throwing away your life.
To treat your own life as worthless in order to save another is neither devotion nor sacrifice, but mere self-love.
Why must you always—why are you so—”
Ciel’s voice was stern.
She was giving me a serious warning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You ask why?
Because you were going to die.
Anyone would do the same thing in that situation."
"Even if it means getting yourself killed?
Tohno-kun, dedication isn't throwing away your life.
Giving up your life to save others isn't dedication or sacrifice, it's just self-love.
Why---did, you----"
Her voice is very stern.
She admonishes me severely.

entries.japanese:
「貴方は、ただ自分が後悔したくないためにあんなマネをして、それで満足しているんですね。
　……はっきり言って、すごく、迷惑です。
　正しく生きようとするのは立派ですが、貴方の身勝手な正しさに、わたしを巻き込まないでください」
「なっ―――なんだよそれ。
俺はただ先輩に死んでなんかほしくなかっただけだ……！
　それが、それが迷惑だっていうのか！？
　先輩はあのままアルクェイドに殺されていても良かったっていうのかよ―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You did that merely to spare yourself regret, and now you are satisfied with yourself.
To be perfectly honest, it is an intolerable nuisance.
Your desire to live rightly may be admirable, but do not involve me in your selfish righteousness.”
“What—what the hell is that supposed to mean? I just didn’t want you to die…!
You call that a nuisance? Are you saying you would’ve preferred Arcueid to kill you!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You only did that so you would not regret it later.
And you are satisfied with just that.
…… To be blunt, it is very troublesome for me.
Idealism is a fine thing, but please don't involve me in your selfish justice."
"Wha---what do you mean?
I just didn't want you to die, Senpai……!
Are you, are you saying that's troublesome!?
Are you saying it would be alright if Arcueid killed you like that---!?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
わたしの命なんですから、貴方にどうこう言われるモノではないはずです。
　……吸血鬼にお情けで見逃されて生き延びるなんて、無様すぎます」
「―――――！」
　頭にきた。
　庇ったあげくに拒絶された事もある。
　けど、なにより―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. It is my life, so you have no right to interfere with what I do with it.
Surviving because a vampire took pity on me would be too humiliating.”
“—!”
Rage surged through me.
Partly because she had rejected me after I protected her.
But more than anything—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
It is my life, so it has nothing to do with you.
…… It's too miserable being allowed to live because of the mercy of a vampire."
"-----!"
I'm pissed.
Partly because she rejected me even after I protected her.
But, more than that---

entries.japanese:
「ふざけんなっ……！
　自分の命を――自分の命をなんだと思ってるんだ、先輩は！
　いいか、死んだらそれまでなんだぞ！？
　どんなに酷くて、どんなにみっともない事をしてでも生きていなくちゃ嘘だ！
　生きていなくちゃ……生きていなくちゃ何もないんだ。
　無様でもいいじゃないか。
それを感じられなくなるより、ずっとずっと何倍もいい………！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t give me that…! What do you think your life is worth, Ciel?
Listen to me: once you’re dead, that’s the end!
No matter how horrible or humiliating it gets, you have to stay alive!
If you aren’t alive—if you aren’t alive, there’s nothing.
So what if it’s humiliating? That’s infinitely better than losing the ability to feel anything at all…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't be ridiculous……!
What--what do you think your life is!?
Don't you see?
If you die, it's all over!
No matter what horrible, awful things you've done, if you don't keep on living, it will have all been a lie!
You have to keep on living…… you have to keep on living because there's nothing else.
So what if you're miserable?
That's far, far better than not being able to feel that at all………!"

entries.japanese:
「―――そうでしたね。
貴方は八年前に一度死にかけた人でした。
だから―――そんな単純な考えで満足できるんです」
　先輩は虚ろな瞳のまま。
　俺も、自分さえも見えていないような目で、そう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course. You are the person who nearly died once, eight years ago. That is why such a simple answer is enough to satisfy you.”
Ciel’s eyes remained empty.
She spoke with eyes that seemed unable to see me—or even herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That's right.
You are someone who tasted death eight years ago.
That's why---you can be content with such a simple way of thinking."
Her eyes are completely vacant.
She speaks without looking at me, like she can't even see herself.

entries.japanese:
「幸せなひと。
そんな言葉は、わたしには言えません」
　言って、先輩は俺を見たまま、後ろに下がった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re fortunate. I could never say those words.”
Still looking at me, Ciel stepped backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How happy you must be.
I cannot say such words."
She steps back as she speaks.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん。
さっき彼女が言っていた事は、本当です」
「なっ……なにを、先輩まで、そんな……」
「アルクェイドの言うとおり、わたしは人間とは呼べません。
　遠野くんも見たでしょう？
　さっきまであんなにこぼれていた血が、まるで無かったことのように消え去ってしまっているのを」
「それは――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. What she said earlier was true.”
“What—why are you saying something like that too?”
“Arcueid was right; I cannot properly be called human.
You saw it yourself, didn’t you? All the blood I spilled vanished as though it had never existed.”
“But that—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun.
What she said before is true."
"Wh…… why are, you, even saying……"
"Like Arcueid said, I cannot be called human.
Didn't you see it, Tohno-kun?
All the blood which was spilled disappeared like it was never there."
"That's----"

entries.japanese:
「いいんです。
わたし、化け物なんです。
　わたしは吸血種ではないんですけど、普通の、人間らしい体をしているわけでもないですから」
　先輩はうつむいたままで、そんな言葉を口にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right. I’m a monster.
I am not one of the vampiric species, but neither do I possess an ordinary human body.”
Ciel spoke with her head bowed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's fine.
I am a monster.
I am not a vampire, but my body, it isn't like that of a normal human."

Senpai looks down as she speaks.

entries.japanese:
「……なに……言ってるんだよ先輩。
人間らしい体って、先輩はじゅうぶん普通じゃないか……！」
「これでも、ですか？」
　先輩はゆっくりと、自らの剣を自分の首筋にあてる。
「せ、先輩……！」
　止めるのも間に合わない。
　ざくっ、と音をたてて剣が首筋に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about, Ciel? Your body looks perfectly normal…!”
“Even after this?”
Slowly, Ciel raised one of her own swords to her throat.
“C-Ciel…!”
I had no time to stop her.
With a wet crunch, the blade sank into her neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What…… are you saying Senpai?
Not a body like a human's?
You seem normal to me……!"
"Even if it's like this?"
Senpai slowly takes her sword and places it against her neck.
"Se, Senpai……!"
I don't even have time to stop her.
With a clean sound, it slices into her neck.

entries.japanese:
びしゃあ、と。
　眼球に染みこんでくるような、鮮やかな朱色が散った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Blood burst outward.
A brilliant vermilion, vivid enough to soak straight through my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Splat.
As if painting my very eyes, fresh blood sprays everywhere.

entries.japanese:
どく
　どくどく
　どくどくどくどくどく
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump
Thump, thump
Thump-thump-thump-thump-thump
entries.mirrorMoon:
Drip.
Drip drip.
Drip drip.
Drip drip.
Drip.

entries.japanese:
美しい。
　視界も意識も奪うような鮮血が、だらだらと黒い法衣を染めていく。
　あの法衣のした。
　先輩の白い裸体に流れていく紅は、さぞ麗しい傾斜した美を顕にしているだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Beautiful.
The flood of brilliant blood, enough to steal sight and thought, soaked slowly through her black habit.
Beneath that habit.
Across Ciel’s naked white body, the red must be tracing a lovely downward curve—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's beautiful.
Captivating my vision, even my whole consciousness, the blood seeps into her black garments.
Underneath her robes,
Senpai's white skin is probably mixed with those beautiful crimson lines---

entries.japanese:
チッ、と指に血が飛び散ってきた。
　なにか、一瞬心を奪われていたけれど、それで現実が戻ってきた。
　目の前には。
血に濡れていく先輩の姿がある。
「先輩……！」
　慌てて先輩に駆け寄る。
「あわてる必要はないです。
ほら、見てください」
entries.maoEnglish:
A fleck of blood struck my finger.
I had lost myself for a moment, but that tiny touch restored reality.
Before me. Ciel stood drenched in blood.
“Ciel…!”
I rushed toward her.
“There is no need to panic. Look.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
A drop of blood flies forth and lands on my finger.
It releases me from my momentary captivity and returns me to reality.
Before me is Senpai's blood-soaked figure.
"Senpai……!"
I quickly dash towards her.
"There is no need to panic.
See, look at it."

entries.japanese:
先輩は俺を止めて、自らの首元を指差す。
　……傷は、とうに塞がっていた。
　そればかりかあれほど流れていた血がまったく無くなっている。
　まるで、ビデオの映像を巻き戻しにするように、何もかもモトに戻っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel stopped me and pointed to her throat.
The wound had already closed.
Even the blood that had poured from it was disappearing.
Everything returned to its former state as though someone were rewinding a videotape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She stops me and points to her neck.
…… The wound is already gone.
And all the blood that was there before has vanished too.
Like a video being rewound, everything returns to the way it was before.

entries.japanese:
―――それは。
　蘇生や治癒というより、本当に『巻き戻る』という表現がピッタリくるような、異状な時間だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It was.
An impossible interval of time—less like resurrection or healing than a literal rewinding.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That was,
strange, and something like the word "rewound" truly describes it, not healing or regeneration.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　言葉がない。
　こんなものを見せられて―――まだ先輩はまともだよ、なんて言えるほど、俺はぶっ飛んだ精神をしてくれてはいなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I had no words.
After witnessing that, I was not deranged enough to insist that Ciel was still perfectly normal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
I can't speak.
After seeing that---I'm not crazy enough to tell her that she is still normal.

entries.japanese:
「……はい、このとおりです。
出来ることなら、遠野くんには知られたくなかったですけど」
　先輩はどこか寂しそうに、笑った。
　俺は
　何を言っていいかわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, as you can see. If I could have, I would have kept this from you, Tohno.”
Ciel smiled, but there was something lonely in it.
I had no idea
what to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's how it is.
If I could've helped it, I didn't want for you to know, Tohno-kun."
Senpai gives a sad smile.
I
don't know what to say.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くんの言ってたとおりなんです。
　わたしは貴方のことを騙してましたから。
あんなふうに怒られても、それは仕方のないことなんです」
「………………あ」
　でも、先輩を責められない。
　こんなコト―――俺だって、出来ればずっと隠し通してほしかった。
　このまま……先輩のままで、いてほしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You were right about me, Tohno.
I deceived you. I can hardly blame you for being angry.”
“…”
But I couldn’t condemn her.
If it were up to me, something like this would have stayed hidden forever.
I wanted her to go on being the Ciel I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Just like you said, Tohno-kun.
I was deceiving you this whole time.
So it can't be helped if you get angry at me."
"……………… Ah."
But, I can't blame her.
Something like that---even I wanted her to hide it from me forever.

I wanted her…… to stay like the old Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「けど、今日の朝のことは後悔してません。
　遠野くんがわたしとの思い出が楽しかったって。
　できるんなら守りたかったって言ってくれて、嬉しかった」
「―――先、輩」
　だって、それは。
　本当に、ずっと続けばいいと思うぐらい、穏やかな時間だったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I don’t regret this morning.
You told me you’d treasured the time we shared. You said that if you could, you wanted to preserve it.”
“Ciel…”
Because it had been.
A time so peaceful I truly wished it could last forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I do not regret what happened this morning.
I was really happy that you said it was a fun time together and that you wanted to protect me if you could."
"---Sen, pai."
But, those were,
really, peaceful times I wanted to last forever.

entries.japanese: 「さよなら」
entries.maoEnglish: “Goodbye.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Farewell."

entries.japanese:
最後にいつもの笑顔をうかべて、先輩は俺の前からかき消えた。
「――――――」
　頭が、ぐちゃぐちゃに、回っている。
　先輩の後を追えない。
　アルクェイドは先輩のことを吸血鬼だと言って。
　先輩はそれを否定もせず、いっそう確かな証拠を残して、さよならと消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
With one last familiar smile, Ciel vanished from before my eyes.
“…”
My thoughts churned into a shapeless mess.
I couldn’t go after her.
Arcueid had called her a vampire.
and Ciel had left behind even stronger proof without denying it, said goodbye, and disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
To the very end she gives her perpetual smile and disappears before my very eyes.
"------"
My mind is in complete disarray.
I can't follow after her.
Arcueid said that Senpai was a vampire.
Senpai didn't deny it, and even showed me proof, and after saying farewell, she vanished.

entries.japanese:
嘘でも。
　たとえすぐに見破れるような嘘でも良かったから、そんなコトはないって言ってくれれば、それだけで良かったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even a lie would have been enough.
Even one I could see through at once would have been enough, if only she had told me it wasn’t true.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even if it was a lie.
Even if it was a lie that could easily be seen through, if she simply said it wasn't so, things would have been fine.

entries.japanese:
あの、悲しそうな顔が、離れない。
　あんなに人のいい先輩が。
　ただの、学校の先輩のはずのひとが。
　こんなに遠いひとだったなんて、知りたくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I couldn’t shake that sorrowful face.
Ciel, who had always been so kind.
The girl who was only supposed to be an older student at my school.
I never wanted to learn how impossibly far away she was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't forget her sad face.
Senpai, who was that good of a person,
just an upperclassman at my school,
I didn't want to know she was such a different person.

entries.japanese:
―――さよなら。
　最後の台詞。
　その意味を考えるまでもない。
　先輩の正体を知ったり、先輩を傷つけたりしたけど、それでも先輩は会いに来てくれた。
　けど、それも終わり。
　こんなに―――もう、出会えないってはっきり実感できるなんて、したくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Goodbye.
Her final word.
I didn’t need to wonder what it meant.
I had learned what she was and hurt her, yet she had still come to see me.
But now even that was over.
I never wanted to feel this certain—this utterly certain—that we would never meet again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Farewell.
Her last words.
There's no need to think about what it meant.
I knew about her and I even hurt her.
But still, she came to see me.
But, that's all over.
I don't---want to believe that I'll never see her again.

entries.japanese:
「――――うそ、だ」
　頭が正常に働いてくれない。
　ただ、ショックで。
　なにがショックだったのかわからないぐらい、ショックで。
　おぼつかない記憶と崩れそうな足取りで、公園を後にしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That can’t be true.”
My mind refused to work.
I was simply in shock.
So profoundly shocked that I no longer knew what had shocked me.
With my memories wavering and my legs ready to buckle, I somehow left the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No, this isn't happening."
My head doesn't seem to be working.
It's just in shock.
It's so shocked that it can't tell why it's in shock.
I leave the park with my uncertain memories and faltering steps.

entries.japanese: ―――ズキン。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――THROB.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---THROB.

entries.japanese: ―――ずきん。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――throb.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Throb.

entries.japanese: ―――ズキン。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――THROB.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---THROB.

entries.japanese: ―――ずきん。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――throb.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Throb.

entries.japanese: ……ひどく、疲れた。
entries.maoEnglish: I was so tired.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… I'm incredibly, exhausted.

entries.japanese:
頭痛がひどい。
　先輩のこともアルクェイドのことも考えずに、何も考えずに、今は、ただ眠りたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
My head was splitting.
I didn’t want to think about Ciel or Arcueid or anything at all; right now, all I wanted was sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This headache is killing me.
More than anything else, without thinking about Senpai, or Arcueid or anything at all.
I just want to go to sleep.

entries.japanese:
夏の、暑い日。
　青い空と　大きな大きな入道雲。
　じりじりとゆらぐ風景と
　気が遠くなるような蝉の声。
　蝉の声。
entries.maoEnglish:
A hot summer day.
Blue sky and enormous, enormous thunderheads.
The landscape shimmering in the scorching air
The dizzying shriek of cicadas.
Cicadas.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A hot, summer day.
The blue sky and large, large columns of summer clouds.
The breeze wafting by,
and the droning voice of the cicadas.
The sound of cicadas.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
――――うるさくて、死にたくなる。

広場には蝉のぬけがら。
　たいようはすぐそばにあるようで、
　広場はじりじりと焦げていく。
　真夏のあつい日。
　まるで、セカイがふらいぱんになったみたい。
　えーん　えんえん
　えーん　えんえん
　えーん　えんえん

秋葉が泣いている。
　秋葉の足元には子供がひとり倒れている。
　白いシャツが真っ赤に染まって、ぴくりとも動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Reeee, ree-ree
Reeee, ree-ree
Reeee, ree-ree
――――so loud I wanted to die.
Empty cicada shells littered the clearing.
The sun seemed close enough to touch,
and the clearing slowly baked beneath it.
A hot midsummer day.
Like the whole WORLD was a frying pan.
Waaah, wah-wah
Waaah, wah-wah
Waaah, wah-wah
Akiha was crying.
A child lay collapsed at her feet.
The white shirt was soaked crimson, and the child did not move at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
----So loud, I want to die.

In the clearing, the discarded shells of the cicadas.
As if the sun is right next to me,
the clearing burns with an intense heat.
A hot midsummer day.
As if the entire world became a frying pan.

waa, u, uwaaa.

entries.japanese:
それを見下ろしている。
　自分の両手は倒れている子供と同じように赤い。
　いや、違う。
　この両手は。
　倒れている子供の血で、赤いのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I looked down at the child.
Both my hands were red, just like the fallen child.
No, that wasn’t it.
These hands.
were red with the fallen child’s blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
waa, u, uwaaa.
waa, u, uwaaa.

Akiha is crying.
There's a child collapsed at her feet.
His white shirt is painted red with blood and he doesn't move at all.

entries.japanese:
日の当たらぬ草原。
　月光だけを頼りにして咲き誇る、白い白い大輪の花。
　透き通るような月の下。
　ただ一人存在していた、白い女。
entries.maoEnglish:
A meadow the sun never touched.
A great white flower in riotous bloom, nourished by moonlight alone.
Beneath a moon clear as glass.
There stood a solitary woman in white.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Looking down at him,
my hands are red, just like that child on the ground.
No, that's not it.
These hands,
are red with the blood of that child.

entries.japanese:
言葉さえ知らず。
　自己の意義も解せず。
　ただ、殺戮の手段としてしか扱われぬ。
　鮮血にまみれた白い女は、決して傷などついていない。
　ドレスを濡らす朱は、ただ敵の血のみで赤いのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
She knew no language.
She did not understand the meaning of her own existence.
She was treated as nothing more than an instrument of slaughter.
Though drenched in fresh blood, the white woman bore no wound.
The scarlet soaking her dress belonged only to her enemies.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A grassy plain hidden from the sun.
Raised only by the moonlight, proud white flowers.
Under the transparent moon.
A lone woman of pure white.

Not even knowing words.
Not even aware of her self.
Only treated as a method of killing.
The white woman stained in fresh blood is completely free of injury.
The crimson saturating her dress is only the blood of her enemies.

entries.japanese:
彼女に許された時間は、血に濡れて帰還したあとの、このわずかな数刻のみだ。
　その後に待つものは、自身では目覚める事さえできない眠りのみ。
　……白い彼女はその運命さえ知らず、ただ、遠い目で月を見上げている。
entries.maoEnglish:
The only time allowed her was this handful of hours after she returned steeped in blood.
Beyond them waited nothing but a sleep from which she could never wake herself.
Unaware even of that fate, the white woman merely gazed up at the moon with distant eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The only time she is allowed is this brief amount of time after her blood-stained homecomings.
What waits for her after that is only a sleep she cannot wake from herself.
…… The white girl does not even know her fate, and just looks up with distant eyes at the moon.

entries.japanese:
―――そこに、永遠を見た、と思った。
　錯覚か。
　おそらくは錯覚だろう。
　だがかまわない。
　その姿が永遠に、この網膜に焼きついた事だけが真実故に―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I thought I saw eternity in her.
An illusion?
Most likely.
But it didn’t matter.
The one truth was that her image had been burned forever into my eyes—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I thought, I saw eternity there.
Is it an illusion?
It probably is.
But I don't care.
The fact that her figure has eternally seared into my memory is truly---

entries.japanese:
懐かしいユメを見ていたような気がして、眠りから目覚めた。
「あ――――」
　今まで呼吸をしていなかったように、大きく喉が酸素をとりこむ。
　それで、はっきりと目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I woke with the feeling that I had been dreaming of something long ago and dear to me.
“Ah—”
My throat dragged in a huge breath as though I hadn’t been breathing at all.
That snapped me fully awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel like I had a nostalgic dream and I wake up from my slumber.
"Ah----"
As if I wasn't breathing before, I suddenly take a huge breath.
That makes me wake up completely.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　自分の部屋にいる。
　あの後―――公園で先輩に別れを告げられたあと、自分はどうにかしてこの部屋に戻ってきたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I was in my room.
Afterward—after Ciel said goodbye in the park—had I somehow made my way back here?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I'm in my room.
After that---after my separation with Senpai in the park, I must have somehow returned to my room.

entries.japanese:
「―――シエル、先輩―――」
　あの顔が忘れられない。
　どうして、あの時何も言えなかったんだろう
　俺はアルクェイドが吸血鬼だってわかっていながら惹かれていたんだ。
　それなら、たとえ先輩が吸血鬼だったとしても、あんなふうに驚くことはなかったハズだ。
　……笑って。
　冗談みたいに笑って受け流していれば、先輩だっていつも通りに笑ってくれたかも、しれないのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel—”
I couldn’t forget her face.
Why hadn’t I said anything
I had been drawn to Arcueid even after learning she was a vampire.
So even if Ciel had been one too, there was no reason for me to recoil like that.
If only I had laughed.
If I had brushed it aside as though it were a joke, perhaps Ciel would have given me her usual smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ciel, Senpai---"
I can't forget her face.
Why didn't I say anything back then?
I was still attracted to Arcueid even though I knew she was a vampire.
So even if Senpai was a vampire, I shouldn't have been that surprised.
…… I should have laughed.
If I laughed like it was a joke, she probably would have laughed with me like always.

entries.japanese:
「……違う。
俺は、やっぱり―――」
　先輩には、本当に先輩でいてほしかった。
　退屈で、けど平和で、楽しかった学校での先輩との時間が、すごく大切だったんだ。
「――――く」
　けど、それも終わりだ。
　彼女はもう二度と、先輩として学校に来る事なんてなくなったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I really did—”
I wanted Ciel to remain the Ciel I knew.
Those dull yet peaceful, happy hours with her at school mattered enormously to me.
“Ngh…”
But they were over.
She would never come back to school as my upperclassman again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
I---"
I really wanted her to stay as Senpai.
The uneventful, but peaceful and fun time I spent with Senpai at school was very precious.
"----Damn."
But, that's all over.
She will never come to school as Senpai ever again.

entries.japanese:
「……どうすればいいんだろうな、俺」
　解らない。
　街に巣くっている吸血鬼を倒そうとは思ったけど、俺一人じゃ探すことさえできない。
　アルクェイドとは決裂して、先輩とは絶交中。
　……いや、先輩とはもう会う事さえできないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What am I supposed to do now?”
I didn’t know.
I had resolved to destroy the vampire nesting in the city, but alone I couldn’t even find it.
I had broken with Arcueid and fallen out with Ciel.
No—there was little chance I would ever see Ciel again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What should I do?"
I don't know.
I wanted to search for the vampire's lair and kill him, but I can't even look for him by myself.
I've cut my ties with Arcueid, and me and Senpai are fighting right now.
…… No, I won't even be able to see Senpai again.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　メガネをかけて、ベッドから体を起こす。
　時計は午前八時過ぎ。
　いつもならとっくに朝食を済ましている時間だけど、今日はうちの学校は創立記念日で休校だった。
「翡翠は……いないか」
　いつもなら影のように扉の前で控えている翡翠はいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I put on my glasses and sat up.
It was a little after eight.
Ordinarily I would have finished breakfast long ago, but school was closed today for its anniversary.
“Hisui isn’t here…”
Normally she would be waiting outside my door like a shadow, but today there was no sign of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
I put on my glasses and get out of bed.
It's past eight o'clock in the morning.
It's long past my usual breakfast time, but today is a school holiday.
"Hisui…… isn't here?"
Her familiar figure standing in front of the door like a shadow is missing.

entries.japanese:
「ん……」
　また、軽い頭痛が走った。
　慣れない屋敷の生活にくわえて、ここ数日の異状な体験でストレスがたまっているのか。
「…………はあ」
　深く息を吐く。
　何をするべきか解らないけど、やるべき事は沢山ある。
　先輩のことが気になるのなら、先輩のアパートを訪ねてみればいいんだし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
Another faint headache stabbed through me.
Maybe life in this unfamiliar mansion, combined with the past few days of madness, had finally worn down my nerves.
“Haa.”
I let out a long breath.
I didn’t know what I should do, but there were plenty of things I could do.
If I was worried about Ciel, I could visit her apartment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"M……"
Once again, my light headache returns.
In addition to my new, unfamiliar life at this mansion, the events of the past few days were very stressful.
………… *sigh*
I let out a deep breath.
I don't know what I should do, but I have a lot of things I have to do.
If I'm worried about Senpai, I can just go to her apartment.

entries.japanese:
「――よし。
なんにせよ、まずは朝飯だな」
　人間、とりあえず何かを食べなくちゃ始まらない。
　起きたばかりのねぼけた頭と体を動かして、居間に向かう事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. Whatever happens, breakfast first.”
Nothing could begin until a person had eaten.
I hauled my newly awakened, sluggish mind and body toward the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Alright.
If anything, first comes breakfast."
You can't work on an empty stomach.
Shaking the sleep from my brain and body, I head towards the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
ロビーでは翡翠がなにやら作業をしていた。
　模様替えだろうか、見なれない椅子をロビーに運んでいる。
「翡翠」
　翡翠は俺に気がついたのか、トツトツと静かな足取りでやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui was busy with something in the foyer.
Perhaps she was rearranging the furniture; she was carrying in a chair I had never seen before.
“Hisui.”
Noticing me, she approached in her usual quiet, measured steps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui is in the lobby doing something.
She must be doing some redesigning because she's carrying a chair.
"Hisui."
As if suddenly realizing I am here, she walks quickly towards me with her usual soft footsteps.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、おはよう。
わるいね、自分かってな時間に起きちゃって」
「こちらこそ、お目覚めの時におそばにいられず、申し訳ございません」
　翡翠はスッ、と音もなく頭をさげる。
　……ここで謝られると、夜中は街に出歩いて、深夜に自分でも解らないまま帰ってきてベッドにもぐりこむ、なんていう自分がひどく極悪人に感じられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning. Sorry I woke up at such an awkward hour.”
“I am the one who must apologize for not being at your side when you awoke.”
Hisui bowed without a sound.
Hearing her apologize made me feel like a criminal for roaming the city at night, stumbling home after midnight without knowing how, and crawling into bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"…… Yeah, good morning.
Sorry for selfishly waking up whenever."
"I am sorry for not being there when you woke up.
Please forgive me."
Hisui silently bows her head.
…… After going out last night and not even remembering how I came back to my room, being apologized to like this makes me feel like a horrible person.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠が謝る必要なんかないよ。
決まった時間に起きないこっちが悪いんだから、翡翠は文句の一つでも言ってくれたほうがいい」
　とくに今はそれぐらい厳しくしてもらわないと、気持ちが揺らいでしまいそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You have nothing to apologize for; I’m the one who can’t wake up on schedule. You ought to scold me for it.”
Especially now, I felt as though my resolve might give way unless someone kept that firm a hand on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There's no need to apologize, I just woke up whenever I wanted to.
It's okay if you want to complain."
Like now, unless she's strict on me, my spirit might waver a bit.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……？」
「ああ、なんでもないんだ。
今のは忘れてくれ。
それより朝飯にしたいんだけど、朝食の準備って出来てる？」
「……姉さんは外に出ています。
志貴さまのご朝食でしたら、食堂のほうにすでに用意されておりますが」
「そっか。
んじゃちょっと食べてくる。
仕事中呼び止めて悪かったね」
　それじゃまた後で、と声をかけて食堂に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…?”
“It’s nothing, so forget I said that. More importantly, I’d like breakfast. Is it ready?”
“My sister has gone out. Master Shiki’s breakfast has already been set out in the dining room.”
“Great. I’ll go eat, then. Sorry for interrupting your work.”
I told her I would see her later and headed for the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……?"
"Ah, it's nothing, don't worry about it.
Anyway, I want to eat some breakfast, is it already made?"
"…… Nee-san is outside.
If you want to eat breakfast, it is already prepared in the dining room."
"Oh.
I'll go eat then.
Sorry for interrupting your work."
After saying I'd see her later, I head towards the dining room.

entries.japanese:
朝食を食べ終わってロビーに戻る。
　……先輩のアパートに行ってみるにしても、一度部屋に戻って着替えたほうがいいだろう。
「――――痛っ」
　がたん、とつま先を椅子にぶつけてしまった。
「……ったあ、なんでこんなところに椅子なんて……」
　ああ、さっき翡翠が運んでいた椅子か。
　普段無いものだから、ついいつも通りに歩いてぶつかってしまったんだ。
「……まいったな。
こんなのにぶつかるほど参ってるってことか」
　はあ、とため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
After breakfast I returned to the foyer.
Even if I meant to visit Ciel’s apartment, I should go upstairs and change first.
“Ow—!”
My toes struck a chair with a clatter.
“Oww—why is there a chair here?”
Oh, right—it was the one Hisui had been moving.
I was so used to the space being empty that I had walked my usual path and run straight into it.
“This is bad. Am I so far gone that I’d walk into something like that?”
I sighed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After finishing breakfast, I return to the lobby.
…… I should go back to my room and change even if I decide to head to Senpai's apartment.
"----Ow!"
My toe bangs into a chair.
"…… Ow.
Why the heck is a chair here……"
That's right, it's the chair Hisui was carrying earlier.
Since it usually isn't here, I just banged into it walking normally without thinking.
"…… Dang.
I must be really out of it to hit such a thing."
I give a sigh.

entries.japanese:
―――けど、翡翠も翡翠だ。
こんなところに椅子を置いても仕方がないだろう。
　そもそも通り道に椅子を置くなんて、何を考えているんだか。
　……椅子の足にぶつけた爪先が、まだ痛んでいる。
　これは余分な痛みだ。
　こんなところに椅子さえなければしなくて良かった痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Still, what was Hisui thinking? There was no point putting a chair here.
Who left a chair right in the middle of a walkway?
The toe I had struck against its leg still hurt.
It was a needless pain.
A pain I would never have felt if this chair hadn’t been here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---But, Hisui is Hisui.
Why does she have to put a chair here?
What was she thinking in the first place to put a chair where people walk by?
…… The toe I banged on the chair still hurts.
It's an excessive pain.
A pain that would have never been there if the chair was never here.

entries.japanese:
―――ケチがついた。
　俺はこれから先輩に会いにいくっていうのに、どうしていきなり邪魔をするんだ。
　この椅子、すごく邪魔だ。
　どうしてこんなものがここにあるんだ。
　なければいいのに。
なければ俺がつまずくなんて事もなかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A rotten omen.
I was about to go see Ciel, so why did this have to get in my way now?
This chair was in the way.
Why was it here?
I wished it weren’t here. If it hadn’t been, I never would have tripped over it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---How annoying.
I was supposed to see Senpai, so why is this suddenly getting in my way?
This chair is an incredible annoyance.
Why is such a thing here?
It never should've been here.
If it wasn't here, I never would've stubbed my toe.

entries.japanese:
頭にきて、椅子を蹴りつけた。
　ずきん。
　すると、蹴ったつま先がよけいに痛んだ。
　ずきん、ずきん。
　ずきん、ずきん、ずきん。
「―――――――コイツ」
　なんて、邪魔な、ヤツ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Furious, I kicked it.
Throb.
The impact only made my toe hurt worse.
Throb, throb.
Throb, throb, throb.
“You—”
What a loathsome thing, always in the way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get mad and kick the chair.
Throb.
As soon as I do that, the toe I kick with hurts even more.
Throb, Throb.
Throb, Throb, Throb.
"-------Why you!"
What a, bothersome, thing.

entries.japanese:
消えろ。
　目障りだ、この椅子。
　この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子。
　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子。
この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子　この椅子！

「志貴さま……！？」
「―――あれ、翡翠。
どうしたんだ、いきなりそんなところに、いて」
　言って、驚いた。
　……自分の呼吸が乱れている。
　ぜいぜいと激しく蠕動している。
　まるで、何十キロとマラソンをしていたみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Disappear.
I can’t stand the sight of this chair.
This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair. This chair This chair. This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair. This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair This chair!
“Master Shiki…!?”
“Oh—Hisui. What are you doing, suddenly standing over there…?”
Even as I spoke, something startled me.
My breathing was ragged.
My lungs heaved and rasped.
It was as though I had just run a marathon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Disappear.
This chair is an eyesore.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair.
This chair!

entries.japanese:
「あれ……なんでこんな、息があがってるんだろう、俺」
　はあはあと息をつく。
「志貴さま―――なにを、言ってらっしゃるのですか？」
「え、なにって―――翡翠こそどうしたんだよ、そんな不安そうな顔して。
なにか、あったのか？」
「……志貴さま、ご自分が何をなさっていたのか、わかっていらっしゃらないのですか……？」
「なにをしてるかって、俺は別に何も―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why am I so out of breath?”
I stood there panting.
“Master Shiki—what are you saying?”
“What do you mean? What’s wrong, Hisui—you look terrified, did something happen?”
“Master Shiki, do you truly not know what you were doing?”
“What I was doing—I wasn’t doing anything—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……!?"
"---Huh, Hisui?
Why are you rushing here, all of a sudden?"
I say that, truly surprised.
…… I'm breathing heavily.
My chest heaves up and down.
I feel like I just ran a marathon.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――」
　また頭痛。
　それを振り払うように頭をふった時、自分の足元にあるモノに気がついた。
　そこにあるのは。
　もう、原形もとどめていないぐらいに壊された椅子の残骸だった。

「――――――え？」
　どくん、と。
　心臓が、早鐘を打つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—”
Another headache.
I shook my head as though I could fling it away—and noticed what lay at my feet.
There it was.
The wreckage of the chair, reduced beyond all recognition.
“What?”
Thump.
My heart began to hammer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
…… Why am I so out of breath?"
I gasp hungrily for air.
"Shiki-sama---what, are you saying?"
"Eh, what---why are you looking at me like that?
Did something happen?"
"…… Shiki-sama, are you saying you do not know what you were doing……?"
"What I was doing?
But, I wasn't really doing anything----"

entries.japanese:
「―――これ―――俺、が？」
「―――はい。
志貴さまが椅子を持って、床に何度も叩きつけた結果です」
「な―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did I do this?”
“Yes. Master Shiki lifted the chair and smashed it against the floor again and again.”
“But—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah---"
My headache returns.
I shake my head to get rid of it and suddenly realize what lies at my feet.
What lies there are……
the shattered remnants of the chair.

entries.japanese:
なんで。
なんでそんなコトを、俺はしたんだ。
　そりゃあたしかに椅子に足をぶつけて、痛いなって思ったけど。
　なんでそんなコトぐらいで、俺は―――こんな子供みたいに、些細な怒りにまかせて物を壊したりしたんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
Why? Why would I do something like that?
Yes, I had struck my foot against it and thought it hurt, but still.
why had something so trivial made me destroy it in a childish fit of petty rage…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Eh?"
Thump.
My heart pounds harder.

"---I---did this?"
"---Yes.
That is the result of you holding the chair and smashing it against the floor many times."
"Wh------"

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、なにかご気分が優れないのですか？
　体調が悪いのでしたら、お医者さまをお呼びいたしますが」
「――――違う。
なんでもない。
なんでもないんだ。
ごめん翡翠、ごめん……俺、どうかしてる」
　翡翠から離れる。
　壊れた、俺の手によってバラバラにされた椅子から離れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you unwell? If you are ill, I can summon a doctor.”
“No. It’s nothing. It’s nothing. I’m sorry, Hisui—I’m sorry; something is wrong with me.”
I backed away from Hisui.
Away from the broken chair my own hands had torn apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Why?
Why did I, do that?
I did think that my toe hurt from running into the chair.
But why did I go that far---why did I get angry over something like that and break it like a kid having a tantrum……?

"Shiki-sama, are you feeling well?
If you are sick, I can call a doctor."
"----No, it's nothing.
It's really nothing.
Sorry Hisui, I…… just felt strange."
I step back from her.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、落ち着いてください。
そんなに息を荒だたしてはお体に障ります」
「いいんだ、ほっといてくれ！
　一人になりたいんだ、一人にさせてくれ……！」
　そう叫んで、階段を駆け上がる。
　まるで翡翠から逃げだしているみたいだな、と他人事のように思えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please calm yourself, Master Shiki. Breathing so violently will harm you.”
“It doesn’t matter—leave me alone! I want to be by myself, so just leave me alone…!”
I shouted the words and fled up the stairs.
Some detached part of me thought it looked exactly as though I were running away from Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I step back from the pieces of the chair I just destroyed.

"Shiki-sama, please calm down.
Breathing like that is not good for your body."
"I'm fine, leave me alone!
I want to be alone, just let me be……!"
I shout that out and run up the stairs.
I passively note that I seem to be running away from her.

entries.japanese:
部屋に戻って、ベッドにうずくまった。
　まただ。
　また、こめかみが疼く。
　ずきんずきん、と。
　まるで脳髄の中に新しい心臓ができたみたいに、軽い頭痛が繰り返される。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back in my room, I curled up on the bed.
Again.
My temples were throbbing again.
Throb, throb.
Faint pain pulsed through my skull as though a second heart had formed inside my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to my room and throw myself on my bed.
Once again.
My temple starts to hurt once more.
Throb, throb.
As if a new heart had emerged in my brain, my head pounds painfully.

entries.japanese:
「…………くっ」
　痛い。
　痛い。
　痛い。
　さっき、わけもなく凶暴な気持ちになったのは、この痛みのせいかもしれない。
　連日の事件で、『死』を視すぎて頭がどうかしてしまったのか。
　ともかく―――今は、落ち着かないと。
　頭痛だって、メガネさえ外さなければこれ以上強くなることはないんだし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh.”
It hurt.
It hurt.
It hurt.
Perhaps this pain had caused the senseless violence downstairs.
Had seeing so much ‘death’ over the past several days broken something in my head?
Whatever the cause, I had to calm down.
As long as I kept my glasses on, the headache shouldn’t grow any worse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Kkk."
It hurts.
It hurts.
It hurts.
This pain probably caused my earlier violent behavior.
Having to see "death" so much these past few days is messing up my brain.
First---I need to calm down now.
As long as I keep my glasses on, this headache shouldn't get worse.

entries.japanese:
「………なにやってるんだろ、俺………すぐに、先輩のところに、行かないと………いけないのに」
　だけど、こんな状態でいったらまた先輩を傷つけるだけだ。
　落ち着かなくちゃ。
　静かに。
静かにしていれば、頭痛もちゃんと収まってくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What am I doing—I need to go see Ciel right away.”
But in this state, I would only hurt her again.
I had to calm down.
Stay still. If I stayed quiet, the headache would subside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… What am I doing?
……… I have to go see Senpai…… quickly."
But, if I see her while I'm like this, I'll only hurt her.
I have to calm down.
Quietly.
If I just sit here quietly, my headache will go away.

entries.maoEnglish:
—
— —
— — —
There—it was easing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
…………………
…………………………… See?
It's disappearing.

entries.japanese:
部屋はとても静かだ。
　時計の針の音しかしないこの部屋なら、すぐに気持ちも静まってくれる。
　チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
　…………時計の針。
entries.maoEnglish:
The room was wonderfully quiet.
In here, where the only sound was the ticking of the clock, my nerves would settle in no time.
Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick.
The clock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My room is very quiet.
In this room with only the ticking of the clock, I should be able to calm down quickly.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
…………… The ticking of the clock.

entries.japanese:
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
　…………ちょっと、静かにしてくれ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick.
Could you be quiet for a minute?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
………… Can't you be quiet?

entries.japanese:
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
　…………おい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick.
Hey.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
………… Hey.

entries.japanese:
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
チッ。
　…………静かにしろって言ってるのに………！
entries.maoEnglish:
Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick.
I told you to shut up…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
………… I told you to be quiet………!

entries.japanese:
―――とまった。
　ガシャン、と音をたてて、時計が止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It stopped.
With a crash, the clock stopped.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It stopped.
With a crash, the clock stops.

entries.japanese:
「―――静かに、なった」
　うん、良かった。
　これなら先輩に会いに行ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s quiet now.”
Good.
Now I could go see Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It's quiet."
Yeah, that's better.
Now I can go see Senpai.

entries.japanese:
玄関に出る。
　天気は、青が眼に染み込むぐらいの快晴だ。
　門に向かって歩き出す。
　その途中。
がさり、と庭のほうから物音がした。
「…………？」
　おかしいな。
翡翠はロビーで椅子の片付けをしていた。
　琥珀さんは外に出ていて、秋葉は学校。
　……屋敷には、他に誰もいないハズなんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
I went to the front entrance.
The sky was so clear its blue seemed to soak into my eyes.
I started toward the gate.
Halfway there. Something rustled in the garden.
“…?”
Strange. Hisui was in the foyer cleaning up the chair.
Kohaku was out, and Akiha was at school.
There shouldn’t have been anyone else in the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk out the front door.
The sky is painted a brilliant blue.
I walk towards the gate.
At that moment, I hear a noise from the garden.
"…………?"
That's odd.
Hisui was in the lobby picking up the pieces of the chair.
Kohaku-san is outside, and Akiha is at school.
…… There shouldn't be anyone else here at the mansion.

entries.japanese:
庭にやってきた。
　……そういえば、子供のころはよくここで秋葉たちと遊んだものだ。
　屋敷に帰ってからこっち、色々とあわただしくて庭の散歩もしてなかったんだっけ。
　がさり。
　また、物音。
　誰かが庭を横断している音みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I entered the garden.
Come to think of it, Akiha and the others and I used to play here constantly as children.
Since returning to the mansion, I had been too busy even to take a walk around the grounds.
Rustle.
There it was again.
It sounded like someone crossing the garden.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I arrive in the garden.
…… Come to think of it, most of the time we spent playing was in the garden.
Since coming back here, I've been busy with many things so I haven't had a chance to walk around the garden.
Rustle.
That sound again.
It seems like someone just walked through.

entries.japanese:
「あれ、翡翠……？」
　そこにいたのは翡翠だった。
　……俺のほうには気がついていないみたいだけど、たしかに翡翠が林のほうへ行こうとしている。
　翡翠はこちらに気づいていない。
　何をしにいくのか、翡翠は森の中に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui…?”
It was her.
She didn’t seem to have noticed me, but there was no mistaking Hisui as she made her way toward the grove.
Hisui still had not noticed me.
Whatever her purpose, she disappeared among the trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
Hisui……?"
It's Hisui.
…… It seems she doesn't notice me, as Hisui is making her way towards the woods.
She doesn't seem to notice me.
Does she have something to do?
She enters the forest.

entries.japanese:
「？」
　興味をひかれて、少しだけ後についていった。
――――と。
　翡翠が歩いていった先には、ちょっとした広場があるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“?”
My curiosity piqued, I followed her a little way.
――――And then.
Beyond the path Hisui had taken, there seemed to be a small clearing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"?"
A bit curious, I follow her from a slight distance.
----And.
Where Hisui headed to, there seems to be a small clearing.

entries.japanese:
「……？
　あんなところに広場なんて……」
　首をかしげて思い出そうとしてみるが、どうも記憶はあいまいだ。
　屋敷の森の中、木々を切りとったような広場が見える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…? Was there always a clearing back there…?”
I cocked my head and searched my memory, but it remained strangely vague.
Within the woods on the estate was a clearing that looked as though the trees had been cut away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… There's a clearing there……?"
Tilting my head to the side, I try to remember, but for some reason, my memory is a bit vague.
In the forest of the mansion, I can see a clearing as if the trees were cut there.

entries.japanese:
―――いや、見えるというのは正しくない。
　普通に歩いている分には決して見えなかったはずだ。
　翡翠があそこに歩いて行かなければ、屋敷に住んでいながら一生気づかなかったぐらい隠れた、木々に囲まれた小さな広場。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――No, saying it could be seen was wrong.
Anyone merely walking past would never have noticed it.
A tiny clearing enclosed by trees, hidden so thoroughly that if Hisui had not walked that way, I might have lived on the estate my whole life without discovering it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---No, "can see" is not quite right.
If you walked by normally, you probably would never notice it.
If Hisui didn't walk there, hidden enough by the surrounding trees as it is, I would never have noticed even if I lived here all my life.

entries.japanese:
「……あんな広場、あったかな……あったならかっこうの遊び場になってたはずなんだけど……」
　少なくとも森の中の広場で秋葉と遊んだ記憶はない。
――――ない、ような、気が、する。
「…………」
　少しだけ思案してから、その広場に入ってみることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was that clearing always there—if it was, it would have made the perfect playground.”
At least, I had no memory of ever playing with Akiha in a clearing in the woods.
――――I don’t think there was.
“…”
After a moment’s hesitation, I stepped into the clearing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… There's a clearing there?
…… If so, we probably did play there as kids."
To say the least, I don't remember ever playing with Akiha in the clearing.

----I feel like I've never, been there, before.
"…………"
After thinking for a bit, I decide to go into the clearing.

entries.japanese:
……広場には特別なにもない。
　先に入っていった翡翠の姿もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was nothing remarkable in the clearing.
Hisui, who had entered ahead of me, was nowhere to be seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The clearing doesn't strike me as anything out of the ordinary.
There's no sign of Hisui, who entered before me.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ―――ただの空き地じゃないか」
　広場の真ん中へ歩いていく。
　広場は本当に、なんていうことはない空き地だった。
　きれいにまったいらにされた土の地面と、
　まわりを囲む深い森の木々。
　蝉の声と。
　溶けるような、強い、夏の陽射し――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—it’s only an empty lot.”
I walked toward the center.
The clearing really was nothing more than an ordinary vacant lot.
A bare stretch of perfectly leveled earth
surrounded by the deep forest.
The cries of cicadas.
The fierce summer sunlight, hot enough to melt me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's this---just an empty place."
I walk to the middle of the clearing.
This clearing really is just an empty space.
The perfectly level, open ground.
The deep woods enclose the area.
The voice of the cicadas.
And the strong, summer sunshine that feels like it could dissolve------

entries.japanese:
「え…………？」
　夏の、陽射し―――？
「い――――痛ぅ…………」
　胸の傷が痛む。
　まるで／ざくりと。
　包丁で胸を刺された／ような／この痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Summer sunlight—?
“Ah――――ow…”
The wound in my chest hurt.
As if / stabbed deep.
This pain / as if / a kitchen knife had been driven into my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh…………?"
Summer, sunshine---?
"Ou----ouch………"
The wound on my chest starts to hurt.
Like / stabbing.
This pain  / that feels like  / a kitchen knife stabbing my chest.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん―――――
――――どこかで、蝉の声がしている。
　今はもう、秋なのに。
――――白く溶けてしまいそうな夏の陽射し。
entries.maoEnglish:
Reeee, ree-ree
Reeee, ree-ree
Reeee, ree-ree—
――――Somewhere, cicadas were screaming.
Even though it was autumn now.
――――Summer sunlight so white it seemed the world might melt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp-----
----From somewhere, I can hear the voice of cicadas.
But, it's autumn now.
----The summer sunshine that bathes everything in white.

entries.japanese:
遠くのそらには入道雲。
　見えるのは空蝉のこえ。
　足元には蝉のぬけがら。
　ぬけがら。
誰かの、ぬけがら。
「――――………」
　―――ああ、癇に障る。
　せっかく気持ちが落ち着いたのに、また、何もかもうざったくなってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thunderheads in the distant sky.
What I could see was the cry of an empty cicada shell.
Cicada husks beneath my feet.
A husk. Someone’s empty husk.
“…”
―――God, it grated on me.
I had finally calmed down, and now everything was becoming intolerable again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The columns of summer clouds in the far off sky.
I can practically see the voices.
At my feet, there are the discarded shells of cicadas.
Discarded shell.
Someone's--discarded shell.

"------………"
---I'm getting angry again.
I finally calmed down earlier, but I'm feeling annoyed again.

entries.japanese:
俺は先輩に会わないと。
　早く会いにいって、先輩が吸血鬼でもかまわないんだって、言わないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had to see Ciel.
I had to reach her quickly and tell her I didn’t care if she was a vampire.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I have to meet Senpai.

I have to hurry up and meet her and tell her I wouldn't care even if she was a vampire.

entries.japanese:
……
　…………
　…………………
　…………………………
　…………………けど、ホントはどうなんだろう。
　遠野志貴は本当に、シエル先輩が吸血鬼でも、今までどおりに笑いあえる事ができるっていうんだろうか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
—
— —
— — —
— — — —
But what was the truth?
Could Shiki Tohno really go on laughing with Ciel as he always had, even if she were a vampire—
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
………………
……………………
………………… but, what is the truth?
Could I honestly say I could smile like I did before with her even if she's a vampire---

entries.japanese:
……うずくまる誰かの影法師。
　　　近寄ってくる幼い少女の足音。
　　　遠くの空には入道雲。
空蝉の青いそら。
　　　気がつけば、
　　　そこには、
　　　胸を貫かれて殺されている俺の体と。
entries.maoEnglish:
The shadow of someone crouching there.
The footsteps of a little girl drawing closer.
Thunderheads in the distant sky. The blue sky of an empty cicada shell.
And when I looked—
there was my body,
murdered by a wound driven through its chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Someone's crouched silhouette.
The approaching footsteps of a young girl.
The columns of clouds in the far sky.
The discarded shells of cicadas.
When I realize it,
there is,
my body pierced through the chest and killed.

entries.japanese:
俺の死体を呆然と見下ろす、
　　　　　やっぱり俺自身の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
And standing over my corpse in stunned
silence was another figure who was also me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And looking down at my corpse in surprise,
is my figure as well.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ」
　胸がいたい。
　吐き気がする。
　傷はとうのむかしに塞がっているはずなのに、どうしてこんなにも痛むのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh…”
My chest hurt.
I felt sick.
The wound had closed years ago, so why did it hurt this badly?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----gg."
My chest hurts.
I feel like vomiting.
My wound has healed a long time ago, but why does it hurt so much?

entries.japanese:
胸が　壊れてる。
　古傷が開いて　セキショクの染みが流れ出す。
―――なんてこと。
　俺の傷は、ぜんぜん癒えてなんかいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My chest is broken.
The old wound splits open, and a RED stain spills out.
―――Oh.
My wound never healed at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My chest   is broken.
The old wound opens, blood flows forth from the opening.
---What is this?
My wound, it hasn't healed at all.

entries.japanese:
イタイ。
　　　コワイ。
entries.maoEnglish:
IT HURTS.
/     I’M SCARED.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It hurts.
I'm scared.

entries.japanese: ―――眩暈がする。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――The world spun.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---I'm assailed with dizziness.

entries.japanese:
コレガ、
　　　　　　　死トイウ衝動カ。
entries.maoEnglish:
IS THIS /                 THE
URGE CALLED DEATH?
entries.mirrorMoon:
This is,
The impulse called Death.

entries.japanese:
意識が沈む。
　　傷が痛む。
　どさり　と、自身の体が地面に倒れこむ音をきいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
My consciousness sank.
The wound hurt.
I heard my body strike the ground with a dull thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My consciousness sinks.
My wound hurts.
I hear the sound of my own body collapsing on the ground.

entries.japanese:
……話し声が聞こえてくる。
「秋葉さま、お医者さまをお呼びしないのですか？」
「馬鹿なことは言わないで翡翠。
呼べるわけないでしょう、兄さんの傷は普通の傷じゃないんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I could hear voices.
“Miss Akiha, shouldn’t we call a doctor?”
“Don’t be ridiculous, Hisui. We can’t call one—Brother’s wound isn’t an ordinary injury…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can hear voices talking.
"Akiha-sama, are you not going to call for a doctor?"
"Don't be stupid, Hisui.
There's no way I could do that, since Nii-san's wound isn't normal…!"

entries.japanese:
……あきは　と　ひすい　が話している。
　ここは　シキの　部屋だ。
　どうやら　ベッドの上で　眠っている　らしい。
　やあ、と声をあげて起きようとしたけれど、体が思うように動かない。
　胸の痛みはもうないくせに、体は鉛のように重い。
　満足に動くのは、目と口だけのようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
……akiha and hisui are talking
this is SHIKI’s room.
it seems i am asleep on the bed.
I tried to greet them and sit up, but my body refused to cooperate.
My chest no longer hurt, yet the rest of me weighed as much as lead.
Only my eyes and mouth seemed capable of moving properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Akiha   and   Hisui are talking.
This  is   SHIKI's room.
It looks   like   I am  sleeping  on the bed.
I planned to say "Yo!" and get out of bed, but I can't move at all.
My chest doesn't hurt anymore, but my body is as heavy as lead.
All I can move are my eyes and mouth.

entries.japanese:
「一体どういうつもりなの翡翠。
志貴をあそこに近づけてはいけないって、あなたも知っているでしょうに……！」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝って済む問題じゃないわ。
あなたを兄さん付きの使用人にしたのは、こういう事態を避けさせるためでしょう？
　それを忘れて、あなたは何をやっていたっていうのよ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What were you thinking, Hisui? You knew you were never supposed to let Shiki near that place…!”
“I am terribly sorry.”
“Sorry isn’t enough. You were assigned to my brother precisely to prevent this sort of thing, weren’t you? So what were you doing after forgetting that…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just what in the world were you trying to do, Hisui?
You know not to let Shiki go near that place……!"
"Please…… forgive me."
"This can't be solved by apologizing.
You were assigned to serve Nii-san to avoid this kind of situation.
So what were you doing…!?"

entries.japanese:
秋葉は普段からでは考えられないぐらい、感情を剥き出しにして怒っている。
　対して、叱られている翡翠はうつむいたままずっと黙っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s anger was raw in a way I had never seen before.
Hisui merely stood with her head bowed, silent beneath the reprimand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Completely different from her usual manner, Akiha gives full vent to her anger.
In comparison, Hisui is accepting the scolding silently, looking down.

entries.japanese:
……俺には、二人がどうしてこうなっているのか全然わからない。
　わからないけれど、翡翠が俺のせいで怒られている、という事ぐらいは読み取れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had no idea why the two of them had come to this.
But I could at least tell that Hisui was being blamed because of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm not sure how this all came about.
But I can at least tell Hisui is being yelled at because of me.

entries.japanese:
「答えなさい翡翠。
あなたは、今日一日どこでなにをしていたっていうの？」
　秋葉の質問に翡翠は答えない。
　二人の間の空気は段々と重苦しくなってくる。
　ぎゅっ、と唇をかみしめて、秋葉が翡翠に一歩だけ近寄る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me, Hisui. Where were you, and what were you doing all day?”
Hisui gave no answer.
The air between them grew steadily more oppressive.
Akiha bit down on her lip and took one step toward her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer me, Hisui.
What were you doing and where were you all day long?"
Hisui doesn't answer.
The air grows tenser between them.
Biting her lip, Akiha takes a step towards Hisui.

entries.japanese:
……秋葉が、翡翠に手を上げようとしているのは、俺の目から見てもよくわかった。
　翡翠もわかっているだろうに、うつむいたままそれを黙って受け入れようとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even I could see that Akiha meant to strike her.
Hisui must have known it too, yet she kept her head lowered and silently prepared to accept the blow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Even I understand that Akiha intends to hit her.
Hisui seems to know this as well, but she just stands with her head hung in shame, ready to receive it.

entries.japanese:
「―――ちょっと待て秋葉」
「兄さん――気がついたんですか！？」
「ああ、秋葉があんまりにうるさいんで、いま目がさめた」
「あ…………」
　秋葉は気まずそうに視線をそらす。
　翡翠はやっぱりうつむいたまま、俺のほうを見ようともしなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Akiha.”
“Brother—you’re awake!?”
“Yeah—you were making so much noise you woke me up.”
“Ah…”
Akiha looked away, suddenly awkward.
Hisui kept her head bowed and still wouldn’t look at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hold on, Akiha."
"Nii-san--You're awake!?"
"Yeah, you were so loud, I woke up."
"Ah…………"
Akiha looks away uncomfortably.
Hisui still keeps looking down, not even trying to look at me.

entries.japanese:
「あのさ、あんまり翡翠にあたるなよ。
事情はしらないけど、ようするに俺が倒れたことでもめてるんだろ？
　なら翡翠に責任なんかないよ。
こんなの俺がかってに倒れただけなんだから」
　よっ、と腕に力をこめて、なんとか上半身だけベッドから起こした。
　今は、それだけでもう指一本だって動かせそうにない。
　けれど翡翠が落ち込んでいる手前、無理をしてでも元気なフリをしなくちゃいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t take it out on Hisui. I don’t know the whole story, but this is about me collapsing, right? Then it isn’t her fault. I fell over all by myself.”
With a grunt, I forced enough strength into my arms to raise my upper body from the bed.
That alone left me unable to move so much as a finger.
But with Hisui looking so crushed, I had to pretend I was fine, no matter how much it cost me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, you shouldn't let it out on Hisui.
I don't know the circumstances, but this has to do with me collapsing, right?
It's not her fault, I just collapsed on my own."
I strain hard and somehow manage to lift the upper half of my body off the bed.
But that's all I can manage, and I don't think I can even move an inch more.
But since Hisui is depressed, I have to force myself to act as fine as possible.

entries.japanese:
「まったく、おまえも俺のコトなんかでケンカなんかするな。
大人びたように見えてまだ子供なんだな」
「でも――――兄さんはあれからずっと気を失っていたんですよ？
　十時間以上も昏睡しているなんて、今までなかったはずです。
もし―――兄さんがあのまま目が覚めなかったら、私はどうすればいいんですか……！」
「ばか、縁起でもないこというなよ。
こんなのはただの貧血じゃないか。
……って、なんだ。
もう夜の十時をまわってるのか」
「……ええ。
兄さんはお昼から今までずっと気を失っていたんです」
　遠慮がちに秋葉は語る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, don’t start fighting over me. You look so grown-up, but you’re still a kid after all.”
“But you’ve been unconscious ever since then! You’ve never been comatose for more than ten hours before. If you had never woken up, what was I supposed to do…?”
“Don’t say something so ominous. This was only anemia. Wait—what? It’s already past ten at night?”
“Yes. You’ve been unconscious since noon.”
Akiha’s answer was subdued.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Honestly, getting into a fight over me.
Even if you look like an adult, you're still a child."
"But… you completely fainted, Nii-san.
You were out for more than ten hours, and nothing like this has happened before.
If----you never woke up, what would I have done……!?"
"Idiot, don't say things like that.
Wasn't this just anemia?
…… Huh?
It's ten o'clock already!?"

"…… Yes, you have been unconscious since noon."
Akiha speaks hesitantly.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　どっ、と体から力が抜けた。
　あれからずっと、こうしてここで眠っていたのか。
　先輩のアパートに行くこともできず、ただ昏々と眠っていただけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
All the strength drained from my body.
Had I really been asleep here the entire time?
I hadn’t even made it to Ciel’s apartment; I had done nothing but lie here in a stupor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
All the strength drains from my body.
I must have slept that long since then.
I wasn't able to go to Senpai's apartment and just slept the time away.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
半日も倒れてるなんて小学校以来だ。
ああ、あの時は頻繁に倒れてたっけ。
有間の家になれなくってさ、神経がまいってたんだ」
　貧血の後遺症か、なんだかまだユメを見ているようだ。
　ぼんやりと、天井をみながらそんな昔の出来事を思い返した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a mess. I haven’t been unconscious for half a day since elementary school. I used to collapse all the time back then, though. I couldn’t adjust to living with the Arima family, and my nerves were shot.”
Perhaps it was an aftereffect of the anemia, but I still felt half inside a dream.
I stared vaguely at the ceiling and let those old memories surface.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Man, I haven't passed out this long since elementary school.
Oh yeah, I did pass out often back then, since I wasn't used to living at the Arimas' and I was stressed out."
Everything is still woozy like I'm still dreaming.
Blanking out, I stare at the ceiling as I remember some of my past.

entries.japanese:
「……そうですね。
ここに帰ってきてまだ一週間です。
兄さん、色々と疲れがたまっているんですよ」
「――ああ。
それは、今日やばいぐらい実感した」
「でしょう？
　ですから、今日はもうこのままお休みください。
兄さんは人より体が不安定なんですから、たまには一日何もしない日がないと参ってしまうんです」
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve only been back a week, Brother. All sorts of strain must have accumulated.” “Yeah. Today made that painfully clear.” “Exactly. So please stay in bed and rest tonight, Brother. Your health is more fragile than most people’s. Unless you occasionally spend a whole day doing nothing, you’ll exhaust yourself.”
Akiha held me with a grave, unwavering gaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That is true.
It has only been a week since you came back here.
Nii-san, you must be exhausted."
"--Yeah.
I felt that today."
"Didn't you?
So please just rest today.
Your health is weaker than most people's, so your body gets tired unless you take a day off sometimes."
She looks at me with a serious expression.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……たしかに、秋葉の言うとおりだ。
　何もかも忘れて。
　先輩のことも吸血鬼のことも考えないで休まないと、本当に参ってしまう。
　悩んで悩んで、そのあげくに椅子にヤツ当たりするなんて、どうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
She was right.
I needed to forget everything.
I had to rest without thinking about Ciel or vampires, or I truly would break down.
Brooding until I took my anger out on a chair was madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… Just like she says.
I should just forget everything.
I shouldn't think about Senpai or vampires and just rest, or I'll really tire out.
Going on a rampage like that and smashing that chair, there must be something wrong with me.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだね。
秋葉の言うとおり、今日はおとなしく眠ることにするよ」
　言って、ベッドに体を横たえた。
「ほんとう……？
　あとになって部屋を抜け出したりするのもナシですよ？」
「なんだよそれ。
俺、そんなに信用ないのかな」
　……ああ、ないか。
　今まで散々、秋葉を放っておいて外に出ていっていたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right, Akiha. I’ll stay here and sleep.”
I lowered myself onto the bed.
“You promise? You won’t sneak out of your room later?”
“What’s that supposed to mean? Do you trust me that little?”
Of course she didn’t.
I had abandoned her and gone out often enough already.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, like you say, I'll just go to sleep."
I lie back down.
"Really……?
You're not going to sneak out of the room later?"
"What, you don't trust me?"
…… I guess not.
Because, these past few days I've been ignoring her and leaving.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、琥珀に兄さんが目を覚ました事を伝えにいって。
兄さん、夕食はどうしますか？」
「……そっか。
いや、琥珀さんには悪いけど、食べられそうにない。
今夜はこのまま眠ることにするよ」
「……わかりました。
じゃあ翡翠、そう琥珀に伝えてきて」
　翡翠はうつむいたままコクン、とうなずいて部屋から出て行く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, go tell Kohaku that my brother has awakened. Brother, would you like dinner?”
“Oh, right. No—tell Kohaku I’m sorry, but I don’t think I could eat. I’m going to sleep through the night.”
“Understood. Hisui, please tell her that.”
Still looking down, Hisui gave a small nod and left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, tell Kohaku that Nii-san is awake.
Nii-san, what about dinner?"
"…… Oh yeah.
No, tell Kohaku-san I'm sorry, but I don't think I can eat right now.
I'm just going to go to sleep."
"…… I understand.
Then Hisui, tell Kohaku that."
Still looking downcast, Hisui nods and leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
……さて。
　ベッドに体を預けたら、また眠気がやってきた。
　このままならあと一分もかからずに眠れるに違いない。
―――と、その前に。
entries.maoEnglish:
Well, then.
The moment I surrendered my weight to the bed, drowsiness returned. At this rate I would be asleep in less than a minute.
―――But first.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well then.
Lying down in bed, I start to feel sleepy again.
Like this, I bet I could fall asleep in a minute…
---But, before that.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
うちの庭に、あんな場所あったっけ？」
「ええ。
私たちが子供のころ、よく遊んだ場所です」
「そっか。
なんだか、よく覚えてないな」
　……ああ。
本当に、忘れてしまってた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Was that place always in our garden?”
“Yes. We often played there when we were children.”
“I see. I barely remember it.”
She was right. I truly had forgotten.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
There's a place like that in the garden?"
"Yes.
When we were children, we used to play there often."
"Oh.
For some reason, I don't remember it well."
…… Yeah.
I really did forget all about it.

entries.japanese:
「それともう一つ。
……ヘンな事を聞くんだけど、子供のころさ、俺と秋葉と―――もう一人ぐらい、子供がいたとかいう話はしらないか？」
「は？」
　秋葉は見当もつかない、と首をかしげる。
　……そうだよな。
そんな子供、いるはずがない。
　あんなのはただのユメだ。
　あの広場で。
子供のころの自分が自分とそっくりの誰かに殺されているなんて、どうかしてる。
　それならここにいる俺はなんだっていうんだ、まったく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“One other thing. This will sound strange, but when we were children, was there another child besides you and me?”
“What?”
Akiha tilted her head, plainly unable to guess what I meant.
Of course. There could never have been such a child.
It was only a dream.
In that clearing. The thought that my childhood self had been murdered by someone identical to me was absurd.
If that were true, then what did that make me—the me lying here now?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And one more thing.
…… It's a weird question, but when we were kids----wasn't there another kid with us?"
"Huh?"
She tilts her head, like she doesn't understand what I'm saying.
…… I guess so.
There couldn't have been another kid.
That was just a dream.
That clearing.
Myself as a child, killed by someone who looked like me.
There's something wrong with that.
If that's true, what am I doing here right now?

entries.japanese:
「いや、なんでもない。
ただのユメの話だ」
「そうですか。
ではおやすみなさい、兄さん。
今日はゆっくり休んでください」
「ああ、そうする」
　秋葉の声にそう答えたとたん。
　いつもの貧血のように、唐突に眠りに落ちていっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind. It was only a dream.”
“I see. Good night, Brother. Please rest well.”
“I will.”
The instant I answered Akiha, sleep took me without warning.
It came as abruptly as one of my familiar attacks of anemia.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it's nothing.
Just talking about a dream."
"Is that so?
Then, goodnight Nii-san.
Please rest well."
"Yeah, I will."
The instant I answer her,
I fall asleep almost as if I just passed out again.

entries.japanese:
暗いところにいた。
　目が覚めてから八年間。
　ずっと、暗いところで息をひそめていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had been in darkness.
Eight years had passed since I awoke.
I had hidden there, scarcely daring to breathe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm in a dark place.
Eight years since I awoke.
I've been holding my breath in darkness the whole time.

entries.japanese:
なんのためにかは、オレにもわからない。
　そんなものはとっくに磨耗してしまった。
　ココにあるのはただの闇だ。
　それでも、オレは何かを成さなければならないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even I no longer knew why.
Whatever reason there had been was worn away long ago.
Nothing remained here but darkness.
Even so, it seemed there was still something I had to accomplish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't even know why.
That has long since been worn away.
Here, there is only darkness.
But, I know there is something I have to do.

entries.japanese:
なんのためにいるのかは、わからない。
　だがオレの目的ははっきりしている。
　オレを縛めていたモノはすべて消えた。
　阻むものはなにもない。
　あとは。
　オマエを、殺しにいくだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I didn’t know why I existed.
But my objective was clear.
Everything that had bound me was gone.
Nothing stood in my way.
There was only one thing left.
To come and kill you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know why I live.
But I know my purpose.
The chains which held me are all gone.
There is nothing holding me back.
All that's left,
is killing you.

entries.japanese:
チチ、チチチ、チチチチチ
　窓が開けっぱなしになっているんだろうか。
　庭の方から小鳥の鳴き声が聞こえてきている。
　ひんやりと冷たい風が頬にあたる。
　目蓋には淡い陽の光。
　静かで、ゆるやかな周囲の色合い。
　柔らかな朝の訪れ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Chirp, chirrup, chirrup-chirrup
Had the window been left open?
I could hear small birds singing in the garden.
A cool breeze brushed my cheek.
Pale sunlight rested on my eyelids.
Everything around me was hushed and softly colored.
The gentle arrival of morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tweet.
Tweet tweet.
Chirp.
Chirp.
Is the window open?
I can hear the voices of small birds coming from the garden.
A cool breeze brushes my face.
The brilliant sunlight hits my eyes.
A quiet, delicate tinge.
A gentle, morning visit.

entries.japanese:
朝、か。
　昨夜、秋葉に看病されたまま眠って、そのまま朝を迎えてしまったらしい。
　体はベッドに横になったままで、体のふしぶしが微かに重かった。
　それでも昨夜よりは体は回復している。
　目を開けて、体を起こす事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Morning.
Akiha must have tended me until I fell asleep last night, and somehow I had slept through until dawn.
I was still lying in bed, every joint faintly heavy.
Even so, I felt better than I had the night before.
I opened my eyes and began to sit up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Morning?
It seems I slept until now after Akiha treated me.
My body still feels a little heavy.
But still I feel much better than last night.
Opening my eyes, I get up.

entries.japanese:
「う…………」
　とたん、吐きそうになった。
　昨日の貧血がまだ続いているのか。
　胸のあたりがムカムカして、気持ちが悪い。
「失礼します」
　翡翠が部屋に入ってくる。
　まだ俺が眠っていると思ったのか、翡翠は入ってくるなり起きている俺を見て微かに驚いたようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ugh…”
Nausea surged through me at once.
Was yesterday’s anemia still lingering?
My stomach churned, and I felt sick.
“Excuse me.”
Hisui entered.
She must have expected me to still be asleep, because the sight of me awake brought a flicker of surprise to her face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh…………"
I feel like throwing up instantly.
I still have my anemia from yesterday?
My chest hurts and I feel sick.
"Please excuse me."
Hisui enters my room.
She must've thought I was still asleep because she seems surprised to see me up.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます。
お目覚めになられていたんですね、志貴さま」
「――――」
　なぜか。
　そんな、些細な翡翠の仕草が癇にさわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning. I see you are already awake, Master Shiki.”
“…”
For some reason.
That tiny reaction from Hisui irritated me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning.
It seems you have awakened, Shiki-sama."
"----"
For some reason,
Hisui's reaction annoys me.

entries.japanese:
「おはよう。
朝食だろ、すぐに行くから出ていってくれ。
着替えるんだ、これから」
「……はい、失礼しました」
「…………」
　いくら気分が悪いからって翡翠にあたるなんて、どうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning. You came about breakfast, right? I’ll be down soon, so leave—I need to get dressed.”
“Yes, forgive me.”
“……”
Taking my foul mood out on Hisui was insane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Morning.
Breakfast, right?
I'll be there soon, so just get out.
I'm going to change."
"…… Yes, please excuse me."
"……………"
No matter how poor of a mood I'm in, letting it out on Hisui like that… there's something wrong with me.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　気分が悪い。
　こんなんじゃ学校にいっても授業にならない。
「……休むか、な」
　けど、学校には行かないと。
　学校に行けば先輩に会えるかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I felt awful.
In this condition, going to school would be pointless.
“Maybe I should stay home.”
But I had to go.
At school, I might see Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I feel sick.
Even if I go to school like this, I won't be able to do anything.
"…… Maybe I'll just stay home."
But, I have to go.
If I go to school, I may see Senpai again.

entries.japanese:
……あの人がまだ『先輩』でいてくれている望みなんて無いだろうけど、それでも―――もしかしたら、先輩はいるかもしれない。
「―――――ふう」
　大きく深呼吸をして、気持ちを落ち着かせる。
　なんとか眩暈を抑えこんで、自分の部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was almost no hope that she would still be there as the Ciel I knew, but even so—perhaps she would be there.
“Haa…”
I drew a long breath and steadied myself.
Somehow suppressing the dizziness, I left my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… She may not be the "Senpai" I want---but she may still be there.
"-----Whew."
Taking a deep breath, I settle down.
Managing to resist my dizziness, I leave my room.

entries.japanese:
「あ、兄さん。
……おはよう、ございます」
　……居間に入るなり、秋葉はうわずった声で挨拶をしてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah, Brother. G-good morning.”
The moment I entered the sitting room, Akiha greeted me in an oddly strained voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Nii-san.
…… Good, morning."
…… As soon as I enter the sitting room, Akiha greets me hollowly.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、おはよう。
今朝も早いな秋葉は」
「わたしはいつも通りですけど……兄、さん？」
「……大丈夫なんですか？
　まだ顔色が悪いようですし、気分が優れないのでしたら今日はお休みになったほうが―――」
「いや、大丈夫だ。
そのうちに治るから、秋葉に心配してもらう必要はない」
　即答して秋葉の前を通りすぎる。
　食堂にいって、朝食を食べないと力が出ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning. You’re up early again.”
“This is my usual time, Brother…?”
“Are you sure you’re all right? You still look pale, and if you feel unwell, perhaps you should stay home today—”
“I’m fine. It will pass, so there’s no need for you to worry.”
I answered at once and walked past her.
I needed breakfast; without food I would have no strength.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, morning.
You're up early Akiha."
"I am always up this early but…… Nii, san?"
"…… Are you alright?
Your face still looks pale.
If you do not feel well, you can stay home---"
"No, I'm fine.
I'm better, so you don't need to worry."
I answer her quickly and pass right by.
I head to the dining room since I'll probably collapse if I don't eat.

entries.japanese:
「じゃあな。
