おまえ、そろそろ時間だろ」
「……………はい。
それではお先に失礼します」
　ためらいがちに言って、秋葉は静かに立ちあがった。
　秋葉が居間から出ていく。
　それを横目で眺めながら食堂に入っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“See you. It’s almost time for you to leave, isn’t it?”
“Yes. Then I’ll go on ahead.”
Still hesitant, Akiha quietly rose.
Akiha left the sitting room.
Watching her from the corner of my eye, I entered the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See ya.
Isn't it about time for school?"
"……………… Yes.
Then, I will be going now."
Speaking hesitantly, she stands up quietly.
Akiha exits the sitting room.
After watching her go out of the corner of my eye, I enter the dining room.

entries.japanese:
屋敷を出て学校に向かう。
　手足がまだ重く、他人の体を着ているような感覚で坂道を下りていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I left the mansion for school.
My limbs remained heavy as I descended the hill, feeling as though I were wearing someone else’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave the mansion and head for school.
My limbs are still heavy, and with a feeling like I'm in someone else's body, I go down the hill.

entries.japanese:
朝の七時四十分。
　正門は登校してくる生徒たちの姿で混雑している。
「……………」
　先輩が来るとは思えないけど、教室で待っているよりはここで待ち伏せしたほうがいいんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Seven forty in the morning.
The front gate was crowded with students arriving for school.
“……”
I doubted Ciel would come, but perhaps I had a better chance of finding her here than in the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's seven-forty.
The gate becomes congested with students hurrying to class.
"………………"
I don't think Senpai will come, but is waiting here better than waiting in my classroom?

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　ここで待とう。
　先輩が来てくれるとは思えないけど、もしかしたら昨日のように登校してくるかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I would wait here.
I didn’t expect Ciel to come, but she might arrive as she had yesterday.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……"
I'll wait here.
I don't think Senpai will come… but maybe she'll come to school like she did yesterday.

entries.japanese:
――――時間になった。
　ホームルームまであと十分ほどという時間になって、正門が閉められた。
「…………」
　先輩はやってこない。
　ため息をついて、重い足取りで教室に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Time was up.
With ten minutes left before homeroom, the front gate was closed.
“……”
Ciel never came.
Sighing, I trudged toward the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It's about time.
At about ten minutes before homeroom, the main gates are closed.
"……"
Senpai is not coming.
Sighing, I head towards the classroom with heavy steps.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　いや、ここで待っていても先輩には会えない気がする。
　先輩のほうに会う気がないのなら、俺の姿を見た時点で帰ってしまうだろうし。
　ひとまず教室に行って、どうすればいいのか考えよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No—waiting here wouldn’t help me find her.
If Ciel didn’t want to see me, she would turn around the instant she spotted me.
For now, I would go to class and think about what to do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……"
No, I get the feeling that I won't be able to see Senpai by waiting here.
If Senpai doesn't feel like seeing me, she'll leave as soon as she sees me.
I should go to the classroom first and think about what to do.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　いや、ここで待っていても先輩には会えない気がする。
　先輩のほうに会う気がないのなら、俺の姿を見た時点で帰ってしまうだろう。
　……それを考えると、先輩が学校に来るルートは正門ではないと思う。
「……来るとしたら裏門からか」
　そう思い立って、校舎の裏側へ走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No—waiting here wouldn’t help me find her.
If Ciel didn’t want to see me, she would turn around the instant she spotted me.
In that case, she probably wouldn’t enter through the front gate at all.
“If she comes, it’ll be through the back gate.”
With that thought, I ran around behind the school building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
No, I have a feeling that I won't see Senpai if I wait here.
If Senpai doesn't feel like seeing me, she'll leave as soon as she sees me.
…… If that's the case, she won't come to school through the front gate.
"…… If she even comes, it'll be through the back gate."
I rush to the back of the school with this thought in mind.

entries.japanese:
「――――はあ」
　裏庭に人影はない。
　裏門から登校してくる生徒もいない。
　……それでも、時間ぎりぎりまで来るはずのない先輩を待ち続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
There was no one in the rear courtyard.
No students were entering through the back gate.
Even so, I waited until the last possible moment for someone I knew would never come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----*sigh*
No one is here.
Not even students coming to school through the back gate.
…… But, I still wait for Senpai who for sure isn't coming.

entries.japanese:
予鈴が一度鳴って、門が閉められる時間を報せてくる。
　……先輩はやってこない。
　ホームルームが始まる前に教室に戻ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The warning bell rang once, announcing that the gates were closing.
Ciel hadn’t come.
I should return to class before homeroom began.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The chime sounds once, telling me that the gate is closing.
…… Senpai didn't come.
I should go back before homeroom starts.

entries.japanese:
ホームルームが間近に迫っているというのに、教室の中はわいわいと騒がしい。
　窓際の自分の席に移動して、鞄を置く。
entries.maoEnglish:
Though homeroom was about to begin, the classroom still roared with chatter.
I went to my window seat and set down my bag.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Homeroom is about to start, but it is still very rowdy in the classroom.
I take my seat by the window and set down my bag.

entries.japanese:
「……まったく。
どいつもこいつも人の顔を見ればそれか。
そんなに顔色悪いのか、俺」
「え―――？
　……そうだな、言われて見れば普通だよな。
なんでかね、遠野がすっごく落ち込んで見えるせいかね」
「…………落ち込んでる、か」
　確かに気持ちは落ち込んでいる。
　先輩にさよならを言われて、体はなんだドロドロと重くて、心も体もノックアウト状態だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Everyone takes one look at me and says the same thing. Do I look that awful?”
“Huh? Now that you mention it, you look normal. Maybe it’s because you seem so completely miserable.”
“Miserable.”
He was right.
Ciel had said goodbye, my body felt like a sack of mud, and both mind and flesh were down for the count.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, mornin'.
You're looking pretty bad today."
"…… Sheesh.
Everyone looks at me and says the same thing.
Do I look that sick?"
"Eh---?
…… Yeah, come to think of it, you look normal.
I don't know, but you look really down, Tohno."
"………… Down, huh?
…"
Certainly my spirits are low.
Ever since Senpai said farewell, my body has been heavy and both my mind and body are knocked out.

entries.japanese:
「―――有彦。
おまえ、今日は先輩見た？」
「あ？
　先輩ってどこのだれ先輩だよ」
「どこのって……俺とおまえの共通の先輩っていえば、シエル先輩以外いないだろ」
「だれそれ、しえるって。
うちの学校に留学生なんかいたっけ？」
――――愕然と、口を開けた。
「……有彦、おまえ」
　途切れ途切れで、なんとかそこまで声をあげる。
　けれど、そのあとは中々続いてくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko. Have you seen Ciel today?”
“Huh? Who?”
“The only upperclassman we both know is Ciel.”
“Who’s Ciel? Did our school have a foreign exchange student?”
――――My mouth fell open in disbelief.
“Arihiko—you…”
I managed that much in broken fragments.
But the rest refused to come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Arihiko.
Did you see Senpai today?"
"Huh?
Senpai?
Which Senpai?"
"Which?
…… the only Senpai we both know is Ciel-senpai."
"Shiel-Senpai?
…… Who's that?
Are there any foreign students at our school?"
----My mouth hangs open in amazement.
"…… Arihiko, you……"
I manage to stammer this out in my confusion.
But, nothing else comes out.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ遠野。
言いたい事があったらはっきり言えって。
金の問題以外ならなんでも聞くぞ」
　有彦の様子はいつもと変わらない。
　いつもと変わらない様子で、あっさりと、先輩の事をまるっきり覚えていない。
「……いや、なんでもない。
席に戻れよ。
ホームルーム、始まるぞ」
「おっ、そんな時間か。
んじゃまあ、また後でな」
　有彦が自分の席に戻って、教室に担任が入ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Tohno? If you have something to say, spit it out. I’ll listen to anything except a request for money.”
Arihiko was exactly as he always was.
In the most casual, ordinary way imaginable, he had no memory of Ciel whatsoever.
“It’s nothing. Go back to your seat. Homeroom’s starting.”
“Already? All right, see you later.”
Arihiko returned to his seat as our homeroom teacher entered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You okay Tohno?
Just spit it out.
As long as it's not asking for money, I'll help you out."
Arihiko is acting like he always does.
Just like always, he completely does not remember Senpai.
"…… Nah, it's nothing.
Sit down, class'll start."
"Oh, it's that time.
Well, later."
Arihiko goes back to his own seat and the teacher arrives.

entries.japanese:
ホームルームが始まって、そのまま一時限目の物理の授業が始まった。
―――それを、まるでスクリーンに映った映画を見るような気持ちで、眺めていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Homeroom began, followed immediately by first-period physics.
―――I watched it all with the detachment of someone viewing a film on a screen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Homeroom starts, followed by physics, the first period class.
---I watch it like a movie on a screen.

entries.japanese:
先輩は、本当に消えてしまった。
　俺の前からいなくなったんじゃなくて、シエル先輩っていう存在が痕跡一つ残さず消えてしまった。
　有彦は覚えていない。
……きっと、他の誰も覚えていない。
　あのさよならは、こういう意味だったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel had truly vanished.
She had not simply left me; the very existence of a person named Ciel had disappeared without a trace.
Arihiko didn’t remember her. No one else would either.
That was what her goodbye had meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Senpai… really disappeared.
Not just from my sight, but the person known as Ciel-senpai is gone completely without a trace.
Arihiko doesn't remember her.
…… I'm sure no one else does either.
That farewell, this is what it meant.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　目の前では、黒板に白いチョークを走らせる教師の映像が流れている。
　なんだか、現実に現実感というものがなくなってしまったみたいだ。
　もう、このまま授業が終わって休み時間になっても、あの人がやってくるコトなんてない。
　昼休みに、茶道室でのんびりと昼食を一緒にとることもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Before me played the image of a teacher drawing white chalk across a blackboard.
It was as if reality no longer felt real.
When class ended and the break began, she would never come through the door.
At lunch, we would never again eat together in the tea room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
The movie in front of me continues playing, showing a teacher using white chalk on a blackboard.
Nothing seems real anymore.
Once classes are over and break time begins, that person will never come again, ever.
During lunch, we will never sit in the tea ceremony room and spend the time aimlessly over lunch.

entries.japanese:
……どこかで。
まだ一縷の望みを持っていたけど、それも終わった。
　俺は、シエルという人を完全に失った。
　まだ何も―――何もしてなかったし、何も伝えてなかったのに。
　今日みたいにいい天気、青い空を眺めながら昼食をとっていた時もあったのに。
　それは、なんてとおとい。
大切な、夢だったんだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Some part of me had clung to one last thread of hope. Now that too was gone.
I had lost Ciel completely.
I still hadn’t done anything—hadn’t told her anything.
We had once eaten lunch beneath a blue sky as clear as today’s.
How precious it had been. How dear a dream—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Somewhere.
I had a thread of hope, but that is gone as well.
I've lost Ciel completely.
I still haven't---haven't done anything.
Haven't told her anything.
We spent time eating lunch together on a nice day such as today.
That was, a distant, precious dream----

entries.japanese:
気がつくと、教室にいるクラスメイトの数が激減していた。
―――どうも、とっくに昼休みになっていたらしい。
「……………」
　何もやる気が起きない。
　体もだるいし、このまま―――
entries.maoEnglish:
When I finally looked around, the classroom held far fewer students.
―――Apparently lunch break had begun some time ago.
“……”
I had no desire to do anything.
My body felt leaden, so perhaps I should simply—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I realize the number of my classmates in the room is dwindling.
---It seems it's now lunch time.
"………………"
I don't feel like doing anything.
I feel sluggish, so I'll just---

entries.japanese:
―――教室でじっとしていよう。
　どこに行ったって先輩はいない。
俺がなにをしたところで、あの人が戻ってきてくれるわけでもないんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’ll stay here in the classroom.
She wouldn’t be anywhere I went. Nothing I could do would make her come back—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'll just stay in the classroom.
Senpai isn't there no matter where I go.
No matter what I do, she won't come back---

entries.japanese:
帰りのホームルームが終わった。
　がやがやと話し声をあげながらクラスメイトたちが席を立つ。
　それをぼんやりと眺めたあと、屋敷に帰るために席を立った。
entries.maoEnglish:
The final homeroom ended.
My classmates rose amid a swelling clamor of conversation.
After watching them vacantly for a while, I got up to return to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The end of the day homeroom session is over.
My chatting classmates get out of their seats.
After staring at them blankly, I get out of my seat to go back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
―――屋敷に帰る。
　けど、帰ったところで、何があるというわけでもない。
「…………っ」
　もう手が届かなくなったものだって解っているのに、まだ未練を断てない。
「くそ―――どうしろっていうんだ、一体……！」
　憎々しげに呟いて、教室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I would go back to the mansion.
But nothing would be waiting for me there.
“…!”
I knew she was beyond my reach, yet still I couldn’t let go.
“Damn it—what am I supposed to do…!?”
I spat the words under my breath and left the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Back to the mansion.
But it's not like there's anything if I go back.
"…………"
I know I can never reach her, but I can't give up.
"Damn it---what the hell should I do……!"
Voicing my thoughts angrily, I leave the classroom.

entries.japanese:
……気がつくと茶道室の前にいた。
　茶道室に先輩が残っているワケはないのに、足は独りでに中に入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I came to myself, I was standing outside the tea-ceremony room.
There was no reason she would still be there, yet my feet carried me inside of their own accord.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I look up and find myself in front of the tea ceremony room.
Even though she won't be here, my legs walk in on their own.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――は」
　茶道室には、当然のように誰も居ない。
　なにかを期待していたわけでもなかったのに、こうトドメを刺されると視界がぐらりと歪んでしまう。
　ガラン、と視界が回っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Of course the room was empty.
I hadn’t expected anything, but this final proof struck the killing blow, and the world lurched sideways.
With a hollow rattle, my vision began to spin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Ha."
Of course, no one is here.
I wasn't expecting anything, but when I'm hit hard like this, my vision seems to waver.
The world starts to spin around me.

entries.japanese: それは、突然やってきた。
entries.maoEnglish: It came without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon: Instantly, it happens.

entries.japanese:
地面が揺れた。
　ずいぶん大きな地震だな―――そう思ったあと、今のは地震ではなく自分が倒れた衝撃なんだと気がついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The ground shook.
That’s a big earthquake, I thought—then realized the impact had been my own body hitting the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The ground shakes.
I think to myself it's a large earthquake---but I realize it's not the ground shaking, but the impact of my body hitting the floor that I felt.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――え？」
　声も、うまくあげられない。
　はあ　　　はあ　　　はあ。
　あえぐような呼吸が、他ならぬ自分の口からもれている。
　だが気分はまったく悪くない。
　どちらかというと、何も感じられないぐらい、感覚というものがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—what?”
I couldn’t even make my voice work.
Hah   hah   hah.
The ragged gasps leaking from my mouth were my own.
Yet I didn’t feel ill at all.
If anything, there was so little sensation left that I could hardly feel anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----eh?"
I can't speak well.
Panting.
The gasping breaths can be no one else's but mine.
But I don't feel bad.
It's more like I don't feel anything, like I have no sense of feeling at all.

entries.japanese:
はあ　　はあ　　はあ　　はあ　　はあ。
　苦しくないっていうのに、喉が苦しげに酸素をとりこもうとしている。
　まったく感覚がない。
　ここに倒れている自分の体が、見知らぬ他人のモノとしか思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah hah hah hah hah.
Though I felt no pain or distress, my throat labored desperately to drag in air.
I had no sensation at all.
The body sprawled here on the floor might have belonged to a stranger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of frantic breathing.
Even though I'm not exhausted, my throat painfully gasps for air.
I don't feel anything.
I feel like the collapsed body here isn't mine.

entries.japanese:
ハア　　ハア　　ハア　　ハア　　ハア。
　なにか―――ヘンだ。
　呼吸は乱れていく一方で、畳には、じんわりと赤い染みが広がっている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
HAH HAH HAH HAH HAH.
Something was wrong.
My breathing only grew more ragged, and a red stain was slowly spreading across the tatami—
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of gasping.
Something's---weird.
As I lie breathing wildly on the floor, blood spreads out on the tatami mats----

entries.japanese:
「――――がっ」
　トウトツに。
　胸が、キしんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghk—”
Without warning.
My chest gave a sickening creak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gah."
Suddenly,
a stabbing pain fills my chest.

entries.japanese:
―――このままここで腐っていても始まらない。
　たたでさえ体調が悪いんだから、食事ぐらいはとらないと本当に倒れてしまう。
「学食に行くか」
　気乗りしないまま呟いて席を立った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Nothing will change if I sit here rotting.
I already felt sick enough; if I didn’t at least eat something, I really might collapse.
“I guess I’ll go to the cafeteria.”
I muttered without enthusiasm and rose from my seat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Nothing's going to get done if I just rot here.
Besides, I'm not in the best health right now, so if I don't eat I'll really collapse.
"Guess I'll go to the cafeteria."
Thinking aloud, I get up from my desk.

entries.japanese:
もうラッシュの時間は終わったのか、食堂に行列はできていない。
　テーブルはほとんどが生徒たちで埋まっている。
　空いている席はないか、と食堂中を見渡す。
―――と。
　……先輩によく似た生徒を見つけてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The lunch rush must have passed, because there was no line at the cafeteria.
Almost every table was still packed with students, though.
I scanned the room for an empty seat.
―――And then.
I found a student who looked remarkably like her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The big rush must be over because there isn't a line.
The tables are mostly full of students already eating.
I glance around the room to see if there are any seats left.
---And then,
…… I see someone who looks like Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「――――は」
　お笑いだ。
　ちょっと似ているだけでシエル先輩と見間違うなんて本格的にまいってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
What a joke.
Mistaking someone for Ciel just because they looked a little alike—I really was losing my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Haha."
I laugh loudly.
Mistaking someone for Ciel-senpai because there's a small resemblance… I truly am beat.

entries.japanese:
まいっているって分かっているのに、先輩似の誰かから視線を外せない。
　先輩に似た誰かはテーブルに座ってうどんをつるつると食べている。
　しかもカレーうどん。
　食べている物まで先輩そっくりだ。
「――――――あ」
　っていうか、シエル先輩本人だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even knowing that, I couldn’t tear my eyes away.
Her look-alike sat at a table, noisily slurping noodles.
Curry udon, no less.
Even her choice of food was identical.
“Ah.”
Or rather, it was Ciel herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I know I'm beat, but I can't take my eyes away from this person that looks like her.
This person that looks like her sits at the table slurping up udon.
It's curry udon too.
Even her food resembles what Senpai would eat.
"------Ah."
Actually, it is Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「――――先輩っ！」
　全力で先輩の座っているテーブルへ駆け寄る。
「―――――――」
　先輩はチラッ、と俺の顔を見上げると、ぷい、と顔を背けてしまった。
　明らかに避けられている。
　だがそんな事を気にしてられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
I sprinted to her table at full speed.
“…”
She flicked a glance up at me, then pointedly turned her face away.
She was plainly avoiding me.
But I had no time to worry about that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Senpai!"
I dash with all my strength towards Senpai.
"-------"
Senpai looks up at me, then glances away quickly.
She's clearly avoiding me.
But, that doesn't matter.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、どうしてこんなトコにいるんだよ……！」
　気が急いてしまって、そんなぶしつけな言葉しか思いつかない。
「なんでって、わたしはここの生徒です。
お昼になったらごはんを食べないとダウンしちゃうじゃないですか」
「いや、だからそういうコトじゃなくて、俺は―――」
　なんて口にしていいか、あんまりに突然すぎて頭がキレイに働いてくれない。
　先輩はいかにも文句がありそうな顔で、つーんと俺から視線を逸らしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why are you here…!?”
I was in such a panic that this was the only graceless thing I could think to say.
“Why? I’m a student here, and if I don’t eat lunch, I’ll collapse.”
“No, that isn’t what I mean—I—”
It was all too sudden, and my thoughts refused to arrange themselves into words.
She kept her gaze turned haughtily aside, wearing the unmistakable face of someone with a grievance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, why are you here……!"
I blurt that out because I can't even think of anything else to say.
"Why am I here?
I'm a student here, you know.
If I don't eat during lunchtime, I'll collapse."
"No, that's not what I mean, but---"
I don't know what to say.
My brain just stopped functioning.
She looks away from me as if she wants to complain.

entries.japanese:
「俺は、先輩がここにいるのが不思議で。
だって一昨日、先輩がさよならって言ったから、もう会えないって―――」
「はい。
だって一昨日はもう時間が遅かったでしょ。
学生さんは家に帰らないといけないです」
　しれっと。
　とんでもないボケを、この人は言ってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I just can’t believe you’re here. The night before last, you said goodbye, so I thought I’d never see you again…”
“Yes. It was late, wasn’t it? Students have to go home at night.”
Without the slightest change of expression.
She delivered that monumental piece of nonsense.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I thought it was strange for you to be here.
Just yesterday, you said farewell, so I thought I would never see you again---"
"Yes, because it was getting late.
Students should go back home at that time, yes?"
Simply.
With a straight face, she says this outrageous punch line.

entries.japanese:
「なっ―――」
「それとも遠野くん。
わたしみたいなのが学校にいちゃいけませんか」
　先輩は一昨日の、無感情な目をして、まっすぐに俺の目を見つめてきた。
　……わたしみたいなの、と先輩は言った。
　先輩が本当に吸血鬼かどうかなのはわからない。
　ただ、死ぬような傷を負ってもすぐに治ってしまう体、なんていうのはアルクェイド同様、遥かに人間離れしている。
　それが人間らしいのかと問われれば、言い淀むしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—”
“What about you, Tohno? Would you rather someone like me didn’t come to school?”
She looked directly into my eyes with the same emotionless gaze she’d worn two nights ago.
Someone like me, she had said.
I still didn’t know whether she was truly a vampire.
But a body that healed instantly from mortal wounds was every bit as inhuman as Arcueid’s.
If she asked whether that made her human, I could only falter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---"
"Or, Tohno-kun, are you saying people like me shouldn't come to school?"
Her eyes, that were so devoid of emotion yesterday, look directly into mine.
…… A student like me?
That's what she said.
I don't know if she's really a vampire or not.
But she healed from that fatal wound quickly, so she has to be something more than human, like Arcueid.
You just can't say that's human.

entries.japanese:
けど、それでも。
　遠野志貴にとって、この人は大事な人なんだ。
　それがどんな感情なのかはまだわからない。
　けどたった半日。
たった半日間でも、この人がいないと思っただけで現実が薄っぺらに感じてしまった。
　だからもう―――自分にとって、この人は無くせない人になってしまっているんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even so.
To Shiki Tohno, she mattered.
I still didn’t understand what kind of feeling this was.
But for half a day. Only half a day—the mere thought that she was gone had made reality feel paper-thin.
Whatever else she might be, I could no longer bear to lose her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But still.
To me, she is a very dear person.
I still don't know exactly what kind of feelings I have for her.
But with just half a day.
It was only half a day, but just thinking she wasn't in my world anymore made me feel like reality was nothing I should care for.
So---for me, she is someone I can't lose.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩、俺は―――」
　そんなこと、全然っていうのは嘘だけど、本当に気になってない。
　先輩がたとえアルクェイドと同じでも、先輩は先輩だ。
それは絶対に信じられる。
　そう、昨日の夜に言えなかった言葉を口にしようと先輩を睨む。
　けれど、その前に。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, I—”
It would be a lie to say I hadn’t thought about it at all.
It truly didn’t matter to me; even if she were the same as Arcueid, she would still be herself. Of that I was absolutely certain.
I fixed her with a determined stare, ready to say what I’d failed to say last night.
But before I could act.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, I---"
I'd be lying if I said all of it, but I don't care.
Even if she is the same as Arcueid, Senpai is still Senpai.
That is an absolute truth I believe in.
Yes, I should say those words I couldn't say last night.
However, before that…

entries.japanese:
「いいです。
遠野くんに嫌われても仕方ないんですから、もう気にしません。
それにこれはわたしの日常ですから。
遠野くんがなんて言おうが、好きにやるって決めたんです」
　そう、きっぱりと先輩は言いきった。
　文句なんかないですよね、と先輩は無言で見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind. I can hardly blame you if you hate me, so I’ve decided not to care. Besides, this is my ordinary life. Whatever you say, I’m going to live it as I please.”
She stated it without a shred of hesitation.
Her silent stare added: You have no objection, I trust.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine.
I cannot help it if you hate me, Tohno-kun.
But this is my daily life, so no matter what you say, I decided to do as I please."
She speaks directly.
"You don't have any complaints, right?" Senpai says and stares at me.

entries.japanese:
「…………は」
　もちろん、文句なんかあるわけがない。
　あんなに悩んでいた自分がバカみたいでがっくりと力が抜けた。
　けど、それ以上に今は嬉しくて仕方がない。
「……ああ、文句なんかあるわけないだろ。
俺だって今まで、先輩の忠告を聞かないで好き勝手やってたんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah.”
Of course I didn’t.
All the anguish I’d put myself through suddenly seemed ridiculous, and the strength went out of me.
More than that, I was helplessly happy.
“No, of course I don’t object. I’ve ignored your warnings and done whatever I wanted from the start.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Huh?"
Of course, no complaints here.
I feel like such an idiot worrying about it so much.
The strength drains from my body.
But more than that, I can't help but feel really happy.
"…… Yeah, of course I don't have any complaints.
Because up until now, I was ignoring all your warnings and doing as I pleased too, Senpai."

entries.japanese:
「よろしい。
なら、握手しましょう」
　先輩は手を差し出してくる。
　先輩の意図はよくわからないけど、差し出された手を握った。
　ぶんぶん、と握手した手を上下に振る先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very good. Then let’s shake on it.”
She held out her hand.
I didn’t quite understand what she meant by it, but I took it anyway.
She pumped our joined hands vigorously up and down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That is acceptable.
Then, let's shake hands."
She sticks out her hand.
I don't know what she's thinking, but I take her outstretched hand.
Senpai shakes it up and down.

entries.japanese:
「はい、これで仲直りです。
これからもよろしくお願いしますね、遠野くん」
　先輩は本当に嬉しそうに、満面の笑みをうかべる。
　先輩はそのまま席を立って、どんぶりを持ってトコトコと歩きだした。
　……どこに行くのかは知らないけど、とにかくどこかに行こうとしているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There—we’ve made up. I hope we’ll get along from now on, Tohno.”
Her face opened into a radiant, genuinely delighted smile.
Then she rose, picked up her bowl, and pattered away.
I had no idea where she was going, but she was plainly going somewhere.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, then this is a sign that we have made peace.
Let's stay this way, okay Tohno-kun?"
She flashes a full, truly happy smile.
With that, she stands up, taking her tray as she walks away.
…… I don't know where, but she seems to be heading somewhere.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　先輩はどんぶりを食器置き場に置いて、食堂から立ち去っていく。
　……いいけど。
　先輩が学校に残っていて、仲直りできただけでも嬉しいけど―――このまま、アルクェイドや吸血鬼のことをうやむやにしていいんだろうか？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
She left her bowl at the dish return and walked out of the cafeteria.
That was fine.
I was overjoyed that she was still at school and that we’d made up—but could we really leave everything about Arcueid and the vampire unresolved?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
After putting her dishes in their place, she exits the cafeteria.
…… That's fine.
I'm happy that she is still here at school, and that we've made up but---can I let things go about Arcueid, and that vampire we're hunting?

entries.japanese:
「……まあいいか。
せっかく仲直りしたんだし、アルクェイドの事を話したらまた怒られちゃいそうだし」
　とにかく、今はこの関係を維持するべきだろう。
　先輩の後ろ姿を見送って、昼食を摂ることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe it’s fine. We only just made up, and bringing up Arcueid would probably make her angry again.”
For now, preserving our restored relationship seemed more important. I watched her go, then finally ate my lunch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh well.
We're finally friends again, and if I talk to her about Arcueid, she'll probably get angry once more."
For now, I have to maintain this relationship.
I watch Senpai as she leaves and then dig into my meal.

entries.japanese:
帰りのホームルームが終わった。
　がやがやと話し声をあげながらクラスメイトたちが席を立つ。
「――――さて」
　とりあえず、もうちょっと教室に残って様子を見よう。
　先輩が訪ねに来てくれるかもしれないし、来る気配がないんならこっちから茶道室に行けばいい。
entries.maoEnglish:
The final homeroom ended, and my classmates rose amid a swelling clamor of conversation.
“Well, then.”
I would wait here a little longer and see what happened.
She might come looking for me.
If she showed no sign of coming, I could always go to the tea-ceremony room myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The end of the day homeroom session is over.
My chattering classmates all get up from their seats.
"----Well then."
I should wait here a bit and see what happens.
Senpai might come here, and even if she doesn't, I can go to the tea ceremony room.

entries.japanese:
先輩がやってくる気配はない。
　惚れた弱みというかなんていうか、ともかくこっちから茶道室に行くしかないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was no sign of her.
Call it the curse of being smitten or whatever you liked; apparently I had no choice but to go to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It doesn't seem like Senpai is coming.
I guess I just have to go to the tea ceremony room.

entries.japanese:
急ぎ足で教室から出る。
目指すは茶道室だ。
―――まあ先輩と会ったら会ったで、話さなくちゃいけない事が山ほどある。
　この街に巣くっている吸血鬼の問題や、アルクェイドとの事もある。
　その話題を先輩にふるのは心苦しいと思う反面、先輩と一緒に過ごせるかと思うと胸が弾む。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hurried out of the classroom. My destination was the tea-ceremony room.
―――…Once we met, there would be any number of things to discuss:
the vampire nesting in this city, and everything that had happened with Arcueid.
The thought of raising those subjects made my heart ache, yet the prospect of spending time with her made it leap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My legs quickly exit the classroom and head there.
---Well, meeting Senpai means there are a lot of things we have to talk about.
About the vampire in this town, and about Arcueid.
Even though I know it will be painful to talk about them, I still get excited at the chance to be with Senpai again.

entries.japanese:
はっ、はっ、はっ―――――
　息を弾ませながら、廊下を全力疾走して茶道室へと向かっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah—
Breath coming fast, I sprinted down the corridor toward the tea-ceremony room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start to breathe hard----
I dash down towards the tea ceremony room.

entries.japanese:
茶道室には誰もいない。
　先輩はまだ来ていないようだった。
　……はあ……はあ。
　……どうも、少しはしゃぎすぎたらしい。
　畳の上に腰をおろして、呼吸を整える。
entries.maoEnglish:
The room was empty.
Apparently she hadn’t arrived yet.
Hah, hah.
I must have gotten a little too excited.
I sat on the tatami and tried to catch my breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There isn't anyone here.
It seems like she hasn't come here yet.
…… *pant*…… *pant*.
…… I think I got too excited.
Sitting down on the tatami mat, I catch my breath.

entries.japanese:
……はあ……はあ……はあ。
　熱くなった体はそう簡単には冷めない。
　喉も苦しげに酸素をとりこもうと大げさに動いている。
　体中、じんわりと汗をかいて、気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah.
My overheated body refused to cool.
My throat worked convulsively, struggling to pull in air.
Sweat filmed my entire body, clammy and revolting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*.
My heated body doesn't cool off that easily.
I painfully gasp for air.
My body is drenched in sweat, and I feel terrible.

entries.japanese:
……はあ……はあ……はあ……はあ……はあ。
　なにか―――ヘンだ。
　さっきから体を休めているのに、呼吸は乱れていく一方だし。
　だいたいどうして、ここまで走ってくるだけでこんなに体中が疲れているんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah, hah.
Something was wrong.
I had been resting all this time, yet my breathing was only getting worse.
Why had a short run exhausted my entire body so completely…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
My panting fills the air.
There's---something weird.
I've been resting for a while, but my breathing is getting worse.
In the first place, why is my body tired after only running this little distance……?

entries.japanese:
「――――がっ！？」
　トウトツに。
　胸が、キしんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghk—!?”
Without warning.
My chest gave a sickening creak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Gah!?"
Suddenly,
a stabbing pain fills my chest.

entries.japanese:
「……いいはずないじゃないか。
先輩、ちょっと！」
　急いで先輩の後を追いかけた。
「あれ？
　遠野くん、五時限目始まっちゃいますよ。
早く教室に戻らないと」
「ばか、それは先輩も一緒だろ。
なんだって中庭なんかに―――」
　……そっか。
　先輩は生徒のふりをしているだけなんだから、授業を受ける必要なんかないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it isn’t fine. Wait!”
I hurried after her.
“Oh? Tohno, fifth period is about to begin. You should hurry back to class.”
“Idiot, that goes for you too. Why are you heading into the courtyard…?”
Oh, right.
She was only pretending to be a student, so she had no need to attend classes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… This can't be good as it is.
Senpai, hey!"
I hurry after her.
"Oh?
Tohno-kun, fifth period will start soon you know.
You should hurry back to class."
"Idiot, the same goes for you.
Why are you out here in the courtyard---"
…… I see.
She's only pretending to be a student, so she doesn't really need to go to class.

entries.japanese:
「ふふ、そうですね。
わたしも五時限目に遅れてしまいます。
今日はこのまま帰ろうと思いましたけど、やっぱり真面目に授業を受けることにしますね」
　なんか、先輩は嬉しそうに笑っている。
「……先輩？
　もしかして、今までちゃんと授業受けてたの……？」
「あたりまえじゃないですか！
　その気がなかったらこんな格好してません！」
　……なんか、先輩は不機嫌そうに怒ってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hee hee, you’re right. I’ll be late for fifth period too. I thought I might go home for the day, but I’ve changed my mind and will attend class properly.”
She smiled, looking strangely pleased.
“Wait. Have you actually been attending all your classes this whole time…?”
“Of course I have! Why else would I dress like this?”
Now she was angry for some reason.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hehe, that's right.
I will be late to fifth period too.
I thought I would skip the rest of class, but maybe I should seriously attend class after all."
Senpai smiles happily.
"…… Senpai?
Don't tell me, you've been taking classes……?"
"Of course I was!
I wouldn't be dressed like this if I wasn't!"
…… She seems quite angry.

entries.japanese:
「―――は、はは」
「むっ。
なにがおかしいんですか、遠野くんは！」
「いや、だって―――喜んだり怒ったりさ、やっぱりシエル先輩はシエル先輩なんだって」
　そう実感できて、嬉しいだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hahaha.”
“Hmph. What are you laughing at, Tohno?”
“It’s just that seeing you laugh and get angry makes me realize you really are still Ciel.”
And realizing that made me happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ha, haha."
"Hey, what's so funny, Tohno-kun!?"
"No, it's just---so happy and so angry, I knew that you really were Ciel-senpai after all."
I really am happy.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ。
わたしはわたしですけど、それでどうして笑うんでしょうか、遠野くんは」
「いいんだ、こっちの話。
　それより先輩。
その、さ。
アルクェイドのことなんだけど―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. I’m still myself, but I fail to see what’s so funny about that.”
“Never mind—it’s nothing.
More importantly, there’s something I need to say. It’s about Arcueid. I—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?
I am me, but why would that make you laugh, Tohno-kun?"
"Ah, it's nothing.
More importantly, Senpai.
About, um.
Arcueid---"

entries.japanese:
「―――う」
　先輩は一瞬にして、あの無表情な目をして見つめてきた。
　……言いにくい。
言いにくいけど、はっきり言うために追ってきたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
In an instant, she was watching me with those expressionless eyes again.
This would be hard to say. But I had followed her precisely because I meant to say it plainly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ugh."
In a flash, Senpai looks up at me with emotionless eyes.
…… It's hard to speak.
It's hard to speak, but this is why I came after her.

entries.japanese:
「……怒らないで聞いてくれよ。
先輩はさんざん止めろって言ってくれたけど、やっぱり俺は吸血鬼の事は放っておけないんだ」
　……うっ。
無表情だった先輩の目が、なんか激しく怒ってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hear me out before you get angry. You warned me over and over to stay away, but I still can’t ignore the vampire.”
Ouch. Her eyes had been expressionless; now they were silently, furiously angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please listen to me without getting angry.
You told me to stop, but I just can't leave this vampire thing alone."
…… Uh-oh.
Her emotionless eyes seem to become tinged with anger.

entries.japanese:
「……とにかく、吸血鬼の事は放っておけない。
けど、昨日のことでアルクェイドとは決裂しちゃって、俺には何かをしたくても手段がないんだ。
　だから―――先輩が吸血鬼を探してるっていうんなら、それに協力させてくれないか」
　……先輩は黙っている。
　そうして、はあ、と深くため息をついて、
「イヤです」
　なんて、笑顔で断言した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t ignore the vampire. But after what happened yesterday, Arcueid and I are finished, and I have no way to act even if I want to.
So if you’re hunting the vampire too, will you let me help?”
She said nothing.
Then she released a long, weary sigh and—
“No.”
She refused me with a smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Anyways, I can't just ignore this vampire.
But I kind of broke up with Arcueid because of yesterday, and I can't do anything without help.
So---if you're looking for this vampire, can I help you?"
…… Senpai is quiet.
She takes a deep breath.
"I refuse."
And says so with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「イヤですって、なんで！？」
「あったりまえじゃないですかっ！
　遠野くん、昨日の夜だって彼女に殺されかけたって自覚してないんですか！？
　吸血鬼を追うっていうのは、いつ殺されてもおかしくないぐらい危険な事なんです。
そんな事に遠野くんを引き込むなんてできません！」
「―――だから、そういうのは覚悟の上だって言ってるだろ！
　これでも散々死ぬような目にあってきたんだ。
自分の身ぐらい自分で守れる！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why would you say no!?”
“Because it’s obvious! Tohno, do you not understand that she nearly killed you last night!?
Hunting a vampire is so dangerous that death can come at any moment. I can’t drag you into something like that!”
“I keep telling you, I’m prepared for that! I’ve already survived more brushes with death than I can count. I can look after myself!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You refuse?
Why!?"
"Of course I would!
Tohno-kun, don't you remember almost being killed by her!?
Hunting vampires means being in continual danger of death.
I will not let you be involved in such a thing, Tohno-kun!"
"---I know, but I'm saying I'm prepared for that!
I might not look like it, but I've experienced many near-death situations.
I can at least protect myself!"

entries.japanese:
「……あのですね。
遠野くん、なにを根拠にそんなコト言ってるんですか。
　確かに遠野くんの運動神経がいいのは認めます。
遠野くんは病弱ですけど、肉体そのものは優れているってわかってますから」
　肩をすくめて、先輩は意外なことを口にする。
「……そ、そうなの？」
　毒気を抜かれてしまって、つい聞き返してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Tell me, Tohno, what possible grounds do you have for claiming that?
I admit your reflexes are excellent. You may be sickly, but I know your body itself is exceptionally capable.”
She shrugged and offered this unexpected assessment.
“R-really?”
The fight went out of me so completely that I couldn’t help asking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, Tohno-kun.
How can you say that?
I will admit that you have very good athletic abilities.
Even though you have a weak constitution, your body itself is excellent."
Slumping her shoulders, Senpai says something very surprising.
"…… R, really?"
The tension seems to disappear, and I blurt that out in response.

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
遠野くん、わたしの部屋に泊まったとき裸になったじゃないですか。
その時に見たんです。
贅肉のない、引き締まった筋肉をしてました。
　遠くからでしたけど、その時にキレイな躯しているなあって思ったぐらいです」
「……裸って――――俺、裸になんかなってないけど」
「忘れちゃったんですか？
　遠野くん、お風呂に入るとき台所で着替えてたじゃないですか」
　あ、そうだった。
　たしか脱衣場に洗濯物が干してあって、邪魔になるからって―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. When you stayed at my room, you got undressed, remember? I saw you then. Your muscles were lean and firm, without any extra fat.
Even from a distance, I thought you had a beautiful body.”
“Undressed—I never got naked.”
“Have you forgotten? You changed in the kitchen before your bath.”
Oh, right.
The changing area had been full of drying laundry, so she’d said it would get in the way—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Tohno-kun, you got naked when you spent the night at my house.
I saw you then.
Not flabbiness, but tight muscles.
You were far away, but I thought your body was very well-formed."
"…… Naked-----But I, didn't get naked."
"Did you forget?
Tohno-kun, did you not change before you entered the bath?"
Ah, that's right.
Certainly I did take off my clothes and had her wash them for me---

entries.japanese:
「知らなかった。
先輩、人の着替えを覗き見するような人だったのか」
「―――え、いえ、アレはですね、不可抗力と申しましょうか、その、隙間から見えてしまって、ちょっとだけ興味があったものですから、いいかなーって」
　先輩の顔は弁解しながら真っ赤になっていく。
　……どうも、言いながらその時の光景を思い出してしまったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I had no idea. So you were the kind of person who spied on someone while he changed.”
“N-no, that was beyond my control; I happened to see you through the gap and was just a little curious, so I thought one tiny look wouldn’t hurt.”
Her face grew redder with every word of her defense.
Apparently the explanation had made her relive the scene.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, I didn't know you were someone who likes to peek at people who are changing."
"---Eh, no, that was, just an accident, I, um, happened to see it, and was a little curious, and thought maybe it would be alright…"
Her face turns a deep red as she stammers her excuses.
…… I guess she's remembering what she saw that time.

entries.japanese:
「ああもうっ、とにかく！
　いくら遠野くんが立派な体をしていようと、普通のひとに吸血鬼と戦う事なんて出来ないんですっ」
　なんだ、先輩が俺を戦わせたくない理由はそれなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, never mind! The point is that no matter how splendid your body may be, an ordinary person cannot fight a vampire!”
So that was why she refused to let me fight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, look!
No matter how good your body is Tohno-kun, ordinary people cannot stand up against a vampire."
Oh, that's why she doesn't want me to fight.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
それじゃこれで問題はないだろ」
　メガネを外す。
　ナイフを手に取る
　ずきん、とこめかみに痛みが走る。
　それを堪えて、木に見えている適当な『線』を切断した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then this should settle the problem.”
I took off my glasses.
I drew my knife—
Pain stabbed through my temple.
I endured it and severed one of the ‘lines’ I could see running across a nearby tree.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then, it's no problem."
I take off my glasses.
I take out my knife.
My headache starts to flare up.
Resisting that, I cut an appropriate "line" on a nearby tree.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、今の―――」
「……とまあ、こういうコト。
悪いけど、俺の目って普通じゃないんだ。
　アルクェイドの話じゃモノの『死』が視える、直死の魔眼ってヤツらしい」
　先輩は目を見張って、言葉を飲みこんでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, what did you just—”
“That’s what I can do. Sorry, but my eyes aren’t ordinary.
Arcueid says they are called the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, and they can see the ‘death’ of things.”
She stared at me, wide-eyed, unable to speak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, that---"
"…… That's how it is.
Sorry, but my eyes aren't normal.
Arcueid told me I can see the 'death' of things, and they're called something like the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception."
Her eyes widen as she takes it all in.

entries.japanese:
「――そう、ですか。
つまりそのナイフが特別というワケではなくて、遠野くん本人が特別だったんですね」
「……特別って、そういうんじゃない。
ただ事故の後遺症で、この両目がイカれただけだよ」
「―――彼女が遠野くんを気に入るわけですね。
貴方の目は、個人が保有する能力にしてはいきすぎていますから」
　先輩は力をなくしたように、急に元気をなくしてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then the knife itself isn’t special—you are.”
“I’m not special. My eyes were just ruined by the accident.”
“No wonder she took an interest in you. Your eyes grant an ability far beyond what any one person should possess.”
All at once, the strength seemed to drain from her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I, see.
So it isn't the knife that's special, but it's you, Tohno-kun."
"…… Not special.
It's just a side effect of an accident I had."
"---That is why she was so interested in you.
Your eyes have too much power for an individual to have."
She suddenly seems drained of all energy.

entries.japanese:
「……たしかに、それだけの力があるんでしたら、遠野くんを一人にしておくのは逆に危険ですね。
　わたしが断っても遠野くんは一人で吸血鬼探しをしてしまうでしょうし、カレのほうも―――遠野くんのことは無視できません」
「先輩……？
　それって、つまり―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you possess that much power, leaving you alone may actually be more dangerous.
Even if I refuse, you’ll hunt the vampire by yourself—and he will no longer be able to ignore you either.”
“Ciel…? Does that mean—?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Certainly, with that kind of power, it is more dangerous to leave you alone Tohno-kun.
And even if I did refuse, you would probably search for the vampire yourself anyway, and he---couldn't afford to ignore you."
"Senpai……?
You mean---"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
あまり遠野くんを巻き込みたくないんですけど、もう手遅れですから。
いまさら遠野くんには関係ないってつっぱねられません」
「それじゃあ、一緒に吸血鬼退治をしていいっていうこと？」
「はい。
こうなったらわたしも覚悟を決めちゃいました」
　先輩は片手を差し出してくる。
　それはさっき食堂でしたものとは違って、どこか決意を感じさせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I wanted to keep you out of this, but it’s already too late. I can’t dismiss you now by claiming it has nothing to do with you.”
“Then I can hunt the vampire with you?”
“Yes. At this point, I’ve made up my mind.”
She extended one hand.
Unlike our handshake in the cafeteria, this one carried the weight of a decision.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I do not want you to be involved, but it's too late.
I cannot deny that you have any connection to this any longer."
"So, it's okay if we go after this vampire together?"
"Yes.
I am prepared to do that."
Senpai extends a hand.
But I can feel it's different than when we shook hands in the cafeteria.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　もちろん、その手を握り返す。
　わずかな間だけ手を取り合って、握手は終わった。
「それじゃあこれからわたしたちはチームです。
わたしも遠野くんを頼りますから、遠野くんもわたしに頼ってください。
　これからは二人で、この街に巣くった吸血鬼を倒しましょう」
　柔らかな笑顔で先輩は語りかけてくる。
　それに無言で頷いた時、昼休み終了を告げる予鈴が鳴り響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Of course I took it.
We held hands for only a moment, and then the handshake ended.
“Then from now on, we’re a team. I’ll rely on you, Tohno, so please rely on me as well.
Together, we’ll destroy the vampire nesting in this city.”
She spoke with a gentle smile.
As I nodded in silence, the warning bell rang to mark the end of lunch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Of course, I take her hand.
Our hands meet briefly, and the handshake is over.
"This makes us a team now.
I am counting on you Tohno-kun, so please count on me.
From now on, the two of us will hunt down the vampire in this city."
She speaks with a gentle smile.
As I nod wordlessly, the chime sounds, signaling the end of lunchtime.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ放課後、茶道室に来て下さい。
そこでこれからのことを話し合いましょう」
　先輩は校舎のほうへ走っていく。
　それに遅れまいと、こっちも校舎へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come to the tea-ceremony room after school. We can discuss our plans there.”
She ran toward the school building.
I ran after her, determined not to fall behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After classes, please come to the tea ceremony room.
We can talk more then."
Senpai runs towards the school building.
I'm late too, so I run as well.

entries.japanese:
帰りのホームルームが終わった。
　がやがやと話し声をあげながらクラスメイトたちが席を立つ。
　いつもはその混雑を避けて最後までゆったりしている俺も、今日にかぎっては一緒になって席を立った。
entries.maoEnglish:
The final homeroom ended, and my classmates rose amid a swelling clamor of conversation.
Usually I waited for the crush to clear before leisurely getting up.
But today I rose with everyone else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The end of the day homeroom session is over.
My chattering classmates all get up from their seats.
I usually just linger until the chaos has passed over, but today I stand up with everyone else.

entries.japanese:
急ぎ足で教室から出る。
　目指すは茶道室だ。
　先輩とは色々あったけど、これで本当にうまくいく。
　先輩の力になれる事は嬉しいし、正直自分ひとりじゃ持て余していた吸血鬼に関してもこれで安心できる。
　いや、それよりなにより―――やっぱり先輩と一緒に過ごせるかと思うと胸が弾む。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hurried out of the classroom, bound for the tea-ceremony room.
We’d been through plenty, but now everything would work out.
I was glad I could help her.
And I was relieved that the vampire problem—far too much for me alone—was finally in capable hands.
No, more than any of that—the thought of spending time with her made my heart leap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I quickly walk out of the classroom.
I head for the tea ceremony room.
A lot has happened between Senpai and me, but it really turned out well.
I'm glad to be able to help her, and I can be more assured than I was fighting by myself.
But, more than that---I'm excited just to have the chance to be with Senpai once more.

entries.japanese:
はっ、はっ、はっ―――――
　息を弾ませながら、廊下を全力疾走して茶道室へと向かっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah—
Breath coming fast, I sprinted down the corridor toward the tea-ceremony room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I breathe hard----
I dash towards the tea ceremony room.

entries.japanese:
茶道室には誰もいない。
　まだ先輩は来ていなかった。
　……はあ……はあ。
　……どうも、少しはしゃぎすぎたらしい。
　畳の上に腰をおろして、呼吸を整える。
entries.maoEnglish:
The room was empty.
She still hadn’t arrived.
Hah, hah.
I must have gotten a little too excited.
I sat on the tatami and tried to catch my breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There isn't anyone here.
It seems like she hasn't come here yet.
…… *pant*…… *pant*.
…… I think I got too excited.
Sitting down on the tatami mat, I catch my breath.

entries.japanese:
……はあ……はあ……はあ。
　熱くなった体はそう簡単には冷めない。
　喉も苦しげに酸素をとりこもうと大げさに動いている。
　体中、じんわりと汗をかいて、気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah.
My overheated body refused to cool.
My throat worked convulsively, struggling to pull in air.
Sweat filmed my entire body, clammy and revolting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*.
My heated body doesn't cool off that easily.
I painfully gasp for air.
My body is drenched in sweat, and I feel terrible.

entries.japanese:
……はあ……はあ……はあ……はあ……はあ。
　なにか―――ヘンだ。
　さっきから体を休めているのに、呼吸は乱れていく一方だし。
　だいたいどうして、ここまで走ってくるだけでこんなに体中が疲れているんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah, hah.
Something was wrong.
I had been resting all this time, yet my breathing was only getting worse.
Why had a short run exhausted my entire body so completely…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
My gasping fills the air.
There's---something weird.
I've been resting for a while, but my breathing is getting worse.
In the first place, why is my body tired after only running this little distance……?

entries.japanese:
「――――がっ！？」
　トウトツに。
　胸が、キしんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghk—!?”
Without warning.
My chest gave a sickening creak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Gah!?"
Suddenly,
pain fills my chest.

entries.japanese:
「っっっ、っ…………！」
　ばたん、と体が倒れこむ。
「っ、あ、あ…………！」
　全身が、痙攣する。
　いた、い。
　胸、胸が、焼け、る、、、、、、！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn—gh…!”
My body hit the floor.
“Ah—aaah…!”
Every muscle convulsed.
It hurt.
My chest—my chest was burning!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tsss, ah…………!"
My body falls with a crash.
"Ah, ah, ah…………!"
My entire body is convulsing.
It, hurts.
My chest, my chest is, burning,,,,,,!

entries.japanese:
「―――っ、――っ、っあああう………！」
　意識がとぶ。
　あまりの痛みで、指先が畳に爪を立てる。
　ギリギリと畳を引き裂く。
　でも、そんな事をしたところで痛みは収まらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—ah—aaauuugh…!”
Consciousness blinked out.
The pain drove my fingernails into the tatami.
They rasped across it, tearing the weave.
But no matter what I did, the agony would not subside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----,---,aaaah………!"
My mind is drifting away.
My fingers claw at the tatami mats in pain.
I pull and rip at the mats.
But, it doesn't stop the pain.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はあううう……！」
　痛い。
　痛い。
　痛い。
　こんな、痛いなんて、恐い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah—aaagh…!”
It hurt.
It hurt.
It hurt.
Pain like this was terrifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hagh, gah, ghaaaaa……!"
Pain.
Pain.
Pain.
Such pain, is frightening.

entries.japanese:
「う、うく、くあああ………！」
　耐えられない。
　この痛みがまだ一秒でも続くというのなら。
　いっそ、殺して、くれればいいのに――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—ghaaah…!”
I couldn’t bear it.
If this pain was going to last even one second more.
I wished someone would just kill me!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"U, ugah, kuaaaa………!"
I can't bear it.
If it lasts another second,
then, it would be better, just to die----!

entries.japanese:
『いいぜ。
オマエの望み、聞いてやるよ志貴』
entries.maoEnglish: “All right—I’ll grant your wish, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine.
I'll grant your wish, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
　畳の上に這いつくばった顔をあげる。
　その前に。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
I lifted my face from the tatami.
Before I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
I lift my head off the floor.
Before that.

entries.japanese:
その前に。
　痛みが消えていた。
　もう、どこも痛いとは感じない。
　重いとも感じない。
　生きているとも、感じない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Before I could.
The pain vanished.
Nothing hurt anymore.
Nothing felt heavy.
I could not even feel that I was alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Before that.
My pain disappears.
I don't feel pain anywhere.

I don't even feel heavy.
I don't even feel… alive.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　何か言おうとしても、喉が動かない。
　なにもない。
　痛みも
　感覚も
　自由も、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I tried to speak, but my throat would not move.
There was nothing.
No pain—
No sensation—
No freedom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I try to say something, but my throat doesn't move.
There's nothing.
No pain,
no sensation,
not even, freedom.

entries.japanese:
「―――――！」
　わけもわからず、なんとか起きあがろうとする。
　体はぴくりとも動かない。
　何かに縛られているわけでもなく、体中が麻痺しているような感じでもない。
　その、例えるのなら。
　俺はとっくに死んでしまっていて、何かの間違いで意識だけが死体に残っているような感覚。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
With no idea what was happening, I struggled to rise.
My body did not twitch.
Nothing bound me, nor did it feel as though I had been paralyzed.
The closest comparison I could find was this.
I had died long ago, and through some mistake my consciousness had been left behind in the corpse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
I don't know what's going on, so I try to get up.
My body doesn't even twitch.
It's not that I'm tied down, nor is it that my entire body is numb.
If I have to give a metaphor,
it's like my body is already dead, but my mind is mistakenly still lingering in my body.

entries.japanese:
「――――――、」
　体の五感の中で、視覚だけがかろうじて生きている。
　……茶道室は暗い。
　いつのまにか、外は完全に夜になっていた。
「―――」
　顔が動かないので、なんとか眼球だけをせわしなく動かした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Of all five senses, only my sight still faintly lived.
The tea-ceremony room was dark.
At some point, night had fallen completely outside.
“…”
Unable to turn my head, I darted my eyes frantically about.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Of my five senses, only my sight is still alive.
…… the room is dark.
It's night outside already.
"---"
I can't move my face, so I move my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「―――ほう。
完全に消えたかと思ったが、わりあいしつこいんだな、志貴」
entries.maoEnglish: “―――Well. I thought you had vanished entirely, but you’re surprisingly tenacious, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Oh?
I thought you had completely disappeared, but you're awfully persistent, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
聞こえない筈の声が聞こえる。
「――――！」
　闇の底を凝視する。
　そこに。
　なにか、見知らぬモノが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I heard a voice I should not have been able to hear.
“――――!”
I stared into the depths of the darkness.
There.
Something unknown stood waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can hear a voice I shouldn't be able to hear.
"----!"
I glance around the dark as best as I can.
There,
I see something I don't know about.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　誰だコイツ。
　初めて見る。
初めて見るヤツなのに―――昔から、知っているような、気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Who was he?
I had never seen him before. I knew that—and yet I felt as if I had known him all my life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Who is that?
I've never seen him.
I've never seen him---but I feel like, I've known him from a long, long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、その反応はひどいじゃないか志貴。
　オマエがオレを捜しているっていうからせっかく出向いてきてやったのに、オマエはオレを覚えていないのか」
　くっ、と愉しげな笑い声をあげて、男は赤黒い眼差しを向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a cruel welcome, Shiki.
You were looking for me, so I went to all the trouble of coming here—don’t you remember me?”
The man gave a low, delighted chuckle and fixed me with eyes of dark, bloodied red.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's this?
How mean of you, Shiki.
You've been looking for me for so long and when I come out, you don't remember me?"
With an amused laugh, he stares at me with blood-shot eyes.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　唯一まともに動いてくれている意識が、凍りついた。
　まだ、はっきりとは言われていない。
　まだはっきりとしていないのに―――コイツが吸血鬼なんだと。
　コイツが先輩とアルクェイドが追い詰めている『蛇』なんだと、はっきりと認識できた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The only part of me still functioning—my mind—froze solid.
No one had told me yet.
Nothing had been established.
Even so, I knew with absolute certainty that this was the vampire—the Serpent Ciel and Arcueid had been hunting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
My mind, the only thing still working, freezes.
He didn't say it yet,
But---I know he is a vampire.
That he is the "Serpent" Senpai and Arcueid are looking for.

entries.japanese:
「……否、それは違う。
たしかに私は転生するアカシャの蛇と呼ばれる吸血種だ。
　だがね、オマエにとって私は蛇ではなくシキの筈ではないのか？
―――チッ、まったく冷たいヤツだよオマエは。
これじゃ八年間思い続けてきたオレが馬鹿みたいじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, that is not so. I am indeed a member of the vampiric species known as the reincarnating Serpent of Akasha.
But to you, surely I am SHIKI rather than the Serpent?
―――Tch, you really are cold. I’ve spent eight years thinking of you, and now I look like a fool.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, that's wrong.
Certainly I am the vampire known as the Serpent of Akasha.
But to you, I'm not the Serpent, but rather, SHIKI, right?
---Man, how cold of you.
You make me look stupid for thinking about you all these eight years."

entries.japanese:
―――――？
　シキ？
　八年間？
　それは一体――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――?
SHIKI?
Eight years?
What in the world—
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----?
SHIKI?
Eight years?
What is that----?

entries.japanese:
「―――本当に忘れているのか志貴。
　……親父の暗示はよほど出来がよかったのか、それとも―――一度死んだ後だから、それまでの記憶は破損しちまったのか。
　くそ、どちらにせよこれじゃあ台無しだ！
　
　わかってるのか！？
　八年間、八年間も待ってたのに！
　オマエに、オレを殺したオマエから全てを奪えるこの瞬間をずっと待っていたのに、肝心のオマエが脱け殻になっているんじゃ話にならないじゃないか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Have you truly forgotten, Shiki?
Was Father’s suggestion really so perfect, or did dying once damage everything you remembered from before?
Damn it—either way, this ruins everything!
Do you understand!? Eight years—I waited eight years! I waited all this time for the moment I could take everything from you, the one who killed me, and now the man at the heart of it is nothing but an empty shell…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Did you really forget Shiki?
…… Was the old man's hypnosis that good or---did you lose your memory after dying once?
Shit, either way, what a waste!
Do you understand!?
These eight years, I've waited these eight years!
I've waited for this instance where I could steal everything from you, the one who killed me!
But what use is it now if you don't remember!?"

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　なに、を、言っているんだ、コイツは。
　俺が―――コイツを、殺した？
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
What was he talking about?
I killed him?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
What is, he saying?
I---killed him?

entries.japanese:
「そうだ！
　忘れているのなら思い出せ。
オレたちはいつも三人一緒だっただろう？
　遠野の屋敷で。
秋葉とオレと、オマエの三人でよく庭を遊びまわった。
八年前のあの日、オレがこうなっちまう前までな！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes! If you’ve forgotten, then remember. The three of us were always together, weren’t we?
At the Tohno mansion. You, Akiha, and I used to run all over the garden. Right up until that day eight years ago, before I became this!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right!
If you've forgotten, then remember.
The three of us were always together, right?
In the Tohno mansion.
Akiha and you, and I would play in the garden together.
Before I became like this eight years ago that day!"

entries.japanese:
―――よく、思い出せない。
　たしかに―――子供のころ、もう一人誰かいた気がするんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I couldn’t remember clearly.
And yet—I did feel as though there had been someone else when I was a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I, can't remember.
Certainly---it seems like there was another kid with us back then.

entries.japanese:
「……思い出せないのか。
オレとオマエはあんなに仲が良かったのに」
　ぎり、と。
　なにか、本当に口惜しそうに、ヤツは表情を曇らせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You can’t remember?
After you and I were such good friends.”
His face tightened, clouding with what looked like genuine bitterness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can't remember?
And we were such good friends too."
He grits his teeth.
His whole body quivers with emotion as if he was brimming with vexation.

entries.japanese:
「―――まったく。
苦しんでいたのはオレだけっていう事か。
　酷い話だぜ、志貴。
オレはずっと親父に閉じ込められていたけどな、それでもオマエの事だけは感じてたんだぜ。
　はは、なんていったってオマエの『命』はオレが使わせてもらってるんだからな。
オレとオマエは血の絆のかわりに魂で繋がっている」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I was the only one who suffered. That’s cruel, Shiki.
Father kept me locked away all those years. Even then, you were the one person I could feel.
Of course you were—after all, I’ve been using your ‘life.’ You and I are joined through our souls instead of our blood.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Geez.
Was I the only one in pain?
That's terrible, Shiki.
I was always locked away by my old man, but I could always sense you.
Haha.
Because I was using your 'life'.
Even though we're not connected by blood, we're connected by our souls."

entries.japanese:
「だからこそオマエには―――この上ないほど凄惨な終わり方を迎えさせてやりたかったんだが」
　残念だ、とヤツは言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s why I wanted to give you the most hideous end imaginable.”
He called it a shame.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why you---I wanted you to have a terribly gruesome end."
How unfortunate, he says.

entries.japanese:
「ようするにさ、志貴。
オレはオマエの兄貴ってコトさ。
秋葉もオマエも、薄情にも忘れてくれているけどな」
「―――――」
　俺の……遠野志貴の、兄………？
entries.maoEnglish:
“To put it simply, Shiki. I’m your older brother. You and Akiha were both heartless enough to forget me.”
“―――――”
My brother—the brother of Shiki Tohno?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What I wanted to say is this, Shiki.
I'm your brother.
But you and Akiha seem to have heartlessly forgotten that."
"-----"
My…… Tohno Shiki's, brother………?

entries.japanese:
「―――忘れているのなら、話はこれまでだ。
　遠野志貴を苦しめて殺す、というのがこの肉体……遠野シキの目的でね。
　それに今まで付き合ってきてやったが、そろそろ幕にしよう。
　私も―――いつまでも二つの肉体に一つの命では効率が悪い」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――If you have forgotten, there is nothing more to say.
To torment and kill Shiki Tohno—that is the purpose of this body, SHIKI Tohno.
I have indulged it until now, but it is time to bring down the curtain.
Sharing one life between two bodies forever is rather inefficient.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---If you've forgotten, then there's nothing to talk about.
Your painful death is the goal of this body…… of Tohno SHIKI.
I've gone along with that this long, but it's time to lower the curtain.
Even for me---to have two bodies with one life is not very efficient."

entries.japanese:
声が、近づいてくる。
　このまま殺される。
　……いや、殺されているというのならとっくに殺されているのか。
　手も足も動かない。
　目も耳も鼻もきかない。
　だから、痛みというものさえ無かった。
　俺はいつ死んでしまったのか気づかないぐらい曖昧に、ぼんやりと殺されてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The voice drew closer.
He was going to kill me.
Or if I was already being killed, perhaps I had died long ago.
My hands and feet would not move.
My eyes, ears, and nose no longer worked.
There was not even any pain.
I was killed so vaguely, so dimly, that I never noticed the moment I died.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice nears.
I'll be killed like this.
…… No, I say I'll die, but maybe I'm already dead.
My arms and legs can't move.
My eyes, my ears, my nose don't work.
That's why there isn't even any pain.
I am killed so vaguely that I don't even realize it.

entries.japanese:
「っっっ、っ…………！」
　ばたん、と体が倒れこむ。
「っ、あ、あ…………！」
　全身が、痙攣する。
　いた、い。
　胸、胸が、焼け、る、、、、、、！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn—gh…!”
My body hit the floor.
“Ah—aaah…!”
Every muscle convulsed.
It hurt.
My chest—my chest was burning!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tsss, ah…………!"
My body falls with a crash.
"Ah, ah, ah…………!"
My entire body is convulsing.
It, hurts.
My chest, my chest is, burning,,,,,,!

entries.japanese:
「―――っあうううぅううう………！」
　意識がとぶ。
　あまりの痛みで、指先が畳に爪を立てる。
　ギリギリと畳を引き裂く。
　でも、そんな事をしたところで痛みは収まらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Agh—aaauuugh…!”
Consciousness blinked out.
The pain drove my fingernails into the tatami.
They rasped across it, tearing the weave.
But no matter what I did, the agony would not subside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----,aaaah………!"
My mind is drifting away.
My fingers claw at the tatami mats in pain.
I pull and rip at the mats.
But, it doesn't stop the pain.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はあううう……！」
　痛い。
　痛い。
　痛い。
　こんな。
痛いなんて。
恐い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah—aaagh…!”
It hurt.
It hurt.
It hurt.
Pain like this. Pain this terrible. I was afraid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hagh, ghah, ghaaaaa……!"
Pain.
Pain.
Pain.
Such pain, is frightening.

entries.japanese:
「う、うく、くあああ………！」
　耐えられない。
　この痛みがまだ一秒でも続くというのなら。
　いっそ、殺して、くれればいいのに――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—ghaaah…!”
I couldn’t bear it.
If this pain was going to last even one second more.
I wished someone would just kill me!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"U, ugah, kuaaaa………!"
I can't bear it.
If it lasts another second,
then, it would be better, just to die----!

entries.japanese:
『いいぜ。
オマエの望み、聞いてやるよ志貴』
entries.maoEnglish: “All right—I’ll grant your wish, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine.
I'll grant your wish Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
　畳の上に這いつくばった顔をあげる。
　その前に
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
I lifted my face from the tatami.
But before I could—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
I lift my head off the floor.
Before that.

entries.japanese:
その前に。
　痛みが消えていた。
　もう、どこも痛いとは感じない。
　重いとも感じない。
　生きているとも、感じない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Before I could.
The pain vanished.
Nothing hurt anymore.
Nothing felt heavy.
I couldn’t even feel that I was alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Before that,
my pain disappears.
I don't feel pain anywhere.

I don't even feel heavy.
I don't even feel… alive.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　何か言おうとしても、喉が動かない。
　なにもない。
　痛みも。
　感覚も。
　自由も、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I tried to speak, but my throat would not move.
There was nothing.
No pain.
No sensation.
No freedom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I try to say something, but my throat doesn't move.
There's nothing.
No pain,
no sensation,
not even, freedom.

entries.japanese:
「―――――！」
　わけもわからず、なんとか起きあがろうとする。
　体はぴくりとも動かない。
　何かに縛られているわけでもなく、体中が麻痺しているような感じでもない。
　その、例えるのなら。
　俺はとっくに死んでしまっていて、何かの間違いで意識だけが死体に残っているような感覚。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
With no idea what was happening, I struggled to rise.
My body did not twitch.
Nothing bound me, nor did it feel as though I had been paralyzed.
The closest comparison I could find was this.
I had died long ago, and through some mistake my consciousness had been left behind in the corpse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
I don't know what's going on, so I try to get up.
My body doesn't even twitch.
It's not that I'm tied down, nor is it that my entire body is numb.
If I have to give a metaphor,
it's like my body is already dead, but my mind is mistakenly still lingering in my body.

entries.japanese:
「――――――、」
　体の五感の中で、視覚だけがかろうじて生きている。
　……茶道室は暗い。
　いつのまにか、外は完全に夜になっていた。
「―――」
　顔が動かないので、なんとか眼球だけをせわしなく動かした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Of all five senses, only my sight still faintly lived.
The tea ceremony room was dark.
At some point, night had fallen completely outside.
“…”
Unable to turn my head, I darted my eyes frantically about.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Of my five senses, only my sight is still alive.
…… the room is dark.
It is already night outside.
"---"
I can't move my face, so I move my eyes.

entries.japanese:
――――、―――――、―――――――、
　なにか。
　すぐ近くで、音がしている。
　耳をすませても何も聞こえない。
　自分の呼吸の音さえ聞こえないということは、俺の耳はどうかしてしまったらしい。
　ただ。
　すごく苦しそうな声で、遠野くん、と名前を呼ばれ続けている気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――, ―――――, ―――――――,
Something.
There was a sound close by.
I strained to hear, but caught nothing—not even my own breathing.
Apparently my ears had ceased to work.
And yet.
I had the sense that an agonized voice kept calling, “Tohno.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
----, -----, ------,
Something.
I hear something nearby.
But I can't really hear anything.
It seems something is wrong with my ears since I can't even hear my own breathing.
Just,
I feel like I can dimly hear a pained voice calling my name.

entries.japanese:
「―――ほう。
完全に消えたかと思ったが、わりあいしつこいんだな、志貴」
　聞こえない筈の声が聞こえる。
「――――！」
　闇の底を凝視する。
　そこに。
　なにか、見知らぬモノが座っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Well. I thought you had vanished entirely, but you’re surprisingly tenacious, Shiki.”
I heard a voice I should not have been able to hear.
“―――――!”
I stared into the depths of the darkness.
There.
Something unknown sat waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Oh?
I thought you had completely disappeared, but you're awfully persistent, Shiki."

I can hear a voice I shouldn't be able to hear.
"----!"
I glance around the dark as best as I can.
There,
I see something I don't know about.

entries.japanese:
「――――！？」
　誰だコイツ。
　初めて見る。
初めて見るヤツなのに―――昔から、知っているような、気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!?”
Who was he?
I had never seen him before. I knew that—and yet I felt as if I had known him all my life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Who is that?
I've never seen him.
I've never seen him---but I feel like, I've known him from a long, long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、その反応はひどいじゃないか志貴。
　オマエがオレを捜しているっていうからせっかく出向いてきてやったのに、オマエはオレを覚えていないのか」
　くっ、と愉しげな笑い声をあげて、男は赤黒い眼差しを向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a cruel welcome, Shiki.
You were looking for me, so I went to all the trouble of coming here—don’t you remember me?”
The man gave a low, delighted chuckle and fixed me with eyes of dark, bloodied red.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's this?
How mean of you, Shiki.
You've been looking for me for so long and when I come out, you don't remember me?"
With an amused laugh, he stares at me with blood-shot eyes.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　唯一まともに動いてくれている意識が、凍りついた。
　まだ、はっきりとは言われていない。
　まだはっきりとしていないのに―――コイツが吸血鬼なんだと。
　コイツが先輩とアルクェイドが追い詰めている蛇なんだと、はっきりと認識できた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The only part of me still functioning—my mind—froze solid.
No one had told me yet.
Nothing had been established.
Even so, I knew with absolute certainty that this was the vampire—the Serpent Ciel and Arcueid had finally cornered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
My mind, the only thing still working, freezes.
He didn't say it yet,
But---I know he is a vampire.
That he is the "Serpent" Senpai and Arcueid are looking for.

entries.japanese:
「……否、それは違う。
たしかに私は転生するアカシャの蛇と呼ばれる吸血種だ。
だがね、オマエにとって私は蛇ではなくシキの筈ではないのか？
―――チッ、まったく冷たいヤツだよオマエは。
これじゃ八年間思い続けてきたオレが馬鹿みたいじゃないか。
　なあ、君もそう思うだろうシエル」
　男はこちらを見たまま、そんな言葉を口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, that is not so. I am indeed a member of the vampiric species known as the reincarnating Serpent of Akasha. But to you, surely I am SHIKI rather than the Serpent?
―――Tch, you really are cold. I’ve spent eight years thinking of you, and now I look like a fool.
Don’t you agree, Ciel?”
The man never looked away from me as he spoke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, that's wrong.
Certainly I am the vampire known as the Serpent of Akasha.
But to you, I'm not the Serpent, but rather, SHIKI, right?
---Man, how cold of you.
You make me look stupid for thinking about you all these eight years.
Hey, don't you feel the same way Ciel?"
He says that while looking at me.

entries.japanese:
「――――！」
　先輩。
先輩がいるのか？
　でもどこに。
気配もなければ姿も見えない。
　それに先輩がいるなら、どうしてコイツをどうにかしないんだ。
　目の前に。
いま目の前に、俺たちの敵が座っているっていうのに………！
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Ciel was here? Where?
But where was she? I could neither see her nor sense her.
And if she was here, why wasn’t she doing something about him?
Our enemy was sitting right in front of me. Right there!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!"
Senpai.
Is Senpai here?
But where?
I can't see her, nor do I sense her presence.
If she is here, then why isn't she doing anything about him?
In front of me.
Right now, our enemy is in front of me………!

entries.japanese:
「ああ、あんまり無茶なことはシエルには言わないほうがいい。
今ね、ちょっと人前に出せるような状態じゃないんだ彼女。
　まあそもそも―――今のオマエには何も見えていないとは思うんだが」
　じゃり、という音。
　なにか。
　狂おしいぐらいの執念で、畳に爪をたてる音が、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, now—don’t ask too much of Ciel. She isn’t exactly fit to be seen at the moment.
Though in any case—I doubt you can see anything at all as you are now.”
A rasp against the tatami.
Something.
Nearby, it was clawing at the tatami with a desperation that bordered on madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You shouldn't ask Ciel something she can't do that much about.
Right now, she isn't in a condition to really show herself in front of others.
Well, in the first place---I don't think you can really see anything right now."
Another sound.
Something.
I can hear the sound of something tenaciously, almost madly clawing the tatami mats.

entries.japanese:
「……だから、そんなモノに気を取られるなと言っているだろう……！
　いいか志貴、いまのオマエが見れるものはオレだけだ。
　オマエが聞き取れる音はオレの声だけ。
　オマエが感じ取れる存在はオレのモノだけ。
　オマエにとっての生の在処はこのオレだけなんだ………！
　やっと、やっとこうしてオマエと会える場面を迎えたっていうのに、オレ以外のモノなんぞ考えるな―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you not to let that thing distract you…!
Listen, Shiki—I am the only thing you can see right now.
My voice is the only sound you can hear.
Mine is the only presence you can feel.
I alone am where life exists for you…!
At last—at long last, we’ve reached the moment when I can meet you like this, so don’t you dare think about anything but me!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey, didn't I tell you not to pay attention to that……!?
Look Shiki, the only thing you should see is me.
The only thing you should hear is my voice.
The only existence you should acknowledge is mine.
The only one that lets you live is me………!
Finally, at last, I've met you here, so don't think of anything other than me---!"

entries.japanese:
――――ざくり、という音。
　目の前の男―――蛇という吸血鬼の手元で、何か、厭な音がして。
　その後、苦痛をおびた吐息が、かすかに聞こえた。
　――――の、く――ん
　よく聞こえないけど、そんな声が。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A wet, slicing sound.
Something made a sickening noise near the hands of the man before me—the vampire called the Serpent.
Then I faintly heard a breath steeped in pain.
――――hno—
I could barely hear it, but the voice seemed to say something like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----A sharp sound.
From the hand of the man before me---this vampire called the Serpent, I hear a sickening sound.
And then, I hear a faint, pained gasp.
----no, ku--n
I can't quite make it out.

entries.japanese:
「―――本当に忘れているのか志貴。
　……親父の暗示はよほど出来がよかったのか、それとも―――一度死んだ後だから、それまでの記憶は破損しちまったのか。
　くそ、どちらにせよこれじゃあ台無しだ！
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Have you truly forgotten, Shiki?
Was Father’s suggestion really so perfect? Or did dying once damage everything you remembered from before?
Damn it—either way, this ruins everything!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Did you really forget Shiki?
…… Was the old man's hypnosis that good or---did you lose your memory after dying once?
Shit, either way, what a waste!

entries.japanese:
「わかってるのか！？
　八年間、八年間も待ってたのに！
　オマエに、オレを殺したオマエから全てを奪えるこの瞬間をずっと待っていたのに、肝心のオマエが脱け殻になっているんじゃ話にならないじゃないか……！」
「―――――」
　なに、を、言っているんだ、コイツは。
　俺が―――コイツを、殺した？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do you understand!? Eight years—I waited eight years! I waited all this time for the moment I could take everything from you, the one who killed me, and now the man at the heart of it is nothing but an empty shell…!”
“…”
What was he talking about?
I killed him?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Do you understand!?
These eight years, I've waited these eight years!
I've waited for this instance where I could steal everything from you, the one who killed me!
But what use is it now if you don't remember!?"

"-----"
What is, he saying?
I---killed him?

entries.japanese:
「そうだ！
　忘れているのなら思い出せ。
オレたちはいつも三人一緒だっただろう？
　遠野の屋敷で。
秋葉とオレと、オマエの三人でよく庭を遊びまわった。
　八年前のあの日、オレがこうなっちまう前までな！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes! If you’ve forgotten, then remember. The three of us were always together, weren’t we?
At the Tohno mansion. You, Akiha, and I used to run all over the garden.
Right up until that day eight years ago, before I became this!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right!
If you've forgotten, then remember.
The three of us were always together, right?
In the Tohno mansion.
Akiha and you, and I would play in the garden together.
Before I became like this eight years ago that day!"

entries.japanese:
―――よく、思い出せない。
　たしかに―――子供のころ、もう一人誰かいた気がするんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I couldn’t remember clearly.
And yet—I did feel as though there had been someone else when I was a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I, can't remember.
Certainly---it seems like there was another kid with us back then.

entries.japanese:
「……思い出せないのか。
オレとオマエはあんなに仲が良かったのに」
　ぎり、と。
　なにか、本当に口惜しそうに、ヤツは表情を曇らせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You can’t remember?
After you and I were such good friends.”
His face tightened, clouding with what looked like genuine bitterness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can't remember?
And we were such good friends too."
He grits his teeth.
His whole body quivers with emotion as if he was brimming with vexation.

entries.japanese:
「―――まったく。
苦しんでいたのはオレだけっていう事か。
　酷い話だぜ、志貴。
オレはずっと親父に閉じ込められていたけどな、それでもオマエの事だけは感じてたんだぜ。
　はは、なんていったってオマエの『命』はオレが使わせてもらってるんだからな。
オレとオマエは血の絆のかわりに魂で繋がっている。
　だからこそオマエには―――この上ないほど凄惨な終わり方を迎えさせてやりたかったんだが」
　残念だ、とヤツは言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I was the only one who suffered. That’s cruel, Shiki.
Father kept me locked away all those years. Even then, you were the one person I could feel.
Of course you were—after all, I’ve been using your ‘life.’ You and I are joined through our souls instead of our blood.
That’s why I wanted to give you the most hideous end imaginable.”
He called it a shame.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Geez.
Was I the only one in pain?
That's terrible, Shiki.
I was always locked away by my old man, but I could always sense you.
Haha.
Because I was using your 'life'.
Even though we're not connected by blood, we're connected by our souls."

"That's why you---I wanted you to have a terribly gruesome end."
How unfortunate, he says.

entries.japanese:
じゃり、じゃり、と。
　また、畳を引っかくような音が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Scrape, scrape.
Once again came the sound of nails clawing across tatami.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That sound again.
The sound of someone clawing at the tatami mats.

entries.japanese:
「……うるさい女だ。
この命はオレが奪ったものだ。
もう八年も前からオレのものなんだよ！
　いまさら志貴に還すなんてマネ、できると思うか？
　だいたいな、コレがなかったらオレが死んじまうじゃねえか。
シエル、オマエはオレに死ねっていうのか？
　ったくひでえ女だ。
いいから黙って、そこで死んでろ」
　ざく、という音。
　じゃり、という音はそれで聞こえなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a noisy woman. This life is mine. I stole it eight years ago, and it has belonged to me ever since! Do you think I could simply hand it back to Shiki now?
Without it, I would die. Are you telling me to die, Ciel? You’re a vicious woman. Now be quiet and lie there until you’re dead.”
A thick, stabbing sound.
The scraping stopped.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What an annoying woman.
I stole this life.
This was mine since eight years ago!
You think I can just give it back to Shiki?
In the first place, I would die without it.
Ciel, are you telling me to die?
How cruel.
Just be quiet and stay dead right there."
Another piercing sound.
The clawing noise stops.

entries.japanese:
「――――と、どこまで話したかな。
　ああ、そうそう。
オマエとオレの絆の深さについて話してたんだっけ。
　ようするにさ、志貴。
オレはオマエの兄貴ってコトさ。
秋葉もオマエも、薄情にも忘れてくれているけどな」
「―――――」
　俺の……遠野志貴の、兄………？
「……まあ、そういう事にしておこうか。
　志貴、オマエはシエルに私については聞いているだろう。
転生する魂。
死した後、新しい人間として孵って来る吸血種のことを」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, where was I?
Ah, yes. I was telling you how deep our bond runs.
To put it simply, Shiki. I’m your older brother. You and Akiha were both heartless enough to forget me.”
“―――――”
My brother—the brother of Shiki Tohno?
“Well, let us leave it at that.
Ciel must have told you about me, Shiki. I possess a reincarnating soul. I belong to a vampiric species that hatches as a new human being after death.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hmm, where were we?
Ah, that's right.
We were talking about how deep our bonds were.
What I wanted to say is this, Shiki.
I'm your brother.
But you and Akiha seem to have heartlessly forgotten that."
"-----"
My…… Tohno Shiki's, brother………?
"…… Well, I'll keep it at that.
Shiki, you've heard from Ciel about me, right?
A reincarnating soul.
A vampire that returns to life after it dies."

entries.japanese:
ヤツの目が細まる。
　さっきまでのヤツとは、雰囲気が変わっていく。
　とても静かで、人間性がまったく感じられなくなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
His eyes narrowed.
His entire presence changed.
The man from a moment ago fell away, replaced by something terribly quiet and utterly devoid of humanity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His eyes narrow.
His mood turns different from before.
His soft, almost human personality starts to disappear.

entries.japanese:
「この私は十八人目の私だ。
私が転生先に選ぶ条件は知っているな。
　旧い異能者としての血筋を持ち、社会的に大きな影響力を持つ家系。
　この二つの条件に見合っているモノがなんであるかは言うまでもないだろう。
　十七人目―――先代の私は、滅ぼされる前に遠野という血筋を候補にあげていた。
　極東の地を選んだのはただの気紛れだがね。
ふん、十七回繰り返したところで何一つ変化がない人生に、新しい刺激を求めたのかもしれないが」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is my eighteenth incarnation. You know the conditions by which I select my next host.
An old gifted bloodline with substantial influence over society.
I need hardly say what satisfied both.
Before I was destroyed, my seventeenth incarnation selected the Tohno bloodline as a candidate.
Choosing the Far East was mere whim. Perhaps after seventeen repetitions of a life in which nothing ever changed, I simply craved some novel stimulus.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is my eighteenth reincarnation.
You know about my requirements for the new reincarnating body, right?
A family that carries power within its blood and has influence in society.
There's no need to say what fits those requirements.
During the seventeenth time---my previous self chose the Tohno bloodline.
Choosing the Far East was just a whim.
Maybe I just wanted a change of scenery from my previous incarnations."

entries.japanese:
「かくて私は姫に滅ぼされ、十八人目の私として遠野シキの体に転生した。
　遠野シキの肉体は申し分がなかった。
知性の発達も早熟で、この国の淀んだ空気も心地よかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thus the Princess destroyed me, and I was reincarnated for the eighteenth time in the body of SHIKI Tohno.
His body was beyond reproach. His intellect matured early, and even the stagnant air of this country pleased me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I was killed by the princess and my eighteenth self was reborn as Tohno SHIKI.
I had no complaints about his body.
His intelligence and development advanced rapidly and the weather in this country was comfortable."

entries.japanese:
「―――だが、調子が良かったのはそれまでさ。
　『蛇』―――まあ、ロアっていうヤツなんだが、ヤツの誤算は遠野の人間っていうのは力が強すぎたっていう事だ。
　オレや秋葉はな、ようするに半分だけしか人間じゃない。
あとの半分はロアのようにもとから化け物っていうワケで、遠野の人間はそれを抑えながら生きている。
　だがな、中には精神が弱くて抑えきれないヤツだって出てくるんだ。
　そういう反転しちまって人間じゃなくなったヤツを殺すのが遠野の当主の役割なんだが―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that was as far as my good fortune went.
The ‘Serpent’—the bastard called Roa—miscalculated just how powerful the Tohno blood could be.
Akiha and I are only half human. The other half was monstrous from the beginning, like Roa, and the Tohnos live by keeping it suppressed.
Some are too weak of mind to hold it down.
When one of them undergoes Inversion and ceases to be human, it is the duty of the head of the Tohno family to kill them, but—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But, that was as far as it went.
'The Serpent'---Well, Roa made a mistake in that the power of the Tohno bloodline was too great.
Akiha and I, we're only half human after all.
The other half is as much a monster as Roa, which those of the Tohno line must resist throughout their lives.
But, some people are weak, which stops them from resisting.
It is the duty of the head of the Tohno household to kill those who succumb to this inversion and are no longer human but---"

entries.japanese:
「ようするに、オレは負けたのさ。
　本来ならオマエみたいにちゃんと成人するまでロアは目覚めない。
　だが―――オレと繋がっているオマエなら解るだろう、志貴？
entries.maoEnglish:
“In short, I lost.
Ordinarily Roa would not awaken until his host came of age, just as you have.
But you’re bound to me, Shiki—surely you understand?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"To sum it up, I lost.
Normally, Roa wouldn't awaken until I become an adult.
But---since you and I are connected, you can understand, right Shiki?"

entries.japanese:
「一つの肉体に二つのイシは入らない。
　一つのイシから乖離する人格ならともかく、まったく異なる魂のイシは入らないんだ。
入らないとどうなるのか？
　簡単さ、器である脳が悲鳴をあげる。
　頭痛が走るんだよ。
わけもなく、意味もなく、突発的にな」
「―――――」
　頭……痛……って、それは、まさか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“One body cannot contain two wills.
Personalities divided from a single will are one thing, but the wills of two entirely different souls cannot coexist. And when they cannot, what happens?
Simple—the brain that serves as their vessel begins to scream.
Headaches strike. For no reason, with no meaning, and without warning.”
“…”
Headaches—could he mean—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Two wills cannot exist in one body.
It's possible if the other personality stems from a person's will, but a completely different will cannot enter.
What happens when it can't?
Simple.
