The vessel, the brain, cries out.
Headaches occur.
Suddenly, without reason, without meaning."
"-----"
Head…… aches……, don't tell me---

entries.japanese:
「そうだよ。
オマエの頭痛は、オレからオマエに流れているものだ。
　言っただろう？
　オマエの命はオレが使っている。
オレたちはさ、一つの命を取り合って生きているんだ。
　だから―――オレがこうして活動すれば、オマエは死体みたいに動けなくなるっていうワケだ。
　イシを殺すものはイシだからな。
オマエの生きようとするイシより、オレの生きようっていうイシのほうが強い」
「……まあ、それでもたいしたもんだ。
オレは殺すつもりでオマエの動力を使っているんだが……おかしいな、どうしてオマエは生きているんだろう」
　ヤツは本気で首をかしげている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right. Your headaches spill into you from me.
I told you, didn’t I? I’m using your life. The two of us live by fighting over a single life.
So whenever I’m active, you’re left unable to move, like a corpse.
Only a will can kill another will. My will to live is stronger than yours.”
“Still, you’ve done remarkably well. I’m drawing on your power with every intention of killing you, yet somehow you’re still alive.”
He tilted his head in genuine puzzlement.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right.
Your headaches have flowed from me to you.
Didn't I say so earlier?
I am using your life.
We are two people using the same life.
So---if I can move like this, then you end up as immobile as a corpse.
What kills a will is another will.
My will to live is stronger than yours."
"…… Well, but you are still amazing.
I'm using your strength trying to kill you…… But that's strange, why are you still alive?"
As he tilts his head, he really does look perplexed.

entries.japanese:
……首をかしげたいのはこっちだ。
　なんだって俺の命とやらがコイツに使われているのか、そもそもコイツは何なのか、本当にワケがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I was the one who should have been asking that.
I could not understand why he was using what he called my life, what he even was, or any of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm the one who wants to tilt my head questioningly.
Why is he using my life, and what in the world is he?
My mind is brimming with questions.

entries.japanese:
「……まだわからないのか志貴。
　だからさ、イシを殺すのはイシなんだよ。
逆に言えばイシを殺しても器である体は死なない。
　オレの中に在たロアはさ、オレ以外のイシだったんだ。
　八年前の夏の日。
ロアは、遠野シキというイシを殺した」
「――――」
　だから。
遠野志貴は、俺じゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You still don’t understand, Shiki?
A will can be killed only by another will. Conversely, killing the will does not kill the body that contains it.
The Roa within me was a will other than my own.
On that summer day eight years ago. Roa killed the will that was SHIKI Tohno.”
“…”
That meant one thing. Shiki Tohno was me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It seems you still don't understand, Shiki.
I told you, the only thing that can kill a will is another will.
In other words, killing the will does not kill the body.
The Roa inside of me was another will besides my own.
Eight years ago that summer day.
Roa killed the will of Tohno SHIKI."
"----"
Like I said, I'm Tohno Shiki, right?

entries.japanese:
「ああ、おまえは遠野志貴だ。
反転して人間じゃなくなったオレの代わりに遠野家の長男になった、真っ赤なニセモノなのさ」
「―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, you are Shiki Tohno. You are the fraud who became the Tohno family’s eldest son in place of me after I underwent Inversion and ceased to be human.”
“―――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, you are Tohno Shiki.
A true impostor who became the eldest son of the Tohno household in place of me, who succumbed to inversion."
"-----"

entries.japanese:
「まあ聞けよ。
　……オレはさ、志貴。
オマエのことが好きだったぜ。
　オレも親父とは反りが合わなかったし、オマエは本当にいいヤツだった。
オレたちは敵同士だったが、本当に仲が良かった。
　もちろん秋葉のことだって愛していた。
あいつがオマエのほうに懐いているのは許せなかったがな」
　……ちょっ……ちょっと、待て。
　コイツ。
コイツは、何を――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Just listen.
Shiki… I loved you, you know.
Father and I never got along, and you were a genuinely good kid. We may have belonged to opposing sides, but we were the closest of friends.
I loved Akiha too, of course. I simply couldn’t forgive her for being more attached to you than to me.”
Wait—wait a minute.
This man. What was he—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Listen up.
…… I even liked you Shiki.
Me and my old man didn't get along either, and you were a good guy.
We really were good friends.
Of course I loved Akiha too.
But I couldn't allow her to grow more attached to you."
…… w, wait.
What, what is he saying----

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、あの時の気持ちを覚えている。
　目の前が真っ赤になって、なにもかもが気に食わなくなるんだ。
鳥の声や木の葉のずれる音さえ耳障りで、気がつくと壊していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes—I remember exactly how it felt.
Everything before my eyes turned red, and everything offended me. Even birdsong and the rustle of leaves grated on my ears; before I knew it, I had destroyed whatever made the sound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I remember that feeling from that time.
Everything turned crimson and I started to hate everything.
The voices of the birds, the leaves on the trees, everything became bothersome to me, and I destroyed whatever I came across.

entries.japanese:
「八年前の話だ、志貴。
　あの中庭で、オレのイシはロアに殺された。
　いつもならそれでロアが覚醒して終わる。
けどな、遠野の人間は特殊なんだ。
　オレという理性をなくした肉体は反転する。
　反転衝動というのかな。
今までタブーと思っていた事をまっさきにやっちまうんだ。
　オレは心のどこかでオマエに嫉妬していたんだろうさ。
結局、いあわせたオマエを殺した」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It happened eight years ago, Shiki.
In that courtyard, Roa killed my will.
Ordinarily that would have ended with Roa awakening. But the Tohnos are different.
Once my reason was gone, the body inverted.
An inversion impulse, I suppose. You rush first to do everything you once considered taboo.
Somewhere inside, I must have envied you. In the end, I killed you simply because you happened to be there.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eight years ago, Shiki.
In that courtyard, Roa killed my will.
Normally, it would have been all over when Roa awoke.
But the Tohno family is special.
As soon as my reason was lost, my body succumbed to inversion.
I guess it's what you call an inversion impulse, but you do what you always thought was taboo.
I guess deep in my heart, I was jealous of you.
In the end, I killed you because you were there."

entries.japanese:
「まったく、あの時以上の快感はなかったぜ！
　この手をオマエの胸につっこんでさあ、心臓を抉り出した時の嘔吐感っていったら、もういっきに生まれ変わるんじゃないかって思うぐらいだった！
　それがあんまりにも気持ち気持ちイイもんでさ、もう少しオマエの体で遊ぼうって思ってたのが運の尽きだったんだがね。
　オレがオマエの心臓をキレイにしようって躍起になっている時にさ、誰かがオレとオマエの事を親父に密告しやがった。
　親父のヤロウ、駆けつけてくるなりオレのことを殺しやがった！
　実の息子のこのオレをだぜ！？
　　ったく、酷い親父もいたもんだ。
あんなんじゃ息子にくびり殺されても文句は言えないよな志貴！
　まあ最後は――わりとスカッとしたけどな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nothing has ever felt as good as that did!
I plunged this hand into your chest, and the rush of nausea when I gouged out your heart was so overwhelming I thought I might be reborn on the spot!
It felt so good—so incredibly good—that I decided to play with your body a little longer; that was my mistake.
While I was busy making a nice clean job of your heart, someone ran and told Father about us.
The bastard came charging in and killed me on sight! His own son!? What a monstrous father. He had no right to complain when his son finally strangled him, did he, Shiki!
I must admit, the ending felt rather satisfying.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Man, there never was a pleasure greater than that time!
Piercing your chest with this hand and feeling your heart as you coughed up blood.
I thought I was born again!
It felt so wonderful, I stood there wanting to play with your dying body even longer, but I was pushing my luck.
While I was eagerly trying to rip out your heart, someone informed the old man.
That bastard, he rushed over and killed me!
Me, his real son!
Shit.
I guess cruel fathers do exist.
A father like that can't complain when he's killed by his own son, right, Shiki!?
Well in the end--I felt pretty good."

entries.japanese:
――――――血。
　あの中庭で。
　血にまみれていた、子供の死体は。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Blood.
In that courtyard.
The child’s corpse, drenched in blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Blood.
In that courtyard.
The bloody corpse of a child.

entries.japanese:
「――そうだ、ようやく思い出してくれたか志貴……！
　そうなんだ、オマエを殺したのはオレなんだよ！
　だっていうのに生き汚いオマエは生き残って、あまつさえオレの代わりに遠野志貴になんかなりやがった……！
　親父のヤロウ―――自分で殺したオレの体をゴミみたいに地下牢に捨てやがって。
　遠野家の長男をなくすワケにはいかない、なんて下らない理由で養子のオマエを遠野シキに仕立てやがったんだよ、アイツは！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――Yes, you finally remember, Shiki…!
I was the one who killed you! Yet you clung so filthily to life, survived, and even had the gall to become Shiki Tohno in my place…!
Father—the bastard threw the body he had killed into an underground cell like so much rubbish.
He couldn’t bear to let the Tohno family lose its eldest son, so for that pathetic reason he passed you, his adopted child, off as SHIKI Tohno!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Yes, you finally remember Shiki……!
That's right, I'm the one who killed you!
But you lived through it and took over my place as Tohno Shiki……!
My old man, that bastard---he locked me away like trash in an underground cell after killing me.
Because he couldn't have it known that his eldest son was dead, he took you, his adopted son, and replaced me!"

entries.maoEnglish: I was—adopted?
entries.mirrorMoon: I---------was adopted?

entries.japanese:
「ああ。
親父は奇跡的に助かったオマエを利用したのさ。
幸いまだガキだったからな、オレたちは。
　自分たちが本当の兄弟だって疑わなかったし、オマエも―――事故のショックでどうにかしてたんだろ。
　親父の簡単な嘘に秋葉もオマエも騙されて、今まで本当の遠野シキであるオレを忘れていやがったのさ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Father made use of you after you miraculously survived. Fortunately, we were still children.
None of us doubted that we were true siblings, and the shock of the accident must have left your mind in ruins.
Father’s simple lie deceived both you and Akiha, and all this time you’ve forgotten me—the real SHIKI Tohno!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah.
The old man used you after your miraculous recovery.
Fortunately for him, we were kids.
We didn't doubt the fact that we were actual brothers---and you were pretty screwed up from that incident.
My old man deceived you and Akiha with a simple lie and made you forget about me, the true Tohno SHIKI!"

entries.japanese:
――――――誰も、いなかった。
　あの事故のあと。
　どうして自分はあんなに一人だったのか。
　それは、つまり―――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――There had been no one.
After the accident.
Why had I been so completely alone?
The reason was—
entries.mirrorMoon:
------No one, was there.
After that accident.
Why was I all alone like that?
In other words, that means---

entries.japanese:
「そう、オマエがいらない人間だったからだ。
　まあ、世間体を保つためにカタチだけは遠野志貴として扱われたんだろう。
―――ああ、だがオレにとってオマエは必要だった。
　なにしろオマエから命を奪っていたおかげで、親父に殺されてもなんとか生きのびれたんだ。
　その一点だけは本当に感謝してるぜ、志貴」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because nobody wanted you.
For appearances’ sake, they must have treated you as Shiki Tohno in name.
―――Ah, but I needed you.
The life I stole from you was the only reason I survived after Father killed me.
For that one thing, I am truly grateful, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, it's because no one needed you.
Well, in order to protect the image of this family, you were treated as Tohno Shiki.
---Yeah, but I did need you.
Because thanks to stealing your life, I was able to survive when my old man killed me.
For that, and only that, I thank you, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
……わからない。
　じゃあなんで。
　俺は生きてる？
entries.maoEnglish:
I didn’t understand.
Then why.
Was I alive?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I don't understand.
So why?
Why am I still alive then?

entries.japanese:
「さあな。
それは俺も知りたいところだが―――まあ、どうでもいい問題だ。
どのみちオマエはここで死ぬんだから」
　言って。
　ヤツ―――ロアは、ゆっくりと立ちあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who knows? I’d like the answer myself, but it hardly matters. Either way, you die here.”
With that.
He—Roa—slowly stood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Who knows.
I'd like to know that myself---but, it really doesn't matter.
Because you're going to die here anyway."
Saying that,
He---Roa stands up slowly.

entries.japanese:
「―――遠野志貴を苦しめて殺す、というのがこの肉体……遠野シキの目的だ。
それに今まで付き合ってきてやったが、そろそろ幕にしよう。
　私も―――いつまでも二つの肉体に一つの命では効率が悪くてね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“To torment and kill Shiki Tohno—that is the purpose of this body, SHIKI Tohno. I have indulged it until now, but it is time to bring down the curtain.
Sharing one life between two bodies forever is rather inefficient.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Your painful death was the goal of this body…… of Tohno SHIKI.
I've gone along with that this long, but it's time to lower the curtain.
Even for me---to have two bodies with one life is not very efficient."

entries.japanese:
声が、近づいてくる。
　このまま殺される。
　……いや、殺されているというのならとっくに殺されているのか。
　手も足も動かない。
　目も耳も鼻もきかない。
―――俺には、もう何もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The voice drew closer.
He was going to kill me.
Or if I was already being killed, perhaps I had died long ago.
My hands and feet would not move.
My eyes, ears, and nose no longer worked.
―――There was nothing left of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice nears.
I'll be killed like this.
…… No, I say I'll die, but maybe I'm already dead.
My arms and legs can't move.
My eyes, my ears, my nose don't work.
---There is nothing left.

entries.japanese:
コイツの言っている事は、あまり受け入れたくなかったけれど。
　……もう、なにもかもどうでもいい。
　俺の目が『死』を視ていたのは、俺自身が死人みたいなものだったからだ。
　結局、俺はニセモノで。
　八年前のあの夏の日に、とっくの昔に死んでいたんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I did not want to accept what he had told me. But—
None of it mattered anymore.
My eyes had been able to see “death” because I myself was little more than dead;
In the end, I was only a counterfeit.
I had already died on that summer day eight years ago—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't want to just accept what he says.
…… But I don't care about anything anymore.
My eyes that can see "death", because my body is already like a dead body.
In the end, I was just an impostor.
And on that summer day eight years ago, I was already dead----

entries.japanese:
「――――遠野くん――――！」
　……けど、声が聞こえた。
　泣くような。
　すごく悲しく、叫ぶような声が聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Tohno――――!”
But I heard a voice.
Like weeping.
A terribly sad voice crying out to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Tohno-kun----!"
…… But, I can hear a voice.

A sobbing voice.
An incredibly sad, almost shouting voice.

entries.japanese:
―――闇に目が慣れたのか。
　それとも、俺のイシとやらが、少しだけ目覚めたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Perhaps my eyes had adjusted to the darkness.
Or perhaps the thing he called my will had stirred faintly awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Did my eyes get used to the darkness?
Or, did my will force my eyes to open?

entries.japanese: 俺は、今までどんな状態であのクソヤロウの長話を聞いていたのか、あいつが今まで何に座っていたのか、ようやく把握した。
entries.maoEnglish: At last I understood the state I had been in throughout that bastard’s endless speech—and what he had been sitting on all this time.
entries.mirrorMoon: I finally grasp what it was this bastard was sitting on while he gave his long speech.

entries.japanese:
「―――チ、また蘇生したか」
　ロアの足が止まる。
　ヤツはそのまま、先輩へと振り向いた。
「大人しく死んでいろといっただろう。
先ほどから見苦しいんだよ、君は」
　ざく、と。
　先輩の剣が、ロアの手で、先輩の体に突き刺さる。
「あうっ…………！」
　苦悶の声。
　じゃり、と先輩の爪が畳をかきむしる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Tch, alive again?”
Roa stopped.
He turned toward Ciel.
“I told you to stay dead. You’ve been a disgusting spectacle.”
A wet stab.
In Roa’s hand, Ciel’s own sword plunged into her body.
“Aah…!”
A cry of torment.
Ciel’s nails scraped across the tatami.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Damn, you regenerated again?"
Roa's legs stop.
He turns around toward Senpai.
"Didn't I tell you to stay dead?
You really are an eyesore."
With a piercing sound,
Roa takes one of Senpai's swords and thrusts it into her body.
"Aug…………!"
Her pained voice.
Her nails dig into the tatami mat.

entries.japanese:
じゃり、じゃり。
　その爪は剥がれかけていて、先輩の呼吸は車のエンジンみたいに乱れている。
　なのに。
「……遠野、くん………！」
　じゃりじゃりと。
　人形みたいに倒れている俺に向かって、必死に、呼びかけ続けていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Scrape, scrape.
Her nails were nearly torn away, and her breathing sputtered as violently as a car engine.
And still.
“Tohno…!”
Scrape, scrape.
She kept desperately calling to me as I lay there like a discarded doll.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clawing, and clawing.
Her nails are almost peeled off, and her breathing is like a combusting engine.
But still.
"…… Tohno, kun………!"
Clawing and writhing.
She frantically continues to call out my name as I lie there collapsed like a cut puppet.

entries.japanese:
「……うるさい女だ。
何度呼びかけても志貴には聞こえていないと言っているだろう。
　そいつはな、もう生きる死体だ。
私の声以外は聞こえない。
　……いや、私の声さえ聞こえん。
命を共有するという事でのみ、かろうじて私のイシを伝えているだけだというのが、なぜ解らない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a noisy woman. How many times must I tell you that Shiki cannot hear you?
He is a living corpse now. He hears no voice but mine.
No—even my voice does not reach him. Only because we share a life can my will barely touch his, so why can you not understand that?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Annoying woman.
Didn't I tell you no matter how many times you call out his name, Shiki won't hear you?
Right now, he's just a living corpse.
He can only hear my voice.
…… No, not even my voice.
He only knows my will because of the connection of life between us.
How can you not understand that fact?"

entries.japanese:
ざく、ざく。
　無造作に、剣が先輩の体に刺さる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Stab, stab.
The sword drove carelessly into Ciel’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
More piercing sounds.
The swords pierce Senpai's body.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――！」
　びくん、と先輩の体が跳ねる。
　それでも―――先輩は、本当にバカみたいに、俺に向かって名前を呼びかけ続けていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Her body bucked.
Even then—idiotically, impossibly—Ciel kept calling my name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ts----!"
Her body twitches in response.
Even still---Senpai continues to call out my name, as if she was a broken record.

entries.japanese:
遠野くん。
　遠野くん。
　遠野くん、って。
　痛みと、涙の混ざったクシャクシャな声で。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tohno.
Tohno.
Tohno.
Her voice was mangled by pain and tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tohno-kun.
Tohno-kun.
Tohno-kun.
With her pain-filled, sobbing voice.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　聞こえてた。
　……ちゃんと、さっきから聞こえてた。
　でも、きっと先輩が言ってくれた半分も、聞いてやれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I could hear her.
I had heard her all along.
But I probably hadn’t managed to catch even half the words she had given me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I could hear it.
…… I definitely heard it from before.
But I probably didn't listen to half of what she said.

entries.japanese:
そんな、血を吐きながらも。
　こんなガラクタの人形みたいになった俺に、ずっと呼びかけ続けてくれてたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even as she coughed blood.
She had kept calling to this broken thing that looked like a heap of doll parts.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even as she spat out blood.
She kept calling out to me who was just lying there like a thrown-away, broken doll.

entries.japanese:
「―――死ねない体、か。
　愚か者め、これほどの能力を有しているのならば私とて倒しえただろうに」
　ざく。
「それが、こんな男のために自ら剣を放棄するとはな。
見下げ果てたぞエレイシア。
こんな無様なモノが私の娘と思うと吐き気がする……！」
　ざく、ざくざく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――A body that cannot die.
Fool—with power such as this, you might even have defeated me.”
Stab.
“Yet for the sake of a man like this, you cast aside your own sword. I have nothing but contempt for you, Elesia. The thought that such a wretched creature is my daughter makes me sick…!”
Stab, stab, stab.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---An immortal body?
How foolish.
If you had this much power you could have defeated me."
The sound of stabbing again.
"But for such a guy you laid down your swords.
I'm disappointed, Elesia.
Thinking a piece of trash like you is actually my daughter makes me sick……!"
Thrust.
Thrust.
Thrust.

entries.japanese:
ロアは気が狂ったように、先輩の体を滅多刺しにしていく。
　無防備な背中を。
肩を。
足を。
喉を。
　俺に向かって伸ばされた、血まみれの腕を。
　ざくり、と容赦なく刺していく。
　それでも。
　それでもなお、先輩の口は俺の名前を繰り返している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa stabbed Ciel in a frenzy.
Her defenseless back. Her shoulder. Her leg. Her throat.
The blood-soaked arm she had stretched toward me.
He drove the blade into each without mercy.
Still.
Even now, Ciel’s lips continued to shape my name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As if he's lost his mind, he keeps stabbing Senpai over and over again.
Her defenseless back.
Her shoulders.
Her legs.
Her throat.
Her bloody arms outstretched towards me.
Mercilessly stabbing.
Despite this.
Her lips keep on calling my name.

entries.japanese:
……聞こえない。
　もう、聞こえない。
　俺の耳がおかしいんじゃなくて、先輩の喉が、もう死んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I couldn’t hear her.
Not anymore.
It wasn’t my ears that had failed—Ciel’s throat was dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can't hear it.
I can't hear it anymore.
It's not that my ears are no longer working, but her throat is already dead.

entries.japanese:
なのに、俺に向かって叫び続けている。
　そうすれば、いつかは俺が動けるようになるんじゃないかって願っているみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yet she kept screaming toward me.
As though she believed that if she continued long enough, I might finally move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But she still keeps calling out to me.
As if she is wishing I'll be able to move if she continues on like that.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　正直。
　俺には、なんで先輩がそこまでしてくれるのか、わからなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Honestly.
I could not understand why Ciel would go so far for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
To be honest,
I don't understand why she would go that far.

entries.japanese:
「―――――や」
　気が狂いそうで。
　俺なんかのために傷ついている先輩を見て、気が、狂いそう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――S—”
I was going mad.
Watching her be hurt for someone like me was driving me out of my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----St--"
I'm almost going insane.
Watching her be stabbed for my sake makes me almost insane.

entries.japanese:
「――――――メ」
　けど、動かない。
　悔しいぐらいに動かない。
　どうやっても―――どうやっても、この体が動いてくれない……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――top.”
But I couldn’t move.
Maddeningly, humiliatingly, I couldn’t move.
No matter what I did—no matter what I did—this body would not obey me!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------op."
But, I don't move.
No matter how frustrated I am, I can't move.
No matter what I do---no matter what I do, this body doesn't move……!

entries.japanese:
「――素晴らしい。
致死性を持つほど純粋な憎悪。
　瞬間だが、貴様から漏れたイシは私に迫る。
　昏むような良い殺気をしているが―――コレは、そんなに目くじらをたてるほどのコトではないよ」
　ロアが剣を引きぬく。
　先輩の体が畳に沈み込む。
　その前に、ロアの手が先輩の髪をつかんで、引きずりあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Magnificent. Hatred so pure it could be fatal. For an instant, the will spilling from you almost reached me.
That murderous aura is enough to make one reel—but this is hardly worth such fury.”
Roa pulled out the sword.
Ciel’s body began to sink into the tatami.
Before it could fall, he caught her by the hair and dragged her upright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Wonderful.
A simple hatred that is almost lethal.
It was just an instant, but I felt your will directed against me.
You may want to kill me---but this isn't something to be mad about."
He pulls out a sword.
Senpai's body sinks toward the floor.
Before that can happen, he pulls her up by the hair.

entries.japanese:
「いいかい少年、一つ教授してやろう。
　いかに無限に近い治癒能力を持つ吸血種でも、それは生きている間だけの話だ。
　吸血種が不死身であるのは、かろうじて息が続いている間だけでね。
完全に死んでしまえばその治癒機能も停止する。
　吸血種は死に難いだけであって、決して不死ではないのだが―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me teach you something, boy.
Even the nearly limitless regenerative powers of a vampiric species function only while it remains alive.
It is invulnerable only so long as a thread of breath endures. Once it dies completely, its healing stops.
Vampiric creatures are merely difficult to kill, never immortal. And yet―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look boy, let me teach you something.
No matter how limitless the regenerative ability of a vampire is, it lasts only when they are alive.
Their immortality is only as long as they are alive.
Once they die, their powers of recovery cease immediately.
Vampires are only difficult to kill, not immortal, but---"

entries.japanese:
ずっ、と音をたてて。
　先輩の胸から、黒い剣が生えた。
　くん、と胸がつきだされる。
　ロアは背中から、先輩の心臓を、剣で突き刺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a wet thrust.
A black blade bloomed from Ciel’s chest.
Her torso jerked forward.
Roa had driven the sword through her heart from behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Splat.
A black sword springs forth from Senpai's chest.
Her chest breaks apart.
Roa impales her heart from behind.

entries.japanese:
「っっあう………！」
　死んでいたはずの喉が動く。
　赤い血を吐いて、先輩は苦しそうに、ふるふると体を震わせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aah…!”
Her dead throat moved.
Coughing bright blood, Ciel trembled helplessly in pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tsaaah………!"
The throat that died moves.
Spewing forth with blood, her body writhes in agony.

entries.japanese:
「だが―――この女の凄まじい所はな、少年。
　たとえ完全に死んでしまっても、本人ではなく時間がかってに肉体を蘇生させるという所にある。
　理解できるか？
　この女は死したのち、誰の手も借りず、自分の手さえ使わず、この世界そのものが矛盾点を修復するために復元させてしまうのだ。
　例えば―――ほら、こんなふうに！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But here is what makes this woman extraordinary, boy.
Even after she dies completely, time itself restores her body—not any power of her own.
Do you understand?
Once she is dead, without help from anyone, without so much as lifting a finger herself, the world restores her to correct the contradiction she represents.
For example—like this!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But---the amazing thing about this woman is.
Even if she dies completely, it isn't her but time itself that restores her body.
Do you understand?
After she dies, without anyone's help, even her own, this world itself returns it back to normal in order to rectify a contradiction.
For example---just like this!"

entries.japanese:
愉快そうなロアの声にあわせて。
　先輩の額から、ずぶりと。
　黒い、角が生えてきた――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
In time with Roa’s delighted voice.
Something black pushed wetly from Ciel’s forehead.
A horn growing out of her skull—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa's amused voice lifts in delight, and at the same time.
With a sickening sound,
a black sword springs out from Senpai's forehead-------

entries.japanese:
あたま。
　後頭部から。
　あの細く鋭い剣で。
　生きたまま、脳を串刺しにした、の、か―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Her head.
From the back of her skull.
With that long, slender blade.
Had he skewered her brain while she was still alive—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her head.
From behind.
With that thin, sharp sword.
While she was living, her brain was pierced----

entries.japanese:
「ひゃははは、さすがに脳を突き刺せばぴったりと死んでくれたぜ！
　ほら見ろよ志貴、まるでテルテルボウズみたいに手足がビクビク動いているじゃんか！」
　愉しそうに。
　ロアという吸血鬼は、私からオレという有り方に変わっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hyahahaha—a blade through the brain finally killed her stone dead! Look, Shiki—her arms and legs are twitching like a little paper doll on a string!”
In his delight.
The vampire called Roa had slipped from his courtly self back into the coarse, sneering one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hyahahaha, isn't it natural for a pierced brain to bring death!?
Look Shiki, she's flailing about like a fish on a hook!"
Full of amusement,
Roa loses himself in amusement.

entries.japanese:
「でも見ろよ、一度瞳孔がひらききって生命活動が停止したっていうのに、もう心臓が再活動してるだろ？
　……ったく、ふざけた命だぜ。
　一つっきりの命でおっかなびっくり生きてるオレたちがバカみたいじゃねえか」
　ブン、とロアが腕を振るう。
　そのまま、本当にゴミのように、先輩の体が壁に叩きつけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But look—her pupils dilated and every sign of life stopped, yet her heart’s already started beating again, hasn’t it? What a ridiculous life.
It makes fools of those of us creeping around in terror with only one to spend.”
Roa swung his arm.
Ciel’s body flew into the wall like a piece of rubbish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But look.
Even though the light in her eyes faded, her heart is starting to beat again.
…… Shit, what a fucked up life.
It makes us, the ones living with only one life, look foolish."
He swings his arm.
As if she really was a piece of trash, Senpai's body slams into the wall.

entries.japanese: それが、決定的だった。
entries.maoEnglish: That was the last thing I could bear.
entries.mirrorMoon: That was it.

entries.japanese:
もう、いい。
　もうどうなってもいい。
　このままおかしくなって、
　殺人鬼だなんて呼ばれるコトになっても、
　コイツを。
entries.maoEnglish:
Enough.
I didn’t care what happened to me anymore.
Even if I lost my mind like this,
even if they came to call me
a murderer—I would kill him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's enough.
I don't care what happens.
I don't care if I go crazy.
I don't care if people call me a murderer.
I'll

entries.japanese:
「な、オレなんざコイツに比べれば可愛いもんさ。
　コイツはな、肉片の一つ残らず、細胞の一つ残らずをぶっ潰しても、無から完全に元通りになる怪物だ。
どうあっても死なねえヤツを殺しても、それって罪になるのかなぁ……！」
　ひひひ、と耳障りに笑い続けて。
　ロアは、手に持っていた剣を、先輩の体にダーツのように投げつけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“See—compared to her, I’m almost adorable. She’s a monster who can be crushed down to the last scrap of flesh and the last cell, then return whole from nothing. If you kill someone who can never die, does it even count as a sin…?”
He kept up his grating, sniggering laugh.
Then he flung the sword in his hand at Ciel’s body like a dart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, I'm cute compared to her.
This is a monster that comes back from nothing even if you kill every last bit of her, every last cell of her.
Is killing something that doesn't really die really a sin……!?"
Heeheeehee!
A high, ill-sounding laugh.
Roa throws the sword in his hand towards Senpai as if he was playing darts.

entries.japanese:
ざく、という音。
　それが合図。
　理性が、それで焼ききれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet stab.
That was the signal.
The last thread of reason burned away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Splud!
That is the signal.
With that, all rational thought splinters away.

entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I stood up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I stand up.

entries.maoEnglish:
“How can you move!?”
“…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Bastard, how can you move---!?"
"-----"

entries.japanese:
語るまでもない。
　イシの強いほうが命を使うんだろう。
　なら―――俺は今まで。
　こんなに強く、一つのことを思ったことは、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was no need to explain.
The stronger will was the one that got to use the life.
If that was so.
Never before had I wanted one thing this fiercely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no need to say it.
The one with the stronger will uses the life, right?
Then---up until now,
I never thought this strongly about anything before.

entries.japanese:
「嘘だ。
オレが―――オレのほうが弱いっていうのか、オマエより……！」
entries.maoEnglish: “No. You can’t be telling me—I’m weaker than you…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This can't be!
Am---am I weaker than you……!?"

entries.japanese:
ロア。
オマエを殺してやる。
entries.maoEnglish: Roa. I will kill you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa.
I'm going to kill you.

entries.japanese:
闇の中で。
　ナイフと、ロアの爪とが交錯する。
　ロアの動きは見えないぐらいに速い。
　けれど、体が付いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
In the darkness.
My knife crossed Roa’s claws.
He moved too fast for the eye to follow.
My body kept pace anyway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the darkness,
My knife crosses against his claws.
His movement is almost blindingly fast.
But, my body follows him.

entries.japanese:
腕が別の生き物のように動く。
　眼球は的確に執拗に確実に残酷に、ヤツの『線』だけを捉えていく。
　全身が熱い。
　頭蓋が焼ける。
　初めて―――あの金髪の吸血姫を見た時のように、体中が別物になっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
My arm moved like a creature of its own.
Relentlessly, precisely, certainly, cruelly, my eyes caught nothing but the lines on his body.
Heat filled me.
My skull burned.
For the first time since I saw that blond vampire princess, my entire body had become something else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My arms move as if they belonged to someone else.
My eyes persistently, accurately look at just his "lines".
My entire body burns.
My brain feels like it is on fire.
Just like---when I first saw that golden-haired princess of the vampires, my body is like something else.

entries.japanese:
「チッ――――！」
　ロアが離れる。
　その片足。
右腕上腕部分。
鎖骨の左あたり。
　それら三つの『線』は、すでに切断してある。
　代償はこちらの右腕。
　ロアは俺のナイフを持つ腕をまず潰した。
　だから、こっちは残った左腕を潰されれば負けというコトになる。
　この場合、負けというのは即死を意味する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch—!”
Roa sprang away.
One leg. His upper right arm. The left side of his collarbone.
I had already severed the three lines crossing those places.
The price was my right arm.
Roa had destroyed the arm holding the knife first.
If he destroyed my remaining left arm, I would lose.
Here, losing meant instant death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Keh----!"
Roa springs away.
One of his legs.
His upper right arm.
His left collarbone area.
I have already cut through the "lines" there.
The price is my right arm.
Roa first took my arm holding the knife.
So, if he destroys my remaining left arm, it would mean my loss.
In this situation, losing means certain death.

entries.japanese:
「―――まさかな。
吸血種であるオレと互角か。
　……おまえのその目は、ある意味オレ以上に私に相応しい業なのかもしれない」
「――――」
「気づかないのならいいさ。
ああ、これは語るまでもないつまらない話なんだから」
　じり、と。
　ロアの体が、間合いを外していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Impossible. You can fight a vampiric creature like me to a draw.
In a certain sense, those eyes of yours may be a fate more fitting for me than my own.”
“…”
“If you haven’t noticed, never mind. It is a trivial story, hardly worth telling.”
Inch by inch.
Roa withdrew beyond my reach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I don't believe it.
A match for me, a vampire.
…… your eyes, they are perhaps more appropriate for me than this body."
"----"
"If you don't realize it, then that's fine.
This story is a boring one not even worth talking about."
With a shuffle,
Roa increases the distance between us.

entries.japanese:
「……大昔の話さ。
永遠を生きるという事を考えすぎた愚かものの末路だよ。
それを手にいれたのは、結局どちらだったのかなってコトさ」
entries.maoEnglish: “An ancient story. The fate of a fool who thought too long about living forever. I merely wonder which of us attained it in the end.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's a very old story.
The last of a fool who obsessed over living forever.
Just wondering who it was that actually won that."

entries.japanese:
「―――永遠を生きる。
　それがロアが夢見た奇跡だ。
　私は輪廻転生することこそが永遠とした。
　だがね、そんなものは一つの血族を延々と続けていくのと変わりはないのさ。
　死を受け入れたロアというモノの子孫が最後に得る力があるとすれば―――それは吸血種として他者の命を奪う、というものではなく。
　……少年。
オマエのような死を視る力こそ、死に挑んだ私に相応しい果てではなかったのか、とな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――To live forever.
That was the miracle Roa dreamed of.
I took reincarnation itself for eternity.
But that differs little from perpetuating a single bloodline without end.
If the descendants of the thing called Roa, who accepted death, were to attain some final power, it should not have been the vampiric power to steal another’s life.
Boy. Perhaps a power like yours—the power to see death—was the end truly fitting for one who challenged death.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---To live forever.
That was the miracle that Roa dreamed about.
I decided that an everlasting cycle of rebirth is eternity.
But that is no different than a continuation of a single bloodline.
If there is such a thing as a power that Roa, who accepted death, can earn at the end of his reincarnation---instead of the power that steals the lives of others like vampires.
…… I just thought the power you have, the power to see death, was an appropriate end for me."

entries.japanese: ロアの体が、わずかに低くなる。
entries.maoEnglish: Roa lowered himself slightly.
entries.mirrorMoon: His body lowers a bit.

entries.japanese: 「そのような、下らぬ感傷を抱いただけだ！」
entries.maoEnglish: “Nothing more than a worthless fit of sentiment!”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I just had that ridiculous idea!"

entries.japanese:
ロアの腕が伸びる。
　それを、咄嗟に切り返した。
「ぐっ―――！」
　ロアが逃げる。
　それを追う。
　ロアの動きは、俺なんかの何倍も早い。
　けど、そんなことは、あまり問題じゃなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa’s arm shot out.
Instinctively, I slashed it aside.
“Ghh—!”
Roa fled.
I pursued him.
Roa moved many times faster than I could.
But that no longer mattered very much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His arm reaches out.
I slice through it instantaneously.
"Gah---!"
Roa runs away.
I follow after him.
His movements are many times faster than mine.
But, that doesn't matter.

entries.japanese:
ただ殺す。
　それ以外のことなんて、どうでもいい。
　事実。
　とっくにロアの片足を殺して、ヤツの動きは半減させている。
　ロアは逃げながら。
　壁に手をついて、俺を睨んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kill him.
Nothing else mattered.
The fact was simple.
I had already killed one of his legs and cut his speed in half.
Roa kept fleeing.
He braced a hand against the wall and glared at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Just killing.
I don't care about anything else.
In reality,
I've already killed one of his legs, and his speed is reduced.
As he runs away,
He braces his hand against the wall and glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「チクショウ―――自分と戦おうっていうのか、志貴」
「――――――」
「黙るな……！
　オマエはオレだ。
オマエもシキならオレだってシキだ。
　オレたちはな、似たもの同士だ。
ロアなんてヤロウはいてもいなくても変わらない。
　……オレはもともと人食いの変種でね、ガキの頃から人の肉を食いたいって衝動があった。
今じゃ血なんていう物足りないものが主食になっちまったが、ロアが入ってこなかったら間違いなく人食いの化け物になってたさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn you—are you really going to fight yourself, Shiki?”
“…”
“Don’t just stand there in silence! You are me. If you are Shiki, then so am I.
We’re the same kind. Whether the bastard Roa existed or not would have changed nothing.
I was born a mutant cannibal who had wanted to eat human flesh since childhood. These days I have to live on something as unsatisfying as blood, but without Roa I would unquestionably have become a man-eating monster.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shit!
---Do you intend to fight yourself, Shiki?"
"------"
"Don't be silent……!
You're me.
I am SHIKI, and you are Shiki.
We are the same type of being.
It doesn't matter if that bastard Roa existed or not.
…… I was originally a creature eating human flesh.
As a child, I had this urge to eat human flesh.
Even though that has changed to drinking blood, if Roa hadn't entered my body, I would've certainly become a human eating monster."

entries.japanese:
「―――だがな、それはオマエも同じだ。
　オレが人食いに悦楽するようにさ、オマエも人殺しがスキなんだよ！
　思い出せ、オマエがあの女を初めて見た時の衝動を、そのナイフで色んなモノを殺してきたあとの恍惚を！」
「――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――And you are no different.
I delight in eating people, and you delight in killing them! Remember the urge you felt when you first saw that woman and the ecstasy after you killed all those things with your knife!”
“…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But, that's the same for you.
Like I enjoy eating human flesh, you enjoy killing others!
Remember the urge you had when you first saw that woman, the ecstasy of killing with that knife!"
"------"

entries.japanese:
初めてあの女を見た時の衝動――――？
　それは―――アルクェイドを殺した時のコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
The urge I felt when I first saw her?
Did he mean when I killed Arcueid?
entries.mirrorMoon:
The urge I had when I first saw her----
That was---when I killed Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「ああそうだ。
オマエがどんなにイイ子ぶってもな、アレだけは言い訳がきかねえよ。
オマエはあの女に欲情して、オマエが一番興奮する手段でサバいたんじゃねえか。
　これが殺人鬼じゃなくてなんだっていうんだ。
　オレとオマエは、所詮同じイキモノ―――同じトコロに棲んでいる異常者なのさ」
「――――――」
　……うるさい。
　これ以上コイツの声を聞いていると、おかしくなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. Pretend to be a good little boy all you like, but there is no excusing that. You lusted after her, then butchered her in the way that excited you most.
If that does not make you a murderer, what does?
You and I are the same creature in the end—deviants who dwell in the same place.”
“…”
Shut up.
If I listened to him any longer, I would lose my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, that's right.
No matter how much you pretend to be a good person, that's something you can't excuse.
You wanted that woman and did the thing that got you the most excited.
What can you call that other than being a killer?
You and I are the same---we are both abnormal people living in the same place."
"------"
…… Shut up.
If I hear his voice any longer, I'll go crazy.

entries.japanese:
「そう、同じだ。
　なのにどうしてオレを殺す！
　ただオレにだけロアのヤロウが入ってきただけだろう！？
　もしロアがオマエに入っていれば、オレたちの立場はまるっきり入れ替わっていたハズなんだ……！
　なのにオレを殺すのか！？
　おまえは、おまえは自分に手をあげているんだぞ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, we’re the same!
Then why kill me? Roa only happened to enter me instead of you!
If he had entered you, our places would have been completely reversed…!
And still you’ll kill me? You—you’re raising your hand against yourself!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, the same.
So why are you trying to kill me?
It's just that Roa entered me!
If Roa entered you instead, our positions would've been reversed……!
But you're going to kill me!?
You're just hurting yourself……!"

entries.japanese:
ロアが叫ぶ。
　八年間。
　この街に巣くって、何人もの人間の血を吸ってきた化け物が叫ぶ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa screamed.
For eight years.
The monster that had infested this city and drunk the blood of countless people screamed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa screams.
These past eight years.
The monster who made his lair in this city, feeding off the blood of countless people screams.

entries.japanese:
「―――おまえは俺じゃない。
つまらない、ただの人殺しだ」
「ハッ、わかってないな。
オレだって初めはそう思ってた。
オレはマトモだ。
ロアの意思があってもきっと大丈夫だってな。
　けどダメだった。
オマエも同じさ。
オマエも、オレと同じ、ただの人殺しになりさがるんだよ、遠野志貴！」
　おかしそうにロアは笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You aren’t me. You’re nothing but a petty murderer.”
“Ha! You don’t understand. I thought that way at first too. I told myself I was sane, that even with Roa’s will inside me, I would be fine.
I wasn’t. You’ll be the same. You’ll sink into being nothing but a murderer, just like me, Shiki Tohno!”
Roa laughed as though it were all terribly amusing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I'm not you.
You're just a killer."
"Idiot, you don't understand, do you?
I thought so too, at first.
That I'm sane.
That even if Roa's will is here, I thought it would be fine.
But, it wasn't.
You're the same.
You, like me, will end up as a killer, Tohno Shiki!"
He laughs.

entries.japanese:
「そうだろう？
　知っているぜ、オマエの中にもアレが生まれてるって。
　いいか、オマエに生まれつつある衝動はオレから流れたものじゃない。
　いいかげん認めろよ殺人鬼。
　オマエの反転する衝動は、紛れもなくオマエ自身の望みなんだってな……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right. I know that thing has begun to grow inside you too.
Listen—the impulse taking shape in you did not flow from me.
Admit it already, murderer.
Your urge to invert is your own desire and no one else’s…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't that right?
I know that's inside you too.
You know, that impulse is not something that flows from me to you.
Just admit it, killer.
Your inversion impulse is nothing more than what you wish for……!"

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　ナイフを構える。
　これ以上、ロアの声を聞きたくない。
　じっと、ヤツの体を凝視する。
　あとは、それを切断するだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I raised the knife.
I wanted to hear no more of Roa’s voice.
I stared fixedly at his body.
All that remained was to sever it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I ready my knife.
I don't want to hear his voice any longer.
I focus my gaze on him.
All that's left is to slice them.

entries.japanese:
「……そうかよ。
どうしてもオレを殺すっていうんだな、志貴」
　じり、とロアが体を引く。
　それがヤツの最後の行動――――
「けどさあ、オレたちは本当はどちらが殺されたのか疑問に思わないか？」
「――――」
　ぴたり、と。
　襲いかかろうとした、体が止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. No matter what I say, you mean to kill me, Shiki.”
Roa edged backward.
It was to be his final act—
“But haven’t you ever wondered which of us was truly killed?”
“――――”
At that.
My body stopped dead just as I was about to spring.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
You're trying to kill me, Shiki."
He pulls back.
That's his final move---
"But, don't you ever wonder which one of us was really killed?"
"----"
Suddenly,
I halt my attack.

entries.japanese:
「そう、結局オレたちは二人ともあの中庭で死んでいるんだ。
　ならさ―――本当はロアに殺されたのがオレで、生き残っているおまえが、蛇っていう吸血鬼に乗っ取られた遠野シキかもしれないだろ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“In the end, both of us died in that courtyard.
So perhaps I was the one Roa killed—and you, the survivor, are really SHIKI Tohno possessed by the vampire called the Serpent?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, in the end, both of us died in that place.
So---I might be the one killed by Roa, and you might be the Tohno SHIKI taken over by the Serpent, right?"

entries.japanese:
「なあ志貴。
どうしてこうも考えないんだ。
　本当はさ、オマエ本人が気がついていないだけで、とっくの昔にオマエはオレみたいに狂っちまってるんだって！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me, Shiki. Why have you never considered it?
Perhaps you simply haven’t noticed that you went mad long ago, just as I did!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki.
Didn't you ever think about it this way?
That you just have not realized it, but you were already insane a long, long time ago!"

entries.japanese:
――――――――それは。
　そんなコトは絶対にない―――と言いきれるのか、ホントウに？
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――――That was the question.
Could I truly say with absolute certainty that it wasn’t so?
entries.mirrorMoon:
--------That,
That can't be true---can it?

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――！」
　だん、と背中から壁に蹴りつけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—!”
A kick drove me back-first into the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----!"
I get kicked into the wall from behind.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ……！」
　なんてコト。
くだらない言葉に踊らされて、見誤った。
　残った左腕も切り裂かれて、血に染まっている。
　力は一切入らず、ナイフは床に転がっている。
　そうして―――目の前には、血走った目をしたロアがいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
Damn it. I had let his worthless words lead me astray.
My remaining left arm had been slashed open and soaked in blood.
No strength entered it; the knife lay on the floor.
Before me stood Roa, his eyes bloodshot.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah……!"
What is this?
Being distracted by such stupid words.
My remaining left arm becomes shredded and painted in blood.
I can't move it one bit and my knife clatters to the floor.
And---in front of me, Roa stands with his furious, blood-shot eyes.

entries.japanese:
「―――バーカ、そんなワケがないだろう。
ロアはオレだよ。
オマエはただ、オレと意識下で繋がっていたから反転衝動を持っただけだ」
　にやり、と笑って。
　ロアは一歩踏み込んできた。
「じゃあな、志貴。
最後はわりと楽しかったゼ！」
　そうして、ロアはカッターの刃みたいに伸びた爪を振り下ろした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Idiot. As if that could be true—Roa is me. You developed the inversion impulse only because you and I were linked beneath consciousness.”
Roa grinned.
Then he stepped in.
“Goodbye, Shiki. That ending was more fun than I expected!”
Roa brought down claws extended like box-cutter blades.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Idiot, that's not it at all.
I'm Roa.
You had that inverse impulse because you were connected to me subconsciously."
He grins.
Roa takes a step forward.
"Bye Shiki.
It's been fun!"
With that, he swings his knife-like claws downward.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　痛みがない。
　ただ、ビシャリ、と血の飛び散る音がするだけ。
「女、貴様――――！」
　ロアの声。
　目の前には、俺を庇ってロアの爪を受けている、先輩の体がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
There was no pain.
Only the wet splash of scattering blood.
“You woman—!”
Roa’s voice.
Ciel stood before me, shielding my body with her own as Roa’s claws tore into her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
There's no pain.
Just the sound of splashing blood.
"You bitch----!"
Roa's voice rings out.
In front of me, Senpai's body takes the full force of Roa's claws.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　何も考えられない。
　否、何かを考える必要なぞない。
　俺は床に落ちているナイフを食った。
　ガギリ、と柄を歯で噛み砕いて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I could think of nothing.
No—there was no longer any need to think.
I took the knife from the floor in my teeth.
Its hilt cracked between them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I can't think of anything.
No, there's no need to think.
I scoop up my fallen knife with my mouth.
My teeth tighten around the hilt.

entries.japanese:
ロアにぶつかって、崩れ落ちるように。
　ヤツの肩口からナナメに走った『線』を、切断した。
entries.maoEnglish:
I crashed into Roa and collapsed against him.
I severed the line that ran diagonally from his shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I dash into Roa, almost like I was collapsing into him.
I slice the "line" running diagonal from his shoulder.

entries.japanese:
「くああああああああああああああああああ！」
　化鳥じみた断末魔をあげて、ロアが跳ねる。
　俺と先輩から逃げるように窓際まで跳び退いて、ヤツはそのまま落ちた。
　窓ガラスを割って、校庭へと落ちていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
Roa sprang away with the death-cry of some monstrous bird.
He leapt back toward the window as if fleeing both Ciel and me, then toppled through it.
The glass shattered, and he fell toward the schoolyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!"
He screeches like some demonic bird.
Running away from Senpai and me, he jumps directly into the window, and falls out.
The glass shatters and he falls outside.

entries.japanese:
「逃がすか―――！」
　窓ガラスまで走りよる。
「くっ………！」
　けど、さすがに三階から飛び降りるなんて真似はできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re not getting away!”
I ran to the broken window.
“Damn…!”
But even I could not bring myself to jump from the third floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I won't let you get away---!"
I run to the window.
"Damn………!"
But of course, I can't jump from the third floor.

entries.japanese:
月夜の下。
　死の『線』だけでは致命傷には至らなかったのか、ロアは獣のように走り去っていく。
「―――」
　……追いかけられない。
　ここからじゃヤツには追いつかない。
　けど、追いかける必要はないみたいだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beneath the moon.
Perhaps severing only a line of death had not been enough to deal a fatal wound; Roa fled like an animal.
“…”
I couldn’t pursue him.
From here I would never catch up.
It seemed, however, that I had no need to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Under the moonlit night.
As if he didn't receive a fatal wound by just having his "lines" of death cut, Roa runs away like a beast.
"---"
…… I can't chase him.
From here, I can't chase him.
But, it seems like there's no need for that.

entries.japanese:
月明かりの下、走り去っていくロアの影が止まった。
　校庭にのびる影は一つではなく二つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
In the moonlight, Roa’s fleeing shadow stopped.
Two shadows, not one, stretched across the schoolyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Under the moonlight, Roa's running figure stops.
There isn't one person outside, but two.

entries.japanese:
一人は、獣のようにうずくまるロアの影。
　一人は、気高く敵を威圧する白い装束の吸血姫。
―――勝敗は、それこそ一瞬でついた。
　ロアは断末魔をあげて、その場でサラサラと塵になっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
One belonged to Roa, crouching like a beast.
The other to a vampire princess in white, standing nobly as she crushed her enemy beneath her presence.
―――The battle was decided in a single instant.
Roa gave his death-cry and sifted into dust where he stood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
One, the beast-like figure of Roa.
One, the sublime, white figure of the vampire princess.
---The fight lasted only an instant.
Roa screams as he dies and fades to ash.

entries.japanese:
「――――アル……クェイド」
　悠然と立ち尽くしたアルクェイドは、一度だけ俺に視線を投げて、そのまま消えるように立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Arcueid.”
Arcueid stood there in serene command; she glanced up at me once, then departed as though vanishing from the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Ar…… cueid."
She stands there composed and looks up at me, then disappears before my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　……疲れた。
　どさり、と体が倒れこむ。
　壁を背にして、だらしなく座り込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I was exhausted.
My body collapsed with a thud.
I slumped against the wall in an ungainly heap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hha----Ahh."
…… I'm exhausted.
My body collapses on the floor.
Leaning against the wall, I sit down.

entries.japanese:
「ぐ―――」
　口にくわえていたナイフが落ちる。
　右手は肘から下の部分がねじれて、骨が捻じ曲げられている。
　左手は肩口あたりからザックリとロアの爪を受けてしまって、だらりと下がったままピクリとも動かない。
　両腕が動かないだけで、なんだかイカかタコにでもなった気分だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—”
The knife dropped from my mouth.
Below the elbow, my right arm was twisted, the bones bent out of shape.
Roa’s claws had torn deep into my left shoulder, leaving the arm dangling loose and utterly still.
Having both arms useless somehow made me feel like a squid or an octopus.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ga---"
The knife falls from my mouth.
From my elbow down, my right arm is shattered, twisted and split.
Roa's claw marks remain gouged into my left shoulder and my left arm hangs, unmoving.
I feel like a squid or an octopus with both my arms just hanging there.

entries.japanese:
「……先……輩」
　廊下を見渡す。
　さっき、俺を庇ってくれた先輩が倒れている方へ首をまわす。
　と。
「先―――輩、傷、いいのか」
「はい。
あのぐらいの傷なら、すぐに治ります」
　先輩の顔色は、暗くてよく見えない。
　ただ、いつもより青白いな、と思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ci—el.”
I searched the corridor.
I turned toward the place where she had fallen after shielding me.
And then.
“Ciel—are your wounds all right?”
“Yes. Wounds like those heal quickly.”
The darkness hid her complexion.
I thought she looked paler than usual.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sen…… pai."
I look down the hallway.
I look down to where Senpai had collapsed when she protected me earlier.
And there,
"Sen---pai, your wounds are okay?"
"Yes.
A wound like this will heal quickly."
I cannot make out her face since it's dark.
But I thought it looked paler than usual.

entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah----!"
----Thump.

entries.japanese:
頭痛。
――――どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
A headache.
――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Headache.
----Thump.

entries.japanese:
頭痛が、
――――どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
The headache—
――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This headache,
----Thump.

entries.japanese:
まだ、『線』を見てしまっているから、
――――どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
Because I was still seeing the lines—
――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
because I still see these "lines",
----Thump.

entries.japanese: 頭痛が、する。
entries.maoEnglish: My head hurt.
entries.mirrorMoon: I have this headache.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん？
　どうしたんですか？」
「いや――頭、頭が―――痛い、だけ」
　頭痛をこらえながら、なんとかそう返答する。
　両手。
両手が動くんなら、頭を支えて少しぐらいは気分が落ち着くっていうのに、俺の手はどっちも動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? What’s wrong?”
“Nothing—my head just hurts.”
Fighting down the pain, I somehow managed to answer.
My hands. If either of them worked, I could at least cradle my head and calm myself a little, but neither would move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun?
What's wrong?"
"Nothing--it's just---my head, hurts."
I manage to reply as I bear the pain.
My hands.
If I could move them, I could hold my head and maybe calm down.
But, they don't move an inch.

entries.japanese:
「―――死を視すぎた反動かもしれません。
　……遠野くん、無理をするから。
一人でロアを倒そうとするなんて、無茶です」
「……無茶じゃないよ。
無茶っていうのは先輩のほうだ。
どうして―――あんな、ヤツに、いいようにやられてた、んだよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It may be the backlash from seeing too much death.
You pushed yourself too far, Tohno. Trying to defeat Roa alone was reckless.”
“I wasn’t the reckless one. You were. Why did you let that bastard do whatever he wanted to you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Probably because you saw too much death.
…… Tohno-kun, you were pushing yourself too much.
Trying to defeat Roa by yourself was being reckless."
"…… It's not reckless.
You were the one being reckless.
Why---did you let him do that to you?"

entries.japanese:
「それは……わたしが油断して、その……」
「―――ばか。
話、聞こえてた」
　……先輩が、俺のために自分から剣を放棄したって、聞こえてた。
「……俺なんかを庇って、あんな目にあうなんて、ばかだ」
　あんなになってまで、俺の名前を呼び続けていたなんて、どうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was because I let my guard down, and…”
“Idiot. I heard what he said.”
I had heard that Ciel willingly cast aside her sword for my sake.
“You’re an idiot for protecting someone like me and letting that happen to you.”
She had kept calling my name even after being reduced to that; it was madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"He just…… caught me off guard……"
"---Idiot, I, heard all of it."
…… I heard how Senpai threw away her swords to protect me.
"…… Going through that just to protect me, was stupid."
Going through that, and just calling out my name, there's something wrong.

entries.japanese:
「……そうですね。
わたしが何かするまでもなく、遠野くんは自分から蘇生してくれましたから。
　わたし、お節介なことをしただけ、でした」
「――――――」
　そんな―――そんなこと、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, I suppose I am. You revived on your own before I could do anything.
All I managed was to meddle where I wasn’t needed.”
“…”
That wasn’t true—not at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I suppose.
No matter what I did, you revived by yourself.
I guess I was… just doing useless things."
"------"
Not---that's not it at all.

entries.japanese:
「……でも、聞こえた」
「遠野くん……？」
「先輩の声が、ちゃんと聞こえた。
先輩が名前を呼び続けてくれたから―――俺、まだ生きているんだなって、思えた」
　だから、やっぱり。
　俺を救ってくれたのはこの目でもロアへの殺意とかじゃなくて、
　ただ、先輩の声だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I heard you.”
“Tohno…?”
“I heard your voice. Because you kept calling my name, I realized I was still alive.”
So in the end.
What saved me was not these eyes or my hatred of Roa—
It was nothing but Ciel’s voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I heard you."
"Tohno-kun……?"
"Your voice, I know I heard it.
You kept calling my name---so it made me realize that I was still alive."
So,
what saved me wasn't my desire to kill Roa.
But it was just… Senpai's voice.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ―――！」
「遠野くん―――！？
　傷、痛むんですか？
　待っててください、すぐに治療しますから……！」
「……いや、腕の傷はそう痛くない、んだけど……」
　頭痛が、酷い。
　外側から突き刺されるような痛みじゃなくて、内側から弾けるような、痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
“Tohno! Do your wounds hurt? Wait there—I’ll treat them at once…!”
“No—my arms don’t hurt that badly.”
The headache was unbearable.
It was not pain stabbing in from outside, but pain bursting outward from within.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ghh----!"
"Tohno-kun---!?
Your wounds, do they hurt?
Please wait, I'll heal them……!"
"…… No, it's not, really my arms……"
This headache is terrible.
The pain isn't coming from outside, but feels like it is shooting out from inside me.

entries.japanese:
「……『死』を視すぎた反動です。
遠野くんの脳が思考速度を急激に早めてしまったため、それにあわせようと血が流れすぎてるんです」
「……それは、わかってる、けど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s the backlash from seeing too much ‘death.’ Your brain accelerated its thoughts so violently that too much blood is rushing through it to keep pace.”
“I know that, but—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's a reaction from seeing too much 'death'.
Suddenly overworking your brain like that probably caused too much blood flow."
"…… I, know that, but."

entries.japanese:
「いいですか、あなたの力は遠野くん本人にとっても危険なものです。
これ以上『本来の目では見れないもの』を見ようとすれば、急激な血の流れに血管が耐えられなくなる。
　人間……自分に近い生物の『死』を視るぐらいなら問題はないでしょうけど、本来殺せないものの『死』を視ようとすれば、いずれ死んでしまいます」
「……ああ、それは大丈夫、先輩。
　ロアは……あいつは死んだんだ。
もう、これ以上、『死』を視ることなんてないんだから――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen carefully—your power is dangerous even to you. If you keep trying to see things the human eye was never meant to see, your blood vessels will eventually rupture under the flow.
Seeing the ‘death’ of a human being—or another living creature like yourself—should pose little danger, but if you try to see the ‘death’ of something that ought to be unkillable, eventually it will kill you.”
“It’s all right, Ciel.
Roa is dead. I’ll never have to see any more ‘death’—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, your power is very dangerous to you, Tohno-kun.
Seeing that which should not be possible to see puts a huge strain on your body, and your blood vessels will not be able to handle the flow of your blood.
Seeing the 'death' of something close to you…… like humans shouldn't be a problem, but seeing the 'death' of things that don't naturally have a 'death' is extremely dangerous."
"…… Yeah, that's okay though Senpai.
Roa…… is now dead.
I don't have to see any more 'death'----"

entries.japanese:
「だから、もうこんなモノ視なくていい。
　……先輩、俺のメガネ、知らない？」
「――――――は？」
「メガネ……メガネがないと、勝手に余計なモノが視えちまうんだ。
　アレがないと、俺はおかしくなる。
……先輩、きっと茶道室に落ちてるから、持ってきてくれないか」
「遠野くん、何を言ってるんですか。
メガネなら、ちゃんと――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I don’t need to see this anymore.
Ciel, do you know where my glasses are?”
“――――――What?”
“My glasses—without them, I see things I don’t want to see whether I choose to or not.
I’ll go mad without them. They must be in the tea-ceremony room, so could you bring them to me?”
“Tohno, what are you talking about? Your glasses are right—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, I don't have to see them.
…… Senpai, do you know where my glasses are?"
"------Huh?"
"My glasses…… without them, I see these lines all the time.
If I don't have them, I'll go crazy…… they're probably in the tea ceremony room, so could you please get them for me?"
"Tohno-kun, what are you saying?
Your glasses are definitely----"

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
すぐに取ってきますから、遠野くんは目を閉じていてください。
これ以上その目を使うと、遠野くんが参ってしまいますから」
「―――そうする。
悪いけど、頼むよ」
　言って、眠るように瞼を閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll fetch them at once, so keep your eyes closed. If you use them any longer, it will be too much for you.”
“―――I will. Sorry, Ciel—I’m counting on you.”
I closed my eyes as though falling asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
I'll go get it right away, so please close your eyes.
If you use them much longer, it will be really bad for you."
"---Yeah, I'll do that.
Thanks."
I close my eyelids.

entries.japanese:
しばらくして。
　こめかみに先輩の指の感触がした。
「はい、これでオッケーです。
目を開けてもいいですよ、遠野くん」
「あ……」
　死の線が消えている。
　頭痛のほうは目を閉じた時からしなくなっていたから、これでようやく―――まともに先輩の顔が見れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
After a while.
I felt Ciel’s fingers at my temples.
“There, all done. You can open your eyes now, Tohno.”
“Ah…”
The Lines of Death were gone.
The headache had stopped when I closed my eyes, so at last I could look properly at Ciel’s face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After only a few moments,
I can feel Senpai's fingers on my face.
"Here you go, it's all okay now.
Please open your eyes, Tohno-kun."
"Ah……"
The lines of death are now gone.
My headache disappeared as I closed my eyes---and I can now see Senpai's face clearly.

entries.japanese:
「ありがと先輩。
これで元通りになった」
「なに言ってるんですか。
遠野くんを元通りにするのはこれからなんですから、まだじっとしていてください」
　言って、先輩は俺の横に座り込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thanks, Ciel. I’m back to normal now.”
“What are you talking about? Putting you back together is what comes next, so please keep still.”
Ciel sat down beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks Senpai.
Now it's back to normal."
"What are you saying?
There's still some work before you return to normal, so please keep still."
She says that and sits down beside me.

entries.japanese:
「―――へえ、見た目ほどひどい傷じゃないですね。
これならすぐに治せますから、もう少し我慢していてください」
　先輩は割れ物を扱うような手つきで、ねじれた俺の腕に触れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, it isn’t nearly as bad as it looks. I’ll have this healed quickly, so bear with me a little longer.”
She touched my twisted arm as delicately as if it were made of glass.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hmm, these wounds really aren't that bad.
I'll be able to heal them right away, so please hold on just a little longer."
Senpai carefully reaches out and holds my twisted arm.

entries.japanese:
「ん――――」
　なんか、ぬるま湯をかけられているような、くすぐったい感覚。
　冷え切っていた腕が段々と熱を持つようになって、そのあとに、麻痺していた痛みがやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmm…”
It tickled, like warm water trickling over my skin.
Heat slowly returned to my frozen arm, followed by the pain that numbness had kept at bay.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn----"
There's an almost tickling, warm sensation.
My cold arm begins to warm up again, and the numbed pain returns after that.

entries.japanese:
「あいた」
「はい、痛みがあるのは生きている証拠です。
それじゃあ次は左手のほうですね」
　先輩は軽い足取りでこっちの左側に移動して、今度は傷のある肩口に手をあてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow.”
“Pain is proof you’re alive. Now for the left arm.”
With a light step, Ciel moved to my other side and laid her hand over the wound in my shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oww."
"If there's pain, it lets you know you are alive.
Now, let's take care of your left arm."
With a light step, she moves over to my left side and puts her hand on my shoulder.

entries.japanese:
「……すごいな。
左手、もう治ってる」
「すごくなんかないですよ。
わたしはこれが本職なんですから、できて当たり前なんです」
　……これが本職って、先輩は看護婦さんか何かなんだろうか。
　まあ、看護婦さんはねじれた腕を数分で治してしまう、なんて芸当はできないけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s incredible. My left arm’s already healed.”
“It isn’t incredible. This is my profession, so of course I can do it.”
Was Ciel some kind of nurse?
Not that ordinary nurses could mend a twisted arm in a few minutes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Amazing, my left arm is already healed!"
"It isn't amazing, this is my normal profession, so it is only natural I can do that."
…… Her normal profession?
Is she a nurse or something?
Well, I don't think a nurse could heal a shattered arm like that in a matter of minutes though.

entries.japanese:
「……なあ、先輩」
「――はい？」
「先輩って、いったいどうゆう人なのかな。
考えてみたら、俺はシエル先輩のこと、なにも知らない」
　傷口に触れていた指が止まる。
　けど、それも一瞬だけの反応だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel.”
“Yes?”
“What kind of person are you, really? Now that I think about it, I don’t know anything about you.”
Her fingers stopped against the wound.
But only for an instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey Senpai."
"--Yes?"
"Senpai, just what kind of person are you?
Come to think of it, I don't really know anything about you, Ciel-senpai."
The fingers over my wounds suddenly stop.
But, it was only a momentary reaction.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くんと同じですよ。
わたしも、生まれつきこういう体をしていたワケじゃありません。
　一度死にかけて……いえ、一度死んでそこから生きかえった人間なんです。
なんか、そうしたら生きかえるのがクセになっちゃいまして」
　冗談のつもりなのか、先輩の台詞は苦笑まじりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m the same as you, Tohno. I wasn’t born with a body like this.
I nearly died once—no, I died and then came back. Somehow, after that, coming back became a habit.”
Perhaps she intended it as a joke; the words came with a rueful smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm the same as you Tohno-kun.
I also, have not had this body from birth.
I also was close to death…… no, I am someone who died and came back to life.
And it just became a habit for me to come back to life."
Is she joking?
She gives a pained smile.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよそれ。
普通さ、死んだら生きかえってこれないよ」
「ですから、わたしは普通じゃなかったんです」
「普通じゃないって……その、アルクェイドみたいに？」
「……………………」
　先輩は答えない。
　傷の手当てが終わったのか、先輩は立ちあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What kind of answer is that? Ordinary people don’t come back after they die.”
“That is precisely why I wasn’t ordinary.”
“Not ordinary—you mean like Arcueid?”
“…”
Ciel did not answer.
Apparently finished treating me, she rose to her feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What do you mean?
If you die, you normally can't come back, right?"
"What I am saying, is that I was not normal."
"Not normal…… like, Arcueid?"
"……………………"
She doesn't respond.
Is she done?
Senpai stands up.

entries.japanese:
「はい、おしまいです。
どうですか、ちゃんと動きます？」
「……………」
　とりあえず立ちあがって、軽く両手を動かしてみた。
　指は思い通りに動くし、痛みは少ししかない。
「ああ、問題ないみたいだ。
……ありがとう先輩。
とにかくもう、色々助けられっぱなしだ」
　先輩は何も言わず、ただ笑顔を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, finished. How does everything feel?
Can you move properly?”
“…” I stood and flexed both hands.
My fingers obeyed, and only a little pain remained.
“Yes, no problems. Thank you, Ciel. You’ve saved me more times than I can count.”
She said nothing, answering only with a smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There, all finished.
How is it, can you move?"
"………………"
I lift my hands and move them around.
My fingers can move at will, and there is only a little pain.
"Yeah, no problems.
…… Thanks, Senpai.
I'm just always helped by you."
Senpai doesn't answer, she just smiles.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ帰りましょう。
もうここには何もありませんから」
　先輩は歩き始める。
　……廊下に落ちているナイフを拾って、俺も学校を後にする事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let’s go home. There is nothing left here.”
Ciel started walking.
I picked up the knife lying in the corridor and followed her out of the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then, let's go back.
There's no need to be here any longer."
Senpai starts to walk away.
…… Picking up my fallen knife, I follow her out of the school.

entries.japanese:
……月明かりの下、二人で正門まで歩いてきた。
　先輩は何も言わない。
　俺は先輩の背中を見つめながら、あまり考えたくないことを考えていた。
　ロアは消えた。
　アルクェイドも去った。
　初めから彼女たちの目的がロアの消去であったのなら、もう、先輩がここに残る理由はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beneath the moonlight, the two of us walked as far as the front gate.
Ciel said nothing.
Watching her back, I found myself thinking about something I desperately wanted to avoid.
Roa was gone.
Arcueid had left.
If both women had come here solely to destroy Roa, Ciel had no reason to remain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The two of us walk to the gate under the moonlight.
Senpai doesn't say anything.
Looking at her back, I think reluctantly about things I don't want to consider.
Roa is gone.
Arcueid is also gone.
Their purpose was to eliminate Roa, so Senpai has no reason to stay here any longer.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……冗談じゃない。
　そりゃあそういう理屈はわかっていたけど、いくらなんでも―――こんなに早く、その時が来るなんて思ってもいなかった。
　俺は先輩に、残ってほしい。
　残ってほしいけど―――こればっかりは俺の問題じゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
You’ve got to be kidding.
I had always understood the logic of it, but I had never imagined the time would come so soon.
I wanted Ciel to stay.
I wanted it desperately—but this was not my decision to make.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… This is serious.

I knew it all along---but I never thought this would come so quickly.
I want Senpai to stay here.
I want her to stay---but it isn't just my problem.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　ちらり、と先輩の顔を盗み見る。
　先輩は。
　先輩はこれからどうするつもりなんだろう……？
　と。
　いきなり、先輩が足を止めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I stole a glance at her face.
Ciel.
What was she going to do now?
Then.
Without warning, she stopped.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I steal a glance at Senpai's face.
What,
What does Senpai plan on doing……?
And then,
Senpai suddenly stops walking.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん」
　感情のない目で、まっすぐに見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno.”
She looked straight at me with emotionless eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun."
She looks directly at me with eyes devoid of any emotion.

entries.japanese:
「……なに、先輩」
「さっきの話の続きです」
「さっきの話って―――その、先輩がアルクェイドみたいって、ことですか」
　こくん、と先輩は頷く。
　そのまま、じっとまっすぐに俺の目を見て、先輩は口を開けた。
「遠野くん。
わたしが吸血鬼だったらどうしますか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Ciel?”
“The rest of what we were discussing.”
“You mean when I asked if you were like Arcueid?”
She nodded once.
She held my gaze and began to speak.
“Tohno. What would you do if I were a vampire?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What is it, Senpai?"
"About what we were talking about before."
"Before---about how you're like Arcueid?"
She nods.
Still staring me in the eye, she starts to speak.
"Tohno-kun.
If I was a vampire, what would you do?"

entries.japanese:
「なっ――――」
　一瞬、頭の中が真っ白になった。
　先輩が何を聞きたいのか、俺にはてんで解らない。
　ただ―――
「……先輩は先輩だよ。
たとえ吸血鬼だろうと、それは変わらないと思うけど」
　先輩の表情は変わらない。
　ただほんの一瞬だけ。
　寂しそうに微笑んだ気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—?”
For an instant my mind went blank.
I had no idea what answer she wanted from me.
But—
“You’d still be you. Even if you were a vampire, that wouldn’t change.”
Her expression did not move.
Yet for the briefest instant.
I thought she smiled sadly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
My mind goes blank.
I don't know what she wants to hear.
Still---
"…… Senpai is Senpai.
Even if you are a vampire, that wouldn't change."
Her expression remains the same.
Just for an instant,
I think she smiled sadly.

entries.japanese:
「わたしは彼女と同じなんです。
彼女が経験のない吸血鬼であるように、わたしは自覚のない吸血鬼なのかもしれない」
　独白するように、先輩はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am the same as she is. Just as she is a vampire without experience, perhaps I am a vampire without awareness.”
Ciel spoke as though confessing it only to herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I am the same as her.
Just like she is a vampire who has had no experience, I just might be a vampire who has no sense of self."
She speaks as if it was a monologue.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　言葉がない。
　……そんなことを言われたら、なんて答えていいのか解らない。
　だから、さっきと同じように、自分の素直な気持ちを言うことしかできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I had no words.
Faced with something like that, I had no idea what to say.
All I could do was answer honestly, as I had before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I'm at a loss for words.
…… I don't know what to say to that.
So, just like before, I can only say what I really feel.

entries.japanese:
「……いいよ」
「え？」
「だからいいって言ったの。
吸血鬼でも、俺は先輩が好きだよ」
「な――――」
　先輩は呆然と立ち尽くす。
　こっちはなんていうか、勢いで言ってしまったということもあって、顔を赤くしてあさっての方向を見てみたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s all right.”
“What?”
“I said it’s all right. Vampire or not, I love you.”
“Wh—”
Ciel stood speechless.
Having blurted it out on sheer momentum, I turned scarlet and looked determinedly anywhere but at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's fine."
"Eh?"
"I said, that's fine.
Even if you are a vampire, I still like you Senpai."
"Wha----"
Senpai stands there in complete amazement.
Realizing what I just said, I blush furiously and look away.

entries.japanese:
「ああもうっ、とにかく言いたい事はそれだけだ！
　さ、早く帰ろうぜ先輩！」
　照れ隠しにそう言って、現実に引き戻された。
　帰る。
　帰るって、先輩はどこに帰るのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, forget it—that’s all I wanted to say! Come on, Ciel, let’s hurry home!”
I covered my embarrassment with bluster—and the words snapped me back to reality.
Home.
But where was Ciel going home to?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway!
That's all I want to say.
C'mon, let's go back, Senpai!"
Trying to hide my embarrassment, I pull myself to reality.
Go back.
Where is Senpai going to return to?

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　一気に気持ちが凍っていく。
　先輩の顔を見るのが恐くて、振り向けない。
「―――遠野くん」
　背中ごしに、先輩の声が聞こえた。
　感情のない、静かな声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The warmth inside me froze all at once.
Too afraid to see her face, I could not turn around.
“―――Tohno.”
I heard Ciel’s voice from behind me.
It was quiet and empty of emotion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I suddenly feel terrible.
I'm afraid to look at her face and can't turn around.
"---Tohno-kun."
From behind me, Senpai's voice calls out.
Her quiet, emotionless voice.

entries.japanese:
「……なに？」
　振り向けずに返答する。
「わたしが何のためにこの街に来たか、知っていますよね」
「――――ああ。
残念ながら、知ってる。
ロアを、退治するためだろう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
I answered without turning.
“You know why I came to this city.”
“――――Yes. Unfortunately, I do. You came to destroy Roa.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What is it?"
I answer without turning.
"You know why I came to this city, right?"
"----Yeah.
Unfortunately, I know.
You came to kill Roa."

entries.japanese:
「……ええ。
けど、その理由までは話していませんでした。
本当は今日、茶道室でお話しようと思ってたんですけど、なんかあっけなく終わっちゃいましたね」
「……そうだね。
ちょっと、拍子抜けした。
　けど先輩がロアを追っていたのは、教会っていうところの仕事なんじゃなかったの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. But I never explained why. I meant to tell you in the tea-ceremony room today, but everything ended so suddenly.”
“It did. Almost anticlimactically.
But wasn’t hunting Roa an assignment from the Church?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
But, I haven't told you why yet.
I really meant to tell you in the tea ceremony room, but things ended quickly."
"…… That's true.
It was kind of disappointing.
But, wasn't you chasing Roa part of your duty in The Church?"

entries.japanese:
「……いえ。
わたしの所属しているところは、なんていうかあんまり仕事がないんです。
あっても年に数回、ちょっと呼び出される程度で。
　ですから今回の件はわたしの独断なんです。
わたしは教会の指示によってではなく、自分の意思でこの街にやってきました」
「……先輩の、意思？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. The organization I belong to does not have much work, really. At most I’m summoned a few times a year.
This affair was my own decision. I came to this city by my own will, not under orders from the Church.”
“Your own will…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
The place I'm in doesn't really have much work.
Even when there is, it's only a few times a year I get called there.
So this time is my own judgment.
Not because of the orders of The Church, but I came here through my own will."
"…… Your, will?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
わたしは自分の事情だけでここに来たんです。
わたしは人間として死にたいから、ずっとロアを追っていました。
わたしの体がこんなになってしまったのはカレに原因がありましたから」
　……死にたい。
死にたいって、それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I came entirely for my own reasons. I have pursued Roa all this time because I want to die as a human being. He was the reason my body became this way.”
She wanted to die. Did that mean—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I came here only because of my own circumstances.
I want to die as a human, so I've been chasing Roa.
He is the reason my body has become like this."
…… wants to die.
Wants to die?---

entries.japanese:
「……ただそれだけのために、わたしはこうして生き長らえてきました。
　けど、それも終わりです。
　……五年間。
長かったのか短かったのか、よくはわかりませんけど」
　感情のない声は、そこで終わった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was the only reason I went on living.
But now it is over.
Five years. I can no longer tell whether they were long or short.”
The emotionless voice fell silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… For that sole reason, I have kept on living like this.
But, that is all over now.
…… These past five years.
Was it a long time?
Was it a short time?
I don't know."
Her emotionless voice stops.

entries.japanese:
たん、と踊るような足取りで、先輩は俺の前に顔を出す。
「ですから遠野くんには感謝しています。
　わたしの仕事はこれでおしまいです。
あとは、残った自分の責任を、果たさなくちゃいけません」
「……先輩、やっぱり―――」
　もう、行ってしまうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a light, almost dancing step, Ciel moved around to face me.
“That is why I’m grateful to you, Tohno.
My work is finished. Now I must fulfill the responsibility that remains to me.”
“Ciel, are you really—”
Was she leaving?
entries.mirrorMoon:
She jumps directly in front of me.
"So I have to thank you, Tohno-kun.
My work here is done now.
All that's left is for me to take responsibility for all my actions."
"…… Senpai, you mean---"
She's going to leave?

entries.japanese:
「今までありがとうございました。
わたし、こんなに嬉しかったの久しぶりです。
　ですから、最後に握手しましょう」
　先輩は手を差し出してくる。
　その手を、無言で握り返した。
　ただ、強く握っただけの、握手。
「それではお別れです。
えっとですね、わたしがいなくなっても乾くんと仲良くしてくださいね。
　わたし、遠野くんと乾くんみたいな学生になりたかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you for everything. It has been a very long time since I was this happy.
So let’s shake hands one last time.”
Ciel offered her hand.
Silently, I clasped it.
Only a handshake, held fiercely tight.
“Then this is goodbye. Even after I’m gone, please stay friends with Inui.
I wanted to be an ordinary student, like you and him.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank you so much for everything until now.
It has been a long time since I've been this happy.
So, let's finish with a handshake."
Senpai puts out her hand.
I wordlessly accept it.
A handshake where we only grip our hands tightly.
"Then this is where we part.
Um, even though I'm not going to be here, please stay friends with Inui-kun.
I wanted to be a student like you and Inui-kun."

entries.japanese:
「あ、あとですね、あんまりメガネを外しちゃダメですよ。
特異なモノは特異なモノを引き寄せるんです。
今回は解決しましたけど、次はどうなるかわからないんですから」
「……ああ。
わかってる、それは昔教えられたよ。
　そもそもさ、俺がメガネを外したのなんて、本当にここ最近だけの話なんだぜ」
「そうですか。
それを聞いて安心しました」
　先輩の指が離れる。
　握手が終わって、俺たちはすこし距離をとった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And one more thing: please don’t take off your glasses too often. Strange things attract other strange things. This time it ended well, but there is no telling what might happen next.”
“I know. Someone taught me that a long time ago.
Besides, I only started taking them off in the last few days.”
“I see. That puts my mind at ease.”
Ciel’s fingers slipped from mine.
The handshake ended, and we put a little distance between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And, and please don't take off your glasses too much.
Strange power has a tendency to attract strange things.
You were fine this time, but I do not know what will happen the next time."
"…… Yeah.
I know, someone taught me that a long time ago.
In the first place, I've only recently began to take them off with everything that has been happening."
"I see.
That is a relief."
Her fingers pull back.
With the handshake over, she pulls back slightly.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあさよなら。
また会えるといいですね、わたしたち」
「――――」
　返事はできなかった。
　止めるコトも、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then goodbye. I hope we meet again someday.”
“…”
I could not answer.
I could not stop her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then this is farewell.
It would be nice to meet again someday."
"----"
I can't reply.

I couldn't even stop her.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に帰ってきた。
　時刻は夜の九時すぎ。
……門限を一時間もオーバーしてしまっている。
「あっ、志貴さん。
今日は随分と遅いお帰りなんですね」
　今まで居間にいたのか、琥珀さんが出迎えてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I returned to the mansion.
It was past nine. I had missed curfew by more than an hour.
“Oh, Master Shiki. You’re home awfully late tonight.”
Kohaku came to greet me, apparently having been in the sitting room until then.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion.
It's past nine at night.
…… An hour past curfew.
"Ah, Shiki-san.
You have come back late today."
She might have been in the sitting room until now, as Kohaku-san comes out to greet me.

entries.japanese:
「ただいま。
ごめん、遅くなった」
「いえ、無事に帰ってきていただけたのならいいんです。
ご夕飯でしたらすぐに作りますから、居間のほうでお待ちしていてくださいな」
「あ―――居間には秋葉はいる？」
　……門限が守れなかったとかそういった理由ではなくて、ただ―――ロアの話が気になって、今は秋葉とまともに顔を合わせる自信がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m home. Sorry I’m late.”
“Never mind, so long as you returned safely. I’ll prepare your dinner at once, so please wait in the sitting room.”
“Is Akiha in there?”
It wasn’t that I feared being scolded for missing curfew; Roa’s story was still lodged in my mind, and I had no confidence that I could face Akiha normally.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm back.
Sorry about that."
"No, as long as you are back safely it is okay.
I will go make dinner, so please wait in the sitting room."
"Ah---is Akiha there?"
…… Not because I broke curfew---but after hearing what Roa said, I don't think I can talk to her now.

entries.japanese:
「いえ、秋葉さまでしたらお部屋のほうに戻られていますから、安心していいですよ」
「……いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど……ねえ琥珀さん。
この家にさ、俺と秋葉以外の兄弟がいたっていう話、聞いたことがある？」
「そういった話はないと思いますね。
どうしたんですか志貴さん。
なんかあったんですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, Miss Akiha has retired to her room, so you may relax.”
“That isn’t quite what I meant… Kohaku, have you ever heard that there was another sibling in this family besides Akiha and me?”
“I don’t believe so. What is the matter, Master Shiki? Did something happen?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, she is now in her room, so you can rest assured."
"…… No, that's not it, but…… hey Kohaku-san.
In this house, did you ever hear of me and Akiha having another brother?"
"I don't think so.
Why do you ask, Shiki-san?
Did something happen?"

entries.japanese:
「―――いや。
ただ、俺に兄貴がいたかもしれないって、そんな話を聞いてさ。
ちょっと記憶に自信がなくて」
「志貴さんと秋葉さまは二人きりの兄妹ですよ。
幼いころからこの屋敷で働いているわたしが言うんですから間違いありません」
　琥珀さんは愉快そうに笑った。
「―――え？
　琥珀さん、昔からここで働いてたの……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. Someone told me I might have had an older brother. I’m not sure I can trust my memory.”
“You and Miss Akiha are the only two siblings, Master Shiki. I have worked in this mansion since childhood, so you may take my word for it.”
Kohaku laughed cheerfully.
“What? Kohaku, you worked here back then?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
I just heard something about me maybe having a brother, and I wasn't really sure."
"You and Akiha-sama are the only two siblings.
I have worked in this mansion since I was a child, so it can't be a mistake."
She smiles happily.
"---Eh?
Kohaku-san, you've been working here since back then……!?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
見習としてですけど、翡翠ちゃんと一緒にお屋敷のほうでお手伝いをさせていただいていたんです。
何分昔のことですから、志貴さんが覚えてらっしゃらないのは当然だと思いますよ」
　昔を懐かしんでいるのか、琥珀さんは笑顔のまま居間に戻っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Hisui and I were only apprentices, but we both helped around the mansion. It was so long ago that it is perfectly natural you would not remember us, Master Shiki.”
Perhaps reminiscing about those days, Kohaku returned to the sitting room still smiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
We were just apprentices, but Hisui-chan and I would help around the mansion.
It did happen a long time ago, so it is natural that you do not remember."
Is she getting nostalgic?
She continues to smile as she heads back to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　結局、アイツの言っていた事はなんだったんだろう。
「―――まあ、今になっちゃどうでもいい問題か」
　呟いて、夕食を作ってもらうために居間へと足を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
What had that man’s story been about, then?
“Well, I suppose it doesn’t matter anymore.”
Muttering to myself, I headed for the sitting room to have dinner made.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Just what was he saying?
"---I guess it doesn't matter anymore."
Muttering to myself, I walk towards the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
……夜になって、ベッドに横になる。
　シーツをかぶって、ぼんやりと天井を見上げる。
――――終わった。
　傷や思い出とかは残ったままだけど、とにかく、これで終わったんだ。
　これからは普通の学生として、今までどおり平穏に生きていける。
　殺したり殺されたりするのは、いい加減もうこりごりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Later that night, I lay in bed beneath the sheet.
I stared vacantly at the ceiling.
――――It was over.
The wounds and memories remained, but it was over.
From now on I could return to my quiet life as an ordinary student.
I had had more than enough of killing and being killed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I lie down in bed.
Pulling the sheets over me, I stare blankly at the ceiling.
----It's over.
I still have my wounds and my memories, but it's all over.
Now I can return to my peaceful life as a high school student.
No need to think about killing or being killed anymore.

entries.japanese:
忘れよう。
　みんな忘れて、また明日から―――
「っ―――――」
　……わけがない。
　忘れられるわけがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I would forget.
Forget all of it, and starting tomorrow—
“—”
As if I could.
There was no way I could forget.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Just forget.
Forget about everything, and from tomorrow----
"------"
…… I can't.

There's no way I can forget.

entries.japanese:
「く――――そ」
　でも、こればっかりはどうしようもない。
　初めから、俺と先輩は住む世界が違ったんだから。
「………………」
　……眠ろう。
　明日になれば、きっと諦めがついてくれる。
　いまは眠って、気持ちを落ち着かせないといけない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it.”
But there was nothing I could do.
Ciel and I had belonged to different worlds from the beginning.
“…”
I should sleep.
By morning, perhaps I would be able to accept it.
For now I had to sleep and let my heart settle—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn----it."
But, I can't do anything about it.
