"That's fine, but…… did that person really look like me?
That weird person?"
"Well, I'm not too sure.
It was dark, and far away……… huh?"
Yeah, it was far and I couldn't make out her face.
So why did I think it looked like Senpai……?

entries.japanese:
「……なんだかなぁ。
やっぱりどうかしてたのかもしんない」
　うーん、と腕をくんでうなだれる。
　と、門限十分前の予鈴が鳴り響いた。
「―――やばっ、遅刻する。
それじゃ先輩、またあとで！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What was I thinking? Maybe I really was out of my mind.”
I fold my arms, groan, and hang my head.
Just then, the ten-minute warning bell rings.
“Oh, hell—we’re going to be late. See you later, Ciel!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm… Maybe there is something wrong with me."
I cross my arms and think.

Then, the ten minute bell rings.
"---Crap, we'll be late.
Bye, Senpai, see you later!"

entries.japanese:
教室に駆け込む。
　ホームルーム五分前、教室の中は未だにがやがやと騒がしい。
「有彦は来てない、か」
　まあ、あいつの事だから二時間目あたりからやってくるに違いない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I race into the classroom.
Five minutes before homeroom, it is still buzzing with noise.
“Arihiko isn’t here.”
Knowing him, he will probably wander in around second period.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I dash into my classroom.
It's still five minutes before class, so it's very noisy inside.
"Arihiko, isn't here."
Knowing him, he'll probably come in around second period.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになった。
　有彦は休みらしい。
　……今日の欠席者は乾有彦と弓塚さつきの二人だ。
弓塚さつきのほうは風邪をこじらせたとかでここのところずっと欠席している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunch break arrives.
Apparently Arihiko is absent today.
The class has two absentees: Arihiko Inui and Satsuki Yumizuka. Yumizuka has been away for some time, supposedly because her cold took a turn for the worse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Lunch time.
It looks like Arihiko's not coming.
…… Inui Arihiko and Yumizuka Satsuki are the two people absent today.
Yumizuka Satsuki has caught a cold or something and she will be absent for a while.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩も来そうにないし、一人でメシにするか」
　ぼんやりと呟いてみたが、食欲はまったくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel doesn’t look likely to come, so I guess I’ll eat alone.”
I murmur the words absently, although I have no appetite at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai doesn't seem to be coming either, so I guess I'll eat by myself."
I say that, but I'm not hungry.

entries.japanese:
……なんだろう。
　朝から調子は悪かったけど、学校に来てから余計に気持ちが悪くなった気がする。
　それも体の重さだけじゃない。
胸の古傷がチリチリして、痒いような煩わしいような、そんな感覚がしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
What is this?
I already felt ill this morning, but coming to school seems to have made it worse.
Nor is it only the heaviness in my body. The old scar on my chest prickles—an itching, nagging sensation that will not leave me alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What is it?
I didn't feel so good to begin with, but after coming to school, I feel a lot worse.
It's not just my body feeling heavy.
The scar on my chest is irritating; it's an annoying sensation.

entries.japanese:
「……学校、休んだほうが良かったかな」
　……一瞬だけ翡翠と秋葉の不安そうな顔が浮かんだ。
　せめて今夜だけは休んでほしい、という秋葉の願いを無視してアルクェイドに会いに行ったのが響いているのか。
　ただ座っているだけで疲れてしまって、俺はよく解らない違和感にさいなまれてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe I should’ve stayed home.”
For an instant I see Hisui’s and Akiha’s anxious faces.
Perhaps this is the price of ignoring Akiha’s plea that I rest for one night and going out to meet Arcueid.
Simply sitting here exhausts me, while some nameless wrongness keeps gnawing at my senses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe I shouldn't have come to school."
…… For a brief moment, I see the worrying faces of Hisui and Akiha in my mind.
Maybe the fact that I ignored Akiha's wishes for me to rest last night and instead went to see Arcueid might've caused this.
Being worn out by just sitting, I start to feel a strange uneasiness.

entries.japanese:
……授業が始まっている。
　なんの授業だったか。
今日の五時限目の科目が思い出せない。
　黒板を見ても、教師が刻んでいるチョークの跡を見ても、どうしても何の授業なのか。
　俺には、読み取れない。
　文字が、水に流される絵の具のように、ぐちゃぐちゃに混ざっていくような、錯覚。
「うっ…………」
　吐き気が、する。
　眩り、と。
意識が病んでいくような、傾斜。
entries.maoEnglish:
Class has begun.
What class is it? I cannot remember what subject we have for fifth period today.
I look at the blackboard and at the chalk marks the teacher is carving across it, but I still cannot tell what lesson this is.
I cannot read them.
The letters seem to run together like paint washed through water, dissolving into a shapeless smear.
“Ugh…”
Nausea rises.
The world lurches. My consciousness itself seems to tilt into sickness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Class has started already.
Which class was it?
I can't remember today's fifth period lesson.
Even though I look at the blackboard and stare at the marks left behind by the teacher's chalk, I still don't know what class this is.
I can't read it.
The letters start to flow like water and mix together like some sort of hallucination.
"Ugh…………"
I feel like I'm going to throw up.
Dizziness.
My mind starts to slide away.

entries.japanese:
キチキチ。
　　　カタカタ。
　　　　　ギシギシ。
　　　　　　　ガクガク。
entries.maoEnglish:
Click, click.
     Clatter.
          Creak.
               Rattle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Click, click.
Tremble, tremble.
Creak, creak.
Wobble, wobble.

entries.japanese:
そんな音が、爪弾かれていく。
　違和感。
　その齟齬は、どこからくるのか。
　体中に違和感があって落ち着かない。
　キチキチと歪んでいく。
　まるで骨という骨の接合部分が微妙にズレているみたいだ。
　そう、接合の部分がズレているから無理が生じる。
遠野志貴の躯は、目に見えない煙を吐き出していて、今にもガラガラと崩れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Those sounds are plucked one after another.
Wrongness.
Where does the misalignment begin?
Nothing in my body sits right.
I cannot be still.
Everything twists with tiny clicks, as though every joint between every bone has slipped slightly out of place.
Yes—the strain comes from those misaligned joints. Shiki Tohno’s body is venting invisible smoke, ready to collapse into pieces at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Those noises stick out.

Incompatibility.
Where is that inconsistency coming from?
I can't settle this feeling of something being out of place throughout my body.
It fills me to the brim.
As if my bones are sliding out of place in their joints.
Yes, since my joints are out of place, it causes this unnatural feeling.
My corpse is burning unseen smoke and crumbling away.

entries.japanese:
キチキチ。
カタカタ。
ギチギチ。
ガチガチ。
entries.maoEnglish: Click, click. Clatter. Grind. Chatter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Click, click.
Tremble, tremble.
Creak, creak.
Wobble, wobble.

entries.japanese:
ガタン、と椅子から落ちた。
　キャア、という女生徒の声があがる。
　教師がかけよってくる足音が聞こえる。
　俺は。
　完全に気を失ってしまっているのに、どこか離れた所で、冷静に自分が倒れこむ場面を眺めていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The chair crashes beneath me.
A girl screams.
I hear the teacher running over.
As for me.
Though I have already lost consciousness completely, from somewhere far away I calmly watch myself fall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fall from my chair.
A girl screams.
I hear the footsteps of the teacher running to me.
I.
Even though I've completely passed out, I calmly watch myself from far away.

entries.japanese:
……その後はお決まりの展開だった。
　貧血で気を失った俺は保健室に運ばれて、体調が良くなるまでベッドで眠る事になった。
　夜の七時過ぎ、学校の門限がすぎてもまだ熱が三十八度近くあるため、保険医は遠野の家に誰か迎えに来るように連絡して帰ってしまった。
　で、その結果が。
entries.maoEnglish:
What followed was predictable.
After fainting from anemia, I was carried to the infirmary and put to bed until I recovered.
Past seven that evening, after the school’s closing time, my fever was still nearly thirty-eight degrees; the nurse called the Tohno residence for someone to collect me, then went home.
And the result.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What follows is like always.
Collapsed from my anemia, I was carried to the clinic where I slept until I recovered.
Since I had a fever of over 38 degrees Celsius past seven o'clock, the school's closing time, the nurse called my house for someone to pick me up and went home.
And this resulted in…

entries.japanese:
「あっ、大丈夫ですか志貴さん？
　まだ熱があるんですから、遠慮なさらずにわたしの肩につかまってくださいな」
―――まあ、こういう事である。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, are you all right, Master Shiki? You still have a fever, so please don’t be shy—hold on to my shoulder.”
―――Well—there you have it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Are you okay Shiki-san?
You still have a fever, so please do not hesitate to lean on my shoulder."
---Yeah, that's how it is.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、大丈夫です。
歩くぐらいはできるから、気を遣わないでください」
　琥珀さんから離れて、精一杯の強がりを口にした。
　……まったく。
琥珀さんに迎えに来てもらっただけでも恥ずかしいのに、その上肩まで貸してもらった日には情けなくて死にたくなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I’m fine. I can at least walk, so please don’t trouble yourself.”
I draw away from Kohaku and muster all the bravado I have.
Having her come to fetch me is embarrassing enough. If I make her support me too, I may die of humiliation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, I'm alright.
I can at least walk, so please don't worry."
Stepping away from Kohaku-san, I attempt to bluff my way out of it.
…… Geez.
It's embarrassing enough for Kohaku-san to come pick me up.
The day I lean on her shoulders, I'll die.

entries.japanese:
「もう、だめですよ無理をしちゃ。
志貴さんのお体が弱いのは志貴さんのせいじゃないんですから、少しぐらい甘えていいんです。
　秋葉さまや翡翠ちゃんには黙っていてあげますから、今ぐらいはわたしに頼っていいんですよ」
　琥珀さんは優しい笑顔のまま、俺の手を握ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, now, you mustn’t push yourself, Master Shiki. It isn’t your fault that your health is delicate, so you may lean on someone once in a while.
I won’t tell Miss Akiha or Hisui, so just for now, you can rely on me.”
Still smiling gently, Kohaku takes my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh that's not good, forcing yourself like that.
It isn't your fault that your body is weak, Shiki-san.
So you can ask for help a little.
I won't tell Akiha-sama or Hisui-chan, so it's okay to depend on me for now."
With a gentle smile, she takes my hand.

entries.japanese:
「あ……はい、すみません」
　ぼっ、と顔が赤くなるのを意識しながら、素直に琥珀さんの言葉に従った。
　……たしかに、これ以上意地を張るとまた倒れかねない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, sorry.”
Conscious of my face blazing red, I meekly obey her.
She is right: if I keep being stubborn, I may collapse again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… yes, sorry."
Blushing furiously, I meekly do as she says.
…… Certainly I might collapse if I continue to be stubborn.

entries.japanese:
「外にお車を待たせてありますから、そこまで頑張ってくださいね」
　俺の手を引いて、琥珀さんは歩き始める。
「あ――――」
　……まずい。
歩くだけで眩暈がする。
　朦朧とした意識のまま、琥珀さんに任せて昇降口に向かって歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The car is waiting outside, so hold on until we reach it.”
Holding my hand, Kohaku begins to walk.
“Ah――――”
This is bad. Walking alone is enough to make the world spin.
Barely conscious, I entrust myself to Kohaku and start toward the entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There is a car waiting outside, so please hold on until then."
Pulling my hand, Kohaku-san starts to walk.
"Ah----"
…… This isn't good.
Just walking makes me incredibly dizzy.
I depend upon Kohaku-san to lead me to the stairwell as I hold onto my consciousness.

entries.japanese:
あ――――れ？
　なんで―――一階から、二階になんて、あがっているんだろう、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wha—at?
Why am I climbing from the first floor to the second?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hu----h?
Why---am I going up, to, the second, floor?

entries.japanese:
「あの……琥珀さん、こっちは、違う」
　声をかける。
　返事はない。
いや、そればかりか―――琥珀さんの手の感触も、琥珀さんの姿さえ、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku, this is the wrong way…”
I call to her.
No answer comes. Worse, I can no longer feel her hand or even see her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Kohaku-san, this, isn't, the right way."
I call out to her.
There's no response.
No, not only that---I don't feel her hand, or even see her.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀……さん？」
　定まらない意識を総動員してあたりを見渡す。
　廊下には誰もいない。
　ただ、窓から差しこんでくる月明かりだけが、鮮明だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku…?”
I marshal my wavering senses and look around.
The corridor is deserted.
Only the moonlight pouring through the windows remains sharply distinct.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku…… san?"
I use all of my foggy consciousness to look around me.
There's no one in the hallway.
Only the moonlight streaming from the window is vivid.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　それは、唐突にやってきた。
「あ――――――」
　どくん、と高鳴る鼓動。
　背骨にむかって、縦に、ノコギリをひかれるような寒気。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
It comes without warning.
“Ah――――――”
My heart slams once.
A chill saws vertically up my spine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
It comes suddenly.
"Ah------"
The sound of my heartbeat.
And a chill that races up my spine.

entries.japanese:
どくん。
かつん。
　どくん。
かつん。
　どくん。
かつん。
　どくん。
かつん。
どくん。
かつん。
どくん。
かつん。
かつん。
かつん。
かつん。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Click.
Thump. Click.
Thump. Click.
Thump. Click. Thump. Click. Thump. Click. Click. Click. Click.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Tap.

Thump.
Tap.
Thump.
Tap.
Thump.
Tap.
Thump.
Tap.
Thump.
Tap.
Tap.
Tap.
Tap.
Tap.

entries.japanese:
暗い闇の中、足音が近づいてくる。
―――それは。
　あの時に感じた怖れに類似していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Footsteps approach through the darkness.
―――It is.
—like the terror I felt that night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the darkness, the footsteps draw closer.
---This is…
This is similar to the fear I felt that one time.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀、さん……！」
　名前を呼ぶ。
助けを呼ぶためじゃない。
さっきまで一緒にいてくれた琥珀さんが逃げられるように、必死に名前を呼んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku…!”
I call her name. Not to summon help. I call desperately so Kohaku, who was beside me moments ago, can escape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku, san……!"
I call her name.
Not to call for help, but to tell her to escape, I frantically call her name.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さん、琥珀さん、琥珀さん……！」
　何処にいるのか、俺の目では見つけられない。
　かつん、と足音はもう間近に迫ってきている。
　だから、せめて。
　琥珀さんだけでも、無事にここから逃げ出してほしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku, Kohaku, Kohaku…!”
My eyes cannot find her anywhere.
Click—the footsteps are almost upon me.
At least…
I want Kohaku to escape this place alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku-san, Kohaku-san, Kohaku-san……!"
Where is she?
I don't see her anywhere.
The footsteps are near me now.
So, at least.
I want Kohaku-san to escape here unharmed.

entries.japanese:
「無駄だよ志貴。
そいつは、ついさっき用済みになった」
　……声が聞こえる。
　目の前の闇。
そこにいるのは
　あの夜、俺を殺そうとした包帯の男だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s no use, Shiki. I stopped needing her a moment ago.”
I hear a voice.
In the darkness before me. Standing there is
—the bandaged man who tried to kill me that night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's useless, Shiki.
She's already finished."
…… I hear a voice.
In the darkness in front of me,
the bandaged man who tried to kill me that night.

entries.japanese:
「―――――あ」
　……どうしてだろう。
　俺は、コイツの顔を、よく知っている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Ah.”
Why?
I feel as though I know this man’s face intimately.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Ah."
…… Why is it?
I feel like I know this person's face.

entries.japanese:
「よくよく運がないんだなおまえは。
こんな事なら、屋敷の前で待ち構える必要なぞなかったか」
　……足音が近づいてくる。
「くっ…………あ」
　体を動かそうとする。
　だが足はずるずると動くだけだ。
　連日の無理が祟ったのか。
俺の体は、最後の最後で、故障してしまったようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You truly are cursed with rotten luck. Had I known this would happen, I needn’t have waited outside your mansion.”
The footsteps draw closer.
“Ghh—ah.”
I try to move.
But my feet only drag uselessly.
Perhaps all these days of strain have taken their toll. At the very end, my body has finally broken down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You sure aren't lucky.
If I knew it was like this, I wouldn't have waited for you in front of the mansion."
…… The footsteps draw closer.
"Ka………… aah."
I try to move.
But I can only totter along.
I guess I pushed my body too hard every day.
It seems like my body, at the very last moment, broke down.

entries.japanese:
「最後に教えてやるよ。
ココが、今のオレの根城なのさ」
　トス、という音がした。
　男の手にはナイフ。
銀色の刃物は、俺の心臓を確実に貫いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll tell you one last thing. This place is my lair now.”
There is a soft sound.
A knife is in the man’s hand. Its silver blade is driven unerringly through my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is the end, so I'll tell you.
This is my lair now."
I hear a stabbing sound.
In his hands, a knife.
The silver blade pierces directly into my heart.

entries.japanese:
―――ダン、と倒れこむ。
　身体は指先から死んでいく。
　意識が葡萄のように一つ一つ潰れていって、やがて枝だけの残骸になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I hit the floor with a thud.
My body dies inward from the fingertips.
One by one, the grapes of my consciousness are crushed until only the stripped branch remains.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I collapse to the ground.
I feel death working its way from my very fingertips.
My mind fades away, drop by drop.

entries.japanese:
その過程。
　ぷつぷつと消えていく理性の束の中で、網膜は空を見ていた。
　他に見るべき場所がなかったから、そこだけを見ていた。
　夜空には青い月。
　……なんていう間抜けさだ。
　死にいく直前だっていうのに、俺は。
　その、なんの変哲もないモノに惚れ惚れした。
entries.maoEnglish:
During that process.
As the threads of reason wink out one after another, my eyes remain fixed on the sky.
There is nowhere else left to look.
A blue moon hangs in the night.
How stupid.
Even as I am dying.
I find myself enchanted by that perfectly ordinary thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In that process.
With my fading mind, I look up at the sky.
I have nowhere else to look, so I just look there.
The blue moon is in the night sky.
…… How stupid.
I'm about to die, but I…
I am charmed by such an ordinary thing.

entries.japanese:
あれは、いつの記憶だっただろう。
　黒いヴェールのような森の中で。
　遠い日の凶った夜。
　こんなふうに、月だけを、見上げていた―――
entries.maoEnglish:
When was that memory from?
In a forest like a black veil.
On a distant, accursed night.
I had looked up at nothing but the moon―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
When is this memory from?
In a forest like a black veil.
On that terrible night.
Just like this, I was staring only at the moon---

entries.japanese:
こんにちは！
　右も左も解らないままデッドエンドを迎えてしまった迷子の遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“おしえて！
知得留先生！
”の時間です。
　……ははあ。
　やってきてしまいましたね、この五時間目に。
　わりかしこっち側に落ちてしまう遠野くんは多いと思います。
　ま、天罰ですね。
　あんな女に関わった己の不徳を悔やみなさい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hello!
Welcome to Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for our lost little Tohno,
who wandered into a dead end without ever finding his bearings.
I see.
So you’ve made it to lesson five.
Quite a few Tohnos probably fall into this one.
Divine punishment, I suppose.
Repent your poor judgment in ever getting involved with that woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hello!
The hint corner for the poor lost Tohno-kun who ended up in a Dead End without knowing his left from his right,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
…… I see.
You have come to the fifth period.
I think there are lots of Tohno-kuns who fall into this end.
Well, it is your divine punishment.
Regret your own unluckiness for associating with such a woman.

entries.japanese:
「なんでー？
　シエルもわたしのコト言えないじゃんかー。
シエルなんか、はじめっから○○が目的でやってきた――――」
entries.maoEnglish: “Why? You’re hardly one to talk, Ciel. You came here from the very beginning because you wanted [REDACTED]—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why?
You're not one to talk, Ciel.
After all, your goal from the beginning was always **----"

entries.japanese:
――――さて。
　本来ならこればっかりは救罪できませんが、中にはちゃんとあのお天気吸血鬼
　（吸血鬼なのにお天気とはケンカうってます）
　を拒んだにも関わらず来てしまった遠野くんもいるようですから、助け船を出してあげちゃいます。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Now, then.
Normally, this one is beyond even my power to absolve, but some of you may have come here despite properly turning down that sunny little vampire—
(Calling a vampire sunny is practically picking a fight)
—so I’ll throw you a lifeline.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Now then.
Normally there would be no chance of salvation, but some of you came here in spite of rejecting that sunny vampire.
(Sunny even though she's a vampire, I'm picking a fight)
So I'll throw out a lifeboat.

entries.japanese:
このデッドエンドに来てしまった理由は三種類ほどありますが、回避するためには、
　たまには妹さんを安心させてあげたり、
　たまには馬鹿な女のワガママを聞いてあげたり、　不浄な吸血鬼を捜す時は街で一番汚らしい所に行ってみたりする、
　というところです。
entries.maoEnglish:
There are roughly three ways to arrive at this dead end, but to avoid it,
try reassuring your little sister once in a while; indulge that foolish woman’s whims once in a while;
and when you’re hunting a filthy vampire, try the filthiest place in town—
that should do it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There are about three reasons you came to this Dead End, but to avoid it,
You have to reassure your sister sometimes,
you have to indulge a stupid woman's selfishness sometimes, and to find a dirty vampire, try going to a very dirty place.
That's about it.

entries.japanese:
「ねえシエル。
わたし、この字読めないんだけど」
―――却下です。
　……と言いたい所ですが、あんまりにも質問が多かったのでお答えしましょう。
　眩病月、というのは
　眩むのクラ、病みのヤミ、月はツキ。
　三つ合わせてクラヤミヅキ。
暗闇月とかけているんでしょうねー。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Ciel. I can’t read these characters.”
―――Rejected.
Or so I’d like to say, but so many people have asked that I’ll answer.
The Japanese title behind Blackout Moon uses three readings
kura from kuramu, to black out; yami from yamu, to fall ill; and tsuki, moon.
Together they form Kurayamizuki. It is a pun on kurayami, darkness, and tsuki, moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Ciel.
I don't get this."
---Question denied.
…… Or so I'd like to say, but there seemed to be many questions on this, so I will answer it.
DNM is…
D is for "dizzy", N for "not healthy", M for "moon".
It has the same initials as "Dark Night Moon", it's a small play on words.

entries.japanese:
「へえー、ヘンなのー」
（……くっ、このちょこまかと……）
　それでは今回の授業はここまで。
　みなさん、日本語は正しく使いましょうね！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh, that’s weird.”
(This fidgety little—)
That’s all for today’s lesson.
Remember, everyone: treat the English language with care!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, that's weird."
(…… Why, that little……)
Well, this ends the lesson this time.
Everyone, please remember to use proper Japanese!

entries.japanese:
「――――――！」
　バッ、とシーツをはいでベッドから飛び起きた。
　上半身がバネじかけのカラクリにでもなったみたいに、勢いよく体が起きる。
「な―――――」
　額に浮かぶ汗をぬぐう。
　なにか酷い夢で見たのか、体中がべっとりと汗をかいていた。
　特別うなされるような夢をみた覚えはない。
　……眠る前に見ていた本の影響だろうか。
　少しはイヤなものを見たような気がするけれど思い出せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I fling off the sheet and bolt upright. My upper body snaps up like a spring-loaded automaton.
“Wha—”
I wipe the sweat from my brow.
Whatever I dreamed must have been terrible; my whole body is drenched.
Yet I don’t remember anything nightmarish enough to leave me like this.
Maybe it was the book I read before bed.
I have a vague sense that I saw something unpleasant, but I can’t recall it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
I wake up with a start and kick off my sheets, sitting up in bed.
"Wha-----"
I wipe the sweat rolling down my face.
Maybe I saw a bad dream.
I am drenched in sweat.
I don't remember seeing a nightmare.
…… Was it because of that book I read?
I think I saw something a little bad, but I don't remember what it was.

entries.japanese:
……まあ、夢は忘れ去られる運命にある、って有名な博士も言っていることだし、そう躍起になって思い出そうとする事もないだろう。
―――コンコン。
　控えめなノックの音。
「――おはようごさいます、志貴さま」
「ん、おはよう」
　挨拶を返してベッドから立ちあがる。
　翡翠は手に持った着替えの制服を机の上に置いて、しずしずとドアのほうへ戻っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Some famous doctor said dreams are destined to be forgotten, so there is no point straining myself to remember.
―――Knock, knock.
A quiet, diffident knock at the door.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Mm—morning.”
I return the greeting and climb out of bed.
Hisui lays the clean uniform in her hands on the desk, then glides quietly back toward the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, a famous doctor did say it is the nature of dreams to fade away, so I shouldn't try so hard to try to remember it.
---Knock-knock.
A polite knock sounds.
"--Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"Mm, morning."
I return her greeting and stand up.
Hisui places the uniform in her hand onto the desk and shuffles quietly back towards the door.

entries.japanese:
「それでは、着替えが済みしだい食堂のほうへおいだください」
「ああ。
いつもすまないね」
　はい、と返事をして翡翠は部屋から出ていく。
「…………あれ」
　翡翠の顔を見て一息ついたせいか、さっきまで何を考えていたか忘れてしまった。
「……まいったな。
こんなに忘れっぽかったかな、俺って」
　自分自身に首をかしげながら制服に着替える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please come to the dining room once you have dressed.”
“I will. Thanks, as always.”
With a soft acknowledgment, Hisui leaves the room.
“Huh?”
Perhaps seeing Hisui let me relax, because I’ve forgotten what I was thinking about moments ago.
“This is bad. Was I always this forgetful?”
Puzzling over myself, I change into my uniform.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please head to the dining room once you are finished changing."
"Yeah.
Thanks as always."
After giving an affirmative answer, Hisui exits the room.
"………… Huh?"
After seeing her face I completely forgot what it was I was thinking about.
"…… Geez.
Was I always this forgetful?"
Tilting my head in curiosity over myself, I change into the uniform.

entries.japanese:
机の上にはナイフがある。
　ここ数日、いつもポケットに忍ばせていた父の形見だという短刀。
―――それも、もう使う事はないだろう。
「………そっか。
もう、いないんだ」
　アルクェイドもシエル先輩も。
　ネロというケモノの群れも、ロアっていう吸血鬼も。
　みんな、いっしょくたになって何処かに行ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The knife lies on the desk.
It is the short blade said to be my father’s keepsake, which I’ve carried in my pocket for the past several days.
―――I probably won’t need it again.
“Right. They’re gone now.”
Arcueid and Ciel.
The swarm of beasts called Nrvnqsr, and the vampire called Roa.
The whole lot of them have vanished somewhere together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The knife is on my desk.
The knife from my adopted father that I have always been carrying in my pocket these past few days.
---I probably won't have to use that anymore.
"…… That's right.
They're gone."
Arcueid, Ciel-senpai.
The horde of beasts called Nrvnqsr, and the vampire called Roa.
All of them are no longer here.

entries.japanese:
「忘れたものは、案外それかもな」
　学校に行っても何があるわけでもない。
　先輩がいないのなら―――別段楽しいという場所ではないだろう。
　けど、それが今までの遠野志貴の日常だった。
　俺は新しく得たものを無くしただけ。
　もとからあったものは、ちゃんと全てありのままで残っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe that’s what I forgot.”
There’s nothing special waiting for me at school.
Without Ciel there, it won’t be a particularly enjoyable place.
But it is the ordinary life Shiki Tohno has always lived.
I only lost what I had newly gained.
Everything that was mine from the beginning remains exactly as it was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Maybe what I forgot was something about that."
There isn't anything waiting for me at school.
Senpai is gone---so it probably won't be fun anymore.
But, that was how I lived my days up until now.
I only lost something that I gained recently.
Everything I had before then still remains.

entries.japanese:
「―――――はあ」
　そう思えば、先輩がいなくなってもやっていける。
　忘れられないけど、やっていける。
　そう自分を誤魔化して、ドアを開けた。
　さあ。
　今まで通り、元気に学校に行くとしよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Haa.”
If I think of it that way, I can go on without Ciel.
I can’t forget her, but I can go on.
With that lie to myself, I open the door.
All right.
Time to go to school, bright and cheerful as ever—
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----*sigh*
If I think about it that way, I can manage without Senpai.
I could never forget her, but I could manage.
Fooling myself with that, I open the door.
Then,
let's go to school like I've always been doing---

entries.japanese:
七時五十分。
　正門の前は登校する生徒たちの姿であふれかえっている。
　今日が土曜日というコトもあってか、みんなたいていは明るい顔つきで登校してきていた。
「………………」
　その中を、一人陰鬱とした顔をして歩いていく。
　やっぱり、どんなに自分を鼓舞したところで先輩がいないっていう事実が、重く肩にのしかかってしま――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Seven fifty.
The front gate is overflowing with students on their way to class.
Perhaps because it’s Saturday, most of them arrive looking cheerful.
“…”
I walk among them with the only gloomy face in sight. No matter how fiercely I try to encourage myself, Ciel’s absence still bears down on my shoulders――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's seven-fifty.
The gate at the front of the school is crowded with students.
Since it's Saturday, there are bright faces everywhere.
"………………"
I wade through the sea of sunny faces as a cloud of gloom.
No matter what I tell myself, the fact that Senpai is gone weighs heavily on my----

entries.japanese:
「――――――え？」
　一瞬、我が目を疑ったけど、間違いない。
　目の前に、シエル先輩がひょこひょこと歩いて登校している。
「せ、先輩―――！？」
　思わず声をあげると、先輩はこっちに振りかえった。
「あ、遠野くん。
おはようごさいます」
　ぺこり、と先輩はおじぎをしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――What?”
For a moment I doubt my own eyes, but there is no mistake.
Ciel is right ahead of me, trotting cheerfully toward school.
“C-Ciel—!?”
At my involuntary shout, she turns.
“Oh, Tohno. Good morning.”
Ciel gives me a neat little bow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Eh?"
I can't believe my eyes for a moment, but there's no doubt.
Ciel-senpai is walking towards the school.
"Se, Senpai---!?"
I shout her name without even thinking and she turns towards me.
"Oh, Tohno-kun.
Good morning."
She gives me a bow.

entries.japanese:
「おはようごさいますって、先輩帰ったんじゃなかったのか……！？」
「いいえ。
わたしが遠野くんを置いて帰るわけないじゃないですか」
　淡い笑顔で、先輩はそう言った。
　遠野くんを置いて帰るわけが、ない。
　まわりには登校中の生徒たちがうようよしているっていうのに、ぼっ、と自分の顔が熱くなるのを実感する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning—weren’t you supposed to have gone home, Ciel!?”
“No. As if I could leave you behind and go home.”
Ciel says it with a faint smile.
There was no way she could leave me behind and go home.
Even with students swarming all around us, I feel my face burst into flame.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning?
Didn't you go back……!?"
"No.
I would never go back leaving you here."
She speaks with a brilliant smile.
Never go back leaving me here?
Even though there are students all around me, I feel myself blush furiously.

entries.japanese:
「――――えっと、それは」
「はい、なんですか？」
「その、言葉通りの意味として、受け取っていい、んでしょうか」
「はい、遠野くんの想像にお任せします」
　先輩は曇りのない笑顔で頷く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um—does that mean—”
“Yes—what is it?”
“Can I take that exactly the way it sounds?”
“I’ll leave that to your imagination, Tohno.”
Ciel nods, her smile perfectly unclouded.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Um, that is……"
"Yes, what is it?"
"Can I, take those words, for what they sound like?"
"Yes, I leave it up to your imagination, Tohno-kun."
She nods and gives a radiant smile.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――！」
　息がつまる。
　それはもちろん、今まで感じてきた緊張からくる苦しさじゃなくて、あんまりにも嬉しくて胸が熱くなっているからだ。
　もし周りに誰もいなかったら、やったあ、なんて大声で叫び出しているぐらい、どうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My breath catches.
Not from the strain and tension I’ve suffered until now, but because I’m so happy my chest has gone hot.
If no one else were here, I’d be deranged enough to shout with joy at the top of my lungs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------!"
I can't breathe.
Not because of the pained tension I had felt up until now, but because of the burning happiness that now wells up inside of me.
If no one was around, I'd shout out "Alright!" at the top of my lungs.

entries.japanese:
「先輩！」
　がしっ、と先輩の手を握る。
「それじゃあ、もう本当にどこにも行かないんだな！？
　ずっと、このまま学校にいるんだな！？」
「あのですね、ずっと学校にいたらおばあさんになっちゃいます。
わたしは三年生なんですから、あと四ヶ月で卒業ですよ」
「でも、ちゃんと残ってくれるんだろ？
　昨日みたいにいきなり帰るなんていうコトはないんだよな？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
I seize her hand.
“Then you really aren’t going anywhere!? You’re staying here at school!?”
“Honestly, if I stayed at school forever, I’d become an old woman. I’m a third-year; I graduate in four months.”
“But you’re really staying, right? You won’t suddenly leave again like yesterday?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai!"
I grab her hand.
"So, you mean you won't go anywhere, right!?
You'll stay here at school forever, right!?"
"Um, if I stay at school forever, I'll become an old lady.
I am a third-year student, so I have four months left until graduation."
"But, you'll stay here, right?
You won't leave like you said yesterday, right?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
こうなったら最後までお付き合いします」
「いやったあーーっ！」
　手を離して、なんとか体中の力を堪える。
　とにかく、いますぐグランドを何周も走りたい気分だった。
　まるで宝くじで一等が当たった時みたいに、気分がハイになっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Now that it’s come to this, I’ll see it through with you.” “Yeeeees!”
I release her hand and somehow restrain the force surging through my whole body.
I feel like running lap after lap around the athletic field.
I’m as giddy as if I’d won first prize in the lottery.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I'll stay till the end now."
"Alright--!"
I let go of her and manage to stop myself.
I want to run around the ground for many laps.
As if I won a lottery, I'm feeling really high.

entries.japanese:
いやいや、そんなものが当たるより今はもっと、何倍も何倍も笑い出したい気分だ。
　もう、こうしてジッとしているのが我慢できないぐらい、どうかしてる。
「遠野くん、そろそろ行かないと遅刻しちゃいます」
「――――あ、そうだね。
それじゃ先輩、また休み時間に！」
　先輩に手をふって、先に校舎に向かう。
　俺は独りでにやけながら、教室まで全力で走り出していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
No, forget the lottery—I want to laugh many times harder than any prize could ever make me.
I’m so beside myself I can barely stand still.
“Tohno, we’d better go or we’ll be late.”
“—Oh, right. Then I’ll see you at break, Ciel!”
I wave to Ciel and head into the school ahead of her.
Grinning helplessly to myself, I break into a full sprint for my classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No, this feels far, far greater than that.
I feel like laughing out loud.
I can't even bear to just stand here and do nothing.
"Tohno-kun, you should hurry or you will be late."
"----Oh.
That's right.
Later Senpai!
See you at break!"
Waving a hand to Senpai, I go towards the school building.
Smiling to myself, I run as fast as I can to class.

entries.japanese:
――――一時限目が終わった。
　次の授業まで、十分間だけの休み時間がある。
「―――よし」
　三年のどこかの教室にいる先輩を捜しに行こうと、席を立った矢先。
「あれ、どこかに行っちゃうんですか、遠野くん」
―――先に、先輩がやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――First period ends.
There are only ten minutes before the next class.
“—All right.”
Just as I rise to search the third-year classrooms for Ciel.
“Oh, are you going somewhere, Tohno?”
―――Ciel reaches me first.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----First period is over.
I have ten minutes until next class.
"---Alright."
The instant I raise myself to go look for Senpai's classroom,
"Huh?
Where are you going, Tohno-kun?"
---Senpai comes here ahead of me.

entries.japanese:
「いや、先輩を捜しに行こうかなって。
いつも待ってるばかりだからさ、たまにはこっちから行こうって思ったんだ」
「そうですか。
嬉しいですけど、遠野くんわたしのクラスを知らないでしょ？
　３年のＢクラスですから覚えておいてくださいね」
「へえ―――やっぱりちゃんと授業を受けてたんだ。
感心感心、茶道部の部費でお茶飲んでるだけじゃなかったんだね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was about to come find you. You’re always the one who visits me, so I thought I’d return the favor for once.”
“I see. That makes me happy, but you don’t even know which class I’m in, do you? It’s Class 3-B, so please remember.”
“Huh—so you really do attend lessons. I’m impressed; I thought you only drank tea on the tea ceremony club’s budget.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, nowhere, I was going to see you.
I always wait for you, so I thought I'd go see you this time."
"I see.
That makes me very happy, but you don't know my class, right Tohno-kun?
It's third year class B, please remember it."
"Oh really---so you really do take classes.
Well-done, well-done.
I see you do more than just drink tea in the tea ceremony room."

entries.japanese:
「はい、なんとか授業についていってます――」
「って、遠野くん、わたしのことそういうふうに思ってたんですか！」
「――う」
　思っていなかった、と断言できないところが後ろめたい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, I’m somehow managing to keep up with my classes—”
“Wait—did you really think that was all I did!?”
“—Urk.”
I can’t honestly claim that I didn’t, which leaves me feeling guilty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I do manage to follow classes--"
"Hey, wait a minute Tohno-kun!
You think I'm really like that!?"
"--Uh."
I can't really deny that.

entries.japanese:
「あー、いや、悪かった。
けどさ先輩、茶道部に部員はいないって前に言ってたけど、もしかしてこの学校、初めから茶道部なんてないんじゃない？」
　先輩は突然、口の中に氷を投げ入れられたみたいに、大人しくなってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah, sorry—but you told me before that the tea ceremony club had no members. Don’t tell me this school never had a tea ceremony club at all?”
Ciel abruptly falls silent, as if someone has dropped a piece of ice into her mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, sorry.
But Senpai, you said there were no members of the tea ceremony club, but I thought that it might have never existed in the first place."
Senpai stands there and grows quiet.

entries.japanese:
「……あれ。
もしかして本当にないの？
　あの茶道室って、使われてないただの和室？」
「―――さあ。
わたしにはてんでわからないお話みたいです」
　シエル先輩は窓の外に視線を移して、あからさまに怪しいとぼけかたをする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. Does it really not exist? Is that tea room just an unused Japanese-style room?”
“―――Goodness. I’m afraid I haven’t the faintest idea what you’re talking about.”
Ciel turns to the window in the least convincing display of innocence imaginable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?
Don't tell me there really wasn't?
It's just an unused Japanese-style room?"
"---Hmm.
It seems like I do not understand what you're talking about."
Ciel-senpai turns her gaze out the window and stares blankly.

entries.japanese:
「……いいけど、別に。
どんな悪さをしようたって、先輩は根っからの悪人じゃないからな。
誰にも迷惑をかけてるようなコトはないんだろうけど、先輩の暗示ってそんな事まで出来ちゃうのか？」
「ですから、遠野くんのお話はてんでわからないのでお答えできません」
「―――――」
　机に座ったまま、下からじっとシエル先輩を見つめる。
　沈黙すること、一分弱。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, whatever. No matter what mischief you get up to, you aren’t a bad person at heart. I’m sure you haven’t hurt anyone; can your hypnotic suggestions really do things like that?”
“As I said, Tohno, I have no idea what you’re talking about, so I cannot answer.”
“―――――”
Still seated at my desk, I stare steadily up at Ciel.
The silence lasts nearly a minute.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, that's fine.
No matter what you've done, you're not a bad person.
So I don't think you'll cause anyone trouble, but can your power of suggestion do such a thing?"
"I already told you, I don't know what you mean, so I can't answer that."
"-----"
Still in my seat, I stare up at Ciel-senpai.
The silence lasts for about a minute.

entries.japanese:
「……わりとしつこいんですね、遠野くん」
「別に。
ただ先輩の目って青いんだなって、見てただけ」
「……………」
　はあ、と根負けしたようにため息をつくシエル先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re surprisingly persistent, Tohno.”
“Not really. I was only noticing that your eyes are blue.”
“…”
Ciel finally sighs in surrender.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're pretty persistent, Tohno-kun."
"Not really, I was just thinking how blue your eyes were."
"…………"
Ciel-senpai gives a sigh as if admitting defeat.

entries.japanese:
「言っときますけど、暗示っていうのはそんなに都合のいいものじゃないんです。
　暗示というのは物事の捉え方を変える、のではなく逸らす、というのが大前提なんです。
　ですからわたしが、『遠野くんはカレーが大好き』って言い聞かせても、遠野くん本人がカレーが大嫌いならその暗示は成功しません」
「……そうなの？
　つまり本人が嫌がっている事は暗示にかけられないっていうコト？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“For the record, hypnotic suggestion isn’t nearly that convenient.
Its fundamental principle is not to change how someone perceives something, but to divert that perception.
So if I told you, ‘Tohno loves curry,’ but you truly hated curry, the suggestion wouldn’t take.”
“Really? So you can’t suggest something the person fundamentally rejects?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I said it already, but the power of suggestion isn't that convenient.
Suggestion isn't so much able to change your perceptions of things as it is more like making you look away.
So even if I told you that you really liked curry when you hate it, it would not work."
"…… Really?
So you can't make someone do what they don't want to?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
まあ、それでも遠野くんにカレーを食べさせる方法はいくらでもありますけど。
　例えば、大好きだから食べる、というのではなく、食べなければ死んでしまう、という暗示をかければ――」
「なるほど、大嫌いでも食べるしかないな。
……なんだ、やっぱりなんでも出来るじゃないか、それ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right. Although there are any number of ways I could still make you eat curry.
Instead of suggesting that you eat it because you love it, I could suggest that you’ll die unless you do—”
“I see. Then I’d have no choice even if I hated it, so it can do anything after all.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Well, there's still many ways to make you eat curry, Tohno-kun.
For example, I wouldn't tell you that you really like curry.
Instead, I could tell you that you would die if you didn't eat curry--"
"I get it, I would eat it even if I hate it.
…… I see, then you can do anything with that."

entries.japanese:
「いえ、そういった意味の挿げ替えはとても難しいですから、よっぽど舞台を整えてやらないとかかってくれません。
　暗示にかかりにくい人も大勢いますし、わたしに出来ることなんて『わたしを疑問に思わない』っていう暗示ぐらいです」
　……ああ、それは前にアルクェイドも言っていたっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—substituting one meaning for another is so difficult that it will not work unless the circumstances are very carefully prepared.
Many people are resistant to suggestion as well, and about all I can manage is making people never question my presence.”
Right—Arcueid told me that before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it is really difficult to set the stage for such a thing as the resistance would be great.
There are many people that are difficult to forcibly use suggestion against, so all I can do is to suggest something like, 'Do not doubt what I say.'"
…… Yeah, Arcueid said something like that too.

entries.japanese:
「―――なるほどね。
ところで先輩」
「はい？
　なんですか、あらたまって」
「うん。
先輩、なんかカレーにこだわるけど。
もしかして、好きなの？」
　シエル先輩は笑ったまま答えない。
　なんとも微妙な表情で、否定しているのか肯定しているのか判別不可能だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I see. By the way, Ciel.”
“Yes? Why so solemn all of a sudden?”
“Well. You keep using curry as your example. Do you happen to like it?”
Ciel keeps smiling and says nothing.
Her expression is so delicately poised between denial and admission that I can’t tell which it is.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
By the way, Senpai."
"Yes?
What is it?"
"Yeah.
Senpai, you really love curry, don't you?"
Ciel-senpai just smiles and does not answer.
Her slight expression makes it impossible for me to see if she is denying it or affirming it.

entries.japanese:
「っと、そろそろ時間ですね。
また放課後に来ますけど、遠野くん体のほうは大丈夫ですか？
　両腕、ちゃんと動いてます？」
「ああ、もう痛みもないよ。
こうして学校に来れるのは先輩のおかげです」
　感謝、と手を合わせて拝んだりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, it's nearly time. I'll come back after school, but how are you feeling, Tohno? Can you move both arms properly?”
“Yes, they don't even hurt anymore. You're the reason I was able to come to school today.”
I press my palms together and bow to her in mock worship.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, it is about time.
I'll see you again after classes are over, but is your body okay, Tohno-kun?
Your arms are working fine?"
"Yeah, it doesn't even hurt anymore.
I can come to school thanks to you."
I bring my hands together and give her a bow of thanks.

entries.japanese:
「そうですか。
それじゃ頭痛のほうはどうです？
　昨夜はすごく痛がってましたけど」
「頭痛のほうもオッケーだよ。
だいたいメガネをかけていれば問題なんかないんだから」
「そうですか。
それを聞いて安心しました」
　シエル先輩はトコトコと廊下に向かって歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. What about your headache? You were in terrible pain last night.”
“That’s fine too. As long as I’m wearing my glasses, there’s never much of a problem.”
“Good. I’m relieved to hear it.”
Ciel pads toward the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, then how is your headache?
It seemed like it really hurt yesterday."
"My head is okay too.
Besides, if I have my glasses on, there's no problem."
"I see.
Hearing that makes me feel much better."
Ciel-senpai heads towards the hallway.

entries.japanese:
と。
何かを思いたったようにピタリと足を止めると、くるりとこっちに振り向いた。
「聞き忘れてました。
遠野くん、気分のほうはどうですか」
「―――いや、気分はいいけど。
その、先輩がいてくれたから、悩みが消えた」
「よかった。
それじゃあ何かおかしなことがあったら、遠慮なく相談してください。
これ、わたしの部屋の電話番号です」
「―――――え」
entries.maoEnglish:
Then she stops dead. As if something has occurred to her, she spins back toward me.
“I forgot to ask. How are you feeling otherwise, Tohno?”
“I feel great. Now that you’re here, all my worries are gone.”
“I'm glad. Then if anything strange happens, please come to me without hesitation. Here's the telephone number for my room.”
“—What?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
She suddenly stops as if she forgot something and turns around.
"I forgot to ask.
Tohno-kun, are you feeling well?"
"---Yeah, I'm fine.
Thanks to you, all my troubles have disappeared."
"That's good.
If anything strange happens, then please do not hesitate to tell me.
Here's my phone number."
"-----Eh?"

entries.japanese:
シエル先輩は電話番号の書かれたメモ用紙を俺に手渡して、早足で教室から去っていった。
「……電話番号って……これ？」
　渡されたメモ用紙を呆然と眺める。
　シエル先輩は昨夜のことを心配してくれてこんなコトまで教えてくれるんだろうけど……。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel hands me a scrap of paper bearing her telephone number, then hurries out of the classroom.
“Her telephone number—this?”
I stare blankly at the note.
I’m sure Ciel only gave it to me because she’s worried about what happened last night, but…
entries.mirrorMoon:
She hands me a slip of paper with her phone number on it and quickly leaves the classroom.
"…… Her…… phone number?"
I stare down at the paper in surprise.
I'm sure she told me this because she's really worried about last night, but……

entries.japanese:
「……すっごいラッキーだけど。
いいのかな。
こんなトントン拍子で」
　……我ながら情けない。
　生まれつき小市民なせいか、自分の幸福を素直に喜べない性格らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…This is incredible luck. But is it really all right for everything to go this smoothly?”
I’m pathetic.
Perhaps I was born too incurably ordinary to accept my own happiness without suspicion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… This is lucky, but is it good that things are going this smoothly?"
…… It's pitiful if I say so myself.
Maybe it's because I'm a small town person by nature, but I can't honestly be happy about my good fortune like this.

entries.japanese:
ホームルームが終わって、教室はにわかに騒がしくなる。
　時刻はまだ十二時になっていない。
　土曜の放課後は賑やかだ。
　すぐに家に帰る生徒と、教室で昼食をすませて部活に出ようとする生徒たちがごちゃごちゃと入り混じっている。
　席を立って、帰りの支度をしながら先輩を待つ。
　……と。
　いつから学校にきていたのか、有彦が怪しい笑みをうかべたまま近寄ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Homeroom ends and the classroom erupts into noise.
It isn’t even noon yet.
Saturday afternoons are always lively.
Students heading straight home mingle with those eating lunch at their desks before club activities.
I rise, pack my things, and wait for Ciel. Then.
Arihiko—who knows when he arrived at school—approaches wearing a suspicious grin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After homeroom is over, the classroom suddenly erupts into its usual chaos.
It's not quite noon yet.
It's always like this after Saturday class.
The students rushing back home or eating in the classroom before they go to their club activities mix together and create chaos.
Standing up from my seat, I prepare my things while waiting for Senpai…… and then,
I'm not sure when he even came to school, but Arihiko appears with a suspicious smile on his face.

entries.japanese:
「遊びに行こう、遠野」
　……前振りも何もなしで、実に率直に己の欲望を叩きつけてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let’s go out, Tohno.”
With no preamble or explanation, he simply hurls his desire straight at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's go play, Tohno."
…… Without anything else, he tells me what he wants to do.

entries.japanese:
「……また、今日はえらく率直にきたな。
なんかイヤなことでもあったのか、おまえ」
「べっつにー。
今日はワケもなく親友と遊びに行きたくなっただけだぜー」
　……露骨にあやしい。
「お断りだ。
どうせ約束をすっぽかされたかなんかしたんだろ。
今日は先輩と帰るんだから、おまえのグチに付き合ってやる余裕はないよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re unusually direct today. Did something bad happen?”
“Noooothing. I just happened to feel like hanging out with my best friend today, that’s all.”
Painfully suspicious.
“No. Someone stood you up, didn’t they? I’m going home with Ciel today, so I have no time to listen to you complain.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You seem pretty direct today.
Did something bad happen to you?"
"Oh, nothing.
I just wanted to hang out with my good friend for no reason."
…… It's all too suspicious.
"No way.
I bet you were laid off by someone or something like that.
I'm going home with Senpai today, so I don't have time to spare for you."

entries.japanese:
「先輩？
　先輩って、シエル先輩？」
　有彦の眉が跳ねあがる。
「……そうだけど……有彦、おまえ先輩のこと覚えてるのか……！？」
「なんですかソレは。
先輩はオレの大本命だぞ、忘れるわけないじゃんか」
　あっさりと、当たり前のように有彦は即答した。
「………………」
　そっか。
シエル先輩が学校に戻ってきたんだから、何もかも元通りになったっていうことなんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel? You mean Ciel?”
Arihiko’s eyebrows leap upward.
“Yes, but Arihiko—you remember her!?”
“What kind of question is that? Ciel is the girl of my dreams; like I’d ever forget her.”
He answers at once, as if nothing could be more obvious.
“…”
Right. Ciel has returned to school, so everything else has returned to normal too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai?
You mean Ciel-senpai?"
His eyebrows lift in surprise.
"…… Yes, but…… Arihiko, you remember Senpai……!?"
"Whatd'ya mean?
She's who I'm after, how could I forget her?"
Arihiko makes his proclamation as if it was the most natural thing in the world.
"………………"
I see.
Since Ciel-senpai came back to school, everything is back the way it was.

entries.japanese:
「あっ、せんぱいだー」
　教室のドアを指差す有彦はとても嬉しそうだ。
「お待たせしました。
乾くんも、こんにちは」
　シエル先輩は丁寧におじぎをする。
「それじゃ帰りましょうか。
それとも茶道室に寄っていきます？」
「そうしようか。
このまま帰ると正門でお別れだもんな。
今日はもっと先輩と話がしたいし、茶道室でお茶でも飲みながら―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, there she is!”
Arihiko points toward the classroom door, delighted.
“Thank you for waiting. Hello to you too, Inui.”
Ciel bows politely.
“Shall we go home, then? Or would you like to stop by the tea room?”
“Let’s do that. If we leave now, we’ll have to part at the front gate. I want to talk to you more today, so we could have some tea and—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, it's Senpai!"
Arihiko points happily to the door.
"Thanks for waiting.
Good afternoon, Inui-kun."
Ciel gives a succinct bow.
"Shall we go back now?
Or maybe go to the tea ceremony room?"
"Let's do that.
If we leave now, we have to part at the gate.
I want to talk to you some more, so while we have tea, we can---"

entries.japanese:
「――――！？」
　せ、背中にいきなり何者かによる衝撃が―――
「どげし」
「……………おまえか、有彦」
「そう、オレだ。
あんまりこうゆうのに口だしする趣味はないんだが、今のはあんまりにもアレだったんで、口だしをする」
　有彦は呆れたような目で俺と、ついでにシエル先輩まで一瞥する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!?”
S-Something suddenly slams into my back—
“Wham.”
“That was you, Arihiko.”
“Yes, me. I don’t usually interfere in this kind of thing, but that was so awful I have to say something.”
Arihiko gives me an exasperated look, then throws one Ciel’s way for good measure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!?"
Someone punches me unexpectedly from behind---
"Hey."
"……………… It's you, Arihiko?"
"Yeah, it's me.
I'm not one to open my mouth about these things very often, but since that was too much back then, I'll tell you."
Arihiko looks at me and Senpai with sad eyes.

entries.japanese:
「？」
　思わずシエル先輩と顔を合わす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“?”
Ciel and I glance at each other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"?"
Ciel-senpai and I look at each other.

entries.japanese:
「あのね、キミたち。
せっかくの土曜の半ドンをどうしてそういうふうにしか使えないんだ。
　茶道室に寄っていくんなら、もっとマシな遊び場があそこには山ほど転がってるだろうに！」
　ビシッ、と大げさに有彦は窓の外を指差した。
「……えっと、ドコでしょうか」
「窓の外は、まあ、ようするに外だと思うけど」
　シエル先輩の疑問に、自分なりに答えてみる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, you two. Why would you waste a precious Saturday half-day like that?
Forget the tea room—the whole city is full of better places to have fun!”
With a grand flourish, Arihiko points out the window.
“Um—where exactly?”
“Outside the window is outside, I suppose.”
I offer Ciel my best attempt at an answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, you two.
It is a Saturday, so why do you use it like that?
There are far more fun places to go to than the tea ceremony room!"
With a greatly exaggerated movement, he points out the window.
"…… Um, where?"
"Outside the window.
Well, I think he's talking about outside."
I answer Ciel-senpai's question.

entries.japanese:
と。
　また有彦に殴られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then.
Arihiko hits me again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And then,
Arihiko whacks me again.

entries.japanese:
「遠野、オマエがそんなだから先輩までボケちまってるんじゃないか！
　いいか、土曜日だぞ？
　まだ昼なんだぞ？
　ついでにオレたちは学生なんだぞ！？
　これだけの条件が揃っていてどうして街に遊びに行こうとか思わないんだ、オマエは！」
「――――む」
　ばかもの。
　それぐらい俺だって思ってる。
　思ってるけど、その―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, your stupidity is rubbing off on Ciel!
Listen—isn’t it Saturday? Isn’t it still before noon? And aren’t we students!? With all those conditions aligned, how can going into town to have fun not even occur to you!?”
“――――Mm.”
Idiot.
Of course it occurred to me.
It did, but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno, are you really trying to make a fool of Senpai!?
Look, it's Saturday.
It's still before noon.
And we're students!
So why can't you come up with an idea such as going into town with all these conditions!?"
"----Mph."
Idiot.
I've thought about that already.
I did, but---

entries.japanese:
「？」
　シエル先輩の姿を盗み見る。
　この人は街で派手に遊ぶより、公園とかでのんびりしたほうが性に合っているような気がして、どうも誘えない。
　これから街に遊びに行こうっていっても、先輩は断ってくると思うし―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“?”
I steal a glance at Ciel.
She seems more the type to take it easy in a park than go out on the town, so I can never quite bring myself to invite her.
If I asked her to go out with us now, I'm sure she would turn me down—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"?"
I steal a glance at Ciel-senpai.
I get the feeling that rather than roaming rowdily around the city, she would feel more at ease just sitting quietly in a park or something, so I can't ask her that.
If I did ask her to go hang out in town, I think she would probably say no---

entries.japanese:
「そうですね、それじゃあ三人で遊びに行きましょうか」
「………先輩？」
「いいじゃないですか。
もう何に気がねをする必要もないんですし、遠野くんと乾くんと三人で遊びに行くんならきっと楽しいです」
「あ―――うん、先輩がいいっていうなら、俺も嬉しいけど」
「はい。
乾くんもいいですよね？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, then—why don’t the three of us go out?”
“Ciel?”
“Why not? There’s nothing left for me to worry about, and I’m sure going out with you and Inui will be fun.”
“Oh—well, if you want to, then I’d be happy to.”
“Good. That’s all right with you too, isn’t it, Inui?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then shall the three of us have fun?"
"……… Senpai?"
"Isn't it alright?
I don't have to worry about anything anymore, and I bet it'll be fun to go with the three of us."
"Ah---yeah, if you want to, then I'd be happy."
"Yes.
Inui-kun, you're okay with this too, right?"

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　コクコク、と有彦は首を上下に動かしている。
　……あいつ自身、まさかこんなコトになるなんて予想だにしてなかったんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
Arihiko nods furiously.
He clearly never imagined things would turn out this way either.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
He simply nods up and down.
…… I bet he didn't expect things to turn out this way.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ決まりですね。
えっと、二人ともお昼ごはんはどうします？
　お家で食べてくるか、それとも三人で一緒に食べましょうか」
「いや、それは学校でいつもやってるし、外食する分の金は遊びにまわそう。
俺も有彦もあんまり金もってないし。
な、有彦」
「……う……オレ、姉貴に金借りてもいいかも」
　……どうも有彦はシエル先輩と外食がしたいらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then it’s settled. What shall we do about lunch? Would you both like to eat at home first, or shall the three of us eat together?”
“We eat together at school all the time. Let’s save the money we’d spend on lunch for having fun. Arihiko and I don’t have much to spare—right, Arihiko?”
“Uh—I could borrow money from my sister.”
Apparently Arihiko is determined to eat out with Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then it's decided.
Um, what shall we do for lunch?
Shall we eat at our houses or the three of us together?"
"Hm, we always eat at school, so let's put the money for lunch to play.
Me and Arihiko are pretty poor, right?"
"…… Uh…… I, could maybe borrow some money from my sister."
…… It seems Arihiko really wants to go out and eat with Ciel-senpai.

entries.japanese:
「―――先輩は？
　なんか外で食べに行きたいところとかある？」
「いえ、わたしはあんまり……人前でごはんを食べるのは、ちょっと」
「そっか。
人よりいっぱい食べるもんな、先輩。
そりゃ金がかかるか」
「ち、違いますっ！
　なんてコト言うんですか遠野くんは！」
　……いや、今まで茶道室で一緒に昼飯を食べてきたデータをもとに、客観的に意見を述べただけなんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—What about you, Ciel? Is there anywhere you’d like to eat?”
“No, I’d rather not—eating in front of other people is a little…”
“Right. You eat more than most people. I suppose that gets expensive.”
“Th-That’s not why! How could you say such a thing, Tohno!?”
I only offered an objective conclusion based on the data gathered from all our lunches in the tea room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---How about Senpai?
Is there some place you want to eat?"
"No, I don't…… usually eat in front of others…"
"I see.
You eat more than normal, so I bet it'll be expensive."
"Th, that's not it!
What are you saying, Tohno-kun!?"
…… I just recalled the data I collected during our lunches in the tea ceremony room until now, and just gave a personal opinion.

entries.japanese:
「いいです、わたしも乾くんに賛成です。
今から三人でお昼ごはんを食べに行きましょう。
映画館の横にあるアーネンエルベのストロベリーパイがおいしいらしいです」
「おっ、通だね先輩！
　あの喫茶店のマスター、実はどこぞのイタリア料理の達人らしいぜ！」
　……また、どうしてこの男はそういうワケのわからない噂話に詳しいんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine—I agree with Inui. The three of us will go to lunch right now. I hear Ahnenerbe, beside the movie theater, serves delicious strawberry pie.”
“Oh, you know the good places! They say the master of that café is secretly some kind of genius at Italian cooking!”
How does this man always know such baffling bits of gossip?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I agree with Inui-kun.
Let us all go out to eat.
There is a place by the movie theater called Ahnenerbe that I heard has great strawberry pie."
"Oh, you know your places, Senpai!
The owner of that cafe is a master of Italian cooking!"
…… Why does Arihiko know so many rumors and useless information?

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ映画館の前に三十分後に集合しましょう。
いいですね、遠野くん！」
「―――あの。
俺、家に帰るのに三十分かかるって知ってるだろ、先輩」
　シエル先輩はずかずかと廊下へと去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let’s meet in front of the movie theater in thirty minutes. Understood, Tohno?”
“Hold on. You do know it takes me thirty minutes just to get home, don’t you?”
Ciel marches briskly out into the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then let's meet in front of the movie theater in half an hour.
Is that alright, Tohno-kun?"
"---Um.
You know it takes half an hour to get to my house, Senpai."
Senpai already starts to disappear down the hallway.

entries.japanese:
「おーし。
遅れてくれ遠野。
いっそ一日ぐらい遅れてくれてもかまわないからな！」
　有彦もダッシュで教室から立ち去っていく。
　……なんだか、あれよあれよとおかしな話になってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right! Be late, Tohno. I won’t mind if you’re a whole day late!”
Arihiko sprints from the classroom too.
Somehow, events have taken a bizarre turn before I could blink.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, be late, Tohno.
If you want to, I wouldn't care if you didn't come till tomorrow!"
Arihiko stands up and dashes out of the classroom.
…… This all worked out rather strangely.

entries.japanese:
「……ま、いいか」
　ともかくシエル先輩と遊びに行けるんだ。
　鞄を手にとって、こっちもダッシュで家に帰る事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, well.”
Whatever else happens, I’m going out with Ciel.
I grab my bag and sprint home myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh well."
I still get to hang out with Ciel-senpai.
Bag in hand, I also rush back to my place.

entries.japanese:
「あら、志貴さん今日はお早いお帰りなんですね」
「ああ、ただいま琥珀さん。
ちょっと急いでるから、また後で！」
entries.maoEnglish: “My, you’re home early today, Master Shiki.” “I’m back, Kohaku. I’m in a hurry, so I’ll see you later!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
Shiki-san, you're back early today, aren't you?"
"Yeah, I'm back Kohaku-san.
I'm in a hurry, so see you later!"

entries.japanese:
「いま帰ってきたトコ。
すぐに出かけるから、昼飯は用意しなくていい！」
entries.maoEnglish: “I just got back. I’m heading straight out again, so don’t make lunch for me!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama?
You have returned?"
"I'll be leaving right away, so don't worry about lunch!"

entries.japanese:
「よし、十五分！」
　学校からここまで、新記録を更新した。
　鞄を机に放り投げて、すぐに制服から私服に着替える。
あとはそのまま、息つく間もなく部屋から飛び出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fifteen minutes!”
A new record from school to the mansion.
I fling my bag onto the desk and change from my uniform into ordinary clothes. Then I bolt from the room without stopping for breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright, fifteen minutes!"
I set a new record from my school to back here.
Throwing my bag on my desk, I change out of my uniform.
After that, I fly out of my room again.

entries.japanese:
屋敷から街の大通りまでは学校から屋敷までの距離より遠い。
　はっきり言ってあと十五分でたどりつける距離ではない。
　先輩は俺の家が坂の上にあるって知ってて、あんな無理難題な待ち合わせ時間を指定したのだ。
「―――くそ、案外いじわるなんじゃないか、あの人は」
　ぼやきながら、階段を駆け下りていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
The city’s main avenue is farther from the mansion than the mansion is from school.
Frankly, there is no way I can reach it in the remaining fifteen minutes.
Ciel knew my house stood at the top of a hill when she imposed that impossible meeting time.
“―――Damn, maybe she has a mean streak after all.”
Complaining under my breath, I race down the stairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
From the mansion to the main street is farther than the mansion to the school.
To be honest, it's not a distance I can make in fifteen minutes.
She knew I lived uphill, but she still made that impossible deadline.
"---Damn, maybe she might be a bit mean."
I grumble as I shoot down the stairs.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----Throb.

entries.maoEnglish: “—What?”
―――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----Throb.

entries.japanese: いきなり、何の前触れもなく。
entries.maoEnglish: All at once, without the slightest warning.
entries.mirrorMoon: Suddenly, without warning.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----Throb.

entries.japanese: 目の前が、真っ赤になった。
entries.maoEnglish: Everything before me turns scarlet.
entries.mirrorMoon: Everything turns red.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴さま！？」
　……翡翠の声が聞こえる。
　ドタドタ、という足音。
……翡翠とは思えないぐらい、慌てている。
「志貴さま、お怪我はありませんか！？」
　耳元で声がする。
翡翠の姿は見えない。
―――――ずきん。
　ただ、頭痛がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Master Shiki!?”
I hear Hisui’s voice.
Feet thunder toward me. She sounds more frantic than I ever imagined Hisui could be.
“Master Shiki, are you hurt!?”
Her voice is beside my ear. I can’t see her.
―――――Throb.
There is nothing but the headache.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shiki-sama!?"
…… I can hear Hisui's voice.
I hear fast footsteps.
…… Hisui seems to be in a hurry more than usual.
"Shiki-sama, are you hurt!?"
I can hear her voice, but I can't see her.
-----Throb.
I just have this headache.

entries.japanese:
「落ちついて翡翠ちゃん。
階段から落ちた怪我は打撲だけだから、お医者さまを呼ぶほどのことじゃありません。
　それより志貴さんの体が熱いんです。
階段を踏み外したのも熱のせいでしょうから、すぐにベッドの用意をして」
「わかりました。
姉さん、このことは秋葉さまには……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, calm down. The fall only left him bruised, so there’s no need to call a doctor.
What matters is that Master Shiki is burning up. The fever probably made him miss his footing, so prepare his bed at once.”
“Understood. Kohaku, should we tell Miss Akiha…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Calm down Hisui-chan.
Falling down the stairs just means a few bruises here and there, so there is no need to call a doctor.
But his body is very hot.
He may have fallen down the stairs due to a fever, so please get his bed ready."
"I understand.
Nee-san, about Akiha-sama……"

entries.japanese:
「そうですね、このまま大事がなければお報せする必要はないでしょう。
それと解熱剤がわたしの部屋にあるから、お願い」
　タタタタタ、と翡翠の足音が遠ざかっていく。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“If nothing worse comes of it, there’s no need to alarm her. I have some fever medicine in my room, so bring that too, please.”
Hisui’s hurried footsteps recede.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true, if it doesn't turn out to be a big deal, we don't have to tell her.
There is some medicine in my room, if you please."
Hisui disappears with quick footsteps.
I----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、気がつかれました？」
「……琥珀……さん？」
「はい。
志貴さん、いま派手に階段から転がってきたんですよ。
幸い背中に痣ができている程度ですから大事はないようですけど、熱がありますね。
　どこかにお出かけするみたいでしたけど、今日はこのまま休んでください」
　琥珀さんは俺の肩に手をやって、なんとか立たせてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
“Kohaku…?”
“Yes, Master Shiki. You just took quite a spectacular fall down the stairs. Fortunately, you seem to have escaped with nothing worse than a bruise on your back, but you do have a fever.”
“It looked as though you were going out, but you must stay in bed today.”
Kohaku puts a hand on my shoulder and somehow helps me to my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, are you conscious?"
"…… Kohaku…… san?"
"Yes.
Shiki-san, you took quite a tumble down the stairs.
Fortunately you do not have any serious bruises, but you seem to have a fever.
You seem like you were going somewhere, but please just rest for today."
Kohaku-san puts her hand on my shoulder and manages to make me stand up.

entries.japanese:
「いや――大丈夫だから、休む必要なんてないよ。
きっと、ここまで全力で走ったから息があがってるだけなんだ」
「だめです！
　そんな、今にも吐きそうな青い顔して何を言ってらっしゃるんですか。
　これでもわたし、志貴さんの主治医さんからキチンと志貴さんの健康管理を任されているんです。
このまま志貴さんを危ない目に合わせる事はできません」
「でも、約束が―――」
「お断りの連絡でしたら引き受けます。
あんまり無茶するようでしたらお注射の出番ですからねっ」
　……琥珀さんは俺を引きとめるように、前に立ちはだかっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—I’m fine, so there’s no need for bed. I’m probably just winded from running all the way home.”
“Absolutely not! Your face is so pale you look ready to vomit.”
“Your doctor specifically entrusted me with looking after your health, Master Shiki. I cannot let you put yourself in danger like this.”
“But I promised—”
“I’ll contact them and cancel for you. If you insist on being reckless, I’ll have to bring out the injections!”
Kohaku plants herself squarely in my path to stop me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nah--I'm fine, I don't need to rest.
I ran all the way here, so I was just out of breath."
"That won't do!
How can you say that with such a pale face, looking like you'll throw up?
I was told by your physician to monitor your health closely.
I can't let you take such risks."
"But, I made a promise---"
"If you want to tell them you can't make it, I can go tell them.
If you keep pushing yourself, I'll have to take out my syringes and give you shots."
…… As if she wants to keep me here, she stands in front of me.

entries.japanese:
―――ずきん。
　頭痛が、する。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Throb.
My head aches.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Throb.
I have a headache.
I---

entries.japanese:
―――それでも約束を破る事はできない。
「っ――――！」
　刃物が体に突き刺さるような頭痛。
　それを堪えて、なんとか前へと歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Even so, I cannot break my promise.
“Ah――――!”
The headache pierces me like a blade.
Enduring it, I somehow force myself forward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Even still, I can't break my promise.
"Tss-----!"
I feel like spikes are being driven into my head.
Bearing that, I manage to walk forward.

entries.japanese:
「いけません、志貴さん！
　そんなお体で出かけられてはわたしたちが秋葉さまに叱られます！」
　琥珀―――さんが、外に出ようとする俺の、邪魔をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mustn’t, Master Shiki! If you go out in that condition, Miss Akiha will scold us!”
Kohaku―――blocks my way outside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You mustn't, Shiki-san!
If you go out like that, we will get in trouble with Akiha-sama!"
Kohaku---san, tries, to get in my way, to stop me from leaving.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　……この人が止めようとする気持ちもわかる。
　こんな頭痛を抱えて遊びにいっても、そこいらで倒れてしまうに決まっている。
　だからここでじっとしていろって言っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
I understand why she wants to stop me.
If I go out with a headache like this, I’m certain to collapse somewhere.
That is why she is telling me to stay here and rest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
…… I can understand why.
Even if I go out with this headache, I might very well collapse somewhere.

That's why she wants me to stay here.

entries.japanese:
けど聞けない。
「……うる……さい」
　何故だろう。
　なんの理由もなく、思った。
　いま会いにいかなければもう永遠に、マトモなままで先輩に会えないだろう、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
But I can’t listen.
“Shut—up.”
Why?
For no reason at all, I think it.
If I don’t go to her now, I will never again see Ciel while I am still in my right mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But I won't listen.
"…… Shut…… up."
Why?
For no reason at all, I thought.
I thought that if I didn't see Senpai now, I'll never see her again normally.

entries.japanese:
「何かお約束をされたのならわたしが代理で断りに行きますから、志貴さんは部屋に戻って――」
「うるさい、そこを退けって言ってるんだ……！」
「あ――――」
　乱暴に琥珀さんを押しのけて、外に向かって走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you have an appointment, I’ll go and cancel it for you, Master Shiki, so please return to your room—”
“Shut up—I said get out of my way…!” “Ah――――”
I shove Kohaku roughly aside and run for the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you made some sort of promise, I will go and tell them for you, so please go back to your room and--"
"Shut up!
I'm telling you to get out of my way……!"
"Ah----"
I violently push her away and dash towards the door.

entries.japanese:
「いけません、志貴さん……！」
　琥珀さんの声をふりきって、吐き気を堪えながら走る。
　ただ走った。
　先輩との約束に追いつけるように、
　何か得体のしれないモノから逃げるように、
　倒れる寸前の躯にムチをうって走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mustn’t, Master Shiki…!”
I outrun Kohaku’s voice, fighting back nausea as I go.
I run.
I run to keep the promise I made to Ciel,
as though fleeing some nameless,
incomprehensible thing, driving my body onward at the brink of collapse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You shouldn't, Shiki-san……!"
I ignore her voice and resist the urge to puke as I run.
I just run.
As if chasing down my promise with Senpai,
as if running away from something I can't see,
I propel my body down the street as it is on the verge of collapse.

entries.japanese:
―――街は人間であふれかえっている。
　熱い陽射し。
　むせ返る惰性に満ちた活気は見苦しい。
　どうしてこう。
　無為な昆虫のように、知性あるものが、命題もなく群をなすのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The city overflows with humans.
Scorching sunlight.
The suffocating bustle, full of mindless inertia, is hideous.
Why is this?
Why do beings with reason gather in purposeless swarms like idle insects?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The street is full of people.
The hot sunshine.
The saturation of activity is painful to watch.
Why do they do this?
Like unthinking insects, ones with intelligence still group up without any theory to solve.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……朦朧とする。
　吐き気と眩暈のせいだろうか。
　何か、自分が、自分でないような、気がする。
「――――――先、輩」
　周囲を見渡す。
　先輩は――――何処に、いるんだろう。
　意識が霞んで見つけられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
My thoughts are fogging.
Is it the nausea and dizziness?
Somehow, I feel as though I am no longer myself.
“――――――Ciel.”
I scan the crowd.
Where is she――――?
My clouded mind cannot find her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
…… Everything gets hazy.
Is it because of this nausea?
I feel like I… am not me.
"------Sen, pai."
I look around me.
Where is----she?
My mind is dizzy and I can't find her.

entries.japanese:
―――――見つけられない。
　こう人が多いと。
　　　　　　　　　　。
見つけられない――――
　　　　　　　　　　　　こう雑多すぎると。
　何も。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　意味などないような
　　　　　　　　　眩暈が
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Can’t find her.
With this many people.
Can’t find her――――.
With all this clutter.
Nothing.
As if any of it had meaning
The dizziness—
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Still can't find her.
With all these people,
I can't find her.
All this randomness.
Nothing.
Feeling like everything is pointless,
a dizziness that……

entries.japanese:
「あ、遠野くん。
驚いたなあ、ほんとに時間通りに来たんですか？」
「先……輩？」
―――初めて見た。
先輩の、私服だ。
「……えっと、さっきはちょっといじわるしちゃいました。
そんなに疲れるぐらい走らせちゃって、ごめんなさい」
―――ぺこり、と頭をさげてくる先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Tohno. I’m surprised—you actually made it on time?”
“Ciel…?”
―――It’s the first time I’ve seen her. Ciel, in ordinary clothes.
“Um, I was a little mean earlier. I’m sorry I made you run until you were this exhausted.”
―――Ciel bows to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Tohno-kun.
I'm surprised you actually made it here on time."
"Sen…… pai?"
---It's the first time I've seen her in regular clothes.
"…… Um, I was being a bit mean earlier.
Sorry for making you run here and be exhausted like this."
---She gives a quick bow of the head.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　ばかだな。
そんなこと、気にしなくていいのに。
「あ、遠野くん―――！？」
　……ああ、吐き気がする。
　けど来て良かった。
　先輩の私服を見れたんだから、こんな眩暈ぐらい我慢して、今日は三人で楽しく遊ばなくっちゃいけない―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
Idiot. She doesn’t need to worry about anything like that.
“Tohno—!?”
God, I feel sick.
But I'm glad I came.
I got to see Ciel in ordinary clothes, so I have to endure a little dizziness and spend today having fun with the three of us—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
That's silly.
She shouldn't worry about that.
"Oh, Tohno-kun---!?"
…… Uck.
I feel sick.
But I'm glad I came.
I got to see Senpai in her normal clothes, so I have to bear this dizziness, and we have to have fun together-----

entries.japanese: ――――気がつくと、ベッドに眠っている自分がいた。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――When I come to, I find myself lying in bed.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----When I wake up, I'm in a bed.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――れ」
　首だけを動かして周囲を見る。
　ここは自分の部屋で、窓の外は夜。
　部屋には翡翠がいて、眠っていた俺の様子をうかがっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
I turn my head and look around.
This is my room, and beyond the window it is night.
Hisui is here; she has been keeping watch over me while I slept.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh---?"
Moving my head, I look around me.
This is my room, and it's night outside.
Hisui is here, and she must have been watching over me as I slept.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お目覚めになられましたか？」
「……翡翠。
俺は、どうして」
　手足がしびれて、自由のきかない体のまま、首だけを動かして翡翠を見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
“Hisui. Why am I…?”
My limbs are numb and useless, so I can only turn my head toward her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, have you awoken?"
"…… Hisui.
Why am I here?"
My arms and legs don't respond.
Moving just my neck, I look at Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまは外でお倒れになられました。
　志貴さまと同伴していたご学友が屋敷に連絡をくださいまして、そのまま志貴さまをお屋敷にお連れしました」
「――――そうか。
結局、俺は」
　琥珀さんを押しのけておいて、気を失ってしまったっていうワケか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, you collapsed outside.
Master Shiki’s school friends contacted the mansion and brought Master Shiki home at once.”
“—I see. So in the end…”
I shoved Kohaku aside only to lose consciousness anyway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, you collapsed outside.
Your friend from school called here and carried you back to the mansion."
"----Oh.
That means, I"
Pushed aside Kohaku-san like that, and lost consciousness.

entries.japanese:
「……バカみたいだ。
琥珀さんに、会わせる顔がない」
　後悔と一緒になって頭痛がやってくる。
　……体の具合はそれなりによくなってはいるみたいだけど、頭痛だけは消えてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m such an idiot. I don’t know how I’ll face Kohaku.”
Regret brings the headache surging back with it.
My body seems to have recovered somewhat, but the pain in my head refuses to leave.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm an idiot.
I can't possibly face Kohaku-san now."
Another headache arrives along with my regret.
…… My body seems to have gotten a little better, but my headache doesn't go away.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
俺の体、どうなったんだ？」
「ご安心ください。
志貴さまのお体に大事はありませんでした。
姉さんが処方した鎮痛剤もありますから、頭痛がするようでしたらお飲みください」
　翡翠は銀のトレイに水と、琥珀さんが用意してくれたっていう薬を持ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. What happened to my body?”
“Please don’t be alarmed, Master Shiki. There is nothing seriously wrong with you. Kohaku has also prescribed a painkiller, so take it if your headache persists.”
Hisui brings a silver tray bearing water and the medicine Kohaku prepared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
What, happened to me?"
"Please relax, Shiki-sama.
It does not seem to be serious.
Nee-san has prepared some medicine, so if you seem to have a headache, please drink it."
Hisui carries a silver tray with some water and the medicine Kohaku-san prepared.

entries.japanese:
だが、今は飲む気になんてなれなかった。
「……ああ。
ひどくなったら自分で飲むから、そこに置いておいてくれ」
entries.maoEnglish:
But I can’t bring myself to take it now.
“…All right; leave it there, and I’ll take it myself if the pain gets worse.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, I don't feel like drinking it right now.
"…… Yeah.
If it gets terrible, I'll drink it.
Please put it over there."

entries.japanese:
―――たしかに、こんな頭痛を抱えて遊びにいってもシエル先輩に迷惑をかけるだけだ。
「……そう、だね……昨日からまだ一日経ってないもんな。
ちょっと、無茶しすぎた」
「それではお休みいただけるんですね。
志貴さん、一人で歩けますか？」
「あ―――いや」
　どうにも、無理そうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Going out with a headache like this would only cause trouble for Ciel.
“Right. It hasn’t even been a full day since last night, and I pushed myself too hard.”
“Then you’ll rest? Master Shiki, can you walk by yourself?”
“Ah—no.”
It doesn’t seem possible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Certainly, if I went to see Ciel-senpai with this headache, I'd just be a bother.
"…… That's, right…… I haven't even had a chance to rest from last night.
I guess I pushed myself a little."
"Then please rest.
Shiki-san, can you walk by yourself?"
"Ah---no."
It seems impossible right now.

entries.japanese:
「そうですね、あ、翡翠ちゃん！
　志貴さんをお部屋まで連れていって」
「え―――姉さん、けど―――」
「翡翠ちゃん！
　志貴さんは病人なんですよ、困っている人を見捨てるの？」
「あ――――」
「今日ぐらいはわたしが許します。
ちゃんと志貴さんをお部屋まで連れて行ってあげなさいっ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I thought not. Hisui, help Master Shiki back to his room.”
“What—Kohaku, but…”
“Hisui, Master Shiki is ill! Would you abandon someone who needs help?”
“Ah—”
“I’ll allow it just for today. Take proper care of him and help him back to his room.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right, oh, Hisui-chan!
Carry Shiki-san to his room."
"Eh---Nee-san, but---"
"Hisui-chan!
Shiki-san is sick, are you just going to abandon him like that?"
"Ah----"
"I will allow it for today, so take him to his room."

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
すみませんでした、わがままを言って」
「わかってくれればいいんです。
それでお薬は見つかった？」
「……その、姉さんの薬箱は多すぎて。
解熱剤ってこれですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I’m sorry I was being selfish.”
“As long as you understand. Did you find the medicine?”
“There are so many things in your medicine chest. Is this the fever medicine?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
Sorry for saying such selfish words."
"As long as you understand, it's fine.
Did you find the medicine?"
"…… Um, you had too many medicines, is this the fever medicine?"

entries.japanese:
「あはは、それはちょっと違う用途に使うものですよ。
志貴さんはしっかりしてますから、まだ精神安定剤はいりません」
「志貴さんの熱は体の疲れからきているみたいだから薬はわたしが処方します。
翡翠ちゃん、すぐに行くからあとはよろしくね」
　琥珀さんは早足で屋敷の西館―――琥珀さんの部屋がある棟へと歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahaha, that’s for something rather different. Master Shiki is still perfectly lucid, so he doesn’t need a tranquilizer yet.”
“Master Shiki’s fever seems to be caused by exhaustion, so I’ll prepare the medicine myself. Hisui, I’ll be right back, so take care of everything here.”
Kohaku hurries toward the mansion’s west wing, where her room is located.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahaha, that's used for something else.
Shiki-san is still conscious, so we don't need to use medicine that would stabilize him."
"It seems his fever is from being too tired, so I'll make some medicine.
Hisui-chan, please take care of the rest."
Kohaku-san swiftly disappears towards the west hall---where her room is.

entries.japanese:
「それでは志貴さま、お部屋にお連れします」
　失礼します、と断ってから、翡翠は俺に肩を貸してくる。
　翡翠の手をかりて階段を上がっていく。
　途中。
ずきんずきんと繰り返される頭痛より、すぐ真横にいる翡翠のひどく恥ずかしそうな顔のほうが、ひどく記憶に焼きついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I will take you to your room, Master Shiki.”
After asking permission, Hisui slips beneath my arm and lends me her shoulder.
With Hisui’s help, I climb the stairs.
Along the way, the headache pounds again and again. Yet the fierce embarrassment on her face beside me sears itself into my memory far more deeply.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, I will take you to your room."
With an "excuse me", she lends me her shoulder.
Thanks to Hisui's help, I manage to get up the stairs.
On the way, even more than my terribly throbbing headache, Hisui's incredibly embarrassed face burns into my memory.

entries.japanese:
―――結局。
　俺はベッドに横になって、琥珀さんに処方してもらった薬を飲んで、映画館前で待っているシエル先輩への伝言を頼んだ。
「…………く」
　頭痛はやまない。
　その代わりといってはなんだけど、体の熱はすっかりさがってくれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――In the end.
I lie down in bed, take the medicine Kohaku prepared, and ask someone to carry a message to Ciel as she waits outside the movie theater.
“Ngh…”
The headache does not stop.
On the other hand, for whatever comfort that offers, my fever has vanished completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---In the end,
I lie down in bed, drink the medicine Kohaku-san made, and entrust her to pass on my message to Ciel-senpai who is waiting at the movie theater.
"………… Gah."
My headache doesn't stop.
As if in exchange, my body did seem to cool down.

entries.japanese:
「姉さんは槙久さまのご好意で薬剤師としての教育を受けさせていただいたんです。
　槙久さまが亡くなられる前は、槙久さまの健康面での相談役でもありました」
　翡翠はいつもの無表情な顔に戻って、そんな聞いてもいないコトを言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My sister was educated as a pharmacist through Master Makihisa’s generosity.
Before Master Makihisa’s death, she also advised Master Makihisa on matters of health.”
Her face restored to its usual blankness, Hisui volunteers this information without being asked.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks to the goodwill of Makihisa-sama, Nee-san received training in pharmacy.
Until Makihisa-sama passed away, she also was consulted in maintaining his health."
Hisui's face returns to its usual lack of expression and tells me things I didn't even ask about.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ…………！」
　キリキリと、こめかみが痛む。
　こっちはこんなに苦しんでいるっていうのに、翡翠は眉一つ動かさないで、俺の看病をしているつもりらしい
　……まあ、それも当然か。
　痛いのは俺であって翡翠じゃない。
　彼女が、俺の代わりに痛いフリをして暗い顔をされるのも面倒だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
A sharp ache worries at my temples.
Here I am in agony, while Hisui does not so much as move an eyebrow, apparently intending to nurse me
Though I suppose that is only natural.
I am the one in pain, not Hisui.
It would be even more tiresome if she put on a gloomy face and pretended to hurt on my behalf.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh…………!"
Sharp pain stabs through my head.
Even though I'm in this much pain, she seems to be tending me without even batting an eyelash.
…… Well, that's only to be expected.
I'm the one in pain, not her.
If she acted like she was in pain or had a clouded expression, it would be troublesome.

entries.japanese:
「ぐ――――っ！」
「志貴さま、まだどこか痛むのですか？」
「―――翡翠、悪いけど」
「はい、なんでしょう」
「目障りだから、出ていってくれ。
そこにいられると気になって眠れない」
「――――はい。
それでは失礼します。
何かご用がありましたらお呼びください」
　翡翠が部屋を出ていく。
　心なしか、それで気持ちがスッとした。
　頭痛も収まって、これでゆっくり眠れるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――!”
“Master Shiki, are you still in pain somewhere?”
“Hisui—sorry, but…”
“Yes, what is it?”
“Get out. Looking at you is irritating, and I can’t sleep with you standing there.”
“Very well. I shall excuse myself. Please call if you require anything.”
Hisui leaves the room.
Somehow, my head clears and the pain ebbs with it.
Now I should finally be able to sleep in peace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh----!"
"Shiki-sama, are you still in pain?"
"---Sorry Hisui."
"Yes, what is it?"
"You're an eyesore, so please leave.
I can't sleep with you here."
"----I understand, then please excuse me.
If you need anything, please call for me."
Hisui leaves the room.
With that, I actually do relax.
My headache also weakens, so maybe I can sleep now.

entries.japanese:
コンコン、と甲高い音がして、扉が開いた。
「―――失礼します、兄さん。
起きてらっしゃいますか？」
「……ああ、起きてるよ。
なにか用か秋葉」
「いえ、兄さんが貧血で休んでいる、と聞きましたから様子を見にきただけです」
　秋葉の視線は、ベッドで横になっている俺に向けられている。
　いかにも心配しています、といった憂いを帯びた視線。
　……正直、うざったい。
entries.maoEnglish:
A pair of high, crisp knocks sounds, and the door opens.
“Excuse me, Brother. Are you awake?”
“Yeah, I’m awake. What is it, Akiha?”
“I heard you were resting with anemia, so I came to see how you were.”
Akiha’s gaze settles on me where I lie in bed.
It is heavy with obvious concern.
Honestly, it is annoying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock-knock.
The door opens.
"---Excuse me, Nii-san.
Are you awake?"
"…… Yeah, I'm up.
You need something, Akiha?"
"No, I heard you were resting because of your anemia, so I just came to see how you were doing."
She looks over at me as I lie in bed.
A soft gaze that tells me she's worried.
…… To be honest, it's annoying as hell.

entries.japanese:
「体はなんともないよ。
看病されるほどのものでもないから、こうして一人で休んでいるんだ。
秋葉も自分の部屋に戻れ」
「―――兄さん、なに言ってるんですか。
　もう夕食の時間なんですよ。
わたし、兄さんを呼びにきたんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There’s nothing wrong with me. If I needed looking after, I wouldn’t be resting alone. Go back to your room, Akiha.”
“Brother, what are you talking about?
It’s already time for dinner. I came to call you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine.
It's not that bad, that's why I'm resting here by myself.
Go back to your room, Akiha."
"---Nii-san, what are you saying?
It's already dinnertime you know.
I came here to tell you that."

entries.japanese:
……夕食……？
　ああ、もうそんな時間なのか。
　けど空腹というわけでもないし、何か食べたいという意欲もない。
「食欲はないから、夕食はいいよ。
いいから、今日は下がってくれ。
気分が悪いんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
Dinner…?
Is it that late already?
But I am not hungry, nor do I feel the slightest urge to eat.
“I have no appetite, so forget dinner. Just leave me alone today. I feel sick.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Dinner……?
Oh, is it that time already?
But I'm not very hungry, and I don't feel like eating anything.
"I don't have an appetite, so I'll skip dinner.
I'm fine, so go away for today.
I don't feel good."

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
今日はゆっくりお休みください。
ですけど兄さん。
起きてらっしゃるのでしたらお部屋の電気をつけてください。
暗がりにいると目を悪くするでしょう」
「―――いいんだ。
このほうが落ちつくから」
「………………」
　秋葉は最後まで何か言いたそうな目をして、部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Very well. Please rest tonight. But, Brother, if you intend to remain awake, turn on the light. Sitting in the dark will damage your eyes.”
“No. It’s calmer this way.”
“…”
