Akiha leaves at last, still looking as though there is something she wants to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
Please get your rest.
But Nii-san, if you are awake, please turn the lights on in your room.
Your eyes will go bad in the dark."
"---I'm fine.
I can relax this way."
"………………"
Even though her eyes tell me she wants to say more, she leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　ああ、イライラする。
　翡翠の態度とか、秋葉の心配そうな目とか、なんだってそんな腫れ物を扱うみたいに俺に接するんだ。
　こんなのはいつもの事だろう。
　別に血を吐いてるとか血を吸ってるとかの大怪我をしているワケじゃないんだから、ほっといてくれないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
God, I’m irritated.
Hisui’s manner, Akiha’s worried eyes—why does everyone insist on treating me as though I might shatter at a touch?
This happens all the time.
It isn’t as if I am grievously wounded, coughing up blood or drinking it—why can’t they leave me alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I'm so irritated.
Hisui's reactions, Akiha's worried eyes, they all seem to treat me as something fragile.
Isn't this like always?
It's not like I'm coughing up blood or sucking up blood, so why can't they just leave me alone?

entries.japanese:
――――ギリ。
　暗がりの中で、自分の歯軋りの音がする。
「…………」
　神経がささくれだっている、というのが自分でもわかる。
　このまま起きていると鬱になってしまいそうだ。
　眠くはないが、なんとか眠ることにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Grrrk.
The sound of my own teeth grinding fills the dark.
“…”
Even I can tell my nerves are fraying.
If I stay awake like this, I will sink into something ugly.
I am not sleepy, but I will force myself to sleep somehow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Grit.
In the darkness, I hear myself grinding my teeth.
"…………"
My nerves are fraying, I know that.
If I stay awake like this, I'll become completely depressed.
I'm not tired, but I have to sleep.

entries.japanese:
大通りに出た。
　日付はつい二分ほど前に変わった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I emerge onto the main avenue.
The date changed perhaps two minutes ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go out to the main street.
The date has changed about two minutes ago.

entries.japanese:
日曜の午前零時。
　道を歩く人影は皆無だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Midnight on Sunday.
Not a single person walks the street.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The dead of night on Sunday.
No one is walking the streets.

entries.japanese:
時間を誤ったか。
　あと一時間早く出歩けば、こんな手間はかからなかったろうに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Did I choose the wrong hour?
Had I gone out an hour earlier, this would have taken far less trouble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Did I mistake the time?
If I started walking around an hour earlier, I wouldn't have had to work so hard.

entries.japanese:
ずるずると歩く。
　ずるずると音をたてているのは、
　ずるずるとしているモノであって、
　ずるずると自分が歩いているわけではない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Drag, drag, drag.
The dragging sound comes from
the thing that drags along,
not from the way I walk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Dragging, walking.
What makes this dragging sound,
isn't my walking,
but something else.

entries.japanese:
時間は正しかった。
　あと一時間早く出歩いていれば、こんなふうに歩くことはできなかったろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The hour was right.
Had I gone out an hour earlier, I could never have walked this way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The time was right.
If I started walking an hour earlier, I never would have been able to walk like this.

entries.japanese:
ずるずる。
　片手に、女の髪を掴んで歩く。
　長い髪。
秋葉に似ていたから、この女に決めた。
　顔は似つかない。
ただ、髪が気に入った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Drag, drag.
I walk with a fistful of the woman's hair.
Long hair. It reminded me of Akiha's, so I chose her. Her face looks nothing like Akiha's. I only liked the hair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Dragging,
With one hand gripping the woman's hair, I continue to walk.
Long hair.
Because she looked like Akiha, I chose this woman.
Not her face, but I liked her hair.

entries.japanese:
髪から手を離す。
　女は、意識を失ったまま地面に倒れこむ。
　殺してはいない。
　夕食を食べていないので、食事は、できるだけ食欲をそそる方法でとりたかった。
　死人の血は、冷えていてあまり美味くはないと聞いた事がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
I release her hair.
Still unconscious, the woman collapses onto the ground.
I have not killed her.
Since I skipped dinner, I wanted my meal served in the most appetizing way possible.
I once heard that a corpse’s blood is cold and not especially good.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let go of her hair.
Unconscious, she collapses to the ground.
I did not kill her.
I didn't eat dinner, so I want to make it as appetizing as possible.
I've heard somewhere that the blood of the dead is cold and tastes terrible.

entries.japanese:
化粧けのない女の首筋は、悪くはない。
　ナイフを片手に握ったまま、その首筋に向けて、口を―――
　という夢を見て、目が覚めた。
「――――っ！」
　眠りから覚めて、意識がはっきりとしてくる。
　喉がひどく渇いていて、全身がざわざわと総毛だっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
The woman’s unpainted throat is not unappealing.
Knife clenched in one hand, I lower my mouth toward it—
That is the dream I wake from.
“――――!”
Awareness sharpens as sleep releases me.
My throat is terribly dry, and every hair on my body stands on end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I have no complaints about her unblemished neck.
Gripping my knife in one hand, I draw my mouth closer---
After seeing that dream, I wake up.
"-----!"
I wake up from my sleep and my mind starts to clear.
My throat is horribly parched and my entire body feels excited.

entries.japanese:
「なんて―――夢を」
　見ているんだろう、俺は。
　信じられない。
　夜の街に出て、見ず知らずの女性を後ろから昏倒させて、路地裏に連れこむなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What kind of―――dream…”
am I having?
I cannot believe it.
I went into the city at night, knocked an unknown woman unconscious from behind, and dragged her into an alley.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What---kind of dream……"
was I watching?
I can't believe it.
Leaving at night, knocking a woman I don't know unconscious, and dragging her to an alley.

entries.japanese:
はっきりいって、どうかしてる。
　夢だからいいようなものの、現実にあんな真似をしていたら、それこそ気が狂っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is deranged, frankly.
A dream is one thing, but if I ever did that in reality, I would be truly insane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's just plain wrong.
Because it was in a dream, it is okay, but I'd have to be crazy to do that in reality.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ、はあ――――」
　なぜか荒くなっている呼吸を整える。
　瞼を指で押さえて、深呼吸をした。
　……ちょっと、いくらなんでもこれから二度寝はできそうにない。
　部屋の電気をつけて、朝が来るまで本でも読んでいよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa―――haa, haa――――”
I steady my inexplicably ragged breathing.
Pressing my fingers to my eyelids, I draw a deep breath.
There is no chance of going back to sleep after that.
I will turn on the light and read until morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My panting fills the room.
I have to catch my breath.
Rubbing my eyes, I take a deep breath.
…… After that, I don't think I can go back to sleep.
Turning on the light, I decide to read a book until morning.

entries.japanese: 目が、次第に。
entries.maoEnglish: My eyes, little by little…
entries.mirrorMoon: My eyes, gradually,

entries.japanese: 暗闇に、なれてきた。
entries.maoEnglish: adjust to the dark.
entries.mirrorMoon: get used to the dark.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――な」
　息が止まった。
　ここは、自分の部屋なんかじゃない。
　路地裏。
　俺の手にはナイフ。
　目の前には。
　気を失って倒れている、見知らぬ女。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――――What?”
My breath stops.
This is not my room.
An alley.
A knife in my hand.
Before me.
An unknown woman lies unconscious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------Wha……"
I gasp.
This isn't my room.
A back alley.
Knife in hand.
In front of me,
lies an unconscious woman I don't know.

entries.japanese:
「は――――――――――」
　何を。
　何をしているんだ、俺は。
　夢じゃないのか。
　さっきまでのは夢じゃないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
What?
What am I doing?
Wasn’t it a dream?
Wasn’t everything until now a dream?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha-----------"
What,
What am I doing?
Isn't this a dream?

Isn't this what I dreamt before?

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　夢のはずだ。
　だって俺は、こんなコトをしたいなんて一度も思った事がない。
　見ず知らずの女を襲って、
　そのしなやかな体に走る幾条もの『線』にナイフを走らせ、
　手足を解体して赤い、あかい血を見たいだなんて、少しも――――少しも？
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――”
It has to be a dream.
I have never once wanted anything like this.
To attack a strange woman,
draw my knife along the many ‘lines’ crossing her supple body,
take her limbs apart and see the red, red blood—not even once――――not even once?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
It has to be a dream.
Because I've never even wanted to do such a thing before.
Attacking some woman I don't know,
running my knife along the "lines" all over this supple body,
wanting to see the red, red blood coming from the chopped pieces, no way----no way?

entries.japanese:
あぁ、少しも思っていないのに。
　でも、どうしようもなく―――それをしなくちゃいけなって、考えて、しまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have never wanted it at all.
And yet, helplessly, I find myself thinking that I have to do it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, there's no way I want to do it.
But, for no reason---I'm thinking, that I have to do it.

entries.japanese:
バラせ。
　バラせ。
　バラせ。
　バラせ。
　そうすれば、俺は。
　つまらないしがらみから解放されて、誰にも束縛されない生き物になれる。
　そういえば。
　似たようなコトを言っていたヤツが、いたっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
Then I will be free of every petty tie.
I will become a creature no one can bind.
Come to think of it.
Someone once said something very much like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
Take her apart.
If I do that,
I can be released, and become something unable to be bound by anyone.
Come to think of it,
there was someone that said something like that before.

entries.japanese:
―――オマエも同じさ。
オマエも、オレと同じただの人殺しになりさがるんだよ、遠野志貴。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――You’re no different. You’ll sink to being nothing but a murderer, just like me, Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---You're the same.
You, like me, will end up as a killer, Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
「…………さい」
―――いいかげん認めろよ殺人鬼。
　　　オマエの反転する衝動は、紛れもなくオマエ自身の望みなんだってな―――
「うる……さい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shut up…”
―――Admit it already, killer.
That inverted impulse of yours is nothing less than your own desire—
“Shut—up.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… up!"
---Just admit it, killer.
Your inversion impulse is nothing more than what you wish for---
"Shut…… up!"

entries.japanese:
けど、なんだ。
　これはなんだ。
　俺はどうしてこんなコトをしているんだ。
　こうして気がついた今も、どうしてナイフを女の首につきたてようとしているんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
But what is this?
What am I doing?
Why am I doing any of this?
Even now, awake and aware, why am I still trying to drive the knife into the woman’s throat?
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, what is this?
Just what is this?
Why am I doing this?

And even after realizing this, why am I still trying to press my knife against her neck?

entries.japanese:
夢でなく、現実でこんなコトをしてしまうというのなら。
　それは気が狂っているという事だと、さっき思ったのは誰だった？
entries.maoEnglish:
If I am doing this in reality rather than a dream, then I am insane.
Who was it that thought exactly that only moments ago?
entries.mirrorMoon:
If this isn't a dream, and if this is reality,
doesn't that mean I'm crazy, like I thought earlier?

entries.japanese:
「――――ん」
　女の瞼が動いた。
　女の目が覚める。
　その前に。
　確実にバラしておかないと。
俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn…”
The woman’s eyelids flutter.
She is waking.
Before that happens.
I have to make certain I take her apart before she wakes. I have to―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Mm."
Her eyelids flutter.
She starts to open her eyes.
Before that,
I have to chop her apart, or I---

entries.japanese:
「あ」
　ナイフが動く。
　でも、それは。
「……だれ？」
　女の声が聞こえる。
　彼女は、自分の首元にあてられているナイフに気がついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
The knife moves.
But then.
“Who are you…?”
I hear the woman’s voice.
She notices the knife poised against her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah."
My knife moves.
But that's,
"…… Who are you?"
I can hear her voice.
She suddenly realizes the knife next to her throat.

entries.japanese:
「きゃ――――」
「あああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eee—”
“AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kya---"
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!"

entries.japanese:
女の悲鳴は、俺の叫び声にかき消された。
　叫んで。
壊れたサイレンみたいに叫び続けて、気がつけば走っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
My scream drowns out hers.
I scream and keep screaming like a broken siren. When awareness returns, I am running.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her scream vanishes into my yelling.
Yelling.
Like a broken siren, I keep yelling as I run.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ―――」
　指が震える。
　頭の中が真っ白だ。
　それでもかろうじて、あの女性にナイフを突き刺す前に走り出せた。
　だが。
もし彼女が、俺より先に悲鳴を上げていたのなら。
　俺は、あのまま――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah―――”
My fingers tremble.
My mind goes blank.
Yet somehow, just barely, I ran before I drove the knife into that woman.
But. If she had screamed before I did…
I would have gone on and—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I breathe rapidly.
My fingers shake.
My mind has gone blank.
But I manage to pull my knife back and run before I slice her.
But, if she had screamed before me,
I would have----

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はは、ははははは………！」
　恐い。
　それは恐い。
　今まで体験してきたどんな恐怖より、これは恐い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, ha, hahahaha…!”
I am afraid.
Truly afraid.
This is more terrifying than anything I have ever endured.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha, ha, haha, hahahahaha………!"
Scary.
That's scary.

Scarier than any of the things that have happened until now.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ……！」
　追ってくる。
　背中に覆い被さってる。
　いくら逃げても―――自分の恐さから逃げられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah…!”
It follows me.
It hangs over my back.
No matter how far I run, I cannot escape the terror that is me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Half-laughing, half-panting, I run.
It's following me.
It drapes over my back.
No matter how much I run---I can't escape from my own fear.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はあ！」
　部屋に飛び込んで、鍵をかける。
　ガチャガチャと音だけがして、うまくかけられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, haah!”
I plunge into my room and try to lock the door.
The latch only rattles; I cannot make it catch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I fly into my room and try to lock the door.
I clamor about, but I can't get it done.

entries.japanese:
指先。
　指先が狂ったように動き回って、ただ金属のポッチをスライドさせるだけの作業が、どうしてもうまくできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My fingertips.
They skitter madly, unable to perform the simple task of sliding one little metal catch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My fingertips.
My fingertips shake crazily.
It's just sliding a simple metal piece, but I can't do it.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ！」
　恐い。
　早く鍵をかけないと部屋に入ってくる。
　得体のしれない何かが入ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah!”
I’m afraid.
If I do not lock it quickly, something will enter the room.
Something unknowable will come inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I'm scared.
If I don't lock the door quickly, it will come in.

Some unknown thing will come in.

entries.japanese:
「くっ……………！」
　鍵、鍵をかけないと。
　この部屋に入れちゃダメだ。
　この部屋から出しちゃダメだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
The lock—I have to lock it.
I cannot let it into this room.
I cannot let it out of this room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh…………!"
I have to, lock the door.
I can't let it come in this room.

I can't let it leave this room.

entries.japanese:
でも何を？
　わからない。
　わからないまま、狂ったように鍵をかけ続ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
But what?
I do not know.
Without knowing, I keep working the lock like a madman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But why?
I don't know.
I don't know, but I continue to try and lock the door wildly.

entries.japanese:
がちゃがちゃと、一晩中鍵をかけようと努力した。
　何時間かけても鍵一つかけられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The latch rattles all night as I struggle with it.
Hours pass, and still I cannot turn the lock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I try all night to lock the door.
But no matter how long I try, I can't even lock the door.

entries.japanese:
それで思った。
　俺は、とっくに狂ってしまったんだ、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then I understand.
I went mad long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's when it hits me.
I've been crazy all along.

entries.japanese:
朝になって、ようやく、鍵が閉められた。
　はあ、はあ、はあ
　ケモノの息遣いめいた呼吸音が部屋に充満している。
　頭がいたい。
　メガネをどこかで落としてしまったらしい。
　部屋中に『線』が視えて、吐き気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only when morning comes do I finally manage to lock the door.
Hah, hah, hah
The room is filled with breathing like an animal’s.
My head hurts.
I must have lost my glasses somewhere.
‘Lines’ cover everything in the room, making me sick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It becomes morning and I finally manage to lock the door.
*pant* *pant* *pant*
My beast-like panting fills the room.
My head hurts.
It seems I dropped my glasses somewhere.
Seeing the "lines" all over my room, I feel nauseous.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
　あんまりにも吐き気がするから、片っ端から切りつけた。
　気持ちが、少しだけ楽になる。
　モノを切断する瞬間だけ、心が穏やかになってくれた。
　反面、モノを切れば切るほど、その後にまっているのは倍化する渇きだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
The nausea becomes so unbearable that I slash everything within reach.
It eases me a little.
My mind is calm only at the instant something comes apart.
Yet the more I cut, the greater the thirst waiting afterward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I feel so sick, I cut all of them I see.
I feel just a little better.
Only during the instant I cut things apart does my heart feel at ease.
But the more I cut, the thirstier I get.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
　何に渇いているのか、もうわかりきっている。
　俺はとにかく、あらゆる物に渇いていた。
　目に映る全てのものが腹だたしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
I know perfectly well what I thirst for.
I thirst for everything.
Everything I see enrages me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I know what I'm thirsty for.
I'm thirsty for everything.
Everything I see is pissing me off.

entries.japanese:
見苦しい。
　死を内包しているくせにだらだらと生きている無様さが許せない。
　なぜ死なない。
終わりがあることから逃れられぬのなら、なぜそうやって存在している。
　いずれ終わるのならば―――有る意味など何処にある。
　見えているモノが全て不気味に見えてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is obscene.
I cannot forgive the ugliness of things that carry death within them yet drag out their lives.
Why don’t they die? If none can escape their end, why do they continue to exist?
If they will end someday, what meaning can there be in their existence?
Everything I see becomes grotesque.
entries.mirrorMoon:
They look miserable.
I can't forgive that they are living meaninglessly even though they have death built into them.
Why don't they die?
They all have an end they can't escape, so why do they still exist like that?
If it will end anyway---where is the meaning in existence?
Everything I see is ghastly.

entries.japanese:
かといって目を閉じれば、思い出すのは人を殺した時の感触だけだ。
　硬い、血のかよっていない刃物が、
　柔らかな、脈打つ肉と一体化していく感触。
　おそらくは人としてアレにまさる刺激はありえまい。
　舌を噛み切りたくなるほどのおぞましい感触だった。
　それが正であるか負であるかは問題ではない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yet when I close my eyes, all I remember is the sensation of killing.
A hard, bloodless blade,
merging with soft, pulsing flesh.
For a human being, there can surely be no more powerful sensation.
The feeling was so hideous I wanted to bite through my tongue.
Whether that force was positive or negative is beside the point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But if I close my eyes, all I can remember is the sensation of killing.
The sensation of a hard, unbloodied blade,
softly uniting with pulsing flesh.
There can't be a greater stimulation for a human than that.
A terrible sensation that almost makes me want to bite my tongue off.
It doesn't matter if it is a positive or negative feeling.

entries.japanese:
とりわけ俺の場合、一番初めの相手が最悪なまでに最高だったから始末が悪い。
　……アルクェイド。
あいつの体を十七つに解体した時の興奮が、脳に焼き付いて離れない。
　あの美しい肢体を。
　人間の器でありながら、ヒトを遥かに凌駕した強靭な命を。
　ざっくざくに切断した時の快感は終わっていた。
　あの時。
殺されたのはアルクェイドではなく、俺の脳髄のほうだったに違いない。
entries.maoEnglish:
In my case, what makes it worse is that my first victim was the best in the worst possible way.
Arcueid. The ecstasy of dividing her body into seventeen pieces is burned into my brain and will not leave.
That beautiful body.
A life housed in human form yet infinitely stronger than any human.
The pleasure of hacking it apart destroyed me. That day, it was not Arcueid who was killed. It must have been my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Especially in my case.
Because my first was the best beyond all belief, it's hopeless.
…… Arcueid.
The pleasure I got from severing her body into seventeen pieces still burns in my brain and won't go away.
Those beautiful body parts.
The appearance of a human, but with a tenacious life that surpasses far beyond that of people.
The enjoyment I had from the killing has faded.
That time, I didn't kill Arcueid, but I must've killed my brain instead.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
　全て壊したくて、
　全て殺したい。
　それが禁じられている事だとわかっているのに、我慢できそうにない。
　体中が興奮していて、どうにかしそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
Wanting to break everything,
I want to kill everything.
I know it is forbidden, but I cannot endure much longer.
My entire body is feverishly aroused, and I am going to lose myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I want to destroy everything,
kill everything.
I know that's wrong, but I don't think I can hold it in.
My body is filled with excitement; I'm about to go insane.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、起きてらっしゃるんですか？」
「――――っ！」
　扉の向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
“――――!”
Hisui’s voice comes through the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you awake?"
"----!"
I can hear Hisui's voice from the other side of the door.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、鍵をかけられては困ります。
起きていらっしゃるのでしたら開けてください」
「…………け……る……？」
　ドアを、開ける？
　扉を開けて、翡翠を中に入れる？
―――冗談じゃない。
　そんなコトになったら、俺は何をするかわからない。
　こうして―――こうして一人きりになって、カーテンを閉めきってベッドにうずくまって、かろうじて理性が欲情を押しとどめてくれているのに。
　だっていうのに、翡翠になんか入ってこられたら、それこそ俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki must not keep the door locked. If you are awake, please open it.”
“Open it…?”
Open the door?
Let Hisui into the room?
―――Absolutely not.
If that happens, I do not know what I will do.
Here—alone, curtains drawn, curled on the bed—my reason is only just holding my lust in check.
If Hisui comes inside, then I will—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, it is not good if you keep the door locked.
If you are awake, please open the door."
"………… Op…… en…………?"
Open the door?
Open the door and let Hisui inside?
---You must be kidding me.
If that happened, I don't know what I would do.
Like this---if I stay alone like this, lying in bed with the curtains shut, I can stave off the desires that threaten to overtake my mind.
That's why, if Hisui comes in here, I'll---

entries.japanese:
「―――うるさい！
　俺にかまうな！」
　ドアに向かって、大声で叫んだ。
「……志貴さま？
　体調が優れないのですか？」
「かまうなって言ってるだろ……！
　いいから、大丈夫だから俺にかまわないでくれ……！」
　部屋に―――中に入ってきたら、きっと取り返しのつかない事をしてしまう。
「……………」
　沈黙のあと、翡翠の足音が聞こえた。
　静かに、俺の部屋の前から遠ざかっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shut up! Leave me alone!”
I shout at the door.
“Master Shiki? Are you unwell?”
“I said leave me alone…! I’m fine, so just stay away from me…!”
If she comes into the room, I will surely do something beyond repair.
“…”
After a silence, I hear Hisui’s footsteps.
They recede quietly from my door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shut up!
Leave me alone!"
I scream at the door.
"…… Shiki-sama?
Are you not feeling well?"
"I said leave me alone……!
I'm fine, so just leave me alone……!"
If she---came in this room, something I couldn't take back would happen.
"…………"
After a deep silence, I hear her footsteps.
Quietly, she walks away from the door.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
―――これで、安全だ。
　そう思ったら少し落ちついた。
　気晴らし―――気晴らしに、本でも読もうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
―――Now it is safe.
The thought calms me a little.
A distraction―――maybe I should read.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
---Now it's safe.
Thinking that, I calm down just a little.
I should---I should just read a book to unwind.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――れ」
　いつも枕元にあった本がない。
　英文で書かれた本。
……そりゃあ俺に読めるはずがないんだけど、それでも気晴らしにはなるはずなのに。
　探しても見付からない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What―――?”
The book that was always beside my pillow is gone.
The one written in English. Of course I could never read it, but it should still have served as a distraction.
I search and cannot find it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H---uh?"
The book that was always beside my pillow isn't there.
The book written in English …… I definitely can't read it, but it was a way to kill time.
I search but I can't find it.

entries.japanese:
見つからない。
　必死にどんな装丁だったかを思い出す。
　どうしても、思い出せない。
　はあ、はあ、はあ
「本―――本」
　考えてみれば。
　あんな本を、俺はどうして枕元になんか置いておいたんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is nowhere.
I desperately try to remember what the binding looked like.
I cannot.
Hah, hah, hah
“The book―――the book.”
Come to think of it.
Why did I ever keep such a book beside my pillow?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't find it.
I frantically try to remember what the cover looked like.
But I can't.
*pant* *pant* *pant*
"The book---the book."
Come to think of it,
Why did I even put that book by my pillow?

entries.japanese:
知らない。
あんな本を持ってきた記憶がない。
　あんな本がどこにあったのかも知らない。
　そもそも―――そんなもの、本当にあったんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I do not know. I have no memory of bringing it here.
I do not know where I found it.
Did such a book ever truly exist?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know.
I don't even remember bringing it here.
I don't know where I brought it from.
In the first place---did that book even exist?

entries.japanese: ……本当は、オマエ本人が気づいていないだけで
entries.maoEnglish: The truth is, you’re the only one who hasn’t noticed
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Really, you may have not realized it.

entries.japanese:
……耳障りなロアの声を思い出す。
　あの本―――その内容。
　いつも眠れなくて読んでいた本。
　でもそれは、眠っている時に、眠れないという夢を、見ていただけじゃ、なかったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember Roa’s grating voice.
That book―――its contents.
The book I always read when I could not sleep.
But perhaps, while asleep, I was merely dreaming that I lay awake reading.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I remember Roa's irksome voice.
That book---those contents.
The book I read when I couldn't sleep.
Was it maybe just a dream of mine dreaming that I was awake and couldn't sleep?

entries.japanese: ……とっくの昔に、遠野志貴は狂ってるのさ……！
entries.maoEnglish: Shiki Tohno went mad a long, long time ago…!
entries.mirrorMoon: …… But you were already insane a long, long time ago……!

entries.japanese:
ロアは、そんな言葉を言っていた。
　ユメ―――ゆめ。
　でも、俺はあんな夢なんかみない。
　そもそも、遠野志貴の中にあんなワケのわからない知識はない。
　あんな夢を見る材料がない。
　アレは、俺の夢なんかじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Those were Roa’s words.
A dream—a dream.
But I do not dream things like that.
Shiki Tohno does not possess that incomprehensible knowledge.
There is nothing in me from which such dreams could be made.
That was not my dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa said such words.
DREAM---dream.
But, I don't see those kinds of dreams.
In the first place, I don't have that strange knowledge inside of me.
There's no reason for me to have that dream.
That, isn't my dream.

entries.japanese: おまえ本人が、気がついていないだけで
entries.maoEnglish: You’re the only one who hasn’t noticed
entries.mirrorMoon: You may have not realized it.

entries.japanese:
「――――うる、さい」
　はあ、はあ、はあ
　それじゃあアレはなんだ。
　俺はいったいいつから、自分でないヤツの夢なんてものを見始めていたっていうんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Shut up.”
Hah, hah, hah
Then what was it?
When did I begin dreaming the dreams of someone who was not me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shut, up."
*pant* *pant* *pant*
Then what is that?
Since when the hell did I start having dreams that belonged to another person?

entries.japanese: オレとオマエは繋がっているんだ志貴
entries.maoEnglish: You and I are connected, Shiki
entries.mirrorMoon: You and I are connected, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
「――――だまれよ、死人」
　とっくにくたばった貴様が、何度も何度も耳障りな声をあげるんじゃない。
　俺は―――貴様とは違う。
　俺は殺人鬼なんかじゃない。
　今はただ、後遺症で戸惑っているだけだ。
　せっかくシエル先輩が帰ってきてくれたのに、こんなコトで、イカレてなんかやるものか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Shut up, dead man.”
You died long ago, so stop raising that loathsome voice again and again.
I am―――not like you.
I am no murderer.
I am only confused by the aftereffects.
Ciel has finally come back to me; I will not let this drive me insane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shut up, you're dead."
You're already dead, you bastard, so stop your incessant calling out.
I'm---different from you.
I'm not a killer.
I'm just confused by all the after-effects.
Since Ciel-senpai came back, I won't allow myself to go mad over something like this.

entries.japanese:
―――ああ、オレも初めはそう思ってた。
　　　　ロアなんてヤツが入っていても―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Oh, I thought the same at first.
Even with a man called Roa inside me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Yeah, I also thought so at first.
Even if this Roa came in---

entries.japanese:
「―――黙れって言ってるだろう……！」
　はあ、はあ、はあ―――――
　……呼吸が荒い。
　太陽の光が癇に障る。
　喉が。
喉が渇いて、どうかしそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I told you to shut up…!”
Hah, hah, hah―――――
My breathing is ragged.
The sunlight enrages me.
My throat. My throat is so dry I am losing my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I told you to shut up……!"
*pant* *pant* *pant*-----
…… I breathe heavily.
The sunlight pisses me off.
My throat.
My throat is so dry, I'm about to go insane.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……！
　なにをしていらっしゃるんですか、志貴さま！？」
　ドアの向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえる。
　……答える余裕がない。
　コトバ。
自分のコトバを、思い出せない。
　頭に浮かぶのは。
　頭に、浮かぶのは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki! What are you doing in there, Master Shiki!?”
Hisui calls through the door.
I cannot spare the strength to answer.
Words. I cannot remember my own words.
All that enters my mind…
All that enters… my mind is—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……!
What are you doing, Shiki-sama!?"
I hear Hisui's voice across the door.
…… I can't even answer.
Words.
I can't even remember, my words.
What fills my head,

What fills my, head,

entries.japanese:
ただ、欲望のままに。
　雌を、犯したくて、犯したくて
　狂ったように発情している、自分の姿だけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nothing but blind desire.
Wanting to rape a female, wanting it, wanting it—
—and the sight of myself, rutting like a mad animal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
is just lust.
I want to violate, violate any female.
I start to lust crazily.

entries.japanese:
「うわあああ――――！」
　頭。
頭を壁に打ち付ける。
　何度も何度も、額が割れそうになるまで打ちつける。
　それでも―――翡翠をズタズタにしようっていう考えが、頭の中から消えてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaaaah――――!”
My head. I smash my head into the wall.
I strike it over and over until my forehead feels ready to split.
Still the thought of tearing Hisui to pieces will not leave my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uwaaaa----!"
My head.
I bang my head against the wall.
Over and over, as if I was trying to split it.
But still---the thought of me slicing apart Hisui doesn't disappear from my brain.

entries.japanese:
がんがんと、壁に頭をうちつける。
　まるで俺のソレと競争するように、翡翠のドアを叩く音が大きくなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pound my head against the wall.
As if racing the blows, Hisui’s pounding on the door grows louder and louder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bam.
Bam.
I hit my head on the wall.
As if she was trying to compete with it, Hisui knocks harder on the door.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ―――――
　そういう、コトか。
　この衝動。
　俺の意思を残したままで狂わせようとするこの衝動。
　これが。
　これがロアなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah―――――
So that’s it.
This impulse—this thing that means to
drive me mad without erasing my will.
Is this…
Is this Roa?
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*----
I see.
This impulse.
This impulse that tries to drive me insane while leaving me conscious.
This is,
This is Roa.

entries.japanese:
でもどうして。
少なくとも、俺はずっとマトモだったのに。
　この屋敷に帰ってくるまでは、本当に普通の人間だったのに。
　どんどん、とドアを叩く音がする。
　けれどそこを開けるワケにはいかない。
　開ければ、俺はそれで終わってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
But why? I was sane all this time.
Until I returned to this mansion, I was a perfectly ordinary human being.
Someone pounds on the door.
I cannot open it.
If I do, that will be the end of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But why?
I was always sane.
Until I came back to this mansion, I really was normal.
I hear heavy knocking on the door.
But I can't open it.
If I open it, it will be completely over.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　ようやくわかった。
　あの夢は、俺より一代前のロアの記憶だ。
　部屋に閉じこもって、そのあげくに両親を殺して、自分の住んでいた街を吸血鬼だらけにしてしまった、見知らぬ誰かの、最後の記憶。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah.”
At last I understand.
That dream was the memory of Roa’s previous incarnation: the final memory of a stranger who locked himself in his room,
murdered his parents, and filled his hometown with vampires.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
I finally understand.
That dream was the memory of the Roa one generation before mine.
Locked up in her room, killing both her parents, ruling over her town as a vampire, the final memories of someone I don't know.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……手段がない。
　コイツは、俺が自殺すれば解決するという問題でもない。
　こればっかりは、もうどうしようもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
…There is no way out.
This isn’t something my suicide would solve.
Nothing can be done about it now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… There's no way out.
This is not a problem that can be solved by killing myself.
This is nothing that can be helped.

entries.japanese:
前のヤツの気持ちがわかった。
　俺が死んだところで、死ぬのは俺のイシとやらだけだ。
そうなれば残ったロアのイシがこの体を完全に操るだろう。
　そうなれば―――もっと酷いコトになる。
「は―――はは、は」
　……もっとも、俺には自殺するなんていうつもりは微塵もないんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
I understand how the last one felt.
If I die, only whatever passes for my will would perish. Then Roa's surviving will would probably take complete control of this body.
That would be worse.
“Ha—haha… ha.”
…Not that I have the slightest intention of killing myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I understand that previous person's feelings.
Even if I die, the only thing to die would be my will.
Then the will of Roa would take over my body completely.
If that happened---things would get much worse.
"Ha---haha, ha."
…… In the first place, I don't have the slightest intention of killing myself.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、開けてください、志貴さま！」
　ドンドン、と扉の向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえる。
　……翡翠の声は、どこか知らない異国のコトバのように聞こえた。
　遠すぎる。
　たった一枚。
たった一枚の壁を隔てただけなのに。
　今はそれが、もう月と星の間ぐらい、遠く離れて聞こえていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, please open the door! Master Shiki!”
Bang, bang. Hisui's voice comes from the other side.
…Hisui's voice sounds like words from some unknown foreign country.
Far too distant.
Only one wall. A single wall is all that separates us.
Yet her voice now seems as distant as the moon from the stars.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please open up, Shiki-sama!"
I hear her voice from behind the door.
…… It almost sounds like it was in another language.

So far away.
Just one.
It's just one sheet of wood between us.
But it seems as far away as the moon and the stars.

entries.japanese:
午前十時になった。
　翡翠は諦めて引き下がった。
　かわるがわる、秋葉や琥珀さんがやってきて扉をノックしたが、すべて無視した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ten in the morning.
Hisui finally gives up and withdraws.
Akiha and Kohaku come in turns to knock on my door, but I ignore them both.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's now ten in the morning.
Hisui gave up and went back.
Akiha and Kohaku-san came and took turns knocking but I ignored them.

entries.japanese:
十二時。
　……腹がへった。
　けど、まだ大丈夫だ。
　シーツをかぶって、ガタガタと震える体を抱きしめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Noon.
…I’m hungry.
But I can still bear it.
Beneath the sheet, I hug my violently trembling body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Twelve o'clock.
…… I'm hungry.
But, I'm still fine.
I pull the sheets over me and hug my shaking body.

entries.japanese:
二時。
　……喉がかわいて、死にそうだ。
　時間の感覚が、少しおかしい。
　とてもゆったりと感じられる。
　興奮剤をうたれつづけているみたいに、体中が動き回りたくて暴れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Two o’clock.
…The thirst is killing me.
My sense of time has gone strange.
Everything feels terribly slow.
My whole body is rioting for movement, as though someone keeps pumping me full of stimulants.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Two o'clock.
…… I'm dying of thirst.
I've lost all sense of time.
It feels very calm.
But as if I was taking stimulants, my body wants to rage around.

entries.japanese:
四時。
　……またドアがノックされた。
　名前を呼ばれる。
　それが誰の声だったか、誰の名前を口にしているのか、どうしても判別できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Four o’clock.
…Another knock.
Someone calls a name.
I can’t tell whose voice it is, or even whose name they’re saying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Four o'clock.
…… More knocking.
A name being called out.
Whose voice is that?
Whose name are they calling?
I can't tell.

entries.japanese:
五時。
　段々と暗くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Five o’clock.
The room slowly darkens.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Five o'clock.
It slowly starts to get dark.

entries.japanese: 六時。
entries.maoEnglish: Six o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Six o'clock.

entries.japanese: 七時。
entries.maoEnglish: Seven o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Seven o'clock.

entries.japanese: 八時。
entries.maoEnglish: Eight o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Eight o'clock.

entries.japanese: ―――誰か、きた。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Someone’s here.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Someone, comes by.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、夕ごはんをもってきました。
朝から何も食べていないんじゃまいってしまいますよ」
　琥珀の声だ。
　どんどん、と扉をノックしている。
「もう、こうなったらお食事だけでも食べてもらいますからね」
　ガチャガチャ、という音。
　ドアをノックする音ではなく、鍵を開けているような、そんな音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I brought your dinner. You haven’t eaten since morning—you’ll make yourself ill.”
Kohaku.
She pounds on the door.
“All right, that does it. I’m going to make sure you eat something, at least.”
A metallic rattle follows.
It isn’t another knock. It sounds like someone working the lock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I've brought you dinner.
You haven't had anything since this morning, so you'll collapse you know."
Kohaku's voice.
She knocks on the door.
"Geez, if that's how it is, I'll get you to at least eat."
A rattling sound.
Not knocking, but the sound of a lock opening.

entries.japanese:
「ふふふ、最後の切り札マスターキーの出番ですよー」
「――――あ」
　カギが、開く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Heh heh heh. Time for my last and greatest weapon—the master key!”
“—Ah.”
The lock opens.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huhuhu, time to use my secret weapon, the master key!"
"----Ah."
The lock unlocks.

entries.japanese:
……扉が開く。
　もう遅い。
今から彼女を追い返しても、部屋の中に入られる事は変わらない。
――――それでも。
　食事を食べる、という行為は、できない。
　それはひどく牡的な喚起をさせて、かろうじて残っている『遠野志貴』という自分を、粉々に砕いてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
…The door opens.
Too late. Even if I order her away now, she’ll already have entered the room.
――――Even so, I cannot eat.
The very act would awaken something brutally male inside me and
shatter what little remains of the person called Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The door opens.
It's too late.
Even if I send her away, she's already come inside.
----But still.
I can't do the action called eating food.
It will get me too excited, and it will smash the remaining "Tohno Shiki" within me to pieces.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ……はあ……はあ……」
　息があがっている。
　なんとか。
　コレを、抑えつけないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hah… hah… hah…”
I can’t catch my breath.
Somehow.
I have to hold this thing down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*……
I breathe hard.
Somehow.
I have to resist it.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、中に入りますからねー……って、どうしたんですか、これ」
　彼女は笑顔のまま、そこらじゅうズタズタに裂かれた部屋を見て驚く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I’m coming in now… Oh. What happened in here?”
Still smiling, she stares in surprise at the room, slashed to ribbons from wall to wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I'm coming in…… wh, what happened?"
Still smiling, she looks in surprise at the room lying in shambles.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ……はあ……はあ……」
　恐れを知らない、可憐な顔立ち。
　俺をまったく警戒していない、無防備すぎる姿。
　赤い髪と―――うっとりするぐらい生々しい、美味そうな肌。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hah… hah… hah…”
That sweet face, innocent of fear.
That defenseless body, utterly unwary of me. Red hair—and skin so warm and vividly alive that it looks intoxicatingly delicious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*……
Her cute face devoid of fear.
Her completely unguarded, defenseless figure.
Her red hair----and her delicious-looking skin.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん……？
　おかしいですよ、なにがあったらこんなふうになっちゃうんですか」
　笑顔のまま、彼女はベッドの上に丸まった俺に近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…? Something’s wrong. What could have happened to leave you like this?”
Still smiling, she approaches me where I lie curled on the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san……?
This is strange, how did all of this happen?"
Still smiling, she draws closer to where I lie curled on the bed.

entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――――――――――――Hurry.
No.
――――――――――――――Hurry.
        That's not it.

I've---done such a terrible thing to Kohaku-san, but it never seems to end.
The truth is… my regret is already fading as I look at Kohaku-san's neck.
Her white neck.
Put my teeth at her throat and.

entries.japanese:
「――――はは」
　壊れた。
「あは、あはは」
　もう、本当に壊れた。
　俺は、ダメだ。
　これ以上―――正気でいられる自信がない。
「あはは、あはははは」
　外。
　外に出ないと。
　このままじゃ琥珀さんを殺してしまう。
　屋敷にいれば秋葉や翡翠にも手をかけてしまう。
　だから、またあの衝動が来る前に、消えないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Haha.”
Broken.
“Aha… ahaha.”
I’m broken. Truly broken now.
I’m finished.
I can’t trust myself to stay sane any longer.
“Ahaha… ahahahaha.”
Outside.
I have to get outside.
If I stay, I’ll kill Kohaku.
If I remain on this estate, I’ll turn on Akiha and Hisui too. I have to disappear before that impulse returns.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Haha."
I broke apart.
"Aha, ahaha."
I really broke down.
I'm done.
No longer---do I have the confidence to stay sane.

"Ahaha, ahahahaha."
Outside.
I have to go outside.
If I stay here, I'll kill Kohaku-san.
If I stay in the mansion.
I'll kill even Akiha and Hisui.
So before those urges come again, I have to disappear.

entries.japanese:
「あははははははははは！」
　早く。
　誰もいないところ。
　誰もいないところ行かないと、また俺は狂ってしまう――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahahahahahahahaha!”
Hurry.
Somewhere with no one.
I have to go somewhere empty, or I’ll go mad again—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahahahahahaha!"
Quickly.
A place where no one is.
I have to go to a place where no one is or I'll go crazy again----

entries.japanese:
屋敷の外に出る。
　……なんてことだろう。
　まわりには誰もいないのに、人の気配を感じる。
　建物。
まわりにある家々から、人の気配を感じ取っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I leave the mansion.
…This is terrible.
The streets around me are empty, yet I can sense people everywhere—in the buildings, in every house nearby.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave the mansion.
…… What the hell is going on?
Even though there's no one around, I can feel the presence of people.
Buildings.
From the houses around me, I sense people.

entries.japanese:
「はあ――――はあ――――――」
　こんな人が沢山いるところにいると、また堪えきれなくなる。
　どこか―――どこか周りに誰も存在していないところに行かないと安心できない。
　誰もいないところ。
　周りに誰も住んでいないところ。
　……俺が狂ってしまっても、誰にも迷惑のかからないところ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—”
Surrounded by this many people, I’ll lose control again.
I need somewhere—anywhere without another person around.
Somewhere empty.
Somewhere no one lives.
…Somewhere my madness cannot hurt anyone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*----*pant*------
With all these people here, I won't be able to hold back again.
Somewhere---I have to go somewhere without any people around or I'll never be able to calm down.
Where no one is.

Where there's no residences nearby.
…… Somewhere, where even if I go crazy again, I won't cause anyone any trouble.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ……はあ………」
　公園には誰もいない。
　ここならまわりに家もない。
　……誰もいないはずなのに、落ち着かない。
　いくら離れていても、人々の家がまわりにある。
　遠くには街の明かりが見えている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hah… hah…”
The park is empty.
There are no houses immediately around it.
…Yet I cannot relax.
However distant, people’s homes still surround me. The lights of the city shine beyond the trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*………
There's no one else in the park.
There's no houses nearby.
…… No one's supposed to be here, but I still can't calm down.
No matter how far away they are, there are houses all around here.
I can see the lights of town in the distance, too.

entries.japanese:
「あるわけ、ない」
　そう、あるわけがなかった。
　街の中で、人間の気配がまったくしない場所なんてあるわけがなかった。
　本当の意味で一人になることなんて、文明の発達した街じゃもう不可能なコトだったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There… isn’t anywhere.”
Of course there isn’t.
There can be no place inside a city where every trace of humanity vanishes.
In a city built by civilization, true solitude is no longer possible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It doesn't, exist."
Yeah, it doesn't exist.
There's no place in a city where you can't sense any presence of humans.
There's really no place where I can truly be alone in this civilized city.

entries.japanese:
「く――――そ」
　まわり。
　まわりには人間が沢山いて、少し歩くだけで、獲物なんていくらでも手に入る。
「だま―――れ」
　頭がいたい。
　せっかく、あの忌々しい『線』が視えなくなったっていうのに、これじゃまた視えるようになってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn… it.”
Everywhere.
People are everywhere, and all I need do is walk a little way to find all the prey I could want.
“Shut… up.”
My head hurts.
The cursed “lines” had finally vanished, but at this rate they’ll return.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn-----it."
All around me.
So many people all around me.
If I walk just a little, I can catch all the prey I want.
"Shut---up."
My head hurts.
Even though I finally don't see the "lines" anymore, I'll start to see them again like this.

entries.japanese:
「――――え」
　待ってくれ志貴。
　それはおかしいだろ。
　だって俺は、気が昂ぶっていたから『線』を視ていたというワケじゃないハズだ。
　『線』はどうしたって、メガネがなければ視えてしまうものなんだ。
　だからいくら今は落ちついていても、メガネがなければ視えてしまう。
　けど俺はメガネを落として―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“—What?”
Wait, Shiki.
That makes no sense.
I wasn’t seeing the “lines” because I was agitated.
Without my glasses, I see them no matter what.
Even calm, I should see them if I’m not wearing my glasses.
But I dropped them—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
Wait, Shiki.
Isn't this strange?
Because it's not like I was seeing these "lines" because I was excited.
Those "lines" are things I can't help but see when I don't have my glasses on.
So even if I'm calmed down, I would still see them if I don't have my glasses on.
But I have dropped my glasses---

entries.japanese:
「――――あ、る」
　指で顔を触ってみれば、メガネはずっと顔にかかったままだった。
　ようするに、俺は。
　先生にもらったメガネをかけていても、もう自分の視力を制御できないというコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—They’re…
here.” My fingers touch my face.
The glasses have been there all along.
So even wearing the glasses she gave me, I can no longer control my sight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----They're… here."
I bring my fingers to my face and find out my glasses were there all along.
In other words,
Even if I wear the glasses Sensei gave me, I cannot control my eyes anymore.

entries.japanese:
「は―――はは」
　思い知った。
　ロアの言っていたとおり、俺一人気がついていないだけで、遠野志貴はとっくに狂っていた。
　あの夜。
　シエル先輩を陵辱していたヤツを、心の底から殺してやると思ったあの時から。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha…
haha.”
Now I know. Roa was right.
Shiki Tohno went mad long ago; I was the only one who failed to notice.
It began that night, the moment I wished from the bottom of my heart to kill the one violating Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha---haha."
I am hit with the truth.
Just like Roa said, I just didn't realize that I was already insane.
That night.
Ever since that time when I wanted from the bottom of my heart to kill that bastard who was disgracing Ciel.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか……それじゃあ、あの時の頭痛は」
　ロアと殺しあっていた時の頭痛。
　メガネを外した覚えもないのに死の『線』が視えていて、シエル先輩にメガネを探してもらったあの夜。
　あの時から、俺は―――メガネをしていても、俺の意思とは無関係に『線』が視えるようになっていたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Then… that headache…”
The headache when Roa and I were killing each other.
That night I saw the “lines” of death without remembering taking off my glasses, and had Ciel search for my glasses.
Since that night, have the “lines” been forcing themselves into my sight regardless of my will—even through the glasses?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh…… then, the headache from that time was……"
The headache from when I was fighting Roa.
When I saw those "lines" of death even when I don't remember taking off my glasses, and when I got Ciel-senpai to go find them for me.
Since that time, I---even when I wore my glasses, regardless of what my intentions were, I've been able to see those "lines".

entries.japanese:
「……先輩……知ってた、んだ」
　いや、きっと黙っていてくれたのか。
　俺を心配させないように、俺の勘違いを嘘で守ってくれていた。
「……そうだ……先……輩」
　何かあったら相談してください、ってあの人は言ってくれた。
　電話番号なんか、とっくに暗記している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Ciel…
knew.” No.
She must have kept quiet for my sake—kept my misconception intact with a lie so I wouldn't worry.
“…That's right… Ciel…”
She told me to come to her if anything happened.
I memorized her telephone number long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai…… knew."
No, she probably just didn't tell me.
So as not to worry me, she lied to protect my mistaken perceptions.
"…… I see…… Sen…… pai."
She told me to talk to her if anything happened.
I've already memorized her phone number.

entries.japanese:
「電話―――」
　すぐ近くに公衆電話がある。
　けど―――電話をしてどうするんだ？
　俺の体は誰にも治せない。
　いくらシエル先輩だって、俺の中身までは治してくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The telephone…”
There is a public phone close by.
But what would calling accomplish?
No one can heal this body.
Not even Ciel can mend what is inside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Phone---"
There's a payphone nearby.
But---what am I going to do by calling her?
No one can heal my body.
Even Ciel-senpai can't heal what's inside me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　……できない。
　こんな、殺人鬼じみた自分を、あの人に見てほしくない。
　誰にも救えない。
　誰にも助けを求められない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
…I can’t.
I can’t let her see me like this, some kind of murderer.
No one can save me.
I can’t ask anyone for help.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… I can't do it.
I don't want her to see me like this… like a killer.
No one can save me.
I can't ask anyone for help.

entries.japanese:
この衝動。
自分の中にいる『ロア』を消す方法は、きっと一つぐらいしかない。
　夢で見た、一代前の誰かのように。
　あの白い吸血姫に殺されるか、それとも――――これ以上犠牲者を出さないうちに、自分の手で、幕を閉じるべきなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
This urge. There was only one way to erase the Roa inside me: death.
Like the previous incarnation I saw in that dream.
Either the white vampire princess had to kill me—or, before there were any more victims, I had to bring down the curtain with my own hands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This impulse.
There can only be one way to eliminate this "Roa" inside of me.
Like that previous person I saw in that dream.
I can be killed by that white vampire princess, or---- in order to prevent any more victims from appearing, I can lower the curtain on myself.

entries.japanese:
「―――く」
　……いや、まだだ。
　まだ俺は残っている。
　まだ俺は誰もこの手にかけていない。
　なら―――方法はあるハズだ。
　こんな所で終われない。
　街に巣くっていた吸血鬼は倒した。
　先輩だって残ってくれた。
　俺は、夢みたいに幸せになったんだ。
　だから―――まだ、この夢から覚められない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ghh.”
…No. Not yet.
Some of me was still here.
These hands had not killed anyone yet.
So there had to be another way.
I couldn’t end here.
I had defeated the vampire nesting in the city.
Ciel had stayed behind.
I had found a happiness so perfect it felt like a dream.
So—I couldn’t wake from that dream yet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Kk."
…… No, not yet.
There's still some of me remaining.
I haven't killed anyone yet.
So---there has to still be a way.
I can't end here.
The vampire in this city is gone.
And Senpai is still here.
I became happy, like in a dream.
So---I can't wake from this dream yet.

entries.japanese:
生きているかぎり。
　自分が残っているかぎり、ギリギリまでこの化け物をどうにかする方法を探すべきだ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
As long as I was alive.
As long as some part of me remained, I had to search until the last possible moment for a way to deal with this monster—
entries.mirrorMoon:
As long as I live.
As long as there are pieces of me remaining, I have to look for a way to do something about this monster inside of me---

entries.japanese:
でも、会いたい。
　シエル先輩の声を聞きたい。
　今の自分が唯一人弱音を言えて、それを聞いてくれるひと。
　シエル先輩がいてくれるなら、俺はまだ遠野志貴でいられる。
entries.maoEnglish:
But I want to see her.
I want to hear Ciel’s voice.
She is the one person I can show my weakness to now—the one person who will listen.
As long as Ciel is there, I can still be Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, I want to see her.
I want to hear Ciel-senpai's voice.
The only one who I can talk to, the only one who will listen to me.
If she is there, then I can remain as Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　ダイヤルを回す。
　呼び出し音が三回鳴ったあと、受話器ごしにシエル先輩の声が聞こえた。
「はい、もしもし。
どなたですか？」
「……………」
　不思議だ。
　この人の声が、すごく温かく聞こえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I dialed the number.
After three rings, Ciel’s voice came through the receiver.
“Hello? Who is this?”
“……”
How strange.
Her voice sounded so warm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I turn the dial.
After three rings, I hear the receiver pick up and Ciel-senpai's voice.
"Hello?
Who is it?"
"………………"
It's strange.
Her voice seems… so warm.

entries.japanese:
「もしもし？
　おーい、聞こえてますかー？」
　とぼけた声。
　一度だけしか行ってないけど、シエル先輩が自分の部屋で受話器を持っている姿が想像できた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hello? Hellooo? Can you hear me?”
That cheerfully silly voice.
I had visited her room only once, but I could picture her there with the receiver in her hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hello?
Hey, can you hear me?"
Her questioning voice.
I've only been there once, but I can imagine her holding the phone in her room.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　言葉が出ない。
　何を言っていいのか、わからない。
　いや、やっぱり電話なんかするんじゃなかった。
　このひとを、俺なんかの問題に巻きこんじゃいけない。
　このまま――何も言わず、電話をきろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No words came.
I had no idea what to say.
No. I never should have called. I couldn’t drag her into a problem like mine.
I should hang up now without saying anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
I can't speak.
I don't know what to say.
I knew I shouldn't have called.
I can't get this person involved.
I should--just hang up without saying anything.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　もしかして遠野くんですか？」
「あ―――――――――」
　名前を呼ばれて、不意に、泣きそうになった。
「………はい」
　声がもれる。
「あ、やっぱり遠野くんじゃないですか。
どうしたんです、こんな夜更けに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? Is that you, Tohno?”
“Ah—”
The moment she called my name, I almost began to cry.
“…Yes.”
The word leaked from me.
“Ah, I knew it was you. What’s wrong, calling this late at night?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
Is that you, Tohno-kun?"
"Ah----------"
Hearing my name, I suddenly want to cry.
"……… Yes."
I slip out a response.
"Ah, I knew it was you, Tohno-kun.
Why are you calling this late?"

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　やめよう、と思った。
　当たり障りのない嘘を言って、また明日学校で、と告げて電話を切ろうと努力した。
　けど、どうしてもできなかった。
「先輩、俺、ダメ、みたいだ」
　かすれた声で呟く。
「――――遠野くん？」
　シエル先輩の声が凍りついたように、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I told myself to stop.
I tried to offer some harmless lie, say I would see her at school tomorrow, and hang up.
But I couldn’t.
“Ciel… I think I’m beyond saving.”
The words came out in a rasp.
“—Tohno?”
Her voice seemed to freeze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I tell myself to stop.
I tell myself to make up some excuse, tell her I'll see her tomorrow and hang up.
But, I can't seem to do that.
"Senpai, I, I think I'm not going to make it."
I speak in a fading voice.
"----Tohno-kun?"
It sounds like her voice froze.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、それどういう意味ですか？
　ダメって、なにがダメなんです？」
「――――だから、ダメなんだ。
　自分なりになんとかしてみようと努力はした。
けど無駄だった。
俺はアイツの言っていたとおり、ただの殺人鬼、みたいだ」
　それもとびきり質が悪い。
　今でも気を抜けば秋葉や翡翠の喉をナイフで切り裂きたいと思ってしまう。
　他の誰でもなく、身近な人々の血が見たいと思っている時点で――俺の理性は崩壊しかかっているんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, what do you mean? Beyond saving how?”
“―I mean exactly that.
I tried to deal with it in my own way, but it was no use. Just as he said, I’m nothing but a murderer.”
And a particularly rotten kind.
Even now, the instant I let my guard down, I want to slash open Akiha’s or Hisui’s throat with my knife.
If the blood I crave belongs not to strangers but to the people closest to me, then my reason is already coming apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, what do you mean?
What's wrong?"
"----I mean, I can't make it.
I tried to resist it.
But, it was useless.
Like he said, it seems like, I'm just a killer."
And a really bad one, too.
Even now, if I let my guard down, I want to slice my knife through Akiha's or Hisui's throat.
Not just someone off the street, but people close to me--My sanity is about to crumble away, I'm at the point of thinking such things.

entries.japanese:
「……どうすればいいんだろう。
俺、自殺なんてできない。
自分で自分を殺すなんて、そんなこと教わったこともない」
「……それで、今どこにいるんですか」
「公園。
人気がないところに来たつもりだけど、ここもダメだ。
まわりに家が多すぎて、どうかしそうだ」
「……わかりました。
これから学校に向かいますから、そこで落ち合いましょう。
学校なら周りに人家もありませんし、静かでしょう？」
「―――そうか―――学校なら、誰もいない」
「いいですね。
学校の校庭で待っていてください」
　ぶつ、と電話が切れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What am I supposed to do? I can’t kill myself. Nobody ever taught me how to kill myself.”
“…Where are you now?”
“At the park. I came somewhere deserted, but even here it’s no good. There are too many houses nearby. I feel like I’m going to lose control.”
“…All right. I’m going to the school. Meet me there. There aren’t any houses around it, and it should be quiet.”
“—The school… Right. No one will be there.”
“Good. Wait for me in the schoolyard.”
The line went dead with a click.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What should I do?
I can't kill myself.
I've never been taught how to kill myself."
"…… And, where are you right now?"
"In the park.
I wanted to go where there aren't any people, but there's too many houses nearby.
I'm, going crazy."
"…… I understand.
I'll head to the school so let's meet there.
There's no houses nearby, so won't it be quiet?"
"---That's right---at school, there won't be anyone there."
"Alright?
Please wait at the school grounds."
The line cuts off.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　公衆電話から出る。
　先輩―――シエル先輩に会える。
　会ってどうなるわけでもないけど、それでも会いたい。
「――――は、あ」
　また、体中が熱くなり始めた。
　学校に行くまで誰にも出会わないように願いながら、おぼつかない足取りで公園を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
I stepped out of the phone booth.
I would see her—see Ciel.
It wouldn’t change anything, but I wanted to see her all the same.
“—Haa…”
The heat began spreading through my body again.
Praying I would meet no one on the way, I staggered out of the park toward the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I exit the phone booth.
Senpai---I can see Ciel-senpai.
I don't think anything will change when I see her, but I still want to see her.
"----Gha, agh."
My body starts to get hot again.
Hoping I won't meet anyone on the way to school, I leave the park with uncertain steps.

entries.japanese:
学校は静まり返っている。
　あたりには人家もなくて、このあたりは本当に静かだ。
「はあ―――はあ、はあ――――」
　メガネを外して、校門を閉めている鍵をナイフで切断する。
entries.maoEnglish:
The school lay utterly still.
There were no houses nearby. This part of town really was quiet.
“Haa—haa…
haa—” I removed my glasses and sliced through the padlock on the school gate with my knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The school is dead quiet.
There's no houses nearby, so it's very quiet around here.
*pant*----*pant*, *pant*---

I take off my glasses and cut the lock on the school gate with my knife.

entries.japanese:
「あ」
　……信じられない。
　自分でも意識しないまま、俺はナイフをポケットに収めていたらしい。
　たぶん、きっと。
　いつでも人を殺せるように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
…I couldn’t believe it.
Without even realizing it, I must have slipped the knife into my pocket.
Probably—surely.
So that I could kill someone whenever I pleased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah."
…… I can't believe it.
Even without thinking about it, I seemed to have put my knife in my pocket.
Probably,
so that at any time, I can kill someone.

entries.japanese:
「は…………あ」
　グラウンドについたとたん、膝から地面に崩れ落ちた。
　膝をグラウンドの土につけて、倒れようとする体を両手で支える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa……ah.”
The moment I reached the schoolyard, my knees gave way.
I knelt in the dirt and caught my collapsing body on both hands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha………… ah."
I fall to my knees as soon as I get to the school grounds.
I brace myself off the ground using both my hands.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　体が熱い。
　けど、さっきまでの自分が自分でなくなるような感覚はない。
　きっと、
　琥珀さんを　汚して
　一時的に、衝動が収まったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
My body was burning.
But the sensation that I was becoming someone else had vanished.
It must be because—
I violated Kohaku,
and the urge subsided for a little while.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
My whole body is hot.
But, I don't feel like I am not me anymore.
Probably,
by violating Kohaku-san,
the impulse momentarily subsided.

entries.japanese:
「――――ぐ」
　胃液が逆流する。
　口の中が苦い。
　今日は何も口にしていないから、吐き出すものは酸味のきいた胃液だけだった。
「琥珀―――さん」
　謝って許されるコトじゃない。
　だから、謝ることなんてできない。
　俺はあの人に、この先どう償えばいいんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ghh.”
Stomach acid surged up my throat.
Bitterness flooded my mouth.
I hadn’t eaten all day, so there was nothing to vomit but sour gastric fluid.
“Kohaku…”
An apology could never earn forgiveness for what I had done.
That was why I could not apologize.
How could I ever make amends to her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gg."
Gorge rises in my throat.
My mouth tastes bitter.
I haven't eaten anything today, so all I can vomit is my stomach acid.
"Kohaku---san."
It isn't something forgiven with a mere apology.
So, I can't apologize.
How can I offer my atonement to her from now on?

entries.japanese:
もう、何日も前の話。
　アルクェイドを殺してしまって自暴自棄になっていた俺を、シエル先輩が助けてくれた。
　あの人は―――罪を犯す人と犯さない人がいるんじゃなくて、償える人と償えない人がいるだけだ、と教えてくれた。
　でも、どうすれば。
　犯した罪、傷つけた心というのは、償えるっていうんだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
That was days ago now.
After I killed Arcueid and fell into despair, Ciel saved me.
She taught me that the world was not divided into those who sinned and those who did not—only into those who could atone and those who could not.
But how?
How could anyone atone for a crime committed, for a heart wounded—?
entries.mirrorMoon:
That conversation so many days ago.
When Ciel-senpai helped me while I was in the depths of despair after I killed Arcueid.
That person---she told me that there weren't people who sinned and people who did not sin, but there are only people who can and who cannot atone for their sins.
But, what should I do?
My committed sin, the wounded mind, can it be atoned for----

entries.japanese:
「―――？」
　すう、とあたりが暗くなった。
　かっ、かっ、という足音。
　地面に手足をついていて下を見ていたから気付かなかったけど、誰かがこっちにやってくる。
　月明かりの下。
　その人の影が、四つんばいになっている俺にかかって暗くなったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—?”
The moonlight dimmed around me.
Clack. Clack. Footsteps.
I had been on all fours, staring at the ground, and hadn’t noticed anyone approaching.
Beneath the moon,
someone’s shadow had fallen over me where I knelt on all fours. Was that why it had grown dark?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---?"
It suddenly gets darker.
The sound of footsteps.
I didn't realize it since I was face down, but someone is coming.
Under the moonlight.
Did that person darken the sky with her shadow?

entries.japanese:
「懺悔の真似事ですか、遠野くん」
　どこか冷たい、シエル先輩の声。
「――――先輩」
　……本当に、来てくれた。
　ただ先輩の顔を見たくて、夜空をあおぐみたいに顔をあげる。
「――――え？」
―――それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Playing at confession, Tohno?”
Ciel’s voice carried an unfamiliar chill.
“—Ciel.”
…She had really come.
Wanting only to see her face, I raised my head as though looking up at the night sky.
“――――What?”
―――But what I saw…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Are you trying to repent, Tohno-kun?"
Ciel-senpai asks in a cold voice.
"----Senpai."
…… She, really came.
I want to see her face, so I lift my head like I'm looking up at the night sky.
"----Eh?"
---But this.

entries.japanese:
―――俺の知っている、
　　　シエルという人物ではなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――was not the
Ciel I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---This isn't,
the Ciel that I know.

entries.japanese:
剥き出しの腕にある、黒い十字架の入れ墨。
　冷たい、まるで知らない他人を見るような目。
　……無骨で、剥き出しで、見ているだけで寒気を呼びおこしそうな、先輩にはあんまりにも不似合いな凶器。
entries.maoEnglish:
A black cross tattooed on her bare arm.
Eyes as cold as if she were looking at a total stranger.
…And a crude, naked weapon whose mere appearance sent a chill through me—something grotesquely ill-suited to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her bare arms have the tattoo of a cross on them.
Her cold eyes, as if watching someone she doesn't even know.
…… Senpai bears an uncouth weapon with an aura of coldness that doesn't suit her.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――あ」
　……知っている。
　頭が、あの凶器がどんなものだか、知っている。
　アレはたしか―――第七聖典と呼ばれる、門外不出の外典の一つ。
「先―――輩？」
「やっぱり貴方がロアだったんですね、遠野くん」
　冷たい目のまま。
　先輩は、同じように冷たい声でそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah.”
…I know it.
Somewhere inside my head, I know what that weapon is. It is called the Seventh Holy Scripture, one of the apocryphal texts forbidden to outsiders.
“Ci—el?”
“So you really were Roa, Tohno.”
With the same cold eyes,
she spoke in the same cold voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Ah."
…… I know this.
Inside my brain, I know what weapon this is.
That has to be---what's called the Seventh Holy Scripture, one of the apocrypha that must never be removed from its resting place.
"Sen---pai?"
"As I expected, you were Roa after all, Tohno-kun."
With her frigid eyes,
Senpai speaks with a voice that is equally cold.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　ぞくり、と背筋が震える。
　ワケもなく。
いや、本能と理性が総動員して危険を報せてきて、思わず先輩から跳び退いた。
「――――――」
　先輩は固く口を閉ざしたまま、一歩、あの不吉な凶器を持ったまま近寄ってくる。
　……そこには、まったくといっていいほど隙がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
A shudder ran down my spine.
For no reason—no, because instinct and reason were screaming danger with one voice—I sprang away from her.
“—”
Her lips pressed into a hard line, Ciel advanced one step with that sinister weapon in her hands.
…Her stance offered no opening at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I start to feel a shiver up my spine.
For no reason.
No, my instincts and my brain work full force to tell me the danger, and I jump back.
"------"
Still with her mouth shut, she takes a step towards me with that ominous weapon.
…… She has no openings whatsoever.

entries.japanese:
下手に逃げれば。
　このまま背中を向けて走り出せば、自分の心臓がアレで貫かれて、転生もかなわぬまま消滅してしまうってわかってしまう。
　……俺の記憶には、そんな知識はありはしないというのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
If I made a careless run for it.
If I turned my back and fled, that weapon would pierce my heart and erase me beyond all hope of reincarnation; somehow, I knew it.
…Even though no such knowledge existed anywhere in my memories.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I run away hastily,
if I show my back to her, I know that thing will pierce my heart and I will disappear without the opportunity for reincarnation ever again.
…… Even though I don't even have that knowledge in my memories.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんで。
俺は、ただ―――」
　ただ、先輩に会いたかっただけなのに。
「わかってます。
ロアの意識が浮上しているんでしょう？
　なら、もう手遅れです」
　ざっ、と。
　もう一歩、無造作に近づいてくる。
　その姿はまるで―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Why? I only—”
I only wanted to see her.
“I understand. Roa’s consciousness is surfacing, isn’t it? Then it’s already too late.”
Scrape.
She took another casual step toward me.
She looked exactly like—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Why?
I just---"
I just… wanted to see Senpai again.
"I understand.
Roa is already surfacing, right?
Then it is too late already."
Lightly,
she takes another effortless step forward.
That figure looks like----

entries.japanese:
「―――おかしいよ先輩。
　それじゃあまるで―――俺を、殺そうと、しているみたいじゃないか」
「―――――」
　彼女は答えない。
　ただ、どこを狙えば確実に仕留められるのか、それだけが関心事のように俺を見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Something’s wrong, Ciel.”
“You look as if—as if you’re trying to kill me.”
“—”
She did not answer.
She watched me as though her only concern was where to strike for a certain kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are you doing, Senpai?
You look like---you're, going to kill me."
"-----"
She doesn't answer.
She just stares at me like she's trying to find out where she can aim to kill me quickly.

entries.japanese:
「―――先、輩」
　本気だ。
　この人は、本気で、俺を殺すつもりだ。
―――ギッ。
　殺される直前ということを感じとって、神経が軋みをあげる。
　脊髄はびりびりと悲鳴をあげて、首の後ろがギチギチとかじかんでいく。
　けど―――そんな死の恐れより、俺は。
　この人がどうしてそんなことを言うのか、本当に、信じられなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ci…el.”
She was serious.
She truly meant to kill me.
―――Creak.
My nerves recognized the instant before death and began to buckle.
My spinal cord shrieked with electric pain; the back of my neck seized tighter and tighter.
But more than the fear of death—
I simply could not believe she was saying these things to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Sen, pai."
She's serious.
She seriously, plans to kill me.
---Creak.
My nerves feel the imminent death before me.
My spine is screaming and the back of my neck is numbing.
But---more than this fear of death,
I can't believe this person is saying such things.

entries.japanese:
「――――なん、で？」
　わからない。
「先輩は、俺のために残ってくれるって、言ったのに」
「――――――」
　ぴたり、と。
　シエル先輩の足が止まる。
　彼女は俺を凝視したまま、クスリと、笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Why?”
I didn’t understand.
“You said you would stay for me.”
“—”
Abruptly.
Ciel stopped dead.
Still staring straight at me, she gave a tiny laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Why?"
I don't know.
"Senpai, you said you stayed here for my sake."
"------"
With a start,
Ciel-senpai's legs stop.
She looks at me and grins.

entries.japanese:
「貴方の人の良さは国宝級ですね。
人を信じるのはいいですが、もう少し冷静に物事を考えられたのなら逃げおおせることもできたのに」
「え―――」
「だいたい、どうしてわたしがこの学校に紛れこんでいたのか、その理由を一度も考えなかったんですか貴方は。
　わたしは別に、好きでこんなコトをしていたわけではないんですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Your trusting nature belongs in a museum. Faith in others is a fine thing, but if you had stopped to think more calmly, you might have escaped.”
“What—?”
“Did you never once wonder why I had infiltrated this school?
I certainly wasn’t doing it because I enjoyed pretending to be a student.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Your goodness really is a rare treasure.
It is a good thing to trust people, but if you were a little more composed and thought about it clearly, you could have maybe got away."
"Eh---"
"First of all, didn't you ever think about why I came to this school in the first place?
I didn't do it just because I wanted to, you know."

entries.japanese:
「――――――先、輩？」
「わたしの目的は『蛇』―――ロアを消滅させる事だと知っているでしょう。
　わたしがこの学校にやってきたのは、ここにロアの転生体がいるとわかったから。
けれど確たる証拠がなくて、しばらくその転生体の様子を見る必要があった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ci—el?”
“You know my purpose is to destroy the Serpent—Roa.
I came to this school because I learned Roa’s reincarnation vessel was here. But I had no conclusive proof, so I needed to observe the vessel for a time.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Sen, pai?"
"You knew my goal was to destroy 'The Serpent'---Roa.
Coming here to this school was because I knew Roa's reincarnated host was here.
But since I didn't know for sure, I needed to check things out for a while."

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれ、一体なにを―――」
　なにを口走ってるんだろう、この人は。
　わからない。
　まるで、てんで理解できない。
　先輩は困惑する俺を無視して話をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. What are you—?”
What was she talking about?
I didn’t understand.
I couldn’t understand a word of it.
Ciel ignored my confusion and continued.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute, what in the world are you---"
What is she babbling about?
I don't know.
I really can't understand what she's talking about.
She ignores my bewilderment and keeps talking.

entries.japanese:
「……前に教えてあげたでしょう、遠野くん。
ロアが転生先に選ぶ家系には条件があると。
　逆に言えば、その条件さえあっている家系を探せばいいだけ。
ロアの転生体の特定は、わかってしまえば容易なんですよ。
　その家系が旧い異能の血を継いでいるかは調べればすぐにわかります。
この街ではロアの転生先になるような家柄は一つしかなかった。
　ですから―――初めから誰がロアであるかは解っていたんですよ、わたし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I explained this before, Tohno. Roa chooses his reincarnation host according to certain conditions.
That means one need only find a family that satisfies them. Once those conditions are known, identifying his reincarnation vessel is easy.
Whether a family carries an ancient supernatural gift can be discovered with very little investigation. In this city, only one lineage qualified as a possible host for Roa.
So—I knew who Roa was from the very beginning.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I told you before, Tohno-kun.
Roa has requirements for the family he decides to reincarnate into.
If you think the other way around, you just have to look for families with those traits.
When you know that, finding him is very simple.
It's easy to find families that have special abilities passed down through their blood once you do a bit of research.
In this city, there is only one family that fits Roa's requirements.
So---I knew from the beginning who Roa was."

entries.japanese:
「―――――な」
　そんなのは、おかしい。
　初めから解っていたんなら、さっさとそいつを殺すか、掴まえるかすれ……ば……。
　初めから？
　誰であるか、わかって、いた……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Wh…”
That made no sense.
If she had known from the beginning, she should have killed that person at once, or captured them…
From the beginning?
She had known who it was…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Wha--"
That's strange.
If she knew from the beginning, she could have killed him or caught him right then……
From the beginning?
She knew, who it was……?

entries.japanese:
「そうです。
ほら、もういいかげん気がついたでしょう？
　わたしはね、遠野くん。
初めから、貴方を捕えるためにこの学校に紛れこんだんです」
「――――――――――――――」
　待て。
　それは、ちょっと、待って、ほしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. Surely you’ve realized it by now.
I infiltrated this school from the beginning in order to capture you, Tohno.”
“—”
Wait.
I needed her to wait—just for a moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Look, don't you realize it now?
You know, Tohno-kun.
I came to this school to catch you from the beginning."
"--------------"
Wait.
I just want, her to, wait.

entries.japanese:
「ですが、そこで少し間違いが起きてしまいました。
　……貴方の中のロアを刺激しないように遠くから監視していたんですが、どうも貴方はロアの転生先ではないと結論がでたんです。
　けど、ロアの転生先は絶対に遠野家の長男なんです。
それに間違いはありませんから、そうなると間違っているのは遠野くんのほうになる」
　シエル先輩は淡々と語る。
　俺は―――何も、言えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But then a small discrepancy arose.
—I watched you from a distance to avoid stirring the Roa inside you, and eventually concluded you were not his reincarnation host.
Roa’s host, however, had to be the eldest son of the Tohno family—that fact was beyond dispute. Which meant that you, Tohno, were the discrepancy.”
Ciel recited it all dispassionately.
I—could say nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, a little mistake happened.
…… I was watching you from afar so as not to stimulate Roa inside you, but I concluded that you might not be Roa's new reincarnated host.
But, the eldest son of the Tohno family had to be what Roa reincarnates into.
There is no mistake in that, so what had to be a mistake was you, Tohno-kun."
Ciel-senpai speaks matter-of-factly.
I---can't say anything.

entries.japanese:
「調べてみれば、遠野くんは八年前に大怪我をして親戚の家に預けられている。
　そのあとの出来事は二日前の夜、本当の遠野シキが言っていた通りです。
　八年前の遠野家で何があったのか知りませんが、遠野くんはあのシキという少年に殺された。
いえ、命を奪われたんでしょうね。
　結果として遠野くんはロアの転生先であるシキと繋がってしまった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My investigation showed that you suffered a grave injury eight years ago and were sent to live with relatives.
What happened afterward is exactly as the real SHIKI Tohno described two nights ago.
I don’t know what occurred in the Tohno household eight years ago, but that boy SHIKI killed you—or rather, took your life.
As a result, you became connected to SHIKI, Roa’s reincarnation host.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Looking into it, you were fatally wounded eight years ago and adopted by your relatives.
What happened afterwards was exactly as Tohno SHIKI said two nights ago.
I don't know what happened in the Tohno family eight years ago, but you were killed by that kid called SHIKI.
No, it's more like your life was stolen.
As a result, you became connected to SHIKI who was Roa's host."

entries.japanese:
感情のない声で、淡々と。
　それは俺の知らないシエル先輩だ。
　それとも、これが。
　これが本当のシエルで、今までの優しかったこの人は、全部――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Calmly, in a voice without feeling.
This was a Ciel I did not know.
Or was this the truth?
Was this the real Ciel, and had all the kindness she had shown me until now been nothing but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
A direct voice, without emotion.
I don't know this Ciel-senpai.
Or is this…
Is this the true Ciel, and the kind person I knew up until now was all just----

entries.japanese:
「これまで何度かシキを通じて遠野くんの中にロアの記憶が流れ込んでくる事もあったでしょう。
　もともと魂という、カタチに出来ないモノを加工した吸血鬼です。
ロアにとってみれば、一つの命を共有している貴方たちは良く出来た二重存在だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Roa’s memories must have flowed into you through SHIKI on several occasions.
Roa is a vampire who remade something as intangible as the soul. To him, the two of you sharing a single life made an ideal dual existence.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Up until now, there should have been times where Roa's memory would flow into you through SHIKI.
He is a vampire that manipulated the shapeless thing called a soul.
For Roa, you two who shared one life were a finely crafted double existence.

entries.japanese:
「だから―――シキの肉体が滅んでも、ロアは次の転生先に行く必要がない。
この時代には、まだ貴方という避難先があったんですから」
　冷たい。
　まるで仇を睨むように、彼女は俺を憎んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So even when SHIKI’s body was destroyed, Roa had no need to seek his next reincarnation host. In this age, he still had you as a refuge.”
Cold.
She hated me, glaring as though I were her bitterest enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why---when SHIKI's body was destroyed, Roa didn't need to reincarnate.
He still had a place to run to: you."
Cold.
As if hating her enemy, she detests me.

entries.japanese:
「でも、それも終わりです。
あの夜は突然の事で準備が出来ませんでしたが、今夜は違います。
　ある意味、わたしは幸運ですね。
あのままアルクェイドにロアが消されていたのなら、ロアはまた転生してしまったでしょうから」
　……信じ。
られない。
　そんなもの―――そんな、ものは
「――――うそ、だ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that ends tonight. I had no time to prepare when it all happened so suddenly that night, but tonight is different.
In a sense, I was fortunate. Had Arcueid destroyed Roa then and there, he would only have reincarnated again.”
—I couldn’t. Believe it.
That—none of that—
“—It’s a lie.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it's all over now.
I wasn't prepared to finish it so suddenly that one night, but tonight is different.
I really am fortunate in a way.
If Arcueid had destroyed Roa, he probably would have reincarnated again."
…… I can't.
Believe this.
That---that…
"----That's not, true."

entries.japanese:
「どうぞ、ご勝手に否定して、そこで惚けていてください。
そのほうがわたしの仕事も楽になります。
もっとも―――」
　かちゃり、とあの凶器が音をたてる。
「貴方がその気になっても楽に始末できることには変わりはありませんけどね、ロア」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Go ahead. Deny it and keep playing dumb right where you are. It will make my work easier. Although—”
The weapon answered with a metallic click.
“Even if you do decide to fight, you’ll still be easy to dispose of, Roa.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, please keep on denying it and play dumb.
That makes my job easier.
Still---"
A metallic rattle sounds from the weapon.
"It doesn't change the fact that I can finish you off easily no matter what you do, Roa."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　その、あざ笑うような声で、解った。
　……彼女の言葉に嘘はない。
　……彼女の目は『俺』を見ていない。
　……彼女の気持ちには初めから『俺』なんていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
The mockery in her voice made me understand.
…She had not told a single lie.
…Her eyes were not looking at me.
…There had never been any place for me in her heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Her laughing voice causes me to finally understand.
…… She isn't lying.
…… Her eyes aren't looking at "me".

…… Her feelings never did have anything to do with "me" from the beginning.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、それ。
　それじゃあ、それじゃあ先輩ははじめっから俺がロアだって当たりをつけてたのか。
　先輩が。
先輩が俺と仲良くしていたのは、全部……………！」
―――言えない。
　その先は、口にできない。
　そうしてしまえば、その瞬間に全ての出来事が嘘になってしまいそうで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What the hell is that supposed to mean?
So you had me marked as Roa from the very beginning?
Then you—everything you did to get close to me was all……!”
―――I couldn’t say it.
I could not give voice to the rest.
The instant I did, everything that had happened between us would become a lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What is this?
Then, then from the very beginning, you always thought of me as Roa?
Senpai.
Being friends with me was all just……………!"
---I can't say it.
I can't finish the sentence.
If I do that, I feel like everything will turn into a lie in that instant.

entries.japanese:
「当然でしょう。
シキが消えた後、わたしが学校に残ったのはロアが消えていなかったからです。
ロアがこの学校の生徒である以上、ここに残ったほうが何かと便利ですから」
entries.maoEnglish: “Naturally. I remained at the school after SHIKI disappeared because Roa had not. As long as Roa was one of its students, staying here was the most convenient course.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Of course.
After SHIKI was destroyed, the only reason why I stayed in school was because Roa had not disappeared.
Since Roa is a student here, it's more convenient for me to stay."

entries.japanese:
……わたしが遠野くんを置いて帰るわけがないじゃないですか。
　先輩はそう、笑顔で言った。
　アレは、俺のためじゃなくて。
　この人はまだ生きているロアを捜すために残って、その追跡者に、俺は自ら電話を入れたわけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
…You don’t honestly think I could leave you behind and go home, do you?
She had said those words with a smile.
They had not been for me.
She remained to hunt the still-living Roa—and I had called his pursuer myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I would never go back while leaving you here.
That's what she told me once with a smile.
That wasn't, for my sake.
She stayed here just to search for the still-living Roa.
That is the only reason why she gave me her phone number.

entries.japanese:
「――――は」
　じゃあ、あれも。
「はは―――」
　あの時のことも。
「はは――――は」
　あの夜、俺を救ってくれたのも。
「あ………は、は」
　あの、悲しそうな目も。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ha.”
Then that, too.
“Ha ha—”
That time as well.
“Ha ha—ha.”
That night, when she saved me.
“Ah… ha, ha.”
Even those sorrowful eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ha."
Then, that too.
"Haha---"
And those times, too.
"Haha----ha."
And when she saved me that one night, too.
"Ah……… ha, ha."
And, those sad eyes, too.

entries.japanese:
「はは――――は」
　……そうだ志貴、なんてコトはないじゃないか。
　こんな記憶―――きっと、どうというコトはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha ha—ha.”
…That’s right, Shiki. It was nothing. Memories like these couldn’t possibly mean a thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha---ha."
…… That's right, Shiki, this is nothing at all.
These memories---they are nothing at all.

entries.japanese:
ただ、愛してるって。
　愛されてるって、思っていただけの話。
　……まったくお笑いだ。
　そんなもの、芝居の上で作られた幻でしかなかった。
――――全部。
　全部、嘘でかためられた夢物語だっただけ――
entries.maoEnglish:
I had merely believed that I loved her.
That she loved me.
…What a joke.
It had been no more than an illusion manufactured for a performance.
――――All of it.
Nothing but a fairy tale built out of lies—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I just thought I loved her.
And that she loved me back.
…… What a joke.
They were all just an illusion made from a play.
----All of it.
All of it was a fairy tale made up of lies---

entries.japanese:
「―――納得いったよ。
けどさ、先輩。
　どうして先輩にはロアが生きているってわかるんだ。
どうして、どうして遠野志貴っていうヤツがロアの転生先だってわかったんだ」
「わかりますよ。
だって自分のことなんですから」
　しれっと、先輩は理解不能な事を言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—All right. I understand. But tell me, Ciel.
How did you know Roa was still alive? How did you know that someone called Shiki Tohno was his reincarnation host?”
“Of course I knew. It concerns me personally, after all.” Ciel gave that incomprehensible answer with complete nonchalance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I understand.
But, Senpai.
How did you know Roa was still alive?
How, how did you know Roa reincarnated into this Tohno Shiki?"
"Of course I knew.
Because it's about myself." Senpai says something I can't understand.

entries.japanese:
「……自分の、こと……？」
「ええ。
遠野という血筋を探し当てて、それを次の転生の候補に選んだのはわたしなんですから。
　……まあ、実際にロアの意識が浮上しないと『現れた』とわかりませんから、あまり役に立つ記憶ではありませんでしたけど」
「先輩、何を―――言ってるんですか、いったい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…It concerns… you?”
“Yes. I was the one who found the Tohno bloodline and chose it as a candidate for Roa’s next reincarnation.
…Admittedly, I cannot tell that he has ‘appeared’ until his consciousness actually surfaces, so the memory was not terribly useful.”
“Ciel… what in the world are you talking about?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… About yourself……?"
"Yes.
The one who sought out the Tohno family and chose it for the next host was me.
…… Well, unless Roa's consciousness awakens, I couldn't tell that it "appeared", so it wasn't that useful of a memory, though."
"Senpai, what---are you saying?"

entries.japanese:
「何って、ちょっとした昔話です。
　いまから八年前の話なんですが、遠野くんと同じように何も知らなかった少女がいたんです。
　彼女がその衝動に汚染されはじめたのは十六歳のころでした。
　……それまで何も。
その子は遠野くんみたいに特別な力なんてありませんでしたから、本当に何も知らないまま、普通に暮らしていたんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nothing more than an old story.
Eight years ago, there was a girl who knew as little as you do now.
The urge began corrupting her when she was sixteen.
…Until then, she had known nothing at all. She had none of your unusual powers, Tohno. She had simply lived an ordinary life, never suspecting a thing.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What am I saying?
It's an old story.
It's a story from eight years ago, but there was a girl like you who didn't know anything.

She was sixteen years old when that impulse began to stain her.
…… But before that, there was nothing.
She didn't have any special power like you did, Tohno-kun.
