She really did live a normal life without knowing anything.

entries.japanese:
「お父さんの手伝いをして、学校に行って。
　早起きするのが苦手で、お父さんの手伝いをするのはいつも夕方からのお店番でしたけど、それでも将来はお父さんのお店を受け継ごうって思ってたんですね」
「え―――」
　今、なにか。
　見た事がなくて、けど見た覚えのある風景が頭に浮かんだ。
　先輩の話は、なんだか―――俺が見た夢に、とても似ている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She helped her father and went to school.
She was terrible at waking early, so she always worked the evening shift in his shop. Even so, she meant to inherit it from him one day.”
“What—?”
For an instant,
a scene I had never seen—and somehow remembered—rose inside my head.
Ciel’s story felt terribly similar to the dream I had seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Helping out her father, going to school.
Terrible at waking up early but always helping with the store in the evening.
She really did think she would carry on her father's work."
"Eh---"
Just now.
Scenery I have never seen before flashes in my head… yet I feel like I have in fact seen it somewhere.
Her story---feels like it's very similar to that dream I saw.

entries.japanese:
「でも、その子の夢は叶わなかった。
当たり前のようにあった幸せを、自分の手で壊してしまったんです。
　その子は、ロアの転生体でしたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But her dream never came true. With her own hands, she destroyed the happiness she had always taken for granted.
Because that girl was Roa’s reincarnation vessel.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, her dream wasn't fulfilled.
With her own hands, she destroyed the happiness that was there naturally.
Because she was Roa's reincarnated host."

entries.japanese:
「少女の体はすごく才能があるって、ロアは喜んでましたっけ。
　その子もいまの遠野くんみたいにそれなりに努力はしたんですけど、無駄な努力でした。
結局お父さんとお母さんの血を吸って、街の人たちをゆっくりと殺していって。
　その子、もしかしたらその時に気がふれてしまったのかもしれませんね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Roa was delighted by how much potential the girl’s body possessed.
She struggled against him, much as you have, but all her efforts were wasted. In the end she drank her father’s blood, then her mother’s, and slowly murdered the people of her town.
Perhaps that was when the girl lost her mind.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Her body had great ability and Roa was pleased.
She tried so hard to resist it just like you, but it was useless.
In the end, she drank the blood of her father and mother and slowly killed the townspeople.
That child, maybe she went crazy then."

entries.japanese:
「わかるでしょう遠野くん？
　
　アレって止めようがないんです。
やめよう、とかいけない、とか、そういう考えさえ浮かばなくなる。
　おかしいですよね。
―――ちゃんと、自分の意識はあるっていうのに」
「せ―――ん、ぱい。
それは、その話は、まさか」
「でも悪夢はわりあい早く終わりました。
白い女性がやってきて、少女の心臓を貫いたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You understand, don’t you, Tohno?
That urge cannot be stopped. Eventually, thoughts like I must stop or this is wrong no longer occur to you at all.
Strange, isn’t it?—Your own consciousness is still perfectly intact.”
“Ci—el… This story, you can’t mean—” “But the nightmare ended relatively quickly. A woman in white came and pierced the girl’s heart.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You understand, right, Tohno-kun?
You can't stop it.
"Stop" or "You shouldn't" doesn't even enter your thoughts.
Isn't it strange?
---Even though you still have your conscious awareness."
"Se---n, pai.
Don't tell me, that story is,"
"But that nightmare came to an end soon.
That woman in white came and pierced her heart."

entries.japanese:
―――ああ、知っている。
　そうして少女は死んでしまって、ロアは遠野シキっていうヤツに転生した。
　でも、それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes. I know this.
The girl died, and Roa reincarnated into someone called SHIKI Tohno.
But that meant…
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Yeah, I know.
So the girl died, and Roa reincarnated as Tohno SHIKI.
But, that's.

entries.japanese:
「けど、その子、死にきれなかったんです」
　ぽつりと。
　笑うように、彼女は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Except the girl failed to stay dead.”
She said it softly,
almost with a laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, that girl, she couldn't stay dead."
Quietly.
Almost laughingly, she says this.

entries.japanese:
「少女の死体は教会に運ばれて、吸血種から人間に戻った死体のサンプルとして保存されました。
　……けど、どういう因果だか知りませんけど、その子の躯というのはすごく特殊な躯で、人並み以上の蘇生能力があったんです。
　その子は三年たったある日、よせばいいのに死から目覚めてしまったんです。
　……おかしいですよね、ロアという魂に見捨てられたただの脱け殻のくせに生きかえっちゃうんですもの。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Her corpse was taken to the Church and preserved as a specimen—a body that had reverted from a vampiric species to a human being.
…But through some twist of fate, the girl’s body was exceptionally unusual. It possessed powers of resurrection far beyond those of an ordinary human.
Three years later, when it would have been better for everyone if she had not, she awoke from death.
…Absurd, isn’t it? An empty shell abandoned by the soul called Roa, and yet it came back to life.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Her dead body was taken to The Church and preserved as a sample of a vampire returning to human form.
…… But, though I don't know what kind of fate it was, her body was a special body, and had an abnormal reviving ability.
One day three years later, even though she shouldn't have, she came back from the dead.
…… It's strange, isn't it?
Even though it was just a discarded shell of Roa's soul, it still came back to life.

entries.japanese:
「そのあとはタイヘンでした。
教会の人たちは異端者だってその子を何度も何度も殺すんですけど、どうやっても死なないんです。
　……ごめんなさい、恨み言を言っていいですか？
　その子はね、一ヶ月もただ殺されるだけの生活を送ったんですよ。
一日の休みも、たった少しの休みもなく、生き返った瞬間に殺されるっていう毎日を」
entries.maoEnglish:
“After that, things became rather unpleasant. The people of the Church branded her a heretic and killed her again and again, but no matter what they did, she would not die.
“…Forgive me. May I indulge in one bitter complaint? For an entire month, that girl knew no life but being killed. Not one day of rest, not even a moment. Every time she revived, they killed her again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After that, things were… difficult.
The Church viewed the child's existence as heresy and killed the child, but no matter how many times they killed her, she wouldn't die.
…… I'm sorry, can I complain a bit?
That girl, she underwent an entire month of life only being killed.
Every single day, without even a single moment of rest, she came back to life only to be killed once more.
Every day, all day."

entries.japanese:
「………………な」
　死ねない、体。
　どうあっても元通りになる肉体。
　遠野シキに転生したロアという吸血鬼は、この人をそう罵倒していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………What?”
A body that could not die.
Flesh that restored itself no matter what happened to it.
The vampire Roa, reincarnated as SHIKI Tohno, had taunted her with those very words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… What…"
A body that can't die.
Flesh that will return to its original state no matter what happens.
Roa, the vampire reincarnated as Tohno SHIKI, said that about this person.

entries.japanese:
……痛そうだった。
　どんな傷を受けても治るというけど、先輩は、傷をうけるたびに苦痛で顔をゆがませていた。
　それを、毎日？
　毎日、一日の間に休む事なく、殺されて生き返るだけの生活を送ったって……？
entries.maoEnglish:
…It had looked painful.
Her wounds might always heal, but every injury twisted Ciel’s face in agony.
And that happened every day?
All day, every day, without a moment’s rest—nothing but dying and returning to life?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It seemed so painful.
Senpai healed no matter what wound she received, but every wound she got caused her face to contort in pain.
Every day of that?
Every day, all day without a single pause, living to be killed and coming back again……?

entries.japanese:
「それでですね、教会の人たちもいくらなんでもコレはおかしいって気がついてくれました。
　対処できない問題、解決できない問題はみんな埋葬機関っていうところに回されるんです。
　そこで、その子は自分がどうなってしまったのか教えられました。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eventually, the people of the Church realized that even by their standards, something was wrong.
Every problem they cannot handle or resolve is passed on to an organization called the Burial Agency.
There, the girl was finally told what had happened to her.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And then, the people of The Church finally realized this was too strange.

All the problems that no one can deal with or solve are handed to the place called the Burial Agency.
There, she was taught what happened to her.

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、ようするにその子は矛盾しているんです。
　その子はロアとして生まれた人間です。
たとえ十五歳までの人格が一人前の人格だっていっても、魂の名前はロアなんです。
　その子はその子でありながら、ロアでもある。
　だから、ロアが生きているのにロアであるその子が死んでいては矛盾している。
　ロアという存在が生み出す子孫……娘であるその少女は、ロアより先に死ぬ事はできないんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…In short, the girl is a contradiction.
She was born as a human being who was also Roa. Her personality may have grown into a complete person during her first fifteen years, but the name of her soul is Roa.
She is herself, yet she is also Roa.
So while Roa lives, it would be a contradiction for the girl who is Roa to remain dead.
The girl is an offspring—a daughter—produced by Roa’s existence. She cannot die before Roa does.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… In short, she was a contradiction.
She was a human born as Roa.
Even though the personality of her first fifteen years was hers, the name of her soul was Roa.
While she was herself, she was also Roa.
So, it is a contradiction if the girl called Roa is dead when Roa is alive.
The progeny of the existence Roa…… this daughter of Roa cannot die before him.

entries.japanese:
「この世界はわずかな綻びがあれば、世界が世界自身のためにその綻びを修復します。
　ですから――その子は、ロアという転生する魂が消えないかぎり、永遠にそこにあり続けてしまう。
　他の誰でもない、この世界がかってに『治して』しまうんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Whenever the slightest flaw appears in this world, the world repairs it for its own sake.
So until the reincarnating soul called Roa disappears, the girl must continue to exist forever. The world itself, of its own accord, keeps ‘healing’ her.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Whenever this world has even a slight error, this world corrects it to preserve itself.
So--that child, as long as Roa's soul still exists, will exist for all eternity.
No one else but the world itself "fixes" the error automatically.

entries.japanese:
「司祭殿はその子を『輪から外れている』と言っていました。
ロアが生きているかぎり永遠に止まったまま。
　歳をとることもできませんから寿命では死ねませんし、消し炭にしても時間が巻き戻って元に戻ってしまう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The priest said she had ‘fallen outside the cycle.’ As long as Roa lives, she remains eternally fixed in place.
She cannot age, so her lifespan cannot kill her; even if she is burned to ash, time rewinds and restores her.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The clergy said the child was 'outside the cycle'.
As long as Roa lives, it will forever be stopped.
She cannot die of old age since she cannot age, and even if she was burnt to ashes, time would reverse itself to return it to its original state."

entries.japanese:
「そんな怪物、本来ならずっと幽閉されたままでしょうけど、その子はロアだったころの魔術の知識とか引き継いでいたんです。
　埋葬機関の司祭殿は利用価値があるといって、その子を教会に迎え入れてくれました。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ordinarily, a monster like that would remain imprisoned forever. But the girl had inherited the knowledge of magecraft she possessed while she was Roa.
The priest of the Burial Agency judged her useful and welcomed her into the Church.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Such a monster… it usually would have been sealed away forever, but she happened to inherit the magical knowledge of Roa.
The clergy of the Burial Agency said she would be useful and brought her into The Church.

entries.japanese:
「それから五年。
生き残ってしまった脱け殻はかつての名前を捨てて、吸血鬼を退治するための生き方を選んだんです。
―――わたしはロアの主であるアルクェイドよりも、ロアという魂が何処に居るかを知覚することができます。
　その理由は、もう言うまでもないでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Five years have passed since then. The shell that survived abandoned its old name and chose a life devoted to hunting vampires.
―――I can sense where the soul called Roa resides more clearly than Arcueid, Roa’s master.
By now, I hardly need explain why.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Five years since then.
She chose to discard her name and live as one who hunted vampires.
---More than Roa's master Arcueid, I can tell where Roa's soul exists.
The reason… I don't even have to tell you, right?"

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　そう、言うまでもない。
　けどそんな事、認めたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
No. She did not need to explain.
But I refused to accept it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Right, it doesn't need to be said.
But, I don't want to admit such a thing.

entries.japanese:
「前に言いましたよね、遠野くん。
シエルの目的はただ一つだって」
　――わたしは、人間として死にたいから――
　あの時、それがどんな意味なのか、解らなかった。
　けど今なら。
　今なら、少しは―――理解ができるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you before, didn’t I, Tohno? Ciel has only one purpose.”
――Because I want to die as a human being—
Back then, I had not understood what those words meant.
But now—
now, perhaps I understood a little.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I said it before, Tohno-kun.
Ciel's goal is one thing and one thing only."
--I want to die as a human--
I didn't understand what those words meant then.
But now.
Now---can I understand at least a bit of it?

entries.japanese:
「――――できない」
　ああ、悔しいぐらい、できっこない。
　俺には死にたいなんていう気持ちがわからない。
　生きている以上―――死にたいと思うことぐらいはあるけど、心の底から願うことなんてない。
　けど、先輩はそれだけが望みなんだ。
　そうなってしまった思考。
　そんなことしか望めなくなるような人生。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—No. I don’t understand.”
Damn it, I couldn’t possibly understand.
I did not know what it meant to want death. As long as you are alive, you may feel that way sometimes—but I had never wished for it from the bottom of my heart.
Yet that was Ciel’s only wish.
A mind reduced to that one desire.
A life that had left her capable of wishing for nothing else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I can't."
It's almost regretful, but I can't.
I can't understand that feeling of wanting to die.
As long as I'm alive---I'll think about wanting to die, but I would never truly mean it.
But, that's all Senpai wishes for.
A way of thinking which was transformed into that.
A life that makes you wish only that.

entries.japanese:
俺はまだ知らない。
　自分の手で。
　自分の意思が残ったままで、大切な人たちを殺してしまう痛みを、知らない。
　……そんなもの、一生涯知りたくはない。
　でもこの人はその上にいる。
　だから―――ただ、死にたいと思うのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I still do not know.
I have never known the pain of killing the people I love
with my own hands while my own will remains awake inside me.
…I never want to know it, not for as long as I live.
But she has already passed beyond that pain.
Is that why—she wishes only to die?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know yet.
With my own hands.
I don't know the pain of killing the ones close to me with my own hands even while still conscious.
…… And I don't ever want to know it.
But this person has lived through it.
So---is that why she just wants to die?

entries.japanese:
「違う……そんなのは、違う」
「違わないですよ。
わたしは、人並みに死にたいだけなんですから」
　先輩の声はどこまでも冷たい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No… that isn’t right.”
“It is. I only want to die the way any ordinary person can.”
Ciel’s voice was utterly cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's…… that's wrong."
"It's not.
I simply want to die as a human."
Her voice sounds cold.

entries.japanese:
「………………だ」
　……俺は、頷くしかない。
　彼女の望みも。
　彼女が得てしまった苦しみも、わかってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………You’re right.”
…I could only nod.
I understood both her wish
and the suffering she had been forced to bear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… I…"
…… I can only nod.
Both her wish,
and her pain, I understand.

entries.japanese:
「…………いや、だ」
　なにもかも、俺の境遇もシエルの望みもイヤだ。
　こんなもの―――現実だなんて思いたくない。
　けど、現実は待ってくれない。
　ガチャリと音をたてて。
　シエルという代行者が、俺を殺すために踏み込んできた。

もう、これ以上語る言葉もなければ、語る必要もないと。
　シエルの両腕が、あの『凶器』を持ち上げた。

第七聖典。
　輪廻転生を否定する教会が作り上げた、転生批判のあらゆる弾劾を記した教本。
　聖典でありながら外典、教本でありながら凶器という曰くつきの一品だ。
　アレに撃たれれば、魂そのものが霧散する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………No.”
I hated all of it—my own fate, and Ciel’s wish. I didn’t want to believe any of this was real.
But reality did not wait.
With a metallic clack,
the executor called Ciel stepped forward to kill me.
There was nothing left to say and no reason to say it.
Ciel raised the weapon in both hands.
The Seventh Holy Scripture.
A catechism created by the Church that denies reincarnation, inscribed with every indictment ever leveled against the cycle of rebirth.
Holy scripture yet apocryphon, textbook yet weapon—a singular object with a sinister history.
If it shot me, my soul itself would scatter into mist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… I don't want it."
I don't like my treatment or Ciel's wish.
I don't want to think this is reality.
But, time waits for no one.
With a metallic rattle,
the agent called Ciel steps forward to kill me.

As if saying there's no need to talk anymore,
Ciel's hands lift up that weapon.

The Seventh Holy Scripture.
The weapon that the reincarnation-denying Church created.
A scriptural canon inscribed with every possible impeachment of reincarnation criticism.
It's an item that is scripture yet an apocrypha.
A weapon, yet a scripture at the same time.
If I'm hit by that, my soul itself will disperse into nothingness.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　銃剣が跳ねあがる。
　その切っ先がこちらに走る。
　なぜか、ゆったりと。
　彼女なら―――シエルなら、俺が刺されたと気がつく間もないぐらいのスピードで、突き刺す事が出来るはずなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
The bayonet sprang up.
Its point swept toward me.
Slowly, for some reason.
She—Ciel—should have been able to drive it through me before I even realized I had been stabbed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
The bayonet rises up.
The tip comes towards me.
But slowly.
If it is Ciel---she should be able to pierce me without me even noticing it ever happened.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　考える余裕はない。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
There was no time to think.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
There's no time to think.
I----

entries.japanese:
―――とっさに、後方に跳んでいた。
　軽く後ろに跳び退く。
　それだけで、俺と先輩の距離は何メートルも離れていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――On instinct, I leap backward.
It is only a light hop,
yet it puts several meters between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I jump back instantly.
With just lightly jumping back,
I increase the distance between us to many meters.

entries.japanese:
「え――――？」
　驚きは俺だけのものだった。
　銃剣を構えたまま、無表情で先輩は追ってくる。
「っ―――！」
　そのまま正門へと走り出した。
　自分の体が恐ろしいまでに軽い。
　風を切るように体が走る。
　これなら先輩の運動神経が人間離れしていても、追いつかれる事はない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—?”
I’m the only one surprised.
Weapon still leveled, Ciel pursues me without a flicker of expression. “—!”
I break into a run for the main gate.
My body is terrifyingly light.
It flies forward as if cutting through the wind.
Even with Ciel’s superhuman athleticism, she can never catch me at this speed—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh-----?"
The one who's surprised is me.
Weapon still at the ready, Senpai pursues me emotionlessly.
"----!"
I run towards the school's front gate.
My body is almost frighteningly light.
I run as if slicing through the wind.
Even if Senpai's athletic abilities far exceed those of a human's, she can't chase me if I'm like this----

entries.japanese:
――――と。
　唐突に体が止まった。
　いくら前に出ようとしても足があがらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Or so I think.
My body stops dead.
No matter how I strain forward, my feet refuse to lift.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And then.
My body stops suddenly.
No matter how much I try to move forward, my legs won't budge.

entries.japanese:
「―――――な」
　振りかえると、そこには剣が刺さっていた。
　細い、釘のような剣が、俺の足元に突き刺さっている。
　剣は俺の影を刺していて、それが原因で、俺の足は地面から離れないようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh—”
I look back and see a sword embedded there.
A slender, nail-like blade has been driven into the ground at my feet.
It pins my shadow, which seems to be why my feet will not leave the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Wha--"
When I turn around, there is a sword pierced right there.
A thin, nail-like sword is pierced into the ground at my feet.
The sword is piercing my shadow, which seems to be the reason why I can't raise my legs from the ground.

entries.japanese:
「こ……の……！」
　両足に力をこめる。
　けれど、どんなに頑張っても足は一ミリだって動かない。
―――そこへ。
「浅はかですね。
逃げるにしても、もう少しうまいやり方があったでしょうに」
　『弓』の異名をとる埋葬者が現れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn you—!”
I put all my strength into both legs.
But no matter how hard I strain, my feet will not move a single millimeter.
―――And then—
“How shortsighted. Even if you meant to flee, surely you could have found a cleverer way.”
The Burial Agent known as the Bow appears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…… you……!"
I gather up all the strength in my legs.
But no matter how hard I try, they don't even move one millimeter.
---And there.
"How careless.
Even if you were to run away, I bet there was a better way to do so."
The member of the Burial Agency nicknamed "Bow" appears.

entries.japanese:
「先―――輩」
「体まで吸血鬼化している貴方を外に出すわけにはいきません。
ここで―――その魂を断罪します」
　かつん、という足音。
　十三階段を昇る、死刑囚の足音のよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ci—el.”
“I cannot allow you outside when even your body is turning vampiric. Here and now—I will pass judgment on your soul.”
Click.
Her step sounds like a condemned prisoner mounting the thirteen stairs to the gallows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sen---pai."
"I can't allow you to leave as your body has transformed into a vampire already.
Here---I will exorcise that soul."
The sound of her footsteps.
Like the sound of a condemned criminal walking up the thirteen steps of the gallows.

entries.japanese:
「―――さようなら。
せめて、これで―――」
　小さな、聞き取れないぐらい小さな声で呟いて。
　彼女はその弾劾の切っ先を俺の心臓に押し当てて、ヒキガネを引いた。
　どん、という炸裂音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye. If nothing else, let this—” The murmur is so faint I can barely hear it.
She presses the point of that instrument of judgment against my heart and pulls the trigger.
A thunderous detonation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Farewell.
At least, with this---"
She speaks in a small voice, almost inaudible.
She plants the point of the weapon against my heart and pulls the trigger.
A brief explosion.

entries.japanese:
「ご―――ふ」
　逆流した血液が口からあふれだす。
　脳髄の中心が炸裂するような閃光のあと。
　消えていく自分のなか、バラバラと散っていく、古い本のような魂を、見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—”
Blood surging backward spills from my mouth.
A flash explodes through the center of my brain.
Then, within my vanishing self, I see a soul like an ancient book tearing itself apart and scattering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"G---hu."
I cough up blood.
After a flash of light that seems to blow apart my brain,
inside my disappearing self, I see my soul, being scattered away, like the pages, of an old book.

entries.japanese:
―――体を前に倒した。
　後ろを向けば。
背中を見せれば、背後から心臓を穿たれると、さっきから感じていた。
「ひゃ――――！」
　ズン、と顔の真横を銃剣が通過していく。
　本当に、ゆっくりだ。
　俺は突き出された先輩の銃剣をかわして、そのまま彼女の真横へ出て、そのまま――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I pitch my body forward.
I have felt it all along. If I turn away—if I show her my back—she will drive straight through my heart from behind.
“Hyah—!”
The bayonet drove past my cheek with a heavy rush.
It truly was slow.
I slipped past the thrust, came out beside her, and kept moving—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I fall forward.
I felt from before that if I turned and ran, my heart would be shot from behind.
"Hya----!"
Her sword flies past my head.
It seems really slow.
I evade her attack, move right beside her, and----

entries.japanese:
「っ――――！」
　前に走りぬけようとした矢先、先輩の動きが一変した。
　一瞬、先輩の体が消えたと錯覚するぐらいのスピードで、彼女はあのバカでかい凶器を横に薙いだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Just as I tried to sprint past, her movement transformed.
With such speed that her body seemed to vanish, she swept that enormous weapon sideways.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
The instant I tried to run forward, Senpai's movement changed drastically.
In an instant, with a speed that makes her seem to have literally disappeared, she swings her weapon horizontally.

entries.japanese:
ゴオン、という風きり音が聞こえて俺は―――なぜか、彼女から何メートルも離れたところに立っていた。
「―――――――」
　チッ、と舌うちして先輩がこちらを睨む。
entries.maoEnglish:
The air boomed—and somehow I found myself standing several meters away from her.
“……”
Ciel clicked her tongue and glared at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The rush of the wind fills my ears---and for some reason, I am standing many meters away from her.
"-------"
She clicks her tongue and glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「痛っ……！」
　左腕が痛む。
「なん……えぇ――――！？」
　驚いた。
　肘から先、下腕部がものの見事に折れている。
　それも生半可な折れ方じゃなくて、腕が山形にひん曲がってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow…!”
My left arm hurt.
“What the hell—?!”
I stared.
From the elbow down, my forearm was spectacularly broken.
This was no simple fracture; my arm was bent into a sharp peak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ow……!"
My left arm hurts.
"What…… Huh-----!?"
I'm surprised.
From the elbow down, my arm is broken.
Not broken normally, but my lower arm is bent in the shape of a triangle.

entries.japanese:
「―――首を庇って腕一つですか。
何もしなければ、今ので楽にしてあげたのに」
「な――――」
　自分でも解らないけど、さっきの先輩の一撃を受けて腕がイッちまったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You saved your neck and lost only an arm.
Had you done nothing, that blow would have ended your pain.”
“Wh—” I didn’t understand it myself, but blocking her last strike had apparently destroyed my arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Sacrificing your arm to save your head?
If you didn't do anything, I would have ended it painlessly for you."
"Wha----"
Even though I didn't notice it, I must have broken my arm defending against her attack.

entries.japanese:
「ナイフ、抜かないんですか」
　つまらなそうに先輩は俺を見る。
　……見下してる。
　先輩は、俺をいつでも殺すコトができるって、見下している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aren’t you going to draw your knife?”
She regarded me with boredom.
…She was looking down on me,
certain she could kill me whenever she pleased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aren't you going to pull out your knife?"
She looks at me with a bored expression.
…… She's looking down at me.
She looks down at me as if saying she could kill me at any moment.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ……！」
　痛み。
腕の痛みが頭にきた。
　折れた腕の血が、そのまま毒になって脳髄に送り込まれたような痛み。
　ずきん、と。
　それだけで、意識に白いブランクができてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh…!”
Pain. The pain in my arm reached my head.
It felt as though the blood from the fracture had turned to poison and been pumped straight into my brain.
One throb.
That alone opened a white gap in my consciousness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gg……!"
Pain.
Pain shoots from my arm to my brain.
The blood from my broken arm seems to flow like poison into my nerves.
Sharply.
Just with that, my mind fills with a white blankness.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　先輩は、冷めた目で俺を眺めている。
「こ―――の」
　人の腕を折っておいてそれか。
　これがどのくらい痛いかわかっているのか。
　馬鹿にして。
　馬鹿にして。
　馬鹿にして―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
She watched me with cold, indifferent eyes.
“You—”
She had broken my arm, and this was how she looked at me?
Did she understand how much it hurt?
Mocking me.
Mocking me.
Mocking me—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
She continues to look at me with those cold eyes.
"You---!"
You break my arm, and you still act that way!?
Do you know how much this hurts!?
Making such a fool of me.
Making such a fool of me!
Making such a fool of me------!

entries.japanese:
「先輩が、その気なら――――」
　ポケットの中にあるナイフを握る。
「こっちだって、むざむざ――――」
　かつん、という硬い感触。
「殺されてやるつもりなんか、ない」
　バチン、という音をたてて。
　ナイフの刃を突き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If that’s how you want it—”
I closed my hand around the knife in my pocket.
“Then I’m not going to just stand here and—”
My fingers found the hard metal.
“—let you kill me.”
The blade sprang
out with a snap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If that's how you're going to be, Senpai----"
I grip the knife in my pocket.
"I'm not just going to stand here helplessly----"
The hard feeling of metal.
"--and let you kill me."
With a quick snap,
I take out the blade of my knife.

entries.japanese:
「―――馬鹿ですか、貴方は」
　瞬間。
　先輩の体が、爆ぜた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you an idiot?”
In that instant,
her body exploded.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Are you stupid?"
Instantly,
her body, explodes.

entries.japanese:
――――いや、それは違う。
　先輩はとても低く―――それこそトカゲみたいに地面スレスレに身をかがめて、俺の目の前まで、一瞬で走りこんできた。
　瞬きの間に、六メートルはある距離をつめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――No—that wasn’t it.
She had dropped almost flat to the ground, scuttling as low as a lizard, and crossed the distance to me in a single instant.
More than six meters vanished in the time it took to blink.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----No, that's not right.
She crouches down low to the ground---almost like a lizard, and runs up towards me in a flash.
She closes the distance of six meters in a flash.

entries.japanese:
こっちの視界にはいない。
　先輩の体は俺の膝下よりさらに下にあって、目の前で、爆ぜた。
　ドン、という音。
　ほぼ真下から突き上げられる先輩の銃剣は、惚れ惚れするぐらいの正確さで俺の喉のあたりを串刺しにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
She disappeared from my field of vision.
Her body dropped below my knees, almost against the floor—and exploded upward before me.
Boom.
Rising from almost directly below, her bayonet drove with breathtaking accuracy through the flesh near my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She's not in my vision at all.
Her whole body is below my knee-height, and explodes upward from there.
A thud.
From right beneath me, her bayonet accurately shoots directly for my throat.

entries.japanese:
「が―――――あ」
　息、息がもれる。
　痛みは、痛みはあるか？
　ある、まだ痛いって感じられる。
「は―――――う」
　意識、意識は？
　よし、まだなんとかそれなりに。
「あ、ああああああ…………！」
　体、体は――――どうか、してるか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gah—ah.”
Breath—my breath leaks out.
Pain—was there pain? Yes, I could still feel it.
“Hah—uh.”
My consciousness—was it intact? Good, more or less.
“A-aaaaah…!”
My body—what had happened to my body?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ga----ah!"
I gasp.
Pain, is there pain?
Yes, I can still feel pain.
"Ha-----ugh."
Conscious, am I conscious?
Alright, I still have that.
"A, aaaaaa…………!"
My body.
My body----is not okay.

entries.japanese:
どぷどぷという音。
　それは俺の左肩からしている。
　見れば、そこはもう血の滝だ。
どくどくと血が流れている。
　たった今。
　先輩の銃剣が、俺の喉をそれて左肩を突き刺したんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
A thick, wet gushing.
It was coming from my left shoulder.
When I looked, there was a waterfall of blood. It pulsed out in heavy surges.
Just now.
Ciel’s bayonet had missed my throat and punched through my left shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A dripping sound.
It's coming from my left shoulder.
Looking at it, it's already a waterfall of blood, which pours straight down.
Just now.
The bayonet didn't hit my throat, but my left shoulder.

entries.japanese:
「あ、ああ、ああああああああ！」
　イタイ。
　イタイとかそういう問題じゃないぐらい、イタイ。
「はあ、あああ、あぐぐぐぐぐぐ――――――！」
　でも、生きている。
　なんとか生きてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah… aaaaaaaaaah!”
It hurt.
It hurt beyond anything the word pain could describe.
“Hah—aaah—nghhhh—!”
But I was alive.
Somehow, I was still alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A, Aa, Aaaaaaah!"
It hurts.
It hurts so much the word pain doesn't come close to describing it.
"Haa, aaa, aggggg------!"
But, I'm alive.
Still, I'm alive.

entries.japanese:
体。
体は、また先輩から離れている。
　肩にはかすかな火薬の匂い。
「あ、ああ、あ」
　さっき。
あの銃剣が突き刺さった瞬間、引き金を引かれたんだ。
　それで俺は吹っ飛んで、また先輩と距離が離れてくれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
My body was once again some distance from her.
A faint odor of gunpowder clung to my shoulder.
“Ah… ah… ah.”
When the gun-blade entered me, she pulled the trigger.
The blast threw me away and opened the distance between us again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My body.
My body is away from her again.

I smell a whiff of gunpowder from my shoulder.
"A, Aah, ah."
Just now.
The instant that bayonet pierced me, she must have pulled the trigger.
I was blown away by that, and there's distance between us again.

entries.japanese:
「……二度続く、という事は偶然じゃないですね。
その出血でもショック死しないという事は、身体の変化は始まっている、という事ですか」
　ジャコン、という音。
　あの凶器の切っ先の剣が新しいものに代わる。
　今さっき俺を撃った剣は落ちて、そのまま―――パラパラと本のページになって散っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Twice in a row cannot be coincidence. If even that much blood loss did not send you into fatal shock, does that mean your body has begun to change?”
The weapon clacked.
A fresh blade replaced the one at its point.
The sword that had just shot me fell away, then fluttered apart into the pages of a book.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… To happen twice, that must mean it's not a coincidence.
With that much blood pouring out, not dying from shock must already be a sign that your body has begun to change."
Ga-chang!
A metallic sound.
The sword on the end of that weapon changes into a new one.
The sword that shot me just now falls---and turns into pages of a book and scatters.

entries.japanese:
「……で……デタラメ、だ」
　でも、そのデタラメなものがとても恐い。
　アレは―――ただ、この体に触れるだけで致死性の毒を持つ。
　死。
　死ぬ。
　間違いなく、殺される。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Th—That’s nonsense.”
Yet that impossible weapon terrified me.
A mere touch from it would be fatal to this body.
Death.
I would die.
She was unquestionably going to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's…… ridiculous."
But that ridiculous thing is really frightening.
That---just touching me carries a fatal poison.
Death.
I'll die.
Without a doubt, I'll be killed.

entries.japanese:
死ぬのか。
　それが恐いのか。
　わからない。
「あ、く………っ！」
　肩が燃えている。
　熱くて熱くて、このまま全身が焼かれてしまいそうなほどの灼熱。
entries.maoEnglish:
Was I going to die?
Was that what frightened me?
I didn’t know.
“Ah… ngh…!”
My shoulder was burning.
The heat was so fierce it seemed ready to consume my entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Will I die?
Is that what I'm scared of?
I don't know.
"Ah, gg………!"
My shoulder is burning.
Hot, it's so hot, as if my entire body will burst into flames.

entries.japanese:
かちゃり、と先輩があの凶器を構えなおす。
　……二回。
　二回もアレをなんとか出来たのは、奇跡以外の何物でもない。
　次は間違いなく――――
entries.maoEnglish:
She readied the weapon with another metallic click.
Twice.
Surviving it twice had been nothing short of a miracle.
The next time, without question—
entries.mirrorMoon:
She readies her weapon once more with another metallic clang.
…… Twice.
Withstanding that twice can be nothing but a miracle.
The next time will certainly----

entries.japanese:
あの銃剣が俺の顔の真ん中にささって、そのままえぐりこむ姿を想像した。
　それは恐いというよりおぞましい。
　死は。
　それがどんなカタチであれ、無様で、汚くて、おぞましいもの。
　俺は自分が好きだから―――そんな目にはあいたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I imagined the bayonet sinking into the center of my face and gouging its way deeper.
The image filled me with revulsion more than fear.
Death.
Whatever shape it took, it was ugly, filthy, and revolting.
I liked myself—that was why I did not want it to happen to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I imagine that bayonet piercing me right in the face.
That's more repulsive than frightening.
Death is.
No matter how it happens, something useless, dirty, and disgusting.
I like myself---so I don't want that to happen.

entries.japanese:
だから恐いのか。
　わからない。
　思えば―――俺はあれだけ『死』を視ておきながら、『死』というものをまったく考えたことがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Was that why I was afraid?
I didn’t know.
Come to think of it, though I had seen so much “death,” I had never once thought about what death itself meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Is that why I'm scared?
I don't know.
Come to think of it---I was always able to see "death", but I never thought about "death" at all.

entries.japanese:
いや、そんなコト、今はどうでもいい。
「はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　逃げないと。
　死にたくないんだから、今は逃げないと。
「――メガネ、取らないんですか」
　プラスティックな、簡素な声。
　その言葉。
その意味にハッとした。
　だってメガネを外すっていうことは、先輩の『線』を視るということだ。
　そんなコトになれば、俺は先輩を殺してしまうかもしれない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
No—none of that mattered now.
“Hah, hah, hah—”
I had to run.
I did not want to die, so I had to run now.
“Aren’t you going to remove your glasses?”
Her voice was flat and artificial.
Those words. Their meaning struck me all at once.
Removing my glasses meant seeing her “lines.”
And if I did that, I might kill her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
No, that doesn't really matter right now.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
I have to escape.
I don't want to die, so I have to get away.
"--You won't take off your glasses?"
A simple, plastic voice.
Those words.
I gasp at their meaning.
Because taking them off means I would see Senpai's "lines".
If that happens, I might kill her----

entries.japanese:
「な――なにを、言うんですか、先輩は……！」
「―――――――」
　ぞくり、と。
　大気が燃え立つかのような、殺気。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh-what are you saying, Ciel…?!”
“……”
A chill.
Her bloodlust seemed to set the air itself ablaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha--What are you, saying, Senpai……!?"
"-------"
A chill runs through me.
The air suddenly becomes saturated with a murderous intent.

entries.japanese:
「……つきあってられません。
いいですから、もう死んでください」
　先輩の姿勢が低くなる。
　―――来る。
　また走りこんでくるってわかってるけど、俺には先輩の姿を視認することさえ難しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve had enough of this. Please, just die.”
She lowered her stance.
―――She was coming.
I knew she would rush me again, yet even seeing her move was nearly beyond me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't spend any more time with you.
Please just die already."
Her figure plunges low again.
---She's coming.
Even though I know she's going to run towards me again, it's hard for me to even see her.

entries.japanese:
―――逃げる以外、考えつかない。
　殺されたくないなら―――もう逃げるしか手段がない。
　幸い、距離は十メートル近く離れている。
このまま全力で走れば、校舎の中ぐらいには逃げられる。
　こんなまったいらな所じゃなく、校舎の中ならなんとかなるかもしれない―――！
「――――――」
　背中。
　背中に、何か―――刺さって、る。
「痛――――い」
　どさり、と体が前のめりに倒れた。
　あと少し。
　あと少しで、校舎の中に、入れたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I could think of nothing but escape.
If I didn’t want to die, running was the only choice left.
Nearly ten meters separated us. At a full sprint, I might at least reach the school building. Inside, with walls and corridors instead of this empty field, I might have a chance—!
“—”
My back.
Something is—buried in my back.
“It—hurts.”
My body pitches forward and hits the ground.
I was so close.
Just a little farther and I would have made it inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I can only think of escaping.
If I don't want to be killed---escape is my only option.
Fortunately, our distance is almost ten meters.
If I run as fast as I can, I can make it to the school building.
Maybe I might be able to do something if I can get into a less open space-----!
"------"
My back.
Something----pierced, my back.
"Aa----ah."
My body falls forward.
Just a little more.
And it was just a little more before I could enter the school building.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――――」
　片手で体を立ちあがらせる。
　背中に刺さったのは、先輩が以前に使っていた釘のような剣だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—!”
I pushed myself up with one hand.
The object in my back was one of the nail-like swords she had used before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kk-----"
I lift myself up with one arm.
What sticks through me is one of those swords that looks like a nail that Senpai was using before.

entries.japanese:
「こ――――の………！」
　痛みなんて麻痺しているのか、背中に刺さった剣を引きぬいた。
　……体を貫通していたから、頭にきて胸の方から抜いてやった。
「よし………！」
　これで、校舎の中に逃げられる……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… bastard…!”
Perhaps pain had ceased to mean anything, because I pulled the sword out.
It had passed clean through me, so in my fury I dragged it the rest of the way out through my chest.
“Good…”
Now I could escape into the building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why----you………!
I must be numbed to pain, and I pull out the sword skewering my back from behind.
…… Since it penetrated through me, I got mad and pulled it out from my chest.
"Alright………!"
Now I can escape inside……!

entries.japanese:
「逃げてどうするつもりですか、遠野くん」
　その前に。
　後ろから、先輩の声がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And what do you intend to accomplish by running, Tohno?”
Before I could move,
her voice came from behind me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you plan on doing by escaping, Tohno-kun?"
Before that,
I hear Senpai's voice from behind me.

entries.japanese:
「まだ解らないんですか。
貴方は今、校庭からここまでどのくらいの速さで走ったと思っているんです。
本来なら致命傷である傷を受けて、どうして死なないでいるんです」
entries.maoEnglish: “Do you still not understand? How fast do you imagine you ran from the schoolyard to here? Why are wounds that should be fatal failing to kill you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You still don't understand?
How fast do you think you just ran here?
Why are you still alive after receiving that fatal wound?"

entries.japanese:
「や―――――――」
　意識が、白くなる。
　騙されるな。
　騙されるな。
　その女にはずっと騙されてきたじゃないか。
　もうあいつの言葉になんて耳を貸すな。
　聞けばそのまま死に至る。
　無視しろ。
　受け入れるな。
　それが真実だろうと、もう跳ね除けるしかないんだ、この体は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—” My consciousness whitened.
Don’t be fooled.
Don’t be fooled.
That woman has deceived you all along.
Stop listening to her.
Hear her out and it will lead directly to death.
Ignore her.
Reject it.
Even if she speaks the truth,
this body has no choice now but to cast it aside—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"St-------"
My mind begins to white out.
Don't let her trick you.
Don't let her trick you.
Hasn't she been deceiving you all along?
Don't listen to her anymore.
If you listen, you'll die.
Ignore her.
Don't accept it.
Even if it is the truth, this body can only reject it---

entries.japanese:
「――――やめ、ろ」
「もう、何処にも逃げ場なんてないんです。
　貴方には戦うか殺されるかの道しかない。
けれど戦う事ができないのなら、あとはもう死ぬしかないでしょう」
　かつかつと。
　足音をたてて、先輩がやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop…”
“There is nowhere left for you to run.
You have only two choices: fight or be killed. If you cannot fight, then all that remains is death.”
Click by measured click.
She approached.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Stop, it."
"Geez, there's nowhere for you to run to.
You can only fight or be killed.
But if you can't fight, you can only die."
Her footsteps.
With the sound of footsteps, Senpai approaches.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――！」
　跳ねた。
　背中も、肩も、腕もほとんど死んでいるっていうのに、そんなものは瑣末なことのように、体が跳ねた。
―――自分でも、信じられない。
　俺は荒い息遣いのまま、先輩に負けないぐらいの速さで、校舎の中へと走りこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My body sprang.
My back, shoulder, and arm were nearly dead, yet it leapt as if such injuries were trivial.
―――I could scarcely believe it myself.
Breathing raggedly, I raced into the school building at a speed nearly equal to hers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------!"
I leap.
My back, my shoulders, my arm are all almost dead, but I leap as if it was nothing.
---I can't even believe it myself.
Still breathing wildly and with a speed that matches Senpai, I run into the school building.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　走った。
　何も考えずに、ただ、何かから逃げたくて走り続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah—” I ran.
Without thought,
wanting only to escape from something, I kept running.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
I run.
Without thinking, just wanting to escape, I continue running.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　それも限界。
　息があがってしまったのか、体の傷がひどくて手足がもう動かないのか。
　そんなもの、どっちだってあまり大差はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah—”
At last I reached my limit.
Maybe I had run out of breath; maybe my wounds had finally robbed my limbs of movement.
There was little difference between them now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
But I'm at my limit.
Is it because I'm out of breath or is it that my wounds won't let me move my arms and legs anymore?
Whatever it is, it doesn't matter.

entries.japanese:
「はっ……はっ……はっ――――――」
　廊下の突き当たり。
　もう道のない壁につきあたって、倒れこんだ。
　あお向けに倒れて、起きあがろうと手足に力をこめて、馬鹿らしくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah—”
I reached the end of the corridor.
I struck the wall where the path ended and collapsed.
Flat on my back, I tried to force strength into my limbs, then realized how absurd that was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My breathing becomes more forced.
At the end of the hallway.
Coming onto a wall aimlessly, I fall.
I fall on my back, and try to get back up, and feel foolish for doing so.

entries.japanese:
「……はっ……はっ……は」
　床にあぐらをかくように座り込んで、そのまま壁に背中をあずける。
　膝をたてて、顔をのけぞらせて、大きく息を吸った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah.”
I sat slumped on the floor with my legs loosely crossed and rested my back against the wall.
I drew up my knees, tipped my face back, and took a deep breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
Sitting cross-legged on the floor, I lean my back against the wall.
Throwing back my head, I take a big breath of air.

entries.japanese:
「―――――月」
　見上げれば、窓からは月明かりがうかがえた。
　疲れているせいだろうか。
　なんだか目に見えるものすべてに靄がかかったように、虚ろに見える。
　虚ろ。
　それは不確かという事か。
　俺と同じで。
遠野志貴という人間と同じで、不確か。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—The moon.”
Moonlight shone through the window above me.
Perhaps it was exhaustion.
Everything I could see looked hollow, blurred beneath a veil of mist.
Hollow.
Did that mean uncertain?
As uncertain as I was. As uncertain as the person named Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----The moon."
Looking up, I can see the moonlight through the window.
Is it because I'm so exhausted?
Everything I look at seems vague, as if everything was covered in a mist.
Vagueness.
Does that mean it is indefinite?
The same as me.
The same as the person called Tohno Shiki, indefinite.

entries.japanese:
「……い……た………」
　ずきりと肩が痛んだ。
　自分がこの痛みぐらい確かなものだったら、こんな事にはならなかったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hur… ts…”
My shoulder throbbed.
If only I had been as solid and certain as this pain, would any of this have happened?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ou…… ch……"
My shoulder throbs in pain.
If I was as definite as this pain, maybe this wouldn't have happened?

entries.japanese:
よく、わからなくなってきた。
　自分はずっと遠野志貴だと思って生きてきた。
　けどそいつは別にいて、俺は、どこの誰とも知らない養子だという。
　養子という事は遠野の屋敷に来る前の記憶があるはずなのに、そんなものはまったくない。
　俺は。
本当に、遠野志貴としての記憶しかもっていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I no longer understood.
I had lived my entire life believing I was Shiki Tohno.
But apparently there was another Shiki, and I was an adopted child of unknown origin.
An adopted child should have memories from before entering the Tohno household, yet I had none.
I truly possessed no memories except those of Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm starting to not understand.
I always thought I was Tohno Shiki.
But that was a different person, and they tell me I'm just an adopted son from somewhere.
Being adopted means I should have memories of before I came to the Tohno mansion, but there's nothing.
I…… really, I only have the memories of Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
夜空には、ただ独りきりの月がある。
「――――」
　すごく、不思議だ。
　どうして今まで気がつかなかったのか。
　今夜はこんなにも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
A solitary moon hangs in the night sky.
“…”
How strange.
How did I never notice before?
Tonight is so—
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the night sky is the solitary moon.
"----"
It's incredibly… strange.
Why didn't I realize it until now?
Tonight is so---

entries.japanese:
……結局、俺はなんだったんだろう。
　自分の事なんて何一つ知らないまま、あげくには自分そのものがなくなろうとしているなんて、馬鹿げてる。
　なにもかもぼんやりしていて、馬鹿げてる。
　死の見える世界。
　死が視える視界。
　八年前のあの日。
　俺は先生に出会えて、こうしてマトモに生きてこれた。
　アレは正しい出会いだったと、今でも断言できる。
entries.maoEnglish:
…In the end, what had I ever been?
I knew nothing about myself, and now even that self was about to disappear. It was ridiculous.
Everything was indistinct and absurd.
A world where death could be seen.
Eyes that saw death.
That day eight years ago.
I met the woman who taught me how to live, and because of her I had managed a normal life.
Even now, I could say without doubt that meeting her had been right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… In the end, just what was I?
It's stupid not knowing anything about myself and just disappearing like this.
Everything is so vague, it's stupid.
A world where I can see death.
A vision where I can perceive death.
That day eight years ago.
I was able to meet Sensei and was able to live normally.
I can still declare that it was proper to meet her.

entries.japanese:
「……けど先生。
俺は、生きてちゃいけない、人間だったみたい、だ」
　……まだそう思える自分がいるうちに、自らの命を絶つべきなんだろう。
　でも出来ない。
　自殺なんかできない。
　たとえ無様でも、間違っていても、生きていたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……But it seems I was someone who never should have been allowed to live.”
Perhaps I ought to end my life while enough of me remained to believe that.
But I couldn’t.
I could not kill myself.
However wretched or mistaken my life might be, I had lived it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, Sensei.
I, guess I, was someone, who shouldn't be alive."
…… I should end my life while some part of me can still think that.
But I can't do it.
I can't kill myself.
Even if it is pointless, even if it is a mistake, I want to keep on living.

entries.japanese:
死んだら何もかも嘘になる。
　生きていたい。
　どんなに間違っていて、色々なものをなくしてしまうとしても、生きていたい。
　あの人さえ。
　シエル先輩さえいてくれれば、あとは、何を無くしたってかまわなかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
If I died, everything would become a lie.
I wanted to live.
No matter how wrong I was, no matter how much I might lose, I wanted to live.
If only I still had her.
If only Ciel had remained beside me, I would not have cared what else I lost.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I die, everything will become a lie.
I want to keep on living.
No matter how wrong it is, no matter how many things I have to lose, I want to keep on living.
Only her.
If only I had Ciel-senpai with me.
I wouldn't care what else I had to lose.

entries.japanese:
―――ただそれだけのために、わたしはこうして生き長らえてきました。
けど、それも終わりです。
　五年間。
長かったのか短かったのか、よくはわかりませんけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――For that alone, I kept myself alive. But now even that is over. Five years.
I cannot really say whether they were long or short.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---For that sole reason, I have kept on living like this.
But, that is all over now.
These past five years.
Was it a long time?
Was it a short time?
I don't know.

entries.japanese:
「……うそつき」
　そんな言葉、聞きたくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Liar.”
I never wanted to hear those words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Liar."
I don't want to hear those words.

entries.japanese:
―――遠野くんには感謝しています。
　わたしの仕事はこれでおしまいです。
あとは、残った自分の責任を、果たさなくちゃいけません。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I am grateful to you, Tohno.
My work is finished now. All that remains is to fulfill the responsibility I still bear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I have to thank you, Tohno-kun.
My work here is done now.
All that's left is for me to take responsibility for all my actions.

entries.japanese:
「……うそ、つき」
　ああ。
けど、真実だってあったのかもしれない。
　だって、あの人は俺を騙してはいたけど、ただの一度も
entries.maoEnglish:
“…You liar.”
Yet perhaps there had been truth as well. She deceived me, yes—but not even once had she ever—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Li, ar."
Yeah.
But, maybe there was some truth in there, too.
Because even though she deceived me, not even once…

entries.japanese:
―――今までありがとうございました。
わたし、こんなに嬉しかったの久しぶりです。
　ですから、最後に握手しましょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thank you for everything. I cannot remember the last time I was this happy.
So let us shake hands one final time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thank you so much for everything until now.
It has been a long time since I've been this happy.
So, let's finish with a handshake.

entries.japanese:
「………おお、うそつき」
　ただの一度も。
あの人は、俺に嘘はつかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Oh, you liar.”
Not once. Not once had she actually lied to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You, big liar."
Not even once did she lie to me.

entries.japanese:
―――わたしがいなくなっても乾くんと仲良くしてくださいね。
　わたし、遠野くんと乾くんみたいな学生になりたかった――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――After I am gone, please stay friends with Inui.
I wanted to be a student like you and him—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Even though I'm not going to be here, please stay friends with Inui-kun.
I wanted to be a student like you and Inui-kun----

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　でも、あの人自体が嘘だった。
　あの笑顔が本当の嘘だったなんて、俺には思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
But her very existence had been the lie.
Even so, I cannot believe that smile was false.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
But that person herself was a lie.
I can't even think that smile could really be a lie.

entries.japanese:
けど、現実なんてこんなもんだ。
　……シエルは嘘で、ただ俺を殺すためだけに傍にいてくれただけ。
　騙されていた。
　シエルは俺を愛してなどいてくれていなかった。
　俺がダメになっていた時に助けてくれたのも。
　休み時間に二人で意味もなく過ごしたことも。
　全部、俺がロアかどうかを確かめるためのものだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
But this is what reality amounts to.
Ciel was a lie.
She stayed beside me only so that she could kill me.
I had been deceived.
She had never loved me.
Helping me when I was falling apart, wasting our breaks together for no reason—every moment of it was only meant to determine whether I was Roa.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, this is what reality is.
…… Ciel is a lie, and she was staying near me only so she could kill me.
I was fooled.
She did not love me at all.
And when she helped me when I was completely lost, too.
And the time we spent during breaks for no reason, too.
All of it was just to confirm if I was Roa or not.

entries.japanese:
ぎり、と歯が軋んだ。
　奥歯を強くかみ締める。
「……ちく、しょう」
　悔しくて、壁を引っ掻く。
　そう、騙されていた。
　シエルは全て計算づくで自分に近づいてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
My teeth grind.
I clamp my jaw until my molars ache.
“…Damn it.”
Bitter with frustration, I claw at the wall.
Yes. I had been deceived.
Every step Ciel took toward me was calculated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I grit my teeth.
I grit my teeth hard.
"…… Damn it."
I scratch the wall in frustration.
Yes, I was tricked.
Ciel got closer to me, calculating everything.

entries.japanese:
「……それなのに」
　切なくて、壁を爪弾く。
　……そう、騙されていた。
　けれど、それでも――――
「―――俺は、先輩を憎めない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…And yet…”
My fingertips brush the wall, aching with a grief I cannot name.
Yes, she deceived me.
But even so—
“I can’t hate her.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Even still."
Feeling pain in my heart, I scratch the wall.
…… Yes, I was tricked.
But, still----
"---I, can't hate Senpai."

entries.japanese:
憎めるはずなんか、ない。
　あの人にとっては嘘でも、俺は楽しかった。
　どうあってもそれだけは本当なんだ。
　先輩と出会ってからたった二週間にも満たない時間だったけど、本当に―――自分は、あんなにも幸せだった。
「……ちく、しょう――――」
　だから憎めない。
　でもそんなものは俺だけの幻想だ。
　だから、それだけが悔しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I could never hate her.
Even if it was a lie to her, I was happy.
Nothing can make that untrue.
I knew her for less than two weeks, and yet I had been so—so genuinely happy.
“—Damn it—”
That is why I cannot hate her.
Yet that illusion belonged to me alone.
That alone is what makes it so bitter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no way I can hate her.
Even if it was all a lie for her, I really enjoyed it.

No matter what, that's still true.
It was only less than two weeks since I met Senpai, but---I really was happy.
"…… Damn it-----"
That's why I can't hate her.
But that's an illusion only for me.
That's why I regret only that.

entries.japanese:
視界が滲んでいく。
　窓の外には白い夜。
　ここは静かで、海の底に沈んでいるような校舎。
　ゆらゆらと揺らいでいる。
　何もかも偽りで、近づけば消えてしまう幻。
　それは一つの、掴みようのない蜃気楼のようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
My vision blurs.
Beyond the window lies a white night.
The silent school seems sunk at the bottom of the sea,
wavering gently around me.
Everything is false, a vision that vanishes when approached.
One vast mirage, forever beyond my grasp.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My vision wavers.
Outside the window lies the white night.
It's quiet here, almost like the bottom of a deep sea.
Wavering quietly.
Everything is fake, an illusion that disappears when you approach it.
Like a mirage you can never grasp.

entries.japanese:
かつん、かつん、という足音が聞こえてくる。
　……彼女がやってくる。
「――――殺すか」
　頭の中で、そんな声が聞こえた。
　死にたくないのなら、バラせ。
　自分が間違っていないと思うのなら、バラせ。
　いいからバラせ。
　バラせ。
バラせ、バラせ、バラせ、バラせ、バラせ、バラせ、バラ、バラバラ、バラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラ――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I hear approaching footsteps—click, click.
—She is coming.
“Kill her.”
The voice speaks inside my head.
If you do not want to die, cut her apart.
If you believe you are not the one in the wrong, cut her apart.
Just cut her apart.
Cut her apart. Cut her apart, cut her apart, cut her apart, cut her apart, cut her apart, cut her apart, cut her, cutcut, cutcutcutcutcutcutcutcut—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can hear her footsteps.
…… She's coming.
"----Kill her?"
Inside my head, I hear those words.
If you don't want to die, slice her apart.
If you think you're not mistaken, slice her apart.
Just slice her apart already!
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice her apart, Slice, slice, slice, slice, slicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslice-------

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……本当に、俺はここまでみたいだ。
　また頭の中がぐちゃぐちゃになりはじめた。
　それでも俺は死にたくない。
　死にたくないんなら―――やる事は一つだけ。
　かつん、かつんと足音が大きくなってくる。
　先輩の影が伸びてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
This really is the end for me.
My thoughts are collapsing into chaos again.
Even so, I do not want to die.
If I want to live—there is only one thing to do.
The approaching footsteps grow louder.
Her shadow reaches toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… It looks like I'm really done.
My head starts to rage again.
But still, I don't want to die.
If I don't want to die---there's only one thing to do.
The footsteps get louder.
Her shadow grows larger.

entries.japanese:
―――メガネ、取らないんですか。
　それが何を意味するかわかっていながら、彼女はそう言っていた。
　ならば。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Aren’t you going to remove your glasses?
She said it knowing exactly what it meant.
Then—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Aren't you going to take off your glasses?
Even knowing what it meant, she said that.
In that case.

entries.japanese:
―――――すべて。
　　　　　みんな、幻になってしまえば、いい。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Everything.
Let it all—let everyone—fade into illusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Everything.
All of it should turn into illusion.

entries.japanese:
ナイフを強く握って、立ちあがる。
　足音が大きくなっていく。
　敵が近づいてくる確かな気配。
　その度に頭の中に響いてくる、誰かの声。
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
entries.maoEnglish:
I clench the knife and force myself to my feet.
The footsteps swell.
The enemy is coming closer; I can feel it beyond doubt.
And with every step, someone’s voice rings through my skull.
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
entries.mirrorMoon:
I stand up as I strongly grip my knife.
The footsteps get even louder.
I sense the enemy coming closer.
All the time, someone's voice echoes in my brain.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――」
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラ――――
「黙れ」
　強く意思を保って、頭の中を黙らせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER—
“Shut up.”
I seize hold of my own will and silence the voice in my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.

"U----"
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart----
"Shut up."
Using my willpower, I force the voice in my head to be quiet.

entries.japanese:
「これは、俺が決めた事だ」
　バ――――
「オマエに指図される謂れはない」
　ラ――――
「シエルに殺されたくないのなら」
　せ――――
「終わるまで黙ってろ、ロア」
　―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is my decision.”
Cut—
“You don’t get to tell me what to do.”
her—
“If you don’t want Ciel to kill you—”
up— “then keep your mouth shut until this is over,
Roa.”
―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is, what I decided."
Slice----
"I don't need you to tell me what to do."
her----
"If you don't want to be killed by Ciel."
apart----
"Just shut up until it's over, Roa."
-----

entries.japanese:
声は完全に消えた。
　かつん、という足音と、伸びてくる影。
　―――シエルが、俺の前に現れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The voice vanishes completely.
A sharp click of a heel; a shadow reaching toward me.
―――Then Ciel steps into view.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice disappears completely.
The footsteps, and her approaching shadow.
----Ciel appears before me.

entries.japanese:
「―――ようやく戦う気になったんですね」
　なぜか、安堵するような声で彼女は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you’ve finally decided to fight.”
For some reason, she sounds relieved.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---You finally decided to fight."
Her voice seems almost relieved.

entries.japanese:
「良かった。
これでお互いに罪はありません。
　互いに殺し合うという条件なら、わたしたちの罪は相殺されます。
あとは、生き残った者に罰が残るだけです」
　……お互いが殺しあおうというのなら罪はないというのか。
　それは、俺には理解できない世界の話だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good. Now neither of us will be guilty.
If we agree to kill one another, our sins cancel each other out. Only the survivor will be left to bear the punishment.”
If both of us intend to kill, neither of us is guilty?
She is speaking of a world I cannot understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's good.
Now there is no sin for either of us.
Now that we are both trying to kill each other, our sin will die.
Now there is only punishment for the one who lives."
…… Since we are both trying to kill each other there is no sin?
Her words are part of a world I can't understand.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
なら、残ったほうの罰っていうのは、償えるものなのか」
「ええ。
果たすことのできる代償行為を罰というんです。
罰と名のつくものなら償えない道理はない。
　消えさってくれないものは罪だけです。
　ですから―――お互いそんなもの、いまさら背負いたくはないでしょう？」
　言って。
　一歩、彼女は踏みこんでくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then can the survivor ever atone for that punishment?”
“Yes. A punishment is an act of restitution that can be carried out. Nothing that truly deserves the name can be beyond atonement.
Sin alone refuses to disappear.
So—neither of us wishes to shoulder any more sin now, do we?”
With that, she advances one step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then is that punishment for the one that's left alive atoneable?"
"Yes.
Something that is atoneable is what we call punishment.
If it is called punishment, there is no reason for it not to be atoneable.
The only thing that does not disappear is the sin.
So---we don't want to carry that burden, do we?"
Saying that,
she takes another step forward.

entries.japanese:
「――それじゃあ、ここで先輩を殺す事は罪じゃないのか」
「はい。
わたしは貴方を殺します。
だから貴方もわたしを殺していい。
条件は同じです」
　さらに、一歩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then killing you here wouldn’t be a sin?”
“Correct. I am going to kill you. So you are free to kill me. We stand on equal terms.”
Another step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Then, killing you here isn't a sin, Senpai?"
"Yes.
I will kill you, so it is okay for you to kill me, Tohno-kun.
Our conditions are equal."
Another step.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　それは、違う。
　たしかに俺は殺されようとしていて、自分の命を守るために殺し返そうとしている。
　それに罪がないというのなら―――シエルはどうなるのか。
　彼女は初めから片思いの殺人意思を持ってやってきた。
　それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
No—that isn’t right.
She is trying to kill me, and I am trying to kill her in defense of my own life.
But if that leaves me innocent—what does it make Ciel?
She came here with a murderous intent that was hers alone from the very beginning.
Which means—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
That's, not right.
Certainly I am getting killed, so I'm killing her back to protect my own life.
But to say there's no sin---what would happen to Ciel?
From the beginning, she came here with an unrequited will to kill.
That is---

entries.japanese:
「さよなら。
これで、くだらなかった芝居に幕を下ろしましょう」
　最後の一歩。
　彼女の銃剣が構えられて、そのきっさきが俺の心臓に向けられる。
　その前に。
　ただ無造作に前に乗り出して、彼女の右肺の『点』を狙った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye. Let us bring this ridiculous play to an end.”
Her final step.
She levels her gun-blade, its point aimed straight at my heart.
Before she can strike,
I pitch forward almost carelessly and aim for the “point” in her right lung.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Farewell.
Let us lower the curtain on this ridiculous play."
The last step.
Her readied bayonet shoots toward my heart.
Before then,
I lunge forward and aim for the "point" on her right lung.

entries.japanese:
―――殺せるとは、思っていなかった。
　こちらのナイフが届く間合いに踏みこむより先に、彼女の銃剣が俺の心臓を貫くのは道理だ。
　だから、驚いた。
　俺はあっさりと銃剣をかわして、トン、とあっけなく彼女の『点』を刺せたから。
「――――先、輩」
　彼女はわざと、俺のナイフを受け入れたように、見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I never thought I could kill her.
By every right, her gun-blade should pierce my heart before I can step within reach of her.
That is why I’m so shocked.
I slip past the weapon with absurd ease, then tap my knife into her “point” as if it were nothing.
“Ci…el.”
It looks as though she accepted my knife on purpose.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I didn't think I could kill her.
It's only natural for her to pierce my heart before I get within knife range.
That's why I was surprised.
I easily dodged her blade and was able to pierce her "point" with ease.
"----Sen, pai."
It looked like she accepted my knife on purpose.

entries.japanese:
「貴方に、わたしを殺させて、しまった」
　死に至る前の、弱々しい声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I made you… kill me.”
Her voice is frail, poised on the brink of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I made you… kill… me."
Her faint, weak voice on the verge of death.

entries.japanese: 「それが、一番大きな、わたしの罪でした」
entries.maoEnglish: “That was… the greatest of my sins.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "That was, my, greatest sin."

entries.japanese: 泣くような声をあげて、彼女は最後の力をふりしぼって、俺の胸に、銃剣をつきたてた。
entries.maoEnglish: With a sound like a sob, she gathers the last of her strength and drives the gun-blade into my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon: Sounding like she's crying, she uses her remaining strength to stab me with her bayonet.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ご、ふ」
　破壊された心臓から、血液が逆流する。
　喉からこみあげてくる血液を吐き出して、廊下に倒れこんだ。
　目の前には。
　俺より少し前に絶命した、彼女の体が倒れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ghh.”
Blood surges backward from my ruined heart.
I vomit the blood welling into my throat and crumple onto the corridor floor.
Before my eyes.
Her body lies there—she died only moments before I will.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ga, hu."
My blood flow reverses through my lanced heart.
Coughing up blood, I collapse onto the ground.
Before my eyes,
the body of the one who died slightly ahead of me lies on the floor.

entries.japanese:
「――――なんて」
　わかって、いたのか。
「――――愚か、な」
　初めから―――罪があるとしたら自分にだけだって、わかって、いたのか、あなたは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How could you…”
You knew?
“You… fool.”
Did you know from the start that if either of us bore any guilt, it belonged to you alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----How--"
Did you, know?
"----foolish."
Did you know from the beginning---that if there was such a thing as sin, it would only be for you?

entries.japanese:
「はっ――――あ」
　手足の感覚がなくなっていく。
　意識も。
血液の供給が途絶えて、あと数秒と保つまい。
　あの銃剣で刺された瞬間。
　自分の中で、何か古い本のようなモノが、ページを撒き散らして消えていくイメージがあった。
　おそらく。
それで、ロアと呼ばれたモノは霧散したのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah.”
Feeling drains from my limbs.
My consciousness follows.
With the blood supply cut off, it cannot last more than a few seconds.
At the instant her gun-blade struck me, I saw something within myself like an ancient book, scattering its pages as it vanished.
Perhaps. Then that was Roa dispersing into nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah."
The sensation in my limbs fades away.
My consciousness, too.
It will be seconds before I bleed to death.
The instant I was stabbed,
I had a vision of something like an old book, scattering and crumbling away page by page.
Probably, with that, the thing called Roa was dispersed.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　何も思い浮かばない。
　彼女が初めから、自分の命と引き換えに俺を殺そうとしたこと。
　それがせめてもの罰だと思ったのか。
―――バカげてる。
　そんなもの―――何の意味も、ない。
「―――それでも」
　俺に謝ることなく死んだのは、悲しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Nothing comes to mind.
From the very beginning, she had meant to kill me at the cost of her own life.
Did she believe that would serve as some small punishment?
―――Absurd.
It means nothing. Nothing at all.
“Even so…”
It hurts that she died without ever apologizing to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I can't think.
From the very beginning, she planned to give her life to take mine.
Did she think that was her punishment?
---How foolish.
There's no---meaning in that.
"---Still."
I was sad that she died before she apologized to me.

entries.japanese:
ごめんなさい、と言ってくれれば、それで彼女の気持ちも少しは救われただろうに。
……この人は、それさえ口にできなかったのか。
　謝って償える事じゃないって解っていたから、彼女は最後まで謝らなかった。
　その決意。
そこまで追いこんだのが自分だという事が、頭にくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
If she had only said she was sorry, perhaps it would have brought her some small measure of peace. But she could not even permit herself that.
Knowing an apology could never repay what she had done, she refused to offer one even at the end.
That resolve of hers—and the knowledge that I drove her to it—makes me furious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If she could have apologized to me, then I bet she would have felt some relief…… But, she couldn't even say that.
Since she knew it was something that wasn't atoneable by apology, she didn't apologize to the very end.
That determination.
It makes me angry that I made her go that far.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、結局――――」
　俺は、この人が、好きだったのか。
　最後まで。
　こうして死の直前まで彼女を悲しいと思ってしまうぐらい、大切だったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that was it…”
I loved her after all.
Right to the end.
She mattered so much that even on the threshold of death, my heart still aches for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What.
In the end----"
I liked her?
Until the very end.
Feeling sad like this until my own death, she was that dear to me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　軽く咳き込んで、血を吐いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
I cough lightly, bringing up a mouthful of blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Tss."
I cough weakly and spit out blood.

entries.japanese:
それで終わり。
　ぼんやりと月を見上げたまま、胡乱な意思のまま、いつのまにか、眠って、い――――
entries.maoEnglish:
And that is the end.
I gaze vaguely up at the moon, my thoughts adrift, and before I know it I am falling… asle—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's all over.
Staring dazedly at the moon, with these strange thoughts, I drift off to slee----

entries.japanese:
ならば―――どうするというんだ、俺は。
「できる………、か」
　細かく痙攣する指でメガネに触れて、そのまま、放り投げた。
　カラン、という音が海の底の廊下に響く。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then what am I supposed to do?
“Like hell—I can.”
My twitching fingers touch my glasses, then tear them off and fling them away.
Their clatter echoes down the corridor beneath the sea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then---What do I do?
"No…… way."
I bring my slightly trembling fingers up to my glasses and throw.
Clang.
The dull sound echoes through the hallway.

entries.japanese:
「できるわけないだろ、そんなマネ―――！」
　頭にきて、俺の中の誰かに向けて怒鳴った。
　自分自身に殺意を覚えたなんて、これがはじめてだ。
　カラン、カラン、と硬い物が廊下に転がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There’s no way I could do that—!”
Furious, I shout at whoever is inside me.
It is the first time I have ever felt murderous toward myself.
The hard object goes clattering away along the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There's no way I can do that!"
I shout angrily at the other person inside my head.
It's the first time I ever wanted to kill myself.
Clang.
Clang.
The hard object rolls along the floor.

entries.japanese:
……線など視えない。
　放り投げたものは、持っていたナイフだ。
　メガネは外さない。
……絶対に、外さない。
　ただ、俺はもう自信がないから、ナイフを遠くに投げただけだ。
　持っていればきっと、俺は自分が死ぬよりイヤな事をしてしまうだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
No lines appear.
The thing I threw was the knife.
I will not remove my glasses. I will never remove them.
I no longer trust myself, so I cast the knife far away.
If I keep it, I know I will do something worse than dying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I don't see any lines.
What I threw away was my knife.
I won't take off my glasses.
…… I'll never do that.
It's just that, since I didn't have confidence in myself, I threw away my knife.
If I kept holding it, I know I would've done something worse than me dying.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　そうして、彼女がやってきた。
　感情のない瞳も、不吉な凶器も、さっきとまったく変わっていない。
　彼女は、座り込んだ俺の前で止まった。
　どうしてだろう。
　彼女はすぐにトドメをさそうとしてこない。
　ただ、俺たちはお互いをぼんやりと見つめ合うだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Then she arrives.
Her emotionless eyes and ominous weapon are exactly as they were before.
She stops before me where I sit.
I do not know why,
but she makes no immediate attempt to finish me.
We only stare at each other through the haze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
And then, she arrives.
Neither her emotionless eyes nor that foreboding weapon change.
She stops in front of me as I sit on the ground.
How come?
She doesn't finish me off.
We just both stare at each other aimlessly.

entries.japanese:
「―――一つ、聞きますけど」
　銃剣の切っ先が俺の胸に向けられる。
「どうしてメガネを外さなかったんです。
　どうして―――ただの一度も、わたしと戦おうとしなかったんです」
「……そんなの、なんでもなにもない」
　ただ、そんなことを思いもしなかっただけ。
「そんな酷いこと、先輩にはできないだろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is one thing I want to ask.”
The point of her gun-blade turns toward my chest.
“Why didn’t you remove your glasses?
Why—not even once—did you try to fight me?”
“…There isn’t any reason.”
The thought had simply never occurred to me.
“I couldn’t do anything that cruel to you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I have one question."
The tip of her bayonet aims at my chest.
"Why didn't you take off your glasses?
Why---didn't you even try to fight me once?"
"…… It's simple."
It's just that the thought never crossed my mind.
"I can't do such a horrible thing to you, Senpai."

entries.japanese:
「酷いって………馬鹿ですか貴方は。
　わたしは貴方を殺すんですよ。
わたしは貴方の先輩なんかじゃない。
全て嘘だったって、あれだけ言ってまだ解らないんですか、貴方は……！」
　……先輩の声には苛立ちがある。
―――すごく、怒ってる。
　冷静な顔をしているけど、手足が震えるぐらい怒っているなと、なんとなく解ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Cruel…? Are you an idiot?
I am going to kill you. I was never the person you knew at school. How can you still fail to understand after I told you it was all a lie…?”
Irritation edges her voice.
―――She is furious.
Her face remains composed, yet somehow I know she is so angry that her hands and feet are trembling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Horrible?
…… Are you stupid?
I am going to kill you.
I am not your Senpai.
I told you everything was a lie, and you still don't understand……!"
…… Her voice sounds irritated.
---She's really… angry.
I realize that even though her face is calm, her arms and legs are literally shaking with anger.

entries.japanese:
「……知ってる。
先輩は、ずっと俺を騙してきた。
シエル先輩なんていう人は、初めからいやしなかったんだって、わかってる」
「解っているんなら、どうして……！」
「……いいんだ。
先輩が嘘でも、関係ない。
　俺は、すごく楽しかった。
先輩と過ごした時間は、先輩にとってはどうでもいい時間だったかもしれないけど、俺にとっては大切だった」
　……だから、いいんだ。
　たとえ先輩にとって全てが嘘でも、
　俺がそれに救われていたのは本当の話。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I know. You deceived me all along. I know the Ciel I thought I knew never existed.” “If you understand, then why…?”
“…It doesn’t matter.
Even if you were a lie, I don’t care.
I was happy. The time we spent together may have meant nothing to you, but it mattered to me.”
That is why it does not matter.
Even if every moment was false to her,
it remains true that those moments saved me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I know.
Senpai, you were deceiving me up until now.
This person called Ciel-senpai never existed from the beginning.
I understand that."
"If you understand, then why……!"
"…… It's okay.
Even if "Senpai" is a lie, it doesn't matter.
I really had a lot of fun.
The time we spent together may not mean much to you, but it was very dear to me."
…… That's why it's okay.
Even if it's all a lie to Senpai,
the fact that I was saved by that is still true.

entries.japanese:
「―――だから、いいんだ」
　この二週間は楽しかった。
　けど、ここで先輩を憎めば、それさえも亡くなってしまう。
　先輩にとってそれが嘘だったのなら、せめてあとの半分。
　半分の俺ぐらいは、最後までそれを本当のものにしておきたいんだ。
　……自分の命と引き換えにするにしては、ひどく滑稽な望みかもしれないけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is why it’s all right.”
Those two weeks were happy.
If I hate her now, even that happiness will die.
If it was all a lie for her,
then at least the other half—my half—will remain true until the end.
It may be a ludicrous wish to purchase with my life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That's why it's okay."
These past two weeks really were fun.
But, if I hate you here, I'll lose even that.
Even if it's a lie to you, that's only half of it.
As for my half, I want to make it real, until the very end.
…… Although exchanging my life for that might be a comical wish.

entries.japanese:
「―――そんなコト。
そんなコトのために、命を投げ捨てるんですか。
望みは。
貴方の望みっていうのは、その程度のものなんですか」
「……そっか。
やっぱり小さい、かな」
　―――でもまあ、今はそれが二番目ぐらいに大切なんだ。
　それ以外の望みなんて、どうあっても一つしか思いつかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“For that. You would throw your life away for something so trivial? Your hope. Is that all you hope for?”
“—I see. I suppose it is pretty small.”
―――Yet right now, it may be the second most important thing in the world to me.
As for any greater wish, there is only one I can imagine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---For that… for that you are going to throw away your life?
Such a wish, your wish is something that small?"
"…… I see.
Maybe it is, kind of small."
---But, right now, that is the second dearest thing to me.
I can only think of one wish other than that.

entries.japanese:
「―――わたし、色々な人を見てきましたけど」
　一歩、踏み込んで。
「貴方ほど馬鹿な人は、初めてでした」
　先輩は銃剣の切っ先を俺の心臓に当てた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I have met a great many people.”
She steps closer.
“But never anyone as foolish as you.”
She sets the point of her gun-blade against my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I have seen many people, but,"
She takes a step forward.
"This is the first time I've met someone as stupid as you."
Senpai places the tip of her bayonet right up against my heart.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
「――――――」
　……どうしてだろう。
　なぜか、引き金が引かれない。
　俺を見つめてくる目は虚ろだ。
　……先輩が時折見せる、感情のない瞳。
それは、この人が冷酷な人というわけじゃなくて。
　単に―――自分自身を騙せないから、結局自分の感情を殺すしかないからじゃないんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
“…”
Why does she not pull the trigger?
Her eyes remain hollow as they stare into mine.
I have seen that emptiness in her before.
Perhaps it never meant she was cold.
Perhaps she simply cannot deceive herself, and so has no choice but to kill what she feels.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
"------"
…… How come?
She doesn't pull the trigger.
The eyes looking at me are completely empty.
…… Those emotionless eyes that Senpai shows me.
That doesn't mean she's a cold-hearted person, but…
Simply---She can't deceive herself, so in the end, I suppose all she could do was just kill her emotions.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　ああ、やっと気づいた。
　この目をする時、先輩はいつも――俺ではなく、自分自身を、騙していたんだっていうコトが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
At last I understand.
Whenever her eyes looked like this, the person she was deceiving was never me. It was herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Yeah, I finally realized it.
That whenever she showed those eyes, she wasn't fooling me--she was fooling herself.

entries.japanese:
「……殺さないのか、先輩」
「―――忘れていました。
最後に、懺悔を聞いておかないといけません。
わたし、これでも聖職者ですから」
「……そう。
懺悔なんてないけど、一つだけ、聞いていいかな」
「――――はい。
手短にお願いします」
「……うん、すぐ済む。
ただ、どうして先輩は、そんなに泣きそうな顔をしてるのかなって、思って」
「な―――――――」
　びくり、と。
　シエルの体が、震えた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Aren’t you going to kill me?”
“I forgot. I must hear your final confession first. I am still a woman of the Church, after all.”
“…I don’t have anything to confess, but may I ask one question?”
“Yes.
Make it brief.”
“…It won’t take long.
I was only wondering why you look as if you’re about to cry.”
“Wh—” Her body seems to flinch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're not going to kill me, Senpai?"
"---I forgot.
In the end, I still must hear your confession.
I am a member of The Church after all."
"…… Oh.
I don't have anything to confess, but can I ask something?"
"----Yes.
Please make it short."
"…… Yeah, it'll be quick.
It's just, I was wondering why you look like you're going to cry."
Like a jolt,
I think Ciel's body trembled.

entries.japanese:
「―――わたしは、泣いてなんて、いません」
　断言する先輩の顔は、確かに冷酷そのものだ。
　……そう言われると、こっちもつい首をかしげてしまう。
　けどどうしても、俺には――――
「……泣きそうな顔に、見える。
どうしてか、わからないけど」
「それは貴方の錯覚です。
わたしは何も感じていませんから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am not about to cry.”
The face with which she declares it is coldness itself.
Put that way, even I find myself wondering whether I imagined it.
And yet, to me she still—
“…looks as if she might cry. I don’t know why.”
“That is your imagination. I feel nothing.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I'm, not, crying."
Certainly her face is stone cold as she denies this.
…… Hearing that, I even tilt my head to the side.
But, all the same, I----
"…… But you still look like you're about to cry.
I don't know why though."
"That's just your imagination.
I don't feel anything."

entries.japanese:
「―――わたしにある感情は、人間として死にたいというものだけです。
それ以外の感情なんて、ない」
　感情のない目をしたまま、彼女はそう言った。
　ひどく、悲しい。
　こんな時に、それが嘘だなんて解ってしまうなんて、皮肉すぎる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The only feeling left in me is the desire to die as a human being. Nothing else remains.”
She says it with those empty eyes.
How terribly sad.
What bitter irony that only now, of all times, I can tell she is lying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---The only emotion I have is the desire to die as a human.
There's nothing else."
She says this with her emotionless eyes.
It's… terribly sad.
Knowing she's lying right now is just too ironic.

entries.japanese:
「……ひどいな。
最後まで、先輩は俺に嘘をつくのか」
「―――――――」
　答えがない。
　凍りついたように、先輩は動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…That’s cruel. You’re going to lie to me right to the end?”
“…”
She gives no answer.
Frozen in place, she does not move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… How terrible.
Even to the end, you're going to lie to me, Senpai?"
"-------"
There's no response.
As if she was frozen, she doesn't move.

entries.japanese:
「―――貴方こそ、嘘をついてる。
ここでわたしに殺されることが望みなんて、思ってはいないでしょう」
「……当然だろ、そんなの。
死んだらなにもないじゃないか。
一応経験があるから、それぐらいはわかってる。
……本音を言えば生きていたい。
けど、ただ生きているなんてのは、もうダメなんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are lying too. You do not truly wish to be killed by me here.”
“—Of course I don’t. Death leaves you with nothing. I’ve experienced it once, so I know that much. If I’m honest, I want to live. But just staying alive isn’t enough anymore.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What about you?
You're lying.
I don't think your wish is to be killed here by me, right?"
"…… Of course.
Because if you die, there's nothing.
I've already experienced it once, so I understand that.
…… To tell the truth, I want to live.
But I don't want to just live."

entries.japanese:
……そう、ダメだ。
　もしここでなんとか生き延びても、その先には何もない。
　遠野志貴なんていう人間もいなくなって、この人が経験してしまったような出来事を繰り返す。
　けど、そんな事より。
　このままでいっても、そこには先輩がいない。
　そんな生活には、俺はきっと耐えられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes.
It is not enough.
Even if I somehow survive this night, there is nothing beyond it.
Shiki Tohno will disappear, and I will repeat the horrors she once endured.
But more than any of that—she will not be there.
I know I could never bear such a life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yes, I don't want that.
Even if I manage to keep living, there's nothing for me after that.
The person called Tohno Shiki would die and would do things just like this person experienced.
But, more than that.
If I live here, that means Senpai will be gone.
I would not be able to bear living like that.

entries.japanese:
「……今まで、すごく楽しかったんだ、先輩。
　有彦と俺と先輩でバカな話をしている時は、悪くなかった。
ただの休み時間でも、先輩がきてくれるだけで夢みたいに、楽しかった。
　……だから、きっとそれが俺の願いなんだ。
もう叶わないけど、俺は―――ずっと、あのままの生活が続いてほしかった」
「まだ解らないんですか。
アレはただの芝居だったって、言ったのに」
「ああ、それでも――――本当に、楽しかった」
　そう口にした瞬間、ひどく心が落ち着いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I was so happy, Ciel.
When Arihiko and I sat around talking nonsense with you, it wasn’t bad at all. Even an ordinary lunch break felt like a dream if you came to see us.
I think that was my wish. It can never come true now, but I wanted that life to go on forever.”
“Do you still not understand? I told you it was only a performance.”
“I know. Even so—it truly made me happy.”
The instant I say it, a profound calm settles over me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, everything was fun up until now.
The times I spent with you and Arihiko weren't bad.
Even during breaks when you came, it was fun, almost like a dream.
…… That's probably what my wish is.
It can't ever be granted, but---I really wanted that kind of life to continue."
"You still don't understand?
I already said it was all fake."
"Yeah, but still----it really was fun."
The instant I say that, my heart calms down.

entries.japanese:
届かない幻でもいい。
初めから存在しなかった蜃気楼でもかまわない。
　いや、むしろ幻だったからこそ―――今、こんなにも先輩と過ごした時間が、愛しく感じられる。
　どのみち、俺はもう助からない。
　それなら―――あのゆめを夢みたままでいられるなら、それはどんなに――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I do not care if it was an illusion forever beyond reach, or a mirage that never existed at all.
No—perhaps because it was an illusion, the time I spent with her now feels all the more precious.
I cannot be saved in any case.
So if I can remain inside that dream until the end, how—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's okay if it's just an unreachable illusion.
I don't care if it was a mirage that never existed in the first place.
No, maybe because it was an illusion---Even now, the times I spent with Senpai feel so dear to me.
No matter what, I can't escape now.
Then---if I can just keep watching that dream, then it would be such a great----

entries.japanese:
「な―――――んて」
　愚か、と呟いて。
　先輩はわずかに銃剣を動かした。
　ギッ、と音をたてて、銃剣が胸に刺さる。
　ほんの少し。
爪の先ぐらいだけ、刃が胸にえぐりこむ。
　先輩の目は止まっている。
　あとは、そのまま。
　彼女が一歩踏み込むだけで、終わる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How…
foolish.”
She murmurs the word and shifts the gun-blade slightly.
With a scrape, the blade enters my chest.
Only a little—the depth of a fingernail—but
its point bites into my flesh.
Her gaze is fixed.
