All that remains is for her to take one step forward, and it will be over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H-----how,"
Foolish, she says.
And she slightly moves her bayonet.
It sticks into my chest.
Just a little bit.
It only goes into me slightly, like a fingernail's depth.
Her eyes have stopped.
All that's left,
is for her to take another step and it'll all be over.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　その最後の一歩が、始まらない。
　彼女は銃剣を構えたまま、感情のない瞳で俺を凝視している。
　ぎり、と。
先輩は、苦しそうに、唇を噛んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
That final step never begins.
She holds the gun-blade steady and stares at me through empty eyes.
Then, painfully, she bites down on her lip.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
But that final step doesn't start.
Bracing the bayonet, she stares at me with her emotionless eyes.
She grits her teeth painfully.

entries.japanese:
「………そっか」
　……俺に見られていてはやりづらいだろう。
　これ以上、この人のこんな、泣き出しそうな顔を見ていたくなかったコトもあるし。
　せめて、苦しませないように。
　目を閉じて、受け入れる事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I see.”
It must be harder for her while I am watching.
And I cannot bear to look any longer at that face, so close to tears.
Hoping to spare her any further pain,
I close my eyes and choose to accept what comes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… I see."
…… It must be too difficult for her to do it while I'm looking at her.
More than anything else, I also don't want to see this person's face on the verge of tears.
So I won't trouble her anymore.
I decide to close my eyes and accept my end.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん、と心臓が震える。
　覚悟しているハズなのに、吐き気とか寒気とかは消えてくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My heart convulses with a heavy thud.
I thought I was prepared, yet the nausea and chills refuse to leave me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
My heart quivers.
Even though I'm prepared, the nausea and chills don't go away.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　　　どくん、どくん。
　　　どくん、どくん、どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thud.
Thud, thud.
Thud, thud, thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
Thump, Thump.

Thump, Thump, Thump.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　喉が熱い。
　指先がガチガチと震えている。
　解っている。
ここで殺されるコトが一番いい方法なんだってわかっているクセに―――ただ、恐かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
My throat burns.
My fingertips chatter uncontrollably.
I know dying here is the best answer. I know it—and still, I am afraid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
My throat is burning.
My fingertips shake uncontrollably.
I know.
I know this is the best way, but still---I'm just scared.

entries.japanese:
――――はあ。
はあ。
はあ。
　漏れそうになる呼吸を必死に圧し留める。
　先輩があと十センチも手を前に突き出せば、俺はただの肉片になってしまう。
　こうして潔く覚悟したつもりなのに、本当は恐くて恐くて震えているココロも、たぶん跡形もなく消えてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Hah. Hah. Hah.
I fight desperately to suppress the breath trying to escape me.
If she drives her hand forward another ten centimeters, I will be reduced to shreds of flesh.
The heart that pretended to meet death bravely while trembling in terror will probably vanish without a trace as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----*pant*, *pant* ,*pant*
I frantically try to hold my breath that tries to spill out.
She simply has to move ten centimeters forward and I'll turn into a mere lump of flesh.

Even though I'm supposed to be ready for this, my fearful heart is scared of disappearing without a trace.

entries.japanese:
――――はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ。
　ただ必死に、口を閉じて受け入れようと努力した。
　胸を刺されれば痛いだろう。
　今こうして思っている自分が、思うことさえできなくなるという事は不理解で恐いだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Hah, hah, hah, hah.
I clamp my mouth shut and struggle to accept it.
A blade through the chest will hurt.
That this thinking self will soon be unable even to think is beyond comprehension—and terrifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
All I do is frantically close my mouth, and try to accept my fate.
It would probably hurt if I get stabbed in the chest.

I'm scared of not being able to think like I am right now.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――ぁ」
　額に汗が滲む。
　それでも、声はあげたくなかった。
　静かに、潔く果てる事ができたのなら。
　先輩は罪悪感なんて抱かずにすむだろうし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah.”
Sweat beads on my brow.
Even so, I do not want to cry out.
If I can meet my end quietly and with dignity,
perhaps she will not have to carry the guilt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"U-----ah."
Sweat beads on my forehead.
But still, I don't want to speak.
If I quietly let everything end,
Senpai probably won't have to feel guilty.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――っ」
　息を呑む音がする。
「どうして―――――」
　搾りだすような声。
「どうして、そんな」
　胸に突きつけられた剣が震えている。
「わたしを恨まないで、いられるんですか」
　いや。
震えているのは、先輩の声だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Someone catches their breath.
“Why—”
Her voice sounds wrung dry.
“Why would you…”
The blade against my chest trembles.
“How can you keep yourself from hating me?”
No. It is her voice that is trembling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Ss."
I hear a gasp.
"Why-----"
A forced voice.
"Why, how?"
The sword sticking into my chest quivers.
"How can you not hate me?"
No.
What's quivering is Senpai's voice.

entries.japanese:
「わたし、わたしは貴方を殺そうとしているんですよ……！？
　今まで騙していて、裏切って、こうして残酷に追い詰めているのに、なんでそんな穏やかな顔をしてるんですか、貴方は……！」
　かつん、と。
　銃剣はそのままで、先輩は俺に向かって踏みこんできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I—I am trying to kill you…! I deceived you, betrayed you, and hunted you down this cruelly. So why are you wearing such a peaceful expression…?”
Click.
Without lowering the gun-blade, she steps toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I am trying to kill you……!
I've deceived you until now, I've betrayed you, and mercilessly hunted you down!
Why does your face look so peaceful……!?"
Tap.
With her sword still in place, she takes another step towards me.

entries.japanese:
「答えなさい……！
　わたしは貴方を殺すんです。
貴方の意思なんて関係なく、ただ一方的に殺そうとしているんです……！
　ならせめて、わたしを憎まないと貴方は報われないじゃないですかっ……！」
　火のついたような激しさで、先輩は問い詰めてくる。
　……やだな。
せっかく恐いのを堪えているのに、ここで声をあげたら感情が堰をきりそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me…! I am going to kill you whether you consent or not. This is nothing but one-sided murder…! If you do not at least hate me for it, how can there be any justice for you…?”
She demands an answer with fiery desperation.
I wish she would stop. I have worked so hard to master my fear; if I speak now, everything inside me may burst free.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer me……!
I am going to kill you.
Without any regards to your own will, just a one-sided murder……!
Then, you won't be compensated unless you hate me, right……!?"
Senpai questions me with burning intensity.
…… Quit it.
I'm working so hard to resist this fear, but if I answer now, my feelings might flow out.

entries.japanese:
「それとも本当に馬鹿なんですか貴方は……！
　わたしは、貴方を汚らしい吸血鬼として処理するんです。
なのに、どうして―――」
　……そんなの、どうしてもなにもないって、さっき言ったのに。
　
「―――だって。
それは、先輩のせいじゃないだろ」
「っ………！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Or are you truly an idiot…? I am going to dispose of you as a filthy vampire. So why—”
I already told her—there is no reason.
“Because, Ciel. None of this is your fault.”
“—!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Or are you really just that stupid……!?
I'm exterminating you as a dirty vampire, so why---"
…… Didn't I tell her it was nothing earlier?
"---Because, it isn't your fault, Senpai."
"………!!"

entries.japanese:
ズッ、と。
　剣の切っ先が胸に食い込む。
　皮膚を裂いたのか、とろり、と生ぬるい血が胸を伝っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The point slides forward.
The sword’s tip bites into my chest.
It splits my skin, and warm blood trickles slowly down my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slice.
The tip of the blade cuts into me further.
It must have broken the skin because fresh blood seeps over my chest.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――あ、ぅ………っ！」
――――激痛。
　傷自体はそう深くはない。
ただ第七聖典という凶器が体内に侵入しただけで、意識がバラバラと砕けていく。
「あ――――ぁ、あ………っ！」
　ガクガクと体が震える。
　体中の血液が逆流して、吐血してしまいそうな程の、痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah… ngh…!”
――――Agony.
The wound itself is not deep. Yet the mere intrusion of the Seventh Holy Scripture into my body makes my consciousness crumble into pieces.
“Ah—ah…!”
My whole body convulses.
The pain is so intense that all my blood seems to reverse its course, ready to erupt from my mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ss----Ah, u……… gh!"
----Sharp pain.
The wound isn't even deep.
But just the slightest penetration by the Seventh Holy Scripture causes my mind to shatter.
"AH----a, Ah………!"
My body shakes uncontrollably.
The blood in my body reverses flow and I almost cough up blood in my pain.

entries.japanese:
「―――痛いでしょう。
本来なら痛みなんて感じさせないように消してあげられるのに、こうしてわざと貴方を苦しめているんです。
　……今まで貴方に付き合わされた分、こうでもして楽しまないと帳尻が合いませんから」
　たどたどしい声でそう言って。
　いっそう深く、銃剣が食い込んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It hurts, doesn’t it? Normally, I could erase you before you felt a thing, yet here I am deliberately making you suffer.”
“After everything you put me through, I deserve at least this much amusement.”
She says it in a halting voice.
Then the bayonet drives deeper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It hurts, right?
I can actually terminate you without making you feel pain, but I'm hurting you like this on purpose.
…… Unless I enjoy this, we won't be able to call it even for all the time I had to spend with you until now."
She seems to be speaking with difficulty.
The bayonet plunges deeper.

entries.japanese:
「ひ――――――アっ！」
　あまりの痛みに全身から汗が噴き出す。
　内臓が、口からこぼれてくるかと、思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hyaaaaaah!”
Sweat bursts from every pore.
For an instant I think my organs will spill out through my mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hya----ah!"
The pain causes sweat to pour out from me.
I feel like my insides are going to flow out through my mouth.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、わたしが憎いでしょう遠野くん。
　だから、だから早く恨んでください……！
　わたしに裏切られたって、わたしなんか信用しなければよかったって言ってください。
　そうでないとわたし―――貴方を殺す事が、できないじゃないですか……！」
　震える声で、そんな事を言った。
　……けど、それはおかしな話だ。
　恨まれないのならそれに越した事はないハズなのに、この人は俺に恨まれたがっている。
　せめて、そうやって一番悪いヤツになる事が―――自分の罰なんだって、言うみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You hate me now, don’t you, Tohno?
So please—please hurry and say it……! Say I betrayed you, that you wish you had never trusted me.
If you do not, I―――I cannot kill you……!”
Her voice shakes.
Yet what she asks makes no sense.
Surely being spared my hatred should be a mercy, but she longs for me to hate her.
As if she were saying: at least this way, by becoming the worst villain of all―――she can punish herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, don't you hate me, Tohno-kun?
So please hate me……!
Tell me I betrayed you.
Tell me it would have been better if you never trusted me.
If you don't---I won't be able to kill you……!"
Her voice shakes as she says this.
…… But, that's just strange.
It's better if I don't hate her, but she still wants me to hate her.
It's like she's telling me that being the bad guy like that, is her punishment.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ……………あ」
　でもそれは無茶な注文だ。
　恨めるハズなんて、ない。
　こんな、まるで泣いている子供のようなこの人を、恨むことなんてできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
But she is asking the impossible.
There is no way I could hate her.
How could I ever hate someone who looks like a child in tears?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……………… Ah."
But, that is an impossible order.
There's no way I can hate her.
I just can't hate this person who looks like a child on the verge of tears.

entries.japanese:
「……まさか。
先輩を恨むことなんて、できない」
「や―――やめてください……！
　どうして、どうして最期までそんなコトを言うんですか……！
　悪いのはわたしで、貴方は被害者だっていうのに……！」
「…………」
　……被害者なのは、先輩も同じだろうに。
　それにどのみち、もうすぐ俺はロアに支配されてしまうんだ。
　その前に、シエル先輩の時のような間違いを犯す前に、俺はロアを殺さないといけない。
　ロアを消す方法が俺の死以外にないのなら―――これは、もうどうしようもないコトなんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Never. I could never hate you.”
“D-don’t say that…!
Why—why would you still say such things at the end…? I am the one at fault, and you are my victim…!”
“…”
She is a victim too.
In any case, Roa will soon take control of me.
Before I repeat the same terrible mistake Roa made while possessing Ciel, I have to kill him.
If my death is the only way to erase Roa, then there is nothing either of us can do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can't be serious.
I can't hate you, Senpai."
"St---stop it please……!
Why, why are you saying that till the very end……!?
I'm the one who's to blame, and you're just a victim……!"
"…………"
…… Isn't Senpai a victim too?
And no matter what, I'll be taken over by Roa soon.
Before that, before I make mistakes like Ciel-senpai did, I have to kill Roa.
There isn't any other way to vanquish Roa than my death---so it just can't be helped.

entries.japanese:
「……いいんだ。
先輩は悪くないよ。
それよりごめん。
こんな役目を、先輩に押し付けて」
「や――――め」
　やめて、と小さな声がして、わずかだけ胸に刺さっていた銃剣が離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—It’s all right. None of this is your fault, Ciel. And I’m sorry. I never wanted to force this duty on you.”
“Stop—”
At that tiny plea, the bayonet withdraws from the shallow wound in my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay.
It's not your fault.
More than that, I'm sorry.
Sorry to make you do this, Senpai."
"St----op."
Stop it, she says in a quiet voice and her bayonet pulls from my chest slightly.

entries.japanese:
「だめ――――わたし、わたしは――――ロアを、見逃すコトなんて、できない」
　ゆらゆらと第七聖典の切っ先が揺れている。
　……だが、それもじき終わるだろう。
「そんなコト―――許されないんです、遠野くん」
　ギリ、という音。
　先輩は必死に歯を噛んで、ぴたりと、第七聖典を止めた。
　第七聖典の切っ先は、ぴったりと俺の心臓を狙いこむ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t—I cannot let Roa escape.”
The point of the Seventh Holy Scripture wavers.
But this too will soon end.
“This cannot be allowed, Tohno.”
Her teeth grind.
With desperate effort, Ciel stills the Seventh Holy Scripture.
Its point takes aim squarely at my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No-----I, I-----can't, let Roa escape."
The tip of the Seventh Holy Scripture wavers.
…… But, that should end soon.
"I can't---allow that, Tohno-kun."
A grinding sound.
Senpai grits her teeth and stops the Seventh Holy Scripture.
The tip of it points at my heart.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　先輩の息を飲む音が聞こえた。
　目を閉じていても、引き鉄にかけた指に力が込められていく気配がわかる。
　カチリ、と。
　硬い鉄の音がする直前。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I hear her catch her breath.
Even with my eyes closed, I can feel her finger tightening on the trigger.
Click.
The instant before the hard sound of iron.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I hear her suck in a breath.
Even with my eyes closed, I can feel her finger gripping the trigger.
Click.
Right before the hard metallic sound,

entries.japanese:
「ありがとう。
たとえ嘘でも―――先輩が先輩でいてくれて、良かった」
　最期に、一番伝えたかった言葉を、遺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. Even if it was all a lie—I’m glad you were the Ciel I knew.”
At the end, I leave behind the words I most wanted her to hear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank you.
Even if it was a lie---it was good having you as Senpai."
In the end, I say what I wanted to tell her the most.

entries.maoEnglish: “…Uh… uh.”

entries.japanese: ―――声が、聞こえる。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――I hear a voice.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---I can, hear a voice.

entries.japanese: 「うあ………あ、ああ、あ」
entries.maoEnglish: “Uah… ah… aah…”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Uah…… ah, aah, ah."

entries.japanese:
―――ぽろぽろと。
　　　子供が泣くような、声が聞こえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Broken sobs spill out.
I hear a voice crying like a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Sobbing.
I can hear a voice that sounds like a crying child.

entries.japanese: 「うぁ……あ……あ、あ」
entries.maoEnglish: “Uah… ah… ah…”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Uwah…… ah…… ah, ah."

entries.japanese:
―――どすん、という音。
　鉄の塊が床に落ちる。
　俺の背後の壁には、槍で貫かれたような銃創が一つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A heavy crash.
The mass of iron strikes the floor.
Behind me, the wall bears a single gunshot crater, as though a spear had punched through it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---A loud thud.
The metallic pile falls to the floor.
A bayonet sticks into the wall behind me like a spear.

entries.japanese:
―――ひっく、ひっく、という、苦しそうな声。
　それが誰のものかわかって、ゆっくりと目を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Painful, hitching sobs.
I know whose they are, and slowly open my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Hic.
Hic.
A pained voice.
I realize who that voice is coming from and I open my eyes slowly.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　そこにいるのは、さっきまでの先輩じゃなかった。
　俺の前で立ち尽くしているのは、うつむいて苦しそうに泣いている、ただの女の子だった。
　彼女の両手には何もない。
　第七聖典は床に落ちている。
　俺の心臓を撃ち抜くハズだった銃剣は、俺のわき腹をすり抜けていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
This is not the Ciel who stood before me moments ago.
She is only a girl with her head bowed, crying as if it hurts.
Her hands are empty.
The Seventh Holy Scripture lies on the floor.
The shot meant to pierce my heart passed harmlessly beside my ribs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
There isn't the Senpai that was there just now.
The one I see standing before me is just a girl crying painfully.
Her hands are empty.
The Seventh Holy Scripture lies fallen on the floor.
The bayonet that should have pierced my heart is thrust by my side.

entries.japanese:
「……う……うあ、あ、あっ……！」
　……先輩は、ただ泣いていた。
　何が悲しいのか、血を吐き出すような苦しさで泣いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Uah, ah…!”
She simply cries.
Whatever grieves her, she cries with the rending agony of coughing up blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… U…… uwaah, ah, aah……!"
…… Senpai just cries.

I don't know what she's sad about, but she cries so painfully I expect her to cough up blood.

entries.japanese:
「…………先、輩」
　声をかける。
「……ずるい……遠野くんは、ずる、い……！」
　ひっく、と喉をしゃくりあげて、駄々ッ子のように先輩は声をあげる。
「……あんな……あんなコト言うなんて、ずるい、です……！
　なんで、わたし、なんか、を……！」
　ポロポロとこぼれる涙。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Ci…el.”
I call to her.
“…You’re not fair… Tohno. You’re not… fair…!”
Her throat catches on a sob, and she raises her voice like a child in the middle of a tantrum.
“Saying—saying something like that is not fair…! Why would you say it to someone like me—?”
Tears spill freely down her cheeks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Sen, pai."
I call out to her.
"…… That's not fair…… Tohno-kun, it's, not, fair……!"
Hic.
Her throat convulses as she shouts like a spoiled child.
"…… Saying…… Saying such a thing, isn't fair……!
Why, why can't I……!"
Her tears course down her face.

entries.japanese:
「できない……わたし、自分だっていつでも殺せるのに、あんなコト言われたら、できない……！」
　彼女は俺を見る事を恥じるように。
「ありがとう、なんて―――そんな幸せな人を、死なせるなんて、ヤだ――――」
　両手で両目を覆って、ただボロボロと泣き続ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t do it… I could kill myself whenever I wanted, but after you said that, I just can’t…!”
As though ashamed even to look at me.
“You thanked me and sounded so happy—I don’t want someone that happy to die—”
She covers both eyes with her hands and continues to weep helplessly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I can't…… Even though I can even kill myself at any time, if you say that to me, I can't……!"
She seems ashamed to see me.
"Saying thank you like that---I can't, let such a happy person die like that----"
She covers her face with her hands and continues to weep.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
そんなに泣かれると、困る」
　……その、どうしていいか解らなくなるから。
「うっ……うう、うあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁん……！」
　……俺の言葉が悪かったのか、先輩は声をあげて一際大きく泣き始めた。
「もう―――――なんだって、いきなり……！」
　自分でもどうしてそうしたのかは解らない。
　ただ、目の前で泣いているこの人を放っておけなくて、強引に腕を引っ張って抱き寄せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ciel. I don’t know what to do when you cry this hard.”
I truly have no idea how to help her.
“Uhhh—waaaaaah!”
Maybe I said the wrong thing, because she raises her voice and cries harder still.
“Come on—why all of a sudden…?”
I do not understand why I do it.
I simply cannot leave her crying in front of me, so I catch her arm and pull her roughly into my embrace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
Seeing you cry makes me troubled."
…… Because I won't know what to do.
"Uu…… uu, uwaaaaaaah……!"
…… My words might have been the wrong choice, as Senpai cries even louder.
"Geez-----why are you doing this all of a sudden……!"
I don't even understand why I did that.
But, I can't leave this person who's crying in front of me, so I pull her to me and embrace her.

entries.japanese:
――――どん、という衝撃。
　先輩はあっさりと俺の胸に倒れてきて、声を押し殺して泣き続けた。
「………ごめん、なさい……！」
―――ごめんなさい、と。
　震える声で、何度も何度も、そんな言葉を繰り返しながら。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Her body hits mine with a heavy thud.
She collapses easily against my chest and keeps crying, smothering the sound.
“—I’m sorry.”
―――Sorry, she says.
In a trembling voice, she repeats those words again and again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----We collide with a thud.
Senpai collapses against my chest and continues crying as she stifles her voice.
"……… I'm, sorry……!"
---I'm sorry.
With a quivering voice, she says this over and over.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……なんだ。
　嘘だったのは、さっきまでの先輩じゃないか。
　やっと、先輩に会えた。
　電話をしてからたった一時間程度だけど、とても長い間、先輩を待っていた気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I see.
The false Ciel was the one standing here until a moment ago.
At last I have found her.
Barely an hour has passed since the phone call, yet it feels as though I have been waiting for her forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… What is this?
Then, the real lie was the Senpai up until now.
Finally, I get to meet Senpai.
It was about an hour after I called her, but I feel like I've waited for so long.

entries.japanese:
「……謝らなくていいんだ、先輩」
　ただそうしてあげたくて、満足に動く右手で先輩の体を抱く。
「あ――――――――」
　なにか、張り詰めていたものが切れたような声をあげて。
　先輩は、ようやく泣きやんでくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—You don’t have to apologize, Ciel.”
I want nothing more than to do this for her.
With my one working arm, I hold her close.
“Ah—”
The sound is like something stretched too tight finally snapping, and at last, Ciel stops crying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You don't have to apologize, Senpai."
I just wanted to do so, and I embrace her with my still functional right hand.
"Ah--------"
A voice like something stretched was just snapped.
Senpai finally stops crying.

entries.japanese:
……どくん、とくん、という音。
　お互いの心音が、自分のもののように聞こえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud, thump.
Our heartbeats sound so close that I cannot tell hers from mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Thump.
Thump.
I can hear the heartbeat of the person across from me like my own.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　ひどく、静かだ。
　かける言葉なんて見当たらない。
　ただこうして―――この人の鼓動を聞いているだけで、よかった。
―――求めていたものは。
　俺が望んだことなんて、本当に小さな事だった。
　こうして、先輩が先輩のままでいてくれるだけでよかったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The silence is absolute.
I can find no words to give her.
It is enough simply to hold her and listen to her heart.
―――What had I been searching for?
My wish was truly such a small one. All I wanted was for her to remain herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
It's awfully quiet.
I can't find the right words to say.
But staying like this---just hearing her heartbeat is good enough.
---What I really wanted.
What I really wished for was just a small thing.
Like this, it was just fine having Senpai like she is.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
先輩の体、あったかい」
「……違います。
あったかいのは遠野くんのほうで、わたしは、イヤになるぐらい、冷たい人間です。
こんなに―――優しいひとに、酷いことを、しました」
　……違う、先輩。
俺は優しくなんかない。
　今だって、ただ、先輩に触れていたいだけなんだ。
　ただ――――ずっと、こうしていたいだけなんだ。
「……いいよ。
俺はまだ生きているんだから、それでいい。
もう……こうしていられるなら、それでいいんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ciel. Your body is so warm.”
“—No. You are the warm one, Tohno. I am so cold it disgusts me, and I did something terrible to someone so kind.”
No, Ciel. I am not kind.
Even now, I only want to keep touching her.
I only want—to stay like this forever.
“—It’s all right. I’m still alive, and that is enough. If I can stay like this with you—this is enough.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
Your body is warm."
"…… No.
The one who is warm is you, Tohno-kun.
I am a very cold person.
I---did such terrible things to such a nice person."
…… No, Senpai.
I'm not kind.
Even now, I just want to touch you, Senpai.
I just----want to stay like this forever.
"…… It's okay.
I'm still alive, so it's okay.
If…… we can keep doing this, it's okay."

entries.japanese:
俺は、昔死にかけて。
　その後に、ただ生きているというコトは、それだけで幸運なコトなんだって気がついた。
　死の見える世界。
　死が視える世界。
　いつだって簡単に、何かの弾みで失われていくモノたち。
　けど、だからこそ――――生きているという事は、それだけで幸運なコトなんだ。
　それを実感できる事。
こうして先輩の体温を感じられる事は、それだけで、幸福すぎる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Long ago, I nearly died.
Afterward I realized that merely being alive was already a stroke of incredible fortune.
A world where death is visible.
A world where death can be perceived.
Things that can vanish at any time, lost to the smallest accident.
But precisely because of that, life itself is a blessing.
To feel that truth. To feel Ciel’s warmth against me—is almost too much happiness to bear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I died once a long time ago.
After that, I realized how much happiness it was just to be alive.
A world where death can be seen.
A world where I can see death.
Every time, things that are easily lost.
But, that's why----being alive is happiness.
To feel that, being able to feel Senpai's warmth like this, is an exceeding happiness by itself.

entries.japanese:
「―――先輩。
俺、先輩がすごく大切だ」
「…………っ」
「俺はやっぱり死にたくない。
ぎりぎりまで生きて、こうして先輩と一緒にいたい」
　ぎゅっ、と。
　先輩の手が、強く、握られる。
「だから先輩には生きていてほしいんだ。
お願いだから……死ぬことが望みなんて、言わないでくれ」
「……………」
　返答はない。
　とくん、とくん、と。
　先輩の鼓動が、肌を通じて伝わってくるだけで。

「……………だめ、ですよ、そんなの」
　不意に。
　泣きそうな声で、彼女は言った。

「……わたしは、そのために今まで生きていたんです。
　死ねるから。
ロアさえ消してしまえば死ねるから、わたしは死ななくちゃいけないから、ずっと、我慢してこれた。
　お父さんとお母さんを殺したから、みんなを殺してしまったから、こんな体になったから、遠野くんを騙して殺そうとしたから―――わたしは、早く、一秒でも早く、死なないと、いけない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ciel. You matter so much to me.”
“…!”
“I do not want to die after all. I want to live until the last possible moment and spend that time with you.”
Her hand closes around mine.
She squeezes hard.
“So I want you to live too. Please—do not say that death is what you want.” “…”
She does not answer.
Thump, thump.
All I can feel is Ciel’s heartbeat through our skin.
“—No, you can’t ask that of me.”
Suddenly.
She speaks, her voice close to tears.
“That is what I have lived for.
I endured it all for that reason. I would be allowed to die once Roa was gone—because I had to die.
I killed my mother and father, killed everyone, became this thing, deceived you, and tried to murder you―――so I have to die, as soon as I possibly can.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Senpai.
You are really dear to me."
"…………"
"I don't want to die.
I want to live as much as I can, and I want to be with you like this, Senpai."
Firmly,
I grip her hands.
"So I want you to live.
Please…… please don't say your wish is to die."
"……………"
There's no answer.
Thump, Thump.
Just the beating of her heart through our skin.

"……………… No, that can't happen."
Suddenly,
she speaks in a crying voice.

"…… That's the only thing that kept me going until now.
I could die.
If Roa disappeared, I could die.
I must die.
That's why I could bear everything so far.
Because I killed my father and mother, because I killed everyone, because I became like this, and because I tricked you and tried to kill you----I, without delay, I have to die."

entries.japanese:
「……死ななくちゃいけないって、どうして。
　そりゃあたしかに先輩は苦しいことをしてきただろうけど、それは先輩のせいじゃないだろ……！」
「だとしても、悪いコトをしてきたのはわたし自身の手でしょう、遠野くん」
「違う……！
　悪いのはロアのヤツだ。
先輩が死ななくちゃいけない理由なんて、どこにもない！」
「―――でも、生きていていい理由も、ないじゃないですか」
　言って。
　先輩はくすりと、自分自身を蔑むように、笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why—why do you have to die?
You may have done terrible things, but none of that was your fault…!” “Even so, these hands committed them, Tohno.”
“No…! Roa is the one at fault. There is no reason anywhere in this world that you have to die!”
“But there is no reason I should be allowed to live, either.”
She says it.
Ciel gives a tiny laugh, as if mocking herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why do you have to die?
Certainly you've done a lot of painful things, but that wasn't your fault, Senpai……!"
"You say that, but I did them all with my own hands, Tohno-kun."
"No……!
The one who's at fault is Roa.
There's, no reason you have to die, Senpai!"
"---But, there's no reason for me to live either."
Saying that,
Senpai gives a mirthless laugh.

entries.japanese:
「……わかってる。
わたしにはそんな資格なんてないって、わかっている、つもりでした。
わたしは、ひどいことを、たくさんしてきてしまったから」
　なのに、どうして、と。
　先輩は、震える声で呟いた。
「わたしは幸せになんかなってはいけないんです。
だから今までずっと考えなかったのに、夢見る事さえなかったのに……！
　なのに、なのに、どうして―――」
　だん、と。
　泣いている子供のように、先輩の手が、胸を叩く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I know. I thought I understood that I had no right. I have done so many terrible things.”
And yet—why?
Ciel whispers in a trembling voice.
“I am not allowed to be happy. That is why I never thought about it, never even let myself dream…!
And yet—yet why—”
Thump.
Like a crying child, Ciel pounds a fist against my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I know.
I know I don't have the right.
I, did so many horrible things."
But why?
She asks with a quivering voice.
"I don't deserve to be happy.
That's why I never thought of it, that's why I never even dreamed of it……!
But, but why---"
Thud.
Like a crying child, Senpai beats her hand against my chest.

entries.japanese:
「今になって、どうして―――こんな、罪深い、夢を」
　見て、しまっているのか、と。
　深く、いっそう俺の胸に顔をうずめて、震える声で、先輩は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why now—why am I dreaming such a sinful dream?”
She asks why she has let herself dream it.
Burying her face deeper against my chest, she speaks in a trembling voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So why---now, do I see,"
this sinful dream?
She buries her face deep in my chest as she says this.

entries.japanese:
「……あんまりにも、楽しかったんです。
　こんなのは嘘だ、わたしは楽しい生活の芝居をしているだけなんだって解っていたのに、それでもいいって思うぐらい――――嘘でもいいから無くしたくないって思うぐらい、楽しかった。
　まるで夢の中の出来事みたいに幸せで、一日でも長く続いてほしかった」
　……なんだ。
俺たちの欲しかったもの、望んでいたものは、結局同じだったんじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I had so much fun.
I knew it was a lie, that I was only playing at a happy life; even so, it was such fun that I did not care, that I could not bear to lose it even if it was false.
It was like happiness inside a dream, and I wanted it to last for even one more day.”
So that was it. In the end, what we wanted—what we had both wished for—was the same.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It was so fun.
Even though I knew it was all a lie and I'm just playing out the life where I'm having fun, I thought it was fine the way it was----it was so much fun, I didn't want it to end even if I knew it was all a lie.
An almost dream-like happiness that I wanted to always last just one day longer."
…… I see.
What we wanted, what we wished for, was the same after all.

entries.japanese:
「―――でも、そんな我が侭は許されない。
　わたしは一刻も早くロアを殺して、罰を受けないといけないんです。
　わたしには遠野くんたちみたいに生きていい権利なんてない。
　そんなコト、言われなくてもわかってる。
　こんな夢を見てしまって、遠野くんさえ殺せないのなら、わたしは消えるしかない。
　わたしにはもう、ここにいていい理由がありません」
　痛みに耐えるぐらいの悲しい顔をして、先輩はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I am not allowed such selfishness.
I must kill Roa as quickly as possible and accept my punishment.
I have no right to live as you and your friends do.
No one needs to tell me that; I already know.
If dreaming this dream has made me unable even to kill you, then all I can do is disappear.
I no longer have any reason to remain here.”
She says it with such sorrow on her face that she seems to be enduring physical pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But, that selfishness can't be allowed.
I have to kill Roa quickly and receive my punishment.
I have no right to live a normal life like you, Tohno-kun.
Such a thing, I understand without you saying it.
If I'm wishing for such a dream and I can't even kill you, I can't do anything but disappear.
There's no longer a reason for me to stay here."
Senpai speaks with an anguished face.

entries.japanese:
「……さよなら。
ありがとうって言ってくれて、本当に、嬉しかった」
　先輩はそっと離れた。
　さっきまで伝わってきていた心音が途切れてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Goodbye. Hearing you thank me made me happier than I can say.”
Ciel gently draws away.
The heartbeat I felt moments ago disappears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Farewell.
I was, really happy to hear you thank me."
Senpai pulls back from me.
The heartbeat I felt up until now cuts off.

entries.japanese:
……この人には、もう何度もさよならを言われてきた。
　あの時だって。
　笑顔で、とても大切な事のように、こんな事を言っていたんだっけ。
―――さよなら。
わたし、遠野くんと乾くんのような学生になりたかった。
　……本当に、どうして気がつかなかったんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
She has already said goodbye to me so many times.
That day, too.
She smiled as she said these words, as though they were something precious.
―――Goodbye. I wanted to be a student like you and Inui.
How had I never noticed?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… This person has told me farewell so many times.
Even that time.
With a smile, she said it as if it was very important to her.
---Farewell.
I really did want to be a student like you and Inui-kun.
…… Really, why didn't I ever realize it?

entries.japanese:
この人は、そんな簡単なことを。
　とおとい夢のように、語っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
For her, something so simple was enough.
She spoke of it as though it were a precious dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She would always say those simple things,
as if they were a distant dream for her.

entries.japanese:
「―――違う。
そんなのは夢なんかじゃない」
「え――――きゃっ……！」
　離れていく先輩の体を力ずくで引き戻した。
　愛しいというより、ただ悲しくて、先輩の体を抱き寄せる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. That isn’t a dream.”
“Wha—ah…!”
I seize her as she pulls away and drag her back by force.
Less out of tenderness than sheer sorrow, I gather her into my arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
It's not a dream."
"Eh----kya……!"
I pull Senpai's body back towards me.
Less out of love and more out of sorrow, I draw her close.

entries.japanese:
「と、遠野くん、もう――――」
「駄目だ。
先輩の嘘には、もう騙されない」
　離れようとする先輩の体を抱きしめる。
「続けたいんなら続ければいいじゃないか。
先輩が言っているコトは、決して夢なんかじゃない」
「そんな……そんなコト、できっこない、です」
「なんで？
　だって本当にあったコトじゃないか。
先輩さえ望めばすぐに戻ってくる生活だろ。
そんな簡単なコト、夢みたいだったなんて言わないでくれ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“T-Tohno, please—”
“No. I’m not falling for your lies anymore.”
I hold her tighter as she tries to pull away.
“If you want that life to continue, then let it continue. Nothing you described was ever a dream.”
“I—I could never do that.”
“Why not? It truly happened. If you want it back, that life can begin again tomorrow. Please don’t call something so simple a dream.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"To, Tohno-kun, that's enough-----"
"No.
I won't be fooled by your lies anymore, Senpai."
I hold her close to me as she tries to escape.
"If you want to continue, then go ahead and do so.
What you're talking about is definitely not a dream."
"That…… that's impossible."
"Why?
After all, it really happened in reality.
It's a way of life that if you wish for it, it will come back.
Please don't call such simple things like that a dream."

entries.japanese:
「……無理です。
遠野くんをこんなに傷つけてしまったのに、今さら―――元に戻ることなんて、できないでしょう」
「ああ、それなら大丈夫。
俺は気にしてないから、先輩も気にしなくていいよ。
　ほら、好きな人に追いかけられるっていうのも貴重な経験だったしさ」
　できるだけ明るく、冗談のように言う。
「…………」
　先輩は黙っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I can’t. Not after hurting you this badly—we cannot go back to how things were now.”
“That part is all right. I do not mind, so you do not have to either.
Besides, being chased by the girl I love was a rare experience.”
I make it sound as bright and joking as I can.
“…”
Ciel remains silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's impossible.
I've hurt you so much, Tohno-kun, it's too late to go back."
"Oh, that's okay.
I don't mind, so you shouldn't either.
See, I think I got to experience something as rare as truly being chased by the one I like."
I try to sound as jokingly cheerful as I can.
"……………"
Senpai is silent.

entries.japanese:
「それに今夜の先輩、かっこ良かった。
いつもの神父さんみたいな服装もいいけど、今日みたいなハデな服も似合ってて、見れてラッキーだったし」
　
「…………………」
　先輩は黙っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You looked amazing tonight. I like the priestly clothes you usually wear, but the flashy outfit suited you too.”
“…”
Ciel remains silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And tonight, you looked really cool.
Those clergy robes are good too, but your outfit tonight really suits you too.
I was lucky to see it."
"………………"
Senpai is silent.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、メガネをかけてないとイメージ変わるんだな。
キリッとして、なんだか年上みたいに見えたよ」
「…………………………」
　……やっぱり先輩は黙っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You look completely different without your glasses—sharper somehow. You even seem older.”
“…”
She still says nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, you look different without your glasses.
You were handsome, and you looked older."
"……………………"
…… As expected, Senpai is silent.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――はあ」
　何を言っても先輩は答えてくれない。
　場をなごませようとした会話も空振りしてしまって、他に言うべき言葉が見付からない。
「……先輩、何か言ってよ。
それとももう俺なんかとは話したくない？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
Nothing I say draws an answer.
Every attempt to lighten the mood falls flat, and I can think of nothing else.
“—Ciel, say something. Or do you not want to talk to me anymore?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
--------*sigh*
Not matter what I say, Senpai does not answer.
I try as hard as I can to soften the mood but fail miserably.
I don't know what else I can say.
"…… Senpai, say something.
Or don't you want to talk to me now?"

entries.japanese:
「………………………」
　先輩は答えない。
　ただ俺の胸にこつん、と額を当てて。
　小さく、囁くように、
「…………………………ばか」
　……なんて、コトを言ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Ciel does not answer.
She merely rests her forehead against my chest.
Then, in the tiniest whisper—
“—Idiot.”
That is what she says to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………………"
Senpai doesn't answer.
She just pats her forehead on my chest.
Softly, like a murmur,
"…………………… Idiot,"
…… is what she ends up saying.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くんは、ばかです。
　わたしは、遠野くんが思っているような人間じゃないのに、どうして、そんなに優しく、できるんですか」
「だって、先輩には泣いてほしくない。
笑っていてほしいから、元気になってほしいんだ」
「……でも、わたしにはそんな資格ありません。
遠野くんに優しくしてもらえる資格なんて、ないんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are an idiot, Tohno.
I am not the person you imagine me to be; how can you still treat me so kindly?”
“Because I don’t want you to cry. I want you to smile and be happy again.”
“—But I have no right to that. I have no right to receive your kindness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun, you're an idiot.
I, I'm not the person you think I am, so how can you be so nice?"
"Because I don't want you to cry.
I want you to laugh; I want you to cheer up."
"…… But, I don't have the right.
I don't have the right to receive your kindness."

entries.japanese:
「………………」
―――優しくしてもらう資格。
　そんなもの、俺にだってありはしなかった。
　けど、それでも―――そんなものは必要ないって笑い飛ばしてくれたのは、この人だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――The right to be treated kindly.
I never possessed such a thing either.
Yet she alone laughed away the very notion that anyone needed one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
---A right to receive kindness.
I didn't have such a thing either.
But, still---the one who laughed it off and told me that I didn't need such a thing, was her.

entries.japanese:
「知らないよ。
俺には先輩の事情なんてわからないし、正直そんなものどうでもいい。
俺が先輩に優しくするのは先輩のためじゃないから、気にしないでくれ」
　いつか。
　アルクェイドを殺してしまって、自殺ぐらいしか考えつかなかった俺に、貴方がそう言ってくれたように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. I don’t understand your circumstances, and honestly, I don’t care. I’m not being kind for your sake, so please don’t concern yourself with it.”
Once, long ago.
When I had killed Arcueid and could think of nothing but suicide, Ciel said the same thing to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't know.
I don't know your circumstances, and honestly I don't care.
I'm not being kind to you for your sake, so don't worry about it."
That time.
After I killed Arcueid and when I could only think of killing myself, just like what you said to me that time.

entries.japanese:
「……あの、さ。
俺は、俺が先輩に優しくしてあげたいからこうしているんだと思う。
　そこに先輩の事情はあまり関係ないんだ。
先輩にとっては迷惑だろうけど、たちの悪い後輩に捕まったと思って、いいかげん観念してくれないか」
　ぎゅっ、と。
　一際強く抱きしめて、先輩と肌を重ね合う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen. I think I’m doing this because I want to be kind to you.
Your circumstances don’t have much to do with it. I know it may be a nuisance, but you’re stuck with one incorrigible junior now, so give in already.”
I squeeze her tight.
I hold her closer still, until our bodies press together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, well.
I think I'm doing this because I want to be kind to you.
Your circumstances have nothing to do with this.
It may be a bother to you, but just think of yourself as having been caught by a mean-spirited underclassman and give up."
Harder,
I hold her even more strongly to me, and press our bodies together.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――志貴、くん」
「先輩の罪なんて知らない。
　俺は先輩の事が好きだから―――先輩を愛しているから、優しくするんだ。
　他のことなんてどうでもいい。
俺は先輩と幸せになりたい。
―――ずっと一緒にいたいから、シエルに、死んでほしくないだけだ」
「でも―――わたし、は――――」
「……それでも。
それでも先輩が幸せになりたくないっていうんなら、それでもいい。
俺がかってに、先輩がどんなに嫌がっても傍にいて幸せにしてやるから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—Shiki.”
“I don’t care about your sins.
I’m kind to you because I love you—because I’m in love with you.
Nothing else matters. I want us to be happy together. I want to stay with you forever—and I don’t want Ciel to die.”
“But—I—”
“—Even so. Even if you insist that you don’t want happiness, that’s fine. I’ll stay beside you and make you happy whether you like it or not…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----Tohno, kun."
"I don't know about your sins.
I like you---I love you Senpai, that's why I'm being kind to you.
Everything else doesn't matter.
I just want to be happy with you.
---I want to be with you forever, so I don't want you to die."
"But---I, I----"
"…… But still.
Still, if you say you don't want to be happy, that's fine too.
I'll just do what I want, and no matter how much you might hate it, I'll be by your side and make you happy……!"

entries.japanese:
「だから―――もう、さよならなんて言わないでくれ」
　言って。
抱き寄せた先輩の顔に手をそえる。
「志貴――――――くん」
　微かな呟きのあと。
　俺たちは、そうする事が自然のように、互いの唇を重ね合った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So please—don’t ever say goodbye again.”
I say it. Then I place a hand against the face I have drawn close.
“Shiki…”
After that faint whisper.
We kiss as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So---please, don't say farewell anymore."
Saying that, I bring my hands to her face.
"Shiki------kun."
After she says this faintly…
Completely naturally, our two lips come together.

entries.japanese:
「―――――ん」
　……唇が離れる。
　抱き寄せていた腕も力尽きたように解けて、シエル先輩はそっと体を離した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Mm.”
Our lips part.
My arms loosen as if their strength has finally run out, and Ciel gently draws away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Mm."
…… Our lips separate.
Ciel-senpai lets her arms fall to the side and pulls back from me.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　……廊下は静まりかえっている。
　月光だけが青く世界を染める光景を見て、俺は、急速に現実に引き戻された。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The corridor lies utterly still.
Moonlight alone stains the world blue, and the sight drags me abruptly back to reality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
…… The hallway is silent.
Seeing the blue moonlight faintly shading the world jolts me back to reality.

entries.japanese:
「は………あ」
　俺の行為は、この上なく愚かだ。
　自分自身でさえ出口がないっていうのに、先輩を抱きとめても意味がない。
　けど、抱き寄せずにはいられなかった。
　出来る事なら、あのままずっと、この人を抱きしめていたかったぐらいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…”
What I have done is foolish beyond measure.
I have no escape from my own fate, so embracing her can change nothing.
Still, I could not help pulling her close.
If I had been able, I would have held her forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha…… ah."
I just… made a big fool of myself.
Even though there's no way out even for me, it's meaningless to embrace her.
But, I couldn't refrain from doing so.
If I could, I wanted to stay like that forever.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん。
いいんですか、そんなコトいって」
「―――ごめん。
俺、考えなしだ。
俺本人、もうどうしようもないのに―――偉そうなこと、口にしてる」
「そんなコトを言ってるんじゃないですよ。
わたしなんかとそんな約束していいんですかって、聞いてるんです」
　先輩の声からはさっきまでの弱々しい響きが消えている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. Are you sure you can say that?”
“I’m sorry. I wasn’t thinking. I’m already beyond saving, yet I stood there making grand promises.”
“That isn’t what I mean. I’m asking whether you’re certain you should make a promise like that to someone like me.”
The frailty has vanished from her voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun.
Is it okay to say that?"
"---Sorry, I wasn't thinking.
I don't even know what to do with myself---and I was saying such haughty words."
"That's not what I'm saying.
I'm asking you if you really can make that sort of promise with me."
The weakness she had in her voice has disappeared completely.

entries.japanese:
「……いいに決まってるだろ。
俺はこんなだけど、せめて自分が残っているうちぐらいは、先輩のことを愛してる」
「無責任なこと言わないでください。
わたしを幸せにしてくださるんでしたら、ずっと、遠野くんには遠野くんのままでいてもらわないと困ります」
　……それはそうだけど、それは叶わない。
　俺は明日にだって、自分でいられるかどうか自信がないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Of course I’m certain. I may be like this now, but for as long as any of me remains, I love you.”
“Then don’t say such irresponsible things. If you intend to make me happy, I need you to remain yourself forever.”
She is right, but what she asks is impossible.
I am not even certain I will still be myself tomorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Of course.
I'm like this, but as long as there's a piece of me remaining, I'll always love you, Senpai."
"Please don't say irresponsible things.
If you're going to make me happy, you have to stay as Tohno-kun."
…… That's true, but it won't happen.
I can't even trust if I'll be myself by the time tomorrow comes.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん。
俺は、駄目だ。
先輩、俺が本当に戻れなくなったら、その時は―――」
「―――死なせません」
　きっぱりと。
　強く、彼女は俺の言葉をさえぎった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I’m sorry. I can’t. If the time comes when I truly cannot return, then—”
“—I will not let you die.”
She says it without hesitation.
Her words cut mine off with absolute force.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
I, I'm hopeless.
Senpai, when I get to a point where I can't turn back, at that time---"
"---I will not let you die."
She declares.
She strongly interrupts my words.

entries.japanese:
「貴方は、絶対に死なせない。
ロアなんかに遠野くんは渡さない」
「先輩、けど―――」
「わたしが貴方を守ります。
必ず、必ず救ってみせる。
だから―――そんなこと、言わないでください」
　先輩はすぐに立ちあがって、真剣な顔つきで俺の体の傷を看てくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I will never let you die. I will not surrender you to Roa.”
“Ciel, but—”
“I will protect you. I swear—I swear I will save you. So please, do not say that.”
She rises at once and begins examining my wounds with grave concentration.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I will not let you die.
I won't let Roa have you."
"Senpai, but---"
"I will protect you.
I will save you, no matter what.
So---please do not say that."
Senpai quickly stands up and with a serious face, tends to my wounds.

entries.japanese:
「……傷そのものはもう治ってますね。
夜ですから、肉体が吸血種よりになっているんです。
　えっと、そのおかげで遠野くんを殺さずにすんだんですから、少しはロアにも感謝するべきなんでしょうか」
　……場をなごますためか、先輩は返答しにくい冗談を口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—The wounds themselves have already healed. It is nighttime, so your body has shifted closer to a vampiric species.
Well, since that kept me from killing you, perhaps we should be a little grateful to Roa.”
Perhaps to ease the tension, she attempts a joke that leaves me with no possible answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It seems they have already healed.
It's nighttime, so your body is more like that of a vampire's right now.
Um, thanks to that, you were not killed.
Maybe we should give Roa some thanks."
…… Trying to lighten the mood or something, Senpai gives a joke that isn't exactly easy to reply to.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、一人で立てますか？」
「立てるけど―――先輩、俺を救うってなにか方法でもあるのか……？」
「……確実とは言えませんが、法王庁に戻れば何か手段が見付かるかもしれません。
　その、以前と違ってわたしというサンプルがありましたから、転生体の意識を残したままロアの魂だけを封印する技術らしきものは研究されている筈なんです」
「―――なんだよそれ。
そんな便利な方法があるんなら、どうして―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you stand on your own?”
“I can, but—do you actually know some way to save me?”
“—I cannot promise it will work, but if we return to the Holy See, we may find some means.
Unlike before, they now have me as a specimen, so there should be research into something like a technique for sealing only Roa’s soul while leaving the consciousness of his reincarnation vessel intact.”
“What the hell? If there’s a convenient method like that, why didn’t you—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, can you stand by yourself?"
"I can stand, but---Senpai, is there really a way to save me……?"
"…… I can't say for sure, but if I go back to the Vatican, there might be a way.
Um, unlike before, they had a sample, me, to research on, so they should have researched into how to seal Roa's soul while leaving the reincarnated human's consciousness."
"---What's that?
If there was such an easy way, then why---"

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん。
たしかに教会に行けば貴方は助かるかもしれない。
けど、そこで待っているのは地獄かもしれない。
　教会の方々にとってみれば、わたしも貴方も異端者です。
遠野くんは研究に協力するという形で治療をうけます。
　……遠野くんは目の事さえ黙っていれば一般人ですから、わたしのように研究材料として扱われる事はないでしょうけど―――」
「―――つまり、すごく痛い？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Tohno, the Church may be able to save you. But what waits there may also be hell.
To the Church, both you and I are heretics. You would receive treatment by participating in their research.
If you keep your eyes secret, you are otherwise an ordinary person, so they probably would not use you as research material the way they used me—but…”
“So it’s going to hurt a lot?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun.
Certainly The Church may be able to help you, but what awaits you may be hell.
To the people of The Church, you and I are both heretics.
You will get the treatment in return for helping their research.
…… Although if you stay quiet about your eyes, you may not be treated like a lab specimen like I was, but---"
"---In other words, it'll really hurt?"

entries.japanese:
「―――はい。
それでも治療ができなかった場合、遠野くんは吸血種として扱われてしまうんです。
　……わたしは貴方に、死より辛い事を経験してほしくはありません。
　だからわたしは、いっそ―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. And if the treatment fails, they will classify you as one of the vampiric species.
I don’t want you to suffer anything worse than death.
That is why I thought it might be better to—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yes.
And if they still could not heal you, you would be treated as a vampire.
…… I don't want you to experience those terrible things worse than death.
That's why, I---"

entries.japanese:
「……いいよ先輩。
どのみちこのままじゃ行き止まりなんだ。
少しでもなんとか出来る可能性があるんなら、ローマだろうがイタリアだろうが、どこにだって行くしかないだろ。
　……たとえどんな結果になろうと、先輩に文句はいわないよ」
「―――いえ。
誰にも遠野くんは傷つけさせません。
それだけは信じてください」
「……ああ。
先輩を信じるよ」
　……というか、そんな事より旅費とかパスポートとかを心配してしまう自分の小市民ぶりが情けない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—It’s fine. The road I’m on ends here anyway. If there’s even the smallest chance of fixing this, then I have no choice but to go—whether it’s Rome or Italy or anywhere else.
Whatever happens, I won’t blame you.”
“—No. I will not let anyone hurt you. Believe me on that.”
“—I do. I believe you.”
Though honestly, the fact that I am worrying about travel expenses and passports at a time like this makes me ashamed of how painfully ordinary I am.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay, Senpai.
Right now, we're at a dead end.
If there's even the slightest chance, then we have to go wherever.
…… And no matter how it turns out, I won't complain, Senpai."
"---No.
I won't let anyone hurt you.
Please trust me on that."
"…… Yeah, I trust you, Senpai."
…… I say that, but being a real small-town person, I'm actually kind of worried about things like my passport and airfare.

entries.japanese:
「けどどうするんだ。
もしかしてこのまま法王庁とやらに行くことになるの？」
「いえ、今夜はわたしが遠野くんの治療を行います。
ロアは吸血種ですから、朝になれば活動も沈静化します。
　……単に法王庁に赴くだけなら簡単なんですけど、遠野くんの問題は裏側のものです。
わたしの時と同じで本来有り得てはいけない事柄ですから、遠野くんは教会の裏側に足を運ばないといけない。
　ですが、そこに遠野くんを直接連れていくには幾つかの許可をとらないとダメなんです。
最低限の洗礼を行うにしても、この街に秘跡を行える聖堂はありません。
　この国でわたしたちよりの洗礼ができる聖堂は一つしかありませんから、まずは一度聖堂まで来てもらわないと」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So what happens now? Are we heading straight to this Holy See of yours?”
“No. I will treat you myself tonight; Roa is one of the vampiric species, so his activity should subside by morning.
Going to the Holy See itself would be easy, but your case belongs to the hidden side of the Church. Like mine, it should never have existed, so you must enter the Church’s hidden world.
I cannot take you there directly without obtaining several permissions. Even the bare minimum requires a baptism, and there is no church in this city equipped to administer the sacrament.
There is only one church in this country that can perform the kind of baptism our side requires, so first I will need you to go there.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But what are we going to do?
Are we going to the Vatican right now?"
"No, I will treat you for tonight.
Roa is a vampire, so when it becomes morning, he will calm down.
…… It would be simple if it was just a matter of taking you to the Vatican, but your problem is something that should be kept low-profile.
Just like with me, you are something that should not exist, so you have to go to the hidden part of The Church.
But, to take you there, I have to get some permission.
Even if we were to minimally purify you, there aren't any places in this city where we could do that.
There is only one place where we can purify you in our way in this country, so I have to take you there first."

entries.japanese:
「ふうん。
それじゃ朝になったら教会に行くっていうことですか」
「いえ、そう簡単にはいかないんです。
信徒でもない遠野くんが法王庁に入るためには、もう頭が痛くなるぐらい面倒な許可が必要になります。
　ですから、明日になったらわたしが遠野くんに仮の入会が許されるようにこの国にある聖堂に赴きます。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So we go to church in the morning?”
“No, it is not that simple. For someone who is not even a believer to enter the Holy See requires enough maddening paperwork to make my head ache.
Tomorrow, I will go to the cathedral here in Japan and apply for your provisional admission.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm.
So, are you saying we're going to The Church tomorrow morning?"
"No, it's not that simple.
For an unbeliever like you to enter the Vatican, there is a long and frustrating approval process.
So, tomorrow, I will go to the church in this country so that you can get a temporary permit.

entries.japanese:
「……その、手続きには何日かかかるでしょうけど、その間はわたしの部屋で待っていてください。
　部屋には吸血鬼用の封鎖を施しますから、そこにいてくれれば一週間や二週間程度はロアを抑えられるでしょう」
「……先輩の部屋って―――もしかして、先輩の部屋に泊まりこむのか、俺！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The process will probably take several days. Until it is finished, please stay in my room; I will seal it against vampires, which should suppress Roa for a week or two.”
“—Your room—you mean I’m staying there!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… And, that may take a number of days, so please wait in my room until then.
I will place a blockade against vampires in my room, so you should be able to last against Roa for a week or two there."
"…… Your room---you mean, I'm staying in your room!?"

entries.japanese:
「……あのですね。
遠野くんの命がかかっているんですから、それぐらい我慢してください。
あ、妹さんに連絡を入れるぐらいはいいですけど、あんまり事情は説明しないでくださいね」
「……いや、こんな事情は頼まれたって説明はできないけど―――」
「それじゃ行きましょうか。
とりあえず遠野くんに溶け込んでるロアの意識を乖離させないといけません」
　ぐい、と強引にこっちの腕を掴んで先輩は歩き始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, your life is at stake. You’ll simply have to endure it. You may call your sister, of course, but please don’t tell her too much.”
“Even if you begged me, I couldn’t explain something like this…”
“Then let’s go. First we need to separate Roa’s consciousness from yours, now that it has blended into you.”
She seizes my arm and strides off, practically dragging me with her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, Tohno-kun.
Your life is in danger, so please put up with it.
Oh, you can at least let your sister know, but please don't tell her the details."
"…… Well, it's not like I can tell her in the first place---"
"Then shall we go?
We have to separate the Roa inside of you to start off."
She grabs my arm and starts to walk.

entries.japanese:
……なんていうか、そこにさっきまでの弱々しさは微塵もない。
　けどそれは無理やりな明るさだ。
　先輩は、俺を不安にさせまいと無理をしている。
「……ありがと、先輩」
　聞こえないように、小さく、そんな言葉を呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
There isn’t a trace of her earlier frailty left.
Yet the brightness is forced.
She is pushing herself so I won’t be afraid.
“Thank you, Ciel.”
I whisper it too softly for her to hear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There really is no trace of her weakness before.
But, it is a forced cheerfulness.
Senpai really doesn't want me to be worried, so she's forcing herself.
"…… Thanks, Senpai."
I speak in a low voice so she won't hear me.

entries.japanese:
「どうぞ、狭苦しいところですけど楽にしてください」
「あ……うん。
えっと、おじゃまします」
　
　こんな夜更けに女の子の部屋にあがる、なんてコトを妙に意識しながら部屋に入った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s cramped in here, but please make yourself comfortable.”
“Ah—right. Excuse me.”
Acutely conscious that I am entering a girl’s room in the dead of night, I step inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here we are.
It is a small place, but please make yourself at home."
"Ah…… yeah.
Um, sorry for intruding."
Being quite aware that I'm entering a girl's room this late at night, I walk in.

entries.japanese:
シエル先輩の部屋は、あの時となんら変わってはいない。
「それで、先輩。
俺はこれからどうすればいいのかな」
「えっとですね、まず遠野くんの中のロアを一時的に沈静化させます。
　……といっても、わたしの部屋そのものが簡易的な聖域になっていまから、ロアの意識だけならここに篭っているだけで侵食速度をかなり遅めることになります」
「―――へえ。
それじゃこの部屋にいるだけでとりあえずは安全っていうことなのか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel’s room hasn’t changed at all since the last time I was here.
“Ciel. What do I do now?”
“First, we’ll temporarily quiet Roa inside you.
That said, when it comes to Roa’s consciousness alone, my room is already a makeshift sanctuary. Simply staying shut in here will greatly slow the rate at which it encroaches on your mind.”
“Huh. So for the moment, I’m safe just by being here?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ciel-senpai's room hasn't changed a bit.
"Senpai, so, what do I do now?"
"Well, first we will temporarily silence the Roa inside of you, Tohno-kun.
…… Well, I say that, but my place itself is holy ground, so the advancement of Roa's consciousness will be greatly slowed just by staying here."
"---Oh?
Then I'm safe as long as I stay here?"

entries.japanese:
「はい、ロアの意識が遠野くんの意識に侵食するのを阻むだけなら、この部屋にいてくれるだけで十分なんですけど、その……」
「ん……？」
　シエル先輩は頬を赤らめて、なにか言いにくそうにごにょごにょと呟いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, just staying here would be enough to keep Roa’s consciousness from eating into yours, but—”
“Hm—?”
Ciel’s cheeks redden as she mumbles something under her breath, plainly unable to bring herself to say it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, if we were to just stop Roa's mind from invading yours, this room should be enough, but……"
"Hm……?"
Her cheeks flushing red, Ciel-senpai hesitates as if she wants to say something more.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩？
　どうしたの、他になにか問題でもあるのか？」
「いえ、問題というほどのコトじゃないんですけど、それなりに命にかかわる問題なんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel—what is it? Is there another problem?”
“Not exactly, though it could still threaten your life.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai?
What's wrong, is there another problem?"
"No, it's not what I would call a problem, but it can be dangerous to your life."

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
命にかかわる事なら、それって重大な事じゃないの？」
「ええまあ、そうなんですけど、その……単刀直入に言うとですね。
遠野くん、さっきから体のどこかがおかしいんじゃないですか？」
「体がおかしいって、そりゃあ人間離れした頑丈さにはなってるみたいだけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel. If it could kill me, isn’t that serious?”
“Well, yes, but—to put it plainly. Has any part of your body felt strange for the last little while?”
“You mean besides being inhumanly tough?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
If it's dangerous to my life, wouldn't that be very, very important?"
"Well you're right, but um…… If I say directly, Tohno-kun, is there any part of your body that feels strange?"
"Feels strange?
Well, I do have inhuman strength right now."

entries.japanese:
「……そうゆうコトじゃなくてですね、こう熱いー！
　とか、あばれたーい！
　とか、きません？」
「えっ―――そ、それは、その―――」
　……そういった破壊衝動は、たしかについさっきまで自分の中で渦巻いていた感情だ。
　現に俺は、琥珀さんを相手に酷い事をしてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, not that; I mean urges like ‘I’m burning up!’ or ‘I want to go wild!’ Haven’t you felt anything like that?”
“Wh—th-that’s—”
Those destructive impulses had indeed been churning inside me until only moments ago.
I had actually done something terrible to Kohaku because of them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's not what I mean, but don't you feel like, 'this is really hot!', or like, 'I need to let it out!' or something like that?"
"Eh---th, that is---"
…… Well, that urge to destroy was certainly in me until recently.
And I did that horrible thing to Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、大丈夫だよ。
この部屋に入ってから俺以外のヤツの声も聞こえない。
先輩の言うとおり、ここにいればロアのヤツも大人しくしてくれてるみたいだ」
「ですから、それは精神面の問題であってですね、身体面の問題じゃないじゃないですか」
「―――？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I’m fine. Since I entered this room, I haven’t heard anyone’s voice but my own. Just as you said, Roa seems to behave himself in here.”
“That is a mental symptom, not a physical one, Tohno.”
“What?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, I'm fine.
Since I entered this room, I haven't heard that guy's voice once.
Just like you said, it looks like he'll calm down if I'm in here."
"But that is the mental side of your problem, not your body."
"---?"

entries.japanese:
シエル先輩はまたも言いにくそうにごにょごにょと呟いている。
　……わけがわからない。
　とりあえず床に腰を下ろして体を休める。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once again, Ciel mutters awkwardly under her breath.
I have no idea what she means.
For now, I sit on the floor and let my body rest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ciel-senpai still hesitates like she has to say something rather difficult.
…… I have no clue.
I sit down on the floor to rest for now.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、先輩も立ってないで座ったら？
　あんなコトの後なんだから疲れてるだろ」
「…………………」
　シエル先輩は答えず、なにやら真剣に考え込んでいる。
　と。
「遠野くん、シャワーを浴びてください」
「――――はい？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You should sit down too. You must be tired after everything that happened.”
“…”
Ciel does not answer, lost in serious thought.
Then.
“Tohno, please take a shower.”
“I’m sorry?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, you don't need to stand, sit down.
You must be tired after all that."
"…………………"
Without answering me, she looks deep in thought.
And then.
"Tohno-kun, please take a shower."
"----Huh?"

entries.japanese:
「だって、いま言ったじゃないですか。
たしかにあんなコトがあったんですから、体を洗って落ち着かないとヘンですよ」
「いや―――でも」
「デモもパンもないでしょ。

“A question, boy?”
“Hey, that’s cheating! Nrvnqsr’s sticking his face in even here just to steal the spotlight!”
“Fool. Ciel has gone to the curry shop. Therefore I am standing in.”
“Oh, really? Then let’s hear you offer one useful hint.”
“In any quarrel, both sides are punished. Do not take life needlessly.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Young one, do you have a question?"
"Hey, that's dirty.
You're trying to stand out by coming out here too, Nrvnqsr."
"Don't be ridiculous.
Ciel-kun went to the curry shop.
I am the substitute."
"Alright.
Then give us a hint."
"Fighting punishes both parties.
Do not kill needlessly."

entries.japanese:
「なっとくいかなーい。
シエルと戦う気がなくっても、無条件でメガネ外しちゃった志貴だっているはずにゃ。
　それはどうだっていうのよう」
「盗むな、犯すな、欺くな。
不心得者は心当たりがあろう。
ならば早々にこの日の朝に時間旅行にでかけるがいい。
　ふん。
そう言えば姫君にも心当たりがあるのではないかね？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m not convinced! There must be some Shikis who took off their glasses automatically even though they had no intention of fighting Ciel.
What about them, meow?”
“Do not steal, violate, or deceive. The guilty know what they have done. Let them make haste and travel back to the morning of this day.
Hmph. Come to think of it, does that not strike close to home for you as well, Princess?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm not convinced.
Even if you don't want to fight Ciel, there's some people who unconditionally took off their glasses.
What is up with that?"
"Thou shalt not steal, rape, or deceive others.
It might sound familiar for some of you.
If so, then go on a journey through time to this morning.
Yes.
Come to think of it, the princess might have an idea of that, no?"

entries.japanese:
「にゃ、にゃにが？
　わたし難しいコトわからなーい」
「……まあ、人の事など瑣末だがね。
　では私はここで、君たちの結末を見てみるとしよう―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“M-Meow what? I don’t understand complicated things.”
“Well, the affairs of others are trivial.
I shall remain here and observe how you meet your end—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nya, w-what?
I don't understand what you're talking about."
"…… Well, what happens to others is just a trivial matter for me.
Then, I shall watch how the end plays out for all of you from here-----"

entries.japanese:
朝になって、ようやく、鍵が締められた。
　はあ、はあ、はあ
　ケモノの息遣いめいた呼吸音が部屋に充満している。
　頭がいたい。
　メガネをどこかで落としてしまったらしい。
　部屋中に『線』が視えて、吐き気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only when morning comes do I finally manage to lock the door.
Hah, hah, hah
The room is filled with breathing like an animal’s.
My head hurts.
I must have lost my glasses somewhere.
‘Lines’ cover everything in the room, making me sick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It becomes morning and I finally manage to lock the door.
*pant* *pant* *pant*
My beast-like panting fills the room.
My head hurts.
It seems I dropped my glasses somewhere.
Seeing the "lines" all over my room, I feel nauseous.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
　あんまりにも吐き気がするから、片っ端から切りつけた。
　気持ちが、少しだけ楽になる。
　モノを切断する瞬間だけ、心が穏やかになってくれた。
反面、モノを切れば切るほど、その後にまっているのは倍化する渇きだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
The nausea becomes so unbearable that I slash everything within reach.
It eases me a little.
My mind is calm only at the instant something comes apart. Yet the more I cut, the greater the thirst waiting afterward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I feel so sick, I cut all of them I see.
I feel just a little better.
Only during the instant I cut things apart does my heart feel at ease.
But the more I cut, the thirstier I get.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
　何に渇いているのか、もう分かりきっている。
　俺はとにかく、あらゆる物に渇いていた。
　目に映る全てのものが腹だたしい。
　はあ、はあ、はあ
　全て壊したくて、
　全て殺したい。
　それが禁じられている事だとわかっているのに、我慢できそうにない。
　体中が興奮していて、どうにかしそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
I already know what I’m thirsty for.
For anything. Everything.
Everything I see enrages me.
Hah, hah, hah
Wanting to break everything,
I want to kill everything.
I know it is forbidden, but I cannot endure much longer.
My entire body is feverishly aroused, and I am going to lose myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I know what I'm thirsty for.
I'm thirsty for everything.
Everything I see is pissing me off.

*pant* *pant* *pant*
I want to destroy everything,
kill everything.
I know that's wrong, but I don't think I can hold it in.
My body is filled with excitement; I'm about to go insane.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、起きてらっしゃるんですか？」
「――――っ！」
　扉の向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえてきた。
「志貴さま、鍵をかけられては困ります。
起きていらっしゃるのでしたらお開けてください」
「…………け……る……？」
　ドアを、開ける？
　扉を開けて、翡翠を中に入れる？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
“—!”
Hisui’s voice comes through the door.
“Master Shiki, you must not keep the door locked. If you are awake, please open it.”
“…Open… it?”
Open the door?
Let Hisui into the room?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you awake?"
"----!"
I can hear Hisui's voice from the other side of the door.

"Shiki-sama, it is not good if you keep the door locked.
If you are awake, please open the door."
"………… Op…… en…………?"
Open the door?
Open the door and let Hisui inside?

entries.japanese:
―――冗談じゃない。
　そんなコトになったら、俺は何をするかわからない。
　こうして―――こうして一人きりになって、カーテンを閉めきってベッドにうずくまって、かろうじて理性が欲情を押しとどめてくれているのに。
　だっていうのに、翡翠になんか入ってこられたら、それこそ俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――No. God, no.
If I did that, there’s no telling what I might do.
Alone like this, curtains drawn, curled up on the bed, I can barely keep reason on top of lust as it is.
If Hisui came in here, I would—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---You must be kidding me.
If that happened, I don't know what I would do.
Like this---if I stay alone like this, lying in bed with the curtains shut, I can stave off the desires that threaten to overtake my mind.
That's why, if Hisui comes in here, I'll---

entries.japanese:
「―――うるさい！
　俺にかまうな！」
　ドアに向かって、大声で叫んだ。
「……志貴さま？
　体調が優れないのですか？」
「かまうなって言ってるだろ……！
　いいから、大丈夫だから俺にかまわないでくれ……！」
　部屋に―――中に入ってきたら、きっと取り返しのつかない事をしてしまう。
「……………」
　沈黙のあと、翡翠の足音が聞こえた。
　静かに、俺の部屋の前から遠ざかっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Shut up! Leave me alone!”
I shout at the door.
“Master Shiki? Are you unwell?”
“I said leave me alone…! I’m fine, so just stay away from me…!”
If she comes into the room, I will surely do something beyond repair.
“…”
After a silence, I hear Hisui’s footsteps.
They quietly recede from my door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shut up!
Leave me alone!"
I scream at the door.
"…… Shiki-sama?
Are you not feeling well?"
"I said leave me alone……!
I'm fine, so just leave me alone……!"
If she---came in this room, something I couldn't take back would happen.
"…………"
After a deep silence, I hear her footsteps.
Quietly, she walks away from the door.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ
―――これで、安全だ。
　そう思ったら少し落ちついた。
　気晴らし―――気晴らしに、本でも読もうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah
―――Now it is safe.
The thought calms me a little.
A distraction―――maybe I should read.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
---Now it's safe.
Thinking that, I calm down just a little.
I should---I should just read a book to unwind.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――れ」
　いつも枕元にあった本がない。
　英文で書かれた本。
……そりゃあ俺に読めるはずがないんだけど、それでも気晴らしにはなるはずなのに。
　探しても見付からない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What―――?”
The book that was always beside my pillow is gone.
The one written in English. Of course I could never read it, but it should still have served as a distraction.
I search and cannot find it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H---uh?"
The book that was always beside my pillow isn't there.
The book written in English…… I definitely can't read it, but it was a way to kill time.
I search but I can't find it.

entries.japanese:
見つからない。
　必死にどんな装丁だったかを思い出す。
　どうしても、思い出せない。
　はあ、はあ、はあ
「本―――本」
　考えてみれば。
　あんな本を、俺はどうして枕元になんか置いておいたんだろう。
　知らない。
あんな本を持ってきた記憶がない。
　あんな本がどこにあったのかも知らない。
　そもそも―――そんなもの、本当にあったんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is nowhere.
I desperately try to remember what the binding looked like.
I cannot.
Hah, hah, hah
“The book…
the book.”
Come to think of it, why did I keep a book like that beside my pillow?
I don’t know. I don’t remember bringing it here.
I don’t even know where it came from.
Was there ever really such a book at all?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't find it.
I frantically try to remember what the cover looked like.
But I can't.
*pant* *pant* *pant*
"The book---the book."
Come to think of it,
Why did I even put that book by my pillow?

I don't know.
I don't even remember bringing it here.
I don't know where I brought it from.
In the first place---did that book even exist?

entries.japanese: ……本当は、オマエ本人が気づいていないだけで
entries.maoEnglish: …The truth is, you’re the only one who hasn’t noticed
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Really, you may have not realized it.

entries.japanese:
……耳障りなロアの声を思い出す。
　あの本―――その内容。
　いつも眠れなくて読んでいた本。
　でもそれは、眠っている時に、眠れないという夢を、見ていただけじゃ、なかったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember Roa’s grating voice.
That book―――its contents.
The book I always read when I could not sleep.
But perhaps, while asleep, I was merely dreaming that I lay awake reading.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I remember Roa's irksome voice.
That book---those contents.
The book I read when I couldn't sleep.
Was it maybe just a dream of mine dreaming that I was awake and couldn't sleep?

entries.japanese: とっくの昔に、遠野志貴は狂ってるのさ……！
entries.maoEnglish: Shiki Tohno lost his mind a long, long time ago…!
entries.mirrorMoon: "…… But you were already insane a long, long time ago……!"

entries.japanese:
ロアは、そんな言葉を言っていた。
　ユメ―――ゆめ。
　でも、俺はあんな夢なんかみない。
　そもそも、遠野志貴の中にあんなワケのわからない知識はない。
　あんな夢を見る材料がない。
　アレは、俺の夢なんかじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Those were Roa’s words.
A dream—a dream.
But I do not dream things like that.
Shiki Tohno does not possess that incomprehensible knowledge.
There is nothing in me from which such dreams could be made.
That was not my dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa said such words.
DREAM---dream.
But, I don't see those kinds of dreams.
In the first place, I don't have that strange knowledge inside of me.
There's no reason for me to have that dream.
That, isn't my dream.

entries.japanese: おまえ本人が、気がついていないだけで
entries.maoEnglish: You’re the only one who hasn’t noticed
entries.mirrorMoon: You may have not realized it.

entries.japanese:
「――――うる、さい」
　はあ、はあ、はあ
　それじゃあアレはなんだ。
　俺はいったいいつから、自分でないヤツの夢なんてものを見始めていたっていうんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Shut up.”
Hah, hah, hah
Then what was it?
When did I begin dreaming the dreams of someone who was not me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shut, up."
*pant* *pant* *pant*
Then what is that?
Since when the hell did I start having dreams that belonged to another person?

entries.japanese: ……オレとオマエは繋がっているんだ志貴
entries.maoEnglish: …You and I are connected, Shiki.
entries.mirrorMoon: You and I are connected, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
「――――だまれよ、死人」
　とっくにくたばった貴様が、何度も何度も耳障りな声をあげるんじゃない。
　俺は―――貴様とは違う。
　俺は殺人鬼なんかじゃない。
　今はただ、後遺症で戸惑っているだけだ。
　せっかくシエル先輩が帰ってきてくれたのに、こんなコトで、イカレてなんかやるものか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Shut up, dead man.”
You died long ago, so stop raising that loathsome voice again and again.
I am―――not like you.
I am no murderer.
I am only confused by the aftereffects.
Ciel has finally come back to me; I will not let this drive me insane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shut up, you're dead."
You're already dead, you bastard, so stop your incessant calling out.
I'm---different from you.
I'm not a killer.
I'm just confused by all the after-effects.
Since Ciel-senpai came back, I won't allow myself to go mad over something like this.

entries.japanese:
―――ああ、オレも初めはそう思ってた。
　　　　ロアなんてヤツが入っていても―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Oh, I thought the same at first.
Even with a man called Roa inside me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Yeah, I also thought so at first.
Even if this Roa came in---

entries.japanese:
「―――黙れって言ってるだろう……！」
　はあ、はあ、はあ―――――
　……呼吸が荒い。
　太陽の光が癇に障る。
　喉が。
喉が渇いて、どうかしそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I told you to shut up…!”
Hah, hah, hah―――――
My breathing is ragged.
The sunlight enrages me.
My throat. My throat is so dry I am losing my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I told you to shut up……!"
*pant* *pant* *pant*-----
…… I breathe heavily.
The sunlight pisses me off.
My throat.
My throat is so dry, I'm about to go insane.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……！
　なにをしていらっしゃるんですか、志貴さま！？」
　ドアの向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえる。
　……答える余裕がない。
　コトバ。
自分のコトバを、思い出せない。
「志貴さま、開けてください、志貴さま！」
　ドンドン、と扉の向こうから翡翠の声が聞こえる。
　……翡翠の声は、どこか知らない異国のコトバのように聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…! What are you doing in there? Master Shiki!?”
Hisui calls through the door.
I cannot spare the strength to answer.
Words. I cannot remember my own words.
“Master Shiki, please open the door! Master Shiki!”
Bang, bang. Hisui's voice comes from the other side of the door.
…Hisui’s voice sounds like words from some foreign country I have never known.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……!
What are you doing, Shiki-sama!?"
I hear Hisui's voice across the door.
…… I can't even answer.
Words.
I can't even remember, my words.
"Shiki-sama, please open up, Shiki-sama!"
I hear her voice across the door.
…… Her voice almost sounds like it was in another language.

entries.japanese:
遠すぎる。
「あ―――――ぐ」
　……ダメだ。
　オレは、もう、今まで通りに翡翠に会う自信がない。
「志貴さま、どうかなされたのですか、志貴さま…………！」
　どんどん、とドアを叩く音。
「……うる……さい……」
　両耳を押さえて、それを必死に遮る。
「　　　　　　　　　　」
　……翡翠の声は聞こえない。
　オレは、このまま。
　翡翠にも秋葉にも琥珀さんにも会わないまま、この部屋に閉じこもっていないといけない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Too far away.
“Ah―――――gh.”
It’s no use.
I no longer trust myself to face Hisui as I always have.
“Master Shiki, what has happened, Master Shiki…!”
The pounding on the door continues.
“Shut—up.”
I clamp both hands over my ears, desperate to block it out.
“                    ”
Hisui’s voice is gone.
I have to remain here.
Shut inside this room, never seeing Hisui, Akiha, or Kohaku again――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
So far away.
"Ah-----gh."
…… This isn't good.
I, don't have the confidence to face Hisui like usual.
"Shiki-sama, did something happen, Shiki-sama…………!"
She knocks on the door.
"…… Shut…… up……"
I desperately place my hands over my ears…
"        "
…… I can't hear Hisui's voice anymore.
Just like this,
I have to lock myself up in my room so I can't see Hisui, Akiha, or Kohaku-san----

entries.japanese:
午前十時になった。
　翡翠は諦めて引き下がった。
　かわるがわる、秋葉や琥珀さんがやってきて扉をノックしたが、すべて無視した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ten in the morning.
Hisui finally gives up and withdraws.
Akiha and Kohaku come in turns to knock on my door, but I ignore them both.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's now ten in the morning.
Hisui gave up and went back.
Akiha and Kohaku-san came and took turns knocking but I ignored them.

entries.japanese:
十二時。
　……腹がへった。
　けど、まだ大丈夫だ。
　シーツをかぶって、ガタガタと震える体を抱きしめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Noon.
…I’m hungry.
But I can still bear it.
Beneath the sheet, I hug my violently trembling body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Twelve o'clock.
…… I'm hungry.
But, I'm still fine.
I pull the sheets over me and hug my shaking body.

entries.japanese:
二時。
　……喉がかわいて、死にそうだ。
　時間の感覚が、少しおかしい。
　とてもゆったりと感じられる。
　興奮剤をうたれ続けているみたいに、体中が動き回りたくて暴れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Two o’clock.
…The thirst is killing me.
My sense of time has gone strange.
Everything feels terribly slow.
My whole body is rioting for movement, as though someone keeps pumping me full of stimulants.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Two o'clock.
…… I'm dying of thirst.
I've lost all sense of time.
It feels very calm.
But as if I was taking stimulants, my body wants to rage around.

entries.japanese:
四時。
　……またドアがノックされた。
　名前を呼ばれる。
　それが誰の声だったか、誰の名前を口にしているのか、どうしても判別できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Four o’clock.
…Another knock.
Someone calls a name.
I can’t tell whose voice it is, or even whose name they’re saying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Four o'clock.
…… More knocking.
A name being called out.
Whose voice is that?
Whose name are they calling?
I can't tell.

entries.japanese:
五時。
　段々と暗くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Five o’clock.
The room slowly darkens.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Five o'clock.
It slowly starts to get dark.

entries.japanese: 六時。
entries.maoEnglish: Six o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Six o'clock.

entries.japanese: 七時。
entries.maoEnglish: Seven o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Seven o'clock.

entries.japanese: 八時。
entries.maoEnglish: Eight o’clock.
entries.mirrorMoon: Eight o'clock.

entries.japanese: ―――誰か、きた。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Someone’s here.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Someone, comes by.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、夕ごはんをもってきました。
朝から何も食べていないんじゃまいってしまいますよ」
　琥珀の声だ。
　どんどん、と扉をノックしている。
「もう、こうなったらお食事だけでも食べてもらいますからね」
　ガチャガチャ、という音。
　ドアをノックする音ではなく、鍵を開けているような、そんな音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I brought your dinner. You haven’t eaten since morning—you’ll make yourself ill.”
Kohaku.
She pounds on the door.
“All right, that does it. I’m going to make sure you eat something, at least.”
A metallic rattle follows.
It isn’t another knock. It sounds like someone working the lock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I've brought you dinner.
You haven't had anything since this morning, so you'll collapse you know."
Kohaku's voice.
She knocks on the door.
"Geez, if that's how it is, I'll get you to at least eat."
A rattling sound.
Not knocking, but the sound of a lock opening.

entries.japanese:
「ふふふ、最後の切り札マスターキーの出番ですよー」
「――――あ」
　カギが、開く。
　……扉が開く。
　もう遅い。
いまから彼女を追い返しても、部屋の中に入られる事は変わらない。
――――それでも。
　食事を食べる、という行為は、できない。
　それはひどく牡的な喚起をさせて、かろうじて残っている『遠野志貴』という自分を、粉々に砕いてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Heh heh heh. Time for my last and greatest weapon—the master key!”
“—Ah.”
The lock opens.
…The door swings inward.
Too late. Even if I order her away now, she’ll already have entered the room.
――――Even so, I cannot eat.
The very act would awaken something brutally male inside me and
shatter what little remains of the person called Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huhuhu, time to use my secret weapon, the master key!"
"----Ah."
The lock unlocks.
…… The door opens.
It's too late.
Even if I send her away, she's already come inside.
----But still.
I can't even do the action called "eating food".
It will get me too excited, and it will smash the remaining "Tohno Shiki" within me to pieces.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ……はあ……はあ……」
　息があがっている。
　なんとか。

As if under a spell, I continue walking.

entries.mirrorMoon:

"------"
For some reason, it seems like the other "me" wanted this.

Under the light as bright as the sun.

Didn't you go back?"

「ぁ――――――」
　息ができない。
　喉が動かない。
　そんな余分な真似をすれば―――次の瞬間、この首が千切られてしまうだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……Well. You haven’t run. Does that mean you’re prepared?”
Her red eyes stared at me as though I were an enemy she despised.
“Ah…”
I couldn’t breathe.
My throat refused to move.
If I attempted anything so unnecessary, my head would be torn from my neck in the next instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm.
You're not running away, so you're prepared?"
Her red eyes stare at me, as if she is looking at a hated enemy.
"A------"
I can't breathe.
My throat doesn't move.
If I do such extraneous movement---she would tear it out at that moment.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ殺すけど、最期に言っておく事はある？」
「―――――――――」
　恐ろしくて声さえ出せない。
　ただ、もし満足に喋れるのなら―――どうして俺をそんなに本気になって殺そうとしているかって、聞きたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m going to kill you now. Any last words?”
“……”
Terror had taken even my voice.
If I could have spoken, I would only have asked why she was trying so earnestly to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then I'll kill you, but do you have any last words?"
"---------"
I'm so scared I can't even speak.
But, if I could speak---I want to ask her why she wants to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「え―――？
　うそ、信じられない。
志貴ったらまだ気がついてないのね」
　クスリと微笑って、アルクェイドは一歩こちらに近づいた。
　かつん、という乾いた足音が公園に響き渡る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? No—I don’t believe it. Shiki, you still haven’t realized?”
Arcueid gave a soft, amused smile and stepped closer.
The dry click of her heel rang across the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---?
No way, I can't believe it.
You haven't realized it yet?"
With a giggle, Arcueid takes a step closer.
The dry sound of her footsteps echoes through the park.

entries.japanese:
「わたしも騙されたわ。
まさか、貴方がロアだったなんて、ね」
entries.maoEnglish: “You fooled me too. I never imagined that you were Roa.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I was also deceived.
I didn't think you were Roa."

entries.japanese:
言って。
　アルクェイドはほんのわずかな憐憫と、この上ない娯楽を見つけた子供のように、嬉しげに目を細めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
With the faintest trace of pity, Arcueid narrowed her eyes in delight,
like a child discovering the finest game in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that,
she shows just a brief moment of pity.
Then, her eyes light up with pure delight like a happy child.

entries.japanese:
パキン、と。
　頭の中で、何かが弾けた。
　それは決定的に、およそ壊滅的なまでの、すでに不能ですらある、絶望的な亀裂だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crack.
Something split inside my head.
It was a final fracture—catastrophic, hopeless, breaking something already beyond repair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Snap.
Something cracks in my head.
It was a definite, most terrible, already nonfunctional, desperate crack.

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　声が漏れる。
　何を。
　何を言っているんだろう、こいつは。
「それで、どうなの志貴？
　自分の中にロアがいるっていう感想は？」
　ゾッとするぐらい親しげな声で、形容しがたいほどの殺気をこめて、白い吸血姫はそう言った。
「俺――――俺、は」
　ロアなんていうヤツは知らない。
　俺の中にあるのは、自分でもワケが解らない破壊衝動だけだ。
　何の意味もなく琥珀さんを殺そうとして、それに快楽を見出している衝動だ、け――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh—” A sound escaped me.
What?
What was she
talking about?
“So, Shiki? How does it feel to have Roa inside you?”
The white vampire princess spoke with a friendliness that chilled the blood, her voice laden with indescribable bloodlust.
“I—I…”
I knew no one called Roa.
Inside me was only a destructive impulse I couldn’t understand—the urge that had tried to kill Kohaku for no reason and found pleasure in the thought.
Only that—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
My voice leaks out.
What.
What is she saying?
"So how is it, Shiki?
How does it feel to have Roa inside you?"
The white vampire princess speaks with a kind voice as she stares with hostility.
"I-----I."
I don't know about this Roa guy.
What's inside me is only this inexplicable urge to destroy things.
Like trying to kill Kohaku-san without any reason, and getting pleasure out of seeing it.
That's, all-----

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　つまり、それが。
　あの黒い、突発的な衝動が。
　ロアと、呼ばれるものなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Then that was it.
That sudden, black impulse.
Was that what they called Roa?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh----"
In other words.
That black, sudden impulse.
That's Roa?

entries.japanese:
「―――ちが、う。
そんなハズは、ない」
「とぼけても無駄よ。
もともとロアはわたしが死徒にしてしまったヤツだもの。
　奪われた自分の力がどこで脈づいているかは簡単に感じ取れるわ」
「―――そんなのは、うそ、だ」
　言って、絶望した。
　そんな言葉―――自分さえ、騙せていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
