“N-no. That can’t be true.”
“There’s no use pretending. Roa was originally a man I turned into a Dead Apostle.
I can easily feel where the power stolen from me is still beating.”
“That’s… a lie.”
The words plunged me into despair as soon as I spoke them.
They could not deceive even me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
That, can't be true."
"You can't play dumb.
In the first place, Roa was made into a Dead Apostle by me.
It's very easy for me to tell where the person who stole my power is."
"----That's, a lie."
Saying that, I fall into despair.
With those words---I can't even deceive myself.

entries.japanese:
「どういう理由かは知らない。
今まで十七回も繰り返してきたけど、こんな事は初めてよ」
　アルクェイドはこれ以上、一歩だって近づいてこようとしない。
　……いや、近づこうとする必要なんてないのか。
　俺とアルクェイドの距離は七メートル程度。
アルクェイドならたとえこの十倍の距離があったって、すぐさま俺の首を掻っ切れる。
　ここはもう、あいつの間合いの中だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know why it happened. I’ve gone through this seventeen times, but this is the first time I’ve ever seen anything like it.”
Arcueid made no attempt to come closer.
…No, she had no need to.
Barely seven meters separated us. Even at ten times that distance, she could cut my throat before I moved.
I was already inside her reach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't know why.
There have been seventeen reincarnations before this, but this is the first time this has happened."
She doesn't look like she intends to take another step forward.
…… No, there's no need.
The distance between me and Arcueid is about seven meters.
But even if it was ten times that, Arcueid could chop off my neck instantly.
This is well within her range.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん、と鳴動する。
　それは生命の危機を感じている俺自身の本能か。
　それとも―――この脳髄の中に在る、ロアという衝動の猛りなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
Was that my own instinct, sounding the alarm at mortal danger?
Or was it the impulse called Roa, raging inside my brain?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
A rumbling starts.
Is that my instinctual reaction to life-threatening danger?
Or---is that the ferocity of Roa residing in my brain?

entries.japanese:
「……アル……クェイド」
　ポケットの中に手を忍ばせる。
　ナイフの硬い手触りが、バラバラになりそうな俺の意識を押し留めてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Ar… cueid.”
I slipped a hand into my pocket.
The knife’s hard surface held together a mind on the verge of shattering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ar…… cueid."
I put my hand in my pocket.
The hard sensation of my knife gathers up my splintering consciousness.

entries.japanese:
「ようやく認めてくれたみたいね、志貴。
　貴方も自分の中にいるロアの気配を感じているんでしょう？
　
　あの時、ロアの転生体を殺した瞬間、ロアは貴方の中に転移したのね。
どうしてそんな事になったのかわたしにはわからないけど」
　
　……紅い、瞳。
　それに見つめられていると、ずきりと、頭痛が戻ってくる。
　ずきり、ずきり。
　頭の中で。
　ロアという吸血鬼が、活性化したがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve finally admitted it, Shiki.
You can feel Roa inside you too, can’t you?
When you killed his reincarnation vessel, Roa must have transferred himself into you. I have no idea how that was possible.”
…Those crimson eyes.
Under their gaze, the headache returned.
Throb.
Throb.
Inside my skull, the vampire called Roa was struggling to awaken.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It seems you finally admit it, Shiki.
You feel the Roa inside you too, right?
Back then, the instant Roa's reincarnated body was killed, he transmitted himself into you.
I don't understand how it happened."
…… Crimson, eyes.
Being stared at by them, my headache returns again.
Thump, Thump.
Inside my head.
The vampire called Roa, is wanting to emerge.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……痛む。
　アルクェイドがヤツの名前を口にするたびに、脳髄の中でヤツの記憶が暴れまわる。
　ずきり。
　ずきり。
　ずき――――――り
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
…It hurt.
Every time Arcueid spoke his name, his memories thrashed inside my brain.
Throb.
Throb.
Thro-o-ob.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
…… It hurts.
Just having Arcueid say his name enrages the memories of this guy in my brain.
Throb.
Throb.
Thro------b

entries.japanese:
「余裕ね。
わたしが目の前にいるっていうのに逃げもしないなんて。
てっきりわたしの顔を見た瞬間、すぐに逃げ出すだろうなって思ってたけど」
「……そんなわけ、ないだろ。
なんで俺が、逃げ出さなくちゃいけない、んだ」
　ずきり、と痛む頭を抱えて、なんとかアルクェイドに返答する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re remarkably calm. I expected you to run the moment you saw my face, but here you are, standing right in front of me.”
“…Why would I run? I’ve got no reason to… run from you.”
Clutching my throbbing head, I somehow managed to answer her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're pretty composed.
You're in front of me and not even running away.
I thought you would run away the instant you saw me."
"…… I… won't do, that.
Why, would I have, to run away?"
Resisting the pain in my head, I reply.

entries.japanese:
「―――ふうん。
まだ強がりを言えるなんて意外。
　てっきり半分以上ロアに呑まれてると思ったんだけど―――そっか、そういうコトなんだ」
　アルクェイドの声は弾んでいる。
　……何が楽しいのか知らないけど、あいつにはまだ人間味というものが残っている。
「気が変わったわ。
志貴がわたしの言う事を聞いてくれるなら、貴方の事を殺すのは止めてあげてもいいんだけど、どう？」
　どこか嬉しげな口ぶりで、アルクェイドは俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, well. I’m surprised you can still bluff. I thought Roa had swallowed more than half of you by now—but I see. So that’s how it is.”
Arcueid’s voice was almost buoyant.
…I had no idea what delighted her, but some trace of humanity remained in her.
“I’ve changed my mind. If you’ll do as I say, Shiki, I may decide not to kill you. What do you think?”
Arcueid watched me with a curious note of happiness in her voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hm?
I'm surprised you can still bluff.
I really thought over half of you was taken over by Roa already---I see, that's how it is."
Her voice sounds happy.
…… I don't know what's making her so happy, but it seems she still has some humanity left in her.
"I've changed my mind.
If you do as I say, I won't kill you.
How's that?"
Arcueid looks at me as she says this, happiness coloring her voice.

entries.japanese:
―――ずきん、という頭痛。
　頭の中で、ロアがその女を信用するなと、叫んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A spike of pain drove through my skull.
Inside it, Roa screamed that I must not trust her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Another headache.
Inside my head, Roa screams at me not to trust this woman.

entries.japanese:
「……どうって、なにが。
おまえはロアを殺したいんだろ。
なら……俺を見逃すなんて、するわけがないじゃないか」
「ええ、わたしは一度決めた事は絶対に完遂させるもの。
ロアは必ずわたしが制裁を加えるわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What am I supposed to think? You want Roa dead. There’s no way you’d let me go.”
“True. Once I decide upon something, I always carry it through. Roa will receive his punishment at my hands.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What do you mean?
Don't you want to kill Roa?
Then…… there's no way you'll let me go, right?"
"Yes, once I decide something, it will be done.
I will get at Roa for sure."

entries.japanese:
「でもね、志貴。
貴方の中にいるロアの波動は弱々しいの。
　きっとあいつは赤子から生まれなおさないと、その肉体の中でかつての意思を保てないのよ。
　なんとか貴方の中に転移したのはいいけど、それが限界。
　ただ新しい逃げ場に移っただけのロアは、貴方の中ではそう簡単に主導権を握ることができず、貴方の暗黒面として生き続けるしかできないでいる」
「………それは、」
　つまり。
ロアの意思っていうのは、もうほとんどないっていう事なんだろうか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“But the presence of Roa inside you is feeble, Shiki.
Unless he is reborn from infancy, he cannot preserve his former will within a new body.
He somehow managed to transfer himself into you, but that was the limit of what he could do.
He merely fled into another refuge. He cannot easily seize control of you and has no choice but to survive as your own dark side.”
“……Then…”
Did that mean Roa’s own will was almost entirely gone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But Shiki, the Roa inside you is very weak.
He probably can't take away a person's will unless he's born into their body.
He somehow managed to transmit himself to you, but that was all he could do.
The Roa who was just trying to escape couldn't establish control over you.
He is only able to live as your dark side."
"…… That,"
Does that mean Roa's will is almost nothing in me……?

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、それって―――」
「ええ。
それなら殺すまでもないわ。
わたしはロアに奪われた力が、わたしの下で動けばそれでいいんだから」
「――――？」
　殺すまでもない、と彼女は言う。
　ならどうして俺の前なんかにやってきたんだ。
　どうしてそんなに―――真剣な目で、俺を見ているんだ、コイツは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, are you saying—”
“Yes. If that is all he has become, there is no need to kill you. I only need the power Roa stole from me to serve beneath me once more.”
“……?”
No need to kill me, she said.
Then why had she come?
Why was she looking at me with such grave, unwavering eyes?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, that---"
"Yes.
There's no need for me to kill you if that's the case.
I'm fine just having the power Roa stole from me working under me."
"----?"
There's no need for me to be killed is what she's saying.
So why did she come to see me?
Why---does she look at me with those serious eyes?

entries.japanese:
「……わからないな。
何が言いたいんだ、アルクェイド」
「貴方に、わたしの下僕になれって言ってるのよ」
「――――――――え？」
　―――冗談では、なさそうだ。
　先輩とアルクェイドが睨み合っていた時、アルクェイド本人は質の悪い冗談だって言ってたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……I don’t understand. What are you trying to say, Arcueid?”
“I’m telling you to become my servant.”
“……What?”
―――She did not appear to be joking.
Yet when she and Ciel had faced each other, Arcueid herself had called the idea a tasteless joke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't understand.
What are you trying to say, Arcueid?"
"I am telling you to become my servant."
"--------Eh?"
---She doesn't seem like she's joking.
When Arcueid and Senpai were fighting, she said it was just a joke.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ。
あれ、冗談じゃ、なかったのか」
「ええ。
わたしは貴方が気に入っている。
なら、殺すよりは傍においておきたい思うのは当然でしょ？」
――――バキン。
　その一言で、今までとは比べ物にならない頭痛が走った。
　ロア。
俺の中のアイツが、アルクェイドの言葉を憎悪している。
　……それが歓喜からくる反転した衝動なのか、それとも遠野志貴という俺に対しての嫉妬なのかはどうにも。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……So that wasn’t a joke after all?”
“No. I like you. It’s only natural that I’d rather keep you beside me than kill you, isn’t it?”
――――Crack.
Her words brought a headache greater than all the others combined.
Roa. The thing inside me hated what Arcueid had said.
Whether it was joy inverted into hatred, or jealousy of me as Shiki Tohno, I couldn’t tell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
That wasn't a joke?"
"No.
I like you.
So isn't it natural for me to want you by my side rather than to kill you?"
----Snap.
With that line, my headache pounds more than it ever has before.
Roa.
The guy inside my head rages against her words.
…… I don't know if that comes from delight or from deep jealousy.

entries.japanese:
「わたしの下僕になるのなら、ロアの侵食は止めてあげるわ。
　そのままじゃ貴方はロアに乗っ取られるんだから、考えるまでもない事だと思うけど」
「……簡単に言ってくれるけどさ。
アルクェイド、おまえはどうやって俺の中のロアを止められるっていうんだ」
「あら、ロアを止められるのはきっと貴方だけよ、志貴。
　けどその方法では志貴自身も死んでしまう。
　わたしの方法は志貴自身を強くするだけ。
貴方がロアより強い心を持てば、ロアがどう暴れようと関係ないでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Become my servant and I’ll halt Roa’s encroachment.
As you are now, he’ll eventually take you over. There’s hardly anything to consider.”
“…Easy for you to say. How exactly do you plan to stop Roa inside me?” “Oh, I’m sure the only person who can stop Roa is you, Shiki.
But that method would kill you as well.
My method merely makes you stronger.
If your heart becomes stronger than Roa’s, it won’t matter how violently he struggles, will it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you are willing to become my servant, I will stop Roa from consuming you.
I don't think you even need to think about it, seeing how Roa will consume you like this."
"…… You say it so simply, but how do you intend to stop this Roa inside me?"
"Huh?
The only one who can stop Roa is you, Shiki.
But that method would mean your death.
My method is simply strengthening you.
As long as your will is stronger than Roa's, then it doesn't matter how much he rages in you, right?"

entries.japanese:
バキン、ともう一度頭痛が叩きつけられる。
　ロアが暴れている。
　騙されるな。
あの女は、おまえを人形にするつもりだ、と暴れている。
　……その衝動を鵜呑みする気はない。
　ないけど、ロアの意見には賛成だ。
　俺は、俺のままでいたいんだ。
　ロアから逃げるためにアルクェイドの下僕になるなんて本末転倒じゃないか。
　それに、第一。
　俺には、シエル先輩がいる。
　明日学校にいって、あの人に相談すればきっと解決策ぐらい見つけてくれる―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crack—the pain smashed into me again.
Roa was raging.
Don’t be fooled. That woman means to make you her puppet.
…I had no intention of swallowing his warning whole.
But I agreed with him.
I wanted to remain myself.
Becoming Arcueid’s servant to escape Roa would defeat the entire point.
Besides, I still had Ciel.
If I went to school tomorrow and asked her for help,
she would surely find some answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Something bursts in my head again.
Roa keeps raging.
Don't let her fool you, he rages.
This woman wants to make you her puppet.
…… I don't intend to give in to that impulse.
But, I agree with Roa.
I want to stay as myself.
To become Arcueid's servant to get away from Roa is getting my priorities wrong.
And, in the first place,
there is Ciel-senpai.
If I go to school tomorrow and talk to her about it, I bet she can come up with a solution to this---.

entries.japanese:
「…………っ」
　ぎり、と歯を食いしばって、頭痛を押さえつけた。
　メガネを外す。
　ナイフをポケットから出す。
　刃を出して、自分の目の高さにあげて、両手で構えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……!”
I clenched my teeth and forced the headache down.
I removed my glasses, drew the knife from my pocket,
snapped out the blade,
and raised it in both hands before my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Gritting my teeth, I resist the pounding in my head.
I take off my glasses,
and get my knife from my pocket.
I take the blade out and hold it at eye level.

entries.japanese:
「――――志貴」
「お断りだ。
悪いけど、俺はおまえの物になんかならない」
「そっか。
しかたないな、なら力ずくね」
　かつん、という硬い足音。
「貴方には一度殺されたこともあるし。
一度、お返しをしてあげなくっちゃって思ってたんだ」
　突風をともなって、白い影が迫ってくる。
――――瞬間。
　戦いは、始まっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…” “No.
Sorry, but I’m not going to belong to you.”
“I see. Then I suppose I’ll have to use force.”
Her heel struck the ground with a hard click.
“You did kill me once, after all. I’ve been meaning to return the favor.”
A white shape hurtled at me on a gale of displaced air.
――――In that instant,
the fight had already begun.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki."
"I refuse.
Sorry, but I won't be yours to possess."
"I see.
Then, I guess it'll just have to be by force."
A hard footstep cracks through the air.
"You killed me once, so I always thought I should pay you back."
Her white figure rushes forth with a gust of wind.
----In that instant,
the fight begins.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィン。
　アルクェイドの爪と、俺のナイフがぶつかり合う。
　金色の月の下、走りこんできたアルクェイドの姿は、敵だとしても美しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Arcueid’s claws collided with my knife.
Beneath the golden moon, even the sight of Arcueid charging as my enemy was beautiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
Her claws meet my knife.
Under the golden moon, even if she is my enemy, her figure is still beautiful.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　また弾けあう。
　正直、俺にはアルクェイドの動きなんて見えていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
We sprang apart again.
To be honest, I couldn’t see Arcueid’s movements at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other again.
To be honest, I can't even see her movements.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　さらに弾く。
　アルクェイドは全然本気でやっていない。
　けど、それでも俺の手足を引き裂くぐらいは容易なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Another parry.
Arcueid wasn’t fighting seriously in the least.
Even so, tearing off my arms and legs would probably have been easy for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other once more.
Arcueid isn't serious at all.
But still, it should be easy for her to rip off my arms and legs.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　まだ弾く。
　体が動く。
俺は何も考えていないのと同じだ。
　この手足、この体が、ただ死にたくないとう号令のもと、かってにアルクェイドの爪を弾いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Another parry, and another.
My body moved while my mind did nothing.
My arms, my legs—this whole body—deflected Arcueid’s claws on its own, obeying a single command: I don’t want to die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
We repel each other again.
My body moves without thinking.
My arms and legs, this body, with just the intention of not dying, fends off Arcueid's claws by itself.

entries.japanese:
「く―――――」
　口元が皮肉げに歪んだ。
　あまり認めたくないが、俺の体は遥かに人間ばなれしてしまっているみたいだ。
　夜のうちなら、遠野志貴はかつてのシキという男並みに、校舎の三階ぐらいなら楽に飛び降りられるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn…”
My mouth twisted in bitter amusement.
I hated to admit it, but my body had strayed far beyond anything human.
At night, Shiki Tohno could probably leap from the third floor of the school building as easily as the man once called SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tch-----"
My lips curl in irony.
I don't want to admit it, but it seems my body has become beyond that of a human's.
In the dead of night, it seems Tohno Shiki has become like SHIKI, probably able to easily jump off the third floor of a building and be just fine.

entries.japanese:
ギィ、ィィィ。
　だが、それも限界だった。
　初めから―――アルクェイドには勝てっこないって解っていた。
　そもそも、俺の唯一の武器である『線』が視えない。
　俺には彼女を傷つける手段がない。
　いつかアルクェイドが言っていた。
　夜であるのなら、アルクェイドは死の要因がなくなる生命だと。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrr— But that was my limit.
I had known from the beginning.
I could never defeat Arcueid.
For one thing, I couldn’t see the lines, my only weapon.
I had no way to harm her.
Arcueid had once told me that at night she became a form
of life from which every cause of death disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Cl, ang.
But, this is it.
From the very start---I knew I couldn't win against Arcueid.
First of all, I can't see any "lines" on her.
I have no way of hurting her.
Arcueid said it once.
That during nighttime, there is nothing which can cause her death.

entries.japanese:
ギイン。
　勢いよくナイフが弾かれる。
　アルクェイドの腕の一振りで、俺は大きく弾き飛ばされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Clang!
My knife was flung aside.
A single sweep of Arcueid’s arm sent me flying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
She hits my knife.
With just a swing of her arm, I fly through the air.

entries.japanese:
「くっ――――！」
　なんとか地面に着地して、ナイフを構える。
　いくら睨んでも、アルクェイドの体には『線』一つ視えない。
「くそ、なんてデタラメなんだ、アイツは……！」
――――まったくもってその通りだ。
　太陽の恩恵がないこの夜のなか。
　月の姫に挑むということは、あまりにも無謀すぎた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—!”
I somehow landed on my feet and raised the knife.
No matter how hard I stared, not a single “line” appeared on Arcueid’s body.
“Damn it, she’s impossible…!”
――――And that was precisely the truth.
Here in the night, beyond the sun’s blessing,
challenging the princess of the moon was sheer madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"K-----!"
I manage to land on the ground and ready my knife.
No matter how much I look, I can't see any "lines" on her.
"Damn it.
What nonsense you are……!"
----Yes, I am so right.
In the deep night without the mercy of the sun,
facing the princess of the moon is too reckless.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ、あ」
　喉があつい。
　心臓が爆発しそう。
　気がつけば、俺はアルクェイドと出会った時から彼女の紅い瞳に威圧されて、呼吸さえ満足にさせてもらっていなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah…”
My throat burned.
My heart felt ready to burst.
Only now did I realize that her crimson eyes had held me under such crushing pressure from the instant we met that I had scarcely been allowed to breathe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah, ha."
My throat is burning.
My heart feels like it'll explode.
I realize that since I saw her tonight, I was under the pressure of her crimson eyes and I haven't been able to breathe well.

entries.japanese:
「どう？
　少しは目が覚めた？」
　アルクェイドは息一つあがっていない。
　こっちは酸欠で今にも心臓が止まりそうだっていうのに、いい気なもんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well? Are you awake now?”
Arcueid wasn’t even winded.
I was close to cardiac arrest from lack of air, and there she stood without a care in the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Have you realized it yet?"
She isn't even out of breath.
Even though I'm gasping for air and my heart feels like it'll stop, she's completely relaxed.

entries.japanese:
「くそ――――おまえこそ、少しは頭を冷やせって言うんだ――――」
　乱れた呼吸を整えながら、少しずつアルクェイドから離れる。
　……アルクェイドはまったく本気になっていない。
ネロやロアのような威圧感こそないものの、ここまで―――自分と相手の『存在』のレベルの違いを感じさせられるなんて、思わなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn you… You’re the one who needs to cool your head…”
I edged away from Arcueid as I struggled to steady my breathing.
…She wasn’t remotely serious. She lacked the oppressive aura of Nrvnqsr or Roa, yet never had I felt so nakedly the difference between the level of my existence and another’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn----What about you, have you cooled your head----"
Trying to control my breathing, I step back from her little by little.
…… Arcueid isn't fighting me seriously at all.
She doesn't have the pressure like Roa or Nrvnqsr, I never thought I would feel this much difference between us.

entries.japanese:
「もう、しょうがないなぁ。
志貴は一度ぐらい殺されないと判ってくれないみたいだね」
　はあ、と面倒くさそうにため息をついて。
　アルクェイドは、俺の真後ろに立っていた。
「ぐっ――――！」
　ガン、という音が後頭部でなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Shiki. It seems you won’t understand until you’ve been killed at least once.”
She sighed as though the whole business were a nuisance.
Arcueid was standing directly behind me.
“Guh—!”
Something struck the back of my skull with a boom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh well.
It seems you won't understand until you die once, Shiki."
She gives an impatient sigh.
Arcueid stands directly behind me.
"Gh----!"
I hear a sound from behind my head.

entries.japanese:
――――瞬きをする間もない。
　アルクェイドは無造作に俺を地面に押し付けた。
　両肩にはアルクェイドの体重がかかっている。
　倒された。
　一瞬で、わけもわからないまま、アルクェイドに押さえつけられてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Before I could blink,
Arcueid casually slammed me against the ground.
Her weight bore down on both my shoulders.
I had been taken down—pinned beneath
her in one incomprehensible instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----There's not even time to blink.
She effortlessly pushes me to the ground.
Her body pushes up against my shoulders.
I'm down.
In an instant, without me knowing what's going on, Arcueid has pinned me down.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　アルクェイドは無言で、俺を睨みつけてくる。
　両肩にかかった体重。
　今すぐ俺をどうにかできるのに、まるで躊躇っているかのように、アルクェイドは止まっている。
「――――――」
　息を飲む。
　けど、それはアルクェイドの静寂だったのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Arcueid glared down in silence.
Her weight pressed into my shoulders.
She could do anything she wished to me, yet she had stopped, almost as though she were hesitating.
“……”
I caught my breath.
Or perhaps that breathless pause belonged to Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Arcueid glares at me without speaking.
Her body weight against my shoulders.
She stops as if hesitating over what to do with me.
"------"
I gasp.
But, it might have been just her silence.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　こんなに間近。
　抱き合う寸前まで近づいた今なら―――視えるかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
We were so close—almost close enough to embrace.
From here, perhaps I could see it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
This close.
Now that we are so close---I may be able to see it.

entries.japanese:
――――――アルクェイドの体を凝視する。
　びきり、と頭の芯で音がする。
　今までのような頭痛じゃなくて―――本当に、脳に亀裂が走ってしまいそうな、おと。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――I stared hard at Arcueid’s body.
Something creaked deep in my skull.
This was no ordinary headache; it sounded as though a crack were truly opening through my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I stare at her body.
The core of my brain screams in protest.
Completely unlike the pain of my headache before---as if it really were tearing itself apart.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ」
　それでもだめだ。
　アルクェイドという存在から『死』が読み取れない。
　日中ならともかく、夜においてはコイツはかぎりなく完璧に近い命、死という概念を持たない存在なんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Still nothing.
I could read no trace of death in Arcueid herself.
In daylight, perhaps—but at night she was a life infinitely close to perfection, a being without the very concept of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
But it's no good.
I can't read the "death" from an existence like Arcueid.
Daytime might be different, but at night, she is close to being a perfect life form that doesn't even carry the concept of death.

entries.japanese:
「……ロアをどうするつもりなんだ、アルクェイド。
おまえは俺を殺さないっていうけど、俺が生きているかぎりロアは生き続けるんだぞ」
「希薄になったロアは放っておいてもかまわないわ。
……そうね、だから貴方のことも見逃してあげてもよかったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, what will you do about Roa? You say you won’t kill me, but Roa will live for as long as I do.”
“Roa has grown so faint that I can safely ignore him. That was why I could have let you go.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What do you intend to do with Roa, Arcueid?
You said you wouldn't kill me, but as long as I live, Roa will still be alive."
"I don't care about a diluted Roa.
…… Yes, that's why I could have let you go, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「―――なんだ、遠慮しないで見逃せよ。
俺なんかにかまってないでさ、早く帰って故郷のパパを安心させてやれ」
「でもね。
もともと自分の力なんだから取り戻そうとするのは当然でしょう？
　なによりわたしは貴方の事を気に入っている」
　ぎり、と。
　両肩にかかる体重が、重くなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then don’t hold back—let me go. Forget about me and hurry home so your daddy won’t worry.”
“But the power was mine to begin with. Of course I would want it back. More importantly, I like you.”
Her weight ground harder
into my shoulders.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Oh, you don't have to hold back, go ahead and let me go.
Don't worry about me and go home, back to your daddy."
"But you know, isn't it natural for me to take back my own power?
And more than anything else, I do like you."
Squeeze.
The body weight on my shoulders becomes even heavier.

entries.japanese:
「わたしは貴方を殺してロアを奪り混むより、このまま志貴を取りこみたい」
　だから殺さない、と。
　赤い瞳が、訴えてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Rather than kill you and absorb Roa, I want to take Shiki into myself exactly as you are.”
I won’t kill you.
Her red eyes pleaded the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"More than killing you and destroying Roa, I want to take you in."
So, I won't kill you,
her red eyes seem to say.

entries.japanese:
「信じられないけど、わたしは貴方が好きみたい。
　だから助けてあげる。
血も吸わないし、貴方の嫌がることは決してしない」
　だから言うコトを聞いて、と赤い瞳が語ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can hardly believe it, but I think I like you. So I’ll save you. I won’t drink your blood, and I’ll never do anything you hate.”
So please obey me, her crimson eyes said.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I can't believe it, but it seems I really like you.
That's why I'll save you.
I won't suck your blood, and I won't do anything you won't like."
So please listen to what I tell you, her red eyes say.

entries.japanese:
―――それは、間違いなくアルクェイドの本心だ。
　けど、聞けない。
　気が緩んでいるのか、アルクェイドの体から完全が薄れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――She meant every word.
But I could not obey.
Perhaps her guard had fallen; the perfection surrounding Arcueid’s body had begun to fade.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Those are, without a doubt, her true feelings.
But, I can't listen.
She might be not on guard right now as the perfection is fading from her body.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴。
それとも、わたしのコトは嫌い？」
　まっすぐに見つめてくる、目。
　押さえ付けられながら彼女の顔を見つめた。
　真摯に。
―――脳が焼ききれてしまうほど、強く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……Shiki.
Or do you hate me?”
Her eyes met mine without wavering.
Pinned beneath her, I stared into her face—earnestly, fiercely enough to burn out my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki.
Or do you, hate me?"
Her eyes look straight at me.
I look at her face while being pinned down.
Sincerely.
---So strongly it might burn my brain.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイドのことは、嫌いじゃない」
「ほんと？」
　嬉しそうに彼女は言った。
　……額が熱い。
　脳がぐつぐつと音をたてるなか、確かに―――
　たった一本だけの、死に易い『線』を見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I don’t hate you, Arcueid.”
“Really?”
She asked, delighted.
…My forehead burned.
Through the sound of my brain boiling, I finally—
—saw one solitary “line,” one that would make her easy to kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't hate you Arcueid."
"Really?"
She sounds very happy.
…… My forehead is burning.
As my brain throbs horribly, I definitely---
See just one "line" of death.

entries.japanese:
「だけどな、それでもおまえの人形になるつもりなんかない……！」
「―――――――！」
　アルクェイドの目が怒りに染まる。
　だがその前に。
　俺は、彼女の首に視えている『線』をかっ切っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But even so, I’m not becoming your puppet!”
“—!”
Arcueid’s eyes flared with rage.
But before that could matter,
I had already cut the “line” across her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Still, I have no intention of becoming your puppet……!"
"-------!"
Her eyes brim over with anger.
But before that,
I slice through the "line" on her neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　喉から鮮血をこぼして、アルクェイドは倒れこむ。
　俺は彼女の下から抜け出して、今のうちに離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Bright blood spilled from her throat, and Arcueid collapsed.
I wriggled out from under her and put distance between us while I still could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
Fresh blood spilling from her neck, Arcueid collapses.
Slipping out from underneath her, I get away.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　息があがっている。
　傷はないけど、これじゃあまともに走れない。
　アルクェイドのことだ、あの程度の傷すぐに治して、また襲いかかって―――
「アル……クェイド？」
　彼女は、ぴくりとも動かない。
　地面に血を流して、白い体を朱に染めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah”
I was already panting.
I wasn’t wounded, but I could never run properly like this.
Knowing Arcueid, she would heal a cut like that in moments and come after me again—
“Ar—cueid?”
She did not move.
Blood pooled beneath her, staining her white body scarlet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----Ah."
I am out of breath.
I'm not hurt, but I can't run in this state.
It's Arcueid, she should be able to heal such a wound and will come to attack me again---
"Ar…… cueid?"
She doesn't even move.
Blood flowing over the ground, her white body is covered in vermillion.

entries.japanese:
―――――まさか。
殺して、しまったの、か。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――No. Had I—had I killed her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----No way.
Did I, kill her?

entries.japanese:
「な―――アルクェイド、そんな―――」
　逃げようとした足を止めて、アルクェイドの体に駆け寄ろうとして、息を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—Arcueid, that can’t be—”
My fleeing feet stopped; I turned to rush back to her body and sucked in a breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---Arcueid, are---"
Stopping my legs that tried to flee, I try to rush towards her body, but gasp.

entries.japanese:
片腕。
　倒れこんだアルクェイドの片腕が、ぎっ……と、蜘蛛の足のように、地面に手をついたから。
　その時。
　確かに、世界が凍りついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
One arm.
One of Arcueid’s arms creaked into motion, planting its hand on the ground like a spider’s leg.
At that instant.
The world truly froze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
One arm.
One of her arms on her collapsed figure…… like a spider's leg, stands up on the ground.
In that instant,
the whole world freezes over.

entries.japanese: 「こ　　　　ろ　　　　し　　　　て」
entries.maoEnglish: “K i l l m e.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I      Wi   l    l"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあ。
はあ。
　……彼女の喉から漏れる鮮血と、呼吸。
　アルクェイドの腕にぐ、と力が入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah. Hah.
Blood and breath leaked together from her throat.
Strength gathered in Arcueid’s arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
…… From her neck spills her blood, and her breath.
Her arm tenses.

entries.japanese: 「し　　　て、　　　　　　げ　　　　る、」
entries.maoEnglish: “I’ l l d o i t f o r y o u.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Ki  ll,    Yo   u,"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあ。
はあはあ。
はあ。
は。
　……朱い血はまだ流れ続けている。
　静かに、彼女の体が地面から離れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah. Hah-hah. Hah. Ha.
Scarlet blood kept flowing.
Quietly, her body began to rise from the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant* *pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*
…… The vermillion blood continues to flow.
Her body lifts slowly from the ground.

entries.japanese: 「こ　　　　ろ　　　　し　　　　て」
entries.maoEnglish: “K i l l…”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I   Wi   l    l"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあはあ、はあ。
あ。
あははは、は。
　……血にけがされた、白い彼女。
　顔があがる。
　金色の髪の間に目が見える。
　瞳は、黒く落ち込んだ娑齢頭のように闇。
　その中に。
　火傷してしまいそうな程に、爛々とした赤があった。

「ころ　　　して　　　あげ　　　る」

はあ。
はあ。
はあ。
　はあ。
はあはあ、はあ。
あ。
あははは、は。
　ははは、あははは、
　あははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははは―――――！！！！
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah-hah, hah. Ah. Ahahaha, ha.
White, defiled with blood.
Her face lifted.
An eye appeared between strands of golden hair.
Its pupil was a hollow darkness, black as a skull.
Within it.
A red light blazed so brilliantly it seemed capable of scorching me.
“I’ l l k i l l y o u.”
Hah. Hah. Hah.
Hah. Hah-hah, hah. Ah. Ahahaha, ha.
Hahaha, ahahaha—
Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha—!!!!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Heavy, rapid breathing turns into laughter.
…… Her white body stained in blood.
She raises her face.
I can see her eyes gleaming between her golden hair.
Her eyes are pitch-black.
And in them,
glows a fierce, fiery red.

"I    will    kill   you."

*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
ha.
a.
ahahaha, ha.
Hahaha, ahahaha,
Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahah-------!!!!

entries.japanese:
「アル―――クェイド」
　彼女の目は、何も見ていない。
　片手で立ちあがろうとするのだけれど、そのたびに彼女は地面に倒れてしまう。
　自らの血だまりで手が滑って、そのたびに彼女の体は赤くなっていく。
　何度も、何度も。
　立ちあがろうとして、滑って、倒れて。
　……そんな無様な行為さえ、彼女は愉しんでいるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—cueid.”
Her eyes saw nothing.
She tried to rise on one hand, only to collapse each time.
Her hand slipped in her own blood, staining more of her body red with every fall.
Again and again.
She tried to rise, slipped, and fell.
She seemed to relish even that wretched spectacle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar---cueid."
Her eyes are looking at nothing.
She tries to lift herself up with one hand, but every time, she collapses back down to the ground.
She slips on her own pool of blood, and each time, her body gets redder.
Over, and over.
She tries to stand up, slips, and falls.
…… It seems as if she's enjoying that cycle of failure.

entries.japanese:
「まっ、てて」
「―――――――」
　動けない。
　アルクェイドの声が、姿が、意思が―――否応無しに頭の中に流れこんでくる。
　俺という意思が流される。
融かされる。
翻弄される。
　ぐるぐると世界が回る。
　その中で、彼女のイメージが入ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait.”
“…”
I couldn’t move.
Arcueid’s voice, her form, her will—all of it poured irresistibly into my mind.
The will that was me was swept away. Dissolved. Toyed with.
The world spun round and round.
Amid the spinning, an image of her entered me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ju st, wait."
"-------"
I can't move.
Her voice, her figure, her will---flows compulsorily into my head.
My will is flowing, fusing, merging.
The whole world spins around me.
In the middle of it all, her image dominates.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　　　　そう。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ff0000



Yes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
That's right.

entries.japanese:
こんな屈辱は味わったことがない。
　こんな恥辱は身にうけたこともない。
―――だから、愉しい。
　志貴に、この身を焦がすほどの憤怒をぶつけ、叩きつける時がどれほど気持ちよい事か想像もつかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Never had I suffered such humiliation.
Never had I endured such disgrace.
―――That was why it delighted me.
I could not imagine how exquisite it would feel to hurl this body-searing rage at Shiki and smash him beneath it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I have never felt such shame before.
I have never been so disgraced.
---That's, why it's funny.
I can't even imagine how much pleasure I'll get when I take this anger out on you, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
壊す。
壊す。
壊す。
　少しずつ、一息に、この上なく優しく、痺れるぐらい残酷に、あの命を犯しつくそう。
　そう。
　四肢を引き千切って肋骨をあばいて臓物をよじり出して、助けをこう喉を踏み潰して眼を噛み砕いて頭蓋を切開して脳髄をバターのように地面に塗りたくるその瞬間―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
Break him. Break him. Break him.
Slowly and all at once, with unsurpassed tenderness and cruelty enough to numb the senses, I would violate that life utterly.
Yes.
That instant when I tore off his limbs, split open his ribs and twisted out his entrails, crushed the throat that begged for mercy, bit his eyes to pulp, split his skull open, and spread his brains across the ground like butter—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Destroy.
Destroy.
Destroy.
Slowly, completely, gently beyond comparison, cruelly to the point of numbness, I'll violate your life.
That's right.
The instant I tear off your limbs, rip open your chest and pull out your intestines, biting into your neck as you ask for mercy, chewing through your eyes and spreading your brains on the ground like butter------!

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
「待っていて、すぐに殺してあげるから……！」
　笑って、狂ったように笑い続けて、アルクェイドは自らの血の海でもがいている。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ffffff

“Wait for me; I’ll kill you very soon…!”
Laughing and laughing like a madwoman, Arcueid writhed in a sea of her own blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
"Just wait, I'll kill you soon……!"
Smiling, laughing insanely, Arcueid wallows in a sea of her own blood.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　動けない。
　いけない。
　ロアのヤツでさえ、固まってる。
　ここにいたら、本当に殺される。
　逃げないと。
　どこでもいい、早くここから離れないと、殺される。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I couldn’t move.
This was bad.
Even Roa had gone rigid.
If I stayed, she truly would kill me.
I had to run.
Anywhere—anywhere at all. If I didn’t get away now, I would die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I can't move.
This isn't good.
Even Roa can't move.
If I stay here, I really will be killed.

I have to escape.
It doesn't matter where, if I don't get away from here quickly, I will get killed.

entries.japanese:
「あ、あ―――――」
　びちゃり、びちゃり、という、音。
　アルクェイドは自らの血の海で、気が狂ったように笑っている。
「ああ、あ――――」
　喉からこぼれる血液。
　切断された死に至る傷。
　それがよほど痛いのか。
　彼女は、その痛みを緩和させるために、自らの腹や腕を、噛み、切っていた。
「ああああぁあああああ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…
ah—” Wet, splashing sounds.
Arcueid laughed madly in the lake of her own blood.
“Ahh…
ah—” Blood spilled from her throat.
The severed wound that carried death.
Was the pain so terrible?
To dull it, she bit and tore at her own stomach and arms.
“Aaaaaaaaaah!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Ah-----"
Wet, dripping sounds.
In the pool of her own blood, Arcueid laughs insanely.
"A ah, ah-----"
The blood spraying from her neck.
Her slashed, fatal wound.
Does it hurt that much?
As if to mitigate the pain, she is chewing through her stomach, her arms, tearing herself apart.
"AAAAAaAAAAAA!"

entries.japanese:
――――走った。
　何処に行こうとか、どう逃げようとか、そんな頭のいい事は考えつかない。
　ただ走らなければという恐怖に駆られて、この惨殺の空間から逃げ出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I ran.
I couldn’t think of where to go or how best to escape.
Driven by the terror that I had to run, I fled that place of slaughter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I run.
Thoughts of where and how don't even enter my mind.
I am driven by fear, and I run away from this killing chamber.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ、はあ――――」
　気がつけば、こんな所まで走ってきていた。
「はあ――――あ、あ」
　息があがっている。
　体はもう、一歩だって動けないっていうぐらい疲労している。
「っ―――あ、は、あ」
　それでも足を動かした。
　こんなところにいると見付かってしまう。
　建物の中に入って、朝まで隠れていないと殺されてしまう。
　こんなふうに休んでいる間も、アイツは俺を捜しているに違いない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… hah, hah…”
When I came to myself, I had run all the way here.
“Hah… ah, ah…”
I couldn’t catch my breath.
My body was so exhausted it could not take another step.
“Ah… ha… ah…”
Still I forced my legs onward.
She would find me if I stayed here.
I had to get inside a building and hide until morning or she would kill me.
Even while I rested, she had to be searching for me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*---*pant*, *pant*----
I run to this place without even realizing it.
"Ghaa----ah, ah."
I'm out of breath.
I'm so exhausted I can't take another step.
"Ts---ah, ha, ah."
But my legs keep moving.
I'll be found in this place.
I have to go inside and hide myself until morning or I'll die.
Even while I'm resting like this, I bet she's looking for me---

entries.japanese:
メガネを外して、校門を閉めている鍵をナイフで切断する。
　
「あ――――く」
　門を開けて、学校の中に入っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I removed my glasses and cut through the lock on the school gate with my knife.
“Ah… ngh.”
I opened the gate and slipped onto the grounds.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take off my glasses and cut the lock on the school gate with my knife.
"Ah----kk."
Opening the door, I walk inside the school grounds.

entries.japanese:
「は…………あ」
　グラウンドについたとたん、膝から地面に崩れ落ちた。
　膝をグラウンドの土につけて、倒れようとする体を両手で支える。
「………………」
　体が熱い。
　早く、校舎の中に入らないといけないのに、もう足が動いてくれない。
　それは体の疲れというより、心の疲れといえるものだった。
　止まらない頭痛。
　俺の中にいるというロア。
　……そして、狂ったように笑い続けていた白い吸血姫。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… ah.”
The moment I reached the athletic field, my knees gave way.
I sank into the dirt and caught my falling body on both hands.
“……”
My body burned.
I had to get inside the school, but my legs would no longer move.
This was less physical exhaustion than exhaustion of the soul.
The ceaseless headache.
Roa, supposedly living inside me.
…And the white vampire princess laughing like a lunatic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha………… ah."
I fall to my knees as soon as I get to the school grounds.
I brace myself off the ground using both my hands.
"……………"
My whole body is hot.
I have to hurry inside the school building, but my legs won't move.
More than my body, my heart and mind are completely worn out.
This headache that won't stop.
This Roa inside of me.
…… And, the white vampire princess that continued to laugh insanely.

entries.japanese:
「――――ぐ」
　胃液が逆流する。
　口の中が苦い。
　今日は何も口にしていないから、吐き出すものは酸味のきいた胃液だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Guh.”
Bile surged up my throat, filling my mouth with bitterness.
I had eaten nothing all day,
so there was nothing to vomit but sour stomach acid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gg."
Gorge rises in my throat.
My mouth tastes bitter.
I haven't eaten anything today, so all I can vomit is my stomach acid.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――あ」
　膝をついたまま、がつん、と地面に頭を打ち付けた。
「なんで……こんな、ことに」
　諦めに似た吐息をもらして、立ちあがるのを放棄した。
　……見付かってしまうのなら、それでもいい。
　どうせ逃げられない。
　アルクェイドからも、自分の中にいるというロアからも。
　それなら、もう―――ここでこうして、静かに終わりを待ち続けたほうが、楽だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… ah.”
Still on my knees, I let my forehead strike the ground.
“How…
did it come to this?”
I breathed out something close to surrender and abandoned the effort to rise.
…If she found me, so be it.
There was no escape anyway—not from Arcueid, nor from the Roa inside me.
In that case, it would be easier to remain here and quietly wait for the end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah."
Still on my knees, I collapse headfirst onto the ground.
"Why…… did it end up, like this?"
Breathing painfully, I give up trying to lift up my face.
…… Even if she finds me, I don't care.
I can't escape anyway.
Away from Arcueid, or from Roa who is inside me.
Since that's the case---waiting here quietly for the end is easier for me.

entries.japanese:
「―――？」
　すう、とあたりが暗くなった。
　かっ、かっ、という足音。
　地面に手足をついていて下を見ていたから気付かなかったけど、誰かがこっちにやってくる。
　月明かりの下。
　その人の影が、四つんばいになっている俺にかかって暗くなったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……?”
The light around me dimmed.
Click, click—approaching footsteps.
On all fours with my head hanging, I hadn’t noticed someone coming toward me.
Under the moonlight, that person’s shadow had fallen across me where I crouched on all fours.
Was that why it had grown dark?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---?"
It suddenly gets darker.
The sound of footsteps.
I didn't realize it since I was face down, but someone is coming.
Under the moonlight.
Did that person darken the sky with her shadow?

entries.japanese:
「懺悔の真似事ですか、遠野くん」
　それは。
　冷たい、シエル先輩の声だった。
「――――先輩？」
　……呆然と顔をあげる。
　どうして先輩がこんな所にいるかは知らない。
　ただ、今は何かに縋りたくて、夜空を仰ぐように顔をあげた。
「――――え？」
―――それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Playing at confession, Tohno?”
It was Ciel’s
voice—cold as ice.
“Is that… you?”
I raised my head in a daze.
I had no idea why she was here.
I only needed something—anything—to cling to, and lifted my face as though appealing to the night sky.
“――――What?”
―――But what I saw…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Are you trying to repent, Tohno-kun?"
Ciel-senpai asks in a cold voice.
"----Senpai?"
…… I lift my head in amazement.
I don't know why she's here.
But, I wanted to rely on something right now, and I lift my face to meet the night air.
"----Eh?"
---But this.

entries.japanese:
―――俺の知っている、
　　　シエルという人物ではなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――was not the
Ciel I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---This Ciel before me,
she isn't the one that I know.

entries.japanese:
剥き出しの腕にある、黒い十字架の入れ墨。
　冷たい、まるで知らない他人を見るような目。
　……無骨で、剥き出しで、見ているだけで寒気を呼びおこしそうな、先輩にはあんまりにも不似合いな凶器。
entries.maoEnglish:
A black cross tattooed on her bare arm.
Eyes as cold as if she were looking at a total stranger.
…And a crude, naked weapon whose mere appearance sent a chill through me—something grotesquely ill-suited to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her bare arms have the tattoo of a cross on them.
Her cold eyes, as if watching someone she doesn't even know.
…… Senpai bears an uncouth weapon with an aura of coldness that doesn't suit her.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――あ」
　……知っている。
　頭が、あの凶器がどんなものだか、知っている。
　アレはたしか―――第七聖典と呼ばれる、門外不出の外典の一つ。
「先―――輩？」
「やっぱり貴方がロアだったんですね、遠野くん」
　冷たい目のまま。
　先輩は、同じように冷たい声でそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah.”
…I know it.
Somewhere inside my head, I know what that weapon is. It is called the Seventh Holy Scripture, one of the apocryphal texts forbidden to outsiders.
“Ci—el?”
“So you really were Roa, Tohno.”
With the same cold eyes,
she spoke in the same cold voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Ah."
…… I know this.
Inside my brain, I know what weapon this is.
That has to be---what's called the Seventh Holy Scripture, one of the apocrypha that must never be removed from its resting place.
"Sen---pai?"
"As I expected, you were Roa after all, Tohno-kun."
With her frigid eyes,
Senpai speaks with a voice that is equally cold.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　ぞくり、と背筋が震える。
　ワケもなく。
いや、本能と理性が総動員して危険を報せてきて、思わず先輩から跳び退いた。
「――――――」
　先輩は固く口を閉ざしたまま、一歩、あの不吉な凶器を持ったまま近寄ってくる。
　……そこには、まったく隙がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
A shudder ran down my spine.
For no reason—no, because instinct and reason were screaming danger with one voice—I sprang away from her.
“……”
Her lips stayed tightly closed. Carrying that ominous weapon, she took one step toward me.
…There was not the slightest opening in her guard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I start to feel a shiver up my spine.
For no reason.
No, my instincts and my brain work full force to tell me the danger, and I jump back.
"------"
Still with her mouth shut, she takes a step towards me with that ominous weapon.
…… She has no openings whatsoever.

entries.japanese:
下手に逃げれば。
　このまま背中を向けて走り出せば、自分の心臓がアレで貫かれて、転生もかなわぬまま消滅してしまうってわかってしまう。
　……俺の記憶には、そんな知識はありはしないというのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
If I made a careless run for it.
If I turned my back and fled, that weapon would pierce my heart and erase me beyond all hope of reincarnation; somehow, I knew it.
…Even though no such knowledge existed anywhere in my memories.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I run away hastily,
if I show my back to her, I know that thing will pierce my heart and I will disappear without the opportunity for reincarnation ever again.
…… Even though I don't even have that knowledge in my memories.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんで。
先輩まで、そんな―――」
「わかってます。
ロアの意識が浮上しているんでしょう？
　なら、もう手遅れです」
　ざっ、と。
　もう一歩、無造作に近づいてくる。
　その姿はまるで―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…? Why are you acting like this too—?”
“I understand. Roa’s consciousness is surfacing, isn’t it? Then it’s already too late.”
Scrape.
She took another casual step toward me.
She looked exactly like—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Senpai.
Why are you doing this too---?"
"I understand.
Roa is already surfacing, right?
Then it is too late already."
Lightly,
she takes another effortless step forward.
That figure looks like----

entries.japanese:
「―――おかしいよ先輩。
　それじゃあまるで―――俺を、殺そうと、しているみたいじゃないか」
「―――――」
　彼女は答えない。
　ただ、どこを狙えば確実に仕留められるのか、それだけが関心事のように俺を見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Something’s wrong, Ciel.”
“You look as if—as if you’re trying to kill me.”
“—”
She did not answer.
She watched me as though her only concern was where to strike for a certain kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are you doing, Senpai?
You look like---you're, going to kill me."
"-----"
She doesn't answer.
She just stares at me like she's trying to find out where she can aim to kill me quickly.

entries.japanese:
「―――先、輩」
　本気だ。
　この人は、本気で、俺を殺すつもりだ。
―――ギッ。
　殺される直前ということを感じとって、神経が軋みをあげる。
　脊髄はびりびりと悲鳴をあげて、首の後ろがギチギチとかじかんでいく。
　けど―――そんな死の恐れより、俺は。
　この人がどうしてそんなことを言うのか、本当に、信じられなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ci…el.”
She was serious.
She truly meant to kill me.
―――Creak.
My nerves recognized the instant before death and began to buckle.
My spinal cord shrieked with electric pain; the back of my neck seized tighter and tighter.
But more than the fear of death—
I simply could not believe she was saying these things to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Sen, pai."
She's serious.
She seriously, plans to kill me.
---Creak.
My nerves feel the imminent death before me.
My spine is screaming and the back of my neck is numbing.
But---more than this fear of death,
I can't believe this person is saying such things.

entries.japanese:
「――――なん、で？」
　わからない。
「先輩は、俺のために残ってくれるって、言ったのに」
「――――――」
　ぴたり、と。
　シエル先輩の足が止まる。
　彼女は俺を凝視したまま、クスリと、笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Why?”
I didn’t understand.
“You said you would stay for me.”
“—”
Abruptly.
Ciel stopped dead.
Still staring straight at me, she gave a tiny laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Why?"
I don't know.
"Senpai, you said you stayed here for my sake."
"------"
With a start,
Ciel-senpai's legs stop.
She looks at me and grins.

entries.japanese:
「貴方の人の良さは国宝級ですね。
人を信じるのはいいですが、もう少し冷静に物事を考えられたのなら逃げおおせる事もできたのに」
「え―――」
「だいたい、どうしてわたしがこの学校に紛れこんでいたのか、その理由を一度も考えなかったんですか貴方は。
　わたしは別に、好きでこんなコトをしていたわけではないんですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Your trusting nature deserves to be declared a national treasure. Trusting people is admirable, but if you had stopped to think a little more calmly, you might have escaped.”
“What…?”
“Did you never once wonder why I had infiltrated this school?
I certainly wasn’t doing it because I enjoyed playing student.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Your goodness really is a rare treasure.
It is a good thing to trust people, but if you were a little more composed and thought about it clearly, you could have maybe got away."
"Eh---"
"First of all, didn't you ever think about why I came to this school in the first place?"
I didn't do it just because I wanted to, you know."

entries.japanese:
「――――――先、輩？」
「わたしの目的は『蛇』―――ロアを消滅させる事だと知っているでしょう。
　わたしがこの学校にやってきたのは、ここにロアの転生体がいるとわかったから。
けれど確たる証拠がなくて、しばらくその転生体の様子を見る必要があった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ci—el?”
“You know my purpose is to destroy the Serpent—Roa.
I came to this school because I learned Roa’s reincarnation vessel was here. But I had no conclusive proof, so I needed to observe the vessel for a time.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Sen, pai?"
"You knew my goal was to destroy 'The Serpent'---Roa.
Coming here to this school was because I knew Roa's reincarnated host was here.
But since I didn't know for sure, I needed to check things out for a while."

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれ、一体なにを―――」
　なにを口走ってるんだろう、この人は。
　わからない。
　まるで、てんで理解できない。
　先輩は困惑する俺を無視して話をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. What are you—?”
What was she talking about?
I didn’t understand.
I couldn’t understand a word of it.
Ciel ignored my confusion and continued.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute, what in the world are you---"
What is she babbling about?
I don't know.
I really can't understand what she's talking about.
She ignores my bewilderment and keeps talking.

entries.japanese:
「……前に教えてあげたでしょう、遠野くん。
ロアが転生先に選ぶ家系には条件があると。
　逆に言えば、その条件さえあっている家系を探せばいいだけ。
ロアの転生体の特定は、わかってしまえば容易なんですよ。
　その家系が旧い異能の血を継いでいるかは調べればすぐにわかります。
この街ではロアの転生先になるような家柄は一つしかなかった。
　ですから―――初めから誰がロアであるかは解っていたんですよ、わたし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I explained this before, Tohno. Roa chooses his reincarnation host according to certain conditions.
That means one need only find a family that satisfies them. Once those conditions are known, identifying his reincarnation vessel is easy.
Whether a family carries an ancient supernatural gift can be discovered with very little investigation. In this city, only one lineage qualified as a possible host for Roa.
So—I knew who Roa was from the very beginning.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I told you before, Tohno-kun.
Roa has requirements for the family he decides to reincarnate into.
If you think the other way around, you just have to look for families with those traits.
When you know that, finding him is very simple.
It's easy to find families that have special abilities passed down through their blood once you do a bit of research.
In this city, there is only one family that fits Roa's requirements.
So---I knew from the beginning who Roa was."

entries.japanese:
「―――――な」
　そんなのは、おかしい。
　初めから解っていたんなら、さっさとそいつを殺すか、掴まえるかすれ……ば……。
　初めから？
　誰であるか、わかって、いた……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Wh…”
That made no sense.
If she had known from the beginning, she should have killed that person at once, or captured them…
From the beginning?
She had known who it was…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Wha--"
That's strange.
If she knew from the beginning, she could have killed him or caught him right then……
From the beginning?
She knew, who it was……?

entries.japanese:
「そうです。
ほら、もういいかげん気がついたでしょう？
　わたしはね、遠野くん。
初めから、貴方を捕えるためにこの学校に紛れこんだんです」
「――――――――――――――」
　待て。
　それは、ちょっと、待って、ほしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. Surely you’ve realized it by now.
I infiltrated this school from the beginning in order to capture you, Tohno.”
“—”
Wait.
I needed her to wait—just for a moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Look, don't you realize it now?
You know, Tohno-kun.
I came to this school to catch you from the beginning."
"--------------"
Wait.
I just want, her to, wait.

entries.japanese:
「ですが、そこで少し間違いが起きてしまいました。
　……貴方の中のロアを刺激しないように遠くから監視していたんですが、どうも貴方はロアの転生先ではないと結論がでたんです。
　けど、ロアの転生先は絶対に遠野家の長男なんです。
それに間違いはありませんから、そうなると間違っているのは遠野くんのほうになる」
　シエル先輩は淡々と語る。
　俺は―――何も、言えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But then a small discrepancy arose.
—I watched you from a distance to avoid stirring the Roa inside you, and eventually concluded you were not his reincarnation host.
Roa’s host, however, had to be the eldest son of the Tohno family—that fact was beyond dispute. Which meant that you, Tohno, were the discrepancy.”
Ciel recited it all dispassionately.
I—could say nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, a little mistake happened.
…… I was watching you from afar so as not to stimulate Roa inside you, but I concluded that you might not be Roa's new reincarnated host.
But, the eldest son of the Tohno family had to be what Roa reincarnates into.
There is no mistake in that, so what had to be a mistake was you, Tohno-kun."
Ciel-senpai speaks matter-of-factly.
I---can't say anything.

entries.japanese:
「調べてみれば、遠野くんは八年前に大怪我をして親戚の家に預けられている。
　その後の出来事は二日前の夜、本当の遠野シキが言っていた通りです。
　八年前の遠野家で何があったのか知りませんが、遠野くんはあのシキという少年に殺された。
いえ、命を奪われたんでしょうね。
　結果として遠野くんはロアの転生先であるシキと繋がってしまった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My investigation showed that you suffered a grave injury eight years ago and were sent to live with relatives.
What happened afterward accords with what the real SHIKI Tohno said two nights ago.
I do not know what occurred in the Tohno household eight years ago, but that boy SHIKI killed you—or rather, took your life from you.
As a result, you became connected to SHIKI, Roa’s reincarnation host.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Looking into it, you were fatally wounded eight years ago and adopted by your relatives.
What happened afterwards was exactly as Tohno SHIKI said two nights ago.
I don't know what happened in the Tohno family eight years ago, but you were killed by that kid called SHIKI.
No, it's more like your life was stolen.
As a result, you became connected to SHIKI who was Roa's host."

entries.japanese:
感情のない声で、淡々と。
　それは俺の知らないシエル先輩だ。
　それとも、これが。
　これが本当のシエルで、今までの優しかったこの人は、全部――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Calmly, in a voice without feeling.
This was a Ciel I did not know.
Or was this the truth?
Was this the real Ciel, and had all the kindness she had shown me until now been nothing but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
A direct voice, without emotion.
I don't know this Ciel-senpai.
Or is this…
Is this the true Ciel, and the kind person I knew up until now was all just----

entries.japanese:
「これまで何度かシキを通じて遠野くんの中にロアの記憶が流れ込んでくる事もあったでしょう。
　もともと魂という、カタチに出来ないモノを加工した吸血鬼です。
ロアにとってみれば、一つの命を共有している貴方たちは良く出来た二重存在だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Roa’s memories must have flowed into you through SHIKI on several occasions.
Roa is a vampire who remade something as intangible as the soul. To him, the two of you sharing a single life made an ideal dual existence.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Up until now, there should have been times where Roa's memory would flow into you through SHIKI.
He is a vampire that manipulated the shapeless thing called a soul.
For Roa, you two who shared one life were a finely crafted double existence.

entries.japanese:
「だから―――シキの肉体が滅んでも、ロアは次の転生先に行く必要がない。
この時代には、まだ貴方という避難先があったんですから」
　冷たい。
　まるで仇を睨むように、彼女は俺を憎んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is why―――even when SHIKI’s body was destroyed, Roa had no need to seek his next reincarnation host. In this age, he still had you as a refuge.”
Cold.
She hated me, glaring as though I were her bitterest enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why---when SHIKI's body was destroyed, Roa didn't need to reincarnate.
He still had a place to run to: you."
Cold.
As if hating her enemy, she detests me.

entries.japanese:
「でも、それも終わりです。
あの夜は突然の事で準備が出来ませんでしたが、今夜は違います。
　ある意味、わたしは幸運ですね。
あのままアルクェイドにロアが消されていたのなら、ロアはまた転生してしまったでしょうから」
　……信じ。
られない。
　そんなもの―――そんな、ものは
「――――うそ、だ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that ends tonight. I had no time to prepare when it all happened so suddenly that night, but tonight is different.
In a sense, I was fortunate. Had Arcueid destroyed Roa then and there, he would only have reincarnated again.”
—I couldn’t. Believe it.
That—none of that—
“—It’s a lie.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it's all over now.
I wasn't prepared to finish it so suddenly that one night, but tonight is different.
I really am fortunate in a way.
If Arcueid had destroyed Roa, he probably would have reincarnated again."
…… I can't.
Believe this.
That---that…
"----That's not, true."

entries.japanese:
「どうぞ、ご勝手に否定して、そこで惚けていてください。
そのほうがわたしの仕事も楽になります。
もっとも―――」
　かちゃり、とあの凶器が音をたてる。
「貴方がその気になっても楽に始末できることには変わりはありませんけどね、ロア」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Go ahead. Deny it and keep playing dumb right where you are. It will make my work easier. Although—”
The weapon answered with a metallic click.
“Even if you do decide to fight, you’ll still be easy to dispose of, Roa.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, please keep on denying it and play dumb.
That makes my job easier.
Still---"
A metallic rattle sounds from the weapon.
"It doesn't change the fact that I can finish you off easily no matter what you do, Roa."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　その、あざ笑うような声で、解った。
　……彼女の言葉に嘘はない。
　……彼女の目は『俺』を見ていない。
　……彼女の気持ちには初めから『俺』なんていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
The mockery in her voice made me understand.
…She had not told a single lie.
…Her eyes were not looking at me.
…There had never been any place for me in her heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Her laughing voice causes me to finally understand.
…… She isn't lying.
…… Her eyes aren't looking at "me".

…… Her feelings never did have anything to do with "me" from the beginning.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、それ。
　それじゃあ、それじゃあ先輩ははじめっから俺がロアだって当たりをつけてたのか。
　先輩が。
先輩が俺と仲良くしていたのは、全部……………！」
―――言えない。
　その先は、口にできない。
　そうしてしまえば、その瞬間に全ての出来事が嘘になってしまいそうで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What the hell is that supposed to mean?
So you had me marked as Roa from the very beginning?
Then you—everything you did to get close to me was all……!”
―――I couldn’t say it.
I could not give voice to the rest.
The instant I did, everything that had happened between us would become a lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What is this?
Then, then from the very beginning, you always thought of me as Roa?
Senpai.
Being friends with me was all just……………!"
---I can't say it.
I can't finish the sentence.
If I do that, I feel like everything will turn into a lie in that instant.

entries.japanese:
「当然でしょう。
シキが消えた後、わたしが学校に残ったのはロアが消えていなかったからです。
ロアがこの学校の生徒である以上、ここに残ったほうが何かと便利ですから」
　わたしが遠野くんを置いて帰るわけがないじゃないですか。
　先輩はそう、笑顔で言った。
　アレは、俺のためじゃなくて。
　この人はまだ生きているロアを捜すために残って、その追跡者に、俺は救いを求めていたワケか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course. I remained at the school after SHIKI disappeared because Roa had not vanished with him. Since Roa was still one of its students, staying here was the most practical choice.”
—There’s no way I would go home and leave you behind, Tohno.
She had said that with a smile.
But it had never been for my sake.
She remained to hunt the Roa who still lived—and I had gone seeking salvation from the woman hunting me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Of course.
After SHIKI was destroyed, the only reason why I stayed in school was because Roa had not disappeared.
Since Roa is a student here, it's more convenient for me to stay."
I would never go back while leaving you here.
Senpai said that with a smile.
That wasn't, for my sake.
She stayed here just to search for the still-living Roa.
That is the only reason why she gave me her phone number.

entries.japanese:
「――――は」
　じゃあ、あれも。
「はは―――」
　あの時のことも。
「はは――――は」
　あの夜、俺を救ってくれたのも。
「あ………は、は」
　あの、悲しそうな目も。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ha.”
Then that, too.
“Ha ha—”
That time as well.
“Ha ha—ha.”
That night, when she saved me.
“Ah… ha, ha.”
Even those sorrowful eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ha."
Then, that too.
"Haha---"
And those times, too.
"Haha----ha."
And when she saved me that one night, too.
"Ah……… ha, ha."
And, those sad eyes, too.

entries.japanese:
「はは――――は」
　……そうだ志貴、なんてコトはないじゃないか。
　こんな記憶―――きっと、どうというコトはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha ha—ha.”
…That’s right, Shiki. It was nothing. Memories like these couldn’t possibly mean a thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha---ha."
…… That's right, Shiki, this is nothing at all.
These memories---they are nothing at all.

entries.japanese:
ただ、愛してるって。
　愛されてるって、思っていただけの話。
　……まったくお笑いだ。
　そんなもの、芝居の上で作られた幻でしかなかった。
――――全部。
　全部、嘘でかためられた夢物語だっただけ――
entries.maoEnglish:
I had merely believed that I loved her.
That she loved me.
…What a joke.
It had been no more than an illusion manufactured for a performance.
――――All of it.
Nothing but a fairy tale built out of lies—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I just thought I loved her.
And that she loved me back.
…… What a joke.
They were all just an illusion made from a play.
----All of it.
All of it was a fairy tale made up of lies---

entries.japanese:
「―――納得いったよ。
けどさ、先輩。
　どうして先輩にはロアが生きているってわかるんだ。
どうして、どうして遠野志貴っていうヤツがロアの転生先だってわかったんだ」
「わかりますよ。
だって自分のことなんですから」
　しれっと、先輩は理解不能な事を言う。

もう、これ以上語る言葉もなければ、語る必要もないと。
　シエルの両腕が、あの『凶器』を持ち上げた。

第七聖典。
　輪廻転生を否定する教会が作り上げた、転生批判のあらゆる弾劾を記した教典。
　聖典でありながら外典、教典でありながら凶器という曰くつきの一品だ。
　アレに撃たれれば、魂そのものが霧散する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—All right. I understand. But tell me, Ciel.
How did you know Roa was still alive? How did you know that someone called Shiki Tohno was his reincarnation host?”
“Of course I knew. It concerns me personally, after all.” Ciel gave that incomprehensible answer with complete nonchalance.
There was nothing left to say and no reason to say it.
Ciel raised the weapon in both hands.
The Seventh Holy Scripture.
A holy text created by the Holy Church, which rejects reincarnation, and inscribed with every condemnation ever leveled against rebirth.
Holy scripture yet apocryphon, sacred teaching yet murder weapon—a relic with a dark and singular history.
If it shot me, my soul itself would scatter into mist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I understand.
But, Senpai.
How did you know Roa was still alive?
How, how did you know Roa reincarnated into this Tohno Shiki?"
"Of course I knew.
Because it's about myself." Senpai says something I can't understand.

As if saying there's no need to talk anymore,
Ciel's hands lift up that weapon.

The Seventh Holy Scripture.
The weapon that the reincarnation-denying Church created.
A scriptural canon inscribed with every possible impeachment of reincarnation criticism.
It's an item that is scripture yet an apocrypha.
A weapon, yet a scripture at the same time.
If I'm hit by that, my soul itself will disperse into nothingness.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　銃剣が跳ねあがる。
　その切っ先がこちらに走る。
　なぜか、ゆったりと。
　彼女なら―――シエルなら、俺が刺されたと気がつく間もないぐらいのスピードで、突き刺す事が出来るはずなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
The bayonet sprang up.
Its point swept toward me.
Slowly, for some reason.
She—Ciel—should have been able to drive it through me before I even realized I had been stabbed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
The bayonet rises up.
The tip comes towards me.
But slowly.
If it is Ciel---she should be able to pierce me without me even noticing it ever happened.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　考える余裕はない。
―――咄嗟に、体を前に倒した。
　後ろを向けば。
背中を見せれば、背後から心臓を穿たれると、さっきから感じていた。
「ひゃ――――！」
　ズン、と顔の真横を銃剣が通過していく。
　本当に、ゆっくりだ。
　俺は突き出された先輩の銃剣をかわして、そのまま彼女の真横へ出て、そのまま――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—” There was
no time to think.
―――I pitched forward on instinct.
All this time, I had known that if I turned and showed her my back, she would pierce my heart from behind.
“Hyah—!”
The bayonet drove past my cheek with a heavy rush.
It truly was slow.
I slipped past the thrust, came out beside her, and kept moving—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
There's no time to think.
---Instantly, I fall forward.
I felt from before that if I turned and ran, my heart would be shot from behind.
"Hya----!"
Her sword flies past my head.
It seems really slow.
I evade her attack, move right beside her, and----

entries.japanese:
「っ――――！」
　前に走りぬけようとした矢先、先輩の動きが一変した。
　一瞬、先輩の体が消えたと錯覚するぐらいのスピードで、彼女はあのバカでかい凶器を横に薙いだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Just as I tried to sprint past, her movement transformed.
With such speed that her body seemed to vanish, she swept that enormous weapon sideways.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
The instant I tried to run forward, Senpai's movement changed drastically.
In an instant, with a speed that makes her seem to have literally disappeared, she swings her weapon horizontally.

entries.japanese:
ゴオン、という風きり音が聞こえて俺は―――なぜか、彼女から何メートルも離れたところに立っていた。
「―――――――」
　チッ、と舌うちして先輩がこちらを睨む。
entries.maoEnglish:
The air boomed—and somehow I found myself standing several meters away from her.
“……”
Ciel clicked her tongue and glared at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The rush of the wind fills my ears---and for some reason, I am standing many meters away from her.
"-------"
She clicks her tongue and glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「痛っ……！」
　左腕が痛む。
「なん……えぇ――――！？」
　驚いた。
　肘から先、下腕部がものの見事に折れている。
　それも生半可な折れ方じゃなくて、腕が山形にひん曲がってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow…!”
My left arm hurt.
“What the hell—?!”
I stared.
From the elbow down, my forearm was spectacularly broken.
This was no simple fracture; my arm was bent into a sharp peak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ow……!"
My left arm hurts.
"What…… Huh-----!?"
I'm surprised.
From the elbow down, my arm is broken.
Not broken normally, but my lower arm is bent in the shape of a triangle.

entries.japanese:
「―――首を庇って腕一つですか。
何もしなければ、今ので楽にしてあげたのに」
「な――――」
　自分でも解らないけど、さっきの先輩の一撃を受けて腕がイッちまったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You saved your neck and lost only an arm.
Had you done nothing, that blow would have ended your pain.”
“Wh—” I didn’t understand it myself, but blocking her last strike had apparently destroyed my arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Sacrificing your arm to save your head?
If you didn't do anything, I would have ended it painlessly for you."
"Wha----"
Even though I didn't notice it, I must have broken my arm defending against her attack.

entries.japanese:
「ナイフ、抜かないんですか」
　つまらなそうに先輩は俺を見る。
　……見下してる。
　先輩は、俺をいつでも殺すコトができるって、見下している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aren’t you going to draw your knife?”
She regarded me with boredom.
…She was looking down on me,
certain she could kill me whenever she pleased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aren't you going to pull out your knife?"
She looks at me with a bored expression.
…… She's looking down at me.
She looks down at me as if saying she could kill me at any moment.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ……！」
　痛み。
腕の痛みが頭にきた。
　折れた腕の血が、そのまま毒になって脳髄に送り込まれたような痛み。
　ずきん、と。
　それだけで、意識に白いブランクができてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh…!”
Pain. The pain in my arm reached my head.
It felt as though the blood from the fracture had turned to poison and been pumped straight into my brain.
One throb.
That alone opened a white gap in my consciousness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gg……!"
Pain.
Pain shoots from my arm to my brain.
The blood from my broken arm seems to flow like poison into my nerves.
Sharply.
Just with that, my mind fills with a white blankness.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　先輩は、冷めた目で俺を眺めている。
「こ―――の」
　人の腕を折っておいてそれか。
　これがどのくらい痛いかわかっているのか。
　馬鹿にして。
　馬鹿にして。
　馬鹿にして―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
She watched me with cold, indifferent eyes.
“You—”
She had broken my arm, and this was how she looked at me?
Did she understand how much it hurt?
Mocking me.
Mocking me.
Mocking me—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
She continues to look at me with those cold eyes.
"You---!"
You break my arm, and you still act that way!?
Do you know how much this hurts!?
Making such a fool of me.
Making such a fool of me!
Making such a fool of me------!

entries.japanese:
「先輩が、その気なら――――」
　ポケットの中にあるナイフを握る。
「こっちだって、むざむざ――――」
　かつん、という硬い感触。
「殺されてやるつもりなんか、ない」
　バチン、という音をたてて。
　ナイフの刃を突き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If that’s how you want it—”
I closed my hand around the knife in my pocket.
“Then I’m not going to just stand here and—”
My fingers found the hard metal.
“—let you kill me.”
The blade sprang
out with a snap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If that's how you're going to be, Senpai----"
I grip the knife in my pocket.
"I'm not just going to stand here helplessly----"
The hard feeling of metal.
"--and let you kill me."
With a quick snap,
I take out the blade of my knife.

entries.japanese:
「―――馬鹿ですか、貴方は」
　瞬間。
　先輩の体が、爆ぜた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you an idiot?”
In that instant,
her body exploded.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Are you stupid?"
Instantly,
her body, explodes.

entries.japanese:
――――いや、それは違う。
　先輩はとても低く―――それこそトカゲみたいに地面スレスレに身をかがめて、俺の目の前まで、一瞬で走りこんできた。
　瞬きの間に、六メートルはある距離をつめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――No—that wasn’t it.
She had dropped almost flat to the ground, scuttling as low as a lizard, and crossed the distance to me in a single instant.
More than six meters vanished in the time it took to blink.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----No, that's not right.
She crouches down low to the ground---almost like a lizard, and runs up towards me in a flash.
She closes the distance of six meters in a flash.

entries.japanese:
こっちの視界にはいない。
　先輩の体は俺の膝下よりさらに下にあって、目の前で、爆ぜた。
　ドン、という音。
　ほぼ真下から突き上げられる先輩の銃剣は、惚れ惚れするぐらいの正確さで俺の喉のあたりを串刺しにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
She disappeared from my field of vision.
Her body dropped below my knees, almost against the floor—and exploded upward before me.
Boom.
Rising from almost directly below, her bayonet drove with breathtaking accuracy through the flesh near my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She's not in my vision at all.
Her whole body is below my knee-height, and explodes upward from there.
A thud.
From right beneath me, her bayonet accurately shoots directly for my throat.

entries.japanese:
「が―――――あ」
　息、息がもれる。
　痛みは、痛みはあるか？
　ある、まだ痛いって感じられる。
「は―――――う」
　意識、意識は？
　よし、まだなんとかそれなりに。
「あ、ああああああ…………！」
　体、体は――――どうか、してるか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gah—ah.”
Breath—my breath leaks out.
Pain—was there pain? Yes, I could still feel it.
“Hah—uh.”
My consciousness—was it intact? Good, more or less.
“A-aaaaah…!”
My body—what had happened to my body?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ga----ah!"
I gasp.
Pain, is there pain?
Yes, I can still feel pain.
"Ha-----ugh."
Conscious, am I conscious?
Alright, I still have that.
"A, aaaaaa…………!"
My body.
My body----is not okay.

entries.japanese:
どぷどぷという音。
　それは俺の左肩からしている。
　見れば、そこはもう血の滝だ。
どくどくと血が流れている。
　たった今。
　先輩の銃剣が、俺の喉をそれて左肩を突き刺したんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
A thick, wet gushing.
It was coming from my left shoulder.
When I looked, there was a waterfall of blood. It pulsed out in heavy surges.
Just now.
Ciel’s bayonet had missed my throat and punched through my left shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A dripping sound.
It's coming from my left shoulder.
Looking at it, it's already a waterfall of blood, which pours straight down.
Just now.
The bayonet didn't hit my throat, but my left shoulder.

entries.japanese:
「あ、ああ、ああああああああ！」
　イタイ。
　イタイとかそういう問題じゃないぐらい、イタイ。
「はあ、あああ、あぐぐぐぐぐぐ――――――！」
　でも、生きている。
　なんとか生きてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah… aaaaaaaaaah!”
It hurt.
It hurt beyond anything the word pain could describe.
“Hah—aaah—nghhhh—!”
But I was alive.
Somehow, I was still alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A, Aa, Aaaaaaah!"
It hurts.
It hurts so much the word pain doesn't come close to describing it.
"Haa, aaa, aggggg------!"
But, I'm alive.
Still, I'm alive.

entries.japanese:
体。
体は、また先輩から離れている。
　肩にはかすかな火薬の匂い。
「あ、ああ、あ」
　さっき。
あの銃剣が突き刺さった瞬間、引き金をひかれたんだ。
　それで俺は吹っ飛んで、また先輩と距離が離れてくれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
My body was once again some distance from her.
A faint odor of gunpowder clung to my shoulder.
“Ah… ah, ah.”
The instant the bayonet pierced me, she had pulled the trigger.
The shot hurled me backward and opened the distance between us again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My body.
My body is away from her again.

I smell a whiff of gunpowder from my shoulder.
"A, Aah, ah."
Just now.
The instant that bayonet pierced me, she must have pulled the trigger.
I was blown away by that, and there's distance between us again.

entries.japanese:
「……二度続く、という事は偶然じゃないですね。
その出血でもショック死しないという事は、身体の変化は始まっている、という事ですか」
　ジャコン、という音。
　あの凶器の切っ先の剣が新しいものに代わる。
　今さっき俺を撃った剣は落ちて、そのまま―――パラパラと本のページになって散っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Twice in a row cannot be coincidence. If even that much blood loss did not send you into fatal shock, does that mean your body has begun to change?”
The weapon clacked.
A fresh blade replaced the one at its point.
The sword that had just shot me fell away, then fluttered apart into the pages of a book.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… To happen twice, that must mean it's not a coincidence.
With that much blood pouring out, not dying from shock must already be a sign that your body has begun to change."
Ga-chang!
A metallic sound.
The sword on the end of that weapon changes into a new one.
The sword that shot me just now falls---and turns into pages of a book and scatters.

entries.japanese:
「……で……デタラメ、だ」
　でも、そのデタラメなものがとても恐い。
　アレは―――ただ、この体に触れるだけで致死性の毒を持つ。
　死。
　死ぬ。
　間違いなく、殺される。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Th—That’s nonsense.”
Yet that impossible weapon terrified me.
A mere touch from it would be fatal to this body.
Death.
I would die.
She was unquestionably going to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's…… ridiculous."
But that ridiculous thing is really frightening.
That---just touching me carries a fatal poison.
Death.
I'll die.
Without a doubt, I'll be killed.

entries.japanese:
死ぬのか。
　それが恐いのか。
　わからない。
「あ、く………っ！」
　肩が燃えている。
　熱くて熱くて、このまま全身が焼かれてしまいそうなほどの灼熱。
entries.maoEnglish:
Was I going to die?
Was that what frightened me?
I didn’t know.
“Ah… ngh…!”
My shoulder was burning.
The heat was so fierce it seemed ready to consume my entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Will I die?
Is that what I'm scared of?
I don't know.
"Ah, gg………!"
My shoulder is burning.
Hot, it's so hot, as if my entire body will burst into flames.

entries.japanese:
かちゃり、と先輩があの凶器を構えなおす。
　……二回。
　二回もアレをなんとか出来たのは、奇跡以外の何物でもない。
　次は間違いなく――――
entries.maoEnglish:
She readied the weapon with another metallic click.
Twice.
Surviving it twice had been nothing short of a miracle.
The next time, without question—
entries.mirrorMoon:
She readies her weapon once more with another metallic clang.
…… Twice.
Withstanding that twice can be nothing but a miracle.
The next time will certainly----

entries.japanese:
あの銃剣が俺の顔の真ん中にささって、そのままえぐりこむ姿を想像した。
　それは恐いというよりおぞましい。
　死は。
　それがどんなカタチであれ、無様で、汚くて、おぞましいもの。
　俺は自分が好きだから―――そんな目にはあいたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I imagined the bayonet sinking into the center of my face and gouging its way deeper.
The image filled me with revulsion more than fear.
Death.
Whatever shape it took, it was ugly, filthy, and revolting.
I liked myself—that was why I did not want it to happen to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I imagine that bayonet piercing me right in the face.
That's more repulsive than frightening.
Death is.
No matter how it happens, something useless, dirty, and disgusting.
I like myself---so I don't want that to happen.

entries.japanese:
だから恐いのか。
　わからない。
　思えば―――俺はあれだけ『死』を視ておきながら、『死』というものをまったく考えたことがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Was that why I was afraid?
I didn’t know.
Come to think of it, though I had seen so much “death,” I had never once thought about what death itself meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Is that why I'm scared?
I don't know.
Come to think of it---I was always able to see "death", but I never thought about "death" at all.

entries.japanese:
いや、そんなコト、今はどうでもいい。
「はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　逃げないと。
　死にたくないんだから、今は逃げないと。
「――メガネ、取らないんですか」
　プラスティックな、簡素な声。
　その言葉。
その意味にハッとした。
　だってメガネを外すっていうことは、先輩の『線』を視るということだ。
　そんなコトになれば、俺は先輩を殺してしまうかもしれない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
No—none of that mattered now.
“Hah, hah, hah—”
I had to run.
I did not want to die, so I had to run now.
“Aren’t you going to remove your glasses?”
Her voice was flat and artificial.
Those words. Their meaning struck me all at once.
Removing my glasses meant seeing her “lines.”
And if I did that, I might kill her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
No, that doesn't really matter right now.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
I have to escape.
I don't want to die, so I have to get away.
"--You won't take off your glasses?"
A simple, plastic voice.
Those words.
I gasp at their meaning.
Because taking them off means I would see Senpai's "lines".
If that happens, I might kill her----

entries.japanese:
「な――なにを、言うんですか、先輩は……！」
「―――――――」
　ぞくり、と。
　大気が燃え立つかのような、殺気。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh-what are you saying, Ciel…?!”
“……”
A chill.
Her bloodlust seemed to set the air itself ablaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha--What are you, saying, Senpai……!?"
"-------"
A chill runs through me.
The air suddenly becomes saturated with a murderous intent.

entries.japanese:
「……つきあってられません。
いいですから、もう死んでください」
　先輩の姿勢が低くなる。
　―――来る。
　また走りこんでくるってわかってるけど、俺には先輩の姿を視認することさえ難しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve had enough of this. Please, just die.”
She lowered her stance.
―――She was coming.
I knew she would rush me again, yet even seeing her move was nearly beyond me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't spend any more time with you.
Please just die already."
Her figure plunges low again.
---She's coming.
Even though I know she's going to run towards me again, it's hard for me to even see her.

entries.japanese:
―――逃げる以外、考えつかない。
　殺されたくないなら―――もう逃げるしか手段がない。
　幸い、距離は十メートル近く離れている。
このまま全力で走れば、校舎の中ぐらいには逃げられる。
　こんなまったいらな所じゃなく、校舎の中ならなんとかなるかもしれない―――！
「――――――」
　背中。
　背中に、何か―――刺さって、る。
「痛――――い」
　どさり、と体が前のめりに倒れた。
　あと少し。
　あと少しで、校舎の中に、入れたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I could think of nothing but escape.
If I didn’t want to die, running was the only choice left.
Nearly ten meters separated us. At a full sprint, I might at least reach the school building. Inside, with walls and corridors instead of this empty field, I might have a chance—!
“—!” Something was stuck in my back.
Something had…
pierced me. “It…
hurts.”
My body toppled forward.
Just a little farther.
I had almost reached the building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I can only think of escaping.
If I don't want to be killed---escape is my only option.
Fortunately, our distance is almost ten meters.
If I run as fast as I can, I can make it to the school building.
Maybe I might be able to do something if I can get into a less open space-----!
"------"
My back.
Something----pierced, my back.
"Aa----ah."
My body falls forward.
Just a little more.
And it was just a little more before I could enter the school building.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――――」
　片手で体を立ちあがらせる。
　背中に刺さったのは、先輩が以前に使っていた釘のような剣だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—!”
I pushed myself up with one hand.
The object in my back was one of the nail-like swords she had used before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kk-----"
I lift myself up with one arm.
What sticks through me is one of those swords that looks like a nail that Senpai was using before.

entries.japanese:
「こ――――の………！」
　痛みなんて麻痺しているのか、背中に刺さった剣を引きぬいた。
　……体を貫通していたから、頭にきて胸の方から抜いてやった。
「よし………！」
　これで、校舎の中に逃げられる……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“You… bastard…!”
Perhaps pain had ceased to mean anything, because I pulled the sword out.
It had passed clean through me, so in my fury I dragged it the rest of the way out through my chest.
“Good…”
Now I could escape into the building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why----you………!
I must be numbed to pain, and I pull out the sword skewering my back from behind.
…… Since it penetrated through me, I got mad and pulled it out from my chest.
"Alright………!"
Now I can escape inside……!

entries.japanese:
「逃げてどうするつもりですか、遠野くん」
　その前に。
　後ろから、先輩の声がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And what do you intend to accomplish by running, Tohno?”
Before I could move,
her voice came from behind me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you plan on doing by escaping, Tohno-kun?"
Before that,
I hear Senpai's voice from behind me.

entries.japanese:
「まだ解らないんですか。
貴方はいま、校庭からここまでどのくらいの速さで走ったと思っているんです。
本来なら致命傷である傷を受けて、どうして死なないでいるんです」
entries.maoEnglish: “Do you still not understand? How quickly do you think you crossed the distance from the athletic field to here? Why are you still alive after suffering wounds that should have been fatal?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You still don't understand?
How fast do you think you just ran here?
Why are you still alive after receiving that fatal wound?"

entries.japanese:
「や―――――――」
　意識が、白くなる。
　騙されるな。
　騙されるな。
　その女にはずっと騙されてきたじゃないか。
　もうあいつの言葉になんて耳を貸すな。
　聞けばそのまま死に至る。
　無視しろ。
　受け入れるな。
　それが真実だろうと、もう跳ね除けるしかないんだ、この体は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—” My consciousness whitened.
Don’t be fooled.
Don’t be fooled.
That woman has deceived you all along.
Stop listening to her.
Hear her out and it will lead directly to death.
Ignore her.
Reject it.
Even if she speaks the truth,
this body has no choice now but to cast it aside—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"St-------"
My mind begins to white out.
Don't let her trick you.
Don't let her trick you.
Hasn't she been deceiving you all along?
Don't listen to her anymore.
If you listen, you'll die.
Ignore her.
Don't accept it.
Even if it is the truth, this body can only reject it---

entries.japanese:
「――――やめ、ろ」
「もう、何処にも逃げ場なんてないんです。
　貴方には戦うか殺されるかの道しかない。
けれど戦う事ができないのなら、あとはもう死ぬしかないでしょう」
　かつかつと。
　足音をたてて、先輩がやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop…”
“There is nowhere left for you to run.
You have only two choices: fight or be killed. If you cannot fight, then all that remains is death.”
Click by measured click.
She approached.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Stop, it."
"Geez, there's nowhere for you to run to.
You can only fight or be killed.
But if you can't fight, you can only die."
Her footsteps.
With the sound of footsteps, Senpai approaches.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――！」
　跳ねた。
　背中も、肩も、腕もほとんど死んでいるっていうのに、そんなものは瑣末なことのように、体が跳ねた。
―――自分でも、信じられない。
　俺は荒い息遣いのまま、先輩に負けないぐらいの速さで、校舎の中へと走りこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My body sprang.
My back, shoulder, and arm were nearly dead, yet it leapt as if such injuries were trivial.
―――I could scarcely believe it myself.
Breathing raggedly, I raced into the school building at a speed nearly equal to hers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------!"
I leap.
My back, my shoulders, my arm are all almost dead, but I leap as if it was nothing.
---I can't even believe it myself.
Still breathing wildly and with a speed that matches Senpai, I run into the school building.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　走った。
