　何も考えずに、ただ、何かから逃げたくて走り続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah—” I ran.
Without thought,
wanting only to escape from something, I kept running.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
I run.
Without thinking, just wanting to escape, I continue running.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　それも限界。
　息があがってしまったのか、体の傷がひどくて手足がもう動かないのか。
　そんなもの、どっちだってあまり大差はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah—”
At last I reached my limit.
Maybe I had run out of breath; maybe my wounds had finally robbed my limbs of movement.
There was little difference between them now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*-----
But I'm at my limit.
Is it because I'm out of breath or is it that my wounds won't let me move my arms and legs anymore?
Whatever it is, it doesn't matter.

entries.japanese:
「はっ……はっ……はっ――――――」
　廊下の突き当たり。
　もう道のない壁につきあたって、倒れこんだ。
　あお向けに倒れて、起きあがろうと手足に力をこめて、馬鹿らしくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah—”
I reached the end of the corridor.
I struck the wall where the path ended and collapsed.
Flat on my back, I tried to force strength into my limbs, then realized how absurd that was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My breathing becomes more forced.
At the end of the hallway.
Coming onto a wall aimlessly, I fall.
I fall on my back, and try to get back up, and feel foolish for doing so.

entries.japanese:
「……はっ……はっ……は」
　床にあぐらをかくように座り込んで、そのまま壁に背中をあずける。
　膝をたてて、顔をのけぞらせて、大きく息を吸った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah.”
I sat slumped on the floor with my legs loosely crossed and rested my back against the wall.
I drew up my knees, tipped my face back, and took a deep breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… *pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
Sitting cross-legged on the floor, I lean my back against the wall.
Throwing back my head, I take a big breath of air.

entries.japanese:
「―――――月」
　見上げれば、窓からは月明かりがうかがえた。
　疲れているせいだろうか。
　なんだか目に見えるものすべてに靄がかかったように、虚ろに見える。
　虚ろ。
　それは不確かという事か。
　俺と同じで。
遠野志貴という人間と同じで、不確か。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—The moon.”
Moonlight shone through the window above me.
Perhaps it was exhaustion.
Everything I could see looked hollow, blurred beneath a veil of mist.
Hollow.
Did that mean uncertain?
As uncertain as I was. As uncertain as the person named Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----The moon."
Looking up, I can see the moonlight through the window.
Is it because I'm so exhausted?
Everything I look at seems vague, as if everything was covered in a mist.
Vagueness.
Does that mean it is indefinite?
The same as me.
The same as the person called Tohno Shiki, indefinite.

entries.japanese:
「……い……た………」
　ずきりと肩が痛んだ。
　自分がこの痛みぐらい確かなものだったら、こんな事にはならなかったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Hur… ts…”
My shoulder throbbed.
If only I had been as solid and certain as this pain, would any of this have happened?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ou…… ch……"
My shoulder throbs in pain.
If I was as definite as this pain, maybe this wouldn't have happened?

entries.japanese:
よく、わからなくなってきた。
　自分はずっと遠野志貴だと思って生きてきた。
　けどそいつは別にいて、俺は、どこの誰とも知らない養子だという。
　養子という事は遠野の屋敷に来る前の記憶があるはずなのに、そんなものはまったくない。
　俺は。
本当に、遠野志貴としての記憶しかもっていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I no longer understood.
I had lived my entire life believing I was Shiki Tohno.
But apparently there was another Shiki, and I was an adopted child of unknown origin.
An adopted child should have memories from before entering the Tohno household, yet I had none.
I truly possessed no memories except those of Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I'm starting to not understand.
I always thought I was Tohno Shiki.
But that was a different person, and they tell me I'm just an adopted son from somewhere.
Being adopted means I should have memories of before I came to the Tohno mansion, but there's nothing.
I…… really, I only have the memories of Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
夜空には、ただ独りきりの月がある。
「――――」
　すごく、不思議だ。
　どうしていままで気がつかなかったのか。
　今夜はこんなにも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
The moon hung utterly alone in the night sky.
“……”
How strange.
Why had I never noticed before?
Tonight was so—
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the night sky is the solitary moon.
"----"
It's incredibly… strange.
Why didn't I realize it until now?
Tonight is so---

entries.japanese:
……結局、俺はなんだったんだろう。
　自分の事なんて何一つ知らないまま、あげくには自分そのものがなくなろうとしているなんて、馬鹿げてる。
　なにもかもぼんやりしていて、馬鹿げてる。
　死の見える世界。
　死が視える視界。
　八年前のあの日。
　俺は先生に出会えて、こうしてマトモに生きてこれた。
　アレは正しい出会いだったと、今でも断言できる。
entries.maoEnglish:
…In the end, what had I ever been?
I knew nothing about myself, and now even that self was about to disappear. It was ridiculous.
Everything was indistinct and absurd.
A world where death could be seen.
Eyes that saw death.
That day eight years ago.
I met the woman who taught me how to live, and because of her I had managed a normal life.
Even now, I could say without doubt that meeting her had been right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… In the end, just what was I?
It's stupid not knowing anything about myself and just disappearing like this.
Everything is so vague, it's stupid.
A world where I can see death.
A vision where I can perceive death.
That day eight years ago.
I was able to meet Sensei and was able to live normally.
I can still declare that it was proper to meet her.

entries.japanese:
「……けど先生。
俺は、生きてちゃいけない、人間だったみたい、だ」
　……まだそう思える自分がいるうちに、自らの命を絶つべきなんだろう。
　でも出来ない。
　自殺なんかできない。
　たとえ無様でも、間違っていても、生きていたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……But it seems I was someone who never should have been allowed to live.”
Perhaps I ought to end my life while enough of me remained to believe that.
But I couldn’t.
I could not kill myself.
However wretched or mistaken my life might be, I had lived it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, Sensei.
I, guess I, was someone, who shouldn't be alive."
…… I should end my life while some part of me can still think that.
But I can't do it.
I can't kill myself.
Even if it is pointless, even if it is a mistake, I want to keep on living.

entries.japanese:
死んだら何もかも嘘になる。
　生きていたい。
　どんなに間違っていて、色々なものをなくしてしまうとしても、生きていたい。
　あの人さえ。
　シエル先輩さえいてくれれば、あとは、何を無くしたってかまわなかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
If I died, everything would become a lie.
I wanted to live.
No matter how wrong I was, no matter how much I might lose, I wanted to live.
If only I still had her.
If only Ciel had remained beside me, I would not have cared what else I lost.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I die, everything will become a lie.
I want to keep on living.
No matter how wrong it is, no matter how many things I have to lose, I want to keep on living.
Only her.
If only I had Ciel-senpai with me.
I wouldn't care what else I had to lose.

entries.japanese:
かつん、かつん、という足音が聞こえてくる。
　……彼女がやってくる。
「…………闘うしか、ないのか」
　呟いて、ゾッとした。
　俺には先輩と戦う事なんてできない。
　呟いたのだって、なんとなく口にしただけだ。
　なのに、バラせ、と。
　頭の中、脳髄の芯から、脳漿に染み渡るように、同じコトバが繰り返される。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hear approaching footsteps—click, click.
—She is coming.
“……Do I have no choice but to fight?”
The words left me shuddering.
I could never fight her.
I had spoken only because the thought happened to enter my head.
Yet a command began repeating from the core of my brain,
soaking through the marrow of my mind: Cut her apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can hear her footsteps.
…… She's coming.
"……………… Can I only fight?"
Mumbling, I feel a chill.
I can't do such a thing as fight Senpai.
I said that out loud just on a whim.
But, "Slice her apart".
From in my head, from deep inside my brain, as if trying to seep itself into my mind, the same words keep repeating over and over.

entries.japanese:
バラセ。
バラセ。
バラセ。
バラセ。
　生き残りたいのならバラせ。
　死にたくないのならバラせ。
　おまえを騙したヤツをバラせ。
　おまえを殺そうとするヤツをバラせ。
　いいからともかく―――オレの邪魔をするヤツをバラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラせ。
バラセ、バラセ、バラセ、バラセ、バラセ、バラセ、バラセバラセバラセバラセバラセバラ、セ、バラ、セ、バラ、バラ、バラ、バラ、バラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラバラ―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART.
If you want to survive, cut her apart.
If you don’t want to die, cut her apart.
Cut apart the one who deceived you.
Cut apart the one trying to kill you.
Forget why—cut apart anyone who stands in my way. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART. CUT HER APART, CUT HER APART, CUT HER APART, CUT HER APART, CUT HER APART, CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT—APART—CUT—APART—CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT CUT—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
If you want to stay alive, slice her apart.
If you don't want to die, slice her apart.
Slice apart the person who deceived you.
Slice apart the person trying to kill you.
Just do it already---slice apart the person getting in my way.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
SliceSliceSliceSliceSliceSlice, Slice, apart, slice, apart, slice, slice, slice, slice, sliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslicesliceslice-----!!

entries.japanese:
「黙れぇっっっっっっ！！！！」
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
「うる……さいんだよ、さっきからおまえは……！」
―――はあ……はあ、はあ。
　……頭痛が薄れる。
　声が聞こえなくなる。
　けど、そのかわりに。
　今の絶叫で、先輩は俺がここにいるって気付いただろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHUT UUUUUUP!!!!”
―――Hah, hah, hah.
“You’ve been… screaming in my head this whole time…!”
―――Hah… hah, hah.
…The headache faded.
The voice fell silent.
But my scream had surely
told her where I was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shuuuuut Uuuuup!!!!!!"
---*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
"Shut…… up, you're always……!"
---*pant*…… *pant*, *pant*.
…… My headache thins.
I can't hear that voice anymore.
But, in place of that,
Now, Senpai probably knows where I am because of my scream.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　ぎゅっ、とナイフを強く握り締める。
―――戦うのか。
　あの人と殺シ合ウのか。
　……よく、考えがまとまらない。
　俺の神経は、もうとっくに磨耗して焼き切れようとしている。
　アルクェイドに襲われて、あいつの首を切断して。
なんとか逃げ出してみれば、そこにはシエルが待っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I tightened my grip on the knife.
―――Was I going to fight?
Was I going to k i l l her while she k i l l e d me?
…I could no longer think clearly.
My nerves had long since worn through and were beginning to burn out.
Arcueid had attacked me, and I had cut her throat. I had somehow escaped, only to find Ciel waiting for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I grip my knife strongly.
---Are you going to fight?
Have a fight to the death with that person?
…… I can't think clearly.
My nerves feel numb, as if they were burned off a long time ago.
I fought Arcueid and sliced her neck.
I somehow managed to escape, but Ciel was waiting for me.

entries.japanese:
「は……はは、は」
　少し、呆れる。
　いくらなんでも、こんなのはない。
　逃げても逃げても、その先で最悪の状況が待っているなんて笑い話だ。
　俺はいつから―――こんな、救いのない道に迷いこんでしまったんだろう―――
「あ―――ぐ…………！」
　ナイフを突き刺すような、頭痛。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha… haha, ha.”
It was almost astonishing.
This was too much, even for a joke.
Every escape led me into a still worse nightmare.
When had I wandered onto a road so utterly without salvation?
“Ah—guh…!”
A headache like a knife driven through my skull.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha…… haha, ha."
It's a little disappointing.
I never thought it would be like this.
I escape and escape, but a worse situation awaits me.
It's like a joke.
Since when did I---get lost on this hopeless path----
"Ah---gg……………!"
The headache runs through me like a knife through my brain.

entries.japanese:
「は…………ぁ、あ―――――」
　うまく呼吸ができない。
　視界がぐらぐらとゆらいでいく。
　……本当に、俺はここまでみたいだ。
　また頭の中がぐちゃぐちゃになりはじめた。
　それでも俺は死にたくない。
　死にたくないんなら―――やる事は一つだけ。
　かつん、かつんと足音が大きくなってくる。
　先輩の影が伸びてくる。
―――メガネ、取らないんですか。
　それが何を意味するかわかっていながら、彼女はそう言っていた。
　ならば。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… ah…”
I couldn’t breathe properly.
My vision pitched and swayed.
…This really seemed to be the end of me.
My thoughts were dissolving into chaos again.
Yet I did not want to die.
And if I wanted to live, there was only one thing left to do.
The approaching footsteps grew louder.
Her shadow stretched toward me.
―――Aren’t you going to remove your glasses?
She had said it knowing exactly what it meant.
In that case—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha…………… a, ah------"
I can't breathe properly.
My vision wavers.
…… It looks like I'm really done.
My head starts to rage again.
But still, I don't want to die.
If I don't want to die---there's only one thing to do.
The footsteps get louder.
Her shadow grows larger.
---Aren't you going to take off your glasses?
Even knowing what it meant, she said that.
In that case.

entries.japanese:
―――――すべて。
　　　　　みんな、幻になってしまえば、いい。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Everything.
Let it all—let everyone—fade into illusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Everything.
All of it should turn into illusion.

entries.japanese:
ナイフを強く握って、立ちあがる。
　足音が大きくなっていく。
　敵が近づいてくる確かな気配。
　その度に頭の中に響いてくる、誰かの声。
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
entries.maoEnglish:
I clench the knife and force myself to my feet.
The footsteps swell.
The enemy is coming closer; I can feel it beyond doubt.
And with every step, someone’s voice rings through my skull.
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
entries.mirrorMoon:
I stand up as I strongly grip my knife.
The footsteps get even louder.
I sense the enemy coming closer.
All the time, someone's voice echoes in my brain.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――」
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ
　バラせ　バラせ　バラせ　バラ――――
「黙れ」
　強く意思を保って、頭の中を黙らせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART
CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER APART CUT HER—
“Shut up.”
I seize hold of my own will and silence the voice in my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.
Slice her apart.

"U----"
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart
Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart  Slice her apart----
"Shut up."
Using my willpower, I force the voice in my head to be quiet.

entries.japanese:
「これは、俺が決めた事だ」
　バ――――
「オマエに指図される謂れはない」
　ラ――――
「シエルに殺されたくないのなら」
　せ――――
「終わるまで黙ってろ、ロア」
　―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is my decision.”
Cut—
“You don’t get to tell me what to do.”
her—
“If you don’t want Ciel to kill you—”
up— “then keep your mouth shut until this is over,
Roa.”
―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is, what I decided."
Slice----
"I don't need you to tell me what to do."
her----
"If you don't want to be killed by Ciel."
apart----
"Just shut up until it's over, Roa."
-----

entries.japanese:
声は完全に消えた。
　かつん、という足音と、伸びてくる影。
　―――シエルが、俺の前に現れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The voice vanishes completely.
A sharp click of a heel; a shadow reaching toward me.
―――Then Ciel steps into view.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice disappears completely.
The footsteps, and her approaching shadow.
----Ciel appears before me.

entries.japanese:
「―――ようやく戦う気になったんですね」
　なぜか、安堵するような声で彼女は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you’ve finally decided to fight.”
For some reason, she sounds relieved.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---You finally decided to fight."
Her voice seems almost relieved.

entries.japanese:
「良かった。
これでお互いに罪はありません。
　互いに殺し合うという条件なら、わたしたちの罪は相殺されます。
あとは、生き残った者に罰が残るだけです」
　……お互いが殺しあおうというのなら罪はないというのか。
　それは、俺には理解できない世界の話だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good. Now neither of us will be guilty.
If we agree to kill one another, our sins cancel each other out. Only the survivor will be left to bear the punishment.”
If both of us intend to kill, neither of us is guilty?
She is speaking of a world I cannot understand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's good.
Now there is no sin for either of us.
Now that we are both trying to kill each other, our sin will die.
Now there is only punishment for the one who lives."
…… Since we are both trying to kill each other there is no sin?
Her words are part of a world I can't understand.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
なら、残ったほうの罰っていうのは、償えるものなのか」
「ええ。
果たすことのできる代償行為を罰というんです。
罰と名のつくものなら償えない道理はない。
　消えさってくれないものは罪だけです。
　ですから―――お互いそんなもの、いまさら背負いたくはないでしょう？」
　言って。
　一歩、彼女は踏みこんでくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then can the survivor ever atone for that punishment?”
“Yes. A punishment is an act of restitution that can be carried out. Nothing that truly deserves the name can be beyond atonement.
Sin alone refuses to disappear.
So—neither of us wishes to shoulder any more sin now, do we?”
With that, she advances one step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then is that punishment for the one that's left alive atoneable?"
"Yes.
Something that is atoneable is what we call punishment.
If it is called punishment, there is no reason for it not to be atoneable.
The only thing that does not disappear is the sin.
So---we don't want to carry that burden, do we?"
Saying that,
she takes another step forward.

entries.japanese:
「――それじゃあ、ここで先輩を殺す事は罪じゃないのか」
「はい。
わたしは貴方を殺します。
だから貴方もわたしを殺していい。
条件は同じです」
　さらに、一歩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then killing you here wouldn’t be a sin?”
“Correct. I am going to kill you. So you are free to kill me. We stand on equal terms.”
Another step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Then, killing you here isn't a sin, Senpai?"
"Yes.
I will kill you, so it is okay for you to kill me, Tohno-kun.
Our conditions are equal."
Another step.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　それは、違う。
　たしかに俺は殺されようとしていて、自分の命を守るために殺し返そうとしている。
　それに罪がないというのなら―――シエルはどうなるのか。
　彼女は初めから片思いの殺人意思を持ってやってきた。
　それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
No—that isn’t right.
She is trying to kill me, and I am trying to kill her in defense of my own life.
But if that leaves me innocent—what does it make Ciel?
She came here with a murderous intent that was hers alone from the very beginning.
Which means—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
That's, not right.
Certainly I am getting killed, so I'm killing her back to protect my own life.
But to say there's no sin---what would happen to Ciel?
From the beginning, she came here with an unrequited will to kill.
That is---

entries.japanese:
「さよなら。
これで、くだらなかった芝居に幕を下ろしましょう」
　最後の一歩。
　彼女の銃剣が構えられて、そのきっさきが俺の心臓に向けられる。
　その前に。
　ただ無造作に前に乗り出して、彼女の右肺の『点』を狙った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye. Let us bring this ridiculous play to an end.”
Her final step.
She levels her gun-blade, its point aimed straight at my heart.
Before she can strike,
I pitch forward almost carelessly and aim for the “point” in her right lung.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Farewell.
Let us lower the curtain on this ridiculous play."
The last step.
Her readied bayonet shoots toward my heart.
Before then,
I lunge forward and aim for the "point" on her right lung.

entries.japanese:
―――殺せるとは、思っていなかった。
　こちらのナイフが届く間合いに踏みこむより先に、彼女の銃剣が俺の心臓を貫くのは道理だ。
　だから、驚いた。
　俺はあっさりと銃剣をかわして、トン、とあっけなく彼女の『点』を刺せたから。
「――――先、輩」
　彼女はわざと、俺のナイフを受け入れたように、見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I never thought I could kill her.
By every right, her gun-blade should pierce my heart before I can step within reach of her.
That is why I’m so shocked.
I slip past the weapon with absurd ease, then tap my knife into her “point” as if it were nothing.
“Ci…el.”
It looks as though she accepted my knife on purpose.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I didn't think I could kill her.
It's only natural for her to pierce my heart before I get within knife range.
That's why I was surprised.
I easily dodged her blade and was able to pierce her "point" with ease.
"----Sen, pai."
It looked like she accepted my knife on purpose.

entries.japanese:
「貴方に、わたしを殺させて、しまった」
　死に至る前の、弱々しい声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I made you… kill me.”
Her voice is frail, poised on the brink of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I made you… kill… me."
Her faint, weak voice on the verge of death.

entries.japanese: 「それが、一番大きな、わたしの罪でした」
entries.maoEnglish: “That was… the greatest of my sins.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "That was, my, greatest sin."

entries.japanese: 泣くような声をあげて、彼女は最後の力をふりしぼって、俺の胸に、銃剣をつきたてた。
entries.maoEnglish: With a sound like a sob, she gathers the last of her strength and drives the gun-blade into my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon: Sounding like she's crying, she uses her remaining strength to stab me with her bayonet.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ご、ふ」
　破壊された心臓から、血液が逆流する。
　喉からこみあげてくる血液を吐き出して、廊下に倒れこんだ。
　目の前には。
　俺より少し前に絶命した、彼女の体が倒れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ghh.”
Blood surges backward from my ruined heart.
I vomit the blood welling into my throat and crumple onto the corridor floor.
Before my eyes.
Her body lies there—she died only moments before I will.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ga, hu."
My blood flow reverses through my lanced heart.
Coughing up blood, I collapse onto the ground.
Before my eyes,
the body of the one who died slightly ahead of me lies on the floor.

entries.japanese:
「――――なんて」
　わかって、いたのか。
「――――愚か、な」
　初めから―――罪があるとしたら自分にだけだって、わかって、いたのか、あなたは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How could you…”
You knew?
“You… fool.”
Did you know from the start that if either of us bore any guilt, it belonged to you alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----How--"
Did you, know?
"----foolish."
Did you know from the beginning---that if there was such a thing as sin, it would only be for you?

entries.japanese:
「はっ――――あ」
　手足の感覚がなくなっていく。
　意識も。
血液の供給が途絶えて、あと数秒と保つまい。
　あの銃剣で刺された瞬間。
　自分の中で、何か古い本のようなモノが、ページを撒き散らして消えていくイメージがあった。
　おそらく。
それで、ロアと呼ばれたモノは霧散したのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah.”
Feeling drains from my limbs.
My consciousness follows.
With the blood supply cut off, it cannot last more than a few seconds.
At the instant her gun-blade struck me, I saw something within myself like an ancient book, scattering its pages as it vanished.
Perhaps. Then that was Roa dispersing into nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah."
The sensation in my limbs fades away.
My consciousness, too.
It will be seconds before I bleed to death.
The instant I was stabbed,
I had a vision of something like an old book, scattering and crumbling away page by page.
Probably, with that, the thing called Roa was dispersed.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　何も思い浮かばない。
　彼女が初めから、自分の命と引き換えに俺を殺そうとしたこと。
　それがせめてもの罰だと思ったのか。
―――バカげてる。
　そんなもの―――何の意味も、ない。
「―――それでも」
　俺に謝ることなく死んだのは、悲しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Nothing comes to mind.
From the very beginning, she had meant to kill me at the cost of her own life.
Did she believe that would serve as some small punishment?
―――Absurd.
It means nothing. Nothing at all.
“Even so…”
It hurts that she died without ever apologizing to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I can't think.
From the very beginning, she planned to give her life to take mine.
Did she think that was her punishment?
---How foolish.
There's no---meaning in that.
"---Still."
I was sad that she died before she apologized to me.

entries.japanese:
ごめんなさい、と言ってくれれば、それで彼女の気持ちも少しは救われただろうに。
……この人は、それさえ口にできなかったのか。
　謝って償える事じゃないって解っていたから、彼女は最後まで謝らなかった。
　その決意。
そこまで追いこんだのが自分だという事が、頭にくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
If she had only said she was sorry, perhaps it would have brought her some small measure of peace. But she could not even permit herself that.
Knowing an apology could never repay what she had done, she refused to offer one even at the end.
That resolve of hers—and the knowledge that I drove her to it—makes me furious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If she could have apologized to me, then I bet she would have felt some relief…… But, she couldn't even say that.
Since she knew it was something that wasn't atoneable by apology, she didn't apologize to the very end.
That determination.
It makes me angry that I made her go that far.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、結局――――」
　俺は、この人が、好きだったのか。
　最後まで。
　こうして死の直前まで彼女を悲しいと思ってしまうぐらい、大切だったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that was it…”
I loved her after all.
Right to the end.
She mattered so much that even on the threshold of death, my heart still aches for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What.
In the end----"
I liked her?
Until the very end.
Feeling sad like this until my own death, she was that dear to me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　軽く咳き込んで、血を吐いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
I cough lightly, bringing up a mouthful of blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Tss."
I cough weakly and spit out blood.

entries.japanese:
それで終わり。
　ぼんやりと月を見上げたまま、胡乱な意思のまま、いつのまにか、眠って、い――――
entries.maoEnglish:
And that is the end.
I gaze vaguely up at the moon, my thoughts adrift, and before I know it I am falling… asle—
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's all over.
Staring dazedly at the moon, with these strange thoughts, I drift off to slee----

entries.japanese:
……三時間目は悲しいお話でした。
　なんとか一人で解決しようとした遠野くんは立派ですが、今回はそれが裏目に出てしまったようです。
　ここは頼りになる先輩に相談して、なんとかピンチをしのいじゃってください。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lesson three was a sad one.
It was admirable of Tohno to try solving everything alone, but this time it worked against him.
Consult the senior you can depend on and let her help you out of this predicament.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The third period class was a sad story.
You really were splendid in trying to resolve everything by yourself, but it seems to have backfired this time.
Consult your reliable Senpai, and please make your way through this trouble.

entries.japanese:
――――それと！
　それ以外でここにきてしまった遠野くん！
　残念です、もーちょっとでクライマックスだっていうのに、シエルさんとの絆が足りません。
　再提出です。
　随分前に戻って、こまめにシエルさんと仲良くなってください。
　ポイントとしては多々ありますが、最大のポイントは六日目の夜の出来事でしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――And another thing!
Tohno, if you arrived here by any other route, listen up!
I’m afraid your bond with Ciel is too weak, even though you were almost at the climax.
Resubmit your work.
Go back quite a way and take every opportunity to grow closer to her.
There are many important moments, but the greatest one is probably what happens on the night of day six.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And!
For you Tohno-kuns who came here for some other reason.
Unfortunately, even though you were so close to the climax, your bond with Ciel-san was not deep enough.
I have to ask you to resubmit.
Please go back a long time, and make good friends with Ciel-san.
There are a lot of places you can do this, but the most important one is what happens on the sixth night.

entries.japanese:
遠野くんは、もしかしてシエルさんとアルクェイドの天秤で、あのば○女を選びませんでしたか？
　その結果がこれです。
　これにこりたら六日目の夜に戻って、もう一度どちらを選ぶのか考えてみてくださいね。
　………………ね！
entries.maoEnglish:
Tohno, when you weighed Ciel against Arcueid, did you perhaps choose that idi○t woman?
This is the result.
Let it be a lesson: return to the night of day six and think very carefully about whom you choose.
All right?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tohno-kun, when it came time to choose between Ciel-san or Arcueid, did you choose that idio**c woman?
This is the result.
If you have learned your lesson, please go back to the night of day six and think again about who you should choose.
……………… Okay!?

entries.japanese:
シエルが居なくなるとこの部屋も広く感じる。
　時刻はまだ朝の七時すぎ。
　昨夜がんばったせいか、まだ体は眠たがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Without Ciel, the room feels larger.
It is barely past seven in the morning.
Perhaps because of last night’s exertions, my body is still clamoring for sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The room feels empty without Ciel here.
It's past seven in the morning.
My body still feels tired after everything that happened last night.

entries.japanese:
月曜日。
　本来ならこれから学校に行かなくちゃいけない時間だけど、この部屋から出るなとシエルに堅く言われている。
　今はシエルが帰ってくるまで外と連絡をとるような事はしないほうがいい。
　……秋葉にしばらく帰れないと伝える事。
　……琥珀さんに、許される筈はないけど、それでも謝らなくてはいけない事。
　その二つを残したままでいるのは心苦しいけど、今はロアをなんとかするほうが先決だと思う。
「………………」
　シーツを頭からかぶる。
　胸に重苦しいしこりを抱えたまま、沈むように再び眠りに落ちていった
entries.maoEnglish:
Monday.
Ordinarily I would have to leave for school soon, but Ciel sternly ordered me not to step outside this room.
Until she returns, I should avoid any contact with the outside world.
I still have to tell Akiha that I won’t be home for a while.
I still have to apologize to Kohaku, though there is no chance she can forgive me.
Leaving both undone weighs heavily on me, but dealing with Roa must come first.
“…………”
I pull the sheet over my head.
With a heavy knot still lodged in my chest, I sink back into sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Monday.
Normally, it would be time for me to go to school, but Ciel firmly told me not to leave this room.
It's better if I don't go anywhere until Ciel returns.
…… Having to tell Akiha I won't be coming back for a while.
…… And to Kohaku-san.
It can't be forgiven, but the fact is, I have to apologize to her.
It's painful to leave those two things aside, but right now I think dealing with Roa takes priority.
"…………………"
I pull the sheets over my head.
Resisting the tightness I feel in my chest, I fall asleep once more.

entries.japanese: ――――目的は、変わったのか。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Has my purpose changed?
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Has your goal changed?

entries.japanese:
いや、目的そのものは変わっていない。
　私は永遠を目指す。
　ただ理由もなく永遠を目指そうとした。
　それはなんて、純粋で穢れのない意思だったのだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
No—the purpose itself remains unchanged.
I seek eternity.
Once, I sought eternity for no reason at all.
What a pure and stainless will that was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No, the goal itself has not changed.
I aim for eternity.
I tried to seek out eternity for no reason.
That was, really a pure, undefiled will.

entries.japanese:
変わってしまった。
　私は、変わってしまった。
　目的を。
永遠を目指すという目的が、手段になりさがる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have changed.
I have changed.
My purpose. The pursuit of eternity has fallen into nothing more than a means.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Changed.
I've changed.
My goal.
The goal of attaining eternity has been degraded to a means to an end.

entries.japanese:
なんという無様さだ。
　自分で理解していながら、それでも己の心を変えられない。
　あの女。
　あの女がいるせいだ。
　あの女のせいで――――私は、純粋ではなくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
How wretched.
I understand my degradation, yet cannot alter my own heart.
That woman.
It is because of that woman.
Because of her—I am no longer pure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
How ugly is this.
I understand so myself, yet I cannot change my heart.
That woman.
Because of that woman.
Because of that woman----I became impure.

entries.japanese:
だが、どうすればいいのだろう。
　人間という生命種に千年を生きる力はない。
　肉体的にも精神的にも、人の器はその磨耗に耐えきれない。
　たとえ吸血種として不死の肉体を手にいれても、精神の老化だけは止められない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yet what am I to do?
Human beings lack the strength to live for a thousand years.
Neither body nor mind can withstand such erosion.
Even an immortal body gained as one of the vampiric species cannot halt the aging of the mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, what should I do?
The human species does not have the power to live for a thousand years.
Mentally and physically, a human vessel cannot resist the wearing down of time.
Even if you gained an immortal body as a vampire, you cannot stop the aging of the mind.

entries.japanese:
老化を防ぐことはできる。
だがそれは停止だ。
停止した精神になど価値はない。
　私は、この私という純度を保ったままで有り続けねばならない。
　そうでなくては―――あの女には届くまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Aging can be prevented. But that is stasis. A mind held in stasis has no value.
I must continue to exist without compromising the purity of the self I am.
Otherwise—I shall never reach that woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You can stop the aging, but that is only a halt.
There is no meaning to a mind which has stopped.
I have to exist with the purity of my essence preserved.
Unless I can be like that---I won't reach that woman.

entries.japanese:
やはり、転生という手段をとろう。
　一から生まれなおし、私となってまた死ぬ。
　この循環の中でなら、私は私という純度を保ったまま在きられる。
　おしむらくは、かつての純粋さが失われてしまったこと。
　私は、他の有象無象どもと同じように、今の私のままで存在し続けたいと願ってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then reincarnation remains the answer.
I shall be born anew from the beginning, become myself, and die once more.
Within that cycle, I can continue to exist without diluting the purity of what I am.
My only regret is that my former purity has already been lost.
Like all the other rabble, I have begun to desire continued existence as the self I am now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As expected, I will use the method of reincarnation.
Restarting from birth, being myself, and dying once more.
In this cycle, I can exist while preserving the purity of my self.
What I regret is that I've lost my original purity.
I, like those other pitiful wretches, am wishing to continue existing as my self as it is right now.

entries.japanese:
憎悪というものを初めて知った。
　それも全て、あの女さえいなければありえなかった堕落だからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
For the first time, I learned hatred.
That hatred too is a corruption that could never have arisen without that woman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It was the first time I knew hate.
Because everything, it was a downfall which would have never occurred if that woman did not exist.

entries.japanese:
「……あの……女……？」
　なにか、とても強い意思を思い出して、目が覚めた。
「あの――女？」
―――ズキン。
「い――――た」
――――――――ズキン。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That—woman?”
The memory of some overpowering will wakes me.
“That woman?”
―――Throb.
“It—hurts.”
――――――――Throb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That…… woman……?"
I remember a strong will and wake up.
"That--woman?"
---Throb.

"Ou----ch."
--------Throb.

entries.maoEnglish:
“A woman I know?”
――――――――――――――Throb!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… This…… woman, I know……?"
--------------Throb!

entries.japanese:
「がっ―――！」
―――なんだ、今の、頭痛。
　普通、普通じゃ、ない……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gah—!”
―――What was that headache?
This—this isn’t normal!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah---!"
---What, is, this, headache?
It isn't, it isn't, natural……!

entries.japanese:
「あ………ぐ……！」
　両手で頭を押さえる。
　痛い。
今までみたいな生半可な痛みじゃない。
　あたま。
頭を、ハンマーで殴られ続けているみたいな、痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh—!”
I clutch my head in both hands.
It hurts. Nothing like the pain before.
My head. It feels as though someone is striking it with a hammer over and over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… gh……!"
I hold my head with both hands.
It hurts.
I've never felt pain like this before.
My head.
My head feels like it's being hit with a hammer.

entries.japanese:
「ぐ――――がっ………！」
　やめ、やめ、ろ
　これ以上、これ以上続くと、割れる。
　あたま、が、くだ、ける―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—gah—!”
Stop—stop
If this keeps going, my head will split apart.
My skull is breaking—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"G---gah………!"
Sto, sto, p
If this, if this keeps up, it'll split apart.
My head, will, shatter apart------

entries.japanese:
「ギッ――――！」
　びくん、と体が跳ねる。
　いたい。
まだ、収まってくれないの、か。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gii—!”
My body convulses.
It hurts. Why won’t it stop?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gi-----!"
My body convulses.
It hurts.
Won't it, ever, stop?

entries.japanese:
「ひ―――――」
　あんまりに痛くて、頭をテーブルに打ち付けた。
　ぽたり、という音。
　ガラスのテーブルが割れた。
　額からは血が流れている。
　だが、こんなものはまったく痛くない。
　そんなものより、何もしないのにやってくる頭痛のほうが、はるかに―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hh——”
The pain is so unbearable that I smash my head against the table.
A drop falls.
The glass tabletop has shattered.
Blood runs from my forehead.
But this doesn’t hurt at all.
Compared with the headache that comes without cause, this is nothing—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hya----"
It hurts so much that I smash my head against the table.
A shattering sound.
The glass table breaks into pieces.
Blood flows from my forehead.
But, it doesn't hurt one bit.
More than that, this headache that comes for no reason, is far more----

entries.japanese:
「―――――――、て」
　耐えられない。
　気絶することさえ、できない。
　何秒。
何分。
何時間ごとに、この、痛みが、くる、のか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It—hurts.”
I can’t endure it.
I can’t even lose consciousness.
Every few seconds? Minutes? Or hours?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------,t"
Unbearable.
I can't even pass out.
How many seconds?
How many minutes?
How many hours, will this, pain last?

entries.japanese:
「―――た、すけ」
　いたい。
　どうにかしようと、ナイフで掌をザクザクと刺してみた。
　ダメだ。
ぜんぜんイタク、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Help…”
It hurts.
Desperate to do something, I stab the knife into my palm again and again.
No use. It doesn’t hurt at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---He,lp."
It hurts.
Trying to do something about it, I stab my hand with my knife.
It's no good.
It doesn't, hurt at all.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　シエル……シエル先輩は、まだ、帰ってこない。
　時計をみたら、まだ昼にもなってない。
　目を覚ましてから、たった一時間しか経っていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Ciel—Ciel still hasn’t returned. The clock says it isn’t even noon.
Only one hour has passed since I woke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Ciel…… Ciel-senpai, has not come back yet.
I look at the clock and it isn't even noon.
It hasn't even been an hour since I woke up.

entries.japanese:
明日の朝になるまで、あと二十時間以上、ある。
　その事実だけで、気が狂いそうになった。
entries.maoEnglish: More than twenty hours remain until tomorrow morning. That fact alone nearly drives me mad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There is, another twenty hours until tomorrow morning.
Just knowing that almost makes me go insane.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　ズキン、ズキン、ズキン。
　もう、何時間この痛みに耐えたか、わからない。
　とっくに限界は超えている。
　これ以上この痛みを我慢していたら、シエルが帰ってくる前に、俺自身が死んでしまう。
「―――――――は」
　この部屋にいると、頭痛がする。
　外。
　外に出ないと、気が狂う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Throb, throb, throb.
I no longer know how many hours I have endured this pain. I passed my limit long ago.
If I bear it any longer, I’ll die before Ciel returns.
“————Hah.”
This room gives me headaches.
Outside.
If I don’t get outside, I’ll go mad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Throb, throb, throb.
I don't even know how long I withstood this pain.
I passed my limit long ago.
With all this pain, I'll die long before Ciel comes back.
"-------Gah."
If I'm in this room, this headache will stay.
Outside.
I have to go outside or I'll go insane.

entries.japanese:
「ダ――――め」
　シエルが言っていた。
この部屋から、外には出るな、と。
　だが―――このままいれば、ロアなんかに乗っ取られる前に、俺が死ぬ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I… can’t.”
Ciel told me not to leave this room.
But if I stay—before Roa ever takes me over, I will die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I-----can't."
Ciel told me not to leave this room.
But---If I stay here, I'll die before Roa takes over me.

entries.japanese:
「だメだっ―――て、いってる、のに」
　ふらふらと足が玄関に向かう。
　ふと、理由もなく。
　無性に、金色の月が見たくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I said—I can’t—”
Yet my unsteady feet carry me toward the front door.
Then, for no reason at all.
I am seized by the need to see the golden moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm saying----I can't."
My legs head towards the door.
For no reason.
I really wanted to see the golden moon.

entries.japanese:
―――線が、消えない。
　視界の歪みが、一段とひどくなっている。
　夜の街は白い霧に覆われていて、もう何千年も前に死んでしまった都に似ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The lines won’t disappear.
My vision is more distorted than ever.
The night streets are shrouded in white mist, like a city that died thousands of years ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The lines won't disappear.
The wavering in my vision worsens.
The night city is shrouded in a white fog, as if it was a city that died thousands of years ago.

entries.japanese:
街に人の気配はない。
　道という道、建物という建物にかかる、蜘蛛の糸のような繭。
　ひどく、静か。
　深海の底に建てられたような死の都。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no trace of anyone in the city.
Every street, every building lies swaddled in a cocoon like a web of spider silk.
So terribly quiet.
A dead city built on the ocean floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no sign of anyone else.
A cocoon that's like a spider's web is everywhere on every building.
It's terribly quiet.
Like a dead city at the bottom of a vast ocean.

entries.japanese:
そんな幻視に眩わされながら、歩いた。
　頭上には一際大きく、晧晧と輝く黄金の月。
　月の光の恩恵だろうか。
　あれだけあった頭痛は消えて、頭の中は眠っている時みたいに、ぼんやりとしている。
　月の下。
　何かに惹かれるように、歩いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I wander on through the vision.
Overhead, a golden moon blazes larger and brighter than ever.
Perhaps its light has blessed me.
The crushing headache is gone, leaving my thoughts dim and shapeless, as though I were asleep.
Beneath the moon,
I walk as though something is drawing me onward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In that illusion, I still walk.
Overhead, the large golden moon shines radiantly.
Is it the mercy of the moon?
My headache has disappeared and my head is in a daze.
Under the moon.
As if under a spell, I continue walking.

entries.japanese:
夜の公園。
　何もかもあやふやな視界の中、唯一つはっきりとした影がある。
「――――――」
　なんとなく。
　俺ではないオレが、こうなることを、望んでいたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
A park at night.
In a world where everything else swims out of focus, one figure alone stands perfectly clear.
“—”
Somehow.
The me who isn’t me must have wanted this to happen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Night hangs over the park.
In the middle of my hazy vision, there is one figure that looks clear.
"------"
For some reason, it seems like the other "me" wanted this.

entries.japanese:
月光は強く。
　太陽の明かりほど眩しい月下。
entries.maoEnglish:
The moonlight is fierce.
Night lies beneath it as bright as day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The moonlight is strong.
Under the light as bright as the sun.

entries.japanese: そこに、白い装束のアルクェイドが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish: And there stands Arcueid, dressed all in white.
entries.mirrorMoon: There, Arcueid stands dressed in white.

entries.japanese:
「久しぶり。
今夜はいい月ね、志貴」
「――アルクェイド。
おまえ、帰ったんじゃなかったのか」
「いいえ。
わたし、まだ自分の目的を果たしてないもの。
このまま帰るわけにはいかないでしょう？」
―――無造作に。
　アルクェイドは、紅い瞳で俺を見つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s been a while.
Beautiful moon tonight, Shiki.” “Arcueid… I thought you’d gone home.”
“No. I still haven’t accomplished what I came here to do. I can hardly go home now, can I?”
―――Without the slightest ceremony,
Arcueid fixed her crimson eyes on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's been a while.
Isn't it a wonderful moon tonight, Shiki?"
"--Arcueid.
Didn't you go back?"
"No, I haven't fulfilled my objective yet.
I can't go back before then, can I?"
---Effortlessly.
Arcueid looks at me with crimson eyes.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――」
　呼吸が止まる。
　先輩と対峙した時とは比べ物にならないぐらいの、異質なまでの圧迫感。
　これが―――彼女を、『敵』に回した時の重圧。
「――――――」
　息ができない。
　喉が動かない。
　そんな余分な真似をすれば―――次の瞬間、この首が千切られてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My breath stops.
The alien pressure is beyond anything I felt facing Ciel.
This is what it means to have Arcueid for an enemy.
“—”
I can’t breathe.
I can’t move my throat.
One unnecessary twitch, and my head will be torn from my shoulders.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ts------"
My breathing stops in my throat.
An unnatural pressure, nothing like when I confronted Senpai.
This is---the pressure that I feel being confronted as her "enemy".
"------"
I can't breathe.
My throat doesn't move.
If I do such extraneous movement---she would tear it out at that moment.

entries.japanese:
「ばかな志貴。
あんな女に肩入れしなければ、そんな目にあわなかったのにね」
　アルクェイドはほんのわずかな憐憫と、この上ない娯楽を見つけた子供のように、嬉しげに目を細める。
「それで、どうなの志貴？
　自分の中にロアがいるっていう感想は？」
　形容しがたいほどの殺気をこめて、白い吸血姫はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Poor, foolish Shiki. None of this would have happened if you hadn’t taken that woman’s side.”
Arcueid’s eyes narrow with the faintest pity—and the delight of a child discovering the most marvelous new toy.
“So tell me, Shiki. How does it feel to have Roa inside you?”
The white vampire princess speaks with murderous intent beyond description.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stupid Shiki.
This wouldn't have happened if you didn't side with that woman."
Arcueid shows just a brief moment of pity.
Then, her eyes light up with pure delight like a happy child.
"So how is it, Shiki?
How does it feel to have Roa inside you?"
The white vampire princess speaks with indescribable enmity in her voice.

entries.japanese:
背骨をまるごと引きはがされそうな危機感をあびて、はっきりと目が覚めた。
―――目の前には俺を殺すつもりでいるアルクェイドがいる。
　距離は―――七メートルぐらいか。
　くそ、コイツ相手なら百メートルあっても安心できないっていうのに、たった七メートルしか離れていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The certainty that my entire spine is about to be ripped out jolts me fully awake.
―――Arcueid is standing before me, intent on killing me.
The distance—seven meters, maybe.
Damn it—a hundred meters wouldn’t be safe against her, and I have only seven.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Feeling the danger that sends chills up my spine, I clearly realize the situation.
---Standing before me is Arcueid, who is trying to kill me.
Our distance is---about seven meters.
Damn it.
With an opponent like this, you can't even feel safe with a hundred meters, but she is only seven meters away.

entries.japanese:
「―――なに、バカなこと言ってるんだ、おまえ」
　ポケットの中にナイフが入っている事を確認して、とりあえずとぼけてみた。
「無駄よ。
もともとロアはわたしが死徒にしてしまったヤツだもの。
奪われた自分の力がどこで脈づいているかは簡単に感じ取れるわ」
―――そうか。
　そういえばシエルが前に言っていたっけ。
　ロアはもともと、アルクェイドに血を吸われて吸血鬼になったヤツだと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What kind of stupid nonsense are you talking about?” I check that the knife is still in my pocket and play dumb.
“It won’t work. Roa was a man I turned into a Dead Apostle myself. I can easily feel where the power he stole from me is still beating.”
―――Oh.
Right.
Ciel had told me before: Roa was originally made a vampire when Arcueid drank his blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What kind of nonsense are you saying?" I confirm that the knife is in my pocket and play dumb.
"It's useless, you know.
In the first place, Roa was made into a Dead Apostle by me.
It's very easy for me to tell where the person who stole my power is."
---I see.
Come to think of it, Ciel said it before.
That Roa became a vampire because he had his blood sucked by Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「どういう理由かは知らない。
今まで十七回も繰り返してきたけど、こんな事は初めてよ」
　アルクェイドはぴくりとも動かない。
　近づこうとする必要なんて、ないんだ。
　ここはもう、あいつの間合いの中なんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know why. I’ve been through this seventeen times, and nothing like it has ever happened before.”
Arcueid doesn’t move a muscle.
She has no need to come any closer.
I am already within her reach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't know why.
There have been seventeen reincarnations before this, but this is the first time this has happened."
She doesn't even move one bit.
There's, no reason for her to come closer.
Because, this is well within her range.

entries.japanese:
……紅い、瞳。
　それに見つめられていると、ずきりと、頭痛が戻ってくる。
　ずきり、ずきり。
　頭の中で。
　ロアという吸血鬼が、活性化したがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Those crimson eyes…
As they hold me, the headache begins to throb again.
Throb, throb.
Inside my skull.
The vampire called Roa is struggling to awaken.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Crimson, eyes.
Being stared at by them, my headache returns again.
Throb.
Throb.
Inside my head.
The vampire called Roa is wanting to emerge.

entries.japanese:
「でもたしかに貴方からロアの波動を感じる。
あの時、ロアは貴方の中に転移したのね。
どうしてそんな事になったのかわたしにはわからないけど」
　
「―――――――」
　……痛む。
　アルクェイドがヤツの名前を口にするたびに、脳髄の中でヤツの記憶が暴れまわる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But there’s no mistaking Roa’s presence inside you. He must have transferred himself into you back then. I don’t know how it happened, though.”
“—”
It hurts.
Each time Arcueid speaks his name, his memories thrash through the marrow of my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Certainly, I can sense Roa.
Back then, Roa must have transmitted himself to you.
I really don't understand why though."
"-------"
…… It hurts.
Every time Arcueid says his name, the memories of this guy rage in my brain.

entries.japanese:
ずきり。
　ずきり。
　ずき――――――り
entries.maoEnglish:
Throb.
Throb.
Throooooob—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Throb.
Throb.
Thro-----b.

entries.japanese:
―――それは、どこだったか。
　深い、深海の底のように深い、山間の古城。
　そこに囚われていた一人の少女の姿。
　それだけが、もうただの記憶に成り果てた男の魂に、焼きついている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Where had it been?
A mountain castle, deep as the floor of a lightless sea.
A single girl imprisoned there.
That image alone remained branded upon the soul of a man who had long since withered into nothing but memory.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Where… was it?
Deep in the mountains, an old castle.
The figure of a solitary girl bound there.
Only that is burned into this man's soul, which has already become only a memory.

entries.japanese:
俺には、解らない。
　真祖である彼女は自らの意味も教えられず、ただ堕ちた真祖たちを狩るための道具として扱われていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I couldn’t understand.
A True Ancestor who had never even been told the meaning of her own existence, she had been used as nothing more than a weapon to hunt fallen True Ancestors.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I… don't understand.
Even though she was a True Ancestor, she was not even told the meaning of her own existence, and was only used as a tool to hunt fallen True Ancestors.

entries.japanese:
自身はかすり傷さえ帯びず。
　ただ返り血だけで真紅に染まった少女。
　言葉も知らず、ただ白痴のように月だけを見上げていた女。
　頭上には仰ぐほど大きい黄金の月。
　何もかも枯れ果てた庭園の中で、彼女の姿だけが、鮮明だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She did not bear so much as a scratch.
Only the blood of others dyed her scarlet.
A woman who knew no words and stared witlessly up at the moon.
Above her hung a golden moon vast enough to fill the sky.
In a garden where everything had withered away, she alone remained vivid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She herself does not receive any wounds whatsoever.
The girl painted only in the crimson blood of her enemies.
Not knowing words, the woman was just looking up at the moon as if she was some sort of an idiot.
Overhead, the huge golden moon.
In that withering courtyard, only her figure was distinct.

entries.japanese:
その姿を、彼は、美しいと感じた。
　生まれて初めて。
　おそらく、いや、生涯にただ一度のみ。
entries.maoEnglish:
He thought she was beautiful.
For the first time in his life.
Perhaps—no, certainly—the only time in all his life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
He felt her figure was beautiful.
For the first time since he was born.
Probably, no definitely, the only time in his life.

entries.japanese: ――――ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォンは、その白い少女に恋をした――――
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Michael Roa Valdamjong fell in love with the girl in white――――
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Michael Roa Valdamjong fell in love with that white woman-----

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　初めて。
　衝動ではなく、ロアという人物の心が見えた。
　残された唯一の感情。
　かつてのロアという人格はとっくに亡くなってしまっているのに、決して消えずに焼きついている、永遠の記憶。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
For the first time.
I saw not an impulse, but the heart of the man Roa had been.
His one surviving emotion.
The person he once was had died long ago, yet this eternal memory remained, branded too deeply ever to fade.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
This is the first time.
Not an impulse, but truly Roa's heart.
The only remaining emotion.
Roa's personality had long died, but it continues to exist without disappearing, that eternal memory.

entries.japanese:
「……そう、か」
　だから―――そんなにアルクェイドが憎かったのか。
　自分から純粋さを奪った女。
　たった一瞬。
ただ一度見ただけだというのに、それだけで心を奪われてしまった自分。
　純粋であった自分を堕落させた、憎い真祖。
　その存在。
白い吸血姫の全てが、憎かったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I see.”
Was that why he hated Arcueid so much?
The woman who had robbed him of his purity.
Himself, losing his heart in a single instant to a girl he had seen only once.
The hateful True Ancestor who had corrupted his once-pure self.
Did he hate her very existence—everything about the white vampire princess?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I, see."
That's why---he hated Arcueid so much.

The woman who stole his purity.
Just an instant.
He only saw her for an instant, but his heart was stolen.
That hated True Ancestor that caused his purity to fall.
That existence.
He hated everything about that white vampire princess.

entries.japanese:
「……なんて、間違い」
　なんていう間違いだろう。
　ロアはあんまりにも憎くて、何回も転生して、そのたびにアルクェイドが追ってくるのを待っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What a terrible mistake.”
How terribly, terribly wrong.
Roa’s hatred drove him through reincarnation after reincarnation, waiting each time for Arcueid to come after him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What a mistake."
What a mistake it was.
Roa hated her so much that he reincarnated so many times and always waited for Arcueid to come pursue him each time.

entries.japanese:
そのために彼はなんでもした。
　アルクェイドを騙して、自分が吸血種だという事さえ知らないアルクェイドを騙して、自分の血を吸わせた。
　アルクェイドの死徒になった彼は、他でもない彼女自身の力で、細々と生き残っていた真祖たちを皆殺しにして、じっとアルクェイドを待ったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
He had done anything to make that happen.
He deceived Arcueid—deceived a girl who did not even know she belonged to a vampiric species—and tricked her into drinking his blood.
Once he had become her Dead Apostle, he used the power of Arcueid herself to slaughter every True Ancestor clinging to life, then settled down to wait for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For that, he did anything.
He deceived Arcueid, fooling her when she didn't even know she was a vampire, and let her suck his blood.
Becoming a Dead Apostle of Arcueid, he used her power to destroy the remaining True Ancestors, and waited for her.

entries.japanese:
なんで、わからなかったのか。
　何十回と転生してはアルクェイドを苦しめようと待ち続けるその憎しみ。
　それは憎悪の類じゃない。
　ロアっていう男は純粋すぎて、自分の感情さえわからなかった。
　自分がどうにかしてしまうぐらい、他者のことを思うこと。
それは憎悪にひどく似ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
How could he never have understood?
That hatred had reincarnated dozens of times, always waiting for another chance to torment Arcueid.
It wasn’t hatred at all.
Roa had been too pure even to recognize his own feelings.
To care for another person so desperately that it drives you mad. That can look very much like hate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Why did he not understand?
The hate that caused him to reincarnate and wait for Arcueid.
That isn't hatred.
The man called Roa was so pure, he didn't even understand his own emotions.
To think about someone else so much it makes you go almost crazy.
That feeling is very similar to hatred.

entries.japanese:
けど、たった一言。
　それが愛情というものだって教えられていたのなら、ロアという男は、こんな間違いを犯さずにすんだっていうのに―――
entries.maoEnglish:
If only someone had given it a name—love.
Then Roa might never have made such a terrible mistake―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, merely a single word.
If this man called Roa could have been told his feeling was love, he wouldn't have made this mistake---

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　――――一瞬。
いや、長い間。
　全ての元凶、転生して『現代』に有り続けようとした男の、夢を見ていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
――――For an instant. No, for a long time.
I dreamed the dream of the man behind everything, the man who reincarnated so that he might remain forever in the present age.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
----For just an instant.
No, for a long time.
I saw the dream of the instigator of it all, the man who reincarnated to stay in the "present".

entries.japanese:
「余裕ね。
わたしが目の前にいるっていうのに逃げもしないなんて。
　それとももう観念してくれたの、志貴？」
「観念って、なにを諦めろっていうんだよ。
あいにく俺はロアなんてヤツには負けない。
　明日になれば、きっと―――」
　シエルが帰ってきてくれる。
　だからそれまで。
　ここで、アルクェイドに殺されるわけにはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How composed you are. I’m standing right in front of you, and you don’t even run.
Or have you finally resigned yourself to it, Shiki?”
“Resigned myself to what? I’m not losing to someone like Roa.
Once tomorrow comes, I know—”
Ciel will return.
Until then.
I cannot let Arcueid kill me here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're pretty composed.
You're in front of me and not even running away.
Or, did you already give up, Shiki?"
"Give up?
What am I going to give up about?
I won't lose to Roa.
Tomorrow, for sure---"
Ciel will return.
So until then,
I can't let myself be killed by Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「―――ふうん。
まだ強がりを言えるなんて意外ね。
てっきり半分以上ロアに呑まれてると思ったけど―――そっか、そういうコトなんだ」
　アルクェイドの声は弾んでいる。
　……何が楽しいのか知らないけど、あいつにはまだ人間味というものが残っている。
　なら、どうにかすれば。
　このまま逃げられるっていうチャンスも出てくるかもしれない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm—I’m surprised you can still put on a brave face. I thought Roa had swallowed more than half of you already—but I see. So that’s what’s happening.”
There is a spring in Arcueid’s voice.
I don’t know what pleases her.
But some trace of humanity still remains in her.
If I can reach it, perhaps there is still a chance I can escape—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hm?
I didn't think you could still bluff around.
I really thought over half of you was taken over by Roa already---I see, that's how it is."
Her voice sounds happy.
…… I don't know what's so enjoyable, but it seems she still does have those kinds of human feelings.
Then, if I can do something.
Maybe there will be a chance to run away---

entries.japanese:
「……何を納得してるか知らないけど、ロアとは俺がキチッとカタをつける。
　俺はロアには負けない。
おまえがロアを殺したいっていうんなら、きっかり俺がヤツの始末をつけてやる。
　だから、このまま―――」
「帰れっていうのなら聞かないわ。
どうせ志貴がアテにしているのは教会の連中でしょう？
　あいつらにロアを封印されるのはお断りよ。
　志貴、わたしがロアを処分するのは自分の力を取り戻すためなの。
　だから、ね。
ロアを内包した人間はわたしの手で始末をつけないと意味がないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know what you think you’ve figured out, but I’ll settle things with Roa myself.
I won’t lose to him. If you want Roa dead, then I’ll make absolutely sure he’s finished.
So just—”
“If you’re about to tell me to go home, don’t bother. You’re counting on those people from the Church, aren’t you? I refuse to let them seal Roa away.
Shiki, I need to destroy Roa so I can reclaim my power.
So you see. There’s no point unless I personally dispose of the human carrying him.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't know what you think you understood, but I'll settle the thing with Roa myself.
I won't lose to Roa.
If you say you want to kill Roa, then I'll kill him myself for you.
So, you can just---"
"I won't listen if you tell me to go back.
You intend to get the help of The Church, right?
I refuse to let them seal away Roa.
Shiki, I want to eliminate Roa so I can get back my power.
So, you know?
If I don't do it myself, it would be meaningless."

entries.japanese:
「――――そうかよ。
それじゃどうしても―――」
　俺を、殺すっていうのかアルクェイド。
「でもね、志貴。
貴方の中にいるロアの波動は弱々しいわ。
　きっとあいつは赤子から生まれなおさないと、その肉体の中でかつての意思を保てないんでしょう。
　なんとか貴方の中に転移したのはいいけど、それが限界。
ロアは貴方の中で貴方の暗黒面として生き続けるしかできない」
「………え？」
　つまり、ロアの意思っていうのはほとんどないっていう事なのか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. So no matter what, you’re—”
Going to kill me, Arcueid.
“But Shiki, Roa’s presence inside you is very weak.
He probably has to begin again as an infant to preserve his old will inside a new body. He managed to transfer into you somehow, but that was the limit. All he can do now is remain inside you as your dark side.”
“…What?”
Did that mean almost nothing of Roa’s own will was left?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Then, no matter what---"
You're going to kill me, Arcueid?
"But Shiki, the Roa inside you is very weak.
He probably can't take away a person's will unless he's born into their body.
He somehow managed to transmit himself to you, but that was all he could do.
He is only able to live as your dark side."
"……… Eh?"
Does that mean that Roa's will is almost nothing in me……?

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、それって―――」
「ええ。
それなら殺すまでもないわ。
わたしはロアに奪われた力が、わたしの下で動けばそれでいいんだから」
「――――？」
　殺すまでもない、と彼女は言う。
　ならどうして俺の前なんかにやってきたんだ。
　どうしてそんなに―――真剣な目で、俺を見ているんだ、コイツは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, does that mean—”
“Yes. Then there’s no need to kill you. All I need is for the power Roa stole to answer to me again.”
“—?”
No need to kill me, she said.
Then why had she come?
Why was she looking at me with such terribly serious eyes?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, that means--"
"Yes.
There's no need for me to kill you if that's the case.
I'm fine just having the power Roa stole from me working under me."
"----?"
She's saying there's no need for me to be killed.
So why did she come to see me?
Why---does she look at me with those serious eyes?

entries.japanese:
「……わからないな。
何が言いたいんだ、アルクェイド」
「貴方に、わたしの下僕になれって言ってるのよ」
「な―――――」
　―――冗談では、なさそうだ。
　シエルとアルクェイドが睨み合っていた時、アルクェイド本人は質の悪い冗談だって言ってたのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t understand. What are you trying to say, Arcueid?”
“I’m telling you to become my servant.” “Wha—”
―――She didn’t seem to be joking.
When she and Ciel had faced each other before, Arcueid herself had called the idea a particularly nasty joke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't understand.
What are you trying to say, Arcueid?"
"I'm telling you to become my servant."
"Wha-----"
---She doesn't seem like she's joking.
When Arcueid and Senpai were fighting, she said it was just a joke.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ。
あれ、冗談じゃなかったのか」
「ええ。
わたしは貴方が気に入っている。
なら、殺すよりは傍においておきたい思うのは当然でしょ？」
――――バキン。
　その一言で、今までとは比べ物にならない頭痛が走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? So that wasn’t a joke?”
“No. I like you. If the choice is between killing you and keeping you beside me, isn’t it obvious which I’d prefer?”
――――Crack.
At those words, a headache unlike anything before tore through me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
That wasn't a joke?"
"No.
I like you.
So isn't it natural for me to want you by my side rather than to kill you?"
----Snap.
With that line, my headache pounds more than it ever has before.

entries.japanese:
ロア。
俺の中のアイツが、アルクェイドの言葉を憎悪している。
　……それが歓喜からくる反転した衝動なのか、それとも遠野志貴という俺に対しての嫉妬なのかはどうにも。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roa. The thing inside me hated what Arcueid had said.
Whether that impulse was joy twisted inside out, or jealousy of me as Shiki Tohno, I couldn’t tell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Roa.
The guy inside my head rages against her words.
…… I don't know if that comes from delight or from deep jealousy.

entries.japanese:
「わたしの下僕になるのなら、ロアの侵食は止めてあげるわ。
そのままじゃ貴方はロアに乗っ取られるんだから、考えるまでもない事だと思うけど」
「……簡単に言ってくれるけどさ。
アルクェイド、おまえはどうやって俺の中のロアを止められるっていうんだ」
「あら、ロアを止められるのはきっと貴方だけよ、志貴。
　けどその方法では志貴自身も死んでしまう。
　だから、わたしの方法は志貴自身を強くするだけ。
貴方がロアより強い心を持てば、ロアがどう暴れようと関係ないでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you become my servant, I’ll stop Roa from consuming you. He’ll take you over otherwise, so I shouldn’t think there’s much to consider.”
“…Easy for you to say. How exactly are you going to stop the Roa inside me?”
“Oh, the only person who can truly stop Roa is probably you, Shiki.
But your way would kill you too.
My way simply makes you stronger. If your heart becomes stronger than Roa’s, it won’t matter how violently he struggles, will it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you are willing to become my servant, I will stop Roa from consuming you.
I don't think you even need to think about it, seeing how Roa will consume you like this."
"…… You say it so simply, but how do you intend to stop this Roa inside me?"
"Huh?
The only one who can stop Roa is you, Shiki.
But that method would mean your death.
My method is simply strengthening you.
As long as your will is stronger than Roa's, then it doesn't matter how much he rages in you, right?"

entries.japanese:
バキン、ともう一度頭痛が叩きつけられる。
　ロアが暴れている。
　騙されるな。
あの女は、おまえを人形にするつもりだ、と暴れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crack—the headache struck again.
Roa was raging.
Don’t be deceived. That woman means to turn you into a puppet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Something bursts in my head again.
Roa keeps raging.

Don't let her fool you, he rages.
This woman wants to make you her puppet.

entries.japanese:
「―――――はあ」
　一度だけ、深く息をついた。
　……ロアの言い分なんか信じない。
　けど、俺にだってわかる。
今のアルクェイドは俺が知っていたアイツとは少し違う。
　アルクェイドの言う方法は、たしかにロアを抑えつけられるかもしれない。
　けど―――この頭痛に耐えられるぐらい強くなった心というのは、もう何も感じなくなるぐらい、不感症な心になるという事だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I drew one deep breath.
I had no intention of trusting Roa.
But even I understood. The Arcueid before me was not quite the one I had known.
Her method might indeed suppress him.
But a heart strong enough to endure this agony would be a heart numbed beyond feeling anything at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----*sigh*
I take a deep breath.
…… I won't believe Roa's words.
But, even I can understand.
The Arcueid now is slightly different from the one I knew.
Certainly what she says might possibly stop Roa.
But---a heart strong enough to resist these headaches means a heart that is so strong that it won't feel anything.

entries.japanese:
メガネを外す。
　ナイフをポケットから出す。
　刃を出して、自分の目の高さにあげて、両手で構えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I took off my glasses.
I drew the knife from my pocket.
I opened the blade, raised it level with my eyes, and held it in a two-handed guard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take off my glasses.
I take the knife out of my pocket.
I take the blade out and hold it at eye level.

entries.japanese:
「――――志貴」
「お断りだ。
悪いけど、俺はおまえの物になんかならない」
　シエルが、帰ってくるんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—”
“No. Sorry, but I’m not becoming yours.”
Because Ciel was coming back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki."
"I refuse.
Sorry, but I won't be yours to possess."
Because Ciel is going to come back.

entries.japanese:
「そっか。
しかたないな、なら力ずくね」
　かつん、という硬い足音。
「貴方には一度殺されたこともあるし。
一度、お返しをしてあげなくっちゃって思ってたんだ」
　突風をともなって、白い影が迫ってくる。
――――瞬間。
　戦いは、始まっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then I suppose I’ll have to use force.”
Her heel struck the ground with a hard click.
“You did kill me once. I’ve been thinking I ought to return the favor.”
A white shape hurtled at me on a gale of displaced air.
――――In that instant,
the fight had already begun.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
Then, I guess it'll just have to be by force."
A hard footstep cracks through the air.
"You killed me once, so I always thought I should pay you back."
Her white figure rushes forth with a gust of wind.
----In that instant,
the fight begins.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィン。
　アルクェイドの爪と、俺のナイフがぶつかり合う。
　金色の月の下、走りこんできたアルクェイドの姿は、敵だとしても美しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Arcueid’s claws collided with my knife.
Beneath the golden moon, even the sight of Arcueid charging as my enemy was beautiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
Her claws meet my knife.
Under the golden moon, even if she is my enemy, her figure is still beautiful.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　また弾けあう。
　正直、俺にはアルクェイドの動きなんて見えていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
We sprang apart again.
To be honest, I couldn’t see Arcueid’s movements at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other again.
To be honest, I can't even see her movements.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　さらに弾く。
　アルクェイドは全然本気でやっていない。
　けど、それでも俺の手足を引き裂くぐらいは容易なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Another parry.
Arcueid wasn’t fighting seriously in the least.
Even so, tearing off my arms and legs would probably have been easy for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang!
We repel each other once more.
Arcueid isn't serious at all.
But still, it should be easy for her to rip off my arms and legs.

entries.japanese:
ギィィィィン。
　まだ弾く。
　体が動く。
俺は何も考えていないのと同じだ。
　この手足、この体が、ただ死にたくないとう号令のもと、かってにアルクェイドの爪を弾いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrrng!
Another parry, and another.
My body moved while my mind did nothing.
My arms, my legs—this whole body—deflected Arcueid’s claws on its own, obeying a single command: I don’t want to die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
We repel each other again.
My body moves without thinking.
My arms and legs, this body, with just the intention of not dying, fends off Arcueid's claws by itself.

entries.japanese:
「く―――――」
　口元が皮肉げに歪んだ。
　あまり認めたくないが、俺の体は遥かに人間ばなれしてしまっているみたいだ。
　夜のうちなら、遠野志貴はかつてのシキという男並みに、校舎の三階ぐらいなら楽に飛び降りられるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn…”
My mouth twisted in bitter amusement.
I hated to admit it, but my body had strayed far beyond anything human.
At night, Shiki Tohno could probably leap from the third floor of the school building as easily as the man once called SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tch-----"
My lips curl in irony.
I don't want to admit it, but it seems my body has become beyond that of a human's.
In the dead of night, it seems Tohno Shiki has become like SHIKI, probably able to easily jump off the third floor of a building and be just fine.

entries.japanese:
ギィ、ィィィ。
　だが、それも限界だった。
　初めから―――アルクェイドには勝てっこないって解っていた。
　そもそも、俺の唯一の武器である『線』が視えない。
　俺には彼女を傷つける手段がない。
　いつかアルクェイドが言っていた。
　夜であるのなら、アルクェイドは死の要因がなくなる生命だと。
entries.maoEnglish:
Krrr— But that was my limit.
I had known from the beginning.
I could never defeat Arcueid.
For one thing, I couldn’t see the lines, my only weapon.
I had no way to harm her.
Arcueid had once told me that at night she became a form
of life from which every cause of death disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Cl, ang.
But, this is it.
From the very start---I knew I couldn't win against Arcueid.
First of all, I can't see any "lines" on her.
I have no way of hurting her.
Arcueid said it once.
That during nighttime, there is nothing which can cause her death.

entries.japanese:
ギイン。
　勢いよくナイフが弾かれる。
　アルクェイドの腕の一振りで、俺は大きく弾き飛ばされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Clang!
My knife was flung aside.
A single sweep of Arcueid’s arm sent me flying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Clang.
She hits my knife.
With just a swing of her arm, I fly through the air.

entries.japanese:
「くっ――――！」
　なんとか地面に着地して、ナイフを構える。
　いくら睨んでも、アルクェイドの体には『線』一つ視えない。
「くそ、なんてデタラメなんだ、アイツは……！」
――――まったくもってその通りだ。
　太陽の恩恵がないこの夜のなか。
　月の姫に挑むということは、あまりにも無謀すぎた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—!”
I managed to land on my feet and raised the knife.
However fiercely I stared, I couldn’t see a single line on Arcueid’s body.
“Damn it, what a ridiculous monster she is…!”
――――That was exactly right.
Here in the night, without the sun’s blessing,
it was far too reckless to challenge the princess of the moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"K-----!"
I manage to land on the ground and ready my knife.
No matter how much I look, I can't see any "lines" on her.
"Damn it.
What nonsense you are……!"
----Yes, I am so right.
In the deep night without the mercy of the sun,
facing the princess of the moon is too reckless.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ、あ」
　喉があつい。
　心臓が爆発しそう。
　気がつけば、俺はアルクェイドと出会った時から彼女の紅い瞳に威圧されて、呼吸さえ満足にさせてもらっていなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah…”
My throat burned.
My heart felt ready to burst.
Only now did I realize that her crimson eyes had held me under such crushing pressure from the instant we met that I had scarcely been allowed to breathe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah, ha."
My throat is burning.
My heart feels like it'll explode.
I realize that since I saw her tonight, I was under the pressure of her crimson eyes and I haven't been able to breathe well.

entries.japanese:
「どう？
　少しは目が覚めた？」
　アルクェイドは息ひとつあがっていない。
　こっちは酸欠でいまにも心臓が止まりそうだっていうのに、いい気なもんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well? Are you thinking more clearly now?”
Arcueid wasn’t even breathing hard.
I was suffocating badly enough for my heart to stop, and she looked perfectly pleased with herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Have you realized it yet?"
She isn't even out of breath.
Even though I'm gasping for air and my heart feels like it'll stop, she's completely relaxed.

entries.japanese:
「―――もう。
本当に強情ね。
それだけの強さがあるんなら、さっさとロアを殺してしまえばよかったのに」
「な―――なに、言ってる、んだ、おまえ」
　ぜいぜいと喉を動かして、なんとか酸素を吸いこむ。
「ロアを、殺すって、いう事は、自殺するって、コトだ、ろ」
　……まあ、逃げるためではなく戦うために自殺するということは、たしかに強い心かもしれないけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. You’re impossibly stubborn. If you have that much strength, you should have killed Roa yourself already.”
“Wh-what are you talking about?”
I dragged air through my rasping throat.
“Killing Roa means killing myself, doesn’t it?”
Though I supposed choosing suicide as a way to fight, rather than escape, might indeed take a strong heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, you really are stubborn.
If you had that much strength, you should have gone ahead and killed Roa."
"Wha---what, are, you, saying?"
Gasping, I manage to suck in air.
"Kill, Roa?
That means… to kill myself, right?"
…… Well, to fight and kill myself rather than running away may indicate a strong heart, but…

entries.japanese:
「わかってないのね。
志貴、貴方の目は肉体ではなく意味を、存在そのものを死滅させるのよ。
　モノの死、『点』というのは肉体を殺すものではないわ。
　貴方は命を殺しているわけではないの。
その程度の力ならこの世界にはありふれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You still don’t understand. Shiki, your eyes destroy meaning rather than flesh—existence itself.
A thing’s death—its ‘point’—is not what kills its body.
What you kill is not life. Power of that order is commonplace in this world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You don't seem to understand.
Shiki, your eyes do not kill the body, but the meaning… existence itself.
The death of things, those "points" are not something that kills the body.
It does not mean you are killing their life.
That kind of power is very common in this world.

entries.japanese:
「志貴、貴方を唯一つのモノとしているその眼は、物の意味を殺すのよ。
死滅するのはその存在。
命が消えてしまうのは、あくまでその後についてくるおまけでしかないわ。
　だから貴方の力なら、肉体を殺さずに魂そのものを仕留める事だって出来る。
もっとも魂がなくなった肉体はすぐに停止してしまうから、それではただの自殺と変わらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Those eyes are the one thing that makes you uniquely you. They kill what a thing means. Its existence is what dies; the loss of life afterward is almost incidental.
Your power could destroy a soul without harming its body. Of course, a body without a soul would stop at once, so ordinarily that would be no different from suicide.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, your unique eyes, they kill the meaning of things.
What is destroyed is the existence.
The extinguishing of life is only a side effect that comes afterwards.
With your power, it is possible to kill the soul without harming the body.
Usually, a body without a soul will cease to live, so it is like suicide.

entries.japanese:
「けど今の志貴は違うでしょう？
　一つの肉体に二つの魂が入っているんだもの。
　まあ――いつだって負けるのは弱いほうだから、今の志貴ならロアとは互角かな。
かなりの確率で二人とも消えてしまうでしょうけどね」
「え――――ちょっと、待って。
それはどういう………」
「だめ。
待ったげない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But you aren’t ordinary right now, are you? There are two souls in one body.
The weaker one always loses, though, and as you are now, you and Roa are probably evenly matched. There’s a very good chance you would both disappear.”
“Wait—what? What does that…”
“Nope. Not gonna wait for you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But that's different for you right now, right?
Because you have two souls in one body.
Well--it's always the case that the weaker one loses.
You do seem to be about even right now with Roa.
I suppose there is a high probability that you both will disappear."
"Eh-----hey, wait.
What do you………"
"No, I won't wait."

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――！」
　ガン、という音が後頭部でなった。
　両肩にはアルクェイドの体重がかかっている。
　倒された。
　一瞬で、わけもわからないまま、アルクェイドに押さえつけられてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—!”
The back of my skull struck the ground with a crack.
Arcueid’s weight bore down on both shoulders.
She had taken me down.
In one bewildering instant, she had me pinned beneath her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh----!"
I hear a sound from behind my head.

Her body pushes up against my shoulders.
I'm down.
In an instant, without me knowing what's going on, Arcueid has pinned me down.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　アルクェイドは無言で、俺を睨みつけてくる。
　両肩にかかった体重。
　いますぐ俺をどうにかできるのに、まるで躊躇っているように、アルクェイドは止まっている。
「――――――」
　息を飲む。
　けど、それはアルクェイドの静寂だったのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Arcueid stared at me without speaking.
Her weight pressed into my shoulders.
She could do anything she liked to me now, yet she remained perfectly still, almost as though she were hesitating.
“—”
I caught my breath.
But perhaps that silence had been hers, not mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Arcueid glares at me without speaking.
Her body weight against my shoulders.
She stops as if hesitating over what to do with me.
"------"
I gasp.
But, it might have been just her silence.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　こんなに間近。
　抱き合う寸前まで近づいた今なら―――視えるかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
We were so close—almost close enough to embrace.
From here, perhaps I could see it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
This close.
Now that we are so close---I may be able to see it.

entries.japanese:
――――――アルクェイドの体を凝視する。
　びきり、と頭の芯で音がする。
　今までのような頭痛じゃなくて―――本当に、脳に亀裂が走ってしまいそうな、おと。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――I stared hard at Arcueid’s body.
Something creaked deep in my skull.
This was no ordinary headache; it sounded as though a crack were truly opening through my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I stare at her body.
The core of my brain screams in protest.
Completely unlike the pain of my headache before---as if it really were tearing itself apart.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ」
　それでもだめだ。
　アルクェイドという存在から『死』が読み取れない。
　日中ならともかく、夜においてはコイツはかぎりなく完璧に近い命、死という概念を持たない存在なんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Still nothing.
I could read no trace of death in Arcueid herself.
In daylight, perhaps—but at night she was a life infinitely close to perfection, a being without the very concept of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
But it's no good.
I can't read the "death" from an existence like Arcueid.
Daytime might be different, but at night, she is close to being a perfect life form that doesn't even carry the concept of death.

entries.japanese:
「……ロアをどうするつもりなんだ、アルクェイド。
おまえは俺を殺さないっていうけど、俺が生きているかぎりロアは生き続けるんだぞ」
「希薄になったロアは放っておいてもかまわないわ。
……そうね、だから貴方のことも見逃してあげてもよかったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, what will you do about Roa? You say you won’t kill me, but Roa will live for as long as I do.”
“Roa has grown so faint that I can safely ignore him. That was why I could have let you go.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What do you intend to do with Roa, Arcueid?
You said you wouldn't kill me, but as long as I live, Roa will still be alive."
"I don't care about a diluted Roa.
…… Yes, that's why I could have let you go, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「―――なんだ、遠慮しないで見逃せよ。
俺なんかにかまってないでさ、早く帰って故郷のパパを安心させてやれ」
「でもね。
もともと自分の力なんだから取り戻そうとするのは当然でしょう？
　なによりわたしは貴方の事を気に入っている」
　ぎり、と。
　両肩にかかる体重が、重くなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then don’t hold back—let me go. Forget about me and hurry home so your daddy won’t worry.”
“But the power was mine to begin with. Of course I would want it back. More importantly, I like you.”
Her weight ground harder
into my shoulders.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Oh, you don't have to hold back, go ahead and let me go.
Don't worry about me and go home, back to your daddy."
"But you know, isn't it natural for me to take back my own power?
And more than anything else, I do like you."
Squeeze.
The body weight on my shoulders becomes even heavier.

entries.japanese:
「わたしは貴方を殺してロアを奪り混むより、このまま志貴を取りこみたい」
　だから殺さない、と。
　赤い瞳が、訴えてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Rather than kill you and absorb Roa, I want to take Shiki into myself exactly as you are.”
I won’t kill you.
Her red eyes pleaded the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"More than killing you and destroying Roa, I want to take you in."
So, I won't kill you,
her red eyes seem to say.

entries.japanese:
「信じられないけど、わたしは貴方が好きみたい。
だから助けてあげる。
血も吸わないし、貴方の嫌がることは決してしない」
　だから言うコトを聞いて、と赤い瞳が語ってくる。
―――それは、間違いなくアルクェイドの本心だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can hardly believe it, but it seems I like you. So I’ll save you. I won’t drink your blood, and I’ll never do anything you hate.”
Her crimson eyes told me, So do as I say.
―――There could be no doubt: Arcueid meant every word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I can't believe it, but it seems I really like you.
That's why I'll save you.
I won't suck your blood, and I won't do anything you won't like."
So please listen to what I tell you, her red eyes say.

---Those are, without a doubt, her true feelings.

entries.japanese:
けど、聞けない。
　気が緩んでいるのか、アルクェイドの体から完全が薄れている。
「……志貴。
それとも、わたしのコトは嫌い？」
　まっすぐに見つめてくる、目。
　押さえ付けられながら彼女の顔を見つめた。
　真摯に。
―――脳が焼ききれてしまうほど、強く。
entries.maoEnglish:
But I couldn’t ask.
Perhaps she had relaxed her guard; the flawless perfection of Arcueid’s body had begun to fade.
“Shiki… or do you hate me?”
Her eyes looked straight into mine.
Pinned beneath her, I stared up at her face.
Earnestly. Fiercely enough to burn my brain to ash.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, I can't listen.
She might be not on guard right now as the perfection is fading from her body.

"…… Shiki.
Or, do you hate me?"
Her eyes look straight at me.
I look at her face while being pinned down.
Sincerely.
---So strongly it might burn my brain.

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイドのことは、嫌いじゃない」
「ほんと？」
　嬉しそうに彼女は言った。
　……額が熱い。
　脳がぐつぐつと音をたてるなか、確かに―――
　たった一本だけの、死に易い『線』を見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I don’t hate you, Arcueid.”
“Really?”
She asked, delighted.
My forehead was on fire.
Through the bubbling heat in my brain, I saw it clearly—
—a single fragile line, terribly easy to kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't hate you Arcueid."
"Really?"
She sounds very happy.
…… My forehead is burning.
As my brain throbs horribly, I definitely---
See just one "line" of death.

entries.japanese:
「けど、やっぱりお断りだ。
俺が惚れてるのはシエルであって、アルクェイドじゃないんだから……！」
「―――――――！」
　アルクェイドの目が怒りに染まる。
　だがその前に。
　俺は、彼女の首に視えている『線』をかっ切っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But my answer is still no. Ciel is the one I’m in love with, not you…!”
“—!”
Fury flooded Arcueid’s eyes.
But before it could matter.
I slashed through the line I saw across her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I have to refuse.
The one I love is Ciel, and not you, Arcueid……!"
"-------!"
Her eyes brim over with anger.
But before then,
I slice through the "line" on her neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　喉から鮮血をこぼして、アルクェイドは倒れこむ。
　俺は彼女の下から抜け出して、今のうちに離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Bright blood spilled from her throat, and Arcueid collapsed.
I wriggled out from under her and put distance between us while I still could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
Fresh blood spilling from her neck, Arcueid collapses.
Slipping out from underneath her, I get away.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　息があがっている。
　傷はないけど、これじゃあまともに走れない。
　アルクェイドのことだ、あの程度の傷すぐに治して、また襲いかかって―――
「アル……クェイド？」
　彼女は、ぴくりとも動かない。
　地面に血を流して、白い体を朱に染めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah”
I was already panting.
I wasn’t wounded, but I could never run properly like this.
Knowing Arcueid, she would heal a cut like that in moments and come after me again—
“Ar—cueid?”
She did not move.
Blood pooled beneath her, staining her white body scarlet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----Ah."
I am out of breath.
I'm not hurt, but I can't run in this state.
It's Arcueid, she should be able to heal such a wound and will come to attack me again---
"Ar…… cueid?"
She doesn't even move.
Blood flowing over the ground, her white body is covered in vermillion.

entries.japanese:
―――――まさか。
殺して、しまったの、か。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――No. Had I—had I killed her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----No way.
Did I, kill her?

entries.japanese:
「な―――アルクェイド、そんな―――」
　逃げようとした足を止めて、アルクェイドの体に駆け寄ろうとして、息を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—Arcueid, that can’t be—”
My fleeing feet stopped; I turned to rush back to her body and sucked in a breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---Arcueid, are---"
Stopping my legs that tried to flee, I try to rush towards her body, but gasp.

entries.japanese:
片腕。
　倒れこんだアルクェイドの片腕が、ぎっ……と、蜘蛛の足のように、地面に手をついたから。
　その時。
　確かに、世界が凍りついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
One arm.
One of Arcueid’s arms creaked into motion, planting its hand on the ground like a spider’s leg.
At that instant.
The world truly froze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
One arm.
One of her arms on her collapsed figure…… like a spider's leg, stands up on the ground.
In that instant,
the whole world freezes over.

entries.japanese: 「こ　　　　ろ　　　　し　　　　て」
entries.maoEnglish: “K i l l m e.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I      Wi   l    l"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあ。
はあ。
　……彼女の喉から漏れる鮮血と、呼吸。
　アルクェイドの腕にぐ、と力が入っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah. Hah.
Blood and breath leaked together from her throat.
Strength gathered in Arcueid’s arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
…… From her neck spills her blood, and her breath.
Her arm tenses.

entries.japanese: 「し　　　て、　　　　　　げ　　　　る、」
entries.maoEnglish: “I’ l l d o i t f o r y o u.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Ki  ll,    Yo   u,"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあ。
はあはあ。
はあ。
は。
　……朱い血はまだ流れ続けている。
　静かに、彼女の体が地面から離れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah. Hah-hah. Hah. Ha.
Scarlet blood kept flowing.
Quietly, her body began to rise from the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant* *pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*
