…… The vermillion blood continues to flow.
Her body lifts slowly from the ground.

entries.japanese: 「こ　　　　ろ　　　　し　　　　て」
entries.maoEnglish: “K i l l m e.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I   Wi   l    l"

entries.japanese:
はあ。
はあはあ、はあ。
あ。
あははは、は。
　……血にけがされた、白い彼女。
　顔があがる。
　金色の髪の間に目が見える。
　瞳は、黒く落ち込んだ娑齢頭のように闇。
　その中に。
　火傷してしまいそうな程に、爛々とした赤があった。

「ころ　　　して　　　あげ　　　る」

はあ。
はあ。
はあ。
　はあ。
はあはあ、はあ。
あ。
あははは、は。
　ははは、あははは、
　あははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははははは―――――！！！！
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah. Hah-hah, hah. Ah. Ahahaha, ha.
White, defiled with blood.
Her face lifted.
An eye appeared between strands of golden hair.
Its pupil was a hollow darkness, black as a skull.
Within it.
A red light blazed so brilliantly it seemed capable of scorching me.
“I’ l l k i l l y o u.”
Hah. Hah. Hah.
Hah. Hah-hah, hah. Ah. Ahahaha, ha.
Hahaha, ahahaha—
Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha—!!!!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Heavy, rapid breathing turns into laughter.
…… Her white body stained in blood.
She raises her face.
I can see her eyes gleaming between her golden hair.
Her eyes are pitch-black.
And in them,
glows a fierce, fiery red.

"I    will    kill   you."

*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
*pant*.
ha.
a.
ahahaha, ha.
Hahaha, ahahaha,
Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahah-------!!!!

entries.japanese:
「アル―――クェイド」
　彼女の目は、何も見ていない。
　片手で立ちあがろうとするのだけれど、そのたびに彼女は地面に倒れてしまう。
　自らの血だまりで手が滑って、そのたびに彼女の体は赤くなっていく。
　何度も、何度も。
　立ちあがろうとして、滑って、倒れて。
　……そんな無様な行為さえ、彼女は愉しんでいるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—cueid.”
Her eyes saw nothing.
She tried to rise on one hand, only to collapse each time.
Her hand slipped in her own blood, staining more of her body red with every fall.
Again and again.
She tried to rise, slipped, and fell.
She seemed to relish even that wretched spectacle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar---cueid."
Her eyes are looking at nothing.
She tries to lift herself up with one hand, but every time, she collapses back down to the ground.
She slips on her own pool of blood, and each time, her body gets redder.
Over, and over.
She tries to stand up, slips, and falls.
…… It seems as if she's enjoying that cycle of failure.

entries.japanese:
「まっ、てて」
「―――――――」
　動けない。
　アルクェイドの声が、姿が、意思が―――否応無しに頭の中に流れこんでくる。
　俺という意思が流される。
融かされる。
翻弄される。
　ぐるぐると世界が回る。
　その中で、彼女のイメージが入ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait.”
“…”
I couldn’t move.
Arcueid’s voice, her form, her will—all of it poured irresistibly into my mind.
The will that was me was swept away. Dissolved. Toyed with.
The world spun round and round.
Amid the spinning, an image of her entered me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ju st, wait."
"-------"
I can't move.
Her voice, her figure, her will---flows compulsorily into my head.
My will is flowing, fusing, merging.
The whole world spins around me.
In the middle of it all, her image dominates.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　　　　そう。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ff0000



Yes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
That's right.

entries.japanese:
こんな屈辱は味わったことがない。
　こんな恥辱は身にうけたこともない。
―――だから、愉しい。
　志貴に、この身を焦がすほどの憤怒をぶつけ、叩きつける時がどれほど気持ちよい事か想像もつかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Never had I suffered such humiliation.
Never had I endured such disgrace.
―――That was why it delighted me.
I could not imagine how exquisite it would feel to hurl this body-searing rage at Shiki and smash him beneath it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I have never felt such shame before.
I have never been so disgraced.
---That's, why it's funny.
I can't even imagine how much pleasure I'll get when I take this anger out on you, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
壊す。
壊す。
壊す。
　少しずつ、一息に、この上なく優しく、痺れるぐらい残酷に、あの命を犯しつくそう。
　そう。
　四肢を引き千切って肋骨をあばいて臓物をよじり出して、助けをこう喉を踏み潰して眼を噛み砕いて頭蓋を切開して脳髄をバターのように地面に塗りたくるその瞬間―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
Break him. Break him. Break him.
Slowly and all at once, with unsurpassed tenderness and cruelty enough to numb the senses, I would violate that life utterly.
Yes.
That instant when I tore off his limbs, split open his ribs and twisted out his entrails, crushed the throat that begged for mercy, bit his eyes to pulp, split his skull open, and spread his brains across the ground like butter—!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Destroy.
Destroy.
Destroy.
Slowly, completely, gently beyond comparison, cruelly to the point of numbness, I'll violate your life.
That's right.
The instant I tear off your limbs, rip open your chest and pull out your intestines, biting into your neck as you ask for mercy, chewing through your eyes and spreading your brains on the ground like butter------!

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
「待っていて、すぐに殺してあげるから……！」
　笑って、狂ったように笑い続けて、アルクェイドは自らの血の海でもがいている。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ffffff

“Wait for me; I’ll kill you very soon…!”
Laughing and laughing like a madwoman, Arcueid writhed in a sea of her own blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
"Just wait, I'll kill you soon……!"
Smiling, laughing insanely, Arcueid wallows in a sea of her own blood.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　動けない。
　いけない。
　ロアのヤツでさえ、固まってる。
　ここにいたら、本当に殺される。
　逃げないと。
　どこでもいい、早くここから離れないと、殺される。
「―――――あ」
　なのに足が動かない。
　どのみち、何処に逃げても。
　もう、絶対に殺されるって理解してやがるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I couldn’t move.
This was bad.
Even Roa inside me had gone rigid.
If I stayed, she really would kill me.
I had to run.
Anywhere—anywhere, as long as I got away before she killed me.
“Ah—”
Yet my legs refused to move.
Wherever I ran.
Does my body already understand that I am certain to die?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I can't move.
This isn't good.
Even Roa can't move.
If I stay here, I really will be killed.

I have to escape.
It doesn't matter where, if I don't get away from here quickly, I will get killed.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん！
　何してるんですか、こっちです！」
―――その声。
　その声で、恐怖から解放された。
「先輩……！？」
「いいですから、早く逃げるんです……！
　彼女の蘇生が終わる前に、早く！」
「あ――――」
　当惑する俺を無視して、シエルは俺の腕をとって走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, what are you doing? This way!”
―――That voice.
It broke terror’s hold on me.
“Ciel…?!”
“Never mind that—run! Before she finishes regenerating, hurry!”
“Ah—”
Ignoring my confusion, Ciel seized my arm and ran.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Ah."
But my legs won't move.
Maybe they know.
That no matter where I run, she'll kill me.

"Tohno-kun!
What are you doing?
This way!"
----That voice.
That voice frees me from fear's grip.
"Senpai……!?"
"Just hurry up……!
Before she recovers, hurry!"
"Ah----"
Ignoring my bewilderment, she grabs my arm and starts to run.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ……先輩、どうして―――！？」
「どうしてもなにも、聞きたいのはこっちのほうです！
　あれほど部屋から出ないでくださいって言ったのに、どうして外でアルクェイドなんかと会ってたんですか、遠野くんのうわきもの！」
「――――」
　いや、浮気者って、今はそういう場合じゃなくて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait—Ciel, how did you—?!”
“I’m the one who should be asking! I told you not to leave your room, so why were you outside meeting Arcueid, you unfaithful wretch?!”
“…”
Calling me unfaithful hardly seemed the point right now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey…… Senpai, why---!?"
"It doesn't matter.
I'm the one who wants to ask!
Tohno-kun, you unfaithful cheater!
After I told you not to leave my place, why did you go meet Arcueid!?"
"----"
No, this isn't the time to be calling me an unfaithful cheater.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、違うんだ。
その、部屋から出たのは謝るよ。
けどどうしても耐えられなくて、それで外に出たらアルクェイドがいて―――」
「――もう、言い訳はあとでたっぷりしてもらいますから、今は急ぎます！」
　シエルは走りつづける。
　……この方角。
　どうも、彼女は学校に向かっているらしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, no. I’m sorry I left the room. But I couldn’t bear staying inside any longer, and then Arcueid was there—”
“Save the excuses for later; right now, move!”
Ciel kept running.
This direction.
It seemed she was taking us to the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, that's not it.
Um, I'm sorry for leaving the room.
But I couldn't resist it, so I went outside and Arcueid was there---"
"--Geez, I'll hear your excuses later.
Now, we have to hurry!"
Ciel keeps running.
…… This direction.
It seems like she's heading for the school.

entries.japanese:
ここまで走り続けて、ようやくシエルは足を止めた。
「―――先輩、どうしたんだ一体。
アルクェイドから離れるのはわかるけど、どうして学校になんて来たんだよ」
「……ここなら他に被害はでませんから。
遠野くんは先に校舎の中に入っていてください」
「な―――どうして」
「……アルクェイドが来ます。
遠野くんは逃げてください」
「――――――」
　アルクェイドが来るって―――あいつが、ここまで追いかけてくるっていうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only after running all that way did Ciel finally stop.
“What is going on? I understand getting away from Arcueid, but why did you bring us to school?”
“No one else will be caught in it here. Go inside the school.”
“What—why?”
“Arcueid is coming. You have to run.”
“—”
Arcueid was coming—did she mean the woman would chase me all the way here?
entries.mirrorMoon:
After running here, Ciel finally stops.
"----Senpai, what the hell is going on?
I understand why we got away from Arcueid, but why did we come to the school?"
"…… Here, nothing else will get destroyed.
Please go into the school building ahead of me."
"Wha----why?"
"…… Arcueid is coming.
Please escape, Tohno-kun."
"------"
Arcueid is coming----Is she going to chase us this far?

entries.japanese:
「……それはないんじゃないか。
たしかにあいつの壊れっぷりは凄まじかったけど、それでも……あの、怒らないで聞いてくれよ。
　あいつは本当にいいヤツなんだ。
さっきのは俺がやりすぎちまって血迷ってたけど、ちゃんと傷が治って落ちつけば―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t believe it. She was completely out of her mind back there, but still—please listen without getting angry.
She really is a good person. I went too far back there and lost my head, but once her wound heals and she calms down—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't think that'll happen.
Certainly, she was pretty screwed up that time, but…… um, please listen without getting angry.
She really is a good person.
I overdid it earlier and she got pissed, but if she recovers and calms down, she should----"

entries.japanese:
「―――無理ですね。
そもそも遠野くんの中には彼女が敵視しているロアがいる。
　それにくわえて、あそこまで彼女に傷を負わせたんです。
……今の彼女は血に飢えた吸血鬼と化しています。
遠野くんが知っているアルクェイドには、貴方を殺すまで戻ってはくれないでしょう」
「なっ――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That won’t happen. To begin with, Roa—whom she regards as her enemy—is inside you.
And now you’ve wounded her that badly. She has become a vampire mad with thirst. The Arcueid you know will not return until she has killed you.”
“What—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----It's useless.
In the first place, Roa, who is her enemy, is inside of you.
And in addition, you wounded her that much.
…… Right now, she's turned into a bloodthirsty vampire.
She probably won't turn back to the Arcueid you know until she kills you."
"Wha------"

entries.japanese:
「……そろそろ蘇生が終わるころですか」
　ぽつりと呟くと、シエルは俺の腕を掴む。
「―――校舎の中なら、少しは勝ち目があるかもしれません。
どのみち遠野くんを守るためには、彼女と決着をつけなくちゃいけなかった」
「シエ……ル？」
「彼女が活動していると、その下僕であるロアの意思も活性化するんです。
遠野くんの中のロアを抑えるには、まず彼女を眠らせるか追い返すかしなくてはいけません。
　ですから、ここで彼女を倒すのは一石二鳥です」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Her regeneration should be almost complete.”
Ciel murmured, taking my arm.
“Inside the school, I may have some chance of winning. To protect you, I would have to settle matters with her sooner or later.”
“Ciel?”
“While she is active, the will of her servant Roa grows stronger too. To suppress Roa inside you, I must either put her to sleep or drive her away.
Defeating her here solves both problems at once.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… She'll be done healing soon, I imagine."
She mutters, and grabs my arm.
"----We might have a bit of a chance inside the school building.
In any case, to protect you, I have to settle it with her once and for all."
"Ci…… el?"
"When she is active, her subordinate Roa also gets active.
To suppress Roa, we must let her sleep or fend her off.
So, defeating her here is killing two birds with one stone."

entries.japanese: 行きます、とシエルは俺の腕をひいて校舎へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish: Saying we had to go, Ciel pulled me toward the school building at a run.
entries.mirrorMoon: "Let's go," she says as she pulls me into the school building.

entries.japanese:
夜の廊下に、月明かりがさしこんでいる。
「………」
　昨夜のことを思い出す。
　どうも、夜の学校にはいい思い出がまったくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Moonlight streamed into the night-dark corridor.
“…”
I remembered the previous night.
Apparently, nothing good ever happened to me at school after dark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At night, the hallway is illuminated only by the moonlight.
"…………"
I think back to the events of last night.
It seems I have no good memories whatsoever of my school at night.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くんは二階にあがっていてください。
彼女と戦うのはわたしの役割ですから」
「イヤだ。
こうなったのも俺の責任だから、先輩こそ二階にあがっていてくれ。
あいつとは――俺がケリをつける」
「……遠野くん。
わたし、怒りますよ」
　じっ、とシエルが睨んでくる。
　けどそれは怒る、というよりいじけているような、そんな視線だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Go up to the second floor. Fighting her is my responsibility.”
“No. This is my fault, so you go upstairs. I’ll settle things with her myself.”
“Tohno. I am going to get angry.”
Ciel fixed me with a stare.
But she looked more wounded and sulky than furious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please go up to the second floor, Tohno-kun.
Fighting her is my duty."
"No.
This is my responsibility, so you go up to the second floor, Senpai.
I'll--settle this."
"…… Tohno-kun.
I'll get mad."
Ciel glares at me.
But she seems to be getting more timid than angry.

entries.japanese:
「えっと……先輩？」
「遠野くん、わたしの体のことは知っているでしょう？
　わたしは何があっても死にません。
けど遠野くんは些細な傷でも命取りになる。
　たしかに遠野くんの目ならアルクェイドを倒せるかもしれませんけど、その前に彼女の爪が貴方を殺します」
「遠野くん、言ったじゃないですか。
わたしを幸せにしてくれるって。
なら、お願いですからこんなところで死なないでください」
「でも―――先輩一人じゃ、あいつは―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel?”
“You know what my body is like. Nothing can kill me. But the slightest wound could be fatal to you.
Your eyes might be capable of defeating Arcueid, but her claws will kill you first.”
“Tohno, you said it, didn’t you? You said you would make me happy. Then please—don’t die here.”
“But if you face her alone—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Senpai?"
"Tohno-kun, you know about my body, right?
No matter what happens, I won't die.
But a trivial wound could be fatal for you.
Certainly you might be able to defeat Arcueid using your eyes, but before that, she would just shred you apart."
"Tohno-kun, didn't you even say it yourself that you'll make me happy?
So I beg of you, please don't die here."
"But----Senpai, by yourself, you can't----"

entries.japanese:
「見くびらないでください。
わたし、これでも何十という吸血種を退治してきたんですよ。
こと吸血種に対しての事なら、わたしたちの右にでる者はいないんです」
　自信ありげにシエルはガッツポーズなんかをとったりする。
　……けど。
　彼女の指先が震えているのが見えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t underestimate me. I have destroyed dozens of vampiric creatures. When it comes to fighting their kind, no one surpasses us.”
Ciel even struck a little victory pose, full of apparent confidence.
And yet.
I could see her fingertips trembling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't belittle me please.
I've already exterminated scores of vampires before.
When it comes to defeating vampires, there's no one better than me."
She strikes a confident, gutsy pose.
…… But.
I see the tips of her fingers shaking.

entries.japanese:
恐いのか。
　その、何十っていう吸血鬼を退治してきたシエルでも。
　いや、退治してきたシエルだからこそ、さっきのアルクェイドが普通じゃなかったってわかるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Was she afraid?
Even Ciel, who had killed dozens of vampires?
No—perhaps precisely because she had killed so many, she understood that the Arcueid we had just seen was anything but ordinary.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Is she scared?
Even for her, who has exterminated numerous vampires.
No, because she has, she knows Arcueid isn't a normal opponent.

entries.japanese:
「……だめだよ。
先輩、俺はそれでも―――」
　シエルを一人にして、自分だけ逃げるなんて事はしたくない。
　その思いを口にする前に、ぴっ、と俺の口に人差し指を当てて、シエルは言葉をさえぎってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, Ciel. Even so—”
I didn’t want to abandon Ciel and save myself.
Before I could say it, she touched one finger lightly to my lips and stopped the words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, Senpai.
Even still, I---"
I don't want to leave Ciel by herself and run away.
Before I can voice that thought, she presses a finger to my lips and stops me.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、その先は言っちゃダメです。
お願いですから、わたしの我が侭を聞いてください。
　一度ぐらい―――本当に一度ぐらい、わたしだけの意思で貴方を守りたいんです。
そうしないと、わたしは遠野くんに心から笑顔を向けられなくなっちゃうじゃないですか」
　……彼女は瞳に涙をたたえて、そう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t say the rest. Please indulge my selfishness.
Just once—truly, just this once—I want to protect you of my own free will. Otherwise, how could I ever smile at you from the bottom of my heart?”
Her eyes brimmed with tears as she spoke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, you shouldn't say that.
Please, listen to my selfishness.
For once----For once, I want to protect you out of my own will.
If I don't do that, I'll never be able to face you with a smile from my heart."
…… She says that with tears brimming in her eyes.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん。
わたしがこんなに早く帰ってきたのは、駄目だったからなんです」
「―――――」
「遠野くんを助ける方法は教会にはありません。
あそこにあるモノはロアを利用しようっていう方法ばっかりで、転生体である遠野くんを助けようとする方法なんて、なかったんです」
「――――そう、か。
まあ、仕方ないよな。
それは、シエル先輩が、泣くようなことじゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. I came back so soon because I failed.”
“—”
“The Church has no way to save you. Everything they had was about exploiting Roa; there was no method to save you, his reincarnation vessel.”
“I see. It can’t be helped. This isn’t something you should cry over, Ciel.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun.
I came back this early because it was no good."
"------"
"There isn't a way to help you at the church.
The only thing there was were ways to try to use Roa to their advantage, and there wasn't anything that could help you as his host."
"----I, see.
Oh well, it can't be helped.
It's not something for you to cry about, Ciel-senpai."

entries.japanese:
「いいえ……！
　わたし、わたしがもっとしっかりしていれば、もっと方法が見付かったはずなのに、駄目だったんです……！
　だから、もう―――わたしに出来ることは、ロアの侵食を少しでも遅くすることしかできない。
　……苦しいって。
　遠野くんがどれだけ苦しいかってわたしは知っているのに、それでも少しでも長く遠野くんにいてほしいって、そんな自分勝手なコトばっかり考えてるんです、わたしは―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No…! If I had only been more capable, I’m sure I could have found another way—but I couldn’t!
Now all I can do is slow Roa’s encroachment a little.
I know how much it hurts.
Even though I know exactly how badly you’re suffering, I selfishly keep wishing you would remain with me as long as possible—!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No……!
If only I, I was better, I could have found something more, but I couldn't……!
That's why----the only thing I can do now is to slow Roa's advance.
…… It hurts.
Even though I know the pain you're going through, I'm only selfishly thinking that I want you to be by my side as long as possible---!"

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　シエルの涙なんか見たくない。
　見たくないから、見えないように、そのまま彼女を抱きしめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I didn’t want to see Ciel cry.
So I pulled her against me, hiding her tears where I could no longer see them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I don't want to see her cry.
I embrace her so I won't be able to see it.

entries.japanese:
「遠野―――くん」
「だから、いいって。
俺だってシエルとできるだけ一緒にいたい。
どんなに苦しくても、最後までロアにあがいてみせる。
　……先輩は自分勝手じゃないよ。
自分勝手なのは俺のほうなんだから」
「でも―――でも、それじゃ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno—”
“It’s all right. I want to stay with you as long as I can too. No matter how much it hurts, I’ll fight Roa to the very end.
You’re not the selfish one. I am.”
“But—then you’ll…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno----kun."
"It's okay.
I want to be with you as much as I can too.
No matter how much it hurts, I'll fight Roa until the very end.
…… You weren't being selfish.
I'm the one being selfish."
"But----But, that……!"

entries.japanese:
「勘違いしないでくれ。
俺、いっとくけどこれっぽっちもロアなんかに負けるつもりはないぜ。
　さっき、ちょっとさ。
アルクェイドのヤツがヘンなことを口走ってたんだ」
　だから、もしかしたら―――手は、まだあるんだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t misunderstand me. I have absolutely no intention of losing to Roa.
A moment ago. Arcueid said something strange.”
So perhaps there was still a way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't get me wrong.
I don't intend to lose to Roa.
Before, Arcueid said something weird."
So, maybe---there just might be a way left.

entries.japanese:
「……シエル。
俺は負けない。
けど、たしかに俺じゃあアルクェイドを止めるには分が悪い。
　だから、任せる。
吸血鬼に関してなら百戦錬磨なんだろ、先輩は」
「―――――はい。
ありがとう、ございます」
　背中にまわされたシエルの腕が、ぐっとしまる。
　抱きあって、そのままシエルの唇に、自分の唇を重ねようとする。
　と、シエルはウサギみたいにぴょこん、と離れてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel… I won’t lose. But you’re right that I’m at a disadvantage against Arcueid.
So I’ll leave her to you. You’re the seasoned expert on vampires, aren’t you?”
“Yes… Thank you.”
Ciel’s arms tightened around my back. Holding her, I began to lower my lips to hers.
Ciel promptly sprang away like a startled rabbit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ciel.
I won't lose.
But, my chances of stopping Arcueid are slim.
That's why, I leave it to you.
You're unbeatable against vampires, right?"
"------Yes.
Thank you, very much."
Ciel's arm around my back tightens.
As we hold each other, I try to put my lips onto hers.
Then, Ciel hops back like a rabbit.

entries.japanese:
「―――キスはダメですよ。
そんなことされたら、わたし嬉しすぎて気が抜けちゃいます。
　ですから、今は抱き合うだけにしておきましょう」
「………だね。
じゃあ少し離れてるけど、ピンチになったら呼んでくれ。
すぐに駆けつけるから」
　こくん、とシエルは無言で頷く。
　俺は―――彼女を信じて、背中を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No kissing. If you did that, I’d be so happy I’d lose my focus completely.
For now, let’s stop at holding each other.”
“Fair enough. I’ll keep my distance, but call if you’re in trouble. I’ll come at once.”
Ciel nodded without a word.
Trusting her, I turned my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----We can't kiss.
If you do such a thing, I'll be too happy and wouldn't be able to concentrate.
So let's just keep it as a hug for now."
"…… Yeah.
Then I'll go away, but if you get in trouble, just call out for me.
I'll come right away."
Ciel nods silently.
I----put my trust in her and turn around.

entries.japanese:
「待ってください」
「……？
　なに、忘れもの？」
「はい。
……その、明日になったら街に遊びに行きましょう。
乾くんと三人で、この前のやり直しをするんです」
　儚げな笑顔で、彼女はそう言った。
――――よかった。
　シエルにとってあの約束が大切なものであってくれた、本当に、よかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait.”
“Hmm? Did you forget something?”
“Yes. Tomorrow, let’s go into town. The three of us, with Arihiko, can make up for the other day.”
She said it with a fragile smile.
――――I was so glad.
So glad that promise mattered to Ciel too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please wait."
"……?
Did you forget something?"
"Yes.
…… Um, tomorrow, let's go play.
The three of us with Inui-kun, we will make up for that one time."
She says so with a fleeting smile.
----I'm glad.

I'm glad that our promise meant so much to her.

entries.japanese:
「―――ああ。
それじゃあ約束」
　片手を差し出す。
「はい、今度はちゃんと守ってくださいね」
　シエルの手が俺の手に触れる。
　ぶんぶん、と元気よく振って、離した。
「―――それでは離れていてください。
彼女の蘇生が、たった今終わったみたいです」
「ん」
　頷いて、今度こそシエルに背中を向けて歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. Then it’s a promise.”
I offered my hand.
“Yes—this time, make sure you keep it.”
Ciel’s hand touched mine.
She pumped it vigorously up and down, then let go.
“Now please stand back. It seems her regeneration has just finished.”
“Right.”
I nodded and, this time, truly turned away from Ciel and walked on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Yeah.
Then it's a promise."
I stick out my hand.
"Yes, please keep it this time."
Ciel's hand touches mine.
After a vigorous shake, she pulls back.
"----Now please stay away.
Her recovery seems to have completed just now."
"Yeah."
Nodding, I really turn my back to Ciel this time.

entries.japanese:
―――静かだ。
　二階に上がってきて、ナイフを手にして、深呼吸をする。
　……シエルのことは信頼している。
　あの人が守るといってくれたのなら、絶対に守ってくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Silence.
On the second floor, I drew my knife and breathed deeply.
I trusted Ciel.
If she said she would protect me, she would do it without fail.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It's quiet.
I walk up to the second floor while holding my knife, and take a deep breath.
…… I believe in Ciel.
If she says she'll protect me, she'll definitely do so.

entries.japanese:
「……ばか」
　けど、それは俺だって同じ気持ちだ。
　シエルが俺を守るって言ってくれたように、俺だってシエルのことを守りたい。
　だから、すぐにあの場所に戻る。
　シエルと戦っている時なら、アルクェイドにだって隙はあるだろう。
　その一瞬。
　その間隙に、全てをかける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot…”
But I felt exactly the same.
Just as Ciel wanted to protect me, I wanted to protect her.
So I would return there immediately.
Even Arcueid would leave an opening while fighting Ciel.
One instant.
I would stake everything on that single gap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Idiot."
But, I feel the same way too.
Just like she told me that she'll protect me, I want to protect her too.
That's why, I'm going to go back there right away.
Even Arcueid should have an opening when she's fighting Ciel.
In that instance,
I'll give everything I have.

entries.japanese:
「……オマエとの決着はその後だ。
いいだろ、ロア」
　月を見上げながら、呟いた。
―――アルクェイドを追い返したあと。
　俺は、とても成功率の低い綱渡りをしなくちゃいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll settle with you afterward. Agreed, Roa?”
I murmured it while looking up at the moon.
―――After Arcueid had been driven away.
I would have to walk a tightrope with almost no chance of success.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'll deal with you later.
Okay, Roa?"
I speak to myself as I look up at the moon.
----After I fend off Arcueid.
I have to walk a tightrope with a very low chance of succeeding.

entries.japanese:
生き残れるなんていう保証はないし、そもそも『そんな方法』でいいのかどうかもわからない。
　けど、もうそれしかない。
―――その力が、君に有るという事。
　それには何かしらの意味があって、俺の未来にこの力を必要とする時がくるって教えてくれた人がいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
There was no guarantee I would survive, and I didn’t even know whether such a method could work.
But it was all I had left.
―――That power exists within you.
Someone once told me that it must have a meaning—that a time would come when my future required this power.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no guarantee I'll survive.
And in the first place, I don't even know if "this method" will work.
But, there's nothing else to do.
----If you have that power.
Some one told me before that there is a meaning behind having such a power, and a time will come when I will need that power.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、そうだね。
きっとこれが俺の役割なんだ、先生」
　……覚悟は決まった。
　後はアルクェイドのヤツを、どう追い返すか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right. This must be what I’m here to do, Teacher.”
My resolve was set.
All that remained was finding a way to drive Arcueid away—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, that's right.
This is probably my duty, Sensei."
…… I'm prepared.
Now I just have to figure out how to get Arcueid---

entries.japanese:
「―――！？」
　校舎がゆれた。
　ゴン、という衝撃。
　ダンプカーが一直線に、フルアクセルノーブレーキでつっこんできたような、衝撃。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—?!”
The school shook.
A tremendous impact.
It was as if a dump truck had come straight through the wall at full throttle, without touching its brakes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---!?"
The building shakes.
A large crash.
An impact like a dump truck slamming into the building at full speed.

entries.japanese:
「――――うそ、だろ」
　校舎はまだ揺れている。
　蘇生が終わった、とシエルが口にしてからまだ一分とたっていない。
　あの公園からここまでの距離を。
　たったそれだけの時間で、あいつはやってきたっていうのか―――！？
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve got to be kidding.”
The building was still trembling.
Not even a minute had passed since Ciel said Arcueid’s regeneration was complete.
The distance from that park to here.
Had she really covered it in so little time?!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No, way."
The building is still shaking.
It hasn't even been a minute since Ciel said Arcueid was done healing.
From the park to here, such a distance.
She came in just that amount of time----!?

entries.japanese:
……それは、違う。
　俺の知ってるアルクェイドとは、違いすぎる苛烈さだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
No—that was wrong.
It was a ferocity utterly unlike the Arcueid I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That's, different.
That severity is entirely different from the Arcueid I know.

entries.japanese:
「―――――先輩！」
　一瞬の隙をつくなんて、どうでもいい。
　何も考えられず、全力で走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
Forget waiting for an opening.
Thought vanished, and I sprinted with everything I had.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Senpai!"
Who cares about taking her opening right now.
Without thinking, I run with all my might.

entries.japanese:
――――それは、悪夢だ。
　廊下にはシエルと、アルクェイドの姿がある。
　事実としては、ただそれだけ。
　それだけなのに、足が凍った。
　この空気。
　廊下にはまっとうな空気というものがない。
　その全て。
　その全てが、アルクェイドという吸血鬼の意思で塗り固められた、生き物の胎内じみた息苦しさ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――It was a nightmare.
Ciel and Arcueid stood in the corridor.
As a matter of fact, that was all.
Yet my feet froze.
This air.
There was no ordinary air left in that hallway.
Every part of it.
Every part had been plastered over with the vampire Arcueid’s will, suffocating as the inside of some living womb.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It's, a nightmare.
Ciel and Arcueid are in the hallway.
In reality, that's all there is.
That's all, but my legs freeze.
This air.
The air isn't normal.
Everything.
Everything, it's difficult to breathe as this whole place is filled with Arcueid's vampiric will, like I'm inside some living thing.

entries.japanese: その中で、シエルとアルクェイドの戦いは、あっけないほど一方的に終わってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish: Within it, the battle between Ciel and Arcueid had ended almost anticlimactically, entirely one-sided.
entries.mirrorMoon: In the middle of it all, the fight between Ciel and Arcueid ended really easily, so one-sided.

entries.japanese:
「――――先、輩」
　遠い。
ここからすごく遠いところで、シエルは、アルクェイドに殺されかけてる。
　……シエルはほとんど死にかけていて、何も、アルクェイド以外は見えていないようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel—”
Far away. Incredibly far from where I stood, Arcueid was killing her.
Ciel was already nearly dead, unable to see anything but Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Sen, pai."
It's far.
Across a seemingly infinite span, Ciel is almost killed by Arcueid.
…… Ciel is almost dead, and she doesn't seem to see anything but Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
……アルクェイドの腕が、シエルの胸にのびる。
　ずぶり、という音をたててシエルの心臓を抉り出そうとする。
　それは、あんまりだ。
　いくら死なないっていっても、そんな―――生きたまま心臓を引きずり出すなんて、あんまりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid reached into Ciel’s chest. With a wet plunge, she began gouging out her heart.
It was too much.
Even if Ciel couldn’t die, this was too much—dragging her heart out while she was still alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Arcueid's arm reaches for Ciel's chest.
With a sickening sound, she tries to rip out Ciel's heart.
That's, too much.

Even if she says she won't die----pulling out her heart while she's still alive is too much.

entries.japanese:
「やめろ…………！」
　アルクェイドが振り向く。
　なにげない、虫でも見るかのような一瞥。
「―――――あ」
　それだけで、自分が生き物だという事さえ、忘れてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop…”
Arcueid glanced back.
An idle look, the sort one might give an insect.
“Ah—”
That look alone made me forget I was even a living thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop…………!"
Arcueid turns around.
She looks like she's staring at an insect.
"------Ah."
Just that causes me to forget that I'm alive.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、ちゃんといるじゃない。
そこで待っていて。
すぐに、終わらせてあげるから」
　言いながら、アルクェイドはシエルをいたぶる。
　首の骨を折ったまま、もう一本の腕で何度も何度も体を引き裂く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There you are after all. Wait there. I’ll finish this soon.”
As she spoke, Arcueid tortured Ciel. Holding her neck broken, she used her other hand to rip her body open again and again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, you're here too?
Wait there, I'll be finished soon."
Saying that, Arcueid destroys Ciel.
She snaps Ciel's neck as she repeatedly tears her body apart with her other arm.

entries.japanese:
「しぶといなあ。
やっぱりロア本人を殺さないと貴女は死なないみたいね、シエル」
　ざくざくと。
　あの人が教会でされていたっていう、殺しては生き返ってしまう、という繰り返し。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re stubborn. It seems you truly won’t die unless Roa himself does, Ciel.”
Slice after slice.
It was the same cycle she had suffered at the Church, killed only to return to life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Pretty stubborn, huh.
I guess you won't die unless Roa is killed, Ciel."
Slash.
Splat.
A cycle like she said she experienced at The Church, a cycle of reviving and dying.

entries.japanese:
「わたしがロアを奪り混んでしまえば、貴女はわたしが死ぬまで生き続けるしかなくなる。
　貴女が死ぬためには教会で用意した転生批判の聖剣でロアを殺さないといけない」
「っ……それが……どうしたって、いうん、ですか」
　苦しそうに、半ば朦朧とした意識でシエルが答える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If I seize Roa and take him into myself, you’ll have no choice but to live until I die.
The only way for you to die is to kill Roa with the holy sword the Church prepared to negate reincarnation.”
“And what of it?”
Ciel answered through agony, her mind half gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If I take in Roa, you have to continue living until I die.
In order for you to die, you'd have to kill Roa with the Holy Sword of Reincarnation Criticism prepared by The Church."
"…… So…… what?"
Ciel painfully responds, half-conscious.

entries.japanese:
「けれど、いいの？
　ロアが死ぬという事は貴女も死ぬという事なのよ。
ロアを消滅させてしまえば、貴女のこの体も普通の、つまらない人間の体に戻ってしまうでしょう」
「……それが……わたしの、望み……です」
「そう。
かわいそうね。
貴女の望みは叶えられない。
わたしは今度こそロアを奪り混む。
　あそこにいる肉塊をこの手で何百回と引き裂いてね……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But are you sure? If Roa dies, so do you. Erase him, and that body of yours becomes an ordinary, tedious human body.”
“That is what I want.”
“I see. How pitiful. Your wish will never come true. This time I will seize Roa and take him into myself.
I’ll tear that lump of meat over there apart hundreds of times with my own hands…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that alright with you?
Roa's death means your death.
If you destroy Roa, your body would return to a normal, boring human body."
"…… That's…… what, I…… wish for."
"I see.
How pitiful.
Your wish won't be granted.
I'm going to take Roa back this time for sure.
By slicing apart that lump of flesh over there hundreds of times……!"

entries.japanese:
「―――――！」
　どくん、とシエルの体が跳ねた。
　アルクェイドが彼女の心臓を引き抜く。
　それでもすぐに意識が戻るシエルは、ごぼごぼと口から血液を逆流させる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Ciel’s body convulsed.
Arcueid pulled out her heart.
Consciousness returned to Ciel almost at once, and blood came bubbling back up through her mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
Ciel's body convulses.
Arcueid rips out Ciel's heart.
Even still, Ciel revives and coughs up blood.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――アル」
　バキン、という音。
　激しい頭痛。
　吐き気。
「黙ってろ、テメエは―――！」
　ガン、と頭を壁に打ち付ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ar—”
Something cracked.
Blinding pain split my head.
Nausea surged through me.
“Shut the hell up—!”
I smashed my head against the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Arc…"
Something snaps.
My headache rages.
I feel sick.
"You shut the hell up----!"
I slam my head into the wall.

entries.japanese:
見ろ。
　今はこんなヤツにかまっている時じゃない。
　もう、あれ以上、指一本だってシエルを傷つけさせない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Look.
I had no time for that thing inside me.
I would not let her harm so much as a single finger of Ciel’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Look.
This isn't the time to pay attention to him.
I can't let her lay even one more finger on Ciel.

entries.japanese:
見ろ。
　血管が焼ききれるほどの負荷を脳に与えて、凝視しろ。
　見ろ。
見ろ。
見ろ。
　あの吸血鬼を、絶命させる『死』を視ろ―――
「どうして――――！」
　狂いそうになる。
　生命の死。
植物の死。
空間の死さえ視えている。
　なのに、アルクェイドには死の要因がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Look.
Drive my brain hard enough to burn out every blood vessel, and stare.
Look. Look. Look.
See the ‘death’ that would end that vampire—
“Why?!”
I was going mad.
I could see the death of living things. The death of plants. Even the death of space itself. Yet Arcueid possessed no cause of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Look.
Give your brain a strain that could burst your blood vessels, and look.
Look.
Look.
Look.
Look at the "death" that would kill that vampire----
"Why----!?"
I almost go crazy.
The death of animals.
The death of plants.
I can even see the death of the air before me.
But Arcueid has nothing which can cause death on her.

entries.japanese:
……あれは、この自然界の上にいるだけで完璧な生命だと、前に誰かが言っていた。
　自然の延長である真祖は、この世界という地盤からいくらでも活力を引き上げられる。
　だから死なない。
限界というものがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Someone had once said that merely by existing within nature, she was perfect life.
As an extension of nature, a True Ancestor could draw limitless vitality from the foundation of this world.
Therefore she could not die. She had no limit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Before, someone told me that True Ancestors are a perfect life just by being in this natural world.
They are an extension of nature, so they can draw as much power from the source called Earth.
That's why they won't die.
They have no limits.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　つまり。
　それは、自然界の上だけの完全なのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Then.
Did her perfection exist only while she stood upon the natural world?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh----"
So that means…
They are only perfect in this natural world.

entries.japanese:
―――探せ。
　あるはずだ。
　あらゆるものの死、『点』が視えるのなら、必ずどこかにあるはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Find it.
It had to exist.
If I could see the points where all things died, then somewhere—somewhere—there had to be one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Look for it.
It has to exist.

If I can see the death of everything, the "point", has to exist somewhere.

entries.japanese:
俺は間違っていた。
　アルクェイドに死の要因はない。
　それなら―――その要因をなくしているものを、まず先に――――
　あった。
　遠いか、だがこれ以上は許せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had been looking at it wrong.
Arcueid had no cause of death.
Then first I had to destroy whatever was taking that cause away—
There.
It was far, but I couldn’t let this continue.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I was mistaken.
There are no causes of death on Arcueid.
In that case----first, I have to take that which makes it so----
I found it.
It's far away, but I can't allow any more of this.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド――――！」
　ぴたり、とアルクェイドの手が止まる。
「ついてこい。
そこで、おまえを殺してやる」
　言って、そのまま窓から校庭へと駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid!”
Arcueid’s hand stopped.
“Follow me. Out there, I’ll kill you.”
I leapt through the window and raced toward the schoolyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid----!"
Her hand stops.
"Follow me.
I'll kill you out there."
Saying that, I jump out the window and onto the school grounds.

entries.japanese:
―――グラウンドの真ん中か。
　遠い。
間に合うか。
　アルクェイドはタン、と軽い足取りで追ってくる。
　速い。
速いけど、今度ばかりは俺のほうが先をとる―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The middle of the athletic field.
It was far. Could I reach it in time?
Arcueid came lightly after me, each step barely touching the ground.
Fast. She was fast, but this once I would get there first—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----In the center of the ground.
It's far.
Can I make it?
Arcueid pursues me with light footsteps.
It's far.
It's far, but I'll strike first this time----

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――」
　グラウンドの真ん中にたどりつく。
　アルクェイドは一直線に俺へと向かってくる。
　その前に。
　この足元にある一際巨大な『点』、このあたり一帯の世界そのものの『死』を、ナイフで刺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—”
I reached the center of the field.
Arcueid came straight at me.
Before she reached me.
I drove my knife into the enormous point beneath my feet—the death of the world itself throughout this entire place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hah----"
I reach the middle of the school ground.
Arcueid comes straight at me.
Before that,
I take my knife and stab the large "point" at my feet, the "death" of the very world around me.

entries.japanese:
ごん、というズレ。
　これで、終わった。
　この一帯。
アルクェイドに向けて放たれている活力とやらの供給源である自然を、この一帯だけ『殺した』。
entries.maoEnglish:
A heavy jolt, and the world slipped out of joint.
It was done.
This area. I had killed the nature in this one area, the source supplying Arcueid with whatever they called vitality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A distortion.
With this, it's over.
Everything around here… I "killed" the nature that Arcueid draws all of her power from.

entries.japanese:
「――――考えたわね、志貴！」
　アルクェイドが走りこんでくる。
　その体、いたる所に死が浮かび上がっている。
「よし―――――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Clever, Shiki!”
Arcueid charged.
Death had surfaced everywhere across her body.
“Yes—!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----You've thought well, Shiki!"
Arcueid comes towards me.
Her body is filled with death now.
"Alright------!"

entries.japanese:
いける。
　これならアイツを仕留められる――――そう、勝利を確信するより早く。
entries.maoEnglish:
I could do it.
With this, I could finish her—but before the certainty of victory had even formed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can do it.
I can kill Arcueid like this----But before I confirm my victory.

entries.japanese:
「ご―――――ふ」
　口から、血が逆流してきた。
「え……？」
　……彼女の動きがあまりに速すぎたせいだろう。
　ただ、信じられなくて、痛みも衝撃も、何も感じなかった。
　ザン、という音が、今さらになって耳に響いた。
　ドボドボと大量の液体がこぼれていく音。
　見れば。
　アルクェイドの爪は、俺がそれに気がつくより早く、俺の胸を串刺しにしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—”
Blood surged back up into my mouth.
“What…?”
Perhaps she had simply moved too fast. It was so impossible that I felt no pain, no impact—nothing at all.
Only then did the sound of the strike reach my ears. Liquid poured out in torrents.
When I looked.
Arcueid’s claws had already run me through the chest before I even noticed them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go------ugh."
Blood pours from my mouth.
"Eh……?"
…… Probably because her movements were so fast.
I just couldn't believe it, and I didn't feel pain, or shock, or anything.
The slicing sound finally reaches my ears.
The sound of blood pouring forth.
Looking down,
Arcueid's claws pierced through my chest before I even realized it.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――あ」
　意識が遠のく。
　急激に、何もかもが喪われていく。
　アルクェイドの腕は、俺の胸を穿って、そのまま体を貫通していた。
　それは。
　普通の人間なら、間違いなく即死の傷だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Consciousness receded.
Everything was being lost at once.
Arcueid’s arm had bored through my chest and emerged from my back.
It was.
For an ordinary human, this wound would mean instant death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Ah."
I feel faint.
Everything starts to fade away quickly.
Her arm has thrust through my chest, impaling me.
That…
That is a fatal wound for a normal human being.

entries.japanese:
「は――――――」
　けど、まだ死なない。
　今の俺ならあと少しぐらい生きていられる。
　……足首から、真っ黒い死の影が侵食してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—”
Yet I wasn’t dead.
As I was now, I could remain alive for a little longer.
A pitch-black shadow of death began creeping upward from my ankles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha------"
But, I won't die just yet.
With the way I am now, I'll still be able to live for a bit longer.
…… From my ankles, the pitch-black shadow of death starts to creep upwards.

entries.japanese:
「あ………………ぁ」
　かまうものか。
　口から逆流してくる血液を無理やり飲みこんで、片手で、彼女の胸の『線』にナイフをつきたてた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
It didn’t matter.
I forced down the blood flooding my mouth and, with one hand, plunged my knife into the line across her chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……………… ah."
I don't care.
I forcefully swallow the blood pouring from my mouth, and I slice the "line" on her chest with one hand.

entries.japanese:
「くっ…………！」
　アルクェイドの、声。
　それももう、よくは聞こえない。
　あたま。
あたまが、とけてる。
　アルクェイドに貫かれた胸の痛みによるものか。
　それとも限界まで脳を酷使して、体より先に脳が焼き切れようとしているのか。
　……まあ、どちらにしても、俺の死がもうすぐやってくる事には変わりはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
Arcueid’s voice.
I could barely hear it anymore.
My head. My head was melting.
Was it the agony in the chest she had pierced? Or had I driven my brain past its limit until it burned out before the rest of me?
Whichever it was, death was nearly here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh………!"
Arcueid's, voice.
I can, barely hear it.
My head, my head is fading.
Is it the pain from Arcueid piercing my chest?
Or is my brain about to burn out from being strained to the limit?
…… Well, whichever it is, it doesn't change the fact that my death is coming.

entries.japanese:
意識が遠のく。
　けど、その前に――――このナイフで、こいつの線を切断しないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
Consciousness faded.
Before it vanished, I had to sever her line with this knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start to feel faint.
But, before that----with this knife, I have to cut her line.

entries.japanese:
「……消えろ、吸血鬼―――！」
「ふざけないで、この程度でわたしは死なないんだから！」
　アルクェイドの手が俺の頭を掴む。
　そのまま握りつぶそうとするアルクェイドより早く、ナイフを彼女の股下まで切り下げた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Disappear, vampire—!”
“Don’t be absurd—something this trivial cannot kill me!”
Arcueid gripped my head.
Before she could crush it, I dragged the knife down her body to the juncture of her thighs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Disappear, you vampire----!"
"Don't fool around, I won't die with such a thing!"
Her hands grab my head.
But faster than Arcueid's hands trying to squeeze my head, I slice my knife down to her thigh.

entries.japanese:
「いいから消えろ……！
　ロアは俺が連れて行く、おまえに手間なんかかけさせずに必ずあの世に連れて行ってやる！
　だから、消えろ。
俺はおまえと殺し合いなんかやりたくない……！」
「今さら何よ―――わたしを拒んだのは貴方のほうじゃない！」
　ぐ、とアルクェイドの腕に力がこもる。
　めきり、と頭蓋に亀裂の走る音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Just go! I’ll take Roa with me and send him to the other side without making you lift a finger!
So go. I don’t want to kill you, and I don’t want you killing me…!”
“You say that now, when you were the one who rejected me?!”
Arcueid’s grip tightened.
My skull creaked as a fracture spread through it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just go away……!
I'll take Roa with me.
Without your help, I'll kill him.
So disappear.
I don't want to fight you……!"
"What are you saying----You're the one who refused me!"
Her grip increases.
The sound of my skull fracturing.

entries.japanese:
「ロアはここで殺してやる。
そうでもしなければ帰らないって言ったでしょう！？」
「こ―――この、ばか女が―――！」
　ナイフが踊る。
　ざん、という音をたてて、アルクェイドの腕を切断した。
　ぼたりと地面に落ちる白い腕。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m killing Roa here. I told you I wouldn’t leave otherwise!”
“Y-you stupid woman—!”
The knife danced.
With one clean stroke, it severed Arcueid’s arm.
The white limb fell heavily to the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll kill Roa right here.
I told you I won't go back unless I do so!"
"You---you, stupid woman----!"
My knife swings again.
With a slice, I cut off her arm.
Her white arm falls to the ground.

entries.japanese:
よろよろとアルクェイドは後退する。
　それを見届けたとたん、俺は地面に崩れ落ちた。
　どすん、と糸の切れた人形みたいに、地面に尻餅をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid staggered backward.
The moment I saw it, I collapsed.
I landed hard on my backside like a puppet whose strings had been cut.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid staggers back.
As soon as I see that, I crumble to the ground.
Like a puppet with its strings cut, I collapse on my rear end.

entries.japanese:
「志、貴――――」
　……どこか、ためらうような、アルクェイドの声が聞こえた。
「――――――――」
　声が、うまくでない。
　ごぼっ、と。
　喉を動かすと、その代わりに、赤い血が流れてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—”
Arcueid’s voice reached me, hesitant now.
“…”
My voice would not come.
A wet gurgle.
When I moved my throat, all that emerged was a gush of red blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi, ki----"
…… I, hear Arcueid's, somewhat hesitating voice.
"--------"
I can't, speak well.
*cough*
If I move my throat, the only thing that pours forth is red blood.

entries.japanese:
「志――――貴」
　……薄れていく。
　さっきまでアルクェイドに纏わりついていた殺気とか威圧とかが、薄れていく。
　彼女が傷を負ったからか、それとも彼女がつけた俺の傷があまりに酷すぎたおかげか。
　アルクェイドは、俺のよく知っている、以前の彼女に戻りつつある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shi…
ki.”
It was fading.
The murderous pressure that had surrounded Arcueid moments ago was thinning away—perhaps because she had been wounded, or because the wound she had given me was simply too terrible.
Arcueid was becoming the woman I knew again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi----ki."
…… Fading.
The pressure and killing aura Arcueid was exerting is fading away.
Is it because of her wounds?
Or is it because the wounds she gave me were so terrible?
She is returning to the Arcueid that I once knew.

entries.japanese:
「――――よかっ、た」
　何がいいのかは、もうわからない。
　ただ、やっぱり、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m glad.”
I no longer knew what was good about any of this.
Only that, in spite of everything, I still did.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Thank, God."
I don't know what's so good.
But, I.

entries.japanese:
「しっかりして、志貴……！
　そんな傷ぐらい、志貴がわたしのものになってくれるならすぐに平気になるんだから……！」
　アルクェイドが手を伸ばしてくる。
「――――――」
　朦朧とした意識で。
　イヤだ、と手をあげて彼女を止めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Shiki…! A wound like that would be nothing if you’d only become mine…!”
Arcueid reached for me.
“…”
Through the haze, I raised one hand and stopped her.
No.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hang in there, Shiki……!
If you become mine, that wound will be nothing……!"
She reaches out to me.
"------"
With a hazy mind,
I lift my hand and stop her.

entries.japanese:
「なんで……？
　志貴、このままだと死んじゃうのよ？
　いいから―――さっきのことは許してあげるし、シエルの事も気にしない。
　わたし、わたし志貴に無くなってほしくない……！
　だから―――お願いだからわたしのものになって、志貴……！」
　ふるふる、と。
　満足に息もできない体で、首をふる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…? Shiki, you’ll die like this. Please—I forgive what happened, and I won’t mind about Ciel.
I don’t want you to disappear! So please—become mine, Shiki!”
Trembling.
Barely able to breathe, I shook my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why……?
Shiki, you'll die like this, you know?
Look----I'll forgive you for earlier, and I won't worry about Ciel either.
I, I don't want you to die Shiki……!
So----please, please become mine, Shiki……!"
Back and forth.
Even though I can barely breathe, I shake my head no.

entries.japanese:
「……わからない。
志貴が死んじゃったらロアはまた転生してしまうのよ。
志貴だってロアを恨んでいるんでしょう？
　そのままだと、志貴が死んでしまったあと、ロアが貴方の体を乗っ取るわ」
「―――――――」
　……そうか。
それは確かに―――放っておけない、かな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t understand. If you die, Roa will reincarnate again. You hate him too, don’t you? Leave things as they are, and after you die, he’ll take over your body.”
“—”
I see. That was indeed one thing I couldn’t ignore.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't understand.
If you die, Roa will just reincarnate.
Even you hate Roa, right?
If you die like this, he'll just take over your body."
"----------"
…… Oh yeah.
Certainly----I can't let that happen.

entries.japanese:
けど、このままアルクェイドに従っても、同じことの繰り返しになると思う。
　例えば俺がアルクェイドに血を吸われて、かつてのロアのようになって、ロアに負けないぐらいの意思の強さを手に入れても。
　……結局は、アルクェイドがロアに振り向いてやらないかぎり、ロアが自分から消える事は、ないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
But if I submitted to Arcueid now, I thought the same cycle would only begin again.
Even if she drank my blood, made me what Roa had once been, and gave me a will strong enough to resist him.
Roa would never disappear of his own accord unless Arcueid finally turned and looked his way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, if I just follow Arcueid, I think the same thing will happen.
Even if Arcueid sucks my blood, like what happened to Roa, and I gain the willpower so I won't lose to Roa…
…… In the end, Roa will not disappear by his own will unless Arcueid turns to acknowledge him.

entries.japanese:
「……ダメだ。
おまえの言う事は、きけない」
「どうして。
そんなに―――そんなにわたしの事が嫌いなの、志貴」
　……まさか。
そんなこと、たとえ嘘でも―――
「……頼む。
おまえの気持ちもわかるけど、もう許してやってくれ。
ロアはさ、たんにおまえに振り向いてほしかっただけなんだよ。
そのために何回も生き返って、おまえがやってくるのを心待ちにしていた。
　……でもあいつは人間なんだ。
おまえのように長く長く生きられる命じゃない」
　……そう、人間には不老不死なんてもの、遠すぎるんだ。
　ロアは転生という方法で自分が自分のままで存在し続けられると信じた。
　けど、それさえも限界があった。
　その方法ではただ、同じ過去と目的を共有する『子孫』を作るだけであって、自分の『分身』を作ることにはならなかったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I can’t do as you ask.”
“Why? Do you hate me—do you hate me that much, Shiki?”
Never. I could not say such a thing, not even as a lie—
“Please. I understand how you feel, but forgive him now. All Roa ever wanted was for you to look his way. He returned to life over and over, waiting eagerly for you to come.
But he’s human. His life was never meant to stretch on and on like yours.”
Yes—ageless immortality lay impossibly far beyond humanity.
Roa had believed reincarnation would let him continue forever as himself.
But even that had a limit.
His method created only descendants who shared the same past and purpose. It never created another self.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
I can't do what you say."
"Why?
Do you really----really hate me that much, Shiki?"
…… Don't be crazy.
Even as a lie, I can't say----
"…… Please.
I know how you feel, but please forgive him.
Roa simply wanted for you to like him.
For that, he reincarnated over and over, and was looking forward to your arrival each time.
…… But, he's a human.
He's not an existence that can live for a long, long time like you do."
…… Yes, for humans, immortality is too far away.
Roa believed his method of reincarnation would let him exist forever.
But, even that had its limit.
Because that method was the same as making "descendents" which shared his same past and goals, but not creating another "self" for him.

entries.japanese:
「……ロアはすでに居ないのと同じなんだ。
あいつはもう、過去を引きずって同じことを繰り返すだけの存在だ。
　―――だから、もう終わりにしてやらないと」
「志貴―――あなた、もう」
　……アルクェイドの目が、正気に戻っていく。
　紅色の瞳が、赤い瞳に薄れていく。
　月の下、金色の髪がゆれていて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Roa is already as good as gone. He’s nothing but an existence that drags the past behind it and repeats the same act forever.
―――That’s why someone has to end it.”
“Shiki—you’re already…”
Sanity returned to Arcueid’s eyes.
Their crimson faded to a softer red.
Her golden hair stirred beneath the moon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Roa is as good as gone now.
He is just an existence which does the same thing over and over because of his past.
----So, I have to end it for him."
"Shiki---you're already…"
…… Sanity returns to Arcueid's eyes.
The deep crimson of her eyes thins to red.
Her golden hair flutters underneath the moon.

entries.japanese: そこにいるのは、やっぱり、俺が好きだったアルクェイド本人だった。
entries.maoEnglish: The woman standing there was, after all, the Arcueid I had fallen for.
entries.mirrorMoon: There, is the Arcueid that I liked.

entries.japanese:
月を見上げるように、彼女を見上げる。
　……ごめん、シエル。
やっぱりさ、俺はアルクェイドを、すごく、キレイだって思うんだ。
　あの赤い瞳も、毅然としたくせに人懐っこい目も、白く細い輪郭も、俺がたった今つけてしまった、胸に咲いた赤い血の痕でさえも。
　なにもかも、あるものすべてひっくるめて本当に―――アルクェイドは、綺麗だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I looked up at her as if I were looking at the moon.
I’m sorry, Ciel. Even now, I still think Arcueid is breathtakingly beautiful.
Those red eyes; the gaze at once proud and guilelessly warm; the fine white contours of her face; even the blossom of blood on her chest, the wound I had just made.
Everything she was, taken whole—Arcueid was beautiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I look up at her as if staring at the moon.
…… Sorry, Ciel.
I can't help but think she's incredibly beautiful.
Those red eyes, those resolute, yet friendly eyes, her white slender curves, even the gash I just gave her on her chest that is welling up with blood.
Everything about her, she really is----Arcueid really is beautiful.

entries.japanese:
だから残念。
　こんなふうに決着がついたのは、胸が痛い。
　……くそ。
アルクェイドももうちょっと早く正気に戻ってくれれば、こんな真似しなくても、良かったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
That was why it hurt.
I hated that this was how our struggle had ended.
Damn it. If only Arcueid had come to her senses a little sooner, none of this would have been necessary.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's why it's so unfortunate.
The vestiges of my chest tighten at the thought that it has to end like this.
…… Damn it.
If only Arcueid had returned to sanity just a bit faster, none of this would have had to happen.

entries.japanese:
「そうなの、志貴。
貴方……もう、ロアと一つなの？」
「……………」
　さあ、わからない。
　ただ―――今のは、無茶をしすぎた。
　こうしている今もボロボロと記憶がかけていってる。
　シエルが言っていたっけ。
　本来視えないものを視ようとすれば、血管が切れて、廃人になっちまうって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is that it, Shiki? Have you…
already become one with Roa?”
“…”
I didn’t know.
I only knew I had pushed too far.
Even now, my memories were crumbling away piece by piece.
Ciel had warned me: try to see what could not be seen, and my blood vessels would burst and leave me a mindless shell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, Shiki.
You're…… already one with Roa?"
"…………"
I don't know.
Just----all of this was too much.
Right now as I speak, my memories are disappearing.
Ciel said something like that.
That if I tried too hard to see something that should not be seen, my blood vessels will burst and that I would lose my mind.

entries.japanese:
「……なによ、馬鹿。
それじゃあシエルに殺されてやるっていうの、貴方は」
「―――まさか。
けど、おまえのおかげでこのザマだ。
もう、長くは保たないだろ」
「………………」
　アルクェイドは自分の体を見下ろす。
　胸と、そのまま縦一文字につけられたナイフの傷。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You idiot. Are you planning to let Ciel kill you, then?”
“Of course not. But thanks to you, look at me. I doubt I have much time left.”
“…”
Arcueid looked down at her body.
At the wound in her chest and the single vertical slash running down from it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki, you idiot.
Are you saying you'll let Ciel kill you?"
"----Of course not.
But I'm already like this thanks to you.
I probably can't hold on for long."
"………………"
Arcueid looks down at herself.
Her chest, and the large slash wrought by my knife.

entries.japanese:
「信じられない。
今まで、わたしをこんなに傷つけた相手はいなかったわ」
　声にはほんのわずかな恨みと、惜しむような、響きがあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t believe it. No one has ever wounded me this badly.”
Her voice held the faintest trace of resentment—and something almost wistful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't believe it.
Until now, I've never met someone who could wound me this much."
There is a faint glimmer of resentment and regret in her voice.

entries.japanese:
「……本当に残念。
けど、わたしもそろそろ限界みたい。
この傷を治すには今すぐにでも故郷の城に戻る必要があるでしょうね」
「―――だろ。
なら、さっさと帰っちまえ」
「………………」
　彼女は答えない。
　実際には、沈黙なんてなかったのかもしれない。
　ただその間。
　お互いの別れになるこの時を、ただ、長いものとして感じたかっただけだったんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It truly is a shame. But I seem to have reached my limit too. To heal this wound, I’ll need to return to the castle of my homeland immediately.”
“Exactly. So hurry up and go.”
“…”
She did not answer.
Perhaps the silence was not truly long.
Only for that moment.
Perhaps we merely wanted this parting to feel longer than it was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It really is too bad.
But, it looks like I'm at my limit as well.
I need to return to my castle quickly to heal this wound."
"----Right.
So, you should just hurry and get out of here."
"………………"
She doesn't answer.
It probably wasn't even a brief pause.
Just, for that instant,
It's probably that I wanted to treasure the last moment before we parted.

entries.japanese:
「――――――はあ」
　と、アルクェイドは呆れたようにため息をついた。
「いやな男ね。
最後まで憎まれ口をたたくんだから。
けど、わたしね」
「志貴の、そういう所が好きだったなあ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
Arcueid sighed in exasperation.
“What an awful man. Bitter words to the very end. But you know…”
“I always liked that about you, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid gives an amazed sigh.
"You're such a mean guy.
You say mean things until the very end.
But, you know what?"
"I liked that about you, Shiki."

entries.japanese:
言って。
　最後に、笑顔のままで、彼女の体は霧に溶けていくように消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
With those words.
Her body vanished with one last smile, as though dissolving into mist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that,
with a smile to the very end, her body disappears like fading mist.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ――――同じだったのか」
　呟いて、ただ月を見上げた。
　最後のわずかな間だけ、俺たちは元の、協力しあっているんだかいないんだかっていう、あやふやな関係に戻っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So we felt the same.”
I murmured it and looked up at the moon.
For that final, fleeting moment, we had returned to the old uncertain bond in which neither of us could tell whether we were allies or not.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see----we were the same after all."
Thinking that aloud, I look up at the moon.
In the end, it really was just a brief moment, but we both returned to the relationship we had when we first teamed up together.

entries.japanese:
「――――っ」
　あいつのことが、好きだった。
　俺の中にいるロアの影響なんて、知らない。
　ただ、気に入っていた。
　だからこんな、殺しあったすえに別れるなんていう結末は、痛すぎる。
　どうしてこんな事になったんだろう。
　俺とアイツの関係にかぎって―――目のアテられないような過ちなんて、そう犯してはいなかったと思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
I had feelings for her.
I didn’t give a damn whether Roa inside me had influenced them.
I simply liked her.
That was why parting like this, after we had tried to kill each other, hurt too much.
How had it come to this?
Whatever else could be said of our relationship, I didn’t think we had made any unforgivable mistake—not one so hideous it could not be faced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!"
I, really liked her.
It had nothing to do with the Roa inside of me.
Just, she attracted me.
That's why, parting like this after we were fighting only moments ago, is too painful.
Why did it turn out like this?
Our relationship----I don't think we made that many big mistakes.

entries.japanese:
「ご――――ぼ」
　血が止まらない。
　息を吸おうとすると、ポンプのように口から血の塊が吐き出される。
　……意識が、途絶える。
　アルクェイドも手加減ぐらいしてくれたらよかったのに。
　こんな、胸に大穴を開けられたら、吸血鬼になりかけの半端な俺じゃ助からない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—blh.”
The bleeding would not stop.
Every attempt to breathe made my mouth pump out another clot of blood.
Consciousness broke apart.
Arcueid could at least have held back a little.
A half-made vampire like me could not survive a hole this large through the chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gh----ho."
The blood doesn't stop.
I try to breathe, but blood just flows forth from my mouth like a pump.
…… I'm, almost gone.
Arcueid should have taken it easy on me.
If I get such a big hole in my chest, even a half-vampire like me can't be saved.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ」
　どくん、と振動する。
　心臓ではない。
心臓の動きなんて、もうとっくに止まっている。
　この、体そのものがズレるような振動は頭からしてきている。
　アルクェイドを追い返すために限界以上に脳を酷使したせいだろう。
　俺―――遠野志貴というモノが段々と削れていって、段々とロアの意思が強くなってきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
A pulse shook me.
Not my heart. That had stopped long ago.
The vibration that seemed to shift my whole body out of place came from my head.
I had abused my brain beyond its limit to drive Arcueid away.
I―――Shiki Tohno―――am being scraped away piece by piece, while Roa’s will grows stronger and stronger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Tss."
Thump.
It's not my heart.
The beating of my heart has long since stopped.
The only pulse remains in my head.

It's probably because I strained myself too hard to get Arcueid back.
I----Tohno Shiki begins to fade and Roa becomes stronger.

entries.japanese:
……体は、じき停止する。
　そのあとに俺まで亡くなってしまえば、この体はロアのモノだ。
　俺では助からないこの傷も、ロアのヤツならなんとか蘇生させる事ができるだろう。
　そうなってしまえば――――俺は、シエルと同じ過ちを繰り返す事になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
My body would soon stop.
If I died too after that, this body would belong to Roa.
Even this wound, which I could never survive, might be something Roa could regenerate from.
And then I would repeat the same mistake Ciel had made.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My body, is almost completely dead.
After I die, Roa will take over.
Even though I can't, Roa would probably find a way to heal himself.
If that happens----I would make the same mistake Ciel did.

entries.japanese:
「――――ごめん」
　ただ、その言葉を口にした。
　どく、ん、という躍動。
　本当に、意識が、保てなくなっている。
　その前に―――俺は、自分の体を直視した。
　胸の古傷に、その『点』は存在する。
　俺と―――ロアの死ともいうべき『点』が。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry.”
Those were the only words I spoke.
Another broken pulse.
I truly could no longer hold on to consciousness.
Before it vanished, I looked directly at my own body.
The point was there,
in the old scar upon my chest—the point that meant death for both Roa and me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Sorry."
That's all I can say.
Thu, mp.
I, really, can't, keep, conscious.
Before that----I look at myself.
The "point" is on my scar.
The "point" of my death, of Roa's death.

entries.japanese:
―――遠野くん、言ったじゃないですか。
わたしを幸せにしてくれるって。
　なら、お願いですからこんなところで死なないでください。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Tohno, you promised. You said you would make me happy.
So please—don’t die here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Tohno-kun, you said it yourself.
That you'd make me happy.
So please, don't die here.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　だから、謝るしかない。
　許してくれなんて、そんな事は言えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
All I could do was apologize.
I had no right to ask her forgiveness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
That's why, all I can do is apologize.
I can't ask for forgiveness.

entries.japanese:
色々な事をしてあげたくて、けど結局は何一つ叶えてやれないっていうのなら。
　せめて、最後に。
　彼女を、こんなつまらない因縁から、解放するぐらいは、してやらないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had wanted to give her so many things, yet in the end I could grant her nothing.
At least, before the end.
I had to free her from this worthless bond.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though I wanted to do so much, it turns out that I won't be able to do anything for her.
Then at least, in the very end.
I should release her, from her terrible fate.

entries.japanese:
「―――――はあ」
　大きく息をはいて、ナイフを胸に突きつける。
　ナイフの先にあるものは『点』だ。
　あとは、力をいれるだけ。
　それだけで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
I breathed out and set the knife against my chest.
Its point rested over the point of death.
All I had to do was press.
That was all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------*sigh*
Taking a deep breath, I place my knife on my chest.
The "point" is at the tip of my knife.
All that's left is for me to push.
Just that.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――STOP.

entries.japanese:
……声が聞こえる。
　おそらくは幻聴だろう。
　…………遠野くん…………！
　泣き叫ぶような声が、校舎のほうから届いてきた。
　見れば、すっかり傷の塞がったシエルが、俺に向かって走ってきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I heard a voice.
It was probably nothing but an auditory hallucination.
Tohno—!
A voice like a scream of grief reached me from the school.
Ciel was running toward me, every one of her wounds already closed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can hear a voice.
It has to be a hallucination.
………… Tohno-kun…………!
A crying voice calls out from the school building.
Looking up, I see a fully healed Ciel running towards me.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……顔を見れば、決意が鈍る。
　きっと、申し訳なくて、ナイフを持つ力が無くなる。
　だから、彼女がやってくる前に。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
If I saw her face, my resolve would fail.
Shame and sorrow would drain the strength from the hand holding the knife.
So before she reached me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… If I see her face, I will lose my resolve.
Probably, I'll feel sorry and be unable to finish this.
That's why, before she comes.

entries.japanese:
ナイフを持つ手に力を入れた。
　スウ、と音もなく感触さえなく、ナイフの刃が体に透る。
　それだけで。
entries.maoEnglish:
I tightened my grip.
The blade passed into my body with no sound and no sensation.
That alone was enough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I strengthen the power in my hand.
The knife slides silently into my body.
With just that.

entries.japanese:
声は、それで消えた。
　一冊の古びた本。
　それが、パラパラとページを撒き散らしながら、　闇に蕩けていく幻視が、見えた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
The voice vanished.
I thought I saw an old book shedding its pages
in a flutter as it dissolved into the dark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice disappears.
An old book.
I thought I saw a illusion of it disappearing page by page into the darkness.

entries.japanese:
それだけで。
　もう何年も前に落ちたことのある、深い深い闇へと落ちていけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
That alone was enough to let me fall into the same deep,
deep darkness I had fallen into years before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
With that.
I was able to fall into the deep darkness I fell into years ago.

entries.japanese: 遠野くん、遠野くん……！
entries.maoEnglish: Tohno… Tohno…!
entries.mirrorMoon: Tohno-kun, Tohno-kun……!

entries.japanese: ―――声が、聞こえる。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――I could hear a voice.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----I hear, a voice.

entries.japanese: 遠野くん、そんな……どうして……！
entries.maoEnglish: Tohno, no… Why…?!
entries.mirrorMoon: Tohno-kun…… why……!?

entries.japanese:
―――ほら。
やっぱり思ったとおり。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――There. Just as I had known.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----See?
Just as I thought.

entries.japanese:
……やだ。
こんなの、わたしはイヤです……！
entries.maoEnglish: No… I don’t want this…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… No.
I don't want this……!

entries.japanese: ―――こうなふうに、泣きじゃくる声を聞けば。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Hearing her sob like this—
entries.mirrorMoon: ----If I heard this crying voice,

entries.japanese:
どうして……！？
　死なないって、死なないって言ったのに……！
entries.maoEnglish: Why?! You said you wouldn’t die—you promised you wouldn’t die…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Why……!?
You said you wouldn't die……!

entries.japanese: ―――――きっと、後悔すると、思ってた――――
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――I knew I would regret it――――
entries.mirrorMoon: ------I knew I would regret it----

entries.japanese:
―――――そこは、
　　　　　何処か懐かしい匂いのする病室だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Then I was in a hospital room
with a strangely familiar smell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----It was,
a hospital room that somehow seemed nostalgic.

entries.japanese:
「………………あ」
　呼吸がもれる。
「…………生き、てる」
　呼吸に合わせて胸が上下する。
　開きっぱなしの窓からは、気持ちのいい風がそそいできている。
　黄色のカーテンが風になびいている。
　外はハッとするほどの鮮やかな青空で、
　気温は春先のように、暖かだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Breath escaped me.
“I’m…
alive.”
My chest rose and fell.
A pleasant breeze poured through the open window, stirring yellow curtains.
Outside, the sky was a startling, vivid blue,
and the air was warm as the beginning of spring.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Ah."
I let out a breath.
"………… I'm, alive."
My chest moves up and down as I breathe.
A comfortable breeze blows in through the open window.
The yellow curtains sway playfully in the wind.
The fresh blue sky is enough to take my breath away.
The air is warm, like a spring day.

entries.japanese:
「生きてる……俺」
　呆然と呟いて、きょろきょろとあたりを見渡した。
　広い病室には誰もいない。
　俺はベッドに横になっていて、右腕には点滴のための針が刺さっている。
　胸には包帯があって――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m alive…”
I murmured in a daze and looked around.
The spacious room was empty.
I lay in bed with an IV needle in my right arm.
Bandages covered my chest—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm…… alive."
I look around as I speak to myself in amazement.
There's no one else in the spacious room.
I'm lying in bed with an IV in my right arm.
There's a large bandage on my chest----

entries.japanese:
「…………なんだよ、これ」
　点滴の針を外して、胸の包帯を取る。
　包帯が取れたあとには、何もなかった。
　あるのは自分の胸だけだ。
　包帯が巻いてあるという事は傷がある、という事なのに、胸には傷痕はおろか染み一つなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell is this?”
I pulled out the IV and unwound the bandages.
Beneath them was nothing.
There was only my bare chest.
Bandages implied a wound, yet there was no scar, not even a blemish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… What's this?"
I take out the IV and remove my bandage.
There's nothing under the bandage.

Only my chest.
Having a bandage there means there's a wound there, but there's not a trace whatsoever of anything.

entries.japanese:
……かすかに首をかしげる。
　俺は、胸に包帯を巻くような怪我を、したんだろうか。
「―――――」
　と。
開けっぱなしのドアの向こう。
　誰もいない廊下で、見知らぬ子供が病室を覗いていた。
「……………」
　きみ、と呼びかける前に、子供はどこかに歩いていってしまった。
――――――なんだろう、今のは。
「―――――なにか」
　忘れている気が、する。

「遠野、入るぞー」
　病室のドアがノックされて、有彦が入ってきた。

陽気に言って、有彦はベッドの傍までやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I tilted my head.
Had I suffered an injury serious enough to require bandaging my chest?
“…”
And then. Beyond the open door.
An unfamiliar child was peering into the room from the empty hallway.
“…”
Before I could call out, the child wandered away.
――――――What was that?
“Something…”
I felt as though I had forgotten something.
“Tohno, I’m coming in.”
Someone knocked, and Arihiko entered the room.
Still speaking cheerfully, Arihiko came over to the bedside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I tilt my head to the side questioningly.
Did I do something to get a wound on my chest?
"-----"
I look over to the open door.
From the empty hallway, some unknown child peers into the room.
"………………"
Before I can call out, the child walks away somewhere.
------What was that just now?
"-----Something."
I feel like, I forgot something.

"Tohno, I'm coming in."
The door gets knocked and Arihiko walks into the room.

"Yo, you're up?
Good, good.
We really couldn't talk much yesterday, but you seem a lot better now."
He cheerfully walks over to the side of the bed.

entries.japanese:
「……有彦。
おまえ、なにしてるんだ」
「はあ？
　何してるんだって、遠野の見舞いに来てやってるんだよ。
昨日と同じ質問しやがって、まだ寝ぼけてんのかおまえは」
「見舞いって―――誰の？」
「あのなあ。
そりゃあ二ヶ月も眠ってれば頭もボケるだろうけど、昨日と同じコトばっかり聞くなよな。
自分の事なんだから、医者にさんざん説明されたんじゃなかったのか？」
　呆れたふうに言って、有彦は椅子に座った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko… what are you doing here?”
“Huh? I’m here to visit you, obviously. You asked the same thing yesterday; are you still half asleep?”
“Visiting whom?”
“Come on—two months asleep would scramble anyone’s brains. Stop asking the same things you asked yesterday. Didn’t the doctor explain it all?”
With an exasperated look, Arihiko sat in the chair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arihiko.
What are you doing?"
"Huh?
What am I doing?
I'm here to check up on you.
You asked me that yesterday too.
You must still be out of it."
"Check up?----on who?"
"I'm sure your head would space out after sleeping for two months, but don't keep asking me the same things you asked me yesterday.
It's about your body, so didn't the doctor tell you about it?"
Saying that, Arihiko takes a seat in a nearby chair.

entries.japanese:
「…………え？」
　ますますワケが解らなくなって、頭を押さえる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Even more confused, I put a hand to my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Eh?"
I get even more confused, and I hold my head.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、医者に聞いてないのか？
　おまえさ、ここんとこずっと入院してたんだぜ」
「……ああ。
まあ、それはなんとなく解る、けど……」
「……ふーん。
もしかしたら遠野本人は解ってないかもしれないって医者は言ってたからな。
　ま、しゃーないか。
医者にあれこれ説明されるよりオレが教えてやったほうがフレンドリーってもんだろ」
　うむ、と鹿爪らしく腕を組んで、有彦は俺の目をまっすぐに見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What, the doctor didn’t tell you? You’ve been in the hospital all this time.”
“Right… I can see that much, sort of.”
“Hmm. The doctor did say you might not understand what had happened.
Fine, then. Better to hear it from a friend than get a clinical lecture.”
Arihiko folded his arms with mock gravity and looked me squarely in the eye.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, the doctor didn't say anything?
You've been here for a long time, you know."
"…… Yeah.
Well, I kind of figured that out, but……"
"…… Hmm.
The doctor did say you might not know what's going on.
Well, I guess it can't be helped… I guess it's more friendly for me to tell you than having a doctor tell you."
Crossing his arms and nodding to himself, Arihiko looks me in the eye.

entries.japanese:
「もう二ヶ月ぐらい前の話。
おまえさ、学校のグラウンドで倒れてたんだってさ」
「………グラウンド…………」
―――なんだろう。
　なにか、言われてみると心当たりがあるような気がする。
「陸上部の連中がさ、朝練の時に見つけたらしいぜ。
あいつら朝の五時には来るって話だから、遠野は夜のうちに倒れたんじゃないかって言われてるけど、どうなんだ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This was about two months ago. They found you collapsed on the school’s athletic field.”
“The field.”
―――What could it be?
Now that she mentioned it, something did ring a bell.
“The track team found you during morning practice. They arrive around five, so everyone figures you went down sometime in the night; any idea if that’s right?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It was two months ago.
You were found collapsed on the ground at school."
"……… Ground………"
----Why is it?
Now that he mentions it, I feel like I know something.
"It seems the track and field club found you during morning practice.
They come at around five o'clock in the morning, so they say you must have collapsed there during the night, but what's the truth?"

entries.japanese:
「いや―――どうなんだって言われても、わからない。
だいたいグラウンドで倒れてたって、俺はグラウンドになんか寄りつかないだろ」
「だよな。
ま、ともかく遠野が倒れていたワケだ。
　とりあえず傷もなければ出血もないからいつもの貧血ってコトで保健室に運ばれたんだが、これが一向に目を覚まさない。
　仕方ないっていうんで遠野んちに連絡して、そのまま病院に担ぎ込まれたんだよ、おまえは。
　それから二ヶ月近く、おまえさんは昏睡状態だったってわけ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How should I know? I don’t even go near the athletic field.”
“True. Anyway, there you were. With no wound or blood, they assumed it was your usual anemia and carried you to the infirmary; but you wouldn’t wake up.
They called your family and took you straight to the hospital.
You spent nearly two months in a coma.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um----Even if you ask, I don't know.
First of all, you say I was collapsed on the school grounds, but I never even go near there."
"Right.
Well, anyway, you were found there collapsed.
You weren't hurt or bleeding so you were taken to the clinic because they thought it was your anemia.
But you never woke up.
So we called your house and then you were brought to this hospital.
You've been in a coma for about two months since then."

entries.japanese: あっさりと、なんか物凄いことを有彦は言ってくれる。
entries.maoEnglish: Arihiko delivered that astonishing news as casually as the weather.
entries.mirrorMoon: Arihiko tells me an amazing story.

entries.japanese:
「二ヶ月も昏睡状態って―――それって、普通」
「ああ、医者のほうもサジを投げてたらしいぜ。
昏睡が一週間も続けば立派な植物人間だからな。
オレも昨日、おまえが目を覚まして『よっ、有彦』なんて声をかけてきた時は心臓止まるかと思った」
　あははは、と本気とも冗談ともとれる笑いをこぼす有彦。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A two-month coma—is that even…”
“The doctors had all but given up. Stay in a coma for a week and you’re officially a vegetable. When you woke yesterday and said, ‘Hey, Arihiko,’ I thought my heart had stopped.”
He laughed, and I couldn’t tell how much was a joke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A coma for two months----that's usually…"
"Yeah, even the doctor seemed to have thrown in the towel.
To be in a coma for even a week means you're a vegetable.
Then, yesterday, you just woke up and said "Yo, Arihiko".
I thought my heart would stop.
Ahahaha!"
He laughs heartily.

entries.japanese:
「ま、遠野はいつくたばってもおかしくないヤツだったからな。
オレはてっきりずっとあのままだと思ってた分、余計にびっくりしたのだ」
「……おまえな。
人がそんな状態だったっていうのに、随分なコトを言ってくれるじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, you’ve always looked liable to drop dead without warning. I’d convinced myself you would stay that way forever, which made it even more shocking.”
“You know, that’s awful. I was in that condition.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, you were always the kind who could have died any moment anyway.
So since I was thinking you'd be like that forever, it surprised me even more."
"…… Arihiko.
I'm in that kind of situation, and you're saying pretty mean things."

entries.japanese:
「いーじゃん、ちゃんと回復したんだから。
それにな、おまえが植物してた時は凄かったんだぞ。
　もう回復する見込みはないっていうのに秋葉ちゃんは毎日見舞いにきて、その時に先輩が来るもんだから居づらいのなんのって」
　ふふん、と意味ありげな笑みをうかべる有彦。
　……って、ちょっと待った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who cares? You recovered, and things got wild while you were doing your vegetable impression.
Even after the doctors said you’d never recover, your sister Akiha visited every day; then your favorite upperclassman would arrive, and I never knew where to look.”
Arihiko grinned suggestively.
Wait.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's fine, 'cause you healed.
But it was quite the amazing time while you were a vegetable.
Even though they said you had no hope of recovery, Akiha-chan came and visited you every day.
Senpai would come there at that time too, so it was really hard to be here."
Arihiko gives a meaningful laugh.
…… Wait, wait a minute.

entries.japanese:
「待て有彦。
その、秋葉ちゃんって何だ」
「秋葉ちゃんは秋葉ちゃんだ。
遠野の妹さんで、ここで顔を合わすたびにオレたちは親密な関係になったりならなかったり」
「……秋葉……そうか、あいつ見舞いにきてた、のか」
　……言われて、秋葉の事を思い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on, Arihiko. What’s this ‘dear Akiha’ business?”
“I mean your sister Akiha. Every time we met here, our relationship became either a little more intimate or a little less.”
“Akiha—so she came to visit.”
At his words, I remembered my sister.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait Arihiko.
What's with that 'Akiha-chan'?"
"Akiha-chan is Akiha-chan.
It's your younger sister and every time we see each other here, our relationship gets closer and farther."
"…… Akiha…… so, she came to visit me."
…… hearing that, I remember about Akiha.

entries.japanese:
有彦の言うとおり、俺はまだ寝ぼけているのか。
　なんだかこの病室以外の事を忘れてしまっている。
　……言われれば思い出すからどうという事はないのだが、なんだか自分がふわふわしているようで不思議な感じがする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps Arihiko was right and I was still half asleep. Everything beyond this room seemed to have fallen out of my memory.
It returned when someone prompted me, so perhaps it was nothing—but I felt strangely weightless and unreal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Like Arihiko said, I must still be out of it.
It's like I forgot about everything outside of this hospital room.
…… Well, I remember whenever he tells me about it, so it doesn't really matter.
But I feel really light and feel like something's strange.

entries.japanese:
「……けど秋葉と会ってたのか。
……わるいな有彦。
あいつ、わりときついだろ？
　時々厳しいコトを言ってくるだろうけど、大目に見てやってくれ」
「わりと、時々！
　すごいな遠野、オレは今ほどおまえを大物と思ったコトはないぞ！」
　有彦は椅子に座って、腕組みをして、嬉しいんだかひきつっているんだか解らない笑い声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you’ve met Akiha. Sorry, Arihiko. She can be rather severe. She may say some harsh things now and then, but try not to hold it against her.”
“Rather and now and then?! Amazing, Tohno—I’ve never thought you such a giant among men!”
Seated with his arms folded, Arihiko laughed in a way that sounded equally delighted and traumatized.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You met Akiha?
…… Sorry Arihiko.
She's pretty up-tight, right?
She says some harsh things sometimes, but please overlook it."
"'Pretty'!?
'Sometimes'!?
Amazing, Tohno.
I never thought you were that great of a guy until now!"
Sitting in the chair with his arms still crossed, he laughs out loud.

entries.japanese:
有彦はいつも通りだ。
　正直、自分がどうなってしまったのか全然解っていないけど、こいつの底抜けの陽気さのおかげで気分が落ち着いてくれた。
「―――――はあ」
　ベッドに体を預けて、深く深呼吸をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arihiko was exactly as ever.
I had no idea what had happened to me, but his bottomless good humor steadied my nerves.
“Haa…”
I sank back against the bed and drew a long breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arihiko is like he usually is.
To be honest, I don't know what happened to me, but his infinite supply of cheerfulness does calm me down.
-----*sigh*
Leaning back on the bed, I take a deep breath.

entries.japanese:
「おっと、そろそろ診察の時間か。
それじゃまたな。
先輩も連れてこようとしたんだけど、学校で会うからいいって来なかったんだよ」
「え……先、輩？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oops, nearly time for your examination. I’ll see you later. I tried to bring Ciel too, but she said she’d see you at school, so she stayed away.”
“Ciel?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, it's about time for your examination.
Then I'll see ya' later.
I was going to bring Senpai along, but she said she wouldn't come because she knew she was going to see you at school."
"Eh…… Sen, pai?"

entries.japanese:
「そっ。
今までオレと交代で来てたんだぜ。
だっていうのに、昨日おまえが起きてすぐ先輩に抱きついたりするから、もう病院には行きませんってヘソまげちまったんだ。
先輩怒ってたからな、言い訳ぐらい考えとけよ」
　言って、有彦は病室から去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah. She and I took turns visiting. But yesterday, the moment you woke up, you grabbed her and held on, so she got offended and swore she wasn’t coming back to the hospital. She was furious, so you’d better prepare an excuse.”
With that, Arihiko left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah.
We've been taking turns seeing you.
Well, yesterday you woke up and hugged her right away, so she kind of got angry and said she wouldn't come here anymore.
She was angry, so you should think up an excuse or something."
Saying that, Arihiko leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「…………先輩？」
　ちょっと、よく、思い出せない。
　自分にとって先輩っていったらあの人しかいない。
　名前も、顔も、どんな人だったかも知っている。
　なのに、どうしてか。
　俺は、その先輩とやらの事を深く考えていけない気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel…?”
I couldn’t quite remember.
There was only one person the name could mean.
I knew her face and what kind of person she was.
Yet, for some reason.
I felt I must not think too deeply about her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Senpai?"
I can't, quite remember.
To me, there's only one person who I call Senpai.
The person's name, face, and personality, I know them all.
So why?
Why do I feel like I shouldn't think deeply about this Senpai?

entries.japanese:
ふわふわしている。
　二ヶ月も昏睡していたせいで、体がまったく動いてくれないせいだろうか。
　なんだか、足りないモノがある気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
I was floating.
Perhaps it was only because two months asleep had left my body helpless.
Even so, I felt that something was missing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel light.
It's probably because I've been asleep for two months and my body doesn't move at all.
I feel like, something is missing.

entries.japanese:
―――そういえば、もう一つおかしな所がある。
　自分はこの病室には見覚えがあった。
　けど、俺の記憶が確かなら。
　八年前のあの病院は、もうとっくになくなっているハズなんだけど――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――There was another strange thing.
I recognized this hospital room.
But if my memory was right.
The hospital from eight years ago had been gone for years—
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Come to think of it, there's one other thing that's strange.
I remember seeing this hospital room before.
But, if my memory serves me correctly,
that hospital room from eight years ago has to have been long gone by now-------

entries.japanese:
翌日、屋敷に帰ってきた。
　長く眠っていたせいか、自分の家に帰ってくるのはひどく久しぶりのような気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
The next day, I returned to the mansion.
Perhaps because I had slept so long, coming home felt like returning after an age away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The following day, I return to the mansion.
Probably because I was asleep for so long, it feels like forever since I've been back at my own house.

entries.japanese:
「………？」
　屋敷の玄関に向かう前に、屋敷の林に立ち寄ったあと、おかしな場所に出た。
「…………」
　……知らなかった。
　屋敷の林の奥に、こんな和風の屋敷があったなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm…?”
Before going to the front entrance.
