I took a detour through the woods and emerged somewhere strange.
“…”
I had never known there was an old Japanese house this deep in the mansion’s grounds.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………?"
Before I go to the door to the mansion, I take a walk in the woods and come out to a strange place.
"………"
…… I never knew it.
I never knew there was a Japanese style building like this here.

entries.japanese:
「――――――！」
　がさり、と背後で物音がした。
　振りかえると、そこには―――
　見知らぬ、子供がぼんやりと立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Something rustled behind me.
I turned, and there—
—an unfamiliar child stood staring vacantly into space.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
I hear a commotion behind me.
I whirl around and see----
some kid just standing there.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……迷い込んだのだろうか。
　子供はどこか浮世離れしていて、それこそ幽霊か何かのようだ。
　ただ、その胸。
　着物がはだけたその胸にある何かの痕が、ひどく――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Had the child wandered in by mistake?
There was something unearthly about that figure, almost ghostlike.
But its chest.
A mark where the kimono had fallen open seemed terribly—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… Did he get lost?
He seems quite detached, almost like a ghost or something.
It's just, on his chest.
That scar on his chest showing through his kimono is terribly----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、何をしていらっしゃるんです？」
「え――――琥珀、さん？」
「はい、志貴さんをお迎えにあがりました。
玄関で待っていたんですけど、志貴さんったら庭のほうに歩いていってしまうんですもの。
わたし、なんか驚いちゃいました」
　琥珀さんはいつも通り、こっちが嬉しくなるような笑顔を浮かべている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, what are you doing here?”
“What—Kohaku?”
“I came to welcome you home, Master Shiki. I was waiting at the entrance, but you wandered off toward the garden. You gave me quite a surprise.”
Kohaku wore her usual smile, the kind that made everyone around her feel happier.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, what are you doing?"
"Eh----Kohaku, san?"
"Yes, I came to greet you.
I was waiting for you by the doorway, but you headed towards the garden instead.
I was a little surprised."
As usual, Kohaku-san has that cheerful smile.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、ちょっと寄り道しただけなんだけど。
琥珀さん、さっきの子はどこの子？」
「はい？
　子供って、なんの事ですか？」
　琥珀さんはさっきの子供を見なかったみたいだ。
「いや、見なかったならいいんだ。
それじゃ屋敷に行こうか。
秋葉のヤツ、待ってるんだろ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I only took a little detour. Kohaku, who was that child just now?”
“What? What child do you mean?”
Apparently she hadn’t seen the child. “Never mind, then. Let’s go to the mansion. Akiha is waiting, isn’t she?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I was just walking around.
Kohaku-san do you know who that kid is?"
"Huh?
A kid?
What do you mean?"
It seems like Kohaku-san didn't see that kid.
"No, if you didn't see him, that's fine.
Shall we go back?
Akiha's probably waiting."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、秋葉さまは何もおっしゃりませんけど、今朝はずっとロビーのほうでぐるぐると歩きまわってらっしゃるんです。
きっと志貴さんのお帰りを今か今かとお待ちしているんですよ」
「―――そっか。
そりゃあ早く行かないとどんな文句を言われるかわからないな」
「はい、急ぎましょう志貴さん」
　琥珀さんは俺の手をとって屋敷へと走り始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha hasn’t said anything, but she has been pacing round and round the foyer all morning. I’m sure she can hardly wait for you to come home, Master Shiki.”
“I see. We’d better hurry, then, or there’s no telling what she’ll complain about.”
“Yes—let’s hurry, Master Shiki.”
Kohaku took my hand and ran toward the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, Akiha-sama didn't say anything, but she was pacing back and forth in the lobby all morning.
I'm sure she is anxiously waiting for you, Shiki-san."
"-----Oh.
Then I should hurry up or who knows how mad at me she'll get."
"Yes, let's hurry, Shiki-san."
Kohaku-san takes my hand and we run to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
―――去り際。
　後ろ髪を引かれた気がして、もう一度だけ和風の屋敷に振りかえった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――As we left.
I felt reluctant to go and looked back at the old Japanese house one last time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----As we leave,
I felt like someone called me, and I look back at the Japanese style building.

entries.japanese:
……幻だろうか。
　子供はじっと、何か言いたそうな目をして、走り去っていく俺の背中を見つめていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps it was an illusion.
The child stood motionless, watching my retreating back with eyes full of something left unsaid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Is it an illusion?
The kid just stares as we run towards the mansion, as if he wanted to say something.

entries.japanese:
何かが欠けたまま、遠野志貴はもとの生活に戻っていた。
　屋敷に帰って、秋葉に小言を言われて、朝になったら翡翠に起こされて、琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食を食べて屋敷を出る。
―――なにか、欠けている。
　それを思い出せないまま、学校に着いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Still missing something, Shiki Tohno returned to his old life.
He came home, endured Akiha’s scolding, woke each morning when Hisui roused him, ate the breakfast Kohaku had made, and left for school.
―――Something was missing.
Unable to remember what it was, I arrived at school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even if something does seem missing, the life of Tohno Shiki returns to normal.
I'm back at the mansion, Akiha scolds me, Hisui wakes me up in the morning, and after eating the breakfast Kohaku-san made, I leave the mansion.
----There's something missing.
Without being able to remember what it is, I get to school.

entries.japanese:
「よっ、おはようさん。
もう学校に来ていいんだ、おまえ」
　気軽に声をかけてくる有彦。
「あとしばらくはリハビリだって聞いたけどな。
そっか、そんなに無理して学校に来るっていう事は、やっぱりそういうコトですか」
　にしし、と意味ありげな笑いをする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning. They’re letting you come back already?”
Arihiko greeted me as casually as ever.
“I heard you still had weeks of rehabilitation. So if you’re pushing yourself this hard to get here, I suppose it means exactly what I think it means.”
He grinned knowingly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yo, morning.
You can come back to school now?"
Arihiko greets me cheerfully.
"I heard you had to rehabilitate for a while.
I see, for you to come to school like this must be because of that."
Arihiko gives a meaningful laugh.

entries.japanese:
「そうだよなあ、あと一ヶ月ちょいで卒業式だもんな。
一緒にいられるのもあと少しっていうワケだ」
　……？
「……わからないな。
一緒にいられるって、誰とだよ」
「誰とって、そりゃあおまえ――――」
　有彦の声が止まる。
　たっ、たっ、たっ、という軽快な足音が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Makes sense—graduation is barely a month away. You don’t have much time left together.”
…?
“I don’t understand. Together with whom?”
“Obviously, I mean you and—”
Arihiko fell silent.
Light, quick footsteps came tapping toward us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
It's only a month until graduation.
That means you can be together for only a bit longer."
……?
"…… What do you mean?
Together, with who?"
"With who!?
Of course you and----"
Arihiko cuts off.
I hear quick footsteps.

entries.japanese:
明るい春先の陽射しの下。
　息を弾ませて、彼女は目の前に現れた。
「おはようございます。
今日もいい天気ですね、遠野くん！」
　その人はいつも通りの笑顔をしていた。
「―――――先、輩」
　息がつまる。
　そうだ。
どうして俺は、この人のコトを思い出さずにいたんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The bright early-spring sun shone down.
She appeared before us, a little out of breath.
“Good morning! Beautiful weather again today, isn’t it, Tohno?”
She wore the same smile as always.
“Ciel—”
My breath caught.
Of course. How had I managed not to remember her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Underneath the bright, early spring sunshine.
Breathing quickly, she appears before me.
"Good morning.
Great weather today, isn't it, Tohno-kun!"
She gives her usual smile.
"------Sen, pai."
I gasp.
That's right.
Why, couldn't I remember about her until now?

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　おはようございます、ですけど」
「あ―――うん、おはよう、先輩」
　ぎこちない仕草で挨拶を返す。
　先輩はどこか納得いかないような顔で首をかしげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? I said good morning.”
“Ah—right, good morning, Ciel.”
I returned the greeting stiffly.
She tilted her head, looking unconvinced.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
Um… I said good morning…"
"Ah----yeah, good morning, Senpai."
I reply awkwardly.
She seems a bit puzzled and tilts her head.

entries.japanese:
「もうっ、せっかく退院したっていうのに元気がないです。
わたし、遠野くんが元気になってるって聞いて楽しみにしてたのに」
「楽しみにしてた……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, you’ve finally left the hospital, but you don’t look happy at all. I heard you were better, and I’ve been looking forward to this.”
“Looking forward to it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez.
You finally got out of the hospital but you're not cheerful at all.
I was so looking forward to seeing you again."
"Looking forward to……?"

entries.japanese:
どうしてか、思い出せない。
　なにがあったのか。
　この人とはすごく大切なコトをしあった気がするんだけど、思い出せない。
　俺が覚えているコトといえば、この人は三年の先輩で、どうしてか俺と有彦と気が合って、昼休みに三人で過ごしていた事ぐらいしか、思い出せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
For some reason, I couldn’t remember.
What had happened.
I felt that we had shared something terribly important, but it would not come back.
All I knew was that she was a third-year student who had somehow become friends with Arihiko and me, and that the three of us used to spend lunch together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Why can't I remember?

Did something happen?
I feel like something very important happened between the two of us, but I can't remember.
All I can remember is that she's a third year upperclassman who took a liking to me and Arihiko for some reason, and that we would spend lunchtime together.

entries.japanese:
……思い出せない。
　他のことは思い出せない。
それは悲しかったり辛かったりする事だから、いらないモノだと切り捨てたみたいに、思い出せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I couldn’t remember.
I couldn’t remember anything else. It was as if I had discarded every painful or sorrowful thing as something I did not need.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can't remember.
I can't remember anything else.
It's like I forgot about everything else because it was so sad or difficult that I cut the unneeded memories away.

entries.japanese:
「もう、遠野くんったら約束を忘れたんですか？」
　先輩は不満そうに見つめてくる。
―――約束。
　　　約束。
　　　大切な、約束――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten our promise.” She looked at me reproachfully.
―――A promise.
A promise.
A precious promise—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, Tohno-kun, did you forget our promise?" Senpai looks at me disappointedly.
----Promise.
Promise.
An important, promise----

entries.japanese:
「ほら、今度三人で街に遊びに行こうって言ったじゃないですか。
遠野くん、その前日に倒れちゃって病院に運ばれちゃいましたけど」
　本当に、そんな些細なコトが楽しみそうな顔だったから。
　他のことなんて、もうどうでもよくなってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We said the three of us would go into town together. You collapsed the day before and were taken to the hospital, though.”
She looked genuinely happy about such a trivial little outing.
Everything else ceased to matter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, you said that the three of us would hang out in town.
But, you collapsed the day before that and had to go to the hospital."
She looks like she really was looking forward to that little thing.
So I didn't care about anything else.

entries.japanese:
「……そう、だね。
そういえば、そうだった」
「はい。
今度は忘れないでくださいね、遠野くん」
「いや、今度こそ忘れていいぞ遠野。
そん時こそオレは先輩と二人っきりでキメにかかるからな」
　……いつか聞いたような事を有彦は繰り返す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right… Yes, now I remember.”
“Good. Don’t forget again, Tohno.”
“No, feel free to forget next time, Tohno. Then I’ll make my move when the two of us are alone.”
Arihiko repeated something I felt I had heard before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
Yeah, that's right."
"Yes.
Please don't forget it this time, Tohno-kun."
"No, you can go ahead and forget, Tohno.
Then Senpai and I can have fun by ourselves."
…… Arihiko repeats what I heard sometime before.

entries.japanese:
「だめですっ！
　こんな機会はもうないかもしれないんですから、今回だけは三人で行かないと！」
　むっ、と先輩は珍しく怒っている。
「そ、そんなコトないですって。
オレたちまだ学生なんだから、遊びに行く機会なんていくらでもあるじゃないッスか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No! We may never get another chance like this, so this time all three of us are going!”
She was actually angry, an uncommon sight.
“Th-that’s not true—we’re still students. We’ll have plenty of chances to go out together.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That won't do!
We may not have a chance to do this again, so this time it has to be the three of us!"
She seems unusually angry.
"Th, that's not true.
We're still students, so we can always hang out."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、たしかに遠野くんや乾くんはお暇でしょうけど、わたしは春から忙しいんです。
進学先がちょっと遠いですから、そう簡単にこっちには戻ってこれません」
「あ。
そっか、先輩って、たしか―――」
　言葉を飲む有彦。
　俺には先輩の言っている意味がわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You and Tohno may have all the time in the world, but I’ll be busy from spring onward. I’m going quite far away to continue my studies, so I won’t be able to come back easily.”
“Oh. Right, you’re going to—”
Arihiko swallowed the rest.
I had no idea what she meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, certainly you and Tohno-kun will have lots of free time, but I will be very busy starting in spring.
The university I plan on attending is a little far, so it will not be easy to come back here."
"Ah.
That's right.
Senpai, you----"
Arihiko stops mid-sentence.
I don't understand what she's talking about though.

entries.japanese:
「はい、卒業したら外国に留学するんです。
一人前のケーキ職人になるのが夢でしたから」
――――なんか、笑顔で。
　先輩は、とんでもないコトを口にした。
「……先輩。
留学するって、この街に残るんじゃないのか……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, after graduation I’m going abroad to train. I’ve always dreamed of becoming a proper pastry chef.”
――――Somehow, she was smiling.
Then she said something unthinkable.
“Ciel, you’re going abroad? I thought you were staying in this city.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, after I graduate, I plan on going overseas to study.
It's always been my dream to become a master at crafting cakes."
----With such a smile,
Senpai says something outrageous.
"…… Senpai.
Then, you won't be staying here……?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ、残りますよ。
わたしの家はこの街にあるんですから、あちらに永住するコトなんてないです。
　お父さんをいつまでも一人にしておけないですし。
　ただお弟子にとってくれるっていう職人さんは厳しい方ですから、少なくとも三年は帰ってこれないでしょうけど……」
――――――――な、に？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll come back. My home is here; I could never settle abroad for good. And I can’t leave my father alone forever.
But the chef who has agreed to take me on is strict, so I doubt I’ll be home for at least three years…”
――――――――What?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I'll stay here.
My house is here, so I don't plan on going to live over there.
I can't exactly leave my father alone either.
But the person I will be studying under is very strict, so I won't be able to come back for at least three years……"
--------What?

entries.japanese:
「けど、わたしが子供のころから憧れていたコトですから。
わたしが住み込みで働かせていただくお店はですねー、王室ご用達の職人さんなんです。
　家系の人以外はお弟子にとってくれないお店なんですけど、筋はいいからすぐに来なさい、なんて内定までいただいちゃいました」
　先輩は嬉しそうに、俺にはよく分からない世界の話をしてくれる。
「そう―――それは、良かった、けど」
―――三年も、離れ離れになるなんて、どうして。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s been my dream since I was a child. The shop where I’ll live and work holds a Royal Warrant.
They never accept apprentices from outside the family, but they told me I had talent and should come at once, even offering me the position.”
Ciel happily told me about a world I knew nothing about.
“I see—that’s wonderful, but…”
―――Why did three years apart feel so unbearable?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it's always been my childhood dream.
The place I'm going to work as a live-in employee is a craftsman for the king.
Normally non-relatives are not allowed to work there, but he told me I had great talent, so I am able to go there."
Senpai happily speaks of another world I didn't even know existed.
"Oh----that's, great but."
----She'll be gone for three years… why?

entries.japanese:
「はい、ありがとうございます。
三年は長いですけど、遠野くんなら待っていてくれますよね？」
　上目遣いで、先輩は照れ隠しの微笑みをする。
「わたしがいないからって浮気しちゃイヤですよ。
　遠野くんは情にほだされやすいところがありますから、ホントは連れていきたいぐらいなんですけどねー」
　はあ、とため息をつく先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. Three years is a long time, but you’ll wait for me, won’t you, Tohno?”
She looked up at me through her lashes with a shy, deflecting smile.
“Don’t be unfaithful while I’m gone, because you’re far too easily swayed by affection. Honestly, I wish I could take you with me.”
She sighed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, thank you very much.
Three years is a long time, but you can wait that long, right Tohno-kun?"
Senpai gives a faint smile to hide her embarrassment.
"Now don't be unfaithful because I'm gone, Tohno-kun.
You have a tendency to get swept away easily, so really, I want to take you with me."
Senpai sighs.

entries.japanese:
「え―――あの、先輩？」
「けどそういうワケにもいきませんね。
遠野くんはまだ学生さんですし、なにより秋葉さんを説き伏せるなんて一年や二年じゃ絶対無理でしょう？
　ですから今回は遠野くんを信じて、三年間だけ離れる事にしたんです」
　……なんか、先輩はひどく強気な発言をしてくる。
　俺の隣にいる有彦なんか、先輩の言葉を聞いてあんぐりと口を開けているぐらいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait—Ciel?”
“But that won’t do. You’re still in school, and persuading Akiha would take far more than a year or two. So this time I’ve decided to trust you and endure only three years apart.”
She was making astonishingly forceful claims.
Beside me, Arihiko’s mouth hung open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh----Um, Senpai?"
"But, that just can't be. You're still a student, and it would be impossible to convince Akiha-san in a year or two.
So this time I will just trust you and leave for three years."
…… Senpai declares this fiercely.
Arihiko takes this all in with his mouth hanging wide open.

entries.japanese:
「そういうわけで、三人で遊びに行けるなんて今回が最後かもしれないんです。
ですから今度こそ、ちゃんとした思い出を作らせてください」
　彼女は、本当に嬉しそうに言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s why this may be our last chance to go out together, all three of us. So please—this time, let me make a real memory of it.”
She sounded truly happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So.
This may be the last time the three of us get to play together.
So this time, please let me make a good memory out of it."
She sounds truly happy as she says this.

entries.japanese:
―――――ズキン、と。
　　　　　胸の古傷が痛んだ、気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――A sharp throb.
I thought the old scar on my chest had hurt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Throb.
It feels like, the scar on my chest hurts.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　どうしました、胸なんか押さえちゃって。
まだ体が痛むんですか？」
「あ――いや、別に。
胸には傷なんてないから、ただの気のせいだよ」
　答えて、なにかおかしいな、と思った。
　辻褄が、ズレてしまっている、気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? Why are you holding your chest? Does it still hurt?”
“No—it’s nothing. There isn’t any wound on my chest, so I must have imagined it.”
As I answered, I sensed something wrong.
The pieces no longer fit together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
What's wrong?
Grabbing your chest like that, are you still hurt?"
"Ah--no, not really.
My chest was never injured, so it's just your imagination."
As I answer, it feels strange.
It's like, something is inconsistent.

entries.japanese:
予鈴がなった。
　じき朝のホームルームだ。
「それじゃまたお昼休みに行きますね」
　先輩は一足先に校舎へと去ろうとする。
　その前に、一つだけ聞いてみた。
「――――先輩。
先輩のお父さんって、どんな人だっけ」
entries.maoEnglish:
The warning bell rang.
Homeroom would begin soon.
“I’ll come see you again at lunch.”
She turned toward the school ahead of us.
Before she left, I asked one question.
“Ciel. What was your father like again?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The first bell rings.
Morning homeroom is about to start.
"Then I'll come again at lunch break, okay?"
Senpai disappears towards the school building.
Before she can do that, I ask her a question.
"----Senpai.
Your father, what kind of person is he?"

entries.japanese:
「え？
　遠野くん、お父さんを知ってるでしょ？
　わたしの家は隣街でパン屋さんをやっていて、前に買いに来てくれたじゃないですか。
　お父さん、遠野くんのこと愉快な青年だって気に入ってくれましたし」
　彼女は、本当に嬉しそうに言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? You know my father. My family runs a bakery in the next town, and you came to buy bread once.
He liked you—said you were an amusing young man.”
She sounded genuinely delighted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh?
Tohno-kun, you know my father, don't you?
My family has a bakery at the nearby town and you came to buy from there before.
My father said you were such a pleasant young man too."
She sounds truly happy as she says this.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――――」
　……そう言われてみれば、そんな気がする。
―――でも、それは違うんだ。
　先輩。
あなたのお父さんが、生きているハズなんて、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Now that she mentioned it, I almost felt it was true.
―――But that was wrong.
Ciel. There was no way your father could still be alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------"
…… Now that she mentions it, I think it did happen.
----But, that's wrong.
Senpai.
There is no way your father can be alive.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？」
　先輩が話しかけてくる。
　あたりは急速に熱を失っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno?”
She called to me.
The world around us rapidly lost its warmth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?"
Senpai calls out to me.
Everything suddenly turns colder.

entries.japanese:
「気付いちゃったんですか、遠野くん？」
　どこか物悲しい声で、そんな事を聞いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You noticed, didn’t you, Tohno?”
Her voice was touched with sorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You realized it, Tohno-kun?"
She asks me, somewhat sadly.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ああ、気がついた」
　言って、瞳が涙で滲んだ。
―――気がつかなければよかった。
　そうすれば―――このまま幸せなままで、誰も傷つくことのない世界が続いていただろうから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes—I noticed.”
Tears blurred my sight as I said it.
―――I wished I hadn’t.
Then this happy world where no one was hurt might have continued forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Yeah, I did."
I say that as tears fill my eyes.
----I wish I never realized it.
Then----I could have continued to live happily in this world where no one gets hurt.

entries.japanese:
「すごいですね。
普通、気がつかないものなんですよ、こういうのって。
おかしな所とか辻褄が合わない所とか、そんな都合の悪い事はみんな無視しちゃうのに」
「――――そうだね。
少しぐらいおかしくても、それが幸せであるのなら、無視すれば良かった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s remarkable. Usually people never notice these things. They let every contradiction and oddity pass—anything inconvenient.”
“Yes. If it made me happy, I should have let a little inconsistency pass.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Amazing.
Normally, people never realize it.
Usually, they ignore all the inconvenient inconsistencies."
"----Yeah.
Even if it was a little strange, if I was happy, I should have ignored it."

entries.japanese:
「そうですよ。
そんな事にさえ嘘をつけないなんて、ほんと、正直なんですから」
　……先輩は。
　先輩に似た彼女は、本当に悲しそうに、そんな言葉を口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You should have. You’re so painfully honest that you can’t lie even about this.”
Ciel— No.
The girl who resembled her spoke those words with genuine sadness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right. To be not able to lie about such things, you really are honest."
…… Senpai.
The girl who looks like Senpai, says this with incredible sadness.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　ひどく、彼女に申し訳がなくって、胸が後悔でしめつけられた。
　でも仕方がないじゃないか。
　以前のままの学園生活。
　まるでこの街の住人のようなシエル先輩。
　あの傷から生きていて、八年前の胸の傷痕さえない遠野志貴。
　……悲しいことなんて何一つない、今までに似た時間。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Regret constricted my chest, and I felt terribly guilty toward her.
But what else could I do?
School life exactly as before.
Ciel as though she had always belonged to this city.
Shiki Tohno alive after that wound, without even the scar from eight years ago.
Time resembling the past, with nothing sorrowful in it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I really feel sorry, and regret tightens in my chest.
But, it really couldn't be helped.
My school life from before.
The Ciel-senpai that seems like she's lived in this town.
The Tohno Shiki who survived that wound without a single scar on his chest.
…… These days similar to the original days without a single moment of unhappiness.

entries.japanese:
―――それが、あんまりにも幸福だから。
　　　これが夢だと、わかってしまった。
　
「やだなあ。
遠野くんはいつもそうですよね。
些細な事は見逃してくれるくせに、本当に見逃してほしい事だけは気がついてしまう。
それが遠野くんのいい所なのかもしれません。
　けど、それでも――――」
　最後に、恨むように俺を見て。
「今回ぐらいは、見逃してくれても良かったのに」
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It was all too perfectly happy.
And so I understood that it was a dream.
“Oh, Tohno. You’re always like this. You let all the little things pass, yet you notice the one thing I desperately want you to let pass. Perhaps that is one of your virtues.
But even so…”
At the end, she looked at me almost resentfully.
“Just this once, I wish you had let it pass.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
----That, was just too happy.
and I knew this was a dream.
"Geez, you are always like this Tohno-kun.
Even though you overlook so many trivial things, you realize the one thing that you really wish you wouldn't.
But, that is one of your good traits, I suppose.
But still----"
She looks at me regretfully.
"You should have at least overlooked it this time."

entries.japanese:
……先輩の姿は、消えた。
　世界も。
　同じように、消えていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then she vanished.
The world did too.
It faded away just as she had.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Senpai disappears.
And so does the world.
It disappears in the same way.

entries.japanese:
――――――そうして、何もかもなくなった。
　ようやく相応しい世界になってくれたらしい。
　俺は死んで。
いや、死んでいたらこんな幻の途中にさえいないだろうから、死に至る直前なのかもしれない。
　まあ、ともかく―――ここが『死』という地点に限りなく近い、という事だけは確かだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――And then there was nothing.
At last, the world had taken a form appropriate to me.
I was dead. No—if I were truly dead, I could not linger inside even this illusion, so perhaps I was poised just before death.
In any case, this place was unquestionably as close to the point called death as it was possible to come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------And, everything disappears.
The world returns to the way it should be.
I died.
No, if I was dead, I even wouldn't have seen such a dream, so I might be on the very verge of death then.
Well, anyway----it's certain that this has to be quite close to "death".

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……不思議と、恐怖は感じなかった。
　自分が死んでしまったにしろ、もうすぐ消えてしまうにしろ、本当はとっくに消えてしまっているにしろ。
　今は、自分なんかの事よりあの人のほうが大切だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Strangely, I wasn’t afraid.
Whether I had died, was about to vanish, or had really vanished long ago…
none of it mattered as much as she did now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
…… Strangely, I'm not afraid.
No matter if I'm already dead, or about to disappear, or have already disappeared,
Right now, that person is more important to me than myself.

entries.japanese:
「…………先、輩」
　さっきまで俺の前で笑っていた人。
　あんなに嬉しそうに、こんな都合のいい作り話を語っていたシエル。
　イヤな事も苦しかった事もなくて、あの人が望んだままの、当たり前の日常の話。
　悲しいことなんて何もなくて、ただ、それなりに平凡で、それなりに輝かしい事がある世界。
entries.maoEnglish:
“C-Ciel”
The woman who had been smiling at me moments ago.
Ciel, so happy as she told me this convenient little story.
A perfectly ordinary life, just as she had always wanted it, with no pain and nothing terrible anywhere.
A world without sorrow, modestly uneventful and modestly bright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Sen, pai."
That person who was smiling before me earlier.
Ciel, who has so happily told me this fairy tale.
Without pain or suffering, a completely ordinary life, a story as she wanted.
No sadness at all, just a very common-place life, a radiant world.

entries.japanese:
俺や有彦にとってみれば、退屈すぎて何の価値も見出せなかった毎日の繰り返し。
　それが。
そんな、つまらない、ものが。
「―――あの人にとって、かけがえのない、夢だったんだ」
　呟いて、悲しくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
To Arihiko and me, it had been nothing but the same dreary days repeating themselves, too dull to have any value.
And yet. Something so ordinary, so worthless…
“To her, it was an irreplaceable dream.”
I murmured it, and sorrow overcame me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
To me or Arihiko, it was a completely boring repetition of days without any value.
That, that boring thing was.
"----To her, it was an unfulfillable dream."
Thinking aloud, I feel sad.

entries.japanese:
俺は自分の勝手な考えで、自らの命を断った。
　そのあとの事なんて深く考えなかった。
　こんなものが、あの人の夢だったというのなら。
　俺は、どんなに無様で、どんなに酷い人間になってしまったとしても。
　彼女の傍にいて、彼女に助けられながら、彼女を守っていくべきだったんじゃ、なかったのかって。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had taken my own life for selfish reasons.
I had never thought deeply about what would happen afterward.
If this was what she had dreamed of. Then no matter how pathetic I became, no matter how cruel a man…
Shouldn’t I have stayed beside her—letting her save me even as I protected her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I selfishly ended my life.
I didn't think deeply about what would happen afterwards.
If this was what her dream was, then no matter how terrible I become or how pitiful I become,
Maybe I should have stayed beside her, being helped by her and protecting her.

entries.japanese:
「それはシエルという人の願いだよ。
志貴という君の願いじゃないんだから、気にする必要はないんじゃない？」
entries.maoEnglish: “But that was Ciel’s wish, not yours. It wasn’t what Shiki wanted, so why let it trouble you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That is the wish of the person called Ciel.
It is not the wish of you yourself as Shiki, so you don't need to worry about it, right?"

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――What?

entries.japanese:
「遠野志貴は考えられる、およそ最善の行為を行ったんだよ。
それをシエルという他人の思惑と天秤にかけるコトはいらないよ。
そんなことをすると、さっきみたいに人のユメにひっぱられるコトになる」
entries.maoEnglish: “Shiki Tohno did just about the best thing he could have done. There’s no need to weigh that against what someone else—Ciel—wanted. Do that, and another person’s dream will sweep you away again, just like before.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno Shiki has acted on what he thought was the best choice.
You don't need to burden yourself with what Ciel wants.
If you do that, you will be burdened by someone else's dream like earlier."

entries.japanese: ――――もう、俺以外は誰もいないのに、声が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――There is no one here but me anymore, and yet I hear a voice.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Although there's no one other than me here anymore, I can hear someone else's voice.

entries.japanese:
「うん、ユメから冷めてしまった志貴だから、ここには志貴以外のイメージはありえない。
　なんだ、少しは頭が働くようじゃないか、遠野志貴」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right—the Shiki who woke from the dream is the only image that can exist here.
Well, Shiki Tohno, it seems your head still works a little.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah.
You woke yourself from the dream, so there is nothing else here besides Shiki.
I see, you can use your brain a little, Tohno Shiki."

entries.japanese: ――――それじゃ、おまえは。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Then you’re…
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Then, you are.

entries.japanese:
「ううん、勘違いはしないでほしいな。
ロアはとっくに君に殺されたよ。
　だいたいね、ロアが生き残っていたら君がまだ残っているハズはないじゃないか。
　君は、とうに死んでいるのに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, don’t get the wrong idea. You killed Roa a long time ago.
If Roa had survived, you could hardly still be here, could you?
Not when you’ve been dead all this time.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No.
I don't want you to get the wrong impression.
Roa was killed by you already.
In the first place, if Roa still existed, then there would be no way you could exist.
Even though you are already dead."

entries.japanese:
――――よく、わからない。
　それじゃあ、こうしている俺はなんなんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I don’t understand.
Then what am I—the me who is standing here now?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I don't, quite get it.
Then what am I, right now?

entries.japanese:
「そうだね、自己を失う手前の君なんじゃない？
　ナイフで自分の胸をさした時と、その後に死んでしまった志貴の間の君。
わずかな瞬間の隙間がここなんだろう」
　ぱちん、と音がして。
　見覚えのある、病室が映し出された。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe you’re the self you were just before you lost yourself.
The Shiki caught between the instant the knife entered your chest and the Shiki who died afterward. This place must be the tiny gap between those moments.”
There is a sharp snap.
A hospital room I recognize flickers into view.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's see, maybe you're on the verge of losing yourself?
The time you stabbed yourself and the time you died.
I think this is that brief moment in between the two."
Something snaps.
I see a projection of the familiar hospital room.

entries.japanese:
「夢というものにはね、完全な虚像というものはないんだ。
どのような作り話でも、所詮はその人間が得た知識の延長のものでしかない。
　だから、君がさっき見た夢にだって現実でいうところの真実はある。
　例えば――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No dream is made entirely of illusion. However fanciful the story, it can only grow out of things the dreamer has learned.
So even the dream you just saw contains truths about reality.
For example…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A thing called a dream cannot be something completely unknown.
Any story, is only an extension of what that person knows.
So, the dream you saw has some truth about reality.
Such as----"

entries.japanese: ―――俺が、意識を失ったままで植物人間になってしまっている、という所とか？
entries.maoEnglish: ―――The part where I’ve become an unresponsive body, lying there unconscious?
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Like becoming a vegetable without gaining consciousness?

entries.japanese:
「うん、それだけは本当のことだ。
　君は自らをナイフで刺したあと、目覚める事もなくただ延々と残っている。
この瞬間は、そうなる前のわずかな隙間だよ。
　この夢が覚めてしまえば―――君は、おそらく起きる事のない昏睡の体になって、夢を見る事さえできなくなる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes—that much is true.
After you stabbed yourself, you never woke. Your body simply lingered on and on, and this moment is the narrow gap before that happens.
Once this dream ends, you’ll become a comatose body that will probably never wake—and you won’t even be able to dream.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, that at least is true.
After you stabbed yourself, you were still left without waking up.
This instant is really just a small gap of time between the two.
When you wake up from this dream----you will simply be comatose, not even able to dream."

entries.japanese: ―――それじゃあ、先輩はどうなるんだ。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Then what happens to Ciel?
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Then, what will happen to Senpai?

entries.japanese:
「さあ。
けど他人の事なんかよりさ、自分の事を考えたほうがいいんじゃない？
　
　悪いことは言わないから、もう一度目を閉じるんだ。
　それで今度は冷めないように努力するといい。
　そうすれば―――また幸せなユメを見れる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who knows? But shouldn’t you worry about yourself instead of somebody else?
Take my advice and close your eyes again.
This time, try not to wake up.
Then you can have another happy dream.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't know.
But shouldn't you think about yourself more than other people?
It won't be bad, so just close your eyes again.
This time, try not to wake up.
If you do that----then you can watch that happy dream again."

entries.japanese:
―――わからない。
おまえは、誰だ。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――I don’t understand. Who are you?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I don't understand.
Who are you?

entries.japanese:
「あのね。
そんなコトは関係ないだろう。
どうせ目を覚ましてしまえば、君はユメを見るなんていう事さえできない、ただの『器官の群』になっちゃうんだよ？
　それならここで、ユメともゆめともつかない夢に沈んでいたほうがいい。
　君は今までよくやった。
シエルっていう人も可哀想だけどね、君も僕も悲惨なものだったじゃないか。
　だから、これぐらいおいしいユメを見てもいいとは思うんだけど？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, that doesn’t matter. If you wake, you’ll become nothing but a ‘collection of organs,’ incapable even of dreaming. Do you understand?
You’d be better off sinking into some half-dream that may not even deserve the name.
You’ve done well enough. I feel sorry for Ciel, but you and I have both had miserable lives too.
Don’t you think we’ve earned a dream this sweet?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey.
That doesn't really matter.
If you wake up, you won't even be able to dream, you'd just become a 'pile of organs', you know?
So, it's just better to sink back into that dream.
You really did well.
It is too bad for that person Ciel, but you and I also had horrible luck.
So, I think we could at least see a happy dream, you know?"

entries.japanese:
―――――だから。
おまえは、誰だ。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――That isn’t an answer. Who are you?
entries.mirrorMoon: ------So, who are you?

entries.japanese:
「……はあ。
そんなのさっき君自身が言ったじゃないか。
ユメから冷めたんだから、ここには志貴以外のイメージはないんだって。
　だとすると、僕はきっと――――」
「―――こんなカタチを、してるんじゃないかな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, honestly. You already answered that yourself. Once you’ve woken from the dream, nothing can exist here except an image of Shiki.
Which must mean I’m…”
“I probably look something like this.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm.
You just said that earlier yourself.
Since you woke up from that dream, there's nothing else here besides Shiki.
So, I must----"
"----probably look like this."

entries.japanese:
―――こど……も……。
「あ、失礼だな。
これでも君より一歳だけ年上なんだぜ。
遠野志貴はまだ八年だろ？
　その点僕は九年近く在ったんだから」
―――じゃあ、おまえは。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A ch-child?
“Hey, that’s rude. I’m still a year older than you. Shiki Tohno has only existed for eight years, right? I was around for almost nine.”
―――Then you’re…
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Ki…… d……
"Hey, excuse yourself.
I'm a year older than you, you know.
Tohno Shiki is only eight years old, right?
With that in mind, I have existed for almost nine years."
----Then, you are……

entries.japanese:
「そういう事。
今まで廃棄物っぽく底で捨てられてたんだけどね、君が同じところに落ちてきたから声をかけたんだよ。
　あ、でも別に僕は君と別人ってわけじゃないぜ。
　僕らはあくまで一つの名前の棲む現象だからね。
　たとえ君が忘れていたとしても、君はもちろん僕の延長である志貴だ。
ただ僕の場合は君の土台ではあるが過去ではないから、廃棄物っていう事になってしまう。
　ま、そのあたりは難しい話だからおいておこう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. I’d been discarded at the bottom like a piece of refuse, but then you fell into the same place, so I spoke to you.
That doesn’t mean we’re different people. We’re still a single phenomenon inhabited by one name.
Even if you’ve forgotten, you are Shiki—the life that continued on from me. I’m the foundation you were built upon, but I’m not your past, which leaves me as nothing but refuse.
Still, that gets complicated, so let’s leave it there.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's it.
I was cast away until now, but since you fell into the same place, I called out to you.
But, it's not like we're actually separate people.
We are the same existence, after all.
Even if you forgot, you are the Shiki that is the extension of me.
But in my case, I am your foundation but not your past, so I am just trash.
Well, it is difficult to talk about it, so let's just leave it aside."

entries.japanese:
―――――わからない。
その廃棄物が、俺になにをさせたいんだ。
「だから、目を醒ますのは止めたほうがいいっていう忠告だよ。
君、つまり遠野志貴の現実は『一生病院のベッドで意識不明のまま』っていうリアルだ。
　その状態に覚めてしまえば、君は夢を見る事さえできなくなる。
肉体は維持できても脳はまともに機能してくれていないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――I don’t understand. What does this piece of refuse want me to do?
“I’m warning you not to wake up. The reality waiting for you—the reality of Shiki Tohno—is a lifetime unconscious in a hospital bed. If you wake into that, you won’t even be able to dream. Your body may survive, but your brain no longer functions properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----I don't understand.
Then what does that trash want to make me do?
"That's what I've been saying.
I'm warning you not to wake up.
You, I mean Tohno Shiki's reality is nothing more than spending the rest of your life in a coma.
If you awake to that, you won't even be able to dream.
Even though you could manage your body, your brain would not function.

entries.japanese:
「つまり、それは死だ。
存在としての死ではなく、意味としての死だね。
そんな状態……わざわざ死ぬ必要なんかないだろ？
　どうせ目が覚めても現実に生きられないのなら、ここで現実をユメ見ていてくれたほうが僕は嬉しい」
―――……なんだよ、それ。
　たとえ一生寝たきりでも、こんなふうに自分だけのゆめを見ていても、楽しくなんかないだろ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In other words, it’s death. Not death as an existence, but death as a meaning. Why go out of your way to die like that? If waking won’t let you live in reality anyway, I’d rather you stayed here and dreamed of it.”
―――What the hell is that supposed to mean…?
Even if I’ll spend my whole life in bed, dreaming alone like this wouldn’t make me happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"In other words, death.
Not death to your existence, but the death of your will.
In that situation…… you wouldn't need to die, right?
Even if you woke up, you can't live in reality.
I'd be much happier if you just watched a dream about reality here."
----…… what is that?
Even if I just slept the rest of my life, dreaming selfishly isn't fun at all.

entries.japanese:
「そうだね。
現実に覚めて意味としての死を迎えるか、ここで自分だけのユメを見続けるか。
　どっちにしたってあんまり変わりなんかないんだ。
　現実に覚めて死んでしまえば、こんなふうに悩む事もなくなる。
　幸せというのなら、きっとそっちのほうが何倍も幸せなんだろう」
―――な……。
entries.maoEnglish:
“True. You can wake into reality and die in meaning, or stay here and dream your private dream forever.
There isn’t much difference either way.
If you wake and die, at least you’ll never have to torment yourself like this again.
If happiness is the measure, that would probably make you far happier.”
―――What…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true.
You can either wake up to reality and face the death of your will or you can stay here and dream.
No matter which, there really isn't much of a difference.
If you wake up to reality and die, you wouldn't trouble yourself like this.
If you call that happiness, it probably is many times happier."
----Wha……

entries.japanese:
「……けど、僕は君にユメを見てほしい。
僕らは同じ名前でありながら、見れるユメが違うんだ。
　僕の見るユメはね、たいていはあの日の出来事か、九歳までの出来事だけなんだ。
　それはそれで楽しいのかも知れないけど、そこには志貴の未来がない。
　例えば、大人になって、好きな人が出来て、毎日を忙しく生きていく、といった未来かな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I want you to dream. We share the same name, yet the dreams available to us are different.
Most of mine are about that day, or about things that happened before I turned nine.
Maybe they’re pleasant in their own way, but there’s no future for Shiki in them.
No growing up, falling in love, or spending your days busy with living.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I want you to dream.
We have the same name, but the dreams we can see are different.
My dreams are usually about that day, or the days I had until I was nine years old.
That may be happy, but there's no future for Shiki there.
Such as getting older, having a person you like, living busily every day."

entries.japanese:
「僕の現実、僕が知り得た知識、そこから想像できるであろう未来は、とても狭くて救われないものばかりだから、そういったものを想像する事さえできない。
　けど君のユメは違った。
君にとっては当たり前の風景も、僕にとってみれば輝かしい風景なんだ。
それこそ夢にまで見たっていうヤツだよ。
　……もっとも狭量な僕の年月では君のようなユメは思い浮かばないんだけどね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My reality, everything I ever learned, and every future I can imagine from them are so narrow and hopeless that I can’t even picture a life like that.
But your dreams were different. Scenes that were ordinary to you shone brilliantly to me. They were, quite literally, the stuff of my dreams.
Though my little lifetime was too cramped to invent dreams like yours on its own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"My reality, my knowledge, the future I can imagine from that is so small and hopeless that I can't even imagine those things.
But, your dreams were different.
What is normal scenery for you looks brilliant to me, even if they are just dreams.
…… But with my limited years, I can't even think of your dreams by myself."

----………

entries.japanese:
―――…………。
「君は自分だけのユメに我慢できないんなら、僕も少しは手を貸そう。
君が忘れてしまっている昔の出来事を提供してもいい。
僕たちがお互いを騙そうと努力すれば、それなりに幸せなユメを見れるさ」
―――………………。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――…
“If you can’t bear a dream made from your memories alone, I’ll help. I can give you the things you’ve forgotten from long ago. If we both work at deceiving each other, we should manage a reasonably happy dream.”
―――…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you can't stand your selfish dream, then I can help a little.
I can let you remember the other things you forgot that happened in the past.
If we work together to fool each other, we can see a somewhat happy dream."
----…………………

entries.japanese:
「……気が乗らないみたいだね。
やっぱり冷めてしまうと目を覚まそうとしてしまうものなのかな。
　けど、君の現実は終わってるんだよ。
たしかにユメに見る現実なんて、本当の現実に比べるべくもないものだけどさ。
　それでも―――頑張れば、少しぐらいは幸せになれるじゃないか」
―――……違う。
　そこで幸せになれるのは、俺たちだけじゃないか、志貴。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You don’t seem interested. Maybe once someone realizes it’s a dream, trying to wake is inevitable.
But your reality is already over. Of course a dreamed reality can’t compare with the real thing.
Even so—if you try, you could find a little happiness here.”
―――No…
We’d be the only ones happy there, Shiki.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It seems you don't like that.
I guess once you realize the truth, you have to wake up.
But, your reality is already over.
Certainly dreams can't compare to reality.
But still----if you try, I think you can at least become a bit happy, right?"
----…… No.
Wouldn't we be the only ones becoming happy there, Shiki?

entries.japanese:
「………馬鹿だな。
幸福なんて、自分だけのモノにしておけば簡単なのに。
他人の事まで考えるとね、色々と難しくなっていくんだよ。
　その結果、なにが良くて何が悪かったのかなんて事さえ難しくてわからなくなる。
　事実、僕も君も何一つだって悪い事はしなかった。
なのに結果はこうだろう？
　ほら、志貴はそういう人間なんだ。
奪われてばかりの人生だから、誰かの幸福なんて欲しがっちゃいけないんだよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You idiot. Happiness is easy if you keep it all for yourself. The moment you include other people, everything becomes complicated.
Soon even deciding what was right and what was wrong becomes too difficult.
The truth is, neither of us did anything wrong. And this is still how it ended.
That’s the kind of person Shiki is. When life has done nothing but take from you, you have no business reaching for someone else’s happiness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… You are stupid.
It's simple to be happy by yourself.
If you start to think about others, it gets much more difficult.
As a result, even what's good or bad becomes too difficult to figure out.
And in reality, you and I never did anything wrong.
But this is how we ended up, right?
See, that's the person you are Shiki.
You've only had things stolen from you, so you shouldn't worry about making others happy."

entries.japanese:
―――そうかもしれない。
　けど、それでも、一人にしないって約束したんだ。
　さっきまでのものも、こうしている自分も、そのすべてが夢だというのなら――――早く、こんな夢から醒めないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Maybe he is right.
But I promised I wouldn’t leave her alone.
If everything before this, and even the self standing here now, is only a dream—then I have to wake up from it at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----That may be true.
But, still, I made a promise not to leave her alone.
If everything before, if everything right now, if all of it is a dream------I have to wake up.

entries.japanese:
「夢が終われば。
そこには、何もないかもしれないのに？」
entries.maoEnglish: “Once the dream ends. What if there’s nothing waiting for you?”
entries.mirrorMoon: "Even if there might be nothing for you if you wake up?"

entries.japanese:
―――だって、彼女が待ってるんだ。
早く戻らないといけないだろ。
　たとえ死ぬ事になっても―――彼女が待っている所に居るって、約束したんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――She’s waiting for me. I have to hurry back.
Even if I die—I promised I would be wherever she was waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Because she's waiting.
I have to go back.
Even if it means my death----I promised I'll be there where she's waiting.

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
それじゃお別れだ。
放っておけなくて手を出しちゃったけど、やっぱり今さら僕は必要なかったみたいだな。
　……でもまあ、楽しかったよ。
僕は将来あんな生活を送れるんだって、いいユメを見せてもらえた」
―――な、なんだよ。
いきなり握手してくるなんて、気持ちわるいな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then this is goodbye. I couldn’t leave you alone, so I interfered, but I suppose it was too late for you to need me.
Still, I had fun. You showed me a wonderful dream—a life I might have lived when I grew up.”
―――H-hey, don’t suddenly shake my hand. That’s creepy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Then, this is goodbye.
I couldn't leave you alone, so I lent you a hand.
But, like I thought, you don't need me now.
…… All the same, it really was fun.
I was able to see a good dream that maybe my future could be like that."
----What, what's this?
Shaking my hand all of a sudden.
That's just weird.

entries.japanese:
「あはは、僕だって気持ち悪いよ。
でもこうしないと渡せないんだから仕方がないじゃないか。
　いくら同じ自分だっていってもね、ここまで別れてしまうと『触れ合う』っていうイメージが必要になってくるワケ。
ま、そのあたりの知識を忘れちゃってる君に言ってもそれこそ無為か」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha ha. It feels creepy to me too, but I can’t give it to you otherwise.
We may be the same self, but after separating this far, we need an image of ‘contact’ to pass anything between us. Though explaining that to someone who’s forgotten all the relevant knowledge is probably pointless.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahaha, I even felt weird.
But, it can't be helped because I can't give you it unless we do this.
Even though we are the same, if we are parted this much, we need an image to "merge".
Well, I guess it's useless for me to tell you because you've even forgot about that."

entries.japanese:
―――ちょっと……おまえ、消えかかってる、けど。
「そう言う君はカタチが出来はじめてるね。
　さて、それじゃあこのへんでお別れだ。
僕は君のことを忘れるから、君も僕のことは忘れてくれ。
　今さら―――遠野志貴以前の志貴になんて、戻っても意味がないんだ」
―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Wait—you’re fading away.
“And you’re beginning to take shape.
Well, this is goodbye. I’ll forget you, so please forget me too.
There’s no point going back now—to the Shiki you were before you became Shiki Tohno.”
―――…
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Hey…… You, you're disappearing.
"You're starting to form shape.
Well, it's about time for our goodbyes.
I'll forget about you, so please forget about me.
Now----It's meaningless to go back to the Shiki before becoming Tohno Shiki."
----.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、そうそう。
彼女のことだけど、僕も気に入ったよ。
だから君が自分よりあの人の事が大切だっていう意見には賛成する。
　けどな、君。
それだったらもう二度と、つまんない事をやって泣かせたりするんじゃないぞ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, right. I liked her too. So I agree with you that she matters more than you do.
But listen. If that’s true, don’t ever do anything that stupid and make her cry again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh yeah, about her.
I like her too.
So I agree on the fact that she's more important than you.
But you know, if that's the case, never do something stupid again to make her cry, okay?"

entries.japanese:
―――そうして、消えてしまった。
　いや、亡くなってしまった、という感覚のほうが近いんだろうか。
　……チクリと、不思議な痛みが走る。
　懐かしくて、もう二度と取り戻せない何か。
　何か、悲しくて。
　深く、思い出そうとしても。
　それが郷愁と呼ばれるものだと気が付く事は、自分には、ついぞ、出来なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And then he vanished.
No—perhaps it felt closer to watching someone die.
A strange little pain pricked through me.
Something achingly familiar, lost beyond all hope of recovery.
It left me with an inexplicable sadness.
Yet however deeply I searched for the memory…
I never managed to understand that what I felt was nostalgia.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And, he disappears.
No, maybe died would be closer in meaning.
…… I feel a strange pain.
Missing, something I won't be able to get back.
I feel sad about something.
Even though I tried to remember,
I didn't quite grasp that it was nostalgia.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　意識が覚めていく。
　一時のユメが冷めていく。
　このユメが消えて、こうしている俺も消えれば。
　そこにあるのは、もう夢を見る事さえない、死んでいる自分だけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Consciousness returns.
The passing dream recedes.
When this dream vanishes, and the self who stands within it vanishes too…
All that will remain is the dead thing I have become, incapable even of dreaming.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
My consciousness returns.
I wake up from a moment's dream.
If that dream disappears and I disappear,
the only thing waiting for me is death.

entries.japanese:
―――ぼんやりと。
　朝の光が、映ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Dimly.
Morning light seeps into view.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Aimlessly.
The morning light shines.

entries.japanese:
朦朧としたあたま。
　まだ、何も考えられない。
　体は倒れている。
　頭は―――なにか、柔らかいモノの上にある。
―――おかしいな。
　もう、ユメは冷めているはずなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
My thoughts are fog.
I still can’t think at all.
My body is lying down.
My head rests on something soft.
―――That’s strange.
The dream should already be over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My mind is hazy.
I still can't think of anything.
My body is collapsed.
My head----is on something soft.
----That's strange.
I should have woken from that dream already.

entries.japanese:
目蓋をあける。
　目の前には、彼女の、泣き顔があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I open my eyes.
Her tear-streaked face is waiting above me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I open my eyes.
I see, her crying face.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　……ただ手を伸ばして、彼女の頬に触れた。
　指先に涙が伝わってくる。
　それは、紛れもなく現実でしかない、温かい泪だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I simply reach up and touch her cheek.
Tears run warm over my fingertips.
They are warm tears that could only be real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
…… I just reach out my hand and touch her cheek.
Her tears course down my fingers.
Without a doubt, these warm tears are real.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　……彼女は何も言ってこない。
　俺も―――言葉を発する必要性なんかこれっぽっちも感じなくて、ただ彼女の体温だけを感じていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
She says nothing.
I feel no need to speak either, and simply rest in her warmth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… She doesn't say anything.
Neither do I----I do not feel that words are necessary.
I just feel her warmth against me.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん、という鼓動。
　夜空にはアルクェイドが消えた時のままの月があって、俺の胸は血にまみれていた。
　ただ、そこにあった穴は塞がっていた。
　彼女が治癒してくれたのか、それともあんな傷は初めからなかったのか。
　……まあ、生きているのなら、そんなコト。
　こうしていられるコトに比べれば、本当に瑣末だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A heartbeat—deep and strong.
The moon still hangs in the night sky exactly as it did when Arcueid disappeared, and my chest is drenched in blood.
But the hole that had been there is closed.
Perhaps she healed it—or perhaps such a wound had never existed at all.
As long as I’m alive, what does it matter?
Compared with being here together like this, it is utterly trivial.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thump.
In the night sky, the moon still hangs from the time Arcueid disappeared, and my chest is covered in blood.
But, that gaping wound has closed.
Did she heal me or did that wound never exist in the first place?
…… Well, if I'm alive.
That's just a trivial matter since I am able to exist here right now.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん……わたしのこと、わかりますか……？」
　震えているような、声。
「……驚いたな。
先輩、すごく、泣いてる」
「―――はい。
わたし、こんなにどうしようもない気持ちなんて、生まれて初めてです」
「はは、そりゃあ言い過ぎだよ、先輩」
　ぼんやりとした頭で、そんな軽口を言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno—do you know who I am?”
Her voice trembles.
“I’m amazed. Ciel, you’re crying so much.”
“Yes. I’ve never felt so utterly helpless in my life.”
“Come on—that’s laying it on a little thick.”
The feeble joke slips from my clouded head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun…… Can you, understand me……?"
Her shaking voice.
"…… I'm surprised.
Senpai, you're really crying."
"----Yes.
I've never felt like this ever before."
"Haha, isn't that a bit much, Senpai?"
I ramble with my hazy head.

entries.japanese:
ぼう、とする。
　頭痛はない。
痛みもない。
ロアがどうなったのか、自分がどうなったのか、まったくわからない。
　ただ、わかるのは朝の光と目の前にシエルがいるという事だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I drift in a daze.
No headache. No pain. I have no idea what became of Roa or what has happened to me. All I know is the morning light, and Ciel here before me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel spaced out.
There's no headache.
There's no pain.
I don't know what happened to Roa or what happened to me.
All I know is Ciel is here with me in the morning light.

entries.japanese:
「………はあ」
　なんて倖せ。
　欲しいものは、目の前にそろっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
What bliss.
Everything I want is right in front of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………… *sigh*
What happiness.
What I want is all right here before me.

entries.japanese:
「……良かった。
約束が、守れて」
　はあ、と喘ぐような吐息をもらして、そう言った。
「なに言ってるんですか。
今日は学校が終わったら乾くんと三人で遊びに行くんでしょう？
　ですから、いつまでもこんなふうに膝まくらされてる暇なんてないですね」
　彼女はクスリと、以前のようにイタズラな笑みを浮かべる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m glad… I kept my promise.”
The words escape on a breath almost like a gasp.
“What are you talking about? The three of us are going out with Arihiko after school today. You can’t spend forever lying here with your head in my lap.”
A mischievous smile, just like the ones she used to wear, curls across her lips.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Thank goodness.
I can keep my promise."
I say that after a long sigh.
"What are you saying?
Aren't we supposed to go with Inui-kun and hang out today after school?
So we really don't have time to just sit here all day, do we?"
She speaks and gives a mischievous smile like before.

entries.japanese:
「――――そっか。
それじゃあいいかげん起きないといけないか……って、痛っ……！」
　体を起こそうとしたとたん、胸が激しく痛んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, right. Then I’d better get up—ow!”
The moment I try to rise, agony tears through my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----I see.
Then I should get up…… Ow……!"
As soon as I try to get up, my chest stabs with pain.

entries.japanese:
「あ、まだ動いちゃダメですっ……！
　あんな大きな傷口だったんですから、あと一時間はそのままでいてもらわないと」
「……シエル。
すごく、矛盾したこと言ってるって、わかってる？」
「あ……はい、そうみたいです。
その、遠野くんが目を覚ましてくれたから、わたしどうかしちゃってます」
　顔を真っ赤にして、彼女はそんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you mustn’t move yet! It was such a terrible wound, so you need to stay exactly as you are for another hour.”
“Ciel… do you realize how badly you’re contradicting yourself?”
“Oh—yes, I suppose I am. You woke up, Tohno, and now I don’t seem to know what I’m saying.”
Her entire face goes scarlet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, don't move yet……!
It was a big wound, so you should stay like this for at least another hour."
"…… Ciel.
You really contradicted yourself.
You know that, right?"
"Oh…… yes, it seems so.
I seem to have lost my mind since you woke up."
She gives a deep blush.

entries.japanese:
「……けど参ったな。
あと一時間もこのままだなんて、退屈だ」
　動かせるとしたら腕ぐらい。
　それに彼女だって一時間も膝まくらをしていたら疲れてしまうだろうし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“An entire hour like this, though… I’ll be bored to death.”
My arms are about the only things I can move.
Besides, spending an hour with my head in her lap would surely exhaust her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Aw, man.
I'll be bored if I have to stay like this for another hour."
All I can move is my arms.
And she should get tired from having my head on her lap for an hour.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん。
このままじゃ何かと疲れるだろシエル。
なんだったら地面にそのまま寝かせてくれてもいいんだけど―――」
「……もう、何言ってるんですか。
わたしは好きでこうしているんですから、これぐらいの我が侭はさせてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry. This position must be tiring, Ciel. You could just put me down on the ground if you wanted…”
“Oh, honestly—I’m doing this because I want to. Please let me have this one selfish pleasure.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
Doesn't this tire you out?
You can let me sleep on the ground---"
"…… Geez, what are you saying?
I'm doing this out of my own will, so please indulge my selfishness."

entries.japanese:
頬を赤く染めたまま、彼女はじっと俺を見つめてくる。
「……それに、ですね。
こうしていれば、遠野くんにしてもらえるかなっ、って……」
「あ――――――」
―――思い出した。
　そういえば、さっきそんな事を、約束した気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Still flushed, she holds my gaze without looking away.
“And… I thought that if I kept you like this, perhaps you might…”
“Ah…”
―――Now I remember.
I think I promised her something like that a little while ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her cheeks turning even redder, she continues to look at me.
"…… And, if I stayed like this, I thought you might do it……"
"Ah------"
----I remember.
Come to think of it, I think we made a promise like that before.

entries.japanese:
「……うん。
俺も、今はそうしたい」
　言って。
　唯一自由になる腕で彼女の頬に手をそえる。
　彼女が静かに頭をさげてくる。
―――唇が、深く、触れ合った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes… I want that too.”
I say it.
With the one arm I can move, I cup her cheek.
She quietly lowers her face to mine.
―――Our lips met in a deep kiss.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah.
I want to do so too."
Saying that,
I reach out to her face with my only free arm.
She quietly lowers her face.
----Our lips meet, deeply.

entries.japanese:
それこそ一時間にも思える口付けをして、俺と彼女は顔を離した。
「―――――――――」
　……言葉がない。
　ただ、本当に、ようやく。
　俺は、長い夢から、目覚められた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
After a kiss that seems to last the whole hour, we finally draw apart.
“…”
There are no words.
But truly, at last.
I feel as though I have awakened from a long dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After what feels like an hour, we separate.
"---------"
…… I'm speechless.
Just, at last, for real,
I feel like I've woken, from a long sleep.

entries.japanese:
「……とりあえず、おはようシエル」
「はい。
おはようございます、遠野くん」
　その笑顔は涙に濡れていながら、何よりも華やかだったから。
　つい、気が抜けて瞼を閉じてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well—good morning, Ciel.”
“Yes. Good morning, Tohno.”
Her smile, though wet with tears, is more radiant than anything in the world.
The sight lets all the tension drain from me, and my eyes close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… First, good morning Ciel."
"Yes.
Good morning, Tohno-kun."
Since her smiling face and her tears are more glorious than anything on this earth,
I relax and close my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「え……？
　遠野くん、遠野くん……！？」
「ん―――ごめん、先輩。
もうちょっと……眠らせて、くれないか」
　……本当にホッとして、今までの疲れが戻ってきてしまった。
　出来る事なら、このまま先輩に抱かれたまま眠りたいけどそうもいかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? Tohno—Tohno!?”
“Mm—sorry, Ciel. Could you let me sleep a little longer?”
Relief brings all my exhaustion flooding back at once.
If I could, I would fall asleep just like this in her arms, but that probably isn’t possible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh……?
Tohno-kun, Tohno-kun……!?"
"M----Sorry, Senpai.
I want…… to sleep a little longer."
…… I really felt relaxed and all my tiredness returned.
If I can, I want to sleep in Senpai's arms but I don't think that's possible.

entries.japanese:
「……どっか適当な物陰にでも置いておいてくれればいいから……授業が始まったら、起こして」
「――――むっ」
　いかにも不満そうな声が聞こえる。
　けど、本当に―――今は、眠くて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Just set me down somewhere out of sight—and wake me when classes start.”
“Hmph.”
Her displeasure could hardly be clearer.
But right now, I’m simply too tired to care.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can just put me somewhere…… so when classes start, wake me up."
"-----Hmph."
She sounds a little disappointed.
But, really----I'm sleepy right now.

entries.japanese:
「―――わかりました。
それじゃこのままわたしの部屋に連れていきますけど、それでいいですね？」
「え……それは、ちょっとまずいんじゃないか、な。
それじゃ学校を休んじゃう、じゃない、か」
「いいんです、今日はさぼっちゃいましょう。
どのみち遠野くんには聞きたい事が沢山あったんです」
―――と。
　体がひょい、と抱きかかえられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well—then I’ll carry you to my room just as you are. That suits you, I assume?” “What? That might be a bad idea; we’d end up missing school.”
“That’s fine. Let’s play truant today; I have a great many questions for you in any case.”
―――And with that.
She scoops me effortlessly into her arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I understand.
Then I'll carry you to my room, but is it okay?"
"Eh…… Isn't that bad?
We'll miss school if we do that."
"It's okay, let's skip for today.
Besides, there are a lot of things I want to ask you about, Tohno-kun."
---And then,
I feel myself being lifted.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ―――先輩、保健室でいいから、先輩の部屋に行くのはやめよう……！」
「却下します。
遠野くんにはわたしが居ない間、アルクェイドと何をしていたかを教えてもらわないといけませんから」
　俺を抱きかかえたまま、ニッコリとシエルは微笑む。
　それは、こっちの眠気を無くしてしまうぐらい、静かな迫力があったと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait—the infirmary is fine, Ciel, so let’s not go to your room!”
“Request denied. You owe me a full account of everything you did with Arcueid while I was away.”
Still carrying me, Ciel smiles sweetly.
There is enough quiet force behind it to banish every trace of sleep from my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey----Senpai, the clinic is fine, we don't have to go to your room……!"
"Denied.
Tohno-kun, you have to tell me what you did with Arcueid when I wasn't there."
Ciel smiles as she holds me.
There's enough intensity to almost banish all traces of sleepiness away.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ行きますね。
まだ日が昇ったばかりですし、急げば人目につく事もないでしょうから」
「先輩、だから保健室でって―――うわあ！」
　たん、という軽い足音がして、シエルは大きく跳んでいた。
　それはほとんど宙に浮いているような跳躍だったと思う。
　この分なら、本当にすぐシエルのアパートに辿り着きそうなんだけど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Off we go, then. The sun has only just risen, so if we hurry, no one should see us.”
“Ciel, I said the infirmary—whoa!”
Her foot strikes the ground with a light tap, and Ciel launches herself into an enormous leap.
She is almost floating through the air.
At this rate, we really will reach her apartment in no time at all—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then, let's go.
The sun is just rising, so if we hurry, no one will see us."
"Senpai, that's why the clinic is much bet----uwaaaah!"
With a light stomp, Ciel takes a huge leap.
I feel weightless, like I'm floating in space.
At this rate, we really will be at Ciel's apartment soon but---

entries.japanese:
「……………ふう」
　なんていうか、今更ながらすごい人に惚れたんだなって実感する。
　けどまあ、それも覚悟の上か。
　俺とロアの問題が解決したところで先輩には先輩の問題があるんだから、このまま平穏な生活に戻れるとは思えない。
　けど、それでも―――もう、この人と一緒にいるって決めたんだ。
　この先なにがあろうと、二人でなんとかやっていこう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Whew…”
Only now does it truly sink in that I’ve fallen for one incredible woman.
But I knew what I was getting into.
Solving the problem between Roa and me does nothing to solve Ciel’s own troubles, so I doubt we can simply return to a peaceful life.
Even so, I have chosen to stay with her.
Whatever waits ahead, we’ll face it together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Whew."
I feel like I really have fallen in love with a surprising person.
But, I'm more than prepared.
Even though I've settled the problem with Roa, Senpai has her own problems as well.
I don't think we can return to a peaceful life.
But, even still----I've decided to be with this person already.
No matter what happens in the future, we'll get through it together.

entries.japanese:
「そう――――だよな、志貴」
　ユメの中にいた誰かにそう呟く。
　さて、それじゃあとりあえず―――今は、アルクェイドとの事をどう言い訳したものか、なんて真面目に考えなくっちゃいけないか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s right—isn’t it, Shiki?”
I murmur the words to someone who lived inside a dream.
For the moment, though—I have a more immediate problem: seriously working out how I am going to explain everything that happened with Arcueid—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right----Shiki."
I whisper to the person in my dream.
Well then, first thing's first----I have to start seriously thinking about what I should tell her about Arcueid---

entries.japanese:
……アルクェイドと過ごした時間が思い出される。
　初めてアルクェイドを見てしまった時、自分は確かに異常だった。
　あの昂ぶりが何に起因するかはわからない。
　だがそれでもはっきりと言えるコトがあった。
　俺は。
遠野志貴は、この白い吸血鬼を見た瞬間に、確かに心を奪われていたんだと。
entries.maoEnglish:
…Memories of the time I had spent with Arcueid returned to me.
When I first laid eyes on Arcueid, something in me had undoubtedly gone mad.
I still didn’t know what had caused that fever.
But there was one thing I could say with certainty.
I had. Shiki Tohno had lost his heart to the white vampire the instant he saw her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I remember the times I spent with Arcueid.
The first time I saw Arcueid, I was certainly insane.
I don't know what caused that impulse.
But still, there is something I can be sure of.
I, Tohno Shiki, the instant I saw that white vampire, had my heart stolen.

entries.japanese:
真祖なんていう吸血鬼のくせに無邪気で、常識知らずで、俺をこんな物騒な出来事に巻き込んだ張本人。
　……俺は彼女を殺してしまったのに、笑顔で許すと、言ってくれた。
　……俺の知りえない過去の映像。
　俺に寄生したロアという亡霊が執着するアルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド。
　その影響を受けているにしても、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
A vampire known as a True Ancestor—innocent, ignorant of common sense, and personally responsible for dragging me into this nightmare.
I had killed her—and she had smiled and said she forgave me.
Images from a past I could never have known.
Arcueid Brunestud—the obsession of the ghost called Roa, now living inside me as a parasite.
Even if I was under his influence, I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though she's a vampire, a True Ancestor, she's still innocent.
She lacks common sense and was the one who got me involved in this mess.
…… Even though I killed her, she forgave me with a smile.
…… An unknown image of the past.
The parasitic ghost of Roa's attachment to Arcueid Brunestud.
Even if it influenced me, I----

entries.japanese:
「これが最後よ。
志貴、わたしの言うコトを聞いて」
　アルクェイドの声は震えている。
「―――――――――」
　その、否定される事を恐れる声で、思い知らされた。
　自分にとって一番大切な人はシエルだ。
　けど、だからと言ってコイツを嫌う事なんて、できない。
　シエルを大切に思う気持ちが本物なら、コイツの事を気に入っている気持ちも本当なんだ。
　ロアの影響なんて関係ない。
　遠野志貴は遠野志貴の感情で、アルクェイドに惹かれていたんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is the last time I’ll ask. Shiki, please do as I say.”
Arcueid’s voice trembled.
“—”
The fear of rejection in her voice forced me to understand.
The person who mattered most to me was Ciel.
But that did not mean I could hate Arcueid.
If my love for Ciel was real, then my feelings for Arcueid were real too.
Roa’s influence had nothing to do with it.
Shiki Tohno had been drawn to Arcueid by feelings entirely his own—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is your last chance, Shiki.
Do as I say."
Arcueid's voice is shaking.
"---------"
Her voice filled, with fear of rejection, tells me.
The most important person to me is Ciel.
But, that doesn't mean I can hate this person.
Holding Ciel dear to me is true, but my fondness for Arcueid is also true.
It has nothing to do with Roa's influence.
As Tohno Shiki, I am attracted to her----

entries.japanese:
「……志貴。
それとも、そんなにわたしのコトが嫌い？」
「……ふざけんな。
簡単におまえを嫌えるなら、こんな事には、ならなかった」
　ぎり、と。
心の中でシエルに謝りながら、そんなコトを、口にしてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki. Or do you really hate me that much?”
“Don’t be ridiculous. If I could hate you that easily, none of this would have happened.”
I ground my teeth. Apologizing to Ciel in my heart, I let myself say it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki.
Or, do you really hate me that much?"
"…… Don't be ridiculous.
If I could hate you so simply, things wouldn't have turned out this way."
I apologize to Ciel in my head as I say that.

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
　アルクェイドは首をかしげる。
「ちょっと志貴。
それ、どういう意味だかわからない」
　……このバカ。
はっきり言わなくちゃ解らないのか、くそ。
「――――アルクェイド、俺は」
　……ごめんシエル。
口にしてはいけない事を、俺は口にしようとしてる。
「おまえの事を、嫌いになれない。
　俺は、きっと―――おまえに、惚れてる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—What?”
Arcueid tilted her head.
“Shiki, I don’t understand. What do you mean?”
This idiot. Did I really have to spell it out, damn it?
“—Arcueid, I…”
Forgive me, Ciel. I was about to say something I had no right to say.
“I can’t make myself hate you.
I think—I think I’m in love with you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
Arcueid tilts her head.
"Wait Shiki.
What, what does that mean?"
…… This idiot.
Damn it, she just won't understand unless you say it directly.
"----Arcueid, I"
…… Sorry Ciel.
I'm about to say something I shouldn't.
"I, can't hate you.
I'm probably---attracted to you."

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　アルクェイドの瞳が細まる。
　息を飲むような緊迫した沈黙のあと。
「――――――ほんと？」
　なんて、気の抜けた声で、アルクェイドは問いただしてきた。
「……あのな。
この状況で嘘を言っても仕方がないだろ。
悔しいけど、俺はおまえに惹かれてる。
初めて会った時から、ずっと惹かれてたんだ」
「――――――――」
　ぱあ、とアルクェイドの顔が明るくなる。
　俺の両腕を抑えていた手を離して、嬉しそうに体を起こそうとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Arcueid’s eyes narrowed.
A breathless, charged silence followed.
“Really?”
She asked in such an absurdly deflated voice that all the tension vanished.
“…Why would I lie now? I hate admitting it, but I’m drawn to you. I have been ever since we met.”
“—”
Arcueid’s face lit up.
She released my arms and happily began to sit up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Arcueid's eyes narrow.
After a tense pause,
"------Really?"
She asks in a drained voice.
"…… Hey now.
It's useless to lie in this kind of situation.
I don't want to admit, but I'm attracted to you.
Ever since I met you, I've always been attracted to you."
"--------"
Arcueid's face brightens.
Her hands which were pinning me down let go and she happily tries to get up.

entries.japanese:
「けど、それでも俺はおまえの言うコトはきけない」
「――――――――」
　ぴたり、とアルクェイドの動きが止まる。
　彼女は離しかけた両手を、もう一度俺の腕に乗せてきた。
「志貴、それどういうコト。
わたしのコトを好いてくれているなら、わたしの言うコトぐらい聞いてくれるんじゃないの？
　それともわたしの言うコトは信用できない？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I still can’t do what you ask.”
“—”
Arcueid froze.
She put both hands back on the arms she had begun to release.
“Shiki, what does that mean? If you care about me, shouldn’t you at least listen to me? Or don’t you trust what I’m telling you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I still can't do as you say."
"--------"
She freezes instantly.
She takes her hands which were letting go and puts them on my arms again.
"Shiki, what do you mean?
If you like me, why can't you listen to what I say?
Or are you saying you can't trust what I say?"

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイドの言い分は信じてる。
おまえは色々と秘密が多かったけど、決して嘘は言わなかった。
だから、おまえがロアをどうにかできるっていうんなら、それは本当の事なんだろう」
「解ってるじゃない。
なら何が不満なのよ。
もしかして貴方、ロアの力を手放したくないなんて言うんじゃないでしょうね」
　むっ、とご不満そうに睨んでくるアルクェイド。
　……まったく。
　どんな状況だろうと、こいつのズレた所は変わらないみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I trust what you’re saying. You kept plenty of secrets, but you never lied. So if you say you can deal with Roa, that must be true.”
“You understand, then. So what’s the problem? Don’t tell me you’ve decided you want to keep Roa’s power.”
Arcueid scowled, visibly offended.
Honestly.
No matter the situation, that off-kilter part of her never seemed to change.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I believe you.
You have a lot of secrets, but you never lied to me.
And if you say it's possible to do something about Roa, then it's probably true."
"You understand.
Then what's wrong?
Don't tell me, you don't want to get rid of Roa's power?"
She stares at me, dissatisfied.
…… Geez.
No matter what situation we're in, I guess she'll always be a bit off.

entries.japanese:
「……あのな、俺は善良な一般市民なんだぞ。
頼まれたってこんな力はいるもんか。
出来るなら今すぐにでもごみ箱に棄てたいぐらいだ」
「？
　ならどうしてイヤなのよ。
わたしの下僕になれば、すぐにロアを仕留められるじゃない。
……志貴、言ってるコトがヘン」
「ヘンなのはおまえの方だ。
いいかアルクェイド、確かに俺はおまえに惹かれてる。
けど、俺が一番好きな人は別にいるんだ。
　だから俺は決して―――おまえのモノになんか、ならない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, I’m an innocent, ordinary citizen. I wouldn’t want this power even if someone begged me to take it. If I could, I’d throw it in the trash this instant.”
“Then why refuse? Become my servant. You can finish Roa immediately. Shiki, you’re not making sense.”
“You’re the one who makes no sense. Listen, Arcueid. I’m drawn to you, yes, but there’s someone else I love most.
That’s why I will never become yours.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey, I'm just an average guy.
I wouldn't want this power even if you asked me to take it.
If I could, I want to throw it in a trash can right now."
"?
Then why don't you want this?
If you become my servant, you can bring down Roa right away.
…… Shiki, you're being weird."
"You're the weird one.
Look, Arcueid, I'm attracted to you, but the one I like the most is someone else.
That's why I'll never---become yours."

entries.japanese:
「――――ふぅん、そう。
志貴はまだあんな女の方がいいって言うんだ」
　アルクェイドの声が冷たくなる。
　……まずい。
なんか、本気で怒らせてしまったような気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, I see. So you still prefer that woman.”
Arcueid’s voice went cold.
This was bad. I had the distinct feeling I had truly made her angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Oh?
I see.
Shiki, you're still saying that woman is better."
Arcueid's voice turns cold.
…… This is bad.
I think I really got her pissed.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ。
志貴が他の誰を好きでもかまわない。
　わたしね、誰かを好きだなって思った事は貴方が初めてだった。
だから志貴が少しでもわたしの事を好きだって言ってくれるなら、他のコトなんてどうでもいいんだ。
　たとえ志貴がわたしを一番に見てくれなくてもかまわない。
だってわたしが志貴を一番に思えるのなら、それだけで十分でしょう？」
　冷たい瞳のまま、アルクェイドは微笑った。
　そこには冷酷さと無邪気さが同居している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. You can care about anyone you want.
You’re the first person I’ve ever felt this way about. So if you care about me even a little, nothing else matters.
I don’t care if I’m not the one who matters most to you. If you’re the one who matters most to me, that’s enough, isn’t it?”
Arcueid smiled without warmth, her eyes still cold.
Cruelty and innocence dwelled together there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's fine.
I don't mind if you like someone else.
Shiki, you're the first person I've ever liked.
So if you like me even just a little bit, then nothing else matters.
So even if you don't think about me the most, I don't mind.
Because if you're my number one, isn't that enough?"
Cold eyes shine over her smile.
A mixture of chilling coldness and innocence.

entries.japanese:
「――――けどあの女だけは別よ。
　あんなヤツに志貴を取られるくらいなら、志貴はわたしの事を嫌いでいい。
　……あーあ、結局は力ずくになっちゃったかな。
志貴に嫌われても、こうしちゃえば志貴はわたしから離れられなくなるんだから」
　言って、アルクェイドは唇を噛んだ。
　ぷつり、と。
　赤い血の雫が、アルクェイドの唇に滲む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that woman is different.
I’d rather have you hate me than let someone like her take you away.
Oh well. I suppose it comes down to force after all.
Once I do this, you won’t be able to leave me even if you hate me.”
Arcueid bit her lip.
A bright drop of blood welled there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----But that woman is different.
If she's the one to take you from me, it's better if you hate me.
…… Aw man, in the end, I guess I do have to use force.
You may hate me for this, but if I do this, you'll never be able to leave me."
Arcueid bites her lip after saying that.
Drip.
A bead of red blood forms on her lip.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ――――アルク、ちょっと待て……！」
　身の危険を感じて怒鳴るが、アルクェイドは聞こえないフリをして顔を下げてくる。
　捕まれた両腕を払おうとするが、間に合わない。
　そのまま――――
　―――アルクェイドの唇が、俺の口に重ねられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait—Arcueid, hold on…!”
I shouted at the sudden sense of danger, but Arcueid pretended not to hear and lowered her face.
I tried to wrench my captive arms free, but I was too late.
And then—
―――Arcueid pressed her lips to mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey----Arc, wait……!"
I yell out, sensing some kind of danger, but Arcueid looks down and pretends not to hear me.
I try to free myself, but I'm not in time.
Like that-----
----Arcueid's lips press onto my mouth.

entries.japanese:
「んっ――――――！」
　これは口付けなんかじゃない。
　アルクェイドは単に、自分の血を、俺に飲ませようとしている、だけだ。
「っ、っ、っ――――――――！」
　なんか、その行為は決定的にまずい気がして、とにかく必死になって抵抗する。
　が、がっちりと掴まれた両腕と、その……アルクェイドの唇の感触が気持ちよくて、段々と抗う力が弱くなってしまっ――――――
「こ………の、不浄者ぉっっっっ！！！！！」
――――と。
　トウトツに、世界が揺れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmph—!”
This wasn’t a kiss.
Arcueid was only trying to make me drink her blood.
“Nn—nn—nnnn!”
Something told me with absolute certainty that this was dangerous, and I fought with everything I had.
But her grip was unbreakable, and the feel of Arcueid’s lips was so pleasant that little by little my strength to resist drained away—
“Y-you unclean creature!”
――――And then.
Without warning, the world lurched.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Mmph-------!"
This isn't a kiss.
Arcueid is just, trying to get me to drink her blood.
"-----------!"
Something tells me this is really bad and I resist frantically.
But her arms grabbing mine are strong, and, um…… the sensation of her lips feels so good, my struggles grow weaker and weaker------
"You………… filthy thiiiiinnnnnnnggggg!!!!!!!!"
----And then,
my whole world suddenly jolts.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――え？」
　目を開けた時、視界に入ったのは弾き飛ばされるアルクェイドの姿だった。
　突然横なぐりに飛んできた何十という剣の直撃を受けて、ドン、ドン、ゴロン、バタン、ダンダンダンダン、かーん、とアルクェイドは公園のレンガ道を転がっていって、そのまま木々の茂みへと消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh?”
When I opened my eyes, Arcueid was being hurled away.
Dozens of swords struck her broadside without warning; bam, bam, tumble, crash, thud-thud-thud-thud, clang—she bounced down the park’s brick path and vanished into the trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Eh?"
When I open my eyes, I see Arcueid's body flying through the air.
Arcueid was hit directly by countless swords that came flying through the air, and she flew right along the brick pathway and disappeared into the trees.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――え？」
　アルクェイドが吹っ飛んでいった反対側に視線を送る。
「―――――――げ」
　そこには、はぁはぁと両肩を震わせているシエル先輩の姿があった。
「―――――――ぎろり」
　仇を見るような視線をこっちに向けて、シエルはツカツカと硬い足音をたててやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh?”
I looked in the opposite direction from where Arcueid had gone flying.
“Oh, hell.”
Ciel stood there, shoulders heaving as she gasped for breath.
“—Glare.”
Staring at me as if I were her mortal enemy, Ciel marched over, every hard footstep ringing out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Eh?"
I look down the opposite direction from where Arcueid disappeared to.
"-------Crap."
I see Ciel-senpai's there, her shoulders shaking.
-------I can feel the heat of her glare.
Staring at me like I was her enemy, Ciel walks over with sharp footsteps.

entries.japanese:
にこり、と笑って手を差し伸べてくる先輩。
　その手を握って、なんとか立ちあがった。
「……あの、シエル……先輩？
　もう帰ってきた、んだ」
「はい、遠野くんが心配で急いで帰ってきたんですよ。
けど部屋に帰ったらびっくりしました。
遠野くん、外に出ちゃいけないってあれほど言ったのに居ないんですから」
「いや、それには深いワケがあって、話すと長くなるんだけど―――――」
「はい、どうぞ話してください。
アルクェイドと何をしていたかは知りませんけど、言い訳ぐらいは聞いてあげますから」
entries.maoEnglish:
She smiled and offered me her hand.
I took it and somehow got to my feet.
“Um, Ciel? You’re back already?”
“Yes, Tohno. I was worried about you, so I hurried back. But imagine my surprise when I returned to the room and found you gone after I had told you not to leave.”
“There’s a complicated explanation, though it’ll take a while—”
“Then please explain. I don’t know what you were doing with Arcueid, but I’ll at least hear your excuses.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
She smiles and stretches out her hand out to me.
I grab her hand and manage to stand back up.
"…… Um, Ciel…… Senpai?
You're, back already."
"Yes, I was worried about you, Tohno-kun, so I hurried back.
But when I came back to my room, I was surprised.
I told you not to leave the room, but you weren't there."
"Uh, there's a big reason for that, and it's a long story------"
"Then please, go ahead.
I don't know what you were doing with Arcueid, but I'll at least listen to your excuse."

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
一番初めに言っておくけど、先輩が思っているようなコトはないぞ。
俺はアルクェイドとまだ何もしてないんだ。
　先輩が思っているコトは、間違いなく冤罪だ」
「なるほど。
わたしが思っているようなコトはなくて、遠野くんにかけられている容疑はわたしの一方的な勘違い、というんですね」
「そう！
　良かった、さすがシエル先輩っ！
　細かく説明しなくても解ってくれるって思ってた！」
　ばんざーい、と手をあげる。
「………………う」
　睨まれて、両手を下げた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, let me say this first. Nothing happened like what you’re imagining. Arcueid and I haven’t done anything yet.
Whatever you think I’m guilty of, I’ve been falsely accused.”
“I see. So nothing happened, and every suspicion against you is merely a baseless misunderstanding on my part.”
“Exactly! I knew you’d understand, Ciel! I knew I wouldn’t have to explain every little thing!”
I threw both hands up in triumph.
“Urk.”
One glare, and my hands came down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai.
I'll say this now, but it isn't what you think.
I didn't do anything with Arcueid.
What you're thinking is, just a false accusation."
"I see.
So you're saying that there's nothing going on, and it's all just a misunderstanding on my part?"
"Yeah!
Alright, way to go Ciel-senpai!
I knew you'd understand right away!"
I raise my hands in the air and cheer.
"………………… Erk."
Being glared at, I lower my hands.

entries.japanese:
「……まあいいでしょう。
残念ですが、今は彼女を倒す事が先決ですから。
けど遠野くん、この件は後できちんと追求しますからね」
　シエルは俺から視線を逸らして、木々の茂みを見つめる。
「―――――――――っ！」
　俺でも、そこから溢れ出している歪みが感じとれた。
　ぞわり、と。
　目に見えない毒が流出してくるような、違和感。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. Unfortunately, defeating her comes first. But we will discuss this properly later, Tohno.”
Ciel looked away from me and into the trees.
“—!”
Even I could feel the distortion pouring from the thicket.
A crawling wrongness came over me.
It was like invisible poison spilling into the air.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh well.
Unfortunately, taking care of her takes priority right now.
But Tohno-kun, I'll definitely ask you about this later on."
She looks away from me and towards the thick trees.
"----------!"
Even I can feel something straining forth from that direction.
Chill.
An uneasiness like an unseen poison is starting to fill the air.

entries.japanese:
「……離れていてください、遠野くん」
　シエルはアルクェイドが弾き飛ばされた茂みへと歩いていく。
「離れていろって、シエル……！」
　そんな事は聞けない。
　以前、シエルとアルクェイドはこの公園で戦った。
あの時だってシエルはアルクェイドには敵わなかったんだから、一人でアルクェイドと戦わせる訳にはいかない。
　かといって、シエルと二人がかりでアルクェイドを襲うなんて、そんなコト、考えたくもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stay back, Tohno.”
Ciel walked toward the thicket where Arcueid had disappeared.
“Stay back? Ciel…!”
I couldn’t obey that.
Ciel and Arcueid had fought in this park before, and Ciel had been no match for her then. I could not let her face Arcueid alone.
But the thought of joining Ciel to attack Arcueid was just as unbearable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please get away, Tohno-kun."
Ciel walks toward the bushes that Arcueid disappeared into.
"Get away?
Ciel……!"
I can't listen.
Before, Ciel and Arcueid fought in this park.
Even at that time, Ciel didn't stand a chance against her, so I can't let her fight with Arcueid alone.
But, I don't want to even think about me and Ciel both attacking Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「待った、先輩……！
　アルクェイドは何もしてないんだ。
あいつは悪い吸血鬼ってワケじゃないんだから、もう――――」
「……遠野くん。
吸血種に善悪は関係ありません。
彼らは人間社会に混濁している時点で排除されるべき存在です。
　それに、もう手遅れです。
彼女、本気でわたしたちを殺すつもりですから」
「そ――――――」
　そんな事はない、と言うより早く。
　ゆらり、と致死性の毒を撒き散らすように、アルクェイドが姿を現した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Ciel…! Arcueid hasn’t done anything. She isn’t some evil vampire, so please—”
“Tohno. Good and evil are irrelevant to vampiric species. Once they mingle with human society, their very presence must be eliminated.
Besides, it’s too late. She truly intends to kill us.”
“That’s—”
Before I could deny it.
Arcueid emerged, swaying like a body that shed lethal poison with every step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait, Senpai……!
Arcueid didn't do anything.
She's not a bad vampire, so----"
"…… Tohno-kun.
When it comes to vampires, good and evil do not matter.
They are an existence that must be eliminated once they mix into human society.
And, it's already too late.
She intends to kill us already."
"Th-----"
Before I can say, "That's not true,"
Arcueid's figure appears, swaying like she's sowing the seeds of death.

entries.japanese:
「―――また不意打ちか。
芸がないというより性根が腐っているみたいね、あなたは」
「減らず口を。
通常の吸血種なら六度は殺せる黒鍵を受けて傷一つない相手には、いかなる手段も公正でしょう。
貴方のような化け物に、人の性格をどうこう語られるのは不愉快です」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Another ambush. I’d call you unimaginative, but rotten to the core seems more accurate.”
