“Spare me. Any method is fair against an opponent who can take enough Black Keys to kill an ordinary member of the vampiric species six times over without suffering a scratch. I will not be lectured on character by a monster like you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Another surprise attack?
Not so much you being unoriginal but just having a sick personality instead."
"You talk too much.
Against an opponent who emerges unscratched where normal vampires would have been killed six times over by these Black Keys, any method should be fair.
It's sickening to have a monster like you comment on my personality."

entries.japanese:
ばちばち、と二人の間に火花が散っている。
　……比喩ではなく、本当に帯電してる。
　アルクェイドの殺意は空気を侵食していて、息をするだけで肺が焼きつきそうだ。
　シエル先輩も似たようなもので、心なしか法衣が以前よりゴツゴツしている気がする。
　……今回は徹底交戦のつもりなのか、なにやら物騒な武器をいくつも隠し持っているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Sparks crackled between them.
Not metaphorically—the air was genuinely charged.
Arcueid’s murderous intent corroded the atmosphere until every breath threatened to sear my lungs.
Ciel was little better.
Her vestments somehow looked bulkier than before, as though she had hidden any number of dangerous weapons beneath them for an all-out war.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sparks are flying between the two of them.
…… That isn't a metaphor; the air really is charged.
Arcueid's hostility invades the air so much that the simple act of breathing burns my lungs.
Ciel-senpai is similar, and it seems her robe is more bulky than usual.
…… It seems she's prepared for total war this time, and it looks like she's hiding all sorts of freaky weapons under there.

entries.japanese:
「―――ふん。
教会に戻って何をしてきたかと思えば、黒い銃身を持ち出してくるなんてね。
エンハウンスにつまらない知恵を与えたのはあなただっていう噂、本当なんだ」
「貴方には関係のない話です。
……まあ、ここで封じられるんですから、貴方にとって関係のある話というのは未来永劫ありませんけど」
「―――――――――」
　……アルクェイドの腕がさがる。
　彼女は本気だ。
　次の瞬間にもシエルへと襲いかかるだろう。
　それをシエルは迎え討つ。
　……どちらに事が有利に運ぼうと、どちらかが傷を負うのは解りきっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmph. So that’s what you went back to the Church for—you brought out that black gun barrel. I heard the rumor that you were the one who put those foolish ideas into Enhance’s head.”
“That is none of your concern. Although once you have been sealed here, nothing will ever concern you again.”
“—”
Arcueid’s arm lowered.
She was serious.
She would attack Ciel in the next instant.
Ciel would meet her head-on.
No matter which side gained the advantage, one of them was certain to be hurt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Oh?
I wondered what you did going back to the church, but bringing out the Black Barrel?
I guess the rumor of you giving boring knowledge to Enhance was true."
"It doesn't concern you.
…… Well, since you will be sealed here, there won't be anything that will concern you ever again."
"---------"
…… Arcueid's arm lowers.
She's serious.
The next instant, she'll probably attack Ciel.
Ciel would fight back.
…… No matter who wins, I already know someone is going to get hurt.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――っ」
　そんなのは、許せない。
　以前は止められなかった。
　だが今は、今回こそは止めないといけない。
　この状況を招いたのは自分だ。
　シエル先輩とアルクェイド、二人ともが自分にとって大切だと思ったのなら。
「……………この、馬鹿野郎」
　俺は。
命がけで、二人を止めなければいけない筈だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I couldn’t allow it.
I had failed to stop them before.
This time, I had to.
I was the reason they had come to this.
If Ciel and Arcueid both mattered to me—
“You pair of idiots.”
I had to. I had to risk my life to stop them both.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I, can't let that happen.
I couldn't stop it before.
But now, this time, I have to stop it.
I am the one who brought this situation on.
Ciel-senpai and Arcueid.
If I think they are both very important to me, then…
"……………… You, stupid idiots."
I have to stop them even if it costs me my life.

entries.japanese:
……空気が揺れる。
　アルクェイドの視線がシエルの首筋につけられる。
　その、前に。
「――――――待て」
　二人の間に、割って入った。
entries.maoEnglish:
The air trembled.
Arcueid’s gaze fixed on Ciel’s throat.
Before she could move—
“Wait.”
I stepped between them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The air vibrates.
Arcueid is looking directly at Ciel's neck.
Before, then,
"------Wait!"
I throw myself between the two of them.

entries.japanese:
「邪魔よ、志貴は黙っていて」
「邪魔です、遠野くんは退いていてください」
　二人の視線が突き刺さる。
「―――――――――っ」
　頭痛と悪寒。
　二人は本気で俺を邪魔だと思っているんだろう。
　二人分の敵意を受けて、背骨がぎちぎちと悲鳴をあげている。
　くわえて、頭痛は一層激しさを増して二重に遠野志貴を責めてくる。
　……本気で死の線を凝視する反動と。
　……アルクェイドを殺そうとする自分に対する、ロアからの反動か。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re in the way, Shiki, so stay out of this.”
“You’re in the way, Tohno; please move.”
Their gazes stabbed into me.
“—!”
A headache and a chill.
They truly must have seen me as an obstacle.
Their combined hostility made my spine creak in protest.
Worse, the headache swelled, tormenting Shiki Tohno from two directions.
Was one the recoil from straining with all my might to see the Lines of Death?
And the other Roa’s recoil against the part of me trying to kill Arcueid?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're in the way, be quiet Shiki."
"You're in the way, please get back Tohno-kun."
I'm pierced by both of their gazes.
"---------!!"
A headache and chills.
They both really think that I'm in the way.
My spine screams as I bear the full brunt of their enmity.
What's more, my headache worsens.
…… It's in reaction to seriously gazing at the lines of death.
…… And Roa's reaction to me trying to kill Arcueid, perhaps.

entries.japanese:
「二人とも、止めろ。
二人が争う必要なんて無いだろう」
「ふざけないで、理由なんて初めから無いに決まってるでしょう。
いいから退いて志貴。
いくら志貴でもわたしの邪魔をするっていうんなら容赦しないわよ」
「彼女の言うとおりです。
これは遠野くんが関わり合う問題ではありません。
……そのままでいるというのなら、このまま戦うまでです」
　二人は俺の制止の声なんて聞かない。
　……まあ。
そんなことだろうと、覚悟はしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Both of you, stop. There’s no reason for you to fight.”
“Don’t be ridiculous; of course there was never any reason. Just move, Shiki. Even for you, I won’t show mercy if you get in my way.”
“She is correct. This does not concern you, Tohno. If you remain there, we will simply fight with you between us.”
Neither of them listened to me.
Well. I had expected as much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop it you two.
There's no need for you to fight."
"Don't be ridiculous.
There never was a reason in the first place.
Just get back Shiki.
Even if it is you, I won't let you go if you get in my way."
"Just like she says.
This does not concern you, Tohno-kun…… Even if you stay there, we're going to fight anyway."
They're not listening to a word I say.
…… Well.
I was prepared for that, anyway.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
なら仕方ない。
どうしてもやりあうっていうんなら、俺がやる」
「「―――――え？」」
「言ってもきかないんなら仕方がないだろう。
二人が殺し合いを始めるなら、たとえ殺してでも、それを止めるだけだ」
　ナイフを強く握って、脳が焼ききれるぐらい強く、セカイを見つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then there’s no choice. If you insist on fighting, I’ll fight too.”
Together: “What?”
“If words won’t stop you, what else can I do? If you start trying to kill each other, I’ll stop you—even if I have to kill you both.”
I clenched the knife and stared into the world until my brain seemed ready to burn away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Then it can't be helped.
If you're going to fight no matter what, then I'll have to do it myself."
""-----Eh?""
"It can't be helped if you don't listen to what I say.
If you two intend to kill each other, I'll have to stop you, even if I have to kill."
Gripping my knife strongly, I stare at the world almost hard enough to fry my brain.

entries.japanese:
どくん、という音。
　脳髄が心臓にでもなってしまったような振動。
　息を吸いこむだけで全身の骨が分解しそうな痛みの中、多くの『死』を凝視する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump.
The vibration made it feel as though my brain had become a second heart.
Through pain that threatened to pull every bone in my body apart whenever I breathed, I stared at the many deaths around me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
My brain throbs as if it turned into another heart.
Bathed in an agony where sucking in my breath seems to break every bone in my body, I stare at the "death" all around me.

entries.japanese:
「と、遠野くん………！
　ダメです、そんなふうに眼を使うと、遠野くんの脳の血管が焼ききれてしまいますっ……！」
「―――仕方ないだろ。
こうでもしないと―――アルクェイドを止める事が、できないんだから」
「…………………………」
　慌てるシエルとは逆に、アルクェイドは冷めた目で俺を見ていた。
　……くそ、あの様子じゃアルクェイドのヤツ、俺にアルクェイド自身の線が視えていないって、気づいて、いる、みたい、だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“T-Tohno, stop! If you use your eyes like that, the blood vessels in your brain will burn out!”
“I don’t have a choice. This is the only way I can stop Arcueid.”
“…”
Unlike the panicking Ciel, Arcueid watched me with cold eyes.
Damn it—from that look, she had already realized I still couldn’t see any lines on her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"To, Tohno-kun………!
You shouldn't.
If you use your eyes like that, the blood vessels in your brain will explode……!"
"---I can't help it.
If I don't do this---I can't stop Arcueid."
"……………………"
In contrast to the panicking Ciel, Arcueid just stares at me with cold eyes.
…… Damn it, Arcueid standing like that, it seems like she knows I, can't, see, any, of, her, lines.

entries.japanese:
「―――当然でしょう。
志貴が命がけになったぐらいじゃ、わたしから『死』の点は読み取れない。
……まあ、線ぐらいは視つけられるかもしれないけど、それも無意味よ」
「…………この。
とことん可愛げがないな、おまえってヤツは」
「――――――――」
　……っ。
やば、い。
気が、遠くなって、きた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. Risking your life is nowhere near enough to read a Point of Death from me. You might manage to find a line, but even that would be useless.”
“…You really don’t have one lovable bone in your body.”
“—”
This was bad. My consciousness was fading. I could feel it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Of course.
You just risking your life won't let you see any points of "death" on me.
…… Well, you may be able to find some lines, but that's meaningless as well."
"…………… Why you… You're not cute at all."
"--------"
…… Crap.
I'm, going to, pass out.

entries.japanese:
「解ったのならすぐに止めて。
志貴の意識が死んでしまえば、ロアの意識が貴方を乗っ取る。
そうなったらわたしでも志貴を助ける事なんかできない」
　……アルクェイドの声が聞こえる。
　だがそれでも、二人を止めると決めたんだ。
この程度で―――
　根をあげるワケには、いかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then stop immediately. If Shiki’s consciousness dies, Roa’s will takes over. Once that happens, even I won’t be able to save you.”
Arcueid’s voice reached me.
But I had decided to stop them. Something this small could not—
Make me surrender.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you understand, then stop.
If your consciousness dies, then Roa will take over.
If that happens, then not even I can help you, Shiki."
…… I can hear Arcueid's voice.
All the same, I've decided to stop them.
Such a thing can't----
Stop me.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん―――アルクェイドに線が視えるんですか！？」
　と。
　唐突に、シエル先輩が声をあげた。
「チッ―――――」
　アルクェイドが悔しそうに舌を鳴らす。
　立ち尽くしたまま動かないアルクェイドをよそに、シエル先輩が駆け寄ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno—can you see a line on Arcueid?”
And then.
Ciel suddenly cried out.
“Tch—”
Arcueid clicked her tongue in frustration.
While Arcueid stood rooted in place, Ciel rushed toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun---you can see lines on Arcueid!?"
Suddenly,
Ciel-senpai's voice calls out.
"Tch------"
Arcueid clicks her tongue disappointedly.
Ciel-senpai rushes towards me ignoring Arcueid who just stands there.

entries.japanese:
「答えて。
遠野くん、アルクェイドの線が視えるんですね！？」
　必死になって聞いてくるシエルに頷く。
「良かった―――――それなら遠野くんを助ける事ができます……！
　諦めていたけど、これなら本当に、ロアをあなたから離す事ができる……！」
　先輩から、さっきまでの殺気が消えている。
　……良かった。
どうしてか知らないけど、シエルはアルクェイドと戦うコトを止めてくれた、みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me. You can see a line on Arcueid, can’t you?”
I nodded to the desperately pleading Ciel.
“Thank goodness—then I can save you! I had given up, but now we truly can separate Roa from you!”
The murderous intent vanished from Ciel.
Thank God. I didn’t know why, but it seemed Ciel had abandoned the fight with Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tell me.
Tohno-kun, you can see lines on Arcueid!?"
I nod to Ciel's frantic question.
"Good--------then you can be helped, Tohno-kun……!
I gave up hope, but with this, we can really separate Roa from you……!"
The hostility I sensed from Senpai disappears.
…… Thank God.
I don't know why, but it seems like Ciel stopped fighting Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
先輩、教会で俺からロアを離す方法を、探してきてくれたんだ」
「ぁ―――――――」
　明るかった声が消える。
　シエルは俯いてから、顔をあげた。
「……違うんです。
教会には遠野くんを助ける方法なんてなかった。
わたしがこんなに早く帰ってきたのは、何も手段がないって解ってしまったからなんです」
「――――――――」
　思わず、声を飲んでしまった。
　それはつまり、俺はこのままロアに飲みこまれるだけだと、いう事だからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. You went to the Church to find a way to separate Roa from me.”
“Ah—”
The brightness left Ciel’s voice.
She lowered her face, then looked up again.
“No. The Church had no way to save you. I came back so quickly because I learned there was nothing we could do.”
“—”
My voice died in my throat.
That meant I could do nothing but wait for Roa to swallow me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
Senpai, you found a way to eliminate Roa from inside me at the church."
"A-------"
Her enthusiastic voice cuts off.
Ciel looks down, then raises her head.
"…… No, there was no way to help you at the church.
I came back this early because it was a dead end."
"--------"
I gasp automatically.
Because, that means the only thing left for me is to be consumed by Roa.

entries.japanese:
「けど、遠野くんがアルクェイドから死の要因を視つけられるのなら話は違ってきます。
　ロアはアルクェイドの死徒です。
たとえ今では乖離し、侍従としての関係を断った所で、力の源がアルクェイドである事に変わりはありません。
　ですから―――アルクェイドを消滅させる事ができるのなら、ロアの力も弱くなる筈なんです」
「な―――――――え？」
　シエルが何を言っているのか瞬時に理解できない。
　アルクェイドは立ち尽くしたまま、ただ俺とシエルの会話を聞いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But if you can find a cause of death in Arcueid, everything changes.
Roa is Arcueid’s Dead Apostle. He may have broken away and severed their bond as master and servant, but Arcueid remains the source of his power.
Therefore, if Arcueid can be annihilated, Roa’s power should weaken as well.”
“W-what?”
I could not immediately grasp what Ciel was saying.
Arcueid remained motionless, listening to our conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, Tohno-kun.
If you can see that which can cause Arcueid's death, then it is a different story.
Roa is Arcueid's Dead Apostle.
Even if he is separated right now, his connection to Arcueid as the source of his power does not change.
So----if you are able to destroy Arcueid, then Roa will have to get weaker."
"Wha----------eh?"
I can't quite grasp what she says right away.
Arcueid just stands there, listening to the conversation between Ciel and me.

entries.japanese:
「わたし一人では、いえ教会の秘宝では真祖であるアルクェイドを消滅させる事はできない。
できて彼女を拘束し、封印する程度です。
　けど遠野くんが彼女から死の要因を視つけられるのは、話は違ってきます。
　遠野くん、力を貸してください。
貴方が協力してくるのなら、わたしだけでもアルクェイドを殺しきる事ができる……！」
「―――――――――――」
　息がつまる。
　俺が？
　アルクェイドを殺す事に協力する？
　自分が。
ロアから自分が助かる為に、アルクェイドを殺す事を手伝えって、いうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I cannot annihilate a True Ancestor like Arcueid alone. Even the Church’s sacred treasures could do no more than bind and seal her.
But if you can find a cause of death in her, everything changes.
Tohno, lend me your strength. With your help, I can kill Arcueid completely…!”
“—”
My breath caught.
Me? Help kill Arcueid?
I would. To save myself from Roa, I was supposed to help kill Arcueid?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"By myself… no, even with a treasure of The Church I cannot destroy Arcueid, a True Ancestor.
The best I can do is to seal her away.
But, if you can see those causes of death on her, then it is a different story.
Tohno-kun, lend me your power.
If you help me, even I can kill Arcueid……!"
"-----------"
My breath stops in my throat.
Me?
Help kill Arcueid?
Me.
She's saying I have to help kill Arcueid so I can save myself from Roa?

entries.japanese:
「―――――だめだ。
それは、できない」
「「――――――――え？」」
　また、二人の声が重奏した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I can’t do that.”
“What?”
Once again, their voices rang out together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No.
I can't do that."
""---------Eh?""
Their voices overlap once more.

entries.japanese:
「な―――何を言ってるんですか遠野くん……！
　そうしないと遠野くんはロアに乗っ取られるんですよ！？
　それに、そうしているのだって彼女を殺すためじゃないですか……！」
　……違う。
それは違うんだ、先輩。
「……シエル。
俺はアルクェイドを殺したくなんかない。
俺は先輩とアルクェイドが争うのを止めてほしくて、こうするしかないって、思っただけだ」
「そ、それは……そうでしょうけど、でも……！
アルクェイドを殺さないと、遠野くんが消えてしまうんです。
わたし、わたしはそんなのイヤです……！
　どうして……？
　自分の命より彼女のほうが大切だっていうんですか、あなたは！」
「――――――――」
　それは。
確かに、先輩の言うとおり、だけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-what are you saying, Tohno? If we don’t do this, Roa will take you over! And aren’t you straining your eyes precisely so you can kill her?”
No. That wasn’t it.
“Ciel, I don’t want to kill Arcueid. I only wanted you two to stop fighting. I thought this was the only way.”
“I-I understand, but…
Arcueid has to die or you’ll disappear. I can’t bear that! Why? Is she more precious to you than your own life?”
“—”
That was true. Ciel was right, but still.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---What are you saying, Tohno-kun……!?
If you don't do that, Roa will take over!
And, weren't you looking for her lines to kill her……!?"
…… No, you got it wrong, Senpai.
"…… Ciel.
I don't want to kill Arcueid at all.
I just wanted you two to stop fighting, and this was the only way I thought I could stop it."
"That, that…… may be true, but……!
If you do not kill Arcueid, you will disappear, Tohno-kun!
I, I don't want that……!
Why……?
Are you saying Arcueid's life is more important than your own!?"
"---------"
Senpai is right, but,

entries.japanese:
「……解らない。
けど、俺はアルクェイドを傷つける事はできない。
　……勝手なコトを言ってごめん、シエル。
　俺は、アイツの事を嫌いになれないんだ。
だから……自分が助かるためにアイツを殺すなんて、できない」
「……遠野君。
彼女の事が、好きなんですか」
「―――まさか。
俺はシエルを愛してる」
　その言葉に偽りはない。
　俺にとって一番大切な人はこの人しかいないんだから。
「―――――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. But I can’t hurt Arcueid.
Forgive me for being selfish, Ciel.
I can’t make myself hate her. So I can’t kill her just to save myself.”
“Tohno. Do you have feelings for her?”
“Don’t be ridiculous. I love you, Ciel.”
There was no lie in those words.
No one mattered more to me than her.
“—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't know, but I can't hurt Arcueid.
…… Sorry for being selfish, Ciel.
I can't hate her.
That's why…… even to save myself, I can't kill her."
"…… Tohno-kun.
You, like her?"
"---Of course not.
I love you, Ciel."
That's no lie.
There's only one person I hold the most dear.
"---------"

entries.japanese:
シエルは俯いて、口を閉ざした。
　……そこにはもう、殺意や敵意といったものは感じられない。
　あとは、あそこでご機嫌ナナメとばかりにこっちを睨んでいるアルクェイドさえ引き下がってくれれば、この場はなんとか解決するんだけど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel lowered her head and fell silent.
I could no longer feel any murderous intent or hostility from her.
Now, if only Arcueid—who was glaring at me as if profoundly offended—would also back down, we might somehow settle this—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ciel closes her mouth as she hangs her head.
…… I don't sense any hostility or enmity from her at all anymore.
Now, if I can get the person staring at me with a sour expression to go away, everything will be just fine--

entries.japanese:
「……アルクェイド。
頼む、引いてくれないか。
　ロアは俺が必ず連れていく。
……あとどのくらい俺が残っていられるか解らないけど、最期になったら必ず―――」
「自分ごと死の点を突いて、ロアを『殺す』って言うんでしょ」
　きっぱりと、アルクェイドは俺の心を見透かしてくる。
「そんなのお断りよ。
志貴が最期の時って、もう半分以上ロアに支配されてるってコトじゃない。
　そんな状況で自害なんてできると思ってるの、志貴は」
「う―――――――」
　流石に鋭い所を突いてくるな、コイツ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, please. Let this go.
I swear I’ll take Roa with me. I don’t know how much longer I’ll remain myself, but when the end comes, I promise—”
“You’ll stab your own Point of Death and ‘kill’ Roa along with yourself—that’s what you were going to say.”
Arcueid read my mind without hesitation.
“Absolutely not. By the time your end comes, Roa will control more than half of you.
Do you really think you’ll be able to kill yourself then?”
“Urk—”
Damn her for seeing straight through the plan.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Arcueid.
Please, can you give up?
I will definitely take Roa.
…… I don't know how long I'll remain, but at the very end, I'll---…
"Pierce your point of death and 'kill' Roa?"
Arcueid reads my mind.
"I refuse.
The very end means Roa will have almost taken you over completely.
Do you think you can kill yourself in that situation, Shiki?"
"U--------"
She makes some cutting remarks.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあどうしろって言うんだ。
ロアに食われはじめたらおまえを呼べっていうのかよ」
「いいえ、そんなまだるっこしい事しなくていいよ。
志貴がここで自害してくれればそれでいいんだから」
　さらりと。
　いつもの調子で、アルクェイドは惨い事を言ってくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then what am I supposed to do? Call you once Roa starts eating me?”
“No, there’s no need for anything so tedious. All you have to do is kill yourself here.”
Without a second thought,
Arcueid delivered this atrocity as lightly as any ordinary remark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then what're you saying I do?
Go tell you once Roa starts to consume me?"
"No, you don't have to go through all that trouble.
It'll be all fine if you just kill yourself right here."
Easily,
with her usual expression, Arcueid speaks cruelly.

entries.japanese:
「な、何言ってるんですか貴方は！
　そんな事、たとえ遠野くんが認めてもわたしが許しませんっ……！」
「ちょっ、ちょっとシエルっ……！」
　があ、とアルクェイドに襲いかかろうとする先輩を押さえつける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-what are you saying? Even if Tohno agreed, I would never allow it!”
“C-Ciel, wait!”
I grabbed Ciel as she tried to launch herself at Arcueid with a roar.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha, what are you saying!?
Such a thing I would not allow even if Tohno-kun accepted it……!"
"H-hey, Ciel……!"
I hold back Senpai who tries to attack Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「アルクェイド、確かにおまえにとってはそれが一番いいんだろうけど、それは―――その、できれば勘弁してくれないか」
「だーめ。
それが一番いいって志貴も解ってるんでしょ？
　なら待ったげない。
志貴はここでロアごと自分を殺さないと、後々面倒なコトになるわ」
「んーっ、んっー、んっー……！」
　バタバタと暴れるシエルを必死に押さえつける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid, I realize that would be best for you, but could you possibly—if it isn’t too much trouble—not make me do that?”
“Nope. You know that’s the best solution too, don’t you? Then I’m not gonna wait for you. If you don’t kill yourself along with Roa right here, it will only cause trouble later.”
“Mmm-mmm-mmmmm…!”
I desperately held down the thrashing Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arcueid, maybe that is the best thing for you---but can you just let it go?"
"Nope.
You understand that's the best way too, right Shiki?
So I won't wait.
If you don't kill Roa right now, things will get difficult later on."
"Nnggh, nnngh, nnn……!"
I desperately hold on to Ciel who goes wild in my arms.

entries.japanese:
「……ま、わたしももうちょっと志貴に血を飲んでほしかったけど、シエルもいる事だしこれ以上は難しいわ。
　だから、これで妥協してあげる。
言ったでしょ、志貴。
貴方がわたしのモノになってくれるなら、ロアなんてすぐに取り除いてあげるって。
あれってね、もう半分以上実現してるんだから」
「なっ……遠野くん、アルクェイドの血を飲んじゃったんですか！？」
　がばっと腕を払って、シエル先輩は俺を睨みつけてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I would have liked you to drink a little more of my blood, but with Ciel here that will be difficult.
So I’ll compromise. Remember what I told you, Shiki? If you became mine, I could remove Roa at once. Well, that promise is already more than half fulfilled.”
“T-Tohno, you drank Arcueid’s blood?!”
Ciel tore free of my arms and rounded on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I wanted Shiki to drink more of my blood, but with Ciel here, it's a little difficult.
So I will compromise.
Didn't I say so earlier, Shiki?
That if you became mine, you could rid yourself of Roa right away.
It's already more than half done, anyway."
"Wha…… Tohno-kun, you drank some of Arcueid's blood!?"
Breaking free, Ciel-senpai glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ―――ああ。
その、さっきアルクェイドに押さえつけられてた時、強引に飲まされちゃったんだけど……なんか問題、あるんですか先輩」
「そ、そんなの大有りです！
　それじゃあ遠野くん、アルクェイドの影響下にあるようなものじゃないですか！
　彼女の血を体内に取り入れてしまったのなら、遠野くんはアルクェイドの手足の延長と同じなんです……！」
「え―――――それって、ようするに」
「はい、血を吸われて死徒になるのと何ら変わりはありませんっ！」
　アルクェイドに視線を移す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y-yeah. She forced me to drink some when she had me pinned down earlier, but is that a problem, Ciel?”
“Of course it is! That practically places you under Arcueid’s control. Once her blood enters your body, you become an extension of her own limbs!”
“Wait—so, in other words…”
“It’s no different from being drained and turned into a Dead Apostle!”
I looked at Arcueid.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---uh, well, when Arcueid was pinning me down earlier, she forced me to…… is there a problem with that, Senpai?"
"Y, yes!
It's a huge problem!
With that, you're pretty much under her influence!
If you have her blood inside you, you'll be just like an extension of her, like an arm or a leg……!"
"Eh-------Then, you mean--"
"Yes, no different than a Dead Apostle who got his blood sucked!"
I look over to Arcueid.

entries.japanese:
「へへー」
　……あのヤロウ。
余裕に満ちた笑顔なんか浮かべやがって、どうりで―――
「ア、アルクェイド……！
　おまえ、力ずくってこういう事か！
　何が俺の嫌がる事はしない、だ！
　立派に俺の血を吸ってるじゃないか、このおおうそつき……！」
「えー、違うよー。
わたし、志貴の血は吸ってないもの。
ただわたしの血をあげただけだから、志貴は死徒になんか成ってないじゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Heh-heh.”
That little monster wore such a smugly confident smile—no wonder.
“Arcueid! Is this what you meant by force? You said you’d never do anything I hated, and then you went and drank my blood!
You lying fraud!”
“No, that’s not it. I didn’t drink Shiki’s blood. I only gave him mine, so he hasn’t become a Dead Apostle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hehe~"
…… Why that little…… Smiling like that, no wonder---
"A, Arcueid……!
Is this what you mean by using force!?
What part of this is not doing something I won't like!?
You've sucked my blood, you big liar……!"
"Eh-, you got it all wrong.
I didn't suck your blood.
I just gave you some of my blood, so that's why you didn't turn into a Dead Apostle."

entries.japanese:
「同じ事です……！
　貴方の血を体内に含む、という事は貴方の意志には逆らえなくなるって事じゃないですか……！
　それも度をすぎれば人間としての遺伝情報が真祖の遺伝情報に侵されて壊れてしまう。
　貴方の血だったら、ほんの少しだけで人間の体なんて壊れてしまうでしょう！？」
「失礼ね、そんな不手際はしないわ。
だいたい志貴の体はロアに侵されてとっくに吸血種に成りかけてるじゃない。
この場合、わたしの血は良い方に働くと思うけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It amounts to the same thing! Having your blood inside him means he can no longer defy your will! If it goes too far, a True Ancestor’s genetic information will invade and destroy his human genome.
With blood like yours, even a tiny amount could destroy a human body!”
“How insulting—I would never make such a clumsy mistake. Besides, Roa has already invaded Shiki’s body so deeply that he’s halfway to becoming one of the vampiric species. My blood should help him, if anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's the same thing……!
To have your blood inside someone means they cannot disobey you……!
And if you go too far, your genetic information as a True Ancestor will invade and destroy his human genetic information.
If it's your blood, only a little would destroy a human body, right!?"
"How rude, I won't make such sloppy mistakes.
In the first place, Shiki's body is already invaded by Roa and is almost a vampire's body anyway.
In this case, I think my blood helps.

entries.japanese:
「……それにね、志貴はわたしの言うコトなんて聞いてくれないわ。
たった一雫だけの血じゃ、わたしの言葉を拒否するのに多大な精神力を必要とする、ぐらいがせいぜいでしょ。
　加えてわたしは志貴の血を吸ってないから、志貴の体は志貴のものよ。
知ってるでしょう、吸血種は対象の血を獲り混む事でその対象を自身の所有物にするんだって」
「そ、それでも貴方が遠野くんに無理やり血を飲ませたのは事実ですっ……！
　そんなコトをして、貴方は一体なに考えてるんですか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And Shiki won’t obey me. One drop can do no more than force him to expend considerable willpower when he refuses me.
I never drank his blood, so his body remains his own. You know that a member of the vampiric species claims someone as property by taking that person’s blood into itself.”
“B-but you still forced Tohno to drink your blood! What in the world were you thinking?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Besides, Shiki won't listen to what I say.
With only one drop of blood, it'll only take him some willpower to refuse my orders.
Besides, I didn't suck Shiki's blood, so his body is his own.
You know already, right?
A vampire makes a target their own by sucking the target's blood and mixing it with their blood."
"B-but still, you forced Tohno-kun to drink your blood……!
What in the world were you thinking……!?"

entries.japanese:
「決まってるじゃない。
志貴がロアと一緒に死んでも、ちゃんとロアに勝てるようにしてあげたの。
　志貴は今、わたしの影響下にあるのよ？
　ロアと志貴が互角でも、わたしが志貴のバックアップに回れば志貴が生き残るのは自明の理じゃない」
「あ―――――――――」
　ぽかん、と。
　シエル先輩は呆然と口を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Isn’t it obvious? I made certain Shiki could defeat Roa even if they died together.
Shiki is under my influence now, isn’t he? If he and Roa are evenly matched, my support makes Shiki’s survival inevitable.”
“Ah—”
Blankly.
Ciel’s mouth fell open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's obvious, right?
I made it so that Shiki can beat Roa even if Shiki and Roa die at the same time.
Now, Shiki is under my influence, you know.
Even if Roa and Shiki are equal, if I give Shiki backup, it's only natural that Shiki will survive.
"Ah----------"
Ciel-senpai's mouth opens in shock.

entries.japanese:
「解った？
　志貴を助けるとか何とか言ってたけど、あなたの方法なんかよりわたしの方法のほうがずっと優れている。
ほら、身のほどを知ったのなら早く志貴から離れなさい」
「う――――あう、う」
　ぱくぱくと口を開けるシエル先輩。
　……なんか、一気に形成が逆転したというか、間が抜けてしまったというか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do you understand now? You made such a fuss about saving Shiki, but my method is far superior to yours. Now that you know your place, hurry up and leave him.”
“U-uh—ah…”
Ciel’s mouth opened and closed soundlessly.
The balance of power had reversed so suddenly that the whole scene had somehow become ridiculous.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you understand?
You said you'll help Shiki, but my method is much better than yours.
Come on, if you understand, then hurry up and get away from Shiki."
"Uh-----Ah, uh."
Ciel-senpai's mouth opens and closes.
…… It seems things have taken a sudden twist.

entries.japanese:
「ま、ホントはね、わたしも黙っていようとは思ってたんだ。
……けど、まあいいかなって。
さっきの志貴の言葉で、わたしも脈ありってわかったし。
　そうね、志貴がシエルよりわたしのほうが好きだって言ってくれるなら、今回は助けてあげてもいいよ」
　にっこりと、アルクェイドは俺にではなくシエル先輩に笑いかける。
「だ――――――――――」
　わなわなと肩を震わせるシエル先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“To be honest, I had planned to keep it secret. But then I decided there was no harm in telling you. After what Shiki said earlier, I know I have a chance too.
So if Shiki promises he likes me more than Ciel, I might agree to save him this time.”
Arcueid smiled brightly—not at me, but at Ciel.
“Y-you—”
Ciel’s shoulders began to tremble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, to be honest, I was thinking about not telling you about it…… but, I think it might be alright.
Earlier, Shiki said he liked me.
Let's see.
If Shiki says he likes me more than Ciel, I'll help out this time."
Arcueid smiles.
Not at me, but at Ciel-senpai.
"N---------------"
Ciel-senpai's shoulders start quivering furiously.

entries.japanese:
――――と。
　ちょっと、待った。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Then.
Wait a moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----And,
Hold on a second.

entries.japanese:
「だ――――だだ、だめですそんなのっっ……！
　貴方の力なんか借りなくても、遠野くんはわたしがなんとか助けますっ！
　今夜は見逃してあげますから、さっさと帰ってください……！」
「ふーん。
帰ってもいいけど、それだと志貴は消えちゃうわよ。
あなたって志貴がロアに乗っ取られても志貴の体があればそれでいいんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“N-no, absolutely not!
We don’t need your power; I’ll find some way to save Tohno myself! I’ll spare you tonight, so go home at once!”
“Hmm. I can go home, but then Shiki will disappear. I see—you don’t care if Roa takes him over, as long as you get to keep Shiki’s body.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N-----No, not, not a chance……!
Even without your help, I'll somehow save Tohno-kun!
I'll let you go for tonight, so just go back……!"
"Hmm.
I suppose I can go back, but then Shiki will disappear.
So you're saying it's okay if Roa takes over Shiki as long as Shiki's body remains?"

entries.maoEnglish: ――――――Something was happening to my body.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------My, body is.

entries.japanese:
「ば、馬鹿な事は言わないでください。
わたしだって、貴方以上にロアに消えてもらいたいんです。
もうこれ以上、大切な人をロアに奪われるなんて、耐えられない」
「そう。
なら話は簡単でしょ。
志貴はわたしのほうがいいって約束して、ロアは完全に消滅する。
それでお互い目的は果てしてると思うけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“D-don’t be absurd. I want Roa gone even more than you do. I cannot bear to lose anyone else precious to me because of him.”
“I see. Then it’s simple, isn’t it? Shiki promises to choose me, and Roa disappears completely. We both get what we want.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"D, Don't be stupid!
I want Roa to be destroyed more than you do.
I can't bear Roa taking away the person I hold the most dear anymore!"
"Then, it's simple.
Shiki just has to promise he likes me more, and Roa will be destroyed completely.
I think that's fulfilling both our goals."

entries.japanese: ―――――体の感覚が、薄れて、きた。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――The feeling in my body was fading.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----My body's feelings, are starting, to fade away…

entries.japanese:
「だから、それはこれとは別問題です！
　だいたいですね、貴方の言うことなんか信用できるワケないじゃないですかっ。
遠野くんに自殺しろ、だなんて、そんな綱渡りみたいな真似はさせられない。
　それなら、このまま―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is a completely separate issue!
In any case, why should I trust anything you say? Telling Tohno to kill himself—there is no way I’ll make him risk his life on such a desperate gamble.”
“I would rather we simply—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Those are two completely different matters!
In the first place, there's no reason for us to trust you.
I won't let Tohno-kun walk such a tightrope like killing himself.
Then-----"

entries.japanese:
「わたしを殺したほうがいい、って顔ね。
けどあなたはともかく、今の志貴じゃわたしは殺しきれない。
ただでさえロアに侵食されているんだから、これ以上無理をすれば志貴の精神の方が先に崩壊するのは目に見えている」
entries.maoEnglish: “Your face says you’d rather kill me. You might manage it, but Shiki as he is now cannot. Roa is already consuming him, so if he pushes himself any further, his mind will collapse long before he can finish me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You look like you'd rather kill me.
Anyway, with Shiki the way he is now, you can't.
Roa's invaded his mind enough already, so it's easy to see that if you stress him any further, his mind will collapse."

entries.japanese:
「それは――――――――――――」
「志貴がわたしたちを止めようと無理をしなければあと数日は保ったでしょうけど、今の志貴じゃロアを抑えこむ事はできない。
　見なさい、志貴ったら必死に頭痛に堪えてるでしょ。
　この分だと今夜が勝負所に―――って、あれ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that—”
“If Shiki hadn’t strained himself trying to stop us, he might have lasted a few more days, but as he is now, he can’t suppress Roa.
Look at him—he’s desperately enduring the headache.
At this rate, tonight will decide everything—wait, what?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's------------"
"If Shiki didn't strain himself to stop us, he might have lasted for a few more days, but the way he is now, he can't resist Roa for long.
Take a look, he's desperately resisting a headache right now.
Like that, tonight would be-----, huh?"

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと志貴、まさか本当にもうダメなの！？」
「え―――――と、遠野くん！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, don’t tell me you’re already at your limit!”
“T-Tohno?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki.
Don't tell me you're already at your limit!?"
"Eh------To, Tohno-kun!?"

entries.japanese:
#0000ff
　　　　意識。
意識は、まだある。
　　　　　体。
体は、まだ動く。
　　　なのに、生きている気がしない。
　　　　　現実感が損なわれていく。
　　　ボロボロと遠野志貴が崩れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
#0000ff

Consciousness. I was still conscious.
Body. My body still moved.
Yet I no longer felt alive.
Reality was slipping away.
Shiki Tohno was crumbling, piece by piece.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#0000ff
Awareness.
I still have my awareness.
My body.
My body can still move.
So why… don't I feel like I'm alive?
I'm losing my grip on reality.

Tohno Shiki is fading away.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff

「―――――遠野くん、しっかりしてください、遠野くん……！」
　シエルの声。
彼女の手はしっかりと俺の体を抱いているのに、その感触が伝わってこない。
「志貴、聞こえているなら早くしなさい。
考えている時間もためらっている余裕もないわよ」
　アルクェイドの声。
彼女の手はしっかりと俺の手の平を握っている。
　そこにあるのは、凶器であるナイフだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, stay with me—please…!”
Ciel’s voice. Her arms held my body tightly, yet I could no longer feel them.
“Shiki, if you can hear me, do it now. There’s no time left to think or hesitate.”
Arcueid’s voice. Her hand was wrapped firmly around mine.
The knife—the instrument of death—lay between our palms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff

"-----Tohno-kun, hang in there, Tohno-kun……!"
Ciel's voice.
Even though she's holding me, I can't feel her at all.
"Shiki, if you can hear me, hurry.
There's no time to hesitate or think things over."
Arcueid's voice.
Her hand grabs my palm.
What's there, is my knife.

entries.japanese:
「さっき言ってたでしょう。
最期の時になったら自分の手でロアを殺すって。
覚悟は出来ていたんだから、早く殺さないとダメよ。
　ロアを殺せるのは志貴だけなんだから、志貴が残っているうちに自殺してもらわないと意味がないわ」
「…………！
　ダメです、遠野くん！
　そんなコトをしたって、遠野くんが死んじゃうだけじゃないですか……！
　もっと気持ちを強くもって、頭痛さえ収まればまたいつもの遠野くんに戻れます……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You said it yourself. When the end came, you would kill Roa with your own hands. You were already prepared, so do it before it’s too late.
Because you’re the only one who can kill Roa, it will mean nothing unless you kill yourself while Shiki still remains.”
“No, Tohno! Don’t do it! Even if you do, you’ll only die! Hold on to who you are; once the headache passes, you’ll be yourself again!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You said it before.
That at the very end, you'll kill Roa with your own hands.
If you're ready, you have to kill him now.
You're the only one who can kill him, so it's meaningless unless you kill yourself while you're still there."
"…………!
You can't, Tohno-kun.
If you do that, you will just die……!
If you just focus, if you can resist that headache, you can come back, Tohno-kun……!"

entries.japanese:
#0000ff
―――――――そう、だった。
　もとから覚悟は出来ていたんだ。
　どく、ん、という躍動。
　もう、すぐそこにロアの口が迫ってきている。
　その前に―――自分の体を直視した。
　胸の古傷に、その『点』は存在する。
　……そういえば、シキが言っていたっけ。
　イシを殺すものは、やはりイシなんだと。
entries.maoEnglish:
#0000ff

―――――――That was right.
I had been prepared from the beginning.
Thump.
Roa’s jaws were already closing in.
Before they reached me, I looked straight into my own body.
The point was there on the old scar on my chest.
Come to think of it, SHIKI had said it.
In the end, only one will can kill another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#0000ff
-------That's, right.
I was already prepared.
Thump.
Roa's mouth is already right there.
Before that---I stare at my body.
That "point" exists right on my scar.
…… Come to think of it, SHIKI said something like that.
What kills a will is another will.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff

「やめ―――やめてください……！
　アルクェイドが言っている事が本当とは限らないのに、どうして―――――！」
entries.maoEnglish: “Stop—please, stop! You don’t even know whether Arcueid is telling the truth, so why?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff

"Stop---please stop……!
You can't be sure what Arcueid is saying is true, so why----!?"

entries.japanese:
#0000ff
―――うん、シエルの危惧もわかる。
　けど、アルクェイドの言っていたコトは本当のコトだ。
　だってアイツは、一度だって俺に嘘はつかなかったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
#0000ff



―――I understood Ciel’s fear.
But Arcueid had told me the truth.
She had never lied to me—not once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#0000ff
----Yeah, I understand why Ciel's worried.
But, what Arcueid says is the truth.
Because she never lied to me even once.

entries.japanese:
胸にナイフをあてる。
　一つの命の中に二つのイシがあるというのなら。
　一度の死で死滅するのは、単純計算で一つ分だけのはずだ。
　……まあ、単純すぎるとは思うけど、信じよう。
　たとえアルクェイドの言うとおりにはならないとしても、どのみちこのままではロアに食われてしまう。
　それなら―――ここで、俺がオマエに引導を渡してやる。
　転生ごっこはおしまいだ。
　俺が視ているものは俺自身の死と、ロアという魂の死に他ならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I set the knife against my chest.
If one life contained two wills.
Then by simple arithmetic one death ought to extinguish only one of them.
It might be far too simple, but I chose to believe.
Even if things did not go as Arcueid said, Roa would consume me if this continued.
In that case—this is where I lay you to rest.
Your game of reincarnation is over.
What I was seeing was nothing other than my own death and the death of the soul called Roa.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I place the knife on my chest.
If there are two wills in one life,
then with one death, with a simple calculation, only one will die.
…… Well, I think that's too simple, but I'll believe it.
Even if it doesn't turn out like Arcueid says, no matter what, Roa will consume me eventually.
Then---I'll kill you right here.
Your reincarnation is at an end.
What I see is my death, and the death of Roa's soul.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――――」
　息を飲む気配がしたあと。
　ぎゅっ、と。
　爪をたてるぐらいの激しさで、誰かの手の平が俺の手を握ってきた。
「―――――――――――」
　なにか小さな呟きが聞こえた。
　体の中から熱い血が巡ってきて、そっと背中を抱かれているような感覚があった。
　……………なんだ。
　こんなの、なんていう事はない。
　俺はきっと、もう絶対に、何があったって生き残れる。
　そう確信して、ナイフを握る指に力をこめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
After someone caught their breath.
A sudden squeeze.
Someone’s hand seized mine so fiercely its nails dug into my skin.
“—”
I heard a tiny murmur.
Hot blood coursed through me from within, and I felt as though someone had gently wrapped their arms around my back.
What was I afraid of?
This was nothing.
I knew with absolute certainty that whatever happened, I would survive.
I tightened my fingers around the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------------"
After I sense someone gasping,
Squeeze.
Someone grips my hand hard.
"-----------"
I can hear someone speaking softly.
Hot blood courses through my body and I feel someone embracing my back.
…… I see.
This is nothing.
I'll probably, definitely survive no matter what happens.
I believe firmly, and I strengthen my grip around my knife.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
―――ロア、意思を殺すのが意思の力だというのなら。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ffffff

―――Roa. If the power of one will is what kills another—
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
---Roa, if what kills a will is a will, then…

entries.japanese:
おまえは一人、こっちは三人分だ。
　そこに、負ける道理が有り得ない―――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
You stand alone; we have the strength of three.
There’s no possible way we can lose!
entries.mirrorMoon:
You are alone, and there are three of us.
There's no way we can lose-----!

entries.japanese:
見なれた道を歩いて、いつもの路地裏に入ったあと、おかしな所に出てしまった。
　学校から屋敷に帰るまでの近道の途中に、こんな場所があったとは知らなかった。
　開けた広場。
　周囲に壁らしきものはないのに、人気というものがまったくない。
　まるで世界にこの場所しかないような閑けさの中、誰かが、ベンチに腰をかけて本を読んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I followed the familiar road and entered my usual alley, only to emerge somewhere strange.
I had never known such a place existed along the shortcut from school to the mansion.
An open square.
There were no walls around it, yet not a soul was in sight.
In a silence that made this seem like the only place left in the world, someone sat on a bench reading.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After walking down the usual road and entering the usual alley, I come out to a strange place.
I never knew this place was on the way back from school to the mansion.
A clearing.
There's no walls around, but I don't feel anyone else around here.
It's so quiet that it feels like this is the only place in the world, and in it, someone sits on a bench reading a book.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　長い金髪に、小さな丸いメガネをかけた男。
　彫りの深い顔立ちと金髪からして、外国人だという事は疑いようがない。
　男は整った顔立ちをしているくせに、どこか柔らかい雰囲気があった。
　外見は冷酷なイメージなのに、どこか人なつっこい目をしている。
　……そのせいだろう。
　あからさまに怪しい男に、もしもしと話しかけてしまったのは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
A man with long blond hair and small round spectacles.
His deeply carved features and golden hair left no doubt that he was foreign.
Despite his handsome face, there was a gentleness about him.
His appearance seemed cold, yet his eyes were strangely approachable.
Perhaps that was why.
Why I called out to a man so obviously suspicious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
A man with long, golden hair and small, round glasses.
With deep, chiseled features and golden hair, there's no doubting that he's a foreigner.
Despite his very set features, there is an atmosphere of softness to him.
Even though he looks cold-hearted, his eyes seem gentle.
…… It's probably because of that.
So, I talked to this strange person.

entries.japanese:
なんでしょう、と男は顔を上げた。
　何をしているんですか、と尋ねた。
　ごらんの通り読書をしているだけです、と男は笑った。
　面白いですか、と尋ねた。
　男はひどく優しい笑みをうかべて、面白いコトなどありません、と断言した。
　男は立ち上がる。
　ベンチには、男が読んでいた古い本が残された。
entries.maoEnglish:
The man looked up and asked what I wanted.
I asked what he was doing.
Reading, as you can see, he answered with a smile.
I asked whether it was interesting.
His smile became very gentle, and he declared that nothing about it was interesting.
The man rose.
The ancient book he had been reading remained on the bench.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After looking up, he asks me what I want.
I inquire what he was doing.
With a smile, he says that just like it appears, he is reading a book.
I then ask if it is interesting.
With a terribly kind smile, he declares that nothing is interesting at all.
He stands up.
He leaves the old book that he was reading on the bench.

entries.japanese:
もしもし、と声をかけた。
　本を忘れていますけど、と言うと、
　読み終わってしまいましたから、と男は肩をすくめた。
　パラパラと本のページがめくれている。
　風は、吹いていない筈だ。
　いつしかページは千切れて、一枚一枚、虚無に消えていくように遠くなっていく。
　その紙吹雪に隠れるように、男の姿は段々と薄れていく。
　何処に行くのか、と尋ねると、もとから自分は何処にもいない、と男は答えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I called after him.
When I told him he had forgotten his book,
the man shrugged and said he had finished it.
The pages began to flutter.
There should have been no wind.
Soon they tore loose and sailed away one by one, receding as though they were vanishing into nothingness.
Veiled by that storm of paper, the man gradually faded.
When I asked where he was going, he replied that he had never been anywhere to begin with.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I call out to him.
I tell him he forgot his book.
Over his shoulder, he says that he is done reading it.
The pages of the book are flipping.
Even though there is no wind.
The pages unbind, and page by page, they fly far away as if they were disappearing into nothingness.
As if hiding in the paper storm, the man's figure starts to fade away.
I ask where he's going, but he just responds that he never was anywhere to begin with.

entries.japanese:
ソレは書を読むだけの観測者にすぎない。
　書がなくなれば、観測者もまた存在しない。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was merely an observer who read the book.
Once the book was gone, there could be no observer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There is only an observer which reads the book.
If the book ceases to exist, the observer also ceases to exist.

entries.japanese:
やがて全てのページが飛び去って、本は存在しなくなった。
　男の姿も、当然のようにない。
　そうなれば、本来自分のものではないこの場所の記憶も無くなるのは道理か。
　永い間転生の記憶を連ねた書は消え。
　ロアと呼ばれた吸血鬼は拍子抜けするほど潔く、八百年ごしの死を迎えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
At last every page had flown away, and the book ceased to exist.
Naturally, the man was gone as well.
It followed that the memory of this place, never mine to begin with, would disappear too.
The book that had recorded so many years of reincarnation was gone.
And the vampire called Roa accepted his eight-hundred-year-delayed death with an almost anticlimactic grace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At last, all the pages fly away and the book becomes nothing.
The man's figure is obviously nowhere to be seen.
If that's the case, it's no surprise the memories which do not belong to me of this place also disappear.
The book carrying the memories of long reincarnation disappears.
And the vampire called Roa gracefully dies after eight hundred years.

entries.japanese: ―――さて、それからどうなったかと言うと。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――And as for what happened after that.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Well, what happened from there?

entries.japanese:
何か、小さな音で眠りから覚まされた。
　かちゃり、ぎ、ぎぎ。
　ドロボウのようにこっそりと窓を開ける音。
　そのあとに、かつかつかつ、なんて堂々として足音がやってくる。
「志貴ー。
朝だぞ、起きろー」
　何者かがゆさゆさと体をゆすってくる。
「………………」
　はあ、と頭痛を堪えながら、ゆっくりと目を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A faint noise woke me.
Click, creak, creeeeak.
The sound of a window being opened with all the stealth of a burglar.
Then came a bold, unapologetic clack-clack-clack of footsteps.
“Shiki, it’s morning. Wake up!”
Someone shook me vigorously.
“…”
With a sigh, enduring the headache, I slowly opened my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A small noise wakes me up.
Creak.
Creak.
Creak.
A sound like a burglar quietly opening a window.
After that, footsteps come toward me.
"Shiki-.
It's morning, get up-"
Someone shakes me.
"……………"
Resisting my headache, I slowly open my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「おはよー！
　今日もいい天気だよ、志貴！」
「……………………アルクェイド、おまえな」
　ねぼけた頭を指で押さえながら、目の前にいる不法侵入者を流し見る。
　アルクェイドはここにいるのが当然のように堂々としていて、一瞬だけでも違和感を感じなくなっていた自分に呆れてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning! Another beautiful day, Shiki!”
“Arcueid, you…”
Holding my sleep-fogged head, I glared sidelong at the intruder.
Arcueid stood there as grandly as though she belonged in my room, and I was appalled that, for even one instant, her presence had seemed perfectly natural.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Morning-!
It's great weather today, Shiki!"
"…………………… Arcueid, you…"
Holding my still-sleepy head, I look at the trespasser in front of me.
Arcueid acts as if it was completely normal for her to be here, and I'm surprised at myself for feeling the same way for a brief moment.

entries.japanese:
「ん？
　なに、言いたいコトははっきり言ったほうがいいよ。
そうでなくても最近の志貴はいつも苦い顔してるんだから」
「……あのな、誰のせいだと思ってるんだよ。
おまえが朝っぱらから頭が痛くなるようなコトをするから、背負わなくてもいい気苦労を背負ってるんじゃないか。
　だいたいな、こんなコト先輩に知られたら、おまえの前に俺が殺されかねないぞ、ホント」
　というか、今この瞬間に翡翠が部屋にやってきたら、先輩の前に秋葉に殺されかねない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm? What is it you want to say? You’ve been looking sour all the time lately.”
“And whose fault is that? You start doing things that give me headaches first thing in the morning, and I end up worrying about problems I never needed.
If Ciel finds out about this, I might be dead before she ever gets to you.”
For that matter, if Hisui came in right now, Akiha might kill me before Ciel could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm?
What?
If you have something to say, you should just say it.
You're always looking so troubled recently."
"…… Hey, whose fault do you think that is?
It's because you do things that make my head hurt starting early in the morning and cause me to have stress when I shouldn't have any.
In the first place, if Senpai finds out, she'd kill me before she kills you.
Really."
Or if Hisui came in right now, Akiha would kill me before Senpai would.

entries.japanese:
「あはは、そうなったらいよいよシエルとは決別だね。
けど大丈夫、その時はわたしが責任もって志貴を連れて行っちゃうから」
　何が愉快なのか、楽しそうにアルクェイドは笑う。
当然、俺にとっては笑い話なんかじゃない。
「……おまえ。
それ、半分以上本気だろ」
「当たり前じゃない。
わたし、あんまり冗談って言わないよ」
「―――そりゃそうだ。
存在自体が冗談みたいなヤツだからな、おまえは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahaha, then you’ll finally have to break things off with Ciel. Don’t worry; when that happens, I’ll take full responsibility and carry you away.”
Arcueid laughed delightedly. I saw nothing remotely funny.
“…You’re more than half serious, aren’t you?”
“Of course. I hardly ever joke.”
“Naturally. Your entire existence is already a joke.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahaha.
In that case, you'd finally be breaking up with Ciel, right?
But that's okay, I'll take responsibility and take you with me."
She laughs like it's funny.
Of course, I'm not laughing at all.
"…… You, you're actually serious."
"Of course.
I don't joke that often."
"----That's true.
Your existence itself is like a joke."

entries.japanese:
「むっ。
それ、すごい差別よ。
志貴は他の人には優しいのに、どうしてわたしにだけそういうコト言うわけ？」
　ずい、とアルクェイドはこっちの目を覗きこんでくる。
「ぁ――――――――」
　……ちょっと、困る。
　アルクェイドは相変わらず遠慮なしで、こっちの男心というものをまったく考慮してくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmph. That’s terribly unfair. You’re kind to everyone else, so why do you say such things only to me?”
Arcueid thrust her face close and peered into my eyes.
“Ah—”
This was a problem.
As usual, she had no restraint whatsoever and gave no thought to what this did to a boy’s heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey!
That's being discriminatory.
You're so nice to everyone else, so why do you only say such things to me?"
She looks me right in the eye.
"Ah--------"
…… I'm a bit troubled.
As usual, Arcueid is without hesitation, and doesn't take a man's heart into consideration.

entries.japanese:
「と、当然だろ。
何度言っても人の部屋に忍び込んでくるようなヤツにはね、気を遣ってなんかやらないの。
ほら、いいから退いてろ。
これから着替えるんだから」
　目と鼻の先にあるアルクェイドの顔から視線をそらして、逃げるようにベッドの反対側に足をつける。
――――と。
　こんこん、と控えめなノックが響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“O-of course I do. Anyone who keeps sneaking into my room after I’ve told her not to gets no special consideration. Now move. I have to change.”
I tore my gaze from Arcueid’s face, scarcely an inch from mine, and fled to plant my feet on the far side of the bed.
――――Then.
A discreet knock sounded at the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"O-of course.
You can't be kind to someone who sneaks in no matter how many times you tell them not to.
C'mon, get out.
I'm going to change."
Looking away from Arcueid who's directly in front of me, I stand up on the other side of the bed as if running away from her.
----And then,
Knock-knock.
The sound echoes through the room.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お目覚めでございますか？」
　翡翠の声。
　時計は――――七時十分前だった。
「やばっ…………！
　アルクェイド、早く、早く窓から出て行ってくれ………！」
　あたふたと窓まで走って、アルクェイドを手招く。
　が。
　アルクェイドはいかにも何か言いたそうな態度で、じっと部屋の真ん中に立ち尽くしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
Hisui’s voice.
The clock read ten minutes to seven.
“Oh, hell! Arcueid, hurry—get out through the window!”
I scrambled to the window and beckoned frantically.
But.
Arcueid remained planted in the middle of the room, looking as though she desperately wanted to say something.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, have you awakened?"
Hisui's voice.
The clock-----says it's ten minutes before seven.
"Crap………!
Arcueid, hurry, get out the window………!"
I hurry to the window and motion her to come to the window.
But,
Arcueid just looks at me like she wants to say something and stays in the center of my room.

entries.japanese:
「ア、アルクェイド……！
　頼むから出ていってくれって……！」
「………………………」
　アルクェイドは聞く耳もたない。
「志貴さま？
　お目覚めでいらっしゃるんですね？」
「うわあ、待ったあ！
　今着替えてるから、ちょっと待って……！」
「着替え、ですか？
　学生服でしたら今お持ちしたところですが」
「あ、いや、そうじゃなくて―――ともかく待った！
　すぐに済ませるから、ちょっと待っててくれ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“A-Arcueid…! Please, just get out…!”
“…”
Arcueid refused to listen.
“Master Shiki? You are awake, aren’t you?”
“Wait! I’m changing, so give me a minute…!”
“Changing? I have your school uniform here with me.”
“No, that’s not it—just wait! I’ll be finished in a moment, so please stay there!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A, Arcueid……!
Please, just get out……!"
"……………………"
She's not listening.
"Shiki-sama?
You are awake, are you not?"
"Uwaa!
Wait!
I'm changing, so just wait……!"
"Changing?
I have your school uniform here, however."
"Uh, no, that's not it---anyway, just wait!
I'll be done soon, so please wait!"

entries.japanese:
……あ。
　すぐに済ませる、という発言がお気に召さなかったのか、アルクェイドはますます不機嫌になっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh.
Apparently, saying I would be finished in a moment only made Arcueid’s expression darken further.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Uh.
I guess she didn't like me saying it'll be done soon as Arcueid starts to look angry.

entries.japanese:
「こ……の、何が不満なんだよアルクェイド……！
　勝手にやってきて勝手に拗ねられちゃお手上げだろ。
言いたいコトがあるんなら、おまえの方こそはっきりと言えっての」
　小声でアルクェイドに怒鳴りつける。
―――と。
「……だって、最近志貴が遊んでくれないんだもん。
だから、ちょっと困らせてみようかなって」
　ぼそぼそと、アルクェイドはそんなコトを言ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you sulking about now? You can’t barge in here and then expect me to guess why you’re upset. If you have something to say, take your own advice and say it clearly.”
I hissed the words under my breath.
―――And then.
“But you haven’t played with me at all lately. So I thought maybe I’d make a little trouble for you.”
Arcueid mumbled.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You…… what are you dissatisfied about, Arcueid……!
I can't do anything if you just selfishly come here and get angry.
If you have something to say, just say it."
I yell at her, but quietly.
----And then,
"…… Because, you don't play with me recently.
So I thought I should trouble you a bit."
Arcueid says quietly.

entries.japanese:
「……あのな。
学生には期末試験っていうのがあって、終わるまでは忙しいって言ったじゃないか。
終わったらまる一日付き合ってやるから、とにかく今は外に行ってくれないか」
「ほんと？
　シエルより先にしてくれる？」
「う……で、できるだけ善処する」
「やったあ、約束だからね！
　それじゃ外で待ってるよ……！」
　たん、と軽い足取りでアルクェイドは窓から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you, students have final exams. I’ll be busy until they’re over. Once they are, I’ll spend an entire day with you, so could you please go outside for now?”
“Really? Before you spend a day with Ciel?”
“I-I’ll do my best.”
“Yes! You promised, so I’ll wait outside…!”
With a light spring, Arcueid slipped out the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey now.
I told you, students have these things called exams and are busy until they are over.
Once I'm done, I'll spend a whole day with you so can you leave for now?"
"Really?
You'll do that before Ciel?"
"Uh…… I'll try…"
"Yay!
It's a promise, okay?
Then, I'll be waiting outside……!"
With a light hop, Arcueid jumps out the window.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
　入れ替わりで翡翠が入ってくる。
「志貴さま……？
　話し声らしきものが聞こえたのですが、なにかあったのですか？」
「え――――いや、ちょっと独り言をつらつらと朗読していたんだけど………」
　題して、私の詩集。
……ちょっと寒いか。
「………………………………」
　じっ、と無言で見つめてくる。
　流石に毎日のようにアルクェイドがやってきているんだから、翡翠は何か感づいているんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Hisui entered as Arcueid departed.
“Master Shiki…? I thought I heard voices; did something happen?”
“W-well, I was just reciting a rather long monologue to myself…”
Call it My Poetry Collection. No, that was too embarrassing.
“…”
She stared at me in silence.
With Arcueid appearing almost every day, Hisui must have suspected something by now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please excuse me."
Hisui enters as if she was merely trading places.
"Shiki-sama……?
I heard some voices speaking, did anything happen?"
"Eh-----No, I was just musing.
Sorry if it was confusing……"
Poem yet to be titled… that wasn't very amusing…
"…………………………"
She stares at me wordlessly.
Arcueid is coming here practically every day, so Hisui might be catching on.

entries.japanese:
「あっと、もうこんな時間だ。
すぐに着替えて居間に行くから、翡翠は先に行っててくれ」
「…………かしこまりました。
それでは失礼します、志貴さま」
　翡翠はおじぎをして退室していった。
「……はあ」
　これじゃバレるのも時間の問題か。
　なんとかしてアルクェイドのヤツに、せめて朝だけでも部屋にやってくる事を止めてもらわないといけないな――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, look at the time. I’ll change and come right down, so go on to the sitting room without me.”
“Very well. Excuse me, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bowed and left.
“Haaah.”
At this rate, discovery was only a matter of time.
I had to persuade Arcueid to stop coming into my room—at least in the mornings—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"My, look at the time.
I'll hurry up and change and go to the sitting room, so please go ahead of me, Hisui."
"………… I understand.
Then please excuse me, Shiki-sama."
With a succinct bow, she exits the room.
…… *sigh*
I guess it's only a matter of time before she finds out.
I have to somehow tell Arcueid to not come to my room at least in the morning----

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます、兄さん」
　居間に入るなり、どこか剣のある声で秋葉が挨拶をしてくる。
「おはよう秋葉。
……って、今朝はずいぶんとゆっくりなんだな。
そろそろ出ないと間に合わないんじゃなかったっけ」
　秋葉の行っているお嬢様学園は、隣の県にある。
　最近までは気がつかなかったけど、秋葉は俺より三十分早く屋敷を出て、車で登校しないと学校に間に合わない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother.”
The moment I entered the sitting room, Akiha greeted me with a certain edge in her voice.
“Morning, Akiha. Aren’t you taking it rather easy today? Don’t you have to leave soon?”
Akiha’s private girls’ academy was in the neighboring prefecture.
I had only recently realized that she had to leave thirty minutes before me and travel by car to arrive on time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Nii-san."
As soon as I enter the sitting room, Akiha greets me with a bit of an edge to her voice.
"Morning Akiha.
…… You're really taking your time this morning.
I thought you needed to leave soon in order to be on time."
Akiha's ladies' boarding school is in the next prefecture.
I didn't realize it until recently, but Akiha won't make it to school on time unless she leaves thirty minutes before me by car.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、昨夜の私の話を忘れてしまったんですか？
　私は昨日で冬休みに入ったんです。
うちは私立ですから、兄さんの学校とは予定がズレているんですよ」
「――――――あ」
　言われてみれば、秋葉は私服だ。
　となると、忙しいのは俺だけという事か。
「お解りになられたのでしたら、どうぞ食堂のほうに行ってください。
兄さんの朝食でしたらとっくに用意できている筈です」
「オッケー。
んじゃ、ちゃっちゃっと済ませてくるか」
　もう学校は休みになっている秋葉を背にして、食堂へと足を運ぶ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, have you forgotten what I told you last night? Winter vacation began for me yesterday. My school is private, so its calendar differs from yours.”
“Oh.”
Now that she mentioned it, Akiha was wearing ordinary clothes.
Apparently I was the only one still busy.
“If you understand, please go to the dining room. Your breakfast should have been ready for some time.”
“Got it. I’ll eat quickly and get moving.”
Leaving Akiha to enjoy her vacation, I headed for the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, did you forget what I told you last night?
Winter break started yesterday for me.
Since I go to a private school, it is on a different schedule than yours."
"------Oh."
Now that she mentions it, she's in her normal clothes.
Meaning, I'm the only one who's busy.
"If you understand, then please go to the dining room.
Your breakfast should be prepared already."
"Okay.
Then I'll go right away."
I leave behind Akiha, who's already on break from school, and walk into the dining room.

entries.japanese:
朝食を終えて、居間に戻ってくる。
　と。
心なしか、秋葉が不機嫌そうに睨んできた。
「秋葉……？
　なにかあったのか？」
「いえ、とりわけ何も。
ただ兄さんが朝食を済ませている時に来客があっただけです」
「来客……？
　こんな朝早くから？」
「はい。
なんでも兄さんを迎えにきたとかいう、学校の上級生です。
玄関のほうで待たせていますから、早く行ったほうがいいんじゃないですか」
　じろり、と睨んでくる秋葉。
　……どうも秋葉が不機嫌なのは気のせいじゃないみたいだ。
　いや、そんな事より迎えにきた上級生って、やっぱり先輩の事だよな……。
entries.maoEnglish:
After breakfast, I returned to the sitting room.
And then. Akiha seemed to be glaring at me with even more displeasure.
“Akiha…? Did something happen?”
“Nothing of consequence. A visitor arrived while you were eating breakfast.”
“A visitor…? This early?”
“Yes. An upperclassman from your school who claims she came to collect you. I left her waiting in the entrance hall, so perhaps you ought to hurry.”
Akiha gave me another hard look.
Evidently I hadn’t imagined her bad mood.
More importantly, that upperclassman had to be Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After breakfast, I return to the sitting room.
Akiha stares at me coldly, as if she is in a terrible mood.
"Akiha……?
Did something happen?"
"No, not really.
Just while you were eating, a guest came for you, Nii-san."
"A guest……?
This early?"
"Yes.
It seems she came to pick you up, an upperclassman from your school.
I have her waiting at the entrance, so you should probably hurry."
She glares at me.
…… It seems like it wasn't my imagination that Akiha is in a sour mood.
No, more than that, it has to be Senpai who came here……

entries.japanese:
「――――どうしたんだろ、シエル先輩。
今日になっていきなり迎えに来るなんて」
　まあ、会ってみれば理由も解るだろう。
「じゃ行ってくる。
今日から試験だから、昼過ぎには帰ってくるよ」
「それは楽しみですね。
帰ってきたらシエル先輩という方のお話を聞かせてもらいますから」
　なんか空恐ろしい笑顔を作って、秋葉は俺を見送った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I wonder what’s gotten into Ciel. Why would she suddenly come to get me today?”
I would find out soon enough.
“I’m off. Exams start today, so I’ll be home sometime after noon.”
“How delightful. When you return, you can tell me all about this Ciel of yours.”
Akiha saw me off with a smile that chilled my blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I wonder what happened?
For Ciel-senpai to suddenly come pick me up today?"
I'm sure I'll find out when I see her.
"Well, I'm off.
I have a test today, so I'll be back past noon."
"I'll look forward to it.
When you come back, I want to hear your story about this Ciel-senpai."
Giving an empty, scary smile, Akiha watches me leave.

entries.japanese:
「あ、おはようございます遠野くん」
　玄関で待っていたのは、予想通りシエル先輩だった。
「はい、おはようございます……って、先輩。
どうして今日に限って迎えにきたんですか」
　素朴な疑問を口にしてみる。
　……というか、さっきから後ろのほうで目を光らせている翡翠に対する、ちょっとした言い訳というか、そういった意味もかねて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Tohno.”
As expected, Ciel was waiting in the entrance hall.
“Good morning. But Ciel, why did you come for me today of all days?”
I asked the simple question.
It was also a small excuse for Hisui, whose watchful gaze had been boring into my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, good morning Tohno-kun."
Just like I thought, the one waiting for me is Ciel-senpai.
"Yeah, good morning…… wait, Senpai, why did you come to pick me up today?"
I ask her a perfectly natural question.
…… Well, it also is an excuse for Hisui, who's watching things from behind.

entries.japanese:
「いえ、特に意味はないです。
しいて言えばイヤな予感がした、という所でしょうか」
「……そっか。
心配してくれるのは嬉しいけど、ちょっと困ったかもしれないな」
　その、秋葉になんて紹介したもんかな、と考え込んでしまう。
　どうしてだか知らないけど、秋葉とシエル先輩の相性は破滅的に悪いんじゃないか、という予感がするのだ。
　……いや、というか確信に近い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No particular reason. At most, I had a bad feeling.”
“I see. I appreciate your worrying about me, but this may have made things a little awkward.”
I found myself wondering how to introduce her to Akiha.
For some reason, I had the feeling the two of them would be catastrophically incompatible.
No, it was closer to certainty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I don't have much of a reason.
If I had to say, I just had a bad feeling."
"…… I see.
I'm happy that you worry about me, but it is a little troubling."
Well, I think about how I should introduce her to Akiha.
I'm not sure why, but I have this premonition that Akiha and Ciel-senpai won't get along at all.
…… No, I'm pretty sure of it.

entries.japanese:
「ま、とりあえず行こうか。
あんまり時間に余裕はないし」
　はい、と頷いてシエル先輩は俺と一緒に歩き出した。
「それでは行ってらっしゃいませ、志貴さま」
　翡翠に見送られて門を後にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, let’s go. We don’t have much time.”
Ciel nodded, and we set off together.
“Have a pleasant day, Master Shiki.”
With Hisui seeing us off, we passed through the gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, shall we go?
We don't have that much time."
Nodding yes, Ciel-senpai and I start to walk.
"We await your return, Shiki-sama."
Hisui sees me off past the gate.

entries.japanese:
「驚きました。
遠野くん、あんな可愛いメイドさんに毎朝見送られてたんですね」
「そうだけど、別に他意はないよ。
見送りなんていいよって言っても、翡翠は律儀に見送りに来るだけなんだから」
「ふーん、翡翠さんって仕事熱心なんだ。
けどメイドさんがいるなんて、遠野くんのお家ってやっぱりお金持ちだったんですねー」
「……………………」
　シエルはやけに絡んでくる。
　もしかして、俺が朝ごはんを食べてる時に翡翠と話しこんでいたんだろうか？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m surprised. Tohno, I never realized such an adorable maid saw you off every morning.”
“Yes, but it doesn’t mean anything. I’ve told her she needn’t see me out, but Hisui is so conscientious she always does.”
“Hmm, Hisui really is devoted to her work. Still, having a maid at all means your family must be rich.”
“…”
Ciel was being unusually persistent.
Had she spent the whole time I was eating breakfast talking with Hisui?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm surprised.
Tohno-kun, you have such a cute maid see you off every morning."
"Yeah, but it doesn't really mean anything.
I tell her not to, but Hisui is just very conscientious about seeing me off, that's all."
"Hmm.
Hisui-san really is dedicated.
But your family must be really rich to have maids."
"………………"
Ciel is awfully nosy.
Was she talking to Hisui while I was eating breakfast?

entries.japanese:
「先輩。
一つ聞くけど、翡翠と何か話した？」
「はい。
翡翠さんから遠野くんのお話を聞いちゃいました。
妹さんにすごく甘い所とか、朝はぼんやりしててカワイイとか、色々」
「……なんだいそれ。
別に俺は秋葉に甘くなんかないぞ」
「あ、翡翠さんの言った通りだ。
遠野くん、妹さんに甘くしてないって言い返す筈だって言ってましたよ」
「う……琥珀さんだけじゃなく翡翠までそう思ってたのか」
　……まいったな。
俺は決して秋葉を甘やかしているつもりはないんだけど、二人にはそう見えていたんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, let me ask you something. Did you talk to Hisui?”
“I did. She told me all about you—how hopelessly soft you are on your sister, how cute and sleepy you are in the mornings… all sorts of things.”
“What’s that supposed to mean? I’m not soft on Akiha.”
“Oh, Hisui called it exactly. She said you’d insist you weren’t soft on your sister.”
“So it isn’t just Kohaku—Hisui thinks so too.”
Wonderful. I had no intention of spoiling Akiha, but was that really how it looked to both of them?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai.
I'll ask, but did you talk about something with Hisui?"
"Yes, I heard a lot of things about you from Hisui-san.
About how you indulge your sister, about how cute and spaced out you are in the morning, this and that."
"…… What do you mean?
I don't really indulge Akiha."
"Oh, just like Hisui-san said.
She said you would definitely say in response that you don't indulge your sister."
"Uh…… Not just Kohaku-san, but even Hisui thinks that way?"
…… Sheesh.
I don't really mean to indulge her, but they both seem to think so.

entries.japanese:
「ま、いっか。
コレも何かの縁だし、学校が終わったらうちに来ない？
　妹も学校が休みだし、先輩のことを紹介するよ」
「――――はい。
わたしも遠野くんの妹さんに会いたいです」
　柔らかな微笑みをうかべるシエル。
　が。
その微笑は、一点して敵意に満ちてしまった。
「……シエル先輩……？」
「――――――――――」
　シエルは鋭い視線のまま、周囲の気配をうかがっている。
　そこへ―――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, well. Since this is as good an occasion as any, why not come over after school? My sister’s off too, so I can introduce you.”
“Yes. I’d like to meet your sister.”
Ciel smiled gently.
But. In an instant, that smile hardened into open hostility.
“Ciel…?”
“…”
Her eyes stayed razor-sharp as she searched the air around us.
And then—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, whatever.
I guess this is some sort of fate, so do you want to come by my house after school?
My sister is on break, so I'll introduce you to her."
"----Yes.
I would also like to meet your sister, Tohno-kun."
She smiles softly.
But, that smile quickly fills with hostility.
"…… Ciel-senpai……?"
"----------"
Still keeping her sharp glance, Ciel is looking around us.
There--------

entries.japanese:
「待ってたよ、志貴！」
　背後から、アルクェイドがタックルをかましてきた。
「あ、倒れた。
情けないなあ、朝だからって油断してるからそういう目にあうのよ」
「……………………………………」
　間違ってる。
それは、激しく間違ってる。
　油断していようが警戒していようが、背後からオートバイ並の勢いで突進されれば誰だって生きてはいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve been waiting for you, Shiki!”
Arcueid came barreling into me from behind.
“Oh, you fell over—that’s pathetic. This is what happens when you let your guard down just because it’s morning.”
“…”
Wrong. Spectacularly wrong.
Guarded or not, anyone hit from behind at the speed of a motorcycle would be lucky to remain alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I was waiting, Shiki!"
Arcueid tackles me from behind.
"Oh, you fell down.
How shameful.
If you leave yourself so open because it's the morning, this is what happens."
"…………………………"
That's mistaken.
That's terribly mistaken.
Even if you're ready for it or keeping an eye out for it, nobody can survive being hit full-force from behind by a speeding motorcycle.

entries.japanese:
「……………………」
　立ち上がって、パンパンと学生服についた砂をはたく。
――――――さて。
「なにしやがるんだおま―――――」
「なにしやがるんですか貴方は――――！！」
　びりびりびり。
　弾き飛ばされた俺以上に怒っているのか、真横でとんでもない怒鳴り声をあげるシエル先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I got up and slapped the dirt from my uniform.
――――――Right, then.
“What the hell do you think you’re—”
“What the hell do you think you’re doing?!”
The sheer volume made the air vibrate.
Beside me, Ciel was somehow even angrier than the person who had actually been sent flying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I stand up and dust myself off.
------And now.
"What are you doi-----"
"What are you doing----!!"
At the same time,
Ciel-senpai screams loudly right beside me.

entries.japanese:
「あれ。
なんだ、シエルいたんだ」
「当然です。
貴方のほうこそ、白々しいオトボケはやめてください。
さっきからこそこそと後をつけてきていたクセに、わたしに気がつかないハズないじゃないですか」
「失礼ね、わたしは本当に気がつかなかったわよ。
だってシエルがいようがいまいがわたしと志貴には全然関係ないでしょう？」
　……つまりそれは、シエル先輩の事を完全に無視していた、という事ですね。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh. Ciel, you were here?”
“Of course, and spare me that transparent little act. You’ve been skulking along behind us for some time. There’s no conceivable way you failed to notice me.”
“How rude—I truly didn’t notice you. Whether you’re here or not makes no difference at all to Shiki and me, does it?”
In other words, she had been ignoring Ciel completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
You're here too, Ciel?"
"Of course.
Don't pretend like you didn't notice.
You were sneaking behind us for a while, so there's no way you didn't notice me."
"That's rude, I really didn't notice.
Because it doesn't really matter to me and Shiki if you're here or not, right?"
…… In other words, she was just ignoring Ciel-senpai completely.

entries.japanese:
「……貴方も懲りない人ですね。
遠野くんはこれから学校なんですから、邪魔しないでください。
　だいたい、貴方がこの国に残っている理由はもうないでしょう？
　ロアは消えたんだし、ここには他に死徒はいない。
野放しになっている死徒はまだ十人以上いるんですから、とっとと他の死徒でも退治しにいったらいいじゃないですか」
「ええ、言われなくてもそのつもりよ。
けどその時は志貴も一緒に連れていくんだから、まずは志貴を釣り上げなくっちゃいけないじゃない」
「つ、釣り上げるって、遠野くんはもう危ない真似は一切しませんっ！
　貴方の勝手な都合に巻き込まないでくださいっ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really never learn, do you? Tohno is on his way to school, so stop interfering.
Besides, you have no reason to remain in this country. Roa is gone, and there are no other Dead Apostles here. More than ten are still at large elsewhere, so why don’t you go hunt one of them instead?”
“I intend to, whether you tell me or not. But Shiki is coming with me when I go, so naturally I have to reel him in first.”
“R-reel him in? Tohno is never doing anything dangerous again; stop dragging him into your selfish schemes!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You really don't learn a thing, do you?
Tohno-kun is going to school, so please don't bother us.
In the first place, there's no reason for you to stay in this country, right?
Roa is gone and there's no more Dead Apostles here.
There's over ten Dead Apostles running around on the loose, so you should go ahead and go after them."
"Yes, I plan on doing that without you telling me.
But I have to take Shiki with me then, so I have to reel him in first."
"R, reel him in!?
Tohno-kun won't do any more dangerous things!
Please stop involving Tohno-kun in your selfish circumstances!"

entries.japanese:
「行きましょう遠野くん。
こんな吸血鬼の相手をしていたら、こっちまでおかしくなっちゃいます」
　ぐっ、と手を握るやいなや、シエルはずかずかと坂道を下っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, Tohno. If we keep listening to this vampire, we’ll lose our minds too.”
Ciel seized my hand and marched down the hill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's go Tohno-kun.
You'll turn weird like her if you hang around this vampire too long."
Grabbing my hand, she starts to walk down the hill.

entries.japanese:
「ふうん。
わたしのことをなんて言おうと気にしないけど、志貴の問題はあなたが決定する事じゃないでしょう。
　あなたはどう思おうが、志貴本人はわたしを嫌ってないもの。
志貴がわたしに協力してくれるって言えば、あなたの方こそ邪魔者になるんだから」
「―――――――――――」
　ぴたり、とシエルの足が止まる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm. Say whatever you like about me, but Shiki’s decisions aren’t yours to make.
Whatever you think, Shiki himself doesn’t hate me. If he says he’ll help, then you’re the one who’ll be in the way.”
“…”
Ciel stopped dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
I don't care what you say about me, but Shiki's problem isn't anything you can decide.
It doesn't matter what you think, but he doesn't hate me.
If he says he'll help me, then you'll be the one getting in the way."
"-----------"
Ciel freezes in her tracks.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん。
もしかして、彼女に協力するつもりなんですか」
　……う。
そう、感情のない目で見つめられると困る。
「いや、そんな口約束はして、ないけど」
「それじゃ断ってください。
っていうか、もう金輪際自分に関わらないようにってアルクェイドに絶縁状を叩きつけるべきです」
「……あのね、先輩。
本当にそんなコトしちゃっていいと思ってるんですか」
　ぼそりとシエルに耳打ちする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno… you aren’t actually planning to help her, are you?”
Ugh. That blank, emotionless stare was hard to face.
“I haven’t made any promises, exactly.”
“Then refuse her. Better yet, tell Arcueid never to come near you again and sever all ties with her.”
“Ciel… do you honestly think that would be a good idea?”
I whispered into her ear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun.
Don't tell me, you plan on helping her?"
…… Uh-oh.
Being stared at by those emotionless eyes is troubling.
"No… I never… made that promise."
"Then please refuse her.
Actually, you should tell her not to associate with you anymore."
"…… Um, Senpai?
Do you really think I should do that?"
I whisper in Ciel's ear.

entries.japanese:
「いいって、いいに決まっています。
遠野くんがはっきりすれば、彼女だって潔く――――」
「……潔く、帰ってくれると思う？
　それに忘れてるようだけど、俺が助かったのもアルクェイドのおかげじゃないか。
……だから、なんていうか、その……あんまりアルクェイドを無碍にできないっていうか」
「それは――――そうです、けど」
　シエルは嫌そうに視線を逸らす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course. If you make yourself perfectly clear, even she’ll have the decency to—”
“Do you really think she’ll leave quietly? Besides, you seem to have forgotten that Arcueid helped save my life, didn’t she? So—well—I can’t exactly treat her as though she means nothing to me.”
“That’s true, but—”
Ciel looked away in naked displeasure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Of course you should.
If you tell her directly, even she would----"
"Do you think she'd go back?
You may have forgotten, but I was saved because of Arcueid.
…… So, I don't know how to say it, but…… I can't really be hard on Arcueid."
"That----That may be true, but…"
Ciel looks away, disappointed.

entries.japanese:
「で、でもやっぱりイヤです！
　遠野くんは、その……わ、わたしと恋人同士なんですから、他の女の人なんかに誑かされないでくださいっ……！」
　耳まで真っ赤にして、シエル先輩は言いきった。
「――――――――――」
　そうはっきりと言われると、こっちも嬉しいやら恥ずかしいやらで赤面してしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“B-but I still hate it! You and I are lovers, Tohno, so please don’t let some other woman lead you astray…!”
Red to the tips of her ears, Ciel forced the words out.
“…”
Hearing her state it so plainly left me blushing too, caught somewhere between happiness and embarrassment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"B, but I still don't want that!
Tohno-kun, we…… w-we're lovers, so please don't let other women seduce you……!"
Turning red to the tips of her ears, Ciel-senpai states it directly.
"----------"
Since she is so direct, I'm embarrassed but happy, and turn red as well.

entries.japanese:
だっていうのに、
「ふーん。
独占欲強いんだ、シエルって」
　なんて、あっけらかんとしたヤツが一人。
entries.maoEnglish:
And yet—
“Hmm. You’re awfully possessive, Ciel.”
One person, at least, remained utterly unruffled.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Despite that,
"Oh?
You're pretty controlling, Ciel."
There's still one that's open.

entries.japanese:
「い、いけませんか。
わたしの気持ちで遠野くんを束縛しちゃいけないなんて、そんな決まりはないでしょう」
「そうなんだ。
わたしは別に、志貴が誰を好きでもかまわないけどなあ。
　志貴がわたしを好いていてくれるなら、あとはわたしの問題だもの。
志貴が他の誰を好きでもかまわないよ」
「な―――――――――」
　アルクェイドの一言に、ぐらぐらとシエルは頭を揺らしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I-is that wrong? There’s no law saying I can’t hold on to Tohno because I love him.”
“Really? I don’t mind who Shiki loves.
As long as he loves me, the rest is my problem. He can love anyone else he likes.”
“Wh—”
Ciel reeled, her head swaying from that single remark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"C-can't I?
It's not like there's a rule against me chaining down Tohno-kun with my feelings."
"Is that so?
I don't really care if Shiki likes someone else.
If Shiki likes me, then the rest is my problem.
I don't mind if he likes someone else too."
"Wha--------"
Ciel shakes her head in response to Arcueid's words.

entries.japanese:
「ま、もっともわたしもシエルのコトは言えないかな。
わたしを好きでいてくれればいい、なんてコトは、結局いつかは自分のモノにするっていう大前提があればこそだもの。
　その点で言うと志貴は脈ありなわけなんだし、わたしもシエルと同じかもしれないなあ。
　あはは、そのうち愛だけじゃ全然足りなくなっちゃうね」
「ぶっ………………！」
　言われて、思わず咳き込んだ。
　ア、アルクェイドのヤツ、笑顔でとんでもなコトを―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Though I suppose I can’t criticize you. I can say it’s enough for him to love me only because I take it for granted that, sooner or later, he’ll belong to me.
And Shiki clearly isn’t immune to me, so perhaps you and I are alike after all.
Ahaha—one day love alone won’t be nearly enough.”
“Pff—!”
I choked.
A-Arcueid was saying something outrageous with the brightest smile imaginable—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I won't speak for you.
To say that I don't mind him just liking me comes with the condition he'll be mine in the end.
In that regards, Shiki likes me, so maybe I'm the same as you, Ciel.
Ahaha, I guess just loving him won't be enough soon."
"Gah…………!"
I cough out loud hearing that.
A, Arcueid, saying that with a smile---

entries.japanese:
「そ、そんなのぜっっったいダメです！
　そもそもですね、わたしと遠野くんは、もう、その……愛し合ったんですから、貴方の立ち入る余地なんてありません……！」
「愛し合ったって、肉体関係のこと？
　……ふーん。
そうなんだあ、志貴はそういうの好きなんだ」
　ちらり、と意味ありげな笑みを浮かべて俺に視線を移してくるアルクェイド。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Th-that is absolutely out of the question! Tohno and I have already—loved each other, so there is no room for you between us!”
“By ‘made love,’ do you mean you’ve slept together? Hmm. So that’s the sort of thing Shiki likes.”
Arcueid turned a sidelong glance on me, her smile heavy with implication.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y-you can't do that!
In the first place, Tohno-kun and I, we, um…… made love already, so there's no room for you……!"
"Made love?
You mean connection between your bodies?
…… Oh, I see.
Shiki likes those kinds of things?"
With a smile full of meaning, Arcueid looks over at me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　ぞくり、と背筋に悪寒が走る。
　なにかイヤな予感がするな、と思った瞬間、アルクェイドは素早く俺の腕をつかんで、そのまま――――
　有無を言わさず、唇を重ねてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
A chill ran down my spine.
The instant I sensed trouble, Arcueid darted forward, caught my arm, and—
—pressed her lips to mine, giving me no chance to object.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I feel a chill run through me.
The instant I have a bad feeling about this, Arcueid grabs my arm, and----
Without saying anything further, presses her lips to mine.

entries.japanese:
「んっ、んん、ん―――――――！」
　バタバタと抵抗する。
　シエルは呆然と、この光景を見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm—mmph—mmm!”
I thrashed against her.
Ciel could only stare, stunned senseless by the spectacle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N, nn, nn--------!"
I try and resist.
Ciel watches it all in shock.

entries.japanese:
「んっ、ん――――ん、―――――――」
　どくん、という鼓動。
　……あの時、血を飲ませようとした時の口付けとは、全然違う。
　これは本当に、求愛行為のための口付けだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmmnn—”
My heart slammed once.
This was nothing like the kiss she had used when trying to make me drink her blood.
This was a kiss meant solely for courtship.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn, n-----n,-----"
Thump.
My pulse.
…… This is completely different from that time when she tried to get me to drink her blood.
This really is a kiss to express love.

entries.japanese:
「……ん……っ…………」
　強引なアルクェイドの舌に、気がつけば自分から応えていた。
　どくん、どくん。
　重なりあう呼吸と鼓動が、なんだかもう何もかもどうでもよくさせてしまう。
　……信じ、られない。
　シエルが目の前にいるっていうのに、俺は、何をして、るんだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn—mm…”
Before I knew it, I was responding to Arcueid’s insistent tongue.
Thud-thud.
Our mingled breath and heartbeats made everything else stop mattering.
I couldn’t believe it.
Ciel was standing right there, and still—what was I doing—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Mm…… mm………"
Before I realize it, I answer her insisting tongue with my own.
Thump, Thump.
Our matching breathing and pulses make me not care about anything.
…… I can't, believe it.
Ciel is in front of me, but, what, am I, doing----

entries.japanese:
アルクェイドが離れる。
「ん―――――ぷはぁ…………！」
　止まっていた呼吸を再開して、激しく咽せながら、俺は―――最低なコトに、すごく、ドキドキしていたり、した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arcueid drew away.
“Nn—hah…!”
Air rushed back into my lungs, and I coughed violently; unforgivably, my heart was still racing with excitement.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid steps back.
"N-----haa…………!"
I suck in my stopped breath, and I was excited by such an awful thing.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、カンタンじゃない。
シエルもね、そんな誰にでもできる事で保険をかけようだなんて甘いわよ。
一度ぐらいの求愛行為でわたしと勝負しようなんて、どうかしてるんじゃない？」
　くすり、いやニヤリと楽しげに笑うアルクェイドと、わなわなと体を震わせているシエル先輩。
　……その、鈍感な俺にだって解る。
　次の瞬間にでもシエル先輩が誰彼かまわずに暴れ出すな、というコトが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“See how easy that was? And Ciel, it was naïve to think doing something anyone could do would stake your claim. Trying to compete with me over a single act of courtship is absurd, don’t you think?”
Arcueid gave a delighted chuckle—no, a wicked grin—while Ciel trembled from head to foot.
Even someone as oblivious as I was could tell.
In another second, Ciel would start attacking everyone within reach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, it's easy.
Ciel, you're pretty stupid to feel like you're insured by doing something anyone can do.
What are you thinking, trying to go against me with just one act of love?"
With a big grin, Arcueid laughs as Ciel-senpai starts to shake.
…… Even I can understand.
Ciel-senpai is about to explode no matter who's nearby.

entries.japanese:
「ほら志貴、ぐずぐずしてると危ないよ」
　ぐい、とアルクェイドに腕を掴まれた。
　アルクェイドはそのまま、俺を引きずるように坂道を駆け下りていく。
「ま――――待ちなさい、このアーパー吸血鬼っっっっっっ！」
　どどどどどど、と振り返るのが怖くなるような足音をたてて、シエル先輩が追いかけてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, Shiki; if you stand around, it’ll get dangerous.”
Arcueid caught my arm.
She sprinted down the hill, all but dragging me behind her.
“W-wait, you brainless vampire!”
Ciel came thundering after us with footsteps so terrifying I was afraid to look back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki, standing there's a little dangerous."
Arcueid grabs my arm.
Like that, she dashes down the hill, pulling me with her.
"Wa------wait, you airheaded vampire--------!"
With a frightening sound that makes me scared to turn back, Ciel-senpai runs after us.

entries.japanese:
