"Yes.
Please rest until I call you."
I turn my back to the bowing Hisui and walk toward my room.

entries.japanese:
―――夕食が終わって、ベッドに腰をかける。
　時計の針は夜の九時にさしかかろうとしている。
　この屋敷は八時をすぎてからの外出は禁じられているから、もう外に出る事はできない。
「……………」
　だが、そんなものはただのきまりごとだ。
　その気になればいくらでも外には出れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――After dinner, I sat on the edge of my bed.
The clock was approaching nine.
No one in this house was allowed out after eight, so I couldn’t leave now.
“…”
But that was only a rule.
If I truly wanted to, nothing could keep me inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---After supper, I sit down on my bed.
The clock's hands show nine o'clock.
Since leaving the mansion after eight is forbidden, I cannot go outside any longer.
"…………"
But, that's merely a rule.
If I feel like it, I can easily go outside.

entries.japanese:
―――ばいばい。
また明日学校でね、遠野くん。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Bye. See you at school tomorrow, Tohno.
I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Bye-bye.
See you at school tomorrow, Tohno-kun.

I---

entries.japanese:
――――俺は……どうしても、放っておけない。
　弓塚を捜すっていう事が危ないことだっていうのは解っている。
　理由はどうあれ、あいつはあれだけの人間を殺したヤツだ。
　けど、どうしても放っておけない。
　夕暮れの帰り道。
　弓塚の最後の言葉が、どうしても忘れられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I can’t… I just can’t leave her alone.
I knew searching for Yumizuka was dangerous.
Whatever her reasons, she had killed all those people.
Even so, I couldn’t abandon her.
The road home at sunset.
I couldn’t forget Yumizuka’s final words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I… just can't let her be.
I know that looking for Yumizuka is dangerous.
No matter what her reason is, she did kill that many people.
But I can't let it go.
That way home in the sunset.
I cannot forget the last words she said.

entries.japanese:
「……行こう。
考えてても始まらない」
　着替えて、ナイフをポケットにいれた。
　秋葉たちに見付からないように、足音をたてずに部屋を後にした。
　……ロビーの明かりは消えていた。
　暗くて寂しいかぎりだけど、こっそりと出ていくには丁度いい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m going. Sitting here won’t change anything.”
I changed clothes and slipped the knife into my pocket.
Then I left my room without a sound, careful not to let Akiha or the others see me.
Creak, creak.
I crept down the stairs, which of course chose a night like this to groan, and made my way quietly to the front door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'll go.
Obsessing over it won't do any good."
I change clothes, and slip my knife into my pocket.
I tiptoe out the mansion, so as not to wake Akiha or the others.
…… The lights in the lobby are out.
It's a dark, lonely place; perfect for a secret departure.

entries.japanese:
ぎし、ぎし。
　こういう時にかぎってきしむ階段をおりて、静かに玄関へと向かっていく。
―――と。
「兄さん？
　こんな夜更けにお出かけですか？」
　いつからロビーにいたのか、秋葉は静かな面持ちで声をかけてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Creak. Creak.
Naturally, the stairs chose tonight to complain beneath my feet. I descended and stole quietly toward the front door.
―――And then.
“Brother? Are you going out at this hour?”
I had no idea how long Akiha had been in the lobby when she addressed me with perfect composure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Creak, creak.
I go down the stairs which creak only when they shouldn't, and walk quietly to the door.
--And…
"Nii-san?
You're going out, at this hour?"
Already in the lobby, Akiha speaks quietly.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――帰ってたのか」
「ええ、ついさきほど。
　それより兄さんこそどうしたんですか。
着替えているところを見ると、どこかに出かけるようですけど」
　じっ、と秋葉は俺を見つめてくる。
　俺を責めている、というわけじゃない。
　ただ不安そうな目で俺の姿を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—you’re back?”
“Yes, only a few minutes ago.
But what about you, Brother? Judging by your clothes, you seem to be going somewhere.”
Akiha watched me steadily.
There was no accusation in her gaze.
Only anxiety.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha--so, you got back, huh?"
"Yes, just a little while ago.
But anyway--what are you doing, Nii-san?
You've changed your clothes, so it appears you are going out."
Akiha gazes intently at me.

It's not a look of blame.
She is merely gazing at me uneasily.

entries.japanese:
「昨夜、あんなケガを負ってきたのにまた出かけるんですね、兄さんは」
「……ごめん。
友達がピンチでさ。
放って、おけないんだ」
「……そうですか。
どうせ止めても行かれるんでしょう、兄さんは」
「ああ。
けど危ないマネはしないよ。
ちょっと様子を見てくるだけだ。
……家に帰ってきたばっかりだっていうのに迷惑をかけて、すまない」
　言って、玄関に歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You came home with terrible injuries last night, and now you’re going out again, Brother.”
“I’m sorry. A friend of mine is in trouble. I can’t just leave her alone.”
“I see… You would go even if I tried to stop you, wouldn’t you, Brother?”
“Yeah. But I won’t do anything dangerous. I’m only going to check on them. I’m sorry to cause trouble when I’ve barely returned home myself.”
With that, I started toward the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're going to go out and get hurt again, like last night.
Aren't you, Nii-san?"
"…… I'm sorry.
A friend of mine is in trouble.
I can't let it go."
"…… I see.
I'm sure you're going to go even if I stop you, Nii-san."
"Yeah, but I won't do anything dangerous.
I'm just going to check it out a bit.
…… I'm sorry to cause trouble like this, when I've only just come home."
Saying so, I begin walking out.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　背中にかかる、小さな声。
「兄、さん」
　今までの声とは違う、弱々しい秋葉の声。
　……それはまるで八年前に戻ったような、不安をおびた声だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
A small voice came from behind me.
“Brother…”
It was Akiha, but her voice was weak and utterly unlike the one she had used until now.
It was an anxious voice, as though she had become the little girl from eight years ago again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah--"
A soft voice comes from behind me.
"Nii… san."
A weak voice, so unlike Akiha's usual tone.
…… It's just like her voice from eight years ago--tinged with unease.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……？」
「ちゃんと……戻って、来ますよね……？」
「――――」
　弱々しい秋葉の顔。
　今までの凛としたところはまったくなくて、それは―――本当に、子供のころの泣き虫だった秋葉の顔だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…?”
“You will come back, won’t you…?”
“……”
Akiha’s frail, helpless face.
All her usual poise was gone; she looked exactly like the crybaby she had been as a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha…?"
"You'll… come back, won't you?"
"----"
Akiha's weak, vulnerable face.
It has none of its earlier coldness, but like Akiha's childhood face, it's close to tears.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、ちょっと出かけてくるだけだって言ってるだろ。
秋葉が、そんな顔するほどの事じゃないよ」
「それは―――そうでしょう、けど」
「大丈夫、すぐ帰ってくるよ。
ごめんな秋葉、俺、おまえには迷惑をかけてばっかりだ」
「あ――――兄さん！」
　背中にかかる秋葉の声を振り払って屋敷を出る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, I told you I’m only going out for a while. There’s no reason for you to look like that.”
“I suppose not, but…”
“It’ll be all right; I’ll be back soon. I’m sorry, Akiha—all I ever do is make trouble for you.”
“Ah—Brother!”
I pushed Akiha’s voice from my mind and left the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What are you talking about?
I'm only going out for a moment.
You shouldn't make a face like that."
"I… I know, but…"
"It's okay.
I'll come right back.
I'm sorry, Akiha; I've always been causing you trouble."
"Ah--Nii-san!"
Ignoring Akiha's voice behind me, I leave the mansion.

entries.japanese:
……外は月の明るい夜。
　不安げな秋葉の顔を見たせいだろうか。
　なんだか、二度とここには戻ってこれないような、予感がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Outside, the moon shone brightly.
Was it because I had seen the fear in Akiha’s face?
Somehow, I had a feeling I would never come back here again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Outside, a moonlit night.
Perhaps because I saw Akiha's unsettled expression.
For some reason, I feel I may never return here.

entries.japanese:
繁華街にきた。
　弓塚がいるとしたら、おそらくはこのあたりだろう。
　例の通り魔殺人の犠牲者は、繁華街を中心に発見されているからだ。
「……くそ、何考えてるんだ、俺は……！」
　自分の憶測に文句を言う。
　……けど、他のところを捜すよりはここを捜したほうが弓塚を見つけやすいのは確かな事だ。
　意を決して、弓塚の姿を探しはじめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I reached the downtown district.
If Yumizuka was anywhere, she was probably somewhere around here.
The victims of the serial killings had mostly been discovered near the city center.
“Damn it, what am I even thinking…?”
I cursed myself for the suspicion.
Yet this was still the likeliest place to find Yumizuka.
I steeled myself and began searching.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I arrive at the shopping district.
If Yumizuka's anywhere, she'll most likely be here.
It's because the murder victims are found near this shopping district.
"…… Damn it, what am I thinking…!"
I curse my own logic.
…… But, at least I'm more likely to find her here than anywhere else.
Putting all thoughts aside, I start to look around for Yumizuka.

entries.japanese:
……どのくらい時間が経っただろう。
　路地裏や人気のないところを走りまわっても、弓塚の姿は見つけられなかった。
「はあ―――はあ――――はあ」
　走りどおしで熱くなった体を休める。
　時間はじき午前零時にさしかかろうとしている。
　……これ以上は、捜しても無駄かもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
How long had it been?
I had raced through back alleys and deserted streets, but found no sign of Yumizuka.
“Hah—hah—hah.”
I stopped to catch my breath and let my overheated body cool.
It was almost midnight.
Searching any longer might be pointless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… How long has it been?
There's no sign of Yumizuka; not in the back alleys nor in the crowds.
*pant*---*pant*----*pant*
I rest my body, burning from all the running.
It's almost midnight.
…… It might be useless to keep looking around.

entries.japanese:
「どこ行っちまったんだ、あいつ―――」
　立ち止まりかけている足を動かす。
　まだ行っていない場所がある。
　諦めるのは、本当に体が動かなくなったあとにしよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where the hell did she go—?”
I forced my faltering legs onward.
There were still places I hadn’t checked.
I could give up when my body truly refused to move—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Where has she gone…?"
I start walking again.
There's one place I haven't looked yet.
I'll give up after my body really can't move anymore--

entries.japanese:
……華やかな大通りを離れて、公園のほうにやってきた。
　連日の殺人事件でこのあたりには人影がない。
「……………」
　弓塚がいるとは思えないけど、もうここ以外、行っていない場所はなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I left the brilliant main street and headed toward the park.
The recent murders had emptied the whole area.
“……”
I doubted Yumizuka would be here, but it was the only place left.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Leaving the brightly-lit main street behind, I arrive at the park.
Because of the serial killings recently, there's not a soul to be seen around here.
"…………"
Even though I can't imagine Yumizuka being here, it's the only place left to look.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　夜の公園に人気はない。
　物音一つしない月下。
　わけもなく、全身の体温が下がった気がした。
「―――つ」
　首の後ろがしびれる。
　体がシン……と冷えきって、指先さえかじかんでいくような、悪寒。
「はっ……はっ……」
　冷めていく体とは正反対に、喉が熱かった。
　カラカラに渇いている。
　ポケットの中に手をいれる。
　ただしきりに―――刃物を、手にしていたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No one else was in the park.
Nothing stirred beneath the moon.
For no reason I could name, the warmth drained from my body.
“—!”
The back of my neck tingled.
A chill stole through me until my whole body fell deathly cold and even my fingertips began to numb.
“Hah… hah…”
While my body grew colder, my throat burned.
It was parched dry.
I slipped a hand into my pocket.
More than anything, I wanted a blade in my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
The park is empty at night.
There isn't a sound under the moonlight.
I don't know why, but a chill runs through me.
"--Sst."
The back of my head numbs.
A horrible chill, as if my body freezes to my fingertips.
I try to catch my breath.
In contrast to my cold body, my throat is scorching.
It's dry with thirst.
I put my hand in my pocket.
I just---wanted a blade in my hand.

entries.japanese:
「なん―――だ」
　ギリ………。
　微かな頭痛。
　低くなる体温。
　氷のように冷めていく理性。
　なにか、ヘンだ。
　この公園。
このあたりには、よくないモノが、渦巻いている気がする。
「……まだ奥があったよな、この公園」
　頭痛を振り払って、奥へと足を進ませた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—is this?”
My teeth ground together.
A faint headache.
My temperature falling.
My reason cooling into ice.
Something was wrong.
This park. Something evil was churning all around it.
“There was more to the park back there, wasn’t there?”
I shook off the headache and pressed deeper inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…?"
Just…
A faint headache.
A low temperature.
My mind is cool like ice.
Something is strange.
This park, it feels like something bad is around here.
"…… A little more till I reach the center of this park."
I shake the headache off, and walk deeper in.

entries.japanese:
あたりには誰もいない。
　ひどく暗くて、寂しい待ち合わせ場所。
　そこに―――誰かが蹲っていた。
　はあはあという呼吸。
　顔色は真っ青で、苦しそうに喉をかきむしっている姿。
　それは間違いなく、弓塚さつきの姿だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
No one was there.
Only a lonely meeting place drowned in darkness.
And there—someone was crouching on the ground.
Ragged breaths.
Their face was deathly pale, their hands clawing desperately at their tortured throat.
It was unmistakably Satsuki Yumizuka.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no one around.
A terribly dark and lonely place to meet someone.
There--someone is crouched.
Breathing raggedly.
Her face, pale white, as she scratches her throat in pain.
Without a doubt, it is Yumizuka Satsuki.

entries.japanese:
「弓塚―――！？」
　やっと会えたっていう喜びもあったんだろう。
　昨夜のことなんて考えもせず、俺は弓塚へと駆け出した。
「待って―――！」
　そんな俺の行動を、弓塚は声だけで止めてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka—!?”
Perhaps I was simply that relieved to have found her.
Without a thought for what had happened the night before, I ran toward her.
“Wait—!”
Her voice alone stopped me in my tracks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka--!?"
I guess there is the joy of finally finding her.
Not thinking about last night, I run towards her.
"Wait…!"
Yumizuka stops me with just a word.

entries.japanese:
「……待ってよ、志貴くん。
志貴くんのほうから来てくれたのは嬉しいけど、今は近くにこられると困っちゃうんだ。
お願いだから、それ以上は近寄らないで」
　苦しげな呼吸で。
　今にも倒れそうに体を震わせながら、弓塚はそんなことを言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please wait, Shiki… I’m happy you came looking for me, but I can’t have you near me right now. Please—don’t come any closer.”
Every breath was agony.
Her body trembled as though it might collapse, yet still Yumizuka told me to stay away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait, Shiki-kun.
I'm glad you came, but I don't want you any nearer right now.
Please, don't come any closer."
Her breathing looks painful.
Her body convulses as she speaks, as if she's about to collapse any second now.

entries.japanese:
「ばか、そんな顔色をしてるヤツを放っておけるわけがないだろ……！」
「ううん、わたしは、大丈夫……志貴くんが来てくれたから、もう元気になっちゃった」
　無理やりに体を起こして、弓塚は笑顔をうかべた。
　それは、どうみたって空元気だ。
　……近づけない。
　そうまでして、弓塚は俺を近づけまいとしているんだって、分かってしまったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be stupid; you look half dead—how am I supposed to leave you like this…?”
“No, I’m all right—now that you’re here, Shiki, I feel better already.”
Yumizuka forced herself upright and smiled.
Her cheer was obviously forced.
I couldn’t bring myself to go closer.
I understood now that she was pushing herself this hard precisely to keep me away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't be stupid!
I'm not going to leave someone looking as painful as you alone…!"
"No, I'm okay… You came, so I'm fine now."
Forcing herself up, Yumizuka smiles at me.
It seems like a show of bravado.
…… But I can't approach her.
I do at least understand that Yumizuka doesn't want me near her.

entries.japanese:
「……いったいどうしたんだよ弓塚。
どうして家に帰ってないんだ。
昨日のアレは一体なんだったんだ。
どうして、あんな――――」
「ん？
　あんな、なに？」
「……くそ、俺にはわからない！
　ほんとうに――悔しいぐらいわからないんだ、弓塚……！」
「そうなの？
　昨日のことは見たまんまよ。
わたしがあの人たちを殺したって言ったでしょ？」
　あっさりと返答する。
　……それだけは否定したいっていう俺の気持ちを、嘲笑うみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened to you, Yumizuka? Why haven’t you gone home? What was all that yesterday? Why did you do something so—”
“Hmm? Something so what?”
“Damn it, I don’t understand! I truly don’t—it’s driving me crazy how little I understand, Yumizuka…!”
“You don’t understand? Yesterday was exactly what it looked like. I told you I killed those people, remember?”
She answered without hesitation.
As though mocking how desperately I wanted that one fact to be false.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's going on, Yumizuka?
Why haven't you been home?
What was that about, yesterday?
Why, that----"
"Hm?
That what?"
"…… Damn it, I don't know!
I really don't understand anything, Yumizuka…!"
"Really?
You saw what happened yesterday.
I told you 'I killed those people', didn't I?"
She answers frankly.
…… It's almost as if she's laughing at my feelings of denial.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ……街で起きている殺人事件は、弓塚の仕業だっていうのか……！」
「あんまし答えたくないけど。
そういう事になるよ、うん」
「そういう事になるって、なんで……！？」
「そういう事はそういう事だよ。
わたしはあの人たちを殺したし、きっとこれからも同じ事をしていくんだもん。
嘘をついたって仕方ないでしょ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then… you’re the one behind the murders in the city…?”
“I don’t really want to answer, but… yes. I suppose I am.”
“What do you mean, you suppose? Why…?”
“It means what it means. I killed those people, and I’m sure I’ll keep doing the same thing. There’s no point lying about it, is there?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then… the recent killings in town were all your doing, Yumizuka…!"
"I don't like to say it, but… that's the way it is, yeah."
"What the hell do you mean, 'That's the way it is' …!?"
"It's just the way it is.
I killed those people, and I'll keep on doing the same thing.
I can't just lie about it, can I?"

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚、おまえ―――」
「その呼び方、やめてくれないかな。
わたしだって志貴くんって呼んでるんだから、志貴くんも名前で呼んでくれないと不公平だよ」
「なっ――――」
　ごくりと息を飲む。
　弓塚はやっぱり以前のままだ。
　以前のままの仕草で―――ひどく恐ろしいことを、口にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumi—zuka, you—”
“Would you stop calling me that? I call you Shiki, so it’s only fair that you call me Satsuki.”
“Wh—”
I swallowed hard.
Yumizuka was still exactly as she had always been.
With all the same gestures as before, she said something utterly horrifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka, you--"
"Please.
Stop calling me that.
I'm calling you Shiki-kun, so it's only fair for you to call me by my first name too."
"Wha…"
I take a deep breath.
Yumizuka is still like before.
Even though she acts like she used to----she says some pretty scary things.

entries.japanese:
「考えてみると、わたしってばかみたいだよね。
こんなふうに志貴くんって呼ぶこともできないで、何年間もあなたのことを遠くから見てるだけだった」
「弓―――塚？」
「ずっと志貴くんのことを見てた。
あの倉庫で助けられる前から、ずっと志貴くんの事を見てた。
　わたし、本当は臆病なんだ。
だから周りの人たちに合わせて、無理をして笑ったり話を合わせたりしてたらね、いつのまにかアイドルみたいに扱われちゃった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, I was such an idiot. For years I only watched you from afar, unable even to call you Shiki the way I do now.”
“Yumi—zuka?”
“I was always watching you. Even before you rescued me from that warehouse, I had been watching you all along.
The truth is, I’m a coward. I kept forcing myself to smile and agree with everyone around me so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of idol.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"When I think about it, I look foolish.
I could never talk to you like this, for all the years I watched you from afar."
"Yumi… zuka?"
"I was always watching you, Shiki-kun.
Even before I was saved in that warehouse, I was always watching you.
I'm… really a coward.
I always just agreed with the people around me, and smiled when it seemed right.
Before I knew it, everyone was treating me like an idol."

entries.japanese:
「だから、学校はあんまり楽しくなかったんだ。
でも中学二年生になったばかりの時にね、志貴くんに話しかけられてから変わったんだ」
「え―――？」
「ううん、志貴くんは覚えてなんかないよ。
なんていうのかな、あなたはいつも自然で、飾らない人だから。
たぶんあの時の言葉も、志貴くんにとってなんでもない一言だったんだろうなあ」
「――――――」
　なんていえばいいんだろう。
　弓塚の言うとおり、俺は何も覚えていない。
　弓塚と何を話したのか、いや、弓塚と話したことがあるなんていうことさえ、覚えてない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was why I never enjoyed school much. But then, just after we started our second year of middle school, you spoke to me, and everything changed.”
“I did…?”
“You don’t remember. Of course you don’t. You’ve always been so natural, so completely yourself. Whatever you said that day was probably nothing at all to you.”
“……”
What could I possibly say?
She was right.
I remembered nothing—neither what we had spoken about nor even the fact that I had ever spoken to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So school wasn't fun for me.
But that changed, after you talked to me in the second year of junior high, Shiki-kun."
"Eh--?"
"Nah.
It's not something you'd remember.
How can I put it… You were always natural, never showing off.
Probably you didn't even think about what you said back then."

"------"
What can I say.
Just as Yumizuka says, I remember nothing.
I don't know what I said to her, or even if I had talked to her back then.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ、そんな顔しなくても。
志貴くんはあの頃から乾くんに付きっきりだったから、他のクラスメイトには興味がなさそうだったし」
「けど、それでも良かったんだ。
志貴くんと同じ教室にいるんだって思うだけで、すごく嬉しかった。
　いつかあなたにちゃんと話しかけて、弓塚さんって呼ばれることを目標にしてたなんて、今思うとすごく損してたなって思うけど」
　懐かしむように彼女は言った。
　とても昔。
　……とても遠い昔のことを思い出すように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right; you don’t have to look like that. Even back then, you spent all your time with Arihiko and never seemed interested in any of your other classmates.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy.
My great ambition was to work up the courage to speak to you properly and hear you call me Yumizuka one day—looking back, I wasted so much time.”
She spoke wistfully.
A very long time ago.
As though remembering something from the impossibly distant past.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's okay.
Don't make a face like that.
You were only hanging out with Inui-kun, so it was normal for you to ignore other classmates."
"But that was okay.
I was happy just being in the same class as you, Shiki-kun.
It was my goal to talk to you and let you call me Yumizuka-san.
Now that I think about it, it was too small of a wish."
She recalls nostalgically.
Those ancient days.
…… Like she is remembering something that happened a long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「わたし、ずっとあなたのことを見てた。
　気付いてくれないって解ってたけど、ずっと見てたんだよ」
「――――――」
　それは―――正直嬉しいけど。
「ね。
志貴くんはわたしのこと、好き？」
　今の彼女に、俺はなんて答えてあげればいいんだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was always watching you.
I knew you would never notice me, but I kept watching.”
“……”
To be honest, it made me happy. But—
“Tell me, Shiki. Do you like me?”
What answer could I possibly give her now—?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I… was always watching you.
I knew you'd never notice me, but I watched you anyway."
"----"
Well--to be honest, I'm happy, but…
"Do you like me, Shiki-kun?"
How can I answer her right now---?

entries.japanese:
――――わからない。
　夕方までは弓塚を捜そうと必死だった。
　けどこうして日が落ちて夜になったとたん、昨夜の出来事を鮮明に思い出してしまう。
　路地裏に散乱していた死体。
　自分が殺したんだと言った弓塚。
　……理由はどうあれ、彼女はあれだけの人間を殺してしまっている。
　だから、このまま無関係でいるのが正しい選択だって解っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I didn’t know.
Until evening, I had been desperate to find Yumizuka.
But the instant the sun went down, the night before returned with terrible clarity.
The bodies strewn across the alley.
Yumizuka saying she had killed them.
Whatever her reasons, she had murdered all those people.
I knew the right choice was to stay out of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I don't know.
I was so intent on looking for Yumizuka until this evening.
But with nightfall, the events of last night suddenly appear fresh in my mind.
The dead bodies scattered about the alley.
Yumizuka, who said she killed them.
…… No matter what the reason, she killed them.

So I understand that staying out of it is the best choice.

entries.japanese:
「…………っ」
　解っているのに、まだ迷いを捨てきれない。
　なにを考えてるんだろう、と自分でもバカらしく思う。
　弓塚がいったいどうなっているのか、俺にはてんで解らない。
　アイツが街を騒がしている吸血鬼殺人の犯人だっていう事も、思い知らされてる。
　けど、どうしても。
　夕暮れの帰り道、弓塚の最後の言葉が、どうしても忘れられないでいた――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I knew that, yet I still couldn’t put my doubts aside.
Even I could see how absurd I was being.
I had no idea what had happened to Yumizuka.
The truth had already been driven home: she was the vampire behind the murders terrorizing the city.
But no matter what…
I still couldn’t forget Yumizuka’s final words on the road home at sunset—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
I understand, but I can't cast aside my doubts.
What am I thinking?
It's just foolish.
I just can't comprehend what's happening to Yumizuka.
I do realize she is the vampire serial killer causing all these incidents in town.
But still,
I can't forget her last words she said in the sunset on our way home----

entries.japanese:
……いつのまにか、時計の針は十二時を指そうとしていた。
　どうするべきかまだ迷ったままで、眠れない夜を過ごしている。
「志貴さま、起きていらっしゃいますか……？」
　……翡翠の声だ。
　どうしたんだろう、こんな夜更けに。
「起きてるけど、どうしたの翡翠？」
「―――はい、なにぶんこのような時間なので迷ったのですが、志貴さまが起きていらっしゃるようでしたらお伝えしようと思いまして」
entries.maoEnglish:
Before I knew it, the clock was nearing twelve.
Still unable to decide what to do, I remained awake.
“Master Shiki, are you still awake…?”
It was Hisui.
What could she want at this hour?
“I’m awake. What is it, Hisui?”
“I hesitated because of the hour, but since you were awake, Master Shiki, I thought I ought to tell you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Before I realize it, it's almost midnight.
Lost in thinking about what I should do, I've passed some of the night wide awake.
"…… Shiki-sama, are you awake……?"
…… Hisui's voice.
Why is she up this late at night?
"I'm up, but why, Hisui?"
"---Yes, I was unsure, but if you were awake, I thought that I should tell you."

entries.japanese:
「伝えるって、なにを？」
「先ほど、志貴さまにお電話がありました。
公園で待っている、との言伝です」
「電話って……こんな時間に？」
「はい。
お名前も言われずにお切りになりましたので、志貴さまに伝えるのはどうかと迷ったのですが―――」
「いや―――それは」
　……考えるまでもない。
　その電話は、弓塚からのものだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tell me what?”
“There was a telephone call for you a short while ago, Master Shiki. The caller left a message saying they would be waiting in the park.”
“A call at this hour?”
“Yes. The caller gave no name before hanging up, so I wasn’t sure whether I should pass the message on to you, Master Shiki—”
“No—that was…”
There was no need to think.
The call had to be from Yumizuka.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tell me what?"
"Just a while ago, a call came for you, Shiki-sama.
The message was that 'I'll be waiting in the park.'"
"Phone call…… This late at night?"
"Yes, the call ended before I could ask for a name, so I was unsure if I should tell you, Shiki-sama--"

"No--that is……"
…… This doesn't require any thought.
That phone call had to have been from Yumizuka.

entries.japanese:
「……ありがとう。
でも、今夜は遅いからまた明日にする。
その子、学校のクラスメイトだから明日になれば会えるんだ」
「うそです。
そんな辛そうな顔をしているのに、笑われては、困ります」
「ばか、うそなんてついてないよ。
大丈夫、こんな時間に外出なんてしない。
秋葉をまた怒らせるだけだし、翡翠にも迷惑をかけるじゃないか。
だから、そんなコトはしないって」
「…………………」
　翡翠は押し黙る。
　しばらく、俺たちの間には言葉がなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. But it’s late, so I’ll leave it until tomorrow. She’s a classmate. I’ll see her at school then.”
“You’re lying. You look like you’re in pain—please don’t force yourself to smile.”
“Don’t be silly. I’m not lying. It’s all right—I’m not going out at this hour. I’d only make Akiha angry again and cause trouble for you. So I won’t.”
“……”
Hisui fell silent.
For a while, no words passed between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Thanks.
But, it's a little late, so I'll wait until tomorrow.
She's one of my classmates, so I'll see her tomorrow."
"That is not true.
There is something wrong with smiling like that with such a strained face."

"Stupid, I'm not lying at all.
I'm fine, I won't go out this late at night.
Akiha would get mad, and you would get in trouble, so there's no reason for me to do that."
"…………………"
Hisui descends into silence.
The conversation between us dies.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま。
どうか、ご無理はなさらないでください」
「やだな、べつに無理なんかしてないって。
これから寝るんだから、翡翠も部屋に戻っていいよ」
「………………」
　翡翠はただ俺を見つめてくるだけだ。
「―――それじゃあ、おやすみ」
　それに耐えきれなくなって、強引にドアを閉めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki… please, do not push yourself.”
“Come on, I’m not pushing myself at all. I’m going to sleep now, so you can go back to your room.”
“……”
Hisui merely stared at me.
“Well… good night.”
Unable to bear her gaze, I forced the door shut.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama.
Please do not push yourself too hard."
"…… Nah, I'm not pushing anything.
I'll go to sleep, so please go back to your room."
"…………………"
Hisui just looks at me.
"---Well, good night."
Not being able to endure her stare, I slam the door.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
翡翠に隠し事はできないか」
　机の引き出しからナイフを取り出す。
　……なにをするっていうわけでもないけど、一応用心のために武器を持っていかないと安心できない。
「―――公園か。
こんな時間に呼び出すなんて、どうして―――」
　呟いて、つまらない寓話を思い出した。
　吸血鬼は夜じゃないと活動できない。
　それが本当だっていうんなら、弓塚はこんな時間に俺を呼び出したんたじゃなくて、こんな時間じゃないと俺を呼び出せないだけじゃないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn. So I can’t hide anything from Hisui.”
I took the knife from my desk drawer.
I wasn’t planning to use it, but I wouldn’t feel safe going without some kind of weapon.
“The park… Why call me out at this hour—?”
The question brought a silly old tale to mind.
Vampires could only move at night.
If that was true, then Yumizuka hadn’t summoned me at this hour by choice; it was simply the only hour when she could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sheesh.
I can't hide anything from Hisui."
I take my knife out of the drawer.
…… I don't intend to necessarily use it, but I just feel better with it by my side.
"---The park?
Why would she call me out at this hour---"
Muttering, I think back to those foolish tales.
Vampires can only move about during night time.
So supposing that's true, then Yumizuka didn't call me out at this hour.
It's more like if it wasn't this hour, then she couldn't call me at all.

entries.japanese:
「……考えても始まらないか」
　ともかく今は公園に向かおう。
　翡翠に気付かれないよう、静かに屋敷を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No point thinking about it now.”
First I had to reach the park.
I left the mansion in silence, careful not to alert Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No matter how much I think about it nothing will get done."
Right now I have to go to the park.
I exit the mansion quietly to avoid Hisui's notice.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ――――はあ」
　走りどおしで熱くなった体を休める。
　時間はじき午前零時にさしかかろうとしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… hah… hah…”
I stopped to cool my body after running the whole way.
It was almost midnight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*--*pant*--*pant*
I rest my body, burning from all the running.
It's almost midnight.

entries.japanese:
大通りから離れた公園。
　連日の殺人事件でこのあたりには人影がない。
「………」
　どくん、と心臓が高鳴る。
　緊張で喉が渇く。
　翡翠がうけとった電話が弓塚からのものなら。
　彼女は、この奥で俺を待っているハズだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The park lay beyond the main thoroughfare.
The recent murders had emptied the entire area.
“……”
My heart slammed against my ribs.
Tension dried my throat.
If the call Hisui had answered was from Yumizuka.
Then she should be waiting somewhere deeper inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The park located off of the main road.
Because of the serial killings these past several days, there's not a soul to be seen around here.
"………"
Thump.
My heart beats loudly.
My throat dries up from the tension.
If the phone call that Hisui received was from Yumizuka,
then she has to be waiting there for me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　夜の公園に人気はない。
　物音一つしない月下。
　わけもなく、全身の体温が下がった気がした。
「―――つ」
　首の後ろがしびれる。
　体がシン……と冷えきって、指先さえかじかんでいくような、悪寒。
「はっ……はっ……」
　冷めていく体とは正反対に、喉が熱かった。
　カラカラに渇いている。
　ポケットの中に手をいれる。
　ただしきりに―――刃物を、手にしていたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No one else was in the park.
Nothing stirred beneath the moon.
For no reason I could name, the warmth drained from my body.
“—!”
The back of my neck tingled.
A chill stole through me until my whole body fell deathly cold and even my fingertips began to numb.
“Hah… hah…”
While my body grew colder, my throat burned.
It was parched dry.
I slipped a hand into my pocket.
More than anything, I wanted a blade in my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
The park is empty at night.
There isn't a sound under the moonlight.
I don't know why, but a chill runs through me.
"--Sst."
The back of my head numbs.
A horrible chill, as if my body freezes to my fingertips.
I try to catch my breath.
In contrast to my cold body, my throat is scorching.
It's dry with thirst.
I put my hand in my pocket.
I just---wanted a blade in my hand.

entries.japanese:
「なん―――だ」
　ギリ………。
　微かな頭痛。
　低くなる体温。
　氷のように冷めていく理性。
　なにか、ヘンだ。
　この公園。
このあたりには、よくないモノが、渦巻いている気がする。
「……いまさら何を恐がってるんだ、俺は」
　頭痛を振り払って、奥へと足を進ませた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—is this?”
My teeth ground together.
A faint headache.
My temperature falling.
My reason cooling into ice.
Something was wrong.
Something foul seemed to be churning through this park, all around me.
“…What am I afraid of now?”
I shook off the headache and pressed deeper inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…?"
Just…
A faint headache.
A low temperature.
My mind is cool like ice.
Something is strange.
This park, it feels like something bad is around here.
"…… Just what am I afraid of?"
I shake the headache off, and walk deeper in.

entries.japanese:
あたりには誰もいない。
　ひどく暗くて、寂しい待ち合わせ場所。
　そこに―――誰かが蹲っていた。
　はあはあという呼吸。
　顔色は真っ青で、苦しそうに喉をかきむしっている姿。
　それは間違いなく、弓塚さつきの姿だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
No one was there.
Only a lonely meeting place drowned in darkness.
And there—someone was crouching on the ground.
Ragged breaths.
Their face was deathly pale, their hands clawing desperately at their tortured throat.
It was unmistakably Satsuki Yumizuka.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There's no one around.
A terribly dark and lonely place to meet someone.
There--someone is crouched.
Breathing raggedly.
Her face, pale white, as she scratches her throat in pain.
Without a doubt, it is Yumizuka Satsuki.

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚？」
　その姿があんまりにも苦しげだったからだろう。
　俺は昨夜のことなんて考えもせず、弓塚へと駆け出した。
「待って―――！」
　そんな俺の行動を、弓塚は声だけで止めてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumi…zuka?”
Perhaps she simply looked too wretched to leave alone. Without even thinking of the night before, I ran toward her.
“Wait—!”
Her voice alone stopped me in my tracks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka?"
Her figure is tormented.
Without a thought for what happened last night, I run towards her.
"Wait… !"
Yumizuka stops me with just a word.

entries.japanese:
「……待って、志貴くん。
来てくれたのは嬉しいけど、今は近くにこられると困っちゃうんだ。
お願いだから、それ以上は近寄らないで」
　苦しげな呼吸で。
　今にも倒れそうに体を震わせながら、弓塚はそんなことを言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Shiki. I’m glad you came, but I can’t have you close to me right now. Please, don’t come any nearer.”
Her breath came in tortured gasps.
Her body trembling as if she might collapse at any moment, Yumizuka told me to stay back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait, Shiki-kun.
I'm glad you came, but I don't want you any nearer right now.
Please, don't come any closer."
Her breathing looks painful.
Her body convulses as she speaks, as if she's about to collapse any second now.

entries.japanese:
「ばか、そんな顔色をしてるヤツを放っておけるわけがないだろ……！」
「ううん、わたしは、大丈夫……志貴くんが来てくれたから、もう元気になっちゃった」
　無理やりに体を起こして、弓塚は笑顔をうかべた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be stupid; you look half dead—how am I supposed to leave you like this…?”
“No, I’m all right—now that you’re here, Shiki, I feel better already.”
Yumizuka forced herself upright and smiled.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't be stupid!
I'm not going to leave someone looking as painful as you alone…!"
"No, I'm okay… You came, so I'm fine now."
Forcing herself up, Yumizuka smiles at me.

entries.japanese:
「……いったいどうしたんだよ弓塚。
どうして家に帰ってないんだ。
昨日のアレは一体なんだったんだ。
どうして、あんな――――」
「ん？
　あんな、なに？」
「……くそ、俺にはわからない！
　ほんとうに――悔しいぐらいわからないんだ、弓塚……！」
「そうなの？
　昨日のことは見たまんまよ。
わたしがあの人たちを殺したって言ったでしょ？」
　あっさりと返答する。
　……それだけは否定したいっていう俺の気持ちを、嘲笑うみたいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened to you, Yumizuka? Why haven’t you gone home? What was all that yesterday? Why did you do something so—”
“Hmm? Something so what?”
“Damn it, I don’t understand! I truly don’t—it’s driving me crazy how little I understand, Yumizuka…!”
“You don’t understand? Yesterday was exactly what it looked like. I told you I killed those people, remember?”
She answered without hesitation.
As though mocking how desperately I wanted that one fact to be false.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's going on, Yumizuka?
Why haven't you been home?
What was that about, yesterday?
Why, that----"
"Hm?
That what?"
"…… Damn it, I don't know!
I really don't understand anything, Yumizuka…!"
"Really?
You saw what happened yesterday.
I told you 'I killed those people', didn't I?"
She answers frankly.
…… It's almost as if she's laughing at my feelings of denial.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ……街で起きている殺人事件は、弓塚の仕業だっていうのか……！」
「あんまし答えたくないけど。
そういう事になるよ、うん」
「そういう事になるって、なんで……！？」
「そういう事はそういう事だよ。
わたしはあの人たちを殺したし、きっとこれからも同じ事をしていくんだもん。
嘘をついたって仕方ないでしょ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then… you’re the one behind the murders in the city…?”
“I don’t really want to answer, but… yes. I suppose I am.”
“What do you mean, you suppose? Why…?”
“It means what it means. I killed those people, and I’m sure I’ll keep doing the same thing. There’s no point lying about it, is there?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then… the recent killings in town were all your doing, Yumizuka…!"
"I don't like to say it, but… that's the way it is, yeah."
"What the hell do you mean, 'That's the way it is' …!?"
"It's just the way it is.
I killed those people, and I'll keep on doing the same thing.
I can't just lie about it, can I?"

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚、おまえ―――」
「その呼び方、やめてくれないかな。
わたしだって志貴くんって呼んでるんだから、志貴くんも名前で呼んでくれないと不公平だよ」
「なっ――――」
　ごくりと息を飲む。
　弓塚はやっぱり以前のままだ。
　以前のままの仕草で―――ひどく恐ろしいことを、口にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumi—zuka, you—”
“Would you stop calling me that? I call you Shiki, so it’s only fair that you call me Satsuki.”
“Wh—”
I swallowed hard.
Yumizuka was still exactly as she had always been.
With all the same gestures as before, she said something utterly horrifying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka, you--"
"Please.
Stop calling me that.
I'm calling you Shiki-kun, so it's only fair for you to call me by my first name too."
"Wha…"
I take a deep breath.
Yumizuka is still like before.
Even though she acts like she used to----she says some pretty scary things.

entries.japanese:
「考えてみると、わたしってばかみたいだよね。
こんなふうに志貴くんって呼ぶこともできないで、何年間もあなたのことを遠くから見てるだけだった」
「弓―――塚？」
「ずっと志貴くんのことを見てた。
あの倉庫で助けられる前から、ずっと志貴くんの事を見てた。
　わたし、本当は臆病なんだ。
だから周りの人たちに合わせて、無理をして笑ったり話を合わせたりしてたらね、いつのまにかアイドルみたいに扱われちゃった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, I was such an idiot. For years I only watched you from afar, unable even to call you Shiki the way I do now.”
“Yumi—zuka?”
“I was always watching you. Even before you rescued me from that warehouse, I had been watching you all along.
The truth is, I’m a coward. I kept forcing myself to smile and agree with everyone around me so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of idol.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"When I think about it, I look foolish.
I could never talk to you like this, for all the years I watched you from afar."
"Yumi… zuka?"
"I was always watching you, Shiki-kun.
Even before I was saved in that warehouse, I was always watching you.
I'm… really a coward.
I always just agreed with the people around me, and smiled when it seemed right.
Before I knew it, everyone was treating me like an idol."

entries.japanese:
「だから、学校はあんまり楽しくなかったんだ。
でも中学二年生になったばかりの時にね、志貴くんに話しかけられてから変わったんだ」
「え―――？」
「ううん、志貴くんは覚えてなんかないよ。
なんていうのかな、あなたはいつも自然で、飾らない人だから。
たぶんあの時の言葉も、志貴くんにとってなんでもない一言だったんだろうなあ」
「――――――」
　なんていえばいいんだろう。
　弓塚の言うとおり、俺は何も覚えていない。
　弓塚と何を話したのか、いや、弓塚と話したことがあるなんていうことさえ、覚えてない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was why I never enjoyed school much. But then, just after we started our second year of middle school, you spoke to me, and everything changed.”
“I did…?”
“You don’t remember. Of course you don’t. You’ve always been so natural, so completely yourself. Whatever you said that day was probably nothing at all to you.”
“……”
What could I possibly say?
She was right.
I remembered nothing—neither what we had spoken about nor even the fact that I had ever spoken to her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So school wasn't fun for me.
But that changed, after you talked to me in the second year of junior high, Shiki-kun."
"Eh--?"
"Nah.
It's not something you'd remember.
How can I put it… You were always natural, never showing off.
Probably you didn't even think about what you said back then."

"------"
What can I say.
Just as Yumizuka says, I remember nothing.
I don't know what I said to her, or even if I had talked to her back then.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ、そんな顔しなくても。
志貴くんはあの頃から乾くんに付きっきりだったから、他のクラスメイトには興味がなさそうだったし」
「けど、それでも良かったんだ。
志貴くんと同じ教室にいるんだって思うだけで、すごく嬉しかった。
　いつかあなたにちゃんと話しかけて、弓塚さんって呼ばれることを目標にしてたなんて、今思うとすごく損してたなって思うけど」
　懐かしむように彼女は言った。
　とても昔。
　……とても遠い昔のことを思い出すように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right; you don’t have to look like that. Even back then, you spent all your time with Arihiko and never seemed interested in any of your other classmates.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy.
My great ambition was to work up the courage to speak to you properly and hear you call me Yumizuka one day—looking back, I wasted so much time.”
She spoke wistfully.
A very long time ago.
As though remembering something from the impossibly distant past.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's okay.
Don't make a face like that.
You were only hanging out with Inui-kun, so it was normal for you to ignore other classmates."
"But that was okay.
I was happy just being in the same class as you, Shiki-kun.
It was my goal to talk to you and let you call me Yumizuka-san.
Now that I think about it, it was too small of a wish."
She recalls nostalgically.
Those ancient days.
…… like she is remembering something that happened a long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「わたし、ずっとあなたのことを見てた。
　気付いてくれないって解ってたけど、ずっと見てたんだよ」
「――――――」
　それは―――正直嬉しいけど。
「ね。
志貴くんはわたしのこと、好き？」
　今の彼女に、俺はなんて答えてあげればいいんだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was always watching you.
I knew you would never notice me, but I kept watching.”
“……”
To be honest, it made me happy. But—
“Tell me, Shiki. Do you like me?”
What answer could I possibly give her now—?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I… was always watching you.
I knew you'd never notice me, but I watched you anyway."
"----"
Well--to be honest, I'm happy, but…
"Do you like me, Shiki-kun?"
How can I answer her right now---?

entries.japanese:
「―――正直、俺にはわからない。
ただ、きみを放っておけない」
　……そう。
　弓塚と話をしたのはたった二日前の事だけど、それがずっと脳裏に残って離れない。
　なら、それは。
「……俺は弓塚さんのように、昔からきみを知っているってワケじゃないけど――――」
　危険だって解っているのに、こんなところまで足を運んでくるほど。
「きみのことが、好きなんだと、思う」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, I don’t know. I only know I can’t leave you alone.”
Yes…
I had spoken to Yumizuka only two days ago, yet she had stayed in my thoughts ever since.
Then perhaps this meant…
“I haven’t known you for years the way you’ve known me, but—”
I had come all this way despite knowing the danger.
“I think I like you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---To be honest, I don't know.
But I can't just leave you alone."
…… Yes.
Since I talked to Yumizuka two days ago, she has never left my mind.
So that must mean…
"…… Unlike your case, I don't feel like I've known you for years, but---"
Even though I knew it was dangerous, I still came here.
"I… think I do… like you."

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……弓塚は呆然と俺を見ている。
　それを、できるだけまっすぐに受け止めて、見つめ返す。
「―――――、だ」
　ふるふると首をふって。
　今にも泣き出しそうな顔で、彼女は言った。
「―――そんなの、やだよ」
「……弓塚、さん……？」
「だって、そんなの―――わたし、ばか、みたい」
　呆然としたまま呟いて、弓塚はうつむいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Yumizuka stared at me, stunned.
I met her gaze as directly as I could.
“No.”
She shook her head.
On the verge of tears, she said it.
“I don’t want that.”
“Yumizuka…?”
“Because that would make me look like such an idiot.”
Still dazed, Yumizuka lowered her head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Yumizuka looks at me, aghast.
I stare back at her.
"---No…"
She shakes her head.
She seems about to burst into tears.
"---I don't want that…"
"…… Yumizuka… san?"
"…… Because that, that just makes me look---stupid…"
Still aghast, Yumizuka looks down as she murmurs.

entries.japanese:
「――――悪いけど。
きみに、特別な感情は、抱けない」
　きっぱりと、弓塚の目を見据えたまま返答した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…I’m sorry, but I don’t have those kinds of feelings for you.”
I held Yumizuka’s gaze and gave her the truth without softening it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I'm sorry, but, I can't have any special feelings for you."
I answer clearly while looking her straight in the eye.

entries.japanese:
「――――そう、なんだ」
　……弓塚の声と体が震えている。
「…………」
　……続ける言葉が見付からない。
　自分でもひどいヤツだって思うけど、それが本当の気持ちだった。
　遠野志貴は弓塚さつきっていうクラスメイトの事を、今まで意識したことはない。
　ここにいるのだって、二日前の帰り道があんまりにも印象的だったから、どうしても放っておけなかっただけなんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see…”
Yumizuka’s voice and body trembled.
“……”
I could find nothing more to say.
It made me a bastard, but it was the truth.
Shiki Tohno had never thought of his classmate Satsuki Yumizuka that way.
I had only come because our walk home two days ago had left such a powerful impression that I couldn’t abandon her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I… see."
…… Both Yumizuka's voice and body tremble.
"…………"
…… I can't think of anything else to say.
Maybe this makes me a horrible person, but those are my true feelings.
I never had any special feelings for my classmate Yumizuka Satsuki.
I'm only here because what happened on the way home two days ago left such an impression on me, I couldn't just forget about it---

entries.japanese:
「……うん、それぐらい、わかってた。
だからこうなっちゃったんだものね。
……いいよ。
志貴くんがそう言ってくれるなら、わたしも、自分に素直になるだけだから」
entries.maoEnglish: “Yes, I knew that much. That’s why I ended up like this, after all. It’s fine. If that’s what you’re telling me, Shiki, then I only have to be true to myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I knew that.
I guess that's why things turned out this way.
…… It's okay.
Since you say that, I'll be honest to myself too, Shiki-kun."

entries.japanese:
「弓塚――――俺は」
　俺は―――答えられない。
　自分でもひどいヤツだって思うけど、それが本当の気持ちなんだ。
　弓塚さつきっていうクラスメイトの事を、今まで意識したことはない。
　ここにいるのだって、二日前の帰り道があんまりにも印象的だったから、どうしても放っておけなかっただけなんだ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka—I…”
I couldn’t answer her.
It made me a bastard, but that was the truth.
I had never thought of my classmate Satsuki Yumizuka that way.
I was only here because our walk home two days ago had left such a powerful impression that I couldn’t abandon her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka----I…"
I… can't answer.
Maybe this makes me a horrible person, but those are my true feelings.
I never had any special feelings for my classmate Yumizuka Satsuki.
I'm only here because what happened on the way home two days ago left such an impression on me, I couldn't just forget about it---

entries.japanese:
「そうだよね。
志貴くん、わたしのことなんて見てなかったもの。
わたしのことを好きになってくれるはずないわ」
entries.maoEnglish: “Of course. You never even saw me, Shiki. There was no way you would ever like me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I thought so.
You never even knew I existed, so you couldn't have fallen in love with me."

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　びくり、と弓塚の体が震えた。
　弓塚はハァハァと苦しげに息をはいて、そのまま―――地面に膝をついてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Yumizuka shuddered.
Panting painfully, she sank to her knees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---"
Yumizuka's body trembles.
Breathing painfully, she falls to her knees.

entries.japanese:
ごふっ、という音。
　地面にしゃがみこんだ弓塚は、大きく咳をして、血の塊を吐き出した。
「―――弓塚！？」
　今度こそ弓塚にかけよった。
「弓塚、大丈夫か、弓塚……！」
　ぜいぜいと上下する肩に手をやる。
「あ――――」
　ゾッとした。
　弓塚の体は、服の上からでも分かるぐらい冷たかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet, choking sound came from her.
Crouched on the ground, Yumizuka coughed violently and spat out a clot of blood.
“Yumizuka!?”
This time I rushed to her.
“Yumizuka—tell me you’re all right, Yumizuka…!”
I put a hand on her heaving shoulder.
“Ah—”
A chill ran through me.
Even through her clothes, her body was unmistakably cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A choking sound.
Squatting on the ground, Yumizuka coughs heavily, and she spits out a lump of blood.
"---Yumizuka!?"
This time, I do rush near her.
"Yumizuka, are you okay?
Yumizuka…!"
I put my hand on her heaving shoulder.
"Ah---"
I feel a chill.
Even through her clothes, I can feel the coldness of her body.

entries.japanese:
「ばかっ、こんなに体が冷えきってるじゃないか！
　なんでこんなんで夜出歩いてるんだよ、おまえは！」
「―――志貴、くん」
　虚ろな声で俺の名前を呼んで。
　そのまま、弓塚は倒れるように俺にしなだれかかってきた。
　はあ、はあ、と。
　熱をもった吐息が、肌にかかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You idiot! You’re frozen through—what are you doing outside at night in this condition!?”
“Shiki…”
She called my name in a hollow voice.
Then Yumizuka collapsed against me.
Hah—hah.
Her feverish breath touched my skin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stupid, you're freezing!
What are you doing out in the open on a night like this!"
"---Shiki, kun…"
Her voice is hollow as she says my name.
Yumizuka collapses against me.
As she pants, her warm breath brushes my skin.

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚？」
「志貴くんがわたしのことを好きじゃなくてもいいよ。
わたしだって、今までずっと志貴くんのことがわからなかったから」
　こふ、と吐き出すような咳をしながら、弓塚は声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumi—zuka?”
“It’s all right if you don’t like me, Shiki. I never understood you before either.”
Her voice strained past a rasping cough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka?"
"It's okay if you don't like me, Shiki-kun.
Because, I really didn't understand you at all until now, either."
Yumizuka speaks as she coughs.

entries.japanese:
「いいから、もうしゃべるな……！
　すぐに病院に連れていってやるから……！」
「でも、今なら解るよ。
志貴くんのことも、志貴くんがやりたいことも、本当によくわかるんだ。
　だって――――」
「え――――？」
「だってわたしも、志貴くんと同じになれたんだから―――！」
　言って、弓塚は俺の首にその歯をつきたてた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop talking…! I’ll take you to a hospital right now!”
“But I understand now. I understand you, and what you want, perfectly.
Because…”
“What…?”
“Because now I’m the same as you!”
With that, Yumizuka sank her teeth into my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright, don't talk…!
I'll take you to a hospital…!"
"But, I understand now.
Who you are, and what you want to do.
I really understand now.
Because---"
"Eh---?"
"Because, I became like you, Shiki-kun---!"
Saying that, Yumizuka sinks her teeth into my neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――」
　意識。
意識が、遠のく。
　首筋には弓塚の牙がえぐりこんできてる。
「―――――――」
　吸われていく。
　なにか、体中の全てのものが、液体に変えられて吸い上げられていくよう。
　力が入らなければ、何も思いつかない。
　これは、意識が遠のいているんじゃなくて。
　単純に、意識を破壊されているだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Consciousness. My consciousness receded.
Yumizuka’s fangs burrowed into my neck.
“……”
She was drinking me.
It felt as if everything inside my body were turning to liquid and being drawn upward.
With no strength, no thoughts would come.
My consciousness wasn’t fading.
It was simply being destroyed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Fading.
My consciousness is fading.
Yumizuka's fangs dig into my neck.
"-------"
I'm being drained.
As if all the life in my body is liquified and sucked out.
Without strength, there are no thoughts.
So, my consciousness is not fading.
It is simply being destroyed.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――あ」
　何も考えつかない。
　このままだと死んでしまうって解っているのに、なにも――――
　だっていうのに。
　俺の理性の与り知らないところで、どくん、と体中の血液が沸騰した。
「弓塚――――――！」
　両腕はただ反射的に、弓塚の体を突き放した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
I couldn’t think.
I knew I would die if this continued, yet nothing—
Even so.
Beyond reason’s reach, all the blood in my body suddenly boiled.
“Yumizuka!”
My arms shoved her away on reflex.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Ah."
There are no thoughts.
I know I'll die if I stay like this, but I can't even----.
All the same.
From somewhere beyond my mind, my blood begins to boil.
"Yumizuka----!"
Both my arms push her back out of pure reflex.

entries.japanese:
どすん、と地面に尻餅をつく弓塚。
「なに、を――――」
　立ちあがる。
　けど、それはできなかった。
　体中が疲れきっていて、自分の腕一本さえも満足に動かせない。
　弓塚はまるでアルコールを飲んだ後みたいに、ぼう、と座り込んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka landed hard on her backside.
“What did you…?”
I tried to stand.
But I couldn’t.
My whole body was exhausted; I could barely move a single arm.
Yumizuka sat there in a daze, as if drunk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She falls right on her behind.
"What are----"
I stand up.
But, I can't.
I'm so exhausted I can barely even lift an arm.
Yumizuka sits, as if in a drunken stupor.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　弓塚の顔が、よく見えない。
　意識が朦朧として、何もかも霞んでいる。
　体の自由もきかない。
　あるのはただ、首筋の痛みだけだ。
　血がとくとくと流れている。
　首筋に穿たれた、弓塚の歯形。
　深く食い込まれた二つの穴から、なにか、黒いモノが体の中に注ぎ込まれてきているよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
I couldn’t see her face clearly.
My mind swam, blurring everything.
My body would not obey me.
Only the pain in my neck remained.
Blood pulsed steadily from my neck.
The marks where Yumizuka’s teeth had pierced me.
Through the two deep holes, something black seemed to be pouring into my body—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
I can't see her face clearly.
Everything dims as my consciousness fades.
I can't control my body either.
All that exists is the pain in my neck.
Blood gurgles forth.
Yumizuka's teeth marks remain in my neck.
And through those two deep holes, something black is being poured into my body---

entries.japanese:
血脈の中。
　もう俺ではどうしようもできないところで、黒いモノが全身を犯していく。
　ほんの一握りに満たない黒い塊が血管を通っていくたびに、体の中が焼かれていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Inside my veins.
Beyond any place I could reach, the black substance ravaged my entire body.
Each tiny clot burned me from within as it traveled through my blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In my veins.
Somewhere beyond my reach, the black thing violates my whole body.
As a small piece of the black thing goes through my veins, my body burns inside.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――ぐ、ううううう！」
　背骨、背骨を抜き取られるような、痛み。
「は――――あ、ぐうう……！」
　ただ苦しくて、地面をひっかく。
　けれどどこにも助けなんかない。
　弓塚に体の中身を吸われて動けない上に、体の中に黒い蛇を注入されたような痛み。
　動くこともできないで、体の中を這い回る黒いモノに好き勝手犯されていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh, aaaaaagh!”
Pain—as though someone were pulling my spine out of my body.
“Hah—aghhh…!”
I clawed at the ground in agony.
But there was no help anywhere.
Yumizuka had drained me until I could no longer move, and now it felt as if she had injected a black snake into my body.
Helpless, I could only let the crawling darkness violate me from within.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---guhhhh!"
A pain, a pain as if my spine is about to be ripped out.
"Haa---arghhh!"
In pain, I claw at the ground.
But there is no relief.
I cannot move since Yumizuka has drained everything out of me, and the pain pours into me like a black snake.
I cannot move, so the black thing crawls and twists as it pleases inside me.

entries.japanese:
「はっ――――あ、あ――――」
　地面をかきむしる。
　弓塚は恍惚とした瞳のまま、俺を、見つめて、いる。
「弓……塚……、おまえ、なにを………！」
「だいじょうぶ、痛いのは最初だけだから我慢して。
初めは苦しいけど、血が混ざってくれればすぐに落ちつくよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah—”
I tore at the earth.
Yumizuka watched me through eyes glazed with ecstasy.
“Yumi—zuka—what did you do?!”
“It’s all right. It only hurts at first, so bear with it; the beginning is awful, but once our blood blends, you’ll calm down.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haa---ah, ah---"
I clutch at the ground.
With glazed eyes, Yumizuka… looks at… me.
"Yumi… zuka… what have you…!"
"It's okay, it only hurts at first.
First it hurts, but when the blood mixes, it should die down."

entries.japanese:
「安心して、志貴くんを殺すようなことはしないわ。
ちゃんとわたしの血を流し込んでおいたから、昨日の出来そこないみたいに崩れる事もないし、わたしの事だけを見てくれるようになるよ」
　弓塚は嬉しそうに囁いてくる。
「なに―――言ってる、んだ、ゆみづ、か――」
「なにって、志貴くんもわたしと同じになるっていうことだよ。
普通の食べ物のかわりに人間の血を吸って、太陽の下は歩けないから夜出歩くしかなくなる、違った生き物になるの」
　……なんだ、それ。
　ばかげてる、それじゃあまるで―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t worry, Shiki—I would never kill you. I put my blood inside you properly, so you won’t crumble like that failure yesterday and soon you’ll have eyes only for me.”
Yumizuka whispered happily.
“What are you talking about, Yumi—zuka?”
“I mean you’re going to become like me. You’ll drink human blood instead of eating ordinary food, and because you can’t walk beneath the sun, you’ll live at night as a different creature.”
What was that supposed to mean…
Absurd—that sounded just like—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't worry, I won't kill you.
I poured my blood in properly, so you won't collapse and crumble away like those failures last night.
You will only look at me from now on."
Yumizuka whispers joyfully.
"What are---you talking about… Yumizu… ka---"
"I'm saying that I'm making both of us the same, Shiki-kun.
Sucking people's blood instead of eating normal food, nocturnal, unable to walk under the sun.
You're going to be a different creature."
…… What is, that.
Ridiculous, that's just like--

entries.japanese:
「うん、吸血鬼みたいだよね。
わたしもどうして自分がこんなになっちゃったか解らなかった。
　二日前の夜、志貴くんが夜の繁華街で歩いているっていう噂を確かめにいって、気がついたら路地裏で倒れてて。
　その時はただ、暗くて、寒くて、体中が痛いって思うだけだった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, like a vampire. I didn’t understand how I had become this way either.
Two nights ago, I went downtown to see if the rumor about you wandering around at night was true, and the next thing I knew, I was lying in an alley.
All I knew then was that it was dark and cold, and every part of me hurt.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, like a vampire.
I didn't really understand how I became this way either.
Two nights ago, I went out to check the rumor that you were walking around in the shopping district every night, and then when I came to I was lying down in that back alley.
Back then, I thought it was just cold, dark, and painful."

entries.japanese:
「けど不思議なことにね、時間がたって、体が変わりきると色々なことが分かるようになってた。
　わたしの体が痛いのはすごい勢いで崩れていっているからで、太陽の光をあびるとそれが早まっちゃうとか、体の崩壊を止めるには同じ生き物の遺伝情報っていうのが必要なんだとか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But something strange happened. Once enough time passed and my body finished changing, I began to understand all sorts of things.
I knew my body hurt because it was collapsing incredibly fast, that sunlight would make it happen faster, and that I needed genetic information from the same kind of creature to stop it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But it's strange, after a while, after my body has changed completely, I understood a lot of things.
My body hurts because it's being destroyed very fast, and the sunlight acts like a catalyst for that.
And if I want to stop the destruction, I need the genetic information of the same type of living organism as myself."

entries.japanese:
「うん、理屈はよく解らなかったけど、とにかく何をしなくちゃいけないかは簡単だったんだよ。
　わたしは寒かったし、一人で寂しかった。
あのまま消えちゃうのなんてイヤだったから、とりあえず適当な人の血を吸ったんだ。
　そうしたらね、それがすごく美味しいの！
　体のの痛みも薄れて、もうなんだって出来る気がしたんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I didn’t understand the theory, but what I had to do was simple.
I was cold and lonely. I didn’t want to disappear, so I drank the blood of the first person I found.
And it was delicious! The pain faded, and I felt as though I could do anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I didn't understand the logic that well, but it was plain enough what I had to do.
I was cold, and it was lonely by myself.
I didn't want to disappear, so I just grabbed a random person and sucked his blood.
And you know what?
It was really delicious!
The pain went away and I thought I could do anything."

entries.japanese:
「けど、あんまりにも美味しかったから、気がついたらその人の血を残らず吸っちゃてた。
　その人ね、干からびてミイラみたいになっちゃて、すごく後悔したわ。
わたし、体だけじゃなくて心まで怪物みたいになっちゃったのかなって。
　―――でも、生きていくためにはそうしないといけなかった。
　言ったでしょ、わたしは憎くて人を殺してるんじゃないわ。
わたしが人から血を吸うのは志貴くんたちが他の動物を食べてるのと同じ理由よ。
だから、人を殺すっていう事をあんまり深く考えないようにしたんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It tasted so good that before I knew it, I had drunk every drop.
The person dried up like a mummy, and I regretted it terribly. I wondered if my heart had become monstrous along with my body.
―――But I had to do it to survive.
I told you—I don’t kill people because I hate them. I drink human blood for the same reason you eat other animals. So I decided not to think too deeply about killing people.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it was so nice that before I realized it, it was all gone.
The man was all shriveled up, like a mummy, and I felt really bad.
I thought to myself that I was turning into a monster, both in mind and body.
---But, I had to do it in order to live.
Like I said, I didn't kill them because I hated them.
I suck blood the same way you people eat animals.
So I decided not to think about it too deeply."

entries.japanese:
「ば―――――」
　なんだ、それは。
　生きるために必要だから人間を殺してもいいっていうのか。
　そんなこと、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“You—”
What was she saying?
That needing to kill humans to survive made it acceptable?
I could never—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---"
What… is this?
Is it okay to kill other people in order to live?
That… I…

entries.japanese:
「でもね、これでわたしも一人前の吸血鬼になれたみたい。
　今夜の食事はわりと楽しかった。
今まではただ寒くて痛いから血を吸っていたけど、段々とコツがわかってきて面白くなってきたんだ。
　志貴くんならわかるでしょう？
　あなたはわたしなんかより、もっと上質な人殺しなんだもん」
「な――――」
　なに、を。
　なにを言っているんだ、弓塚、は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But now I think I’ve finally become a proper vampire.
Tonight’s meal was rather fun. Until now I only drank because I was cold and hurting, but I’m learning how it works, and it’s becoming interesting.
You understand, don’t you, Shiki? You’re a much finer killer than I am.”
“What…?”
What was she saying?
What was Yumizuka saying?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it seems I've become a proper vampire.
Tonight's meal was quite fun.
Until now, I've been sucking blood since I was cold and in pain, but now that I'm getting the hang of sucking blood, it's becoming more interesting.
You understand, don't you Shiki-kun?
You are a much better killer than I am."
"Wha---"
What…
What are you talking about, Yumizuka.

entries.japanese:
「わたしはずっとあなたを見てきた。
だからあなたの優しいところも、恐いところもちゃんと分かってた。
　わたしがあなたに話しかけられなかったのはね、志貴くんの恐いところがなんなのか解らなかったからなんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve always watched you. I knew the gentle parts of you and the frightening parts too.
I could never speak to you because I didn’t understand what made you frightening.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I was always watching you.
So, I know your gentle side and your scary side.
I never talked to you because I didn't understand your scary side."

entries.japanese:
「でも今なら解る。
あなたはわたしと同じだもん。
　憎いとか好きだとかいう感情とは関係なく、誰かを殺したいって思うんでしょう？」
「ふざ―――ける、な」
　そんなこと、俺は今まで一度だって思ったことはない。
「ふざけてなんかないっ！
　わたし、志貴くんがもってる脆い空気がなんなのか解らなかった。
けど、こんな体になって理解できたんだよ。
　志貴くんはね、ただそこにいるだけで死を連想させる。
　世の中には稀に生まれついての殺人鬼がいるけど、その中でもあなたは生粋の殺人鬼だわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I understand now. You’re just like me.
You want to kill people without any need to love or hate them, don’t you?”
“Don’t be ridiculous.”
I had never felt that way, not even once.
“I’m not being ridiculous! I never understood that fragile air around you. Once I became like this, I finally did.
Simply standing there, you make people think of death.
There are rare people born as killers, but even among them, you are a killer in the purest sense.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I understand now.
You're the same as me.
It doesn't matter if you like or hate people.
You could kill anyone, right?"
"Don't--be ridiculous."
I've never even once had that thought.
"I'm not being ridiculous!
I never understood the fragile air about you, but now my body has changed, and I can understand.
Shiki-kun, just you being there is flirting with death.
There are natural-born killers in this world, but even among them, you are the best."

entries.japanese:
「わたしね、昨日は嬉しかった。
こんな体になって、初めてよかったなって思えた。
　だって今まで解らなかった志貴くんを、ようやく理解できたんだもの。
　ね、志貴くんだって同じでしょう？
　誰かを見て、理由もなく心臓がどくんどくんって高鳴って、喉がカラカラに渇いたりするでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yesterday made me happy. For the first time, I was glad this had happened to me.
At last I understood the Shiki who had always been a mystery.
You feel it too, don’t you? You look at someone, and for no reason your heart starts pounding and your throat goes dry.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, I was really happy yesterday.
It was the first time I was happy after becoming this way.
Because I finally understood you, Shiki-kun.
I never really knew you before.
Shiki-kun, you're the same, right?
You see someone, and for no reason, your heart throbs, and your throat goes dry."

entries.japanese:
「うそ――だ、そんなコト―――一度、だって」
「―――――」
　一度、だって………ないとは、言え、ない。
「ほら。
それが感情に左右されない、純粋な殺人衝動だよ。
わたしが理解したくてずっと理解できなかった志貴くんの脆いところ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s—a lie—I’ve never—”
“…”
I couldn’t say that. I couldn’t say it had never happened.
“See? That is a pure murderous impulse, untouched by emotion—the fragile place in you I spent so long trying and failing to understand.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's--a lie, that feeling----I've never."
"-----"
I can't say… I never had it.
"See?
A pure homicidal impulse, without the influence of emotion.
Your fragile side, which I always wanted to understand."

entries.japanese:
「それともう一つ言い忘れてた。
吸血鬼はね、血を吸った人間を吸血鬼にするっていうでしょ？
　あれはね、ほんとのことなんだよ。
　正確にいうとね、血を吸っただけじゃその人間は死んじゃうだけなんだ。
吸血鬼は血を吸う時にね、自分の血を相手の体に流し込むことで吸血鬼の分身にしてしまうの。
　さっきまで志貴くんの体の中にあったのはね、わたしの血液」
　立ちあがって、満足そうに、弓塚は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There’s one more thing I forgot to tell you. People say vampires turn those they drink from into vampires. That part is true.
To be precise, drinking someone’s blood alone only kills them. A vampire makes the victim into an extension of itself by pouring its own blood into the victim while it feeds.
What was inside your body just now was my blood.”
Yumizuka rose and spoke with satisfaction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I forgot to say one more thing.
A vampire is someone whose blood has been sucked by a vampire, right?
That's true, you know.
To be precise, the person whose blood has just been sucked dies.
Vampires pour their own blood into their victim as they drink to turn them into their own.
So what was in your blood back then was my blood."
Standing up, Yumizuka says this with satisfaction.

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
コレ、弓塚さんの、血、なん、だ」
　……未だ体の中で毒を放ち続ける、黒いモノ。
　こんな一口分にも満たない量で、狂いそうな寸前まで苦しいなんて、信じられない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see… so this is your blood.”
The black substance still released its poison inside me.
I could hardly believe that less than a mouthful could bring me so close to madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So, this is… your… blood, huh?"
The black thing that still defiles my body.
It's not even a mouthful, but it still causes unbelievable pain, enough to drive me to madness.

entries.japanese:
「さあ、もういいころだよね。
立って、志貴くん」
　……弓塚の命令が聞こえる。
　痛みが薄れる。
　手足の自由が戻って、俺はようやく立ちあがれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That should be long enough. Stand up, Shiki.”
I heard Yumizuka’s command.
The pain receded.
Freedom returned to my limbs, and at last I stood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I guess that's long enough.
Stand up, Shiki-kun."
I hear Yumizuka's command.
The pain fades.
Feeling returns to my limbs, and I can finally stand up.

entries.japanese:
「―――よかった。
これでずっと一緒だね、志貴くん」
「………………」
「さあ、こっちに来て。
わたしの傍にきて、わたしの手を握って、わたしを安心させて」
　手を差し伸べてくる。
――――どくん。
　心臓が一際高く鳴って、足が勝手に動き出す。
　ただし、前ではなく後ろに動いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good. Now we can be together forever, Shiki.”
“……”
“Come here. Stand beside me, take my hand, and put me at ease.”
She held out her hand.
――――Thump.
My heart struck one deafening beat, and my feet moved on their own.
But not toward her—back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Good.
From now on, we'll always be together, Shiki-kun."
"……"
"Now, come here.
Come by my side, hold my hand, and make me feel better."
She holds out her hand.
----Thump.
My heart pounds, and my legs begin to move.
But they don't move forward.
They move backward.

entries.japanese:
「志貴……くん？」
　困惑する弓塚の声。
――――どくん。
　心臓が高鳴る。
　喉がはあはあと渇いていく。
　神経という神経が、目の前のモノを敵と認識していってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…?”
Yumizuka’s voice was bewildered.
――――Thump.
My heart raced.
My throat dried with every ragged breath.
Every nerve in my body began to recognize the thing before me as an enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki…… kun?"
Yumizuka's voice is perplexed.
----Thump.
My heart throbs.
My throat becomes dry.
Every nerve in my body recognizes the person in front of me as an enemy.

entries.japanese:
「はあ……はあ……はあ」
　その感情。
　体の中でいまだ融けずに残っている弓塚の血の毒と、体中から沸きあがってくる衝動を、必死に堪えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah.”
That feeling.
I fought desperately against the poison of Yumizuka’s blood still undissolved inside me and the impulse boiling up from every part of my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I start to breathe harder.
This feeling.
Desperately, I endure the poison of Yumizuka's blood and the boiling impulse arising in my body.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたの……？
　ねえ、どうしてわたしの言うことをきいてくれないの……？」
　どくん、と心臓が脈打つ。
　それはついさっき弓塚本人が言っていた衝動というヤツなのか。
　どくん、どくんと脈打つ鼓動は。
　ころせ、ころせ、と自分自身に命令するように、繰り返されている。
「志貴くん、あなた―――」
「正気に戻るんだ、弓塚」
　はあはあと苦しい呼吸のまま、弓塚を見据える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong…? Why won’t you do what I say…?”
My heart thudded.
Was this the impulse Yumizuka herself had described?
Each repeated beat seemed to command me: Kill her.
Kill her.
“Shiki, you—”
“Come back to your senses, Yumizuka.”
Still breathing painfully, I held her gaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…?
Hey, why aren't you doing what I tell you to do…?"
Thump.
My heart beats.
Is this the impulse Yumizuka was talking about just a while ago?
Thump, Thump.
My heart beats loudly,
as if it was repeatedly ordering me to kill… to kill.
"Shiki-kun, you---"
"Think straight, Yumizuka."
Yumizuka looks at me as I breathe painfully.

entries.japanese:
「どうして―――！？
　どうしてわたしの血が効かないの……！？」
「……さあ。
わからないけど、ほんの少しだけ、体の中に、泥が入っているような気がする」
　それが弓塚の、吸血鬼の血。
　こんな――たった一口分ぐらいの水だけの量で、これだけ吐き気がするというのなら。
　全身がこんな血になってしまった弓塚は、どれほど苦しいのか想像もつかない。
　……痛い、と。
　弓塚が何度も繰り返して言っている言葉の意味が、ようやく理解できた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why!? Why doesn’t my blood work on you…!?”
“I don’t know. It only feels as though there’s a little mud inside me.”
That was Yumizuka’s vampire blood.
If no more than a mouthful made me this sick.
I could not imagine the torment of Yumizuka’s entire body becoming blood like this.
It hurts…
At last I understood what she had meant by the words she kept repeating.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why---!?
Why didn't my blood work…!?"
"…… I don't know, but it does feel like there's some mud in my body."
That should be Yumizuka's vampire blood.
If a mouthful of it could make me feel this sick,
I can't even imagine what pain it must be for Yumizuka, whose body is filled with it.
…… It hurts, she said.
At last, I understand what she meant.

entries.japanese:
「……やめよう、弓塚さん。
こんなことしても何もならない。
弓塚さんは、病気なんだ。
だから早く病院にいって、元の体に戻らないと」
　……自分のことを好きだといってくれた子を、これ以上苦しめたくない。
　だっていうのに、彼女は憎しみのこもった目で俺を睨んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let’s stop, Yumizuka. None of this will help. You’re sick. We need to get you to a hospital and turn you back.”
I didn’t want the girl who had said she loved me to suffer anymore.
Yet she glared at me with naked hatred.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Let's stop, Yumizuka-san.
It doesn't help you to do this.
You're sick.
We have to get you to a hospital, and return your body to the way it was."
…… I don't want the girl who cares for me to be suffering anymore.
But she glares at me with eyes filled with hate.

entries.japanese:
「―――わたしの血は確かに志貴くんの血に混ざってる。
それなら、あなたはもうわたしの体の一部のはずなのに……！
　まさか、わたしより前に誰かの支配を受けてたの……！？」
「……だから、俺にはてんでわからないんだ、弓塚。
　俺にわかるのは、ただ―――暗くて寒くて独りきりだって、辛そうに言ったきみの姿だけだ。
　二日前の帰り道、笑顔でピンチの時は助けてほしいって言ってた笑顔が、思い出されるだけなんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My blood is definitely mixed with yours. You should be part of my body now…! Unless someone had already taken control of you before me?”
“…I don’t understand any of this, Yumizuka.
All I understand is how miserable you looked when you said you were alone in the dark and the cold.
All I can remember is your smile on the way home two days ago, when you asked me to save you if you were ever in trouble.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---My blood is definitely mixed with your blood!
So you should already be part of my body…!
Could it be, someone else has control over you already…!?"
"Like I said, I don't understand, Yumizuka.
All I understand is---you saying that it's dark, cold, and lonely.
All I remember is your smiling face two days ago, telling me to help you whenever you're in a pinch."

entries.japanese:
……吸血鬼というものがどのようなものなのか、正直よくわからない。
　それでも、生きるために人間を殺して血を吸って、それでも痛くて痛くて泣いてしまいそうだというのなら、なんとかして元に戻してあげなくっちゃ、ダメだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I honestly knew almost nothing about vampires.
But if she had to kill humans and drink their blood to survive, and still hurt so badly she could almost cry, then I had to find some way to turn her back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… To be honest, I don't know what kind of creature a vampire is.
But you have to kill and suck blood to live, and if you're still in pain, then I have to try to get you back the way you were.

entries.japanese:
「……弓塚。
きみは、苦しいって言ってた」
「そうだよ。
わたし、こうしている時も苦しいんだ。
まだ血管が人間の時のままだから、血が流れるだけで苦しいの。
細くて弱くて、すぐに破裂しちゃう。
　でもね、もっと多くの人たちの血を吸っていけば、すぐに血管も丈夫になるから平気だよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka. You said you were suffering.”
“I am. Even standing here hurts. My blood vessels are still human, so the blood hurts whenever it flows through them. They’re narrow and frail and burst so easily.
But once I drink from enough people, they’ll become stronger and I’ll be fine.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yumizuka.
You said it hurts."
"Yeah.
It still hurts even now.
My blood vessels are still the same as they were when I was human, so just the flow of blood hurts.
Delicate and weak, as they burst easily.
But if I drink a lot more human blood, my blood vessels will be just fine."

entries.japanese:
「……痛いって、言ってた」
「ええ、ココロが痛いわ。
生きるためとはいえ、みんなの血を奪わなくちゃいけないんだもん。
罪の意識とかじゃなくて、純粋にね、今までわたしだったわたしが薄れていくのが痛くて恐いんだ。
けど、それも独りじゃなくなれば恐くなくなるよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You said it hurt.”
“Yes, my heart hurts. Even to stay alive, I have to take everyone’s blood. It isn’t guilt; what hurts and frightens me is feeling the person I used to be grow fainter. But once I’m no longer alone, I won’t be afraid.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You said, it's painful."
"Yes.
My heart is in pain.
I have to take people's blood in order to live.
I don't feel like it's a crime but it hurts.
I'm painfully afraid that the person I was is going to disappear.
But, I wouldn't be so scared if I'm not alone."

entries.japanese:
「……寒いって、言ってた」
「うん。
寒くて寒くて、指先が壊死してしまいそう。
けど、それは別に辛くはないよ。
ただ暖かいって感じなくなっただけだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You said you were cold.”
“Yes. So cold it feels as though my fingertips might die. But that isn’t painful. I simply can’t feel warmth anymore.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You said, it's cold."
"Yeah.
I'm so cold, I feel like my fingers will freeze off.
But I don't think it's bad.
I just can't feel warmth anymore."

entries.japanese:
「必死に―――助けてって、言ってた」
「助けてはほしいけど、もうダメだよ。
わたしはもとのさつきには戻れっこないんだから」
　弓塚はあの時とまったく同じ笑顔で告げる。
「どうして―――どうして、こんな、ことに」
「そんなの、わたしのほうこそ聞きたいわ。
気がついたらこんな体になってて、人の血を飲まないと生けていけなくなってたんだよ？
　目が覚めたら死んでたほうがずっとずっと楽だったのに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You begged me—desperately—to save you.”
“I want you to, but it’s too late. I can never become the old Satsuki again.”
Yumizuka said it with exactly the same smile she had worn then.
“Why—why did this have to happen?”
“I should be asking you. Before I knew it, I was trapped in this body, unable to survive without drinking human blood. It would have been so much easier if I’d simply woken up dead.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You asked for help, desperately."
"I want help, but it's already too late.
I can't go back to who I used to be."
Yumizuka says, smiling just as she did back then.
"Why---why did you end up that way…"
"Why?
That's what I want to know.
When I woke up, I had this body and just had this thirst for human blood I needed to fulfill.
It would have been so much easier if I just died instead."

entries.japanese:
「でも、こうなったからには仕方がないよね。
みんなが当然のように他の動物を食べるように、わたしもみんなを食べるしかないんだもん」
「なっ―――なんだよそれ………！
　そんなのはどうかしてる……！
　そんなの―――どうして、弓塚が、そんな事に―――」
　認められなくて、ただ声をあげた。
「――――――――――」
　弓塚は無言で、ふるふると首をふる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But now that I’m like this, there’s nothing I can do. Everyone eats other animals as if it were only natural, so I have no choice but to eat all of you.”
“W-what the hell is that…?! That’s insane…! Why—why did this have to happen to you, Yumizuka—”
I couldn’t accept it; I could only cry out.
“――――――――――”
Without a word, Yumizuka slowly shook her head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I guess it can't be helped.
Like people eat animals to live, I have to eat people too."
"Wha---what is that…!
What are you talking about…!
Why are you saying such things, Yumizuka---"
Unable to accept the facts, I just shout.
"---"
Yumizuka is silent, and only shakes her head.

entries.japanese:
「どうして……！
　昔みたいに、普通に笑って、普通に歩いて、普通に話したりする事が、もうできないっていうのか。
たった―――たった二日前の話なのに……！」
「……そうだよね。
たった二日前まで、わたしも志貴くん側の生き物だったなんて、夢みたい。
失ってみて初めてわかった。
―――うん、ホントに夢みたいな時間だったなあ。
もし戻れるのなら、わたしはどんな代償を払っても戻りたい」
「なら―――」
「でも無理だよ。
わたしは元に戻れない。
ずっと、この寒くて痛くて、独りっきりのままで生きていくしかない」
　弓塚はうつむく。
　がくがくと震えていく、冷たい体。

「―――助けて、志貴くん」
　喉から搾り出すような、小さな声。

「恐いの。
すごく寒くて、どこにいってもわたしは独りきりで、すごく不安なの。
お願いだから、わたしを助けて」
　……わかってる。
　二日前の帰り道にした、なんでもない約束を、覚えている。
「―――ああ。
俺に出来る事なら、何でもするよ」
　……本当に。
　それで、きみがもとの弓塚さつきに戻れるっていうのなら、俺は何だってしてみせる。
　けれど。
　彼女の返答は、俺のそれとは、大きく違っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…? Are you saying you can never smile normally again, or walk and talk like an ordinary person? It was only two days ago…!”
“You’re right. It feels like a dream that only two days ago, I was still a creature on your side. I never understood what I had until I lost it. Yes, it truly was a dream. If I could go back, I would pay any price.”
“Then—”
“But I can’t. I can never go back. I have to live forever in this cold and pain, all alone.”
Yumizuka lowered her head.
Her cold body trembled violently.
“―――Save me, Shiki.”
The tiny plea was wrung from her throat.
“I’m scared. I’m so cold, and wherever I go, I’m all alone and helpless. Please, save me.”
I understood.
I remembered the idle promise we had made on the way home two days ago.
“Yes. I’ll do anything I can.”
I meant it.
If that would restore the Satsuki Yumizuka she once was, I would do anything.
And yet…
Her answer was nothing like mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…!
Are you saying you can't laugh and walk and talk normally again like before?
It… it was only two days ago…!"
"…… That's right.
Just two days ago, I was a creature on your side.
It was like a dream.
I understand now that I've lost it.
---Yes, it was really like a dream.
I would give anything to go back."
"Then---"
"But it's impossible.
I can't go back.
I have to live on like this.
Cold, painful, alone."
Yumizuka looks down.
Her cold body trembles.

"---Help me, Shiki-kun."
A faint voice escapes her throat.

"I'm scared.
It's really cold, and I'm alone no matter where I go.
So please, help me."
…… I understand.
I remember the trifling promise I made on the way home from school two days ago.
"---Yeah.
I'll do whatever I can."
…… Really.
To change you back into the old Yumizuka Satsuki, I'll do anything.
But…
Her answer is very different than mine.

entries.japanese:
「……あは。
志貴くんったら、この後におよんでまだわたしを元に戻したいって思ってるんだ。
　……ほんと、うっとりするほど優しいんだね。
人殺しが大好きなクセに、それ以外ではすごく優しいなんて、すごい矛盾」
　クス、と楽しそうに笑う弓塚。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahaha. Even now, you still want to turn me back.
You really are kind enough to make me swoon. You love killing people, yet you’re incredibly gentle about everything else—a remarkable contradiction.”
Yumizuka laughed in delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ahaha.
Oh, Shiki-kun, you're still thinking about turning me back?
…… Honestly, you're so kind.
It's a great contradiction for someone who loves to kill to be so gentle about everything else."
Yumizuka chuckles happily.

entries.japanese:
「無理だって言ってるのに。
志貴くんのやり方じゃ、わたしを助けるなんて事はできないよ」
「なっ―――じゃあ、じゃあどうすればいいんだ……！
　俺は何もできない。
弓塚を助けたくても助けてやれなくて、どうしていいか解らない――！」
「そんなことないよ。
志貴くんならわたしを助けてくれるもん」
　言って、弓塚は歩いてくる。
―――どくん、と。
　背筋が、危機感で凍った気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I keep telling you it’s impossible. Your way can’t save me.”
“Then what am I supposed to do? I can’t do anything! I want to save you, but I can’t, and I don’t know what to do!”
“That isn’t true. You can save me, Shiki.”
With that, Yumizuka began walking toward me.
―――Thump.
A sense of mortal danger froze my spine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I told you, it's impossible.
You can't help me like that, Shiki-kun."
"Wha---then, then what should I do…!
There's nothing else I can do.
I want to help you, there's nothing I can do…!"
"That's not true.
There is something you can do to help me, Shiki-kun."
Saying so, Yumizuka steps forward.
---Thump.
A chill runs through my back, sensing the danger.

entries.japanese:
「――俺が弓塚を助けられるって、どうやって」
「簡単だよ。
志貴くんが、わたしの仲間になってくれればいいんだから……！！」
「っ――――！」
　赤い眼光に見据えられて、息ができなくなった。
―――まずい。
　はっきりとそう分かるのに、両足はまったく動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How am I supposed to save you?”
“It’s simple. You only have to become one of us…!”
“…!”
Her crimson gaze pinned me, stealing my breath.
―――Danger.
I knew it with perfect clarity, yet my legs refused to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--How can I help you, Yumizuka?"
"It's easy.
You just have to become my friend…!!"
"Ch---!"
Red, piercing eyes stare at me, and I can't breathe.
---This is bad.
I realize it, but my legs are not moving.

entries.japanese:
「仲間って、なにを―――」
「そうすればわたしは独りじゃなくなって、寒い思いも恐い思いもしなくなるわ。
　ううん、志貴くんさえわたしのモノになってくれれば、人間だった時よりわたしはずっとずっと幸せになれるんだから―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you mean, join you—”
“Then I won’t be alone, and I won’t have to be cold or afraid.
No—if you become mine, Shiki, I’ll be happier than I ever was as a human!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Friend, wha---"
"Then I won't be alone, and I won't be cold or scared.
No, if you will be mine, I'll be much happier than I ever was as a human---!"

entries.japanese:
―――ドクン。
　心臓が一段高く鳴動する。
　弓塚はまっすぐに、迷いなく俺の首を掴まえようと腕を伸ばしてくる。
　その速度は、それこそ弾丸のようだ。
　なのにそれがはっきりと見えている―――ような錯覚がして、咄嗟に地面にしゃがみこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――THUMP.
My heart gave a louder thump.
Without the slightest hesitation, Yumizuka shot an arm toward my throat.
She moved like a bullet.
Yet I had the illusion that I could see her clearly, and I dropped to the ground on instinct.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---THUMP.
My heart beats even faster.
Yumizuka reaches out with her arm, straight for my neck.
Her speed is like a bullet.
But somehow, I see it perfectly---or I felt like I saw it perfectly and I drop to the ground.

entries.japanese:
「――――ぐっ………！」
　必死に首をひねって地面にしゃがみこむ。
　ゴウン、と。
　風切り音をともなって、弓塚の腕が頭の上を通りすぎていく。
「は―――――あ」
「―――――うそ」
　襲ったモノと、躱した者。
　俺たちはお互いを驚愕の瞳で見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
Desperate, I twisted my neck aside and dropped into a crouch.
A roar filled the air.
Yumizuka’s arm swept over my head with the sound of displaced wind.
“Hah.”
“No way.”
The thing that attacked and the one who evaded it.
We stared at each other, eyes wide with shock.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Guh…!"
I twist my head desperately, and throw myself to the ground.
With a whoosh,
Yumizuka's arms pass over my head.
"Haa----ah."
"---Can't be."
The target and the attacker.
We gaze at each other in amazement.

entries.japanese:
「弓塚、おまえ―――」
「志貴――――くん？」
　呆然と弓塚が俺を見下ろしてくる。
　俺は―――逃げなくっちゃって分かっているのに、全身が固まったままだった。
　どくん。
　心音は、鐘のように。
　片手は麻痺している俺の理性とは関係なく、ポケットの中のモノを掴んでいく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka, you…”
“Shiki…?”
Yumizuka gazed down at me in a daze.
I knew I had to run, yet my entire body remained frozen.
Thump.
My heartbeat rang like a bell.
While my reason lay paralyzed, one hand closed around the object in my pocket.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka, you---"
"Shiki-----kun?"
Yumizuka looks down at me, aghast.
I---I know I have to run away, but my body is still frozen.
Thump.
My heart rings like a bell.
My hand grabs the thing in my pocket, in spite of my paralyzed mind.

entries.japanese:
弓塚は動かない。
　ただその目だけが、驚きから喜びへと変化していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka did not move.
Only her eyes changed, surprise giving way to delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yumizuka doesn't move.
Only her eyes change, from surprise to delight.

entries.japanese:
「……そうなんだ。
志貴くんを手に入れるのは簡単に済むと思ってたけど、これなら―――」
　どくん。
「――今夜は、わりと楽しめそうだよね、志貴くん？」
　血に飢えた赤い眼光。
　容赦なく伸びてくる、獣のような腕。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. I thought getting hold of you would be easy, but if this is what you’re like—”
Thump.
