“Tonight might actually be fun, don’t you think, Shiki?”
Her crimson eyes starved for blood.
Her arm reached for me without mercy, bestial and inhuman.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I get it.
I thought it would be simple to get you into my possession, but---"
Thump.
"Tonight will be quite entertaining, won't it, Tohno-kun?"
Her red, piercing eyes are hungry for blood.
Her arms extend brutishly, mercilessly.

entries.japanese:
全身の毛が逆立つ。
　このまま引き裂かれてしまう前に。
　俺の手は独りでにポケットのナイフを取り出していた。
　どくん。
「―――――え？」
　自分の声より、自分の腕の動きのほうが早い。
　ナイフはざとりと音をたてて、弓塚のむき出しの太ももを縦に削り取った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Every hair on my body stood on end.
I had to act before she tore me apart.
My hand drew the knife from my pocket of its own accord.
Thump.
“What?”
My arm moved faster than my voice.
With a wet rasp, the knife peeled a strip lengthwise from Yumizuka’s bare thigh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Every hair on my body stands on end.
Before I'm torn apart,
my hand takes the knife out from my pocket.
Thump.
"-----Eh?"
The movement of my arm is faster than my voice.
With a swish, the knife slices through Yumizuka's thigh.

entries.japanese:
「きゃあああああああ！」
　甲高い弓塚の悲鳴。
―――呆然と自分の腕を見る。
　そこには、たった今彼女の片足を裂いた、血に染まったナイフがある。
「……………あ」
　正気が戻る。
　体が動く。
―――気がつけば。
　俺は震えながら、弓塚から逃げ出していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaaaaah!”
Yumizuka’s shrill scream split the night.
―――Dumbfounded, I stared at my arm.
In my hand was the blood-soaked knife that had just torn open her leg.
“Ah…”
My reason returned.
My body moved.
―――By the time I realized it.
I was fleeing from Yumizuka, trembling all over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kyaaaa!"
Yumizuka screams shrilly.
---I look in shock at my arm.
There is the bloody knife that sliced open her leg.
"…………… Ah."
My senses return.
My body moves.
---Before I realize it,
I am fleeing from Yumizuka as I tremble.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ―――！」
　ただ走った。
「なん、で―――なんで、俺は―――」
　わからない。
　どうして弓塚を刺してしまったのか、自分のことだっていうのにまったく理解できない。
　どくん、と心臓が高鳴って。
　気がつけば、ナイフで弓塚の足を裂いていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah…!”
I ran blindly.
“Why—why did I—?”
I didn’t understand.
Though it was my own act, I could not comprehend why I had stabbed her.
My heart had given one violent thud.
The next thing I knew, my knife had ripped open her leg.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I breathe wildly.
I just run.
"Why---why did I---"
I don't know.
I don't understand why or how I stabbed her.
Thump.
My heart rings out.
And before I knew it, I had sliced her leg with my knife.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ―――！」
　ただ、ナイフには弓塚の血がこびりついて。
　この腕には、弓塚の肉を裂いた感触が残っている。
「なんで―――――」
　本当に、なんでこんな事になったんだろう。
　俺はただ―――弓塚さつきを、助けようと思っただけなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah…!”
Yumizuka’s blood clung to the blade.
My arm still remembered the sensation of opening her flesh.
“Why…?”
How had any of this happened?
All I had wanted was to save Satsuki Yumizuka.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*---!
Yumizuka's blood flows over the knife.
The feeling of tearing flesh remains in my arm.
"Why---"
Really, why did I do such a thing?
I only---I only wanted to help Yumizuka Satsuki.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ―――」
　なのに、弓塚の顔を思い出すと心臓がどくん、とはねあがる。
　恐怖と興奮。
　弓塚は俺を殺そうとしている。
　心臓はドクドクとその危険に呼応している。
　俺では。
遠野志貴では、あの生き物には太刀打ちできない。
　例えるのなら果実と人間だ。
食べられる側のモノが、食べる側にどうやって逆らえっていうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—”
Yet the moment I pictured her face, my heart leapt.
Terror and excitement.
Yumizuka was trying to kill me.
My heart answered the danger with a savage pounding.
I could not win. Shiki Tohno could never stand against that creature.
It was like a piece of fruit facing a human. How could something meant to be eaten resist its devourer?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Guh---"
Somehow, remembering her face makes my heart beat louder.
Fear and excitement.
Yumizuka is trying to kill me.
My heart pounds in response to the danger.
I, Tohno Shiki, cannot compete with that creature.
It's like apples and humans.
How can the ones getting eaten oppose that which eats them?

entries.japanese:
アレは、すでにそういったモノ。
　遠野志貴がトマトを口にするのに何の苦労もしないように、弓塚さつきにとって俺はトマトとなんら変わらない。
　遭えば。
　捕まってしまえば、あとは当然のように殺されるだけ。
　だから逃げている。
　逃げて、自分がまだ生きているんだと、吐きそうなぐらい実感していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
That was what she had already become.
Just as Shiki Tohno could eat a tomato without effort, to Satsuki Yumizuka I was no different from a tomato.
If she found me, there was no escape.
If she caught me, she would kill me as a matter of course.
That was why I ran.
I ran, and felt the fact that I was still alive so violently it made me sick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's already like that.
Just as Tohno Shiki eats a tomato with no opposition… for Yumizuka Satsuki, I am no different from a tomato.
If she finds me…
If she catches me, she'll kill me.
So, I am running away.
I run, and feel that I'm still alive.

entries.japanese:
ただ、夜を走る。
　とにかく今は走っている。
――――――何のために？
　そんなのは決まっている。
　そうしなければ捕まってしまう。
　弓塚さつきが、自分を追いかけてきている気配を感じている。
　さっきまでは針の先ほどの気配が、あっというまに背中全部をのっぺりと覆うほどに大きくなってきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I ran through the night.
For now, running was all there was.
――――――Why?
The answer was obvious.
If I stopped, she would catch me.
I could feel Satsuki Yumizuka pursuing me.
A moment ago her presence had been no larger than the point of a needle; now it spread across my entire back, broad and featureless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I run through the night.
For now, I just run.
------For what?
That's clear.
Because if I don't I'll be caught.
I feel the presence of Yumizuka Satsuki behind me.
The presence, which felt like a needle before, gets larger and looms menacingly behind me.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ――――！」
　逃げるために走ってる。
　けど、誰から逃げようっていうんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah…!”
I was running to escape.
But who was I trying to escape from?
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*----!
I run to escape.
But who am I running from?

entries.japanese:
……あれは、きれいな笑顔だった。
　中学時代の思い出話を語った弓塚さつきの笑顔は、本当に、優しかった。
「く………そ………！」
　こんなコトって、こんなコトってあるか……！
　弓塚は人を殺して、人の血を吸う化け物になってしまっ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Her smile had been beautiful.
When Satsuki Yumizuka spoke about our middle-school days, her smile had been genuinely kind.
“Damn it…!”
How could anything like this happen?!
Yumizuka had become a monster that murdered people and drank their blood—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It was a beautiful smile.
The smiling face of Yumizuka Satsuki remembering her days at junior high school was truly gentle.
"Sh… it…!"
Such a thing, how could such a thing happen…!?
Yumizuka became a monster which kills people, and drinks their blood----

entries.japanese:
「――――！？」
　突然、背中に何かが当たって、そのまま地面に倒れこんだ。
「あ―――ぐっ―――ぅぅ………！！」
　走ったまま転んだものだから、体中が擦り傷だらけになる。
　だが、今はそれ以上に背中が痛い。
　背中に受けた鈍器のような衝撃で、満足に呼吸ができない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…!?”
Something struck my back and hurled me to the ground.
“Ah—ghhh…!”
I had fallen at a run, scraping my whole body raw.
But the pain in my back was worse.
The impact had been like a blow from a club, leaving me unable to breathe properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!?"
Suddenly something hits my back, and I'm knocked to the ground.
"U---gh----uh…!!"
Since I fell over running, my body is covered with scrapes.
But my back hurts far more right now.
With the impact on my back like that from a weapon, breathing becomes impossible.

entries.japanese:
「なん―――」
　だ、といいかけて、言葉を失った。
　地面に倒れ込んだ自分の真横に。
　たった今、自分にぶつかってきたものが転がっている。
「にん……げん」
　それは、腕や足をいびつに曲げた、見知らぬ男だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
The rest of the question died in my throat.
Something lay beside me on the ground.
It was the thing that had just crashed into my back.
“A h-human.”
It was a man I had never seen, his arms and legs bent into grotesque angles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What---"
I start to say it, but the words vanish.
Something falls onto the ground next to me.
The thing that just smashed into me is rolling.
"Per… son…"
It was some guy, arms and legs twisted.

entries.japanese:
「――――――あ」
　男の体から、血が流れてくる。
　アスファルトごしに赤い血が流れてきて、こっちの体を真っ赤にそめる。
　それは。
　首のない、人間の体だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Blood flowed from the man’s body.
Red blood streamed across the asphalt.
It reached me and dyed me red.
It was a human body without a head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
Blood flows from the man's body.
Red blood flows over the asphalt, staining my body red.
It's…
a human body without a head.

entries.japanese:
「あーあ、当てるつもりはなかったんだけどなあ。
運動神経が上がったのはいいけど、狙いが正確になりすぎちゃうのってのも困りものだよね」
　背後から楽しげな声が聞こえてくる。
「あ―――」
　倒れたまま後ろを向く。
　そこには。
　生首を片手にもった、弓塚さつきが歩いてきていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh dear. I wasn’t trying to hit you.
Better reflexes are nice, but being too accurate can be inconvenient.”
A cheerful voice came from behind me.
“Ah…”
Still sprawled on the ground, I looked back.
Satsuki Yumizuka was approaching with a severed head in one hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ohh, I didn't mean to hit you.
My reflexes have improved, but I guess it's a problem if my aim is too accurate."
A delighted voice comes from behind me.
"Ah---"
Still on the ground, I look behind me.
What I see there,
is Yumizuka Satsuki walking, with a human head in one hand.

entries.japanese:
「ごめんなさい志貴くん、痛かったでしょう？
　ほんとは志貴くんが走ってく先に投げつけて、ちょっとビックリしてもらおうって思っただけなんだよ」
　弓塚はごめんねと舌を出すと、ぽい、と生首を後ろに投げ捨てた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, Shiki—did that hurt? I only meant to throw him ahead of you and give you a little fright.”
Yumizuka stuck out her tongue in apology, then tossed the head carelessly behind her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm sorry, Shiki-kun; it hurt, right?
I just tried to surprise you by throwing it ahead of you."
As she apologizes, Yumizuka tosses the severed head away.

entries.japanese:
「弓塚、今の、は―――」
「うん？
　ああ、ソレのこと？
　志貴くんを追っかけてる時にぶつかっちゃったんだ。
　なんだかんだってうるさいから、口と体を引き千切ったの。
ペロッて血も舐めてみたけど、お酒で肝臓がやられてる男の人の血ってすごくまずいんだ。
志貴くんも相手を選ぶ時は若くて健康な体にしなくちゃダメだからね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka, what was that?”
“Hm? Oh, that? I bumped into him while I was chasing you.”
“He wouldn’t stop making noise, so I tore his head from his body. I tried a lick of his blood, but men whose livers are ruined by alcohol taste awful. When you choose your victims, Shiki, make sure they’re young and healthy.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka, what was that---"
"Hm?
Oh, this?
I ran into him while I was running after you.
He was being a little noisy so I ripped off his mouth.
I tasted a little of his blood, but drunk people's blood tastes so nasty.
Shiki-kun, you should only choose young and healthy bodies too."

entries.japanese:
愉しそうにそう言って、彼女は笑顔で近づいてくる。
　そこに、あの時の笑顔の面影なんか、なかった。
　ばいばい、と。
　手をふって別れていった彼女の面影なんて、どこにもなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She said it with evident delight and drew closer with a smile.
That smile held no trace of the one I remembered.
Bye-bye.
There was no trace anywhere of the girl who had waved as we parted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Speaking pleasantly, she approaches with a smile.
It's nothing like the smile from back then.

Bye-bye, she said.
There are no similarities with the person who waved and departed back then.

entries.japanese:
「人を殺して―――なんとも思わないのか、弓塚」
「思わないよ。
話をする人間と食用の人間は別物だもん。
志貴くんだって、友達用の人間と殺し用の人間は別なんでしょ？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You killed a man and feel nothing, Yumizuka?”
“No. People you talk to and people you eat are different things. You separate people meant for friendship from people meant for killing too, don’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You---really don't think anything of killing people, Yumizuka?"
"I don't.
Talking humans and edible humans are different.
Even you make a difference between human friends and friends to be killed, right Tohno-kun?"

entries.japanese:
「そりゃあわたしだって、初めはそんなふうにわりきれなかった。
昨日の夜だって、自分自身がすごく嫌いだったんだから。
　でも、体中が痛くて、痛みを和らげるためには血を飲むしかなかった。
だからたくさんの人を殺したわ。
一人殺すたびに、カラダの痛みが和らぐかわりにココロが痛かった」
　ぴたりと立ち止まって。
　弓塚さつきは、ほんの一瞬だけ、悲しそうに目を伏せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“At first, I couldn’t separate them so neatly either. Even last night, I hated myself.
But my whole body hurt, and blood was the only way to ease it. So I killed many people. Each time I killed someone, the pain in my body faded, but the pain in my heart grew.”
She stopped dead.
For one brief moment, Satsuki Yumizuka lowered her eyes in sorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I didn't think so at first.
Last night, I really hated myself too.
But, I had to drink blood, to ease the pain.
So I killed a lot of people.
Each time I killed someone, my body stopped hurting and my heart hurt more."
She stops for just a moment.
For a moment, Yumizuka Satsuki looks down sadly.

entries.japanese:
「でも、だんだんと分かってきたんだ。
今はまだチクンって痛むけど、そのうちそれもなくなっていくはずだよ。
だって―――人を殺すっていう罪悪感より、命を奪うっていう優越感のほうが、何倍も気持ちいいんだから。
　言ったでしょ？
　すぐに志貴くんと同じになるからって。
安心して。
わたし、志貴くんみたいに人殺しが楽しめるような、立派な吸血鬼になるから」
　笑顔で弓塚は近寄ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But gradually I came to understand. It still stings a little, but soon even that will disappear. After all, the sense of superiority that comes from taking a life feels many times better than the guilt of killing.”
“I told you, didn’t I? I’ll be just like you soon. Don’t worry. I’ll become a splendid vampire who enjoys killing people as much as you do.”
Yumizuka came closer, smiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I came to understand.
Right now it will still hurt a bit, but even that will fade.
Because----beyond the guilt of killing people, the wonderful feeling of taking their lives away was many times stronger.
I told you, didn't I?
That I will be like you, Shiki-kun.
Don't worry, I'll become a splendid vampire who enjoys killing, just like you."
Yumizuka approaches with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「―――――うそ、だ」
　口にして、それさえも、嘘だと悟った。
　自分さえ騙せない不出来な嘘を、どうして口になんかするんだろう。
――――ダメだ。
　　　　彼女は、ダメだ。
　弓塚さつきはもう救えない。
　俺に残されていた理性までも、その絶望的な結論に負けて、しまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s a lie.”
The moment I said it, I knew those words were a lie too.
Why utter a lie so poor it could not deceive even me?
――――No.
She was beyond saving.
Satsuki Yumizuka could no longer be saved.
Even the last of my reason surrendered to that hopeless conclusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----That's a lie."
I say so, only to realize that even that is a lie.
It's such a poor lie that even I can't be deceived.
----It's hopeless.
She's hopeless.
Yumizuka Satsuki cannot be saved.
Even my remaining reasoning lost to that sole conclusion.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　ナイフを握り締めたまま、立ちあがった。
　どのみち彼女は俺の血を吸うつもりだ。
そうすればこの命はなくなってしまうだろうし、俺は吸血鬼の仲間入りをするつもりはない。
　なら。
　初めから、やるべき事は決まっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
Still gripping the knife, I rose.
She meant to drink my blood regardless. Then I would lose my life, and I had no intention of joining the ranks of the vampires.
Then.
What I had to do had been decided from the start.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I stand up, grasping the knife tightly.
She's going to suck my blood anyway.
I don't plan on losing my life and becoming one of those vampires.
So.
There was only one thing to do from the beginning.

entries.japanese:
「――――弓塚。
俺は、おまえを助けられない」
「そんなことないよ。
志貴くんが大人しくしてくれれば、それでわたしも志貴くんも幸せになれるんだって」
「――――――」
　違う。
その幸せは歪んでいるんだ、弓塚。
「けどな、それでも約束したから。
―――俺は別の方法で、おまえを助けてやらなくちゃ」
　言って、メガネを外した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka. I can’t save you.”
“That isn’t true. If you simply stop resisting, we can both be happy.”
“…”
No. That happiness was twisted, Yumizuka.
“But I made you a promise. So I have to save you another way.”
I took off my glasses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yumizuka, I… can't save you."
"That's not true.
If you just cooperate, we'll be happy together."
"---"
No.
That's a twisted happiness, Yumizuka.
"But.
I made a promise.
---so I have to help you in some other way."
Saying so, I take off my glasses.

entries.japanese:
ずきん、と頭痛が走る。
　、
　、
　、
　、
　、
　俺は、本当にはじめて。
　人を殺すために、この視界を受け入れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Pain lanced through my skull.
,
,
,
,
,
For the first time—truly the first time.
I accepted this sight in order to kill a human being.
entries.mirrorMoon:
An ache floods my head.
For the first time,
I accept this vision in order to kill someone.

entries.japanese:
「――――そう。
やる気なんだ、志貴くんってば。
でもだめだよ。
おいかけっこはもうおしまい」
「―――――！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…So you’re going to fight after all. But it’s too late, Shiki. Our game of chase is over.”
“…!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
Well, I'm glad you're motivated, Shiki-kun.
But it's too late.
This race is already over."
"-----!?"

entries.japanese:
「がっ――――！」
―――なに、なにが、起きたんだろ、う。
　一瞬だけ弓塚の姿が消えて、気がついたら真横に弓塚の顔が見えて―――そのまま、横腹を殴られた、のか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gah…!”
―――What—what had happened?
Yumizuka vanished for an instant; then her face was beside mine, and something struck me in the ribs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah---!"
---What, what just happened…?
In an instant, Yumizuka disappears, I see her face beside me---and at that moment, something slams into my side.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――あ、ぐ…………！」
　……背中が痛い。
　あの、なんでもない一撃で建物の壁まで吹き飛ばされた、のか。
「く――――――！」
　強くナイフを握ってなんとか立ち上がる。
「あれ、まだ動けるんだ。
志貴くんってわりと頑丈なんだね。
いつも貧血をおこしてるから、病弱なのかなって思ってた」
　弓塚の声が近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—aghh…!”
My back hurt.
Had that casual blow really sent me flying all the way into a building wall?
“Ghh—!”
I clenched the knife and somehow forced myself upright.
“Oh, you can still move. You’re sturdier than you look, Shiki. You’re always fainting from anemia, so I thought you might be sickly.”
Yumizuka’s voice drew closer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha---a, guh…!"
…… My back hurts.
Such a simple attack and I am slammed into the wall of a building?
"Kuh---!"
Grasping my knife tightly, I somehow manage to stand.
"Oh, you can still move?
You're relatively strong, aren't you, Shiki-kun?
Since you were always troubled by anemia, I thought you were weak."
Yumizuka's voice draws nearer.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ、はあ」
　呼吸―――呼吸が、荒い。
　なんてコトだろう。
　俺は、とんでもない勘違いをしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—haaah, haaah.”
My breathing—my breathing was ragged.
How could this be?
I had made a terrible mistake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*---*pant*, *pant*
Breathing---my breathing is rough.
What is this?
I have made a serious mistake.

entries.japanese:
「だめだよ、そんなナイフなんかに頼っちゃ。
志貴くんの動きなんて止まって見えるんだから、てっぽうを持っててもわたしには敵わないのにね」
　クスクスと、愉しげに笑う声。
「――――はあ――――あ」
　それが、勘違いだ。
　俺はモノの壊れやすい線が見えるけど、ただそれだけの人間なんだ。
　今の弓塚みたいに、俺の何倍も速く動く動物が相手なら、その線に触れる事さえままならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t rely on a knife like that. You move so slowly you look frozen to me, so even with a gun you couldn’t beat me.”
Her delighted laughter drifted toward me.
“Hah—ah.”
That had been my mistake.
I could see where things were fragile, but otherwise I was only human.
Against an animal many times faster than I was—like Yumizuka now—I could not even touch those lines.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's useless to expect anything from that knife.
To me, you look as if you're stopped.
Even if you had a gun, it would be useless."
Her laughing voice is full of amusement.
"---Ghaa---ah."
That's, the mistake.
I can see the lines along which things break, but I'm just a human who can see that.
If my opponent is many times faster than me, like Yumizuka, I can't even touch those lines.

entries.japanese:
「く―――」
　ようするに。
　彼女の前じゃ、こんな線が見えたとしても意味なんかないんだ。
「―――もう。
仕方ないな、少し荒っぽくするからね。
だいじょうぶ、頭と心臓だけ生きてれば、あとはなんとかできるから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…”
In other words.
The lines were worthless against her.
“Honestly, Shiki. I suppose I’ll have to be rough. Don’t worry—as long as your head and heart stay alive, I can fix everything else…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuh---"
In other words,
against her, it's useless even if I can see these lines.
"---Ohh.
Well, it can't be helped.
I'm going to be a little rough.
Don't worry, if your head and heart are intact, I can do something."

entries.japanese:
「く――――」
　ドン、という衝撃がして、目の前が真っ暗になった。
　弓塚の手が、俺の腕を握って。
　そのまま、引きずるように放り投げたらしい。
　それこそサッカーボールみたいに放り投げられて、背中から地面に落下した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—”
A thudding impact plunged the world into darkness.
Yumizuka’s hand closed around my arm.
She seemed to drag me for a moment, then hurl me away.
I flew like a soccer ball and crashed onto my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuh----"
With a crash, everything becomes black.
Yumizuka's hand grabbed my arm.
And threw me like that…
Like a soccer ball, I was thrown and I fall to the ground on my back.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――ぐ――――！」
―――見えない。
　全身が痛すぎて、何も、見えない。
「ほら、そんなところで寝てるとタイヘンだよ、志貴くん……！」
「――――！」
　とっさに横に転がる。
　さっきまで自分がいたらしい地面を、弓塚の腕が叩いたのか。
　びきっ、なんてシャレにならない亀裂音まで聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—ghh!”
―――I couldn’t see.
My whole body hurt too much to see anything.
“Careful—you’re in trouble lying there, Shiki…!”
“――――!”
I rolled aside on instinct.
Yumizuka’s arm must have struck the ground where I had been lying.
A sharp crack split the earth—nothing anyone could laugh off.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----ghh----!"
----I can't see.
My body is in such pain, I can't see anything.
"Hey now, you shouldn't be sleeping there, Shiki-kun……!"
"----!"
I roll to the side quickly.
Right where I was before, Yumizuka's arms pound the ground.
The sound of asphalt breaking apart reaches my ears.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――く………！」
　しびれている体を無理やりに動かす。
　視界はまだ真っ暗のまま。
　感じられるのは弓塚の気配だけ。
「………こ…………の」
　立ちあがって、弓塚の気配がするほうに、ナイフを構える。
「もう、無駄だって言ってるのに、どうしておとなしくしてくれないのかな、志貴くんは！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ghh…!”
I forced my numb body to move.
My sight remained utterly black.
Only Yumizuka’s presence reached me.
“You—”
I struggled upright and raised my knife toward her.
“I keep telling you it’s hopeless—why won’t you just do as you’re told, Shiki?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----kk……!"
I force my numb body to move.
My vision is still pitch-black.
All I can feel is Yumizuka's presence.
"……… You……!"
Standing up and facing her presence, I raise my knife.
"I said it was useless.
Why can't you just accept it calmly, Shiki-kun!?"

entries.japanese:
弓塚の気配が迫る。
　どくん、という自分の心音。
　なまじ目が見えないおかげなのか、今度は弓塚の腕をすり抜けられた。
「―――――うそ」
　呆然とした、弓塚の声。
　きっと、弓塚はいま背中を見せている。
　けど目が見えない俺にはどうするコトもできない。
　そこへ―――ぞわり、とよけい強くなった殺気が走ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka’s presence rushed closer.
My heart thudded.
Perhaps because I could not see, this time I slipped past her arm.
“No way…”
Yumizuka sounded stunned.
She must have had her back to me.
But blind as I was, I could do nothing.
Then an even fiercer wave of murderous intent swept over me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her presence nears.
Thump, the sound of my heartbeat.
It might be because I can't see anything, this time I easily slip through her grasp.
"------No way."
Yumizuka's surprised voice.
I know her back is facing me.
But since I can't see her, I can't do anything.
From there----a hostile, killing presence growing stronger.

entries.japanese:
「このぉ―――おとなしくしてって言ってるのに！」
　弓塚の声。
迫ってくる死。
　それに合わせて、闇雲にナイフをふるった。
「きゃあ―――！」
　びしゃり、という音。
　いま、たしかに弓塚の腕を切った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You little—hold still!”
Yumizuka’s voice. Death closed in.
I swung the knife blindly to meet it.
“Aaah!”
Something splashed.
I had definitely cut Yumizuka’s arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why you----I said, don't move!!!"
Her voice.
Impending death.
I blindly swing my knife to meet them.
"Kyaa----!"
The sound of rending flesh.
I just sliced her arm.

entries.japanese:
「しまっ―――弓塚、大丈夫か……！？」
　思わず口にして、自分の甘さにほとほと愛想がつきた。
　なんだって俺は、自分を殺そうとしている相手にそんな心配をして――――
「―――――あ」
　体が、浮いた。
　正面から何かに殴りつけられて、弾き飛ばされる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh no—Yumizuka, are you all right?!”
The question escaped before I could stop it, and I despised my own softness.
Why was I worrying about someone who was trying to kill me—
“Ah…”
My body lifted from the ground.
Something struck me head-on and hurled me away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Cra----Yumizuka, are you okay……!?"
Saying so, I hate how stupid I am.
Why am I worrying over someone trying to kill me----?
"------Ah."
My body… floats.
I am hit from the front and fly through the air.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　視界が、戻った。
　今の一撃があんまりにも強力だったおかげだろうか。
「……路地……裏」
　どうも、さっきの一撃で路地裏の壁まで弾き飛ばされたみたいだ。
　背中には硬い壁の感触がある。
「―――あ」
　意識が遠のく。
　なのに、弓塚は容赦なくやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
My sight returned.
Perhaps the blow had been so powerful it shocked my vision back into place.
“An alley.”
It seemed the impact had thrown me against an alley wall.
I could feel the hard wall against my back.
“Ah…”
My consciousness faded.
But Yumizuka kept coming without mercy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
My vision returns.
Is it because her attack was so strong?
"…… Back…… alley."
It seems I flew all the way to the back alley wall.
I feel the hard wall against my back.
"----Ah."
My consciousness starts to fade.
Still, Yumizuka mercilessly presses forward.

entries.japanese:
「うそつき―――！」
　恨みのこもった声をあげて、俺めがけて手を振り上げる。
「……………」
　動けない。
　動けないから、もう、殺されるしかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Liar!”
Her voice thick with resentment, she raised a hand over me.
“…”
I could not move.
There was nothing left but to let her kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Liar----!"
Her voice full of hate, she swings her arm towards me.
"………………"
I can't move.
Since I can't move, all I can do is be killed.

entries.japanese:
「…………………え？」
　壁がゆれる。
　弓塚の腕は、俺のすぐ横の壁を、ただ乱暴に叩いただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
The wall shook.
Yumizuka’s arm had struck it violently—mere inches beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Eh?"
The wall shakes.
Yumizuka's arm only pounded the wall next to me.

entries.japanese:
「うそつき―――！
　助けてくれるって、わたしがピンチの時は助けてくれるって言ったのに！」
　また、見当違いのところを彼女は壊している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Liar! You promised you would save me if I was ever in trouble!”
Again, she destroyed something nowhere near me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Liar----!
You said you'd help me when I was in a pinch!"
Again, she starts to break areas away from me.

entries.japanese:
「どうして？
　わたしがこんなになっちゃったからダメなの？
　けど、そんなのしょうがないよ……！
　わたしだって、すきでこんな体になったんじゃないんだから……！」
　どん、どん。
　駄々をこねる子供みたいに、ただ、彼女は叫んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why? Is it because I became like this? But I couldn’t help it…! I never wanted this body…!”
Bang, bang.
She screamed like a child throwing a tantrum.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why?
Am I not good enough because I became like this?
But I couldn't help it……!
I didn't become like this because I wanted to……!"
Bam.
Bam.
Like a child throwing a tantrum, she keeps screaming.

entries.japanese:
「……こんなに痛いのに、こんなに苦しいのに、どうして志貴くんはわたしを助けてくれないの！？
　助けてくれるって約束したのに、どうして――」
　どん、どん。
　出口のない苦悶の声。
　いつ自分の体を串刺しにされてもおかしくないこの状況で。
　どうしてだろう、これから殺されるという恐怖は薄れていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even though it hurts this much, even though I’m suffering this much, why won’t you save me, Shiki?! You promised you would, so why—”
Bang, bang.
Her anguish had nowhere to go.
At any moment she could have run my body through.
Yet somehow, my fear that she was about to kill me was fading.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It hurts so much, it is so painful, but why won't you help me, Shiki-kun!?
You promised to help me, so why--"
Bam.
Bam.
Her forlorn, anguished voice.
In this situation where she could kill me any time…
For some reason, my fear of impending death starts to fade away.

entries.japanese:
「志貴くん―――志貴くんがわたしの傍にいてくれるなら、この痛みにだって耐えていけるのに。
どうして、どうしてあなたまでわたしを受け入れてくれないの……！」
　……なんて、愚かさ。
　繰り返される言葉は、俺に対する恨み言なんかじゃない。
　弓塚さつきは、ずっと、どうしようもなくて泣いているだけだったって、いうのに――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—if you stayed beside me, I could endure this pain. Why won’t even you accept me…?”
What a fool I had been.
Those repeated words were not curses aimed at me.
All along, Satsuki Yumizuka had only been crying because there was nothing else she could do—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-kun----if you could be by my side, I could even bear this pain.
Why, why can't you accept me……!?"
…… How, foolish.
Her words weren't ones of hate directed at me.
Yumizuka Satsuki was only crying this whole time because she can't help it----

entries.japanese:
―――弓塚の声が聞こえなくなった。
　もう指先ぐらいしか動かなくなった体で、彼女の姿を見つめる。
　……どうしたんだろう。
　弓塚は、ピクリとも動かなくなった俺を見て、呆然と立ち尽くしている。
　……まるで。
　悪い夢から覚めて、自分のしたことを、後悔する、ように。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Then Yumizuka’s voice stopped.
With only my fingertips still able to move, I watched her.
What was wrong?
Yumizuka stood dumbstruck, staring at my now-motionless body.
She looked like someone waking up.
Someone waking from a nightmare to regret what she had done.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Her voice dwindles away.
Only able to move my fingers, I look at her.
…… How come?
Yumizuka looks at my unmoving body as if she was surprised.
…… As if,
she was waking from a nightmare, and regretting what she's done.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴くん、わたし……こんな、つもり、じゃ―――」
　弓塚の声は震えている。
　……冷静になってくれたらしいけど、それでもやっぱり、彼女の声は泣きそうだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—I never meant to—”
Her voice trembled.
She seemed to have regained her senses, yet she still sounded ready to cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki-kun, I…… never, meant to----"
Her voice is trembling.
…… I guess she's calmed down, but her voice still sounds like she is about to cry.

entries.japanese:
「………いい………んだ」
―――そんなに、自分を責める必要なんて、ない。
　たとえ、身も心も吸血鬼なんていうモノになってしまったとしても。
　彼女はやっぱり、どうしようもないぐらい、可哀相な被害者なんだ。
　どのみち、もう俺の体は動かない。
　弓塚、キミがそんなに一人で、痛くて、寒いっていうんなら。
　俺に出来ることは、もう一つしか残っていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s—all right.”
―――She did not need to blame herself so bitterly.
Even if she had become a vampire in both body and soul.
She was still a pitiful victim.
My body would never move again anyway.
Yumizuka, you were so alone, in so much pain, so cold.
There was only one thing I could still do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… It's……… okay."
----You don't need to blame yourself like that.
Even if your mind and body turned into a vampire.
In the end, you're still just a pitiful victim.
In any case, I can't move.
Yumizuka, if you say you are so alone, in so much pain, and so cold,
then there is only one thing that I can do.

entries.japanese:
「……いいよ、弓塚さん」
「志貴……くん？」
「俺の血でよければ吸っていいよ。
　約束だもんな……キミと一緒に、いってやる」
　それは、自分でもわからないぐらい、優しい声だったと思う。
　彼女はためらった後、静かに俺の膝元に跪いて、俺の体をだきあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right, Yumizuka.”
“Shiki?”
“You can drink my blood if you want it.
It’s a promise; I’ll go with you.”
My voice sounded gentler than I knew I could be.
After hesitating, she knelt quietly before me and gathered me into her arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay, Yumizuka-san."
"Shiki…… kun?"
"You can suck my blood if you want.
It's a promise…… I'll be with you, okay?"
I think my voice was kinder then I ever was.
After hesitating, she quietly kneels by me and holds me.

entries.japanese:
「――――ほんとに、いいの？」
　囁くような声には戸惑いと喜びが混ざっている。
「……なんだよ。
今までそうしたくて散々追い回したんだろ。
なんでここで遠慮するのかな、弓塚さんは」
「だって―――――わたし、本当にそうしたいけど、でも―――」
―――それをしたら、もう、本当にダメになってしまいそうで―――
　そう、彼女の唇が声にならない言葉を紡ぐ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you sure?”
Her whispered voice mingled hesitation and delight.
“What’s wrong? You chased me all this way because this is what you wanted. Why hold back now, Yumizuka?”
“But—I really do want to, but—”
―――If I do that, I think I really will be lost forever—
Her lips shaped the voiceless words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Is it, really okay?"
Her voice is mingled with hesitation and happiness.
"…… What?
You came after me because you wanted to do that, right?
Why are you hesitating now, Yumizuka-san?"
"But------I really want to, but----"
----If I do that, I really will be hopeless----
That last line barely escapes her lips.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　……なんて皮肉だろう。
　たしかに彼女は吸血鬼になってしまっている。
けど、それでも一番大切な部分で、人間のココロを残しているんだ。
　だからこそ、そのココロが弓塚さつきに吸血鬼である自分を“痛い”と感じさせている。
　人間であること。
　そうであるかぎり、彼女は、ずっと痛いままなんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
What bitter irony.
She had indeed become a vampire. Yet in the place that mattered most, she still possessed a human heart.
That heart was precisely why being a vampire hurt Satsuki Yumizuka.
Being human.
As long as that remained, she would always be in pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
…… How ironic.
Certainly she has become a vampire.
Yet in her most important part, a human heart remains.
Because her heart remains, Yumizuka Satsuki still feels pain over being a vampire.
Being human.
As long as that part remains human, she will be in pain.

entries.japanese:
「―――痛いんだろ。
なら、いいよ。
俺はキミを助けられない。
だから、弓塚さんの言う方法で助けるしかないじゃないか」
「………志貴………くん」
　コクン、とうなずいて。
　彼女は、俺の首筋に唇を当てた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It hurts, doesn’t it? Then go ahead. I can’t save you. So I have no choice but to help you your way.”
“Shiki…”
She nodded.
Then she pressed her lips to my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----It hurts, doesn't it?
So it's okay.
I can't help you.
So shouldn't we just do things your way?"
"……… Shiki……… kun."
She nods.
Then, she brings her lips to my neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　消えていく。
　体に残った微かな熱が、急速に力を失っていく。
　静かな。
　とても静かな、死。
　今さら彼女を引き離す力もない。
　この目に見えている『線』も、じき、消えてくれるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
I was disappearing.
The faint warmth left in my body rapidly lost its strength.
A quiet death.
A death so very quiet.
I had no strength left to push her away.
Soon even the lines in my sight would disappear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
Disappearing.
The remaining heat in my body fades away quickly.
Quiet.
Such a quiet death.
I don't have any power to break free.
The "lines" in my vision should disappear soon too.

entries.japanese:
―――これで終わり。
　じき遠野志貴は消えて、それで何もかもが終わりになる。
「―――――――ぁ」
　終わり……終わって、いいん、だろう、か。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――This is the end.
Soon Shiki Tohno will disappear, and everything will end.
“Ah—”
The end—was it really all right to let it end?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----With this, it is over.
Tohno Shiki will soon disappear, and everything will end.
"--------Ah."
End…… end… is that, okay?

entries.japanese:
……戻って、きますよね……？
　そんなセリフを、秋葉は言った。
　八年間も放っておいた自分の妹。
　何一つ、兄貴らしいことなんてしてやれなかった、黒髪の少女。
―――ずっと、
　　　あの広い屋敷で一人きりだった遠野秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
You will come back, won’t you…?
Akiha had said those words.
My little sister, whom I had abandoned for eight years.
The black-haired girl for whom I had never once done anything worthy of an older brother.
―――Akiha Tohno,
left alone all those years in that enormous mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… You will come back, right……?
Akiha said that.
My sister I left alone for eight years.
The black-haired girl I have done nothing for as a brother.
----Always,
Tohno Akiha was alone in that mansion.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　さっき、俺は死が救いになる事がある、と弓塚にナイフを向けた。
　そうして今も、死が救いになるのならとこの命を投げ出している。
　けど、それは。
　はたして、誰にとっての救いになるんだろうか。
　少なくとも遠野志貴という自分にとって、一番大切な人に対する救いには、決してなっていない気がする―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
A short while ago, I had turned my knife on Yumizuka, telling myself that death could be a salvation.
And now, still telling myself that death could be a salvation, I was throwing away my own life.
But then.
Whom would that save?
At least, it could never save the person I, Shiki Tohno, cared for most—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Before, I faced Yumizuka with my knife to bring her salvation from death.
And now, I am giving up my life to save her with my life.
But, that…
Doing that, who would be saved?
At least for Tohno Shiki, it's not helping someone he cares the most about----

entries.japanese:
「あき―――は」
　……死ねない。
　間違っても、今は死ねない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
I couldn’t die.
Whatever happened, I could not die now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki----ha."
…… I can't die.

Even if I'm wrong, I can't die now.

entries.japanese:
「弓、塚―――」
　ナイフが動く。
　……彼女の胸にある『線』。
　自分を信じきって、最後の救いにすがっている彼女の心臓にある線。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka—”
The knife moved.
The line across her chest.
The line upon the heart of the girl who trusted me absolutely and clung to me as her final salvation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi, zuka----"
My knife moves.
…… The "line" on her chest.
The line on the heart of the girl who believed in herself, hoping for some last salvation----

entries.japanese: ……そこに、ナイフは深々と突き刺さった。
entries.maoEnglish: The knife sank deep into that line.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… I plunge my knife deeply into it.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴、くん？」
　さつきの唇が離れる。
　その力が急速にゼロになっていく。
「―――ごめん。
俺は、弓塚を助けられない」
　こんな方法でしか、助けられられない。
　その痛みから逃れる事ができないのなら。
　せめて―――最期ぐらいは、痛みもなく逝けるようにするしか、できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki?”
Satsuki’s lips drew away.
The strength in her body rapidly dwindled to nothing.
“—I’m sorry. I can’t save you, Yumizuka.”
This was the only way I could save her.
If she could not escape that pain.
Then the least I could do was let her meet the end without pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki, kun?"
Satsuki's lips pull back.
The power there turns to nothing.
"----Sorry.
I couldn't help you, Yumizuka."
This is the only way I can.
If she can't escape from the pain,
then at least----I can let her have a painless death.

entries.japanese:
「そっか――――やっぱり一緒には行ってくれないんだね、遠野くん」
　彼女の声は、ひどく穏やかだ。
　まるで、二日前の夕暮れの帰り道のように。
「でも、うれしかったよ。
ほんの少しの間だったけど、遠野くんは、わたしを選んでくれたんだもん。
　……うん、これならこのまま死んじゃっても悪くないかな。
　あれだけいっぱいあった痛みもないし、こわい気持ちも魔法みたいに消えちゃったし―――」
　ざら、とした感触が足にあたる。
　見れば。
　弓塚の両足は、もう膝までが灰になってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see—so you still won’t come with me, Tohno.”
Her voice was terribly gentle.
Just as it had been when we walked home at sunset two days ago.
“But I was happy. We weren’t together long, but you chose me. Yes, if it ends like this, dying might not be so bad.
All that pain is gone, and even the fear disappeared like magic—”
Something rough brushed against my legs.
I looked down.
Yumizuka’s legs had already turned to ash up to the knees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see----I knew it… you couldn't be with me, right Tohno-kun?"
Her voice is terribly peaceful.
Just like the way home in the sunset two days ago.
"But, I'm still happy.
Even if it was just a brief moment, you chose me, Tohno-kun…… Yeah, in that case, maybe dying like this isn't so bad.
All the pain is gone, and the scary emotions have disappeared like magic----"
I feel something blowing at my feet.
Looking there,
I see Yumizuka's legs have turned to ash from the knees down.

entries.japanese:
「―――それに、今は少しだけあったかいや。
　えへへ、これって遠野くんの体温かな」
　嬉しそうに弓塚は言った。
―――――俺は本当に。
　　　　　後悔で、死にたくなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—And I feel a little warmer now.
Hee hee, do you suppose this is your body heat, Tohno?”
Yumizuka sounded delighted.
―――――I truly did.
The regret made me wish I were dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----And, it's a little warm right now.
Ehehe, this must be your warmth, Tohno-kun."
She speaks happily.
------This pure regret,
it's so much, I want to die.

entries.japanese:
―――覚悟してた。
　この裏切りをした時、どんな恨み言を言われてもいいと、覚悟していたのに。
―――どうして。
　どうしてそんな、穏やかな声で、嬉しそうな声で。
　俺を責めることさえ、しないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I had prepared myself.
When I betrayed her, I had been ready to hear any curse she cared to throw at me.
―――Then why?
Why did she speak so gently, so happily?
Why wouldn’t she even blame me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I prepared myself.
I prepared myself when I betrayed her, for whatever hateful words she might say.
----So why?
Why this peaceful, happy voice?
She doesn't even blame me at all.

entries.japanese:
「―――ごめん。
俺は―――無力で、最低だ」
　瞳が熱い。
　脳の奥が、ぼやけて視界がぼやけてしまってる。
「あは。
遠野くんったら泣いてるんだ。
　……優しいなあ。
わたし、ひどいこといっぱいしたのに、それでも泣いてくれるんだね。
　……うん、そんなトコ、誰よりも好きだった。
　中学校からずっと遠野くんだけを見てたから―――そんな誰も知らないことだって、わたしはお見通しだったんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I’m sorry. I’m powerless and despicable.”
My eyes burned.
A haze spread through the back of my mind and blurred my sight.
“Ahaha. You’re crying, Tohno.”
“You’re so kind. I did so many terrible things, yet you’re still crying for me.”
“Yes, that was what I loved most about you.”
“I’ve watched only you ever since middle school, so I knew even the things no one else did.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Sorry.
I----was powerless.
I'm the lowest."
My eyes are burning.
Inside my brain, my vision wavers.
"Aha.
Tohno-kun, you are crying.
…… You really are kind.
After I did these horrible things, you still cry for me.
…… Yeah, that's what I liked the most about you.
I watched you since middle school, Tohno-kun----so I always knew about that side of you no one else did."

entries.japanese:
誇らしげな声と、ざらざらという感触。
　彼女の体は、もう上半身しか存在していない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her voice was proud, and the rough sensation continued.
Nothing remained of her body below the waist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her proud voice, and the sensation of something drifting away on the wind.
Her lower body doesn't exist anymore.

entries.japanese:
「……わたし、もっと遠野くんと話したかった。
ほんとうに普通に、なんでもないクラスメイトみたいに話したかった。
だから、いま死んじゃうのはホントにイヤだよ」
「――――――」
　何も言えない。
　俺には、彼女に語りかけられる言葉がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I wanted to talk to you so much more. Just normally, like any ordinary classmate. So I really don’t want to die now.”
“……”
I could say nothing.
I had no words left to offer her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I, wanted to talk more with you, Tohno-kun.
Normally, just as classmates, to talk more.
That's why I really don't want to die now."
"------"
I can't say anything.
I don't have any words for her.

entries.japanese: ―――彼女は、最後にコン、と自分の額を、俺の額にあてた。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――At the very end, she gently tapped her forehead against mine.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----At the very end, she leans her head against my forehead.

entries.japanese:
「でも、きっとこれが一番いい方法だったんだよね。
　―――だから、泣かないで遠野くん。
あなたは正しい事をしてくれたんだから」
　ナイフの感触が軽い。
　さつきの体には、もう、心臓がなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But this must have been the best way.
―――So don’t cry, Tohno. You did the right thing.”
The knife suddenly felt weightless.
Satsuki no longer had a heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, this is for sure the best way.
---So, don't cry, Tohno-kun.
You did the right thing."
The sensation of the knife gets lighter.
Satsuki's body doesn't have a heart anymore.

entries.japanese:
「あ、もう声を出す事ができなさそう。
　それじゃあ、わたしは家がこっちだから。
そろそろお別れだね」
「弓――塚………っ！」
「うん、ばいばい遠野くん。
ありがとう―――それと、ごめんね」
　ざ。
　一握りの灰が風に飛ばされて霧散するように。
　弓塚さつきは、この目の前から、完全に消滅した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah, I don’t think I can speak much longer.
My house is this way. I suppose it’s time to say goodbye.”
“Yumi—zuka!”
“Mm, goodbye, Tohno. Thank you—and I’m sorry.”
A soft rush.
Like a handful of ash scattered into nothing by the wind.
Satsuki Yumizuka vanished completely before my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, it seems like I won't be able to talk anymore.
Well, my house is this way.
So this is goodbye then."
"Yumi----zuka……!"
"Yeah, bye bye, Tohno-kun.
Thank you---and, sorry."
Whoosh.
Like ash scattered by the wind,
Yumizuka Satsuki completely disappears before my eyes.

entries.japanese:
……弓塚の姿は、まるで幻だったみたいに、あっさりと消えてしまった。
「――――――」
　眩暈だけが、残った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka vanished as simply as though she had been an illusion.
“……”
Only the vertigo remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Her figure disappeared like it was just a mirage.
"------"
All that remains is this dizziness.

entries.japanese:
俺は、彼女を殺した。
　救いたかったのに―――最後は彼女の言うとおりの救いをしようと思ったのに―――結局は、自分の身かわいさに、殺して、しまった。
「あ――――あ」
　それでも。
　それでも、彼女が散り際に嘘吐きとでも言ってくれればよかった。
　そうしてくれれば、俺は本当に悪いやつになりきれたのに、どうして―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I had killed her.
I wanted to save her and meant, in the end, to grant the salvation she asked for, yet when it came down to it, I killed her to save myself.
“Ah—ah.”
Even so.
If only she had called me a liar as she vanished.
Then I could have surrendered completely to being the villain; so why—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I killed her.
I wanted to save her----I even said I would save her---but in the end, I killed her to save myself.
"A----a."
But still.
But still, it would have been okay for her to call me a liar at the very end.
If she did that, I really could have turned into a bad person, so why----

entries.japanese:
ありがとう。
ごめんなさい。
　感謝されるいわれはない。
謝られる理由もない。
「俺が――キミを、殺したのに」
　……それでも、ありがとうと、言ってくれた。
　だからこそ。
　本当に、彼女を、救ってあげたかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you. I’m sorry.
She had no reason to thank me. She had nothing to apologize for.
“I—killed you.”
Yet she thanked me all the same.
That was why.
I had truly wanted to save her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thank you.
Sorry.
She didn't have to thank me.
There was no reason to apologize.
"I--killed you."
…… But still, she thanked me.
That's why.
I really did want to save her.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　しびれた体が、かってに立ちあがる。
　今は、何も考えられない。
　心と体は別物なのか。
　ざっ、ざっ、と無様に体を引きずって、路地裏を後にした――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
My numb body rose without my asking it to.
I could think of nothing.
Perhaps the heart and body really were separate things.
Dragging myself along with graceless, scraping steps, I left the alley behind—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
My numb body stands up on its own.
I can't think of anything right now.
Are my mind and body separate things?
Mindlessly dragging my body, I exit the alley----

entries.japanese:
ぎい、と音をたてて扉が開く。
　傷だらけの体をひきずって、ようやく屋敷に帰ってきた。
「――――――あ」
　ロビーには秋葉がいた。
　あれからずっとここで待っていたんだろうか。
　……今の自分には、もう、何もわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
The door creaked open.
Dragging myself along despite my wounds, I finally made it back to the mansion.
“—Ah.”
Akiha was in the foyer.
Had she been waiting there all this time?
I could no longer understand anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The door opens with a creak.
Covered in wounds, I finally make it back to the mansion.
"------Ah."
Akiha is in the lobby.
Was she waiting for me this whole time?
…… Right now, I can't understand anything.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、今まで何をしていたんですか。
いったい今何時だと―――」
「に、兄さん、その体―――」
　……秋葉が驚いている。
　どうして。
　何に驚いているのかさえ、もう、考えたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where have you been, Brother? Do you have any idea what time it—”
“B-Brother, your body—”
Akiha was shocked.
Why?
I no longer wanted to think about what had startled her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, what were you doing this whole time?
What time do you think----"
"N, Nii-san, you look----"
…… Akiha is shocked.
Why?
I can't even bring myself to want to think about what's so shocking for her.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、しっかりしてください……！
　いったいどうしたんですか、そんな傷だらけで、そんな……ひどい、目をして」
「……………………」
　何も答えない。
いや、答えられない。
　秋葉が何を言っているのかも、わからない。
「――――――」
　秋葉は無言で息を飲むと、つかつかとこちらに近づいてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, stay with me…! What happened to leave you covered in wounds and looking so awful?”
“……”
I gave no answer. No—I couldn’t.
I couldn’t even understand what Akiha was saying.
“……”
Akiha caught her breath, then strode straight toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, hang in there……!
What in the world happened?
You have all these wounds, and…… you look terrible."
"………………"
I don't say anything.
No, I can't say anything.
I don't even know what Akiha is saying.
"------"
Akiha gasps silently and then walks towards me.

entries.japanese:
「とにかく手当てをしないと。
兄さん、歩けますか？」
「………………」
　ああ。
生きているんだから、歩くことぐらいはできる。
「手当てをしますから居間に来てください。
あ、それとお風呂――は無理ですから、お湯で体を拭かないといけませんね」
　秋葉はパタパタと足音をたてて消えていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We have to tend to your wounds. Can you walk, Brother?”
“……”
Yes. I was still alive, so surely I could manage that much.
“Come to the sitting room so I can treat you. And since a bath is impossible, I’ll have to wipe you down with hot towels.”
Akiha hurried away, her footsteps pattering into the distance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, I will have to treat you.
Nii-san, can you walk?"
"………………"
Yeah.
I'm alive, so I can walk.
"I will treat your wounds, so please come to the sitting room.
Ah, and take a bath--that will be impossible, so I'll have to wipe you with warm water."
Akiha disappears with quick footsteps.

entries.japanese:
―――秋葉は一人で俺の怪我の手当てをしてくれた。
　汚れた体もタオルで拭いて、食べ物まで作ってくれたあげく、部屋まで連れてきてくれた。
　その間、俺は一言も、口にすることなんか、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Akiha tended every one of my wounds herself.
She wiped the filth from my body, cooked something for me, and finally brought me to my room.
Through all of it, I could not utter a single word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Akiha takes care of me by herself.
She wipes off my dirty body with a towel, goes so far as to make me food, and accompanies me to my room.
During that time… I couldn't… even say a single word.

entries.japanese:
「……それでは、私は戻ります。
兄さんも今夜はゆっくり眠ってください」
　何も聞かず。
　秋葉は最後まで何も聞かず、静かに立ち去っていこうとする。
　消えていく。
　俺が、殺してしまった、彼女の、ように。
――――そう思った瞬間、秋葉の腕を掴んでしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll leave you now. Please get a good night’s sleep, Brother.”
She had asked nothing.
Still asking nothing, Akiha quietly turned to leave.
She was disappearing.
Just like the girl I had killed.
――――The moment I thought that, my hand seized Akiha’s arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then I will go back to my room.
Please rest well tonight, Nii-san."
Without even asking anything.
In the end, she doesn't ask anything and quietly walks away.
Disappearing.
Just like… the girl… I killed.
----As I think that, I grab Akiha's arm.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん――！？」
　そのまま秋葉を抱きしめる。
　……強く。
　ただ独りになるのが耐えられず、誰かの体温を感じたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother—!?”
I pulled her into my arms and held her tight.
I could not bear to be alone.
I needed to feel another person’s warmth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san--!?"
Then, I embrace Akiha…
…… Strongly.
Unable to be alone, I wanted to feel someone's body warmth.

entries.japanese:
「あき―――は」
　無心で抱きしめる。
　……秋葉は何も言わない。
　すぐに引き離してくるはずなのに、震えている俺の体を拒絶しない。
　このまま―――ただ、こうしているだけで、よかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
I clung to her without thought.
Akiha said nothing.
Ordinarily she would have pushed me away at once, yet now she did not pull away from me as I trembled.
It would have been enough simply to stay like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki----ha."
I embrace her without thinking.
…… Akiha doesn't say anything.
Even though she definitely should pull away, she doesn't resist my trembling body.
Like this----all I wanted was to stay like this.

entries.japanese:
「俺は、最低だ」
　そう、告白して。
　自分の罪から、秋葉に逃げた。
「……助けたかった……助けたかったのに、助けてやる事が、できなかった」
　ぐっ、と救いを求めるように秋葉を抱きしめる。
　秋葉からの答えはない。
　まるで俺の弱さを嫌うように、秋葉は俺から体を離した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m the worst.”
That was my confession.
I fled from my guilt into Akiha’s arms.
“I wanted to save her, but I couldn’t.”
I tightened my embrace as though begging Akiha to save me instead.
Akiha gave no answer.
As though disgusted by my weakness, she drew herself away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, am the worst."
I confess.
From my sin, and I escape to Akiha.
"…… I wanted to save her…… I wanted to save her…… but I couldn't do anything."
As if seeking salvation, I squeeze Akiha tighter.
There's no response from Akiha.
As if repelled by my weakness, Akiha pulls away.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん。
貴方に何があったかは知りません。
きっと、私が聞くべき事でもないと思います」
「――――」
「私には何も答えてあげることはできません。
兄さんの問題は兄さんが解決すべきことです。
　ですから―――こんなことで、私に甘えないでください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Brother, I don’t know what happened to you. I’m sure it isn’t something I should ask about.”
“……”
“And there is no answer I can give you. Your problem is one you must resolve yourself.
So please—don’t come seeking comfort from me over something like this.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san.
I do not know what happened to you.
I think it is something I shouldn't ask about, either."
"----"
"I cannot give you any answers.
You have to solve your own problems.
So----please do not run to me for something like this."

entries.japanese:
……秋葉の言葉は、本当に、その通りだ。
　その叱咤があまりにも的確すぎて、俺はようやく、自分の心を取り戻した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha was entirely right.
Her rebuke was so painfully accurate that at last I regained control of myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Her words are really right on target.
Her rebuke is so correct, I finally return to myself.

entries.japanese:
「……すまない。
今夜のことは、忘れてくれ」
「…………」
　秋葉は答えずドアへ歩いていく。
　そのまま出て行こうとして、ピタリ、と秋葉は立ち止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry. Please forget what happened tonight.”
“……”
Without answering, Akiha walked to the door.
She was about to leave when she came to an abrupt stop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
Just forget about it, please."
"…………"
Akiha walks to the door without answering.
She tried to leave, but she suddenly stops.

entries.japanese:
「――――何があったかは聞きませんけど。
　私、さっき兄さんを送り出す時、ひどく恐かったんです。
なんだかこのまま兄さんは帰ってこないような気がして。
八年前と同じ、そんな予感がしたんです」
「―――――――」
「でも、兄さんはちゃんと帰ってきてくれたわ。
　……兄さんは誰かを救えなかったと言ったけど。
少なくとも、兄さんは私をちゃんと、そんな予感から救ってくれたんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—I won’t ask what happened.
But when I watched you leave earlier, Brother, I was terrified. I had the strangest feeling that you would never come back. It was the same dread I felt eight years ago.”
“……”
“But you did come back.
You said there was someone you couldn’t save. Yet at least you saved me from that dreadful premonition.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I will not ask what happened.
But when you left, I was very frightened.
I felt like you would not return.
Like eight years ago, I had the same premonition."

"-------"
"But, you did come back, Nii-san.
…… You said you were unable to save someone.
But at least, you were able to save me from that premonition."

entries.japanese:
「―――ですから、お帰りなさい兄さん。
　秋葉は兄さんが帰ってきてくれただけで、ほんとはものすごく嬉しいんです。
……それを、わずかでいいですから覚えておいてください」
　恥ずかしそうに言って、秋葉はぺこりとおじぎをした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—So welcome home, Brother.
Akiha is happier than you can imagine just because you came home. Please remember that, if only a little.”
Her face coloring with embarrassment, Akiha gave me a small bow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----So, welcome back, Nii-san.
Just your return has made me so happy…… So please keep that in mind."
Saying that embarrassedly, she gives a quick bow.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉――――――」
「私からはそれだけです。
　……あたまのわるい兄さんのために言い直してあげると、もう二度と可愛い妹を一人きりになんかしないでくださいって事ですから」
「は、はは―――そっか、よくわかった。
けどさ、可愛いって、そうゆうのは自分で言っちゃだめだよ、秋葉」
　秋葉の言葉にようやく言葉が返せた。
　たったそれだけの事なのに、秋葉は誇らしげな笑顔をうかべる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—”
“That is all I wished to say.
To put it another way for my slow-witted brother: never leave your adorable little sister all alone again.”
“Ha—haha. All right, I understand—but Akiha, you shouldn’t call yourself adorable.”
At last I managed to answer her.
It was such a small thing, yet Akiha smiled with unmistakable pride.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha------"
"That is all I have to say.
…… I will be very clear so my slow Nii-san can understand.
I'm saying please don't leave your cute little sister alone again."
"Ha, haha----I see, I get it.
But cute?
It's not right to say such things about yourself, Akiha."
I finally manage a response.
But with just that, Akiha gives a boastful smile.

entries.japanese:
「はい。
それではまた明日。
いい夢を見て、新しい朝を迎えてくださいね。
　明日、朝になってもそんな顔をしていたら承知しませんから」
　秋葉は去っていった。
　俺は―――傷だらけの自分の体を眺めて、そのままベッドに倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I’ll see you tomorrow. Sleep well, and be ready to face a new morning.
If you’re still wearing that face when morning comes, you’ll answer to me.”
Akiha left.
I looked over my wounded body, then collapsed onto the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Then I will see you tomorrow.
Sweet dreams, tomorrow will be a new day.
I won't allow you to be looking like that tomorrow."
Akiha leaves.
I----looking at my body covered in wounds, fall to my bed.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――あ」
　深く。
　何かに決別するように、深くため息をつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—”
A deep breath.
I breathed out deeply, as though severing myself from something.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha-----ah."
Deep.
As if I'm saying goodbye to something, I let out a deep sigh.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん、弓塚。
やっぱり俺は―――後悔は、しちゃいけないって、思うんだ」
　……彼女との事は、きっと一生許せない傷痕になった。
　けど、アレは正しかったんだって信じよう。
　罪だっていうのは認めるし、いずれ罰があるっていうのなら受け入れる。
　けど、自分がこうして生きている事に後悔だけはしたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry, Yumizuka. But I still think I mustn’t regret it.”
What happened between us would remain an unforgivable scar for the rest of my life.
Even so, I would believe that what I had done was right.
I accepted that it was a sin, and if punishment came one day, I would submit to it.
But I refused to regret being alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, Yumizuka.
I decided----I shouldn't be full of regret after all."
…… Everything about what happened with her will be an indelible scar.
But, I should believe it was the right thing to do.
I know it is a sin, and I will have to accept my punishment someday.
But, I can't have regret for being alive right now.

entries.japanese:
「……ただいま、秋葉」
　精一杯の感謝の念をこめて、そう呟いた。
　……意識が落ちる。
　疲れきった体と心が、急速に眠りにおちていく。
　その狭間で、思った。
　自分は、生きていてよかったんだ。
　少なくとも自分には帰るべき家があって。
　それを待っていてくれた、かけがえのない肉親がいるんだから、と――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m home, Akiha.”
I whispered the words with all the gratitude I could muster.
Consciousness slipped away.
My exhausted body and mind sank swiftly into sleep.
In that space between waking and sleep, a thought came to me.
I was glad to be alive.
At least I had a home to return to.
And an irreplaceable member of my family was there, waiting for me—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm back, Akiha."
I mumble aloud my heartfelt thanks.
…… My mind starts to drift.
My exhausted mind and body swiftly approach sleep.
In that instant, I thought…
It's good for me to be alive.
At the very least, I have a home to return to.
And waiting for me there is my priceless family----

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　びくり、と弓塚の体が震えた。
　弓塚ははぁはぁと苦しげに息をはいて、そのまま―――地面に膝をついてしまった。
　ごふっ、という音。
　地面にしゃがみこんだ弓塚は、大きく咳をして、血の塊を吐き出した。
「―――弓塚！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Yumizuka’s body shuddered.
Breathing painfully, she sank to her knees.
She made a wet, choking sound.
Crouched on the ground, Yumizuka coughed violently and spat out a clot of blood.
“Yumizuka!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---"
Yumizuka's body trembles.
Breathing painfully, she falls to her knees.

A choking sound.
Squatting on the ground, Yumizuka coughs heavily, and she spits out a lump of blood.
"---Yumizuka!?"

entries.japanese:
今度こそ弓塚に駆けよった。
「弓塚、大丈夫か、弓塚……！」
　ぜいぜいと上下する肩に手をやる。
「あ――――」
　ゾッとした。
　弓塚の体は、服の上からでも分かるぐらい冷たかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
This time I rushed to her.
“Yumizuka, are you all right, Yumizuka…!”
I put a hand on her heaving shoulder.
“Ah—”
A chill ran through me.
Even through her clothes, her body was unmistakably cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This time, I do rush near her.
"Yumizuka, are you okay?
Yumizuka…!"
I put my hand on her heaving shoulder.
"Ah---"
I feel a chill.
Even through her clothes, I can feel the coldness of her body.

entries.japanese:
「ばかっ、こんなに体が冷えきってるじゃないか！
　なんでこんなんで夜出歩いてるんだよ、おまえは！」
「―――志貴、くん」
　虚ろな声で俺の名前を呼んで。
　そのまま、弓塚は倒れるように俺にしなだれかかってきた。
　はあ、はあ、と。
　熱をもった吐息が、肌にかかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You idiot! You’re frozen through—what are you doing outside at night in this condition!?”
“Shiki…”
She called my name in a hollow voice.
Then Yumizuka collapsed against me.
Hah—hah.
Her feverish breath touched my skin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stupid, you're freezing!
What are you doing out in the open on a night like this!"
"---Shiki, kun…"
Her voice is hollow as she says my name.
Yumizuka collapses against me.
As she pants, her warm breath brushes my skin.

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚？」
「志貴くんがわたしのことを好きじゃなくてもいいよ。
わたしだって、今までずっと志貴くんのことがわからなかったから」
　こふ、と吐き出すような咳をしながら、弓塚は声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka?”
“It’s all right if you don’t love me, Shiki. I never understood you before either.”
Her voice strained past a rasping cough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka?"
"It's okay if you don't like me, Shiki-kun.
Because, I really didn't understand you at all until now, either."
Yumizuka speaks as she coughs.

entries.japanese:
「いいから、もうしゃべるな……！
　すぐに病院に連れていってやるから……！」
「でも、今なら解るよ。
志貴くんのことも、志貴くんがやりたいことも、本当によくわかるんだ。
　だって――――」
「え――――？」
　ぐっ、と弓塚の腕に力がこもる。
　ものすごい力で、俺の肩を押さえつけてくる。
「だってわたしも、志貴くんと同じになれたんだから―――！」
　言って。
　弓塚は、俺の首にその歯をつきたてた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Enough—stop talking…! I’ll get you to a hospital right away…!”
“But now I understand. I understand you and what you want perfectly.
Because—”
“What?”
Yumizuka’s arms tightened.
They pinned my shoulders with tremendous force.
“Because now I’ve become the same as you—!”
She said it.
Yumizuka sank her teeth into my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright, don't talk…!
I'll take you to a hospital…!"
"But, I understand now.
Who you are, and what you want to do.
I really understand now.
Because---"
"Eh---?"
Yumizuka's arm tenses.
With amazing strength, she digs into my shoulder.
"Because, I became like you, Shiki-kun---!"
Saying that, Yumizuka sinks her teeth into my neck.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――」
　意識。
意識が、遠のく。
　首筋には弓塚の牙がえぐりこんできている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
My consciousness. My consciousness receded.
Yumizuka’s fangs burrowed into my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Fading.
My consciousness is fading.
Yumizuka's fangs dig into my neck.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　吸われていく。
　なにか、体中の全てのものが、液体に変えられて吸い上げられていくよう。
　力が入らなければ、何も思いつかない。
　これは、意識が遠のいているんじゃなくて。
　単純に、意識を破壊されているだけだ。
「―――――――あ」
　何も考えつかない。
　このままだと死んでしまうって解っているのに、なにも――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
She was drinking me.
It felt as if everything inside my body were turning to liquid and being drawn upward.
With no strength, I could think of nothing.
My consciousness wasn’t fading.
It was simply being destroyed.
“Ah.”
I couldn’t think.
I knew I would die if this continued, and still, nothing—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---"
I'm being drained.
As if all the life in my body is liquified and sucked out.
Without strength, there are no thoughts.
So, my consciousness is not fading.
It is simply being destroyed.
"-------Ah."
There are no thoughts.
I know I'll die if I stay like this, but I can't even----

entries.japanese:
#ff0000

　　　　　　　その女を　殺せ
entries.maoEnglish: KILL THAT WOMAN
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000

Kill  this woman.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
　だっていうのに。
　俺の理性の与り知らないところで、どくん、と体中の血液が沸騰した。
「弓塚――――――！」
　両腕はただ反射的に、弓塚の体を突き放した。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ffffff

And yet.
Somewhere beyond the reach of reason, all the blood in my body surged to a boil.
“Yumizuka—!”
My arms thrust her away by pure reflex.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
All the same.
From somewhere beyond my mind, my blood begins to boil.
"Yumizuka----!"
Both my arms push her back out of pure reflex.

entries.japanese:
どすん、と地面に尻餅をつく弓塚。
「なに、を――――」
　立ちあがる。
　けど、それはできなかった。
　体中が疲れきっていて、自分の腕一本さえも満足に動かせない。
　弓塚はまるでアルコールを飲んだ後みたいに、ぼう、と座り込んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka landed hard on her backside.
“What did you…?”
I tried to stand.
But I couldn’t.
My whole body was exhausted; I could barely move a single arm.
Yumizuka sat there in a daze, as if drunk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She falls right on her behind.
"What are…----"
I stand up.
But, I can't.
I'm so exhausted I can barely even lift an arm.
Yumizuka sits, as if in a drunken stupor.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――」
　弓塚の顔が、よく見えない。
　意識が朦朧として、何もかも霞んでいる。
　体の自由もきかない。
　あるのはただ、首筋の痛みだけだ。
　血がとくとくと流れている。
　首筋に穿たれた、弓塚の歯形。
　深く食い込まれた二つの穴から、なにか、黒いモノが体の中に注ぎ込まれてきている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
I couldn’t see her face clearly.
My mind swam, blurring everything.
My body would not obey me.
Only the pain in my neck remained.
Blood pulsed steadily from my neck.
The marks where Yumizuka’s teeth had pierced me.
Through the two deep holes, something black seemed to be pouring into my body—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
I can't see her face clearly.
Everything dims as my consciousness fades.
I can't control my body either.
All that exists is the pain in my neck.
Blood gurgles forth.
Yumizuka's teeth marks remain in my neck.
And through those two deep holes, something black is being poured into my body---

entries.japanese:
「あ―――ぐ、ううううう………！」
　背骨、背骨を抜き取られるような、痛み。
「は――――ぐ、ああぁああ……！」
　ただ苦しくて、地面をひっかく。
　けれどどこにも助けなんかない。
　弓塚に体の中身を吸われて動けない上に、体の中に黒い蛇を注入されたような痛み。
　動くこともできないで、体の中を這い回る黒いモノに好き勝手犯されていく。
「はっ――――あ、あ――――！」
　地面をかきむしる。
　弓塚は恍惚とした瞳のまま、俺を、見つめて、いる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh, aaaaaagh…!”
Pain—as though someone were pulling my spine out of my body.
“Hah—aghhh…!”
I clawed at the ground in agony.
But there was no help anywhere.
Yumizuka had drained me until I could no longer move, and now it felt as if she had injected a black snake into my body.
Helpless, I could only let the crawling darkness violate me from within.
“Hah—ah—!”
I tore at the earth.
Yumizuka watched me through eyes glazed with ecstasy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---guhhhh!"
A pain, a pain as if my spine is about to be ripped out.
"Haa---arghhh!"
In pain, I claw at the ground.
But there is no relief.
I cannot move since Yumizuka has drained everything out of me, and the pain pours into me like a black snake.
I cannot move, so the black thing crawls and twists as it pleases inside me.

"Haa---ah, ah---"
I clutch at the ground.
With glazed eyes, Yumizuka… looks at… me.

entries.japanese:
「弓……塚……、おまえ、なにを………！」
「だいじょうぶ、痛いのは最初だけだから我慢して。
初めは苦しいけど、血が混ざってくれればすぐに落ちつくよ。
　志貴くんを殺すようなことはしないから安心して。
ちゃんとわたしの血を流し込んでおいたから、昨日の出来そこないみたいに崩れる事もないし、わたしの事だけを見てくれるようになるから」
　弓塚は嬉しそうに囁いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumi—zuka—what did you do?!”
“It’s all right. It only hurts at first, so bear with it; the beginning is awful, but once our blood blends, you’ll calm down.
Don’t worry, Shiki—I would never kill you. I put my blood inside you properly, so you won’t crumble like that failure yesterday and soon you’ll have eyes only for me.”
Yumizuka whispered happily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka… what have you…!"
"It's okay, it only hurts at first.
First it hurts, but when the blood mixes, it should die down."

"Don't worry, I won't kill you.
I poured my blood in properly, so you won't collapse and crumble away like those failures last night.
You will only look at me from now on."
Yumizuka whispers joyfully.

entries.japanese:
「なに―――言ってる、んだ、ゆみづ、か――」
「なにって、志貴くんもわたしと同じになるっていうことだよ。
　普通の食べ物のかわりに人間の血を吸って、太陽の下は歩けないから夜出歩くしかなくなる、違った生き物になるの」
　……なんだ、それ。
　ばかげてる、それじゃあまるで―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about, Yumi—zuka?”
“It means you’re going to become like me.”
“You’ll drink human blood instead of eating ordinary food, and because you can’t walk beneath the sun, you’ll live at night as a different creature.”
What was that supposed to mean…
Absurd—that sounded just like—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are---you talking about… Yumizu… ka---"
"I'm saying that I'm making both of us the same, Shiki-kun.
Sucking people's blood instead of eating normal food, nocturnal, unable to walk under the sun.
You're going to be a different creature."
…… What is, that.
Ridiculous, that's just like--

entries.japanese:
「うん、吸血鬼みたいだよね。
わたしもどうして自分がこんなになっちゃったか解らなかった。
　二日前の夜、志貴くんが夜の繁華街で歩いているっていう噂を確かめにいって、気がついたら路地裏で倒れてて。
　その時はただ、暗くて、寒くて、体中が痛いって思うだけだった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, like a vampire. I didn’t understand how I had become this way either.
Two nights ago, I went downtown to see if the rumor about you wandering around at night was true, and the next thing I knew, I was lying in an alley.
All I knew then was that it was dark and cold, and every part of me hurt.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, like a vampire.
I didn't really understand how I became this way either.
Two nights ago, I went out to check the rumor that you were walking around in the shopping district every night, and then when I came to I was lying down in that back alley.
Back then, I thought it was just cold, dark, and painful."

entries.japanese:
「けど不思議なことにね、時間がたって、体が変わりきると色々なことが解るようになってた。
　わたしの体が痛いのはすごい勢いで崩れていっているからで、太陽の光をあびるとそれが早まっちゃうとか、体の崩壊を止めるには同じ生き物の遺伝情報っていうのが必要なんだとか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But something strange happened: once enough time had passed and my body finished changing, I began to understand all sorts of things.
I knew my body hurt because it was collapsing incredibly fast, that sunlight would make it happen faster, and that I needed genetic information from the same kind of creature to stop it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But it's strange, after a while, after my body has changed completely, I understood a lot of things.
My body hurts because it's being destroyed very fast, and the sunlight acts like a catalyst for that.
And if I want to stop the destruction, I need the genetic information of the same type of living organism as myself."

entries.japanese:
「うん、理屈はよくわからなかったけど、とにかく何をしなくちゃいけないかは簡単だったんだよ。
　わたしは寒かったし、一人で寂しかった。
　あのまま消えちゃうのなんてイヤだったから、とりあえず適当な人の血を吸ったんだ。
　そうしたらね、それがすごく美味しいの！
　体の痛みも薄れて、もうなんだって出来る気がしたんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I didn’t understand the theory, but what I had to do was simple.
I was cold and lonely.
I didn’t want to disappear, so I drank the blood of the first person I found.
And it was delicious! The pain faded, and I felt as though I could do anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I didn't understand the logic that well, but it was plain enough what I had to do.
I was cold, and it was lonely by myself.
I didn't want to disappear, so I just grabbed a random person and sucked his blood.
And you know what?
It was really delicious!
The pain went away and I thought I could do anything.

entries.japanese:
「けど、あんまりにも美味しかったから、気がついたらその人の血を残らず吸っちゃてた。
　その人ね、干からびてミイラみたいになっちゃて、すごく後悔したわ。
わたし、心も体も怪物みたいになっちゃったのかなって。
――――でも、生きていくためにはそうしないといけなかった。
　言ったでしょ、わたしは憎くて人を殺してるんじゃないんだって。
　わたしが人の血を吸うのは志貴くんたちが他の動物を食べてるのと同じ理由だもの。
　だからわたし、あんまり深く考えないようにしたんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It tasted so good that before I knew it, I had drunk every drop.
The person dried up like a mummy, and I regretted it terribly. I wondered if my heart had become monstrous along with my body.
――――But I had to do it to survive.
I told you—I don’t kill people because I hate them.
I drink human blood for the same reason you eat other animals.
So I decided not to think too deeply about it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it was so nice that before I realized it, it was all gone.
The man was all shriveled up, like a mummy, and I felt really bad.
I thought to myself that I was turning into a monster, both in mind and body.
---But, I had to do it in order to live.
Like I said, I didn't kill them because I hated them.
I suck blood the same way you people eat animals.
So I decided not to think about it too deeply."

entries.japanese:
「ば―――――」
　なんだ、それは。
　生きるために必要だから人間を殺してもいいっていうのか。
　そんなこと、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“You—”
What was she saying?
That needing to kill humans to survive made it acceptable?
I could never—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---"
What… is this?
Is it okay to kill other people in order to live?
That… I…

entries.japanese:
「でもね、ようやくわたしも一人前の吸血鬼になれたみたい。
　今夜の食事はわりと楽しかった。
　今まではただ寒くて痛いから血を吸っていたけど、段々とコツがわかってきて面白くなってきたんだ。
　志貴くんなら解るでしょう？
　あなたはわたしなんかより、もっと上質な人殺しなんだもん」
「な――――」
　なに、を。
　なにを言っているんだ、弓塚、は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But now I think I’ve finally become a proper vampire.
Tonight’s meal was rather fun.
Until now I only drank because I was cold and hurting, but I’m learning how it works, and it’s becoming interesting.
You understand, don’t you, Shiki? You’re a much finer killer than I am.”
“What…?”
What was she saying?
What was Yumizuka saying?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it seems I've become a proper vampire.
Tonight's meal was quite fun.
Until now, I've been sucking blood since I was cold and in pain, but now that I'm getting the hang of sucking blood, it's becoming more interesting.
You understand, don't you Shiki-kun?
You are a much better killer than I am."
"Wha---"
What…
What are you talking about, Yumizuka.

entries.japanese:
「言ったでしょう？
　わたしはずっとあなたを見てきた。
だからあなたの優しいところも、恐いところもちゃんとわかってた。
　わたしがあなたに話しかけられなかったのはね、志貴くんの恐いところが何なのか解らなかったからなんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you, didn’t I? I’ve always watched you. I knew the gentle side of you, and the frightening side too.
The reason I could never talk to you was that I didn’t understand what made you frightening.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Didn't I say it before?
I was always watching you, so I know your gentle side and your scary side.
I never talked to you because I didn't understand your scary side."

―――――俺には、理解、できなかった。
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　それで　いい
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――What had just happened?
That’s right
―――――I couldn’t understand it.
That is enough
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----What happened?
#ff0000
That's right.
#ffffff
-----I could not, understand.
#ff0000
That's fine.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
「は―――――――あ」
　……息があがる。
　ナイフを手にして、胃の中のものが、喉からせりあがってくる。
「あ――――はあ―――はあ―――」
　……どうしてなのか。
　彼女を殺してしまった後悔もある。
罪悪感もある。
　けれど、今はそれ以上に―――この感覚にこらえきれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—”
I can’t catch my breath.
Knife in hand, I feel my stomach rise into my throat.
“Ah—hah—hah.”
Why?
I regret killing her. I feel the guilt of it.
But right now, more than either of those things, I cannot endure this sensation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
"Ha------ah."
…… I breathe harder.
Knife still in hand, the contents of my stomach rise to my throat.
"Ah----ghaa--aah--"
…… How come?
There is regret over killing her.
There's also guilt.
But, above all else---I can't rid myself of this feeling.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ―――はあ―――」
　なんて、衝撃。
　この痛みを快楽というのなら、おそらくはこれ以上の快感はこの世には存在しまい。
　そう思えるほど、全身の血がたぎって、どくどくと脈打っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—hah—hah.”
What a shock.
If this pain is pleasure, then no greater pleasure can exist anywhere in the world.
My blood seethes through my whole body, pounding hard enough to convince me of that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aah--ghaa--gah--"
What a shock.
If you call this pain pleasure, then this has to be the greatest pleasure in the world.
That's what I think as I feel this blood pulsing throughout my body.

entries.japanese:
……あなたはそういう人よ。
いまのわたしと同じで、人を殺さないと生きていけない人。
―――――彼女は。
　……呼吸をしなくちゃいきていけないのと同じぐらい、志貴くんにとって殺人行為は当たり前のことなのよ。
―――――人殺しが楽しいといった彼女は、誇らしげに、俺に対してそう言っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
That’s the kind of person you are. You’re like me now—you have to kill people to stay alive.
―――――She had said it.
Killing comes as naturally to you as breathing, Shiki.
―――――The girl who had called murder fun had said it with such pride.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That's the kind of person you are.
Like me, someone who has to kill people to live.
-----She…
…… Your need to kill others is the same as your need to breathe.
-----She said killing others was fun, she proudly said that to me.

entries.japanese:
「―――違う」
　そんなものは違う。
　そんなものを認めるわけにはいかない。
　そんなものを認めてしまっては、自分はまともでいられなくなる。
「――――俺は違う。
キミとは違うよ、弓塚」
　反論に力はなかった。
　視界が歪む。
　ここに―――これ以上いたら、俺はダメになる。
　……戻らないと。
　自分の世界に、遠野志貴の日常に早く戻らないと、この毒に冒されてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No.”
That wasn’t true.
I couldn’t accept it.
If I did, I would never be sane again.
“I’m not like you. I’m different, Yumizuka.”
There was no strength in my denial.
My vision warps.
If I stay here any longer, something in me will break.
I have to go back.
Back to my own world, to the ordinary life of Shiki Tohno, before this poison infects me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No."
No, that's wrong.
I cannot accept that.
If I accept that, I could never live as myself again.
"----I'm different.
I'm different from you, Yumizuka."
There's no power in my denial.
My whole vision wavers.
Here---if I stay here any longer, I'll go crazy.
…… I have to go back.
Back to my world.
I need to hurry back to the normal life of Tohno Shiki, or else I'll be engulfed by this poison.

entries.japanese:
「――――――く」
　鋭い頭痛をかみ殺して、ふらふらと歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Kh.”
I swallow the spike of pain in my skull and stagger away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Gaaah."
Trying to stifle the sharp pain in my head, I start to walk away.

entries.japanese:
………………さむい。
　こんなにさむい思いに一人で耐えてきたのか、弓塚。
　ごめんな―――かわいそうだ、とか思っていながら、俺は全然、その痛みが判っていなかった。
　けど、それも終わり。
　じき遠野志貴は消えて、それで何もかもが終わりになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Cold.
Is this the cold you endured alone, Yumizuka?
I’m sorry, Yumizuka—I had felt sorry for you without understanding your pain at all.
But that is over too.
Soon Shiki Tohno will disappear, and everything will end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………… Cold.
Were you bearing this much cold all by yourself, Yumizuka?
Even as I said sorry----and pitied you, I didn't understand your pain at all.
But, that's over.
Tohno Shiki will soon disappear, and everything will end.

entries.japanese:
―――心音が、遠くなっていく。
　体中の温かなもの、生きていた全てが停止していく。
　懐かしい、感覚。
　八年前の白い夏の日に、孵るような、冷たさ。
　ドク・ン。
　一際高く鳴ったあと、心臓が停止した。
　それで何もかも。
遠野志貴だったモノは消え去った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My heartbeat recedes into the distance.
Every warm thing within me, everything that lived, begins to stop.
A familiar sensation.
A coldness like hatching backward into that white summer day eight years ago.
Thump.
After one final, deafening beat, my heart stops.
And then everything ends. Everything that once was Shiki Tohno vanishes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---My heartbeat gets farther away.
My body warmth, everything that is living, ceases.
A familiar sensation.
That summer day eight years ago, a hatching cold.
THUMP
After screaming loudly, my heart stops.
And everything.
Everything that is Tohno Shiki disappears.

entries.japanese:
ボンジュール！
　またもやデッドエンドを迎えてしまった遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bonjour!
It’s time once again for Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for Tohno,
who has managed to hit yet another dead end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonjour!
Now the hint corner for Tohno-kun who has met yet another Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"

entries.japanese:
三日目の二時間目は家族愛についてです。
　今回遠野くんがデッドしてしまった理由は簡単。
　弓塚さんに噛まれてしまった時、それを跳ね除ける力の要因となってくれる事柄が希薄だったコトでしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lesson two of day three concerns familial love.
The reason Tohno died this time is simple. When Yumizuka bit him, the feelings that might have given him the strength to throw her off were too weak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The second period lesson of the third day will be about filial love.
The reason you died this time is simple, Tohno-kun.
There wasn't enough incentive in you to pull Yumizuka-san off of you the instant she bit you.

entries.japanese:
家族の絆は大切に。
　クラスメイトも大事です。
　遠野くんはもっとお兄ちゃんとして妹さんを気にかけてあげないといけないし、クラスメイトだった子の思いにもなんらかの応えを出してあげないと。
　はい、なにしろ二人とも年期入ってますからね～。
entries.maoEnglish:
Treasure the bonds of family.
Your classmates matter too.
Tohno needs to pay more attention to his little sister as her older brother, and he owes some kind of answer to the feelings of the girl who used to be his classmate. After all, both girls have been carrying those feelings for a very long time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonds of family are very important.
Classmates are also important.
You have to make sure you concern yourself with being a good Onii-chan, and you have to somehow answer your classmate's love.
Yes, you have obligations to both of them.

entries.japanese:
それではちょっしたアドバイス。
　ここにきてしまった遠野くんは少し前に戻って、ちゃんと弓塚さんへの誠心誠意を見せてみるといいかもしれません。
　それでは皆さん、また次の授業で会いましょー。
entries.maoEnglish:
Here is a little advice.
If you ended up here, go back a short way and show Yumizuka that you sincerely care.
That’s all, everyone—I’ll see you at the next lesson.
entries.mirrorMoon:
So a little piece of advice.
Tohno-kun, it's probably good if you go back and show Yumizuka-san some sincerity.
Well then, let's meet again in the next lesson, everyone.

entries.japanese:
――――そんな危険な真似はできない。
　路地裏なんて、入ったら最後、誰も助けが来てくれない行き止まりだ。
　ただ物音がしただけでそんな場所に行こうとするなんて、どうかしている。
　夜も遅いし、今夜はこのまま帰るべきだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I can’t take a risk like that.
An alley is a dead end. Once inside, no one will come to help.
Going into a place like that over nothing more than a noise would be insane.
It was already late; I should go straight home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I can't do something that dangerous.
If I went into an alley like that, no one can come to help me.
There's something wrong with me wanting to go in there just because I heard a noise.
It is getting late and I should head back.

entries.japanese:
途中、誰にもすれ違わずに屋敷まで帰ってきた。
　屋敷の明かりはみな消えている。
　連絡もいれず、こんな夜遅くに帰ってくることになるなんて思いもしなかった。
　秋葉―――秋葉はきっと、俺のことを怒っているんだろうな、なんて思いながら、玄関の重いドアに手をかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I met no one on the way back to the mansion.
Every light in the house was out.
I had never expected to come home this late without so much as calling.
Akiha—Akiha must be furious with me, I thought as I put my hand on the heavy front door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion without meeting anyone.
The lights around the mansion are all off.
Somehow, I hadn't realized I would be coming back so late.
Akiha--Akiha will surely be angry with me, I think as I put my hand on the heavy doors.

entries.japanese:
……ロビーには誰もいない。
　時間も時間だ。
　秋葉や翡翠、琥珀さんも部屋に引っ込んで眠っているんだろう。
「……結局探し出せなかったな、弓塚さん」
　けどちゃんと彼女がいるっていう事は判ったんだ。
　これなら―――ちゃんと明日、彼女も学校に来ていることだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The lobby was empty.
At this hour, Akiha, Hisui,
and Kohaku had probably all retired to their rooms.
“In the end, I never found you, Yumizuka.”
But at least I had confirmed that she was still around.
Surely she would be back at school tomorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There's no one in the lobby.
It is late after all.
Akiha, Hisui and Kohaku-san are most likely fast asleep in their rooms.
"…… I couldn't find you after all, Yumizuka-san."
But I know she has to be somewhere.
Then----for sure, she will come to school tomorrow.

entries.japanese:
秋葉たちを起こさないように部屋に戻ってきた。
　夜もふけている。
　明日にそなえて、早々に眠ることにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Careful not to wake anyone, I returned to my room.
It was already late.
I decided to sleep at once and be ready for tomorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to my room silently so as not to wake Akiha and the others.
It's getting late.
To get ready for tomorrow, I have to hurry up and go to sleep.

entries.japanese:
……誰かに自分の名前を呼ばれた気がして、眠りから目覚めた。
「ん…………」
　けだるい体に、少しずつ熱が戻っていく。
　胡乱なままの頭と眼をぐるりと動かすと、ベッドから離れた所に見なれない人影があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I woke with the feeling that someone had called my name.
“Nn…”
Warmth slowly returned to my heavy limbs.
Still muddled with sleep, I looked blearily around the room and saw an unfamiliar silhouette standing some distance from the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I feel as if someone is calling my name as I wake up.
"Mn…………"
A little warmth returns to my body.
I look around suspiciously and see an unfamiliar figure by my bed.

entries.japanese:
「あれ――――翡翠」
「はい。
おはようございます、志貴さま」
　ふかぶかと一礼をする翡翠。
「あ、そっか―――うん、おはよう翡翠」
　答えて体を起こした。
　ここは自分の部屋で、昨日と同じように今朝も翡翠が起こしにきてくれたんだろう。
「ありがと。
着替えたらすぐに居間に行くから、翡翠も戻ってくれていいよ」
「はい。
それでは居間でお待ちしております」
　うなずいて翡翠はドアのほうへと歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh… Hisui.”
“Yes. Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bowed deeply.
“Right… good morning, Hisui.”
I answered and sat up.
This was my room, and Hisui had apparently come to wake me just as she had yesterday.
“Thanks. I’ll come to the sitting room as soon as I’m dressed, so you can go on ahead.”
“Very well. I shall wait for you there.”
Hisui nodded and walked toward the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh----Hisui."
"Yes.
Good morning Shiki-sama."
Hisui bows.
"Ah, right----yeah, morning Hisui."
