I get up as I answer.
This is my room, and just like yesterday, Hisui came to wake me up.
"Thanks.
I'll change and head to the sitting room, so you can go back to what you were doing."
"Yes.
Then I will be waiting in the sitting room."
Hisui bows her head and walks to the door.

entries.japanese:
かつ、かつ、かつ。
　いつもより翡翠の足音が高い。
　翡翠はドアを開けて部屋を退室していこうとして、くるりと振り向いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Click, click, click.
Her footsteps were sharper than usual.
She opened the door to leave, then turned back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tap, tap, tap.
Her footsteps are louder than normal.
She reaches the door and then turns around.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、つかぬ事をお伺いします。
昨夜は何時に帰ってこられたのですか？」
――――昨日。
　たしか弓塚さんを探しに出て、結局見つけられずに帰ってきたのは―――
「……ごめん。
どうしても気になる事があって、遅くまで出かけていた。
……その、今日からはちゃんとするから、大目に見てくれると嬉しいんだけど……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, may I ask you something? What time did you return last night?”
――――Last night.
I had gone looking for Yumizuka and failed to find her. By the time I returned—
“I’m sorry. Something was bothering me, so I stayed out late. I’ll be more responsible from today on, so I’d appreciate it if you could overlook this once…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, forgive me for asking such a question.
What time did you return last night?"
----Yesterday.
If I recall correctly, I went out looking for Yumizuka-san and returned after not finding her----
"…… Sorry.
Something caught my attention and I came back late…… Um, I will be prompt from now on so it would be great if you could overlook it this time……"

entries.japanese:
「……いえ、志貴さまがそのように言われる必要はありません。
主人の予定に合わせるのがわたしたちの仕事ですから。
　ですが、これからはせめてご連絡の一つでもいれてください。
どのような事情であれ、連絡をいれる事はできるはずです」
「―――そうだね。
ごめん、今日からは必ず約束は守る」
「はい。
それでは失礼します」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is no need for you to apologize to me, Master Shiki. It is our duty to accommodate the master’s schedule.
Nevertheless, in the future, please at least telephone us. Whatever the circumstances, it should be possible to send word.” “You’re right.
I’m sorry. From today on, I promise I’ll follow the rules.”
“Very well. Please excuse me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, it is not necessary for you to say such a thing, Shiki-sama.
It is the duty of us servants to work in accordance with the schedule of our masters.
However, I humbly request that you at least contact us.
Whatever the circumstances, you should still be able to let us know."
"----You're right.
Sorry.
I'll keep my promise from now on."
"I understand.
Then please excuse me."

entries.japanese:
「……珍しく怒ってたな、翡翠」
　普段から無表情だから、翡翠が怒るとすごく怒っているように感じられる。
　……その、まるで俺がとんでもない悪さでもしたみたいだ。
「――――さて、起きるか」
　寝巻から学生服に着替えて、居間に向かうことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It was unusual to see Hisui angry…”
She was always so expressionless that when she did get angry,
she seemed furious—as though I had committed some dreadful offense.
“Well, time to get up.”
I changed out of my pajamas and into my school uniform, then headed for the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That was rare.
Hisui seemed pretty angry."
She's always so expressionless, it seemed she really gets angry when she does get angry.
…… As if I did something really terrible.
"----Well then, time to get up."
After changing out of my pajamas and into my school uniform, I head to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉と翡翠の姿があった。
　琥珀さんは厨房のほうで俺の朝食の支度をしてくれているんだろう。
「おはようございます、兄さん」
　秋葉はソファーに座ったまま、こっちの顔色をうかがうように挨拶をしてくる。
「……ああ、おはよう。
昨日はすまなかった」
　挨拶を返して、そのまま食堂に向かう。
　時間的に秋葉とのんびり居間で話をする余裕はないし―――俺自身にも、誰かと話をする余裕なんてなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and Hisui were in the sitting room.
Kohaku was probably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.
“Good morning, Brother.”
Still seated on the sofa, Akiha studied my face as she greeted me.
“Morning. Sorry about yesterday.”
I returned the greeting and started toward the dining room.
There was no time to sit and talk with Akiha—and I myself was in no state to talk to anyone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I find Akiha and Hisui there.
Kohaku-san is probably in the kitchen cooking my breakfast.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、お話があるのですけど―――少し、よろしいですか」
「話？
　別にかまわないけど」
　秋葉の向かいのソファーに座る。
「それでは単刀直入に訊きますけど、昨日は何をしていたんですか？
　翡翠の話じゃ帰ってきたのは深夜だっていうし。
　兄さん、うちの門限が八時だって知っているでしょう？」
　秋葉はまっすぐな目で問いただしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, I need to speak with you. Do you have a moment?”
“Speak with me? Sure.”
I sat on the sofa opposite her.
“Then I’ll be direct. What were you doing yesterday? Hisui says you didn’t return until after midnight.
Brother, you know the curfew in this house is eight o’clock.”
Akiha’s gaze did not waver.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Nii-san."
Sitting on the sofa, Akiha greets me and looks at my expression.
"…… Ah, morning.
Sorry about last night."
Returning her greeting, I head to the dining room.
There really isn't that much time for me to stay and chat with Akiha--and I myself don't really feel like talking to anyone at all.

entries.japanese:
「門限を破ったのは悪かった。
ちょっとクラスメイトが大変な状況っぽくて、捜してたんだ。
……ま、それにしたってただ街を歩いていただけだぞ。
遅くなったのは謝るけど、そう大したことじゃないよ」
「街を歩いていただけって、それは大した事でしょう。
兄さんはまだ未成年なんですから、夜の街になんか行かないでください。
そうでなくても最近は物騒なのに」
「……そりゃあ確かに未成年だけど、危ないコトなんてやってないって。
お酒とかそういうコトには興味はないから安心しろ。
　それにな、これでも男なんだから夜の街ぐらい一人で歩いても危険なコトなんかないよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry I broke curfew. One of my classmates seemed to be in serious trouble, so I went looking for her. But all I did was walk around town. I apologize for being late, but it wasn’t anything dramatic.”
“Walking around town at night is serious. You’re still a minor, Brother, so please don’t go out into the city at night. Things have been dangerous lately.”
“I know I’m underage, but I wasn’t doing anything dangerous. I don’t drink or anything like that, so don’t worry.”
“Besides, I’m a man; walking around the city alone at night isn’t dangerous for me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, I would like to speak with you a little--is that alright?"
"Speak with me?
I don't really mind."
I sit on the sofa across from Akiha.
"This is cutting straight to the heart of the matter, but what were you doing last night?
Hisui says you returned late at night.
Nii-san, you know about our eight o'clock curfew, correct?"
Akiha asks me with a direct stare.

entries.japanese:
「なに言ってるんですか。
そういうセリフはですね、せめて一週間だけでも貧血を起こさずに暮らせるようになってから言ってください。
　こんなこと私が言うまでもないでしょうけど、兄さんの体は無茶がきかないんです。
自分だけ元気なつもりで街を歩いていて、ぱったり倒れたりしたらどうするんですか」
「あ―――――それは、そうだけど」
　秋葉は心配してくれているらしい。
　そう思うと、確かに昨夜の行動は身勝手だったって反省して――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be ridiculous. You can say that after you manage one full week without collapsing from anemia.
I should not have to remind you that your body cannot endure much strain, Brother. What would you do if you wandered around imagining yourself perfectly healthy and suddenly fainted?”
“Well… yes, but…”
She really was worried about me.
Realizing that, I began to regret how selfishly I had behaved the night before—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sorry for breaking the curfew.
A classmate of mine seemed to be having a lot of trouble so I went looking for her…… Well, all I did was walk around.
I apologize for being late, but it isn't a big deal."
"Just walking the streets IS something.
You are still a minor, so please do not wander out late at night.
Even if you weren't, there have been a lot of disturbances going on."
"…… Maybe I am a minor, but I don't do anything dangerous.
I don't care for drinking or anything like that.
You can just relax.
And I'm a guy after all.
Walking around town at night isn't dangerous."

entries.japanese:
「まったく。
そんな事にでもなったら世間体が悪いったらないわ。
遠野家の長男が夜の街で行き倒れた、なんて噂が流れたら、恥ずかしくて学校に行けなくなります」
「う―――――それは、そうだけど」
　……秋葉は、自分の心配をしているらしい。
　そう思うと、昨夜の行動は身勝手だった、と一瞬でも反省した自分がバカみたいだ。
「とにかく、今日はきちんと門限を守ってくださいね。
あと一回門限を破ったら、当主として罰則を与えますから」
　ふん、と肩で風を切って、秋葉は居間から退室していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, the scandal would be unbearable. If people heard that the eldest son of the Tohno family had collapsed in the nightlife district, I would be too ashamed to show my face at school.”
“Urgh… yes, but…”
Apparently Akiha was worried about herself.
For one brief moment I had reflected on my selfishness. Now I felt like an idiot.
“In any case, you will observe curfew today. Break it once more and, as head of the family, I will impose a penalty.”
With a disdainful huff, Akiha swept out of the sitting room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying?
Please say those kind of words after you can go a week without anemia.
I shouldn't have to say this, but you shouldn't strain your body.
You might plan on walking around energetically, but you'll end up collapsing all of a sudden.
What would you do then?"
"Ah------that may be true, but…"
Akiha seems to be worrying about me.
When I think about it that way, I start to feel that maybe last night was a little selfish----

entries.japanese:
「……罰則って、秋葉」
　冗談とは思うんだけど、本気にしか聞こえないあたり、秋葉は難しいと思う。
「志貴さーん、朝ごはんですよー」
　食堂から琥珀さんの声が聞こえてくる。
　席を立って、食堂に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A penalty? Akiha…”
It sounded like a joke, yet somehow also sounded entirely serious. Akiha was difficult that way.
“Master Shiki, breakfast is ready!”
Kohaku called from the dining room.
I rose and went in.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Goodness.
If you do that what would others think?
For the eldest son of the Tohno family to collapse late at night in town, the rumors would make me so embarrassed I couldn't even go to school."
"Uh------that may be true, but…"
…… Akiha seems to be worrying about herself.
I start to think I was stupid for thinking last night was selfish.
"Anyway, please keep the curfew tonight.
If you break it again, I will have to hand down a punishment on you as head of the household."
Akiha whirls around quickly and exits the room.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、今日のお帰りはいつごろになるでしょうか？」
「ああ、今日は土曜日だから早めに帰ってくるよ。
遅くなると秋葉が何を企むか解らないし」
　うん。
正直、ちょっと怖い。
「……かしこまりました。
それではどうぞお気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ」
　ふかぶかと一礼する。
　翡翠に見送られて、屋敷を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, when do you expect to return today?”
“It’s Saturday, so I’ll be home early. If I’m late, there’s no telling what Akiha might be plotting.”
Yes. Honestly, the thought frightened me a little.
“Understood. Please take care on your way.”
Hisui bowed deeply.
Hisui saw me off as I left the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Punishment, Akiha?"
I think it was a joke, but she certainly sounded serious.
"Shiki-saaaan, breakfaaaast!"
Kohaku-san's voice rings out from the dining room.
I rise and head towards the dining room.

entries.japanese:
―――教室に着くなり、弓塚さんの姿を捜す。
　女子のグループの中に彼女はいない。
　まだ登校していないのか、それとも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The moment I entered the classroom, I looked for Yumizuka.
She was not among the clusters of girls.
Perhaps she had not arrived yet. Or perhaps—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, around what time will you be returning today?"
"Yeah, today is Saturday so I'll be back early.
I don't know what Akiha will do if I get back late either."
Yeah.
To be honest, it's a little scary.
"I understand.
Well then, please be attentive and take care of yourself."
She gives her customary bow.
After Hisui sees me off, I leave the mansion.

entries.japanese:
「よっ、何かお探しですか遠野くん」
　……と、おなじみの顔が、横からカニの如くスササササ、と現れた。
「ああ、何かお探ししてる最中だ。
わかってるなら邪魔するなよな、有彦」
「ふふーん。
さっちんなら捜してもムダだぜ。
今日は学校休むそうだからな」
　有彦はにひひ、と意味ありげに含み笑いをする。
……なんか、一から十まで見抜かれているようで、タイヘンよろしくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning, Tohno. Looking for something?”
A familiar face scuttled in sideways like a crab.
“Yes, I am. If you already know that, don’t get in my way, Arihiko.”
“Heh-heh. No point looking for Sats. She’s staying home today.”
Arihiko gave me a knowing, unpleasant little grin. I disliked the distinct impression that he had seen through absolutely everything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----As I arrive at my classroom I look for Yumizuka-san.
She isn't in the group of girls.
She hasn't come yet?
Or maybe----

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよ、そのさっちんって」
「さっちんはさっちんさ。
弓塚嬢なら昨夜のうちに警察に保護されて、今日は自宅謹慎だとよ。
今さっき高田くんがチョコ食いながら話してたぜ」
「え―――弓塚さん、家に帰ったのか」
　どこか、おかしな違和感を覚えた。
「おう。
信用できないんなら高田くんに直接聞けよ。
なんでも弓塚とは近所らしいぜ、あいつ」
「―――――――――」
　ちらり、と自分の隣のクラスメイトを流し目に見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s with ‘Sats’?” “Sats is Sats.
The police picked up our dear Yumizuka last night, and she’s confined to home today. Takada was talking about it a minute ago while eating chocolate.”
“What—Yumizuka went home?”
Something about it felt strangely wrong.
“Yep. Ask Takada yourself if you don’t believe me.
Apparently he and Yumizuka are neighbors.”
“—” I glanced sidelong at the classmate sitting beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yo.
are you looking for something Tohno-kun?"
…… The familiar face of my friend appears from the side like a crab.
"Yeah.
I'm in the middle of looking, so don't get in my way, Arihiko."
"Oh reeeeally?
If you're looking for Sacchin, it's useless.
It seems she'll skip school today too."
Arihiko giggles meaningfully…… He seems to have seen right through me.

entries.japanese:
高田くんはいつも通り、ポリポリとチョコを食べている。
クリスマスにはサンタクロースの擬態をして、袋の中にチョコレートをつめて道を歩きながらモグモグ食べるらしい。
　……脇のクセに、なかなかにおいしいキャラクター性だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Takada was crunching chocolate as usual. At Christmas, I was told, he dressed as Santa Claus, filled his sack with chocolate, and munched his way down the street.
For a background character, he had a remarkably memorable gimmick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's this Sacchin thing?"
"Sacchin is Sacchin.
Miss Yumizuka was taken in by the police last night and is now under house arrest.
Takada-kun told me while he was eating chocolate."
"Eh----Yumizuka-san returned home?"
Something seems a little out of place.
"Hey.
If you don't believe me ask Takada-kun.
He seems to be one of Yumizuka's neighbors."
"---------"
I look around to my classmate nearby.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、いい。
高田くんは無闇に噂をたてるヤツじゃないだろ。
それ、きっと本当だよ」
「だろうな。
女連中の中には何人か会ったっていうヤツもいるし、国藤も今朝、一番で弓塚の家に行ったらしいし。
……ま、弓塚もこれからが大変だろうけど」
　有彦は難しい顔をして自分の席へと戻っていった。
――――ホームルーム開始のチャイムが鳴る。
　どこか釈然としない気持ちのまま、自分の席について担任の国藤教諭の到着を待つ事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, never mind. Takada isn’t the type to spread a careless rumor. It must be true.” “Probably.
A few girls say they’ve seen her, and Mr. Kunifuji went straight to Yumizuka’s house first thing this morning. Though I suppose the hard part starts now for her.”
Arihiko returned to his desk with an unusually grave expression.
――――The bell rang for homeroom.
Still vaguely unsettled, I took my seat and waited for our homeroom teacher, Mr. Kunifuji.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As usual, Takada-kun is eating chocolate.
He looks like he's doing his best impression of Santa Claus as he munches while walking.
…… Quite the interesting person for a side character.

entries.japanese:
……うちの担任である国藤はやってこなかった。
結局ホームルームがないまま授業が始まって、土曜の授業はあっさりと終わってしまった。
　クラスメイト達は早足で教室を後にしていく。
　部活のある者は昼食を食べに、ないものは手早く家に帰って土曜の午後を有効に使うのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Mr. Kunifuji never came.
Lessons began without homeroom, and the short Saturday schedule ended uneventfully.
My classmates hurried out—club members to lunch, everyone else home to make the most of the afternoon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, I'll pass.
Takada-kun isn't one to spread rumors so it's most likely true."
"Yeah.
A lot of girls have gone by to visit her and Kunifuji went this morning to her house…… Well, it seems like Yumizuka will have a rough time for a while."
Arihiko returns to his chair with a difficult expression.
----The homeroom bell rings.
Still feeling a bit vague about it all, I wait for Kunifuji-sensei's arrival.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――さて」
　こっちもゆっくりとしている必要はない。
　屋敷に帰って、それからどうするか考えよう、と席を立つ。
――――、と。
『二年三組の遠野志貴君、至急職員室に来なさい』
　なんて、校内放送が流れ出した。
「………なんだろう。
呼び出されるようなコトしたかな、俺」
　はて、と首をかしげながら教室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well…”
I had no reason to linger either.
I rose, intending to go home and decide what to do next.
――――And then.
“Shiki Tohno of Class 2-3, report to the faculty office immediately.”
The announcement rang through the school.
“What could that be? Did I do something?”
Puzzled, I left the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Our teacher Kunifuji didn't come.
Classes started without homeroom and the Saturday class ended quickly.
My classmates exit the room hastily.
Those with club activities go to the cafeteria while those without any hurry on home to spend the rest of their Saturday elsewhere.

entries.japanese:
―――まあ、考えてみれば思い当たる所はあった。
　学生服のまま夜の街を走り続けていれば、そりゃあ学校側にだって知られてしまう。
　うちの学校は二流ではあるものの、それなりの進学校だから校則はわりとうるさい。
　……とりあえず厳重注意、という事で叱られた後、生徒指導室で反省文を書かされるハメになった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――On reflection, one possibility came readily to mind.
Running around town at night in my school uniform was bound to get back to the administration.
The school might be second-rate, but it was still academically ambitious and strict about its rules.
After a severe reprimand, I was sent to the disciplinary room to write a formal apology.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Well then."
There's no need to laze around here.
I should go back to the mansion and think about what to do from there.
I stand out of my chair.
----And then,
"Will Second Year, Third Class Tohno Shiki-kun please report to the Staff Room immediately."
Says the intercom announcement.
"…… What's this?
I didn't do anything to be called up."
Tilting my head out of question, I leave the classroom.

entries.japanese:
「…………日が落ちちゃったんですけど、国藤先生」
　ぽつん、と一人残された生徒指導室で呟いてみる。
　一時間したら反省文を取りに来る、と言ったうちのクラスの担任はなしのつぶてだ。
　……時計は六時半を回ってしまった。
　このままでは今日も秋葉にチクチクと文句を言われるハメになる。
「――――はあ。
もう帰りますからね、俺は」
　居もしない教諭に対して敬語を使う、なんて自分の甘さに飽き飽きしながら席を立った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The sun has gone down, Mr. Kunifuji.”
I muttered to the empty disciplinary room.
My homeroom teacher had promised to collect my essay in an hour, then vanished without a word.
The clock had passed six-thirty.
At this rate Akiha would spend another evening needling me.
“I’m going home now, whether you like it or not.”
Disgusted with myself for addressing an absent teacher so politely, I rose.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Come to think of it, maybe it is natural.
The school was bound to find out if I was walking around late at night in my school uniform.
My school is second-rate but still oriented towards attending university so there are a lot of troublesome rules.
…… After being sternly warned by the student guidance counselor, I end up writing an essay of apology.

entries.japanese:
教室には当然のように誰もいない。
　自分の机に歩み寄って、鞄を手にとって廊下に出ようとした時。
「こんばんは、遠野くん」
　と、トウトツに、呼びかけられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Naturally, the classroom was empty.
I went to my desk, picked up my bag, and turned toward the hall. Just then—
“Good evening, Tohno.”
The greeting came without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… It's getting late, Kunifuji-sensei."
I mutter to myself in the empty room.
The teacher told me he would come back after an hour.
…… It's half-past six already.
It seems Akiha will scold me once more.
"-----Fine.
I'll be heading back now."
I announce this to the teacher who isn't here in an attempt to convince myself and stand up.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――！？」
　咄嗟に後ろに振り向く。
―――明かりのない暗い教室。
　蒼ざめた月明かりを背にして、弓塚さつきがそこに居た。
「え――――弓塚、さん？」
「奇遇だね。
遠野くんもまだ残ってたんだ。
もしかして生徒指導室にいたの？」
「あ――――ああ。
ちょっと、つまんない事で居残らされてたんだけど―――」
「そうなんだ。
わたしもね、昨日の事で呼び出されてたんだよ。
それも遠野くんがいた生徒指導室の隣の教室」
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!?”
I whirled around.
―――The classroom lay dark, lit only by pallid moonlight.
Satsuki Yumizuka stood with that light behind her.
“Yumizuka…?”
“What a coincidence. You stayed late too, Tohno.
Were you in the disciplinary room?” “Yes… I got detention over something stupid.”
“I see. I was called in because of yesterday. They put me in the room right beside yours.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Of course, the classroom is empty.
I walk over to my desk to take the bag in my hand and exit to the hallway.
"Good evening, Tohno-kun."
Suddenly, someone calls my name.

entries.japanese:
言って、彼女は笑った。
　以前のままの、屈託のない柔らかな笑み。
「――――――――」
　なのに、どうしてか。
　理由もなく、背筋がバキンと、音をたてそうなぐらい、寒かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She smiled—the same soft,
guileless smile as before.
“—” Yet for no reason I could name,
a cold so fierce it seemed ready
to snap my spine went through me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------!?"
I whirl around instantly.
----In the dark, unlit classroom.
Yumizuka Satsuki sits with her back to the blue moonlight.
"Eh----Yumizuka, san?"
"What a coincidence.
You are still here Tohno-kun?
Don't tell me you were in the guidance counselor's room?"
"Ah----yeah.
Just a little unpleasantness there----"
"I see.
You know, I was called there about last night too.
I was in the very next room."

entries.japanese:
「そっかぁ、となりにいたのは遠野くんだったんだ。
ふふ、学校の壁って薄いから、となりの部屋の様子はなんとなく分かるんだよね。
　まだ生きてる遠野くんの体温とか息遣いとか、もっとちゃんと楽しんでおけばよかったかな」
　弓塚さんと視線が合う。
　ゆらり。
　ぐにゃり。
　地面が曲がっていくような、不安定さ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that was you next door. The walls here are thin; you can get a sense of what’s happening in the other room.
Maybe I should have savored it more—your warmth, your breathing, while you were still alive.”
Yumizuka’s eyes met mine.
The world swayed.
Buckled.
The floor seemed to bend beneath me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She smiles as she says so.
A gentle, carefree smile like before.
"--------"
So why is it?
For no reason, a chill runs up my spine.

entries.japanese:
「でも丁度良かった。
わたし、遠野くんにお願いしたいことがあったんだ。
ね、いいかな遠野くん？」
「いや―――俺に出来る事なら、できるだけ善処する、けど」
「そう？
　なら言っちゃうね。
遠野くん、わたしと付き合ってくれないかな」
―――？
　まあ、そんな事でいいんなら、いいけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But this works out perfectly. There’s something I wanted to ask you. Is that okay, Tohno?”
“If it’s something I can do, I’ll do my best…”
“Really? Then I’ll say it. Tohno, would you go out with me?”
―――Huh?
Well, if that was all, then sure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see… it was you next door.
Huhu, the school rooms are narrow so you can somehow understand what is going on next door.
Your live body warmth or your breathing… it would have been nice for me to enjoy it longer."
Our eyes meet.
Swaying.
Stretching.
This instability as if the floor was bending.
"But it's great timing.
I… have a request for you Tohno-kun.
Is it alright?"
"Uh----sure, I'll do it if I can."
"Really?
Then I'll ask.
Tohno-kun, can you go out with me?"
----?
Well, if that's it… sure.

entries.japanese:
「いいけど、何か買い物でもあるの？
　これからだとあんまりいい店はやってないと思うけど」
「………………………」
　ぼう、と弓塚さんは俺を見つめてくる。
　……あれ。
なんか、違ったみたいだ。
「もう、違うよ遠野くん。
買い物に付き合うんじゃなくて、恋人として付き合うの」
　クスクスと楽しそうに弓塚さんは笑っている。
「え――――――」
　俺は。
いきなりの告白に、頭がうまく働いてくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sure, but did you want to go shopping? Most of the good stores will be closed by now.”
“…”
Yumizuka stared blankly at me.
Apparently I had misunderstood.
“No, silly. I don’t mean come shopping with me.
I mean be my boyfriend.”
Yumizuka giggled delightedly.
“What—” Faced with that sudden confession, my mind stopped working.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sure, do you have something you need to buy?
I don't think there's too many good stores open right now though."
"……………………"
She looks at me blankly.
…… Huh?
It seems like I was a little off.
"Oh, that's not it Tohno-kun.
I'm not asking you to take me out shopping.
I'm asking you to go out with me like a lover."
Yumizuka-san giggles happily.
"Eh------"
After… such a sudden confession… my brain… doesn't seem to work… properly.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待った。
弓塚さん、それは――――」
　嬉しい、けど。
　いきなりそんな事を言われても、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait.
Yumizuka, that’s…”
I was happy, but she had sprung it on me so suddenly that I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a second.
Yumizuka-san, I----"
I'm happy, but…
To be told this all of a sudden, I----

entries.japanese: まあ―――問題は――――ない――――かな。
entries.maoEnglish: Well… there wasn’t… any problem… was there?
entries.mirrorMoon: Well----no-----problem----right?

entries.japanese:
「そう……だね。
問題は、ない、と思う」
「ほんと！？
　やったあ、じゃあこれからは志貴くんって呼ぶね！
　良かった、わたし志貴くんには嫌われてるって思ってたから、ホントは諦めてたんだ。
　……うん。
これならわざわざ先生を使って志貴くんを居残らせる必要もなかったかな」
　ぽつりと。
　よくワカラナイ事を、彼女は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes… I don’t think… there’s any problem.”
“Really?! Yes—then I’ll call you Shiki from now on! I’m so glad; I thought you hated me, so I’d already given up.”
“…Maybe I didn’t need to use the teacher to keep you here after all.”
Under her breath.
She said something I couldn’t make sense of.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah…… there's, no problem… I think."
"Really!?
Yay!
Then I'll call you Shiki-kun from now on!
I'm so glad.
I was worried that you might hate me for saying that.
…… Yeah.
Maybe I didn't need to use the teacher to make sure you stayed late."
She mumbles.
I don't quite grasp what she said.

entries.japanese:
「ね、志貴くん。
わたし、すごく勇気を出して告白したんだ。
わたしがどれだけ怖かったか、志貴くんなら解るでしょう？」
　まっすぐに見つめてくる。
　その目。
　その目がどうしてか、赤く、見えて―――酸欠になったみたいに、思考が断片していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen, Shiki. I had to gather so much courage to confess. You understand how frightened I was, don’t you?”
She looked straight at me.
Those eyes.
Somehow they seemed red—and my thoughts fragmented as though I had run out of air.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey Shiki-kun.
I really used a lot of courage to tell you.
Did you know how scared I was, Shiki-kun?"
She looks at me directly.
Her eyes.
Why… do her eyes look red----and as if I was asphyxiated, my brain stops working.

entries.japanese:
「―――ああ。
よく頑張ったね、弓塚さん」
「……うん。
だから、ね。
わたし、志貴くんにご褒美をもらいたいなあって。
　わたし、今までずっと我慢してたから―――志貴くんに、してもらいたい」
「してもらいたいって、何を？」
「簡単だよ。
志貴くんからね、わたしにキスしてほしいんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. You did very well, Yumizuka.”
“Mm. So I thought I might deserve a reward.
I’ve been holding myself back for so long—I want you to do something for me.”
“Do what?”
“It’s simple. I want you to kiss me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Yeah.
You did well, Yumizuka-san."
"…… Yeah.
So, hey.
Maybe I should get a reward from you, Shiki-kun?
I've been waiting so long----I want you to do it, Shiki-kun."
"Do what?"
"Simple.
I want you to kiss me, Shiki-kun."

entries.japanese:
―――まずい。
　それはまずいと、心の何処かが警告を鳴らしている。
―――だから？
　そんなものは知らない。
　彼女が―――弓塚さんが望んでいるんなら、別にいいじゃないか。
　俺たちは恋人同士なんだし―――それぐらい、普通の行為だと、思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Danger.
Somewhere inside me, an alarm insisted that this was dangerous.
―――So what?
I didn’t care.
If she—if Yumizuka wanted it, what was wrong with that?
We were lovers now. A kiss was perfectly ordinary. I thought.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----This isn't good.
Somewhere in my mind, something screams at me in warning.
----So…?
I don't care about that.
If she----if Yumizuka-san wants it, what's wrong with it?
We are lovers----so isn't it normal?

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
動かないで、弓塚さん」
　弓塚さんに向かって歩いていく。
　かつん、という乾いた足音。
　机と机の間を歩いて、窓際にいる彼女まで近寄っていく。
　……その、途中。
　机の谷間に隠れるように、何人かの女生徒が倒れているのが見えた。
　そのどれもが首もとから血を流している。
　なのに、どうしても―――俺は、彼女たちに関心を持てなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. Don’t move, Yumizuka.”
I walked toward her,
my shoes striking the floor with dry clicks
as I passed between the desks to the window.
On the way,
I saw several girls lying hidden in the narrow valleys between desks.
Blood ran from every throat.
Yet no matter how I tried, I could not make myself care about them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright.
Don't move, Yumizuka-san."
I walk towards Yumizuka-san.
The dry sounds of my footsteps.
I walk in between the desks to draw closer to the girl by the window.
…… As I do,
I see the bodies of many female students collapsed in between the desks as if they were hidden.
Blood flows from each of their necks.
But still----I couldn't care less about them.

entries.japanese:
――――弓塚さんは動かない。
　彼女の両腕を握って、そのまま、何の感情もない、口付けをした。
「……ふふ。
これで志貴くんはわたしのものだ」
　ひどく、邪悪な。
　呟きが、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Yumizuka did not move.
I took her by both arms and kissed her without a trace of feeling.
“Hee-hee. Now you belong to me, Shiki.”
Unspeakably evil.
A whisper reached me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Yumizuka-san doesn't move.
Grabbing both her arms, I press my lips to hers emotionlessly.
"…… Huhu.
With this, you are mine Shiki-kun."
Her whisper sounds incredibly evil.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――――ぐっ…………！？」
　床に倒れる。
　びちゃり、という音。
　見れば床は所々が血まみれで、机の下には何十人という、クラスメイトたちの亡骸が放置されていた。
「な―――――――」
　立ちあがろうと腕をたてて、倒れた。
　体に力が入らない。
　熱。
熱が、急速に、冷めていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh…!”
I fell to the floor
with a wet splash.
Blood covered the floor in patches.
Beneath the desks lay the bodies of dozens of my classmates.
“What—” I braced an arm to rise, then collapsed again.
I couldn’t muster any strength.
My heat—my heat was draining away with terrifying speed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-------rghh……!?"
I collapse onto the floor.
A splashing sound.
I didn't notice it before, but the floor is splattered with blood.
Under the desks lie the discarded corpses of my classmates strewn about.
"Wha------"
I try to stand up using my arms but I fall back down again.
There's no strength in my body.
Heat.
The heat, suddenly turns cold.

entries.japanese:
「安心して、志貴くん。
貴方は他の人たちみたいにはしないから。
ずっとそうして、わたしの声だけを聞いていてくれればいいんだよ」
―――冷たい声。
　何がどうしているのか、これっぽっちも解らない。
　これっぽっちも解らないっていうのに、これが間違っている事だけは、吐き気がするほど理解できた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be afraid, Shiki. I won’t do to you what I did to the others. You only have to stay there forever and listen to my voice.”
―――A cold voice.
I understood nothing of what was happening.
Nothing at all—yet I understood with nauseating certainty that it was wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Relax Shiki-kun.
I won't make you like them.
All you have to do is listen to my voice just like this."
----Her cold voice.
I don't understand at all what she's doing.
Even though I don't understand anything, I know this is so wrong it makes me nauseous.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――――――！」
　手足に力をこめて床を這う。
　だが、それも。
彼女の声にさえぎられて、不可能になった。
「だめ、もう逃げられないし、逃がしてあげないもの。
　……さあ。
まずはココからわたしの世界を広げようかな。
志貴くんも手伝ってくれるでしょう？
　ピンチの時には助けてくれるっていう約束を反古にしたんだから、これからはずっと、わたしの我が侭を聞いてもらうんだから」
　くすくす、という忍び笑い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
I forced strength into my limbs and crawled.
Even that became impossible when her voice stopped me.
“No. You can’t escape anymore, and I won’t let you.
Now, where should I begin spreading my world? Right here, perhaps. You’ll help me, won’t you, Shiki? You broke your promise to save me when I was in trouble, so from now on you’ll indulge every selfish wish I have.”
Her muffled laughter followed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ghh--------!"
I strain my arms and legs as I crawl on the floor.
But even that was stopped with her voice.
"No.
You can't get away.
I won't let you get away.
…… C'mon.
First we have to expand my world.
You'll help me won't you?
You broke your promise to help me whenever I was in a pinch, so you have to listen to whatever I say from now on."
She chuckles.

entries.japanese:
……遠くなっていく心臓の鼓動。
　床に満ちた血の薫りで、気が遠くなる。
　だから、もし目覚める事があるのなら、それは。
　もう、二度と自分の体温を感じられなくなるコトだと、理解した。
　月明かりだけの教室で。
　弓塚さつきは、ゆっくりと、遠野志貴の首元に牙を突きたてた。
entries.maoEnglish:
My heartbeat receded into the distance.
The fragrance of the blood flooding the floor made consciousness slip away.
And I understood that if I ever woke again,
I would never feel the warmth of my own body.
In the classroom lit only by moonlight,
Satsuki Yumizuka slowly sank her fangs into Shiki Tohno’s throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My distant heartbeat.
The fragrance of the blood drenching the floor makes me dizzy.
So, if I ever do wake up again, then…
I realized my body will never feel warm again.
In the moonlit classroom,
Yumizuka Satsuki slowly bites into Tohno Shiki's neck.

entries.japanese:
ボンジュール！
　かくも容易くデッドエンドを迎えてしまったおませな遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
　さて、三日目の一時間目です。
残る授業は秋葉さんだけですねー
entries.maoEnglish:
Bonjour!
Welcome to Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for our precocious Tohno,
who stumbled into a dead end with astonishing ease.
This is lesson one of day three, and only Akiha’s lessons remain now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonjour!
And now the hint corner for the sake of the precocious Tohno-kun who easily meets another Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
Now, the first period lesson of the third day.
The only remaining lessons are about Akiha-san's route.

entries.japanese:
「んにゃ？
　せんせい、どうして秋葉より翡翠の授業の方が早く終わってるの？」
　その質問は却下します。
　さて、遠野くん。
　お気持ちは解りますが、弓塚さんの大ピンチです。
「？？？？
　むしろ志貴のほうが大ピンチなんじゃない？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Meow? Teacher, why did Hisui’s lessons finish before Akiha’s?”
That question is rejected.
Now, Tohno.
I understand how you feel, but Yumizuka is in terrible danger.
“Huh? Isn’t Shiki the one in terrible danger?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nnya?
Sensei, why would Hisui's lessons be done before Akiha's?"
Question denied.
Now, Tohno-kun.
I understand how you feel, but Yumizuka-san is in big trouble.
"????
Isn't Shiki the one in trouble?"

entries.japanese:
いいから大ピンチです。
　同級生の女の子がＳＯＳなんですから、君子危うに近寄らずを気取っている場合ではありません。
　少し前に戻って、ちゃんと路地裏を調べて下さいね。
　それではまた、次の授業で会いましょう！
entries.maoEnglish:
She is in terrible danger because I say so.
A girl in your class is sending an SOS, so this is no time to play the prudent man and keep away from danger.
Go back a little and investigate the alley properly.
I’ll see you at the next lesson!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Enough, it is big trouble.
A girl your own age is in trouble, so this is no time to be shying away from danger.
Please go back a little earlier and be sure to investigate the back alley.
Well then, see you in the next lesson!

entries.japanese:
「……なっとくいかない。
どうして秋葉より翡翠のが先なのよー」
「わたし、なっとくいかないぞ。
　正ヒロインなのにぜんぜん出番ないし、志貴はわたしのこと無視するし！」
「そうだ、なっとくいかないのだ！
　わたしだけならまだしもシエルは出番あるみたいじゃん！
　なのにわたしは後ろ姿だけだし、くわえてさっちんの方が吸血鬼らしいなんてどういうコトだきのこー！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m not satisfied. Why did Hisui finish before Akiha?”
“I’m not satisfied at all! I’m the main heroine, but I never get any screen time, and Shiki keeps ignoring me!”
“That’s right, it’s completely unfair! It would be one thing if it were just me, but Ciel still seems to get scenes! All anyone sees of me is my back, and how is Satsuki more vampire-like than I am, Kinoko?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't get it.
Why would Hisui be done before Akiha?"
"I just don't get it.
I'm the main heroine and I don't get much screen time, and Shiki ignores me!"
"Yeah, I don't get it!
It's just me, and even Ciel has an appearance!
But you only get to see me from behind.
What's more, Sacchin is acting more like a vampire than I am!
What the heck is this, Kinoko!?"

entries.japanese: 「なっとくいかない、なっとくいかない、なっとくいかなーい！」
entries.maoEnglish: “It’s unfair, it’s unfair, it’s completely unfair!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I just don't get it.
Don't get it, don't get it!!!"

entries.japanese:
――――強い陽射しで目が覚めた。
「……………ん」
　ベッドから起きて窓の外に視線を送る。
　窓ごしに見える空は快晴で、日曜日に相応しいぐらい気持ちのいい天気だ。
　……それは。
　昨夜の出来事が夢のようにさえ思える、雲一つない青空だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Brilliant sunlight woke me.
“Mm.”
I sat up in bed and looked out the window.
The sky was perfectly clear, the kind of beautiful weather a Sunday deserved.
It was.
A cloudless blue sky, enough to make everything that happened last night seem like a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I awaken to brilliant sunshine.
"…………… Mmmn."
I climb out of bed and look out the window.
The weather out the window is beautiful, truly fitting for a Sunday.
…… That is,
there isn't a cloud in the sky, as if trying to tell me everything that happened yesterday was just a dream.

entries.japanese:
「…………朝、か」
　ずきりと胸が痛む。
　空はこの上ないぐらいの青空で、自分はいつも通りの朝を迎えている。
　そんな事が、ただ、いたたまれなかった。
　彼女は。
　昨日の夜、消えてしまった彼女はもう二度と、こんな朝を迎えられる事がないんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning.”
Pain stabbed through my chest.
The sky was impossibly blue, and here I was, waking to an ordinary morning.
I could hardly bear it.
That girl.
The girl who vanished last night would never see another morning like this—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Is it morning?"
My chest hurts.
The unmatched clear sky greets me, as it always does.
But, that fact just hurts me too much.
That girl.
The girl who disappeared last night will never be able to experience a morning like this again----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お目覚めでしょうか？」
　……その声で現実に引き戻された。
「……なにを、いまさら」
　俺が後悔した所で、そんなものは偽善だろう。
「志貴さま？
　起きていらっしゃいますか、志貴さま？」
　トントン、という控えめなノックの音。
　俺は自分の部屋に戻ってきている。
　こうして、どんなに悔やんでもいつも通りに朝を迎えるしかない。
　それが生きているかぎり、避けようのない現実だ。
　それを今更、悔やんでも始まらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
The voice pulled me back to reality.
“It is too late for that.”
Regret from me would be nothing but hypocrisy.
“Master Shiki? Are you awake, Master Shiki?”
A discreet tap at the door.
I had returned to my own room.
No matter how bitterly I regretted it, I still had to wake to another ordinary morning.
As long as I lived, there was no escaping that reality.
Regretting it now would change nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you awake?"
…… That voice brings me back to reality.
"…… What is it, all of a sudden… ?"
Being regretful, is that hypocrisy?
"Shiki-sama?
Are you awake, Shiki-sama?"
Knock-knock, comes a hesitant sound at the door.
I am back in my room.
No matter how much regret I feel, I wake up just like always.
As long as I live, I can't escape reality.
No matter how much I regret it.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、起きてるよ。
どうぞ、入ってきて」
「失礼します」
　がちゃり、と扉を開けて翡翠が入ってくる。
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
　着替えを持ってきたのか、翡翠は洗濯したての洋服を持ってきてくれた。
「おはよう翡翠。
えっと、秋葉たちはもう朝食を済ませたのか？」
「……志貴さま。
失礼ですが、お目覚めになってから時間を確認なさいましたか？」
「え――？
　時間って、まだ朝の―――」
　朝の、十二時をとっくに過ぎていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yeah, I'm awake. Come in.”
“Excuse me.”
The door clicked open, and Hisui entered.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui had brought a set of freshly laundered clothes for me.
“Morning, Hisui. Has Akiha finished breakfast already?”
“Master Shiki. Forgive me, but did you happen to check the time after waking?”
“Huh? It's still morning—”
It was already well past noon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I'm up.
Come in."
"Please excuse me."
The door opens with a clink and Hisui enters.
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
Did she come to get my change of clothes?
She's carrying a clean set.
"Morning, Hisui.
Um, has everyone had breakfast already?"
"…… Shiki-sama.
Forgive my rudeness, but did you check the time since you woke up?"
"Eh--?
The time?
It's still morning--"
The clock claims it's just past twelve.

entries.japanese:
「えぇ―――？
　な、なんでもう昼になってるんだ、この時計？」
「いつのまにか正午になっていたのは時計ではなく志貴さまのほうだと思います。
　朝方から何回かお起こしいたしましたが、一向に目を覚ましてはいただけませんでした」
「………………」
　……よっぽど深い眠りだったんだろう。
　精神面だけじゃなく、体のほうも重い傷を負っていたというコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? Why does this clock say it’s noon already?”
“I believe it is you, rather than the clock, who somehow arrived at noon, Master Shiki.
I tried several times to wake you this morning, but you showed no sign of stirring.”
“……”
I must have been sleeping incredibly deeply.
Apparently the damage had not been merely emotional; my body had taken a serious wound as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eehh--?
Wh, why does this clock say it's noon already?"
"I think the clock is not the one who has the time incorrect, Shiki-sama.
I came to wake you many times this morning, but you did not open your eyes even once."
"…………………"
…… Was it really that deep of a sleep?
Not just my mind, but my body suffered heavy wounds, I suppose.

entries.japanese:
「そっか、ごめん。
せっかく起こしに来てくれたのに、なにやってたんだろうな、俺。
　……ああ、昨日眠ったのが遅かったっていっても、起きないことの理由にはならないし」
「いえ、休日なのですからいつ起床しようと志貴さまの自由ですが―――志貴さま、まさか昨夜もお出かけになっていたのですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Sorry you came all this way to wake me, only for me to sleep straight through it.
Going to bed late last night isn't much of an excuse.”
“It is your day off, so when Master Shiki rises is his own affair, but—Master Shiki, you did not go out again last night, did you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, sorry.
You came to wake me up… just what was I doing?
…… Ah, it was a late night, but I still shouldn't have slept in like that."
"No, you do not have school today, so sleeping in was an option, but---Shiki-sama, you intend to go out again tonight?"

entries.japanese:
「え―――いや、そんなコトは、その、ないんだけど……ああ、それより秋葉はどうしてるかな。
　あいつも昨日は夜遅くまで起きていたと思うんだけど――――」
「秋葉さまでしたら、いつも通りに起床されておりますが」
　翡翠は文句ありげな顔のまま、ちゃんとこっちのいい訳に答えてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—no, I didn't, but never mind that; what's Akiha doing?”
I thought she was awake late last night too.
“Miss Akiha rose at her usual time.”
Hisui still looked displeased, but she answered my transparent attempt to change the subject.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---No, not, at all…… Ah, more importantly, I wonder how Akiha is.
I think she was up late last night too----"
"Akiha-sama woke up at her usual time this morning."
Hisui looks like she wants to say something more, but she answers my question.

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
さすがに俺と違って規則正しいんだな、あいつは」
　……昨夜、この部屋であった事が思い出された。
　弓塚のことでボロボロになっていた俺を、秋葉は何も聞かずに介抱してくれたんだっけ。
　そのあとのことは、その……我ながら恥ずかしいんであまり思い出したくはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course. Unlike me, she is disciplined.”
Last night in this room returned to me.
When Satsuki Yumizuka left me shattered, Akiha had cared for me without asking a single question.
What happened afterward was embarrassing enough that I would rather not remember it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh.
She really is different from me, leading that disciplined lifestyle."
…… I think back to what happened last night.
While I was still in a dazed stupor over what happened with Yumizuka, Akiha took care of me without asking any questions.
After that, um…… it's a little embarrassing, so I don't want to remember it.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、秋葉は屋敷にいるのか？
　なにかと忙しいヤツだから、やっぱり休日も習い事をしてるとか」
「はい、秋葉さまは休日も予定が入っておりますが、今日は屋敷に残っておられます」
「………？」
　予定はあるけど、屋敷には残ってる……？
「よくわからないけど……ま、とにかく着替えたら居間に行くから、先に行っていてくれ」
「はい。
それでは失礼します」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, is Akiha staying home today? She's always busy—doesn't she have lessons even on her days off?”
“Miss Akiha has plans today, but she will remain at the estate.”
“……?”
Plans, but she's staying here?
“I'm not sure I follow, but never mind; I'll come to the sitting room once I'm dressed, so go on ahead.”
“Very well. Excuse me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, is Akiha still here?
She's an awfully busy person, so does she have a routine on her day off?"
"Yes, she does have plans during her day off, but today she is still in the mansion."
"………?"
She has plans, but she's still here……?

"I don't quite get it, but…… Well, I'll get changed, so please head to the sitting room ahead of me."
"Yes.
Well, please excuse me."

entries.japanese:
翡翠はいつも通り、足音一つたてず立ち去っていく。
「あ、翡翠」
「はい？
　なんでしょう、志貴さま」
「うん、言い忘れてた。
起こしにきてくれてありがとう。
遅れたけど、おはよう翡翠」
「―――はい。
どうかよい一日を、志貴さま」
entries.maoEnglish:
As always, Hisui departed without making a sound.
“Oh—Hisui.”
“Yes? What is it, Master Shiki?”
“I forgot to say it. Thanks for coming to wake me. It’s late, but—good morning, Hisui.”
“Yes. I hope you have a pleasant day, Master Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
As usual, Hisui glides away without a sound.
"Ah, Hisui."
"Yes?
What is it, Shiki-sama?"

"Yeah, I forgot to say something.
Thanks for coming to wake me up.
It's a little late, but… good morning, Hisui."

entries.japanese:
「――――――――はあ」
　天井を見上げて、大きく息を吐く。
　弓塚さつきの事は、きっと一生忘れられない記憶になった。
　だが、それに支配されてしまう訳にもいかない。
　俺には帰るべき家があって、出迎えてくれた秋葉がいて、こうしていつも通りに機能する日常がある。
　それを守るために彼女を裏切ったんだ。
　だから―――せめて、それぐらいは守りとおさないと、全てが嘘になってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I stared at the ceiling and let out a long breath.
Satsuki Yumizuka would remain with me for the rest of my life.
But I could not allow that memory to rule me.
I had a home to return to, Akiha to welcome me, and an ordinary life that kept moving as it always had.
I betrayed Satsuki to protect those things.
So unless I protected at least that much, everything I had done would become a lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yes.
Please have a nice day, Shiki-sama."

Staring up at the ceiling, I let out a deep breath.
About Yumizuka Satsuki… That's something I can never forget, for the rest of my life.
But, I will not let that control my life.
I have a home to return to.
Akiha is here for me, and I have an ordinary life to live.
To protect all of that, I betrayed her.
So--if I can't protect that, then everything will have been a lie.

entries.japanese:
「―――――詭弁、かな」
　それでも騙し騙しやっていくしかないんだろう。
　さて、翡翠が待っている。
　手早く着替えて、いつも通りの日常がある居間に向かわないといけない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is that just sophistry?”
Even if it was, I would have to muddle through somehow.
Hisui was waiting.
I had to dress quickly and head for the sitting room, where ordinary life was waiting—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Is that just sugarcoating it?"
Maybe all I can do is deceive myself.
Well, Hisui is waiting.
I should change quickly, and go back to the normal life waiting for me in the sitting room----

entries.japanese: 居間にはソファーに座った秋葉と、その相手をしている琥珀さん、それに壁際で控えている翡翠の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish: Akiha sat on the sofa in the sitting room, with Kohaku keeping her company and Hisui standing in attendance by the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon: In the sitting room, Akiha is on the sofa, Kohaku-san is keeping her company, and Hisui is standing by the wall.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます、志貴さん」
「うん、おはよう琥珀さん。
悪いんだけど、ごはん作ってもらえるかな。
ずいぶんと眠ってておなかが減っちゃってさ」
「はい、かしこまりました。
いま支度をしますからしばらく待っていてくださいね」
　琥珀さんはパタパタと食堂へと去っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Shiki.”
“Morning, Kohaku. Sorry to ask, but could you make me something to eat? I slept forever, and I’m starving.”
“Of course. Give me a few minutes to prepare something.”
Kohaku hurried away toward the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-san."
"Morning, Kohaku-san.
Sorry to be a bother, but could you fix me something to eat?
I'm a little hungry from all that sleeping."
"Yes, right away.
I will get it ready, so please wait a little bit."
Kohaku-san quickly patters away towards the dining room.

entries.japanese:
これで居間に残ったのは秋葉と、彫像のように無言を通している翡翠だけになる。
「……やっ。
秋葉も、おはよう」
「……………………」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうな顔で俺を一瞥するだけで、挨拶を返してこない。
「…………う」
　やっぱり昨夜のことを怒っているんだろうか。
　いきなり抱きついたんだから怒られてもしかたがないんだけど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
That left only Akiha and Hisui, who stood in silence like a statue.
“Hey, Akiha. Good morning.”
“……”
Akiha merely gave me a displeased glance, refusing to return the greeting.
“Urgh.”
Was she still angry about last night?
I had thrown my arms around her without warning, so I could hardly blame her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
That leaves Akiha and Hisui, who is standing wordlessly like a statue.
"…… Yo, Akiha.
G'morning."
"……………………"
Akiha just looks at me with a dissatisfied look on her face and doesn't return my greeting.
"…………… Uh."
I knew she'd be upset about last night.
I know I deserve it since I embraced her like that last night---

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
昨日は、その―――」
「兄さん。
いくらなんでもこんな時間に起きてくるなんて、なにを考えているんですか」
「え―――いや、その、だから、ごめん」
「……もうっ、そんなコトを怒っているんじゃありません。
せっかくの休日なのにこんな時間まで眠っている、兄さんの緩みようを怒っているんです、私は！」
　ふん、と顔をそむけて怒る秋葉。
　……っていうか、怒っているというよりは拗ねているように見えるのは、気のせいだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. About yesterday…”
“Brother. What could you possibly be thinking, getting up at this hour?”
“Uh—sorry.”
“Oh, honestly—that isn't what I'm angry about. I'm angry because you wasted half your day off in bed and have grown far too lax!”
Akiha turned away with an offended huff.
Was it my imagination, or did she look less angry than sulky?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Last night, was---"
"Nii-san.
Sleeping in this late… just what were you thinking?"
"Eh---um, well, I… sorry."
"…… Geez, I'm not mad about that.
It's your day off, and you've chosen to sleep in until now.
It's your laziness that angers me!"
With a "hmph", Akiha angrily turns her face away.
…… Well, it may just be my imagination, but "peevishly" is a better word than "angrily".

entries.japanese:
「いや、だって仕方ないだろう。
昨日は遅かったんだし、体だって疲れきってたんだから」
「そんなのは自業自得です。
どんな事情があろうと、この屋敷で暮らしていくのでしたらきちんと規律は守ってください」
「………う」
　悔しいが、こっちと同じ条件でちゃんと起きていた秋葉に言われると反論のしようがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It couldn’t be helped. I was up late, and my body was completely exhausted.”
“That was entirely your own doing. Whatever the circumstances, if you intend to live in this house, you will observe its rules.”
“Urgh.”
It galled me, but with Akiha having faced the same night and still risen on time, I had no answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I couldn't help it.
I got in late last night, and my body was just tired."
"You brought that on yourself.
No matter what the circumstances, please obey the rules of this house."
"………… Erk."
I hate to admit it, but since she went to sleep the same time I did, and still woke up early, I really can't counter her argument.

entries.japanese:
「だいたいね、兄さん。
朝起きるだけだったら翡翠に起こしてもらえばいいだけでしょう？
　今日は、まあ昨夜のことがあるから大目に見てあげるけど、なんだっていつもいつも時間ぎりぎりで起床するのよ、兄さんは」
「……あのさ、秋葉。
いちおう言っておくんだけど、俺だって好きで寝過ごしてるわけじゃないよ」
「なによ、それじゃあどうしていつも余裕のない朝を過ごしてるの？
　私がいつもどんな思いで、時間ぎりぎりまで待って――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Besides, Brother, waking up is easy. All you need is to have Hisui wake you, isn't it?
I'll overlook today because of what happened last night, but why must you always sleep until the last possible minute?”
“Listen, Akiha. It's not as if I oversleep because I enjoy it.”
“Then why are your mornings always such a mad rush? Do you have any idea how I feel, waiting until the very last moment for you to—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Besides, Nii-san.
Shouldn't you let Hisui wake you up in the morning?
I'll let you go today because of last night, but you always laze around in bed too long, Nii-san."
"…… Um, Akiha.
Maybe it's not my place to say, but it's not like I'm sleeping in because I want to."
"What?
So how come you always sleep in until the last minute every morning?
You don't know how I feel when I wait for you until the last minute, and----"

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま」
「あ――――」
「…………？」
　さっきまでの剣幕はどこにいったのか、秋葉は唐突に黙ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha.”
“Ah…”
“……?”
Akiha's fury vanishes as she abruptly falls silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama."
"Ah----"
"………?"
Where did the dire, threatening atmosphere go?
All of a sudden, Akiha descends into silence.

entries.japanese:
「あのな、秋葉。
言っとくけど俺が起きるのがいつも七時過ぎなのはワザとじゃないよ。
　俺だって早起きはしたいけど、体が言うことをきかないんだからしょうがないだろ。
　そんなに早起きさせたいんならすっごく強力な目覚まし時計を買ってくれ。
それなら、まあなんとか早起きできるかもしれないから」
「……あの、兄さん？
　ふと疑問に思ったんですけど、兄さんは翡翠に何時に起こしてほしい、といった事は伝えてないの？」
「―――――あ」
　そっか、そんな単純なことをど忘れしてた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Look, Akiha. I don’t deliberately sleep past seven every morning.
I’d like to wake earlier, but my body simply won’t cooperate.
If you want me up that badly, buy me some monstrously powerful alarm clock. Then I might just manage it.”
“Brother? A thought just occurred to me: have you ever told Hisui what time you want her to wake you?”
“Ah.”
Of course, I had forgotten the most obvious thing imaginable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Akiha.
I said so before, but waking up past seven o'clock in the morning isn't intentional.
Even I would like to get up earlier, but my body doesn't listen to what I tell it.
If you want to help me wake up earlier, please buy me a really powerful alarm clock.
I'm sure that'd get me up."
"…… Uh, Nii-san?
This may be a stupid question, but did you ever tell Hisui what time you wanted her to wake you up?"
"----Ah."
That's right, I forgot such a simple thing as that.

entries.japanese:
「そうだよな、せっかく毎朝翡翠が起こしにきてくれるんだから、翡翠に起こしてもらえばいいんだ。
　そういうわけなんで翡翠、これからは朝の六時半ごろに起こしてくれると助かるんだけど……」
　ちらり、と背後の翡翠に視線を投げる。
　と、翡翠はじっ、と俺の顔を睨みつけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You're right—since Hisui comes to wake me every morning anyway, I can just have her do it.
Hisui, from now on, could you wake me at about six-thirty?”
I glanced back at her.
Hisui fixed me with an unblinking glare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh yeah.
Hisui comes every morning to wake me, so it's alright for her to do that.
So… Hisui, could you please wake me up at six-thirty each morning?
It would really help me out……"
I swing around to face Hisui.
She stares right back at me.

entries.japanese:
「お断わりします」
「え？」
「ですから、志貴さまを起こすのはお断わりします、と申しあげたのです」
「えーと、その」
　なんて言っていいものか、あまりのショックで思考が働かない。
　見れば秋葉もびっくりしたような顔で翡翠を呆然と見つめていた。
「な────」
「翡翠。
どうして兄さんを起こすのは出来ないの」
「出来ない事はお引き受けできません。
　志貴さまを私の意志で起こすのは、おそらく無理だと思います」
「───無理って、どうして」
　思わず二人の会話に口を挟む。
　と、またも翡翠は俺をじっと睨んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I refuse.”
“What?”
“I said that I must decline to wake you, Master Shiki.”
“Er—well.”
The shock was so great that my mind stopped working.
Akiha looked equally stunned as she stared at Hisui.
“Wh—”
“Hisui. Why can’t you wake my brother?”
“I cannot accept a duty I am unable to perform.
I do not believe it is possible for me to wake Master Shiki by my own efforts.”
“Why wouldn’t it be possible?”
I broke into their conversation without thinking.
Hisui turned that level glare on me again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I refuse."
"Eh?"
"Forgive me, but I refuse to wake you up, Shiki-sama."
"Well, um--"
I don't know what to say.
The shock put my brain on hold.
Looking at the situation, Akiha is also gaping at Hisui in surprise.

"Wha----"
"Hisui, why can't you wake up Nii-san?"
"I am unable to undertake things I cannot do.
I do not think I am able to wake up Shiki-sama with my own power."
"----Unable?
Why not?"
I unthinkingly enter their conversation.
Hisui continues staring at me.

entries.japanese:
「今までの三日間、すべて無理でしたから。
　志貴さま、昨日はわたしが幾度お呼びしたか覚えてらっしゃいますか？」
「いや、覚えてらっしゃいますかって───俺はいつも翡翠の声で目が覚めてたんだけど……」
「それ以前のわたしの声は記憶にも留まっていない、という事ですね。
───秋葉さま、つまりこういう事です」
　なるほどねー、と秋葉はいじわるな眼差しを向けてくる。
　……なんていうか、一瞬にして俺の立場は最悪なものになってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because I have failed every day for the past three days.
Master Shiki, do you remember how many times I called to you yesterday?”
“But I always wake up when I hear your voice—”
“Which means that you retain no memory of all the times I called before that. Miss Akiha, that is precisely the difficulty.”
Akiha gave me a wicked look that said, Now I understand.
In a single instant, my position had become indefensible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"These past three days, all my efforts were fruitless.
Shiki-sama, do you remember how many times I called your name this morning?"

"No, I don't remember----I woke up from your voice?
I thought I woke up by myself……"
"That means there is no memory of me even calling out.
----Akiha-sama, that is the situation."
"Oh, I see," Akiha says and looks over at me teasingly.
…… How do I say this…… it would seem my standing here has just been lowered quite a bit.

entries.japanese:
「ようするに翡翠がいくら起こしても、兄さんは自分の起きたい時間でなければ反応さえしてくれない───そういう事なの、翡翠？」
　翡翠は無言でうなずく。
「………………」
　俺も無言でうなずく。
　そっかー、実は朝早くからちゃんと起こされてたのか。
　自分でいうのもなんだけど、俺の熟睡ぶりもここまでくると神業の域に到達してしまっているかもしんない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In other words, no matter how often Hisui tries, you won’t even respond until the time you have decided to wake—is that right, Hisui?”
Hisui nodded silently.
“……”
I nodded too.
So she had been trying to wake me properly all along.
If I did say so myself, sleeping this soundly might qualify as a supernatural talent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"In short, you have tried repeatedly to wake up Nii-san, but there isn't even the slightest reaction on his part---that's how it is, Hisui?"
Hisui nods silently.
"………………"
I nod silently as well.
…… I see.
The truth is, Hisui has already been trying to wake me up early in the morning.
I don't want to say it myself, but I must be really good at sleeping in.

entries.japanese:
「………兄さん。
どうして、そこで得意げな顔をなさるんですか」
「いや、つい。
自分の大物ぶりに呆れてたとこ」
「……はあ。
判りました、翡翠は今までどおり、兄さんが起きそうになったらなんとか起きてもらえるように努力してちょうだい」
　はい、と翡翠はうなずく。
　よし、話はまとまったようだ。
　結局、俺は今までどおり自由気ままに朝を迎えるしかないってコトだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Why do you look so proud of yourself?”
“I couldn't help it. I was marveling at what a formidable man I am.”
“I see. Hisui, continue as before; when he appears ready to wake, do your best to coax him the rest of the way.”
Hisui nodded and said, “Very well.”
Good—that settled it.
Apparently I had no choice but to keep greeting the morning whenever my body happened to feel like it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Nii-san.
Why are you looking so proud of yourself?"
"Nothing.
I was just surprised by how daunting it is to wake me."
"…… Hmm.
I understand.
Hisui, just like before, please try and wake up Nii-san as much as you can."
Hisui nods in assent.
It seems like the conversation is finished.
In the end, it may be just me waking up whenever I feel like it again.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ。
ところで翡翠」
「はい、なんでしょうか」
「その、兄さんったら本当に起きないの？
　呼びかけてもまったく反応しないの？」
「───はい。
志貴さまの眠りはとても静かで、彫像のようですから分かりやすいんです」
　……彫像のようって、なんだいそれ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey. By the way, Hisui.”
“Yes, what is it?”
“Does he truly never wake? He doesn’t react at all when you call him?”
“That is correct. Master Shiki sleeps so quietly—like a statue—that it is quite easy to tell.”
What was that about being like a statue?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, by the way, Hisui?"
"Yes, what is it?"
"Um.
Does Nii-san really not wake up?
Even if you call his name, he doesn't respond?"
"---Yes.
Shiki-sama's sleep is very quiet, and he sleeps like a statue."
…… Like a statue?
What?

entries.japanese:
「へえ。
兄さん、寝相いいんですね」
「いえ、そうではなくて───なんと申しますか、その、お眠りになられている志貴さまは別人のような気がします。
　あのような静かな寝顔は見た事がありませんでしたから、初めて見た時はお亡くなりになられたのじゃないかと、その───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Really? You’re a quiet sleeper, Brother.”
“No, that is not quite what I mean; I suppose Master Shiki seems like another person when he sleeps.
I had never seen such a still sleeping face, so the first time I thought he might have died—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
Nii-san has a great sleeping posture, huh?"
"No, that is not it---how do I say it… um, Shiki-sama is like a completely different person when he sleeps.
I have never seen such a peaceful sleeping face, so when I first saw him, I thought that he had passed away, I---"

entries.japanese:
「ですから起こしにくい、というのではなくて、起こすのがとても失礼な気がして、強く起こせないのです。
　志貴さまがご自分でお目覚めになられる時は、白い頬に体温が戻っていって、ああ、お目覚めになられるんだな、とすぐに分かるんですが───」
　翡翠は目を伏せたまま、人の寝相の感想をもらしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is not that he is difficult to wake; rather, waking him feels like a terrible discourtesy, so I cannot bring myself to be forceful.
When Master Shiki begins to wake on his own, warmth returns to his pale cheeks, and I can always tell at once that he is about to wake—”
Hisui keeps her eyes lowered as she describes my sleeping face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So it is not quite that he is hard to awaken, but that it seems very rude to do so, so I can not help but be very gentle.
Once Shiki-sama is about to wake up by himself, warmth returns to his white face, and I know he will wake up soon, but---"
Looking down, Hisui talks about how I look when I sleep.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　……なんか、すごく恥ずかしい。
　考えてみれば寝相っていうのは人間のもっとも無防備な姿なわけで、それをこう微にいり細にいり説明されると、裸を見られたみたいで赤面してしまう。
　翡翠はそのまま黙ってしまうし、秋葉もなぜか顔をそむけて見当違いのところを見ていたりする。
「………………………」
　なんか、ヘンに場が重い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
This was mortifying.
Sleep left a person utterly defenseless, and hearing every detail of mine described like this made me flush as though she had seen me naked.
Hisui fell silent; for some reason, Akiha turned away too, staring fixedly at nothing in particular.
“……”
The atmosphere had become strangely oppressive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
…… I can't help but feel embarrassed.
Come to think of it, a sleeping person is completely defenseless, and after listening to that explanation, I flush as red as if she said she saw me naked.
Hisui descends into silence, and Akiha is obviously trying not to look in my direction.
"…………………"
The air has become a little, heavy.

entries.japanese:
「はい、お待たせしました。
志貴さん、朝食が出来ましたよー」
　そこへ、明るい声で救世主が登場した。
「あ、ありがとう。
それじゃあごちそうになります」
「はい、ゆっくり召し上がってくださいね」
　琥珀さんの笑顔に背中をおされて、一人で食堂へ足を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you for waiting! Shiki, your breakfast is ready.”
A savior arrived on a tide of good cheer.
“Thanks. I’ll go eat, then.”
“Please take your time.”
Urged onward by Kohaku’s smile, I escaped alone to the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks for waiting!
Shiki-san, breakfast is reaaadyyyy!"
A bright voice saves the situation.
"Th, thanks.
Well, I'll eat up!"
"Yes, please take your time eating."
Turning my back to Kohaku-san's smile, I head to the dining room alone.

entries.japanese:
昼食を済ませて戻ると、秋葉も翡翠も居間に残っていた。
　二人を無視して部屋に戻るのも気まずいので、秋葉の向かい側のソファーに座ってみたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I returned after lunch, Akiha and Hisui were still in the sitting room.
Ignoring them and going straight upstairs would have been awkward, so I sat on the sofa opposite Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After I eat lunch, Akiha and Hisui are still in the sitting room.
It wouldn't be good to ignore them and go back to my room, so I sit on the sofa across from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「どうぞ、志貴さんはお茶のほうが好きなんですよね」
　琥珀さんが食後のお茶をテーブルに置いてくれた。
「うん、ありがと。
遠慮なくいただきます」
「いえいえ、遠慮なんかしないでくださいな。
ここは志貴さんのお家なんですから、もっと楽にしてください」
　琥珀さんは俺に気を使ってくれているのか、細かいところまで世話を焼いてくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Here you are—tea is what you prefer, isn't it, Shiki?”
Kohaku set a cup of after-lunch tea on the table.
“Thanks. Don't mind if I do.”
“No need to stand on ceremony. This is your home, Shiki, so please make yourself comfortable.”
Perhaps she was trying to put me at ease; Kohaku attended to every little detail.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here, Shiki-san.
You prefer green tea, right?"
Kohaku-san places an after meal cup of tea on the table beside me.
"Yeah, thanks.
If you don't mind, then."
"No, not at all.
This is your home, so please relax a little more."
Kohaku-san must be trying to make me feel more comfortable here because she takes good care of me.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
俺、これでも屋敷には慣れたつもりなんだけど、まだ緊張してるように見える？」
「そうですねー、まだ両肩に力が入っている感じです。
昔みたいに、とはいかないでしょうけど、もうすこしゆったりしていいと思いますよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That's discouraging. I thought I'd finally grown used to this house, but do I still look tense?”
“A little—your shoulders are still rather stiff. It may not be possible to act exactly as you did when you were young, but you can relax a bit more.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
I'm thinking I'm already used to this place.
Do I still look a little strained?"
"Yes, just a little bit.
Your shoulders seem a little tense.
I wouldn't say you should be like back then, but you certainly can relax a bit more."

entries.japanese:
「琥珀、あんまり兄さんを甘やかしちゃだめよ。
　ただでさえ有間の家の暮らしで鈍っているんだから、初めは緊張しているぐらいがちょうどいいのよ、この人には」
「ふふ、秋葉さまは志貴さんにだけ厳しいんですね」
「私だって好きで厳しくしてるんじゃないわ。
兄さんがあんまりにものんびりしてるから、こっちが気を配らないといけないだけだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku, don't coddle him.
Life with the Arima family has already made him soft, so a little tension is exactly what he needs while he settles in.”
“My, Miss Akiha—you only ever seem strict with Shiki.”
“It isn’t as if I enjoy being strict. He’s so hopelessly easygoing that someone has to look after him.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku, you shouldn't spoil Nii-san.
He's been living like a sloth at the Arimas' house so long, it's probably good for him to be a little tense just at first."

"Heehee.
Akiha-sama, you are really strict with Shiki-san, are you not?"
"I don't want to be strict.
It's just that he is always so spaced out, I have to watch out for him."

entries.japanese:
「………ふうん」
　少し驚いた。
　秋葉は琥珀さんと話していると、どことなくいつもの凛とした雰囲気がなくなっている。
　同じ年頃だという事もあるんだろうけど、この二人はすごく仲がいいのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh.”
That surprised me a little.
When Akiha spoke to Kohaku, some of her usual austere composure fell away.
Perhaps it was because they were close in age, but the two of them might genuinely be very good friends.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Huh?"
I'm a little surprised.
When Akiha talks to Kohaku-san, there isn't any hint of her usual coldness.
Maybe it's because they're so close in age, but they seem to be really good friends.

entries.japanese:
「………」
　ちらり、と翡翠に視線を移す。
　秋葉が何人もいた使用人を解雇して翡翠と琥珀さんを残した以上、翡翠だって秋葉に信頼されていると思う。
　けど、やっぱり琥珀さんとは正反対の性格のためか、翡翠と秋葉が気軽に会話をする場面は少ない気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I glanced over at Hisui.
Akiha had dismissed the estate’s many servants but kept Hisui and Kohaku, so she must trust Hisui too.
Yet perhaps because Hisui’s temperament was the exact opposite of Kohaku’s, I rarely saw Akiha and Hisui chatting so freely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
I glance over at Hisui.
Since Akiha dismissed all of the other servants except for Hisui and Kohaku-san, I think Hisui must be trusted by Akiha as well.
But, since Kohaku-san is her complete opposite in personality, I have a feeling that there isn't much talk between Hisui and Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
　俺が見ている事に気がついて、翡翠が用事を聞いてくる。
「いや、別に用事はないんだ。
ただ翡翠は大人しいなって思っただけで」
「―――はい。
そのように槙久さまにお教えいただきました」
　きっぱりと返答する翡翠。
　……なんていうか、きっぱりしすぎていて会話が続いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did you need something, Master Shiki?”
Noticing my gaze, Hisui asked whether I had some business with her.
“No, nothing. I was only thinking how quiet you are.”
“Yes. Master Makihisa taught me to be so.”
Hisui delivered the answer with absolute certainty.
Too much certainty, really; it left the conversation nowhere to go.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"May I be of service, Shiki-sama?"
Hisui realizes I was looking at her and asks me if there is anything she can do.
"No, it's nothing.
I was just thinking that you're really calm."
"---Yes.
It is something that Makihisa-sama taught to me."
She answers very distinctly.
…… The answer is so distinct, I can't continue the conversation.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　なんとなく気まずくなって黙り込む。
　琥珀さんと秋葉はまだなにやら話しこんでいるようだ。
「―――志貴さま、一つお聞きしてよろしいでしょうか？」
「え―――ああ、いいけど、なに？」
「はい。
志貴さまは昨夜もお出かけになられたようですが、深夜になると定期的に出かけるような用があるのですか？」
「あ―――いや、そんな事はないよ。
ちょっとここ二日間は特別だっただけだから」
　言って、秋葉の顔を盗み見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I fell silent in awkward defeat.
Kohaku and Akiha were still deep in conversation.
“Master Shiki, may I ask you something?”
“Sure—what is it?”
“Master Shiki appears to have gone out again last night. Do you have some regular business that requires you to leave after midnight?”
“No, nothing like that. These past two nights were special circumstances, that's all.”
As I answered, I stole a look at Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I get a little uncomfortable and go silent.
It seems Kohaku-san and Akiha are still talking.
"Shiki-sama, is it okay if I ask a question?"
"Eh---ah, yeah.
What is it?"
"It seems like you departed the mansion last night again, so I would like to inquire if you had some usual, scheduled routine to take care of every night."
"Ah---no, I don't have anything like that.
The past two days were just something special."
I steal a glance at Akiha's face as I say this.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は黙って、ただ俺と翡翠の様子を見つめている。
　……どうも、昨日の秋葉との一件は翡翠も琥珀さんも知らないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha said nothing, merely watching Hisui and me.
Apparently neither Hisui nor Kohaku knew what had happened between Akiha and me last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is just quietly watching the two of us.
…… It would appear neither Hisui nor Kohaku-san know about my run-in with Akiha last night.

entries.japanese:
「大丈夫だよ翡翠。
もう夜遅くに外出することはないから、よけいな心配はしなくていい。
　それにさ、子供じゃないんだから夜出歩くぐらいそう危険なことじゃないだろ？」
「お言葉ですが、志貴さまは遠野家のご長男です。
そのような無用心な行動はお控えください」
「そうそう、翡翠ちゃんの言うとおりですよ。
志貴さんは貧血持ちなんですから、あんまり無理をしちゃいけないってお医者さんにも注意されてるじゃないですか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It's all right, Hisui. I won't be going out late anymore, so there's no need to worry.
Besides, I'm not a child, so walking around at night is not so dangerous, is it?”
“Forgive me, Master Shiki, but you are the eldest son of the Tohno family. Please refrain from exposing yourself to needless danger.”
“Exactly—Hisui is right. You suffer from anemia, Shiki, and your doctor has already warned you not to overexert yourself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright, Hisui.
I won't go out late at night anymore.
Besides, I'm not a kid anymore, so it's not like there's any danger in going out at night."
"You say that, but Shiki-sama, you are the eldest son of the Tohno family.
Please refrain from doing anything careless."

"Yes, yes, just as Hisui-chan says.
Your personal physician told me that you should not strain yourself.
Besides, you have anemia.

entries.japanese:
「そうだけど、それと夜の外出は関係ないよ。
一人で出歩くのがいけないんなら、俺は学校にだって行けないじゃないか」
「まあ、それはそうですけど、昼間は明るいから誰かが助けてくれるでしょう？
　けど夜は別です。
とくに最近は吸血鬼殺人とか流行ってるんですから、貧血で倒れたところを襲われる、なんてコトがあったらどうするんですか」
「あ…………」
　びくり、と思わず体が震えた。
　吸血鬼殺人。
夜の街を徘徊して無差別に人を殺していた殺人鬼。
　……昨日の夜、この手で殺してしまったクラスメイト。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s true, but it has nothing to do with going out at night. If being alone is the problem, I wouldn’t even be able to attend school.”
“Perhaps, but there’s daylight then, and someone would come to your aid. Night is different—especially with all these vampire murders lately. What if you collapsed from anemia and someone attacked you?”
“Ah…”
I flinched.
The vampire murders. A killer who had roamed the night streets and murdered indiscriminately.
The classmate I had killed with my own hands last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true, but it has nothing to do with going out late at night.
If I can't walk by myself, I shouldn't be going to school either, right?"
"Well, yes.
But during the day it is bright outside and people could help you, right?
But at night it's different.
There's been all these vampire murders recently, so if you go outside and collapse, what do you think will happen?"
"Ah…………"
Without thinking, my body shudders.
Killer vampire.
The killer indiscriminately killing people on the streets at night.
…… Last night, the classmate I killed with my own hand.

entries.japanese:
「いや、大丈夫だよ琥珀さん。
夜の街に吸血鬼なんていない。
……あの事件は、もう二度とおきないから」
　弓塚さつきは、もうこの世にはいないんだから。
「はい？
　そうなんですか秋葉さま？」
「わたしに聞かれても解るわけがありません。
断言しているのは兄さんなんですから、兄さんには何か根拠でもあるんでしょう。
　そういえば、兄さんの高校では殺人事件の犠牲者になった方がいたらしいけど。
二年三組といったら兄さんのクラスではなかったかしら」
「え……？
　俺のクラスで犠牲者なんていないけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right, Kohaku. There are no vampires in the streets at night. Those murders will never happen again.”
Because Satsuki Yumizuka was no longer in this world.
“Really? Is that true, Miss Akiha?”
“How should I know? He is the one making such a categorical claim, so presumably he has some basis for it.
“Come to think of it, I heard a student at your school fell victim to the murders. Wasn’t Class Two-Three your class?”
“What? Nobody in my class was a victim.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, it's okay, Kohaku-san.
There isn't a vampire out there anymore.
…… Those incidents… they won't happen ever again."
Because Yumizuka Satsuki… is no longer in this world.
"Oh?
Is that true, Akiha-sama?"
"I haven't heard anything about it.
The one to ask is Nii-san, since he seems to know something about it.
Oh yeah, there was a victim from your high school, Nii-san.
Year 2 Class 3 is your class, right?"
"Eh……?
There wasn't a victim from my class."

entries.japanese:
「あ、志貴さんは今朝のニュースを見てないんですね。
なんでも一昨日の夜、弓塚さつきさんという方の血痕が大通りの路地裏で発見されたそうなんです。
　血痕自体は三日ほど前についたものらしいんですけど、現場に残された出血量からして死亡しているのはまず間違いないという話ですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, you didn’t see the news this morning. Apparently blood belonging to a girl named Satsuki Yumizuka was found the night before last in an alley off the main avenue.
The blood itself appears to have been there for about three days, but from the volume lost at the scene, the authorities say there can be little doubt that she is dead.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san, you didn't see the news this morning.
Last night, they found a large quantity of blood from someone named Yumizuka Satsuki in an alley off the main street.
The blood seems to have been there for a while, but from the amount of blood there, they say she is more than likely dead."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……動悸が激しい。
　彼女。
弓塚さつきが死亡しているなんて、そんな事は誰よりもよくわかっている。
　けれど、こうはっきりと“死亡している”と言われると、“おまえが殺したんだろう”と言われている気がして――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
My heart began to pound.
She was dead. Satsuki Yumizuka was dead, and I knew it better than anyone.
But hearing it declared so plainly made it sound like an accusation—You killed her
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
…… My heart starts to throb violently.
The fact that Yumizuka Satsuki is dead, I know that better than anyone else.
But when they say she's dead, it sounds like, "you killed her, didn't you?" to me----

entries.japanese:
「―――兄さん？
　どうしたのよ、顔色が悪いわよ」
「―――――」
　……大丈夫だって、答えられない。
　彼女の死が。
　自分の中のものだけじゃなくて、とうに、現実のものとして扱われてしまっている事が、ひどく、哀しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? What's wrong—you've gone pale.”
“…”
I couldn't even tell her I was all right.
Her death was no longer something that existed only inside me.
It had already been accepted as a fact of the world, and that was unbearably sad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Nii-san?
What's wrong, you're really pale."
"-----"
…… I can't say "I'm alright."
Her death.
I am sad that her death was publicized in reality and could not stay as something just in my heart.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　後悔はしないと決めたのに、こうして彼女のことを思うと影がさす。
――――と。
「みなさん、今夜は歓迎会をいたしましょう！」
　なんて、トウトツに琥珀さんが声をあげた。
「――――はい？」
　と、俺と秋葉、あまつさえ翡翠までもが首をかしげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I had sworn not to regret it, yet every thought of her cast a shadow over me.
――――And then.
“Everyone, let’s hold a welcome party tonight!”
Kohaku announced without the slightest warning.
“What?”
Akiha, Hisui, and I all tilted our heads in unison.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I said I wouldn't regret it, but a shadow envelops me as soon as I think about her.
----And then.
"Everyone, let's have a welcome party tonight!"
Kohaku-san suddenly makes a loud announcement.
"----Huh?"
Akiha and I say the same thing aloud, and even Hisui tilts her head.

entries.japanese:
「ですから志貴さんの歓迎会をしましょう！
　せっかくみんなそろっているんですし、志貴さんの引っ越し祝いもまだしてないじゃないですか。
　ですから、今夜は志貴さんの歓迎会なんです」
　ね、と琥珀さんは俺ににっこりと笑顔をむけてくる。
「…………」
　……まいった。
　俺は本当に元気のない顔をしていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A welcome party for Shiki! We’re all together, and we haven’t even celebrated his moving home yet.
So tonight is Shiki’s welcome party.”
Kohaku turned a brilliant smile on me, inviting my agreement.
“……”
So much for hiding it.
I must truly have looked miserable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A welcome party for Shiki-san!
Everyone is here, and we haven't even celebrated Shiki-san's arrival yet.
So, tonight should be Shiki-san's welcome party."
"Right?" Kohaku-san looks at me and smiles.
"………………"
…… Crap.
I must have looked really depressed.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま、よろしいですか？
　お許しがいただければ、いまから腕によりをかけてご馳走をお作りしますけど」
「そうね、せっかく兄さんが帰ってきたのに何もしないっていうのもなんだし。
わたしは賛成だけど、翡翠はどう？
　もちろん賛成でしょ？」
「あ―――はい、志貴さまがよろしいというのでしたら、わたしも、悪くはないと思います」
　じっ、と三人の目がこっちにむけられる。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Would that be all right, Miss Akiha? If you give me permission, I’ll start now and make a proper feast.”
“Yes, we should do something now that Brother has finally come home. I'm in favor, but what about you, Hisui? You agree, of course?”
“If Master Shiki approves, I suppose I would not object.”
All three pairs of eyes settled on me.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama, is that acceptable?
If you allow it, we can start the preparations right away."
"Yes, Nii-san has finally come back and we haven't even done anything.
I think it's a good idea, but… Hisui?
You agree, right?"
"Ah---yes, if it is acceptable to Shiki-sama, I do not think it will be a bad thing."
The three of them turn to stare at me.
I---

entries.japanese:
……そうだな、仕事に不慣れな自分が翡翠たちの手伝いをしても足手まといになるだけだろうし。
　秋葉が家にいることなんて珍しいんだから、今日ぐらいは秋葉とゆっくり話をしてみよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Right—I would only get in Hisui and Kohaku's way when I don't know the work.
Akiha is hardly ever home, so I may as well spend today talking with her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I guess if I tried to help Hisui I'd just get in the way.
Since Akiha's actually home for a change, I guess I'll pass the time talking to her.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、いる？」
「え―――に、兄さん……！？」
　ばたばた、とあわただしい音が聞こえてくる。
「ちょっと話をしたいんだけど、いいかな」
「あ―――はい、どうぞお入りください」
　ドアノブに手をかける。
　……考えてみたら、秋葉の部屋に入るのはこれが初めてだったりする。
「……………ん」
　すこしだけ緊張しながら扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, are you in there?”
“Wha—B-Brother…?!”
A sudden flurry of noise comes from inside.
“I wanted to talk for a while, if that’s all right.”
“Ah—yes, please come in.”
I put my hand on the knob.
Come to think of it, I’ve never actually been inside Akiha’s room.
“Mm.”
A little nervous, I open the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, you here?"
"Eh---Ni, Nii-san…!?"
Hurried sounds can be heard from within.
"I just wanted to talk for a bit, if that's okay?"
"Ah---yes, please, come in."
I put my hand on the doorknob.
Thinking about it, this is the first time I've ever been in Akiha's room.
"……… Hmm."
I open the door a bit tensely.

entries.japanese:
「う―――」
　……予想はしていたけど、これはまたなんてその、予想通りの部屋なんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Uh…”
I had expected something like this, but the room was almost comically predictable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh---"
…… I guess the room is exactly what I was expecting.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんですか兄さん？
　私の部屋を訪ねてくるなんて、なにか特別な用事ですか？」
「いや、そうゆうワケじゃないよ。
ただ秋葉と話がしたいなって思っただけでさ。
忙しいんなら出直すから、遠慮なく言ってくれ」
「……忙しいというんなら忙しいですけど、えっと、それは後にでも回せることですから、兄さんと話す時間ぐらいは作れます」
　机の上に広げられたノートをわしゃわしゃと片付ける秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Brother? Did you need something special?”
“No, nothing like that. I just felt like talking to you. If you’re busy, I can come back later, so don’t be afraid to say so.”
“I am busy, but this can wait, so I can certainly make time to talk with you, Brother.”
Akiha hurriedly gathers up the notebooks spread across her desk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it, Nii-san?
Is it something important, to make you come to my room?"
"Nah, not at all; I just felt like talking for a bit.
If you're busy, I can come back later."
"…… Well, I am busy, but… I can put that off, to make time to talk with you."
Akiha tidies up the notebook on her desk.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ、学校の課題をやってたのか。
それなら後にするよ。
勉強の邪魔はできないだろ」
「いえ、これから始めようって思ってたところですから、夜に回してもいいんです。
　いいですから、兄さんは適当な椅子に座ってください。
今お茶をいれてきますから」
「……ならいいんだけど、お茶はいらないよ。
少しでもおなかをすかしておいたほうがいいだろ、今日は」
「そ、そうですね。
それじゃあ、そうします」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, you were doing schoolwork. Then I’ll come back later. I can’t interrupt your studies.”
“No, I was only about to start, so I can leave it until tonight.
Please, Brother, sit wherever you like. I’ll go make some tea.”
“If you’re sure, forget the tea. We ought to save our appetites today, don’t you think?”
“Y-yes, that’s true. Let’s do that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, you were doing homework?
Then, I should go; I shouldn't interrupt your studies."
"No, I was just about to start, so I can leave it for tonight.
It's fine, so please sit down.
I shall make some tea."
"Alright, but no tea, thanks.
I wouldn't want to spoil my appetite today."
"Ah, t-that's true… Then, I'll do the same."

entries.japanese:
秋葉は自分の机の椅子に座る。
　こっちも適当な椅子に腰を下ろして、しずしずと秋葉の部屋を見渡した。
　すごい内装だとは思うけど、やっぱり俺には性が合わない。
　ベッドと机しかない自分の部屋でも落ち着かないんだから、こんな部屋をあてがわれていたらそれこそ逃げ出してたかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha sits at her desk.
I take another chair and quietly survey her room.
The furnishings are impressive, but they’re definitely not for me.
I can’t even relax in my own room with nothing but a bed and a desk, so if they had given me a room like this, I might have run away on the spot.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sits on the chair of her desk.
I lower myself into a suitable chair, and glance around Akiha's room.
It's an amazing room, but of course it's not really my type of place.
I haven't even been able to settle into my own room, and it has just the bed and the desk; if they'd given me a room decked out like this, I might have fled.

entries.japanese:
「なあ、秋葉」
「はい？
　なんですか、あらたまって」
「いや、前から聞こうとは思ってたんだけどさ。
本当にどうして、今になって秋葉は俺を呼び戻してくれたんだ？
　親父が死んで、俺が長男だからって呼び戻す理由にしては弱いと思うんだけど」
「理由が弱いって、何を言い出すんですか兄さんはっ。
兄さんの家はここなんですから、帰ってきてもらうのは当然のことです。
　理由なんて―――それこそ必要ありません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Akiha.”
“Yes? Why so serious all of a sudden?”
“It’s something I’ve been meaning to ask. Why did you really decide to bring me home now? Father died and I’m the eldest son, sure, but that doesn’t seem like enough of a reason by itself.”
“What are you talking about, Brother? This is your home, so of course you should come back.
We don’t need any other reason.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Akiha."
"Yes?
What is it?"
"Um, it's just something I've been wondering about for a while.
Why did you call me back?
The old man died, and while I am the eldest son, that doesn't seem like much of a reason."
"What do you mean, not much of a reason?
This is your home; it's only natural for you to come back here.
There doesn't need to be a reason."

entries.japanese:
「まあ、それはそうだけど……秋葉は、俺のこと恨んでないのか。
俺は八年間もおまえのことを放っておいたんだぞ」
「ええ、もちろん恨んでるわ。
兄さんが有間の家に預けられたのはお父様のせいですからそれは仕方ありませんけど、その間に手紙の一通も送ってくれなかったコトには、本当に毎日あたまにきてましたから」
「う―――いや、それは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I suppose that’s true, but don’t you resent me, Akiha? I left you alone for eight whole years.”
“Of course I resent you. It was Father’s fault that you were sent to live with the Arima family, so I can hardly blame you for that, but I was furious every day because you never sent me so much as one letter.”
“Uh—well, that was…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, that's true, but… don't you have a grudge against me?
I left you here for eight years."
"Yes, of course I have a grudge.
It was father's fault you were sent to live with the Arimas, but it really made me mad that you didn't send even a single letter during that time."
"Uh---no, that was…"

entries.japanese:
「それは、なんですか？
　ああもう、なんなんですか兄さんは！
　せっかく忘れようとしていたコトをわざわざ思い出させにくるなんて、そんなに私を怒らせて楽しいんですか？」
「違う、秋葉を怒らせるつもりなんてまったくないぞっ。
手紙のことだって、あれは……親父に禁じられていたから出来なかっただけで―――」
「そんなコトわかってます！
　私が怒っているのは、どうして今になってそんな事を言うのかっていうことですっ」
「―――そっか。
ごめん、ただ疑問に思っただけなんだ。
いまのは、俺が悪かった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was what? Oh, honestly, what is wrong with you, Brother? I was finally trying to forget about it, and you came here just to drag it all up again—is making me angry really so entertaining?”
“No—I wasn’t trying to make you angry at all. Father forbade me to write, so I couldn’t—”
“I know that! What makes me angry is that you chose to say all this now!”
“―――I see. I’m sorry—I was only wondering. That was my fault.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That was what?
Come on, Nii-san, what is it!?
You come in here to remind me of things I almost forgot!
