Do you enjoy making me angry that much?"
"No!
Of course I didn't do it to make you angry.
The thing about the letter, I didn't do it because that old man forbade me to do it, so---"
"I know that!
I'm angry because you brought it up!"
"---Ah.
I'm sorry, I just wondered.
I shouldn't have mentioned it."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、そう思っているんでしたら二度とつまらない事は言わないでください」
　ふん、と顔を背ける秋葉。
　……ほんと、何しているんだろう俺は。
　せっかく秋葉と話をしにきたっていうのに、つまらない事を聞いてみたりして。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you mean that, don’t say anything so foolish again.”
With a huff, Akiha turns her face away.
What am I doing?
I came here because I wanted to talk to her, and the first thing I do is ask a stupid question.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Indeed.
Please don't talk about such trifling matters."
With a sound of annoyance, Akiha looks away.
…… Really, what am I doing?
After I took the trouble to come and talk to Akiha, why am I talking about such unimportant things?

entries.japanese:
「ま、兄さんのことだからいつまでも気にしてるとは思ってましたけどね。
　琥珀も言ってたでしょう？
　ここは兄さんの家なんだから、もうちょっとリラックスしていいんだって」
「ん……それはまあ、おいおい慣れていくとは思うよ。
ただ――――」
「ただ、なんです？」
「いや、なんていうかあんまり懐かしいって感じがしなくてさ。
屋敷の生活は覚えているんだけど、どうも昔のイメージと一致しなくて戸惑ってる。
　ま、八年間も離れていたんだからそれも当然だとは思うんだけどね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, knowing you, I expected you to keep brooding over it.
Kohaku told you the same thing, didn’t she? This is your home, so you’re allowed to relax.”
“Mm—I’m sure I’ll settle in eventually. It’s just—”
“Just what?”
“I don’t know—it doesn’t feel very nostalgic. I remember living in the mansion, but none of it quite matches the picture in my head, and that keeps throwing me.
I suppose that’s only natural after eight years away.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I guess it's like you to carry such small matters forever.
Kohaku said so too, right?
This is your home.
You should be more relaxed."
"Yeah… I think I'll get used to it, gradually.
But---"
"But, what?"
"Well, no, it's just… there's no nostalgia.
I remember life in the mansion, but I'm confused, because none of this matches my memories.
Well, I guess I've been away for eight years, so it's natural."

entries.japanese:
「ん？
　なんだよ、そんな顔して。
言っておくけど、俺はこの屋敷は嫌いじゃないよ。
もう出ていくなんていう事はないから、安心しろって」
「あ―――うん、それは、嬉しいんですけど」
　秋葉はなぜかうつむいて視線を逸らす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm? Why are you making that face? I don’t dislike this mansion, you know. I’m not going to leave again, so stop worrying.”
“Ah—I’m glad to hear that, but—”
For some reason, Akiha lowers her head and looks away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm?
What's with that expression?
Like I said, I don't have anything against the mansion.
Don't worry, I don't want to leave or anything."
"Ah---yeah.
I'm glad, but…"
Akiha looks away for some reason.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、私も一つ聞き忘れていたことがあります。
……その、八年前の事故の傷のことなんですけど」
「？
　事故の傷って、胸の傷のこと？」
「はい。
その、琥珀の話ではまだ完全に治っていないという事ですけど、その点は安心できるんですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, there was something I forgot to ask you as well. It’s about the injury from the accident eight years ago…”
“The injury? You mean the scar on my chest?”
“Yes. Kohaku told me you still haven’t recovered completely, so is there truly nothing to worry about?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, I have a question I forgot to ask, too.
It's… about the injury from your accident eight years ago…"
"Hm?
Injury from the accident… you mean, the wound in my chest?"
"Yes.
Kohaku said it hasn't completely healed yet, but… does it still trouble you?"

entries.japanese:
「んー、どうだろう。
傷そのものはとっくに完治してるらしいけど、それでも破損してしまった不安定な器官があるから。
年数が経てぱ完治するものもあれば、不安定なまま治らないものもあるっていう話だ。
　……俺がしょっちゅう貧血を起こすのはそういった不安定な器官と、事故の時の精神的なダメージが治ってないからなんだとさ」
「それは……その、痛いんですか、兄さん」
　うつむいて、秋葉はそんな言葉を呟く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m not sure. The wound itself healed ages ago, apparently, but some of the organs that were damaged are still unstable. Some things mend completely with time, and others never do.
They say the reason I keep getting anemic is a combination of those damaged organs and the mental trauma from the accident never fully healing.”
“Does it hurt, Brother?”
Akiha murmurs without raising her head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hm… I don't know.
The actual wound itself healed ages ago, but there's some unstable organs that got damaged.
I heard that some of those would heal in time, but some would stay unstable.
…… I guess my incessant anemia is the result of that, in addition to some emotional damage from the accident."
"Does it… um, hurt, Nii-san?"
Akiha murmurs a question, looking away.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、痛むことはもうないよ。
ただ眩暈を起こすだけだから、そうたいした事じゃない」
　まあ、冬になって寒くなると、時折痛むぐらいのものか。
「眩暈っていっても最近は減ってきてるし、あと数年もたてば慢性的な貧血もなくなるんじゃないかな。
　ま、なんにせよこのぐらいの傷だったらそう気にかけるほどのものじゃないって。
世の中にはな、完治したあとに二十年ぐらいかけてリハビリをする凄い人だっているんだから、俺の傷なんてまだまだ生ぬるいってこと」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It doesn’t hurt anymore. I only get dizzy, so it’s nothing serious.”
Though it does ache now and then when winter turns cold.
“Even the dizzy spells have become less frequent, so in another few years, the chronic anemia may disappear altogether.
Either way, an injury like mine isn’t worth worrying over. There are amazing people who spend twenty years in rehabilitation even after they’re cured, so compared with that, mine is nothing.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nah, it doesn't hurt anymore.
I just feel a little dizzy when I wake up, no worse than that."
Well, perhaps it hurts occasionally in the dead of winter.
"The dizziness has faded lately, and I'm sure the anemia will go away in a few years.
Anyway, it's nothing to worry about.
There are people out there with wounds they won't recover from for twenty years, so my wound's nothing in comparison."

entries.japanese:
秋葉はうつむいたまま、何も言わない。
「…………………」
　まいったな。
　なんか、一気に重い雰囲気になってしまった。
「…………………」
　秋葉はぴくりとも動かない。
「………………？」
　いくらなんでも、不自然な気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha says nothing, her head still bowed.
“……”
Wonderful.
The whole room has gone heavy in an instant.
“……”
She doesn’t move a muscle.
“…?”
This is beginning to feel unnatural.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha says nothing, still looking away.
"…………………"
Damn.
The atmosphere has become heavy again.
"…………………"
Akiha is completely motionless.
"………………?"
Somehow, it seems unnatural.

entries.japanese:
「おい、秋葉！？」
「あ――――兄、さん？」
　秋葉の顔があがる。
　ぼう、とした。
今まで気を失っていたような、生気のなさ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha?!”
“Ah—Brother?”
Akiha raises her face.
Her eyes are vacant. Her whole expression is lifeless, as though she had been unconscious until this moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Akiha!?"
"Ah---Nii-san?"
Akiha looks up.
She lacks all vitality, as if she was passed out until now.

entries.japanese:
「どうした、気分が悪いのか？
　体調が悪いなら横になってくれ。
俺も部屋に戻るから」
「ん―――ううん、違うの。
ちょっと……兄さんの話を聞いてたら昔のことを思い出しちゃって、それで―――」
　うっ、と秋葉の体がゆれた。
　秋葉は椅子から床に倒れこもうとして、なんとか踏みとどまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong? Are you ill? Lie down if you’re not feeling well, and I’ll go back to my room.”
“No, it isn’t that. Listening to you reminded me of something from long ago, and—”
Akiha’s body lurches.
She starts to topple from the chair, but somehow catches herself before she hits the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's wrong, do you feel bad?
If you do, you should lie down.
I'll go back to my room."
"Nn---no, that's not it.
I was just…… listening to you, I was remembering about the past---"
Akiha's body shakes.
She almost falls off her chair, but she remains in it somehow.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
「秋葉、本当におかしいぞ。
無理しないで横にならないとだめだ」
「―――いえ、大丈夫です。
兄さんほどではありませんけど、私も眩暈をおこしやすい体質なだけですから。
　……その、今のは八年前の事故を思い出してしまって。
兄さんの傷は深くて、とてもたくさん血が流れてましたから―――それで気持ちが悪くなっただけなんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah.”
“Akiha, something is really wrong. Don’t push yourself; you need to lie down.”
“—No, I’m all right. I’m not as bad as you, but I’ve always been prone to dizzy spells.
I simply remembered the accident eight years ago. Your wound was so deep and there was so much blood that the memory made me feel sick, that’s all.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
She takes a halting breath.
"Akiha, you're really acting strangely.
You should lie down."
"---No, it's alright.
It's not as bad as yours, but I get easily dizzy too.
…… I was just thinking about the accident eight years ago.
Your wound was so deep, and there was so much blood coming out of it---that's why I felt so bad."

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
それならいいけど、本当に無理はするなよ。
気分が悪かったらすぐに悪いって言ってくれ」
「ええ、言われなくてもそうさせていただきます。
大丈夫、私の眩暈は兄さんとは違って精神的なものにすぎませんから」
　完全に持ちなおしたのか、きっぱりと秋葉は返答した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. If that’s all, fine—but don’t force yourself. The moment you feel ill, tell someone.”
“Yes, I will whether you tell me to or not. Unlike yours, my dizzy spells are purely psychological.”
Apparently recovered, Akiha answers with her usual crisp certainty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
If that's so, but don't push yourself.
If you feel bad, please tell me."
"Of course.
I would do that without being told.
It's alright; unlike yours, my dizziness is purely mental."
Akiha answers me clearly, completely recovered.

entries.japanese:
「そろそろ時間ですね。
琥珀が呼びにくるでしょうから、兄さんは部屋に戻らないと」
「ありゃ、もう五時なのか。
……それじゃあ部屋に戻るけど、秋葉もあんまり我慢するなよ。
辛い時ははっきり辛いって言わないと損するんだからな」
「あら。
兄さんがそこまで私の心配をしてくれるなんて意外ですね。
こんなことならたまには倒れたほうがいいみたい」
「ばか、今日はたまたまだよ。
それじゃまた後でな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It must be nearly time. Kohaku will be coming to call for you, so you ought to return to your room.”
“What, it’s five already? All right, I’ll go, but don’t bottle everything up, Akiha. When something hurts, you only lose by pretending it doesn’t.”
“My. I never expected you to worry so much about me. Perhaps I should collapse every now and then.”
“Idiot, today was a special case. See you later.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's almost time, isn't it?
Kohaku will call us soon, so you should go back to your room."
"Ahh, five o'clock already?
…… Well, I'll go back to my room, but Akiha, don't push yourself.
It doesn't do any good not to speak up when you're suffering."
"Oh?
It's not like you to be so concerned about me, Nii-san.
Maybe I should do so once in a while."
"Dummy.
It's just an occasional thing.
I'll see you later."

entries.japanese:
ガチャリ、と扉をあける。
　秋葉の部屋は西館の一番奥、俺の部屋は東館の一番奥だから、距離的にみると五十メートル近く離れているわけだ。
「あ―――兄さん」
「ん？
　なに、なにか言い忘れ？」
「いえ、そういうコトではないんだけど………」
entries.maoEnglish:
I open the door with a click.
Akiha’s room lies at the far end of the west wing and mine at the far end of the east, which puts almost fifty meters between us.
“Ah—Brother.”
“Hm? Did you forget something?”
“No, it isn’t that…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I open the door.
Akiha's room is deep in the east wing, a good fifty meters from my room deep in the west wing.
"Ah---Nii-san."
"Hm?
What is it?
Did you forget something?"
"No, it's not that, but………"

entries.japanese:
秋葉は言いにくそうに黙っている。
　ただ、俺を見つめる目が、まるで―――
「……ごめんなさい。
なんでも、ないんです」
　―――謝っているように、見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha falls silent, struggling to say whatever is on her mind.
But the way she looks at me is almost—
“I’m sorry. It’s nothing.”
―――as though she were apologizing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha falls silent, unable to find the right words.
But the eyes gazing at me---
"…… I'm sorry.
It's nothing."
---seem like they are apologizing to me.

entries.japanese:
「それでは食堂で会いましょう。
今日は何をしても怒りませんから、安心してください」
「ああ、それは嬉しいな。
せっかく琥珀さんがご馳走を作ってくれたんだから、今日ぐらいはテーブルマナーなんて忘れたかったところなんだ」
　答えて、秋葉の部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I’ll see you in the dining room. You may do whatever you like today without fear of being scolded.”
“Now that is good news. Kohaku went to all the trouble of making a feast, so just for today, I was hoping to forget table manners existed.”
After answering, I leave Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll see you in the dining room later.
I won't get angry whatever you do today, so don't worry."
"Ahh, that's a relief.
Since Kohaku-san cooked us a feast, I was hoping we might be able to forget about table manners today."
With that, I leave Akiha's room.

entries.japanese:
―――――で。
　一時間も経たないうちに翡翠は眠ってしまって、琥珀さんは笑顔のままで翡翠を部屋へと引きずっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――And so.
Before an hour had passed, Hisui fell asleep, and still smiling, Kohaku dragged her off to bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----And…
In less than an hour, Hisui falls asleep and Kohaku-san carries her to her room with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　こっちはこっちで、なれないアルコールを飲むもんだから意識が朦朧としている。
　隣にいる秋葉は、まだ元気に飲んでいるから始末が悪い。
「……秋葉。
おまえ、酒強かったんだな」
「そう？
　ストレートで飲んでいるわけじゃないんだから、このぐらいは普通だと思いますけど」
　……いや、だからさ。
　未成年にしちゃあ、アルコールに慣れてるなっていう意味なんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
My own thoughts are swimming from alcohol I’m not used to.
To make matters worse, Akiha beside me is still drinking away with perfect vigor.
“Akiha. I never knew you could hold your liquor.”
“Really? I’m not drinking it neat, so this seems perfectly ordinary.”
That wasn’t my point.
I meant that she seems awfully accustomed to alcohol for a minor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Not being used to alcohol, my mind is a little fuzzy.
Akiha sits nearby and is still drinking eagerly.
It doesn't bode well for the rest of the evening.
"…… Akiha, you really have some tolerance, don't you."
"Oh?
I'm not drinking it straight up so I think it is about normal."
…… Um, that's not the point…
I'm saying she's pretty used to drinking for being a minor.

entries.japanese:
「もう、またそんな顔をして。
いいから兄さんも少しは酔ってください。
　せっかく琥珀が兄さんを元気づけようって準備をしてくれたのに、それじゃ意味がないじゃないですか」
「ああ、そうだったっけ。
……うん、琥珀さんの気遣いには感謝してるよ。
おかげで少し楽になったし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, there’s that face again. Please, Brother, at least get a little drunk.
Kohaku arranged all of this to cheer you up, so if you sit there looking miserable, the whole thing is wasted.”
“Oh, right. Yes, I appreciate what she’s done. I do feel a little better.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, making that face again.
Please get at least a little drunk, Nii-san.
Kohaku prepared all this to cheer you up, so isn't it meaningless if you don't?"
"Ah, that's right.
…… Yeah, I have to thank Kohaku-san for her consideration.
Thanks to that, I do feel a bit better."

entries.japanese:
「なに言ってるんですか。
ぜんぜん楽になってませんよ、兄さんは。
しらふでも元気がなくて、お酒に酔っても元気がないんじゃ、あとはもう手段がないじゃないですか」
「なんだ、ずいぶん乱暴な言い分だな。
酒を飲んでも元気にならないからって、もう手段がないっていうのは間違いだよ」
「仕方ないでしょ、兄さんが何も話してくれないんですから。
私だって兄さんが昨夜のことを話してくださるのなら、お酒の力なんて借りないわ」
「―――――」
　そう、か。
　琥珀さんと同じように、秋葉も俺のことを気遣ってくれていたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about? You don’t look better at all; you were miserable sober, and you’re miserable drunk. What else are we supposed to try?”
“That’s a rather brutal argument. Alcohol failing to cheer me up does not mean there are no other options.”
“What choice do I have when you refuse to tell us anything? If you would only tell me what happened last night, I wouldn’t have to resort to alcohol.”
“……”
So that was it.
Like Kohaku, Akiha had been worried about me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying?
You don't look happy at all.
If alcohol doesn't make you feel better, isn't there nothing left?"
"Wow, that's a little bold.
Saying nothing is left if alcohol doesn't work… isn't that mistaken?"
"It cannot be helped if you do not wish to speak to me, Nii-san.
If you would talk about last night, I wouldn't ask for the help of alcohol."
"------"
I see.
Just like Kohaku-san, Akiha is concerned about me.

entries.japanese:
「けど、私からは何も聞けないでしょう？
　何も聞かないっていう約束なんですから」
「……すまない。
俺は、みんなに迷惑をかけてばっかりだ」
「まあ、わかってくれてるならいいです。
　―――えっと、兄さんの言うとおり酔っているみたいですから、少し外に出てきますね」
　酔っている、というわりには確かな足取りで秋葉は食堂から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I cannot ask you myself, can I? I promised not to ask.”
“I’m sorry. All I ever do is cause trouble for everyone.”
“Well, as long as you understand.
―――You were right: I do seem to be a little drunk, so I think I’ll step outside for a while.”
For someone admitting she was drunk, Akiha leaves the dining room on remarkably steady feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I can't ask, right?
I already promised no longer to ask about it."
"…… Sorry.
I'm just a big burden to everyone."
"Well, as long as you understand it is alright.
----Um, as you say I seem to be a little drunk, so I will go outside."
She says "drunk", but her steps are firm as she exits the dining room.

entries.japanese:
秋葉に倣って、夜風をあびに中庭に出た。
　時刻はまだ六時前。
　外は赤い日に染まっている。
「……まだ夕方だったのか」
　中庭には誰もいない。
　てっきり秋葉がきているかと思ったけど、入れ違いになったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Following Akiha’s example, I go out to the courtyard for some cool air.
It is not yet six.
The world outside is steeped in red sunlight.
“It’s still evening?”
No one is in the courtyard.
I expected to find Akiha here, but apparently we missed each other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Following Akiha, I go out to the courtyard to get some fresh air.
It is still before six o'clock.
The red sun paints the sky.
"…… Still the afternoon?"
There's no one else around.
I thought Akiha was going to be here but I guess we missed each other.

entries.japanese:
「……赤い夕焼け、か」
　今までは夕焼けを見ると血を連想していた。
　けど、今日は。
　帰り道で見せた、彼女の最後の笑顔が思い出された。
　……ズキリ、と胸が痛んだ。
　胸の古傷が痛むのか。
　それとも後悔で胸が痛いのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A red sunset.”
Until now, sunsets had always reminded me of blood.
But today.
I remember her final smile on the road home.
A sharp pain twists through my chest.
Is it the old scar aching?
Or is my heart hurting with regret?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Red sunset?"
Until now, the red sunset reminded me of fresh blood.
But today,
it reminded me of her final smile as we parted on the road home.
…… Throb.
A stabbing pain in my chest.
Does the scar on my chest hurt?
Or is my heart in pain from regret?

entries.japanese:
判別がつかない。
　ただ胸が痛むだけ。
　それこそ、血を流しているかのように。
「ぐっ――――――」
　眩暈がした。
　なれないアルコールと胸の痛みのせいだ。
　こんな、なんでもない事で、俺は意識を失おうとしてしまっている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I cannot tell.
My chest simply hurts.
As though it were bleeding.
“Guh—”
The world spins.
It must be the unfamiliar alcohol and the pain in my chest.
Over something so trivial, I am already beginning to lose consciousness—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I can't tell the difference.
Only that my chest hurts.
As if it was bleeding.
"Gah------"
Dizziness assails me.
Because of the alcohol and the pain in my chest,
such a small, insignificant thing causes me to lose consciousness----

entries.japanese:
……わたしの家はこっちだから。
　そういって、彼女は自分とは違う方角に去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
My house is this way.
With those words, she walked away in a direction different from mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My house is this way.
Saying that, she went down a different path.

entries.japanese:
……ありがとう。
　それはたぶん、最後まで付き合った俺に対しての言葉だったと思う。
　……ごめんなさい。
　それはたぶん、これから悔やんでいく俺に対しての言葉だったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you.
Those words were probably meant for me because I had stayed beside her to the end.
I’m sorry.
Perhaps those words were meant for the me who would spend the future regretting it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Thanks.
She probably said that since I was there for her until the very end.

…… Sorry.
She probably said that since she knew I would carry this regret from now on.

entries.japanese:
……だから、忘れていいよ。
　そんなさつきの言葉が、耳元で囁かれた気がした。
　……なんて偽善だろう。
　俺は、俺自身がゆめに見るゆめの中で、そんな都合のいい言葉をゆめみている。
entries.maoEnglish:
So it’s all right to forget.
I feel as though Satsuki whispered those words in my ear.
What hypocrisy.
In this dream I myself am dreaming, I dream up the words I most want to hear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… So it's okay to forget.
It felt like she whispered those words in my ears.

…… Isn't that just a false happiness?
In a dream I dreamed about, I dream such selfish words.

entries.japanese:
忘れられるのなら、それはとても楽なことだろう。
　けど忘れられない。
　好きでもなければ嫌いでもなかったけど、
　彼女の笑顔を忘れてはいけない気がする。
　それになにより。
　この首筋の傷痕が痛むかぎり、忘れる事などできないんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
If I could forget, it would be so easy.
But I cannot.
I neither loved nor hated her,
yet I feel that I must not forget her smile.
And more than anything.
As long as the scar on my neck still aches, forgetting is impossible—
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I can just forget, it will be very easy for me.
But I can't forget.
I didn't like her nor did I hate her, but,
I think I shouldn't forget her smile.
And more than that,
as long as this scar remains on my neck, I can't forget----

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　気がつくと、自分の部屋で横になっていた。
　俺はベッドに眠っていて、目の前には秋葉の姿がある。
「……秋、葉？」
「気がついた？
　もう、なんだっていきなり貧血なんておこすんですか、兄さんは」
「そうか……やっぱり倒れたのか、俺」
「ええ。
けどよかった、すぐに目を覚ましてくれて。
ごめんなさい、私が無理にお酒を勧めたせいですね」
「いや、それは関係ないよ。
ただ自分の都合で倒れただけだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
When I come to, I find myself lying in my own bed.
Akiha is sitting before me.
“Akiha?”
“You’re awake? Honestly, Brother, why must you suddenly collapse from anemia?”
“So I really did fall over.”
“Yes, but I’m glad you woke so quickly. I’m sorry. This happened because I pressed you to drink.”
“No, that had nothing to do with it. I collapsed for reasons of my own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
When I come to, I'm lying in my room.
While I was sleeping, Akiha must have been watching me because she is there in front of me.
"Aki, ha?"
"Have you awakened?
Goodness, suddenly collapsing like that, what happened Nii-san?"
"I see…… did I pass out?"
"Yes.
Thankfully, you woke up quickly.
I'm sorry for forcing you to drink like that."
"No, that has nothing to do with this.
I just collapsed on my own."

entries.japanese:
言って、天井を見上げた。
　頭はまだクラクラしていて、秋葉と話す気になれない。
　……だっていうのに、秋葉は会話がなくとも気にならないのか、ただ静かに座ってこっちの容体を看ていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I turn my eyes to the ceiling.
My head is still swimming, and I have no desire to talk.
Yet Akiha does not seem troubled by the silence and merely sits beside me, quietly watching over my condition.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that, I stare up at the ceiling.
My head is still dizzy, and I don't feel like talking with Akiha right now.
…… Even still, Akiha is not bothered by this and she quietly tends to me.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉？」
「はい？
　なんですか兄さん」
「―――その、さ。
そこにいても退屈だろ。
俺は大丈夫だから、部屋に戻ってくれてもいいぞ」
「それは私は邪魔、という事ですか？」
「いや、そういうわけじゃなくて、秋葉は退屈じゃないかなって」
「退屈ですが、我慢はできます。
好きでしている事だから、兄さんが気に病む必要はありません」
　それなら―――まあ、いいけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha?”
“Yes? What is it, Brother?”
“Well… you must be bored sitting there. I’m all right, so you can go back to your room.”
“Are you saying I am in the way?”
“No, I only thought you might be bored.”
“I am bored, but I can endure it. I am here because I choose to be, so you needn’t feel guilty, Brother.”
In that case, I suppose it’s fine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha?"
"Yes?
What is it, Nii-san?"
"---Um, well.
Isn't this boring for you?
I'm fine, so you can go back to your room if you want."
"Are you saying I'm bothering you?"
"No, that's not it at all.
I was just thinking that maybe you were a little bored."
"It is boring, but I can stand it.
This is something I'm doing out of my own interest, so there is no need for you to worry, Nii-san."
Then----I guess that's alright.

entries.japanese:
時間が流れる。
　時刻は夜の十時を過ぎていた。
　あれから四時間。
秋葉はこうして俺の看病をしてくれてたんだろうか。
　秋葉は黙って、俺の熱を測っている。
　……ああ、思い出した。
　あれはたしか、もう八年以上前のことだ。
　風邪かなにかをこじらせた自分のところに、秋葉が見舞いにきたことがあったっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time passes.
It is after ten at night.
Four hours have gone by. Has Akiha truly been tending me all this time?
She silently takes my temperature.
Then I remembered.
It had been more than eight years ago.
Once, when I had been terribly ill with a cold, Akiha had come to visit me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Time passes.
It's past seven o'clock.
Seven hours since then.
Has Akiha been tending me this long?
Akiha silently takes my temperature.
…… Ah, I remember now.
That had to have been more than eight years ago.
Akiha came to watch over me after I caught a cold or something like that.

entries.japanese:
あれは本当にひどい風邪で、息をするのも苦しかった。
　そんな俺の枕もとに座って、じっと俺の手を握っていた黒髪の少女。
　畳と障子。
　ひんやりと冷たい冬の気温。
　暗い座敷で泣きそうに自分を見つめていた幼いあきはの姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
It had been a vicious cold, so bad that every breath hurt.
A black-haired girl had sat at my bedside, holding my hand.
Tatami and paper screens.
The cold hush of winter.
Little Akiha in the dark room, watching me as though she might cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It really was a terrible cold; even breathing was painful.
The black-haired girl sat by my pillow, holding my hand and just staring at me.
Tatami and the shouji.
The cool winter air.
In the dark tatami mat room, the young figure of Akiha watching me on the verge of tears.

entries.japanese:
「……すこし、安心した」
「え？
　なにか言った、兄さん？」
「……ああ。
秋葉にも少しは昔の面影が残ってるんだなって思ってさ。
なんでもないことなのに、なんだか嬉しくなったんだ」
　本当に自然に、自分でも驚くぐらい優しく、秋葉に微笑む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s a relief.”
“Hm? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Yes. I was thinking that a little of the old Akiha still remains. It’s nothing important, but it made me happy.”
The smile I give her comes so naturally and so gently that it surprises even me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm a little relieved."
"Eh?
Did you say something Nii-san?"
"…… Yeah.
I was just thinking there is a little bit of the old Akiha in you.
It's not really anything, but it makes me pretty happy."
I give Akiha a gentle smile so naturally, it almost surprises me.

entries.japanese:
「それはいいですけど、兄さんは昔とまったく変わりませんね。
人に手間隙をかけさせるところぐらい、少しは正してください」
　顔を背けて憎まれ口をたたく秋葉。
　今は、それが照れ隠しだっていうことが分かってしまって、余計に嬉しくなってしまった。
「……もう、なんですかさっきからにやにや笑って。
そんなに元気があるんでしたら、もう私が看ている必要はなさそうですね」
「いや、そういうんじゃなくてさ、ただ昔のことを思い出しただけだって。
　畳の部屋でさ、秋葉が―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is all very well, but you haven’t changed in the slightest, Brother. You might at least correct your habit of making other people fuss over you.”
Akiha turns away and delivers the barb.
Now that I can tell she is only hiding her embarrassment, it makes me happier still.
“Honestly, why have you been grinning like that? If you have so much energy, perhaps you no longer require my care.”
“That isn’t it—I was only remembering the past.
There was a room with tatami, and you—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That is fine, but you haven't changed at all Nii-san.
Causing so much work for others… please act more properly."
Akiha looks away and complains.
Understanding she is just embarrassed, I start to feel even more happier.

"…… Sheesh, why are you smiling like that?
If you have this much energy I guess you don't need me to take care of you."
"No, that's not it.
I just remembered something from a long time ago.
Akiha, in that tatami room----"

entries.japanese:
――――畳の、部屋？
　なんだろう、それ。
　秋葉に看病されているのは解るけど、どうしてそれが自分の部屋じゃなくて、畳の部屋だったりするんだろうか。
　なにか。
　なにか、ひどい違和感が、ある。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A room with tatami?
What is that memory?
I understand Akiha was caring for me, but why were we in a tatami room instead of my bedroom?
Something is wrong.
Terribly wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Tatami room?
What is that all about?
I understand Akiha taking care of me, but why was it in a tatami room and not my room?
Something.
There's something not quite right.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
この屋敷に畳がある部屋ってあったっけ？」
「いえ。
この屋敷に和室はありませんよ」
「そうだよな。
いや、なんでもないんだ。
ちょっと不思議に思っただけでさ、気にしないでくれ」
「はあ。
和室がないと不思議なんですか、兄さんは」
「まあな。
こんだけ広い屋敷だから、一つぐらいはあるかもしれないじゃないか」
「ええ、一つと言わず和風の離れはまるごと和室ですけど」
「え―――？」
　―――ああ、そういえばそうだった。
　庭の森の奥に、和風の屋敷があったんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Does this mansion have any rooms with tatami?”
“No. There are no Japanese-style rooms in the mansion.”
“I thought not. Never mind. I was only wondering about something.”
“I see. Does the absence of a Japanese-style room strike you as strange, Brother?”
“A little. In a mansion this large, you’d think there might be at least one.”
“There is considerably more than one—the entire detached house is Japanese-style.”
“What—?”
―――Of course.
There was a traditional house beyond the trees in the garden.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Is there a room with tatami in this mansion?"
"No.
There are no Japanese rooms in this mansion."
"Yeah, you're right.
It's nothing.
I just thought it was odd, don't worry about it."
"Hm?
What is so odd about not having a Japanese room?"
"Oh, you know.
This mansion is so big, I thought maybe there was at least one."
"There is a detached Japanese-style building however."
"Eh----?"
----Now that she mentions it, of course.
In the middle of the forest in the garden, there was a Japanese-style mansion.

entries.japanese:
「……もう、ホントに元気になっちゃいましたね。
これ以上私がいてもお邪魔みたいですから、部屋に戻ります」
　椅子から立ちあがって、退室しようとする秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really have recovered. I seem to be in the way now, so I’ll return to my room.”
Akiha rises from the chair and turns to leave.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Goodness, you really have become more energetic.
I think I will only be in the way if I stay longer so I will return to my room."
Standing up from the chair, Akiha goes to leave the room.

entries.japanese:
「ありがと、秋葉。
何時間もつきあわさせて悪かった」
「どうぞお気になさらずに。
明日から似たような生活サイクルになるんですから」
「………？」
　なんだかよく解らないことを言って、秋葉は部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thanks, Akiha. I’m sorry I kept you here for hours.”
“Please don’t concern yourself. Beginning tomorrow, our days will follow much the same rhythm.”
“…?”
Leaving me with that baffling remark, Akiha walks out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks, Akiha.
Sorry for making you stay here this whole time."
"Please don't mind.
Starting tomorrow your daily life will become more like this."
"………?"
After saying something I don't quite understand, Akiha exits the room.

entries.japanese:
――――電気を消して、体をベッドに休める。
　秋葉が看病してくれた事もあって、気持ちはとても安らいでいた。
　これならすぐに、何日かぶりの安らかな夢を見られるだろう。
　深く息をはいて、ゆっくりとまぶたを閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I switch off the light and settle into bed.
Akiha’s care has left me deeply at peace.
I should be able to fall at once into the first gentle sleep I have had in days.
I breathed out slowly and closed my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I turn off the lights and rest in bed.
Thanks to Akiha taking care of me, I feel more relaxed.
At this rate, I should be able to dream peacefully for the first time in days.
I take a deep breath and slowly close my eyes.

entries.japanese:
……眠りに落ちる前。
　幼い秋葉に看病されている昔の自分を、鮮明に思い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Just before sleep takes me.
I remember with perfect clarity my younger self being nursed by little Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Right before I fall asleep,
the memory of myself being tended by a young Akiha freshly surfaces in my mind.

entries.japanese:
誰も見舞いに来てくれなかった暗い和室。
　槙久の目を盗んできたのか、秋葉はこっそりとやってきて、俺の手を握って泣いていた。
　ごめんなさい、と。
　俺には理由が分からなかったけど、ただごめんなさいという言葉を、何度も何度も繰り返していた、黒髪の少女。
entries.maoEnglish:
A dark Japanese-style room where no one else came to visit.
Perhaps slipping past Makihisa’s notice, Akiha crept inside, took my hand, and wept.
I’m sorry, she said.
I did not understand why; the black-haired girl only repeated those words again and again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The dark Japanese-style room where no one came to see me.
Did she sneak away from Makihisa?
Akiha snuck in and cried as she held my hand.
"I'm sorry," she was saying.
I didn't know why, but the black-haired young girl kept repeating "I'm sorry" over and over.

entries.japanese:
―――おぼえている。
　ただ一人、自分の看病をしてくれた、儚げな遠野家の長女を。
「……………」
　暗い和室の中でずっと泣き続けていた幼い少女。
　熱で朦朧としながら、悔しくて舌をかんだ。
　どうして泣いているんだろう、と。
　俺だったら。
　俺だったら、決して、あきはを泣かせたりしないのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I remember.
I remember the frail eldest daughter of the Tohno family.
She alone cared for me.
“……”
A little girl who had cried and cried in that dark tatami room.
Feverish and dazed, I bit my tongue in frustration.
Why was she crying?
If it were up to me, I would never, ever make Akiha cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I remember.
About the proud eldest daughter of the Tohno family who was the only one to care for me.

"………………"
The young girl always crying in the dark Japanese room.
I bit my tongue in frustration while being dizzy from fever.
I wonder why she was crying.
If it was me,
I would never, never let Akiha cry.

entries.japanese:
……ごめんなさい。
　……ごめんなさい、しきにいさん。
　その涙が、ただ、綺麗で。
　あの時から、あきはにとって本当の兄になろう、と誓ったんだっけ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I’m sorry.
I’m sorry, Brother Shiki.
Her tears were simply beautiful.
Perhaps that was when I had sworn to become a true brother to Akiha—
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm sorry.
…… I'm sorry, Shiki-nii-san.
Her tears were simply beautiful.
Since that time, I vowed to be her real brother----

entries.japanese:
……ダメだ、そんな気分じゃない。
　気を遣ってくれた琥珀さんには悪いけど、弓塚との事が忘れられないうちは、とてもじゃないけどそんな気分にはなれない。
　この二日間。
　あんなに他人の血を見てきた自分が、琥珀さんや秋葉、翡翠に歓迎されていいはずが、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
No, I couldn't celebrate.
I felt bad after Kohaku had gone out of her way for me, but until I could forget what had happened with Yumizuka, I couldn't possibly be in the mood.
These past two days, I had seen so much of other people’s blood.
Someone like me had no right to be welcomed by Kohaku, Akiha, and Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… No, I don't feel like it at all.
I know Kohaku-san just wants me to feel good, but I can't forget about Yumizuka right now.
These past two days.
After I've seen so much of other people's blood, I can't be welcomed by them.

entries.japanese:
「ごめん。
嬉しいんだけど、今はそんな気分じゃなくて――――」
―――ドクン。
「あ――――れ」
―――どくん。
　唐突に。
―――ドクン。
　眩暈が、して。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry. I’m glad you offered, but I’m really not in the mood right now—”
―――THUMP.
“What…?”
―――Thump.
All at once.
―――THUMP.
the room began to spin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sorry.
I'm really happy that you asked, but I just don't feel like it right now----"
---Thump.
Thump.
"Hu----h?"
------My head is pounding.
Suddenly.
---Thump.
I feel, very dizzy.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと、兄さん―――！」
　……秋葉の声が聞こえる。
　だがそれで薄れていく意識が止まってくれるワケでもない。
「しっかりしてください、兄さん……！」
　秋葉の声が遠くなっていく。
　……まったく、自分でもイヤになる。
　ただ弓塚との事を思い出しただけで、遠野志貴は意識を失おうとしてしまっているんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother!”
I heard Akiha call out.
But her voice couldn't arrest the darkness swallowing my mind.
“Stay with me, Brother…!”
Her voice receded into the distance.
God, I disgusted myself.
Merely remembering Yumizuka was enough to make Shiki Tohno lose consciousness—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Nii-san---!"
…… I can hear Akiha's voice.
But that doesn't stop it from getting worse.
"Hang in there, Nii-san……!"
Her voice becomes very distant.
…… Sheesh, I really am pretty pathetic.
Just thinking about Yumizuka and what happened, I lose consciousness like this----

entries.japanese:
―――――わたしの家はこっちだから。
　そういって、彼女は俺とは違う方角に去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――My house is this way.
With those words, she had walked away in the opposite direction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----My house is this way.
Saying that, she went down a different path.

entries.japanese:
―――――ありがとう。
　それはたぶん、最後まで付き合った俺に対しての言葉だったと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Thank you.
Those words, I thought, had been meant for me—for staying with her until the end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Thanks.
She probably said that since I was there for her until the very end.

entries.japanese:
―――――ごめんなさい。
　それはたぶん、これから悔やんでいく俺に対しての言葉だったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――I’m sorry.
Perhaps those words had been meant for the me who would spend the rest of his life regretting what came next.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Sorry.
She probably said that since she knew I would carry this regret from now on.

entries.japanese:
―――――だから、忘れていいよ。
　そんな彼女の言葉が、耳元で囁かれた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――So it’s all right to forget me.
I thought I heard her whisper the words beside my ear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----So it's okay to forget.
It felt like she whispered those words in my ears.

entries.japanese:
―――――なんて偽善だろう。
　俺は、俺自身がゆめに見るゆめの中で、そんな都合のいい言葉をゆめみている。
　忘れられるのなら、それはとても楽なことだ。
　けど忘れられない。
　好きでもなければ嫌いでもなかったけど、
　彼女の笑顔を忘れてはいけない気がする。
　それになにより。
　この首筋の傷痕が痛むかぎり、忘れる事などできないんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――What nauseating hypocrisy.
Inside the dream I dream for myself, I dream up the words that suit me best.
If I could forget, everything would be so much easier.
But I couldn't.
I had neither loved nor hated her,
yet I felt that I must never forget her smile.
More than anything.
As long as the scar on my throat continued to ache, forgetting would be impossible—
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Isn't that just a false happiness?
In a dream I dreamed about, I dreamt those selfish words.
If I can just forget, it will be very easy for me.
But I can't forget.
I neither liked her nor hated her, but,
I think I shouldn't forget her smile.
And more than that,
as long as this scar remains on my neck, I can't forget----

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　気がつくと、自分の部屋で横になっていた。
　俺はベッドに眠っていて、目の前には秋葉の姿がある。
「秋、葉？」
「気がついた？
　もう、なんだっていきなり貧血なんておこすんですか、兄さんは」
「そうか……やっぱり倒れたのか、俺」
「はい。
あれから七時間も眠っていたんですよ、兄さんは」
「―――そうか。
最近なにかと寝不足だったから、その反動かもしれないな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
When I came to, I was lying in my own room.
I was in bed, and Akiha was sitting before me.
“Akiha?”
“You're awake? Honestly, why must you suddenly collapse from anemia like that?”
“I see—so I did pass out.”
“Yes. You slept for seven hours, Brother.”
“I see. I haven't been sleeping much lately; perhaps it all caught up with me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
When I come to, I'm lying in my room.
While I was sleeping, Akiha must have been watching me because she is there in front of me.
"Aki, ha?"
"Have you awakened?
Goodness, suddenly collapsing like that, what happened, Nii-san?"
"I see…… did I pass out?"
"Yes.
You slept for seven hours since then, Nii-san."
"---Oh.
I haven't been sleeping enough recently, so this must be a reaction to that."

entries.japanese:
言って、ただ天井を見上げた。
　頭はまだクラクラしていて、秋葉と話す気になれない。
　……だっていうのに、秋葉は会話がなくとも気にならないのか、ただ静かに座って俺の容体を看ていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I said that and stared at the ceiling.
My head was still swimming, and I didn't feel like talking.
Yet Akiha seemed perfectly content with the silence as she simply sat beside me and watched over my condition.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Saying that, I stare up at the ceiling.
My head is still dizzy, and I don't feel like talking with Akiha right now.
…… All the same, Akiha is not bothered by this and she quietly tends to me.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉？」
「はい？
　なんですか兄さん」
「―――その、さ。
そこにいても退屈だろ。
俺は大丈夫だから、部屋に戻ってくれてもいいぞ」
「それは私は邪魔、という事ですか？」
「いや、そういうわけじゃなくて、秋葉は退屈じゃないかなって」
「退屈ですが、我慢はできます。
好きでしている事だから、兄さんが気に病む必要はありません」
「………………む」
　それなら―――まあ、いいけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha?”
“Yes? What is it, Brother?”
“Well, you must be bored sitting there. I'm fine now. You can go back to your room.”
“Are you telling me I'm in the way?”
“No, I only thought you might be bored.”
“I am bored, but I can endure it. I'm here because I choose to be, so you needn't feel guilty.”
“Mm.”
In that case, I supposed it was all right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha?"
"Yes?
What is it, Nii-san?"
"---Um, well.
Isn't this boring for you?
I'm fine, so you can go back to your room if you want."
"Are you saying I'm bothering you?"
"No, that's not it at all.
I was just thinking that maybe you were a little bored."
"It is boring, but I can stand it.
This is something I'm doing in my own interests, so there is no need for you to worry, Nii-san."
"…………… Hmm."
Then----I guess that's alright.

entries.japanese:
時間が流れる。
　時刻は夜の七時を過ぎていた。
　あれから七時間。
秋葉はこうして俺の看病をしてくれてたんだろうか。
　秋葉は黙って、俺の熱を測っている。
　……ああ、思い出した。
　あれはたしか、もう八年以上前のことだ。
　風邪かなにかをこじらせた自分のところに、秋葉が見舞いにきたことがあったっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time passed.
It was already after seven in the evening.
It had been seven hours. Had Akiha truly spent all of them nursing me like this?
Without a word, she checked my temperature.
Then I remembered.
It had been more than eight years ago.
Once, when I had been terribly ill with a cold, Akiha had come to visit me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Time passes.
It's past seven o'clock.
Seven hours since then.
Has Akiha been tending me this long?
Akiha silently takes my temperature.
…… Ah, I remember now.
That had to have been more than eight years ago.
Akiha came to watch over me after I caught a cold or something like that.

entries.japanese:
あれは本当にひどい風邪で、息をするのも苦しかった。
　そんな俺の枕もとに座って、じっと俺の手を握っていた黒髪の少女。
　畳と障子。
　ひんやりと冷たい冬の気温。
　暗い座敷で泣きそうに自分を見つめていた幼いあきはの姿。
entries.maoEnglish:
It had been a vicious cold, so bad that every breath hurt.
A black-haired girl had sat at my bedside, holding my hand.
Tatami and paper screens.
The cold hush of winter.
Little Akiha in the dark room, watching me as though she might cry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It really was a terrible cold; even breathing was painful.
The black-haired girl sat by my pillow, holding my hand and just staring at me.
Tatami and the shouji.
The cool winter air.
In the dark tatami mat room, the young figure of Akiha watching me on the verge of tears.

entries.japanese:
「……すこし、安心した」
「え？
　なにか言った、兄さん？」
「……ああ。
秋葉にも少しは昔の面影が残ってるんだなって思ってさ。
なんでもないことなのに、なんだか嬉しくなったんだ」
　本当に自然に、自分でも驚くぐらい優しく、秋葉に微笑む。
「それはいいですけど、兄さんは昔とまったく変わりませんね。
人に手間隙をかけさせるところぐらい、少しは正してください」
　顔を背けて憎まれ口をたたく秋葉。
　今は、それが照れ隠しだっていうことがわかってしまって、余計に嬉しくなってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That's a relief.”
“What? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Yes. I was thinking that there’s still a little of the old Akiha left in you. It’s nothing important, but realizing it made me happy.”
Without effort or artifice, I smiled at her so gently that I surprised myself.
“That’s very nice, but you haven’t changed at all. You might at least correct this habit of making everyone fuss over you.”
Akiha turned away and delivered the insult.
Now that I understood she was only hiding her embarrassment, it made me happier still.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm a little relieved."
"Eh?
Did you say something Nii-san?"
"…… Yeah.
I was just thinking there is a little bit of the old Akiha in you.
It's not really anything, but it makes me pretty happy."
I give Akiha a gentle smile so naturally, it almost surprises me.
"That is fine, but you haven't changed at all Nii-san.
Causing so much work for others… please act more properly."
Akiha looks away and complains.
Understanding she is just embarrassed, I start to feel even happier.

entries.japanese:
「……もう、なんですかさっきからにやにや笑って。
そんなに元気があるんでしたら、もう私が看ている必要はなさそうですね」
「いや、そういうんじゃなくて、ただ昔のことを思い出しただけだ。
畳の部屋でさ、秋葉が―――」
――――畳の、部屋？
　なんだろう、それ。
　秋葉に看病されているのはわかるけど、どうしてそれが自分の部屋じゃなくて、畳の部屋だったりするんだろうか。
　なにか。
　なにか、ひどい違和感が、ある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, why have you been grinning like that? If you have so much energy, perhaps I no longer need to watch over you.”
“It's not that. I was only remembering something from long ago, when you were in a tatami room—”
――――A tatami room?
What was that memory?
I understood that Akiha had been nursing me, but why had it happened in a tatami room instead of my own bedroom?
Something was wrong.
Something about it felt horribly out of place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sheesh, why are you smiling like that?
If you have this much energy, I guess you don't need me to take care of you."
"No, that's not it.
I just remembered something from a long time ago.
Akiha, in that tatami room----"
----Tatami room?
What is that all about?
I understand Akiha taking care of me, but why was it in a tatami room and not my room?
Something.
There's something not quite right.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
この屋敷に畳がある部屋ってあったっけ？」
「いえ。
この屋敷に和室はありませんよ」
「そうだよな。
いや、なんでもないんだ。
ちょっと不思議に思っただけでさ、気にしないでくれ」
「はあ。
和室がないと不思議なんですか、兄さんは」
「まあな。
こんだけ広い屋敷だから、一つぐらいはあるかもしれないじゃないか」
「ええ、一つと言わず和風の離れはありますけど」
「え―――？」
　―――ああ、そういえばそうだった。
　庭の森の奥に、和風の屋敷があったんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Does this mansion have any rooms with tatami?”
“No. There are no Japanese-style rooms in the mansion.”
“Right. Never mind—the thought simply struck me as odd. Don't worry about it.”
“I see. Does the absence of a Japanese room trouble you so much?”
“A little—this place is enormous. You'd think there might be one somewhere.”
“We have not just one room, but an entire Japanese-style annex.”
“What—?”
―――Of course, now I remembered.
There was a Japanese house deep among the trees in the garden.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Is there a room with tatami in this mansion?"
"No, there are no Japanese rooms in this mansion."
"Yeah, you're right.
It's nothing.
I just thought it was odd, don't worry about it."
"Hm?
What is so odd about not having a Japanese room?"
"Oh, you know.
This mansion is so big, I thought maybe there was at least one."
"There is a detached Japanese-style building, however."
"Eh----?"
----Now that she mentions it, of course.
In the middle of the forest in the garden, there was a Japanese-style mansion.

entries.japanese:
「……もう、ホントに元気になっちゃいましたね。
これ以上私がいてもお邪魔みたいですから、部屋に戻ります」
　椅子から立ちあがって、秋葉は退室しようとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really have recovered. I seem to be intruding now, so I'll return to my room.”
Akiha rose from her chair and turned to leave.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Goodness, you really have become more energetic.
I think I will only be in the way if I stay longer so I will return to my room."
Standing up from the chair, Akiha goes to leave the room.

entries.japanese:
「ありがと、秋葉。
何時間もつきあわさせて悪かった」
「どうぞお気になさらずに。
明日から似たような生活サイクルになるんですから」
「………？」
　なんだかよく分からないことを言って、秋葉は部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thanks, Akiha. I’m sorry you had to sit with me for hours.”
“Please don’t concern yourself. Starting tomorrow, this will be more or less our regular routine.”
“…?”
With that cryptic remark, Akiha left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks, Akiha.
Sorry for making you stay here this whole time."
"Please don't worry about it.
Starting tomorrow, your daily life will become more like this."
"………?"
After saying something I don't quite understand, Akiha exits the room.

entries.japanese:
―――電気を消して、体をベッドに休める。
　秋葉が看病してくれた事もあって、気持ちはとても安らいでいた。
　これならすぐに、何日かぶりの安らかな夢を見られるだろう。
　深く息をはいて、ゆっくりとまぶたを閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I turned off the light and settled into bed.
Perhaps because Akiha had cared for me, my heart felt deeply at peace.
I should be able to drift at once into the first untroubled sleep I’d had in days.
I breathed out slowly and closed my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I turn off the lights and rest in bed.
Thanks to Akiha taking care of me, I feel more relaxed.
At this rate, I should be able to dream peacefully for the first time in days.
I take a deep breath and slowly close my eyes.

entries.japanese:
……眠りに落ちる前。
　幼い秋葉に看病されている昔の自分を、鮮明に思い出した。
　誰も見舞いに来てくれなかった暗い和室。
　槙久の目を盗んできたのか、秋葉はこっそりとやってきて、俺の手を握って泣いていた。
　ごめんなさい、と。
　俺には理由がわからなかったけど、ただごめんなさいという言葉を、何度も何度も繰り返していた、黒髪の少女。
entries.maoEnglish:
Just before I fell asleep.
I vividly remembered my childhood self being nursed by little Akiha.
The dark tatami room where nobody had come to visit me.
Perhaps she had slipped away without Makihisa noticing; Akiha had crept inside, taken my hand, and wept.
She kept saying she was sorry.
I had no idea why, but the black-haired girl simply repeated the apology over and over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Right before I fall asleep,
the memory of being tended by a young Akiha surfaces freshly in my mind.
The dark Japanese-style room where no one came to see me.
Did she sneak away from Makihisa?
Akiha snuck in and cried as she held my hand.
"I'm sorry," she was saying.
I didn't know why, but the black-haired young girl kept repeating "I'm sorry" over and over.

entries.japanese:
―――――おぼえている。
　ただ一人、自分の看病をしてくれた、儚げな遠野家の長女を。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――I remember.
The frail eldest daughter of the Tohno family, the only person who had nursed me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I remember.
About the proud eldest daughter of the Tohno family who was the only one to care for me.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　暗い和室の中でずっと泣き続けていた幼い少女。
　熱で朦朧としながら、悔しくて舌をかんだ。
　どうして泣いているんだろう、と。
　俺だったら。
　俺だったら、決して、あきはを泣かせたりしないのに。
　……ごめんなさい。
　……ごめんなさい、しき兄さん。
　その涙が、ただ、綺麗で。
　あの時から、自分はあきはにとって本当の兄になろう、と誓ったんだっけ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
A little girl had cried and cried in that dark tatami room. Feverish and dazed, I bit my tongue in frustration.
Why was she crying?
If it were up to me.
If it were up to me, I would never, ever make akiha cry.
I'm sorry.
I'm sorry, big brother shiki.
Her tears were simply beautiful.
Perhaps that was when I had sworn to become a true brother to akiha—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
The young girl always crying in the dark Japanese room.
I bit my tongue in frustration while being dizzy from fever.
I wonder why she was crying.
If it was me,
I would never, never let Akiha cry.
…… I'm sorry.
…… I'm sorry, Shiki-nii-san.
Her tears were simply beautiful.
Since that time, I vowed to be her real brother----

entries.japanese:
「ん―――――」
　何か、ズキリとした痛みで目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn…”
A sharp stab of pain woke me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nnn------"
I wake with a sudden ache.

entries.japanese:
「……朝、か」
　時計は六時四十分を過ぎたあたり。
　窓の外は文句のつけどころがないほどの快晴。
「いた―――」
　ずきん、とまた痛みが走った。
　頭でも胸でもなくて、首の横が痛んだみたいだ。
「……おかしいな……首が痛いなんて、今までなかったのに」
　首筋に手をあてても出血はない。
　だいたい弓塚にかまれた傷はとっくに塞がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning already?”
The clock showed a little after six forty.
Beyond the window, the sky was flawlessly clear.
“Ow—”
Another pulse of pain went through me.
It wasn't in my head or chest, but along the side of my neck.
“That's strange—my neck has never hurt before.”
My fingers found no blood.
The wounds where Yumizuka had bitten me had closed long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Morning?"
The clock says it's just past six-forty.
The weather outside the window is perfectly cloudless.
"Ow----"
Pain runs through me once again.
Not my head or chest, but apparently on the side of my neck.
"…… That's odd…… I've never had pain there before."
I put my hand on my neck, but there's no blood.
The wound from Yumizuka's bite is already closed.

entries.japanese:
「……熱でもあるのかな、俺」
　疲れが溜まっているのか、体がいつもより重い気がする。
「志貴さま、お目覚めでいらっしゃいますか？」
　ノック音と一緒に翡翠の声が聞こえてきた。
「……ああ、起きてるから中に入ってきていいよ」
「はい。
それでは失礼します」
　一礼して部屋に入ってくる翡翠。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do I have a fever?”
Perhaps exhaustion had accumulated after all, leaving my body heavier than usual.
“Master Shiki, are you awake?”
Hisui's voice came through the door with a knock.
“Yes, I'm up, so you can come in.”
“Very well. Excuse me.”
Hisui bowed before entering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe I have a fever."
Am I just worn out?
My body feels heavier than normal.
"Shiki-sama, are you awake?"
Accompanied by a knock, I hear Hisui's voice.
"Yeah, I'm up, so you can come in."
"Yes.
Please excuse me."
With a bow, Hisui enters the room.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、ご気分のほうはいかがですか？
　体調が優れないようでしたら、どうか遠慮なさらずにおっしゃってください」
　翡翠はじっとベッドに横になったこちらを見つめてくる。
　……どうも、昨日突然倒れた事をまだ心配してくれているみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How are you feeling, Master Shiki? If you are at all unwell, please don’t hesitate to tell me.”
Hisui studied me as I lay in bed.
Apparently my sudden collapse yesterday was still troubling her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, how are you feeling?
If you feel bad, please do not hesitate to tell me."
Hisui stares over at me as I lie in bed.
…… It seems she is still really worried about me collapsing so suddenly yesterday.

entries.japanese:
「大丈夫、体のほうは問題ないって。
昨日倒れたのだって、今までちょっと無理しすぎただけなんだし、これからはもうあんなコトにはならないよ」
　弓塚―――吸血鬼はもういない。
　だから、この数日間のように深夜に出歩くなんていう事は、もうないんだから。
「志貴さまがそうおっしゃるのでしたらよろしいのですが―――」
　何か他に心配事でもあるのか、翡翠は珍しく不安そうな顔をする。
「――――まあ、心配してくれるのは有り難いけど」
　言って、勢いよくベッドから立ちあがる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I'm fine—there's nothing wrong with me. I only collapsed because I'd been pushing myself too hard, and it won't happen again.”
Yumizuka—the vampire—was gone.
There would be no more wandering the streets after midnight as I had these past several days.
“If you say so, Master Shiki…”
Hisui looked unusually anxious, as though something else still concerned her.
“I appreciate you worrying about me, but—”
I sprang briskly out of bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine, there's nothing wrong with me.
I collapsed yesterday because I've been pushing myself recently, but that won't happen again."
Yumizuka---The vampire does not exist anymore.
Therefore, I won't have to walk the streets late at night like I did these past few days.
"If you say that is the case, then---"
I don't know what else she is worried about, but she looks at me uneasily.
"----Well, thank you for worrying about me."
I jump out of bed.

entries.japanese:
「ごらんの通り体のほうは元気一杯だよ。
すぐに着替えて居間に行くから、翡翠は先に行っていてくれ」
「……かしこまりました。
それでは失礼します」
　翡翠は着替えの学生服を置いて退室した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“As you can see, I’m full of energy. I’ll change and come to the sitting room in a minute, so go on ahead.”
“Very well. Please excuse me.”
Hisui left my school uniform and withdrew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"As you can see, I'm just fine.
I'll change real quick, so please go ahead of me to the sitting room."
"…… As you wish.
Well then, please excuse me."
Hisui places my fresh clothes down and exits the room.

entries.japanese:
「……どうしたんだろ。
そんなに顔色悪いのかな、俺」
　窓ガラスに映った自分の顔は普段とそう変りは無い。
　とにかく、学生服に着替えて居間に向かわないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What was that about? Do I really look so pale?”
My reflection in the window looked no different from usual.
In any case, I needed to put on my uniform and head downstairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What was that all about?
Do I look that pale?"
My face reflecting on the window glass looks pretty normal to me.
Anyways, I should hurry up and change, then head to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
「「あ」」
　ばったり、ロビーで秋葉と顔を合わせた。
　秋葉はもう学校に行くのか、鞄を持っている。
　……どうしてか、秋葉の顔を見たとたん、ぼっと体が熱くなった気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah,” we both said
I had run into Akiha in the foyer.
She was already holding her schoolbag, apparently ready to leave.
For some reason, the moment I saw her face, a rush of heat went through my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
""Ah.""
I run into Akiha in the lobby.
I guess she's going to school as she's holding her bag.
…… For some reason my entire body starts to heat up as soon as I see her face.

entries.japanese:
「おはよう、兄さん」
「―――あ、ああ。
おはよう、あきは」
　どくん、と胸が苦しくなる。
「ふふ、今日は何かあったんですか？
　いつもより二十分も早いなんて、兄さんらしくないですね」
「いや、ちょっと夢見が悪かっただけだよ。
ただの気紛れだから、気にしないでくれ」
　……自分で何を言っているのか分からない。
　あんな夢をみたせいか、幼いころの秋葉の顔がちらついてしまって、まともに秋葉の顔が見れなくなってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother.”
“Y-yes. Morning, Akiha.”
My heart gave a painful thud.
“My, did something happen today? Being twenty minutes early is hardly like you.”
“No, I only had an unpleasant dream. It was just a whim, so don't worry about it.”
I had no idea what I was saying.
Perhaps because of that dream, the face of Akiha as a child kept flickering over the face before me, and I could no longer look her in the eye.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Nii-san."
"----Y, yeah.
Good morning, Akiha."
Thump.
My chest starts to hurt.
"Wow.
Is something special going on today?
You're up a full twenty minutes earlier than usual, Nii-san."
"No… I just had a bit of a bad dream, that's all.
Just a whim, don't worry about it."
…… I don't understand what I'm saying.
Is it because of my dream?
Suddenly remembering her young face, I can't look at Akiha directly.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　お顔が赤いですけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど―――」
「……？」
　なぜか秋葉を正視できなくて視線をそらす。
　と、秋葉のヤツは不審げに眉をよせて、傍まで近寄ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Your face is red.
Do you have a fever?”
“No, I don't think it's that—” “……?”
Unable to meet Akiha’s eyes, I looked away.
She knit her brows suspiciously and stepped close to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
Your face is red… do you have a fever?"
"No, it's not that----"
"……?"
For some reason I just can't return her gaze.
She lifts an eyebrow suspiciously and comes near me.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
　秋葉の手が、おでこに触れる。
「あ――――」
　どくん、という胸の動悸。
―――秋葉の手の平は、昔とちっとも変わらない。
　冷たく、柔らかい指先。
　どくん、どくん、と。
　ただ秋葉の指が触れているだけの数秒間、自分の心臓がどくどくと脈動している事が、不思議でならなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Akiha laid a hand against my forehead.
“Ah—”
My heart slammed in my chest.
―――Akiha’s palm hadn’t changed at all.
Cool, soft fingertips.
Thud, thud.
Her fingers touched me for only a few seconds, yet my heart pounded so violently that I couldn’t understand it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me."
She brings her hand to my forehead.
"Ah----"
Thump.
My heart beats.
----Akiha's palm is not any different from back then.
Cold, soft fingertips.
Thump.
Thump.
Her fingers touch me for only a matter of seconds, but my heart strangely begins to pound harder.

entries.japanese:
視線をさげれば、すぐ近くに秋葉の顔がある。
　……強い意志を思わせる、細く力強い眉。
　……深く澄んだ黒い瞳と、同じように深い黒色をした長い髪。
　それらは本当に、遠野秋葉という名前に関係なく、キレイだ。
―――どくん、という心音。
　もう、真っ赤に赤面しているだろう自分の顔が容易に想像できる。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I lowered my gaze, Akiha's face was very close.
Fine, forceful brows that spoke of a formidable will.
Deep, lucid black eyes, and long hair of the same profound black.
They were beautiful in their own right, quite apart from the name Akiha Tohno.
―――Another heavy beat of my heart.
I could easily imagine how scarlet my face must have become.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I were to glance down, her face would be right there.
…… Her thin, strong eyebrows which show her strong will.
…… Her clear black pupils with her matching long, black hair.
It really is a beauty unrelated to the name Tohno Akiha.
---Thump.
My heartbeat.
I can just imagine how red my face has become.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――ちょっと」
　離れてくれないと、困る。
「……熱はないようですね」
　指を離して、秋葉は少しだけ身を引いた。
「念のため琥珀に風邪薬を用意させますから、兄さんは居間で待っていてください」
　と、秋葉は二階に上がっていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—wait.”
I needed her to move away.
“You don't seem to have a fever.”
Akiha removed her hand and stepped back a little.
“I'll have Kohaku prepare some cold medicine, just in case; please wait in the sitting room, Brother.”
With that, Akiha went upstairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey----Akiha."
If she doesn't pull back, it'll be troubling.
"…… It seems you don't have a fever."
She pulls her fingers away and backs off slightly.
"Just in case, I'll have Kohaku prepare some cold medicine.
Please wait in the sitting room, Nii-san."
With that, Akiha goes up to the second floor.

entries.japanese:
時計の針が七時にさしかかる。
「はい、お待たせしました。
風邪薬とお水をお持ちしましたから、食後に飲んでくださいね」
「あ………琥珀、さん」
　ガックリと肩がおちる。
　いや、琥珀さんが持ってきてくれるだけでも十分嬉しいんだけど、てっきり秋葉が持ってきてくれると思っていたから、拍子抜けしてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The clock was approaching seven.
“Thank you for waiting. I've brought cold medicine and water, so take it after breakfast.”
“Oh—Kohaku.”
My shoulders sagged.
I was perfectly happy to have Kohaku bring it, of course, but having assumed Akiha would return, the sight of someone else caught me off guard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The hands of the clock reach seven.
"Sorry to keep you waiting.
I have cold medicine and water, so please drink it after breakfast, okay?"
"Ah……… Kohaku… san."
My shoulders slump.
I'm really glad Kohaku-san brought it, but I was expecting Akiha to bring it, so I'm a little disappointed.

entries.japanese:
「ありがとう琥珀さん。
それで秋葉は？
　まだ学校には早いと思うんだけど」
「いえ、秋葉さまは色々と手続きがありますから早めに登校なさったんです。
それでですね、志貴さん？」
　にまにまとした顔で琥珀さんは俺の顔を覗きこんでくる。
「な、なに？
　俺、またなんかやってた？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you, Kohaku. Where’s Akiha? It still seems early for school.”
“Miss Akiha had some paperwork to arrange, so she left early. But more importantly, Shiki…”
Kohaku leaned in with a wicked grin.
“Wh-what? Did I do something again?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks, Kohaku-san.
Where's Akiha?
I think it's a bit early for her to go to school…"
"No, since there were some formalities to take care of, Akiha-sama left for school earlier.
And, you know what, Shiki-san?"
Kohaku-san looks into my face with a smile.
"Wh… what?
Did I do something again?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
さっき、秋葉さまに何をしたのかなあって。
あんなに嬉しそうな秋葉さまを見るのは久しぶりでしたから、気になって気になって」
「……いや、別に秋葉を喜ばすような事なんかしてないよ。
……しいていうなら、こっちが嬉しかった事があったぐらいで――――」
　……っていうか、今日の秋葉はえらく機嫌がよかったな。
　顔を合わせた時から笑顔だったし、それに、俺の熱をはかるなんて秋葉のイメージに合わない。
　熱を測るのなら琥珀さんに任せればいいのに、アレはちょっとヘンだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I was wondering what you did to Miss Akiha. It has been ages since I saw Miss Akiha look so happy, and I simply had to know.”
“No—I didn’t do anything to make Akiha happy. If anything, something happened that made me happy—”
Come to think of it, Akiha was in an exceptionally good mood.
She was smiling from the moment we met, and checking my temperature herself hardly fits my image of her.
She could have left that to Kohaku, which made it seem a little strange.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I was wondering what you did to Akiha-sama just now.
It's been such a long time since I have seen Akiha-sama this happy.
I'm curious, really curious."
"…… Um, I didn't really do anything to make her happy…… In fact, it's more like I'm the happy one----"
…… But, Akiha did seem to be in a good mood, didn't she?
She was smiling when we ran into each other, and for Akiha to take my temperature just isn't like her at all.
It would've been fine just to leave that to Kohaku-san, so that was odd enough.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん？
　なにか思い当たりました？」
「ごめん、わからない。
たしかにあいつ、今日はすごく機嫌がよかったけど、それって俺のせいじゃないと思うよ。
　だいたいさ、俺は今の秋葉のことはよくわからないんだ。
あいつだって八年前とは違うんだから」
「そうですか。
まあ、たんに志貴さんに自覚がないだけとは思いますけど、そういうコトにしておきましょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki? Have you thought of something?”
“Sorry, no. She was certainly cheerful today, but I doubt it was because of me.
The truth is, I hardly know the Akiha of today. She isn’t the same person she was eight years ago.”
“I see. I suspect you’re simply oblivious, but we’ll leave it at that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san?
Does anything ring a bell?"
"No, sorry.
She definitely did seem in a good mood, but I don't think it was because of me.
In the first place, I don't understand Akiha right now at all.
She is different than she was eight years ago."
"Oh really?
Well, I personally think you are a bit dense at times, but let us leave it at that."

entries.japanese:
「さて、それじゃあ志貴さんは朝ごはんを召し上がってください。
食堂のほうにご用意しておきましたから」
「あ、はい。
いつもすみません」
　ぺこりと頭をさげて食堂に向かう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, Shiki, please have your breakfast. I've set everything out in the dining room.”
“Right. Thank you, as always.”
I bowed and headed for the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, please eat breakfast, Shiki-san.
It is waiting for you in the dining room."
"Uh, yeah.
Thanks as always."
I give her a quick bow of the head and go to the dining room.

entries.japanese:
「あ、志貴さん。
先ほどの言葉ですけど、あれは間違ってますよ」
「……え？
　間違ってるって、何がです？」
「秋葉さまは昔とこれっぽっちも変わっていません。
秋葉さまを分からないようにしているのは、志貴さんのほうだと思います」
　なんとも意味深な捨てゼリフを残して、琥珀さんはロビーのほうへ去っていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Shiki. What you said a moment ago was wrong.”
“…What was wrong?”
“Miss Akiha has not changed in the slightest. I think you’re the one keeping yourself from understanding Miss Akiha.”
With that pointed parting shot, Kohaku disappeared toward the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san.
What you said earlier was mistaken."
"…… Eh?
Mistaken?
What was?"
"Akiha-sama has not changed one bit from the past.
I think the one who is making Akiha hard to understand is you, Shiki-san."
Leaving me with a phrase loaded with meaning, Kohaku-san disappears towards the lobby.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、今日のお帰りはいつごろになるでしょうか？」
「ん、夕方には帰ってくるよ。
……もう特別な用事もないしね、やっぱり四時までには帰ってくるから」
「はい。
……今日からはここでお帰りを待つ事はできませんが、お帰りしだいご用がありましたら声をおかけください」
「………？」
　門で待つ事はできないって、どういう意味だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, at what time do you expect to return today?”
“Sometime this afternoon. I don't have any unusual business left, so I'll be back by four.”
“Very well. I will no longer be able to await your return here from today onward, but please call for me if you require anything once you are home.”
“……?”
What did she mean, she couldn't wait for me at the gate anymore?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, what time will you be returning today?"
"Hm, in the evening…… I don't have anything special to do, so I'll be back by four."
"I understand…… I will no longer be able to wait for you here, but please call for me if you need anything when you return."
"………?"
Unable to wait by the gate… what does she mean?

entries.japanese:
「それではいってらっしゃませ、志貴さま」
「ああ、行ってくるよ」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをする翡翠に手をあげて、屋敷の正門を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have a pleasant day, Master Shiki.”
“I'll see you later.”
I raised a hand to Hisui as she bowed deeply, then left through the mansion gates.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please have a safe journey, Shiki-sama."
"Yeah, I'm off."
Raising a hand to the bowing Hisui, I exit the front gate of the mansion.

entries.japanese:
今日は早起きしたおかげか、登校にも余裕がある。
　いつもは小走りで通りすぎる道を、ゆったりと散歩気分で歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thanks to waking early, I had plenty of time to reach school.
Instead of jogging along the road as usual, I strolled at my leisure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since I woke up early, I can take my time going to school.
I walk leisurely down the road to school which I normally jog down.

entries.japanese:
ゆったりと歩いて、校門が閉められる十分前に到着した。
　この時間は朝の部活をしていない生徒が登校してくる時間帯だ。
　進学校であるうちの高校の部活は、おもだった体育系の部活しか朝錬はしていない。
　自然、校門は群がる生徒たちでごった返すことになる。
「あ、先輩」
　少し前にシエル先輩がトコトコと歩いているのを発見した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even at that pace, I arrived ten minutes before the gates closed.
This was when students without morning club practice generally came in.
At our academically focused school, only the major athletic clubs trained before class.
The gate naturally became a solid press of students.
“Oh, Ciel.”
I spotted her a short distance ahead, trotting toward the entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk slowly and arrive at the gate ten minutes before it closes.
It's the time when all the students not participating in clubs arrive.
In a high school prepping for general entry like mine, the only clubs practicing in the morning are the athletic clubs.
It's only natural for the school gate to be this crowded.
"Ah, Senpai."
I see Ciel-senpai walking a little bit ahead of me.

entries.japanese:
「先輩！」
　声をかけて呼び止める。
「あ、おはよう遠野くん。
めずらしいですね、昇降口で会うなんて」
「ああ。
先輩の後ろ姿が見えたから走ってきたんだ。
先輩はいつもこの時間？」
「はい、早起きが苦手なんでいつも時間ぎりぎりなんです。
そうゆう遠野くんは今朝は寝坊したんですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
I called out to stop her.
“Good morning, Tohno. Fancy meeting you at the entrance.”
“Yes. I saw you ahead of me and ran to catch up. Do you always arrive around this time?”
“Yes, I'm terrible at waking early, so I'm always cutting it close. Did you oversleep this morning?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai!"
I call out to stop her.
"Ah, good morning, Tohno-kun.
It's rare to meet you by the entrance here."
"Yeah.
I saw you from behind so I ran up to meet you.
Do you always come at this time?"
"Yes, I am bad at getting up early so I always just barely make it.
Did you oversleep today?"

entries.japanese:
「いや、これでも早起きしたほうなんだけど。
いつもはですね、門が閉められるかどうかの瀬戸際で生きているんです、俺」
「へえ、遠野くんって実はお寝坊さんだったんですね……って、あれ？」
　ゴミでもついているのか、先輩はじっと俺の顔を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, this actually counts as early for me. Ordinarily I live each morning on the knife-edge of whether the gates will close first.”
“My, so you're secretly a sleepyhead—wait, what?”
Ciel stared intently at my face; did I have something stuck to it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I actually woke up earlier.
You know, I normally make it right as the gate is about to close."
"Wow, you mean you're a late riser, Tohno-kun…… huh?"
I might have something on my face as Senpai stares right at me.

entries.japanese:
「あの―――先輩？」
「遠野くん、休みの間に何かありましたか？」
「いえ、別にこれといってないけど、どうしたんですか先輩？」
「いえ、別になんでもないです。
ちょっとからかっただけですから、忘れてください」
「？」
　わけがわからなくて困惑する。
――――と。
　そんなとき、昇降口のほうからすごい勢いで見知った顔が走ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel?”
“Did something happen over the holiday, Tohno?”
“Nothing in particular—why?”
“No reason. I was only teasing you, so forget I said anything.”
“?”
I could only stare at her in confusion.
――――And then.
a familiar face came tearing out of the school building at tremendous speed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um----Senpai?"
"Tohno-kun, did something happen over the weekend?"
"No, not really.
Why do you ask, Senpai?"
"Oh, it's nothing.
I was just playing around.
Please forget about it."
"?"
I'm a little bewildered.
----And then,
at that moment, I see a familiar face running vigorously from the entrance.

entries.japanese:
「乾くんですね」
　先輩は冷静な発言をする。
「うん、あれは乾だね」
　こっちも冷静に言ってみた。
　俺も先輩も、この時間帯にわざわざ校舎から出てきて、おまけにこっちに向かって爆走してくる有彦の奇行をおかしいとも思ってない。
　というか、もう慣れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That's Inui.”
Ciel observed calmly.
“Yes, that's Inui.”
I agreed with equal calm.
Neither of us considered it strange that Arihiko had left the building at this hour merely to sprint straight toward us.
We were used to him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's Inui-kun."
Senpai says this calmly.
"Yeah, it's Inui."
I try answering her calmly.
Senpai and I don't even think the actions of the rampaging Arihiko as he dashes towards us are odd at all.
In other words, we're used to it.

entries.japanese:
「遠野ーーーーーっ！」
　有彦は砂煙をあげて走ってくる。
　止まらない。
　俺たちが目の前にいるっていうのに止まらず、有彦は俺に向かって豪快な飛び蹴りをかましてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohnooooo!”
Arihiko came charging in a cloud of dust.
He didn’t slow down.
Even with us directly ahead, he kept coming and launched a magnificent flying kick at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno~~~~~~!"
A cloud of dust kicks up behind him.
He doesn't stop.
Even though we are right in front of him, Arihiko launches a drop kick in my direction without even pausing.

entries.japanese:
どん、がらがらがら、とたん。
「……………」
　信じ、られない。
　この男、人にライダーキックをかましただけでは飽き足らず、衝突したまま地面に三回も転がってくれた。
「……………」
　とりあえず立ち上がって服についた砂を払う。
　有彦も立ち上がって、ぱんぱんと服をはたいていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud—clatter, crash, bang.
“……”
Unbelievable.
As if delivering a flying Rider Kick weren’t enough, the idiot had carried us through the collision and rolled us across the ground three full times.
“……”
I stood and brushed the dirt from my clothes.
Arihiko rose too and slapped the dust from his uniform.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Crash, roll, roll, roll, thud.
"……………"
I can't… believe it.
This guy, this person throws a kick full-force into me and we suddenly crash into the ground and roll three times.
"………………"
I get up and shake off all the dust from my clothes.
Arihiko also stands up and pats his uniform.

entries.japanese:
「有彦」
「遠野」
　三秒のインターバルののち、俺たちはまっすぐに向かい合った。
　せーの、
「いったい何するんだ、オマエ！」
「おまえ、妹がいるだろう！」
　で、お互いに怒鳴りあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko.”
“Tohno.”
After a three-second interval, we faced each other squarely.
Ready, and—
“What the hell was that for?”
“You have a sister!”
We shouted over each other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arihiko."
"Tohno."
After a three second interval, we face off directly.
Ready.
"What the hell are you doing!?"
"You have a sister!?"
Both of us shout simultaneously.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――――Wait—what?

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっと待って。
俺に妹がいるって、なんでそんなコト知ってるんだオマエ」
「うわああ、いるっていうのかー！」
　おう、と頭を抱えて身をよじる有彦。
　……なんていうか、たとえコイツに百万円ほど貸していても、他人ですと言いたくなるぐらい愉快なパフォーマンスだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hold on. How do you know I have a sister?”
“Waaaah—you really do?”
Arihiko clutched his head and writhed in anguish.
It was such a delightful performance that even if he owed me a million yen, I would still have denied knowing him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a second.
How do you know I have a sister?"
"Uwaaa, you do have one after all!"
Arihiko holds his head in his hands, and twists his body.
…… It's so ridiculous looking, I would deny knowing him even if he owed me a million yen.

entries.japanese:
「おい、やめろ有彦。
っていうかやめてくれ。
このままじゃ学校じゅうの笑いもんだぞ、俺たち」
「ええい、知ったコトか！」
　ぎり、と有彦は睨んでくる。
「うらぎりものめっ、いまにお兄さんと呼んでやるぜ！」
　わけのわからない言葉を残して有彦は走り去っていった。
　その、校舎のほうではなく、校門のほうへ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop it, Arihiko. Please. At this rate, the whole school will be laughing at us.”
“Like I care!”
Arihiko glared at me through gritted teeth.
“You traitor—one of these days, I'll make you call me big brother!”
Arihiko ran off after delivering that incomprehensible threat.
He went not toward the school building, but straight back out through the gates.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, cut it out Arihiko, please.
We'll end up being the laughingstock of the school."
"Screw that, I don't care!"
Arihiko looks up with a glare.
"You traitor!
I'll call you Onii-san someday!"
Leaving such an incomprehensible parting shot, Arihiko runs off.
Not towards the school building, but to the front gate.

entries.japanese:
「……なんなんだ、アイツ」
　ホームルーム開始まであと五分もない。
　何もかも理解不能だが、とにかく今日一日は有彦と顔を合わす事はなさそうだった。
　二時限目が終わった休み時間、トウトツに有彦は帰ってきた。
「うむ。
よく考えたら俺が帰る理由はなかったのだ」
　なんて事を言って、大人しく自分の席に座ってしまう。
　放っておいて、こっちもぼんやりと席に座って三時限目の開始を待つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What was that about?”
Homeroom began in less than five minutes.
None of it made sense, but at least I probably wouldn't have to see Arihiko again today.
During the break after second period, Arihiko abruptly returned.
“Indeed. Upon reflection, I realized there was no reason for me to go home.”
Having declared that, he sat quietly at his desk.
I ignored him and waited drowsily for third period to begin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's he doing?"
There isn't even five minutes until homeroom starts.
Nothing about him is understandable.
Anyways, it seems like I won't run into him for the rest of the day.
During the break after second period, Arihiko suddenly returns.
"Hm.
After thinking about it for a while, I had no reason to go home."
Saying so, he calmly takes his seat.
Leaving him alone, I stare blankly in my seat and wait for third period to start.

entries.japanese:
に、しても───今日の教室は何かヘンだ。
　休み時間になるたびに教室中の男子が大挙して教室を出ていって、シアワセそうな顔をして戻ってくる。
「？」
　……なんか、気になるな。
entries.maoEnglish:
Still, something felt odd about the classroom today.
At every break, nearly all the boys streamed out in a mob, then returned wearing blissful smiles.
“?”
Now I was curious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But----the classroom seems odd today.
Every break, all the guys leave the room, and come back with happy looks on their faces.
"?"
…… I'm a bit curious.

entries.japanese:
「こんにちは遠野くん。
お邪魔していいですか？」
「あれ？
　先輩、休み時間だっていうのに、うちの教室になんてきていいの？」
「はい、自分の教室にいるよりこっちのほうが楽しいですから」
　笑顔で嬉しいことを言ってくれる。
　有彦は机に座ったままで、先輩がやってきた事に気付いていない。
　実に理想的な位置関係だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hello, Tohno. Mind if I intrude?”
“Ciel? Should you really be visiting our classroom during break?”
“Certainly—it's more fun here than in my own classroom.”
She said something delightful with a smile.
Arihiko remained seated with his back to us, apparently unaware of her arrival.
The arrangement was ideal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hello, Tohno-kun.
Do you mind?"
"Huh?
It's break time, Senpai, is it okay to come to my classroom like this?"
"Yes, being here is much more fun than being in my classroom."
She smiles happily as she says this.
Arihiko sits at his desk unaware of Senpai's arrival.
It is quite the ideal situation.

entries.japanese:
「けど、二年生の教室も騒がしいんですね。
三年生の男子生徒も騒いでましたから、今ごろ四階は大混雑してるんでしょうか」
「……はい？
　三年の男子が騒いでるって、何がですか？」
「あ、余裕ですね。
まあ、遠野くんは見にいく必要がないですからねー」
「……？」
　……よく解らないけど、トオノくんはミにいくヒツヨウがないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The second-year floor is lively too, I see. The third-year boys were making quite a commotion, so the fourth floor must be packed by now.”
“What? What are the third-year boys excited about?”
“Oh, how relaxed you are. I suppose you have no reason to go look, Tohno.”
“…?”
I didn’t understand, but apparently TOHNO HAD NO REASON TO GO LOOK.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But the second year classrooms are pretty noisy too.
The third year boys have also been making a fuss and I imagine the fourth floor is overcrowded by now."
"…… Huh?
The third year boys making a fuss?
About what?"
"Oh, you're not making a big deal out of it.
Well, there is no reason for you to go look, Tohno-kun."
"……?"
…… I don't quite understand, but it seems there is no reason for me to go look.

entries.japanese:
「なんですかそれ。
見にいくって、何を見にいくんです」
「だから、一年生にやってきた転校生のことですよ。
教室の男の子、みんな代わる代わるで見にいっているじゃないですか。
　彼女が転入したクラスの廊下も人が集まってるそうですし、すごい人気ですよね」
　転校生……？
　えっと、ようするに、うちの男子たちはさっきからその子を見に行っていたのかな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What does that mean? Go look at what?”
“The new transfer student in the first year, of course. The boys in your classroom have been taking turns going to see her.
I hear the corridor outside her new class is crowded too.
She's remarkably popular.”
A transfer student—so that was who all the boys had been going to see?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you mean?
Go see what?"
"The new first year transfer student.
All the boys in every class are taking turns to go see her.
Apparently the hallway outside her classroom is very crowded.
She's awfully popular."
Transfer student……?
Hmm… in other words, that's where all the guys in my classroom went too.

entries.japanese:
「────はあ。
その言いぶりじゃ可愛い子なんだ、その転校生って」
「わたしは知りませんけど、朝からその話で持ちきりですよ。
一年に有名なお嬢様学院から転校してきた子がいるぞって」
「……ふうん。
こんな時期に転校だなんてよっぽどの事情があったのかな」
「あ、やっぱりそうなんですか。
でももったいないですよね、浅上女学院っていえば名門中の名門でしょう？」
「へえ、そいつは奇遇だな。
たしかうちの妹もそこの一年生なんだけど───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. From the way you describe her, she must be pretty.”
“I haven't seen her, but everyone has been talking about it since morning. A girl transferred into the first year from a famous young ladies' academy.”
“At this time of year? She must have had an unusual reason.”
“So it is unusual. What a waste, though—Asagami Girls' Academy is one of the finest schools in the country, isn't it?”
“What a coincidence. My sister is a first-year there—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Oh?
So that means she's really cute, this new transfer student?"
"I don't know, but that's what I've heard.
They say a girl in the first year transferred from a famous ladies academy."
"…… I see.
For someone to transfer at this time of the year, there must be some strange circumstances."
"You thought so too, huh?
But it seems like a waste.
Why is she transferring from the distinguished Asagami Ladies' Academy to go here?"
"Hm?
What a coincidence.
My sister is also a first year student at----"

entries.japanese:
────って、待った。
　さっきからどうも先輩と会話がかみ合わない。
　先輩の口ぶりは、まるで俺がその転校生の事を知っているような感じだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
────Wait.
Something had been out of step in this conversation from the start.
Ciel had been speaking as though I already knew the transfer student.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Wait a minute.
There's something not quite right about this whole conversation.
Senpai sounds like I know this transfer student already.

entries.japanese:
どうぞお気になさらずに。
　明日から似たような生活サイクルになるんですから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Don’t concern yourself.
Starting tomorrow, this will be more or less our regular routine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Please don't mind.
Starting tomorrow your daily life will become more like this.

entries.japanese: 秋葉さまは手続きがありまから、早めに登校したんですよ。
entries.maoEnglish: Miss Akiha went in early because she had paperwork to arrange.
entries.mirrorMoon: Since there were some formalities to take care of, Akiha-sama left for school earlier.

entries.japanese:
「――――――うそ」
　愕然とした。
　愕然としたけど、これは、もうそうとしか考えられない。
「遠野くん？」
　先輩の声も聞こえない。
　有彦の席を見ると、ヤツはにやりと邪悪な笑みをうかべていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No way.”
I was stunned.
Stunned, but there was no other possible explanation.
“Tohno?”
I could no longer hear Ciel.
When I looked toward Arihiko’s desk, he was wearing a wicked grin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------No way."
I'm shocked.
I'm shocked, but that's the only conclusion I can draw.
"Tohno-kun?"
I can't hear Senpai's voice anymore.
I look over at Arihiko's desk and he has an especially evil grin on his face.

entries.japanese:
ずかずかと有彦の席へ歩いていく。
「有彦」
「あら、なにかしらお兄さま」
「……殴るよ、それ」
「ちぇっ、冗談の通じないヤツ。
で、どうした。
いまさら俺のような庶民になにか誤用ですかね」
　ひっひっひ、と笑いながら有彦はいう。
「ゴヨウって、まあ、そりゃあ誤用かもしんないけどさ、この場合」
entries.maoEnglish:
I marched over to him.
“Arihiko.”
“Why, whatever is it, dearest brother?”
“Say that again and I'll hit you.”
“Tch. No sense of humor. So what does a grand gentleman like you want to misuse a commoner like me for?”
Arihiko snickered.
“Well, I suppose 'misuse' may be the right word here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk purposefully over to his desk.
"Arihiko."
"Oh?
What could it possibly be, Onii-sama?"
"…… I'll punch you for saying that."
"H, hey, can't you take a joke?
What is it, is there a reason you would talk to a commoner like me?
Hyahahaha!"
Arihiko laughs.
"Reason?
Well, I do have a reason this time."

entries.japanese:
「で、有彦。
その転校生っていうのは、なんて名前か教えてくれないか」
「いやーん、言わなくてもわかってんだろ？
　そう、彼女の名前は遠野秋葉。
何を隠そうおまえの妹さんだな。
　ったく、オレにまで秘密にしやがって、あんだけの上玉ならすぐにバレるっつーの。
今度という今度こそ友情を疑ったね、オレは」
「……いや、もとから俺とおまえの間にはそんな幻想はなりたってなかったけど、まあ、そっか」
　力なく返答して、自分の席に戻る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko. Tell me the name of this transfer student.”
“Oh, don't make me say it when you already know.
Her name is Akiha Tohno. Wonder of wonders, she happens to be your little sister.
Honestly, you even kept me in the dark. With a catch like that, the secret was bound to get out; this time, I really have to question our friendship.”
“No—there was never any such fantasy between us, but—right, I see.”
I answer weakly and return to my desk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arihiko, can you tell me the name of this new transfer student?"
"Man, you should know without me saying anything, right?
Yes, her name is Tohno Akiha.
Your younger sister.
Geez, you even kept it a secret from me.
I would've found out quickly since she's that hot.
I really doubted our friendship this time."
"…… No, there's never been that sort of illusion between us, but I see."
Totally drained, I answer and return to my seat.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？」
　先輩がなにか言っているんだけど、返事をする気力はなかった。
「……はあ。
なにかたいへんそうですから、わたしも戻りますね」
 
　先輩はタッタカター、と軽い足取りで教室から去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno?”
Ciel was saying something, but I lacked the strength to answer.
“…Well, you seem to have a lot to deal with, so I’ll head back.”
Ciel skipped lightly out of the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?"
Senpai is speaking, but I just don't feel like responding.
"…… Hmm.
You seem to be having trouble, so I will go back."
Senpai walks out of the room lightly.

entries.japanese:
秋葉が、うちの学校に転校してきてる。
「───なに考えてんだ、あいつ」
　呆然と呟いて、ぱたん、と力なく自分の椅子に座り込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha had transferred to my school.
“What the hell is she thinking?”
I muttered in a daze and collapsed limply into my chair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha has transferred to my school.
"----What is she thinking?"
Muttering aloud in astonishment, I fall into my chair.

entries.japanese:
三時限目になって、英語の授業がはじまった。
　流暢な発音で流れてくる英文は、あまり頭に入ってくれない。
　転校してきたという秋葉のことで頭がいっぱいなせいで、英文はなにか不快なノイズにしか聞き取れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Third period began, and with it English class.
The fluent English washed over me without sinking in.
