My thoughts were so consumed by Akiha's transfer that the English sounded like nothing but irritating noise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Third period starts and English class begins.
The sound of fluent English goes in one ear and out the other.
My head is only full of thoughts about Akiha right now.
This English is just noise to me.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　だいたい秋葉も秋葉だ。
　うちに転校してくるなら、前もって俺に言ってくれてもよかったじゃないか。
　いや、そもそもあいつがうちの学校に転校してきたって、何の利点もないっていうのに―――
「あ―――――」
　ズキリと。
　首筋に、痛みが走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Honestly, Akiha was impossible.
If she meant to transfer here, she could at least have warned me.
Besides, what possible advantage could there be in attending my school—
“Ah—”
Pain stabbed through me.
It came from the side of my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
As always, Akiha is Akiha.
If she's going to transfer to my school, couldn't she at least tell me?
No, more importantly, she transferred to my school when there's no advantage for her to do so---
"Ah----"
Pain again.
Sharp pain in my neck.

entries.japanese:
がたん、と体が机につっぷす。
　まいった。
体が、うまく動かせない。
　眩暈だろうか。
　ならこんなのはいつもどおりだ。
つまり正常。
すぐに復帰。
なにしろ授業中。
早く回復しないと。
ほら、英語の教師が苛だたしげに英文を読み上げている。
黒板。
チョーク。
白墨の粉。
英文。
英文。
チョークを削る音。
教師。
教師。
大人。
教壇。
ギシギシと軋む教壇。
机。
三十六個の机。
生徒。
生徒。
三十六人の生徒。
三日前までは三十七個。
窓。
空。
校庭。
太陽。
人気がない。
寂しい。
寒い。
恐い。
不安。
なにか。
欲しい。
欲しい。
欲しい――――
entries.maoEnglish:
My body pitched onto the desk with a clatter.
Damn. I couldn’t make it move properly.
Was this dizziness?
Then it was the same as always. Normal. I’d recover at once. Class was in session. I had to recover. The English teacher was reading impatiently. Blackboard. Chalk. White dust. English. English. The scrape of chalk. Teacher. Teacher. Adult. Lectern. The lectern creaking. Desks. Thirty-six desks. Students. Students. Thirty-six students. There had been thirty-seven three days ago. Window. Sky. Schoolyard. Sun. Nobody there. Lonely. Cold. Afraid. Uneasy. Something. I want something. Want it. Want it—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fall onto my desk.
This is bad.
I can hardly move.
Is it anemia again?
Then it's just as always.
It's normal.
It'll pass.
I'm in class.
I have to recover.
Look, the English teacher is reading aloud.
The blackboard.
Chalk.
Chalk dust.
English.
The sound of chalk scraping.
Teacher.
Teacher.
Adult.
Podium.
The creaking podium.
Desk.
Thirty-six desks.
Student.
Students.
Thirty-six students.
Three days ago there were thirty-seven.
Window.
Sky.
Schoolyard.
Sun.
Unpopular.
Lonely.
Cold.
Frightened.
Uneasy.
Something.
Desire.
Desire.
Desire----

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん！
　きみ、大丈夫かね遠野くん！？」
　教壇からの声で、はた、と目が覚めた。
　……額にはすごい汗。
　体は冷たくなっていて、呼吸だけがはあはあと荒い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno! Are you all right, Tohno?”
The voice from the front of the room snapped me awake.
Sweat drenched my forehead.
My body had gone cold, while my breath came in harsh, ragged gasps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun!
Hey, are you alright, Tohno-kun!?"
My eyes open wide at the sound of the teacher's voice.
…… Sweat rolls down my forehead.
My body is cold, my breathing is ragged.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんだ遠野くん。
きみ、体の調子が悪いなら休んでいいぞ」
「あ、いえ。
大丈夫です、おさまりましたから」
「……そうか。
まあ、あまり無茶はしないようにね。
きみの場合、成績はいいんだから少しは休んでもいいんだぞ。
多少のハンデがあっても問題はないだろうからね」
　……英語の教師の言い分は、少しデリカシーにかけると思う。
　大丈夫です、とはっきり断言して、授業を再開させた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened, Tohno? If you're unwell, you may go rest.”
“No, sir. I'm all right now.”
“I see. Don't push yourself too hard. Your grades are excellent, so you can afford to miss a little class. Even with your condition, you shouldn't have trouble keeping up.”
The English teacher's concern lacked a certain tact.
I insisted that I was fine, and class resumed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it, Tohno-kun?
If you are not feeling well, you can rest."
"Ah, no, I'm fine.
It has passed."
"…… I see.
Well, don't push yourself.
Your grades are good so it is acceptable to take an occasional rest.
Your progress will be satisfactory even with some handicaps."
…… The English teacher's words lack a little consideration for the other students.
I once again declare I am fine and resume class.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになって、教室中があわただしくなる。
「――――はあ」
　ため息がもれる。
　朝から熱っぽかったけど、本当に風邪でも引いているのか、全身がだるかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
At lunchtime the classroom erupted into motion.
“Haaah…”
A sigh escaped me.
I had felt feverish since morning, and now my whole body was so heavy that perhaps I truly had caught a cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At lunch, the classroom gets frantic.
*sigh*
I take a deep breath.
I've been hot since this morning.
Maybe I caught a cold.
My whole body feels languid.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ遠野。
まだ教室に残ってたのか」
「……ああ、今日はちょっと体調が悪くてさ。
学食まで行けないから、買い物頼まれてくれないか？
　購買のいつものセットでいいから」
「いや、それはかまわないけどな。
いいのか、おまえの妹さん、なんだか食堂で困ってた風だったぞ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What's this, Tohno? Still in the classroom?”
“Yeah, I'm not feeling well today. I can't make it to the cafeteria, so could you buy lunch for me? My usual set from the school store is fine.”
“Sure, but what about your sister? She looked rather lost in the cafeteria.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What, Tohno?
Are you still sticking around here?"
"…… Yeah.
I don't feel too well today.
I can't go to the cafeteria, so can you please get me something?
I'll have the usual."
"No, I don't mind, but is that alright?
Your dear sister seems to be having trouble in the cafeteria."

entries.japanese:
「――――あ」
　そうか、あいつは今までお嬢さま学校に通っていたから、一般の学校の『学食』っていうシステムをまったく知らないんだ。
　今ごろ学食に行って、立ち往生している秋葉の姿がありありと目に浮かぶ。
―――くそ、そんなの放っておける訳がない。
「あ、遠野！
　行くならオレも行くぞ！」
　教室を駆け出る。
　……後ろからは、妙にハッスルした有彦が付いてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
Of course—she had always attended a refined young ladies' academy and wouldn't know the first thing about an ordinary school cafeteria.
I could picture her perfectly, stranded in the middle of it with no idea what to do.
―――Damn it, I couldn't leave her like that.
“Hey, Tohno! If you’re going, I’m coming too!”
I bolted from the classroom.
Behind me came an inexplicably enthusiastic Arihiko.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
That's right.
She's always been at a ladies academy so she wouldn't know anything about how a normal "school cafeteria" system works.
I can distinctly imagine Akiha standing in the cafeteria not knowing what to do.
----Damn, I can't leave her like that.
"Ah, Tohno!
Wait up!
I'm coming too!"
I dash out of the classroom.
…… Close behind me, Arihiko follows a bit more energetic than usual.

entries.japanese:
生徒たちで混雑した食堂の真ん中で、秋葉は呆然と立ち尽くしていた。
　一人で、何をしていいものか解らない、といったふうに。
「―――ったく。
なにしてるんだ、あいつは」
　急いで秋葉のところに走りよる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha stood frozen in the center of the crowded cafeteria.
She was alone and plainly unable to decide what she was meant to do.
“Honestly. What is she doing?”
I hurried toward her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha stands aghast in the center of the crowded cafeteria.
She looks as if she does not know what to do.
"----Geez.
What is she doing?"
I hurry over to Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉」
「兄、さん」
　一瞬。
　秋葉の顔が泣きそうなものに見えて、胸が痛んだ。
「―――ほら、こっちにこい。
おまえ、こういう人込みは嫌いだろ」
「あ――――はい」
　もう、一秒だってそんな泣きそうな顔なんか見たくなくて、強引に秋葉の腕をとって食堂を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
“Brother.”
For one instant, Akiha looked ready to cry.
Pain tightened my chest.
“Come on. This way—you hate crowds like this, don't you?”
“Yes.”
Unable to bear that near-tearful face for even another second, I seized Akiha by the arm and pulled her out of the cafeteria.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha."
"Nii… san."
In that instant,
I see her face on the verge of tears and my chest starts to hurt.
"----C'mon, over here.
You don't like crowds, right?"
"Ah----yes."
Not wanting to see her almost crying face a second longer, I strongly pull Akiha out of the cafeteria.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、ここなら落ちつくだろ。
とりあえず昼飯は買ってきてやるから、ベンチにでも座ってろ」
「……はい。
わざわざごめんなさい、兄さん」
「―――いいよ、詳しい事情はあとで聞くから。
有彦、購買に行ってくるから、それまで秋葉のことよろしくな」
「げっ。
な、なんだってこんな時にオレに頼るんだおまえはっ！
　いいって、購買ならオレが行ってくるから、遠野は妹さんの相手をしてろよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It's quieter here. Sit on the bench while I go buy you lunch.”
“Yes. I'm sorry you had to come all this way, Brother.”
“It's fine; I'll ask what happened later. Arihiko, I'm going to the school store, so look after Akiha until I'm back.”
“Gah! Wh-why would you rely on me at a time like this? I'll go to the store, so you stay and keep your sister company.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here, you should be able to relax now.
I'll go buy us some lunch, so just sit at this bench."
"…… Yes.
I apologize for the trouble, Nii-san."
"----It's alright.
I'll hear about it later.
Arihiko, I'm going to get lunch so take care of Akiha, okay?"
"W, why are you asking me all of a sudden!?
Look, I'll go buy lunch and you keep your sister company, Tohno."

entries.japanese:
「……？
　なんだよ有彦、オレのことをお兄さんって呼ぶんじゃないのか？
　いっとくけどこんなチャンス、この先ぜったいにやらないぞ」
　ぼそぼそ、と有彦に耳打ちする。
　こっちの小声に負けじと、有彦も秘密会議に参加してくる。
「いや、そうだけどよ、いくらなんでもいきなり二人っきりはまずいだろ。
そりゃあたいていの女ならそっちのがいいんだけど、おまえの妹さんはちょっとレヴェルが高すぎる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong, Arihiko? Weren’t you going to call me Big Brother? I’m warning you, you’ll never get another chance like this.”
I murmur into his ear.
Not to be outdone, Arihiko joins the whispered conference.
“I know, but putting me alone with her this suddenly would be madness. With most girls I’d prefer it, sure, but your sister is way out of my league.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
What's the matter Arihiko?
Aren't you going to call me Onii-san?
I'll tell you right now, but I won't give you a chance like this in the future."
I whisper to Arihiko.
He whispers back, maintaining our secrecy.
"R, right, but I can't be with her alone all of a sudden.
If it was any other woman I'd agree, but your sister is just too high class."

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ、らしくないな。
おまえ秋葉にびびってるのか？」
「おう。
率直にいえばビビってるぞ。
なにしろ今までにないタイプ故に、初戦は諜報活動に徹したい所存ナリよ」
　……こいつも、どうしてこう不思議なところで面白いんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That's unlike you. Are you afraid of Akiha?”
“Yes. In perfect honesty, I am terrified. She is an unprecedented type, and therefore I hereby propose that the opening engagement be devoted entirely to reconnaissance.”
Why was this idiot funniest at the strangest possible moments?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hm?
This isn't like you at all.
Are you scared of Akiha?"
"Yeah.
To be honest, I am.
Since she is the type I've never went against, I'd like to concentrate on getting information in the first round."
…… Why is he always this funny at strange times.

entries.japanese:
「しょうがないな、それじゃ三人分の昼飯を調達してきてくれ」
「おう、任せとけ。
……って、妹さん何食べるんだ？
　購買で売ってるパンなんて恐れ多くて出せないぞ、オレ」
「……そんなの知るか。
うちの学校に転校してきたんだからカレーパンとコーヒー牛乳で十分だ」
「――――了解。
五分で戻る」
　有彦はダッシュで校舎へと戻っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, bring back lunch for all three of us.”
“Leave it to me. Wait—what does your sister eat? I can’t present her with mere bread from the school store.”
“How should I know? If she transferred here, curry bread and coffee milk are good enough.”
“Understood. Five minutes.”
Arihiko sprinted back toward the school building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
Then can you go get lunch for the three of us?"
"Leave it to me…… Um, what does your sister want?
I'm too scared to buy her ordinary cafeteria bread."
"…… As if I would know.
She transferred here, so curry bread and coffee milk will be good enough."
"----Roger.
I'll be back in five minutes."
Arihiko returns to the building in a dash.

entries.japanese:
「今の人と随分仲がいいんですね、兄さん」
　……あれ？
　さっきまでの弱々しい姿はどこにいったのか、秋葉はすっかり元通りになっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You and that person seem very close, Brother.”
Huh?
Akiha's former frailty had vanished, and she was completely back to normal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You seem to be very good friends with him, Nii-san."
…… Huh?
Where did all her vulnerability go?
She's suddenly back to normal.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、あいつは特別気が合うヤツだからな。
……って、そんなコトより秋葉！」
「もう、そんな大声ださないでください。
周りの人たちが驚いてるじゃないですか」
「なっ―――」
「それより私の質問に答えてくれませんか。
今の人、兄さんのなんなんですか？」
　……なんなんですかって、あいつとは中学からの腐れ縁なだけだけど―――って、そうじゃなくて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. He's one of the few people I truly get along with.
But never mind him—Akiha!” “Please don't shout. Everyone around us is staring.”
“Wh—”
“Answer my question first. What exactly is that person to you, Brother?”
We had been stuck with each other since middle school, nothing more—but that wasn't the point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, we get along specially well…… M, more importantly, Akiha!"
"Please don't yell like that.
People around us are surprised."
"Wha----"
"More importantly, can you answer me?
That person, what is he to you, Nii-san?"
…… What is he?
He's just an unwanted but inseparable guy who's been with me since middle school----no, that's not what we're talking about.

entries.japanese:
「ん―――――」
　何か、ズキリとした痛みで目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nn…”
A sharp throb of pain wakes me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nnn------"
I wake with a sudden ache.

entries.japanese:
「……朝、か」
　時計は六時四十分を過ぎたあたり。
　窓の外は文句のつけどころがないほどの快晴。
「いた―――」
　ずきん、とまた痛みが走った。
　頭でも胸でもなくて、首の横が痛んだみたいだ。
「……おかしいな……首が痛いなんて、今までなかったのに」
　首筋に手をあてても出血はない。
　だいたい弓塚にかまれた傷はとっくに塞がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning already?”
The clock reads a little after six forty.
Outside the window, the sky is flawlessly clear.
“Ow—”
Another pulse of pain.
It is not my head or chest, but the side of my neck.
“That’s strange—my neck has never hurt like this before.”
I touch it, but there is no blood.
The wound where Yumizuka bit me closed long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Morning?"
The clock says it's just past six-forty.
The weather outside the window is perfectly cloudless.
"Ow----"
Pain runs through me once again.
Not my head or chest, but apparently on the side of my neck.
"…… That's odd…… I've never had pain there before."
I put my hand on my neck but there's no blood.
The wound from Yumizuka's bite is already closed.

entries.japanese:
「……熱でもあるのかな、俺」
　昨日のアルコールのせいか、体はどんよりと重いし、どことなく熱っぽい。
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あ、おはよう翡翠。
昨日はよく眠れた？」
「―――は、はい、昨日はお見苦しいところを見せてしまい、申し訳ありませんでした」
「あ、そっか。
翡翠は眠っちゃったんだっけ。
いいよ、俺だってあのあと貧血で倒れちゃったんだから、こっちのほうが見苦しかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe I have a fever.”
Perhaps it is yesterday’s alcohol, but my body feels leaden and faintly hot.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Morning, Hisui. Did you sleep well last night?”
“Y-yes—I apologize for behaving so disgracefully yesterday.”
“Oh, right—you fell asleep. Don’t worry about it. I passed out from anemia afterward, so I was much worse.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe I have a fever."
Is it because of the alcohol last night?
My body is heavy and I feel like I have a fever.
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"Ah, morning Hisui.
Did you sleep well last night?"
"----Y, yes.
Please forgive me for my unsightly behavior last night."
"That's right, you went to sleep.
It's okay.
I fainted afterwards anyway which was probably worse."

entries.japanese:
「そういっていただけると助かります。
それでは、着替えがすみましたら食堂のほうにいらしてください」
　よっぽど昨日のことが恥ずかしいのか、翡翠はおどおどしたままで出ていった。
「翡翠って、もしかして」
　もしかすると、すごい恥ずかしがり屋なのかもしれない。
　初めは無表情だなって思ったけど、よく見るとわりと怒ったり拗ねたりしているし。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is kind of you to say. Once you have dressed, please come to the dining room.”
Hisui leaves in a fluster, apparently still mortified by yesterday.
“Hisui couldn’t possibly be…”
Could she actually be painfully shy?
At first I thought she never showed any emotion, but once you watch closely, she gets angry and sulks quite a lot.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank you for your kind words.
After you change, please head towards the dining room."
She must still be very embarrassed about last night and leaves somewhat flustered.
"Hisui… maybe…"
Maybe it's possible for her to be easily embarrassed.
I thought she was basically expressionless at first but when you look at her closely, she gets embarrassed and mad a lot.

entries.japanese:
「……今度、思いっきり笑わせてみようかな」
　どうやって笑わすかは未定だけど、翡翠の心からの笑顔というのはきっと可愛いに違いない。
「―――って、翡翠の笑顔っていったら琥珀さんじゃないか」
　……つまらない結論になった。
　さっさと着替えて居間に向かおう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe I should really make her laugh one day.”
I have no idea how, but Hisui’s unguarded smile would surely be adorable.
“Wait—Hisui smiling would just make her look like Kohaku.”
A thoroughly uninspiring conclusion.
I’d better get dressed and head downstairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Next time I should try to make her laugh really hard."
I don't know how I would do that but there's no doubt Hisui's smile would be very cute.
"----Hey, Hisui's smile would look just like Kohaku-san."
…… A boring conclusion.
I quickly change and head to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
「「あ」」
　ばったり、ロビーで秋葉と顔を合わせた。
　秋葉はもう学校に行くのか、鞄を持っている。
　……どうしてか、秋葉の顔を見たとたん、ぼっと体が熱くなった気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
Akiha and I exclaim together as we run into each other in the lobby.
She has her bag, so she must already be leaving for school.
For some reason, the moment I see her face, a rush of heat floods my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
""Ah.""
I run into Akiha in the lobby.
I guess she's going to school as she's holding her bag.
…… For some reason my entire body starts to heat up as soon as I see her face.

entries.japanese:
「おはよう、兄さん」
「―――あ、ああ。
おはよう、あきは」
　どくん、と胸が苦しくなる。
「ふふ、今日は何かあったんですか？
　いつもより二十分も早いなんて、兄さんらしくないですね」
「いや、ちょっと夢見が悪かっただけだよ。
ただの気紛れだから、気にしないでくれ」
　……自分で何を言っているのか分からない。
　あんな夢をみたせいか、幼いころの秋葉の顔がちらついてしまって、まともに秋葉の顔が見れなくなってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother.”
“Y-yeah. Morning, Akiha.”
My heart gives a painful thud.
“My, did something happen today? You’re up twenty minutes earlier than usual, which isn’t like you, Brother.”
“Nothing—I just had a bad dream. It was a whim, so don’t worry about it.”
I don’t even know what I’m saying.
Maybe it is because of that dream, but Akiha’s childhood face keeps flickering over the one before me, and I can no longer look her in the eye.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning Nii-san."
"----Y, yeah.
Good morning Akiha."
Thump.
My chest starts to hurt.
"Wow.
Is something special going on today?
You're up a full twenty minutes earlier than usual, Nii-san."
"No… I just had a bit of a bad dream, that's all.
Just a whim, don't worry about it."
…… I don't understand what I'm saying.
Is it because of my dream?
Suddenly remembering her young face, I can't look at Akiha directly.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　お顔が赤いですけど、熱でもあるんですか？」
「いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど―――」
「……？」
　なぜか秋葉を正視できなくて視線をそらす。
　と、秋葉のヤツは不審げに眉をよせて、傍まで近寄ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Your face is red—do you have a fever?”
“No, it isn’t that, exactly…”
“……?”
For some reason I cannot face her, so I look away.
Akiha frowns suspiciously and steps close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
Your face is red… do you have a fever?"
"No, it's not that----"
"……?"
For some reason I just can't return her gaze.
She lifts an eyebrow suspiciously and comes near me.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
　秋葉の手が、おでこに触れる。
「あ――――」
　どくん、という胸の動悸。
―――秋葉の手の平は、昔とちっとも変わらない。
　冷たく、柔らかい指先。
　どくん、どくん、と。
　ただ秋葉の指が触れているだけの数秒間、自分の心臓がどくどくと脈動している事が、不思議でならなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Akiha lays a hand against my forehead.
“Ah…”
My heart pounds.
―――Akiha’s palm has not changed at all since we were children.
Cool, soft fingertips.
Thump, thump.
For the few seconds they rest against me, I cannot understand why my heart beats so violently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me."
She brings her hand to my forehead.
"Ah----"
Thump.
My heart beats.
----Akiha's palm is not any different from back then.
Cold, soft fingertips.
Thump.
Thump.
Her fingers touch me for only a matter of seconds, but my heart strangely begins to pound harder.

entries.japanese:
視線をさげれば、すぐ近くに秋葉の顔がある。
　……強い意志を思わせる、細く力強い眉。
　……深く澄んだ黒い瞳と、同じように深い黒色をした長い髪。
　それらは本当に、遠野秋葉という名前に関係なく、キレイだ。
―――どくん、という心音。
　もう、真っ赤に赤面しているだろう自分の顔が容易に想像できる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lowering my eyes brings Akiha’s face close beneath mine.
Fine, strong brows that speak of her will.
Clear black eyes, deep as the long black hair framing them.
Whatever name she bears, those things are simply beautiful.
―――My heart gives another heavy thud.
I can easily imagine how scarlet my face must be.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I were to glance down, her face would be right there.
…… Her thin, strong eyebrows which show her strong will.
…… Her clear black pupils with her matching long black hair.
It really is a beauty unrelated to the name Tohno Akiha.
---Thump.
My heartbeat.
I can just imagine how red my face has become.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――ちょっと」
　離れてくれないと、困る。
「……熱はないようですね」
　指を離して、秋葉は少しだけ身を引いた。
「念のため琥珀に風邪薬を用意させますから、兄さんは居間で待っていてください」
　と、秋葉は二階に上がっていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—wait.”
This is going to be a problem if she doesn’t step away.
“You don’t appear to have a fever.”
Akiha removes her fingers and draws back a little.
“I’ll have Kohaku prepare some cold medicine just in case, so please wait in the sitting room, Brother.”
With that, Akiha disappears upstairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey----Akiha."
If she doesn't pull back, it'll be troubling.
"…… It seems you don't have a fever."
She pulls her fingers away and backs off slightly.
"Just in case, I'll have Kohaku prepare some cold medicine.
Please wait in the sitting room, Nii-san."
With that, Akiha goes up to the second floor.

entries.japanese:
時計の針が七時にさしかかる。
「はい、お待たせしました。
風邪薬とお水をお持ちしましたから、食後に飲んでくださいね」
「あ………琥珀、さん」
　ガックリと肩がおちる。
　いや、琥珀さんが持ってきてくれるだけでも十分嬉しいんだけど、てっきり秋葉が持ってきてくれると思っていたから、拍子抜けしてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The hands of the clock creep toward seven.
“Sorry to keep you waiting. I brought cold medicine and some water, so take it after breakfast, all right?”
“Oh—Kohaku.”
My shoulders sag.
It is wonderful of Kohaku to bring it, of course, but I had convinced myself Akiha would, so the surprise leaves me deflated.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The hands of the clock reach seven.
"Sorry to keep you waiting.
I have cold medicine and water, so please drink it after breakfast, okay?"
"Ah……… Kohaku… san."
My shoulders slump.
I'm really glad Kohaku-san brought it, but I was expecting Akiha to bring it so I'm a little disappointed.

entries.japanese:
「ありがとう琥珀さん。
それで秋葉は？
　まだ学校には早いと思うんだけど」
「いえ、秋葉さまは色々と手続きがありますから早めに登校なさったんです。
それでですね、志貴さん？」
　にまにまとした顔で琥珀さんは俺の顔を覗きこんでくる。
「な、なに？
　俺、またなんかやってた？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thanks, Kohaku. Where’s Akiha? It still seems early for school.”
“Miss Akiha had various formalities to complete, so she left early. But tell me, Shiki…”
Kohaku peers into my face with a delighted grin.
“Wh-what? Did I do something again?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thanks Kohaku-san.
Where's Akiha?
I think it's a bit early for her to go to school…"
"No, since there were some formalities to take care of, Akiha-sama left for school earlier.
And, you know what, Shiki-san?"
Kohaku-san looks into my face with a smile.
"Wh… what?
Did I do something again?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
さっき、秋葉さまに何をしたのかなあって。
あんなに嬉しそうな秋葉さまを見るのは久しぶりでしたから、気になって気になって」
「……いや、別に秋葉を喜ばすような事なんかしてないよ。
……しいていうなら、こっちが嬉しかった事があったぐらいで――――」
　……っていうか、今日の秋葉はえらく機嫌がよかったな。
　顔を合わせた時から笑顔だったし、それに、俺の熱をはかるなんて秋葉のイメージに合わない。
　熱を測るのなら琥珀さんに任せればいいのに、アレはちょっとヘンだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I was wondering what you did to Miss Akiha. It has been ages since I saw Miss Akiha look so happy, and I simply had to know.”
“No—I didn’t do anything to make Akiha happy. If anything, something happened that made me happy—”
Come to think of it, Akiha was in an exceptionally good mood.
She was smiling from the moment we met, and checking my temperature herself hardly fits my image of her.
She could have left that to Kohaku, which made it seem a little strange.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I was wondering what you did to Akiha-sama just now.
It's been such a long time since I have seen Akiha-sama this happy.
I'm curious, really curious."
"…… Um, I didn't really do anything to make her happy.
…… In fact, it's more like I'm the happy one----"
…… But, Akiha did seem to be in a good mood, didn't she?
She was smiling when we ran into each other, and for Akiha to take my temperature just isn't like her at all.
It would've been fine just to leave that to Kohaku-san, so that was odd enough.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん？
　なにか思い当たりました？」
「ごめん、わからない。
たしかにあいつ、今日はすごく機嫌がよかったけど、それって俺のせいじゃないと思うよ。
　だいたいさ、俺は今の秋葉のことはよくわからないんだ。
あいつだって八年前とは違うんだから」
「そうですか。
まあ、たんに志貴さんに自覚がないだけとは思いますけど、そういうコトにしておきましょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki? Have you thought of something?”
“Sorry, no. She was certainly cheerful today, but I don’t think it had anything to do with me.
The truth is, I don’t really understand the Akiha of today. She isn’t the same person she was eight years ago.”
“I see, Shiki. Personally, I think you’re merely unaware of what you did—but we’ll leave it at that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san?
Does anything ring a bell?"
"No, sorry.
She definitely did seem in a good mood, but I don't think it was because of me.
In the first place, I don't understand Akiha right now at all.
She is different than she was eight years ago."
"Oh really?
Well, I personally think you are a bit dense at times but let us leave that there."

entries.japanese:
「さて、それじゃあ志貴さんは朝ごはんを召し上がってください。
食堂のほうにご用意しておきましたから」
「あ、はい。
いつもすみません」
　ぺこりと頭をさげて食堂に向かう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, Shiki, you should have breakfast. I’ve laid it out in the dining room.”
“Oh—right. Thank you, as always.”
I give her a small bow and head for the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, please eat breakfast Shiki-san.
It is waiting for you in the dining room."
"Uh, yeah.
Thanks as always."
I give her a quick bow of the head and go to the dining room.

entries.japanese:
「あ、志貴さん。
先ほどの言葉ですけど、あれは間違ってますよ」
「……え？
　間違ってるって、何がです？」
「秋葉さまは昔とこれっぽっちも変わっていません。
秋葉さまを分からないようにしているのは、志貴さんのほうだと思います」
　なんとも意味深な捨てゼリフを残して、琥珀さんはロビーのほうへ去っていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Shiki. What you said a moment ago was wrong.”
“…What was wrong?”
“Miss Akiha has not changed in the slightest. I think you’re the one keeping yourself from understanding Miss Akiha.”
Having delivered that loaded parting shot, Kohaku walks off toward the lobby.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san.
What you said earlier was mistaken."
"…… Eh?
Mistaken?
What was?"
"Akiha-sama has not changed one bit from the past.
I think the one who is making Akiha hard to understand is you, Shiki-san."
Leaving me with a phrase loaded with meaning, Kohaku-san disappears towards the lobby.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、今日のお帰りはいつごろになるでしょうか？」
「ん、夕方には帰ってくるよ。
……もう特別な用事もないしね、やっぱり四時までには帰ってくるから」
「はい。
……今日からはここでお帰りを待つ事はできませんが、お帰りしだいご用がありましたら声をおかけください」
「………？」
　門で待つ事はできないって、どういう意味だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, what time do you expect to return today?”
“I’ll be home this afternoon. I don’t have any special errands left, so I’ll definitely be back by four.”
“Understood. Starting today, I won’t be able to wait here for your return, but once you are home, please call for me if you need anything.”
“……?”
What does she mean, she cannot wait for me at the gate anymore?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, what time will you be returning today?"
"Hm, in the evening.
…… I don't have anything special to do, so I'll be back by four."
"I understand.
…… I will no longer be able to wait for you here, but please call for me if you need anything when you return."
"………?"
Unable to wait by the gate… what does she mean?

entries.japanese:
「それではいってらっしゃませ、志貴さま」
「ああ、行ってくるよ」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをする翡翠に手をあげて、屋敷の正門を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have a pleasant day, Master Shiki.”
“Thanks—I’ll see you later.”
I raise a hand to Hisui as she bows deeply, then leave the mansion gates behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please have a safe journey, Shiki-sama."
"Yeah, I'm off."
Raising a hand to the bowing Hisui, I exit the front gate of the mansion.

entries.japanese:
今日は早起きしたおかげか、登校にも余裕がある。
　いつもは小走りで通りすぎる道を、ゆったりと散歩気分で歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thanks to my early start, I have plenty of time to reach school.
Instead of trotting down the streets as usual, I take them at an easy, almost leisurely pace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since I woke up early, I can take my time going to school.
I walk leisurely down the road to school which I normally jog down.

entries.japanese:
ゆったりと歩いて、校門が閉められる十分前に到着した。
　この時間は朝の部活をしていない生徒が登校してくる時間帯だ。
　進学校であるうちの高校の部活は、おもだった体育系の部活しか朝錬はしていない。
　自然、校門は群がる生徒たちでごった返すことになる。
「あ、先輩」
　少し前にシエル先輩がトコトコと歩いているのを発見した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even walking slowly, I arrive ten minutes before the gates close.
This is when students without morning practice usually come in.
Since ours is an academically minded school, only the major sports clubs hold practice before class.
The gates therefore become a crush of arriving students.
“Oh, Ciel.”
I spot her a short distance ahead, walking along in her brisk little way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk slowly and arrive at the gate ten minutes before it closes.
It's the time when all the students who don't participate in clubs arrive.
In a high school prepping for general entry like mine, the only clubs practicing in the morning are the athletic clubs.
It's only natural for the school gate to be this crowded.
"Ah, Senpai."
I see Ciel-senpai walking a little bit ahead of me.

entries.japanese:
「先輩！」
　声をかけて呼び止める。
「あ、おはよう遠野くん。
めずらしいですね、昇降口で会うなんて」
「ああ。
先輩の後ろ姿が見えたから走ってきたんだ。
先輩はいつもこの時間？」
「はい、早起きが苦手なんでいつも時間ぎりぎりなんです。
そうゆう遠野くんは今朝は寝坊したんですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel!”
I call out to stop her.
“Oh, good morning, Tohno. It’s unusual to meet you by the entrance.”
“Yeah. I saw you ahead of me and ran to catch up. Do you always come at this time?”
“Yes—I’m terrible at getting up early, so I’m always cutting it close. Did you oversleep this morning, Tohno?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai!"
I call out to stop her.
"Ah, good morning Tohno-kun.
It's rare to meet you by the entrance here."
"Yeah.
I saw you from behind so I ran up to meet you.
Do you always come at this time?"
"Yes, I am bad at getting up early so I always just barely make it.
Did you oversleep today?"

entries.japanese:
「いや、これでも早起きしたほうなんだけど。
いつもはですね、門が閉められるかどうかの瀬戸際で生きているんです、俺」
「へえ、遠野くんって実はお寝坊さんだったんですね……って、あれ？」
　ゴミでもついているのか、先輩はじっと俺の顔を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, this counts as early for me. Ordinarily I live on the knife-edge between getting through the gate and having it shut in my face.”
“So you’re actually a sleepyhead—wait, what?”
Ciel stares intently at my face, as though I have something stuck to it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I actually woke up earlier.
You know, I normally make it right as the gate is about to close."
"Wow, you mean you're a late riser, Tohno-kun…… huh?"
I might have something on my face as Senpai stares right at me.

entries.japanese:
「あの―――先輩？」
「遠野くん、休みの間に何かありましたか？」
「いえ、別にこれといってないけど、どうしたんですか先輩？」
「いえ、別になんでもないです。
ちょっとからかっただけですから、忘れてください」
「？」
　わけがわからなくて困惑する。
――――と。
　そんなとき、昇降口のほうからすごい勢いで見知った顔が走ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um—Ciel?”
“Did something happen to you over the break?”
“No, nothing in particular—why?”
“It’s nothing. I was only teasing, so forget I said anything.”
“?”
I can only stare at her, baffled.
――――Just then.
A familiar face comes hurtling toward us from the school entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um----Senpai?"
"Tohno-kun, did something happen over the weekend?"
"No, not really.
Why do you ask, Senpai?"
"Oh, it's nothing.
I was just playing around.
Please forget about it."
"?"
I'm a little bewildered.
----And then,
at that moment, I see a familiar face running vigorously from the entrance.

entries.japanese:
「乾くんですね」
　先輩は冷静な発言をする。
「うん、あれは乾だね」
　こっちも冷静に言ってみた。
　俺も先輩も、この時間帯にわざわざ校舎から出てきて、おまけにこっちに向かって爆走してくる有彦の奇行をおかしいとも思ってない。
　というか、もう慣れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s Inui.”
Ciel makes the observation with perfect calm.
“Yeah, that’s Inui.”
I answer with equal composure.
Neither of us finds anything strange about Arihiko charging out of the school at this hour and racing directly at us.
We are used to him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's Inui-kun."
Senpai says this calmly.
"Yeah, it's Inui."
I try answering her calmly.
Senpai and I don't even think the actions of the rampaging Arihiko as he dashes towards us are odd at all.
In other words, we're used to it.

entries.japanese:
「遠野ーーーーーっ！」
　有彦は砂煙をあげて走ってくる。
　止まらない。
　俺たちが目の前にいるっていうのに止まらず、有彦は俺に向かって豪快な飛び蹴りをかましてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“TOHNO!”
Arihiko barrels toward us in a cloud of dust.
He does not slow down.
Though we are standing directly in his path, he keeps coming and delivers a magnificent flying kick straight into me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno~~~~~~!"
A cloud of dust kicks up behind him.
He does not stop.
Even though we are right in front of him, Arihiko launches a drop kick in my direction without even pausing.

entries.japanese:
どん、がらがらがら、とたん。
「……………」
　信じ、られない。
　この男、人にライダーキックをかましただけでは飽き足らず、衝突したまま地面に三回も転がってくれた。
「……………」
　とりあえず立ち上がって服についた砂を払う。
　有彦も立ち上がって、ぱんぱんと服をはたいていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wham—clatter, crash, thud.
“……”
I don’t believe it.
Apparently hitting someone with a full-on Rider Kick wasn’t enough for him; he had to crash into me and roll us across the ground three full times.
“……”
For now, I get up and brush the dirt from my clothes.
Arihiko rises too and slaps the dust from his uniform.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Crash, roll, roll, roll, thud.
"……………"
I can't… believe it.
This guy, this person throws a kick full-force into me and we suddenly crash into the ground and roll three times.
"……………"
I get up and shake off all the dust from my clothes.
Arihiko also stands up and pats his uniform.

entries.japanese:
「有彦」
「遠野」
　三秒のインターバルののち、俺たちはまっすぐに向かい合った。
　せーの、
「いったい何するんだ、オマエ！」
「おまえ、妹がいるだろう！」
　で、お互いに怒鳴りあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko.”
“Tohno.”
After a three-second interval, we turn and face each other squarely.
Ready, and—
“What the hell was that for?!”
“You have a little sister!”
We shout at each other in perfect unison.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arihiko."
"Tohno."
After a three second interval, we face off directly.
Ready.
"What the hell are you doing!?"
"You have a sister!?"
Both of us shout simultaneously.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――――Wait—what?

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっと待って。
俺に妹がいるって、なんでそんなコト知ってるんだオマエ」
「うわああ、いるっていうのかー！」
　おう、と頭を抱えて身をよじる有彦。
　……なんていうか、たとえコイツに百万円ほど貸していても、他人ですと言いたくなるぐらい愉快なパフォーマンスだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. How do you know I have a sister?”
“Aaaagh, so you really do!”
Arihiko clutches his head and writhes in agony.
It is such a joyous little performance that even if he owed me a million yen, I would still be tempted to deny knowing him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a second.
How do you know I have a sister?"
"Uwaaa, you do have one after all!"
Arihiko holds his head in his hands, and twists his body.
…… It's so ridiculous looking, I would deny knowing him even if he owed me a million yen.

entries.japanese:
「おい、やめろ有彦。
っていうかやめてくれ。
このままじゃ学校じゅうの笑いもんだぞ、俺たち」
「ええい、知ったコトか！」
　ぎり、と有彦は睨んでくる。
「うらぎりものめっ、いまにお兄さんと呼んでやるぜ！」
　わけのわからない言葉を残して有彦は走り去っていった。
　その、校舎のほうではなく、校門のほうへ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Knock it off, Arihiko. Please. At this rate the entire school will be laughing at both of us.”
“Like I care!”
Arihiko glares daggers at me.
“Traitor—just you wait, I’ll be calling you Big Brother soon!”
Leaving that incomprehensible threat behind, Arihiko runs off.
Not toward the school building, but back through the gates.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, cut it out Arihiko, please.
We'll end up being the laughingstock of the school."
"Screw that, I don't care!"
Arihiko looks up with a glare.
"You traitor!
I'll call you Onii-san someday!"
Leaving such an incomprehensible parting shot, Arihiko runs off.
Not towards the school building, but to the front gate.

entries.japanese:
「……なんなんだ、アイツ」
　ホームルーム開始まであと五分もない。
　何もかも理解不能だが、とにかく今日一日は有彦と顔を合わす事はなさそうだった。
　二時限目が終わった休み時間、トウトツに有彦は帰ってきた。
「うむ。
よく考えたら俺が帰る理由はなかったのだ」
　なんて事を言って、大人しく自分の席に座ってしまう。
　放っておいて、こっちもぼんやりと席に座って三時限目の開始を待つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is wrong with him?”
Homeroom begins in less than five minutes.
None of this makes any sense, but at least I probably won’t have to see Arihiko again today.
Arihiko abruptly returns during the break after second period.
“Indeed. Upon reflection, I discovered that I had no reason to go home.”
With that pronouncement, he sits quietly at his desk.
I leave him alone and wait vacantly for third period to begin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's he doing?"
There isn't even five minutes until homeroom starts.
Nothing about him is understandable.
Anyways, it seems like I won't run across him for the rest of the day.
During the break after second period, Arihiko suddenly returns.
"Hum.
After thinking about it for a while, I had no reason to go home."
Saying so, he calmly takes his seat.
Leaving him alone, I stare blankly in my seat and wait for third period to start.

entries.japanese:
に、しても───今日の教室は何かヘンだ。
　休み時間になるたびに教室中の男子が大挙して教室を出ていって、シアワセそうな顔をして戻ってくる。
「？」
　……なんか、気になるな。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even so, something feels strange about the classroom today.
Every time the bell rings for a break, all the boys surge out together, then come back wearing expressions of perfect bliss.
“?”
Now I’m curious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But----the classroom seems odd today.
Every break, all the guys leave the room, and come back with happy looks on their faces.
"?"
…… I'm a bit curious.

entries.japanese:
「こんにちは遠野くん。
お邪魔していいですか？」
「あれ？
　先輩、休み時間だっていうのに、うちの教室になんてきていいの？」
「はい、自分の教室にいるよりこっちのほうが楽しいですから」
　笑顔で嬉しいことを言ってくれる。
　有彦は机に座ったままで、先輩がやってきた事に気付いていない。
　実に理想的な位置関係だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hello, Tohno. Mind if I intrude?”
“Huh? Ciel, should you really be visiting our classroom during break?”
“Yes—it’s more fun here than in my own classroom.”
She gives me that welcome answer with a smile.
Arihiko remains seated, oblivious to her arrival.
An ideal arrangement.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hello Tohno-kun.
Do you mind?"
"Huh?
It's break time, Senpai, is it okay to come to my classroom like this?"
"Yes, being here is much more fun than being in my classroom."
She smiles happily as she says this.
Arihiko sits at his desk unaware of Senpai's arrival.
It is quite the ideal situation.

entries.japanese:
「けど、二年生の教室も騒がしいんですね。
三年生の男子生徒も騒いでましたから、今ごろ四階は大混雑してるんでしょうか」
「……はい？
　三年の男子が騒いでるって、何がですか？」
「あ、余裕ですね。
まあ、遠野くんは見にいく必要がないですからねー」
「……？」
　……よく解らないけど、トオノくんはミにいくヒツヨウがないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The second-year classrooms are lively too, I see. The third-year boys were making quite a commotion, so I imagine the fourth floor must be packed by now.”
“What? What are the third-year boys making a fuss about?”
“Oh, how composed you are. Well, I suppose you have no need to go and look.”
“……?”
I don’t understand, but apparently TOHNO HAS NO NEED TO GO AND LOOK.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But the second year classrooms are pretty noisy too.
The third year boys have also been making a fuss and I imagine the fourth floor is overcrowded by now."
"…… Huh?
The third year boys making a fuss?
About what?"
"Oh, you're not making a big deal out of it.
Well, there is no reason for you to go look, Tohno-kun."
"……?"
…… I don't quite understand, but it seems there is no reason for me to go look.

entries.japanese:
「なんですかそれ。
見にいくって、何を見にいくんです」
「だから、一年生にやってきた転校生のことですよ。
教室の男の子、みんな代わる代わるで見にいっているじゃないですか。
　彼女が転入したクラスの廊下も人が集まってるそうですし、すごい人気ですよね」
　転校生……？
　えっと、ようするに、うちの男子たちはさっきからその子を見に行っていたのかな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What does that mean? Go and look at what?”
“The new first-year transfer student, of course. Every boy in this classroom has been taking his turn to see her.
I hear the corridor outside her new class is packed too.”
A transfer student?
So all the boys have been leaving to stare at this girl?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you mean?
Go see what?"
"The new first year transfer student.
All the boys in every class are taking turns to go see her.
Apparently the hallway outside her classroom is very crowded.
She's awfully popular."
Transfer student……?
Hmm… in other words, that's where all the guys in my classroom went too.

entries.japanese:
「────はあ。
その言いぶりじゃ可愛い子なんだ、その転校生って」
「わたしは知りませんけど、朝からその話で持ちきりですよ。
一年に有名なお嬢様学院から転校してきた子がいるぞって」
「……ふうん。
こんな時期に転校だなんてよっぽどの事情があったのかな」
「あ、やっぱりそうなんですか。
でももったいないですよね、浅上女学院っていえば名門中の名門でしょう？」
「へえ、そいつは奇遇だな。
たしかうちの妹もそこの一年生なんだけど───」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. From the way you’re talking, she must be pretty.”
“I wouldn’t know, but she’s all anyone has discussed since this morning. A first-year girl transferred in from some famous academy for young ladies, apparently.”
“Hm. She must have had a serious reason to transfer at this time of year.”
“So it is unusual? What a waste—Asagami Girls’ Academy is one of the finest schools there is, isn’t it?”
“That’s a coincidence. My sister is a first-year there…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Oh?
So that means she's really cute, this new transfer student?"
"I don't know, but that's what I've heard.
They say a girl in the first year transferred from a famous ladies academy."
"…… I see.
For someone to transfer at this time of the year, there must be some strange circumstances."
"You thought so too, huh?
But it seems like a waste.
Why is she transferring from the distinguished Asagami Women's Academy to go here?"
"Hm?
What a coincidence.
My sister is also a first year student at----"

entries.japanese:
────って、待った。
　さっきからどうも先輩と会話がかみ合わない。
　先輩の口ぶりは、まるで俺がその転校生の事を知っているような感じだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
────Wait.
Ciel and I have been talking past each other this whole time.
The way she speaks makes it sound as though I already know the transfer student.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Wait a minute.
There's something not quite right about this whole conversation.
Senpai sounds like I know this transfer student already.

entries.japanese:
どうぞお気になさらずに。
　明日から似たような生活サイクルになるんですから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Please don’t trouble yourself.
Starting tomorrow, we’ll be keeping similar hours.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Please don't mind.
Starting tomorrow your daily life will become more like this.

entries.japanese: 秋葉さまは手続きがありまから、早めに登校したんですよ。
entries.maoEnglish: Miss Akiha left early because she had paperwork to take care of.
entries.mirrorMoon: Since there were some formalities to take care of, Akiha-sama left for school earlier.

entries.japanese:
「――――――うそ」
　愕然とした。
　愕然としたけど、これは、もうそうとしか考えられない。
「遠野くん？」
　先輩の声も聞こえない。
　有彦の席を見ると、ヤツはにやりと邪悪な笑みをうかべていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No way.”
I’m stunned.
But however impossible it feels, there is only one explanation.
“Tohno?”
I cannot even hear Ciel.
When I look toward Arihiko’s desk, he is wearing a wicked grin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------No way."
I'm shocked.
I'm shocked, but that's the only conclusion I can draw.
"Tohno-kun?"
I can't hear Senpai's voice anymore.
I look over at Arihiko's desk and he has an especially evil grin on his face.

entries.japanese:
ずかずかと有彦の席へ歩いていく。
「有彦」
「あら、なにかしらお兄さま」
「……殴るよ、それ」
「ちぇっ、冗談の通じないヤツ。
で、どうした。
いまさら俺のような庶民になにか誤用ですかね」
　ひっひっひ、と笑いながら有彦はいう。
「ゴヨウって、まあ、そりゃあ誤用かもしんないけどさ、この場合」
entries.maoEnglish:
I march over to him.
“Arihiko.”
“Why, whatever is it, dearest brother?”
“Keep that up and I’ll hit you.”
“Tch, no sense of humor. Well? What possible use could a lofty gentleman like you have for a commoner like me?”
Arihiko snickers.
“Use—abuse, maybe, under the circumstances.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk purposefully over to his desk.
"Arihiko."
"Oh?
What could it possibly be, Onii-sama?"
"…… I'll punch you for saying that."
"H, hey, can't you take a joke?
What is it, is there a reason you would talk to a commoner like me?
Hyahahaha!"
Arihiko laughs.
"Reason?
Well, I do have a reason this time."

entries.japanese:
「で、有彦。
その転校生っていうのは、なんて名前か教えてくれないか」
「いやーん、言わなくてもわかってんだろ？
　そう、彼女の名前は遠野秋葉。
何を隠そうおまえの妹さんだな。
　ったく、オレにまで秘密にしやがって、あんだけの上玉ならすぐにバレるっつーの。
今度という今度こそ友情を疑ったね、オレは」
「……いや、もとから俺とおまえの間にはそんな幻想はなりたってなかったけど、まあ、そっか」
　力なく返答して、自分の席に戻る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So, Arihiko. Could you tell me the transfer student’s name?”
“Oh, don’t be coy—you already know, don’t you?
Yes. Her name is Akiha Tohno—and, as fate would have it, she’s your little sister.
Damn you for keeping even me in the dark—a prize like that was bound to be discovered at once. This time you have truly made me question our friendship.”
“That particular fantasy never existed between us—but right, I see.”
I answer weakly and return to my desk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arihiko, can you tell me the name of this new transfer student?"
"Man, you should know without me saying anything, right?
Yes, her name is Tohno Akiha.
Your younger sister.
Geez, you even kept it a secret from me.
I would've found out quickly since she's that hot.
I really doubted our friendship this time."
"…… No, there's never been that sort of illusion between us, but I see."
Totally drained, I answer and return to my seat.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？」
　先輩がなにか言っているんだけど、返事をする気力はなかった。
「……はあ。
なにかたいへんそうですから、わたしも戻りますね」
 
　先輩はタッタカター、と軽い足取りで教室から去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno?”
Ciel is saying something, but I lack the strength to answer.
“Well. You appear to have enough trouble already, so I’ll return to my class.”
Ciel trots cheerfully out of the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?"
Senpai is speaking but I just don't feel like responding.
"…… Hmm.
You seem to be having trouble, so I will go back."
Senpai walks out of the room lightly.

entries.japanese:
秋葉が、うちの学校に転校してきてる。
「───なに考えてんだ、あいつ」
　呆然と呟いて、ぱたん、と力なく自分の椅子に座り込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha has transferred to my school.
“What was she thinking?”
I mutter in a daze and collapse feebly into my chair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha has transferred to my school.
"----What is she thinking?"
Muttering aloud in astonishment, I fall into my chair.

entries.japanese:
三時限目になって、英語の授業がはじまった。
　流暢な発音で流れてくる英文は、あまり頭に入ってくれない。
　転校してきたという秋葉のことで頭がいっぱいなせいで、英文はなにか不快なノイズにしか聞き取れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Third period begins, and with it English class.
The teacher’s fluent English simply refuses to sink in.
Akiha’s transfer has crowded out everything else; the teacher’s English is nothing but an irritating drone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Third period starts and English class begins.
The sound of fluent English goes in one ear and out the other.
My head is only full of thoughts about Akiha right now.
This English is just noise to me.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　だいたい秋葉も秋葉だ。
　うちに転校してくるなら、前もって俺に言ってくれてもよかったじゃないか。
　いや、そもそもあいつがうちの学校に転校してきたって、何の利点もないっていうのに―――
「あ―――――」
　ズキリと。
　首筋に、痛みが走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Honestly, Akiha is impossible.
If she planned to transfer here, she could at least have told me.
And what does she gain by coming to my school in the first place—
“Ah—”
A sharp throb.
Pain stabs through the side of my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
As always, Akiha is Akiha.
If she's going to transfer to my school, couldn't she at least tell me?
No, more importantly, she transferred to my school when there's no advantage for her to do so---
"Ah----"
Pain again.
Sharp pain in my neck.

entries.japanese:
がたん、と体が机につっぷす。
　まいった。
体が、うまく動かせない。
　眩暈だろうか。
　ならこんなのはいつもどおりだ。
つまり正常。
すぐに復帰。
なにしろ授業中。
早く回復しないと。
ほら、英語の教師が苛だたしげに英文を読み上げている。
黒板。
チョーク。
白墨の粉。
英文。
英文。
チョークを削る音。
教師。
教師。
大人。
教壇。
ギシギシと軋む教壇。
机。
三十六個の机。
生徒。
生徒。
三十六人の生徒。
三日前までは三十七個。
窓。
空。
校庭。
太陽。
人気がない。
寂しい。
寒い。
恐い。
不安。
なにか。
欲しい。
欲しい。
欲しい――――
entries.maoEnglish:
My body collapses onto the desk with a clatter.
Damn it. I can’t move properly.
Is it dizziness?
Then this is normal. The usual. Nothing wrong. I’ll recover. I have to—class is still going. There, the English teacher is reading aloud in an irritated voice. Blackboard. Chalk. White dust. English. English. Chalk scraping down. Teacher. Teacher. Adult. Lectern. The lectern creaks and creaks. Desks. Thirty-six desks. Students. Students. Thirty-six students. Three days ago there were thirty-seven. Window. Sky. Schoolyard. Sun. Nobody there. Lonely. Cold. Afraid. Uneasy. Something. I want it. Want it. Want it—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I fall onto my desk.
This is bad.
I can hardly move.
Is it anemia again?
Then it's just as always.
It's normal.
It'll pass.
I'm in class.
I have to recover.
Look, the English teacher is reading aloud.
The blackboard.
Chalk.
Chalk dust.
English.
The sound of chalk scraping.
Teacher.
Teacher.
Adult.
Podium.
The creaking podium.
Desk.
Thirty-six desks.
Student.
Students.
Thirty-six students.
Three days ago there were thirty-seven.
Window.
Sky.
Schoolyard.
Sun.
Unpopular.
Lonely.
Cold.
Frightened.
Uneasy.
Something.
Desire.
Desire.
Desire----

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん！
　きみ、大丈夫かね遠野くん！？」
　教壇からの声で、はた、と目が覚めた。
　……額にはすごい汗。
　体は冷たくなっていて、呼吸だけがはあはあと荒い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno! Are you all right, Tohno?”
The voice from the front of the room snaps me awake.
My forehead is streaming with sweat.
My whole body has gone cold, and only my breathing is hot and ragged.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun!
Hey, are you alright Tohno-kun!?"
My eyes open wide at the sound of the teacher's voice.
…… Sweat rolls down my forehead.
My body is cold.
My breathing is ragged.

entries.japanese:
「どうしたんだ遠野くん。
きみ、体の調子が悪いなら休んでいいぞ」
「あ、いえ。
大丈夫です、おさまりましたから」
「……そうか。
まあ、あまり無茶はしないようにね。
きみの場合、成績はいいんだから少しは休んでもいいんだぞ。
多少のハンデがあっても問題はないだろうからね」
　……英語の教師の言い分は、少しデリカシーにかけると思う。
　大丈夫です、とはっきり断言して、授業を再開させた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What happened, Tohno? If you’re unwell, you may rest.”
“No. I’m fine—it has passed.”
“Very well. But don’t push yourself. Your marks are excellent, so you can afford to miss a little class. Even with a slight handicap, I doubt you’ll have any trouble.”
The English teacher’s phrasing could use a little more tact.
I insist that I am fine, and the lesson resumes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it Tohno-kun?
If you are not feeling well, you can rest."
"Ah, no, I'm fine.
It has passed."
"…… I see.
Well, don't push yourself.
Your grades are good so it is acceptable to take an occasional rest.
Your progress will be satisfactory even with some handicaps."
…… The English teacher's words lack a little consideration for the other students.
I once again declare I am fine and resume class.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになって、教室中があわただしくなる。
「――――はあ」
　ため息がもれる。
　朝から熱っぽかったけど、本当に風邪でも引いているのか、全身がだるかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
At lunchtime the classroom erupts into motion.
“Haaah…”
A sigh escapes me.
I have felt feverish since morning; maybe it truly is a cold, because every limb feels heavy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At lunch, the classroom gets frantic.
*sigh*
I take a deep breath.
I've been hot since this morning.
Maybe I have caught a cold.
My whole body feels languid.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ遠野。
まだ教室に残ってたのか」
「……ああ、今日はちょっと体調が悪くてさ。
学食まで行けないから、買い物頼まれてくれないか？
　購買のいつものセットでいいから」
「いや、それはかまわないけどな。
いいのか、おまえの妹さん、なんだか食堂で困ってた風だったぞ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What, Tohno? You’re still here?”
“Yeah, I’m not feeling well today. I can’t make it to the cafeteria, so could you buy lunch for me? Just get my usual from the school shop.”
“Sure, but are you certain? Your sister looked rather helpless in the cafeteria.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What, Tohno?
Are you still sticking around here?"
"…… Yeah.
I don't feel too well today.
I can't go to the cafeteria, so can you please get me something?
I'll have the usual."
"No, I don't mind, but is that alright?
Your dear sister seems to be having trouble in the cafeteria."

entries.japanese:
「――――あ」
　そうか、あいつは今までお嬢さま学校に通っていたから、一般の学校の『学食』っていうシステムをまったく知らないんだ。
　今ごろ学食に行って、立ち往生している秋葉の姿がありありと目に浮かぶ。
―――くそ、そんなの放っておける訳がない。
「あ、遠野！
　行くならオレも行くぞ！」
　教室を駆け出る。
　……後ろからは、妙にハッスルした有彦が付いてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
Of course—she has always attended a school for proper young ladies and knows nothing about how an ordinary school cafeteria works.
I can picture Akiha standing there now, completely stranded.
―――Damn it—I can’t simply leave her there.
“Hey, Tohno! If you’re going, I’m coming too!”
I race out of the classroom.
Behind me, an inexplicably enthusiastic Arihiko follows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
That's right.
She's always been at a ladies academy so she wouldn't know anything about how a normal "school cafeteria" system works.
I can distinctly imagine Akiha standing in the cafeteria not knowing what to do.
----Damn, I can't leave her like that.
"Ah, Tohno!
Wait up!
I'm coming too!"
I dash out of the classroom.
…… Close behind me, Arihiko follows a bit more energetic than usual.

entries.japanese:
生徒たちで混雑した食堂の真ん中で、秋葉は呆然と立ち尽くしていた。
　一人で、何をしていいものか解らない、といったふうに。
「―――ったく。
なにしてるんだ、あいつは」
　急いで秋葉のところに走りよる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha stands dazed in the middle of the crowded cafeteria.
Alone, plainly unable to guess what she is supposed to do.
“Honestly. What is she doing?”
I hurry toward her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha stands aghast in the center of the crowded cafeteria.
She looks as if she does not know what to do.
"----Geez.
What is she doing?"
I hurry over to Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉」
「兄、さん」
　一瞬。
　秋葉の顔が泣きそうなものに見えて、胸が痛んだ。
「―――ほら、こっちにこい。
おまえ、こういう人込みは嫌いだろ」
「あ――――はい」
　もう、一秒だってそんな泣きそうな顔なんか見たくなくて、強引に秋葉の腕をとって食堂を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
“Brother.”
For an instant.
She looks ready to cry, and my chest aches.
“Come on. You hate crowds like this, don’t you?”
“Ah—yes.”
Unable to bear that tearful face for another second, I seize Akiha’s arm and pull her bodily out of the cafeteria.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha."
"Nii… san."
In that instant,
I see her face on the verge of tears and my chest starts to hurt.
"----C'mon, over here.
You don't like the crowds, right?"
"Ah----yes."
Not wanting to see her almost crying face a second longer, I strongly pull Akiha out of the cafeteria.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、ここなら落ちつくだろ。
とりあえず昼飯は買ってきてやるから、ベンチにでも座ってろ」
「……はい。
わざわざごめんなさい、兄さん」
「―――いいよ、詳しい事情はあとで聞くから。
有彦、購買に行ってくるから、それまで秋葉のことよろしくな」
「げっ。
な、なんだってこんな時にオレに頼るんだおまえはっ！
　いいって、購買ならオレが行ってくるから、遠野は妹さんの相手をしてろよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There—this should be quieter. Sit on the bench and I’ll go buy us lunch.”
“Yes. I’m sorry to make you go to all this trouble, Brother.”
“It’s fine—I’ll ask for the details later. Arihiko, I’m going to the school shop, so look after Akiha until I get back.”
“Wh-why would you rely on me at a time like this?! I’ll go to the shop. You stay here and keep your sister company!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here, you should be able to relax here.
I'll go buy us some lunch so just sit at this bench."
"…… Yes.
I apologize for the trouble, Nii-san."
"----It's alright.
I'll hear about it later.
Arihiko, I'm going to get lunch so take care of Akiha, okay?"
"W, why are you asking me all of a sudden!?
Look, I'll go buy lunch and you keep your sister company, Tohno."

entries.japanese:
「……？
　なんだよ有彦、オレのことをお兄さんって呼ぶんじゃないのか？
　いっとくけどこんなチャンス、この先ぜったいにやらないぞ」
　ぼそぼそ、と有彦に耳打ちする。
　こっちの小声に負けじと、有彦も秘密会議に参加してくる。
「いや、そうだけどよ、いくらなんでもいきなり二人っきりはまずいだろ。
そりゃあたいていの女ならそっちのがいいんだけど、おまえの妹さんはちょっとレヴェルが高すぎる」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong, Arihiko? Weren’t you going to call me Big Brother? I’m warning you, you’ll never get another opportunity like this.”
I murmur into his ear.
Not to be outdone, Arihiko joins the whispered conference.
“I know, but putting me alone with her this suddenly would be madness. With most girls I’d prefer it, sure, but your sister is several leagues above my level.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
What's the matter, Arihiko?
Aren't you going to call me Onii-san?
I'll tell you right now, but I won't give you a chance like this in the future."
I whisper to Arihiko.
He whispers back, maintaining our secrecy.
"R, right, but I can't be with her alone all of a sudden.
If it was any other woman I'd agree, but your sister is just too high class."

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ、らしくないな。
おまえ秋葉にびびってるのか？」
「おう。
率直にいえばビビってるぞ。
なにしろ今までにないタイプ故に、初戦は諜報活動に徹したい所存ナリよ」
　……こいつも、どうしてこう不思議なところで面白いんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That doesn’t sound like you. Are you frightened of Akiha?”
“Absolutely. Frankly, I am terrified. She’s an unprecedented type, so I intend to devote the opening engagement entirely to reconnaissance, sir.”
How does this idiot manage to be funny in such strange ways?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hm?
This isn't like you at all.
Are you scared of Akiha?"
"Yeah.
To be honest, I am.
Since she is the type I've never went against, I'd like to concentrate on getting information in the first round."
…… Why is he always this funny at strange times.

entries.japanese:
「しょうがないな、それじゃ三人分の昼飯を調達してきてくれ」
「おう、任せとけ。
……って、妹さん何食べるんだ？
　購買で売ってるパンなんて恐れ多くて出せないぞ、オレ」
「……そんなの知るか。
うちの学校に転校してきたんだからカレーパンとコーヒー牛乳で十分だ」
「――――了解。
五分で戻る」
　有彦はダッシュで校舎へと戻っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine—then go secure lunch for all three of us.”
“Leave it to me. But what does your sister eat? I can’t present her with bread from the school shop—it would be sacrilege.”
“How should I know? She transferred here, so curry bread and coffee milk are good enough.”
“Understood. I’ll be back in five minutes.”
Arihiko sprints back toward the school building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
Then can you go get lunch for the three of us?"
"Leave it to me.
…… Um, what does your sister want?
I'm too scared to buy her ordinary cafeteria bread."
"…… As if I would know.
She transferred here, so curry bread and coffee milk will be good enough."
"----Roger.
I'll be back in five minutes."
Arihiko returns to the building in a dash.

entries.japanese:
「今の人と随分仲がいいんですね、兄さん」
　……あれ？
　さっきまでの弱々しい姿はどこにいったのか、秋葉はすっかり元通りになっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You seem remarkably close to that person, Brother.”
Huh?
Akiha’s frailty has vanished without a trace; she is entirely herself again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You seem to be very good friends with him, Nii-san."
…… Huh?
Where did all her vulnerability go?
She's suddenly back to normal.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、あいつは特別気が合うヤツだからな。
……って、そんなコトより秋葉！」
「もう、そんな大声ださないでください。
周りの人たちが驚いてるじゃないですか」
「なっ―――」
「それより私の質問に答えてくれませんか。
今の人、兄さんのなんなんですか？」
　……なんなんですかって、あいつとは中学からの腐れ縁なだけだけど―――って、そうじゃなくて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. He’s one of the few people I truly get along with—but never mind that, Akiha!”
“Please don’t shout. Everyone around us is staring.”
“What—”
“Answer my question first. What exactly is that man to you?”
What is he to me—we’ve been saddled with each other since middle school, that’s all—but wait, that isn’t the point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, we get along specially well.
…… M, more importantly, Akiha!"
"Please don't yell like that.
People around us are surprised."
"Wha----"
"More importantly, can you answer me?
That person, what is he to you, Nii-san?"
…… What is he?
He's just an unwanted but inseparable guy who's been with me since middle school----no, that's not what we're talking about.

entries.japanese:
「有彦はただのクラスメイトだよ。
それより秋葉、質問なら俺のほうが先だ」
「はい。
なんでしょうか、兄さん」
「なんでしょうかじゃない！
　おまえ、なんだってうちの高校になんて転校してきたんだ。
うちみたいな二流の進学校に転校したって、何のメリットもないじゃないか！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko is only a classmate. More importantly, Akiha, I asked my question first.”
“Very well. What is it, Brother?”
“Don’t ‘what is it’ me! Why did you transfer to my school? There’s nothing for you to gain by transferring to a second-rate prep school like ours!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Arihiko's just one of my classmates.
But you haven't answered my question, either."
"Very well.
What is it, Nii-san?"
"What is it!?
Why have you transferred to this school?
What possible reason could you have for transferring to a second-rate elevator school!?"

entries.japanese:
「お言葉ですけど兄さん。
私がどこの学校に通うかは私の自由です。
兄さんに答えなくちゃいけない理由なんてないわ」
「……馬鹿なこと言うな。
俺はおまえの兄貴だぞ。
兄貴として、おまえの為にならない事を見過ごすわけにはいかない。
　はっきり言えば、うちの高校に転校してくるのはおまえにとってマイナスしかないと思う。
親父ももういないんだから、せめて俺がちゃんとおまえを見てやらないといけないじゃないか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“With all due respect, Brother. I’m free to attend any school I please. I see no reason I owe you an explanation.”
“Don’t be ridiculous. I’m your older brother. I can’t stand by and let you do something that’s bad for you.
Frankly, transferring to my school can only hurt your prospects. Father isn’t here anymore, so the least I can do is look after you properly…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So you say, Nii-san.
But I can go to school wherever I choose; I do not need to explain myself to you."
"…… Don't be stupid.
I'm your brother!
I can't just overlook things that are against your best interests.
Frankly, I can't see any benefit in you transferring to this school.
Since our old man isn't around anymore, it's my responsibility to look out for you…!"

entries.japanese:
「……なによ。
こういう時だけそうゆう言い回しをするなんて、フェアじゃないわ」
「フェアじゃないのはそっちのほうだろ。
俺に黙って転校するなんて、一体どういうつもりなんだ。
　ちゃんと理由を聞くまで俺はおまえの転校なんて認めないからな！」
「あ―――――」
「つまらない理由だったらもといた学校に叩き返す。
ほら、言えよ秋葉。
なんで転校なんかしたんだ、おまえ」
　秋葉はうつむいて黙り込む。
　ほんの少しだけそうした後、秋葉は凛とした姿勢で顔をあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s not fair. You only invoke being my brother when it suits you.”
“You’re the one being unfair. What were you thinking, transferring without telling me?
Until you give me a proper reason, I refuse to approve of it!”
“Ah…”
“And if your reason is stupid, I’ll send you straight back to your old school. Come on, Akiha. Tell me why you transferred.”
Akiha lowers her head and falls silent.
A moment later, she straightens proudly and raises her face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
It's not fair to say things like that at times like these."
"'Not fair' is my line.
What were you thinking, transferring without even telling me?
I won't accept this transfer until I hear a good reason!"
"Ah----"
"If I'm not satisfied with the reason, I'll send you right back to your own school.
So, tell me, Akiha.
Why did you change schools?"
Akiha falls silent and looks down.
A very brief moment later, she raises a brave face.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さんが心配だから、ではいけませんか」
―――――――え？
「……ちょっ、ちょっと待った。
俺が心配だからって、なんで―――」
　なんでそんな理由で転校なんかしてくるんだよ、おまえは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is it so wrong that I’m worried about you?”
―――――――What?
“W-wait. You were worried about me, so why would—?”
Why would you transfer schools over something like that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I was worried about you, Nii-san.
Is that not a sufficient reason?"
-------Eh?
"…… Ha, hang on.
What do you mean, worried about me…?"
What sort of reason is that for transferring?

entries.japanese:
「だって、このところの兄さんの素行の乱れは目にあまるんだもの。
遠野の名を汚さないためにも、私が近くで監督する事に決めたんです」
　秋葉はきっぱりと言い切った。
「うっ―――――」
　素行の乱れ、だなんて言われると、こっちとしてはうなずくしかない。
　事実、ここんとこの俺の生活はメチャクチャで、秋葉たちには迷惑をかけっぱなしだったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because your recent conduct has become impossible to ignore, Brother. To keep you from disgracing the Tohno name, I decided to supervise you personally.”
Akiha delivered the verdict without hesitation.
“Urk…”
Accused of bad conduct, I could only concede the point.
My life had been a complete wreck lately, and I had caused nothing but trouble for Akiha and the others.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, looking at your unruly behavior recently, I decided that in order to prevent you from disgracing the Tohno name, I would have to keep a close eye on you."
Akiha explains clearly.
"Erk----"
When she says "unruly behavior", I can't help but nod.
It's true; my everyday life since coming here has surely been an annoyance to Akiha and the others.

entries.japanese:
「で、でも、だからって転校までする事ないだろ。
今までの友達とかどうするんだ」
「そんなこと、兄さんが気に病む必要はありません。
少しでも私に悪いと思うんでしたら、今日から考えを改めてくださればいいんです」
　ぷい、と顔を背けて反論する秋葉。
　……もう、こう言えばああいうヤツだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“B-but you didn’t have to transfer. What about all your friends at your old school?”
“You needn’t worry about that, Brother. If you feel the least bit guilty, mend your ways starting today.”
Akiha turned her face aside in a huff.
She had an answer for everything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Bu, but, transferring is still a bit much, isn't it?
What about your friends?"
"That's none of your concern, Nii-san.
If you feel even a little bad for me, then all you have to do is change your way of thinking from now on."
Akiha turns sharply away.
…… Well, this is just the way she is.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった、勝手にしろ。
けどな、あとで後悔したって知らないからな」
「けっこうです。
兄さんに心配してもらおうなんて思ってませんから」
　ふーんだ、とばかりに胸をはって、秋葉は拗ねた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, do whatever you want. But don’t come crying to me if you regret it later.”
“Perfectly acceptable. I never wanted you worrying about me anyway, Brother.”
Akiha thrust out her chest and sulked with all the dignity of a child declaring, So there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright, do as you please.
But one day, you'll regret it."
"That's fine.
I wasn't thinking of having you worry over me, Nii-san."
With a sound of exasperation, Akiha starts to sulk.

entries.japanese:
「なんなんですかって―――有彦はただのクラスメイトだよ。
それ以外の何に見えるってんだ、おまえ」
「へえ。
ただのお友達を名前で呼ばれるんですか、兄さんは」
　むっとした、不機嫌そうな視線を向けてくる秋葉。
「あのな、俺が友人を名前で呼ぼうが姓名で呼ぼうが別に問題なんてないだろう。
なんだってそんな事でつっかかってくるんだよ、おまえは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you mean—Arihiko is just a classmate. What else could he possibly be?”
“Really, Brother. And you address an ordinary friend by his given name?”
Akiha shot me a distinctly displeased look.
“What does it matter whether I call a friend by his first or last name? Why are you picking a fight over something so trivial?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is he to me?----Arihiko is just a classmate.
What else does he look like?"
"Oh, so you refer to 'just' your friend by his first name, Nii-san?"
Akiha looks at me unhappily.
"Look, does it matter if I refer to him by his last name or his first name?
Why are you hung up on that all of a sudden?"

entries.japanese:
「ふーん、自覚はないんですね。
兄さん、女性ならともかく、男性が同性の友人を名前で呼ぶのは普通じゃないわ。
兄弟や肉親ぐらいです、同性を名前で呼んだりするのは」
「え―――まあ、そりゃあそうだけど」
　……言われてみると、自分でも首をかしげてしまう。
　けど有彦を有彦と呼んでいたのは初めからだったし、そもそもアイツとは付き合いが長いんだからそれぐらいはおかしくないと思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you aren’t even aware of it, Brother. It may be common with women, but men do not ordinarily use another man’s given name. That is generally reserved for brothers and other close relatives.”
“Well, I suppose that’s true.”
Now that she mentioned it, I did find it slightly odd.
Still, I had called him Arihiko from the beginning, and after knowing him for years I saw nothing strange in that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"My, you have no awareness, Nii-san.
Maybe for women, but it is not normal for two boys to refer to each other like that.
Unless they were brothers or relatives…"
"Eh----well, maybe you're right."
…… Even I tilt my head to the side as I think about it.
But since the very beginning, I've always called him "Arihiko".
Besides, we've known each other so long it isn't that odd.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、あと一つぐらい例外がありますね。
もしかして兄さん、あの人とそういう関係なんですか？」
「……？
　なんだそりゃ、そういう関係ってどういう関係のことだよ」
　わけが解らないので真剣に聞き返すと、秋葉は目を点にして視線を逸らしてしまった。
「……なんでもありません。
厭味のつもりだったんですけど、兄さんには通じなかったみたいです」
　はあ、と力なく肩を落とす秋葉。
　……なんだか、ますます意味が解らなくなってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is one other exception, I suppose. Brother, are you and that boy in that kind of relationship?”
“What? What kind of relationship is ‘that kind’?”
Not knowing what she meant, I asked in complete earnestness; Akiha stared at me, dumbfounded, then looked away.
“Never mind. It was meant as sarcasm, but apparently it was wasted on you, Brother.”
Akiha’s shoulders sagged with a feeble sigh.
Now I understood even less than before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, there is another case.
Don't tell me you have that sort of relationship with him, Nii-san?"
"……?
That sort of relationship?
What do you mean?"
I respond seriously, not understanding, but Akiha shifts her gaze.
"…… It's nothing.
I was being sarcastic but you don't seem to get it, Nii-san."
Akiha slumps her shoulders.
…… I start to get more and more confused.

entries.japanese:
「―――秋葉。
アイツとは中学からの付き合いで、昔から助けられてるんだ。
……そりゃあ外見で誤解される事もあるけど、有彦は呆れるぐらい善人だよ。
何が気に食わないのか知らないけど、有彦を悪く思うのはやめてくれ」
「…………」
　何が不満なのか、秋葉はよけい拗ねた態度をとる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. I’ve known him since middle school, and he’s helped me more times than I can count. People misjudge him because of his looks, but Arihiko is almost absurdly decent. I don’t know what you dislike about him, but stop assuming the worst.”
“…”
Whatever her grievance was, Akiha only grew more sullen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Akiha.
I've known him since middle school and he has always helped me out.
…… He might not look like it, but he is a good person.
I don't know what you don't like about him, but don't think bad of him."
"…………"
Is she not satisfied about something?
Akiha starts to sulk.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
人の話、聞いてるのか」
「ちゃんと聞いてます！
　ええ、兄さんがそんなに躍起になって誰かを弁護するなんて初めてですから、よほど今のご学友は大切な方なんですね！」
　ふーんだ、とばかりに胸をはって、秋葉は顔を背ける。
　……まったく。
かってに転校してきた事だけでもわけが解らないのに、今の秋葉は輪をかけて理解不能だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Are you even listening?”
“Of course I am! I’ve never seen you defend anyone so desperately before, Brother, so this school friend of yours must be terribly precious to you!”
Akiha turned away with her chest thrust out, practically announcing, So there.
Her transferring without warning had already made no sense. Now she had become wholly incomprehensible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, are you listening?"
"Yes, I hear you!
This is the first time I have ever heard you defend someone so eagerly.
He really must be special to you, this school friend of yours!"
She puffs out her chest and turns her head away.
…… Geez.
I don't know why she decided to transfer here all of a sudden.
Now I don't even know what's with her.

entries.japanese:
「有彦は中学時代からの友人だけど――秋葉？」
「はい？
　なんですか兄さん」
「その、今は随分と落ちついているんだな。
さっき食堂でおどおどしていたのがウソみたいだ」
「―――それがどうしたんですか、兄さん」
「いや、もしかして周りの目があったから猫でもかぶってたのかな、と思ったんだけど」
　どうも、その説はかなり有力のようだ。
　考えてみれば、この秋葉があの程度の人込みで立ち尽くしたりするワケがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Arihiko has been my friend since middle school, but—Akiha?”
“Yes? What is it, Brother?”
“You seem remarkably composed now. It’s hard to believe you were so nervous in the cafeteria a minute ago.”
“And what of it, Brother?”
“I wondered whether you had been putting on an act because everyone was watching.”
That theory seemed increasingly likely.
When I thought about it, there was no way this Akiha would be reduced to helpless silence by an ordinary crowd.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"He's a friend of mine from middle school--Akiha?"
"Yes?
What is it, Nii-san?"
"You seem to have calmed down a whole lot.
All your confusion earlier in the cafeteria seems like it never happened."
"----What are you trying to say, Nii-san?"
"No, I was just thinking… maybe you were pretending to be naive earlier?"
There is a strong possibility that is the case.
Come to think of it, there was no reason for Akiha to just stand there stupidly in the middle of the crowd like that.

entries.japanese:
「ふうん。
兄さん、私のことをそういう目で見ていらしたんですね」
　じとり、と足から頭まで俺を観察する秋葉。
　……やっぱりコイツ、俺を騙そうとあんな芝居をうったのか。
「ええ、どうぞご勝手に想像していてください。
私だって兄さんに心配してもらおうなんて思ってませんから」
　ふーんだ、とばかりに胸をはって、秋葉は拗ねた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So that is how you think of me, Brother.”
Akiha gave me a long, sour inspection from head to toe.
Had she really put on that whole performance just to fool me?
“Believe whatever you please. It isn’t as though I wanted you worrying about me, Brother.”
Akiha thrust out her chest and sulked with all the dignity of a child declaring, So there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
Nii-san, is that what you think of me?"
Akiha looks me over from head to toe.
…… I knew it.
She was just putting on an act to fool me.
"Yes, please go ahead and imagine what you like.
It isn't like I wanted you to be worried."
She puffs out her chest and pouts.

entries.japanese:
「お待たせ、三人分買ってきたぜ……って、なに、もしかしてお邪魔ッスかオレ？」
「いえ、そんな事はありませんよ、先輩。
「兄さんのお友達ですね。
遠野志貴の妹で、秋葉と申します。
どうぞ、これからよろしくお願いします」
　スッ、と音もなくお辞儀をする秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry to keep you waiting—lunch for three, coming right up—wait, am I interrupting something here?”
“Not at all.”
“You’re a friend of my brother’s, then. I’m Akiha, Shiki Tohno’s younger sister. It’s a pleasure to meet you.”
Akiha bowed with silent grace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here ya go, lunch for three people… huh?
What, am I interrupting something?"
"No, nothing of the sort, Senpai.
You are a friend of Nii-san?
I am Tohno Shiki's younger sister, Akiha.
It is a pleasure to meet you."
Akiha bows softly.

entries.japanese:
「いやいや、こっちこそよろしくな。
オレは乾有彦、遠野とは中学からの付き合いでさ、秋葉ちゃんのことは今日はじめて知ったよ」
　……黙っていたことをまだ根に持っているのか、言わなくてもいいことを有彦は言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Likewise. I’m Arihiko Inui, and Tohno and I have been stuck with each other since middle school—today was the first I’d ever heard he had a sister.”
Apparently he was still holding a grudge over my secrecy, because Arihiko added that last, entirely unnecessary remark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Not at all, the pleasure's mine.
I'm Inui Arihiko, I've known Tohno since junior high, but today was the first time I've found out about you, Akiha-chan."
…… Maybe he's still holding a grudge against me for not telling him about her, as he says things he doesn't have to.

entries.japanese:
「いいから有彦、メシにしよう。
昼休みは短いんだから、秋葉にかまってばかりいるわけにはいかないだろ」
　むっ、と睨んでくる秋葉をやりすごして、有彦から昼飯をうけとる。
「ほら秋葉。
カレーパンと牛乳をあげるから、ここで食べよう。
あんまり時間がないからな、ゆっくりしてる暇はないぞ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind that, Arihiko. Lunch break is short, so let’s eat instead of spending it all fussing over Akiha.”
I ignored Akiha’s offended glare and accepted the food from Arihiko.
“Here, Akiha. You can have the curry bread and milk. We’ll eat here, but there isn’t much time, so don’t dawdle.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright, Arihiko, let's eat.
Lunch break is short, so there's no time for chit-chat with Akiha."
I ignore Akiha glaring at me, and I accept the lunch from Arihiko.
"Here, Akiha.
Here's curry bread and milk, and you can eat them here.
There isn't much time, so you can't take too long over them."

entries.japanese:
「そんなこと解ってます。
子供じゃないんですから、いちいち説明しないでください」
「そうだぞ遠野、おまえ秋葉ちゃんにわざとつらくあたってないか？」
　ぶーぶー、とブーイングをする有彦。
「………………」
　それを無視して、自分のパンの封をあけて、牛乳にストローをさしこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I understand perfectly well. I’m not a child, so please stop explaining every little thing to me.”
“She’s right, Tohno—are you going out of your way to be mean to her?”
Arihiko boos me loudly.
“…”
I ignore him, open my own bread, and push the straw into my carton of milk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I know that.
I'm not a child, so you don't have to explain every little thing to me."
"That's right, Tohno.
Aren't you a bit mean to Akiha-chan?"
Arihiko boos at me.
"…………"
Ignoring them, I open my own bread, and stick the straw into my milk.

entries.japanese:
もぐ。
　もぐもぐ。
　もぐもぐもぐ。
「―――――」
　さて、昼飯も食べ終わったし、教室に戻るか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Munch.
Munch, munch.
Munch, munch, munch.
“…”
Now that lunch is over, I should head back to class.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Munch.
Munch munch.
Munch munch munch.
"-----"
Right.
Lunch is over, so it's time to go back to class.

entries.japanese:
「………あの、兄さん」
　おずおずと声をかけてくる秋葉。
　見ればカレーパンはまだ封さえ開いていない。
「なんだ秋葉。
あんまり食欲ないのか？」
「えっと、そうじゃなくて、あの、ですね」
　恥ずかしそうに上目遣いをしてくる。
「……その、食べ方、教えてくれませんか……？」
「――――――」
　もじもじと見上げてくる視線。
　それに―――なんていうか、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Brother?”
Akiha ventures timidly.
Her curry bread is still in its wrapper.
“What is it? Not hungry?”
“Um, no, that isn’t it…”
She looks up at me through her lashes, visibly embarrassed.
“Could you show me how to eat it?”
“…”
She gazes up at me, shy and fidgeting.
Faced with that―――what else can I do?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ah, Nii-san."
Akiha speaks up timidly.
Looking over, I see that she hasn't even opened her curry bread yet.
"What is it, Akiha?
You're not hungry?"
"It's… well, it's not that, it's just…"
She glances upward, like she's embarrassed or something.
"…… Could you… teach me how to eat these…?"
"……"
She glances hesitantly towards me.
And… what am I supposed to say?

entries.japanese:
「食べ方って、なに言ってるんだよ。
そんなの封を開けて食べるだけじゃん。
別に難しいことでもなんでもないぜ。
なあ遠野？」
「有彦、悪いけど学食にいってナプキンとか持ってきてくれないか」
「―――え？
　オレ？」
　うん、と無言でうなずく。
「いいけどな、貸しにしとくぞ」
　有彦はまたも校舎にむかってダッシュしていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you mean, show you how to eat? You just open the wrapper and eat it. There’s nothing hard about that. Right, Tohno?”
“Arihiko, could you run to the cafeteria and bring us some napkins or something?”
“What? Me?”
I answer with a silent nod.
“Fine, but you owe me.”
Arihiko went sprinting back toward the school building yet again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Waddya mean, how to eat them?
You just break open the wrapper and eat it.
It's not hard, is it Tohno?"
"Arihiko, sorry, but could you go get a napkin from the cafeteria?"
"…… Eh, me?"
I nod silently.
"Fine, but you'll owe me one."
Arihiko runs off towards the school building again.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、かして。
これは袋のここをこう開けて、そのままかぶりつくんだ。
……いっとくけど、味のほうは期待するなよ。
琥珀さんの料理とは天と地ほどの差があるからな」
「えっと―――兄さん、ほんと？」
「嘘は言わない。
それともなにか。
うちの学校に転校してきたのに、うちの購買で売ってるものなんて食べられないなんて言わないでくれよ。
　俺、秋葉のことを軽蔑したくない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Here, give it to me. You tear the wrapper open here, like this, then just bite into it. Don’t expect too much from the taste. It’s worlds apart from Kohaku’s cooking.”
“Um—Brother, are you serious?”
“I wouldn’t lie to you. Or is that it? After transferring here, are you going to tell me you’re too refined to eat anything from our school shop?
I’d hate to lose all respect for you, Akiha.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright, give it to me.
You open the bag here, like this.
And you just bite into it… it's okay, but don't expect too much for the taste.
Kohaku-san's cooking and this are like heaven and earth."
"Ahh… really, Nii-san?"
"I'm not kidding.
Or what are you going to say?
Don't tell me that even though you've transferred to our school, you can't eat our food.
I don't want to think less of you."

entries.japanese:
「ううん、そんなコトないけど……このパン、すごく大きくて、一口じゃ無理じゃないかな……」
「……誰も一口で食べろなんて言ってないよ。
こうゆうパンはね、少しずつかじっていくものなんだから。
そのぶん口が汚れるけど、有彦がナプキンを持ってきてくれるからそれで拭けばいいだろ？」
「……うん。
ありがと、兄さん」
　言って、秋葉はカレーパンをかじりはじめた。
　……なんていうか、カレーパンを一口食べるのにこれだけ緊張した女の子もいないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it isn’t that, but this bread is enormous—surely I can’t eat it in one bite…?”
“Nobody told you to swallow it whole. You take little bites. It’ll make a mess around your mouth, but Arihiko is bringing napkins, so you can wipe it off.”
“All right. Thank you, Brother.”
With that, Akiha began nibbling at the curry bread.
I doubt any girl in history had ever approached her first bite of one with such grave resolve.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it's not that, it's just… this bread, it's so big, I don't think I could get it into my mouth…"
"…… No one said you have to eat it all in one bite.
It's bread, so you bite off a bit at a time.
You'll get crumbs round your mouth, but Arihiko's bringing you a napkin to wipe it, okay?"
"…… Yes.
Thank you, Nii-san."
Saying so, Akiha starts to bite into the curry bread.
…… I don't think there ever was a girl getting this nervous to start eating curry bread.

entries.japanese:
秋葉が昼食を終えて数分後。
　秋葉は有彦の風貌があまり気にならないらしく、わりあい親しげに会話を楽しんでいるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A few minutes after Akiha finished lunch, she and Arihiko were chatting almost companionably.
Apparently his appearance didn’t bother her much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's a few minutes after Akiha finished her lunch.
Arihiko's appearance doesn't seem to bother her, as they are engaged in pleasant conversation.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
乾さんは兄さんと中学時代からの友人なんですね」
「ああ、もうかれこれ五年近くの付き合いでね。
コイツは初めて会った時からなにかと手間がかかるヤツでさあ、色々と面倒みてたらいつのまにかなつかれちまったってワケ」
「……有彦、それは語弊がある。
正確には俺がおまえにたかられちまった、というべきだ」
「おう。
どっちにしても腐れ縁って事だな、そりゃ」
　あはははは、と笑う有彦。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So you and my brother have been friends since middle school, Arihiko?”
“Yeah, coming up on five years now. He’s been a lot of work from the day we met, and after I kept looking after him, the poor guy grew attached.”
“That account is seriously misleading. The accurate version is that you latched on to me and never let go.”
“Sure. Either way, we’re stuck with each other.”
Arihiko laughed uproariously.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So Inui-san, you have been a friend of Nii-san's since junior high school?"
"Yeah, I've known him for about five years now.
He's been a bothersome guy since the moment we met.
I helped him out with all kinds of stuff, and before I knew it, he kind of grew on me."
"…… Arihiko, that's the wrong word.
You should call it extortion."
"Ahh, whatever you wanna call it, we're stuck with each other!"
Arihiko laughs.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、もう完全に腐敗しきってドロドロだから縁が切れない。
お互い厄介なヤツに掴まったもんだ」
　ふん、と皮肉げに有彦に笑い返してやる。
「………………………」
　……と、なぜか秋葉は気に食わなさそうに俺と有彦を見ていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right. The bond’s so rotten it’s turned to sludge and can’t be cut, so we’ve each been saddled with a real nuisance.”
I return Arihiko’s grin with a sardonic one of my own.
“…”
For some reason, Akiha watches the two of us with a distinctly displeased expression.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah.
Kind of like how stuff sticks to the bottom of your shoe.
I guess we both give each other a lot of trouble."
I return Arihiko's laugh cynically.
"………………"
…… Somehow, Akiha seems to be having trouble stomaching Arihiko and myself.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、ところで秋葉ちゃん、一つ訊いていい？」
「ええ、私に答えられる事でしたら」
「あのさあ、前から気になってたんだけど、遠野って慢性的な貧血だろ？
　これって昔からの体質なのか？」
　……有彦のすごいところは、こういう聞きにくいことをストレートに聞くところにある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Akiha—mind if I ask you something?”
“If it’s something I can answer.”
“I’ve wondered about this for a while: Tohno’s chronically anemic, right? Was he born that way?”
Arihiko’s great talent is asking difficult questions with the delicacy of a battering ram.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, by the way Akiha-chan, can I ask you something?"
"Certainly, if it is something I can answer."
"Well, I've been wondering for a while… Tohno has chronic anemia, right?
Was he always like this?"
…… The amazing thing about Arihiko is how he is so straightforward when asking awkward questions like this.

entries.japanese:
「はい、兄さんの貧血は生まれついた体質だそうです。
けれど、遠野の人間は少なからずそういった特質がありますから、兄さんだけが異状、というわけではありません」
「え……？
　そうなのか、秋葉？」
「はい。
お父様も生前は極端な躁鬱のけがありました。
乖離性同一性障害、と呼ばれるものです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I’m told Brother’s anemia is congenital, but traits of that kind appear throughout the Tohno family, so his condition is not unique.”
“What…? Is that true, Akiha?”
“Yes. Father suffered pronounced swings between mania and depression while he was alive. It is what is called dissociative identity disorder.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, Nii-san has been anemic since birth.
