But all the people of the Tohno family have similar problems; his is not a special case."
"Eh…?
Really, Akiha?"
"Yes.
Father suffered from manic depression.
Divergent Identity Disorder, to give it its full title."

entries.japanese:
「なに？
　かいりせいどういつせいしょうがい……？」
「俗にいう二重人格です。
お父様は記憶の混濁をなさるほど重度のものではありませんでしたけど」
――――初耳だ。
　けど思い返してみれば、遠野槙久は極端に優しさと強暴さが入れ替わる人物だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? Dis-so-ci-a-tive identity disorder…?”
“What people commonly call a split personality. Father’s case was not severe enough to cloud his memory, however.”
――――That was news to me.
But thinking back, Makihisa Tohno had been a man who could swing violently from kindness to brutality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha?
Divergent Identity…?"
"More commonly called split personalities.
Though, Father's wasn't severe enough to cause muddiness of memory."
----I didn't know.
But looking back on it, Tohno Makihisa's character did seem to switch often from tenderness to brutality.

entries.japanese:
「ふうん……心の病だったんだ、親父」
　そう言われてみれば、全ての物事が腑に落ちる。
　俺が事故に巻き込まれる前まで、父はこちらを敬遠していた気はあるものの優しい人物だったと思う。
　けれど、事故の後の槙久ははっきりとこちらの事を嫌悪していた。
　それも、考えてみれば躁鬱のせいだったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh, so Father was mentally ill.”
Put that way, everything seemed to fall into place.
Before my accident, he had kept his distance from me, but I remembered him as a kind man.
Afterward, Makihisa had plainly loathed me.
Perhaps that, too, had been due to his mood swings.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm… so, it was a medical condition, that old man…"
Looking at it like that, everything becomes clear.
Before the accident, I always felt father was a tender man, who kept his distance.
But after the accident, Makihisa clearly hated me.
Looking back, it may have been because of his condition.

entries.japanese:
「やっべぇー！
　昼休み終わっちゃったじゃんか、遠野！」
「俺に文句言うなよ。
ほら、秋葉も自分の教室に急がないと。
転校初日から五時限目に遅刻なんて恥ずかしいだろ」
「わかっています。
兄さんも、お気をつけて」
　予鈴が鳴り響く中、俺たちはそれぞれの教室に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Crap! Lunch break’s over, Tohno!”
“Don’t blame me. Come on, Akiha, you need to hurry back to your classroom too. Being late for fifth period on your first day would be humiliating.”
“I know. Take care, Brother.”
As the warning bell rang through the school, we scattered toward our respective classrooms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Argh!
Lunch break's over, Tohno!"
"Don't complain to me about it.
C'mon Akiha, you should hurry back to your classroom.
It'll be embarrassing to be late on your first day at school."
"I understand.
Take care, Nii-san."
As the bell resounds, we return to our classrooms.

entries.japanese:
波乱に満ちた一日が終わった。
　さて、これからどうするか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
At last, that eventful day came to an end.
Now, what should I do—
entries.mirrorMoon:
A day full of ups and downs finishes.
What should I do now---

entries.japanese:
……昼休みの件もあるし、秋葉のことが気にかかる。
　一人で帰れない、なんて事はないだろうけど、念のため様子を見に行ってみるか。
entries.maoEnglish:
After what happened at lunch, I can’t help worrying about Akiha.
Not that she can’t get home by herself, but maybe I should check on her just in case.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The events which happened during lunch break still weigh on my mind.
I'm sure she can walk home alone, but I feel I ought to go and check on Akiha.

entries.japanese:
すっかり日が暮れた廊下を歩く。
　秋葉のクラスは一年一組だったっけ。
　教室は静まりかえっていた。
　人気のない赤い教室の中、一人の女生徒が佇んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I walk down corridors already dark with night.
Akiha’s class was First-Year Class One, wasn’t it?
The classroom is utterly still.
In the deserted room, washed red by sunset, stands a lone schoolgirl.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk along the corridor lit by the fading sun.
I think Akiha's class is first grade, class one.
The classroom is silent.
A girl stands alone in the empty, red classroom.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……少し。
眩暈がした。
　まっかな夕焼けに染まった教室。
　かすかに赤い長髪の女生徒が、一人で帰り支度をしている。
　それは、どう見ても秋葉に違いない。
　なのにどうしてか、俺には初めて見るような、見知らぬ女生徒のように、思えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
A little. I feel dizzy.
The classroom is steeped in crimson evening light.
A girl with faintly red, waist-length hair is packing her things to leave.
She can only be Akiha.
Yet somehow she looks like a stranger—a girl I have never seen before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……"
…… I feel… a little dizzy.
The classroom dyed by the evening glow.
Alone, a girl with long, faintly red hair is preparing to leave.
No matter how I look at her, she's Akiha.
So why?
Why do I feel as if I am seeing a stranger for the first time?

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？」
「――――――」
　呼びかけられて眩暈がおさまった。
「おまえ―――秋葉、だよな」
「？
　兄さん、また気分でも悪いんですか？」
　秋葉はいつもの調子で話しかけてくる。
　……見れば秋葉は黒髪だし、この少女は紛れもなく自分の妹である遠野秋葉だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother?”
“…”
Her voice dispels the dizziness.
“You’re―――Akiha, right?”
“Brother? Are you feeling ill again?”
Akiha speaks in her usual manner.
A proper look shows me that her hair is black and that she is unmistakably my sister, Akiha Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?"
"------"
As she calls out to me, the dizziness subsides.
"You're---Akiha, right?"
"…?
Nii-san, are you feeling poorly again?"
Akiha addresses me in her usual tone.
…… Looking at Akiha's black hair, I feel that without a doubt, this is my own little sister, Tohno Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、なんでもない。
それより秋葉、これから帰るんだろ。
用がないんなら一緒に帰らないか？」
「ええ、そうですね。
兄さんがよろしいのでしたら、一緒に帰りましょう」
　どういう風の吹き回しか、秋葉はすごく優しく微笑んだ。
　……どくん、と心臓が動く。
　さっきの眩暈のせいなのか、それとも自分の学校に秋葉がいるっていう事自体が異常なことなのか。
　ともかく、なんだか必要以上に、胸の動悸が激しくなってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it’s nothing. More importantly, you’re heading home now, right? If you don’t have anything else to do, want to go together?”
“Yes, all right. If you’d like the company, let’s go together.”
For whatever reason, Akiha gives me an extraordinarily gentle smile.
My heart gives one hard thump.
Maybe it’s the lingering vertigo, or maybe the very sight of Akiha at my school feels too unnatural.
Whatever the cause, my heart is racing far harder than it should.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nah, it's nothing.
Come on, Akiha, it's time to go back.
If you're not doing anything, do you want to walk home together?"
"Yes… if you don't mind, let's walk home together."
For some reason, Akiha smiles tenderly.
…… My heart thumps.
Perhaps it's the dizziness from earlier, or perhaps the strangeness of seeing Akiha in my own school.
For some reason, my heart beats far harder than it needs to.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と一緒に校舎を出る。
　昇降口をすぎて校門に着いたとたん、俺に手をふる先輩の姿が見えた。
「あっ、やっと来ましたね遠野くん」
「あれ、先輩。
どうしたんですか、こんなところでぼけっとして」
「もう、ぼけっとしていたんじゃないです。
遠野くんが来ると思って待っていたんですけど―――」
　先輩は俺の横にいる秋葉に視線を送る。
　先輩は一目で俺と秋葉が一緒に帰っている、という事実を看破したらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I leave the school building.
The moment we pass the entrance and reach the front gate, I see my upperclassman waving to me.
“Ah, there you are at last, Tohno.”
“Oh, hello. What are you doing standing around here in a daze?”
“Honestly, I wasn’t in a daze. I thought you’d be coming, so I was waiting for you, but…”
Her eyes move to Akiha beside me.
Apparently one glance is enough for her to deduce the remarkable fact that Akiha and I are going home together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave the school building with Akiha.
As we reach the school gates, I catch sight of Senpai waving at me.
"Ah, you came at last, Tohno-kun."
"Huh, Senpai?
What are you doing, standing here like this?"
"Geez, I wasn't just standing here, I was waiting for you, Tohno-kun, but---"
Senpai glances at Akiha next to me.
Somehow, at a glance she realizes that Akiha and I are walking home together.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、そちらが妹さんなんですか？」
　秋葉をちらりと流し目に見る先輩。
「………………………」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　言わないけど、先輩も秋葉も『そのコを紹介してほしい』と視線で語ってくる。
 ────はあ。
　なんか、すごく疲れる事になりそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, is this your sister?”
She casts Akiha a sidelong glance.
“…”
Akiha says nothing.
She doesn’t need to; both of them are plainly demanding with their eyes that I introduce the other girl.
────I sigh.
This promises to become exhausting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, is this your little sister?"
Senpai throws a sidelong glance at Akiha.
"………………………"
Akiha says nothing.
Nothing is said, but both Senpai and Akiha tell me with their eyes to "Introduce me to this person".
----Ahh.
It seems like this is going be a really tiresome job.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、こいつは俺の妹で秋葉っていうんだ。
今日うちの学校に転校してきたらしい」
　よろしく、と秋葉は先輩に頭をさげる。
「そうなんですか。
こんにちは、遠野くんのおともだちのシエルです」
　……なんだろう。
　先輩と秋葉は、互いを見つめあったまま何も話さない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is my sister, Akiha. Apparently she transferred to our school today.”
Akiha bows to her in greeting.
“I see. Hello, I’m Ciel, a friend of your brother’s.”
What is this?
Ciel and Akiha only stare at one another, neither speaking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, this is my younger sister, Akiha.
She transferred to our school just today."
Akiha bows to Senpai.
"I see.
Hello.
My name is Ciel and I'm a friend of Tohno-kun."
…… What is it?
Senpai and Akiha just stare at each other, saying nothing.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、俺を待ってたような口ぶりだったけど、何かあったんですか？」
「はい、ちょっと遠野くんに付き合ってもらいたいところがあったんですけど―――」
「―――今日はもう遅くなっちゃいましたから、また今度にしますね。
さよなら遠野くん。
秋葉さんもまた明日お会いしましょう」
　それじゃあ、と先輩は反対方向へ歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You made it sound as if you were waiting for me—did something happen?”
“There was somewhere I wanted you to come with me, but…”
“It’s gotten too late today, so we’ll leave it for another time. Goodbye, Tohno. I’ll see you tomorrow too, Akiha.”
With a brief farewell, Ciel walks away in the opposite direction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, you sounded like you were waiting for me… What's going on?"
"Well, it just happened that I wanted to spend a little time with you, but---
---Since it's already late today, I'll leave it for another time.
Bye, Tohno-kun.
See you tomorrow as well, Akiha-san."
"Bye" says Senpai, and she walks away from us.

entries.japanese:
「───あ」
　止める間もなく、先輩はトコトコと去っていく。
「帰りましょう兄さん。
もう日が暮れてしまうわ」
　秋葉は何事もなかったように、極めてクールにそんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───Ah”
Before I can stop her, Ciel patters away.
“Let’s go home, Brother. It will be dark soon.”
Akiha says it with perfect composure, as though nothing whatsoever has happened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
Senpai leaves without giving me a chance to stop her.
"Let's go home, Nii-san.
It will get dark soon."
Akiha says this as if nothing happened.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に帰ったらどんな顔をして秋葉と会っていいか分からない。
　分からないので、屋敷に帰る前にこんなところで考え込んでみる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had no idea how I was supposed to face Akiha when I got home.
Since I couldn’t find an answer, I sat here brooding before returning to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know how to face Akiha once I get home to the mansion.
So, I sit and think right here before I go home.

entries.japanese:
あまり気の利いた結論はでそうにない。
　気がつけば教室には誰もいなくなっていた。
「───帰るか」
　無駄な時間を過ごした。
　あれこれ考えている暇があるのなら、どーんと秋葉と正面からぶつかった方がいくぶん生産的だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I wasn’t likely to arrive at any particularly clever conclusion.
Before I knew it, the classroom was empty.
“───Time to go home.”
I had wasted my time.
If I had time to sit here agonizing, I might as well go home and collide with Akiha head-on; that would at least accomplish something.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It looks like no ideas are forthcoming.
Before I knew it, the classroom was empty.
"---I guess I'll go home."
What a waste of time.
If I had time to think, it would have been more productive if I just faced Akiha without any plans.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん！」
　廊下に出たとたん、名前を呼ばれた。
「よかった、遠野くんがまだ残ってて。
あの、これから帰るところですか？」
「んー、まあそんなところ。
別段やる事がないから、今日はおとなしく帰ろうかなって。
そういう先輩もこれから帰り？」
「はい。
今日は頼まれごともありませんから、たまには買い物でもして帰ろうと思ってたところです」
「そっか。
買い物って駅前のほう？」
「いいえ、ココに売ってます」
　先輩はまたもおかしな事を言い出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno!”
The instant I stepped into the corridor, someone called my name.
“Thank goodness you’re still here. Were you about to leave?”
“More or less. I’ve got nothing else to do, so I thought I’d be good and go straight home. Are you leaving too?”
“Yes. No one needs me for anything today, so I thought I might do some shopping on the way.”
“I see. Near the station?”
“No, what I want is sold right here.”
Ciel had begun saying strange things again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun!"
Someone calls my name as I step out into the hallway.
"Thank God you're still here.
Um, are you going home right now?"
"Umm, something like that.
Since I don't have anything to do, I was thinking of just going straight home.
Are you heading home too, Senpai?"
"Yes, since I don't have anything I have to do, I was thinking of going shopping."
"I see, shopping.
You mean by the station?"
"No, it's on sale here."
Senpai starts to talk weird again.

entries.japanese:
「……ココって───ここ？」
　はい、と満面に笑みをうかべる先輩。
「……ココ、なに売ってるの？」
「コレです」
　ぴっ、と先輩は指をつきだした。
　先輩の細い指の先にあるのは俺の顔ぐらいしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait—by ‘here,’ you mean───here?”
She answered yes with a radiant smile.
“What exactly are they selling here?”
“This.”
She thrust out one slender finger.
The only thing at its tip was my face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Here--you mean here?"
Yes, says Senpai with a big smile.
"…… What's on sale here?"
"This."
Senpai points with her finger.
Only my face is in her slender finger's way.

entries.japanese:
「コレって、俺？」
「はい。
まだ残ってましたから、遠野くんの時間を買うことにします。
そういうわけなので遠野くんはわたしと一緒に帰りましょう」
　ぐい、と俺の腕を掴んで先輩は歩きだす。
「ちょっ───ちょっと待った、そりゃあ嬉しいけど先輩の家って俺んとこと逆方向じゃないか。
校庭まで一緒に帰るためにわざわざ来たの？」
「いえ、今日は駅前のほうでお買い物をするので途中まで一緒なんです」
「ああ、それなら途中まで一緒だな───って、その買い物ってなにさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“By ‘this,’ do you mean me?”
“Yes. You were still here, so I’ve decided to buy some of your time. That means you’re coming home with me.”
She seized my arm and began towing me away.
“W-wait! I’m flattered, but your house is in the opposite direction from mine; did you come all this way just so we could walk together as far as the schoolyard?”
“No, I’m shopping near the station today, so we’ll be going the same way for a while.”
“Oh, then we can walk together—but what are you shopping for?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You mean, me?"
"Yes, since you're still here, I've decided to buy your time.
So let's go home together, Tohno-kun."
Senpai tugs at my arm and starts to walk.
"W-wait a second, I'm glad we can go home together, but isn't your house in the opposite direction of mine?
Did you come by just to walk together to the gate?"
"No, I'm going to go shopping by the station, so we'll walk together for a while."
"I see, then we will be walking together for a while---wait, what are you shopping for anyways?"

entries.japanese:
「ええっと、寒くなってきたので今のうちに暖房器具を買っておこうと思いまして」
「暖房器具か……ちょっと気が早いけど、まあ秋なんかあっという間にすぎるからな。
　で、何買うの？
　エアコン？」
「一介の高校生にエアコンなんて買えません。
ですから安価で便利な日本の伝統工芸、コタツさんを購入しようかな、と」
　こたつが日本の伝統工芸とは知らなかった。
　それは、ともかく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, it’s getting cold, so I thought I’d buy a heater now, before I need one.”
“A heater—maybe it’s a little early, but autumn will be over before we know it.
So what are you buying? An air conditioner?”
“An ordinary high school student can’t afford an air conditioner. So I thought I might purchase that inexpensive, convenient triumph of traditional Japanese craftsmanship: good old Kotatsu.”
I had no idea the kotatsu was a traditional Japanese craft.
That aside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I thought since it's starting to get cold, I should buy some heating equipment."
"Heating equipment, huh… I think it's a bit too early for that, but I guess autumn goes by quickly.
So what are you buying?
An air conditioner?"
"A high schooler can't afford an air conditioner.
So, I was thinking of buying the cheap, efficient, traditional Japanese craft, Kotatsu-san."
I never knew kotatsu was a traditional Japanese craft.
With that aside.

entries.japanese:
「────先輩。
なんだかんだとうまい事いって、俺を労働力として利用するつもりだろ」
「そんなことないですよー。
ただ途中まで一緒に帰って、ちょっと買い物選びにつきあってもらうだけですから」
「……で、買いおわった後にこう言うんだろ。
遠野くん、わたしこんな重いものもてないわ！
って」
「むっ。
遠野くん、わたしはそんなぶしつけなお願いはしません。
するんならこう、もっと婉曲な言い回しをするんですからっ」
「そうだよな。
ま、どっちにしても俺はイヤだって断るけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“────Ciel. You’ve dressed this up very nicely, but you only want to use me as free labor.”
“That isn’t true. We’re only walking home together, and I’d like a little company while I choose one.”
“…Then once you’ve bought it, you’ll say, ‘Oh, Tohno, I could never carry anything so heavy!’”
“Hmph. I would never make such an impertinent request. If I wanted your help, I’d phrase it much more delicately.”
“Naturally. Either way, I’d refuse.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Senpai, you were going to talk me into carrying your stuff, right?"
"That's not true.
I just thought we could walk together for a bit, and you could accompany me while I shop."
"…… And you would say this to me after shopping.
Tohno-kun, I can't carry such a heavy load!"
"Hey.
Tohno-kun, I wouldn't ask you to do such a thing.
Even if I did, I'd ask in a much more roundabout manner."
"You're right.
Either way, I'd tell you I wouldn't want to do it."

entries.japanese:
「あはは、大丈夫ですよ。
わたしはそんなコト頼みません」
「わかってるって。
先輩はそんな人じゃないもんな」
　あはははは、と俺たちは笑いあう。
　しばらくそんな、とぼけた笑い声をあげていたのだが、先輩は突然がっくりと肩を落とした。
「……………………いじわる」
　やばい、イジメすぎたか。
　せっかく頼りにされてたんだから、もう少し素直に乗せられてあげてもよかったかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ahaha, don’t worry. I would never ask you to do such a thing.”
“I know. You aren’t that kind of person.”
We laughed together, each of us keeping up the ridiculous performance.
After a while, however, Ciel’s shoulders suddenly slumped.
“You’re mean.”
Uh-oh—maybe I teased her too much.
She had gone to all this trouble to rely on me; perhaps I should have let her rope me in a little more gracefully.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahaha, it's alright.
I would never ask you to do such a thing."
"I know you're not that kind of a person, Senpai."
We laugh together for a while.
We were laughing together for a while, but Senpai suddenly drops her shoulders.
"…………… Meanie."
Oh no, I guess I made too much fun of her.
She was relying on me, so maybe I should have cooperated with her a bit more.

entries.japanese:
「───わかったよ。
今度お昼ご飯をおごってくれるなら、喜んで荷物持ちでも何でもしてあげます」
「無理に手伝ってくれなくていいです。
ただちょっと、一人じゃ重たいかなって思ってただけなんですから」
「なにいってんだい。
先輩の生っ白い腕で運べるわけないじゃないか。
いいから付いてくよ。
　先輩、さっき俺の時間を買うっていっただろ？
　昼飯代で雇われてあげますから、今日はせいぜいこき使ってくださいって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“───All right. Buy me lunch sometime, and I’ll gladly carry whatever you like.”
“You don’t have to force yourself. I only thought it might be a little heavy for me alone.”
“Don’t be ridiculous. Those pale little arms of yours could never carry it. I’m coming.
You said you were buying my time, remember? Hire me for the price of lunch and work me as hard as you please.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Alright.
If you'll buy me lunch next time, I'll do the carrying or anything else you want me to do."
"You don't have to help me if you don't want to.
I just thought it might be a bit too heavy for me alone."
"What are you saying?
There's no way you'll be able to carry it with your weak arms.
I'll go.
You said you'll buy my time, Senpai.
I'll work for lunch, so take advantage of that all you want."

entries.japanese:
「───わかりました。
それじゃあお言葉に甘えて、今日は頼りにしちゃいます」
「ああ、いくらでも頼りにしてくれ」
　ぐっ、と腕を叩いて腕力あるよー、とアピールする。
　先輩は軽く笑って、それじゃあと歩きだした。
「あ、その前に一つ聞きたいんですけど」
「なに？」
「お昼ご飯、お弁当でいいですか？」
　是非もない。
　考えるまでもなく即座にうなずいていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───All right. If you insist, I’ll depend on you today.”
“As much as you like.”
I thumped my arm to advertise its magnificent strength.
Ciel laughed softly, then started walking.
“Before we go, may I ask one thing?”
“What?”
“Would a packed lunch be acceptable payment?”
I could hardly say no.
I nodded before I even had to think.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Alright.
I'll take your kind words and I'll rely on you today."
"Yeah, rely on me all you want."
I hit my arm to appeal to her that I have some power in there.
Senpai laughs and starts to walk.
"Oh, I wanted to ask you one thing before that."
"What?"
"Can I bring you a bentou for lunch?"
Of course.
I found myself nodding even before I thought about it.

entries.japanese:
昇降口から校庭に出る。
　グランドには陸上部以外の生徒はいない。
「……放課後の部活、減っちゃいましたね」
　先輩は残念そうに呟く。
　例の吸血鬼事件の影響で、放課後の部活動がのきなみ禁止されてしまって、グラウンドには陸上部ぐらいしかいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
We left through the shoe lockers and crossed into the schoolyard.
Apart from the track team, the grounds were deserted.
“There are so few clubs practicing after school now.”
Ciel murmured sadly.
In the wake of the recent murders, almost every club had been sent home, leaving only the track team on the field.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We exit to the school grounds.
There's no one out here except for the track team.
"There's less after school activity now."
Senpai says this regretfully.
Due to that vampire incident, most of the after school clubs have been cancelled and the only guys that are left are the track team.

entries.japanese:
……もっとも、あの事件はもう起こらない。
　弓塚がいなくなってしまった以上、これ以上犠牲者は出ないんだけど、そんな事を言っても誰も信じてくれないだろう。
「……そうだね。
もう何人も犠牲者が出ているんだから父兄の方々も黙ってなかったんだろ」
「ちょっと残念です。
わたし、放課後の雰囲気って好きだったから」
entries.maoEnglish:
Of course, there would be no more such incidents.
With Yumizuka gone, no more victims would appear—but no one would believe me if I said so.
“…I suppose parents couldn’t stay quiet after so many people were killed.”
“It’s a shame. I always liked the atmosphere after school.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… But that incident will not occur again.
Since Yumizuka is no longer alive, there will be no more victims.
But I bet no one would believe me even if I said that.
"…… You're right.
There's been several victims, so I guess the parents had a say."
"I feel a bit down.
I liked that after school atmosphere."

entries.japanese:
校門に出る。
「え────？」
　同時に、俺は予想外の人間と目があった。
「もう。
下校時間もずいぶんと遅いんですね、兄さんは」
「あ、あき───」
　は、と言いかけた時、先輩がやってきた。
「遠野くん？」
　立ち止まった俺に声をかけてくる先輩。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reached the school gate.
“What…?”
At that same instant, my eyes met those of the last person I expected to see.
“Honestly, Brother. You leave school remarkably late.”
“A-Aki───”
Just as I was about to finish saying her name, Ciel came over.
“Tohno?”
Ciel called when she saw me stop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We exit to the gate.
"Huh-?"
At the same time, I face an unexpected person.
"Geez, you go home late too, Nii-san."
"A, Aki-"
As I start to finish with "ha", Senpai comes along.
"Tohno-kun?"
Senpai calls me as I stand still.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は一目で俺と先輩が一緒に帰っている、という事実を看破したらしい。
　まるで非難するような眼差しで俺と先輩を眺めている。
「秋葉───おまえ、何してんだよ」
「兄さんと一緒に帰ろうと思って」
　じろり、と冷たい眼差しで秋葉は告げてくる。
「遠野くん、妹さんなんですか？」
　秋葉をちらりと流し目に見る先輩。
　はっきりとは言わないが、先輩も秋葉も『その人を紹介してほしい』と視線で語ってくる。
 ────はあ。
　なんか、すごく疲れる事になりそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
One glance told Akiha that Ciel and I had been leaving together.
She surveyed us both with open accusation.
“Akiha, what are you doing here?”
“I came so we could walk home together.”
Her reply arrived on an icy glare.
“Tohno, is this your sister?”
Ciel gave Akiha a sidelong glance.
Neither said so aloud, but both were plainly demanding an introduction with their eyes.
────I sighed.
This promised to become exhausting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems that Akiha understood the fact that Senpai and I were going home together.
She stares at Senpai and me as if criticizing us.
"Akiha---what are you doing?"
"I thought I would go home with you, Nii-san."
Akiha answers while staring at me coldly.
"Tohno-kun, is that your little sister?"
Senpai glances at Akiha.
They don't say it directly, but both Senpai and Akiha tell me with their eyes to "Introduce me to this person".
-------*sigh*
It seems like this is going be a really tiresome job.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、こいつは俺の妹で秋葉っていうんだ。
今日うちの学校に転校してきた」
　よろしく、と秋葉は先輩に頭をさげる。
「そうなんですか。
こんにちは、遠野くんのおともだちのシエルです」
　……なんだろう。
　先輩と秋葉は、互いを見つめあったまま何も話さない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, this is my sister, Akiha. She transferred to our school today.”
Akiha bowed to her in greeting.
“I see. Hello, I’m Ciel, a friend of your brother’s.”
What is this?
Ciel and Akiha only stare at one another, neither speaking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, this is my younger sister, Akiha.
She transferred to our school just today."
Akiha bows to Senpai.
"I see.
Hello.
My name is Ciel and I'm a friend of Tohno-kun."
…… What's going on?
Senpai and Akiha just stare at each other, saying nothing.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
俺、今日は先輩の買い物に付き合うことになってるから、その―――」
「そうなんですか、先輩？」
　……先に帰ってくれ、と続ける前に、秋葉はぴしゃりと先輩に質問する。
「はい。
けど、またの機会にすることにします。
遠野くんも妹さんと仲良くしてあげないとだめですよ」
　それじゃあ、と先輩は反対方向へ歩いていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. I promised to help Ciel with some shopping today, so―――”
“Is that true?”
Before I could finish by asking her to go home without me, Akiha cut in and addressed Ciel directly.
“Yes. But we can always go another time. You should be nicer to your sister, Tohno.”
With a brief goodbye, Ciel walked away in the opposite direction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, I'm going to go shopping with Senpai today, so-"
"Is that true, Senpai?"
…… Before I could tell her to go home, Akiha questions Senpai.
"Yes, but I'll do so on another occasion.
Tohno-kun, you should be nicer to your sister."
"Bye" says Senpai, and she walks away from us.

entries.japanese:
「───あ」
　止める間もなく、先輩はトコトコと去っていく。
「帰りましょう兄さん。
もう日が暮れてしまうわ」
　秋葉は何事もなかったように、極めてクールにそんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───Ah”
Before I can stop her, Ciel patters away.
“Let’s go home, Brother. It will be dark soon.”
Akiha says it with perfect composure, as though nothing has happened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Hey."
Senpai leaves without giving me a chance to stop her.
"Let's go home, Nii-san.
It will get dark soon."
Akiha says this as if nothing happened.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と屋敷に向かって歩いていく。
「…………」
　はっきりいって、複雑だ。
　ふと隣に視線を向ければ長い髪をなびかせて秋葉が歩いている。
　秋葉は黙っている分には楚々としていて、非の打ち所のないお嬢様だったりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I walk toward the mansion.
“…”
To be honest, I don’t know what to make of this.
Whenever I glance aside, there she is, walking beside me with her long hair streaming behind her.
As long as she keeps quiet, Akiha is all grace and refinement—the very picture of a flawless young lady.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk with Akiha towards the mansion.
"……"
Frankly, it's difficult.
If I look beside me, I can see Akiha walking with her long hair fluttering.
Akiha is silent and graceful, the perfect daughter of a respected family.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　どうしてか、会話がうかばない。
　秋葉とは家で毎日顔を合わせているっていうのにひどく緊張したままで、屋敷に向かって足を進ませていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
For some reason, I can’t think of a thing to say.
I see Akiha every day at home, yet I remain painfully tense as we make our way back to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
Why can't I think of anything to say?
Even though I see Akiha at home every day, I somehow feel some tension walking home toward the mansion.

entries.japanese:
――それでも、どうしても聞いておかない事が一つだけあった。
「秋葉」
「はい、なんでしょうか兄さん」
「なんでしょうか兄さん、じゃないだろ。
おまえ、なんだってうちの高校になんて転校してきたんだ。
うちみたいな二流の進学校に転校したって、何のメリットもないじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
――Even so, there is one thing I simply have to ask.
“Akiha.”
“Yes―――what is it, Brother?”
“Don’t give me that. Why did you transfer to my school? There’s nothing for you to gain by moving to a second-rate college-prep school like ours.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
--But I still haven't had an explanation.
"Akiha."
"Yes?
What is it, Nii-san?"
"What is it!?
Why have you transferred to this school?
What possible reason could you have for transferring to a second-rate elevator school!?"

entries.japanese:
「お言葉ですけど兄さん。
私がどこの学校に通うかは私の自由です。
兄さんに答えなくちゃいけない理由なんてないわ」
「……馬鹿なこと言うな。
俺はおまえの兄貴だぞ。
兄貴として、おまえの為にならない事を見過ごすわけにはいかない。
　はっきり言えば、うちの高校に転校してくるのはおまえにとってマイナスしかないと思う。
親父ももういないんだから、せめて俺がちゃんとおまえを見てやらないといけないじゃないか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“With all due respect, Brother, I’m free to attend any school I please. I see no reason I owe you an explanation.”
“Don’t be ridiculous. I’m your older brother. I can’t stand by and let you do something that’s bad for you.
Frankly, transferring to my school can only hurt your prospects. Father isn’t here anymore, so the least I can do is look after you properly…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So you say, Nii-san.
But I can go to school wherever I choose; I do not need to explain myself to you."
"…… Don't be stupid.
I'm your brother!
I can't just overlook things that are against your best interests.
Frankly, I can't see any benefit in you transferring to this school.
Since our old man isn't around anymore, it's my responsibility to look out for you…!"

entries.japanese:
「……なによ。
こういう時だけそうゆう言い回しをするなんて、フェアじゃないわ」
「フェアじゃないのはそっちのほうだろ。
俺に黙って転校するなんて、一体どういうつもりなんだ。
　ちゃんと理由を聞くまで俺はおまえの転校なんて認めないからな！」
「あ―――――」
「つまらない理由だったらもといた学校に叩き返す。
ほら、言えよ秋葉。
なんで転校なんかしたんだ、おまえ」
　秋葉はうつむいて黙り込む。
　ほんの少しだけそうした後、秋葉は凛とした姿勢で顔をあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s not fair. You only talk like my protective older brother when it suits you.”
“You’re the one who’s not playing fair. What were you thinking, transferring without telling me?
Until I hear a proper reason, I refuse to approve of this!”
“Ah―――――”
“And if your reason is stupid, I’ll personally send you straight back to your old school. Come on, Akiha. Tell me why you transferred.”
Akiha lowers her head and falls silent.
A moment later, she straightens proudly and raises her face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
It's not fair to say things like that at times like these."
"'Not fair' is my line.
What were you thinking, transferring without even telling me?
I won't accept this transfer until I hear a good reason!"
"Ah----"
"If I'm not satisfied with the reason, I'll send you right back to your own school.
So, tell me, Akiha.
Why did you change schools?"
Akiha falls silent and looks down.
A very brief moment later, she raises a brave face.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さんが心配だから、ではいけませんか」
 ─────え？
「……ちょっ、ちょっと待った。
俺が心配だからって、なんで―――」
　なんでそんな理由で転校なんかしてくるんだよ、おまえは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is it so wrong that I’m worried about you?”
─────What?
“W-wait a minute.
You were worried about me, so why—” Why would you transfer schools for a reason like that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I was worried about you, Nii-san.
Is that not a sufficient reason?"
-------Eh?
"…… Ha, hang on.
What do you mean, worried about me…?"
What sort of reason is that for transferring?

entries.japanese:
「だって、このところの兄さんの素行の乱れは目にあまるんだもの。
遠野の名を汚さないためにも、私が近くで監督する事に決めたんです」
　秋葉はきっぱりと言い切った。
「な―――――」
　素行の乱れ、だなんて言われると、こっちとしてはうなずくしかない。
　事実、ここんとこの俺の生活はメチャクチャで、秋葉たちには迷惑をかけっぱなしだったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because your behavior lately has been impossible to overlook.
To keep you from disgracing the Tohno name, I decided to supervise you personally.”
Akiha delivers the verdict without the slightest hesitation.
“Wh—” Faced with a charge like improper conduct, I can hardly deny it.
My life has been a complete mess lately, and I’ve caused Akiha and the others no end of trouble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, looking at your unruly behavior recently, I decided that in order to prevent you from disgracing the Tohno name, I would have to keep a close eye on you."
Akiha explains clearly.
"Erk----"
When she says "unruly behavior", I can't help but nod.
It's true, my everyday life since coming here has surely been an annoyance to Akiha and the others.

entries.japanese:
「で、でも、だからって転校までする事ないだろ。
今までの友達とかどうするんだ」
「そんなこと、兄さんが気に病む必要はありません。
少しでも私に悪いと思うんでしたら、今日から考えを改めてくださればいいんです」
　ぷい、と顔を背けて反論する秋葉。
　……もう、こう言えばああいうヤツだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“B-but you didn’t have to transfer schools. What about all your friends there?”
“You needn’t worry about that. If you feel the least bit sorry for me, start mending your ways today.”
Akiha turns her face away in a huff.
Honestly, whatever I say, she has an answer waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Bu, but, transferring is still a bit much, isn't it?
What about your friends?"
"That's none of your concern, Nii-san.
If you feel even a little bad for me, then all you have to do is change your way of thinking from now on."
Akiha turns sharply away.
…… Well, this is just the way she is.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった、勝手にしろ。
けどな、あとで後悔したって知らないからな」
「けっこうです。
兄さんに心配してもらおうなんて思ってませんから」
　ふーんだ、とばかりに胸をはって、秋葉は拗ねた。
　俺たちはそれきり黙り込んで、屋敷へ続く坂道を上り続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine—do whatever you want. But don’t come crying to me if you regret it later.”
“I won’t. I never asked you to worry about me in the first place.”
Akiha thrusts out her chest in a splendid little sulk.
Neither of us says another word as we continue up the hill to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright, do as you please.
But one day, you'll regret it."
"That's fine.
I wasn't thinking of having you worry over me, Nii-san."
With a sound of exasperation, Akiha starts to sulk.
We fall silent, and continue up towards the mansion.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に着いた。
　秋葉は門を開けようと前に出て、思い出したように俺へと振り返った。
「……一つ、聞きますけど。
兄さんはシエルという人とどれくらい親しいんですか？」
　唐突に、突拍子もない質問をしてくる。
「いや、別に親しいっていうほどじゃないけど。
シエル先輩とは先輩と後輩の間柄だよ。
なんていうか、話してると落ち着く友達って感じだけど」
　そうですか、と秋葉は目を背けて玄関に向かっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach the mansion.
Akiha steps ahead to open the gate, then turns back to me as though something has just occurred to her.
“One question. How close are you to this Ciel?”
The question comes completely out of nowhere.
“We’re not especially close. She’s a year above me, and that’s all. I suppose she’s a friend I can relax around.”
Akiha says, “I see,” then looks away and heads for the front door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We arrive at the mansion.
Akiha steps forward to open the gate, but as if remembering something, turns to me.
"…… I have one question.
How close are you to that person called Ciel, Nii-san?"
Abruptly, she asks an extremely forward question.
"Not especially close.
We're just friends from school.
She… feels like someone I can talk to."
"Really?" Akiha says, turning away and going through the gates.

entries.japanese:
庭を通り過ぎて玄関に着く。
　翡翠が門で待っていたり、庭で琥珀さんがホウキを手にして掃除していたりする事はなく、今日は申し合わせたように二人の姿は見当たらなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We cross the garden and reach the entrance.
Hisui is not waiting at the gate, nor is Kohaku sweeping the garden with her broom; today, as if by prior agreement, neither of them is anywhere to be seen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We cross the courtyard and arrive at the door.
As Hisui is not waiting at the gates and Kohaku is not sweeping the garden, there is no sign of either of them today.

entries.japanese:
「あ」
「はい？
　何か言いましたか兄さん」
「いや、ちょっとした事なんだけど。
あのさ、秋葉が言っていた例の和風の離れに入ってみたいんだけど、いいかな」
「――――離れに、ですか？」
　呟いて、秋葉は難しそうに眉をよせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh.”
“Yes? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Nothing important. Could I take a look inside that Japanese-style annex you mentioned?”
“――――The annex?”
Akiha murmurs, knitting her brows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah."
"Yes?
Did you say something, Nii-san?"
"Well, nothing much but… I'd like to go and take a look at the Japanese-style building you were talking about, if that's okay."
"----The detached building?"
Murmuring, Akiha's brow creases with concern.

entries.japanese:
「やめてください。
あそこはもう何年も前に封鎖したところです。
兄さんといえど、あそこ立ち入ることは許しません」
　きっぱりと言って、秋葉は屋敷の中に入っていってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please don’t. That building was sealed off years ago. Even you are not permitted to enter it.”
With that flat refusal, Akiha disappears into the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please, do not.
It was sealed up many years ago.
Nii-san, even you are not permitted to go there."
Having stated this, Akiha goes into the mansion.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と屋敷に向かって歩いていく。
「…………」
　はっきりいって、複雑だ。
　ふと隣に視線を向ければ長い髪をなびかせて秋葉が歩いている。
　秋葉は黙っている分には楚々としていて、非の打ち所のないお嬢様だったりする。

“…”
To be honest, I don’t know what to make of this.
Whenever I glance aside, there she is, walking beside me with her long hair streaming behind her.
As long as she keeps quiet, Akiha is all grace and refinement—the very picture of a flawless young lady.

Frankly, it's difficult.
If I look beside me, I can see Akiha walking with her long hair fluttering.

Even though I see Akiha at home every day, I somehow feel some tension walking home toward the mansion.
