…… Yumizuka's bite marks are long gone.
I'm still a normal human being.
I don't want to drink people's blood, and I don't have a problem with the sun.
"----Ah."
No.
Yesterday, I
What did I think when I saw Kohaku-san's neck?
---Her white neck.
From the bottom of my heart, I wanted to drink the blood flowing in there----

entries.japanese:
「――――なにを、ばかな」
　違う、ただ疲れているだけだ。
　弓塚とのことがまだ忘れられないだけだ。
　俺は吸血鬼になんかなっていない。
まだまっとうな人間のままのはずだ。
　だが、毎夜血を求めてさまよっている自分がいる。
　なら、もしかすれば。
　俺だけ気がついていないだけで、実際は、もう戻れない所まで――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What nonsense”
No, I am only tired.
I still have not shaken what happened with Yumizuka.
I have not become a vampire. I should still be an ordinary human being.
And yet, there I was—roaming the streets every night in search of blood.
Then, perhaps.
Without my even realizing it, I had already gone too far to return――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What am I thinking?"
No, I'm just tired.
I still haven't forgotten what happened with Yumizuka.
I'm not a vampire.
I'm still a normal human being.
But, there's a part of me that wanders in search of blood every night.
So, maybe…
It's that I don't notice, but I'm already at a point where I can't go back----

entries.japanese:
「翡翠―――？」
　翡翠はやけに切迫した面持ちで入ってきた。
「―――失礼いたしました。
お目覚めでいらしたんですね、志貴さま」
　スッ、と静かにおじぎをする翡翠。
　……その姿はさっきまでの夢とは正反対に清らかで、見ているだけで胸の不安を薄れさせてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui―――?”
She comes in looking unusually desperate.
“―――Forgive me. I see you are awake, Master Shiki.”
Hisui gives a swift, silent bow.
She is the very opposite of the dream, so pure that looking at her eases the dread in my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui---?"
Hisui enters with an urgent expression.
"…… Excuse me.
You are awake, are you not, Shiki-sama?"
Hisui bows quietly.
…… Her pure figure is so much the opposite of my earlier dream, it makes the uneasiness in my chest go away.

entries.japanese:
「いや、いま起きたばっかりだっから気にしないで。
……その、おはよう翡翠。
今日も起こしに来てくれてありがとう」
「……はい、おはようございます」
　ぺこり、ともう一度おじぎをして翡翠はベッドに近付いてくる。
「お飲み物をお持ちいたしました。
ご気分がすぐれないようでしたらお飲みください」
　翡翠は銀のトレイに飲み物を用意していた。
トレイには薬らしきものまである。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do not worry, I only just woke up. Good morning, Hisui. Thank you for coming to wake me again today.”
“Good morning.”
Hisui bows again, then approaches the bed.
“I brought you something to drink. If you are feeling unwell, please have some.”
Hisui had brought a drink on a silver tray. The tray even held what looked like medicine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, don't worry, I was up already.
…… Morning, Hisui.
Thanks for coming to wake me up again today."
"…… Yes.
Good morning."
Bowing again, Hisui approaches the bed.
"I have brought you a drink.
If you are feeling poorly, please take it."
Hisui presents a drink on a silver tray.
The tray also has some kind of medicine on it.

entries.japanese:
「……？
　どうしたんだ、翡翠。
薬をもってくるなんて今までなかったのに」
「……志貴さま、ご気分はよろしいのですか？
　先ほどまでひどくうなされていて、顔色が優れないようでしたのでお薬をお持ちしたのですが」
「――――うなされていたって、俺が？」
「はい。
見た限りではお体も熱をもっているようでしたから、姉さんに解熱剤を処方してもらったのですが、その必要はなかったでしょうか？」
「まさか、そんなことはないよ。
気を使ってくれてありがとう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…? What’s wrong, Hisui? You’ve never brought me medicine before.”
“Master Shiki, are you feeling all right? You were having a terrible nightmare and looked pale, so I brought medicine.”
“――――A nightmare, me?”
“You also appeared feverish, so I asked my sister to prepare something for it. Was that unnecessary?”
“Of course not. Thank you for going to the trouble.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……?
What is it, Hisui?
You've never come with medicine before."
"…… Shiki-sama, are you feeling alright?
As you seemed to be caught up in a terrible nightmare and your face appeared pale, I brought you some medicine."
"----I seemed to be having a nightmare?"
"Yes.
It also seemed that your body was very hot, so I had Nee-san prescribe something for a fever.
Perhaps there was no need?"
"Of course not, thank you for worrying."

entries.japanese:
差し出された薬と水を飲み下す。
　薬はともかく、水はありがたかった。
　翡翠の言うとおり体全体が熱っぽくて、喉がカラカラに渇いていたせいだろう。
　ただの水なのに、このうえなく美味しく感じられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I swallowed the medicine with the water she offered.
Whatever I thought of the medicine, the water was a blessing.
Just as Hisui had said, my whole body felt feverish and my throat was parched.
Plain water had never tasted so good.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I swallow the medicine and water she offers.
Ignoring the medicine, I'm grateful for the water.
As Hisui says, my body is very hot, and my throat is terribly dry.
Even though it's only pure water, it tastes great.

entries.japanese:
「体調がよろしければ食堂においでください。
お体のほうが優れないようでしたら、今日はお休みくださいませ」
「いや、学校は休まないよ。
こんなコトで休んでいたらそれこそキリがないからね」
「……ですが、まだ志貴さまの顔色はよくはありません」
「大丈夫だって。
それにさ、うちの学校は明日休みなんだ。
明日休めるんだから、今日は無理してもいいだろう？」
「……………」
　翡翠は何か言いたそうにうつむいてしまう。
　そんなに顔色が悪いんだろうか、今の自分は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you feel well enough, please come to the dining room. If not, I ask that you remain home today.”
“No, I’m going to school. If I started staying home over something like this, there’d be no end to it.”
“But you are still very pale, Master Shiki.”
“I said I am fine. Besides, school is closed tomorrow. If I can rest then, I can push myself today, can I not?”
“…”
Hisui lowered her head, plainly wanting to say something.
Did I really look that bad?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you are feeling better, please go to the dining room.
If you are not, please take today off."
"No, I won't skip school.
I can't take a day off just because of this."
"…… But, your face still appears pale, Shiki-sama."
"I'll be fine.
Anyway, our school has tomorrow off.
Since I'll have tomorrow off, I can push it a little today, can't I?"
"…………"
Hisui glances down, looking like she wants to say something.
Do I really look that bad today?

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
一つ聞くけど、そんなにうなされてたのか、俺」
「―――はい。
いつお帰りになられたかは存じませんが、ひどく疲れたようにお眠りになられていました。
　朝は失礼して志貴さまのお部屋のカーテンを開けにくるのですが、その時から苦しそうに呼吸を荒だたせていましたが」
　……そうか。
あんな夢を見ていたんだから、そりゃあ苦しくもなる……って、ちょっと、待った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, tell me something. Was I really having that bad a nightmare?”
“―――Yes. I do not know when you returned, but you were sleeping as though exhausted.
Each morning I enter to open Master Shiki’s curtains, and from the moment I arrived your breathing was labored.”
I see. A dream like that would make anyone suffer—but wait.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, just one question.
Was I really having a nightmare?"
"---Yes.
I do not know when you returned, but you were terribly tired and went straight to sleep.
When I came to wake you in the morning and opened the curtains, you seemed to be in pain, and your breathing was rough."
…… I see.
A dream like that would cause me to be in pain… eh?
Just hang on a second.

entries.japanese:
「―――翡翠。
今、なんて言った」
「ですから朝方から志貴さまの体調が崩れていたようです、と」
「違う、その前！
　俺が帰ってきたって、どこから！？」
「―――存じません。
ただ姉さんが屋敷の見回りをしていた時、志貴さまが外に出ていったところを見かけただけですから」
「外にって、俺が……？」
「はい。
わたしと姉さんは三時間ごとに屋敷の見回りを任されています。
昨日の深夜は姉さんの見回りで、その時に志貴さまがお屋敷を出ていくところを見たそうです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hisui. What did you just say?”
“That Master Shiki appeared unwell from early this morning.”
“Not that—the part before it! Where did I come back from?”
“―――I do not know. My sister only saw Master Shiki leaving the mansion during her rounds.”
“Leaving, me?”
“Yes. My sister and I inspect the mansion every three hours. Last night’s late round was hers, and she saw Master Shiki going outside.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hisui.
What did you just say?"
"That you were in poor condition since this morning."
"No, before that!
I came back?
Where from!?"
"---I do not know.
Nee-san told me she saw you leave while she was patrolling the mansion."
"…… I, left…?"
"Yes.
Nee-san and I patrol the mansion every three hours.
While Nee-san was doing the rounds at midnight last night, she saw you leaving the mansion."

entries.japanese:
「な―――」
「志貴さまも朝には戻られたようですから、姉さんも秋葉さまには報せておりません。
　……姉さんは志貴さまに甘いですから、きっと内密にしているのでしょう」
「―――――――」
　な―――なんだ、それ。
　俺が外に出ていっていたって？
　そんなハズないじゃないか。
俺はちゃんとここで眠っていて、夢だって見てる。
　あんな生々しい夢を―――みて、る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wha―――”
“Since Master Shiki returned by morning, my sister did not report it to Miss Akiha.
My sister is lenient with Master Shiki, so she must mean to keep it secret.”
“―――――――”
Wh―――what does that mean?
I went outside?
Impossible. I was asleep here and even had a dream.
I dreamed something so vivid―――so real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha…"
"Since it seems you were able to return before morning, Nee-san has not told Akiha-sama of this.
…… As Nee-san is indulgent of you, Shiki-sama, it will surely remain that way."
"-------"
Wha---what is, this?
I went outside?
That can't be.
I was sound asleep this whole time, having a dream.
Having such a… lively… drea… m.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――」
　けど、不思議だ。
　夢なんてものは目覚めた瞬間に忘れていくものなのに、どうして俺は、いつまでも夢の内容を明確に覚えていたりするんだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――”
But that is strange.
Dreams vanish when one wakes, so why can I still remember every detail so clearly―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
But, this is weird.
Dreams are forgotten the moment you wake up, so why do I still remember all the details of the dream so perfectly…

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――？
　やはりお顔の色が優れないようですが、いかがいたしましょう」
「……あ、ああ、大丈夫。
大丈夫だから、翡翠は先に行っていてくれ。
……大丈夫、すぐに行くから」
「かしこまりました。
それでは食堂でお待ちしております」
　ドアを閉めて、翡翠が退室していく。
「……そう、大丈夫だ。
……なにも問題なんかない。
俺は、大丈夫なんだから―――」
　自分に言い聞かせるように、そんな言葉を繰り返していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――? You still look unwell, so what would you like me to do?”
“I am fine. Go on ahead, Hisui. I will be down in a minute.”
“Very well. I shall await you in the dining room.”
Hisui closed the door behind her and left.
“Yes, I am fine. Nothing is wrong. I am fine―――”
I repeat the words as though trying to convince myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama…?
Your face still appears pale.
How are you feeling?"
"Ah, yeah, I'm fine.
I'm fine, so go ahead, Hisui… It's okay, I'll go right away."
"I understand.
I shall wait for you in the dining room."
Closing the door behind her, Hisui leaves the room.
"…… Yeah, I'm fine.
No problems at all.
I'm just, fine…"
I say it over and over again, trying to persuade myself.

entries.japanese:
食堂に行くためには、どうしても居間を通らないといけない。
　……気が重い。
正直、今は誰とも顔を合わせたくないっていうのに。
　翡翠や琥珀さん、それに―――秋葉に、普段どおり振る舞える自信がない。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no way to reach the dining room without passing through the sitting room.
The thought weighs on me. I honestly do not want to face anyone.
I have no confidence I can act normally around Hisui, Kohaku, or―――Akiha.
I――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
To get to the dining room, I have to pass through the sitting room.
…… It's depressing.
To be honest, I don't want to see anyone right now.
Hisui and Kohaku-san, and… and Akiha.
I'm not sure I can act normally.
I'll----

entries.japanese:
それでも、朝の挨拶ぐらいはしておかないと。
　こんな事で秋葉を避けるなんて、それこそ自分がどうかしてるって認めることになるじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Still, I have to at least say good morning.
Avoiding Akiha over this would amount to admitting there really is something wrong with me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Still, I have to at least say good morning.
Avoiding Akiha because of this little thing will be confirming something is wrong with me.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます、兄さん」
「あ―――」
　居間に入るなり、秋葉は笑顔で挨拶をしてきてくれた。
「……ああ。
おはよう秋葉」
「おはよう秋葉……って、どうしたんです兄さん？
　なんだかすごく元気がなさそうですけど」
「ちょっと夢見が悪かっただけだよ。
それにしても今日は上機嫌じゃないか。
なにかいいことでもあったのか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother.”
“Ah―――”
As soon as I enter the sitting room, Akiha welcomes me with a smile.
“Yeah. Morning, Akiha.”
“Good morning, Akiha… wait, what is wrong, Brother? You look utterly drained”
“Just a bad dream. You are in a fine mood today. Did something good happen?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Nii-san."
"Ah---"
As soon as I enter the sitting room, Akiha greets me with a smile.
"…… Ahh.
Morning, Akiha."
"'Morning, Akiha'…?
What's wrong, Nii-san?
You seem really depressed."
"I just had a bit of a bad dream.
But you seem to be in a good mood; did something nice happen?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ、ほんの少しだけ。
兄さんが早く起きてくれたから、今日はゆっくり登校できるでしょう？
　余裕のある朝が迎えられるんですから、機嫌だってよくなります」
「――――そう。
それはよかったな、秋葉」
　答えて、ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
　俺は。
　そんなふうに笑いかけてもらえるような人間じゃ、ないかもしれないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A little. Since you woke up early, Brother, we can take our time getting to school today, can’t we?
Anyone would be cheerful to have such a leisurely morning”
“――――I see. Good for you, Akiha”
I answer, and a sharp pain stabs my chest.
I…
I might not be the kind of person who deserves to have her smile at me like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, quite.
You got up early.
Perhaps we might be able to go to school leisurely today?
Having time in the morning always puts me in a good mood."
"----I see.
Well, I'm glad, Akiha."
As I answer, my chest hurts.
I…
I might not be a person that deserves to be smiled at like that.

entries.japanese:
「それなら先に行けよ。
俺を待ってると走るはめになるぞ」
「はい？
　なにか言いましたか、兄さん？」
「だから、余裕のある朝が好きなんだろ。
なら先に行けって言ったんだよ。
　俺に付き合ってると余裕なんかないし、こっちは秋葉に合わせるほど暇じゃないからな。
準備が出来てるならさっさと行ったほうがいい」
「え―――えっと、それはそうですけど、私は―――」
「それともなにか、一人じゃ学校に行けないっていうのか秋葉は。
やめてくれよな、子供じゃあるまいし。
いいかげんそんな歳でもないだろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then go on ahead. If you wait for me, you’ll only end up running.”
“Excuse me? Did you say something, Brother?”
“I said you like leisurely mornings. So go on ahead.
Waiting for me will not leave you any time to spare, and I am too busy to adjust my schedule to yours. If you are ready, just go.”
“I―――well, that is true, but I―――”
“Or what, can you not go to school by yourself? Give me a break, Akiha. You are far too old to act like a child”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You should go ahead, then.
You'll end up running if you wait for me."
"Hm?
Did you say something, Nii-san?"
"I mean, if you like free time in the mornings, you should just go ahead.
You don't really need to accompany me and I don't really have time to keep you company either.
If you're ready, you should just go on ahead."
"Eh… well, that's true, but I…"
"But what?
You're saying you can't go to school on your own?
Give me a break, you're not a child.
We're not that young anymore."

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　がたん、とソファーから立ちあがる秋葉。
「兄さん。
それは、本気で言っているんですか」
「……別に。
ただそう思っただけだよ」
　ぎり、という音。
　秋葉はうつむいたまま、わなわなと肩を震わせている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Akiha rises from the sofa with a clatter.
“Brother. Do you truly mean that?”
“Nothing. I only said what I thought.”
A sharp grinding sound.
Akiha keeps her head bowed, her shoulders trembling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Akiha stands up from the sofa.
"Nii-san.
Were you serious about what you just said?"
"…… Not really.
It's just what I thought."
Her teeth grit.
Akiha looks down, her shoulders shaking.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
本当にそろそろ行かないと遅刻するぞ」
「ええ、わかってます！
　私だって兄さんに付き合って遅刻なんかしたくありませんからっ！」
「だろ。
じゃあ先に行ってろよ。
……あんまり人の相手をできる状態じゃないんだ、俺」
「――――っ」
　秋葉は早足で出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. You really will be late if you do not leave soon”
“Yes, I know! I have no desire to be late because I waited for you, Brother!”
“Right. Then go on ahead. I am not in any state to deal with anyone right now”
“—!”
Akiha strides out of the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
You'll be late if you don't go soon."
"Yeah, I know!
After all, I don't want to go with you and be late!"
"Right.
So go on…… I'm not in the mood to be with anyone right now."
"----"
Akiha rushes out.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……何してるんだ、俺は。
こんなつもりじゃなかったのに、どうして――――　
「志貴さん、いまのはひどいです！」
「―――琥珀、さん？」
「もうっ、わたし志貴さんのこと見損ないましたっ！
　どうして秋葉さまにあんなコト言ったんですか！？」
「……わかってるよ。
俺だって、あんなふうに秋葉をつっぱねるつもりなんか、なかったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
What am I doing? This was never supposed to happen, so why――――
“Master Shiki, that was awful!”
“―――Kohaku?”
“Honestly, Master Shiki, I am ashamed of you! Why would you say something so cruel to Miss Akiha?”
“I know. I never meant to push Akiha away like that”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… What am I doing?
I didn't mean to say that, so why----
"Shiki-san, that was horrible!"
"---Kohaku-san?"
"Oh, I completely misjudged you!
Why did you say such things to Akiha-sama!?"
"…… I know.
Even I didn't plan on turning her down."

entries.japanese:
「いえ、ぜんぜんわかってませんっ！
　志貴さんは秋葉さまがどんな思いで今まで待っていたか知らないんですっ」
「？
―――待ってたって、今日の朝のこと？」
「そんなんじゃないですっ。
秋葉さまには黙っているように言われてましたけど、もうがまんできませんっ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you do not understand at all! Master Shiki, you have no idea how Miss Akiha has felt, waiting all this time!”
“Waiting? You mean this morning?”
“Nothing of the sort! Miss Akiha told me never to mention it, but I simply cannot keep quiet any longer!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, you do not understand anything!
You don't know how much Akiha-sama was looking forward to this while waiting for you up until now."
"?
---Waiting for me… you mean this morning?"
"No.
Akiha-sama told me not to tell you, but I can't bear this anymore!"

entries.japanese:
「いいですか、志貴さん。
今でこそ秋葉さまは志貴さんと同じように朝食をとっていますけど、転校する前はタイヘンだったんですよ。
　志貴さん、秋葉さまの行っていた学校がどこにあるか知っていますか？」
　……秋葉の行っていた女学院は、たしかとなりの県にあったと思ったけど。
「―――となりの、県……？」
　ちょっと待った。
　それって、距離的に車で一時間以上かかるんじゃないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen carefully, Master Shiki. Miss Akiha can have breakfast with you now, but before she transferred schools it was an enormous ordeal.
Master Shiki, do you even know where Miss Akiha’s old school was?”
Akiha’s girls’ academy was in the next prefecture, if I remembered right.
“―――The next prefecture…?”
Wait a second.
Would that not be more than an hour away by car?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Listen, Shiki-san.
Now, Akiha-sama eats breakfast with you normally, but it was a real hassle before she transferred."
…… I think the ladies' academy Akiha used to go to was in the next prefecture.
"-----Next prefecture……?"
Hold on.
That's more than an hour's worth of driving.

entries.japanese:
「やっと気がついてくれましたね。
　そもそも秋葉さまは朝の六時にここを出ないと学校には間に合わない方だったんです。
なのに秋葉さまは無理をして、志貴さんと朝ごはんを食べるのを楽しみにしていたんです」
「……楽しみにしてたって、どうして。
だってあいつ、俺の顔をみるたびに文句を言ってたじゃないか」
「ですから、秋葉さまは素直じゃないんです。
志貴さんが一度でもちゃんと早起きしてくれたなら秋葉さまも文句なんて言わなかったと思います」
entries.maoEnglish:
“At last, you understand”
“Miss Akiha had to leave this house by six every morning to reach school on time. Even so, Miss Akiha went to all that trouble because she looked forward to eating breakfast with Master Shiki”
“Why would she look forward to it? She complained every time she saw me”
“Because Miss Akiha cannot be honest about things like this. If you had gotten up on time even once, I doubt Miss Akiha would have complained”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You finally noticed.
To begin with, Akiha-sama would not have made it to school unless she left here at six.
Nevertheless, she overlooked that because she was looking forward to eating breakfast with you."
"…… Looking forward to?
Why?
She complains every time she sees me."
"Because Akiha-sama isn't honest.
If you ever woke up on time, I do not think she would have any complaints."

entries.japanese:
「なのに志貴さんったら寝坊してばっかりで、一度も朝をご一緒してくださらなかった。
秋葉さまは『朝に兄さんの顔を見れればいい』なんて言って、志貴さんを起こすようなコトはしなかったんです」
「な――――――」
「―――これで少しはわかってくれました？
　なら、せめて秋葉さまにさっきの事ぐらい謝ってあげてくださいね」
「――――――」
　…………それは、初めからそのつもりだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But Master Shiki, you overslept every morning and never once joined her. Miss Akiha would say, ‘It is enough if I see Brother’s face in the morning,’ and refused to let us wake you.” “Wh――――――”
“Do you understand a little better now? Then please, at the very least, apologize to Miss Akiha for what you just said.”
“――――――”
I had meant to do that from the beginning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But all you did was sleep in and didn't eat with her even once.
But Akiha-sama told me just seeing your face in the morning is good enough, and she never told us to go wake you up."
"---Now do you understand?
If you do, can you please apologize to Akiha-sama about earlier?"
"------"
………… I was going to do that already, but…

entries.japanese:
「……わからないな。
琥珀さんは、俺にどうしろっていうんだよ」
「いえいえ、難しく考えないでくださいな。
　志貴さんは今までどおりでいいんですよ。
ただ秋葉さまは素直じゃありませんから、少しぐらいは志貴さんに気を遣ってほしかっただけなんです」
「……………」
　今までどおりって、それが一番難しいと思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand. What exactly do you want me to do, Kohaku?”
“Oh, do not make it so complicated”
“Master Shiki, you can carry on exactly as before. Miss Akiha merely has trouble being honest, and I only wanted Master Shiki to show her a little consideration”
“……………”
Carrying on as before sounded like the hardest thing she could have asked of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't get it.
What do you want me to do, Kohaku-san?"
"No, don't think too hard about it.
You just act normally.
But Akiha-sama isn't direct, so I just wanted you to be more considerate of her."
"…………"
Act normally?
I think that's the most difficult thing for me to do right now.

entries.japanese:
「あ、それとこのお話はないしょですからね。
わたしがお話ししたことがばれたら、秋葉さまに叱られちゃいますから」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のまま食堂に移動していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, and this conversation is our secret. If Miss Akiha learns I told you, I’ll be in dreadful trouble.”
Still smiling, Kohaku heads into the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, and all this is a secret.
If Akiha-sama finds out I told you this, I will get in trouble."
Kohaku-san heads into the dining room with a smile on her face.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
「ほら志貴さん、早く食べないと本当に遅刻してしまいますよー」
　食堂から琥珀さんの声が聞こえてくる。
　ボッと赤くなっている顔を手で隠しながら、食堂に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……………”
“Come along, Master Shiki—if you do not eat soon, you really will be late”
Kohaku’s voice carries from the dining room.
Hiding my burning face behind one hand, I follow her inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
"Come on, Shiki-san; if you don't hurry up and eat, you'll really be late…"
I can hear Kohaku-san's voice from the dining room.
I head into the dining room, hiding my embarrassed face with my hand.

entries.japanese:
時間ぎりぎりに校門に到着した。
　屋敷から走ってきて、結局遅刻は免れた。
――――と。
　ぽん、と後ろから肩を叩かれた。
「おはようございます。
今日は時間ぎりぎりなんですね、遠野くん」
「………先輩」
「それに秋葉さんも一緒じゃなさそうですし。
今日は寝過ごしちゃったんですか？」
「……ん、そんなところ。
つまんない事で秋葉とケンカらしきものをしちまったんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
I reach the school gates with no time to spare.
After running all the way from the mansion, I somehow escape being late.
――――And then.
Someone taps me on the shoulder from behind.
“Good morning. Cutting it close today, are you not, Tohno?”
“…Ciel”
“And Akiha is not with you. Did you sleep in?”
“Something like that. Akiha and I had what you might call an argument over something stupid”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I arrive at the school gates just in time.
Running all the way, I somehow escape being late.
----Then,
I'm patted on the shoulder from behind.
"Good morning.
Just made it today, huh Tohno-kun?"
"…… Senpai."
"And it seems you're not with Akiha-san.
Perhaps you overslept today?"
"…… Uh, something like that.
I had a bit of a fight with Akiha."

entries.japanese:
「はあ、ダメですよ兄妹でケンカなんかしちゃ。
遠野くんはお兄さんなんですから、あとで謝りに行かないと」
「……そうだね。
同じ学校なんだし、昼休み前には謝りにいくよ。
もとから一方的に俺が悪かったんだし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You must not quarrel with your sister. You are the older brother, so make sure you apologize later.”
“You are right. We go to the same school, so I will apologize before lunch. It was entirely my fault to begin with”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, it's no good for siblings to fight.
Tohno-kun, you're the older brother, so you should go and apologize later."
"…… You're right.
We're in the same school, so I should go and apologize before lunchtime.
On top of that, it was my fault to begin with."

entries.japanese:
はあ、とため息をつく。
　たしかに秋葉のことも大事だけど、今は自分の事をどうにかしないと。
　昨日の夢。
　俺は眠っていたつもりなのに、夜に出かけていたっていう自分。
entries.maoEnglish:
I sigh.
Akiha matters, of course, but right now I have to deal with myself.
Yesterday’s dream.
I thought I was asleep, yet somehow I had gone out into the night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I sigh.
Certainly my problems with Akiha are important, but I should worry about my own troubles for now.
Last night's dream.
Even though I knew I was asleep, I seemed to have wandered out at night.

entries.japanese:
「……遠野くん？
　どうしました、そんなにうかない顔をして。
なにか悩み事でもあるんですか？」
　じっ、と心配そうに先輩は見つめてくる。
　心配してもらえるのは嬉しいけど、こればっかりは先輩に頼るわけにはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? What is wrong—you look so glum. Is something troubling you?”
Ciel studies my face with concern.
I am grateful she is worried, but this is one problem I cannot ask her to solve.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Tohno-kun?
What's wrong?
Are you worried about something?"
Senpai stares at me with concern.
I'm grateful for her concern, but I can't rely on her for this.

entries.japanese:
「え―――ああ、ちょっと悩んでる。
けど自分だけの問題だからさ、一人でなんとかするよ。
……どうも、心配してくれてありがとう先輩」
「……そうですか。
けど一人でなんとかできなくなったら、いつでも相談してくださいね。
わたしでよかったら力になりますよ」
「ああ、ホントに困ったら先輩に相談するよ」
　……と、話しているうちに朝の予鈴が鳴り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Uh―――yeah, something is bothering me. But it is my problem, so I will handle it myself. Thanks for worrying about me, Ciel”
“I see. But if it ever becomes too much to handle alone, please come talk to me. I will help however I can”
“If I am truly stuck, I promise I will come to you”
As we talk, the warning bell begins to ring.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh?
…… Ah, just a bit.
But it's my problem, so I'll work it out.
Thanks for worrying, Senpai."
"…… Really.
Well, if it's something you can't solve on your own, I'm always here to help.
I'd be happy to do whatever I can."
"Yeah, if I'm in real trouble, I'll ask you, then."
…… As I speak, the morning bell begins to ring.

entries.japanese:
「―――まずい。
それじゃ先輩、また後で！」
「はい。
またお昼にお邪魔しますね」
　予鈴が鳴っているのにのんびりと構えている先輩をおいて、昇降口へ駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Damn. See you later, Ciel!”
“Of course. I’ll come bother you again at lunch.”
Leaving Ciel unhurried even as the warning bell rings, I sprint for the student entrance.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ack!
Well, Senpai, later!"
"Yep.
I'll see you at lunch."
Leaving Senpai standing leisurely as the first bell rings, I rush in the doorway.

entries.japanese:
二時限目の授業が終わった。
　……秋葉に朝のことを謝りに行くとしたら今がちょうどいいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Second period ends.
If I am going to apologize to Akiha for this morning, now is the perfect time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Second period ends.
…… If I'm going to go apologize to Akiha about this morning, now would be the right time.

entries.japanese:
……いったん部屋に戻ろう。
　このまま居間に入っていっても、おそらく秋葉の顔さえ見られない。
そんな事で秋葉に不審がられるよりは、秋葉が学校に行くまで部屋に引きこもっていたほうがいくらかましだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I should go back to my room for now.
If I walk into the sitting room like this, I probably cannot even look Akiha in the face. Better to hide upstairs until she leaves for school than let her see me acting strangely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Let's go back to my room for now.
I don't think I would even be able to look at Akiha if I went into the sitting room now.
I don't want to look suspicious.
It would be better if I stay in my room until Akiha leaves.

entries.japanese:
………。
　……………。
　……………………。
　……………………………。
　…………………………………七時半を過ぎた。
　窓から玄関の様子を見ると、秋葉が一人で屋敷を出て行くところだった。
「…………」
　はあ、と重苦しいため息がもれる。
　秋葉には悪いけど、今は自分の事をどうにかしないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
………
……………
……………………
……………………………
………………………………… It is past seven thirty
Looking down at the entrance from my window, I see Akiha leaving the mansion alone.
“…………”
A heavy sigh escapes me.
I feel terrible for her, but right now I have to deal with myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
………
……………
……………………
……………………………
………………………………… It's past seven thirty now.
I look out the window and see Akiha leaving.
"…………"
Phew.
I let out a deep sigh.
I feel bad for Akiha, but I should worry about my own troubles for now.

entries.japanese:
昨日の夢。
　俺は眠っていたつもりなのに、夜に出かけていたっていう自分。
　その問題だけで今は手いっぱいで、秋葉に『普段通りの自分』を演じる気力はない。
「…………くっ」
　自己嫌悪に押されるように、自分の部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yesterday’s dream.
I thought I was asleep, yet somehow I had gone out into the night.
That problem alone is all I can handle; I have no strength left to play my usual self for Akiha.
“Damn…”
Driven on by self-disgust, I leave my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yesterday's dream.
Even though I knew I was asleep, I seemed to have wandered out at night.
With my hands full of this problem, I don't have the energy to act out my "usual self".
"………… Shit."
I leave my room as if I was pushed by my self-hatred.

entries.japanese:
居間には誰もいない。
　テーブルにはぽつん、と一つだけティーカップが残されている。
おそらく、さっきまで秋葉が使っていたものだろう。
「――――――」
　秋葉に対する後ろめたさのせいか、無言で居間に入っていく。
――――――と。
「志貴さん！」
　いきなり、台所からやってきた琥珀さんに怒鳴られた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sitting room is empty.
A single teacup sits forlornly on the table. It is probably the one Akiha was using moments ago.
“――――――”
Burdened by guilt toward Akiha, I enter without a word.
――――――And then.
“Master Shiki!”
Kohaku comes out of the kitchen and immediately shouts at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No one is in the sitting room.
There is one teacup on the table.
Probably the one Akiha was using until just now.
"------------"
I enter the sitting room quietly, probably because I feel guilty about Akiha.
------------And.
"Shiki-san!!"
Suddenly, Kohaku-san comes out of the kitchen, scolding me.

entries.japanese:
「あ……琥珀さん、おはよう」
「おはよう、じゃありませんっ！
　いったい何時だと思っているんですか、志貴さんは！」
　琥珀さんは本気で怒っているのか、すごい剣幕でつめよってくる。
「……すみません。
今朝はちょっと寝起きが悪かったもんで、遅刻しちゃってもいいかなって」
「もうっ、学校のお話をしているんじゃありません！
　 どうして居間にきて秋葉さまに一言なりともお声をかけてさしあげなかったのかを聞いているんです！」
　むーっ、と琥珀さんは眉をよせる。
「それは……その、今朝はなんとなく秋葉とは顔をあわせづらかったっていうか、その―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning, Kohaku”
“Do not ‘good morning’ me! What time do you think it is, Master Shiki?”
Whether she is genuinely furious or not, Kohaku bears down on me like a storm.
“Sorry. I woke up feeling awful and thought I might as well be late”
“I am not talking about school! I am asking why you did not come down and say so much as one word to Miss Akiha!”
Kohaku knits her brows into an indignant scowl.
“Well―――I just did not feel able to face Akiha this morning, and―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh…… good morning, Kohaku-san."
"It's not 'good morning'!
What time do you think it is, Shiki-san!!"
Kohaku-san might be really mad, as she unleashes quite the scary attitude.
"…… I'm sorry.
I couldn't wake up this morning so I decided it didn't matter if I'm late for school or not."
"Geez, I'm not talking about school!!
I'm asking you why you didn't show up and talk to Akiha-sama for just a little while!!"
Kohaku-san draws her eyebrows together.
"Well…… Um, I kinda felt like it was hard for me to face Akiha this morning, um-----"

entries.japanese:
「なんとなくってなんですか！
　秋葉さまはさっきまでずっと待っていたんですよ？
　なのに秋葉さまに一言も声をかけず、秋葉さまが登校なされてからやってくるなんてひどいです！」
「……う」
　……琥珀さんの言葉には反論ができない。
　俺自身、秋葉を避けたことに後ろめたさがあったからだ。
「……それは、わかってる。
けど秋葉が嫌いっていうわけじゃないんだ。
ただ今朝は本当に……いつも通りに話せる気分じゃなかったんだよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you mean, you just did not feel able? Miss Akiha waited until the last possible moment! You never said a word to Miss Akiha, then came down only after Miss Akiha had left”
“Ugh…”
There is no answering her.
I already feel guilty about avoiding Akiha.
“I know. It is not because I hate her. I simply could not face talking to her as if everything were normal this morning”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Felt like it!?
Akiha-sama was waiting for you all this time!!
But you don't say a word to her and show up after she leaves?
That's terrible!"
"…… Ugh."
…… I can't counter that.
It's because I do feel guilty for avoiding Akiha.
"…… I understand.
But it's not like I dislike Akiha.
But this morning… I really didn't feel like I could talk to her."

entries.japanese:
「いえ、ぜんぜんわかってませんっ！
　志貴さんは秋葉さまがどんな思いで今日まで待っていたか知らないんですっ」
「え――今まで待ってたって、今日の朝のこと？」
「そんなんじゃないですっ。
秋葉さまには黙っているように言われてましたけど、もうがまんできませんっ」
「いいですか、志貴さん。
今でこそ秋葉さまは志貴さんと同じように朝食をとっていますけど、転校する前はタイヘンだったんですよ。
　志貴さん、秋葉さまの行っていた学校がどこにあるか知っていますか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you do not understand at all! Master Shiki, you have no idea how Miss Akiha has felt, waiting all these years!”
“What do you mean, all this time—you mean this morning?”
“Nothing of the sort! Miss Akiha told me never to mention it, but I simply cannot keep quiet any longer!”
“Listen carefully, Master Shiki. Miss Akiha can have breakfast with you now, but before she transferred schools it was an enormous ordeal.
Master Shiki, do you even know where Miss Akiha’s old school was?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, you do not understand anything!
You don't know how much Akiha-sama was looking forward to this while waiting for you up until now."
"What---Waiting for me, you mean this morning?"
"No.
Akiha-sama told me not to tell you, but I can't bear this anymore!"
"Listen, Shiki-san.
Now, Akiha-sama eats breakfast with you normally, but it was a real hassle before she transferred."
Shiki-san, do you remember where her old school was?"

entries.japanese:
……秋葉の行っていた女学院は、たしか隣の県にあったと思ったけど。
「―――となりの、県……？」
　ちょっと待った。
　それって、距離的に車で一時間以上かかるんじゃないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s girls’ academy was in the next prefecture, if I remembered right.
“―――The next prefecture…?”
Wait a second.
Wouldn’t that be more than an hour away by car?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I think the ladies' academy Akiha used to go to was in the next prefecture.
"-----Next prefecture……?"
Hold on.
That's more than an hour's worth of driving.

entries.japanese:
「やっと気がついてくれましたね。
　そもそも秋葉さまは朝の六時にここを出ないと学校には間に合わない方だったんです。
なのに秋葉さまは無理をして、志貴さんと朝ごはんを食べるのを楽しみにしていたんです」
「……楽しみにしてたって、どうして。
だってあいつ、俺の顔をみるたびに文句を言ってたじゃないか」
「ですから、秋葉さまは素直じゃないんです。
志貴さんが一度でもちゃんと早起きしてくれたなら秋葉さまも文句なんて言わなかったと思います」
entries.maoEnglish:
“At last, you understand”
“Miss Akiha had to leave this house by six every morning to reach school on time. Even so, Miss Akiha went to all that trouble because she looked forward to eating breakfast with Master Shiki”
“Why would she look forward to it? She complained every time she saw me”
“Because Miss Akiha cannot be honest about things like this. If you had gotten up on time even once, I doubt Miss Akiha would have complained”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You finally noticed.
To begin with, Akiha-sama would not have made it to school unless she left here at six.
Nevertheless, she overlooked that because she was looking forward to eating breakfast with you."
"…… Looking forward to?
Why?
She complains every time she sees me."
"Because Akiha-sama isn't honest.
If you ever woke up on time, I do not think she would have any complaints."

entries.japanese:
「なのに志貴さんったら寝坊してばっかりで、一度も朝をご一緒してくださらなかった。
　秋葉さまは『朝に兄さんの顔を見れればいい』なんて言って、志貴さんを起こすようなコトはしなかったんです」
「な――――――」
「これで少しは分かっていただけました？
　なら、せめて秋葉さまにさっきの事ぐらい謝ってあげてくださいね」
「――――――」
　…………それは、初めからそのつもりだけど。
　こんな、こんな話をされても困る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But Master Shiki, you overslept every morning and never once joined her.
Miss Akiha would say, ‘It is enough if I see Brother’s face in the morning,’ and refused to let us wake you”
“Wh――――――”
“Do you understand a little better now? Then please, at the very least, apologize to Miss Akiha for this morning.”
“――――――”
I had meant to do that from the beginning.
But I do not know what I am supposed to do with a story like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But all you did was sleep in and didn't eat with her even once.
But Akiha-sama told me just seeing your face in the morning is good enough, and she never told us to go wake you up."
"Wha--------"
"Now do you understand?
If you do, can you please apologize to Akiha-sama about earlier?"
"------------"
………… I was going to do that already, but…
Such, such a talk doesn't help me out.

entries.japanese:
「……解らないな。
琥珀さんは、俺にどうしろっていうんだよ」
「いえいえ、難しく考えないでくださいな。
　志貴さんは今までどおりでいいんですよ。
ただ秋葉さまは素直じゃありませんから、少しぐらいは志貴さんに気を遣ってほしかっただけなんです」
「……………」
　今までどおりって、それが一番難しいと思うんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand. What exactly do you want me to do, Kohaku?”
“Oh, do not make it so complicated”
“Master Shiki, you can carry on exactly as before. Miss Akiha merely has trouble being honest, and I only wanted Master Shiki to show her a little consideration”
“……………”
Carrying on as before sounded like the hardest thing she could have asked of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't get it.
What do you want me to do, Kohaku-san?"
"No, don't think too hard about it.
You just act normally.
But Akiha-sama isn't direct, so I just wanted you to be more considerate of her."
"……………"
Act normally?
I think that's the most difficult thing for me to do right now.

entries.japanese:
「あ、それとこのお話はないしょですからね。
わたしがお話ししたことがばれたら、秋葉さまに叱られちゃいますから」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のまま食堂に移動していく。
「……………」
「志貴さん、朝食の支度が出来ていますから、どうぞいらっしゃってください」
　食堂から琥珀さんの声が聞こえてくる。
　ボッと赤くなっている顔を手で隠しながら、食堂に向かっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, and this conversation is our secret. If Miss Akiha learns I told you, I’ll be in dreadful trouble.”
Still smiling, Kohaku heads into the dining room.
“……………”
“Master Shiki, breakfast is ready, so please come in”
Her voice carries back to me.
Hiding my burning face behind one hand, I follow her into the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, and all this is a secret.
If Akiha-sama finds out I told you this, I will get in trouble."
Kohaku-san heads into the dining room with a smile on her face.
"……………"
"Shiki-san, your breakfast is ready, so please come eat."
I can hear Kohaku-san's voice from the dining room.
I head into the dining room, hiding my embarrassed face with my hand.

entries.japanese:
―――――結局、学校には遅刻した。
　校門には生徒の姿はまったくない。
　一時限目が中頃にさしかかっている時間帯に、一人で校門をくぐっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――In the end, I was late for school.
The school gates are utterly deserted.
I pass through them alone with first period already halfway over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----I ended up being late for school.
The entrance to the school is empty.
I walk through the school's gate during first period.

entries.japanese:
二時限目の授業が終わった。
　……秋葉に朝のことを謝りに行くとしたら今がちょうどいいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Second period ends.
If I am going to apologize to Akiha for this morning, now is the perfect time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's the end of second period.
…… If I'm going to go apologize to Akiha about this morning, now would be the right time.

entries.japanese:
……四階に上がってきた。
　秋葉の教室は一年一組。
廊下に出てきた生徒に声をかけて、秋葉を呼びつけてもらう。
「遠野さーん、お兄さんが来たよー！」
　……偶然呼びとめた女の子は、とても解りやすい方法で秋葉を呼んでくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I go up to the fourth floor.
Akiha is in Class 1-1. I stop a girl in the hall and ask her to call Akiha out.
“Tohno, your brother is here!”
By chance, I chose a girl with a wonderfully direct approach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go up to the fourth floor.
Akiha's class is first year, class one.
I speak to a student leaving the classroom, and ask her to call Akiha.
"Tohno-saaan, your brother's here!"
…… The girl I stopped calls out to Akiha quite directly.

entries.japanese:
「なにかご用ですか、兄さん」
　秋葉はむっとした顔をして出てきた。
「―――――――」
　さて、困った。
　琥珀さんは謝れって言ってたけど、あんな話を聞いたあとだとヘンに意識してしまって、困る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did you want something, Brother?”
Akiha emerges wearing a sullen expression.
“―――――――”
This is awkward.
Kohaku told me to apologize, but after hearing that story, I cannot help feeling painfully self-conscious around Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you need something, Nii-san?"
Akiha comes out with a sullen expression.
"-------"
Well, this is troubling.
Kohaku-san told me to apologize, but after hearing her story, it's a little troubling.

entries.japanese:
「用件がないんでしたら、教室に戻らせてもらいますね」
「―――いや、用件はあるんだ。
その、なんて言うか…………」
「なんて言うか、なんです？
　休み時間は短いんですから、言いたい事があるんなら早く言ってください」
「……いや、それがな……」
―――って、ええい！
　ここまできて恥ずかしがってる場合じゃないっ！
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you have no business with me, I will return to class.”
“―――No, I do. I am not sure how to say it.”
“What do you mean, ‘I am not sure how to say it’? Break is short, so if you have something to say, say it quickly.”
“Well, the thing is.”
―――Damn it! I hadn’t come all this way to lose my nerve now!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you don't need anything, I'll go back to my classroom."
"---No, there's something.
It's… well, I mean…"
"What is it, already?
The break time is short, so if you want to say something then please hurry and say it."
"…… Well, it's just…"
---Alright already!
I've come this far, so I can't be shy about it!

entries.japanese:
「その、朝のことはごめんな……！」
「え―――に、兄さん……？」
「だから、今朝は俺が悪かったって言いに来たんだ！
　ちゃんと、明日からちゃんとするから、今日のことは許してくれないか秋葉―――！」
「べ……べつに許すもなにも、私はそんなコト気にしてなんか―――」
「いいんだ、とにかく謝りたかっただけなんだからっ。
それじゃあな、手間とらせて悪かった！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry about this morning…!”
“Wh―――Brother?”
“I came to tell you I was wrong this morning! I will get my act together tomorrow, so forgive me for today, Akiha―――!”
“There is nothing to forgive; I did not even care about―――”
“That is fine, I only wanted to apologize! Sorry I took your time; see you!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm… I'm sorry about this morning…!"
"Eh?
---Ni, nii-san…?"
"I came to say that this morning was my fault, and that from tomorrow on I'll be good, so please forgive me, Akiha…!"
"It's… there's not much to forgive, it didn't really bother me…"
"That's fine, I just wanted to apologize.
I'll see you later, sorry for taking your time!"

entries.japanese:
「―――あ、ちょっと兄さん！」
　背中に秋葉の声がかかる。
　けどいまさら立ち止まるのも振りかえるのも恥ずかしくて、そのまま自分の教室目指して走りぬけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Wait, Brother!”
Akiha called after me, but by then I was too embarrassed to stop or even look back.
I ran all the way to my own classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ah, wait, Nii-san!"
Akiha calls after me.
But right now I'm too embarrassed to even look back, so I run straight back to my own classroom.

entries.japanese:
……昼休みになった。
　秋葉に謝りに行く、なんてことをしたばっかりであいつと昼食を一緒にするのは余計照れくさい。
　だが。
「おう、遠野。
早く中庭に行こうぜ、秋葉ちゃんが待ってるぞ」
　……なんていう男もいるし、秋葉を一人にしてはおけない。
「……………はあ」
　重いため息をついて、有彦と教室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunch break arrives.
Having just apologized to Akiha makes eating with her even more embarrassing.
But.
“Hey, Tohno. Come on, let us get to the courtyard; Akiha is waiting.”
With a man like that around, I can hardly leave her there alone.
“Sigh…”
I let out a heavy breath and leave the classroom with Arihiko.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It's lunchtime.
Since I just went and apologized to Akiha, it feels kind of awkward to have lunch with her.
However.
"Yo, Tohno.
Let's hurry up and go to the courtyard.
Akiha-chan is waiting."
…… Says one guy.
Besides, I can't leave her by herself.
…………… *sigh*
I let out a big sigh and leave the classroom with Arihiko.

entries.japanese:
秋葉はまだ来ていない。
　どうせシエル先輩も来るんだから、今日はベンチより芝生に陣取るとしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha had not arrived yet.
Since Ciel would be joining us anyway, we decided to claim a patch of lawn instead of a bench.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha isn't here yet.
Since Ciel-senpai will be coming too, I guess we'll eat on the grass instead of on the bench.

entries.japanese:
「お邪魔しまーす。
って、秋葉さんはまだ来てないんですね」
「そうッスね、そろそろ来てもいいころだと思うんだけど―――おい遠野、おまえ秋葉ちゃんとなんかあったのか？」
　ごつん、と人の横腹を肘でつついてくる有彦。
　……こいつはどうしてこう、どうでもいい時に勘が働くんだろう。
「あ、来た来た。
秋葉ちゃん、こっちー！」
　ぶんぶん、と手を振る有彦。
　秋葉は戸惑いながら芝生を踏みしめてやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mind if I join you? Oh, Akiha isn’t here yet.”
“Yeah, she ought to be here any minute―――hey, Tohno, did something happen between you and Akiha?”
Arihiko drove an elbow into my ribs.
Why did his intuition only work at the most useless times?
“There she is. Akiha, over here!”
He waved both arms wildly.
Looking uncertain, Akiha crossed the lawn toward us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm here.
Hey, Akiha-san isn't here yet?"
"Yeah, she should be here any minute now----hey, Tohno, did something happen between you and Akiha-chan?"
Arihiko asks, elbowing me in the side.
…… Why is he so perceptive all of a sudden?
"Ah, there she is.
Akiha-chan, over here!"
Arihiko waves his hands around.
Akiha comes onto the grass looking a bit puzzled.

entries.japanese:
「すみません、遅れてしまいました。
クラスの子たちの誘いを受けてしまって、断るのに時間がかかってしまって」
「いいっていいって、俺たちも来たばっかりだからさ。
ほら、ここに座って座って」
　ばんばん、と芝生を叩く有彦。
　秋葉は少しだけためらったあと、俺のとなりに腰を下ろした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry I’m late. Some girls in my class invited me to eat with them, and it took a while to decline.”
“No problem, we only just arrived. Come sit here.”
Arihiko slapped the grass beside him.
After a moment’s hesitation, Akiha sat down next to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm sorry I'm late.
I received an invitation to have lunch with my classmates, and it took some time to decline their invitations."
"Don't worry, we just got here too.
Here, sit here."
Arihiko pats the grass.
After hesitating for a moment, Akiha sits down next to me.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
「―――――――」
　俺もなんて言っていいのか解らず、つい黙ってしまう。
「どうしたんですか二人とも。
せっかくのお昼ごはんなのに黙っちゃって、ヘンですよ」
「う――――――」
　それはわかってるんだけど、何て言っていいものか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“………………….”
Akiha says nothing.
“―――――――”
I do not know what to say either, so I fall silent.
“What is wrong with you two? Sitting there in silence over lunch is strange.”
“U――――――”
I know that, but have no idea what to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
Akiha says nothing.
"-------"
Not knowing what to say, I remain silent.
"What is it, you two?
It's weird to eat lunch like this in silence."
"Uh-----"
I know that, I just don't know what to say.

entries.japanese:
……けど、今更こっちから謝りにいくなんて大袈裟すぎるかもしれない。
　琥珀さんは『内緒にしてくださいね』とか言っていたし、あの秋葉のことだから面と向かって『今までごめん』なんて言ったら、逆に怒鳴りつけられそうな気がする。
「……そうだな。
とりあえず昼休みまで様子を見るか」
　なんとなく落ち着かない気分のまま、教室に残って次の授業の準備をした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Going to apologize now might make far too much of it.
Kohaku asked me to keep it secret, and knowing Akiha, if I faced her and apologized for everything, she might only yell at me.
“Right. Maybe I should wait and see until lunch.”
Still vaguely restless, I remain in the classroom and prepare for the next lesson.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… But I might be overreacting if I go apologize to her.
Kohaku-san told me to keep that conversation a secret.
Besides, considering Akiha, if I apologize to her like "I'm sorry for everything", I can see her getting mad at me.
"…… Yeah, I guess I'll wait until lunchtime."
I stay in the classroom and get ready for the next period, still feeling a bit unsettled.

entries.japanese:
昼休みになった。
　暗黙の了解というか、今日も中庭に行けば秋葉と昼食をとる事になるだろう。
「……はあ」
　ただ、今日は少しだけ気が重い。
　今朝の事を謝ろうとは思っているけど、なんて謝っていいのか皆目見当がつかない。
「おう、遠野。
早く中庭に行こうぜ、秋葉ちゃんが待ってるぞ」
　……なんていう男もいるし、秋葉を一人にしてはおけない。
「……………はあ」
　重いため息をついて、有彦と教室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Lunch break arrived.
By unspoken agreement, if I went to the courtyard today, I would end up eating with Akiha again.
I sighed.
Today, the prospect weighed on me a little.
I meant to apologize for this morning, but I had no idea how.
“Hey, Tohno. Come on, let us get to the courtyard; Akiha is waiting.”
With a man like that around, I can hardly leave her there alone.
“Sigh…”
I let out a heavy breath and leave the classroom with Arihiko.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's lunchtime.
It's like an unspoken agreement, but if I go out to the courtyard, I will end up having lunch with Akiha.
…… *sigh*
But it's a bit depressing today.
I want to apologize about this morning, but I don't have any idea how I can apologize.
"Yo, Tohno.
Let's hurry up and go to the courtyard.
Akiha-chan is waiting."
…… Says one guy.
Besides, I can't leave her by herself.
…………… *sigh*
I let out a big sigh and leave the classroom with Arihiko.

entries.japanese:
秋葉はまだ来ていない。
　どうせシエル先輩も来るんだから、今日はベンチより芝生に陣取るとしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha had not arrived yet.
Since Ciel would be joining us anyway, we decided to claim a patch of lawn instead of a bench.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha isn't here yet.
Since Ciel-senpai will be coming too, I guess we'll eat on the grass instead of on the bench.

entries.japanese:
「お邪魔しまーす。
って、秋葉さんはまだ来てないんですね」
「そうッスね、そろそろ来てもいいころだと思うんだけど―――お、来た来た。
秋葉ちゃん、こっちー！」
　ぶんぶん、と手を振る有彦。
　秋葉は戸惑いながら芝生を踏みしめてやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mind if I join you? Oh, Akiha isn’t here yet.”
“Yeah, she ought to be here any minute―――oh, there she is. Akiha, over here!”
Arihiko waves both arms wildly.
Looking uncertain, Akiha crosses the lawn toward us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm here.
Hey, Akiha-san isn't here yet?"
"Yeah, she should be here any minute now----Oh, there she is.
Akiha-chan, over here!!"
Arihiko waves his hands around hard.
Looking a bit puzzled, Akiha comes onto the grass.

entries.japanese:
「すみません、遅れてしまいました。
クラスの子たちの誘いを受けてしまって、断るのに時間がかかってしまって」
「いいっていいって、俺たちも来たばっかりだからさ。
ほら、ここに座って座って」
　ばんばん、と芝生を叩く有彦。
「いいんですか？
　芝生にあがって昼食をとるなんて、他の方たちはしていませんけど」
「オッケーオッケー、別に学則で禁止されてるわけじゃないんだし問題ないって。
秋葉ちゃんはそんな余計な心配はしなくていいんだってば」
　ばんばん、とまたも芝生を叩く有彦。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry I’m late. Some girls in my class invited me to eat with them, and it took a while to decline.”
“No problem, we only just arrived. Come sit here.”
Arihiko slaps the grass beside him.
“Are we allowed to eat on the lawn? No one else is doing it.”
“Sure, there is no rule against it. Akiha need not worry about every little thing.”
Arihiko slaps the grass again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm sorry I'm late.
I received an invitation to have lunch with my classmates, and it took me some time to decline their invitations."
"Don't worry, we just got here too.
Here, sit here."
Arihiko pats the grass.

"Is it alright?
I do not see anyone else eating their lunch on the grass."
"It's okay.
It's not prohibited or anything.
There's no problem.
You don't have to worry about it."
Arihiko pats the grass once again.

entries.japanese:
「―――はい。
それでは失礼します」
　かすかに会釈をして、秋葉は俺のとなりに腰を下ろした。
「う…………」
　……朝の一件がまだ解決していないっていうのに、こんな間近に座られると緊張してしまう。
「―――どうしたんですか、兄さん？
　顔色が優れないようですけど、食欲がないんですか……？」
　こっちの顔色をうかがうように、秋葉は静かな視線を向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Very well. Excuse me, then.”
With a small bow, Akiha sits down next to me.
“Urgh.”
We have not settled what happened that morning, and having her sit so close makes me nervous.
“―――What is it, Brother? You look pale; have you lost your appetite…?”
Akiha studies my face with a quiet, searching gaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Okay, then excuse me."
Akiha bows faintly and sits next to me.
"Ug…………"
…… I still haven't gotten over the incident from this morning.
I feel a bit nervous if she sits this close to me.
"----What's wrong, Nii-san?
You don't look too well.
Are you not hungry……?"
Akiha gives me a quiet glance as if to find out my condition.

entries.japanese:
「え―――いや、別に気分は悪くないけど」
　……ないんだけど、少し居づらい。
　秋葉は朝の一件を特別意識していないように見えるけど、こっちは琥珀さんの言葉が頭にちらついて秋葉を意識してしまう。
「…………」
　結果、なんて言っていいのか解らず、つい黙ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H―――no, I do not feel sick.”
I do not, but I feel a little awkward.
Akiha seems no more conscious of what happened that morning than usual, but Kohaku’s words keep flashing through my mind and making me acutely aware of her.
“……”
In the end, I could think of nothing to say and lapsed into silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What-----no, I don't feel bad at all."
…… I don't, but it does feel a bit awkward being here.
It seems that Akiha doesn't care about what happened this morning, but it really bugs me as Kohaku-san's words keep flickering in my head.

"…………"
As a result, I can't think of anything to say as I fall silent.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　秋葉はじっと黙り込んでこっちを見ている。
―――と。
「……………お昼ですね、兄さん」
　なんて、ものすごく当たり前のコトを口にした。
「そうだな、お昼だな。
お昼だから何か食べないとまずいよな」
　がさごそ、とビニール袋から購買のパンを取り出す。
「昨日と同じパンだけど、いいか？」
「はい、いただきます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“………………….”
Akiha sits in silence, staring at me.
―――Then.
“Brother, it is lunchtime.”
She states the spectacularly obvious.
“Yes, it certainly is. Since it is lunchtime, we should probably eat.”
I rustle through the plastic bag and take out the bread I bought.
“It is the same as yesterday; is that all right?”
“Yes, thank you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
Akiha stares at me intently.
---And then.
"…… It's lunchtime, isn't it, Nii-san?"
She says something terribly normal.
"That's right, it's lunchtime.
It'd be bad not to eat anything at lunchtime."
I pull the bread I bought out of a plastic bag.
"It's the same bread as yesterday; is that okay?"
"Yes, thank you."

entries.japanese:
秋葉にサンドウィッチを手渡して、自分もサンドウィッチをかじりはじめる。
「………………」
　くそ、なんだか秋葉の一挙一動が気になって、うまく体が動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hand Akiha a sandwich and begin eating my own.
“………………”
Damn it, I am so conscious of her every movement that I can barely make my body behave normally.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hand Akiha a sandwich, and start to chew on my own.
"…………"
Damn it, somehow Akiha's every move gets my attention, and my body won't move right.

entries.japanese:
「おっ、先輩ったら今日は豪勢っスね。
なんかおめでたい事でもあったんスか？」
「いえ、そういうわけじゃないんですけどねー。
色々と佳境に入ってきましたから、いっぱい食べて力をつけておかないとダウンしちゃうんです」
「なるほど、食欲の秋ってワケ。
先輩のばあい、食べても栄養が胸にいきそうでいいッスね」
　……こっちが秋葉と気まずい食事を送っているっていうのに、有彦と先輩はやけに陽気な食事を楽しんでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Whoa, you’re eating like royalty today. Something to celebrate?”
“Not really. Things are reaching a critical stage, though, so I have to eat plenty and keep my strength up or I’ll collapse.”
“Ah, the autumn appetite. With you, I bet every calorie goes straight to your chest.”
While Akiha and I struggle through an awkward lunch, Arihiko and Ciel have a remarkably cheerful one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, you're livin' in luxury today, Senpai!
You got something to celebrate?"
"No, nothing like that.
Since everything's coming to the peak, I have to eat a lot and get a lot of energy."
"Ahh, I see, autumn eating.
I guess in your case, the food goes straight to your chest, huh?"
…… In contrast to the unpleasant meal me and Akiha are having, Arihiko and Senpai seem to be enjoying a very cheerful meal.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　もぐ。
　もぐもぐ。
　もぐもぐもぐもぐもぐ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Chew.
Chew, chew.
Chewchewchewchewchew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Munch.
Munch munch.
Munch munch munch munch munch.

entries.japanese:
「あの……兄さん？」
「ん？
　なに、秋葉」
「その……今日は飲み物はないんですか？
　少し、喉が渇いてしまったんですけど……」
「―――――あ」
　忘れてた。
　せっかく買っておいたいちご牛乳がビニール袋の中で眠っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Brother?”
“Hm? What is it, Akiha?”
“Did you bring anything to drink today? I am getting a little thirsty…”
“―――――Oh.”
I had forgotten.
The strawberry milk I had bought for her was still sleeping at the bottom of the bag.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um… Nii-san?"
"Hm?
What is it, Akiha?"
"Well… is there no drink today?
I'm a little thirsty…"
"-----Ah."
I forgot about it.
The strawberry milk I bought is still sitting in the plastic bag.

entries.japanese:
「わるい、忘れてた。
ほら、これでいいだろ」
　牛乳のパックを差し出す。
　パックを受け取る秋葉。
「あ――――」
　パックが小さすぎたせいか、秋葉の指と自分の指が重なった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, I forgot. Here.”
I hold out the carton.
Akiha takes it.
“Ah――――”
Perhaps the carton is too small; Akiha’s fingers settle over mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sorry, I forgot.
Here you go…"
I offer her the milk.
Akiha takes it.
"Ah----"
Because the carton is so small, our fingers touch.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　ただ、それだけ。
　たったそれだけのコトなのに、どうしてか指先が熱くなった。
　すぐに手を離せばいいのに、手が離れない。
　見れば秋葉も、俺と同じように固まったままだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
That was all.
Such a tiny thing, and yet my fingertips burned.
I should have let go at once, but my hand would not move.
When I looked at Akiha, she was frozen too.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
Just that.
It's just that, but my fingertips get hot.
Even though I should take my hand away immediately, it stays there.
Looking at Akiha, she seems to be paralyzed as well.

entries.japanese:
「あれ？
　遠野くん、なにやってるんですか？」
「―――――！」
　バッ、と秋葉の手から自分の手を離す。
「い、いえ、たんに秋葉に飲み物を渡してただけです」
「そうだったんですか。
なんか二人とも止まってましたから、飲み物を奪い合っているように見えちゃいました」
「あっ、先輩もそう見えた？
　オレもさ、遠野が一個しかないジュースを必死に渡すまいと死守しているみたいに見えた。
　秋葉ちゃんがのど渇いたっていうんだからあげればいいのに、人間なってねーなーって」
　……まあ、そうゆうふうに見えないコトも、なかったか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? What are you doing?”
“―――――!”
I snatch my hand away from Akiha’s.
“N-nothing; I was only handing her a drink.”
“Oh, I see. You both stopped moving, so it looked as though you were fighting over it.”
“That is what you saw too? Me too; it looked like Tohno was desperately guarding the last drink from her.
I was thinking, Akiha says she is thirsty and he still will not hand it over—what kind of monster is this guy?”
I suppose it might have looked that way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
Tohno-kun, what are you doing?"
"-----!"
Quickly, I pull my hand away from Akiha's.
"Ah, no, I was just passing Akiha her drink."
"Is that so?
Since you had both stopped moving, I thought you were fighting over the drink."
"Oh, you thought so too, Senpai?
It looked to me like Tohno was battling to the death not to hand over the juice.
Since Akiha-chan was thirsty it would've been good to give it to her, and I was thinking he was being a jerk."
…… Well, I guess it did look like that.

entries.japanese:
「いや、そういう訳じゃないんだ。
ちょっとぼんやりしてただけだから。
な、そうだろ秋葉？」
「……………」
　秋葉はぼんやりとするだけだ。
　その顔があんまりにも、その……俺の知っている秋葉とは違っていて、どきりとした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, it wasn’t like that. We both drifted off for a second. Right, Akiha?”
“……”
Akiha remained dazed.
That expression was so unlike the Akiha I knew that it made my heart jump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nah, it was nothing like that.
I was just careless for a moment, right Akiha?"
"…………"
Akiha just seems vacant.
The expression is so unlike the Akiha I know, I'm dazzled for a moment.

entries.japanese:
「ふーん……な、遠野。
前から思ってたんだけど、おまえと秋葉ちゃんってさ」
「―――なんだよ。
つまんない事言ったら怒るぞ」
「いや、あんまり似てないなって」
「……そんなの当たり前だろ。
いくら兄妹でも男と女なんだから、そう似てたまるもんか」
「あー、そういうコトじゃなくてさ、なんてゆーのかな、雰囲気ってヤツが違うなって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh… You know, Tohno, I have always thought you and Akiha…”
“―――What? Say anything stupid and I will hit you.”
“You two do not look much alike.”
“Of course we do not. We may be siblings, but I am a boy and she is a girl.”
“That is not what I mean; it is more like the two of you give off completely different vibes.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm… hey, Tohno, I've been thinking for a while, but, you and Akiha-chan…"
"---What is it?
I'll get mad if you say something stupid."
"Nah, you just don't seem all that alike."
"…… That's natural, right?
We may be siblings, but we're man and woman, so we won't be that similar."
"Oh, I don't mean that.
How to say it… you seem like different types."

entries.japanese:
「そうですね。
秋葉さんは近づきがたい雰囲気がありますけど、遠野くんはその逆ですから。
　遠野くんが水なら秋葉さんは油っていうところでしょうか」
「……まあ、たしかに秋葉はとっつきにくいところがあるかな。
もうちょっと優しいと文句はないんだけど」
「そなの？
　秋葉ちゃん、十分に優しいじゃんか」
「ああ、外面はいいんだこいつ。
けど家ん中じゃまったく別人でさ、厳しいの厳しくないのって。
夕食の時なんて生きたここちがしないぐらい俺のことを叱って―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s true. Akiha has an unapproachable air, while Tohno is just the opposite.
The two of you are like oil and water.”
“Well, Akiha can be rather prickly. If she were a little kinder, I’d have no complaints.”
“Really? She seems plenty kind to me.”
“That is because she behaves in public. At home she is a different person; strict does not begin to cover it. At dinner she lectures me so relentlessly I hardly feel alive―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true.
Akiha-san is quite unapproachable, Tohno-kun is the opposite.
It's like Tohno-kun is water and Akiha-san is oil, right?"
"…… Well, certainly Akiha is hard to grapple with.
I'd have no complaints if she was nicer."
"What?
Akiha-chan's kind enough, right?"
"Ah, she's nice on the surface.
But underneath there's another person entirely, the coldest of the cold.
You should see how she scolds me when I make mistakes at dinner---"

entries.japanese:
「―――まあ、こんな話はよそう。
もっとこう、世間的な話をしようぜ有彦」
「あら、お話の途中でしたのにやめてしまうんですか？
　私、きちんと最後まで兄さんの意見を聞いてみたいのに」
「う………………」
　秋葉の視線がいたい。
　……どうも、さっきの秋葉は一時の気の迷いだったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Actually, let us drop this. We should talk about something less personal, Arihiko.”
“Oh? But you were in the middle of such an interesting story; I would very much like to hear the rest of your opinion, Brother.”
“Urgh…”
Akiha’s stare hurts.
Apparently that dreamy expression was a momentary aberration.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Well, that's about enough.
Let's talk about something more interesting, Arihiko."
"Ah, you're stopping in the middle of what you were saying?
I would like to hear exactly what you think of me, Nii-san."
"Uh……………"
Akiha's gaze is painful.
…… The Akiha from a moment ago must have been just some kind of illusion.

entries.japanese:
「世間的な話ねえ―――って、そういえば遠野。
おまえん家、今日の朝のニュースに出てたたけどなんかあったの？」
「え―――？
　朝のニュースって、うち？」
「ええ、通り魔殺人の被害者が遠野くんの家の近くで出たじゃないですか。
あの監獄みたいにずーっと並んでる塀って、秋葉さんのお屋敷の塀ですよね？」
「――さあ、どうでしょう。
朝のニュースは観ていませんから、私からはなにも言えませんけど」
　秋葉は他人事のように、あっさりと受け流す。
　けど俺は、秋葉のように無関心ではいられなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Something less personal, huh―――oh, right, Tohno; your house was on the news this morning. Did something happen?”
“What―――? The morning news showed our house?”
“Yes. Another victim of the random killings was found near your home; that endless wall that looks like a prison belongs to Akiha’s estate, does it not?”
“――I would not know. I did not watch the news this morning, so I cannot tell you anything.”
Akiha dismisses it as though it has nothing to do with her.
I cannot be so indifferent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Something more interesting, huh.
Thinking about it, Tohno, did you see the news about your place this morning?"
"Eh---?
This morning's news?"
"Yes, the serial killer's latest victim was found near Tohno-kun's house, wasn't he?
That blank prison-like wall is the wall of Akiha-san's mansion, isn't it?"
"--I don't really know.
I didn't look at the news this morning, so I can't say."
Akiha neatly dismisses the affairs like it had nothing to do with her.
But I can't dismiss it like Akiha.

entries.japanese:
だって、例の通り魔事件はもう起きないはずなんだ。
　人の血を吸わなくちゃ生きていけなかった弓塚はもういない。
　だから犠牲者はもう出ないハズだ。
　俺の。
　俺のあの夢さえ、夢のままでいてくれるなら。
entries.maoEnglish:
The random killings were supposed to be over.
Yumizuka, who needed human blood to survive, was no longer here.
There should be no more victims.
My dream.
If only it would remain a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Because there shouldn't be any more killings.
Yumizuka isn't drinking people's blood to live any longer.
So, there shouldn't be any more victims.
My…
If that dream of mine is just a dream…

entries.japanese:
「―――先輩。
それ本当ですか。
通り魔殺人って、あの吸血鬼殺人のことだろ」
「はい、昨夜で十人目の犠牲者だそうです。
やっぱり体中の血液が抜かれてしまっていたそうなんですけど、今回のは体のほうも色々となくなっているそうですよ」
　先輩はいつもの調子で説明してくれる。
　けど、俺は。
　自分がいる世界がぐらりと傾くような、大きな眩暈に襲われていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Ciel. Is that true? By the random killings, you mean the vampire murders?”
“Yes. Last night’s was apparently the tenth victim.
The body had been drained of blood as before, but this time several other parts were missing as well.”
Ciel explained it in her usual tone.
But I was seized by a violent vertigo, as though the world beneath me had tilted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Senpai.
Is this true?
Is it the same as those vampire killings from before?"
"Yes.
They say last night's was the tenth victim.
Of course all the blood was drained from the body, but this time there were body parts missing, too."
Senpai explains in her usual tone.
But, I…
I'm attacked by a great dizziness like the whole world just tilted.

entries.japanese:
「遺体には手足がなかったそうなんですけど、これが人の口で食いちぎられたんじゃないかっていう話なんです。
でもおかしいですよね、人間の口じゃ」
「人間の体を食いちぎる事は不可能です。
人間のアゴの筋力では人間の手足を食いちぎれませんし、歯のほうも耐えられないでしょう。
　……そうですね、柔らかい軟骨に歯をたてるのなら骨を削ることぐらいはできるかもしれませんが」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The body had no arms or legs. They believe a human mouth bit them off, but that is strange; a human mouth could not”
“It could not tear limbs from a human body. Human jaws lack the strength, and the teeth would fail as well.
One might scrape bone by sinking one’s teeth into the softer cartilage, perhaps, but no more.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The body's hands and feet were missing, but they say it was like they were bitten off with a human mouth.
But that's strange, isn't it?
A person's mouth?"
"It's impossible to bite off human body parts.
The human jaw is not strong enough to bite off someone's hand or foot, and the teeth wouldn't bear it either.
…… Well, you could grind on the cartilage with your teeth, but that's about it."

entries.japanese:
「はい、その通りです。
ですけど遺体には人間のモノとしか思えない歯形がついていたそうですから、こうなると人間の姿をした人間じゃない生き物が犯人っていう事になりますよね。
そうなると吸血鬼が犯人っていうのも、わりかし的をいているんじゃないでしょうか」
――――吐き気が、する。
　先輩、先輩は知らないからそんな笑顔で言えるけど、それは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. Yet the marks on the body looked unmistakably human, which would make the killer a creature shaped like a person but not human. In that case, calling it a vampire may be close to the truth.”
――――Nausea rises in my throat.
Ciel, you can smile because you do not know, but that is―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Precisely.
But the marks on the body can only belong to a human, so maybe it is something inhuman yet shaped like a human.
Quite similar to a vampire, don't you think?"
----I feel sick.
Senpai, since she doesn't know, can say all this with a smile---

entries.japanese:
「くす」
「秋葉さん。
わたし、なにかおかしなコト言いましたか」
「ええ、とても愉快なコトを言われているものですから、つい笑ってしまいました」
「もうっ、笑い事じゃないですっ！
　昨夜の犠牲者は秋葉さんの家の近くで発見されたのに！」
「失礼でしたら謝ります、先輩。
けれど先輩がそんなに夢見がちな人だとは思いませんでした。
　ついでですから、先輩が想像している吸血鬼像を聞かせていただけます？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Heh.”
“Akiha. Did I say something amusing?”
“Yes, what you said was so entertaining that I could not help laughing.”
“This is hardly a laughing matter! Last night’s victim was found near your home!”
“I apologize if I was rude. I simply never imagined you were such a dreamer.
Since the subject has come up, would you describe the vampire you imagine?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha."
"Akiha-san.
Have I said something funny?"
"Yes.
Since it was so funny, I laughed in spite of myself."
"Geez, it's no laughing matter!
Last night's victim was found near your house!"
"I'm sorry if I was impolite, Senpai.
But, I didn't think you were a person given to such flights of fancy.
Well, Senpai, perhaps you could tell us what you think of the vampire?"

entries.japanese:
「えっと、それは童話でいうところの吸血鬼のことですか？」
「いえ、その通り魔殺人というものの犯人像としての吸血鬼です」
　うーん、とシエル先輩は考え込む。
　俺は―――そんなもの先輩の口から聞きたくないと思う反面、ひどく、興味をひかれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, do you mean the sort of vampire that appears in fairy tales?”
“No, I mean the kind of vampire you imagine as the culprit behind these murders.”
Ciel considers the question.
Part of me―――does not want to hear any of this from her, while another part is fiercely curious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh, you mean, the vampires in legends?"
"No, I mean your image of the vampire as the serial killer."
Ciel-senpai is lost in thought.
I---while I don't really want to hear Senpai's answer, I'm terribly interested in spite of myself.

entries.japanese:
「やっぱり、犯人は人間ですよ。
ただちょっとわたしたちとは違う価値観とか素質とかを持っているんだと思います。
　そういった常識では判断されない性質を、わたしたちは吸血鬼といって判断しようとするんじゃないでしょうか」
「……つまり精神に異常をきたした人間、本来なら禁忌である事を禁忌とは感じなくなっている精神異常者を『吸血鬼』だと言っているんですね、先輩は」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The killer is still human. I think they simply possess values and inclinations different from ours.
Perhaps when someone has qualities ordinary standards cannot judge, we call that person a ‘vampire’ so that we can make sense of them.”
“So by ‘vampire,’ you mean a deranged human being—someone who no longer recognizes as taboo what should be forbidden.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Really, the culprit's just a person.
I think he just has qualities and values different from ours.
I think we take those characteristics that cannot be distinguished by common sense and try to understand them by using the label 'vampire'."
"…… In other words, Senpai believes a 'vampire' is someone with a mental disability, a psychosis that prevents them from telling right from wrong?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
呼び方は『吸血鬼』でなくても結構ですけど。
社会の決まりごとから外れてしまった人間は、その性質が理解できないという理由だけで社会に属する人々から人間と扱われなくなります。
　それが世間一般の常識の防衛機能でしょう、秋葉さん」
「たいへん参考になりました先輩。
……けれど難しいですね。
先輩の考えでは『吸血鬼』は罪を犯している訳ではなくなってしまいます。
　だって、『吸血鬼』は自分の行為が悪いことだと微塵も思っていないんでしょう？
　なら、罪ではないものを罰することはできないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. It needn’t be called a vampire. When someone leaves the rules of society behind, the people within society cease to regard them as human simply because their nature is incomprehensible.
That is the common sense of society defending itself.”
“That was very instructive. But it creates a difficulty. Under your interpretation, the vampire is not committing a crime.
The vampire feels no trace of guilt for what they do, correct? Then one cannot punish them for something that is not a crime to them.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
You don't have to use the term 'vampire', but anyone outside the customs of society is disowned by those within the society, as society cannot understand the person's character.
That's the defense function of ordinary common sense, isn't it, Akiha-san?"
"You've thought about this a lot, Senpai.
But it's difficult, isn't it?
By your thinking, the 'vampire' cannot be said to have committed a crime.
After all, the 'vampire' has no qualms about his own conduct, does he?
If there has been no crime, how can he be punished?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
ですからそういった外れた人たちを罰するのは、社会に属する人達にはできません。
　罪を罪と認識していない物を罰するためには、個人の倫理観ではなくその種族全体の原則で罰しないといけないんです」
「……種全体の原則……ですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. That is why the people who belong to society cannot punish those who have strayed outside it.
To punish a being that does not recognize its crime, one must appeal not to individual ethics but to the law of the species as a whole.”
“The law of the entire species?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Indeed.
So, it is not the role of those within society to exact punishment.
To punish a crime not recognized as a crime, the punishment must be based not on the morals of an individual but on the principles of the entire species."
"…… The principles of the entire species…?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
自種を他種より繁栄させる、という一番初めの原則ですよ。
種にとって、これを妨害するものはそれだけで罪ですから。
　たとえ吸血鬼さんが殺人を罪と感じていなくても、人間全体にとっては殺人行為ではなくその吸血鬼さんの存在そのものが罪なんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. The oldest law: one’s own species must prosper over all others. Anything that obstructs that prosperity is, by that fact alone, a crime.
Even if a vampire sees no sin in murder, to humanity as a whole the vampire’s very existence is the crime.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
The first principle that it is better for one's own kind to prosper than for others' to.
For a species, that which obstructs this principle is a crime by itself.
Even if Vampire-san does not view murder as a crime, for the human species, it is not the murder but the existence of the vampire itself that is the crime."

entries.japanese: ――――――その、存在自体が罪。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――Its very existence—a crime.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------The existence itself is a crime.

entries.japanese:
……なんだろう。
　おかしな事を聞く秋葉も秋葉だけど、それに答える先輩も先輩だ。
　それに。
　なんだか二人の会話は、他の誰でもない自分自身に向かってのものに思える。
entries.maoEnglish:
What is this?
Akiha is strange for asking, and Ciel is just as strange for answering.
And yet.
Their conversation feels directed not at anyone else, but at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What is this?
Akiha asking those strange things, and Senpai giving those answers.
And,
for some reason, it seems like they're talking about no one else but me.

entries.japanese:
昼休みの終わりを告げるチャイムが鳴り響く。
「――すみません、つまらない話をしてしまって」
「あー、いいよいいよー。
オレ、秋葉ちゃんの声が聞けるだけで満足だから」
「それじゃあ解散ですね。
みなさん、急がないと間に合いませんよ」
　先輩は食堂のほうに走っていく。
　先輩の教室はそっちのほうから校舎に入ったほうが近いんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The bell rang, announcing the end of lunch.
“――I am sorry for bringing up such a dull subject.”
“It’s fine, it’s fine. Hearing Akiha’s voice is enough to make me happy.”
“Then I suppose we should disperse. You’ll all be late if you don’t hurry.”
Ciel runs toward the cafeteria.
Her classroom must be closer if she enters the building from that side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The chime that marks the end of lunch sounds.
"--I'm sorry for talking about such unappealing things."
"Ah, it's fine, it's fine.
I'm happy just listening to Akiha's voice."
"Well then, shall we go?
You'll all be late if you don't hurry."
Senpai heads for the cafeteria.
It's quicker for her to go through there to get to her classroom.

entries.japanese:
――――先輩が行ってしまう。
　あの人が通り魔殺人について詳しいからなのか、それともさっきの話がひっかかるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Ciel is leaving.
Was it because she knew so much about the killings, or because something in that conversation still troubled me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Senpai's going.
Is it because she knew so much about the serial killings or is it that I was drawn into the conversation?

entries.japanese:
……何の根拠もない。
　なのに、ただ漠然と、あの人なら俺の悩みを解決してくれるかもしれないと思った。
「―――――」
　迷っている暇はない。
　自分一人でこんなモノを抱えることには、これ以上耐えられない。
「悪い、先に戻っていてくれ有彦！」
「ああ？
　先に戻ってろって、どこ行くんだよ遠野！」
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no reason to believe it.
Even so, I have the vague conviction that she might be able to resolve what is tormenting me.
“―――――”
There is no time to hesitate.
I can’t bear carrying this thing alone any longer.
“Sorry, Arihiko—go on back without me!”
“Huh? You want me to go back—but where are you going, Tohno?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I don't have any reason for it.
But I just have a vague feeling she might be the person able to help me with my troubles.
"-----"
There's no time to think.
I can't bear to keep this to myself any longer.
"Sorry, you go on ahead, Arihiko!"
"Huh?
'Go on ahead'?
Where are you going, Tohno!?"

entries.japanese:
……とにかく、もう怒られても仕方がないぐらいの強引さで、先輩を校舎裏に連れてきてしまった。
　五時限目はとっくに始まってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have practically dragged Ciel behind the school with enough force to deserve a scolding.
Fifth period is already well under way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Anyway, I get her to come to the rear of the school building so forcefully that it can't be helped if she gets mad at me.
Fifth period has already started.

entries.japanese:
「もう、いきなりこんなところに連れて来て、なんなんですか遠野くん」
　……先輩は怒っているというより呆れている。
「ごめん先輩。
けど、さっきの話をもう少し詳しく聞きたいんだ」
「さっきの話って、通り魔殺人の話ですか？」
「そう。
その、罪を罪と感じないっていうヤツ。
それって、ようするに無自覚で人殺しをしているっていう事なのかな」
　……例えば。
　自分は眠っているつもりでも、外に出て人殺しをしてしまっている、といったふうな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Tohno, why did you drag me out here without warning?”
Ciel sounds more exasperated than angry.
“Sorry, Ciel. But I need to hear more about what you said earlier.”
“About the street murders?”
“Yes. That part about not recognizing guilt as guilt. Does that mean the killer could be murdering people without knowing it?”
For example.
Someone might believe he was asleep while actually wandering outside and killing people.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, pulling me to a place like this… what is it, Tohno-kun?"
…… Senpai is more amazed than angry.
"I'm sorry, Senpai.
But, I wanted to hear more about what you were saying before."
"What I was saying before… you mean the serial killer?"
"Yes, that.
About the person who doesn't feel a crime is a crime.
Are you saying they kill people unconsciously?"
…… For example.
Like if you intend to sleep, but instead go outside to commit murder.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ、いたいです遠野くん。
ちゃんと話は聞きますから、手を離してください」
「あ―――ごめん」
　先輩から手を離す。
　……よっぽど俺は慌てていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow—Tohno, that hurts. I promise I’ll listen, so please let go of my hand.”
“Ah―――sorry.”
I release her.
I must be more frantic than I realized.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, that hurts, Tohno-kun.
I'll answer you, so please let go of me."
"Oh---I'm sorry."
I let her go.
…… It seems I was really worked up.

entries.japanese:
「はい、けっこうです。
えっと、通り魔殺人の犯人さんが無自覚で殺人を起こしているかどうか、というコトでしたね」
「うん―――どうしてもそれが聞きたいんだ」
「そんなの知りませんよ。
わたし、犯人さんじゃないんですから」
「な―――そ、それはそうだけど、先輩！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. Now, you were asking whether the killer might be unaware of committing the murders.”
“Yes―――I have to know.”
“How should I know? I’m not the murderer.”
“Wha―――well, no, but Ciel!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright.
Anyway, you were asking if the killer might be killing people unconsciously, right?"
"Yeah---I really want to know."
"Well, I don't know, because I'm not the killer."
"Wha---yes, that's true, Senpai, but…!"

entries.japanese:
「はい、冗談です。
遠野くんがあんまりにも真剣だから、ちょっとからかっちゃおうかなって」
「……先輩、勘弁してくれ。
こっちは本当に大真面目なんだから」
「ええ、そうみたいですね。
だけどどうしたんです？
　通り魔事件の犯人のことなんて、遠野くんには関係ないじゃないですか」
「それは――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m joking. You looked so desperately serious that I couldn’t resist teasing you.”
“Please don’t. I really am serious.”
“Yes, I can see that. But what brought this on? The murderer has nothing to do with you.”
“That’s――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, it's just a joke.
Since you seemed so serious, Tohno-kun, I thought I'd be a little playful for a moment."
"…… Senpai, give me a break.
I'm really serious here."
"Yeah, it looks like it.
But, why?
The serial killer is none of your concern, is he, Tohno-kun?"
"That's----"

entries.japanese:
「それは、なんですか」
　……それは。
「俺が―――その犯人だっていったら、どうする？」
　意を決して、そう言った。
　だっていうのに。
　先輩は、できのいい冗談を聞いたような顔をして、くすくすと笑い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s what?”
It is…
“What would you do if I―――if I told you I was the killer?”
I force myself to say it.
And yet.
Ciel looks as if she has just heard an excellent joke and begins to laugh softly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes?
What is it?"
…… That's.
"If---if I told you I was the killer, what would you do?"
I finally say it.
But,
Senpai's face lights up as if I said the funniest joke, and she bursts into laughter.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、冗談じゃないんだ。
俺は―――」
「ええ、遠野くんが本気だっていうことは分かってます。
けど、だからなんだかおかしくて。
だって自分が殺人鬼なんだって相談にくる殺人鬼なんて、普通いないじゃないですか」
「先輩―――――」
「それじゃわたしから聞きますけど、遠野くんはなんだってそんなふうに思うんです？」
「それは―――その、最近の俺、おかしいんだ。
……原因は判ってる。
たぶん、俺は吸血鬼に噛まれたんだ」
　……何かの比喩のように、そう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, this isn’t a joke. I―――”
“I know you mean it. That’s what makes it funny. Murderers don’t ordinarily seek advice because they’re worried they might be murderers.”
“Ciel―――――”
“Then let me ask you: why do you think such a thing?”
“It’s―――well, I haven’t been myself lately. I know the cause. I think a vampire bit me.”
I say it as if it were some kind of metaphor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, this is no joke, I'm---"
"Yes, I know you're serious.
But that's why it's funny.
Because the murderer doesn't usually come and ask for help because they're the murderer."
"Senpai-----"
"Then I will ask.
Why do you think so, Tohno-kun?"
"It's because---recently, I've been… strange.
I know why.
I was probably bitten by a vampire."
…… I say it frankly, as if it was a euphemism.

entries.japanese:
「―――どうぞ。
まだ続きがあるんでしょう？」
「……それ以来、なんかヘンなんだ。
突然自分が自分じゃないみたいになったり、人を殺してしまう夢を見たりする。
　昨日なんて、俺は眠っているつもりだったのに外に出歩いていたらしいんだ。
……その時見ていた夢も人を殺して、血を吸う夢だった」
「――――――」
　先輩は何も言わず、ただ俺の目を見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Go on. There is more, isn’t there?”
“Ever since then, something has been wrong with me; sometimes I suddenly feel like someone else. I dream about killing people.
Yesterday, I thought I was asleep, but apparently I went wandering outside. And in the dream I was having then, I killed someone and drank their blood.”
“――――――”
Ciel says nothing, only studies my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Please, go on."
"…… Since then, it's been strange.
Suddenly I don't feel like myself, and I have dreams about killing people.
Last night, although I only intended to sleep, it seems that I went out.
And I had a dream in which I killed someone, and sucked blood."
"------"
Senpai says nothing, just watching me.

entries.japanese:
「……俺の親父は二重人格だったそうだし、もしかしすると俺本人が気がついていないだけで、人殺しの俺がいるのかもしれない。
でもそれを確かめるコトができなくて、俺は―――」
「それで遠野くんは犯人は無自覚なのか、なんて聞いてきたんですね」
　はあ、と先輩は呆れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“They say my father had two personalities, so perhaps there is a murderer inside me and I’m simply the one who doesn’t know. But I have no way to find out, and I―――”
“So that is why you asked whether the killer might be unaware.”
Ciel sighs in exasperation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… My father had a split personality.
Maybe I just don't know about it, but there might be a killer in me.
But I have no way of finding out---"
"So that's why you came to ask if the killer was unconscious of his actions."
Senpai sighs in amazement.

entries.japanese:
「あのですね、もし遠野くんがその殺人鬼さんだとしたら、無自覚なんかじゃありませんよ。
夢として殺人の行為を見ている時点で、それは無自覚ではありませんから。
　けど、そんなことよりですね。
はっきり言ってしまうと、そんなのはただの夢です。
遠野くんがなにを不安がってるかは知りませんけど、遠野くんは遠野くんです」
「―――――」
　……そう言ってくれるのは、嬉しいけど。
　俺には先輩の言葉を鵜呑みできるものが、何一つだってありはしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen: if you were the killer, you wouldn’t be unaware of it. The moment you witness the murders in your dreams, they are part of your awareness.
More importantly. They are only dreams. I don’t know what has frightened you so badly, but you are still you, Tohno.”
“―――――”
I’m grateful to hear it.
But I have no reason—none at all—to accept her reassurance on faith.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, if you were truly the killer, you would not be unconscious of yourself.
The point you're seeing it in your dreams makes it not unconscious.
But more importantly, it's just a dream.
I don't know what you're worried about, but Tohno-kun is Tohno-kun."
"-----"
…… I'm glad to hear that, but…
There's no reason for me to believe in any of Senpai's words.

entries.japanese:
「はあ。
よっぽど不安なんですね、遠野くん」
　言って。
　先輩はぽんぽん、と俺の頭をなでた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My. You really are frightened, aren’t you, Tohno?”
With that.
Ciel pats me lightly on the head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She sighs.
"You must be feeling really uneasy, Tohno-kun."
Saying so,
Senpai pats my head.

entries.japanese:
「―――大丈夫ですよ。
遠野くんは何の問題もありません。
他でもないわたしが保証するんですから、絶対に大丈夫です」
「あ――――はい」
　……自然に、心からうなずいていた。
　ただこうしている間だけだって分かっていても、心が休まる。
　こっちの不安を包み込むような、先輩の手の平が優しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You’ll be all right. There is nothing wrong with you. I am personally guaranteeing it, so you are absolutely going to be all right.”
“Ah――――okay.”
The nod comes naturally, from somewhere deep inside me.
Even knowing the relief will last only as long as this moment, I can finally breathe.
Her palm is gentle, as though it could cradle every fear I have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It's okay.
You have nothing to worry about, Tohno-kun.
I myself guarantee it, so it's definitely okay."
"Ah----yes."
…… Automatically, I nod in complete agreement.
Even if I know it's only while she's doing so, I feel at ease.
Like wrapping up my uneasiness, Senpai's hands are gentle.

entries.japanese:
放課後になった。
　秋葉の事や自分の事で混乱しながら、とりあえず一日が終わろうとしている。
「……帰るか」
　秋葉を迎えにいって、屋敷に帰ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
School lets out.
Though my thoughts remain tangled around Akiha and myself, the day is finally drawing to a close.
“Time to go.”
I’ll collect Akiha, and we’ll head home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
School is over now.
I was confused about myself and Akiha, but today is about to end.
"…… Time to go home."
