I should go get Akiha and go back to our mansion.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と一緒に帰路につく。
　……昼休みの時と同じように、二人きりになるとお互い会話が途絶えてしまった。
―――秋葉と話したいと思う反面、秋葉の顔を見るのが照れくさい。
「……まったく、中学生じゃあるまいし」
「……？
　何か言いましたか、兄さん？」
「あ―――いや、なんでもない。
ただの独り言」
　……はあ。
　ほんと、一体何をしているんだろう遠野志貴は。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I start home together.
Just as at lunch, the moment we are alone, conversation deserts us both.
―――I want to talk to her, yet somehow I’m too self-conscious even to look at her face.
“Honestly, I’m not a middle-schooler anymore.”
“Hm? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Ah―――no. Just talking to myself.”
Haaah.
What are you doing, Shiki Tohno?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk home together with Akiha.
…… Just like lunchtime, we grow quiet as soon as there's only the two of us.
---While I want to talk to Akiha, I also feel embarrassed looking at her.
"…… Man, it's not like I'm a middle schooler."
"…?
Did you say something Nii-san?"
"Oh---no, it's nothing, just talking to myself."
…… *sigh*
Really, what the hell am I doing?

entries.japanese:
長い坂道につく。
　ここを登りきれば屋敷は目の前だ。
「兄さん。
屋敷に戻る前に、一つお聞きしたい事があります」
　ぴたり、と足を止めて、秋葉はまっすぐに俺を見据えてきた。
「―――――」
　そこにはさっきまでの、じれったいような沈黙はない。
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで俺を見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach the long slope.
Once we climb it, the estate will be directly ahead.
“Brother. Before we return to the estate, there is one thing I wish to ask you.”
Akiha stops dead and faces me squarely.
“―――――”
The awkward silence from before is gone.
Her gaze is grave and unwavering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We reach the long hill.
Once we go up it, our mansion will be right there.
"Nii-san.
I would like to ask you one thing before we get home."
Akiha's feet stop and she looks straight at me.
"-----"
The kind of silence that was there before is gone.
Akiha looks at me seriously.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ。
聞きたい事ってなに？」
「……その、以前も聞きましたけど、兄さんはシエルをどう思っているんですか？」
「――――なんだ、なにかと思ったらまたそれか。
どう思ってるかも何も、先輩は先輩だよ。
なんでも相談できる頼りがいのある先輩だけど」
「……そうですね。
兄さんはなにか悩みごとがあるようでしたから。
今日の朝のことも、それが原因だったんでしょう？」
「―――――」
　……驚いた。
　秋葉は、俺が一人で悩んでいたことに気付いてたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sure. What do you want to ask?”
“I asked you once before; how do you feel about Ciel?”
“――――Oh, that again? Ciel is Ciel. She’s a dependable upperclassman I can talk to about anything.”
“Yes, I suppose she is. You seemed troubled about something. That was also the reason for what happened this morning, wasn’t it?”
“―――――”
I’m taken aback.
Akiha noticed that I’d been worrying alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, what do you wanna ask about?"
"…… Um… I asked before, but, what do you think of Ciel?"
"----What, that again?
I don't think anything of her.
She's just my senpai.
She's a trustworthy senpai I can ask about anything, though."
"…… I see.
It seemed like something was bothering you; this morning was a result of it too, wasn't it?"
"-----"
…… I'm surprised.
Akiha knew that I was worrying about the problem by myself.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……おまえ、気付いてたのか」
「あたりまえです。
私たちは兄妹なんですから、兄さんが落ち込んでいる事ぐらい感じ取れるわ。
　だっていうのに、どうして兄さんは私に相談してくれないんですか。
私よりあんな人のほうが信頼できるんですか、兄さんは」
「お―――おまえ、俺が先輩に相談するとこ、見てたのか……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—you knew?”
“Of course; we are brother and sister. I can at least tell when you are miserable.
And yet why wouldn’t you confide in me? Do you trust that woman more than your own sister?”
“Y-you―――you saw me talking to Ciel…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha… you noticed?"
"Of course.
We are brother and sister.
I can tell when you are depressed, Nii-san.
So, why didn't you just come and talk to me?
Do you trust that woman more than you trust me?"
"Y---you were watching me talk to Senpai…!?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
本当にあの時は我が目を疑ったわ。
兄さん、あの人の前ではすごく素直なんですから！」
　ふん、と顔を背ける秋葉。
「……違う。
俺が秋葉や琥珀さんに相談しなかったのは、その―――」
　今の自分の体を打ち明けて、嫌われたくなかったからなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I did. I could hardly believe my eyes. Brother, you’re so open with her!”
Akiha turns away with an offended huff.
“That isn’t it. I didn’t tell you or Kohaku because―――”
Because I couldn’t bear for them to learn what my body had become and hate me for it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I could hardly believe my eyes and ears.
You, being so honest in front of that person!"
With a "hmph", Akiha turns away.
"…… It's not like that.
I didn't talk to you or Kohaku-san, because---"
I didn't want to tell them about my body and have them hate me.

entries.japanese:
「その、なんですか。
言いたい事があるんでしたらはっきり言ってください」
「ばか、言えたらこんなに悩んだりするもんか！
　　俺は、秋葉たちのことが大事だから先輩に相談したんだ。
別におまえの事を信頼してなかったとか、そういう事じゃない」
「そんな言い訳、聞きたくないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because what? If you have something to say, then say it plainly.”
“Idiot—if I could say it, I wouldn’t be suffering like this! I went to Ciel because you and the others matter to me. It isn’t because I don’t trust you.”
“I don’t want to hear your excuses.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because of what?
If there's something you want to say, please, say it."
"Are you stupid?
I wouldn't worry this much if I could say it!
I asked Senpai since you guys are important to me.
It's not because I don't trust you or anything."
"I don't want to hear such excuses!"

entries.japanese:
「この際ですからはっきり言います。
　あの人と兄さんは釣り合いません。
……ですから、これ以上はあの人と親しくしないでください。
それは兄さんの為になりません」
「な────」
　あまりに唐突な言葉に声が出ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I shall speak plainly.
You and that woman are ill-suited to one another. Do not grow any closer to her. It will bring you nothing good.”
“Wha────”
The words come so abruptly that they silence me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine, I'll come out and say it.
That person doesn't suit you.
So please, do not get any closer to her.
It is for your sake."
"Wha----"
It's so sudden I'm at a loss for words.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
それは、一般家庭の人間は遠野家には相応しくないっていう意味で言ってるのか」
「………………」
　秋葉は答えない。
　沈黙は、すなわちイエスだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Are you saying someone from an ordinary family isn’t good enough for a Tohno?”
“………………”
She does not answer.
Her silence means yes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Are you saying that ordinary people are not suitable company for those of the Tohno house, then?"
"…………"
Akiha doesn't answer.
The silence means a yes.

entries.japanese:
「───そうか。
そうだよな、そりゃあ秋葉は遠野家の当主だもんな。
親父と同じで家柄や血筋が大事だっていうんだろ？」
「……兄さん、それは」
「いいよ、別に文句を言ってるわけじゃない。
秋葉を一人残して家を出たのは俺のほうだ。
本来ならさ、そういうふうに育てられたのは俺の方だったんだ。
だから、秋葉を悪く言ってるんじゃないんだ」
「…………………」
「でもな、今のは聞き流せない。
先輩のことを何もしらないクセに、相応しくないなんて、そんなコト言わないでくれ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“───I see; of course. You’re the head of the Tohno family, after all. Just like Father, you care about pedigree and bloodlines, is that it?”
“Brother, that isn’t—”
“It’s fine; I’m not criticizing you. I’m the one who left you alone and walked away from this family. I was the one who should have been raised that way. So I’m not blaming you.”
“…”
“But I can’t let what you just said pass. You know nothing about Ciel, so don’t say she isn’t good enough.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
Well, you are the head of the Tohno household.
You're saying that family and lineage is important like that old man, right?"
"…… Nii-san, that's…"
"It's fine.
I'm not really complaining.
I'm the one who left you alone in that house.
I should have been the one raised that way originally.
So, I'm not speaking badly of you."
"…………"
"But, I can't let what you said right now go.
Even though you don't know anything about Senpai, don't just say she's unsuitable."

entries.japanese:
秋葉はうつむいたままで何も言わない。
　しばらく、俺たちの間に言葉はなかった。
「…………のクセに」
「え───？」
「兄さんだって遠野家の事を何も知らないクセに、勝手な事を言わないで――！」
　苦しげに叫んで、秋葉は俺の前から離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha remains bowed and silent.
For a while, neither of us speaks.
“When you don’t know anything either…”
“What───?”
“You don’t know anything about the Tohno family either, Brother, so stop saying whatever you please――!”
The cry tears out of her in pain, and she recoils from me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Looking down, Akiha says nothing.
For a while, we stand in silence.
"…… You don't…"
"Eh---?"
"Nii-san, you don't know anything about the Tohno house, don't say such selfish things!"
Crying out painfully, Akiha pulls away from me.

entries.japanese:
「───とにかく、あの人とは親しくしないで。
あの人は違う人です。
親しくすればするほど、兄さんが苦しくなるだけだわ」
　秋葉は坂道を駆け上がっていく。
「───なんだよ、それ」
　俺は呆然と、秋葉の後ろ姿を見つめることしかできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───In any case, stay away from that woman. She is not what you think. The closer you become, the more you will suffer.”
Akiha runs up the hill.
“───What the hell does that mean?”
All I can do is stare numbly after her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Anyway, you mustn't get close to that person.
She's not like us.
If you get any closer to her, you're the one who would suffer."
Akiha runs up the hill.
"---What does that mean?"
All I can do is gaze up after her, aghast.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に戻ってきた。
　いつもなら何も考えずにロビーに入るのだが、今は中に入りづらい。
　……この屋敷に戻ってきて、俺はさんざん秋葉を怒らせてきたと思う。
　けど、さっきのは本物だ。
　俺は初めて、秋葉を本気で怒らせて、あんな苦しそうな声をあげさせてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I arrive at the estate.
Usually I would walk straight into the foyer without thinking, but now I can’t bring myself to enter.
Since returning to the estate, I must have angered Akiha countless times.
But that was different.
For the first time, I truly hurt her—hurt her enough to make her cry out like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion.
Though I usually go into the lobby without thinking, right now it's hard to enter.
…… I have made Akiha angry many times since I came back to the mansion.
But, she was really mad back then.
For the first time, I really angered Akiha, and made her sound so hurt.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　さっきのはどっちが悪い、という問題じゃないと思う。
　ちゃんと時間が経てば秋葉も冷静になって、どうしてシエル先輩をあんなに嫌うのかを説明してくれるはずだ。
「……庭でも回るか」
　屋敷の中に入ると秋葉と顔を合わせるかもしれないし、しばらく庭を散歩しよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I don’t think what happened can be reduced to which of us was wrong.
Once enough time passes, Akiha will calm down and explain why she hates Ciel so much.
“Maybe I’ll walk around the garden.”
If I go inside, I may run into Akiha, so I’ll walk around the garden for a while.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I don't think it matters who was wrong.
I'm sure that in time Akiha will calm down and explain why she doesn't like Ciel-senpai.
"…… I could hang around the garden for a bit."
If I go into the mansion, I might face Akiha, so I'll take a walk in the garden for a while.

entries.japanese:
「あれ、琥珀さん……？」
　そこにいたのは琥珀さんだった。
　……こっちには気がついていないみたいだけど、林のほうへ行こうとしている。
　琥珀さんはこちらに気づいていない。
　何をしにいくんだろう、琥珀さんは森の中に入っていく。
「？」
　興味をひかれて、少しだけ後についていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Kohaku…?”
It is Kohaku.
She doesn’t seem to have noticed me, and she is heading toward the trees.
Kohaku has not noticed me.
I wonder what she is doing as she walks into the woods.
“?”
Curious, I follow her a little way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
Kohaku-san?"
It's Kohaku-san.
She doesn't seem to have noticed me, and she's heading into the forest.
She hasn't noticed me.
I don't know what she's doing, but she disappears into the forest.
"?"
I'm curious, so I'll follow her.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんが歩いていった先には、ちょっとした広場があるようだった。
「……？
　あんなところに広場なんて……」
　首をかしげて思い出そうとしてみるが、どうも記憶はあいまいだ。
　屋敷の森の中、木々をきりとったような広場が見える。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beyond the path Kohaku took lies a small clearing.
“What…? A clearing in a place like that…?”
I tilt my head and search my memory, but find only haze.
There it is among the estate woods, as though it had been cut out of the surrounding trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems there's a small clearing where Kohaku-san headed to.
"……… There's a clearing there……?"
Tilting my head to the side, I try to remember, but for some reason, my memory is a bit vague.
In the forest of the mansion, I can see a clearing as if the trees were cut there.

entries.japanese:
――――いや、見えるというのは正しくない。
　普通に歩いている分には決して見えなかったはずだ。
　琥珀さんがあそこに歩いて行かなければ、屋敷に住んでいながら一生気づかなかったぐらい隠れた、木々に囲まれた小さな広場。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――No—saying that I can see it isn’t quite right.
No ordinary path would ever have revealed it.
If Kohaku had not walked there, I might have lived in the estate my entire life without discovering that tiny clearing enclosed by trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---No, "can see" is not quite right.
If you walked by normally, you probably would never notice it.
If Kohaku-san didn't walk there, hidden enough by the surrounding trees as it is, I would never have noticed even if I lived here all my life.

entries.japanese:
「……あんな広場、あったかな……あったならかっこうの遊び場になってたはずなんだけど……」
　少なくとも森の中の広場で秋葉と遊んだ記憶はない。
――――ない、ような、気が、する。
「…………」
　少しだけ思案してから、その広場に入ってみることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was that clearing always there—if it was, it would have made the perfect playground.”
At least, I had no memory of ever playing with Akiha in a clearing in the woods.
――――I don’t think there was.
“…………”
After a moment’s thought, I step inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… There's a clearing there?
…… If so, we probably did play there as kids."
To say the least, I don't remember ever playing with Akiha in the clearing.

----I feel like I've never, been there, before.
"…………"
After thinking for a bit, I decide to go into the clearing.

entries.japanese:
……広場には特別なにもない。
　先に入っていった琥珀さんの姿もない。
「なんだ―――ただの空き地じゃないか」
　広場の真ん中へ歩いていく。
　広場は本当に、なんていうことはない空き地だった。
　きれいにまったいらにされた土の地面と、
　まわりを囲む深い森の木々。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is nothing unusual here.
Nor is there any sign of Kohaku, who entered before me.
“Oh―――it’s only an empty lot.”
I walk to its center.
It truly is nothing more than vacant ground.
Earth leveled smooth and flat,
surrounded by the trees of the deep wood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The clearing doesn't strike me as anything out of the ordinary.
There's no sign of Kohaku-san, who entered before me.
"What's this---just an empty place."
I walk to the middle of the clearing.
This clearing really is just an empty space.
The perfectly level open ground.
The deep woods enclosing the area.

entries.japanese:
蝉の声と。
　溶けるような、強い、夏の陽射し――――――
「え…………？」
　夏の、陽射し―――？
「い――――痛ぅ…………」
　胸の傷が痛む。
　まるで／ざくりと。
　包丁で胸を刺された／ような／この痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
The cry of cicadas.
Fierce summer sunlight, hot enough to melt the world――――――
“What…?”
Summer sunlight―――?
“Ah――――ow…”
The wound in my chest hurt.
As if / stabbed deep.
This pain / as if / a kitchen knife had been driven into my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice of the cicadas.
And the strong, summer sunshine that feels like it could dissolve------

"Eh…………?"
Summer, sunshine---?
"Ou----ouch……"
The wound on my chest starts to hurt.
Like / Stabbing.
This pain  / that feels like  / a kitchen knife stabbing my chest.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん―――――
――――どこかで、蝉の声がしている。
　今はもう、秋なのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min―――――
――――Somewhere, cicadas are crying.
Though autumn has already come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp-----
----From somewhere, I can hear the voice of cicadas.
But, it's autumn now.

entries.japanese:
――――白く溶けてしまいそうな夏の陽射し。
　遠くのそらには入道雲。
　見えるのは空蝉のこえ。
　足元には蝉のぬけがら。
　ぬけがら。
誰かの、ぬけがら。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Summer light so white it seems to dissolve everything.
Thunderheads tower in the distant sky.
I see the voice of an empty cicada shell.
At my feet lies a cicada husk.
A husk. Someone’s discarded husk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The summer sunshine that bathes everything in white.
The columns of summer clouds in the far off sky.
I can practically see the voices.
At my feet, there are the discarded shells of cicadas.
Discarded shell.
Someone's--discarded shell.

entries.japanese:
「――――………」
　三人目。
　三人目の子供の脱け殻。
　もう、思い出すコトもできない三人目のこども。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――………”
The third.
The husk of the third child.
The third child I could no longer even remember.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----………"
Third.
The third child's discarded shell.
The third child I no longer remember.

entries.japanese:
……うずくまる誰かの影法師。
　　　近寄ってくる幼いあきはの足音。
　　　遠くの空には入道雲。
空蝉の青いそら。
entries.maoEnglish:
A person’s shadow crouches there.
Little Akiha’s footsteps come closer.
Thunderheads in the distance. A blue summer sky, hollow as a cicada shell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Someone's crouching shadow.
Young Akiha's approaching footsteps.
Clouds high in the emptiness.
Cicadas in the blue sky.

entries.japanese:
ただ、夢中だった。
　　　あのままじゃあきはがころされてしまう。
　　　ほんとうに、それだけしかわからなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nothing else mattered.
At this rate Akiha would be killed.
That was truly all I understood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I was just, in a trance.
Akiha would have been killed.
That was really all I knew.

entries.japanese:
ただ、走っていた。
　　　そんなことしかわからなかった。
　　　自分のほうがあぶないなんて、
　　　そんなコトどうでもよかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I only ran.
That was all I knew how to do.
That I was the one in danger,
I did not care at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I just, ran.
That was all I understood.
As for the danger to myself,
I never even thought about it.

entries.japanese:
あきはをまもりたくて、
　　　あきはのかわりになっただけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wanting to protect Akiha,
I merely took her place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wanted to protect Akiha,
and I just took her place.

entries.japanese:
とおくで。
　　　セミの　なき声。
entries.maoEnglish:
Far away.
The cicadas crying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the distance.
The voices of the cicadas.

entries.japanese:
―――その後。
　　　胸を貫かれて殺されている俺の体と。
　　　俺の死体を呆然と見下ろす、
　　　三人目の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Afterward.
My body, lying dead with its chest pierced through.
And standing over my corpse,
staring down at it in a daze, was the third child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---After that.
My body that died from having its chest pierced.
And a figure that looks down at my dead body in shock.
A third child's figure-----

entries.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ」
　胸がいたい。
　吐き気がする。
　胸の傷はとうのむかしに塞がっているはずなのに、どうしてこんなにも痛むのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――gh.”
My chest hurts.
I’m going to be sick.
The wound closed long ago, so why does it hurt this much?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ua---gh."
My chest hurts.
I feel sick.
The wound in my chest should have closed long ago, so why does it hurt now?

entries.japanese:
胸が　壊れてる。
　古傷が開いて　セキショクの染みが流れ出す。
――――なんてこと。
　俺の傷は、ぜんぜん癒えてなんかいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My chest is broken.
The old wound splits open, and a crimson stain pours out.
――――How could this be?
My wound never healed at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My chest, rips.
The old wound opens, and a crimson stream flows out.
----What is this?
My wound, it didn't heal at all.

entries.japanese:
イタイ。
　　　コワイ。
――――眩暈がする。
　　　　　コレガ、
　　　　　　　　死トイウ衝動カ。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
IT HURTS.
I’M SCARED.
――――The world spins.
IS THIS THE IMPULSE
CALLED DEATH?!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
It hurts.
I'm scared.
----I feel dizzy.
This is,
the impulse of death.

entries.japanese:
意識が沈む。
　傷が痛む。
　どさり　と、自身の体が地面に倒れこむ音をきいた。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
Consciousness sinks.
The wound aches.
I hear my own body strike the ground with a heavy thud.!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Consciousness fades.
My wound aches.
I hear a thump as my body falls to the ground.

entries.japanese:
……話し声が聞こえてくる。
「秋葉さま、お医者さまをお呼びしないのですか？」
「馬鹿なことを言わないで翡翠。
呼べるわけないでしょう、兄さんの傷は普通の傷じゃないんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I could hear voices.
“Miss Akiha, shall I call a doctor?”
“Don’t be ridiculous, Hisui. We can’t call anyone because my brother’s wound isn’t an ordinary injury…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can hear voices talking.
"Akiha-sama, are you not going to call for a doctor?"
"Don't be stupid, Hisui.
There's no way I could do that, since Nii-san's wound isn't normal…!"

entries.japanese:
……あきは　と　ひすい　が話している。
　ここは　シキの　部屋だ。
　どうやら　ベッドの上で　眠っている　らしい。
　やあ、と声をあげて起きようとしたけれど、体が思うように動かない。
　胸の痛みはもうないくせに、体は鉛のように重い。
　満足に動くのは、目と口だけのようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
……akiha and hisui are talking
this is SHIKI’s room.
it seems i am asleep on the bed.
I tried to greet them and sit up, but my body refused to cooperate.
My chest no longer hurt, yet the rest of me weighed as much as lead.
Only my eyes and mouth seemed capable of moving properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Akiha   and   Hisui are talking.
This  is   SHIKI's room.
It looks   like   I am  sleeping  on the bed.
I planned to say "Yo!" and get out of bed, but I can't move at all.
My chest doesn't hurt anymore, but my body is as heavy as lead.
All I can move are my eyes and mouth.

entries.japanese:
「一体どういうつもりなの翡翠。
兄さんをあそこに近づけてはいけないって、あなたも知っているでしょうに……！」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝って済む問題じゃないわ。
あなたを兄さん付きの使用人にしたのは、こういう事態を避けさせるためでしょう？
　それを忘れて、あなたは何をやっていたっていうのよ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What were you thinking, Hisui? You knew you were never to let my brother near that place…!”
“I am—terribly sorry.”
“Sorry isn’t enough. I assigned you to my brother precisely to prevent this. Did you forget what you were supposed to be doing…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just what were you thinking, Hisui?
Nii-san mustn't be allowed to go there, you know that…!"
"Please…… Forgive me."
"This can't be solved by apologizing.
You were assigned to serve Nii-san to avoid this kind of situation.
So what were you doing…!?"

entries.japanese:
秋葉は普段からでは考えられないぐらい、感情を剥き出しにして怒っている。
　叱られている翡翠はうつむいたままずっと黙っていた。
　……俺には、二人がどうしてこうなっているのか全然わからない。
　わからないけれど、翡翠が俺のせいで怒られている、という事ぐらいは読み取れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s anger is more naked than I have ever seen it.
Hisui stands beneath the scolding with her head bowed, saying nothing.
I have no idea how things came to this.
But even I can understand that Hisui is being blamed because of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Completely different from her usual manner, Akiha gives full vent to her anger.
In comparison, Hisui is accepting the scolding silently, looking down.
…… I'm not sure how this all came about.
But I can at least tell Hisui is being yelled at because of me.

entries.japanese:
「答えなさい翡翠。
どうして兄さんはあの場所に行ってしまったの？」
　秋葉の質問に翡翠は答えない。
　二人の間の空気は段々と重苦しくなってくる。
　ぎゅっ、と唇をかみしめて、秋葉が翡翠に一歩だけ近寄る。
　……秋葉が、翡翠に手を上げようとしているのは、俺からでも読み取れた。
　翡翠も解っているだろうに、うつむいたままそれを黙って受け入れようとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me, Hisui. Why did my brother go there?”
Hisui does not answer.
The air between them grows steadily more oppressive.
Akiha bites her lip and takes one step toward her.
Even from here, I can tell that Akiha is about to strike her.
Hisui must know it too, yet she keeps her head bowed and silently prepares to accept the blow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer me, Hisui.
Why did Nii-san go there?"
Hisui does not answer Akiha's question.
The air between them is becoming heavy.
Biting her lip, Akiha takes a step closer to Hisui.
…… Even I can tell that she's about to raise a hand against her.
I'm sure Hisui knows too, but she's just looking down, accepting it.

entries.japanese:
「―――ちょっと待て秋葉」
「兄さん――気がついたんですか！？」
「ああ、秋葉があんまりにうるさいんで、いま目がさめた」
「あ…………」
　秋葉は気まずそうに視線をそらす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Wait, Akiha.”
“Brother――you’re awake!?”
“Yeah, Akiha was making so much noise that she woke me up.”
“Ah…”
Akiha averts her eyes, suddenly uncomfortable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hold on, Akiha."
"Nii-san--you're awake!?"
"Yeah, you were so loud, I woke up."
"Ah…………"
Akiha looks away uncomfortably.

entries.japanese:
「あのさ、あんまり翡翠にあたるなよ。
事情はしらないけど、ようするに俺が倒れたことでもめてるんだろ？
　なら翡翠に責任なんかないよ。
こんなの俺がかってに倒れただけなんだから」
　よっ、と腕に力をこめて、なんとか上半身だけベッドから起こした。
　今は、それだけでもう指一本だって動かせそうにない。
　けれど翡翠が落ち込んでいる手前、無理をしてでも元気なフリをしなくちゃいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t take it out on Hisui. I don’t know the whole story, but this is about me collapsing, right? Then it isn’t her fault. I fell over all by myself.”
With a grunt, I forced enough strength into my arms to raise my upper body from the bed.
That alone left me unable to move so much as a finger.
But with Hisui looking so crushed, I had to pretend I was fine, no matter how much it cost me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, you shouldn't let it out on Hisui.
I don't know the circumstances, but this has to do with me collapsing, right?
It's not her fault, I just collapsed on my own."
I strain hard and somehow manage to lift the upper half of my body off the bed.
But that's all I can manage, and I don't think I can even move an inch more.
But since Hisui is depressed, I have to force myself to act as fine as possible.

entries.japanese:
「……まったく、おまえも俺のコトなんかでケンカなんかするな。
大人びたように見えてまだ子供なんだな」
「でも――――兄さんはずっと気を失っていたんですよ？
　五時間以上も昏睡しているなんて、今までなかったはずです。
もし―――もし兄さんがあのまま目が覚めなかったら、私はどうすればいいんですか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, don’t start fights over me. You look so grown-up, but you’re still a child after all.”
“But――――you were unconscious for hours! You’ve never been in a coma for more than five hours before. If―――if you had never woken up, what was I supposed to do…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Honestly, getting into a fight over me.
Even if you look like an adult, you're still a child."
"But----you were out for a long time, Nii-san.
You were out for more than five hours, and nothing like this has happened before.
What would I have done if you'd never woken up…!"

entries.japanese:
「ばか、縁起でもないこというなよ。
こんなのはただの貧血じゃないか。
……って、なんだ。
もう夜の十時をまわってるのか」
「……ええ。
兄さんは夕方から今まで、ずっと気を失っていたんです」
　遠慮がちに秋葉は語る。
「――――――」
　どっ、と体から力が抜けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot, don’t say things like that. It was only anemia. Wait—what? It’s already past ten?”
“Yes. You have been unconscious since this afternoon.”
Akiha’s voice turns diffident.
“――――――”
All the strength leaves my body at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Idiot, don't say things like that.
This is just anemia… Eh?
It's ten o'clock already?"
"…… Yes.
Nii-san, you have been out all evening."
Akiha speaks reluctantly.
"------"
The strength flees from my body.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
そんなに長く気絶してたなんて、小学校以来だ。
ああ、あの時は頻繁に倒れてたっけ。
有間の家になれなくってさ、神経がまいってたんだ」
　貧血の後遺症か、なんだかまだユメを見ているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s bad. I haven’t been out that long since elementary school. I used to collapse all the time back then. I couldn’t adjust to living with the Arimas, and my nerves were shot.”
Perhaps it is the aftereffect of the anemia, but I still feel half trapped in a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
I haven't fainted for that long since elementary school.
Yeah, I used to faint all the time back then.
I wasn't used to the Arimas and my mind was always under stress."
It seems like I'm still dreaming, maybe an after-effect of the anemia attack.

entries.japanese:
「……おぼえてる。
有間の家の人たちはいい人ばかりで、俺を本当の子供みたいに扱ってくれた。
―――啓子さんは厳しいけど思いやりがある人で、俺を本当の子供なんだって自分に言い聞かせてた。
　……だから、俺も――本当の子供にならなくっちゃって、思ってたんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I remember. Everyone in the Arima family was kind and treated me like their own child.
―――Keiko was strict but caring, and she kept telling herself I really was her son.
So I――I thought I had to become a real son too.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I remember.
The Arimas were all good people; they treated me like their own child."
---Keiko-san was strict but thoughtful and always treated me like I was her own son.
"…… So, I thought I had to become their real child, too."

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、無理はしないで。
ここは遠野の屋敷です。
兄さんがそんなコトを自分に言い聞かせる必要なんて、もうないんです……！」
「――――わかってる。
　けど、昔から、そう思ってた。
物心ついた時から、ずっと思ってたんだ。
　……有間の人たちも秋葉たちもいい人ばっかりで、だから、すごく、つらかった―――」
　……何を言っているんだろう、俺は。
　ぼんやりと天井をみながら、自分でも思い出せないぐらい昔の出来事を思い返して。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, don’t force yourself. This is the Tohno estate. You no longer need to tell yourself anything like that.”
“――――I know.
But I’d always felt that way. Ever since I was old enough to remember, I had felt that way.
The Arimas and all of you are good people, so it hurt me terribly―――”
What am I talking about?
I stare vaguely at the ceiling, remembering things from so long ago I can no longer properly recall them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, don't push yourself.
This is the Tohno mansion.
You don't have to tell yourself that anymore…!"
"----I know.
But, for a long time, I thought that way.
From the beginning, I always thought that.
…… The Arimas, and you, you're all good people, so, it was so hard---"
…… What am I saying?
Gazing vacantly at the ceiling, thinking back to memories of long ago.

entries.japanese:
「……無理はなさらないで。
兄さんがここに帰ってきてまだ一週間です。
ですから、色々と疲れがたまっているんです」
「――そうかな。
……まあ、疲れは溜まっている、けど」
「でしょう？
　ですから、今日はもうこのままお休みください。
兄さんは人より体が不安定なんですから、たまには一日ゆっくり休まないと今日のように倒れてしまうんです」
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please don’t overtax yourself. You’ve only been back for a week, Brother. Naturally, the strain has accumulated.”
“――Maybe. Well, I am tired, though.”
“Exactly, so please remain in bed tonight. Your health is less stable than other people’s. Unless you occasionally rest for an entire day, you’ll collapse again just as you did today.”
Akiha watches me with grave eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please, don't push yourself, Nii-san.
You've only been back here for a week.
So you must be tired."
"--Really.
Well, I'm tired, but…"
"Right?
So, please, just rest today.
Since your body's weaker than most people's, if you don't take a day to rest from time to time, you'll collapse like you did today."
Akiha looks at me seriously.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……たしかに、秋葉の言うとおりだ。
　何もかも忘れて。
　吸血鬼のことも自分のことも考えないで休まないと、本当に参ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“………………”
Akiha is right.
I need to forget everything.
Unless I rest without thinking about vampires or myself, I truly will break.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
…… Certainly, it's just as she says.
Forgetting about everything.
Unless I rest without thinking about vampires or about myself, I'll really be out of it.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだね。
秋葉の言うとおり、今日はおとなしく横になっているよ」
　言って、ベッドに体を横たえた。
「ほんとう……？
　あとになって部屋を抜け出したりするのもナシですよ？」
「なんだよそれ。
俺、そんなに信用ないのかな」
　……ああ、ないか。
　今まで散々、秋葉を放っておいたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll take your advice and stay in bed tonight.”
I lower myself onto the mattress.
“You promise? You won’t sneak out later?”
“What’s that supposed to mean? Do you trust me that little?”
Ah—no, she doesn’t.
Not after I neglected her so thoroughly for all these years.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're right.
As you say, I'll just lie quietly today."
Saying so, I lie down again.
"Really…?
No more sneaking out of your room later, too?"
"What is that?
Am I that untrustworthy?"
…… Yeah, I guess so.
I've left Akiha alone for all this time.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、琥珀に兄さんが目を覚ました事を伝えにいって。
兄さん、夕食はどうしますか？」
「……そっか。
いや、琥珀さんには悪いけど、食べられそうにない」
「……わかりました。
じゃあ翡翠、そう琥珀に伝えてきて」
　翡翠はうつむいたままコクン、とうなずいて部屋から出て行く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, tell Kohaku that my brother has awakened. Brother, would you like dinner?”
“Oh. No, I’m sorry to Kohaku, but I don’t think I can eat.”
“I understand. Hisui, please tell Kohaku that as well.”
Still looking down, Hisui gives a small nod and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, tell Kohaku that Nii-san is up.
Nii-san, what will you do about dinner?"
"…… I see.
Well, my apologies to Kohaku-san, but I don't feel like eating."
"…… I understand.
Well, Hisui, please inform Kohaku."
Still looking down, Hisui nods in assent and leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「さあ兄さん。
今夜はもうお休みになってください」
　すごく優しい声で秋葉は言う。
　けど、眠るのは。
　眠って、またあんな悪夢を見るのは恐い。
「いや、俺は―――」
「……お願いします、兄さん。
今日だけは私の言うことを聞いてくれるっていったでしょう……？」
　懇願するような、秋葉の目。
　……本当に心の底から、秋葉は俺のことを案じてくれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, Brother. Please sleep for the rest of the night.”
Akiha’s voice is remarkably gentle.
But sleep means dreaming.
The thought of seeing that nightmare again terrifies me.
“No, I―――”
“Please, Brother. You said that for today, at least, you would listen to me…”
Akiha’s eyes plead with me.
She truly is worried for me from the bottom of her heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, Nii-san.
Please go to sleep for tonight."
Akiha speaks in a very gentle tone.
But, to sleep…
I'm afraid that if I sleep, I'll see that nightmare.
"No, I---"
"Please, Nii-san.
Didn't you say you'll listen to what I say, just for today…?"
Akiha's eyes are pleading.
…… From the bottom of her heart, Akiha is really worried about me.

entries.japanese:
「わかった。
大人しく眠るよ」
「……はい。
ありがとうございます」
「ばか、なんでそこで礼なんか言うんだよ。
お礼を言いたいのはこっちのほうだ」
　……俺を。
　八年間もおまえを放っておいた俺を、この屋敷に呼び戻してくれたのはそっちのほうなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll go to sleep.”
“Yes. Thank you.”
“Idiot, why are you thanking me? I’m the one who should be grateful.”
Me.
After all, you are the one who brought me—who left you alone for eight years—back to this estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
I'll sleep quietly."
"…… Yes.
Thank you."
"Silly.
Why are you thanking me?
I should be the one thanking you."
…… Thanking me?
Even though I neglected you for eight years, you're the one who called me back to this mansion.

entries.japanese:
「―――秋葉。
その、いろいろごめんな。
たしかに俺は身勝手で、秋葉のことを考えてやれなかった。
けど、これからは―――」
「いいんです。
兄さんは今までどおり兄さんのままでいてください。
　それに、謝らなくちゃいけないのは私のほうなんです。
……兄さんは私に謝らないでください。
そんなことをされたら、私は本当にいやな女になってしまいます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Akiha. I’m sorry for everything. I was selfish and never stopped to think about you. But from now on―――”
“No. Please remain exactly as you have always been, Brother.
Besides, I am the one who owes an apology. Please don’t apologize to me. If you do, I’ll become a truly hateful woman.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Akiha.
I'm… sorry for everything.
I'm selfish, and never thought about you.
But, from now on…"
"It's fine.
Please stay as you are, Nii-san.
And, I should be the one who's apologizing.
Please, don't apologize to me.
If you do, I'll feel like a really horrible person."

entries.japanese:
瞳に涙をためて、秋葉はじっと俺の手を握っている。
　……わからない。
　どうして秋葉がそんな事を言うのか。
　どうしてそんな―――ごめんなさいって、繰り返すのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tears fill Akiha’s eyes as she holds tightly to my hand.
I don’t understand.
Why would she say such a thing?
Why does she keep repeating that word―――sorry?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha grasps my hand, tears welling in her eyes.
…… I don't understand.
Why Akiha is saying such things.
Or why she keeps repeating "I'm sorry".

entries.japanese:
「……眠くなってきた。
少し、眠る」
「―――はい。
おやすみなさい、兄さん」
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m getting sleepy. I think I’ll rest.”
“―――Yes. Good night, Brother.”!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm, getting tired.
I'll, sleep for a bit."
"---Yes.
Good night, Nii-san."

entries.japanese:
……胸の古傷が痛む。
　三人目のこども。
　……それはきっと、十年前に養子にとられて、すぐに死んでしまったこどもだ。
　暑い夏の日。
　血だらけのこどものすがた。
　不吉なことばかり積み重なっていく、遠野志貴の世界。
entries.maoEnglish:
The old wound in my chest aches.
The third child.
It must be the child adopted ten years ago, the one who died almost immediately.
A sweltering summer day.
A child drenched in blood.
Omen upon omen gathering in the world of Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The wound in my chest hurts.
The third child.
…… Probably, it's the child who was adopted ten years ago, and died soon after.
A hot summer day.
A figure of a bloody child.
The world of Tohno Shiki, filled with ill omens.

entries.japanese:
―――とくん。
　だっていうのに、静かだ。
―――とくん。
　気持ちが安らぐ。
―――とくん。
　すぐ近くに、あきはの鼓動。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
And yet everything is quiet.
―――Thump.
Peace settles over me.
―――Thump.
Akiha’s heartbeat, very close beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
But, it's so quiet.
---Thump.
I feel at ease.
---Thump.
Akiha's heartbeat is very close.

entries.japanese:
―――とくん。
　本当に、静かだ。
――とく、ん。
　そうして何日かぶりに、悪い夢を見ない穏やかな眠りに落ちていけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
It is truly quiet.
――Thum, p.
And for the first time in days, I drift into a peaceful sleep untouched by nightmares.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
It's really quiet.
--Thump.
And for the first time in days, I sleep calmly, untroubled by nightmares.

entries.japanese:
……いや、何の根拠もない。
　シエル先輩に自分の夢の出来事を相談して何になるっていうんだ。
　あの夢。
　殺人の夢を見るのは他でもない自分自身なら、それを解決できるのも自分以外にありえない。
「おい遠野。
グズグズしてる暇なんかねえぞ」
「―――わかってる。
ダッシュで教室に戻らないと間に合わないんだろ」
　言って、自分たちの教室に向かって走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no basis for it.
What good could come of telling Ciel about my dreams?
They are my dreams.
If I am the one dreaming of murder, no one but me can resolve them.
“Hey, Tohno. We do not have time to stand around.”
“―――I know. We will be late unless we sprint back to class.”
With that, I break into a run.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… No, there's no reason to.
What can Ciel-senpai do if I talk to her about my dreams?
That dream.
If I'm the person who dreams about killing people, then I'm the only one who should be able to solve that problem.
"Yo, Tohno, we don't have much time."
"------I know, we won't make it unless we run, right?"
Saying so, I start running toward our classroom.

entries.japanese:
―――――放課後になった。
　秋葉の事や自分のことで混乱しながら、とりあえず一日が終わろうとしている。
「―――帰るか」
　秋葉を迎えにいって、屋敷に帰ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――School lets out.
Though my thoughts remain tangled around Akiha and myself, the day is finally drawing to a close.
“―――Time to go.”
I will collect Akiha, and we will head home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----------School is over now.
I was confused about myself and Akiha, but today is about to end.
"------Should I go back?"
I should go get Akiha and go back to our mansion.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と一緒に帰路につく。
　……昼休みの時と同じように、二人きりになるとお互い会話が途絶えてしまった。
―――秋葉と話したいと思う反面、秋葉の顔を見るのが照れくさい。
「……まったく、中学生じゃあるまいし」
「……？
　何か言いましたか、兄さん？」
「あ―――いや、なんでもない。
ただの独り言」
　……はあ。
　ほんと、一体何をしているんだろう遠野志貴は。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I start home together.
Just as at lunch, the moment we are alone, conversation deserts us both.
―――I want to talk to her, yet somehow I’m too self-conscious even to look at her face.
“Honestly, I’m not a middle-schooler anymore.”
“Hm? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Ah―――no. Just talking to myself.”
Haaah.
What are you doing, Shiki Tohno?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk home together with Akiha.
…… Just like lunchtime, we grow quiet as soon as there are only the two of us.
---While I want to talk to Akiha, I also feel embarrassed looking at Akiha.
"…… Man, it's not like I'm some middle schooler."
"…?
Did you say something, Nii-san?"
"Oh---no, it's nothing, just talking to myself."
…… *sigh*
Really, what the hell am I doing?

entries.japanese:
長い坂道につく。
　ここを登りきれば屋敷は目の前だ。
「兄さん。
屋敷に戻る前に、一つお聞きしたい事があります」
　ぴたり、と足を止めて、秋葉はまっすぐに俺を見据えてきた。
「―――――」
　そこにはさっきまでの、じれったいような沈黙はない。
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで俺を見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach the long slope.
Once we climb it, the estate will be directly ahead.
“Brother. Before we return to the estate, there is one thing I wish to ask you.”
Akiha stops dead and faces me squarely.
“―――――”
The awkward silence from before is gone.
Her gaze is grave and unwavering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We reach the long hill.
Once we go up it, our mansion will be right there.
"Nii-san.
I would like to ask you one thing before we get home."
Akiha's feet stop and she looks straight at me.
"-----"
The kind of silence that was there before is gone.
Akiha looks at me seriously.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ。
聞きたい事ってなに？」
「答えたくなければ答えなくていいんですけど―――兄さん、私に何か隠している事があるんじゃないですか？」
「は――――？」
　あんまりにトウトツな秋葉の質問に、ぴたりと足が止まってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sure. What do you want to ask?”
“You need not answer if you do not wish to―――Brother, are you hiding something from me?”
“What――――?”
The question is so abrupt that it stops me in my tracks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, what do you wanna ask about?"
"If you don't want to answer, that's fine but-----do you have something you are hiding from me, Nii-san?"
"Huh-------?"
The question is so abrupt, I stop in my tracks.

entries.japanese:
「ふぅん……隠してることって、なにが？」
　とりあえずとぼけてみた。
「なにがって、だから何かをです。
ここ数日の兄さんの態度は明らかにヘンですもの。
一緒に暮らしているんですから、それぐらいすぐに分かります」
　じっ……、とこっちの心を見透かすような目をする秋葉。
「―――――う」
　……ダメだ。
当たり障りのない返答で誤魔化す事はできそうにない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hiding something, like what?”
I try playing dumb.
“What I mean is, something. You have clearly been behaving strangely these past few days. We live together, so naturally I would notice.”
Akiha stares as though she can see straight through me.
“―――――Urgh.”
This is hopeless. I cannot evade her with some harmless answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… What are you talking about?"
I decide to act like I don't know what she's talking about.
"What?
That's what I am asking.
You have been acting very strange these past few days.
I can easily tell since we live together."
Akiha looks at me as if she can read my mind.
"--------Uhh."
…… No, there's no way I can lie to her without her finding out.

entries.japanese:
「……やっぱり何か隠しているんですね。
　兄さんがここのところ元気がないのも今朝のコトも、それが原因なんでしょう？
　何を悩んでいるか知りませんけど、兄さんの隠し事はそんなに難しいコトなんですか？」
「――――」
　……驚いた。
　秋葉は、俺が一人で悩んでいたことに気付いてたのか。
「秋葉……おまえ、気付いてたのか」
「あたりまえです。
私たちは兄妹なんですから、兄さんが落ち込んでいる事ぐらい感じ取れます。
だっていうのに兄さんは一人で抱え込んでしまって、私たちに相談さえしてくれない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you are hiding something.
That explains why you have been so listless lately, and what happened this morning. I do not know what is troubling you, but is this secret truly so difficult to share?”
“――――”
I am stunned.
Akiha noticed that I was suffering alone.
“Akiha, you knew?”
“Of course. We are brother and sister, so I can at least tell when you are unhappy. Yet you keep everything to yourself and refuse even to speak to us.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… So you are hiding something.
Is that the reason you have not been feeling well recently, like this morning?
I do not know what is troubling you but is it so bad you have to hide it?"
"--------"
…… I'm surprised.
Akiha knew that I was worrying about the problem by myself.
"Akiha…… you noticed?"
"Of course.
We are brother and sister.
I can tell when you are depressed, Nii-san.
Yet you keep the problem to yourself and don't even ask us for help."

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――相談って、そんなコト―――」
　そんなコト、できるわけがない。
　毎夜、殺人の夢を見て。
　それが夢なんだか現実なんだか自分でも解らず、実際に自分の夢の通りに犠牲者が出てしまっていて。
　遠野志貴は殺人鬼なのかもしれないから、夜になったら気をつけてくれなんていう、そんな相談ができる筈がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――I cannot tell you something like that―――”
I can never do that.
Every night, I dream of murder.
I can no longer tell whether the dreams are real, and actual victims are discovered exactly as I dream them.
How can I ask them to be careful after dark because Shiki Tohno might be a killer?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"!!
-------I can't ask you for help-----"
I can never do that.
How I dream about murder every night.
And that I can't tell if it's real or just a dream, and the victims in real life are just like the ones in my dream.
I can't tell her that I, Tohno Shiki, might be a killer, so be careful at night.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、私たちは兄妹でしょう？
　でしたら少しは頼ってください。
私だけじゃなく、琥珀も翡翠も兄さんの事を心配しています。
　兄さん一人で解決できないような悩みなら私たちもお力になりますから、どうか悩みをうちあけてください」
「秋葉――――――」
　秋葉はじっと見つめてくる。
　……そこにあるのは、ただ俺を心配している真摯な瞳だけだ。
　秋葉は俺が隠し事をしているのを責めているんじゃなくて、俺の悩みをなんとか解決しようと努力している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, we are family. Please rely on us a little. Kohaku and Hisui are worried too.
If this problem is more than you can solve alone, we will help; please tell us what troubles you.”
“Akiha――――――”
Akiha holds my gaze.
Her eyes contain nothing but sincere concern.
She is not accusing me of keeping secrets; she is trying with all her heart to help me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
We're brother and sister, right?
Then please rely on me a bit.
Not just me, but both Kohaku and Hisui are also worried about you.
If it's a problem you can't solve by yourself, we will gladly help you, so please tell us about it."
"Akiha----------"
Akiha just stares at me.
…… Her eyes are filled only with worry.
Akiha is not complaining to me for hiding something from her, but she is trying to help me solve my problem.

entries.japanese:
「…………ば」
　だから余計にうち明けられない。
　自分が―――遠野秋葉の兄が殺人鬼かもしれないなんていう事は、絶対に口にできない。
「ばかなこと言うなよ。
俺に隠し事なんてないし、悩みなんてあるわけないだろ。
　ここんところ元気がなかったのは屋敷の生活に慣れていなかっただけ――――」
「……………」
　ぎろり、と敵意のこもった視線を向けてくる秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ridic…”
That makes it even more impossible to confess.
I can never tell her that I, Akiha Tohno’s brother―――might be a murderer.
“Do not be ridiculous. I am not hiding anything, and nothing is troubling me.
I have only been out of sorts because I am still getting used to life at the estate――――”
“……………”
Akiha glares at me with open hostility.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… D-"
That's why I can't tell her.
I---Tohno Akiha's brother might be a killer---those words would never come out of my mouth.
"Don't say stupid things.
I'm not hiding anything and I don't have any problems.
I wasn't feeling well recently because I wasn't used to the life in the mansion-----"
"……………"
Akiha looks at me angrily.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――秋葉？」
「わかりました。
私がこれだけ言ってるのに聞いてくれないんですね、兄さんは。
私だけじゃなくて、琥珀や翡翠も信用できないというのでしたら、もうこれ以上言うことはありませんから」
　ふん、と鼻をならして秋葉は顔を背ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――Akiha?”
“I understand. Even after all I have said, you refuse to listen. If you cannot trust me, Kohaku, or Hisui, then I have nothing more to say, Brother.”
Akiha gives an indignant huff and turns away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----Akiha?"
"I understand.
You won't listen to me even after all that I've said.
If you can't trust me or Kohaku or Hisui, then there's nothing more I want to say."
Akiha breathes out and looks away.

entries.japanese:
「なっ……違うぞ秋葉、俺は秋葉たちを信用してないとかじゃなくて、ただ――――」
「言い訳は結構ですっ！
　そんなに隠し事がお好きなら、どうぞご自由になさってください！」
　ぴしゃりと怒鳴って、秋葉は坂道を駆け上がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, Akiha, that is not it; it is not that I do not trust you and the others, I just――――”
“I have heard enough excuses! If you love your secrets so much, keep them!”
With that furious retort, Akiha runs up the hill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, that's wrong, Akiha.
It's not that I don't trust you guys, but-----"
"I don't want to hear your excuses!
If you like secrets so much, then do what you want!!"
Akiha screams at me and runs up the hill.

entries.japanese:
―――追いかける事はできなかった。
　走って秋葉を掴まえても、俺は自分の悩みごとをうち明ける事ができない。
　……それは、結局。
　どんな事情であれ、自分は秋葉たちを信用しきれていないという事だからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I could not follow her.
Even if I run after her and catch her, I still cannot reveal what torments me.
In the end.
Whatever my reasons, it means I do not trust Akiha and the others completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I could not chase after her.
Even if I chased her, I would not be able to tell her anything.
…… Then that means,
it doesn't matter what goes on; I do not trust them well enough.

entries.japanese:
夕食が終わって、就寝時間がやってきた。
　食事時も食後のお茶会でも秋葉は俺のことを無視していた。
坂での一件をまだ怒っているんだろう。
　……今回ばっかりは、一日や二日ぐらいで秋葉の怒りは収まってくれそうにない。
「いや、そのほうが都合はいいのか」
―――そう、これ以上自分の夢に脅えているわけにはいかない。
　シエル先輩に相談しなかったのも、悩みをうち明けてほしいという秋葉を拒絶したのも、自分だけで解決すると決めたからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Dinner ends, and bedtime comes.
Akiha ignores me through the meal and the tea afterward. She is clearly still angry about what happened on the hill.
This time, I doubt her anger will fade in a day or two.
“Maybe that’s more convenient.”
―――I could not go on fearing my dreams.
I had refused to speak to Ciel, and rejected Akiha’s plea that I confide in her, because I had decided to solve this alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Dinner has ended and it's time to go to bed.
Akiha ignored me during dinner and during the tea afterwards.
She must be still mad about that conversation we had at the hill.
…… This time, it doesn't seem like her anger will fade in a matter of days.
"No, that's better for me."
------Yes, I can't be afraid of my own dreams anymore.
I didn't ask Ciel-senpai for help and I rejected Akiha's offer for help, because I've decided I will solve this on my own.

entries.japanese:
「俺が―――遠野志貴が殺人鬼でないと証明する方法―――」
　そんなもの、今の俺には一つぐらいしか考え付かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A way to prove that I―――Shiki Tohno―――am not a murderer.”
I can think of only one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"To prove that I, Tohno Shiki, am not the killer-----"
I can only think of one way to do that.

entries.japanese:
部屋の電気を消して、ナイフをポケットにいれる。
「………よし、行くか」
　物音をたてないように部屋を後にする。
　自分が殺人鬼なのかどうかを証明する方法。
　……そんなもの、考えるまでもない。
　単に夜の街を探し回って、俺じゃない別の殺人鬼を見つけ出せばいいだけの話なんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
I switch off the light and slip the knife into my pocket.
“All right, let us go.”
Without making a sound, I leave the room.
A way to prove whether I am the murderer.
There is no need to think about it.
All I have to do is search the city at night and find another killer, someone other than me―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I turn off the lights in my room and put the knife in my pocket.
"……… Let's go."
I leave the room, trying not to make any noise.
To prove if I am a killer or not.
…… I don't even have to think about it.
I just have to look around the town at night and find the killer which isn't me------

entries.japanese:
は――――ぁ、と息を吐いた。
―――――夜の街を歩きまわる。
　ポケットに手をいれて、その中に隠したナイフの硬さを指先に感じながら、夜の街を歩きまわる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I breathe out――――slowly.
―――――I wander through the city at night.
With one hand in my pocket, my fingertips resting against the hard knife concealed there, I wander through the city at night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let out a long breath.
----------I walk around the night-shrouded town.

I put a hand in my pocket, feeling the knife in there on my fingertips as I walk around town.

entries.japanese:
はぁ―――はぁ。
――――息を潜めて歩きまわる。
　出来るだけ目立たないように。
　物陰から、周囲の人間たちの視界から隠れるように、通り過ぎていく人々を観察していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah.
――――I move with my breath held.
As inconspicuously as possible.
From the shadows, hidden from the eyes around me, I watch the people passing by.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*-----*pant*
-------I breathe quietly as I walk around.
Trying not to draw attention.
I look at the people passing by as I conceal my presence.

entries.japanese:
はぁ―――はぁ、はあ。
――――殺人鬼を、探している。
　今夜もきっと襲われるだろう、新しい被害者を探している。
　たとえば、長い黒髪の女。
　年齢は自分と同い年ぐらいが一番好ましい。
　手足の美しさはもとより、首筋の優雅さを評価すべきだ。
　全ては結局、その一点に収束する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah, hah.
――――I am looking for the murderer.
Looking for the next victim, the one who will surely be attacked tonight.
A woman, perhaps, with long black hair.
Someone my own age would be ideal.
Beautiful arms and legs matter, naturally, but the grace of her throat deserves the closest appraisal.
Everything comes down to that one point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*------*pant*, *pant*.
--------I am searching for the killer.
Someone will get attacked tonight.
He is looking for a new victim.
Say, a girl with long, black hair.
A girl around my age would be best.
No need to mention the beauty of her hands and feet, but the beauty of her neck should be considered.
In the end, everything counts on that one spot.

entries.japanese:
は―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
――――殺人鬼を探している。
　……すぐに見つかるとは思っていない。
　理想の獲物が簡単に見つかるものではないのは、夢の中で何度も味わっていたからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah, hah, hah.
――――I am looking for the murderer.
I do not expect to find one at once.
My dreams have taught me again and again that ideal prey does not present itself so easily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*p-pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
--------I look for the killer.
…… I know I won't find him easily.
I knew from my dreams that the perfect prey is hard to find.

entries.japanese:
ハァ……ハァ……ハァ
　に、して、も。
　今夜の街は、退屈だ。
　エモノが見つからない。
　頭にくる。
目的は、たしか。
誰かを見つけるコトとか、誰かを排除するコト、だったっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
HAH, HAH, HAH
Even so.
The city is boring tonight.
No prey.
It makes me furious. My purpose, I think. To find someone or eliminate someone; was that it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
B… u… t
Tonight, this town bores me.
I cannot find my PREY.
I'm getting angry.
My objective was to find someone, or to kill someone, or something like that.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ハ」
　息を殺そう。
　ナイフはずっと握り締めておく。
　いつでも、コロシカエセルように、神経を研ぎ澄ませていなければなるまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Hah.”
Keep the breath silent.
Keep the knife clenched tight.
Hone every nerve so I can KILL IT BACK at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------Ha…"
I'll hold my breath.
I'll hold on to my knife.
I should concentrate, so I will be able to return death at any time.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ。
―――サツジンキを、探している。
　だが見つからない。
　ただ時間だけが過ぎていく。
　はぁ、はぁ、と。
　膨張し、研ぎ澄まされ、消耗し、摩耗し尽くし、いずれはササクレだち、変形し――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah.
―――I am looking for THE KILLER.
But I cannot find the killer.
Only time passes.
Hah, hah.
Swelling, sharpening, exhausting itself, wearing itself away until it frays and warps――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I pant more and more.
---I look for the KILLER.
But I can't find him.
Only time passes.
*pant*, *pant*.
It overflows, sharpens, is used, is used up, and over time stands up, and changes form and-------

entries.japanese:
目の前に、今夜のエモノが転がっていた。
「はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ」
　女の死体だ。
　オレの手にはナイフがあって、ぼたり、ぼたり、と赤い血を滴らせている。
――――なぜだろう。
　サツジンキを探していたハズなのに、いつのまにか、オレの目の前には真新しい女の死体が転がっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tonight’s prey lay sprawled before me.
“Hah, hah, hah, hah.”
A woman’s corpse.
In my hand, a knife drips red blood, drop by drop.
――――Why?
I was looking for the killer; yet somehow a fresh woman’s corpse lies at my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In front of me lies tonight's prey.
My panting fills the air.
It is a dead woman's corpse.
In my hand is a knife.
The red blood on my knife drips to the ground.
--------Why?
I was looking for the killer, but all of a sudden, there's the dead body of a woman right in front of me.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ。
　呼吸が乱れる。
　目の前には死体。
　俺の手には、血に染まったナイフ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah.
My breathing will not steady.
A corpse before me.
A bloodstained knife in my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
My breathing gets out of control.
A dead body in front of me.
A bloody knife in my hand.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――――I do not understand.
entries.mirrorMoon: --------------I don't understand.

entries.japanese:
いつ、どんな隙間に、何をしたのか。
　俺の神経は、どうかしてしまったのか。
　そう、たとえば。
　膨張し、研ぎ澄まされ、消耗し、摩耗し尽くし、いずれはササクレだち、変形し、意味を変え、自在となり、炸裂し、閃光する。
　その過程。
　意識と意義の進化論。
　だが重大な過程が失われている。
entries.maoEnglish:
When had it happened?
In what missing instant had I done it?
Had my nerves gone wrong?
Imagine it: swelling, sharpening, exhausting itself, wearing itself away until it frays, warps, changes meaning, becomes fluid, bursts, flashes.
A process.
The evolution of consciousness and meaning.
But one crucial stage was missing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When, at what time, what I did.
Did something happen to my mind?
Yes, like…
it overflows, sharpens, is used, is used up, and over time stands up, and changes form, changes its meaning, becomes free, explodes, and lightens up.
On that path.
The theory of evolving consciousness and meaning.
But an important path is missing.

entries.japanese:
俺は。
　いつから。
　オレに。
　成っていたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I…
When had I…
become…
ME?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since when.
Did I.
Turn into.
The other "me"?

entries.japanese:
―――――なんだ。
　オレがゆさぶる必要もなかったな、志貴。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Well, look at that.
Guess I never needed to rattle you after all, Shiki.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---------I see.
There was no need for me to give you a push, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
背後で。
　そんな、声がした。
「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、はぁ」
　振り返る。
　そこには。
　初めて見る、自分と似たような顔をした、誰かが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Behind me.
A voice speaks.
“Hah, hah, hah, hah.”
I turn.
There.
Someone I have never seen stands there, wearing a face much like mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
From behind me,
comes a voice.
Heavy breathing.
I turn around.
There.
Someone I have never seen before, yet someone who looks like me, stands there.

entries.japanese:
―――壊れちまったのなら仕方がないか。
　　　あばよ志貴。
もう少し、おまえで楽しみたかったんだけどな。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――If you’re already broken, there’s no helping it.
See you, Shiki. I’d hoped to enjoy you a little longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------It can't be helped if you're already broken.
Bye, Shiki.
I wanted to play around with you for a bit longer.

entries.japanese:
ざっ、と墨を引くように、ナイフで切り裂かれた。
　イタイ。
　ユカイ。
　フカイ。
　ツーカイ。
!w1000
entries.maoEnglish:
The knife sweeps across me like a stroke of black ink.
PAIN.
THRILL.
CHILL.
SHEER THRILL.!w1000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slash.
I'm cut with a knife.
It hurts.
It's funny.
It's deep.
It's great!

entries.japanese:
「は―――はは、は」
　意識が遠のく。
　そのまま、あいまいな意識のまま、俺は殺された。
　……なんとなく、嬉しい。
　遠野志貴はサツジンキに殺された。
　それはつまり、自分が、殺人鬼ではなかったという事を証明していたからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha―――ha ha, ha.”
Consciousness recedes.
In the haze, I am killed.
Somehow, I am glad.
Shiki Tohno is killed by THE KILLER.
That proves I am not the murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha------haha, ha."
I start to pass out.
Like that, in that ambiguous state, I was killed.
…… I'm happy, in a way.
Tohno Shiki was killed by the killer.
That's proof that I wasn't the killer.

entries.japanese:
メルシー！
　はい、惜しくもデッドエンドを迎えてしまった遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
　三日目の三時間目は協力することの大切さをお教えします。
　ほら、ダメですよ遠野くん。
　遠野くんが巻き込まれているこの事件は、決して遠野くん一人の力で解決できるものではないんです。
　さて、今回の失敗点ですが―――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
Merci!
Welcome to Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for Tohno,
who came so close but nevertheless met a dead end.
Lesson three of day three is about the importance of cooperation.
Honestly, Tohno, this won’t do.
The incident you’ve become entangled in cannot possibly be resolved by your strength alone.
Now, as for where you went wrong―――――.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Merci!
Now, the hint corner for Tohno-kun, who has regrettably ended up in this Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
In this third period of the third day, I will teach you about the importance of cooperation.
See, that's no good, Tohno-kun.
This situation you are involved in right now is not something you can solve by yourself.
Let's see, the mistake you made this time-----

entries.japanese:
……いけません。
　遠野くんが巻き込まれているこの事件は、決して遠野くん一人の力で解決できるものではないんです。
　ちゃんと自分の住んでいる家の怪しい所を調べたり、
　意固地にならず周りの人を信じて相談してみてください。
　先生、殺人鬼になってしまった遠野くんなんて見たくありませんから。
entries.maoEnglish:
No, this won’t do.
The incident you’ve become entangled in cannot possibly be resolved by your strength alone.
Investigate the suspicious places in the house where you live,
and stop being stubborn long enough to trust the people around you and ask for help.
I don’t want to see you become a murderer, Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Ah, no good.
This situation you are involved in right now is not something you can solve by yourself.
You have to search weird places around your house,
and don't be so persistent; you should trust the people around you and ask for their help.
I don't want to see Tohno-kun become a killer.

entries.japanese:
「えー。
でも志貴は数年後に殺人貴ってあだ名がつけられるんじゃん。
それで復讐騎と協力して死徒をバッタバッタと狩りだしてるよー」
　アルクさん。
それはあくまで貴女の希望であって、決定事項ではありません。
　それでは遠野くん、こちらのルートでは一切出番のない外野は放っておいて、引き続き本編をお楽しみくださいねー。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Whaaat. But doesn’t Shiki get called the Killer of Death a few years from now? Then he teams up with the Knight of Vengeance and starts mowing down Dead Apostles left and right.”
Arc! That is merely your personal hope, not a settled future.
Tohno, please ignore the bystander who has no role whatsoever in this route and continue enjoying the story.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, in a few years, Shiki will be called Shikiller, and will team up with the Knight of Vengeance to go hunt down the Dead Apostles."
Arc-san, that is just what you hope for, not a fact.
Alright, Tohno-kun.
Ignore the person who doesn't even get one appearance in this route and enjoy the rest of the main story.

entries.japanese:
「うー。
わたし悪いコトしてないのに、どーして出番がにゃいのー？
　わたし正ヒロインなのになー」
entries.maoEnglish: “But I haven’t done anything wrong! Why don’t I get any scenes, meow? I’m the main heroine!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Awwww.
I haven't done anything wrong, so why don't I get to appear-nyaa?
I'm supposed to be the main heroine."

entries.japanese:
淡い朝の光で目が覚めた。
　昨日の貧血の後遺症か、体はまだ少し重かったが気分は晴れやかだった。
　……何日ぶりだろう。
　こんな、なにも不安なことのない朝を迎えられたのは。
　くわえて今日は創立記念日で学校が休みときている。
　いつものようにあわただしく学校の準備をする必要もなく、ゆったりと朝を満喫できる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Pale morning light wakes me.
Perhaps it is an aftereffect of yesterday’s anemia; my body still feels a little heavy, but my spirits are clear.
How many days has it been?
A morning with nothing to fear.
Better yet, school is closed for Founding Day.
There is no need to rush through my usual preparations, and I can savor the morning at my leisure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I open my eyes to the morning light.
Even though my body still feels heavy, probably because of yesterday's anemia, I feel pretty good.
…… How many days has it been?
How long since I had a morning so free of unease?
And today is my school's Founder's Day.
There's no need to prepare for school like I usually do, so I can enjoy the morning calmly.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――」
　そこで、ようやく気がついた。
　何か人の気配がすると思ったら、誰かがベッドに体をあずけて眠っている。
「秋葉……？」
　一晩中看病してくれていたのか、秋葉は椅子に座ったまま、上半身をベッドにあずけて眠ってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――”
Only then do I notice.
Someone is asleep with her body folded against the bed.
“Akiha?”
She must have nursed me through the night; still seated in the chair, Akiha has laid her upper body across the bed and fallen asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---"
Then, I notice.
Though I thought there was no one in the room, someone is asleep by the bed.
"Akiha…?"
As if she has been nursing me all night long, Akiha is sitting on a chair, the top half of her body collapsed on the bed.

entries.japanese:
すう、という小さな寝息。
　長い黒髪はベッドに広がっていて、なんていうか、それだけでもひどく綺麗だった。
「秋葉、おい秋葉ってば」
　小声で呼びかけてみたが、目を覚ます気配はまったくない。
　……まあ、よく眠っていていることだし無理に起こすこともないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her breathing is soft and even.
Her long black hair lies spread across the bed; the sight alone is breathtakingly beautiful.
“Akiha; hey, Akiha.”
I call quietly, but she shows no sign of waking.
She is sleeping soundly, so there is no reason to force her awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Asleep, she breathes softly.
Her long black hair spread out on the bed… it looks beautiful.
"Akiha… hey, Akiha…"
After calling her softly, she shows no sign of waking up.
…… Well, if she's sleeping, then there's no point in making her wake up.

entries.japanese:
「……………ん」
　かすかな寝返りをうつ秋葉。
　こうして眠っている分には普段の気丈さはかけらもない。
　無防備な秋葉の寝顔は、子供のころの秋葉と何一つ変わっていなかった。
そのせいか、目を閉じればあの頃の秋葉の姿が鮮明に思い出せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm…”
Akiha shifts faintly in her sleep.
Like this, not a trace remains of her usual iron composure.
Her unguarded sleeping face is exactly as it was when we were children. If I close my eyes, I can see the Akiha of those days with perfect clarity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Mm."
Akiha turns over weakly.
Sleeping, she has none of her usual strength.
Her defenseless sleeping face hasn't changed since she was a child.
Because of that, I can close my eyes and vividly recall the Akiha from back then.

entries.japanese:
……八年前。
　ふたりで遊んでいる時、きまって後ろをついてきた黒髪の少女。
　無口な子だったけれど、秋葉はずっと自分たちについてきた。
　滅多に笑うことがなくて、時々見せる笑顔はどこか哀しそうで、儚かった。
―――何も知らなかった子供の頃。
　俺は本当に、秋葉に嬉しそうに笑ってほしくて、何度も何度も屋敷から庭に連れ出していたんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Eight years ago.
Whenever the two of us went out to play, a black-haired girl would invariably trail behind us.
She was a quiet child, but Akiha followed us everywhere.
She almost never smiled, and her rare smiles always seemed sad and fragile.
―――Back when we were children who knew nothing.
I had wanted so badly to see Akiha smile with real happiness that I kept coaxing her out of the house and into the garden, over and over again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Eight years ago.
Playing together, the black-haired girl who always followed me.
Although she was a quiet girl, Akiha always came with us.
She rarely smiled and even her smiling face seemed somehow sad, transitory.
---When I was a child, and knew nothing.
I really wanted to make her laugh with joy, so I dragged her out into the garden with us over and over again.

entries.japanese:
「ん……兄……さん……」
　どんな夢を見ているのか、秋葉はむにゃむにゃと声をもらす。
「――――――」
　どうしてか、ただ自然な気持ちで、眠っている秋葉の髪を手にとった。
　秋葉の寝顔を見ていると、心が深く静かになっていく。
　……出来るのなら、ずっとこうして見守っていたいと思うぐらいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…”
Whatever she is dreaming, Akiha murmurs in her sleep.
“――――――”
Without thinking, I take a lock of her hair in my hand.
Watching her sleep brings a deep stillness over my heart.
If I could, I might stay here watching over her forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn… Nii… san…"
As Akiha murmurs to herself, I wonder what kind of dream she's having.
"------"
For some reason, on impulse, I lift the sleeping Akiha's hair.
While I watch her sleeping face, my heart becomes calm.
…… It makes me want to watch over her forever if I could.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉」
　……覚えている。
　子供のころ、いつも思ってた。
　誰よりもこの少女を大切にしようと誓った日々。
　泣きながら自分に抱き付いてきたあきはのことを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
I remember.
As a child, I always felt the same way.
All those days when I vowed to treasure this girl above anyone else.
The little Akiha who clung to me in tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha."
…… I remember.
When we were children, I always thought about it.
That day I vowed to hold this girl more precious than anyone else.
The Akiha who would cry as she held me.

entries.japanese:
「……でも、まいったよな。
もうあの頃の面影は薄れてて、今じゃ立派な女の子なんだもんな」
　秋葉の綺麗な寝顔を見つめながら、そんな事を呟いた。
「――――ん」
　さらり、と長い黒髪が流れていく。
「……ごめん……なさい」
　苦しそうに眉をよせて、秋葉は寝言をもらす。
「……ごめんなさい……ごめんなさい、兄さん……」
「――――秋葉？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is a problem. There is hardly anything left of the little girl you were, and now you are a fine young woman.”
I murmur it while gazing at Akiha’s lovely sleeping face.
“――――Mm.”
Her long black hair slips through my fingers.
“I am sorry.”
Akiha’s brow tightens in pain as she speaks in her sleep.
“I am sorry, I am sorry, Brother.”
“――――Akiha?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But it's no good, is it?
The image from back then is gone.
She's a proper young lady now."
I murmur, gazing at Akiha's sleeping face.
"----Nn."
I let her long black hair fall.
"…… I'm…… sorry."
Knitting her eyebrows painfully, Akiha whispers in her sleep.
"…… I'm sorry…… I'm sorry, Nii-san……"
"----Akiha?"

entries.japanese:
秋葉の呼吸が乱れる。
　長い黒髪がざあ、とベッドから滑り落ちて、秋葉はゆっくりと体を起こした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s breathing grew ragged.
Her long black hair poured from the bed, and she slowly raised herself upright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha's breathing is irregular.
With her long black hair sliding off the bed, Akiha slowly lifts herself up.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――兄さん、だ。
どうして……兄さんが、いるんですか」
「……そりゃあいるよ。
だってここ、俺の部屋だから」
「え―――！？」
　びしっ！
　と背中を叩かれたように背筋を伸ばして、秋葉はさっと周囲を見渡す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――Brother. Why are you here?”
“Of course I am here. This is my room.”
“What―――?!”
Akiha’s back snaps straight, as if struck between the shoulder blades! She darts a look around the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---it's Nii-san.
Nii-san… why are you, here…?"
"…… Well, it's natural.
This is my room, after all."
"Eh---!?"
Akiha leaps upright as if stung, and glances around quickly.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます兄さん。
昨夜はよく眠れましたか？」
　……ここで眠ってしまっていた事をまるっきり無視して挨拶をしてくるとは、さすが秋葉。
　度胸の良さというか、開き直り方が尋常のレベルじゃない。
「ああ、おはよう。
秋葉のおかげでよく眠れたよ。
こんなにいい朝を迎えたのは久しぶりだ」
「そうですか。
それじゃあ体のほうも持ちなおしたんですね」
「いや、そっちのほうはまだ少しだるいかな。
どうせ今日は休みだし、一日大人しくしているよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Brother. Did you sleep well?”
She greets me, entirely ignoring that she fell asleep here—typical Akiha.
Her nerve, or perhaps her talent for brazening things out, is beyond ordinary human limits.
“Morning. Thanks to you, I slept very well. I have not woken to such a beautiful morning in ages.”
“I see. Then you’re feeling better as well?”
“I’m still a little sluggish. We have the day off anyway, so I’ll take it easy.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Nii-san.
Did you sleep well last night?"
…… As if she hadn't slept here at all, she greets me calmly.
Just like Akiha.
Her guts, or I should say her response, is not normal.
"Yeah, morning.
I slept well, thanks to you.
It's been a long time since I had such a pleasant morning."
"Really?
Is your body completely recovered, then?"
"No, it still feels kind of heavy.
Today's a holiday, so I'll just rest quietly."

entries.japanese:
「珍しいですね、兄さんがそんなことを言うなんて。
いつもだったらいつのまにかどこかに消えているっていうのに」
「それはいわないでくれ。
これからはちゃんと家にいるから、秋葉に心配はかけさせないよ」
「はいはい、話し半分に聞いておきますね」
　秋葉は楽しげな笑顔をうかべて、俺の顔を流し見る。
　……こう間近でそんな顔をされると、困る。
　秋葉はただでさえ綺麗な顔立ちをしているっていうのに、そんな明るい笑顔を向けられたらどうかしてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is an unusual promise from you. Normally you vanish somewhere the moment no one is looking.”
“Please do not remind me. From now on I will stay home and stop making you worry.”
“Yes, yes; I will believe half of that.”
Akiha gives me a merry smile and glances sidelong at my face.
Having her look at me that way from so close is dangerous.
She is beautiful enough already; when she turns that bright smile on me, I feel as though I might lose my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why Nii-san, it's unlike you to say such things.
Usually you disappear off somewhere before anyone notices."
"Please don't say that.
I'll be staying at home from now on, so you don't need to worry."
"Yes, yes, I'll accept half of that statement."
Smiling happily, Akiha gazes at my face.
…… If our faces stay as close as this, it'll be a problem.
Akiha's features are very beautiful, and if she keeps pointing that cheerful smile at me, I might go crazy.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ兄さん、またお昼になったら様子を見に来ますから。
それまで無理をして外に出たりしないでくださいね」
「わかってるよ。
……けど情けないな。
この家に戻ってきてから秋葉には看病されてばっかりだ。
これじゃあ兄貴失格だ」
「――――兄さん」
　なにげない感想だったのに、秋葉はとたんに顔を曇らせてしまった。
　ほんのわずかだけ俯いた後、秋葉は椅子から立ちあがって顔をあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll come see how you are again at noon, Brother. Until then, please don’t overexert yourself or go outside.”
“I know. Still, it’s pathetic. Ever since I came home, you’ve done nothing but nurse me. I’m a failure as an older brother.”
“――――Brother.”
It was an idle remark, but Akiha’s face clouds at once.
She lowers her eyes for the briefest moment, then rises from the chair and looks up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, Nii-san, we shall see how you feel at lunch.
Until then, please don't exert yourself, or go outside."
"I understand… But, it's terrible.
Since I came back here, you've had to nurse me all the time.
I'm no older brother."
"----Nii-san."
Though it was only a casual comment, Akiha's face is clouded.
After hanging her head for a moment, she stands and looks up.

entries.japanese:
「―――馬鹿な事は言わないでください。
　兄さんは私の兄さんよ。
たとえ失格していようとも、それだけは変わらないわ」
「……いや、それはそうだけど、秋葉？」
「……なんでもありません。
けど、それだけは本当の事ですから。
兄さんの看病なんて毎日だって苦痛ではないんですから、そんな事は気にしないでください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Do not say such foolish things.
You are my brother. Even if you have failed as one, that will never change.”
“No, of course not, but Akiha?”
“It is nothing. But what I said is true. Nursing you would be no burden even if I did it every day, so please do not concern yourself with that.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Please don't say stupid things like that.
You're my brother.
And even if you don't act like a good one, nothing would change."
"…… Well, I suppose, but…?"
"…… It's nothing.
But, it's true.
I don't mind having to nurse you every day, so please, don't worry about it."

entries.japanese:
秋葉は早足でドアまで歩いていく。
「それでは失礼します。
午前中は家を留守にしますから、何かあるのでしたら翡翠を使ってください」
　そうして、秋葉は部屋から退室していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha walked briskly to the door.
“I’ll leave you to rest. I shall be away from the house this morning, so if you need anything, please call Hisui.”
With that, Akiha left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha walks quickly to the door.
"Well, excuse me.
I shall be out during the morning, so if you need anything, please ask Hisui."
And with that, Akiha leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
時刻は十時になったばかり。
　体を休めるのもいいけど、こう一日中ベッドに横になっているっていうのも退屈だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was only just ten o’clock.
Resting was all very well, but lying in bed for the entire day would be tedious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ten o'clock comes around.
Although it's good to rest, lying in bed like this all day is boring.

entries.japanese:
「……ふわあぁあ」
　……だっていうのに、俺の体はまだ眠り足りないらしい。
　体もだるい事だし、下手に歩きまわって昨日みたいな事になったら秋葉に怒られる。
「……あと二時間もすれば秋葉も帰ってくるし。
今日一日は秋葉の言うとおりにしようって昨日約束したじゃないか」
　そう自分に言い聞かせて、ばふっと勢いよくシーツをかぶりなおした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yaaawn…”
And yet my body apparently still needs more sleep.
I still feel weak, and if I wander around only to collapse again like yesterday, Akiha will be furious.
“Another two hours and Akiha will be home. I promised yesterday that I would do as she said for one whole day.”
I tell myself that and fling the sheet back over my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ahhhh…"
…… But even so, it seems my body hasn't slept enough yet.
My body's still sluggish, and if I walk around and end up like yesterday, Akiha will get angry.
"…… Akiha will be back in two hours.
And I promised her that I'd take today off, after all."
Telling myself this, I throw the sheets over me.

entries.japanese:
よっぽど今まで疲れていたのか、気を抜くとすぐに眠気がやってきた。
　……こうして耳をすませていると、自分の鼓動がよく聞こえる。
「あ………つ」
　そういえば、昨日からあまり水分をとっていない。
　喉がカラカラに渇いているし、頭もぼーっとかすんできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I must have been far more exhausted than I knew, because the moment I relaxed, sleep came for me again.
When I lay still and listened, I could hear my own heartbeat clearly.
“Hot…”
Come to think of it, I had hardly drunk anything since yesterday.
My throat was parched, and a dull haze had begun to settle over my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get really drowsy, probably because I'm still exhausted.
…… If I listen, I can hear my own heartbeat.
"Ho… t…"
Come to think of it, I haven't had anything to drink since yesterday.
My throat's dry, and my head feels a little dim.

entries.japanese:
少しぐらい。
　ただ食堂にいって水を飲むぐらいなら、外に出てもいいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Surely a little would be all right.
I could leave my room long enough to go to the dining hall and drink some water.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Just a little.
I guess it's okay to go out to get some water.

entries.japanese:
廊下には誰もいない。
　昔。
　思い出せないぐらい昔か、それとも思い出す必要がない昔に見た、映画に出てくる廃墟みたいに、静かだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The corridor is deserted.
Long ago.
As quiet as the ruins in some film I saw long ago—so long ago I can no longer remember it, or perhaps simply have no need to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The corridor is empty.
Long ago.
So long ago I can't remember, or don't need to remember.
Like ruins in a movie, very quiet.

entries.japanese:
暑い。
　陽射しが暑い。
　やはり体がまだ本調子ではないのか。
　あまり長くは陽の光を浴びてはいられないようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hot.
The sunlight is hot.
My body must still be out of sorts.
I can’t endure the sun for long.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hot.
The sunshine is hot.
Is my body still not recovered yet?
It seems I can't spend too long in the sun.

entries.japanese:
……離れは強い陽射しにかすみそうだった。
　まるで、ここだけ砂漠にでもなったように暑くて、白くて、目がかすむ。
　……ごと、と物音がした。
　……離れの中からだ。
　……誰か。
　……中に、いるのだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
The detached building shimmers in the fierce sunlight.
It is as if this one place has become a desert—hot, white, blurring before my eyes.
Something knocks softly inside.
Inside the annex.
Is someone…
in there?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The detached building seems to waver in the sun.
My vision dims completely, like I'm in a hot desert.
White.
…… There's a clatter.
…… From the detached building.
…… Someone.
…… Is there someone in there?

entries.japanese:
縁側から障子を少しだけあけて、中を覗いた。
　そこには秋葉と琥珀の姿があった。
　二人の様子はどこかおかしい。
　しゅるり、という、帯の外れる音。
―――――なに、を。
　無言のまま、琥珀は着物をはだけさせて、その胸をさらけだした。
entries.maoEnglish:
From the veranda, I ease the shoji open a crack and peer inside.
Akiha and Kohaku are there.
Something about them is wrong.
Silk whispers as an obi comes undone.
―――――What are they doing?
Without a word, Kohaku parts her kimono and bares her breasts.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Opening the sliding door very slightly, I peer in from the porch.
Inside, I see the figures of Akiha and Kohaku.
They look a little strange.
I hear the swishing of an obi being removed.
-----What…?
Without a word, Kohaku pulls down her kimono and bares her breasts.

entries.japanese:
裸体をさらけだした琥珀は、頬を赤くして、ぴくりとも動かない。
　その、白い胸のふくらみに、秋葉は唇を押し当てる。
　きり、という、緊張感。
　胸をはだけて俯いている琥珀と、その胸元にうずくまるように顔をうずめている秋葉。
　琥珀の胸元から、ぽたり、ぽたりと紅い雫がこぼれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Naked, her cheeks flushed, Kohaku stands perfectly still.
Akiha presses her lips to the white swell of her breast.
The tension draws taut as wire.
Kohaku bows over her exposed chest while Akiha crouches against her, face buried between her breasts.
Red drops fall from Kohaku’s bosom, one after another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku stands there with a blushing face, but does not move.
Akiha presses her lips against the bared white chest.
Tension.
Kohaku looks down at her bare chest, and Akiha crouches so that she is burying her face in Kohaku's breasts.
A thin red drop makes a line down her breast.

entries.japanese:
ごくり、と秋葉の喉がなにかを嚥下する。
　なにを―――なにを飲んでいるのか、そんな事はいうまでもない。
理解するまでもない。
　秋葉は、琥珀の血を、飲んでいる――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s throat works as she swallows.
There is no need to ask what―――what she is drinking. No need even to understand it.
Akiha is drinking Kohaku’s blood――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha's throat starts to move, swallowing something.
What---what is she drinking?
There's no need to ask; I already understand.
Akiha, she's drinking, Kohaku's blood----

entries.maoEnglish:
――――――――――DREAM
DREAM――――――――――
This is a dream.
If it is a dream―――I have to wake up, quickly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----------Dream
Dream------
This is a dream.
It's a dream, so I should hurry up and wake up.

entries.japanese:
「――――え」
　……自分の部屋。
　ちゃんと、自分の部屋に、いる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Huh?”
My room.
I am in my own room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
…… My own room.
I'm definitely in… my own room.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……と、琥珀さん、が」
　秋葉が。
秋葉が琥珀さんの血を飲んでるのを、たしかに見ていたのに。
「夢でも見てたのか、俺」
　……そうかもしれない。
　いや、あんなコト絶対に夢のはずだ。
　あんなコトが現実でいい筈がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha and Kohaku”
I saw it. Akiha drinking Kohaku’s blood.
“Was I dreaming?”
Maybe.
No, that had to be a dream.
Something like that cannot be real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, and Kohaku-san…?"
Akiha.
Akiha was drinking Kohaku's blood, I definitely saw it.
"Was I just dreaming…?"
…… Perhaps.
No, it must have been a dream.
There's no way that was real.

entries.japanese:
「……けど……生々し、すぎた」
　夢のはずなのに。
　俺は和室の畳の匂いも、微かに乱れた二人の息遣いも、秋葉の喉がごくりと鳴った音も、確かに聞いてしまった。
「――――――――」
　ベッドから起きあがる。
　……眩暈がした。
　だがそんな事はどうでもいい。
　離れの屋敷。
　離れの屋敷に行ってみれば、アレが夢であったかどうかがはっきりする―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“But—it was too vivid.”
It had to be a dream.
Yet I smelled the tatami, heard their faint, uneven breathing, and heard Akiha’s throat work as she swallowed.
“――――――――”
I rise from the bed.
My head spins.
But that does not matter.
The detached house.
If I go there, I will know whether it was a dream―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But… it was so real."
It has to be a dream.
The smell of the tatami mats, the two's ragged breathing, the gulping I heard from Akiha's throat.
"--------"
I get out of bed.
…… I feel dizzy.
But I don't care.
The detached building.
If I go out to the detached building, I'll know for sure whether it was a dream or not---

entries.japanese:
「――――！」
　物音を聞いて咄嗟に身を隠す。
「琥珀……さん」
　離れの屋敷がある方から琥珀さんが歩いてきて、そのまま屋敷へ去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――!”
At the sound of movement, I instinctively hide.
“Kohaku…”
She came walking from the direction of the detached house, then continued on toward the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!"
Hearing a noise, I hide myself.
"Kohaku… san."
Kohaku-san walks from the direction of the detached building, towards the mansion.

entries.japanese:
……屋敷は静まりかえっている。
　いないとは思う。
　秋葉は、こんなところにはいない。
　だって午前中は出かけるって言っていたんだ。
　秋葉がこんなところで、琥珀さんと一緒にいるなんていう事はありえない。
「…………」
　ごくり、と喉がなる。
　大きく深呼吸をして、中に足を踏み入れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The detached house is utterly still.
She won’t be there.
Akiha can’t be here.
She said she would be out all morning.
There is no possible way she could have been here with Kohaku.
“……”
My throat clicked as I swallowed.
I drew one deep breath and stepped inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The house is as silent as the grave.
I think it's empty.
Akiha isn't here.
Because she said she'd be out during the morning.
Akiha couldn't have been in a place like this with Kohaku-san.
"………"
I swallow hard.
I take a deep breath, and step inside.

entries.japanese:
「……兄……さん……？」
　和室には、秋葉の姿があった。
　秋葉は呆然とした顔をして、入ってきた俺を眺めている。
「………秋葉」
「はい……なんでしょう、兄さん」
　俺がやってきた事を不思議にも思っていないのか。
　秋葉はけだるい面持ちで反応した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…?”
Akiha is in the tatami room.
She stares blankly at me as I enter.
“Akiha…”
“Yes, what is it, Brother?”
Does she find nothing strange about my arrival?
Akiha answers languidly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii…… san……?"
Akiha is standing in the Japanese-styled room.
She is looking at me aghast.
"…… Akiha."
"Yes…?
What is it, Nii-san…?"
Akiha doesn't seem surprised that I'm here.
She merely reacts listlessly.

entries.japanese:
「……なんでしょう、じゃないだろ。
おまえ、こんなところで何をしていたんだ」
「なにって、取り壊す前にもう一度見ておこうと思っただけですけど」
「―――いや、そういうんじゃなくて」
　じっと秋葉の体を見る。
　あれ―――そういえば、秋葉は制服を着ている。
　さっきまではたしかに普段着だったけど……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do not ask me that. What were you doing here?”
“I merely wanted to see it before demolition.”
“―――No, that is not what I mean.”
I study Akiha’s clothes.
Wait―――Akiha is wearing her uniform.
In the scene I saw, she was wearing ordinary clothes…
entries.mirrorMoon:
"'What is it'…?
What are you doing in a place like this?"
"What?
I just thought I'd come and have one last look around before it's demolished."
"---No, I don't mean that…"
I stare at Akiha's body.
Hm?
---Come to think of it, Akiha's wearing her uniform.
Wasn't she wearing her normal clothes a while ago…?

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、おまえ着替えたのか」
「ええ、午前中は学校のほうに行っていましたから。
兄さんの部屋から出た後に着替えて、先ほど帰ってきたんです」
「……そう、か。
そうだよな、こんなところであんな事をしてるわけないもんな」
――そう、やっぱりあんな光景は夢だったんだ。
　……けど、なにか、おかしい。
　おかしいけど、それはどっちがおかしいのか。
　秋葉がおかしいのか、それとも俺がおかしいのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, did you change clothes?”
“Yes, I had business at school this morning. I changed after leaving your room and returned a short while ago.”
“Right… of course, you could not have been doing something like that here.”
――Yes, that scene was a dream after all.
But something is wrong.
Something is wrong, but which of us is it?
Is Akiha strange, or am I?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, you changed your clothes?"
"Yes, since I went to school during the morning.
After leaving your room, I changed, and I only just returned."
"…… Really?
Yeah, of course, you weren't doing those things in here."
--Yes, it was a dream, after all.
…… But, something's odd.
It's odd, but… who's odd?

Is Akiha odd?
Or am I odd?

entries.japanese:
さっき見た光景。
あの時の秋葉は普段着だった。
　アレからすぐに着替えるなんていうのはおかしいし、なにより―――秋葉の話は、どこもおかしなところがない。
　なら―――あんな夢を見てしまう俺のほうが、圧倒的におかしいのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
