In that scene, Akiha was wearing ordinary clothes. It would be strange for her to change immediately afterward.
More importantly―――nothing about Akiha’s account seems strange.
Then―――does having such a dream make me the one who is truly strange?
entries.mirrorMoon:
When I saw that sight, Akiha was wearing her normal clothes.
It would be strange to change clothes after that, and what Akiha just said, there's nothing strange about it at all.
So---that makes me who saw that dream strange.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん？
　どうしたんですか、顔色が悪いようですよ。
それに午前中は休んでいてくれるって言ったのに、どうしてこんなところにいるんです」
「いや、ちょっと体を動かそうと思って」
「……そうですか。
それはかまいませんけど、ここは立ち入り禁止だと言ったでしょう。
私との約束を守れないんですか、兄さんは」
　じろり、という秋葉の視線。
　自分の心の底まで見透かされているようで、どくん、と心臓が跳ねあがる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…? What is the matter, you look pale. You promised to rest this morning, so why are you here?”
“I thought I should move around a little.”
“I see… that is fine, but I told you this place was forbidden. Can you not keep a promise to me, Brother?”
Akiha fixes me with a hard stare.
It seems to see through to the bottom of my heart, and my pulse leaps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san?
What is it?
You seem pale.
You said you'd rest all morning, so why are you out in a place like this?"
"Ah, I just thought I'd go for a bit of a walk."
"…… Really?
Well, I don't care about that, but I forbade you from coming here.
It seems you couldn't keep your promise to me, Nii-san."
Akiha glares accusingly at me.
Her gaze seems to see right to the bottom of my heart, which jumps in response.

entries.japanese:
「……悪かった。
これからは気をつける」
「この離れは老朽化が進んでいますから、万が一ということもあるんです。
どうか、兄さんはもう近づかないでください」
―――気のせいだろうか。
　やっぱり、秋葉の態度はどこかおかしい気がする。
　そもそも、どうしてそんな危険な所に秋葉は一人でいたんだろうか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am sorry… I will be more careful from now on.”
“The annex is badly deteriorated, so an accident could happen. Please do not come near it again, Brother.”
―――Was I imagining it?
Akiha’s behavior still seemed wrong somehow.
Besides, if the place was so dangerous, why had she been here alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're right.
From now on, I'll be careful."
"This building is getting very old, so there's a chance it may collapse.
Please don't come here anymore, Nii-san."
---Is it just my imagination?
I think there really is something odd about Akiha's attitude.
For one thing, why would Akiha be in such a dangerous place alone……?

entries.japanese:
「それではお帰りください。
兄さん、顔色が優れませんよ」
　俺の横を通りすぎて、秋葉は和室から出ていこうとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now please go back. You look unwell, Brother.”
Akiha passed me and moved to leave the tatami room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Now, please go back, Nii-san.
You do not look well."
Walking past me, Akiha leaves the Japanese-styled room.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれ秋葉。
昨日聞き忘れていた事があるんだ」
「聞き忘れていたこと、ですか？」
「ああ。
俺が倒れた中庭があるだろ。
昔さ、あそこで秋葉と遊んだけど、その時もう一人、他に誰かがいたような気がするんだ。
秋葉は覚えてないか？」
「―――そんな子はいませんでした。
それは、兄さんの勘違いです」
　きっぱりと返答して、秋葉は離れを後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Akiha. There’s something I forgot to ask you yesterday.”
“Something I forgot?”
“Yes. You know the courtyard where I collapsed? We used to play there long ago, but I feel there was one other child with us. Do you remember anyone?”
“―――There was no such child. You are mistaken, Brother.”
With that categorical answer, Akiha left the detached house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait a minute, Akiha.
There's something I forgot to ask yesterday."
"Something you forgot to ask?"
"Yeah.
That clearing where I collapsed.
Long ago, I used to play with you there, but I feel like there was someone else as well.
Do you remember?"
"---There was no one else.
You're mistaken."
Answering clearly, Akiha leaves the detached building.

entries.japanese:
「……だけど秋葉、三人目の子供はいたんだ。
十年前に養子にとられていた子供のことを、おまえは知らないっていうのか」
　和室に残されて、一人、呟く。
　秋葉は三人目の養子のことを隠しているのか、それとも本当に覚えていないのか。
――――俺には、判別がつかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But, there was a third child, Akiha. A child adopted into this family ten years ago—do you really know nothing about them?”
Left alone in the tatami room, I mutter to myself.
Is Akiha hiding the third adopted child, or does she truly not remember?
――――I had no way to tell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, Akiha, there was a third child.
A child adopted ten years ago.
Are you saying you don't know about him?"
Left alone in the Japanese-styled room, I talk out loud.
Is Akiha hiding the truth about that child, or does she really not remember?
----I can't tell.

entries.japanese:
――――夜。
　あれから部屋に戻ってぼんやりとしているうちに、一日はあっけなく終わってしまった。
　……考える事、考えなくてはいけない事が多すぎるせいだろう。
　弓塚がいなくなって、もう起こらないハズの通り魔殺人がまだ続いている。
　それと同じように人を殺して血を吸う夢を見る自分。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Night.
After returning to my room, I passed the hours in a daze, and the day ended almost before I knew it.
Perhaps there was simply too much to consider—too much I had to consider.
Yumizuka was gone, yet the killings that should have ended with her were continuing.
And I was dreaming of murder and drinking blood in exactly the same way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Night.
As I returned and sat absent-mindedly in my room, it seems the day ended.
…… Too many things to think about, too many things I have to think about.
Even with Yumizuka gone, the killings still continue.
And I see matching dreams of killing people and sucking their blood.

entries.japanese:
八年前。
　俺が瀕死の大怪我を負った事故と、それ以前にいたはずの子供。
　中庭で思い出されたモノは、紛れもなく八年前の記憶だ。
　人殺しの夢を見るようになったけど、なんていう事はない。
俺はもうとっくの昔に、似たような出来事を目の当たりにしていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Eight years ago.
The accident that left me mortally wounded, and the child who should have been there before it happened.
What returned to me in the courtyard was unquestionably a memory from eight years ago.
I had begun dreaming of murder, but there was nothing new in that. Apparently, I had witnessed something much like it long before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Eight years ago.
The near-fatal injury I received in an accident, and the child that had to be here.
The scene I remembered in the courtyard.
Undoubtedly, it was a memory from eight years ago.
If I've started to see dreams of killing people, there's no question why.
It seems that same thing happened right before my eyes, a long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　……あれから秋葉とは顔を合わせていない。
　夕食も琥珀さんに食事を部屋まで運んでもらったし、秋葉が見舞いにきてくれる事はなかった。
「まあ、もう十分元気だから見舞いにくる必要はないんだろうけど」
　……秋葉とは気まずいままだ。
　このまま夜が明けて朝になって、またいつも通り『おはよう』って言いあえば、さっきの気まずいモノもなくなってくれるだろう。
「……そうだな。
今日はもう眠ろう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
I have not seen Akiha since then.
Kohaku brought dinner to my room, and Akiha did not come to check on me.
“Well, I am already well enough that she has no reason to.”
Things between us are still awkward.
If night gives way to morning and we exchange our usual morning greeting, perhaps the awkwardness will disappear.
“Yes… I will go to sleep now.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
…… I haven't seen Akiha since then.
Kohaku-san brought supper to my room, and Akiha has not come to visit.
"Well, I guess since I'm feeling better, there's no reason to visit, but…"
…… I still feel awkward when it comes to her.
If day breaks, and morning comes, and we say "good morning" as always, I bet the bad feeling will disappear.
"…… That's right.
I'll just sleep today."

entries.japanese:
電気を消して、ベッドにもぐりこんだ。
　だが、秋葉が傍にいない。
　このまま眠ってしまえば、また。
　俺は夢を、人を殺しに行くことになるのかもしれない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I turned off the light and slipped into bed.
But Akiha is not beside me.
If I fall asleep now, then again.
I may dream, and go out to kill someone――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
With the lights off, I curl up in bed.
But, Akiha is not beside me.
If I sleep like this, then…
I might dream about killing people again----

entries.japanese:
「く―――そ」
　……だめだ、とてもじゃないけど眠れない。
　昨日は秋葉が傍にいてくれたから、あんなに安らかに眠れたんだ。
　一人で眠れば、またあの夢を見るかもしれない。
　そうして血を吸う夢を見て、また新しい通り魔殺人の犠牲者がでた時。
　その時こそ俺は、自分自身を弁解する余地さえなく、自身が殺人鬼である事を受け入れるしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn―――it.”
No, I cannot possibly sleep.
Last night I slept so peacefully because Akiha was beside me.
Alone, I might have that dream again.
I might dream of drinking blood, and then another victim of the serial killer might appear.
If that happens, I will have no excuse left and must accept that I am a murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Crap."
…… It's no good, I can't sleep at all.
Because Akiha was beside me yesterday, I was able to sleep peacefully.
If I sleep alone, I might have that dream again.
And if I dream of drinking blood, and another victim appears…
I wouldn't be able to deny it and would have to conclude that I am the killer.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　ベッドから出る。
　……眠らない。
　今夜は眠らないで、ずっと起きていよう。
　窓から入ってくる月光も明るいし、こうやって月を眺めていれば時間なんてすぐに―――
「あれ―――中庭に誰かいる」
　じっと目を凝らす。
「秋葉じゃないか……なにしてるんだろ、中庭の真ん中でぼうっとして」
　秋葉はひときわ大きい木の下にぼう、と佇んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
I climb out of bed.
I will not sleep.
I will stay awake all night.
The moonlight streaming through the window is bright, and if I watch the moon like this, the hours will surely pass in no time―――
“Wait―――someone is in the courtyard.”
I narrow my eyes.
“Is that Akiha…? What is she doing, standing there in the middle of the courtyard?”
Akiha stands in a daze beneath the largest tree.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Gh."
I get out of bed.
…… I won't sleep.
I won't sleep tonight, I will stay awake.
Moonlight is streaming in through the window, so I can just gaze at the moon for a while---
"Huh?
There's someone in the courtyard."
I look closely.
"Isn't that Akiha?
What's she doing, standing in the courtyard?"
Akiha is standing quietly under a particularly large tree.

entries.japanese:
「……散歩かな。
もう十一時を過ぎてるっていうのに、あいつも無用心なヤツ」
　そういえば、屋敷に帰ってきた初日も秋葉は夜中に出歩いていたっけ。
　………どうせ、こうしていても眠れないのなら。
　昨日のように秋葉が側にいてくれれば、悪夢を見なくてすむかもしれない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe she is taking a walk… it is past eleven, yet she is careless too.”
Come to think of it, Akiha also wandered outside at night on the first day I returned to the mansion.
And if I cannot sleep anyway…
Perhaps having Akiha beside me, as she was last night, will spare me the nightmare―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe she's taking a walk.
It's past eleven already; she's so careless."
In fact, the first night I came back to the mansion, Akiha was walking about in the dead of night too.
……… Well, if I'm not going to sleep anyway…
If, like yesterday, I have Akiha beside me, I don't think I'll have nightmares---

entries.japanese:
月明かりの下を歩く。
　屋敷の木々は見事な紅葉で、はらはらと葉が散っていくさまはひどく幻想的だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I walked beneath the moonlight.
The trees of the estate blazed with autumn color, and the leaves drifting down one by one made the garden seem impossibly dreamlike.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk in the moonlight.
The mansion's trees are painted in splendid autumn colors, and the falling leaves really look illusionary.

entries.japanese:
その中に秋葉の姿があった。
　長い黒髪と細い背中を見せて、舞い散る紅葉を見つめている。
　はらり、はらり、と。
　木の葉と同じように揺れる黒髪と、脆そうなその体のせいか。
　秋葉の姿は、蜃気楼のようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha stands among them.
Her long black hair and slender back turned toward me, she watches the falling leaves.
Down they come, one after another.
Perhaps it is the way her black hair sways like the leaves.
Because of that, and her fragile body, Akiha looks like a mirage.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha stands in the center of it all.
I gaze at her long black hair, her thin back, and the autumn leaves scattered about her.
Swaying.
Her black hair shakes like the leaves; is that why her body seems so weak?
Akiha's figure seems like a mirage.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉。
なにしてるんだ、こんな時間に」
「なにって、月見ですよ。
兄さんといっしょです」
　俺がやってきた事をさして驚いたふうもなく、秋葉はそう答えて振り返った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha… what are you doing out here at this hour?”
“Watching the moon. The same as you, Brother.”
Not particularly surprised to see me, Akiha answers and turns.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha?
What are you doing, at a time like this?"
"What?
I'm watching the moon.
Just like you, Nii-san."
Showing no surprise at my appearance, Akiha turns and answers.

entries.japanese:
「こんばんは、兄さん。
病人なのにこんな時間まで出歩くなんて、困った患者さんですね」
「まあな。
部屋から月を見てたんだけど、不良娘が外にいたからさ。
兄貴としては放っておけなくて出てきたんだ」
「ふふ、それは申し訳ありませんでした」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good evening, Brother. Wandering about so late when you’re ill makes you a very troublesome patient.”
“Maybe. I was looking at the moon from my room, but then I saw a wayward girl outside. As her older brother, I couldn’t very well ignore her.”
“My apologies, then.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good evening, Nii-san.
Going out at a time like this even when you're sick; you're such a troublesome patient, aren't you?"
"I guess.
I could see the moon from my room, but there was a poor little girl outside.
As a proper brother, I had to come out."
"Huhu.
Well, I'm sorry about that."

entries.japanese:
「あ――――まあ、屋敷の中だから別にいいんだけど、最近なにかと物騒だろ。
秋葉は女の子なんだから、あんまり夜は外に出ちゃだめだぞ」
「はい。
兄さんがそう言うのでしたら、すぐに部屋に戻りますね」
「ばっ、今はいいんだ。
……その、俺も眠れなかったところだからさ、少し付き合ってくれると助かる」
「ええ、兄さんがそう言われるのでしたら、ぜひ」
　まぶたを閉じて、静かに頷く。
　……秋葉のその頷きは、まるで何かに祈っているかのように静かで、清らかだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――well, we are inside the estate, but things have been dangerous lately. You are a girl, so you should not be outside much at night.”
“Very well. If you say so, Brother, I will return to my room at once.”
“No, wait… tonight is fine. I could not sleep anyway, so I would be grateful if you stayed with me for a while.”
“If that is what you want, then gladly.”
She closes her eyes and nods.
The gesture is quiet and pure, almost like a prayer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----well, I guess inside the mansion is fine, but it has been unsafe recently.
You're a girl, so you shouldn't be wandering around outside at night."
"You're right.
If you say so, I'll go straight to my room."
"Bah, it's fine now.
…… I, couldn't sleep either, so it'd be nice to spend some time together."
"If you'd like, then certainly, Nii-san."
Closing her eyes, Akiha nods quietly.
…… Akiha's nod seems as if she is praying for something.

entries.japanese:
「……驚いたな。
なんだか、今夜はやけに優しいじゃないか。
なんかいい事でもあったのか？」
「いいことなんてないですけど。
まあ、兄さんとここで話ができるのは、いいことかもしれませんね」
　くすり、と冗談っぽく笑う秋葉。
「―――――」
　その仕草に、どくん、と胸が鳴った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am surprised… you are awfully kind tonight. Did something good happen?”
“Nothing in particular. Though being able to speak with you here might count as something good.”
Akiha laughs softly, almost teasing me.
“―――――”
My heart gives a sudden thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm surprised.
You're really nice tonight.
Did something good happen?"
"Nothing wonderful has happened… but, I guess being able to talk to you like this might be something wonderful."
Akiha chuckles with a smile.
"-----"
In response, my chest thumps.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　どうしました、顔が赤いですよ。
まだ体の調子が悪いのでしたら、中庭のテラスに移動しましょうか？」
「いや、大丈夫だ。
もう少し見ていたいから、ここにいる」
「そうですね、今日は本当にきれいな夜ですもの。
私、この屋敷でここの風景が一番好きです」
　秋葉はまた淡く微笑んだ。
　……その仕草に、どきりとする。
　秋葉の雰囲気はひどく穏やかで、優しすぎるせいだろうか。
　赤い落ち葉の中。
　遠野秋葉は、いつもの何倍も可愛く見えてしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? What is wrong, your face is red. If you still feel ill, shall we move to the terrace?”
“No, I am fine. I want to keep looking a little longer, so I will stay here.”
“Yes, it truly is a lovely night. This is my favorite view on the entire estate.”
Akiha smiles faintly again.
The sight makes my heart leap.
Perhaps it is because she seems so calm—too gentle.
Amid the red fallen leaves.
Akiha Tohno looks many times lovelier than usual.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
What is it?
Your face is red.
If you're still feeling ill, shall we move to the terrace?"
"No, I'm fine.
I'd like to gaze for a little longer, so let's stay here."
"Yes… tonight really is beautiful.
Of all the scenery around the mansion, this is my favorite."
Akiha smiles faintly.
…… Her behavior really surprises me.
Her atmosphere is terribly calm and gentle.
Amidst the red autumn leaves.
Tohno Akiha seems many times prettier then usual.

entries.japanese:
「ねえ兄さん。
この場所を、覚えてますか」
「この場所って、この大きな木のこと？」
「はい。
まだ私たちが子供のころ、ここが待ち合わせ場所だったじゃないですか。
　私が部屋で習い事をしている時、コンって窓に石をなげてくれて。
　私はそのあと、なんとかして家庭教師のじいやをやり過ごしてここまで走ってくるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, do you remember this place?”
“You mean this big tree?”
“Yes. When we were children, this was where we met.
While I was shut in my room taking lessons, you would throw a pebble against the window—tap.
Then I would find some way past my old tutor and run here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Nii-san?
Do you remember this place?"
"This place?
You mean, this big tree?"
"Yes.
When we were children, this was our meeting place.
When I was inside doing my lessons, I'd hear a stone at the window.
And then I'd slip away from my private teacher, and run out here."

entries.japanese:
――――ああ、言われてみればそうだった。
　秋葉はいつも屋敷の中で習い事をしていて、親父は秋葉を外に出そうとしなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Yes—now that she mentioned it, that was how things had been.
Akiha was always kept inside for lessons, and Father never wanted her to go outdoors.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Yeah, come to think of it, she's right.
Akiha was always doing lessons in the mansion; our old man wouldn't let her go outside.

entries.japanese:
「屋敷の人たちはお父様を恐がって、私に話しかける事さえしてくれなかった。
　……けど、それは当然でした。
　私自身もお父様以外の人間と話をするのはいけない事だって信じていたんです。
　あんなに大勢のひとたちがいたのに、私はみんなより遠野の家訓のほうが大事だった。
だから一人でも平気でしたし、お父様の教えにも耐えていられたんでしょうね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Everyone at the estate was afraid of Father, so they would not even speak to me.
But that was only natural.
I believed it was wrong for me to speak to anyone but him.
The house was full of people, yet the Tohno family rules mattered more to me than any of them. That must be why solitude never troubled me, and why I could endure Father’s instruction.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The people in the mansion were afraid of Father, so they wouldn't even talk to me.
…… But, that was natural.
I thought I wasn't meant to talk to anyone except Father.
There were lots of people, but to me the rules of the Tohno house were more important than any of them.
So I was fine by myself, and I could bear Father's lessons."

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
思い出したよ、俺がいてもいなくても、親父のやつは秋葉に厳しかったもんな。
ずっと部屋に閉じ込めて、一日中習い事をさせていただろ。
俺は、アレがすごくイヤだった」
「ええ。
私も、本当は大っ嫌いでした」
　……それは、もう過去の思い出として整理できているのか。
　秋葉はくすりと、懐しむように笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I remember now… Father was strict with you whether I was here or not. He kept you shut in your room and made you study all day. I hated that.”
“Yes. The truth is, I hated it too.”
Perhaps she has made peace with it as something safely in the past.
Akiha smiles with quiet nostalgia.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I remember.
He didn't care about me, but the old man was really strict with you.
Shut up in your room all the time, doing lessons all day long.
I really didn't like that."
"Yes.
To be honest, I hated it too."
…… I guess she has sorted it out as something in the past.
Akiha laughs nostalgically.

entries.japanese:
「けど、それを気付かせてくれたのは兄さんなんですよ。
　……兄さんにとっては当たり前の事だったから覚えてないでしょうけど、兄さんは私が中庭で先生を待っている時に突然やってきて、いきなり私の手を掴んで走り出したんです。
　なにするのって聞いたら、一人じゃ鬼ごっこができないから鬼になれって。
　……ほんと、思い返してみるとものすごく強引な人ですね、兄さんは」
　くすくすと秋葉は笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But you were the one who taught me that.
It was so natural to you that you probably don’t remember, but one day, while I was waiting in the courtyard for my tutor, you appeared from nowhere, seized my hand, and ran.
When I asked what you were doing, you said one person couldn’t play tag and ordered me to be It.
Looking back, you really were appallingly forceful, Brother.”
Akiha laughed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, Nii-san, you were the one who let me notice.
…… You won't remember this since it was like an everyday thing for you, but one day, while I was waiting for the teacher in the courtyard, you came up, grabbed my hand, and began to run.
I asked what you were doing, and you said you couldn't play tag by yourself, so I should play too.
…… Really… Thinking back, you were a terribly pushy person, weren't you?"
Akiha giggles.

entries.japanese:
「……まあ子供のする事だからな。
そのあたりの無作法は大目に見てくれると助かる」
「そうですね。
それで結局、私と兄さんはお父様に叱られて、よけい会う事が難しくなったんですけど―――」
「―――ああ、こっちも意地になってたからな。
一日一回は秋葉と遊ぶんだって、あの手この手で秋葉を連れ出したんだっけ。
　けどさ、最後のほうには秋葉のほうから抜け出してきたじゃないか。
そのくせ遠くから見てるだけで、なかなかこっちにはこなかったけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well… I was a child, so I would appreciate it if you forgave my lack of manners.”
“Of course. Though Father scolded us both, and afterward it became even harder for us to meet―――”
“―――Yes, and I got stubborn. I swore I would play with you once every day and tried every trick I could think of to sneak you out.
Toward the end, you started slipping away by yourself. But you only watched from a distance and hardly ever came over.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, that's what children do.
Please forgive my impoliteness."
"Yes… after that, Father scolded us, so it became harder for us to meet---"
"----Yeah, I became stubborn too.
I decided I'd play with you once a day, and one way or another, I'd get you outside.
But, in the end, you slipped away yourself.
But you'd just watch from far away and never come close."

entries.japanese:
「いいんです、私はそれだけで楽しかったんですから。
　―――そう、本当に楽しかったわ。
　私を当然のように遊びに連れていってくれて、そのたびにお父様に叱られて。
　お父様の叱りようは日に日に厳しくなったでしょう？
　だから私、その度に思ってました。
今日はもう来ない、今日こそもうだめね、今日は来てくれるはずなんかない、って。
　けど、兄さんはそんな私の予想をいつも裏切ってくれた。
……ほんとうに、あれだけ叱られたらもう絶対に来てくれないのに、兄さんはいつも通りの笑顔でやってくるんです。
　お父様には叱られてなんかないから平気だよって、ものすごく下手な嘘をついて」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That was enough; I was happy simply to be there.
―――Yes, I was truly happy.
You took me out to play as though it were the most natural thing in the world, and Father scolded you every time.
His punishments grew harsher by the day, did they not? Each time, I would think: he will not come today; today it is finally over; there is no possible way he will come.
But you always proved me wrong. No matter how terribly Father had punished you, you would appear with the same smile as ever.
You would tell the most hopeless lie—that you had not been scolded at all, so everything was fine.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's fine.
I was happy just with that.
---Yes, I really was happy.
You took me out to play, and Father would scold us afterwards.
Father's scolding got worse day by day, right?
So, I began to think.
He won't come today.
He shouldn't come today.
I don't think he'll come today…
But, you always betrayed my expectations.
Every time we were scolded, and I thought you wouldn't come anymore, you always appeared, smiling.
You always said Father didn't scold you, but it was a pretty bad lie."

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
こっちは完全に秋葉を騙してるって思ってたんだけど、バレバレだったのか」
「もちろんです。
おかげで私、よけいに兄さんに申し訳なくって大変でした。
　毎日いつもの時間になると、兄さんったら今日も来ちゃうのかなって、すっごくはらはらして待ってたんですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see… I thought I had you completely fooled, but you knew all along?”
“Of course. It only made me feel guiltier.
Every day, when the usual hour arrived, I would wait in an agony of suspense, wondering if you were really going to come again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?
I always thought I'd fooled you completely; but I guess it was easy to tell it was a lie."
"Of course.
I was sorry you were always scolded on my behalf.
Every day at the same time, I would wait excitedly, wondering, 'Is Nii-san going to come today?'"

entries.japanese:
「……けど、そんな事が、一番嬉しかった。
　兄さんがいなくなって、私の生活はまた元の生活に戻ってしまったけど、辛くはありませんでした。
　だって、どんなに辛い事より兄さんとの思い出のほうが強かったんです。
　……兄さんは私を放っておいたって言いますけど、それは違います。
私―――私のほうこそ、ずっと兄さんに助けられていました。
　兄さんとの思い出があるから、私はまだ遠野秋葉のままでいられるんです」
　そうして、本当に幻のように、秋葉はわらった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And yet… that made me happier than anything.
After you left, my life returned to what it had been before, but I was not miserable.
My memories of you were stronger than anything painful that happened to me.
You say you abandoned me, but that is wrong. I―――I was the one you kept saving.
Because I have those memories, I can still remain Akiha Tohno.”
Then Akiha smiled, as insubstantial as a vision.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, that was the happiest time.
When you went away, life returned to normal again, but I didn't suffer.
But, the memories of you were stronger than anything else, Nii-san.
…… You say you left me alone, but that is wrong.
I----I was always saved by you.
Because I had memories of you, I was able to remain as Tohno Akiha."
And, like an illusion, Akiha smiles.

entries.japanese:
「―――本当にどうかしていますね。
子供じゃあるまいし、いつまでも兄さん兄さんと頼っているようでは遠野家の当主失格です」
「……ばか。
そんなの関係ないだろ。
頼りたくなったら頼ればいいんだ。
俺たちは兄妹なんだから」
「いいえ、そんな事ができるのは子供の時だけです。
私は遠野家の跡継ぎで、それはすでに決定された事です。
ですから誰にも頼らず、一人で生きていかなければいけません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I truly am behaving strangely. I am not a child anymore; if I keep depending on my brother at every turn, I am unfit to lead the Tohno family.”
“Idiot… That has nothing to do with it. If you need someone, depend on me. We are brother and sister.”
“No. Only children may do that. I am the heir to the Tohno family, and that has already been decided; I must live alone, without depending on anyone.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---There's something wrong with me.
If I was always clinging onto you like a child, I could hardly be head of the Tohno House."
"…… Stupid.
That has nothing to do with it.
It's okay to depend on someone when you need to.
We're brother and sister, after all."
"No, that was only when we were children.
It was decided that I would be the heir of the Tohno House.
So, I cannot depend on anyone; I must manage on my own."

entries.japanese:
「……なんだよそれ。
遠野の跡取りになったからって、そんなふうに我を張ることはないだろ」
「いえ、遠野家の跡取りになるという事はそういう事なんです。
もう何年も前から、私はそういう風に教育されてきました。
　―――けど、私もまだまだ修行が足りませんね。
こんなふうに弱さを見せてしまうなんて、どうかしています」
　言って。
　たん、と軽い足取りで秋葉は跳ねた。
　まるで踊るように、舞い散る紅葉の中を歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What does that even mean… becoming the Tohno heir does not mean you have to be so stubborn.”
“No, it means precisely that. I have been educated for this role for years.
―――But I clearly still have much to learn. Showing such weakness is shameful.”
With that said.
Akiha skips away on light feet.
She walks through the shower of autumn leaves as though dancing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's with that?
Just because you became the heir of the Tohno House, does that mean you can't make your own decisions?"
"That's what it means to become the heir of the Tohno House.
Long ago, that's what I was taught to believe.
---But, I'm still no good at it.
After all, I'm showing weakness like this, aren't I?"
As she speaks,
Akiha jumps forward with light steps.
As if dancing, she walks amidst the fallen autumn leaves.

entries.japanese:
「秋―――葉」
　……胸がいたい。
　俺はどうかしてしまったのか、この瞬間、目の前にいる秋葉を無性に抱きしめたくなった。
　……月の光には魔力があるのか。
　たとえ妹でも―――いや、妹だからこそ、俺は、この少女を守りたいっていう衝動にかられている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aki―――ha.”
My chest hurts.
Something must be wrong with me; at that moment, I desperately want to take her in my arms.
Does moonlight possess some kind of magic?
Even though she is my sister―――no, because she is my sister, I am seized by the need to protect her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki---ha."
…… My chest hurts.
I don't know why, but right now, I want to embrace Akiha tightly.
…… Is there some magic in the light of the moon?
Even though she's my sister… no, because she is my sister, I really want to protect this girl.

entries.japanese:
「冷えてきましたね。
そろそろ戻りましょうか、兄さん」
「……そうだな、戻ろう。
いつまでもこうしているとどうにかしそ―――」
「……兄さん？」
「―――――」
　秋葉の声が聞こえる。
　けど、何を言っているのか聞き取れない。
　本当に、俺はどうかしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is getting cold. Shall we go back, Brother?”
“Yes… let us go. If I stay out here much longer, I might lose―――”
“Brother…?”
“―――――”
I can hear Akiha’s voice.
But I cannot make out what she is saying.
There truly is something wrong with me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's getting cold.
Shall we go back, Nii-san?"
"…… Yeah, let's go back.
We shouldn't stay here forever----"
"…… Nii-san?"
"-----"
I can hear Akiha's voice.
But, I can't hear what she's saying.
Really, I don't know what it is.

entries.japanese:
黒い筈の秋葉の髪が。
　血のように、真っ赤な色に、見えるなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s hair should be black.
Yet it looks scarlet—as red as blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha's hair that should be black,
It looks crimson, like blood.

entries.japanese:
―――――いらない。
　それは、いらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――I do not need it.
I do not need that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Unnecessary.

It's unnecessary.

entries.japanese:
――――いらない。
　それはいらないもの。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I do not need it.
That is something I do not need.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Unnecessary.
It's something unnecessary.

entries.japanese:
――――いらない。
　赤い髪。
血のようなイメージ。
血を吸う鬼。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I do not need it.
Red hair. An image of blood. A blood-drinking demon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Unnecessary.
Red hair.
The image of blood.
A demon that drinks blood.

entries.japanese: ――――それは、人間ではないもの、故に。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Because it is not human.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----That is not human, therefore…

entries.japanese: 排除しなくては、いけない、もの。
entries.maoEnglish: Something that must be eliminated.
entries.mirrorMoon: It, must be eliminated.

entries.japanese:
「―――兄さん？
　ちょっと、大丈夫ですか兄さん……！？」
「ぐっ………あ、っ………！」
　胸が絞まる。
　心臓が暴れまわる。
　血液は静脈動脈を拡大させ、
　脳髄がころせころせと繰り返す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Brother? Please, are you all right, Brother…!?”
“Guh, ah!”
My chest constricts.
My heart thrashes.
Blood swells every vein and artery,
and my brain chants kill, kill, kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Nii-san?
Are you alright?
Nii-san…!?"
"Guh… ahh…!"
My chest tightens.
My heart is racing.
Blood clogs my veins.
Repeating in my head, kill, kill.

entries.japanese:
―――――いや、コロスまでもない。
　その前にこの女の体を楽しもう。
　か細い腕。
美しい髪。
小さな胸。
　人形のように素晴らしく均整のとれたその体を、犯してしまえ。
―――喉が熱い。
　まるで。
　夢の中で人を殺した時のように、熱い。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――No; there is no need to kill her.
First, enjoy this woman’s body.
Frail arms. Beautiful hair. Small breasts.
Take that exquisitely proportioned, doll-like body—and rape her.
―――My throat is burning.
Burning just as it did when I
killed people in my dreams.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----No, I'm not going to kill yet.
I'll enjoy this woman's body first.
Her slender arms.
Her beautiful hair.
Her small breasts.
Her body, perfect like a beautiful doll; I'll violate it.
---My throat is hot.
It's just like…
when I kill people in dreams.
Hot.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、しっかりしてください。
肩をかしますから、屋敷に戻りましょう」
　声。
秋葉の声しか聞こえない。
否、顔を見てはいけない。
見ればきっと、俺はそのまま――――
「―――いい。
あきはの体には、触れ、ない」
　違う、触れたくない。
　触れれば―――なにをしてしまうか、解らない。
「……先に戻る。
おまえもちゃんと戻れよ、秋、葉」
　かろうじて残っている理性を総動員して、秋葉の前から駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, pull yourself together. Lean on me and we will go back to the mansion.”
Her voice. I hear only Akiha’s voice. No, I must not look at her face. If I do, I know I will――――
“―――No. I will not touch Akiha’s body.”
Wrong, I do not want to touch her.
If I touch her―――I do not know what I might do.
“I am going on ahead… make sure you come back too, Akiha.”
Gathering every scrap of reason left to me, I run from her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, please hold on.
I'll help you, so let's go back to the mansion."
Voice.
I can only hear Akiha's voice.
No, I mustn't see her face.
If I do, I'll…
"---It's okay.
I… won't touch, your body."
No.
I can't touch it.
If I touch it---I don't know what I'll do.
"…… I'll go back first.
Make sure you come in too, Aki, ha…"
With what little reason I have left, I run from Akiha.

entries.japanese:
なんとか自力で戻ってこれた。
「はっ―――あ、はあ、あ――――」
　そのままベッドに倒れこむ。
「く――――そ、ぅ………！」
　自己嫌悪で死にたくなる。
　俺は夢の中だけじゃ飽き足らず、現実でまであんな衝動を覚えてしまった。
　
　それも他の誰でもなく、秋葉に対してあんな淫らな―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Somehow I make it back under my own power.
“Hah―――ah, hah, ah――――”
I collapse onto the bed.
“Damn――――it…!”
Self-loathing makes me want to die.
Dreams were not enough; I felt that impulse in the waking world too.
And toward Akiha, of all people, something so obscene―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Somehow, I make it back alone.
I breathe desperately.
I collapse onto the bed.
"Damn it………!"
I hate myself.
Not satisfied with mere dreams, I feel these urges in reality, too.
And not strangers; I wanted to do such things to Akiha---

entries.japanese:
「オレ―――俺、は」
　もう、自分で自分がわからない。
　八年前の思い出。
　血まみれの少年と秋葉。
　今見ている現実とも夢ともとれない出来事。
―――――殺人鬼のような遠野志貴。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I―――I am”
I no longer understand myself.
Memories from eight years ago.
A blood-soaked boy and Akiha.
Events unfolding before me that might be reality or dreams.
―――――Shiki Tohno—something like a murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I---I…"
I don't understand myself anymore.
Memories of eight years ago.
Akiha, and a boy covered in blood.
An event I can't dismiss as a dream or as reality.
-----Tohno Shiki, like a killer.

entries.japanese:
「――知ってるよ。
志貴くんの脆いところを」
　……彼女。
弓塚が誇らしげに言っていた言葉。
「志貴くんもわたしと同じだよ。
　わたしと同じ、人殺しが好きで好きでたまらないヒトなんだって―――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――I know, Shiki. I know where you are weakest.”
Her words. Yumizuka had said them so proudly.
“You are the same as me, Shiki.
Just like me, you love killing people so much you can never get enough―――!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I know.
Shiki-kun's fragile side."
…… Her.
Yumizuka spoke those words proudly.
"You're the same as me.
Just like me, you have the same unbearable urge to kill---!"

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　否定、できない。
　そもそも遠野の人間はみんなどこか異状なんだ。
　狂死。
変死。
行方不明。
精神異常。
　琥珀の血を飲んでいた秋葉。
　殺人の夢をみる自分。
「―――――く」
　思って、あまりの馬鹿らしさに苦笑いをした。
　なんで秋葉がおかしくなければいけないのか。
　秋葉は正常で、あれは俺が見た破綻した妄想じゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
I cannot deny it.
Every member of the Tohno family is abnormal somehow.
Death by madness. Unnatural death. Disappearance. Insanity.
Akiha drinking Kohaku’s blood.
Me dreaming of murder.
“―――――Hah.”
The thought is so absurd that a bitter laugh escapes me.
Why must Akiha be the one who is mad?
Akiha is sane, and what I saw was nothing but my own broken delusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I can't deny it.
After all, those in the Tohno family have problems.
Death by madness.
Death by violence.
Disappearances.
Psychotic episodes.
Akiha drinking Kohaku's blood.
Me, seeing homicidal dreams.
"-----Guh."
Thinking about it, I have to smile at my foolishness.
Why should Akiha be strange?
Akiha is normal, and that's just what I imagined.

entries.japanese:
そう、狂っているのはオレだけだ。
　オレだけがこうして―――今夜も、ヒトの血を求めて、いる――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, I alone am mad.
I am the only one like this―――craving human blood again tonight――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, I'm the only one that's mad.
Only I am---wanting blood tonight as well---

entries.japanese: ―――――一度昂ぶった体は、眠りなどでは治まらない。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Once the body has been aroused, sleep cannot quiet it.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----Once aroused, my body can't be calmed with something like sleep.

entries.japanese:
―――――さあ。
　　　　　今夜も、この渇きを癒しにいこう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Come.
Tonight, once again, we will go and slake this thirst.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----So.
Tonight too, I shall relieve my thirst.

entries.japanese:
また夜の街に出たようだ。
　また目を血走らせて、
　また誰か通りかからないか待っているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
It seems the figure has gone out into the city again.
Eyes bloodshot again,
waiting again for someone to pass by.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems I went into town at night again.
It seems my eyes are bloodshot,
and I'm waiting for someone to pass by again.

entries.japanese: ――――いつのまに眠ってしまったのか。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――When did I fall asleep?
entries.mirrorMoon: ---When did I unknowingly fall asleep?

entries.japanese:
長い髪をざあ、とゆらして。
　夜の街を徘徊していっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Long hair streams through the air.
The figure prowls the night streets.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Long hair swaying.
Wandering the town at night.

entries.japanese: ――――また、殺人の夢を見てる。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――I’m dreaming of murder again.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----I'm having another homicidal dream.

entries.japanese:
新しい獲物を見つけたようだ。
　今夜はもう誰でもいいのか。
　見知らぬ男性を殺して、路地裏に引きずっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
It seems to have found new prey.
Will anyone do tonight?
A stranger is killed and dragged into an alley.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems I found new prey.
Anyone will do tonight.
Killing a strange man, dragging him into a back alley.

entries.japanese:
その死体の喉元に食らいつく音。
　じゅるじゅる、という音が聞こえる。
　喉もとから、肉ごとかみ切るように血を飲んで、喉の渇きを癒している。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sound of teeth fastening on the corpse’s throat.
Wet sucking fills my ears.
Blood is swallowed straight from the neck, meat bitten away with it, until the thirst subsides.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of biting the throat.
There's a gurgling sound.
Biting into the throat, and drinking blood to relieve the thirst.

entries.japanese: ――――また、同じ出来事。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The same thing, all over again.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----It's the same again.

entries.japanese:
と。
　邪魔が、入った。
　死体を捨てて跳びあがる。
　誰か。
誰かが見ているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then.
An interruption.
The corpse is cast aside, and I leap away.
Someone. Someone is watching.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then.
An obstruction appears.
I throw the body aside and rise.
Someone.
Someone is watching me.

entries.japanese: ――――黒い人影がやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――A black silhouette approaches.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The black figure appears.

entries.japanese: 髪を振り乱して、頭上の月を見上げている。
entries.maoEnglish: Hair flying wild, the figure looks up at the moon.
entries.mirrorMoon: Shaking my hair loose, I look up at the moon.

entries.japanese: ――――その人影は、俺のよく知っている人だった。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――It is someone I know well.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The figure is someone I know well.

entries.japanese:
屋根から屋根へ。
　闇から闇へ。
　人影は追ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Roof to roof.
Darkness to darkness.
Still the figure follows.
entries.mirrorMoon:
From rooftop to rooftop.
From shadow to shadow.
The figure follows.

entries.japanese: ――――シエル先輩にそっくりの人影は、化け物みたいな殺人鬼を、同じように化け物みたいな速さで追っていく。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The shadow that looks exactly like Ciel chases the monstrous murderer with equally monstrous speed.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The black figure looks a lot like Ciel-senpai, matching the fiend's unnatural speed perfectly.

entries.japanese: ――――動きが止まった。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The killer stops.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The movement stops.

entries.japanese:
昂ぶっていたためだろう。
　戦う気らしかった。
　逃げるのは飽きたらしい。
　おそらくは、『遊んでやる』気になったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps it is the excitement.
The killer means to fight.
It seems to have tired of running.
Perhaps it has decided to ‘play.’
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since it's excited.
It seems ready to fight.
It seems tired of running.
It probably felt like playing.

entries.japanese: ――――シエル先輩が、やってくる。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Ciel closes in.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Ciel-senpai is coming.

entries.japanese:
……その後は早かった。
　シエル先輩はとても強かったけど、偶然通行人がやってきてしまって、それで終わってしまったみたいだ。
　通行人を庇おうとして、シエル先輩はその通行人ごと鉄パイプらしきもので串刺しにされてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
After that, it happens quickly.
Ciel is terribly strong, but a passerby stumbles into the fight, and that seems to decide it.
When Ciel tries to protect him, both of them are run through by something like an iron pipe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… After that, it was quick.
Ciel-senpai was very strong, but when a passerby happened to appear, that was the end.
When she moved to protect that passerby, she was skewered with something like an iron pipe along with the passerby.

entries.japanese: ――――むごすぎる光景。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――A scene too hideous to bear.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----It's too cruel to watch.

entries.japanese:
両手を重ねられて、そこも鉄パイプで貫かれてしまう。
　ちょうど張りつけにされるようになって、シエル先輩は裸にされてしまったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her hands are laid one over the other and pierced by another iron pipe.
Had Ciel been stripped naked and crucified like that?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Lifting her hands up, they too are skewered with pipes.
Hung like a crucifix, Ciel-senpai is stripped.

entries.japanese: ――――……笑っているのが、わかる。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――I can tell that the figure is smiling.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----…… I know it's laughing.

entries.japanese:
シエル先輩の胸に舌を這わせて、笑っている。
　シエル先輩は何もせずに睨んできていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The figure smiles as it trails its tongue across Ciel’s breast.
She does nothing but glare back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sliding its tongue over Ciel-senpai's breasts, it laughs.
Ciel-senpai simply glares, doing nothing.

entries.japanese:
――――火のような青い瞳。
　　　　それと俺の目があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Blue eyes like flame.
They meet mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Blue pupils like flames.
Looking into my eyes.

entries.japanese: ――――映像が途絶える。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The vision cuts out.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The image stops.

entries.japanese: ――――ｏｒｇａｎが壊れた。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The organ breaks.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Organs break.

entries.japanese: ――――夢は、カサブタを引き剥がすように、
entries.maoEnglish: ――――The dream, like a scab being torn away,
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Like peeling off a scab,

entries.japanese: 覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish: comes to an end.
entries.mirrorMoon: I wake up.

entries.japanese:
「――――！」
　ベッドから跳ね起きる。
　時計は朝の六時前。
「先輩まで―――どうして」
　……いや、あの神父のような服装をした人影が先輩と決まったわけじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――!”
I bolt upright in bed.
The clock shows a little before six.
“Why was Ciel there too―――?”
No, there is no proof that the shadow dressed like a priest was really her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!"
I jump out of bed.
It's almost six in the morning.
"Even Senpai---why?"
…… No, that woman in priestly robes wasn't necessarily Senpai.

entries.japanese:
それに、さっきの先輩は普通じゃなかった。
　夢の中の自分も異状だったけど、先輩の異状さはその上をいっていた。
　屋根から屋根へ跳び移るなんていうのは当たり前で、手に持った剣を弾丸みたいに投げつけてきていた。
　見ようによっては、殺人鬼なんかより先輩のほうがよっぽど怪物じみていたと思う。
―――だから、あれは夢のハズだ。
　その証拠に目が覚めたら、自分はベッドに眠っていたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Besides, the Ciel in that dream was not normal.
My dreaming self had been monstrous, but she was stranger still.
Leaping from roof to roof seemed effortless to her, and she hurled the swords in her hands like bullets.
Depending on how one looked at it, she had seemed more inhuman than the murderer.
―――So it had to be a dream.
The proof was that I had awakened in my own bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Because, there was something different about her.
The me inside the dream was strange, but that Senpai was even stranger.
Leaping from rooftop to rooftop, and throwing swords like bullets.
It almost seemed like Senpai was more of a monster than the killer.
---So it has to be a dream.
Because when I opened my eyes, I was sleeping in my own bed.

entries.japanese:
「―――あれが夢だっていうのか、俺は」
　はは、と笑ってしまった。
　あれが夢かどうかは問題じゃない。
　俺が覚えてなかろうと、俺に人殺しをするつもりがなかったとしても、そんなものは何の意味も持ちえない。
―――確かな事は、まだこの体が興奮しているという事だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――And I am calling that a dream?”
A laugh escapes me.
Whether it was a dream is not the point.
It makes no difference that I cannot remember doing it, or that I never intended to kill anyone.
―――The only certainty was that my body remained aroused.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I can just call it a dream?"
I laugh.
Whether or not it was a dream isn't the problem.
What I remember and how much I didn't want to kill are meaningless.
---All I know is, my body is still excited.

entries.japanese:
見知らぬ男性の首を折る時の感触も、
　シエル先輩の両腕を串刺しにして、その体に舌を這わせた生々しさも。
　……間近で感じた先輩の吐息の熱さも、まだ感覚として残っている。
　だから、アレが夢であろうと現実であろうと、何も変わらない。
　俺が人を殺して、先輩を犯そうとした事には変わりはないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
The feel of the stranger’s neck breaking in my hands,
the obscene reality of impaling Ciel’s arms and running my tongue over her body.
Even the heat of her breath against me remains in my senses.
Dream or reality, it changes nothing.
Either way, I killed a man and tried to rape her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The feel of breaking the man's neck,
of skewering Ciel-senpai's arms over her head, and licking her body.
…… I can still feel the heat of her breath.
So, whether it was a dream or reality makes no difference.
I killed someone and tried to rape Senpai in either case.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
　学生服を持って翡翠が入ってくる。
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「……ああ、おはよう翡翠」
　胸に残る血の手触りと、先輩の肌の温かさを振り払うように声をかける。
　……けど、そんな事は無駄だった。
　翡翠がやってきて朝を告げてくれたっていうのに、俺の気分はどうしようもないぐらいに沈みこんだままだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Hisui enters carrying my school uniform.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Morning, Hisui.”
I answer as though my voice could drive away the feel of blood on my hands and the warmth of Ciel’s skin.
It is useless.
Hisui has come to announce the morning, yet my spirits remain fathoms deep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me."
Hisui enters carrying my school uniform.
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"…… Yeah, morning, Hisui."
I answer, shaking off the remaining sensation of Senpai's warmth.
…… But, it's no good.
Even though Hisui came to wake me up, I still can't help but feel depressed.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……？
　お顔の色が優れないようですが、まだお体の調子が優れないのですか？」
「……いいや、そんな事はないよ。
寝起きに体調が悪いのはいつもの事だから」
　ベッドから立ちあがる。
　……頭痛がしたが、それは無視した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…? You look pale; are you still unwell?”
“No… I am fine; I always feel ill just after waking.”
I rise from the bed.
My head ached, but I ignored it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama…?
You seem pale.
Are you still ill?"
"…… Nah, it's not that.
I'm always like this in the morning."
I get out of bed.
…… My head aches, but I ignore it.

entries.japanese:
「すぐに居間に行くよ。
秋葉のやつ、待ってるんだろ？」
「いえ、秋葉さまも今朝はお体のほうが優れないらしく、学校をお休みになられるそうです」
「え―――だってあいつ、昨日の夜はあんなに元気だったのに」
「わたしからは何もお答えできません。
姉さんから聞いただけですので、詳しく知らされてはいないのです」
「―――そうか。
その、前と同じような発作なのかな」
「姉さんが居間におりますから、詳しい話は姉さんに聞いてください」
　それでは、と翡翠は部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll be in the sitting room in a minute. Akiha’s waiting, isn’t she?”
“No, Miss Akiha also appears unwell this morning and will be absent from school.”
“What―――but she was perfectly fine last night.”
“I cannot tell you anything more. I only heard it from my sister and was given no details.”
“―――I see. Could it be another attack like last time?”
“My sister is in the sitting room; please ask her.”
With a quiet farewell, Hisui left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll go to the sitting room.
I bet Akiha's waiting?"
"No.
It seems that Akiha-sama is not feeling well this morning either, so she shall be absent from school today."
"Eh---but, she was fine just last night."
"I cannot say.
Since I heard this only from Nee-san, I do not know the details."
"---I see.
Another fit, like before, I guess…"
"Nee-san is in the sitting room, so please ask her for the details."
With that, Hisui leaves.

entries.japanese:
「あら、おはようございます志貴さん。
今日はお早いんですね」
「おはよう琥珀さん。
……って、そんなことより秋葉の容体が悪いって、どうしてなんですか」
「え――？
　あ、翡翠ちゃんから聞いたんですね。
秋葉さまは少し熱があるようですので今日はお休みになられるそうです」
「熱があるって―――だから、どうして」
「そうですねー、志貴さんが帰っていらしてからずっとお忙しかったでしょう？
　親戚の方たちとのお話とか、転校の手続きとか。
それで疲れがたまってしまっただけです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, good morning, Master Shiki. You are up early today.”
“Morning, Kohaku. Never mind that—why is Akiha ill?”
“What――? Oh, Hisui told you. Miss Akiha seems to have a slight fever, so she will be resting today.”
“A fever―――but why?”
“Well, Miss Akiha has been terribly busy ever since you returned, Master Shiki. Meeting with relatives, arranging her transfer… the strain must finally have caught up with her.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, good morning, Shiki-san.
You're up early today."
"Morning, Kohaku-san… I heard Akiha's condition is bad, what happened?"
"Eh--?
Ah, Hisui-chan told you?
Akiha-sama has a bit of a fever, so she's taking today off."
"A fever… but, why?"
"Well, she's been really busy since you got back, hasn't she?
Speaking with relatives, arrangements to change schools.
She's just tired out."

entries.japanese:
「……疲れがたまっただけって、ほんとですか？」
「もちろんです。
ふふ、志貴さんったらそんなに血相を変えてしまって、やっぱり秋葉さまの事が大切なんですねー」
　くすくすと嬉しそうに笑う琥珀さん。
　言われて、自分がどれくらい切迫していたかに気がついた。
「あ……いや、別に秋葉が大切っていうわけじゃなくて、その―――」
「その、なんですか志貴さん」
　じっ、とまっすぐに見つめてくる瞳。
　下手なウソなんてすぐ見ぬかれそうだし、なにより自分の気持ちにウソを言うのは間違ってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you sure she is only tired?”
“Of course. My, you have gone so pale; Miss Akiha really is precious to you, Master Shiki.”
Kohaku giggles happily.
Only then do I realize how desperate I must have looked.
“Ah, no, it is not that Akiha is especially precious to me, I just―――”
“You just what, Master Shiki?”
Her eyes hold mine without wavering.
She would see through any clumsy lie at once; more importantly, lying about my own feelings would be wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Just tired out?
Really?"
"Of course.
Oh, Shiki-san, you're panicking.
She must be really important to you."
Kohaku-san laughs happily.
As she speaks, I realize how tense I was getting.
"Ah… nah, I wasn't really worried about Akiha, I was just…"
"Just what, Shiki-san?"
Her eyes stare straight at me.
I'm not good at lying, and I don't want to betray my feelings.

entries.japanese:
「―――いや、違います。
……琥珀さんの言うとおり、俺にとって秋葉は大切だから心配にもなるんです」
　……自分でも恥ずかしいけど、琥珀さんの前では本当の気持ちを口にする事にした。
「志貴さん、今日は素直なんですね。
そういう事は、ぜひ秋葉さまがいる時に言ってあげてください」
　無邪気な笑顔でとんでもない事を言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No, that is not it. You are right—Akiha is precious to me, so of course I am worried.”
It embarrasses me even to admit it to myself, but I choose to tell Kohaku the truth.
“You are very honest today, Master Shiki. Please be sure to say that when Miss Akiha can hear you.”
She delivers this outrageous suggestion with an innocent smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ah, no, you're right.
Akiha's important to me, so like you said, I was worried."
…… Though I'm embarrassed, I tell Kohaku-san my true feelings.
"Shiki-san, you're very honest today.
Please, say that when Akiha-sama's here."
With an innocent smile, she says something pretty scary.

entries.japanese:
「……あのですね。
秋葉本人にこんな事を言っても仕方がないでしょう。
　それより琥珀さん、秋葉はまだ眠っているんですか？」
「はい、先ほどお薬を飲んでお眠りになりました。
『見舞いになんてこなくていいから兄さんは学校に行ってください』だそうです」
「……そっか。
なら、少し安心した」
　ふう、とソファーに腰を下ろす。
　……とりあえず、これで悩み事が一つ減ってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…What would be the point of saying that to Akiha herself?
More importantly, Kohaku, is she still asleep?”
“Yes, she took some medicine and fell asleep a little while ago. Her message was that Brother need not visit her and should go to school.”
“I see… then I am a little relieved.”
I sink onto the sofa with a long breath.
At least one of my worries has been lifted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"… Oh, come on.
There's no way I could tell Akiha that.
By the way, is she still asleep?"
"Yes, she took some medicine and went to sleep a short while ago.
She said 'there's no need to visit, so Nii-san should just go to school'."
"…… Really.
Well then, I'm glad."
I sit down on a sofa.
…… At least this is one less thing to worry about.

entries.japanese:
「あっ、志貴さん。
昨夜のことですけど、秋葉さまとお庭のほうで話していたというのは本当ですか？」
「本当だよ。
昨日は寝つけなくて、庭を眺めてたら秋葉がいたもんだから少し話しこんだんだけど、それがどうかしたの？」
「いえ、翡翠ちゃんがそんな事を言ってたから気になっただけです。
　けど志貴さん、夜中に出歩くのはあんまり感心できることじゃありませんよ。
最近はとても物騒なんですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Master Shiki. Is it true that you spoke with Miss Akiha in the garden last night?”
“Yes, I could not sleep and saw Akiha while looking into the garden. We ended up talking for a while, but why?”
“No, Hisui mentioned it, so I wondered.
But you really should not wander around at night, Master Shiki. Things have been terribly dangerous lately.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san.
Last night, were you really talking to Akiha-sama in the garden?"
"That's right.
I couldn't sleep yesterday, and when I looked out, Akiha was in the garden, so I went out and talked for a bit.
Why?"
"Well, Hisui-chan said so, so I was a bit worried.
But, Shiki-san, you shouldn't be going outside late at night.
It's very dangerous these days."

entries.japanese:
「……例の通り魔殺人のことだろ。
そんな事なら誰よりもわかってるつもりだよ」
「それでしたらいいんですけど、本当に気をつけてくださいね。
昨日の夜も街のほうで男の人が殺されてしまったらしいですから」
「―――――――」
　がたん、とソファー立ちあがった。
「琥珀さん、いまの話、ほんとう？」
「ええ、朝のニュースでやってましたから。
今まで女性しか被害者がいなかった所に男の人の犠牲者が出たという事で、色々と騒がしくなってたみたいです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mean the serial killings… believe me, I understand the danger better than anyone.”
“That is all right, then, but please be careful. Apparently a man was murdered in the city last night as well.”
“―――――――”
I shot to my feet, knocking against the sofa.
“Kohaku, is that true?”
“Yes, it was on the morning news. All the victims until now had been women, so the first male victim caused quite an uproar.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Because of the killer, right?
I think I know that better than anyone."
"Even so, please take care.
Apparently a man was killed in town last night."
"-------"
I jump off the sofa.
"Kohaku-san… is that true?"
"Yes, it was on the morning news.
Since the victims have all been women until now, they seem to be talking about it a lot."

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　男。
男の、被害者。
　夢の中で殺してしまった、見知らぬ男性。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
A man. A male victim.
The stranger I killed in my dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
A man.
A male victim.
The unknown man I killed in the dream.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん―――？」
　……琥珀さんが何か言っている。
「あ―――いや。
なんでも、ないんだ」
　そんな言葉しか返せないまま、いつまでも呆然と立ち尽くした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――?”
Kohaku is saying something.
“Ah―――no. It is nothing.”
That is all I can answer as I stand there, numb and unmoving.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san---?"
…… Kohaku-san is saying something.
"Ah---no, it's… nothing."
That's all I can say as I stand in amazed shock.

entries.japanese:
――――学校に着いた。
　時間は七時五十分過ぎ。
　ずいぶんと早く屋敷を出たはずなのに、結局いつものようにギリギリの時間に登校するはめになっている。
　理由は言うまでもない。
　自分が殺人鬼かもしれないという恐れが、足の進みを遅くしていただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I arrived at school.
It is past seven fifty.
I left the mansion unusually early, yet in the end I arrive at the last possible minute, as usual.
The reason needs no explanation.
The fear that I might be a murderer has slowed every step.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I arrive at school.
It's seven-fifty.
Even though I left the mansion very early, I still only made it to school at the last minute.
The reason is obvious.
The possibility that I might be a killer slowed me down.

entries.japanese:
校門をくぐる。
　周りには自分と同じように教室に向かう生徒たちの姿がある。
「―――――――」
　……彼らの姿を見るたびに足が止まる。
　彼らは人殺しなんて考えもしない普通の人間だ。
その中に自分のような人間が混ざって、一緒に授業なんて受けていいはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pass through the school gate.
Other students are making their way toward the school building.
“―――――――”
Every time I look at them, my feet stop.
They are ordinary people who would never dream of murder. Someone like me has no right to mingle among them and sit through the same lessons.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I step through the gate.
There are people like me all around, going to class.
"-------"
…… Every time I see them, I freeze.
They are people who never think of murder.
And amongst them there are people like me, attending the same lessons.

entries.japanese:
「……弓塚。
やっと、キミの気持ちが分かった」
　いや、彼女に比べれば俺の不安なんて小さいものだろうけど、でもようやく、弓塚さつきが失ってしまったものがなんだったのかが実感できた。
　……今の遠野志貴は、ここには居てはいけないと思う。
　もう何人も人を殺してきている。
　それが夢であるか現実であるかは別にして、たしかにそういった嗜好を持ってしまっているのなら、ここに居てはいけないハズだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka… I finally understand how you felt.”
My fear is probably small compared with hers, yet I finally understand what Satsuki Yumizuka lost.
The Shiki Tohno I am now does not belong here.
I have already killed several people.
Dream or reality, if I truly possess such appetites, I have no right to be here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yumizuka.
At last, I know how you felt."
No, I can't compare my situation to hers.
But perhaps now I understand a little of her feelings.
…… The way I am now, I can't be here.
I have killed many people already.
It doesn't matter if it's a dream or not, but with desires like that, I must not be here.

entries.japanese:
「…………は」
　苦笑してしまう。
　ほんの数日前までは、こんな事で悩むなんて考えもしなかったのに。
「ほら、そこの少年。
のんびりしてたら遅刻しちゃいますよ」
「え？」
　ぽん、と肩を叩かれた。
「おはようございます遠野くん。
今朝も一緒の時間ですね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…”
I laugh bitterly.
Only a few days ago, I could never have imagined agonizing over something like this.
“Come now, young man. If you dawdle there, you will be late.”
“Huh?”
A hand pats my shoulder.
“Good morning, Tohno. We’ve arrived at the same time again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Ha."
I smile wryly.
A few days ago, I wouldn't even have imagined something like this.
"Hey, you.
If you just stand around like that, you'll be late."
"Eh?"
Someone hits me on the shoulder.
"Good morning, Tohno-kun.
We're here today at the same time."

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　あんまりに咄嗟のことで、喉がつまった。
「あれ、どうかしました？
　遠野くん、顔が赤いですけど」
「――――――」
　忘れていた。
　俺は自分の事ばっかりで、先輩の事を忘れていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
The encounter is so sudden that my throat closes.
“Is something wrong? Your face is red, Tohno.”
“――――――”
I had forgotten.
I was so consumed by myself that I forgot about Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I'm so surprised, I can't speak.
"Hm?
What's wrong?
Your face is red, Tohno-kun."
"------"
I forgot.

Thinking only about myself, I forgot about Senpai.

entries.japanese:
―――――昨日の夜。
　人を殺していた俺の前にやってきた黒い人影。
　血を吸う殺人鬼を追いかけて、あと少しで殺人鬼を仕留められるという所で捕まってしまって、逆にその体を串刺しにされた誰か。
―――――そうして、その後。
　俺が、犯そうとしてしまった、体。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Last night.
The black silhouette that came upon me while I was killing.
The one who pursued the blood-drinking murderer and nearly brought the killer down, only to be caught and impaled instead.
―――――And afterward.
The body I tried to rape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Last night.
The black figure who appeared before me as I killed.
Pursuing the killer, caught by the killer and skewered from behind.
-----And then.
The body, I was about, to rape.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩、その―――」
　なんて言っていいのか解らない。
　昨日の夜のことを謝らなくっちゃいけないけど、あれが夢なのか現実なのかまだ俺自身判っていない。
　それに、何より―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, that is―――”
I do not know what to say.
I must apologize for last night, yet even I still do not know whether it was dream or reality.
And above all―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, um---"
I don't know what to say.
I should apologize for last night, but I still don't know myself whether that was a dream or not.
But, more than anything---

entries.japanese:
「はい、なんですか遠野くん？」
「いえ、その……先輩はいつも通りだなって、思って」
―――何より、先輩はいつも通りだ。
　だから昨日の夜の出来事はやっぱり夢なのか、それともあの人影は先輩じゃない誰かっていう事になる。
　昨日の夜、体を鉄パイプで串刺しにされた人がこうして元気に学校にいるわけはないし……シエル先輩が昨日の人影なら、殺人鬼である俺を目の前にしてこんなふうに笑いかけてくれるはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, what is it, Tohno?”
“No, it is just, I was thinking you seem exactly the same as ever.”
―――Above all, she is unchanged.
Either last night was a dream after all, or the shadow was someone else.
A person impaled by iron pipes cannot be standing here in perfect health, and if that really was Ciel, she would never smile like this at the murderer before her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes?
What is it, Tohno-kun?"
"No, you… you seem the same as ever, Senpai."
---More than anything, Senpai is the same as ever.
So, either last night's events were just a dream, or the figure in black wasn't Ciel-senpai.
The person who was skewered with an iron pipe last night would not be attending school today… and if Ciel-senpai was the figure from yesterday, she should not be smiling warmly at the killer.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん？
　どうしちゃってるんですか、さっきから顔を赤くしたり青くしたり。
気分悪そうですけど、もしかして秋風邪ですか？」
「いや、そういうワケじゃないんだけど、その―――」
　……昨夜の夢がまだ体に残っていて、先輩の顔を直視できない。
　艶かしい素肌の色とか、柔らかい手触りとか。
　張りがあって、そのくせ強く握ると柔らかく指が食いこんでいく乳房と、その上にイレズミみたいに流れた赤い血の鮮やかさ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno? What has gotten into you, turning red and then white? You look ill; perhaps you have caught an autumn cold?”
“No, it is not that, I just―――”
Last night’s dream still clings to my body, and I cannot look her in the face.
The sheen of naked skin, its yielding softness.
The full breasts that resisted my grip before my fingers sank into them, and the vivid red blood trailing over them like a tattoo.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun?
Is something wrong?
Your face keeps going red and blue.
Are you not feeling well?
An autumn cold, perhaps?"
"No, it's not that, it's just---"
…… The feel of last night's dream is still with me, and I can't look directly at Senpai.
The gleam of naked skin, its soft texture.
My fingers gripping her soft breasts with most of the red blood flowing over her like a tattoo.

entries.japanese:
「―――――う」
　……まずい。
余計なことをリアルに思い出してしまった。
「遠野くん？
　ほんとうにさっきからヘンですよ。
教室に行く前に保健室でお薬をもらったほうがいいんじゃないですか？」
　こっちの様子が気になるのか、先輩は下から覗き込んでくる。
「う―――ちょっと、先輩」
　そんなに近くにこられると、昨日の夢を思い出してしまう。
　……シエル先輩の顔を目の前にして、カア、と自分の頬が赤くなるのがわかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Ugh.”
This is bad. I remembered far too much, far too vividly.
“Tohno? You really have been acting strangely. Perhaps you should stop at the infirmary for medicine before going to class.”
Apparently worried, Ciel bent down to peer into my face.
“Wait―――Ciel.”
Having her so close brings the dream rushing back.
With her face immediately before mine, I feel heat flood my cheeks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Uh."
…… This is bad.
I remember too much, it's too real.
"Tohno-kun?
You've really been strange for a while.
Maybe you should get some medicine from the nurse's office before going to class?"
Is she concerned?
Senpai peers up at me.
"Uh---wait, Senpai…"
If she gets close, I'll remember last night's dream.
…… With Ciel-senpai's face appearing before me, I can feel my face going completely red.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、重症みたいですね」
　呆れたふうに肩をおとして、先輩は腕を伸ばした。
　スッ、と先輩の手が額に触れてくる。
　柔らかな感触と彼女の体温が、よけい鮮明に感じられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodness, you must be seriously ill.”
With a resigned droop of her shoulders, Ciel reached toward me.
Her hand settled lightly against my forehead.
Its softness and the warmth of her body struck me with painful clarity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahh, you seem really ill."
Dropping her shoulders in amazement, Senpai stretches out her hand.
Senpai's hand touches my forehead.
Her warmth and gentle touch is too much.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ、先輩―――嬉しいけど、今はそうゆうの、困るんですけど―――」
「うーん、思ったほど熱はないみたいですね」
　先輩はこっちの言い分なんて無視して、俺の額に手を当てている。
――――と。
　熱を測る先輩の服の袖から、白い包帯が巻かれているのが見えた。
「――――え？」
　……手の平の付け根よりやや下に巻かれた包帯。
　そこは、間違いない。
　昨夜、夢の中で先輩が貫かれた部分だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait, Ciel―――I am glad, but right now this is difficult―――”
“Hmm, you do not seem as feverish as I expected.”
Ignoring my objections, Ciel keeps her hand against my forehead.
――――Then.
Her raised sleeve slips back as she takes my temperature, revealing white bandages.
“――――What?”
They are wrapped just below the heel of her hand.
There can be no mistake.
That is exactly where her arm was pierced in the dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait, Senpai… it's nice, but, right now it's a bit---"
"Hmm, it doesn't feel like you have a fever."
Senpai ignores my words, pressing her hand against my forehead.
----And.
As she takes my temperature, I catch sight of a bandage under the sleeve of Senpai's uniform.
"----Eh?"
…… The bandage goes a little way down from the base of her palm.
There's no mistaking it.
That is where she was skewered last night.

entries.japanese:
熱が急速に冷めていく。
　現実が、本当に崩れていくような感覚。
「……先輩。
その腕の包帯、どうしたんだ」
「あ、これ？
　恥ずかしながら、油断してしまった代償なんです。
……その、とっくに治っているんですけど、なんとなく気になって包帯ぐらい巻いておこうかなって。
たいした事はないですから気にしないでください」
　先輩はなんでもないように言った。
　……どうしてだろう。
　だからこそ、それが嘘だと解ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The heat drained from me in an instant.
It felt as though reality itself were truly falling apart.
“Ciel… that bandage on your arm, what happened?”
“Oh, this? Embarrassing as it is, that is the price I paid for letting my guard down. It healed ages ago… but it still bothered me, so I thought I might as well wrap it; it is nothing serious, so please do not worry.”
Ciel speaks as though it means nothing.
Somehow.
That is precisely why I know she is lying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My body heat vanishes instantly.
I feel as if reality is collapsing around me.
"…… Senpai.
That bandage on your arm.
What happened?"
"Ah, this?
Well, it's embarrassing, but it was my own negligence.
It healed already, but I felt like putting a bandage on.
It's nothing major, so don't worry about it."
Senpai speaks casually.
…… Why?
Because, I know it's a lie.

entries.japanese:
「―――違う。
たいした事、あるだろ。
昨日の夜に鉄パイプで腕を貫かれたんだから、まだ痛いにきまってる」
「――――――」
　とたん、先輩から笑顔が消えた。
「あ――――」
――――どくん。
　夢の中の空気が蘇る。
　ほんの一瞬だけ、俺のまわりの空気が凍りついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No. It is serious. An iron pipe went through your arm last night, so of course it still hurts.”
“――――――”
Her smile vanishes instantly.
“Ah――――”
――――Thump.
The atmosphere of the dream returned.
For a single moment, the air around me froze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No, it is something major.
Since you were skewered by that iron pipe, I bet it still hurts."
"------"
Then, the smile vanishes from Senpai's face.
"Ah---"
----Thump.
The atmosphere in my dream returns.
For an instant, the air around me freezes.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん、ちょっといいですか？」
　言って、先輩は俺の腕を掴んだ。
「―――――――」
　……今の自分に返す言葉はない。
　シエル先輩は何をいうのでもなく、かといって無言というわけでもなく、俺を校舎裏まで引っ張っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno, would you come with me?”
Ciel takes hold of my arm.
“―――――――”
I have no answer to give her.
Without offering any real explanation—though not exactly walking in silence either—Ciel pulled me around behind the school building.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, do you have a moment?"
Saying so, Senpai takes my arm.
"-------"
…… I can't find words yet.
Ciel-senpai says nothing, and she pulls me behind the school building.

entries.japanese:
「授業、さぼらせちゃいましたね」
　どうゆうつもりなのか、先輩はいつも通りの仕草でそんな事を口にした。
「……………」
　俺は何も言えない。
　無様にも、まだ一縷の望みにすがろうとしている。
　この後、先輩が『ところで昨日の夜って何のことですか、遠野くん』なんて言ってくれることを。
　あの夢はやっぱり夢で、先輩はただの先輩だっていうユメを、まだ期待している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve made you skip class.”
Whatever she intended, Ciel said it in her usual way.
“……………”
I cannot speak.
Pathetically, I still cling to one last thread of hope.
That Ciel will ask, ‘By the way, Tohno, what did you mean by last night?’
I still dream that the dream was only a dream, and that Ciel is only the Ciel I know.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess I made you skip class."
For some reason, Senpai sounds so normal.
"……………"
I can say nothing.
I can only hang awkwardly on this ray of hope.

That in a moment, Senpai will say, "What are you talking about?
Last night, Tohno-kun?"
That dream will be a dream after all, and Senpai will just be Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩、俺は」
「そうですね。
その前にコレを見せないといけませんね」
　俺の言葉をさえぎって、シエル先輩は服の袖をまくって両腕を見せた。
　……包帯にまかれた、痛々しい両腕。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, I…”
“Yes. Before that, I suppose I should show you this.”
Cutting me off, Ciel rolls up her sleeves and exposes both arms.
Both are swathed in painful-looking bandages.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, I…"
"Yes, I should show you this first."
Interrupting me, Ciel-senpai rolls up the sleeves of both arms.
…… Both arms weak, wrapped in bandages.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くんの言うとおり、これは昨夜やられたものです」
「――――――」
　誰に、とは聞けない。
　それは他ならぬ俺自身によるものなんだから。
　ただ、これではっきりとした。
　アレは現実で、俺はもう何人も人を殺している殺人鬼だっていう事が。
entries.maoEnglish:
“As you said, Tohno, these wounds were inflicted last night.”
“――――――”
I cannot ask by whom.
No one did it but me.
Now I know beyond doubt.
That was real, and I am a murderer who has already killed several people.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"As you say, this happened last night."
"------"
I can't ask who did it.
Because it is my doing.
But, it's clear now.
It's the truth; I am a killer who has killed many people already.

entries.japanese:
「……まいった。
あれは本当に―――本当にあった事、だったなんて」
「――――――」
　先輩は何も言わず、ただじっと俺を見つめている。
　俺が。
　遠野志貴が殺人鬼だって知っているのに、どうして―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t believe it… That really―――really happened.”
“――――――”
Ciel says nothing and only watches me.
I.
She knows Shiki Tohno is a murderer, so why―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Crap.
It's real… it really happened…"
"------"
Senpai says nothing else, but merely stares at me.
At me.
She knows Tohno Shiki is the killer, then why…

entries.japanese:
「――――――――なんで」
　この人は、どうして。
「なんで今まで黙ってたんだよ、先輩……！
　先輩は俺が人殺しだってわかってたんだろう？
　ならどうして、今まであんな―――」
　平凡な高校生の、先輩と後輩の関係を続けていてくれたのか、俺にはまったく理解できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――Why?”
Why would she.
“Why did you say nothing before, Ciel…! You knew I was killing people, did you not? Then why did you keep acting like we were―――”
I cannot understand why she kept treating me as an ordinary younger schoolmate, as though nothing were wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Why?"
Why does she…
"Why have you said nothing until now, Senpai…!
You knew I was the killer, right?
So why didn't you---"
I can't understand why she continued to be my ordinary school senpai.

entries.japanese:
「俺は人殺しだ。
昨日の夜だって先輩にあんな事をしたのに、どうしてそんな顔してられるんだよ、先輩は……！」
「そんな顔もなにも、わたしと遠野くんは普通の先輩と後輩なんですから当たり前じゃないですか。
言っておきますけど、わたしは遠野くんと夜に会ったことなんてありませんよ」
　胸をはって、キッパリと先輩は言った。
「――――はい？」
　……夜に出会った事がないって―――昨日、出会うどころか殺し合いまでしたっていうのに……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am a murderer. Even after what I did to you last night, how can you still look at me like that, Ciel…!?”
“What do you mean? You and I are an ordinary senior and junior, so of course I look at you normally; for the record, I have never met you at night.”
Ciel declares it firmly, her chest held high.
“――――What?”
Never met me at night―――when yesterday we did not merely meet, but tried to kill each other…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I've killed people.
I did that to you last night.
How can you face me like that, Senpai…!"
"It's not unusual.
I'm your senpai, so why shouldn't I?
Whatever you say, I haven't seen you out at night."
Straightening, she speaks frankly.
"----What?"
…… She hasn't met me at night----but yesterday we were fighting to the death……?

entries.japanese:
「―――何を言ってるんだ、先輩！
　今まで、今まで二回も、シエル先輩は俺の殺人を邪魔してるじゃないか……！」
「そうですけど、わたしは遠野くんに剣を向けたことなんかないです」
「な―――向けた事がないって、現に今まで何度も投げつけてきたじゃないか！
　俺は確かに見たんだ。
それともあの人影は先輩じゃないって、いまさらシラをきるっていうのか……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What are you talking about, Ciel! Twice now, you have stopped me from killing someone…!”
“That is true, but I have never turned a sword on you.”
“What―――never turned one on me? You have thrown them at me again and again! I saw you. Or will you now pretend the shadow was not you…!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are you talking about, Senpai!
Twice now, you've interrupted me killing someone…!"
"That's true, but I've never raised a sword against you."
"Wha---that's nonsense, you've thrown loads of them at me!
I saw it clearly.
Or are you saying that figure wasn't you?
Are you pretending not to know!?"

entries.japanese:
「まあ、できればシラはきりたいですけど、そこまで見られてしまっては言い訳はきかないでしょ」
　先輩の態度はまったく変わらない。
　なんていうか、先輩の言葉はいまいち要領をえない。
……いや、きっとわざとそういうふうに喋ってる。
――――冷静になってみれば。
　こっちだって人の事は言えないけど、普通じゃないっていったら先輩だって普通じゃなかったんだ。
　だからこんなふうに、はぐらかすような態度をとっているんだろうか―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I would prefer to pretend, but after you saw that much, excuses would be pointless.”
Her manner does not change at all.
Nothing she says quite answers me… no, she is surely speaking this way on purpose.
――――Once I force myself to think calmly.
I cannot criticize anyone else, but Ciel was no more normal than I was.
Is that why she keeps evading me―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I would like to feign ignorance if I could, but there's no reason to if you've seen that much."
Senpai's attitude is completely unchanged.
Senpai's words just seem not to the point… no, she is purposely doing so.
----If I calm down…
I'm not one to talk, but Senpai isn't exactly normal either.
So is that why she is trying to evade my questions----?

entries.japanese:
「先輩、真面目に答えてくれ。
俺には解らない事だらけでどうかしそうだ。
シエル先輩、あなたはどうしてあんな真似をしているんだ」
「やだ。
遠野くん、なんか恐いです」
　……どこまで本気なのか、先輩は身を引いた。
　なんか、完全にはぐらかされている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please answer me seriously. Nothing makes sense anymore, and I feel as if I’m losing my mind. Ciel—why are you doing these things?”
“Oh dear. You’re frightening me, Tohno.”
Whether she meant it or not, Ciel drew away.
She was evading me completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, please answer me seriously.
There's too much I don't understand, I'll go crazy.
Ciel-senpai, why were you doing that?"
"Oh… Tohno-kun, you look scary."
…… I don't know how serious she is but Senpai pulls away from me.
Somehow, she dodges the question completely.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩、頼むから真面目に答えてくれ。
　昨日の夜といいその前といい、先輩はいったいなんなんだ。
あんなの、普通の人間にできることじゃないだろ」
「はあ。
あんなのって、どういうのですか」
「だから……！
　こっちのデタラメな動きに平気でついてきて、何本も剣を投げつけてきたじゃないか……！
　俺が見てただけでも二十本近くはあったけど、どこにあんな沢山の剣を持ってたっていうんだ！
　それに―――昨日は」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, please answer me seriously.
What are you? What you did last night, and the time before, is impossible for an ordinary person.”
“Well… what exactly do you mean by that?”
“I mean…! You kept pace with those impossible movements and threw sword after sword at me…! I counted nearly twenty, so where were you carrying so many? And last night―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, please answer me seriously.
Last night and before that, what were you?
That was something no ordinary human can do."
"Ahh… what do you mean, 'that'?"
"I mean…!
That ridiculous movement, throwing all those swords…!
I saw about twenty swords, where were you keeping them all!
And, last night…"

entries.japanese:
「はい、昨日はどうしたんでしょうか」
「昨日は……俺に、体を鉄パイプで貫かれた。
なのにどうして、今もそんな平気な顔をしてられるんだよ。
どう考えても普通じゃないだろ。
先輩、ほんとうに人間か……！？」
　瞬間。
　先輩はひどく哀しそうな顔をして、俯いてしまった。
「……さあ。
実をいうと、わたしにも自信はないです」
「わたしはただシエルという名前がある、吸血鬼専門のエクソシストですから。
遠野くんや他のみなさんのように、常識の中にいられる人間じゃない事ぐらいはわかってます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, and what happened last night?”
“Last night, you were run through by an iron pipe. So how can you stand there looking perfectly fine? Nothing about that is normal. Ciel, are you even human…!?”
In that instant.
Ciel’s face turns terribly sad, and she lowers her head.
“I do not know… to tell you the truth, I am not certain either.”
“I’m merely a vampire-hunting exorcist named Ciel. I know at least that I’m not someone who can live an ordinary life as you and everyone else do.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes?
What about last night?"
"Last night, I… I stabbed you with an iron pipe.
So how, how can you be walking around so calmly today?
However you look at it, it's not normal.
Senpai, are you really human…!?"
For a moment.
Senpai glances down with a terribly sad expression.
"…… I don't know.
To be honest, I've no idea."
"I only have the name Ciel, an exorcist specializing in vampires.
I know that I'm not an ordinary human like you."

entries.japanese:
「え……吸血鬼って、先輩……？」
「いいです、どうせわたしはよそ者ですから。
遠野くんに白い目で見られてもしかたないって覚悟ぐらいしてますよーだ」
　そっぽを向いて、先輩はわけのわからない事を言う。
「ちょっと待って。
エクソシストってなに言ってんだよ、先輩は！」
「エクソシストはエクソシストです。
悪魔祓いの知識を学んだ修道士がなるものなんですけど、遠野くん知らないんですか？
　よく使われる言葉だから知ってると思ったんですけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Vampires, Ciel?”
“Fine, I am an outsider anyway. I am prepared for you to look at me with disgust, Tohno.”
Ciel turns away with an offended little pout and begins talking nonsense.
“Wait. What do you mean you are an exorcist, Ciel?”
“An exorcist is an exorcist. A monk trained in the lore of casting out demons, but do you not know the word? It is common enough that I thought you would.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh… vampires, Senpai…?"
"Don't worry.
I'm not from around here, so I'm already ready for you to look at me that way."
Looking away, she says something incomprehensible.
"Hold on, Senpai, what do you mean by 'exorcist'!?"
"An exorcist is an exorcist.
A member of a holy order who has learned the rites for banishing demons.
Don't you know, Tohno-kun?
It's a common word, so I thought you'd know it."

entries.japanese:
「まあ、わたしは祓うというより退治ですから厳密に言うとエクソシストとは外れています。
　そうですね、解りやすく言うと魔法使いです。
これまた厳密にいうと大はずれっていうか、正反対の俗称ですけど、遠野くんにはそのほうが解りやすいんじゃないですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Strictly speaking, though, I destroy things rather than exorcising them, so the name doesn’t quite fit.
Put simply, you could call me a ‘magician.’ Strictly speaking, that is wildly wrong too—practically the opposite—but I thought it might be easier for you to understand.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, to be honest, I do more extermination than banishing, so I'm a bit different.
Would it help if I said it's more like a sorceress?
It's not exactly right… in fact, it's almost the opposite, but perhaps it'll be easier for you to understand?"

entries.japanese:
「ま、魔法使いって、そんな―――」
　バカな、とは言えなかった。
　実際、俺はこの人の人間ばなれしたところを目の当たりにしていたから。
　……けど、それでも信じられない。
　それとも信じたくないんだろうか。
　この人があんまりにも優しい先輩だったから、俺は、シエルという人物には先輩のままでいてほしいのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A-a magician, that is―――”
I cannot call it absurd.
I have seen this woman do things no human can.
Yet I still cannot believe her.
Or perhaps I do not want to.
Because she has always been so gentle with me, perhaps I want the person named Ciel to remain the older student I know.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A sorceress?
But that's---"
I can hardly call it impossible.
After all, I've seen her superhuman powers.
…… But, I can't believe it.
Or maybe I don't want to believe it.
Since she was such a kind senpai, maybe I just want Ciel to stay as Senpai.

entries.japanese:
「―――うそ、だろ」
　……知らず、そんな言葉を口にしていた。
「はい、実はうそなんです。
全部でたらめなことなんだから、信じないでください」
　……この人は何も語ってくれない。
　それこそ、すべて作り話のようにすまそうとするだけで。
「―――違う。
アレは、でたらめなんかじゃない」
　……俺だって認めたくないけど、認めないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――That is a lie.”
The words escape me before I know I mean to speak.
“Yes, actually it is a lie. Every word was nonsense, so please do not believe any of it.”
She would tell me nothing.
She meant to dismiss everything as though it were nothing but an invented story.
“―――No. What happened was not nonsense.”
I do not want to admit it either, but I have to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That's a lie…"
…… Without realizing it, those words escape my mouth.
"Yep, you're right, it's a lie.
It's all nonsense, so please don't believe any of it."
…… She won't say anything.
She's just going to let it disappear as a lie.
"---No.
This isn't nonsense."
…… I don't want to accept it, but I have to.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　……どうしてだろう。
　先輩は、悲しそうに目を細める。
「……俺だってどうなっているのかわからない。
　けど、俺は実際に人を殺そうとして、いつも先輩に助けられてた。
何がなんだかわからないけど、それだけは真実なんだ」
「そんなのは夢じゃないですか。
遠野くんは平凡な一学生です。
わたしが保証します」
「平凡なもんか……！
　たとえ夢でも――毎夜人殺しを楽しんでいるヤツが日常生活に紛れ込んでるんだぜ？
　そんなの、俺だってゾッとする……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………………”
Why, I wonder.
Ciel narrows her eyes sadly.
“I do not understand what is happening to me either.
But I truly tried to kill people, and every time you saved me. I understand nothing else, but that much is real.”
“Perhaps it was only a dream. You are an ordinary student, Tohno. I guarantee it.”
“Ordinary…! Even if it is only in dreams――someone who delights in killing every night is walking among ordinary people? The thought horrifies even me…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
…… Why is it?
Senpai lowers her eyes sadly.
"…… I don't know what's happening either.
But, I have tried to kill people, and you always saved me.
I don't understand anything, but I do know that."
"Wasn't that just a dream?
You're just an ordinary high school student.
You have my word."
"Just an ordinary…!
Even if it is a dream, someone who enjoys murder every night is living with other normal people!
Even I feel bad about being bad……!"

entries.japanese:
―――そう、人を殺したがっている。
　夢の中だけでなく、俺は実際に殺人衝動をもってしまった。
　それも見知らぬ他人相手じゃなくて、俺は一番身近な人間である秋葉に対して―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes; I want to kill.
Not only in dreams, I have felt a genuine murderous impulse.
And not toward some stranger, but toward the person closest to me, Akiha―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Yes, feeling the urge to kill people.
Not merely in dreams, but I have such desires in reality too.
And not strangers; Akiha, the person I know best----

entries.japanese:
「……殺人鬼、か。
ああ、口にしてやっとわかった。
毎夜、先輩が俺のところにやってくるのは当然の事なんだ。
こんな危ないヤツは放っておけないもんな。
　だから―――だから先輩は俺を殺そうとしてたんだろ……！」
「……………………」
「なんで黙ってるんだ。
何か言ってくれよ、先輩！」
「あ―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“A murderer… yes, now that I have said it, I finally understand. Of course you come after me every night. You cannot leave someone this dangerous at large.
That is why―――that is why you were trying to kill me…!”
“……………………”
“Why will you not answer? Say something, Ciel!”
“Ah―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… A killer, huh.
Yeah.
Now that I state it, I understand.
It's natural for you to come to me every night.
You can't leave such a dangerous guy alone.
So---so, you were going to kill me, Senpai……!?"
"………………"
"Why won't you answer?
Say something, Senpai!"
"Ah---"

entries.japanese:
包帯にまかれた先輩の腕を掴んで、強引に引き寄せた。
　先輩は俯いたまま、何も言ってくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I catch her bandaged arm and pull her roughly toward me.
Ciel keeps her head bowed and says nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I grab Senpai's arm around the bandage, and drag her towards me.
Senpai says nothing, looking down.

entries.japanese:
「……解らない。
何一つ解らないんだ、先輩。
　俺は自分がどうなっちまっているのか本当に解らない。
……だから、頼む。
先輩が何か知っているなら教えてくれ……！」
「……………遠野くん。
あなたは、本当に自分が殺人鬼だなんて思っているんですか」
「思っているも何も、それ以外ないじゃないか。
　……だから、もう楽になりたいんだ。
俺自身で解らないから―――先輩の口からはっきりと言ってほしい。
　そうすれば、もう―――」
　もう、殺されても仕方がない事だって、覚悟ぐらいはできるだろうから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand… I do not understand anything, Ciel.
I truly do not know what is happening to me. So please. If you know something, tell me…!”
“Tohno…………… do you truly believe you are a murderer?”
“What else could I believe?
I want this uncertainty to end. Since I cannot make sense of it myself―――I need you to say it plainly.
Then I can finally―――”
Then I can at least prepare myself to accept that I deserve to die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't understand.
I don't understand anything, Senpai.
I don't understand myself anymore.
So, please, Senpai.
If you know anything, please tell me…!"
"…… Tohno-kun.
Do you really believe you're the killer?"
"I can't think of anything else.
…… So, I just want to rest now.
Since I don't know myself… I want to hear it clearly from you.
And then---"
Then, even if I have to die, I'll be ready for it.

entries.japanese:
「……どうして」
「先輩……？」
「どうして……どうしていつもみたいに、そんな馬鹿なって陽気に笑いとばしてくれないんですか。
そうすれば、ずっとこのままで過ごせたかもしれないのに」
「でも、もうダメなんですね。
魔法は、簡単にとけちゃいました」
―――そう言って。
　先輩は俺の腕から逃れて、遠く、離れてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…?”
“Ciel…?”
“Why, why could you not laugh and call it ridiculous, the way you always do? If you had, perhaps we could have gone on as we were forever.”
“But it is too late now. The magic came undone so easily.”
―――She says that.
Ciel slips free of my grasp and retreats far away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why…"
"Senpai…?"
"Why…… why can't you just laugh it off as always.
If you did, maybe we could go on like this…"
"But, it's too late for that now.
The spell has already faded."
