---Saying so,
Senpai escapes my grasp and leaps away, far away.

entries.japanese:
「遠野くん。
わたしが知っている事でいいのなら教えてさしあげます。
貴方がどんな人間なのか。
……今まで、何人の人間を殺してきたのか」
「あ―――――」
　少しだけ、眩暈がした。
　あれほど覚悟しているって言ったのに、こうはっきりと『殺した』って言われると、胸が痛くなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. If what I know will suffice, I will tell you. What kind of person you are. And how many people you have killed…”
“Ah―――――”
The world sways a little.
I insisted that I was prepared, yet hearing the word ‘killed’ spoken so plainly sends pain through my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun, I'll tell you what I know.
What kind of person you are… exactly how many people you've killed."
"Ah-----"
For a moment, I feel dizzy.
Even though I said I was ready, hearing the word 'killed' so clearly, my chest hurts.

entries.japanese:
「……いいぜ。
教えてくれ、先輩」
「いえ、ここではだめです。
今夜、わたしは学校にいます。
……その先のことは、遠野くんが決めてください」
　……それは、最後の決定権を俺に委ねるという事か。
　夜の学校に俺が行けばそれでおしまい。
　けど俺が行かなければ、このままいつもの先輩と後輩っていう関係に戻れるっていう、最後の選択―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right… tell me, Ciel.”
“No, not here. I will be at the school tonight. What happens after that is for you to decide.”
She is leaving the final decision to me.
If I go to the school that night, everything will end.
If I do not, we can return to what we have always been—an older and a younger schoolmate, one last choice―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Good.
Tell me, Senpai."
"No, not here.
I'll be at the school tonight.
After that, you decide, Tohno-kun."
…… So that means she's leaving the final decision to me.
If I go to school tonight, that's the end.
But if I don't, we can go back to the way we've always been; a final choice---

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　はっきりと行くと言えず、口を閉ざす。
「……それでは、夜の学校で待っています。
　ただ、一つだけ約束してください。
この事は妹さんには内緒にする、と」
「え……秋葉に、ですか？」
　いや、こっちだって秋葉を巻き込むつもりはないから言われるまでもない。
　ない、けど。
　どうして先輩は、真剣な顔でそんな事を言ってくるんだろう。
　それこそ、先輩にとっての敵は俺なんかじゃなく、秋葉だとでも言うように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……………”
Unable to promise that I will go, I close my mouth.
“Then, I shall wait for you at the school tonight.
But promise me one thing. You will keep this from your sister.”
“From Akiha…?”
I have no intention of involving her, so the warning should be unnecessary.
It should be.
Yet why does Ciel say it with such gravity?
It is almost as though Akiha, not I, is her enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I can't say I'll definitely be there, so I say nothing.
"Well then, I'll be waiting at school tonight.
But, promise me one thing.
That you will keep this a secret from your younger sister."
"Eh?
From Akiha?"
Of course, I wouldn't get Akiha involved in any of this, so there's no need to say that.
There isn't, but…
Why is Senpai asking so seriously?
As if saying Akiha was the enemy, not me.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩。
秋葉は、関係ないだろ」
「――遠野くん。
彼女には、気をつけてください」
　ひどく恐い声でそんな警告を残して、先輩は俺の前から立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel… Akiha has nothing to do with this.”
“――Tohno. Be careful of her.”
Leaving that warning in a voice cold enough to frighten me, Ciel walks away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, Akiha has nothing to do with this."
"--Tohno-kun.
Please be careful around her."
Leaving a warning in a frightening voice, Senpai disappears.

entries.japanese:
―――授業が終わって、教室から人気が失せていく。
　……今夜、学校でシエル先輩と会うにしても会わないにしても、一度屋敷には戻らないとまずいだろう。
　結局、朝の先輩との会話で判った事なんて、あの夢が現実のものだったという事だけだ。
　問題は何一つとして解決していないし、俺が殺人鬼なのかさえ、分からない。
「――――――はあ」
　深くため息をついて、教室を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Classes end, and the classroom slowly empties.
Whether I meet Ciel here tonight or not, I should probably return to the estate first.
In the end, the only thing our conversation this morning established was that those dreams truly happened.
Not one problem is solved, and I still do not even know whether I am a murderer.
“――――――Haaah.”
With a long sigh, I leave the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The lesson finishes, and the students disperse.
…… Even if I'm going to meet Ciel-senpai at school tonight, I should return to the mansion first.
In the end, the conversation only told me the dreams were real.
Nothing is resolved, and I still don't know whether I am the killer or not.
------*sigh*
After sighing heavily, I leave the classroom.

entries.japanese:
屋敷の門の前には翡翠の姿があった。
「あれ、翡翠。
なにしてるんだ、こんなところで」
「はい、志貴さまのお帰りをお待ちしておりました」
「え……それは嬉しいけど、どうして？
　もう出迎えはできないって言ってたじゃないか」
「それは秋葉さまと志貴さまがご一緒の時のお話です。
……その、姉さんからの提案で、お二人がご一緒の時は見送りも出迎えも控えましょう、と」
「―――――――」
　そっか、たしかに秋葉と二人でいる時、翡翠に出迎えられたりするのは気まずいかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui is waiting outside the estate gates.
“Hisui? What are you doing out here?”
“I was waiting to welcome you home, Master Shiki.”
“That’s nice of you, but why? I thought you said you couldn’t come out to meet me anymore.”
“That only applies when Master Shiki and Miss Akiha return together. My sister suggested that we refrain from seeing you off or welcoming you home whenever the two of you are together.”
“―――――――”
I see; having Hisui greet us when Akiha and I are alone together might indeed feel awkward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui is at the mansion gate.
"Huh?
What are you doing out here, Hisui?"
"I am waiting to welcome you home, Shiki-sama."
"Eh?
Well, I'm glad, but, why?
You said you wouldn't be able to meet me here anymore."
"That was because you and Akiha-sama were together.
…… Nee-san… she suggested we should refrain from send-offs and greetings when you were together."
"-------"
I see.
Certainly, if I were with Akiha, it would be awkward to be met by Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さんもヘンなところで気を回すんだな。
　ま、俺としては翡翠に出迎えてもらえるのならそっちのほうが嬉しいんだけど。
　ともかくただいま。
わざわざありがとう、翡翠」
「はい。
お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをしてくる翡翠。
　……冷静に考えてみると、屋敷の前でメイドさんにおじぎをされるというのは、ものすごく時代錯誤なことなのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku worries about the strangest things.
Personally, I’d much rather have you here to welcome me.
Anyway, I’m home. Thanks for coming all this way, Hisui.”
“Yes. Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bowed deeply.
Thinking about it calmly, being met outside the gates by a bowing maid was staggeringly anachronistic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Another of Kohaku-san's strange ideas.
Well, I'm always glad to be met by you, Hisui.
Anyways, I'm home.
Thanks for coming out."
"Yes.
Welcome home, Shiki-sama."
Hisui bows.
…… Thinking about it calmly, a maid bowing in front of a mansion is a terribly anachronistic image.

entries.japanese:
「あ。
そういえば秋葉のヤツはもういいのか？」
「はい、お昼には体調も戻られたようです。
なんでしたら秋葉さまのお部屋に行かれてはいかがですか？」
「そうだな、一度ぐらいは―――」
―――彼女には、気をつけてください。
「――――いや、やっぱりよそう。
ちょっと、今はうまく会えない」
　……秋葉をどうこう思っているんじゃない。
　ただ、シエル先輩があんな事をいうから、今は秋葉と会いづらいだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, right. Is Akiha feeling better now?”
“Yes, she appeared to have recovered by noon. Perhaps you would like to visit Miss Akiha in her room?”
“Maybe I should, at least once―――”
―――Be careful of her.
“――――No. Better not; I do not think I can face her properly just now.”
It is not that I suspect Akiha of anything.
Ciel’s warning has simply made it hard to be around her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, by the way, is that Akiha doing any better?"
"Yes, it seems her condition improved by lunchtime.
Perhaps you should stop by her room?"
"Maybe, at least once---"
---Please be careful around her.
"----No, I shouldn't.
I… can't see her right now."
…… It's not that I'm not thinking about her.
But, because of what Ciel-senpai said, it's hard to see her right now.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お部屋に戻られないのですか？」
「あ、そうだった。
それじゃ中に入ろうか」
　胸中の不安を悟られないように明るく振る舞って、屋敷の門をくぐり抜けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you not going inside?”
“Oh, right. Come on, then.”
I put on a cheerful face so she will not notice the unease inside me, and pass through the gates.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
Are you not returning to your room?"
"Ah, you're right.
Well then, shall we go in?"
Acting cheerful to hide my uneasiness, I pass through the mansion gates.

entries.japanese:
……夜になった。
　秋葉とは夕食の時に少し話をしただけで、すぐ自分の部屋に戻ってきた。
　秋葉の様子は今までとそう変わったふうじゃなく、やっぱり先輩の警告は見当違いのものだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Night falls.
I speak to Akiha only briefly over dinner, then return to my room.
She seems no different from before, so Ciel’s warning must have been misguided after all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It's night.
I talked only a little to Akiha at supper, then came straight back to my room.
She seemed no different than usual, so I'm sure Senpai's warning was wrong.

entries.japanese:
「……行くとしたらそろそろか」
　夜の学校で話をする、と先輩は言った。
　行けば、俺と先輩の今までの関係はそれでおしまいになる。
　けど行かなければ、明日からはまた以前と同じ関係のままでやっていける。
　その選択権を、先輩は俺に預けたんだ。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“If I am going, it is about time.”
Ciel said we would talk at the school tonight.
If I go, the relationship we had will end there.
If I do not, tomorrow we can go back to being what we were before.
Ciel left that choice in my hands.
I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… If I'm going to go, I should leave pretty soon."
Senpai said we'll talk at the school tonight.
If I go, she won't be my Senpai any longer.
But if I don't go, everything will go back the way it was.
Senpai left me with that choice.
I'll---

entries.japanese:
「――これ以上、曖昧なままにしてはおけない」
　あの夢が本当に現実なのか。
　自分は人の血を吸う殺人鬼になってしまったのか。
　……それらの問題は、もう曖昧のまま済ませられるものじゃない。
「一応、念のために持っていくか」
　弓塚との一件以来、机にしまっていたナイフをポケットにいれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――I cannot leave this unresolved any longer.”
Were those dreams truly real?
Had I become a murderer who drank human blood?
Those questions can no longer remain unresolved.
“I’d better take it, just in case.”
I slip into my pocket the knife that has lain in my desk since the incident with Yumizuka.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I can't let it remain unanswered."
If that dream is real.
Am I really a bloodsucking, killer?
…… I can't let those questions remain unanswered.
"I should take it, just in case."
The knife has been in my desk ever since what happened with Satsuki; I slip it into my pocket.

entries.japanese:
翡翠や琥珀さんに見付からないように、そっとロビーまで下りてきた。
　あとは音をたてないように玄関を開けるだけなのだが―――
　俺が玄関を開けるより先に、ぎい、と音をたてて玄関の扉が開いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The street ahead is still busy.
All that remains is to open the door and step outside―――
Before I can touch it, the front door creaks open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go down to the lobby quietly, so that Hisui and Kohaku-san won't notice.
I just need to open the door without making a sound---
but before I can open it, it opens with a creak.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　どうしたんです、そんなトコで固まってしまって」
「あ―――秋葉、おまえ」
　なんでそこに、と指さす。
「少し庭を散歩していただけですけど、兄さんこそどうしたんですか。
まるで今から出かけるような格好じゃないですか」
「……ああ、学校に忘れ物をしたんでとりに行くところだよ」
　……秋葉には嘘はつきたくない。
　だから最低限の事実だけを口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, what is wrong? Why are you frozen there?”
“Ah―――Akiha, you”
I point at her, asking why she is there.
“I was only taking a walk in the garden. What about you, Brother; you look as though you are about to go out.”
“I left something at school and was just going to retrieve it.”
I do not want to lie to Akiha.
So I say only the bare minimum of the truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
What is it?
Why are you standing here, frozen?"
"A---Akiha, you…"
Why are you here, I ask wordlessly.
"I was just taking a walk in the garden.
What about you, Nii-san?
You look like you're going to go out right now."
"…… Yeah.
I left something at school, so I was going back for it."
…… I don't want to lie to Akiha.
So, I say as little as possible.

entries.japanese:
「ふぅーん、忘れ物ですか」
　じーっ、と俺の目を見つめる秋葉。
「まあ、いいですけど。
まだ八時前ですし、九時には戻ってこれるわよね、兄さん」
「……そうだな。
一時間もあれば戻ってくる」
「わかりました。
玄関の鍵は開けておきますから、どうぞ気をつけて行ってきてください」
　秋葉は居間のほうに歩いていった。
　……おかしいな。
ちょっと前までだったらもっと疑われたんだけど、今の秋葉は俺のことを全面的に信頼しているみたいだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm, something you forgot.”
Akiha stares directly into my eyes.
“Very well. It is not eight yet, so you can be back by nine, can you not, Brother?”
“Yes. An hour should be enough.”
“All right. I will leave the front door unlocked, so please be careful.”
Akiha walks toward the sitting room.
Strange. Not long ago she would have been far more suspicious, but now Akiha seems to trust me completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm, you forgot something?"
Akiha narrows her eyes at me.
"Well, alright, it's still eight.
Make sure you are back by nine, Nii-san."
"Right.
I'll be back in an hour."
"Understood.
I shall leave the door unlocked; please take care."
Akiha walks to the sitting room.
…… It's strange.
Before, I would have been doubted more, but Akiha seems to trust me completely.

entries.japanese:
……その、やっぱり昨日の中庭での出来事の影響だろうか。
　秋葉が俺の事を信頼してくれるように、俺も秋葉に信頼されていると思うと、すごく嬉しい。
―――彼女には気をつけてください。
「―――――っ」
　先輩の言葉が、呪いのように思い出される。
「……とにかく学校に行って、早く戻ってこよう」
　それも先輩に会えばはっきりする筈だ。
　よし、と覚悟をきめて玄関の扉に手をかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps this too is because of what happened in the courtyard yesterday.
It makes me deeply happy to think that Akiha trusts me, just as I trust her.
―――Be careful of her.
“―――――!”
Ciel’s words return like a curse.
“I will go to the school and come straight back.” Once I see her, the warning should make sense too.
Steeling myself, I reach for the front door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Is it because of what happened in the garden last night?
Being trusted by Akiha, feeling that she trusts me, makes me very happy.
---Please be careful around her.
"-----Uh."
Senpai's words return like a curse.
"…… Anyway.
I'll go to school, and come straight back." And I'll meet with Senpai.
Alright.
I grasp the door handle.

entries.japanese:
――――校舎は静まりかえっている。
　うちの学校の下校時刻は六時半で、夜の見まわりをするような教師も用務員もいない。
　この時間、校舎は完全に無人の領域になっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――The school building is utterly silent.
Students must leave by six-thirty, and neither teachers nor custodians patrol at night.
At this hour, the school is completely deserted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The school is wrapped in silence.

Our school closes at half past six, and no teachers or janitors patrol at night.
At this time, the buildings are completely empty.

entries.japanese:
……あたりは、本当に静かだ。
　物音一つしなくて、自分の心臓の鼓動が、このあたりで唯一の音だった。
「……先輩、校舎の中かな……」
　そういえば学校で待つって言われたけど、どこで待っているかは聞いていなかった。
　……いや、先輩が意図的に口にしなかったというのが正しいだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is truly silent.
Not a sound anywhere; my heartbeat is the only noise left in the world.
“Is Ciel inside?”
She said she would wait at the school, but never told me where.
No, more likely she deliberately withheld that part.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… All around, it's quiet.
The only sound is the beating of my own heart.
"…… Is Senpai inside, I wonder…?"
Although she said she would wait at school, she never said where.
…… No, Senpai probably deliberately didn't tell me.

entries.japanese:
「……しょうがないな。
てきとうな窓の鍵を切って中に入るか」
　メガネを外す。
「……く」
　軽い頭痛をともなって、視界に『線』が浮かび上がる。
　物の壊れやすい『線』。
　そこを通すだけでモノを切断してしまうもの。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Nothing else for it. I will cut a window latch and climb inside.”
I take off my glasses.
“Ngh…”
A mild headache comes as lines rise across my vision.
The fragile lines in all things.
Tracing one is enough to sever whatever bears it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, can't be helped.
I'll cut the lock of a window and go in."
I remove my glasses.
"…… Kuh."
Along with a light headache, the "lines" appear before me.
The "lines" along which things easily break.
Things which can be cut just by passing through them.

entries.japanese:
「……弓塚の時は、ただ必死だったけど……」
　こうして冷静になってメガネを外すと、自分の眼の異常さを再認識してしまう。
「……さて、線が鍵にある窓は、と……」
　何でも切断できるといっても、切ることができるのは『線』が視えているところだけだ。
　壁や窓そのものを切ってしまうと明日になって大事になる。
切るものは最小限にとどめておかないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“With Yumizuka, I was too desperate to think.”
Now that I can take off my glasses calmly, I am reminded just how abnormal my eyes are.
“Now, which window has a line through its latch?”
I may be able to sever anything, but only where I can see a line.
If I cut the wall or the window itself, there will be an uproar tomorrow. I have to keep the damage to an absolute minimum.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… With Yumizuka, it was just desperation…"
Removing my glasses calmly like this, I really feel how strange my eyes are.
"…… Now, where's a window with a line in the lock…"
Although anything can be cut, they can only be cut where the "lines" appear.
If I cut the wall or the window itself, it'll draw attention tomorrow.
The cut has to be as small as possible.

entries.japanese:
「おっ、ちょうどあった。
これで……よし、と」
　スッ、とバターを切るような滑らかさで鍵を断って、廊下の窓を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, I found one. This should do.”
The blade slips through the latch as smoothly as butter, and I open the corridor window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, perfect.
Here goes…"
With a click, I cut the lock smoothly, and open the corridor window.

entries.japanese:
―――――どくん。
　窓から廊下に入ったとたん、胸が苦しくなった。
「う………………」
　なんだろう。
　ひどく。
――――どくん。
　ひどく、不吉な、空気がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――thump.
The instant I climb through the window, my chest constricts.
“Ugh…”
What is this?
Terrible.
――――Thump.
A terrible, ominous air hangs here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Thump.
My chest aches as soon as I climb in the window.
"Uh…"
What is it?
It's horribly…
----Thump.
There's a horribly sinister atmosphere.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩……どこにいるんだ、ろう」
　呟く事さえ、難しい。
　どくん、という心音。
　一際大きく、まるで血液を逆流させているような激しさで太鼓を打つ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, where are you?”
Even whispering is difficult.
My heart thumps.
It pounds harder than ever, as though forcing my blood to flow backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai… where are… you?"
It's hard even to murmur.
My heart beats.
A resounding pumping, like a drum driving my blood backwards.

entries.japanese:
「あ………れ？」
　見れば自分の指先が震えている。
　喉元には吐き気。
　メガネを外しているからとはいえ、頭痛は秒刻みで強さを増していっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
My fingertips are trembling.
Nausea rises in my throat.
Even with my glasses off, the headache grows stronger by the second.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh…?"
It looks like my fingertips are trembling.
I feel sick.
Without my glasses, my headache is getting worse by the second.

entries.japanese:
「なんだ……なにか、おかしい」
　わからない。
　ただ校舎の中の空気は、外の空気とは違いすぎる。
　しいて言うのなら、活気がない。
　外の生々しい現実感に比べて、廊下の中の空気は悲しいほど衰弱してしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Something is wrong.”
I do not understand.
The air inside the school is completely different from the air outside.
If I had to put it into words, it has no vitality.
Compared with the vivid reality outside, the air in the corridor feels pitifully drained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is this… it's… strange…"
I don't understand.
The atmosphere inside the building is so different from outside.
If I have to put it into words, it's without life.
Compared to the fresh air outside, the air in the corridor is so weak that it feels sad.

entries.japanese:
「………けど、知ってる………」
　こんな厭な空気、初めて吸うのに、知っている。
　だって見てた。
　毎夜、夢の中で。
　俺が人を殺して血を吸う時の空気は、いつも―――こんな、死臭で満ちていたから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I know this.”
This clinging, ominous air is familiar.
Because I saw it.
Every night in my dreams.
Whenever I killed someone and drank their blood, the air was always―――thick with this same stench of death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I know…"
Though I'm breathing this air for the first time, I know it.
Because I've always watched it.
Every night, in my dream.
When I kill people and drink their blood, the atmosphere is always… full of this smell of decay.

entries.japanese:
「え――――？」
　音。
背後で、何かが倒れる音がした。
「先輩……？」
　振りかえる。
　そこに、　　　　いたのは。
　見覚えのない男性だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What――――?”
A noise. Something falls behind me.
“Ciel?”
I turn.
There.
A man I have never seen before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh----?"
A sound.
From behind me, the sound of something falling.
"Senpai…?"
I turn.
There,	           there is…
A strange man.

entries.japanese:
「うっ………！」
　吐きそうになって、口元を手で押さえた。
　男性……見覚えのない男の体中に、『線』が走っている。
　まるで体中の血管が浮かび上がっているような奇怪さ。
「―――――ギ」
　男はゆっくりと、それこそスローモーションのように、こっちへと歩いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ugh…!”
I clamp a hand over my mouth to keep from vomiting.
The stranger’s entire body is overrun with lines.
They rise grotesquely, like every blood vessel beneath his skin.
“―――――Ghh.”
Slowly, with the unreal drag of slow motion, he starts toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh…!"
I clasp my hand over my mouth, about to vomit.
The man… the "lines" run within his body.
They run through his whole body like blood vessels.
"-----Gih."
The man walks toward me, as if in slow motion.

entries.japanese:
「あの――――もしもし？」
　意を決して話しかけた。
　……たしかに奇怪だけど、それは俺の眼のほうが奇怪なんだ。
　あんな、体中に『線』をもった人間は初めて見たけど、ともかく線さえなければまともな人間なんだから。
「―――ギ―――ギギ」
　男は何か言っている。
　けど、それは声にも音にもなっていなくて、よく聞き取れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um――――hello?”
I force myself to speak.
He looks bizarre, but only because my eyes are bizarre.
I have never seen a human body covered in so many lines, yet without them he would look like any ordinary man.
“―――Ghh―――ghgh.”
The man is saying something.
But it is neither voice nor sound, and I cannot make it out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh----hello…?"
I make up my mind and talk to him.
…… It's strange, but my eyes are stranger.
It's the first time I've seen "lines" all over a person's body like this, but take them away and you'll have a normal human.
"---Gih---gigih…"
The man is saying something.
But his voice is not even a noise, I can't hear.

entries.japanese:
男は歩み寄ってくる。
―――ぞくりと、する。
　どうしてか、この人が一歩近づくたびに寒気が走る。
　これは―――
「ギ――――」
　男が、もう目の前にいる。
「ちょっ、ちょっと待って、あなた一体だ――」
　誰ですか、なんていう暇はなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The man keeps coming.
―――A chill crawls through me.
For some reason, every step he takes sends another shiver down my spine.
This is―――
“Ghh――――”
The man is already right in front of me.
“W-wait, just who are you――”
There is no time to finish asking his name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The man approaches.
Why is it?
Whenever the man steps closer, a shudder runs through me.
It's---
"Gih----"
The man is right in front of me.
"W… wait, who…"
…… are you?
I don't even have time to finish.

entries.japanese:
「あっ――――！」
　だん、という衝撃。
　男は近寄ってくるやいなや、片手でなぎ払うように俺の体を弾き飛ばした。
「あ――――ぐ」
　背中。
弾き飛ばされて、背中を壁に打ちつけた。
　あんまりに突然の事と、激しい痛みで目がクラクラする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――!”
A heavy impact.
The instant he comes close, the man sweeps me aside with one hand and sends me flying.
“Ah――――gh.”
My back. It slams into the wall.
The attack is so sudden, the pain so violent, that the corridor spins.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----!"
There is a crash.
As he approaches, the man throws me aside with a single hand.
"Ugh---"
My back.
Thrown aside, my back smashes against the wall.
It's so sudden, the pain makes my eyes dizzy.

entries.japanese:
「痛っ……なにするんですか、いきなり……！」
　立ちあがって男を睨む。
「――――――」
　声が、止まった。
　アレ。
アレは、なんだ。
　今目の前にいるのは、なんだ。
　さっきまでの男か。
これが生きている人間か。
　いや、肝心なのはそんな瑣末な事じゃなくて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow, what was that for, out of nowhere?!”
I struggle upright and glare at him.
“――――――”
My voice dies.
That. What is that?
What is standing before me now?
Is it the same man as before? Is this a living human being?
None of that is the real issue―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ow… what are you doing, all of a sudden…!"
I stand and glare at the man.
"------"
My voice dies.
He's… what is he?
What is this thing before me?
Was this a man?
Is this a living human being?
No, that's not important right now.

entries.japanese:
視力が回復して、男の姿がもとに戻る。
　……そう、元に戻った。
　俺の目はモノの『死』を見るのだと、先生は言った。
　ああ、まったくその通りだ。
　だって、なぜなら―――
entries.maoEnglish:
My vision clears, and the man returns to normal.
Yes, back to normal.
My teacher told me that my eyes see the ‘death’ of things.
She was absolutely right.
Because―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I recover my sight, and look again at the man.
…… Yes, it's back.
Sensei said that my eyes see the "death" within things.
That's exactly right.
Because---

entries.japanese:
「おまえ、は―――」
「ギ―――ギギ、ギギギ」
　男が何かを口にする。
　言葉にならないのは当たり前だ。
だって喉が半分以上なかった。
鋭い牙で食いちぎられていた。
だから、まともに喋れるはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are―――”
“Ghh―――ghgh, ghghgh.”
The man tries to speak.
Of course it cannot form words. More than half its throat is gone. Sharp fangs tore it away. There is no way it can speak properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're---"
"Gi---gigi, gigigih."
The man is saying something.
Of course it doesn't speak words.
Because half of his throat is missing.
It was bitten away by something.
So there's no way for him to speak.

entries.japanese:
「どうして―――昨日、殺したはず、なのに」
「ギ―――ギギギギギ」
　肩をふるわせて、男は笑っているふうに見えた。
　けど、間違いはない。
　いま目の前にいる死体は、昨日、夢の中で、俺が殺した男だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How can you be―――when I killed you yesterday?”
“Ghh―――ghghghghgh.”
His shoulders shake as though he is laughing.
There can be no mistake.
The corpse before me is the man I killed in yesterday’s dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why---you were killed, yesterday…"
"Gi---gigigigigih…"
His shoulders are shaking; he seems to be laughing.
But there's no mistake.
The corpse before me is definitely the man I killed in the dream yesterday.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　男がゆっくりと近寄ってくる。
「あ――――」
　何も考えられない。
ただ、死の塊が近寄ってくる。
「あ――――あ」
　ずきり、という痛み。
　それで気がついた。
さっき男に弾かれた時、胸の側面を殴られたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
The man slowly comes closer.
“Ah――――”
I cannot think. A mass of death is approaching.
“Ah――――ah.”
Pain stabs through my side.
Then I realize it. When he knocked me aside, he struck the side of my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---"
The man approaches slowly.
"Ah----"
There's no thought.
The lump of death approaches.
"Ah----ah."
A shudder of pain.
Then, I notice.
When the man threw me before, the side of my chest was injured.

entries.japanese:
ずきり、ずきり。
　体が痛い。
筋肉が痛いとかいうレベルじゃなくて、骨そのものが軋んでいるような感じ。
　今ので、確実にあばら骨がどうかしてしまった。
「ギ―――ギギギギギギ…………！」
　男が腕を振り上げてくる。
　それで、麻痺した頭がようやく理解してくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Throb, throb.
My body hurts. Not merely my muscles; it feels as though my very bones are creaking.
That blow definitely did something to my ribs.
“Ghh―――ghghghghghgh…!”
The man raises his arm.
At last, my numb mind understands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My body hurts.
Not just on the level of muscles; my bones themselves are creaking.
Something definitely happened to my ribs.
"Gih----gigigigigigih…!"
The man flings up an arm.
At last, my numb head understands.

entries.japanese:
―――間違いない。
　コイツは、俺を殺したがっているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――There can be no mistake.
This thing means to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Without a doubt,
he intends to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「ひ―――！」
　振り下ろされてくる男の腕を避けた。
　べき、というイヤな音。
　男の腕が壁に突き刺さる。
……コンクリートの壁に、本当に突き刺さっている。
　よほど手加減というものをしなかったらしい。
　コンクリートの壁を崩す、なんていう代償に自分の骨を折ってしまっているんだから。
「あ―――ああ」
　それは、酷く滑稽で、信じがたい世界だった。
　夢なら。
夢なら、ここで覚めてほしいって思うぐらい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hh―――!”
I dodge the arm swinging down at me.
An ugly crack.
His arm buries itself in the wall. It truly is lodged in solid concrete.
Apparently, he did not hold back at all.
The price of smashing a concrete wall is breaking the bones in his own arm.
“Ah―――ah.”
It is a grotesquely absurd, unbelievable world.
If only this were a dream. If it is, I want to wake up now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hii----!"
I dodge the sweep of the man's arm.
There is an unpleasant crunching sound.
The man's arm is embedded in the wall… it's buried right into the concrete wall.
He did not hold back an inch.
Breaking a concrete wall, and in return, he's breaking his own bones.
"Ah---ahah…"
It's a funny, hard to believe world.
If it's a dream… if it's a dream, I want it to end now.

entries.japanese:
「ギ―――」
　男が俺に振り向く。
「あああ、あ―――」
　べき、という音。
　男は腕を壁に突き刺さしたまま、俺に近寄ってくる。
　腕は。
壁に突き刺さったまま、体からべき、と千切れた。
「ギ、ギギ、ギ」
　笑いながら、やってくる。
「あ―――ああああぁあ！」
　足が動く。
　もう、一秒だってこの場所にはいられなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh―――”
The man turns toward me.
“Aah, ah―――”
A crack.
Without pulling his arm from the wall, the man advances on me.
His arm stays buried in the wall. With a crack, it tears free from his body.
“Gh, ghgh, gh.”
He comes forward laughing.
“Ah―――aaaaaah!”
My legs move.
I cannot stay here another second.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gih---"
The man turns towards me.
"Aaa, ah---"
Another crunch.
The man comes toward me, his arm still in the concrete wall.
The arm.
Stuck in the wall, the arm tears away from his body.
"Gih, gigih, gih."
It's still laughing.
"Ah---aaaahhhh!"
My legs move.
I can't bear to be here any longer.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ………！」
　がくん、と膝から床に崩れ落ちる。
　男……あの死体は追ってこない。
あの速度なら、とうてい追いついてはこれない、はずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah, haaah, haaah…!”
My knees buckle and I collapse to the floor.
The man, that corpse, is not following. At that speed, it should never be able to catch me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahh, ghah, ghah…!"
I collapse to my knees with a thump.
The man… that corpse is not following.
At that speed, it can't, catch me.

entries.japanese:
「はあ、はあ、はあ………！」
　胸が痛む。
　呼吸をするたびにあばら骨が砕けそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah, haaah, haaah…!”
My chest aches.
Every breath feels ready to shatter my ribs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hagh, ghahh…!"
My chest hurts.
Whenever I breathe, my ribs feel like they're about to break.

entries.japanese:
「はあ……はあ……は……あ」
　なんとか呼吸を整える。
　なんとか。
　なんとかまともに戻ろうと、必死に気持ちを落ちつかせる。
　考えろ。
よく見て、そのあとに考えろって先生に教わったはずだ。
　だからよく考えないと。
　たとえアレが死体で。
　俺が殺してしまった相手だとしても。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah, haaah, ha, ah.”
Somehow, I force my breathing under control.
Somehow.
Desperately, I try to calm down and get a grip on myself.
Think. My teacher taught me to look carefully first and think afterward.
So I have to think.
Even if that thing is a corpse.
Even if it is someone I killed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gah… hah… ha… h."
Somehow I catch my breath.
Somehow.
I have to somehow get back to normal.
I MUST calm down.
Think.
Look, and then think.
I learned that from Sensei.
So I have to think hard.
Even if that's a dead body.
Even if it's someone I killed.

entries.japanese:
「は―――考えられるか、そんなのモノ……！」
　あばらの痛みも無視して、ただそう叫んだ。
　わからない。
　わかるはずがない。
　自分が殺した相手が、今こうして自分を殺そうとしている。
　自分が殺したはずの相手が、生き返って復讐をしにきている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hh―――how am I supposed to think about that…?!”
Ignoring the pain in my ribs, I scream.
I don’t understand.
I couldn’t possibly understand.
Someone I killed is now trying to kill me.
Someone who should be dead has returned to life for revenge.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha---I can't think about it, that's just…!"
Ignoring the pain in my ribs, I cry out.
I don't understand.
I can't understand.
The one I killed is about to kill me.
The one I have killed has returned to take his revenge.

entries.japanese:
―――そんなものは、ただの悪夢だ。
　現実ではありえない、常識から外れている悪夢。
　けど、いまさら何を。
　俺はとっくの昔に、その悪夢にどっぷりと叩きこまれているじゃないか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――That is nothing but a nightmare.
A nightmare that violates common sense and cannot exist in reality.
But what am I saying?
I was thrown headfirst into that nightmare long ago―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's just a nightmare.
It can't be real, just an insane nightmare.
But what am I saying now?
I've been in a nightmare for a long time already----

entries.japanese:
「く―――そ」
　なんとか、なんとか呼吸を整えて、逃げないと。
　この校舎から外に出て、屋敷に戻って、秋葉にただいまって言わないと―――　
「え――――？」
　背後から音がした。
「―――まさか」
　追いつかれた―――？
　いや、そんなハズはない。
あんなゆっくりしたヤツがそう簡単に追いついてくるはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn―――it.”
Somehow, somehow I have to steady my breathing and escape.
I have to get out of this school, return to the estate, and tell Akiha I am home―――
“Wh――――what?”
A noise comes from behind me.
“―――It cannot be.”
Has it caught up―――? No, impossible. Something that slow could not overtake me so easily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn it!"
I have to recover my breath and run away.
I have to leave this school, go back to the mansion, tell Akiha I'm home…
"Eh-----?"
A sound from behind me.
"---It can't be."
It caught up?
No, that's impossible.
It moved so slowly it couldn't just catch up like that.

entries.japanese:
階段を覗きこむ。
　……あがってくる人影はない。
　さっきの物音は気のせい――――
「あ―――っう――――」
　また、やられた。
　こっちが階段で振り向いた時、アレはもう二階にあがっていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
I peer down the stairs.
No figure is climbing toward me.
The sound must have been my imagination――――
“Ah―――ugh――――”
It hits me again.
Apparently, by the time I turned toward the stairwell, the thing was already on the second floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I look down the stairs.
…… There is no one coming up.
The noise was just my----
"Ahh-----!"
Again, I'm beaten.
When I turned around on the stairs, it seems it was already there.

entries.japanese:
「逃げ―――ないと」
　痛む体にムチをうって立ちあがる。
「つっ―――！？」
　がくん、とそのまま倒れこんだ。
　弾き飛ばされて足を打ってしまったらしい。
　右足にまったく力が入らない。
　立ちあがる事も、逃げることも、できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have to―――run.”
I force my battered body upright.
“Ngh―――?!”
My legs fold and I crash down again.
I must have injured my leg when I was thrown.
There is no strength at all in my right leg.
I can neither stand nor run.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Have to---get away…"
I drag my aching body up.
"Uhh---!?"
I fall again with a thump.
It seems that when he threw me this time, my leg was damaged.
There's no strength in my right leg at all.
I can't stand, and I can't escape.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　足音が近づいてくる。
―――どくん。
　かつん、かつん、という、感情のない渇いた音。
―――どくん。
　漂ってくるのは、死臭だろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
Footsteps draw closer.
―――Thump.
Clack, clack, a dry and emotionless sound.
―――Thump.
Is that the stench of death drifting toward me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Approaching footsteps.
---Thump.
Clank, clank; a dry, emotionless sound.
---Thump.
The putrid smell of a corpse hangs in the air.

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
　心臓の音が高い。
理性は、とっくにどうかしている。
―――どくん。
　近寄ってくる。
　俺を殺そうと、死体がやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
My heartbeat hammers in my ears. Reason abandoned me long ago.
―――Thump.
It comes closer.
A corpse is coming to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
My heart beats loudly.
All rational thought has long departed.
---Thump.
It approaches.

That corpse is coming to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――あ」
　ただ、恐ろしかった。
「ギ………」
　やってくる。
　穴だらけの体で、俺を殺そうとやってくる。
　あと一歩。
　それで、さっき壁を刺したように、俺の胸を貫いておしまいになる。
「あ――――は」
　その極限で、ふと、疑問に思った。
　俺は何を恐れているのか、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――ah.”
I am simply terrified.
“Ghh…”
It comes.
Its body riddled with holes, it comes to kill me.
One more step.
Then it will thrust through my chest just as it pierced the wall, and it will all be over.
“Ah――――ha.”
At that extremity, a question suddenly occurs to me.
What am I afraid of?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----ah."
I'm just afraid.
"Gih…"
It's coming.
With a body full of holes, it comes to kill me.
One more step.
Then it'll pierce my chest the way it did the wall, and that'll be the end.
"Ah----hah…"
At that moment, I wonder.
What is it that I fear?

entries.japanese:
殺した相手が生きていることが恐ろしいのか。
　いや、違う。
　ならば今から殺されようとしていることが恐ろしいのか。
　それも、違う。
　思い出されるのは、ただ一つ。
　夢の中、愉悦のみでヒトを殺す時の熱さだけ。
　……その罪が、恐ろしい。
　俺は人を殺そうとする自分自身の罪が恐い。
entries.maoEnglish:
Am I afraid because someone I killed is still moving?
No.
Am I afraid because I am about to be killed?
Not that either.
Only one thing returns to me.
The heat of killing people for pure pleasure in my dreams.
That sin terrifies me.
I fear my own sin, the will to kill another person.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Am I afraid because the one I killed has returned?
No, that's not it.
Am I afraid because I'm about to be killed?
No, not that either.
I remember only one thing.
In my dreams, how hot it is when I kill people.
…… I'm afraid of my own crime.
I'm afraid of my own crime trying to kill people.

entries.japanese:
「く――――はは、は」
　なんだ、それなら問題なんてなにもなかった。
　この相手はすでに死んでいる。
なら、恐れる事など一つもない。
　死者を死者に戻すことには何の罪悪もないハズだ。
　なら。
　もう一度殺す事に、一体なにをためらう必要があるのだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kh――――haha, ha.”
Then there was never any problem.
This man is already dead. There is nothing to fear.
Surely there can be no guilt in returning the dead to death.
Then.
Why should I hesitate to kill him again―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuh-----hah, haha…"
Well, if that's so, then there's no problem.
This one's already dead, so there's nothing to fear.
There's nothing wrong with putting the dead to rest.
So.
There's no need to hesitate about killing again, is there…?

entries.japanese:
「ギ―――！」
　死体が腕を振り上げる。
　俺はポケットからナイフを取り出す。
―――そのあとは、本当にあっけなかった。
　夢の中で何度も凶行を重ねたおかげか、それともやはりあの凶行は自分の手によるものなのか。
　俺の腕は嘘みたいに的確に動き、本物の殺人鬼のように鮮やかに死者を仕留めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh―――!”
The corpse raises its arm.
I draw the knife from my pocket.
―――What follows is almost laughably brief.
Perhaps I can do this because I committed the act so often in my dreams, or perhaps those acts truly were my own.
My arm moves with impossible precision, dispatching the dead man with the clean efficiency of a true murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gih…!"
The body flings up an arm.
I take the knife from my pocket.
---What followed was, really, quick.
Was it because I watched all those crimes in my dreams?
Or maybe because those crimes were committed by my own hands like I suspected.
My arm moved impossibly fast, and struck down the corpse like a true killer.

entries.japanese:
どさり、どさり、どさり。
　たった今八つに解体した肉片が、廊下に転がっていく。
「あ――――は」
　ぞくりと、した。
　肉を断つ感触。
命を絶つ陥落。
　返り血はない。
　ただ、ナイフに赤い血がこびりついているだけで、俺自身には何もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud, thud, thud.
The flesh I have just carved into eight pieces tumbles across the corridor.
“Ah――――ha.”
A shudder passes through me.
The sensation of parting flesh. The collapse of extinguishing a life.
No blood has splashed onto me.
Only the knife is caked in red; I myself am untouched.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The meat, divided into eight pieces, now just rolls around the corridor.
"Ah---hah."
A shudder.
The feeling of slicing meat.
The acceptance of taking a life.
There is no flowing blood.
Only my knife drips with blood; I remain spotless.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　ぞくりと、してる。
　背中を這う感覚は痛みと寒さ。
　得る物などない。
　ただ、ナイフに赤い血がこびりついているだけで、得たものなんて、何一つ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I am still shuddering.
Pain and cold crawl up my back.
I have gained nothing.
Only red blood clings to the knife; I have gained nothing at all――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Shuddering.
A feeling of pain and coldness crawls on my back.
There is nothing to earn.
Only my knife drips with blood, I haven't gained anything----

entries.japanese:
「―――――は」
　ただ、吐き気がする。
　気がふれてしまったのか。
　目の前に散らばる残骸を見て、切開してしまいそうなほど、胸がいたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Ha.”
I only feel sick.
Have I gone mad?
Looking at the remains scattered before me, my chest hurts as though it might split open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hah."
I just feel ill.
Maybe I'm going crazy.
Looking at the remains before me, my chest hurts like it was torn open.

entries.japanese:
夜の校舎。
　月明かりの下で、嗤った。
entries.maoEnglish:
The school at night.
I laugh beneath the moonlight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The school at night.
In the moonlight, it's amusing.

entries.japanese:
「……は、」
「……ははは、」
「…………あはははははははははははは！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha,”
“Hahaha,”
“Ahahahahahahahahahaha!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hah,"
"…… Hahaha…"
"…… Ahahahahahahaha!"

entries.japanese:
いつまでも笑い続ける。
　おかしいんじゃない。
　こみ上げてくるものは後悔しかない。
　殺した。
どんなに理由があうと、俺は、また殺して、しまった。
――――彼に罪があったわけではないのに。
　この人にも、自分の人生というものがあったハズなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
I laugh and laugh.
Nothing is funny.
The only thing rising within me is regret.
I killed him. Whatever reason I had, I killed someone again.
――――He had committed no crime.
He, too, must once have had a life of his own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I laugh without stopping.
It's not funny.
Only regret is felt.
I killed.
Whatever the reason, I killed someone again.
----Even though he was blameless.
This person also had a life to protect.

entries.japanese:
「はは、ははは、はははははははは…………！」
　耳障りな笑い声。
　聞き届ける自分の耳か、笑い続ける自分の喉を殺したかった。
　けど笑い続けるしかない。
　せめて、笑わないと。
　何か一つでも人間らしいコトをしていないと、壊れてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahaha…!”
The sound grates against my ears.
I want to kill the ears forced to hear it, or the throat that keeps producing it.
But I can only laugh.
I have to laugh.
If I do not perform at least one human act, I will break.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahaha…!"
A jarring, laughing voice.
I want to kill my ears for listening, and my throat for laughing.
But I can only laugh.
At least, I have to laugh.
Unless I do a single act resembling human actions, I will break.

entries.japanese:
「はは、は、はは、は――――」
　おかしくて笑っているんじゃない。
　かろうじて正気を保つため、笑っていた。
　そうでもして自分を卑下しなければならないほど、自分の理性が保てなかった。
「は―――ははは、は…………は」
　……いっそ、泣いてしまえばよかった。
　だがそんな偽善は許されまい。
　なにが―――死者を殺す事は罪じゃない、だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haha, ha, haha, ha――――”
I am not laughing because anything is funny.
I laugh to preserve the barest scrap of sanity.
My reason is so fragile that I have to debase myself like this just to hold it together.
“Ha―――hahaha, ha, ha.”
I should have cried instead.
But I have no right to such hypocrisy.
What was that―――about there being no sin in killing the dead?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha, ha, haha, ha-----"
I'm not laughing because something is funny.
I laugh to keep my sanity.
If I can't even ridicule myself, I can't keep my sanity.
"Hah----hahaha, ha… hah."
…… Perhaps I should have cried.
But I won't allow myself such hypocrisy.
What do I mean by… killing the dead… isn't a crime.

entries.japanese:
「は―――は――――あ」
　……変わらない。
　生きていようが死んでいようが、その人を殺そうとする意思にかわりはない。
　死者であるからって、その活動している命を絶つ感触が鈍くなるなんて事さえない。
「――――は」
　自分の浅はかさに怒りすら湧いてこない。
　たとえ死人であろうと、人を殺す、という事はそれだけで罪なんだ。
　俺が、遠野志貴がまっとうな人間であろうとすればするほど、その罪が背負いきれなくなるほどに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha―――ha――――ah.”
It makes no difference.
Living or dead, the will to kill another person remains the same.
Calling someone dead does not even dull the sensation of extinguishing the life still moving within them.
“――――Ha.”
I cannot even summon anger at my own stupidity.
Dead or not, killing a person is a sin in itself.
The harder I, Shiki Tohno, try to be a decent human being, the more impossible that sin becomes to bear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hah---hah-----ahh."
…… it doesn't change.
Whether he was living or dead, it doesn't change the fact that I made the decision to kill him.
Even if he was already a corpse, the feeling of stopping his activity does not dull.
"----Hah."
I can't get mad at myself for my stupidity.
Even if they're dead, killing someone is still a sin.
As long as I, Tohno Shiki, remain a proper human, the burden of this sin will never leave me.

entries.japanese:
……弓塚との事を思い出す。
　彼女はあれが一番正しいといったけど、それでもやっぱり、彼女は生きていたかったはずだ。
　死が救いになるなんて事、生きている側の勝手な願いだ。
　死は。
　ただそれだけで、こんなにも、痛い。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember Yumizuka.
She said that ending was the best one, but she must still have wanted to live.
The belief that death can be salvation is only a selfish wish made by the living.
Death.
That alone hurts this much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I remember Yumizuka.
Even if it was the right thing to do, in the end, I know she wanted to live.
Saying death is salvation is only the selfish wish of those still living.
Death…
Is just that, and is so painful.

entries.japanese:
――――誰かがやってくる。
　今度こそ先輩だろう。
「―――――く」
　壁によりかかりながら、なんとか立ちあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Someone is coming.
This time it must be Ciel.
“―――――Ngh.”
Leaning against the wall, I somehow force myself upright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Someone is coming.
This time, it has to be Senpai.
"-----Kuh."
Somehow, I stand, holding onto the wall.

entries.japanese:
どくん、どくん。
　心臓はまだ激しく活動している。
　俺の心は半ば死んでいるっていうのに、体はその限界まで生きようと活動する。
　……なんて、生き汚さだろう。
　こんなに死は辛いものだって、八年前も、弓塚の時も、この瞬間も思い知らされたっていうのに。
　遠野志貴の体は、それでも生きようと努力している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump, thump.
My heart still labors violently.
Though my mind is half dead, my body fights at the very edge of its strength to remain alive.
What a wretched attachment to life.
Eight years ago, with Yumizuka, and now in this very moment, I learned how cruel death is.
Yet Shiki Tohno’s body still struggles to survive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump, Thump.
My heart still beats violently.

Even if my heart is halfway dead, my body tries to live until the very end.
…… Such a worthless life.
Dying like this is painful… I realized that already eight years ago, during my time with Yumizuka, and even this very moment.
Yet, Tohno Shiki's body is still making a great effort to survive.

entries.japanese:
「……なんて、無様――――」
　けど、無様なのはどちらなのか。
　自分が殺人鬼と判ってしまったから死ぬべきだと思う心か。
　それとも、たとえ他者を殺してでも自分が生き延びようとする体の方か。
　……おそらくは心だろう。
　善悪はともかく、俺の心は、こんなも脆かったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How pathetic――――”
But which part of me is pathetic?
The mind that believes I deserve to die now that I know I am a murderer?
Or the body that insists on surviving even if it must kill someone else?
Probably the mind.
Right or wrong aside, my heart has proved this fragile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… How… ugly---"
But, which is ugly?
The heart that thinks I should die, because I'm a killer?
Or the body, trying to live by killing others?
…… I think it's the heart.
Good or evil, my heart is really fragile after all.

entries.japanese:
「――――来た」
　呼吸を整えて、ナイフをしっかりと握る。
　打ちつけた右足がかすかに痛む。
　痛覚が回復したっていう事は動くっていう事だ。
　これで戦うコトぐらいは出来る。
　そうして、シエル先輩が月明かりの下に現れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――She is here.”
I steady my breathing and grip the knife.
A faint ache has returned to my injured right leg.
If I can feel pain, it can move.
At least I can fight.
Then Ciel steps into the moonlight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----You're here."
Breathing heavily, I grasp the knife.
My injured right leg hurts faintly.
If I can feel pain, I can still move.
Meaning I can still fight.
And Ciel-senpai appears in the moonlight.

entries.japanese:
「……驚いたな。
夢の中でも、そんな物騒な格好はしてなかったのに」
「はい。
これは、吸血鬼を殺す時の武装ですから」
――――ぞくりとする。
　先輩の目と、その声を聞いただけで理解できた。
　この人は、一切の迷いもなく俺を殺すつもりなんだって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a surprise. Even in my dreams, you never wore anything so dangerous.”
“Yes. This is what I wear when I kill vampires.”
――――A chill passes through me.
One look at her eyes, one sound of her voice, is enough.
She intends to kill me without the slightest hesitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm surprised.
In all the dreams you never were dressed like that."
"Yes.
Because these are the armaments to kill a vampire."
----A jolt.
I understand the instant I see her eyes and hear her voice.
This person plans to kill me without the slightest hesitation.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
俺を殺すつもりでこの場所に呼んだんだ、先輩は」
「―――――――――」
　先輩は答えない。
　……きっと、答えるまでもない事だからだろう。
「ひどいな。
俺は殺人鬼じゃないって言ってくれたのに、心の中では俺がそうだって判ってたんだ」
「―――はい。
この街に巣くっている吸血鬼は遠野志貴だという事は、初めから解っていましたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that is why you called me here. You meant to kill me.”
“―――――――――”
Ciel does not answer.
Perhaps the answer is too obvious to require words.
“That is cruel. You told me I was not a murderer, but all along you knew I was.”
“―――Yes. I knew from the beginning that the vampire nesting in this city was Shiki Tohno.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
You called me here to kill me, Senpai."
"---------"
Senpai doesn't answer.
…… Clearly, because there's nothing to say.
"That's mean.
You said I'm not the killer, but you knew in your heart that I was."
"---Yes.
I knew from the beginning that the vampire haunting this town was Tohno Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「初めから、わかってた……？」
「ええ。
だからわたしはこの学校にやってきました。
初めから、貴方を監視するために」
　言って、彼女は短刀を抜いた。
　俺のナイフの二倍近い刀身と幅をした、確実に人を殺すための凶器を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You knew from the beginning?”
“Yes. That is why I came to this school. From the beginning, I came to keep watch over you.”
With that, she draws a short sword.
Its blade is nearly twice the length and breadth of my knife, a weapon made unmistakably to kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You knew… from the beginning…?"
"Yes.
So, I came to this school.
In order to watch you."
So saying, she draws a dagger.
Twice the length and width of my knife, it is a weapon intended to kill.

entries.japanese:
「―――先輩、あなたがなんなのか俺には解らない。
知っても、俺には関わりのない事なんだろ」
「そうですね。
貴方には関わりのない出来事です、これは」
「……そう。
でもさ、悪いけど俺は殺されないぜ。
考えてみたら、俺は死にたくないから、弓塚を殺したんだ。
　なら―――もう簡単には死ねない。
あなたが俺を殺すっていうんなら、俺も―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I do not know what you are, Ciel. Even if I did, it would have nothing to do with me.”
“That is right. None of this concerns you.”
“I see. But I am sorry, I will not let you kill me. Now that I think about it, I killed Yumizuka because I did not want to die.
Then―――I cannot die so easily now. If you mean to kill me, then I will―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Senpai, I don't know what you are at all.
Even if I knew, I don't think it would concern me."
"Yes; this is a situation of no concern to you."
"…… Yeah.
But, I'm afraid I won't be killed.
Thinking about it, I killed Yumizuka because I didn't want to die.
So---I can't just die here.
If you say you're going to kill me, I'll…"

entries.japanese:
「結構です。
お互い同意の上での殺し合いでしたら、罪はありますが罰はありません。
貴方がその気になってくれていて、助かりました」
　ざ、という音。
　いつのまにか、先輩の体がすぐ間近に迫っていた。
「それでは遠野くん。
昨夜の続きを始めましょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excellent. If we kill one another by mutual agreement, there may be sin, but there can be no punishment. I’m glad you’re willing.”
A scrape.
Somehow, Ciel’s body is already almost touching mine.
“Then, Tohno. Let us continue where we left off last night.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's fine.
If we agree to kill each other, then there is crime, but no punishment.
It would be more helpful if you think of it this way."
A noise of movement.
Before I realize it, Senpai's body is right in front of me.
"Well then, Tohno-kun.
Let us continue last night's fight."

entries.japanese:
瞬間。
　飛び散る火花を思わせるスピードで、シエル先輩が突進してきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
In an instant.
Ciel charges at me with a speed that seems to scatter sparks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A moment.
Ciel-senpai moves fast enough to fling up sparks.

entries.japanese:
先輩の行動は、すごくシンプルだった。
　俺の目の前まで踏みこんできて、ただ、短刀を横一線に薙いだだけ。
「っ………！」
　とっさに防ぎに入ったナイフごと、体が弾かれる。
「っ――――！」
　よろめく体。
　後ろに倒れそうになる体を必死に堪えて、とにかく先輩の姿を――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel’s movements are brutally simple.
She steps directly into reach and sweeps the short sword sideways.
“Ngh…!”
The strike blasts through my hurried guard, knife and body together.
“Ngh――――!”
I stagger.
Fighting not to fall backward, I search desperately for Ciel――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her attack is very simple.
Leaping from right in front of me, she slashes a horizontal line with her dagger.
"……!"
I block with my own knife, and am pushed back.
"----!"
My body staggers.
I desperately stop myself from collapsing backwards, and look for…

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　瞬間、思考が凍った。
　廊下に先輩の姿はない。
　たった一瞬。
　俺のナイフと先輩の短刀がぶつかっただけなのに、先輩の姿は忽然と消えてしまっ――――
「え―――――？」
―――それは、ただの偶然だったと思う。
　何の予兆もなく、ただ真横から風を感じて、視線を動かした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――――what?”
My thoughts freeze.
The corridor is empty.
Only an instant passed.
Our blades merely met, yet Ciel vanished as though she had never been there――――
“H―――――huh?”
―――It can only have been chance.
With no warning at all, I feel a breath of wind from the side and turn my eyes toward it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha-----"
For a moment, my mind freezes.
There's no sign of her in the corridor.
In an instant,
as our weapons clashed, Senpai suddenly disappeared----
"Eh-----?"
---I think it was just by chance.
Without reason, just the feel of a breeze beside me, I shift my gaze.

entries.japanese:
窓ガラスから差し込む青い月光を明かりに。
　階段を駆け上がるように壁を駆けていた、先輩のシルエットが見えた。
「―――――上！？」
　そう知覚するのと、身を屈めるのは同時だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Blue moonlight spills through the windows.
By its glow, I see Ciel’s silhouette running up the wall as though charging up a staircase.
“―――――Above?!”
I recognize it and duck in the same instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the blue moonlight shining in through the window,
I see Senpai's silhouette running up the wall like she was going up a flight of stairs.
"-----Above!?"
Even as I notice, I lower my body.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――！」
　犬のように四つんばいになって前に逃げる。
　振りかえった先には、ちょうど天井から落下している先輩の姿が見えた。
　……俺に短刀を振るった後、そのまま壁を駆けあがって天井から俺の頭を狙ったのか。
その、ジェットコースターのループじみた無茶な運動は、惚れ惚れするぐらい美しかった。
　例えそれが、俺の後頭部を串刺しにしようとした一撃であったとしても。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
I scramble forward on all fours like a dog.
When I look back, Ciel is dropping from the ceiling.
After striking at me, she ran straight up the wall and aimed at my head from the ceiling. The impossible motion, like the loop of a roller coaster, was beautiful enough to make me stare.
Even though that blow was meant to drive a blade through the back of my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
Scrambling on all fours like a dog, I escape forward.
Glancing back, I see Senpai fall from the ceiling precisely where I was.
…… After swinging at me, she ran up the wall to try to strike my head from the ceiling?
Such an absurd, rollercoaster-like movement was charmingly beautiful.
Even though it could have skewered the back of my head.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　先ほどの閃光のような動きが嘘のように、先輩は動きを止めた。
　今の一撃を俺がかわした事が意外だったのか。
　青い眼が遠野志貴という生き物の性能を確認する。
　その、機械のように感情のない目。
　かちり、と。
　次の行動のためにゼンマイを巻くような、緊張感。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Ciel stops as completely as if her lightning speed a moment ago had been a lie.
Perhaps she is surprised that I evaded the blow.
Her blue eyes assess the capabilities of the creature called Shiki Tohno.
Those machine-like, emotionless eyes.
Click.
Tension coils like a spring being wound for its next motion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
As if her previous flash of movement never happened, Senpai stops moving.
Is she surprised I avoided that blow?
Her blue eyes confirm that Tohno Shiki is still alive.
Her eyes devoid of feeling, like a machine.
There is a tension, as I wait for her to spring into her next action.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　息をする事さえ忘れてしまう。
　あの目に睨まれていると、動くことができない。
　そんな余分な隙を見せた途端、あの短刀が俺の胸に突き刺さるだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
I forget even to breathe.
Pinned beneath that gaze, I cannot move.
The instant I offer the smallest opening, that short sword will pierce my chest――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
I forget even to breathe.
With those eyes upon me, I can't move.
In just a moment more, that dagger will be driven into my chest----

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――っ」
　どくん、どくん、という心音だけが響く。
　俺は自分から動くことができず、先輩はただ俺を凝視しているだけだ。
　……まずい。
　このままだと、いずれ緊張に耐えきれなくなって自分から何かをするハメになる。
　そんな事になれば、先輩は確実に俺を仕留めてしまう。
「――――――――」
　何もできず、ただナイフを強く握り締める。
　その時。
　機械のようだった先輩が、唐突に口を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――Ngh.”
Only my pounding heart echoes.
I cannot make the first move, and Ciel merely stares at me.
This is bad.
Eventually the tension will become unbearable, and I will be forced to act.
The moment I do, she will finish me.
“――――――――”
Unable to do anything else, I tighten my grip on the knife.
Then.
Ciel, mechanical until now, abruptly speaks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Ssst."
The only sound is my heart pounding.
I stand unable to move, and Senpai only stares at me.
…… This is bad.
At this rate, I'll break under this tension, and make a movement.
When that happens, Senpai will certainly strike me down.
"--------"
All I can do is grasp my knife tightly.
At that moment,
Senpai suddenly speaks.

entries.japanese:
「――――驚きました。
　確かに貴方は殺し合いに長けている。
相手の気配にではなく、自身の死の気配に反応するなんて突き抜けている。
　貴方本人が記憶していなくとも、貴方はそういった訓練をしていたのかもしれませんね」
　眉一つ動かさず、先輩は言葉を紡ぐ。
「殺される、という防衛本能が予知にまで達している相手には暗殺の類は通じない。
　遠野くん相手に死角からの奇襲なんて、無意味でした」
　はあ、と。
　まるで哀れむように、先輩は吐息を漏らす。
「――――――？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――I am surprised.
You truly are skilled at fighting to the death. Reacting not to your opponent’s presence but to the approach of your own death is extraordinary.
Even if you remember nothing, perhaps you once received training of that kind.”
Her face remains perfectly still as she speaks.
“Assassination is useless against someone whose instinctive fear of being killed has sharpened into precognition.
A surprise attack from your blind spot was pointless, Tohno.”
She exhales.
Ciel sighs almost with pity.
“――――――?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I'm surprised.
You're certainly an excellent killer.
You are not good at feeling the other's presence, but you are good at feeling your own death.
Even if you don't remember it, perhaps you have been trained for such things."
Senpai speaks without even moving her eyebrows.
"Against someone that has a superior self-defense mechanism close to seeing the future, assassination is useless.
Trying to attack you from a blind spot was pointless, Tohno-kun."
Seeming terribly sad, Senpai lets out a sigh.
"------?"

entries.japanese:
「可哀想に。
痛みを感じる前に意識を断つ事ができないなら、あとは力任せに殺すだけです。
　例え死を予知できたとしても、遠野くんの運動能力ならどうという事はありません」
　ぎしり。
「――――顔色が悪いですね、遠野くん」
　どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How unfortunate. If I can’t sever your consciousness before you feel pain, I’ll simply have to kill you by force.
Even if you can foresee death, your physical ability poses no real difficulty.”
Creak.
“――――You look pale, Tohno.”
Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's a pity.
If I can't kill your consciousness before you feel pain, all I can do is attack with my full strength.
Even if you can see death coming, your reflexes also make it an almost moot point."
Creak.
"----You don't look well, Tohno-kun."
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「さっきから感じているんでしょう？
　心臓を鷲掴みにされているような嘔吐感を」
　ぞくん。
「遠野くんは敏感なんですね。
つまりそれが」
　ぞくり。
「自分が殺される、という、あらゆる生物が持つ本能的な衝動です」
　言って。
　彼女は、真正面から切りかかってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ve felt it all this time, haven’t you? That nausea, as though a hand were crushing your heart.”
A convulsion.
“You are unusually sensitive. That sensation is”
A shudder.
“The instinctive impulse that every living thing feels at the prospect of being killed.”
With those words.
She attacks me head-on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You've been feeling that way for a while, haven't you?
Nausea that feels like your heart is being grabbed."
Shudder.
"You're so sensitive.
That's…"
Shudder.
"…… Because of the impulse all living things have that says 'I'm about to be killed'."
Saying that,
she strikes from right in front of me.

entries.japanese:
「くっ…………！！」
　先輩の短刀をナイフで防ぐ。
　ドン、という衝撃。
　無造作に踏みこんできた先輩の一撃は、まるで大きなハンマーを撲ちつけてきたような衝撃だった。
　ギィィィン、とナイフが悲鳴をあげる。
「っっっっ…………！」
　指先が痺れる。
　だが、そんな事を気にしている余裕なぞない。
　ダン、という足音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…!”
My knife catches her short sword.
The impact lands with a boom.
Her casual step and effortless blow strike like an enormous hammer.
My knife shrieks in protest.
“Nnnngh…!”
My fingertips go numb.
But there is no time to care about that.
A foot slams against the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuh…!!"
I block her dagger with mine.
A shock.
Senpai's simple attack feels like she used a giant hammer.
My knife screeches.
"Tttch…!"
My fingertips go numb.
But I don't have time to think about that.
Her foot audibly strikes the ground.

entries.japanese:
「は、ぐっ…………！？」
　口から酸素が漏れる。
　先輩は俺の足の隙間に踏み込んできた。
　体と体が衝突するほどの距離。
その勢いのまま、先輩は肩を俺の胸へと叩きつけた。
　よろめく体。
　ナイフを持つ力が弱まる。
　そこへ、間髪入れずに二撃目がやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hagh?!”
The breath bursts from my lungs.
Ciel steps between my feet.
She is close enough for our bodies to collide. With that momentum, she drives her shoulder into my chest.
My body reels.
My grip on the knife weakens.
Her second strike comes without the slightest pause.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha, guh………!?"
The air is knocked out of me.
Senpai has stepped into the gap between my legs.
So close that our bodies collide, and with that momentum, Senpai slams her shoulder into my chest.
I stagger.
The strength in my knife weakens.
Without a single pause, her second attack begins.

entries.japanese:
下から掬い上げるような短刀の軌跡。
　なんとかナイフで防いだものの、勢いは殺しきれなかった。
　ざく、と。
　イヤな音が、した。
entries.maoEnglish:
The short sword rises in a scooping arc.
I barely block it with the knife, but cannot kill its momentum.
A wet chop.
A sickening sound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her dagger swings upwards from below.
Somehow, I block it with my knife, but I can't kill its momentum.
Slash.
There's a horrible sound.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――――」
　熱い。
どこかを切られた。
ざっくりと落ちた肉と、血の熱さ。
　それを感じる間さえなく。
　三撃目が、入ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――――”
Heat. Something has been cut. Flesh falls away, and blood burns hot.
I have no time even to feel it.
The third strike lands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
It's hot.
Somewhere, I'm cut.
Falling meat, the heat of blood.
There's no time to feel any of that.
The third blow comes.

entries.japanese:
心臓を狙ったのか。
　咄嗟に体を捻ったおかげで、短刀はアバラの骨と、そのあたりの肉を削いだ。
「がっ、あぁあああああ………！！！！」
　悲鳴。
　殺されかけたという寒気より。
　ただ、痛みによる怖れだけが走った。
　そこへ。
　容赦のない四撃目が迫ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
She must have aimed for my heart.
I twist at the last instant, and the blade gouges across a rib and the flesh around it.
“Gah, aaaaaaaaagh!”
A scream.
The chill of nearly being killed is nothing.
Only the terror of pain races through me.
Then.
The merciless fourth blow bears down on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It was probably aimed at my heart.
Since I immediately twisted my body to avoid it, the knife rips out my rib along with the flesh around it.
"Gah, aaahhhh…!!!!"
I scream.
The coldness of death does not cause me to shudder.
But fear from the pain races through me.
There.
Follows the fourth unforgiving blow.

entries.japanese:
――――アバラをやられた。
　ナイフを持つ腕には片腕分しか力が入らない。
　それでは先輩の短刀を弾くのは不可能だ。
「くっ――――――！」
　よろめく足で、なんとか後ろに跳ぶ。
　離れる間合い。
　先輩はくるり、と背中を見せて―――
　ザン、と。
　槍のような回し蹴りを、俺の腹に叩きこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――She got my ribs.
I can put only one arm’s strength behind the knife.
That will never be enough to knock Ciel’s short sword aside.
“Ngh――――――!”
On staggering feet, I somehow leap backward.
The distance opens.
Ciel turns, presenting her back―――
A slash.
Her spinning kick strikes my stomach like a spear thrust.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----My ribs are damaged.
I can only use the power of my arm to wield my knife.
But with that, it's impossible to block Senpai's dagger.
"Kuh-----!"
Somehow, I jump back on my staggering leg.
I get enough distance.
Senpai turns, showing me her back----
Crash.
She drives a roundhouse kick like a spear into my belly.

entries.japanese:
「は――――アッ………！！！！！」
　背中から廊下に倒れる。
　痛がっている暇なんてない。
　すぐに立ちあがらないと殺される。
　だが遅い。
　体を起こした瞬間、目の前に先輩の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha――――agh!”
I crash onto my back in the corridor.
There is no time to writhe in pain.
If I do not stand immediately, she will kill me.
But I am too slow.
The instant I lift myself, Ciel is there before me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ahh…!!!!!"
I collapse backwards onto the hallway floor.
I don't have time to feel pain.
If I don't stand up immediately, I'll be killed.
But it's too late.
The moment I get up, Senpai is right in front of me.

entries.japanese:
その短刀が俺の心臓に打ち下ろされる。
「――――――！」
　ただ、夢中だった。
　夢中で、その一撃に対抗するように、ナイフを先輩の首元に構える。
―――とたん。
　ぴたりと、先輩の短刀は停止した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her short sword plunges toward my heart.
“――――――!”
I act without thought.
Frantically, I raise my knife to Ciel’s throat in answer.
―――At that instant.
Ciel’s blade stops dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The dagger strikes down at my heart.
"------!"
I was just, desperate.
In desperation, I try to match her blow by placing my knife next to Senpai's neck.
---Then.
Senpai's dagger stops short.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――」
　呼吸。
呼吸が、荒い。
「はっ、はっ、はっ、は――――」
　自分の喉元に短刀をつきつけられている。
　先輩が少し腕に力をこめれば、間違いなく即死するこの距離。
「は―――あ」
　その事実。
　それだけで、気がふれそうに、なる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――”
Breath. My breathing is ragged.
“Hah, hah, hah, ha――――”
A short sword is pressed to my throat.
At this distance, the slightest pressure from Ciel’s arm will kill me instantly.
“Ha―――ah.”
That fact.
That alone is enough to drive me mad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haghh---"
Breathing.
My breathing is, hard.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*…
Her dagger is aimed at my throat.
If Senpai moves her hand even slightly, I'll die instantly.
"Ha… ah…"
That fact.
Just that causes me to go insane.

entries.japanese:
「―――終わりです。
たとえ貴方がそのナイフをわたしの首に刺しても、わたしは死にません」
「な―――なに、を―――」
「貴方も見たと言ったでしょう。
鉄パイプで体を刺されても、わたしの体はすぐに傷を治してしまう。
　……たしかに首を貫かれればしばらくは死んでいますが、その前に貴方を殺します」
「―――――な」
　彼女の言葉に嘘はない。
　……そんなつまらない嘘をつける状況じゃない。
　つまり。
　こうしてお互いの命を握って牽制しあっている状況には、なんの意味もないっていう事か。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――It is over. Even if you drive that knife into my throat, I will not die.”
“Wh―――what are you―――”
“You said you saw it yourself. Even after an iron pipe pierced my body, the wound healed at once. A blade through the throat would leave me dead for a little while, certainly, but I would kill you first.”
“―――――What.”
She is not lying.
This is hardly a situation in which anyone would waste time on such a trivial lie.
In other words.
This deadlock, each of us holding the other’s life, means nothing at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It's over.
Even if you stab that knife through my neck, I won't die."
"Wha---what are…"
"You said before that you saw it.
Even though my body was pierced by an iron pipe, my body heals the wound instantly.
…… Certainly if you stab me through the neck I'll be dead for a while, but I'll kill you before that."
"-----Wha."
What she says is true.
…… There's no sense in lying in a situation like this.
In other words.
This situation where both of us hold each other's life in each other's hands is meaningless.

entries.japanese:
「死なない―――だって―――？」
　……ああ、それは本当かもしれない。
　現にあれだけの傷を受けておいて、先輩は平気な顔をして学校に来ていた。
「―――く」
　けど、そんなモノ、知ったことか。
　先輩の体には『死』が視える。
　ひどく他の人間とは違うけれど、先輩の死はたしかに視える。
　なら、殺すことは容易い。
　この『線』に例外などありえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You say you do not die―――is that what you mean―――?”
Yes, it may be true.
After suffering wounds like those, Ciel came to school looking perfectly well.
“―――Ngh.”
But I do not care.
I can see ‘death’ on her body.
It looks profoundly different from the death in ordinary people, but it is there.
That makes killing her easy.
There can be no exception to these lines.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Won't---die…?"
…… Ah, but it could be true.
Even injured like that, Senpai came to school like normal.
"---Kuh."
But, screw all that.
I can see "death" on her body.
Although it's very different from other people's, I can still see her death.
So, killing her is easy.
The "lines" have no exceptions.

entries.japanese:
「信じられないのでしたら、どうぞナイフを動かしてけっこうです。
……まあどのみち、わたしを殺す以外に貴方に助かる道はありません。
ここで試してみるのもいいんじゃないですか？」
「――――――」
　……挑発してる。
　殺せるものなら殺してみろ、と挑発している。
　けど先輩、その挑発は命取りなんだ。
　他のヤツならともかく、俺は―――本当に、あなたを殺す事ができるんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you do not believe me, go ahead and move your knife. In any case, killing me is your only chance of surviving. Why not test it now?”
“――――――”
She is provoking me.
Daring me to kill her if I can.
But Ciel, that challenge will cost you your life.
Anyone else might fail, but I―――truly can kill you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you don't believe me, please, use your knife… In any case, you can't save yourself unless you kill me.
Shall we test it out?"
"------"
……She's provoking me.
If I can be killed, kill me, she's saying.
But Senpai, provocation like that is fatal.
I'm not like the others----I can really kill you.

entries.japanese:
――――どくん、という鼓動。
　視線をさげれば、胸には短刀がつきつけられている。
　……殺す、しかない。
　死にたくないんだから。
　もう簡単に死ぬわけにはいかないって解ったんだから、ここで、殺されるわけにはいかない。
　いや、そもそも単純に。
　俺は、死にたくなんか、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A heartbeat: thump.
Lowering my gaze, I see the short sword poised against my chest.
I have to kill her.
I do not want to die.
Now that I understand I cannot throw my life away so easily, I cannot let myself be killed here.
No.
More simply than that—I do not want to die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----My heart beats.
If I look down, her dagger is at my chest.
…… I have to kill.
Because I don't want to die.
I found out I shouldn't die that easily, so I can't let myself be killed.
No, it's simpler than that.
I just, don't want to die.

entries.japanese:
――――どくん、という鼓動。
　なら答えは一つしかない。
　殺せ。
　そのナイフでシエルの首筋に見える『線』を切断して、殺せ。
　生きたいのなら殺せ。
　殺せ。
殺せ。
殺せ。
殺せ。
殺せ。
殺せ―――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――A heartbeat: thump.
Then there is only one answer.
Kill her.
Cut the line visible across the side of Ciel’s neck with that knife, and kill her.
If you want to live, kill.
Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----My heart beats.
So there's only one answer.
Kill.
Drive this knife into the "line" I see in Ciel's neck, and kill her.
Kill if you want to live.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill---

entries.japanese:
はぁ　はぁ　はぁ。
　うまく呼吸ができない。
　俺の生き死にになんら興味がなさそうな先輩の目。
　ピタリと心臓の前で停止した短刀。
　一秒後には確実に殺されてしまう状態。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah.
I can’t breathe properly.
Her eyes show no interest at all in whether I live or die.
Her dagger has stopped dead in front of my heart.
One second from now, I will certainly be killed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I can't breathe properly.
Senpai's eyes don't even appear interested in my death.
Her dagger is poised directly in front of my heart.
A situation where I'm a second away from being killed.

entries.japanese:
「おかしいですね。
もう何人も殺してきたクセに、自分が殺されるのは恐いなんて。
死にたくないのなら、そのナイフを突き出せば助かるかもしれないのに」
「――――――――」
　先輩の吐息が瞳に触れた。
　くらりと。
　その言葉に眩暈がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How strange. You have killed so many people, yet you are afraid when it is your turn to die. If you do not want to die, you might save yourself by driving that knife into me.”
“――――――――”
Her breath brushes my eyes.
The world sways.
Her words make me dizzy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's odd.
You've killed so many people, yet you are frightened to die yourself."
"--------"
Her breath blows into my eyes.
Her words make me dizzy.

entries.japanese:
「さよなら。
遠野くんがやらないのなら、わたしが先にやるだけです」
　言って。
　先輩の腕に力が篭った。
「―――――――――」
　それで終わる。
　遠野志貴はこれで死ぬ。
　それがイヤなら。
　先輩より早く、このナイフを突き刺すだけ―――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye. If you will not do it, Tohno, then I will simply strike first.”
With those words.
Her arm tenses.
“―――――――――”
That will be the end.
Shiki Tohno will die here.
If I cannot accept that.
I only have to drive my knife into her before she moves―――!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Goodbye.
If you won't do it, Tohno-kun, I'll have to do it myself."
Saying that,
Senpai tenses her arms.
"---------"
This is the end.
Tohno Shiki dies here.
If I don't want that.
I have to stab with this knife faster than Senpai---!

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――！」
　指先に力が篭る。
　けど、それだけだった。
　どうしても腕が動いてくれない。
　……死にたくはない。
自分が殺人鬼だからって殺されてもいい、なんて事もない。
　けどシエル先輩を殺さなければ俺が殺される。
　だから今は、殺したくないとしても、やらなければいけないって解っている。
　なのにどうして。
　俺の腕は、ぴくりとも動いてくれないのか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――!”
My fingers tense.
But that is all.
No matter how I try, my arm refuses to move.
I do not want to die. Being a murderer does not mean I deserve to be killed.
But unless I kill Ciel, she will kill me.
I understand that even if I do not want to, I have to do it now.
Then why.
Why will my arm not move even an inch――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Guh----!"
My fingertips fill with strength.
But that's all.
My arms don't move at all.
…… I don't want to die.
It's not that I'm willing to die since I'm a killer.
But if I don't kill Ciel-senpai, I'll be killed.
So right now, I understand that even if I don't want to kill, I have to.
So why?
Why won't my arm move----

entries.japanese: 不意に。
entries.maoEnglish: Without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon: Suddenly.

entries.japanese:
わたし、もっと遠野くんと話したかった。
　だから、いま死んじゃうのはホントにイヤだよ。
!w1500
entries.maoEnglish:
I wanted to talk to you so much more, Tohno.
So I really do not want to die now.!w1500
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wanted to talk more with you, Tohno-kun.
That's why I really don't want to die now.

entries.japanese: そんな、ことを。
entries.maoEnglish: Those words.
entries.mirrorMoon: Those words.

entries.japanese:
でも、きっとこれが一番いい方法だったんだよね。
　―――だから、泣かないで遠野くん。
あなたは正しい事をしてくれたんだから。
!w1500
entries.maoEnglish:
But this must have been the best way.
―――So do not cry, Tohno. You did the right thing.!w1500
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, this is for sure the best way.
---So, don't cry, Tohno-kun.
You did the right thing.

entries.japanese: 身勝手に、思い、出した。
entries.maoEnglish: I remembered them, selfishly, in broken pieces.
entries.mirrorMoon: They force themselves into my memory.

entries.japanese:
うん、ばいばい遠野くん。
　ありがとう―――それと、ごめんね。
!w1500
entries.maoEnglish:
Mm, goodbye, Tohno.
Thank you―――and I am sorry.!w1500
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, bye bye, Tohno-kun.
Thank you---and, sorry.

entries.japanese:
―――――ああ。
　そういう、ことか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Oh.
So that was it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Yeah.
I see now.

entries.japanese:
「どうして抵抗しないんですか」
　先輩の声が聞こえる。
　短刀は胸に突きつけられたままで、ずっ、と服を裂いて肉に食い込んでくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why won’t you fight back?”
Her voice reaches me.
The dagger remains pressed to my chest, slicing through my clothes and slowly biting into flesh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why aren't you resisting?"
I hear Senpai's voice.
The dagger is still at my chest; it tears my clothes and digs into my flesh.

entries.japanese:
「このままだと死にますよ。
なのにどうして、そのナイフを動かさないんですか」
　そんなコトは。
「………俺には、できない」
「どうして。
今まで、何人も殺してきたのに？」
　もう、絶対に。
「………俺には、できない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ll die if this continues. Why won’t you move that knife?”
How could I.
“I cannot do it.”
“Why? You’ve already killed so many people.”
Never again.
“I cannot do it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Like this, you'll die.
So why?
Why aren't you moving your knife?"
That's because…
"…… I can't."

"Why not?
Even though you've killed so many people up to now?"
Never again.
"…… I can't do it."

entries.japanese:
「たった今、そこの死体を殺したじゃないですか。
一度してしまえば二度目も三度目もかわりません。
やらなければ―――わたしは、このまま貴方を殺します」
　……彼女は本気だ。
　きっと一秒後には遠野志貴という殺人鬼を殺すだろう。
　それが恐くないワケがない。
　ああ、それでも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“You just killed that corpse lying there. Once you have done it once, a second or third time makes no difference. Unless you do it―――I will kill you.”
She means it.
One second from now, she will surely kill the murderer named Shiki Tohno.
Of course I am afraid.
Even so―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You just killed that corpse.
After you've done it once, a second, or third time will not change anything.
If you don't do it, I will kill you."
…… She's serious.
In a second, the killer called Tohno Shiki will surely be killed.
It's not that I'm not afraid.
Yeah, but still---

entries.japanese: 「俺には、人は、殺せない―――」
entries.maoEnglish: “I cannot kill another human being―――”
entries.mirrorMoon: "I can't… kill someone---"

entries.japanese:
言って、涙が流れた。
　何が悲しいというわけでも、誰が哀しいというわけでもなく。
　ただ、頬を伝う涙が止まらなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The words leave my mouth, and tears begin to fall.
I am not grieving for anything or anyone.
The tears simply will not stop running down my cheeks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As I speak, tears flow.
It's not like something is sad, or someone's unhappy.
But the tears running down my cheeks don't stop.

entries.japanese:
どのくらいの時間が経ったのか。
　ただ虚ろになっていた意識は、
「―――ふう。
ようやく解ってくれましたね、遠野くん」
　なんていう、間の抜けた先輩の声で戻ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
How much time passed?
My mind had simply gone blank when
“―――Whew. You finally understand, Tohno.”
Ciel’s oddly anticlimactic voice brings me back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
How much time has passed?
My mind which has been in a trance…
"---Phew.
You understand at last, Tohno-kun."
…… Comes back with Senpai's words.

entries.japanese:
「え―――先、輩………？」
「ほら、これで納得がいったでしょう？
　貴方は殺人鬼なんかじゃありません。
今の言葉が遠野くんの真実じゃないですか。
　だから、こんなことは夢なんです。
遠野くんは遠野くん。
とても自然で、思いやりがあって、こんなことで泣いてしまうぐらい優しいひと。
わたしが憧れた、どこにでもいるようなふつうの男の子なんですから」
　言いながら、先輩は短剣をしまった。
　さっきまでの殺気はどこにいったのか、先輩は本当にいつもの優しい先輩に戻っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eh―――Ciel?”
“Now you believe it, don’t you? You are not a murderer. What you just said is the truth of who you are.
So all of this is only a dream. You are still yourself. You are natural, considerate, and kind enough to cry over something like this. You are the ordinary boy I admired, the sort you could find anywhere.”
As she speaks, she puts away the dagger.
Her murderous intent has vanished, and she is once again the familiar, gentle Ciel I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh---Sen, pai…?"
"See, are you satisfied?
You're not a killer.
Those words were true words.
So, all this is just a dream.
Tohno-kun is Tohno-kun.
Very gentle, thoughtful, and so sensitive as to cry over something like this.
Just the ordinary, everyday boy I yearned for."
Saying so, Senpai puts the dagger away.
Her scary tone of death disappears, and Senpai returns to her usual gentle self.

entries.japanese:
「どうして……？
　俺を殺すためにきたんじゃないんですか、先輩は」
「ええ、遠野くんのそういった自暴自棄な心を殺すためにきたんです。
貴方は殺人鬼なんかじゃない。
けどわたしがいくら言っても信じてくれないようでしたから、ちょっと追い詰めて体で解らせてあげようかなって」
「な―――体で解らせるって、それじゃあ、さっきまでのは全部芝居だったっていうのか……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why…? Didn’t you come here to kill me?”
“I came to kill that self-destructive part of you. You are not a murderer. But nothing I said seemed to convince you, so I thought I would corner you and prove it the hard way.”
“Wh―――what do you mean, the hard way; was everything up to now an act?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…?
You didn't come here to kill me, Senpai…?"
"Right, I came here to kill the self-loathing in your heart.
You're not a killer.
But since it seemed you wouldn't believe that no matter how much I told you, I had to persuade you on a more physical level."
"Wha---persuade me physically?
Then, you mean, this was all just an act…!?"

entries.japanese:
「いえ、わたしは本気でしたよ。
遠野くんが殺人鬼だっていう可能性も否定はできませんでしたから手は抜きませんでしたし、思いっきりやったほうがわたしも楽しいですから。
　ほら、好きな子ほどいじめたくなるっていうアレですね」
　先輩は笑顔でとんでもないことを言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I was perfectly serious. I couldn’t rule out the possibility that you truly were a murderer, so I didn’t hold back—and it’s more fun for me when I can go all out.
You know how people always want to torment the one they like.”
She says this outrageous thing with a smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I was serious.
I couldn't completely rule out the possibility of you being the killer, Tohno-kun.
Therefore I couldn't hold back.
Besides, it is more fun to go all out.
You know, like how you enjoy teasing someone you like."
Senpai says something pretty scary with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「は――――」
―――それで、気が抜けた。
　さっきまで色々と思いつめていた自分が馬鹿らしく思えてくる。
「はは、は――――」
　なんだかおかしくて、笑ってしまった。
　先輩の言うとおり、あれほど自分が殺人鬼なんじゃないのかって恐れてた不安が消えている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh――――”
―――And just like that, all the tension leaves me.
The way I had been brooding until moments ago suddenly seems ridiculous.
“Hah, ha――――”
Something about it strikes me as funny, and I begin to laugh.
Just as she said, the fear that I might be a murderer has disappeared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha---"
---And with that, I collapse.
All the things I've been thinking about up until now seem so foolish.
"Haha, ha---"
For some reason, it's funny and I laugh.
As Senpai says, my fear that I might be a killer has disappeared.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、そうだね。
たしかにようやく目が覚めた気がする。
けどひどいな先輩。
今日のは、いくらなんでも厳しすぎる」
「はい。
今まで甘やかしてたぶん、帳尻を合わせたんです」
　微笑んで、先輩は手を差し出してきた。
　先輩の手を握り返す。
　よっ、と声をかけて先輩は俺の体を立ちあがらせてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I do feel as though I have finally woken up. But that was cruel. You went much too far tonight.”
“Yes. I was balancing the books after indulging you for so long.”
Smiling, she offers me her hand.
I take it.
With a small grunt, Ciel pulls me to my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, you're right.
It feels like I finally got it.
But that's terrible, Senpai.
You went too far today."
"Yes.
I've been going easy on you up until now, so I made up for that too."
Smiling, Senpai holds out her hand.
I take it.
With a grunt, Senpai pulls me up.

entries.japanese:
校舎からグラウンドに出る。
　先輩につけられた傷は、先輩が治療してくれた。
　……どんなカラクリなのか、塗り薬らしきものを塗られた後、先輩が手を当てるだけで傷が塞がってくれたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
We leave the school building and step onto the athletic field.
She treats the wounds she gave me. I have no idea how it works: after applying something like an ointment, she merely places her hand over them, and the wounds close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We exit the building onto the school grounds.
Senpai has treated the wounds she inflicted.
By some trick, the wounds closed after Senpai put medicine-like stuff on there and put her hand over it.

entries.japanese:
「さて、それじゃあわたしの知っている事を教えてあげる約束でしたね。
さ、何が聞きたいんですか、遠野くんは」
「なにって―――そりゃあ決まってるだろ。
俺が夢で見てることの全てだよ。
どうして俺が人を殺す夢なんか見るのか、いったい先輩はどんな人なのか、わからない事だらけだから」
「はあ、そういう事ですか。
それじゃあまず遠野くんが見ているという夢のことから話しましょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now then, I promised to tell you what I know. What would you like to ask, Tohno?”
“What do you mean―――it is obvious. Everything about those dreams: why I dream of killing people and who you really are. There is so much I do not understand.”
“Ah, I see. Then let’s begin with these dreams you’ve been having.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I promised to tell you what I know.
What do you want to hear, Tohno-kun?"
"What---well, that's obvious.
I want to know everything about my dreams.
Why do I have dreams about killing people… who exactly are you… there's a lot I don't understand."
"Ahh, I see.
Well, let's start with the dreams you have, Tohno-kun.

entries.japanese:
「簡単に言ってしまうとですね、遠野くんが見ている夢は遠野くんの夢ではないと思います。
　遠野くん、人殺しの夢を見るって言ってましたけど、その夢って『誰かが人を殺している所』を見ているだけの夢なんじゃないですか？」
「……そりゃあそうだよ。
夢の中の事を自分でどうにかできたら、人を殺したりするもんか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Put simply, I do not believe those are actually your dreams.
You said you dream about murdering people, but are you not really only watching someone else commit the murders?”
“Of course. If I could control what I do in the dream, I would not go around killing people.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"To put it simply, I don't think the dream you're seeing is your dream.
Tohno-kun, you say you dream of killing, but isn't the dream more like watching someone killing someone else?"
"…… Well yeah.
Do you think I would kill people in my dreams if I could control myself?"

entries.japanese:
「ほら、だからそういう事なんです。
遠野くんはですね、眠ってしまうと殺人鬼の意識に同化してしまうんですよ。
あ、同化っていうよりは取りこまれている、というのが正しいんでしょうか。
　ですから遠野くんの視点は殺人鬼の物と同じでありながら、どこかその光景を遠くから眺めているような感覚じゃなかったですか？」
「………………」
　それは―――その通りだ。
　今まで何度も殺人の夢を見てきたけど、俺は結局、そういった『場面』を見てきたにすぎなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. When you fall asleep, your consciousness merges with the murderer’s. No, perhaps it would be more accurate to say that theirs engulfs yours.
Although you share the murderer’s viewpoint, does it not also feel as though you are watching everything from somewhere far away?”
“…”
That is―――exactly right.
However many dreams of murder I have seen, in the end I was only witnessing those scenes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, that's what I mean.
When you sleep, you go into the killer's mind.
Well, not exactly going into but more like being taken into.
So, even though your viewpoint was that of the killer, didn't you feel as though you were watching things from afar?"
"…………"
That's---precisely right.
