Even though I've had dreams about killings for a while now, they've all felt as if I were watching a "scene".

entries.japanese:
「けど、どうしてそんなヤツと俺の意識とやらが一緒になるんだ。
それ、なにか原因でもあるんですか」
「……ええ、理由ははっきりしています。
けど、それはもう少し後で説明させてください。
その前に遠野くんが殺人鬼と呼んでいるモノがなんなのかを話さないといけませんから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But why would my mind merge with someone like that? Is there a reason?”
“Yes. The reason is clear, but let me explain it a little later. First I must tell you what the thing you call a murderer actually is.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, why is my mind and this killer's mind merging?
There must be some reason, right?"
"…… Yes, there's a very clear reason.
But let us leave that aside for a moment.
First, we have to discuss what you are calling the killer."

entries.japanese:
「たしかに、アレは殺人鬼ではあります。
けどその性質は吸血鬼と呼ばれるものです」
「……そりゃあまあ、たしかに吸血鬼っていうほうがいいんだろうね、アレは」
　夢の中での光景を思い出す。
　アレは殺人を愉しんでいたのと同時に、やはり人の血肉を食らっていたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It certainly is a murderer. But by its nature, it is what we would call a vampire.”
“I suppose ‘vampire’ does fit it better.”
I remember the things I saw in those dreams.
It delighted in murder, but it also devoured human blood and flesh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Certainly, there is a killer.
But it's characteristics are more like a vampire's."
"…… That's fair enough.
Certainly, you could call someone like that a vampire."
I remember the scene in my dream.
That guy, while enjoying the killing, he ate their flesh and blood.

entries.japanese:
「はい。
わたしはその吸血鬼を処理するためにこの街にきた人間です。
　……詳しくは話せませんが、世界には様々な防衛機能が存在します。
法律を破る犯罪者を捕えるために警察機構があるように、人間の枠から外れた異端者を処理する組織も多く存在するんです。
　……わたしは、そういった組織の一人だと思ってください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I came to this city to dispose of that vampire.
I cannot tell you the details, but the world has many ways of defending itself. Just as the police exist to arrest criminals who break the law, organizations exist to dispose of heretics beyond the bounds of humanity.
Think of me as one member of such an organization.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I am the person who came to this town to deal with that vampire.
…… Although I can't tell you the details, the world has various defense mechanisms.
Just like there are police to deal with those who break the law, there are also many organizations which deal with heretics who are inhuman.
…… Think of me like a member of that kind of organization."

entries.japanese:
「……吸血鬼を、処理するために……？」
「そうです。
自らの肉体を維持するために同じ生物の血液を搾取して生き続けるモノ。
そうやって存在しているかぎりは不老である停止した生命。
　そういった異端者を掃討するのがわたしの役割ですから。
　わたしが毎夜、遠野くんが見ていた夢の中で吸血鬼と戦っていたのはそういった理由からです」
「――――――」
　言葉がない。
　正直、俺にはとうてい理解できない世界の話だったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You came here to dispose of a vampire?”
“Yes. A creature that sustains its own body by taking the blood of others of its species. An arrested form of life that remains ageless for as long as it continues to exist that way.
My duty is to eradicate such heretics.
That is why I was fighting the vampire every night in the dreams you saw.”
“――――――”
I have no words.
She is describing a world I cannot begin to comprehend.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Deal with vampires?"
"Yes.
That which sucks the blood of the living to maintain its own flesh.
A stopped life which does so in order to have eternal life.
It is my role to wipe out such heretics.
That's the reason I was fighting the vampire every night in your dreams."
"------"
There's nothing to say.
To be honest, I don't understand the world she's talking about at all.

entries.japanese:
「……あれ。
先輩はその吸血鬼と何度か戦っているんだよな？」
「今まで二回ほどです。
一度目は逃げられて、二回目は痛みわけという所でしたけど」
「だろ？
　ならその吸血鬼ってヤツの顔を見ているんじゃないか。
それなら初めから俺が吸血鬼じゃないって分かってたはずじゃないのか？」
「……いえ。
残念ながら、それでは確証がとれないんです。
吸血種の中には体格を自在に変化させられる者もいますから、外見だけでは特定はできません」
「……そうなのか。
厄介な話だね、それは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait. You have fought this vampire several times, have you not?”
“Twice. It escaped the first time, and the second ended more or less in a draw.”
“Right? Then you have seen its face. Should you not have known from the beginning that I was not the vampire?”
“No. Unfortunately, that is not conclusive. Some of the vampiric kind can alter their physique at will, so appearance alone cannot identify them.”
“I see. That makes things difficult.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?
So you've fought the vampire several times already?"
"Twice now.
The first time it escaped, and the second time, our encounter was rather painful."
"Right?
So, you've seen his face, haven't you?
So didn't you know immediately I wasn't the vampire?"
"No.
Unfortunately, I couldn't be certain.
Since some vampires can change their bodies freely, you cannot rely on appearance to identify them."
"…… Really.
That's a problem, then."

entries.japanese:
「けど、これではっきりしたよ。
随分と回り道をしたけど、その吸血鬼っていうヤツが通り魔殺人をしているやつなんだな？」
「はい。
通り魔殺人の犠牲者として報道されている遺体は、ただの食べ残しにすぎません。
　実際は血肉を全て奪われたか、それとも血を吸われて同じように吸血鬼になってしまったかしていますから、遺体なんてそもそも残らないんです」
「……ちょっと待って。
血を吸われて吸血鬼になる人間なんていたら、そんなの倍々ゲームじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But at least one thing is finally clear. We took the long way around, but this vampire is the one behind the serial street murders, isn’t it?”
“Yes. The bodies reported as victims of the serial killer are merely leftovers.
In reality, the other victims are either stripped of every trace of blood and flesh or drained and turned into vampires themselves; in either case, no body remains.”
“Wait. If people who are bitten become vampires too, the numbers would double forever.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, now it's clear.
So we've beaten around the bush, but this vampire is the serial killer then?"
"Yes.
The dead bodies reported as victims of the serial killer are merely leftover food.
Usually the flesh is consumed completely, or the blood is drained and they become vampires too, so there shouldn't be any bodies left."
"…… Hold on.
If people who get their blood sucked turn into vampires, then wouldn't they start multiplying?"

entries.japanese:
「いえ、血を吸われ、殺されても死なずに『残れる』人間というのは限られているんです。
大抵の人間は肉体から魂を剥離できず、肉体の死とともに魂も死滅してしまいますから。
　死なずに『残れる』人間というのは百人に一人いるかどうかの確率です。
　……例えば、貴方の知っている弓塚さつきのように」
「な―――先輩、先輩は弓塚のことを知ってたのか」
「いえ、わたしが駆けつけた時には、もう貴方が彼女を消滅させている所でしたから。
　……ごめんなさい。
あの時、遠野くんが傷ついているって分かっていたのに助けてあげられなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, very few people can be drained, killed, and still ‘remain.’ Most cannot separate the soul from the body, so the soul dies when the body does.
Perhaps one person in a hundred can ‘remain’ after death.
Someone like Satsuki Yumizuka, for example.”
“Wh―――what, Ciel, you knew about Yumizuka?”
“No; by the time I arrived, you were already annihilating her.
I am sorry. I knew you were suffering then, but I still could not help you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, there is a limit to those who are killed by having their blood sucked, yet 'remain' without dying.
Most humans cannot separate the soul from the body, so the soul dies with the death of the body.
Only perhaps one in a hundred people can 'remain' without dying.
…… Like Yumizuka Satsuki did."
"Wha---Senpai, you knew about Yumizuka?"
"No.
By the time I got there, you had already destroyed her.
…… I'm sorry.
Back then, even though I knew you were in pain, I couldn't help you."

entries.japanese:
「――――いや、そんな事はいいんだ。
弓塚との事は、あれで一番よかったって思いたい。
　……けど、そうか。
弓塚だって初めから吸血鬼だったわけじゃないんだもんな。
あいつはその吸血鬼に襲われて、あんな体になっちまったんだ―――」
「そうでしょうね。
　ただ、弓塚さんのような人は他にはいないと思います。
吸血鬼として活動できるようになるには、長い年月が必要なんです。
　彼女がすぐに活動できたところを見ると、弓塚さつきは生まれつき霊的な想念が優れていたのでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――No, that is all right. I want to believe that what happened with Yumizuka was the best ending she could have had.
But of course. She was not born a vampire. That vampire attacked her and turned her into what she became―――”
“That is probably true.
Still, I doubt there are many people like her. Ordinarily, it takes many years before someone can function as a vampire.
Since she became active almost immediately, Satsuki Yumizuka must have possessed exceptional spiritual aptitude from birth.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No, it's alright.
I want to think that what happened with Yumizuka was for the best.
…… But, I see now.
Yumizuka wasn't a vampire from the beginning.
She was attacked by that vampire, and that was the result---"
"Yes, that's true.
But I don't think there are others like Yumizuka-san.
It takes many years before a vampire can function as a vampire.
For her to be able to function immediately, Yumizuka Satsuki must have had amazing spiritual conception."

entries.japanese:
「へ……？
　霊的な想念って、なに？」
「人間が胎児として形成される時に定められる脳の機能範囲―――とも言われています。
遠野くんのような『能力者』は、一般では覚醒しない脳の器官を使っているんです。
　弓塚さつきも同様です。
彼女は生まれつき『適していた』んでしょう。
だから親元である吸血鬼の支配は受けないで、独立した吸血種として活動できた」
　俺には先輩の説明はわからない。
　ただ、ひっかかる事が一つあっただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh? What does ‘spiritual aptitude’ mean?”
“It is said to be the range of brain functions fixed while a human is still forming in the womb―――or something like that. People with abilities like yours use organs in the brain that never awaken in ordinary people.
Satsuki Yumizuka was the same. She must have been born ‘suited’ to it. That is why she escaped the control of the vampire who made her and could act as an independent member of a vampiric species.”
I don’t understand her explanation.
Only one thing bothers me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh…?
Spiritual conception?
What's that?"
"A functional extent of the brain determined when a person is an embryo---or so it is said.
Like how you use your ability, it is employing a section of the brain most people never use.
The same for Yumizuka Satsuki.
She was naturally 'suitable'.
So, instead of being under the control of her parent vampire, she became a vampire that could act independently."
I don't understand Senpai's explanation.
But, one thing occurs to me.

entries.japanese:
「先輩。
俺が能力者とか言ってたけど、先輩は俺の目の事を知ってるのか……？」
「目、ですか？
　いえ、遠野くんがどんな目をしているかは知りませんけど、貴方が特異な能力を持っている事はわかってますよ。
　遠野くんの血筋は特別な血筋ですから。
わたしのように修練をして身につけた魔術ではなく、貴方は生まれ持って『能力』を身につけている。
　そういうのを『超能力』っていうんです。
一般の人間は脳の回線が一つしか開いてないんですけど、遠野くんはその他にもう一つ、わたしたちでは見る事のできない回線が開いているんでしょうね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You called me someone with an ability. Do you know about my eyes…?”
“Your eyes? No, I don’t know what sort of eyes you possess, but I do know that you have an unusual ability.
Your bloodline is special. Unlike the magecraft I acquired through training, your ‘ability’ was yours from birth.
That is what people call psychic powers. An ordinary person has only one circuit open in the brain, but you must have another as well—one that people like us cannot even perceive.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai.
You mentioned my abilities… so, you know about my eyes…?"
"Eyes?
No, I don't know what kind of eyes you have, Tohno-kun, but I know that you have an unique ability.
Tohno-kun's blood is special.
Not a trained ability like mine, but something you are born with.
Those kind of things are called 'supernatural powers'.
Most people have only one channel open in their minds, but you have another channel open that we can't see, right?"

entries.japanese:
「……特別な血筋って、それは遠野の血筋が特別っていう事……？」
「そうですね、遠野の血筋も旧いものですから。
　ですが、過去の記録をみると遠野の人間の特異能力はみんなバラバラなんです。
単純な感応能力しかない者や、人間としてのカタチを保てないで殺人を犯してしまう者、能力こそあるものの一生目覚めることなく過ごせる者。
　……それも代を重ねるごとに薄れているようですから、今代ではそう大した能力者はでてこないでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“A special bloodline means the Tohno bloodline itself is special?”
“Yes, the Tohno bloodline is very old.
But according to past records, every Tohno manifested a different innate ability. Some possessed only simple resonance, some lost human form and committed murder, and others had an ability but lived their whole lives without awakening it.
The blood seems to weaken with every generation, so I doubt anyone exceptionally powerful will appear in the present one.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Special blood… you mean, the blood of the Tohno house…?"
"Yes, the Tohno bloodline is ancient.
But looking at the history of the Tohno family, one can see the abilities of its members are varied.
Such as those who can receive divine inspiration, those unable to maintain their shape as humans and become killers, or those who never awaken to their power.
…… As time passed, this blood has thinned and probably most of these abilities do not occur anymore."

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　呆然とする。
　先輩の言うことが本当だとしたら、俺だけじゃなくて秋葉にも、俺の目みたいに『壊れた』部分があるっていうんだろうか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
I stare at her, stunned.
If she is telling the truth, does that mean Akiha has something ‘broken’ inside her too, just as I have these eyes?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I'm aghast.
If what Senpai says is true, then not just me, but Akiha will also have something "broken" like my eyes…?

entries.japanese:
「話を戻しましょうか。
　遠野くん、さっき言ってましたよね。
どうして自分の意識が吸血鬼のものと混濁してしまうのかって」
「あ……ああ、たしかに訊いたけど」
「それも遠野くんの能力に関係しているんだと思います。
　貴方の脳は他の人間より回線が広いんです。
貴方はその回線の広さゆえに、眠りにおちて自我が薄れてしまうと、自分と関わりのあるモノ、繋がりやすい脳を持つ吸血鬼の意識に吸い寄せられてしまっているんだと思います」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shall we return to the subject?”
“Tohno, you brought it up a moment ago. You asked why your consciousness was becoming mixed with the vampire’s.”
“Ah, yes, I did ask.”
“I believe that also relates to your ability.
Your brain has more channels than an ordinary person’s. When you fall asleep and your sense of self grows faint, that breadth draws you toward the consciousness of a vampire connected to you—one whose brain is easy for yours to reach.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shall I continue?
Tohno-kun, you asked a while ago.
Why are your senses merging with those of the vampire?"
"Ah… ah, yes, I did…"
"I think that is also related to your abilities.
Your brain has a larger channel than other people's.
Because of that, when you sleep and your sense of self dims, your mind is drawn towards a vampire which has an easily connectable brain with you."

entries.japanese:
「は……？
　先輩、繋がりやすい脳ってなんなんだ。
その、作りが似てるとかそういったワケじゃないんだろ？」
「いえ、その通りの意味ですよ。
　遠野くんは双子が同一体験をする、という話を聞いた事がありませんか？」
「双子の同一体験……？」
「ほら、兄のほうが傷を負うと、遠く離れた所にいる弟も同じ痛みを感じる、という話です。
遠野くんの夢はこれと似ているんだと思います。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…? What do you mean, a brain that’s easy to reach? You don’t mean our brains are physically similar, do you?”
“That is exactly what I mean.
Have you heard stories about twins sharing the same experience?”
“Twins sharing an experience…?”
“You know—the stories where one twin is injured and the other, far away, feels the same pain. I think your dreams are something similar.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh…?
Senpai, what do you mean, an easily connectable brain?
You can't mean they are made similarly, right?"
"No, that is precisely what I mean.
Have you ever heard of twins sharing experiences?"
"Twins sharing experiences…?"
"For instance, if the elder brother is injured, the younger brother who's miles away feels the same pain.
I think that your dreams are similar to this.

entries.japanese:
「もともと、一卵性の双生児というものは一つの遺伝子情報から作られる二つの人間の肉体です。
　彼らはまったく同じ規格で作られた肉体のパーツですから、片一方の脳が感じた痛みを、もう片一方の脳が受信する、というのはありえない話ではありません。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Identical twins are two human bodies produced from the same genetic information.
Since their bodies are made to precisely the same specifications, it is not inconceivable that one brain might receive the pain felt by the other.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fundamentally, identical twins are two humans' flesh born from the same genes.
They are body parts made from the same instructions, so it isn't impossible for pain felt by one brain to be received by the other."

entries.japanese:
「脳は受信と送信をつかさどる器官です。
私たちは一人一人が違った設計図で作られた脳を持つから、他人に自分の感覚を伝えるためには言葉で送信しなくてはいけません。
けれどまったく同じ規格の脳であるのなら、言葉にしなくとも意思は伝わってしまう。
　さきほどの表現でいうのなら、脳の回線があっているから電波を受信してしまうんです。
　遠野くんの場合、人より優れた脳があるから、自分に近い肉体に繋がってしまうんですね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The brain governs both transmission and reception. Each of us has a brain built from a different blueprint, so we must use language to transmit our sensations to others. But if two brains are made to exactly the same specifications, thought may pass between them without words.
To use my earlier metaphor, their channels match, so they receive the same signal.
In your case, your brain’s unusual capacity allows it to connect with a body similar to your own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"The brain is an organ that manages reception and transmission.
Since every person's brain is made from a different blueprint, we have to communicate our feelings through language.
But if two brains are precisely the same, thought will be transmitted without the need for language.
To put it in the previous terms, since the brain's channel is on the same frequency, the electric signal is received.
Since your brain is superior to others', you connect to the bodies close to you."

entries.japanese:
「……まさか。
俺には双子なんて、いない」
「ええ、解っています。
けど遠野くんの場合は双子である必要なんてない。
　意識が意識に飲まれる、同化する、という事はより近い脳の規格をしているという事でしょう。
遠野くんの場合、脳の回線が多いんですから一卵性の双子である必要なんかないんです。
　単純に同じルーツ、似たような身体をしていれば、おそらくはその相手に取りこまれてしまう。
　それは同じ母親と父親をもつ兄弟でもかまいません。
……まあ、特例として他人同士でも臓器移植をしてお互いの『肉体』を分け合っていると引きずられてしまうかもしれませんけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is impossible. I do not have a twin.”
“I know. But in your case, you do not need one.
If one consciousness can engulf and assimilate another, their brains must already be built to similar specifications. Since your brain has additional channels, the other person need not be your identical twin.
Shared ancestry and a similar body would probably be enough for their consciousness to draw yours in.
A sibling with the same mother and father would qualify. As an exceptional case, even strangers who share part of their bodies through an organ transplant might influence one another.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It can't be.
I don't have any twin."
"I know.
But in your case, it doesn't need to be a twin.
It's not like you are merging with them, but more like you have similar brains.
Since your brain has many channels, there is no need for you to be identical twins.
Simply the same roots, a similar body… that's probably all that is needed for you to be drawn in.
Probably a sibling with the same parents… Well, I suppose an exception could be made in the case of organ transplants; the 'flesh' might pull on your mind in that case."

entries.japanese:
―――血の繋がっている者であるのならかまわない……？
　それは―――そんな事は、ない。
　だって俺の肉親なんて、今じゃもう秋葉しか残っていない。
　秋葉しか。
　秋葉しか、いないって、いうのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――A blood relative would be enough?
That is―――that cannot be true.
Akiha is the only blood family I have left.
Only Akiha.
Does that mean there is no one but Akiha?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It could happen with anyone connected by blood…?
That---that can't be.
Akiha is the only blood relative I have left now.
Only Akiha.
Is there… no one but Akiha?

entries.japanese:
「――――うそだ。
そんなのは、違う」
　……先輩は何も言わない。
　俺の脳裏には。
　琥珀さんの血を吸う、秋葉の姿が。
「そんなコトあるもんか。
……やっぱり、あれは夢なんかじゃないんだ。
人を殺して血を吸っているのは俺のほうなんだ。
　だって、そうじゃないと――――」
　あらゆる事で、辻褄が、あってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――That is a lie. That is not what happened.”
Ciel says nothing.
An image fills my mind.
Akiha drinking Kohaku’s blood.
“That cannot be true. The dreams must really be mine. I am the one killing people and drinking their blood.
Because otherwise――――”
Every piece of it falls horribly into place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----It can't be.
That's… that's wrong."
…… Senpai doesn't answer.
In my mind,
I see Akiha's figure, drinking Kohaku-san's blood.
"That can't be.
I knew it, it wasn't a dream.
I was the one who killed people and drank their blood.
Because, if I not----"
All together, it makes sense.

entries.japanese:
「……わたしも初めは遠野くんを疑っていました。
けれど接していくうちに、遠野くんではないって思ったんです。
　けど、それはわたしの身勝手な願望かもしれなかった。
だから、今夜のことはわたしにとっても賭けだった。
　貴方がためらわずにわたしを殺そうとするのなら、遠野くんが吸血鬼なんだって認めるしかなかった。
……けど、やっぱり遠野くんは違ってくれました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“At first, I suspected you too. But the more time I spent with you, the more certain I became that it was not you.
Yet that certainty might have been nothing but my own selfish wish. So tonight was a gamble for me as well.
If you had tried to kill me without hesitation, I would have had no choice but to accept that you were the vampire. But you proved that you were not.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I suspected you at first.
But after meeting you, I decided you weren't it.
But I might have just been fooling myself.
So, tonight was a gamble for me.
If you had killed me without hesitation, I would have known you were a vampire… But, you weren't, after all."

entries.japanese:
「―――違う。
さっきのは、その―――」
「遠野くん。
遠野家の血族はその全員が『人でない者』の血が混ざっています。
中にはまったく害のない者もいたようですが、そういった者は一代に一人ほどしかいないという話です。
　過去に遡れば、遠野の血族の中で人の血を吸う者も少なくはありません。
　けど、遠野くんは人の血を吸う意思もなければその必要もない。
なら―――」
「そんなの―――先輩に解るもんか」
「……遠野くん。
遠野の家には吸血鬼が生まれる可能性があるんです。
けど貴方がそうでないのなら、もう――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No. What just happened was, well―――”
“Tohno, everyone in the Tohno bloodline carries the blood of something inhuman. Some seem to have been completely harmless. But the records say there was only one such person in each generation.”
“Looking back through Tohno history, more than a few members of the family drank human blood.”
“But you have neither the desire nor the need to drink human blood. If so―――”
“How could you possibly know that―――”
“Tohno. A vampire could be born into the Tohno family. But if you are not one, then――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
That was just---"
"Tohno-kun.
All those in the Tohno family have something 'inhuman' mixed in their blood.
Though some were completely harmless, there are usually only one of these in each generation.
In the past, there were many members of the Tohno family that drank blood.
But you do not need to drink the blood of others or have an urge to.
So----"
"How---how would you know that, Senpai?"
"…… Tohno-kun, the Tohno House holds a possibility of giving birth to a vampire.
If you are not it, then…"

entries.japanese:
「―――――――っ」
　違う、と必死に首をふった。
―――俺は、先輩の言葉を認めない。
　　　認めることなんか、できない。
　……けど、思い出してしまった。
　離れの屋敷で琥珀さんの血を吸う、遠野秋葉の横顔を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――!”
I shake my head desperately in denial.
―――I refuse to accept what she is saying.
I cannot accept it.
But the memory comes back anyway.
The image of Akiha Tohno in the detached house, drinking Kohaku’s blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
No, I shake my head desperately.
---I won't accept Senpai's words.
I can't accept them.
…… But, I remember.
In the detached building, the face of Tohno Akiha drinking Kohaku-san's blood.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉は違う。
そんなヘンな力があるのは、俺のほうだ」
「――そうかもしれませんね。
わたしから見ても、秋葉さんは覚醒しているとは思えません。
汚染規定で言うのならまだ『戻れる』レベルです」
「……違う。
秋葉は、違う……！
　そんな、そんなふうに異状なのは俺だけなんだ。
　だって、秋葉は何年も俺のことを待っててくれて、今日だって、ちゃんと見送ってくれたんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha is different. I’m the one with a strange power.”
“――Maybe. Even to me, Akiha does not seem to have fully awakened. On the contamination scale, she is still classed as ‘able to return’ if treated.”
“No. Akiha is different…! I am the only one who is abnormal like this.
She waited years for me to come home; she even saw me off properly today…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's not Akiha.
The one with strange power… is me."
"--You may be right.
Just by looking, Akiha-san does not seem to have her power awakened.
She is certainly contaminated with it, but only to a level that she can still turn back."
"…… No.
It's not Akiha…!
I'm the only one who has these troubles.
Akiha waited for me for many years, and just today, she said goodbye to me properly…!"

entries.japanese:
「わたしは吸血鬼を狩るだけです。
それが誰であろうと、見逃すわけにはいきません」
「―――――っ」
　何もいえず、ただ唇を噛んだ。
　……わからない。
　もし……秋葉がそうであった場合、自分はどうすればいいんだろうか。
　見て見ぬふりをするのか、それとも秋葉を助けるために先輩と戦うのか。
　……駄目だ。
　いくら考えても、答えなんて、出る筈がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I hunt vampires. Whoever they may be, I cannot let one escape.”
“―――――!”
Unable to answer, I bite my lip.
I do not know.
If Akiha really is the vampire, what am I supposed to do?
Pretend I never saw anything—or fight Ciel to protect Akiha?
It is no use.
No matter how long I think, I will never find an answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I only hunt vampires.
Whoever it is, I cannot overlook them."
"-----"
Unable to speak, I only bite my lip.
…… I don't understand.
If… if Akiha is such a thing, what should I do?
Should I pretend not to realize, or should I fight Senpai to defend Akiha?
…… It's useless.
No matter how much I think, I can't find any answers.

entries.japanese:
「―――わかりました。
遠野くんにとって秋葉さんはとても大事な人なんですね。
たぶん、貴方自身よりずっと」
「……当たり前だろ。
妹を大事に思わない兄貴なんていない」
「わたしたち、戦うことになるかもしれませんね」
「………」
　言葉がない。
　……ほんとうに、まいる。
　先輩は、言いたくない事でもはっきり口にするから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I understand. Akiha is very important to you. Probably more than you yourself are.”
“Of course she is. What kind of brother would not cherish his sister?”
“We may end up fighting each other.”
“…”
I have no answer.
She really does leave me at a loss.
Ciel says things plainly, even when she would rather not say them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I understand.
Akiha-san is a very important person to you.
Probably more important than yourself."
"…… Of course.
A little sister is always important to her brother."
"We might end up fighting each other."
"……"
There's nothing to say.
…… I'm completely defeated.
Senpai clearly states things I don't want to say.

entries.japanese:
……校門にきた。
　先輩の中では結論が出たのか、もう何一つとして話してはくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach the school gate.
Perhaps she has already reached her conclusion, because she says nothing more.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… We reach the school gates.
Senpai seems to have reached a conclusion, as she doesn't say anything.

entries.japanese:
「―――これから遠野くんがどうするかは聞きません。
わたしたち、ここでお別れですから」
　感情のない目をして、先輩は片手をさしだした。
「………………」
　言葉もなく、その手を握り返す。
　ほんの少しの間だけ。
　俺と先輩は、虚ろな握手をかわした。
　さよなら、とだけ告げて、先輩は去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I will not ask what you intend to do now. We part here.”
Her eyes empty of emotion, she offers me one hand.
“…”
I take it without a word.
Only for a moment.
Ciel and I share a hollow handshake.
She says only goodbye, then walks away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I won't ask what you'll do now.
We'll part here."
Her eyes emotionless, Senpai extends a hand.
"………………"
Saying nothing, I take her hand.
For only a brief moment.
Senpai and I exchange a hollow handshake.
With just a goodbye, Senpai departs.

entries.japanese:
……秋葉の待つ屋敷に帰る。
　先輩との会話で、俺の見ていたものは夢とわかった。
　けど、根本的な問題が解決してくれたわけじゃない。
　吸血鬼――夜な夜な人を殺していくモノの正体。
　それが本当に秋葉だとしたら、俺は何ができて、何をするべきなのか。
「くっ…………！」
　わからない。
　ただ悔しくて、唇をかみ締める事しかできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to the estate where Akiha is waiting.
My conversation with Ciel established that what I saw was a dream.
But it did nothing to solve the fundamental problem.
A vampire――the true identity of the thing that kills people night after night.
If it really is Akiha, what can I do, and what should I do?
“Damn it…!”
I do not know.
All I can do is bite my lip in helpless frustration.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I return to the mansion where Akiha awaits.
I know from the conversation with Senpai that what I see are just dreams.
But, the fundamental problem is still unsolved.
The vampire--the truth, that thing which kills people every night.
If it's really Akiha, what can I do?
What should I do?
"Kuh…!"
I don't know.
Regretfully, all I can do is bite on my lip.

entries.japanese:
「―――だめ、だ」
　行くことはできない。
　俺に残った、数少ない確かなもの。
　学生である自分、先輩であるシエルという人を失う事はできない。
「―――――――」
　これが一時しのぎの逃げであることは解っている。
　それでも―――俺は、最後に残っている平穏な日常を失いたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No, I cannot.”
I cannot go.
So few certainties remain to me.
I cannot lose my life as a student, or Ciel as the upperclassman I know.
“―――――――”
I know this is only a temporary escape.
Even so―――I do not want to surrender the last peaceful corner of my ordinary life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I can't."
I can't go.
The few remaining things I can be certain about.
My life at school, Ciel as my Senpai… I can't lose them.
"--------"
I know this can't last forever.
But still----I don't want to lose my peaceful life I have left.

entries.japanese:
――――夜になった。
　先輩との約束の時間は過ぎ、俺は今夜もあの夢を見ようとしている。
「……………」
　いや、それは違う。
　先輩の力を借りるまでもない。
これが俺自身の問題であるのなら、俺の力だけで解決する。
　明日から今まで通りの生活を送れるように、自分自身で“殺人鬼”と決着をつけてやる―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Night fell.
The time I promised to meet Ciel has passed, and once again I am about to enter that dream.
“……………”
No.
That is not right. I do not need her help; if this is my problem, I will solve it myself.
I will settle matters with the ‘murderer’ on my own, so tomorrow I can return to the life I had before―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Night.
The time I promised to meet Senpai has already passed and I will watch that dream tonight once more.
"…………"
No, that's not right.
I won't rely on Senpai's help.
This is my problem, so I will solve it myself.
In order to keep living the way I have until now, I will have to settle matters with this "killer" myself----

entries.japanese:
自分が殺人鬼なのかどうかを証明する方法。
　……そんなもの、考えるまでもない。
　単に夜の街を探し回って、俺じゃない別の殺人鬼を見つけ出せばいいだけの話なんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
A way to prove whether I am the murderer.
There is no need to think about it.
All I have to do is search the city at night and find another killer, someone other than me―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
To prove that I am a killer or not.
…… I don't even have to think about it.
I just have to look around the town at night and find the killer which isn't me------

entries.japanese:
は――――ぁ、と息を吐いた。
―――――夜の街を歩きまわる。
　ポケットに手をいれて、その中に隠したナイフの硬さを指先に感じながら、夜の街を歩きまわる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I breathe out――――slowly.
―――――I wander through the city at night.
With one hand in my pocket, my fingertips resting against the hard knife concealed there, I wander through the city at night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let out a breath.
------I walk around the night-shrouded town.

I put a hands in my pocket, feeling the knife in there on my fingertips as I walk around town.

entries.japanese:
はぁ―――はぁ。
――――息を潜めて歩きまわる。
　出来るだけ目立たないように。
　物陰から、周囲の人間たちの視界から隠れるように、通り過ぎていく人々を観察していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah.
――――I move with my breath held.
As inconspicuously as possible.
From the shadows, hidden from the eyes around me, I watch the people passing by.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*-----*pant*
-------I breathe quietly as I walk around.
Trying not to draw attention.
I look at the people passing by as I stand concealing my presence from everyone.

entries.japanese:
はぁ―――はぁ、はあ。
――――殺人鬼を、探している。
　今夜もきっと襲われるだろう、新しい被害者を探している。
　たとえば、長い黒髪の女。
　年齢は自分と同い年ぐらいが一番好ましい。
　手足の美しさはもとより、首筋の優雅さを評価すべきだ。
　全ては結局、その一点に収束する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah, hah.
――――I am looking for the murderer.
Looking for the next victim, the one who will surely be attacked tonight.
A woman, perhaps, with long black hair.
Someone my own age would be ideal.
Beautiful arms and legs matter, naturally, but the grace of her throat deserves the closest appraisal.
Everything comes down to that one point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*------*pant*, *pant*.
--------I am searching for the killer.
Someone will get attacked tonight.
He is looking for a new victim.
Say, a girl with long, black hair.
A girl around my age would be best.
No need to mention the beauty of her hands and feet, but the beauty of her neck should be considered.
In the end, everything counts on that one spot.

entries.japanese:
は―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
――――殺人鬼を探している。
　……すぐに見つかるとは思っていない。
　理想の獲物が簡単に見つかるものではないのは、夢の中で何度も味わっていたからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah―――hah, hah, hah.
――――I am looking for the murderer.
I do not expect to find one at once.
My dreams have taught me again and again that ideal prey does not present itself so easily.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*p-pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
--------I look for the killer.
…… I know I won't find him easily.
I knew from my dreams that the perfect prey is hard to find.

entries.japanese:
ハァ……ハァ……ハァ
　に、して、も。
　今夜の街は、退屈だ。
　エモノが見つからない。
　頭にくる。
目的は、たしか。
誰かを見つけるコトとか、誰かを排除するコト、だったっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
HAH, HAH, HAH
Even so.
The city is boring tonight.
No prey.
It makes me furious. My purpose, I think. To find someone or eliminate someone; was that it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
B… u… t
Tonight, this town bores me.
I cannot find my PREY.
I'm getting angry.
My objective was to find someone, or to kill someone, or something like that.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ハ」
　息を殺そう。
　ナイフはずっと握り締めておく。
　いつでも、コロシカエセルように、神経を研ぎ澄ませていなければなるまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Hah.”
Keep the breath silent.
Keep the knife clenched tight.
Hone every nerve so I can KILL IT BACK at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------Ha."
I'll hold my breath.
I'll hold on to my knife.
I should concentrate, so I will be able to return death at any time.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ。
―――サツジンキを、探している。
　だが見つからない。
　ただ時間だけが過ぎていく。
　はぁ、はぁ、と。
　膨張し、研ぎ澄まされ、消耗し、摩耗し尽くし、いずれはササクレだち、変形し――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah.
―――I am looking for THE KILLER.
But I cannot find the killer.
Only time passes.
Hah, hah.
Swelling, sharpening, exhausting itself, wearing itself away until it frays and warps――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I pant more and more.
---I look for the KILLER.
But I can't find him.
Only time passes.
*pant*, *pant*.
It overflows, sharpens, is used, is used up, and over time stands up, and changes form and-------

entries.japanese:
目の前に、今夜のエモノが転がっていた。
「はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ」
　女の死体だ。
　オレの手にはナイフがあって、ぼたり、ぼたり、と赤い血を滴らせている。
――――なぜだろう。
　サツジンキを探していたハズなのに、いつのまにか、オレの目の前には真新しい女の死体が転がっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tonight’s prey lay sprawled before me.
“Hah, hah, hah, hah.”
A woman’s corpse.
In my hand, a knife drips red blood, drop by drop.
――――Why?
I was looking for the killer; yet somehow a fresh woman’s corpse lies at my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In front of me lies tonight's prey.
My panting fills the air.
It is a dead woman's corpse.
In my hand is a knife.
The red blood on my knife drips to the ground.
--------Why?
I was looking for the killer, but all of a sudden, there's the dead body of a woman right in front of me.

entries.japanese:
はあ、はあ、はあ、はあ。
　呼吸が乱れる。
　目の前には死体。
　俺の手には、血に染まったナイフ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah.
My breathing will not steady.
A corpse before me.
A bloodstained knife in my hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
My breathing gets out of control.
A dead body in front of me.
A bloody knife in my hand.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――――I do not understand.
entries.mirrorMoon: --------------I don't understand.

entries.japanese:
いつ、どんな隙間に、何をしたのか。
　俺の神経は、どうかしてしまったのか。
　そう、たとえば。
　膨張し、研ぎ澄まされ、消耗し、摩耗し尽くし、いずれはササクレだち、変形し、意味を変え、自在となり、炸裂し、閃光する。
　その過程。
　意識と意義の進化論。
　だが重大な過程が失われている。
entries.maoEnglish:
When had it happened?
In what missing instant had I done it?
Had my nerves gone wrong?
Imagine it: swelling, sharpening, exhausting itself, wearing itself away until it frays, warps, changes meaning, becomes fluid, bursts, flashes.
A process.
The evolution of consciousness and meaning.
But one crucial stage was missing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When, at what time, what I did.
Did something happen to my mind?
Yes, like…
it overflows, sharpens, is used, is used up, and over time stands up, and changes form, changes its meaning, becomes free, explodes, and lightens up.
On that path.
The theory of evolving consciousness and meaning.
But an important path is missing.

entries.japanese:
俺は。
　いつから。
　オレに。
　成っていたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I…
When had I…
become…
ME?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since when.
Did I.
Turn into.
The other "me"?

entries.japanese:
―――――なんだ。
　オレがゆさぶる必要もなかったな、志貴。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Well, look at that.
Guess I never needed to rattle you after all, Shiki.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---------I see.
There was no need for me to give you a push, Shiki.

entries.japanese:
背後で。
　そんな、声がした。
「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、はぁ」
　振り返る。
　そこには。
　初めて見る、自分と似たような顔をした、誰かが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Behind me.
A voice speaks.
“Hah, hah, hah, hah.”
I turn.
There.
Someone I have never seen stands there, wearing a face much like mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
From behind me,
that voice sounds out.
Heavy breathing.
I turn around.
There.
Someone I have never seen before, yet someone who looks like me, stands there.

entries.japanese:
―――壊れちまったのなら仕方がないか。
　　　あばよ志貴。
もう少し、おまえで楽しみたかったんだけどな。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――If you’re already broken, there’s no helping it.
See you, Shiki. I’d hoped to enjoy you a little longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------It can't be helped if you're already broken.
Bye, Shiki.
I wanted to play around with you for a bit longer.

entries.japanese:
ざっ、と墨を引くように、ナイフで切り裂かれた。
　イタイ。
　ユカイ。
　フカイ。
　ツーカイ。
!w1000
entries.maoEnglish:
The knife sweeps across me like a stroke of black ink.
PAIN.
THRILL.
CHILL.
SHEER THRILL.!w1000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Slash.
I'm cut with a knife.
It hurts.
It's funny.
It's deep.
It's great!

entries.japanese:
「は―――はは、は」
　意識が遠のく。
　そのまま、あいまいな意識のまま、俺は殺された。
　……なんとなく、嬉しい。
　遠野志貴はサツジンキに殺された。
　それはつまり、自分が、殺人鬼ではなかったという事を証明していたからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha―――ha ha, ha.”
Consciousness recedes.
In the haze, I am killed.
Somehow, I am glad.
Shiki Tohno is killed by THE KILLER.
That proves I am not the murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha------haha, ha."
I start to pass out.
Like that, in that ambiguous state, I was killed.
…… I'm happy, in a way.
Tohno Shiki was killed by the killer.
That's proof that I wasn't the killer.

entries.japanese:
はぁ　はぁ　はぁ。
　うまく呼吸ができない。
　俺の生き死にになんら興味がなさそうな先輩の目。
　ピタリと心臓の前で停止した短刀。
　一秒後には確実に殺されてしまう状態。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah.
I can’t breathe properly.
Her eyes show no interest at all in whether I live or die.
Her dagger has stopped dead in front of my heart.
One second from now, I will certainly be killed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant*
I can't breathe properly.
Senpai's eyes don't even appear interested in my death.
Her dagger is poised directly in front of my heart.
A situation where I'm a second away from being killed.

entries.japanese:
はぁ　はぁ　はあ　はあ
「おかしいですね。
もう何人も殺してきたクセに、自分が殺されるのは恐いっていうんですか」
　嫌悪に似た声。
　侮蔑するような目のカタチ。
　今にも俺を殺そうとする、彼女の短刀。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah
“How strange. You’ve killed so many people, yet you’re afraid when it’s your turn to die?”
Disgust in her voice.
Contempt in the shape of her eyes.
Her dagger, poised to kill me at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*
"That's odd.
You've killed so many people, yet you are frightened to die yourself."
Her voice, tinged with disgust.
Her eyes, rimmed with contempt.
Her dagger, ready to kill me.

殺される。

I will be killed.
I will be killed.

killed.

kill.

entries.mirrorMoon:

entries.japanese:
「―――――は――――は、あ」
　息が。
「さよなら。

　うまく。
「―――はは―――ぁ―――は、は―――――」
　できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Hah――――hah, ah.”
My breath.
“Goodbye. Die here, Tohno.”
Properly.
“―――Hah―――ah―――hah, ha―――――”
It will not work.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ha------ha, ah."
I.
"Goodbye.
Please die here, Tohno-kun."
Can hardly.
"----Haha----a----ha, ha----"
Breathe.

entries.japanese:
ソレは、こっちのほうが、早かった。
　先輩の短刀が深く刺さるより前に、俺のナイフは先輩の首に視えていた『線』を通っていた。
「ぁ―――――――」
　声はどちらのものだったか。
　どさり、と首が落ちる音がして、ダボダボとだらしのない音。
オトがして、クビ、「首」
、／あたま？
／が転がり、転がり、転がり、転がり。
entries.maoEnglish:
IT—mine—was faster.
Before her dagger could sink deep into me, my knife had already passed through the ‘line’ I saw across her throat.
“Ah―――――――”
Whose voice was that?
A heavy thump as the neck fell, followed by a loose, sloshing sound. A SOUND, and the NECK, the “neck,” /the head?/ rolled and rolled and rolled and rolled.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, I was faster.
Before she can plunge her dagger deeply into me, my knife runs through the 'line' on Senpai's neck.
"A--------"
Which one of us said that?
The sound of a head hitting the ground and the sound of gurgling.
The neck, "neck", / face?
/ it rolls, rolls, rolls, rolls.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――え？」
　だが、それはおかしい。
　どう考えても、同時だったハズ。
俺、オれだけ生き残っていて、先輩の首、クビ、だけが、こんな、コロコロと転がっていくなんていうのは、おかしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――what?”
But something is wrong.
They should have struck at the same time. It makes no sense that I—mE alone—am alive while only Ciel’s neck, her NECK, goes rolling away like a ball.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------eh?"
But, that's strange.

It had to have been the same time.
But only I am alive.
Senpai's head, HEAD, is the only thing rolling and rolling and rolling.

entries.japanese:
「はは――――あ」
　つまり、それは。
　先輩は、初めから。
　オれを殺す気なんか、なかったっていう、コトじゃない、のか。
「ぁ、はぁ、ぁ、はぁはぁはぁはぁ、はは」
　喉がうまく繰れない。

　廊下はビシャビシャと塗れていく。
　赤いペンキがビシャビシャと濡れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah.”
Which means.
From the very beginning.
She never intended to kill mE, did she?
“Ah, hah, ah, hah-hah-hah-hah, ha.”
My throat won’t work properly.
Her body is so very red.
The corridor turns slick, painted in it.
Red paint, wet and splashing everywhere.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha----a!"
In other words.
From the very beginning,
Senpai never… intended… to kill me.
"A, haa, a, haahaahaahaa, haha!"
My throat seems stuck.
Senpai's body is so red.
The hallway gets wet.

Red paint coats everything.

entries.japanese:
「はは―――――」
　首の取れた人間というのは、その時点で違う機能を備えるらしい。
　びしゃびしゃと。
　スプリンクラーのように、赤い液体を蒔き散らしていく。
「は、はは―――――は」
　全身真っ赤になった。
　ナイフはもとより、髪から靴下まで赤い斑模様になって、気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――”
Apparently, once a person loses their head, the body acquires a new function.
Splash, splash.
It scatters red liquid like a sprinkler.
“Ha, hah―――――hah.”
I am red from head to toe.
The knife, my hair, even my socks are mottled red, and it is disgusting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haha----"
Once someone is decapitated, it seems they add a different function.
Spurting.
Like a sprinkler, spraying red blood everywhere.
"Ha, haha------ha."
My whole body is now crimson.
More than my knife, from my hair to my shoes, it's sickeningly speckled red.

entries.japanese:
「―――なんだ。
大したこと、ないじゃないか」
　ああ、本当にどうというコトはない。
　もっとこう、色々なものがあると思ったのに、あるのはただ浮いているような感覚だけだ。
「これじゃあさ。
夢のほうが、よっぽど」
　生々しくて、リアル、だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Huh. That was nothing.”
It truly is nothing at all.
I thought there would be so much more, but all I feel is a strange lightness, as though I were floating.
“Compared with this. The dream was far more”
Raw and real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----What's this?
This isn't a big deal."
Yeah, it really not a big deal.
I thought there would be something more, but I only have this floating feeling.
"If it's like this… my dreams were more…"
Lively and real.

entries.japanese:
立ち上がって歩き出す。
　べちゃり、と足音。
　目の前にはシエルという女の頭が転がっていて、その目が、おレを睨んでいるように見えた。
「バカだな先輩。
どんな自信があったかは知らないけど、死なないモノなんてないんだ」
　だから、それが貴方の間違いだ。
　間違い。
　間違い。
　間違い。
　間違い。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　いや。
entries.maoEnglish:
I rise and begin walking.
Squelch.
The head of a woman named Ciel lies before me, and its eyes seem to glare at mE.
“You were an idiot. I don’t know what made you so confident, but nothing exists that cannot die.”
That was your mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
No.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I stand up and start walking.
My feet splash with each step.
Before me lays the head of the woman named Ciel.
Her eyes seem to stare at me.
"How stupid, Senpai.
I don't know how much confidence you had, but there's nothing that can't die."
So, it was your mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
Mistake.
No.

entries.japanese: 間違いといったら、そんなのは全てにか。
entries.maoEnglish: If we’re talking about mistakes, wasn’t everything a mistake?
entries.mirrorMoon: What's mistaken is everything.

entries.japanese:
幻想は終わり。
　今まで必死に否定していたコトも、これではっきりと肯定された。
　おレはただの人殺しで。
　自分の手で、壊してはいけないものを壊して、おレの基盤もドロのように流れていった。
「くっ―――なんだよ弓塚。
みんな、おまえの言ったとおりじゃないか」
　笑いがこみあげる。
　どうかしてしまったらしい。
　おレは、自分が人殺しにすぎないのだという事実が、例えようもなく愉しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
The illusion is over.
Everything I had fought so desperately to deny has now been proved true.
mE, nothing but a murderer.
With mY own hands I broke what must never be broken, and the ground beneath mE dissolved and ran away like mud.
“Damn it―――Yumizuka. Everything was exactly the way you said.”
Laughter wells up inside me.
Something in me must have broken.
The knowledge that mE is nothing more than a murderer is more delightful than words can say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The illusion is over.
Even though I desperately denied it until now, this confirms it.
I am just a killer.
With my own hands, I destroyed what shouldn't have been destroyed.
The foundations of my being are crumbling away.
"Kk----what's this, Yumizuka?
It's just like you said."
I start to laugh.
It seems I have gone insane.
The truth that I am the killer seems so funny to me.

entries.japanese:
窓の外には遠く遠く月が冴え。
　視界は朱に統一され還元する兆候もなく。
　地球製だった思考回路はおかしな異星の回路にすげかわり。
　十何年間も蓄えた観念は羅列する数字と極めて未知の方程式へと進化進化。
　そこには共通する色彩さえなく、キミが見ている朱とワレの見ている朱は判別できまい。
　嗚呼。
　つまり、オレは壊れたらしい。
#ff0000
　それとも全てははじめから愉快な嘘ですか。
　それならどうぞ、明日には消えてください。
entries.maoEnglish:
Far beyond the window, the moon burns cold and clear.
My vision is reduced to scarlet, with no sign it will ever return.
The circuitry once made on Earth has been replaced with the wiring of some bizarre alien world.
Every notion accumulated across my dozen-odd years evolves evolves into strings of numbers and utterly unknown equations.
Not even our colors are held in common; you could never distinguish the scarlet YOU see from the scarlet WE see.
Ah.
In other words, ME seems to have broken.
Or was everything a delightful lie from the very beginning?
If so, please let it all disappear by tomorrow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Outside the window, the far, distant moon shines.
My vision has turned red with no signs of returning normal.
But my mind on earth has been swapped with that from some other planet.
The years of accumulated perceptions exceedingly enumerate towards unknown equations of evolution.
Nothing is even remotely the same.
You can not tell the difference between the crimson you see and the crimson I see.
Alas.
It seems I am broken.
#ff0000
Or was everything just a humorous lie from the beginning?
In that case, please let it all disappear tomorrow.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff
　……昏い森で舞台が始まる。
　よく解らないけれど、殺人鬼なら殺人鬼らしいことをしないといけないのです。
　とりあえずは街に出て、夢の続きを行いましょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
#ffffff

The curtain rises in a dark forest.
I do not quite understand, but if I am a murderer, I must do what murderers do.
For now, let us go into town and continue the dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff
…… The stage set in the dark forest begins.
I don't quite understand, but if I am a killer, I must act like a killer.
To begin with, let's go out into town and continue my dreams.

entries.japanese:
どうでもいい誰かを捕まえる。
　路地裏に連れこんで、じっと目を覚ましてくれるのを待つ。
　しばらくして、誰かはうっすらと目を開ける。
　出来るだけ優しく、両手を広げて歓迎しよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I catch someone who does not matter.
I drag them into an alley and wait patiently for them to awaken.
After a while, they slowly open their eyes.
Let us spread our arms and welcome them as gently as we can.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I catch a random person.
I take them to the alley and wait for the person to awaken.
After a while, the person's eyes open.
As gently as possible, I offer a welcome with both arms spread wide.

entries.japanese:
――――さあ。
　　　　ようこそ、この素晴らしき惨殺空間へ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Now then.
Welcome to this splendid realm of slaughter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Now then,
welcome to this wonderful killing chamber.

entries.japanese:
メルシー！
　はい、ついに四時間目です。
　理不尽なデッドエンドを迎えてしまった恵まれない遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
entries.maoEnglish:
Merci!
At last, lesson four.
Welcome to Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for poor downtrodden Tohno,
who has suffered a most unreasonable dead end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Merci!
We're finally in the fourth period.
The hint corner for Tohno-kun, who has unluckily ended up in this unjust Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"

entries.japanese:
「いいなー、シエルは色々出番があって。
わたしなんて正ヒロインなのにこの扱いだラクガキ」
　はいそこ、ヘンな語尾をつけない。
　いいじゃないですか、私みたいになんでも屋にされるよりは貫禄があって。
「やだー、ふまんー！
　わたしもシエルみたいな格好して、あたまいいって言われるわよー！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel is lucky to get so many different scenes. I’m the main heroine, and this is how they treat me, scribble.”
You there, stop adding strange words to the ends of your sentences.
Besides, isn’t it more dignified than being made into a general-purpose errand girl like me?
“No, it’s unfair! I’ll dress like Ciel too, and then everyone will say I look smart!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I envy you, Ciel.
You get a lot of appearances.
I'm the main heroine, but they still treat me like this scribble."
Hey you, don't say weird things.
That's fine.
At least you have more dignity than me, the do-it-all character.
"No!!
Unsatisfactory!
I want to dress like you and be called smart!!"

entries.japanese:
…………。
「出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
「出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　シエルめがね！
　出番ない！
　シエルない！
　出番ない！
　シエルメガネ！
　出番ない！
　シエル地味！
　シエル降板！
　メガネシエル！
　エセフランス！
　鉄砲フェチ！
　シエルインド！」
　…………（むか）
entries.maoEnglish:
…
“No screen time! No screen time! No screen time!”
“No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! Four-eyes Ciel! No screen time! Ciel gone! No screen time! Four-eyes Ciel! No screen time! Boring Ciel! Ciel canceled! Glasses Ciel! Fake Frenchwoman! Gun fetishist! Indian Ciel!”
(vein throbs)
entries.mirrorMoon:
…………
No appearance!
No appearance!
No appearance!
"No appearance!
No appearance!
No appearance!
No appearance!
No appearance!
Ciel-glasses!
No appearance!
No Ciel!
No appearance!
Ciel-glasses!
No appearance!
Ciel-too plain!
Ciel-get out!
Ciel-glasses!
Fake-Frenchie!
Gun-fetish!
Ciel-India!"
………… (Anger)

entries.japanese:
「きゅううぅぅぅぅ………………」
――――さて、それではレクチャーです。
　今回の死因ははっきりしていますね。
　自分一人の手で解決しよう！
　という意気込みは立派ですけど、この事件は遠野くん一人で解決できる物ではありません。
　何かを得るためには何かを失うのが世の常。
　先生も悲しいですが、ここは一度だけシエルさんと決別するべきでしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kyuuuu…”
――――Now, for the lesson.
The cause of death is obvious this time.
Your determination to solve everything yourself—wonderful! But this incident is beyond Tohno’s power alone.
In this world, gaining one thing always means losing another.
It pains me too, but this once, you should part ways with Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kyuuuuuuuuu………………"
----Well, let's start the lecture.
The cause of death is clear this time.
Your eagerness to try and solve this incident by yourself is splendid, but this is something you cannot solve by yourself.
It's the way of the world to lose something to obtain something.
It's also sad for me, but you should part with Ciel-san just this once.

entries.japanese:
……はい、三日目のお昼休みです。
　いつもならお昼ご飯を食べに外出しているんですけど、今回はさすがに、ちょっと……。
「首ちょんぱだもんねー。
食べても胃までいかないにゃ。
志貴もやることエグイけど、シエルは自業自得なんじゃない？」
　あはは、やかましいです。
　まったく出番のない人よりはマシですよーだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, it’s lunchtime on day three.
Normally I’d go out for lunch, but under the present circumstances, that would be a little…
“Your head did get chopped off. Even if you ate, the food wouldn’t reach your stomach, meow. What Shiki did was gruesome, but didn’t you bring it on yourself, Ciel?”
Ha ha, do be quiet.
At least I’m better off than someone who never appears at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It's now time for lunch during our third day.
I usually go outside to get lunch, but this time, I don't feel like doing so……
"You got your head cut off.
Even if you eat, it won't get to your stomach.
Shiki does some nasty things, but isn't it your own fault, Ciel?"
Hahaha, shut up.
It's better than not even appearing.

entries.japanese:
「うっ、言われてみればそのとおりー！
　どうしてここまで出番がないのよ、ばかー！」
　日頃の行いでしょうけど、今回は貴女にかまっている余裕はありません。
　遠野くん。
　さっさと一個前に戻って、もっと遠野くんらしい選択をしてください。
　このままじゃわたしも遠野くんもうかばれません！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oof, now that you mention it, you’re right! Why have I gone this long without a single scene, you idiots?!”
That may be the fruit of your usual conduct, but I have no time to indulge you today.
Tohno.
Go back one choice at once and make a decision more worthy of you.
At this rate, neither you nor I will ever rest in peace!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh.
You're right!!
Why don't I get to appear?
It's stupid!"
I bet it's your karma, but I have no time to play with you right now.
Tohno-kun.
Please go back to the previous choice and choose the selection that's more in tune with your character.
With things like the way they are now, neither I nor Tohno-kun will be saved!

entries.japanese:
……あれは、もう何年前のことだろう。
　ここにやってきて、ずっと部屋に閉じこもっていたあと。
　使用人の女の子と仲良くなって、ようやく外で遊ぶようになったあとだったろうか。
―――ごめんなさい、兄さん。
　誰もいない庭で、あきははとうとつに泣き始めた。
　何を謝っているのか問いただしても、秋葉はただごめんなさいと繰り返すだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
How many years ago was that?
It happened after I first came here and spent so long shut away in my room.
Perhaps it was after I befriended the servant girl and finally began playing outside.
―――I’m sorry, Brother.
In the empty garden, Akiha suddenly began to cry.
No matter how often I asked what she was apologizing for, all she did was repeat that she was sorry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It was years and years ago.
I came here, after having shut myself up in my room for so long.
Probably after I had become friends with one of the servant girls, and was coming out to play at last.
---I'm sorry, Nii-san.
In the empty courtyard, Akiha suddenly started to cry.
Even when I asked what she was apologizing for, she just kept apologizing.

entries.japanese:
―――わたしたちが、兄さんからみんなうばってしまったから。
　秋葉の泣いている理由は、そのときの自分にはもう終わってしまった出来事にすぎなかった。
　……恨んでいないといえば嘘になる。
　けど、それはまだ六歳ぐらいの女の子が責任を感じて、必死に謝ってくるような事ではないはずだ。
　第一、 秋葉は何も悪くはなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Because we took everything away from you.
By then, whatever had made Akiha cry was already over and done with as far as I was concerned.
It would be a lie to say I felt no resentment.
But it was not something a little girl of six should feel responsible for, much less apologize so desperately over. Akiha had done nothing wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Because we stole everything from you, Nii-san.
The reason why Akiha is crying is something that has already ended for me in the past.

…… It would be a lie to say I didn't hold a grudge.
But, a six year old girl can't feel responsible for that, and it can't be something she would apologize so desperately for.
In the first place, she didn't do anything wrong.

entries.japanese:
―――ごめんなさい。
ごめんなさい、兄さん。
　……どうして気がつかなかったんだろう。
　秋葉は初めて会った時から、いつも俺に謝っていた。
　この広い屋敷の中で、ただ一人自分のために泣いてくれた少女。
―――ありがとう。
けど、もういいんだ。
　笑って、秋葉の頭をなでた。
　秋葉はきょとんとした顔でこっちを見上げる。
　その時に、初めて、強く思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I’m sorry. I’m so sorry, Brother.
How had I never noticed?
From the first day we met, Akiha had always been apologizing to me.
In that vast estate, she was the only girl who cried for my sake.
―――Thank you. But it’s all right now.
I smiled and stroked Akiha’s hair.
She stared up at me, bewildered.
And for the first time, I felt it with all my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'm sorry.
I'm sorry, Nii-san.
…… Why didn't I notice?
From the very first time I met Akiha, she was always apologizing to me.
In this big mansion, the only one who cried for me.
---Thank you.
But, that's enough.
Smiling, I stroked Akiha's head.
Akiha looked up at me, bewildered.
Then, for the first time, I felt strongly…

entries.japanese:
―――泣かなくていいよ、あきは。
　これからは、ボクらは兄妹なんだから。
　……嬉しそうに笑った秋葉の顔を覚えている。
　その時に誓った。
　本当の家族になると。
　自分はお兄ちゃんなんだから、どんなことがあっても秋葉を守ると誓った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――You don’t have to cry, Akiha.
From now on, you and I are brother and sister.
I remember the joy in Akiha’s smile.
That was when I swore we would become a true family.
I was her big brother.
Whatever happened, I would protect her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---You don't have to cry, Akiha.
From now on, we're brother and sister.
…… I remember Akiha's face laughing happily.
I made a promise then.
We would be a real family.
Since I was the elder brother, I would protect Akiha, whatever happened.

entries.japanese:
そんな思いを。
　夢見るように、抱き続けた頃が、あった。
entries.maoEnglish:
That resolve.
There was a time when I cherished it like a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Such thoughts.
I had a time where I held on to those thoughts as if I was dreaming.

entries.japanese:
「ん…………」
　朝の光で目が覚めた。
　自分が殺人鬼ではないとはっきり解ったおかげか、昨夜は殺人の夢は見なかった。
「……けど、なんか……」
　懐かしい夢を見たような気がする。
　まだ俺も秋葉も幼くて、自分たちがどんな関係なのか解っていなかったころの夢―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm…”
Morning light wakes me.
Perhaps because I finally know I’m not a murderer, I had no dreams of killing last night.
“But something…”
I have the feeling I dreamed of something long ago.
From when Akiha and I were still children and did not understand what we were to each other―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn…"
I awake to the morning light.
Knowing for sure that I am not the killer, I had no dreams of murder last night.
"…… But, there was something…"
I feel like I had a nostalgic dream.
When Akiha and I were still young, a dream from before we knew what we were to each other…

entries.japanese:
「失礼します。
お目覚めでしょうか、志貴さま」
「ああ、おはよう翡翠。
今朝も早いね」
　翡翠はおじぎをして入ってくる。
　いつも通り、着替えの学生服を置いておはようございますと挨拶をしてきてくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Pardon me. Are you awake, Master Shiki?”
“Morning, Hisui. You’re up early again.”
Hisui bows as she enters.
As always, she lays out my school uniform and wishes me good morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me.
It is time to get up, Shiki-sama."
"Yeah, morning, Hisui.
You're early again this morning."
Hisui bows and enters.
As always, she places down a fresh school uniform and bids me good morning.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、昨夜はいつの間に戻られたのですか？
　秋葉さまが居間でお待ちしていたのですが」
「…………ああ、昨日は疲れててさ。
秋葉が居間にいるっていうのは解ってたんだけど、そのまま自分の部屋に戻ったんだ」
　そう答えて、自分に対する嫌悪感で気が滅入った。
　……昨日の夜。
　シエル先輩と別れた後、屋敷に戻ってきた俺は秋葉から逃げるように自分の部屋に戻ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“When did you return last night, Master Shiki? Miss Akiha was waiting for you in the sitting room.”
“Oh, I was tired yesterday. I knew Akiha was there, but I went straight back to my room.”
The answer leaves me sick with self-loathing.
…Last night, after parting from Ciel,
I returned to the estate and went straight to my room to avoid Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, what time did you return last night?
Akiha-sama was waiting in the sitting room."
"…… Yeah, I was tired yesterday.
I knew Akiha was waiting in the sitting room, but I went straight to my room."
Answering, I feel depressed from self-loathing.
…… Last night.
After parting from Ciel-senpai, I returned to the mansion and went straight to my room to escape Akiha.

entries.japanese:
先輩には違うって連呼していたくせに、俺自身、秋葉に問いただすのが恐かった。
『おまえが吸血鬼なのか』なんて事を秋葉に聞けるわけがないし、もしその答えが最悪なものだったら、どうしていいか分からない。
　そんな事を思っている以上、秋葉と顔を合わせてまともに会話ができるはずがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
For all my frantic insistence that Ciel was wrong, I was too afraid to confront Akiha myself.
I could never ask her outright whether she was the vampire; if her answer was the worst possible one, I would have no idea what to do.
With thoughts like that in my head, there was no chance I could face her and carry on a normal conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Although I denied it to Senpai, I was afraid to ask Akiha.
I can't just ask Akiha, "Are you a vampire?" If the answer was the worst possible, I wouldn't know what to do.
Thinking about that sort of thing, I can't face her, and I can't talk to her.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
秋葉はもう居間にいるのか？」
「はい、先ほどから志貴さまをお待ちになってらっしゃいます」
「……そうか。
まいったな、それは」
　今は、あいつと二人きりで今まで通りに過ごせる自信がない。
何気ない挨拶でさえうまくできないような気がする。
「翡翠、悪いんだけど今日は一緒にいてくれないか。
うちを出るまででいいから、傍にいてほしい」
「――――――――」
　表情こそ変わらないものの、翡翠は息をのんで
俺を見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Is Akiha already in the sitting room?”
“Yes, Master Shiki; she has been waiting for you for some time.”
“I see. That is a problem.”
Right now, I have no confidence that I can be alone with her and behave as usual. Even an ordinary greeting feels beyond me.
“Hisui, could you stay with me today? Only until I leave the house; I would like you beside me.”
“――――――――”
Her expression does not change,
but Hisui catches her breath and stares at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui.
Is Akiha already in the sitting room?"
"Yes.
She has been waiting for you for some time."
"…… I see.
That's bad…"
Right now, I have no confidence that I can talk with her as I usually do.
I'm not sure I can manage even a casual greeting.
"Hisui.
Sorry, but could you stay with me today?
Until I leave, I'd like you by my side."
"--------"
Although her expression does not change, Hisui looks at me in shock.

entries.japanese:
「―――かしこまりました。
それでは、志貴さまがお出かけになられるまでご一緒させていただきます」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをして、翡翠は俺の頼みを聞き入れてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Certainly. I will remain with you until you depart, Master Shiki.”
She bows deeply, accepting my request.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I understand.
Then, I shall accompany you until you leave, Shiki-sama."
Bowing very deeply, Hisui grants my request.

entries.japanese:
居間には秋葉と琥珀さんが揃ってお茶を飲んでいた。
「やあ。
二人とも、おはよう」
　なんとか自然に挨拶をする。
「…………………」
　昨夜、秋葉のいた居間に顔をださず部屋に戻ってしまった事を怒っているのか、秋葉はこっちをチラリと見るだけで何も言わない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and Kohaku are having tea together in the sitting room.
“Hey. Good morning, you two.”
Somehow, I manage to make it sound natural.
“…”
Perhaps angry that I went straight to my room last night without speaking to her, Akiha merely glances at me and says nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the sitting room, Kohaku-san is drinking tea with Akiha.
"Ah, morning, both of you."
Somehow, I greet them naturally.
"………………"
Maybe she's mad at me for going straight to my room; Akiha glances only briefly at me, saying nothing.

entries.japanese:
「はい、おはようございます志貴さん。
めずらしいですね、翡翠ちゃんと一緒に来るなんて」
「……ん、今日は少し体調が悪くて付き添ってもらったんだ。
階段で眩暈でも起こしたら危ないからさ」
「へええ、それはそれは。
翡翠ちゃんったら頼りにされてるんですねー」
「……………」
　翡翠はやっぱり無言で俺の横にいてくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Shiki. How unusual to see you come down with Hisui.”
“I’m feeling a little unwell today, so I asked her to come with me. It would be dangerous if I got dizzy on the stairs.”
“My, my. He certainly relies on you, Hisui.”
“…”
As promised, Hisui remains silently at my side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-san.
It's unusual to see you together with Hisui-chan."
"…… Yeah, I don't feel great today, so I asked her to escort me.
It would be dangerous if I felt giddy on the stairs."
"Ehe~, I see.
Hisui-chan, you really are relied on."
"…………"
Of course, Hisui stands beside me silently.

entries.japanese:
「それでは朝食の支度をしてきますから、秋葉さまとお待ちになっていてくださいね」
　琥珀さんは厨房に向かっていった。
「………………」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　気まずい雰囲気のまま、ソファーに腰を下ろす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll go prepare breakfast, so please wait here with Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku heads for the kitchen.
“…”
Akiha says nothing.
I sit down on the sofa amid the awkward silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I'll go and prepare breakfast.
Please wait with Akiha-sama."
Kohaku-san goes into the kitchen.
"…………"
Akiha says nothing.
Feeling an unpleasant atmosphere, I sit down on the sofa.

entries.japanese:
……。
　…………。
　………………………。
　気まずい沈黙が居間を支配する。
entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………
An uncomfortable silence settles over the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
………………
An uneasy silence rules the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん」
「ん―――なんだよ、秋葉」
「体の具合が悪いって言ってましたけど、気分はいいんですか……？」
「いや、そう大した事じゃないから。
秋葉に心配してもらうほどの事じゃないよ」
「……そうですか。
それなら、別にいいんですけど」
　気まずそうに視線を逸らす秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother.”
“Mm―――what is it, Akiha?”
“You said you were not feeling well; are you all right…?”
“It’s nothing serious. Certainly nothing you need to worry about.”
“I see. Then I suppose it is fine.”
Akiha looks away, plainly uncomfortable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san."
"Nn---what is it, Akiha?"
"You said you're not feeling well; are you feeling alright…?"
"No, it's nothing major.
You don't need to worry about it."
"…… Really.
Well, then, that's good, but…"
Akiha looks away uneasily.

entries.japanese:
「……？」
　秋葉の態度は、どこかおかしい。
　昨夜のことを気にしているのは明白なんだけど、どうもいつもとは勝手が違う。
　秋葉のことだから『どうして声をかけてくれなかったの』ぐらいは言ってくるはずなのに、妙にそわそわしていて落ちつきがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…?”
Something is wrong with her.
Last night is clearly on her mind, but she is not acting like herself.
Normally, Akiha would at least demand to know why I had not spoken to her; instead, she keeps fidgeting, unable to settle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…?"
There's something strange about Akiha's attitude.
It's obvious she cares about last night, but she's different from usual.
Usually, she would at least say "Why didn't you tell me when you came home?" Instead, she looks incredibly nervous.

entries.japanese:
「その、秋葉？」
「えっと、兄さん？」
――――二人して、同時に声をかけたりする。
「あ、はい。
なんでしょうか、兄さん」
「いや、秋葉のほうこそなんなんだよ」
「………いえ、私はただ呼んでみただけなんだけど―――」
「………？」
　ますますワケがわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Akiha?”
“Um, Brother?”
――――We both speak at once.
“Oh, yes. What is it, Brother?”
“No, what were you going to say?”
“No, I only wanted to call your name―――”
“…”
Now I understand even less.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh, Akiha?"
"Ah, Nii-san?"
----The two of us speak simultaneously.
"Ah, yes.
What is it, Nii-san?"
"No, what were you going to say?"
"…… Nothing, I was just calling your name----"
"………?"
I get even more confused.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま、志貴さーん！
　朝ごはんの支度が出来ましたよー！」
　琥珀さんの声が食堂から聞こえてくる。
「だってさ。
行こうか、秋葉」
「―――はい、行きましょう兄さん」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha, Master Shiki! Breakfast is ready!”
Kohaku’s voice carries from the dining room.
“You heard her. Shall we go, Akiha?”
“―――Yes, let’s go, Brother.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama, Shiki-san!
Breakfast is ready…!"
Kohaku-san's voice comes from the dining room.
"Well, shall we go, Akiha?"
"---Yes, let's go, Nii-san."

entries.japanese:
なんだか今朝の秋葉はやけにしおらしい。
　……なんか、ますます自己嫌悪してしまう。
　さっきまで秋葉に会いづらい、なんて言っておきながら、こんな大人しい秋葉とならもう少し話していたかった、なんて思っているんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is strangely meek this morning.
That only makes me despise myself more.
Moments ago I was complaining that I could not face her, yet now I find myself wishing I could talk a little longer with this quieter Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Somehow, Akiha seems awfully meek this morning.
…… And now, I hate myself even more.
Before, I was thinking how difficult it would be to see Akiha, yet I'm thinking if she is this subdued, I want to talk with her more.

entries.japanese:
「それでは志貴さま、秋葉さま、行ってらっしゃませ」
　俺の言葉をきちんと守って、翡翠は正門まで付いてきてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have a pleasant day, Master Shiki, Miss Akiha.”
True to her word, Hisui accompanies us all the way to the front gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, Shiki-sama, Akiha-sama, have a good day."
Following my instructions precisely, Hisui follows us to the main gates.

entries.japanese:
「今日は土曜だから早めに帰ってくるよ。
……あ、でもここで待ってなくていいからな。
もしかするとそのまま遊びに行くかもしれないから、屋敷のほうでのんびり待っててくれ」
　かしこまりました、とおじぎをする翡翠に手をふって、屋敷の正門を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s Saturday, so I’ll be home early. But you don’t have to wait here. I might go out with friends afterward, so relax inside the estate until I return.”
Hisui bows her agreement, and I wave to her as I leave the estate grounds.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Since today's Saturday, I'll be back a little early… Ah, but you don't need to wait out here.
Since I may go to play for a bit, please wait in the mansion."
Affirming her consent, Hisui bows and we leave the gates of the mansion behind.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　さて。
問題はここから学校までの距離である。
「………………」
　となりにいる秋葉は黙ってついてくる。
　……その、黙っていてくれる分にはありがたいんだけど、それはそれで居心地が悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Now comes the real problem. The entire walk from here to school.
“…”
Akiha walks silently beside me.
I’m grateful she isn’t talking, but the silence is uncomfortable in its own way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Now.
The problem is the way from here to school.
"…………"
Akiha follows silently next to me.
……Although part of me is glad of the silence, it still feels uncomfortable.

entries.japanese:
学校に着いた。
　時間は七時半を過ぎたあたり。
　この時間、登校している生徒の数はごく少数だ。
「………………」
　秋葉はまだ黙っている。
　……さすがに朝からまったく言葉を交わしていないと気まずい。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach school.
It is a little after seven thirty.
Very few students arrive this early.
“…”
Akiha is still silent.
Going the whole morning without exchanging a single word is becoming unbearable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We arrive at school.
It is just past seven-thirty.
Only a small number of students arrive at this time.
"…………"
Akiha is still silent.
…… It would be really awkward if we didn't exchange a word all morning.

entries.japanese:
「……なあ、秋葉」
「あ―――は、はい。
なんですか、兄さん」
「なんですかって、その……なんだか今朝はおかしくないか、おまえ。
昨日の夜の事も怒らないし、ずっとぼんやりしてるみたいだし」
「え―――そう見えますか、私？」
「……ああ、見える。
もしかしてまだ気分が悪いのか？
　それならちゃん休んでないと―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey, Akiha.”
“Ah―――y-yes? What is it, Brother?”
“What do you mean? You have been acting strange all morning—you did not even get angry about last night, and you have seemed lost in thought the whole time.”
“Do I really seem that way―――?”
“Yes. Are you still feeling sick? If you are, you ought to stay home and rest properly―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey, Akiha."
"Ah… ah.
Yes, what is it, Nii-san?"
"What is it…?
You… you seem really odd this morning.
You're not even angry about last night and you seem really distant."
"Eh---does it seem that way?"
"…… Yeah, it does.
Are you still feeling bad?
If so, you should be resting---"

entries.japanese:
―――あ。
　ふと、気がついた。
　秋葉は昨日、学校を休んだ。
　昨日のシエル先輩は腕に包帯を巻いていて、吸血鬼とは痛み分けになったと言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Oh.
Suddenly, I realize it.
Akiha missed school yesterday.
Yesterday, Ciel’s arm was bandaged, and she told me her fight with the vampire had ended in a draw.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Ah.
Suddenly, I notice.
Akiha took the day off school yesterday.
Yesterday Ciel-senpai had bandages on her arm, and said she had a painful experience.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
「……あの。
兄さんのほうこそ、お顔の色が優れないようですけど」
「あ――――いや、それは」
　ぶんぶん、と頭をふってイヤな想像を振り払う。
　……どうかしている。
　秋葉は俺と同じように突発的な体の障害を持っているんだから、そりゃあ学校を休む時ぐらいいくらでもあるんだ。
　秋葉を信じなくちゃいけないのに、なにを不吉な想像をしてしまっているんだろう、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
“…Brother, you’re the one who looks pale.”
“Ah――――no, that is…”
I shake my head hard, trying to scatter the ugly suspicion.
What is wrong with me?
Akiha suffers sudden attacks of poor health just as I do; of course she sometimes misses school.
I should trust her, so why am I imagining something so terrible?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
"…… Um, Nii-san, you don't really look well either."
"Ah----no, that's…"
I shake my head, to throw off the unpleasant image.
…… There's something wrong.
Since Akiha suffers from the same frailties as I do, there's nothing strange about her taking a day off school.
I have to trust Akiha, so I can't let my imagination run away with me like that.

entries.japanese:
「俺のことはいいんだ。
それより本当にどうしたんだ。
今朝の秋葉はすごく女の子っぽくて、なんだか秋葉らしくないぞ」
「……。
今ものすごいことを言ってくれましたね、兄さん」
「おっ。
そうそう、少しは調子が戻ってきたな。
秋葉はやっぱりそうじゃないと落ち着かない。
……まあ、大人しいんならそれにこしたコトはないんだろうけどさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind me; what is really going on with you? You are acting awfully girlish this morning. It does not feel like you.”
“…That was an appalling thing to say, Brother.”
“Oh, there you are. You’re starting to sound like yourself again. I can’t relax unless Akiha acts like Akiha. Though I suppose being quiet is preferable in itself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm fine.
More importantly, what's wrong?
Somehow, you seem really feminine this morning, not like yourself at all."
"…… You just said something really terrible, Nii-san."
"Ah, yes, that's a little more like it.
I'll feel uneasy if you're not like this, Akiha… Well, being calm isn't that bad every once in a while."

entries.japanese:
「……もう。
私、普段はそんなに大人しくないんですか」
「あ……いや、秋葉は大人しいよ。
礼儀正しいし、ちゃんとしてるし。
……あれ、おかしいな、それだけ条件がそろってるのにどうしてこう……」
　どうしてこう、秋葉は大人しいっていうイメージが薄いんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Am I usually so unruly?”
“Ah, no; you are quiet. You have excellent manners, and you are always composed. Wait, that is strange—if you meet every requirement, why is it still so hard to think of you as demure…?”
Why does the word fit Akiha so poorly?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh.
Am I always so rough?"
"Ah… no, you are gentle.
You're polite, and very proper… That's strange, in that case, why……"
Why don't I think of her as being calm all the time?

entries.japanese:
「……まあいいか。
秋葉の体調が悪いっていうんじゃなければ何も聞かない。
ほら、校舎に入ろうぜ」
「……………………」
　秋葉は何か言いたそうな顔のまま、俺の後に続いて校門をくぐった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Never mind. If you are not ill, I will not pry. Come on, let’s go inside.”
“…”
Still looking as though she wants to say something, Akiha follows me through the gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, it's okay.
If you say there's nothing wrong with you, I won't ask anymore.
Come on, let's go inside."
"………………"
Looking like she wants to say something more, Akiha follows me into the school building.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあな。
今日は昼で学校が終わるから、昼食は屋敷で食べられるぞ」
「あ―――兄さん」
「うん？
　なんだ、やっぱり具合が悪いのか？
　それなら保健室まで連れていくけど」
「いえ、体の調子はいいんです。
それに気分も悪くはありません。
ただ、その……今朝の私がこんなふうに気が抜けてしまっているのはワケがあるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“See you later. School lets out at noon today, so we can have lunch at the estate.”
“Ah―――Brother.”
“Mm? Are you feeling sick after all? I can take you to the infirmary.”
“No, I feel perfectly healthy. I am not in a bad mood either. There is simply a reason I have been so absent-minded this morning.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See you later; since school finishes early today, we can have lunch at the mansion."
"Ah---Nii-san."
"Hm?
What is it, do you feel bad after all?
If so, I'll take you to the nurse…"
"No, I feel fine.
I don't feel bad at all.
But there is a reason I just… feel completely lost this morning."

entries.japanese:
「……？
　気が抜けてるって、なんで？」
「その……兄さん、子供のころの約束を覚えていますか？」
　唐突に。
　頬を赤くさせて、秋葉はじっと俺の目を見つめてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…? What reason?”
“Brother, do you remember the promise we made as children?”
The question comes from nowhere.
Her cheeks flushed, Akiha stares directly into my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…?
Lost?
What do you mean?"
"Um… Nii-san, do you remember that childhood promise?"
Suddenly,
Akiha glances up at me with flushed cheeks.

entries.japanese:
「―――子供のころの約束って、なに？」
「……もう。
やっぱり覚えてなんかないですよね。
　いいんです、何でもありませんからっ。
始めから期待なんてしてないし、どうせ兄さんにとってはどうでもいい事だったんでしょうし！」
　ふん、と秋葉は顔を背ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What promise from when we were children?”
“Honestly. You really do not remember after all.
Never mind! I wasn’t expecting anything in the first place, and I’m sure it meant nothing to you anyway!”
Akiha turns her face away with a huff.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Childhood promise?
What's that?"
"…… Geez.
Of course you don't remember it.
That's fine, it's nothing at all.
I didn't expect you to anyway.
It seems it didn't mean anything to you!"
With a hmph, Akiha turns away.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよいきなり。
子供のころのことなんて、もう八年以上も前の事じゃないか。
それに約束って言ったって、おまえとした約束ってそれこそ数え切れないほどあるだろ。
　そんなふうに言われても、なんの事だか見当がつかないぞ」
「それは……そうなんだけど、それでも覚えていてほしい事ってあるでしょう？
　……その、昨日は子供のころの夢をみてしまって、兄さんは覚えているかなって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What brought this on? Our childhood was more than eight years ago. And you and I made more promises than I could possibly count.
How am I supposed to know which one you mean?”
“That may be true, but some things still matter enough that you want another person to remember them. I dreamed about our childhood last night, and I wondered whether you remembered it too.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What's this all of a sudden?
When we were children, that was eight years ago.
You say promise, but there's so many promises I made to you.
Even if you ask me like that, I won't be able to remember."
"That's… true, but… aren't there some things you want others to remember?
Last night, I had a dream about when we were small, so I wondered if you would remember."

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
子供のころの夢を見ただけでいちいち昔のことをひっぱりだすのか、おまえは」
「……だって、懐かしかったんです。
覚えていませんか、あの木の下で兄さんが私の名前を初めて呼んでくれて、私の頭を撫でてくれた時のこと。
　私、あの頃はすぐに泣いてしまう子だったでしょう？
　みんなは私が泣くと困ったようにあやしてくるんですけど、兄さんだけは一緒になって悲しんでくれたわ。
だからよけいに泣きやめなかったんだけど、その後は本当に、もう悲しいことなんてないんだって思えた。
　あの時から私は―――兄さん？
　どうしました、気分が悪いんですか……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Do you drag up the whole past every time you dream about being a child?”
“But it made me nostalgic. Don’t you remember that day beneath the tree, when you called me Akiha for the first time and stroked my hair?
I cried at the slightest thing in those days, didn’t I? Everyone else would fuss over me because they didn’t know what to do, but you were the only one who felt sad with me. It made me cry even harder—but afterward, I truly felt as though nothing sad could ever happen again.
Ever since then, I―――Brother? What is wrong; do you feel ill…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
You think I can remember everything just because you saw a dream from your childhood?"
"…… But, it was nostalgic.
Don't you remember, the first time you called my name, and stroked my head under that tree?
Back then, I would cry easily, right?
Everyone would try to calm me down when I cried, but you would be sad with me.
So it caused me to cry more, but afterwards, I really felt like there was nothing sad anymore.
From that time, I----Nii-san?
What's wrong?
Do you feel ill…?"

entries.japanese:
「―――秋葉。
その、昨日見た夢って、もしかして誰もいない庭でおまえがずっと泣いてた時のことか……？」
「あ………うん、私もよく思い出せないけど、そういった感じの夢だったかな―――」
「――――――」
　ぞくり、と背中に冷たいモノが走る。
　その夢。
　その夢は、俺も見た。
　……先輩は言っていた。
　俺は吸血鬼の意識に引きずられるって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Akiha. Was your dream about the day you cried and cried in that empty garden?”
“Ah, yes; I do not remember it clearly either, but I think it was something like that―――”
“――――――”
A cold shiver races down my back.
That dream.
I saw it too.
…Ciel told me that my consciousness
was drawn into a vampire’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Akiha.
That dream, last night.
Is it the time you were crying in the empty garden…?"
"Ah… yes.
I don't remember it very well, but it felt like that kind of dream---"
"------"
Something cold runs down my back.
That dream.
I had that dream too.
…… Senpai said.
I get pulled into the vampire's mind.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　本当に大丈夫なんですか……？」
「――――なんでもない。
それじゃあ、俺はこっちだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Are you sure you’re all right…?”
“――――It is nothing. My classroom is this way.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
Are you sure you're alright…?"
"----It's nothing.
Well, I'm going this way, so bye!"

entries.japanese:
吐き気をこらえながら、秋葉から離れる。
　……どうして。
　どうしてこう、望まない結果ばっかり出てくるんだろう。
　眠ってしまうと吸血鬼の意識に引きこまれる自分。
　昨日の夜。
　殺人の夢をみるかわりに、秋葉と同じ夢を見ていたなんて、そんなこと、知りたくはなかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Fighting down nausea, I move away from Akiha.
Why?
Why do things keep turning out the way I least want them to?
Whenever I sleep, a vampire’s consciousness draws mine in.
Last night, instead of dreaming of murder, I dreamed the same dream as Akiha.
I never wanted to know that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I part from Akiha, feeling sick.
…… Why?
Why is the result always the worst possible?
Being drawn into the vampire's mind as I sleep.
Last night.
I didn't want to know I was dreaming the same dream as Akiha instead of the killer's dream.

entries.japanese:
……教室には数えるほどしか人がいない。
　窓際の自分の席に移動して、鞄を置く。
「……………」
　椅子に座って、そのままホームルームが始まるのを待った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Only a handful of students are in the classroom.
I cross to my seat by the window and set down my bag.
“…”
Then I sit and wait for homeroom to begin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… There are only a few people in the classroom.
I move to my seat by the window, and put down my bag.
"…………"
Sitting in my chair, I wait for homeroom to start.

entries.japanese:
「おう、早いな遠野。
今朝はまた随分と顔色が悪いけど、どしたん」
「有彦か。
……まったく、秋葉にしろおまえにしろ同じような事ばっかり言いやがって。
俺、そんなに顔色悪いのか」
「あ？
　……いや、そうだな、言われて見れば普通だよな。
なんでかね、遠野がすっごく落ち込んで見えるせいかね」
「…………落ち込んでる、か」
　確かに気持ちは落ち込んでいる。
　これで先輩がやってきて、
『やっぱりそうだったでしょう？
』
　なんて言ってきたら、もう反論のしようがないぐらいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are early, Tohno. You look awfully pale this morning; what happened?”
“Arihiko. First Akiha, now you; you both keep saying the same thing. Do I really look that pale?”
“Huh? No, now that I look, your color seems normal. Maybe it’s because you look so incredibly depressed.”
“Depressed, huh?”
I certainly feel depressed.
If she appeared now and said
“I was right after all, was I not?”
I would have no answer left to give her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, you're early, Tohno.
You look pretty pale this morning; you alright?"
"Arihiko?
…… Honestly, you, Akiha, you all keep saying the same thing.
Do I really look that bad?"
"Uh?
Nah, actually, you look much like you always do.
I guess you just look really down, huh."
"……… Down, huh."
Certainly, I feel down.
If Senpai came and said,
"Wasn't it like I said?"
I wouldn't be able to say anything back.

entries.japanese:
「―――有彦。
おまえ、今日は先輩見た？」
「あ？
　先輩ってどこのだれ先輩だよ」
「どこのって……俺とおまえの共通の先輩っていえば、シエル先輩以外いないだろ」
「だれそれ、しえるって。
うちの学校に留学生なんかいたっけ？」
――――愕然と、口を開けた。
「……有彦、おまえ」
　途切れ途切れで、なんとかそこまで声をあげる。
　けれど、そのあとは中々続いてくれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Arihiko. Have you seen that upperclassman today?”
“Huh? Who?”
“The only upperclassman we both know is Ciel.”
“Who’s Ciel? Did our school have a foreign exchange student?”
――――My mouth fell open in disbelief.
“Arihiko, you…”
I manage to force out that much in broken fragments. Nothing else will come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Arihiko?
Have you seen Senpai today?"
"Eh?
Which Senpai?"
"Which…?
The only Senpai we both know is Ciel-senpai, right?"
"Who's that?
'Shieru'?
Were there any foreign students at this school?"
----My mouth falls open in astonishment.
"…… Arihiko, you…"
My broken voice gets that far.
But I can't get any further.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ遠野。
言いたい事があったらはっきり言えって。
金の問題以外ならなんでも聞くぞ」
　有彦の様子はいつもと変わらない。
　いつもと変わらない様子で、あっさりと、先輩のことをまるっきり覚えていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it, Tohno? If you’ve got something to say, spit it out. I’ll listen to anything except a request for money.”
Arihiko is exactly as he always is.
Exactly as he always is—and he has utterly forgotten her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it, Tohno?
If you got something to say, then say it.
I'll listen to anything except money problems."
Arihiko acts like usual.
Acting like usual, he doesn't remember Senpai at all.

entries.japanese:
「本当に、先輩のことを覚えてないのか」
「だーかーらー、先輩ってどこの誰先輩だって聞いてるじゃんか」
「――――――」
　そんな事、もういまさら答えられない。
　俺は、ようやく。
　昨日の夜、あの人が言ったさよならの意味が、のみこめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You really do not remember her?”
“How many times do I have to ask which upperclassman you mean?”
“――――――”
There is no way I can answer that now.
At last.
