I understand what her goodbye meant last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You really don't remember Senpai…?"
"That's why I'm asking, who is this Senpai you keep talking about?"
"------"
I can't answer anymore.
Gradually,
I begin to understand the meaning of the goodbye she gave last night.

entries.japanese:
「おっ、そろそろ国藤のヤロウが来やがるな。
んじゃまあ、また後でな」
　有彦は自分の席に戻っていく。
　そうして教室に担任が入ってきて、ホームルームが始まって、そのまま一時限目の物理の授業が始まった。
――――それを、ぼんやりと眺めていた。
　先輩は、本当に消えてしまった。
　俺の前からいなくなったんじゃなくて、シエル先輩っていう存在が痕跡一つ残さず消えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, looks like that bastard Kunifuji is about to show up. Catch you later.”
Arihiko returns to his seat.
Our homeroom teacher enters, homeroom begins, and first-period physics follows without a break.
――――I watch it all in a daze.
She truly has disappeared.
Not merely left my life—the very existence of Ciel has vanished without a trace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, old Kunifuji'll be here any moment.
See you later!"
Arihiko returns to his own desk.
The teacher enters the classroom, homeroom begins, and after that, the first period starts with physics.
----I just observe vacantly.
Senpai has really disappeared.

She has not merely disappeared from before me, but she has vanished, without a trace.

entries.japanese:
―――魔法は、簡単にとけちゃいました。
　……どこか悲しそうな顔で、あの人はそう言っていたんだっけ。
　有彦は覚えていない。
……きっと、他の誰も覚えていない。
　あの人はこの学校の生徒じゃなかった。
　俺という人間を監視するために紛れこんでいた人だったんだ。
　だから俺に正体がばれれば、あとはもういなくなるしかない人だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The magic came undone so easily.
She said that with such a sad look, didn’t she?
Arihiko does not remember. No one else will remember either.
She was never a student at this school.
She had slipped inside to watch a person named Shiki Tohno.
Once I discovered who she was, she had no choice but to disappear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The spell has easily faded.
…… Looking somewhat sad, she said that.
Arihiko doesn't remember her.
I'm sure no one else remembers either.
She was never a student here.
She was just sent here in order to observe me.
So, once she revealed her true character to me, there was no need for her to remain here.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　胸がいたい。
　俺を殺人鬼なんかじゃないと証明してくれたかわりに、シエル先輩は蜃気楼のように掻き消えてしまったのか―――。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
My chest hurts.
In exchange for proving I was no murderer, Ciel had vanished like a mirage―――gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
My chest hurts.
In place of proving that I was not a killer, Ciel-senpai disappeared like a mirage---

entries.japanese:
お昼になって、授業はすべて終了した。
　せっかくの土曜日をフルに活用しようと、クラスメイトたちは我先にと教室を飛び出していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
At noon, the school day ends.
Eager to make full use of their Saturday, my classmates race one another out of the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Lunch comes, and all classes end.
Seeking to enjoy Saturday to the fullest, my classmates rush out of the classroom.

entries.japanese:
「お？
　なんだよ遠野、帰らないのか？」
「ああ、まだ残ってる。
ちょっと人を待とうかなって思って」
「ふぅーん……それって秋葉ちゃんのことか？」
「まさか。
秋葉だったらこっちから迎えにいくよ。
俺が待ってるのは来るアテのない人だから、会えるかどうかはわからない」
「そっか。
んじゃお先」
「ああ、あんまり夜遊びするんじゃないぞ」
「うひゃひゃ、遠野に心配されちゃおしまいだな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh? Aren’t you going home, Tohno?”
“No, I’m staying. I thought I might wait for someone.”
“Hmm, are you waiting for Akiha?”
“Of course not. If it were Akiha, I’d go meet her myself. The person I’m waiting for may never come, so I don’t know whether I’ll see her.”
“Got it. I’m off, then.”
“Try not to stay out all night.”
“Hah, if you are worrying about me, I must really be finished.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
What is it, Tohno?
You're not going?"
"Ah, just staying a bit longer.
I thought I'd wait a bit for someone."
"Hmmm?
That'd be Akiha-chan, huh?"
"No way.
If it were Akiha, I'd go and pick her up.
I'm waiting for someone who has no reason to come, so I don't know if I'll get to see her."
"Right.
Well, later."
"Yeah, and don't go playing around too much at night."
"Ahah!
I'm done for if you have to tell me that."

entries.japanese:
有彦が教室を出て言って、他の生徒たちの姿もなくなっていく。
　一人教室に残って、ただシエル先輩を待ちつづけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Arihiko leaves, and soon the other students disappear as well.
Alone in the classroom, I keep waiting for Ciel.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Arihiko goes, and the other students start to go as well.
I am left alone in the classroom, still waiting for Ciel-senpai.

entries.japanese:
かちり、と時計の針が午後一時を指す。
　グラウンドから陸上部の掛け声が聞こえ始めた時、がらり、と教室の扉が開いた。
「――――――」
　やってきたのは秋葉だった。
　秋葉は窓際の椅子に座った俺のところまでやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
The clock clicks over to one in the afternoon.
As the track team’s shouts begin to carry from the athletic field, the classroom door slides open.
“――――――”
It is Akiha.
She walks over to where I sit beside the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Click, the hand of the clock hits 1pm.
As the sounds of practice begin to echo from the grounds, the classroom door slides open.
"------"
It is Akiha.
She comes over to my seat by the window.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、帰らないんですか？」
「……いや、帰るよ。
ただ今日一日先輩と顔を合わせていなくてさ。
ここで待ってれば、やってくると思うんだけど」
　……いや、違う。
　やってきてほしいって思っているだけだ。
　だが、あの人が俺の前に現れてくれる事はもうないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, aren’t you going home?”
“I will. I just have not seen her once today. I thought she might come if I waited here.”
No, that is not true.
I only want her to come.
I know she will probably never appear before me again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
You're not going home?"
"…… No, I'll go.
I just haven't seen Senpai today.
I thought if I waited here, she might come by."
…… No, that's wrong.
I just want her to come by.
But, she's never going to appear before me again.

entries.japanese:
「―――そうですか。
それなら私もお付き合いします」
　秋葉は隣の椅子に座った。
「……別にいいけど。
物好きなんだな、おまえ」
「はい。
なにしろ兄さんの妹ですから」
　……なにが嬉しいのか、秋葉は笑顔で椅子に座っている。
　……まあ、追い出す理由もない。
　先輩と秋葉を会わせるのはまずいけど、どのみち先輩はやってこない。
　俺はただ、一日を棒にふってるだけなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I see. Then I will wait with you.”
Akiha takes the chair beside mine.
“…I don’t mind, but you’re an odd one.”
“Yes. I am your sister, after all.”
For some reason, Akiha sits there smiling.
I have no reason to send her away.
It would be dangerous to let her meet Ciel, but Ciel will not come anyway.
I am merely throwing away an entire day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Is that so?
Well then, I'll wait with you."
Akiha sits at the desk next to me.
"…… I don't mind or anything.
You really are nosy, aren't you?"
"Yes.
I'm your sister, after all."
…… Seeming a little happy, Akiha sits on the chair with a smile.
…… Well, there's no reason to send her away.
Although it's unpleasant when Akiha and Senpai see each other, Senpai isn't coming anyway.
I'm just wasting a day.

entries.japanese:
夕方になった。
　秋葉は文句一つ言わず、ただ俺のとなりに座っている。
　……思えば、屋敷に帰ってからこんなに長い間、秋葉と二人きりになったのは初めてかもしれない。
　なまじ会話がない分、いつもより深く秋葉のことを意識してしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Evening comes.
Akiha remains seated beside me without a single complaint.
Now that I think about it, this may be the longest we have spent alone together since I returned to the estate.
With no conversation to distract me, I am more conscious of her than ever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's afternoon.
Akiha doesn't complain, and merely sits next to me.
…… Come to think of it this is the first time I've been with Akiha for such a long time since I came back to the mansion.
Without conversation, I'm more aware of Akiha than ever.

entries.japanese:
幼い頃、いつも泣いていた秋葉。
　それから八年間、ずっと俺を待っていてくれた秋葉。
　こうして今も、ただ静かに俺に付き添っている秋葉。
　……その秋葉が吸血鬼かもしれないと聞かされて、俺はただ否定するしかできなかった。
　理由はいうまでもない。
　俺にとって秋葉は大切な妹だから、そんな事は認めたくなかっただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha, who cried so often as a child.
Akiha, who waited eight years for my return.
Akiha, who even now sits quietly beside me.
When I was told that Akiha might be a vampire, all I could do was deny it.
The reason is obvious.
Akiha is my precious little sister, and I simply did not want to believe it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When we were small, Akiha was always crying.
And for eight years, Akiha waited for me.
And even now, Akiha simply accompanies me calmly.
…… When I was told that Akiha might be a vampire, all I did was to deny it.
The reasons are obvious.
Akiha is my important younger sister, so I didn't want to accept it.

entries.japanese:
……守ろうと誓った少女。
　俺が遠野の屋敷に戻った理由。
　八年ぶりに会って、美しく成長した秋葉を見た時の驚き。
entries.maoEnglish:
The girl I swore to protect.
The reason I returned to the Tohno estate.
My astonishment when, after eight years apart, I saw how beautifully she had grown.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The girl I promised to protect.
The reason I returned to the Tohno mansion.
My surprise when I met Akiha for the first time after eight years, now grown beautiful.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は大切な存在だ。
　それは愛情だと思う。
　けど、その愛情の種類がどんなものなのか、はっきりと口にできない。
　兄妹として暮らしてきた時はわずか二年だけ。
　その間も、どうしてか肉親の情よりも、ただ守っていたいっていう感情のほうが優先していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is precious to me.
I think what I feel must be love.
But I cannot clearly put into words what kind of love it is.
We lived as brother and sister for only two years.
Even then, the desire to protect her somehow outweighed ordinary affection between family.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is important to me.
I think I love her.
But what kind of love it is, I cannot put into words clearly.
We've lived as siblings for only two years.
During that time, the feeling of wanting to protect her was stronger than the feeling of family.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　わからない。
　ときおり、自分でもわからないぐらい、秋葉に見惚れてしまう時もある。
　妹だから大切なのかと言われれば、違う。
　俺にとって、秋葉はただ大切な存在なんだろう。
　だから。
　たとえ秋葉が吸血鬼だとしても、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I don’t understand it.
Sometimes I find myself captivated by her beauty beyond all reason.
Is she precious because she is my sister?
No.
Akiha is simply precious to me.
So, even if Akiha truly is a vampire, I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I don't understand.
At times, I gaze on Akiha so much that I don't understand myself.
It's not that she's important to me because she's my younger sister.
She's just important to me.
So.
Even if she's a vampire, I---

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
そろそろ帰ろうか」
「それはかまいませんけど……いいんですか、兄さん。
まだ先輩が来ていないでしょう？」
「いや、初めから来ないって解ってた。
だから、もういい」
「…………………」
　秋葉は何も聞いてこない。
　……ふと、疑問に思った。
　有彦や他の生徒―――教師たちさえ先輩の事を覚えていなかったけど、秋葉は覚えているのかどうか、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Shall we go home?”
“I do not mind, but are you sure, Brother? The person you were waiting for still has not come.”
“No. I knew from the beginning that she would not come, so I am done waiting.”
“…”
Akiha asks no questions.
Then a thought occurs to me.
Arihiko, the other students―――even the teachers had forgotten her, but did Akiha remember?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Shall we go back?"
"I don't mind, but… is that alright, Nii-san?
Senpai isn't here yet, is she?"
"No.
She was never going to come, so it's alright."
"…………"
Akiha says nothing more.
…… Suddenly, I realize something.
Arihiko and the others… even the teachers don't remember Senpai.
But Akiha seems to.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
おまえ、先輩の事をどう思う？」
「……先輩だけでは誰の事を指しているかわかりませんけど、兄さんが指している人物はシエルさんのことでしょう？
　それでしたら、私の言葉は変わりません。
あの人とは付き合ってほしくないだけです」
「な――――――」
　声がつまる。
　秋葉は先輩のことを覚えていた。
　誰もが忘れていた先輩の事を、どうして――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. What do you think of her?”
“I don’t know whom you mean by ‘her,’ but you must be referring to Ciel. In that case, my opinion has not changed. I don’t want you associating with that woman.”
“――――――”
My voice catches.
Akiha remembers Ciel.
Everyone else had forgotten Ciel, so why――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
What do you think of Senpai?"
"…… I'm not sure who you mean by 'Senpai'.
But I think you mean Ciel-san?
In that case, my opinion hasn't changed.
I do not want you to associate with that person."
"Wha-----"
My voice dies.
Akiha remembers Senpai.
Everyone else has forgotten her, so why---

entries.japanese:
「秋葉、おまえ――――」
「兄さん？
　どうしました、そんなに恐い顔をして」
「……どうして？
　どうして覚えてるんだ、秋葉。
先輩の事はみんな忘れているっていうのに、どうしておまえは覚えてるんだ……！？」
「え――――」
　秋葉の表情が凍りつく。
　そうして、秋葉はごまかすように俺から視線を逸らした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, you――――”
“Brother? Why are you looking at me like that?”
“Why? Why do you remember, Akiha? Everyone else has forgotten Ciel, so why are you the only one who remembers?!”
“What――――?”
Akiha’s expression freezes.
Then, as though trying to hide something, she averts her eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, you----"
"Nii-san?
What is it?
You have such a terrible expression right now."
"…… Why?
Why do you remember, Akiha?
Everyone has forgotten Senpai, so why do you remember her…!?"
"Eh----?"
Akiha's expression freezes.
And then, she looks away from me.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
おまえ、もしかして……初めから先輩の正体がわかってたのか……？」
「――――――――」
　秋葉は答えない。
　……その沈黙は、すなわちイエスだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Did you know what she really was from the beginning?”
“――――――――”
Akiha does not answer.
Her silence is answer enough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Could it be… you knew from the beginning who Senpai was…?"
"--------"
She doesn't answer.
…… The silence means "yes".

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……！
　黙ってないで答えてくれ、おまえは初めから先輩が吸血鬼を退治するためにいる人だって知ってたから、ずっと先輩のことを毛嫌いしてたっていうのか……！」
「吸血鬼って、兄さん――――」
　呆然と俺を見る秋葉。
　……その顔は吸血鬼という単語に驚いているというより、俺が吸血鬼なんて言葉を口にする事に驚いているようだった。
「……秋葉。
黙ってないで答えてくれ。
そうしないと俺は、おまえを―――」
　信じることが、できなくなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, answer me! Did you hate her all this time because you knew from the beginning that she was here to hunt vampires…?!”
“Vampires, Brother――――”
Akiha stares at me in shock.
Her expression suggests not that the word itself surprises her, but that she is stunned to hear me speak it.
“Akiha. Please answer me. Otherwise I will―――”
I will no longer be able to trust you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha…!
Answer me, you knew Senpai was a vampire hunter from the beginning, is that why you didn't like her…!?"
"Vampire… Nii-san----"
Akiha looks at me, aghast.
…… Her face doesn't seem surprised at the word vampire, but it seems she's surprised to hear it coming from me.
"…… Akiha, answer me.
If you don't, I---"
I won't be able to believe you.

entries.japanese:
「……そうよ、兄さん。
私にはあの人が最初から違うひとだと解っていました。
あの人が初対面の人間に暗示をかけている事に気がついたから、あの人のことは信用できなかったんです」
「……？
　初対面の人に暗示をかけてるって、先輩が……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, Brother. I knew from the beginning that there was something different about her. I noticed she was planting suggestions in everyone she met, so I never trusted her.”
“Planting suggestions…? Ciel was doing that?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, Nii-san.
I knew from the beginning that person was different.
Since I knew she was hypnotizing people she saw for the first time, I didn't trust her."
"…?
Senpai… was hypnotizing people…?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
だからみなさん、シエルなんていう名前にさえ違和感を覚えなかったでしょう？
　私は暗示にはかからなかったから、あの人がどこか異状な人だと気がついてたんです」
　弁解するように秋葉は言う。
　けど、秋葉は肝心なことを言ってくれない。
　誰もがかかっていたというシエル先輩の暗示とやらに、どうして秋葉はかからなかったのかという事を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. That is why no one even found a name like Ciel strange, remember? The suggestion did not work on me, so I could tell there was something wrong about her.”
Akiha says it almost defensively.
But she still avoids the one thing that matters.
Why had she alone resisted a suggestion that affected everyone else?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
That's why everyone didn't think it was odd for someone to have a name like Ciel.
Since I was unaffected by her, I realized there was something different about her."
Akiha explains herself.
But, she left out an important part.
If everyone was taken in by Ciel-senpai's hypnosis, why was Akiha unaffected?

entries.japanese:
「あの人の暗示にかかっていた人は、その暗示が解けた時点でシエルという人間のことを忘れてしまう。
私は初めから暗示にはかかっていませんでしたから、暗示が解けた今もあの人の事を覚えているんです」
「……それはわかった。
けど秋葉。
どうしておまえは、その暗示にはかからなかったんだ」
「―――それは、その―――」
「……そうだよな。
遠野の人間は普通じゃないもんな。
普通じゃないから、先輩の暗示なんかにはかからなかったんだろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Everyone under her suggestion forgot that Ciel had ever existed the moment it was lifted. I was never under it, so naturally I still remember her now.”
“I understand that. But why, Akiha? Why did the suggestion not work on you?”
“―――That is, well―――”
“Right. The Tohnos are not normal. Because they are not normal, Ciel’s suggestion did not work on you, did it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"When the hypnosis is removed, those people affected by it will forget the person called Ciel.
Since I was never affected in the first place, even though it has been removed, I remember her."
"…… I get it.
But Akiha, why weren't you affected?"
"---Well, that's---"
"…… I see.
Those of the Tohno bloodline aren't normal.
Because of that, Senpai's hypnosis was ineffective."

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、どうしてそれを」
「……当たり前だろ。
俺だって、普通じゃないから」
　言って、椅子から立ちあがる。
　秋葉は愕然とした顔をしたあと、覚悟したような面持ちで椅子から立ちあがった。
―――無人の教室。
　赤く染まった教室で、俺たちは互いの顔を見つめ合う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, how do you know that?”
“Isn’t it obvious? I’m not normal either.”
With that, I rise from my chair.
Akiha stares at me in shock; then, her face settling into grim resolve, she stands as well.
―――An empty classroom.
In the room bathed red by the setting sun, we stand facing one another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, why do you…"
"…… It's natural.
After all, I'm not normal either."
Saying that, I stand up.
After a moment of astonishment, Akiha also stands up with a determined expression.
---The empty classroom.
We gaze at each other in a classroom dyed red.

entries.japanese:
「……先輩から聞いた。
遠野の人間はみんな特別な力を持ってるんだって。
……その中には自分でも自分をおさえられないで、人を殺してしまうヤツもいたって、教えてもらった」
「……………………」
「けど、俺は信じられない。
信じたくなんか、ないんだ」
「……………………」
「答えてくれ、秋葉。
おまえは―――吸血鬼なんかじゃないよな？」
　秋葉は答えない。
ただつらそうに目を細めるだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel told me. She said everyone in the Tohno family has some sort of special power… and that some of them lost control of themselves and killed people.”
“…”
“But I cannot believe it. I do not want to.”
“…”
“Tell me, Akiha. You are not―――a vampire, are you?”
Akiha gives no answer. Her eyes merely narrow with pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I heard from Senpai.
That all those in the Tohno family have special powers.
…… And that among them, there are those who end up not being able to restrain themselves and kill others."
"…………"
"But, I don't believe it.
I don't want to believe it…"
"…………"
"Please tell me, Akiha.
You're---not a vampire, are you?"
Akiha doesn't answer.
She merely narrows her eyes painfully.

entries.japanese:
――――なんで。
　どうして秋葉は、嘘でもいいから、そんな事はないって、言ってくれないんだろう―――

「―――なんとか言えよ。
なんで黙っているんだ秋葉……！」
　沈黙が苦しくて、そう怒鳴りつけていた。
　……ほんの少しの静寂のあと。
　秋葉は、何事もなかったかのような優雅さで、窓際まで歩き出した。
　長い髪が赤い夕焼けに透けている。
　赤い、髪をなびかせて、秋葉はくるりと振り返った。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Why?
Why can she not deny it, even if she has to lie―――
“―――Say something. Why are you silent, Akiha…!?”
The silence is unbearable, and I find myself shouting at her.
After a brief stillness.
Akiha walks to the window with all her customary grace, as though nothing happened.
Her long hair shines translucent in the crimson sunset.
That red hair streams behind her as she turns to face me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Why?
Why won't Akiha, even if it's a lie, say 'of course not'---

"--Say something!
Why won't you answer, Akiha…!"
I cry out, since the silence is painful.
…… A little more silence follows.
As if nothing was wrong, Akiha walks gracefully to the window.
Her long red hair is transparent in the sunset.
Her red hair flutters as she turns around.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ聞くけど。
兄さんは私が吸血鬼だとしたら、どうするんですか？」
　ずい、と。
　視線という刃が、俺の喉元に突き刺さるような、迫力。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then let me ask you something. What would you do if I were a vampire, Brother?”
She leans toward me.
Her gaze bears enough force to drive a blade through my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, then, I'll ask.
If I was a vampire, what would you do, Nii-san?"
Her look, like a blade, pierces my throat.

entries.japanese:
「――――それは」
　秋葉の視線が鋭く刺さる。
　離れている。
　秋葉と俺は離れているっていうのに、まるで目の前に秋葉がいるような、緊迫した空気。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――I would…”
Akiha’s eyes stab into me.
We are far apart.
Yet the air between us is so taut it feels as if she stood directly before me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's…"
Akiha's gaze drills into me.
We're separated.
Even though she's away from me, there is a feeling of tension like she's right in front of my face.

entries.japanese:
「答えて兄さん。
私が血を吸う鬼だったとしたら、貴方はどうするっていうんです」
「―――秋葉、それは――――」
「もし私がそれを認めたら、秋葉は自分を押し殺す必要がなくなります。
わかってるの、兄さん？
　私、もうつまらない意地をはるのはやめて、自分に素直になれるんですよ？」
　鬼気迫るような迫力と、どこか愉しむような残忍さを含んだ瞳で、秋葉は下から見つめてくる。
　その視線に、ぞくりとした。
　秋葉は俺を見上げているのに、こっちが見下されていると思うぐらい、冷たい静の迫力がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me, Brother. If I were an ogre that drank human blood, what would you do?”
“―――Akiha, that is――――”
“If I admitted it, Akiha wouldn’t have to keep smothering herself anymore. Do you understand, Brother?
I could give up this silly pride and finally be honest with myself.”
She looks up at me through eyes at once ferocious and cruelly amused.
A shiver runs through me.
Though Akiha is looking up, her cold, quiet force makes me feel as though I were the one beneath her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer me, Nii-san.
I asked, if I were a blood-sucking demon, what would you do?"
"---Akiha, that's…"
"If I were to confirm that, there would be no need for me hold back.
Do you understand, Nii-san?
I could stop being obstinate and become more honest with myself, right?"
With terrible pressure and a glint of cruel enjoyment in her eyes, Akiha gazes up at me.
I shudder as I look at her.
Even though Akiha is looking up at me, her gaze is so cold that she seems to be looking down on me.

entries.japanese:
「な――――」
　息を飲むばかりで何も言えない。
　離れているのに。
　……俺たちは今にもくちづけを交わすような姿勢と錯覚のまま、ただ見つめ合うだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh――――”
I can only gasp; no words come.
Though there is still distance between us.
We merely stare at each other, caught in the illusion that our faces are poised to meet in a kiss.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
I'm breathing in and I can't speak.
Even though we're far apart,
…… it feels like we're so close we could kiss at any moment.

entries.japanese:
秋葉の目は別人のように冷たい。
「秋葉、おまえ―――」
　喉はそこで停止する。
　どうしても―――どうしても、俺にはその先が言えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s eyes are so cold they seem to belong to someone else.
“Akiha, you―――”
My throat closes there.
No matter how I try―――no matter how I try, I cannot force out what comes next.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha's eyes are cold as those of a stranger.
"Akiha, you---"
My voice stops there.
Whatever happens---whatever happens, I cannot finish.

entries.japanese:
「冗談よ、兄さん。
私は誰かの血なんて飲まないもの」
　言いよどむ俺の様子を愉しむように笑って、秋葉は刃のようだった視線を止めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It was a joke, Brother. I don’t drink anyone’s blood.”
Smiling as though she has enjoyed watching me struggle, Akiha sheaths the blade of her gaze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just a joke, Nii-san.
I don't drink people's blood."
With a delightful smile at my hesitant state, Akiha releases her blade-like gaze.

entries.japanese:
「シエルの言うとおり、たしかに遠野の家の人間には『違うもの』の血が混ざっています。
　けれどそれは発現すれば一目でわかるものだって、兄さんだって知っているじゃないですか」
　くすり、と。
　秋葉はからかうように笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel was right that the blood of ‘something else’ runs in the Tohno family.
But you know as well as I do, Brother, that when it manifests, there is no mistaking it.”
A soft giggle.
Akiha gives a teasing laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It is just as Ciel said.
Certainly, members of the Tohno house have something 'different' in their blood.
However, that's something that can be told at a glance if it's awake.
Even you know that, don't you Nii-san?"
Akiha teases with a laugh.

entries.japanese:
「俺が、知っている……？」
「ええ。
ですから、兄さんの質問は無意味です。
私は兄さんが思っているようなモノじゃないから。
　それで、話はそれだけですか？
　なら、私は先に帰らせてもらいます」
　秋葉は立ち去ろうとする。
　けど、だめだ。
　……もう、今を逃したらチャンスはない気がする。
　ここまできたら、もう何もかも問い詰めるしか、出口がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I know that…?”
“Yes. Which makes your question meaningless, Brother. I’m not the thing you imagine me to be.
Was that all? Then I’ll be going home ahead of you.”
Akiha turns to leave.
But I can’t let her.
Something tells me that if I miss this moment, I will never have another chance.
We have come too far; the only way out now is to demand the whole truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I… know…?"
"Yes.
So, your question is meaningless.
Because I am not what you think I am, Nii-san.
Well then, is that all?
In that case, I am going home."
Akiha is about to leave.
But, no.
…… If I miss this chance, I feel there will be no more chances.
Having come this far, I can't let her go without asking her everything.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、まだ聞きたい事がある。
俺とおまえが子供の頃にいた、もう一人の男の子のことだ」
「案外しつこいんですね、兄さんは。
そんな子はいなかったって言ったはずです」
「そんなハズはないだろ。
十年前に親父が養子をとったんだから」
「――――――――」
　秋葉はキッと眉をつりあげる。
　それは今までのように後ろめたいものを隠す反応ではなく、怒りに近い反応だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is something else I want to ask. The other boy who lived with us when we were children.”
“You’re surprisingly persistent, Brother. I already told you there was no such child.”
“That can’t be true. Father adopted someone ten years ago.”
“――――――――”
Akiha’s brows snap upward.
This is no guilty flinch or attempt to hide something; it is anger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, there's still something I want to ask.
About the other child, when we were children."
"You're really persistent, Nii-san.
Didn't I tell you there was no other child?"
"That's not true.
Our old man adopted a kid ten years ago."
"--------"
Akiha raises her eyebrows.
It's not like her previous reaction, a hiding of guilt.
It's more like anger.

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
翡翠にも困ったものね。
兄さんに知られないように、あれほど注意なさいって言ったのに」
　はあ、とため息をつく秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Hisui really is hopeless. I warned her again and again not to let you find out, Brother.”
Akiha sighs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see, Hisui has been troublesome.
I told her to take care not to let you discover that."
Akiha sighs.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉。
三人目の子供はいたんだ。
俺だっておぼろげに覚えてる。
もう教えてくれてもいいだろう。
あいつは……どうして、死んでしまったんだ」
「いいえ。
その人は、死んでなんていません」
「―――え？」
「でも殺されたんです。
――兄さん、あなた自身の手によって」
「な―――俺が、殺した―――？」
　口にして。
　ぐらりと、眩暈がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. There was a third child. Even I remember him, however faintly. You can tell me now. Why did he—why did he die?”
“No. That person is not dead.”
“―――What?”
“But he was killed. ――By your own hands, Brother.”
“Wh―――I killed him―――?”
I say the words.
The world lurches beneath me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha.
There was a third child.
Even I remember vaguely.
Can't you tell me?
He… why did he die?"
"No.
That child did not die."
"---Eh?"
"But he was killed.
…… By your hands, Nii-san."
"Wha---I, killed---?"
Saying that.
Dizziness assaults me.

entries.japanese:
――――そう、殺した。
　八年前の事故。
　幼いころの自分。
　あの中庭で。
　暑い、悪夢のように暑い夏の日。
　血にまみれた秋葉と少年。
　入道雲と、どこまでも鳴り響く蝉の音。
――――そこで、俺はあの子供を、殺した、のか。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――So I killed him.
The accident eight years ago.
Myself as a child.
That courtyard.
A summer day hot as a nightmare.
Akiha and the boy, drenched in blood.
Towering clouds, and the endless shriek of cicadas.
――――Was that where I killed that child?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Yes, I killed.
The accident eight years ago.
My younger self.
In that courtyard.
A hot, nightmarish summer day.
Akiha, and the boy covered in blood.
The thick clouds, and the echoing sound of the cicadas.
----There, I killed, him…

entries.japanese:
ぐらりと、眩暈がした。
「くっ―――――」
　遠くなっていく意識をなんとか踏みとどまらせる。
「ちが――――俺、は」
　はぁはぁと呼吸が歪む。
　俺。
俺は、そんなこと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
The world reels.
“Ghh―――――”
I fight to hold on as consciousness recedes into the distance.
“No――――I did not”
My breathing twists into ragged gasps.
Me. I could never have done something like that――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel dizzy.
"Kuh…"
Somehow, I have the strength to keep from fainting.
"No----I…"
My breath comes out in gasps.
I… I couldn't…

entries.japanese:
「ほら兄さん。
人には、誰だって秘密にしておかなければならない事があるでしょう？」
「秋葉―――おまえ」
「だからもう、つまらない事を考えるのはやめてください。
兄さんは遠野志貴として、あの屋敷にいればそれでいいんですから」
―――秋葉が去っていく。
　俺には、それを止める言葉がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You see, Brother? Everyone has things they must keep secret.”
“Akiha―――you”
“So please stop troubling yourself with such pointless questions. All you need to do, Brother, is remain at that estate as Shiki Tohno.”
―――Akiha walks away.
I have no words to stop her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, Nii-san.
Doesn't everyone have secrets they have to keep to themselves?"
"Akiha---you…"
"So, you should stop thinking about such things.
It's enough if you just live at the mansion as Tohno Shiki."
---Akiha leaves.
I have no words to stop her.

entries.japanese:
夕暮れの教室。
　俺は一人残されたまま、何もできずに立ち尽くすだけだった――――
entries.maoEnglish:
The classroom at dusk.
I stand there alone, helpless and unable to move――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
The classroom in the sunset.
Only I am left, standing, unable to move.

entries.japanese:
――――――――夜になった。
　屋敷に帰る気にもなれず、公園のベンチに座って、ただ考える。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――――Night falls.
Unable to bring myself to return to the estate, I sit on a park bench and think.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--------Night falls.
Since I don't feel like returning to the mansion, I merely sit on the bench in the park, thinking.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……駄目なのか。
　秋葉が『違うもの』だという事は疑いようがないし、三人目の子供がいて、それが死んでしまったのだという事もはっきりしている。
　秋葉は、俺が三人目の子供を殺したと言う。
　そして俺自身、血にそまった子供をあの中庭で見た記憶がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Is there no escaping it?
There can be no doubt that Akiha is something inhuman, or that there was a third child and he died.
Akiha says I killed the third child.
And I myself remember seeing a child drenched in blood in the courtyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… Is it pointless?
It's undeniable that Akiha is something "different", and it's clear that there was a third child who is now dead.
Akiha says I killed the third child.
And I remember looking down at a bloody body in the courtyard.

entries.japanese:
「…………く」
　琥珀さんの血を吸っていた秋葉。
　遠野の者は人間じゃないと言った秋葉。
　……兄妹であるのなら、眠っている時に意識が同化してもおかしくないといっていた先輩。
「―――――っ」
　なら、もう疑う要素はなにもない。
　認めたくないけど、これが真実だ。
　せめて。
　せめて秋葉が琥珀さんの血を吸っている所さえ見てなければ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
Akiha drinking Kohaku’s blood.
Akiha telling me the Tohnos were not human.
Ciel saying that, as brother and sister, it would be no surprise for one mind to merge with the other in sleep.
“―――――!”
There is nothing left to doubt.
I don’t want to accept it, but this is the truth.
If only.
If only I had never seen Akiha drinking Kohaku’s blood――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kuh."
Akiha drinking Kohaku-san's blood.
Akiha saying the Tohno family is inhuman.
…… Senpai, saying it would not be strange for the minds of siblings to merge while they sleep.
"-----"
So, there's no longer any doubt.
Even if I don't want to accept it, it's true.
At least.
At least, if I didn't see Akiha drinking Kohaku-san's blood----

entries.japanese:
「――――あれ」
　……ちょっと、待った。
　俺が秋葉と琥珀さんを見たのは、夢の中だったハズだ。
　夢の中で、俺は秋葉と琥珀さんを見た。
　それはつまり―――秋葉に同化していては、秋葉本人を見る事はできない、ということ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Wait”
No, hold on.
I saw Akiha and Kohaku in a dream.
In that dream, I was watching the two of them.
Which means―――if my consciousness had merged with Akiha’s, I could not possibly have been watching Akiha herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Huh?"
…… Hang on.
When I saw Akiha and Kohaku-san, it was in my dream.
I saw Akiha and Kohaku-san in a dream.
That means, if I was merging with Akiha's mind, I wouldn't be able to see Akiha herself.

entries.japanese:
「……じゃああの夢を見ていたのは―――」
　見られていた秋葉のハズがない。
　秋葉が吸血鬼なら、あんな映像は絶対に見るはずがないんだ。
「――そうだよ。
秋葉が殺人鬼のはずがないじゃないか！」
　言って、ベンチから立ちあがった。
　あとはもう、自分でも恥ずかしいとは思うんだけど、公園中を駆けまわった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then the one who had that dream was―――”
It could not have been Akiha; she was the one I was watching.
If Akiha were the vampire, I could never have seen the scene that way.
“――That is right. There is no way Akiha could be the killer!”
I say it and spring from the bench.
What follows is embarrassing even to me: I run madly around the park.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then, the person seeing that dream…"
It couldn't have been Akiha, who was being watched.
If Akiha is a vampire, she would never see that.
"--Yeah.
There's no way Akiha could be the killer!"
Saying that, I jump off the bench.
Though I will be embarrassed later, I run around the park.

entries.japanese:
「は、はは、ははははは――――！」
　まわりの視線なんてどうでもいい。
　ただ嬉しくて、笑いながら駆けまわる。
　だって、これで―――俺は秋葉のことをずっと守っていられるんだ。
　俺と意識が同化してしまう吸血鬼にも、今回ばかりは感謝してやる。
　あいつが秋葉のことを覗いていなかったら、俺はとんでもない勘違いをしたまま―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha, hah, hahahaha――――!”
I don’t care who stares.
I’m too happy; I run and laugh.
Because this means―――I can go on protecting Akiha forever.
For once, I can even thank the vampire whose consciousness merged with mine.
If that monster hadn’t been spying on Akiha, I might have gone on believing something terrible―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha, haha, hahahaha-----!"
I don't care about how people think.
I just run around happily, laughing.
Because this means I can protect Akiha from now on.
Just this once, I am happy that my mind merged with the vampire's.
If he hadn't seen Akiha, I would still believe my terrible mistake---

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　いや、ちょっと待て。
「秋葉を―――見ていた？」
　殺人鬼は、秋葉を見ていた。
　屋敷の中で。
　獲物を狙う陰湿さで、物陰からじっくりと。
　まるで、次の獲物を秋葉に定めたかのように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
No, wait.
“Was it watching―――Akiha?”
The killer was watching Akiha.
Inside the estate.
Patiently, from concealment.
With the furtive malice of a hunter stalking prey, as if it had marked Akiha as its next victim.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
No, hold on.
"Watching---Akiha…?"
The killer, was watching Akiha.
Inside the mansion.
Like watching its prey, from a dark corner.
As if he decided his next prey was Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「な―――――」
　背筋が凍った。
　けど、今は立ち止まっている時じゃない。
「秋葉――――！」
　叫んで、全力で屋敷へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No―――――”
Ice races down my spine.
But there is no time to stand still.
“Akiha――――!”
I shout and run for the estate with everything I have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha---"
My back freezes.
But this is no time to stand around.
"Akiha----!"
Crying out, I run to the mansion with all my strength.

entries.japanese:
はあ――――
　はあ――――
　はあ――――
　はあ――――
「はあ、はあ、はあ……！」
―――おかしい。
　まだ七時になったばっかりなのに、屋敷の明かりがついていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Haaah――――
Haaah――――
Haaah――――
Haaah――――
“Hah, hah, hah…!”
―――Something is wrong.
It is barely seven, yet there isn’t a single light on in the estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*----
*pant*----
*pant*----
*pant*----
" *pant*, *pant*, *pant*………!"
---Strange.
Though it's still only seven, the lights of the mansion are out.

entries.japanese:
「はあ……はあ、はあ――――」
　走りどおしで喘ぐ呼吸を抑えつけて、屋敷の中へ駆けこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah――――”
Fighting down the gasps torn from me by the long run, I rush inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I gasp for air.
I catch my breath from running, then run into the mansion.

entries.japanese:
……屋敷は静まりかえっている。
　あたりは、ひどく暑い。
　秋の夜だっていうのに、今夜はひどく熱い。
「はあ……はあ……はあ……」
　呼吸が乱れているのは、決して走ってきたからだけじゃない。
　ひどい熱帯夜だ。
額から流れた汗が、ぽたぽたと頬を伝って落ちていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
The estate is utterly still.
The air is unbearably hot.
Though it is an autumn night, the heat is savage.
“Hah, hah, hah…”
Running is not the only reason my breathing has gone ragged.
It is a suffocatingly hot night. Sweat streams from my forehead, rolls over my cheeks, and falls in heavy drops.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The mansion is as silent as a grave.
It's terribly hot.
For an autumn night, it's terribly hot.
I keep panting heavily.
My breathing is irregular, but not just because I've been running.
It's a terrible, tropical night.
Sweat pours off me, dripping down my cheeks.

entries.japanese:
「…………く」
　額の汗をぬぐう。
　蒸せるような夜気の中、屋敷の玄関に手をかけた。
「くっ――――！」
　眩暈がした。
　ギッ、と体中の骨が軋むような悪寒は、意識を細く細く絞り込もうとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
I wipe the sweat from my brow.
Through the suffocating night air, I reach for the front door.
“Ghh――――!”
Vertigo strikes.
A chill that makes every bone in my body creak squeezes my consciousness thinner and thinner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kuh."
I wipe it away.
In this boiling night, I grasp the door of the mansion.
"Kuh----!"
I feel dizzy.
A chill runs through my bones as if my brain was being wrung out.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　眩暈は、眩暈とは違っていた。
　意識は遠ざからない。
むしろより鮮明に、余分な部分を削ぎ落として細く強く、刃物のように研ぎ澄まされていく。
―――ギリ、という音。
　わけもなく憎しみが湧いてくる。
　眩暈は止まらず、頭痛は激しくなる一方なのに、体には活力が漲っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
But this is no ordinary vertigo.
My consciousness does not recede; it sharpens. Every superfluous part is pared away until my mind becomes narrow, hard, and keen as a blade.
―――A dry, grinding sound.
Hatred wells up from nowhere.
The dizziness will not stop and the headache only worsens, yet strength floods my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
This isn't my normal dizziness.
My consciousness isn't blurred.
Instead, it's sharpened, like a honed blade.
---I grit my teeth.
Without reason, hatred boils up.
The dizziness does not fade, and despite a violent headache, my body fills with strength.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉………！」
　叫んでも返事はない。
　屋敷はすべて電気が途絶えている。
　人の気配はまったくしない。
「翡翠、琥珀さん……！
　誰かいないのか！？」
　返事はない。
　あるのはうだるような熱さと、針のように肌にささってくる静寂だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…!”
No answer comes.
Every light in the estate is dead.
There is not the faintest trace of another person.
“Hisui, Kohaku! Is anyone here?!”
Nothing.
Only the sweltering heat and a silence that pricks my skin like needles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha…!"
There's no response to my cry.
The mansion is completely without power.
There is no sign of anyone.
"Hisui, Kohaku-san…!
Is there anyone here…!?"
There is no reply.
The only thing here is heat and silence piercing into my skin like needles.

entries.japanese:
「――――秋葉」
　厭な気配だけがする。
　他のことを考える余裕はない。
　秋葉。
秋葉の部屋は、たしか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Akiha”
There is only that hideous presence.
No room remains in my mind for anything else.
Akiha. Her room should be――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Akiha."
Just, an awful feeling.
I can't think of anything else.
Akiha.
Akiha's room is----

entries.japanese: ―――一階の東館だった、と思う。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――The east wing on the first floor, I think.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----The east wing of the first floor, I think.

entries.japanese:
「…………あれ」
―――何を考えているんだ、俺は。
　一階の東館っていったら居間や台所がある区域で、個人の部屋なんて一つもない。
「―――東館は東館でも、秋葉の部屋は二階じゃないかっ……！」
　自分で自分を罵倒して、二階へと駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait…”
―――What am I thinking?
The first floor of the east wing holds the sitting room and kitchen; there is not a single private bedroom there.
“―――The east wing, yes, but Akiha’s room is upstairs…!”
Cursing my own stupidity, I race for the second floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Huh?"
----What am I thinking?
All that's in the east wing of the first floor is the sitting room and the kitchen, not anyone's room.
"----East is east, but her room is on the second floor……!"
Cursing at myself, I dash upstairs.

entries.japanese:
……階段をあがっていく。
　高い気温と厭な予感が、夜の闇をガラスのようにはりつめさせている。
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
　荒い息遣いのまま階段をのぼりきって、廊下を歩く。
　……背筋が痛い。
　厭な空気は、秋葉の部屋に近づくたびに重くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I climb the stairs.
The heat and my sense of foreboding draw the darkness taut as glass.
―――Hah, hah, hah.
Still breathing hard, I reach the landing and move down the hall.
Pain needles my spine.
The foul pressure in the air grows heavier with every step toward Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I run up the stairs.

The heated air and sense of foreboding seem to stretch over the dark of night like glass.
----*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
Breathing heavily, I reach the top of the stairs and walk down the hallway.
…… My back hurts.
This terrible feeling in the air gets heavier as I draw near Akiha's room.

entries.japanese: ―――一階の西館……だったっけ？
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Was it the west wing on the first floor?
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Was it… the west wing on the first floor?

entries.japanese:
……電灯が消えてしまっていて、部屋の様子はよく判らない。
　ただ、ここが秋葉の部屋でない事だけははっきりとわかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
With the lights out, I can barely make out the room.
One thing, however, is perfectly clear: this is not Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The lights are off and I can't quite make out the details of the room.
But, I can tell right away it isn't Akiha's room.

entries.japanese:
「ここは琥珀さんの部屋じゃないか……！」
　暗がりの中で地団太を踏む。
　思い返してみれば、秋葉の部屋は俺の部屋と正反対の所にある。
という事は二階の東館の奥じゃないか。
「くっ……！」
　踵を返して廊下に出ようとして、なにか、床に倒れているものが見えた。
「………？」
　暗闇に目を凝らす。
　そこには――――ぐったりと床に倒れこんだ翡翠の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is Kohaku’s room!”
I stamp in frustration in the darkness.
Now that I think about it, Akiha’s room is on the exact opposite side from mine. That means it is at the far end of the east wing upstairs.
“Damn it!”
I spin toward the hall, then notice something lying on the floor.
“What…?”
I peer into the darkness.
There――――Hisui lies on the floor, limp and motionless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is Kohaku-san's room……!"
I kick the ground in the darkness.
Come to think of it, Akiha's room is exactly across from mine.
In other words, the east wing on the second floor.
"Gah……!"
As I turn around to exit into the hallway, I see something lying on the ground.
"………?"
I squint my eyes in the dark.
I see----Hisui's figure collapsed on the floor.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠――――！？」
　声をあげて駆け寄る。
「…………ん」
　翡翠は答えない。
　ただ安らかな寝息が唇から漏れている。
「眠ってる……のか？」
　信じられないけどそうらしい。
　翡翠は苦しそうな様子もなく、本当にただ眠ってしまっているだけのようだ。
　ただ、テーブルにはティーカップが倒れていて、中身の紅茶がこぼれていた。
　なんとなく、紅茶に睡眠薬が混ざっていて眠らされた、なんていう安っぽい想像が頭をよぎった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui――――!?”
I cry, rushing to her side.
“Mmm…”
She does not answer.
Only the soft sound of peaceful breathing escapes her lips.
“Is she asleep?”
Unbelievable as it seems, she is.
She shows no sign of pain; she truly appears to be merely sleeping.
But a teacup lies overturned on the table, its contents spilled.
A cheap, melodramatic explanation crosses my mind: someone drugged the tea and put her to sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui----!?"
I call out and run to her.
"…………… Mnh."
Hisui doesn't answer.
She's only peacefully breathing out in her sleep.
"Is she…… asleep?"
I can't believe it, but it seems so.
Hisui doesn't look like in pain.
She really does seem like she's sleeping.
Just, there's a teacup tipped over on the table with the contents spilled.
The easiest explanation is there was a sleeping drug mixed into her tea and she fell asleep.

entries.japanese:
「―――琥珀さんはいないのか」
　部屋に倒れているのは翡翠一人だ。
　……翡翠はただ眠っているだけのようだし、今は秋葉の無事を確認しなくてはいけない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Kohaku is not here?”
Hisui is the only person lying in the room.
She appears to be merely asleep, and right now I have to make sure Akiha is safe――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Kohaku-san isn't here?"
The only one collapsed in the room is Hisui.
…… Hisui seems to be just sleeping, so I have to make sure Akiha is safe----

entries.japanese:
……階段をあがっていく。
　高い気温と厭な予感が、夜の闇をガラスのようにはりつめさせている。
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
　荒い息遣いのまま階段をのぼりきって、廊下を歩く。
　……背筋が痛い。
　厭な空気は、秋葉の部屋に近づくたびに重くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I climb the stairs.
The heat and my sense of foreboding draw the darkness taut as glass.
―――Hah, hah, hah.
Still breathing hard, I reach the landing and move down the hall.
Pain needles my spine.
The foul pressure in the air grows heavier with every step toward Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I run up the stairs.

The heated air and sense of foreboding seem to stretch over the dark of night like glass.
----*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
Breathing heavily, I reach the top of the stairs and walk down the hallway…
…… My back hurts.
This terrible feeling in the air gets heavier as I draw near Akiha's room.

entries.japanese:
―――――二階の東館の一番奥。
　そこが秋葉の部屋だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――The very end of the east wing, on the second floor.
That is Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----The very back of the east wing on the second floor.
That's where Akiha's room is.

entries.japanese:
……階段をあがっていく。
　高い気温と厭な予感が、夜の闇をガラスのようにはりつめさせている。
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
　荒い息遣いのまま階段をのぼりきって、廊下を歩く。
　……背筋が痛い。
　厭な空気は、秋葉の部屋に近づくたびに重くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I climb the stairs.
The heat and my sense of foreboding draw the darkness taut as glass.
―――Hah, hah, hah.
Still breathing hard, I reach the landing and move down the hall.
Pain needles my spine.
The foul pressure in the air grows heavier with every step toward Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I run up the stairs.

The heated air and sense of foreboding seem to stretch over the dark of night like glass.
----*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
Breathing heavily, I reach the top of the stairs and walk down the hallway.
…… My back hurts.
This terrible feeling in the air gets heavier as I draw near Akiha's room.

entries.japanese: ―――――二階の西館だったハズだ。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――It should be the west wing on the second floor.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------It has to be the west wing on the second floor.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……我ながら、今ほど自分の馬鹿さかげんを痛感した事はない。
　二階の西館にあるのは俺の部屋だけで、あとはほとんどが空き部屋なんだ。
　同じ二階でも、秋葉の部屋はこことは正反対の東館の奥にある―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Never in my life have I felt my own stupidity so keenly.
My room is the only occupied bedroom in the west wing; almost every other room is empty.
Akiha’s room is on the same floor, but at the far end of the opposite east wing―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… If I say so myself, I've never felt so stupid before in my entire life.
The west wing on the second floor only has my room, the others being mostly empty.
It's on the same floor, but Akiha's room is exactly opposite of mine, in the east wing----

entries.japanese:
廊下を走る。
　高い気温と厭な予感が、夜の闇をガラスのようにはりつめさせている。
―――はあ、はあ、はあ。
　荒い息遣いのまま廊下を駆けていく。
　……背筋が痛い。
　厭な空気は、秋葉の部屋に近づくたびに重くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
I run down the corridor.
The heat and my sense of foreboding draw the darkness taut as glass.
―――Hah, hah, hah.
I race down the hall, breath tearing in and out of me.
Pain needles my spine.
The foul pressure in the air grows heavier with every step toward Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I race down the hallway.
The heated air and sense of foreboding seem to stretch over the dark of night like glass.
----*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
Breathing heavily, I dash down the hallway.
…… My back hurts.
This terrible feeling in the air gets heavier as I draw near Akiha's room.

entries.japanese:
――――秋葉の部屋についた。
　眩暈は耐えきれないほど強くなっている。
　ポケットに手をいれる。
　かろうじて幸運だったのか、ナイフはきちんと入っていた。
「――――――」
　眩暈をかみ殺して、ナイフを片手に扉を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I reach Akiha’s room.
The vertigo has grown almost unbearable.
I reach into my pocket.
By some stroke of luck, the knife is still there.
“――――――”
I bite back the vertigo and open the door, knife in one hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I reach Akiha's room.
The dizziness is getting unbearably stronger.
I put my hand in my pocket.
I'm lucky, as my knife is still there.
"------"
I ignore my dizziness and with the knife in my other hand, I open the door.

entries.japanese:
―――――闇。
　窓からさしこむ月光だけが、かろうじて部屋の様子を明らかにしている。
　その青い闇の中、倒れこんでいる秋葉の姿があった。
「秋葉――――！」
　かけつけて抱き起こす。
「…………………」
　秋葉は気を失っているのか、ぴくりとも動かない。
ただ、その小ぶりな胸がかすかに上下していて、息がある事だけが読み取れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Darkness.
Only the moonlight through the window gives the room any shape.
In that blue darkness, Akiha lies collapsed.
“Akiha――――!”
I rush to her and lift her into my arms.
“…”
Whether unconscious or worse, she does not move. Only the faint rise and fall of her chest tells me she is still breathing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Darkness.
The moonlight coming in from the window barely sheds enough light to see.
In the blue darkness, I see Akiha on the ground.
"Akiha----!"
I run to her and hold her up.
"…………………"
Akiha does not move, so she might be unconscious.
But I can tell she's alive as her small chest rises and falls with her breathing.

entries.japanese:
いや、そんな事よりもっとおかしな所がある。
　秋葉の長い黒髪。
それが、今では血のような赤に染まっていた。
「秋葉―――ほんとに秋葉……だよな？」
　……闇の中で赤色に見える髪。
　けれど、それでも秋葉は間違いなく秋葉だった。
「秋葉、おい、しっかりしろ……！
　いったいなにがあっ―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
No, something else is terribly wrong.
Akiha's long black hair. It has turned red as blood.
“Akiha―――you really are Akiha, right?”
Hair that shines red even in darkness.
Yet she is unmistakably Akiha.
“Akiha, wake up! What happened―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, there's something more strange.
Akiha's black hair.
It has turned into a bloody shade of red.
"Akiha---you're really Akiha…… right?"
…… The hair looks red in the darkness.
But, it's definitely Akiha.
"Akiha, hey, come on……!
What happen---"

entries.japanese:
がさり、という音がした。
「――――――！」
　振り返る。
　物音がした方角―――月の明かりがさしこむ窓際に、何か、異質なモノが立っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A rustle.
“――――――!”
I whirl around.
Beside the window, where moonlight spills in―――something alien stands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hear a noise.
"------!"
I turn back.
The direction the sound came from---there's, someone standing by the moonlit window.

entries.japanese:
……それは、全身を包帯で覆った人間のようだった。
「―――――誰だ」
　人影は答えない。
　……背骨にたれながされる、極度の悪寒。
　神経の中枢である脊髄をつたって、脳髄に知らされる死の気配。
entries.maoEnglish:
It resembles a human being wrapped from head to foot in bandages.
“―――――Who are you?”
The silhouette does not answer.
A terrible chill trickles down my spine.
A premonition of death races up my spinal cord—the core of my nervous system—and into my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It seems to be someone wrapped in bandages.
"------Who are you?"
The man does not answer.
…… A cold chill goes through my spine.
I feel death in my nerves.

entries.japanese:
……人影は、ただそこにいるだけで、壊れていた。
　明らかに常軌を逸した、ぎょろりと浮かび上がっている目。
　けれどそこには確かな知性が存在していて、包帯の人物は狂気と理性を同時に兼ね備えているように見える。
entries.maoEnglish:
The figure is broken simply by being there.
Its bulging eyes are unmistakably deranged, yet intelligence lives inside them.
The bandaged man seems to possess madness and reason in equal measure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The person is just there, broken.
Abnormal eyes that seem out of this world.
But there is some intelligence.
It seems the bandaged person has both intelligence and madness.

entries.japanese:
どくん、とはねあがる心臓。
　心拍数は限界をこえてあがっていく。
　反面、理性は死者のように冷めていく。
　この空気。
　空気を汚染し衰弱させていくこの死臭を知っている。
―――間違いない。
　今この部屋にあるのは、何度も夢でみた殺人の世界だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
My heart bucks violently.
My pulse races past its limit.
My reason, by contrast, cools into something corpse-like.
This air.
I know this stench of death that pollutes the air and saps it of strength.
―――There is no mistaking it.
This room has become the world of murder I have seen again and again in dreams.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My heart beats loudly.
It beats quicker.
All the while, my mind freezes like I was dead.
This feeling.
I know this feeling of death.
---I'm sure.
What's in this room right now is the world of murder I saw in my dreams.

entries.japanese:
「―――誰だと、聞いてる」
　ナイフを強く握って、人影を睨む。
　包帯の男はにやりと笑ったように見えた。
「さみしいな、志貴。
おまえは自分が殺した相手もおぼえていないのか」
　音をたてて、一歩だけ近づいてくる。
「――――っ！」
　秋葉を片手で抱きかかえて、引いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I asked who you are.”
I tighten my grip on the knife and glare.
The bandaged man seems to grin.
“How sad, Shiki. You do not even remember the man you killed?”
He takes one audible step toward me.
“――――!”
I retreat, gathering Akiha against me with one arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I asked you who you are."
I hold my knife and stare at the person.
The bandaged man appears to be smiling.
"I feel sad, Shiki.
You don't even remember the person you've killed?"
He steps toward me.
"-----!"
I back up, holding Akiha in one arm.

entries.japanese:
「わからないのか志貴。
オレは、おまえに殺された男だよ」
「なにを――――」
　男の声は、ただ聞いているだけで癇に障る。
　憎い。
……屋敷に入った時から感じていた憎しみが凝縮されて、この男に対して灌がれているように、憎い。
　この憎しみ。
排除しなくてはいけないという本能が、殺人衝動というものなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do you not understand, Shiki? I am the man you killed.”
“What are you――――”
The mere sound of his voice grates on my nerves.
I hate him. All the hatred I have felt since entering the estate seems to have condensed into a single stream directed at him.
This hatred. Is the instinct that tells me to eliminate him what they call a murderous impulse?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Can't you tell, Shiki?
I'm the guy you killed."
"What are you saying-----"
Just listening to his voice gets on my nerves.
I hate him.
…… The hatred I was feeling since I entered the mansion is concentrated on him.
This hatred.
Is my instinctual drive to remove him a homicidal impulse?

entries.japanese:
どぐん、という鼓動。
　俺の知らないところで、俺の体が叫んでいる。
　この男。
この存在は、殺すべき対象なのだと叫んでいる。
「―――そうか。
おまえが、吸血鬼か」
　秋葉を片手で抱きかかえたまま、もう片手でナイフを構えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
My heart hammers.
Somewhere beyond my awareness, my body is screaming.
This man. This thing is one I must kill.
“―――I see. You are the vampire.”
Still holding Akiha with one arm, I raise the knife in the other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My heart beats.
From somewhere inside me, my body screams.
It screams that this person must be killed.
"----I see.
You're the vampire."
Holding Akiha with one arm, I hold out my knife with the other.

entries.japanese:
ははは、と。
　男は声を押し殺して、心底楽しそうに笑った。
「やめておけ。
オレはおまえだ。
誰にも自身を殺すことは、できない」
「な―――なんだと……？」
「秋葉は返してもらうぞ。
本来、それはオレのものなんだからな」
　さらに一歩。
　男はこちらに近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
A stifled laugh.
The man laughs with wholehearted delight, keeping his voice low.
“Do not bother. I am you. No one can kill himself.”
“What―――did you say…?”
“I am taking Akiha back. She was mine to begin with.”
Another step.
The man comes closer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hahaha.
The man laughs as it was really funny.
"Don't even try.
I am you.
There's no one who can truly kill himself."
"W---what……?"
"I'm taking Akiha back.
She was mine to start with."
Another step.
The man comes closer.

entries.japanese:
「止まれ―――！」
「止まるものか。
オレはおまえから取り返しにきたんだからな。
名前も、立場も、その力も、すべてはオレだったものだ」
　男はゆっくりと両手を広げて、誇らしげに声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop―――!”
“I will not. I came to reclaim everything you stole from me: my name, my place, my power. All of it once belonged to me.”
He slowly spreads his arms and makes the declaration with pride.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop----!"
"I won't stop.
I came to get everything back from you.
Name, position, power… everything was mine."
The man opens his arms and talks proudly.

entries.japanese:
「……なにを言ってる。
おまえ―――おまえは、何だ」
「……まだ分からないのか。
まったく、ほんとうに薄情なヤツだ。
八年前。
俺とおまえは、あんなに仲が良かったのにな」
「え―――」
　八年前？
　あんなに、仲が、良かった―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you saying? What―――what are you?”
“You still do not know? Honestly, you are truly heartless. Eight years ago. You and I were such good friends.”
“What―――”
Eight years ago?
We were such good friends―――?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What are you saying?
You---what are you?"
"…… You still don't remember?
What a guy.
We were such good friends eight years ago."
"What----"
Eight years ago?
Such, good, friends----?

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、覚えていないのは仕方がないか。
あの親父のことだ、おまえに全てを忘れさせるための暗示は念をいれたものだったろうし」
「おまえ自身も―――忌まわしい記憶は忘れ去りたかったんだろうしなあ、志貴」
　男が笑う。
　視界が揺れる。
　八年前。
八年前。
八年前――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I suppose it is no surprise that you do not remember. Knowing that old man, he must have been thorough with the suggestion that made you forget everything.”
“And you―――you must have wanted to forget those hateful memories yourself, Shiki.”
The man laughs.
My vision sways.
Eight years ago. Eight years ago. Eight years ago――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I guess you forgot it.
It's that old man.
I bet he put a strong spell on you to make you forget."
"And I bet you yourself---wanted to forget about the ugly past, Shiki?"
He laughs.
My vision shakes.
Eight years ago, eight years ago, eight years ago-----

entries.japanese:
それは俺が事故に巻き込まれて病院に運ばれた頃。
　それは遠野の屋敷で、三人で遊ぶことが最後になった頃。
　それは――――あの中庭で、血にまみれた少年の姿があった時間――――
entries.maoEnglish:
That was when an accident sent me to the hospital.
That was when the three of us played together at the Tohno estate for the last time.
That was――――when a blood-soaked boy lay in the courtyard――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's the time I was sent to the hospital from that accident.
That was the last time the three of us played together in this mansion.
That was the time-----that child was there, and all the blood----

entries.japanese:
「だがそれも終わりだ。
今まで苦しかっただろう、志貴？
　待っていろ、すぐに楽にしてやる」
　男は、顔の包帯をゆっくりと解いていった。
　その中にある素顔、それは―――――
「お……まえ」
「久しぶりだな、遠野志貴。
いや、それは本当のおまえの名前じゃなかったか」
　包帯の下から出てきた素顔。
　それは――――血にまみれたあの少年ではなく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that ends now. It has been painful, has it not, Shiki? Wait there; I will put you out of your misery soon.”
The man slowly unwinds the bandages from his face.
The face beneath them is―――――
“You…”
“It has been a long time, Shiki Tohno. No, that was never your real name, was it?”
The face emerging from beneath the bandages.
It is not――――the blood-soaked boy from that day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But that's all ending now.
It was painful for you, right, Shiki?
Hold on, I'll save you."
The man slowly takes off the bandage around his head.
His face-----
"You…"
"It's been a while, Tohno Shiki.
No, that's not your real name."
The face that came out from the bandage,
it was----not the face of that bloody child but…

entries.japanese:
「遠野―――シキ」
　そうだ。
どうして忘れていたんだろう。
　むかし秋葉と一緒にいた彼。
三人目の子供は、たしかにそんな名前だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tohno―――SHIKI.”
Of course. How could I have forgotten?
The boy who used to be with Akiha. The third child had certainly borne that name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno----SHIKI."
Yes, why did I forget?
He was with Akiha back then.
The third kid's name was certainly that.

entries.japanese:
「そうだ。
本当に久しぶりだな、七夜志貴。
ようやく―――自分がニセモノだっていう事を思い出してくれたらしい」
　男―――シキは口元をつりあげて、心底から嬉しそうに笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. It has been a very long time, Shiki Nanaya. At last―――it seems you remember that you are the impostor.”
The man―――SHIKI pulls his lips into a smile of unalloyed delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, it's really been a long time, Nanaya Shiki.
You finally remembered that you were an impostor."
The man's---SHIKI's lips turn up into a smile and he laughs deeply.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　頭痛。
頭痛がする。
　フタが開く。
　頑丈に閉じられた、（誰に？
）
　見てはいけない、（何を？
）
　忘却が録音された箱が。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――”
Pain. My head is splitting.
The lid opens.
The thing sealed so tightly—by whom?
The thing I must never see—see what?
A box with oblivion recorded inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
Headache.
I have a headache.
The lid opens.
Which was sealed shut.
(By whom?)
I can't look at it.
(At what?)
The box of forgotten memories.

entries.japanese: ――――その全てを忘れろと、命じられた。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――I was ordered to forget it all.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----He commanded me to forget everything.

entries.japanese:
遠野槙久。
　俺を独りきりにしたその人物に、七夜志貴は養子にむかえられた。
　単に俺の名前と彼の息子の名前が同じだったという偶然が、彼には愉快に感じられたからだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Makihisa Tohno.
The man who left me all alone took Shiki Nanaya into his family.
Perhaps he found it amusing that his son and I happened to share the same given name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tohno Makihisa.
Nanaya Shiki was adopted by the person who made him alone.
Probably, because it was amusing to him that I had the same name as his son.

entries.japanese:
あれは、もう十年も過去の話。
　養子にとられた自分。
　連れてこられた見知らぬ屋敷。
　いつも、いつも他人だった家族たち。
　はなれの屋敷での生活。
　そこで知り合った少年と少女。
　三人で遊びまわった広い庭。
　夏の暑い日。
　恐ろしい影に襲われるあきは。
　ただ、助ける事しか考え付かなくて、自らの体を盾にしたあの瞬間――――
entries.maoEnglish:
It happened ten years ago now.
I was adopted.
Brought to an estate I had never seen.
Given a family who were always, always strangers.
Made to live in the detached house.
There I met a boy and a girl.
The three of us raced through the vast garden.
A hot summer day.
Akiha, attacked by a terrifying shadow.
The moment I could think of nothing but saving her and threw my own body in the way――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's something that happened ten years ago.
I was adopted.
I was brought into an unknown mansion.
My family were always people I didn't know.
My life in the detached building.
The boy and the girl I met.
The big garden we played around in.
A hot summer day.
Akiha getting attacked by a shadow.
I could only think about helping her, and the moment I used myself as a shield----

entries.japanese: ――――その全てを、忘れろと命じられた。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――I was ordered to forget all of it.
entries.mirrorMoon: ----I was commanded to forget everything.

entries.japanese:
遠野槙久に。
　自分の父親に。
　今から自分は七夜志貴としてではなく、遠野志貴として暮らしていくのだと命じられて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
By Makihisa Tohno.
By my father.
Ordered that from then on I would live not as Shiki Nanaya, but as Shiki Tohno―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
By Tohno Makihisa.
By my own father.
He commanded me to live as Tohno Shiki and not Nanaya Shiki and---

entries.japanese:
「――――、…………っ！」
　眩暈、吐き気。
　混濁する記憶が、脳髄の中を跳ねまわる。
　どさり、という音。
　自分の体がいうことをきかない。
　せっかく抱き上げた秋葉を床に放って、俺は、はあはあと情けない声をあげて、ナイフを抱きしめるように握っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――…!”
Vertigo, nausea.
Confused memories ricochet through my skull.
A heavy thud.
My body will no longer obey me.
I drop Akiha onto the floor despite having just lifted her, panting helplessly as I clutch the knife against myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------, …………!!"
Dizziness, Sickness.
Mixed memories run through my head.
Thump.
I can't control my body.
I throw Akiha on the ground, and embrace my knife as I pant for air.

entries.japanese:
「―――ショックか？
　ああ、そりゃあショックだろうな。
今まで遠野志貴だって思い込んでいたぶん、自分がニセモノだって解った時の衝撃は格別だろう……！」
　あはは、と笑うシキ。
「だがな、そんなものはオレに比べれば生易しい。
　オレはな、志貴。
親友だと思っていたおまえに殺され、遠野志貴という名前さえ横取りされ、秋葉まで―――オレの秋葉までおまえに奪われてしまった……！
　その屈辱がおまえに解るか！」
「殺、した―――？
　俺が、おまえを―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――In shock? Of course you are. After all these years believing yourself to be Shiki Tohno, discovering you are an impostor must be quite a blow!”
SHIKI laughs.
“But that is nothing compared to what I have endured.
Listen, Shiki. You killed me, the man who thought you his best friend; you stole even the name Shiki Tohno, and then Akiha―――even my Akiha was taken from me…! Do you understand that humiliation?”
“Killed―――? I killed you―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Is it shocking?
I bet it is.
It should have been a big shock to know that you were an impostor, since you thought you were Tohno Shiki this whole time……!"
SHIKI laughs.
"But, that's nothing compared to me.
You know, Shiki, I was killed by the person I thought was my best friend and even had the name Tohno Shiki taken away from me.
You even took Akiha---my Akiha……!
Can you understand how I felt!?"
"Killed----?
I, you----"

entries.japanese:
「そうだ。
まあ、先に殺したのはオレのほうだが、結果としておまえはオレを殺したんだよ。
　まだ思い出せないのか志貴。
八年前のあの日、オレは自分の血に負けておまえを殺した。
その胸の傷痕を見ろよ。
この腕でさあ、おまえの胸を串刺しにしてやっただろう？」
「胸の、傷――――」
　それは、事故で。
　何かの事故に巻き込まれたものだって、教えられてきたモノ―――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Granted, I killed you first, but in the end you killed me.
Do you still not remember, Shiki? That day eight years ago, my own blood overcame me and I killed you. Look at the scar on your chest. I drove this arm straight through you, did I not?”
“The scar on my chest――――”
That was from an accident.
That was what I had always been told―――――.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right.
I killed you first, but the end result was, you killed me.
Can't you recall yet?
Eight years ago on that day, I lost to my blood and killed you.
Look at that scar on your chest.
I took this arm and pierced right through you."
"Scar on my chest----"
That was in an accident.
I was told I got that from an accident-----

entries.japanese:
「そうだ。
もっとも、その後でオレは親父に殺されかけたがな。
　ようやく遠野寄りの血に覚醒したっていうのに、あとはそのまま地下牢に幽閉されて、八年間も闇の中にいたわけだ。
―――あのクソ親父、遠野寄りになった体を人間に戻せたら外に出してやるなんて言いやがって……！
　それまで遠野志貴が不在じゃ面倒だろうとな、オレの代わりに養子であるおまえを遠野志貴にしたてあげたんだ、アイツは」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is right. Though afterward, the old man nearly killed me too.
Even though the Tohno blood in me had finally awakened, I was locked in an underground cell and left in darkness for eight years.
―――That bastard promised to let me out if he could turn my Tohno body human again…! Since it would be inconvenient for Shiki Tohno to remain absent until then, he turned you, his adopted son, into Shiki Tohno in my place.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, the old man almost killed me afterwards, though.
The Tohno blood finally awakened inside me, but I was imprisoned underground, and lived in the dark for eight years.
---That damn old man.
He said he'd let me out if I returned to being a human…!
He thought it would be inconvenient for Tohno Shiki to be gone, so he made you into Tohno Shiki."

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　……つまり。
　十年前にいた養子っていうのは、他でもない俺の事だったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
In other words.
The adopted child from ten years ago was none other than me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… So,
the adopted kid that was here ten years ago was me.

entries.japanese:
「わかるか志貴。
オレはおまえに殺されたんだ。
　オレはこうしてここに生きている。
なのに遠野志貴としてのおまえがいる。
　オレにはな、もう帰る場所が存在しないんだ。
　遠野志貴という名前も、立場も、最愛の妹さえも、自分の存在意義さえも貴様に奪われた。
　オレという遠野シキはな、おまえという遠野志貴によって殺されたんだ」
　一歩。
　光るような殺意のこもった眼をして、シキはこちらに近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do you understand, Shiki? I was killed by you.
I am alive. Yet here you stand as Shiki Tohno.
There is nowhere left for me to return to.
You stole the name Shiki Tohno, my place in this family, my beloved sister, even my reason for being.
I, the real Shiki Tohno, was killed by the Shiki Tohno you became.”
One step.
Eyes bright with murderous intent, SHIKI advances.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you get it, Shiki?
I was killed by you.
I'm alive right now, but you're Tohno Shiki.
I have no place to go back to.
My name as Tohno Shiki, my position, my dear sister, and even my existence was taken away by you.
I, as Tohno SHIKI, was killed by you, Tohno Shiki."
A step.
He starts to walk towards me with glaring eyes.

entries.japanese:
「さあ―――これで話はおしまいだ。
志貴、おまえは本来なら八年前に死んでいたんだ。
ならばもう十分だろう。
そろそろ、本来の関係に戻ろうじゃないか」
「――――本来の、関係、だと――――？」
「そうだ。
オレは遠野志貴に戻り、おまえは―――もとの死者に戻れっていう事だ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come now―――that ends our talk. Shiki, you should have died eight years ago. You have had long enough. Is it not time we returned to our proper relationship?”
“――――Our proper relationship――――?”
“Exactly. I will return to being Shiki Tohno, and you―――will return to being dead!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here---that's the end of the story.
Shiki, you should have died eight years ago.
You've had enough, right?
Let's go back to the way things were eight years ago."
"-----The way things were-----?"
"Yes.
I return to being Tohno Shiki, and you return----to the dead person you were!"

entries.japanese:
だん、という衝撃。
　シキの一撃で廊下まで弾き飛ばされた。
「あ――――」
　背中を壁に打ちつけた。
　息がうまく出来ない。
　頭もまだ―――混乱したままで、動いてくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
A crushing impact.
One blow from SHIKI hurls me into the hallway.
“Ah――――”
My back slams against the wall.
I cannot breathe.
My mind is still―――still confused, refusing to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A big impact.
I was blown out to the hallway with one strike from SHIKI.
"A------"
My back strikes the wall.
I can't breathe.
My head, I---still can't think straight.

entries.japanese:
「く―――――」
　気配が近づく。
　秋葉の部屋から、シキの体が飛び出してくる。
「チィ―――！」
　シキの声が聞こえる。
　ヤツの武器もナイフなのか、咄嗟に繰り出したこちらのナイフとヤツのナイフがつばぜり合った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh―――――”
His presence closes in.
SHIKI bursts out of Akiha's room.
“Tch―――!”
SHIKI snarls.
He has a knife too; his blade meets the one I thrust out by reflex, and they lock at the guards.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ku-----"
I can sense him coming.
SHIKI jumps out from Akiha's room.
"Damn----!"
I can hear SHIKI.
His weapon also happens to be a knife, and my knife joins his in a deadly competition.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はっ、はっ―――」
　息があがる。
　吐き気が止まらない。
　それでも、迷っている暇なんて、ない。
　俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah―――”
My breath comes ragged.
The nausea will not stop.
Even so, there is no time left for hesitation.
I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I gasp for air.
I'm out of breath.
I still feel sick.
But, I don't have time to think.
I----

entries.japanese:
―――自分の事を考えるのなんて、二の次だ。
　確かな事はコイツがすべての元凶だという事。
　街で何人も人を殺して血を吸っているのも。
　先輩を傷つけて、その体を犯そうとしたのも。
　……弓塚を。
　弓塚を吸血鬼にして、あんな苦しみを背負わせたのも。
　全部。
全部、この『敵』の仕業に他ならないのなら―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――What happens to me comes second.
One thing is certain: he is the cause of all of it.
The people he has murdered throughout the city and drained of blood.
Ciel, whom he wounded and whose body he tried to violate.
Yumizuka.
Turning Yumizuka into a vampire and condemning her to that suffering.
All of it. If every last thing was the work of this enemy―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I should not consider my own safety.
The only sure thing is that this guy is the reason for everything going on.
The one sucking the blood out of all the people in town.
The one that hurt Senpai and tried to rape her.
…… And Yumizuka.
The one who turned Yumizuka into a vampire and made her suffer like that.
Everything.
Everything is this "enemy's" fault.
Then----

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　ぎり、と歯を噛んで、憎しみを押さえ付ける。
　できるだけ冷静になろうと努めて、メガネを外した。
　――――始めよう。
　幸い、命のやりとりはこれで三度目。
　いい加減、どう動けばいいのかはイヤというほど解っていた―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
I grind my teeth and force down my hatred.
Struggling to remain as calm as I can, I remove my glasses.
――――Let’s begin.
This will be my third fight to the death.
By now, I know how to move in a fight like this all too well―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
I grit my teeth and hold on to my hatred.
Trying to cool myself down, I take off my glasses.
----Let's get started.
Fortunately, this is my third time fighting in a life-or-death situation.
By now, I know more than enough about how exactly I should be moving---.

entries.japanese:
―――何より秋葉の安全を確保するべきだ。
　ここで、秋葉が倒れているこの部屋でコイツと争うのは危険すぎる。
もっと広いところ……ロビーあたりにまで出ないといけない―――
「くっ……………！」
　ナイフを構えたまま、後ろも見ずに廊下へと下がる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Before anything else, I have to get Akiha to safety.
Fighting him here, in the room where Akiha lies unconscious, is far too dangerous. I have to draw him somewhere larger, out into the lobby―――
“Ghh…!”
Keeping my knife raised, I retreat into the corridor without once looking behind me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I should worry about Akiha's safety most of all.
It's too dangerous to fight near Akiha.
I need to move to somewhere bigger, like the lobby---
"Ku……………!"
Still holding my knife, I jump back without looking.

entries.japanese:
「っ………！」
　シキのナイフがこめかみをかすっていく。
　幸い傷はない。
　ただ、メガネが弾き飛ばされただけで―――
「き―――さま………！」
　どくん、と心臓が高鳴った。
　視界が『死』に覆われる。
　逃げ腰だった意識に敵意、憎悪が芽生えてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…!”
SHIKI’s knife skims my temple.
Fortunately, I am not cut.
It only knocks my glasses away―――
“You―――bastard!”
My heart slams once against my ribs.
Death floods my vision.
Hostility and hatred take root in the part of me that had wanted only to flee.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………!!"
SHIKI's knife slashes in front of my face.
Fortunately, I did not get cut.
But, he hits my glasses off----
"Y----ou bastard………!!"
My heart pounds loudly.
"Death" covers my view.
Hatred takes over my mind.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――はっ、は――――」
　息があがる。
　シキが襲い掛かってくる。
　ならば、いまさら迷うことなんてありえない。
　――――いいだろう。
　幸い、命のやりとりはこれで三度目。
　いい加減、どう動けばいいのかはイヤというほど解っていた―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah, hah――――!”
My breath comes fast.
SHIKI is attacking me.
There is no room left for hesitation.
――――Fine, then.
This will be my third fight to the death.
By now, I know how to move in a fight like this all too well―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I gasp for air.
My breathing goes wild.
SHIKI attacks.
In that case, there's nothing to be afraid of now.
----Not a problem.
Fortunately, this is my third time fighting in a life-or-death situation.
By now, I know more than enough about how exactly I should be moving---.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ―――はあ――――」
　ぽたり、ぽたりと汗が落ちる。
　体のいたるところにナイフを振るわれたが、幸い、致命傷は負ってはいない。
　吐く息が荒いのは、ただ、限界以上に体を動かしている代償だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah―――hah――――!”
Sweat drips steadily to the floor.
His knife has opened cuts all over my body, but fortunately none of them are fatal.
My breathing is ragged only because I have driven my body far past its limits.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*---*pant*---*pant*----
Sweat drips down to the ground.
His knife swings at every part of my body, but I have fortunately not received any fatal wounds.
I am breathing hard because I move my body past its limits.

entries.japanese:
「解せん――――」
　……目の前の敵は、忌々しげに息をはく。
「なぜだ―――どうしてただの人間のおまえを殺せない……？
　なぜおまえに、ここまでの殺傷能力が備わっているのだ、志貴！」
　敵の目には怒りがある。
　おそらく、簡単に仕留められるとふんでいた獲物に抵抗された苛立ちだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I do not understand――――”
The enemy before me exhales in disgust.
“Why―――why can I not kill a mere human…? Why do you possess such a capacity for killing, Shiki!”
There is fury in his eyes.
It is probably the frustration of a hunter whose supposedly helpless prey has the nerve to resist.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't understand----"
…… The enemy in front of me breathes out in annoyance.
"Why---why can't I kill just an ordinary human being?
Why is your killing ability so high, Shiki!?"
There is anger in his eyes.
He's probably irritated from all this unexpected resistance by something that should be easy prey.

entries.japanese:
「はあ―――はあ――――はあ――――」
　心臓が、苦しい。
　いくらアイツの手口を夢で見ていたといっても、そもそも体の能力が違う。
　ナイフでアイツのナイフを防ぐのが精一杯で、ヤツの『線』を引くのは難しい。
―――もっとも。
　相討ちでいいのなら、それこそたやすくアイツの息の根を止められるのだが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah――――hah――――!”
My heart is in agony.
I may have seen his methods in my dreams, but our physical capabilities are fundamentally different.
Parrying his knife with mine takes everything I have, and tracing his line is all but impossible.
―――Still.
If I am willing to die with him, ending his life would be easy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My heavy breathing fills the air.
My chest hurts.
Even though I have seen his killings already in my dreams, our abilities are naturally different.
It's already hard enough to block his attacks, and it's almost impossible to attack his "lines".
---But.
If I didn't care to avoid mutual death, I could easily kill him.

entries.japanese:
「―――よかろう、遊びは終わりだ。
おまえと同じナイフで仕留めてやろうとしたんだがな、やはりなれないエモノは使うものじゃなかった」
　敵はナイフを床に捨てる。
　ぎらり、と。
　闇の中で光る、ケモノじみた鋭い爪。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Very well, playtime is over. I thought I would finish you with the same kind of knife you use, but an unfamiliar weapon is never worth the trouble.”
The enemy drops his knife to the floor.
A glint flashes in the darkness.
Sharp, bestial claws gleam there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Alright.
Enough playing around.
I tried to finish you off with the same weapon you had, but I shouldn't have used something I'm not used to using."
The enemy throws down his knife.
Slash.
The sharp, animal-like nails shine in the night.

entries.japanese:
「結局はこれか。
八年前と同じというのは、あまりに芸がないんだがな」
　笑って、敵は構えをといた。
――――どくん、という音。
　本気になったヤツの動きにはついていけない、と体が理解してる。
　ヤツが襲いかかってくる姿は、おそらく視認さえできないだろう。
　気がついた時には、こっちの体に穴が空いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So it comes to this after all. Repeating what happened eight years ago is hardly original, though.”
Laughing, the enemy drops his stance.
――――Thump.
My body already understands that I cannot keep pace once he becomes serious.
I probably will not even see him attack.
By the time I notice anything, there will be a hole through my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So it's this after all.
It's really dull to use the same thing as eight years ago."
The enemy smiles and frees his stance.
----Thump.
My heart beats.
My body knows I won't be able to keep up with him once he gets serious.
I probably won't be even able to see him attacking me.
The first thing I will realize, is that my body has a hole in it.

entries.japanese:
――――どくん。
　死の気配が増してくる。
　このままでは確実に殺されるという危機感。
　だが、恐怖はまったくなかった。
　増していく危機感に比例して、体中の軋みが強くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Thump.
The presence of death grows stronger.
The certainty that if this continues, he will kill me.
Yet I feel no fear.
As the danger mounts, every joint and sinew in my body begins to creak more violently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thump.
The presence of death increases.
The sense of impending death is upon me.
But, I have no fear.
The cracking inside my body grows proportionally with the sense of crisis.

entries.japanese:
「はあ――――はあ―――――はあ―――――」
　熱い痛み。
　それは限界まで弦をひく弓に等しい。
　自分自身にもどうしようもなく押さえられない殺人衝動。
　おそらく―――それは次の瞬間に放たれて、確実にシキを殺す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――hah―――――hah―――――!”
A burning pain.
The strain of a bow drawn to the very limit.
A murderous impulse I cannot restrain, not even within myself.
In the next instant, it will be released―――and it will kill SHIKI without fail.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Panting.
Burning pain.
Just like a bow pulled to the limit.
A homicidal impulse that I cannot control.
Most likely---it will be released in a moment and kill SHIKI for sure.

entries.japanese:
「じゃあな志貴。
秋葉は俺のものだ。
今度はおまえが、果てることのない闇に落ちろ―――！」
　敵の体が消える。
　張り詰められた弓の弦が引かれる。
―――だが、その直前。
　俺とシキの間に、割って入ってくる人影があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye, Shiki. Akiha is mine. This time, you will be the one to fall into endless darkness―――!”
The enemy’s body vanishes.
The bowstring inside me draws taut.
―――But just before it can be released.
A figure steps between SHIKI and me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So long, Shiki.
Akiha is mine.
This time, you go to hell---!"
The enemy's body disappears.
The strained bow is released.
---But before that,
someone comes in between me and SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　……それは、赤い髪をなびかせた秋葉だった。
　秋葉は俺を庇うようにシキの前に立ちはだかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
It is Akiha, her red hair streaming behind her.
She plants herself in SHIKI’s path, shielding me with her body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
…… It was Akiha, with her flowing red hair.
Akiha stands in front of SHIKI as if to protect me.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉。
なんのつもりだ」
　秋葉は答えない。
――――その背中。
　秋葉の赤い髪を前にして、俺の中の血はざわざわと騒ぎ始める。
「……どくんだ、秋葉。
おまえの本当の兄はオレだ。
そんなニセモノにかまってやる必要はない」
　秋葉は答えない。
――――その背中。
　秋葉の赤い髪を前にして、俺の中の血はざわざわと騒ぎ始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. What do you think you are doing?”
Akiha does not answer.
――――Her back.
At the sight of Akiha’s red hair, the blood inside me begins to stir and whisper.
“Move, Akiha. I am your real brother. There is no need to concern yourself with that counterfeit.”
Akiha does not answer.
――――Her back.
At the sight of Akiha’s red hair, the blood inside me begins to stir and whisper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha, what are you doing?"
Akiha does not answer.
----Her back.
With Akiha's red hair in front of me, I start feeling excited.

"…… Move, Akiha.
I am your real brother.
You don't have to worry about this impostor."
Akiha does not answer.
----Her back.
With Akiha's red hair in front of me, I start feeling excited.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉、あんまりオレを悲しませないでくれ。
オレは、おまえだけを大切に思っているんだ」
「……いやです。
どきません」
　秋葉は首をふって、はっきりとシキを拒絶した。
「……秋葉！」
「さがりなさい。
あなたが兄さんを殺すというのなら、その前に私があなたを殺す。
　遠野の当主の役割は、あなたのようなモノを消去する事ですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, please do not hurt me like this. You are the only one who matters to me.”
“No. I will not move.”
Akiha shakes her head and rejects SHIKI without hesitation.
“Akiha!”
“Step back. If you intend to kill my brother, I will kill you first.
It is the duty of the head of the Tohno family to eradicate things like you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha, don't make me sad.
You are the only important person for me."
"…… No.
I won't move."
Akiha shakes her head and clearly rejects SHIKI.
"…… Akiha!"
"Move back.
If you say you are going to kill Nii-san, I will kill you first.
The role of the head of the Tohno family is to eliminate people like you."

entries.japanese:
「なにを―――何を言っているんだ秋葉！
　おまえはあんなにオレを待っていたじゃないか。
　いつも、いつも見ていたぞ。
兄であるオレを待ち続けるおまえの姿があったから、オレはここに帰ってきたんだ。
　あのクソ親父を殺してようやく自由になったのは全ておまえの為なんだぞ。
　だっていうのに、どうしてそんなニセモノを庇うんだ、おまえは！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What―――what are you saying, Akiha?
You waited for me all those years! I was always watching you. I saw you waiting, always waiting, for your brother, and that is why I came home.
I killed that bastard father of ours and finally won my freedom, all for you.
So why are you protecting that counterfeit?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What---what are you saying, Akiha!
You were waiting for me for so long.
I was always, always watching.
I came back because you were waiting for your brother.
I killed that old man and became free just for you.
But why are you protecting that impostor!?"

entries.japanese:
「……たしかに、私は兄さんを待っていました。
けどそれはあなたなんかじゃない。
遠野の血に負けて、ただの殺人鬼になったあなたは八年前に死ぬべきだったんです」
「あ―――秋葉、おまえは実の兄に死ねっていうのか？
　違うんだ、そいつは違うんだ。
騙されるな、おまえの兄はオレだけなんだ。
いいか、そこの男はただの―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was waiting for my brother, yes, but not for you. You surrendered to the Tohno blood and became nothing more than a murderer. You should have died eight years ago.”
“A―――Akiha, would you tell your own brother to die? No, you are wrong; that man is not your brother. Do not be deceived; I am your only brother. That man is nothing but―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Indeed, I was waiting for Nii-san.
But that is not you.
You lost against the Tohno blood and became just a killer.
You should have died on that day eight years ago."
"A---Akiha, you're telling your own brother to die?
No, that's not right.
I am your only brother.
Listen to me, that guy is just a---"

entries.japanese:
「黙りなさい……！
　それ以上兄さんを侮辱するのは許さないわ。
あなたに―――あなたなんかに、もう二度と兄さんは殺させない……！」
「あき―――は」
　シキの体がよろめく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Silence…! I will not allow you to insult my brother any further. I will never let you―――someone like you kill him again…!”
“Aki―――ha.”
SHIKI’s body sways.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Silence……!
I will not allow any more insults against Nii-san.
I---I am not going to let you kill Nii-san again……!"
"Aki---ha."
SHIKI staggers.

entries.japanese:
「やめろ―――そいつはただのニセモノじゃないか。
そんなヤツを庇って―――オレを、これ以上裏切らないでくれ、秋葉」
「―――――――」
　秋葉は答えない。
　ただ激しい敵意をシキに向けるだけで。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop―――he is only a counterfeit. Do not protect someone like that―――do not betray me any more than you already have, Akiha.”
“―――――――”
Akiha offers no answer.
She only fixes SHIKI with a gaze of blazing hostility.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop---He's just an impostor.
Don't betray me for such a guy, Akiha."
"------"
Akiha doesn't answer.
She just confronts SHIKI with fierce aggression.

entries.japanese:
「あきは―――おまえまで、オレを裏切るのか、あきは――――」
　じり、という音。
　血走った目でシキは俺と―――秋葉を敵視する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――are you going to betray me too, Akiha――――?”
A foot scrapes across the floor.
With bloodshot eyes, SHIKI turns his hostility on me and―――on Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha---are you going to betray me too, Akiha---"
SHIKI takes a step.
SHIKI looks at me---and Akiha with bloodshot eyes.

entries.japanese:
「……これが最後だ。
どけ、秋葉。
