It's so exhausted, I'm practically numb.

entries.japanese:
「は…………あ」
　ずっ、と引きずるように足を動かす。
　体はとっくに限界を迎えていて、自分が人形になってしまった気がするぐらい、うまく動いてくれない。
　こんな体では何も出来はしないだろう、と理性は悲観的なコトばかりを考える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah… ah.”
I dragged one foot forward.
My body had passed its limits and obeyed so poorly that I felt like a puppet.
My rational mind could think of nothing but the bleak conclusion that in this condition, I could accomplish nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah………… h."
I drag my legs.
My body has reached its limit and doesn't move like I want it to.
My mind thinks negatively, telling me I can't do anything with such a body.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　だが、血のめぐりの熱さがそれらを全て否定する。
　どくん、どくん、という心音。
　鼓動だけが高い。
　月の下、神経が研ぎ澄まされていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
But the heat racing through my blood denied them all.
Thud. Thud.
Only my heartbeat rang loud.
Beneath the moon, every nerve grew sharper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
But my burning blood denies all those ideas.
My loud heartbeat.
Only my pulse is high.
Under the moon, my concentration is sharpened.

entries.japanese:
―――ただ、自然にここに来た。
　間違いはない。
　どくん、と膨張する心臓。
　喉が熱い。
　肉体は疲れきって、ただ生きているというコトを維持するだけに全ての機能を費やしている。
　こんな体で戦う、なんて行為は自殺と同意か。
　だが怖れは感じない。
　手に持ったナイフの重みに指が痺れる。
　神経が剥き出しになったような、この感覚。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I had simply come here, as though it were the most natural thing in the world.
There was no mistaking it.
My heart swelled with one heavy thud.
My throat burned.
Every function of my exhausted body was devoted merely to keeping me alive.
To fight in this condition—was that any different from suicide?
Yet I felt no fear.
The weight of the knife numbed my fingers.
My nerves felt stripped bare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I just came here naturally.
There's no mistake.
My heart beats loudly.
My throat burns.
My body is exhausted and uses all its energy to stay alive.
It's suicidal to fight like this.
But I feel no fear.
My fingers are paralyzed by the weight of my knife.
My nerves feel frayed.

entries.japanese:
―――懐かしい。
　この感覚には覚えがある。
　以前、何度か味わった感覚。
　夢の中でアイツが人を殺す時に味わった血の昂ぶりと、はるかむかしに、こんな、コトがあった気がする――――
「ぐっ――――」
　長くはもたない。
　離れの中に足を進ませた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It was familiar.
I knew this sensation.
I had felt it several times before.
The fever in my blood when he killed people in my dreams—and somewhere in the distant past, I had the feeling something like this had happened—
“Ghh—”
I wouldn’t last long.
I forced myself into the detached house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---What a familiar sensation.
I remember this feeling.
I felt it so many times already.
The feeling "he" had when he killed in the dream, and a long time ago, I think I had this feeling too----
"Gu----"
I won't last long.
I head into the detached building.

entries.japanese:
―――不思議と。
　その光景を見ても、心は何も感じなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Strangely enough.
Even the sight before me stirred nothing in my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Strangely enough,
I did not feel anything when I saw it.

entries.japanese:
「―――――シキ」
「貴様――――か」
　ゆらりと、シキが体を起こす。
　そこにあるのは、二つの人影だけだ。
　一つはシキという名の吸血鬼。
　もう一つは、血のように赤い髪をした、一人の少女。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—SHIKI.”
“So—it’s you.”
SHIKI slowly raised himself upright.
There were only two figures in the room.
One was the vampire called SHIKI.
The other was a girl whose hair was red as blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----SHIKI."
"It's---you."
SHIKI gets up slowly.
There's only two people there.
One is a vampire called SHIKI.
Another is a red-haired girl.

entries.japanese:
「――――よく来たな。
もう来ないものかと思ったぞ、志貴」
「――――――」
　心が動かない。
　シキの背後には、秋葉がいる。
　ぼんやりと、死んだような目をして、壁にぐったりと背中をあずけている。
　シキに着せられたのか、秋葉は着物姿だった。
　そのカタチ。
　まるで意思のない人形のような、秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—So you came after all. I’d begun to think you wouldn’t, Shiki.”
“……”
My heart did not move.
Akiha was behind SHIKI,
slumped against the wall with vacant, dead eyes.
Perhaps SHIKI had dressed her; she wore a kimono.
That figure.
Akiha was like a puppet with no will of her own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Welcome, Shiki.
I thought you wouldn't make it."
"------"
My mind does not feel anything.
Akiha is there behind SHIKI.
Her eyes look dead as she rests on the wall.
Maybe SHIKI put it on, but she is wearing a kimono.
That thing.
Akiha is like a mindless doll.

entries.japanese:
はあ、と大きく息をもらした。
　不思議と、何も感じない。
　あんなふうになってしまっている秋葉と同じように、俺も人形になってしまったみたいに、何も感じない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I let out one long breath.
Strangely, I felt nothing.
Like Akiha in that state, I seemed to have become a doll myself, incapable of feeling anything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I let out a big breath.
I do not feel anything.

It's like I have turned into a doll like Akiha, feeling nothing.

entries.japanese:
「―――だが遅かったな。
秋葉は確かに返してもらったぞ」
　シキが歩み寄ってくる。
「シキ。
おまえ、何をしたいんだ」
　ナイフを構えて、そう問うた。
　シキは愉快そうに笑いをかみ殺す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—But you’re too late. I got Akiha back.”
SHIKI approached.
“SHIKI. What is it you want?”
I raised my knife as I asked.
He smothered a laugh of delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But you're too late.
I've got Akiha back."
SHIKI walks toward me.
"SHIKI, what do you want to do?"
I ask him as I raise my knife.
SHIKI tries to hold in his laughter as he talks.

entries.japanese:
「さあな。
オレにだってそんなことはわからない。
シキっていうオレの目的は秋葉だけだ。
汚らしい雑種どもの血を吸うのなんて、オレの趣味じゃない」
「……そうか。
そのわりには見境なしだったじゃないか、おまえは」
「ああ、まったくその通りだ。
だが仕方あるまい？
　アレはオレの意思じゃないんだから。
　……響いてくるんだよ、志貴。
　際限なく、殺し、奪い、壊し尽くせっていう考えがな。
オレはそれに従っているだけさ。
理由なんて解らない」
「……ひどいな。
もうよくは思い出せないけど、昔のおまえはそんなヤツじゃなかったよ、シキ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Who knows? I don’t understand it myself. The part of me called SHIKI wants only Akiha. Drinking the blood of filthy mongrels was never to my taste.”
“…That didn’t stop you from attacking anyone you pleased.”
“No, it certainly didn’t. But what choice did I have? That wasn’t my will.”
“It echoes inside me, Shiki.
A thought that says kill without end, take without end, destroy everything. I merely obey it. I don’t know why.”
“…That’s terrible. I can hardly remember anymore, but you weren’t like this in the old days, SHIKI.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Beats me.
I don't even know.
My purpose as SHIKI is to get Akiha.
I have no intention of sucking any of the low-lifes' blood."
"…… I see.
But for that, you were pretty random back then."
"Yes, you're so right.
But it can't be helped, that wasn't my intent.
…… It tells me, Shiki.
To kill, deprive, and destroy all.
I'm just following that.
I don't know why."
"…… That's awful.
I don't remember much but you weren't like that before, SHIKI."

entries.japanese:
「ああ。
八年前のあの日から、オレはいかれちまったのさ。
このあたまの中にはもう一人、おかしな同居人がいる。
そいつが言うんだ。
全てを、殺せと」
　言って、シキは笑った。
　ぎしぎしは音をたてて回転する歯車のように、際限なく笑い続ける。
―――そこに。
　人間らしい翳りなんていうものは、微塵も存在していない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I went mad that day eight years ago. There’s another tenant in my skull now, a strange one. It tells me to kill everything.”
SHIKI laughed.
He went on laughing without end, like gears turning with a tortured creak.
―――In that laughter.
There was not the faintest trace of anything human.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I went crazy from that day eight years ago.
There's a weird guy in my head and he tells me to kill everything."
Saying that, SHIKI laughs.
He keeps on laughing like wheels turning indefinitely.
---There,
I can't find one bit of humanity.

entries.japanese:
「……最後に聞くけど。
おまえは、今の自分が痛くないのか」
「痛い……？
　まさか、オレは完全だ。
こうしている自分を愛しているよ。
　まあ、しいていうのなら退屈だっていう事が不満だったが、それもこれで解決したよ。
　今までは雑種どもを食う、なんていう愉しみしかなかったが、そんなものはこれまでだ。
秋葉が戻ってきた以上、もう雑種で遊ぶ暇なんてなくなったからな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…One last question. Doesn’t it hurt to be what you are now?”
“Hurt? Don’t be absurd. I am perfect. I adore what I’ve become.
If I had one complaint, it was the boredom, and even that has been cured.
Until now my only diversion was feeding on mongrels, but that ends today. Now that Akiha is back, I’ll have no time left to play with them.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… This is my last question.
Aren't you feeling any pain?"
"Pain……?
No way.
I'm perfect.
I love myself for doing this.
Well, I could say I was bored, but I've already solved that.
Until now, my only fun was to eat those low-lifes, but that's over since Akiha's back.
Now I have no time to play with those toys."

entries.japanese:
シキは満足そうに喉をならす。
―――聞くだけ無駄だった。
　けど、それでも聞いておきたかった。
　弓塚が――――彼女が、コイツのように自分の意思とは無関係に吸血鬼になんてモノになってしまった彼女が、最後まで苦しんでいた『人間』としての痛みを、コイツは持っているのかっていう事を。
entries.maoEnglish:
SHIKI purred with satisfaction.
―――It had been pointless to ask.
Yet I had needed to ask.
Yumizuka had been turned into a vampire against her will, just as he had, and suffered to the very end from the pain of remaining human. I had wanted to know whether any of that pain remained in him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
SHIKI sounds satisfied.
---It was useless to ask.
But, I still wanted to ask.
If this guy had the pain Yumizuka had----the pain as a "human" having to suck blood despite not wanting to…

entries.japanese:
「そうか。
なら―――おまえはもう人じゃない」
　言葉に殺意が滲む。
　シキは、ぴたりと動きを止めた。
「わからんヤツだな。
こうしてわざわざ殺されにきた事も不可解なら、今の質問も不可解だ。
　なあ志貴。
おまえさ、いったい何をしにやってきたんだ？」
「おまえを殺して、秋葉を取り返しにきた」
　そう言葉にした瞬間。
　ドクン、と全身の血流が加速した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then—you aren’t human anymore.”
Murder bled into my voice.
SHIKI stopped dead.
“I cannot understand you. It makes no sense that you came here merely to be killed, and that question made even less sense.
Tell me, Shiki—what exactly did you come here to do?”
“To kill you and take Akiha back.”
The moment I said it aloud—
Blood surged faster through my entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then, you're not human anymore."
My words are menacing.
SHIKI stops moving.
"I don't get it.
I don't get why you came here to get killed, and I don't get that question you asked.
Shiki, what did you come here for?"
"To kill you and to retrieve Akiha."
As those words leave my mouth,
all the blood in my body accelerates.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、正気か志貴！
　おまえに、ただの人間であるおまえに、このオレが殺せるっていうのか！？」
「…………………」
　答える必要はない。
　視線を細めて。
　ただ、ヤツの『線』を直死する―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah! Have you lost your mind, Shiki? Do you honestly believe a mere human like you can kill me?!”
“……”
There was no need to answer.
I narrowed my eyes.
And stared straight into the death of his “lines”—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh!
Are you sane, Shiki!?
Are you saying a normal person like you can kill me!?"
"…………………"
There's no reason for me to answer.
I narrow my gaze.
And, look at his "lines"---

entries.japanese:
「思い上がるな……！
　これはオレのものだ。
おまえなぞにはやらん……！」
　なにか不吉なものでも感じ取ったのか。
　シキは恐れるように後退する。
「いいか、秋葉はオレの妹なんだ……！
　こいつと血が繋がっているのは俺だけだ。
おまえなんぞに出番はない……！」
　血走った目でこちらを睨む。
―――もう、これ以上かわす言葉はない。
　ナイフを構えて、一歩前に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t presume…! She is mine. I will never give her to the likes of you!”
Perhaps he sensed something ominous.
SHIKI retreated as though afraid.
“Listen to me. Akiha is my sister! I alone share her blood. You have no place between us!”
He glared with bloodshot eyes.
―――There were no more words to exchange.
I raised the knife and stepped forward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't be full of yourself……!
This is mine.
I won't give it to you……!"
Maybe he felt something.
SHIKI backs up as if scared.
"Akiha is my sister……!
I am the only one with a blood relation.
There's no place for you……!"
He looks at me with blood-shot eyes.
---There's nothing more to say to him.
I raise my knife and take a step.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、その通りだシキ。
秋葉は俺にとって妹じゃない」
「なに………？」
「秋葉は、俺の女だからな」
「き――――！」
　一歩、踏みこむ。
　オレの言葉に逆上したのか、シキは一直線に襲いかかってくる。
　それが俺にとってもヤツにとっても、最後になるだろう殺し合いの合図になった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re right, SHIKI. Akiha isn’t my sister.”
“What…?”
“She’s my woman.”
“You—!”
I stepped in.
Enraged by my words, SHIKI charged straight at me.
That marked the beginning of what would likely be our final fight to the death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're right, SHIKI.
Akiha is not my sister."
"What……?"
"Akiha is my woman."
"You----!!"
I take another step.
Losing himself at my words, SHIKI attacks me straight on.
That becomes the signal for our last deathmatch.

entries.japanese:
―――時間をかける事はできない。
　俺の体は限界だし、秋葉を少しでも早くここから連れ出したかった。
　だから、やる事は一つだけだ。
　一直線にやってくるシキの腕をかわして、ヤツの胸に視えている『線』を裂く。
　一度だけなら。
まだ体が動く今なら、ヤツの腕をかわす事はできるだろう。
　ヤツが襲いかかってくる。
　素手であるシキの間合いと俺の間合いは同じだ。
　俺たちは公平に、お互いがお互いの必殺の間合いで殺し合う――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I could not afford a drawn-out fight.
My body was at its limit, and I wanted Akiha out of this place as soon as possible.
So there was only one thing to do.
Evade SHIKI’s arm as he charged and cut the line visible across his chest.
Just once. While my body could still move, I should be able to dodge him once.
He came at me.
Barehanded, his reach was the same as mine.
We would kill each other on equal terms, each standing inside the other’s fatal range—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I can't take much time.
My body is at its limit, and I want to get Akiha out of here as fast as I can.
So, there's only one thing to do.
I have to dodge SHIKI's arm and cut across the "line" on his chest.
My body will be able to move this once.
I will be able to avoid it.
He attacks me.
SHIKI's range and my range are about the same.
We try to kill each other fairly in our range----

entries.japanese:
―――――否。
　それは、こちらだけの幻想だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――No.
That equality had existed only in my imagination.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----No.
That was just my illusion.

entries.japanese:
「はっ……！」
　嘲笑うような声をあげて、シキはソレをふるった。
「―――――――！？」
　ソレをナイフで受け止める。
―――余分な事など思考する暇はない。
　ギィン、と固い音をたてて、シキの持つソレと、俺のナイフが弾け合う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…!”
With a mocking cry, SHIKI swung it.
“—!?”
I caught it on my knife.
―――There was no time for a single needless thought.
A hard clang split the air as my knife and the thing in SHIKI’s hand rang apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha……!"
SHIKI lets out a funny scream as he swings "it".
"-------!?"
I stop "it" with my knife.
---There's no time to think about other things.
My knife and whatever SHIKI is holding clang together with a high-pitched shriek.

entries.japanese:
「チッ、ナイフごと真っ二つにしてやろうと思ったんだがな―――骨董品にしては頑丈じゃないか、志貴！」
　ぶん、と風切り音をあげて、シキはソレを振り上げる。
「――――――」
　どくん、と全身が脈打つ。
　シキが持っているものは俺のナイフより十倍近い長さがある『剣らしきモノ』だった。
「―――――」
　不理解だ。
　確かにヤツは、さっきまで素手だったのに、そんなものをいつのまに―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch. I meant to cut you in half along with that knife—but for an antique, it’s surprisingly sturdy, Shiki!”
SHIKI whipped the thing overhead with a rush of air.
“……”
My whole body throbbed.
What he held was a sword-like thing nearly ten times the length of my knife.
“……”
It made no sense.
He had been empty-handed a moment ago. When had he found such a weapon—?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn, I thought I'd cut you in half along with your knife---but that thing is pretty strong for an antique, Shiki!"
SHIKI swings "it" above his head.
"-------"
My whole body shakes.
What SHIKI is holding is a "thing like a sword" that must be ten times longer than my knife.
"-----"
I don't understand.
He was certainly bare-handed up until now.
When did he get that-----

entries.japanese:
「だが二度目はない……！」
　振り下ろされる赤い剣。
　こんな室内で、そんなものを振りまわしても天井や壁にぶつかるだけなのに――――
「――――――――！？」
　咄嗟に避けた。
　シキの持つ赤い剣は、天井にぶつかる事なく振り下ろされた。
　その過程。
　確かに天井にめり込んでいたのに、まるで天井を透過するように、ヤツの凶器は振り下ろされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But you won’t stop it twice!”
The red sword came down.
In a room this cramped, a weapon that long should only strike the ceiling or the walls—
“—!?”
I dodged on instinct.
SHIKI’s red sword descended without striking the ceiling.
It had plainly sunk into the wood along the way,
yet his weapon swept through as though the ceiling were no more substantial than air.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But there won't be a second time……!"
The red sword swings down.
Even if he swings it, it's only going to get stuck in the walls or the ceiling due to its length-----
"--------!?"
I avoid it instantly.
The red sword SHIKI was holding came down without getting stuck anywhere.

During that swing,
the sword was indeed in the ceiling, but it came arcing down like a hot knife through warm butter.

entries.japanese:
どこかで。
　ぴちゃり、という音が、する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Somewhere.
I heard a wet little splash.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Somewhere.
The sound of dripping blood.

entries.japanese:
「しつこい――――――！」
　ブン、という風切り音をたてて、シキが剣を構えなおす。
「―――――――――」
　思考が停止する。
　視界にはシキと、部屋の奥に佇む秋葉の姿。
　秋葉はぼんやりと俺とシキを眺めている。
　人形のような秋葉。
　秋葉。
秋葉をこんな場所に残すわけにはいかない。
　だが、今は――――
「く――――！」
　舌を噛んで、離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Persistent bastard!”
SHIKI reset his stance with a rush of wind.
“……”
My thoughts stopped.
I could see SHIKI, and Akiha standing at the back of the room.
She gazed vacantly at the two of us.
Akiha, like a puppet.
Akiha. I couldn’t leave Akiha here.
But for now—
“Ghh—!”
I bit my tongue and broke away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Persistent-------!"
SHIKI holds up his sword once again.
"----------"
My mind stops.
In my vision is SHIKI and Akiha, sitting at the back of the room.
Akiha blankly stares at me and SHIKI.
Akiha sits like a doll.
Akiha.
I can't leave Akiha here.
But right now----
"Ku----!"
I bite my tongue and get away.

entries.japanese:
庭に通じている障子を突き破る。
　あの剣が壁にぶつからないというのなら、室内ではこちらが不利すぎる。
　離れの外は森だ。
　暗い夜、木々高い森の中でなら、少しはこちらにも分があるだろう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I burst through the shoji leading into the garden.
If that sword passed through walls, fighting indoors left me hopelessly exposed.
Beyond the detached house lay the forest.
In the dark night, among the tall trees, I might have some small advantage—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go through the shouji door which leads out to the garden.
If that sword does not hit the walls, then I'm at a disadvantage inside.
Outside, the forest.
In this dark night, in these woods, there should be some advantage for me----

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――ぐ」
　唐突に眩暈がした。
　足がもつれて倒れそうになる。
　今はそんな時じゃないのに、背中の傷が開いて、血が滲み出してしまっている。
「う―――――つ」
　呼吸がもれる。
　足元がふらついて、そのまま、近くの木によりかかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh.”
Dizziness struck without warning.
My legs tangled beneath me.
This was no time for it, but the wound in my back had opened and blood was seeping through.
“Ugh—”
My breath escaped me.
I staggered and slumped against a nearby tree.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ar-----gh."
I suddenly feel dizzy.
My feet stumble as I almost fall.
The wound in my back reopens and blood pours forth.
No time for that.
"Ugh-----"
I let out a breath.
Stumbling, I lean against a tree.

entries.japanese:
「っ…………」
　ここで倒れるワケにはいかない。
　遠くからは草をかきわける音が聞こえる。
　シキは確実に俺を追いかけてきている。
　なら、もう少し。
　せめてこっちの身が隠せて、ヤツの背後から仕掛けられるような場所まで行かないと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
I could not collapse here.
I heard grass parting in the distance.
SHIKI was unquestionably coming after me.
A little farther, then.
I had to reach somewhere I could hide and strike from behind—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tu…………"
I can't pass out here,
I hear the sound of someone moving through grass.
SHIKI is definitely after me.
Then, just a little more.
I need to go at least to some place where I can hide and attack him from behind-----

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　と。
　寄りかかっていた木に、剣のようなものが、突き刺さった。
「―――――――！」
　咄嗟に横に跳ぶ。
　二撃目。
　飛んできた剣は、たやすく木を貫通する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
And then.
Something like a sword punched into the tree I was leaning against.
“—!”
I leapt sideways on instinct.
A second strike.
The hurled sword passed through the tree with ease.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Then,
something like a sword sticks into the tree I am leaning on.
"-------!"
I jump sideways.
Twice.
The sword that comes flying pierces through the tree easily.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――っ！」
　考えるより先に体が動いた。
　木々から木々に身を隠していく。
　それを追いかけてくる剣。
　投げつけられてくる剣に限りはないのか、次から次へと、弾丸のように放たれてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
My body moved before thought.
I darted from tree to tree, keeping the trunks between us.
The swords pursued me.
There seemed to be no limit to them; they came one after another, fired like bullets.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------!"
My body moved before I thought about it.
I hide my body from tree to tree.
The swords are following close behind.
Is there no end to this?
His swords are thrown one after another like bullets.

entries.japanese:
「な―――――――」
　キリがない。
　逃げれば逃げるほど、剣は数を増して投げつけられてくる。
　そうして、気がつけば。
　暗い森は串刺しにされた木々で溢れかえり、その光景は、どこか異国の処刑場のように、思えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—”
They never ended.
The farther I fled, the more swords came after me.
And then I realized.
The dark forest overflowed with impaled trees, and the sight looked like an execution ground in some foreign land.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What------"
There is no end.
As I run away, he increases the amount of swords he throws at me.
When I notice,
The dark forest is full of pierced trees, looking like some sort of foreign execution site.

entries.japanese:
「―――――ん？
　なんだ、逃げるのは止めたのかよ志貴。
まさかココでならオレを殺せる、なんて素敵なコトを考えているんじゃないだろうな……！」
　ヤツの声が高く聞こえる。
　剣は投げつけられてこない。
　こちらからヤツの姿が見えないように、ヤツも俺の姿を見つけられない……なんてコトは、ないか。
「は…………あ」
　呼吸を整えて、一際大きな木に背中を預けた。
この大木ならヤツの剣が貫通する事はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm? What’s wrong, Shiki? Tired of running? Don’t tell me you’ve had the lovely idea that you can kill me here!”
His voice sounded strangely high.
No more swords came.
There was no chance that just because I could not see him, he could not see me either.
“Hah—ah…”
I steadied my breathing and leaned against an exceptionally massive tree. Surely his swords couldn’t pass through a trunk this thick.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Huh?
Are you done running away now, Shiki?
Don't tell me you think you can kill me here……!"
I can hear his voice.
But he does not throw his sword.
As I can't see him, maybe he can't see me… no, no way.
"Ha………… a."
I straighten out and lean on a big tree.
His sword shouldn't pierce through a tree this big.

entries.japanese:
「おいおい、さっきまでの威勢はどうしたんだ！
　オレを殺すっていうんならさ、もっと積極的になってくれなくっちゃつまらないぞ……！」
　声は反響して、依然としてヤツの位置は掴めない。
　目を閉じて、少しでも聴覚を敏感にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come now, where did all that spirit go?
If you mean to kill me, you’ll have to show a little more initiative or I’ll grow bored!”
His voice echoed through the trees, still betraying no position.
I closed my eyes and strained to sharpen my hearing, if only a little.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey man, where's all that talk you gave me earlier!
If you're going to kill me, it's no fun unless you try……!"
The voice echoes as I still cannot tell where he is.
I close my eyes and try to make my hearing more sensitive.

entries.japanese:
……ヤツの呼吸も、気配も聞こえない。
　当然と言えば当然か。
　こっちはヤツのように五感が獣じみているワケではないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
…I could hear neither his breathing nor his presence.
Hardly surprising.
My senses weren’t animal-sharp like his.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can't hear his breathing or feel his presence.
Of course.
I don't have beast-like senses like he does.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――？」
　ぴちゃり、という音が、した。
　……なんだろう。
　この近くには池なんて、なかったハズだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……?”
A wet splash.
What was that?
There shouldn’t have been a pond anywhere nearby.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------?"
I hear a dripping noise.
…… What is it?
I don't think there's any water around here.

entries.japanese:
「ったく、この臆病者め。
いいぜ、おまえがそういうつもりならオレが舞台を盛り上げてやる。
　おまえはそこで、好きなだけ隠れていればいい」
　……声が聞こえる。
　だが依然としてヤツの位置はつかめない。
「……さて。
そうなると少し趣向をこらさないとな。
ただおまえを殺すだけじゃ芸がない。
このまま串刺しにするのは容易いんだが、それじゃあ秋葉も喜ぶまい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, what a coward. Fine. If that’s how you want to play, I’ll liven up the stage myself.
Hide there as long as you please.”
I could hear his voice.
But I still could not place him.
“Now then. This calls for a little imagination. Simply killing you would be dull. It would be easy enough to skewer you where you stand, but I doubt that would please Akiha.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Jeez, you are a big chicken.
Alright.
If that's all you're going to do, I'll make this interesting for you.
You can hide there all you want."
…… I can hear his voice.
But I still can't tell where he is.
"…… Let's see.
If that's the case, I'll have to make this a bit interesting.
It's no fun just to kill you.
It's easy to skewer you right now, but I bet Akiha won't be happy about that."

entries.japanese:
……ぴちゃり、という音。
　今度は近い。
　すぐ目の前の木から音がしている。
　見ると、それは。
　木を貫通した赤い剣から、水のようなものが垂れている音だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet drip.
This time it was close.
The sound came from the tree directly in front of me.
When I looked, I saw what it was.
Something like water was dripping from the red sword that had pierced the tree.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That dripping sound.
It's closer this time.
The sound is from the tree right in front of me.
When I look,
I see it's the sound of liquid dripping down the sword that pierced the tree.

entries.japanese:
「そうだな、手足を潰して秋葉のオモチャにするのもいいかもな……！
　人形遊びなら秋葉だって喜ぶだろうし、今の秋葉には丁度いい」
entries.maoEnglish: “Perhaps I’ll crush your arms and legs and give you to Akiha as a toy. She ought to enjoy playing with dolls, and in her present condition you’d suit her perfectly.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I should crush your hands and feet and make you a toy for Akiha……!
Akiha likes to play with dolls, and it would suit her."

entries.japanese:
……樹液ではなさそうだ。
　あんな細い、それこそ厚さが存在しない剣から液体のようなものが垂れている。
　よくみれば、それは氷が溶けて水になるような、そんな感じだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
…It didn’t look like sap.
Liquid was dripping from a blade so thin it seemed to possess no thickness at all.
Looking closer, it seemed less like liquid escaping than the blade itself melting like ice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It doesn't seem to be sap.
Some kind of liquid is dripping down that thin sword.
When I look at it harder, it seems more like ice melting into water.

entries.japanese:
「そうそう、まだおまえには話してなかったよな志貴。
今の秋葉はさぁ、正直オレの手にもあまるんだ。
あんまりにも嬉しくてオレはやりすぎちまったらしい。
昔の秋葉に戻ったのはいいけどよ、誰彼かまわず噛みついてくるのは困りものだろ？」
entries.maoEnglish: “Oh, that reminds me, Shiki—I haven’t told you about Akiha yet. Frankly, even I can barely manage her now. I was so delighted that I may have overdone it. It’s wonderful to have the old Akiha back, but having her bite everyone she sees is a bit of a problem, don’t you think?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh yeah, I haven't told you this yet but Akiha right now is a bit out of my hands.
I guess I was too happy and I overdid it.
It's good she's back, but it's a problem when she bites anyone she sees, right?"

entries.japanese:
……ぽたり、ぽたりと零れていく。
　赤い剣は、剣というよりは刃そのものだった。
　カッターの刃を剣のようにした、極めて単純な凶器。
　シキが投げつけてきたものの正体がコレか。
　真っ赤な、卒塔婆のような長い刃物。
　しかし何故、それが赤い水をこぼし続けているのか。
　赤い。
　赤い。
　あか……い？
entries.maoEnglish:
…Drop after drop fell.
The red sword was less a sword than a naked blade:
a utility-knife edge enlarged to the length of a weapon, brutally simple.
So this was what SHIKI had been throwing.
A long, blood-red blade shaped like a grave tablet.
But why did it keep shedding red water?
Red.
Red.
Re…d?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The liquid drips down.
The red sword is more like a blade itself than a sword.
A simple weapon, just a blade.
This is the weapon SHIKI was throwing.
A red, thin, long blade.
But why is that dripping red liquid?
Red.
Red.
Re…… d?

entries.japanese:
「あぁそうか、秋葉のオモチャにするっていうのは却下しよう。
何十っていう剣で串刺しにしたおまえは最高の贈り物になりそうだが、秋葉のヤツ、遊ぶ前に食いつきそうだからな。
秋葉にそんな悪いモノを食べさせるわけには――――」
entries.maoEnglish: “Ah, no, making you Akiha’s toy won’t do. You’d make a magnificent present with a few dozen swords through you, but knowing Akiha, she’d bite into you before she started playing. I can’t let her eat anything so unhealthy—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see.
I'll pass on making you Akiha's toy.
I'm sure it'll be a great present if I give you to her with tons of swords sticking in you, but I think Akiha will bite on you before she plays with you.
I can't let Akiha eat such a poor meal-----"

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　うる、さい。
　赤い。
　ひとが、いま。
　朱い。
　だいじな、ことに。
　紅い。
　気がつきそう、だっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Shut up.
Red.
Someone is—right now.
Crimson.
Something terribly important—
Scarlet.
I’m so close to seeing it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Shut, up.
Red.
That person.
Red.
There's something important.
Red.
I have to realize it.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、待てよ。
そうか、そりゃあいい！
　秋葉をオレと同じ人食いにするっていうのは悪くない……！」
entries.maoEnglish: “…No, wait. That’s it—that would be marvelous! Turning Akiha into a man-eater like me isn’t a bad idea at all!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a minute.
Yes, That's a good idea!
To let Akiha be a cannibal just like me……!"

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――血」
　そう、か。
　血だ。
　アレは、血だ。
　だからこんなにも周囲には剣が突き刺さっている。
　木々には何百という剣の卒塔婆。
　バラバラに散乱した人間の手足。
　暗い夜。
　硝子の月。
　一面、血だらけになっている森の広場――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Blood.”
I see.
Blood.
That thing was blood.
That was why so many swords had pierced the forest around me.
Hundreds of swords thrust through the trees like grave markers.
Human arms and legs strewn in pieces.
A dark night.
A glass moon.
A forest clearing awash from end to end in blood—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Blood."
I, see.
It's blood.
That's blood.
That's why there's so many swords around here.
There are hundreds of swords stuck in trees.
Disjointed hands and feet scattered around.
Dark night.
Glass moon.
The bloody forest----

entries.japanese:
「よし、よしよしよしよしよし！
　いいぞ、一番初めの食い物がおまえだっていうのは最高じゃないか……！
――――決まりだ。
あぁ、早く秋葉をオレと同じにしてやらなくちゃいけなくなっちまった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes! Perfect! You being her first meal would be the finest beginning imaginable!
――――It’s settled. Ah, now I simply must hurry and make Akiha like me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, yesyesyesyesyes!
That's good.
It'd be excellent if you were her first meal……!
----I've made up my mind.
Yes, now I have to get Akiha to be like me as soon as possible."

entries.japanese:
ぴちゃり、と。
　また、新しい血が流れる音。
entries.maoEnglish:
A wet splash.
The sound of fresh blood beginning to flow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The dripping sound.
The sound of new blood dripping.

entries.japanese:
「じゃあな志貴。
名残りはつきないが、遊びはここでおしまいだ――――――！」
　それで、ヤツがどこに居るかは聞き取れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Goodbye, Shiki. I hate to cut our fun short, but playtime ends here!”
That last shout told me where he was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Bye Shiki, I must say we are quite close, but I'm done playing around------!"
That lets me know where he is.

entries.japanese:
寄りかかっていた大木から離れる。
　そのまま振りかえって、木に走る『線』を切断した。
　ずるり、と。
　大木はあっけなく倒れようとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
I pushed away from the huge tree.
Then I turned and severed the line running through its trunk.
With a slow slide.
The giant tree began to topple with absurd ease.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I get away from the tree I am leaning on.
I turn around and cut its "lines".
Sliding,
the large tree falls to the ground.

entries.japanese:
「な――――――――！？」
　声は頭上から聞こえた。
　つまり、アイツは。
さっきから俺の真上で、くだらない世迷い事を口走っていたワケだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—!?”
The voice came from overhead.
He had been directly above me all this time, spouting his worthless ravings.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha-----------!?"
I hear the voice from above.
In a word, he was saying such tasteless things right above me until now.

entries.japanese:
「きさ、ま―――――！！」
　シキが落ちてくる。
　その手には赤い、血で出来た剣がある。
　だがそれを振るうより早く―――
　俺のナイフが、ヤツの片腕を一閃した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You bastard!”
SHIKI came falling.
In his hand was a red sword made of blood.
But before he could swing it—
My knife flashed once through his arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You-----!!"
SHIKI comes falling down.
In his hand is the red sword made of blood.
But before he could swing it---
My knife cuts through his arm.

entries.japanese:
飛び散る鮮血。
　……シキの片腕が地面に落ちる。
　切断された断面から噴出した血液が、黒い染みのように地面を濡らしていく。
　それは下にいた俺も同じ事だ。
　普通の人間となんら変わりのない赤い血液が、びしゃりと、この胸にこびりつく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Blood burst through the air.
SHIKI’s severed arm struck the ground.
Blood jetted from the stump and soaked the earth like a spreading black stain.
Standing below him, I was drenched in it too.
Red blood no different from any ordinary human’s splashed across my chest and clung there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Splattering blood.
…… SHIKI's arm falls to the ground.
The blood pouring out of his sliced arm makes a black stain on the ground.
That's the same for me, as I am below him.
Red blood, like human blood, splashes on my chest.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、ぐっ―――――！」
　地面に転がり落ちたシキは、そのまま――――猿のような身軽さで、大きく後ろに跳んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ghh!”
SHIKI hit the ground and, in the same motion, sprang far backward with the agility of an ape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha.
Agh-----!"
SHIKI falls to the ground and-----jumps back like a monkey.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――はは、は」
　口元を歪めて、シキは俺を見ている。
「なんだよ、やれば出来るんじゃねえか……！
　安心したぜ志貴、あのままいい子ちゃんのままで殺されるなんておまえには似合わないもんなぁ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ha, ha.”
SHIKI stared at me through a twisted grin.
“So you can do it when you try!
That’s a relief, Shiki. It wouldn’t suit you to die like an obedient little boy.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha---haha, ha."
SHIKI looks at me.
"Oh, I guess you can do it if you try……!
I'm relieved Shiki.
It's unlike you to be killed so easily like that……!"

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――」
　何か言おうとして、止めた。
　今の自分にそんな余裕はない。
　コロセ。
　コロセ。
　コロセ。
　コロセ。
　喉を動かす体力があるのなら、それを全てあの生き物の排除に使用しろと。
　カラダが、リセイをシハイしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I almost answered, then stopped.
I had no strength to spare.
KILL.
KILL.
KILL.
KILL.
If I possessed enough energy to move my throat, my body commanded me to devote every last fragment of it to eradicating that creature.
The BODY ruled the REASON.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------"
I try to say something and I stop.
I have no room for that.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
If you have energy to move your mouth, use it to eliminate that creature.
My body takes over my mind.

entries.japanese:
「おい、なに黙ってやがるんだよおまえは……！
　くそ、一人で善人面しやがって、おまえのほうがオレなんかよりよっぽど化け物じゃねえか……！」
「――――――――」
　ナイフを強く握って、吠えているシキへ歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why the hell are you standing there in silence? Damn you, with that righteous face—as if you weren’t a far worse monster than I am!”
“……”
I tightened my grip on the knife and walked toward the snarling SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, why aren't you saying anything……!
Damn, don't act like you're the good guy.
You're more like a monster than I am……!"
"---------"
I grip my knife as I walk toward SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
「ハッ、オレなんかとは話す気もないってか。
ああ、まったく同感だね。
オレだって今のおまえと話すのなんて願い下げだ。
オレは確かに人食いだがな、おまえみたいに機械っていうワケじゃないからな……！」
「―――――――――」
　草を踏みしめて、歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah! So I’m not even worth speaking to? I agree completely. I’d rather not talk to what you are now either. I may eat people, but at least I’m not a machine like you!”
“……”
I walked on, crushing grass beneath my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Heh, you don't even want to talk to me, huh?
I feel the same way too.
I don't want to talk to you either.
I may be a cannibal, but I'm not a machine like you……!"
"---------"
I walk through the grass.

entries.japanese:
「いいか、オレにだってまだ判断基準っていうヤツは残っている。
自分がやっている事がおまえたちにとって悪だって理解してる。
それを覚悟した上でオレたちは存在しているんだよ……！
　だがな、それさえも持たないで血なんていうものに命令されているおまえはなんだ？
　自分の意思さえ持たないでモノを殺そうとするおまえはなんなんだって聞いてるんだ、七夜志貴……！！！」
「―――――――――」
　歩く。
あいつを、ころす、ために――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen. Even I still have standards by which I judge myself. I know that what I do is evil in your eyes. We exist with full knowledge of that choice!
But what are you, when you don’t possess even that—when your blood simply gives you orders? I’m asking what you are when you kill without a will of your own, Shiki Nanaya!”
“……”
I walked. To kill him—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright?
I still have a mind that lets me choose.
I know what I'm doing is considered evil for you guys, but we do it knowing that……!
But what are you, being controlled by your blood?
I'm asking what are you trying to kill without any will of your own, Nanaya Shiki……!!!"
"---------"
I walk.
To, kill, him----

entries.japanese:
「ふざけやがって……！
　今のおまえがどんな目をしているのか解っているのか？
　おまえは生き物なんかじゃない。
意思のない機械と同じで、人間外のものなら無条件で殺そうとする人形じゃねえか！
　ああ、親父が七夜の人間を皆殺しにしたのは当然だぜ。
だっておまえのほうこそさあ、感情がない殺人鬼そのものなんだからな……！」
「――――――――」
　最後の一歩。
　これで、確実に。
　この化け物を、殺すコトができる――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t mock me! Do you know what your eyes look like now? You aren’t even alive. You’re a mindless machine, a doll that kills anything inhuman without question!
No wonder Father exterminated the Nanayas. You’re the true murderer here—a killer without a shred of feeling!”
“……”
One final step.
Now, without fail.
I could kill this monster—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shit……!
Do you know how you look right now?
You're not a living thing.
You're like a machine, a doll that kills anything not human!
I see, it was only right that the old man exterminated the Nanaya.
Because you're all emotionless killers……!"
"---------"
The last step.
With this,
I will be able to kill this monster----

entries.japanese:
「―――ほら、おまえはそういうヤツなんだよ志貴！
　人間じゃないヤツが相手なら、相手がどれだけ人間と酷似していても殺すだけなんだろう？
　なら。
おまえはオレを仕留めた後、秋葉も同じように殺すっていうんだな？」
「――――――、」
　なに、を。
　そんな、こと、は―――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“There! That’s what you are, Shiki! If something isn’t human, you kill it, no matter how perfectly it resembles one.
So after you finish me, you mean to kill Akiha the same way?”
“……”
What was he—?
That couldn’t—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---See, that's the kind of creature you are, Shiki.
If you're fighting anyone not human, all you do is kill them no matter how much they look human.
Then, are you going to kill Akiha too after you kill me?"
"------"
What in the world?
I would never-------

entries.japanese:
「ない、と言いきれるのか？
　言っておくけどな、秋葉はオレなんかより数段化け物じみているんだぜ？
　そんなモノを前にして、おまえの理性が衝動を抑えきれる筈がないんだ。
　……ほら、まだおまえに七夜志貴としてではなく、遠野志貴としての理性が残っているんなら解るだろう。
　おまえはここでオレに殺されるか、それとも――――自分で自分を始末したほうが救われるんだっていうコトがな――――！！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you swear you won’t? Akiha is several times more monstrous than I am. Faced with such a creature, your reason could never restrain that impulse.
Come now—if there’s any reason left in you as Shiki Tohno rather than Shiki Nanaya, you understand.
Your only salvation is to let me kill you here, or else—to finish yourself with your own hands!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Can you say that you won't?
I'll tell you, but Akiha is more like a monster than I am.
With her in front of you, there's no way you'll be able to hold down your impulse.
…… See, if you have any reasoning left in you as Tohno Shiki and not Nanaya Shiki, you should understand.
You are going to be killed by me, or----that it's best if you kill yourself----!!"

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――！」
　消えた。
　いや、逃げたのか。
　ガサガサと草を掻き分ける音がする。
　ヤツは森の奥に逃げていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
He vanished.
No—he fled.
I heard him tearing through the grass.
He was escaping deeper into the forest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------!"
He disappears.
No, he ran away.
I can hear the sound of the grass as he runs.
He is running into the forest.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――あ」
　……逃がしてしまった。
　今なら確実に仕留められたのに、逃がしてしまった。
　どうしてだろう。
　それに怒りを覚えている自分と、どこか―――良かった、と思う自分が、いるなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—Ah.”
I had let him escape.
I could have killed him with certainty, and I had let him go.
Why?
Why was one part of me furious while another part, somewhere deep inside, was glad?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------Oh."
…… I let him get away.
I could have definitely killed him, but I let him get away.
Why?
Part of me is angry----part of me thinks it was a good thing.

entries.japanese:
「……逃がすわけには、いかない」
　……草むらに血の跡が続いている。
　片腕を切断したのだ。
　血の跡は明確に、ヤツの居場所を教えてくれる。
　だが、急がなければ見失ってしまうかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can’t let him get away.”
Blood marked a trail through the grass.
I had severed one of his arms.
The trail pointed plainly toward him.
But unless I hurried, I might still lose it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't let him get away."
…… There is a trail of blood on the grass.
I cut off one of his arms.
His trail of blood will tell me exactly where he went.
But if I don't hurry up, I might lose him.

entries.japanese:
――――ここで躊躇っている余裕はない。
　ヤツの傷が癒える前に仕留めなければ、逆にこちらが殺されてしまうだろう。
「は――――――あ」
　疲れきった体を抱えて、シキの後を追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――There was no time to hesitate.
If I didn’t finish him before his wounds closed, I would be the one who died.
“Haaah…”
Dragging my exhausted body along, I ran after SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----No time to waste.
I have to kill him before his wounds heal, or he will kill me.
I take a forced breath,
and spur my tired body after SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、はぁ―――――
　暗い森に、自分の呼吸音が反響していく。
　この闇の中、赤い血の跡は蛍光灯のように光って見えた。
　これなら何があってもシキを逃がす事はない。
　問題は、俺の体がそれまで保ってくれるかどうかだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah—
My breath echoed through the dark woods.
In that blackness, the trail of red blood shone as brightly as a fluorescent lamp.
I couldn’t possibly lose SHIKI now.
The only question was whether my body would last long enough to catch him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Panting-----
My breath echoes through the dark forest.
In this darkness, the trail of blood seems to light the way.
There's no way I'll let SHIKI go now.
The question is, can my body survive long enough?

entries.japanese:
「はぁ――――はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　よろけながら、眩暈を誤魔化しながら走る。
　左手にはナイフの感触。
　強く握った掌から伝わる、その感触だけが、かろうじて意識を繋ぎとめていてくれる。
「あいつ……中庭に、向かっている、のか」
　血の跡は中庭に続いているようだった。
　八年前。
　七夜志貴が遠野シキに殺された場所。
　……言われてみれば、あそこほど俺たちの決着に相応しい場所はないかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—hah, hah, hah…”
I ran on, reeling and fighting down the vertigo.
The feel of the knife in my left hand.
Only that sensation, transmitted through my clenched palm, barely kept me conscious.
“Is he… heading for the courtyard?”
The blood trail seemed to lead into the courtyard.
Eight years ago.
Where Shiki Nanaya had been killed by SHIKI Tohno.
Come to think of it, nowhere else could have been more fitting for our final reckoning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Breathing heavily,
I run while wobbling side to side.
I feel my knife in my left hand.
The sensation of the knife firmly gripped by my hand is the only thing keeping me from passing out.
"Is he…… going to the courtyard?"
It looks like the trail of blood leads to the courtyard.
Eight years ago.
The place where Nanaya Shiki was killed by Tohno SHIKI.
…… Come to think of it, there's no better place to finish our match.

entries.japanese:
「――――――いいぜシキ。
そこで、おまえを」
　殺してやる、と呟いて。
　目の前が、血に染まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, SHIKI. Right there, you’re mine—”
I whispered, “I’ll kill you.”
The world before me flooded red.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Alright SHIKI, I'll…"
Kill you.
Everything turns red.

entries.japanese:
「ご――――――ふ」
　吐いた息から血があふれてくる。
　心臓から血が逆流してくる。
　意識が遠くなって、そのまま――――地面に倒れこんだ。
「え――――――？」
　ワケが解らない。
　ただ痛みと、熱い、感覚だけが、全身に、染み込んでいく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh—”
Blood spilled out with my breath.
It surged backward from my heart.
My awareness receded, and I collapsed face-first onto the ground.
“What…?”
I couldn’t understand.
There was only pain, and a sensation of heat seeping slowly into every part of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gu-------ugh."
Blood accompanies my breath out of my body.
Blood spews out of my heart.
I start to pass out and----fall to the ground.
"What----?"
I don't understand.
I just feel pain and burning everywhere.

entries.japanese:
「―――――そん、な」
　ふと、自分の背中を見た。
　そこには翼のように無数の剣が生えていた。
　無数の剣は俺の体の内部から、外に向けて屹立している。
　つまり、それが。
　俺の致命傷、という事らしい。
「なん、で―――――？」
　わからない。
　剣が飛んできたワケでもない。
　ただいきなり、俺の内部から外に向けて生えるように、剣が突き出してきただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—way…”
I twisted around to look at my own back.
Countless blades had sprouted there like wings.
They stood rigid, thrusting outward from inside my body.
So that.
Was apparently my mortal wound.
“Why…?”
I didn’t understand.
No swords had come flying at me.
They had simply appeared without warning, bursting out of my body as though they had grown there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----What the…"
I look at my back.
There I see numerous swords stuck like wings.
They stick through me and up towards the sky.
That means…
This wound is fatal.
"Why-----?"
I don't understand.
It's not that these swords came flying at me.
They just suddenly seemed to sprout from inside me.

entries.japanese:
ぴちゃり、ぴちゃり、という音。
　赤い剣は血液をこぼしている。
　それは俺の血というワケではなく――――
「―――――そう、か。
あの時の、血か」
　……さっきシキを切りつけた時の返り血。
　それが胸に残ったままだった。
　……なんていう未熟さだろう。
　あの赤い剣がヤツの血液で出来ているって解っていたんだから―――あいつの返り血を浴びるなんていう事は、いつでも串刺しにしてくださいって言っているようなものだったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Drip. Drip.
The red blades were shedding blood.
But it wasn’t my blood—
“Oh… I see. The blood from before.”
The spray that had struck me when I cut SHIKI.
Some of it had remained on my chest.
How careless could I be?
I already knew his red blades were made from his blood—letting that blood spatter me was as good as begging him to skewer me whenever he pleased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of dripping blood.
It drips down the swords on my body.
The blood is not mine---
"----Oh, that blood back then."
…… The blood that spilled on me when I cut SHIKI.
That was still on my chest.
…… What a stupid mistake.
I knew that red swords were made from his blood---so having his blood on me is like asking him to stab me to death any time he pleases.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ぁ」
　意識が遠ざかる。
　自らの血の海に沈んで、ぼんやりと空を見上げた。
　遠い月。
　暗い夜、高い木々。
　いつかと同じ、無意味な死をここに迎えていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
My consciousness drifted away.
Sinking into a sea of my own blood, I stared vaguely up at the sky.
The distant moon.
The dark night, the towering trees.
Here I was, meeting the same meaningless death as before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
I start to fade.
I look up at the sky in my own sea of blood.
The far away moon.
Dark night, tall trees.
I am facing the same meaningless death as once before.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　大きく、息をついた。
「はぁ……はぁ……、あ」
　呼吸が戻ってくる。
　さっきまで朱に染まっていた視界がマトモに戻っていく。
「は――――――あ」
　シキの言うコトを認めるつもりはない。
　俺は秋葉を殺すコトなんて絶対にしないし、相手が人間じゃないから、無条件で殺すなんていうコトは、ないんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I let out one long breath.
“Hah… hah… ah.”
My breathing steadied.
The crimson haze over my sight began to clear.
“Haaah…”
I would never concede that SHIKI was right.
I would never kill Akiha, and I would never kill someone without question merely because they weren’t human.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I let out a deep breath.
Calming down,
I manage to restore control over my breathing.
My view painted in red now returns to normal.
One more calming breath.
I won't believe what SHIKI says.
I would never kill Akiha, and there's no way I would kill someone simply because they weren't human.

entries.japanese:
「……………っ」
　違う。
　あの時は、違う。
　俺はシキとは違う。
　ちゃんと自分の意思で、自分の行動を抑えられる。
　ただ、こう血の匂いが強いと。
　何か、思い出してはいけない、ずっと昔の出来事が蘇ってきそうで、恐いだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……!”
No.
That time was different.
I was nothing like SHIKI.
I could control my actions through my own will.
It was only that, with the smell of blood this strong,
I was afraid some ancient memory—something I must never remember—would come back to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
It's different.
It's different from back then.
I'm different from SHIKI.
I can control my actions through my own willpower.
It's just, the smell of blood is so strong.
It makes me remember the past, and that scares me.

entries.japanese:
「く――――――そ」
　右手はナイフを持ったまま。
　素手のままの左腕で、胸についた返り血をぬぐう。
―――それで、少しは血の匂いが薄れてくれた。
「―――――シキ」
　闇の中、誘蛾灯のように赤い血の跡が続いている。
　もう一度大きく呼吸をして、シキの後を追った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it…”
Still holding the knife in my right hand.
I wiped the spattered blood from my chest with my bare left arm.
―――That dulled the smell of blood a little.
“SHIKI…”
The red trail stretched on through the darkness, glowing like a lamp set to lure moths.
I drew one more deep breath and followed him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shi------t"
My right hand is still holding the knife.
With my bare left hand, I wipe the blood off my chest.
---With that, the smell of the blood goes away a bit.
"-----SHIKI"
In the darkness, the trail of blood seems to light the way.
I take another deep breath, then go after SHIKI.

entries.japanese: ここが、終着だった。
entries.maoEnglish: This was the end of the trail.
entries.mirrorMoon: This is the last stop.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　……これは偶然か、それとも意図的なものか。
　八年前。
　俺がシキに殺されかけた場所で、もう一度殺し合いをしなくてはいけないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Was this chance, or had he chosen it deliberately?
Eight years ago, SHIKI had nearly killed me here.
Now, it seemed, we had to try to kill each other here once again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… Is this just a coincidence or is it on purpose?
Eight years ago.
We fight to death once more at the place where SHIKI almost killed me.

entries.japanese:
「……チッ。
やっぱり追いかけてきやがったか」
　広場の奥で、シキはうずくまっている。
　そんな事さえもあの時と同じだ。
「……………」
　ナイフを強く握って歩き始める。
　足元にはぬるりとした感触。
　シキの出血は止まっていない。
流れ出る血の跡はシキへと続いている。
　ぴちゃり、ぴちゃり。
　歩くたびにヤツの血が足の裏で音をたてる。
　……これだけの出血でよく生きているものだ。
　血の跡は、それこそ水たまりのようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch… Knew you’d come after me.”
SHIKI crouched at the far side of the clearing.
Even that was the same as it had been then.
“…”
I tightened my grip on the knife and walked toward him.
Something slick shifted beneath my feet.
SHIKI was still bleeding; the stream ran straight back to where he crouched.
Drip. Slosh.
With every step, his blood sounded under my soles.
It was incredible that he was alive after losing so much.
The trail had swollen into a pool.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmph, you did come after me."
SHIKI is sitting down at the very edge of the clearing.
Even that is the same as back then.
"……………"
I hold onto my knife and walk towards him.
I feel something slimy under my feet.
SHIKI's blood has not stopped; all the flowing blood is from him.
Splash, splash.
His blood makes noise as I step towards him.
…… It's amazing he's alive after losing this much blood.
It's like a giant puddle on the ground.

entries.japanese:
「く……………っ」
　だが限界なのはこっちだって同じ事だ。
　長引けば不利になる。
　ヤツが傷を負っている今しか殺せるチャンスはないだろう。
「――――――、っ」
　一歩を踏み出す。
「―――――待て！
　まだ話していない事があるんだ。
少しでいいからそこで大人しくしていてくれないか、志貴」
「――――――――」
「そんな顔するなよ。
これはおまえにとってもいい話なんだぜ？
　なにしろ、秋葉を元に戻す方法があるかもしれないってヤツだからな」
「な―――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kh…!”
But I was just as close to my limit.
The longer this took, the worse my chances became.
While he was wounded, I might still be able to kill him.
“—!”
I took one step.
“Wait! There’s still something I haven’t told you. Would you stay right there for just a moment, Shiki?”
“…”
“Don’t look at me like that. This is good news for you too. There may be a way to turn Akiha back to normal.”
“What—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ku……………"
But, I'm also at my limit.
I'll be at a disadvantage if I wait any longer.
This is the only chance to kill him, with him wounded.
"--------!!"
I step forward.
"-----Wait!
There's something I haven't told you yet.
Can you wait there a bit, Shiki?"
"-----------"

"Don't look at me like that.
This should benefit you too.
Because it's about Akiha.
There might be a way to turn her back."
"Wha-------"

entries.japanese:
瞬間。
　理性が足を止めてしまった。
　だが体は今すぐに走り出して、ヤツの息の根を止めなければと訴えている。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
In that instant.
Reason stopped my feet.
But my body screamed at me to charge him now and end his life.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
At that moment,
my still functioning reason stops my feet.
But, my body is telling me to go on and kill him right now.
I------

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　その手にはひっかからない。
　コイツの声を聞いていると、体の機能が狂ってしまう。
　秋葉を救う方法があるのだとしたら、それは自分で探してみせる。
　コイツに―――秋葉を変えてしまったシキに教わる事など皆無だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I wouldn’t fall for that.
Listening to him made the workings of my body go wrong.
If there was a way to save Akiha, I would find it myself.
SHIKI—the one who had changed her—had nothing in this world to teach me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------"
I won't fall for that trick.
My body stops working properly when I listen to him.
If there is a way to turn back Akiha, I'll find it myself.
No way---no way will SHIKI, the one who turned Akiha that way, tell me.

entries.japanese:
「――――はん。
流石にひっかからねえか。
仕方ねえな、それじゃあ後は殺し合いだ。
どっちがより優れた殺人鬼か競い合うとしようかね」
　うずくまったまま、シキは愉快そうに笑う。
「―――――――――」
　答えず、ただ一直線にシキへと歩を進めていく。
　距離にして十メートルほど。
　あと数秒を待たずして、跳びかかれる間合いになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah. Didn’t think that would fool you. Fine, then. All that’s left is for us to kill each other. Let’s see which of us is the better murderer.”
Still crouching, SHIKI laughed in delight.
“…”
Without answering, I walked straight toward him.
Ten meters separated us.
In a few more seconds, he would be within range of a single leap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Huh!
I guess you won't fall for it.
Alright then.
It's all about killing each other from now on.
Let's see who's the better killer."
SHIKI laughs, still down on the ground.
"------------"
I don't answer and instead walk straight to him.
About ten more meters to go.
I will be able to jump at him within a few seconds.

entries.japanese:
「……ふん。
まさかオレの片腕を切り落としたぐらいで得意になっているんじゃないだろうな、志貴」
「―――――――」
　一メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmph. You haven’t gotten conceited just because you cut off one of my arms, have you, Shiki?”
“…”
One meter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Heh.
Don't tell me you think you're good just because you cut one of my arms off, Shiki."
"--------"
One meter.

entries.japanese:
「最後に一つ教授してやるよ。
　遠野の人間はそれぞれ能力が違うってコトは知ってるだろう？
　秋葉は周囲の熱を奪うコトに長けているらしい。
まあ、アレだ。
ようするに外界に影響をおよぼす、干渉能力っていうところかな」
「――――――」
　二メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me teach you one last thing.
You know every member of the Tohno family manifests a different ability, don’t you? Akiha seems particularly gifted at stealing heat from her surroundings. In other words, hers is an ability that reaches outward and interferes with the world around her.”
“…”
Two meters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll teach you one last thing.
You know everyone in the Tohno family has different powers, right?
I guess Akiha's good at taking heat from her surroundings.
Well, it's kind of like that, influencing the outside world, like an interference ability."
"--------"
Two meters.

entries.japanese:
「遠野の人間の中でも、干渉するタイプのヤツは少なかったらしい。
そういった意味で言うと、秋葉の潜在能力は稀少なんだ。
秘めた能力が大きい分、並大抵のことじゃ覚醒してくれない。
オレがなんとか呼びかけても大海に小石を投げるようなものさ。
　秋葉の血を完全に呼び起こす為にはな、他人と感応する能力をもったヤツに秋葉の体を預けちまうのが一番いいんだ」
「―――――――」
　三メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Apparently, very few Tohnos were the outward-reaching type. That makes Akiha’s potential unusually rare. But the greater the power lying dormant inside her, the harder it is to awaken. No matter how I called to it, I might as well have been throwing pebbles into the ocean.
The best way to rouse the Tohno blood in her completely is to entrust her body to someone with the power to resonate with others.”
“…”
Three meters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It seems the ability to interfere with the outside world has been scarce even in the Tohno family.
You can say that Akiha's ability is rare.
Since she has such large potential, it doesn't wake up easily.
Any time I try to wake it up, it's like throwing a rock into the ocean.
The best way to use her full ability is to have someone take over her mind and control her."
"--------"
Three meters.

entries.japanese:
「まあ、秋葉の話は置いておこう。
今はそんなコトより、オレについてのほうが重要だからな」
「―――――――」
　四メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But enough about Akiha. Right now, what matters is me.”
“…”
Four meters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, let's put Akiha off to the side.
It's more important to talk about me right now."
"--------"
Four meters.

entries.japanese:
「志貴。
オレは親父と同じで、外界に干渉する術はもたない。
吸血鬼としての能力はもとからオレのものではないんだ。
これは後から憑いてきたおまけみたいなもんでさ。
オレ本来の力は、『不死』っていうものだったんだ」
「―――――――」
　五メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki—like our father, I have no way to interfere with the outside world. The powers I gained as a vampire were never mine to begin with. They’re just an extra that latched on later. My own true ability was something called ‘immortality.’”
“…”
Five meters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki, I'm like the old man; I have no method to interfere with the outside world.
The vampire ability isn't my original ability.
This is more like a bonus that I got later.
My real ability is 'immortality'."
"--------"
Five meters.

entries.japanese:
「ま、不死っていっても限界はある。
なにしろオレは自分の傷を治すコトができないんだ。
それなのに不死っていうのはおかしいだろ？
　けどまあ、オレが死ににくいっていうのは本当の事さ。
オレの体はな、とにかくその時点で生存できるように自身の中身を作り変えちまうんだ。
　人間は肉体の大部分を失ったら死亡するだろう？
　それは人が生きていくのに『人間としてカタチ』、つまり全てのパーツが生存するに必要だからだ。
だからなくなったパーツを補えなかったら、その時点で人は死んでしまう。
いや、生きていけなくなる、っていうのが正しいか」
「―――――――」
　六メートル。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course, even my immortality has limits. I can’t heal my own wounds. Calling that immortality sounds absurd, doesn’t it?
But it’s true that I’m very hard to kill. My body remakes its own inner workings into whatever form will keep it alive at that moment.
A human dies after losing too much of his body because the complete ‘human shape’—every one of its parts—is necessary for him to survive. If he can’t replace what he lost, he dies then and there. Or rather, he becomes incapable of living.”
“…”
Six meters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, there are limits to my immortality, since I can't heal my own wounds.
Isn't it weird that this ability is called immortality?
But it's true that dying is hard for me.
My body changes its context so that it can survive whatever state it is in at that moment.
Humans die when they lose a large portion of their body, right?
That's because humans need a 'Human shape' with all the necessary parts to live as a human.
If they can't find a substitute for their lost part, they die.
Well, it might be more correct to say they cannot continue to live."
"--------"
Six meters.

entries.japanese:
「だがね。
オレの場合はそれが逆なのさ。
　なくなったパーツを補う、という方向じゃない。
手がなくなったら手がなくても生きていけるように、血がなくなったら血がなくなっても生きていけるように、体の中身が違ったそれまでとは違った『内臓』に変化していくワケさ。
　な、これだって『不死』って言えなくはないだろう？
　オレはな、きっと首だけになっても生きていられるんだろうさ。
……ま、そんな姿には間違ってもなりたくはねえけどな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“With me, it works in reverse.
My body doesn’t replace what is missing. If I lose a hand, my insides change into ‘organs’ that can live without a hand. If I lose my blood, they change into something that can live without blood.
You could call that immortality, couldn’t you? I would probably survive even if nothing remained but my head. Not that I’d ever want to end up that way.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But in my case, it's the opposite.
I don't supplement my lost parts.
Instead, I continue to live even if I lose an arm or all my blood.
My body changes its internal organs so that I can live without the parts I lost.
See, can't you say that this is 'immortality'?
I would probably live even if my head only remained.
…… Well, there's no way I'd want to be like that."

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　七メートル。
　……あと一歩。
　それでもう、ヤツに一足で跳びかかれる間合いになる――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Seven meters.
One more step.
Then he would be within the reach of a single bound—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Seven meters.
…… One more step.
Then, I am within reach----

entries.japanese:
「……やる気だな。
　ま、オレが何を言いたかったかって言うとさ、つまりオレは外界ではなく内界……自分の肉体を操れる能力者っていうコトだ。
　わかるか？
　おまえ達にとってはただの消耗品でも、オレにとっては――――――」
「―――――――」
　ここまでだ。
　このまま、ヤツの―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you mean to do it.
What I’m getting at is this: my power doesn’t govern the outer world, but the inner one—my own flesh.
Understand? To you, it may be something disposable, but to me—”
“…”
Enough.
I would take his—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're about to kill me, huh?
Well, what I want to say is this.
I have the ability not to influence the outside world, but rather my inner body.
Do you get it?
Even if it seems like a useless part of your body to you, for me------"
"--------"
This is it.
Now, I'll-----

entries.japanese:
どん、と。
　トウトツに、踝から脳天まで。
　地面から突き立ってきた無数の剣に、串刺しにされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thud.
Without warning, from ankle to crown.
Countless blades erupted from the earth and impaled me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Stab.
Suddenly, from my ankles to my head…
I am stabbed by numerous swords that popped out of the ground.

entries.japanese:
「――――こんなふうに、大切な武器になるワケだ。
　おまえも注意力が散漫だぞ。
オレがこんな、何の意味もなく血を撒き散らすワケがないじゃないか」
　……そう、か。
　なんて、間抜け。
　俺はヤツの血の跡を追いかけて。
　自分から、針の山の上を、歩いていた、なんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—It becomes a priceless weapon.
You’re careless too, you know. Surely you didn’t think I was spilling all this blood for no reason.”
I see.
What a fool.
I had followed his blood trail.
Only to walk across a mountain of needles by my own choice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----I can change it to an important weapon like this.
You need to pay more attention.
There's no way I would scatter this much blood for no reason."
…… I… understand.
How stupid of me.
I followed his trail of blood,
and walked onto a mountain of needles.

entries.japanese:
「オレは秋葉やおまえのように他者を害する能力がないものでね、こういった小細工をするしかないワケだ。
　もっとも、オレの頭の中にいる『誰か』がもう少しハッキリとしてくれれば、そいつの吸血鬼としての能力を発現できるんだろうがな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Unlike you or Akiha, I have no power that directly harms anyone else, so I’m forced to rely on little tricks like this.
If only the ‘someone’ inside my head would come into sharper focus, I could probably manifest his powers as a vampire too.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't have the ability like you or Akiha to hurt others directly, so I have to rely on little tricks like these.
But if this 'someone' in my head becomes clearer, I might be able to use his ability as a vampire."

entries.japanese:
「――――もう意識が保てないか。
　それじゃあお別れだ。
後のことはオレに任せて、おまえは墓場に戻るといいよ、シキ―――――」
　笑い声が聞こえる。
　耳朶に残響するそれに嘲笑われながら、俺の意識は暗い闇へと落ちていった―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can’t hold on to consciousness anymore?
Then this is goodbye. Leave the rest to me and go back to your grave, SHIKI—”
I heard laughter.
Mocked by the sound ringing inside my ears, I sank into the deepest dark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----I guess you can't keep yourself together anymore.
Then this is it.
You can leave the rest to me and you can go back to your grave, Shiki-----"

I hear laughter.
It echoes through my head as my mind falls into the darkness-----

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　足を止めた。
　ぬらりとした地面を踏みしめながら、うずくまっているシキを睨む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I stopped.
Planting my feet on the slick ground, I glared at the crouching SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I stop walking.
I stare at the crouching SHIKI as I stand on the slimy ground.

entries.japanese:
「は――――はは、あはははははははは！」
　愉快そうにシキは笑っている。
　……解っている。
ここで俺が止まっていれば、ヤツは先ほどのダメージから回復してしまうだろう。
　俺は最後のチャンスを棒に振ってしまったんだって、理解している。
　だが、それでも――――秋葉を、もとの秋葉に戻せる方法があるというのなら、それを聞かないわけにはいかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—haha! Ahahahahahaha!”
SHIKI laughed merrily.
I knew what this pause meant. If I stood here, he would recover from the wounds I had given him.
I understood that I was throwing away my last chance.
Even so—if there truly was a way to restore Akiha, I had to hear it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha-----haha, ahahahahahaha!!"
SHIKI is laughing loudly.
…… I know.
If I stop now, he will recover from his wounds.
I know I have thrown away my last chance.
But still----if there's a way to get Akiha back, I have to hear it.

entries.japanese:
「……本当、に」
「ん？
　なんだよ志貴。
声が小さくて聞こえないぜ」
「……本当、なんだろうな、シキ」
「ああ、オレはお喋りだがな、嘘だけは口にしないのがポリシーなんだ。
だからおまえがもう少しそこで立ち止まっていてくれればなんだって話してやるし――――おまえの出方次第によっちゃあ、オレの手で秋葉を助けてやってもいいぐらいだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is it… true?”
“Hmm? What was that, Shiki? Speak up.”
“It’s true… isn’t it, SHIKI?”
“Oh, I’m a talkative man, but I make a point never to lie. Stand there a little longer and I’ll tell you anything you want. Depending on how you behave, I might even save Akiha myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?"
"What?
I can't hear you."
"…… Is it for real, SHIKI?"
"Yeah, I talk a lot but it's against my policy to ever lie.
So I'll tell you if you stay there a bit longer---and depending on your attitude, I could go ahead and save Akiha myself."

entries.japanese:
「……………秋葉を、助ける…………？」
　その言葉に何か、不吉なモノが混じっていたのか。
　びくん、と体が震えて、そのまま転びそうになった。
　足元がぬかるんでいるせいで地面が滑りやすくなっているせい―――――
「滑り――――――やすい？」
―――――待て。
　今、俺は。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Save… Akiha…?”
Was there something ominous mixed into those words?
My body jerked, and I nearly fell.
It was only because the ground had turned slick with mud—
“Slippery…?”
―――――Wait.
Just now, I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Save, Akiha…………?"
Is it that I felt something bad in those words?
My body shakes and I almost fall.
The ground is slippery because it's slimy------
"Sli-------ppery?"
------Wait.
I am now…

entries.japanese:
「なあに、秋葉を助ける方法なんて解りきってるだろう。
あいつはな、人間として生きていく力がないから、遠野よりの血の力で生きていくしかない。
　そうして遠野よりの力を使っちまっているから、結果として人間より遠野よりの生き物になっちまってるだけだろう？」
　赤い血で出来た、ヤツの凶器。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, you already know how to save Akiha. She doesn’t have enough strength to live as a human, so she has no choice but to live on the power in the Tohno blood.
And because she’s using that power, she’s become more a creature of the Tohnos than a human. Isn’t that all?”
His weapons, made from red blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, you should know how to save her.
She has no power to live as a human, so she has to live as a Tohno.
And since she is using the power of the Tohno blood, she became one of the Tohno blood, rather than someone of human blood."
His weapon made out of red blood…

entries.japanese:
「だからさ。
あいつが自分だけで生きていけるような状態に戻してやれば、遠野の血になんか頼らなくてよくなるんだ。
　ほら、簡単だろ？
　秋葉を戻したかったら、秋葉をそんな状態にしている原因を排除すればいいだけなんだ」
　その血の跡に、俺は立っている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“So restore her to a state where she can live by her own strength, and she won’t need to rely on the Tohno blood anymore.
Simple, isn’t it? If you want Akiha back, all you have to do is remove the cause that made her this way.”
I was standing in that trail of blood—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So if you reset things back to the state where she can live as a human, she doesn't have to rely on the Tohno blood.
See?
Isn't it easy?
If you want to save Akiha, all you have to do is eliminate the cause for her current state."
I am standing in a puddle of blood-----

entries.japanese:
「ようするにさ、志貴。
おまえさえ死ねば、何もかも解決するっていうコトだろう―――――！」
「っ―――――――！」
　その声と同時に。
　あらんかぎりの力で、俺は真横に跳んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In other words, Shiki, everything will be solved once you’re dead!”
“—!”
At the same instant as his shout.
I hurled myself sideways with every scrap of strength I had.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So all I want to say is, everything will be fine if you just die--------!!"
"----------!!"
At the same time.
I jump to the side with all my power.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　一瞬の差だった。
　シキの体から流れていた血の川。
　それが一斉に、一瞬にして針の山と化した。
　なんて不覚。
　あの赤い剣がヤツの血で出来ているものならば、流れ出た血液をそのまま剣と成す事さえ容易だったのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
A fraction of a second.
The river of blood flowing from SHIKI’s body.
It became a forest of needles in a single instant.
How could I have overlooked it?
If those red blades were made from his blood, then turning all the blood he had shed into swords would have been effortless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
It really was a matter of a split second.
The blood that was flowing from SHIKI's body…
All of it turns into a mountain of needles.
How could I be so careless?
If that red sword was made of his blood, then it would be easy for him to make his flowing blood into swords as well.

entries.japanese:
「は、あ――――あ」
　血の跡から横に跳んで、地面に転がり落ちる。
　……だが完全に逃げ切れた、というワケじゃなかった。
　左腕が、終わっていた。
　左腕はあの針の山に貫かれたんじゃない。
腕は内側から外に向けて裂かれている。
　……ようするに。
　さっき、左腕で胸の返り血をぬぐった。
あの血が結晶化して、爆発する花火みたいに左腕を切りさいただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah—ah…”
I leaped clear of the trail and crashed to the ground.
But I had not escaped entirely.
My left arm was finished.
The forest of needles had not pierced it. My arm had been ripped apart from the inside.
In other words.
Earlier, I had used my left arm to wipe SHIKI’s blood from my chest. That blood crystallized and burst outward like exploding fireworks, shredding the arm from within.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Grunting with exertion, I jump from the puddle of blood and roll onto the ground.
…… But I couldn't get away unscathed.
My left arm is useless now.
My left arm wasn't stabbed, but cut from the inside out.
…… In other words…
The blood I wiped off with this arm cut through me like an exploding firework.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ…………！」
　地面に転がって、なんとか痛みを堪える。
　不幸中の幸いだ。
もしあの時胸の血をぬぐっていなかったら、俺は背中から剣を生やして即死していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Agh…!”
I writhed on the ground and somehow endured the pain.
That was one stroke of luck amid all this disaster. If I hadn’t wiped the blood from my chest, swords would have burst from my back and killed me instantly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Agh------gh………!!"
I roll on the ground and fight the pain.
I still got lucky.
If I hadn't of wiped that blood off my chest, I would have grown swords out of my back and died instantly.

entries.japanese:
「チッ――――――！」
　声が聞こえる。
　ザッ、と。
草をかきわけて走り寄ってくる音。
「往生際が悪いぜ、頼むから今ので死にやがれってんだ―――――！！」
　迫ってくる。
　地面に倒れている自分に、シキを迎え撃つ事はできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch—!”
I heard him.
Grass tore beneath pounding feet.
“Just die already! Why couldn’t that finish you?!”
He was coming.
Flat on the ground, I had no way to meet SHIKI’s attack.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shit------!!"
I hear a voice.
The sound of SHIKI running toward me through the grass accompanies it.
"You don't know when to stay down.
You should have died with that-----!!"
He's coming.
I cannot fight back since I'm on the ground.

entries.japanese:
迫ってくる。
　刃物のように鋭利な爪を生やした腕を突き出して、俺の、心臓を抉り取ろうと迫ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Closer.
An arm thrust before him, its nails honed like knives, reaching for my heart—coming to tear it out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
He's coming.

He sticks out his arm with sharp nails and approaches, trying to dig my heart out.

entries.japanese:
それは、まるでサーカスみたい。
　暗い森。
いつ幕があがるのかと、わくわくした。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was like a circus.
The dark woods. I waited in a thrill for the curtain to rise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's like a circus.
Dark forest.
I get excited thinking about when the curtain will rise.

entries.japanese:
とおくには蝉の声。
　あおいそら　と　たかいたかい入道雲。
entries.maoEnglish:
Cicadas in the distance.
A blue sky, and tall, tall thunderheads.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The far away voices of cicadas.
Blue sky, and high, high, summer clouds.

entries.japanese:
そうして。
　また、森の中で殺されるっていうのか。
　それは頭にくる。
　そう何度も。
　何度も何度も、同じように殺されるのか。
――――目を覚ませよ遠野志貴。
　そんなことは、いいかげん。
　もう、見飽きてしまっているだろう―――？
entries.maoEnglish:
And so.
I was going to be killed in the woods again.
That made me angry.
Again and again.
How many times would I be killed the same way?
――――Wake up, Shiki Tohno.
You’ve seen enough of this by now.
Aren’t you sick of it yet?
entries.mirrorMoon:
And then.
I'll be killed again in the forest?
That pisses me off.
Again.
Again and again, being killed in the same way?
-----Wake up, Tohno Shiki.
Enough of that.
Aren't you tired of seeing that over and over----?

entries.japanese:
「え―――――――――？」
　声をあげたのは、シキのほうだった。
　シキの腕は俺の胸ではなく、地面を抉っている。
　……別に、なんという事はない。
　何度も何度も同じ殺され方をしたものだから、たんに体のほうが慣れていただけ。
　遠野志貴は、自分の胸を貫こうとした敵の腕をかわして、そのまま敵の腹部に走っていた『線』を切断していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—?!”
The cry came from SHIKI.
His arm had gouged the earth, not my chest.
It was nothing miraculous.
After being killed the same way so many times, my body had simply learned.
Shiki Tohno had slipped past the arm meant to pierce his chest and severed the ‘line’ running across his enemy’s abdomen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What--------?"
The voice comes from SHIKI.
SHIKI's arm is not in my chest, but on the ground.
…… It's nothing, really.
My body has learned to react after having been killed so many times in the same way.
Tohno Shiki simply avoided the enemy's arm and then cut across the line on the enemy's torso.

entries.japanese:
「う―――そだろ？」
　ずるり、と。
　シキの体が横にズレる。
　それを必死に腕で支えて、シキは離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re kidding.”
With a wet slide.
SHIKI’s body shifted sideways.
Bracing the halves together desperately with one arm, he staggered back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Are----you kidding me?"
With a sound,
SHIKI's body slides to one side.
SHIKI desperately supports it as he gets away.

entries.japanese:
「なんで――――なんで、なんで、なんで？
　なあ志貴、おかしいよ。
この傷、どうして――――簡単に、くっついて、くれないんだ？」
　ひきつった笑みをうかべて、シキはよろよろと後退していく。
　少しずつズレていく上半身と下半身。
　それを片腕で、必死に押さえつけているシキの姿は、サーカスの道化のようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why—why, why, why? Shiki, this is wrong. Why won’t this wound… just close?”
A rigid smile on his face, SHIKI stumbled backward.
His upper and lower body slid farther apart by degrees.
The sight of SHIKI desperately holding himself together with one arm was like a clown at the circus.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why-----why, why, why?
Hey Shiki, this is wrong.
This cut, why----won't it stick back?"
With a cramped smile on his face, SHIKI staggers back.
His upper body and lower body slowly separate.
SHIKI looks like a circus clown trying to desperately hold onto his body.

entries.japanese:
「いた――――いた、い。
なんだ、やだよコレ。
気が遠く、なる。
血が止まらない。
体が別れる。
痛い。
痛い。
痛い。
痛い。
痛い。
痛い。
いた――――」
　言って。
　ずるり、とシキは倒れこんだ。
　足はまだ立ったまま。
　上半身だけが、何かの冗談のように地面に落ちた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It hu—hurts. What is this? I don’t like it. I’m blacking out. The blood won’t stop. My body’s coming apart. It hurts. Hurts. Hurts. Hurts. Hurts.
Hurts.
It—” With a wet slide, SHIKI collapsed.
His legs remained standing.
Only his upper body fell to the ground, like some kind of joke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ou----ch.
It hurts.
I don't like it.
I'm going to pass out.
I can't stop bleeding.
My body is separating.
It hurts.
It hurts.
It hurts.
It hurts.
It hurts.
It hur----"
Saying that,
SHIKI falls to the ground.
His legs are still standing.
Only his upper body falls to the ground like some kind of joke.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　生き、てる。
　あんな上半身だけの、出来そこないのクモのようなカタチになっても、あいつは生きている。
「ぐっ……………」
　痺れる体にムチをうって、なんとか立ちあがる。
　あいつは、生きてる。
　なら――――殺さ、ないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
He was alive.
Even reduced to an upper body shaped like a malformed spider, he was alive.
“Ghh…”
I lashed my numb body until I managed to stand.
He was still alive.
Then—I had to kill him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
He's still alive.
He's still alive after becoming like a weird spider with only his upper body left.
"Ghu……………"
I push my body and manage to stand up.
He's still alive.
Then----I have to kill him.

entries.japanese:
「ひ―――――！？」
　ずるずると片腕で逃げようとするソレの前にひざまずいた。
　ナイフを頭上に振りかぶる。
　あとは、これを落とすだけ。
　ソレの中心、心臓のやや隣にある『点』のような線にナイフを落とせば、それで終わる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eek—?!”
I knelt before the thing dragging itself away on one arm.
I raised the knife over my head.
All I had to do was bring it down.
Drive the blade into the point-like ‘line’ near the center of that thing, just beside its heart, and it would end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi------!?"
I kneel down in front of that thing that is dragging itself with its right hand.
I raise my knife.
Now, all I have to do is to drop it.
If I drop my knife in the center of his body, in the "point" next to his heart, everything will end.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――ひ、ひ？」
　……終わる。
　なにもかも。
　八年前から続いていたくだらない因縁も、それだけで終わるんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—hee, hee?”
It would end.
Everything.
The worthless entanglement stretching back eight years would end with one stroke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----Hiii, hiiii?"
…… Will end.
Everything.
A stupid story that has continued for eight years will end with just that.

entries.japanese:
「ひゃ――――ひぃいいぃぃい！？」
　死を拒むシキの声。
　……別に、ソレに同情をしたわけじゃない。
　今になって恐くなったわけでもない。
　怒りが。
薄れてしまったわけでも、ない、のに。
「……なん、で」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hya—heeeeeee?!”
SHIKI’s voice rejected death.
It wasn’t pity for that thing.
I hadn’t suddenly become afraid.
My anger had not faded. And yet— “Why…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hya------Hyaiiiiiii!?"
SHIKI's voice resists death.
…… It's not like I feel sorry for him.
It's not that I got scared of killing him.
It's not that my anger has gone away, but "…… Why?"

entries.japanese:
なんで。
　俺は、このナイフを落とすなんていう、簡単なコトさえできないんだろう……？
entries.maoEnglish:
Why?
Why couldn’t I do something as simple as letting this knife fall?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Why?
Why can't I do something so easy as bringing down this knife……?

entries.japanese:
「ひ―――ひひ、ひひひひひひひひ……！！！」
　笑って、ずるずるとソレは草むらの中に消えていった。
「――――――――」
　呆然と眺めて、血に染まったナイフを見つめた。
　……俺は、殺さなかった。
　それとも殺せなかっただけなのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hee—heehee, heeheeheeheehee…!”
Laughing, the thing dragged itself into the grass and vanished.
“…”
I stared after it, then down at my bloodstained knife.
I hadn’t killed him.
Or perhaps I simply hadn’t been able to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi----Hihi, hihihihihihihi……!!!"
Laughing, that thing disappears into the bushes.
"---------"
I look with a blank stare at my bloody knife.
…… I did not kill him.
Or was it that I could not kill him?

entries.japanese:
ひひ、ひひひ、ひひひひひひひ。
　耳障りな笑い声が聞こえる。
　それは離れの屋敷のほう。
秋葉が残されている屋敷に向かっているように、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Heehee. Heeheehee. Heeheeheeheehee.
That grating laughter carried through the woods.
It seemed to be moving toward the detached house—toward the house where Akiha remained.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hihi, hihihi, hihihihihihihihi.
I hear the annoying laughter.
It seems like he is going toward the detached building, where Akiha is left.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――！」
　立ちあがる。
　なんて甘さだ。
あいつが最後に秋葉のところに逃げ込むなんて、そんなのは考えればすぐに解る事だったのに……！
「くっ―――――！」
　満足に動きやしない両足を動かして、離れの屋敷へ走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I lurched upright.
How could I have been so naive? A moment’s thought should have told me he would flee to Akiha in the end.
“Kh—!”
Forcing my useless legs to move, I ran for the detached house.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----!!"
I get up.
How stupid of me!
I should have known that he would have gone to Akiha.
"Ku-----!"
I start to move my weak legs and head for the detached building.

entries.japanese:
血の跡は一直線に離れへと伸びている。
　赤い道のはしばしには、臓物らしきものが散らばっていた。
　……これではあの場でトドメを刺すまでもなく、シキはいずれ息絶えていただろう。
だがその前に、あいつは最後の力で秋葉の元に向かっている。
「く―――――」
　倒れそうになる体を支えて走る。
　血の跡を辿って離れに着く。
　血は。
そのまま、屋敷の中へと侵入していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The blood trail ran straight to the detached house.
Things that looked like pieces of intestine lay scattered along that red road.
At this rate, SHIKI would have died whether or not I finished him in the clearing. But before that happened, he was using the last of his strength to reach Akiha.
“Kh…”
Holding my collapsing body together, I ran.
I followed the blood to the house.
It had gone straight inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The trail of blood goes straight to the detached building.
Around the red trail are remnants of organ-like pieces.
…… With an injury like that, SHIKI would have died anyway without me finishing him off back there, but he is using his last energy to get to Akiha.
"Ku----"
I support my weak body and run.
I reach the detached building after following the red trail of blood.
The blood goes directly into the building.

entries.japanese:
―――間に合った。
　和室の中は、さっきとなんら変わっていない。
　壁際には呆然と座りこんだ秋葉がいる。
　畳の上には血の跡があって、そこには。
「あ―――あ、ああ、あ―――」
　ずるり、と。
　上半身しかない男が、必死に畳の上を這っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I had made it in time.
The tatami room was exactly as I had left it.
Akiha sat dazed against the wall.
Blood streaked the mats, and there.
“A-ah—ah…”
With a wet, dragging sound.
A man with only an upper body crawled frantically across the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I made it in time.
Nothing is different inside the room.
Akiha sits by the wall with a blank stare.
On the tatami floor is a trail of blood, and there,
"Ah----a, aa, a----"
Crawling.
A man with only his upper body, dragging himself desperately on the ground.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――あ、あき、は―――！」
　ずるずると。
　ナメクジのように跡を残して、シキは壁によりかかった秋葉へと這っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A-ah—Akiha…!”
Dragging himself along.
SHIKI crawled toward her, leaving a glistening trail like a slug.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A----A-Aki, ha---!"
Dragging on.
Leaving a trail like a slug, SHIKI crawls toward Akiha by the wall.

entries.japanese:
「たす、け―――あき、は―――」
　助けを請うように伸ばされる腕。
　血にまみれた指が、呆然と座り込んでいる秋葉に伸びる。
「――――――――」
　そんな事はさせない。
　その前に、歩み寄ってヤツの息の根を止めないと―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Help… me… Aki… ha…”
He reached for her as if begging for salvation.
Blood-smeared fingers stretched toward Akiha where she sat in a stupor.
“…”
I couldn’t allow it.
Before he touched her, I had to reach him and end his life—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"He, lp, me-----Aki, ha----"
SHIKI reaches out his hands asking for help.
His bloody fingers reach out to Akiha.
"--------"
I won't let him.
I have to go over there and finish him off----

entries.japanese:
「え―――――？」
　驚きは、俺とシキの口から、同時にもれた。
　ふ、ふふ。
　無邪気な笑い声が、した。
「ギィ―――あ、ひぃあ、あ、ああああああ！」
　心臓をもぎ取られて、シキが叫ぶ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—?”
The same gasp escaped both SHIKI and me.
Heh… heh-heh.
An innocent laugh.
“Gyee—ah, heeaa, aaaaaah!”
SHIKI screamed as his heart was torn out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What----?"
The exclamation of surprise comes from both me and SHIKI.
Hu, huhu.
Innocent laughter.
"Gi----A, hya, a.
Ahhhhhhhh!!"
SHIKI screams as his heart is ripped out.

entries.japanese:
あはは、は。
　子供みたいな、笑い声。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ahaha… ha.
A child’s laughter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Ahahahaha.
Childlike laughter.

entries.japanese:
「ひ、ひゃああああああああああああああ！」
　シキの叫び。
　ビュッと飛び散る血。
　畳や障子を紅に切り裂いていく、血の筋。
　あは、あはは、あははは
　楽しくて仕方がないという、笑い声。
「や、やめ、やめて、あき、秋葉ぁああああああ！」
　シキの叫びは、そこで終わった。
　声をあげるべき器官である喉を潰され、頭ごと、首を引き千切られたから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H-heeeeeeeeeeeeeee!”
SHIKI’s scream.
Blood bursting through the air.
Crimson lines slashing across tatami and paper screens.
Aha. Ahaha. Ahahaha.
Laughter too delighted to contain itself.
“S-stop, stop it, Aki—Akihaaaaa!”
SHIKI’s scream ended there.
The throat that made his voice was crushed, and his neck, head and all, was torn away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi, hyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!"
SHIKI's scream.
Blood sputters all over.
Waves of red blood color the tatami floor and the walls.
Aha, ahaha, ahahaha.
Laughter of unbearable happiness.
"S-stop, stop, Aki, AKIHAAAA!!"
SHIKI's scream ends there.
It's because his throat, the organ allowing him to talk, is crushed, and was torn away along with his head from his body.

entries.japanese:
「あき――――は」
　俺の呟きに、秋葉は反応しない。
　……おそらく、自分がそんな名前だったなんていう事が、わかっていない。
　秋葉は赤い髪を振り乱して、あはははは、と童女のように笑うだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aki… ha.”
She gave no sign that she heard me.
Perhaps she no longer knew that such a name had ever belonged to her.
Tossing her red hair, Akiha merely laughed like a little girl.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki----ha."
Akiha does not react to my voice.
…… She probably doesn't even know that's her name.
Akiha waves her red hair around and laughs like a little girl.

entries.japanese:
「秋―――――葉」
　答えはない。
