　理性というものが抜け落ちた秋葉を前にして、俺は―――ただ、そんな事しか、言えなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aki… ha.”
No answer.
Standing before an Akiha emptied of reason, that was all I could say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki----ha."
There's no answer.
That is all I can say to her.
She's lost her mind.

entries.japanese:
くすくす。
　秋葉の笑い声が響く。
　シキの体をしばらくいじっていた彼女は、動かない玩具にもう飽きてしまったらしい。
　きょろきょろと部屋中を見渡したあと、唐突に、障子を破って外へと駆け出していった。
　その両手を、生々しい血で濡らしたまま。
entries.maoEnglish:
Soft giggles.
Akiha had played with SHIKI’s body for a while.
She seemed to tire of the toy once it stopped moving.
She looked around the room, then abruptly tore through a paper screen and raced outside.
Her hands still wet with fresh blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Giggling.
The sound of Akiha's laughter echoes in the room.
She was fiddling with the body of SHIKI, but seems to have gotten bored of her toy which didn't move anymore.
After looking around the room, she rips through the shouji and runs outside.
Her hands are still drenched in blood.

entries.japanese:
「ま――――――」
　待て、とは言えない。
　……わかってる。
　もう、何もかも手遅れなんだって解っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wai—”
I couldn’t tell her to wait.
I knew.
I knew that everything was already too late.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wa-------"
I can't tell her to wait.
…… I know.
I know that everything is too late.

entries.japanese:
子供のような秋葉。
　無邪気な、物の善悪さえ知らないまま、あんなふうに人を殺すしかない生き物。
―――殺して、ください。
　だから。
　いま、俺が秋葉を追いかけるという事は。
　彼女を、殺すという、事だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha, like a child.
An innocent creature that knew neither right nor wrong and could do nothing but kill people that way.
―――Please kill me.
And so.
For me to follow Akiha now.
Would mean going to kill her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That childlike Akiha.
She is now an innocent creature, not knowing good or evil.
Just a living creature that can only kill.
---Please, kill me.
So.
To go after Akiha right now means…
I am going to kill her.

entries.japanese:
―――答えなんて出ない。
　だが、秋葉を放っておけないことだけは確かだ。
「――――――っ」
　こみ上げてくる感情を押し殺す。
　何も考えられないまま、秋葉の後を追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――No answer came.
But one thing was certain: I could not abandon Akiha.
“—!”
I forced down the emotion rising inside me.
Unable to think at all, I ran after Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I cannot come up with an answer.
But I do know that I can't leave Akiha alone.
"-------!!"
I kill the flood of emotions.
Without thinking, I go after Akiha.

entries.japanese:
――意外なことに、秋葉は外に出ていなかった。
　月明かりの下。
　いつか一緒に話をした紅葉の木の下で。
　秋葉は、ぼんやりと立ち尽くしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――To my surprise, Akiha had not left the grounds.
In the moonlight.
Beneath the maple tree where we had once talked together.
Akiha stood lost in a daze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--To my surprise, Akiha has not gone beyond the mansion.
Under the moonlight.
Under the autumn leaved tree we once talked under.
Akiha just stands there.

entries.japanese:
静かに、ぽつりと佇んでいる。
　何をするでもない。
　子供のように純真に、散っていく紅葉を眺めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
She stood alone and still.
Doing nothing.
With the innocence of a child, she watched the maple leaves drift down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She is standing quietly.
Not doing anything.
Like a child, she innocently stares at the falling autumn leaves.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　それを―――どうする事が、できるだろう。
　理性もなく、知性もない。
ただそこにいるだけの少女。
　そこに罪なんてない。
　秋葉は、何も、悪くない、のに。
―――――殺してください。
　その言葉が思い出される。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
What could I possibly do to her?
Without reason or intellect. A girl who merely existed there.
There was no guilt in that.
Akiha had done nothing—nothing wrong.
―――――Please kill me.
The words came back to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
What---could I do about it?
No reason, no intelligence, a girl that's just there.
There's no crime.
Akiha is not the one to blame…
-----Please kill me.
I recall those words.

entries.japanese:
―――貴方の手で、殺してください。
　なんて残酷な、願い。
　そんな事しか―――助けてほしいとさえ、言えなかったのか。
　そう言ってくれれば―――俺は何を敵にしたって、最後まで、おまえのことを守り続けるのに。
―――貴方だけは、約束を守ってください。
　……ひどい仕打ちだ。
　そりゃあ八年間も放っておいたけど。
こんな報復をされるなんて、思ってもいなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Kill me with your own hands.
What a cruel wish.
Was that all she could bring herself to ask—couldn’t she even say she wanted me to save her?
If you had only said it—no matter what I had to make my enemy, I would have protected you to the very end.
―――You, at least, must keep your promise.
…What a vicious thing to do to me.
Yes, I had abandoned her for eight years. But I never imagined she would take revenge like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Please kill me with your hands.
What a cruel wish.
She could only ask for that---she couldn't even ask for help.
If you asked---I would have been on your side until the very last moment, even if the whole world was against me.
---Please keep our promise.
…… What severe treatment.
I did leave her for eight years, but I never thought I'd be retaliated against in such a way.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　秋葉は言った。
　自分が誰かも解らず、ただ本能に従って人を殺してしまうモノになってしまうのなら、それは死より恐ろしい事なんだって。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
Akiha had said it.
That becoming a creature driven to kill by instinct, no longer even knowing who she was, would be a fate worse than death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Akiha said…
Not knowing who you are and going around killing people out of instinct is more frightening than death.

entries.japanese:
先輩は言った。
　自分が誰かも解らず、ただ本能に従って人を殺してしまうモノになってしまうのなら、死なせてやるほうが救いなんだと。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ciel had said it.
That if someone became such a thing—killing by instinct without even knowing who they were—then allowing them to die was the only mercy left.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Senpai said…
If you become something that just kills because of instinct, sometimes death is the only salvation.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　ナイフを握る。
　不思議と、哀しいとも感じない。
　ココロがガランドウになってしまったみたいに、何も、感じたくはなかった。
「秋葉――――」
　落ち葉を踏みしめて秋葉へと歩いていく。
　気づいて、秋葉は笑顔で俺を迎えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—”
I gripped the knife.
Strangely, I felt no sorrow.
As though my heart had been hollowed out, I wanted to feel nothing at all.
“Akiha—”
Leaves crunched underfoot as I walked toward her.
She noticed me and welcomed me with a smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I grip my knife.
Surprisingly, I feel no sadness.
It's like my mind has gone empty; I don't want to feel any emotions.
"Akiha---"
I step on the dead autumn leaves as I walk towards her.
Akiha notices me and greets me with a smile.

entries.japanese:
「―――――せめて」
　ナイフを強く握る。
　秋葉は、笑った。
　あはははは、と楽しそうに笑って、自らを殺そうとする俺を、迎えている。
「―――――っ」
　決心が鈍る。
　けど、もう歩き出してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“At least—”
I tightened my grip on the knife.
Akiha laughed.
She laughed merrily—ahahahahaha—and welcomed me as I came to kill her.
“—!”
My resolve faltered.
But I had already begun to walk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----At least."
I grip hard onto my knife.
Akiha laughs.
She laughs happily as she greets the person that will kill her.
"-------!!"
My mind weakens.
But I have started walking.

entries.japanese:
―――死が、救いになることもある。
　歩く。
　秋葉は逃げ出さないで、楽しそうに、俺を待っている。
―――殺して、ください
　散りゆく紅葉。
―――それが、おまえの最後の望みだったから。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Sometimes death could be salvation.
I kept walking.
Akiha did not run; she waited for me, smiling with delight.
―――Please kill me
Falling maple leaves.
―――Because that had been your final wish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Death can be salvation.
I walk.
Akiha does not run away, but waits for me happily.
----Please kill me.
The autumn leaves fall.
---That was your last wish.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は笑っている。
　もう、これ以上近寄れる距離がない。
　あとはこの腕を突き出すだけで、よかった。
―――俺は、どんなに辛くても
「おまえを、殺さないといけない」
　告げて。
　不意に、涙があふれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha was smiling.
There was no distance left to close.
All I had to do was drive my arm forward.
―――No matter how much it hurt, I—
“I have to kill you.”
I said it aloud.
Then the tears came without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha is laughing.
There's no more distance to cross.
Now all I have to do is stick out this arm.
----No matter how painful it is for me,
"I have to kill you."
Saying that,
my eyes suddenly overflow with tears.

entries.japanese:
―――そうして。
　正面から、秋葉の体を抱きしめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And then.
I wrapped my arms around Akiha from the front.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And then,
I embrace Akiha's body from the front.

entries.japanese:
―――殺せるはずが、ない。
「……生きていてほしいんだ」
　不思議そうに首をかしげる秋葉。
「どんな姿になっても―――俺はおまえに生きていてほしいんだ、秋葉」
　涙は止まってくれない。
　秋葉は嬉しそうに抱き返して―――俺の首筋に、がちりと歯をつきつけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――There was no way I could kill her.
“…I want you to live.”
Akiha tilted her head, puzzled.
“No matter what you become, I want you to go on living, Akiha.”
The tears wouldn’t stop.
Akiha happily returned my embrace—then set her teeth hard against my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---There's no way I could kill her.
"…… I want you to live."
Akiha tilts her head questioningly.
"No matter what you become---I still want you to live, Akiha."
My tears cannot be stopped.
Akiha hugs back joyfully---and bites on my neck.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――」
　痛い。
　それは、血を吸うためのものじゃない。
　ただ噛みきるだけの、原始的な行為。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—”
Pain.
This wasn’t a bite meant to drink blood.
A primitive act meant only to bite through flesh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!!"
It hurts.
But it is not an act to suck my blood.
It is just a primitive act to bite me.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――あき、は」
　秋葉はただ、一心不乱に噛みついてくる。
　がり、と肉が裂かれて骨が削られる。
　秋葉に理性はない。
　抱きしめている相手が誰であるかも、抱きしめるという行為の意味さえもわからない。
　秋葉は、ヒトのカタチをしたケモノと変わらない。
　けど、それでも――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“A-Aki…ha.”
She bit down with mindless abandon.
Flesh tore with a grating crunch; teeth scraped bone.
There was no reason left in Akiha.
She no longer knew whom she held, or even what it meant to hold someone.
Akiha was nothing but a beast in human shape.
But even so—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A-Akiha."
Akiha just frantically bites my neck.
She tears off the meat and my bones are being chipped away.
Akiha has no intelligence.
She does not know who is holding her, or the meaning of an embrace.
Akiha is no different from a beast in human form.
But still----

entries.japanese:
「―――それでも……生きていて、ほしいんだ」
　……そう願うことはいけないのか。
　たとえ秋葉が人を殺してまわるようなモノになってしまっても、それでも生きていてほしいと思うのは罪なのか。
　秋葉が。
そんな自分には耐えられないといっても、俺は、それに耐えて欲しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even so… I want you to live.”
…Was it wrong to wish for that?
Even if Akiha became something that roamed the streets killing people, was it a sin to want her alive?
Even if she said she could never endure becoming such a thing, I wanted her to endure it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Still…… I want you to live."
…… Is it wrong to wish such a thing?
Is it a crime to wish for her to stay alive even though she goes around killing people?
Even if Akiha says she cannot endure such a thing, I want her to endure past it.

entries.japanese:
だが。
　そんなものは―――俺の、かってな、願い。
entries.maoEnglish:
But.
That was nothing more than my own selfish wish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But.
That's---just a selfish wish.

entries.japanese:
「―――けど、約束だもんな」
　秋葉は離れない。
　抱きしめたまま、秋葉の『線』にナイフを当てる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I made you a promise.”
Akiha would not let go.
Still holding her, I set the knife against one of her “lines.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----But, we made a promise."
Akiha does not let go.
Still holding on to her, I place my knife on Akiha's "line".

entries.japanese:
―――いずれ、おまえが誰かに殺されるなら。
「誰にも、傷つけさせない」
―――ナイフは音もなく。
　　　おそらくは痛みさえなく。
「俺が、おまえの唯一人の相手だから、さ」
―――優しく、秋葉の命を止めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――If someone was destined to kill you one day.
“I won’t let anyone hurt you.”
―――The knife moved without a sound.
And, almost certainly, without pain.
“Because I’m the one—and only one—for you.”
―――And gently, I brought Akiha’s life to a halt.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---If someone is going to kill you eventually, then…
"I won't let anyone hurt you."
----The knife, without a sound,
and probably without pain,
"Since I am the only one for you."
----Gently ends Akiha's life.

entries.japanese:
紅葉が散っていく。
　赤い地面。
そこに、秋葉は横になっている。
　地面に広がる髪は黒。
鮮やかに、赤い葉っぱの中でうねっている。
　死に顔は穏やかで、まるで幸せな夢を見ているように、思えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crimson leaves drifted down.
Red earth. Akiha lay upon it.
Her hair was black. It spread across the ground, curling vividly among the scarlet leaves.
Her face was peaceful in death, as though she were dreaming something happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The autumn leaves fall.
Akiha lies on the red ground.
The hair scattered on the ground is black.
It vividly undulates on the red leaves.
Her face is peaceful, as if happily dreaming.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　或る、一つの出来事が、終わった。
　子供の頃。
　ここで待ち合わせて、中庭をかけまわった時の嬉しさも。
　二人きりで言葉もなく星の空を見上げ続けた時の眩しさも。
　つい、数日前。
　ここで、話した出来事も、全て。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Something had come to an end.
When we were children.
The happiness of meeting here and racing through the courtyard.
The radiance of sitting here alone together, gazing wordlessly at the stars.
Only a few days ago.
Everything—even the conversation we shared here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
One event has ended.
When I was a child.
The happiness when we met here and ran around this courtyard.
The brightness of the stars we watched together.
Just a few days ago.
Everything we talked about here.

entries.japanese:
――――兄さん。
秋葉は兄さんが帰ってきてくれただけで嬉しいんです。
　……その事を、心の何処かに覚えていてくださいね。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Brother. Akiha is happy simply because you came home.
…Please keep that somewhere in your heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Nii-san, I am just happy that you have come back.
…… I just want you to keep that in mind.

entries.japanese:
いつのまにか、月を見上げていた。
　……体が冷たい。
　意識が眠りに落ちる時のように、くらくらと揺らいでいく。
entries.maoEnglish:
At some point, I found myself looking up at the moon.
…My body was cold.
My consciousness swayed and faltered as though sinking into sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At some point, I started staring at the moon.
…… My body is cold.
My mind feels dizzy, like I'm about to go to sleep.

entries.japanese:
……眠い。
　もしこのまま眠りについてしまえば、全ては元通りになっているかもしれないなんていう、ゆめをみた。
　けどそれはゆめで、結局はいつか醒めてしまう。
　こうしてまどろんでいる自分さえ、一つのユメのように思える。
　それともすべては、はじめから邯鄲の夢だったのか。
　それなら、どうか。
　この夢のまま醒めることなく、眠り続けてくれれば良かったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
I was sleepy.
I dreamed that if I simply fell asleep like this, perhaps everything might return to the way it was.
But a dream is still a dream, and in the end one always wakes.
Even I, drowsing here like this, began to seem no more than a dream.
Or perhaps it had all been the Dream of Handan from the very beginning—a lifetime dreamed in a moment?
If so, then please.
If only I could have gone on sleeping forever, never waking from this dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I'm sleepy.
I feel like if I slept right now, I could dream that this was all a dream.
But that's just a dream and someday, I would have to wake up.
It feels like even I am just part of this dream.
Or was everything an ephemeral dream from the start?
If so, please…
Let me sleep on and never wake me up.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――は、は」
　空には青い青い硝子の月。
　高い木々のカーテンと、ふりしきる、拍手のような紅葉の群れ。
「はは、は――――――」
　ただ哀しくて、涙よりは笑いがこぼれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha—ha.”
Overhead hung a moon of blue, blue glass.
Tall trees formed the curtains, and a storm of crimson leaves fell like applause.
“Ha, ha—ha.”
I was simply too sad, and laughter spilled from me in place of tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------Ha, ha."
In the sky, the blue, blue, glass moon.
The tall curtain of trees and the applause of showering crimson leaves.
"Haha, ha------"
I'm sad, yet all that comes forth is laughter.

entries.japanese:
夜は深く。
　あたりは静謐としていて、その静けさが、喝采のように鼓膜に響く。
　視界が歪んで、狭くなっていく。
　……閉幕の時間らしい。
　木々のカーテンがくるくると回っていく。
　まるで。
　全てが作り物のような、
　サーカスの中に、いるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The night deepened.
Perfect stillness lay over everything, yet that silence rang against my eardrums like an ovation.
My vision warped and narrowed.
…It seemed the curtain was about to fall.
The curtains of trees wheeled round and round.
As though.
Everything were make-believe,
and I were standing inside a circus.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The night is deep.
There is a serene silence around me, which hits my eardrums like thunderous applause.
My view distorts and narrows.
…… It seems to be time to lower the curtain.
The curtain of trees turns round and round.
As if
everything in this circus
was artificial.

entries.japanese:
―――そうして。
　正面から、秋葉の体を抱きしめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And then.
I wrapped my arms around Akiha from the front.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And then,
I embrace Akiha's body from the front.

entries.japanese:
―――殺せるはずが、ない。
「……生きていてほしいんだ」
　不思議そうに首をかしげる秋葉。
「どんな姿になっても―――俺はおまえに生きていてほしいんだ、秋葉」
　涙は止まってくれない。
　秋葉は嬉しそうに抱き返して―――俺の首筋に、がちりと歯をつきつけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――There was no way I could kill her.
“…I want you to live.”
Akiha tilted her head, puzzled.
“No matter what you become, I want you to go on living, Akiha.”
The tears wouldn’t stop.
Akiha happily returned my embrace—then set her teeth hard against my throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---There's no way I could kill her.
"…… I want you to live."
Akiha tilts her head questioningly.
"No matter what you become---I still want you to live, Akiha."
My tears cannot be stopped.
Akiha hugs back joyfully---and bites on my neck.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――」
　痛い。
　それは、血を吸うためのものじゃない。
　ただ噛みきるだけの、原始的な行為。
「あ―――あき、は」
　秋葉はただ、一心不乱に噛みついてくる。
　がり、と肉が裂かれて骨が削られる。
　秋葉に理性はない。
　抱きしめている相手が誰であるかも、抱きしめるという行為の意味さえもわからない。
　秋葉は、ヒトのカタチをしたケモノと変わらない。
　けど、それでも――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—”
Pain.
This wasn’t a bite meant to drink blood.
A primitive act meant only to bite through flesh.
“A-Akiha.”
She bit down with mindless abandon.
Flesh tore with a grating crunch; teeth scraped bone.
There was no reason left in Akiha.
She no longer knew whom she held, or even what it meant to hold someone.
Akiha was nothing but a beast in human shape.
But even so—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----!!"
It hurts.
But it is not an act to suck my blood.
It is just a primitive act to bite me.

"A-Akiha."
Akiha just frantically bites my neck.
She tears off the meat and my bones are being chipped away.
Akiha has no intelligence.
She does not know who is holding her, or the meaning of an embrace.
Akiha is no different from a beast in human form.
But still----

entries.japanese:
「―――それでも……生きていて、ほしいんだ」
　……そう願うことはいけないのか。
　たとえ秋葉が人を殺してまわるようなモノになってしまっても、それでも生きていてほしいと思うのは罪なのか。
　秋葉が。
そんな自分には耐えられないといっても、俺は、それに耐えて欲しい。
――――その罪を。
　俺が背負うと思う事が、ただの、自分勝手な欺瞞だとしても。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even so… I want you to live.”
…Was it wrong to wish for that?
Even if Akiha became something that roamed the streets killing people, was it a sin to want her alive?
Even if she said she could never endure becoming such a thing, I wanted her to endure it.
――――That sin.
Even if believing I could bear it for her was only selfish hypocrisy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Still…… I want you to live."
…… Is it wrong to wish such a thing?
Is it a crime to wish for her to stay alive even though she goes around killing people?
Even if Akiha says she cannot endure such a thing, I want her to endure past it.

----Even if.
To think that the crime is borne by me is selfish thinking.

entries.japanese:
「……俺が、助ける」
　強く。
　ただ一心に、秋葉の体を抱きしめた。
「う、うぅう、うー！」
　腕の中で暴れる秋葉を抱きとめる。
　がっ、と。
　噛みつかれた肩の骨が、噛み砕かれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll save you.”
Tightly.
With all my heart, I held Akiha against me.
“U-uuuh!”
I held on as Akiha thrashed in my arms.
With a crack.
Her teeth crushed the bone in the shoulder she had bitten.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'll save you."
Hard.
With all my might, I embrace Akiha.
"Uh, uhhh, uhh!!"
I embrace the wildly moving Akiha.
Crunch.
She breaks my shoulder bone by biting through it.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――――あ、あき、は―――――」
　肩が噛み砕かれて、それでも片手で秋葉を抱きしめた。
「うー！
　うう、ん…………！！」
　バタバタと暴れる秋葉。
　それをずっと受け止めていた。
　……これが最後の抱擁になるかもしれないからだろうか。
　こんなに強く、相手の体温も鼓動も覚えようと抱きしめた事はなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—A-Akiha—”
Even with my shoulder crushed, I held her one-handed.
“Uu! Uu—nn…!”
Akiha kicked and flailed.
I held her through it all.
Was it because this might be our last embrace?
Never before had I held anyone so fiercely, straining to memorize every trace of warmth and every heartbeat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------A, Akiha-------"
Even though one of my shoulder's bones is broken, I embrace Akiha with one arm.
"Ugh!!
Uhnn………!!"
Akiha rages wildly.
I embrace her for a long time.
…… Is it because this might be our last embrace?
I have never held someone so dearly, trying to remember everything… their heartbeat, their warmth…

entries.japanese:
「うー……ん、ん……」
　……俺が何もしないとわかって安心したのか、秋葉は暴れる事をしなくなった。
　さらさらと降りしきる紅葉の中、どのくらいそうしていたのか。
　いつしか秋葉は、俺に体を預けたまま眠ってしまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Uu—nn, nn…”
Perhaps reassured that I meant her no harm, Akiha stopped struggling.
I don’t know how long we remained that way beneath the endless whisper of falling leaves.
At some point, Akiha fell asleep with her whole weight resting against me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh…… Mm……"
…… Maybe since she found out I am not going to do anything, Akiha stops fighting.
I don't know how long we were like this in the falling autumn leaves.
But Akiha has fallen asleep in my arms.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　できるだけ優しく、秋葉を地面に寝かす。
　秋葉の髪の色は赤いままだ。
　シキの言葉が確かならば。
　或る方法以外では、ずっと元の黒髪に戻る事はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I laid Akiha on the ground as gently as I could.
Her hair was still red.
If SHIKI had told the truth.
Then, barring one particular method, it would never return to its original black.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I rest Akiha's body on the ground as gently as I can.
Akiha's hair is still red.
If SHIKI's words are true, then…
There is no way for it to return it to black except for that one method.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　たとえどんな結果になろうとも、助けると誓った。
　秋葉を助ける方法は簡単だ。
　秋葉が遠野よりのモノになってしまっている原因。
　彼女がその命の半分を分け与えている人間がいなくなれば、彼女は元の『遠野秋葉』に戻れる。
　だがそれは――――俺の、遠野志貴の死を意味している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I had sworn to save her, whatever the cost.
The method was simple.
The reason she had become more fully one of the Tohnos was the person to whom she had given half her life.
If that person ceased to exist, she could return to being Akiha Tohno.
But that would mean the death of me—Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
I swore I would save her, no matter what happened.
It's really easy to save her.
The reason why Akiha is living as one of the Tohno Blood.
If the human she is sharing her life with disappears, she can go back to the original "Tohno Akiha".
But that means---the death of Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
一体何が幸福で、何が救いになるのかは解らない。
　死が救いになる、なんて言葉は知らない。
　けど、今は何が正しいのか判別がつかない。
　俺は――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I no longer knew what happiness was, or what salvation meant.
I had never believed that death could be salvation.
Yet now I couldn’t tell what was right.
I—
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know what leads to happiness or what can save us.
I don't know if death can be the way to save her.
But right now, I can't tell what is the right thing to do.
I------

entries.japanese:
ボンジュール！
　あと一歩という所でデッドエンドを迎えてしまった遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bonjour!
This little feature is for our dear Tohno, who met a dead end one step from victory,
and now it’s time! “Teach Me, Ciel!” Class is in session!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonjour!
The hint corner for Tohno-kun, who has ended up in this Dead End with only a bit left to go,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"

entries.japanese:
五時間目の授業は吸血鬼との戦闘について。
　本日は特別ゲストとしてロア博士をお呼びしています。
　ロア博士、今回の遠野くんの敗因はなんでしょうか？
「注意が足りなかった、という所でしょうか。
　相手の武器がなんであるか。
この追及が超越種と呼ばれる類との戦闘における最優先事項です。
　まあ彼は気付いていながら、最後のツメを誤ったという所でしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
Lesson five concerns combat with vampires.
Today we have invited Doctor Roa as our special guest.
Doctor Roa, what caused Tohno’s defeat this time?
“A lack of vigilance, I would say.
Determining the nature of one’s opponent’s weapon comes first. That is the foremost priority when fighting anything classed as a transcendent species.
He had, in fact, noticed it, but mishandled the final move.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The fifth period is about battles with vampires.
I have brought Professor Roa as a special guest.
Professor Roa, what is the reason for Tohno-kun's loss this time?
"I have to say he was a bit careless.
Finding out about your enemy's weapon is the top priority in a battle against the transcendent race.
Well, in this case, I think that he knew about it, but didn't act very intelligently."

entries.japanese:
ははあ。
　ところで博士。
どうして博士とこっちのシキさんは容姿が違うんですか？
　わたし、ずっと疑問に思ってたんですけど。
「そうですね、趣味の問題ではないでしょうか。
　シキの意識が薄かった時はかつてのロアとしての嗜好が表立ち、こういった服装や髪型をしていましたが。
　シキ君の方では、とある理由によってシキ君の自我がほぼ完全に崩壊してしまっているので、人格を寄り代にするロアも表立って出現できなかった、というコトではないか、と」
entries.maoEnglish:
I see.
By the way, Doctor. Why do you and this SHIKI look different?
I’ve always wondered about that.
“A matter of taste, perhaps.
When SHIKI’s consciousness was faint, Roa’s former preferences came to the surface, producing this manner of dress and hairstyle.
In SHIKI’s case, however, his sense of self had almost entirely collapsed for certain reasons; since Roa uses the host personality as his vessel, he could not manifest openly either—or so I would surmise.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I see.
Excuse me, Professor, but why does SHIKI-san in this route look different than you?
I've been wondering about this for a long time.
"Yes, I think it's just a difference in tastes.
When SHIKI's mind was weak, Roa's preferences surfaced and I dressed like this.
But in this case, SHIKI-kun completely lost his mind for some reason, and Roa could not come out since he relies on taking control of someone's mind.
That is my theory on what happened."

entries.japanese:
へええ。
つまり秋葉さんルートのシキさんは、紛れもない遠野シキという事なんだ。
　……遠野くん、シキ君と似ているっていうけど、あんまり似てませんね……
entries.maoEnglish:
Fascinating. So the SHIKI in Akiha’s route truly is SHIKI Tohno and no one else.
They say he resembles Tohno, but honestly―――they hardly look alike at all――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh really?
So in Akiha-san's route, SHIKI-san is the real Tohno SHIKI.
…… They say Tohno-kun is like SHIKI-kun, but they're not alike at all……

entries.japanese:
はい、最後の授業がやってきちゃいました。
　七時間目は、ある一つの終劇についてです。
　……約束を果たした遠野くんの心情は、彼以外の誰にも解らないものでしょう。
　わたしからアドバイスするような事はありません。
　ですが遠野くんが違う結末を望む、というのでしたらどうか遡って、もう一度自分の行動を選んでください。
entries.maoEnglish:
Here we are: the final lesson.
Lesson seven concerns one particular ending.
No one but Tohno can know what he felt when he kept that promise.
I have no advice to offer.
But if you want a different ending, please turn back and choose your actions again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It is time for the last lesson.
The seventh period is about the end of this one particular person.
…… No one can truly understand the feelings of Tohno-kun, who kept his promise.
There is nothing for me to advise.
But if Tohno-kun wishes for a different outcome, please go back a bit and choose a different course of action.

entries.japanese:
「えー。
でも秋葉の好感度が足りないと選択肢出てこないじゃん」
――――うっ。
　そ、その場合はですね、何日か戻って、秋葉さんとの絆を深めてください。
　そうすればきっと、違った運命が待っているはずですから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Whaaat. But if Akiha’s affection isn’t high enough, the choice never appears.”
――――Urk.
I-In that case, go back several days and deepen your bond with Akiha.
If you do, a different fate will surely be waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uhh, but if Akiha doesn't like you enough, you don't even get a choice."
----Ah.
In, in that case, please go back a couple of days and deepen your bond with Akiha-san.
If you do that, a different fate should await you.

entries.japanese:
―――死が、救いになるなんて事はない。
　それは八年前、死にかけてから蘇生した自分にとって、当たり前になっていた答えだった。
　どんなに苦しくても、どんなに辛くても、ただ生きているだけで幸せだと実感していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Death can never be salvation.
That answer had become self-evident to me in the eight years since I nearly died and was brought back.
However much life hurt, however bitter it became, being alive was happiness enough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I don't think death can be a way to save anyone.
It is an answer I've carried with me since my life was saved eight years ago.
No matter how painful or hard it is, I feel happy just being alive.

entries.japanese:
だから、それに従うのなら自殺するような真似はできない。
　秋葉だって死んでしまったわけじゃないんだ。
　生きているのなら、なんとか看病していって、いつか元に戻ってくれる日がくるかもしれない。
　簡単に命を投げ出すなんていうのは、死は尊いのだという幻想に酔っているコトだって、わかってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
If I held to that belief, I could never do anything that amounted to suicide.
Akiha wasn’t dead either.
As long as she lived, we could care for her, and perhaps one day she would return to herself.
I knew that throwing my life away so easily would mean surrendering to the fantasy that death was somehow noble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
So if I live up to my belief, I cannot kill myself.
It's not like Akiha has died either.
If she's alive, she might get well again one day if I take care of her.
I know that to give away your life that easily means you have an illusion that death is honorable.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――それでも」
　それでも、秋葉には幸せでいてほしいんだ。
　自分の事より、もっともっと何倍も、秋葉には幸せになってほしいだけなんだ。
　それに、元々。
　俺は八年前に死んでいて、ずっと、秋葉にユメを見させてもらっていたにすぎない。
　だから、これは本来の持ち主に返すだけの話。
　悲しむべき事もなければ、惜しむ事もない。
　全てはもとのカタチに納まるだけの終わりだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even so…”
Even so, I wanted Akiha to be happy.
Far more than I wanted happiness for myself—many times more—I wanted it for her.
Besides, I had died eight years ago.
All this time, Akiha had merely allowed me to dream.
So this was only a matter of returning something to its rightful owner.
There was nothing to mourn and nothing to regret.
It would simply be an ending in which everything resumed its proper shape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------But still."
Still, I want Akiha to be happy.
I just want Akiha to be much happier than I am.
Besides,
I was dead eight years ago and Akiha has given me this dream this whole time.
So this is just about giving back what used to be hers.
There's nothing to be sad about and there's nothing to lose.
It's an end where everything goes back to where it came from.

entries.japanese:
紅葉が散っていく。
　赤い地面。
そこに、秋葉は横になっている。
　地面に広がる髪は赤。
鮮やかに、赤い葉っぱの中に融けるように流れている。
　その顔は穏やかで、とても、幸せな夢を見ているように見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Crimson leaves drifted down.
The ground was red. Akiha lay there.
Her hair spread red across the earth. Vividly, it flowed among the scarlet leaves as though melting into them.
Her face was peaceful, as if she were dreaming a very happy dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The autumn leaves fall.
Akiha lies on the red ground.
Her hair on the ground is red.
It flows through the red leaves as if melting in them.
Her face looks peaceful, as if she's having a happy dream.

entries.japanese:
「……まったく。
こんな所で寝て、風邪引くなよ」
　出来るだけ普段通りに呟いて、自分の体を見下ろした。
　体中に走る『線』。
　どこを通せば、体に負担をかけずに死に至れるかを探してみる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. Sleeping out here—you’ll catch cold.”
I murmured as casually as I could and looked down at my body.
The ‘lines’ ran over every inch of it.
I searched for the one that would lead to death with the least strain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez, don't catch a cold sleeping in a place like this."
I mutter as normally as I can and look down at my body.
The "lines" are throughout my body.
I look to see which one would kill me the easiest.

entries.japanese:
「……ずっと、預かっていたものを返さないと。
長く借りすぎちまったけど、今ならまだ間に合うよな、あきは」
　……この体が、秋葉の命によって生かされているっていうんなら。
　俺というものが止まれば、その命は本来の持ち主に還るはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I have to return what I’ve been holding for you. I borrowed it far too long, but it isn’t too late yet, is it, Akiha?”
If Akiha’s life was what kept this body alive…
then when I come to a halt, that life should return to its true owner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I have to return what I have borrowed for so long.
I've borrowed it for too long, but I can still give it back to you in time.
Right, Akiha?"
…… If this body is being kept alive by Akiha,
then if I am eliminated, the life should go back to its original owner.

entries.japanese:
ナイフを体にあてる。
　どくん、と心臓が悲鳴をあげる。
　やっぱりソレは恐い。
　恐いから、穏やかに消えられるように、秋葉の寝顔だけを見つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I placed the knife against my body.
My heart screamed with a violent thud.
It was frightening after all.
Because I was afraid, I kept my eyes on Akiha’s sleeping face so I could vanish in peace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I place the knife on my body.
My heart screams loudly.
I am still scared.
Since I'm scared, I look at Akiha's sleeping face so that I can go away calmly.

entries.japanese:
「だめだな―――俺は、秋葉との約束を破ってばかりだ」
　死に至る、馴染んだ感触。
　一番死にやすそうな『線』にナイフが通る。
　瞬間。
　手足を操る糸が切れたように、体中の歯車が止まってしまった。
　ばたり、と秋葉の体に重なるように倒れ込む。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m hopeless—all I ever do is break my promises to you.”
The familiar sensation of approaching death.
The knife passed through the ‘line’ that offered the easiest end.
In that instant.
The strings controlling my limbs snapped, and every gear in my body stopped.
I toppled forward, falling across Akiha’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn---I just keep on breaking my promises with Akiha."
The familiar feeling of death.
My knife cuts through the "line" that will kill me the easiest.
At that moment,
as if the thing that controlled my body malfunctioned, my whole body stops working.
I fall onto Akiha.

entries.japanese:
薄れていく意識の底で、紅葉が降り積もっていくのを眺めた。
　雪のように降り積もる。
　それが、あんまりにもキレイだったおかげだろうか。
　眠るように、意識が白くなっていけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
From the depths of my fading consciousness, I watched the crimson leaves settle over us.
They fell and gathered like snow.
Perhaps it was because they were so beautiful.
My consciousness faded gently into white, as though falling asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As I start to pass out, I watch the falling autumn leaves.
They lay thick like snow.
It might be because it is so beautiful.
My mind goes blank as if I am going to sleep.

entries.japanese:
とおい月。
　白い夏の日。
　みーん、と。
　せみのなき声が、聞こえた。
!w1500
entries.maoEnglish:
A distant moon.
A white summer day.
Miiiiin.
I heard the cicadas singing.!w1500
entries.mirrorMoon:
Distant moon.
White, summer sun.
And the sound.
The sound of cicadas.

entries.japanese:
―――――暖かな陽射し。
　窓から差し込んでくる白い光にまぶたを刺されて、ゆっくりと目を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Warm sunlight.
The white light streaming through the window pricked my eyelids, and I slowly opened my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----Warm sunlight.
I feel the bright sunlight coming in from the window, and I open my eyes slowly.

entries.japanese:
「…………ん」
　まどろんでいた意識が醒める。
　窓ごしの青空は澄みきっていて、今日が気持ちのいい一日になるだろう事を告げていた。
「ふぁ―――――ぁ」
　……慣れないベッドで眠ったせいか、なんだか体が重い。
　んー、と背伸びをして体をほぐして、ベッドから起き上がった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm.”
My drowsing mind awoke.
The sky beyond the window was perfectly clear, promising a beautiful day.
“Yaaawn…”
Perhaps it was the unfamiliar bed, but my body felt strangely heavy.
I stretched until the stiffness eased, then rose.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Hmm."
I start to wake up.
The sky outside the window is a clear blue, and it tells me that today is going to be a beautiful day.
"Hwaa------ah."
…… It might be because I slept in an unfamiliar bed, but my body feels a bit heavy.
I stretch out a bit and get up.

entries.japanese:
コンコン、とドアを叩く音がした。
「失礼します」
　一礼して翡翠が入ってきた。
　翡翠は慣れた様子で扉を閉める。
「あ―――――――」
　……静かな朝。
　この部屋に訪れる事が当たり前のように振舞う彼女の姿を見て、少しだけ―――私は自分がこの部屋の主になった錯覚を覚えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
There came a soft knock at the door.
“Excuse me.”
Hisui bowed as she entered.
Then she closed the door with practiced ease.
“Ah…”
A quiet morning.
Watching her behave as though coming to this room were perfectly natural, for a moment I felt as if the room belonged to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hear a knock on the door.
"Excuse me."
Hisui comes in with a bow.
Hisui shuts the door as if she had a lot of experience doing it.
"Ah----------"
…… A quiet morning.
Looking at her acting like it was natural for her to come into this room---I feel for a while that this is my own room.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます秋葉さま。
昨夜はよく眠れたでしょうか？」
「ええ、ちゃんと眠れたわ。
ごめんね翡翠、兄さんの部屋で眠りたい、なんてわがままを言って」
「……いえ、そのような事はありません。
志貴さまも……秋葉さまに使っていただいて、嬉しいと思います」
　途切れ途切れに翡翠は言う。
「ふうん。
翡翠は諦めが悪いんだ。
そんな風に思ってもらえるなんて、兄さんは幸せ者かもね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Miss Akiha. Did you sleep well?”
“Yes, quite well. I’m sorry for being selfish and asking to sleep in Brother’s room, Hisui.”
“No, it wasn’t selfish. I believe Master Shiki would be glad to have Miss Akiha using his room.”
Hisui forced the words out in fragments.
“I see. You really don’t know when to give up. Brother may have been fortunate to have someone believe in him so stubbornly.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Akiha-sama.
Did you sleep well last night?"
"Yes, I did.
I'm sorry for saying such selfish things as me wanting to sleep in Nii-san's room."
"…… No, it is no problem.
I think… Shiki-sama is also happy for you to use this room."
Hisui says this haltingly.
"I see.
You don't give up easily, Hisui.
Nii-san should be happy that you think of him that much."

entries.japanese:
「あ―――秋葉さま……！」
「ホントのコトでしょう。
それじゃ着替えてから居間に行くから、琥珀に声をかけておいて」
「………………はい。
失礼します、秋葉さま」
　翡翠は静かに退室していった。
　部屋はとたんに寂しくなる。
　……兄さんは自分の荷物というものを持っていなくて、ここにはベッドと机ぐらいしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—Miss Akiha…!”
“It’s the truth. I’ll come to the sitting room once I’m dressed, so tell Kohaku.”
“Yes. Excuse me, Miss Akiha.”
Hisui withdrew in silence.
The room became lonely the instant she left.
Brother had owned almost nothing, so there was scarcely more here than a bed and a desk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A------Akiha-sama……!!"
"It is true, right?
I'm going to get changed and go to the sitting room.
Can you go tell that to Kohaku?"
"……………… Yes.
Excuse me, Akiha-sama."
Hisui exits the room quietly.
The room suddenly feels lonely.
…… Nii-san did not bring any of his belongings here; there is only a bed and a desk.

entries.japanese:
「…………ほんと。
こんな殺風景な部屋でよく眠れたわね、兄さんは」
　呆れてしまう。
　欲しいものがあったのならすぐに用意してあげたのに、兄さんは何も言わなかった。
　……私に遠慮してた、という事もあるんだろうけど、基本的にあの人は物欲が皆無なんだ。
　子供の頃からそうだった。
　自分は何もいらないって、あきはたちがいればそれでいいんだよって、キレイな笑顔でそう言っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. How did you sleep in such a barren room, Brother?”
It was exasperating.
If he had wanted anything, I would have provided it immediately, yet he had never asked.
Perhaps he had been reluctant to impose on me, but fundamentally, that man simply wanted no possessions at all.
He had been the same as a child.
He would smile beautifully and say that he needed nothing, that having all of us was enough.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Really, how could you sleep in such an empty room, Nii-san?"
I am surprised.
I would have obtained for him anything he wanted, but Nii-san did not ask for anything.
…… I guess he was reserving himself a bit, but he was basically a person with no desires for things.
He was like that from the time we were small.
He said with a smile that he did not want anything and he was happy if we were with him.

entries.japanese:
それが私には不安だったっけ。
　あの人は何も残さないで、何にも縛られていなかった。
　そうして自由であるという事は、何よりも孤独である事を幼い私に思い知らせてくれたのだ。
「――――――――ふん」
　窓を見る。
　いつも兄さんが見ていた景色。
　森の翠は、空の蒼に照らされていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
That had always frightened me.
He left nothing behind and allowed nothing to bind him.
Even as a little girl, I understood that to be so free was also to be utterly alone.
“Hmph.”
I looked toward the window.
It showed the view Brother had always seen.
The green forest lay illuminated beneath the blue sky.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But that made me uneasy.
He did not leave anything and he was not restricted by anything.
And he let me know as a child that to be free is to be lonely.
"----------Hm?"
I look out the window.
The view Nii-san was always watching.
The forest is illuminated under the blue sky.

entries.japanese:
―――あの後。
私はゆっくりと目を覚ました。
　落ち葉が敷き詰められた庭。
　そこで倒れたまま、ゆっくりと体を起こした。
　……私は生きていた。
髪も元に戻っていたし、血の昂ぶりも感じていなかった。
　体調はむしろ良好で、いつも体にあった脱力感も無くなってしまったと言っていいぐらい薄れていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Afterward. I slowly regained consciousness.
I lay in the garden on its bed of fallen leaves, then slowly raised myself.
I was alive.
My hair had returned to normal. I no longer felt the fever of my blood.
In fact, I felt so well that even the familiar weakness in my body had faded almost completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----After that, I slowly woke.
In the garden filled with dead leaves.
I slowly moved my collapsed body.
…… I was still alive.
My hair was returned to black, and I did not feel the rage in my blood.
I was feeling rather well and that load I had always had in my body was lifted, I could almost say it disappeared.

entries.japanese:
そう、子供のころ。
　大好きだった兄を助けたくて願った時からあった体の重さが、まるで無かった事のようになくなっていた。
　……あの重さは辛くはあったけど、同時に安心できる重さだったのに。
　自分の体は半分の力しかなくて、いつも体が重かったけど、嬉しかった。
　だってその重さが兄さんの重さで、私はずっとそうしているかぎりずっと、兄さんを感じていられたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, back when I was a child.
The heaviness I had carried since wishing to save the brother I adored had vanished as though it had never existed.
It had been painful, but also comforting.
My body had possessed only half its strength and had always felt heavy, yet that made me happy.
That heaviness was Brother’s weight, and as long as I carried it, I could feel him with me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, since I was a child.
That load that was there since I wished to save my brother, was gone, as if it never existed.
…… That load was painful for me, but it was also a load that relieved me.
I always had only half of my energy and I always felt a load, but I was happy.
Because that load was Nii-san, and I could feel Nii-san as long as I felt the load.

entries.japanese:
けれど、今はその重さが手の平ほどしか感じられない。
　庭を見渡す。
　落ち葉散る夜に、遠野志貴の姿はどこにもなかった。
　それで理解してしまった。
　自分はどうして生き帰れたのか。
　遠野秋葉は、どうして元の遠野秋葉に戻れたのか、という事の意味を。
entries.maoEnglish:
Now only a palm-sized remnant of that weight remained.
I searched the garden.
Shiki Tohno was nowhere to be found beneath the falling leaves.
Then I understood.
I understood why I had returned to life.
I understood what it meant for Akiha Tohno to become Akiha Tohno again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But that started to feel really light.
I looked around the garden.
I could not see Tohno Shiki anywhere in that night of falling leaves.
Then, I understood.
Why I was able to live.
Why Tohno Akiha returned to the original Tohno Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「……………………」
　外はいい天気だし、いつまでもこんな事をしていられない。
　早く着替えて、朝食を済ませて学校に行かないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The weather was beautiful, and I couldn’t sit here forever.
I needed to dress, eat breakfast, and go to school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
It is really nice outside and I can't stay like this forever.
I have to change and eat breakfast so I can get to school on time.

entries.japanese:
居間に下りて朝食を済ませる。
　時刻は六時を過ぎたばかり。
これならあと数分はゆっくりできるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I went down to the sitting room and finished breakfast.
It was only just past six. I still had a few minutes to relax.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I come down to the dining room and finish my breakfast.
It is only a little past six.
I should be able to relax for a few more minutes.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま」
「ん？
　なに、翡翠。
あなたも一服する？」
「………………」
　翡翠はいかつい顔で見つめてくる。
……というより、アレは睨んできているのかもしれない。
　大人しい翡翠にしては珍しい事だ。
「……朝のお茶に付き合ってくれる……ってわけじゃなさそうね。
なにか言いたい事でもあるの？」
「……はい。
失礼を承知で意見させていただきます。
秋葉さまは、なぜまた転校をなさったのですか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha.”
“Mm? What is it, Hisui? Would you like some tea?”
“…”
Hisui stared at me with a stern expression. In fact, she might have been glaring.
That was unusual for the normally quiet Hisui.
“You don’t seem to have come for tea. Is there something you want to say?”
“…Yes. Forgive my impertinence, but why has Miss Akiha transferred schools again?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama."
"Hmm?
What is it, Hisui?
Would you like to relax too?"
"………………"
Hisui looks at me with an angry expression…… no, it's more like she's staring at me.
It is a bit unusual for that calm Hisui.
"…… It does… not seem like you would like to join me for some morning tea.
Is there something you would like to say?"
"…… Yes.
Please forgive my rudeness, but why did you transfer schools again, Akiha-sama?"

entries.japanese:
――――なるほど、その事か。
　兄さんが死んでしまった、という事実を認めようとしない翡翠にしてみれば、私がもとの浅上女学院に戻ってしまった事は何かの符号のように感じられるのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――So that was it.
Hisui refused to accept that Brother was dead, so to her, my return to Asagami Girls’ Academy must have seemed like an ominous sign.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----I see.
It's about that.
The fact that I have transferred back to my original school must mean something to Hisui since she does not believe Nii-san has died.

entries.japanese:
「何故も何もないでしょう。
私があの学校に転校したのは兄さんがいたからです。
その目的がなくなったんだから、もとの場所に戻るのは当たり前でしょう？」
「…………………………」
　翡翠は納得がいかないようだ。
「それともなに？
　翡翠は兄さんがいなくてもあの学校に残るべきだっていうの？」
「…………はい。
志貴さまはお亡くなりになられた訳ではないのですから、秋葉さまがそのような事をなされると志貴さまは悲しまれます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is no mystery. I transferred to that school because Brother was there. Now that the reason is gone, returning to my former school is only natural.”
“…”
Hisui was plainly unconvinced.
“Or what? Do you think I should remain at that school even without him?”
“Yes. Master Shiki has not passed away, and if you do this, Miss Akiha, it will make Master Shiki very sad.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why do you ask?
I transferred to that school since Nii-san was there.
Now since that reason is gone, it is only natural for me to go back."
"…………………………"
It does not look like Hisui is convinced.
"Or what is it?
Are you saying I should have stayed at that school even though Nii-san isn't there?"
"………… Yes.
it is not like Shiki-sama has died.
If such a thing is done, Shiki-sama will feel sad."

entries.japanese:
「まさか。
もういない人がどう悲しむっていうのよ、翡翠」
　ソファーから立ちあがる。
　……時間は早いが、学校に行く事にしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be absurd. How can someone who no longer exists be sad, Hisui?”
I rose from the sofa.
It was early, but I would leave for school now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Impossible.
How can someone who's not here anymore feel sad, Hisui?"
I get up from the sofa.
…… It's still a bit early but I should leave.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、琥珀に準備をするように言って。
　ああ、あとこれから私は学園の寮で生活するようになるだろうから、屋敷の管理は引き続き任せるわ。
　引継ぎは今週中に済ませるから、詳しいことは帰ってきてからね」
「―――――――秋葉さま！」
「なに？
　まだ何かあるの、翡翠」
「……秋葉さまは……もう、志貴さまの事を忘れてしまうおつもりなのですか」
「別に。
ただ、いもしない人間の事を考えても時間の無駄なだけよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, tell Kohaku to prepare the car.
I’ll likely be living in the school dormitory from now on, so I’m leaving the management of the mansion in your hands.
We’ll complete the transfer of duties this week, and I’ll explain the details when I return.”
“Miss Akiha!”
“What is it? Is there still something else, Hisui?”
“Does Miss Akiha mean to forget Master Shiki now?”
“Not particularly. It is simply a waste of time to think about someone who isn’t here.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, can you tell Kohaku to get ready?
Oh, and I will probably live in the dormitory from now on, so I will leave you two in charge of the mansion.
I will make it official within this week, so I will give you the details when I come home."
"-----------Akiha-sama!"
"Yes?
What else do you have to say, Hisui?"
"…… Akiha-sama…… are you going to forget about Shiki-sama?"
"No, but it's a waste of time thinking about someone who is not here anymore."

entries.japanese:
居間を出る。
　背中に翡翠の視線を感じながら、ロビーへと歩いていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I left the sitting room.
With Hisui’s gaze fixed on my back, I walked toward the entrance hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave the room.
I walk to the lobby, feeling Hisui's eyes on my back.

entries.japanese:
「それでは行ってらっしゃいませ、秋葉さま」
　門まで見送りにきて、琥珀は一礼する。
「行ってくるわ。
夕方には戻ってくるから、話はその時にしましょう」
「はい。
けど残念です。
こうして秋葉さまを見送る事も、もうなくなってしまうんですから」
「……もう、琥珀までそんなコトを言うなんてね。
　こんなの、兄さんが帰ってくる前に戻っただけでしょう？
　私はもともと土日しか屋敷には帰ってこなかったんだし」
「そうですね。
けど槙久さまが亡くなられた今、秋葉さまがお屋敷に帰ってくる理由はありません。
　秋葉さま、これからは長期のお休みにしか帰ってこられないのでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have a safe journey, Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku had come to see me off at the gate and bowed.
“I’ll be back this evening. We can talk then.”
“Yes. But it’s sad. I won’t be seeing Miss Akiha off like this anymore.”
“Honestly, even you, Kohaku?
Things are merely returning to how they were before Brother came home. I used to return to the mansion only on weekends.”
“That is true. But now that Master Makihisa has passed away, Miss Akiha has no reason to return to the mansion.
From now on, Miss Akiha will come home only for the long school holidays, won’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please take care on your way, Akiha-sama."
Kohaku walks me to the gate and bows.
"I'm going.
I will be back this afternoon, so we can talk then."
"Yes, but it's a bit regrettable since I will no longer be able to see you off anymore like this."
"…… Geez.
Even you say that.
This is just like before Nii-san came.
I only came back on the weekends back then."
"That's true, but now that Makihisa-sama is dead, there's no reason for you to come back here, Akiha-sama.
You will only come back during long vacations, right?"

entries.japanese:
「―――――ん。
たぶん、そうなるかな」
　うなずいて、琥珀には隠し事はできないなあと実感した。
　私が遠野の屋敷に帰ってきていた理由は、一重に父がうるさかったからだ。
　その父も亡くなり、父の後継者としての責務も卒業するまで代理を立てられた今、私が好き好んでこの屋敷に帰ってくる理由はない。
　なにしろ卒業してしまえば、あとはずっとこの屋敷で過ごすのだ。
　最後の自由時間である三年間をみすみす放棄するのは馬鹿げている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. That is probably what will happen.”
I nodded, reminded that nothing could be hidden from Kohaku.
The only reason I had returned to the Tohno mansion was that Father insisted upon it.
Now Father was dead, and with a deputy appointed to carry the duties of his successor until I graduated, I had no reason to return here by choice.
After graduation I would spend the rest of my life in this mansion.
It would be foolish to surrender the final three years of freedom left to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Yes, I would think so."
I nod and feel that I can not hide anything from Kohaku.
The only reason I came back to the mansion was because my father wanted me to.
Now that Father is dead and I do not have responsibility as the successor until I graduate, there is no reason for me to come back to this mansion.
Because when I graduate, I will live in this mansion for the rest of my life.
It's stupid to let go the last free time of my life.

entries.japanese:
「けど屋敷に新しいし使用人は雇わないわよ。
大変だろうけど二人で頑張ってね、琥珀」
「はい。
秋葉さまも月に一度はお帰りになってくださいましね」
「―――オッケー、善処する」
　と、時間になった。
　車の運転手がコンコン、とノックで時間を知らせてくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I won’t hire any new servants, though. It will be hard work, but the two of you will manage, won’t you, Kohaku?”
“Yes. But Miss Akiha should come home at least once a month.”
“All right—I’ll do my best.”
It was time.
The driver knocked to let us know it was time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But I won't hire anyone else.
Please keep up your good work, Kohaku."
"Yes, please come back here at least once a month, Akiha-sama."
"----Okay, I'll try."
It's time.
My driver knocks on the door to tell me it is time to leave.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉さま？
　本当にいいんですか？」
「いいって、なにが。
あなたまで翡翠と同じコトを言うつもりじゃないでしょうね、琥珀」
「―――いえ、それならいいんです。
それでは行ってらっしゃいませ、秋葉お嬢さま」
　ぺこり、とお辞儀をする琥珀。
　彼女を門の前に残して、車は坂道を下り始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha? Are you certain?”
“Certain of what? You aren’t about to repeat what Hisui said, are you, Kohaku?”
“No, if that is your answer, then all is well. Have a safe journey, Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku gave a small bow.
Leaving her at the gate, the car began its descent down the hill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha-sama?
Is it really alright?"
"What are you talking about?
Are you going to say what Hisui has said to me too, Kohaku?"
"---No, it's alright then.
Take care, Akiha-sama."
Kohaku bows.
Leaving her in front of the gate, the car starts to drive down the hill.

entries.japanese:
――――流れていく風景を眺める。
　秋葉さまは忘れてしまわれるのですか？
　そう翡翠が責めたてた時、私は何も言わなかった。
　だってそんなのは個人の自由だ。
　翡翠が兄さんの死を受け入れようが信じまいが私には関係がない。
　翡翠は兄さんが生きている、なんてそれこそフルカウントでの満塁逆転ホームランを望んでいる。
　……それを無意味だと思って、私は自分自身に対して笑ってしまった。
　だって、その望みは私自身の望みでもあったからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I watched the scenery flow past the window.
Are you going to forget him, Miss Akiha?
When Hisui had accused me, I said nothing.
It was a personal choice.
Whether Hisui accepted Brother’s death or refused to believe it was no concern of mine.
She was hoping he was alive—a bases-loaded home run on a full count, the most impossible reversal imaginable.
I laughed at myself for finding that hope meaningless.
Because it was my hope as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I look at the flowing scenery.
Are you going to forget everything, Akiha-sama?
I did not say anything when Hisui asked me that question.
Because it's each person's choice.
It doesn't matter to me if Hisui does or does not believe in Nii-san's death.
Hisui wishes that Nii-san is alive… it's like wishing for a full count, game winning grand slam.
…… Seeing that my thoughts are meaningless, I laugh at myself.
Because, that is also my wish.

entries.japanese:
―――志貴さまを忘れてしまわれるですか。
　そんなコト、ありえないと言い返せば良かったのだろうか。
　兄さんが生きている筈はない。
　だって兄さんが命を投げ出す事が、私がこうして戻れる唯一つの方法だったからだ。
　それを誰よりも解っているクセに―――私は、翡翠たちと同じように信じてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Are you going to forget Master Shiki?
Should I have told her such a thing was impossible?
Brother couldn’t be alive.
Brother sacrificing his life had been the only way for me to return to myself.
I understood that better than anyone—yet just like Hisui and Kohaku, I still believed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Are you going to forget about Shiki-sama?
Should I have answered that it will never happen?
I know it is impossible for Nii-san to be alive.
Because the only way for me to turn back is for Nii-san to give back his life.
I know that fact more than anybody----but still, I am believing in him just like Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「……だって、まだ残ってる」
　ぼんやりと空を見上げる。
　……幼い頃、兄さんに命を分けた時からあった胸の鼓動。
　自分以外の、もう一人誰かの心臓が胸にあったような重さ。
　とくん、とくんと鼓動していた感覚が、いまだ胸に残っている。
　……それは、もう本当に微かで希薄なモノになってしまったけど、まだ残っている。
　鼓動もしなくなってしまって、ただの石の欠片のようになってしまったけど、まだ残っている事だけは確かだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because it’s still there.”
I stared vaguely at the sky.
Ever since I had shared my life with Brother as a child, I had felt another pulse within my chest.
It was like the weight of someone else’s heart resting beside my own.
I could still feel the steady throb it had made.
It had faded to something truly faint and insubstantial, but it remained.
It no longer beat and seemed little more than a chip of stone, but I knew for certain it was still there.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Because it's still there."
I look up at the sky.
…… The heartbeat that was there since I gave Nii-san half of my life.
The load that felt like I had another heart in me.
The beating is still there.
…… It is really weak and faint, but it is still there.
It does not beat and it feels like a rock, but I am certain it is still there.

entries.japanese:
だから自分自身で否定しながらも、翡翠よりも琥珀よりも、世界中の誰よりも兄さんが生きていているんだって信じてる。
　あの人はいつかちゃんと帰ってくる。
　なら問題なんてないんだから、私は元の生活に戻らないといけない――――
entries.maoEnglish:
So even as I denied it, I believed more fiercely than Hisui, more fiercely than Kohaku—more fiercely than anyone in the world—that Brother was alive.
He would come home one day.
And since there was nothing to worry about, I had to return to my former life—
entries.mirrorMoon:
So while I am disagreeing, I believe more than Kohaku or Hisui or anyone else in the world that Nii-san is still alive.
He is going to come back one day.
I should go back to my normal life since there are no problems-----

entries.japanese:
――――屋敷に帰ってきた。
　こうして帰ってくる事も、あと数回ほどでなくなってしまうだろう。
「……思ったより早く着いちゃったな」
　ぼんやりと呟いて、少しだけ感傷に浸る事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I returned to the mansion.
There would only be a few more times when I came home like this.
“We arrived sooner than I expected.”
I murmured absently and allowed myself a moment of nostalgia.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----I come back to the mansion.
I believe there will only be a few more times that I will be coming home like this.
"…… I got here earlier than I thought."
I think aloud and allow myself some sentimentality.

entries.japanese:
森にやってきた。
　あの夜以来、一度も足を踏み入れなかった場所。
　……ここには思い出がありすぎる。
　子供の頃、兄さんと遊びまわった庭。
　いつか、屋敷を抜け出して二人きりで星を見に行った夜。
　帰ってきた兄さんと話をした木々の囲み。
―――そうして、反転してしまった私が目覚めた森。
entries.maoEnglish:
I came to the forest.
I hadn’t set foot here once since that night.
There were too many memories here.
The garden where Brother and I had raced about as children.
The night we slipped out of the mansion together to see the stars.
The ring of trees where I spoke with him after he came home.
―――And the forest where I awoke after my Inversion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I am in the forest.
I have not set foot in this place since that night.
…… There are too many memories here.
The garden me and Nii-san played around as children.
The night when we snuck out of the mansion to watch the stars.
The enclosure of the trees when I talked with Nii-san when he came back.
---And the forest where I woke up in after that incident.

entries.japanese:
「……ほんと、バカみたい。
あれだけ私を殺してくれって言ったのに、結局――――」
　兄さんは自分を犠牲にする方法を選んだ。
　あの人ならそうしてしまうって解っていた。
　だからあれだけ強く約束したのに、兄さんは私の言うコトなんて何一つ聞いてくれなかったのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What an idiot. I begged him over and over to kill me, and in the end—”
Brother had chosen to sacrifice himself.
I had known he would.
That was why I had forced him to promise so solemnly, yet he hadn’t listened to a single word I said.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… He really is an idiot.
I told him so much to kill me, and still----"
Nii-san chose to sacrifice himself.
I knew he would have chosen to do that.
That is why I made him promise, but Nii-san did not listen to a word of what I said.

entries.japanese:
「そーそー、そういえば子供の頃からそうだったっけ。
兄さんは結局、自分が正しいって思ったコトしかやらない人だった。
……だっていうのにいつも、他人のために自分を犠牲にしてたのよね」
――――そう。
　私や翡翠がお父様に叱られる時も、兄さんは庇ってくれた。
　私がシキに殺されようとした時も、身を呈して庇ってくれた。
　そうして、私が戻れなくなってしまった時も。
　頼みもしないのに、勝手に――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, that’s right—he was always like that, even as a child. In the end, Brother only ever did what he believed was right. And somehow that always meant sacrificing himself for someone else.”
――――Yes.
Whenever Father scolded Hisui or me, Brother protected us.
When SHIKI tried to kill me, Brother shielded me with his own body.
And when I could no longer return to myself.
He took it upon himself again without even being asked—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, he was like that since he was a kid.
Nii-san only did what he believed was right.
…… He always sacrificed himself for others."
-----Yes.
Whenever Hisui or I were scolded by Father, Nii-san took our blame.
When I was about to be killed by SHIKI, he saved me.
And when I could not turn back.
I didn't even ask him to, but----

entries.japanese:
「………………っ」
　漏れそうな嗚咽を押し留めた。
　私は悲しんでなんかない。
　むしろ怒ってるんだ。
　今度という今度は頭にきた。
　あの人は自分の事ばかりで、残された私の事なんてこれっぽっちも考えてくれなかったんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh.”
I swallowed the sob that tried to escape.
I wasn’t sad.
I was angry.
This time he had truly gone too far.
That man had thought only of himself and spared no thought at all for the person he left behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………!!"
I stop the tears that were about to come out.
I am not sad.
Rather, I am mad.
I am really mad this time.
He only thinks about himself and does not take into account how I feel.

entries.japanese:
「……本当に。
ぜったいに許さないんだから」
　けど、その相手が目の前にいない場合。
　この諸々の感情は、一体どこに放せばいいんだろうか。
　兄さんはいない。
　帰ってくる予感もしない。
　胸に残る温かさは消えて、今では死んでしまったような、ただの重さが残るだけで――――
「―――――確かなものが、それだけ、なんて」
　そう思うと不安になる。
　どんなに強がっても本当はもうダメなんだって、負けそうになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I mean it. I will never forgive you.”
But the person those feelings were meant for wasn’t there.
Where was I supposed to release all this emotion?
Brother was gone.
There was no sign he would return.
The warmth in my chest had vanished, leaving only a dead, inert weight—
“And that’s the only certainty I have…”
The thought made me afraid.
No matter how hard I tried to stay strong, I felt myself giving in to the fear that everything was already lost.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I really won't forgive him this time."
But when the person to say that to is not here…
To where should I release my emotions?
Nii-san is not here.
There is no feeling that he is going to come back.
The warmth in my heart is gone, and only the weight of what seems to be dead remains---
"-----That's the only certain thing in me."
I feel uneasy when I think about it.
I feel like giving up thinking that it might be useless no matter how much I try.

entries.japanese:
―――兄さんが何処かで生きてるって信じてる。
　胸に残る兄さんの重さはとても希薄になってしまったけど、確かに残っている。
　だから生きているんだって、信じたい。
　信じたい、けど―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――I believe Brother is alive somewhere.
The weight of him in my chest had faded almost to nothing, but it remained.
I wanted to believe that meant he was alive.
I wanted to believe, but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I believe that Nii-san is alive somewhere.
The load inside me is really faint now, but it is still there.
So I want to believe he is alive.
I want to believe, but---

entries.japanese:
「―――でも兄さん。
こんなに静かだと、いつか、本当に忘れてしまうじゃないかって、私――――」
　……兄さんを待ってる。
　けど、信じ続けるコトが難しい。
　胸にいまだ残っている残滓。
　それは兄さんが生きているんだって信じられると同時に、もう生きていないんだっていう証拠になってしまいそうで、恐い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But Brother… when everything is this quiet, I’m afraid that one day I truly will forget you—”
I was waiting for him.
But continuing to believe was difficult.
A remnant of him still lingered in my chest.
It let me believe Brother was alive, yet I was terrified that it might instead become proof that he was dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But Nii-san, if it's this quiet, I feel like I might forget someday, and I---"
…… I am waiting for Nii-san.
But it is hard to keep my belief in him.
The load still in my chest.
While it might be a proof that Nii-san is alive, I am scared that it might be a proof that Nii-san is dead.

entries.japanese:
「……あーあ。
こんな所を人に見られたらいい笑い者じゃない」
　はあ、と息をはいて屋敷に戻る事にする。
――――と。
　こつん、とつま先に何か当たった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. If anyone saw me like this, I’d never hear the end of it.”
I sighed and turned back toward the mansion.
――――Then.
Something struck the toe of my shoe with a small click.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez, I can't let anyone see me like this."
I let out a breath and decide to head back to the mansion.
---And then,
I hit something with my feet.

entries.japanese:
「……………あれ？」
　落ち葉に隠れて見えなかったけど、何か落ちている。
「…………………む」
　キラリ、と夕日に反射する金属片。
　……カマか何かだろう。
　琥珀も清掃道具を放りっぱなしにしておくなんて、危ないったら―――
「――――――――――――」
　いや、違う。
　気づいて、息をする事さえ忘れて、それを拾い上げた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
Something lay there, hidden beneath the leaves.
“Hm.”
A shard of metal flashed in the setting sun.
A sickle, perhaps.
How careless of Kohaku to leave cleaning tools lying about; someone could—
“――――――――――――”
No, that wasn’t it.
The moment I understood, I forgot even to breathe and snatched it up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Huh?"
I could not see it under the leaves, but something is there.
"………………… Hey."
Some metal blade that shines in the setting sun.
…… Is it a hand sickle or something?
It's dangerous for Kohaku to leave tools lying about---
"-----------"
No, it's not.
As I notice, I forget to breathe as I pick it up.

entries.japanese:
そう、ただ一度だけ。
　そのナイフを握り締めた時、化石になっていたモノが生き返った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, just once.
When I closed my hand around the knife, the thing that had become a fossil came alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, only once.
When I grabbed the knife, what was dead inside me came alive.

entries.japanese:
……それは、どんな繋がりだったんだろう。
　このナイフと持ち主の間には、目に見えない特別な繋がりでもあったのか。
　ただ、本当に一瞬だけ。
　胸の奥に、以前と同じ、いやもっと強く、あの人の鼓動が感じられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
What kind of bond was it?
Did some invisible, extraordinary connection join this knife to its owner?
It lasted only an instant.
But deep in my chest, I felt his heartbeat as I had before—no, more strongly than ever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I do not know what kind of connection it was.
Was there a special connection between him and the knife?
But still, for a moment.
I could feel his heartbeat inside me as I used to.
No, stronger than ever before.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――ぁ」
　つう、と頬に熱いものが流れる。
　それが涙だと気づいても、拭う事はしなかった。
―――――――生きてる。
　それだけで、何も考えられない。
　何処にいるかなんて解らない。
　どうしているかなんて教えてくれない。
　けど、解った。
　兄さんは生きてる。
たった一度だけだったけど、私は確かに兄さんの温もりを感じて、抱きしめる事ができた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Something hot traced my cheek.
Even when I realized it was a tear, I made no attempt to wipe it away.
―――――――He’s alive.
That single fact left no room for thought.
I didn’t know where he was.
It told me nothing of what had become of him.
But I knew.
Brother was alive. It had lasted only an instant, but I had felt his warmth unmistakably and held him close.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------Ah."
Something warm flows down my cheeks.
Even after noticing it is my tears, I still do not wipe them away.
---------He's alive.
With just that fact, I cannot think.
I don't know where he is.
He doesn't tell me how he is doing.
But I know.
Nii-san is alive.
It was only once, but I certainly felt Nii-san's warmth and I was able to embrace it.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――はあ」
　大きく息をついて、言葉を飲みこんだ。
　……信じられる。
　もう、今の鼓動だけで十分だった。
　この先何があっても私は信じて、兄さんの帰りを待つ事ができると思えた。
――――それが、すごく嬉しい。
「………はい。
とりあえず預かっておきますからね、兄さん」
　七つ夜と刻まれたナイフを仕舞って、思い出の森に背を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
I breathed deeply and swallowed the words rising within me.
I could believe.
That heartbeat was enough.
Whatever happened from this day forward, I could believe and wait for Brother to return.
――――And that made me happier than I could say.
“Very well. I’ll keep this for you until you come back, Brother.”
I put away the knife engraved with the words Seven Nights and turned my back on the forest of memories.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take a deep breath and swallow my words.
…… I can believe.
That heartbeat is enough.
No matter what happens in the future, I feel like I can believe in Nii-san and wait for his return.
----That makes me real happy.
"…… Yes, I will hold on to it for you, Nii-san."
I put away the knife that said "Nanatsu Yoru", and turn my back to the forest of memories.

entries.japanese:
森は赤一色。
　数え切れないほどの思い出をつめた森に、しばしのさよならを告げる。
　だって、思い出はこれからまだたくさんできるし、私にはやるべき事がある。
　感傷にふけるなんていうのはここまでだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The forest was a world of red.
I bade a brief farewell to the place that held more memories than I could count.
There would be countless new memories from now on, and I had things to do.
My time for brooding over the past was finished.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The forest is tinted red.
I say goodbye to the forest which carries so many memories.
Because I can make new memories, and there are things I must do.
I won't be indulging in sentimentality anymore.

entries.japanese:
――――――さあ。
　私はいつも通りの私のまま日々に戻る。
　そうして、それが何年かかっても。
　きっと帰ってくるって信じて、いつまでもあの人を待ち続けるんだから―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Now, then.
I would return to my ordinary life as the Akiha I had always been.
And however many years it took.
I would believe that he would come home and wait for him for as long as I had to—
entries.mirrorMoon:
-------Now then.
I go back to the normal life I am having as myself.
And, no matter how long it may take,
I am going to believe that he will come back some day, and keep waiting for him until he does-------

entries.japanese:
秋葉・トゥルーエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　通常はトゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングと呼ばれますが、秋葉さんだけはノーマルエンディング、トゥルーエンディングと呼ばれています。
　秋葉さんのルートは他のルートとは違っていて、好感度さえクリアしていればグッド・トゥルー、共に特別な条件を必要としません。
entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Akiha’s True Ending.
Each heroine—with one exception—has two endings.
Ordinarily they are called the True Ending and the Good Ending, but Akiha’s are instead called the Normal Ending and the True Ending.
Akiha’s route differs from the others: once you meet the affection requirement, neither ending has any additional special condition.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Akiha's True Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings.
Usually, they are called "True Ending" and "Good Ending", but Akiha-san's are called "Normal Ending" and "True Ending".
Akiha-san's route is different from everyone else's in that how much Akiha-san likes you does not determine which ending you receive.

entries.japanese:
それでは、ここまでプレイしていただいてありがとうございました。
　また“月姫”のどこかでお会いしましょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for playing this far.
I hope we meet again somewhere in TSUKIHIME.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well then, thank you very much for playing up to this point.
Let's meet again somewhere in Tsukihime.

entries.japanese:
「…………違う」
　そう、それはきっと違う。
　俺が死ねば本当に秋葉が助かるのならいい。
　けどそんな保証はどこにもないし、何より。
―――死が、救いになるなんて事はない。
　俺が死ぬことで秋葉が助かったにしても、その後で秋葉は何を思うだろう。
　悲しんでくれるのならいいが、それを罪として、一生ぬぐえない罪悪感として抱いてしまうのは違う。
　死が尊い、勇気ある決断なんていうのは違う。
　そんなもの―――ただ、現実から逃げるだけの手段にすぎない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No.”
Yes, that couldn’t be right.
If my death would truly save Akiha, then fine.
But there was no guarantee it would—and more than anything…
―――Death can never be salvation.
Even if my death saved Akiha, how would she live with it afterward?
I wouldn’t mind if she mourned me, but it would be wrong for her to take my death as a sin and carry that guilt for the rest of her life.
There was nothing noble or courageous about choosing death.
It was only another way to run from reality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Wrong."
Yes, it's probably wrong.
It's alright if I can really save Akiha by dying.
But there's no proof of that, and besides…
---I don't think death can be a way to save someone.
Even if Akiha is saved by my death, how would she feel afterwards?
It's fine if she only feels sad about it, but it's wrong if she should feel guilty for the rest of her life.
I don't think that choosing death is neither courageous nor honorable.
I think---that's just a way to run away from reality.

entries.japanese:
「あき、は……」
　秋葉はもう、以前の秋葉じゃない。
　彼女は人を殺すだけの生き物になってしまった。
　……けど、それでも生きていてほしいんだ。
　罪も罰も感じられない秋葉の代わりに、俺がそれを償うのなら――――秋葉は、生きていてもいいんだって、信じたい。
「…………いつか」
　いつか、元に戻れる日が来るなんて思えない。
　それでも信じ続ける事が、秋葉を守れなかった自分にできる最後の役割だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…”
Akiha was no longer the girl she had been.
She had become a creature that did nothing but kill.
And still, I wanted her to live.
If I could atone in her place for the guilt and punishment she could no longer feel, then I wanted to believe she had the right to go on living.
“Someday.”
I couldn’t imagine a day when she would return to herself.
But believing in that day was the last thing left to me, after I had failed to protect her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki, ha……"
Akiha isn't like the Akiha before.
She has become a creature that just kills others.
…… But still, I want her to live.
If I bear everything for Akiha, who can't feel crime or punishment----I want to believe that Akiha can live.
"………… One day."
I don't think she'll turn back one day.
But to keep my belief in her is the last role for me, as I could not keep her promise.

entries.japanese:
「…………秋葉。
おまえがずっとこのままでも」
　ひざまずいて、秋葉の赤い髪を手に取る。
「……傍にいれるだけで、きっと」
　それは、何よりも幸福だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Even if you never change back—”
I knelt and gathered a lock of Akiha’s red hair into my hand.
“Just being beside you would be enough.”
I could ask for no greater happiness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Akiha, even if you're like this forever…"
I kneel and scoop up Akiha's red hair.
"…… Just being able to be with you…"
That will be my greatest happiness.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　紅葉が散っていく。
　秋の終わり。
　旧い思い出が張りついたこの庭で、静かに秋葉に口付けをした。
―――何の意味もない儀式。
　その時、おぼろげに未来視した。
　これが遠野志貴として秋葉に触れる、最後の時間なのだという事を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
The crimson leaves drifted down.
Autumn was ending.
In this garden, where old memories clung to everything, I gently kissed Akiha.
―――A ritual without meaning.
In that moment, I dimly saw the future.
This would be the last time I ever touched Akiha as Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
The autumn leaves fall.
Autumn is ending.
In this garden filled with many memories, I quietly kiss Akiha.
---A ritual with no meaning.
I faintly see the future.
This will be my last time touching Akiha as Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
目を開けた。
　まどろんだ意識に果てしのない青が染み入ってくる。
　かすかに暖かい陽射しと、かすかに肌寒い空気。
　草の匂いと木々のざわめきしかない世界。
　この屋敷の森は季節が違っているのか、じき冬だというのに大気は秋の残滓を含んだままだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I opened my eyes.
Endless blue seeped into my drowsing mind.
Sunlight faintly warm, air faintly cold.
A world made only of the smell of grass and the whisper of trees.
Perhaps the forest around this mansion kept a season of its own; winter was almost here, yet the air still carried the remnants of autumn.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I open my eyes.
Endless blue soaks my sleepy mind.
Slightly warm sunlight and a slightly cool breeze.
A world with only the smell of grass and the sound of trees.
It might be that this mansion's forest is in a different season.
It's almost winter, but this place still feels like autumn.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　地面に寝そべったまま青い空を見上げる。
太陽はすでに空の真中に昇っていた。
　……どうも、眠ってしまっていたらしい。
　朝食を終えて散歩がてらに森に入った後、草むらに横になったのがいけなかったのか。
　まあ、かといって別にやる事があったわけじゃない。
　ここで、こうして。
　自分の名前さえ忘れて午睡するのも、そうおかしな事ではないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Still lying on the ground, I gazed up at the blue sky. The sun had already climbed to its zenith.
Apparently, I had fallen asleep.
Perhaps stretching out in the grass after breakfast and wandering into the woods had been my mistake.
Not that I had anything else to do.
Here, like this.
An afternoon nap deep enough to forget even my own name hardly seemed so strange.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
I look up at the blue sky as I lie on the ground.
The sun is already way up in the sky.
…… I guess I fell asleep.
I guess it was my fault for lying down here on the grass coming after breakfast.
Well, I didn't have anything to do anyway.
Doing this here.
Falling asleep deeply, even forgetting my name, can't be that bad.

entries.japanese:
―――――底のない青。
　衛生的すぎるその空が遠いなあ、と。
　子供のころに思うような感傷を抱いて、飽きることなく見つめ続けた。
　夢に見るような、遠すぎる空。
　視界いっぱいに広がる景色は意味もなく綺麗すぎて、ため息をつく事さえ、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Bottomless blue.
The sky seemed so sterile, so far away.
I watched it without tiring, caught in the kind of melancholy one feels as a child.
A sky from a dream, impossibly distant.
The view filled my vision, beautiful for no reason at all—too beautiful even for a sigh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Bottomless blue.
The clean sky is far away.
Thinking like a child, I keep on watching the sky.
A far sky like in a dream.
The view is so beautiful, I even cannot let out a sigh of amazement.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……？
　こちらにいらっしゃいますか、志貴さま」
　中庭のほうから翡翠の声が聞こえてくる。
「…………」
　もうそんな時間なのか。
　自分はまた眠っていたらしい。
　この青空に憑かれて忘我していたのなら、それは眠っていた事となんら変わりはないのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…? Are you out here, Master Shiki?”
Hisui’s voice came from the courtyard.
“…”
Was it that late already?
Apparently I had been asleep again.
If the blue sky had bewitched me out of myself, there was little difference between that and sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……?
Are you over here, Shiki-sama?"
I hear Hisui's voice from the courtyard.
"…………"
It's that time already.
I guess I fell asleep again.
If I forgot time while watching this blue sky, it makes no difference if I was sleeping or not.

entries.japanese:
息を切らした風もなく翡翠はやってきた。
「志貴さま、秋葉さまがお呼びです」
「そっか、いつのまにか眠ってたみたいだ。
悪いね翡翠、ここのところずっと手間をかけさせて」
「いえ、そのような事はないのですが……」
　翡翠は何か言いたそうに目を伏せる。
　……翡翠が何を言いたいのかは解っている。
ただそれは言葉にされても返答できない物だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui arrived without so much as appearing winded.
“Master Shiki, Miss Akiha is asking for you.”
“I see—I must’ve fallen asleep without noticing. Sorry for making so much work for you lately, Hisui.”
“No, it has been no trouble, but…”
Hisui lowered her eyes, plainly wanting to say something.
I knew what it was. But even if she put it into words, I would have no answer for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui arrives, composed.
"Shiki-sama, Akiha-sama is calling you."
"Alright.
I guess I was asleep.
Sorry for being so troublesome, Hisui."
"Not at all, it is nothing of the sort ……"
Hisui looks down as if she wants to say something.
…… I know what Hisui wants to say, but even if she did, I wouldn't be able to give her an answer.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ行ってくる。
一時間経ったら琥珀さんに声をかけておいてくれ」
「あ―――――」
　翡翠に背を向けて、秋葉の居る離れの屋敷に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’d better go. Tell Kohaku when an hour has passed.”
“Ah—”
I turned my back on Hisui and made for the detached house where Akiha lived.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll get going.
Can you tell Kohaku-san in about an hour or so?"
"Ah-----"
I turn my back to Hisui and head to the detached building where Akiha is waiting.

entries.japanese:
和室には一人の少女がいる。
　いや、いる、という表現は正しくはない。
　少女は自分だけでは動いてくれない。
ただ食事を摂る時にだけ生き物として活動して、それ以外は彫像のように止まってしまう人形だった。
　だから、それは居る、というより。
　おそらくは在る、という表現のほうが相応しい、人形そのものだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A girl sat in the Japanese-style room.
No—saying she was ‘there’ wasn’t quite right.
The girl could not move on her own. She stirred as a living creature only when she ate; otherwise she froze like a statue, no more than a doll.
She did not live there.
She merely existed: a doll in the fullest sense of the word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the room lives a girl.
No, the term "lives" is not right.
The girl cannot move of her own will.
She only moves as a living thing when she eats, and she just sits there like a statue when she isn't.
So instead of "live",
"exists" is a more correct term, since she is more like a doll.

entries.japanese:
「ごめんな秋葉。
ちょっと昼寝しててさ、いつもの時間に遅れちまった」
　障子を閉めて部屋に入る。
　秋葉は座ったまま動かない。
「なんだ、髪がグシャグシャじゃないか。
着替えもまだ終わってないみたいだし、琥珀さんは今朝こなかったのか？」
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　ただ焦点のない瞳で、ぼんやりとこちらを眺めている。
　……いや。
　眺めているような、気がするだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, Akiha. I dozed off and missed our usual time.”
I slid the shoji shut and entered.
Akiha remained seated and motionless.
“Your hair is a mess. You haven’t finished dressing either—didn’t Kohaku come this morning?”
Akiha said nothing.
Her unfocused eyes seemed to rest vaguely on me.
No.
I only imagined they did.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm sorry Akiha.
I fell asleep and couldn't make it in time."
I enter the room and close the shouji.
Akiha sits there and does not move.
"Whoa, your hair is messed up.
It looks like you haven't changed yet either.
Didn't Kohaku-san come by this morning?"
Akiha does not say anything.
She looks in my direction with a blank stare.
…… No,
it just seems like she's looking.

entries.japanese:
「しょうがないな。
ほら、髪ぐらい綺麗にしないと」
　秋葉の髪に手をかける。
　抵抗する素振りはない。
　静かに、できるだけ柔らかに、赤い髪を梳る。
　ざあ、と長い髪が流れていく。
　秋葉は何も言わない。
　しばらくそんな時間が続いたあと。
　不意に、秋葉の腕が動いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. At least let me fix your hair.”
I laid a hand on it.
She showed no sign of resistance.
Quietly, as gently as I could, I combed the red strands.
Her long hair flowed down with a soft rush.
Akiha said nothing.
We remained that way for a time—until, without warning…
Akiha’s arm moved.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright, let's at least make your hair look good.
I touch Akiha's hair.
She makes no motion to fight it.
Quietly, as softly as I can, I let my hands go through her hair.
Her long hair flows in my hand.
Akiha does not say anything.
After some time like that,
Akiha suddenly moves her arm.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――？」
　返事はない。
　ただ秋葉の指がこちらの腕を掴んで、口まで持っていく。
　ガツ、という感触のあと。
　秋葉は俺の腕に噛み付いて、無表情のまま、血を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…?”
No answer.
Her fingers closed around my arm and lifted it to her mouth.
There came a hard click.
Then Akiha bit down and drank my blood, her face utterly blank.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha----?"
There's no answer.
She just takes my arm and takes it to her mouth.
After a hard sensation,
Akiha bites on my arm and starts to suck out my blood expressionlessly.

Her white throat gulps down my blood.

entries.japanese:
白い喉が、ごくごくと赤い血を嚥下していく。
　口元からこぼれた血は秋葉の喉を伝って、着物を赤く汚していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her white throat worked, gulping down the red blood.
What escaped her mouth ran along her neck and stained her kimono crimson.
entries.mirrorMoon: The blood which spills out of her mouth drips down her throat and stains her kimono red.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ――――う」
　歯を食いしばって秋葉が満足するまで耐える。
　……秋葉には適量というものがない。
　満腹になれば吸うのを止めるだけで、それがどの程度の量なのかは統計できない。
　だからこうして、秋葉が自分から止めるのを待つ事しか、俺にはできない。
「っ…………ぁ」
　くらりと意識が点滅する。
　それでも自分から腕を引く事はしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gh…!”
I clenched my teeth and endured until Akiha was satisfied.
For her, there was no such thing as the right amount.
She stopped only when she was full, and there was no predicting how much that might be.
All I could do was wait for her to stop of her own accord.
“Ngh—ah…”
My consciousness flickered.
Still, I did not pull my arm away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ghu----u"
I grit my teeth and hold on until Akiha is full.
…… There is no proper quantity for Akiha.
She stops only when she's full, and I can't predict when that is.
So all I can do is wait like this for her to be full.
"………… Ah."
I feel dizzy.
But I don't pull back.

entries.japanese:
……そういえば、この事を最後まで反対していたのは翡翠だったっけ。
　秋葉が人の血しか受け付けなくなってから、俺は自分の血を与える事に決めた。
　それは責任感、なんてものじゃない。
　秋葉が人の血を口にしなければ生きていけないというのなら、その被害者は最低限に抑えたかったし、何より―――俺は、秋葉に俺以外の人間の血なんかを飲んでほしくはなかったのだ。
　秋葉にとって俺の血は相性が良かったのか、それ以来秋葉が独りでに外に出る事はなくなった。
　反面、それは俺の体にしてみれば危険な事だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Come to think of it, Hisui had been the one who opposed this to the very end.
Once Akiha could no longer stomach anything but human blood, I had decided to give her mine.
It wasn’t out of anything so grand as responsibility.
If she needed human blood to live, I wanted to keep the victims to an absolute minimum; more than anything, I didn’t want Akiha drinking anyone’s blood but mine.
Perhaps my blood agreed with her, because after she began drinking it, Akiha never wandered outside on her own again.
For my body, however, the arrangement was dangerous.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Hisui was against this until the very last minute.
I decided to give Akiha my own blood ever since she could only take in human blood.
It wasn't a sense of responsibility.
If Akiha could only survive by taking in blood, I wanted to limit the amount of victims, and most of all---
