明日には新しいものを用意させておきますから」
「………………」
　……まだ理性が麻痺している。
　秋葉は本当に何も聞かず、丁寧に傷の手当てをしてくれた。
　少し、意外だ。
こんな事は琥珀さんや翡翠に任せればいいのに、秋葉は微笑みさえ浮かべて傷の手当てをしてくれた。
　……その、ここ三日の秋葉のイメージとは違う柔らかさは、昔の秋葉を思い起こさせる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, all done. That uniform is ruined. I’ll have a new one prepared by tomorrow.”
“……”
My reason is still numb.
Akiha really does ask nothing.
She could have left this to Kohaku or Hisui. Yet she treats me herself with painstaking care, even smiling as she works.
That gentleness—so unlike the Akiha I have known these last three days—reminds me of the girl she used to be.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"All finished.
This uniform is done for, so we will have to get a new one prepared tomorrow."
"………………"
…… My mind is still numb.
Akiha really hasn't asked me any questions about what happened and simply took care of my injury.
I'm a little surprised.
I thought she would let Kohaku-san or Hisui take care of it, but Akiha did it all with a smile.
…… Her gentleness is completely different from the way she was these past three days and I think back about Akiha from long ago.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　ほら、手当ては終わったんですから、お部屋に帰ってください。
私なんかの相手をするより、眠りたいって言ってたじゃないですか」
　さっきの俺の言葉を根に持っているのか、秋葉は不満そうに言ってくる。
「…………」
　俺は、まだ頭がどうかしたままだけど、それでも秋葉がどれくらい心配してくれたのかは理解できた。
「……うん。
ありがとう、秋葉」
　頭がどうかしていたからだろうか。
いつもより素直に、感情を口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? The treatment is over, so please go back to your room. You said you would rather sleep than waste time with someone like me, didn’t you?”
Apparently still nursing a grudge over what I said earlier, Akiha delivers this with an aggrieved look.
“……”
Even with my mind barely working, I understand how worried she has been.
“Yeah. Thank you, Akiha.”
Maybe I really am out of my mind. The feeling comes out more honestly than it ever would otherwise.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
Hey, it's all finished, so please go back to your room.
Didn't you say you would rather go to sleep than keep me company?"
She may still be resenting my words from earlier because she sounds very dissatisfied.
"……………"
There's still something wrong with my brain, but I do understand how much Akiha worried over me.
"…… Yeah.
Thanks, Akiha."
Is it because I'm still woozy?
I let my true feelings show.

entries.japanese:
「え――――」
　とたん、秋葉は顔を赤くして俺から離れた。
「――――そう？
　べ、別に感謝されるほどの事じゃないと思うけど。
兄さんだって、私が怪我をしたら助けてくれるでしょう？」
「それは、そうだけど。
今は、嬉しかったから」
　訥訥と口にして、自分でもようやく気がついた。
　今はどうしても無感動になってしまっているけど、俺は本当に―――琥珀さんや翡翠でもなく、秋葉に手当てをしてもらって嬉しいみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—”
Akiha’s face flushes, and she immediately draws away from me.
“Is that so? I-it was hardly anything worth thanking me for. You would help me if I were hurt, wouldn’t you?”
“Of course I would. But I’m still glad you did this.”
I say it haltingly, and only then do I understand.
I may be too numb to feel much of anything right now, but I truly am glad that it was Akiha who cared for me—not Kohaku, not Hisui, but Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh--"
Akiha's face turns red and she shrinks away from me.
"----Oh?
I, I don't think it was anything to thank me for.
You would help me if I was hurt, right Nii-san?"
"That may be true, but it makes me happy."
Stuttering, I finally realize it.
I am quite emotionally detached right now, but I honestly am happy that---rather than Kohaku-san or Hisui, Akiha was the one that treated my wounds.

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――罵伽な事を言ってないで、早くお部屋に戻ってくださいっ。
それともまだ、どこか怪我をしてらっしゃるんですかっ」
　言って、秋葉は視線を逸らす。
「――――？
　兄さん、肩に血が」
entries.maoEnglish:
“D-don’t say such idiotic things—go back to your room at once! Unless there is somewhere else you’ve been hurt?”
Akiha averts her eyes as she speaks.
“What? Brother, there’s blood on your shoulder—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"D---don't say such stupid things, please hurry back to your room.
Or are you hurt somewhere else?"
Akiha says so and shifts her gaze.
"----?
Nii-san, your shoulder… there's blood."

entries.japanese:
言って、秋葉は俺の肩に手を置いた。
　ずるり、とシャツがはだける。
　露になった肩と、首すじ。
　そこには弓塚に噛まれた傷跡と、乾いた血の跡が残っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha lays a hand on my shoulder.
My shirt slips aside.
My shoulder and the side of my neck lie bare.
The marks of Yumizuka’s bite remain there, crusted with dried blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha places her hand on my shoulder.
She peels back my shirt.
My exposed shoulder, and neck.
Yumizuka's bite marks and dried blood are still there.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、これ――――――――」
　一瞬。
　空気が、凍った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, this is—”
For one instant.
The air freezes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, this--------"
In that instant,
the air freezes.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　首筋に穿たれた牙の跡。
　それがどのようにつけられた物か説明できず黙り込む。
「―――――――」
　秋葉は息を飲んだまま、ゆっくりと、体をこちらに預けてきた。
「……兄さん……ここ、まだ……血が、出てる」
　秋葉の声は、ひどくたどたどしかった。
　ぐっ、と肩に置かれた秋葉の手に力がこもる。
　倒れてきた体は、俺の体に触れるか触れないかの所で止まったまま。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Two fang marks pierce the side of my neck.
Unable to explain how they came to be there, I say nothing.
“……”
Still holding her breath, Akiha slowly lets her body lean toward mine.
“Brother, this is still bleeding.”
Her voice is painfully unsteady.
The hand on my shoulder tightens.
Her falling body stops a hair’s breadth from touching mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
The fang shaped wounds on my neck.
I don't know how to even begin to explain that and descend into silence.
"-------"
Akiha slowly leans her body towards mine.
"…… Nii-san…… there is still…… blood flowing, here."
Her voice is terribly taut with strain.
The grip of her hand on my shoulder becomes stronger.
Her body stops in a position somewhere between touching mine and not.

entries.japanese:
「……どうしよう……血止めをしないと、いけません、よね――――」
　熱に浮かされたような秋葉の声。
「―――――秋葉？」
　言いようのない違和感に襲われて声をかける。
「ん――――――」
　返事はない。
　ただ入れ替わりに、つぅ、と。
　首筋に温かい感触が伝わった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What should I do—we have to stop the bleeding, don’t we?”
Akiha sounds delirious with fever.
“Akiha?”
A nameless sense that something is wrong seizes me, and I call her name.
“Mm—”
She does not answer.
Instead, something glides along my skin.
Warmth spreads across the side of my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What should I do…… We should, stop the bleeding, right----"
Her voice sounds delirious.
"----Akiha?"
I call her name while assailed by an unspeakable disquiet.
"Nnn------"
There's no reply.
But instead,
I feel a warm sensation along my neck.

entries.japanese:
「なっ………………」
　声が遠くなる。
　秋葉の顔が俺の顔の真横にある。
　……ぬらり、とした感触。
　……ぴちゃり、と鳴る接触。
「あき…………は……？」
　……麻痺したままの理性は、よく現状を把握してくれない。
　ためらいがちに触れられた唇。
　恐れるように血の筋を舐め取っていく赤い舌。
　ふるふると。
震える指で抱き付いてくる秋葉の体温。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh……”
My voice recedes into the distance.
Akiha’s face is beside my own.
Something wet and slick.
A soft, smacking contact.
“Akiha?”
My numb mind cannot quite comprehend what is happening.
Lips touch me with timid care.
A red tongue, almost frightened, laps away the trail of blood.
A shiver runs through her. Akiha’s warmth presses near as trembling fingers cling to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha…………………"
My voice fades away.
Akiha's face is right next to mine.
…… The sensation of rubbing.
…… A contact.
Wetness.
"Aki………… ha…… ?"
…… My numbed sense of reason can't grasp what's going on.
A hesitatingly touching tongue.
The red tongue that fearfully touches my neck.
Shaking.
The shaking fingers that embrace me, the warmth of Akiha's body.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ――――――――、っ」
　……首筋から流れている俺の血を、秋葉が舐めとっている。
　別に、それはどうという事はない。
　それはただそれだけの、子供がするような止血行為にすぎない。
　なのに、それがとても甘美なものに思えて、何も言えなかった。
　秋葉もそれは同じなのか、ただ―――意味もなく、俺の首筋に穿たれた牙跡に歯を合わせている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—!”
Akiha is licking the blood from my neck.
It should mean nothing.
Nothing more than the childish way of stopping blood that it resembles.
Yet the sensation is so sweet that I cannot speak.
Perhaps Akiha feels the same; without any reason at all, she fits her teeth against the fang marks in my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aaaa--------,"
…… Akiha is licking the blood dribbling down my neck.
But, it really isn't anything to be alarmed over.
It's just like what you would do as a kid to stop the bleeding.
But it feels so sweet, I can't say anything.
Akiha must think the same way, as she just---for no reason, brushes her teeth against my wound.

entries.japanese:
――――不意に。
　コトン、とロビーのほうで物音がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Then, without warning.
Something clatters in the lobby.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----All of a sudden.
A sound comes from the lobby.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――っ！」
　秋葉が離れる。
「ご――――ごめんなさい、兄さん――――！」
　顔を真っ赤にして、秋葉は走り去ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
Akiha tears herself away.
“I-I’m sorry, Brother!”
Her face blazing red, Akiha runs away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------!"
Akiha pulls back.
"I----I'm so sorry, Nii-san----!"
Her face a pure red, Akiha runs away.

entries.japanese:
「な――――――――」
　居間に一人残されて、首筋の傷に手をあてる。
　傷跡には、まだ微かに秋葉の体温が残っていた。
「……逃げる事なんて、ないのに」
　ぼんやりとした頭で呟いて、いや、と首をふった。
　確かに傷口を舐める、なんていうのは子供の頃はよくやった。
秋葉や翡翠が怪我をした時はためらう事なく傷口を舐めたものだ。
　……けど、それは子供の頃だけの純粋さ故の行為なんだろう。
　こうしてお互い異性として成長してしまった今では、そんな手当てなんか出来るはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What—”
Left alone in the sitting room, I touch the wound on my neck.
A faint trace of Akiha’s warmth still lingers there.
“You didn’t have to run away.”
I murmur through the fog in my head, then shake my head.
Licking a wound was something we often did as children. Whenever Akiha or Hisui got hurt, I would do it without a second thought.
But that was only possible through a child’s innocence.
Now that we have grown into a man and a woman, there is no way we could tend each other like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
Left by myself in the sitting room, I reach my hand up to my neck.
Her warmth is still lingering there faintly.
"…… She didn't have to run away."
I murmur to myself and shake my head.
Licking the wound like that, I did a lot of that as a child.
I did that to Akiha and Kohaku-san when they got hurt.
…… But, that's just an act from child-like purity, only done as a child.
Both of us grown up like this now and being the opposite gender.
We can't really use that method anymore.

entries.japanese:
「……どうしたんだろう、秋葉のやつ。
……なんかおかしかったけど」
　……まあ、おかしいのは今の自分も同じか。
　まるで夢の中にいるように、記憶が一定してくれない。
　たった今秋葉と交わした秘め事めいた事さえも、明日の朝になれば夢だったと思えてしまうぐらいに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What got into Akiha? She was acting strange.”
Though I am hardly one to talk.
My memories refuse to hold still, as if I were dreaming.
Even the secret, intimate thing that just passed between us feels as though by morning I might dismiss it as a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What was she doing?
…… She was acting pretty strange."
…… Well, I guess I'm also strange right now.
As if in a dream, I can't recall what exactly happened.
Even what Akiha and I just did, I feel like it'll all be a dream tomorrow morning.

entries.japanese:
……そうして、部屋に戻ってきた。
　ベッドまで歩いて、そのまま倒れこむ。
「――――――ん」
　眠気が意識を刈り取っていく。
　疲れていたのは理性ではなく肉体のほうだったらしい。
　疲労を癒すために肉体は急速に停止する。
　その前に。
はあ、と息を吐いてもう一度首筋に指を這わせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
At last I return to my room.
I make it as far as the bed and collapse.
“Mm……”
Sleep shears away my consciousness.
It seems my body was exhausted, not my reason.
To repair itself, it begins shutting down at once.
Before it can. I breathe out and trail my fingers once more along my neck.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… And I reach my room.
I lurch to my bed and collapse.
"------Nnn."
Tiredness closes in around my brain.
My exhaustion is more in my body than my mind.
My body must be trying to halt everything in order to quickly heal its exertions.
Before that, I take a deep breath and trace my fingers along my neck once more.

entries.japanese:
「……………あ」
　少しだけ驚いた。
　穿たれた二つの傷跡。
そこからの出血は、秋葉の唇で止まってくれていた――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
I am a little surprised.
Akiha’s lips have stopped the bleeding from the two punctures.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Ah."
I'm a little surprised.
The two fang marks.
The blood really was stopped by Akiha's lips----

entries.japanese:
長い眠りから目が覚めた。
　窓から入ってくる陽射しは、すでに朝というより昼の陽射しだった。
　昨夜、夜遅くに帰ってきたせいだろう。
　昼近くになって、ようやく俺は目が覚めたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
I wake from a long sleep.
The sunlight coming through the window belongs more to noon than morning.
I must have slept late because I came home so late last night.
It seems I have only just awakened, with midday almost here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wake from a long sleep.
The sunshine from the window looks closer to mid-day than morning.
It must be because of how late I got back last night.
It seems I've overslept.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　ベッドから体を起こして、自分の手を見る。
――――まだ、弓塚を刺した時の感触が残っている。
　二日前の夜。
　弓塚に出会って、その晩にひどい悪夢を見た。
「……いっそ昨日のことも……夢なら、よかったのに」
　そんな都合のいい話はない。
　弓塚が吸血鬼だった理由もわからなければ、アイツを助けてやる事もできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I sit up in bed and stare at my hand.
――――I can still feel the moment I stabbed Yumizuka.
Two nights ago.
I met Yumizuka, and that night I had a terrible nightmare.
“I only wish yesterday had been a dream.”
But nothing could be that convenient.
I never learned why Yumizuka had become a vampire, and I could do nothing to save her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
Dragging myself up from bed, I look down at my hand.
----The sensation of how I stabbed Yumizuka remains.
Two nights ago.
When I met Yumizuka and saw that hideous dream.
"…… If only yesterday…… was just a dream."
But wishing it won't make it so.
I've no clue why or how Yumizuka became a vampire, and I couldn't do anything to help her.

entries.japanese:
―――いや。
　ああなってしまった弓塚を助ける方法なんてなかったのかもしれない。
　彼女は、とっくに生きてはいなかった。
　俺がした事は、人並みに動き回れる死体を、ちゃんとした死体に戻しただけの事だって、それぐらいのことは考えられる。
　だが、それでも―――
「失礼します、志貴さま」
　もう馴染みになった声がして、翡翠が部屋に入ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――No.
Maybe there had been no saving Yumizuka after what she became.
She had stopped being alive long before.
I can understand that much: all I did was turn a corpse that could still walk around like anyone else into a corpse that behaved properly.
And yet—
“Excuse me, Master Shiki.”
Hisui enters the room, her voice already familiar to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---No.
Once Yumizuka had become like that, there was probably no way for anyone to help her.
She was already dead.
All I did was return that corpse somehow moving about as if it were a living thing back to being a dead body.
That's the only way I can think of it.
But, still---
"Please excuse me, Shiki-sama."
With that voice I have become accustomed to, Hisui enters the room.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます志貴さま。
今日は体調のほうはよろしいですか？」
「ん……ああ、よく眠ったおかげかな、体の調子は悪くないよ」
「そうですか。
それを聞いて安心しました」
　……眉一つ動かさないで言われても、翡翠が安心しているようにはとても見えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Master Shiki. How are you feeling today?”
“Mm—I think all that sleep helped, because I don’t feel bad.”
“I see. I am relieved to hear it.”
With her expression perfectly still, she hardly looks relieved.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-sama.
How are you feeling today?"
"Hm…… ah, I slept well, so I don't feel bad at all."
"Is that so?
Hearing that makes me feel very relieved."
…… Even though she says that, I don't see her even relax her shoulders, or give any other indication of it.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　けど、俺は安心できた。
　昨夜の出来事から、たった一晩しか明けていない。
俺は、もうあの異常な世界から抜け出せないだろうって、心のどこかで諦めていた。
「……ありがとう翡翠。
きみの事だから、朝から何度も様子を見に来てくれたんだろ？
　気を遣ってくれて、感謝してる」
「――――いえ。
志貴さまのお世話をさせていただくのがわたしの仕事ですから」
　かすかに嬉しがっているような翡翠の表情。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
But I found relief.
Only one night had passed since it happened. Somewhere inside, I had resigned myself to never escaping that mad world.
“Thank you, Hisui. Knowing you, you probably checked on me again and again this morning, didn’t you? I appreciate your concern.”
“No. It is my duty to attend to you, Master Shiki.”
Something in Hisui’s expression looks almost pleased.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
But, I feel relieved as well.
Because of what happened last night, the long night is over.
Because I don't have to enter that unnatural world any longer, my heart can relax.
"…… Thanks, Hisui.
You've always come to check up on me from early in the morning, right?
Your concern means a lot to me."
"----Not at all.
It is my duty to be concerned with your welfare."
There is a hint of happiness in Hisui's expression.

entries.japanese:
……それに、幾分救われた気がした。
　こうしてベッドに眠っていて、いつも通り翡翠が起こしに来てくれる。
　そんな些細な事だけで、自分はちゃんとした日常に戻ってこれたって実感できたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
That tiny change in her face saves me a little.
I slept here in my own bed, and Hisui came to wake me as she always does.
Something so small is enough to make me feel that I have truly returned to an ordinary life.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Moreover, I feel like I've been somewhat rescued.
While I've been sleeping in bed like this, Hisui came as always to wake me up.
With just that trivial thing, I honestly feel like I have returned to my normal life.

entries.japanese:
「あの……志貴さま、申し上げにくいことなのですが、よろしいでしょうか？」
「……？
　なに、言いにくい事って。
昼過ぎまで寝てた事には弁解のしようがないから、平謝りするしかないけど」
「いえ、そのようなことではないのですが、多少は志貴さまの睡眠時間が関係あることかもしれません」
　翡翠は言いにくそうにもじもじと指を絡ませている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, there is something difficult for me to say; may I?”
“Hm? What could be difficult? If this is about sleeping past noon, I have no excuse and can only apologize.”
“No, not that, although it may have something to do with how long Master Shiki slept.”
Hisui fidgets, uneasily lacing and unlacing her fingers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Shiki-sama, this is somewhat difficult for me to say, but… can I?"
"……?
Difficult to say?
If it's about me sleeping in till noon, I really can't do anything but apologize."
"No, that is not what I meant, but it is perhaps related to when you went to sleep."
Hisui fidgets with her fingers as she struggles to come up with the right words.

entries.japanese:
「……その、わたしがいたらないばかりに、昨夜のことを秋葉さまに知られてしまいました」
「え……昨夜のことって……なに？」
「ですから、志貴さまがお出かけになられた事です」
「――――」
　思わず翡翠から目を逸らす。
　自分ではうまくやり過ごしたつもりだったけど、やっぱり翡翠にはバレてしまっていたか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Through my own failings, Miss Akiha learned about last night.”
“Last night—what do you mean?”
“That you went out, Master Shiki.”
“……”
I look away without meaning to.
I thought I had covered my tracks, but Hisui saw through me after all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, I did not say anything, but Akiha-sama found out about last night."
"Eh…… about last night…… what?"
"I mean when you left late last night, Shiki-sama."
"----"
I unconsciously turn my eyes away from her.
I thought I'd managed to slip away undetected, but I should have known Hisui would still find out.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまは夜のうちに戻られましたから秋葉さまもそう気に留めてらっしゃらないようですが、のちほど何か聞かれることは確実です。
　居間のほうにいかれるのでしたら、どうか気を引き締めてください」
「………そっか。
分かった、覚悟しとく」
　……けど、昨夜の事だったら秋葉はとっくに知っている筈だ。
　……あの後、放心状態で帰ってきた俺の手当てをしてくれたのは他ならぬ秋葉なんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because Master Shiki returned before the night was over, Miss Akiha does not seem overly concerned, though she is certain to question you later.
If you intend to go to the sitting room, please prepare yourself.”
“I see. I’ll brace myself.”
But Akiha already knows what happened last night.
After I came home in a stupor, she was the one who treated my wound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, your return late at night has gained the attention of Akiha-sama, so I believe you will be asked to explain yourself sooner or later.
She is in the sitting room and may be angry, so please be prepared."
"……… I see.
I got it; I'll be prepared."
…… But, if it's about last night, then Akiha definitely knows about it already.
…… And after that, it was Akiha who took care of me when I was in a complete stupor.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま？
　その件ですが、今後もこのような事があるのですか？
　わたしは志貴さまをお止めすることはできませんが、昨夜のような事が続くようでしたら秋葉さまにお報せしなくてはなりません」
「――――いや、昨日みたいな事はもうないよ。
全部、昨日で終わったんだ。
……もう、電話がかかってくることなんて、ない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? On that subject, should I expect this to happen again? I cannot prevent Master Shiki from leaving, but if nights like the last one continue, I will be obliged to inform Miss Akiha.”
“—No, nothing like yesterday will happen again. It all ended yesterday. There won’t be any more phone calls.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About that, will it be occurring again?
I cannot stop you, but if you continue doing such things, I must tell Akiha-sama."
"----No, nothing like last night will happen again.
Everything…… has ended last night…… There won't be any phone calls anymore."

entries.japanese:
―――そう。
本当に、決着がついた。
　こうして言葉にして、ようやく終わった。
　弓塚さつきはもういない。
　街を騒がしていた吸血鬼は消えて、俺は、自分のことを好きだったと言ってくれたクラスメイトを、自らの手で、永久に喪った。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes. It really is over.
Only after saying it aloud does the ending become real.
Satsuki Yumizuka is gone.
The vampire that terrorized the city has disappeared, and with my own hands I have lost forever the classmate who told me she loved me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Yes.
It really has ended.
With these words, it truly is over.
Yumizuka Satsuki is no more.
The vampire skulking the streets has vanished.
I, with my own hands, sent away a classmate who said she liked me, for all eternity.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　翡翠は痛ましそうな顔で俺を見る。
　……まったく、翡翠にあんな顔をさせるぐらい、今の自分はひどい顔をしてるってコトか。
「―――さ、時間も時間だしいいかげん起きないとな。
翡翠、秋葉は今日は屋敷にいるの？
　なにかと忙しいヤツだから、やっぱり休日も習い事をしてるとか」
「はい、秋葉さまは休日も予定が入っておりますが、今日は屋敷に残っておられます」
「………？」
　予定はあるけど、屋敷には残ってる……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Hisui watches me with pain in her eyes.
Do I really look so awful that even Hisui has to make that face?
“Well, it’s getting late, so I should get up. Hisui, is Akiha home today? She’s always busy—does she have lessons even on holidays?”
“Miss Akiha has an engagement today despite the holiday, but she will remain at the mansion.”
“……?”
She has plans, but she is staying here?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
Hisui looks at me with a painful expression on her face.
…… Geez, if Hisui is making that sort of face, then I must look terrible right now.
"---Well, I should get up sooner or later.
Hisui, is Akiha still here?
She's an awfully busy person, so does she have a routine on her day off?"
"Yes, she does have plans during her day off, but today she is still in the mansion."
"………?"
She has plans, but she's still here……?

entries.japanese:
「よくわからないけど……ま、とにかく着替えたら居間に行くから、先に行っていてくれ」
「はい。
それでは失礼します」
　翡翠はいつも通り、足音一つたてず立ち去っていく。
―――と、大事なコトを忘れていた。
「翡翠」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t quite follow, but I’ll come to the sitting room when I’m dressed, so go on ahead.”
“Very well. If you will excuse me.”
As always, Hisui departs without making a sound.
―――Wait—I nearly forgot something important.
“Hisui.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't quite get it, but…… well, I'll go and get changed, so please head to the sitting room before me."
"Yes.
Well then, please excuse me."
As usual, Hisui walks away without a sound.
---But, I forgot something really important.
"Hisui."

entries.japanese:
「はい？
　なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「うん、言い忘れてた。
起こしにきてくれてありがとう。
遅れたけど、おはよう翡翠」
「―――はい。
どうかよい一日を、志貴さま」
　さて。
　こっちも手早く着替えて居間に向かうことにしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes? What is it, Master Shiki?”
“I forgot to say it. Thanks for coming to wake me. And though it’s late—good morning, Hisui.”
“Yes. I hope you have a pleasant day, Master Shiki.”
Well, then.
I had better dress quickly and head for the sitting room myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes?
What is it, Shiki-sama?"
"Yeah, I forgot to say something.
Thanks for coming to wake me up.
It's a little late, but good morning, Hisui."
"---Yes.
Please have a nice day, Shiki-sama."
Well then.
I should hurry up and change, and head to the sitting room.

entries.japanese:
単純に考えて、四人分のご馳走を作る琥珀さんが一番タイヘンだろう。
　こと料理に関して何を手伝えるか不安だが、とりあえず琥珀さんのところに行こう。
　すでに台所は戦場と化していた。
　台という台には山のように積まれた食材が散乱していて、台所に足を踏み入れた瞬間に逃げたくなるぐらい仰々しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku is making a feast for four, so by any reasonable measure she has the hardest job.
I’m not sure what use I’ll be in a kitchen, but I’ll go see her anyway.
The kitchen has already become a battlefield.
Every available surface is buried beneath mountains of ingredients, an imposing spectacle that makes me want to retreat the moment I step inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
To be honest, Kohaku-san has the hardest job because she has to prepare the feast for the four of us.
I don't think I can be that much help in cooking, but I'll go see Kohaku-san.
The kitchen has already become a battlefield.
On each counter there is a mountain of ingredients, and I get the urge to turn around and go back as soon as I enter.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、何かご用ですか？」
　ひょこっ、と琥珀さんが顔を出してくる。
「……いや、何か手伝えないかなってやってきたんだけど――――」
　これは、俺なんかがやってきてはいけないセカイのような気がする。
「あ、それは助かっちゃいます。
ほんとを言うとですね、わたしのほうから志貴さんにお願いに行こうかなって思ってたんですよ」
「そ、そうなの……？
　けど俺、料理をしたことがないから琥珀さんの力になれるかちょっと不安なんだけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did you need something, Shiki?”
Kohaku pops her head out.
“I came to see if I could help, but—”
I have the distinct feeling this is a world into which amateurs like me should never trespass.
“Oh, that would be wonderful. To tell you the truth, I was thinking of coming to ask for your help, Shiki.”
“Y-you were…? I’ve never cooked anything in my life, so I’m not sure I’ll be much use to you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, is there anything I can do for you?"
Kohaku-san peeks her head through.
"…… No, I was thinking maybe I could help or something----"
But, it seems like I've entered a world where I shouldn't be.
"Ah, that really helps.
To tell the truth, I was thinking of going to ask you for some help."
"R, really……?
But, I don't really have any cooking skills, so I'm unsure if I can even help, Kohaku-san."

entries.japanese:
「いえいえ、ちゃんと誰でもできるような作業だってあるんです。
ささ、そういうワケですからお手伝いをしてください」
　ぐ、と俺の手を引っ張っていく琥珀さん。
「…………」
　なんか納得がいかないまま、琥珀さんの手伝いをする事になった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t worry; there are plenty of jobs anyone can do. Come along, then—time to put you to work.”
Kohaku takes me firmly by the hand and pulls me in.
“……”
Somehow, before I can quite agree to it, I find myself drafted into her service.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Not at all, it is something anyone can do.
Come on, please lend me a hand."
Kohaku-san takes my hand and pulls me with her.
"…………"
Not really understanding what's going on, I end up helping Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
……冷静になってみると、この屋敷の大きさからいって、この台所は小さかった。
　まだ屋敷に沢山の人がいた頃は厨房を使っていたらしいんだけど、今は秋葉と翡翠、琥珀さんに俺という四人だけだから、新しく台所を改装したという事だ。
「はい、それではきちんと手を洗って、エプロンを着用してください」
　誰の趣味なのか、朴念仁と書かれたエプロンを渡される。
entries.maoEnglish:
Once I stop to think about it, this kitchen is remarkably small for a mansion of this size.
Apparently they used the main kitchens back when the house was fully staffed, but now that only Akiha, Hisui, Kohaku, and I live here, this smaller room has been remodeled for daily use.
“First, wash your hands properly and put on an apron.”
She hands me an apron emblazoned with BLOCKHEAD and leaves me wondering whose taste it reflects.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… After calming down a bit, I realize that the kitchen is actually pretty small for a mansion so large.
They probably had a much bigger galley when there were many people living in the mansion, but with just Akiha, Hisui, Kohaku-san and I, they had this smaller kitchen prepared.
"Here, please wash your hands and use this apron."
I don't know whose tastes this is a reflection of, but she hands me an apron that says "Quiet Unsociable Person" on it.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃあ志貴さんには単純作業から入っていただきますね。
それ、全部終わったら次は志貴さんならではの作業が待っていますから」
　琥珀さんは上機嫌だ。
――――とりあえず、ざるいっぱいに入ったエビの皮むきを隊長から命じられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We’ll start you on something simple, Shiki. Once you finish all of that, I have a special job that only you can do.”
Kohaku is in excellent spirits.
――――For my first mission, the captain orders me to peel an entire colander of shrimp.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll start you off with a simple task, Shiki-san.
When it's all done, I have another task just for you."
Kohaku-san is in a good mood.
----First, I have to take the shells off all these shrimp.

entries.japanese:
とん、とん、とん。
　まな板を叩く軽快な包丁の音。
　んんんんん～。
　調子のずれた琥珀さんのハミングが台所に響いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap, tap, tap.
Her knife patters briskly against the cutting board.
Mmm-mm-mm-mmm.
Kohaku’s off-key humming fills the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Whick, whick, whick.
The sound of a knife lightly hitting the cutting board.
Nnnnn~.
Kohaku-san's humming fills the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
……。
　…………。
　……………………。
　琥珀さんは調理に没頭しているのか、あまり話しかけてこない。
　俺のほうもエビの皮むきが楽しくて、ついペリペリと皮をむき続けている。
「――――――」
　……けど、懐かしい。
　俺が事故にあって屋敷を出る事になる前、琥珀さんと秋葉と俺でこういったママゴトを何度かやったことがある。
entries.maoEnglish:
…
…
……
Perhaps Kohaku is too absorbed in cooking to talk much.
I’m enjoying peeling the shrimp myself, and keep happily stripping shell after shell.
“……”
But this feels nostalgic.
Before the accident sent me away from the mansion, Kohaku, Akiha, and I played at keeping house like this several times.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
………………
She must be immersed in cooking because she doesn't say much.
As for me, I actually enjoy peeling the shrimp, and keep on peeling the skin.
"------"
…… You know, this really brings back memories.
Before the incident and before I left the mansion, I played like this several times with Kohaku-san and Akiha.

entries.japanese:
あの頃は幼くて、お互いが異性なのだという事を考える事さえなかった。
　ただこの広い屋敷にいる、知り合ったばかりの友達との毎日が楽しかっただけだ。
　それまで色々とつもった出来事を忘れてしまうぐらい、俺たちははしゃぎまわっていたと思う。
　……いや、それとも。
　様々な過去を忘れるために、日々を楽しく過ごそうとしていたのかもしれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We were so young then that it never occurred to us to think of one another as boys and girls.
We were simply happy to spend each day with new friends in this enormous mansion.
I think we played hard enough to forget everything that had piled up before.
Or perhaps…
Perhaps we were trying to fill our days with fun precisely so we could forget the past.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We were young then, and we didn't even think about how we were of the opposite gender.

We were just in this spacious mansion, and all we knew was the continuous fun of every day.
We played around so much, we forgot about all the things that bothered us before.
…… Or maybe.
Maybe, in order to forget the bothersome past, we tried to pass our days with as much fun as possible.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、エビの皮むき気に入りました？」
「え？
　いや、別にそういうわけじゃないけど、どうしてそんなコト言うんです？」
「だってすごく楽しそうじゃないですか。
翡翠ちゃんはですね、エビの皮むきをしてると眉をよせていって、最後には八の字になっちゃうんですよ」
「そうなの？
　意外だな、翡翠はこういうの淡々とこなしそうに見えるけど」
「ええ、どうしてか翡翠ちゃんはお料理が苦手なんです。
お掃除とか、物を整頓するのはすごく得意なんですけどね」
「そうなんだ。
翡翠も琥珀さんも、なんでも出来るって感じだけどな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have you taken a liking to peeling shrimp, Shiki?”
“Hm? Not especially, but what makes you ask?”
“You look as though you’re having such fun. Whenever Hisui peels shrimp, her brows pinch closer and closer until they make a perfect little frown.”
“Really? I wouldn’t have guessed; she looks like she’d work through something like this without a word.”
“For some reason, Hisui is hopeless at cooking. She’s wonderful at cleaning and putting things in order, though.”
“Huh. You and Hisui both seem like you can do anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, you really have taken a liking to peeling those shrimp, haven't you?"
"Eh?
No, not really, why do you ask?"
"Because you look like you're having so much fun.
You know Hisui-chan, her eyebrows would always be so scrunched up by the time she gets done."
"Really?
I'm surprised.
She looks like the type that would do it without complaint."
"Yeah, for some reason, Hisui-chan is poor at cooking.
But she is really great at cleaning and arranging things."
"Is that so?
I always felt that both you and Hisui could do anything."

entries.japanese:
「そうだったら嬉しいんですけど、わたしも翡翠ちゃんも生まれつき一般の常識からズレてる所があるんです。
　翡翠ちゃんは味覚がおかしくて、翡翠ちゃん本人が美味しい料理を作ったつもりでも、わたしや秋葉さまからするとものすごく玄妙な味わいがしたりするんです」
　なるほど、それで翡翠は料理はしないのか。
　翡翠は味覚がちょっとヘンで、琥珀さんは……どこがズレてるんだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’d be delighted if that were true, but both of us were born a little out of step with what most people consider normal.
Hisui’s sense of taste is so strange that she may believe she’s made something delicious while Miss Akiha and I find the result remarkably mysterious.”
So that is why Hisui never cooks.
Hisui’s oddity is her sense of taste, but what is Kohaku’s?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If that was true I would be very happy.
But both Hisui-chan and I are merely normal, so we have our faults too.
Hisui-chan's sense of taste is a little strange, so even when she makes things that she thinks are delicious, for Akiha-sama or I, it tastes really strange."
I see, so that's why Hisui doesn't cook.
Hisui's sense of taste is a little odd; Kohaku-san…… what's her fault, I wonder?

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、考えてみれば翡翠だって琥珀さんだって何もかも一緒ってわけじゃないもんな。
　琥珀さんは昔っから明るかったし、翡翠は昔っから屋敷に閉じこもっていたし」
「へえ、わたしって明るく見えました？
　いちおう、これでも志貴さんたちのことを見ているつもりだったんですけど」
「うん、それは知ってた。
琥珀さんは一緒になってはしゃぎまわってくれたけど、危ないような遊びは止めてくれたし、いつも見守ってくれてただろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, there’s no reason you and Hisui should be alike in every way.
You were always cheerful, and Hisui always kept herself shut away inside the mansion.”
“Did I seem cheerful? I was trying to keep an eye on all of you in my own way, Shiki.”
“I knew that. You ran wild with us, but you always watched over us and stopped us whenever a game became dangerous.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, come to think of it, you and Hisui are different in your own ways.
Kohaku-san, you were always cheerful, while Hisui stayed in the mansion back then."
"Oh, did I look that cheerful?
I thought I was always watching you all though."
"Yeah, I remember.
You would always run around with us, but you would tell us to stop doing dangerous things and look out for us."

entries.japanese:
……ああ、ちゃんと覚えている。
　屋敷の中庭で鬼ごっこをした時とか。
　出来たばかりの池で、親父の鯉を釣り上げようと試行錯誤した時とか。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember it clearly.
Playing tag in the courtyard.
Trying scheme after scheme to catch Father’s carp from the newly dug pond.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Ah, I really do remember.
Playing tag in the courtyard of the mansion.

Trying as hard as we could to catch my old man's carp in the pond.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、そういえばさ、屋敷の門から抜け出して外に出た時があっただろ。
　あの時なんか帰り道がわからなくなってさ、結局琥珀さんが屋敷に電話してくれて、使用人の人に迎えに来てもらったんだよな」
「ええ、そのあとに槙久さまがひどく志貴さんを叱ってましたね。
みんなで遊びに出たはずなのに、いつのまにか遊びに出たのは志貴さんだけになっていて。
色々とやんちゃな事をするんですけど、最後には秋葉さまとわたしは志貴さんに助けられるのが日課でした」
　くすくすと笑みをこぼしながら、懐かしむように琥珀さんは独白する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Remember the time we slipped through the gates and went outside?
We couldn’t find our way back, so in the end you called the mansion and had one of the servants come collect us.”
“Master Makihisa gave you a terrible scolding afterward. All of us had gone out to play, but somehow by the end it was as though only you had gone, Shiki. We were always getting into mischief, yet it became almost a daily ritual for Miss Akiha and me to be rescued by you.”
Kohaku laughs softly, speaking almost to herself as she savors the memory.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, remember that time, the time where we left the mansion from the gate, right?
We didn't know the way to get back, and you ended up calling the mansion and one of the mansion's servants had to come pick us up."
"Yes, and after that Makihisa-sama really did yell at you.
Everyone was playing with you, but somehow you ended up being the only one.
We did so many things, but in the end, you always saved Akiha-sama and me from getting in trouble."
She giggles as she speaks aloud nostalgically.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだろ。
こうして昔のことを話してると、帰ってきたんだなって気がする」
　そう。
　この屋敷にはあまり思い出がない分、琥珀さんと過ごした幼年期の思い出を話しているだけでひどく懐かしい気持ちになれる。
　けど、思い出されるのはそんな楽しかった記憶だけじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. Talking about those days like this makes me feel as though I really have come home.”
Yes.
I have few memories of the mansion itself, so merely talking about the childhood I spent with Kohaku fills me with a fierce nostalgia.
But those happy memories are not the only ones returning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's this?
Talking about old times, I really feel like I have returned now."
That's right.
I really don't have too many memories of this mansion, but talking about old times honestly makes me feel nostalgic.
But, my memories aren't just happy ones.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠には、悪いことをしたな」
　……いつも心の片隅に残っていたあの子。
　結局、一度もまともに話さなかった窓際の少女の記憶がある。
「……あの子、ずっと窓から俺たちを見てたんだ。
いつもさ、子供心に気になってた。
あんな寂しそうな顔してないで、こっちに来て遊べばいいのにって」
　それでも、あの子は俺が屋敷から立ち去る時、ただ一人贈り物をくれたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I treated Hisui badly.”
The girl who had always lingered in a corner of my mind.
The girl at the window, with whom I never managed to have a real conversation.
“She watched us from the window the whole time. Even as a child, I worried about her. I kept wishing she would stop looking so lonely and come play with us.”
Yet when I left the mansion, she alone gave me a parting gift.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I did treat Hisui poorly."
…… That girl who was always in the corner of my heart.
In the end, I was never able to have a true conversation with that girl by the window.
"…… That girl, she was always watching us from the window.
Always, it struck me.
That lonely face looking down, I always thought it would be great if she could come and play."
But still, before I left the mansion, she gave me that one parting gift.

entries.japanese:
「そうですよねー。
翡翠ちゃんったら、あの頃から内気で何を考えているかよくわからない子だったから。
わたしも、翡翠ちゃんが幸せになってくれるなら自分はどうなってもいいって、ずっと思ってたぐらいですから」
「そっか。
琥珀さんは妹思いなんだな」
　なんだか嬉しくて、そんな相づちをうつ。
「あ」
　と。
　短い声をあげて、琥珀さんが手をあげた。
　見れば人差し指がざっくりと包丁で切られている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s true. Hisui was shy even then, and it was always difficult to tell what she was thinking. I always believed that as long as she could be happy, nothing that happened to me mattered.”
“I see. You really love your sister.”
The thought makes me strangely happy, and I say it almost without thinking.
“Ah.”
And then.
Kohaku gives a short cry and raises her hand.
Her index finger has been sliced deeply by the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right.
She was always shy even then, so I never knew what she was thinking.
I always thought if Hisui-chan was happy, it wouldn't matter what happened to me."
"Oh?
Kohaku-san, you really are a good older sister."
I'm feeling happy, so I give an answer like that.
"Ah."
All of a sudden,
with a short sound, Kohaku-san lifts her hand.
I can see she cut her finger with the kitchen knife.

entries.japanese:
「こ、琥珀さん、指切れてる……！」
「え？」
　言われて、琥珀さんは自分の指が切れている事に気がついたようだ。
「あ、ほんとだ」
「ほんとだって、ちょっと琥珀さん！」
　信じられない。
　俺から見てもざっくりと切っているっていうのに、琥珀さんはずいぶんとのんびりとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“K-Kohaku, you cut your finger…!”
“Hm?”
Only when I point it out does she seem to notice the wound.
“Oh, you’re right.”
“Don’t just say that, Kohaku!”
I can’t believe her.
Even I can see it is a deep cut, yet she remains perfectly unhurried.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ko, Kohaku-san, your finger……!"
"Eh?"
After I say that, she seems to have realized she cut her finger.
"Ah, that's true."
"'That's true'?
Hey, Kohaku-san!?"
I don't believe this.
Even I could see that the cut is really deep, but Kohaku-san is still slow-paced.

entries.japanese:
「恥ずかしいなあ。
得意分野のお料理でドジをしちゃうなんて」
　あはは、といつも通りに笑う琥珀さん。
「笑い事じゃないだろ、早く手当てをしないと……！」
「大丈夫ですよ。
命に別状があるわけじゃないんですし」
「でも痛いでしょう、そんなに切れてるんだから！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How embarrassing. Imagine making a blunder while doing the one thing I’m good at.”
Kohaku laughs as cheerfully as ever.
“This isn’t funny—you need to treat that immediately!”
“I’ll be fine. It isn’t going to kill me.”
“It must hurt with a cut that deep!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How embarrassing.
I am supposed to be such a good chef.
Ahaha!"
Kohaku-san gives her normal laugh.
"This is no laughing matter.
We have to take care of it right away……!"
"It's fine.
It isn't life threatening or anything."
"But doesn't it hurt?
It's cut pretty bad!"

entries.japanese:
「いえいえ。
こういうのはですね、痛くないって思えば痛くないんですよ。
この指だけ自分の体じゃなくて、人形か何かだと思い込むんです。
そうすれば痛いなんていう感覚がしなくなるでしょう？」
「な――――」
　笑顔で琥珀さんは達観したコトを言う。
　そりゃあそういうふうに思えば、少しは痛みを我慢できるだろうけど、痛み自体はけっして和らがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Not at all. Things like this don’t hurt if you believe they don’t. You convince yourself that this finger isn’t part of your body, but belongs to a doll or something. Then you stop feeling pain, don’t you?”
“Wha—”
Kohaku delivers this serene pronouncement with a smile.
Thinking that way might help her endure the pain, but it cannot diminish the pain itself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, not at all.
If I think it doesn't hurt, then it won't hurt.
If I think this isn't my finger, and that it's just a finger of some doll, then I won't feel pain, right?"
"Wha----"
With a smile, Kohaku-san says something pretty outlandish.
Well I'm sure if you think that way, it won't hurt as much, but you can't get rid of it all.

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、ともかく手当てをしてください！
　俺は血に弱いんです。
ここで貧血で倒れたら琥珀さんのせいですから……！」
「そうですね、ちゃんと手当てはしないといけませんね。
それじゃ志貴さん、ちょっと席を外します」
　最後までにこやかな笑顔を崩さず、ペコリと頭をさげて琥珀さんは台所から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough—just please bandage it! I can’t stand blood. If I collapse from anemia in here, it will be your fault…!”
“You’re right—I ought to tend to it properly. Please excuse me for a moment, Shiki.”
Her bright smile never faltering, Kohaku gives me a neat little bow and leaves the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, let's just get it taken care of!
I'm a little weak when it comes to blood, so if I have an anemic fit right here, it'll be your fault, Kohaku-san……!"
"I see, then I should take care of it right away.
Well then, Shiki-san, excuse me for a moment."
The whole time her smile never cracks, and giving me a bow with her head, she leaves the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんも大変そうだけど、琥珀さんの分の仕事を任された翡翠のほうが忙しそうだ。
　日ごろの恩返しもかねて、翡翠の手伝いをしにいこう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku has plenty to do, but Hisui seems even busier with Kohaku’s share of the work added to her own.
I owe her for everything she does, so I’ll go lend her a hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san has a lot to do, but I'm sure Hisui is much busier.
I should try and pay Hisui back for everything she's done, so I'll go help her.

entries.japanese:
ロビーに出ると、さっそく翡翠に出くわした。
　調度品の手入れでもするのか、翡翠の足元にはハタキやらフキンやらが用意されている。
「翡翠、ちょっといい？」
「志貴さま？
　お部屋にお戻りになられたのではないのですか？」
「いや、部屋には戻らないよ。
翡翠と琥珀さんが忙しくしてるのに、俺だけのんびりしてるわけにもいかないだろ」
「………………」
　む、と翡翠は無言で俺の目を見詰めてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I find Hisui as soon as I enter the lobby.
A feather duster, polishing cloths, and other supplies lie at her feet, presumably for tending the furnishings.
“Hisui, have you got a minute?”
“Master Shiki? I thought you had returned to your room.”
“No, I’m not going back. I can’t relax while you and Kohaku are both working yourselves ragged.”
“……”
Hisui fixes me with a stern, wordless stare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I head out to the lobby and run into Hisui right away.
She must be tidying things up, because there's a cloth and a feather duster at her feet.
"Hisui, can I have a minute?"
"Shiki-sama?
Did you not return to your room?"
"No, I won't.
You and Kohaku-san seemed so busy, I feel bad just lounging around and doing nothing."
"………………"
Hisui just looks at me silently.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま。
まさかとは思いますが、わたしの仕事の手伝いをする、などとはおっしゃらないでくださいませ」
「―――――――う」
　先手を打たれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Surely you are not about to suggest helping me with my duties.”
“—Uh.”
She struck before I could.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama.
I do not believe this is the case, but are you asking me if you could help me with my duties?"
"------Uhhh."
She struck first.

entries.japanese:
「なんだよ、いいじゃないか手伝うぐらい。
この広い屋敷を一人で掃除するのなんて無理なんだから、少しぐらい協力させてくれ」
「お言葉ですが、志貴さまに手伝っていただくほどの仕事量ではありません。
……むしろ、今日は姉さんがいない分楽になったぐらいです」
「？
　なに、琥珀さんがいないと楽になるの、屋敷の掃除って？」
「あ―――いえ、あの、そういうわけでは………」
　思わず口を滑らせたのか、翡翠はうつむいてごにょごにょと弁解をする。
　……なんか、新鮮すぎて顔がにやけそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong with letting me help? Nobody can clean a mansion this big alone, so at least let me do something.”
“Forgive me, Master Shiki, but there is not enough work to require your assistance. In fact, today is somewhat easier because my sister is absent.”
“What? Cleaning is easier when Kohaku isn’t here?”
“No, that was not what I meant…”
Apparently realizing that she let something slip, Hisui lowers her head and mumbles an explanation.
This is such a rare sight that I can barely keep from grinning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you mean?
Isn't it alright?
Cleaning this huge mansion by yourself is hard, so let me help just a little bit, please?"
"You say that, but there is not so much that I require assistance…… Actually, I can say that since Nee-san is not here, I have an easier time."
"?
Huh?
Cleaning is easier… when Kohaku-san isn't here?"
"Ah--no, well, I mean--that………"
Did she accidentally let something slip out?
She looks down as she stammers for an excuse.
…… It's something I don't see every day, so I smile at her.

entries.japanese:
「……あの、志貴さま。
今のは姉さんには、その……」
　黙っていてください、とごにょごにょ呟く翡翠。
「なに、今のって琥珀さんに話しちゃいけないコトなんだ。
そっか、わかった」
　そういうコトは、ぜひ琥珀さんに教えてあげなくては。
「……志貴さま。
その、なにを考えているかすぐ解るような態度は改めたほうがよろしいかと思います」
「ん？
　なに、別になにも考えてないけど、俺」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. About what I just said, please do not tell my sister…”
Hisui mumbles the request under her breath.
“Oh, so Kohaku isn’t supposed to hear that? I understand.”
Which means, naturally, that I absolutely must tell her.
“…Master Shiki, I believe you should cultivate a manner that does not reveal your thoughts quite so plainly.”
“Hm? I’m not thinking anything.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, Shiki-sama.
What I said just now…… Nee-san, um……"
Flustered, she tries to tell me not to tell Kohaku-san.
"Oh, so what you said right now can't be told to Kohaku-san.
I see, I got it."
I have to tell Kohaku-san about it.
"…… Shiki-sama.
Um, I think you should try not to show what you are thinking."
"Hm?
I'm not really thinking anything at all."

entries.japanese:
「………………………」
　翡翠はじっと見つめてくる。
　……なんか、さっきのはこっちが思っている以上に、琥珀さんにとっての禁句なんだろうか。
「わかった、琥珀さんには黙ってるからそう睨まないでくれ」
「……思い出しました。
志貴さまは昔から根拠のない悪戯をされる方でしたね。
どうしてそう、思い出したように天邪鬼なことをなされるのでしょうか、志貴さまは」
「いや、べつに大した理由なんてないよ。
ちょっと翡翠の困った顔が見たかっただけだし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Hisui stares straight through me.
Was what she said an even greater taboo with Kohaku than I realized?
“All right, I won’t tell her, so stop glaring at me.”
“Now I remember, Master Shiki. Even as a child, you played pranks without the slightest cause. Why must Master Shiki turn contrary on a whim like this?”
“There’s no grand reason. I just wanted to see what you looked like flustered.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………………"
Hisui just looks at me.
…… Perhaps what she said just now might be more of taboo for Kohaku-san than I thought it was.
"I understand; I won't tell her, so please stop looking at me like that."
"…… I remember now.
Even long ago, you would always do pranks and tease others for no reason.
Are you perchance planning on doing something devious like you did back then, Shiki-sama?"
"No, not really.
I just wanted to see how your face looked if you were a little distressed, that's all."

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　……しまった。
どうしてこう、素直に思ったことを口にしてしまうんだろう、俺は。
「志貴さま。
わたしは仕事がありますので、そんなにお暇なら姉さんの手伝いでもしていてください。
志貴さまがおっしゃられたとおり、こちらも忙しいので志貴さまのお相手はできません」
　ふい、と顔を背けて、花瓶のまわりを拭き始める翡翠。
　……なんか、手伝うつもりが怒らせてしまったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Damn. Why do I always blurt out exactly what I’m thinking?
“Master Shiki, I have work to do. If you have so much time to spare, please assist my sister instead. As Master Shiki himself observed, I am busy and cannot entertain Master Shiki.”
Hisui turns away sharply and begins polishing around a vase.
I came here to help, but somehow I’ve only managed to make her angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… Crap.
Why do I blurt out the truth like that?
"Shiki-sama.
I still have duties remaining to finish, so if you have free time, please go help Nee-san.
As you say, I am very busy so I can not keep you company."
Hisui turns away and starts to clean the flower vases.
…… It seems that even though I wanted to help, I made her angry.

entries.japanese:
「……その、翡翠？」
「はい、なんでしょうか」
　それでも話しかけると律儀に答えてくれる翡翠は、人間ができていると思う。
「さっきの話だけど―――あ、答えたくなかったら答えなくていいからな。
　その、琥珀さんっていつも中庭の掃除をしてるけど、屋敷の中の掃除はあんまりしてないよな。
あれって、さっき翡翠が言ってた事と関係あるのか？」
「え……はい、その、たしかに関係はあるのですけど……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Hisui?”
“Yes, Master Shiki?”
Even angry, she answers when addressed, which makes Hisui a better person than I am.
“About what you said—oh, you don’t have to answer if you’d rather not.
Kohaku is always cleaning the courtyard, but she hardly ever cleans inside the mansion. Does that have something to do with what you meant?”
“Yes, there is a connection, but…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, Hisui?"
"Yes, what is it?"
But Hisui still responds courteously, so I think she's really nice.
"About before--ah, if you don't want to answer, you don't have to.
Well, Kohaku-san is always sweeping in the courtyard, and she doesn't really clean in the house that often.
Does it have anything to do with what you said earlier?"
"Eh…… Yes, it, is related, somewhat……"

entries.japanese:
「姉さんには、あまり話さないでください。
アレで自分の不器用さを気にしている風ですから」
「？
　不器用って、琥珀さんは器用じゃないか。
料理だっておいしいし、薬学の知識だってあるんだろ？」
「それが、その……人には向き不向きがありますから。
姉さんはですね、大雑把な掃除でしたら楽しそうにこなしてくれるんですけど、こういった調度品の管理には致命的なまでにドジなんです」
「―――ドジって、翡翠。
そんな直な表現をするなんて」
　それこそ翡翠のイメージじゃ、ないんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please do not discuss it with her. She appears to be rather sensitive about her clumsiness.”
“Clumsiness? But Kohaku is good with her hands. Her cooking is wonderful, and she knows pharmacology too, doesn’t she?”
“People have their strengths and weaknesses. My sister can cheerfully manage broad, simple cleaning, but when it comes to caring for delicate furnishings, she is catastrophically clumsy.”
“Clumsy? Hisui, I never expected you to put it so bluntly.”
That is nothing like the Hisui I thought I knew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please do not tell Nee-san.
She is rather self-conscious of her lack of ability."
"?
Lack of ability?
Kohaku-san doesn't lack in ability; she's a wonderful cook, and knows so much about medicine, right?"
"That is, um…… everyone has things suited and not suited for them.
Nee-san really seems to enjoy herself when cleaning, but she is too rambunctious and is very dangerous when she tries to do cleaning and maintenance in the mansion."
"--Dangerous, Hisui?
Putting it that way, is…"
That doesn't seem to fit Hisui either.

entries.japanese:
「いえ。
志貴さまはご存知でないからそう生易しい事が言えるんです。
姉さんが掃除の名を騙って破損させた品の数は、十や二十ではすみません。
　真剣になればなるほど掃除をしているのに散らかっていってしまう、という稀有な才能の持ち主なんです、あの人は」
　ぐっ、と握りこぶしでも作りそうな勢いで翡翠は語る。
　……どうも、今までよっぽど琥珀さんのドジとやらの被害をこうむってきたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. You can afford to be charitable because you do not know the facts, Master Shiki. The number of objects my sister has destroyed under the pretense of cleaning is far beyond ten or twenty.
She possesses the rare gift of making a room messier the more earnestly she cleans it.”
Hisui speaks with enough force to make a fist.
Apparently she has suffered quite extensively from Kohaku’s fabled clumsiness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, you do not understand, so it is easy for you to say that.
Nee-san has tried to excuse the breaking of several items all in the name of cleaning, and not just ten or twenty times.
If she becomes serious, her cleaning becomes more like a whirlwind.
She has that sort of… talent."
As she speaks, I can almost see a fiery aura form around Hisui.
…… It seems that she has been the victim of Kohaku-san's cleaning many times.

entries.japanese:
「……そうなんだ。
なんか、意外だな」
「……はい。
姉さん本人もそれを気にしています。
　わたしと秋葉さまが話し合って、姉さんには家事と庭の掃除に専念してもらう事にしたんですけど、その時の姉さんの落ち込みようは物凄かったんです」
「……まあ、琥珀さんは物を壊すから掃除はするなって言われたら、そりゃあ落ち込みはするだろうけど……」
　あの、いつもニコニコした琥珀さんが落ち込む姿というのはどうも想像できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. That’s rather unexpected.”
“Yes. She is conscious of it herself. Miss Akiha and I agreed that she should concentrate on housework and cleaning the garden, but she was devastated when we told her.”
“Anyone would be upset if they were told not to clean because they broke things…”
It is difficult to imagine the perpetually smiling Kohaku looking dejected.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
I'm--quite surprised."
"…… Yes.
Nee-san knows about it too.
After Akiha-sama and I discussed it, we decided and told her it was better for her to work outside in the garden or do other non-cleaning chores.
She was very down and disheartened back then."
"…… Well, if she did break things and was told not to clean, I guess she would be a little disappointed……"
Um, I still can't quite picture that happy Kohaku-san looking down.

entries.japanese:
「そういうわけですので、志貴さまもどうか姉さんに室内の掃除をさせるような事は言わないでください。
　姉さんはそれさえなければ立派な―――」
「はい？
　わたしのこと呼びました？」
「「！？」」
　びくっ、と体を震わす翡翠と俺。
　噂をすればなんとやらで、台所のほうから琥珀さんがやってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So please do not suggest that my sister clean indoors, Master Shiki.
Without that one failing, she is an exemplary—”
“Yes? Did someone call me?”
“?!”
Hisui and I cry out together and jump.
Speak of the devil: Kohaku has arrived from the direction of the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, please do not discuss cleaning indoors with Kohaku-san, Shiki-sama.
If Nee-san doesn't do that, then she is really fine--"
"Yes?
Did you call me?"
""!?""
Hisui and I both freeze.
Speak of the devil… Kohaku-san walks in from the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
「姉さん―――なにか足りないものでもあるの？」
「ええ、人手が足りないから志貴さんに手伝ってもらおうと思って」
　にこり、とつっ立っている俺に笑顔を向ける琥珀さん。
「けど、一足遅かったみたいですね。
志貴さん、どうか翡翠ちゃんのお手伝いをしてあげてください」
「姉さん。
別に志貴さまに手伝ってもらっていたわけじゃありません」
　きっぱりと翡翠は言う。
　……まあ、それはその通りなんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku—do you need something?”
“I’m short-handed, so I came to ask Shiki for help.”
Kohaku smiles at me as I stand there frozen.
“But it seems I was too late. Please help Hisui instead, Shiki.”
“Sister. I was not receiving any help from Master Shiki.”
Hisui states it flatly.
She is right, of course.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nee-san--is there something you need?"
"Yes, I needed another hand, so I thought maybe Shiki-san could come help me."
Smiling, Kohaku-san faces me.
"But, it seems I was too late.
Shiki-san, please continue helping Hisui-chan."
"Nee-san.
Shiki-sama is not really helping me at the moment."
Hisui responds very matter-of-factly.
…… Well, that's how it is.

entries.japanese:
「あ、そうなんですか？
　なら志貴さん、今は暇なんですね？」
「―――そうだね。
人手が足りないなら手伝わせてもらうよ。
けど、俺に琥珀さんの手伝いが務まるかな。
料理はしたことないんだけど」
「いえいえ、ちゃんと誰でもできるような作業だってあるんです。
ささ、そういうワケですからお手伝いをしてください」
　ぐ、と俺の手を引っ張っていく琥珀さん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, really? Then you’re free at the moment, Shiki?”
“—I suppose I am. If you need another pair of hands, I’ll help. But are you sure I can manage? I’ve never cooked before.”
“Don’t worry; there are plenty of jobs anyone can do. Come along, then—time to put you to work.”
Kohaku takes me firmly by the hand and pulls me away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, is that so?
Then Shiki-san, are you free?"
"---That's right.
If you need another hand, I'll lend you one.
But, I'm not sure if I'd be any help.
I don't ever cook or anything."
"Not at all, it is something anyone can do.
Come on, please lend me a hand."
Kohaku-san takes my hand and pulls me with her.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　それを、翡翠はじっと見つめていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
Hisui watches us go without a word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
Hisui watches it all silently.

entries.japanese:
……屋敷の台所は、思ったより小さかった。
　まだ屋敷にたくさんの人がいた頃は厨房を使っていたらしいんだけど、今は秋葉と翡翠、琥珀さんに俺という四人だけだから、新しく台所を改装したという事だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The mansion’s kitchen is smaller than I expected.
Apparently they used the main kitchens back when the house was fully staffed, but now that only Akiha, Hisui, Kohaku, and I live here, this smaller room has been remodeled for daily use.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The kitchen is smaller than I expected.
They probably had a much bigger galley when there were many people living in the mansion, but with just Akiha, Hisui, Kohaku-san and I, they had this smaller kitchen prepared.

entries.japanese:
「はい、それではきちんと手を洗って、エプロンを着用してください」
　誰の趣味なのか、おなかの部分に筆文字で“野暮天”と書かれたエプロンを渡される。
「それじゃあ志貴さんには単純作業から入っていただきますね。
それが全部終わったら、次は志貴さんならではの作業がまってますから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“First, wash your hands properly and put on an apron.”
She hands me an apron with BOOR brushed boldly across the stomach, leaving me to wonder whose taste it reflects.
“We’ll start you on something simple, Shiki. Once you finish all of that, I have a special job that only you can do.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Here, please wash your hands and use this apron."
I don't know whose tastes this is a reflection of, but she hands me an apron that says "Quiet Unsociable Person" on it.
"I'll start you off with a simple task, Shiki-san.
When it's all done, I have another task just for you."

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんは上機嫌だ。
　とりあえず、ざるいっぱいに入ったエビの皮むきを隊長から命じられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku is in excellent spirits.
For my first mission, the captain orders me to peel an entire colander of shrimp.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san is in a good mood.
First, I have to take the shells off all these shrimp.

entries.japanese:
とん、とん、とん。
　まな板を叩く軽快な包丁の音。
　んんんんん～。
　調子のずれた琥珀さんのハミングが台所に響いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap, tap, tap.
Her knife patters briskly against the cutting board.
Mmm-mm-mm-mmm.
Kohaku’s off-key humming fills the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Whick, whick, whick.
The sound of a knife lightly hitting the cutting board.
Nnnnn~.
Kohaku-san's humming fills the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
……。
　…………。
　…………………。
　…………………………。
　…………………………………。
　………………………………………琥珀さんは調理に没頭しているのか、あまり話しかけてこない。
　俺のほうもエビの皮むきが楽しくて、ついペリペリと皮をむき続けている。
「――――――」
　……けど、懐かしい。
　俺が事故にあって屋敷を出る事になる前、琥珀さんと秋葉と俺でこういったママゴトを何度かやったことがある。
entries.maoEnglish:
…
…
…
…
…
Perhaps Kohaku is too absorbed in cooking to talk much.
I’m enjoying peeling the shrimp myself, and keep happily stripping shell after shell.
“……”
But this feels nostalgic.
Before the accident sent me away from the mansion, Kohaku, Akiha, and I played at keeping house like this several times.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
………………
……………………
…………………………
…………………………… She must be immersed in cooking because she doesn't say much.
As for me, I actually enjoy peeling the shrimp, and keep on peeling the skin.
"------"
…… You know, this really brings back memories.
Before the incident and before I left the mansion, I played like this several times with Kohaku-san and Akiha.

entries.japanese:
あの頃は幼くて、お互いが異性なのだという事を考える事さえなかった。
　ただこの広い屋敷にいる、知り合ったばかりの友達との毎日が楽しかっただけだ。
　それまで色々とつもった出来事を忘れてしまうぐらい、俺たちははしゃぎまわっていたと思う。
　……いや、それとも。
　様々な過去を忘れるために、日々を楽しく過ごそうとしていたのかもしれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
We were so young then that it never occurred to us to think of one another as boys and girls.
We were simply happy to spend each day with new friends in this enormous mansion.
I think we played hard enough to forget everything that had piled up before.
Or perhaps…
Perhaps we were trying to fill our days with fun precisely so we could forget the past.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We were young then, and we didn't even think about how we were of the opposite gender.

We were just in this spacious mansion, and all we knew was the continuous fun of every day.
We played around so much, we forgot about all the things that bothered us before.
…… Or maybe.
Maybe, in order to forget the bothersome past, we tried to pass our days with as much fun as possible.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、エビの皮むき気に入りました？」
「え？
　いや、別にそういうわけじゃないけど、どうしてそんなコト言うんです？」
「だってすごく楽しそうじゃないですか。
翡翠ちゃんはですね、エビの皮むきをしてると眉をよせていって、最後には八の字になっちゃうんですよ」
「そうなの？
　意外だな、翡翠はこういうの淡々とこなしそうに見えるけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have you taken a liking to peeling shrimp, Shiki?”
“Hm? Not especially, but what makes you ask?”
“You look as though you’re having such fun. Whenever Hisui peels shrimp, her brows pinch closer and closer until they make a perfect little frown.”
“Really? I wouldn’t have guessed; she looks like she’d work through something like this without a word.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, you really have taken a liking to peeling those shrimp, haven't you?"
"Eh?
No, not really; why do you ask?"
"Because you look like you're having so much fun.
You know Hisui-chan, her eyebrows would always be so scrunched up by the time she gets done."
"Really?
I'm surprised.
She looks like the type that would do it without complaint."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、どうしてか翡翠ちゃんはお料理が苦手なんです。
お掃除とか、物を整頓するのはすごく得意なんですけどね」
「……へえ。
なんか、似たような話を聞いたコト、あるよ」
　うん、それもついさっき、その翡翠の口から。
entries.maoEnglish:
“For some reason, Hisui is hopeless at cooking. She’s wonderful at cleaning and putting things in order, though.”
“Huh. I feel as though I heard a very similar story somewhere.”
Yes—from Hisui herself, only moments ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, for some reason, Hisui-chan is poor at cooking.
But she is really great at cleaning and arranging things."
"…… Oh?
I seem to have heard, something like that, before."
Yeah, just now, actually, and from Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「……まあ、考えてみれば翡翠だって琥珀さんだって何もかも一緒ってわけじゃないもんな。
　琥珀さんは昔っから明るかったし、翡翠は昔っから屋敷に閉じこもっていたし」
「へえ、わたしって明るく見えました？
　いちおう、これでも志貴さんたちのことを見ているつもりだったんですけど」
「うん、それは知ってた。
琥珀さんは一緒になってはしゃぎまわってくれたけど、危ないような遊びは止めてくれたし、いつも見守ってくれてただろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, there’s no reason you and Hisui should be alike in every way.
You were always cheerful, and Hisui always kept herself shut away inside the mansion.”
“Did I seem cheerful? I was trying to keep an eye on all of you in my own way, Shiki.”
“I knew that. You ran wild with us, but you always watched over us and stopped us whenever a game became dangerous.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
" …… Well, come to think of it, you and Hisui are different in your own ways.
Kohaku-san, you were always cheerful, while Hisui stayed in the mansion back then."
"Oh, did I look that cheerful?
I thought I was always watching you all though."
"Yeah, I remember.
You would always run around with us, but you would tell us to stop doing dangerous things and look out for us."

…… Ah, I really do remember.
Playing tag in the courtyard of the mansion.

entries.japanese:
……ああ、ちゃんと覚えている。
　屋敷の中庭で鬼ごっこをした時とか。
　出来たばかりの池で、親父の鯉を釣り上げようと試行錯誤した時とか。
「ほら、そういえばさ、屋敷の門から抜け出して外に出た時があったじゃないか。
　あの時なんか帰り道がわからなくなってさ、結局琥珀さんが屋敷に電話してくれて、使用人の人に迎えに来てもらったんだよね」
entries.maoEnglish:
I remember it clearly.
Playing tag in the courtyard.
Trying scheme after scheme to catch Father’s carp from the newly dug pond.
“Remember the time we slipped through the gates and went outside?
We couldn’t find our way back, so in the end you called the mansion and had one of the servants come collect us.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Trying as hard as we could to catch my old man's carp in the pond.

"Hey, remember that time, the time where we left the mansion from the gate, right?
We didn't know the way to get back, and you ended up calling the mansion and one of the mansion's servants had to come pick us up."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、そのあとに槙久さまがひどく志貴さんを叱ってましたね。
みんなで遊びに出たはずなのに、いつのまにか遊びに出たのは志貴さんだけになっていて。
志貴さん、どんなに怒られても悪いのは自分だっていつも言い張ってました。
　……懐かしいです。
わたしたちは色々とやんちゃな事をしてましたけど、最後には秋葉さまとわたしは志貴さんに助けられるのが日課でした」
　くすくすと笑みをこぼしながら、懐かしむように琥珀さんは独白する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Makihisa gave you a terrible scolding afterward. All of us had gone out to play, but somehow by the end it was as though only you had gone, Shiki. No matter how harshly he scolded you, you insisted the fault was yours.
Those days were wonderful. We got into all kinds of mischief, but it became almost a daily ritual for Miss Akiha and me to be rescued by you.”
Kohaku laughs softly, speaking almost to herself as she savors the memory.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, and after that Makihisa-sama really did yell at you.
Everyone was playing with you, but somehow you ended up being the only one.
Shiki-san, no matter how much you got yelled at, you always said it was your own fault.
…… Oh it is so nostalgic.
We did so many things, but in the end, you always saved Akiha-sama and me from getting in trouble."
She giggles as she speaks aloud.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだろ。
こうして昔のことを話してると、帰ってきたんだなって気がする」
　そう。
　この屋敷にはあまり思い出がない分、琥珀さんと過ごした幼年期の思い出を話しているだけで、ひどく懐かしい気持ちになれる。
　けど、思い出されるのはそんな楽しかった記憶だけじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. Talking about those days like this makes me feel as though I really have come home.”
Yes.
I have few memories of the mansion itself, so merely talking about the childhood I spent with Kohaku fills me with a fierce nostalgia.
But those happy memories are not the only ones returning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's this?
Talking about old times, I really feel like I have returned now."
That's right.
I really don't have too many memories of this mansion, but talking about old times honestly makes me feel nostalgic.
But, my memories aren't just happy ones.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠には、悪いことをしたな」
　……いつも心の片隅に残っていたあの子。
　結局、一度もまともに話さなかった窓際の少女の記憶がある。
「……あの子、ずっと窓から俺たちを見てたんだ。
いつもさ、子供心に気になってた。
あんな寂しそうな顔してないで、こっちに来て遊べばいいのにって」
　それでも、あの子は俺が屋敷から立ち去る時、ただ一人贈り物をくれたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I treated Hisui badly.”
The girl who had always lingered in a corner of my mind.
The girl at the window, with whom I never managed to have a real conversation.
“She watched us from the window the whole time. Even as a child, I worried about her. I kept wishing she would stop looking so lonely and come play with us.”
Yet when I left the mansion, she alone gave me a parting gift.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I did treat Hisui poorly."
…… That girl who was always in the corner of my heart.
In the end, I was never able to have a true conversation with that girl by the window.
"…… That girl, she was always watching us from the window.
Always, it struck me.
That lonely face looking down, I always thought it would be great if she could come and play."
But still, before I left the mansion, she gave me that one parting gift.

entries.japanese:
「そうですよねー。
翡翠ちゃんったら、あの頃から内気で何を考えているかよくわからない子だったから。
わたしも、翡翠ちゃんが幸せになってくれるなら自分はどうなってもいいって、ずっと思ってたぐらいですから」
「そっか。
琥珀さんは妹思いなんだな」
　なんだか嬉しくて、そんな相づちをうつ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s true. Hisui was shy even then, and it was always difficult to tell what she was thinking. I always believed that as long as she could be happy, nothing that happened to me mattered.”
“I see. You really love your sister.”
The thought makes me strangely happy, and I say it almost without thinking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's right.
She was always shy even then, so I never knew what she was thinking.
I always thought if Hisui-chan was happy, it wouldn't matter what happened to me."
"Oh?
Kohaku-san, you really are a good older sister."
I'm feeling happy, so I give an answer like that.

entries.japanese:
「あ」
　と。
　短い声をあげて、琥珀さんが手をあげた。
　見れば人差し指がざっくりと包丁で切られている。
「こ、琥珀さん、指切れてる……！」
「え？」
　言われて、琥珀さんは自分の指が切れている事に気がついたようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
And then.
Kohaku gives a short cry and raises her hand.
Her index finger has been sliced deeply by the knife.
“K-Kohaku, you cut your finger…!”
“Hm?”
Only when I point it out does she seem to notice the wound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah."
All of a sudden,
with a short sound, Kohaku-san lifts her hand.
I can see she cut her finger with the kitchen knife.

"Ko, Kohaku-san, your finger……!"
"Eh?"
After I say that, she seems to have realized she cut her finger.

entries.japanese:
「あ、ほんとだ」
「ほんとだって、ちょっと琥珀さん！」
　信じられない。
　俺から見てもざっくりと切っているっていうのに、琥珀さんはずいぶんとのんびりとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, you’re right.”
“Don’t just say that, Kohaku!”
I can’t believe her.
Even I can see it is a deep cut, yet she remains perfectly unhurried.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, that's true."
"'That's true'?
Hey, Kohaku-san!?"
I don't believe this.
Even I could see that the cut is really deep, but Kohaku-san is still slow-paced.

entries.japanese:
「恥ずかしいなあ。
得意分野のお料理でドジをしちゃうなんて」
　あはは、といつも通りに笑う琥珀さん。
「笑い事じゃない、早く手当てをしないと！」
「大丈夫ですよ。
命に別状があるわけじゃないんですし」
「だからって放っておいちゃダメじゃないか！
　もうっ、そんなに切れてるんだから痛いだろうに……！」
「いえいえ。
こういうのはですね、痛くないって思えば痛くないんですよ。
この指だけ自分の体じゃなくて、人形か何かだと思い込むんです。
そうすれば痛いなんていう感覚がしなくなるでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How embarrassing. Imagine making a blunder while doing the one thing I’m good at.”
Kohaku laughs as cheerfully as ever.
“This isn’t funny—you need to treat that immediately!”
“I’ll be fine. It isn’t going to kill me.”
“That doesn’t mean you can ignore it! A cut that deep must hurt…!”
“Not at all. Things like this don’t hurt if you believe they don’t. You convince yourself that this finger isn’t part of your body, but belongs to a doll or something. Then you stop feeling pain, don’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How embarrassing.
I am supposed to be such a good chef.
Ahaha!"
Kohaku-san gives her normal laugh.
"This is no laughing matter.
We have to take care of it right away……!"
"It's fine.
It isn't life threatening or anything."
"But we can't just leave it alone!
Geez, cutting it like that, doesn't it hurt……!?"
"No, not at all.
If I think it doesn't hurt, then it won't hurt.
If I think this isn't my finger, and that it's just the finger of some doll, then I won't feel pain, right?"

entries.japanese:
「な――――」
　笑顔で琥珀さんは達観したコトを言う。
　そりゃあそういうふうに思えば、少しは痛みを我慢できるだろうけど、痛み自体はけっして和らがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wha—”
Kohaku delivers this serene pronouncement with a smile.
Thinking that way might help her endure the pain, but it cannot diminish the pain itself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
With a smile, Kohaku-san says something pretty outlandish.
Well I'm sure if you think that way, it won't hurt as much, but you can't get rid of it all.

entries.japanese:
「ああもう、ともかく手当てをしてください！
　俺は血に弱いんです。
ここで貧血で倒れたら琥珀さんのせいですからね……！」
「そうですね、ちゃんと手当てはしないといけませんね。
それじゃ志貴さん、ちょっと席を外します」
　最後までにこやかな笑顔を崩さず、ペコリと頭をさげて琥珀さんは台所から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, enough—just please bandage it! I can’t stand blood. If I collapse from anemia in here, it will be your fault…!”
“You’re right—I ought to tend to it properly. Please excuse me for a moment, Shiki.”
Her bright smile never faltering, Kohaku gives me a neat little bow and leaves the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Look, let's just get it taken care of!
I'm a little weak when it comes to blood, so if I have an anemic fit right here, it'll be your fault, Kohaku-san……!"
"I see, then I should take care of it right away.
Well then, Shiki-san, excuse me for a moment."
The whole time her smile never cracks, and giving me a bow with her head, she leaves the kitchen.

entries.japanese: ――――ほら、だから言ったじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――I told you this would happen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----See?
I told you so.

entries.japanese:
……何がまずいって、とにかく翡翠がまずかった。
　琥珀さんと秋葉は不心得にも酒に慣れているらしかったが、翡翠にとってまともに飲むのは今日が初めてだという。
　だっていうのに俺に合わせての事なのか、頬を赤らめて一生懸命にグラスを口をつけて、その結果がコレだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The greatest problem by far is Hisui.
Kohaku and Akiha appear to be disgracefully familiar with alcohol, but today was Hisui’s first time truly drinking.
Even so—perhaps because I was drinking—she kept bringing the glass earnestly to her lips with her cheeks flushed red, and this is the result.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… What's bad you say?
Hisui was bad.
Kohaku-san and Akiha seemed to be already used to drinking alcohol, but as far as Hisui is concerned, it was her first time seriously drinking.
Still, she drank to keep me company, trying hard to finish her glass.
And this was what happened.

entries.japanese:
「……あの、翡翠……？
　その、辛いんだったら無理に飲まなくてもいいんだぞ」
「……………………」
　こくん、と頷く翡翠。
　そのまま無言でグラスに口をつけて、ぼう、と視線を宙に漂わせる。
　……いくら止めても翡翠はちょびちょびとグラスを傾ける。
　……よく解らないけど、翡翠は翡翠でお酒が気に入ってしまったのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui? You don’t have to force yourself if it’s unpleasant.”
“……”
Hisui nods once.
Then she puts the glass to her lips again and lets her unfocused gaze drift into space.
No matter how often I try to stop her, she keeps taking tiny sips.
I don’t understand it, but perhaps she has discovered that she likes alcohol.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, Hisui…?
There's no reason for you to force yourself to drink like that."
"………"
Hisui nods.
And then, she takes the glass to her lips and she looks around aimlessly.
…… No matter how much I try to stop her, Hisui keeps sipping out of her glass.
…… I don't really understand it, but perhaps Hisui has taken a liking to alcohol.

entries.japanese:
―――、と。
「ぁ………」
　なんて声をあげて、猫のように翡翠はソファーにまるまってしまった。
「あはは、だめですよー、翡翠ちゃん。
こんなところで寝ちゃったりしたら風邪引くじゃないですか。
ほらほら、秋葉さまもぶつぶつと文句なんておっしゃらないでくださいな」
　琥珀さんは笑顔で眠ってしまった秋葉と翡翠に話しかけている。
　……どう見ても、琥珀さん本人も酔っているふうにしか見えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And then.
“Ah…”
With that little sound, Hisui curls up like a cat on the sofa.
“Ahaha, you mustn’t, Hisui. If you sleep here, you’ll catch cold. And Miss Akiha, please stop muttering complaints.”
Kohaku smiles as she addresses the sleeping Akiha and Hisui.
No matter how I look at it, Kohaku herself is drunk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---And then…
"Ah………"
With that, Hisui curls onto the sofa like a cat.
"Ahaha.
You can't be doing that, Hisui-chan.
If you sleep there, you'll catch a cold.
Come on, Akiha-sama, please don't complain."
With a smile, Kohaku-san talks to the sleeping Akiha and Hisui.
…… It seems Kohaku-san is drunk too.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
翡翠、本当に初めてだったのか」
「はい。
翡翠ちゃん、お酒にはてんで弱いですから。
いつもはですね、一口飲んだだけで顔を真っ赤にしてしまうんですよー」
　あははー、と陽気に笑う琥珀さん。
「……ちょっと。
それ、かなり問題があるんじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is a disaster. Was this really Hisui’s first time actually drinking?”
“Yes. She cannot hold her liquor at all. Normally one sip is enough to turn her bright red.”
Kohaku laughs merrily.
“Wait. Doesn’t that make this considerably worse?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It really was your first time, wasn't it, Hisui?"
"Yes.
Hisui-chan has always been pretty weak with alcohol.
Usually, she takes a sip and she turns completely red.
Ahaha~!"
Kohaku-san laughs brightly.
"…… It seems like we have quite a problem, don't we?"

entries.japanese:
「そうですよね。
翡翠ちゃんもいつもは断るんですけど、志貴さんが勧めるから無理したんですよー。
　普段は愛想よく振る舞えないから、せめてお酌ぐらいはしようとしたんでしょうね。
もう、わが妹ながらかわいいったらないじゃないですか！」
　バンバン、と俺の背中を叩いてくる琥珀さん。
　……なんだかんだと、この人もものの見事にできあがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It does, doesn’t it? Hisui normally refuses, but she pushed herself because you encouraged her, Shiki. She can’t act very friendly most of the time, so perhaps she thought she could at least pour your drinks. Honestly, my little sister is just too adorable!”
Kohaku pounds me on the back.
Whatever else may be said, she is magnificently drunk herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
Hisui-chan always turns down alcohol, but since Shiki-san offered, she pushed herself.
She is normally not very sociable, so I guess she at least tried to keep you company.
Isn't my sister so cute!?"
Bam-bam, Kohaku-san slaps my back.
…… Kohaku-san is quite drunk too…

entries.japanese:
「今夜はこれでお開きかな。
秋葉もへべれけだし、翡翠も丸まってしまってるし」
「……へべれけって……なんですか。
兄さん、わからない言葉、使わないで、ください……」
　ぶつぶつと文句を言う秋葉。
　なんでも秋葉は解らない事があると不機嫌になるらしい。
　それはそれでいいんだけど、こうして酒がまわってしまうと何もかもが理解不能になってしまうらしく、結果としてぶつぶつと文句を繰り返すマシーンと化していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I suppose that ends the party. Akiha is plastered, and Hisui has curled into a ball.”
“What does ‘plastered’ mean? Brother, please don’t use words I don’t understand.”
Akiha mutters complaints.
Apparently, not understanding something puts her in a foul mood.
Ordinarily that would be harmless enough, but alcohol has rendered everything incomprehensible to her, transforming her into a machine that does nothing but mutter grievances.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess this wraps up the night.
Akiha is hammered and Hisui is all curled up."
"…… Hammered… what is that?
Nii-san, please don't use words, that I can't, understand……"
Akiha complains in a murmuring voice.
It seems that Akiha doesn't like things she doesn't understand.
That's all good, but it seems when she's drunk, she doesn't understand anything… consequently, she has turned into a complaining machine…

entries.japanese:
「それでは秋葉さまはわたしがお運びしますから、志貴さんは翡翠ちゃんをお願いしますね」
「え―――ちょっと待って琥珀さん。
俺、翡翠には触れられないよ。
前に翡翠に触っただけで叩かれちゃったんだから」
「―――そっか、そういえば翡翠ちゃんってば極度の潔癖症でしたっけ。
男の人と手を握るだけで吐いちゃうぐらいですから、志貴さんが抱きかかえるのは問題がありますねー」
「……手を握るだけで吐く……？」
　それは潔癖症という言葉だけですませられる事じゃない。
　八年前からおかしいと思っていたけど、翡翠って一体―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll carry Miss Akiha, so please take Hisui, Shiki.”
“What—wait, Kohaku. I can’t touch Hisui. The last time I merely touched her, she slapped me.”
“Oh, that’s right. Hisui is exceptionally averse to physical contact, and merely holding hands with a man can make her vomit, so I suppose having you carry her may be a problem, Shiki.”
“Holding hands makes her vomit?”
That cannot be dismissed as mere fastidiousness.
I thought something was strange eight years ago, but what happened to Hisui—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I will carry Akiha-sama, so Shiki-san, could you please take care of Hisui-chan?"
"Eh---wait a second Kohaku-san.
I can't touch Hisui.
I just brushed against her earlier and she hit me."
"---That's right.
Now that you mention it, Hisui-chan is a little obsessed about cleanliness.
Even just holding hands with a man will cause her to throw up.
If you hold her, I suppose there would be a problem."
"…… Just holding hands and throwing up……?"
That goes beyond just being obsessed with cleanliness.
I thought she was strange eight years ago, but Hisui----

entries.japanese:
「でも、翡翠ちゃんは眠ってるんだし大丈夫ですよ。
はい、それじゃ秋葉さま、お部屋に戻りますからね」
「そんな、ちょっと琥珀さん！」
　……琥珀さんは振り返らない。
　秋葉に肩をかして、よろよろと食堂を後にしていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She’s asleep, so it will be fine. Come along, Miss Akiha—I’m taking you to your room.”
“No, wait, Kohaku!”
She does not look back.
Supporting Akiha by the shoulder, she staggers out of the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, if Hisui-chan is sleeping, then it will be okay.
Well, Akiha-sama, let's go back to your room."
"What?
Wait, Kohaku-san!"
…… She doesn't respond.
With Akiha over her shoulders, she disappears out of the dining room.

entries.japanese:
残ったものは。
　食べきれなかった料理の山と、空になったお酒の山と、すーすーと安らかな寝息をたてる翡翠だけだった。
　秋も本番。
　こんなところで寝てしまったら風邪ぐらい引いてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
What remains.
A mountain of unfinished food, a mountain of empty bottles, and Hisui breathing peacefully in her sleep.
Autumn is well under way.
If she sleeps here, she really will catch cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
What she left behind…
A mountain of uneaten food, a mountain of empty bottles, and the contentedly sleeping Hisui, who is breathing softly on the sofa.
It truly is autumn.
Sleeping there like that, she will certainly catch a cold.

entries.japanese:
「……いいのかな、翡翠に触っちゃって」
　けど場合が場合だ。
　……こっちだって、その、よこしまな気持ちはないんだし、翡翠を部屋に運ぶだけ、なんだし。
「……ごめん。
あとで怒っていいから」
　眠っている翡翠を抱き上げる。
「ぁ――――――」
　それだけで、どくんと心臓が高鳴った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is it really all right to touch her?”
But there is no other choice.
Besides, I have no improper intentions; I am only carrying her to her room.
“I’m sorry. You can be angry with me later.”
I lift the sleeping Hisui into my arms.
“Ah—”
That alone sends my heart pounding.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Is it okay to touch Hisui like this?"
But, it can't be helped.
…… I don't have any bad intentions, and I do have to get her up to her room.
"…… Sorry.
You can be mad at me later."
I lift up the sleeping Hisui.
"Ah……"
With just that, my heart begins to pound.

entries.japanese:
「……軽い」
　翡翠は思っていたとおり、軽かった。
　すっぽりと両手に納まる華奢な体。
　柔らかい手触りと、確かな体温。
「……まず。
早く部屋に連れていかないと、俺のほうがどうかしそうだ」
　翡翠を起こさないようにゆっくりと、食堂を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She’s light.”
Hisui is as light as I imagined.
Her slender body fits neatly in my arms.
Softness and unmistakable warmth.
“This is bad. I need to get her to her room before I lose my mind.”
Moving slowly so I do not wake her, I leave the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Light."
Just like I thought, Hisui is very light.
Her delicate body fits in my arms.
Softness and the warmth of her body.
"…… This isn't good.
I have to take her to her room quickly or I'll be the one in trouble."
So as not to wake Hisui, I slowly carry her out of the dining room.

entries.japanese:
翡翠の部屋のドアノブに手をかけて、愕然とした。
「――――うそだろ」
　鍵がかかってしまっている。
「鍵は―――翡翠のポケット、かな」
　まずい。
いや、ただポケットに手をいれるだけなんだけど、それはまずい。
　そんなことをしたらこっちの理性がどうなるかわからない。
「…………仕方ない、よな、こういう場合」
　幸い、翡翠の部屋と俺の部屋は二階だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I reach for the knob of Hisui’s door—and freeze.
“You’ve got to be joking.”
It is locked.
“The key must be in her pocket.”
This is bad. It would only mean putting my hand in her pocket, but that is still bad.
I have no idea what would become of my self-control.
“There’s no helping it, is there?”
Fortunately, both Hisui’s room and mine are on the second floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I turn the doorknob to Hisui's room, and I stop, stunned.
"----No way."
It's locked.
"The key… must be in Hisui's pocket, right?"
This is bad.
No, it's just reaching my hand in her pocket, but it's bad.
If I did that, who knows where my mind will go.
"…… Oh well, that's how it is."
Fortunately, both Hisui's room and my room are on the second floor.

entries.japanese:
――というわけで、
　　翡翠を抱えたまま自分の部屋に戻ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――And that is how I return to my own
room with Hisui still in my arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--So,
I came back to my room with Hisui still in my arms.

entries.japanese:
「よい……しょ、と」
　ベッドに翡翠を寝かせる。
　ほんとうに無理をしてお酒を飲んだらしく、翡翠はまったく目を覚まさない。
「……さて。
俺はどうしようか―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There we go.”
I lay Hisui on the bed.
She must truly have forced herself to drink, because she shows no sign of waking.
“…Now what am I supposed to do?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There we go."
I place Hisui on my bed.
I guess she really pushed herself drinking alcohol, as she does not wake up.
"…… Well.
What should I do now---"

entries.japanese:
「あ―――れ」
　翡翠をおろして気が抜けたのか、絨毯に倒れこんでしまった。
「ん―――－む」
　自分にも酒が回ってきたらしい。
　くらり、と心地よい眩暈がする。
「……ま……いい、か」
　別に何をするわけでもないんだし。
　このまま、絨毯で眠ってしまっても、誰も文句は言わないだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh…?”
Perhaps setting her down made the tension leave me, and I crumple onto the carpet.
“Mmm…”
It seems the alcohol has finally caught up with me too.
A pleasant dizziness rolls through me.
“Fine.”
It isn’t as though I intend to do anything.
