No one can object if I simply fall asleep here on the carpet—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?"
Am I that tired from carrying Hisui?
I fall to the carpet.
"Umph---"
It seems like the alcohol is having an effect on me too.
Suddenly, I start to feel very dizzy.
"…… Well… whatever."
I hadn't really planned on doing anything anyway.
Even if I go to sleep on the floor like this, I don't think anyone will complain---

entries.japanese: ―――懐かしい、匂いが、する。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――There was a familiar scent.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Something seems… very familiar.

entries.japanese:
古い和室。
　暗い部屋。
entries.maoEnglish:
An old tatami room.
A dark room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
An old Japanese-style room.
A dark room.

entries.japanese:
―――あれは、
　一体どのくらい昔のことだったろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――How long ago
had that been?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That is,
that's an extremely old memory.

entries.japanese:
新しく連れてこられて周りの人たちになれなくて、一人でずっと閉じこもっていた子供のころ。
　とにかく何もかもがイヤで、誰とも話したくなかった。
　ずっと、ずっと一人のままで、幸せだったころの、揺籃の時代の繭に閉じこもっていたかった。
　その先に何もないってわかっていても、ずっとそうしていたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Back when I had just been brought there, when I couldn’t grow used to the people around me and spent every day shut away alone.
I hated everything and didn't want to speak to anyone.
I wanted to remain alone forever, sealed inside the cocoon of that happy childhood.
Even knowing there was nothing beyond that cocoon, I wanted to stay inside forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When I was very young, I wasn't used to the new people that took me in, so I locked myself up in my room.
I didn't care for anything; I didn't want to talk to anyone.
Always, always alone, and I wanted to be swaddled in the cradle of my happy memories.

Even if I knew there would be nothing like that for me ever again, I still wanted to do so.

entries.japanese:
トントン、という音。
「―――だれ？」
「あたしだよ」
　ああ、またやってきた。
　同い年ぐらいの女の子が、この部屋の扉を叩いている。
「シキちゃん、遊ぼ。
そんなとこにいたらかびが生えちゃうんだからね」
「ヤだ。
外は、ヤだ」
　膝を抱えて、あかりのない部屋のすみで、ずっと小さくなっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Knock, knock.
“―――Who is it?”
“It’s me.”
She had come again.
A girl about my age was knocking on the door.
“Shiki, come play. If you stay in there, you’ll grow mold.”
“No. I don’t wanna go outside.”
Hugging my knees, I stayed curled into a tiny ball in the unlit corner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock knock, came a sound.
"…… Who is it?"
"It's me."
Ah, she came again.
That girl around my age was knocking on the door again.
"Shiki-chan, let's play.
You'll get moldy if you stay in a place like that."
"I don't wanna.
I don't like going outside."
Hugging my knees, I huddled in a corner of the dark room.

entries.japanese:
……女の子は毎日やってきた。
　飽きもしないでノックをする。
　少女は、決して無理強いはせず、扉を開けようともしないで、ただ自分に呼びかけ続けていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The girl came every day.
She never tired of knocking.
She never forced me or tried to open the door, but simply kept talking to me through it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That girl came every day.
She would always knock, never getting tired of it.
She would never force me out, so she would not open the door, but just continued to call my name.

entries.japanese:
「どうして外に出てこないの？」
　だって、外には知らない人しかいないもの。
みんな、ボクのことを憎んでいるんだ。
「そんなことないよ。
みんな、シキくんのこと好きになりたがってるよ」
　うん。
それはわかるけど、しんじられない。
だって、ボクのお父さんは、そうして―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why won’t you come outside?”
Because everyone outside is a stranger. They all hate me.
“That’s not true. Everyone wants to like you, Shiki.”
I know. But I can’t believe it. Because my father was like that, and then—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why won't you come outside?"
Because there's no one that I know outside.
Everyone hates me outside.
"That's not true.
Everyone wants to like you, Shiki-kun."
Yes.
I knew that, but I couldn't believe it.
Because my father went outside, and---

entries.japanese:
そうして。
　自分の父親は、そうして、バラバラにされてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then.
My father was, just like that, torn to pieces.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And.
He was torn to pieces.

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
そうだよね、それじゃあ誰もしんじられないよね」
　そうなんだ。
だから、ずっとここにいる。
もうこわい思いはしたくないんだ。
「でも、それじゃいつまでもひとりきりだよ。
ひとりきりはつまんないよ」
　つまんなくても、こわいよりは楽しいとおもうけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Then of course you can’t trust anybody.”
That’s right. So I’m staying here forever. I don’t want to be scared again.
“But then you’ll always be alone. Being alone is boring.”
Even if it’s boring, I think it’s nicer than being scared.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
No wonder you can't believe anyone."
Yeah, that's why I will always stay here.
I don't want any more scary things happening.
"But, you will just be by yourself all the time.
Being by yourself is no fun."
Even if it's no fun, it is better than being scared.

entries.japanese:
「そんなの、ぜんぜんたのしくなんかない。
もう、ほんとにしょうがないなあ。
じゃあ、シキちゃんはあたしをしんじていいよ」
　……しんじていいよって、なにそれ。
あべこべだよ、ふつーはボクがしんじてあげてもいいってゆわない？
「いいのっ！
　シキちゃんはあたしをしんじて出てくるの！」
　……いいけど。
けど、しんじるってなにをしんじるの？
entries.maoEnglish:
“That isn’t nice at all. Honestly, you’re hopeless. Fine, then—you can trust me, Shiki.”
What does that mean, I can trust you? That’s backwards—aren’t I supposed to be the one who says I might trust you?
“That’s just how it is! Trust me, Shiki, and then come outside!”
All right. But what am I supposed to trust?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's, that's not fun at all.
Then, Shiki-chan, you can believe in me."
…… You say I can believe in you.
That's a little backwards.
Don't people normally say, "I believe you?"
"It's okay!
Shiki-chan, you can believe in me and come out!"
…… Fine.
But, believe… what should I believe in?

entries.japanese:
「かんたんだよ。
もしみんながシキちゃんを嫌っても、あたしはきっとシキちゃんを好きだってこと。
　あたし、シキちゃんのことが好きだから、こうやって遊びにいこうって言ってるんだもん」
　…………そとは、たのしい？
「うん！
　ひとりでいるより、きっときっと楽しいよ―――――」
――――そうして、自分は外に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s easy. Even if everybody hates you, I’ll still like you, Shiki. I keep coming to ask you to play because I like you, Shiki.”
Is it fun outside?
“Yes! It’ll be much, much more fun than being alone—”
――――And so I went outside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Simple.
Even if everyone hates you, I will still like you, Shiki-chan.
Because I like you, I always come and ask you to play."
……… Is outside, fun?
"Yeah!
It's much, much more fun than being by yourself-----!"
----And then, I went outside.

entries.japanese:
思えば。
　アレが遠野志貴にとって、一番はじめの景色だったと思う――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Looking back.
I think that was the very first sight Shiki Tohno ever saw—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Come to think of it,
that was my first memory as Tohno Shiki----

entries.japanese:
―――明るい光に意識が冴えていく。
　窓からさしこんでくる朝の光に目が覚めていく。
「………ん」
　夢からさめる。
　……よくわからない、ひどく曖昧な夢を見た気がする。
　懐かしい匂いをかんじた。
　あれは畳の匂い―――だろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Bright light draws my mind toward waking.
Morning pours through the window and opens my eyes.
“Mm.”
I wake from the dream.
I had a terribly vague dream I could not make sense of.
There had been a familiar scent.
Tatami, perhaps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---A bright light floods my consciousness.
As I open my eyes, the morning light shines through the window.
"……… Nnn."
I wake from my dream.
…… I don't quite remember it, but I remember vaguely watching a dream.
It was very nostalgic.
The smell of tatami---is that what it was?

entries.japanese:
「あ………れ」
　おかしいな、とっくに目を覚ましているっていうのに―――まだ、なんかいい匂いがしてくる。
「ん―――志………貴………」
　耳元で聞こえる声。
「……え？」
　何かすぐ近くに気配を感じて、まどろんでいた目を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh…?”
Strange—I am fully awake, yet a sweet scent still lingers.
“Mm—Shiki.”
A voice murmurs beside my ear.
“What?”
Sensing someone very close, I force my drowsy eyes open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?"
That's strange, even though I'm awake, I still smell a nice scent.
"N---Shi……… ki………"
I hear a voice by my ear.
"…… Eh?"
Sensing something beside me, my dozing eyes fly open.

entries.japanese:
「……………っっっっ！」
　驚く声を、必死に押しとどめた。
　どういう事なのか、翡翠が俺のベッドで眠っている。
　そ、それだけじゃなくて、こんな間近に、あまつさえ俺の体によりかかって、その―――無防備すぎる寝顔がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I choke back my cry with everything I have.
Somehow, Hisui is asleep in my bed.
And not merely that—she is right here, leaning against my body, her sleeping face utterly defenseless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… sssssst!"
I frantically stop my surprised shout.
I don't know why, but Hisui is sleeping in my bed.
A-And that's not all.
At the same time, leaning right up against me, is her completely unguarded sleeping face.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ――――、っ」
　緊張して声が出ない。
　眠気なんて、もう一瞬でぶっ飛んだ。
「……どうなってるんだ、これ」
　首だけを起こしてまわりを見渡す。
　……ここは確かに俺の部屋だ。
　翡翠はすーすーと安らかな寝息をたてている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
Tension strangles my voice.
Every trace of sleep vanishes in an instant.
“What is going on?”
I raise only my head and look around.
This is definitely my room.
Hisui continues to breathe softly and peacefully.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Tense as I am, I can't say a thing.
My sleepiness disappears in a flash.
"…… What's going on?"
Moving just my neck, I glance around.
…… Without a doubt, this is my room.
Hisui lies there, breathing softly.

entries.japanese:
「……えっと、昨日は確か……」
　昨日のことを思い出そうとしたけど、そんな事はどうでもよかった。
　翡翠の吐息が胸にかかる。
　……安らかな寝顔。
　それをこんな間近で見ているだけで、もう他の事なんてどうでもよかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let me think—last night.”
I try to remember, but suddenly none of that matters.
Hisui’s breath warms my chest.
Her face is so peaceful.
Seeing it this close, I cannot bring myself to care about anything else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Let's see, yesterday we…"
I try to remember what happened yesterday, but that's not important.

Hisui's breathing is on my chest.
…… Her peaceful, sleeping face.
For now, just being able to see that so closely, makes me not care about anything else.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　つい見惚れてしまう。
　今まで漠然と感じてはいたけど、翡翠は本当にキレイだ。
　……顔が美人だとかそういうんじゃなくて、その、楚々とした雰囲気が、とてもキレイだと思わせてくれる。
「……………翡翠」
　できることなら、ずっとこうしていたい。
　けどそれは不可能な話だし、そろそろ翡翠に起きてもらわないと困る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
I cannot help staring.
I had sensed it vaguely before, but Hisui truly is beautiful.
Her beauty is not simply in her features; it is the quiet, delicate grace around her.
“Hisui.”
If I could, I would stay like this forever.
But that is impossible, and I need her to wake soon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I'm completely absorbed.
It's not that I didn't realize it before, but Hisui is really pretty.
It's not that she just has a beautiful face.
Rather, her graceful atmosphere, I can't help but think that it is pretty.
"……………… Hisui."
If I could, I would like to stay this way forever.
But that can't happen… Besides, unless Hisui wakes up soon, there will be a lot of trouble.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
おい、翡翠」
　……呼びかけても起きる気配がない。
「ほら、朝なんだって。
そろそろ起きる時間じゃないのか」
　ゆさゆさと翡翠の体を揺らす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Hey, Hisui.”
Calling her does nothing.
“Come on, it’s morning. Isn’t it about time you woke up?”
I take her by the shoulders and gently shake her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
Hey, Hisui."
…… I call, but she doesn't seem to wake up.
"Hey, it's morning.
Isn't it time to get up?"
I gently shake Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
起きろってば、翡翠」
「う……ん」
　ぴくり、と翡翠の指が動く。
　そのまま、氷が溶けていくように、ゆっくりと翡翠のまぶたが開かれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Wake up, Hisui.”
“Mmh.”
One of her fingers twitches.
Then, slowly, like ice beginning to thaw, Hisui’s eyes open.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui.
Wake up, Hisui."
"U… nh."
Hisui's fingers start to twitch.
Hisui's eyelids slowly open, like melting ice.

entries.japanese:
「……………ん」
　ゆらり、と腕をたてて起きあがる翡翠。
　まぶたをこすりながらキョロキョロとあたりを見渡すこと数秒。
　翡翠は自分が俺の部屋にいて、しかも目の前に俺がいるという事態をようやく把握してくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmh.”
Hisui props herself unsteadily upright.
She rubs her eyes and spends several seconds peering around the room.
At last, she grasps that she is in my bedroom—and that I am right in front of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Mm."
Waveringly stretching out her arms, Hisui wakes up.
She looks around the room rubbing her eyes for a few seconds.
Hisui finally grasps the fact that she is in my room, and the fact that I am right in front of her.

entries.japanese:
「きゃっ――――！」
　ベッドから飛び起きる翡翠。
「し、志貴さま、わたしはどうして――――」
「その……うまく説明できないんだけど、昨夜のことは覚えてる？」
「え―――昨夜の、事ですか？」
　じっ、と考え込む翡翠。
　と。
とたん、翡翠の頬が赤くなった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eek—!”
Hisui bolts out of the bed.
“M-Master Shiki, why am I—”
“Well—I’m not sure how to explain it, but do you remember last night?”
“Last night?”
Hisui falls silent, thinking hard.
Then. All at once, her cheeks flush crimson.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kyaaa!"
Hisui jumps up from the bed.
"Shi, Shiki-sama, why am I----"
"I… I can't explain it very well, but do you remember about last night?"
"Eh---about last night?"
Hisui starts to think.
And all of a sudden, Hisui's cheeks turn red.

entries.japanese:
「思い出した？」
「はい―――志貴さまにはご迷惑をおかけしました」
　頬を赤らめたまま、真正面から翡翠はこっちを見つめてくる。
「……その、ごめんな。
翡翠の部屋まで行ったんだけど、鍵がかかっていて入れなかったんだ。
　とりあえず俺の部屋で寝かせてから、琥珀さんを呼びに行こうと思ったんだけど……俺も酒が回ってたらしくて、そのまま眠っちゃったみたいなんだ」
　……うん、たしかにそんな記憶がある。
　けどおかしいな、昨夜はたしか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Remember now?”
“Yes—I’m sorry to have caused you so much trouble, Master Shiki.”
Still blushing, Hisui looks me squarely in the eye.
“No, I’m the one who should apologize. I took you to your room, but the door was locked, so I couldn’t get in.
I thought I’d let you sleep here while I went to fetch Kohaku, but I suppose the alcohol had caught up with me too, because I seem to have fallen asleep.”
Yes—I do remember something like that.
But that’s strange—last night, I’m sure—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You remembered?"
"Yes…… I caused you a lot of trouble, Shiki-sama."
With flushed cheeks, Hisui looks right at me.
"…… Sorry about that.
I went to your room, but it was locked and I couldn't enter.
I thought you could sleep in my room while I went to get Kohaku-san, but the alcohol got to me and just like that, I fell asleep."
…… Yeah, that's exactly how I remember it.
But that's odd, last night I thought for sure…

entries.japanese:
「……おかしいな、初めはちゃんと絨毯で眠ってたんだけど……その、いつのまにかベッドにあがってしまってたみたいだ。
　あ、けど翡翠にヘンなことはしてないぞっ！
　俺だっていまさっき目が覚めたんだから……！」
「………………」
　翡翠はじっと無言で見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s odd—I know I fell asleep on the carpet at first, but somehow I ended up in the bed.
B-but I didn’t do anything to you, Hisui! I only woke up a moment ago myself!”
“…………”
She merely stares at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's odd, I thought that I went to sleep on the carpet, but… sometime during the night I must have got on the bed.
Ah, I wasn't thinking of doing anything weird to you, Hisui!
I just now woke up too……!"
"…………"
Hisui stares at me silently.

entries.japanese:
「ほ、ほんとだって！
　だって仕方ないじゃないか、琥珀さんは秋葉だけで手一杯だったし、あのまま翡翠を放っておくこともできなかったんだからっ！
　……そりゃあ翡翠を抱えたことは謝るけど、それだって、その、あとで怒られるのを覚悟してたんだから！」
　翡翠のまっすぐな視線になんとか答えようと、とにかく精一杯の弁解をする。
「…………………」
　翡翠は何も答えないで、自分の服をかるく見て頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I-I’m telling the truth—what else could I do? Kohaku already had her hands full with Akiha, and I couldn’t just leave you there! I’m sorry I picked you up, but even then, I knew you’d be furious with me later!”
Desperate to answer Hisui’s unwavering gaze, I plead my case with everything I can muster.
“…………”
Without a word, Hisui glances over her clothes and gives a small nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I mean it!
I didn't have a choice, Kohaku-san had to take care of Akiha, and I couldn't just leave you alone like that!
…… I apologize for holding you, and I was ready for you to get mad at me for doing that!"
Trying to answer Hisui's direct gaze, and I try my utmost to explain.
"……………"
Hisui doesn't answer; she just looks over her clothes and nods.

entries.japanese:
「そのようですね。
服の乱れがありませんから、志貴さまは潔白です」
「よかった――――」
　ほう、と胸を撫で下ろす。
「それに、志貴さまをベッドにあげたのは、その……きっとわたしです。
　夜半に一度だけ目が覚めたのですが、その時に志貴さまが床で眠っていらしたものですから、そんなところで眠っては風邪をひかれます、とベッドでお眠りになっていただいた記憶があります」
「え……そうなの？」
　それなら確かにベッドに上がってしまっただろうけど、どうして翡翠はベッドで眠っていたのだろう？
entries.maoEnglish:
“It appears you are telling the truth. My clothes are undisturbed, so you are innocent, Master Shiki.”
“Thank God—”
I let out a deep breath, relief washing over me.
“Besides, I believe I was the one who brought Master Shiki into the bed.
I woke once during the night and found Master Shiki asleep on the floor; I seem to remember telling him that he would catch cold there and making him sleep in the bed instead.”
“What—really?”
That would explain how I got into the bed, but then why had Hisui been sleeping there too?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It appears that way.
My clothing does not appear to be tampered with.
You are innocent, Shiki-sama."
"Good----"
I breathe a sigh of relief.
"And I think the one who placed you on the bed… was me.
I woke up once during the night and saw you sleeping on the floor.
I did not want you to catch a cold, so I remember getting you to sleep on the bed."
"Eh…… for real?"
If that's true, then that would explain why I was in bed, but why was Hisui sleeping on the bed too?

entries.japanese:
「……申し訳ありません。
わたしも、その、お酒に酔って前後不覚になってしまい、目の前にベッドがあるなら自室に戻る必要なんてない、とかってに思い込んでしまって……」
　恥ずかしそうに翡翠は説明する。
「そ、そう……そうだよな、たしかにそういうふうになっちゃうよな、酔ってる時って」
　ははは、となんとなく笑ってみる。
　翡翠は恥ずかしそうに肩をすぼませている。
　……どうしてだろう。
　さっきまで一緒に眠っていたっていうだけなのに、翡翠のことを妙に意識してしまって、うまく言葉がうかばない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m terribly sorry: I was so intoxicated that I lost track of everything. I seem to have decided that, with a bed directly in front of me, there was no need to return to my own room—”
Hisui explains, plainly mortified.
“R-right—of course that’s the sort of thing people do when they’re drunk.”
I let out an awkward little laugh.
Hisui draws her shoulders in with embarrassment.
Why is this so awkward?
All we did was sleep beside each other, yet now I’m painfully conscious of her and can’t think of a single thing to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please forgive me.
I, I was still a little drunk, and I thought that since there was a bed in front of me, I wouldn't need to go back to my room…"
Embarrassed, Hisui explains what happened.
"I-I see.
Certainly, that's how you think when you are drunk.
Hahaha."
I start to laugh for some reason.
Embarrassed, Hisui drops her shoulders.
…… Why is it?
Even though I was only sleeping next to her, I get so conscious of Hisui, I am unable to say anything clearly.

entries.japanese:
「と、とにかくこのことは二人に内緒にしよう。
秋葉に知られたら怒られるし、琥珀さんに知られたらなんてからかわれるかわからないからな」
「―――はい。
志貴さまがお許し下さるのなら、わたしとしても助かります」
「ああ、ごめんな翡翠。
俺がもうちょっとしっかりしていれば、こんなコトにはならなかったのに」
　ごめん、と翡翠に頭をさげる。
　結局何もなかったけど、女の子を自分の部屋に連れこんで一緒に眠ってしまったのは事実なんだ。
　翡翠がなんて言おうと、ここはやっぱり俺に責任があると思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A-anyway, let’s keep this between us. Akiha would be furious, and there’s no telling how badly Kohaku would tease us.”
“Yes. If you are willing to overlook it, Master Shiki, that would be a great relief to me as well.”
“I’m sorry, Hisui. If I’d kept my wits about me, none of this would have happened.”
I bow my head and apologize.
Nothing happened in the end, but I did bring a girl into my room and fall asleep beside her.
Whatever Hisui may say, the responsibility is mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A, anyway, let's just keep this a secret between us.
If Akiha knew about it, she'd get angry, and if Kohaku-san knew about it, she'd just tease us about it relentlessly."
"---Yes.
If Shiki-sama will allow it, then it will help me as well."
"Yeah, sorry Hisui.
If I was more responsible, this thing would never have happened."
I say sorry and bow my head to her.
Nothing did happen, but it's still a fact that I carried a girl to my room and slept next to her.
No matter what Hisui says, I think I'm responsible.

entries.japanese:
「いえ、わたしのほうこそ、もっとしっかりしていれば志貴さまのお手を煩わせる事などなかったはずですから」
「いいの！
　とにかく謝らせてほしいだけだから。
……まあ、できるなら『志貴さまのばかっ』ってはたかれたほうがスッキリするんだけど、どうあったって翡翠はそんなことしてくれないだろうしさ」
「あ……はい。
そのようなことを、命じられても困ります」
「だろ？
　それなら、せめて素直に謝られてくれ。
そうしてくれないと、俺はこれから翡翠に何も頼れなくなるから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No—had I kept my own wits, Master Shiki would never have had to trouble himself on my account.”
“Never mind that—I just need you to let me apologize. Honestly, I’d feel better if you slapped me and said, ‘Master Shiki, you idiot!’ but you’d never do anything like that, no matter what I asked.”
“Ah, yes. I would be at a loss even if you ordered me to do such a thing.”
“Exactly. So at least let me apologize without arguing. If you won’t, I’ll never be able to ask anything of you again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Not at all, it is my fault.
If I was more responsible, then you would never have had to worry about any of this, Shiki-sama."
"No, it's okay.
Anyway, I just want to apologize.
…… I'd actually feel better if you say something like 'Shiki-sama is a jerk.' You have every right to, although I don't think you'd say something like that."
"Ah… Yes.
That kind of order, would be very troubling."
"Wouldn't it?
So let me apologize.
If you don't let me, then I will never trust you with anything again."

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　翡翠はまた黙り込んで、じっと俺を見つめてくる。
「……本当に不器用なんですね、志貴さまは」
　今までとは違う、ひどく優しい声で、翡翠はぽつりと呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
Hisui falls silent again and studies me.
“You really are awkward, aren’t you, Master Shiki?”
Her murmur is gentler than anything I have ever heard from her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Hisui just stares at me, deep in thought.
"…… Shiki-sama is… really clumsy, are you not?"
Hisui says this in an awfully kind voice, different from before.

entries.japanese:
「では、今回のことは志貴さまが悪いという事にさせていただきます。
いつか償いをしていただきますので、その時まで忘れないでいてください」
「え―――ひす、い？」
「それでは失礼します。
志貴さまも早く居間のほうに行かれないと遅刻してしまいます」
　ちゃんとおじぎをして翡翠は退室していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well—we shall consider this entirely Master Shiki’s fault. One day I will ask him to make amends, so please do not forget before then.”
“Hi—Hisui?”
“Now, if you’ll excuse me. You should hurry to the sitting room as well, Master Shiki, or you will be late.”
Hisui bows formally and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I'll say Shiki-sama is at fault this time.
I will have to let you make up for this sometime, so please do not forget."
"Eh-----Hisu,i?"
"If you will please excuse me.
Shiki-sama, please hurry to the sitting room or you will be late."
Hisui gives a perfect bow and exits the room.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　俺はというと、ぽかんと口をあけたままでまだベッドの上にいたりする。
「…………わらった」
　それだけの事なのに、時間が止まったみたいに感じられてる。
「―――――――」
　まずい。
なんだか、すごくまずい。
　ただ笑いかけられただけだっていうのに、どうしてこうも、俺はぼんやりとしてしまっているんだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“————”
I remain on the bed, mouth hanging open.
“—She smiled.”
That is all she did, yet it feels as though time itself has stopped.
“————”
This is bad. Somehow, this is very bad.
She only smiled at me—so why has it left me in such a daze—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I just remained there on my bed, mouth open and in stunned silence.
"……… She smiled."
For that instant, it seemed like time itself had stopped.
"-------"
This isn't good.
This is really not good.
All she did was smile, but why am I so stunned---?

entries.japanese:
居間に行くと、すでに翡翠の姿があった。
　秋葉はすでに朝食を済ませて紅茶を飲んでいるし、琥珀さんは台所にいるらしい。
「おはよう兄さん。
今朝はいくらか早いんですね」
「ん？
　ああ、今朝はちょっとしたトラブル……」
　言いかけて、ちらりと翡翠の顔を盗み見る。
「いや、まあ鬼の霍乱ってヤツで早起きしただけ。
そういう秋葉もすごいじゃないか。
昨日あれだけ酔ってたのに、こんなに早く起きてくるなんて」
entries.maoEnglish:
When I reach the sitting room, Hisui is already there.
Akiha has finished breakfast and is drinking tea, while Kohaku appears to be in the kitchen.
“Good morning, Brother. You’re rather early today.”
“Hm? Oh, there was a little trouble this morning…” I stop and steal a glance at Hisui.
“No, nothing—call it a blue moon. You’re the impressive one, Akiha. After getting that drunk last night, I can’t believe you’re up already.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go to the sitting room and see Hisui standing there.
Akiha has already eaten breakfast and is drinking tea, and it seems that Kohaku-san is in the kitchen.
"Good morning, Nii-san.
You're up very early this morning, aren't you?"
"Hm?
Ah, this morning there was a little trouble…" I stop short and steal a glance at Hisui's face.
"Well, I just happened to wake up early today.
But you're pretty impressive too, Akiha.
To still wake up this early as drunk as you were yesterday."

entries.japanese:
「当然です。
お酒は翌日のことをきちんと踏まえて楽しむものですから、お酒のせいで寝坊するなんていうのはありえません」
「ふーん。
そのわりには昨日はへべれけだったけどな。
もしかすると秋葉は人より分解酵素が多いのかもしれない。
だとしたら羨ましい話だけど」
「……兄さん、なんですかその分解酵素って」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Naturally, one drinks with the following day firmly in mind. Oversleeping because of alcohol is simply unacceptable.”
“Really? You were completely plastered last night. Maybe you have more alcohol-processing enzymes than most people. If so, I envy you.”
“Brother, what are these alcohol-processing enzymes?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Of course.
You should always drink considering the next day, so there is no reason to oversleep because of it."
"Really.
But you were pretty hammered last night.
Maybe you have more breakdown enzymes than a normal person, Akiha.
If that's so, I'm a little jealous."
"Nii-san, what are these, 'breakdown enzymes'?"

entries.japanese:
「いや、ちょっとした話だよ。
アルコールは体内に入るとアセトなんとかっていう猛毒に変わるらしいんだ。
　で、そうなるとまずいんで肝臓内でその猛毒を分解する酵素っていうのが分泌されて、アルコールをただの水に分解するんだってさ。
　分解酵素の量は人種差があるらしいんだけどね、日本人は比較的少ないんだって。
その酵素が少ない人のことを下戸って言うんだ」
　へえ、と秋葉は感心したように目を丸くする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s nothing complicated. Apparently, once alcohol enters the body, it turns into some highly toxic substance called aceto-something.
Since that would be bad, the liver produces enzymes that break the poison down and eventually turn the alcohol into plain water.
Different ethnic groups supposedly produce different amounts, and Japanese people tend to have relatively little. People who don’t produce much are what you’d call lightweights.”
Akiha’s eyes widen with interest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I'll make it short.
After alcohol enters the body, I guess it changes to some kind of poison.
The poison is processed by the liver by these enzymes that break down the alcohol into water.
The amount of enzymes in each person is different, and Japanese people tend to have less than others.
You can say those that have less enzymes have to moderate a little."
Akiha looks impressed.

entries.japanese:
「……驚いたわ。
よくそんなこと知ってますね、兄さん」
「いや、べつに。
友人で質の悪い酒飲みがいるだけだから」
「ふうん。
そのわりには昨夜はあまりお飲みになられていなかったようですけど？」
「だから、俺はその下戸ってヤツなんだってば。
酒は気合で呑むものだー、なんていう悪友をね、論理的に改心させるにはこうゆうふうに苦労しないといけなくてさ」
　ちなみに、その悪友とは乾有彦に他ならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m astonished. How did you learn all that, Brother?”
“It’s nothing. I just happen to have a friend who’s a particularly obnoxious drunk.”
“Is that so? Yet you hardly seemed to drink anything last night.”
“That’s because I’m one of those lightweights. When your idiot friend insists that drinking is all about willpower, this is the kind of research it takes to argue him out of it.”
The idiot friend in question is, of course, Arihiko Inui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I am a little surprised.
You seem to know quite a bit, Nii-san."
"No, not really.
I just have a bad friend that drinks a lot, that's all."
"Is that so.
It seems like you were not drinking that much last night though…"
"That's because I'm one of those people that have to moderate.
Since my bad friend simply downs his drinks, I have to always stay sober to take care of him."
By the way, this bad friend I'm talking about is no other than Inui Arihiko.

entries.japanese:
「……はあ。
よくわかりませんけど、兄さんの私生活はなんだか楽しそうですね」
「なんだよいきなり。
どうしていきなりそういう話になるんだ」
「兄さんの顔、すごく楽しそうでしたから。
昨日だってそんな顔していなかったじゃないですか」
「う―――」
　そりゃあたしかに昨日は楽しむっていうより呆れてたんだけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. I don’t entirely follow, but your life away from home sounds rather enjoyable.”
“Where did that come from? How did we suddenly get onto my private life?”
“You looked as though you were having a wonderful time. You certainly didn’t look that way last night.”
“Urk—”
True, last night I had been more appalled than amused.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm.
I don't really understand it, but it seems like your private life is very fun indeed."
"Why that all of a sudden?
Why do you bring that up?"
"Nii-san, your face seemed so happy just now.
You didn't show that face last night."
"Uh---"
Well, it is true that last night was more surprising than it was fun.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さーん、朝ごはんできましたよー」
　と、いいタイミングで琥珀さんが声をかけてくれた。
「あ、すぐにいただきますー！
　……んじゃ、そーゆー事なんでまたな、秋葉」
「…………………」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, breakfast is ready!”
Kohaku calls at precisely the right moment.
“I’ll be right there! Well—you heard her; see you later, Akiha.”
“…………”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, breakfast is ready!"
With excellent timing, Kohaku-san's voice cuts in.
"Ah, I'll be right there!
…… Well, I gotta go, Akiha."
"………"

entries.japanese:
朝食を終えて居間に戻ると、秋葉の姿はすでになかった。
「あれ……？
　翡翠、秋葉は？」
「秋葉さまでしたら、志貴さまが食堂に行かれたあとすぐに学校に行かれました」
「そっか、秋葉の学校って遠いんだっけ。
……っと、俺ものんびりしてる場合じゃないか」
「はい、鞄を持ってまいります」
　翡翠はパタパタと足音をたててロビーへと消えていく。
「……………」
　その後ろ姿をぼんやりと眺めていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
By the time I finish breakfast and return to the sitting room, Akiha is gone.
“Huh…? Hisui, where’s Akiha?”
“Miss Akiha left for school immediately after you went into the dining room, Master Shiki.”
“Right, her school is quite a distance away. Wait—I can’t afford to dawdle either.”
“Certainly—I will fetch your schoolbag.”
Hisui hurries away toward the entrance hall, her footsteps pattering over the floor.
“…………”
I find myself staring dreamily after her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After finishing breakfast, I head to the sitting room to find Akiha gone.
"Huh…?
Hisui, where is Akiha?"
"Akiha-sama left for school right after you went to the dining room, Shiki-sama."
"Oh yeah, Akiha's school is far, isn't it?
…… Well, I shouldn't be standing around either."
"Yes, I will bring you your bag right away."
Hisui disappears towards the lobby.
"…………"
I stare listlessly behind her.

entries.japanese:
「ふーん。
志貴さん、昨夜なんかあったんですか？」
「なっ―――いきなり出てきてなんて事言い出すんですか、琥珀さんっ！」
「あら、照れてるところをみるとやっぱりなにかあったんですね」
「え―――いや、なんにもなかったですよ。
なんなら翡翠に聞いてみても、いいです」
「そうなんですか？
　なんか、翡翠ちゃんと仲がよくなってる気がしたんですけど」
　はて、と首をかしげる琥珀さん。
　……翡翠と仲がよくなったかなんて、そんなのはこっちが聞きたいぐらいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, well. Did something happen last night, Shiki?”
“Wha—don’t just appear out of nowhere and say things like that, Kohaku!”
“Oh my—judging by that blush, something did happen.”
“No—nothing happened. You can ask Hisui yourself, if you like.”
“Really? I could have sworn you and Hisui seemed closer than before.”
Kohaku tilts her head, puzzled.
Whether Hisui and I have grown closer is something I would like to know myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hee hee.
Shiki-san, what happened last night?"
"Wha… what do you mean, Kohaku-san!?"
"Oh my, I see you're blushing.
Something must have happened, didn't it?"
"Eh---no, nothing happened at all.
Go ahead, ask Hisui."
"Is that so?
It seems like you have become pretty good friends with Hisui-chan."
Kohaku-san tilts her head to the side.
…… I became good friends with Hisui?
That's something I'd like to hear about myself.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、鞄をお持ちいたしました。
そろそろ屋敷を出ないと時間的に余裕がありません」
「ああ、いま行くよ。
それじゃ琥珀さん、また夕方」
「ええ、それではいってらっしゃいませ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I have brought your schoolbag. If you do not leave the mansion soon, you will have very little time to spare.”
“Right, I’m coming. See you this evening, Kohaku.”
“Of course—have a pleasant day.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, I have your bag ready.
Please get ready to leave the mansion as you do not have much time left."
"Yeah, I'm coming.
Later, Kohaku-san, see you this evening."
"Yes, I look forward to it."

entries.japanese:
「今日はまっすぐ帰ってくるから、帰りは四時ごろになるよ。
あ、それとここで出迎える、なんて事はしなくていいから」
「かしこまりました。
それでは志貴さま、どうかお気をつけて」
「ありがとう。
それじゃ行ってくるよ、翡翠」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをしてくれる翡翠に手をふって、坂道へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m coming straight home today, so I should be back around four. Oh, and you don’t need to stand here waiting to greet me.”
“Understood. Please take care on your way, Master Shiki.”
“Thanks. I’m off, Hisui.”
I wave to Hisui as she bows deeply, then race off down the hill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'll come right back today, so I'll be back around four o'clock.
Oh, and you don't have to wait here."
"I understand.
Please be careful on your way, Shiki-sama."
"Thanks.
I'll be going now, Hisui."
Waving a hand to the bowing Hisui, I dash down the street.

entries.japanese:
―――目の前では酒盛りが続いている。
　一体どこでどう間違ったのか、遠野志貴の歓迎会は身内での酒宴に変わってしまったらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The drinking continues before my eyes.
Somewhere along the way, Shiki Tohno’s welcome party has apparently turned into a private family drinking session.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The drinking continues.
I don't know how this happened, but it looks like the "Tohno Shiki Welcome Party" has turned into just a drinking party.

entries.japanese:
普段からアルコールに慣れているのか、秋葉はすました顔でグラスをあおっていく。
その勢いたるや、水を飲むが如しだ。
　琥珀さんはそんな秋葉に酌をしながら、秋葉の付き合いでゆっくりと飲んでいる。
　二人とも外見上に変化がないところを見ると、あまり顔に出ない性質らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps she drinks regularly, because Akiha tosses back glass after glass without disturbing her composure. She might as well be drinking water.
Kohaku keeps her glass filled and drinks at a leisurely pace alongside her.
Neither looks any different, so apparently neither of them shows it when she drinks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha might be used to drinking, as she gulps down her glass as if she's drinking water.
Kohaku-san slowly drinks with Akiha while refilling Akiha's cup.
Seeing that their faces still look normal, I'm guessing they don't show drunkenness on their faces.

entries.japanese: ……ちなみに、翡翠はお酒を一口飲んだ後、ふらふらとソファーに座りこんで、そのままうつらうつらとしていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish: Hisui, meanwhile, took a single sip, tottered over to the sofa, and has been nodding off there ever since.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Incidentally, Hisui sits on the couch dizzily after drinking just one sip.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉のヤツ、ざるだな」
　笑顔で盛りあがっている秋葉と琥珀さんを眺めながらグラスをあおる。
　中はただの水で、俺は乾杯の時に交わした一口しかアルコールを摂っていない。
　ひょい、とテーブルにもられたスモークサーモンを口に運ぶ。
……美味である。
やるな遠野家、酒のつまみも一級品だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha can really hold her liquor…”
I raise my glass while watching Akiha and Kohaku laugh together.
Mine contains nothing but water; the toast was my first and only sip of alcohol.
I pluck a piece of smoked salmon from the table and pop it into my mouth. Delicious. The Tohnos do nothing by halves—even their drinking snacks are first-rate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha really has quite a lot of tolerance."
Looking at the smiling Akiha and Kohaku-san, I gulp down my glass.
It is just water, as I only drank a mouthful of alcohol during the toast.
I take a bite of the smoked salmon on the table.
It is exquisite.
In the Tohno house, even the snacks are first class.

entries.japanese:
「………………うむ」
　なにか、色々と問題はあるような気がするけど、これはこれで楽しいのかもしれない。
　秋葉と琥珀さんの会話は、はっきりいってつまらない。
太陽が東から昇って西に沈む、といった当たり前の話しかしていない。
　だっていうのにそのつまらない話で楽しそうに笑い合っているあたり、見ていて微笑ましいものがあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm.”
This gathering may have all sorts of problems, but maybe I’m enjoying it anyway.
Frankly, Akiha and Kohaku’s conversation is dull. They are discussing facts as obvious as the sun rising in the east and setting in the west.
Yet the sight of them laughing so happily over such dreary subjects is strangely heartwarming.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Mmm."
Even though there might be a lot of problems, it is pretty enjoyable right now.
To be blunt, Akiha and Kohaku-san's conversation is outright boring.
It's as if they were just discussing how the sun rises in the East and sets in the West.
Despite that, it all seems rather charming seeing them laughing at those kinds of conversations.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　一方、翡翠は乾杯の時に使ったグラスを大事に持ったまま、ぽーっとしていた。
　少し目を離してたから翡翠を見ると、少しだけグラスの中身が減っている。
……アレはアレで、楽しんでいるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
Hisui still cradles the glass from the toast as though it were precious, gazing dreamily into space.
Whenever I look away and back again, the level inside has fallen by the slightest amount. It seems she is enjoying herself after her own fashion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
On the other hand, Hisui is holding the glass she used during the toast and gazing vacantly.
Whenever I look away from Hisui, the glass becomes a little more empty.
…… She seems to be enjoying herself, too.

entries.japanese:
ひょい、とまたも酒のつまみを口に運ぶ。
　アルコールは苦手なくせに、こういった小料理は割合好きだ。
　……と。
「…………？」
　どうしたんだろう。
　いつのまにか、秋葉がむこうのソファーから立ち上がって、俺の目の前に立っていたりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
I help myself to another snack.
I may dislike alcohol, but I am rather fond of the little dishes served with it.
Then.
“……?”
What is it now?
At some point Akiha has left the sofa across the room and come to stand directly in front of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I sneak another bite of food.
I'm pretty weak against alcohol, so I prefer to eat the finger food instead.
…… And.
"…………?"
What happened?
Akiha stands up and walks over to me.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
さっきから食べてばっかりで、お酒が進んでいないようですけど」
　何が気に食わないのか、秋葉はむっ、と瞳を細めて睨んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. You’ve done nothing but eat, and you hardly seem to be drinking at all.”
Whatever has displeased her, Akiha narrows her eyes and glares at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
You've only been eating, you aren't going to drink any?"
Akiha looks at me a little dissatisfied.

entries.japanese:
「……あのな。
おまえが酔う分にはかまわないけど、人を自分のペースに巻き込むのはやめたほうがいいぞ。
もともと俺は酒は苦手なんだから、飲み合いっこがしたいんなら琥珀さんと――――」
　琥珀さんを指差そうとして、指が止まった。
　琥珀さんの姿がない。
どうも、お酒を調達しに厨房まで引っ込んでしまったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen. I don’t care if you get drunk, but don’t drag other people along at your pace. I’ve never been good with alcohol, so if you want a drinking companion, ask Kohaku—”
I lift a finger to point at her, then stop.
Kohaku is gone. Apparently she has gone back to the kitchen to find more alcohol.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Now look, I don't care if you get drunk, but you shouldn't try to make others drink at your pace.
I'm not used to drinking a lot, so if you want to drink with someone, Kohaku-san can-----"
I try to point over to Kohaku-san, but…
She isn't there.
It seems like she went to get some more alcohol from the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
「失礼ですね。
私、これっぽっちも酔ってなんかいませんわ」
　グラスを片手に、ぐいっと身を乗り出してくる秋葉。
「……そっか。
琥珀さんが居なくなったから……」
　クダを巻く相手がいなくなって、俺にちょっかいを出しにきたというコトか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How rude. I am not the least bit drunk.”
Glass in hand, Akiha leans aggressively toward me.
“Oh, I see. Kohaku left…”
So she lost the person she had been drunkenly haranguing and came to bother me instead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well excuuuse me!
I'm not the slightest bit drunk."
Raising her glass with one hand, Akiha leans forward.
"…… I see.
Since Kohaku-san isn't here……"
I guess she's messing with me since she has no one to talk to.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀は関係ないでしょう。
今はどうして兄さんがお酒を飲んでくださらないか、という話をしている筈ですっ」
「……いや、別に酒ならさっきから飲んでるけど」
「嘘ですっ。
私、まだ一度もお酌をしていないじゃないですか。
　私、兄さんがくつろげるようにと積極的にお酒を飲んでいるんです。
なのに兄さんったらさっきからぱくぱくぱくぱくと琥珀の作ったものにばかり箸をつけて、一向にグラスを空にしてくれないじゃないですかっ」
　むむむー、と顔をしかめて俺を見下ろしてくる秋葉。
　気のせいか、秋葉の足元はおぼつかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku has nothing to do with this. We are discussing why you refuse to drink with me!”
“I’ve been drinking all this time.”
“That’s a lie! I haven’t poured you a single glass yet.
I’ve been drinking so eagerly just to help you relax, and all you have done is nibble and nibble and nibble at Kohaku’s cooking. You haven’t emptied your glass once!”
Akiha screws up her face and glares down at me.
Unless I am imagining it, she is none too steady on her feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku doesn't have anything to do with this.
We are talking about why you are not drinking."
"…… Well, I have been drinking…"
"That's a lie.
I, haven't had a chance to pour you anything.
I was drinking so that you could relax, but all you have been doing is munching away at the food Kohaku made.
You haven't even had one glass, right?"
Akiha pouts.
Is it just me or is her step a little unsteady?

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
一つ聞くけど、酔ってる？」
「とんでもありません。
私、酔ってなんかいないもの。
だって秋葉は、兄さんが泥酔してくださるまではずっと正気でいるんだからっ」
「……泥酔ってな、おまえ」
「いいから、早くグラスを空にしなさい。
話があるのならその後に聞いてあげます」
　びっ、と俺のグラスを指差す秋葉。
　ふらふらと揺れている人差し指が、ちょっとだけ心もとない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, one question. Are you drunk?”
“Of course not. I’m not drunk at all. Akiha is going to stay perfectly sober until you’re completely plastered, Brother!”
“Completely plastered, huh…”
“Never mind that—empty your glass at once. If you have something to say, I will hear it afterward.”
Akiha stabs a finger toward my glass.
The finger sways unsteadily through the air, which does little for her authority.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, I just have to ask, are you drunk?"
"Don't be ridiculous.
I'm not drunk at all.
You will be dead drunk long before I will."
"…… You are dead drunk."
"Hurry up and finish your glass.
I will listen to whatever you have to say when you are done."
She points commandingly at my glass.
Except her finger is wobbling all over.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉。
重ねて言うけど、おまえは酔ってる」
「もうっ――――！
　しつこいですね、酔ってないって言ってるでしょう！」
　怒鳴って、くらりと秋葉はよろめいた。
　……自分の声で眩暈を起こすなんて、やっぱり酔っている証拠じゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha, I’ll say it again. You are drunk.”
“Oh, honestly! How many times must I tell you that I’m not drunk?”
She shouts—and promptly reels.
If the sound of her own voice is enough to make her dizzy, surely that proves my point.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha, I've said this before, but you really are drunk."
"Sheesh----!
You really are persistent.
I told you I'm not drunk!"
Akiha yells and wobbles back.
…… Her own voice causes her to get dizzy, so what part of that isn't being drunk?

entries.japanese:
「……しょうがないな。
ほら、立ってないで座りなさい。
話があるんならちゃんと聞くから」
　ぽんぽん、と隣のソファーを叩く。
「あ……はい、座ります」
　ちょこん、とソファーに座る秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re hopeless. Come on, don’t just stand there—sit down. If there’s something you want to discuss, I promise I’ll listen.”
I pat the sofa beside me.
“Oh, yes—I’ll sit.”
Akiha perches primly on the sofa.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh well.
Have a seat, we can chat a bit, I suppose."
I pat the sofa next to me.
"Ah…… yes, I'll sit."
Akiha sits down on the sofa.

entries.japanese:
さっきまでの威勢はどこにいったのか、隣に座った途端、秋葉は大人しくなってしまった。
「…………………………」
「…………………………」
　なぜか、唐突に気まずくなる。
「………………ん」
　所在ないので、仕方なくグラスを手に取った。
　ぐい、と軽くグラスをあおる。
　慣れないアルコールは喉に熱くて、あまり美味いとは感じられない。
　ただ貧血の眩暈に似た、地面が低くなるような感覚があるだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The instant she sits beside me, all her earlier bluster vanishes and she becomes meek and quiet.
“…………”
“…………”
For no reason, the silence abruptly turns awkward.
“Mmh.”
At a loss for anything else to do, I pick up my glass.
I take a small swallow.
The unfamiliar alcohol burns my throat; it does not taste especially good.
All it gives me is something like a dizzy spell brought on by anemia, as though the ground has suddenly dropped away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't know where all her bossiness disappeared to, but she just meekly sits down.
"…………………………"
"…………………………"
For some reason, I suddenly don't feel comfortable.
"……………… Hmm."
Resigned, I pick up my glass.
I take a light gulp.
The unfamiliar alcohol burns my throat; it doesn't taste good at all.
I feel the ground dip beneath me, as if I was feeling dizzy from my anemia.

entries.japanese:
「……………………」
　まあ、それでも気持ち悪いというものじゃない。
　ここまで飲んだのならいっそ全部飲んでしまえ、と一気にグラスを空にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
Still, it is not exactly unpleasant.
Having come this far, I decide I may as well finish it and drain the glass in one go.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
But, I can't say that this feels bad, either.
I might as well just finish it off, so I down the rest of it.

entries.japanese:
「……呆れた。
さっきまで何か囀っていたようですけど、結局はお酒好きのようですね、兄さんは」
「むっ。
なんだよそれ、別に俺は酒好きってわけじゃないぞ」
「そんなわけないでしょう。
あんなに美味しそうに飲んでいらしたクセに、弁解はしないでください」
　秋葉は身を乗り出してテーブルの上にあるボトルを取った。
「お湯で割りますけど、他に希望はありますか？」
　勝手に人のグラスにウイスキーを注ぐ秋葉。
　常識的には止めるべきだ。
　けどやけに秋葉が嬉しそうなんで、このさい常識とか道徳はうっちゃっておくべきだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good grief. You were chirping all sorts of objections a moment ago, but it seems you do like alcohol after all, Brother.”
“Hey—what’s that supposed to mean? I’m not some great lover of drink.”
“Of course you are. You looked as though you were enjoying it immensely, so please spare me the excuses.”
Akiha leans across the table and picks up a bottle.
“I’ll dilute it with hot water—do you have any other requests?”
Without waiting for an answer, Akiha begins pouring whisky into my glass.
Common sense says I ought to stop her.
But she looks absurdly pleased with herself, so perhaps this is the moment to cast common sense and morality aside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm surprised.
You may have said differently before, but you sure seem to like drinking, Nii-san."
"What do you mean?
I'm not a big drinker or anything."
"It doesn't look like it.
You were drinking that rather happily."
Akiha leans over and takes a bottle from the table.
"I'll water it down, but do you have any other preferences?"
Akiha pours me some whiskey without asking.
Common sense demands that I stop her.
But she seems so happy, I throw aside any thoughts of common sense.

entries.japanese:
「……思いっきり薄めにしてくれ。
そうしたら飲んでもいい」
「はい、解りました。
とりあえず始めはこれで許してあげます」
　やっぱり嬉しげな顔で秋葉は酒をグラスに注ぐ。
「…………ったく。
有彦と飲む時だって深酒はしないっていうのに」
　グラスを持って、ソファーに体を預ける。
そのまま天井を見上げるようにグラスを仰いだ。
　ゆっくりと、それでもグラスを唇から離さず、秋葉が注いでくれた酒を飲み干す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Make it extremely weak. Do that and I’ll drink it.”
“Certainly. I shall be merciful for the first glass.”
Still looking delighted, Akiha fills it.
“Honestly… I don’t drink heavily even when I’m with Arihiko.”
I take the glass and sink back into the sofa. Then I tip my face toward the ceiling.
Slowly, but without once lowering it from my lips, I finish everything Akiha poured for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please water it down a lot.
Otherwise, I won't be able to drink it."
"As you say.
Well, then let's start, shall we?"
Akiha happily fills my glass.
"………… Man, I don't even drink this much when I'm with Arihiko."
I lean back on the sofa.
I down the glass with my neck tilted so far back that I can see the ceiling.
I drink what Akiha poured me slowly without letting my mouth go from the glass.

entries.japanese:
「―――ふう。
これで満足ですか、お嬢様」
　空になったグラスをテーブルに置く。
「ええ、気持ちのいい飲み方だったわ。
勢いがなかったのは減点だけど、おおむね合格かな」
「厳しいな。
今のは自己新だったんだぞ。
秋葉が飲めっていうから、精一杯背伸びしたつもりなんだけど」
「そうなの？
　珍しいな、兄さんが私に付き合ってくれるなんて」
　くすり、と笑って。
　秋葉は自分で酒を注いで、ぐい、と一気に飲み干した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Phew. Satisfied now, my lady?”
I set the empty glass on the table.
“Yes, that was pleasant to watch. You lose points for lacking momentum, but overall I’ll give you a passing mark.”
“Harsh. That was a personal record. You told me to drink, so I pushed myself as hard as I could.”
“Did you? How unusual for you to indulge me, Brother.”
Akiha gives a soft laugh.
Then she pours herself another drink and downs it in one swallow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Phew.
Well, are you satisfied, princess?"
I place the empty glass on the table.
"That's the way to do it.
I have to take points off for not drinking it fast, but it's still a passing grade."
"You're pretty strict.
That was my new record, you know.
You told me to drink it, so I pushed myself."
"Really?
This is pretty rare, you keeping me company like this, Nii-san."
She chuckles.
Pouring herself another glass, she downs it.

entries.japanese:
―――――その横顔に、どきりとした。
　グラスをあおる秋葉の横顔は、ひどく大人びて見えた。
　瞼を閉じて顔をあげる。
　ごくり、とアルコールを嚥下する白い喉はそれだけで艶めかしくて、つい酔っている事を忘れてしまう。
「―――――はあ」
　と、深く息をつく秋葉。
グラスは空になっている。
　……おいしい、とため息めいた呟きがした。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――The sight of her profile makes my heart skip.
With the glass raised to her lips, Akiha looks startlingly mature.
Her eyes close and her chin lifts.
Her pale throat moves as she swallows, a gesture so sensuous that I forget for a moment how drunk she is.
“Haa…”
Akiha releases a deep breath. Her glass is empty.
I hear her murmur, almost like a sigh, “Delicious.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----My heart beats loudly at the sight of her face.
She looks so mature when she is drinking.
She closes her eyes and tilts her head back.
Seeing her white throat voluptuously gulp down the alcohol, I forget about being drunk.
"-----Aaah."
Akiha lets out a deep breath.
The glass is empty.
…… She says under her breath something to the effect that it is delicious.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
「？
　どうしました兄さん。
私の顔になにかついてるんですか？」
「あ――――いや、別にそういうわけじゃない」
　言って、意味もなくグラスを手に取った。
「はい、次ですね。
今度はもうちょっと、アルコールの分量を増やしましょう」
　秋葉はまたもグラスに酒を注いでくる。
　……別に酒が飲みたくてグラスを手にとった訳ではなかったが、まあ、これも悪くはないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
“Hm? What is it, Brother? Is there something on my face?”
“Ah—no, it’s nothing like that.”
As I answer, I pick up my glass for no reason at all.
“Ready for another, then. This time we shall increase the proportion of alcohol.”
Once again, Akiha pours into my glass.
I had not picked it up because I wanted another drink, but perhaps this is not so bad after all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
"?
What is it, Nii-san.
Is there something on my face?"
"Ah----nothing, it's nothing."
Without thinking, I pick up my glass.
"Another one?
This time, we'll have something a little bit stronger."
Akiha fills up the glasses again.
…… I didn't really want another glass, but I suppose it won't hurt.

entries.japanese:
「……………………ん」
　ぐい、と秋葉に倣って一息で酒を飲み干す。
　どうっていう事のないアルコール量だったが、一気に飲んだのがいけなかったのか。
　頭が唐突にぐらん、としてソファーに大きく倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmh.”
Following Akiha’s example, I toss it back in one swallow.
It was not much alcohol, but perhaps drinking it so quickly was a mistake.
My head abruptly pitches sideways, and I collapse against the sofa.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………… Mmm."
Trying to imitate Akiha, I drink it all in one gulp.
It wasn't that much alcohol, but I shouldn't have drank it that fast.
My head starts to spin and I fall back on the sofa.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん―――？
　ちょっと、大丈夫ですか……！？」
「あー、大丈夫。
ちょっと回っただけで、酔ったわけじゃない。
しばらくこうしているから、俺の事はほっといて楽しんでくれ」
　ソファーに背中を預けて、ぼんやりと天井を見上げる。
　力を抜いてこうしているのが、ひどく気持ち良かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Are you all right?”
“Yeah, I’m fine. It just hit me for a second, but I’m not drunk. I’ll stay like this for a while, so forget about me and enjoy yourself.”
I rest my back against the sofa and stare hazily at the ceiling.
Letting every muscle go slack feels wonderful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san---?
Are, are you alright……!?"
"Ah, I'm fine.
I just got a little dizzy, but I'm not drunk.
I think I'll rest for a little bit.
You go ahead and have fun."
Laying back on the sofa, I stare aimlessly at the ceiling.
Even though I feel completely drained, I feel incredibly good.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめんなさい。
私、無理をさせてしまったんですね」
　しんみりとした秋葉の声。
「いや、無理だったけど気持ちはいいよ。
秋葉があんまりにも美味しそうに飲むから釣られたんだけど、結果オーライってところ。
　だから、秋葉はそのまま飲んでいてくれ。
俺も落ち着いたらまた付き合うよ」
「―――はい。
それじゃお言葉に甘えて、兄さんが落ち着くまで待たせてもらうわ」
　とくとく、という水の音。
　秋葉はダウンした俺の隣で、やっぱり美味しそうにグラスをあおっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry. I pushed you too hard, didn’t I?”
Akiha’s voice is subdued.
“It was hard, but I feel good—you looked as though you were enjoying every drop, and I let that carry me away. It worked out in the end.
Keep drinking, Akiha. Once I recover, I’ll join you again.”
“All right. Then I shall take you at your word and wait until you feel better.”
Liquid burbles into a glass.
Beside me, where I lie defeated, Akiha continues to drink with obvious delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm sorry.
I… forced you to drink too much."
Akiha's voice sounds very sad.
"No, maybe it was a little much, but it feels good.
I drank it because you drank it so deliciously.
I guess the result is alright though.
So, go ahead and keep drinking.
Once I settle down, I'll join you again."
"---Okay.
If you say so, I will wait until you are done."
I hear the sound of something pouring.
As expected, she pours another glass and drinks it.

entries.japanese:
「……………………」
　……不思議だ。
こんな事はどうという事はないのに、ひどく―――安らいでいく気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………”
Strange. Nothing remarkable is happening, yet I can feel myself relaxing completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………………"
…… That's odd.
This isn't anything much, but---I feel incredibly relaxed here.

entries.maoEnglish:
“All right.”
After a long rest, I push myself upright.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………………………………………………………………………………………………………… Alright!"
Taking a breath, I get up from the sofa.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　もう気分はよろしいんですか？」
「いいよ。
もう少しぐらい秋葉に付き合う」
　グラスを秋葉に向ける。
　秋葉は笑顔のままで酒を注いできて、それを今度はゆっくり、自分のペースで飲むことにする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? Are you feeling better already?”
“I’m fine. I’ll keep you company a little longer.”
I hold my glass out to her.
Still smiling, Akiha fills it, and this time I drink slowly, at my own pace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
Are you feeling better?"
"I'm fine.
I'll keep you company a little bit more."
I give her my glass.
Smiling, she pours me another drink.
This time, I decide to drink at my own pace.

entries.japanese:
……時間が流れていく。
　いつのまにか翡翠はソファーで眠っている。
　厨房に行った琥珀さんは一向に戻ってこない。
　居間で活動しているのは俺と秋葉の二人だけで、俺はアルコールが回ってきてあまりマトモに活動しているとは言えない状態になりつつある。
　それでも琥珀さんが戻ってくるまで、秋葉に付きあっていたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time drifts by.
At some point Hisui falls asleep on the sofa.
Kohaku has yet to return from the kitchen.
Akiha and I are the only two people in the sitting room still active, and with the alcohol spreading through me, I can barely call myself functional.
Even so, I want to stay with Akiha until Kohaku comes back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Time passes by.
Hisui has fallen asleep on the sofa.
Kohaku-san never did come back from the kitchen.
The only ones still moving about are me and Akiha, but I am pretty drunk, so I wouldn't necessarily call myself moving about.
But still, I want to keep Akiha company until Kohaku-san returns.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん。
今日は優しいんですね」
　不意に。
小声で、秋葉はそんな事を言った。
「――――え？
　優しいって、俺が？」
「ええ。
普段、兄さんは冷たい人ですから。
今日みたいに気を許してくれる事なんて滅多にないでしょう？」
「………………そう、かな。
自分ではよく解らないけど、俺は冷たい、のかな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…you’re being kind tonight.”
The words come suddenly. Akiha’s voice is low.
“What? Me, kind?”
“Yes. You are usually such a cold person. You almost never let your guard down with me the way you have tonight.”
“Am I? I’ve never thought about it—am I really cold?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san.
You are very kind today."
Akiha says this suddenly, in a small voice.
"-----Eh?
Kind?
Me?"
"Yes.
Normally, you are a very cold person.
Acting kind like this is very rare, isn't it?"
"……………… Really?
I don't really know, but maybe I am cold."

entries.japanese:
「……もう。
兄さんはご自分の性格がよく解っていないんですね。
貴方は優しい人だから、同時にとても冷たい人なんです。
　……だって、兄さんは誰にだって分け隔てなく接するでしょう？
　どんなに憎い人でも、どんなに好きな相手でも、遠野志貴の中では一番になる人がいない。
兄さんは誰だって好きになれるし、誰だって許してしまう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. You understand yourself so poorly, Brother. You are kind, and that is precisely why you are terribly cold.
You treat everyone exactly the same, don’t you? No matter how much you hate someone or how dearly you love them, no one ever comes first in Shiki Tohno’s heart. You can love anyone and forgive anyone.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh, Nii-san, you don't understand yourself very well.
You are a very kind person, but at the same time, you are very cold.
…… Because you make no distinction between people.
You don't have anyone that you like the most, no matter if you hate them or like them.
Nii-san, you like and forgive everyone."

entries.japanese:
「……けどそれは、一番になりたい者にとっては残酷だわ。
兄さんにとっては誰だって等価値にすぎない。
私も琥珀も翡翠も、みんな同じ所にいるだけ。
　それは優しい、という領域を逸しているのよ。
自分の死期を悟った老犬が黙って消えていくみたいに、兄さんは自分から何かを残そうとしてくれない。
　……昔からそんな所はあったけど、帰ってきてからの兄さんは、なんていうか……とても危うい匂いがして、不安になる」
　秋葉はうつむいたまま、そんな独り言を続ける。
　グラスは空。
酒は注がれず、ただ静かな声だけが響いている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But to anyone who longs to be first, that is cruel. Everyone has equal value to you. Kohaku, Hisui, and I all occupy the same place.
That goes beyond kindness. Like an old dog that knows it is going to die and slips away without a sound, you never try to leave any part of yourself behind.
You were always somewhat like that, but since you came home there has been something so precarious about you; it frightens me.”
Akiha continues her quiet monologue with her head bowed.
Her glass sits empty and unfilled. Only her subdued voice moves through the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But that is very cruel to the people who want to be closest to you.
For you, everyone is the same.
Me, Kohaku, Hisui… we are all the same for you.
That isn't kindness.
Like an old dog that knows its time of death is near, you simply don't want to leave anything behind.
…… You were like that back then, but now, how do you say it…… you seem very dangerous, and that makes me uneasy."
Downcast, Akiha continues to speak, almost as if she was thinking aloud.
Her glass is empty.
She doesn't fill it, and her quiet voice echoes in the air.

entries.japanese:
「……ねえ。
もしかすると兄さんはとても無関心な人で、本当はとても孤独な人なのかもしれないって、私―――そんな罵伽な事を、思ってしまうんです。
　兄さんの中には一番になれる人がいない。
もしかすると、遠い昔に一番だった人を失っているのかもしれない。
　昔の私は、それでも好いていてくれるのならいいって思ってた。
兄さんには一番に思える人がいないんだから、それでいいって。
　……けど今は、もう――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sometimes I wonder whether you are utterly indifferent—and whether, underneath it all, you are terribly lonely. I know it is a foolish thought, but I can’t help having it.
No one can come first in your heart. Perhaps you lost the person who once did, a very long time ago.
When I was little, I thought it was enough if you cared for me at all. Since there was no one you could place first, I told myself that was enough.
But now—”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hey.
I just thought that you were maybe inconsiderate and very lonely… I was just thinking something stupid like that.
There isn't anyone you hold dearest in your heart.
Maybe you lost that person a long time ago.
Back then, I thought that if you just liked me, that would be fine.
At least there wasn't anyone you liked the most, so that was good enough.
…… But now, it is----"

entries.japanese:
「お待たせしましたー！
　追加のお酒とお料理です」
　笑顔で琥珀さんが戻ってきた。
「あ……」
　秋葉は急に言葉を飲みこむと、はあ、とため息をついてグラスに酒を注ぐ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you for waiting! I’ve brought more drinks and food.”
Kohaku returns with a radiant smile.
“Ah…”
Akiha abruptly swallows the rest of her sentence and, with a sigh, pours herself another drink.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Thank you for waiting!
More food and more drink!"
With a smile, Kohaku-san returns.
"Ah……"
Akiha suddenly swallows her words, and with a sigh, pours herself more to drink.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、兄さんも飲んでくださいっ。
さっきから私ばっかり飲んでるじゃないですかっ」
　琥珀さんの持ってきたボトルを手に取って、秋葉はドクドクと俺のグラスに酒を注ぐ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on, Brother, you drink too. I’m the only one who’s had anything for ages!”
Akiha seizes the bottle Kohaku brought and sends liquor glugging into my glass.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Nii-san, please drink some more as well.
It's just me drinking now."
Taking the bottle that Kohaku-san brought, she pours some more drink into my glass.

entries.japanese:
「いや、もう限界だよ。
いつもの二倍近く飲んだんだから勘弁してくれないか。
これ以上飲んだら、本当に体を悪くする」
「なに言ってるのよ。
まだ一瓶も空けていないくせに限界なんて早すぎるわ。
ほら、今日はとことんまで付き合ってくれるって言ったじゃない」
　さあ、と秋葉はグラスを差し出してくる。
　が、こっちは本当にそろそろ限界なんだってば。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, I’ve reached my limit. I’ve had nearly twice as much as usual, so please let me stop. Any more really will make me ill.”
“Nonsense—we haven’t even emptied one bottle. It’s far too early to talk about limits. You promised to stay with me to the bitter end tonight.”
Akiha thrusts the glass toward me.
But I really am nearing my limit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, I've had enough.
I've had twice as much as normal, so please let me pass on this one.
If I do drink more, I really will end up in bad shape."
"What are you saying?
You haven't even had a bottle yet.
It's way too early to say you've had enough.
You said you'd drink with me, right?"
"Come on," she says and holds out my glass.
But, I really am at my limit.

entries.japanese:
「だめですよ秋葉さま。
秋葉さまみたいなザルと志貴さんを一緒にしないでください。
　ほら、志貴さんもはっきりお断りしないと大変ですよ。
秋葉さまはいくら飲んでも酔われないんですから、とことんまで付き合ったら夜が明けてしまいます」
「ちょっと琥珀！
　ザルってなによ、ザルって。
せめて酒仙とか酒豪とか、そういう言い方をしてくれない！？」
　むっ、と怒って、秋葉はぐいっと酒を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mustn’t do that, Miss Akiha. You can’t compare Shiki with a bottomless drinker like yourself, Miss Akiha.
And Shiki, you had better refuse her properly or you’ll be in terrible trouble. No amount of alcohol can make Miss Akiha drunk, so if you stay with her to the bitter end, dawn will find you still drinking.”
“Kohaku! What do you mean, ‘bottomless’? At least call me a legendary drinker or a champion!”
Scowling indignantly, Akiha tosses back another glass.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Now, now, Akiha-sama.
You do have to realize that Shiki-san does not have the same tolerance as you do, Akiha-sama.
Shiki-san, you should say no or you'll be in trouble.
Akiha-sama doesn't get drunk no matter how much she drinks, so if you keep drinking with her until she's happy, you'll end up drinking until dawn."
"Wait a minute, Kohaku!
You make me sound like some sort of an alcoholic!"
Angrily, Akiha takes another drink.

entries.japanese:
あれだけ飲んでいたのに、まるでこれが一杯目かのような勢いだ。
　……秋葉がなんて言おうが、琥珀さんの言葉に間違いはないと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
After everything she has already consumed, she still drinks as though this were her first glass.
Whatever Akiha says, Kohaku is right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though she drank a lot, it seems like that's her first glass.
…… No matter what Akiha says, Kohaku-san seems to be right.

entries.japanese:
「……悪い秋葉。
本当にこれ以上は付き合えないんだ。
俺が医者に過度のアルコール摂取を禁じられてるのは知ってるだろ？」
　うっ、とばつが悪そうに秋葉は黙り込む。
「……それは、そうだけど……」
「そんな顔するなよ。
秋葉が満足するまで一緒にいるから、それでいいだろ？」
「……………………」
　秋葉は納得のいかない顔のまま、こくん、と頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry, Akiha. I truly can’t drink any more. You know my doctor forbade me from consuming too much alcohol.”
Akiha winces and falls silent, looking chastened.
“I know, but—”
“Don’t make that face—I’ll stay here until you’ve had enough. That will do, won’t it?”
“…………”
Still plainly dissatisfied, Akiha gives a tiny nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry, Akiha.
I really have to stop now.
You know my doctor says I shouldn't drink too much, right?"
Akiha descends into an apologetic silence.
"…… That, is true……"
"Don't look so sad.
I can still keep you company until you're done drinking.
How's that?"
"………………"
She nods, but doesn't quite look satisfied.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ秋葉さまのお酌はわたしがしますね。
ほら秋葉さま、志貴さんが付き合ってくださるんですから、それでいいじゃないですか」
「そう、ね……確かに兄さんが付き合ってくれるなんて、滅多にない事だもの。
とりあえず今日はこれで勘弁してあげるわ」
　秋葉は琥珀さんにグラスを差し出す。
　琥珀さんは笑顔で秋葉にお酒を注いで、秋葉はちびちびと控えめに飲み始めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I shall keep Miss Akiha’s glass filled. There, Miss Akiha—Shiki has promised to stay with you, so surely that is enough.”
“I suppose so—it is rare enough for my brother to indulge me at all. For tonight, I shall let him off with this.”
Akiha offers her glass to Kohaku.
Kohaku fills it with a smile, and Akiha finally begins taking small, restrained sips.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, I will pour your drinks, Akiha-sama.
See, Shiki-san is still here, so isn't everything okay, Akiha-sama?"
"I, guess…… certainly having Nii-san keep me company is rare enough.
I will let it go this time."
Akiha holds out her glass to Kohaku-san.
Smiling, Kohaku-san serves Akiha another drink, who starts to sip it slowly.

entries.japanese:
時間が経過する。
　いつのまにか翡翠も目を覚ましていて、とりとめのない会話が流れた。
　アルコールのせいか会話の内容はよく覚えていない。
　ただ何の意味もない、温かい会話だった。
　そういったものに慣れていない自分は、柔らかい真綿に締められているような、不安定な居心地を味わっている。
　そのせいだろう。
　この時間がもう少し続いてくれればいいと思う反面、少し一人になりたい、と思ってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Time passes.
At some point Hisui wakes, and we drift into idle conversation.
Perhaps because of the alcohol, I remember little of what we say.
It is warm and utterly meaningless.
Unaccustomed to such warmth, I feel as if I am being gently smothered in cotton wool—a precarious, uneasy comfort.
Perhaps that is why.
Part of me wishes the evening would last a little longer, while another part longs to be alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It has gotten pretty late.
Hisui woke up eventually and we talked about unimportant things.
It's probably the fault of the alcohol, but I don't remember what we talked about at all.
Just meaningless, warm conversation.
Because I wasn't used to that kind of stuff, I settled into an insecure comfort, like hanging from a silken thread.
It's probably because of that.
On one hand, I thought it would be nice for this to continue, but on the other hand, I wanted a little time to myself.

entries.japanese:
不意に。
「……兄さん……？」
　と、秋葉が不安げな瞳で見上げてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then, without warning.
“Brother…?”
Akiha looks up at me, anxiety in her eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And all of a sudden.
"…… Nii-san……?"
Akiha, with eyes full of anxiety, looks up at me.

entries.japanese:
「どうした？
　気分が悪くなったのか、秋葉？」
「いえ……そうではないんです。
ただ、急に不安になって。
……ねえ兄さん。
兄さんは、もう何処へも行きませんよね？」
「いかないよ。
……そりゃあ先の事は解らないけど、今はここにいようって決めてるから」
　……そう、少なくとも学校を卒業するまではここにいるし、秋葉が一人でもやっていけるようになるまでは離れられない。
―――だが。
　それはいつかは出て行く、という意味でもある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What is it? Are you feeling sick, Akiha?”
“No, nothing like that. I only felt frightened all of a sudden. Listen, Brother. You aren’t going away again, are you?”
“I’m not. I can’t promise what the distant future will bring, but for now I’ve decided to stay here.”
At the very least, I will remain until I finish school, and I cannot leave until Akiha is able to stand on her own.
―――But.
That also means that, one day, I will leave.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What is it?
Are you feeling okay, Akiha?"
"No…… that's not it.
I just got uneasy all of a sudden.
…… Hey, Nii-san.
You won't go away again, will you?"
"No.
…… I don't know what will happen in the future, but I've decided to stay here for now."
…… At least until I've finished school, and until it seems that Akiha can manage by herself.
---But.
That would imply that I would leave sometime.

entries.japanese:
「やめて。
そんな言葉、聞きたくありません。
ここは兄さんの家なんですから、なにがあったってここで暮らしていけばいいじゃない」
　言って、秋葉は一気にグラスをあおいだ。
　……凛々しい横顔。
　不快な思いを一気に飲み干すように、秋葉はグラスを空にする。
　ぐびり、と動く白い喉。
　ほのかに赤くなった頬が、秋葉がかすかに酔っている事を示している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop—I don’t want to hear that. This is your home, Brother. Whatever happens, you can simply go on living here.”
With that, Akiha drains her glass.
Her profile is proud and resolute.
As though swallowing every bitter thought along with the liquor, she empties it in a single draft.
Her pale throat bobs.
The faint color in her cheeks is the only sign that the alcohol has touched her at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop, I don't want to hear those words.
This is your house, so no matter what happens, it is best for you to live here, right?"
After saying this, she downs her glass.
…… An amazing sight.
As if drinking down her uneasiness, she empties her glass.
Gulp, gulp.
Her cheeks are faintly flushed, showing that she has a buzz.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ……もう、どうして兄さんは、そうやっていつも私を不安にさせるんですか」
　酔っているのか、秋葉は焦点の定まってない瞳で俺を睨む。
――――――っ。
　それに。
　理由もなく、どくん、と心臓が高鳴った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Brother, why do you always have to frighten me like this?”
Whether from drink or emotion, Akiha glares at me through unfocused eyes.
――――――My breath catches.
And then.
For no reason I can name, my heart gives a violent thud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha sighs.
"…… Why do you always make me feel so uneasy, Nii-san?"
She must be drunk, as she stares at me blankly.
------.
Seeing that,
my heart starts to beat faster for no reason.

entries.japanese:
「……聞いてるんですか？
　兄さんさえいてくれれば、私はそれでいいんです。
だっていうのに、兄さんはいつもいつも…………」
　まっすぐに見つめてくる瞳。
　秋葉の頬が赤くて、その瞳がうるんでいる。
　それがなんだか――――ひどく、妖しかった。
　……俺の頭にもアルコールが回っているせいだろうか。
　秋葉は妹なのに、なんだか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you listening? As long as you stay with me, I need nothing else. And yet you always, always…”
Her eyes hold mine without wavering.
Her cheeks are flushed, her gaze wet and luminous.
Somehow, she looks dangerously alluring.
Perhaps the alcohol has gone to my head as well.
Akiha is my sister, and yet somehow—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Are you listening?
As long as you are here, I am fine, but you always, always…………"
Her eyes look straight ahead.
Her cheeks are red and her eyes are glazed.
This----all seems very erotic.

…… Maybe it's because I'm drunk as well.
She is my sister, so why----

entries.japanese:
「……………………あき、は」
「……ん……兄さん、私……なんか、ヘン……」
　ぼんやりと呟く声さえ、他人のようで。
　俺は、そのまま――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aki—ha.”
“Mm—Brother, I feel strange—”
Even her dazed murmur sounds as though it belongs to someone else.
And I begin to—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………… Aki, ha."
"…… N…… Nii-san, I…… feel, strange……"
She speaks aimlessly, as if she was someone else.
If this keeps up, I----

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま。
グラスが空ですから、お酒をおつぎしますね」
「あ……うん。
ありがとう、琥珀」
　琥珀さんからグラスを手渡しされて、秋葉はまたもぐいっと一気飲みをする。
―――――と。
　途端、秋葉は真面目な顔になってしまった。
「……秋葉？」
「……おかしいわね。
私、なんだか酔ったみたい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha, your glass is empty. Allow me to refill it.”
“Oh, yes. Thank you, Kohaku.”
Kohaku hands the glass back, and Akiha drains it in another single swallow.
―――――And then.
Akiha’s face abruptly turns grave.
“Akiha…?”
“How strange. I think I may be drunk.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama, your glass is empty.
I'll pour you some more, okay?"
"Ah…… yeah, thanks, Kohaku."
Kohaku-san pours her another drink, which she downs promptly.
-----And then.
All of a sudden, Akiha looks very serious.
"…… Akiha?"
"…… That's odd, I seem to be drunk."

entries.japanese:
秋葉はこめかみを指で押さえている。
「酔ったみたいって……おまえ、さっきまで酔ってたじゃないか」
「なに言ってるんですか。
私がお酒に酔ったら、まともに話ができるわけないじゃない」
　とん、と秋葉はグラスをテーブルに置く。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha presses two fingers to her temple.
“You think you’re drunk—you’ve been drunk this whole time.”
“Don’t be absurd. If alcohol had truly made me drunk, I could hardly be speaking coherently.”
She sets her glass down with a firm tap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She massages her temple with her fingers.
"Seem to be drunk?
…… You've been drunk for quite a while."
"What are you saying?
I'm drunk, so of course I won't make sense."
She places her glass on the table quickly.

entries.japanese:
「おかしいなぁ……このぐらい、まだ中頃にすぎないのに」
　言って。
　ばたん、と秋葉はこちらに倒れてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How strange—I’m only halfway to my usual limit.”
With that.
Akiha topples sideways onto me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's strange…… I just got started."
Saying that,
she collapses towards me.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ、ちよっと秋葉……！？
　おまえ、いきなりどうし――――」
　どうしたも何もない。
「………………おい」
　声をかけても反応はない。
　秋葉はスースーと、それはそれは幸せそうに眠っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“W-wait, Akiha! What happened all of a—”
There is no mystery to solve.
“Hey.”
She does not react when I call to her.
Akiha is fast asleep, breathing softly with an expression of perfect bliss.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H, hey, Akiha……!?
What are you----"
That is pretty obvious though.
"……………… Hey."
There is no response.
Her breathing tells me that she is happily asleep.

entries.japanese:
「あら、珍しいですね。
秋葉さまが酔ってしまうなんて何年振りでしょうか」
　クスクスと楽しそうに笑う琥珀さん。
「……琥珀さん。
秋葉が酔ってるって、どういう事？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“My, how unusual. How many years has it been since Miss Akiha drank herself to sleep?”
Kohaku giggles in delight.
“Kohaku…what do you mean, drank herself to sleep?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
This is rare indeed.
I have not seen Akiha drunk in years."
Kohaku-san smiles amusedly.
"…… Kohaku-san.
What do you mean?"

entries.japanese:
「はい、秋葉さまはお酒には酔われないんです。
ただ一定量を超えてしまうと一気に今までの酔いが襲ってくるらしくて、そうなると眠ってしまうんです。
ですから秋葉さまにとって酔う、というのは眠る、という事なんです。
　でも不幸中の幸いと申しましょうか、もし秋葉さまが普通の酔い方をしたら怖いでしょう？
　志貴さん、酔って乱暴になった秋葉さまって想像できます？」
　……琥珀さんは中々に恐ろしい事を尋ねてくる。
　その答えは保留して、眠ってしまった秋葉の寝顔を見てみた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha does not become drunk in the usual way. Once she passes a certain amount, all the intoxication catches up with her at once, and she falls asleep. For Miss Akiha, being drunk simply means sleeping.
Perhaps that is a blessing in disguise—imagine how frightening Miss Akiha would be if alcohol affected her normally. Can you picture a drunken Miss Akiha turning violent, Shiki?”
Kohaku asks a truly terrifying question.
I leave it unanswered and look down at Akiha’s sleeping face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, Akiha-sama does not usually get drunk.
But when she drinks over a certain limit, I guess all the alcohol hits her, and she falls asleep.
So for Akiha-sama, being drunk is the same as going to sleep.
I don't know if that is good or bad, but if Akiha-sama got drunk like most people, wouldn't that be scary?
Shiki-san, could you imagine a rampaging Akiha-sama?"
…… Kohaku-san paints a very frightening mental image.
Deciding not to answer, I look at Akiha's sleeping face.

entries.japanese:
―――秋葉は安らかに眠っている。
　お互い肩をくっつけて、体が密着した状態。
　秋葉の寝息や体温が直に伝わってくる距離。
　……さっきの、おかしな感覚が思い出される。
　秋葉が酔っていたからなのか、さっきの秋葉はまるで別人みたいだった。
　それでドギマギしていたのは否定できない。
　けどこうして安らかに、俺によりかかって眠っている秋葉を見るとホッとする。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Akiha is sleeping peacefully.
Our shoulders touch, our bodies pressed close.
I can feel her breath and warmth directly against me.
The strange sensation from a moment ago returns.
Perhaps it was the alcohol, but Akiha had seemed like another person entirely.
I cannot deny that she left me flustered.
Yet seeing her sleep so peacefully against me now fills me with relief.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Akiha is sleeping contentedly.
She is leaning with her whole body up against mine.
I can feel her breathing and body warmth.
…… I remember that strange feeling I felt before.
She must have been completely drunk, because she seemed like a totally different person.
I can't deny that I was utterly flustered.
Having her sleep so contently against me puts me in a daze.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は、確かに綺麗だ。
　八年ぶりにあって妹だって思えなかったのも本当のこと。
　けど、そんな事はもう関係ない。
　こうして俺に身を預けて、安心して眠っている秋葉を見ているだけで良かった。
　秋葉は間違いなく俺の妹だ。
　俺がこの屋敷に帰ってきた理由の一つは、秋葉を守るためだったんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha is undeniably beautiful.
When we met again after eight years, I truly could not believe she was my little sister.
But none of that matters now.
It is enough to watch her sleeping against me in complete trust.
Akiha is my sister.
One of the reasons I returned to this mansion was to protect her—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Without a doubt, she is very beautiful.
I couldn't believe she was my sister when I met her after eight years.
But that doesn't mean anything.
All I can think is that looking at her resting up against me is a good thing.
Without a doubt, she is my sister.
One of the reasons I came back to the mansion was to protect Akiha----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま。
そのままでは秋葉さまがお風邪を引いてしまわれるのではないでしょうか？」
「え―――あ、そっか。
まだ十月っていっても油断はできないもんな。
それじゃ悪いけど―――」
「はい、秋葉さまをお部屋へお連れいたします」
　翡翠は秋葉に肩をかして、そのまま居間を後にした。
　残されたのは俺と琥珀さんだけになるのだが―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Will Miss Akiha not catch cold if she remains there?”
“What—? Oh, right—it may only be October, but we shouldn’t take chances. Sorry, but could you—”
“Certainly—I will take Miss Akiha to her room.”
Hisui supports Akiha and leads her out of the sitting room.
That leaves only Kohaku and me—but—
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, if Akiha-sama sleeps like that, I believe she might catch a cold."
"Eh---ah, that's right.
It is October, so we shouldn't let our guard down---"
"I will take Akiha-sama up to her room."
Hisui hoists Akiha over her shoulders and exits the room.
The only ones left are me and Kohaku-san---

entries.japanese:
「そうですね、秋葉さまもお眠りになられましたし、そろそろお開きにしましょうか。
片付けはわたしが行いますから、志貴さんもお部屋にお戻りください」
　琥珀さんの言葉に頷く。
　本当は後片付けぐらい手伝いたいんだけど、こっちも酒が回っていて手先がうまく動いてくれない。
　こんな状態で手伝っても、琥珀さんに迷惑をかけるだけだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now that Miss Akiha has retired, perhaps we should bring the evening to a close. I will clear everything away, so you should return to your room as well, Shiki.”
I nod.
I would like to help with the cleanup, but the alcohol has made my hands clumsy.
In this state, I would only make more work for Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, if Akiha-sama is asleep, then we should end this party.
I will take care of tidying things up, so please return to your room, Shiki-san."
I nod.
I really do want to help, but I'm a little too drunk for that.
If I helped in this condition, I'd probably just get in the way.

entries.japanese:
「ん……悪いね琥珀さん。
それじゃ後を頼むよ」
「はい、おまかせください。
それではおやすみなさい志貴さん」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm. Sorry, Kohaku—I’ll leave the rest to you.”
“Certainly—leave everything to me. Good night, Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N…… Sorry, Kohaku-san.
Please take care of things."
"Just leave it to me, please.
Good-night, Shiki-san."

entries.japanese:
――――酔いを冷ます為に中庭に出た。
　夜風はかすかに肌寒く、アルコールで火照った肌を冷ますには丁度いい。
「―――まず。
ほんとに飲みすぎたな、今日は」
　アルコールを飲んだ事による頭痛に誘発されて、いつもの眩暈がやってきた。
　……この分だと今夜はひどい悪夢を見てしまうかもしれない。
　まあ、それも覚悟の上で飲んだ事だ。
　今日の秋葉は楽しそうだった。
　それに比べれば、悪夢の一つや二つはどうという事はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I step into the courtyard to sober up.
The night breeze carries a faint chill—perfect against skin still flushed by alcohol.
“Ugh. I really overdid it tonight.”
The headache from the alcohol brings on one of my usual dizzy spells.
At this rate, I may be in for a terrible nightmare.
Still, I knew the risk when I drank.
Akiha looked happy tonight.
Compared with that, one or two nightmares are a small price to pay.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I go out to the courtyard to clear my head of some of the alcohol.
The breeze is a little cool, so it feels good against my hot skin.
"---This is bad.
I really did drink too much."
All that drinking gave me a headache, and I start to feel a little dizzy.
…… I'll probably have some nightmares tonight.
Well, that is just something I have to face after drinking.
Akiha seemed really happy tonight.
One or two nightmares is a small price to pay for that.

entries.japanese:
中庭に用意された椅子に座って、はあ、と大きく息を吐いた。
「―――――――ん」
　夜風が冷えた薄布のように肌をかすめていく。
　……中庭は物音一つしない。
　住宅地にあるといえ、遠野の屋敷は他の住宅から遠く離れている。
　こうしていると深い森の中にある洋館にいるようで、自分が遠野志貴という学生である事さえ忘れそうになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I sit in one of the courtyard chairs and let out a long breath.
“Mmh.”
The night wind brushes my skin like a length of chilled gauze.
Not a sound disturbs the courtyard.
The Tohno mansion may stand in a residential district, but it lies far from any other house.
Sitting here, I could imagine myself at a manor deep in some forest—and almost forget that I am a student named Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sitting down on a chair, I take a deep breath.
"-------Hm."
The night breeze blows against my skin.
…… There is nothing but silence.
All the other houses are far from the Tohno mansion.
Doing this, I feel like I'm in a mansion in the middle of the woods, and I almost forget that I am a normal student.

entries.japanese:
色のない、衰弱した空気。
　音もせず、停滞した景色。
　微小にのみ記憶に吊られた揺籃の庭。
　そこにはもう誰もいない。
　自分たちを叱る父親の支配も、
　自分たちを縛る立場の隔壁も、
　遠野志貴を驕る誰かの狂想も、
　とうに磨耗し、或いは暴落し、とうに非価値な物となっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Colorless, exhausted air.
A soundless landscape gone stagnant.
A cradle-garden hanging by the barest thread of memory.
No one is left there now.
Not the rule of the father who scolded us,
nor the wall of rank that kept us apart,
nor the mad dream of someone who had called himself Shiki Tohno,
all of it long since worn away or brought crashing down, stripped of every last scrap of value.
entries.mirrorMoon:
An empty, weak atmosphere.
A soundless scenery, of stagnation.
The small fragment of memory, about a garden.
There is no one there.
No father to yell at us,
no one to tie us down and lock us away,
Or even that person who curses Tohno Shiki…
A long time ago, it all wore away, declining into something worthless.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　そんな、とりとめのない事を考えているうちに、段々と瞼が落ちてきた。
「志貴さん、そんな所で寝てしまうと風邪をひきますよ」
―――と。
　その声で、胡乱な眠りから引き起こされた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“————”
As these aimless thoughts drift through my mind, my eyelids grow heavier and heavier.
“Shiki, you’ll catch cold if you fall asleep out here.”
―――Then.
The voice pulls me out of a murky half-sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
Thinking about these rambling ideas, my eyelids start to droop more and more.
"Shiki-san, if you sleep there, you'll catch a cold."
---And.
That voice jars me from my sleepiness.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめんなさい志貴さん。
お酒は出さなかったほうが良かったですね」
　俺の目を見るなり、琥珀さんは微笑みながらそう言った。
　……俺が酔いを冷ます為にここに来た、という事を琥珀さんは察してしまったみたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry, Shiki. Perhaps I should not have served alcohol tonight.”
The moment our eyes meet, Kohaku says it with a smile.
She seems to have realized that I came outside to sober up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I am sorry, Shiki-san.
I guess it would have been better if you didn't drink anything tonight."
Kohaku-san says this with her usual smile, looking at me.
…… It seems that Kohaku-san must have guessed I came here to cool off.

entries.japanese:
「わたしもはしゃぎすぎてしまいました。
志貴さんのお体の事を考えもしないで、こんな事をしてしまって。
志貴さん、辛かったんですね？」
　琥珀さんはこっちには近寄らず、申し訳なさそうに離れて立っている。
　……なんだか、それはいつも笑顔な琥珀さんらしくない。
　酒を飲んだのは自分の意思だし、そんな事で琥珀さんが心を痛める必要なんて、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I let myself get carried away as well. I arranged all this without considering your health. You were suffering, weren’t you, Shiki?”
Kohaku remains at a distance, too apologetic to come closer.
This apologetic distance is nothing like the Kohaku who is always smiling.
I chose to drink, so Kohaku has no reason to feel guilty about it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I guess I got a little carried away.
Not thinking about your health, I forced you to do too much.
It was very tough, wasn't it?"
Kohaku-san apologetically keeps her distance.
…… What is this?
This doesn't seem like the normal, cheery Kohaku-san.
It was my decision to drink, so she shouldn't feel bad about it.

entries.japanese:
「……まったく。
らしくないな、琥珀さん」
　目を合わすと琥珀さんはまた謝ってきそうなので、まだ寝ぼけているふりをして森に視線を向ける事にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. That isn’t like you, Kohaku.”
If I meet her eyes, she will only apologize again, so I pretend I am still half asleep and turn my gaze toward the woods.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez, this isn't like you at all, Kohaku-san."
I look at Kohaku-san, but she is still looking apologetic, so I sleepily gaze into the forest.

entries.japanese:
「辛かったかなんて、そんな事はないよ。
秋葉も明るかったし、楽しいお酒だったじゃないか。
琥珀さん、過保護すぎるって言われるでしょ」
　ぼんやりと森を眺めながら、出来るだけ優しい声でそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
