―――時間が時間のせいか。
　　　昨夜に比べて、人通りはまったくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Perhaps it is the hour.
Compared with last night, the streets are utterly deserted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Maybe it's because of the time?
Compared to last night, there's hardly anyone around.

entries.japanese:
……誰かに、見られている。
　見付からない。
　今夜も、目当ての人物は見付からない。
#ff0000
　　　　　　　イライラ　する
entries.maoEnglish:
…Someone is watching me.
I cannot find her.
Tonight again, the person I want is nowhere to be found.
I’M GETTING ANGRY
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Someone is watching me.
I can't find what I'm looking for.
Again.
Tonight, I can't find the person I'm looking for.
#ff0000
I'm starting to get annoyed.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff

「ハア―――ハア―――ハア――――」
entries.maoEnglish: “Hah―――hah―――hah――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff

I pant heavily.

entries.japanese:
場所を変えよう。
　今夜は、街はやめだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I will try somewhere else.
No more city tonight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I should change my spot.
I'm going to stop looking in town.

entries.japanese:
屋根から屋根を伝って、ごちゃごちゃとしたところに出た。
　……一際高い家の屋根から、道を見渡す。
entries.maoEnglish:
Leaping from roof to roof, I emerge above a crowded tangle of streets.
From the roof of one exceptionally tall house, I survey the road below.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go from roof to roof and end up somewhere crowded.
…… Looking from the roof of the highest house, I scan the streets.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　　　みるな
entries.maoEnglish: DON’T LOOK
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
Don't look!

entries.japanese:
#ffffff


「――――いた」
　通りを一人きりで歩いている。
　女だ。
　今度こそ間違いなく
　アキハだったら、いい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――There she is.”
Someone walks the street alone.
A woman.
This time, surely,
let it be AKIHA.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff


"----There."
I see a person walking alone.
A woman.
This time, there can be no mistake…
It'll be great if it's Akiha.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　　オレを　みるな
entries.maoEnglish:
#ff0000


DON’T LOOK AT ME
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
Don't look at me.

entries.japanese:
#ffffff

　いや、別にそうでなくてもいい。
　もう一度。
　もう一度、あのカンカクを味わいたい――――
entries.maoEnglish:
No, it does not even have to be her.
Once more.
I want to taste that feeling once more――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff

No, it really doesn't matter.
Once more.
Once more, I want to taste that wonderful sensation----

entries.japanese:
後ろから、できるだけ体をキズつけないように、殺した。
　髪を握って、ずるずるとアキハのカラダを引きずっていく。
「ハア――――ハア――――ハア」
　アキハの首筋にかじりついて、血を吸った。
―――つまらない。
　昨夜ほど、今夜のは、面白くなかった。
　やっぱりこんな短い髪だと、アキハじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I kill her from behind, taking care to damage the body as little as possible.
Gripping her hair, I drag AKIHA’s body away.
“Hah――――hah――――hah”
I bite into AKIHA’s neck and suck her blood.
―――Boring.
Tonight was not nearly as much fun as last night.
With hair this short, she cannot be AKIHA after all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I kill her from behind, taking care not to damage her body.
Holding her long hair, I drag Akiha's body.
*pant*----*pant*----*pant*
Biting into Akiha's neck, I suck her blood.
---Boring.
This is nowhere near as exciting as last night.
If her hair is this short, it's not Akiha at all.

entries.japanese:
「……つまらない……！」
　頭にくる。
　死体をバラバラにしても、ぜんぜん気が晴れない。
　ニセモノ。
　ニセモノは、頭にくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Boring!”
It makes me furious.
Even tearing the corpse to pieces brings no relief.
A counterfeit.
Counterfeits make me angry.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Boring……!"
I start to get pissed off.

Even though I slice the body into pieces, I'm still mad.
Impostor.
This impostor pisses me off.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　　　　　　　　　　のぞくな
entries.maoEnglish:
#ff0000


DON’T PEEK
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
Stop watching me!

entries.japanese:
#ffffff

「ハア――――ハア――――ハア――――」
　余分な体力を使ってしまった。
　じき夜があける。
　朝になれば、志貴が目を覚ます。
「今夜は、疲れた。
また明日、やろう」
　うん、それがいい。
そうしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――hah――――hah――――”
I have wasted too much strength.
Dawn will come soon.
When morning arrives, Shiki will wake.
“I’m tired tonight. We’ll do it again tomorrow.”
Yes, that sounds good. Let’s do that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ffffff

*pant*----*pant*----*pant*----
I've used up extra energy.
Soon, dawn will arrive.
Once it becomes morning, Shiki will awaken.
"I'm tired tonight.
I'll start again, tomorrow."
Yeah, that'll do.
That's what I'll do.

entries.japanese:
さあ。
　朝が来る前に、誰にも気付かれないように、今日は学校に戻らないと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Come on.
Before morning comes, I must make it back to the school without anyone noticing――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Now then.
Before the morning comes, before any one realizes, I must go back to school----

entries.japanese:
目が覚めない。
　暗い夢に沈んだまま、目を覚ます気配がない。
―――ゾッとした。
　何の理由もなく、さしたる確証もなく。
　俺はこのままずっと、夢から覚めないのだと、わかってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I cannot wake.
I remain submerged in a dark dream, with no sign that waking will ever come.
―――A chill went through me.
There was no reason for it, no evidence at all.
Yet I knew I would remain trapped in this dream forever.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I cannot wake up.
Immersed in a dark dream, I can't wake up.
---I feel a chill go down my spine.
Without reason, without purpose.
I realize I will never be able to wake from this dream.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お時間ですよ。
起きてくださらないと学校に遅れてしまいます」
「―――――――――え？」
　目の前に翡翠の姿がある。
　ここは自分の部屋で、外は呆れかえるぐらいのいい天気だった。
「ひ……すい？」
「おはようございます志貴さま。
今朝はいつもよりお時間がおしておりますので、お早く居間においでください」
　翡翠はいつも通り、淡々と声をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it is time to wake. If you do not get up, you will be late for school.”
“―――――――――What?”
Hisui stood before me.
I was in my own room, and the weather outside was almost absurdly beautiful.
“Hi—sui?”
“Good morning, Master Shiki. We are running later than usual today, so please come to the sitting room at once.”
Hisui spoke in the same calm, even voice as always.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please wake up.
You will be late for school."
"---------Eh?"
Hisui is in front of me.
This is my room, and there is surprisingly great weather outside.
"Hi…… sui?"
"Good morning, Shiki-sama.
You do not have as much time today, so please hurry to the sitting room."
As usual, Hisui speaks in her detached tone.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――――ぁ」
　それで、何もかも消え去ってくれた。
　目が覚めている自分と、確かに鼓動している自分の体を抱きしめる。
　……ホッとする。
　さっきまでの悪夢が、本当になんていう事はない、ただの悪夢に変わってくれた。
「……よかった。
翡翠が起こしてくれなかったら、あのまま、目覚めなかったかもしれない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――――――”
With that, everything vanished.
I held myself—this waking self, this body with a heart unmistakably beating inside it.
Relief washed over me.
The nightmare from moments before became an ordinary nightmare, nothing more.
“Thank goodness. If you hadn’t woken me, Hisui, I might never have awakened.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh------h."
With that, everything disappeared.
I embrace my recently awakened but still throbbing body.
…… I feel relieved.
The awful world I was in until just now has just turned into a dream.
"…… Thanks.
If you hadn't woken me up, I might have never woken up."

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま……？
　体調が優れないのでしたら、どうぞそうおっしゃってください」
「いや、そうじゃないんだ。
―――おはよう翡翠。
きみがいてくれて、よかった」
「え――――あ、はい。
ありがとうございます、志貴さま」
　微かに頬を染めて、翡翠は頭をさげてくる。
「いや、そうじゃないんだ。
本当にお礼がいいたいのは俺のほう―――――って、もう七時半じゃないか！
　ごめん、すぐ起きるから先に居間に行っててくれ！」
「はい、それではお待ちしております」
　翡翠が退室していくのと同時に、寝巻から学生服に着替える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…? If you are unwell, please tell me.”
“No, that isn’t it. ―――Good morning, Hisui. I’m so glad you’re here.”
“Oh――――yes. Thank you, Master Shiki.”
A faint blush touched Hisui’s cheeks as she bowed.
“No, that isn’t it. I’m the one who should be thanking you―――――wait, it’s already seven thirty! Sorry, I’ll get up now; go ahead to the sitting room!”
“Very well; I shall wait for you there.”
As Hisui left, I changed out of my pajamas and into my school uniform.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……?
If you are not feeling well, please tell me so."
"No, that's not it.
---Morning, Hisui.
I'm glad that you're here."
"Eh----ah, thank you very much, Shiki-sama."
She blushes slightly and lowers her head.
"No, I'm the one who should be saying thank-----it's past seven-thirty already!?
Sorry, I'll get up, so please go wait in the sitting room!"
"Yes, I will be waiting."
Right as Hisui leaves the room, I change into my school uniform.

entries.japanese:
ベッドから跳ね起きて、琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食を少しだけ食べて玄関に出る。
　所要時間は実に十分とかかっていない。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
またな、翡翠！」
「はい。
お帰りをお待ちしております」
entries.maoEnglish:
I sprang out of bed, ate a little of the breakfast Kohaku had made, and reached the front door.
The entire operation took less than ten minutes.
“I’m off. See you later, Hisui!”
“Yes. I shall await your return.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Jumping out of bed, I scarf down a little of the breakfast Kohaku-san made and leave the mansion.
It all took me less than ten minutes.
"I'm leaving--see you later, Hisui!"
"Yes, I will be awaiting your return."

entries.japanese:
「……間に合ったぁ……」
　はあ、と息をついて体を休める。
　間に合った、といっても校門が閉められる時間に間に合っただけで、ここからさらに教室までスパートをかけないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Made it…”
I paused to catch my breath.
That only meant I had beaten the closing of the school gates; I still had to sprint all the way to my classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I made it……"
I breathe out and rest my body.
I made it just in time before they closed the gate, but I still have to make it to class.

entries.japanese:
「………はぁ」
　まだ担任は教室に到着していなかった。
　走り通しで荒くなった呼吸を整えながら自分の席に座る。
　……教室の様子は、いつもより賑やかだ。
　明日が創立記念日で休校なものだから、みんな気分が土曜日になっているのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…”
Our homeroom teacher had not arrived yet.
I dropped into my seat and tried to bring my ragged breathing under control.
The classroom was livelier than usual.
Tomorrow was the school’s anniversary and therefore a holiday; perhaps everyone had already slipped into a Saturday mood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Whew."
The teacher hasn't arrived in the classroom yet.
I try to catch my breath as I sit down.
…… The classroom seems more lively today than usual.
Tomorrow is a holiday, so everyone probably feels like today is a Saturday.

entries.japanese:
放課後になった。
　学校に残るような用事もないし、屋敷に戻る事にしよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Classes ended.
I had no reason to remain at school, so I decided to return to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
School ends.
Since I don't have any reason to stay at school, I'll head back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
「……昨日の夢」
　たしかに昨日、ここで人を殺す夢を見た。
　自分なりに夢を見ないようにと努力はしたけど、自分自身からは逃げられないという事なのか。
「―――――く」
　ぎり、と歯をかみ締める。
　弱気になっている自分が情けない。
　あれは所詮、夢にすぎないことだ。
　たしかにあんな夢を見るのはどうかしてるけど、今はまだ自分は正気のままだと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Last night’s dream.”
I had dreamed of killing someone here.
I had done what I could to keep myself from dreaming again, but perhaps there was no escaping myself.
“―――――Damn.”
I clenched my teeth.
I hated how frightened I had become.
It was only a dream.
Dreaming anything so grotesque was certainly abnormal, but for now, at least, I still believed myself sane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yesterday's dream."
This is definitely the place where I saw someone get killed in my dream.
Even though I tried as hard as I could not to dream, I guess you can't run away from yourself.
"-----Kk."
I grind my teeth.
I feel pitiful about my weakness.
After all, it's all a dream.
Certainly there is something wrong with me seeing those dreams, but I think I'm still sane.

entries.japanese:
……親父は親父だ。
　遠野の血とやらがどんなものなのか俺は知らない。
　ただ、俺がこうしてまだマトモでいられるうちは、秋葉たちに迷惑をかけたくない。
　できるだけ普通に、今まで通りに振る舞いながら、なんとか解決策を見つけるしかないだろう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
My father was his own man.
I knew nothing about this Tohno blood.
But while I could still call myself sane, I did not want to burden Akiha and the others.
I would have to act as normally as possible, carry on as before, and somehow find a solution―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My old man is my old man.
I don't know about the Tohno blood.
But I don't want to become a burden on Akiha and the others while I'm sane.
I have to try and act as normally as possible, and try to find a way to solve all of this---

entries.japanese:
「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」
　玄関を開けるなり、翡翠が丁寧に出迎えてくれる。
「ただいま。
すぐ部屋に戻るから、翡翠は自分の仕事に戻っていいよ」
「はい。
では居間の掃除に戻りますので、何かご用がおありでしたらお声をかけてください」
「……翡翠は居間の掃除、か……」
　琥珀さんの姿が見えないけど、裏庭の掃除か買い物に出ているんだろう。
　秋葉もまだ帰ってきていないようだし、いったん部屋に戻ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.”
The moment I opened the front door, Hisui greeted me with a formal bow.
“I’m back. I’m going straight to my room, so you can return to your work.”
“Very well. I shall resume cleaning the sitting room; please call for me if you need anything.”
“Hisui’s cleaning the sitting room…”
Kohaku was nowhere in sight, but she was probably cleaning the back garden or out shopping.
Akiha did not seem to be home yet either, so I decided to return to my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Welcome back, Shiki-sama."
As soon as I open the door, Hisui politely greets me.
"I'm back.
I'll be in my room, so it's okay if you return to whatever you were doing."
"Thank you.
I will return to cleaning the sitting room.
If you need anything, please call for me."
"…… Hisui is cleaning the sitting room…"
I don't see Kohaku-san, but she's probably sweeping the rear courtyard or going out to get groceries.
It appears Akiha hasn't come back yet, so I'll go back to my room.

entries.japanese:
鞄を置いて私服に着替える。
　そのままぼんやりと部屋で過ごすこと一時間弱。
　いきなり、ぐるうううう、なんていう音を聞いた。
　不気味な音は、なんていう事はない。
　正真正銘、自分の腹の虫である。
entries.maoEnglish:
I put down my bag and changed into casual clothes.
Nearly an hour passed as I sat in my room in a daze.
Then I suddenly heard an ominous growl.
The source was nothing mysterious.
It was, beyond dispute, my own stomach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Putting away my bag, I change out of my uniform.
I spend about an hour just sitting around my room.
All of a sudden, I hear a gurgling noise.
It's not a strange noise or anything.
It's just the sound of my stomach.

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
朝から満足な食事をとってなかったんだっけ」
　朝は遅刻寸前という事で、琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食も舐める程度にしか食べていなかった。
　そのあと学校で昼食をとろうとも思ったが、昨日の食堂の一件を思い出したとたん食欲がなくなって、結局なにも食べていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right. I haven’t had a proper meal all day.”
I had been on the verge of being late that morning and had barely tasted the breakfast Kohaku prepared.
I meant to eat lunch at school, but the memory of yesterday’s incident in the cafeteria killed my appetite, and in the end I ate nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right, I didn't really have a chance to eat since this morning."
Not wanting to be late this morning, I was only able to eat just a little of what Kohaku-san made for breakfast.
I thought about eating at the cafeteria, but I lost my appetite as soon as I remembered what I saw at the cafeteria yesterday.

entries.japanese:
「……夕食前になんか軽いものでも作ってもらえないかな……」
　……余分な仕事を増やしてしまって申し訳ないけど、空腹なものは空腹なのだ。
　ここは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I wonder if someone could make me a little something before dinner…”
I felt guilty about adding to anyone’s work, but hunger was hunger.
In that case, I should―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I wonder if I can get something to snack on before dinner……"
…… I really don't want to be a bother, but I'm really starving.
I should---

entries.japanese: ……わがままを言って、琥珀さんに何か軽食を作ってもらおう。
entries.maoEnglish: I would impose on Kohaku and ask her to make me a light snack.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… It is a little selfish, but I'd better ask Kohaku-san to make me something to eat.

entries.japanese:
「あ、志貴さん。
帰ってきていたんですね」
　ホウキを掃く手を止めて、琥珀さんはペコリとおじぎをしてくる。
「ああ、ただいま。
それで琥珀さん、帰ってきてそうそう悪いんだけど、その」
「はい？
　何か特別なご用があるんですか？」
「えっと、実は恥ずかしながらですね」
　おなかがすいているので何か作ってください、と言う前に。
　ぐるううう、とおなかの音が中庭に鳴り響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Master Shiki. I didn’t realize you were home.”
Kohaku stopped sweeping and gave me a small bow.
“I’m back. Sorry to bother you the moment I get home, Kohaku, but…”
“Yes? Is there something special you need?”
“Well, embarrassing as this is…”
Before I could ask her to make something because I was hungry.
My stomach unleashed a long growl that echoed across the courtyard.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san.
You're back."
Moving the broom off to one side, Kohaku-san bows.
"Yeah, I'm back.
I do have a little favor to ask, though."
"Yes?
Is there something special you need?"
"Um, I'm a little embarrassed, but…"
Before I could even ask her nicely to make me something to eat,
the growling of my stomach rumbles through the courtyard.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　呆気にとられたのか、琥珀さんはまじまじとこっちの顔を見つめてくる。
「―――――う」
　なにか、自分がこの上なく節操のない人間のように思えて赤面してしまう。
「……えー、まあこういうワケなんです。
朝からごはんを食べていないもんだから、夕食まで我慢できそうにないな、と」
「――――――」
　琥珀さんは無言で俺を眺めて、くすっ、と思い出したように笑いだした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Apparently dumbfounded, Kohaku stared openly at my face.
“―――――Urk”
I blushed, feeling like some creature utterly devoid of self-control.
“Well, that explains it. I haven’t eaten since morning, and I don’t think I can last until dinner.”
“――――――”
Kohaku regarded me in silence, then, as though something had just come back to her, gave a quiet laugh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Surprised, Kohaku-san just gapes.
"-----Uh."
My face turns red… I didn't realize my body was that crass…
"…… Um, so that's it.
I didn't have much to eat since morning, so I can't wait until dinner…"
"------"
Kohaku-san stares at me wordlessly and then, as if remembering, lets out a little laugh.

entries.japanese:
「はい、それでしたら何か軽いものをお作りいたしますね。
志貴さん、何かお食べになりたいものはありますか？」
「食べたいもの、ですか？」
　……言われてみれば、ただ小腹がすいているというだけでどんなモノが食べたい、という明確なイメージはもっていなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“In that case, I’ll make something light. Master Shiki, is there anything in particular you would like?”
“Anything in particular?”
Now that she asked, I realized I had only a vague sense of hunger, with no clear image of what I wanted to eat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I understand.
So you want me to fix you something light?
Shiki-san, is there something you want in particular?"
"Something I want?"
…… To be honest, I was just hungry, and I didn't even think about what I wanted to eat.

entries.japanese:
「うーん……それじゃホットケーキかなんか作ってもらえたらいいかな、とか」
　どうしてか、ワケもなく蜂蜜のかけられた黄色いパンケーキが頭に浮かんだ。
「ホットケーキ、ですか……？
　志貴さん、甘いものはお嫌いだって聞いていますけど」
　と、意外そうに首をかしげる琥珀さん。
「あ―――いや、過剰な糖分は摂らないようにしてるけど、嫌いってわけじゃないよ。
有間の家にいた頃も、和菓子はよく食べてたし」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm, could you make pancakes or something?”
For no reason I could name, a stack of golden pancakes drizzled with honey appeared in my mind.
“Pancakes…? Master Shiki, I had heard that you disliked sweets.”
Kohaku tilted her head in surprise.
“Ah―――no, I avoid too much sugar, but I don’t dislike it. I ate Japanese sweets fairly often when I lived with the Arimas.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… I guess some pancakes would be fine."
I don't know why, but the image of golden pancakes just pops into my head.
"Pancakes……?
Shiki-san, I've heard that you do not like sweets, but…"
Kohaku-san tilts her head in surprise.
"Ah---no, I don't eat a lot of sugar, but it's not like I don't like it… I did eat lots of Japanese candy at the Arima's too…"

entries.japanese:
「まあ、そうだったんですか！
　なんだ、そういう事でしたらもっと早く言ってくださいな。
　わたし、お茶会の時に志貴さんには何をご用意しようかってずっと悩んでたんですけど、これからは秋葉さまと同じものをお作りできますね」
　嬉しそうに琥珀さんは声を弾ませる。
　……けど秋葉と一緒ってことは、あの食べるのが勿体ないぐらいキレイなショートケーキを出されるってコトなんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, did you? You should have told me sooner!
I’ve always wondered what to prepare for you at teatime, Master Shiki, but now I can make the same things for you and Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku’s voice danced with delight.
But if I received the same thing as Akiha, did that mean those exquisite little strawberry cakes that looked far too beautiful to eat?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Really!?
If that was the case, you should have told me earlier.
I was wondering all this time if I should get you something during teatime.
But from now on, I'll make you the same thing that I make Akiha-sama."
Kohaku-san's voice suddenly brightens.
…… But eating the same thing as Akiha, does she mean I'll be eating those dainty little shortcakes from now on…?

entries.japanese:
「けど志貴さん、どうしてホットケーキなんですか？
　言ってくださればもっともっと凝った物をご用意させていただきますのに」
「ん……いや、なんとなく。
食べるのに神経使わなさそうじゃないか、アレ」
「あはは、志貴さんったら翡翠ちゃんとおんなじコト言うんですね。
　これは秘密なんですけどね、翡翠ちゃんもホットケーキが好きみたいなんです。
たまに台所のほうでお料理をしてるなって思ったら、たいていはホットケーキを作ってますから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But why pancakes, Master Shiki? If you asked, I could prepare something much more elaborate.”
“No particular reason. They don’t look like the kind of food you have to be careful around.”
“Ha ha, Master Shiki, you sound just like Hisui.
Keep this to yourself, but I think she likes pancakes too. Whenever I notice her cooking in the kitchen, that is usually what she’s making.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, Shiki-san, why do you want pancakes?
If you want, I can fix you something a little better."
"Hm…… no reason, I guess.
I like them because they are pretty simple."
"Ahaha, Shiki-san, you just said the same thing as Hisui-chan.
This is a secret, but I think Hisui-chan really likes pancakes, too.
Whenever she tries to cook something, it's almost always pancakes."

entries.japanese:
「へえ……意外だな、それ。
翡翠はもっと、なんていうか難しそうな食べ物が好きそうな気がするけど」
　その、どこからナイフをいれていいか解らないぐらい繊細な作りをしたケーキとか。
「でしょう？
　わたしも不思議に思って訊いてみたらですね、“これが一番簡単だ”ってわたしが言ったからだそうなんです。
　でも翡翠ちゃん、まだ自分で納得のいく味付けはできないとかなんとか」
「……………？」
　……あの。
それってホットケーキが好き、というんじゃなくて、単にホットケーキを作る練習をしているだけなんじゃ、ないでしょうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Really? That’s unexpected; I always imagined Hisui preferring something more complicated.”
Something so delicate you could not tell where to put the knife.
“I thought so too. When I asked, she said it was because I had told her pancakes were the easiest thing to make.
But apparently she still hasn’t managed a flavor she considers satisfactory.”
“…?”
Um. Wasn’t that less a love of pancakes than a determined campaign to master them?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Really?
…… That's pretty surprising.
I thought she would like something a little more complex."
Like, a very decorated cake that makes you wonder where to cut it from.
"Isn't it?
I think it is a little strange too, so I asked her.
She told me it's because I told her that they are very simple to make.
But she says she still can't make it to satisfy her…"
"……………?"
…… Um, so it's not that she likes pancakes, but just that she practices making them?

entries.japanese:
「あ、ごめんなさい志貴さん。
それじゃすぐにご用意いたしますから、居間のほうでお待ちしていてください」
　琥珀さんはホウキを片手に、小走りで裏口へと去っていった。
「―――――ま、いっか」
　とにかく食べ物にありつけたんだ。
　琥珀さんにお茶を淹れてもらって、軽くホットケーキを食べて、あとは夕食時まで羽を休めるとしよう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, forgive me, Master Shiki. I’ll begin at once, so please wait in the sitting room.”
Broom in hand, Kohaku hurried toward the back door.
“―――――Oh well.”
At least food was on its way.
I would have Kohaku brew some tea, eat a few pancakes, then take it easy until dinner――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, sorry Shiki-san.
I will go make you some, so please wait in the sitting room."
With her broom in hand, Kohaku-san hurries toward the rear entrance.
"-----Well, whatever."
In any case, I'll get to eat soon.
I'll be able to have some tea and pancakes and then get to rest until dinner----

entries.japanese:
……その、ダメでもともとで翡翠にお願いしてみたりしたらどうなるだろう。
「……居間にいるんだっけ、翡翠」
　ちょっとワクワクしてきた。
　善は急げ、さっそく翡翠にお願いしてみよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
What would happen if I took a chance and asked Hisui?
“Hisui’s in the sitting room, right?”
I found myself growing excited.
Nothing ventured; I would ask her immediately.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Although I think she'll refuse, I wonder what will happen if I ask Hisui.
"…… Hisui's in the sitting room."
I'm a little excited.
I should hurry over and go ask Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「お断りします」
　きっかり一秒もかけず。
　翡翠はすごいカウンターで、こっちの思考をノックアウトしてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No.”
Not even a full second passed.
Hisui delivered a perfect counterpunch and knocked my train of thought out cold.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I refuse."
Not even a second after I ask…
With an incredible counterpunch, she totally knocks out my plan.

entries.japanese:
「そ……そうか。
翡翠は忙しいもんな」
　倒れそうになる体をなんとか支えながら、敗残兵のように撤退していく。
「悪かった。
どうか、仕事を続けてください」
　よろよろとロビーのほうへ立ち去っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I—I see. Of course you’re busy.”
Barely supporting my collapsing body, I retreated like a defeated soldier.
“Sorry. Please, carry on with your work.”
I staggered toward the foyer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I…… I see.
You are a little busy."
Defeated, I slump like a captured soldier.
"Sorry.
Please continue what you were doing."
I slowly start to shuffle my way to the lobby.

entries.japanese:
「あ……いえ、お待ちください志貴さま。
　その……決して志貴さまにお食事をお作りするのが嫌だというわけではなくて、その……」
「え………？」
　思わず振り返る。
　と―――
　そこには、なんだか妙にかわいい翡翠がいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, no; please wait, Master Shiki.
It is not that I would dislike cooking for Master Shiki, only…”
“What…?”
I turned despite myself.
And there―――
Hisui looked strangely, helplessly adorable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… Please wait, Shiki-sama.
Um… it is not that I would not like to make you something, but……"
"Eh………?"
I turn around without even thinking.
Then---
Hisui looks incredibly cute for some reason.

entries.japanese:
「その、志貴さまは姉さんの食事になれてしまっていますから、わたしの作ったものなんてとてもお口に合わないと思って……」
　もじもじと、言いにくそうに翡翠は言葉を続ける。
「ですから、もう少しわたしの技術が向上した時に召し上がっていただきたいのです、けど」
「―――――――」
　な……なんて、ことを言ってくるんだろう、翡翠は。
　さっきの『お断りします』もすごい衝撃だったけど、あんなもの今の翡翠に比べれば軽いジャブだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki has grown accustomed to my sister’s cooking, so I feared anything I made would not suit your taste…”
Hisui fidgeted as she forced out the difficult words.
“I would prefer you to taste my cooking once my abilities have improved a little more.”
“―――――――”
What—what was she doing to me?
Her earlier refusal had been a brutal blow, but compared with this Hisui, it was only a light jab.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I, I just thought that since you are used to Nee-san's cooking, my cooking would not even come close…"
Fidgeting, Hisui continues speaking uneasily.
"So I want for you to eat my food when my skill has improved…"
"-------"
Wh…… what an amazing thing she says!
That "I refuse" back then was a big shock, but compared to what she just said, it's merely a light jab.

entries.japanese:
「な、なに言ってるんだよ翡翠！
　その、翡翠が作ってくれたものならなんでも食べるから、そんなコト気にしないでいいんだって！」
「…………いえ、そういうわけには参りません。
どうか志貴さま、食事に関しては姉さんにお申しつけくださいませ」
「……いや、俺は翡翠のがいい。
琥珀さんに頼むなら初めから琥珀さんのところに行ってる。
　俺は、その―――翡翠に作ってもらいたくて、お願いにきたんじゃないか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about, Hisui? If you made it, I’d eat anything, so you don’t need to worry about that!”
“No. I cannot allow that; please, Master Shiki, ask my sister whenever you require food.”
“No; I want yours. If I meant to ask Kohaku, I would have gone to her in the first place.
I came here because I wanted―――you to make it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying, Hisui?
I'll eat anything you make, so please don't fret about that sort of thing."
"………… No, I cannot do that.
Shiki-sama, please ask Nee-san about food."
"…… No, what I really want is something from you.
If I wanted Kohaku-san's cooking, I'd have gone to her first.
I came here to ask you---cause I wanted your cooking."

entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui only stared at me without answering.
“Hmph.”
Fine; I could be stubborn too. I would remain in this room until she agreed to cook for me…!
“…”
“…”
“……”
“………”
“…………”
“……………”
“………………”
“…………………”
“……………………”
“………………………”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui just looks at me, not responding.
"………… Hm."
If that's how she's going to be, then I'll just stay right here in the sitting room until she says she'll make me something.
"……"
"………"

"…………"
"……………"
"………………"
"…………………"
"……………………"
"………………………"
"…………………………"
"……………………………"

entries.japanese:
なんともいえない睨み合いが続く。
　……おかしいな。
　一体いつから、どうして、こんなコトになっちゃったんだろ？
entries.maoEnglish:
Our indescribable contest of wills continued.
This was strange.
When, and how, had matters come to this?
entries.mirrorMoon:
We continue staring at each other without saying anything.
…… That's odd.
How did we end up like this?

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
わたしでいいのでしたら、作らせていただきます」
「―――！
　やった、ほんとだな翡翠！」
「はい。
ですが口にされたあと、後悔されてもしりませんから」
「え………？」
　なんか空恐ろしいことを言って、翡翠は台所に向かっていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. If you truly do not mind my cooking, I shall prepare something.”
“―――! Yes, you mean it, Hisui!”
“Yes. But I will accept no complaints if you regret it after the first bite.”
“What…?”
Having issued that faintly terrifying warning, Hisui went to the kitchen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
If you do not mind, then I will make something."
"---!
Yes!
For real, Hisui!?"
"Yes.
But since you insisted, you are bringing this on yourself."
"Eh………?"
Saying something incredibly ominous, Hisui heads towards the kitchen.

entries.japanese:
「――――――ふ。
ふふ、ふふふふふ」
　嬉しくて笑いがこみあげてくる。
　壁一枚隔てた台所で、翡翠が俺のために料理をしてくれているかと思うと、つい口がにやけてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Heh. Heh heh, heh heh heh.”
Laughter bubbled out of sheer delight.
Knowing that Hisui was on the other side of a single wall, cooking for me, made it impossible to keep the grin off my face.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------He.
Hehe, hehehehehe."
I start chuckling uncontrollably.
In the kitchen behind that wall, Hisui is making food for my sake.
Thinking about it, I can't help but smile.

entries.japanese:
そりゃあ琥珀さんには毎日作ってもらっているけど、琥珀さんの場合はあんまりにもテキパキしすぎていて、『琥珀』という別の料理人がいるみたいでかしこまってしまう。
　反面、翡翠は今まで料理らしきものは作っていなかったという事もあって、なんだか妙にドキドキしてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku cooked for me every day, of course, but she was so brisk and professional that she seemed less like Kohaku than a professional cook, and I could never entirely relax around her.
Hisui, on the other hand, had never made anything resembling a meal for me, so the wait left me strangely excited.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though Kohaku-san prepares food every day, she does so too professionally; it feels like some other cook is making the food.
On the other hand, I have never seen Hisui's cooking, so I'm pretty excited.

entries.japanese:
「……琥珀さん曰く、翡翠は料理ベタだっていう話だけど……」
　まあ、それでも食べられないようなモノはでてこないだろう。
　人並みの味覚があるんなら、食べられない料理なんていうものは普通どうあっても作れないものなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku did say Hisui was hopeless in the kitchen…”
Even so, surely nothing genuinely inedible would emerge.
Given an ordinary sense of taste, it should be almost impossible to create food no human being could eat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kohaku-san did say that Hisui was poor at cooking though……"
Well, even so, I don't think anything inedible will be the result.
If you have a normal sense of taste, it's impossible to make something that is completely inedible.

entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………
…………
……………
………………Still,
wasn’t this taking a little too long?
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
………
…………
……………
………………
………………… But still.
Doesn't she seem to be taking a little too long?

entries.japanese:
「きゃっ――！？」
―――と。
　台所から、ガタン、と大きな音が聞こえてきた。
「翡翠！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Eek—!”
―――And then.
A tremendous crash came from the kitchen.
“Hisui!?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kya--!?"
---And then,
I hear a gigantic crash coming from the kitchen.
"Hisui!?"

entries.japanese:
「どうした、なにかあったのか翡翠！？」
　台所にかけこむ。
「――――あ」
　入って、ちょっと引いた。
　翡翠はものすごいご馳走でも作るつもりだったのか、台という台にこれでもかっていうぐらい食材が並んでいる。
　まな板の上には墓標かどこかの聖剣のように包丁が突き刺さっているし、コンロには黒煙をあげているフライパンがあったりする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, what happened to you?!”
I ran into the kitchen.
“――――Ah.”
Then stopped short.
Perhaps Hisui had meant to prepare a royal banquet; every available surface was buried beneath a prodigious quantity of ingredients.
A kitchen knife stood embedded in the cutting board like a grave marker—or some holy sword from legend—and a frying pan on the stove was pouring out black smoke.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What happened, Hisui!?"
I run into the kitchen.
"----Ah."
After entering, I'm a little taken aback.
Hisui might have been planning on cooking a feast as ingredients are stacked all about the kitchen.
A kitchen knife is thrust into the cutting board like a gravestone or like that holy sword from somewhere.

entries.japanese:
「あ……と、翡翠？」
「……………………」
　翡翠は恥ずかしそうにうつむいたままだ。
「あの、翡翠。
俺は別に軽いものでよかったんだけど。
ほら、簡単なところでホットケーキとか、そういうの」
「……お言葉ですが志貴さま。
ホットケーキは、簡単ではありません」
　きっ、と心底からの本心で翡翠は言い返してくる。
　……まいった。
これは本当に、翡翠に料理というのは鬼門なのかもしれな―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Hisui?”
“…”
Hisui kept her head bowed in embarrassment.
“Listen, Hisui. I only needed something light. Something simple, like pancakes.”
“With respect, Master Shiki. Pancakes are not simple.”
Hisui looked up sharply and contradicted me with absolute conviction.
I surrendered. Cooking truly might be her mortal enemy―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
And on the stove, black smoke billows from a frying pan.
"Um…… Hisui?"
"……………………"
Hisui embarrassedly hangs her head.
"Um, Hisui.
I would have been happy with something light.
Something simple, like a pancake."
"…… Shiki-sama, you may say that, but a pancake is not very simple."
Hisui says so from the bottom of her heart.
…… Geez.
Hisui really IS pretty poor at cooking---

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
ちょっと、手を見せて」
「え……手を、ですか」
　翡翠は遠慮がちに手を見せる。
「やっぱり。
指、切っちゃってるじゃないか」
「……はい。
すみません、満足な料理一つ作れず、こんな無様な姿までお見せしてしまいまして……」
「ばか、そんなコト言いたいんじゃない。
ケガをしたんなら、無理なんかしないで―――」
　無理なんかしないで、すぐに手当てをしないといけないのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Let me see your hand.”
“My hand?”
Hisui held it out reluctantly.
“I knew it. You cut your finger.”
“Yes. I apologize for failing to prepare even one proper dish and exposing you to this disgraceful sight.”
“Idiot, that isn’t what I mean. If you’re hurt, don’t push yourself―――”
She should not have pushed herself when the wound needed treating at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, let me see your hand."
"Eh…… My hand?"
Hisui reluctantly shows me her hand.
"Just as I thought.
You cut yourself, didn't you?"
"…… Yes.
Forgive me, I was not even able to fix you anything properly, and now I have shown you this pathetic sight."
"Don't be stupid, that's not what I'm trying to say.
If you cut yourself, you shouldn't force---"
She shouldn't force herself, she should treat her wounds.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま？」
　翡翠の白い指先が、真っ赤に染まっている。
　とろり、と瑞々しく朱に濡れた翡翠の指先。
「―――酷いな。
けっこう深い傷じゃないか、これ」
　言って、翡翠の腕を取る。
「っ――――！」
　びくり、と震える翡翠の体。
　それにも気付かないで、ただ、翡翠のキズをどうにかしてあげたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki?”
Hisui’s white fingertip was dyed scarlet.
Fresh blood glistened thickly over it.
“―――That’s nasty. The cut is fairly deep.”
I took hold of Hisui’s arm.
“――――!”
Hisui’s body flinched.
Oblivious to her reaction, I thought only of doing something about the wound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama?"
Hisui's white finger is painted a deep red.
Her fingertip, wet with the color red.
"---This is bad.
That's pretty deep."
Saying that, I take her arm.
"----!"
Hisui's body flinches noticeably.
I don't even notice.
The only thing I care about right now is treating her cut.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――」
　翡翠の声。
―――よく聞こえない。
　ただ子供の時みたいに、傷口を舐めて血をふき取る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
Hisui’s voice.
―――Too faint to hear.
I merely did what I had done as a child: licked the wound clean of blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Hisui's voice.
---I don't even hear it.
Just like back when I was a kid, I place the finger in my mouth and lick the blood.

entries.japanese:
「………志貴、さま」
―――細い指。
　赤い血は、翡翠の白い指には似合わない。
　だからキレイにしてあげようと、思っただけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master—Shiki”
―――Such slender fingers.
Red blood did not belong on Hisui’s white skin.
I only meant to make it clean again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Shiki--sama."
---Her slender finger.
Red blood does not suit her white finger at all.
So I only thought to make her finger clean again.

entries.japanese:
「……おやめください、志貴、さま……」
―――なんで、だろう。
　翡翠の血は、すごく―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please stop—Master Shiki”
―――Why?
Hisui’s blood was so―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please stop, Shiki… sama……"
---Why is it?
Hisui's blood is extremely---

entries.japanese:
「………………あ」
―――――あまい。
　翡翠の血は甘くて、ただこうしているだけで、体が熱くなって、なんだか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
―――――Sweet.
Hisui’s blood was sweet, and merely doing this sent heat spreading through my body, made me feel almost―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Ah."
-----sweet.
Her blood is sweet, and just from doing this, my body starts to feel hot and---

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
―――声が聞こえない。
　視線を上げれば、そこに翡翠の顔があった。
　赤く染まった頬。
深い碧色の瞳。
　……昔。
すごく間近にあった、赤い髪。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――I could no longer hear her voice.
When I lifted my eyes, Hisui’s face was there.
Flushed cheeks. Deep jade eyes.
