entries.maoEnglish:
I run to the washroom and vomit.
“Ugh―――ngh, ah…!”
No matter how much I empty from my stomach, the nausea will not ease.
Last night’s dream.
In one sense, a dream even worse than the dreams of murder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I run to the bathroom and throw up in the sink.
"Uughuuhuuk!
ah!"
I empty the contents of my stomach, but I still feel sick.
Last night's dream.
In a sense, it's worse than my dreams of being a killer.
It's much, much worse.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――ぁ、あ―――」
　俺は―――秋葉だけじゃなく、翡翠や琥珀さんさえ、汚してしまった。
　あんな夢を。
　翡翠とも琥珀さんともとれない誰かを、一晩中犯し続ける夢を見るなんて。
「………は…………あ」
　何も吐き出すものがなくなって、ようやく喉の痙攣が止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――ah, ah―――”
I―――I had defiled not only Akiha, but even Hisui and Kohaku.
To dream something like that.
To dream I spent the entire night raping someone who could have been Hisui or Kohaku.
“Hah, aaah”
At last there is nothing left to bring up, and the spasms in my throat subside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----gaa, ah---"
In my dreams, I don't just violate Akiha, but even Hisui and Kohaku-san.
That dream.
Dreaming I violated a girl that looked like Hisui or Kohaku-san all night.
"……… Aa………… ach."
Not having anything left to throw up, my convulsions start to diminish.

entries.japanese:
ロビーに出ると、翡翠がなにやら作業をしていた。
　模様替えだろうか、見なれない椅子をロビーに運んでいる。
「……………く」
　眩暈がする。
　今は―――まともに翡翠の顔が見られない。
　けど、このまま無視して部屋に戻るのは、もっと耐えられない。
　いつものように翡翠に起こしてもらっていたのなら、少しは―――この胸のむかつきも和らいでくれただろうし。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I enter the lobby, Hisui is busy with some task.
Perhaps the furniture is being rearranged; she is carrying in a chair I don’t recognize.
“Ngh.”
The room spins.
Right now―――I can’t look Hisui in the face.
But ignoring her and retreating to my room would be even harder to bear.
If she had woken me as usual, perhaps―――the sickness in my chest would have eased a little.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go out in the lobby and see Hisui taking care of something.
She might be doing some rearranging, as I see her carrying a chair towards the lobby.
"…………… Ku."
I feel dizzy.
Right now---I can't bring myself to look at her face.
But I can't bear to go back to my room without saying anything.
If Hisui tried to wake me up as usual---I think this sickness would have been a bit better.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠」
　翡翠は俺に気がついたのか、トツトツと静かな足取りでやってくる。
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「……ああ、おはよう。
わるいね、自分かってな時間に起きちゃって」
「こちらこそ、お目覚めの時にお傍にいられず、申し訳ございません」
　翡翠はスッ、と音もなく頭をさげる。
　……無表情な翡翠。
昨夜の夢を思い出しそうになって、後ろめたい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui.”
Noticing me, she approaches with small, quiet steps.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Morning. Sorry for waking up whenever I felt like it.”
“No, I apologize for not being at your side when you woke.”
Hisui bows without a sound.
Her face is blank. The memory of last night’s dream stirs, and guilt knots inside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui."
Hisui realizes I'm here and quietly walks over to me.
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"…… Ah, morning.
Sorry for waking up at a selfish time."
"I apologize as well.
I should have been there when you awoke.
Please forgive me."
Hisui silently bows her head.
…… Hisui's expressionless face.
Remembering last night's dream, I start to feel guilty.

entries.japanese:
「……いや、翡翠が謝る必要なんかない。
決まった時間に起きないこっちが悪いんだから、翡翠は、俺に文句の一つでも言ってくれたほうが、いい」
　……そうしてくれれば、少しは楽になれる。
「志貴さま……？」
　でも、そんなのはこっちのかってな都合だ。
　げんに、俺の言葉で翡翠は気に病んでしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No, you have nothing to apologize for. I’m the one who failed to wake at the proper time, so if anything, you ought to scold me.”
If she did, perhaps I could feel a little less wretched.
“Master Shiki…?”
But that would serve only my own selfish needs.
My words have already made Hisui anxious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, there's no need for you to apologize.
I didn't wake up at the usual time, so it's my fault.
It's better if you complain to me a bit."
…… If you do that, I'd feel a little better.
"Shiki-sama……?"
But, that's just my selfish thoughts.
Like right now, my words are making her feel bad.

entries.japanese:
「なんでもない、今のは忘れてくれ。
……それより朝飯にしたいんだけど、朝食の準備って出来てる？」
「……姉さんは外に出ています。
志貴さまのご朝食でしたら、食堂のほうにすでに用意されておりますが」
「そっか。
それじゃあ有り難くいただいてくる。
仕事中、呼び止めて悪かったね」
　それじゃまた後で、と声をかけて食堂に向かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forget I said that. Anyway, I’d like some breakfast; is anything ready?”
“My sister is away. Master Shiki’s breakfast has already been laid in the dining room.”
“I see. Then I’ll go enjoy it. Sorry for interrupting your work.”
Telling her I’ll see her later, I head for the dining room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's nothing, forget about it.
…… More importantly, I'm kinda' hungry; is breakfast ready?"
"…… Nee-san went outside.
Your breakfast is ready in the dining room."
"Oh.
In that case, I'll go have some food.
Sorry to bother you while you were working."
After saying a quick goodbye, I head towards the dining room.

entries.japanese:
自室に戻ってはみたが、とりあえずやるべき事がない。
　眠るのはもうこりごりだ。
　何をしたものかとしばらく考えこんだあげく、八年ぶりに屋敷の中を散歩する事にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to my room, but there is nothing in particular I need to do.
I have had more than enough of sleep.
After pondering the problem for a while, I decide to tour the mansion for the first time in eight years.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go back to my room, but I don't really have anything to do here.
I've had my fill of sleeping.
Thinking about what I should do next, I decide to walk around the mansion.

entries.japanese:
ロビーにおりてきた。
　なんとなく、子供のころの思い出を確かめる為に、のんびりと屋敷の中を歩き始める。
entries.maoEnglish:
I go down to the lobby.
On a whim, I begin strolling through the mansion, looking for the memories I left here as a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I arrive at the lobby.
For some reason, I aimlessly wander around the mansion to confirm my childhood memories.

entries.japanese:
廊下は長く延びている。
　子供のころは、この廊下がどこまでも続いているんだって信じて疑わなかった。
　屋敷は城のように広くて、毎日少しずつ歩き回っては壁や柱、床に自分の名前を刻み付けた。
　当時、秋葉との遊びで陣地取りみたいなゲームが流行ったせいだ。
　名前を刻んだところが自分の領地だ、なんていって二人で屋敷じゅう歩き回っては、自分の名前を刻んでいったんだっけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The corridor runs on and on.
As a child, I never doubted it continued forever.
The mansion seemed as vast as a castle, and every day I explored a little more of it, carving my name into walls, pillars, and floors.
Akiha and I had become obsessed with a game of claiming territory.
Wherever we carved our names became our territory; we roamed the entire mansion together, leaving our names behind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The hallway stretches quite a long distance.
When I was a child, I believed that this hallway would go on forever.
The mansion seemed as large as a castle, and every day, I would walk a bit around the mansion and would carve my name on the wall, the pillars, or the floor.
It was sort of a game I would play with Akiha to see who could take over the mansion.
Saying that wherever we put our names became our territory, the two of us walked around the mansion carving our names here and there.

entries.japanese:
「……あった」
　階段の手すりにシキという名前が刻まれている。
　父親が屋敷の中で遊ぶのを禁じたのは、案外この遊びのせいかもしれない。
　ともかく注意深くして見れば、そこかしこに自分と秋葉の名前が刻まれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Found one.”
SHIKI is carved into the stair rail.
Perhaps this game was the real reason Father eventually forbade us to play inside.
Now that I’m looking carefully, I find my name and Akiha’s everywhere.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Here."
On the handrail by the stairs is carved the name SHIKI.
It was probably because of these games that my old man forbade us from playing inside the mansion.
Anyway, if I look closely, I can see both mine and Akiha's name all over the place.

entries.japanese:
外に出る。
　……そういえば、秋葉と遊ぶのはたいていが庭でだったっけ。
　秋葉は俺と違って親父の言いつけを守っていたから、一日に三十分ぐらいしか遊ぶ事ができなかった。
　だっていうのにやる事といったら俺たちの後ろについてきて、じっと言うことを聞いているだけだった。
　それでも、いざ遊び出せば元気に走り回って、何をするにしても俺たちと勝ち負けを競りあっていたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I go outside.
Come to think of it, Akiha and I usually played in the garden.
Unlike me, she obeyed Father, so she was allowed only thirty minutes a day.
Even then, she mostly followed behind us and quietly did whatever she was told.
But once a game began, she raced about with all her energy and fought us for victory in everything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go outside.
…… Come to think of it, most of the time we spent playing was in the garden.
Since Akiha was obedient to the old man, unlike me, she could only play outside for about thirty minutes a day.
And still, she usually just stayed behind us, watching and listening.
But she would energetically run out with us and compete with us in whatever games we would play.

entries.japanese:
「……なんだ。
あいつ、昔っから今の性格の下地はあったんじゃないか」
　親父の手前、猫を五、六匹かぶっていたのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…So the foundations were there all along.”
Perhaps she had simply hidden her real nature under five or six layers of good behavior whenever Father was watching.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Perhaps her personality stems from those times?"
She might have suppressed herself in front of the old man.

entries.japanese:
屋敷の壁にはまた名前が刻まれていた。
　志貴、志貴、秋葉、シキ、秋葉、シキ、秋葉、志貴、志貴、シキ、志貴。
　割合的にはこんなところで、さすがにシキという名前のほうが多い。
　なんだかんだいっても秋葉は女の子で、男の子であるこっちの行動範囲には敵わなかったということだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
More names are carved into the mansion wall.
Shiki, Shiki, Akiha, SHIKI, Akiha, SHIKI, Akiha, Shiki, Shiki, SHIKI, Shiki.
The proportions are roughly like that; naturally, SHIKI is the name that appears most often.
Whatever else she may be, Akiha was a girl, and she could not match the territory covered by the boys.
entries.mirrorMoon:
On the walls of the mansion, the carved names appear again.
Shiki, Shiki, Akiha, SHIKI, Akiha, SHIKI, Akiha, Shiki, Shiki, SHIKI, Shiki.
The ratios are like that, and the name SHIKI appeared far more times.
I suppose Akiha was just a girl so she couldn't keep up with a boy.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さん……？」
　裏庭にやってくると、ちょうど琥珀さんの後ろ姿が目に入った。
　琥珀さんはこちらに気づいていない。
　何をしにいくのか、森の中に入っていく。
「？」
　興味をひかれて、少しだけ後についていった。
――――と。
　琥珀さんが歩いていった先には、ちょっとした広場があるようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku…?”
When I reach the rear garden, I catch sight of Kohaku from behind.
She has not noticed me.
For some reason, she walks into the woods.
“?”
Curious, I follow her a little way.
――――And then.
Beyond the trees where Kohaku disappeared, there seems to be a small clearing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku-san……?"
As I come to the backyard, I see Kohaku-san's figure from behind.
She hasn't noticed me.
I don't know what she's doing, but she disappears into the forest.
"?"
A bit curious, I follow her from a slight distance.
----And.
Where Kohaku-san headed to, there seems to be a small clearing.

entries.japanese:
「………あんなところに広場なんて……」
　首をかしげて思い出そうとしてみるが、どうも記憶はあいまいだ。
　屋敷の森の中、木々を切り取ったような広場が見える。
　―――いや、見えるというのは正しくない。
　普通に歩いている分には決して見えなかったはずだ。
　琥珀さんがあそこに歩いて行かなければ、屋敷に住んでいながら一生気づかなかったぐらい隠れた、木々に囲まれた小さな広場。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was there always a clearing over there?”
I tilt my head and search my memory, but everything is hazy.
Amid the woods of the estate, I can make out a clearing carved from the trees.
―――No—make out is the wrong phrase.
I would never have seen it merely by walking past.
If Kohaku had not gone there, I might have lived in this mansion all my life without discovering that tiny clearing enclosed by trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… There's a clearing there……?"
Tilting my head to the side, I try to remember, but for some reason, my memory is a bit vague.
In the forest of the mansion, I can see a clearing as if the trees were cut there.

---No, "can see" is not quite right.
If you walked by normally, you probably would never notice it.
If Kohaku-san didn't walk there, hidden enough by the surrounding trees as it is, I would never have noticed even if I lived here all my life.

entries.japanese:
「……おかしいな。
あんな所に広場があったなんて、覚えてないけど」
　少なくとも森の中の広場で秋葉と遊んだ記憶はない。
――――ない、ような、気が、する。
「…………」
　少しだけ思案してから、その広場に入ってみることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s strange. I don’t remember a clearing there.”
At least, I have no memory of playing with Akiha in a clearing in the woods.
――――I don’t think there was.
“…”
After a moment’s thought, I decide to enter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's odd.
I don't remember a clearing ever being here."
To say the least, I don't remember ever playing with Akiha in the clearing.

----I feel like I've never, been there, before.
"…………"
After thinking for a bit, I decide to go into the clearing.

entries.japanese:
……広場には特別なにもない。
　先に入っていった琥珀さんの姿もない。
「なんだ―――ただの空き地じゃないか」
　広場の真ん中へ歩いていく。
　広場は本当に、なんていうことはない空き地だった。
　きれいにまったいらにされた土の地面と、
　まわりを囲む深い森の木々。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is nothing unusual in the clearing.
Kohaku, who entered ahead of me, is nowhere to be seen.
“What―――it’s only an empty patch of ground.”
I walk toward the center.
It really is nothing more than a vacant space.
Smooth, level earth beneath my feet,
and the deep forest closing in on every side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The clearing doesn't strike me as anything out of the ordinary.
There's no sign of Kohaku-san, who entered before me.
"What's this---just an empty place."
I walk to the middle of the clearing.
This clearing really is just an empty space.
The perfectly level open ground.
The deep woods enclose the area.

entries.japanese:
蝉の声と。
　溶けるような、強い、夏の陽射し――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
The singing of cicadas.
Fierce summer sunlight, hot enough to melt me away――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice of the cicadas.
And the strong, summer sunshine that feels like it could dissolve------

entries.japanese:
「え…………？」
　夏の、陽射し―――？
「い――――痛ぅ…………」
　胸の傷が痛む。
　　　　　　　　　まるで　／　　　ざくりと。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　包丁で胸を刺された　　　／　　ような　／　　この痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Summer sunlight―――?
“It――――hurts…”
The scar in my chest aches.
as though / a sudden stab.
a kitchen knife in my chest / as though / this pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh…………?"
Summer, sunshine---?
"Ou----ouch……"
The wound on my chest starts to hurt.
Like / Stabbing.
This pain  / that feels like  / a kitchen knife stabbing my chest.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん―――――
――――どこかで、蝉の声がしている。
　今はもう、秋なのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min―――――
――――Somewhere, cicadas are singing.
Though it is already autumn.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp-----
----From somewhere, I can hear the voice of cicadas.
But, it's autumn now.

entries.japanese:
――――白く溶けてしまいそうな夏の陽射し。
　遠くのそらには入道雲。
　見えるのは空蝉のこえ。
　足元には蝉のぬけがら。
　ぬけがら。
誰かの、ぬけがら。
「―――――――――…………………………」
　傷が開く。
　胸が真っ赤に染まって、この両手まで赤黒く赫灼と―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Summer sunlight, bleached white enough to dissolve the world.
Far away, thunderheads climb the sky.
I can see the voice of an empty cicada shell.
At my feet lies a cast-off husk.
A husk. What someone left behind.
“―――――――――…………………………”
The wound tears open.
My chest floods scarlet, and even my hands blaze dark with blood―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The summer sunshine that bathes everything in white.
The columns of summer clouds in the far off sky.
I can practically see the voices.
At my feet, there are the discarded shells of cicadas.
Discarded shell.
Someone's--discarded shell.

"------------………………"
My wound opens.
My chest becomes painted a dark crimson; black vermillion soaks both my hands-----

entries.japanese:
……うずくまる誰かの影法師。
　　　近寄ってくる幼い少女の足音。
　　　遠くの空には入道雲。
空蝉の青いそら。
　　　気がつけば、
　　　目の前には血まみれの秋葉の泣き顔。
entries.maoEnglish:
Someone’s shadow crouching on the ground.
The footsteps of a little girl drawing near.
Thunderheads in the distant sky. An empty husk beneath the blue.
And when I look again,
Akiha’s tearful face is before me, drenched in blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Someone's crouched silhouette.
The approaching footsteps of a young girl.
The columns of clouds in the far sky.
The discarded shells of cicadas.
I suddenly realize,
in front of me is the crying face of Akiha, drenched in blood.

entries.japanese:
みーん、みんみん。
　みーん、みんみん。
―――鼓膜を突き破ろうとする、
　　　　　　　　　　　　　針みたいな蝉の声。
!w750
entries.maoEnglish:
Miiin, min-min.
Miiin, min-min.
―――The cicadas shriek like needles
trying to pierce my eardrums.!w750
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
---Ah.
Voices which try to pierce my eardrums,
voices of the cicadas.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ」
　胸がいたい。
　吐き気がする。
　傷はとうのむかしに塞がっているはずなのに、どうしてこんなにも痛むのか。
　胸が　壊れてる。
　古傷が開いて　セキショクの染みが流れ出す。
―――なんてこと。
　俺の傷は、ぜんぜん癒えてなんかいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――ngh.”
My chest hurts.
I’m going to be sick.
The wound closed long ago, so why does it hurt this much?
My chest is broken.
The old wound gapes, and a CRIMSON stain pours out.
―――Of course.
My wound never healed at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----gu."
My chest hurts.
I feel sick.
My wound healed a long time ago, so why does it hurt so much?
My chest   is broken.
The old wound opens, blood flows forth from the opening.

---What is this?
My wound, it hasn't healed at all.

entries.japanese:
意識が沈む。
　傷が痛む。
　その、昏睡する直前に、イヤな映像を思い出した。
　夏の暑い日。
　血まみれの秋葉と、それを見下ろしている自分。
　手についている血を舐めとる影。
　……影はしだいに自分そのものの顔をした少年になって、愉しそうに、笑っていた―――
entries.maoEnglish:
My consciousness sinks.
The wound throbs.
Just before darkness takes me, a hateful image returns.
A sweltering summer day.
Akiha covered in blood, and me standing over her.
A shadow licking the blood from its hands.
Slowly, the shadow becomes a boy with my own face, smiling in delight―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
My consciousness sinks.
My wound hurts.
Right before I pass out, I remember a terrible image.
A hot summer day.
Akiha stained in blood and myself staring down at her.
The silhouette licks the blood off its hands.
…… Then, the silhouette becomes my face as a young boy, laughing with pleasure---

entries.japanese: ……話し声が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish: I can hear voices.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… I can hear voices talking.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま、お医者さまをお呼びしないのですか？」
「馬鹿なことは言わないで翡翠。
呼べるわけがないでしょう、兄さんの傷は普通の傷じゃないんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha, should we not summon a doctor?”
“Don’t be absurd, Hisui. We can’t call one; Brother’s wound isn’t an ordinary injury…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama, are you not going to call for a doctor?"
"Don't be stupid, Hisui.
There's no way I could do that, since Nii-san's wound isn't normal……!"

entries.japanese:
……あきは　と　ひすい　が話している。
　ここは　シキの　部屋だ。
　どうやら　ベッドの上で　眠っている　らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
……akiha and hisui are talking
this is SHIKI’s room.
it seems i am asleep on the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Akiha  and  Hisui   are talking.
This  is   SHIKI's room.
It looks   like   I am  sleeping  in the bed.

entries.japanese:
よお、と声をあげて起きようとしたけれど、体が思うように動かない。
　胸の痛みはもうないくせに、体は鉛のように重い。
　満足に動くのは、目と口だけのようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I try to sit up and call hello, but my body will not obey.
The pain in my chest is gone, yet my limbs feel heavy as lead.
Only my eyes and mouth seem capable of moving properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I planned to say "Yo!" and get out of bed, but I can't move at all.
My chest doesn't hurt anymore, but my body feels as heavy as lead.
All I can move are my eyes and mouth.

entries.japanese:
「一体どういうつもりなの翡翠。
志貴をあそこに近づけてはいけないって、あなたも知っているでしょうに……！」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝って済む問題じゃないわ。
あなたを兄さん付きの使用人にしたのは、こういう事態を避けるためでしょう？
　それを忘れて、あなたは何をやっていたっていうのよ……！」
　秋葉は普段からでは考えられないぐらい、感情を剥き出しにして怒っている。
　対して、叱られている翡翠はうつむいたままずっと黙っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What were you thinking, Hisui? You knew Shiki must never be allowed near that place…!”
“I am terribly sorry.”
“Sorry does not begin to answer for this. You were assigned to Brother precisely to prevent something like this, weren’t you? What in heaven’s name were you doing…!”
Akiha’s fury is naked in a way I have never seen before.
Hisui keeps her head bowed and suffers the rebuke in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just what in the world were you trying to do, Hisui?
You know not to let Shiki go near that place……!"
"Please…… forgive me."
"This can't be solved by apologizing.
You were assigned to serve Nii-san to avoid this kind of situation.
So what were you doing……!?"

Completely different from her usual manner, Akiha gives full vent to her anger.
In comparison, Hisui is accepting the scolding, looking down silently.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀は？
　あの子にも言いつけてあったでしょう？
　兄さんから目を離さないでって」
「姉さんは、いません」
「いないって……どういう事？」
　翡翠は答えない。
　ぎり、と秋葉は歯をならす。
―――いない？
　なに言ってるんだ、琥珀さんならさっき、裏庭のほうにいたじゃないか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Where is Kohaku? I told her too, didn’t I? I ordered her not to take her eyes off Brother.”
“My sister is not here.”
“What do you mean, not here?”
Hisui does not answer.
Akiha grinds her teeth.
―――Not here?
What is she talking about; Kohaku was in the rear garden just before I collapsed―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What about Kohaku?
Didn't I give her orders too?
Not to let Nii-san out of her sight?"
"Nee-san--is not here."
"Not here…… what do you mean by that?"
Hisui doesn't answer.
Akiha grinds her teeth.
---Not here?
What is she saying?
Kohaku-san was in the rear courtyard right now---

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま。
もう、やめましょう」
「―――翡翠」
「この人は違います。
違う人なんです。
この屋敷にいるときっと不幸になる。
だから、もうやめましょう」
「そんな話、今は聞きたくないわ」
「いえ、だからこそ申し上げるのです。
秋葉さまもお気づきになられているはずです。
志貴さまは、このままだと本当の殺人鬼になってしまいます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha. Please, let us stop.”
“―――Hisui”
“This man is different. He is not the same person. If he stays in this mansion, he will surely be unhappy. Please, let us stop this.”
“I don’t want to hear that now.”
“That is precisely why I must say it. You have realized it too, Miss Akiha. At this rate, Master Shiki will become a true murderer.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama.
We should stop doing this."
"---Hisui."
"He is different.
He is a different person.
This mansion, it is not good for him.
So, we should stop doing this."
"I don't want to hear those words!"
"No, that is why I must say them.
You realize it, too.
At this rate, Shiki-sama will really become a killer."

entries.japanese:
――――今。
翡翠は、なんて。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――Just now. What did Hisui say?
entries.mirrorMoon: ----Just now, what did Hisui say?

entries.japanese:
「……屋敷にいることで遠野の血が騒いでいるっていうの？
　それこそまさかよ。
兄さんに限って、それだけはありえないもの」
「……そうですね。
この人はわたしたちと同じ、槙久様の気紛れで―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You think living in this mansion has stirred the Tohno blood in him? Impossible. That one thing could never happen to Brother.”
“Yes. This man is like us, made so by Master Makihisa’s whim―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Are you saying his Tohno blood is awakened in this mansion?
That's ridiculous.
It's impossible for that to happen to Nii-san."
"…… You are right.
He is just like us, with Makihisa-sama's choice---"

entries.japanese:
瞬間。
　ぱん、と頬を叩く音が部屋に響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
At that instant.
A sharp slap cracks through the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In that instant.
Smack!
The sound of a cheek being slapped echoes throughout the room.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
それを口にする事は許さない、といったはずよ」
「…………………」
　二人はそれきり黙りこむ。
　息がつまりそうなほど張り詰めた空気が、二人の間に充満していた。
　……翡翠は辛そうにずっとうつむいている。
　秋葉がどうしてそんなに怒っているかは解らないけど、俺は、これ以上翡翠の辛そうな顔を見ていたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. I told you that you were never to speak of that.”
“…”
Neither of them says another word.
The air between them draws so taut it seems ready to choke me.
Hisui keeps her head bowed, plainly in pain.
I don’t understand why Akiha is so angry, but I can’t bear to watch Hisui suffer any longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I've told you that I won't allow anyone to say that."
"…………………"
The two become silent.
The air between the two of them increases in tension.
…… Hisui stands painfully with her head down.
I don't understand why Akiha is so angry, but I don't want to see Hisui in pain any longer.

entries.japanese:
「うーん」
　なんて、わざとらしく身をよじってみる。
「……翡翠、あとは任せます。
兄さんが起きたら、どうか労ってあげて」
「秋葉さまはよろしいのですか？」
「ええ。
私がいたら、逆に兄さんの体を弱らせてしまうもの」
　どこか自嘲するような苦笑いをのこして、秋葉は部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmm…”
I twist in the bed with deliberate theatricality.
“Hisui, I leave the rest to you. When Brother wakes, please take good care of him.”
“Will you not stay, Miss Akiha?”
“No. If I remain, I’ll only weaken him further.”
With a bitter, self-mocking smile, Akiha leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ugh."
Somehow, I manage to shift my body.
"…… Hisui, I leave the rest to you.
If Nii-san wakes, take care of what he needs."
"Akiha-sama, are you okay with this?"
"Yes.
If I'm here, Nii-san will just get weaker."
Akiha leaves the room with an extremely painful smile on her face.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　さて、俺はこれからどうしよう。
　まだ目が覚めていないフリをしていたほうがいいんだろうけど―――
「もう目を開けてよろしいかと思います、志貴さま」
「……なんだ、気がついてたのか。
人が悪いな。
翡翠」
「はい。
秋葉さまはお気づきになられませんでしたが。
……昔から、人の芝居を見抜くのが苦手な人ですから」
　遠慮がちに翡翠は言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Now what?
I should probably keep pretending to be asleep, but―――
“I believe you may open your eyes now, Master Shiki.”
“…You noticed? That was mean of you, Hisui.”
“Yes. Miss Akiha did not notice. She has always been poor at seeing through other people’s performances.”
Hisui says with hesitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
Well, what should I do now?
Maybe it's better if I just pretend I'm still asleep--
"Shiki-sama, I think it is safe now for you to open your eyes."
"…… Oh, you knew, Hisui."
"Yes, Akiha-sama did not realize it but…… Ever since a long time ago, she has never been good at being able to see through someone who is acting."
Hisui speaks reluctantly.

entries.japanese:
「……ふうん。
それじゃあ翡翠は敏感なんだ」
「……どうでしょう。
一番知りたい人の心が分かりませんから、わたしも自分が思っているほど勘がいい、というわけではないようです」
「そっか」
　うなずいて、なんとなく翡翠が言っているのは琥珀さんのことなんだろうな、と直感した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So you’re the perceptive one.”
“I’m not certain. I cannot understand the heart of the person I most wish to understand, so perhaps I am not as perceptive as I believed.”
“I see.”
I nod, intuiting somehow that she means Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Is that so?
But you are pretty perceptive."
"…… I do not know.
Since I cannot understand the heart of the person I want to know the most about, I do not think I am very perceptive."
"I see…"
Nodding, I somehow get the feeling she's talking about Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
さっき言ってたけど、琥珀さんはどこに行ったんだ？」
「……すみません。
わたし、姉さんの事はよくしらないんです」
「……………」
　なにか、ひっかかる。
　けど何がひっかかるのか、今の自分には考えつかなかった。
　こうしている間も。
　体はだるくて、話すことにさえ体力を使う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. You said something earlier—where has Kohaku gone?”
“I’m sorry. I do not know my sister very well.”
“…”
Something about that catches in my mind.
But in my present state I cannot say what.
Even as we speak, my body remains leaden.
Talking alone drains my strength.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui, you mentioned it earlier, but where did Kohaku-san go?"
"…… I am sorry.
I, do not know about Nee-san very well."
"…………"
Something about that response is not right.
But what's not right, I can't seem to grasp it right now.
As I am doing this right now.
My body is sluggish, and it takes all my strength just to talk.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、ご無理をなさっているのではありませんか……？」
「……うん。
白状すると、すごくだるい。
俺、いったいどうしちゃったんだ？」
「……志貴さまは裏庭で倒れていらしたのです。
いつもの貧血とは違っているようで、とにかく秋葉さまに連絡をいれてお部屋にお連れしました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you not pushing yourself too hard…?”
“…Honestly, I feel awful. What happened to me?”
“Master Shiki collapsed in the rear garden. It did not appear to be your usual anemia, so I contacted Miss Akiha and we carried you to your room.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you not pushing yourself?"
"…… To tell the truth, I feel extremely sluggish.
Just what in the world happened to me?"
"…… Shiki-sama, we found you collapsed in the rear courtyard.
It did not seem like your normal anemia, so we contacted Akiha-sama and brought you to your room."

entries.japanese:
……倒れた。
　裏庭で。
　白い陽射しと、空蝉の声。
entries.maoEnglish:
Collapsed.
In the rear garden.
White sunlight, and the voices of empty cicada shells.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Collapsed.
In the rear courtyard.
The white summer sunshine, and the voice of cicadas.

entries.japanese:
「――――思い出した。
そう、いきなり立ち眩みがしてさ。
そのままぐらっといっちまったんだ。
　……まいったなあ、こんなの小学校以来だ」
「……お医者さまをお呼びしようともしたのですが、秋葉さまがもう少し様子を見るように、と」
「……ああ、秋葉は正しいよ。
こんなのは精神的なものなんだから、医者を呼んでもどうにもならない。
で、どのくらい気を失ってたんだ、俺？」
「……志貴さまが倒れているのを見つけたのが昼過ぎでしたから、ちょうど十二時間ほどです」
「な―――もうそんな時間なのか！？」
　驚いて時計を見る。
　が、体が動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Now I remember. I was suddenly dizzy. Then everything tipped over.
What a mess; this hasn’t happened since elementary school.”
“I wished to summon a doctor, but Miss Akiha said we should watch you a little longer.”
“Akiha was right. This is all in my head, so a doctor couldn’t do anything. How long was I unconscious?”
“I found Master Shiki shortly after noon, so almost exactly twelve hours.”
“What―――it’s that late already?!”
Startled, I try to look at the clock.
My body refuses to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I remember.
I was standing, and then I got real dizzy.
Geez, I haven't had it this bad since elementary school."
"…… I thought that I should call the doctor, but Akiha-sama wanted us to wait and see."
"…… Yeah, Akiha's right.
This is more like a mental thing, so calling the doctor wouldn't have helped.
How long was I out?"
"…… I found you after noon, so approximately twelve hours."
"Th---that long!?"
Surprised, I look at the clock.
But, my body doesn't move.

entries.japanese:
「今は午前零時です。
今夜はここでお世話をさせていただきますから、何かありましたら遠慮なくお声をかけてください」
「あ……ああ、それは、頼もしいけど」
―――半日も意識を失っていたなんて、事故にあった時以来だ。
　くわえて、半日も眠っていたっていうのに体はまだ眠りたがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is midnight. I will attend you here tonight, so please call me without hesitation if you need anything.”
“Ah, yes; that’s reassuring, but”
―――I haven’t lost half a day like this since the accident.
Worse, despite sleeping for twelve hours, my body still craves more.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It is now midnight.
I will watch over you tonight, so please, if you need anything, do not hesitate to ask."
"O…… okay.
I appreciate it."
---I was unconscious for half a day, I haven't done that since that accident.
Furthermore, after sleeping for so long, my body is still wanting more sleep.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん。
なんか、すごく眠い……」
「それでしたらどうぞお眠りになってください。
わたしは廊下で控えさせていただきますから、何かありましたらすぐに」
「……なに……言ってるんだ。
看病してくれる人を、廊下になんて居させられないだろ。
……頼むから、翡翠は……ここに……」
―――くそ、声が続かない。
　ぐらり、と背中から水槽に落ちていくように。
　意識は、唐突に途絶えてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sorry. I’m so sleepy…”
“Then please rest. I will wait outside in the corridor and come at once if you call.”
“What are you saying? I can’t leave the person nursing me out in the hall. Please, Hisui, stay here…”
―――Damn it; I can’t keep my voice going.
The room reels, as though I am falling backward into a tank of water.
My consciousness cuts out without warning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm sorry.
I'm so sleepy……"
"Then please go to sleep.
I will be in the hallway, so if anything happens, I will be there."
"…… What…… are you saying?
I can't let someone taking care of me wait out in the hallway…… I have to ask, Hisui…… you stay… right… here."
---Damn it, I can't continue.
I feel as if I'm falling into a tank of water.
My consciousness ceases abruptly.

entries.maoEnglish: ――――――――And then, quite suddenly, I dream.
entries.mirrorMoon: --------I saw a dream.

entries.japanese:
暗い夜だった。
　夜半、なにか物音を聞いた気がして目を覚ました。
　座敷は無人。
　いつのまにか大人たちは出払ってしまったらしい。
　一人きりは不安になる。
　大人たちがどこに行ったのか確かめるために庭に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was a dark night.
Some sound woke me in the dead of night.
The room was empty.
At some point all the adults had gone out.
Being alone frightened me.
I went into the garden to find where they had gone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It was a dark night.
In the middle of the night, I thought I heard a noise and I woke up.
The tatami room was otherwise empty.
It seems at some point, all the adults went outside.
I was a little uneasy all by myself.
I went outside to the garden to see where they went.

entries.japanese:
それは、冬の凍えるような夜だった。
　吐く息が白い。
　庭は寒く、反面、夜空は美しかった。
　冴え凍える、という表現はこの冬の夜空のためにあるに違いない。
　凍る星。
深い闇。
　世界を照らす、命のない月の光。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was a winter night, cold enough to freeze.
My breath came white.
The garden was bitterly cold, but the night sky was beautiful.
That sky must have been what people meant by crystalline winter clarity.
Frozen stars. Bottomless dark.
Lifeless moonlight illuminating the world.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The night itself feels frozen by the winter cold.
My breath hangs white in the air.
The garden is cold, but at the same time, the sky was beautiful.
The expression "freezing cold" seems to have been made up just for this winter night.
The cold stars.
The deep darkness.
Illuminating this world is the lifeless moonlight.

entries.japanese:
子供の自分にとって、屋敷の庭は広すぎる。
　庭をすぎれば周囲は森。
　山奥にあるこの屋敷は、実のところ人間が住むような環境ではありえなかった。
　屋敷は暗い森の中にある。
　それは
　深海の底でともる、発光魚の明かりに似ていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
To a child, the mansion grounds were far too vast.
Beyond the garden lay forest on every side.
Hidden deep in the mountains, this mansion was not truly a place where human beings ought to live.
The mansion stood in the dark forest.
It was like
the glow of a luminous fish at the bottom of the sea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
For a child like myself, the mansion's garden is too big.
A dense forest encloses the garden.
The mansion is deep in the mountains, and to be honest, is no place for anyone to live.
The mansion is in the very heart of a dark forest.
It is…
like the light of a luminescent fish at the bottom of the ocean.

entries.japanese:
森の闇は深く高く、暗く遠い。
　もはや木々というより、月にまで届こうとする黒いカーテンそのものだ。
　音がして、大人たちが森の中にいるのだと確信した。
　森に中に入っていく。
　一切の光源さえない、絶対の闇がそこにある。
　自分の体さえ見えない闇の中、ただ音がする方向へ歩いていく。
　ただ　寒い。
　眼球の奥がしびれてしまう。
　その中で、自分の名前を呼ばれた気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
The forest’s darkness rose deep and high, remote and black.
The trees were no longer trees, but a curtain of night reaching for the moon.
I heard something and became certain the adults were inside.
I entered the forest.
Absolute darkness waited there, untouched by any source of light.
Unable to see even my own body, I walked only toward the sound.
It was cold.
So cold the backs of my eyes went numb.
Somewhere in that darkness, I thought I heard my name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The darkness of the forest swells deeply.
The trees are like a black curtain trying to reach for the moon.
I heard a noise, and was convinced the adults must have gone into the forest.
I enter the forest.
Not even a single ray of light exists in this darkness.
Unable to even see my own body, I walk towards the sound.
It's just   cold.
Even my eyes become numb.
I feel as if someone is calling my name.

entries.japanese:
葦切りの鳴き声。
　ザワザワとゆれる草。
　そこで、赤い鬼と出会った。
　鬼はこちらには関心がなく。
　自分も、その鬼には関心はなかった。
　紅。
赤。
朱。
　緋色の海原と化した野原を、越える。
entries.maoEnglish:
The cry of a reed warbler.
Grass stirring and whispering.
There, I met a red demon.
The demon took no interest in me.
I took none in it.
Crimson. Red. Vermilion.
I crossed a field transformed into a scarlet sea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A reed warbler's cry.
The swaying grass.
There, I met a red demon.
The demon does not seem to be interested in me.
At the same time, I am not concerned with the demon either.
Crimson.
Red.
Vermillion.
I walk past the field that has turned into a crimson sea.

entries.japanese:
木々が切り取られた広場に出る。
　そこには、大人たちの死体が散乱していた。
　暗いはずの大地は毒々しい朱に染まって、まるで世界という生き物が流血しているように見える。
entries.maoEnglish:
I emerged into a clearing cut from the trees.
The adults’ bodies lay scattered everywhere.
The earth, which should have been dark, was steeped in poisonous vermilion, as though the world itself were bleeding.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The trees part into a clearing.
There, the scattered corpses of all the adults are littered all over the ground.
The dark ground is bathed in poisonous red, as if the entire world was bleeding.

entries.maoEnglish: ――――――That was.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------That is.

entries.japanese: 流血する大地には、大人たちを殺した敵がいる。
entries.maoEnglish: Upon the bleeding earth stood the enemy who had killed the adults.
entries.mirrorMoon: In the middle of the bleeding earth, the enemy that slaughtered the adults is standing there.

entries.japanese: ――――――一番初めの、悪い夢。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――The very first nightmare.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------The very first nightmare.

entries.japanese:
敵はこの身さえ殺そうと近寄ってくる。
　母は、この身を庇って切り殺された。
entries.maoEnglish:
The enemy approached to kill me too.
Mother was cut down shielding my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The enemy approaches to kill even me.
My mother dies, protecting me.

entries.japanese: ――――――顔にかかる、熱い血液。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――Hot blood splashed across my face.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------Blood splatters onto my face.

entries.japanese:
凍えるような夜の中で。
　その、温かさが。
entries.maoEnglish:
In the freezing night.
That warmth…
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the middle of this frigid night.
That warmth.

entries.japanese: ――――――初めて嫌悪した、色。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――The first color I ever hated.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------The first hated color.

entries.japanese:
敵の爪が胸に刺さった。
　あまりの寒さに麻痺していたおかげだろう。
　痛みは、あまり感じなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The enemy’s claws pierced my chest.
Perhaps the cold had numbed me too completely.
It did not hurt very much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The claws of the enemy pierce my chest.
Maybe I was numb from the coldness.
I didn't really feel much pain.

entries.maoEnglish: ――――――I looked up at the heavens.
entries.mirrorMoon: ------I look up at the heavens.

entries.japanese:
世界が醜く溶けていく。
　その中で、唯一不変の蒼い闇。
entries.maoEnglish:
The world melted into ugliness.
Within it, only the blue darkness remained unchanged.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The whole world starts to melt away.
There, the unchanging, pale darkness.

entries.japanese: ――――――なんて　キレイ
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――How beautiful
entries.mirrorMoon: ------How   beautiful.

entries.japanese: それは　硝子のような、儚い月。
entries.maoEnglish: It was a fragile moon, like glass.
entries.mirrorMoon: The ephemeral glass moon.

entries.japanese: ああ───気がつかなかった。
entries.maoEnglish: Ah───I hadn’t noticed.
entries.mirrorMoon: Ah---I didn't realize it.

entries.japanese: こんやはこんなにも
entries.maoEnglish: tonight, the moon is so
entries.mirrorMoon: Tonight,

entries.japanese: つきが、きれい────だ─────
entries.maoEnglish: beautiful────it is─────
entries.mirrorMoon: The moon is so----beautiful-----

entries.maoEnglish:
………………………………………… A door clicks softly shut, and my consciousness drifts free of the memory. My heart rises toward the surface.
Reality waits above.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………… A door closes softly and my consciousness separates from my memories.
My heart surfaces.
Reality is on the surface.

entries.japanese:
―――――そうして、旧い夢から目が覚めた。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――And so I awaken from that ancient dream.!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon: -----And I wake from the old dream.

entries.japanese:
「あれ……なんで」
　頬にふれて、自分が泣いている事に気がついた。
　なにが悲しかったのか、なにが痛かったのか、よく解らない。
　ただ、ひどく大切なものから離されたという感覚だけ、胸に残っている。
「悪い夢じゃなかった、のかな」
　今まで見ていた殺人の夢とは違っていたと思う。
　昨夜は何日かぶりに、よく眠れた夜だった。
　それもきっと、翡翠が近くで看ていてくれたからだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What… why”
Touching my cheek, I realize I am crying.
I don’t know what made me sad, or what caused me pain.
Only the feeling of having been torn from something terribly precious remains inside my chest.
“Maybe it wasn’t a bad dream after all.”
It felt different from the dreams of murder I have been having.
For the first time in days, I slept well last night.
Surely that was because Hisui stayed nearby and watched over me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
…… Why?"
Touching my cheeks, I realize I was crying.
I don't know what was so painful, or what was so sad.
Only, the feeling that I just lost something extremely important remains in my heart.
"Was it a nightmare?"
I think this is different than those dreams where I killed people.
But it was the first time that I slept so well in many days.
Maybe it was because Hisui was watching me the whole time.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠？」
　体を起こして部屋を見渡す。
　翡翠の姿はない。
　さっき扉が閉まるような音を聞いた気がするのは、翡翠が出ていったからだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui?”
I sit up and look around.
She is gone.
I thought I heard a door close a moment ago; perhaps that was her leaving.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui?"
I lift my body and look around the room.
I don't see Hisui anywhere.
The sound I heard of a door closing was probably her leaving the room just a second ago.

entries.japanese:
ともかく朝だ。
　今日は金曜日、学校は当然のようにある。
「さて、起きなくっちゃ」
　昨日の後遺症か、ベッドから立ちあがると少しだけ吐き気がした。
「着替えは……なんだ、まだ用意してないんだ」
　翡翠は学生服を取りに行ったらしい。
　それならすぐに戻ってくるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
In any case, it is morning.
Today is Friday, so of course there is school.
“All right, time to get up.”
Perhaps from yesterday’s ordeal, a faint wave of nausea passes through me when I rise from the bed.
“She hasn’t laid my clothes out yet.”
Hisui must have gone to fetch my uniform.
She’ll be back soon, then.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Anyway, it is now morning.
Today is Friday, so I should go to school.
"I have to get up."
Maybe it's the aftereffects of yesterday, but I feel a little nauseous when I stand up.
"I should change…… What's this, my clothes aren't ready?"
It seems like Hisui went to pick up my uniform.
Which means she should return soon.

entries.japanese:
「……あ……れ」
　突然、力を失って前のめりに倒れこんだ。
　いつもの眩暈―――なんだけど、立ちあがれない。
　腕や足に力が入らない。
　なんとか腕は動くものの、自分の体さえ持ち上げられない。
「……ちょっと、うそだろ」
　必死になって力をこめる。
　だけど動かない。
腕立て伏せの一回もできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Without warning, all strength leaves me and I pitch forward.
It feels like my usual dizziness, except I cannot stand again.
There is no strength in my arms or legs.
I can move my arms a little, but not enough to lift my own body.
“You’ve got to be kidding.”
I strain with everything I have.
Nothing happens. I cannot manage even a single push-up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hu…… h?"
All of a sudden, all strength drains from my body and I collapse.
It feels just like the normal dizziness---only I can't get back up.
I can't put any power into my arms or legs.
I can barely move my arm, but I can't even get up from the ground.
"…… This can't be happening."
I desperately try to get up.
But I can't move.
I can't even do a single push-up from here.

entries.japanese:
「まいったな……体、まだ本調子じゃないみたいだ」
　絨毯に転がったまま、素直に現状を受け入れた。
　このまま躍起になって起きあがろうと努力しても、起きあがれないのは明白だ。
　別に苦しいというわけでもなし、しばらく横になっていればいずれ体力も戻ってくれるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is bad; I guess my body hasn’t recovered yet.”
Still sprawled on the carpet, I accept the situation.
Frantic struggling clearly will not get me upright.
I’m not in pain, so if I lie here awhile, my strength should eventually return.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez…… looks like my condition is still pretty bad."
Floundering around on the carpet, I take in my situation.
It's obvious that I won't be able to get up no matter how hard I try.
It's not that I'm in so much pain, so I should feel better if I lay here for a while.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、着替えを持ってまいりました」
　ガチャリ、とドアが開いて翡翠が入ってくる。
「――――志貴さま！？」
　悲鳴のような声と、駆けつけてくる足音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I have brought your clothes.”
The door opens with a click, and Hisui enters.
“――――Master Shiki!?”
Her voice is almost a scream as footsteps rush toward me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, I have your clothes ready."
Hisui opens the door and walks into my room.
"----Shiki-sama!?"
Hisui's voice rings out like a scream, and her footsteps rush toward me.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、しっかりしてください、志貴さま……！」
　翡翠は必死に呼びかけてくる。
「やっ、おはよう翡翠。
その、倒れただけだからそう心配しないでくれないか」
「倒れただけって―――なにを言ってらっしゃるんですか、志貴さまは……！」
「大丈夫だって。
起こしてくれれば、すぐにいつも通りになれるから」
「はい、かしこまりました―――」
　即座にうなずいて、翡翠は俺の肩に手を伸ばす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, please, answer me, Master Shiki…!”
Hisui calls to me desperately.
“Morning, Hisui. I only fell over, so could you please not worry so much?”
“Only fell over―――what are you saying, Master Shiki…!”
“I’m fine. Help me up and I’ll be back to normal.”
“Yes, at once―――”
She nods immediately and reaches for my shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please hold on, Shiki-sama……!"
Hisui frantically calls my name.
"Hey, morning Hisui.
I just fell down a little, so there's no need to panic."
"Just fell down---what are you saying, Shiki-sama, you…… !"
"I'm fine.
If you let me up, I will be fine."
"As you wish---"
Hisui immediately stoops down and reaches her hand to my shoulder.

entries.japanese:
「あ……」
　ぴたり、と翡翠の腕が止まる。
　翡翠は緊張した面持ちで、額に汗さえうかべて、必死に腕を伸ばそうと努力している。
　けど、それ以上のことはなかった。
　翡翠は見ているこっちのほうが辛くなってしまうぐらい、唇を噛んで、必死に俺の体に触れようと努力して、体を震わせている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
Her arm stops dead.
Face taut, sweat beading on her brow, Hisui fights desperately to make herself reach farther.
But nothing more happens.
She bites her lip and trembles, struggling so desperately to touch me that merely watching becomes painful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……"
Hisui suddenly stops her hand.
With a strained face, Hisui desperately reaches out her hand with all her will, sweat appearing on her forehead.
But that is all she can do.
Biting her lip, Hisui tries frantically to touch my shoulder, but she just stands there, shaking uncontrollably.

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
いや、無理はしなくていいよ翡翠。
琥珀さんを呼んできてくれればそれでいいだろ」
「……………………」
　翡翠はこくん、とうなずいて駆け出していった。
「……なんだろうな。
翡翠の潔癖症も、なんだか根が深そうだ」
　倒れたままで、気楽にそんなコトを呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. Don’t force yourself, Hisui; just go and fetch Kohaku. That will do.”
“…”
Hisui gives one small nod and runs from the room.
“What is it with her? Hisui’s squeamishness about physical contact must run pretty deep.”
Still lying there, I mutter it casually.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
No, don't push yourself, Hisui.
Just go get Kohaku-san and it'll be fine."
"………………"
Hisui nods and runs out of the room.
"…… What was that all about?
Hisui's obsession about cleanliness looks pretty bad."
Collapsed on the floor, I carelessly voice my thoughts.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんはすぐにやってきて、俺に肩を貸してくれた。
　……といってもこっちは体に力が入ってくれないものだから、ほとんどが琥珀さんがやってくれた。
　俺が脱力しているからなのだろうか、琥珀さんは“志貴さんったら女の子みたいに軽いですねー”なんて言っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku comes at once and lends me her shoulder.
Though since my body has no strength at all, she ends up doing almost everything herself. Perhaps because I’m completely limp, she remarks, “Goodness, Master Shiki, you’re as light as a girl.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san arrives soon and lends me her shoulder.
…… Actually, since I don't have any power, Kohaku-san does most of the work.
Probably because I'm so weak, but Kohaku-san has the gall to say that I'm as light as a girl.

entries.japanese:
「おっかしいな……別段どうってことないんだけど、体が動かない」
「そうですねー、とりあえず熱もないようですし、ちょっと様子を見てみないことにはなんとも言えません。
けど顔色もよろしいですし、しばらくすれば回復されると思いますよ」
　琥珀さんは笑顔を崩さず、俺の体温を測ったりする。
　その笑顔のおかげでこっちも気を楽にできるんだけど……
entries.maoEnglish:
“Strange; I don’t feel especially ill, but my body won’t move.”
“Let me see. You don’t appear to have a fever, but I can’t say much until we watch you for a while; you look well enough, so I expect your strength will return soon.”
Still smiling, Kohaku takes my temperature and looks me over.
Her smile helps me relax, but
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's strange…… there's nothing wrong, but my body just won't move."
"I see, you do not seem sick, but I can't say anything unless we wait a while.
But your face looks fine.
I think you will recover soon."
Still smiling, Kohaku-san takes my temperature.
Because of her smile, I do feel a little more at ease, but……

entries.japanese:
翡翠はさっきから顔を曇らせたままだった。
　今も琥珀さんの背中に隠れるようにして、こっちの様子をちらちらと盗み見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s face has remained clouded all this time.
Even now she half-hides behind Kohaku, stealing anxious glances at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui has a clouded expression.
Even right now, she seems to be hiding behind Kohaku-san and looks at me occasionally.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん……！」
―――と。
　血相を変えて、秋葉が部屋に駆けつけて来た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…!”
―――And then.
Akiha rushes into the room, her face transformed with alarm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san……!"
---And.
With a bit of a panic, Akiha bursts into the room.

entries.japanese:
「やっ。
朝から元気がいいんだな、秋葉」
　片手をあげて挨拶をする。
「なっ―――」
　だっていうのに、秋葉のヤツは人の顔を見た途端、お化けでも見るような驚きかたをしてくれる。
「なんだよ、大げさだな。
別にどこもおかしくないんだから、そう恐い顔しないでくれ。
なんだかこっちまで心配になってくる」
「それは……そうかもしれません、けど―――」
　青い顔をして、秋葉はじっとこっちを見つめてくる。
　俺本人はたいした事じゃないってわかってるのに、翡翠と秋葉は遠野志貴がひどい重症だと勘違いしているらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey. Full of energy this morning, aren’t you?”
I raise one hand in greeting.
“What―――”
Even so, the instant she sees me, Akiha recoils as though she has seen a ghost.
“Come on, don’t be so dramatic. There’s nothing wrong with me, so don’t look so terrified. You’re going to make me worry too.”
“Perhaps you’re right, but―――”
Pale-faced, Akiha stares at me.
I know perfectly well this is nothing serious, but Hisui and Akiha seem convinced that Shiki Tohno is gravely ill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yo.
You're pretty energetic this morning, Akiha."
I raise my hand to greet her.
"Wha---"
After seeing my face, her expression transforms into surprise.
"What's with this exaggeration?
I'm fine, so don't make such a scary face.
If you do that, I'll be the one to start worrying."
"That…… may be true, but---"
Akiha stares at me with a pale face.
I really am fine, but it seems like Hisui and Akiha honestly think that I am deathly ill or something.

entries.japanese:
「……そんなにひどい顔してるのかな、いまの俺って」
「そんなことないですよ。
志貴さんはいつもどおりです。
　ともあれ、まだ体のほうは本調子じゃないようですから、今日一日はゆっくりしていてください。
学校には電話をしておきますから」
「……そうね。
うちの主治医にも連絡をお願い。
一応、精密検査をしてもらいましょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do I really look that awful?”
“Not at all. You look just as you always do, Shiki.
Still, your body has plainly not recovered, so please rest for the day. I’ll telephone the school.”
“…Yes; contact our family physician as well. We should have him perform a thorough examination.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Do I look that bad right now?"
"No, Shiki-san.
You look like you always do.
But still, your body is not fully recovered so I think you should take the day off.
I'll go call your school to let them know."
"…… Yes.
Please call the doctor as well.
He can perform a more thorough examination."

entries.japanese:
「精密検査ねえ……そんな必要はないと思うけどな」
「―――兄さん。
精密検査がイヤでしたら、このまま入院してもらいますけど、それでよろしいですか」
「あ……いや、精密検査のほうが、いいです」
「けっこうです。
それじゃ琥珀、翡翠。
兄さんのことをよろしくお願いします。
　この人はご自分の体を気遣えない人だから、その分あなたたちで気遣ってあげて」
　散々な言い付けをして、秋葉は部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I really don’t think a thorough examination is necessary.”
“―――Brother. If you object to an examination, would you rather be admitted to the hospital?”
“Ah, no; I’d prefer the examination.”
“Very well. Kohaku, Hisui. I leave Brother in your care.
Since he is incapable of looking after his own health, you must do it for him.”
After issuing that merciless order, Akiha leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A thorough examination?
…… I don't think I really need that."
"---Nii-san, if you don't care for an examination, maybe we should check you into a hospital instead?"
"Ah…… No, an examination will be fine."
"Alright.
Kohaku, Hisui, please take care of Nii-san.
Since he does not seem to concern himself with his health, please do that for him."
Akiha gives severe instructions and departs the room.

entries.japanese:
「それではわたしはお電話をしてきますね」
　琥珀さんも部屋から出ていった。
　残ったのは、寝たきりの自分とうつむいている翡翠だけになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I’ll go make the calls.”
Kohaku leaves as well.
Only Hisui, still hanging her head, and bedridden me remain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"In that case, I'll use the telephone, okay?"
Kohaku-san leaves the room as well.
The only ones left are me lying on the bed, and Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠？」
「……はい、なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「うん。
俺なら大丈夫だから、自分の仕事に戻っていいよ。
体も思うように動いてくれないし、ベッドから抜け出して外に出ることなんかないからさ」
「………………」
　翡翠はうつむいたまま、一歩も動こうとしない。
「……翡翠？
　どうしたんだ、さっきから様子がおかしいぞ。
気分が悪いんなら、俺になんかかまってないで休んでくれ」
「……………………」
　翡翠はますます黙りこんでしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui?”
“…Yes, Master Shiki?”
“I’m all right, so you may return to your work. My body won’t cooperate anyway; I certainly can’t climb out of bed and go wandering.”
“…”
Hisui keeps her head lowered and does not move.
“…Hisui? What’s wrong? You’ve been acting strangely. If you feel ill, forget about me and go rest.”
“…”
She retreats into an even deeper silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui?"
"…… Yes, what is it, Shiki-sama?"
"I'm fine, so you can go back to your duties.
Since I can't really move, it's not like I'll be going anywhere."
"…………"
Hisui does not even budge a single step.
"…… Hisui?
What's wrong, you've been acting a little strange.
If you feel sick, go ahead and rest; I don't mind."
"……………………"
Hisui stands there in silence.

entries.japanese:
……と。
　不意に、意を決したように翡翠は声をあげた。
「……志貴さまは、お怒りでは、ないのですか」
「へ？
　お怒りって、なにに」
「ですから、先ほどのことです。
……わたしは志貴さまのお世話をしなくてはいけないのに、志貴さまを助けることさえできなくて……」
「―――――翡翠」
　……驚いた。
そんな事を気にしていたなんて、思わなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then.
Having made up her mind, Hisui suddenly raises her voice.
“Master Shiki, are you not angry with me?”
“Huh? Angry about what?”
“About what happened earlier. I’m supposed to care for Master Shiki, yet I couldn’t even help Master Shiki…”
“―――――Hisui”
I’m taken aback. I had no idea she was tormenting herself over that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… And then.
All of a sudden, as if making up her mind, Hisui says,
"…… Shiki-sama, you are not mad?"
"Wha…?
Mad about what?"
"Of what happened before.
…… Even though I should take care of you, I could not even help you……"
"-----Hisui."
…… I am shocked.
I didn't even think about that.

entries.japanese:
「たしかに、さっきはちょっとショックだったかな。
すぐ翡翠が起こしてくれるかなって期待してたのに、結局は琥珀さんに起こされる事になったし」
「………………」
「けど、そんなのはどうでもいい話だよ。
翡翠は気付いてないかもしれないけど、俺はすごく翡翠に助けられてる。
それに比べたら、さっきの事なんてほんのご愛嬌なんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I admit it was a little disappointing. I thought you would lift me right up, but Kohaku had to do it in the end.”
“…”
“But that doesn’t matter. You may not realize it, Hisui, but you help me enormously. Compared with that, what happened earlier is nothing—just one of those little mishaps.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, it was a bit of a surprise.
I thought that you would be able to help me right away, but it ended up being Kohaku-san."
"……………"
"But I don't care about that.
You may not realize it, Hisui, but you have already helped me so much.
Compared to that, what happened earlier is nothing."

entries.japanese:
「……そう、でしょうか。
わたしは少しも志貴さまのお役にたっていないと思います」
「分かってないな。
俺がこうして落ち着いていられるのは翡翠のおかげなんだ。
……本当にお世辞とかじゃなくて、翡翠がいなかったら俺はとっくにどうかしてたんだから」
「……？
　わたしが、ですか？」
「そうだよ。
俺さ、ここんところずっと情緒不安定でいつも悪い夢を見るんだ。
　けど翡翠が毎朝おはようって言ってくれるから、俺はなんとか穏やかでいられてるんだと思う。
―――だから、俺はもう何度も翡翠には助けられてる。
今日だって、翡翠が来てくれてすごく嬉しかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is that truly so? I don’t believe I have been of any help to Master Shiki.”
“You don’t understand. The reason I can remain calm like this is you. That isn’t flattery; without you, I would have lost my mind long ago.”
“…I have?”
“You have. Lately my emotions have been all over the place, and I have nightmares constantly.
But every morning you say good morning to me, and I think that’s what lets me stay sane.
―――So you’ve already saved me many times. Even today, I was so glad when you came.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Really?
I do not think I am very useful."
"You don't understand, it seems.
I'm able to be calm right now because of you being here.
…… It's more than you looking after me; if you weren't here, I don't know what I would do."
"……?
Because of me?"
"Of course.
Ever since I came here, I've been uneasy, and always had these nightmares.
But when you say good morning to me every day, I'm able to be at peace.
---Therefore, you have helped me so many times.
Like today, when you came, it made me happy."

entries.japanese:
「え……あ、はい、ありがとうございます」
「ええっと、つまりそういうコトだよ。
体になんか触れなくても、翡翠はちゃんと言葉で伝えてきてくれるだろ？
　それだけで嬉しいことって、いっぱいあると思うよ。
だから、翡翠はすごく俺を助けてくれてるんだって」
「あの……ほんとうに、そうでしょうか」
「本当もほんとう。
その証拠にね、今朝はまだ朝を迎えたような気になれないんだ。
こっちはちゃんと言ったのに、翡翠がまだ言ってくれないから」
「―――――――」
　翡翠はおずおずとこちらに視線を向けたあと、小さく、深呼吸をしたように見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh—ah, yes; thank you.”
“That’s what I mean. You don’t have to touch me; you make your feelings clear in words, don’t you? Words alone can make someone happy in all sorts of ways. That’s why I’m saying you help me so much.”
“Do you truly mean that?”
“Absolutely. Here’s proof: it still doesn’t feel like morning has begun. I greeted you, but you haven’t said it back yet.”
“―――――――”
Hisui timidly meets my eyes, then appears to take a deep breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Eh…… Ah, thank you very much."
"Um, that's how it is.
Even if you can't touch me, your words reach me, don't they?
Just that makes me happy enough.
Hisui, you are extremely helpful."
"Um…… are you serious?"
"I'm very serious.
As proof, I don't feel like it's morning yet.
It's because even though I said it, you haven't said it yet."
"-------"
Hisui looks at me timidly and takes a small breath.

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
おはようございます、志貴さま」
　かすかに頬を染めて、翡翠はまっすぐな眼差しで言い忘れた言葉を告げてくる。
「そうゆうこと。
人間誰にだって向き不向きがあるんだから、あんまり気にする必要はないよ。
翡翠は翡翠の出来るコトをしてくれればいいんだから」
「……………」
　翡翠は何も答えない。
　ただ、じっと何かを考えるようにこっちを見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Good morning, Master Shiki.”
A faint blush touches her cheeks as she meets my eyes and offers the greeting she forgot.
“Exactly. Everyone has things they’re suited to and things they aren’t, so don’t dwell on it. Just do what you can, in your own way.”
“…”
Hisui does not answer.
She merely studies me, lost in thought.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, good morning, Shiki-sama."
She blushes a bit as she says the words she forgot to say this morning.
"That's the thing.
Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses, so don't worry about it.
Hisui, as long as you do what you do, everything will be alright."
"……………"
Hisui does not respond.
She just looks at me as if she is deep in thought.

entries.japanese:
「あー、その……そう睨まれると緊張するんだけど、翡翠」
「は、はいっ、もうしわけありません」
　言って、翡翠は逃げるように扉へと歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Um, Hisui, when you stare at me that hard, I get nervous.”
“Y-yes, I beg your pardon!”
With that, Hisui retreats toward the door as if fleeing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-, if you stare at me like that, I'll start to get nervous, Hisui."
"Y, yes, forgive me."
After saying that, Hisui starts to escape towards the door.

entries.japanese:
「それでは失礼します。
姉さんが連絡をしてくれたようですから、じきお医者さまがお見えになるでしょう」
　いつものふかぶかとしたお辞儀もおざなりに、翡翠はトタトタと足音をたてて退室していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please excuse me. My sister appears to have made the arrangements, so the doctor should arrive shortly.”
Barely remembering her usual deep bow, Hisui patters hastily from the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please excuse me.
It appears that Nee-san has contacted the doctor, so he should be here soon."
Bowing quickly, Hisui swiftly heads out the door.

entries.japanese:
精密検査といっても、どうせ血圧とかを測る程度だと楽観していたのが甘かった。
　さすがはお金持ちというか常識から外れているっていうか、精密検査にやってきたお医者さんはなにやらとゴテゴテした機械を隣の部屋に持ちこんで、簡易診察室を用意してくれた。
　本格的に体中の検査をされて、お医者さんが屋敷を後にしたのが正午すぎ。
　俺が琥珀さんに肩をかりて部屋に戻ったのは当然その後で、都合四時間近く拘束されていたことになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I had optimistically assumed that a thorough examination meant no more than taking my blood pressure.
I was naive: whether because the Tohnos are rich or simply divorced from common sense, the doctor arrives with a heap of elaborate equipment and turns the adjoining room into a temporary clinic.
After subjecting every part of me to a proper examination, the doctor finally leaves shortly after noon.
Only then does Kohaku help me back to my room; altogether, they kept me captive for nearly four hours.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It was my fault for thinking that a thorough examination would be just taking blood pressure and a few measurements.
Being a rich family's doctor, the doctor brings a lot of equipment and sets up an examination room next to mine.
After an exhaustive evaluation, the doctor leaves after noon.
Leaning on Kohaku's shoulder, I stumble back to my room.
All in all, everything took about four hours.

entries.japanese:
「…………はあ」
　ベッドに横になって、軽くため息をつく。
　あれだけ検査をしても異状は見当たらないという事だった。
　……まあ、そもそも八年前の事故で命をとりとめた時点で奇跡的だったんだから、お医者さまも原因不明の病状、というものをあっさり受け入れてくれた。
　とりあえずの方針として、こうしてベッドで休んでいる事が最適らしい。
　点滴をされるのかとも思ったが、異状のない体に薬を投与するのはそれこそ危険なんだそうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haa.”
Lying in bed, I let out a small sigh.
Despite all those tests, they found nothing wrong.
Then again, my survival after the accident eight years ago was itself a miracle, so the doctor readily accepts another unexplained condition.
For now, apparently, the best treatment is simply to rest in bed.
I thought they might put me on an IV, but administering medicine to a body with no detectable abnormality would be dangerous in its own right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Whew."
Lying on my bed, I give a little sigh.
Even after the examination, he did not find anything wrong with me.
…… Well, ever since the accident eight years ago and my miraculous recovery, the doctor has always blamed any mysterious symptoms upon it.
Well, the best policy is just to sleep here in bed.
I thought maybe I should get an IV or something, but if there's nothing wrong with my body, he said it's better if I don't take any medicine.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さーん、中に入りますよー」
　琥珀さんが入ってきた。
　その手にはお盆と、お粥らしきものが見られる。
「朝から何も食べていなかったですからね。
遅くなりましたけどお食事をお持ちしました」
「そっか。
さんきゅ、琥珀さん」
「いえいえ、これもわたしのお仕事ですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I’m coming in!”
Kohaku enters.
She carries a tray and what looks like rice porridge.
“You haven’t eaten anything since morning. It’s late, but I brought you some lunch.”
“Oh. Thanks, Kohaku.”
“Think nothing of it; this is my job.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-saaan, I'm coming in."
Kohaku-san enters my room.
She carries something like rice porridge on a tray.
"You haven't had anything since this morning, right?
It is a little late, but I brought you something to eat."
"Oh.
Thanks, Kohaku-san."
"Not at all, this is my job, after all."

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんは枕元までやってくると、らんらんと鼻歌を歌いながらスプーンを持ったりする。
「あの、琥珀さん？」
「はい、あーんしてください、あーん」
　ニコニコ笑顔で、この人はとても恥ずかしいことを強要してきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku comes to my bedside, humming merrily as she picks up a spoon.
“Um, Kohaku?”
“Now open wide—say aah.”
Beaming, she demands something mortifying of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kohaku-san walks right next to my pillow, humming merrily as she holds the spoon.
"Um, Kohaku-san?"
"Yes, please open your mouth wide."
With a big smile, she asks me to do something extremely embarrassing.

entries.japanese:
「…………え？」
　事態を掴めずに、ぽかんと口をあける。
　と、琥珀さんはおかゆをすくったスプーンを冷ましてから、俺の口にスプーンをさしいれた。
―――そのまま、開いているほうの手でもぎゅもぎゅとこっちのアゴを動かしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
Too bewildered to understand, I let my mouth fall open.
Kohaku cools a spoonful of porridge, then slips it between my lips.
―――With her free hand, she takes hold of my chin and works my jaw up and down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Eh?"
Not quite understanding the situation, I just open my mouth.
And then, after cooling down the rice in the spoon, she sticks the spoon in my mouth.
---With her open hand she holds my jaw and moves it up and down.

entries.japanese:
「……琥珀さん。
その、なんの冗談？」
「冗談じゃないですよ。
志貴さんは病人なんですから、お食事をお助けするのは当然じゃないですか」
　にっこりと笑顔をうかべて、琥珀さんは第二撃を放ってきた。
「んぐっ―――」
　とりあえず、今度は自分の力で咀嚼する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…Kohaku, what kind of joke is this?”
“It isn’t a joke. You’re ill, Master Shiki, so of course I have to help you eat.”
Smiling sweetly, Kohaku launches her second attack.
“Mmph―――”
This time, at least, I chew under my own power.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kohaku-san, is this some sort of joke?"
"Not at all.
Shiki-san, you are sick, so it is only natural that I help you to eat."
Smiling, Kohaku-san proceeds to attack me a second time.
"Gw---"
This time, I am able to swallow it by myself.

entries.japanese:
「はい、よくできました。
それじゃこんな感じでいきましょうね志貴さん」
「ちょっ、ちょっと待って琥珀さん……！
　病人っていうけど、俺はただの貧血ですってば。
こんなふうにしてもらわなくても、食事ぐらいは自分で食べられます……！」
「はい、いいから大人しくしててください。
わたし、こういうのは慣れてるんですから」
　えっへん、と胸をはって琥珀さんは第三撃を繰り出してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very good. We’ll carry on just like this, Master Shiki.”
“W-wait, Kohaku…! You keep calling me ill, but I’m only anemic. I can feed myself without all this…!”
“Now, now; lie still and behave. I’m very experienced at this.”
Puffing out her chest, Kohaku launches her third attack.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good job!
Keep it up, Shiki-san."
"Wa, wait a second, Kohaku-san……!
I may be sick, but it's just my anemia.
I can handle feeding myself……!"
"Sure, sure, now please calm down.
I'm used to things like this."
Kohaku-san gives a pleased giggle and starts to attack me a third time.

entries.japanese:
「んっ―――」
　強引にスプーンを口にいれられて、仕方なくアゴを動かす。
「お味のほうはどうですか？
　有間のお家の方から、志貴さんは梅のおかゆが好物だって聞いたんですけど」
「……はい、たしかにおいしいです」
「よかった。
それじゃ遠慮なく食べてくださいね」
　琥珀さんはとても楽しそうだ。
「……はあ」
　どうも、何を言っても無駄みたいだ。
　観念して琥珀さんの看病をうけることにする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mmph―――”
The spoon is forced into my mouth, leaving me no choice but to chew.
“How does it taste? The Arimas told me that plum porridge is one of your favorites, Master Shiki.”
“Yes, it’s very good.”
“Wonderful. Then eat as much as you like.”
Kohaku is having the time of her life.
“Haa.”
Clearly, nothing I say will matter.
Resigned, I submit to her nursing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn---"
She puts the spoon into my mouth forcefully, and I can't help but just swallow it down.
"How does it taste?
I heard that when you lived with the Arimas you liked plum porridge."
"…… Yes, it is very tasty."
"That's good.
Then please, eat as much as you like."
Kohaku-san appears to be having a fun time.
"…… Haa."
It seems whatever I say will have no effect.
I give up and let Kohaku-san do what she wants.

entries.japanese:
……。
　…………。
　………………恥ずかしい。
　恥ずかしいんだけど、嬉しいことには、まあ変わりはない。
　琥珀さんの作ってくれたおかゆは美味しくて、あっというまに食事は終わってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………This is humiliating
Humiliating, yes, but that does not make it any less pleasant.
Kohaku’s porridge is delicious, and the meal is over before I know it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……
…………
……………… I'm so embarrassed.
I'm embarrassed, but I suppose I'm a little happy as well.
Kohaku-san's cooking is so delicious, and I finish pretty quickly.

entries.japanese:
「ところで志貴さん、お体の調子はどうですか？」
「いや、別に。
だるいだけだからいつもの貧血と変わらないよ」
「そうですか。
志貴さんは子供のころにもここで大怪我をしているんですから、無理をしちゃだめですよ」
　食器を片付けながら、琥珀さんは、そんな事を言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“By the way, Master Shiki, how are you feeling?”
“Fine. I’m only tired, so it’s no different from my usual anemia.”
“I see. You were badly injured here as a child, Master Shiki, so you mustn’t overexert yourself.”
Kohaku says it while clearing the dishes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"By the way, Shiki-san, how do you feel?"
"I'm fine.
It just feels like my regular anemia."
"Is that so?
When you were a child, you received a serious injury here, too, so please do not push yourself."
Kohaku-san says this as she straightens up the dishes.

entries.japanese:
「―――琥珀さん。
それ、どういう意味？」
「え？
　どういう意味もなにも、志貴さんは八年前に事故にあって大怪我をしたんでしょう？
　その養生のために有間の家に預けられたって聞いてますけど？」
「いや、それはそうなんだけど……この屋敷で大怪我なんか俺はしてな―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Kohaku. What do you mean by that?”
“Hm? Master Shiki, you were in an accident eight years ago and badly hurt, weren’t you? I heard you were sent to live with the Arimas while you recovered.”
“Yes, that’s true, but I wasn’t badly injured here at the mansion―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Kohaku-san, what is that supposed to mean?"
"Eh?
That just means that you were in an accident and were really injured eight years ago, right?
I heard that's why you were adopted by the Arimas: to help to get better."
"That's true, but that's not what I meant…… you said that I got injured here at the mansio---"

entries.japanese:
―――いや、そもそも。
　俺はどこで、死ぬような事故に巻き込まれたんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――No.
More fundamentally—where did the accident that nearly killed me happen?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---In the first place.
Just where did I get into the accident that almost killed me?

entries.japanese:
子供のころの大怪我。
　死の線が視えるきっかけになった事故。
　それは一体どんなもので、
　一体どこでそんな事故に巻き込まれたのか、
　俺はまったく覚えていない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
The terrible injury from my childhood.
The accident after which I began seeing the lines of death.
What happened to me,
where it happened,
I remember none of it―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
The near fatal wound from my childhood.
The accident that caused me to be able to see death's lines.
Just how in the world did it happen,
and where in the world did I get in that accident,
I don't remember anything at all---

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん？
　どうかなさいましたか？」
「え……あ、なんでもないんだ。
琥珀さんに聞いても解るわけないよな、そんなこと」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? Is something wrong?”
“What…? No, it’s nothing; there’s no reason you would know the answer, Kohaku.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san?
Is something wrong?"
"Eh…… Ah, it's nothing.
I don't think you'd understand even if I told you."

entries.japanese:
―――けど、昨日かすかに思い出したアレは、
　　　八年前の事故の記憶のような気がする。
　あの時―――自分と、秋葉と、あともう一人、誰かいたような気がするんだけど――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――But what I dimly remembered yesterday felt
like a memory of that accident eight years ago.
Back then―――there was me, Akiha, and I think one other person――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---But what I remembered yesterday,
it might be something that has to do with the accident eight years ago.
That time, I think---there was Akiha, myself, and one more person there---

entries.japanese:
「それでは食器を片付けてきますね」
　琥珀さんは部屋を出ていこうとする。
「ちょっと待って琥珀さん。
昔、琥珀さんと一緒によく遊んだよね。
その時に誰か、他にもう一人いなかったっけ？」
　琥珀さんは背中を向けたまま、ピタリと立ち止まった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ll go put the dishes away.”
Kohaku turns to leave.
“Wait, Kohaku. We used to play together when we were little, didn’t we? Wasn’t there someone else with us—one more person?”
With her back still to me, Kohaku stops dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I will go and take care of these dishes then."
Kohaku-san tries to leave the room.
"Wait a sec, Kohaku-san.
Back then, we played a lot together, didn't we?
At that time, was there someone else with us?"
Kohaku-san stops in her tracks.

entries.japanese:
「わたしと、志貴さんが、いっしょに……？」
　くすり、と。
　昔を懐かしむような笑いが、冷たく部屋に響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…
you and I played together?”
A soft laugh, almost nostalgic, rings coldly through the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"We played, a lot, together……?"
She laughs.
As if remembering the past, her nostalgic laughs echoes in the room coldly.

entries.japanese:
「さあ、気のせいじゃないですか？
　たまたま翡翠ちゃんが混ざっていただけかもしれないし」
「あ、そっか。
そういう事もあるか」
「そうですよ。
それではまた後で来ますね」
　琥珀さんは食器を持って退室していく。
「―――――さて」
　ごはんを食べたら眠くなってきた。
　やることもないし、少しの間仮眠をとることにしよう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Perhaps you imagined it. Maybe Hisui just happened to join you that time.”
“Oh, right. That could be it.”
“I’m sure it is. I’ll come back later.”
Carrying the dishes, Kohaku leaves the room.
“―――――Well, then”
Eating has made me sleepy.
There’s nothing else to do, so I may as well take a short nap―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hmm, maybe it is your imagination?
Maybe Hisui-chan might have been with you or something."
"Ah, maybe that's it.
That could be it."
"Of course.
Well then, I will see you later."
Kohaku-san carries the dishes and leaves the room.
"------Well."
Having eaten, I feel pretty sleepy.
There isn't anything else to do, so I guess I should just sleep a little---

entries.japanese: ―――気がつくと、見知らぬ場所にいた。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――When awareness returns, I am somewhere unfamiliar.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---All of a sudden, I find myself in an unknown place.

entries.japanese:
そこは―――もう長いこと使われていない地下室らしい。
　机や椅子が散乱している。
　奥には壊れた黒板やパイプ椅子が棄てられている。
　太陽の陽射しは差し込んでこない。
　暗い、かびの匂いがする地下室で、ただ息を潜めていた。
　机の上に座って、膝を抱えている。
　床には、真新しい女の死体が転がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
It appears to be a basement―――one unused for many years.
Desks and chairs lie scattered around.
Broken blackboards and folding chairs have been discarded at the far end.
No sunlight reaches this place.
In the dark, mold-reeking basement, I sit holding my breath.
I sit on a desk with my knees drawn up.
The fresh corpse of a woman lies on the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This place---looks like a basement that hasn't been used for a long time.
Desks and chairs are strewn about.
In the back of the room are discarded broken chalkboards and folding chairs.
The sun's rays cannot reach this place.
In this dark basement that smells like mold, I just breathe in and out.
Sitting on top of a desk, hugging my knees.
The dead body of a new woman is laying on the floor.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000
　ハア　　ハア　　ハア
#ffffff
　荒い息遣い。
　血が足りない、とソレは思っている。
　肉を食いたい、とソレは思っている。
#ff0000
　人を殺したい、とオレは思っている。
　ハア　　ハア　　ハア
entries.maoEnglish:
#ff0000

Hah Hah Hah
Harsh breathing.
It wants blood.
It wants to eat flesh.
I want to kill someone.
Hah Hah Hah
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000
The sound of my breathing.
#ffffff
It's ragged.
That thing is thinking that it does not have enough blood.
That thing is thinking that it wants to eat fresh meat.
#ff0000
I'm thinking that I want to kill people.
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*

entries.japanese:
ハア　　ハア　　ハア
#ffffff
　はあ　　はあ　　はあ
　呼吸が、ぴたりとあった。
!w2000
「誰だ――――！」
　声をあげて周囲を見渡す。
　地下室には、誰もいない。
#ff0000
　ハア　　ハア　　ハア
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah      Hah      Hah
hah      hah      hah
The two rhythms lock together perfectly.!w2000
“Who’s there――――!”
I shout and search the room.
The basement is empty.
Hah Hah Hah
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*
#ffffff
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*
Our breathing matches rhythm.
"Who is it----!"
Raising my voice, I look around.
In this basement, there is no one else.
