*pant*   *pant*   *pant*

entries.japanese:
ハア　　ハア　　ハア
#ffffff
　はあ　　はあ　　はあ
「クソ、またおまえか！」
　ソレは、オレに向かってそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah      Hah      Hah
hah      hah      hah
“Damn it—you again!”
It says those words to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*
#ffffff
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*
"Damn it, it's you again!"
It shouts this at me.

entries.japanese:
「やらない……！
　この女はオレがとってきたものだ！
　おまえに横取りされてたまるものか！」
　言って、ソレは足元の死体のハラに食いついた。
　ぞぶり。
　ぐちゃ、ぐちゃ。
　ハラワタを、食い破っていく音。
―――――――はあ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You can’t have her…! I brought this woman here! I won’t let you steal her from me!”
With that, It sinks its teeth into the corpse’s belly.
Squelch.
Wet, pulping crunches.
The sound of entrails being chewed through.
―――――――Haa.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I won't……!
I took this woman myself!
I won't give her to you."
Saying that, it bites into the dead body.
Munch.
Squish, rip.
The sound of intestines being chewed.
-------Exhaling.

entries.japanese:
はあ　　はあ　　はあ　　はあ
　息があがる。
　なぜか。
　ソレの呼吸と同化するように、こっちの呼吸も乱れていく。
「ころしてやる」
　ハア　　はあ　　ハア　　はあ
「はやく、はやくおまえを、ころして、やる」
　狂ったように呟いて、ソレは、バキバキと音をたてて死体の骨さえも咀嚼していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
hah    hah    hah    hah
My breath comes faster.
Why?
Somehow, as though merging with that thing’s breathing, my own breathing loses its rhythm too.
“I’ll kill you.”
Hah hah Hah hah
“Soon, soon, I’m going to kill you.”
Muttering madly, it ground even the corpse’s bones between its teeth with a splintering crunch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*   *pant*   *pant*  *pant*
My breathing gets ragged.
Somehow.
Just like that thing's breathing, my breathing starts to get wild as well.
"I'll kill you."
*pant*   *pant*  *pant*   *pant*
"Soon, soon, I'll, kill, you."
As if it lost its mind, it starts to wolf down everything, even the bones.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お眠りになられたのですか？」
「え――――？」
　と、いつのまにか目の前に翡翠がいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, did you fall asleep?”
“Huh――――?”
Somehow, Hisui was standing right in front of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you sleeping?"
"Eh----?"
Suddenly, Hisui appears in front of me.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠……いつのまに部屋に入ってきたんだ？」
「いつのまに……とおっしゃられても。
わたしは五分ほど前に、志貴さまのシーツをお取り替えし終わったところです」
「そうなんだ。
悪い、さっきまで眠ってたみたいで、翡翠が入ってきた事に気付いてなかった」
「……志貴さま、悪ふざけはおやめください。
入室を許されたのも志貴さまですし、シーツを取り替えるように指示をくださったのも志貴さまです」
「な―――――――」
　なんだそれ。
　俺はさっきまで眠っていて、またイヤな夢を見て、翡翠の声で目が覚めたのに……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, when did you come in?”
“When…? I finished changing your sheets about five minutes ago, Master Shiki.”
“Sorry. I must have been asleep until just now; I didn’t notice you come in.”
“Master Shiki, please don’t tease me. Master Shiki was the one who allowed me in, and Master Shiki was also the one who instructed me to change the sheets.”
“What―――――――?”
What was she talking about?
I’d been asleep until a moment ago, trapped in another horrible dream, and Hisui’s voice had woken me—or hadn’t it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui…… when did you come in?"
"When…… you ask?
It has been about five minutes since I finished changing your sheets."
"Oh.
Sorry, I was sleeping and didn't notice you come in."
"…… Shiki-sama, please do not joke around.
You accepted me coming into the room, and you ordered me to change the sheets."
"Wha-------"
What's going on?
Up until now, I was asleep, had another nightmare, and I woke up to Hisui's voice……

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
俺、起きてるように見えたのか？」
「……はい。
シーツを取り替えたあと、志貴さまが目を閉じられたのでこれからお眠りになるのか尋ねていたところですが」
「―――いや。
当分、眠らない」
　なんとかそう返答して、自分の手を見た。
　……手を持ち上げる事が、今は難しい。
　体調は朝から一向に回復しない。
　重い体。
　今まで自分の――――遠野志貴の体と思っていたこの体が、見知らぬ他人のモノのような違和感がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Did I look awake to you?”
“Yes. After I changed the sheets, Master Shiki closed his eyes, so I was asking whether you meant to sleep now.”
“―――No. I won’t sleep again for a while.”
I managed to answer, then looked down at my hand.
Even lifting it was difficult now.
I hadn’t improved at all since morning.
My body was leaden.
This body I had always believed was mine――――was Shiki Tohno’s body, yet now it felt like a stranger’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
Did I look like I was awake?"
"…… Yes.
After I changed the sheets, you closed your eyes, which is why I inquired if you were sleeping."
"---No, I won't sleep anymore right now."
Somehow responding, I look at my hand.
…… Lifting my hand is still difficult.
I haven't gotten even the slightest bit better.
My heavy body.
My body----the body of Tohno Shiki, feels like it belongs to some other person.

entries.japanese:
「……しばらく起きてる。
翡翠はこのあと、屋敷の仕事？」
「いえ、今日は志貴さまの看病を許されていますから。
……その、志貴さまさえよろしければ、このままご様子を看させていただけないでしょうか？」
　翡翠の提案は、こっちにこそありがたかった。
翡翠がそばにいてくれるなら、さっきのような夢を見る事もないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m going to stay awake for a while. Do you have other work to do around the house?”
“I have been excused from my usual duties so that I may nurse Master Shiki today. If Master Shiki has no objection, may I remain here and watch over you?”
Her offer was more than welcome. If Hisui stayed beside me, perhaps I wouldn’t have another dream like that one.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'll be awake for a while.
Do you have work after this?"
"No, today I will be watching over you…… If it is alright with you, I would like to take care of you, Shiki-sama."
I can't help but be grateful.
If Hisui is here, I probably won't see nightmares like the one I saw before.

entries.japanese:
「……こっちこそお願いするよ。
翡翠に迷惑じゃないなら、しばらく部屋にいてくれないか」
「―――はい。
それでは、そうさせていただきます、志貴さま」
　ふかぶかとおじぎをして、立ったままでじっと見つめてくる翡翠。
「いや、だからってずっと気を使ってなくていいんだ。
適当に椅子を持ってきて、本を読んだり自分の事をしていてくれたほうが嬉しい。
こっちも適当に時間を潰しているからさ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m the one who should be asking. If it isn’t a bother, would you stay here for a while?”
“―――Yes. Then I shall do so, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bowed deeply, then remained standing there, watching me in silence.
“No, you don’t have to stand on ceremony the whole time. Bring in a chair, read a book—do whatever you’d normally do. I’ll just be passing the time myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's exactly what I wish, Hisui.
If I am not a burden to you, please stay in my room."
"---Yes.
Then I shall do so, Shiki-sama."
After giving a bow, Hisui stands and watches me intently.
"Um, you don't have to concentrate so hard.
I would be happier if you maybe just bring in a chair and read a book or something.
I'm just going to kill some time too."

entries.japanese:
「あ……はい、かしこまりました」
　翡翠は慌てて部屋から出ていく。
　きっと俺が言ったとおり、椅子と本を持ってくるつもりなんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, yes, of course.”
Hisui hurried out of the room.
No doubt she was going to fetch a chair and a book, exactly as I’d suggested.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… yes, as you wish."
Hisui quickly leaves the room.
I'm sure she will come back with a book and a chair, just like I suggested.

entries.japanese:
「律儀だな、翡翠は」
　呟いて、つい笑いがこぼれた。
　この屋敷で翡翠と再会した時、無表情で冷たい女の子だと思ったのが懐かしい。
　あの時はそうとしか思えなかったけど、今は―――翡翠がどんな子なのか、少しずつ分かってきた。
「―――早く来ないかな、翡翠」
　ベッドに体を預けて、本心からそう思った。
　彼女が傍にいてくれるのなら、こうして病人でいるのも、そう悪いことじゃないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“She really does take everything seriously.”
A smile escaped me as I said it.
It seemed almost funny now that, when I first met Hisui again in this house, I had taken her for a cold, expressionless girl.
I hadn’t been able to see her any other way then, but now―――little by little, I was beginning to understand what she was really like.
“―――I wish she’d hurry back.”
I let myself sink into the bed, meaning it with all my heart.
If having her beside me was the reward, perhaps being ill wasn’t entirely terrible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're pretty dutiful, aren't you, Hisui?"
I laugh a little as I say this.
It feels like ages since the time I met Hisui again and thought that she was simply a cold, expressionless girl.
Well, that's all I thought back then, but now---I think I understand Hisui a little better.
"---C'mon, Hisui, hurry back."
Leaning on the bed, I really do mean this.
If she's going to be around, being sick like I am right now doesn't sound bad at all.

entries.japanese:
翡翠の看病は、それこそただ一緒にいるだけのものだった。
　異性の体に触れられない、という翡翠はこっちの容体を看ることができない。
　熱を測ったり汗を拭いたりしてくれるのは琥珀さんの役目で、翡翠は傍にいてこっちの『喉が渇いた』といった要望を聞いてくれるだけだ。
　けど、それが不満というわけでもない。
　一日中部屋にいてくれる、というわけではなかったけど、それでも極力部屋にいてくれたおかげで、あれ以降おかしな夢は見なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s nursing amounted, quite literally, to keeping me company.
Since she could not bring herself to touch a man, she couldn’t examine me.
Taking my temperature and wiping away my sweat were Kohaku’s duties; Hisui merely stayed nearby and saw to requests such as “I’m thirsty.”
Not that I minded.
She couldn’t remain in the room all day, but she stayed as much as she could—and thanks to that, I had no more strange dreams.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui nursing me turns out to be her just being with me.
Not being able to touch someone of the opposite gender, Hisui can't really take care of me physically.
Taking my temperature or wiping the sweat off my brow is Kohaku-san's role, and Hisui just stays by me, listening to me when I ask for anything, like something to drink.
But that doesn't mean that I'm dissatisfied.
It's not that she was always there, but she was there most of the time.
Thanks to that, I didn't see any terrible dreams.

entries.japanese:
そうして就寝時間である十時の、少し前。
「兄さん、具合はどう？」
　と、秋葉が見舞いにきてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Then, a little before the household bedtime of ten o’clock…
“Brother, how are you feeling?”
Akiha had come to see me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It becomes a little before ten o'clock, right before bedtime.
"Nii-san, how are you feeling?"
Akiha comes to see how I'm doing.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、気分はいいよ。
体のほうはまだ自由がきかないけど、この分なら明日までには治ってると思う。
昔も一度だけこういう事があったんだけど、その時とまったく同じだから」
「―――よかった。
それを聞いて安心しました」
　ほう、と胸を撫で下ろすように吐息をもらす秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My head feels fine. My body still won’t do what I tell it, but at this rate I think I’ll be better by tomorrow. This happened once when I was little, and it’s exactly the same as it was then.”
“―――Thank goodness. I’m relieved to hear that.”
Akiha let out a long breath, the tension leaving her chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I feel fine.
Even though I still can't move my body freely, I think I'll be better tomorrow.
This kind of thing happened to me once before, and it's exactly the same as back then."
"---I'm glad to hear it.
It makes me feel a little more at ease."
Akiha exhales and visibly relaxes.

entries.japanese:
「おやすみなさい兄さん。
あ、でも気分がいいからって無理はしないでくださいね。
それでケガをしてしまったら元も子もありませんから」
「わかってるって。
……それじゃおやすみ秋葉。
わざわざ心配してくれて、ありがとうな」
「え……まあ、兄妹なんですから、これぐらいは当然ですけど……
　ともかく、お体を大事にしてくださいね。
また今朝みたいに兄さんが倒れてるところなんて、私は見たくないんですから」
　それでは、と軽く微笑みを残して秋葉は去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good night, Brother. And please don’t overexert yourself just because you feel better. If you injure yourself now, we’ll be right back where we started.”
“I know. Good night, Akiha. And thanks for going out of your way to check on me.”
“Oh, well, we are brother and sister; this much is only natural
In any case, please take care of yourself. I never want to find you collapsed the way you were this morning again.”
With a faint smile, Akiha leaves.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good night, Nii-san.
Ah, but even if you feel better, don't strain yourself.
It wouldn't do you any good to get hurt again."
"I know that.
…… G'night, Akiha.
Thanks for all of your concern."
"Eh…… Well, we are brother and sister, it's only natural……
Anyway, please take care.
I do not want to see you collapsed again tomorrow."
With a light smile, Akiha exits the room.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　就寝時間になった。
　どのみち体が動かないんじゃ動き回ることはできない。
　きちんと眠って、明日には体を回復させないといけない。
　今夜は何も考えず、ただ眠ることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
It was time for bed.
My body wouldn’t let me go anywhere regardless.
I needed a full night’s sleep if I meant to recover by morning.
So tonight, I decided to think of nothing at all and simply sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
It is time for bed.
If I can't move, I can't go out anywhere.
I have to get enough sleep and make sure that I'll be better tomorrow.
Not thinking of anything, I decide to sleep for tonight.

entries.japanese:
窓から差しこんでくる朝日で目が覚めた。
「―――見なかったな、夢」
　いい夢もわるい夢もなかった、真っ白い眠りだった。
　おかげで気分はそう悪いものじゃない。
　今日は土曜日だし、学校が終わったら翡翠や琥珀さんに看病してくれたお礼をしなくては、なんて考えがうかぶ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Morning sunlight through the window woke me.
“―――No dreams.”
Neither good nor bad—only a pure blank of sleep.
I felt fairly well for it.
It was Saturday, and once school was over I ought to find some way to thank Hisui and Kohaku for looking after me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The light from the window wakes me up.
"---I didn't have any dreams."
It really was just a sleep without dreams, good or bad.
Thanks to that, I don't feel bad at all.
Today's Saturday, so I should probably thank Hisui and Kohaku-san for taking care of me.

entries.japanese:
時刻は朝の六時を過ぎたばかり。
　一日中横になっていたから眠気なんて微塵もない。
「―――よし、起きるか」
　ベッドから体を起こす。
「―――――え」
　体が動かない。
　……容体は、まったく治っていない。
　それどころか悪化している。
昨日は自分の腕ぐらいは動かすことができたのに、今はそんな単純なことが辛い。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was only just past six.
After lying down all day yesterday, I wasn’t the least bit sleepy.
“―――All right, time to get up.”
I tried to rise from the bed.
“―――――What?”
My body wouldn’t move.
I hadn’t recovered at all.
If anything, I was worse. Yesterday I could at least move my arms; now even that simple act was an ordeal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's only just past six.
All I did was lie down yesterday, so I don't feel tired anymore.
"---Time to get up!"
I get up from bed.
"-----Eh?"
My body doesn't move at all.
…… I haven't healed at all.
If anything, it's worse.
Yesterday, I could move my arms, but today I can't even do that.

entries.japanese:
「――――っ、く――――」
　片腕を垂直に上げてみる。
　……。
　…………。
　………………。
「――――はっ……あ」
　ようやく上がった。
　たったそれだけの事をするのに、体中の力をつかって、一分近くかかってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Ngh, come on――――”
I tried raising one arm straight into the air.
…
……
………
“――――Hah, ah”
At last, it rose.
That tiny motion had taken every ounce of strength in my body and nearly a full minute.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Kk----"
I try to bring my arm straight up.
……
………
…………
"----Ha…… ah."
I finally manage to do so.
Using all of my strength, it takes me about a full minute.

entries.japanese:
「……どうなってるんだ、これ」
　これじゃ死体だ。
　それとも動力のきれたロボットか。
　ともかく体が動かない。
　けど、そのわりには意識ははっきりしているし、痛みはまったく感じない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell is happening to me?”
I might as well have been a corpse.
Or a robot with its power cut.
Whatever the comparison, my body refused to move.
Yet my mind was perfectly clear, and I felt no pain at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's going on?"
It's like my body is dead.
Or more like a robot out of gas.
At any rate, my body won't move.
At the same time, I am fully conscious, and I don't feel any pain.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠―――琥珀さん、ちょっと―――」
　来てくれ、と言おうとして止まった。
　声は出せるけど、大声をあげようとすると眩暈がする。
　……大声をあげるにも筋力を使うから、その負荷で脳に血がたまっていくような感覚。
「はっ―――――」
　軽く息を吐く。
　こうなったら翡翠が起こしに来てくれるまで、こうして待っているしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui―――Kohaku, could one of you―――”
I stopped before I could call for them to come.
I could speak, but trying to raise my voice made the room spin.
Shouting took muscle too, and the strain made it feel as though blood were pooling inside my skull.
“Hah―――――”
I let out a shallow breath.
There was nothing to do but wait like this until Hisui came to wake me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Hisui---Kohaku-san---"
I was going to tell them to come here, but I stop.
I can speak, but using a loud voice makes me extremely dizzy.
…… It almost feels like a loud voice uses too much muscle, placing too much strain on the blood flow to the brain.
"Ha-----"
I breathe out.
I guess all I can do is just wait for Hisui to come wake me up.

entries.japanese:
―――その後は、まるっきり昨日の朝の焼きなおしだった。
　初めからこっちがベッドで倒れていた分、話は少しだけ早かったが大筋は変わらない。
　俺を起こしに来た翡翠は顔を蒼白にして琥珀さんを呼びにいって、琥珀さんは俺の体を看てくれた。
　話を聞きつけた秋葉がまた駆けつけてきて、昨日と同じように医者を呼んで検査をしてもらって、こうしてベッドに体を休めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――What followed was a perfect reenactment of the previous morning.
Things went a little faster because I was already lying helpless in bed, but otherwise nothing changed.
Hisui came to wake me, went white, and ran for Kohaku, who examined me.
Akiha heard the news and rushed in; a doctor was summoned, just as before, and after another examination I was left here to rest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---After that, it's pretty much like yesterday morning.
Since I was already in bed, it went by just a bit faster than yesterday.
After coming to wake me up, a pale-faced Hisui called for Kohaku-san, who did a little check up.
Hearing this, Akiha once again ran into my room, called the same doctor as yesterday, who did the same examination, and I end up resting in bed.

entries.japanese: ……さすがに一日中寝たままなのは気分が悪くなるので、今は上半身だけを起こしてベッドボードに背中を預けている。
entries.maoEnglish: After an entire day flat on my back, I couldn’t stand it any longer, so now I had my upper body propped against the headboard.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Since sleeping in bed all day makes me pretty sick, I am now leaning my upper body on the headboard.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、何か言われましたか？」
「ん……？
　いや、ぼんやりとしてただけだよ。
別になにも言ってない」
「―――――――」
「ほら、またそんな顔をする。
別に痛みがあるわけじゃないんだから、翡翠が心配するような事じゃないって言っただろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Did you say something, Master Shiki?”
“Mm? No. I was just staring into space; I didn’t say anything.”
“―――――――”
“There, you’re making that face again. I told you nothing hurts, so there’s no reason for you to look so worried.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, did you say something?"
"N……?
No, I was just zoning out.
I didn't say anything."
"-------"
"Hey, what's with that expression?
I told you that I'm not in any pain or anything, so you don't need to worry."

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
もうしわけありません、志貴さま」
「だからいいんだって。
……まったく、翡翠は心配性なんだな。
そういうところは姉妹なのかな、琥珀さんに似てるよ」
「え――――姉さんに似ているんですか、わたし」
　意外そうに翡翠は尋ねてくる。
　……似ているかって、そりゃあ外見はそっくりだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I’m sorry, Master Shiki.”
“I said it’s all right. Honestly, you worry too much. Maybe it runs in the family—you’re just like Kohaku that way.”
“I’m――――like my sister?”
Hisui sounded genuinely surprised.
As for their looks, of course, the two were almost identical.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I am very sorry, Shiki-sama."
"I told you it's alright…… Geez, you really are worrisome.
Well, I guess you two really are sisters.
You're a lot like Kohaku-san in that way."
"Eh----I'm like Nee-san?"
Hisui asks, very surprised.
…… Well, I wasn't referring to appearance, as that's pretty obvious.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、ちょっと昔の話。
子供のころから琥珀さんはお姉さん役だったって知ってるだろ？
　だから俺や秋葉が無茶してケガをすると、琥珀さんがすぐ心配するんだ。
……いや、ケガだけならまだいいんだけど、こっちが少しでも体調を崩していると寝てろ寝てろってやかましかった」
「え……その、やかしまかった、んですか？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was thinking about when we were children. You know how Kohaku always played the big sister, even then?
Whenever Akiha or I did something reckless and got hurt, Kohaku would start fretting immediately. Injuries weren’t even the worst of it—if one of us so much as felt under the weather, she’d nag us endlessly to get into bed.”
“She—was that much of a nag?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, it's a pretty old story.
Did you know that Kohaku-san has acted like an older sister since we were small?
Whenever Akiha or I would get hurt, Kohaku-san would get so worried.
…… No, it's fine if it was only when we were hurt, but even when we were not feeling well, she would be very fussy, telling us to go to sleep, go to sleep."
"Eh…… She was really, that fussy?"

entries.japanese:
「ああ、こっちが照れるぐらいにやかましかった。
　……あれはいつだったかな、確かにちょっと風邪ぎみなのを無視して遊んでたコトがあったんだけどね。
琥珀さん、三人で遊んでいる時に看病してやるからすぐ寝ろいま寝ろって連発してきてさ。
　結局押しに負けて部屋に戻ったんだけど、そのあと楽しそうに濡れたタオルをもってきて人の顔にかけてきたんだ。
窒息死するかと思ったよ、こっちは」
「…………、」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Enough to embarrass me. Once, I ignored the beginnings of a cold and went out to play anyway. The three of us were together, and Kohaku kept insisting she would nurse me, so I had to go to bed right then and there.
In the end she wore me down and marched me back to my room. Then she came in looking delighted, carrying a wet towel, and dropped it over my face; I thought she was going to smother me.”
“….”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, I felt pretty bashful when she'd do it.
…… Hmm, when was it?
I remember once when I caught a cold, I wanted to play anyway.
Kohaku-san, she would keep telling me to go to bed over and over.
Eventually, she won and I went back to my room, but after that, she came into my room and lay a wet towel on me.
I really thought she would smother me to death."
"…………,"

entries.japanese:
「なんだかなあ、今にして思うとアレは心配性っていうより、たんに看病っていう遊びをしたかっただけかもしんないな。
琥珀さん、なんか妙に楽しそうだったし」
「……………………、」
「あ、けど琥珀さんが迷惑だったてワケじゃないぞ。
琥珀さんのそういうところも嬉しかったし、秋葉を連れまわすのも楽しかった。
　……そうだな。
考えてみると、俺はすごく幸せな幼年期を送れたんだなって思うよ」
「―――はい。
きっと、姉さんもそう思っていると思います」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Looking back, maybe she wasn’t worried at all and just wanted to play at nursing someone. She certainly seemed to be enjoying herself.”
“…”
“Not that I minded, mind you. That side of Kohaku made me happy too, and dragging Akiha along on our adventures was always fun.
Thinking about it now… I really did have a happy childhood.”
“―――Yes. I’m sure my sister feels the same way.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Come to think of it, this time around, I think Kohaku-san wasn't worried as much as I thought, but maybe she wanted to act as a nurse or something.
She really did seem to enjoy it."
"……………………,"
"Ah, but I don't mean I didn't like what Kohaku-san did.
I liked what she would do, and playing with Akiha was also fun.
…… That's right.
Come to think of it, I had a pretty happy time as a kid."
"---Yes.
I am sure Nee-san feels the same way."

entries.japanese:
翡翠は静かに頷く。
　……って、しまった。
子供のころの話なんかしても、翡翠には退屈なだけだったろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui nodded quietly.
Then it occurred to me: what was I doing? Listening to stories about a childhood she hadn’t shared could only be boring for her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui nods quietly.
…… Oh no.
Simply talking about my childhood like this, Hisui must be getting bored.

entries.japanese:
「―――わるい。
翡翠にわからない話をしてもつまらなかっただろ」
「お気になさらないでください。
楽しいです、わたし」
「え、そう……？
　それならいいんだけど……」
　たしかに翡翠は退屈そうには見えない。
「はい。
志貴さまのお体の具合がよろしいのでしたら、どうぞお話を続けてください。
お医者さまも出来るだけ体を動かしたほうがいい、とおっしゃられてましたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Sorry. You must be bored, listening to me talk about things you couldn’t know.”
“Please don’t concern yourself. I’m enjoying it.”
“You are…? Well, if you’re sure….”
She certainly didn’t look bored.
“Yes. If you feel well enough, Master Shiki, please continue. The doctor also said you ought to move as much as you can.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Sorry.
I didn't mean to bore you with this kind of talk."
"Please do not worry about it.
I enjoy it."
"Eh, really……?
In that case……"
Certainly Hisui doesn't look bored at all.
"Yes.
As long as it does not bother you, please continue on.
The doctor said that any sort of activity is preferable."

entries.japanese:
……なるほど。
体を動かすって、今の俺が動かせる体なんてこの口ぐらいなものだもんな。
「まいったな。
そうなるとあんまり話す事ってないんだよな。
昔のことだったら色々と思い出せるんだけど」
「わたしはそれでかまいません。
どうぞ、志貴さまの子供のころのお話を聞かせてください」
「……そう？
　けど、昔の思い出話なんて翡翠にはつまらないと思うけど、いいの？」
entries.maoEnglish:
Of course. And about the only part of my body I could move was my mouth.
“That puts me on the spot. I don’t have much to talk about. I can remember all sorts of things from when I was little, though.”
“That would be quite all right. Please tell me about your childhood, Master Shiki.”
“Really? I’d have thought someone else’s old memories would be dull for you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I see.
They say to move my body, but it's really just my mouth I can move right now.
"Geez.
I don't really have much to talk about, although I do have a lot of memories of my childhood."
"I do not mind.
Please, tell me about your childhood, Shiki-sama."
"…… Really?
But I think it'll just be boring, are you sure?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
楽しいです、わたし」
　本当に嬉しそうな笑顔をうかべる翡翠。
「―――――」
　今の自分の容体も忘れて、どくん、と心臓が高鳴った。
　……滅多に見れない翡翠の笑顔は、こっちが赤面してしまうぐらい、その、なんていうか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I enjoy them.”
Hisui smiled, looking truly happy.
“―――――”
Forgetting how ill I was, I felt my heart give a violent thump.
Hisui smiled so rarely, and when she did, she was enough to make me blush; she was, well, how could I put it―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, I am really, enjoying this."
Hisui gives an extremely happy smile.
"-----"
Completely forgetting about the state I'm in now, my heart starts to race.
…… The smile that is so rarely seen on Hisui's face is, it makes me blush, and, well---

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま？
　いかがなさいました？」
「あ―――いや、なんでもない。
それじゃしばらく昔話に付き合ってもらうよ」
　はい、とうなずく翡翠。
　そうして、おぼろげな記憶を思い出しながら、トツトツとつまらない話を続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? Is something wrong?”
“Oh―――no, nothing. Then you can humor me while I reminisce for a while.”
Hisui nodded.
Searching through my hazy memories, I haltingly went on with one unremarkable story after another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama?
Is there something wrong?"
"Ah---no, it's nothing.
Well, let's continue talking about the past then."
Hisui nods.
As I continue to remember more and more about the past, I continue my boring, inane monologue.

entries.japanese:
昼食の時間になって、翡翠と入れ替わりに琥珀さんがやってきた。
　琥珀さんはお湯のはいった洗面器と数枚の布巾を持ってきている。
「…………」
　なんか、猛烈にわるい予感がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
At lunchtime, Kohaku arrived to relieve Hisui.
She carried a basin of hot water and several washcloths.
“….”
I had a very, very bad feeling about this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At lunchtime, Kohaku-san comes in and trades places with Hisui.
Kohaku-san brings a wash pail and several towels.
"…………"
I get a really bad feeling about this.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ志貴さん、お体を拭きますからちょっと我慢していてくださいね」
「――――」
　やっぱり、そうきたか。
「………う」
　それはイヤすぎるけど、はっきりと嫌だとは言えなかった。
　自分で満足に動けない以上、誰かに体を拭いてもらうしかないのは自明の理だ。
　昨日から寝たきりで体も汗をかいているし、正直ベタベタして気持ち悪い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right, Master Shiki, I’m going to wash you now, so please bear with me.”
“――――”
I knew it.
“Ugh.”
The idea was unbearable, but I couldn’t bring myself to refuse outright.
If I couldn’t move properly, someone else would have to wash me.
I’d been bedridden since yesterday and had sweated through my clothes; to be honest, the sticky feeling was miserable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, we have to wash your body, so please endure this."
"----"
I knew it.
"……… Um"
Even though it is something I'd hate to do, I can't exactly say no.
It's obvious that since I can't move my body, someone has to clean it for me.
I've been laying around since yesterday, and to be honest, I do feel sticky and pretty gross.

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
お願いします」
「いえいえ、こちらこそお願いしますね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. Please.”
“No, no; I should be asking you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
Please."
"Not at all, I'm the one who should be saying please."

entries.japanese:
……終わった。
　そりゃあ死ぬほど恥ずかしかったけど、いまさら琥珀さんには逆らえない。
　そもそも用をたす時だって、琥珀さんに肩を貸してもらってトイレまで行っているんだ。
　ここまで親身になって看護してくれるんだから、恥ずかしがっているのは失礼だと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was over.
Yes, I had nearly died of embarrassment, but at this point there was no opposing Kohaku.
She already had to lend me her shoulder whenever I went to the bathroom.
When she was caring for me so devotedly, acting ashamed of her help felt almost insulting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… And it's over.
It was deadly embarrassing, but I can't fight Kohaku-san.
After all, Kohaku-san helps me get to the bathroom when I have to go.
After receiving so much care from Kohaku-san, I think being embarrassed is rude to her.

entries.japanese:
「はい、これでおしまいです。
どうもおつかれさまでした」
　きちんと新しい寝巻に着替えさせてくれて、シーツをかけなおしてくれる。
「でも志貴さん、本当に力が入らないんですね。
体を拭かさせていただいた時に、反動がないのでびっくりしちゃいました」
「……そうだね。
ほんとにどうしたんだろ、この体」
entries.maoEnglish:
“There, all finished. You did very well.”
She changed me neatly into fresh nightclothes and drew the sheet over me again.
“You really can’t put any strength into your body, can you, Master Shiki? When I was washing you, I was surprised that there wasn’t any resistance at all.”
“No. I wonder what’s happened to this body.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"All finished.
Thank you for your cooperation."
After changing me into a new set of pajamas, she replaces my sheets.
"But Shiki-san, you really have no strength at all, do you?
I was surprised when you didn't even flinch when I was washing you."
"…… You're right.
I wonder what's wrong with my body?"

entries.japanese:
ふつう、介護される立場であったとしても、他人に腕や足を持ち上げられるとつい力が入って力に逆らうように筋肉が動いてしまう。
　その反動があるから看護するほうも体力を使うんだけど、今の自分にはその反動さえない。
　それこそ骨のないクラゲか何かになったような気分だ。
「クラゲ、か……あんがい当たってるかもな、それ」
　冗談のつもりで呟いたが、笑う気持ちにはなれなかった。
　……なんていうか、まるで生きているという気がしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Ordinarily, even a helpless patient tenses when someone lifts an arm or a leg; the muscles push instinctively against the motion.
That resistance is what makes nursing such physical work, yet I didn’t have even that.
I felt like a jellyfish—or some other boneless thing.
“A jellyfish—maybe that’s closer than I meant it to be.”
It was supposed to be a joke, but I couldn’t laugh.
Somehow, I no longer felt alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Normally, when someone is taking care of you, if they move your arms and legs, there is some sort of muscular reaction in the body.
Since the reaction is there, the one doing the caring usually takes a lot of work, but I don't even have that reaction right now.
It's like I'm a boneless jellyfish.
"Jellyfish…… I might be quite right."
I meant it to be a joke, but I don't feel like laughing.
…… How do I put it, it's almost as if I'm not quite alive.

entries.japanese:
体の自由がきかないというコト。
　体の感覚がないというコトが、こんなにもゾッとするものだとは思わなかった。
　これじゃあまるで、こうしている自分さえ夢のような、あやふやなモノみたいに思えてしまう。
「志貴さん、そんな不安そうな顔をしないでくださいな。
きっと何か原因があって、それさえ解決できればすぐに元通りになってくれますから」
「……そうだね。
けど、原因なんてあるのかな、これ」
entries.maoEnglish:
I had never known how terrifying it could be to lose all control of your body.
To lose the very sensation of having one was worse still.
Even the person lying here began to feel unreal, no more substantial than a figure in a dream.
“Master Shiki, please don’t look so frightened. There must be some cause, and once we find it and put it right, I’m sure you’ll recover in no time.”
“Maybe. But what if there isn’t a cause?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The fact that I can't move my body.
I didn't think that not having any feeling in my body would be this scary.
It's like I'm almost in a dream, just a vague existence.
"Shiki-san, please don't make that uneasy face.
Whatever the reason, I'm sure you will be able to return to normal soon."
"…… I'm sure.
But I wonder what the reason is."

entries.japanese:
……あるとしたら八年前の古傷か。
　医者に言わせれば生きているだけで奇跡だって言われた事故から八年間。
　もしかすると、奇跡のツケが今になってやっと回ってきただけかもしれない。
―――なら、遠野志貴は、もう。
　このまま、一生自分で立ちあがるコトさえできなくなるのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
If there was one, it might be the old wound from eight years ago.
Eight years had passed since the accident that doctors said I had survived by a miracle.
Perhaps the bill for that miracle had simply come due at last.
―――If so, then Shiki Tohno might already be…
doomed to spend the rest of his life unable even to stand by himself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… If there is a reason, it would be this scar from eight years ago.
The doctor said that it was simply a miracle to be alive.
Perhaps this is the price of my miraculous recovery.
---If that is the case, then I, Tohno Shiki,
may never be able to even stand on my own for the rest of my life.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん？
　どうかなさいました、ひどく不安そうな顔をしてますけど」
「あ……いや、ちょっとイヤな想像をしたら、急に恐くなっただけです」
「あー、ダメですよ志貴さん！
　病は気から、弱気になってしまうと治る病気も治らないんですからねっ！」
「―――そうですね。
悪いほうに考えても仕方がないですし。
……どうも、ありがとうございます、琥珀さん」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? What’s the matter—you look terribly frightened.”
“Nothing; I imagined something awful, and suddenly it scared me.”
“Ah, you mustn’t do that, Master Shiki! Mind over matter—if you lose heart, even an illness that ought to heal never will!”
“―――You’re right. There’s no sense imagining the worst. Thank you, Kohaku.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san?
Are you okay?
You look terrible."
"Ah…… I just imagined something terrible and got a little scared."
"Ah, that's no good, Shiki-san!
If your spirit is weak, you will never be able to recover."
"---I guess you're right.
I guess I'll try to think positive…… Thank you very much, Kohaku-san."

entries.japanese:
「わかっていただければいいんです。
志貴さんは物分かりが良すぎるっていうか、自分の境遇を潔く受け入れてしまう所がありますから。
　ちゃんと、ここぞという時は自分のためだけにわがままを言ってもいいと思います」
　……琥珀さんは真剣に注意してくる。
　不意に、さっき翡翠に話した八年前のことを思い出した。
「……まいったな。
琥珀さん、まだ看病好きだったんだな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“As long as you understand; you’re almost too quick to accept things, Master Shiki. You have a habit of resigning yourself gracefully to whatever happens.
At times like this, you’re allowed to be selfish for your own sake.”
Kohaku was admonishing me in perfect seriousness.
Suddenly I remembered the story from eight years ago that I had just told Hisui.
“I give up. You still love nursing people, don’t you?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"As long as you understand.
You understand things pretty well, and you always seem to accept your circumstances.
So I think it is okay if you complain every once in a while."
…… Kohaku-san seriously offers some advice.
Suddenly, I remember what I was telling Hisui earlier.
"…… Geez.
Kohaku-san, you still do like to nurse people, don't you?"

entries.japanese:
「はい？
　なんですか、それ？」
「昔さ、俺が風邪をひいてるのに無理して遊んでた時があったでしょ。
その時と同じだなって」
「んーっと、そういえばそうコトもありましたね。
志貴さん、自分の体のことはいつも黙っている子でしたっけ」
「琥珀さんにはすぐバレたけどね。
あのあと離れのほうの屋敷に引っ張られたあとのことは、いまでも恨んでるんだからな」
　……いや、本当は感謝してるんだけど、ついいじわるをしたくなって琥珀さんを責める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hm? What do you mean?”
“Remember when I had a cold but kept playing anyway? You’re acting exactly the way you did then.”
“Hmm, now that you mention it, something like that did happen. You were the sort of boy who never told anyone when something was wrong, weren’t you, Master Shiki?”
“But you always found out. I still haven’t forgiven you for what you did after dragging me off to the annex that day.”
In truth I was grateful; I only felt an impish urge to tease her, so I accused her instead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
What do you mean by that?"
"Remember way back, when I caught a cold and wanted to play anyway?
It's just like back then."
"Hmm, I guess something like that happened.
You never said anything about how you felt, Shiki-san."
"But you found out quickly.
Afterwards, you made me go back to the detached building, and I never forgave you for that."
…… Not really; I was actually extremely grateful, but I thought I'd tease Kohaku-san a little bit.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　と。
　琥珀さんは何か必死に思い出そうとかたまってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――”
Then.
Kohaku froze, straining to remember something.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
And then…
Kohaku-san tries earnestly to remember, and she freezes in place.

entries.japanese:
「……あれ。
なんだ、琥珀さん覚えてないんだ」
「なんかそうみたいです。
すみません、わたし物覚えが悪いですから」
「いや、普通は八年も前のことなんて細かく覚えてないし、仕方ないんじゃない？」
「そうですねー。
たいていのことなら覚えているんですけど、もう八年も前の話ですから。
もしかすると、何か大事なことを忘れてしまってるかもしれませんね」
　……それはまったく同感だ。
　俺だってあの森の中の庭に行くまで、八年前の事故の映像を忘れていたんだから。
「それではお食事を持ってきますから、しばらくお一人で休まれてくださいな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh. So you don’t remember after all.”
“Apparently not. I’m sorry; I’ve never had a very good memory.”
“No one remembers every detail from eight years ago; you can hardly help that.”
“I suppose not. I remember most things, but eight years is a long time. Perhaps I’ve forgotten something important.”
I knew exactly what she meant.
Until I returned to that garden in the woods, I had forgotten the image of the accident eight years ago myself.
“I’ll go fetch your meal, so please rest by yourself for a little while.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh.
What's this, did you forget?"
"I guess so.
I'm sorry, my memory is not all that great."
"No, it's hard to remember stuff from eight years ago, so it's no big deal."
"You're right.
I remember most of the things, but it's something from eight years ago, so maybe I might be forgetting something important too."
…… I completely agree.
Before I went to that garden in the forest, I had forgotten entirely the image of the accident eight years ago.
"Well then, I'll bring you some food, so please rest until then."

entries.japanese:
午後になって、一人になった。
　俺一人に琥珀さんと翡翠をかまわせているのも申し訳ないから、とりあえず二人にはもとの仕事に戻ってもらった。
　昨夜は悪夢を見なかったし、体は動かないものの体調は落ちついている。
　この状態なら、夕食まで一人でいても大丈夫だと判断したからだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
By afternoon I was alone.
It seemed unfair to keep both Kohaku and Hisui occupied with me, so I had sent them back to their usual duties.
I hadn’t suffered any nightmares the night before, and although my body remained useless, my condition seemed stable.
I decided I would be fine on my own until dinner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the afternoon, I become alone.
I feel bad letting Kohaku-san and Hisui take care of me all the time, so I had them return to their duties.
Since I didn't have any hideous nightmares last night, even though I can't move, my health is pretty stable.
I figure I can manage by myself until dinner time.

entries.japanese:
「……まあ体が動かないんだから体調が良いも悪いもないとは思うんだけどな」
　ヘッドボードに背中を預けたまま、やる事もなく部屋を眺める。
　屋敷に帰ってきてから十日。
　初めは違和感のあったこの部屋も今では自分の部屋だと認識できてしまっているあたり、人間の順応性というのは侮れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Though when I can’t move at all, I’m not sure ‘fine’ means anything.”
Still propped against the headboard, I gazed idly around the room.
Ten days had passed since my return to the mansion.
At first the room had felt alien; now I accepted it as mine, and human beings were alarmingly adaptable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, my body can't move, so I can't say my health is good or bad."
Leaning back against the headboard, I stare aimlessly.
It's been ten days since I came back to the mansion.
At first, I felt out of place, but now I feel very comfortable in this room.

The thing screamed.
“Damn you, damn you, damn you, damn you, damn you―――――!”
It threw a tantrum like a spoiled child.
It smashed every abandoned desk in the basement and raked great furrows through the concrete floor.
“I’ll kill you, I’ll kill you, I’ll kill you…!”
Then.
It drove a knife through its own palm.
entries.mirrorMoon:

It screams.
"Damn it, damn it, damn it, damn it, damn it-----!"
It acts as a child throwing a tantrum.
Breaking all the desks, and pulling off pieces of concrete from the floor.
"I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you…… !"
Saying so.
It thrusts a knife in its own hand.

entries.japanese:
――――――ギッ――――！？

entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Ghk――――!?
The agony of the knife piercing its hand. It passed unmistakably into mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Gi----!?
The pain of the knife is transmitted to my own hand.

entries.japanese:

「そうして奪いかえしてやる―――――」
　次に腹を、自らの爪で裂いて、臓物を引きずり出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Watch as I kill you piece by piece―――”
Next, it impaled its own thigh on a splinter from a desk.
――――Gah――――
“And then I’ll take it all back―――――”
Next it tore open its belly with its own nails and dragged out the entrails.

----Ga---.
"And I'll take back what you stole-----"
Using his own claws, he rips open his stomach and starts to pull out his intestines.

Pain.

いっそ。
死にたい。

entries.maoEnglish:
“Those fingers, that skin, those eyes!”
It crushed its own eyeball.
―――I’m going mad.
A dream. If this is a dream, let me wake up.
It hurts. If only. I want to die.
The pain should have killed me from shock, yet I could not die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"These fingers, this skin, even these eyes!"
He pushes in his eyes.

A dream.
If this is a dream, please, wake up!
It hurts.
I'd rather.
Die.
This pain is enough to kill me from shock, but I am not dying.

entries.japanese:
「その声も、その位置も、全てはオレのものだ、本来はオレのものだったものだ―――！
　待っていろ、もうじきもうすぐオマエを殺してオレがそこにいってやるからな……！」
　叫んで。
　ソレは自らの脳髄に、
　　　　　　　ナイフを

entries.maoEnglish:
“That voice, that place, everything was mine—it should all have been mine―――!
Just wait; very soon I’ll kill you and take your place…!”
It screamed.
Then the thing raised
the knife
and drove it deep
into its own brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Your voice, your position, all of it is mine, it was all originally mine---!
Just you wait, I will kill you, I will come soon……!"
Screaming.
It takes a knife,
brings it to it's head,
aims for the brain,
and stabs deeply.

entries.japanese:
「ああああああああああああ！」
　その、おそらくは考えられうる中で最高の痛みのイメージで、目が覚めた。
「あ――――はあ、はあ、はあ――――！」
　夢。
今のは夢だ。
「ぐっ……！」
　なのに体中が痛い。
　手の平。
太もも。
腹。
目。
脳天。

今の夢の中の痛みを、そのまま現実に持ってきてしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
The image of what could only have been the greatest pain imaginable wrenched me awake.
“Ah――――hah, hah, hah――――!”
A dream. That had been a dream.
“Guh…!”
Yet my entire body hurt.
Palm. Thigh. Belly. Eye. Crown of the skull.
Every one of them hurt.
Me. I had carried the pain from the dream intact into reality.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
In the middle of the ultimate pain, I wake up.
"Ahhh----ghaa, aagh, aghhh----!"
A dream.
That was a dream.
"G…!"
But my body is hurting everywhere.
Hand, thigh, eyes, skull.
They all hurt.
The pain I received during my dream, I have brought it back into reality.

"A----hh!"
But my body still can't move.
Even though I feel like there is a hole ripped in my palm, I still can't move my body.
"Ah-------ah."
At least if I could move---I could thrash around and maybe reduce some of the agony, but I can't even do that.

entries.japanese:
「い――――痛ぅ」

「あ―――――あ」
　せめて体が動くなら―――精一杯暴れて、意識のうえだけでも痛みを緩和させるコトができるのに、そんな事さえ俺にはできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It――――hurts”
And still my body would not move.
I could feel a hole through my palm, yet I couldn’t move a muscle.
“Ah―――――ah”
If only I could move―――I could thrash about with all my strength and at least blunt the pain in my mind, but even that much was denied me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn----it."
What is, this?
"Why---do these things…"
Earlier, I thought my mind would break before my body would.
"Why, do these, things happen, to me…… !"
But if I sleep, my body may very well break before my mind.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――！」
―――と。
　ノックもせずに、翡翠が部屋に入ってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――!”
―――And then.
Hisui burst into the room without knocking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---!"
---And,
without a knock, Hisui enters my room.

entries.japanese:
「ひ―――すい……？」
「志貴さま、今のお声は志貴さまのものですか―――！？」
　翡翠は切迫した口調でベッドまで歩み寄ってくる。
「な――――志貴さま、一体、何が――――」
　翡翠の声が震えている。
　……見れば。
　シーツは、じっとりと、血で滲んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hi―――sui…?”
“Master Shiki, was that Master Shiki’s voice just now―――!?”
Hisui hurried to the bed, urgency in every step.
“Wh――――Master Shiki, what happened――――”
Her voice was trembling.
I looked.
The sheets were soaked through with blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hi---sui……?"
"Shiki-sama, was that your voice just now---!?"
Hisui walks to the bed with an urgent expression.
"Wha----Shiki-sama, what, in the world----"
Hisui's voice is shaking.
…… I look down.
My sheets are soaked in blood.

entries.japanese:
―――血は、手の平と太ももから流れ出たものらしかった。
　らしかった、というのは推定でしかない。
　なにしろ俺の体には傷口らしき傷口がないんだから、そもそも血がにじみ出るほうがどうかしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:

Seemed was the best I could do.
There wasn’t a wound anywhere on my body, so blood seeping out at all was impossible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It looks like the blood came from my hand and my thigh.
I say 'looks like' because I just think so.
Because there's no wounds on my body, so what's wrong is the fact that the blood's there…

entries.japanese:
「翡翠ちゃん、わたしは点滴の準備をしてくるから志貴さんの容体を看てあげて」
「待って姉さん、志貴さまは――――」
「翡翠ちゃん。
たまにはお姉さんの言うことを聞いてくれてもいいでしょう？」
「あ――――」
「それじゃあ志貴さん、しばらくしたら輸血をいたしますから、それまでは安静にしていてください」
　俺の手当てを終わらせて、琥珀さんは部屋から出ていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, I’m going to prepare an IV, so stay here and watch Master Shiki for me.”
“Wait, Kohaku; Master Shiki is――――”
“Hisui. Just this once, couldn’t you listen to your big sister?”
“Ah――――”
“Master Shiki, I’ll be back shortly to give you a transfusion, so until then, please lie still.”
Once she had finished tending to me, Kohaku left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui-chan, I will prepare an IV, so please watch over Shiki-san."
"Wait, Nee-san, Shiki-sama is----"
"Hisui-chan.
Don't you think it's best to listen to what your older sister has to say once in a while?"
"Ah----"
"Now, Shiki-san, you are going to have a blood transfusion soon, so please relax until then."
After taking care of me, Kohaku-san leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――本当に何もなかったのですか？

「……しつこいな。

傷口だってなかったんだ。
聞きたいのはこっちのほうだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――are you certain nothing happened? My sister said there was no danger, but that bleeding was so―――”
“Enough. I told you nothing happened. There weren’t even any wounds. I’m the one who wants answers.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---is there really nothing wrong?
Nee-san told me not to worry, but all that blood---"
"…… Pretty persistent, aren't you?
I said there isn't anything wrong.
I don't have any wounds.
I'm the one with questions."

entries.japanese:
―――乱暴に言って、自己嫌悪する。
　翡翠には悪いけど、とても冷静でいられない。
　俺は―――どうかしているのか。
　眠れば殺人鬼の夢をみて、自分の体を傷つけてしまう。
　出血はそれが原因だってわかってる。
　わかっているけど、そんな事を翡翠や琥珀さんに言うわけにはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The harshness of my reply filled me with self-loathing.
Hisui didn’t deserve it, but calm was beyond me.
Was I―――losing my mind?
Whenever I slept, I dreamed of a murderer and injured my own body.
I knew that was what had caused the bleeding.
I knew—but I could never tell Hisui or Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Saying this roughly, I hate myself.
I'm sorry for Hisui, but I can't calm down.
There---must be something wrong with me.
If I sleep, I dream of the killer and hurt myself.
I know that's the cause of the bleeding.
I know, but I can't tell Hisui or Kohaku-san that.

entries.japanese:
信じてもらえるはずがないし、なによりそんな事を打ち明ければ、二人はきっと俺が狂っていると思うだろう。
　この体がおかしいって事は認めてやる。
　けど翡翠や琥珀さん、秋葉に俺がマトモじゃないって思われるのだけは、いやだ。
　それだけは、決して口になんてしたくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
They wouldn’t believe me, and worse, if I confessed such a thing, they would surely think I was insane.
I would concede that my body was wrong.
But I couldn’t bear for Hisui, Kohaku, or Akiha to believe there was something wrong with me.
That was the one thing I would never put into words.
entries.mirrorMoon:
They wouldn't believe me, and worse, they would think I have simply gone crazy.
I'll admit my body is weird.
But Hisui, Kohaku-san and Akiha, I just don't want them to think I am crazy.
I do not want to say that.

entries.japanese:
「ですが、もう志貴さまのお体は平常ではありません。
熱もあるようですし、さきほどから呼吸も乱れていて、とても―――」
　見ていられない、という声を翡翠は飲みこんだ。
「……いいから下がっていてくれ。
心配してくれるのはありがたいけど、今は一人になりたいんだ」
「……それでは何かほしいものはございませんか。
喉が渇いていらっしゃるのでしたら何かお持ちします」
「ほしい―――もの？」
　ほしいもの？
　そんなもの、別にない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But Master Shiki’s condition is plainly abnormal. You seem feverish, and your breathing has been ragged for some time―――”
Hisui swallowed the words that would have finished the sentence: I can’t bear to watch.
“Just leave me alone. I’m grateful that you’re worried, but right now I want to be by myself.”
“Then is there anything you would like? If you’re thirsty, I can bring you something to drink.”
“Something―――I’d like?”
Something I wanted?
There was nothing.
entries.mirrorMoon:

You appear to have a fever, and your breathing is wild, I do not---"
wish to see you like this.

"…… I'm fine; go away.
Thanks for worrying about me, but I just want to be alone for now."
"…… Then, is there something you want?
If you are thirsty, please tell me, and I can bring you something."
"Something---I want?"
Something I want?
I don't really want anything right now.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、たしかに喉は渇いてるかな……」
　そう、渇いている。
　カラカラに渇いている。

　喉に貼りつく、とろりと粘るあの液体。
　熱い、命のほとばしりみたいな真っ赤な血が、いまは、飲みたい――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, I suppose I am thirsty.”
Yes, thirsty.
Parched dry.
So I had to suck.
A red drink.
That thick, clinging liquid coating the throat.
Hot, vivid blood like life itself bursting forth—that was what I wanted now――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, I am certainly thirsty……"
Yes, thirsty.
Really thirsty.
So I must suck.
Red, drink.
That sticky fluid that sticks to my throat.
Hot, crimson red blood that is still warm, that's what I want right now----

entries.japanese:

entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
“Master Shiki?”
Something I wanted.

Hisui’s body, as I had seen it in the dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
"…… Shiki-sama?"
Something I, want.
Of course there's something I want.
That is…
Hisui's body I saw in my dream.

「――――――――っ！」

「志貴さま！？

「近寄るな――――！」

「……はあ……はあ……はあ……」

　どうかしてる。
どうかしてる。
どうかしてる。

entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――!”
I struck myself hard in the head.
Rage at myself made the arm that should not have moved obey me.
“Master Shiki! What’s wrong, Master Shiki?!”
“Don’t come near me――――!”
“Master Shiki.”
“Hah, hah, hah”
My throat was burning.
My whole body was burning.
Something was wrong. Something was wrong. Something was wrong.
What had I just imagined doing―――
entries.mirrorMoon:

Smack!
I hit myself in the head.

"Shiki-sama!?

"Don't come near me----!"

I breathe painfully.
My throat is burning.
My body is burning.
There's something wrong with me.
There's something wrong with me.
There's something wrong with me.
What was I just thinking!?

entries.japanese:
「……近寄るな……来れば、なにをするか、わからない」
「ですが、志貴さま―――」
「寄るなって言ってるだろう……！
　俺は狂ってなんかない……！」

entries.maoEnglish:
“Stay away; if you come closer, I don’t know what I’ll do.”
“But, Master Shiki―――”
“I told you not to come closer…! I’m not insane…!”
I screamed the words and rejected her.
But if I did not, I would undoubtedly rape Hisui.
Just as I had in that dream.
Now, possessed by the pounding pulse of my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:

"But, Shiki-sama---"

I'm not crazy……!"
I scream, refusing Hisui's help.
But if I don't do so, I will violate Hisui for sure.

Being controlled by my pulse through my veins.

entries.japanese:
「―――いいから出ていってくれ。

「……はい。
かしこまりました、志貴さま」

entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Just get out. You couldn’t possibly understand what’s happening to my body.”
“Yes. As you wish, Master Shiki.”
Hisui left.
I watched her retreat through a haze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Just leave.
Hisui, you don't understand, anything about my body."
"…… Yes.
As you wish, Shiki-sama."
Hisui leaves.
As she leaves, I stare at her with hazy vision.

entries.japanese:
―――昂ぶったカラダは、誰を見ても同じ事しか考えなかった。
　俺に輸血のための点滴をしてくれている琥珀さんでさえ、その白い喉に噛みつきたい衝動にかられた。
