entries.maoEnglish:
―――My fevered body could think only one thing, no matter whom I looked at.
Even as Kohaku set up the IV for my transfusion, I was seized by the urge to bite into her white throat.
I―――could preserve my sanity only when I was alone.
So I drove Hisui and Kohaku out—and even Akiha.
―――But the result was no different.
Left alone, I merely continued to fall apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---My excited body thinks about the same thing, no matter who I saw.
When Kohaku-san came to give me transfusion, I had the urge to sink my teeth into her white throat.
I----I can't retain my sanity unless I'm alone.
So I made Hisui and Kohaku-san, even Akiha go out of my room.
---The result doesn't change.
If I am alone, all I can do is break.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ……」
　頭痛が走る。
　起きているとまたあの頭痛が流れこんでくる。
　気が狂う前に、目を閉じて眠る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guh….”
Pain lanced through my head.
If I stayed awake, that headache began pouring into me again.
Before it could drive me mad, I closed my eyes and slept.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gu……"
I get a headache.
If I stay awake, the headache flows into me.
Before I go crazy, I close my eyes to sleep.

entries.japanese:
かといって眠るとアイツの夢を見てしまう。
　アイツが自分の体を傷つけるたびに、肉体的な痛みがやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yet when I slept, I dreamed of that thing.
Every time it mutilated its body, the physical agony came to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But then, if I sleep, I will dream about him.
Every time he inflicts pain on his body, I also feel the physical pain.

entries.japanese:
「――――は」
　その痛みで目が覚める。
　けど、そうして目が覚めるたびにあの頭痛がやってくる。
　だから目を閉じて―――また、眠りについてしまう。
　………………その繰り返し。
　軽いまどろみに何度も落ちて、脳を串刺しにされる痛みで目が覚める。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Hah”
The pain woke me.
But each time I woke, the headache returned.
So I closed my eyes―――and fell asleep again.
Again and again and again.
I slipped repeatedly into shallow sleep, only to wake to the pain of something skewering my brain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Agh."
That pain causes me to wake up.
But as soon as I do so, the splitting pain in my head returns.
So I close my eyes---and I fall asleep again.
………………… And I repeat this process.
I go into a light sleep, and wake up from the pain of getting my brain stabbed through.

entries.japanese:
「はあ――――はあ――――はあ――――」
　呼吸は、とっくに乱れていた。
　手足は動かないくせに、ナイフでズタズタにされた痛みで痙攣している。
　時間の感覚なんて、まるでない。
　たった一時間が無限に感じる。
　正直、俺は。
　明日の朝まで正気でいられる自信なんて、まるでなかった。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――hah――――hah――――”
My breathing had long since lost all rhythm.
My limbs could not move, yet the remembered agony of knives tearing them apart made them spasm.
Time had ceased to mean anything.
A single hour felt infinite.
In truth.
I had no confidence whatsoever that I could remain sane until morning.!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Breathing is painful.
I gasp for air.
My limbs won't move, but they shake from the pain.
I have no sense of time.
An hour feels like infinity.
Truthfully, I…
I don't even think that I will be able to maintain my sanity until the morning.

entries.japanese:
―――がちゃり、とドアが開いた。
　足音が近づいてくる。
　……俺はまどろんでいて、それが誰であるか、はっきりとは分からなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The door opened with a click.
Footsteps drew near.
I was half asleep and couldn’t make out who it was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The door opens with a creak.
The sound of approaching footsteps.
…… I am half asleep, and I can't tell exactly who it is.

entries.japanese:
「―――兄さん。
こんなに、やつれて」
　泣くような、声。
「―――ごめんなさい……兄さんがこんなに苦しんでいるのに、私には何もできない」
　そっと、重ねられる指。
「こんな事しか―――私にはできないんです、兄さん」
　あきはの指が、俺の指に絡まっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Brother. You look so wasted away.”
A voice on the edge of tears.
“―――I’m sorry, Brother; you’re suffering so much, and there’s nothing I can do.”
Fingers settled gently over mine.
“This is all―――all I can do for you, Brother.”
Akiha’s fingers entwined with my own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Nii-san, you look so exhausted."
She sounds like she is crying.
"---I'm so sorry…… You're in this much pain, but there is nothing I can do."
The weight of fingers.
"This is the only thing---that I can do, Nii-san."
Akiha wraps her fingers in mine.

entries.japanese:
とくん。
　とくん。
　とくん。
　点滴の音に合わせて、あきはの体温が伝わってくる。
―――温かい。
　ボロボロに剥がれかけていた精神のカラが、それで、少しだけ塗りなおされた気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Drip.
Drip.
Drip.
In time with the IV, Akiha’s warmth flowed into me.
―――Warm.
It felt as though the shell of my mind, peeling away in tatters, had been given a thin new coat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Throb.
Throb.
Throb.
Matching the sound of my IV, Akiha's body temperature flows into me.
---Warm.
It feels like my rotten wall of my consciousness got rebuilt by just that.

entries.japanese:
「待っていて兄さん。
私が、すぐに楽にしてあげますから」
　……指が離れる。
　足音が遠ざかっていく。
―――がちゃり、とドアが閉まった。
　……まどろみのなかで。
　そんな、不確かなゆめを見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait for me, Brother. I’ll make it easier very soon.”
Her fingers slipped away.
The footsteps receded.
―――The door clicked shut.
Somewhere inside my stupor.
I dreamed that uncertain dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hold on, Nii-san.
I will save you soon."
…… Her fingers separate.
The sound of footsteps goes away.
---The door closes.
…… In my half-sleep,
I saw that strange dream.

entries.japanese:
何度目かの朝を迎えた。
　時間的には昨夜から一夜明けただけの事にすぎないが、眠りと覚醒を繰り返している自分にとって、日数や時間の感覚はもう瑣末な区切りにすぎなくなっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I greeted what felt like the latest in an endless succession of mornings.
In reality, only one night had passed, but after cycling through sleep and waking so many times, days and hours had become meaningless divisions.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's been several mornings.
Time-wise, it is only the next morning from last night, but for me, having alternated between being asleep and being awake, time and day is of no concern.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します、志貴さま」
　声がして、翡翠が入ってくる。
「おはようございます。
お飲みものをお持ちいたしました」
「……………」
　ありがとう、なんていう余裕もない。
　翡翠がグラスを持ってやってくるのを苛だたしげに眺めるだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me, Master Shiki.”
At the sound of her voice, Hisui entered.
“Good morning. I brought you something to drink.”
“….”
I had no room in me even for thanks.
I only watched irritably as Hisui approached with a glass.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me, Shiki-sama."
I hear a voice, and Hisui enters the room.
"Good morning.
I have brought you something to drink."
"………………"
I don't even have the energy to say thank you.
I can only stare longingly at what Hisui brought me.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、ご自分でお飲みになられますか？
　まだお体の自由がきかないようでしたら、こちらでお飲みできるよういたしますが」
　身を乗り出すようにこちらの様子を窺う。
　飲ませてくれるって、それでも翡翠は俺の体には触れないだろう。
　いや、そんな事より翡翠に近づかれるほうが困る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you drink by yourself, Master Shiki? If you still cannot move freely, I can help you.”
She leaned forward, studying my condition.
Even if she helped me drink, she still wouldn’t touch my body; but that hardly mattered.
What troubled me was having Hisui come close at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, can you drink it by yourself?
If you can not move freely yet, I can help you."
She leans over to me to check my condition.
Helping me to drink, she says, but she won't even touch my body.
More importantly, I can't allow her to get close to me.

entries.japanese:
昨日と同じだ。
　体は言うことをきかないくせに、翡翠や琥珀さんの顔をみるたびに―――
―――俺は、それこそ狂い出しそうになる。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was the same as yesterday.
My body refused to obey me, yet every time I saw Hisui or Kohaku―――
―――I felt as if I were about to lose my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's just the same as yesterday.
Even though my body won't move, every time I see Hisui or Kohaku-san, I----
---I feel like going crazy.

entries.japanese:
「……水ぐらい自分で飲める。
グラスを置いたらさがってくれ」
「はい、かしこまりました」
　グラスを置いて翡翠は壁ぎわまで下がった。
　なんとか片腕を動かして、グラスに口をつける。
　冷えた水は、空気のように味気ない。
　熱くなった呼吸器官はこんなものじゃ冷やされないし、何かを欲しがる心臓はこんなものじゃ潤わない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I can drink water on my own. Put the glass down and stand back.”
“Yes, of course.”
Hisui set down the glass and retreated to the wall.
Somehow I moved one arm and brought the rim to my lips.
The cold water was as tasteless as air.
It could not cool my burning throat, nor could it satisfy the heart thirsting for something else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can drink water by myself.
Please just leave the glass over there."
"Yes, as you wish."
Hisui places the glass down and waits by the wall.
I manage to move my arm, and place my lips on the cup.
The cold water is tasteless, just like air.
The burning in me cannot be soothed by just this water, and my thirst cannot be quenched by such a thing.

entries.japanese:
翡翠は壁際でじっとこちらを見つめている。
　……なんてコトだろう。
　たった三日間体が動かなくなっているぐらいで、俺は翡翠に嫉妬している。
　あんなふうに自由に動く体を持っていて、なんの苦しみも持っていない彼女に、苛立ちを感じ始めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui stood by the wall, watching me without a word.
What was wrong with me?
My body had been useless for only three days, yet already I was jealous of Hisui.
I was irritated by the sight of a girl who could move freely and knew none of my suffering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui stares at me silently from the wall.
…… What is this?
Not being able to move for only three days, and I already feel jealous of Hisui.
Being able to move freely like that, not having to feel this pain, I start to get a little annoyed.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠」
「はい、なんでしょう志貴さま」
「用が済んだのなら出ていってくれ。
まわりに誰かいると、落ちつけない」
「―――ですが志貴さま、それでは」
「何かあったら呼ぶって言ってるだろ。
……あんまり同じコトを言わせないでくれ。
喋るのは、わりと疲れるんだ」
「……かしこまりました。
それでは時間をおいてもう一度参りますので、どうかご無理をなさらないでください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui.”
“Yes, Master Shiki?”
“If you’ve finished what you came for, leave. I can’t settle down with someone hovering around me.”
“―――But, Master Shiki, then”
“I told you I’ll call if anything happens. Don’t make me repeat myself. Talking takes more out of me than you think.”
“Very well. I will return after a little while, so until then, please do not overexert yourself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui."
"Yes, what is it, Shiki-sama?"
"If you have finished your task, please leave.
I can't relax with people around me like this."
"---But Shiki-sama, in that case…"
"I told you if I need anything, I'll call for you.
…… Don't make me say the same thing over and over again.
Talking makes me pretty tired."
"…… As you wish.
I will return in a while, so please do not strain yourself."

entries.japanese:
扉が閉まる。
　……翡翠は一時間ごとに看護にやってくる。
「………はあ」
　気が滅入る。
　今日だけであと十回以上も、こうやって翡翠を追い返さないといけないかと思うと、自己嫌悪で潰れそうだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The door closed.
Hisui came to check on me once every hour.
“Hah.”
The thought was crushing.
If I had to drive her away like that ten more times before the day was through, I would suffocate under the weight of my own self-loathing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The door closes.
…… Hisui comes every hour to take care of me.
I let out a deep sigh.
I feel even more tired.
Thinking that I have to turn back Hisui like this more than ten times today makes me depressed from self-hatred.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ………！」
　腕をナイフで滅多刺しにする痛みで目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah…!”
I woke to the pain of a knife stabbing my arm over and over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahh………!"
A pain stabbing my arm causes me to waken.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……」
　いつのまにか、また眠ってしまったらしい。
　アイツは今日もあの地下室で、自分の体を殺し続けていた。
「く……そ」
　ダン、と壁に拳を打ちつける。
　こんな痛みをあとどれくらい耐えなければならないのか。
　それともアイツを俺自身の手でなんとかしないかぎり、この痛みは永遠に続くのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah.”
I must have fallen asleep again without noticing.
That thing was in the basement again today, methodically murdering its own body.
“Damn it.”
I slammed my fist into the wall.
How much longer would I have to endure this pain?
Or would it continue forever unless I dealt with that thing myself?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I gasp for air.
It appears I fell asleep at some point.
That person is still in that basement, continuing to kill his body.
"Damn…… it."
I strike the wall with my fist.
How long do I have to stand this pain?
Or will this pain continue forever until I do something to him personally?

entries.japanese:
「どうしろっていうんだ、一体―――！」
　ダン、ともう一度壁を打つ。
　……って、あれ？
「……体、動くじゃないか」
　上半身をベッドから起こす。
　さっきまでは一時間近くかかっていた事が、今では当たり前のように―――いや、以前のとおり―――出来るように回復していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell am I supposed to do―――!”
I struck the wall again.
Wait—what?
“I can move.”
I lifted my upper body from the bed.
What had taken almost an hour moments ago I could now do without effort―――no, exactly as I had before―――my body had recovered.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just what in the world do I have to do---!"
I strike the wall again.
…… Huh?
"…… My body, it's moving."
I lift my upper body from bed.
The motion which took me about an hour to do before seems so natural now---no, like it always has been---and I may even be healed.

entries.japanese:
「やった……治ってくれた……！」
　あんまりに嬉しくて、ベッドから跳ね起きる。
　ぼとん。
「え？」
　なにか落ちた。
　視線をおとす。
　絨毯には。
　肘から抜け落ちた、俺の腕が転がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, I’m better!”
Overcome with joy, I sprang out of bed.
Thud.
“Huh?”
Something had fallen.
I lowered my gaze.
On the carpet.
My own arm lay there, fallen clean out at the elbow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright!
…… I'm all better…… !
I'm so happy, I jump out from the bed.
Whump.
"Eh?"
Something falls down.
I lower my gaze.
On the carpet,
is my forearm, which detached itself from my elbow.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ」
　……夢を、見ていたらしい。
　体中の力を総動員して、なんとか上半身を起こす。
　片腕はまだちゃんと付いている。
　感覚もなければ痛みもない。
　まだ、遠野志貴は壊れていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Another dream.
Summoning every trace of strength in my body, I managed to raise my torso.
My arm was still attached.
I could neither feel it nor feel pain.
Shiki Tohno had not broken yet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Sssttt!"
…… I guess it was a dream.
Using all of my power, I lift my upper body.
My arm is still attached to my body.
I don't have any feeling, not even pain.
It appears I'm not broken yet.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、中に入ってよろしいでしょうか？」
　……翡翠の声だ。
　どうやら看護の時間になったらしい。
「……ああ、入っていいよ」
「失礼します」
「志貴さま。
どうか横になっていてください。
お体を起こしてはいけないと、お医者さまから注意されているはずです」
「一日中寝てるわけにもいかないだろ。
それに医者だっていっても、少しも体を治せないんなら有り難みも何もない」
　翡翠は肩をすくめて、申し訳なさそうに黙ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, may I come in?”
Hisui’s voice.
It must be time for her next visit.
“Yes, come in.”
“Excuse me.”
“Master Shiki. Please lie down. The doctor expressly warned you not to sit up.”
“I can’t spend the whole day flat on my back. And if a doctor can’t improve me in the slightest, what good is he?”
Hisui drew in her shoulders and fell silent, looking almost apologetic.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, may I please enter?"
…… Hisui's voice.
I guess it's time for her to check up on me again.
"…… Yeah, come in."
"Excuse me."
"Shiki-sama, please lie down.
The doctor has told you not to sit up."
"Well, I can't be sleeping all day.
And even if you call him a doctor, I don't have any appreciation if he can't help me at all."
Hisui lowers her shoulders silently with an apologetic look.

entries.japanese:
……イライラする。
　そんなうわべだけの気遣いをされても俺には不愉快なだけだって、どうして解らないんだこの女は―――

「――やめてくれ。
そんな、いちいち同情しているような顔をされると気が滅入る」
「―――はい。
申し訳ありません、志貴さま」
「……やることがあるなら早く済ませてくれ。
どうせ俺には何もできないんだから、シーツを替えるなり点滴を換えるなり簡単にできるだろ」
「……はい、かしこまりました」
　翡翠は無言で点滴の中身を取りかえる。
　汗と血で汚れたシーツと寝巻を替えるのは琥珀さんの役割らしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
It irritated me.
How could this woman not understand that her shallow concern only made me feel worse―――
“――Stop that. Having you make that pitying face at every little thing is depressing.”
“―――Yes. I’m sorry, Master Shiki.”
“If you have something to do, then hurry and do it. I can’t do anything myself, so changing the sheets or replacing the IV should be easy enough.”
“Yes, at once.”
Hisui silently changed the contents of the IV.
Apparently, replacing the sheets and nightclothes soiled with sweat and blood was Kohaku’s duty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I feel annoyed.
If she acts like that I'll just get more miserable, why can't she understand that, this woman--.
"--Stop it.
If you keep showing such a pitying face, I'll just feel worse."
"---I am very sorry, Shiki-sama."
"…… If you have something to do, hurry up and do it.
I can't do anything, so it should be easy for you to change the sheets or my IV."
"…… Yes, as you wish."
Hisui wordlessly changes my IV bag.
Taking care of the sweat and blood-stained sheets along with my pajamas is apparently Kohaku-san's job.

entries.japanese:
作業が終わったのに、翡翠はなかなかベッドから離れようとしない。
「翡翠……？」
「―――志貴さま。
一つ、お聞きしてよろしいですか……？」
「？」
　翡翠の声は、どこか震えている。
「……いいけど、なに？」
「……はい。
志貴さまのお体は、その……痛むの、ですか」
「な――――――」
　一瞬、本当に翡翠に怒鳴りそうになってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her work was finished, but Hisui made no move to leave the bedside.
“Hisui?”
“―――Master Shiki. May I ask you one question?”
“?”
There was a faint tremor in her voice.
“All right, what?”
“Yes. Master Shiki, does your body hurt?”
“Wh――――――”
For one instant, I nearly screamed at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Even though she's done, Hisui does not withdraw from the bedside.
"Hisui……?"
"---Shiki-sama.
May I ask you a question……?"
"?"
Hisui's voice seems to be quivering.
"…… Yeah, what is it?"
"…… Shiki-sama, does your body…… hurt?"
"Wha------"
For a moment, I almost yell at Hisui.

entries.japanese:
痛むのか、だって？
　翡翠に―――俺じゃないヤツに、この痛みが分かるものか。
　自分の体が刃物で滅多ざしにされているだけでも狂いそうなのに、体がぴくりとも動いてくれない俺を見て、痛むのか、なんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Did it hurt?
Could Hisui―――could anyone other than me possibly understand this pain?
My body could be hacked apart by blades until I lost my mind and not so much as twitch, yet she looked at me and asked whether it hurt―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Does my body hurt?
Can she---someone not me, understand the pain I'm going through?
I'm about to go insane from the constant sensation of my body being stabbed, and I can't even move while all this is happening.
She looks at me like that and asks me if my body hurts---

entries.japanese:
「―――さあ、どうだか。
もうわからない。
俺自身どうなっているのか、とっくに麻痺してしまってるからな」
「…………は……い」
　翡翠の声はますます震えていく。
「ただ、体が透明の炎で燃やされていっているみたいだ。
指の先から一本一本、少しずつ死んでいく」
「…………」
　翡翠は辛そうに押し黙っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Who knows? I don’t anymore. I’ve been numb to what’s happening to me for a long time.”
“I see.”
Her voice trembled harder.
“It feels as if an invisible fire is consuming my body. Starting at my fingertips, killing me one piece at a time.”
“…”
Hisui pressed her lips shut, plainly in pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Who knows.
I don't know.
I've just become numb all over."
"………… Ye……… s."
Hisui's voice is shaking more and more.
"It feels like my body is being burned by an invisible fire.
I'm dying bit by bit from my fingers onward."
"…………"
Hisui stays there in pained silence.

entries.maoEnglish:
…
……
………
And then…

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴さま、わたしは」
　翡翠の声はもう震えていない。
　冷静な、いつも通りの、抑揚のない声。
「このような志貴さまを見ているのは、耐えられません」
　そういう翡翠は。
　俺の事なんてどうでもいいような、無表情な顔をしている。
―――どくん、と心臓がはねあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Master Shiki, I”
Hisui’s voice no longer trembled.
It was calm, flat, and toneless—the voice I knew.
“I cannot bear to watch Master Shiki suffer like this.”
Hisui said it.
Her face was blank, as if she couldn’t care less what happened to me.
―――My heart gave a violent leap.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shiki-sama, I…"
Hisui's voice is no longer shaking.
Calm, as always, uninflected voice.
"I cannot stand seeing you like this any longer."
Hisui says all of this,
but her expressionless face seems like she doesn't care about me.
---My heart starts to race.

entries.japanese:
「――――」
　欲しい、という衝動が湧きあがる。
　こんなに身近に翡翠がいる。
翡翠の体がある。
　手を伸ばせば、今すぐにでも自分のものにしてしまえる―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――”
A single urge welled up inside me: I wanted her.
Hisui was so close. Her body was right there.
I had only to reach out and make her mine―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
The impulse to want her increases.
Hisui stands this close to me.
Her body is this close.
If I just reach out my arms, I can make her mine---

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、わたしは」
「うるさい……！
　そんな顔で俺を見るな！」
　怒りは突発的だった。
　ただ翡翠の無表情な態度が許せなくて、点滴のパックを掴んで、翡翠の顔にたたきつけた。
　ぱしゃ、という液体の音。
　翡翠にかかる、輸血パックの赤い染み。
　それでも翡翠の表情は変わらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I”
“Shut up…! Don’t look at me with that face!”
The anger came from nowhere.
Hisui’s expressionless manner was suddenly intolerable, and I seized the IV bag and flung it into her face.
Liquid burst with a wet splash.
Red from the transfusion bag splashed across Hisui.
Her expression did not change.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, I…"
"Shut up……!
Don't look at me with that face!"
This anger is totally unexpected.
I can't stand her expressionless face, so I take the IV bag and throw it at her.
Splat!
The red stain splashes all over Hisui.
But her expression does not change.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴さま、無理はなさらないでください」
　その言い方。
感情のない、声。
「……うるさい。
俺の体だ、どうしようが俺のかってだろう……！」
　変わらない表情。
それがますます神経に触れる。
「そうだよな。
どうせ翡翠にとっては人ごとにすぎないことだ。
そりゃあ痛くも痒くもないだろうさ！」
「志貴さま―――どうか、落ち着いてください」
　翡翠の表情は変わらない。
俺に何と罵られようが、黙って耐えている。
―――それが、逆に頭にくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Master Shiki, please do not strain yourself.”
That tone. That empty voice.
“Shut up. It’s my body; I can do whatever I want with it…!”
Her expression did not change. It grated on me more and more.
“Of course. To you, this is only happening to someone else. Why should it hurt you?”
“Master Shiki―――please calm yourself.”
Her face remained still. Whatever abuse I hurled at her, she bore it in silence.
―――That only made me angrier.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shiki-sama, please do not strain yourself."
That way of talking.
That expressionless, voice.
"…… Shut up!
This is my body, I can do what I want with it……!"
Her unchanging expression.
It gets more and more on my nerves.
"That's it.
Hisui, this has nothing to do with you.
Of course you don't feel pain or anything like that!"
"Shiki-sama---please, calm down."
Her expression still does not change.
No matter what I say to her, she receives it quietly.
---That only makes me even angrier.

entries.japanese:
「ああ、そうだろうさ。
そりゃあ翡翠に比べたら俺なんか落ちつきのカケラもない……！
　おまえは俺がこんなに苦しんでるのに眉一つ動かさないで、そんなふうに冷静に観察していられるぐらい冷たいヤツなんだから――――！」
「志貴さま、どうか無理なさらないでください。
そのように声をあげられてはお体にさわります」
「こ……の……！
　もういい、さっさと出ていけ！
　何も出来ないのなら目障りだ……！」
「―――かしこまりました。
それでは失礼します、志貴さま」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, I know! Compared with you, I don’t have an ounce of composure, while I’m suffering right in front of you and you don’t so much as lift an eyebrow. You can stand there and observe me so calmly because you’re cold inside――――!”
“Master Shiki, please don’t exert yourself. Raising your voice that way will worsen your condition.”
“You…! Enough; get out! If you can’t do anything, then you’re only in the way!”
“―――Very well. Excuse me, Master Shiki.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, of course.
Compared to you, I can never be that calm.
Because as hurt as I am, you don't even raise an eyebrow, and you just calmly observe me---!"
"Shiki-sama, please do not push yourself.
If you yell like that, your body may get worse."
"Why…… you……!
That's enough, get out of here!
I'm sick and tired of looking at you, you're worthless……!"
"---As you wish.
Please excuse me, Shiki-sama."

entries.japanese:
立ち去っていく翡翠。
　その時、ちらりと翡翠の指先が見えた。
　彼女は血が滲むぐらい強く、自分の手を握っていた。
　……まるで、できるだけ自分の感情を押し殺そうと努力していたみたいに。
「あ――――」
　それが、俺に気を使っての事だっていうのは、すぐに解った。
　同情なんてするな、と俺が言ったから。
　いちいち律儀に、俺の身勝手な八つ当たりに、じっと耐えて、いたのか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui turned to leave.
Then I caught a glimpse of her fingers.
She clenched her hand so hard that blood had begun to well from it.
It looked as though she were doing everything she could to crush her feelings out of sight.
“Ah――――”
I understood at once that she had done it for my sake.
Because I had told her not to pity me.
Meticulous as ever, she had endured every selfish blow I struck at her without protest―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui leaves the room.
As she does so, I happen to see her fingers.
Her fingers are clenched so tightly, I expected to see blood flow.
…… As if she is trying to kill her expression as much as possible.
"Ah----"
I understand instantly that it is for my sake.
Since I told her not to pity me.
She just withstood all my selfish venting of anger on her---

entries.japanese:
「くそ……なにやってるんだ、俺」
　翡翠に当り散らしても体がよくなるわけでもない。
　いや、そればかりか、俺は――――
「―――――く」
　……本当に、どうかしている。
　翡翠にやつ当たりをするだけじゃなくて、翡翠が近くにいるだけで欲情してしまってたなんて。
　翡翠の肌を間近で見て、微かな匂いをかぐだけで欲しがってしまうのなら、俺はアイツと変わらない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it, what am I doing?”
Taking my misery out on Hisui would never make me better.
Worse than that, I had――――
“―――――Guh”
I truly was losing my mind.
It wasn’t enough that I lashed out at Hisui—I became aroused merely by having her near.
If the sight of her skin and the faint scent of her body were enough to make me want her, then I was no different from that thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn… what am I doing?"
It's not like I'll get better if I take it out on Hisui.
No, not just that, but I---
"-----Gah."
…… There really is something wrong with me.
Not only did I take it out on her like that, but when she was close, I was lusting for her.
If seeing her skin so close and smelling her light fragrance makes me want all of her, I'm no different than him.

entries.japanese:
#ff0000

　だから　同じだって　いっているだろう
#ffffff

「また―――」
#ff0000

　オレと　オマエ　は同じ　人間なんだから
#ffffff

「うる―――さい」
#ff0000

　そう　同じだ　オレが　いままで閉じ込められていた　ように　オマエ　も
#ffffff

「だまれ――――」
#ff0000

　その部屋に　一生　閉じ込められる　
#ffffff

「なっ―――」
#ff0000

　その檻から　出られないで　一生
#ffffff

「き―――さま」
#ff0000

　ずっと　閉じ込められたままなのさ……！
#ffffff

「うるさいって言ってるだろう……！」

ゴン、と頭を壁に叩きつける。
　それで声は止んだ。
　……だが、代償に意識が遠くなっていく。
「…………」
　後は。
また、あの地下室の夢を見る事に、なる。
entries.maoEnglish:
that is what i keep telling you　we are the same
“Again―――”
you and i are the same person
“Shut―――up”
yes　the same　just as i was locked away all this time　you too
“Be quiet――――”
you will spend your whole life trapped in that room
“Wh―――”
you will never escape that cage　not for the rest of your life
“You―――bastard”
you will stay locked inside forever…!
“I told you to shut up…!”
I smashed my head against the wall with a dull thud.
The voice stopped.
The price was that my consciousness began to recede.
“…”
After that. I would dream of that basement again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
#ff0000

That's why  I said  we are the same.
#ffffff

"Again---"
#ff0000

Because you  and I  are  the same person.
#ffffff

"Shut---up!"
#ff0000

That's right the same  just like I was   locked up all this time   you too.
#ffffff

"Shut up---"
#ff0000

In this room  locked up  for life.
#ffffff

"Wh---"
#ff0000

Unable to leave  this prison  forever.
#ffffff

"Y---ou."
#ff0000

Eternally  locked away……!
#ffffff

"I said, shut up……!"

entries.japanese:
―――夕方になった。
　起きている間にやってくる頭痛は、今は少し薄れてくれている。
「……………」
　琥珀さんは三度目の着替えをすませて退室していった。
　……翡翠は、あれから姿を現さない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Evening came.
For now, the headache that came while I was awake had faded a little.
“….”
Kohaku had finished changing me for the third time and left.
Hisui had not appeared since then.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I slam my head against the wall.
The voice stops.
…… But, as a price, my consciousness fades.
"…………"
Then, I dream of the basement again.

entries.japanese:
「当たり前か。
……あんなことを言われたら、ふつう来ない」
　……翡翠は、もう来ない。
　そう思っただけで気が遠くなりそうだったけど、それがいいんだっていう事も解っている。
　万が一、翡翠がまたやってきてくれても。
　俺は彼女に辛くあたるばかりで、看護される資格なんてないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course she hasn’t. No one would come back after hearing that.”
Hisui would never come again.
The thought alone nearly made me faint, yet I knew it was better this way.
Even if Hisui did return, I would only hurt her.
I had no right to be nursed by her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It's afternoon now.
The headache that greets me when I awake is slightly less then usual.
"……………"
Kohaku-san finishes changing me for the third time and leaves.
…… Hisui did not come again after that incident.

"Of course.
…… After what I said, it's only natural not to come back."
…… Hisui won't come again.
Just thinking that, I start to feel my spirit drift far away, but I understand that it's to both of our benefits.
If by some chance, she does come again,
all I will do is take it out on her again, and I don't deserve her kindness.

entries.japanese:
「……失礼します、志貴さま」
　そう言って、翡翠が部屋に入ってきた。
　翡翠はドアをしめて、そこから一歩も動かない。
　彼女の手には銀のトレイと、水がつがれたグラスがある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me, Master Shiki.”
With those words, Hisui entered the room.
She closed the door but did not move a single step beyond it.
In her hands were a silver tray and a glass of water.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please excuse me, Shiki-sama."
Saying that, Hisui enters my room.
Hisui shuts the door, but does not come any closer.
In her hand, she holds a tray with a glass of water.

entries.japanese:
「お飲み物をお持ちいたしましたが、お飲みになられますか？」
「――――――――」
　翡翠は本当に無表情だ。
　ただ、その指先が震えている。
「……翡翠」
　……どうして。
あんなコトまで言われたのに、彼女は俺なんかの看護をしてくれるんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I brought you something to drink; would you like it?”
“――――――――”
Her face truly was expressionless.
But her fingertips were trembling.
“Hisui.”
Why? After everything I had said, why would she still care for someone like me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I have brought you something to drink, do you care for it?"
"--------"
Hisui really is expressionless.
But, I can still see her fingertips shaking.
"…… Hisui."
…… Why?
After all those terrible things I said, why is she still taking care of me?

entries.japanese:
「……いいんだ翡翠。
無理をしなくていいから、俺なんかの相手をしなくて、いい」
「志貴さま。
わたしは無理なんてしていません。
志貴さまこそ、どうぞご無理はなさらないでください」
　感情のない翡翠の声。
　今も震えている白い指先。
　……ようやく気がついた。
　翡翠の声は、感情がないんじゃなくて、感情を押し殺した声なんだと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right, Hisui. You don’t have to force yourself to look after someone like me.”
“Master Shiki. I’m not forcing myself. Master Shiki is the one who must stop pushing himself.”
Hisui’s emotionless voice.
Her white fingertips still trembled.
At last, I understood.
Hisui’s voice was not emotionless; it was the voice of someone suppressing every feeling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay, Hisui.
You don't have to force yourself; if you don't wish to be near me, it's fine."
"Shiki-sama, I am not forcing myself.
Rather, please do not force yourself, Shiki-sama."
Hisui's emotionless voice.
Her shaking fingers.
…… I finally realize it.
It isn't that her voice is emotionless; it's that she's killing the emotion in her voice.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん。
俺のこと、軽蔑していい」
「いいんです、志貴さま。
わたしこそ何もできないのですから、責められて当然なんです」
――――そんな事、当然のハズがない。
　悪いのは、一方的にこっちなんだから。
「……すまない。
悪いけど、体が重いんだ。
自分じゃ飲めそうにないから、飲むのを手伝ってもらえないか」
「……はい。
そのお言葉を、お待ちしておりました」
　そうして、翡翠はベッドまで歩いてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry. You have every right to despise me.”
“It’s all right, Master Shiki. I can do nothing to help you, so I deserve your reproach.”
――――Of course she didn’t deserve that.
I was the only one at fault.
“I’m sorry, but my body feels heavy. I don’t think I can drink by myself. Would you help me?”
“Yes. I have been waiting for you to ask.”
Hisui crossed the room to the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm sorry.
You can hate me, if you want."
"It is alright, Shiki-sama.
I cannot do anything, so it is natural for you to scold me."
----That, isn't natural at all.
The only one at fault is me.
"…… I'm sorry.
My body is a little heavy.
I don't think I can drink by myself, can you please help me?"
"…… Yes.
I have been waiting for those words."
Hisui walks towards my bed.

entries.japanese:
「……失礼します」
　遠慮がちな声でそう言って、翡翠は俺の体を起こしてくれた。
「え―――翡翠？」
「どうぞ、ゆっくりお飲みください」
　片手で俺の背中を支えて、グラスを口に運んでくれる。
　今まで。
翡翠は決して、こっちの体には触れてこなかったのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Her voice hesitant, Hisui lifted my body upright.
“Huh―――Hisui?”
“Drink slowly, please.”
She supported my back with one hand and brought the glass to my lips.
Until now. Hisui had never touched my body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please excuse me."
Saying that with a restrained voice, she lifts my body.
"Eh---Hisui?"
"Please, drink slowly."
With one hand supporting my back, she brings the glass to my mouth.
Until now, Hisui never touched me no matter what.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　こくん、と水を数口含んで、首を横にふった。
　グラスを置く翡翠。
　そのまま、手の平を俺の額に重ねてくる。
――――どくん、と。
　今までとは違ったふうに、心臓が高鳴った。
「翡翠―――いい、のか」
　翡翠の手の平が離れる。
「……熱は、ないようです」
　うつむく翡翠。
　思ってもみなかった。
こんな事だけで、こんなにも俺は痛みが和らいでしまっている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“….”
I swallowed several mouthfuls, then shook my head.
Hisui set down the glass.
Without withdrawing, she laid her palm against my forehead.
――――My heart thudded.
It was different from before.
“Hisui―――are you sure?”
Her palm left my skin.
“You don’t seem to have a fever.”
Hisui lowered her eyes.
I would never have believed it. A touch so small could ease the pain this much―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Gulping down a few mouthfuls, I shake my head.
Hisui puts the glass to the side.
Then she puts her hand on my forehead.
----Thump.
My heart starts to pound heavily in a totally different way than other times.
"Hisui---is this, alright?"
Hisui lifts her hand.
"…… There does not, seem to be a fever."
Hisui murmurs this.
I didn't even think so.
All of my pain seems to fade away with just that---

entries.japanese:
「翡翠……その、お願いがあるんだけど」
「はい、なんでしょうか志貴さま」
「ああ――もう少し、手を重ねていてくれないか
「なぜ……でしょうか」
「……翡翠の手、冷たくて気持ちがいいんだ。
そうしてくれると、楽になれる」
―――本当に、さっきまでの痛みが嘘のように、楽になれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, there’s something I’d like to ask.”
“What is it, Master Shiki?”
“Ah――would you keep your hand there a little longer
“Why…?”
“Your hand is cool and feels good. When you touch me like that, I feel better.”
―――The agony of moments ago receded as though it had never existed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui…… Can I ask you a favor?"
"Yes, what is it, Shiki-sama?"
"Aa--could you please, keep your hand there for a bit longer."
"Why…… do you want me to do that?"
"…… Your cool hand, it feels good.
If you do that, I can relax."
---All of my pain disappears as if it was merely a lie.

entries.japanese:
翡翠はかすかに頬を赤らめて、はい、と消え入るように答えて、俺の額に手の平を重ねてきた。
「……不思議だ……なんか、なつかしい……」
　気分が落ち着く。
　意識が和らいでいく。
　……ああ、そういえば翡翠に看てもらったまま眠った時も、こんな感じだった。
「……ありがとう……ごめんな、翡翠」
　意識が沈む。
　ほんの僅かな時間。
　何日かぶりに、何の苦痛に悩まされることもない平穏な眠りにつく事ができた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s cheeks colored faintly as she whispered yes, almost inaudibly, and laid her palm over my forehead once more.
“Strange; it feels familiar.”
Calm settled over me.
My mind softened.
Come to think of it, this was how I had felt when I fell asleep with Hisui watching over me before.
“Thank you, and I’m sorry, Hisui.”
My awareness sank.
Only for a little while.
For the first time in days, I slipped into a peaceful sleep untouched by any kind of pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui's cheeks turn slightly red, and with a smile, she places her hand on my forehead.
"…… That's strange…… Why do I feel nostalgic, all of a sudden……"
I feel relaxed.
My consciousness starts to become at ease.
…… Yeah, come to think of it, I felt like this when Hisui took care of me like this before.
"…… Thank you…… and sorry, Hisui."
My consciousness sinks into oblivion.
For a brief period of time.
For the first time in days, I slip into a peaceful sleep without any pain or suffering.

entries.japanese:
深夜になって、翡翠には部屋に戻ってもらった。
　さっきは気分が落ち着いてくれたが、いつまたあの『頭痛』がやってきて、俺が正気をなくしてしまうか分からない。
「っ…………」
　くわえて、俺の体はどうかしてる。
　指先一本だって動かないくせに、翡翠や琥珀さんの体を自由にするためだったら、それこそ俺の意思とは無関係に暴れ出してもおかしくない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Deep in the night, I sent Hisui back to her room.
Her touch had calmed me before, but I had no idea when that headache might return and rob me of my sanity.
“Ngh….”
And something was badly wrong with my body.
It could not move so much as a fingertip for me, yet if it meant having its way with Hisui’s or Kohaku’s body, it might run wild without the slightest regard for my will.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It's midnight, and I made Hisui return to her room.
Even though I felt better earlier, I don't know when that headache will return and make me lose my sanity.
"…………"
Furthermore, there is something still wrong with my body.
Even though I can't even move my fingers, I wouldn't be surprised if they suddenly moved against my will to attack Hisui or Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
「痛―――う」
　頭痛は止まらない。
　体は動かない。
　アイツが自分の体を傷つけることによって伝わってくるのは痛みだけじゃないのかもしれない。
「っつ―――は、あ、はぁ…………！」
　ゴホゴホと咳き込む。
　今日の夕方からずっと、アイツが喉をナイフで刺していたせいか、それ以来うまく呼吸ができなくなっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It―――hurts.”
The headache would not stop.
My body would not move.
Perhaps pain was not the only thing that passed into me when that thing mutilated itself.
“Ngh―――hah, ah, hah…!”
I broke into a fit of coughing.
Ever since that thing began stabbing itself in the throat that afternoon, I had been unable to breathe properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ouu---"
My headache does not stop.
My body does not move.
Maybe it's not just pain being transmitted when that guy hurts his own body.
"Ah---ha,a,haa…………!"
I cough uncontrollably.
Ever since he started stabbing himself in the throat with a knife, I haven't been able to breathe properly.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ……はあ……は……ぐ」
　ぜー、ぜー。
　しわがれた声が夜に響いていく。
　故障したロボットじゃあるまいし、俺は息を吸う、なんて簡単なことさえ、細心の注意を払っていないと失敗してしまう。
「……ここまで……なのか、な」
　本来なら八年前に停止していた体だ。
　そりゃあ、いつかこうなる事ぐらい、考えてなかったワケじゃない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, ha, gh.”
Wheeze, wheeze.
The rasp of my voice carried into the night.
I was no broken robot, yet even the simple act of drawing breath failed unless I devoted my full attention to it.
“Is this as far as I go?”
This body should have stopped eight years ago.
I could hardly claim I had never imagined that someday it might come to this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ahh…… gghaa…… ah…… ggggg."
*wheeze* *wheeze*
My hoarse voice echoes through the night.
I can't even perform a simple task like breathing normally unless I concentrate.
"…… Is this…… the end?"
This body was supposed to have died eight years ago.
It's not that I never thought I would end up like this.

entries.japanese:
「は………はは、は」
　けど、これでいいのかもしれない。
　俺はいつもアイツが人を殺す夢を見ていた。
　けど、本当は『アイツ』なんていうヤツは初めからいなくて、アレは―――たんに、俺が行っていた現実だったのかもしれない。
　……弓塚の言葉を思い出す。
　彼女は俺のことを殺人鬼だと言っていた。
　あの時は否定するしかなかったけど、今は―――それを否定する力もない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha, hah, ha.”
Perhaps this was for the best.
I had always dreamed of that thing killing people.
But perhaps there had never been anyone else at all, and those dreams were―――simply the reality of what I myself had done.
I remembered Yumizuka’s words.
She had called me a murderer.
Then I could do nothing but deny it, but now―――I did not even have the strength for that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha……… haha, ha."
But maybe this is for the best.
I've always watched him kill people in my dreams.
But, maybe "he" never existed in the first place---maybe it was me all along.
…… I remember Yumizuka's words.
She said that I was a true killer.
Back then, all I could do was deny it, but now---I don't even have the power to do so.

entries.japanese:
マトモじゃない精神。
　壊れている肉体。
　人殺しの夢を見る自分。
　自分の中から響いてくる、自分と違う自分の声。
　……翡翠を汚している妄想が頭から離れない遠野志貴。
entries.maoEnglish:
A mind no longer sane.
A broken body.
A self that dreamed of murder.
Another self’s voice echoing from inside me.
Shiki Tohno, unable to drive from his mind the fantasy of defiling Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My disturbed mind.
My broken body.
The dreams I have of killing people.
The voice that echoes within me, the voice that isn't mine.
…… The Tohno Shiki who can't stop imagining how I violated Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「…………っ！」
　頭蓋骨が割れそうな頭痛。
　まるで殺人鬼という人格が、今の自分を食い破ろうとしているかのような、脱皮の音。
　……忘れている事故の記憶。
　血にまみれた自分の姿。
　なら、こうして見てしまう殺人の夢は、俺が過去に犯して、たんに忘れてしまっている映像が蘇っているだけなのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…!”
A headache fierce enough to split my skull.
The sound of a skin being shed—as though the murderer’s personality inside me were gnawing its way out through my present self.
The memory of an accident I had forgotten.
The sight of myself drenched in blood.
Then perhaps these dreams of murder were only forgotten images returning—images of crimes I myself had committed in the past.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Ah!"
The headache that feels like my skull is cracking.
It's like the sound of the killer's personality devouring my soul.
…… The forgotten memory of that incident.
My figure coated in blood.
Then maybe, my dreams of killing people might be forgotten memories surfacing once again.

entries.japanese:
「―――っ……！
　あ、あううぅぅう……！
　あたまがいたい。
　何かを殺せ、と声が聞こえてくる。
　……ああ、でも大丈夫だ。
　たとえ俺が殺人鬼でも、もう誰も殺せない。
　アイツの言うとおり、俺はこの部屋に閉じ込められたまま、もう一歩だって自分の力じゃ外に出る事はできなくなってしまっているんだから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Ngh…! A-aaagh…!
My head hurts.
A voice is telling me to kill something.
Ah, but it’s all right.
Even if I’m a murderer, I can’t kill anyone anymore.
Just as that thing said, I’m trapped in this room, unable to take even a single step outside under my own power――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Gah……!
Ah, auuuu……!"
Pain floods my consciousness.
I can hear a voice that tells me to kill something, anything.
…… Ah, but it's alright.
Even if I am a killer, I couldn't possibly kill anyone the way I am now.
Just like he said, I'm locked up in here, not even being able to take a step outside by myself----

entries.japanese:
ぜー、ぜー、ぜー
　ぜー、ぜー、ぜー
　ぜー。
ぜー。
ぜー。
ぜー。
「……志貴さま！？
　どうか、どうかしっかりしてください、志貴さま……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
Wheeze, wheeze, wheeze
Wheeze, wheeze, wheeze
Wheeze. Wheeze. Wheeze. Wheeze.
“Master Shiki?! Please—please hold on, Master Shiki!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
*wheeze*, *wheeze*, *wheeze*
*wheeze*, *wheeze*, *wheeze*
*wheeze*.
*wheeze*.
*wheeze*.
*wheeze*.
"…… Shiki-sama!?
Please, hold on, Shiki-sama……!"

entries.japanese:
ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー
　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー
　ぜー、ぜー、ぜー、ぜー……！
「失礼します、志貴さま……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
Wheeze, wheeze, wheeze, wheeze…!
“Forgive me, Master Shiki…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*……!
"Please excuse me, Shiki-sama……!"

entries.japanese:
ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　
「……あ……れ……ひす、い……？」
「よかった……お目覚めになってくれたんですね、志貴さま」
　翡翠は声をつまらせて、そんな事を言ってくる。
　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー
「……？」
　俺には、翡翠がそんな顔をしている理由がてんでわからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
“Wh-what, Hi-sui?”
“Thank goodness, you’ve opened your eyes, Master Shiki.”
Hisui’s voice caught as she spoke.
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
“…?”
I had no idea why Hisui looked that way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
"…… H…… uh…… Hisu,i……?"
"Thank goodness…… You have awoken, Shiki-sama."
Hisui speaks to me in a clipped voice.
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
"…… ?"
I don't understand why Hisui is looking at me like that.

entries.japanese:
「……どうしたんだよ翡翠。
そんな顔して、なにかあったのか」
「…………いえ、何もありません。
志貴さま、今は何もお考えにならず、どうかお体をお休めになっていてください」
「……ああ、言われなくてもそうしてるけど」
　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー
「でも翡翠、なんか、今朝はうるさくないか。
こうぜーぜーうるさいと、よく眠れない」
「……志貴さま、それは」
　それきり、翡翠は言いにくそうに黙ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong, Hisui? Why are you making that face; did something happen?”
“No, nothing is wrong. Master Shiki, please put everything out of your mind and rest.”
“I am; you don’t have to tell me.”
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
“But Hisui, isn’t it awfully noisy this morning? It’s hard to sleep with all that wheezing.”
“Master Shiki, that is”
Hisui fell silent, unable to bring herself to finish.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What happened Hisui?
Looking at me like that, did something happen?"
"………… No, it's nothing.
Shiki-sama, please rest your body; you do not need to think about anything at all."
"…… Yeah, I'm already doing that."
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
"But Hisui, isn't it loud this morning?
I can't sleep well with this wheezing sound coming from somewhere."
"…… Shiki-sama, that is…"
Hisui falls silent with a strained expression on her face.

entries.japanese:
ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　ぜー
　音はやまない。
　とても近いところから聞こえてくる。
「――――っ」
　ごほ、と咳き込む。
　その時だけぜーぜーという音は止まった。
「あ―――」
　……なんだ、馬鹿らしい。
　どうりでうるさいと思ったら、ゼーゼーいっていたのは俺の呼吸だったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
wheeze wheeze wheeze wheeze
The sound would not stop.
It was coming from very close.
“――――”
I coughed.
For that instant alone, the wheezing stopped.
“Ah―――”
How stupid.
No wonder it sounded so loud; the wheezing was my own breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
The sound keeps coming.
I can hear it coming from near me.
"----!"
I cough.
Only during that instant does the sound stop.
"A---"
…… Well, I feel stupid.
The wheezing sound was only my breathing this whole time.

entries.japanese:
「まいったな。
別に、風邪をひいてるわけでもないん、だけど」
「……………」
　翡翠はうつむいたまま、唇をきつくかみ締めている。
　何かを言いたいのに、口にできない。
　……翡翠の態度はそんなふうにとれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s strange. It’s not as though I have a cold.”
“…”
Hisui kept her head bowed, biting hard into her lip.
She wanted to say something, but could not bring herself to speak.
That was how Hisui’s behavior struck me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Man.
It's not like I've caught a cold."
"…………"
With tight lips, Hisui hangs her head.
It looks like she wants to say something, but she can't.
…… Hisui seems to be acting that way.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、どうしたんだよ黙り込んで。
なにも翡翠が悪いわけじゃないんだから、もっと楽にしていてくれ」
「―――はい。
わたしで出来る事でしたら、精一杯お仕えさせていただきます」
「いや、お仕えってなんでそう仰々しいんだろうな、翡翠は。
俺は翡翠がいてくれるだけで気が楽になれるんだから、できれば笑っていてくれたほうがいいんだけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, why have you gone so quiet? None of this is your fault, so try to relax.”
“―――Yes. Whatever lies within my power, I will do my utmost to serve you.”
“Why do you always make it sound so solemn, Hisui? Just having you here makes me feel better, so if possible, I’d rather you smiled.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, why are you so quiet?
You haven't done anything wrong, so relax."
"---Yes.
If there is anything I can do, I will try my hardest to do so."
"Um, you don't have be so tense, Hisui.
As long as you're here, I can relax, and it's better for me if you smile."

entries.japanese:
「……あの、こんな顔でよろしいのでしょうか」
　むっ、と真剣な顔をする翡翠。
　……正直、以前見せてくれた笑顔に比べれると睨まれているようにしか見えないんだけど、それでも翡翠の一生懸命な気持ちが嬉しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Would this expression be suitable?”
Hisui set her face in an intense, determined look.
Honestly, compared with the smile she had shown me before, it looked more as though she were glaring, but the earnest effort behind it still made me happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Um, is this face acceptable?"
Hisui looks at me with an incredibly serious face.
…… In all honesty, the look she has now is nothing like the smile she has shown before, but seeing Hisui try so hard does make me happy.

entries.japanese:
「うん、そんな感じでいいから楽にしていてくれればいいよ。
……っと、楽ついでに何か飲み物を貰えない？
　喉が渇いて、すこし息がしづらくなっている」
「はい、お飲み物でしたら用意してあります」
　視界から翡翠が消える。
　飲み物は壁際に用意してあったのだろう。
　翡翠は銀のトレイを持ってきて、俺の上半身を起こそうと背中に手を置く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, that’s the idea—just relax. And while we’re at it, could you get me something to drink? My throat is dry, and it’s getting a little hard to breathe.”
“Yes, I already have a drink prepared.”
Hisui disappeared from my field of vision.
She must have left the drink by the wall.
She returned with a silver tray and placed a hand behind my back to raise me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, you can relax even more if you want.
…… Could you bring me something to drink?
My throat is so dry I can hardly breathe."
"Yes, I already have a drink ready for you."
Hisui disappears from my view.
The drink probably is set by the wall.
Hisui comes back with a silver tray and places her hand on my back to lift me up.

entries.japanese:
―――その、瞬間。
　その感情が、翡翠の手が触れた背中から脳髄まで、おぞましいまでのスピードでかけあがってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――At that instant.
The emotion raced from the spot where Hisui’s hand touched my back to the core of my brain with hideous speed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---In that instant.
As soon as I feel her hand on my back, it comes with disgusting speed.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お体はこのぐらいでよろしいですか？」
「一息に飲むと体に毒ですから、ゆっくり口に含んでください」
「志貴さま？
　あの、お口を開けていただかないとこぼれてしまいます」
「離れろ――――――っ！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is this position comfortable, Master Shiki?”
“Drinking it all at once would be harmful, so please take it slowly.”
“Master Shiki? You need to open your mouth, or it will spill.”
“Get away from me――――――!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, is this alright?"
"It is not good to drink it all at once, so please drink this slowly."
"Shiki-sama?
If you do not open your mouth, it will spill."
"Get away------!"

entries.japanese:
「きゃっ！」
　ガシャン、という音。
　絨毯に落ちたグラス。
　俺に押されて尻餅をついている翡翠。
　ぜーぜーと。
　ケモノのように息を荒だたしている、自分。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah!”
A crash.
The glass struck the carpet.
Hisui sat where she had fallen after I shoved her away.
Wheezing.
There I was, breathing hard like an animal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kyaa!"
*Crash*
The glass falls to the floor.
Hisui sits on the floor where I pushed her away.
I start to wheeze once more.
My breathing is as ragged as that of a wild beast.

entries.japanese:
「志貴――――さま」
　翡翠は突き飛ばした俺を怒るのではなく、よけいに心配そうな眼差しを向けてくる。
「も、もうしわけございません……志貴さまのお許しもないのにお体を動かしてしまうなんて、なんて恥知らずなことを―――」
「違う―――そうじゃない。
そんな、翡翠が謝ることなんかない……！」
　……悪いのは。
「違うんだ翡翠。
きみが、翡翠が悪いわけじゃない」
　悪いのは、
　ぜーぜーと息をあげて、翡翠の体を欲しがっている俺のほうだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki――――”
Rather than anger at being pushed, Hisui looked at me with still greater concern.
“I-I am terribly sorry; moving Master Shiki’s body without your permission was shameless of me―――”
“No―――that’s not it. You have nothing to apologize for…!”
The one at fault.
“That’s not it, Hisui. You did nothing wrong.”
The one at fault was
me—the one wheezing for breath and lusting after Hisui’s body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki----sama."
Hisui isn't mad that I pushed her; instead, she's even more worried.
"Pl, please forgive me…… I moved you without asking, I should not have done such a shameful thing---"
"No---that's not it.
It isn't your fault……!"
…… The one to blame.
"That's not it at all.
You haven't done anything wrong."
The one to blame,
is me, wheezing even more heavily, lusting after Hisui's body.

entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki?”
“Just go. Please. If only for now, let me be alone.”
“If that is what you wish, Master Shiki.”
She spoke in a trembling voice.
Hisui left the room.
―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――.
Time had tilted out of true.
After lying in bed so long in this body, I could no longer experience its passage normally.
I could not tell whether I had driven Hisui away an hour ago or whether it somehow would not happen for another thirty minutes.
The clock hands had advanced about three hours since I was left alone.
But they could not be trusted.
The face should have been round; for some time now, it had looked grotesquely warped, like a gourd.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki------sama?"
"It's okay; please leave…… I beg of you, just for now, please leave me alone."
"…… Shiki-sama, if that is what you wish."
Hisui's voice trembles.
She retreats from the room.

-------------------------------------------------.

Time slips by.
Simply lying in bed with my body as it is, I lose all sense of time.
…… Did I run Hisui out of my room an hour ago, or was it thirty minutes ago?
I can't tell for certain.
After I became alone, the clock has advanced three hours.
But I can't trust it.
The seemingly round clock looks distorted.

entries.japanese:
ぜー　ぜー　ぜー　
　自分の呼吸だけが聞こえる。
　ゆがんだ時計は正午になったばかりだ。
　検診は午後の二時ごろだから、あとしばらくはこうして一人で理性を保っていられる。
　……まあ、もっとも。
　一人でいるとあの『頭痛』がやってきて、今度こそ遠野志貴の理性というものを根こそぎ奪い去ってしまいそうではあるのだが。
entries.maoEnglish:
wheeze wheeze wheeze
Only my breathing disturbed the silence.
The distorted clock said noon had just passed.
My examination was due around two, which left me a little while longer to preserve my sanity alone.
Then again.
Being alone brought that headache, and this time it seemed ready to tear every last shred of Shiki Tohno’s reason out by the roots.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*wheeze* *wheeze* *wheeze*
All I can hear is the wheezing of my breathing.
The distorted clock claims it is now noon.
The examination is around two, so I can protect my sanity by myself for a bit longer.
…… Well, but then…
If I am alone, then those "headaches" will return and they may rob me completely of all my reason.

entries.japanese:
「失礼します」
　音もなくドアを閉めて、翡翠が入ってくる。
　翡翠が持っている銀のトレイには水の入ったグラスと、何か薬のような包みが置かれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
Hisui entered and closed the door without a sound.
On her silver tray stood a glass of water and a small packet that looked like medicine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Excuse me."
Silently closing the door, Hisui enters my room.
Hisui enters carrying a tray with a glass of water and some sort of medicine.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
まだ検診の時間じゃないだろ」
「はい。
志貴さまの喉がお渇きではないかと思ってまいりました」
　カチャリとドアに鍵をかけて、翡翠はベッドまで近づいてくる。
　………鍵を、かけて……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. It isn’t time for my examination.”
“Yes. I thought you might be thirsty, Master Shiki.”
She turned the key in the lock with a click, then approached the bed.
She locked it…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
It isn't time for the examination yet, right?"
"Yes.
I just thought that you might be thirsty."
She locks the door with metallic clinking and draws close to my bed.
……… Locks, the door……?

entries.japanese:
「お一人で体を起こせますか？
　無理のようでしたらわたしが手をお貸ししますが」
「いや、別に喉は渇いていないからいい。
それよりどうして来たんだ。
俺はしばらく一人にしてくれって言っただろう」
「お断りします。
今の志貴さまを、とても一人にはしておけません」
　きっぱりと言って、翡翠は俺の肩を掴んできた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you sit up by yourself? If not, I can help you.”
“No, I’m not thirsty. More importantly, why are you here? I told you to leave me alone for a while.”
“I refuse. In Master Shiki’s present condition, I cannot possibly leave you alone.”
With those firm words, Hisui seized my shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Can you raise your body by yourself?
If you can't, then I will most humbly give you assistance."
"No, I'm not thirsty.
Besides, why did you come here?
I told you to leave me alone."
"I refuse.
I cannot leave you alone like this."
After she says this in a distinct voice, she places her hands on my shoulders.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ―――翡翠？」
「お一人で立てないのでしたら、そう言ってください」
「――――！？」
　ぐい、と強引に体を起こされた。
　翡翠の指はトレイに置かれた薬の包みを拾って、やっぱり半ば強引に俺の口に放りこむ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait―――Hisui?”
“If you cannot sit up alone, then please say so.”
“――――?!”
She hauled me upright.
Her fingers snatched the packet from the tray and, with equal force, pushed its contents into my mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey---Hisui?"
"Please, if you are unable to stand by yourself, just say so."
"----!?"
She quickly lifts up my body with a strong pull.
Hisui takes the medicine and forces it into my mouth.

entries.japanese:
「お飲みください。
姉が処方した、特別な薬です」
「ん……っ！」
　口に注がれるグラス。
「んー、ん、んー……！」
　……さっきの事で怒っているのか、翡翠の動きには容赦がない。
　的確で、しなやかで、それこそ本当に、意思のない人形のよう。
「はっ―――ぷはぁ……！
　もうっ、いきなり何するんだ翡翠！
　そりゃあここんところずっと翡翠に八つ当たりしてたけど、それにしたって今、の、は―――――」
　あ――――れ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Swallow it. It is a special medicine prescribed by my sister.”
“Mmph…!”
The glass pressed to my mouth.

As the head of the Tohno family, I will kill my brother."
----Those words send chills down my spine.
Akiha isn't playing around.
Even Kohaku-san nods seriously.

entries.japanese:
「それでは秋葉さま。
翡翠ちゃんにもその事を伝えないといけませんね」
「そうね。
……けど、翡翠の手は借りなくていいでしょう。
兄は満足に動ける体じゃない。
息の根を止めるのは私とあなただけで十分でしょうから」
――――はぁ、はぁ、はぁ。
　知らず、呼吸が乱れていく。
「いい、琥珀？
　くれぐれも兄さんには気取られないようにして。
あと数日中に決着をつけるから、できるかぎり兄さんを苦しめたくない」
「はい、存じております。
どのみちどうあってもお一人でベッドから起きあがれないのですから、気付かれる危険はないでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then, Miss Akiha. We must tell Hisui about this too.”
“Yes. But we need not involve Hisui. My brother can barely move. You and I will be more than enough to finish him.”
――――Hah, hah, hah.
Without my noticing, my breathing grows ragged.
“Listen carefully, Kohaku. Do not let my brother suspect anything. I intend to settle this within the next few days, and I want him to suffer as little as possible.”
“Yes, I understand. In any case, since he cannot rise from bed unaided, there is little danger he will notice.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then, Akiha-sama.
We should let Hisui-chan know about this too."
"You're right.
…… But we shouldn't need her help.
My brother can't move around as he likes, so we should be enough to kill him."
----*pant* *pant* *pant*
My breathing gets out of control.
"You understand, Kohaku?
Don't let Nii-san pick up on any of this.
It will all be over in a few days, so let's not trouble him."
"Yes, I understand.
He can't even move from his bed by himself, so he will never find out."

entries.japanese:
―――――はぁ、はぁ、はぁ。
　指が震える。
背中から吐き気が伝わってきて、倒れそうになる。
　だが、ここで倒れるわけにはいかない。
―――――逃げないと。
　ここで倒れたら、殺される。
　いまこうして覗いているのが二人に知られたら、そのまま殺されてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Hah, hah, hah.
My fingers tremble. Nausea crawls up my back, and my legs threaten to give way.
But I cannot collapse here.
―――――I have to run.
If I fall here, they will kill me.
If they discover me spying on them, I will be murdered where I lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----*pant* *pant* *pant*
My fingers shake uncontrollably.
Nausea permeates my being and I almost pass out.
But, I can't pass out here.
-----I have to get away.
If I pass out here, I'll surely be killed.
If they find out I was watching them, they'll kill me right here.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　……わからない。
　二人がどうして俺を殺そうとしているのか、まったく理解できない。
　それを理解しようとする頭も、熱にうかされて動いてくれない。
　……わからない。
　こんなのは、悪い夢だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――aaah.”
I don’t understand.
I cannot begin to imagine why they want me dead.
My fevered mind will not even try to understand.
I don’t understand.
This is a nightmare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I struggle for breath.
…… I don't understand.
I don't understand why they would want to kill me.
Even my brain trying to understand doesn't work because of the fever.
…… I don't understand.
This, has to be a bad dream.

entries.japanese:
そう、これは夢。
　いつも見ている、質のわるい悪夢にすぎない。
　なら、早く覚めないと。
　こんなおかしな妄想に食い尽くされる前に、早く目を覚まして以前の生活に戻らないと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, this is a dream.
Only another of the vicious nightmares that always plague me.
Then I have to wake up quickly.
Before this insane delusion devours me, I have to wake and return to the life I had before――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yes, this is a dream.
Like always, this has to be just another one of my nightmares.
Then, I have to wake up quickly.
Before this horrible vision consumes me, I have to wake up and return to my normal life----

entries.japanese:
「くっ――――う」
　……なんとか部屋に戻って来れた。
　あとは―――そうだ、鍵、鍵をかけないと――
「志貴さま」
「―――――――！」
　……いつから部屋にいたのか、翡翠は俺の部屋の真ん中で立ち尽くしていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh――――uh.”
Somehow I make it back to my room.
Now―――yes, the lock, I have to lock the door――
“Master Shiki.”
“―――――――!”
I do not know how long she has been there, but Hisui stands motionless in the middle of my room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-----"
…… Somehow, I make it to my room.
Now---yes, now I, should lock the door--
"Shiki-sama."
"-------"
…… I don't know how long she has been there, but Hisui is standing in my room.

entries.japanese:
「なにをしていらっしゃったのですか。
そんな体で出歩かれては困ります」
「ひ……すい」
「大人しく横になっていてください。
志貴さまに無理をされては、わたしが秋葉さまに叱られてしまいます」
「秋葉に……叱られる……？」
　どうして俺が外に出ているだけで秋葉に叱られるんだろう。
　……いや、そんなのはもう解りきっている。
　秋葉は俺が殺人鬼だって気がついたから、俺をこの部屋に閉じ込めて、今夜にでも、俺を殺そうとしているだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What have you been doing? You can’t go wandering around in your condition.”
“Hi-sui.”
“Please lie down and rest. If Master Shiki overexerts himself, Miss Akiha will hold me responsible.”
“Akiha will—hold you responsible?”
Why should Akiha care just because I left my room?
No, I already know why.
Akiha realized I am the killer, so she locked me in here and means to kill me tonight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What are you doing?
In your condition, walking is very dangerous."
"Hi…… sui."
"Please, lay down.
If you push yourself, Akiha-sama will scold me."
"Akiha…… will scold……?"
Why would she get in trouble if I went outside?
…… No, I understand perfectly.
Akiha realizes that I'm the killer.
So she plans to lock me in my room, and when night comes, kill me.

entries.japanese:
「――――出ていってくれ、翡翠」
「志貴さま……？」
「この部屋には誰も入らせない。
たとえ翡翠だろうと、もう二度と入らせない……！」
「志貴さま―――きゃっ！」
　どこにそんな力が残っていたのか、翡翠を力ずくでドアから廊下にはじき出す。
　そのまま、ドアを閉めて鍵をかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Get out, Hisui.”
“Master Shiki?”
“No one comes into this room. Not even you, Hisui, ever again…!”
“Master Shiki―――ah!”
I do not know where the strength comes from, but I shove Hisui through the doorway and out into the hall.
Then I slam the door and lock it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Please leave, Hisui."
"Shiki-sama……?"
"I won't let anyone in this room.
Even you, no one will ever come in again……!"
"Shiki-sama---kyaa!"
I don't know where I got the strength, but I push her out into the hallway.
Then, I shut the door and lock it.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――！？
　志貴、さま、お開けください、志貴さま……！」
　ドンドン、という音。
　それを無視して、崩れ落ちるように、絨毯に倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――!? Master Shiki, please open the door, Master Shiki…!”
She pounds against it.
Ignoring her, I crumple onto the carpet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---!?
Shiki, sama, please open the door, Shiki-sama……!"
She knocks on the door.
Ignoring it all, I crumble to the floor.

entries.japanese:
――――くる、しい。
　脳髄にはりついてくる膜。
毛穴という毛穴から染みこんでくる毒。
鼻孔や口から酸素をとりいれるたびに、体内に入りこんでくる膿黴穢れ。
――――体が、うまく動かない。
　なにか、器官とか機能とか、そういったものとは別のところのモノ、人間を活動させている根本的な命、エネルギーのようなものが、流出していっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I can’t breathe.
A membrane clinging to my brain. Poison seeping through every pore. Each breath drawn through my nose or mouth carries pus, mildew, filth into my body.
――――My body will not move properly.
Something apart from organs or bodily functions—the primal life, the energy that keeps a human being in motion—is draining out of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Pai, n.
It sticks inside my brain.
The poison permeates every pore in my body.
Every time I take a breath, the mold invades my whole body.
----I can't move freely.
Something other than my organs or my functions, but something more from the core, like my very own energy, seems to be flowing out of my body.

entries.japanese:
俺の心臓には目には見えないパイプが外に向かって伸びている。
　『命』は、そのパイプを通じて、アイツのほうへと流れていってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
An invisible tube runs from my heart to somewhere outside.
Through it, my very life is flowing away to that thing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My heart has an invisible pipe sticking out of it.
My "life" is flowing along this pipe to him.

entries.japanese:
―――――くる、しい。
　だから、間に合わない。
　俺の体でいくら生きていくためのモノを生産しても、すべてアイツに横取りされてしまう。
　だから、外から活力を補充しないと、生きていけない。
　点滴。
栄養剤。
注射。
鎮痛剤。
水分。
血液。
理性。
知性。
感情。
記憶。
視覚。
聴覚。
味覚。
触覚。
嗅覚。
体液。
愛情。
衝動。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――I can’t breathe.
That’s why I can’t keep up.
However much my body produces to keep itself alive, that thing steals it all.
Unless I replenish that vitality from outside, I can’t survive.
IV drips. Nutrients. Injections. Painkillers. Water. Blood. Reason. Intellect. Emotion. Memory. Sight. Hearing. Taste. Touch. Smell. Bodily fluids. Love. Urge.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----It, hurts.
So I can't make it.
No matter how hard my body tries to recover, he takes away everything.
So unless I take in something from the outside world, I can't live.
Intravenous drip.
Nutrient supplement.
Injection.
Sedative.
Moisture.
Blood.
Reason.
Intelligence.
Feelings.
Memory.
Sight.
Sound.
Taste.
Touch.
Smell.
Bodily fluids.
Love.
Impulse.

entries.japanese:
――――――は……ア
　薬なんかじゃ、ただかろうじて命をとどめている事しかできない。
　そんなんじゃ治らない。
　俺を動けるようにしてくれるものがあるとしたら、それは――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Hah ah
Medicine can do no more than keep the last scrap of life inside me.
It will never cure me.
If anything can make this body move again, it would have to be――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Ha…… a
These drugs, all they can do is barely keep me alive.
This isn't healing me.
If there's something that will help me move, it's----

entries.japanese: ドンドン、という音で目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish: A pounding sound wakes me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock.
Knock.
The sound wakes me up.

entries.japanese:
ドンドン。
　　　　　ドンドン。
　　　　　　　　　ドンドン。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bang.
          Bang.
                    Bang.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock Knock.

Knock Knock.
Knock Knock.

entries.japanese:
「……うる……さい、な」
　壁に手をついて、なんとか立ちあがる。
呼吸は、ぜいぜいと音をたてて、耳障りだった。
　ドンドン。
ドンドン。
ドンドン。
「兄さん！
　開けてください、兄さん！」
　秋葉がドアを叩いている。
　……そうか。
鍵を閉めたから、誰も中に入って来れないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So—noisy.”
I brace against the wall and somehow get to my feet. My own ragged wheezing grates on my ears.
Bang. Bang. Bang.
“Brother! Open the door, Brother!”
Akiha is pounding on it.
Of course. I locked the door, so no one can get inside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sh…… ut, up!"
Placing my hand on the wall, I manage to stand up.
My own wheezing fills my ears.
Knock Knock.
Knock Knock.
Knock Knock.
"Nii-san!
Please open the door, Nii-san."
Akiha is banging on the door.
…… That's right.
I locked it, so no one can get in.

entries.japanese:
「……なんで鍵なんか、かけたんだっけ……」」
　朦朧とする頭を動かす。
　それは、確か――――
「――――――――」
　そうだ。
　秋葉をこの部屋に入れない為に、鍵をかけたんだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did I lock the door again?”
I force my muddled mind to work.
It was because――――
“――――――――”
Right.
I locked it to keep Akiha out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why… did I lock it……"
My thoughts start to move through a haze.
That, was because----
"--------"
That's right.
I locked it so Akiha wouldn't get in.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん……！
　起きているんでしょう、検診をしなくちゃいけないのに鍵なんかかけて何しているんですか！」
　どんどん、という音。
　秋葉は必死に、それこそ恨みさえ篭っていそうな声で、部屋の中にいる俺に呼びかけてくる。
「ああもうっ、とにかく開けてくださいっ！
　夕方の点滴もしてないなんて、兄さんは死にたいんですか！」
　扉を叩く音が止まない。
　……それは当然か。
　秋葉にとって、俺が部屋に閉じこもる事は好ましくない。
　俺がこうしているかぎり―――秋葉は俺を殺すコトができないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…! I know you’re awake, so why have you locked yourself in when you need to be examined?”
She pounds on the door.
Akiha calls desperately to me—her voice so fierce it almost sounds full of hatred.
“Oh, honestly, just open it! You even missed your evening IV, are you trying to die?”
The pounding never stops.
Of course it doesn’t.
Akiha can’t be pleased that I’ve barricaded myself in here.
As long as I stay inside―――she can’t kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san……!
I know you're up.
You have to get your examination, so why did you lock the door!?"
Bam bam.
She knocks harder.
Akiha frantically calls me from outside in a bitter voice.
"Please open the door already!
You haven't had your evening IV, do you want to die!?"
The pounding on the door doesn't stop.
…… That's only natural.
It's not good for Akiha if I shut myself in this room like this.
As long as I'm doing this--Akiha will not be able to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん……！？
　ちょっと、聞いているんでしょう、兄さん……！」
　どんどん、という音。
　……扉を叩く音はどうでもいいが、秋葉の声は、我慢ならない。
「うる、さい…………！！」
「え――――――」
　扉の向こうで、息を飲む声が聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother…!? You can hear me, can’t you, Brother…!”
More pounding.
The noise itself means nothing, but Akiha’s voice is unbearable.
“Sh-shut up!”
“Wh――――――”
Beyond the door, I hear her breath catch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san……!?
Hey, are you listening to me, Nii-san……!?"
Bam, Bam.
…… I don't really mind the knocking, but I cannot stand having to listen to her voice.
"Shut--up…………!!"
"Eh------?"
I hear her gasp from the other side of the door.

entries.japanese:
「う、うるさいって……兄さん、私は兄さんが心配で―――」
「……知らない。
俺はここから出て行かない。
俺のコトが心配だっていうんなら、秋葉は消えてくれ」
「なっ―――」
「いいか、俺は絶対に出て行かないからな。
俺はおまえに、殺されてなんか、やらない……！」
　だん、と扉を叩く。
　……扉の向こうでは、大気が凍りついたような沈黙があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You told me to shut up, Brother, when I’m only worried about you―――”
“I don’t care. I’m not coming out. If you’re really worried about me, then disappear.” “Wh―――”
“Listen to me, I am never coming out. I won’t let you kill me…!”
I strike the door with my fist.
On the other side, silence freezes the air.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shut… up?
…… Nii-san, I am only worrying about you---"
"…… I don't care.
I'm not coming out.
If you're really worried about me, then just go away."
"Wha--"
"Do you get it?
I'm not ever coming out.
I won't--let you--kill me……!"
Thud.
I hit the door.
…… The other side of the door becomes a frozen silence.

entries.japanese:
―――その、後。
「……兄さん、それはどういう意味ですか。
私が兄さんを殺すだなんて、誰にそんな事を聞いたんです」
「……いいから出ていけ……！
　俺は殺人鬼なんかじゃない、まだマトモな人間なんだ……！」
「まさか――――兄さん、貴方はそこまで引きずられてしまっているんですか」
　呆然とした呟きのあと。
　秋葉の気配がドアから離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――After that.
“Brother, what do you mean? Who told you I was going to kill you?”
“Just get out…! I’m not some murderer, I’m still a normal human being…!”
“Surely not――――Brother, have you really been dragged that far under?”
After that stunned whisper.
Akiha’s presence recedes from the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--And after that…
"…… Nii-san, just what do you mean?
Who told you I would kill you?"
"…… Just go away……!
I'm not a killer, I'm still sane……!"
"I can't believe it----Nii-san, you are already pulled in this much?"
Her words are filled with surprise.
I sense her step back from the door.

entries.japanese:
「……わかりました。
兄さんはいま疲れているようですから、また後でやってきます」
「――うるさい。
俺は、秋葉たちをこの部屋には入れない……！」
「……兄さん。
今夜は兄さんの言うことを聞いてあげますけど、明日は私の言う事を聞いてもらいます。
　今の兄さんは一日でも危ないのに、二日も放っておいたらそれこそ衰弱死してしまう。
だから、あと一日だけ我慢していてください」
　かつん、かつん、と遠ざかっていく足音。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Very well. You seem exhausted, so I’ll return later.”
“――Shut up. I’m not letting any of you into this room…!”
“Brother. Tonight I’ll do as you ask, but tomorrow you will do as I say.
Leaving you alone for one day is dangerous enough; after two, you could die of exhaustion. So please hold on for just one more day.”
Her footsteps click away down the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I understand.
Nii-san, you are exhausted right now, so I will come back and see you later."
"--Shut up!
I won't let you or anyone else in this room……!"
"…… Nii-san.
I will listen to your words today, but tomorrow, I will make you listen to me.
Leaving you by yourself for one day is dangerous enough; I simply cannot leave you alone for two days, otherwise you will surely die.
Please wait for just one more day, Nii-san."
I hear her footsteps recede.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ………はぁ………はぁ」
　呼吸がうまくできない。
たしかに秋葉の言うとおり、このままだと本当に衰弱死してしまう。
「はぁ………はぁ………はぁ」
　それでも、秋葉に殺されるよりは、いい。
――――扉に鍵をかける。
　あとは壁にもたれかかって、眠らないように、ずっと目蓋を開け続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah.”
I can barely breathe. Akiha is right: if this continues, I really will waste away and die.
“Hah, hah, hah.”
Even so, that would be better than letting her kill me.
――――I lock the door.
Then I lean against the wall and keep my eyes open so I will not fall asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
I can hardly breathe.
Just like Akiha said, I will surely die at this rate.
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
But, it's still better than Akiha killing me.
----I keep the door locked.
I lean against the wall and keep my eyes open so I won't fall asleep.

entries.japanese:
「そんなに叩かなくても、いま、開ける、から―――」
　朦朧としながら、ドアの鍵をはずした。
「兄さん―――！」
　秋葉が部屋に入ってくる。
　その背後には、琥珀さんの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You don’t have to pound so hard, I’m opening it now―――”
Half delirious, I turn the lock.
“Brother―――!”
Akiha rushes into the room.
Kohaku stands behind her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop pounding on the door, I'm, going--to open…"
Hazily, I open the door.
"Nii-san--!"
Akiha rushes into the room.
Kohaku-san follows behind her.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、なにをしていたんですか……！
　そんな青い顔をして、ちゃんとベッドに横になっていないと―――！」
――――どくん。
「そうですよ志貴さん。
ごはんだってお昼に食べたきりで、夕方の分の点滴もしてないじゃないですか。
それじゃ治る体も治りません」
――――どくん。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, what have you been doing…! You’re white as a sheet, you should be lying in bed―――!”
――――Thump.
“She’s right, Shiki. You haven’t eaten since lunch, and you missed your evening IV. You’ll never recover this way.”
――――Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, what were you doing……!?
You look terrible, you should be in bed---!"
----My heart pounds.

"That's right, Shiki-san.
You haven't eaten since lunch, and you haven't taken your IV.
If you keep this up, you will not heal."
----My heart pounds.

entries.japanese:
「もうっ、何があったか知りませんけど大人しくしていてください。
そんな体で床に寝ているなんて、死にたいんですか兄さんは」
――――どく、ん。
　言って、秋葉は俺の腕を取ろうと近寄ってくる。
　あの離れで口にしていたように。
　俺を、殺すために近寄ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, I don’t know what happened, but you must keep still. Lying on the floor in your condition—are you trying to die, Brother?”
――――Thump.
Akiha reaches for my arm as she says it.
Just as she said in the annex.
She is coming closer to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez.
I don't know what happened, but please calm down.
Sleeping on the floor like that… do you want to die, Nii-san?"
----My heart pounds.
Akiha comes closer to take my arm as she says this.

Like she said in that detached house.
She's coming… to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「――――出ていけ！」
「え―――に、兄さん、なにを―――」
「出ていけって言ったんだ！
　俺はおまえに殺されてなんか、やらない……！」
　だん、と秋葉の体を押す。
　……が、こんな体じゃ秋葉を廊下に追い出す事ができない。
　秋葉は数歩だけ後ろによろめいて、キッと俺を見返してくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Get out!”
“Wh―――Brother, what are you―――”
“I said get out! I’m not going to let you kill me…!”
I shove Akiha back with a thud.
But in this condition, I can’t force her out into the hall.
She only stumbles back a few steps, then glares at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Get out!"
"Eh---Ni, Nii-san, what are---"
"Get out, I said!
I won't let you--kill me……!"
I push her away.
…… But it's not like I can push her out into the hallway with this body.
Akiha simply takes a step back and stares at me.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、それはどういう意味ですか。
私が兄さんを殺すだなんて、誰にそんな事を聞いたんです」
　秋葉はまっすぐに見つめてくる。
　どくん、と跳ねる心臓。
　こっちの混乱した心を見透かすような、鋭い視線。
「……いいから出ていけ……！
　俺は殺人鬼なんかじゃない、まだマトモな人間なんだ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, what do you mean? Who told you I was going to kill you?”
Akiha stares straight at me.
My heart bucks.
Her gaze is sharp enough to lay my confusion bare.
“Just get out…! I’m not some murderer, I’m still a normal human being…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, just what do you mean?
Who told you that I would kill you?"
Akiha looks at me directly.
My heart skips a beat.
Her sharp glance feels like she is reading my mind.
"…… Just get out……!
I'm not a killer, I'm still sane……!"

entries.japanese:
「殺人鬼って、兄さん――――貴方はそこまで、引きずられてしまっているんですか」
　呆然と呟いて。
　秋葉は、自分からドアのほうへ後ずさる。
「……わかりました。
兄さんはいま疲れているようですから、また後でやってきます」
「――うるさい。
俺は、秋葉たちをこの部屋には入れない……！」
「………………」
　秋葉は一瞬だけ眉をひそめた後、自分から廊下へ下がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A murderer, Brother――――have you really been dragged that far under?”
Akiha murmurs in a daze.
Of her own accord, she backs toward the door.
“Very well. You seem exhausted, so I’ll return later.”
“――Shut up. I’m not letting any of you into this room…!”
“….”
Akiha frowns for a single instant, then retreats into the hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Killer… Nii-san--you are already pulled in this much?"
Her voice is filled with surprise.
Akiha walks towards the door on her own.
"…… I understand.
Nii-san, you are exhausted right now, so I will come back and see you later."
"--Shut up!
I won't let you or anyone else in this room……!"
"………………"
Akiha raises her eyebrows for a second, then starts to leave the room.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
今夜は兄さんの言うことを聞いてあげますけど、明日は私の言う事を聞いてもらいます。
　今の兄さんは一日でも危ないのに、二日も放っておいたらそれこそ衰弱死してしまう。
だから、あと一日だけ我慢していてください」
　バタン、と閉じられる扉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Tonight I’ll do as you ask, but tomorrow you will do as I say.
Leaving you alone for one day is dangerous enough; after two, you could die of exhaustion. So please hold on for just one more day.”
The door slams shut.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san.
I will listen to your words today, but tomorrow, I will make you listen to me.
Leaving you by yourself for one day is dangerous enough; I simply cannot leave you alone for two days, otherwise you will surely die.
Please wait for just one more day, Nii-san."
The door shuts.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ………はぁ………はぁ」
　呼吸がうまくできない。
たしかに秋葉の言うとおり、このままだと本当に衰弱死してしまう。
「はぁ………はぁ………はぁ」
　それでも、秋葉に殺されるよりは、いい。
――――扉に鍵をかける。
　あとは壁にもたれかかって、眠らないように、ずっと目蓋を開け続けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, hah, hah.”
I can barely breathe. Akiha is right: if this continues, I really will waste away and die.
“Hah, hah, hah.”
Even so, that would be better than letting her kill me.
――――I lock the door.
Then I lean against the wall and keep my eyes open so I will not fall asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
I can hardly breathe.
Just like Akiha said, I will surely die at this rate.
*pant*…… *pant*…… *pant*
But, it's still better than Akiha killing me.
----I lock the door.
I lean against the wall and keep my eyes open so I won't fall asleep.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.

…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
――――夜が明けた。
　ひどく、静かだ。
　耳障りだったゼイゼイという呼吸音も聞こえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
――――Dawn has come.
It is terribly quiet.
Even the rasp of my own breathing, which grated on me all night, has fallen silent.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
----The night is over.
A terrible silence.
I can't even hear the wheezing of my breathing.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
「――――――――」
　体はもう、ぴくりとも動かない。
　思考も完全に停止している。
　鏡でもあったら、こうして壁に倒れかかっている自分が糸の切れた人形に見えていることだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
“――――――――”
My body will no longer twitch.
Thought itself has stopped.
If there were a mirror here, I would look like a puppet with its strings cut, collapsed against the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
"--------"
My body doesn't even twitch or move at all.
My mind has completely stopped as well.
I bet if I look at myself in the mirror, I would look like a puppet with its strings cut.

entries.japanese:
……と。
とと、ん。
と、ん。
「―――――――ごふ」
　……またリズムを間違えた。
「ご―――は、あ、あ――――」
　……とん。
と、とん。
　……とん。
とと、んとん。
　……とん。
ととん。
とん。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum. Th-thum. Thum.
“―――――――Ghk.”
I lost the rhythm again.
“Gh―――hah, ah, ah――――”
Thum. Th-thum.
Thum. Th-thum-thum.
Thum. Th-thum. Thum.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Kn.
kno kno, ck.
kno, ck.
"-------Gohu."
I cough.
…… I screw up the rhythm again.
"Go--ha, ah, ah----"
…… Knock.
Kno, knock.
…… Knock.
Kno kno, ck knock.
…… Knock.
Knock knock.
Knock.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
「、………、………」
　リズムが戻って、なんとか呼吸を再開できた。
「―――――――――」
　たった一晩一人きりでいただけで、体はひどく衰弱していた。
　視界はぼんやりとかすんでいる。
　肌にふれる空気は、それだけで痛い。
　呼吸も意識してなければもつれて止まってしまいそうなほど、体の器官がおかしくなりはじめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
“…”
The rhythm returns, and somehow my lungs begin working again.
“―――――――――”
One night alone has left me terribly weak.
My sight swims in a gray haze.
Even the air hurts where it touches my skin.
My organs are beginning to fail; if I stop concentrating on each breath, the rhythm tangles and threatens to cease.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock, knock knock, knock.
", ………, ………"
I get back my rhythm, and I can continue breathing.
"---------"
Being by myself all night caused my body to become really weak.
My vision is really blurry.
The air touching my skin is painful.
My organs are so screwed up now that I can't breathe unless I concentrate.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.

…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、起きていらっしゃいますか……？」
　翡翠の声。
　……これで何度目だろう。
翡翠は、本当にこりない。
「起きてらっしゃるのでしょう？
　それでしたら、せめてお食事をおとりになってください」
「……いい。
翡翠たちが持ってくるものは、食べない」
　何も食べない。
　この家で出されるものは何も信用できない。
　食べ物も。
水も。
薬も。
　自分を殺そうとするための、毒に思える。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake…?”
Hisui’s voice.
How many times has this been? She truly never gives up.
“You are awake, aren’t you? Then please, at least eat something.”
“No. I won’t eat anything you bring me.”
I will eat nothing.
Nothing served in this house can be trusted.
Food. Water. Medicine.
All of it feels like poison meant to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you awake……?"
Hisui's voice.
…… How many times is this?
Hisui really doesn't grow tired of this at all.
"You are awake, are you not?
If that is the case, then please at least eat."
"…… No.
I won't eat what any of you give me."
I won't eat anything.
I can't trust anything that comes from this house.
Food.
Water.
Medicine.
It seems like everything is a poison to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま、ここにお食事を置いていきますから。
わたしが立ち去ったあと、どうか扉をあけてお食べになってください」
　……翡翠の気配が遠ざかっていく。
「………」
　ごん、と壁に頭を打ち付ける。
　……こうして翡翠を無視するのは何回目だろう。
　……翡翠。
翡翠は秋葉や琥珀さんとは違う。
　翡翠は俺のことを殺そうとはしていないかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I will leave the meal here. Once I have gone, please open the door and eat.”
Hisui’s presence recedes.
“…”
I knock my head against the wall.
How many times have I ignored her like this?
Hisui. She isn’t like Akiha or Kohaku.
Maybe Hisui isn’t trying to kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama, I will place your food here.
After I leave, please open the door and eat it."
…… Hisui's presence recedes.
"………"
I bang my head against the wall.
…… How many times have I ignored Hisui like this?
…… Hisui.
Hisui is different from Akiha and Kohaku-san.
Maybe Hisui is not trying to kill me.

entries.japanese:
「………」
　けど、そんなものは妄想だ。
　翡翠は俺をこの部屋に閉じ込めようとしていた。
　今だって、さっきみたいに懲りずに俺の様子を窺いにきて、俺をこの部屋に閉じ込めている。
「――――は、あ」
　……だめだ。
　自分で自分の思考がとりとめのない、被害妄想じみている事は分かっている。
　なのに、いまさら思考は正常には戻ってくれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
But that is a delusion.
