Hisui tried to confine me to this room.
Even now she keeps coming back to spy on me, making sure I remain locked inside.
“――――Hah.”
This is hopeless.
I know my thoughts are incoherent, paranoid.
Yet knowing it can no longer make them sane.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………"
But, that is just a fantasy.
Hisui tried to lock me in this room.
Like right now, she came to my room to look after me, keeping me trapped in this room.
"----Ha, ah."
…… This is no good.
I know my thoughts are just paranoia.
But my mind won't return to normal.

entries.japanese:
……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　……とん、ととん、とん。
　意識は朦朧としている。
体は節々が痛い。
　喉は乾いていて、今すぐ水を飲まなければ死にそうなほど。
　……それでも、自分は頑なに扉に鍵をかけたままだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
Thum, th-thum, thum.
My mind is clouded. Every joint aches.
My throat is so dry I feel I will die unless I drink this instant.
Still, stubbornly, I keep the door locked.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
…… Knock,  Knock Knock, Knock.
My mind is foggy and my body pulses with pain.
My throat is so dry that it feels like I will die if I don't drink water.
…… In spite of all that, I still keep the door locked.

entries.japanese:
……またノック。
　トントン、トントンという繰り返し。
「……志貴さま。
お食事が、冷めてしまいました」
　悲しそうな声。
「……秋葉さまも姉さんも、今日はお出かけになって戻られないそうです。
今、この屋敷にはわたしと志貴さましかおりません」
　だから外に出て来い、とでも言いたいのか。
「うるさい……！
　俺にかまうなって言ってるのに、どうしてわからないんだ翡翠は……！」
「――――――――」
　息を飲む気配。
　翡翠の気配が遠くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Another knock.
Tap-tap, tap-tap—the same patient refrain.
“Master Shiki. Your meal has gone cold.”
Her voice is sorrowful.
“Miss Akiha and my sister have gone out for the day and will not be returning. Master Shiki and I are the only people in the mansion now.”
Is that supposed to coax me outside?
“Shut up…! I told you to leave me alone, so why can’t you understand, Hisui…!”
“――――――――”
I hear her catch her breath.
Hisui’s presence receded.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The knocking begins once again.
Knock knock, knock knock, repeating.
"Shiki-sama, your food has gotten cold."
Her voice sounds sad.
"…… Akiha-sama and Nee-san have gone out and will not return today.
We are the only ones in the mansion right now."
Does she want to tell me to come out?
"Shut up……!
I told you to leave me alone.
Why can't you understand that, Hisui…… !?"
"--------"
I hear a gasp.
Her presence recedes.

entries.japanese:
またトントン、という音。
　立ち去っていく気配。
　……そんな繰り返しを、数え切れないほど、している。
entries.maoEnglish:
Again came that tap-tap.
Again, the presence withdrew.
We have repeated that same exchange more times than I can count.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yet again, the knocking continues.
Her presence recedes.
…… We repeat this cycle countless times.

entries.japanese:
「は―――ぁ、つ―――――」
　……苦しい。
　空腹は、どうという事はない。
　ただ喉の渇きと、発熱している体が苦しい。
「――――――――――――」
　……何をしているんだろう、俺は。
　こんなふうに壁によりかかって、今にも止まってしまいそうな体を抱えて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――ah, ngh―――――”
It hurts.
The hunger is nothing.
It is the thirst and the fever burning through my body that hurt.
“――――――――――――”
What am I doing?
I am propped against the wall, cradling a body that feels ready to stop at any moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--ah, g--"
…… Pain.
The hunger is nothing.
But thirst is killing my burning body.
"------------"
…… Just what am I doing?
Lying crumbled against the wall, hugging my broken body.

entries.japanese:
閉じた窓。
閉じた扉。
「――――――――――」
　……そういえば、昔。
　こんなふうな出来事があった気がする。
――――――あれは、
　一体どのくらい昔のことだったか。
entries.maoEnglish:
A closed window. A closed door.
“――――――――――”
Come to think of it, long ago.
I remember something like this happening once before.
――――――But how long
ago had it been?
entries.mirrorMoon:
The closed window, the locked door.
"----------"
…… Come to think of it, a long time ago…
It feels like something like this happened before too.
----That was…
How long ago was that?

entries.japanese:
新しい環境に連れてこられて、周りの人間に馴染めずに一人でずっと閉じこもっていた子供の頃。
　とにかく何もかもが嫌で、誰とも話したくなかった。
　そんな時に、何度もドアを叩いてきた少女がいた。
　トントン、というノック音。
　だれだ、と俺が聞くたびに、「あたしだよ」
と答えてくる声。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I was a child, I was brought to a strange new place and, unable to fit in with the people there, shut myself away.
I hated everything and wanted to speak to no one.
And then there was the girl who came and knocked on my door again and again.
Tap-tap.
Whenever I asked who was there, a voice answered “It’s me” from beyond the door.
entries.mirrorMoon:
When I was just a small kid, taken to new surroundings and not being used to the new people, I locked myself up in my room.
I hated everything and I didn't want to talk to anyone.
During that time, there was a girl that always knocked on the door.
Knock, knock, was the sound.
Every time I would ask who it was, the voice would always respond "It's me."

entries.japanese:
「シキちゃん、遊ぼ。
そんなとこにいたらかびが生えちゃうんだからね」
　余計なお世話だ、と何日も何日も、自分はその子を追い返していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI, come play. You’ll grow mold in there.”
None of your business, I told her, sending her away day after day.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI-chan, let's play.
You'll get moldy if you stay in one place like that."
I tell her it's none of her business and make her go away day after day.

entries.japanese:
またトントン、という音。
　立ち去っていく気配。
entries.maoEnglish:
Again came that tap-tap.
Again, the presence withdrew.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The knocking sound again.
Her presence draws away.

entries.japanese:
……その子は毎日やってきた。
　飽きもしないでトントン、とノックをする。
　少女は決して無理強いはせず、扉を開けようともしないで、ただ自分に呼びかけ続けていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
She came every day.
Never tiring of it, she knocked on the door: tap-tap.
The girl never forced the issue or tried to open the door; she merely kept calling to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That girl came every day.
She would always knock, not getting tired of doing so.
She would never force me out, but continue to call my name without opening the door.

entries.japanese:
「どうして外に出てこないの？」
　外に出る事はできない。
屋敷の人間は、みな自分のコトを敵視している。
「そんなことないよ。
みんな、シキちゃんのこと好きになりたがってるよ」
　だが信じられない。
　自分の父親は、それを信じて遠野槙久に殺されたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why won’t you come outside?”
I couldn’t. Everyone in the mansion hated me.
“That’s not true. Everyone wants to like you.”
But I couldn’t believe that.
My father had believed it, and Makihisa Tohno had killed him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why won't you come outside?"
I can't go outside.
Everyone in the mansion, they all see me as the enemy.
"That's not true.
Everyone wants to like you, SHIKI-chan."
But I can't believe her.
My own father believed that, and was killed by Tohno Makihisa.

entries.japanese:
「……そっか。
そうだよね、それじゃあ誰もしんじられないよね」
　そうだ。
だから、一人でいたほうが楽だった。
「でも、それじゃいつまでもひとりきりだよ。
ひとりきりはつまんないよ」
　かまわない。
死ぬような目にあうよりは、そのほうがいいに決まっている。
　騙されるよりは。
　一人きりのまま、自分に騙されて、死に至ったほうが、キレイだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. After that, you could not trust anyone.”
Exactly. Being alone was easier.
“But then you will always be alone. Being alone is boring.”
I did not care. It had to be better than nearly being killed.
Better than letting someone deceive me.
It would be cleaner to deceive myself and die alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
No wonder you can't believe anyone."
That's right.
So it's easier for me to be alone.
"But, you will just be yourself all the time.
Being by yourself is no fun."
I don't care.
This is better than getting killed.
Better than being tricked.
It's better to be alone and trick myself instead of dying.

entries.japanese:
「もうっ。
わかった、それじゃ志貴ちゃんはわたしを――――していいよ。
それなら外に出て来れるでしょ？」
　その言葉。
　喉まで出かかっているのに思い出せない。
　呆れたような口調で、何をしていいと、あの少女は言ったんだっけ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, honestly! Fine, then you can――――me. That will let you come outside, won’t it?”
Those words.
They hover on the tip of my tongue, yet I cannot remember them.
In that exasperated tone, what had the girl said I could do to her――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez.
I understand, so you can ***** me.
Then you can come outside, right?"
Her words then.
I… can't remember exactly what they were.
With her voice, that girl said I could do what----?

entries.japanese:
トントンという音。
翡翠は、本当に懲りない。
　こっちが飽きれるぐらいの我慢強さは、子供のころの思い出を想起させる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap-tap. Hisui truly never gives up.
Her patience, stubborn enough to wear out my own, called that childhood memory back to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock knock.
Hisui really doesn't tire of this.
Her surprising endurance reminds me of that childhood memory.

entries.japanese:
「……………？」
　足音がしない。
　翡翠の気配が遠ざからない。
「…………翡翠？」
　扉のむこうには沈黙がある。
　翡翠は黙って扉の外に立っている。
　長く。
　翡翠の気配は、それこそもう二度と動かないぐらい長く、ずっと扉の向こうにあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…?”
No footsteps.
Hisui’s presence does not recede.
“Hisui?”
Silence waits beyond the door.
She is still standing there.
For a long time.
Hisui remained beyond the door so long it seemed she might never move again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………?"
I don't hear her footsteps.
She doesn't seem to have walked away.
"………… Hisui?"
There is nothing but silence on the other side of the door.
Hisui is just standing quietly on the other side.
Time passes.
Hisui's presence doesn't move.
All she does is wait by the door.

entries.japanese:
「……どうして外に出てこないんですか、志貴さま」
　……そんなのは決まってる。
　誰も信じられなくなったから、こうして一人でいるんじゃないか。
　秋葉も、琥珀も、自分自身さえもあやふやで信じられないから、こうして閉じこもっているしかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why will you not come outside, Master Shiki?”
The answer is obvious.
I am alone because I can no longer trust anyone.
Because Akiha, Kohaku, and even my own uncertain self are impossible to trust, all I can do is shut myself away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why will you not come outside, Shiki-sama?"
…… That's obvious.
Since I can't believe anyone anymore, I'm being by myself.
Neither Akiha nor Kohaku, not even I can be trusted, so I can't do anything but lock myself away.

entries.japanese:
……ああ、ようやく気がついた。
　秋葉のことなんて、本当は瑣末な事なのかもしれない。
　俺は殺人鬼かもしれない自分自身を閉じ込めたくて、こうして一人でいようとしているのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
At last, I understand.
Perhaps Akiha has never truly been the point.
I have shut myself away because I want to lock up the part of me that might be a murderer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Yeah, I finally realize it.
The thing with Akiha might really be a trivial thing.
I am trying to be alone so that I can lock myself up, as I might be the killer.

entries.japanese:
「……誰も。
何も信じられないというんですか、志貴さまは」
　……そうだ。
だから、翡翠が俺にかまう義務なんて、ない。
　人の血を欲しがって、翡翠の体さえ乱暴に犯した俺なんかを、翡翠がそこまで気にかけるなんて、間違っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you trust no one, Master Shiki? Nothing at all?”
That is right. Hisui has no obligation to care about me.
Craving human blood, I even violated Hisui, and it is wrong for her to care so deeply for someone like me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No one?
Are you saying you can believe in no one, Shiki-sama?"
…… That's right.
Therefore, there is no reason for her to worry about me.
It's wrong for her to worry that much about me, the one wanting human blood, the one who violated her body so roughly.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
いいから、もう行ってくれ。
俺は一人のほうが気が楽なんだ。
そのほうが誰にも迷惑をかけずに済む」
「嘘です。
そんなの、全然楽しくなんかありません。
志貴さまは嘘をついています……！」
　……翡翠の声は、どこか怒っているようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Just go. Being alone is easier for me. This way I will not be a burden to anyone.”
“That is a lie. Being alone is no fun at all. You are lying, Master Shiki…!”
There is anger in Hisui’s voice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
Just go away.
It's easier for me to be by myself.
This way I won't be a burden to anyone."
"That is a lie.
That… that is not fun at all.
Shiki-sama, you are telling a lie……!"
…… Her voice actually sounds a little angry.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、貴方が誰も信じられないというのでしたら、わたしを信じてくださって結構です！
　ですから、今だけはわたしの言うことを聞いてください……！」
　……泣いているような、翡翠の声。
　本当に怒っているのか、翡翠の言っているコトはメチャクチャだ。
　わたしを信じていい、なんて、それこそあべこべだ。
　普通は、俺のほうが信じてやる、とか言うものなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, if you cannot trust anyone, then you may trust me!
So please—just this once, listen to me…!”
Hisui sounds close to tears.
Perhaps anger has muddled her thoughts, because what she says makes no sense.
The idea that I can trust her is completely backward.
Normally I should be the one saying I will trust her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
If you say you cannot believe in anyone, please believe in me!
So please, listen to me for just now……!"
…… Her voice… she sounds like she is crying.
She must be really angry as she's not making any sense.
"You can believe in me"?
That's backwards.
Normally, I have to say, "I believe in you."

entries.japanese:
「………まったく………」
　滅茶苦茶だ。
　そんな自分勝手な理屈を押しつけてくるのは、あの子だけだと、思ってた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly…”
It is absurd.
I had thought that girl was the only person who could force such selfish logic on me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Geez………"
That's just absurd.
I thought the only one who'd make that kind of ridiculous argument was that one girl.

entries.japanese:
「……信じるって、なにを」
「そんなの、わたしにもわかりません……！
　わたしはただ志貴さまが好きだから、こうして志貴さまをお呼びしているだけです……！」
　ドン、と一際強く、扉がノックされる。
「……志貴さま、どうか鍵を開けてください。
わたしでは力不足でしょうけど、一人で閉じこもっていられるよりはずっとずっと楽になりますから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Trust what?”
“I do not know…! I only keep calling Master Shiki because I care about Master Shiki…!”
The door shakes beneath one tremendous blow.
“Please unlock the door, Master Shiki. I may be of little use, but I know you would suffer far less with me than shut away in there alone…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Believe in what?"
"I do not know……!
I just know that… I like you, Shiki-sama, which is why I am calling to you like this……!"
Thud.
She knocks louder than ever before.
"…… Shiki-sama, please.
Open the door.
I know I am powerless, but I do know that it will be better than being by yourself……!"

entries.japanese:
泣くような翡翠の声。
　それは口調こそ違えど、あのときの少女のセリフに、ひどく似ている気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s voice trembled like a sob.
Though her manner was different, the words sounded terribly like something that girl had once said.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She sounds like she's crying.
The tone is different, but it feels similar to what that girl told me back then.

entries.japanese:
「まだダメなんですか……！？
　このままだと本当に志貴さまは危ないんです……！
　どうして―――どうして昔に戻ってしまうんですか……！
　帰ってきたら、またみんなで遊ぼうってあんなに約束したのに、どうして……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is it still not enough…!? If this continues, Master Shiki truly will be in danger…!
Why―――why are you going back to the way you were…!? You promised we would all play together again when you came home, so why…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Will you resist again……!?
Shiki-sama, you are really in danger like this……!
Why--why are you acting like back then……!
You promised that when you came back, you would play with everyone, so why……!"

entries.japanese:
泣くような少女の声。
「あ…………」
　微かに思い出す。
　そういえば昔、俺が病院に運ばれる前にそんな些細な口約束をしたんだっけ。
　あの時はケガが治ったら屋敷に帰って来るのが当たり前だと思っていたから、そんなものはそれこそ挨拶みたいなもので、気にもとめていなかったけど。
entries.maoEnglish:
The weeping voice of a little girl.
“Ah…”
A faint memory surfaces.
Before I was taken to the hospital, had I made some little promise like that?
At the time, I assumed I would return to the mansion once my injuries healed, and the promise seemed no more significant than a farewell, so I thought nothing of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The crying voice of a young girl.
"Ah…………"
I start to remember a little.
That's right.
Back then, before I was taken to the hospital, I made that small promise.
I thought that I would go back to the mansion when I healed, so I just said it without thinking too much.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さまを―――あの時みたいに志貴さまを目の前で失うのは、もうイヤなんです……！
　どうか……お願いだから開けて……志、貴―――」
　ドアを叩く音が止まる。
　泣き崩れるような気配。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――I cannot bear to lose Master Shiki before my eyes again as I did then! Please, I beg you, open the door, Shi, ki―――”
The knocking stops.
Beyond the door, I feel someone collapse in tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---I do not want to lose you right before my eyes, just like before……!
So please…… please, open the door…… Shi, ki--"
The pounding against the door stops.
It seems Hisui has crumbled to the ground in tears.

entries.japanese:
何日も何日も俺に呼びかけを続けてくれたあの子。
　とても気があって、心配性で、いつも傍にいた少女。
―――それは。
　本当は、一体誰だったっていうんだろう――？
!w3000
entries.maoEnglish:
That girl, who had kept calling to me for days and days.
The anxious girl who understood me so well and was always at my side.
―――That girl.
Who had she really been――?!w3000
entries.mirrorMoon:
That girl, who would call to me day after day.
That energetic, worrying girl that was always by my side.
---Just who?
Really, who was she--?

entries.japanese:
「翡翠……！」
　もう立ちあがる力なんてないハズだったのに、体は軋みをあげて立ちあがった。
　動くたびに気が遠くなる。
　けどそんな苦痛は、頭のすみのほうに追いやられていた。
――――――翡翠。
　　　　　　翡翠。
　　　　　　翡翠、翡翠、翡翠、翡翠――――！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui…!”
I should not have had the strength to stand, yet my body creaked to its feet.
Every movement threatened to drag me into darkness.
Somehow, the pain had been banished to a distant corner of my mind.
――――――Hisui.
Hisui.
Hisui, Hisui, Hisui, Hisui――――!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui……!"
Even though I shouldn't have any strength left, I somehow manage to stand.
Every time I move, I feel like fainting.
But the pain is of no concern right now.
----Hisui.
Hisui.
Hisui, Hisui, Hisui, Hisui----!

entries.japanese:
ドアまでたどりついて、鍵に手をかける。
「……こ……の」
　しびれた指先は思うように動いてくれなくて、中々鍵は開いてくれなかった。
　がちゃり、とようやく鍵がはずれた。
　開かれる扉。
　その向こうで、懐かしい、翡翠の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I reach the door and seize the lock.
“Come on”
My numb fingers refuse to obey, and the bolt will not move.
At last, with a click, the lock came free.
The door opened.
Beyond it stood Hisui—achingly familiar.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I drag myself to the door and place my hand on the lock.
"…… Yo…… u"
My numb fingers don't move as I tell them to, and the lock is difficult to turn.
The lock finally clinks loose.
The door opens.
In front of me, I see the figure of Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――なんて、ひどい」
　涙に濡れた顔のまま、翡翠は俺を見つめてくる。
　けど、今は俺の体のことなんてどうでもいい。
　そんな事より、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――this is terrible.”
Hisui stares at me through a face wet with tears.
But my condition no longer matters.
There is something far more important―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---you look… terrible."
With tears still streaming down her face, Hisui stares at me.
But I don't care about my body right now.
More than that, I---

entries.japanese:
「―――翡翠。
キミが、あの子なのか」
「………………」
　翡翠は答えない。
　それはいいえ、という返答ではなく、はい、という沈黙だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hisui. Were you that girl?”
“…”
Hisui does not answer.
It is not a silence that says no, but one that says yes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hisui.
Are you that girl?"
"………………"
Hisui doesn't answer.
Her silence isn't disagreement, but agreement.

entries.japanese:
「どうして――――俺はてっきり琥珀さんがそうなのかって思ってた。
翡翠だって、昨日自分が屋敷の中にいた子だって、言ってたじゃないか」
「……志貴さま。
それは、わたしではありません。
きっと姉さんは、衰弱していく志貴さまを放っておけなくて、志貴さまをお助けしたんだと思います」
「え―――――」
――――それはつまり……昨日の、俺が襲ってしまった翡翠は、琥珀さんだったっていう事、なのか……？
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why――――I was certain it had been Kohaku. Yesterday, you said you were the girl who stayed inside the mansion.”
“Master Shiki. That was not me. I believe my sister could not stand by as Master Shiki grew weaker and came to help Master Shiki.”
“What―――――”
――――Then did that mean the Hisui I had attacked yesterday had really been Kohaku…?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why?
----I thought she was Kohaku-san.
You even told me yesterday that you were the child in the mansion."
"…… Shiki-sama.
That was not me.
I think Nee-san was helping you out since you were so weak."
"Eh----"
----In other words…… The Hisui that I saw yesterday… was really--Kohaku-san……?

entries.japanese:
「……それじゃやっぱり、翡翠が俺たちと遊んでいた子で、琥珀さんのほうが―――屋敷の中にいた子だっていうのか、翡翠」
「……………」
「どうして……？
　わからない。
どうしてそんな入れ替わるような真似をしてるんだ、翡翠たちは」
「……志貴さまを欺こうとしたワケではないんです。
志貴さまが有間の家にいかれた後、わたしは以前に比べて大人しくなったんだと思います。
　姉さんはそんなわたしを励まそうと明るく振る舞うようになって、いつのまにか、わたしたちはそっくり立場が入れ替わっていただけなんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So you were the girl who played with us, and Kohaku was―――the girl who stayed inside the mansion; is that what you are saying, Hisui?”
“…”
“Why…? I do not understand. Why would the two of you trade places like that?”
“We did not intend to deceive Master Shiki. After Master Shiki went to live with the Arima family, I believe I became much quieter than I had been.
My sister began acting cheerful to encourage me, and before we knew it, our roles had completely reversed.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then Hisui?
You're the one who played with us when we were kids, and Kohaku-san is---the one who was always in the mansion?"
"…………"
"Why……?
I don't understand.
Just why are the two of you acting like you traded places?"
"…… We never intended to deceive you.
I think I became calmer after you were adopted by the Arima family.
Nee-san tried to cheer me up by acting very happy, and then, we gradually traded our roles."

entries.japanese:
「そんな……どうしてそんな事に……？
　翡翠……キミはあんなに元気な子だったのに」
「……違います。
わたしはもともと、あまり活動的な子供ではありませんでした。
ただ志貴さまがいらしたから、精一杯駆け足で志貴さまを追いかけていただけなんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But how did that happen? You were such a lively child, Hisui.”
“No. I was never very energetic by nature. I only ran as hard as I could to keep up with Master Shiki because Master Shiki was there ahead of me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But why…… why did it happen……?
Hisui…… you were always so energetic."
"…… That is not true.
I am naturally not active.
But when you were there, I tried to follow you as hard as I could."

entries.japanese:
「……ですが、それがいけなかったんです。
わたしが志貴さまを庭に連れ出したから、志貴さまはあんな事故に会ってしまった。
　わたしは―――ただ恐くて、志貴さまを見殺しにしてしまった。
血にまみれた志貴さまをぼんやりと眺めているだけで、泣く事も助けを呼ぶ事もできなかった。
　……その時から、わたしは自分がわからなくなってしまいました。
どう考えても、以前の自分がどんなふうに話して、どんなふうに笑っていたのかが思い出せなくなっていたんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that was where I went wrong. Because I took Master Shiki into the garden, Master Shiki met with that terrible accident.
I was―――simply afraid, and I left Master Shiki to die. I could do nothing but stare at Master Shiki covered in blood, unable even to cry or call for help.
After that, I lost all sense of who I was. No matter how I searched my memory, I could no longer remember how I had once spoken or smiled.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I never should have done that.
Since I took you out into the garden, you had the accident."
I---all I could do was watch in fear as you were killed before my eyes.
All I could do was stare at your blood-soaked body.
I couldn't even cry, or call for help.
…… Since that time, I was unable to understand myself.
No matter how I tried, I could not remember how I acted, or how I smiled."

entries.japanese:
「……わたしは志貴さまが死にかけているのに何もできず、ただ見ていただけだった。
そんなものは人形と変わりがありません。
　だから―――いっそ人形になってしまえばいいんだなって、そんな呪いを、自分自身にかけてしまったのかもしれません。
　気がつくとわたしは姉さんのように無口になっていました。
……姉さんは仕事ができなくなってしまったわたしの代わりに働くようになって、わたしの代わりに笑うようになったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki was dying, and I did nothing but watch. That made me no different from a doll.
So―――perhaps I cursed myself with the thought that I might as well become one.
Before I knew it, I had grown as silent as my sister. When I could no longer work, she began working and smiling in my place.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… When you were dying, I could not do anything.
I could only watch.
It was as if I was just a doll.
So---I thought… that maybe it would be better if I was just a doll.
Maybe I put a curse on myself.
Before I knew it, I became silent just like Nee-san.
…… Nee-san took my place, doing the work I could not do, smiling because I could not."

entries.japanese:
「……待ってくれ、翡翠。
キミの言うことは、俺にはよく―――」
　わからない。
「俺が死にかけたってどういう事だ。
翡翠は八年前の事故の事を知っているのか」
「……はい。
志貴さまは事故に巻き込まれて怪我をなされたのではありません。
……このお屋敷の中庭で、殺されかけただけなんです」
「な―――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Hisui. What you are saying, I do not quite―――”
Understand.
“What do you mean, I was dying? Do you know what happened in that accident eight years ago?”
“Yes. Master Shiki was not injured in an accident. Someone tried to kill you in the courtyard of this mansion.”
“What―――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait, Hisui.
What you're saying, I don't really---"
Understand, is what I wanted to say.
"What do you mean I almost died?
You know about that accident eight years ago?"
"…… Yes.
You were not injured from a traffic accident.
…… In the courtyard of the mansion, you were killed."
"Wha----"

entries.japanese:
それは、違う。
　殺したのは俺のほうだ。
　だって俺は、血にまみれた自分の体をいつまでも見下ろしていたんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
That is wrong.
I was the one who killed someone.
After all, I stood there forever, looking down at my own blood-soaked body―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's.
Not.
Right.
I'm the one who did the killing.
Because I was the one looking down on that blood stained body---

entries.japanese:
「あ……」
　気が遠くなる。
足に力が入らなくなって、前のめりに倒れこむ―――
「志貴さま……！
　しっかりしてください……！」
　……その寸前。
　翡翠は、倒れる俺の体を正面から抱きとめてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah…”
The world fades. Strength leaves my legs, and I pitch forward―――
“Master Shiki…! Please, hold on…!”
Just before I strike the floor.
Hisui catches my falling body head-on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……"
I start feeling light-headed.
All the strength drains from my legs and I start to fall---
"Shiki-sama……!
Please, hold on……!"
…… In that instant,
Hisui wraps her arms around me to prevent me from falling.

entries.japanese:
「「あ―――――」」
　……俺と、翡翠の声が重なる。
　翡翠はよっぽど必死になって俺を支えてくれたんだろう。
　俺と抱きしめあうカタチになって、体をふるふると震わせている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――”
My voice overlaps Hisui’s.
Hisui must have been desperate to hold me up.
We end up embracing, and her body trembles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
""Ah----""
…… Her voice and mine overlap.
Hisui stands there, desperately holding on to me.
We look like we're embracing each other, and Hisui stands there trembling.

entries.japanese:
「…………翡翠」
　わかってる。
　翡翠が異性と触れ合う事を苦手にしている事はわかってる。
　だから今も、こうして支えてくれてはいるものの、翡翠の体は小刻みに震えているんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui.”
I know.
I know how badly she struggles with a man’s touch.
Even as she holds me upright, her body shakes in tiny, ceaseless spasms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Hisui."
I understand.
I understand that she doesn't like to come into contact with men.
Even now, her body is trembling all over.

entries.japanese:
「―――翡翠」
　それでも、離れる事はできなかった。
　翡翠の体に腕を回す。
　その体温。
柔らかな体。
　……幼い頃から、俺のことを見守っていてくれた、少女。
　ああ―――もう、間違いは、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Hisui”
Even so, I cannot pull away.
I put my arms around her.
Her warmth. The softness of her body.
The girl who has watched over me since we were children.
Ah―――there can be no mistake now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hisui."
Still, I can't let go.
I wrap my arms around her.
Her warmth.
Her soft body.
…… Since we were children, the girl that has always looked after me.
Yeah---there can be no more doubt.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠……やっと、会えた」
　満足に動かない体で、ただ、翡翠の体を抱きしめた。
「ぁ……志貴、さま……」
　翡翠の体の震えは止まらない。
　それでも拒まずに、翡翠は俺の背中に腕をまわしてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, at last I found you.”
With a body that barely moves, I simply hold her.
“Ah, Master Shiki”
She will not stop trembling.
Even so, she does not pull away, but slips her arms around my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui…… Finally, we meet again."
With my weak body, I embrace her close to me.
"Ah…… Shiki… sama……"
Her shaking doesn't stop.
But she does not refuse me and wraps her arms around my back.

entries.japanese:
「……ごめん」
　何に対しての言葉なのか、自分でもわからない。
　ただ、翡翠に謝らないといけないことが数えきれないぐらいある気がして、そんな事を言った。
「……いいんです。
謝らないでください、志貴さま」
　静かに答えて、翡翠は俺をベッドまで連れていってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am sorry.”
I do not even know what I am apologizing for.
It simply feels as if I have more things to apologize to Hisui for than I can count, and so I say it.
“It is all right. Please do not apologize, Master Shiki.”
Hisui answers quietly and helps me back to bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm sorry."
I don't know what I'm apologizing for.
I just feel like there's so many things I have to apologize to her for.
"…… Not at all.
You do not need to apologize for anything, Shiki-sama."
Answering quietly, she takes me to my bed.

entries.japanese:
ベッドに体を休める。
　絨毯とベッドではこうも違うものなのか、ベッドに横になるだけで体が多少は楽になった。
　翡翠はベッドに横になった俺にシーツをかけて、水の入ったグラスを持ち出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
I let my body sink into the mattress.
I had never imagined the difference between carpet and bed could be so immense; merely lying down brought some relief.
Hisui drew a sheet over me, then picked up a glass of water.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I rest in bed.
My body relaxes a little bit, the bed being much more comfortable than the floor.
Hisui covers me with a clean sheet and brings a glass of water.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お一人でお飲みになれますか？」
「ああ、なんとかそれぐらいは」
　翡翠からグラスを受け取って、一日ぶりの水分をとる。
「ん……」
　熱く渇いていた喉が癒される。
　たったグラス一杯分の水が、どくん、と指先まで流れていくような感覚。
　グラスを翡翠に返して、ばふっ、と音をたてて体をベッドに預けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Can you drink without assistance, Master Shiki?”
“Yeah, I can manage that much.”
I accept the glass and take my first drink in a day.
“Mm…”
The water soothes my hot, parched throat.
One glass seems to surge all the way to my fingertips.
I return it to Hisui and drop back onto the bed with a soft thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, are you able to drink by yourself?"
"Yeah, I think I can manage that."
Taking the glass from Hisui, I drink my first glass of water in a day.
"Nnnh……"
The water quenches my thirst.
The water seems to fill me completely, up to my fingertips.
I give the glass back to Hisui, and I fall down onto the bed.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま！？」
「―――ああ、違う違う。
あんまりにも気持ちがいいんで、力を抜いただけだ。
体の調子は、そう悪くない」
「志貴さま、あまり驚かさないでください。
今の志貴さまはこのままお倒れになってもおかしくないのですから」
　本当に不安そうな目で俺を看ている。
　……その眼差しに感謝する反面、ずきりと、後悔の念が走った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki!?”
“―――No, no, it is all right. It felt so good that I just let myself go limp. I am not doing that badly.”
“Master Shiki, please do not frighten me like that. In Master Shiki’s present condition, you might collapse at any moment.”
She watches me with naked anxiety.
Her concern fills me with gratitude—and a sharp stab of remorse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama!?"
"---No, no no, that's not it.
I actually feel good, I was just relaxing.
My health actually seems better."
"Shiki-sama, do not scare me like that.
It would not be very surprising if you really did collapse, in your condition."
Hisui looks at me with uneasiness in her eyes.
…… That look makes me want to thank her, and also makes me feel regret.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま？
　どこか痛むのですか？
　痛むのでしたらどうぞ遠慮なくおっしゃってください」
「いや、別に痛いところなんてないけど」
　……ただ、胸が痛い。
　俺が倒れてから、いつも自分の心配をしていてくれた翡翠。
　その彼女に対して、俺は馬鹿な真似ばかりしてきてしまった。
　彼女のまっすぐな献身にも気付かないで、翡翠の心を傷つけるような事ばかり、してた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? Are you in pain? If anything hurts, please tell me without hesitation.”
“No, nothing hurts.”
Nothing except my heart.
Hisui has worried about me ever since I collapsed.
And all I have done in return is behave like a fool.
Blind to her unwavering devotion, I have hurt her again and again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama?
Does it hurt anywhere?
If you are in pain, please do not hesitate to tell me."
"No, nothing really hurts right now."
…… Well, my heart hurts.
Hisui is worrying about me right now, just like always.
All I've done in return to her is to act stupidly.
Not even realizing her absolute devotion, all I've done is bring pain to her heart.

entries.japanese:
俺の体を回復させようと、あんな事までしてくれた翡翠を乱暴に扱った。
　……あの時の翡翠は琥珀さんだったという話だけど、俺が翡翠に対して乱暴になったという事は事実だ。
　それだけじゃない。
　人を殺す夢を見て、実際にそれに引きずられるように、翡翠を犯す夢さえ見ていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I treated her cruelly even when she went so far to help me recover.
I am told that it was really Kohaku then, not Hisui, but that does not change the fact that I turned violent toward Hisui.
And there was more.
I had dreamed of killing people—and as though those dreams had dragged me onward, I had even dreamed of violating Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And that time, when I did those terrible things to Hisui.
…… Even though it turned out to actually be Kohaku-san, I still did them to Hisui.
And that's not all.
I dreamt about killing people, and in accordance with that, I dreamt about violating Hisui.

entries.japanese:
……俺は。
　こんなふうに、翡翠に看病される資格なんて、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I…
I have no right to be nursed by Hisui like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I,
I do not deserve to be cared for by Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、お飲み物はお口にあいませんでしたか……？」
　いや、と首を横にふる。
「そんな事ないよ。
……その、色々ありがとう翡翠。
水を飲むだけでこんなに楽になれるなんて、思わなかった。
　でも、もういいんだ。
俺は翡翠にここまでしてもらう資格なんてない」
「―――志貴さま、まだそんな事を言っているのですか。
わたしはただ志貴さまをお助けしたいだけです。
そこに資格なんてありません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, was the drink not to your liking…?”
I shake my head.
“No, it was fine. Thank you for everything, Hisui. I never knew a little water could make me feel this much better.
But that’s enough. I don’t deserve to have you do all this for me.”
“―――Master Shiki, are you still saying such things? I only wish to help Master Shiki. No one needs to earn the right to be helped.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, was the water not pleasing to you……?"
I shake my head no.
"That's not it.
…… Um… thanks for everything, Hisui.
I never even thought that drinking water could help me this much.
But, that's enough.
I don't deserve to be treated this well by you."
"---Shiki-sama, are you still saying that?
I just want to help you, it doesn't matter if you deserve it or not."

entries.japanese:
「違うんだ翡翠。
キミが悪いわけじゃない」
　……そう、悪いのは俺のほうだ。
　いくら翡翠が献身的に尽くしてくれても、俺は、その好意をさかしまにして返してしまう。
「……俺は翡翠がいると、きっとまたひどいことをする。
だから最低限の手当てをすませたら、すぐに部屋から出ていってほしい。
……頼む。
俺はもう、翡翠を傷つけたくないんだ」
　翡翠は何も言わない。
　けど俺の言いたい事は解ってくれるはずだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That is not it, Hisui. You have not done anything wrong.”
The fault is mine.
However devotedly she cares for me, I only twist her kindness and repay it with harm.
“If you stay, I know I will do something terrible again. Once you have done the bare minimum, I want you to leave at once. Please. I do not want to hurt you anymore.”
Hisui said nothing.
But surely she understood what I meant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, Hisui.
It's not you."
…… Yeah, I'm the one at fault here.
Hisui gives me nothing but devotion, but I repay her with cruelty.
"…… If you are here with me, I'll probably do something horrible again.
So before I do anything, please, leave.
…… I beg you.
I--I don't want to hurt you anymore, Hisui."
Hisui doesn't say anything.
But she has to understand what I am saying.

entries.japanese:
何秒か沈黙したあと、解ってくれたのか翡翠は顔をあげて頷いた。
「お断りします」
「……ああ、悪いけどそうしてくれると助かる……って、ちょっと待った。
翡翠、いまなんて言った……？」
「お断りします、と申し上げました。
　そのようなお言葉だけでは、志貴さまをお一人にはできません。
納得のいく理由を言っていただかなければ、わたしは志貴さまのお言葉には従いません」
　きっぱりと翡翠は返答する。
entries.maoEnglish:
After several silent seconds, Hisui raised her face and nodded, apparently understanding.
“I refuse.”
“Yeah, sorry, that would help, but wait. Hisui, what did you just say?”
“I said that I refuse.
Those words alone are not enough for me to leave Master Shiki by himself. Unless you give me a reason I can accept, I will not obey Master Shiki’s wishes.”
Hisui delivers the answer without the slightest hesitation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After several seconds of silence, it appears she understands as she raises her head and nods.
"I refuse."
"…… Yeah, I'm sorry it had to be this way, but…… W, wait a minute.
Hisui, what did you just say……?"
"I said that I refuse.
Those words are not enough, and I cannot leave you alone.
Until you can give me a valid reason, I will not follow your command."
Hisui responds clearly.

entries.japanese:
「理由をお聞かせください志貴さま。
わたし、そうでなければここから一歩も動きません」
「な―――」
　翡翠の目は真剣だ。
　下手な言い訳も嘘も見抜かれてしまうだろうし、何より俺は―――翡翠に嘘なんて、つきたくなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please tell me your reason, Master Shiki. Otherwise, I will not move one step from this spot.”
“What―――”
Hisui’s eyes are serious.
She would see through any clumsy excuse or lie, and more than anything, I―――do not want to lie to Hisui.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please tell me the reason, Shiki-sama.
Unless you do, I will not move one step."
"Wha--"
Her eyes are dead serious.
I bet she could tell if I'm telling a lie or an excuse, and more than anything---I don't want to lie to her.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
理由を言えば出ていってくれるんだな？」
「はい。
それが納得のいくものであれば、わたしは志貴さまのお言葉をお守りいたします」
「………はあ」
　深く息をはく。
　……覚悟を決めて、口を開けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine. If I tell you why, you will leave?”
“Yes. If your reason satisfies me, I will honor Master Shiki’s wishes.”
“Hah.”
I exhale deeply.
Then I steel myself and begin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I get it.
So if I tell you the reason, you'll go?"
"Yes.
If it is something that can convince me, then I will fulfill your command."
……… *sigh*
I take a deep breath.
…… Mentally prepared, I open my mouth.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、俺は人を殺す夢を見るんだ。
毎夜毎夜、見知らぬ誰かを殺して、その血を吸う夢を見る」
「……夢を見るって……そんなコトが理由だなんていうんですか、志貴さま」
「……違う。
だからさ、俺にはそれが夢であるかどうか判別がつかないんだ。
本当は俺が気付いていないだけで、現実に人を殺してしまっているかもしれない。
　……俺の親父である、遠野槙久みたいに自分の知らない自分がいて、そいつが街を騒がしている殺人鬼なのかもしれない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, I dream about killing people. Every night I dream of killing someone I’ve never met and drinking their blood.”
“Are you saying dreams are your reason, Master Shiki?”
“No. The point is that I cannot tell whether they are dreams. Maybe I really am killing people and simply do not know it.
Maybe, like my father, Makihisa Tohno, I have another self I know nothing about, and that self is the murderer terrorizing the city.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, I see dreams where I kill people.
Every night, I dream that I kill someone I don't know and drink their blood."
"…… You see dreams…… Is that supposed to be your reason, Shiki-sama?"
"…… No, the thing is, I can't tell if they are dreams or not.
Maybe it's that I don't notice, but I might be killing people in reality.
…… Just like the old man.
There might be another self in me I don't know about, walking the streets killing people."

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、それは――そんなコト、ありえる筈がありません。
志貴さまは今もこうして志貴さまのままじゃないですか」
「……今はそうだ。
けど時折、わけのわからない考えが頭の中に浮かんでくる。
俺が見ている夢だって、過去に俺が犯した殺人の記憶かもしれない」
　……それに事実、俺は八年前に誰かを殺してしまっている。
　あの中庭で血にまみれた少年の姿をじっと見下ろしていた記憶が、実際にあるんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, that is――such a thing cannot be true. Master Shiki is still Master Shiki, right here before me.”
“Right now, yes. But sometimes thoughts I cannot understand surface in my mind. Even my dreams might be memories of murders I committed in the past.”
And in truth, I killed someone eight years ago.
I really do remember standing in that courtyard, staring down at a boy covered in blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, that--that is impossible.
You are acting like the normal Shiki-sama right now."
"…… Right now I am.
But sometimes, I get these strange thoughts.
The dreams I see… they may simply be my memories."
…… And truthfully, I did kill someone eight years ago.
I actually have the memory of looking down on that blood-stained kid.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、しっかりしてください。
まさかご自分が血を吸う怪物だなんて、そんな事を思い込むなんて、おかしいです」
「……ああ、おかしいな。
けど笑い飛ばせないんだ。
……翡翠は知らないだろうけど、遠野の人間はみんな普通とは違うらしいんだ。
親父は二重人格者だったし、俺も似たようなものかもしれない。
秋葉だって――――」
　琥珀さんの、血を飲んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please, Master Shiki, come to your senses. It is absurd to convince yourself that you are some blood-drinking monster.”
“Yes, it is absurd. But I cannot laugh it off. You may not know this, Hisui, but apparently none of the Tohnos are normal. My father had another personality, and I may be the same. Even Akiha――――”
She had been drinking Kohaku’s blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please get a hold of yourself.
Thinking that you are a blood sucking monster is surely too strange."
"…… Yeah, it's strange, but I can't laugh it off.
…… Hisui, you don't know it, but I guess those of the Tohno family are different from normal people.
The old man had split personalities, and even Akiha--"
---was sucking Kohaku-san's blood.

entries.japanese:
「とにかく、遠野の人間はみんな普通じゃないんだ。
俺だってそれは同じだ。
倒れてからずっと、翡翠や琥珀さんがやってくるたびに、二人が欲しくてたまらなかった。
　今はまだなんともないけど、またあの頭痛がやってくれば、きっと―――俺は翡翠にひどい事をするに決まってる……！」
「―――志貴さま。
そのような事でしたら、わたしも姉さんも初めから知っていました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“The point is, none of the Tohnos are normal. I am no different. Ever since I collapsed, whenever you or Kohaku came near, I wanted you so badly I could hardly stand it.
I am all right for now, but when that headache returns, I am sure―――I will do something terrible to you…!”
“―――Master Shiki. If that is what troubles you, my sister and I have known from the beginning.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Anyway, the people of the Tohno family are not normal.
So I'm not normal either.
I can't stop myself from lusting after you and Kohaku-san.
It's alright now, but if I get that headache again, for sure---I will do something terrible to you, Hisui……!"
"---Shiki-sama, Nee-san and I have known all of that from the very beginning."

entries.japanese:
「は……？
　知ってたって、なにを」
「ですから、遠野の人間が普通ではない、という事をです。
いえ、逆にいえば知らないのは志貴さまだけでした。
　わたしも姉さんも、初めからそれを知ったうえでこのお屋敷に引き取られたんですから」
「――――――な」
「ですが、それを奇異に思う事はありません。
わたしと姉さんも、普通の人には持ち合わせていない力があります。
わたしたちはその力があったから、槙久さまに引き取られたのです。
　ですから遠野家の事でしたら、わたしたちは志貴さま以上に知っています」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…? Known what?”
“That the Tohno family is not ordinary. In fact, Master Shiki was the only one who did not know.
My sister and I were taken into this mansion with full knowledge of it.”
“――――――What”
“But we have never found it strange. My sister and I also possess abilities ordinary people do not. Master Makihisa took us in because of those abilities.
We therefore know more about the Tohno family than Master Shiki does.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh……?
You knew?
Knew what?"
"That the people of the Tohno are not normal.
No, in other words, you were the only one that did not know.
Nee-san and I have known that since we were first brought to this mansion."
"------Wha…"
"But do not think that is anything strange.
Nee-san and I, we also carry a power that is not normal.
It was because of that power that Makihisa-sama brought us here.
Regarding the Tohno family, we know much more than you, Shiki-sama."

entries.japanese:
「確かに遠野の血筋は異常と言っても差しつかえのないモノでしょう。
　けれど志貴さま。
そのようなことは貴方には関係がありません。
志貴さまは槙久さまのような二重人格でもなければ、血を吸う鬼などでもありません。
　貴方は―――どちらかというと、わたしや姉さんに近い人ですから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It would be fair to call the Tohno bloodline abnormal.
But none of that concerns Master Shiki. Master Shiki has no second personality like Master Makihisa. Nor are you some demon that drinks blood. You are―――if anything, closer to my sister and me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Certainly, you can call the Tohno blood abnormal.
But, Shiki-sama, that has nothing to do with you.
You do not have a split personality like Makihisa-sama nor are you a vampire that sucks human blood.
Shiki-sama, you are rather someone closer to Nee-san and I."

entries.japanese:
「……俺が、翡翠たちに近い……？」
「はい。
志貴さまは決して殺人鬼なんかじゃありません。
……今はわたしを信じて、どうかお世話をさせてください」
「……だめだ。
それでも俺が翡翠を、その……欲しいって思うのは事実なんだ。
一緒にいたら俺は取り返しのつかない事をしてしまう」
「あ―――あの、その問題なのですが、一つお聞きしてよろしいでしょうか……？」
「え……？
　うん、別にかまわないけど……」
「あの、志貴さまは、その……わたしや姉さんを、お嫌いなのですか……？」
「――――――は？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am like you and Kohaku?”
“Yes, Master Shiki. You are not a murderer. For now, please trust me and allow me to care for you.”
“No. Even so, the fact remains that I want you, Hisui. If we stay together, I will do something that can never be undone.”
“Ah―――about that particular concern, may I ask you one question…?”
“Huh…? Sure, go ahead.”
“Master Shiki, do you dislike my sister and me?”
“――――――What?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm, closer to you……?"
"Yes.
You are definitely not a killer.
…… Please, just trust me for now and let me take care of you."
"…… No.
It still doesn't make a difference to the fact that, um…… I still want you.
If you remain here, I'll do something I can't take back."
"U---um, about this problem, will you allow me to ask a question……?"
"Eh…?
Yeah, I don't mind……"
"Um, Shiki-sama, um…… Do you not like Nee-san and I……?"
"------Huh?"

entries.japanese:
もじもじとせわしなく指を合わせて、翡翠はワケのわからない事を聞いてくる。
　俺が翡翠や琥珀さんを嫌いか、だって？
　そんなこと、天地がひっくり返ってもありえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui fidgets restlessly with her fingers as she asks an incomprehensible question.
Did I dislike her or Kohaku?
Not even if heaven and earth turned upside down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui asks something totally absurd and she starts fidgeting with her fingers.
Do I not like Hisui and Kohaku-san?
Nothing could be further from the truth.

entries.japanese:
「……あのね。
俺が翡翠や琥珀さんを嫌うわけがないだろ。
俺は琥珀さんには感謝してるし、翡翠にだって、その……ありがたいなって、いつも思ってるんだから」
「―――――はあ」
　なぜか胸をホッとなでおろす翡翠。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come on. There is no way I could hate you or Kohaku. I am grateful to Kohaku, and I am always grateful to you too, Hisui.”
“―――――Oh.”
For some reason, Hisui lets out a breath of heartfelt relief.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Now look.
There's no way I could ever not like either of you.
I'm always thankful to Kohaku-san, and to you too…… um, I'm always thinking about how thankful I am to you."
She lets out the breath she was holding.
Hisui visibly relaxes for some reason.

entries.japanese:
「それでしたら何ら問題はありません。
今の志貴さまは、体の影響で感情の抑制が不安定なだけなんです。
普段思っている事が表に出てきているだけですから、それはあくまで志貴さま本人のご意志です。
　ですから、志貴さまがわたしや姉さんに好意を持っていてくださるのでしたら、そのようなお気持ちになる事もおかしくはありません」
「あ……いや、それはたしかにそうだけど……！
でもそんな事で二人を欲しいだなんて思うのはおかしいだろ、やっぱり！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then there is no problem. Master Shiki’s condition has merely weakened your control over your emotions. The feelings you normally suppress are simply surfacing, so those desires are still Master Shiki’s own.
So if Master Shiki cares for my sister and me, there is nothing strange about having such feelings.”
“Ah, well, I suppose that is true, but—!
But it is still wrong to want both of you just because I care about you!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Then there is no problem.
Your condition has put you under a lot of stress.
This caused things in your mind to come up into your dreams.
That means your thoughts are your true feelings.
So it is not odd to feel that way if you have any liking toward us."
"Ah…… That's true, but…… !
Even still, it's strange to lust after the both of you like this."

entries.japanese:
「ええ、危ないですね。
けど志貴さまはいつも我慢していてくれたのでしょう？
　それでしたら今後も心配はありません。
志貴さまはご自分を危険だとおっしゃいますけど、志貴さま自身はそれ以上に強いお方です。
　今までだって我慢してこられたのですから、これからだって我慢できるはずでしょう？
　それに、それが志貴さまのご意志なんですから、二重人格だなんていう事もありません」
「いや……それは、そういう理屈になるだろうけど……」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes, it is dangerous. But Master Shiki has always restrained himself, has he not? Then there is no need to worry from now on. Master Shiki may call himself dangerous, but Master Shiki himself is stronger still.
You have restrained yourself until now, so surely you can keep doing so? And because these are Master Shiki’s own desires, you cannot have another personality.”
“I suppose the logic follows, but…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, it is a bit dangerous.
But Shiki-sama, you have always endured it, right?
Then it will not be a problem.
You say that you are dangerous, but you are a stronger person than that.
If you have held out for this long, then you can still do so, right?
Besides, it is your own will, so in no way do you have a split personality."
"Well…… That theory may be right, but……"

entries.japanese:
……事はそんな簡単にはいかない。
　けど、そんな信頼しきった笑顔を向けられると、それこそ死んでも我慢しなくちゃいけないって気になってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is not that simple.
But when she smiles at me with such absolute faith, I feel as though I have to master myself even if it kills me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… It isn't that simple.
But just seeing that trusting smile, I feel like I have to hold on no matter what.

entries.japanese:
「……わかったよ。
翡翠がそこまで言うんなら、近くにいてくれ。
俺もできるかぎり自分を抑えてみる」
「え――――いえ、その、わたしが言いたかったのはそういう事ではなくて…」
　顔を赤くしてうつむく翡翠。
「ん……？」
　わけがわからない。
　翡翠は言いにくそうに、ちらちらとこっちに視線を向けてくるだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. If you believe in me that strongly, stay close to me. I will do everything I can to keep myself under control.”
“Wha――――no, that is not quite what I meant…”
Hisui blushes and lowers her head.
“Hm…?”
I do not understand.
She only steals uneasy glances at me, unable to bring herself to speak.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Alright.
If you say so, then you can be close by me.
I will try to hold myself in check as much as possible."
"Eh----no.
That… that is not exactly what I meant…"
Hisui blushes and looks down.
"Hm……?"
I don't get it.
Hisui just looks up at me from time to time with a difficult expression.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠？
　俺、なにかおかしなこと言った？」
「……………………」
　翡翠はじっと俺を見つめてくる。
「――――――――？」
　なんか、ひどく居心地が悪い。
　緊張で心臓が高鳴っているような、何か悪戯を見付かって怒られる直前のような、そんな半端な居心地の悪さ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui? Did I say something strange?”
“…”
Hisui stares steadily into my eyes.
“――――――――?”
This is intensely uncomfortable.
My heart pounds with nerves, as if someone has caught me misbehaving and I am waiting for the scolding to begin—a strange, suspended unease.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui?
Did I say something weird?"
"……………………"
Hisui just stares at me.
"--------?"
I start to feel very uncomfortable.
My heart beats faster under tension.
I feel uneasy, like I got caught with something and am about to get yelled at for it.

entries.maoEnglish:
―――――thump.
―――――thump.
―――――thump.
―――――thump.
―――――thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Thump.

------Thump.
------Thump.
------Thump.
------Thump.

entries.japanese:
「く――――」
　……しまった。
　なんか、緊張していたせいか、眩暈がした。
「う……」
　意識がぐらりと揺れる。
　……忘れていたけど、俺はこんなふうに普通に喋っていられる体じゃ、なかった。
「あ…………、っ――――」
　どくん、と心臓が脈打つたびに吐き気がする。
　翡翠―――翡翠には悪いけど、今はこのまま眠っていたほうが、少しは楽になれるんだろうか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gh――――”
Damn.
Maybe the tension has done it, but the room suddenly spins.
“Ugh…”
My consciousness lurches.
I had forgotten that I am in no condition to sit here talking normally.
“Ah, ngh――――”
Every beat of my heart sends nausea rolling through me.
Hisui―――I hate to do this to her, but perhaps I would suffer less if I simply let myself fall asleep――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Cr--"
…… Crap.
I start to feel a little dizzy, probably because I'm nervous.
"Uu…… "
My consciousness starts to flutter.
…… I forgot all about it, but my body isn't in the condition to keep talking.
"Ah…………, ------"
I feel like throwing up every time my heart pounds.
Hisui---I hate to do this to her, but maybe it's better if I just sleep right now----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま。
お苦しいの、ですか」
「え……あ、ちょっと、苦しい。
けどさっきよりはマシだから、心配しなくて、いい」
「……いえ。
このままでは志貴さまのお体は衰弱死してしまいます。
姉さんも、志貴さまは今夜を越すことはできないだろうと、言っていました」
「な――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Are you in pain?”
“A little. But it is better than before, so you do not need to worry.”
“No. At this rate, Master Shiki will weaken and die. My sister said Master Shiki may not survive the night.”
“What――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama?
Are you suffering?"
"Eh…… Ah.
Just… a little bit.
But it's not serious, you don't have to worry about it."
"…… No.
At this rate, you will surely die.
Nee-san said that you may not last until evening."
"Wha----"

entries.japanese:
言われて、ぞくりとした。
　……そりゃあ考えていなかったわけじゃない。
　この体が治らなかった時。
　日増しに酷くなっていくこの体の果てが死であることなんて、そんな想像は何度もした。
　けど、それを。
　こうもはっきりと人の口から言われると、背筋が凍るぐらい、寒気がした。
entries.maoEnglish:
A chill runs through me at the words.
It is not as though I have never considered it.
If my body fails to recover.
I have imagined any number of times that this worsening condition might end in death.
But that possibility.
Hearing someone else state it so plainly sends a chill down my spine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I feel a chill as I hear that.
…… It's not like I haven't thought about it.
When this body did not heal.
I've imagined many times that my weakening body will only end in death.
But still,…
…… to hear it from someone else like that sends a chill up my spine.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　なんて口にしていいか、分からない。
　そうか、と潔く受け入れればいいのか、
　ふざけるなって暴れたほうがいいのか。
「………………」
　どちらも出来ない。
　自分の体が今夜にでも活動を停止する、なんていう予想はできているのに、まるで実感が湧いていない。
　まるでモニターを通して、見知らぬ病人の人生を眺めているぐらい、他人事のような気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I do not know what to say.
Should I accept it cleanly and say I understand,
or rage that it is some sick joke?
“…”
I can do neither.
I understand that my body might stop tonight, yet it does not feel real.
It feels as distant as watching the life of some unknown invalid through a screen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
I… don't know what to say.
Should I just accept it?
Should I deny it?
"…………………"
I can't do either.
I have felt that my body would die pretty soon… but it just doesn't feel real.
It's like I'm just watching the life of some sick person on some sort of television show.

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉さまと姉さんは、志貴さまの体を治すために出かけています。
……けど、それだって間に合わないかもしれません。
いくら志貴さまを治す事ができても、それまでに志貴さまの体力が尽きてしまっては、意味がないんです」
「……………まあ、それは、そうだな」
　秋葉と琥珀さんが何をしに行っているかは知らない。
　俺の体を治すっていうけど、こんな原因不明の病状を治療できるモノを探してでもいるんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha and my sister have gone out to cure Master Shiki. But even they may not be in time. However able they may be to cure Master Shiki, it will mean nothing if Master Shiki’s strength gives out before then.”
“I suppose that is true.”
I have no idea what Akiha and Kohaku have gone to do.
Hisui says they mean to cure me, but are they searching for something that can treat an illness no one can even explain?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha-sama and Nee-san left in order to save you.
…… But they may not make it in time.
Even if they are successful, if your body runs out of energy before that, there is no point."
"…………… Well, I guess you're right."
I don't know what the two of them are doing.
She says they are going to save me, but are they searching for something that can cure my condition?

entries.japanese:
でもまあ、そんな努力も、結局。
　二人が帰って来る前に俺が力尽きてしまえば、何の意味もなくなるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Whatever their efforts amounted to, in the end
they would all be wasted if I died before the two of them returned.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, all that work……
it'll be useless if I die before they get home.

entries.japanese:
「……でも、ですね。
秋葉さまたちが帰って来るまでの間、志貴さまが元気でいられるようにする方法があるんです」
「……？」
「……失礼でしょうが、その、志貴さまさえお許ししてくださるのでしたら、その方法を行えるんです、けど」
　とぎれとぎれ、ためらいながら翡翠は俺の顔色をうかがってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is another possibility. A way to keep Master Shiki well until Miss Akiha and my sister return.”
“…?”
“It would be improper, but if Master Shiki will permit it, I can perform that treatment.”
Hisui speaks in halting fragments, watching my face for a reaction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, you know?
There is a way to give you energy so you will be able to last until they come back."
"…… ?"
"…… Please excuse me, but if you would allow it--then I can perform that method."
Hisui hesitantly looks at my face.

entries.japanese:
俺を今晩だけでも助ける方法がある、と翡翠は言う。
　もしそれが本当なら、俺にそれを拒む理由なんかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui said she knew a way to keep me alive through the night.
If that was true, I had no reason to refuse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui says there is a method to save me at least for tonight.
If that is true, then I have no reason to refuse it.

entries.japanese:
「……許すも許さないもないよ。
少しでも助かるっていうんなら、なんだってやるしかないだろ。
そんなの、むしろ俺から頼みたいぐらいだ」
「―――はい。
それでは志貴さま、少しの間だけ目を閉じていてくださいますか？」
「目を閉じるの？
　まあいいけど……はい、これでいい？」
「……けっこうです。
そのまま、どうか動かないでいてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You do not need my permission. If it might save me, I will do anything. I should be the one begging you.”
“―――Yes. Then, Master Shiki, would you please close your eyes for a moment?”
“Close my eyes? All right—is this enough?”
“That is fine. Please stay perfectly still.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It isn't a matter of allowing, or not.
If it can help me even a little bit, then we don't have a choice.
I'd like to ask for it myself."
"---Yes.
Then Shiki-sama, could you please close your eyes for just a bit?"
"Close my eyes?
Well, sure…… Is this good?"
"…… That is fine.
Please do not move."

entries.japanese:
こつ、という足音。
　近づいてくる翡翠の気配と、衣擦れの音。
　その後。
　ぎしり、とベッドが軋んで、唇に何かが触れてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A soft footfall.
Hisui draws nearer, her clothes whispering as she moves.
Then.
The bed creaks, and something touches my lips.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I hear her footsteps.
The rustling of her clothes tells me she is coming closer.
And then…
Something shifts onto the bed and I feel something touch my lips.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　柔らかい、感触。
　人の体温を感じさせるそれは、間違いなく翡翠の唇だった。
――――ドク、と体温が上昇する。
　ためらいがちに重ねられた、翡翠の唇。
　その感触と、翡翠からもれてくる吐息が、まるで薬のように体中をかけめぐっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
Soft.
Warm with living heat, it can only be Hisui’s lips.
――――Heat floods into my body with a thump.
Hisui’s lips rest uncertainly against mine.
Their touch and the breath escaping her spread through my body like medicine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
A tender sensation.
I feel the warmth of a human body, and it must be Hisui's lips.
----My body heats up.
Her lips hesitantly pressing up against mine.
This sensation, and the feeling of her breathing, seems to fill my body like a drug.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――」
　どくん、どくん。
　ただ唇を重ねているだけなのに、思考が真っ白になる。
　体は浮いているように気持ちがいい。
　痛みも、疲れも、何もかも消えうせていくような浮遊感。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――”
Thump, thump.
Though our lips are merely touching, my mind goes white.
My whole body feels buoyantly light.
A floating pleasure washes away all pain and weariness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Thump, Thump.
With just a kiss, my mind goes totally white.
I am pleasantly floating away.
All my pain, all my tiredness melts away like ice on a summer day.

entries.japanese:
「ん……、……ぁ」
　……翡翠の吐息が、もれる。
　ただ触れていただけの唇は、少しだけ、強く重なり合った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm, ah”
Hisui’s breath slips out.
The lips that had barely touched mine press a little more firmly together.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn……, …… ah."
…… Hisui exhales.
That small contact between us starts to get heavier.

entries.japanese:
「ん―――――ひす、い」
　……自分でも、何をしているのかわからない。
　ただあんまりにも翡翠の吐息が気持ちよくて、自分から翡翠の唇を求めた。
「……、志貴……さ、ま……」
　ためらうように弱くなる翡翠の感触。
　それがイヤで、覆い被さってきていた翡翠の体を抱き寄せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm―――――Hisui”
I do not even know what I am doing.
Her breath feels so good that I seek her lips with my own.
“Master Shiki”
Her touch weakens with hesitation.
I cannot bear that, so I pull her body—poised above mine—down against me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn----Hisu, i"
…… I don't know what I'm doing.
It's just that her lips feel so good, so I press back with mine.
"…… Shiki…… sa--ma……"
Hisui hesitantly starts to pull back.
I don't want that and I pull her closer to me.

entries.japanese:
「ん……あ」
　離れようとする翡翠を抱き寄せて、唇を求める。
「はっ……ん、ん……！」
　息ができないのか、少しだけ翡翠は抵抗した。
「――――――は、あ」
　でも止まらない。
　翡翠の吐息。
唇。
唾液。
その全てが、気持ちいい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm, ah”
I hold Hisui as she tries to draw away and chase her lips.
“Hah, mm, mm…!”
Unable to breathe, she resists a little.
“――――――Hah, ah”
But I cannot stop.
Hisui’s breath. Her lips. Her saliva. Every part of her feels exquisite.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn…… ah."
Pulling her in, I seek out her lips.
"Ha…… n, n……!"
Hisui resists slightly as she might be having a hard time breathing.
"------Ha--ah."
But I can't stop.
Her breath.
Her lips.
Her warmth.
It all feels so good.

entries.japanese:
目を閉じたまま、翡翠の口に舌をいれる。
「ん―――ん！」
　今までとは違って、本気で離れようとする翡翠。
　それを抱きしめて押さえつけて、翡翠の舌を求めた。
「あ……ん、ん……！」
　たぶん、目を開ければ翡翠の嫌がる顔があるんだろう。
　そんなものを見てしまったら、俺はすぐに手を離してしまう。
　だから、このまま。
　何も見えないまま、ただ翡翠の舌を求めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Without opening my eyes, I push my tongue into Hisui’s mouth.
“Mmm―――!”
Now she struggles in earnest to escape.
I pin her in my arms and search for her tongue.
“Ah, mm, mm…!”
If I opened my eyes, I would probably see revulsion on her face.
One glimpse of that and I would release her at once.
So I keep them shut.
Blind to everything, I seek only Hisui’s tongue.
entries.mirrorMoon:
With my eyes still closed, I slip my tongue in between her lips.
"N--n!"
Unlike before, now she really tries to pull back.
I embrace her body to hold on to her, and I continue to seek out her tongue.

"A…… n, n……!"
If I open my eyes, I bet I'll see her distressed face.
If I saw that, I'd let her go right away.
And so, instead,
I continue blindly twirling my tongue against hers.

entries.japanese:
「ん……ぁ、ぁ……」
　唾液にまみれた舌を絡ませあう。
　自分の舌が誰かの舌に触れ合っている事だけで、感覚が狂いそうだ。
　味を確かめるため、触覚の中でもっとも鋭敏な感覚を持つ舌が、本来決して触れ合う事のない他人の舌と融けあっているという、その事実だけで理性がパンクしそうになる。
　くわえて、それが翡翠の舌だなんていったらそれこそ限界破裂だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm, ah, ah”
Our saliva-slick tongues entwine.
The mere touch of another person’s tongue against my own threatens to derange my senses.
The tongue is made to taste, the most sensitive instrument of touch we possess—and the knowledge that mine is melting against another tongue, something it should never ordinarily meet, is enough to overload my reason.
And knowing that tongue belongs to Hisui drives me clean past my limit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N…… a, a……"
Our wet tongues intertwine.
Just the sensation of my tongue against another's drives me wild.
Just the fact that my sensitive tongue is feeling someone else's tongue makes my rational thought about to explode.
And because it is Hisui's tongue, it crumbles completely away.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ……ん、ん……ぁ……」
　赤い舌の絡み合いは続く。
　唇は離れても、翡翠の舌と俺の舌はまだ融けあっている。
　それは比喩ではなく。
　俺たちの舌は、互いの唾液で、本当にドロドロに密着しあっていた。
―――そんな時間が、どのくらい続いただろうか。
　気がつけば俺の体はどくどくとたぎっていて、翡翠は衣服を正しながらベッドの脇に戻っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah, mm, mm, ah”
The tangle of red tongues continues.
Even when our lips part, Hisui’s tongue and mine remain fused.
And that is no metaphor.
Our saliva has made them cling together in a wet, viscous knot.
―――How long did we remain like that?
By the time I come to myself, my blood is surging through me, and Hisui has returned to the bedside, straightening her clothes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A…… n, n…… ah……"
The red, tangled tongues continue their dance.
Even though our lips separate, our tongues have become one.
…… This isn't just some sort of metaphor.
Our tongues are stuck together with all our saliva.

---I wonder how long that lasted?
Before I know it, my body is burning, and Hisui is at the side of the bed adjusting her clothes.

entries.japanese:
ドクン。
「あ――――っ」
　ドクン、ドクン。
「は――あ……はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……」
　ドクン、ドクン、ドクン。
「熱……体が、なんか……すごく」
　ドクン、ドクン、ドクン、ドクン。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump.
“Ah――――!”
Thump, thump.
“Hah――ah, hah, hah, hah”
Thump, thump, thump.
“Hot—my body feels incredible”
Thump, thump, thump, thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
"Ah----"
Thump.
Thump.

I'm out of breath.
Thump, Thump, Thump.
"My…… body… it feels incredibly…… warm."
My heart races uncontrollably.

entries.japanese:
……翡翠は恥ずかしそうにうつむいたままだ。
　俺には―――よく、今の行為の正体が、わからない。
「……翡翠……今の、どうして―――」
　どうして、俺なんかにキスをしたのか。
　どうして、キスをしただけで、薬以上に体が元気になっているのか。
　その正体が、まるっきり解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui keeps her head lowered in embarrassment.
I―――do not understand what just happened.
“Hisui, why did you do that―――”
Why did she kiss someone like me?
Why has a kiss restored me more powerfully than any medicine?
I understand none of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Hisui stands by the side of the bed, averting her gaze in embarrassment.
I----don't exactly know why she did that.
"…… Hisui…… just now, why--"
Why did she kiss me?
Why did nothing more than a kiss heal me better than any medicine?
I don't understand any of it.

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
その、今のが志貴さまを助ける方法なんです」
「俺を助けるって―――だから、どうして」
「どうしてといわれると困ります。
ただ、わたしと姉さんは、体を重ねた人に力を分け与える事ができるんです。
　……その、体液の交換をすれば、その人を自分と同じモノと認識できるようになって、自分の力を分け与えたり、その人の力を増幅させる事ができるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. That was the way to save Master Shiki.”
“Save me―――but how?”
“I cannot explain why. My sister and I can share our strength with someone we join our bodies with.
By exchanging bodily fluids, we come to recognize that person as part of ourselves and can then give them our strength or amplify their own.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That is the way I can help you, Shiki-sama."
"Help me---but, how?"
"I really don't know how.
It is just that Nee-san and I can transmit some of our energy to those that we press our bodies against.
…… Um, if we exchange bodily fluids, we are able to recognize that person as someone like us, and it lets us share our energy and amplify their powers."

entries.japanese:
「な―――なに、それ」
「わたしと姉さんは生まれついて、そういう特別な体質をしています。
遠野の血筋とは別で、普通の人間から生まれる特異な能力者。
槙久さまは『感応者』と呼んでいました」
――――あ。
　その単語は、たしかに、親父の手記にあったようななかったような。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――what does that mean?”
“My sister and I were born with this unusual constitution. It is a rare ability found among ordinary humans, entirely separate from the Tohno bloodline. Master Makihisa called people like us resonators.”
――――Ah.
I may—or may not—have seen that word in Father’s journals.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha--what are you talking about?"
"Ever since we were born, we have had special bodies.
We are not like the Tohno family, but we are special people born from normal people.
Makihisa-sama called us 'Synchronizers'."
----Ah.
I think that word was in the old man's journal.

entries.japanese:
「槙久さまは、年々比重をましていく『遠野よりの自分』を抑制するためにわたしたちを引き取ったのです。
わたしたちは力を分け与える事より、その人本人の力を強くする事のほうが向いていますから。
　……槙久さまは、遠野よりの自分ではなく人間よりの自分に姉さんを感応させて、かろうじて人間としての自我を保っていたんです」
「……………」
　いや、そんな事、俺に言わなくてもいいんだけど……つまりその、体液の交換っていうと、今のは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Makihisa took us in to restrain the Tohno side of himself, which grew stronger every year. We are better at strengthening what already exists within a person than at giving away our own power.
Master Makihisa had my sister resonate with his human side rather than his Tohno side, and in that way he barely preserved his human identity.”
“…”
I could have done without knowing that, but if this requires an exchange of bodily fluids, then what we just did was―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Makihisa-sama brought us here to suppress his increasing 'Tohno self'.
We are more suited for amplifying one's power rather than sharing our power.
…… Makihisa-sama synchronized with Nee-san with his human side, and barely stayed sane."
"……………"
No, she doesn't have to tell me all this…… but by "The exchange of bodily fluids", it must mean---

entries.japanese:
「……よくわからないけど、翡翠の体っていうのは、俺にとって薬みたいなものなの……？」
「はい。
本来の志貴さまなら何の意味もないでしょうけど、今の志貴さまの体力は低下していますから。
わたし程度の力を分けるだけで、なんとか人並みの生命力を維持できると思います」
「――――そっか。
だからこんなに元気になってるんだ、俺」
　ぐっ、と両手を握ってみる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I still do not understand—does that mean your body is like medicine to me?”
“Yes. It would do nothing for Master Shiki under ordinary circumstances, but Master Shiki’s strength is badly depleted. Even the little power I can share should be enough to sustain the life force of an ordinary person.”
“――――I see. So that is why I feel so much better.”
I clench both hands into fists.
entries.mirrorMoon:
" …… I don't understand completely, but your body… it's sort of like a medicine or something……?"
"Yes.
Normally, it would not have much of an effect, but now your energy is very low.
I believe you will be able to at least return to your normal state even with my powers."
"----I see.
That's why I feel so good right now."
I squeeze my hands.

entries.japanese:
「……動く。
うん、ちゃんと動く……！」
　まだ体の節々は鈍いけど、それでも自分の意思で体を動かす事ができる。
　なんだかそんな当たり前の事が、今はとんでもなく嬉しい。
「あ、ありがとう翡翠！
　おかげで元の体力に戻れたみたいだ！」
　やったー、とばかりに腕をあげる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“They move. Yes, they really move…!”
My joints are still heavy, but my body obeys me again.
Something so commonplace makes me absurdly happy.
“Thank you, Hisui! I feel as strong as I did before!”
I fling my arms into the air in triumph.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Moving.
Yeah, I can move……!"
My joints are a little stiff, but I can move my body with my own will.
Being able to do such a simple thing makes me so happy right now.
"Th, thank you Hisui!
It looks like my body is back to normal, thanks to you!"
I throw my arms up in the air.

entries.japanese:
けど、翡翠はまだうかない顔をしたままだった。
　……思い返してみれば。
　いくら翡翠の吐息が気持ち良かったからって、あんなに強引に、嫌がる翡翠を無視してキスを続けてしまったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui, however, still looks troubled. And now that I think back on it…
no matter how intoxicating her breath felt, I forced that kiss to continue even after she tried to pull away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, Hisui still looks uneasy.
…… As I think back.
Her breath felt so good, I forced Hisui to continue kissing me.

entries.japanese:
「あ……その、ごめん。
翡翠の息が、すごく気持ちよくて、つい―――」
「いえ、先ほどの事は、あれでよかったんです。
……その、わたしだけでは体液の交換はできなかったでしょうから」
　恥ずかしそうに俺を見つめてくる翡翠。
「ですが志貴さま。
その、今のは応急処置のようなもので、それではすぐに志貴さまは元に戻ってしまわれます」
「な――――そ、そうなのか？
　せっかく元通りになれたのに、またさっきみたいになるっていうのは―――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am sorry. Your breath felt so good that I lost control―――”
“No. What happened was necessary, because I doubt I could have managed the exchange of bodily fluids on my own.”
Hisui looks at me, her face still flushed.
“But, Master Shiki. What we just did was only an emergency measure, so Master Shiki will soon relapse.”
“Wha――――seriously? After finally getting back to normal, I have to become like that again―――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… I'm, sorry.
Your breath, it… felt so good, so I--"
"No, what happened before was a good thing…… Um, I don't think I would have been able to transfer any fluids by myself."
Hisui looks at me, embarrassed.
"But, Shiki-sama, this is a temporary treatment.
You will return to your original state soon."
"Wha----for real?
My previous state---you mean back to the way I was?"

entries.japanese:
そんなのはお断りだ。
　こうして動けるようになって、ようやく解った。
　さっきまでの自分、ここ数日の自分は本当に異状だった。
　こうして動けるようになった今、またあんな体が動かない、なんていう状況に戻されるなんてゾッとする。
「……どうしよう。
俺は、もう二度とあんなのはゴメンだ。
あんなふうに糸の切れた人形みたいになって、また頭痛に襲われたら、今度こそ―――」
　この体が停止する前に、心のほうが壊れてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I refuse.
Only now that I can move again do I understand.
My condition before, and for the past few days, was truly abnormal.
Now that I can move, the thought of returning to a body that will not obey me is horrifying.
“What am I supposed to do? I can never go through that again. If I become a puppet with its strings cut and those headaches return, then this time―――”
My mind will break before my body stops.
entries.mirrorMoon:
No.
Anything but that.
Being able to move like this again, I finally understand.
These past few days, my body has been terribly wrong.
So now, since I can move again, thinking about my body going back to the way it was sends shivers down my spine.
"…… What should I do?
I don't ever want to go through that again.
Being like a puppet with its strings cut, my head feeling like it's being split open… This time---"
Before my body would stop, I think my mind would break first.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま。
わたしも、二度と志貴さまにあのようなお体になってほしくありません。
　ですから……その、もう少し深く、志貴さまのお体を分けていただけないでしょうか」
　ためらいがちに、重ねた指先を震わせながら、翡翠はまっすぐに俺を見つめてきた。
――――どくん、と心臓が跳ねあがる。
　もう少し深く分け合う、という事は。
　その、お互いの体液を分け合うっていう事なんだから、それって――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. I never want Master Shiki reduced to that condition again.
So, would you please share Master Shiki’s body with me more deeply?”
Her interlaced fingers trembling, Hisui raises her eyes and looks straight at me.
――――My heart leaps against my ribs.
To share ourselves more deeply would mean exchanging more of our bodily fluids.
Since that means sharing our bodily fluids, it would mean――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
I do not want you to have to return to the way you were before either.
Therefore…… can you… share your body with me a little deeper this time?"
With her fingers trembling, she says this while looking directly at me.
----My heart skips a beat.
Sharing our bodies deeper means…
Um, it means exchanging our bodily fluids, so that would mean----

entries.japanese:
「――――それは、その―――――」
　翡翠は黙っている。
　こういう事はやっぱり俺のほうから口にしないと、いけないんだろうか。
「―――つまり、翡翠を抱くっていう、こと？」
　翡翠は無言のまま、こくん、と頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――That would be―――――”
Hisui says nothing.
Am I the one who has to put it into words?
“―――You mean I would sleep with you?”
Without a word, Hisui gives a tiny nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's, um--"
Hisui remains silent.
…… Should I be the one to say it?
"---In other words, I have to make love to you?"
Hisui nods wordlessly.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　カア、と顔が赤くなる。
　それ、それは嬉しいけど、でも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――”
My face burns red.
It makes me happy, but―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
My face instantly flushes crimson.
The very thought makes me happy, but---

entries.japanese:
「―――まずい。
それはまずい。
そんなの願ったりかなったりだけど、それはまずい。
そんな、俺を助けるために翡翠が体を投げ出す、なんていうのは、間違ってる……！」
　ぶんぶん、と手をふって翡翠の提案をつっぱねる。
「………………」
　翡翠は黙ったままだ。
　なんか、断られてホッとしているっていうより、俺の言い分に傷ついているような、そんな弱々しさ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――No. That is no good. It is everything I could wish for, but it is still wrong. You cannot offer me your body just to save my life…!”
I wave both hands frantically, rejecting her proposal.
“…”
Hisui remains silent.
Rather than relieved by my refusal, she looks small and wounded, as though my reasoning has hurt her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No, that's bad.
I can't go back to the way I was, but that's bad.
Using you like that to make me better, that's just wrong…!"
I emphatically refuse her offer.
"……………"
Hisui is still silent.
It seems more like she's hurt by my words instead of being relieved by my refusal.

entries.japanese:
「いや、翡翠がイヤだっていうんじゃなくて……！
　だっておかしいだろ、俺を助けるためかもしれないけど、そんな事のためにじ、自分の体を投げ出すなんて、どうかしてるじゃないか！」
「……どうかしているのは志貴さまです。
志貴さまがお嫌なのは解りました。
　ですが、今わたしと契らないと志貴さまは今夜にでも死んでしまわれます。
なのにどうして、そのような事が言えるのですか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is not that I do not want you…! But even if it would save me, offering your own body for something like that is insane!”
“Master Shiki is the one being unreasonable. I understand that Master Shiki does not want me.
But unless you join with me now, Master Shiki may die tonight. How can you still say such things?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, it's not that I don't want you……!
It's just strange.
It might help me, but to use your body like that, it's wrong."
"…… There is only something wrong with you, Shiki-sama.
I understand that you do not want me.
But if I do not do this, you will die tonight.
So how can you say such things like that?"

entries.japanese:
「あ―――いや、それは」
　……そうだ。
　だから翡翠も、こんな馬鹿げた事を提案してきてくれるんだ。
　……異性の体に触れるのさえ嫌がる翡翠が、その、自分を抱けとまで言うのは、ひとえに俺の命がかかっているからだ。
　だから―――俺なんかのために、そんな事を言ってくれる。
　俺の事が好きだとか嫌いだとか、そんな事は関係なしで、自分を抱いていいと言っている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――no, that is not it”
Of course.
That is why Hisui has made such an absurd proposal.
Hisui, who cannot bear even an innocent touch from a man, is offering herself because my life depends on it.
That is why―――she is willing to say such a thing for someone like me.
Whether she loves or hates me has nothing to do with it; she is saying I may take her body anyway―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---no, that is--"
…… Right.
That's why Hisui is suggesting this preposterous "plan".
…… Hisui, who can't even stand contact with the opposite gender, is suggesting this because my life is at stake.
So---she says all that for my sake.
She's saying I can sleep with her, with like or dislike having nothing to do with it---

entries.japanese:
「く――――――」
　ならそれでいいじゃないか。
　俺だって死にたくない。
　翡翠の体を抱くだけで助かるなら、それを嫌がるなんてどうかしてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Gh――――――”
Then why not accept?
I do not want to die.
If sleeping with Hisui will save me, refusing her would be madness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Da----"
Isn't it okay?
I don't want to die either.
I mean, all I have to do is sleep with her, and if I don't like that, then there really is something wrong with me.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ」
　翡翠はじっと俺を見つめている。
　その指先が震えているのも変わらない。
　不安なのは―――俺なんかより、彼女のほうだ。
　それでもそれを隠して、普段通り振る舞ってくれている。
　そこまでされているのに、どうして―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Hisui gazes at me.
Her fingertips are still trembling.
She―――not I, is the one who is afraid.
Even so, she hides it and acts as she always does.
After all she has done for me, how can I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Hisui watches me quietly.
Her fingers are still shaking.
As uneasy as I am---she is still far more uneasy.
But she hides it, and tries to act normally.
She is doing so much for me, so why---

entries.japanese:
「翡翠――――きみは、それでいいのか」
「……はい。
志貴さまのお役にたてるのでしたら、わたしはそれで満足です」
「―――違う！
　そうじゃなくて、その―――」
　好きでもない相手に、自分の体を預けて本当にいいのか。
　俺は、嫌だ。
　翡翠のことは抱きたい。
　翡翠を愛しいと思うし、翡翠のためになる事をしたいって思ってる。
　けど、それとこれは別問題だ。
　俺は、ようするに。
翡翠が、俺の事を愛しているのかどうか解らないから、彼女を抱くのを嫌がっているだけなんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Is this truly what you want, Hisui?”
“Yes. If I can be of use to Master Shiki, that is enough for me.”
“―――No! That is not what I mean―――”
Can she truly give herself to someone she does not love?
I cannot accept that.
That is not the point.
I want to hear Hisui say that she loves me.
If she could, I would accept her without another thought.
The truth is simple. I am resisting because I do not know whether she loves me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui----is this… alright with you?"
"…… Yes.
If I can be useful to you, then I will be satisfied."
"---No!
That's not what I meant, um---"
Is she really okay with giving her body to someone she does not love?
I… don't like it.
I want to sleep with her.
I think I love her, and I want to do things for her sake.
But those are two different things.
Simply put, I don't want to sleep with her because I don't know if Hisui loves me or not.

entries.japanese:
「―――いいのか、翡翠。
こんな事で俺に体を預けて、後悔しないのか」
「……わかりません。
ですが一つだけお願いがあります」
「お願い……？」
「はい。
志貴さまが少しでもわたしの事を好きでいてくださるのなら、今だけはそれを一番にしてください。
今だけでもわたしを愛してくださるのでしたら、わたしは―――何も、後悔なんてしませんから」
　……震える指先で、翡翠はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Are you certain, Hisui? If you give yourself to me for this, will you regret it afterward?”
“I do not know. But I have one request.”
“A request…?”
“Yes. If Master Shiki cares for me even a little, then for now, put that feeling before everything else. If Master Shiki can love me, even if only for now, then I―――will have no regrets.”
Hisui speaks with trembling fingers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Is it okay, Hisui?
Giving out your body like that, won't you regret it later?"
"…… I do not know.
But I just have one request to ask of you."
"Request……?"
"Yes.
Shiki-sama, if you were to like me even just a little bit, just for now---please, think only of that.
If you are to love me just for now---I would never regret this."
…… Hisui speaks, still trembling.

entries.japanese:
「―――――っ」
　……バカだ。
今ほど、自分がどうしようもなく愚かだって痛感した事は、ない。
「―――翡翠。
俺は」
　……なにが翡翠が愛していてくれないのなら嫌、だ。
そんな事、本当に―――俺には言う資格なんて、なかった。
「―――来てくれ。
今は、きみが必要だ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
I am an idiot. Never in my life have I felt so painfully, hopelessly foolish.
“―――Hisui. I”
What right did I have to demand her love? I truly―――had no such right.
“―――Come here. Right now, I need you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
…… I'm stupid.
I've never felt more stupid than I do right now.
"--Hisui.
I"
…… What do I mean by "I don't want to if Hisui doesn't love me"?
Really---I don't deserve to say that.
"---Come here.
Right now, I really need you."

entries.japanese:
……翡翠がよりそってくる。
　その腕を掴んで、自分のもとに引き寄せる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui comes close.
I take her hand and draw her to the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Hisui draws closer.
Reaching out my arms, I draw her towards me.

entries.japanese:
「―――でも間違わないでくれ。
俺はこんな体じゃなくったって、翡翠のことを一番―――いつだって欲しいって思ってた」
　そのまま。
　翡翠の体をベッドに倒して、その体に、指を這わせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――But do not misunderstand me. Even if my body were well, you would still be the one I―――always wanted most.”
Like that.
I lower Hisui onto the bed and let my fingers travel over her body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But don't get me wrong.
Even without my condition, I've always---wanted you the most for all this time."
Then.
Bringing her down to the bed, I run my fingers across her body.

entries.japanese:
しゅる、と音をたてて胸のリボンをほどく。
「あ……」
　震えるような翡翠の声。
　聞こえないふりをして、背中のエプロンの帯もほどいてしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The ribbon at her breast whispers loose beneath my fingers.
“Ah…”
Hisui’s voice trembles.
Pretending not to hear it, I untie the sash of her apron as well.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I untie her ribbon and it swishes downwards.
"Ah……"
Hisui's voice quivers.
I pretend I didn't hear her, and I untie the belt of her apron behind her back.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、あの……」
　翡翠はよく解っていないような目で、不安そうに俺を見つめてくる。
「翡翠は、初めて……？」
「あ……はい、申し訳、ありません」
　消え入りそうな声と、真っ赤に染まった頬。
　小刻みに震える体は、自身の恐れを逃がすように、懸命にシーツを握り締めている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I…”
Hisui looks up at me anxiously, her eyes uncertain, as though she does not quite understand.
