　何度も何度も突き上げたせいか、翡翠のなかは溶鉱炉のように熱い。
　いや、それとも。
　熱いのは充血し、膨張して、凝固した俺の生殖器のほうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, mm, ngh, ah―――! Hah, yes, ah, it hurts, it hurts―――Master Shiki, please…!”
Her body burns.
After so many upward thrusts, Hisui’s depths are hot as a furnace.
Or perhaps.
The heat comes from my engorged, swollen, rigid sex.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha, n, nn, ah---!
Haa, it, hwa, it hurts---Shiki-sama, please…………!!!!"
Her body is on fire.
It feels like I am inside an oven.
Or, is it.
Is it my own column of flesh, swollen with blood that is on fire?

entries.japanese:
―――はぁ　はぁ　はぁ　はぁ
「あ、は―――志貴さま、わたし―――！」
　涙を流しながら、それでも逆らわずに体を預けてくる翡翠。
　その手触り。
体温。
声。
涙。
全て。
愛おしい。
「翡翠―――俺の、翡翠―――！」
　一際強く突き上げる。
　ど、く、という心音。
「愛している―――誰よりも、翡翠だけをを愛している……！」
　臆面もなく、つまらない言葉を口にして。
　自分の感情を叩きつけるように、男根を突き入れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Hah hah hah hah
“Ah, hah―――Master Shiki, I―――!”
Tears streaming down her face, Hisui still offers herself without resistance.
That touch. That warmth. Her voice. Her tears. All of it. Dear to me.
“Hisui―――my Hisui―――!”
I thrust upward harder.
A heavy heartbeat.
“I love you―――more than anyone, I love only you…!”
I blurt out the trite confession without shame.
I drive into her as though hammering my feelings into her body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*
"Ah, ha--Shiki-sama, I--!"
Even though her eyes are flooding with tears, she still brings down her body onto me once more.
Her feeling.
Her warmth.
Her voice.
Tears.
All of it.
All of it is precious.
"Hisui---my, Hisui--!"
I penetrate again with all my strength.
My heart pounds wildly.
"I love you---more than anyone, more than anything, I love only you, Hisui……!"
Not thinking, I let loose these words.
Baring all of my feelings, I thrust into her passionately.

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――あ、あ――――！」
　痙攣する翡翠の体。
　それが、刻々と、頂点にさしかかっていく、気配。
「わたし、わたしも……！」
　はぁ　はぁ　はぁ　はぁ
「あ―――志貴さま、わたし、も―――志貴さまを、ずっと……！」
　翡翠の体が強ばる。
　男根の根元に溜まったモノが弾ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――ah, ah――――!”
Hisui’s body convulses.
She draws closer to her peak with every passing instant.
“I, I do too…!”
Hah hah hah hah
“Ah―――Master Shiki, I too―――have always loved Master Shiki…!”
Hisui’s body locks rigid.
The pressure gathered at my base bursts.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--ah, ah----!"
Her spasming body.
I feel the climax of all these emotions, all these sensations coming.
"Me, me too……!"
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*
"Ah---Shiki-sama, I love you too---Shiki-sama, always……!"
Her body tenses.
All the love within me gathers up.

entries.japanese:
はぁ　はぁ　はぁ　はぁ……！
「翡翠――――！」
「あっ―――はい、志貴、さま………！」
　昂ぶったお互いの感情に合わせるように。
　俺の迸りと、翡翠の絶頂は、同時だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hah hah hah hah…!
“Hisui――――!”
“Ah―――yes, Master Shiki…!”
As though answering the emotions surging through us both.
My release and Hisui’s climax come at the same instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*……!
"Hisui----!"
"Ah---yes, Shiki, sama………!"
Our emotions fuse together.
We climax together.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――ひす、い――――っ！」
　どく、どく、と撃ち出される、モノ。
「ぁ……は、っんく――――！」
　ぶるぶると震える翡翠の体を抱きしめる。
「ぁ―――――あ」
　自分のなかに叩きつけられるモノの熱さを堪える翡翠。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm―――Hisui――――!”
Pulse after pulse fires from me.
“Ah, hah, ngh――――!”
I embrace Hisui’s violently trembling body.
“Ah―――――ah”
She endures the heat being driven into her depths.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Hisu, i----!"
I release inside of her.
"Ah…… ha, n----!"
I embrace her shaking body close to mine.
"Ah------ah."
Hisui endures the heat flowing into her.

entries.japanese:
「ん――――あ」
　翡翠の声は低い。
　俺の指が翡翠の口の自由を奪っているせいだろう。
　どくん、どくん、という心音は、俺と翡翠のものだ。
　翡翠は絶頂を迎えたあとの余韻を、体を震わせて耐えている。
　それを和らげてやりたくて、ただ翡翠の体を抱きしめる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm――――ah”
Hisui’s voice is low.
Perhaps my finger is still denying her mouth its freedom.
The pounding I hear belongs to both our hearts.
She trembles through the aftershocks of her climax.
I can do nothing but hold her, hoping to ease them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nn----ah."
Her voice lowers.
Probably because my finger is in her mouth.
Our heartbeats harmonize and pulse together.
She still shakes from the lingering sensations inside of her.
I want to ease that, and hold on to her.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴、さま……」
　なんの涙だろう。
　つう、と翡翠の瞳から、涙がこぼれていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki”
What kind of tears are these?
One slips slowly from Hisui’s eye.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki, sama……"
Why is she crying?
From her eyes the tears keep falling.

entries.japanese:
「わたし……こんな」
　震えている声は、何かを後悔するような響きがある。
「……どうしたんだ翡翠。
……その、痛かったとか……？」
「……違うんです……こんな幸せ、恐くて」
　はぁ、と大きく息をはいて、翡翠の震えが止まる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I, something like this”
Her trembling voice sounds almost regretful.
“What is it, Hisui? Did it hurt?”
“No, I am frightened because I am so happy”
She releases a long breath, and the trembling stops.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I…… this…"
It seems her wavering voice contains some regret.
"…… What, Hisui?
…… Did it hurt……?"
"…… No…… I am scared, of this happiness."
Taking a deep breath, her shaking stops.

entries.japanese:
「あ……」
　翡翠の体から力が抜ける。
　力尽きたのか、ぐったりと俺に体を預けてくる翡翠。
「……ごめんなさい……姉、さん」
　そう残して、翡翠はまぶたを閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah”
All strength leaves Hisui’s body.
Utterly spent, she sags against me.
“I am sorry, Sister”
With those last words, Hisui closes her eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……"
The strength drains from her body.
Exhausted, she leans her whole body onto me.
"…… I'm so sorry…… Nee-san."
With that last remark, she collapses and closes her eyes.

entries.japanese:
耳をすませると、すーすーと静かな寝息をたてている。
「……眠ったのか、翡翠」
　翡翠をベッドに寝かして、シーツをかぶせる。
　力尽きてしまった翡翠とは対照的に、俺のほうはまだ元気がある。
　……いや、体は疲れきっているけど、翡翠を抱く前まであった不自由さはなくなっている。
　これで、とりあえず今晩は、俺は人並みの体に戻れた、という事だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
When I listen closely, I can hear her soft, even breathing.
“Fallen asleep, Hisui?”
I lay her on the bed and draw the sheet over her.
Hisui is utterly spent, but I still have strength to spare.
My body is exhausted, certainly, yet the crippling weakness I felt before I held her is gone.
For tonight, at least, I seem to have a normal human body again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of gentle breathing reaches my ears.
"…… Are you sleeping, Hisui?"
Placing her on the bed, I pull the sheets over her.
Unlike Hisui, who's exhausted, I still have a lot of energy.
…… No, even though I am tired, the condition I had before is totally gone.
So, it seems for tonight, I can move like a normal person once again.

entries.japanese:
……翡翠はベッドで眠っている。
　俺の体に力を分けたせいで、翡翠も疲れきってしまったのだろう。
「……それとも、やっぱり無理させすぎちゃったのかな、俺」
　ぽりぽりと鼻をかきながら、少し反省する。
　……翡翠は初めてだったのに、さっきのは本当にやりすぎた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui is asleep on the bed.
Perhaps sharing her strength with me has drained her too.
“Or maybe I just pushed her too hard…”
I scratch my nose, feeling a little ashamed.
It was Hisui’s first time, and what I did really was too much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Hisui sleeps in my bed.
It might be because she helped me regain my strength, but Hisui is absolutely exhausted.
"…… Or maybe, I pushed her too hard."
I feel a tinge of regret.
…… All of this was her first time, so that was really too much for her.

entries.japanese:
「……でも、翡翠が可愛すぎるんだから仕方ないじゃないか」
　なんて言い訳をしてもそれこそ仕方がない。
　翡翠は安らかな寝息をたてて眠っている。
　……行動を起こすとしたら、今しかない。
「……ごめんな。
もう少し眠っててくれ、翡翠」
　翡翠の髪を軽くすいてから、着替えて部屋から外に出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Still, it’s not my fault she’s so adorable.”
An excuse that excuses nothing.
Hisui sleeps on, breathing peacefully.
If I mean to act, this is my only chance.
“Sorry. Sleep a little longer, Hisui.”
I run my fingers lightly through her hair, dress, and leave the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But she is just so cute, I couldn't help it."
I make up an excuse, but it can't be helped.
Hisui sleeps, taking relaxed breaths.
…… If I'm going to take action, it has to be now.
"…… Sorry.
Sleep just a little longer, Hisui."
After running my hand through her hair one last time, I change my clothes and leave the room.

entries.japanese:
―――そういえば秋葉も琥珀さんもいないんだっけ。
　ちょうどいい機会だ。
　今のうちに俺の事、八年前の事故の事をハッキリと調べてやる。
　親父の部屋に入る。
　……ここになら、俺の疑問に答えてくれる何かがあるはずだ。
「……机の引き出し……には、もう何もないかな」
　鍵がかかっている引き出しになら親父にとってプライベートなものがまだ残っているかもしれない。
　けど、そんな所にあるものに、重要な記録を記したものがあるとは思えない。
「……金庫か何かあればいいんだけど」
　部屋中を探す。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Come to think of it, neither Akiha nor Kohaku is here.
Perfect.
While I have the chance, I’ll find out the truth about myself—and about the accident eight years ago.
I enter my father’s room.
If anything in this house can answer my questions, it has to be here.
“Nothing left in the desk drawers, I suppose”
The locked drawers might still hold something private to Father.
But I doubt he would have kept any truly important records there.
“If only there were a safe or something.”
I search the room from end to end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's right.
Akiha and Kohaku-san aren't here.
This is a good opportunity.
I can do some investigating into what happened eight years ago.
I enter the old man's room.
…… This place should definitely have something to answer my questions.
"…… The desk drawer…… it's empty now."
There might be something that belongs to the old man in one of the locked drawers.
But I don't think he'll keep something that important there.
"…… It'd be great if he had a safe or something."
I search the room.

entries.japanese:
「…………あった」
　金庫らしきものなら、わりあい簡単に見付かった。
　鍵もないし、ダイヤルもわからない。
　だからメガネを外して、金庫に見える『線』を切った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Found one”
The safe is surprisingly easy to locate.
There is no key, and I do not know the combination.
So I take off my glasses and cut the ‘line’ I see on the safe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Here it is."
I find something like a safe pretty easily.
There's no external lock and I don't know the dial combination.
So I take off my glasses, and I cut its "line".

entries.japanese:
「……ん……」
　中には古びた日記帳と、便箋らしきものがあるだけだった。
　日記帳は子供用のもので、もう一つは誰かにあてた手紙の原文らしい。
「……手紙の原文って、どうして」
　筆跡は間違いなく親父のものだ。
　内容はひどく断片的で、一見してなんの事だかわからない。
―――日付は、八年前の夏の日から始まって、その後は少しずつ月日が経過しているようだ。

「…………」
　意味がわからないまでも、とりあえず目を通してみることにする。

〇月〇日。
　息子のシキが遠野の血に傾斜する。
　シキ、その場に居あわせた養子を殺害。
（養子は七夜の跡取り息子である。
琥珀、翡翠といった感応者の一族ではないのは不幸中の幸いだった）
　シキは反転が酷い。
よって処罰するしかないと判断した。
遠野の当主の役割といえ、我が子を殺すのは辛い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hmm”
Inside lie only an old diary and several sheets of writing paper.
The diary is made for a child; the other document appears to be the draft of a letter.
“Why would he keep a draft?”
The handwriting is unquestionably my father’s.
The contents are so fragmentary that I can make no sense of them at first glance.
―――The dates begin on a summer day eight years ago, then advance gradually through the months and years.
“…”
Meaningless or not, I decide to read it through.
Month X, Day X.
My son SHIKI has succumbed to the Tohno blood.
SHIKI killed the adopted child who happened to be present.
(It was a small mercy that the boy was heir to the Nanaya rather than a member of a family of resonators like Kohaku and Hisui.)
SHIKI’s Inversion is severe. I have therefore concluded that he must be put down. It is the duty of the Tohno family head, but killing my own child is bitter work.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hmm……"
There seems to be an old diary and some envelopes.
The diary looks like that of a child's and the other looks like some old letters.
"…… Old letters?
Why?"
The handwriting is definitely my old man's.
It's fragmented and I can't understand it at first glance.
---The date starts in the summer of eight years ago and seems to continue on a little past that.

"…………"
I don't understand it yet, but I continue leafing through it.

~ Month ~ Day
My son SHIKI succumbed to his Tohno blood.
SHIKI, he killed my adopted son who happened to be there.
(The adopted son is the heir of the house Nanaya. I guess it is a blessing in all the unfortunate events that he isn't in the same family as the Synchronizers, like Kohaku and Hisui.)
SHIKI's inversion impulse is terrible.
So it was determined that he must be eliminated.
I have my duty as the head of the Tohno household, but killing my own son is so difficult.

entries.japanese:
遠野の血は、アキハよりシキのほうが濃い。
　潜在的なレヴェルではアキハにより旧い起源を感じるが、血の濃さではシキが上回っていた。
　そのために、シキは成人する前に反転してしまったのだろう。
　シキの能力は『不死』と『共融』である。
　シキは蘇った自己の能力を持て余し、結果として近くにいた七夜の養子を殺害し、その命を奪い取った。
　初めての能力行使にしては素晴らしいと言わざるをえまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
The Tohno blood runs more strongly in SHIKI than in Akiha.
On a latent level I sense an older Origin in Akiha, but SHIKI’s blood is the more concentrated.
That must be why he underwent Inversion before reaching adulthood.
SHIKI possesses ‘immortality’ and ‘coalescence.’
Unable to control the powers that awakened when he revived, he killed the nearby Nanaya adoptee and took the boy’s life for himself.
For a first exercise of his abilities, the result was undeniably impressive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The Tohno blood, more in SHIKI than in AKIHA.
Talking about potential, I feel an older origin in Akiha's blood, but SHIKI's Tohno blood runs much stronger.
I assume that is why SHIKI inverted before he became an adult.
SHIKI's powers are "immortality" and "fusion".
SHIKI could not manage the awakened powers and as a result, killed the adopted Nanaya child, taking his life.
I have to say it was a superb job for using his powers for the first time.

entries.japanese:
〇月×日
　シキ、養子、ともに一命を取りとめる。
　シキは私に殺される前に養子を殺害して『生命力』を奪っており、その余命で蘇生したようだ。
シキは臨死していたためか、反転していた理性も多少は戻ってくれた。
　よって、危険ではあるが処罰するのを止め、遠野の屋敷から一時的に隔離する事にしたい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Month X, Day X
Both SHIKI and the adopted child have survived.
Before I killed him, SHIKI had already taken the boy’s life force and appears to have used the boy’s remaining years to resurrect himself.
Perhaps because he came so near death, some measure of reason has returned from his Inversion.
Though he remains dangerous, I will stay his punishment and isolate him from the Tohno mansion for the present.
entries.mirrorMoon:
~ Month x Day
Both SHIKI and the adopted son managed to escape death.
Before I killed SHIKI, he killed the adopted son and stole his "life", regenerating himself with it.
I don't know if it is because he was so close to death, but SHIKI has regained some of his sanity.
Even though it is dangerous, I will not kill him but simply separate him from the mansion for a while.

entries.japanese:
七夜の養子のほうは、命をとりとめたといっても長くは持つまい。
　仮に回復したとしても、シキに命を奪われている身である。
いつ頓死してもおかしくない体だ。
　養子は生きているかぎりシキと意識が同調してしまう可能性がある。
シキと命を共有するが故の副作用だろう。
だが、そうなってしまえばいずれ養子は衰弱死する。
問題はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
As for the Nanaya adoptee, survival does not mean he has long to live.
Even if he recovers, SHIKI has already taken his life. His body may fail without warning.
While the boy lives, his consciousness may synchronize with SHIKI’s. This is presumably a side effect of their shared life. Should that occur, the adopted child will eventually waste away and die. It presents no difficulty.
entries.mirrorMoon:
On the other hand, the adopted child of Nanaya will not live long even if he does survive.
Even if he does heal, his life has been taken by SHIKI.
His body can die any day.
As long as the adopted child lives, there is a possibility that his mind will be attuned with SHIKI's.
It seems it is a side effect of their two lives being linked.
But if that happens, the adopted son will die eventually, so there is no problem there.

entries.japanese:
〇月〇日
　社会的な処理が残る。
　シキは七夜の養子を殺害してしまった。
　事実は隠蔽したが、シキは表に出せる状態ではない。
まだ私につけられた傷も癒えていないし、姿カタチも変貌してしまっている。
　とても遠野シキとして人前に出せる状態……人間として表現できる生命ではない。
　七夜の養子はまだ生きている。
　アレが存命している間、まだ役にたってもらう事にした。
　反対意見があるのなら返答を願う。
entries.maoEnglish:
Month X, Day X
The public account remains to be settled.
SHIKI killed the Nanaya adoptee.
The facts have been concealed, but SHIKI cannot appear in public. The wounds I inflicted have yet to heal, and his very form has changed.
He can no longer be presented as SHIKI Tohno—or even described as a human life.
The Nanaya adoptee remains alive.
As long as that thing survives, I intend to put it to use.
If there are objections, I request a reply.
entries.mirrorMoon:
~ Month ~ Day
The problem of maintaining appearances to normal society still remains.
SHIKI has killed the adopted Nanaya child.
I have covered up the incident, but SHIKI cannot be shown to the public.
The wound I gave him hasn't healed and his figure has transformed.
He is not in a condition to be brought in front of others as Tohno SHIKI…… he cannot be called a human either.
The Nanaya child still lives.
As long as he lives, I've decided to use him.
If there are any disagreements, I would like to hear them.

entries.japanese:
補足。
　七夜の血筋は、ある種殺人鬼を輩出する一族である。
　もしあの養子が生き残ってしまった場合、命を共有して繋がっているシキに悪影響を及ぼすだろう。
　せっかく理性を取り戻したシキが、七夜の養子に引きずられて『殺人鬼』になってしまう可能性も否定できない。
　そのような事態が起きないよう、養子は目の届く範囲で飼わなければならない。
だが遠野の屋敷に近づける事も許されない。
　管理に適切な分家筋を選んでほしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Addendum.
The Nanaya bloodline produces a particular breed of killer.
If the adopted child survives, his bond of shared life may exert a harmful influence upon SHIKI.
SHIKI has only just regained his reason; we cannot dismiss the possibility that the Nanaya boy will drag him into becoming a “murderer.”
To prevent that outcome, the adopted child must be kept on a short leash and under observation. He must not, however, be allowed anywhere near the Tohno mansion.
Select a suitable branch family to manage him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Complementarity.
The Nanayas are a family that produces killers.
If that adopted son happens to stay alive, the link between him and SHIKI may corrupt SHIKI's mind.
Even if SHIKI regains his sanity, I cannot deny the possibility of the Nanaya child's influence turning him into a killer.
To not let this happen, we must have him somewhere where we can keep an eye on him.
But we cannot allow him near the Tohno mansion either.
I should have him raised by an appropriate branch of the family.

entries.japanese:
〇月×日。
　……遠野の血に目覚めてしまったシキ。
　一度臨死体験をしたためか、今では以前のような理性が戻ってくれた。
　だが、いつ何かの拍子で反転してしまうかはわからない。
　不本意ではあるが、シキも遠野の屋敷に近づける事はできない。
　シキの世話は信頼できる使用人に一任する。
entries.maoEnglish:
Month X, Day X.
SHIKI has awakened to the Tohno blood.
Perhaps because he once stood at death’s door, his former reason has returned.
Yet there is no knowing what might provoke another Inversion.
Regrettable though it is, SHIKI cannot be allowed near the Tohno mansion either.
His care will be entrusted entirely to a reliable servant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
~ Month x Day
…… The Tohno blood that has awakened within SHIKI.
Maybe it is because he was so close to death, but he has regained his sanity like before.
But I don't know if something will cause him to invert again.
Even though it tears me apart, I cannot allow SHIKI near the Tohno mansion either.
I place him in the care of a trusted servant.

entries.japanese:
〇月×日。
　あの子の理性が正常に戻った、という報告はまだこない。
……他人の家に預けてから、すでに一年が経過している。
　心苦しい。
あのような生活を我が子にかすのは辛い。
早く、一刻でも早くシキが回復してくれればすぐに屋敷に呼び戻せるのだが。
entries.maoEnglish:
Month X, Day X.
Still no report that the boy’s reason has fully recovered.
A year has already passed since I placed him in another household.
It weighs upon me. Condemning my own child to such a life is painful. If only SHIKI would recover—quickly, as quickly as possible—I could summon him home at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
~ Month x Day
I still haven't received word that his sanity has completely been restored.
…… A year has passed with him under the care of another house.
My heart is in anguish.
It is so hard for me when I think of the way my own son has to live.
As soon as SHIKI heals, I will be able to bring him back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――なんだ、これ」
　養子。
十年前に養子がいたっていう事は、知ってる。
　そんな大昔のこと、俺はまるっきり覚えていないが、確かに養子がいたという事だけは知っている。
　……そいつを、俺が殺した？
　八年前、あの中庭で？
「……意識が繋がる……」
　手紙には、俺とそいつの意識が繋がる可能性がある、と書かれている。
　普通なら笑い飛ばす類の話。
　だが、今の自分には身に覚えがありすぎる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――What is this?”
An adopted child. I know there was one ten years ago.
I remember nothing from so long ago, but I do know that much.
And I killed him?
Eight years ago, in that courtyard?
“Our minds are connected”
The letter says there is a possibility that his consciousness and mine can become linked.
Ordinarily, I would laugh at the idea.
But now it explains far too much.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------What is… this?"
Adopted son.
I knew about the adoption ten years ago.
Even though I don't exactly remember the details, I know about it.
…… He killed me?
Eight years ago, in that courtyard?
"…… Our minds are linked……"
The words say that my mind and his are possibly linked.
Normally, this story would just be something to laugh off.
But, right now, it explains too much.

entries.japanese:
「―――――いや」
　いや、そうじゃない。
　これは、そういう事じゃない。
「―――――くっ」
　……解っている。
　もう、本当は何がどういう事なのか、気がついてくるクセに、俺はそれを考えないようにしている。
―――まだ否定したがっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――No”
No, that is not it.
That is not what this means.
“―――――Damn”
I know.
The truth is already taking shape, and I am deliberately refusing to think it through.
―――I still want to deny it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No."
No, that's not it.
This isn't anything like that.
"------Kk."
…… I know.

Even though I already know about it, I try not to notice.
---I want to deny it again.

entries.japanese:
養子は。
　殺されたのは。
　一体どちらなのかなんて、もうちゃんと解っているハズなのに、俺はその事実を見て見ぬふりをしたがっている――――。
「くっ―――なんて、無様」
　自己を呪う呟きをこぼして、手紙を投げ捨てた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The adopted child.
The one who was killed.
I already know which of us it was, yet I still want to turn my eyes from the truth――――.
“Damn―――how pathetic”
The curse escapes my lips, aimed at no one but myself, and I fling the letter aside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The adopted child was…
The one who was killed was…
I know which is which, but I don't want to admit it----.
"Tch--this is useless."
Cursing myself, I toss the letters to the side.

entries.japanese:
「……あとはこっちか」
　金庫にいれられた日記。
　どうも子供のものらしくて、遠野槙久のものとは思えない。
　パラ、とページをめくる。
　そこにあるのは、ただ四文字のカタカナだけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That leaves this”
The diary was inside the safe.
It looks like a child’s, certainly not something Makihisa Tohno wrote.
I riffle through it.
On the first page are only two words, printed in block letters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… All that's left is this."
I pick up the diary in the safe.
It looks like a child's diary; certainly nothing Tohno Makihisa would have had.
I flip the pages.
There are only two words.

entries.japanese:
タスケテ
　、と。
　真っ白ページに、小さく、刻まれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
HELP ME
There it is.
Carved in tiny letters upon an otherwise spotless page.
entries.mirrorMoon:
HELP ME
Like that.
On a white page, it is written really small.

entries.japanese:
「…………え？」
　ページをめくる。
　　　　　　　　　タスケテ。
　めくる。
　　　　　　　　　タスケテ。
　めくる。
　　　　　　　　　タスケテ。
　めくる。
「な―――――」
　それは、読んでいる者の足場を壊して、深い闇に落としかねないぐらいの、呪いだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
I turn the page.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
“Wh―――――”
It is a curse powerful enough to give way beneath the reader’s feet and pitch them into bottomless darkness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Huh?"
I flip through the pages.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
HELP ME.
I turn the page.
"Wha----"
It's like a curse that brings the reader to the depths of darkness.

　タスケテ
　タスケテ
　タスケテ
　タスケテ
　タスケテ
　タスケテ　!w750タスケテ　!w750タスケテ　!w500タスケテ　!w500タスケテ　!w500タスケテ!w300タスケテ　!w300タスケテ　!w250タスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケテタスケ――――――――
