entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　……吐き気がした。
　今まで色んな悪夢を見てきたが、これは、それを上回る。
　タスケテ、という文字。
　この日記を書いた人間は、他の単語を知らなかったわけじゃない。
　この文字しか。
　コイツは、こんな感情しか浮かばなかっただけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
Nausea rises in my throat.
I have suffered all kinds of nightmares, but this is worse than any of them.
HELP ME.
The person who wrote this diary knew other words.
Only these letters.
This was simply the only feeling they could give words to.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
…… I feel sick.
I've seen many nightmares up until now, but this is far worse.
Those words, "HELP ME".
It isn't that whoever wrote this diary knew only those words.
Only these words.
That is all this person could feel.

entries.japanese:
羅列される文字には、何一つ書きなぐられたものはない。
　一文字一文字、吐き出すような感情をこめられて繰り返されるコトバ。
　コイツはこうやってこの四文字を書くことでしか、逃げ場がなかった。
　それ以外の呪いの吐き出しかたを、コイツは知らなかったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Not one of those pleas was scrawled in haste.
Each letter was formed deliberately, each repetition charged with an emotion being forced out of the body.
Writing those four characters was this person’s only refuge.
They knew no other way to vomit up the curse inside them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
None of the dark litany was scribbled out.
One letter after another, like the spewed feelings of this person.
This is the only way the author could escape.
This person knew no other way to let out this curse.

entries.japanese:
「……っ」
　ページはまだ半分以上残っている。
　俺には。
　これ以上、この本と対峙する気力は、ない。
「――――」
　できるだけ目を背けてページをめくっていく。
　パラパラとめくっていった最後のページで、手が止まった。
「……普通の文章……？」
　最後のページにあるのは、短い文章だった。
　ま白いページに、銀色の鉛筆で書かれた文字。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Mm”
More than half the diary remains.
I cannot.
I do not have the strength to face this book any longer.
“――――”
Keeping my eyes averted, I turn the pages.
I flip quickly until my hand stops on the last page.
“An ordinary sentence?”
Only a short sentence is written on the final page.
Silver pencil marks against pure white paper.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ah."
There is still more than half the diary to look at.
I,
I can't bring myself to read the rest of it.
"----"
I flip through the pages trying not to look at its contents.
As I flip through the pages, my hand stops on the very last page.
"…… Regular sentences……?"
On the last page, there is a short paragraph.
Silver lettering adorns the otherwise perfectly white sheet.

entries.japanese: だから 人形になってしまえばいい!w2000
entries.maoEnglish: Then I should become a doll!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon: So it's better to just become a doll

entries.japanese:
私のからだは、少しずつ脈打つのをやめていきました
　血管は一本ずつチューブになって
　血液は蒸気のように消えていって
　心臓もなにもかも、形だけの細工になる
　ほら、だから　　　もう、痛くなんか
　ない!w3000
entries.maoEnglish:
Little by little, my body stopped beating
One by one, my veins became tubes,
and my blood vanished like steam,
until my heart, and everything else, was only a hollow imitation of its shape
See, that means it does not
hurt anymore!w3000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Gradually, my body stopped generating a pulse
Blood vessels turned into tubes one by one
Blood vanished like vapor
My heart, everything, just crafted parts
See, that's why    there will be no more
pain

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　……日記を閉じて、金庫に戻す。
　遠野槙久がなんのつもりでこれを金庫に仕舞っていたかは知らない。
　ただ、これは。
　この日記を書いた子供の怨念を恐れて、金庫に封印したものに違いなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I close the diary and return it to the safe.
I have no idea why Makihisa Tohno hid it there.
But this much feels certain.
He feared the hatred of the child who wrote it and sealed the diary away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
…… Closing the diary, I put it back in the safe.
I don't know why Tohno Makihisa kept such a thing.
But I do know one thing.
Fearing the child's malice, it was something meant to be sealed away in the safe.

entries.japanese:
……日はとうに暮れていた。
　暗くなった庭。
　目前には黒い、ヴェールのような森が広がっている。
　いつか、この屋敷に来る前に見た、とおいユメを思い出す。
「…………さて」
　別にそこに行って何があるというわけでもない。
　ただ自分の心にケジメをつけたくて、黒いヴェールの中に入っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sun has long since set.
The garden is dark.
Before me, the forest spreads like a veil of black.
I remember a distant dream I saw before coming to this mansion.
“All right”
I have no reason to believe anything awaits me there.
I enter the black veil simply because I need to settle matters with myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The day draws to a close.
The dark garden.
The dark trees spread out before me like a black vale.
I remember the dream I saw before coming to this mansion.
"………… Alright."
It isn't that there is something there.
I just need to confirm something in my heart, so I enter the black vale.

entries.japanese:
中庭には何もない。
　八年前、ここで殺された誰かの死体があるわけでもないし、
　八年前、ここで殺された誰かの血痕が残っているわけでもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is nothing in the courtyard.
There is no body of anyone killed here eight years ago and
no bloodstain left by their death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
There isn't anything here.
It's not like the body of the one killed eight years ago is here.
It's not like the blood of the one killed eight years ago is here.

entries.japanese:
「…………」
　だが、それを一瞬だけ幻想した。
　夏の暑い日。
　俺は確かに、ここで血にまみれた自分の体を、他人ごとのように眺めていたんだ。
「……ふん。
ここで誰かが殺されたのは間違いないっていうワケか」
　その、殺されたのが自分なのかアイツなのか、それこそ俺にはわからない。
　どっちが養子で。
　どっちがシキという怪物なのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Yet for one instant, I see it.
A sweltering summer day.
My own body drenched in blood, while I watch it as if it belonged to someone else.
“Hmph. So there’s no doubt someone was killed here.”
Whether that someone was me or him, I still can’t tell.
Which one of us is the adopted child.
Which is the monster named SHIKI?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
For an instant, the scene flashes in my mind.
That hot summer day.
I was looking down at my blood-stained self as if I was another person.
"…… So.
Someone must have been killed here."
Whether it was me or him, I don't know.
Which one was adopted?
Which one is the monster SHIKI?

entries.japanese:
「……順当に考えるのなら、俺がここでアイツを殺したっていう事になるのかな」
「違います。
ここで殺されたのは志貴さま、貴方のほうなんです」
「――――！？」
　振り返る。
　と、そこには、いつのまにか翡翠がすぐそばまでやってきていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The obvious conclusion is that I killed him here.”
“No. The one who was killed here was you, Master Shiki.”
“――――!?”
I spin around.
Hisui has approached without my noticing and now stands close beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… If I think about it logically, I had to have been the one to kill him here."
"That is incorrect.
The one who was killed, was you, Shiki-sama."
"----!?"
I turn around.
I don't know when she arrived, but Hisui is there.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠。
もう目が覚めたのか。
……その、いいんだぞ、あんまり無理しなくて。
まだ疲れてるんじゃないのか……？」
「志貴さまのほうこそ、あまりご無理はなさらないでください。
いくら体力を補充したといっても、失われていく量のほうが圧倒的に多いのですから」
　翡翠はそのまま、俺の目の前までやってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. You are awake already? You do not have to push yourself. Are you not still exhausted?”
“Master Shiki, you must not push yourself either. However much strength you replenish, you are losing it at a vastly greater rate.”
Hisui comes forward until she stands directly before me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui.
You woke up already?
…… Don't push yourself.
Aren't you still tired……?"
"Shiki-sama, you are the one who should not push yourself.
You are still losing energy at a great pace, much more than you have gained."
Hisui stands before me.

entries.japanese:
「あ……」
　……どくん、と心臓に活が入る。
　翡翠が近くにいてくれるだけで、本当に体に活力が湧いてきてくれる。
「すごいな、体がぽかぽかしてきた。
……うん、翡翠の温かさが伝わってくる」
「けど翡翠。
今のは一体どういう事なんだ。
ここで殺されたのは俺のほうだって言ったけど、翡翠はここで何が起きたのか知っているのか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah”
My heart gives a single, invigorated thump.
Merely having Hisui close truly does restore my strength.
“Incredible. I am warming up all over. I can feel your warmth flowing into me.”
“But Hisui, what did you mean just now? You said I was the one killed here. Do you know what happened in this courtyard?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah……"
…… My pulse picks up.
Hisui standing so close to me really does make me feel more alive.
"Wow, my body really is warm.
…… I think it is your warmth coming into me."
"But Hisui, what are you saying?
You say that I was killed here---do you know what happened here?"

entries.japanese:
「―――はい。
わたしは志貴さまが殺されるのを見ていました。
貴方はここで、シキに殺されたんです。
……肉体や魂だけでなく、本当に、何もかも殺されてしまった」
　翡翠の声は震えている。
　それは恐怖によるものではなく、俺を殺した相手への怒りで震えているらしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I watched you die, Master Shiki. SHIKI killed you here. Not only your body and soul—he truly killed everything you were.”
Hisui’s voice trembles.
Not with fear, but with anger at the one who murdered me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yes.
I saw you die here.
You were killed, by SHIKI…… not just your body and soul, but everything was killed."
Her voice is shaking.
It isn't that she is scared.
Instead, she sounds incredibly angry at that person who killed me.

entries.japanese:
「……ちょっと待ってくれ翡翠。
ここで殺されたのは七夜っていう家の養子なんだろ。
なら、殺されたのはソイツのほうじゃないのか」
「いえ。
殺されたのは貴方のほうなんです、志貴さま」
　きっぱりと翡翠は返答する。
――――ああ、なるほど。
　　　　それじゃあやっぱり――――
「―――そっか。
養子なのは、俺のほうだったのか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Hisui. The person killed here was the boy adopted from the Nanaya family, wasn’t it? Then shouldn’t he be the one who died?”
“No. You were the one who was killed, Master Shiki.”
Hisui’s answer is absolute.
――――Oh, I see.
Then it really was――――
“―――Right. I was the adopted child.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Wait a sec, Hisui.
The one who was killed was the adopted Nanaya kid.
So wasn't he the one who died?"
"No, you are the one that died, Shiki-sama."
Hisui answers directly.
----Oh, I see.
Then that means--.
"---I see.
So, I'm the adopted child?"

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
志貴さまは七夜という家柄の跡取りでした。
槙久さまは、七夜の家で唯一生き残った貴方を養子にとったんです。
　……貴方の名前が志貴―――遠野槙久の息子である遠野シキと同じだ、という偶然を面白がって」
「同じ――――名前？」
「はい。
ですから志貴さまが混乱なされるのも当然です。
それに志貴さまはわたしたちとは違い、本当の家族として遠野家に引き取られましたから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Master Shiki was heir to the Nanaya family. Master Makihisa adopted you after you became the only survivor of that household.
He was amused by the coincidence that your name, Shiki―――was the same as that of his own son, SHIKI Tohno.”
“The same――――name?”
“Yes. It is only natural that Master Shiki became confused. Unlike us, Master Shiki was taken into the Tohno family as a true member of the household.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, you are a descendant of the Nanaya family.
Makihisa-sama adopted you, the only surviving member.
…… Your name is Shiki---and because Makihisa-sama found it amusing that his son was also named SHIKI by a strange coincidence, he adopted you."
"Our names----are the same?"
"Yes.
It is natural for you to be confused.
And you are different from us; you were really adopted into the Tohno family."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　声が出ない。
　……そんなもの、別にいまさらショックでもなんでもない。
　俺は初めから親父とは馬が合わなかったし、この屋敷にだって違和感を覚えていた。
　だから、そんな―――
　そんな――――
　そんな、こと――――
　全て嘘だったにしても、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
I cannot speak.
This revelation should not shock me now.
My father and I never understood each other, and the mansion has always felt wrong to me.
So, that―――
It is not――――
It is nothing like that――――
Even if my whole life has been a lie, I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
I can't speak.
…… Such a thing, isn't a shock or anything.
I remember not getting along with my old man from the beginning, and I never felt quite right in the mansion…
So such a thing---
Such a---
Such a thing----
Even if it were all lies, I---

entries.japanese:
「……もうしわけありません。
志貴さまを悲しませるようなコトばかり、口にして」
「いや、いいんだ。
別に悲しくもなんともない」
――――口にして、嘘だな、と思った。
　これがどんな感情によるものかは解らない。
　ただ、胸に空洞めいた間隙があることだけは、否定のできない事実だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Forgive me. I have only said things that would sadden Master Shiki.”
“No, it is all right. I am not hurt at all.”
――――The moment I say it, I know it is a lie.
I can’t name the emotion.
I can only admit that something hollow has opened inside my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I am very sorry.
Saying things that cause you sadness."
"No, I'm fine.
I'm not sad."
----I say that, but I know it's a lie.
I don't know what kind of feeling it is.
But it is true that I feel an emptiness in my heart.

entries.japanese:
「―――けど、おかしいな。
遠野の人間はみんなおかしな力があるんだろう？
　アイツ……シキが吸血鬼だっていうんなら、俺はどうなるんだ。
　俺だってアイツほどじゃないけど、おかしな目をもってる」
「……わたしも詳しくは存じません。
ただ秋葉さまが言われるには、志貴さまはわたしや姉さんと同じ、遠野家のような『混血』と敵対する家柄なのだそうです。
　……わたしたちにあるのは体液を交換した相手と感応する能力だけですが、七夜という血族には『魔を退ける』という、攻撃的な能力があるのでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Still, something does not add up. Everyone in the Tohno family has some strange power, do they not? If SHIKI is a vampire, then what does that make me?
My eyes are strange too, even if they are nothing like his.”
“I do not know the details. Miss Akiha told me that Master Shiki comes from a family that opposed mixed-blood clans such as the Tohnos, just as my sister and I do.
My sister and I can only resonate with someone after exchanging bodily fluids with them, but the Nanaya bloodline appears to possess a more aggressive gift—the power to drive back demons.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---But, that's weird.
People of the Tohno bloodline have powers don't they?
He…… if SHIKI is a vampire, then what am I?
I'm not the same as him, but I have these strange eyes."
"…… I do not know in detail.
But Akiha-sama said that you are the same as Nee-san and I, whose families are enemies to those of 'mixed blood'.
…… We have the power to synchronize with those we exchange fluids with, and the Nanaya family had the power to fight demons."

entries.japanese:
……なるほど。
　たしかに俺の眼は、翡翠のように誰かを生かす為の力じゃなくて、誰かを殺す為の力だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I see.
My eyes are a power to kill, not to preserve life like Hisui’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I see.
Certainly my eyes are not a power to help people like Hisui's.
Rather, it is a power to kill.

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
けど、それならどうして親父は俺を養子にとったんだろうな。
自分たちの敵を養子にするなんて、おかしな話じゃないか」
「……志貴さまは七夜という退魔の家柄の中でも特殊な血族の跡取りです。
　浅神、巫浄、両儀、七夜。
　この四つの家系は『混血』のモノには天敵とされています。
　槙久さまは、そのうちの一つを遠野家に取り入れる事で何かの抑止力として使うために、志貴さまを招いたのだと思います」
「……だから。
どうしてそんな敵対しあっている連中がさ、養子にやったり養子にとったりするのかなって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. But then why did my father adopt me? Taking your own enemy as a son makes no sense.”
“Master Shiki was heir to a singular bloodline even among the demon-hunting Nanaya.
Asakami, Fujou, Ryougi, Nanaya.
Each of those four bloodlines is considered the natural enemy of mixed-bloods.
I believe Master Makihisa brought Master Shiki into the Tohno family so that possessing one of those bloodlines might serve as a deterrent.”
“That is what I mean. Why would families who were mortal enemies exchange children through adoption in the first place?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
But then, why was I adopted by the old man?
It doesn't make any sense why he would adopt an enemy."
"…… Shiki-sama, you are the inheritor of a very special bloodline of demon hunters.
Asagami, Fujyou, Ryougi and Nanaya.
These four families are the enemies of 'mixed blood'.
I think Makihisa-sama brought you here to help fend off something."
"…… I mean, how did he even get a chance to adopt me in the first place?"

entries.japanese:
「それは……七夜家の中で志貴さまだけが命を取りとめたからだと、聞きました」
「………ああ、そういうこと」
　十年前。
　山間に隠れ住むようにあった古い和風の屋敷。
　黒い森に囲まれた、それこそ歴史の流れに置いていかれたような鄙びた世界。
　……よく、思い出せない。
　こうして思い出せるのはガラスのような蒼い月と。
　黒い森の広場で多くの人間をバラバラにしている、遠野槙久によく似た男の影だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I was told it was because Master Shiki alone survived the destruction of the Nanaya family.”
“So that is it”
Ten years ago.
An old Japanese house hidden in the mountains.
A rustic world enclosed by black forest, left behind by the march of history.
I cannot remember it clearly.
What I can recall is a glass-blue moon.
And the shadow of a man resembling Makihisa Tohno, tearing a crowd limb from limb in a clearing within the black woods.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I…… I heard that you were the only member of the Nanaya family to survive…"
"……… Ah, I see."
Ten years ago.
The Japanese style house nestled deep within the mountains.
Surrounded by a black forest, a rustic world isolated from the flow of history.
…… I can't, quite, remember it well.
All I can remember is that pale, blue glass moon.
And in the forest's clearing, a figure that looked like Tohno Makihisa was cutting up lots of people.

entries.japanese:
「――――――、はぁ」
　いまさら。
　そんな終わってしまった事なんて、どうでもいい話だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Hah”
It is ancient history.
What does any of it matter now?
entries.mirrorMoon:
------*sigh*
But that was then, and this is now.
Something done so long ago, it doesn't matter now.

entries.japanese:
「……それで。
俺がここでシキってヤツに殺されたのはわかった。
けど、どうしてその俺が生きていて遠野志貴なんて立場になってるんだ。
俺には、そのあたりがよくわからない」
「……はい。
たしかに志貴さまはシキに胸を貫かれて瀕死の状態になりました。
けれどその後、志貴さまは奇跡的に一命を取りとめたのです。
　志貴さまは助かり、槙久さまに処罰されたシキも一命を取りとめた。
　誰も死ななかったのですから、事はそれで終わる筈でした。
けれどシキはもう人前に出れるカタチをしていなかったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And then. I understand that SHIKI killed me here. But why am I still alive and living as Shiki Tohno? That is the part I do not understand.”
“Yes. SHIKI pierced Master Shiki’s chest and left him at the brink of death. Yet by some miracle, Master Shiki survived.
Master Shiki survived, and SHIKI also survived the punishment Master Makihisa inflicted upon him.
No one had died, so the matter should have ended there. But SHIKI no longer possessed a form that could be shown in public.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Well, I understand that I was killed by SHIKI here.
But how is it that I am living as Tohno Shiki right now?"
"…… Yes.
Without a doubt, you were stabbed by SHIKI in the chest and on the verge of death.
But by some miracle, you were able to recover.
You were saved and SHIKI also survived.
Since no one died, everything should have ended right then.
But SHIKI became something that could not be shown to other people."

entries.japanese:
「そうか、それで遠野シキの代わりが必要になったっていうわけか。
遠野槙久は一企業のトップだしな。
その息子が突然いなくなった、じゃ言い訳がきかない」
「……はい。
槙久さまは事故で死んだのは七夜という養子の子として処理し、志貴さまを遠野志貴として扱いました。
……あくまで、遠野家の体面を守るためだけに」
「……ふぅん。
なるほど、あの親父のやりそうなことだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So they needed someone to take SHIKI Tohno’s place. Makihisa Tohno headed a company. He could not simply announce that his son had vanished.”
“Yes. Master Makihisa declared the adopted Nanaya child to be the one who died in the accident and presented Master Shiki as Shiki Tohno. Solely to preserve the Tohno family’s reputation.”
“Huh. I see, that sounds exactly like him.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, so a replacement was needed for Tohno SHIKI.
The name of Tohno Makihisa is in the top of the business world; his son can't just suddenly die."
"…… Yes.
Makihisa-sama pretended that the Nanaya child died, and had you live as Tohno Shiki…… It was all to protect the family name."
"…… I get it, it's something the old man would do."

entries.japanese:
ああ、それで全て合点がいく。
　いくら遠野志貴だなんて言っておいても、俺は遠野家の人間じゃない。
遠野の後継ぎは血を引いている秋葉以外、もういない。
　だから親父は俺を有間の家に預けて、長男は健在だが体が弱いので後継ぎにはしない、という立場を作り上げたんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
At last, everything makes sense.
Even if they call me Shiki Tohno, I am not a Tohno. Akiha is the only blood heir the family has left.
So my father sent me to live with the Arima family and manufactured a convenient fiction: the eldest son still lived but was too frail to inherit.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, everything fits in now.
Even though I am Tohno Shiki, I'm not technically part of the Tohno family.
Besides Akiha, no one else holds that blood.
So my old man sent me to live with the Arimas, and contrived a situation where I couldn't be the successor since my health was bad even though I was supposedly the eldest son of the Tohno household.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま―――わたしは」
「……いいよ。
今まで黙っていて悪かった、なんて言わないでくれ。
こうして話してくれただけで十分だ。
翡翠だって俺と似たようなものなんだろう？」
「いいえ、わたしは志貴さまや姉さんに比べれば何も苦痛を味わっていません……！
　
　槙久さまが亡くなられた後だって、秋葉さまがわたしたちの立場を擁護してくださっているんです。
　ですから、わたしだけがただ安穏と、何も知らないまま今まで生きてきてしまったんです……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki―――I”
“It is all right. Do not apologize for keeping quiet. Telling me now is enough. Besides, you are much the same as me, are you not?”
“Compared with Master Shiki or my sister, I have suffered nothing…!
Even after Master Makihisa died, Miss Akiha protected our position in this household.
I alone have lived peacefully all this time, knowing nothing!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama---I…"
"…… It's fine.
You don't have to apologize for keeping this a secret.
Just telling me now is enough.
Besides, aren't you like me?"
"No, compared to you or Nee-san, I have not suffered at all……!
Even after Makihisa-sama died, Akiha-sama took us under her care.
So only I lived peacefully, not knowing anything……!"

entries.japanese:
「ちょっと待った翡翠。
　秋葉は――その、俺が本当の兄貴じゃないっていう事を知っているのか……？」
「……はい。
志貴さまが有間の家に預けられたおり、槙久さまの口から聞かされているそうです。
　ですが、秋葉さまにとって兄妹は志貴さまだけなんです。
　……槙久さまは毎日のように志貴さまの事は忘れろ、と秋葉さまに言いつけておりました。
　けれど、ただの一度も秋葉さまが頷いた事はありません。
どんなに厳しく叱られても、秋葉さまは志貴さまだけをお待ちしていたんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Hisui.
Does Akiha know that I’m not really her brother?”
“Yes. Master Makihisa told Miss Akiha when Master Shiki was sent to the Arima family.
But to Miss Akiha, Master Shiki is her only brother.
Master Makihisa ordered Miss Akiha almost every day to forget Master Shiki.
But Miss Akiha never agreed, not once. However severely Master Makihisa scolded her, Miss Akiha went on waiting for Master Shiki and no one else.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wait, Hisui.
Akiha--she knows that I'm not her real brother……?"
"…… Yes.
She heard it from Makihisa-sama after you were adopted.
But, Akiha-sama would always insist that you were her real brother.
…… Every day, Makihisa-sama would tell Akiha-sama to forget about you.
But, Akiha-sama would never agree.
Even though she would be scolded severely, she still waited for you in her heart.

entries.japanese:
「……本当の事を知られたら志貴さまは遠野の家から離れてしまう。
だから志貴さまには真実は決して話さないでほしい、と秋葉さまはわたしたちに頭をおさげになりました。
　わたしも姉さんも、秋葉さまには何度も助けられました。
姉さんは槙久さま付きの使用人で、槙久さまのお部屋から出る事は許されなかった。
それを嫌って、姉さんを自由にしてくれたのは秋葉さまです。
　ですから―――秋葉さまがそう望むのなら、わたしも姉さんもこの嘘をつきとおしたかった。
秋葉さま同様、わたしたちも、志貴さまには帰ってきてほしかったから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha believed Master Shiki would leave the Tohno family if he learned the truth. She bowed her head to us and begged us never to tell Master Shiki.
My sister and I both owe Miss Akiha a great deal. My sister was Master Makihisa’s servant and forbidden to leave Master Makihisa’s room. Miss Akiha was the one who set my sister free.
So―――if keeping this lie was what Miss Akiha wanted, my sister and I wished to preserve it too. Like Miss Akiha, we wanted Master Shiki to come home.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… If you knew the truth, you would leave.
That is why Akiha-sama told us to never let you know the truth.
Akiha-sama always helped Nee-san and myself.
Nee-san was Makihisa-sama's servant and was not allowed out of his room.
Akiha-sama hated that and freed Nee-san.
So---for Akiha-sama's sake, we continued the lie.
Akiha-sama, all of us… we wanted you to come back."

entries.japanese:
「…………翡翠」
「ですから志貴さま、どうか秋葉さまをお恨みにならないでください。
秋葉さまは誰よりも志貴さまの事を大切に思っているんです」
「……ああ、それは分かってる。
俺が秋葉を恨むはずなんかないよ。
恨まれるとしたら、それはこっちのほうだ。
翡翠や秋葉が悩んでいたのに、俺は一人で気楽に暮らしていたんだからさ」
「…………」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui”
“So please, Master Shiki, do not hate Miss Akiha. No one treasures Master Shiki more than Miss Akiha does.”
“I know. I could never hate Akiha. If anyone deserves to be hated, it is me. You and Akiha were suffering while I lived without a care.”
“…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Hisui."
"So please, do not hate Akiha-sama.
More than anyone else, she thinks importantly of you."
"…… Yeah, I know.
There's no way I would hate her.
It's more appropriate for me to be hated.
I was the one living peacefully while you were all suffering."
"………"

entries.japanese:
だから、秋葉には感謝してる。
　あいつは俺みたいな他人を屋敷に呼び戻す必要なんてなかったのに、それでも俺のことを兄だと言ってくれた。
　……だから、俺も押しとおそう。
　秋葉が遠野志貴を兄だと言ってくれるのなら、俺も、七夜志貴なんていう名前は知らない。
　俺はこのまま、あいつの兄貴として、遠野志貴であり続けなくっちゃ――――
entries.maoEnglish:
That is why I am grateful to Akiha.
She had no reason to invite a stranger like me back to the mansion, yet she still called me her brother.
So I will uphold the lie as well.
If Akiha calls Shiki Tohno her brother, then I have never heard the name Shiki Nanaya.
I will remain her brother, Shiki Tohno――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
So.
I am thankful to Akiha.
She welcomed me, nothing more than an outsider, back into the mansion.
She even calls me brother.
…… So, I'll have to keep it up too.
If she is willing to call me Tohno Shiki, as her brother, then I don't care about the name Nanaya Shiki.
I have to continue being her brother, continue being Tohno Shiki----

entries.japanese:
「ぐ――――っ！」
「志貴さま！？」
　翡翠がかけよってくる。
　不安そうな顔で俺の体を支える翡翠の手を放して、はあ、と深く息をはいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――!”
“Master Shiki?!”
Hisui rushes over.
I gently ease her hands away from me and let out a long breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"G----!"
"Shiki-sama!?"
Hisui rushes to me.
I separate myself from Hisui, who was staring with a worried face, and take a deep breath.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
せっかく翡翠に助けてもらっているのに、今でも頭痛が襲ってくる」
「―――志貴さま。
貴方の体力の衰弱は、八年前の出来事が原因なんです。
あの時、志貴さまの命を奪ったシキは、貴方の命を使うことで生き延びている。
　だから―――志貴さまはこうして衰弱してしまって、シキという人間と、意識まで混同なされてしまうんです」
「……なるほどね。
つまり、こういう事か。
　俺の体はアイツを―――シキっていう殺人鬼をどうにかしないかぎり、二度と元に戻りはしないって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is ridiculous. Even after everything you’ve done for me, the headaches still come.”
“Master Shiki. Your decline began with what happened eight years ago. SHIKI stole Master Shiki’s life then and has survived by consuming it ever since.
That is why―――Master Shiki is wasting away and even confusing his consciousness with SHIKI’s.”
“I see. So this is it.
Unless I deal with him―――with that murderer SHIKI, my body will never recover.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
I just got helped by you, Hisui, but I'm still having these headaches."
"---Shiki-sama.
Your body's weakening is because of that incident eight years ago.
At that time, SHIKI stole your life and is using it to prolong his own life.
That---that is why you are weakening, and why you are linked with SHIKI."
"…… I see.
So, that's how it is.
In other words, as long as I don't do something about that killer---SHIKI, I won't be able to return to normal."

entries.japanese:
「……はい。
シキは志貴さまのことを憎んでいるんだと思います。
だからこうして少しずつ志貴さまの体力を奪っていって、心さえ犯して、志貴さまを苦しめて楽しんでいる」
　翡翠の声に、また怒りの色がまじる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I believe SHIKI hates Master Shiki. That is why he is slowly draining Master Shiki’s strength, violating even his mind, and delighting in Master Shiki’s suffering.”
Anger enters Hisui’s voice again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
I believe he despises you utterly.
That is why he is stealing your life gradually, trying to dirty your heart; he is enjoying your pain."
Her voice is shaded with anger again.

entries.japanese:
「俺が憎い、か。
……解らないな。
俺を殺したのはアイツの方じゃないか。
俺がシキを恨むのなら解るけど、シキが俺を恨むなんていうのは筋違いだ」
「いえ。
シキにとって、志貴さまは自分を殺した相手なんです。
志貴さまは、遠野シキという人間を消してしまわれたのですから」
「……？
　俺がシキを消した……？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“He hates me? I do not understand. He is the one who killed me. I would understand if I hated him, but the reverse makes no sense.”
“No. To SHIKI, Master Shiki is the one who killed him. Master Shiki erased the person SHIKI Tohno had been.”
“I… erased him?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"He hates me?
…… I don't get it.
He's the one that killed me.
I can understand me having a grudge against him, but why would he have a grudge against me?"
"No, SHIKI sees you as someone who has killed him.
Shiki-sama, you have caused the existence of Tohno SHIKI to disappear."
"……?
I caused him to disappear……?"

entries.japanese:
「はい。
志貴さまはたしかにシキに殺されました。
　けれどその後に一命を取りとめて、シキの代わりに遠野志貴として扱われたのです。
　……その後、どこかで幽閉されていたシキにとって、志貴さまの存在は脅威だったと思います。
　遠野シキという自分はたしかに生きているのに、現実に遠野志貴という人物は存在してしまっている。
　シキは、生きていながら『遠野シキ』という存在全てを志貴さまに奪われて、どこの誰でもない、存在しないモノになってしまったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. SHIKI killed Master Shiki.
But Master Shiki survived and was given SHIKI’s place as Shiki Tohno.
To SHIKI, imprisoned somewhere afterward, Master Shiki’s existence must have been terrifying.
SHIKI himself was alive, yet another Shiki Tohno already existed in the world.
While still living, he had everything that constituted ‘SHIKI Tohno’ taken from him by Master Shiki, becoming no one at all—something that did not exist.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
You were certainly killed by SHIKI.
But once your life was saved, you took SHIKI's place as Tohno Shiki.
…… After that, the SHIKI who was confined somewhere must have viewed you as a threat.
Tohno SHIKI is still alive, but there is now someone else existing as Tohno Shiki.
SHIKI is still alive, but you have taken away everything as Tohno Shiki, and he became something that has no name, no existence."

entries.japanese:
「……そうか。
俺っていうニセモノに立場を奪われたホンモノってワケか。
どうりで―――」
　シキが、俺を殺して戻りたがっているわけだ。
「ですがそれもここまでです。
志貴さまのお体はわたしがお守りいたします。
シキが何をしようと、もう二度とシキに貴方は殺させない。
　……殺人鬼として街を徘徊しているシキも、いずれしかるべき処置をうけるはずです。
ですからそれまで、志貴さまはお部屋でお休みになっていてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. The genuine article had his place stolen by a counterfeit like me. No wonder―――”
No wonder SHIKI wants to kill me and return to his place.
“But it ends here. I will protect Master Shiki’s body. Whatever SHIKI attempts, I will never allow him to kill Master Shiki again.
He is roaming the city as a murderer, but in time he will be dealt with. Until then, Master Shiki must remain in his room and rest.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see.
So he views himself as the rightful Tohno SHIKI, and sees me as an impostor.
No wonder---"
SHIKI wants to kill me and get everything back.
"But, that is coming to an end.
I will protect you, Shiki-sama.
No matter what SHIKI does, I will not let him kill you once again.
…… Even if the killer SHIKI walks the streets, he will be disposed of.
So please, until then, rest in your room."

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　部屋で休む……？
　いや、そんなんじゃこっちが保たない。
　翡翠は知らないだけだ。
アイツとの同調は一日ごとに酷くなっていく。
　だから。
　アイツが本当に狂ってしまえば、俺だって正気でいられるか解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Rest in my room?
No.
Hisui simply does not know. The synchronization between us grows stronger every day.
Therefore.
If he truly loses what remains of his mind, I have no idea whether I can keep mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
Rest in my room……?
No, that won't help me.
She doesn't know it, but our fusion gets worse by day.
That means,
if he really does go crazy, I don't know if I can stay sane myself.

entries.japanese:
「……は。
なにしろ自分の体を傷つけてまで、俺に復讐してくるヤツだからな」
　……復讐？
　いや、それは、違う。
　……俺に殺されたというシキ。
　……この俺を偽者というシキ。
　……俺を殺しにいくと繰り返すシキ。
　……俺さえいなければこんなコトにはならなかったというシキ。
　……徒に、遠野槙久のように気まぐれで街の人々を殺していくシキ。
　あとは、そう。
―――とおの昔に死んでしまった、!w1000
　　　　　　　　　七夜志貴という幼いこども。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah. He’s willing to mutilate his own body just to take revenge on me.”
Revenge? No, that is not right.
SHIKI, who claims I killed him.
SHIKI, who calls me the impostor.
SHIKI, forever repeating that he is coming to kill me.
SHIKI, insisting none of this would have happened if only I had never existed.
SHIKI, idly murdering people in the streets on a whim, just as Makihisa Tohno once did.
And then, yes.
―――Dead and gone for so very long,!w1000
the little child named Shiki Nanaya.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Ha.
He's a guy who would hurt even himself to get his revenge."
…… Revenge?
No, that's not it.
…… The SHIKI who says he was killed by me.
…… The SHIKI who sees me as an impostor.
…… The SHIKI who repeatedly says he will kill me.
…… The SHIKI who says any of this would not have happened if I was not here.
…… The SHIKI who has lost his sanity like Tohno Makihisa, killing people in the streets.
And, yes.
---The one who died in the distant past,
the child called Nanaya Shiki.

entries.japanese:
無意識のうちに、ぎり、と歯をならした。
「ふざけるな――――恨み言をいいたいのはこっちのほうだぜ、シキ」
　ズキリ。
　胸の古傷が痛む。
　この傷の痛みを止める方法は、たった一つしかないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
My teeth grind together before I even realize it.
“Do not make me laugh――――I am the one with grievances, SHIKI.”
A stab of pain.
The old wound in my chest aches.
There is only one way to make that scar stop hurting.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Unconsciously, I grit my teeth.
"Don't be ridiculous----I'm the one who has the right to be bitter, SHIKI."
Suddenly,
the old wound on my chest starts to hurt.
There's only one way to stop this pain.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、どこに……？」
「きまってるだろ。
アイツが来るっていってるんだ。
そんなの、わざわざ待っていられないだろ」
　アイツの根城はわかっている。
こんなくだらない因縁は、こっちからいって決着をつけてやる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, where are you going?”
“Isn’t it obvious? He says he’s coming for me. I’m not going to sit here and wait.”
I know where he is hiding. I will go to him and end this worthless feud myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, where are……?"
"You know.
He says he's going to come.
But I'm not going to wait for him."
I know where his hideout is.
I will end this worthless connection of ours.

entries.japanese:
「お止めください志貴さま……！
　志貴さまのお体で外に出るなんて、危険すぎます！」
「翡翠。
悪いけど、俺の部屋にナイフがある。
持ってきてくれないか」
「―――お断りします。
志貴さまを行かせる事なんてできません」
「……はあ。
しょうがないな、それじゃ自分で取ってくる。
翡翠は留守番を頼むよ」
「志貴さま……！」
　翡翠に背を向けて歩き出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please stop, Master Shiki…! Going outside in Master Shiki’s condition is far too dangerous!”
“Hisui. There is a knife in my room. Would you bring it to me?”
“―――I refuse. I cannot allow Master Shiki to go.”
“Fine. I’ll fetch it myself. Hisui, stay here and look after the house.”
“Master Shiki!”
I turn my back on Hisui and start walking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please stop, Shiki-sama……!
With your body like that, it will be too dangerous."
"Hisui.
Sorry, but there's a knife in my room.
Would you go get it for me?"
"---I refuse.
I cannot let you go."
"…… Oh well, I'll get it myself.
Watch over things when I'm gone."
"Shiki-sama……!"
Turning my back to Hisui, I walk away.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま！
　そんなことしたら本当に怒りますから、わたし……！」
　止めようと付いてくる翡翠に心の中で謝りながら、屋敷に戻っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki! If you do this, I truly will be angry with you!”
Silently apologizing to Hisui as she follows and tries to stop me, I return to the mansion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama!
If you do that, I will really get upset……!"
Silently apologizing to Hisui, I head back inside.

entries.japanese:
――――――正門に出る。
　ポケットには七夜と刻まれたナイフ。
　翡翠のおかげで体力はまだ保ちそうだ。
　ただ問題があるとすれば、それは―――
「………………」
　俺の傍らにぴったりと寄り添った翡翠だろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――I emerge at the front gate.
In my pocket is the knife engraved with the name Nanaya.
Thanks to Hisui, my strength seems likely to hold.
There is only one problem―――
“…”
Hisui is pressed firmly against my side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------I leave the gate.
In my pocket is the knife engraved with "Nanaya".
Thanks to Hisui, I have strength in my body now.
If there is a problem, that is---
"…………………"
that Hisui remains by my side.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠。
頼むから屋敷に戻ってくれないか」
「……お断りします。
志貴さまがわたしの願いを聞きとどけてくれないのですから、わたしも志貴さまのお言葉は聞きません」
　ぷい、と顔をそらして翡翠は拗ねる。
「あのな。
俺は翡翠が邪魔だって言ってるんじゃないんだ。
……その、いまから行くところはすごく危険だから、翡翠には屋敷に残っていてほしいんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui. Please go back to the mansion.”
“No. Since Master Shiki refuses to grant my request, I will not obey Master Shiki’s words.”
She turns her face away in a sulk.
“Listen. I am not saying you will be in the way. Where I am going is extremely dangerous, so I want you to stay behind.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
Please, go back to the mansion."
"…… I refuse.
You did not listen to my words, so I will not listen to yours."
Hisui peevishly tosses her head to the side.
"Now look.
I'm not saying you're going to get in the way.
…… Um, the place I'm going to is very dangerous, so I want you to stay in the mansion."

entries.japanese:
「お言葉ですが、今の志貴さまはわたしから離れたらすぐに倒れてしまいます。
本当に志貴さまが行かれるというのでしたら、わたしと連れ添っていただかないと志貴さまが困ります」
「え―――翡翠の力って、そういうものなの？
　
俺たちあんなに、その……体を重ね合ったんだから、しばらくは元気なんじゃないのか、俺は？」
「……違います。
あれは親近者として、志貴さまと契約をするための儀式のようなものです。
わたしや姉さんは血や体液を分け合った人の傍にいないと力を分け与えられません」
entries.maoEnglish:
“With respect, if Master Shiki leaves my side in his present condition, he will collapse at once. If Master Shiki truly insists on going, he must take me with him or Master Shiki will be the one who suffers.”
“What―――is that how your power works?
After everything we did, I thought I would be all right for a while.”
“No. It was more like a ritual, a way to form a close bond with Master Shiki. My sister and I can share our strength only while we remain near someone with whom we have exchanged blood or other bodily fluids.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You say that, but should I leave, you will collapse.
If you really do want to go, it will be a big problem for you unless I go along."
"Eh---your power, is like that?
But, we did that…… we joined our bodies together so much, shouldn't I be good for a while?"
"…… No.
That is just like a ritual to form intimate bonds between us.
Even if someone has exchanged fluids with me or Nee-san, they cannot receive energy if we are not nearby."

entries.japanese:
「――――それは」
　困った。
　それが本当なら、翡翠が傍にいてくれないと俺は学校にたどり着く事さえできない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――But that”
This is a problem.
If she is telling the truth, I cannot even reach the school without Hisui beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----That's…"
That's a huge problem.
If that is true, then I can't even get to the school by myself.

entries.japanese:
「それでも志貴さまが残れ、といわれるのでしたら残りますが。
どうぞ、わたしがどのような行動をとればいいのかは志貴さまがお決めになってください」
　翡翠はキッ、と正面から俺を睨んでくる。
「……う」
　……答えは、もう決まっているようなものだった。
　翡翠の助けがなければ学校に行けないのなら、俺は彼女に付き添ってもらうしかないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If Master Shiki still orders me to remain, I will do so. Master Shiki must decide for himself what he wishes me to do.”
Hisui glares straight into my eyes.
“Urk”
The answer has effectively been decided already.
If I cannot reach the school without her help, I have no choice but to let her accompany me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you still order me to stay here, I will.
Please, decide on what I should do."
Hisui looks at me directly.
"…… Uuu."
…… It seems my answer is already decided.
If I can't get to school without her help, then I can only let her come with me.

entries.japanese:
……何日かぶりにやってきた学校は、背筋が寒くなるほど静かだった。
　人の気配、生の脈動というものが一切感じられない空間。
　昼間は何百人という生徒たちの生活の場となっているソレは、月明かりの下では打ち棄てられた廃墟のように見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
After several days away, I return to a school so silent it chills my spine.
There is no human presence, no pulse of life anywhere.
By day it belongs to hundreds of students; beneath the moon, it looks like an abandoned ruin.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… For the first time in so many days, I arrive at school.
The eerie silence sends a chill down my spine.
A space where no living presence can be felt.
Even though it holds hundreds of students during the daytime, it looks like an abandoned ruin under the moonlight.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、本当にここでよろしいのですか……？」
「――――――」
　翡翠の問いに答える言葉がない。
　俺だって、ただ夢でアイツが学校にいるところを見ていたにすぎない。
「……行くぞ、翡翠」
　言って、校門をくぐり抜ける。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you certain this is the place?”
“――――――”
I have no answer.
I have only seen him at the school in a dream.
“Let’s go, Hisui.”
I pass through the school gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, is this really the right place……?"
"------"
I don't have the words to answer her.
I've only seen him being in school in my dreams.
"…… Let's go, Hisui."
We walk through the front gate.

entries.japanese:
「――――っ」
「志貴さま、ここは―――」
　俺の足が止まったように、翡翠もピタリと動きを止めていた。
――――ぎしっ、という音。
　夜の校舎。
　正門を抜けて中に入ってから、何か空気が違っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――!”
“Master Shiki, this place―――”
Hisui freezes at the same instant I do.
――――Crrrk.
The school at night.
From the moment we cross the gate, the air feels wrong.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----"
"Shiki-sama, this is--"
Hisui halts immediately like I did.
----Creak.
Night hangs over the school building.
As soon as I pass the gate, I feel something wrong in the air.

entries.japanese:
――――ぎしっ、ぎしっ。
　……空気が軋んでいる。
　張り詰めた大気は、吸いこむだけで肺を傷つけそうなほど刺々しい。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Crrrk, crrrk.
The air itself is creaking.
It is stretched so taut and barbed that merely breathing seems likely to tear my lungs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Creak, creak.
…… The air as a whole is creaking.
The tense atmosphere stings our lungs.

entries.japanese:
――――ぎしっ、ぎしっ、ぎしっ。
「……この感覚、は―――」
　夢の中で何度も味わった嫌悪感。
　空気が凍りつく殺気。
敵意。
憎悪。
　校舎の中で。
　あの夢の中の出来事じみた、殺し合いが行われているような、殺伐とした闇。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Crrrk, crrrk, crrrk.
“This feeling―――”
The same revulsion I have endured again and again in my dreams.
Murderous intent cold enough to freeze the air. Hostility. Hatred.
Inside the school.
A darkness steeped in violence, as though the killing from those dreams were taking place within.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Creak, creak, creak.
"…… This feeling, it's--"
I've felt this ill wind many times in my nightmares.
The air is thick with a murderous intent.
Hostility.
Hatred.
Inside the building,
the darkness is filled with murderous intent as if a battle to the death is occurring like in my dreams.

entries.japanese:
「シキ……誰かと、戦っている、のか」
　……わからない。
　あの人間ばなれした怪物とまともに戦えるヤツなんて、いるはずがない。
「姉、さん―――？」
　ぽつりと。
　吐き気をおさえるような仕草で、翡翠はそんな事を呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Is SHIKI fighting someone?”
I do not know.
No one should be capable of facing that inhuman monster head-on.
“Sister―――?”
The word falls from Hisui’s lips.
She raises a hand as though suppressing a wave of nausea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI…… he's fighting someone?"
…… I don't get it.
There couldn't be anyone that would be able to fight an inhuman monster like him.
"Nee, san--?"
A whisper.
Hisui speaks this, as if resisting the urge to throw up.

entries.japanese:
―――姉さん―――琥珀さん。
　　　朝からいなかった秋葉。
　　　琥珀さんと出かけて、今日は戻らない。
　　　……昨日の夜。
　　　部屋に閉じこもった俺に、
　　　あと少しの我慢だと言った秋葉。
「な……まさか、秋葉――――！？」
　足が動く。
　考えるより先に、ただ校舎の中へ走り出していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Her sister―――Kohaku.
Akiha, absent since morning.
Akiha, who went out with Kohaku and will not return today.
Last night.
When I shut myself in my room,
Akiha told me to hold on just a little longer.
“No, it cannot be Akiha――――!?”
My legs move.
Before thought can catch them, they carry me at a run into the school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Nee-san---Kohaku-san.
Akiha hasn't been in the mansion since morning.
She left with Kohaku-san and didn't return all day.
…… Last night…
When I was locked up in my room,
Akiha told me to just wait a little longer.
"Wha---?
…… Don't tell me---Akiha----!?"
My legs spring into action.
Before I start to think, I dash towards the building.

entries.japanese:
――――校舎に入る。
　校内の空気は、外以上に張り詰めていた。
「志貴さま―――」
「…………………」
　翡翠の呟きには答えず、ただ周囲に気を配る。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I enter the building.
Inside, the air is drawn even tighter than it was outdoors.
“Master Shiki―――”
“…”
I ignore Hisui’s murmur and search our surroundings.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I run into the building.
Inside, the air is even more tense.
"Shiki-sama---"
"…………………"
Not answering her, I search for any indication of presence.

entries.maoEnglish:
――――The corridor.
――――Deathly.
――――still.
“…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The hallway.
----Is horribly.
----Quiet.
"………!"

entries.japanese:
きぃぃぃぃぃん、という音が響く。
　鼓膜を震わせる耳障りな高音。
びりびりと窓ガラスに共鳴している。
―――音は、上の階から響いてきたようだ。
「志貴さま、今のは―――」
「……ともかく俺から離れるな。
行くぞ、翡翠」
　翡翠の手をとって、階段へ駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
A piercing metallic whine rings out.
It is an ugly high note that shivers against my eardrums. The windowpanes resonate with it.
―――The sound seems to come from an upper floor.
“Master Shiki, that was―――”
“Whatever it was, do not leave my side. Come on, Hisui.”
I seize Hisui’s hand and run for the stairs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Skreeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!
A high pitched sound assails my eardrums.
It shakes the windows.
---The sound, it's coming from the floor above me.
"Shiki-sama, that's--"
"…… Just stay close.
Let's go, Hisui."
Grabbing Hisui's hand, I bolt to the stairs.

entries.japanese:
―――翡翠の手をとって、階段を上がっていく。
「…………っ」
　ギリ、と知らずのうちに歯を噛んでしまっていた。
　あの日。
　熱にうかされて部屋を出て、秋葉と琥珀さんが話していたことを思い出す。
　秋葉はシキを―――兄を殺す、と言っていた。
アレは俺のことじゃなくて、シキの事だったって今ならわかる。
　だから、今争っている二人というのは、間違いなく秋葉とシキだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Holding Hisui’s hand, I race upward.
“…!”
My teeth clench before I realize it.
That day.
I remember leaving my room in a fever and overhearing Akiha and Kohaku talking.
Akiha said she would kill SHIKI―――her brother. Now I understand she meant SHIKI, not me.
So the two fighting now must be Akiha and SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Still holding her hand, I go up the stairs.
"…………"
I clench my teeth.
That day.
I remember about the time when I left the room and overheard Akiha and Kohaku-san talking.
Akiha said she would kill SHIKI---her brother.
I know now that she didn't mean me, but she meant SHIKI.
Without a doubt, the ones fighting right now are Akiha and SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
きぃぃぃん、と、また共鳴音が響いてくる。
　音はもっと上―――四階あたりからだろうか。
「あのバカ……！」
　三階の踊り場をかけあがる。
　くそ―――なんて無茶なことをするんだろう、秋葉は。
　シキのコトは今まで夢を通して体験してきた俺が一番よく知っている。
　アイツの運動能力は人間の比じゃない。
遠野家の人間がどれほど『人間ばなれ』しているか知らないけど、秋葉では勝てない。
秋葉じゃ、自分からシキになぶられに行くようなものだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The metallic whine rings out again.
It comes from higher still—perhaps the fourth floor.
“That idiot!”
I charge past the third-floor landing.
Damn her—how can Akiha do something so reckless?
I know SHIKI better than anyone; I have lived through him in my dreams.
His physical abilities are beyond comparison with any human being’s. I don’t know how inhuman the Tohnos can become, but Akiha can never defeat him. Going alone is no different from offering herself up to be toyed with.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Skreeee!
The ear-piercing noise screams once again.
The sound comes from above--around the fourth floor.
"That idiot……!"
I fly through the third floor.
Damn it---she's being unreasonable.
Because of my nightmares, I understand SHIKI's body the best.
His power isn't on the same level as a human's.
I don't know how "nonhuman" the members of the Tohno family are, but she won't be able to win.
It would be like going to get herself killed.

entries.japanese:
「…………っ！」
　一歩でも早く階段をかけあがる。
―――秋葉。
　俺は秋葉を信用できずに追い返した。
　兄貴らしいことだって何もしてこなかったのに、それでも俺を兄だと言ってくれた。
――――そうして今、自分だけでシキなんていう殺人鬼と争ってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…!”
I drive myself up the stairs faster still.
―――Akiha.
I distrusted Akiha and sent her away.
I had never once acted like a proper brother, yet she still called me her brother.
――――And now she is fighting a murderer like SHIKI all by herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………!"
I run up the stairs as fast as I can.
---Akiha.
I turned her away, not trusting her.
I haven't done anything to act like her brother, but still she calls me her brother.
----And now, she is fighting the killer SHIKI by herself.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――そ！」
　……なにか、ひどく絶望的な予感だけがする。
　秋葉―――秋葉には、決して勝ち目なんか、ない。
　シキは秋葉を殺すだろうか？
　……わからない。
夢の中であれだけ秋葉に固執していたアイツが秋葉を手にかけるとは思えない。
　だが、その反面。
　ヤツにとって、『何かに固執すること』とは、俺たちのように『それを手に入れること』とは異なっている気がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it!”
All I feel is a dreadful, hopeless premonition.
Akiha―――Akiha cannot possibly win.
Will SHIKI kill Akiha?
I do not know. After seeing how fixated he was on Akiha in my dreams, I cannot imagine him killing her.
But on the other hand.
To him, ‘fixating on something’ seems different from ‘possessing it’ as it is for the rest of us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn---it!"
…… I just have this terrible, awful feeling.
Akiha---Akiha can't possibly win.
Will SHIKI kill her?
…… I don't know.
I don't think he will kill Akiha since he persistently went after Akiha in the dreams.
But, on the other hand…
I don't think he has the same definition of being 'persistent' about someone.
Our definition is obtaining the ones we are persistent about.

entries.japanese:
ヤツは、狂っている。
　そんな男の観念は壊れていない俺にはわからない。
　いや、狂人の思想なんて、狂人にだって到達できない唯一つの世界だ。
　狂った本人にさえ理解できないから誰にも理解できず、ただ孤立して浮かぶしかない唯物論。
entries.maoEnglish:
He is insane.
With my own mind still intact, I can never understand the ideas of a man like that.
No―――the thoughts of a madman form a private world even the madman himself cannot reach.
A materialism no one can understand because not even the madman himself understands it, left to float in isolation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
He's crazy.
I can't understand his broken conceptions since I'm not.
No, even a lunatic couldn't understand another lunatic's thoughts.
Since the lunatic himself can't understand it, no one understands it, and he has to be alone.

entries.japanese:
「秋、葉―――」
―――生きてる。
　秋葉は、まだ絶対に生きてる。
　シキなんかに殺されるハズがない。
　だって、シキに殺されるのは俺だったハズだ。
　秋葉が―――秋葉が俺の代わりに死ぬような事、あってはならない。
　そんな事になったら、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――”
―――She is alive.
Akiha absolutely has to be alive.
There is no way SHIKI could have killed her.
I am the one SHIKI was supposed to kill.
Akiha―――Akiha cannot be allowed to die in my place.
If that happens, I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aki… ha---"
---She is alive.
Akiha… She has to be alive.
There's no way she'll be killed by SHIKI.
Because I should be the one SHIKI is going to kill.
Akiha---I cannot let her die in my place.
If such a thing happens, I---

entries.japanese:
きぃぃぃぃぃん。
　四階に着いたのと同時に、また例の共鳴が聞こえてきた。
　音はすぐ近く。
階段から廊下に出たすぐ先から聞こえてきている。
「秋葉――――！！」
　最悪の光景を頭からふりはらって、廊下へと走り出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
Keeeeeeen.
The instant we reach the fourth floor, that same resonance sounds again.
It is close. I can hear it just beyond the stairwell, where the stairs meet the corridor.
“Akiha――――!!”
I cast the worst image from my mind and burst into the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Skreeeeeee!
As I arrive on the fourth floor, that sound screeches once more.
It's close.
It feels like it is in the hallway past these stairs.
"Akiha----!!"
The worst mental image still writhing in my brain, I dash into the hallway.

entries.japanese:
――――え？
　瞬間、言葉を失って、立ち尽くした。
「―――――――」
　俺の背中のほうで、翡翠の息を飲む気配がする。
「あ―――――あき、は」
　俺も、そんな単語しか、頭に思い浮かばない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――What?
I stop dead, every word gone from me.
“―――――――”
Behind me, I sense Hisui catch her breath.
“Ah―――――Akiha”
Her name is the only word my mind can form.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Eh?
For a moment, I stand, dumbstruck.
"-------"
From behind me, I hear Hisui gasp.
"A----Aki… ha."
That's the only thing that pops into my head.

entries.japanese:
月明かりだけの廊下。
　吸いこむだけで肺を切り裂きそうな凍えた空気の中。
　何メートルも離れた廊下の先に、秋葉は立っていた。
　血のように、赤い。
―――初めはそれが、秋葉の鮮血に見えた。
　だが違う。
　赤いのは、秋葉の長い長い髪だけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Moonlight alone illuminates the corridor.
The frozen air feels sharp enough to slice open my lungs with a breath.
At the far end of the corridor, several yards away, Akiha stands.
Red as blood.
―――At first, I think the red is Akiha’s fresh blood.
But I am wrong.
Only her long, impossibly long hair is red.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The Moonlit hallway.
In the freezing air that cuts into my lungs,
Akiha is standing, a few yards down the hall.
Like blood, a deep crimson.
---At first, it looks like Akiha's blood.
But that's not right.
What is red is just her long, long hair.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　まだ、状況がよく掴めない。
　廊下の先には、しっかりと床に足をつけて、赤い髪をなびかせている秋葉と―――!w1000
　床に片ひざをついて、ゴボゴボと吐血している、アイツの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I still cannot grasp the situation.
At the far end of the corridor stands Akiha, planted firmly on both feet with her red hair streaming, and―――!w1000
There he is, down on one knee on the floor, blood bubbling from his mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I'm still not able to grasp what is going on.
Down the hallway, there is Akiha, with her red flowing hair and---
him, crouching with one hand on the floor, coughing up blood.

entries.japanese:
秋葉を前にして跪いているのは、間違いなくアイツ―――シキだ。
　秋葉はシキを悠然と見下ろしている。
　……秋葉の背後には、寄りそうように琥珀さんの姿もあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The one kneeling before Akiha is unmistakably him―――SHIKI.
Akiha looks calmly down upon him.
Behind Akiha, Kohaku stands close beside her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The one kneeling before Akiha is him---SHIKI.
Akiha is looking down at him.
…… Drawing close behind her is the figure of Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
はぁはぁと、今にも死んでしまいそうなほど弱っているシキと、呼吸一つ乱していない秋葉。
―――状況は。
　信じがたいことに、圧倒的に秋葉のほうが優勢だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
SHIKI pants as though he might die at any moment, while Akiha’s breathing remains perfectly steady.
―――The situation.
Incredibly, Akiha holds an overwhelming advantage.
entries.mirrorMoon:
SHIKI is seemingly on the verge of death and gasping for air.
Akiha is not even breathing wildly.
---The situation.
Unbelievably, it would seem Akiha is the one overwhelming him.

entries.japanese:
「ぐっ………！」
　シキがはねる。
　肉眼ではとらえられないほどの速度で黒い影が秋葉の肩へ食らいつきにいこうとする。
　きぃぃぃぃん、という共鳴。
　秋葉がシキを睨む。
　同時にシキの体は床に引き戻されるように弾き飛ばされ、あの共鳴に反応するように、その躯が煙をあげて無くなっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh…!”
SHIKI springs.
A black shadow too fast for the eye streaks toward Akiha’s shoulder, jaws opening to bite.
Keeeeeeen.
Akiha glares at SHIKI.
At the same instant, SHIKI’s body is flung away as though dragged back to the floor, his flesh smoking and vanishing in response to that resonant whine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gu………!"
SHIKI leaps forward.
In a flash of speed I can't even follow, a black blur shoots toward Akiha.
Skreeeeeeeee!
Akiha simply glances down at SHIKI.
With that, his body slams down to the ground, and as if in response to the sound.
His torso burns, giving out smoke.

entries.japanese:
「ひっ―――あぁああああ！」
　廊下に反響する、シキの悲鳴。
　ざざざ、と煙をあげて蒸発していくシキの身体。
　着物の下のヤツの身体は、その大部分が骨を露出し、まるでミイラのようだった。
　それでも生きているのか、いびつな形になった体躯のままシキは秋葉を見つめている。
恐怖に濁った、びくびくと怯えた瞳で。
　反面、秋葉の衣服には綻び一つない。
　……こうして離れていても解る。
　秋葉の周囲は熱で蜃気楼のように歪んでいて、この校舎を包み込む空気以上に、『異界』だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hh―――aaaaaagh!”
SHIKI’s scream reverberates down the corridor.
His body hisses and evaporates in clouds of smoke.
Beneath his kimono, most of his bones lie exposed, making him look like a mummy.
Is he still alive? SHIKI stares at Akiha from within his malformed body, his clouded eyes trembling with fear.
Akiha’s clothing, by contrast, does not bear a single tear.
I can tell even from this distance.
Heat twists the air around Akiha like a mirage, making it more of an ‘alien world’ than even the atmosphere enveloping this school.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hya--aaAaaaaaAH!"
SHIKI's screams echo through the hallway.
His evaporating body is covered in smoke.
His body under his kimono has mostly bones showing, like a mummy.
But he still lives, his gruesome form still staring at Akiha.
His eyes filled with fear.
On the other hand, Akiha's clothes are undisturbed.
…… Even from here, I can understand it all.
Her surroundings are distorted like a heat-induced mirage, and it seems more out of this world than the air in the building.

entries.japanese:
「はぁ、ぐ、うああああ………！」
　蒸発していく自分の体をかきむしるシキ。
　それを僅かな油断もなく、冷静に観察している秋葉。
―――――二人の力は。
　　　　　根本的に、『質』が異なる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, gh, uaaaaaaagh…!”
SHIKI claws at his own evaporating body.
Akiha watches him with perfect calm, never relaxing her guard for an instant.
―――――The difference between their powers.
At the root, it is a difference of ‘quality.’
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Haa, g, uwaaaaaa………!"
SHIKI claws at his evaporating body.
Akiha calmly observes without carelessness.
----These two's powers…
They are fundamentally different.

entries.japanese:
「すごい………秋葉さま、すごい……です」
　背後で呆然と呟く翡翠。
　それにはこっちも同意見だ。
　……なんてことだろう。
優勢だっていっても、アレは度がすぎる。
　これじゃあ、圧倒的にすぎるじゃないか――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha is incredible.”
Hisui whispers in a daze behind me.
I can only agree.
What can this be? To call it an advantage is an absurd understatement.
This is far too overwhelming――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Amazing…… Akiha-sama, that is…… amazing."
Behind me, Hisui speaks in surprise.
That's exactly what I'm thinking too.
…… What is this?
You can say she is superior, but that's too much.
She is too overwhelming----

entries.japanese:
「ここまでよ、シキ」
「秋、葉」
　シキは荒い呼吸のまま、なんとか実の妹の名前を口にする。
　秋葉は―――シキを睨んだまま、ぴくりとも動かない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It ends here, SHIKI.”
“Akiha”
Between ragged breaths, SHIKI somehow forces out his own sister’s name.
Akiha―――still glaring at SHIKI, does not move a muscle.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This is it, SHIKI."
"Aki--ha."
With a ragged breath, SHIKI somehow manages to say his real sister's name.
Akiha--she just stares at SHIKI, unmoving.

entries.japanese:
「なぜ―――どうしてオレをこんな目にあわせるんだ。
オレはおまえの兄さんじゃないか」
「………………」
　ぎり、と。
　秋葉の周囲の歪みが増していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why―――why are you doing this to me? I am your brother.”
“…”
A harsh tightening sound.
The distortion surrounding Akiha deepens.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why--why are you treating me this way?
I'm your true Nii-san."
"………………"
Shifting,
the distortion around Akiha increases even more.

entries.japanese:
「愛しているんだ、秋葉。
オレは、おまえだけを愛しているんだ。
そのためにあの地下牢で生き延びて、あの偽者を殺してもとの兄妹に戻ろうとしていたのに……それなのに、それなのにどうしてオレの邪魔をするんだ、秋葉！」
「……邪魔をしているわけじゃない。
これは遠野の血筋として当然の行為です。
道を外れた同族を処理するのは遠野の当主の仕事だから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I love you, Akiha. You are the only one I love. I survived in that underground cell and meant to kill the impostor so we could be brother and sister again, so why, why do you stand in my way, Akiha!”
“I am not standing in your way. This is the natural duty of the Tohno bloodline. Disposing of a clansman who has strayed from the path is the responsibility of the family head.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I love you, Akiha.
I only love you.
That's why I kept living in that damn basement, trying to kill that impostor and trying to get us back to being brother and sister!
…… So why, why are you getting in my way, Akiha?"
"…… I'm not getting in your way.
This is nothing more than my duty as the head of the Tohno household---the duty to pass down judgment on all those in the family who stray from being human."

entries.japanese:
「遠野の当主はオレだ！
　あいつさえいなければ、オレがずっとシキのままだったんだ。
ずっと、おまえの兄さんのままでいられたんだ。
目を覚ませ秋葉。
おまえはあの偽者にだまされているだけなんだぞ！」
　ぎり、とまた歪みが大きくなっていく。
　秋葉はほんの少しだけ目をつむった後、決別するように、シキを睨みつけた。
「―――私はだまされてなんかない！
　わたしの兄さんは、あなたなんかじゃないんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am the head of the Tohno family! If he had never existed, I would still be SHIKI. I would still be your brother. Wake up, Akiha! That impostor has deceived you!”
The distortion swells again.
After closing her eyes for only a moment, Akiha glares at SHIKI as though severing all ties with him.
“―――I have not been deceived! You could never be my brother…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm the head of the Tohno household!
If he was not here, I would have still been SHIKI.
I could have always been your Nii-san.
Wake up, Akiha.
That impostor is just deceiving you!"
The distortion around Akiha increases even more.
After closing her eyes briefly, she looks at SHIKI as if she is parting with him.
"---I am not being deceived.
You are not my Nii-san……!"

entries.japanese:
きぃぃぃん、と響く音。
「ひっ……！」
　顔をかばうシキ。
　……けど、そんなものは無意味だ。
　秋葉の力がどんなものなのか、俺には解らない。
　ただ、アレは―――秋葉の視界に納まっているもの、秋葉が見えているものなら、その物体から熱を奪い取るような、そんな不可避の『略奪』だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Keeeeeeen.
“Hh…!”
SHIKI raises his arms to shield his face.
It is useless.
I do not understand Akiha’s power.
All I know is that it is an inescapable ‘plunder’ that seems to rob anything in Akiha’s sight of its heat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Skreeeeee!
"Aaaahhh……!"
SHIKI hides his face with his hands.
…… But that is pointless.
I don't understand what kind of power Akiha possesses.
But that---takes away heat from everything in her view, anything she can see.
It is an inevitable "plunder".

entries.japanese:
きぃぃぃぃん、という音。
　だから、次の瞬間には。
　シキの顔は、一瞬にして凍結して気化する。
　する、筈だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Keeeeeeen.
And so, in the next instant.
SHIKI’s face would freeze and vaporize at once.
It should have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Skreeeeeeeeeee!
So in the next instant,
SHIKI's face will vaporize.
Well, it should have.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん？」
　それは、俺たちに気がついた琥珀さんの、声だった。
「―――え？」
　驚いて俺たちに振り向く秋葉。
　……その、間。
　わずか一瞬。
しかし、絶対的なまでの、隙。
　それを、アイツが見逃すはずがなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Shiki?”
The voice belongs to Kohaku, who has noticed us.
“―――What?”
Startled, Akiha turns toward us.
That instant.
A mere moment. Yet an absolute opening.
And there is no chance he will let it pass.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san?"
Kohaku-san says this as she realizes our presence.
"---Eh?"
Akiha turns toward us in surprise.
…… In that brief moment,
for just a split second, a complete letting down of her guard.
There's no way he would let that chance slip away.

entries.japanese:
とん、と――――ん。
　呼吸のリズムは、さっきから狂ったままで修正できない。
　……ひどく、寒い。
　こんなに寒いと、何もかもどうでもよくなって、そのまま――――眠って、しまいたく、なる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap――――tap.
My breathing has slipped out of rhythm, and I can no longer set it right.
It is bitterly cold.
It is cold enough that nothing matters, and I only want to――――fall asleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock, Kno----ck.
The rhythm of my breathing has gone totally erratic and I can't fix it.
…… It's deathly cold.
If it's this cold, I want to stop caring about everything----I feel like sleeping.

entries.japanese:
とんと、とん。
　と、と、とん。
　ととと、とと。
　と、と、と―――と。
　と、とと、と―――――と。
　と―――――、、、、、と。
　、、、、―――とと、こん・こん。
「――――――――」
　ノックの音が聞こえた気がする。
　翡翠、だろうか。
　けどもう体が動かない。
　遠野志貴はこのまま、誰に殺される事もなくこの檻の中で、一生を過ごす、のだろ――――う!w3000
entries.maoEnglish:
Tap-tap, tap.
Tap, tap, tap.
Tap-tap, tap-tap.
Tap, tap, tap―――tap.
Tap, tap-tap, tap―――――tap.
Tap―――――, tap.
Tap―――tap, knock, knock.
“――――――――”
I think I hear someone knocking.
Could it be Hisui?
But my body will no longer move.
Shiki Tohno will spend the rest of his life in this cage, killed by no one, I suppose――――!w3000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Knock Kno, Knock.
Kno, Kno, Knock.
Kno Kno Kno, Kno Kno.
Kno, Kno, Kno---Kno.
Kno, Kno Kno, Kno-----Knock.
kno-----,,,,,,knock.
,,,,---Kno kno, knock knock.
"--------"
I think I hear a knocking sound.
Maybe it's Hisui.
But my body doesn't move anymore.
Tohno Shiki, will live forever in this cage, and no one will kill Tohno Shiki…

entries.japanese:
メルシー！
　ここまできてあっさりとデッドエンドを迎えてしまったヤバキチな遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
　二日目の授業も、ついに六時間目。
　いよいよ終わりが見えてきましたねー。
entries.maoEnglish:
Merci!
Welcome to Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for our dangerously deranged Tohno,
who came all this way only to tumble casually into a dead end.
At last, lesson six of day two.
The end is finally in sight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Merci!
And now, the hint corner for the sake of the insane Tohno-kun who has come so far only to reach this Dead End,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"
It is finally the sixth period of the second day.
We are getting closer and closer to the end.

entries.japanese:
「いいなー、シエルは色々出番があって。
わたしなんて正ヒロインなのにこの扱いだラクガキ」
　はいそこ、ヘンな語尾をつけない。
　いいじゃないですか、私みたいになんでも屋にされるよりは貫禄があって。
「やだー、ふまんー！
　わたしもシエルみたいな格好して、あたまいいって言われるわよー！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel is lucky to get so many different scenes. I’m the main heroine, and this is how they treat me, scribble.”
You there, stop adding strange words to the ends of your sentences.
Besides, isn’t it more dignified than being made into a general-purpose errand girl like me?
“No, it’s unfair! I’ll dress like Ciel too, and then everyone will say I look smart!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I envy you, Ciel.
You get a lot of appearances.
I'm the main heroine, but they still treat me like this scribble."
Hey you, don't say weird things.
That's fine.
At least you have more dignity than me, the do-it-all character.
"No-!!
Unsatisfactory!
I want to be dressed like you and be called smart!!"

entries.japanese:
…………。
「出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！」
「出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　シエルめがね！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　シエルない！
　出番ない！」
「出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　出番ない！
　シエルメガネ！
　シエル地味！
　シエル降板！
　メガネシエル！
　エセフランス！
　鉄砲フェチ！
　シエルインド！」
　…………（むか）
entries.maoEnglish:
…
“No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time!”
“No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! Four-eyes Ciel! No screen time! No screen time! Ciel gone! No screen time!”
“No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! No screen time! Four-eyes Ciel! Boring Ciel! Ciel canceled! Glasses Ciel! Fake Frenchwoman! Gun fetishist! Indian Ciel!”
(vein throbs)

…………

Fake-Frenchie!
Gun-fetish!
Ciel-India!"
………… (Anger)

entries.japanese:
「きゅううぅぅぅぅ………………」
――――さて、それではレクチャーです。
　ズバリ言いますと再提出ですね、これは。
　ここにいたるまで、遠野くんは翡翠さんの心を充分に引きつけられなかったみたいです。
　五日目や六日目に戻って、もう一度チャレンジしてみてください。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kyuuuu…”
――――Now, for the lesson.
To put it bluntly, this work must be resubmitted.
It seems you failed to win Hisui’s heart sufficiently before reaching this point.
Go back to day five or six and try again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kyuuuuuuuuu………………"
----Well, let's start the lecture.
To say it directly, you need to re-submit.
It looks like Tohno-kun could not attract Hisui-san's heart well enough.
Go back to the fifth or sixth day and please try again.

entries.japanese:
「ヒ――――！」
　泣き声とも笑い声ともつかない声をあげて、シキが跳ねる。
　それこそ火花の速度で跳ねる、黒い影。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H――――!”
With a sound poised between sobbing and laughter, SHIKI springs.
A black shadow leaps as fast as a spark.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Heee----!"
SHIKI lunges with a cry.
His black shape explodes forward like a firework.

entries.japanese:
「っ―――！」
　秋葉と琥珀さんが振り返る。
　だが、もう絶望的なまでに間に合わない。
　黒い影は秋葉には行かない。
　シキは、秋葉にではなく、その横にいる琥珀さんに向かって跳ねたのだ。
―――アイツは知っている。
　今の俺がこうして動けるのが翡翠の力によるもののように。
　秋葉の圧倒的な力が、琥珀さんの助けによるものだっていう事を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――!”
Akiha and Kohaku turn.
But it is already hopelessly too late.
The shadow is not going for Akiha.
SHIKI has leapt at Kohaku, standing beside her.
―――He knows.
Just as Hisui’s strength is what keeps me moving.
SHIKI knows that Kohaku’s help is the source of Akiha’s overwhelming power.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ts--!"
Akiha and Kohaku-san both turn.
But, it's hopeless.
They'll never make it.
The black shape isn't going for Akiha.
SHIKI lunges not at Akiha, but at Kohaku-san who stands next to her.
---He knows.
Just like how I am able to move right now because of Hisui's power,
he knows that Akiha's overwhelming power is possible through Kohaku-san's help.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀………！」
　秋葉の制止の声も間に合わない。
「ヒ―――ィィイイイイ！」
　シキは声をあげて、槍のような腕を、琥珀さんの顔に向かって突き出した。
　どっ、という肉を貫く音が、確かにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku…!”
Akiha’s cry of warning comes too late.
“H―――iiiiiiii!”
SHIKI cries out and thrusts his spear-like arm straight at Kohaku’s face.
A dull thud of pierced flesh reaches me, unmistakable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku………!"
Akiha's voice cannot stop it.
"Hee--eeeeeee!"
SHIKI raises his voice, and with his arm thrusting like a spear, aims for Kohaku's face.
The sound of pierced flesh.

entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
No sound comes out.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
My voice dies in my throat.

entries.japanese:
びちゃびちゃと小気味いい音をたててこぼれる赤い血。
　琥珀さんの頬を濡らす、秋葉の、赤い、血液。
「……秋葉、お嬢さま……？」
「あ――――っ」
　ごふっ、と。
　何かを言おうとして、秋葉は口から血を吐いた。
　おそらくは。
　血管の大部分を失ったために、血流が、逆流してしまっているのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Red blood spills with a wet, almost pleasant sound.
Akiha’s red blood soaks Kohaku’s cheek.
“Miss Akiha…?”
“Ah――――”
With a wet cough.
Akiha tries to speak, and blood spills from her mouth.
Perhaps.
With most of her blood vessels gone, her blood is flowing backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Splat!
The sound of blood spurting forth.
Kohaku-san's face is splattered, with the redness, of, Akiha's blood.
"…… Akiha-sama……?"
"Aa----"
The sound of coughing.
Akiha tries to speak, but blood is the only thing that pours from her mouth.
That means,
the majority of her blood vessels have been destroyed, and all she can do is regurgitate blood.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　声が出ない。
　頭の中が真っ白だ。
　それは。
　秋葉の胸を貫いたシキも、同じよう、だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
No sound comes out.
My mind goes blank.
And that.
SHIKI, whose arm has gone through Akiha’s chest, is just the same.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I can't speak.
My mind is empty.
That is,
the same as SHIKI, who has just impaled Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「――――う」
　ずぶり、と腕をぬくシキ。
「ううう？」
　どさり、と。
　琥珀さんの上に倒れこむ、秋葉の躯。
「うわあああああああああああ！？」
　血に染まった自らの腕を振り回すシキ。
　その度に、びしゃ、びしゃ、と朱墨を撒き散らすように、秋葉の血が床や天井に迸っていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Ugh”
SHIKI pulls his arm free with a wet slide.
“Uuuh?”
With a heavy thump.
Akiha’s body collapses over Kohaku.
“Waaaaaaaaaaaaah?!”
SHIKI flails his blood-soaked arm.
Each sweep sends Akiha’s blood bursting across the floor and ceiling like splashes of vermilion ink.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Aah…"
SHIKI pulls back his arm.
"Uuu?"
A thud.
Akiha's body falls down on Kohaku-san.
"Uwaaaaaaaaaaaa!?"
SHIKI swings his blood stained arm around wildly.
Every time he waves it around, Akiha's blood paints the wall and ceiling.

entries.japanese:
「ああああぁ、ああ、あああああああああ！」
　ぶんぶんと腕を振り回すシキ。
「あああ、あき、あきは、あきはが、あきは？」
　ぴたり、とシキの動きが止まる。
　シキは血に染まった秋葉の体を凝視したあと、真っ赤に染まった自分の腕を見て―――なにか怖いものから逃げるように駆け出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Aaaaah, ah, aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
SHIKI kept whipping his arm through the air.
“Aaaah, Aki, Akiha, Akiha is―――Akiha?”
SHIKI stops dead.
He stares at Akiha’s blood-drenched body, then at his own crimson arm―――and bolts away as though fleeing something terrible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"AAAAAa, AA, AAAAAAAAAA!"
SHIKI shakes his arm desperately.
"AAA, Aki, Akiha, Akiha is, Akiha?"
SHIKI suddenly stops moving.
SHIKI stares at Akiha's blood-drenched body, then looks at his blood-soaked arm--then bolts down the hallway as if running from something.

entries.japanese:
カンカン、と階段を駆け上がっていく音。
　シキは屋上に逃げた。
―――――そんなもの。
　　　　　そんなもの、どうでも、いい。
entries.maoEnglish:
His feet ring against the stairs as he races upward.
SHIKI flees to the roof.
―――――That does not matter.
None of it matters at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
His footsteps lead upstairs.
SHIKI has run to the rooftop.
----But that,
I don't care about that.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉………秋葉――――！」
　何も考えれないまま、秋葉に駆け寄った。
　琥珀さんはぼんやりと立ち尽くしていて、本当に琥珀色の瞳が宝石にでもなってしまったかのように、意思というものがない。
――――俺は。
　　　　血に染まった、秋葉の傍に膝をついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――Akiha――――!”
With no thought in my head, I run to her.
Kohaku stands vacant and motionless, her amber eyes as empty of will as polished gemstones.
――――I kneel.
Beside Akiha’s blood-soaked body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha……… Akiha----!"
Still unable to think, I run to her.
Kohaku-san is still standing in a daze, her amber eyes nothing more than jewels devoid of emotion.
----I
crouch down next to Akiha's body.

entries.japanese:
秋葉はひどく安らかな目をして、力なく、床に倒れこんでいる。
「秋葉……！」
　しっかりしろ、なんて―――とても、言えない。
　メガネを―――メガネをしていても、視えて、しまって、いる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha lies helpless on the floor, her eyes terribly peaceful.
“Akiha…!”
I cannot even tell her to hold on―――…
My glasses―――even with my glasses―――I can see them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha just lies on the floor, powerless, with terribly calm eyes.
"Akiha……!"
I can't tell her--it's alright.
Even with my glasses on---I, can, see, them.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――秋葉！」
　そんな言葉しか頭にうかばない。
　秋葉は――――安らかな瞳のまま、わずかだけ、俺を見た。
「……兄、さん……どうして、こんな、と……ろに」
　ごふっ、と。
　秋葉の口から、赤い血がもれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――Akiha!”
No other words come to mind.
Still wearing that tranquil gaze, Akiha――――looks faintly toward me.
“Brother—why are you, in a place, like this?”
With a wet cough.
Red blood spills from Akiha’s mouth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha--Akiha!"
These are the only words that I can think of.
Akiha----with her calm, gentle eyes, looks up at me.
"…… Nii-san…… why, are you, here……?"
She coughs.
More blood trickles from her mouth.

entries.japanese:
「っ――――――！」
　……視えている。
　秋葉の体にある死の線が、もうどうしようもない速度で、彼女の全身を塗りつぶしていっている。
　これは、即死だ。
　それでもまだかろうじて生きていられるのは、秋葉が遠野という特異な血を持つ一族だからだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――!”
I can see them.
The lines of death in Akiha’s body spread at a hopeless speed, painting over every part of her.
This is instant death.
She remains barely alive only because she belongs to the Tohno family and its strange bloodline.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------!"
…… I can see them.
The lines of death on her body are spreading across her body with gruesome speed.
This is… fatal.
The fact that she's still alive must simply be due to her unnatural Tohno blood.

entries.japanese:
「くっ―――ちくしょう、なんで……！」
　それでも―――誰よりも死が解っている筈でも、そんな事、認めたくない。
「動くなよ……！
　すぐ、すぐに手当てしてやるから……！」
　上着を脱いで、秋葉の胸にかける。
　そのままなんとか秋葉の胸の傷口を塞ごうと縛った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it―――why…!”
Even so—even though I should have understood death better than anyone—I refused to accept it.
“Do not move…! I will treat it at once…!”
I take off my jacket and lay it over Akiha’s chest.
Then I bind it around her, trying somehow to close the wound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"God---damn it, why……!?"
Even though---I understand death better than anyone else, I don't want to believe it.
"Don't move……!
I'll help you right away……!"
Taking off my shirt, I put it on Akiha's chest.
Trying to cover up her wound, I tie it up.

entries.japanese:
血は、上着をまたたくまに染めていく。
　効果なんてただの一つすらありえない。
　それでも、泣きそうになる自分の感情を抑えるように、傷口を押さえた。
―――押さえる事しか、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Blood floods through the jacket in moments.
It cannot possibly help.
Still, as though pressing the wound might hold back my tears as well, I press down harder.
―――It is all I can do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The blood soaks the shirt in matter of seconds.
It doesn't do anything.
As if trying to hold off my weeping emotions, I push against it.
---All I can do is push.

entries.japanese:
「ねぇ……答えて」
　ぼんやりと。
　必死に傷口を押さえる俺が見えていないように、秋葉は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please answer me…”
Dreamily.
Akiha speaks as though she cannot even see me fighting to hold her wound closed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey…… answer me."
In a daze.
Akiha says this to me like she does not see me pushing against her wound.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、どうして、いるの？
　気になって、安心できない。
わたし、解らない事があると、怒りっぽくなるって、知ってる、でしょ？」
「―――――――っ」
　ああ、そういえばそうだったな、と肯いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, why are you here? I cannot rest until I know. You know how angry I get when there is something I do not understand, do you not?”
“―――――――!”
Oh, that was right; I nod.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, why, are, you here?
I'm curious, so I can't rest until I know.
Things I don't understand, they make me angry--you know that, right?"
"-------"
"Oh yeah, that's right," I nod.

entries.japanese:
傷口は血を流し続ける。
上着はとっくに血にまみれて、止血さえできなくなってる。
　くそ―――この安物。
なんだってすぐに血で濡れちまうんだ。
　頭にくる。
　何の役にもたたない上着にも、何の役にもたたない自分にも、本当に、本当に、こんな傷口ひとつ塞げないなんて、なんて、俺は―――
entries.maoEnglish:
The wound keeps bleeding. My jacket is already saturated, useless even as a compress.
Damn―――this cheap rag. Why does it soak through so quickly?
It makes me furious.
The worthless jacket, my worthless hands―――neither can close a single wound, truly, truly, what am I―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her wound keeps bleeding.
The shirt is too soaked, it can't stop the bleeding.
Damn it---this crappy shirt.
Why does it have to soak so fast?
I'm pissed.
At the useless shirt, my useless self.
Really, really, not being able to stop just one wound, I---

entries.japanese:
「……ばか。
どうしてって、ここは俺の学校だぞ。
こんな夜更けでもさ、何かの間違いでやってくる事ぐらいあるかもしれないだろ」
　涙をこらえて。
　ただ、自分に出来ることを、答えた。
「あ、そっか――――わたし、らしくもない。
そ、ゆう事、ぜんぜん、考慮にいれてなかった、なんて」
　満足したように、秋葉は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot. What do you mean, why? This is my school; there is nothing strange about my turning up here by accident, even this late”
I hold back my tears.
I give her the only answer I can.
“Oh, of course――――how unlike me. To think I never considered that possibility”
Akiha says it with satisfaction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Stupid.
Why, you ask?
This is my school.
Even though it's late, it's not that strange for me to be here."
I hold back my tears.
I answer as best as I can.
"Ah, I see----this isn't like me at all.
I didn't… even… think of that at all…"
Akiha sounds satisfied.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は苦しい素振りも見せない。
　ただ、体温が消えていく。
　真白い氷が、日の光の前に音もなく融けていくように。
　秋葉は自分の体の事が解っていないのか、それとも解っているからそうするのか―――まるで何気ない朝食時の会話のように、つまらなそうに、話をする。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha shows no sign of pain.
Her warmth merely fades.
Like pure white ice melting soundlessly beneath the sun.
Whether she fails to understand what is happening to her body or understands it perfectly, Akiha speaks as though bored by an ordinary breakfast conversation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She doesn't even seem to be in pain.
Only, her body warmth starts to disappear.
Like pure white ice melting under the sun.
Does she understand what is happening, or maybe it is because she does understand---she speaks normally as if we were talking during breakfast.

entries.japanese:
「ね。
今の話、聞いていたんですか」
「―――ああ。
悪いけど、聞こえた」
「そっ、か。
知られ、ちゃった、か。
……一番、しられ、知られたくな、ない相手に、聞かれるなんて、馬鹿みたい」
「しゃべるな……！
　いいから、いいからゆっくりしてろよ。
頼む…………頼む、から」
　腕の部分を紐にして上着をぎゅっと秋葉の体にしばりつける。
　無駄だっていうのは解っている。
　けど、本当にそうしなければ、とても、正気でなんかいられなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So. You heard that, did you?”
“―――Yeah. Sorry, but I heard”
“I see. So you know. Of all people, the one person I never wanted to know―――how stupid”
“Stop talking…! Just lie still. Please―――please”
I use the sleeves as ties and cinch the jacket tight around her body.
I know it is futile.
But if I stop, I will lose my mind.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, did you hear about what we were talking about?"
"---Yeah, sorry, but I heard."
"O, oh.
You know now.
…… I'm such an idiot, letting you hear it, the person I didn't want to let hear the most."
"Don't speak……!
It's okay, so relax.
Please……… please."
I roll up my shirt and tie it around her body.
I know it's useless.
But, if I don't do anything, I don't think I can stay sane.

entries.japanese:
「―――ごめんなさい。
わたし、ずっと兄さんを騙してた。
ずっと、ずっといろんな事を、黙って、ました」
「……いい。
そんな事は、もうどうでもいいんだ。
だから―――」
「兄さんは―――あなたは、わたしの兄じゃ、ないんです。
　わたし、ひどい、おん、な、でした。
　ずっと、ずっとそばにいて、いてほしくて、そんな、つまらない嘘を、ついて、いました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I am sorry. I lied to you all this time, Brother. So many things, for so long, I kept from you”
“I do not care. None of that matters anymore. So―――”
“Brother―――you are not my brother”
“I was a terrible woman.”
“I wanted you beside me always, so I told that silly lie”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--I'm sorry.
I, I've deceived you all this time.
I've kept secrets about many, so many things."
"…… It's okay.
I don't care about it.
So please--"
"Nii-san--you are not my real brother.
I was… a, horrible, woman.
I wanted you, to always, always be by my side, so I… told… all those, stupid, lies."

entries.japanese:
だから、これは天罰なんです
　震えてうまく動かない唇で。
　秋葉は、その言葉だけを、はっきりと発音した。
entries.maoEnglish:
That is why this is divine punishment
Her trembling lips barely move.
Yet Akiha pronounces those words alone with perfect clarity.
entries.mirrorMoon:
So this is my punishment.
With her trembling lips,
Akiha says those words clearly.

entries.japanese:
血は、止まらない。
　俺は。
このまま、気が狂うかと、思った。
entries.maoEnglish:
The blood will not stop.
Me. I might go mad right here.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The blood doesn't stop.
I'll go crazy at this rate.

entries.japanese:
「……知ってた。
そんなコトは知ってたんだ。
だから、気にしなくていい」
　秋葉の手を握って、そう言った。
　わずか、大きく息を吐いてから。
　なんだあ、と秋葉はおかしそうに笑った。
「……兄さん、知ってたんだ……それじゃあ、がまんする必要なんて、なかった、んだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I knew. I knew all of that. So you do not need to worry”
Holding Akiha’s hand, I tell her so.
Akiha lets out one faint, deep breath.
Akiha laughs, amused―――“Oh, is that all?”
“So you knew, Brother―――then there was never any need to hold myself back”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I knew.
I already knew.
So don't worry about it."
I grip her hand tightly.
She takes a deep breath.
Akiha gives a strange smile.
"…… Nii-san, you knew?
…… Then, I didn't, have to, hold back."

entries.japanese:
―――――ほんと。
わたし、ばかみたい。
!w1500
entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Really. I am such an idiot.!w1500
entries.mirrorMoon: ----I really am an idiot.

entries.japanese:
秋葉の唇が、そう動く。
　口にすればいいのに。
　声にだせばいいのに。
　秋葉は、言葉に、しなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s lips form the words.
She could say them.
She could give them a voice.
But Akiha does not say them aloud.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her lips shape those words.
She should have said it.
She should have voiced it.
But Akiha, did not do so.

entries.japanese:
「……あきは？」
　返事はない。
　今、自分が抱いているものは呼吸をしていない。
「おい」
　返事はない。
　今、自分が抱いているものは遠野秋葉だったもの。
「なにか、言えよ」
　返事など、永久に、ない。
　いま自分が抱いているものは、安らかに瞳を閉じてしまっている――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha?”
No answer.
The thing in my arms is no longer breathing.
“Hey.”
No answer.
What I hold in my arms is something that was once Akiha Tohno.
“Say something.”
There will never be an answer.
What I hold has peacefully closed its eyes――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha?"
There is no reply.
What I am holding right now is not breathing.
"Hey!"
There is no response.
What I am holding is what used to be Tohno Akiha.
"Say something!"
There will never be an answer.
What I am holding has closed her eyes calmly----

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――――！！！」
　がくがくと秋葉の体をゆらす。
　そんな事をして―――何があるわけでもないと、誰よりも、理解しているのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――――!!!”
I shake Akiha’s body again and again.
Even though I understand better than anyone that nothing can come of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha----!!!"
I shake her body.
Even though---I understand better than anyone else, that it has no meaning.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さま、どうか―――」
　翡翠の手が、秋葉を揺らす俺の手に重なる。
「―――――あ」
　気がつけば、秋葉の体は汚れてしまっていた。
　俺が―――馬鹿みたいに、汚して、しまった。
「――――」
　静かに、秋葉の体を床に戻す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, please―――”
Hisui lays her hand over mine, stopping me from shaking Akiha.
“―――――Ah”
Only then do I see what I have done to her body.
I―――I have sullied her, shaking her like an idiot.
“――――”
Gently, I lower Akiha back to the floor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-sama, please---"
Hisui places her hand on mine.
"----Ah…"
Without even realizing it, I was making her body dirty.

I---like an idiot, I made her body dirty.
"----"
Quietly, I place her on the floor.

entries.japanese:
――――校舎は、ひどく静かだ。
　俺も翡翠も、言葉もなく、ただ停止してしまっている。
　ただ―――琥珀さんだけが、その動力を取り戻した。
「シキ様はどこに向かわれたんでしょう？」
――――シ、キ。
　その言葉に、意識が、覚醒した。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――The school building is terribly quiet.
Hisui and I have stopped entirely, wordless and motionless.
Only Kohaku starts moving again.
“Where do you suppose Master SHIKI went?”
――――SHI, KI.
At that name, my mind snaps awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The school building is horribly quiet.
Hisui and I are wordlessly frozen.
Only---only Kohaku-san seems to have regained the power to move.
"I wonder where SHIKI-sama went to?"
----SHI, KI.
Those words catapult my consciousness back.

entries.japanese:
「姉さん、今はそんなコト―――」
「いや―――琥珀さんのいうとおりだ」
　立ちあがる。
