　よかった―――ナイフを持ってきて、本当に、良かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sister, this is no time for that―――”
“No―――Kohaku is right”
I rise.
Thank God―――thank God I brought the knife.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nee-san, don't say that now---"
"No---Kohaku-san is right."
I stand up.
It's a good thing---it really is a good thing I brought my knife.

entries.japanese:
「お……お止めください志貴さま……！
　そんな、そんな危険なことをしなくても、あの傷ならシキは長く保ちませんから……！」
「……いや。
秋葉はシキを―――あの殺人鬼をこれ以上放っておけなくて、ここまでやったんだ。
　秋葉のためにも、あいつを放っておくわけにはいかない」
　言って、翡翠を押しのけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“P-please stop, Master Shiki…! You need not do anything so dangerous; with wounds like those, SHIKI cannot last much longer…!”
“No. Akiha came this far because she could not leave SHIKI―――that murderer―――at large any longer”
“For Akiha’s sake, I cannot leave him at large either”
With that, I shove Hisui aside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"P…… please stop, Shiki-sama……!
You, you don't have to do such a dangerous thing.
SHIKI will not last long with that wound anyways."
"…… No.
Akiha went that far since she could not let SHIKI, the killer, be alive any longer.
For Akiha's sake, I can't leave him be."
I say this as I push her away.

entries.japanese:
嘘だ。
　今はそんな大義名分よりも―――――
「あいつとは、ここでケリをつけてやる」
　――――憎くて。
　ただ単に、あいつを殺したくて仕方がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is a lie.
Fine motives mean nothing to me now―――――
“I’m ending this with him here.”
――――I hate him.
I simply want to kill him so badly I can think of nothing else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's a lie.
More than that just cause----
"I have to settle this with him here and now."
----I hate him.
To put it simply, I just want to kill him.

entries.japanese:
「ついてくるな。
二人はここにいて、秋葉をキレイにしてやってくれ」
　琥珀さんはこくんと肯く。
　不安げに俺を見つめてくる翡翠に背を向けて、一人、階段をかけあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Do not follow me. Stay here, both of you, and clean Akiha up.”
Kohaku gives a small nod.
I turn my back on Hisui’s anxious gaze and run up the stairs alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't follow me.
Both of you stay here and take care of Akiha."
Kohaku-san nods.
Hisui uneasily watches me as I run up the stairs.

entries.japanese:
屋上。
　月を天に。
　荒い息遣いの獣が、コンクリートの大地にうずくまっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The rooftop.
The moon overhead.
A beast crouches on the concrete earth, panting harshly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The rooftop.
The moon hangs in the sky.
That wild beast is crouching on the concrete.

entries.japanese:
「―――――シキ」
　メガネを外す。
　そこに、ヤツの『死』を直視した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――SHIKI”
I remove my glasses.
There, I look directly upon his death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----SHIKI."
I remove my glasses.
I look at his "death".

entries.japanese:
「はっ―――はっ―――はっ―――！」
　うずくまって、シキは自分の腕を噛み千切っている。
　そこには――とうに理性の煌めきはない。
　今のでようやく狂ったのか。
「……………っ」
　あたまにくる。
　俺は―――秋葉のために、正気を失うことさえ、できないっていうのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah―――hah―――!”
Crouching there, SHIKI gnaws his own arm apart.
There――no spark of reason remains in him.
Has what happened below finally driven him mad?
“……………!”
It infuriates me.
I―――cannot even lose my sanity for Akiha’s sake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*---*pant*---*pant*---!
Crouching, SHIKI is biting his own arms.
There--exists no trace of sanity.
Perhaps what happened caused him to go insane.
"………………"
That pisses me off.
I---I am not able to lose my sanity for Akiha's sake.

entries.japanese:
月光の下。
　今まで何度も知っていたのに、初めて出会った敵に向かって、一歩踏みこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Under the moonlight.
I step toward an enemy I have met time and again, yet am facing for the first time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Underneath the moonlight.
Even though I've known him for so long, I take my first step towards the enemy I just met tonight.

entries.japanese:
「シキ―――秋葉は死んだ」
「あ―――――」
　シキはぎょろり、と血走った瞳を向けてくる。
　顔が半分なくなっても、ヤツは死なない。
　遠野という血族の能力―――シキのそれは『不死』というものらしい。
　つまりは他の生命より死ににくく、生きやすいという事だろう。
「はっ」
　お笑いだ。
　そんなもの、俺の前には無意味にすぎない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI―――Akiha is dead”
“Ah―――――”
SHIKI rolls his bloodshot eyes toward me.
Half his face is gone, yet he still will not die.
The power in the Tohno bloodline―――SHIKI’s seems to be “immortality.”
In other words, he is harder to kill and more able to live than other creatures.
“Ha”
What a joke.
Before me, such a thing is meaningless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI---Akiha is dead."
"Ah-----"
SHIKI looks at me with bloodshot eyes.
His face is half gone, but he still isn't dead.
The powers of those of Tohno blood---Shiki's power is "immortality".
That must mean it is harder for him to die, more likely for him to live on.
"Ha…"
That's funny.
For me, that means nothing.

entries.japanese:
「醜いぜ、おまえ」
「うる……さい」
　ひゅ、と息をはいて、シキは立ちあがった。
「うる、さい。
うるさ、い。
うるさい」
　壊れた人形のように、壊れたままで叫ぶ。
「うるさい、うるさい、うるさい、うるさい、うるさい、うるさい、うるさいう、るさいうるさ、いうるさいうる、さいうるさいうるさい、うるさいうるさいうるさい、うるさいうるさいうるさいうるさいうるさいうるさいうるさいうるさいうるさい―――――！！！！」
「…………………」
「おまえは、うるさい」
　ひゅーひゅーと息をしながら、シキは叫ぶ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are hideous.”
“Shut up”
SHIKI exhales with a hiss and rises.
“Shut up. Shut up. Shut up”
Broken as a shattered doll, he screams through the breaks.
“Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shutupshu, tupshutup, shu, tupshutupshutup, shutupshutupshutupshutupshutupshutupshutupshutup―――――!!!!”
“…………………”
“You are so loud”
SHIKI shrieks between whistling breaths.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You look ugly."
"SHUT…… UP!"
SHIKI gets up with a sharp breath.
"SHUT, UP!
SHUT U--P.
SHUT UP!"
Like a broken record, he repeats the same thing.
"SHUT UP, SHUT UP, SHUT UP, SHUT UP, SHUTUPSHUTUP, SHUTUPSHUTUP, SHUTUPSHUTUPSHUTUP, SHUTUPSHUTUPSHUTUPSHUTUPSHUTUP------!!!!"
"………………"
"Just shut the hell up!"
Panting furiously, SHIKI just shouts.

entries.japanese:
「いつも、いつもうるさいんだ、おまえは！
　なんだ、なんの恨みがあるんだ、なんでいつも俺の邪魔をするんだよ、おまえは！」
　よろよろとおぼつかない足取りで取り乱すシキ。
　俺は―――
「おまえ―――なにを」
―――訳が、わからない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are always so loud! What grudge do you have against me, why are you always getting in my way?!”
SHIKI raves, swaying unsteadily on his feet. I―――
“You―――what are you”
―――I have no idea what he means.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're always, always noisy!
What kind of grudge do you have against me!?
Why are you always getting in my way!?"
SHIKI screams around while staggering around.
I---
"What---are you…"
---I don't get it.

entries.japanese:
「うるさいんだよ、おまえは！
　いいか、オレを一人にしろ、オレの中を見るな、オレの夢をかってに使うな…………！！
　おまえが、おまえが、おまえがいつもオレを支配するから、オレは不安でたまらないんじゃないかっ！」
　シキは頭をかきむしる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are the one who needs to shut up!”
“Listen, leave me alone, stop looking inside me, stop taking my dreams and using them however you like…………!!”
“You are always controlling me and that is why I can never stop being afraid!”
SHIKI tears at his hair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just shut up!
Just leave me alone--don't look inside me, don't use my dreams………!!
You, you, you, you're always watching me, that's why I'm so full of uneasiness!"
SHIKI claws at his head.

entries.japanese:
「な――――」
　……考えたことも、なかった。
　俺は今まで夢を見るとシキの行動をトレースしてしまっていた。
　だが、それを。
　とうの本人、トレースされていたシキ自身がどうおもっていたのだろうか、なんてコトを。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What――――”
I had never considered it.
Whenever I dream, I trace SHIKI’s actions as though they were my own.
But that.
Not once had I wondered what the person being traced―――what SHIKI himself―――might feel about it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha----"
…… I never even thought about that.
I've always seen him, tracking him in my dreams.
But…
It never even occurred to me how SHIKI would feel about being tracked.

entries.japanese:
「……出て行けよ。
オレの中から出て行け。
オレの家から出て行け、オレの名前から出て行け！
　邪魔なんだ、邪魔なんです、邪魔なんだってば、オレが！！！！」
　シキは、子供のように暴れている。
「………チッ。
そんなのはお互いさまだろ」
　ナイフをかまえる。
　もとよりコイツを理解しようなんて思ってない。
　俺は―――貴様と、殺し合いにきたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Get out. Get out of me. Get out of my house, get out of my name! You are in the way, in the way, I said you are in the way―――I AM!!!!”
SHIKI thrashes like a child.
“Tch. That makes two of us”
I raise my knife.
I did not come here to understand him.
I came here to kill him or be killed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Get out.
Get out of me.
Get out of my house, get out of my name.
You're in my way, you're in my way, you're in my way, I'll!!!!"
SHIKI is screaming like a child.
"…… Hmph.
Same goes for you."
I raise my knife.
I never thought to understand him in the first place.
I---I came here for a deathmatch.

entries.japanese:
「いいぜ、殺し合おうじゃないか！
　オレを邪魔者扱いスルヤツは全員敵だ！
　一人、一人のこらず殺してやる！
　おまえも、おまえも、秋葉も、琥珀も！
　俺を死ぬまで地下牢に閉じ込めるなんて言いやがった親父と同じように、ズタズタに殺してやる……！」
　狂人のように雄叫びをあげるシキ。
　その姿は本当に醜い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, let us kill each other! Anyone who treats ME like I am in the way is my enemy! I will kill every last one of you! You, you, Akiha, Kohaku―――all of you! I will tear you apart just like that bastard father who said he would lock me underground until I died…!”
SHIKI howls like a lunatic.
He truly is hideous.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine, let's fight to the death!
All those who get in my way are my enemy.
I'll kill you all.
You, you, Akiha, Kohaku!
Just like that old man who wanted to lock me up till I died, I'll kill you all……!"
SHIKI screams like a raving lunatic.
His figure really is ugly.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はは、ははははははははははは！」
　そうして。
　シキは、真正面から俺に襲いかかってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha, haha, hahahahahahahahaha!”
And then.
SHIKI charges me head-on.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"HA, HAHA, HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
And then.
SHIKI attacks me head on.

entries.japanese:
―――秋葉との戦いで、シキはマトモな体をしていなかった。
　だから、事はたやすかった。
　走ってくる―――シキ本人はそのつもりらしい、歩くより遅いシキの腕をかわして、脳天から腹部まで、その『線』を切断した。
「ぎっ」
　どっ、と。
　力を失ったシキが、こちらの体にのしかかってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――After his fight with Akiha, SHIKI’s body was already ruined.
So it is easy.
SHIKI seems to think he is running, though he moves more slowly than a man walking; I slip past his arm and cut the line running from the crown of his head down through his belly.
“Ghk.”
With a heavy thud.
SHIKI loses his strength and collapses against me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Because of his fight with Akiha, SHIKI does not have a functional body.
So, it was easy.
SHIKI runs---or so he thinks, and I avoid his arm, which is swung slower than walking speed.
I slice the "line" from the top of his head to his abdomen.
"Gi--"
Thud.
SHIKI's body loses power and collapses onto mine.

entries.japanese:
「ほら、簡単だ。
おまえの体の線ははっきりしすぎてる」
　まるで大きな鉄柱が頭からさしこんでるみたいだったシキの死のカタチ。
「だからさ。
醜いっていうのは、それのことだよ」
「はっ………はは、は」
　シキは笑うだけだ。
　そこに、知性らしきものは存在しない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“See, easy. The lines on your body are far too clear”
SHIKI’s death looks like a massive iron pillar driven into him through the skull.
“That is why. That is what I mean when I call you hideous”
“Ha―――haha, ha”
SHIKI only laughs.
Nothing resembling intelligence remains in him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"See, it's simple.
Your lines are too clear."
SHIKI's death looked like an iron shaft was sticking out of his head.
"See.
That's what I meant by ugly."
"Ha……… haha, ha."
SHIKI just laughs.
There, no intelligence exists.

entries.japanese:
「あは、ははは、あははははははははは！」
　笑いながら死んでいく。
　俺によりかかった腕が、ずるりと下がる。
　シキは死ぬ。
　その前に、ぎょろりと俺を見て、不思議そうに首をかしげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah, hahaha, ahahahahahahaha!”
He laughs his way toward death.
The arm draped over me slides slowly down.
SHIKI is dying.
Before the end, he rolls his eyes toward me and tilts his head in innocent confusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"AHA, HAHAHA, AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
Laughing, and dying.
His arms leaning on me fall to the ground.
SHIKI dies.
Before he does, he looks up at me, curiously.

entries.maoEnglish: “――――――Who are you?”
entries.mirrorMoon: "------Who… are you?"

entries.japanese:
「……え？」
「おまえは、誰だよ」
「な、なにをいまさら。
俺はおまえがずっと標的にしていた遠野志貴だ」
「ああ、そっか。
おまえが志貴だったのか」
　ずるり、と地面に倒れこむシキ。
「なんだ――――聞いていた外見と、全然違うじゃない、か」
　シキは倒れ、そのまま風化していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What?”
“Who are you”
“W-what are you asking now? I am Shiki Tohno, the man you have been hunting all this time”
“Oh. I see, so you were Shiki”
SHIKI slides from me and crumples to the ground.
“Strange――――you look nothing like they said you did”
SHIKI falls, and his body weathers away where it lies.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Eh?"
"Who--are you?"
"What are you saying?
I'm the Tohno Shiki you were always targeting."
"Ah, I see.
You're Shiki."
SHIKI collapses to the ground.
"What's this?
----You look nothing… like what I heard."
SHIKI collapses and his body disperses into the wind.

entries.japanese:
―――――――終わった。
　これで、終わった。
　
　けど、何も感じない。
　自分を悩ます頭痛がなくなった事とか、これで人並みの体に戻れた事とか、そんな事は嬉しくもなんともない。
　失ったものが、はるかに大きすぎて、何も。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――It is over.
Now it is over.
But I feel nothing.
The headaches that plagued me are gone and my body can return to normal, yet none of it brings the slightest joy.
What I have lost is too immense for me to feel anything at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------It's over.
With this, it's over.
But, I don't feel anything.
I won't feel those splitting headaches, I can return to life as normal--but I don't feel happy.
What I've lost, is far greater.

entries.japanese:
――――だが、何が終わったのか。
「―――――なんで」
　くらりと、眩暈がする。
　シキの最後の言葉が、眩暈になって網膜から剥がれない。
　たしかに何かが終わった。
　けれど何が終わったのか、そもそも何を終わらせようとしていたのか、俺には解らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――But what, exactly, has ended?
“―――――Why”
Vertigo sweeps through me.
SHIKI’s final words become that vertigo, an image that refuses to peel away from my retinas.
Something has undeniably ended.
But I no longer know what, or what I ever meant to bring to an end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----But, what is over?
"----Why?"
I feel dizzy.
SHIKI's last words won't fade away.
Something did end.
But I don't know what ended, or in the beginning, what I was trying to end.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　月を見上げる。
　漠然とした暗闇に心がとらわれたまま。
　ただ呆然と、翡翠がやってくるまでの間、月光の下で佇んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
I look up at the moon.
My heart remains captive to a shapeless darkness.
I stand there beneath the moonlight, stunned and motionless, until Hisui comes for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I look up at the moon.
In the vague darkness, my heart is enthralled.
Until Hisui came, I just stood in dumb amazement, standing in the moonlight.

entries.japanese: それからの一週間は、夢の様に過ぎていった。
entries.maoEnglish: The following week passed like a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon: The next week passed like it was just a dream.

entries.japanese:
シキの死体同様、秋葉の遺体もほどなくして風化してしまった。
　事件の事は外部にもれず、遠野家の親戚たちによって内々に処理された。
　自分は屋敷に残り、秋葉のかわりに遠野家の後継ぎとなった。
　とりあえずカタチだけのものらしいが、そう簡単に代わりが決定できるものでもないらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Like SHIKI’s corpse, Akiha’s remains weathered away before long.
Nothing about the incident reached the outside world; the Tohno relatives disposed of the matter privately.
I remained at the mansion and became heir to the Tohno family in Akiha’s place.
For the moment, it was apparently little more than a formality, but the position was not one that could easily be handed to someone else.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Just like SHIKI's dead body, Akiha's remains dissolved into nothingness.
The whole affair did not leak out to the public and was taken care of by the people of the Tohno family.
I stayed in the mansion, becoming the successor to the Tohno household in Akiha's place.
For now, it is just in name, but I guess it's not something that can be determined easily.

entries.japanese:
シキが死んだ事により体の衰弱もなくなって、遠野志貴はもとの生活に戻れた。
　あとは、今までと少ししか変わらない。
　秋葉のいない、幸せな学園生活。
　翡翠や琥珀さんとすごす、何不自由のない屋敷の日常。
　遠野志貴―――俺が屋敷に帰ってきてから起きた一連の事件は、これで終わったのだと思う。
　けれど。
　俺にはまだ、やらなければならない事が残っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
With SHIKI dead, the wasting of my body ceased, and Shiki Tohno returned to his former life.
Very little else changed.
A happy school life without Akiha.
A comfortable life at the mansion with Hisui and Kohaku, lacking for nothing.
The chain of incidents that began when Shiki Tohno―――when I returned to the mansion was over, or so I believed.
But.
I still had one thing left to do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Since SHIKI died, my body returned to health and I'm allowed to lead a normal life.
As for everything else, only a little has changed since before.
My happy school life without Akiha.
My life at the mansion with Hisui and Kohaku-san.
I, Tohno Shiki, think the whole incident that occurred after I came to the mansion ended.
However.
There is still a matter that I have to take care of.

entries.japanese:
思えば、些細な食い違いがあった。
　それは疑問に思わなければ疑問と思えない小さな、目に見えない齟齬でしかなかった。
　あの夜。
　死ぬ間際、シキがあんな言葉を遺さなければ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Looking back, there had been small discrepancies.
They were tiny, invisible fractures I could never have questioned unless I first thought to doubt them.
That night.
If SHIKI had not left me those words as he died.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If I think about it, there was a slight discrepancy.
It was something so small that if I didn't question it, I would never have noticed.
That night.
If SHIKI did not leave those words before he died.

entries.japanese:
……微妙に子供のころの記憶と食い違う、琥珀さんと翡翠の会話。
　槙久へ逆恨みをするようになったシキ。
　親父はすぐにでもシキを屋敷に戻したかった筈なのに、自分は一生地下牢に閉じ込められるのだと恨んでいたシキ。
　俺を復讐の対象と思っていたクセに、結局一度も自分から俺の前には現れず、あまつさえ俺の外見を知らなかったシキ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Conversations between Kohaku and Hisui differed ever so slightly from my childhood memories.
SHIKI’s festering resentment toward Makihisa.
Father had wanted SHIKI back in the mansion as soon as possible, yet SHIKI hated him for supposedly intending to keep him in the underground cell forever.
SHIKI claimed I was the target of his revenge, yet never once appeared before me of his own accord—and did not even know what I looked like.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The discrepancies between my memories, and what Kohaku-san and Hisui told me.
SHIKI had a grudge against Makihisa.

SHIKI had a grudge against the old man because he was going to be locked away his entire life, even though my old man wanted to return SHIKI to the mansion as early as possible.
SHIKI thought of me as the target of revenge, but he never showed up in front of me and he did not even know what I looked like.

entries.japanese:
あとは、そう。
　一度だけ夢にみた、シキに陵辱されていた人形のような少女。
　あれは、おそらく――――。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then, yes.
The doll-like woman I had seen in a single dream, being violated by SHIKI.
She had probably been――――.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And one more thing.
That one dream, where SHIKI was violating that one doll-like girl.
That… is probably----.

entries.japanese:
よく晴れた休日の昼下がり。
　翡翠には買い物にいってもらった。
少し無理を言ったので、夕方までは戻らないだろう。
　屋敷には自分と彼女しかいない。
　彼女の部屋に二人だけで話をしたい、という書きおきを残した。
　じき、約束の時間だ。
　そろそろあの場所に行かないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
It was a clear afternoon on a holiday.
I had sent Hisui out shopping with a somewhat unreasonable list. She was unlikely to return before evening.
Only she and I remained in the mansion.
I had left a note asking her to meet me in her room so we could speak alone.
The appointed time was near.
I had to go.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A clear holiday afternoon.
I told Hisui to go shopping.
I asked her for a lot, so she shouldn't be back until evening.
The only ones in the mansion are me and her.
I leave in her room a note that says I want to talk to her.
It is almost the promised time.
I have to go to that place.

entries.japanese: 待ち合わせ場所にいくと、彼女は先に来て待っていた。
entries.maoEnglish: When I reached the meeting place, she was already waiting.
entries.mirrorMoon: When I get there, she is already there, waiting for me.

entries.japanese:
「いい天気ですね、志貴さん」
　ああ、とうなずく。
　彼女はにっこりと笑いかけてくる。
「気づいてしまったんですね、志貴さん」
　ああ、とうなずく。
　彼女はやはり笑顔を崩さない。
　いつも……どんな時も崩れなかったその笑顔。
　思えばいつも無表情だった翡翠は、その実感情をよく変化させる少女だった。
　翡翠は外見が心のない人形のようであって、心までは人形ではなかったのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Beautiful weather, is it not, Master Shiki?”
I nod.
She smiles warmly at me.
“You have realized the truth, have you not, Master Shiki?”
I nod again.
Her smile never wavers.
That smile, unbroken in every circumstance.
Hisui, for all her habitual blankness, was actually a girl whose feelings changed constantly.
Hisui looked like a heartless doll on the surface, but her heart had never been a doll’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Lovely weather, isn't it, Shiki-san?"
I nod.
She smiles cheerfully at me.
"You realized it, didn't you, Shiki-san?"
I nod.
Her smile does not fade.
Always…… her smile does not go away no matter what happens.
Come to think of it, the expressionless Hisui actually showed a lot of different feelings.
From the outside, she appeared to be a heartless doll, but her heart was not a doll's.

entries.japanese:
けれど―――この少女はどうだろう。
　いつも、いつも笑っていた琥珀。
　何があろうと笑みを崩さない、人形のように心が固まった人間。
　秋葉が死んでしまった時でさえ、その笑顔が崩れなかった、能面のような笑顔。
――――それは。
「……琥珀さん。
シキを狂わせたのは君なんだろ？」
「はい」
entries.maoEnglish:
But―――what of the girl before me?
Kohaku, who always, always smiled.
A person whose heart had hardened like a doll’s, whose smile survived anything.
Even when Akiha died, it remained fixed in place, a Noh mask pretending to be a smile.
――――That.
“Kohaku. You were the one who drove SHIKI mad, were you not?”
“Yes.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
However--what about this girl?
The always, ever smiling Kohaku.
No matter what happens, always a smile, like a person with the heart of a doll.
Even when Akiha died, that smile did not fade--her smile that is just like a mask.
----That smile.
"…… Kohaku-san.
You're the one who made SHIKI go crazy, right?"
"Yes."

entries.japanese:
「秋葉に血を与えていたのも、秋葉を人間でなくすためだったんだろ」
「はい」
「シキに間違えた話を教えて、俺じゃない無関係な人間を襲わせたのも」
「はい」
「子供のころ遠くから俺たちを眺めていたのも、翡翠じゃなくて君だった、琥珀」
「はい」
entries.maoEnglish:
“You fed Akiha your blood to strip away her humanity”
“Yes.”
“You filled SHIKI’s head with false information and made him attack innocent people instead of me”
“Yes.”
“And the child who watched us from a distance all those years ago was not Hisui but you, Kohaku.”
“Yes.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And the reason you were sharing your blood with Akiha, was to make her not human?"
"Yes."
"And you lied to SHIKI, and made him attack innocent people."
"Yes."
"When we were small, the one watching us from a distance wasn't Hisui, it was you, Kohaku."
"Yes."

entries.japanese:
「あの時、秋葉の注意を逸らさせたのも！」
「はい」
「俺に、シキの始末を促したのも！」
「はい」
「……全部、全部おまえの思惑通りってワケなのか、琥珀ッ……！」
　彼女は笑顔のままで頷く。
「そうですよ。
それらはみんな、わたしがそうなったらいいなって思った事です、志貴さん」
　それでも笑顔は崩れない。
　ぞくりとしたものを感じて、知らず、一歩あとじさっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You deliberately distracted Akiha back there!”
“Yes.”
“You pushed me into finishing SHIKI off!”
“Yes.”
“So everything, every last thing, went exactly according to your plan, Kohaku…?!”
Still smiling, she nods.
“That is right. Every one of those things was something I thought it would be nice to see happen, Master Shiki”
Her smile remains intact.
A chill passes through me, and without realizing it I take one step back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Back then, you intentionally distracted Akiha!"
"Yes."
"And then you suggested that I kill SHIKI!"
"Yes."
"…… All of it, all of it is how you planned it out, Kohaku……?"
Still smiling, she nods.
"That's right.
All of it was something I wished would happen, Shiki-san."
Still, she smiles.
I feel a chill and unknowingly take a step back.

entries.japanese:
「どうして―――なんのために、そんな事を」
「あら。
いやですね、志貴さんはもう知ってるクセに。
わざわざこんな事をする理由なんて、一つか二つぐらいしかないじゃないですか」
「……復讐、か」
「あ、たぶんそれです。
フクシュウのために、わたしは遠野の人達に死んでもらう事にしたんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why―――what did you do all of that for”
“Oh. Really, Master Shiki, you already know. There can only be one or two reasons to do something like this”
“Revenge, then”
“Oh, that is probably it. For revenge, I decided the Tohno family would have to die”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why---why, did you do these things?"
"Oh my.
You know already.
There are only one or two reasons why I would do all of this."
"…… Revenge…"
"Ah, I think that's it.
For the sake of revenge, I decided that every one of the Tohnos should die."

entries.japanese:
「復讐って……俺と同じように、自分の両親を遠野槙久に殺されたからなのか」
「まさか。
わたしも翡翠ちゃんも元々孤児です。
両親の顔なんて知りません」
「じゃあどうして！」
「さあ。
わたしにも、もうあの時の感情は分かりません。
ただ理由だけなら解ります」
「理由って、どんな」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Revenge―――because Makihisa Tohno killed your parents, the way he killed mine?”
“Of course not. Hisui and I were orphans from the beginning. We do not even know our parents’ faces”
“Then why?!”
“Who knows. I no longer understand what I felt then. I do remember the reason, though”
“What reason”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Revenge…… Is it because like me, you had your parents killed by Tohno Makihisa?"
"Oh, don't be silly.
Hisui-chan and I were orphans.
We don't even know what our parents looked like."
"So why!?"
"Who knows.
I don't even remember how I felt back then.
All I know is the reason."
"Reason?
What reason?"

entries.japanese:
「そうですね、例えばわたしが槙久さまに陵辱されていた事でしょうか。
　わたしと翡翠ちゃんは、もともとそのために引き取られた子供なんだそうです。
人間でなくなっていく槙久さまを人間に留めるために、感応者としてのわたしたちが必要だったんでしょう。
　志貴さんも翡翠ちゃんにしてもらったでしょう？
　力を分け与えるためには、性交が一番効果的なんだって」
「――――――っ」
　それは―――知っている。
　けどそれじゃあ、つまり―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“For example, perhaps, that Master Makihisa raped me”
“Hisui and I were apparently taken in for that purpose. As Master Makihisa ceased to be human, he needed us as resonators to keep him human”
“Hisui did the same for you, did she not, Master Shiki? Intercourse is the most effective way to share one’s strength”
“――――――!”
That―――I know.
But then, that meant―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Let's see… such as getting abused by Makihisa-sama?
That is the reason why Hisui-chan and I were adopted in the first place.
In order to stay human, he needed our abilities as Synchronizers.
Shiki-san, you've done it with Hisui-chan, right?
It is said that sexual intercourse is the best way to share energy."
"------"
I--knew that already.
Then that means--in other words--

entries.japanese:
「槙久さまは追い詰められていましたから。
わたしの年齢なんて、それこそ気に留めている余裕はなかったんでしょうね。
　わたしが先に選ばれた理由は簡単です。
わたし、もとから無口で大人しかったから、元気な翡翠ちゃんよりは暴れないと判断されたんでしょう」
　それでも。
笑顔は、崩れない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Makihisa was desperate. He probably had no composure left to care that I had only just come of age”
“The reason he chose me first was simple. I had always been quiet and meek, so he must have thought I would struggle less than the more spirited Hisui”
Even so. Her smile does not break.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Makihisa-sama was really pushed to his limits.
I think he was too desperate to consider my age.
I was chosen first for a simple reason.
He probably thought that since I wasn't talkative and was quiet, I wouldn't resist like the energetic Hisui-chan would have."
Even now, her smile, does not fade.

entries.japanese:
「槙久さまは別段悪い人、という訳ではありませんでした。
ただ時折、遠野の血の影響で凶暴になってしまうだけなんです。
　だからそういう時のために、わたしを部屋に用意しておいて、わたし相手にその昂ぶりをぶつけていたんです。
　あれは世間一般の常識でいうと、性的な虐待と言うそうですね。
でもわたし、よく覚えていないんです。
槙久さまがわたしを求められるのは日課のようなものでしたから、いちいちそんな事、覚えていたらパンクしてしまうじゃないですか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Makihisa was not especially wicked. The Tohno blood merely made him violent from time to time”
“So he kept me ready in his room for such times and spent his excitement on me.”
“Ordinary society apparently calls it sexual abuse. I do not remember much of it. Master Makihisa using me was an everyday routine, and remembering every occasion would have broken my mind, would it not?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Makihisa-sama wasn't really a bad person.
Only sometimes, he would turn violent because of his Tohno blood.
So, for those times, he had me ready in his room, and he let those feelings out on me.
I guess it is called sexual abuse.
But I don't really remember much of it.
It was just like a daily routine for him to want me, so if I tried to remember something like that, my brain would explode, wouldn't it?"

entries.japanese:
「あっ、けど初めて襲われた時の事はよく覚えてますよ。
　その日はわたしの八歳の誕生日だったんです。
　槙久さまが贈り物をくれるって言われて、わたしは無口ながらもわくわくして、槙久さまのお部屋に付いて行ったんですから」
　楽しそうに、いつも通り、彼女は笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, but I remember the first time Master Makihisa assaulted me very well.”
“It was my eighteenth birthday.
Master Makihisa told me he had a present, and even though I was quiet, I followed Master Makihisa to his room trembling with excitement”
She laughs happily, exactly as she always does.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, but I remember clearly the first time it happened.
It was on my eighth birthday.
Makihisa-sama said he had a present for me, so I quietly but excitedly went into his room."
As if she is having fun, she gives her usual laugh.

entries.japanese:
「槙久さまの行為は日に日にエスカレートしていきました。
でも、それも仕方がない事でした。
　わたしはまだ子供でしたから、感応者として半人前だったんです。
だからどうしても、あとの半分として翡翠ちゃんにも協力してもらわないといけない。
　けど、わたしはお姉さんでしたから、翡翠ちゃんを泣かせてはいけないなって、なんとなく思ったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What Master Makihisa did grew more extreme by the day. But that could not be helped.”
“I had only just come of age, so my ability as a resonator was still immature. Hisui would have had to supply the missing half.”
“But I was her big sister, and somehow I thought I should not let anyone make her cry”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Every day, he got a little worse.
But that couldn't really be helped.
I was merely a child, so my abilities as a Synchronizer weren't fully developed.
That's why he needed Hisui-chan's help too.
But, since I was the older sister, I just thought I shouldn't allow her to cry."

entries.japanese:
「だから、槙久さまが求める事は全部受け入れました。
わたし一人でもやっていけるから、翡翠ちゃんには手を出さないでいてほしいって、一度だけお願いしたんです。
　槙久さまも後ろめたいところがあったのか、わたしの申し出を受け入れてくれました。
きっと、秘密を知っているのは少ないほうがいいって思ったんでしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I accepted everything Master Makihisa asked of me. Just once, I begged him to leave Hisui alone because I could satisfy him by myself.”
“Perhaps Master Makihisa felt some guilt, because he accepted my offer. Or perhaps he simply thought the fewer people who knew his secret, the better.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"So, I took in everything Makihisa-sama wanted to do.
I asked him not to touch Hisui-chan because I would take everything myself.
He was probably ashamed and agreed to my request.
He probably also thought it was better that as few people knew about this secret as possible."

entries.japanese:
「そうしてわたしと槙久さまの関係は誰にも知られず、わたしは槙久さまのお部屋で過ごす事になりました。
　その頃のわたしは、少しは物事を考えていたと思います。
どうやって逃げ出そうか、翡翠ちゃんを連れてどうやって逃げ出そうかって、いつも考えてました。
　けど何処へ逃げ出すかも分からないで、ずっと槙久さまに自分の体を差し出して、少しずつ崩れていったんです。
そのうち考えるのも面倒になって、何も考えなければ傷つかないっていう事に気がつきました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No one ever learned of my relationship with Master Makihisa, and I came to spend my life in Master Makihisa’s room”
“I think I still thought about things in those days. I was always wondering how to escape and take Hisui with me, but I had nowhere to run.”
“I kept offering Master Makihisa my body and slowly fell apart. Eventually even thinking became tiresome, and I discovered that nothing could hurt me if I thought of nothing at all.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's how I came to stay in Makihisa-sama's room, our relationship a secret from everyone else.
During that time, I was able to think about things a little bit, I think.
I always thought about how to get away, how to run away with Hisui-chan.
But I didn't know where to go, and the more I submitted my body to Makihisa-sama, the more I broke down.
Eventually, I got tired of thinking and I realized that if I didn't think, it wouldn't hurt."

entries.japanese:
「わたしは人形だ。
人形は痛がらない。
人形は何も考えない。
そう思いこんで、槙久さまのことをやり過ごすようになったんです。
　するとですね、不思議なことに以前よりあんまり痛くなかったんです。
　槙久さまの吐く息も気持ち悪くなかったし、槙久さまの腕もただ温かいだけの肉になったし、首を締められたりおなかを蹴られたりしても、なんだか他人事のように思えて、毎日は少しだけ楽になりました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am a doll. Dolls feel no pain. Dolls think nothing. I persuaded myself of that and learned to let Master Makihisa happen to me.”
“Strangely enough, it really hurt less than before”
“Master Makihisa’s breath no longer disgusted me; Master Makihisa’s arms became nothing but warm meat; even when he strangled me or kicked me in the stomach, it seemed to be happening to someone else, and each day became a little easier”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I am just a doll.
A doll doesn't know pain.
A doll doesn't think.
I endured Makihisa-sama thinking like that.
Then, it mysteriously did not hurt as much as before.
Makihisa-sama's breath didn't make me sick, his arms were just like warm meat, and even if he strangled my neck or kicked me in the stomach, it seemed like he was doing it to someone else.
And every day got a little easier."

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん。
わたし、翡翠ちゃんにだけはキレイなままでいてほしかったんです。
そのためなら、どんな陵辱だって耐えなくっちゃって決めてました。
　けど、難しかったです。
槙久さまの陵辱が、ではないんですよ。
わたしには志貴さんのほうが意味がわからなくて、恐かった」
「俺……が？」
「はい。
わたしにとって、同じ屋敷の中でも無邪気に遊んでいる志貴さんたちの姿は別世界のように見えていました。
わたしは槙久さまの目を盗んで、ひっそりと志貴さんたちの様子を眺めていました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. I wanted Hisui, at least, to remain clean. I decided I would endure any violation for that, but it was difficult”
“It was not Master Makihisa’s violations that were difficult. It was Master Shiki I could not understand. You frightened me”
“Me?”
“Yes. Watching Master Shiki and the others play so innocently in the same mansion was like looking into another world. Whenever I could escape Master Makihisa’s notice, I hid and watched Master Shiki and the others”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I wanted Hisui-chan to stay clean.
For her sake, I could endure any kind of abuse.
But, it was so hard.
Not Makihisa-sama's abuse.
I couldn't understand you, and that made me scared."
"Scared…… of me?"
"Yes.
The way you played innocently was like a different world to me.
I looked out the window to see all of you play when Makihisa-sama wasn't looking."

entries.japanese:
「それが、わたしにも解らなかったんです。
どうしてそんな意味のない事をするんだろうって。
別の世界なんだから、どうやったって志貴さんたちとは関われないのにおかしいじゃないですか。
　別に志貴さんが羨ましかったわけじゃなかったし、遠野の子供が憎いというわけでもなくて。
　わたしは正体が解らない気持ちを抱えたまま、ずっと志貴さんたちを眺めていた。
　けど、その気持ちが、わたしを人間に戻してしまいそうで、恐かった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I could not understand that either. Why would I do something so meaningless? Master Shiki and the others belonged to another world, and I could never join them, so watching made no sense”
“It was not that I envied Master Shiki, nor did I hate the young Tohnos”
“I simply kept watching while carrying a feeling I could not identify.”
“And I was terrified that the feeling might turn me human again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I didn't understand any of that.
I didn't understand why you did those pointless things.
It was strange for me to think so since it was just another world and I couldn't be involved in it.
I wasn't jealous of you, and I didn't hate the Tohno children.
All I did was stare at all of you, while having this unknown feeling.
But, I was afraid that feeling would turn me back into a human."

entries.japanese:
「そうして二年がたって、志貴さんはシキ様に殺されました。
　志貴さんは覚えていないでしょうけど、シキ様は秋葉さまを殺そうとしたんですよ。
　それを突然、志貴さんがやってきて秋葉さまをお庇いになられた。
　志貴さんは秋葉さまとは他人なのに、志貴さんは遠野の人たちに何もかも奪われたっていうのに、秋葉さまを庇って死んでしまった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Two years passed, and Master SHIKI killed Master Shiki.”
“Master Shiki probably does not remember, but Master SHIKI tried to kill Miss Akiha.”
“Then Master Shiki appeared from nowhere and shielded Miss Akiha.”
“Master Shiki and Miss Akiha were strangers, and the Tohnos had taken everything from Master Shiki, yet Master Shiki protected Miss Akiha and died.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And two years later, you were killed by SHIKI-sama.
You probably don't remember it, but SHIKI-sama was trying to kill Akiha-sama.
But you suddenly came, and you shielded Akiha-sama.
You weren't related to her, and you had everything stolen from you by the Tohno family, but you still died protecting her."

entries.japanese:
「わたし、その時は胸が痛くて、嬉しそうに志貴さんの遺体に抱きついている秋葉さまを、ずっと見つめていました。
　あ、もしかしたらその時から決めていたのかもしれません。
秋葉さまには、あの時の志貴さんと同じ死に方が似合うんだろうなって」
「なっ――――！」
「まだですよ、志貴さん。
理由がお知りになりたいのでしたら、もう少しだけ大人しくしていてください」
「………っ」
　琥珀に詰め寄ろうとした足が止まる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My chest hurt then as I watched Miss Akiha cling almost happily to Master Shiki’s corpse, unable to look away”
“Oh, perhaps I decided it at that very moment. I thought the same death Master Shiki suffered would suit Miss Akiha perfectly”
“What――――!”
“Not yet, Master Shiki. If you truly wish to know my reasons, please behave yourself a little longer.”
“……………!”
The step I take toward Kohaku stops short.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"At that time, I was watching Akiha-sama, who was holding onto your dead body painfully but happily.
Oh, maybe I made up my mind back then.
That it would suit Akiha-sama for her to die just like you did."
"Wha----!"
"Wait, Shiki-san.
If you want to know the reason, you have to be patient."
"………"
I stop my rush towards her.

entries.japanese:
「何日かして、志貴さんは屋敷に戻られて、そのまま有間の家に預けられる事になりました。
　それは本当に秘密の事で、わたしは槙久さまが漏らした言葉で、志貴さんはいなくなるんだなって知ったんです。
　秋葉さまや翡翠ちゃんに教えてあげる時間もなかった。
　結局、ずっと見ていたあの子供と一度も話をする事なく別れてしまうんだ―――そう思ったとたん、不思議と足が動いてくれて、わたしは何年かぶりに廊下を駆け出して、志貴さんをつかまえて、けど話すことなんて見付からなくて、仕方なく唯一自分のものだったリボンを手渡しました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Several days later, Master Shiki returned to the mansion and arrangements were made to send him to the Arima family”
“It was completely secret, and I learned that Master Shiki was leaving only from something Master Makihisa let slip”
“There was no time to warn Miss Akiha or Hisui.”
“I realized I would part from the young man I had watched for years without ever speaking to him, and my legs somehow moved; for the first time in years I ran through the corridors and caught Master Shiki, but then found I had nothing to say; so I gave Master Shiki the ribbon, the only possession that had ever belonged to me”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Days later, you were brought back to the mansion and you were going to be adopted by the Arimas.
That was really a secret, but I overheard it from Makihisa-sama.
That's how I knew you would be leaving.
I didn't have time to tell Akiha-sama or Hisui-chan.
When I thought that I couldn't see that boy again, without even getting to talk to him----my legs strangely moved, and I ran down the hallway and found him, but I couldn't think of anything to say.
So I gave him my ribbon, the only thing that I owned."

entries.japanese:
「その後ですね、シキ様を処断する、と遠野家の身内の方々が決定しました。
　槙久さまは自分の息子を殺す事をためらって、秘密裏に地下牢に幽閉したんです。
シキ様はしばらくすれば元の人間に戻れるから、それまではわたしに世話をしてやってほしい、と言われて」
「……………」
entries.maoEnglish:
“After that, the Tohno relatives decided Master SHIKI should be put to death”
“Master Makihisa could not bring himself to kill his own son, so he secretly imprisoned him underground. He told me Master SHIKI would return to normal after a while and asked me to care for him until then.”
“……………”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I heard that the Tohno family members were going to terminate SHIKI-sama soon after that.
Makihisa-sama didn't want to kill his own son, so he secretly locked him away underground.
He said SHIKI-sama would return to normal and asked me to take care of him."
"………………"

entries.japanese:
ああ、やっぱり―――そういう事か。
　だからあの夢は現実だったんだ。
　俺が翡翠や琥珀さんを陵辱しているという願望を持っていたわけじゃない。
　アレは、現実に。
　シキが、彼女を――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Of course―――that is what happened.
So the dream had been real.
It was not some secret desire of mine to violate Hisui or Kohaku.
In reality.
SHIKI had been doing that to her――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh, of course--that's how it was.
So that dream was real.
It wasn't that I wanted to abuse Hisui or Kohaku-san.
That--was in reality.
SHIKI… did that to her----

entries.japanese:
「槙久さまから自由になる時間を与えられて、よせばいいのにわたしは喜びました。
　けど、結果は同じなんです。
シキ様は、父親である槙久さま同様に、わたしを感情のはけ口にしか使わなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Makihisa had given me hours of freedom, and foolishly, I was happy.”
“But nothing changed. Like Master Makihisa before him, Master SHIKI used me only as an outlet for his feelings”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After gaining some freedom from Makihisa-sama, I became a little happy.
But, it was the same.
SHIKI-sama was just like his father and only used me to let out his feelings."

entries.japanese:
「きっと、それで最後の感情が切れてしまったんだと思います。
　わたし、必死に考えました。
どうやったらこの現状を打破できるんだろうって。
　そうしたらですね、答えは簡単に出てしまったんです。
　ようするに遠野の一族がみんな消えてしまえばいいんだって。
槙久さまだけじゃなく、シキ様も痛いことしかしないのなら、もうそうするしかないでしょう？
　それに気がついた時、わたし、何年かぶりに笑ったんです。
　ほんとうに、なんでそんな簡単なことに気がつかなかったんだろうって、自分で自分が呆れるぐらいおかしかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I think that severed the last of my emotions”
“I thought desperately. How could I break free?”
“Then the answer came very easily”
“In short, the entire Tohno family had to disappear. If not only Master Makihisa but Master SHIKI could do nothing except hurt me, what other choice was there?”
“When I realized that, I laughed for the first time in years.”
“I found myself genuinely hilarious for taking so long to notice something so simple.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I think that had to have been what destroyed my last emotions.
I desperately thought about how I could break free from everything.
Then, I easily came up with a solution.
The whole Tohno family just had to disappear.
If not only Makihisa-sama but SHIKI-sama did those painful things, then that's the only possible thing to do, right?
And when I realized that, I laughed for the first time in years.
I was surprised that it was so simple and I didn't even realize it before."

entries.japanese:
「その時から、わたしはようやく自分で動けるようになりました。
　一番難しかったのは、わたしが動いていい理由を探すことだったんですよ。
人形は自分だけでは動けないんです。
ちゃんと操り糸とかゼンマイがないと、人間らしく振る舞えない。
　だから、その理由が見つかった後からはとても簡単でした。
　シキ様に槙久さまを拒絶させて、お互いの不信感を煽るだけでよかった。
　シキ様が血を飲んでみたいと言われたからわたしの血を飲ませてあげて、シキ様は悪くないって、今のままのシキ様を容認してあげただけです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“From then on, I could finally move by myself”
“The difficult part had been finding a reason I was allowed to move. A doll cannot move alone. It needs strings or a spring before it can behave like a person.”
“Once I found that reason, everything became very easy.”
“I only had to turn Master SHIKI against Master Makihisa and feed the mistrust between them.”
“When Master SHIKI said he wanted to drink blood, I let him drink mine and merely told him he had done nothing wrong while accepting him exactly as he was”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"From that time, I was able to start moving on my own.
The hardest thing for me was to find a reason to move.
A doll can't move by itself.
Without a spring or strings, it can't act like a human.
So, once I found a reason, everything became simple.
All I needed to do was to place mistrust between them by making SHIKI-sama reject Makihisa-sama.
SHIKI-sama said that he wanted to drink blood, so I gave him mine and told him that he wasn't a bad person and I kept him the way he was."

entries.japanese:
「シキ様が躁鬱になってしまわれた時は、特別に薬も調合してさしあげました。
　あっ、それって志貴さんにもお出しした薬なんですよ。
ほら、屋敷の裏庭にアサガオが咲いているでしょう？
　あれはチョウセンアサガオっていうんですけど、アレには三つの向精神物質が含まれているんです。
　簡単に言うと麻薬ですね。
服用した人をせん妄状態にしてしまうお薬です。
　意識を失わせて、わたしの言うことをちゃんと聞くようになって、目覚めたら何も覚えていないっていう便利なお薬。
　わたしは槙久さま付きの主治医になるように教育されてましたから、そうゆうのには詳しいんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“When Master SHIKI began swinging between mania and depression, I even prepared a special medicine for him.
“Actually, Master Shiki, it was the same medicine I served you. You have seen the morning glories in the rear garden, have you not? They are thorn apples, and they contain three psychoactive compounds.”
“Put simply, it is a narcotic. A medicine that induces delirium.”
“A convenient medicine that renders the patient unconscious, makes them follow my instructions, and leaves them with no memory when they wake.”
“I was trained to become Master Makihisa’s personal physician, so I know quite a lot about such things”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"When SHIKI-sama became sick, I took care to make special medicine for him.
Oh, it's the same as the one I gave you.
You know those morning glories in the garden behind the mansion?
They are called Chosen morning glories and have three kinds of mental effects.
In simple terms, it's a drug that makes people hallucinate.
Once they are unconscious, they listen to what I tell them, and when they wake up, they don't remember a thing.
Quite convenient, don't you think?
Because I was educated to become Makihisa-sama's personal doctor, I know a lot about these sorts of things."

entries.japanese:
「そういった事もあって、シキ様はわたしにとって都合のいい狂い方をしてしまいました。
　そのあとはもっと簡単です。
　夜中になったら槙久さまの部屋を覗くように、と秋葉さまに密告して、秋葉さまはようやくわたしと槙久さまの関係に気がつきました。
　それからというもの、秋葉さまはわたしに罪の意識をもってくれて何かとやりやすくなったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“With all that assistance, Master SHIKI went mad in exactly the way that suited me”
“Everything after that was easier still.”
“I sent Miss Akiha an anonymous message telling Miss Akiha to look into Master Makihisa’s room at midnight, and at last Miss Akiha discovered my relationship with Master Makihisa.”
“From then on, Miss Akiha felt guilty toward me, which made her much easier to manage.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"With things like that, SHIKI-sama went crazy at my convenience.
After that, it was even easier.
I secretly told Akiha-sama to look inside Makihisa-sama's room around midnight, and she finally found out about our relationship.
Since then, Akiha-sama felt guilty and it became easier to do a lot of things."

entries.japanese:
「まあ、秋葉さまがすぐに槙久さまに抗議したのは意外でしたけど。
秋葉さまの追及で槙久さまはすぐにわたしを自由にしてくれました。
　……わたし、シキ様が槙久さまを殺してしまうまで自由にはなれないって思っていたのに、実際には四年も早く自由になってしまったんですね。
　それから普通の使用人に戻ったわたしは、無口になってしまった翡翠ちゃんと入れ替わる事にしたんです。
　あ、けどその後も槙久さまとシキ様の相手をするのはわたしでしたから安心してくださいな。
翡翠ちゃんは、ずっとキレイなままですよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I admit, I had not expected Miss Akiha to confront Master Makihisa immediately. Under Miss Akiha’s accusations, Master Makihisa released me at once.”
“I had believed I would remain his prisoner until Master SHIKI killed Master Makihisa, but in fact I gained my freedom four years early.”
“After returning to life as an ordinary servant, I decided to exchange roles with Hisui, who had fallen silent”
Oh, but please do not worry; even afterward, I was still the one who attended to both Master Makihisa and Master SHIKI. Hisui has remained clean all this time.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I didn't expect her to protest against him right away though.
But because Akiha-sama pressed the issue, I was released from Makihisa-sama soon after.
…… I thought that I wouldn't be free until SHIKI-sama killed Makihisa-sama, but I was freed four years earlier, actually.
From then on, I became a normal servant and traded places with Hisui, who became silent.
Oh, but don't worry since I was the one who took care of SHIKI-sama and Makihisa-sama.
Hisui-chan was always clean of everything."

entries.japanese:
ニコリと笑って、彼女は話を終えた。
「……………」
　俺には、適切な言葉がうかばない。
　すべての元凶は遠野槙久にあったとしても。
　この顛末、この結果を望んで、筋書きを作ったのは目の前にいる少女だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
With one last bright smile, she finishes her story.
“……………”
No fitting words come to me.
Even if Makihisa Tohno was the source of everything.
The girl before me desired this conclusion, designed its every turn, and wrote the tragedy to its end.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Smiling, she ends her story.
"……………"
I don't know what to say.
Even if Tohno Makihisa was the main cause,
the one who wished it to turn out this way, and made it turn out this way is this girl before me.

entries.japanese:
「ですが志貴さん。
　わたしは秋葉お嬢さまが憎くもなかったし、シキ様も憎くはなかった。
こんな事をしたくなかった、というのも本当の気持ちなんです」
「――――――」
　……なにを、いまさら。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But, Master Shiki.
I did not hate Miss Akiha, nor Master SHIKI. It is also true that I never wanted to do any of this.”
“――――――”
What could she mean now, after everything.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But Shiki-san.
I didn't hate Akiha-sama or SHIKI-sama.
I didn't even want to do it.
Those are my true feelings."
"------"
…… How can she say that now?

entries.japanese:
「でも、わたしにはそうする事以外にやる事がなかった。
そんな目的を持たないと生きていけなかった。
人形は、自分の意思じゃ動けないんです。
何かに操ってもらわないと、人間らしく振る舞えない」
「だからって―――」
　……許されるはずがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But there was nothing else for me to do. I could not live without that purpose. A doll cannot move of its own will. Unless something pulls its strings, it cannot behave like a human being”
“Even so―――”
That could never absolve her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, there wasn't anything else I could do.
Without a purpose like that, I couldn't live.
A doll cannot move on its own.
Without anything to guide it, it can't move."
"But still--"
…… That is unforgivable.

entries.japanese:
「心からわたしの思惑どおりになってほしい、と思った事は一度もありません。
でも不思議なんです。
みんな、わたしの言葉を真に受けてしまう。
　たかだか十歳ていどの子供のつまらない囁きにその気になってしまうんです。
偶然というのは怖いですね」
　くすりと笑う琥珀。
「―――満足か、琥珀」
「わかりません。
わたしは楽しいとも悲しいとも感じなくなってしまった人形ですから」
　だろうな、と琥珀を見る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I never once truly wanted everything to go according to my plan. But it is strange. Everyone takes my words to heart.
A few foolish whispers from a child barely ten years old are enough to set them in motion. Chance is frightening.”
Kohaku laughs softly.
“―――Are you satisfied, Kohaku?”
“I do not know. I am a doll that can no longer feel either joy or sorrow.”
Of course, I think, looking at her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"There wasn't anything I ever wished from my heart.
But it's strange.
Everyone seriously accepts what I say.
Just the words of a ten-year-old child can manipulate their feelings.
Aren't coincidences scary?"
Kohaku giggles.
"--Are you satisfied, Kohaku?"
"I don't know.
I'm merely a doll that doesn't feel happiness or sadness."
I thought she'd say that.

entries.japanese:
……ここにいるのは限りなく人形に近い人間だ。
　とうの昔に感情が磨耗しきって、何もなくなってしまった少女。
　自分は痛みを感じない人形だって自分に言い聞かせる事で、本当に自分が人間ではない、痛みを感じない人形だと半分以上信じ込んでいる。
entries.maoEnglish:
What stands before me is a human being almost indistinguishable from a doll.
A woman whose feelings wore away to nothing long ago.
She survived by telling herself she was a doll that felt no pain, and now she more than half believes she is no longer human.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Before me is a human that is a doll.
A girl whose emotions were exhausted so long ago.
Nothing remains.
Telling herself that she is a doll that doesn't feel any pain.
More than half of her really believes it.

entries.japanese:
だから傷を負っても痛まない。
　シキが死んでも、秋葉が死んでも、悲しいとも嬉しいとも思わない。
　ただ。
　糸が命じるままに動いていた、虚ろな人間。
entries.maoEnglish:
That is why no wound can hurt her.
Whether SHIKI dies or Akiha dies, she feels neither grief nor joy.
Nothing more.
An empty human shell moving wherever the strings command.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's why injuries don't hurt her.
SHIKI and Akiha died, but she doesn't feel happy or sad.
She is just,
an empty shell manipulated by strings.

entries.japanese:
「でも―――――」
「え？」
「でも、一つだけ、不可解なことがありました」
　ほんの少し。
　わずか遠い目をして、彼女は言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But―――――”
“What?”
“But there is one thing I could never understand.”
For just a moment.
Her gaze goes distant as she speaks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But----"
"Eh?"
"But, there was just one strange thing."
Really just a little bit.
She said that as her eyes trailed off into the distance.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さまは、最後にわたしをかばってくれました。
ええ、半分ぐらいの確率でああなることは解っていたんです。
そうなるように秋葉さまに接してきたんですから。
　槙久さまの行った虐待も明かして、段々と人でなくなってしまう秋葉さまを献身的にお助けして。
―――そうですね、本当は確実にわたしをかばって死んでくれる、と解っていました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“At the end, Miss Akiha protected me. Yes, I knew there was perhaps an even chance she would. I had treated Miss Akiha all this time to make her do exactly that.
I told Miss Akiha about Master Makihisa’s abuse and devoted myself to helping Miss Akiha as she slowly ceased to be human.
―――No, that is not true; I knew for certain that Miss Akiha would shield me and die.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama protected me in the end.
I knew there was a fifty-fifty chance she would do that.
I stayed close to her for that reason.
Revealing Makihisa-sama's abuse and devotedly helping Akiha-sama who was slowly turning nonhuman.
---Yes that's right.
Really, I knew she would die protecting me."

entries.japanese:
その笑顔は。
　笑っているのにひどく悲しそうで、今にも――
「なのに―――わたしったら、あの時驚いてしまったんです。
なんでこの人はわたしを助けるのかなって。
自分が死んでしまうのに、なんでわたしを助けてくれたのかなって」
―――今にも、泣き出しそう、だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
That smile.
Though she is smiling, she looks terribly sad, as if at any moment――
“And yet―――when it happened, I was surprised. I wondered why she was saving me. Why would she save me when she knew it would cost her life?”
―――She looked ready to burst into tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That smile.
Even though she is smiling, she looks really sad, as if she's--
"But----I was really surprised at the time.
Why is she protecting me?
Why is she protecting me, risking her life?"
---She looks like she might burst into tears.

entries.japanese:
「実は今もよく分からないんです。
あのとき秋葉さまが死んで、わたしは本当に悲しんだのか喜んだのか。
　でも、今でもわたしは朝に目がさめると、もういないって解っているのに秋葉さまのお部屋にいって朝のお茶を淹れて差し上げてるんですよ。
　おかしいでしょ？
　あの部屋には、もう誰もいないっていうのに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“In truth, I still do not know. When Miss Akiha died, did I feel grief or joy?
Even now, when I wake in the morning, I go to Miss Akiha’s room and make Miss Akiha tea although I know she is gone.
Strange, is it not? There is no one left in that room.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I still don't actually understand if I was actually happy or sad when Akiha-sama died.
But when I wake up in the morning, I take tea to her room even though I know she is gone.
Isn't this strange?
Even though there's no one in that room anymore."

entries.japanese:
彼女の腕が何かを取り出す。
　しゅる、という絹ずれの音。
　布に包まれた細長いそれを握って、彼女は自分の胸に向けた。
　きらり、と日差しを反射させる刃物の光沢。
「こ――――！」
　走る。
　けれど、彼女のほうが早い。
―――とつ、という、味気ない音がして。
　彼女は、地面に倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her hand draws something out.
Silk whispers against silk.
She grips the long, cloth-wrapped object and turns it toward her own breast.
Sunlight flashed from a naked blade.
“Ko――――!”
I run.
But she is faster.
―――A small, flat sound, too ordinary to mean anything.
She crumples to the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She takes something out.
The sound of moving cloth.
Holding something long wrapped in cloth, she aims for her chest.
A shining blade reflects the sunlight.
"Ko----!"
I run.
But, she is much faster.
---A small sound.
And she collapses to the ground.

entries.japanese:
彼女は自分の短刀で胸をさして、そのまま倒れこんだ。
　駆け寄っても、遅すぎる。
　短刀は、確実に彼女の心臓を貫いていた。
　どくん、と意識がゆらぐ。
―――――理由もなく。
entries.maoEnglish:
She drives her own dagger into her chest and collapses.
By the time I reach her, it is already too late.
The blade has pierced her heart.
My consciousness reels with one violent throb.
―――――For no reason at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She stabs herself, and falls to the ground.
Even though I ran, it's already too late.
It has pierced her heart.
My mind reels.
----Without reason.

entries.japanese:
「ば―――なんで………！」
　抱きかかえる。
　胸には赤い牡丹のような、鮮血。
　彼女の笑顔はそれでも崩れない。
―――――それが、逆に。
　例えようもなく、哀れに、思えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh―――why………!”
I catch her in my arms.
Fresh blood blossoms across her chest like a crimson peony.
Even then, her smile never wavers.
―――――And that, instead.
Makes her seem more pitiful than words can say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha--why………!?"
I hold her in my arms.
Fresh blood blossoms from her chest like a flower.
Her smile still does not fade.
----On the contrary,
it seems indescribably pitiful.

entries.japanese:
「しっかりしろ……！
　なんだって、なんだってこんなこと……！」
「だって、復讐しかやる事がなかったから―――終わってしまえば消えるだけです。
色々と新しいゼンマイを見つけようとしたけど、結局見つからないで時間ぎれになっちゃいました」
　ニコリと笑う。
　それが、理由もなく――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stay with me…! Why would you do this…!”
“Because revenge was the only thing I had to do―――once it ended, all that remained was for me to disappear. I tried to find a new spring to wind me up, but time ran out”
She smiles.
For no reason at all, the sight of it――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hang in there…!
Why, why did you do that…!"
"Because revenge was the only thing I could do----I can only disappear when it's all over.
I tried to find new springs, but I could never find one, and time ran out."
She smiles.
That… for no reason at all----

entries.japanese:
「なんだよそれ、おまえなに言ってんだよ…！」
　秋葉の時と同じように、琥珀の傷を見る。
―――助からない。
　これは、確実に、心臓を貫いてしまっている。
「………っ」
　どうしてだろう。
　理由もなく、ただ―――悲しくて、こらえ、きれなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What the hell are you talking about…!”
As I did with Akiha, I examine Kohaku’s wound.
―――She cannot be saved.
The blade has unquestionably pierced her heart.
“……………!”
I do not know why.
For no reason at all―――the grief comes, and I cannot hold it back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What the hell is that?
What are you saying…!"
I look at the wound like I did to Akiha.
---She won't make it.
It has pierced her heart.
"………"
Why?
There was no reason---I just can't bear the sadness.

entries.japanese:
……彼女は目を細めて青空を見ている。
　中庭の木の下。
　八年前、この屋敷を出て行く自分に、遠くから眺めているだけだった少女がリボンを餞別にくれた場所。
　ここは。
　再会を約束した、大きな木の下だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
She narrows her eyes at the blue sky.
Beneath the courtyard tree.
The place where, eight years ago, the woman who had only watched me from afar gave me a ribbon as a parting gift.
Here.
Beneath the great tree where we promised to meet again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… She's looking up to the blue sky with thinned eyes.
Under the tree in the courtyard.
Eight years ago, when I was leaving this mansion, the place where the girl who was just looking out the window gave me a ribbon as a present.
This is…
where we promised to meet again, under this big tree.

entries.japanese:
「あのリボンは、お気に入りだったんです」
　ぽつりと呟く。
「だから今度会った時には返してねっていったのに。
　約束、守ってくれませんでしたね、志貴さん」
「あれは―――だって」
　勘違いして、翡翠の物なんだって、思ってしまったから――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“I loved that ribbon.”
The words barely escape her lips.
“I told you to give it back when we met again.
You did not keep your promise, Master Shiki”
“But that―――I thought”
I had mistaken it for Hisui’s ribbon――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That ribbon, it was my favorite."
She speaks lightly.
"That's why I asked you to return it when we met again.
But you didn't keep your promise, Shiki-san."
"But--that…"
I was mistaken, and thought it was Hisui's----

entries.japanese:
「一つだけ賭けをしてたんですよ、わたし。
　もし翡翠ちゃんと入れ替わったわたしを、あの時の男の子が気づいてくれたなら―――こんな事、もう止めようって」
「ば―――なんだよそれ。
最後になって俺に責任を押し付けようっていうのか、おまえは……！」
　怒鳴りながら、手は必死に傷口の止血をしようとする。
　けれど死は無惨だ。
　無慈悲に、正確に、一分の狂いも遅れもなく。
　彼女の命の針を、かちかちとゼロの位置まで進ませていっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I made one little wager.”
“If the boy from that day recognized me after I traded places with Hisui―――I would stop all of this”
“You id―――what the hell is that?! Now, at the very end, you are trying to make it my fault…!”
Even as I shout, my hands fight desperately to staunch the wound.
But death is merciless.
Without pity or error, neither a second early nor late.
It ticks the needle of her life steadily down toward zero.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I made a little bet with myself.
That if that boy noticed that I switched places with Hisui-chan----then I would quit everything."
"Wha---what is that?
Are you trying to make me responsible for it at the end…!"
As I shout, my hand desperately tries to stop her bleeding.
But, death truly is miserable.
Ruthless, and accurate, without even a delay or the failure of a single second.
The clock of her life counts down to zero.

entries.japanese:
「くそ―――ふざけやがって！
　なにが一つだけ賭けをしました、だ！
　おまえのせいで秋葉は、秋葉は――――」
　必死に止血する。
　理由もなく、悲しくて。
　涙が、瞳からあふれていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it―――do not give me that! What do you mean, ‘I made one wager’?! Because of you, Akiha, Akiha――――”
I fight desperately to stop the bleeding.
For no reason at all, the sorrow is unbearable.
Tears stream from my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn it, don't be ridiculous!
What the hell do you mean you made a bet!?
Because of you Akiha was, Akiha was----"
I frantically try to stop the bleeding.
Sad, without a reason.
The tears flow from my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「あれ？
　泣いてるんですね、志貴さん」
「―――悪いかよっ！
　ちくしょう、おまえが一番わるいヤツだって解ってるのに、くそう、なんだって俺は、こんなに――――」
　そう、こんなに――――
「琥珀に、死んでなんかほしくないってんだ、くそォ……！」
　ぼろぼろと涙がこぼれる。
　彼女は、くすりと笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh? You are crying, Master Shiki”
“―――Is that a problem?! Damn it, I know you are the worst of all, so why am I so――――”
Yes, this sad――――
“I do not want you to die, Kohaku, damn it…!”
Tears pour down my face.
She laughs softly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
You're crying, Shiki-san."
"---Well excuse me!
Damn it!
I know it's your fault, damn it, so why do I----"
That's right---
"Kohaku, I still don't want you to die, damn it……!"
Tears flow down.
She smiles again.

entries.japanese:
「優しいんですね、志貴さんは。
でも気にしないでください。
わたしは人形ですから、痛くも怖くもありません」
「またそれか―――おまえは、なんでそんな―――」
「だってそのほうがすごく楽なんですよ？
　人間だといろんな事が辛すぎて、すごく、痛かったんです。
でも誰も助けてくれなかった。
どこにも出口なんかなかった」
　そう、と小さく息をはいて。
　彼女は、目を瞑って思い出す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are kind, Master Shiki. But please do not worry. I am a doll, so this neither hurts nor frightens me”
“That again―――why do you keep―――”
“Because it is so much easier, is it not? Being human made everything too painful. No one helped me. There was no way out”
She exhales a quiet sigh.
Closing her eyes, she remembers.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, you are too kind.
But please don't worry about it.
I'm just a doll, so I don't feel pain or fear."
"That again---why do you---"
"But it is much easier this way.
Being a human, everything is painful and it hurts too much.
But no one saved me, I couldn't escape."
She exhales slightly.
She closes her eyes and remembers.

entries.japanese:
「なんか、思い出してきちゃいました。
　……子供のころのお話です。
　わたしね、怖くて痛くて、でも死ぬのはもっとイヤだった。
　遠野槙久は大きくて、絵本でみる魔物そのものだった。
　遠野の屋敷は広すぎて、おばけ屋敷みたいだった。
　日々はいつも寒くて、泣き叫ぶのが日課だった。
　けど声をあげるともっとひどい事をされるから、ずっと我慢しているしかなかった」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Things are coming back to me now.”
“This is from when I was younger.”
“I was frightened, and it hurt, but I was even more frightened of dying.”
“Makihisa Tohno was huge, just like the monsters in picture books.”
“The Tohno mansion was so vast it seemed haunted.”
“Every day was cold, and every day I screamed and cried.”
“But crying aloud only made him do worse things to me, so all I could do was endure in silence”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I just remembered something.
…… It was when I was a child.
I was scared and hurt, but more scared of dying.
Tohno Makihisa was huge, like a demon out of a story book.
The mansion was too big, like a haunted house.
Every day was cold, and it was my daily routine to cry and scream.
But if I raised my voice, it got worse, so I had to endure it all."

entries.japanese:
「なのに、妹は外で楽しそうに遊んでいました。
　わたしがどんなに願っても出る事ができなかった、おばけ屋敷の窓をとびこえて簡単に、お日さまの下で笑っていたんです。
　……なんだか、みんな悲しい事ばっかりでした。
　だから。
　痛みを感じない、人形になろうと、思ったんだっけ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And all the while, my younger sister played happily outside.”
“She easily slipped through the windows of the haunted house I could never escape, no matter how desperately I wished.”
“Somehow, everything was always sad.”
“And so.”
“I decided I would become a doll that could not feel pain”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, my sister was playing outside.
She was laughing under the sun by easily jumping out the window of the haunted house, where I could not get out, no matter how much I wished for it.
…… Come to think of it, everything was sad.
That's why.
That's why I wanted to become a doll that didn't feel pain."

entries.japanese:
出血は止まらない。
　彼女は瞳を閉じたままで、痛みしかなかった揺籃の記憶を懐かしむ。
entries.maoEnglish:
The bleeding will not stop.
With her eyes still closed, she looks back fondly upon memories that held nothing but pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The bleeding doesn't stop.
With her eyes still closed, she remembers the childhood filled only with pain.

entries.japanese:
「痛いのはイヤなんです。
　だから、人形になってしまえばいいと」
「琥……珀？」
「そうして、私のからだは少しずつ脈打つのをやめていきました。
　血管は一本ずつチューブになって。
　血液は蒸気のように消えていって。
　心臓もなにもかも、形だけの細工になる。
　そうすれば、なにも痛くなんかなくなるでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I hate pain.
So I thought I should simply become a doll.”
“Kohaku?”
“Then, little by little, my body stops beating.”
“One by one, my veins become tubes.”
“My blood vanishes like steam.”
“My heart and everything else become hollow pieces made only to look real.”
“Nothing can hurt me after that, can it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't like pain.
That's why I thought it would be better to become a doll."
"Ko…… haku?"
"And gradually, my body stopped generating a pulse.
Blood vessels turned into tubes one by one.
Blood vanished like vapor.
My heart, everything, just crafted parts.
If I did that, there would be no more pain, right?"

entries.japanese:
「な…………………」
　俺は、何もいえない。
　自分を人形だと思いこんだ少女。
　自分を人形なんだと思いこまなければ生きていけなかった少女。
　そうして、本当に自分が人形なんだと錯覚してしまうほど、そんな事以外に救いというものがなかった琥珀。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
I have no words.
A woman who has convinced herself she is a doll.
A woman who could not have survived without believing it.
Kohaku, denied every other form of salvation until she could almost mistake that fantasy for truth.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha……………………"
I can't say anything.
A girl who thought she was a doll.
A girl who couldn't live without thinking that she was a doll.
Kohaku had no other means of salvation but to maintain an illusion that she really was a doll.

entries.japanese:
「だから、いくら志貴さんが優しくても泣かなくていいんです。
人形が一つ、壊れたていどの話なんですから」
　琥珀は瞳を閉じたままだ。
―――それは、違う。
　手を握って、いや、と首をふった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So no matter how kind Master Shiki is, there is no need to cry. This is only one broken doll”
Kohaku keeps her eyes closed.
―――That is wrong.
I clasp her hand and shake my head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why, even if you are this kind, there is no need for tears.
It's just a doll breaking."
Kohaku still keeps her eyes closed.
---No, that is wrong.
I grasp her hand, and shake my head in refusal.

entries.japanese:
「違う……！
　琥珀は人間だ。
人形になんかなれない……！
　琥珀はちゃんと生きてる、生きてる人間じゃないか……！
　その証拠にこうやって、今も赤い血を流してるだろ！」
「あ。
それは、たしかにそうですね」
　目をつむったまま、あはは、と彼女は笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are wrong…! You are human, Kohaku. You cannot turn yourself into a doll…! You are alive, a living human being…! Your blood is red, is it not?!”
“Oh. That is true, is it not?”
She laughs, her eyes still closed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No…!
Kohaku, you are human.
You can't be a doll…!
Kohaku, you're alive, you're a living human being…!
As proof, you are bleeding red blood right now!"
"Ah, that's right."
She laughs again.

entries.japanese:
「……だろ？
　秋葉のことが好きで、翡翠のことをいつも気にかけていて、俺とばか話をして笑っていた、普通の女の子なんだ。
　だから―――」
　彼女がそう望んで、結果として秋葉が死んでしまって、シキが狂ってしまった結末をむかえたとしても。
「―――琥珀が、死ぬことなんか、なかったんだ」
　握った掌に力を込めて、本心から、そんな言葉を搾り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Right? You love Akiha, always look out for Hisui, and are an ordinary woman who laughed with me over stupid things”
“So―――”
Even if her wishes brought about an ending in which Akiha died and SHIKI went mad.
“―――Kohaku did not have to die”
I tighten my grip on her hand and force the words from the deepest part of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Right?
You're a normal girl who liked Akiha, was always worried about Hisui, and laughed when we talked about stupid things.
So----"
Even if she wished it and caused the deaths of Akiha and SHIKI…
"--Kohaku, there was no reason for you to die."
Increasing my grip, I say these words from the bottom of my heart.

entries.japanese:
「……ふふ。
志貴さんは、思った、とおりの、男の子、なんです、ね。
わたし……やっと、話せたん、だ」
　どくん、と。
　一際高く、最後に一度だけというように。
　大きく、彼女の胸が上下した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hehe. Master Shiki, you really are the man I thought you were. I finally got to talk to you”
Thump.
Louder than before, as if it saved all its strength for one final beat.
Her chest rises and falls.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huhu.
Shiki-san, you are just the boy I thought you would be.
I…… finally got to speak to you."
Her heartbeat.
Her heartbeat surges like it is a grand finale.
Her chest rises and falls.

entries.japanese:
……閉じられていた瞳があく。
　彼女は、最後に。
　高い高い、青空を見た。
「そう―――やっぱり、ただの思い込みだったんですね」
　こふっ、と口から血がこぼれる。
――――痛い、と。
　小さく、彼女は呟いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her closed eyes open.
And for the last time.
She looks up at the blue sky, high, high above.
“I see―――so it really was only something I made myself believe.”
Blood wells from her mouth with a soft cough.
――――“It hurts.”
She whispers it softly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Her closed eyes open.
At the very end.
She looks at the deep, distant blue sky.
"I see---I guess it was only an illusion after all."
She coughs up blood.
----It hurts.
She whispers softly.

entries.japanese:
「だから、人形だったら、よかったのに」
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish: “That is why I wish I really had been a doll.”!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon: "That's why--I wanted to be a doll."

entries.japanese:
そうして、彼女は息をひきとった。
　うつろな瞳のまま、永遠に青い空を見上げている。
　それは作り物の笑顔ではなく、静かな、とても悲しそうな、顔だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
And then she dies.
Her empty eyes stare forever into the blue sky.
The face she leaves behind wears no counterfeit smile, only a quiet, terribly sad expression.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then, she passes away.
The hollow eyes endlessly look into the blue sky.
Not a fake smile, but a quiet and very sad face.

entries.japanese:
――――部屋を出て、門へ向かう。
　二人きりの静かな朝食を終えて、いつも通り屋敷の庭を後にする。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I leave the room and head for the gate.
After our quiet breakfast together, I cross the grounds and leave the mansion as I always do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Leaving my room, I head towards the gate.
After a quiet meal together, we leave the garden behind.

entries.japanese:
「行ってらっしゃいませ、志貴さま。
近頃は寒くなってまいりましたから、あまり無茶はなさらないようにしてください」
「ああ。
翡翠もあんまり無茶しないようにね」
　翡翠から鞄を受け取って、屋敷の門に背を向けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Have a safe day, Master Shiki. The weather has grown cold lately, so please do not overexert yourself”
“All right. You take care of yourself too, Hisui”
I take my bag from her and turn away from the mansion gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please be careful, Shiki-sama.
It has become cold recently, so do not strain yourself."
"Yeah.
Don't strain yourself either, Hisui."
Taking my bag from Hisui, I turn my back to the mansion.

entries.japanese:
坂道は長く、どこまでも続いているかのように、街へと伸びている。
　なだらかな坂道と、吸いこまれてしまいそうなほど青い空。
　ふと、幻視した。
　この下りの坂道がはしごのように空へと伸びていて、晴れやかな青空に届こうとする姿を。
―――それを見て、何の理由もなく。
　　　哀しい出来事を、思い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
The long road descends toward the city as if it might continue forever.
A gentle slope beneath a sky so blue it threatens to draw me in.
For an instant, I see a vision.
The road stretches upward like a ladder, climbing into that brilliant blue as though trying to reach the sky.
―――At the sight of it, for no reason at all.
I remember something sorrowful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The road is long, as if it goes on forever.
The gently sloping road, and the blue sky that might suck me in.
I see an illusion.
The road, like a ladder, heading to the sky, trying to reach the clear, blue sky.
---I see that, and for no reason.
I remember that sorrowful affair.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――翡翠」
「はい。
なんでしょうか、志貴さま」
「……ん、明日から冬休みだって言っただろ？
　今日はすぐに帰ってくるからさ、帰ってきたら街にでないか。
ちょっと相談したい事もあるし」
「は―――？
　街に、ですか」
「そう。
冬休みになったらさ、どこか旅行にでもいこうよ。
……まあ、まだ何処に行くか決めてないから、翡翠に選んでもらおうかなって思ってるんだけど」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――Hisui”
“Yes. What is it, Master Shiki?”
“I told you winter break starts tomorrow, right? I will be home early today, so when I get back, shall we go into town? There is something I want to discuss with you”
“Wha―――? Into town?”
“Yes. Once break starts, let us take a trip somewhere. I have not decided where, so I thought I might let you choose”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Hisui."
"Yes.
What is it, Shiki-sama?"
"…… Mm, tomorrow is the start of winter break, right?
I'll come straight home, so how about we go to town?
I have something I want to talk about, too."
"Huh--?
To town?"
"Yeah.
Once it is winter vacation, let's take a trip somewhere.
…… Well, I don't know where yet, so I was thinking of letting you decide."

entries.japanese:
翡翠は黙り込んでしまった。
　……それもそうか。
翡翠は決して屋敷から出ようとしない。
　屋敷の外に出る役割は全て琥珀さんが行っていて、翡翠は八年前から外に出る事がなくなってしまった。
　……それが気に食わない、という訳じゃない。
　ただ、本当に。
　翡翠とどこか知らない所に行って、少しずつ、哀しい事に負けないように、楽しい事を増やそうと思っただけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui falls silent.
Of course. Hisui never willingly leaves the mansion.
Kohaku handled every errand beyond the grounds, and Hisui has not ventured outside in eight years.
It is not that I resent her for it.
Only, truly.
I simply want to go somewhere new with Hisui and gather happy memories little by little, enough that sorrow can no longer defeat us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui stands there in silence.
…… That's right.
Hisui doesn't leave the mansion for herself.
Kohaku-san was always the one to take care of things outside, so Hisui never left for eight years.
…… It isn't that I don't like that fact.
Only, it's just that,
I wanted to go somewhere new with Hisui and wanted to increase our fun memories so we won't lose against all the sad memories.

entries.japanese:
「どうかな。
翡翠が嫌だっていうんなら別にいいけど」
「――――いいえ、志貴さまとご一緒できるのでしたら嬉しいです。
わたし、楽しみにしていますね」
「そっか。
なら昼前には帰ってくるからさ、普段着に着替えて待っててくれ。
一緒に計画を練ろう……っと、もしかしたらトンデモないのが一人憑いてくるかもしんないけど、そん時はそん時ってことで」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you think? It’s fine if you don’t want to.”
“――――No, I would be happy to go with Master Shiki. I am looking forward to it”
“I see. Then I will be home before noon, so change into something casual and wait; we can make plans together. Though one particular menace may end up tagging along, and if so, we will deal with it then”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What do you think?
If you don't want to, I don't mind either way."
"----No, if I get to be with you, it would make me very happy.
I--will look forward to it."
"I see.
Then, I'll be back before noon.
Please be waiting in some regular clothes.
Then we'll figure out what to do…… and maybe a terrible guy might come along too, but we'll deal with it then if it happens."

entries.japanese:
はい？
　と首をかしげる翡翠。
　……学校に行ったら旅行慣れしている有彦に相談する事になるんだろうけど、あいつの事だから付いてくると言い出しかねない。
―――まあ、それはそれで。
　有彦の姉貴あたりを誘って、大勢で遊びに行くのも悪くはないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Hisui tilts her head. “What?”
Once I reach school, I will probably ask the well-traveled Arihiko for advice, and knowing him, he may insist on coming along.
―――Then again, perhaps that wouldn’t be so bad.
We could invite Arihiko’s sister and make a proper group outing of it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Hisui tilts her head questioningly, but agrees.
…… When I go to school, I will end up asking for suggestions from Arihiko, but considering him, he will want to come along.
---Well, that's that.
I can ask his sister to come along too and going with a lot of people might not be bad either.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ行ってくる。
見送りありがとう、翡翠！」
　そう告げて、坂道を駆け下りた。
　道は長く、なだらかに街へと続いている。
　俺は背中に温かな翡翠の視線を感じながら、晴れやかな青空の下を駆けていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am off, then. Thanks for seeing me out, Hisui!”
With that, I run down the hill.
The road is long and gentle, leading toward the city.
I run beneath the clear blue sky, the warmth of Hisui’s gaze against my back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, I'm off.
Thanks for sending me off, Hisui!"
Saying that, I run down the hill.
The road is long, and continues into the town.
I run under the clear blue sky and feel the warmth of Hisui's gaze on my back.

entries.japanese: そうして、わたしは彼を送り出しました。
entries.maoEnglish: And so I watch him go.
entries.mirrorMoon: And, I see him off.

entries.japanese:
いつも通りの日課を終えて、門に手をかける。
　屋敷にはもうわたししかいません。
　姉さんも秋葉さまもいなくなって、新しい使用人も、新しい当主もやってくる事はないそうです。
　妹を失った彼に譲られたものは、この屋敷と、いくらかのお金だけ。
　幸いお屋敷を維持するための費用は全て遠野家の分家の方々が持ってくれる事になったので、すぐにこの屋敷から出て行く、という事はなさそうです。
entries.maoEnglish:
My customary duty done, I put a hand to the gate.
I am the only one left in the mansion now.
My sister and Miss Akiha are gone, and I am told no new servants or new master will ever come.
All he inherited after losing his sister was this mansion and a modest sum of money.
Fortunately, the branch families of the Tohno family have agreed to pay for the estate’s upkeep, so it seems we will not have to leave anytime soon.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This daily task done, I close the gate.
The only one left in the mansion is me.
Nee-san and Akiha-sama are no longer here.
And it seems that no new servants or masters will be coming.

His sister left him this mansion and some money.
Since the money that is used to maintain this place will be paid by the members of the branched Tohno family, it seems we will not have to leave here anytime soon.

entries.japanese:
―――休みになったら、どこか旅行にいかないか。
　その言葉に、わたしは頷く事にしました。
　……あの日から、わたしはこのお屋敷から外に出る事を自ら禁じていました。
　姉さんがわたしの代わりに槙久さまの相手をしていると知った時から、ずっと、外に出る事を嫌っていたんです。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Why don’t we take a trip once break begins?
I decide to accept his invitation.
Since that day, I have forbidden myself to leave this mansion.
Ever since I learned that my sister was enduring Master Makihisa in my place, I have hated going outside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Once vacation starts, do you want to take a trip?
I decided to nod to those words.
…… Ever since that day, I forbade myself from leaving this mansion.
Ever since I found out Makihisa-sama was using Nee-san like that in my place, I hated going outside.

entries.japanese:
だってそうでしょう？
　姉さんはわたしを汚さないために身を差し出しました。
　だからわたしは、決して穢れてはいけなかった。
　誰であろうと男の人には決して触れない。
姉さんを汚し続けた異性の指なんて触れない。

わたしはただ、機械のようになればいいと思いました。
　外に出れば汚れてしまうから、わたしはこの屋敷に留まればいい。
　この、無菌室のようなお屋敷に閉じこもって、ずっと汚れずにいなければならなかった。
　だって、姉さんがわたしを守ってくれたから。
　わたしにできる事は、人形のように綺麗なままでいる事だけだって、思ったんです。
「……でも、それも終わりにしますね。
　わたしは外にでようと思います、姉さん」
entries.maoEnglish:
It is only right, is it not? My sister offered herself to keep me undefiled.
So I could never allow myself to be tainted.
I will never touch any man. I will never touch a man’s hands—not after men kept defiling my sister.
I thought I should become a machine.
The world outside would stain me, so I would remain in the mansion.
I had to seal myself inside this sterile chamber of a house and stay pure forever.
My sister had protected me, after all.
The only thing I could do for her was remain beautiful and untouched, like a doll.
“But I am putting an end to that now.
I am going outside, Sister”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Isn't it natural?
Nee-san did that so I would stay clean.
So, I had to stay clean, no matter what.
I would not let any male touch me.
I would never touch the fingers of the gender that used my sister like that.
I thought it would be better if I was just like a machine.
If I went outside, I would get dirty, so it would be better if I stayed inside.
If I locked myself away in the sterile mansion, I would never become dirty.
Because Nee-san protected me.
I thought the only thing I could do was become like a doll, staying pretty forever.
"…… But, I will end that, will I not?
I am thinking of going outside, Nee-san."

entries.japanese:
正午にさしかかって、普段着に着替えた。
　……自分の服を着るのは何年ぶりだろう。
袖を通してみて、ひどく背中が軽くなった事に驚いた。
　あれだけ着なれていたメイド服は、この普段着の軽さに比べるとまるで重い枷のようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
As noon approaches, I change into ordinary clothes.
How many years has it been since I last wore something of my own? When I slip my arms into the sleeves, I am startled by how light my back feels.
Beside these simple clothes, the maid’s uniform I wore for so long feels like a heavy set of shackles.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Once it gets close to noon, I change my clothes.
…… It's been years since I last wore my own clothes.
Pushing my hands through the sleeves, I am amazed at how light it is.
That maid uniform I got used to so much, compared to these light regular clothes, is really heavy.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――あ」
　ざあ、と風が吹いた。
　髪に結ぼうと手にとっていたリボンが飛んでいく。
　それは白い。
　とても昔、ある少女が彼に贈った、ただ一つの思い出だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――Ah”
A gust of wind sweeps through.
The ribbon I am about to tie into my hair flies from my hand.
It is white.
The sole keepsake a certain woman gave him long, long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Ah."
A wind blows.
The hair ribbon that was in my hand flies off.
It is white.
It was a lone memory that a girl gave to him a long time ago.

entries.japanese:
リボンはどこまでも飛んでいく。
　風に乗って、もとから有りはしなかったかのように、森の中へ融けていく。
「待って、それは―――――」
　追いかけようとして、足を止めた。
　アレは少女のものだった。
　わたしの物ではないから、せめてそれだけでも持ち主のもとに帰すべきなんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
The ribbon flies on and on.
Riding the wind, it melts into the woods as though it had never existed at all.
“Wait, that is―――――”
I start after it, then stop.
It belonged to that woman.
It was never mine, so perhaps this much, at least, ought to return to its owner.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The ribbon flies up and up.
Riding the wind, as if it was never there before, it vanishes into the forest.
"Wait, that was----"
I try to chase after it, and I stop.
That was the girl's ribbon.
It is not mine, so I guess I have to at least give that back to her.

entries.japanese:
わたしの手には約束がある。
　あのリボンを渡した少女が待ち望んだ約束だけは、今もわたしの中に生きている。
　だから―――あのリボンだけは、せめて。
　少女が夢見た場所に、還ろうとしたのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
A promise rests in my hands.
The promise that the woman who gave him that ribbon waited so long to see fulfilled still lives within me.
And so―――the ribbon, at least.
Perhaps it is trying to return to the place that woman dreamed of.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In my hand, I hold a promise.
That awaited promise of the girl who gave that ribbon still lives inside of me.
So---just that ribbon, at least.
I think it tried to return to the place the girl dreamed of.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　約束は果たされる。
　彼がわたしをあの時の少女と思ったのなら、わたしはその少女の夢を叶えなければいけない。
　わたしが彼を愛したように。
　少女もずっと、男の子を愛していた筈だから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
The promise will be kept.
If he believes I am the woman from that day, then I must fulfill her dream.
Just as I came to love him.
She, too, must have loved that man all these years.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
Promises are fulfilled.
If he thought I was that girl, then I will have to fulfill her dream.
Like how I love him.
That girl had to have always loved him too.

entries.japanese:
思えば、わたしたちは本当によく似た姉妹だった。
　わたしと姉さんは入れ替わったけれど、入れ替わった時に翡翠を演じていた姉さんは完璧に翡翠を演じていた。
　屈託のない笑顔。
　まっすぐな感情。
　そして、彼への淡い恋心も、本当の気持ちにして。
entries.maoEnglish:
Looking back, my sister and I truly were alike.
Though we exchanged places, once my sister began playing Hisui, she played the part perfectly.
An untroubled smile.
An honest heart.
Even her tender love for him became real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Come to think of it, we really were sisters alike each other.
Nee-san and I traded places, but Nee-san really did a perfect job of acting out my part.
That carefree smile.
Those straightforward emotions.
And that fleeting experience of love with him, those were all real.

entries.japanese:
あれは芝居だったけれど、姉さんは翡翠でいるときだけ、本当に、素直な気持ちで彼を愛していたんだ。
　翡翠という役割になって、心から彼を愛した。
　……昔。
　少女が望んで、ずっと待ち続けた夢を見るように。
entries.maoEnglish:
It began as an act, but only while she was Hisui could my sister truly love him openly and without deceit.
She stepped into the role of Hisui and loved him with all her heart.
Long ago.
As though living the dream a young woman had wished for and awaited all those years.
entries.mirrorMoon:
