Even though it was just an elaborate play, Nee-san really did love him when she played my role.
She played my part perfectly, and she loved him from the bottom of her heart.
…… Long ago.
As if watching a dream that girl always wished and waited for.

entries.japanese:
「だから、姉さん。
わたしは、わたしに戻らないと」
　それがすぐに出来るとは思えないけど、少しずつがんばろう。
　もう昔の自分のようには振る舞えないかもしれないけど、それでも精一杯―――今の自分のまま、少女の夢を叶えないといけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So, Sister. I have to become myself again”
I cannot imagine it will happen all at once, but I will try, little by little.
I may never be able to behave as I did before, but even so, I must do everything I can―――as the person I am now, I must fulfill that woman’s dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's why, Nee-san.
That's why I have to return to myself."
I don't think I can do it right away, but I can do it gradually.
Maybe I won't be able to behave exactly as I was back then, but with all my strength----I must fulfill her dream, as I am right now.

entries.japanese:
男の子がいなくなった後、姉さんが昔のわたしとそっくりの性格をするようになったのは、それがしたかったから。
　……少女の夢は、翡翠という少女になって遠野志貴と恋をする事だった。
　だからわたしはその夢をかなえる。
　自分の幼いころからの夢と、姉さんの夢を守るために、これからずっと―――あの人の側にいよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
After the boy left, my sister began acting exactly as I once had because that was what she wanted.
The woman’s dream was to become Hisui and fall in love with Shiki Tohno.
So I will fulfill that dream.
To protect both the dream I cherished long ago and the dream my sister made her own, I will remain beside him from this day forward―――always.
entries.mirrorMoon:
After the boy left, Nee-san acted like me because she wanted to do that.
…… Her dream was always to be Hisui and to love Tohno Shiki.
So I will grant her dream.
For the sake of my childhood dream, and for Nee-san's dream, I will always---always be by his side.

entries.japanese:
「あ―――――――」
　遠くから騒がしい声が聞こえてきた。
　……帰ってこられたみたいだけど、なんだか騒がしい。
　……一人ではなく、何人かお友達を連れてこられたみたいだ。
―――翡翠、と呼ぶ声が聞こえる。
　わたしは窓に映った自分の姿を確かめてから、玄関へと走り出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――――”
A clamor of voices reaches me from far away.
He seems to have returned, but it sounds strangely noisy.
Apparently he has brought several friends with him.
―――I hear someone call out, “Hisui.”
After checking my reflection in the window, I run for the entrance hall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah------"
I hear noisy voices in the distance.
…… It seems like he has returned, but it is noisy.
…… He is not alone, but it looks like he brought some friends.
--A voice calls my name.
Checking myself in the reflection off a window, I hurry to the entrance.

entries.japanese:
―――空は、どこまでも高い青い空。
　翡翠は待ち続けた男の子を出迎えて、なんでもない事がただ楽しくて、お互いに笑いあう。
　それは飽きる事なく続く日々の欠片。
　ずっと待ち焦がれていた穏やかな世界。
　それを、ずっと、ずっと待っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――The sky is blue and high without end.
Hisui welcomes home the boy she waited for so long, and they smile together over the simplest things.
One fragment of days that go on without ever growing stale.
The gentle world she has longed for all her life.
She had waited and waited for precisely this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The sky, the infinite deep, blue, sky.
Hisui greets the long-awaited boy, takes delight in such normal things, and returns a smile.
That is something that will continue tirelessly, day after day.
The long-awaited peaceful world.
I have been waiting for it for so, so long.

entries.japanese:
自由に飛び立てる日がやってくると信じて、部屋の窓から高い空を見上げていた。
　いつか世界に羽がはえて。
　この背中にも羽がはえて。
　わたしは姉さんのように笑顔になれて、あの男の子と笑いあえる。
――――――それが、とおい昔に。
　　　　　　幼い少女が見ていた、
　　　　　　或る一つの夢だった――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
She used to gaze through her window at the high sky, believing the day would come when she could spread her wings and fly free.
Someday the world would grow wings.
Someday wings would grow from her own back.
Then she would learn to smile like her sister and laugh together with that boy.
――――――Long, long ago.
A woman dreamed of
One small dream――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Always believing that one day I would be flying freely, I always stood by the window, looking up at the deep sky.
That one day, wings would sprout from this world.
And wings would sprout from this back.
And I will smile like Nee-san with that boy.
------This is what the little girl,
so long ago,
dreamed of------

entries.japanese:
翡翠・トゥルーエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　トゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングがそれです。
　どちらかのエンディングに辿り着いた後、少しだけ戻ってもう一度物語を進めてみてください。
　なにか違った展開が待っている事でしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Hisui’s True Ending.
Each heroine has two endings, with one exception.
They are the True Ending and the Good Ending.
Once you reach either one, go back a little and play through the story again.
A different turn of events should be waiting for you.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Hisui's True Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings.
A True Ending and a Good Ending.
After reaching one of the endings, please go back a little and readvance through the story.
A different event should await you.

entries.japanese:
それでは、ここまでプレイしていただいてありがとうございました。
　また“月姫”のどこかでお会いしましょうね。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for playing this far.
I hope we meet again somewhere in TSUKIHIME.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well then, thank you very much for playing up to this point.
Let's meet again somewhere in Tsukihime.

entries.japanese:
翡翠・グッドエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　トゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングがそれです。
　翡翠さんのグッドに来るためにはトゥルーを経過していなければいけませんので、これで翡翠さんは完璧ですね！
entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Hisui’s Good Ending.
Each heroine has two endings, with one exception.
They are the True Ending and the Good Ending.
Since Hisui’s True Ending must be completed before her Good Ending becomes available, you have now seen her entire story!
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Hisui's Good Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings.
A True Ending and a Good Ending.
Since you can't reach Hisui-san's Good Ending without seeing the True Ending, you have now finished Hisui-san's route completely!

entries.japanese:
それではここまでプレイしていただいてありがとうございました。
　また“月姫”のどこかでお会いしましょう！
「知得留さん。
私も伝えなければならない事があるんですが」
　あれ、ロア博士。
珍しいですね、こういった席に出てらっしゃるなんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for playing this far.
I hope we meet again somewhere in TSUKIHIME!
“Ciel. There’s something I must tell you as well.”
Oh, Doctor Roa. How unusual to see you at an occasion like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well then, thank you very much for playing up to this point.
Let's meet again somewhere in Tsukihime.
"Ciel-san.
I also have something I must impart."
Huh, Professor Roa?
This is rare indeed for you to come to a place like this."

entries.japanese:
「事が事ですからね。
要点だけ説明しますと、翡翠さんをクリアしてから一日目をやり直すと、ある選択肢が増えています。
　事実上、月姫における最終ルートの登場というコトですね。
　……まあ、私がこのような事を言わなくてもグラフィックモードに行ってもらえれば一目瞭然なのですが」
　そうですねー。
　それでは引き続き月姫をお楽しみください。
entries.maoEnglish:
“The circumstances warrant it. In brief, if you restart from day one after completing Hisui’s route, a new choice will have appeared.
In effect, it opens TSUKIHIME’s final route.
Though a glance at the Gallery would make that obvious without any explanation from me.”
Quite right.
Please continue enjoying TSUKIHIME.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"This circumstance is unique.
I will get to the point right away.
Now that you have cleared Hisui-san's route, there should be another choice for you on the first day.
This is the unlocking of the last route in Tsukihime.
…… Well, even if I do not tell you this, it is very clear if you go to the graphic mode."
That's right.
Well then, please continue on and enjoy Tsukihime!

entries.japanese:
「ヒ――――！」
　泣き声とも笑い声ともつかない声をあげて、シキが跳ねる。
　それこそ火花の速度で跳ねる、黒い影。
「こ―――――――――」
　ここからでは、間に合わない。
　間に合うとしたら、それは―――――
「しまっ―――」
　秋葉がシキへと振り返る。
　咄嗟に身を構える秋葉。
だが黒い影は秋葉には行かない。
　シキは、秋葉にではなく、その横にいる琥珀さんに向かって跳ねたのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“H――――!”
With a sound poised between sobbing and laughter, SHIKI springs.
A black shadow leaps as fast as a spark.
“Ko―――――――――”
From here, I cannot reach them in time.
If anyone can reach them, it is―――――
“No―――”
Akiha turns toward SHIKI.
Akiha raises her guard on instinct. But the black shadow is not coming for her.
SHIKI leaps not at Akiha but at Kohaku beside her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Heee----!"
SHIKI lunges with a cry.
His black shape explodes forward like a firework.

"Ko---------"
I can't make it from here.
If there's anything that would make it, that would be----
"Dam---"
Akiha turns towards SHIKI.
Akiha instantly prepares for his attack.
But the black figure isn't going towards Akiha.
SHIKI lunges not at Akiha, but at Kohaku-san who stands next to her.

entries.japanese:
「こは――――――――」
―――アイツは知っている。
　今の俺がこうして動けるのが翡翠の力によるもののように。
　秋葉の圧倒的な力が、琥珀さんの助けによるものだっていう事を。
「琥珀さん、伏せろ―――――――――！」
　叫んだ。
初めからシキが琥珀さんを狙うと解っていたかのように、全身で声をあげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Koha――――――――”
―――He knows.
Just as Hisui’s strength is what keeps me moving.
SHIKI knows that Kohaku’s help is the source of Akiha’s overwhelming strength.
“Kohaku, get down―――――――――!”
I shout. The cry tears from my whole body as though I knew from the start that SHIKI would target Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Koha---------"
---He knows.
Just like I am able to move right now because of Hisui's power…
He knows that Akiha's overwhelming power is possible from Kohaku-san's help.
"Kohaku-san, get down---------!"
I shout.
Like if I knew SHIKI was going for Kohaku all along, I shout from the bottom of my lungs.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀…………！」
　秋葉の体が琥珀さんの前に流れる。
―――――まさか。
　身を呈して、琥珀さんを守ろうというのか。
「ヒ―――ィィイイイイ！」
　シキは声をあげて、槍のような腕を琥珀さんの顔に向かって突き出す。
　そこに割って入る秋葉の体。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku…!”
Akiha sweeps in front of her.
―――――No.
She cannot possibly mean to shield Kohaku with her own body.
“H―――iiiiii!”
SHIKI shrieks and thrusts his spear-like arm toward Kohaku’s face.
Akiha throws herself between them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku………!"
Akiha throws her body in front of Kohaku.
-----I don't believe it.
Is she sacrificing her body to protect Kohaku-san?
"Hee---eeeeeee!"
SHIKI raises his voice, and with his arm thrusting like a spear, aims for Kohaku's face.
Akiha forces herself in between them.

entries.japanese:
――――それは、絶望的なまでのタイミングだ。
　見たくない。
　琥珀さんを庇って、秋葉が、その代わりに死んでしまうなんて、そんな所は。
「だ―――――め……………！！！！！」
　その直前。
　今まで聞いた事がなかった、琥珀さんの、泣くような声が聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――The timing is hopelessly perfect.
I do not want to see it.
I cannot watch Akiha die in Kohaku’s place because she tried to protect her.
“No―――――……………!!!!!”
An instant before it happens.
I hear a voice I have never heard from Kohaku, raw with tears.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Her timing is perfect.
I don't want to look.
I don't want to see Akiha die as she protects Kohaku-san.
"N-----o……!!!!"
Right before it all happens,
I hear a voice which I've never heard before: Kohaku-san's crying voice.

entries.japanese:
ずしゃ、という肉を裂く音がした。
　赤い血が廊下にこぼれる。
「え―――――――――」
　放心したような琥珀さんの声。
　彼女は、咄嗟に秋葉を突き飛ばした。
　自分の身を庇おうとした秋葉を突き飛ばして、自分から、シキの爪の前に身を投げ出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
I hear the wet sound of flesh tearing.
Red blood spills across the corridor.
“What―――――――――”
Kohaku’s voice is stunned.
At the last instant, she shoves Akiha aside.
She throws Akiha aside as Akiha tries to shield her, then casts herself before SHIKI’s claws.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of rending flesh.
Red blood drips down onto the hallway.
"Eh---------"
Kohaku-san's voice almost sounds absent-minded.
She has quickly pushed Akiha away.
She pushed Akiha trying to protect her, and threw herself in front of SHIKI's claws.

entries.japanese:
「キ――――キサ、マ」
　シキの声は怒りで震えている。
　……赤い血は流れていく。
「あ―――――ちが、違うんだ、秋葉。
オレは、オマエを傷つけようなんて、少しも――――」
　ぶるぶると首をふる。
　シキの目の前には、片腕を真っ赤に染めて倒れた秋葉がいた。
　……琥珀さんが突き飛ばしてくれたおかげで、シキの爪は秋葉の腕を裂くにとどまったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Y――――you bastard”
SHIKI’s voice trembles with rage.
Red blood keeps flowing.
“N―――――no, Akiha. I never meant to hurt you, not even――――”
He shakes his head violently.
Akiha lies before him, one arm drenched in red.
Thanks to Kohaku’s shove, SHIKI’s claws must have torn only Akiha’s arm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Y-----you!"
SHIKI's voice quivers with anger.
…… Red blood continues to flow forth.
"Ah------no, no, Akiha.
I, didn't mean, to hurt you----"
He shakes his head.
In front of SHIKI, Akiha lies collapsed, her arm coated with blood.
…… Thanks to Kohaku-san pushing her away, it seems only Akiha's arm was shredded by SHIKI's claws.

entries.japanese:
「っ……くっ…………あ！」
　床に倒れて、苦しげに片腕を押さえる秋葉。
　それを震えながら見下ろすシキと。
　呆然と、それこそ人形のように立ち尽くしている琥珀さん。
「あ――――キサ、キサマが、オレの邪魔をするのか……！」
　シキが顔をあげる。
　その先には琥珀さんがいる。
　……どうしてなのか。
　琥珀さんは、魂を抜かれてしまったかのように、ぴくりとも動いていなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh, ah!”
Akiha lies on the floor, clutching her arm in agony.
SHIKI stands trembling over her.
Kohaku remains frozen in shock, as motionless as a doll.
“Y――――you dare stand in my way…!”
SHIKI raises his head.
Kohaku stands before him.
Why.
She does not twitch, as though her soul has been torn from her body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… G…… wah!"
Lying on the ground, Akiha writhes in agony, clutching her arm.
SHIKI stands dumbstruck, shaking as he looks down.
Kohaku-san, fixated with surprise, stands there unmoving, like a doll.
"You-----you bitch, are you trying to get in my way……!?"
SHIKI lifts his head.
Kohaku-san is in front of him.
…… Why is it?
She is just standing there, not moving a muscle, as if her soul had fled her body.

entries.japanese:
「キサマ――――キサマ、までオレの邪魔を…………！」
　シキが咆える。
「志貴さま…………！」
　懇願するような翡翠の声。
　そんなの言われるまでもない。
　琥珀さんが身を呈して秋葉を助けてくれたように、今度は俺がヤツを絶対に止めてみせる……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“You――――you too would stand in my way…………!”
SHIKI roars.
“Master Shiki…………!”
Hisui’s voice pleads with me.
She does not need to say it.
Just as Kohaku threw herself in the way to save Akiha, this time I will stop him no matter what it takes…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You----you, also get in my way………!?"
SHIKI howls.
"Shiki-sama………!"
Hisui's pleading voice.
She doesn't even have to tell me.
Like Kohaku-san protecting Akiha, this time, I'll stop him for sure……!

entries.japanese:
「シキ…………！」
　走る。
メガネはとうに外してある。
　視えている線は横一文字に断頭できる首と、左大胸筋から腹部中部までの斜線。
　……どちらにしても、“通せば”確実に仕留められる。
　ナイフを強く握ったまま、自分のモノとは思えない速さで廊下を駆けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI…………!”
I run. My glasses are already off.
I can see one line crossing his neck, a stroke that will sever his head, and another slanting from his left breast down to the middle of his abdomen.
Whichever line I pass through, I can finish him for certain.
Knife clenched tight, I hurtle down the corridor at a speed that cannot belong to me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI…………!"
I run, my glasses already off.
The lines I see are across his neck and from his upper left chest to his stomach.
…… Either one will do.
If I work my knife through either one, it will surely kill him.
Gripping my knife firmly, I fly down the hallway with a speed that surprises even myself.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――！」
　振り向くシキ。
　だが、圧倒的に俺のほうが速い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――!”
SHIKI spins around.
But I am overwhelmingly faster.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------!"
SHIKI turns towards me.
But, I'm much faster.

entries.japanese:
「くあああああああああああああああ！？」
　苦悶の声が廊下に反響する。
「ひ――――――は、ははははははははは！」
　気が違ったかのような笑い。
――――浅かったか。
　なんて甘さ。
秋葉の前で―――実の兄であるシキの首を刎ねるのを躊躇った。
　ヤツの胸部から走る斜線。
それを、途中までしか断てなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Guaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah?!”
His howl of agony echoes through the corridor.
“H――――――ahahahahahahaha!”
Then comes laughter, utterly deranged.
――――Too shallow.
What weakness. With Akiha watching―――I hesitate to behead SHIKI, her own brother.
The slanting line runs down his chest. I cut it only halfway.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kuaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?"
His anguished cry reverberates through the hallway.
"Hii------ha, hahahahahahaha!"
An insane laugh.
----It was too shallow.
How naive.
In front of Akiha---I hesitated in cutting her real brother's neck.
The line that runs through his body.
I was only able to cut it halfway.

entries.japanese:
「ひは、はははははははははははははははは！」
　笑い声をあげて、シキは後退する。
　ヤツはそのまま、隙だらけの背中を見せてズルズルと階段へと逃げ出してしまった。
　……追う事はたやすい。
　けど今は、それより何倍も大切なコトがある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Heeha, hahahahahahahahahahahahaha!”
Still laughing, SHIKI staggers backward.
Then he turns his defenseless back on me and drags himself toward the stairs.
Chasing him would be easy.
But something many times more important needs me now.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hiha, hahahahahahahahahaha!"
Laughing wildly, SHIKI pulls back.
Like that, he escapes towards the stairs.
…… Following him would be easy.
But there's something more important for me to do.

entries.japanese:
「――――秋葉！
　しっかりしろ、秋葉……！」
　ひざまずいて秋葉の体を診る。
　……ひどい。
　秋葉の右腕は二の腕の部分をざっくりと裂かれて、赤いペンキを塗りたくられたようだった。
「……ぁ……兄さ……どうして……こんな、トコロに――――」
　朦朧とした瞳。
　はぁはぁと乱れた呼吸と蒼ざめた顔色。
　……その全身に広がっていく、夥しい死のカタチ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Akiha! Stay with me, Akiha…!”
I drop beside her and examine the wound.
It is terrible.
Her upper right arm has been ripped wide open, as though someone slathered it in red paint.
“Brother, why are you here――――”
Her eyes are clouded.
Her breath comes in ragged gasps, her face drained of color.
Shapes of death multiply across her entire body.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Akiha!
Hang in there, Akiha……!"
Kneeling down, I look over her body.
…… This is terrible.
Her right arm is almost split in two and painted an awful crimson.
"…… Ah…… Nii-sa…… why…… are you here----"
Her eyes are hazy.
Her shallow breathing, her pale face.
…… The figure of death stretches across her body.

entries.japanese:
「……どう、して……部屋で、おとなしくして、いないん、ですか…………」
「ば――――黙ってろ……！
　話は後でいくらでもするから、今は黙っててくれ……！」
「……そんな、の…………イヤ、です……にいさ、いつから、ココに、いた――――」
　広がっていく。
　秋葉の出血に合わせて、死の線が広がっていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why did you not stay quietly in your room…………”
“J――――just be quiet…! We can speak later, as much as you want, so please be quiet now…!”
“I do not want that, Brother; how long have you been here――――”
The lines spread.
The Lines of Death spread with Akiha’s bleeding.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Why, aren't…… you, resting, in your, room………?"
"D----don't talk……!
We can talk about it later, for now, just don't talk……!"
"…… No, ……… I won't…… Nii-san, how long, have you, been, here----"
It's spreading.

With her bleeding, her lines of death spread across her body.

entries.japanese:
「いいから黙ってろよおまえは……！
　頼む―――頼むから、今ぐらいは大人しく、していて、くれ…………！」
「…………………………うん。
にいさ、がそう言うの、でしたら―――あきはは、お行儀よく、してます、ね――――」
　なにか、無理やりな笑みをうかべて、秋葉は口を閉ざした。
　……いや、それは。
　たんに、もう、話す事も見る事もできないぐらい、衰弱しているという、コト。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Just be quiet…!
Please―――please, just lie still for now…………!”
“All right. If you say so, Brother―――Akiha will behave――――”
She forces something like a smile, then falls silent.
No, it is not obedience.
She is simply too weak even to speak or see.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright, just be quiet……!
Please---I beg of you, for now, just calm down, please…………!"
"………………………… Okay.
If you say so---then I will, be obedient, Nii-san----"
With a forced smile, Akiha closes her mouth.
…… No, that…
Simply put, she's so weak she can't even speak.

entries.japanese:
「ちが―――違う…………！！！！
　待ってろ、すぐに止血してやるからな……！」
　服を脱いで、即席の布にして秋葉の腕を縛る。
「くそ――――こんなんじゃ意味がない……！
　ちくしょう……！
　なんで、こんなに血が流れたら、それだけで死んじまうっていうのに、どうして…………！」
　必死に秋葉の腕を縛る。
　……それでどうにかなる筈がないと解っているのに、それ以外なにをするべきかも考え付かない。
　俺は。
　自分で自分が半狂乱になっているって解っているのに、冷静になるコトが、どうしてもできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No―――no…………!!!! Hold on, I will stop the bleeding…!”
I strip off my clothes and use them as a makeshift bandage around her arm.
“Damn――――this is useless…! Damn it…! When this much blood alone can kill her, why…………!”
I bind Akiha’s arm desperately.
I know it can never be enough, yet I cannot think of anything else to do.
Me.
I know I am half out of my mind, but no matter how hard I try, I cannot make myself calm down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"N---no………!!!!
Wait, I'll stop the bleeding……!"
Taking off my shirt, I wrap it around her arm.
"Damn----this is useless……!
Shit……!
If the bleeding doesn't stop, she'll die, why doesn't………!"
I frantically tie it around her arm.
…… I know that it will not help her at all, but I can't think of anything else to do.
I…
I know that I'm starting to go crazy, but I still cannot calm myself.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、落ち着いてください……！
　それ以上秋葉さまの腕を縛られては逆効果です」
「翡翠――――――けど！」
「……大丈夫です！
　秋葉さまは死にません。
姉さんがいるのですから、秋葉さまはすぐに持ちなおします。
……ね、そうでしょう姉さん？」
　翡翠は人形のように立ちつくす琥珀さんの手を引いて、秋葉の隣に座らせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, please calm down…! Binding Miss Akiha’s arm any more tightly will only make things worse.”
“Hisui――――――but!”
“It will be all right! Miss Akiha will not die. Sister is here, so Miss Akiha will recover at once. Is that not so, Sister?”
Hisui takes Kohaku’s hand as she stands there like a doll and seats her beside Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please calm down……!
If you tie it any tighter, it will not help her."
"Hisui-------but!"
"…… It is alright!
Akiha-sama will not die.
If Nee-san is here, Akiha-sama will heal.
…… Nee-san, is that not right?"
Hisui pulls Kohaku-san, who's still standing like a motionless doll, and sits her next to Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「……姉さん。
今は、秋葉さまだけに感応してあげてください。
姉さんだって秋葉さまに助かってほしいから、自分から壊してしまったのでしょう？」
「―――――――――――――」
　翡翠は琥珀さんの白い手をそっと、両手で包んだ。
　琥珀さんの視線は、まだ宙を見つめている。
　それでも―――翡翠の言葉が届いたのか、あれだけ流れていた秋葉の血は、波が引くかのように止まってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sister. Please attune yourself only to Miss Akiha for now. You destroyed your own plan because you wanted Miss Akiha to live, did you not?”
“―――――――――――――”
Hisui gently encloses Kohaku’s white hand between her own.
Kohaku’s vacant gaze remains fixed upon the air.
Even so―――perhaps Hisui’s words reach her, because the blood pouring from Akiha’s wound ebbs away like a retreating tide.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nee-san.
For now, please synchronize with Akiha-sama.
You destroyed everything because you wanted Akiha-sama saved, is that not right?"
"-------------"
Hisui wraps both of her hands around Kohaku-san's white hand.
But Kohaku-san's gaze is still empty.
But---maybe Hisui's words reach her after all.
Akiha's blood stops spilling forth.

entries.japanese:
「は―――――――ぁ」
　……胸を撫で下ろす。
　これで―――助かった。
　さっきまで漠然と抱いていた不安。
……秋葉が死んでしまうという最悪の不安が、少しずつ、消えていく。
「――――――――」
　秋葉は琥珀さんと翡翠が助けてくれる。
　なら、俺は。
　遠野志貴にしかできない決着を、つけてこなくてはいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha―――――――ah”
Relief floods through me.
Now―――she is safe.
The shapeless dread I carried until moments ago begins to fade. The worst fear of all, that Akiha might die, recedes little by little.
“――――――――”
Kohaku and Hisui will save Akiha.
Then, I.
Must go settle this in the one way only Shiki Tohno can.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha--------ah."
…… I relax.
With this---I can be assured.
The uneasiness that gripped me before.
The uneasiness that Akiha would meet the worst fate starts to gradually disappear.
"--------"
Akiha will be helped by Hisui and Kohaku-san.
So.
As Tohno Shiki, I will have to end this.

entries.japanese:
「――――――翡翠。
秋葉と琥珀さんを頼む」
「……志貴さま。
やはり、行かれるのですか」
「―――――ある意味アイツと俺は似たもの同士だからな。
せめて自分の手で、幕を下ろさせてやらないと」
「…………………………」
　翡翠は無言で見つめてくる。
　……その瞳が行くなと言っているけど、こればっかりは聞くわけにはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Hisui. Take care of Akiha and Kohaku for me”
“Master Shiki. You are still going?”
“―――――In a way, he and I are alike. I owe it to him to bring down the curtain with my own hands”
“…………………………”
Hisui gazes at me in silence.
Her eyes beg me not to go, but this is the one plea I cannot grant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Hisui.
I leave Akiha and Kohaku-san up to you."
"…… Shiki-sama, you are still planning to go, are you not?"
"-----We are the same type, he and I.
The least I can do is put him to rest."
"…………………"
Hisui wordlessly stares at me.
…… Her eyes beg me not to go, but I can't listen to them.

entries.japanese:
「……ここまでありがとう、翡翠。
君がいてくれて、本当に良かった」
　歩き出す。
　背中にじっと向けられる視線を振り払って、シキの後を追いかけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you for everything, Hisui. I truly am glad you were here”
I start walking.
Tearing myself free of the gaze fixed upon my back, I follow SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Thanks for everything up until now, Hisui.
I'm so glad you were with me."
I walk away.
Feeling her watch me as I leave, I follow after SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
―――血の跡が点々と続いている。
　本気で逃げる気はなかったのか、それとも逃げるという行為さえ解らないほど正気ではないのか。
　シキは、まるで俺を待つように廊下に佇んでいた。
「―――――シキ」
　声をかける。
　シキは焦点の合っていない眼で、こちらを見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Drops of blood make a trail down the corridor.
Perhaps he never meant to escape, or perhaps he is too far gone even to understand what escape means.
SHIKI stands in the corridor as though waiting for me.
“―――――SHIKI”
I call out to him.
SHIKI looks at me with unfocused eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---The path of blood continues.
Maybe he didn't try to really escape, or maybe he isn't even sane enough to understand what running away means.
SHIKI is standing in the hallway as if waiting for me.
"-----SHIKI!"
I call out.
SHIKI looks over at me with his unfocused eyes.

entries.japanese:
「は――――――また、オマエか」
　シキは動かない。
　……先の俺の一撃と、秋葉につけられた傷のせいだろう。
　アイツは、もうマトモに動ける体をしていない。
「くそ――――また失敗だ。
うまくいかない。
どうしてこううまくいかないんだよ……！
　成功しない、うまくいったためしがない、いつもオレは間違える………！！！！！
　おかしいじゃないか、なんでアイツがオレの邪魔をするんだ！
　アイツが、アイツの言うとおりにちゃんとやってきたのに、どうしていつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもいつもオレの邪魔をするんだ、オマエは！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha――――――so it is you again”
SHIKI does not move.
My earlier blow and the wound Akiha dealt him must be to blame.
His body is no longer capable of moving properly.
“Damn――――another failure. Nothing works. Why does nothing ever work…!
Nothing succeeds, nothing ever goes right, I am always wrong………!!!!!
It makes no sense! I did everything exactly the way she told me, so why do you always, always, always, always, always, always, always, always, always, always, always, always get in my way!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha------you again?"
SHIKI doesn't move.
…… Probably because of the wounds by me and Akiha.
He doesn't have a body that can move properly.
"Shit----I failed again.
It won't work out right.
Why is everything getting ruined……!?
It won't work, it never works out right, I always mess up………!!!!
That's strange, why is she getting in my way!?
He, he came just like I was told, so why does he always always always always always always always always always always always always get in my way!?"

entries.japanese:
……シキの目は虚空を睨んでいる。
　ヤツは初めから、誰も見ていなかったのかもしれない。
　こうして目の前でナイフを持っている俺でさえも、シキにとってはただの邪魔物にすぎないのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
SHIKI’s eyes glare into empty space.
Perhaps he never saw anyone from the very beginning.
Even I, standing before him with a knife, may be nothing more than another obstruction.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… SHIKI's eyes are just hollow orbs.
Maybe he didn't even see anyone from the very beginning?
He only sees me before him, holding my knife, as just another obstacle.

entries.japanese:
「シキ。
そんなに、苦しいのか」
「苦しい？
　オレが？
　どうして？」
　シキは心底可笑しそうに笑って、ゆらりと立ち上がった。
「オレは苦しくなんかない。
素晴らしい人生だ。
何をしても、誰にも、オレを罰するコトなんかできない」
　シキの瞳に殺意が灯る。
　……やる気になったか。
　月光の下。
　今まで何度も知っていたのに、初めて出会った敵に向かって、一歩踏みこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI. Does it hurt that badly?”
“Hurt? Me? Why?”
He laughs as though the question is genuinely hilarious, then sways to his feet.
“I am not suffering. My life is magnificent. Whatever I do, no one can punish me”
Murder kindles in his eyes.
So he is ready.
Beneath the moonlight.
I step toward an enemy I have known countless times and am meeting for the first time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"SHIKI.
Are you, in pain?"
"In pain?
Me?
Why?"
SHIKI laughs as if it is so funny, and slowly stands up.
"I'm not in any pain.
This is a wonderful life.
No matter what I do, no one can punish me."
SHIKI's eyes burn with the desire to kill.
…… It seems he's ready.
Underneath the moonlight.
Even though I've known him for so long, I take my first step towards the enemy I just met tonight.

entries.japanese:
「いいぜ、殺し合おうじゃないか！
　オレを邪魔者扱いスルヤツは全員敵だ！
　一人、一人のこらず殺してやる！
　おまえも、おまえも、秋葉も、琥珀も！
　俺を死ぬまで地下牢に閉じ込めるなんて言いやがった親父と同じように、ズタズタに殺してやる……！」
　狂人のように雄たけびをあげるシキ。
―――その姿が、ひどく哀れだったからだろうか。
　これから殺し合いをするというのに、俺は冷静で、氷そのもののようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Fine, let us kill each other! Anyone who treats me as an obstacle is my enemy! I will kill every last one of you! You, you, Akiha, and Kohaku! Just like my old man who said he would lock me underground until I died, I will tear you all apart…!”
SHIKI howls like a madman.
―――Perhaps it is because he looks so pitiful.
Though we are about to fight to the death, I am perfectly calm, cold as ice itself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine, let's fight to the death!
All those who get in my way are my enemy.
I'll kill you all.
You, you, Akiha, Kohaku!
Just like that old man who wanted to lock me up till I died, I'll kill you all……!"
SHIKI screams like a raving lunatic.
---Maybe because that figure looks terribly pitiful.
Even though this is a fight to the death, I remain cool and collected, like ice.

entries.japanese:
「はっ、はは、ははははははははははは！」
　真正面からシキが襲いかかってくる。
「――――――――――――――」
　なんていうコトはない。
　皿の上にもられた肉にナイフを通すように、苦も無く、遠野シキを切断した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ha, haha, hahahahahahahahaha!”
SHIKI charges straight at me.
“――――――――――――――”
There is nothing to it.
As effortlessly as drawing a knife through meat laid upon a plate, I cut straight through SHIKI Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"HA, HAHA, HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
SHIKI attacks me head on.
"--------------"
It's nothing difficult.
Like I'm cutting meat on a plate, I easily slice through Tohno SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
ごとん、と。
　シキの首が床に落ちる。
　力を失ったシキの体は、そのまま俺にのしかかってきた。
「―――――――――」
　何も感じない。
　後悔も痛みも、憎悪も嫌悪も。
　まるでさっきの琥珀さんのように、俺は人形にでもなってしまったかのようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a heavy thud.
SHIKI’s head falls to the floor.
His limp body topples against me.
“―――――――――”
I feel nothing.
No regret, no pain, no hatred or disgust.
Like Kohaku moments before, it is as though I, too, have become a doll.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thud.
SHIKI's head falls to the floor.
His powerless body falls against mine.
"---------"
I don't feel anything.
I don't feel regret, pain, hatred, or disgust.
Like Kohaku-san was earlier, I just stand like a doll.

entries.japanese:
「く―――――――クク、く」
　……ありえない笑い声。
　床に転がったシキの顔が、笑っている。
「スゴイぞ、オマエ―――こんな冷たい痛みは初めてだ。
なんて―――なんて素晴らしい、邪魔者」
　笑いながら、シキの顔は灰になっていく。
　さらさらと、少しずつ消えていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kh―――――――kheh, kh”
An impossible laugh.
SHIKI’s severed face laughs from the floor.
“You are incredible―――I have never felt pain this cold. What―――what a magnificent obstacle”
Still laughing, SHIKI’s face crumbles into ash.
Little by little, it sifts away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ku------kuku, ku."
…… An unbelievable laughing voice.
SHIKI's laughing head rolls on the ground.
"You're wonderful---this is the first time I felt this cold pain!
What a---what a superb hinderer you are!"
Still laughing, his face dissolves into ash.
Gradually, it disappears into the wind.

entries.japanese:
シキは失せる。
　その前に、ぎょろりと俺を見て、不思議そうに声をあげた。
「―――それで。
オマエ、誰だ」
「……え？」
「オマエは、誰だよ」
「……解らないのか。
俺はおまえがずっと標的にしていた遠野志貴だ」
「ああ、そっか。
オマエが志貴だったのか」
　消えていくシキの顔。
「なんだ――――聞いていた外見と、全然違うじゃない、か」
　そう遺して、シキは完全に風化していった。
entries.maoEnglish:
SHIKI vanishes.
Before he disappears, his eyes roll toward me and he calls out in genuine puzzlement.
“―――So. Who are you?”
“What?”
“Who are you?”
“You do not know? I am Shiki Tohno, the man you have been hunting all this time”
“Oh, I see. So you were Shiki”
SHIKI’s face continues to dissolve.
“Strange――――you look nothing like the description I was given”
With those final words, SHIKI crumbles completely away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
SHIKI is disappearing.
Before he does, he looks up at me, and curiously says.
"---So who are you, anyway?"
"…… Eh?"
"Who are you?"
"…… You don't know?
I'm the Tohno Shiki you were always targeting."
"Ah, I see.
You're Shiki."
His disappearing face.
"What's this?
----You look nothing… like what I heard."
With that, he completely disappears.

entries.japanese:
―――――――終わった。
　　　　　　　これで、終わった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――It is over.
Now it is all over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-------It's over.

With this, it's over.

entries.japanese:
何も感じない。
　自分を悩ます頭痛がなくなった事とか、これで人並みの体に戻れた事とか、そんな事は嬉しくもなんともない。
entries.maoEnglish:
I feel nothing.
The headaches that tormented me are gone, and my body is ordinary again, but none of it makes me happy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I don't feel anything.
I won't feel those splitting headaches, I can return to life as normal--but I don't feel happy.

entries.japanese:
――――――それで。
何が終わったのか。
entries.maoEnglish: ――――――So. What has ended?
entries.mirrorMoon:
----And?
Just what ended?

entries.japanese:
「―――――なんで」
　くらりと、眩暈がする。
　シキの最後の言葉が、眩暈になって網膜から剥がれない。
　確かに何かが終わった。
　けれど何が終わったのか、そもそも何を終わらせようとしていたのか、俺には解らない。
「――――――――」
　月を見上げる。
　漠然とした暗闇に心がとらわれたまま。
　ただ呆然と、翡翠がやってくるまでの間、月光の下で佇んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――Why”
Vertigo washes over me.
SHIKI’s last words cling to my vision, a dizziness I cannot scrape from my eyes.
Something has certainly ended.
But I no longer know what it is or even what I set out to end in the first place.
“――――――――”
I look up at the moon.
My heart remains caught in a vague darkness.
I stand dazed beneath the moonlight until Hisui comes for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----Why?"
I feel dizzy.
SHIKI's last words won't fade away.
Something did end.
But I don't know what ended, or in the beginning, what I was trying to end.
"--------"
I look up at the moon.
In the vague darkness, my heart is enthralled.
Until Hisui came, I just stood in dumb amazement, standing in the moonlight.

entries.japanese:
それからの一週間は、慌しく過ぎていった。
　シキの遺体はその痕跡を一切残さずに風化し、秋葉の腕の傷も大事なく治療が施された。
　遠野志貴としての自分の立場はあやふやな物になってしまったが、いまさら七夜志貴なんていう人間には戻れない。
　そんなこっちの心情を知ってか知らずか、秋葉はあの夜の事を口にしようとしなかった。
　遠野家の当主である秋葉がとぼけている、という事もあって、このまましばらくは遠野志貴としての生活が送れると思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
The following week passed in a blur.
SHIKI’s remains had crumbled away without leaving a trace, and Akiha’s wounded arm was treated without lasting harm.
My standing as Shiki Tohno had become uncertain, but I could no longer return to being Shiki Nanaya.
Whether she understood how I felt or not, Akiha never spoke of that night.
And so long as the head of the Tohno family chose to feign ignorance, I believed I could continue living as Shiki Tohno for a while longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The next week passed quickly.
SHIKI's body vanished without a trace and the wound in Akiha's arm was treated.
Even though my place as Tohno Shiki became vague, I can't go back to being Nanaya Shiki.
I don't know if she understands my feelings or not about it, but Akiha hasn't said one word about that night.
If Akiha, the head of the household, is going to play dumb, then I think I can continue my life as Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
――――平穏だった日常は戻ってきた。
　シキが消えた事によって俺の体力は回復したし、秋葉の傷も順調に回復していっている。
　琥珀さんと翡翠は変わらず屋敷で働いていてくれるし、どこにも不安の影なんてなかった。
　……ないと、信じこんでいたかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Our peaceful, ordinary life returned.
With SHIKI gone, my strength returned, and Akiha’s wound healed steadily.
Kohaku and Hisui continued their work at the mansion as though nothing had changed, and there was no shadow of unease anywhere.
Or so I desperately wanted to believe.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The peaceful days have returned.
Since SHIKI disappeared, all my strength returned and Akiha is healing well, too.
Kohaku-san and Hisui go back to their regular duties at the mansion and there isn't a trace of uneasiness.
…… I want to believe that there isn't.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん？
　もうお昼ですよ、兄さん」
　……近くで呆れたような声が聞こえる。
「もう、天気がいいからってこんな所で眠らないでください。
お昼寝でしたらご自分のお部屋でしたらいいじゃないですか」
　……トントン、と肩を叩く指先。
「ん――――」
　それで、胡乱な夢から目が覚めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother? It’s noon already, Brother.”
An exasperated voice sounds nearby.
“Honestly, don’t fall asleep here simply because the weather is pleasant. If you want a nap, you have a bedroom of your own.”
Fingertips tap against my shoulder.
“Mmm――――”
That wakes me from a murky dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san?
It's noon already, Nii-san."
…… I hear a voice.
"Geez, even though it's so nice outside, please do not sleep in such a place.
If you want to take a nap, do so in your room."
…… Fingers tap my shoulder.
"Nnn----"
With that, I wake from my dream.

entries.japanese:
「………ん、おはよう秋葉」
「おはよう、じゃありません。
何をするでもなく居間にやってきて、そのまま眠ってしまうなんて何考えているんですか、兄さんは」
「………………まあ、色々と考えてるけど」
　はあ、と重苦しいため息をついてソファーから立ち上がる。
「ちょっと兄さん。
本気で自分の部屋で寝直すつもりじゃないでしょうね。
　……ほら、せっかくの休日なんですから、もっとこう、有意義に使おうとか思いません？
　例えばの話ですけど、たまには家族と親睦を深めるために遊びに出かけたりとか、日頃の感謝の意をこめて遊びに誘ってくれるとか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Morning, Akiha”
“Do not ‘morning’ me. What possessed you to wander into the sitting room, do nothing, and fall asleep, Brother?”
“I have had a few things on my mind”
With a heavy sigh, I rise from the sofa.
“Hey, Brother. You aren’t seriously planning to go back to bed in your room, are you?
A holiday is a chance to do something worthwhile, do you not think? For example, you could go out with your family to grow closer or invite someone somewhere to show your gratitude”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Nnn, morning, Akiha."
"Don't say 'morning!' Coming to the sitting room only to sleep… Just what were you thinking, Nii-san?"
"……………… Well, I was thinking about this and that."
Giving a deep sigh, I get up from the sofa.
"Wait a minute, Nii-san.
Are you going to actually go sleep in your room?
…… Hey, don't you think you should actually do something worthwhile on your day off?
To give you examples, like going out to deepen bonds with family members, or invite them to have fun out of gratitude."

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　秋葉の言う有意義は、ひどく限定されている気がする。
「……そりゃあ思うよ。
秋葉が思ってる有意義さと俺の思ってる有意義さは違うだろうけど、二度寝するのはもったいない。
　それなのに部屋に戻る理由は簡単。
寝起きに秋葉と顔を合わせるのは体力使うから、ちょっと部屋で目を覚ましてこようかなって、それだけ」
「むっ。
ちょっと、それどういう意味ですか、兄さん！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“…………………………”
Akiha’s definition of worthwhile seems remarkably narrow.
“Of course. Your idea of worthwhile and mine probably differ, but going back to sleep would waste the day.
The reason I am going back to my room is simple. Facing you the instant I wake up takes more strength than I have, so I am only going to wake myself up properly first”
“Excuse me? Just what is that supposed to mean, Brother?!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
I think what Akiha says is worthwhile is very limited.
"…… Well, I do think so.
It's just that what you think is worthwhile is different from what I think is worthwhile.
Sleeping twice would just be a waste.
The reason why I want to go to my room is simple.
It takes a lot of effort to face you right after waking up, so I thought I'd refresh my head in my own room."
"Wh, what is that supposed to mean, Nii-san!?"

entries.japanese:
「どういう意味もなにも、寝ぼけた頭じゃ秋葉の小言を言い返せないだろ。
だから自分の陣地でコンデションを整えてから戻ってくるだけだよ。
どうせそろそろ昼食だし、話は後で聞くから」
　ひらひらと手を振って秋葉に背を向ける。
　秋葉はいかにも文句がありそうな顔で俺を見送る。
　……ふう。
これはまた、昼食は気合をいれてかからないとタイヘンだな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What do you think it means? I cannot argue back against one of your lectures while half asleep, so I am only retreating to home ground to prepare first. Lunch will be ready soon, and I will hear the rest later”
I wave lazily and turn my back on Akiha.
Akiha watches me go with a face full of objections.
Whew. I will need to brace myself for lunch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nothing, I just can't answer to your all your little scolding when my head's still dozy.
So I'm just going to my territory to regroup, that's all.
We can talk more during lunch."
Waving, I turn away.
Akiha watches me silently, but her face tells me she wants to complain.
…… It looks like I will have to be ready during lunchtime.

entries.japanese:
部屋に戻ってくる。
　俺が居間でうたた寝をしていた間、翡翠は部屋を掃除してくれたようだ。
「……しっかし、我ながら殺風景な部屋だよな、ほんと」
　ベッドと机以外は何もない部屋。
　冬も近い事だし、いいかげん暖房器具ぐらいは手に入れなくてはなるまい。
　秋葉はああだこうだとうるさいが、間違っても暖炉なんてものを使う気にはなれないし。
「……？
　なんだろ、机の上に―――――」
　置いた覚えのない手紙が置かれている。
　気になって中身を見て見た。
「―――――――――――――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
I return to my room.
Hisui seems to have cleaned it while I was dozing in the sitting room.
“Even by my standards, this room is bleak”
There is nothing in it but a bed and a desk.
With winter approaching, I ought to acquire some sort of heater.
Akiha can complain all she likes, but there is no chance I will use the fireplace.
“Hm? What is that on the desk―――――”
A letter I do not remember placing there lies on the desk.
Curious, I open it.
“―――――――――――――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I come to my room.
While I was dozing in the sitting room, it looks like Hisui cleaned my room.
"…… But, this really is a dull room, if I have to say it myself."
Other than a bed and a desk, the room is completely empty.
It's close to winter, so I should probably get some heating equipment.
Akiha is pretty noisy about it, but I'd never feel like using the fireplace.
"……?
What's this on the desk----"

A letter I don't remember about is placed there.
I'm curious, so I open it up.
"-----------------"

entries.japanese:
……………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………手紙には、あの木の下で待っています、とだけ書かれている。
「――――――――どうして」
　そんな言葉しか呟けず、手紙を握り潰す。
　机の棚を開けて、七つ夜と刻まれたナイフをポケットをいれた。
「――――――――」
　……見なかった事にはできない。
　自分の気持ちを整理するために深呼吸をして、部屋を出た。
entries.maoEnglish:
After a long moment, I read the letter’s only sentence: I will be waiting beneath that tree.
“――――――――Why”
That is all I can whisper as I crush the letter in my fist.
I open the desk drawer and slip the knife engraved with Seven Nights into my pocket.
“――――――――”
I cannot pretend I never saw it.
I draw a deep breath to steady myself, then leave the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…………………………………………… The letter just says "I am waiting underneath that tree."
"--------Why?"
Saying that, I crumple the paper.
Opening the drawer, I put the knife with the engraving "Nanatsu Yoru" in my pocket.
"--------"
…… I can't pretend like I didn't see it.
Taking a deep breath to compose myself, I leave my room.

entries.japanese:
――――それに、いつ気がついたかは覚えていない。
　ただ、思えばなんとなく都合が良かったな、と思ったのがきっかけだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I don’t remember when I first noticed.
Looking back, I think it began with a vague sense that everything had worked out just a little too conveniently.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I don't know when I realized it.
It all started when I thought that everything turned out pretty conveniently.

entries.japanese:
とにかく、何が一番都合が良いかと言うと、シキと俺の関係だ。
　シキは俺の通っている学校を根城にしておきながらも、結局―――一番憎い相手である俺を狙う事はしなかった。
　シキがその気になっていれば、俺はとっくに殺されていただろう。
　それがこんな結末で幕を閉じたのは、誰かが都合のいい筋書きを用意していたからだとしか、思えなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The greatest convenience of all was the relationship between SHIKI and me.
He had made my school his hunting ground, yet in the end―――he never once attacked the person he supposedly hated most.
If SHIKI had truly intended to kill me, he could have done so long ago.
For it all to end as it had, someone must have prepared a very convenient script.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The happenstances and circumstances surrounding the connection between SHIKI and I were too convenient.
SHIKI had his lair at my school----but he never attacked me, his most hated enemy.

If SHIKI had ever felt like it, I probably would have been killed a long time ago.
I could only think that things ended this way because someone readied a convenient plot.

entries.japanese: 待ち合わせ場所にいくと、彼女はいつも通り笑顔で待っていた。
entries.maoEnglish: When I reached the appointed place, she was waiting with her usual smile.
entries.mirrorMoon: When I get there, she is waiting with her usual smile.

entries.japanese:
「遅いですよ、志貴さん。
朝から待っていたのに、もうお昼になっちゃうじゃないですか」
「うん、申し訳ない。
ちょっと居間のほうで二度寝して、ついさっき部屋に戻ったんだ」
「ああ、そうだったんですか。
……失敗したなあ。
やっぱり直接お伝えしたほうが良かったですね」
　そうかもしれない、とうなずいた。
　彼女はにっこりと笑いかけてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You are late, Master Shiki. I have been waiting since morning, and now it is nearly noon”
“I am sorry. I fell asleep again in the sitting room and only just returned to my room”
“Oh, I see. I miscalculated. I should have told you in person after all”
Perhaps so, I think, and nod.
She beams at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're late, Shiki-san.
I've been waiting since morning, but it's noon already."
"Yeah, sorry.
I fell asleep in the sitting room and just got back to my room."
"Ah, I see.
…… I messed up.
I knew I should have told you directly."
"That may be true," I nod.
She smiles at me.

entries.japanese:
「でも来てくれて良かった。
ここなら二人きりで話せます」
「―――――」
　嬉しそうに笑う。
　笑顔のまま、本当になんでもない事のように、彼女は口を開けた。
「気づいてしまったんですね、志貴さん」
「……………………」
　うなずく事も、首をふる事もできない。
　やっぱり、と彼女は嬉しそうに笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Still, I am glad you came. We can talk alone here”
“―――――”
She smiles with delight.
Still smiling, she speaks as though what comes next were nothing at all.
“You have realized the truth, have you not, Master Shiki?”
“……………………”
I can neither nod nor shake my head.
She smiles with obvious delight, as though my silence confirms it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, it is good you came.
Now we can talk, just the two of us."
"-----"
She smiles happily.
With a smile on her face, she begins to speak like it's nothing.
"You realized it, didn't you, Shiki-san?"
"…………………"
I can't nod or shake my head.
"I knew it," she laughs.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん。
シキ様をあのようにしてしまったのは、わたしなんです」
「……………」
　……そんな、コト。
「秋葉さまに血をお分けしていたのも、秋葉さまを遠野よりのモノにしてしまうためでした」
「……………………」
　……だから、そんなコトを。
「シキ様に間違った情報をお教えして、志貴さんではなく無関係な人が襲われてしまったのもわたしのせいだと思います」
「………………………」
　言ってほしかったんじゃ、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. I was the one who made Master SHIKI what he became”
“……………”
Not that.
“I gave Miss Akiha my blood to draw Miss Akiha further toward her Tohno nature”
“……………………”
Please, do not.
“I also fed Master SHIKI false information, and I believe it was my fault that innocent people were attacked instead of Master Shiki”
“………………………”
I did not want her to say it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I was the one who made SHIKI-sama like that."
"…………"
…… That…
"I gave Akiha-sama my blood so that she would turn more into one of the Tohno blood."
"…………………"
…… But that……
"I was the one that gave SHIKI-sama wrong information, and made him attack innocent people."
"……………………"
I didn't want her to say it.

entries.japanese:
「子供のころ遠くから志貴さんたちを眺めていたのも、翡翠ちゃんじゃなくてわたしなんですよ、志貴さん」
「………………琥珀、さん」
「あの時、秋葉さまの注意を逸らしてシキ様に機会を作ってさしあげたのも意図的なものです」
「………………琥珀」
「けど失敗してしまいました。
本当はあそこで、秋葉さまとシキ様には死んでほしいなって―――」
「――――――――琥珀っっっっっっっっ！」
　うつむいたまま。
　ただ、そう叫んでいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It was I, not Hisui, who watched Master Shiki and the others from afar when we were young, Master Shiki”
“Kohaku”
“When I distracted Miss Akiha and gave Master SHIKI his opportunity, I did it deliberately”
“Kohaku”
“But it failed. In truth, I wanted Miss Akiha and Master SHIKI to die there―――”
“――――――――Kohaku!”
With my head bowed.
I can do nothing but scream her name.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"When we were small, the one who was always watching from the distance wasn't Hisui, it was me."
"……………… Kohaku-san."
"Back then, I intentionally distracted Akiha-sama so that SHIKI-sama could have an opening."
"……………… Kohaku."
"But I really messed up.
Akiha-sama and SHIKI-sama were both supposed to die there---"
"--------Kohakuuuuuuuu!"
Looking down,
All I could do is shout her name.

entries.japanese:
「……………………いい」
「志貴さん？」
「……………いいんだ、そんなコト。
もう終わった事だし、俺は――――そんな話、聞きたくは、ない」
　口にして、本当にそう思った。
　こんな真実、気がつかなければ良かった。
　琥珀さんは琥珀さんのまま。
　いつも笑顔で、翡翠の事を大切に思っていて、秋葉と仲が良くて、俺と、なんでもない話をして笑い合えるような、そんな人のままでいて、ほしかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Enough”
“Master Shiki?”
“It is all right. That is over now, and I――――do not want to hear any more”
The moment I say it, I know it is true.
I wish I had never discovered any of this.
Kohaku should remain Kohaku.
Always smiling, always caring for Hisui, close to Akiha, the sort of woman who can laugh with me over nothing at all; that is who I want her to remain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………… It's fine."
"Shiki-san?"
"…………… It's fine.
All of it is over, so I-----don't want to hear that kind of story."
Those words are truly how I feel.
Such a reality, it is better if I don't realize it.
Kohaku-san can just be Kohaku-san.
Always smiling, thinking of Hisui dearly, being such good friends with Akiha, and laughing when we talk about stupid things, I wanted Kohaku-san to stay like that.

entries.japanese:
「―――俺は、知らない。
琥珀さんが居てくれれば、それでいい、から」
「――――――――――」
　……彼女は答えない。
　長く。
　痛い、静寂があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I do not know. As long as Kohaku is here, that is enough for me”
“――――――――――”
She does not answer.
A long time passes.
A painful silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I, I don't care about all that.
You can just be here, and it'll be fine."
"----------"
…… She doesn't answer.
A long,
painful silence.

entries.japanese:
「だめですよ、志貴さん。
わたしがしてしまった事は、無かった事になんかできません。
　わたしは失敗したんです。
何年間も自分を動かしていた理由に失敗してしまいましたから、この琥珀は消えるだけです」
「な――――」
　顔をあげる。
　そこには――――
　いつもと変わらない、彼女の貌があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That will not do, Master Shiki. What I did cannot be erased.
I failed. The purpose that kept me moving all these years has failed, so this Kohaku has no choice but to disappear”
“Wha――――”
I look up.
There is――――
The same familiar face she has always worn.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No, that won't do, Shiki-san.
What I did can't be ignored like that.
I failed.
I have lost the reason that moved me these past years, so this Kohaku will just disappear."
"Wha----"
I lift my head.
Over there----
She looks like she always does.

entries.japanese:
「けど、志貴さんにはわたしを責める権利があると思ったんです。
　貴方だけは遠野の家とは無関係の人ですから。
　わたしは、その志貴さんを利用して秋葉さまとシキ様を陥れようとしました。
だから志貴さんがわたしを責めたいというのでしたら、どうぞお好きになさってください」
「権利って、そんなもの――――琥珀さんを責める権利なんて、誰にもない」
　……そう。
　幼い頃にこの屋敷に引き取られて、遠野槙久の凶行を一身に受け続けた。
　誰にも助けを呼べず、誰も助けてくれず、そんな日々を何年と重ねてきたのなら、それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I believed Master Shiki had the right to condemn me.
Master Shiki alone has nothing to do with the Tohno family.
I used Master Shiki in my attempt to destroy Miss Akiha and Master SHIKI. So if Master Shiki wishes to condemn me, please do as you like”
“A right like that――――no one has the right to condemn you, Kohaku”
Yes.
She was brought into this mansion and subjected to the full weight of Makihisa Tohno’s depravity.
She spent years unable to call for help, with no one coming to save her. If anyone had a right, it was―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I thought you had the right to blame me.
You are the only one who is not connected with the Tohno house.
I used you in my plot against Akiha-sama and SHIKI-sama.
So if you wish to blame me, you can do whatever you like."
"The right----no one has the right to blame you, Kohaku-san."
…… That's right.
Ever since she was a small child and came to this mansion, she had to receive all the crimes of Tohno Makihisa.
She could not ask for help, nobody helped her, if she lived that life for years, then that's…

entries.japanese:
「……権利なんていうのなら、琥珀さんには復讐する権利があった筈だ。
……俺には想像する事さえできないけど、琥珀さんは遠野という家を、憎むしかなかったんだから」
　詭弁だと知りながら、そんな不出来な嘘を口にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If we are speaking of rights, then Kohaku had the right to take revenge. I cannot even imagine it, but Kohaku could only hate the Tohno family”
I know it is sophistry, yet still I offer her that clumsy lie.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… If you want to talk about rights, you had to have every right to take revenge.
…… I can only imagine what happened to you, but you only could hold nothing but a grudge against the Tohno family."
I know that I'm just sounding clever, but I say those unsatisfactory lies.

entries.japanese:
「――――いいえ。
わたしは槙久さまも秋葉さまも憎くはありませんでした。
　ですからわたしが行った事は復讐なんていうものではないんです。
　わたしはただ、そうする事が一番人間らしいと思っただけ。
　わたしはわたしの為だけに槙久さまとシキ様を陥れて、秋葉さまにも死んでいただこうとしたんです。
　――――あるものはそれだけ。
　そこには何の感情もありませんでした」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――No. I never hated Master Makihisa or Miss Akiha.
What I did was not revenge.
I merely thought it was the most human way to behave.
For myself alone, I led Master Makihisa and Master SHIKI to ruin and tried to have Miss Akiha die as well.
――――That is all there was.
There was no feeling behind any of it”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----No, I didn't have a grudge against Makihisa-sama or Akiha-sama at all.
So what I did wasn't revenge.
I just thought that was what a human would have done.
Only for my sake, I put Makihisa-sama and SHIKI-sama in a trap, and tried to get Akiha-sama dead too.
----That was all I had.
There really weren't any feelings behind it."

entries.japanese:
崩れない笑顔。
　けど、それは嘘だ。
　本当にそうだというのなら、今ごろ俺は―――彼女の事を、心の底から憎んでいた事になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her smile never wavers.
But it is a lie.
If it were truly as she says, then by now―――I would hate her from the bottom of my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her smile does not fade.
But that's a lie.
If that's true, then I---I would have hated her from the bottom of my heart.

entries.japanese:
「……違う、そんな事はない。
琥珀さんはそう思いこみたいだけなんだ。
　だって、それなら―――どうして琥珀さんは秋葉を庇ったんだ。
　琥珀さんには感情があったから。
……秋葉のことが好きだったから、自分から筋書きを壊したんじゃないか……！」
「――――――」
　微かに。
　彼女は少しだけ視線を逸らして、笑顔に戻った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. That is not true; you only want to believe it is.
If it were true―――why did you protect Akiha?
You had feelings. You cared for Akiha, and that is why you broke your own script…!”
“――――――”
Her eyes slip aside for the briefest moment.
Then her smile returns.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, that's wrong.
Kohaku-san, you just want to think that.
If that was true---then why did you protect Akiha?
Kohaku-san, you had emotions.
…… You liked Akiha, so you destroyed your own plan yourself……!"
"------"
For just an instant.
She lowers her glance just a little bit, and smiles again.

entries.japanese:
「……そうですね。
わたし、自分から壊してしまいました。
本当はあの時、わたしはシキ様に殺されるべきだったんでしょう。
……だって初めからわたしか秋葉さま、どちらかしか生き残れないよう組み立てていたんですよ？
　なのにどうして、二人とも生き残ってしまったんでしょうね」
　困ったように言って、彼女は微笑みに戻る。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I did break it myself. Master SHIKI should have killed me there. From the beginning, I had arranged matters so that only Miss Akiha or I could survive, never both. Then how did we both live?”
She sounds genuinely perplexed, then settles back into her smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's right.
I destroyed my own plan.
Really, SHIKI-sama should have killed me back then.
…… I made it so that only one of us would stay alive after that.
But why did we both end up surviving?
She seemed troubled as she says this, and her smile returns.

entries.japanese:
「……そんなの簡単だ。
琥珀さんが秋葉に生きていてほしくて、自分も生きていたいから残ったんだろ。
　それなら―――もう、それでいいじゃないか。
たとえ全てを仕組んだのが琥珀さんでも、俺は嬉しい。
秋葉が生きていてくれて、琥珀さんが生きていてくれて、それが凄く嬉しいんだ。
　それだけじゃ――――琥珀さんは、駄目なのか」
　言って、涙がこぼれた。
　……哀しいというより悔しくて、感情が塞き止められなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It is simple. Kohaku wanted Akiha to live, and Kohaku wanted to live too.
Then―――is that not enough? Even if Kohaku arranged everything, I am still glad. I am overjoyed that Akiha is alive and Kohaku is alive.
Isn’t that enough for you, Kohaku――――?”
The words bring tears to my eyes.
It is not so much sorrow as frustration; the feelings inside me have burst through every barrier.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's simple.
It's because you wanted Akiha to live, and you wanted to stay alive too.
Then---everything's alright.
Even though you planned it all, I'm happy.
Akiha's still alive, and you're still alive, that makes me really happy.
Is that----not enough for you, Kohaku-san?"
Tears come out as I say so.
…… I can't stop my feelings, which are more full of regret than pity.

entries.japanese:
――――俺は、理解してしまっている。
　この人は、もう戻ってきてくれない。
　あの時、秋葉を庇った時からもう壊れてしまって、戻ってきてはくれないのだと、自分でも頭にくるほど理解してしまっている―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I understand.
This woman will never come back to me.
Since the moment she shielded Akiha, something inside her has broken beyond repair, and I understand it so well it makes me furious―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I already understand.
That this person will not return.
Since then, from the time she protected Akiha, she became broken and couldn't come back.
I understand that too well-----

entries.japanese:
「泣いているんですか、志貴さん。
芝居をしていただけの人形が壊れただけなのに、そんなのバカみたいです。
　……ええ、本当に罵迦みたい。
　ねえ志貴さん。
わたし誰も憎くないって言いましたけど、一人だけそういう人がいたんですよ。
　分かるでしょう？
　琥珀は、志貴さんが憎かったんだと思います。
だって志貴さんさえいなければ、わたしは何も考える必要もなくあの窓際にいられたんですから」
　ニコリと笑って、彼女はくるりと背中を見せた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Are you crying, Master Shiki? A doll that only ever played a part has broken, so crying over it is absurd.
Yes, truly absurd.
Master Shiki. I said I hated no one, but there was one exception.
You understand, do you not? I think Kohaku hated Master Shiki. If Master Shiki had never existed, I could have remained at that window without needing to think”
She smiled, then turned lightly away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, are you crying?
That's stupid, crying over a doll in a play that broke.
…… Yes, it really is stupid.
Hey, Shiki-san.
I said that I didn't hate anyone, but there is one person I hated.
You understand, right?
I think I hated you.
Because if you weren't there, I could have just stared out the window without even thinking."
Smiling, she turns away.

entries.japanese:
蝶の羽のように着物の袖が翻る。
　踏み出そうとする足。
　だが動けない。
　一歩でも。
　一歩でも彼女に近づけば、それで―――取りかえしのつかない事に、なってしまう気がして。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sleeves of her kimono flutter like butterfly wings.
A foot poised to step.
But I cannot move.
Not even one step.
I feel that if I take a single step toward her, then―――something irrevocable will happen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her sleeves flutter like butterfly wings.
My legs want to dash forward.
But I can't move.
Even one step.
I feel that if I move one step towards her---something will happen that I can't take back.

entries.japanese:
「わたしが憎かったのは志貴さんだけです。
あとの人は好きでも嫌いでもなかった。
　わたし、そういった感情を無くしてしまったんです。
だから――――秋葉さまを助けたのも、ただの偶然だったんですよ」
　ゆらり、と後ろ姿が霞む。
「琥珀、さん―――」
　何か、不吉な。
　手を伸ばしても掴めないような、絶望だけがする。
―――その時。
「姉さん―――――！」
　そう、彼女を呼ぶ声が響いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki was the only person I hated. I neither liked nor disliked anyone else.
I lost the ability to feel such things. So――――saving Miss Akiha was pure chance.”
Her retreating figure wavers out of focus.
“Kohaku―――”
Something ominous.
All I feel is despair, the certainty that even if I reach out, I will never catch her.
―――Then.
“Sister―――――!”
The cry rings out behind her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You are the only one I hated.
Everyone else, I neither liked nor hated.
I lost those emotions.
So----saving Akiha-sama was only an accident."
Her figure starts to become hazy.
"Kohaku, san---"
I have a bad feeling about this.
I can't place it, but I have a terrible feeling.
---Then.
"Nee-san-----!"
A voice calling for her echoes through the air.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠――――――？」
「翡翠、ちゃん……？」
　声が重なる。
　翡翠ははあはあと肩を弾ませて、まっすぐに彼女を見据えていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui――――――?”
“Hisui…?”
Our voices overlap.
Hisui stands with her shoulders heaving, staring straight at Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui------?"
"Hisui, chan……?"
Our voices overlap.
Gasping for breath, Hisui looks directly at her.

entries.japanese:
「……翡翠ちゃん、どうして」
　彼女の声が震えている。
　それを受けて、翡翠はいっそう強い眼差しで彼女を見た。
「……嘘」
　短く。
強い声で、翡翠はそう言った。
「姉さんが言っている事は、全部嘘です。
　姉さんは秋葉さまが好きだからあの時に庇ってしまったんだし―――今の琥珀が、志貴さまを憎む事なんて、できない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, why”
Her voice trembles.
Hisui answers with an even fiercer gaze.
“That is a lie”
A brief word. Hisui says it firmly.
“Everything Sister says is a lie.
Sister protected Miss Akiha because Sister loves her, and―――the Kohaku standing here now could never hate Master Shiki”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui-chan, why?"
Her voice is shaking.
Taking it, she looks sharply at her.
"…… Lies."
With a short, strong voice, Hisui says so.
"Everything you say are lies, Nee-san.
You saved Akiha-sama back then because you like her---and I know you can't hate Shiki-sama."

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　息を飲む気配がした。
　背中を見せたまま、彼女は―――ひどく、怯えているように見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
I hear her catch her breath.
Even with her back to us, she―――looks terrified.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I hear a sharp gasp.
Still turned around---she looks extremely frightened.

entries.japanese:
「そうでしょう？
　姉さんはわたしの役を演じていた。
なら、志貴さまを憎む事なんて絶対にできない。
　姉さんは昔の翡翠を演じていた。
だから志貴さまを愛して、秋葉さまを守ろうとしただけ……！
　姉さんは姉さんが信じ込んでいるような、空っぽな人なんかじゃないでしょう……！？」
　振り絞るような翡翠の声。
　彼女は振り向かず、ただ、いいえと答えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Isn’t that true? You played my part, Sister. That means you could never hate Master Shiki.
You played the Hisui I used to be. That is why you loved Master Shiki and tried to protect Miss Akiha…! You are not the empty person you believe yourself to be…!?”
Hisui wrings the words from herself.
Without turning, Kohaku answers only, “No.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that not right?
You played my role, so you cannot hate Shiki-sama.
You played the role of Hisui from back then.
So you loved Shiki-sama and tried to protect Akiha-sama……!
You're not an empty human like you think you are……!"
Hisui's voice hangs in the air.
Kohaku doesn't turn back, and just answers "no".

entries.japanese:
「……まいったなあ。
志貴さんが居間で眠ったりしなければ、翡翠ちゃんに気づかれる事もなかったのに。
　ほんとに、志貴さんには予定を狂わされてばかりでした」
　背中を見せたまま、くすりと笑って。
　彼女は口元に指を当てた。
　ごくり、と。
　何かを嚥下する音が、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a nuisance. If Master Shiki had not fallen asleep in the sitting room, Hisui would never have noticed.
Master Shiki always throws my plans into disarray”
Still facing away, she laughs softly.
She raises a finger to her lips.
With a gulp.
I hear her swallow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
If you had never slept in the sitting room, then Hisui-chan never would have noticed us.
Shiki-san, you really do throw all my plans into disarray."
Still facing the other way, she laughs.
She holds up a finger to her mouth.
Gulp.
I hear the sound of something being swallowed.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――――」
　走る。
　けど、間に合わない。
　俺たちが駆け寄るより早く、赤い血を吐いて、彼女は地面に崩れ落ちた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――――”
I run.
But I am too late.
Before either of us can reach her, she vomits bright blood and collapses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------"
I run.
But, I don't make it in time.
Before I can reach her, she collapses to the ground, coughing up blood.

entries.japanese:
どさり。
　固い、イヤな音。
　彼女は微笑んだまま、唇から赤い雫をこぼしていた。
「姉さん――――――――！」
　彼女の体を抱き寄せる翡翠。
　けど、それは。
　誰が見ても、もう遅い、終わってしまった後の、事だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
A thud.
A hard, sickening sound.
Still smiling, she spills red drops from her lips.
“Sister――――――――!”
Hisui gathers Kohaku’s body into her arms.
But anyone can see that she is too late.
It is already over.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thud.
A hard, sickening noise.
Still smiling, she drips red blood from her mouth.
"Nee-san------------!"
Hisui holds her.
But, that.
No matter who looks at it, it is already too late.

entries.japanese:
「うそ―――姉さん、姉さん、姉さん――――――！！！！」
　もう動こうとしない彼女の頭を抱いて、翡翠は必死に呼びかける。
　その、血を吐くような思いが通じたのか。
　ぱくぱくと、彼女の口が動いた。
「姉さん……？
　姉さん、しっかりして……！！」
　懸命な叫び。
　それを見て、彼女は子供のように笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No―――Sister, Sister, Sister――――――!!!!”
Cradling Kohaku’s motionless head, Hisui calls to her desperately.
Perhaps that anguish reaches her after all.
Kohaku’s lips begin to move.
“Sister…? Sister, stay with me…!!”
A desperate cry.
At the sight of it, Kohaku smiles like a child.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No----Nee-san, Nee-san, Nee-san-----!!!!"
Cradling the unmoving girl's head, Hisui frantically calls out.
It seems her feelings overflow like the blood pouring from Kohaku's mouth.
Her mouth opens and closes over and over.
"Nee-san……?
Nee-san, hold on……!!"
A desperate cry.
Seeing that, the girl smiles like a child.

entries.japanese:
「……あれ……だめ、だよ、翡翠ちゃん。
そんなに、泣い、てると……昔に、戻った、みたい」
「そんな―――姉さん、どうして――――」
「……うん。
だって、こうしないと、翡翠ちゃんが、戻れない、から」
　途切れ途切れ。
　翡翠も何も見えていないような目で、ぼんやりと、彼女はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh. You must not cry so much, Hisui; it feels as though we have gone back to long ago”
“No―――Sister, why――――”
“Yes. Because if I do not do this, Hisui can never go back”
Her words come apart between breaths.
She murmurs with eyes that seem unable to see Hisui or anything at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?
…… Don't do that, Hisui-chan.
Crying like that, it feels…… like back then."
"What---Nee-san, why----"
"…… Yeah, because if I, don't do, so, you won't be, able to return, to the way, you were."
Her words in pieces,
and with glazed eyes, she speaks to Hisui.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――姉、さん」
　翡翠の顔が歪む。
　ぼろぼろと。
とめどなく流れていく涙。
「……なんで？
　そんなコト、いいよ。
わたしはこのままで良かった。
姉さんさえ幸せなら、それで良かった。
　わたし―――わたしはずっと姉さんに守られていたから、それで―――」
　ずっと、幸せだったのに、と。
　苦しそうに、翡翠は言葉を飲み込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――Sister”
Hisui’s face crumples.
In great drops. Tears spill without end.
“Why? Sister did not need to do this. I was happy as I was. As long as Sister was happy, that was enough.
I―――I was always protected by Sister, and so―――”
I was happy all along.
Hisui swallows the words in pain.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------Nee, san."
Hisui's face contorts in grief.
Her tears flood her face.
"…… Why?
That's fine.
I was okay with the way I was.
If you were happy, then I was happy.
I---I was always protected by you, so---"
I was always happy.
Painfully, she swallows her last words.

entries.japanese:
「どうして……？
　姉さんは翡翠のままで良かったんだよ。
昔の、姉さんが憧れていた翡翠のままで良かったのに、なんで―――今になって、わたしに返そうって、そんなコト――――」
　ぽたり、と涙がこぼれる。
　彼女の頬に落ちた涙に反応したのか。
　彼女は、うん、と静かにうなずいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why? Sister could have stayed Hisui. Sister could have remained the Hisui she once wanted to be, so why―――try to give that name back to me now――――”
A tear falls.
Perhaps she feels it land on her cheek.
Kohaku nods quietly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why……?
You should have stayed like Hisui, Nee-san.
Like Hisui, the one you admired long ago, so why---why are you returning it to me now----"
A tear falls.
Maybe Hisui's tears caused that.
She nods quietly.

entries.japanese:
「……そう、だね。
　わたし、本当に、楽しかった。
ぜんぶお芝居だったけど、楽しかったよ、翡翠ちゃん。
　だから、翡翠ちゃんも、楽しかったら、いいな―――って」
　血がこぼれる。
　一言口にするたびに、彼女は血液を吐き出していく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes.
I really was happy. It was all an act, but I had fun, Hisui.
So I hoped you could be happy too, Hisui―――”
Blood spills.
With every word, she coughs up blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's, right.
I, really, had fun.
It was all just an act, but it was really fun, Hisui-chan.
So I hoped, Hisui-chan, you were having fun, too----"
Her blood drips out.
As she speaks, blood dribbles out of her mouth.

entries.japanese:
「ね――姉さん、しっかりして姉さん……！
　こんな、こんなのってない……！
　どうして、どうして姉さんが死ななくちゃいけないの……！？
　姉さんが―――姉さんが死ななくちゃいけない理由なんて、何処にもないのに……！」
　翡翠の声は、もう彼女には届いていない。
　はあ、と大きく胸を上下させて、彼女は高い高い空を見上げる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“S――Sister, stay with me, Sister…! This cannot be happening…! Why do you have to die…!?
There is no reason―――no reason anywhere that Sister should have to die…!”
Hisui’s voice no longer reaches her.
Kohaku takes one great, shuddering breath and gazes up at the sky, high, high above.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ne--Nee-san, hang on, Nee-san……!
This, this can't be……!
Why, why do you have to die, Nee-san……!?
There is---there is no reason for you to die, Nee-san……!"
Hisui's voice can no longer reach her.
Her chest rising and falling, she just looks up at the deep, deep blue sky.

entries.japanese:
「……キレイ。
わたし、外に出るコトはできなかったけど、空の色だけは、憶えてた」
「姉さん―――姉さん……？」
「……振りかえると、そんななんでもないコトが、わたしの一日、でした。
　翡翠ちゃんと、志貴さんと、秋葉さまが、いて。
　それは、とてもキレイな空をしていたん、です」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Beautiful. I could not go outside, but I remembered the color of the sky”
“Sister―――Sister…?”
“Looking back, those ordinary things were my entire day.
Hisui, Master Shiki, and Miss Akiha were there.
The sky above them was so beautiful”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's pretty.
I could never go outside, but I always remembered the color of the sky."
"Nee-san---Nee-san……?"
"…… Just those little things were my days.
Hisui-chan, Shiki-san, and Akiha-sama were there.
And there was such a pretty sky overhead."

entries.japanese:
「うん……うまく、思い出せない。
楽しかったコトとか、段々……薄れて、いく、みたい」
　……力が抜ける。
　かろうじて残された瞳の光が消えていく。
　それを。
　放っておける筈なんて、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I cannot remember them clearly. The happy memories seem to be fading away”
The strength leaves her.
The last glimmer in her eyes begins to disappear.
That sight.
I cannot simply stand there and let it happen.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah…… I can't remember it too well.
Those fun things…… are starting to disappear."
…… Her energy drains away.
The remaining light in her eyes is disappearing.
That.
I could not let it be.

entries.japanese:
ナイフを取り出す。
　メガネはとっくに外してある。
　あとは―――
「志貴さま、何を――――！」
　翡翠が抱き付いてくる。
「――――琥珀さんを助ける。
今はだまって、俺を信じてくれ」
　翡翠を引き離して、彼女の体を凝視する。
　……弓塚の時と同じだ。
　あの時、自分の体内に混ざった弓塚の血液を“殺せた”のなら。
　彼女が飲んだ毒だって、殺せる筈だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I draw my knife.
My glasses are already off.
All that remains is―――
“Master Shiki, what are you――――!”
Hisui throws herself against me.
“――――I am going to save Kohaku. Be quiet for now and trust me”
I pull Hisui away and stare into Kohaku’s body.
It is the same as with Yumizuka.
If I could kill Yumizuka’s blood after it mingled with mine.
Then I should be able to kill the poison Kohaku swallowed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take out my knife.
My glasses are already off.
All that is left---
"Shiki-sama, what are----!"
Hisui holds on to me.
"----I am going to save Kohaku-san.
Please be quiet and trust me."
I pull free and look hard at her body.
…… Just like the time with Yumizuka.
That time, I found Yumizuka's polluted blood and "killed" it.
So I should be able to kill the poison she drank.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――く」
　頭痛が激しい。
　ギチギチと音をたてて、こめかみからカッターの刃が刺しこんでくるような頭痛。
　それは、痛みで目を開けていられないほど。
「―――――――――――っ」
　……他人の体内から異物を視るのは難しいのか。
　明らかに自身の能力を超えていると、脳髄は痛みを警告にして伝えてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――――Ngh”
The headache is savage.
It grinds through my skull as though a box-cutter blade were driven into each temple.
The pain is so fierce I can barely keep my eyes open.
“―――――――――――Ngh”
Perhaps it is harder to see a foreign substance inside someone else.
My brain answers with pain, warning me that this plainly exceeds my ability.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------Gah."
The headache gets worse.
It feels like someone is stabbing my skull with a knife.
It's so bad I want to close my eyes.
"-----------"
…… I guess looking at something wrong in someone else's body is difficult.
The pain warns me that this is surpassing the limits of my ability.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――は、あ」
　呼吸が発狂する。
　だらしなく開けられた口から、ボコボコと泡が零れていく。
　視界は赤く。
　体中の体液が消毒液に変わってしまったかのような、灼熱の痛覚が迸る。
「き―――――ギギ、ギ―――――」
　ああ。
だが、それでも―――――
「く―――――――あ、あ―――――――！」
　このまま、失明してもかまわないとソレを視つめた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――ha, ah”
My breathing goes mad.
Foam bubbles from my slack mouth.
My vision floods red.
Scalding pain tears through me as though every fluid in my body has turned to disinfectant.
“Gh―――――gigi, gi―――――”
Yes. But even so―――――
“Guh―――――――ah, ah―――――――!”
I stare into it, willing to go blind if that is the price.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"AH------ha, ah."
My breathing explodes into harsh gasping.
Bubbles escape from my open mouth.
My entire world is red.
As if all my bodily fluids turned into poison, my body is burning from the inside.
"Ahh----g---gaah!!"
Yeah.
But, still------
"Ku-------ah, ahh-------!"
I stare at it, not caring if I go blind.

entries.japanese:
――――――断線していく意識の束。
　世界が白くなったような光景。
　ばちん、ばちん、と血管が焼き切れる音のなか、速やかに、遠野志貴が稼動不可能になる前に、彼女の体内の異物を抹殺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Strands of consciousness snap one by one.
The world turns white.
Amid the sharp reports of blood vessels burning through, I move quickly, annihilating the foreign matter inside her before Shiki Tohno ceases to function.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------My senses disassociate.
My world becomes a white sheet.
As the sound of my blood vessels burning away roars in my ears, I quickly, before I am unable to move, find the poison in her body and kill it.

entries.japanese:
数日振りに見た光景は、白い診察室だった。
「……よし。
どうやら問題はないようだね、志貴くん。
濁りも見られないし、病状が再発することもないだろう。
今日からは普通に暮らしてかまわないよ」
　ここ数日、ずっと診ていてくれた医師はカルテになにやら書き込んでいる。
　初めて見る彼の顔は、思いのほか優しげだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The first thing I saw in several days was a white examination room.
“Good. Everything seems to be in order, Shiki. There is no clouding, and I do not expect the condition to recur. You may resume normal life today”
The doctor who has attended me these past few days scribbles something onto my chart.
Seen clearly for the first time, his face is gentler than I imagined.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The first scenery I've seen in a few days is this white examination room.
"…… All set.
It seems like you are fine, Shiki-kun.
I do not see any cloudiness and your condition should not return.
You can go back to your normal life now."
The doctor continues scribbling away, as he's done these past few days.
His face which I see for the first time looks somewhat kind.

entries.japanese:
「それではお大事に。
ああ、だからといってしばらくは無理をしないように。
君はどうも、自分の体を厳しく扱いすぎる」
「―――解りました。
それではどうも、お世話になりました」
　心から感謝して頭をさげる。
　そうして、椅子から立ち上がった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Take care. Still, do not overexert yourself for a while. You are too hard on your body”
“―――Understood. Thank you for everything”
I bow with sincere gratitude.
Then I rise from the chair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, take care.
Yeah, but don't strain yourself for a while.
You always seem to push yourself too hard."
"---I understand.
Thank you so much for your help."
I bow with heartfelt thanks.
And, I stand up from the chair.

entries.japanese:
廊下に出る。
　待合室には翡翠の姿があった。
　これまた何日かぶりに翡翠の顔を見て、ぶんぶんと手を振る。
　翡翠はすぐにやってきて、病み上がりの俺の体を支えるように寄り添ってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I stepped into the corridor.
Hisui was waiting in the reception area.
Delighted to see her face after several days apart, I waved both arms.
She hurried over and nestled close, supporting me as though I were still unsteady on my feet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I go out into the hallway.
In the waiting room is Hisui.
Not having seen her face in days, I wave to her excitedly.
Hisui quickly runs to my side to support me.

entries.japanese:
「それじゃ行こうか。
琥珀さんも今日から面会できるんだろ？」
　はい、とうなずく翡翠。
「……あの、志貴さま。
本当に体のほうはよろしいのですか？」
　翡翠は心配そうに見上げてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Let’s go, then. Kohaku can have visitors starting today, right?”
Hisui nodded.
“…Master Shiki, are you certain you’re well enough?”
She looked up at me anxiously.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, shall we go?
We can meet Kohaku-san starting today, right?"
Hisui nods.
"…… Um, Shiki-sama.
Is your body really okay?"
Hisui looks up at me, full of worry.

entries.japanese:
「あのね。
医者っていうのは完治してない病人を自由にはさせない人たちなんだぞ。
退院するって事はもう大丈夫ってコトなんだ。
病院に慣れてる俺が言うんだから間違いはないって」
「――――はい。
だから余計に心配なんです。
志貴さまはお医者さまにかかって、きちんと治ってきたためしがありませんから」
「…………む」
　……翡翠も言うようになった。
　それはまったくの事実なので、返答のしようがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Doctors do not release patients who have not recovered. Being discharged means I am fine. I know hospitals. You can trust me”
“――――Yes. That is precisely why I am worried. Master Shiki has never once gone to a doctor and returned properly cured”
“…………”
Hisui has learned to hit where it hurts.
Since every word is true, I have no answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey.
A doctor is a person who can't let unhealed people go free.
If I get to leave the hospital, that means I'm fine.
I'm used to being in hospitals, so trust me."
"-----Yes.
That is why I worry.
There never was an instance where you would come back from the hospital fully healed."
"………… Hmph."
…… Hisui really talks a lot now.
Well, that's the truth, so I can't disagree.

entries.japanese:
「―――ともかく、目の包帯も取れたんだ。
ちゃんと翡翠の顔も見れるし、体も治ったんだから問題ないだろ。
　さ、それより琥珀さんの所に急ごう」
　まだ何か言いたげな翡翠の手を引いて、琥珀さんの病室へと歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Anyway, the bandages are off my eyes. I can see your face and the rest of me is healed, so there is no problem.
Come on, let us hurry to Kohaku’s room”
I take the still-unconvinced Hisui’s hand and lead her down the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Anyway, I finally got those bandages off my eyes.
I can see your face and my body is healed, so there's no more problems.
C'mon, let's go see Kohaku-san."
Pulling Hisui, who's still wanting to say something, I walk towards Kohaku-san's room.

entries.japanese:
―――――あの後。
　ナイフで琥珀さんの体を切り裂いた俺を見て翡翠は半狂乱になった。
　なったが、琥珀さんの体に傷がないこと、そのあとに琥珀さんの呼吸が戻ったこと、くわえて俺がぶっ倒れたこととがあって、翡翠は混乱しながらも事後処理に奔走してくれたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Afterward.
When Hisui saw me slash Kohaku’s body with a knife, she nearly lost her mind.
Yet Kohaku had no wound, her breathing returned, and then I collapsed; bewildered though she was, Hisui apparently raced about taking care of everything that followed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----After that.
After seeing me plunge my knife into Kohaku-san, Hisui panicked.
But, after seeing that Kohaku-san's body was not harmed, that her breathing returned after that, and seeing me collapsing, Hisui ran to save all of us, even though she was still in a panic.

entries.japanese:
結果として、琥珀さんは命をとりとめた。
　俺の方はと言うと、著しい体力の低下に加えて、眼球が機能しないという状況におちいった。
　……まあ、なんとなく失明したんだな、とは理解していた。
実際、琥珀さんの体にナイフを走らせる時は、もう“線”しか視えない状態だったし。
　だから失明したと知らされてもそうショックは受けなかったのだが、しばらくしてあっさりと視力は回復した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku survived.
As for me, my strength was almost entirely spent, and my eyes had ceased to function.
I had understood that I had gone blind. By the time I drew the knife across Kohaku’s body, the lines were all I could see.
So being told came as no great shock, but before long my sight returned almost without incident.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As a result, Kohaku-san was saved.
I fell into a condition where my eyes would not function in addition to the decrease in my physical body strength.
…… Well, I somehow understood that I went blind.
When I stabbed my knife into her body, the only thing I was able to see were those "lines".
So when I was told I went blind, it didn't shock me that much, but then, my sight came back shortly after.

entries.japanese:
検査をしてみれば眼球になんら異状はなく、神経に問題があっただけらしい。
断線していた神経が繋がった、というより麻痺していた神経が回復したようなものなんだろう。
　……どうも、俺の目は簡単に失明するほど優しいものではないみたいだ。
　下手をすると、失明してもあの“線”だけは視えてしまうのかもしれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Examinations found nothing wrong with my eyes themselves; the trouble was in the nerves. Rather than broken nerves reconnecting, it was probably more like paralyzed nerves recovering.
Apparently my eyes are not fragile enough to go blind so easily.
For all I know, even if I lose my sight, those lines alone may remain visible.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The examination revealed absolutely nothing wrong with my eyes, but only problems with my nerves.
Rather than my cut nerves connecting themselves, it seems that it's more like the nerves which were numb healed up.
…… It seems like my eyes will not go blind that easily.
Or it might be that even if I do go blind, I'll still see those "lines".

entries.japanese:
……まあ、そんな事はどうでもいいコトだ。
　大事なコトは俺も琥珀さんも助かった、というコト。
　……けど琥珀さんは五体満足、というワケではなかった。
　彼女は一命をとりとめた。
　だが、その代償として、失ってしまったものがあった。
entries.maoEnglish:
But none of that matters.
What matters is that Kohaku and I both survived.
Yet Kohaku did not emerge entirely whole.
Her life had been saved.
But in exchange, something had been lost.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, those are trivial matters.
The important fact is that Kohaku-san and I were saved.
…… But Kohaku-san wasn't fully saved.
She was able to recover.
But, in turn, she lost something.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま」
「え――――ああ、先にどうぞ。
俺より翡翠が先に入ったほうがいいと思う」
　はい、と答えて翡翠は病室のドアをノックする。
　どうぞ、という返事がして、俺たちは病室に入った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki”
“Oh――――right. Hisui should go first; I think it is better if Hisui enters before me”
Hisui nods and knocks on the door.
A voice invites us in, and together we enter.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama."
"Eh----yeah, go ahead.
I think it's probably better if you went in first."
After answering yes, she knocks on the door.
A voice tells us to come in and we enter the room.

entries.japanese:
――――病室には琥珀さんしかいない。
　彼女はベッドに横たわったまま上半身だけを起こして、俺と翡翠を見た。
「……………………」
　……琥珀さんに笑顔はない。
　不安そうな瞳が、入ってきた来客を見つめるだけ。
「あの……どちらさまでしょうか？」
　その言葉に、翡翠の肩が少しだけ震えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Kohaku is alone in the hospital room.
She lies against the raised bed, sitting only partly upright, and looks from Hisui to me.
“……………………”
There is no smile on Kohaku’s face.
Her anxious eyes merely study the visitors who entered.
“Excuse me, but who are you?”
Hisui’s shoulders trembled faintly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Kohaku-san is the only one in the room.
She sits up in bed and looks at Hisui and I.
"……………………"
…… Kohaku-san isn't smiling.
With uneasy eyes, she looks at her guests.
"Um…… May I please ask who you are?"
With those words, Hisui's shoulders shake a bit.

entries.japanese:
「お見舞いにきたんです。
失礼しますね、姉さん」
　姉さん、と呼ばれて琥珀さんは意外そうに翡翠を見る。
　翡翠は琥珀さんの傍らに座った。
　自分は邪魔だな、と思いつつ、目立たないように壁際の椅子に座る。
　琥珀さんは相変わらず、元気のない顔をして翡翠と俺とを見比べた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“We came to visit you. Please excuse us, Sister.”
At the word sister, Kohaku looked at Hisui in surprise.
Hisui sat beside her bed.
Feeling like an intruder, I quietly took a chair against the wall.
Still subdued, Kohaku looked uncertainly between us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"We have come to see how you are doing.
Please excuse us, Nee-san."
Kohaku-san looks at Hisui with surprised eyes after she hears the word "Nee-san".
Hisui sits down next to Kohaku-san.
I don't want to be in the way, so I sit down on a chair by the wall.
Kohaku-san looks uneasily back and forth between Hisui's face and mine.

entries.japanese:
「あの……ごめんなさい。
わたし、なんだかおかしいんです。
お二人とも憶えはある気はするのですけど、それがどんな憶えだったの思い出せななくて」
　申し訳なさそうに琥珀さんは言う。
　それは冗談や何かの例えではなく、本当に、本心からの言葉だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I am sorry. Something seems to be wrong with me. I feel as though I recognize you both, but I cannot remember how I know you”
Kohaku apologizes with genuine distress.
This is no joke or figure of speech; she means every word.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… I am sorry.
It's a bit strange.
I feel that I do know both of you, but I cannot remember either of you."
Her voice sounds very apologetic.
This isn't a joke or anything as she really does mean those words.

entries.japanese:
―――――記憶に障害がある。
　そう聞かされたのは、たぶん俺の方が先だったと思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――Her memory was impaired.
