entries.maoEnglish:
“That was SHIKI’s influence. A mistake on my part as well, Brother.
My power does not simply eliminate things. Rather than destroying its target, it takes from it.
I took SHIKI’s life from him, but it seems I absorbed something foul along with it.”
“―――――?”
Something foul?
Something Akiha had not possessed before, but did now.
It was that―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It is the influence of SHIKI.
This is my failure, Nii-san.
…… My power is not something that excludes anything or destroys, it is the power to plunder.
I stole SHIKI's life from him.
But at that same time, it seems I also took in something not good."
"-----?"
Something not good?
Something that wasn't in her before, something that's in her now.
That's, um---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……なんていうのかな、シキを殺して以来、私は自分の感情がうまく抑制できないんです。
　ヘンに強気になったり、普段なら心に留めておくだけの欲望をカタチにしてしまう。
　だから今まで耐えてきた欲求に素直になってしまったんでしょうね。
　琥珀の血は私の体を維持する為に必要なものだけど、もう何年も口にしている味だから飽きてたのよ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How shall I put it—since killing SHIKI, I haven’t been able to restrain my emotions very well.
I grow strangely assertive, turning desires I would normally keep buried into actions.
I suppose I simply surrendered to an appetite I had endured for years.
Kohaku’s blood is necessary to sustain my body, but I’ve been drinking the same flavor for so long that I grew tired of it.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… How do I put this…… ever since I killed SHIKI, I became unable to suppress my emotions any longer.
I become unusually strong minded, and my lust takes shape when I normally would have just kept it inside.
So I guess I just became honest with the desires I held back for so long.
I needed Kohaku's blood to maintain my body, but I was getting bored of that taste since I had been drinking it for few years."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――ええ、こんなコト兄さんに話しても判ってもらえないだろうけど、初めて琥珀以外の血を飲んだ時は凄かったんだから。
あんまりにもおいしくて、そのまま気がふれてしまうかと思ったぐらい」
　秋葉は心から嬉しそうに笑った。
　ゆらぐ蜃気楼。
　秋葉に対して危うさを感じたのは、確か、俺……いや、アレはシキだったのか。
シキが、秋葉に殺される夢を見た翌日からだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You probably can’t understand, Brother, but the first time I drank blood other than Kohaku’s was extraordinary. It tasted so wonderful I thought I might go mad on the spot.”
Akiha smiled with genuine delight.
The mirage wavered around her.
I had first sensed this danger in Akiha the day after the dream where she killed me—or no. The dream where she killed SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Yes, you probably will not understand, but the first time I tasted the blood of someone other than Kohaku, it was simply amazing.
It was so delicious I thought I would go insane."
She smiles from the bottom of her heart.
The wavering mirage.
The only time I sensed this danger was when I…… No, that was SHIKI.
When SHIKI was killed in that dream.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「――――秋葉、おまえ――――」
「そんな目で見ないで。
私が奪っているのは血液だけよ。
シキのように命まで奪っているわけではないんですから、そう目くじらをたてる事ではないでしょう、兄さん」
「……血液だけ、だと……？」
　秋葉は一点たりとも負い目を持っていないし、開き直っているというわけでもない。
　ただ当たり前のように話をして、微笑みをうかべて俺を見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Akiha, you――――”
“Don’t look at me that way. I take only blood. I don’t steal lives as SHIKI did, so this hardly deserves such outrage, Brother.”
“Only blood?”
Akiha shows not a trace of guilt, nor is she defiantly excusing herself.
She merely speaks as though discussing the most ordinary thing in the world, smiling as she watches me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Akiha, you----"
"Don't look at me like that.
I only stole their blood.
SHIKI took their lives as well, so you should not look at me like that, Nii-san."
"…… Only, their blood……?"
Akiha is neither defiant nor remorseful.
She just smiles as she looks at me and speaks as if it was a matter of course.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――――――っ」
　……呼吸が、うまくできない。
　秋葉は愉しんでいる。
　俺が直接秋葉を問いただした所で、秋葉にとっては退屈しのぎにすぎないようだ。
―――なんて事。
　これじゃまるで、本当に狂気を楽しんでいる、殺人鬼のようじゃないか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
I cannot breathe properly.
Akiha is enjoying this.
No matter how fiercely I confront her, to her it is nothing more than a way to relieve her boredom.
―――This is monstrous.
She is like a murderer savoring her own madness―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… I can hardly breathe.
Akiha is enjoying this.
I came to confront her, but it seems like it's just killing her boredom.
---What is this?
This is like a killer truly enjoying insanity---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「ふざけるな……！
　なんで―――そんな。
どうしたっていうんだよ秋葉。
おまえ、なんかおかしいぞ……！！」
　秋葉の視線をなんとか振り払って、一歩詰め寄る。
「ぁ………………」
　俺が詰め寄ろうとした事が効いたのか、秋葉は一瞬だけ言葉を飲んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t screw with me! Why would you…? What happened to you, Akiha? There’s something wrong with you!”
I tore myself free of her gaze and advanced one step.
“Ah…”
My advance seemed to get through to her; for one instant, Akiha swallowed whatever she had been about to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stop messing around……!
Why---that…… why, Akiha?
There's something wrong with you……!!"
Somehow warding off her gaze, I take a step closer.
"Ah………………"
It must have worked, because she swallows her words.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「おまえだって解ってるんだろ。
そんな言い分、正しいワケがないじゃないか……！」
　もう一歩、さらに詰め寄る。
　秋葉は拗ねたように視線を逸らした後、唇を噛んで俺を睨んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You know it too. You know none of this can possibly be right!”
I stepped closer again.
Akiha looked away with an almost petulant expression, then bit her lip and glared at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You must know, too.
What you're saying isn't right……!"
I take another step.
After looking away peevishly, she bites her lip and glares at me.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……おかしくなんかないわ。
私が他人の血を吸うのは、みんな兄さんの為なんだから」
「え―――――」
　足が止まる。
　秋葉は唇を強く噛んだあと、なにか、捨て鉢になったように肩の力を抜いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is nothing wrong with me. Every drop of blood I drink is for your sake, Brother.”
“―――――What?”
My feet stop.
Akiha bites down hard on her lip, then lets the tension drain from her shoulders with the air of someone who no longer cares what happens.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… There's nothing wrong.
I drink the blood of other people only for your sake."
"Eh-----"
My legs stop.
After she strongly bites her lip, she relaxes.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……前にも言ったでしょう。
兄さんは八年前にシキに殺されている。
けど、遠野という『混血』ならまだしも、兄さんは普通の人なのよ。
シキに命の大半を奪われてしまった兄さんには、蘇生する力なんてどこにも残っていなかった」
entries.maoEnglish: “I told you before. SHIKI killed you eight years ago. If you had been one of the Tohno mixed-bloods, that might have been different—but you are an ordinary human. After SHIKI stole most of your life, you had no power left with which to revive yourself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I already told you.
You were killed by SHIKI eight years ago.
You are not of the mixed blood of the Tohno family, but you are just a normal person.
You did not have any power to live after SHIKI stole your life from you."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……けど、私はそんな事は許せなかった。
兄さんはね、私を庇ってシキに殺されたんです。
本当なら死ぬのは私のほうだった。
　私は血塗れの兄さんに守られて、兄さんはもう死んでいるのに、それでもシキから私を守ってくれました。
……その後の事は私もよく覚えていない。
ただ兄さんの代わりに自分が死ねばいいんだって思っただけです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I could not accept that. You were killed protecting me from SHIKI. I was the one who should have died.
You stood between us drenched in blood, protecting me even though you were already dead. I scarcely remember what happened afterward. I only remember thinking that I should die in your place.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… But, I could not allow that.
You were killed protecting me, so I was the one that should have died.
I was saved by your bloody body.
You were already dead, but you still protected me.
…… I do not remember everything that happened afterwards clearly, but I just remember thinking only that it would have been better if I died instead of you."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――その願いは叶えられました。
　ほら、おとぎ話でよくあるじゃないですか。
死んでしまった鳥や犬に自分の血を与えて生きかえらせる、というのが。
　本来の私の力とは正反対だけど、私はそんな呪いを兄さんにかけたんでしょうね。
　そうして兄さんは奇跡的に蘇生して、私はその日から体に重い枷を持つようになった。
……考えてみれば当然よ。
本来自分が使うべき命の半分を兄さんに差し上げたんですもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And that wish was granted.
You know the old tales, don’t you? The ones where someone gives their blood to a dead bird or dog and brings it back to life.
It was the very opposite of my true power, but I must have laid such a curse on you.
You miraculously returned to life, and from that day forward my body bore a crushing burden. It was only natural. I had given you half the life meant to sustain me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---That wish was granted.
See, it's like what happens in a fairy tale.
Like giving your blood to dead birds and dogs so they can live again.
My power is really the opposite, but I guess I put that curse on you.
You miraculously recovered and ever since that day I have carried a load…… come to think of it, it was only natural.
It is because I shared half of my life with you, Nii-san."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　目の前が暗くなる。
　それじゃ俺がこうしていられるのは秋葉のおかげで、同時に俺を助けたから―――秋葉は体に疾患を持つようになった、のか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――”
Darkness fills my vision.
Then I am alive only because of Akiha—and saving me has left her body afflicted.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Everything goes black.
So I am alive because of Akiha, and at the same time---because of that, Akiha has to live with that terminal illness?
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……秋葉。
あの時の発作も、全部―――俺の、せいなのか」
「……そうよ。
私は兄さんを生かしているかぎり、遠野という異系の血を使い続ける。
そうしているとね、人としての血が薄くなってしまうんです。
　それが過度になるとシキのように人から外れたモノになってしまう。
　それを防ぐには遠野の血が流れるのを最小限に抑えないといけない。
けどそうすると兄さんに力を分けるのが精一杯で、自分の体を維持できないんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha… Were all those attacks your body suffered my fault?”
“Yes. For as long as I keep you alive, I must draw upon the inhuman Tohno blood. The more I use it, the thinner my human blood becomes.
If that goes too far, I will stray beyond humanity as SHIKI did.
To prevent that, I must keep the Tohno blood’s activity to a minimum. But then all my strength goes into sustaining you, leaving too little to maintain my own body.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Akiha.
That time you had that fit, it was all---my fault?"
"…… Yes.
As long as I keep you alive, I have to use the powers of the Tohno blood.
If I do that, my human blood becomes thinned.
If it becomes too weak, I will become something less than human, just like SHIKI.
To prevent that, I have to only use the minimum of my powers.
But if I do that, I can only maintain your life and I can't support my own body."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……その結果として、ああやって発作めいた反動がやってくる。
体が危険を感じて、兄さんに力を分けるのを止めるか、遠野よりのモノになってしまえって強制してくるんです。
　それでも今まで耐えてこられたのは琥珀のおかげよ。
感応者である琥珀は、個人の意志を補強してくれる。
私は定期的に琥珀の血を飲む事で、人としての遠野秋葉を留めていた―――というワケね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Those seizure-like attacks are the backlash. My body senses the danger and tries to force a choice: stop giving you my strength, or surrender and become something more Tohno than human.
Kohaku is the reason I endured for so long. As a resonator, she can reinforce another person’s will. By drinking her blood regularly, I preserved the human part of Akiha Tohno.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… As a result, those fits occur.
Sensing the danger, my body tells me to stop providing you with energy or just become one with the Tohno blood.
It is only thanks to Kohaku that I have been able to resist it this long.
As a Synchronizer, she can strengthen one's will.
I regularly drank her blood to strengthen the human part of Tohno Akiha."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
知らず、体がよろめいた。
　秋葉。
秋葉が血を飲むのは、結局。
　誰のせいでもなく、俺の責任。
　俺がこうして生きているかぎり、秋葉は遠野よりの生き方をするしかない、という事なのか―――
entries.maoEnglish:
My body staggers before I know it.
Akiha. In the end, she drinks blood because of me.
No one else is to blame.
As long as I remain alive, Akiha has no choice but to live as a creature of the Tohno blood―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Before I realize it, my whole body staggers.
Akiha.
Akiha's sucking of blood.
It's completely my fault.
As long as I'm alive, Akiha has to live as the Tohno---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「けど、それもシキを処罰すれば解決すると思ってた。
シキが死ねば兄さんの命を横から使う邪魔者がいなくなるんだから」
「―――――あ」
　……そうだ。
　シキがもういないのなら、俺の命は俺一人が使うんだから、もう貧血を起こす事はなくなる筈だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I thought disposing of SHIKI would solve everything. Once he died, the intruder siphoning off your life would be gone.”
“―――――Ah”
Of course.
With SHIKI gone, my life should have been mine alone and the anemia should have ended.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I thought if I killed SHIKI it would be solved.
If SHIKI died, then he would no longer be able to steal your life."
"-----Ah."
…… That's right.
If SHIKI is no longer alive, then I could have my life to myself, so I wouldn't be anemic anymore.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「ふふ。
それがね、おかしいのよ兄さん。
私以外の誰かがシキを処理していれば、兄さんは元通りになれたのに。
　言ったでしょう？
　私、シキから全てを奪ってしまったって。
私は琥珀のように他人と感応する力なんてない。
奪ったモノを、誰かに与えるなんて事もできない」
　秋葉は心底おかしそうに、自分自身を卑下するように、微笑をうかべた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But here is the funny part, Brother. If anyone else had disposed of SHIKI, you could have returned to normal.
I told you—I took everything from him. I have no power to resonate with others as Kohaku does, nor can I give what I take to someone else.”
Akiha smiled as though it were all genuinely hilarious, her amusement sharpened into contempt for herself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hehe.
But, it really is funny.
If anyone other than me had killed SHIKI, then you would have been back to normal.
Didn't I tell you?
I stole everything from SHIKI.
I do not have the power to synchronize like Kohaku.
What I stole, I cannot give to anyone else."
She strangely gives a heartfelt smile in pure self-deprecation.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「シキを殺してから、私は体の重みから解放された。
毎夜やってきていた発作も起きなくなって、気分がとてもいいんです。
　……理由は言うまでもないでしょう？
　結局、私はシキを通じて兄さんの命を奪ってしまったの。
　けど、それは奪っただけで兄さんに返す事ができない。
シキと違って、私には誰かと共融する術もありませんから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Since killing SHIKI, I have been freed from the weight in my body. The attacks that came every night have stopped, and I feel wonderful.
The reason is obvious, isn’t it? Through SHIKI, I ended up taking your life as well.
But I can only take it. I cannot return it to you. Unlike SHIKI, I have no means of coalescence with another person.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"After killing SHIKI, I felt a weight lifted from me.
Those spasms I had every evening did not occur, and I felt great.
…… I do not need to say why, do I?
Because, in place of SHIKI, I am now stealing your life.
But, I just took it and I can't give it back to you, Nii-san.
Unlike SHIKI, I do not have the ability to fuse."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……そう、兄さんとシキは共融していたんです。
確かに兄さんはシキから大半の命を奪われていたけど、シキが眠っている時は逆にシキからの供給があったんです。
　それも今ではなくなってしまった。
兄さんの体が動かないのはその為です。
だから私は、今まで以上に兄さんに力を分け与えないといけない。
　……その為には、人の血を摂取して力を蓄える必要がありました」
　言って。
秋葉は赤く染まる窓際から身を離した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You and SHIKI existed in coalescence. He had taken most of your life, yes, but whenever he slept, life flowed back from him to you.
Now even that supply is gone. That is why your body will not move.
I must give you more of my strength than ever before—and to do that, I needed to drink human blood and replenish myself.”
She says it. Then Akiha steps away from the window stained red by sunset.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes, you were fused with SHIKI.
Certainly, SHIKI took away life from you, but it returned to you when he slept.
But that is no longer the case.
That is why you have trouble moving now.
That is why I have to continue supplying you with energy more than before.
…… For that reason, I need to accumulate energy from people's blood."
After saying this, Akiha walks away from the glowing red window.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「兄さん。
たしかに私は血を吸う鬼かもしれない。
けどそれはすべて兄さんの為だった。
　それでも兄さんは私を許せないというの？
　遠野志貴としてではなく、七夜志貴として私を殺しますか？」
「――――――――――――」
　返答が浮かばない。
　秋葉に言われるまでもなく、俺は遠野志貴という人間だ。
　今更、そんな記憶にも残っていない七夜なんていう人間にはならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Perhaps I truly am a blood-drinking fiend. But everything I did was for you.
Can you still not forgive me? Will you kill me, not as Shiki Tohno, but as Shiki Nanaya?”
“――――――――――――”
No answer comes.
Akiha does not need to tell me that I am Shiki Tohno.
I will not suddenly become some man named Nanaya whom I cannot even remember.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san.
Maybe I am just a blood sucking demon, but it is all for your sake.
Will you still not allow it?
Not as Tohno Shiki, but will you kill me as Nanaya Shiki?"
"------------"
I don't know what to say.
Whatever she says, I'm Tohno Shiki.
I won't become what I don't even remember, as Nanaya.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
だが、体は違うのか。
　今の秋葉を見ていると、全身の力を蓄えるようにギリギリとゼンマイが巻かれていくようだ。
　それは今にも。
遠野秋葉という人とはかけ離れたモノを、どうにかしようという勢いで。
entries.maoEnglish:
But does my body disagree?
Looking at Akiha now, I feel every spring inside me winding tighter and tighter, storing strength for the instant it can strike.
It seems ready at any moment. Ready to deal with this thing so utterly unlike the person Akiha Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But, my body is different.
Just seeing Akiha causes all the strength in my body to coil like a spring.
It's like, it's trying to do something to the nonhuman Tohno Akiha.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……違う。
遠野も七夜もない。
俺は、おまえに……秋葉に血を吸うなんて事を、してほしくないだけだ。
おまえに―――そんな、シキみたいな事だけはさせられない」
「兄さん。
私は兄さんのために血を吸っているんです。
どうしてそれが解ってくれないんですか？
　あの時だって―――私はちゃんと兄さんに自分の気持ちを伝えたのに、兄さんは何も言ってくれなかった。
　私は兄さんを愛しているって伝えたのに、どうして私以外の女を見ようとするんですか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. Tohno and Nanaya have nothing to do with it. I simply don’t want you—Akiha—to drink blood.
I can’t let you become like SHIKI.” “I drink blood for you, Brother.
Why can’t you understand? That night, I told you how I felt, and you gave me no answer.
I told you I loved you. Why do you keep looking at women other than me?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No.
It isn't about Tohno or Nanaya.
I just don't want you…… as Akiha to have to drink blood.
I don't want you---to be like SHIKI."
"Nii-san.
I'm doing this for your sake.
Don't you understand that?
Even that time---I told you how I felt and you didn't even say anything.
I told you, that I loved you, so why do you look at another woman……!?"
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――愛してるって、そんなのは兄妹としてだろう……！
　たとえ血が繋がっていなくても、俺たちは兄妹なんだぞ！？
　なにバカなことを言ってるんだよ、おまえは………！」
「バカな事なんかじゃないっ…………！！
　兄妹だから―――妹だから好きになってはいけないっていうんですか！？」
　秋葉の声が部屋に響く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“L-Love? You meant as brother and sister! Even without sharing blood, we are brother and sister! What kind of nonsense are you talking about?”
“It isn’t nonsense! Does being your sister mean I’m forbidden to fall in love with you?”
Akiha’s shout rang through the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Bu---love?
But that's like brother and sister……!
Even if we are not connected by blood, we're still siblings!
Don't say such stupid things……!"
"It is not stupid………!!
Because we are siblings---I can't love you!?"
Her voice echoes through the room.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
……そんな大声を出したのは初めてだったのか。
　秋葉ははぁはぁと肩を上下させて、悔しそうに唇を噛み締めていた。
「―――――――秋、葉」
「……兄さん。
私はこのまま、人間でないものになってしまってもかまわない。
それで兄さんが生きていてくれるなら、どうなってもかまわないんです。
　だから―――兄さんも私だけを見てください。
秋葉はずっと兄さんを待っていたんです。
せっかくこうして帰ってきてくれたのに、今更……私を、裏切らないで」
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps she has never raised her voice that way before.
Her shoulders heave as she breathes, and she bites her lip in wounded frustration.
“―――――――Akiha.”
“Brother, I don’t care if I cease to be human. If it means you remain alive, I don’t care what becomes of me.
So please—look only at me. Akiha waited for you all these years. Now that you have finally come home…please don’t betray me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… That may be the first time she's yelled like that.
Akiha's shoulders rise and fall as she pants heavily and bites her lip regretfully.
"-------Aki, ha."
"…… Nii-san.
I don't care if I become no longer human.
If that means you can live, then I do not care what happens.
So please---look only at me.
I was always waiting for you.
Now that you came back…… do not betray me."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
―――指を震わせて、秋葉はそう言った。
　秋葉は唇を閉ざして、ただ答えを待っている。
　自分だけを見てほしい、という告白。
　……プライドの高い秋葉がそんな言葉を口にするなんて、思わなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Her fingers trembled as she spoke.
Then Akiha sealed her lips and waited for my answer.
Look only at me.
I had never imagined proud Akiha would bring herself to make such a plea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Her fingers tremble as she says this.
She closes her mouth and awaits my response.
She wants me only to look at her.
…… I didn't think Akiha, with her pride, would ever actually say that.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
――――けど、違うんだ、秋葉。
　確かに秋葉は大切な存在だ。
　……今まで秋葉は俺を救ってくれていた。
なら出来るかぎり秋葉の望みに応えたいと思う。
　けど、それでも―――秋葉は妹なんだ。
　そこにそれ以上の愛情は持てない。
　俺が一番に思っている相手は秋葉ではなくなっているんだから―――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――But that wasn’t how I felt, Akiha.
Akiha was precious to me.
She had kept me alive all these years, and I wanted to grant her wishes wherever I could.
But even so, she was my sister.
I could not love her as anything more.
The person dearest to me was no longer Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----But, that's wrong, Akiha.
Without a doubt, she is dear to me.
…… Akiha has saved me up until now.
So I want to grant her wishes as much as I can.
But, still---she is my sister.
I can't love her in any other way.
Because the one I think of the most isn't her---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「…………秋葉。
俺は、おまえの気持ちには応えられない。
俺にとって大切な人は、別にいるんだ」
　……秋葉は、初めから解っていたように冷静だった。
　静かに瞼を閉じると、俺の前から離れていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha…I can’t return your feelings. There is someone else who matters to me.”
Akiha remained calm, as though she had known my answer from the beginning.
She quietly closed her eyes and moved away from me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Akiha.
I can't return your feelings.
My special person, is someone else."
…… Akiha is calm, as if she knew from the start.
She closes her eyes quietly and distances herself.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
かつかつ、という足音。
　秋葉は窓際まで歩いていく。
　ざあ、と。
　風が、秋葉の長い髪を吹き流した。
entries.maoEnglish:
The click-clack of heels.
Akiha walks to the window.
Whoosh.
The wind streams her long hair behind her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her footsteps.
She walks to the window.
The wind blows her long hair freely.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
だけど兄さん？
　貴方には、自由なんてないんですよ」
―――冷たい流し目。
　その直後、
　ガクン、と、俺の体は突然地面にひざをついた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. But Brother…you have no freedom to choose.”
―――A cold sidelong glance.
In the next instant,
My body buckled, and I crashed abruptly to my knees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Oh?
But, Nii-san.
You do not have a choice."
---Her eyes become glaciers.
In that instant,
My body collapses to the floor loudly.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「あ――――、ぐっ……………！？」
　息。
息が、できない。
　さっきまでのような、息苦しいというレベルじゃない。
　ほんと、うに息ができなく、て、手足が、動か、な――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――gh――――!?”
Breath. I cannot breathe.
This is no mere shortness of breath like before.
I truly cannot breathe, and my arms and legs will not mo――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----, gah………………!?"
Breathe.
I can't breathe.
This is worse than anything before.
I really, can't breathe, my arms, and legs, won't move----
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「どうですか兄さん？
　八年前の状態に戻られた感想は」
　秋葉、の―――忍び笑い、が、聞こえ、る。
「あ…………あき、は――――？」
　なんとか視線をあげる。
　そこには今にも崩れそうな危うさを纏った、秋葉の、愉しむような、瞳があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How does it feel, Brother, to be returned to the state you were in eight years ago?”
I could hear Akiha’s stifled laughter.
“A…Akiha…?”
Somehow I raised my eyes.
She stood over me with an air of peril, as though she might shatter at any moment, and eyes bright with enjoyment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How is it, Nii-san?
Returning to how it was eight years ago."
I can hear her laughter.
"A…………… Aki, ha----?"
I somehow manage to look up.
Her eyes are filled with pleasure as she looks at my deteriorating, fragile situation.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「言ったでしょう、兄さんの体は私が生かしてあげているんだって。
　わかる？
　私が少しでもそう思えば死んでしまう体。
それが遠野志貴という命なのよ、兄さん」
　耳元で、囁くように、秋葉は言う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you that I am the one keeping your body alive. Do you understand?
If I so much as will it, you die. That is the life called Shiki Tohno, Brother.”
Akiha whispered the words into my ear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I told you your body is alive only because of me.
Do you understand?
I just have to think it and you will die.
That is the life of Tohno Shiki, Nii-san."
Her voice reaches my ear like a whisper.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――――、っ、――――――！」
　熱が冷めていく。
　急速に死に転がっていく錯覚。
　体中の感覚が消えていって、気を抜けば一秒あとにも消えてしまいそうな、怖さ。
　……秋葉の言っている事は本当だ。
　こうしている今も、秋葉に、心臓を鷲づかみにされているような、気がする――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――kh――――――!”
The heat drains from me.
I feel as though I am tumbling rapidly into death.
Sensation vanishes throughout my body, leaving the terror that if I relax for even a second, I will disappear.
Akiha is telling the truth.
Even now, it feels as though she has my heart clutched in her fist――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----, Ss, -------!"
My heat cools down.
I feel like I'm rapidly tumbling towards death.
My senses start to drain away and I'm scared that if I let my guard down, I will totally disappear.
…… What she is saying is the truth.
Akiha clutches my very heart in her hands right now----
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「兄さんの意思は強いのね。
私、このまま気絶させるつもりで力の供給を断ったのに」
　……秋葉の指が下りてくる。
　つう、と。
　背中をなぞっていく、白い指。
「あ――――痛っ……………！」
　その爪が、背中の傷跡を抉っていく。
「……素敵。
私がつけた傷が、まだ残ってる」
　あの夜。
　泣きながら抱きついてきた秋葉が掻き毟った、背中の傷跡を。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You do have a strong will, Brother. I cut off your supply of strength intending to make you faint.”
Akiha’s finger descends.
Slowly.
One pale finger traces a line down my back.
“Ah—ow…!”
Her nail digs into the scar on my back.
“How lovely. The wound I gave you is still here.”
That night.
The scar Akiha tore into me when she clung to me and wept.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're pretty strong-willed.
I took enough energy away to cause you to pass out already."
…… Her finger lowers.
Ah.
Her finger traces on my back.
"Ah----ouch………………!"
Her nail finds the scars on my back.
"…… Beautiful.
The cuts I gave you are still here."
That night.
Those marks she gave me when she was holding me and crying.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「―――さあ、もう一度訊くわ兄さん。
兄さんにとって一番大切なのは私ですよね？」
　耳元で囁かれる声。
　体の感覚は、もう完全になくなろうとしている。
　このまま答えなければ、そのまま―――俺は、死んでしまうのかも、しれない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now I’ll ask you once more, Brother. I am the most important person in your life, aren’t I?”
Her voice whispered at my ear.
Sensation was almost entirely gone from my body.
If I refused to answer, perhaps I would simply die.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---So, I will ask once more, Nii-san.
I am the most important person to you, right?"
Her whispering voice next to my ear.
My senses are just about completely gone.
If I don't answer---I might die.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「答えて。
私、いつまでも優しくしてあげるつもりはありませんよ？」
　…………冗談じゃ、ない。
　こんな力ずくの方法になんか、従えない……！
「――――もう。
本当に強情ね、兄さんは」
　秋葉の指が離れる。
「わかりました。
明日まで時間をさしあげますから、少しは冷静になって考えてください」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me. I have no intention of being gentle forever.”
Like hell.
I would not submit to brute force like this.
“――――Honestly. You’re terribly stubborn, Brother.”
Akiha’s finger withdraws.
“Very well. I’ll give you until tomorrow, so use the time to calm yourself and think.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer.
I will not be gentle forever, you know."
………… You've gotta be kidding me.
Using her power like this on me, I won't cave in……!
"----Geez.
You really are strong-willed, Nii-san."
Her finger pulls away.
"I understand.
I will give you until tomorrow to think about it calmly."
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
秋葉は倒れた俺から離れて、受話器のような物を手に取った。
「琥珀、私の部屋にきて。
運んでほしいものがあるから」
　秋葉の声は弾んでいる。
「――――――――――」
　……よく、思考がまとまらない。
　ただ琥珀さんがここに来る、という事ぐらいしか、消えそうな意識は理解できな、かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha steps away from my fallen body and picks up something resembling a telephone receiver.
“Kohaku, come to my room. I have something I want you to carry.”
Her voice is almost cheerful.
“――――――――――”
My thoughts will not come together.
As consciousness fades, all I understand is that Kohaku is coming.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha walks away from me and picks up something that looks like a receiver.
"Kohaku, come to my room.
There is something I need you to carry."
Her voice sounds happy.
"----------"
…… I can't think well.
All I can understand is that Kohaku-san, will be, here soon.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
扉が開いて、琥珀さんがやってきた。
「志貴――――さん？」
　倒れている、俺に気がついたのか。
　琥珀さんが走り、よってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The door opened, and Kohaku entered.
“Master Shiki――――?”
She must have seen me lying there.
Kohaku runs to my side.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The door opens and Kohaku-san arrives.

"Shiki----san?"
I think she realizes I'm on the floor.
She runs to me.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん……！？
　しっかりしてください、志貴さん……！」
　……本当に、意識が朦朧としてる、らしい。
　琥珀さんが。
こんな、声を荒立てているなんて、信じられ、ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…!? Please, stay with me, Master Shiki…!”
My mind really must be clouded.
Kohaku. I cannot believe she is raising her voice like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san……!?
Hang in there, Shiki-san……!"
…… My mind must be really messed up.
Kohaku-san.
She sounds, so tense.
I don't believe it.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さま、一体何をなさったのですか」
「別に。
ただ兄さんに現実を教えてあげただけよ。
体に直接教えてさしあげないと解ってくれないみたいだから」
「けれどここでこうしてもらうのもなんでしょう？
　だからね、琥珀。
兄さんを部屋まで連れていってあげて頂戴。
お可哀相に、明日の夜まではずっとその調子でしょうから」
　秋葉が背中をむける。
……寝室に行くらしい。
その背中でゆらめく、蜃気楼のような熱気が、気にかかる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha, what have you done to him?”
“Nothing in particular. I merely taught Brother the reality of his situation. He seemed unable to understand until his body learned it firsthand.”
“Still, we can hardly leave him lying here. Kohaku, take Brother back to his room. Poor thing. He’ll remain like this until tomorrow night.”
Akiha turns her back. She seems to be heading into her bedroom. The mirage-like heat wavering behind her troubles me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama, what have you done?"
"Nothing.
I just showed Nii-san how things stand.
It seemed he would not understand unless I told his body."
"But I can't just let him lie here all night.
So can you take him to his room?
He will be in that state at least until tomorrow night."
Akiha turns away.
…… It seems like she's going to her bedroom.
That fiery aura swirls behind her back like a mirage.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「…………志貴さん、立てますか？」
　………立てる、と口にしたが、言葉にはならなかった。
　琥珀さん、が肩を貸してくれる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Master Shiki, can you stand?”
I try to say yes, but the answer never becomes sound.
Kohaku let me lean on her shoulder.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Shiki-san, can you stand?"
……… I can.
That's what I meant to say, but I can't even do that.
Kohaku-san lends me her shoulder.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
……自分で歩いている、という感触も、自分が生きているのだという感覚さえ希薄。
　遠野志貴という人間を動かすケーブルが、断線している。
　途切れ途切れの映像を見つめながら、俺は秋葉の部屋から、廊下に出た、ようだった――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Even the sense that I am walking under my own power is faint, as is any feeling that I remain alive.
The cables that make Shiki Tohno function have been severed.
Watching the world in broken frames, I seem to leave Akiha’s room and emerge into the corridor――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I hardly feel like I am alive, let alone able to walk.
The cable that lets the human Tohno Shiki move about seems to have been cut.
Looking at my vision in pieces, it seems I have gone out, into the hallway----
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
――――夜になった。
　遠野志貴の体はベッドに横たわっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Night fell.
The body of Shiki Tohno lay on the bed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Night falls.
Tohno Shiki is lying in bed.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
ぜーぜーという呼吸音が、時計の秒針を隠している。
　体は、関節という関節が火花を散らしているように痛い。
　意識は断片的。
おそらくは秒単位で気絶と覚醒を繰り返している。
―――そのせいだろう。
　今がどのくらいの時間なのかは知らない。
　秋葉の部屋から自分の部屋に戻ってから、もう一週間ぐらい経過したような気がする。
　……それがただの錯覚だという事は、八の数字で止まった時計が教えてくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The rasp of my breathing drowns out the ticking of the clock’s second hand.
Every joint in my body hurts as though it is throwing off sparks.
My consciousness comes in fragments. I am probably fainting and waking again every few seconds.
―――That must be why.
I have no idea how much time has passed.
It feels as though a week has passed since I returned from Akiha’s room.
The clock, whose hands have stopped at eight, tells me it is only an illusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My wheezing drowns out the ticking of the clock.
My body feels like every joint is bursting like a firecracker.
Consciousness comes in shards.
I am probably alternating between waking and fainting in between each second.
---It's because of that, I suppose.
I don't know how long it's been.
It feels like a week since I came back to my room.
…… The clock pointed at the number eight tells me that it is just an illusion.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「――――、――――――、―――――」
　呼吸が、止まりそうだ。
　四十度近い熱を出した時も、ここまでひどくはなかった。
　体は動かない。
　なのに心臓だけが、さっきから暴走している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――, ――――――, ―――――”
My breathing threatens to stop.
Even a fever near forty degrees has never been this bad.
My body will not move.
Yet my heart alone has been running wild for some time.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----,------,-----"
My breathing, almost, stops.
When I had a terrible fever, it wasn't this bad.
My body doesn't move.
But my heart is racing.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　……秋葉が意図的にそうしているんだろう、俺の体は動く事がない。
　まるで鉄の杭で、手足がベッドに磔にされているような感覚だ。
　だっていうのに、その気になれば体を動かす事ぐらいはできそうだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
Akiha was presumably keeping me motionless on purpose.
It felt as though iron stakes had crucified my hands and feet to the bed.
Even so, I sensed that if I truly tried, I might still be able to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
…… Akiha probably did this on purpose, I can't even move.
My arms and legs feel crucified to the bed with iron nails.
But still, if I want to, I should be able to move them a bit.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　猛り狂った心臓が、秋葉の呪縛さえ上回っている。
　手足が杭によって封じられているのなら。
　封じられた部分だけを引き剥がして、心臓だけが外に出てしまいそうなほどの血の巡り。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
My raging heart is overpowering even Akiha’s curse.
As if iron stakes held my limbs down.
The blood seems ready to tear free of every pinned part and send my heart bursting out of my body on its own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
My wildly beating heart seems to overpower Akiha's curse.
If my limbs are nailed down,
then it feels like my heart will burst out of this nailed down body.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　何を興奮しているのか。
―――赤い髪の秋葉。
　それを思うだけで、動かないはずの手足が痙攣する。
　きっと、ある事をする為なら、この体はなんとか動いてくれるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
What was it so excited about?
―――Akiha with red hair.
Merely thinking of her made my supposedly lifeless hands and feet convulse.
For one particular purpose, this body would surely find a way to move.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
What is so exciting?
---Akiha with her red hair.
Just thinking of that makes those immobile limbs somehow convulse.
Probably, my body would move to do one thing.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　……頭の中にあるのはなんだろう。
　さっきの、ひどく愉しげだった秋葉の事か。
　アレはおかしかった。
　確かに秋葉はああいう所があったかもしれないけど、アレはいきすぎだ。
　何か、秋葉本人でさえ気がついていないようなモノが、秋葉に獲り憑いているとしか思えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
What was filling my mind?
The memory of Akiha and her terrible delight?
Something about her had been wrong.
Akiha might always have possessed traces of that nature, but what I saw went far beyond them.
Something she herself had not recognized could only have taken possession of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
…… What's in my head right now?
Akiha horribly filled with pleasure earlier?
That was certainly strange.
Certainly she has that in her character, but that was just too much.
It's like something that she doesn't even notice is controlling her.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　秋葉はシキの狂気を飲んだのか。
　シキが狂ってしまった原因があるとしたら、その原因を、秋葉は知らずに摂り込んでしまったのかもしれない。
　だとしたら。
　アレは、遠野槙久と同じ、ただの――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
Had Akiha swallowed SHIKI’s madness?
If something drove SHIKI insane, Akiha may have unknowingly taken that cause into herself.
If so.
Then that thing was just like Makihisa Tohno—nothing but――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Did she absorb SHIKI's madness?
There had to be a reason for his insanity, and maybe Akiha consumed it without knowing it.
If that is the case…
It's just the same as Tohno Makihisa, just----
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
ころせ。
ころせ。
ころせ。
ころせ。
「うる、さい―――――」
　猛り狂う心臓を抑えこむ。
　まったく、さっきから何を興奮していやがるんだ。
　そう休む事なく繰り返されると、俺だってその気になってしまうじゃないか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kill it. Kill it. Kill it. Kill it.
“Shut up―――――”
I fought down the heart rampaging inside me.
What the hell had it been getting so excited about?
If it kept repeating itself without pause, even I would begin to feel like obeying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
"Shut, up-----"
I try to suppress my raging heart.
Geez, what am I being so excited about?
If I keep going through this cycle, won't I actually start to feel that way?
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
ころせ。
ころせ。
ころせ。
ころせ。
「はっ――――ぁ、はぁ、は――――――」
　喉が苦しい。
　体が軋む。
　わかっているのか、この考え無し。
　こんな体で今の秋葉に逆らっても、勝ち目なんて一つもない。
　殺してほしかったら。
　アレを殺せというのなら、もう少し黙っていろ。
　そうすれば言われなくても、この血にかけてあの魔を踏み潰してや、る―――
entries.maoEnglish:
Kill it. Kill it. Kill it. Kill it.
“Hah――――ah, hah, hah――――――”
My throat burns.
My body creaks.
Do you understand, you thoughtless fool?
In this condition, I have no chance against Akiha as she is now.
If you want me to kill it.
If you insist that thing must die, then be quiet a little longer.
Then, without being told, I swear upon this blood that I will crush that demon beneath my feet―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
Kill.
"Ha-----agh, ha, hagh------"
My throat hurts.
My body creaks.
Don't you get it?
I can't oppose her with this body.
If you want to kill,
if you want to kill that, then shut up for a second.
If you do, I will certainly destroy that demon without you telling me so---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
「違うっ…………！
　何を、その気になってるんだ、俺は…………！！！」
　どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
どくん。
　狂った鼓動は続く。
　俺は、朦朧と。
気絶と覚醒を繰り返す、夢とも現ともとれない時間に投げこまれている。
―――これじゃあ明日を待つまでもない。
　こんなものが一晩中続くというのなら、俺は零時を待たずして発狂するに違いなかった―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“No! What the hell am I getting ready to do!?”
Thump. Thump. Thump. Thump.
The mad pulse continues.
I am dazed. I am cast into a stretch of time neither dream nor waking, fainting and surfacing over and over.
―――At this rate, there would be no need to wait for tomorrow.
If this continued all night, I would surely go mad before the clock struck midnight―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No…………!
What, like I would ever…………!!!"
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
The mad pounding continues.
I, faintly, cycle between blankness and awareness, dream and reality.
---I can't last until tomorrow.
If this keeps up, I'll go insane first---
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese:
発汗していた体から、汗が引いていく。
　肉が焼けるかもしれないぐらいに熱くなった肌が、ひんやりと冷えていく。
　額には濡れたタオルの感触。
　体をわずかに起こされて、唇にコップをつけられた。
　こくり。
　少しだけ冷えた水が、喉を滑り落ちていく快感。
――――――。
　すぐ近くには人の気配。
entries.maoEnglish:
The sweat slicking my body begins to dry.
Skin that had burned hot enough to roast the flesh beneath it slowly turns cool.
I feel a damp towel against my forehead.
Someone raises me a little and presses a glass to my lips.
I swallow.
The water is faintly cool, and the pleasure of it slipping down my throat is exquisite.
――――――……
Someone is close beside me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sweat fades from my drenched body.
My roasting flesh begins to cool.
The feeling of a soaked towel is on my forehead.
My body is lifted and a cup is placed against my lips.
Gulp.
The sensation of cool water flowing down my throat.
------.
I sense someone nearby.
entries.scriptLabel: 8 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour II

entries.japanese: それで、誰かに看病されているのだと、気がついた。
entries.maoEnglish: Only then do I realize that someone has been nursing me.
entries.mirrorMoon: I realize that someone is taking care of me.

entries.japanese:
「こんばんは。
お体の具合はどうですか、志貴さん」
　いつもの笑顔で、彼女はそう言った。
「あ……琥珀、さん」
　千切れた呼吸を束ねて、なんとか声をあげた。
「あ、喋らないでいいですよ。
今の志貴さんがどんな状態なのかは、きっと志貴さんより解っていますから」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のまま、俺の額に乗ったタオルを外した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good evening, Master Shiki. How are you feeling?”
she asks with her usual smile.
“Ko…haku”
I gather the torn scraps of my breath and somehow force out her name.
“You don’t have to talk. I probably understand your condition better than you do.”
Still smiling, Kohaku removes the towel from my forehead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good evening.
How are you feeling, Shiki-san?"
She speaks with her usual smile.
"Ah…… Kohaku, san."
I somehow manage to speak through my tattered breathing.
"Ah, you do not have to speak.
I probably understand your condition better than you do."
She removes the towel from my forehead, still smiling.

entries.japanese:
―――やっぱり、さっきのは幻だったのか。
　琥珀さんはいつも通りだ。
こんな時でも笑顔のままで、翡翠のふりを続けている。
　……それを。
　俺は琥珀さんからその仮面を剥がす事もできず、ここで終わってしまうんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――So what I saw before really was a hallucination.
Kohaku is exactly as she always is. Even now, she wears that smile and continues pretending to be Hisui.
That mask.
Is this where I end—without ever managing to tear it from her face?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Was that thing before just an illusion?
Kohaku-san is acting normal.
She keeps smiling and continuing her portrayal of Hisui.
…… That.
Am I going to die here without being able to take off that mask?

entries.japanese:
「事情は秋葉さまから聞きました。
秋葉さまは明日まで待つ、とおっしゃっていましたが、それでは間にあいません。
　秋葉さまも冷静な判断力を失っているんですね。
　このままだと志貴さんは今夜を越す事はできませんから」
「―――――――――」
　ぜーぜーと喉が喘ぐ。
　琥珀さんの言葉は、容赦がなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha told me what happened. Miss Akiha said she would wait until tomorrow, but that will be too late.
It seems even Miss Akiha has lost the ability to judge matters calmly.
At this rate, you won’t survive the night.”
“―――――――――”
My throat rasps and wheezes.
Kohaku’s words show no mercy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama told me everything.
She said that she would wait until tomorrow, but that may be too long.
Akiha-sama seems to have lost her ability to think clearly.
I don't think you'll be able to make it through the night like that, Shiki-san."
"---------"
*wheeze* *wheeze*
Kohaku-san's words are unmercifully true.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さんは前に言いました。
自分は死というものに対して麻痺しているんだって。
　今もそうなんですか？
　だからこんな体でも秋葉さまに逆らうなんて、そんな希望のない事をしているんですか」
「―――――――――琥珀さん？」
　……驚いた。
　琥珀さんの声は、今までとは違う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, you once told me something. You said you had grown numb to death.
Is that still true? Is that why you would defy Miss Akiha even in this condition, when there is no hope in doing so?”
“―――――――――Kohaku?”
I am taken aback.
Her voice is nothing like it was before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, you told me before.
You said that you were numb to death.
Is that still true?
Are you still going to act against Akiha-sama hopelessly with a body like that?"
"---------Kohaku-san?"
…… I'm surprised.
Kohaku-san's voice, it's completely different than before.

entries.japanese:
「……ワケないだろ。
俺は人より死ってものに敏感だって言ったじゃないか。
……だから、今の自分がどういう状況なのかは解ってるつもりだよ。
　琥珀さんに言われるまでもなく―――今夜を越すのは難しいなって、気づいてた」
「では、志貴さんは死が怖くないんですね。
秋葉さまを受け入れれば今すぐにでも良くなるのに、それをしないなんてどうかしています」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course not. I told you I’m more sensitive to death than most people. So I think I understand what condition I’m in.
I’d already realized, without needing you to say it―――that I probably won’t make it through tonight.”
“Then you aren’t afraid to die. Refusing Miss Akiha when accepting her would make you well at once is madness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… No way.
I told you that I am more attuned to death than most people…… So I think I understand the situation I'm in.
Without you telling me---I knew that surviving the night will be extremely difficult."
"Then you are not scared of death?
If you accept Akiha-sama then you will recover quickly, but you still do not.
There's something wrong with you."

entries.japanese:
「……そうかもしれない。
けど、それでいいって思ってる。
俺はこういう自分が好きだし、そんな自分を好いてくれた秋葉が好きなんだ。
　……ああ、それに、さ。
こうして琥珀さんと話が出来るような、なんでもない事も好きなんだ。
　……だけど自分に嘘をついたら、そういうのが楽しくなくなりそうで、こわ、い――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Maybe it is. But I’m all right with that. I like the person I am, and I love Akiha for loving that person.
And―――there’s more. I love ordinary things too, like lying here and talking to you.
But if I lied to myself, I’m afraid none of those things would feel right anymore――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe.
But, I think it's okay.
I like the me that acts like this, and I like Akiha for liking me as I am.
…… Yes, and, well… I enjoy small things like just being able to talk with you, Kohaku-san.
…… But I feel like if I lie to myself, all those small things would lose their enjoyment, and I'm scared of that----"

entries.japanese: それで、誰かに看病されているのだと、気がついた。
entries.maoEnglish: Only then do I realize that someone has been nursing me.
entries.mirrorMoon: I realize that someone is taking care of me.

Akiha-sama seems to have lost her ability to think clearly.
I do not think you will be able to make it through the night like that, Shiki-san."
"---------"
*wheeze* *wheeze*
Kohaku-san's words are unmercifully true.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さん、わたし呆れてしまいました。
　志貴さんはご自分の体がどれほど危ういのか、理解していないんですか？
　今の志貴さんは秋葉さまがそう思うだけで死んでしまわれる体です。
　それなのに秋葉さまに逆らうなんて、そんな希望のない事をしても仕方がないのに」
「―――――――――琥珀、さん」
　……驚いた。
　琥珀さんの声は、今までとは違う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, I’m appalled.
Do you truly not understand how precarious your body has become? As you are now, you will die the moment Miss Akiha wishes it.
There is no point defying Miss Akiha when it is so hopeless.”
“―――――――――Kohaku.”
I am taken aback.
Her voice is nothing like it was before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-san, I am amazed.
Do you not understand the danger your body is in, Shiki-san?
All Akiha-sama has to do is think it and you will die.
So why do you still act against her?
It is completely hopeless."
"---------Kohaku, san."
…… I'm surprised.
Kohaku-san's voice, it is completely different than before.

entries.japanese:
「……わかってる。
俺はきっと、このままだと今夜を越えるコトは出来ないって、理解してる」
「では、志貴さんは死が怖くないんですね。
秋葉さまを受け入れれば今すぐにでも良くなるのに、それをしないなんてどうかしています」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I understand. I know that if nothing changes, I probably won’t make it through tonight.”
“Then you aren’t afraid to die. Refusing Miss Akiha when accepting her would make you well at once is madness.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I know.
I know that I can't last the night like this."
"Then you are not scared of death?
If you accept Akiha-sama then you will recover quickly, but you still do not.
There's something wrong with you."

entries.japanese:
「……そうかもしれない。
けど、それでいいって思ってる。

entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Maybe.
But, I think it's okay.
I like the me that acts like this, and I like Akiha for liking me as I am.
…… Yes, and, well… I enjoy small things like just being able to talk with you, Kohaku-san.
…… But I feel like if I lie to myself, all those small things would lose their enjoyment, and I'm scared of that----"

entries.japanese:
激しく咳き込んだ。
　……無理をして琥珀さんと話をしているからだろう。
　今の俺の体は、そんな余分な事さえ許されない。
entries.maoEnglish:
A violent fit of coughing seizes me.
I must have pushed myself too far talking to Kohaku.
In its present state, my body will not permit even that small indulgence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I cough violently.
…… Probably because I am forcing myself to talk to Kohaku-san,
my body doesn't even allow me to do that properly.

entries.japanese:
「……志貴さん。
どうして秋葉さまを好きだと言わなかったんですか？」
　同じ質問が繰り返された。
　ただ、今の質問は以前のものとは違っている。
　琥珀さんの声は、どこか―――悲しそうに、聞こえた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Why didn’t you tell Miss Akiha you loved her?”
She repeats the same question.
But this time it is different from before.
Kohaku’s voice sounds almost―――sad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Shiki-san.
Why don't you tell Akiha-sama that you love her?"
She asks the same thing again.
But this time, it's a little different.
Kohaku-san's voice seems---somewhat sad.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さまの言う通りにすれば志貴さんは生きていられます。
たとえ口先だけの方便でも、今はそうなさらないと死んでしまうじゃないですか。
　志貴さんが何を思っているか知りませんけど、秋葉さまのお気持ちに応えてあげればいいんですよ」
―――そんな事。
　　　出来るんだったら、とっくにやってる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“If you do as Miss Akiha asks, you can live. Even if you don’t mean a word of it, you have to say it now or you’ll die.
I don’t know what’s going through your mind, but surely you could at least return Miss Akiha’s feelings.”
―――If I could.
I would have done it long ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If you do as Akiha-sama says, then you'll live.
Even if it's just lip service, you will die unless you do so.
I don't know what you're thinking, but isn't it better just to return her feelings?"
---Such a thing.
If I could do that, I would've already done it.

entries.japanese:
「―――嫌だ。
確かに俺は秋葉を愛している。
けどそれは兄妹の感情であって、それ以外のものじゃないんだよ。
　……俺が好きなのは秋葉じゃないだ、琥珀さん。
　俺は、一番好きな相手を偽る事だけは、したくない」
　荒い呼吸のまま、確かな口調で言った。
　かちり、と。
　秒針が一度落ちるだけの、短い沈黙のあと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No. I do love Akiha, but as her brother. Nothing more.
The person I’m in love with isn’t Akiha, Kohaku.
Whatever else I may do, I won’t lie about the person I love most.”
The words come through ragged breaths, but my voice does not waver.
Tick.
A single beat of the second hand passes in silence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
I do love Akiha, but only as my sister and nothing more.
…… The one I like isn't Akiha, Kohaku-san.
I don't, want to lie to the one, I love the most."
I force the words through my ragged breathing.
Tick.
The second hand of the clock ticks in the short silence.

entries.japanese:
「もうっ。
だめですね、志貴さんは。
今だけの、口先だけの方便も出来ないんですか？」
「……できない。
体が自由にならないのなら、せめて心ぐらいは自由でいたいんだ。
　一度自分に嘘をついたら、その嘘をつき続けるしかなくなっちゃうだろ。
　嘘を嘘で固めていってしまったら、いつかみんなガランドウになってしまう。
　そうなってしまったら俺は―――」
　……ただ一人逃げ場もなく、そうなってしまったあの少女を、
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Master Shiki. Are you really incapable of one little white lie, just for now?”
“…I can’t. If my body can’t be free, then at least I want my heart to be.
Once you lie to yourself, you have to keep living that lie.
You bury one lie beneath another until someday there’s nothing left inside.
And if that happened to me—”
that girl who had been left all alone, with nowhere to escape, until she was hollow inside
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh Shiki-san, that's no good.
You can't even do it just this once?"
"…… Nope.
If my body is not free, I'd like at least my heart to be free.
If I lie just once then I'll have to continue lying.
If I surround the lies with more lies, then it will all end up being empty.
If that happens, I would---"
…… That girl that had nowhere to run.

entries.japanese:
「――――一番好きな人を、このまま助けられなくなる」
　そうして、ただ琥珀さんだけを見つめた。
　彼女は笑顔に戻る事をせず、視線を逸らす。
「……駄目ですよ、そんな事じゃ。
それじゃあ秋葉さまが可哀相じゃないですか」
「秋葉が、可哀相……？」
「……はい。
秋葉さまは今夜も街に出かけて、誰かの血を吸うでしょう。
　秋葉さまはシキ様と違って血を吸った相手を同じ物にする力はありませんが、逆に相手から何かを奪う力があるんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――I would never be able to save her—the person I love most.”
I look at Kohaku and no one else.
She does not recover her smile, but looks away.
“That won’t do. Poor Miss Akiha.”
“Poor Miss Akiha―――?”
“Yes. Miss Akiha will go into town again tonight and drink someone’s blood.
Unlike SHIKI, Miss Akiha cannot turn those she feeds on into creatures like herself, but instead takes something from them.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Never be able to help the one I like the most."
And I just look at Kohaku-san.
She looks away without donning her smile again.
"…… That is, pointless.
Don't you pity Akiha-sama?"
"Pity, Akiha……?"
"…… Yes.
Every night she walks the streets and drinks someone's blood.
Akiha-sama is unable to make those from whom she sucks blood like herself in the manner SHIKI-sama was, but she has the ability to steal from others."

entries.japanese:
「秋葉さまも自覚しているはずです。
　いたずらに血を吸えば吸うほど、秋葉さまの力は人間とはかけ離れていく。
けれど秋葉さまはその行為をお止めにならない。
　……秋葉さまの力だけでは志貴さんを存命させられない。
だから―――自身が変貌していくと自覚していても、志貴さんを生かす為に秋葉さまは血を吸う鬼となり続ける」
「あ―――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha must know what it is doing to her.
The more blood Miss Akiha drinks, the further her power strays from anything human. Yet Miss Akiha refuses to stop.
Miss Akiha’s own strength is not enough to keep you alive, Master Shiki. And so―――even knowing that she is changing—Miss Akiha will go on becoming a monster that drinks blood, all to keep you alive.”
“Ah―――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama knows this.
She knows that sucking blood is making her less human, but she doesn't stop.
…… She's only doing it to keep you alive.
So---even though she knows it's transforming her into a blood sucking demon, she continues it for your sake."
"Ah-------"

entries.japanese:
「そこまで志貴さんを必要としている秋葉さまを拒むのですか？
　この八年間、秋葉さまは志貴さんだけを待ち続けていたというのに」
「――――――――」
　……そんな事、答えられない。
　そもそも、いま自分が死にかけているのは秋葉の仕業だ。
　けど今まで俺が生きてこれたのだって秋葉のおかげだった。
　俺は、秋葉に――――返す事なんてできないほど、大きな負債を持っている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Will you still reject Miss Akiha when she needs you so desperately, Master Shiki? For eight years, you were the only person Miss Akiha waited for.”
“――――――――”
I have no answer.
Akiha is the reason I am lying here dying in the first place.
But she is also the reason I have survived this long.
I owe her――――more than I could ever repay.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Do you still refuse her when she does all that for you?
These past eight years, Akiha-sama has waited only for you."
"--------"
…… I can't answer that.
In the first place, I'm dying because of Akiha.
But I've only lived until now because of her efforts.
I----have a debt to her that is too large for me to ever repay.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――っ」
　何が正しいのか、何が間違っているのか断言できない。
　それでも譲れないものがあって、どうしても許せないことがある。
　……だから、やるべき事は決まっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――!”
I cannot say what is right and what is wrong.
But there are things I will not surrender, and things I cannot forgive.
So I know what I have to do.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I can't say what is right and what is wrong.
But I still have something I can't give up and I can't permit.
…… So I know what I have to do.

entries.japanese:
「――――そう。
秋葉は今夜も、血を吸いに行くのか」
　体を起こす。
　脳髄には電流のような痛み。
　それを堪えて、なんとかベッドから立ちあがった。
「な……志貴さん、何を」
「……だめだ。
遠野秋葉に、血を吸うのをやめさせないと」
　なんとか一歩踏み出す。
　倒れそうだけどなんとか前にでれる。
　これなら……秋葉の部屋ぐらいには、行けるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――I see. So Akiha is going out to feed again tonight.”
I force myself upright.
Pain like an electric current tears through my brain.
Enduring it, I somehow manage to rise from the bed.
“Master Shiki―――what are you doing?”
“I can’t let her. I have to stop Akiha Tohno from drinking blood.”
I manage one step.
I nearly fall, but I can still move forward.
At this rate, I can at least make it to Akiha’s room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I see.
Akiha will go out and drink blood tonight again."
I raise myself up.
The pain runs through me like an electric shock.
I manage to stand up while resisting the volume of pain.
"Wha…… Shiki-san, what are--"
"…… No.
I can't let Tohno Akiha drink any more blood."
I laboriously take a single step.
Even though I may collapse at any moment, I continue forward.
I can at least…… make it to Akiha's room.

entries.japanese:
「お待ちください」
　立ちはだかるように。
　琥珀さんは、俺の視線の前に出た。
「秋葉さまを止める、と言いましたね。
それは七夜としての血ですか」
「……そんなものは知らない。
ただ秋葉には、今の秋葉のままで、いて、ほしいんだ。
それは遠野志貴としての、当然の、気持ち、だろ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please wait.”
As if to bar my way.
Kohaku steps directly into my path.
“You said you would stop Miss Akiha. Is that the blood of Nanaya speaking?”
“I don’t know anything about that. I only want Akiha to stay the Akiha she is now. That’s only natural for Shiki Tohno, isn’t it?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please wait."
Standing in my way,
Kohaku-san appears before me.
"You say you'll stop Akiha-sama.
Is that the blood of Nanaya speaking?"
"…… That has nothing to do with it.
I just want Akiha to be Akiha.
That is, what I, as Tohno Shiki, really feel."

entries.japanese:
「…………いけません。
そんなお気持ちのままでは、秋葉さまは志貴さんをお許しにはならないでしょう。
志貴さんも解っているはずです。
今の秋葉さまは以前の秋葉さまではないと」
　……そんな事は承知の上だ。
　秋葉の背中にゆらぐ蜃気楼。
アレが秋葉を追い詰めて、秋葉を秋葉で無くしている。
　今の秋葉にとって、秋葉を受け入れない俺はもういらないモノになっているんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You mustn’t, Master Shiki. Not if that is all you feel. Miss Akiha will never forgive you. Surely you understand that Miss Akiha is not the Miss Akiha she once was.”
I know that already.
There is a mirage wavering behind Akiha. That thing is driving her into a corner, stripping away everything that makes her Akiha.
To the woman she has become, a brother who will not accept her is probably nothing but refuse.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… You mustn't.
Akiha-sama will not have any mercy on you.
You realize it already.
The Akiha-sama from before no longer exists."
…… I know that.
That shimmering mirage behind her.
That thing is driving her away from being Akiha.
The way Akiha is now, she will see me as completely useless if I don't accept her.

entries.japanese:
「それでも―――止めないと。
俺は、あいつの、兄貴なんだから」
「………………………」
　琥珀さんは何も言わない。
　押しのけて、机まで歩く。
　そこには有間の家から持ってきた、数える程度の持ち物が入っている。
　引き出しからナイフを取り出す。
　……そうして。
まだ、返していないモノを、見つけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even so―――I have to stop her. I’m her brother.”
“…”
Kohaku says nothing.
I push past her and make my way to the desk.
It holds the handful of belongings I brought from the Arima home.
I take my knife from the drawer.
And then. I find something I have yet to return.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Even still---I must stop her.
I'm, her brother, after all."
"……………………"
Kohaku-san doesn't say anything.
I push my way through to the desk.
Inside is what I brought from the Arimas, only a few things.
I take my knife out of the drawer.
…… And I see that which I haven't yet returned.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さん」
　最後の名残に強く握り締めて、歩く。
「……………」
　琥珀さんはただ立ち尽くすだけだ。
「……最後になるかもしれないから、これ」
　手を差し出して、白いリボンを見せた。
「遅くなったけど、返すよ。
ごめんな。
せっかく借りたのに、結局、一度も使わなかった」
　……気持ちが言葉に出来たかどうかは解らない。
　ぽん、と出来るだけ優しく。
　少女の手に、約束のリボンを置いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku.”
Clutching it tightly in one last farewell, I cross to her.
“…”
Kohaku only stands there.
“This may be the last time, so here.”
I hold out my hand and show her the white ribbon.
“It took me long enough, but I’m giving it back. Sorry. You lent it to me, and in the end I never used it once.”
I do not know whether the words have carried what I feel. As gently as I can.
With the gentlest little pat I can manage, I lay the ribbon of our promise in the girl’s palm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku-san."
Gripping the final remnants, I walk.
"……………"
Kohaku-san just stands there.
"…… This might be the end, so here."
I hold out the white ribbon in my hand.
"It's a little late, but I'm giving it back.
Sorry.
You went through such trouble to give it to me, and I never even used it."
…… I don't know if my feelings were able to come out through my words.
And as gentle as I can,
I place the ribbon of promise into her hand.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――」
　息を飲む音。
　琥珀さんは人形のように立ち尽くして、呆然と、自分の手の平に納まったリボンを見つめている。
「………気づいていたんですか、志貴さん」
「……すぐには気がつかなかった。
解ったのは本当に最近なんだ。
……本当なら帰ってきたあの時に気がつかなくちゃいけなかったのに」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――――”
She catches her breath.
Kohaku stands frozen like a doll, staring numbly at the ribbon resting in her palm.
“You knew, Master Shiki?”
“Not at first. I only realized very recently. I should have known the moment I came home.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------"
The sound of gasping.
She stands stock still like a doll, just staring in amazement at the ribbon in her hand.
"……… You knew, Shiki-san?"
"…… Not right away.
It was only just recently.
…… I really should have realized it as soon as I came back."

entries.japanese:
そう。
屋敷に帰ってきた自分を迎えてくれた琥珀さんがお帰りなさい、といってくれた時に、俺は気がつかなくちゃいけなかった。
　それでもこの人は、昔ここにいた子か、と問いかけた俺に、微笑みを向けてくれた。
「……だから、今更俺にはそんな資格はないけど、ありがとう。
琥珀さんがこの家で待っていてくれて、嬉しかった」
　……それがこの八年間。
　遠野志貴がずっと言いたかった、言葉だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes. When I returned to the mansion and Kohaku welcomed me home, I should have known.
Yet when I asked whether she was the girl who had once lived here, she still gave me a smile.
“I have no right to say this after all this time, so thank you. I was glad you were here, waiting for me.”
For all these eight years.
Those are the words Shiki Tohno has always wanted to say.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah.
I should've realized it after I returned to the mansion and Kohaku-san said "Welcome back."
Even still, she smiled when I asked if she was one of the children who was here back then.
"…… I, don't have the right, but thanks.
I really was happy that you waited here for me."
…… For eight years.
Those were the words I always wanted to say as Tohno Shiki.

entries.japanese:
涙。
　彼女の頬。
嬉しくも悲しくもない顔に、一筋だけ涙が流れた。
　……その涙がどういったものか俺には解らない。
　ただ、儚くて。
　いつかのように、彼女の体を抱きしめていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
A tear.
Kohaku’s cheek. One solitary tear traces it, though her face looks neither happy nor sad.
I cannot tell what that tear means.
She looks so fragile.
Before I know it, I am holding her as I did once before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Tears.
Her face.
Her face is neither sad nor happy, but a single line flows down.
…… I don't know what it means.
But, naturally.
I hold her body close to mine.

entries.japanese:
……琥珀さんの体温を感じる。
　昂ぶった心臓は、それで、不思議と鎮まってくれた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku’s warmth seeps into me.
Strangely, it calms the frenzy of my heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can feel her warmth.
My raging heart seems to become strangely calm from it.

entries.japanese:
「……琥珀さん。
秋葉は俺が止めるから、琥珀さんは翡翠と一緒にここから離れるんだ。
……そうしたら、そのまま帰ってこなくていい。
　……十年もこの屋敷に囚われていたんだ。
琥珀さんは自由になっていいし、もう―――無理に笑う必要なんて、ない、から―――」
「志貴さん、あなたは、全部」
　知っているんですね、と、琥珀さんの唇が動く。
　それを言わせたくなくて、自然に、自分の唇で、彼女の口を閉ざした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku. I’ll stop Akiha, so take Hisui and leave this place. Once you’re gone, you never have to come back.
This mansion has held you prisoner for ten years. You’re allowed to be free now, and you never have to force yourself to smile again―――”
“Master Shiki, you know everything”
Her lips move to form the final words.
Not wanting to let her say them, I naturally seal her mouth with mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Kohaku-san.
I'll stop Akiha, so you get away with Hisui.
…… And you don't have to come back.
…… You've been locked in this mansion for ten years.
You can be free, and---you don't have, to force yourself, to smile---"
"Shiki-san, everything, you…"
Her lips mouth the word "knew".
I didn't want her to say those words, so I close her mouth with my own.

entries.japanese:
―――それはほんの一瞬。
　触れるだけの、けれど支配を交す口付けのように、忘れがたい時間だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It lasts only an instant.
Our lips barely touch, yet the moment is unforgettable—a kiss that seems to give each of us a claim upon the other.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It was really just an instant.
Just a touch, a fleeting kiss, but unforgettable.

entries.japanese:
顔をあげる。
　抱きとめた両腕を離す。
　人形のような彼女のかわりに、精一杯の笑顔をうかべた。
「それじゃ。
短い間だったけど、琥珀さんと居れて楽しかった。
――――うん。
俺、琥珀さんが一番好きだよ」
―――さあ行こう。
　あとは、秋葉を止めるだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I raise my head.
I release her from my arms.
In place of the doll-like girl before me, I summon the strongest smile I can.
“Goodbye, then. We weren’t together long, but I loved every moment of it.
――――Yes. You’re the one I love most, Kohaku.”
―――Time to go.
All that remains is to stop Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I raise my head.
I release her.
In place of the doll-like Kohaku-san, I smile with all of my heart.
"Well.
It was really short, but living here with you was a lot of fun.
----Yeah.
I really like you the best, Kohaku-san."
---Let's do this.
The only thing left is to stop Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「………………だめ、です」
　ドアを開けようとした時、後ろからそんな声が聞こえた。
「………………だめです、志貴さん。
そのままでは秋葉さまを止める事なんて、できません」
「……え？」
　振り返ると、そこには―――
「志貴さんには―――秋葉さまを止めていただかないと、いけないんです」
　笑顔ではなく、本当に悲しそうな顔の、琥珀さんがいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No.”
As I reach for the door, her voice comes from behind me.
“No, Master Shiki. You can’t stop Miss Akiha like that.”
“What?”
I turn, and there―――
“Master Shiki―――you have to stop Miss Akiha.”
Kohaku stands there without her smile, looking truly, painfully sad.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………… No, stop."
As I move to open the door, her voice rings out to me.
"……………… No, Shiki-san.
You can't stop Akiha-sama like that."
"…… Eh?"
I turn around---
"Shiki-san---you have to stop Akiha-sama."
Kohaku-san stands there, not with a smile, but with a truly sad face.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さん―――なんで」
　そんな、泣きそうな顔をしているんだろう。
「志貴さん。
今の、本当ですか？」
　琥珀さんはまっすぐに俺を見つめていた。
　それは、琥珀さんが好きだと言った事の真偽を確かめる瞳だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku―――why?”
Why does she look ready to cry?
“Master Shiki. Did you mean what you just said?”
Kohaku looks straight into my eyes.
Her gaze searches for proof that I truly meant it when I said I loved her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Kohaku-san---why?"
Why does she look like she's about to burst into tears?
"Shiki-san.
Did you really mean that?"
She looks directly at me.
Her eyes implore me to confirm what I said about liking her.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　無言でうなずく。
　琥珀さんはトコトコと歩いてくると、ぎゅっと俺の手を握った。
　……そのままでどのくらいの時間が流れただろう。
　琥珀さんは何も言わない。
ただ子供のように手を握った後、いつもの笑顔に戻って俺の手を胸の真ん中に置いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
I nod.
Kohaku comes pattering over and clasps my hand tightly.
How long do we remain that way?
Kohaku says nothing. After holding my hand like a child, she recovers her familiar smile and places my palm over the center of her breast.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I nod.
Kohaku-san shuffles over to me and holds my hand.
…… How long were we like this?
Kohaku-san doesn't say anything.
After holding my hand like a child, she smiles once more and places my hand against her chest.

entries.japanese:
「それでは、どうぞわたしを抱いてください。
そうすれば志貴さんは、秋葉さまの助けがなくても大丈夫になりますから」
「なっ――――抱いてって、琥珀さん何を」
「ですから体を重ねる事です。
わたしと翡翠ちゃんはもともとその為にこの屋敷に引き取られた子供なんですよ」
　琥珀さんは笑顔で、なんでもない事のようにとんでもない事を言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then please make love to me. If you do, you’ll no longer need Miss Akiha’s help.”
“Wh――――make love―――Kohaku, what are you saying?”
“I mean that we should join our bodies. Hisui and I were brought to this mansion for precisely that purpose.”
Still smiling, Kohaku delivers that staggering revelation as though it were nothing at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"If that's the case, then please make love to me.
If you do that, then you should be fine without Akiha-sama's help."
"Wha----make love… what are you-"
"I'm talking about having sex.
Hisui-chan and I were both brought to this mansion for that purpose you know."
Kohaku-san says such a thing with her usual smile as if discussing the weather.

entries.japanese:
「か、体を重ねるって、そんな……！」
　あまりに突然のことで声が裏返ってしまう。
「はい。
志貴さんは知らないでしょうけど、わたしたちは感応者と呼ばれる人間なんです。
　簡単に言ってしまうと、自分以外の誰かに自分を投影して、その人の力を向上させる事ができます。
　ですがそれができるのは対になる人……ようするに異性だけなんです。
秋葉さまは女性ですから、わたしとは感応できなかった。
だから秋葉さまはわたしの血を飲んで、仮の契りをしていただけなんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“J-join our bodies―――you can’t mean that!”
The shock pitches my voice into a squeak.
“Yes. You wouldn’t know this, but we are what people call resonators.
Put simply, we can project ourselves into another person and heighten that person’s power.
But it only works with our counterpart—in other words, someone of the opposite sex. Miss Akiha is a woman, so I could not resonate with Miss Akiha. She only drank my blood to form a temporary bond.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"S-sex, but that……!"
It's too sudden, my voice comes out weird.
"Yes.
You may not know this, but we are called Synchronizers.
Simply speaking, we can project ourselves into someone else and increase their powers.
But it only works if…… the person is of the opposite gender.
Akiha-sama is a woman so we could not Synchronize.
That's why she had to drink my blood to form a fake bond."

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　どくん、と体温が上昇する。
　今までのような心臓の猛りではなく、その……遠野志貴本人の感情の昂ぶりというか、そんな事で。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――”
My body heat surges with a single thud of my heart.
This is not the dangerous pounding from before but, well, Shiki Tohno himself getting worked up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
Thump.
My body heat rises.
It isn't the wildness of my heart earlier…… it is the true feelings of Tohno Shiki coming to light.

entries.japanese:
「……で、でも、そんなのは、なんか―――」
「志貴さんは秋葉さまの願いには応えられないのでしょう？
　なら、あとはこの方法しかありません。
　どうぞ、わたしの体を抱いてください。
体液の交換をしてしまえば、わたしは志貴さんの身体をお助けする事ができます。
　そうすれば秋葉さまからの助けがなくても、志貴さんは人並みの体に戻れるんですよ」
「うっ…………」
entries.maoEnglish:
“B-but that feels wrong somehow―――”
“You cannot grant Miss Akiha’s wish, can you? Then this is the only way left.
Please take my body. Once we exchange bodily fluids, I can sustain you.
Then you, Master Shiki, will regain an ordinary, healthy body without any help from Miss Akiha.”
“Ugh…”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… B… but, that, is---"
"You're unable to return her feelings, right?
So there's no other way.
Please, have me.
If we exchange our bodily fluids then I'll be able to help your condition.
If you do so, you can return to normal without Akiha-sama's help."
"Uu…………"

entries.japanese:
……それは、きっと願ってもない事だ。
　秋葉に負担をかけないようになれば、秋葉だって血を吸う事がなくなる。
　それに俺だって、本音を言えば、琥珀さんを自分のものに、したいんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
It is everything I could have asked for.
If Akiha no longer has to sustain me, she will have no need to drink blood.
And if I am honest with myself, I want Kohaku to be mine.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I really can't ask for anything more.
If I won't be a burden to Akiha, she won't have to drink any more blood.
And really, I want Kohaku-san too.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　でもそれは。
　何か、やっぱり違う気がする。

　わたしは自分というものがない人形でしたから、見せかけだけの洋服を着れば、どんな人にだってなりきれました。
　……でも、どんなに違う人になりきれても、それは芝居でしかなかったんです。
　笑う事も泣く事もできました。
けど、それが本当に楽しいのか、本当に悲しいのかは解らないままだったんです」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that solved nothing. So――I found a purpose of my own and began playing whatever role would help me fulfill it.
“I was a doll without a self, but by putting on the right costume, I could become anyone at all.
“But however completely I became someone else, it was still only an act.
“I learned to laugh and cry. What I never learned was whether I was truly happy or truly sad.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, even though I did that, it didn't solve anything.
So--I searched for a purpose and started to act to fulfill my purpose.
I was a doll without any identity, so I if I wore the right clothes, I could become anyone.
…… But, even if I became someone else, it was just an act.
I could laugh or cry.
But I could not understand if I was really happy or really sad."

entries.japanese:
「……おかしいですよね。
自分を守るために自分を捨てて人形になったのに。
　そうすればするほど、わたしは以前より壊れていくんです。
　芝居がうまくなって、嘘も上手になって、笑顔で人を欺けるようになって。
そうして目的を果たそうとすればするほど、自分が守ろうとした自分がなくなっていってしまった。
　嬉しいってなんだろう。
　悲しいってどんな事だったろう。
　……痛いって、どんな意味だったろうって、思い出す事さえできなくなっていました」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s strange, isn’t it? I threw myself away and became a doll to protect myself.
“And the longer I lived that way, the more broken I became.
“I perfected my acting, learned to lie, and became able to deceive people with a smile. The harder I worked toward my purpose, the more thoroughly I erased the very self I had meant to protect.
“What had happiness been?
“What did sorrow feel like?
“By then, I could no longer even remember what pain meant.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Isn't it funny?
In order to protect myself I cast away my identity and became just a doll.
But the more of that I do, the more broken I become.
I became good at acting, an expert at lying, and could deceive anyone with my smile.
But as I try to fulfill my purpose like that, I keep losing my self that I wanted to protect.
Just what is happiness?
What is this thing called sadness?
…… I became unable to even remember the meaning of pain itself."

entries.japanese:
「それでも、ある事を思い出すと心がザワザワとしたんですよ。
　八年前に消えてしまった、あの男の子の事を思い出すと、よく解らない感情があったんです。
　ずっと庭で遊んでいて、わたしの事を知りもしないくせに下りて来いって誘っていた子です。
　わたし、彼の事が好きでも嫌いでもなかった。
ただ、怖かっただけです。
　……せっかく人形になって痛いことが我慢できるようになったのに、その子を見ていると、そんなのはただの思いこみなんだって、気づいてしまいそうで」
entries.maoEnglish:
“And yet one memory could still make something stir inside me.
“When I remembered the boy who disappeared eight years ago, I felt something I couldn’t name.
“He was always playing in the garden; he knew nothing about me, yet kept calling for me to come down and join him.
“I neither liked nor disliked him. I was only afraid of him.
“I had finally become a doll and learned to endure pain, yet watching him threatened to make me realize that was only a belief I had forced upon myself.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But when I would remember one thing, my heart would become agitated.
When I would remember that boy who disappeared eight years ago, I would get this feeling I could not understand.
That boy who was always playing in the garden who knew nothing about me yet invited me with his eyes.
I didn't like him or hate him, I was just scared.
…… After trying so hard and becoming a doll that could endure the pain, I felt like I would realize it was all an illusion when I watched that boy."

entries.japanese:
「……その子が庭で命を落とした時、わたしは窓からずっと見ていました。
　男の子は、血の繋がっていない女の子を守って死んでしまったんです。
　わたしは、それから目が離せなかった。
窓に映った自分の顔は、とても怖い顔をしていました。
　……わたし、その時に初めて人を憎んだんですよ。
　だって、本当に悔しかった。
　他の誰でもない、その男の子が憎くて憎くて、涙をこぼしたぐらいです。
entries.maoEnglish:
“When that boy lost his life in the garden, I watched it all from the window.
“He died protecting a girl who wasn’t even related to him.
“I couldn’t look away. The face reflected in the glass was terrifying.
“That was the first time I ever hated anyone.
“I was so bitter.
“I hated that boy—him, and no one else—so bitterly that I wept.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… When that boy lost his life in the garden, I was watching by the window.
He died saving a girl that was not even related to him by blood.
I couldn't pull my eyes from that scene.
The reflection of my face in the mirror was terrifying.
…… That was the first time I ever hated anyone.
Because I really was frustrated.
I hated him and only him.
I hated him to the point of tears.

entries.japanese:
「……槙久さまは憎くはありません。
あの人に対する感情はまったくなかった。
……あの男の子を殺してしまったシキ様も、男の子に庇われて助かった秋葉さまも、別にどうでもよかったんです」
entries.maoEnglish: “I do not hate Master Makihisa. I never felt anything at all toward him. Master SHIKI, who killed the boy, and Miss Akiha, whom the boy saved, meant nothing to me either.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't hate Makihisa-sama.
I really didn't feel anything at all towards him.
…… Towards SHIKI-sama who killed that boy, or Akiha-sama who was saved by that boy, I didn't feel anything at all."

entries.japanese:
「―――きっと、八つ当たりだったんです。
　だって、どうしてあの男の子がそんな事をしたのかが、私にはぜんぜんわからなかったから。
　血だらけになって庭に棄てられたような男の子の亡骸を、わたしはずっと見つめていました。
　……あの子は自分の事より誰かの事が大切だっていうのかな。
だからあんなふうに、秋葉さまを助けてあげられたんだ。
　けど……ならどうして、それだけの事ができるのに、あの子はわたしをタスケテくれないんだろう。
　どうして――――わたしのまわりの人は、あの子みたいに優しくはなかったんだろうって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I suppose I was only lashing out.
“I couldn’t understand why that boy had done such a thing.
“I stared and stared at his blood-soaked body, discarded in the garden like rubbish.
“Had someone else truly mattered more to him than his own life? Was that why he could save Miss Akiha?
“But then, if he could do something so wonderful, why hadn’t he saved me?
“Why――――were none of the people around me as kind as he was?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I guess I was just taking it out on someone.
Because I couldn't understand why he did that.
I just kept watching his discarded, bloody body.
…… Did he value someone more precious than his own life?
Otherwise he would never have protected Akiha-sama like that.
But…… if he could do that, why didn't he ever help me?
Why----why were the people around me not as kind as he was?"

entries.japanese:
「……それがどんな感情なのかは解りません。
　けど、無感動なわたしの日々の中で、あの男の子だけが輝いていたんです」
　そうして。
ゆっくりと、彼女は体を起こした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I still don’t know what that feeling was.
“But in all those dead, unfeeling days, that boy was the only thing that shone.”
And then. Slowly, she sits up.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't know what that feeling was.
But in my emotionless days, only that boy was shining."
Slowly, Kohaku lifts herself up.

entries.japanese:
「けれど、それだけなんですよ。
　わたしにはこの感情がどんなものか解りません。
　今はとても幸せだけど、もしかしたらそれだってただのお芝居なのかもしれないでしょ？
　ね、いいんですか志貴さん。
　こんな、志貴さんがわたしを愛してくれているように志貴さんを愛せているのか解らないわたしなんかを信用してしまって」
entries.maoEnglish:
“But that is all I know.
“I still can’t tell you what this feeling is.
“I’m very happy now—but perhaps even that is only another performance.
“Are you sure about this, Master Shiki?
“Can you truly trust me, when I don’t even know whether I love you as you love me?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, that's it.
I don't understand this feeling right now.
I am very happy right now, but that just might be another charade, right?
Hey, is it alright, Shiki-san?
Believing in me, someone who doesn't know if she loves you like you do me."

entries.japanese:
「言ったでしょう？
　わたし、自分がどんな人間なのかもわからないんです。
わたしは人形だから、望めばどんな琥珀にもなれちゃいます。
　だから志貴さんが好きだといってくれた琥珀は、わたしじゃなくて、ただの――――」
　芝居をしていた方の琥珀なのかもしれない、と。
　満ち足りた笑顔のまま、震える声で、彼女はそう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I told you, didn’t I? I don’t even know what kind of person I am. I’m a doll, so if I wish, I can become any Kohaku at all.
“So the Kohaku you said you loved may not have been me, but nothing more than――――”
The Kohaku who had been acting.
Her smile is one of perfect contentment, but her voice trembles as she speaks.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Didn't I say it before?
I don't even know what kind of person I am.
Since I'm just a doll, I can become any Kohaku that I wish.
So, this Kohaku that you say you love, it isn't me, it's just----"
It just might be another pretend Kohaku.
She speaks with a satisfied smile and a wavering voice.

entries.japanese:
――――けど。
　　　　そんなコトは、絶対にない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――But no.
That can never be true.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----But.
That can never be true.

entries.japanese:
「……違うよ。
芝居とか作り物とか、そんな事は関係ない。
琥珀さんは琥珀さんだ。
　……誰かに優しくできない人はね、どう芝居をしても優しくはなれないんだ。
だから振る舞いがどんなに変わっても、琥珀さんの中身はおんなじだったんだよ」
　……そう。
　たとえ芝居でも、琥珀さんはあんなにも楽しそうだった。
　ならそれは、その役割を楽しんでいるという事。
　琥珀さん自身がそうなりたいって思っていた、本当に、望めばすぐに叶う夢だったんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re wrong. Acting, pretending—none of that matters. You’re still you, Kohaku.
“Someone incapable of kindness can’t become kind simply by putting on an act. However much your behavior changed, the person underneath it was always the same.”
Yes.
Even if it had been an act, Kohaku had seemed so happy playing that part.
Which meant she had taken joy in it. It was who she herself had wished to become—a dream so close that wanting it was enough to make it real.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's not true.
Acting, faking, that doesn't have anything to do with it.
You are you.
…… A truly mean-hearted person can't pretend to be truly kind.
No matter how you act, you are still the same inside, Kohaku-san."
…… That's right.
Even if it is just an act, Kohaku-san seems like she is having so much fun.
That means she is enjoying that role.
It was her dream that could become real if she really wished for it.

entries.japanese:
「……ああ。
もし今までの琥珀さんが全部嘘でも、俺は新しい琥珀さんだって好きになれる。
きっとだ」
「――――――――――」
　琥珀さんは何も言わず、ただ嬉しそうに頷いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. Even if every Kohaku I’ve known until now was a lie, I could fall in love with the next one too. I know I could.”
“――――――――――”
Without a word, Kohaku nods happily.
