entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, even if everything was just a lie.
I would still like the another, new Kohaku-san.
Definitely."
"----------"
Kohaku-san nods happily.

entries.japanese:
「そうですね。
志貴さんなら、そう言ってくれると思ってました」
　近づいてくる唇。
「え―――――」
　不意打ちぎみに、琥珀さんが唇を重ねてきた。
　琥珀さんの舌が入ってくる。
　カリッ、と何か硬いものの感触がしたあと。
「う――――ごっくん」
　と、喉が何かを嚥下してしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Yes. I thought you would say that, Master Shiki.”
Her lips draw near.
“Wha―――――”
Before I can react, Kohaku presses them to mine.
Her tongue slips into my mouth.
Something hard clicks against my teeth, and then…
“Mm――――gulp.”
Something goes down my throat before I can stop it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"That's true.
I thought you'd say that."
Her lips draw close.
"Eh-----"
She launches a surprise attack and kisses me.
Her tongue slides into my mouth.
I feel something hard.
"Uu----mph."
Something descends down my throat.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ―――琥珀さん、今なんか口移しで飲ませたでしょ――――」
　…………あれ。
　なんか、すごく……気持ちがいい。
　ずっと体が痛かった事もあって、なんだかこのまま眠ってしまい、そうな―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wait―――Kohaku, you just fed me something mouth-to-mouth, didn’t you――――”
Huh.
I feel incredibly good.
After hurting for so long, I feel as though I could drift straight to sleep―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"H, hey---Kohaku-san, what did you make me swallow-----?"
………… Huh?
Something, feels…… so good.
The ever-present pain in my body fades and drowsiness floods over me---

entries.japanese:
「ねえ志貴さん。
最後に聞かせてください。
あなたは、どの『琥珀』が好きだったのか」
　すぐ近くなのに、とても遠く、声が聞こえた。
「ん―――――」
　気が遠くなる。
　それでも、ちゃんと……琥珀さんの言葉に、答えないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Let me ask you one last thing. Which ‘Kohaku’ did you love?”
Her voice sounds impossibly far away, though she is right beside me.
“Mm―――――”
Consciousness slips from me.
Still, I have to give Kohaku a proper answer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Shiki-san.
I just have one last question for you.
Which 'Kohaku' do you like the best?"
Her close, yet so distant voice.
"Mm-----"
I feel faint.
Even still…… I have to answer her.

entries.japanese:
「……そんなの、わからない。
……けど、俺は今の琥珀さんが好きだよ」
　夢うつつで、ぼんやりと口にする。
　彼女は呆然と俺を見たあと。
「はい。
わたしも、この琥珀が一番好きでした」
　そう、これ以上ないっていうぐらいの笑顔を残して、静かに立ちあがった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. But I love the Kohaku who’s here now.”
The words leave me through a haze of sleep.
She stares at me in stunned silence before answering.
“Yes. This was my favorite Kohaku too.”
Leaving behind the most radiant smile I have ever seen, she quietly rises.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I don't, know.
…… But, I like this Kohaku."
I speak as if in a dream.
She looks at me in total surprise.
"Yes.
I liked this Kohaku the best, too."
With an unmatchable smile, she quietly stands up.

entries.japanese:
しゅる、という着物を着る音。
　ベッドから出て服を着ているらしい。
「それじゃ志貴さん。
自分でしでかした事の責任をとってきますね」
　彼女は笑顔で―――今までのものとは違う、本当の笑顔でそう告げて、この部屋から出ていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
Silk whispers through the room.
She must be out of bed, getting dressed.
“Well then, Master Shiki. I’m going to take responsibility for what I set in motion.”
With a smile―――a true smile unlike any she has worn before, she says this and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The sound of a kimono being changed into.
She must be out of bed and putting it on.
"Well then, Shiki-san.
I have to take responsibility for what I have done."
With a smile---one completely different than up until now, her true smile, she leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「―――何しようって、いうんだ、琥珀――――」
　意識が、途切れ途切れになっている。
　……なんて、コト。
　せっかく体が治ったっていうのに、今度は意識のほうが、段々と薄く、なって――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――What are you going to do, Kohaku――――”
Consciousness comes and goes in ragged fragments.
Damn it.
My body has finally recovered, and now my mind is fading instead, growing thinner and dimmer――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---What are, you doing, Kohaku----"
My consciousness flickers off and on.
…… What's, going on?
My body has finally healed, but this time my mind, is, fading----

entries.japanese:
「なんてコト、じゃねえ…………！」
　眠りかけた意識を起こす。
―――琥珀。
　彼女は、最後になんて言った！？
“自分のしでかした事の責任をとってきます”
「……ふざけてる……！
　なんで、こう――」
　自分一人だけでなんとかしようとするんだ、あの人は……！
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is no time to be cursing myself!”
I wrench my sinking mind awake.
―――Kohaku.
What did she say before leaving?
I’m going to take responsibility for what I set in motion
“You’ve got to be kidding…! Why does she always――”
Why does that woman insist on handling everything alone?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What am I doing………!?"
I rouse myself awake.
---Kohaku.
What did she say to me when she left!?
--I have to take responsibility for what I have done--
"…… You've got to be kidding me……!
Why did she--"
Why does she try to do everything herself……!?

entries.japanese:
もう隠す事も、芝居をする必要もない。
　俺は琥珀さんの為だったらなんでもするのに、どうして―――また一人で行こうとするんだ。
　俺を眠らせて、それで―――俺の身を案じたつもりでいるっていうのかっ……………！？
「いいかげん―――あたまに、きた、ぞ―――」
　ベッドから起きあがる。
　……机までが、とても遠い。
「……くそ……なんて薬、飲ませる、んだ……一度、琥珀さんの、部屋―――」
　部屋を徹底的に掃除して、こういったクスリは全部没収しないとダメ、かな―――
entries.maoEnglish:
She has nothing left to hide and no role left to play.
I would do anything for Kohaku, so why―――is she trying to go alone again?
She has drugged me to sleep, and with that―――she thinks she has protected me!?
“Enough―――I am absolutely furious―――”
I force myself out of bed.
The desk seems miles away.
“Damn it, what drug did she give me; when this is over, Kohaku’s room―――”
I will scour it from top to bottom and confiscate every drug like this―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
There isn't any need to continue acting or hide anything.
I would do anything for her, so why---why is she still trying to go alone?
Forcing me to sleep---was she just worrying about me……………!?
"It's really---beginning to piss me off---"
I get up from bed.
…… The desk is so far away.
"…… Damn it…… what kind of drug, did she, give me?
…… I have to go, to her room once and---"
I have to clean out her room and take all her medicine away---

entries.japanese:
「はっ…………あ、あ――――」
　なんとか歩いて、机に倒れこむ。
　机の上にはナイフがある。
　さっき引き出しから出して、そのあとにここに置いた、もの――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah, ah――――”
I somehow stagger to the desk and collapse against it.
My knife lies on top.
I took it from the drawer earlier and left it there afterward――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Aah……… ah, ah----"
I somehow walk and collapse onto the desk.
On top is my knife.
I must have put it there after taking it out of the drawer----

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　いけない。
また、眠ってしまった。
　……なんなんだ、この凶悪な眠気は。
　どうがんばったって意志の力でどうにかなるもんじゃないぞ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“……”
No. I have fallen asleep again.
What is this monstrous drowsiness?
No amount of willpower can overcome it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
Crap.
I fell asleep again.
…… What is this strong drowsiness?
No matter how hard I try to fight it, it won't help.

entries.japanese:
「…………くそ…………琥珀さん、あとで倍返しにしてやる、からな――――」
　ナイフを手に取る。
　パチン、と刃が飛び出してくる。
　それを―――
　あぁ、すっごく痛いんだろうなあ。
―――なんて思いながら、中指の、爪の隙間に刺し入れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it, Kohaku, I’ll pay you back twice over for this――――”
I pick up the knife.
The blade springs out with a snap.
And then―――
God, this is going to hurt.
―――With that thought, I drive the point beneath the nail of my middle finger.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Damn it……… Kohaku-san, I'll pay you back for this----"
I grab the knife.
Kachink!
It flies open.
I take it and---
Man, this is gonna be extremely painful.
---Thinking that, I slice into the nail of my middle finger.

entries.japanese:
「ぎっ――――――――――――！」
　その、鋭角的で金属的な痛みが直接脳髄に叩きこまれる。
「はっ―――この、ざまあみやがれってんだ」
　爪からナイフの先端を引きぬく。
　ずきん、と中指が痛むたびに眠気は撤退していく。
　適当なハンカチで中指を巻いて、出血を止めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――――――――――!”
The sharp, metallic pain punches straight into my brain.
“Hah―――take that, you bastard.”
I pull the knife from beneath my nail.
Each throb in my middle finger drives the drowsiness farther back.
I wrap the finger in a handy handkerchief and staunch the blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gggah---------------!"
The acute, slicing pain drives straight into my brain.
"Ha---take that!"
I pull the knife back out from my nail.
Every time my finger feels pain, the sleepiness goes away.
Wrapping my finger with a handkerchief, I stop the bleeding.

entries.japanese:
「っ…………まあ、これぐらいなら」
　ナイフを握るのに支障はない。
……そもそも俺はナイフを持っているだけでいいんだ。
モノを断ち切るための腕力なんて、遠野志貴には必要ない。
「くそ、早まった真似はするんじゃないぞ、琥珀――！」
　ナイフをポケットに仕舞って部屋から飛び出す。
　琥珀さんを秋葉に会わせるわけにはいかない。
　なんとしてもその前に止めないと、きっと取り返しのつかない事になってしまう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Well, this much is nothing.”
It won’t stop me from holding the knife. In any case, holding it is all I need to do. Shiki Tohno requires no strength to sever things.
“Damn it, don’t do anything rash, Kohaku――!”
I pocket the knife and tear out of the room.
I cannot let Kohaku meet Akiha.
If I fail to stop her first, something irreparable is bound to happen―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………… Well, if it's like this."
It won't stop me from gripping my knife.
…… All I really need to do is hold it, anyway.
I don't even need the physical strength required to cleave through things.
"Damn it, don't do anything foolish, Kohaku--!"
I jam the knife in my pocket and fly out of the room.
I can't let Kohaku-san and Akiha face each other.
If I can't prevent that, then something that can never be taken back will happen---

entries.japanese:
扉を開ける。
「琥珀さん…………！」
　……部屋には人気というものがなかった。
　琥珀さんの姿もなければ秋葉の姿もない。
「――――――隣か！？」
　寝室の様子を見たが、そこにも二人の姿はなかった。
「そんな――――二人とも、何処に」
　時計に視線を走らせる。
　時刻は―――午前零時をすぎて、もう翌日に切り替わっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I throw open the door.
“Kohaku…!”
The room is utterly deserted.
Neither Kohaku nor Akiha is there.
“――――――Next door!?”
I check the bedroom, but find no trace of them there either.
“No――――where are they both?”
My eyes fly to the clock.
It is―――past midnight; the date has already changed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I burst through the door.
"Kohaku-san…………!"
…… There isn't anyone in the room.
Neither Kohaku-san nor Akiha.
"------Are they next door!?"
I run to the bedroom, but they aren't there, either.
"Where----where did they go?"
I run my gaze to the clock.
It says---past midnight.
It's already tomorrow.

entries.japanese:
「―――――うそ」
　いつのまにそんな時間になっていたのか。
　確かに琥珀さんと体を重ねたあたりから時間の感覚が麻痺していたが、それでもまだ夜になったばかりだと思っていたのに。
「この時間なら、秋葉はもう――――」
　夜の街に、人の血を吸いに行ってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――No way.”
When did it get so late?
I have lost all sense of time since Kohaku and I slept together, but I had still thought the night had only just begun.
“At this hour, Akiha must already be――――”
Out in the sleeping city, drinking human blood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----No way."
When did that happen?
I knew that I lost track of time when I was making love to Kohaku-san, but I didn't think it was this late already.
"By this time, Akiha has----"
Gone out on the streets to drink blood.

entries.japanese:
屋敷の外に出る。
　余分な事をしている時間はない。
　琥珀さんは秋葉を止めに行った。
　だが秋葉が琥珀さんの言う事を聞くとは思えない。
　……今の秋葉は普通じゃない。
最悪、止めに来た琥珀さんを邪魔者として排除しかねないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I run out of the mansion.
There is no time to waste.
Kohaku has gone to stop Akiha.
But Akiha will never listen to her now.
She is no longer herself. At worst, she might decide that Kohaku is merely an obstacle and dispose of her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I leave the mansion.
There is no time to waste.
Kohaku-san left to stop Akiha.
But I don't think Akiha will listen to anything Kohaku-san has to say.
…… Akiha isn't normal right now.
If worst comes to worst, she'll see Kohaku-san as an obstacle that needs to be removed.

entries.japanese:
「まさか――――学校、か……？」
　シキが秋葉に殺された後、一度だけ人の血を吸う夢を見た。
　どんな原理でそんな事になったかは解らないが、アレが秋葉の見ていた現実なら、秋葉はシキと同じように夜の学校を『食事の場所』にしていたという事になる。
　なら―――この時間、血を吸う鬼となっている秋葉がいる場所は、学校以外ありえない―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Could she be――――at the school?”
After Akiha killed SHIKI, I once dreamed that I was drinking human blood.
I don’t know how such a thing was possible, but if what I saw was Akiha’s reality, then she, like SHIKI, made the school her feeding ground after dark.
Then―――at this hour, the only place Akiha, now a blood-drinking demon, could be is the school―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It can't be----the school……?"
That dream of drinking someone's blood I once had after SHIKI was killed by Akiha.
I don't know how it happened, but if that was what Akiha was watching, that means Akiha has made the school grounds her feeding place, just like SHIKI.
Then---at this time, Akiha, who's a blood sucking demon, won't be anywhere else but there---

entries.japanese:
―――そうして、この場所に帰ってきた。
　静かだった。
　月光を浴びて佇む巨大な建物は、数百人の生徒を収容する場とは思えない。
―――永く。
　遠い昔に棄てられ、誰の記憶からも忘却され、地図からさえ消去されたような、呪われた墓標に見える。
「―――――――」
　こめかみには軽い頭痛。
　それを堪えて、正門をくぐり抜けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And so I return to this place.
Silence.
The enormous building stands drenched in moonlight, impossible to imagine as a place meant to hold hundreds of students.
―――It seems ancient beyond reckoning.
A cursed grave marker abandoned ages ago, erased from every memory and even from the map.
“―――――――”
A dull ache pulses at my temples.
Enduring it, I pass through the front gate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---And I return to the place.
It's quiet.
The giant building bathed in moonlight does not look like a building that holds hundreds of students.
---For a long time.
It looks just like a monolithic tombstone abandoned long ago, forgotten by memory, forgotten by time.
"-------"
My head starts to throb lightly.
I ignore it and go through the gates.

entries.japanese:
中に入った途端、頭痛が倍化した。
　視界が歪む。
心の臓が覚醒する。
指先が、戦いの予感に打ち震える。
「――――――いる」
　なんという穢れ。
　校舎には血の匂いしかしない。
　漂う大気は熱をおびて、チリチリと肌を焦がしている。
　風は亡く。
停滞した空気は腐敗し、変貌し、ここに魔となって赤色の檻をカタチ作る。
entries.maoEnglish:
The instant I step onto the grounds, the headache doubles.
My vision warps. My heart awakens. My fingertips tremble at the promise of battle.
“――――――She’s here.”
The place is unclean beyond belief.
Nothing remains in the school but the stench of blood.
The air itself is feverish, prickling against my skin like flame.
The wind is dead. The stagnant air has rotted and changed, becoming something monstrous—a crimson cage.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My headache multiplies in intensity the instant I step inside.
My whole world wavers.
My heart wakens.
My fingers shiver in anticipation of battle.
"------She's here."
How vile.
Only the smell of blood sticks to the air.
The air is full of heat and burns on my skin.
The wind is dead.
The stagnant air transforms into a red cage of decay.

entries.japanese:
両眼はメガネ越しにでも夥しい赤い髪を幻視していた。
　赤い髪は校舎はおろか校庭にまで侵食して、一千年を生きた蜘蛛の巣のように、エモノを逃がす隙間というものがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Even through my glasses, my eyes conjure a vision of countless red hairs.
They infest not only the school building but the entire grounds, a thousand-year-old spiderweb without a single gap through which its prey might escape.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I see countless red strands of hair when I look past my glasses.
The red hair permeates the school grounds and the building like the web of a thousand-year-old spider, not a hole anywhere to let its prey escape.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉―――おまえ」
　すでにここは異界だ。
　人が踏み入れていい世界ではない。
「ここまで、終わっているのか」
　頭痛は止まらない。
　ずきん、と爪を剥がした指先が痛む。
　どくん、と心臓は歓喜の嗚咽をあげている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha―――you…”
This place already belongs to another world.
No human being has any right to enter it.
“Has it gone this far?”
The headache will not stop.
The fingertip beneath whose nail I drove the knife throbs.
My heart sobs with joy at every beat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha---you---"
This place is already a different world.
It's not a world any human should enter.
"Have you gone that far?"
My headache does not go away.
The sharp pain of my cut fingernail.
My heart lifts up a rhythm of delighted sobs.

entries.japanese:
メガネを外して、ナイフを握った。
　……こうして『線』と向かい合うのは何年ぶりだろう。
　先生に貰ったこのメガネを自分から外す時が来ると、思った事なんてなかった。
　それが―――自分の妹と対峙するためだなんて、夢にも。
entries.maoEnglish:
I remove my glasses and grip the knife.
How many years has it been since I last faced the lines like this?
I never imagined the day would come when I would willingly remove the glasses my teacher gave me.
And that―――to confront my own sister, of all things.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I take off my glasses and grip my knife.
…… How long has it been since I faced these "lines"?
I never thought I would take off the glasses I received from Sensei of my own free will.
I didn't think even in my dream that I'd be using them to face my little sister.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　嘆いている暇はない。
　準備は整った。
　あとは。
この、赤い檻髪を切り裂くだけだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
There is no time for grief.
I am ready.
Now there is only one thing left. To slash through this red Hair Cage.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
I don't have time to complain.
Everything is set.
All that's left is for me to cut through this Red Lock of Hair.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――Burning.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Burning.

entries.japanese: 中に入ると、気温はさらに上昇した。
entries.maoEnglish: Inside the building, the temperature rises higher still.
entries.mirrorMoon: Entering inside, the temperature is even hotter.

entries.maoEnglish: ―――――Burning.
entries.mirrorMoon: -----Burning.

entries.japanese:
この熱さは知っている。
　夢で見た。
見知らぬ少女を襲った吸血鬼は、校舎に入って、その後――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I know this heat.
I saw it in a dream. The vampire who attacked the unknown girl entered the school, and then――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I know what this heat is.
I saw it in the dream.
The vampire that attacked a young woman entered the school grounds, and then----

entries.maoEnglish: ――――――――Burning.
entries.mirrorMoon: --------Burning.

entries.japanese:
ずるずると少女の体をひきずって、その場所に入っていった。
　かつてシキという殺人鬼が使っていた密室。
　銀の月が蛇の如く咎人を見つめる、
entries.maoEnglish:
Dragging the girl’s body behind him, he entered that place.
The sealed room once used by a murderer named SHIKI.
Beneath the silver moon, watching the sinner like a serpent,
entries.mirrorMoon:
Dragging that body, went into that place.
That room that the killer SHIKI was once using.
The silver moon looks down like a snake at the accused.

entries.japanese: この、教室に。
entries.maoEnglish: This classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon: In this classroom.

entries.japanese:
「……………秋葉」
　足を踏み入れた瞬間、眩暈がした。
　机と机の間には少女の体が倒れている。
　一人、二人………三人。
　見知らぬ彼女たちは全員気を失っている。
　首筋には赤い跡。
　その中で、赤い髪の“妖”が笑っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
The moment I enter, vertigo strikes.
Girls lie crumpled between the desks.
One, two, three.
Every one of the strangers is unconscious.
Red marks stain their throats.
And among them, the red-haired fiend is smiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… Akiha."
Nausea fills me as soon as I enter.
In between the desks lie the collapsed bodies of girls.
One, two……… three.
All of them have completely lost consciousness.
On their necks are trails of blood.
In the middle of it all, that red haired "monster" is laughing.

entries.japanese:
「あら、どうしたの兄さん。
明日が待てなくなって、もう来てしまったんですか？」
　悪びれた様子もなく、秋葉は俺を迎えた
―――ドクン。
　その姿を見ていると、ある衝動に突き動かされそうになる。
　それを全力で、誰と争うよりも必死になって押し殺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why, Brother. Couldn’t you wait until tomorrow before coming?”
Akiha welcomes me without the slightest shame
―――THUMP.
The sight of her threatens to unleash a certain impulse inside me.
I smother it with everything I have, more desperately than I have ever fought any enemy.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh, Nii-san.
You couldn't wait until tomorrow?"
She greets me without a trace of malevolence.
---Thump.
That impulse assails me as soon as I see her.
I desperately suppress the urge with all my strength.

entries.japanese:
「―――――」
　秋葉は窓際で月光を浴びている。
―――どくん。
　俺は教室に入った所から、一歩も前には踏み出していない。
　……まずい、と本能とは別のモノが警告をしている。
　アレは、予想以上だ。
　シキを処理した時の秋葉とは比べ物にならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
Akiha stands at the window, bathed in moonlight.
―――Thump.
Since entering the classroom, I have not taken a single step forward.
Something apart from instinct is warning me: this is bad.
She is more than I anticipated.
There is no comparison between this Akiha and the one who disposed of SHIKI.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
The moonlight streaming through the window illuminates her.
---Thump.
I haven't moved a step since I entered the room.
…… My instincts scream at me that this is bad.
That thing is something beyond what I expected.
The Akiha that exterminated SHIKI pales in comparison to this.

entries.japanese:
「驚いたな。
兄さんは動ける体じゃなかったのに、それでも無理を押して私に会いに来てくれたんですね。
　……良かった。
兄さんもやっと、私の気持ちが解ってくれたんだわ」
　嬉しそうに秋葉は言う。
――――ドク、ン。
　深い所にある理性が言う。
　遠野志貴はアレには勝てない、と。
　故にアレを怒らせてはいけない。
アレを敵に回してはならない。
そうなれば、間違いなく消え去るのは自分のほうだ、と。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m impressed. You could barely move, yet you forced that body all the way here to see me.
“How wonderful. At last, Brother, you understand how I feel.”
Akiha speaks with open delight.
――――THUM—P.
Reason whispers from somewhere deep within me.
Shiki Tohno cannot defeat that thing.
Do not anger it. Do not make an enemy of it. If you do, you will be the one erased without a trace.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I'm surprised.
You aren't supposed to be able to walk, yet you forced yourself to come see me.
…… I'm happy.
I guess you finally understand my feelings."
Her voice is full of happiness.
----Thu, mp.
My reason cries out.
Tohno Shiki cannot win against that thing.
So you can't make it angry.
Don't let it be your enemy.
If you do that, you will surely be annihilated.

entries.japanese:
――――どく、ん。
　それでも―――今更、逃げ出すわけにはいかなかった。
「―――秋葉。
琥珀さんは、どうした」
　空気が凝縮するような威圧感。
　秋葉は不愉快そうに、歯を鳴らした。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――thum—p.
Even so―――it is far too late to run.
“―――Akiha. Where is Kohaku?”
Her presence seems to compress the air itself.
Akiha clicks her teeth in displeasure.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thum, p.
Even still---I can't run away now.
"---Akiha, where is Kohaku-san?"
The air itself stiffens from her overpowering presence.
She grinds her teeth in displeasure.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀ならそこよ。
何を思ったのか私に手をあげてきたから、少しだけ罰を与えている所です」
　秋葉は俺の横……廊下に面した壁を流し見る。
「――――？」
　視線を横に動かす。
　そこには―――壁に磔にされた、琥珀さんの姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku is right there. For some incomprehensible reason she raised a hand against me, so I’m giving her a little punishment.”
Akiha glances toward the corridor wall beside me.
“――――――?”
I follow her gaze.
There―――Kohaku is pinned to the wall as if crucified.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"She's over there.
I don't know what she was thinking, but she's now receiving her punishment for raising a hand against me."
She looks to the wall beside me.
"----?"
I follow her gaze.
On the wall---is the crucified form of Kohaku-san.

entries.japanese:
「なっ―――――」
　琥珀さんの体は宙に浮いていた。
　いや、傍目に見ればそうとしかとれないだろう。
　だが――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What―――――”
Kohaku’s body hangs suspended in the air.
At least, that is how it would appear to any ordinary observer.
But――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
Her body is floating in mid-air.
No, it would look like that for someone else.
But----

entries.japanese:
――――ドク、ン。
　俺の眼には、彼女を縛っているモノが視えた。
　琥珀さんの体は赤い髪の毛のようなモノで壁に磔にされているだけだ。
　髪はぎしぎしと音をたてて、琥珀さんの手足を締めつけている。
　……意識を失っているのか。
琥珀さんはぐったりと首をさげていて、本当に―――蜘蛛の糸に囚われた、哀れな揚羽に見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――THUM—P.
My eyes can see what binds her.
Things like strands of red hair have merely pinned Kohaku’s body to the wall.
The hair creaks as it tightens around her arms and legs.
Is she unconscious? Her head hangs limp, making her look truly―――like a pitiful swallowtail caught in a spider’s web.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thu, mp.
My eyes can see what is tying her.
Her body is pinned against the wall by something like red hair.
The hair creakingly tightens around her arms and legs.
…… Has she passed out?
Her head is hanging down---she really looks like a butterfly caught in a spider's web.

entries.japanese:
「不思議でしょう？
　琥珀ったら一人で壁に張り付いているなんて、すごい特技だと思わない？」
　くすくすと秋葉は笑っている。
「けど安心して兄さん。
私、一回噛みつかれたぐらいじゃ飼い猫は殺さないわ。
琥珀にはちょっとした罰を与えるだけで、すぐに許してあげますから」
「な―――――――」
――――どく、ん。
　目の前が霞む。
　苦しげに頭をたれた琥珀の姿と、赤い秋葉の姿が重なって、理性が溶けかけてしまっている―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Remarkable, isn’t it? Don’t you think Kohaku has quite a talent for sticking to walls all by herself?”
Akiha giggles.
“But don’t worry, Brother. I wouldn’t kill a pet cat over a single bite. I’ll punish Kohaku a little, then forgive her at once.”
“You―――――――”
――――thum—p.
My vision blurs.
Kohaku’s suffering, bowed figure overlaps with Akiha’s crimson form, and my reason begins to dissolve―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Don't you find it strange?
Suspending herself to the wall like that is quite a feat, don't you think?"
Akiha giggles.
"But don't worry Nii-san.
I don't kill cats that bite me once.
After she receives her punishment, I will forgive her."
"Wha------"
----Thum,p.
Everything goes hazy.
Kohaku's anguished figure and Akiha's red figure match up and all rational thought is disappearing---

entries.japanese:
「だけど気をつけてくださいね。
私、一度噛みついてきたペットには興味がないの。
きっと心の中で自分のモノでなくなってしまうんでしょうね。
　だから二度目なんかない。
私のモノでなくなってしまったモノなんかいらない。
　……ねえ兄さん？
　私、自分を裏切った相手にはいくらでも残酷になれるんですよ」
　ぎしり、と。
　琥珀さんの体を縛る赤い髪が、手足を引き千切らんばかりの勢いで締められる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But do be careful. Once a pet bites me, I lose all interest in it. Somewhere inside, I suppose it stops being mine.
“There is no second chance. I have no use for anything that is no longer mine.
“You understand, Brother? I can be as cruel as I please to anyone who betrays me.”
The hair creaks.
The red hair binding Kohaku draws tight enough to tear her limbs away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But let me warn you.
I don't care for pets that bite me.
I guess it doesn't belong to me anymore in my heart.
So there won't be a second time.
I have no need for those that aren't mine.
…… Hey, Nii-san.
I can be very cruel to those who betray me."
The sound of tightening reaches my ears.
The red hair binding Kohaku-san's arms and legs tightens even further, as if to rip her limbs off.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
おまえ――――！」
　壁にかけよる。
　琥珀さんを縛っている髪は、当然のように触れる事ができなかった。
　……これはあくまで秋葉の髪の延長、秋葉本人が思い描いているイメージにすぎない。
　秋葉は琥珀さんを視界にいれる事で、その意志の力で琥珀さんを壁に封じているだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. You――――!”
I rush to the wall.
As expected, my hands pass through the hair binding Kohaku.
It is only an extension of Akiha’s hair, an image that exists within Akiha’s mind.
By holding Kohaku in her sight, Akiha is pinning her to the wall through sheer force of will.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, you----!"
I run towards the wall.
The hair binding Kohaku-san cannot be touched.
…… This is just an extension of her hair, only what Akiha is imagining.
By putting Kohaku-san in her sight, Akiha is trapping Kohaku-san to the wall with her willpower.

entries.japanese:
――――ど、く、ん。
　……その力の流れが赤い髪のように視える。
　それは秋葉本人にも視る事のできないイメージ。
　不意に思った。
　俺の眼は、もとからこういった事のために用意されたモノだったのではないか。
　それが何度も何度も死に接した事によって『死』という概念を識ってしまっただけなんじゃないかと――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――th—um—p.
I can see that flow of power as red hair.
It is an image invisible even to Akiha herself.
A sudden thought comes to me.
Perhaps my eyes were originally made to see things like this.
Perhaps all my brushes with death have merely taught them the concept of death――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Th, um, p.
…… The flowing power looks like red hair.
That is something she can't even see.
I think suddenly.
Weren't my eyes designed specifically for this sort of thing from the beginning?
And by facing death so many times, haven't they discerned the very concept of death----

entries.japanese:
「くっ――――――！」
　うるさい、今はそんな事どうでもいい。
　視えているのなら、俺に『切断』できないモノはないんだ。
　こんな赤い髪なんかに、いつまでも琥珀さんをいいようにさせてたまるか……………！
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it――――――!”
Shut up; none of that matters now.
If I can see it, there is nothing I cannot sever.
I will not let this wretched red hair toy with Kohaku a moment longer.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Tch-----!"
Whatever, that doesn't matter right now.
If I can see it, then there isn't anything I can't cut.
I can't let this red hair do what it wants to Kohaku-san……………!

entries.japanese:
――――ナイフを振るう。
　心臓のリズムが速い為か。
　自分でも驚くぐらい、ナイフの扱いが卓絶していた。
　それは刃物を振るう、という感覚じゃなかった。
　大気を滑るナイフは、赤い髪ではなく大気そのものを刈り取るように繊細で迅速すぎた。
　気がつけば。
　俺は一息で、琥珀さんの体を縛る全ての髪を解体していた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――I sweep the knife through the air.
Perhaps my racing heart is responsible.
Even I am astonished by the mastery in my hand.
It does not feel like wielding a blade.
The knife glides with such impossible speed and delicacy that it seems to reap the air itself rather than the crimson hair.
Before I know it.
In a single breath, I have dismantled every strand binding Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----I swing my knife.
Maybe it's because my heart is beating so fast.
My knife swings out with a speed that surprises even me.

It doesn't feel like I'm cutting through something.
My knife glides through the red hair with speed and accuracy, as if I was merely reaping the air for harvest.
Before I realize it,
I have sliced through all the hair binding Kohaku-san in one breath.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんの体が落ちる。
「―――――――っ」
　受け止めて頬に触れた。
　体温は確かにある。
呼吸も弱々しいけど止まっていない。
……彼女の体に、忌々しい『線』は数えるほどしか視えていない。
「は――――――あ」
　安堵して琥珀さんを床に下ろす。
―――良かった。
本当に……琥珀さんの身に万が一なんて事がなくて、良かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Kohaku falls.
“―――――――”
I catch her and touch her cheek.
She is warm. Her breathing is weak, but it has not stopped. And only a handful of those hateful lines mar her body.
“Hah――――――”
Relief floods me as I lower her to the floor.
―――Thank God. Truly, thank God she is still alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her body falls.
"-------"
I catch her and touch her cheeks.
She's still warm.
Her breathing is weak but it isn't stopped.
…… I can only see a few "lines" on her body.
I let out a sigh of relief.
I place her down on the floor.
---Thank goodness.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん――――今、何を――――」
　……秋葉の声は震えていた。
　ナイフを片手に握ったまま振り返る。
「―――――――――」
　俺を見て、秋葉は息を呑んだ。
　信じられないものを見たように口元に手をあてて、じっと、俺の眼を見つめている。
「――――なんて、綺麗な――――蒼い、眼」
「……………？」
「どうして―――？
　兄さんには、そんな体力は残っていない筈なのに――――」
　呆然とそう呟いたあと。
「ま……さか」
　秋葉は、その唇をわなわなと震わせた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother――――what did you just――――”
Akiha’s voice trembles.
Still holding the knife, I turn to face her.
“―――――――――”
At the sight of me, Akiha gasps.
One hand rises to her mouth as though she has seen the impossible, and she stares into my eyes.
“――――What beautiful――――blue eyes”
“……?”
“How―――? Brother, you shouldn’t have any strength left――――”
After murmuring this in a daze.
“It can’t be”
Her lips begin to tremble.
entries.mirrorMoon:
If anything happened…… thank goodness she is safe.
"Nii-san----what, was that just now----"
…… Her voice is shaking.
I spin to face her, still gripping my knife in one hand.
"---------"
She looks at me and gasps.
Bringing her hand to her mouth in disbelief, she looks at my eyes.
"----What beautiful----blue, eyes."
"………… ?"
"How come---?
You shouldn't have any strength like that left----"
Amazement permeates her voice.
"Did…… you…"
Akiha trembles.

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、貴方――――琥珀と、契約を、したんですか」
　秋葉の声は震えている。
　それは憎悪というより、どこか悲哀に近い、声のように聞こえた。
「……………」
「……うそ。
それじゃあ兄さんは、私を―――」
　がくん、と秋葉の体がよろめく。
　秋葉は愕然とした瞳のまま窓によりかかる。
　その顔は蒼白で、今にも吐きそう―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, did you――――form a pact with Kohaku?”
Akiha’s voice shakes.
It sounds less like hatred than grief.
“……”
“No. Then that means you have―――abandoned me”
Akiha’s body buckles.
Eyes wide with shock, she sags against the window.
Her face has gone deathly pale, as if she might vomit at any moment―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, you----made a contract with Kohaku?"
Her voice quivers.
It isn't full of hatred, but more like sorrow.
"……………"
"…… This can't be.
Then that means you chose not me, but---"
She staggers.
She leans against the window with eyes full of stunned surprise.
Her face is pale and she looks like she will vomit---

entries.japanese:
「うっ………あ、え―――――ぐ」
―――いや、耐えきれずに吐き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ugh, ah, eh―――――gh”
―――No, she can no longer hold it back.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uu……… ah, eh------agh!"
---No, she does.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――っ、ぐ……………………！」
　秋葉は泣くように嘔吐をする。
　赤い髪を揺らして、秋葉は苦しげに顔を隠して、ただ吐いた。
口元までせりあがった悲鳴を吐き出すかのように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――gh…!”
Akiha vomits as though she were weeping.
Her crimson hair sways as she hides her face in anguish and retches. It is as though she is expelling the scream that has risen into her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----, ghuu……………………!"
She vomits as if crying.
Her red hair fluttering, she hides her anguished face as she continues vomiting.
It's almost as if she was letting out her screams.

entries.japanese:
「―――泥棒猫。
殺しておけば良かった」
　そう、倒れた琥珀さんを睨んだあと。
　秋葉は、心底おかしそうに笑った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You thieving little cat. I should have killed you.”
After glaring at the fallen Kohaku.
Akiha laughs as though she has never heard anything so funny.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Thief Cat!
I should have killed you."
"That's right," she says as she stares at Kohaku-san's collapsed figure.
She then laughs strangely from the bottom of her heart.

entries.japanese:
「そう。
そういうつもりなんだ、兄さん。
　兄さんは私を裏切ったくせに、さらに追い討ちをかけにきたってワケなんだ。
　……すごいなあ。
私を一度裏切っただけじゃ飽き足らず、わざわざ琥珀の助けまで借りて遠野秋葉を殺しにくるなんて、徹底してるわ」
　秋葉の笑い声が教室に満ちていく。
　それに応じて温度が上がっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. So that is your intention, Brother.
“You betrayed me, and now you’ve come to drive the knife in deeper.
“How thorough of you. Betraying me once wasn’t enough, so you even borrowed Kohaku’s help and came all this way to kill Akiha Tohno.”
Her laughter fills the classroom.
The temperature rises with it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is this what you plan on doing, Nii-san?
You come here to betray me and then come after me?
…… Incredible.
You weren't satisfied with betraying me once, but you ask for help from Kohaku and came to kill me again.
How thorough you are."
Her laughing voice fills the room.
The temperature of the room rises with it.

entries.japanese:
――――ド、ク、ン。
　心臓が猛る反面、理性が警告をかき鳴らす。
　コロセ、という命令さえ、ニゲロ、という命令にかき消される。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――TH—UM—P.
My heart roars for blood while reason shrieks its warning.
Even the command to KILL is drowned beneath the command to RUN.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Thu, m, p.
On one hand, my heart is raging forth and on the other hand, my reason is screaming warnings at me.
The commands of "kill" and "escape" clash together.

entries.japanese:
「ばっ―――そんなわけないだろう……！
　俺は秋葉を殺しにきた訳じゃない……！」
「嘘ね。
だって兄さんは琥珀と寝たんでしょう？
　ならもう私の助けなんていらないわよね。
なのにここに来たっていう事は、そういう事なんでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“D-don’t―――be ridiculous…! I didn’t come here to kill you, Akiha…!”
“A lie. You slept with Kohaku, didn’t you?”
“Then you no longer need my help. If you came here anyway, there can only be one reason.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Stupi---that isn't it……!
I didn't come here to kill you……!"
"Liar.
You slept with Kohaku, didn't you?
Then you don't need my help anymore, do you?
So isn't that why you came here?"

entries.japanese:
「だから……！
　俺はおまえと殺し合いなんかをしにきたんじゃなくて、おまえに血を吸うのを止めさせる為に来たんだ…………！
　俺を助けようとしなければ、秋葉は血を吸わずにすむんだろう？
　なら、秋葉はもう苦しまなくていい。
……俺の体なら大丈夫だよ。
俺は琥珀さんがいてくれれば、それで――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s not it…! I came to stop you from drinking blood, not to fight you to the death…!
“If you stop trying to keep me alive, you won’t have to drink anymore, will you? Then you won’t need to suffer. My body will be fine. As long as Kohaku is with me, I――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What did I just say……!
I said I didn't come here to kill you, only to stop you from drinking any more blood………!
You were doing this to help me, right?
So you don't have to anymore.
…… My body is fine again.
As long as Kohaku-san is near, I----"

entries.japanese:
「つまり私はもう用済みっていうコト？
　アハ……ほんと、私ってバカみたいですね。
あんなに大切にしていたのに、こんなに兄さんの事を愛していたのに――――兄さんは結局、私に振り向いてさえくれなかった」
「用済みだなんて、そんなバカな事口にするな！
　……俺だって秋葉の事を大切に思ってる。
おまえが―――おまえが望むなら、なんだって―――」
　してやる、とは言えなかった。
　秋葉の望みがなんであるかは解っている。
　だが、それは聞けない。
俺はもう、二度と琥珀さんを裏切るような事だけは、出来ないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So I’m no longer of any use to you?
“Ahaha, what a fool I am. I treasured you so dearly and loved you so much――――yet in the end, Brother, you never once looked my way.”
“Don’t say something so stupid as being useless!”
“You matter to me too, Akiha. If you―――if you ask it of me, I’ll do anything―――”
I cannot say I will give it to her.
I know exactly what Akiha wants.
But I cannot grant it. Never again can I do anything that would betray Kohaku.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You intend just to cast me off now?
Hah…… I really must look stupid.
I thought of you so dearly, I loved you this much----but you don't even think of me."
"Cast you off?
Don't say stupid things like that.
…… You are very dear to me.
What---whatever you want, I---"
I can't say the words "will do them."
I know what it is she wants.
But, I can't do that.
I can't betray Kohaku-san again.

entries.japanese:
「―――嘘吐き。
そんな人は、もういりません」
　ギッ、と教室が悲鳴をあげる。
　空気が焦げていく。
秋葉の赤い髪が際限なく広がっていく。
　それは。
圧倒的なまでの、力の差だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Liar. I have no use for someone like you.”
The classroom shrieks around us.
The air begins to burn. Akiha’s crimson hair spreads without limit.
It is overwhelming. The difference in our power is absolute.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Liar.
I have no need for someone like you."
The entire room screams.
The air is burning.
Her red hair expands without limit.
This, is overwhelming, power.

entries.japanese:
「ぁ――――――――」
　体がよろめく。
　無意識に足が後ろに下がる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――――”
My body sways.
One foot retreats without conscious command.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah--------"
I start to stagger.
Unconsciously, my legs move back.

entries.japanese: ―――どくん。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---Thump.

entries.japanese:
「言ったわよね、兄さん。
私、一度噛みついた飼い犬なんていらないの」
entries.maoEnglish: “I told you, Brother. I don’t want a dog once it has bitten me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I told you, Nii-san.
I have no need for pets that bite me once."

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
どくん。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Thump. Thump.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
Thump.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん。
秋葉にとって、兄さんは本当に一番大切な人だった。
けどそれも終わったわ。
　だって、どんなに焦がれていても、それが手に入らないなら目障りなだけでしょう？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother… to Akiha, you truly were the most precious person in the world. But that is over now.
“No matter how desperately you yearn for something, if it can never be yours, it is only an eyesore, wouldn’t you agree?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san.
For me, you really were the most important person in the world.
But that is all over.
Because, however much I yearn for you, if I can never have you, then aren't you just an eyesore?"

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
どくん。
どくん。

「―――だから、殺してあげますね兄さん。
　一番大切なモノだったから、貴方は他の誰にも傷つけさせません」
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump. Thump. Thump.
“―――So I am going to kill you, Brother.
“You were my most precious possession, so I won’t let anyone else be the one to hurt you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
Thump.
Thump.
"---So, I will kill you, Nii-san.
You are the most important thing to me, so I will not let anyone else have you."

entries.japanese:
―――どくん。
どくんどくんどくんどくん……！
entries.maoEnglish: ―――thump. thumpthumpthumpthump…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
Thump Thump Thump Thump……!

entries.japanese:
「あ―――あき、は」
　息が、できない。
　教室の大気は焔のようで、吸いこむと肺が焼けた。
　秋葉の周囲にはユラユラと揺らめく蜃気楼。
　心臓は。
今すぐにでも、逃げるか殺すかを択一しろと繰り返す。
entries.maoEnglish:
“A―――Akiha”
I can’t breathe.
The classroom air has become flame, searing my lungs with every breath.
A mirage shimmers around Akiha.
My heart. It demands a choice, now and at once: flee, or kill.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"A---Aki, ha."
I can't breathe.
The air in the room is like a furnace, burning the inside of my lungs.
All around Akiha is that shimmering mirage.
My heart.
Even now, the impulses still fight between escaping and killing.

entries.japanese:
「もう、どうしたのよ兄さん。
私、これでも気を遣ってあげてるのよ。
こっちが本気になったらすぐに終わってしまうから、少しは兄さんに華を持たせてあげないといけないでしょう？
　ほら、さっき琥珀を助けたみたいに、私に切りかかってこないんですか？」
「っ………………！」
　秋葉の笑みはなくならない。
　その、吐き気がするぐらいの殺気。
　秋葉はもう、完全に――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s wrong, Brother? I am trying to be considerate. If I grew serious, this would end immediately, and I ought to give you at least one chance to shine.
“Come now, aren’t you going to attack me with that knife, the way you used it to save Kohaku?”
“……!”
Akiha’s smile never falters.
Her murderous intent is nauseating.
She has already, completely――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, what's the matter, Nii-san?
I'm being generous here.
If I became serious, then it would be all over, so I have to let you do at least a little bit, right?
Here, won't you come slash at me like you did when you saved Kohaku?"
"Tss……………!"
Her smile doesn't fade.
The murderous feeling in the air almost makes me want to puke.
Akiha, is completely----

entries.japanese:
「……そう。
弱いのね、兄さんは。
こうなってしまったのにまだ私を殺す気になれないなんて。
　けど私は違うわ。
早く、兄さんを殺したくて仕方がないんです。
　……だって、今までずっと我慢してた。
　その血も肉体も、体温も輪郭も、全部私だけのものにして兄さんを所有できるコトを夢見てたんだから」
　秋葉は震えながら、自分のコトバに身を震わしながら、愉しそうに笑う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. You’re weak, Brother. Even after all this, you still can’t bring yourself to kill me.
“But I am different. I can hardly wait to kill you.
“I have denied myself for so long.
“I dreamed of making every part of you mine—your blood, your body, your warmth, even the shape of you—until I possessed you completely.”
Akiha shudders, intoxicated by her own words, and laughs with delight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I see, you're pretty weak, Nii-san.
You can't even bring yourself to kill me.
But I'm different.
I can't help but want to kill you.
…… Because I've been holding back for so long.
Your blood, your flesh, your warmth, your shape, everything.
I always dreamed about making them completely mine and mine only."
While she shakes, while her body shakes with each word, she smiles with pleasure.

entries.japanese:
―――心臓が狂いそうだ。
　目の前にいるアレは、もう完全に―――以前の遠野秋葉とは違っている。
　頭痛がする。
　頭が割れそうだ。
　それはあまりに痛すぎて、物事を考える事ができなくなる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My heart is going mad.
The thing before me is now completely―――different from Akiha Tohno as I knew her.
My head aches.
It feels ready to split apart.
The pain is too great to let me think.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---My heart feels like it has gone crazy.
This thing before me, it's already---no longer the Tohno Akiha from before.
I get a headache.
It feels like it will split apart.
The pain drives any thoughts out of my head.

entries.japanese:
―――理性が狂いそうだ。
　頭。
あたまがこんなにもイタイと、俺まで。
　気が狂って、秋葉と、殺し合いをする気に、なってしまう――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――My reason is going mad.
My head. If it keeps hurting this badly, even I will break.
I will go mad and find myself wanting to fight Akiha to the death――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I'm about to go crazy.
My head.
If my head hurts this much, I will---
I will go crazy and feel like, fighting Akiha to the death----

entries.japanese:
「さあ、殺し合いましょう兄さん。
遠野と七夜はもとからそういった関係ですもの。
今更ためらう必要なんてないでしょう？」
　かつん、と秋葉が近づいてくる。
　ザワザワと床に敷き詰められた、赤い髪が脈動する。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Come, Brother, and let us kill each other. That has always been the relationship between the Tohno and Nanaya families. There is no need to hesitate now, is there?”
Her shoes click as Akiha approaches.
The crimson hair carpeting the floor rustles and pulses.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well then, let's fight to the death, Nii-san.
The Tohno and Nanaya families have always had that connection.
There's no need to hold back, right?"
She takes a step closer.
Her red hair around the floor shakes.

entries.japanese:
「それでも出来ないというのなら構わない。
　兄さんみたいな嘘吐きは、ここで死んじゃえ」
　言って。
　シキを殺した時のように、秋葉は俺の姿を凝視した。
「――――――――！」
　地面が跳ねあがる。
　目には視えない筈のモノ、熱気じみた赤いモノが俺を飲み込もうと覆い被さってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“And if you still refuse, so be it.
“A liar like you can die right here.”
She says it.
Akiha fixes her gaze upon me, just as she did when she killed SHIKI.
“――――――――!”
The floor bucks beneath me.
Something that should be invisible—a red, heat-hazed mass—surges up to engulf me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I don't care if you can't even do that.
A spew of lies like you should just die here."
She spits these last words.
Like the time she killed SHIKI, she stares at me.
"--------!"
The ground jumps up at me.
That which cannot be seen, the red thing that looks like a fiery aura, tries to engulf me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　タン、と着地する音が廊下に響いた。
「―――――――ハ」
　……どうかしている。
　あの熱気に包まれようとした瞬間、危険を察して体が跳んでいた。
　後ろに大きく跳んで、着地してからもう一度だけ地面を蹴った。
　それだけで、ここまで引いた。
「ハ…………、ア」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
The crack of my landing echoes down the corridor.
“―――――――Hah”
This is insane.
The instant that heat begins to close around me, my body senses the danger and leaps.
I spring far backward, land, and kick off the floor once more.
That alone has carried me this far.
“Hah, ah”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
The sound of something striking the ground echoes through the hallway.
"-------Huh?"
…… There's something wrong.
The instant before I was to be enveloped by that fiery aura, my body instinctively sensed the danger and jumped back.
I took a giant leap backwards and jumped again once I landed.
With that, I made it this far.
"Ah…………, ahh."

entries.japanese:
息があがる。
　今のスピードは尋常じゃない。
　なにしろ一瞬にして、秋葉の視界から消え去ったぐらいの速さだ。
　そうでなければ、あの熱気から逃げられる道理がない。
　あの夢の中で、秋葉はシキの体を睨みだけで奪っていった。
　……俺とシキはまったく同じだ。
　見るだけでいい秋葉と、近づかなければいけない俺とでは戦力が違いすぎる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I am panting.
That speed was inhuman.
In a single instant, I vanished entirely from Akiha’s sight.
Nothing less could have escaped that heat.
In the dream, Akiha stripped away SHIKI’s body with nothing but her stare.
SHIKI and I are exactly alike.
Akiha only needs to see me, while I have to close the distance; the disparity between us is overwhelming.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My breathing goes wild.
This speed isn't natural.
I was so fast that I disappeared from Akiha's vision in an instant.
If I didn't do that, there was no way I could have escaped that fiery aura.
In that dream, Akiha plundered SHIKI's body with just her stare.
…… I am in the same position SHIKI was.
Akiha only needs to look while I need to close in.
There's too much difference in our abilities.

entries.japanese:
「違う―――！
　殺し合う気なんてないって言ってるだろ…………！」
――――ズキン。
　だが頭痛が倍化していく。
　頭が割れて羽が生えてきそうだ。
　教室の扉からは赤い熱気が漏れてくる。
　秋葉は周囲の空気を真紅に変えて、廊下へと俺を追ってきた。
　距離にして教室一つ分、俺と秋葉は離れている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re wrong―――! I told you, I don’t want to fight you to the death…!”
――――A stab of pain.
But the headache only doubles.
My skull feels ready to crack open and sprout wings.
Crimson heat spills from the classroom doorway.
Turning the air around her scarlet, Akiha follows me into the corridor.
A classroom’s length of corridor separates us.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No---!
I said I didn't want to fight you………!"
----THROB!
My headache increases.
It feels like my head's going to split in two and grow wings.
The burning red aura flows out from the classroom door.
She is transforming the entire air into pure vermillion and comes out into the hallway after me.
About a classroom's length lies between me and her.

entries.japanese:
「呆れた。
一体どんな体をしてるのよ、兄さんは」
　ゆらゆらと揺れる赤い髪。
　廊下の気温は際限なく上昇していく。
「いくら夜だからって、いきなり視界から消えるなんてどうかしてるわ。
……本当に驚嘆すべき逃げ足ね。
遮蔽物に身を隠した訳でもなく、ただ速さだけでこっちの動体視力を上回るんだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Unbelievable. Just what kind of body do you have, Brother?”
Crimson hair sways like flame.
The temperature in the corridor climbs without end.
“Even granting that it’s night, vanishing from sight outright is absurd. What astonishing speed you have when running away. You didn’t hide behind anything—you simply moved too fast for my eyes to follow.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Amazing.
Just what kind of body do you have, Nii-san?"
Her hair waves around.
The air in the hallway starts to increase without limit.
"Even if it is night, disappearing from my view like this is strange.
…… Your legs really are amazingly fast.
It isn't that you are hiding your body behind anything, you're just moving faster than my eyes can track."

entries.japanese:
ざくざくと軋むこめかみ。
　遠野志貴の頭痛は際限なく倍化していく。
「でも、それも終わりよ。
今度はもう油断しないし、ここなら兄さんを見失う事もないわ」
―――確かに、ここは教室より不利だ。
　後ろに逃げても、階段までは距離がありすぎる。
　どんなに速く走った所で、その背中を秋葉に睨まれれば赤い熱気に捕われる。
　かといって手近な教室に入ってしまえば、もう袋の鼠になってしまう。
　秋葉は虫の手足をもぎ取るように、少しずつ俺の手足を消していくだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
My temples grind as though packed with broken glass.
Shiki Tohno’s headache goes on multiplying.
“But that is over. I won’t be careless again, and here there is nowhere for you to escape my sight.”
―――She is right; this corridor puts me at a greater disadvantage than the classroom.
The stairs are too far behind me to reach by retreating.
However fast I run, the moment Akiha fixes her gaze on my back, the red heat will seize me.
If I duck into the nearest classroom, I will be trapped.
Akiha will erase my limbs one by one, like a child pulling the legs from an insect.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My forehead throbs.
My headache multiplies in intensity.
"But, that is over as well.
I won't make the same mistake, and you can't escape my vision here."
---Certainly this is worse than the classroom.
The stairs are a long way behind me.
No matter how fast I run, Akiha will simply seize my back with her fiery aura.
But if I run into another classroom, I'll just be a caged rat.
She'll probably destroy my arms and legs one by one, like pulling the legs off a bug.

entries.japanese:
「まずは―――そうね。
その素晴らしい逃げ足を無くしてあげる……！」
　秋葉の瞳が俺の足を捉える。
　ゆらり、と大気が焦げる匂い。
entries.maoEnglish:
“First―――yes. Let’s take away those marvelous legs of yours…!”
Akiha’s eyes lock upon my legs.
The air wavers with the smell of burning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"First---that's right.
I'll destroy those wonderful running legs of yours……!"
Her eyes fixate on my legs.
The air itself smells of burning.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　後ろに跳ぶ。
遠野志貴の周囲の空気が熱気に変わって、そのまま両足を包み込む
　ナイフを握る。
視界は良好。
右脳を切り取られるような頭痛。
　切断・
　大気ごと。
赤い髪を、切り殺した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I leap backward as the air around Shiki Tohno turns to heat and wraps around both legs.
I tighten my grip on the knife. My vision is clear. Pain shears through the right half of my brain.
Sever
Air and all. I cut the red hair dead.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I jump back.
The air around me turns to that fiery aura and wraps around my arms and legs.
I swing my knife.
What I see is satisfactory.
This headache tears at my right brain.
Slice.
I slice apart the red hair with the air around it.

entries.japanese:
「くっ――――――――！」
　呻いて、秋葉は憎々しげに俺を見つめる。
「――――――――――」
　だが苦しいのはこっちも同じだった。
　すぐに切断したとはいえ、両足は火傷したように激しく疼いている。
　頭痛はその疼きよりさらに激しく、本当に頭を割りそうなぐらい、鋭すぎた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ghh――――――――!”
Akiha groans and glares at me with naked hatred.
“――――――――――”
But I am suffering no less.
I severed it immediately, yet both legs throb as though badly burned.
The headache is sharper still, sharp enough to split my skull in two.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"K---------!"
Akiha moans and stares at me full of hatred.
"----------"
But I am also in pain.
Even though I sliced it apart quickly, my arms and legs feel a lingering burning sensation.
My headache gets worse and it feels like it really will split apart.

entries.japanese:
「また―――どうして、そんなコトができるっていうのよ、貴方は…………！！」
　たどたどしい足取りで秋葉は歩いてくる。
　距離が遠くて俺の姿がよく見えないから効かない、と判断したのだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Again―――how can you possibly do such a thing!?”
Akiha advances with faltering steps.
She must have decided her power failed because the distance kept her from seeing me clearly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Again---why can you do such things…………!!?"
She walks over towards me staggering.
She must think that it doesn't work because she cannot focus on my distant figure.

entries.japanese:
……おそらく、それは正しい。
　秋葉の能力は瞳に見えている映像の鮮明さに比例する。
　今が深夜で建物の中だから、俺を捕えようとする熱気の動きが遅い。
　これが日中で光があるのなら、秋葉の視線と熱気の速度はほぼ同一になるだろう。
　そうなればいくら視えていても切り殺す事で防ぐ、なんて事さえ間に合わない。
entries.maoEnglish:
She is probably right.
Akiha’s power depends on the clarity of the image within her eyes.
Because it is midnight and we are inside, the heat pursuing me moves slowly.
In daylight, Akiha’s gaze and that heat would travel at almost the same speed.
Then, however clearly I saw it, I would never sever it quickly enough to defend myself.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, that's probably right.
Her power works proportionally to the clearness of her vision.
Because we're in a building in the middle of the night, her fiery aura is slow in catching me.
If it was daytime, her vision and the fiery aura would probably be the same speed.
If that was the case, I wouldn't be able to kill that aura fast enough.

entries.japanese:
「くっ…………！」
　火傷だらけの足で後ろに引く。
　秋葉は追ってくる。
　お互い警戒しあっている為か、ただ間合いを維持したまま、俺たちは廊下を移動していく。
――――――その時。
　さっきまで俺たちがいた教室から、人影が、出てきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn…!”
I back away on my burned legs.
Akiha follows.
Perhaps because we are both wary, neither changes the distance between us as we move together down the corridor.
――――――Then.
A figure emerges from the classroom we have just left.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gg………!"
I pull back with the burning still in my legs.
Akiha follows.
Since we are cautious of each other, we keep our distance as we shift down the hallway.
------And then.
A figure emerges from the classroom we were just in.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――」
　意識が止まる。
　頭痛も心音もしなくなった。
―――いけない。
　どうして出てくる。
どうしてあのまま気を失ったままで、教室にいてくれなかったのか。
「―――――秋葉、さま」
　背後からの声に秋葉が振り向く。
―――最悪だ、と直感した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
My mind stops.
The headache vanishes; so does the beating of my heart.
―――No.
Why has she come out? Why couldn’t she have remained unconscious inside that classroom?
“―――――Miss Akiha”
At the voice behind her, Akiha turns.
―――In that instant, I know the worst has happened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
My mind freezes.
My headache and my heartbeat disappear.
---This can't be happening.
Why did you come out?
Why couldn't you stay passed out in the classroom?
"-----Akiha, sama."
Akiha turns to face the voice behind her.
---I feel despair creeping all around me.

entries.japanese:
「もう、お止めください。
こんな事をしても、秋葉さまが苦しむだけです。
……人の血を吸い続けて、シキ様のように狂われても楽になれる事なんて、ないんです」
　よろよろと。
　今にも倒れそうな足取りで、琥珀さんは、秋葉へと歩いていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please stop this, Miss Akiha. You will only make yourself suffer. Even if you keep drinking human blood until you go mad like Master SHIKI, it will never bring you peace.”
Staggering.
Barely able to remain on her feet, Kohaku walks toward Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Please stop.
If you do this, you will only hurt yourself, Akiha-sama…… Even if you keep drinking blood and go insane like SHIKI-sama, you will still suffer."
Swaying, wavering.
Like she will collapse at any moment, Kohaku-san walks towards Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「――――――止めろ」
　呟きは届かない。
　琥珀さんの元に行くためには、秋葉をすり抜けなくてはいけない。
　そんな事―――どうやって、やれというんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――Stop”
My whisper does not reach her.
To reach Kohaku, I would have to get past Akiha.
Something like that―――how could I possibly do it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------Stop!"
My outcry can't reach her.
To get to Kohaku-san, I have to go past Akiha.
How---can I do that?

entries.japanese:
「……まだ秋葉さまは間に合います。
けれど志貴さんを手にかけてしまえば、本当に―――遠野よりの、鬼になってしまうんです」
「……………………………」
　秋葉は俺と琥珀さんを見比べる。
　そうして―――
「もう遅いわ。
私は血を吸う鬼なんだし、貴方の言葉にはもう踊らされない。
　楽にならない、ですって？
　この感覚を知らないくせに知った口をきかないでよ琥珀。
　私ね、今とても愉しいのよ。
シキの気持ちも解るわ。
こんなに自由で愉快なのは生まれて初めて。
　だから、今さら戻る事なんてできっこない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“It isn’t too late for you yet, Miss Akiha. But if you kill Master Shiki, then you truly will become―――a demon of the Tohno blood.”
“……”
Akiha looks from Kohaku to me.
And then―――
“It is already too late. I’m a demon that drinks blood, and I won’t dance to your tune anymore.
“You claim this won’t bring me peace? Don’t pretend to understand a feeling you’ve never known, Kohaku.
“I am enjoying myself more than I ever have. I understand SHIKI now. Never in my life have I felt so free or had such fun.
“There can be no going back.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can still make it, Akiha-sama.
But if you kill Shiki-san, you really will---turn into a Tohno demon."
"…………………………"
Akiha looks at me and Kohaku-san.
And then---
"It's too late.
I already am a blood sucking demon.
I won't listen to what you have to say anymore.
Suffer?
You don't know anything about what I'm feeling so don't try and lecture me about it, Kohaku.
This feels wonderful.
I can understand what SHIKI was feeling.
This is the first time I've ever felt this kind of freedom.
So I can't go back now."

entries.japanese:
「違います……！
　秋葉さまはそう信じこもうとしているだけです。
シキ様を手にかけてしまわれて、志貴さんに全てを知られてしまって、それをなかった事にしたいのでしょう……？
　けど、それは出来ない事です。
どんなに狂われたフリをしても、秋葉さまは――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“That isn’t true…! Miss Akiha is only trying to make herself believe it. You killed Master SHIKI and Master Shiki learned everything, so now you want to pretend none of it ever happened, don’t you?
“But you can’t erase it. However mad you pretend to be, Miss Akiha, you are still――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You're wrong……!
That is only what you are telling yourself.
Isn't it just that you killed SHIKI-sama and Shiki-san found out about everything, so you want to make everything like it never happened……?
But that is something you cannot do.
No matter how crazy you may act, you're really----"

entries.japanese:
「うるさい…………！
　あなたなんかに、私と兄さんを殺しあわせようとしたあなたなんかに、そんな善人ぶった言葉を吐く資格なんかない……！」
　秋葉の髪が舞う。
　それは、俺に向けられた熱気とは質の違う、本当に質量をもった髪だった。
「ええ、満足でしょう琥珀。
あなたの思惑どおり私と兄さんは殺しあってしまっている。
あなたの復讐はこれで完成、というわけね」
「あ――――――――」
　琥珀さんの言葉が途切れる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Be quiet…! You tried to make Brother and me kill each other; someone like you has no right to stand there pretending to be good!”
Akiha’s hair sweeps into the air.
This is not the bodiless heat she sent against me; this hair possesses real mass.
“You must be pleased, Kohaku. Brother and I are killing each other exactly as you planned. Your revenge is complete.”
“Ah――――――――”
Kohaku’s words die in her throat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Silence…………!
Don't try and act like a good person after setting us up to kill each other……!"
Akiha's hair dances in the air.
This is entirely different than the amount of power she directed against me.
"You must be satisfied.
Just like you planned, Nii-san and I are fighting to the death.
Your revenge is now complete, right?"
"Ah--------"
Kohaku-san's words are cut off.

entries.japanese:
「そっか、兄さんは知らないのよね。
琥珀が兄さんをいいように操って、兄さんがご自分に自信を持てなくなるようにしたってコトを」
　秋葉は勝ち誇ったように、俺に視線を向けてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Of course, Brother, you don’t know, do you? Kohaku manipulated you into losing all faith in yourself.”
Akiha turns a triumphant gaze upon me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I see, Nii-san doesn't know.
That Kohaku was merely manipulating you so that you won't be confident in yourself, Nii-san."
Akiha directs her gaze towards me as if she was winning a debate.

entries.japanese:
「兄さんもおかしいとは思わなかった？
　毎晩すぐに眠くなって、自分の記憶が曖昧になったのは全部琥珀の仕業よ。
　琥珀はね、薬と偽って兄さんに麻薬めいた物を服用させていたの。
そうしてせん妄状態になった兄さんの耳元で囁いたんでしょうね。
『貴方は街で人を殺している殺人鬼です』って」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Didn’t you ever find it strange, Brother? Falling asleep so quickly every night, your memories growing confused—it was all Kohaku’s doing.
“She gave you something like a narcotic and called it medicine. Then, once you were delirious, she must have whispered the following into your ear.
‘You are a murderer killing people across the city.’
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Didn't you think it was strange?
Going to sleep early every night, having your memories obscured, that was all Kohaku's doing.
She prepared you drugs instead of medicine.
And then all she had to do was whisper in your ear while you were high.
'You are the killer stalking the streets' was all she had to say."

entries.japanese:
「そうして琥珀は兄さんを殺人鬼にしたてあげて、私を殺させようとした。
　いえ、兄さんが殺人鬼になんかならなくても、兄さんが夜の街に出歩くようになるだけでも良かったのよ。
　どうなったって私と兄さんが殺しあってしまうような手の込んだ筋書きを作って、琥珀は笑顔でそれを実行していった。
　遠野家の人間に復讐するために、私だけでなく関係のない兄さんをも騙して、琥珀はこの状況を完成させたんだから」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku turned you into a murderer and tried to make you kill me.
“No—even if you never became one, it was enough simply to make you wander the city at night.
“She devised an elaborate plot that would end with us killing each other no matter what happened, then carried it out with a smile.
“To take revenge on the Tohno family, she deceived not only me but you, who had nothing to do with any of it, and engineered everything you see tonight.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"And after making you a killer, she tried to get you to kill me.
No, even if you didn't become the killer, you just had to walk the streets at night.
While she made this elaborate play pitting you and I against each other, Kohaku prepared everything with a smile.
In order to carry out her revenge against the Tohno family, Kohaku deceived even you, who had no connection to this, and completed the situation we are in right now."

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
―――ああ、なるほど。
　だからいつも、琥珀さんはいいタイミングで現れては、俺の知りたい事を教えてくれて、眠れない俺に薬を持ってきてくれたのか。
　でも、それは。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――Ah, of course.
That was why Kohaku had always appeared at precisely the right moment, told me exactly what I wanted to know, and brought medicine whenever I couldn’t sleep.
But none of that matters.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………………"
---Yeah, it seems so clear now.
That's why Kohaku-san would always appear at the right time, always telling me what I wanted to know, always giving me medicine when I couldn't sleep.
But, still.

entries.japanese:
「琥珀にとって、私も兄さんもお芝居を完成させる為の駒にすぎなかった。
　わかるでしょ？
　琥珀にとっては兄さんだって、ただの道具にすぎなかった………！
　それでも、それでも兄さんは琥珀を選ぶって言うんですか……！」
　……そう。
　泣くような激しさで、秋葉は言った。
―――でも、それは。
「…………知ってる。
そんなコトは、前から解っていたんだ、秋葉」
entries.maoEnglish:
“To Kohaku, you and I were nothing but pieces needed to complete her performance.
“Surely you understand now. Even you were only a tool to her…!
“Knowing that, Brother—knowing all of it—can you still say you choose Kohaku?”
Yes.
Akiha hurls the words at me with the violence of a sob.
―――But even so.
“I know. I’ve understood that for a long time, Akiha.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"For Kohaku, you and I were just pieces to complete her play.
Don't you understand?
To Kohaku, you are nothing more than a tool………!
But still, but still you choose her over me……!?"
…… Yes.
Akiha says this tearfully.
---But, still.
"………… I knew.
All of that, I already knew it, Akiha."

entries.japanese:
「――――え？」
　不思議そうな声。
　それは果たして、誰があげたものだっただろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――What?”
A bewildered voice.
Whose voice was it?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Eh?"
A questioning voice.
I wonder which of them said it?

entries.japanese:
「琥珀さんが俺を利用しているって、そんな事はとっくに知っていた。
……けど、そんな事は関係ないんだ。
　俺は琥珀さんを愛してる。
　だから琥珀さんが何をしようと―――俺は、琥珀さんを信じていただけなんだから」
「―――――――――」
　息を飲む音。
　彼女は、本当に呆然と。
　遠くから、届かない故郷を眺めるような目で、俺を見た。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’ve known for ages that Kohaku was using me. But that doesn’t matter.
“I love her.
“Whatever Kohaku chooses to do―――I will simply trust her.”
“―――――――――”
A sharp intake of breath.
She is utterly dumbstruck.
She looks at me as though gazing from afar upon a homeland she can never reach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"About Kohaku using me, I knew that a long time ago.
…… But, that doesn't matter.
I love Kohaku-san.
So no matter what she does---I just believe in her."
"---------"
A gasp.
She really is surprised.
With distant, longing, unreaching eyes, she looks at me.

entries.japanese:
「――は。
あはは、は」
　乾いた、人形のような秋葉の笑い声。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――Ha. Ahaha, ha.”
Akiha’s laughter is dry and hollow as a doll’s.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--Ha.
Ahaha, ha."
Akiha's dry, doll-like laugh.

entries.japanese:
「……なによ、それじゃ私はとんだ道化じゃない。
　私はどんなものより欲しかった人に拒絶されて、その欲しかった人は愛した相手に道具扱いされている。
　それでも――――それでも兄さんを手に入れられるなんて、ふざけないでよ琥珀……っ！！！！」
「秋葉―――――――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that makes me nothing but a clown.
“The person I wanted more than anything rejected me, while the woman he loves treats him like a tool.
“Even then――――even then, you still get to have him; don’t make a fool of me, Kohaku…!”
“Akiha―――――――!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Then I'm just some sort of clown?
Rejected by the one I love the most who is being used as a tool by the one he loves instead?
Still----you still want to steal him from me!
Don't be ridiculous, Kohaku……!!!!"
"Akiha--------!"

entries.japanese:
秋葉の髪がたなびく。
―――走った。
　秋葉に近づけば殺されるとか、間に合いっこないとか、そんな余分な事は排除して、走って、手を伸ばした。
　だが、それでも残酷に把握できていた。
　彼女が、あの教室から出てきてしまった時点で。
　俺の手は、絶対に、届くことがないのだと。

とす、という音。
　秋葉の髪は刃物のような鋭さで、彼女の胸を貫いた。

呆然と。
いや、それとも受け入れるように、彼女は避ける事さえしなかった。
　倒れる。
　着物がゆれている。
なんていうスローモーション。
　それを認めたくない思考が、時間の流れを遅くしているのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s hair streams out behind her.
―――I run.
I strip away every useless thought—that approaching Akiha means death, that I can never make it in time—and run with my hand outstretched.
Yet some cruel part of me already understands.
From the moment she stepped out of that classroom.
My hand will never reach her.
A soft, blunt sound.
Sharp as a blade, Akiha’s hair pierces Kohaku’s chest.
Dazed. Or perhaps accepting it, she makes no attempt to evade the blow.
She falls.
Her kimono flutters. Everything moves so slowly.
Is my mind slowing time because it refuses to accept what it sees?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her hair starts to flow.
---I run.
Even if Akiha ends up killing me, even if I can't make it, I don't care.
I run and I reach out my hand.
But, I knew the cruel reality.
That the instant she walked out of that classroom.
That my hand, will never make it, to her.

A sickening sound.
Akiha's hair pierces Kohaku's chest like a spear.

Shocked, no, as if she was accepting it, she didn't even try to dodge.
She collapses.
Her kimono wavers in the air as if it was all in slow-motion.
My brain doesn't want to confirm it and lags behind the flow of time.

entries.japanese: ―――八つ当たり、だったんです。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――I suppose I was only lashing out.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---I was just taking it out on someone.

entries.japanese: ふと、そんな言葉を思い出した。
entries.maoEnglish: Those words suddenly return to me.
entries.mirrorMoon: I remember those words.

entries.japanese:
―――どうしてあの男の子はそんな事をしたんだろう。
自分の事より誰かの事が大切だっていうのかな。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――Why had that boy done such a thing? Had someone else truly mattered more to him than his own life?
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I couldn't understand why he did that.
Did he value someone more precious than his own life?

entries.japanese:
彼女は、その、大切な誰かに、ずっと成りたかった。
　だがそれは叶わず、結局は独りで生きて。
　その果てに、こんな結末しか、受け入れられないとでも言うように。
entries.maoEnglish:
She had always wanted to become that precious someone.
But the wish was never granted, and she had lived alone.
As though, at the end of that life, this was the only conclusion she could accept.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She, always wanted, to become, that precious someone.
But that did not happen, so she lived alone.
And as if saying this is the only result that she could end up in.

entries.japanese: ―――それだけの事ができるのに、どうしてあの子はわたしをタスケテくれないんだろう。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――If he could do something so wonderful, why hadn’t he saved me?
entries.mirrorMoon: ---If he could do that, why didn't he ever help me?

entries.japanese:
……………その罪は。
　八年前だけじゃなく、この瞬間にさえ、繰り返された。
entries.maoEnglish:
That sin…
It repeats itself not only eight years later, but in this very moment.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………… That sin.
Not just eight years ago, but it returns even in this instant.

entries.japanese:
―――だから、不思議に思ったんです。
　どうして―――どうしてわたしのまわりの人は、あの子みたいに優しくはなかったのかなって―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――That was why I wondered.
Why―――why had no one around me ever been as kind as he was―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---I thought it was so strange.
Why----why were the people around me not as kind as he was---

entries.japanese:
崩れ落ちる体。
　その間際に。
　最期まで虚ろな瞳をしたまま、それでも―――琥珀は、俺を見て微笑んだように、見えた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Her body crumples.
At the very last moment.
Her eyes hollow to the end, even then―――Kohaku seems to look at me and smile.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her falling body.
In that instant.
Even with her eyes clouding over---I see Kohaku smiling at me, or so I think.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――」
　足が止まる。
　声もなく、呼吸もない。
　刺すような、頭痛があるだけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――――”
My feet stop.
I have neither voice nor breath.
There is only a stabbing headache.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------"
My legs stop.
I can't speak, I can't breathe.
My piercing headache is the only thing that continues.

entries.japanese:
「――――ふん。
泥棒猫には相応しい最期ね」
　秋葉が笑う。
　刺すような頭痛。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Hmph. A fitting end for a thieving cat.”
Akiha laughs.
A stabbing headache.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hmph.
A fitting end for a Thief Cat."
Akiha laughs.
This piercing headache.

entries.japanese:
「私はもう戻れない。
シキを手にかけて、兄さんにだって拒絶された。
なら、もう行きつく所まで行くだけじゃない。
私は自由になったんだから、苦しいワケなんて、ない」
　秋葉の体がこちらに向く。
　大気が焦げる。
赤い髪は蛇のように鎌首をもたげていく。
まるでそれ単体が意志を持つような邪悪さ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“There is no going back for me. I killed SHIKI, and even Brother rejected me. All that remains is to follow this path to its end. I am free now, so I couldn’t possibly be suffering.”
Akiha turns toward me.
The air burns. The crimson hair rears like a snake preparing to strike. It radiates an evil that seems to possess a will of its own.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"I can't go back.
I killed SHIKI, even Nii-san rejected me.
Then, I have nowhere else to go.
I'm free now, so there shouldn't be any pain."
She faces me.
The air burns again.
Her hair coils around her like a snake.
It seems like every one of them has a mind of its own.

entries.japanese:
刺すような頭痛。
頭痛。
「――――俺を殺すんじゃ、なかったのか」
entries.maoEnglish:
A stabbing headache. Headache.
“――――Weren’t you going to kill me?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
This piercing headache.
Headache.
"----Didn't you want to kill me?"

entries.japanese:
ような頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
「琥珀さんじゃなくて―――俺を殺すんじゃなかったのか、秋葉」
entries.maoEnglish:
Like a headache. Headache. Headache. Headache.
“Weren’t you going to kill me―――not Kohaku, Akiha?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
This headache.
Headache.
Headache.
Headache.
"Not Kohaku-san---wasn't I the one you wanted to kill, Akiha?"

entries.japanese:
頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
頭痛。
　頭にくる。
頭にくる。
頭にくる。
　彼女を救えなかった自分。
　のうのうと生きている自分。
　彼女を救えなかった秋葉。
　のうのうと生きている秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
Headache. Headache. Headache. Headache. Headache. Headache.
Rage. Rage. Rage.
At myself, for failing to save her.
At myself, for going on living as though nothing happened.
At Akiha, for failing to save her.
At Akiha, for going on living as though nothing happened.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Headache.
Headache.
Headache.
Headache.
Headache.
Headache.
I'm angry.
I'm angry.
I'm angry.
At myself, who could not save her.
At myself, who's still living right now.
At Akiha, who could not save her.
At Akiha, who's still living right now.

entries.japanese:
「なに、兄さんったらすぐに殺してほしかったの？
　まあ謝ったって許してあげないけど、どのみちね、琥珀は殺すつもりだったわ。
　だってあんなの、生きていても意味なんかないじゃない。
とっくの昔に壊れてたんだから、早めに棄てちゃったほうが本人のためでしょう？」
―――――そうか。
　壊れたのなら、棄てたほうが本人のためなのか。
　なら―――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“What’s this, Brother, did you want me to kill you at once? I won’t forgive you even if you apologize, but in any case, I meant to kill Kohaku.
“There was no point in letting that thing live. She broke long ago, so throwing her away sooner was an act of mercy, don’t you think?”
―――――I see.
If something is broken, throwing it away is an act of mercy.
Then―――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"What, did you want to die quickly, Nii-san?
Well, I wouldn't forgive her even if she apologized.
I would have killed her sooner or later.
Because it's not like she had any reason to live.
She was broken a long time ago, so isn't it doing her a favor to throw her away?"
-----I see.
If someone breaks, then it's a favor for them if you throw them away.
So-------

entries.japanese:
「…………おまえは、秋葉じゃない」
　もう、俺の知っている秋葉じゃない。
　俺だけが認めようとしなかっただけで、とっくの昔に、あの蜃気楼に獲り憑かれている。
「いいよ、秋葉。
おまえの望み通りにする」
　八年前の昔。
二人で、庭を駆け回った時のように。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You aren’t Akiha.”
Not the Akiha I know.
I was the only one who refused to admit it, but that shimmering apparition possessed her long ago.
“All right, Akiha. We’ll do this your way.”
Eight years ago. Just as when we had run together through the garden.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… You, aren't Akiha."
She isn't the Akiha that I know.
I was just refusing to acknowledge that she was already possessed by the mirage so long ago.
"Fine, Akiha, as you wish."
Eight years ago.
Like when we ran in the garden.

entries.japanese: 「さあ――――本気で、殺し合いを始めよう」
entries.maoEnglish: “Come――――let us begin killing each other in earnest.”
entries.mirrorMoon: "C'mon----let's begin our fight to the death."

entries.japanese:
頭痛が、止まった。
　遠野志貴は死に。
俺は夜に逍遥していた頃の、七夜志貴に切り替わった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The headache stops.
Shiki Tohno dies. In his place, I become Shiki Nanaya—the one who once roamed the night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My headache stops.
Tohno Shiki dies.
Nanaya Shiki saunters out of the dark night.

entries.japanese:
自身と敵との間合いを目測する。
　距離にして十メートル。
ナイフが届く範囲に跳びこむだけなら二足。
確実に仕留めるのなら三足が必要になる間合いだ。
　廊下には遮蔽物もなく、大きく動いて身を隠すほどの広さもない。
壁と天井を足場にした所で、秋葉の視界から外れる事は難しい。
　こちらが二足で踏み込んだところで、秋葉がこちらを視認するのが一息。
　状況は以上だ。
このまま間合いを詰めた所で、一呼吸の差でこちらが先に死ぬ事になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I measure the distance between myself and the enemy.
Ten meters. Two strides to enter the knife’s reach. Three to kill with certainty.
The corridor offers no cover and no room for a wide maneuver. Even using the walls and ceiling as footholds, escaping Akiha’s sight is difficult.
Two strides for me to close, one breath for Akiha to see me.
That is the full situation. A direct approach will leave me dead by the margin of a single breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I visually gauge the distance between me and my enemy.
It is about ten meters.
I need two steps to get into knife range.
To ensure a kill, I need to take three steps.
There isn't any cover in the hallway and it's not big enough to hide myself by moving around.
Even if I use the walls or the ceiling, I will have difficulty avoiding her gaze.
Even if I take two steps, Akiha can easily fix her eyes on me in one motion.
That is the situation.
From this distance, I will die faster since she will be slightly faster.

entries.japanese:
「―――そう。
ようやくその気になったっていうワケね、兄さん」
　一歩、秋葉が歩みよる。
　いかに闇夜といっても、その距離ならこちらの姿を正確に見つけられる。
　あと一歩。
秋葉が一度歩み寄れば、それが合図になる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――I see. So you’ve finally decided to fight, Brother.”
Akiha steps closer.
Even in this darkness, at that distance she can see me clearly.
One more step. The next time she advances, that will be the signal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
You're finally in the mood, Nii-san."
Akiha takes a step forward.
Even though it's dark, with this distance, she can see me clearly.
Another step.
If she takes another step, that will be my signal.

entries.japanese:
殺すか、引くか。
　判断を誤れば、あの夢の時と同じようにシキという人体が秋葉の髪に呑まれるだけだ。
――――かつん、という足音。
「――――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
Kill, or retreat.
One mistaken judgment, and the human body named SHIKI will be swallowed by Akiha’s hair, just as it was in the dream.
――――Her next footstep rings against the floor.
“――――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Do I kill her now or pull back?
If I make a mistake, I will end engulfed in Akiha's hair like SHIKI in that dream.
----Another footstep.
"------"

entries.japanese:
―――その、足音が消える前に、地面を蹴った。
「来たわね―――――――――！」
　敵意と興奮が入り混じった秋葉の声。
　殺し合いというギリギリの緊張を秋葉は愉しみ、にやりと、俺の姿を視認する。
「―――――――――」
　その余分さが俺にとってたった一つの有利であり、秋葉にとっての敗因に他ならない。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Before the echo of that footstep can fade, I kick off the floor.
“There you are―――――――――!”
Akiha’s voice mingles hostility with exhilaration.
She savors the knife-edge tension of a fight to the death and grins when she catches sight of me.
“―――――――――”
That needless indulgence is my sole advantage—and the only cause of her defeat.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Before that footstep even fades, I spring into action.
"Here---------!"
Akiha's voice is a mixture of malice and pleasure.
Enjoying the tension of battle, she smiles as she looks in my direction.
"---------"
That carelessness is my only chance and her only reason for loss.

entries.japanese:
「ダメよ兄さん、いくら速くても近づけば近づくほどはっきりと見えるんだから――――！」
　歓喜するような声。
　秋葉の瞳がはっきりとこちらの姿を捉える。
　そうすれば、あとは簡単だ。
　俺は秋葉に近寄る事さえできず、ここで手足を蒸発させられ、ダルマになって床に転がる。
―――――まあ。
　それも、俺が燃え尽きる最後まで、秋葉が俺の姿を見ていられればの話だが。
entries.maoEnglish:
“It’s no use, Brother; however fast you are, the closer you come, the more clearly I can see you――――!”
Her voice rings with delight.
Akiha’s eyes fix on me.
From there, it is simple.
Before I can draw near, she will vaporize my arms and legs and leave a limbless stump rolling on the floor.
―――――Well.
That assumes she can keep looking at me until I finish burning away.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Not good enough, Nii-san.
No matter how fast you are, you just get clearer as you get closer to me-----!"
Her voice is full of delight.
Her eyes catch a hold of me.
Then, the rest is simple.
I won't be able to reach her, as she'll evaporate my arms and legs, and collapse to the floor.
-----Well,
that is, only if she can fix her eyes on me until I am completely burned away.

entries.japanese:
ぐるん、と視界が横転する。
「―――――――――え？」
　間の抜けた秋葉の声。
　手足を焼き尽くそうとしていた赤い髪は、瞬時に消えた。
　廊下という直線でしかありえない状況が幸いしたのか。
　直進するしかない、という前提を信じきった秋葉には、壁を足がかりにして天井を跳ねる俺の姿を視認できない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My vision suddenly rolls sideways.
“―――――――What?”
Akiha’s baffled voice.
The red hair about to consume my limbs vanishes at once.
Perhaps the straight confines of the corridor have worked in my favor.
Certain I could only charge forward, Akiha cannot follow me as I spring from the wall toward the ceiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My view reverses.
"----------Eh?"
Her voice is full of surprise.
In that same instant, the red hair that was to burn my arms and legs vanishes.
It's fortunate that the hallway is just a straight line.
Akiha, who thought I would only attack directly, can't see me as I climb up the wall and jump to the ceiling.

entries.japanese:
クモのように壁を駆けて、天井に一度だけ足をつける。
　実際にクモになれるワケじゃない。
　体を反転させて、足場として天井を使うだけだ。
　間合いは十分。
　体が落下する前に天井を蹴った。
entries.maoEnglish:
I run up the wall like a spider and plant one foot against the ceiling.
I cannot actually become a spider.
I merely flip my body over and use the ceiling as a foothold.
The distance is right.
Before gravity can take me, I kick off the ceiling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Proceeding up the wall like a spider, my foot touches the ceiling only once.
It's not like I can actually be a spider.
Turning my body, I'm just using the ceiling for a foothold.
The distance is good enough.
Before my body falls, I use my legs to thrust off the ceiling.

entries.japanese:
「う、え――――――？」
　秋葉の視界が上がり、手足の燃焼が再開された。
　どちらかの足と腕の感覚が途絶える。
　おそらくはもう存在しまい。
　だが、もうそんなモノに用はない。
　体はすでに必要な推力を得ている。
　そのまま――――
「きゃっ―――――――！？」
　秋葉の体に衝突した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Wh――――――what?”
Akiha’s gaze rises, and my limbs begin to burn again.
Sensation vanishes from one arm and one leg.
They probably no longer exist.
But I have no further use for them.
My body already has all the momentum it needs.
Straight on――――
“Ah―――――――!”
I crash into Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Uh, eh------?"
Akiha's gaze shifts upwards and the burning sensation returns to my arms and legs.
The feeling stops in an arm and a leg.
They probably don't exist anymore.
But, I don't need them any longer.
My body has the speed it needs.
Like this----
"Kyaa--------!?"
I collide into Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「こ、のォ――――――――！」
　倒れた秋葉が顔を起こす。
　秋葉と密接したこの距離で視認されれば、それこそコンマの誤差もなく体が蒸発するだろう。
　だから。
　その前に、分けた。
　細い首。
ドクドクと血を流す血管ごと、横一文字に線を引いた。
　皮膚も筋肉も動脈も白骨も差別なく、!w1500そこには博愛も憐憫もなく、!w1500百合の華を手折る様に、!w1500諸々の痛みさえ玲瓏と。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You――――――――!”
Akiha raises her head from the floor.
If she gets a clear look at me from this distance, my body will be vaporized in an instant.
Because of that.
Before she can, I divide her.
Her slender neck. I draw one horizontal line across it, through the vessels pumping blood.
Skin, muscle, artery, white bone!w1500—no distinction, no charity, no pity!w1500; like plucking a lily!w1500, every agony rendered crystalline.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why, you--------!"
Akiha lifts her head.
Being this close to her, she can easily find me and disintegrate my body.
So,
before that happens, I cut it apart.
That delicate neck.
I cut it horizontally through her pulsing veins.
Making no differentiation between her skin, her muscles, her arteries, her bones,!w1500 without mercy or compassion,!w1500 like plucking a lily,!w1500 without even any resplendent pain.

entries.japanese: ゴトリ。
entries.maoEnglish: Thud.
entries.mirrorMoon: Thud.

entries.japanese:
固い床に、ボーリングの玉に類似した重さと形状のモノが落ちた。
　それで終わり。
秋葉の瞳は廊下の壁なんていう、見当違いのモノを見つめたまま、おそらくは永劫に変わるまい。
entries.maoEnglish:
Something with the weight and shape of a bowling ball drops onto the hard floor.
That is the end. Akiha’s eyes remain fixed on the wholly irrelevant corridor wall, and will probably never move again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
On the hard floor, something that's shaped like a bowling ball drops.
It's all over.
Her eyes are cluelessly looking at the wall of the hallway, and probably will continue to do so for all of eternity.

entries.japanese:
「最期に見たものが、そんなもの、なんてな」
　秋葉は犬や猫より低い視点で、薄汚れた壁を見つめている。
　あたりは闇。
こんな風景を眼球に焼き付けて亡くなるなんて、不出来な笑い話のようだ。
「……殺し合いを愉しんでいるようじゃ浅いって、親父は教えてくれなかったのか、秋葉」
　……いや、それは無理な話か。
遠野槙久自身が浅かったんだから、秋葉が不出来なのも仕方がない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“So that was the last thing you ever saw.”
From a vantage lower than a dog’s or cat’s, Akiha stares at the grimy wall.
Darkness surrounds her. Dying with such a scene burned into her eyes feels like the punch line to a very poor joke.
“Did Father never teach you that anyone who enjoys a killing match is still an amateur, Akiha?”
No, that would have been impossible. Makihisa Tohno was an amateur himself, so no wonder Akiha turned out defective.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Is that the last thing you saw?"
Her eyes being lower than that of a dog or a cat's, she fixes her gaze towards the dirty wall.
Everywhere is darkness.
Dying while watching this scenery, it's like a bad joke.
"…… Didn't the old man teach you that taking pleasure in killing is shallow, Akiha?"
…… Well, that would've been useless.
Tohno Makihisa was shallow, so her messing up like that was inevitable.

entries.japanese:
「……勿体無い。
こんなにも優秀だったのに、鍛える火が弱かったとは」
　だから俺なんかにあっさりと殺されてしまったんだ。
　殺し合いに酔うなんていう余分さ。
　そんなものがあったから、おまえは死んだ。
