　こんな、誰もいない所で。
　一人でずっと、誰も見つめる事のない壁を見つめながら、断末魔さえ上げられずに。
「………………………は」
　まったく。
　我が妹ながら、なんて、哀れ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What a waste. So gifted, yet the fire that tempered you was too weak.”
That is why even someone like me killed you so easily.
You indulged yourself by reveling in our fight.
That single excess is why you died.
Here, where no one else is.
Alone forever, staring at a wall no one else will see, without even a death cry.
“Hah”
Truly.
My own little sister—how pitiful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What a shame.
Even though you were this talented, the fire that formed you was too weak."
That's why I could kill her so easily.
Doing useless things like enjoying killing.
You did that, so you died.
In this place, all alone.
Forever alone, staring at that wall that no one ever watches, not even letting out the final agonies of death.
"…………………… Ha."
Hmph.
Even though she is my sister, she looks so pathetic.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――――はぁ」
　止まっていた呼吸が再開する。
　焼かれていた全身に、どくん、と確かな力が流れる。
　……琥珀さんが死んで、俺の体は体力を失っていく。
　だが秋葉が消えた事で、俺は一人でも活きていけるようだ。
　まあ、もっとも。
　こんな体、こんな頭、こんな心を抱えたまま生きていても、なにも―――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――――Haaah”
My arrested breath begins again.
A solid pulse of strength surges through my scorched body.
Kohaku is dead, and my vitality continues to ebb.
Yet with Akiha gone, it appears I can survive alone.
Though, of course.
There is no point in living with this body, this mind, this heart―――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-----------Ahh."
My stopped breathing resumes.
My burnt body feels power flowing into it once more.
…… Because Kohaku-san died, my body was losing its power.
But since Akiha died, it seems like I am returning to normal.
Well, in the first place,
this body, this head, this heart, even if I embrace them and live, there is nothing-------

entries.japanese:
「はぁ―――はぁ――――はぁ――――」
　呼吸が戻ってくる。
　感覚の無い片手も片足も、まだカタチだけはあるらしい。
　床には、ようやく溢れ出した秋葉の赤色が広がり始めた。
「はぁ―――――――――――ぁ」
　壁際まで這って、なんとか片足で立ち上がる。
　窓を開けると新鮮な空気が入ってきた。
　熱帯夜のようだった廊下に、冷たい風が入ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah――――hah――――”
Breath returns to me.
My numb arm and leg seem at least to retain their shapes.
Only now does Akiha’s red begin spreading across the floor.
“Hah―――――――――――ah”
I crawl to the wall and somehow stand on one leg.
I open the window and fresh air pours in.
Cold wind enters the corridor that had felt like a tropical night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
*pant*---*pant*----*pant*----
My breathing returns.

My numb arm and leg still seem to be holding their shape.
On the floor, Akiha's blood finally starts to spill outward.
"Aah----------ah."
Crawling to the wall, I manage to stand up on one leg.
I open the window and fresh air streams in.
The cold wind blows through the baking hallway.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――ぁは。
ははは、は」
　風はこれ以上ないっていうぐらい心地よい。
　体の熱は冷めて、頭痛もぴたりと止んでくれた。
「――――はは……は……ぁ――――」
　なのに、どうしてだろう。
　思考だけが。
頭の中が真空になってしまったように。
もう何もかも平等に感じられて、灰色で、赤い視界のまま治らない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――Ah. Hahaha, ha”
The wind is exquisite beyond description.
The heat leaves my body, and the headache stops dead.
“――――Haha, ha, ah――――”
Then why?
Only my thoughts. It is as though my skull has become a vacuum. Everything feels equal and gray, while my vision stays red and refuses to clear.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Aha.
Hahaha, ha."
This wind feels extremely good.
It cools my burning body and my headache ceases.
"----Haha…… ha…… ah----"
So why?
Only my thoughts, as if my head is becoming empty.
Everything feels the same and my vision does not return to normal from the red world I'm in.

entries.japanese:
――――――頭上には紅の月。
　いつかのユメを思い出す。
　ジャの如く殺人鬼を見つめていた月。
　あの時でさえ美しかった銀色の月なのに、どうして。
　今夜に限って、平等にこの身を照らし上げてはくれないのか。
―――――蛇の如く。
　爛れた赤い瞳のように、いつまでも俺を見つめる。
　じっと。
熱心に見下ろしてくる赤い瞳。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Overhead hangs a crimson moon.
I remember an old dream.
The moon watching a killer like a SNAKE.
Even then, it was a beautiful silver moon, so why.
Why, on this night alone, will it not shine on me with the same impartial light?
―――――Like a serpent.
It watches me endlessly, a raw and festering red eye.
Motionless and intent. That red eye gazes down.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Above my head is the crimson moon.
I remember that one dream.
That moon looking down at that killer.
Even at that time, it was a beautiful moon, so why?
Why can't it evenly illuminate me tonight?
-----Like a snake.
Like an inflamed red eye, it stares at me.
Staring.
The red eye looks down on me intently.

entries.japanese:
赤い。
赤い赤い赤い瞳。
「……は……はは……なる、ほど――――」
　それで思い至った。
　アキハが最期に見たモノは壁なんかじゃなく。
　自分の首を切断しようとする、機械じみた七夜志貴だったのだと。
「……そっか。
それじゃたしかに――――消えない、な」
　ならば、月はずっと赤いままか。
　アキハの眼球には殺人鬼が焼き付いている。
　それを書きかえる事は不可能だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Red. Red, red, red eyes.
“Hah, haha, I see――――”
And then I understand.
The last thing AKIHA saw was not the wall.
It was Shiki Nanaya, mechanical and inhuman, about to sever her head.
“Right. Then of course――――it won’t fade.”
So the moon will remain red forever.
The killer is burned into AKIHA’s eyes.
Nothing can overwrite him.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Red.
Red, red, red eye.
"…… Ha…… haha…… I understand it now----"
That made it all clear.
What Akiha was looking at in her last moments wasn't the wall.
She was looking at Nanaya Shiki as he approached to mechanically slice her neck.
"…… I see.
Then----it won't go away, will it."
Then, the moon will always be red.
In her eyes, the killer is still burning.
That can't be erased.

entries.japanese:
全てが終わったっていうのに、こんなにも行き場がないのもそのせいか。
　琥珀さんを失って、俺は秋葉さえ殺めてしまった。
　行き場なんて何処にもない。
　やるべき事も、自分さえ消え去った。
　それでも一本だけの足はずるずると廊下を歩いて行く。
――――仰ぐ天上には、巨大な眼光。
　七夜志貴はアキハに見つめられながら、何処かに向けて歩き出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
Perhaps that is why, though everything is over, I have nowhere to go.
I lost Kohaku, then murdered even Akiha.
There is nowhere left for me.
My purpose has vanished, and so have I.
Still, my single remaining leg drags me onward down the corridor.
――――Above me, a vast and glaring eye.
Watched by AKIHA, Shiki Nanaya sets off for some unknown destination.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's why even though everything is over, I have nowhere to go.
I lost Kohaku-san, I even killed Akiha.
There really is nowhere I can go.
All purpose, even my self, has disappeared.
Despite that, my only leg limps down the hallway.
----The sky overhead still has that giant eye.
With Akiha still watching him, Nanaya Shiki walks off to somewhere.

entries.japanese:
―――結果を出すにはまだ早い。
　確実に殺すには、敵をハダカにする必要がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――It is still too early to settle the outcome.
To make the kill certain, I first need to strip the enemy bare.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---It's too early.
To absolutely ensure my kill, the enemy needs to be defenseless.

entries.japanese:
「間違えたわね兄さん。
今のが私を仕留める最後のチャンスだったのに」
　敵の足が止まる。
　自信に満ちた視線と呼吸のリズム。
「――――――――」
　つまり、この距離が闇夜における遠野秋葉の最大射程という事だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You made the wrong choice, Brother. That was your last chance to finish me.”
The enemy stops.
Her gaze is confident, her breathing steady.
“――――――――”
So this distance marks Akiha Tohno’s maximum range in the darkness.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You made a mistake, Nii-san.
That was your last chance to kill me."
The enemy stops.
Her breathing and stare are full of confidence.
"--------"
That means, this distance right now is her maximum range in this dark hallway.

entries.japanese:
「さっきの兄さんの速さなら、もしかしたらこんな狭い廊下でも見失っていたかもしれない。
　でも、この距離ならもう有り得ない。
だって、兄さんの瞳の色が見えるぐらい、貴方の姿を確かめられるんですから」
「―――――――――」
　こっちが走りだした所で、秋葉に近づく前に始末できるという事か。
　だが―――それは、あくまでこちらが接近した場合の話だろうに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“At the speed you moved before, I might have lost you even in this narrow corridor.
But from here, that is impossible. I can see you clearly enough to tell the color of your eyes.”
“―――――――”
So if I charge, she can finish me before I reach her.
But―――that applies only if I approach her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You were so quick earlier.
I thought I would still lose sight of you even in this narrow hallway with your speed.
But, that won't happen with this distance.
I am close enough to see the color of your eyes, so I can easily track you."
"---------"
No matter how fast I dash, she is saying she will kill me before I get close.
But---that's only if I dash toward her.

entries.japanese:
「……………」
　秋葉の目が細まる。
　すでに命を握った相手が、未だ冷静な事が気に食わないのか。
……それとも、たったそれだけの事で躊躇したのか。
　どちらにしても―――シキの思っていた通り、アレはまだ殺し合いというものを解っていない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Akiha’s eyes narrow.
Is she annoyed that the life already in her hands remains calm? Or has that alone made her hesitate?
Either way, just as SHIKI thought, she still understands nothing about a fight to the death.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………"
She narrows her eyes.
Is she bothered by the fact that she has my life in the palm of her hand, or that I am so calm?
…… Or, does that cause her to hesitate?
Whichever one it is---just like SHIKI thought, she really doesn't understand what a battle to the death means.

entries.japanese:
「―――なにか企んでいるみたいね、兄さん」
　当然の事を訊く。
　答える義務はない。
「――――――――馬鹿か、あいつは」
　呟いてナイフを持つ手を変えた。
　利き腕で持っていたナイフを、左手に移し替える。
　秋葉の間合いはこれで掴んだ。
　あとは―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You’re planning something, aren’t you, Brother?”
She asks the obvious.
I have no obligation to answer.
“――――――――Is she an idiot?”
I mutter, changing knife hands.
I transfer it from my dominant right hand to my left.
I know Akiha’s range now.
All that remains―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---You look like you're planning something, Nii-san."
She says the obvious.
There's no need to answer.
"--------Is she stupid?"
I mutter and switch my knife to the other hand.
I take it from my dominant hand and place it in my left.
I have figured out her range.
All that's left---

entries.japanese:
「―――無様だな。
今になって何を怖がっているんだ、おまえ」
「わ――――私は怖がってなんかない……！
　なによ、そこで震えて動けないのは兄さんのほうじゃないっ！」
「……いいけど。
おまえ、俺を殺せるんだろう？
　ならさっさと始めたほうがいい。
このまま何もしないのなら、次におまえが瞬きをした間に殺すよ。
　―――いいかげん、おまえの顔にも見飽きたところだ」
「―――――――――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Pathetic. What are you frightened of now?”
“I――――I’m not frightened…! You’re the one standing there trembling, too scared to move!”
“Fine. You can kill me, can’t you? Then hurry and begin. If you keep doing nothing, I’ll kill you the next time you blink.
―――I am already tired of looking at your face.”
“―――――――――!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Ridiculous.
You're getting scared now."
"I-----I'm not scared……!
You're the one being scared and not able to move!"
"…… Okay.
You can kill me, right?
Then you should do so.
If you do nothing, I'll kill you the next time you blink.
---I'm about sick and tired of seeing your face."
"---------!"

entries.japanese:
秋葉の周囲がゆらぐ。
　ざあ、と。
秋葉の殺意が、赤い髪を具現化させる。
　秋葉の凝視と、周囲の空気が赤い髪になって両腕に絡み付いてくるのは、ほぼ同時だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
The air around Akiha shimmers.
With a rush. Her killing intent takes shape as red hair.
Akiha fixes me with her stare, and almost simultaneously the surrounding air becomes red hair and coils around both my arms.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The air around her swirls.
Her desire to kill starts to embody itself in her red hair.
Her gaze, and the surrounding air that turns crimson and tries to wrap around my arms at the same time.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　後ろに跳ぶ。
　何よりも優先して、利き腕に絡みついた髪の束を、絡みつくより速く切断した。
「くっ――――――！」
　短い秋葉の声。
　すぐさま自由になった利き腕にナイフを移す。
　左腕に絡まった髪を切る。
……こちらを自由にするのに一息ほどかかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I spring backward.
Before anything else, I sever the hair winding around my dominant arm faster than it can finish binding me.
“Damn――――――!”
Akiha’s short cry.
I immediately return the knife to my freed right hand.
I cut the hair from my left arm. Freeing it costs me a full breath.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I leap back.
More than anything, I slice the red hair coming to wrap my dominant hand.
"Ah-------!"
Akiha's clipped voice.
I then switch the knife to my freed dominant hand.
I slice the hair around my left arm…… It took a bit to free myself on this hand.

entries.japanese:
「チィ―――――」
　左腕の感覚が絶無だ。
　腕そのものに外傷は見られないが、反応、感覚、ともにない。
「なるほど――――そういう絡操りか」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Tch―――――”
My left arm is utterly numb.
There is no visible injury, but neither response nor sensation remains.
“I see――――so that is how the binding takes control.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Feh-----"
I can't feel my left arm.
I can't see any wounds, but there isn't any sense or feeling.
"I see now----that's what it does."

entries.japanese:
さらに後ろに跳ぶ。
―――赤い髪は追ってくる。
　さきほどの即効性はないが、ぴたりとこちらの四肢に絡みついてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
I spring farther back.
―――The red hair follows.
It no longer acts with the same instant force, but it clings unerringly to my limbs.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I jump back even more.
---The red hair chases me.
It isn't as quick as before, but still wraps around my limbs.

entries.japanese:
……いや、追ってくる、という表現は正確ではあるまい。
　この赤い髪から逃れる事はできない。
　秋葉に見られる、という事ですでに絡みついているモノだ。
かわすとか避けるとか、そういった行為をイメージするのは間違っている。
　有れば有るのだし、無ければ無いだけの話。
　肌に触れている空気のように、赤い髪はすでにこちらに絡みついている。
entries.maoEnglish:
To say it follows is inaccurate.
There is no escaping this red hair.
The instant Akiha sees me, it is already entwined around me. To imagine dodging or evading it is a mistake.
If it is there, it is there; if it is not, it is not.
Like the air against my skin, the red hair is already wrapped around me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… No, chasing isn't the right word to use.
There is no way to escape this red hair.
When she sees me, it is already wrapped around me.
It is wrong to imagine dodging it or avoiding it.
If it's there, it's there.
If it's not, it's not.
Like the air touching my skin, the red hair is already wrapped around me.

entries.japanese:
故に、あの攻撃から逃れる事はできない。
　出来る事があるとすれば、それは―――秋葉がこちらから何かを奪う前に、そのパイプライン……赤い髪を切断するしかない。
　秋葉が直接対象の姿を見ている時は、奪うという行為そのものは一瞬だろう。
　だが対象が視界に不鮮明な場合、奪う行為に若干のタイムラグが存在する。
その間、何かを決定的に奪われる前に、なんとか赤い髪を切って致命傷を避けている。
entries.maoEnglish:
Therefore the attack cannot be escaped.
My only option is―――to sever its conduit, the red hair, before Akiha can take anything from me.
When she sees her target clearly, the act of taking must be instantaneous.
When her view is indistinct, however, there is a slight delay. During that interval, I cut the hair before anything vital can be stolen and thus avoid a mortal wound.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Therefore, there was no way to escape from that attack.
If there is anything I can do, it is---before Akiha steals something from me, I have to cut that pipeline…… that red hair of hers.
The interval between her seeing something and stealing from it is only an instant.
But if the target isn't clear in her vision, there is a small time before she actually steals from me.
Before she can steal too much from me, I cut the hair to avoid a fatal wound.

entries.japanese:
こちらがしているのは、ただそれだけの事だ。
　いくら秋葉にさえ見えていない“赤い髪”というイメージの延長を視認できた所で、アレが圧倒的な能力であるという事に変化はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
That is all I am doing.
Even if I can see the extension of that image of red hair, invisible even to Akiha herself, her ability remains overwhelmingly powerful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
That's all I'm doing.
Even though I can see her image of "red hair", it doesn't make a difference that her ability is overpowering.

entries.japanese:
―――余裕のつもりか、秋葉は走ろうとせず早足で追ってくる。
「――――――――」
　手や足、胴体に絡まる髪を絶え間なく切断する。
　試しのために犠牲にした左腕はまったく動かない。
　痛みもない。
出血もない。
だが、服の上からでも肉が一回り、火傷によってごっそりと無くなっているのが分かる。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Perhaps to display her confidence, Akiha refuses to run and pursues me at a brisk walk.
“――――――――”
I ceaselessly cut the hair from my hands, legs, and torso.
The left arm I sacrificed for the experiment will not move at all.
There is no pain. There is no blood. Yet even through my clothes I can tell the burn has stripped away an entire layer of flesh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Maybe she's taking it easy, but she follows me without running.
"--------"
I cut the hair that comes to bind my arms, legs and body continuously.
The left arm that I sacrificed to confirm her power doesn't move at all.
There's no pain.
There's no blood.
But despite my clothes, I can tell that a big part of the flesh is taken away by burn wounds.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――チ」
　なにが不快かというと、剥き出しになった肉の側面から、吐き気がするぐらいの冷気が体内に侵入してくる事だ。
　おかげで逃げる事に完全に意識を集中できない。
　秋葉を見据えたまま後ろに引く足取りは段々と遅くなっていって、やがて、止まってしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――Tch”
Worst of all, nauseating cold seeps into my body through the exposed flesh.
It keeps me from devoting myself entirely to escape.
Still facing Akiha, I retreat more and more slowly until at last my feet stop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------Tch."
What's making me uneasy is that the open flesh sends sickening cold air into me.
Thanks to that, I can't concentrate fully on escaping.
My efforts to escape Akiha's gaze gradually become slower and I soon stop.

entries.japanese:
―――そうして、秋葉の間合いになった。
「――――ふん。
なによ、結局逃げ回る事しかできないんじゃない。
焼かれるだけの獲物のくせに、よくも言ってくれたものね」
　追い詰めた、という確信があるのだろう。
　秋葉は足を止めてこちらを睨む。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――And so I enter Akiha’s range.
“――――Hmph. In the end, running away is all you can do. Bold words from prey fit only to burn.”
She must be certain she has cornered me.
Akiha stops and glares at me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---And, it now becomes Akiha's range.
"----Oh, what's this?
All you can do is run away?
I told you, my prey will only end up burning."
She must be confident that I've been driven into a corner.
She stops walking and glares at me.

entries.japanese:
「これで終わりよ、兄さん。
楽しみでしょう？
　これから貴方は、遺さず零さず私に嬲り殺されるんだから―――！」
――――だから。
　そんな口を利くのが余分な事だっていうんだ、秋葉。
entries.maoEnglish:
“This is the end, Brother. Aren’t you excited? I’m going to torment you to death, not a morsel left and not a drop wasted―――!”
――――That is exactly what I mean, Akiha.
Opening your mouth was a needless indulgence.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's over, Nii-san.
Isn't it going to be fun?
You're going to be killed by me without leaving a trace---!"
----I told you.
Talking like that is a useless excess, Akiha.

entries.japanese:
――――――だん、と。
　一息で階段まで跳んで、そのまま、足場を使わずに階下に落ちた。
「うそ―――！？」
　……上から秋葉の声が聞こえてくる。
　今まで直線的に後ろにばかり跳んでいた為、秋葉は突然の真横への移動に反応できなかったのだろう。
　……まあ、こちらもじき階段に辿りつく、という事を考慮にいれて秋葉を誘ったのだから偶然というワケでもない。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Bang.
In a single bound I reach the stairs, then drop to the floor below without touching a step.
“Impossible―――!?”
Akiha’s voice comes from above.
Because I had done nothing but retreat in a straight line, she could not react when I suddenly moved sideways.
Of course, I lured her while keeping the approaching stairs in mind, so it was hardly an accident.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------Crash.
I jump back to the stairs, and jump down them without using the steps.
"What---!?"
…… I hear her voice coming from above.
I was only jumping straight back this whole time, so she could not react to me moving sideways.
…… Well, I planned to reach the stairs while moving back, so it's no coincidence.

entries.japanese:
「こ、の…………！
　さっきからちょこまかと………！」
　秋葉は階段から身を乗り出して下の階に落ちた俺を見つけようとする。
「―――――さて」
　その前に、さらに下の階へ跳び降りた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why, you…! Skittering around like that…!”
Akiha leans over the stairwell to find me on the floor below.
“―――――Now then.”
Before she can, I drop down another story.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why you…………!
Stand still………!"
Akiha looks down the stairs to try to see me.
"-----Now,"
Before she can do that, I jump down one more time.

entries.japanese:
「っ………」
　二回も一気に下の階まで落ちると、膝が悲鳴をあげる。
　それを無視して廊下へと急ぐ。
　カンカン、という階段を駆け下りてくる秋葉の足音も聞こえてくる。
「――――――窓」
　ここは二階だ。
ここからなら窓から地上に飛び降りる事ぐらいはできる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ngh…”
Dropping two floors in quick succession makes my knees scream.
I ignore them and hurry into the corridor.
Behind me comes the clang of Akiha racing down the stairs.
“――――――A window”
This is the second floor. I can still jump from here to the ground.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Gg………"
Flying down the stairs a second time causes my knees to protest in agony.
I ignore it and run to the hallway.
I hear the dry sound of Akiha's footsteps rushing down the stairs.
"------Window."
This is the second floor.
I can jump down outside and still be okay.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　だが、それではシキの二の舞だ。
　ここまであの夢とほぼ同じ状況を再現しているんだから、細部にいたるまでシキを真似る事はない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
But that would only repeat SHIKI’s mistake.
I have already recreated nearly every circumstance of that dream; there is no need to imitate him down to the smallest detail.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
But then, I'll end up like SHIKI.
I have repeated what happened in that dream this much, so I shouldn't have to copy what SHIKI did to every detail.

entries.japanese:
廊下に出る。
　二階の廊下にも、赤い髪があらゆる所に敷かれている。
……まるで動脈か何かのようだ。
「―――――！？」
　足の感覚が消えて、床に倒れこんだ。
「しまっ―――――」
　左足に髪が絡みついている。
―――階段を降りる時に足だけ見られたのか。
　今は秋葉の視界外にいる分、即死という痛みではないが――――
entries.maoEnglish:
I enter the corridor.
Red hair lies spread across the entire second floor. It looks like some vast network of arteries.
“―――――!?”
Sensation vanishes from my leg and I collapse.
“Damn―――――”
Hair is wound around my left ankle.
―――Did she glimpse only my foot as I descended the stairs?
I am outside her sight now, so the pain is not instantly fatal, but――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
I enter the hallway.
Even on the second floor the red hair fills the air…… They're like live blood vessels.
"-----!?"
The feeling in my leg disappears and I collapse to the ground.
"Cra-----"
My left leg is wrapped in hair.
---Did she see my leg as I went down the stairs?
I'm outside her visual range, so this won't be fatal, but----

entries.japanese:
「くそ……予想よりやらしいじゃないか、アイツ」
　髪を切断する。
　左足は―――左腕とほぼ同じ状態になってしまった。
「――――――」
　足音が近づいてくる。
　秋葉が廊下に下りてくる前に、教室に跳び込んだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn, she’s nastier than I expected.”
I sever the hair.
My left leg is now―――in almost the same condition as my left arm.
“――――――”
The footsteps draw closer.
Before Akiha reaches the corridor, I throw myself into a classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shit…… she's more wicked than I thought."
I cut the hair.
My left leg---It's now just like my left arm.
"------"
The sound of footsteps comes closer.
Before she enters the hallway, I dash into a classroom.

entries.japanese:
「――――――、―――――――、――――」
　息を殺して、廊下に面した壁にもたれかかる。
　……なんて事だ。
　これで半身はほぼ死に体。
　自分で解っていながら、あの夢をここまで再現するとは思わなかった。
　……かつん、かつん、かつん、かつん。
　足音が近づいてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――, ―――――――, ――――”
Holding my breath, I lean against the wall facing the corridor.
This is bad.
Half my body is already nearly dead.
Even knowing what I was doing, I never expected to reproduce the dream this faithfully.
Click, click, click, click.
The footsteps approach.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------,-------,----"
Holding my breath, I lean against the wall between us.
…… I don't believe it.
Half of my body might as well be dead.
I was aware of it, but I didn't think I'd end up copying that dream this much.
…… Tap, tap, tap.
The footsteps draw nearer and nearer.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　夢の中では、確かこの後にシキは殺されていた。
　……シキの判断は間違ってはいなかった。
ただ、ヤツは秋葉という敵の能力を正確に把握していなかっただけの話。
　焦げた大気の匂い。
　真夏じみた灼熱の気温。
　そうして、燃えるような熱さをともなって消滅させられる体。
　その事実で、シキは秋葉が敵を“発火”させているのだと思いこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
In the dream, SHIKI was killed after this.
SHIKI’s judgment was not wrong. He merely failed to understand Akiha’s power.
The smell of scorched air.
Heat like midsummer.
A body vanishing amid burning agony.
From those facts, SHIKI assumed Akiha was setting her enemies alight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
In my dream, SHIKI was killed right after this.
…… SHIKI's decision wasn't incorrect.
He just didn't have a full understanding of Akiha's ability.
The burnt smell of the air.
The temperature's scorching resemblance of deep summer.
And the body parts that disintegrate with burning pain.
All of these facts made SHIKI think that Akiha's power was 'burning' the enemy.

entries.japanese:
だが実際はその逆だ。
　秋葉は赤い髪に絡みつかせた対象から“熱”を奪い、一瞬にして凍結、気化し、結果として消滅したように見えるだけだ。
　発火ならば、一度火をつけられてしまえばこちらはどうしようもない。
いくら赤い髪を切った所で、発火した自分の体を切断する訳にはいかない。
entries.maoEnglish:
But the truth is the opposite.
Akiha steals heat from whatever her red hair binds, freezing and vaporizing it in an instant so that it only appears to vanish.
If it were ignition, there would be nothing I could do once I caught fire. Cutting the hair would not help; I could hardly cut my own burning body apart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But the truth is just the opposite.
Akiha entangles her target with her red hair and completely steals their "heat".
This causes instant freezing followed by vaporization, making it look like it disintegrated.
If it truly was burning, then matters would be hopeless once the flame was lit.
No matter how many times the red hair is sliced, it's not possible to cut off your own body.

entries.japanese:
だが―――アレは吸収しているだけの略奪だ。
　故に、もしこの全身を赤い髪に包まれたとしても、奪い尽くされる前に髪を切断し、秋葉本体を仕留めてしまえば問題はない。
　秋葉は秋葉本人が生きている間は対象を炎焼させる。
だがその炎は秋葉が死んでしまえば消え去る幻だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
But―――this is merely plunder through absorption.
Even if the red hair envelops my entire body, I need only cut it before I am drained dry and kill Akiha herself.
While Akiha lives, her target seems to burn. Once she dies, those flames vanish like an illusion.
entries.mirrorMoon:
But---that is just stealing and taking in.
Therefore, even if I get completely wrapped by the red hair, as long as I can cut off the hair before I am completely drained and kill Akiha herself, then there's no problem.
While she lives, she can turn her target into an inferno.
But that illusion of fire will die when Akiha dies.

entries.japanese: ……かつん、かつん、かつん、かつん。
entries.maoEnglish: Click, click, click, click.
entries.mirrorMoon: …… Tap, tap, tap, tap.

entries.japanese:
「――――――」
　もともと、左腕は燃やされる事を覚悟して差し出したものだった。
左腕が燃えたあと、肩から腕を切る準備までしたが、その必要はなかった。
　秋葉の能力は、本体さえ停止させればこちらが死ぬような事はない。
　秋葉の正体が真の火炎使いでない以上、相打ち狙いの奇襲は、相手の絶命がこちらより早ければ相打ちにはなりえない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
I offered my left arm knowing it would burn. I had even prepared to cut it off at the shoulder afterward, but that proved unnecessary.
As long as I stop Akiha herself, her power cannot kill me.
Since she is no true wielder of flame, an ambush meant to kill us both ceases to be mutual destruction if she dies first.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------"
I was already prepared to have my left arm burned when I stuck it out.
I was prepared to cut it off from my shoulder once it lit up, but there was no need for that.
Akiha's ability will not kill me if I can stop Akiha herself.
Since Akiha is not a true flame user, a surprise attack cannot end up in mutual death if she dies before me.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　かつん、と。
　秋葉の足音が、背中ごしに聞こえた。
　間違いなく―――秋葉はこちらに気がつかず、この教室を通り過ぎようとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
Click.
I hear Akiha’s footstep through the wall at my back.
There is no mistake―――she has not noticed me and is about to pass the classroom.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
I hear a sound.
I hear her footstep right behind my back.
Without a doubt---Akiha is about to pass the classroom without even noticing I am here.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　足音が通りすぎていく。
――――チャンスは一度だけだ。
　秋葉がこの教室を通りすぎた瞬間、廊下に出て秋葉に踏み込む。
　その距離が遠ければ、俺はシキと同じように秋葉に殺される。
「――――――――――」
　足音が遠ざかっていく。
　……距離にしてあと二メートル。
秋葉の歩幅なら八歩という所か。
「…………………よし」
　足音を立てず、気配を殺して扉に手をかける。
　かつん、かつん、という硬い足音が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――”
The footsteps pass.
――――I have only one chance.
The instant Akiha passes this classroom, I must enter the corridor and close on her.
If the distance is too great, she will kill me as she killed SHIKI.
“――――――――――”
The footsteps recede.
Another two meters. At Akiha’s stride, about eight steps.
“Now.”
Silently, suppressing every trace of my presence, I put my hand on the door.
Clack, clack, go her hard-soled footsteps.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
The footsteps pass by.
----I only have one chance.
The instant she passes by the classroom, I'll jump out into the hallway and attack her.
If the distance is too great, I'll be killed just like SHIKI.
"----------"
The footsteps keep moving.
…… About a distance of two meters.
At her stride, that should be about eight steps.
"……………… Okay."
I sneak silently over and place my hand on the door.
Tap, tap.
The hard sound of her footsteps come closer.

entries.japanese:
一回。
　　　二回。
　　　　　三回。
　　　　　　　四回。
　　　　　　　　　五回。
　　　　　　　　　　　六回。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　七回。
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　八回……！
entries.maoEnglish:
One.
    Two.
        Three.
            Four.
                Five.
                    Six.
                        Seven.
                            Eight…!
entries.mirrorMoon:
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five.
Six.
Seven.
Eight……!

entries.japanese:
足音は、そこで止まった。
　秋葉はまだ教室を通りすぎていない。
　ちょうどこのドア一枚を挟んで廊下で立ち尽くしている。
「な―――――――――」
　時間が止まる。
　どくん、と頭の中が苦しく歪む。
「――――――――――」
　気づかれた。
気づかれたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
The footsteps stop.
Akiha has not passed the classroom.
She stands in the corridor with only this door between us.
“N―――――――――”
Time stops.
A painful throb twists the inside of my skull.
“――――――――――”
She noticed me. Did she notice me?
entries.mirrorMoon:
The footsteps stop there.
She hasn't passed the classroom yet.
She just stands on the other side of the door.
"Wha-------"
Time stops.
Thump.
The inside of my head torques painfully.
"----------"
Does she know?
Does she know?

entries.japanese:
ならばどうする？
　このドアを開けないかぎり、秋葉は教室に入ってこれない。
　秋葉が俺を見るためには教室に入ってくる必要がある。
　なら―――このドアを閉めているかぎり、秋葉は俺を殺せない。
entries.maoEnglish:
What now?
Unless this door opens, Akiha cannot enter the classroom.
To see me, she must come inside.
Then―――as long as the door stays closed, Akiha cannot kill me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Then what should I do?
She cannot come in the classroom unless she opens the door.
She needs to come in the classroom in order to see me.
So---as long as this door is closed, she can't kill me.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　……それなら別にかまわない。
　秋葉がドアを開けようとするのなら、それでいい。
ドアを開いて秋葉が俺の姿を“見る”のと、俺が秋葉を“切る”のと、どちらが速いかの勝負になるだけだ。
「―――――――――はあ」
　深く呼吸をする。
　それでも俺が不利なのは変わらない。
　秋葉は見るだけでいい。
　だが俺は秋葉の体の“線”を見て、そこにナイフを走らせなければならない。
　動作が一つ多い分、俺の間合いだからって有利とはかぎらな――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――”
That is no problem.
If Akiha means to open the door, let her. Then it becomes a simple contest: whether she can open it and “see” me before I can “cut” her.
“―――――――――Haaah”
I take a deep breath.
Even so, the disadvantage remains mine.
Akiha need only look.
But I must see the “line” on her body and drive my knife along it.
I have one more action to perform, so being within my range is no guarantee of an advantage――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
…… Then I don't care.
If she tries to open the door, then that's fine.
It'll just be a battle between what is faster: my "slicing" or her "looking".
Calm.
I take a deep breath.
But it still doesn't change the fact that I'm at a disadvantage.
All Akiha needs to do is look.
But I have to see the "lines" on her body and then slice them with my knife.
Since I have to make an extra movement, even though this is my range, I can't say it's my advanta----

entries.japanese:
「―――――――え？」
　不意に。
　窓のほうから、物音がした。
「なっ――――――」
　思考が停止する。
　手足の感覚が一瞬で焼失する。
　重いだけの体はひょい、と軽々しく持ち上げられ、乱暴に壁に叩き付けられた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――What?”
Without warning.
A sound comes from the window.
“N――――――”
Thought stops.
All feeling burns out of my limbs in an instant.
My deadweight body is hoisted effortlessly into the air, then slammed against the wall.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------Eh?"
All of a sudden,
A crash comes from the window.
"Wha-----"
My brain freezes.
I instantly lose all feeling in my arms and legs.
My heavy body rises up and is slammed against the wall.

entries.japanese:
「はっ――――ぁ――――！」
　視界は、そこで終わった。
　眼球の水分が一瞬にして蒸発して、何も見えなくなる。
　外界の事は一切解らない。
　解るのは自分のコトだけ。
　俺は宙に浮いて、さっきの琥珀さんのように、秋葉の髪に縛られ、壁に磔にされて、いる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah――――!”
My vision ends there.
The moisture in my eyes evaporates in an instant, and I can see nothing.
I know nothing at all of the world outside.
Only myself.
I hang in the air, bound in Akiha’s hair and crucified against the wall, just as Kohaku was moments ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ha----ah----!"
My field of view cuts off.
The water in my eyes evaporates instantly and I can't see anything.
I don't know anything about what is going on in the outside world.
All I can understand is what I'm doing.
I'm suspended in mid-air, and just like Kohaku-san earlier, I'm crucified to the wall by Akiha's hair.

entries.japanese:
「油断したわね。
生粋の暗殺者である兄さんに比べれば子供騙しだけど、私だって気配ぐらい殺せるんだから。
　ま、そうゆうワケで兄さんが廊下にご熱心な間、隣の教室からお邪魔させていただきました。
これに懲りたら次はベランダにも注意するコトですね」
　クスクスという笑い声。
「ぁ―――――――――ぐ」
　喉が締め上げられていく。
　手足は切断されたように感覚がなく、体という体が、秋葉の髪に、飲まれていく。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You let your guard down. It was a childish trick compared with a born assassin like you, but even I can hide my presence.
While you were so absorbed in the corridor, I slipped in from the neighboring classroom. Let this teach you to watch the balcony next time.”
She giggles.
“Ah―――――――――ngh”
My throat tightens.
My limbs feel severed, and every part of my body is swallowed into Akiha’s hair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"How careless.
It's nothing compared to a natural-born assassin like you, Nii-san, but I can still hide my presence.
Well, that's what I did and while you were paying so much attention to the hallway, I came by from the next classroom.
Next time, you should learn from experience and pay attention to the balcony, too."
She giggles.
"Ah--------gg!"
My neck is being constricted.

My limbs have no feeling, as if they were cut off.
My body is being saturated with Akiha's hair.

entries.japanese:
「あ、今のは失言でした。
注意するも何も、兄さんには次なんて無いんですもの。
　それよりごめんなさい兄さん。
私ったらはしたなく、いきなり口にしてしまって。
　勢いでほとんど食べてしまったけど、まだ意識は残っているでしょう？
　ちゃんとやり直しますから、それで無作法は許してくださいね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, that was careless of me. There can be no next time for you.
More importantly, forgive me, Brother. How shameful of me to help myself without warning.
I consumed nearly all of you in my excitement, but you are still conscious, aren’t you? I will begin again properly, so please pardon my bad manners.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, that was rude.
There is no 'next time' for you, Nii-san.
Besides, I'm sorry, Nii-san.
I rudely ate you instantly.
Even though I consumed most of you in the heat of the moment, you are still conscious, right?
Please forgive my lack of manners since I'll do this right this time."

entries.japanese:
――――さて、それじゃあいただきます。
　　　　　さよなら、兄さん。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Well then—thank you for the meal.
Goodbye, Brother.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Well then, I will have you.
Farewell, Nii-san.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　全身を焼く灼熱。
　肉体ばかりか魂まで焼失させる、赤い檻髪。
　どくん、と最後の鼓動が聞こえた。
　……なんて、無様。
　あれほど判っていたというのに、七夜志貴は遠野シキと同じ結末を迎えてしまった、なんて。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――”
Scorching heat consumes my entire body.
The red Hair Cage burns away not only flesh but soul.
I hear my heart give its final beat.
How pathetic.
Though he understood so much, Shiki Nanaya met the same end as SHIKI Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
My body burns.
The Red Lock of Hair sears both my body and my very soul.
Thump.
I can hear my last heartbeat.
…… How, stupid.
Even though I knew so much, Nanaya Shiki has still ended up the same as Tohno SHIKI.

entries.japanese:
お待たせしましたー！
　知得留先生のなぜなにコーナー。
　好評につき、補習授業（そのいち）です！
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for waiting!
It’s Ciel’s question-and-answer corner.
Back by popular demand: remedial lesson number one!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thanks for waiting!
Time for Ciel-sensei's What & Why corner.
Due to popular demand, here is a supplementary lesson (number one)!

entries.japanese:
あーあ、遠野くんったら本気出しちゃって。
　だめですよ、いくら秋葉さんが無敵モードに入ったからって遠野くんまでその気になっちゃ。
　事殺し合いに関しては遠野くんの方が何枚も上手なんです。
　ここは余裕をもって、秋葉さんの様子を見てあげるべきでしょう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Oh dear, Tohno went and got serious.
You mustn’t let yourself get serious merely because Akiha entered invincible mode.
When it comes to killing each other, Tohno is in an entirely different league.
You should have remained calm and watched to see what Akiha did.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh my, Tohno-kun has gotten really serious.
That's a no-no.
Even though Akiha-san has turned on her invincible mode, you shouldn't try to kill her.
When it comes to killing, you are by far the expert.
You have some leeway, so you should just observe Akiha-san for now.

entries.japanese:
それでは今回はここまで。
　月姫もすでにラストスパートです。
このまま次の補習を受ける事なく頑張ってくださいねー。
entries.maoEnglish:
That’s all for today.
TSUKIHIME is already in its final stretch. Do your best to reach the end without needing the next remedial lesson.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Well, we'll end this lesson now.
The conclusion of Tsukihime is near.
Do your best so you don't have to receive any more supplementary lessons.

entries.japanese:
お待たせしましたー！
　知得留先生のなぜなにコーナー。
　好評につき、補習授業（そのに）です！
entries.maoEnglish:
Thank you for waiting!
It’s Ciel’s question-and-answer corner.
Back by popular demand: remedial lesson number two!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Thanks for waiting!
Time for Ciel-sensei's What & Why corner.
Due to popular demand, here is a supplementary lesson (number two)!

entries.japanese:
……うわあ、秋葉さんったらほとんど妖怪ですねー。
　よっぽど長い間遠野くんに鬱積していた物があったのか、なかなかのはっちゃけぶりです。
「そんなコトないアル。
あんなの全然たいしたコトないアル」
entries.maoEnglish:
Goodness, Akiha is practically a monster.
She must have spent a very long time accumulating resentment toward Tohno, because she has certainly let herself go wild.
“Not true. That was nothing special at all, I tell you.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Oh my, Akiha-san is like a monster.
Maybe she had something pent up all this time against Tohno-kun, but she has gone pretty crazy.
"I don't think so.
That's nothing."

entries.japanese:
はいはい、人間じゃない人には初めから聞いてません。
　一ミクロンも出番のないヒロインは黙っていてください。
「……うにゃ、最後までこんな調子だったアルよー、ラーメン食うあるかー」
entries.maoEnglish:
Yes, yes, no one asked the opinion of a nonhuman.
The heroine who hasn’t appeared by so much as a micron may remain silent.
“Meow—so this is how it ends, I tell you—want some ramen?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, yeah, I don't recall ever asking a nonhuman like you anything.
Heroines that don't even appear should just be quiet.
"…… Unyaa!
I was treated like this until the very end.
Do you want to eat Ramen?"

entries.japanese:
――――さて。
　今回の原因は遠野くんの油断です。
　その方法ではダメなんだって、以前シキ君が示していたのに繰り返してしまいましたね？
　再提出にしますから、一個前に戻ってやり直してください。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Now, then.
This time, Tohno’s carelessness was to blame.
SHIKI had already demonstrated that this method would fail, yet you repeated it anyway.
I’m marking this for resubmission, so return to the previous choice and try again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----Well then.
This time, the cause was your carelessness, Tohno-kun.
SHIKI-kun showed you that method was not going to work, but you repeated it anyway, right?
I'll make this a re-submit, so please go back and try again.

entries.japanese:
――――ここを越えれば、いよいよラスト。
　この教室も今回でおしまいです。
　今までご清聴、どうもありがとうございましたー！
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Once you clear this, the finale awaits.
This is also the last session of our class.
Thank you all very much for listening!
entries.mirrorMoon:
----After this, it will finally be the end.
This will be the final lesson.
Thank you so much for listening up to now!

entries.japanese:
ここで終わりだ。
　シキの夢をなぞるつもりはない。
　遠野秋葉は、ここで完璧に解体し尽くしてやる。
entries.maoEnglish:
It ends here.
I will not follow the course of SHIKI’s dream.
Here, I will dismantle Akiha Tohno completely.
entries.mirrorMoon:
This is it.
I don't plan on ending up like SHIKI in that dream.
I will dismantle Tohno Akiha right here and now.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　壁に走る『線』を凝視する。
　……壁の向こうでは、かつん、という足音。
　もっと強く。
脳髄が焼けるほど、強く壁を直死した。
　……足音は直前にきた。
　この薄い壁の向こうには、無防備に歩いている秋葉の姿がある。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――”
I stare at the lines running through the wall.
Beyond the wall comes the clack of a footstep.
Harder. I force my eyes to see the wall’s death until my brain feels ready to burn.
The footsteps are almost upon me.
Beyond this thin wall, Akiha walks on, defenseless.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------"
I focus on the "lines" running along the wall.
…… On the other side, I can hear her footsteps.
More intently, I stare hard at the wall, as if my brain would fry.
…… The footsteps are right in front of me.
Across this thin wall, Akiha is walking, completely defenseless.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　……巧くすれば、直接手をかける必要もない。
　遠野秋葉は壁の下敷きになって死亡する。
……いや、窓際の壁は薄い。
そんな事では死ぬ事はないだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
If this works, I may not even need to touch her.
Akiha Tohno will die beneath the collapsing wall. No—the wall by the windows is thin. That alone will not kill her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
…… If I do this well, I don't even have to do it myself.
Tohno Akiha will die, being crushed by the wall.
…… No, the wall is too thin.
That won't kill her.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　なら、やはり。
　あの長い髪を切断し、彼女の肉体をバラバラにするのは自分の役目だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
Then, just as I thought.
It falls to me to sever that long hair and cut her body to pieces.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
So, then.
Cutting that long hair and dismembering her body is my role.

entries.japanese:
秋葉を。
殺す。
　もう人でなくなった秋葉は。
殺しても、いい相手。
　……………………………もう人でなくなった。
　だが、それでも。
　秋葉は、遠野志貴の、妹、なのに。
　それを。
　人でなくなっただけで、おまえは。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha. Kill her.
Akiha, no longer human. Someone I am allowed to kill.
No longer human.
But even so.
Akiha is Shiki Tohno’s little sister.
Her.
Merely because she is no longer human, you would.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Kill.
Akiha.
The no longer human Akiha.
She is someone I can kill.
…………………… She is no longer human.
But, still.
But, Akiha is, Tohno Shiki's, younger sister.
Do that.
Just because she isn't human anymore?

entries.japanese:
―――――――ズキン
「くっ――――――――あ」
　頭痛。
止まったはずの頭痛が、どうして。
―――――――ズキン　ズキン　ズキン
　頭痛。
眼球が飛び出しそうな痛み。
　……壁の線を無理に見出そうとしたせいだ。
　頭が、痛い。
　……ああ。
こんなにもイタイと、さっきまでの自分が、納まってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――Throb
“Ngh――――――――ah”
The headache. It had stopped, so why?
―――――――Throb Throb Throb
A headache. Pain fierce enough to force my eyes from their sockets.
I strained too hard to find the wall’s lines.
My head hurts.
Ah. When the pain is this intense, the thing I was until moments ago begins to subside.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-------Throb
"Kk--------ah."
Headache.
I thought the headache was gone, so why?
-------Throb Throb Throb
This headache.
The pain feels like my eyes will burst from my head.
…… It's because I tried to see the lines on the wall.
My head, it hurts.
…… Ah.
If it hurts this much, my recent self feels like it will go away.

entries.japanese:
―――――――ズキン　ズキン　ズキン　ズキン
「ぁ―――――――――――あ」
　考えるな。
　頭痛ぐらい無視しろ。
　ここで考えれば、俺はきっと―――自分の間違いに気がついてしまう。
　そうなる前に―――遠野志貴に戻る前に、秋葉を殺さなければ逆に殺されてしまう。
「―――――――――――！」
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――Throb Throb Throb Throb
“Ah―――――――――――ah”
Do not think.
Ignore the headache.
If I think now, I will surely―――realize my mistake.
Before that happens―――before I become Shiki Tohno again, I must kill Akiha or she will kill me.
“―――――――――――!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
-------Throb Throb Throb Throb
"Ah----------ah."
Don't think!
Ignore the headache.
If I think right now, I will definitely---recognize my mistake.
Before that happens---before I return to Tohno Shiki, I have to kill Akiha before she kills me.
"-----------!"

entries.japanese:
自身を殺す勢いで、ナイフを振るった。
　キィン、という乾いた音。
　たった一度だけ大きく振るったナイフは円を描いて、バターのように、壁をキレイに切り取った。
　あとは。
　廊下に向けて、切断した壁を蹴り押した。
entries.maoEnglish:
I swing the knife with enough force to kill myself.
A dry, ringing crack.
The single broad stroke traces a circle and cuts cleanly through the wall as though it were butter.
The rest is simple.
I kick the severed section out into the corridor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I swing my knife with all my strength.
A dry sound.
With one giant swing, I draw a circle in the wall with my knife that cuts cleanly through the wall like butter.
And then.
Facing the hallway, I kick down the cut wall.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――――え？」
　間の抜けた秋葉の声が聞こえる。
　……それも当然か。
　突然壁が円形に切り取られて、それがまるごと自分にむかってスライドしてきたのだ。
驚かないハズがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――――What?”
I hear Akiha’s baffled voice.
No wonder.
The wall has suddenly been cut into a circle, and the entire slab comes sliding straight toward her. How could she not be surprised?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"------------Eh?"
Akiha's voice almost sounds comical.
…… That's only natural.
Having a large circle suddenly appear in the wall and burst out against her, she should be surprised.

entries.japanese:
そして、それが終わりだった。
　壁に開いた穴から廊下に跳び出る。
　こちらの―――俺の姿は切り取られた壁が障壁となって秋葉には見えない。
entries.maoEnglish:
And that decides it.
I leap through the hole into the corridor.
The severed wall stands between her and―――me, shielding me from Akiha’s sight.
entries.mirrorMoon:
And, it's all over.
I jump through the opening in the wall and into the hallway.
Over here---my figure is completely hidden from Akiha's view by the wall.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――」
　秋葉に向かって倒れようとする壁。
　それを秋葉の赤い髪が包む。
　……無機物からでさえも熱を奪えるのか、壁は急速に結合を失っていく。
　だが。
　秋葉がそれを分解する前に、俺のナイフが解体した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
The wall topples toward Akiha.
Her red hair envelops it.
Perhaps she can steal heat even from lifeless matter, for the wall rapidly loses cohesion.
But.
Before Akiha can break it down, my knife dismantles it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------"
The collapsing wall rushes towards Akiha.
The red hair wraps around it.
…… It even steals heat from inorganic things?
The wall starts to break apart.
But.
Before she can break it down, my knife dismantles it.

entries.japanese:
バラバラと。
　大小様々な塊になった壁が落ちていく。
―――――――――――――ズキン
　それは一瞬。
　一瞬だけの、光景だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
With a clatter.
Fragments of every size rain down.
―――――――――――――Throb
It lasts only an instant.
A sight seen for a single instant.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Pieces.
The wall falls into clumps of varying size.
-------------Throb
It all happens in an instant.
This scene, it lasts for one instant.

entries.japanese:
秋葉の髪が逆立つ。
　そのまま俺の体を包み込む。
　だが―――遅い。
　秋葉の周囲の熱気ごと壁を切断した。
　新しい熱は瞬間には放出されないだろうし、たとえそうでなくとも。
　秋葉を押し倒して、馬乗りになった俺のナイフのほうが、秋葉の髪よりわずかに速かった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s hair rises on end.
It surges around my body.
But―――too late.
I severed the wall along with the heat around Akiha.
Fresh heat will not be released in an instant, and even if it is.
I knock Akiha down and straddle her; my knife is a fraction faster than her hair.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Her hair races back up.
It wraps around my body.
But---it is too late.
I slice through both the wall and the fiery aura around her.
She won't be able to instantly put out more heat, not that it matters.
Because my knife is far faster than her hair as I push her down and get on top of her.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――――――」
　秋葉の、声。
　持ち上げたナイフ。
あとは、それを秋葉の左鎖骨から右肺に走る『線』へ通すだけ。
　だが、秋葉の髪も俺の腕に絡まっている。
　首にも体にも髪は流れて、躊躇すれば次の瞬間に自分の体が気化させられると理解している。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――――”
Akiha’s voice.
My knife is raised. All that remains is to drive it along the line from her left collarbone to her right lung.
But her hair is already wound around my arm.
It streams over my neck and body, and I know that one moment’s hesitation will see me vaporized.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah-------"
Akiha's, voice.
My knife is raised.
All I have to do is pass through the "line" running from her left collarbone to her right lung.
But, Akiha's hair is wrapping around my arm.
It flows around my neck, around my body.
I know that if I wait, in an instant, my body will be vaporized.

entries.japanese:
――――――――――――――――ズキン
　でも、頭痛がする。
　頭痛がするんだ、秋葉。
　あんなに頭の中でコロセと繰り返していたのに、
　あんなにおまえが憎かったのに、
　それでも――――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――――――――――――Throb
But my head hurts.
My head hurts, Akiha.
Though KILL HER had repeated endlessly inside my skull,
though I hated you so much,
even so――――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
----------------Throb
But, this headache does not go away.
My head hurts, Akiha.
Even though the command to kill repeated itself so many times in my head,
and I hated you so much,
but still---------

entries.japanese:
……どうして。
　どうして目が醒めてしまったのか。
　どうして秋葉の姿が、一瞬でも元の秋葉に見えてしまったのか。
　それさえなければ、すぐにこのナイフを落としていたのに。
　それでも――――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Why?
Why did I come to my senses?
Why, even for an instant, did Akiha look like the Akiha she used to be?
Without that single glimpse, I would already have brought the knife down.
Even so――――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Why?
Why did I wake up?
Why did Akiha suddenly look like her old self?
If it wasn't for that, I would have brought this knife down.
But still--------

entries.japanese:
……肌が焼けている。
　体に絡みついた髪が、熱を奪っている。
　視界が薄くなる。
　秋葉を押さえつける体に力が入らない。
　ふう、と。
　秋葉に息を吹きかけられれば、それだけで倒れてしまいそうなぐらい、体が軽い。
entries.maoEnglish:
My skin is burning.
The hair around me is draining away my heat.
My sight fades.
There is no strength left in the body holding Akiha down.
One breath.
My body is so light that a single breath from Akiha would topple me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… My skin is burning.
The hair that wraps around my body steals my heat.
My vision starts to fade.
I can't force Akiha down.
With a breath.
My body is so light now that it feels like Akiha could blow me over with one breath.

entries.japanese:
だが―――まだ腕は生きている。
　まだ間に合う。
即死していないのなら、俺の勝ちだ。
秋葉さえ仕留めれば、これ以上熱を奪われる事はない。
　それでも―――――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
But―――my arm still lives.
There is still time. If I have not died instantly, I have won. Once I finish Akiha, she can steal no more heat.
Even so―――――――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
But---my arms are still alive.
I can still make it.
If I don't die, victory is mine.
As long as I can kill her now, she can't steal any more of my heat.
But still---------

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――――――っ」
　なのに、どうしても、ナイフを落とせなかった。
　なんて、甘さだろう。
　秋葉は躊躇うことなく俺を消し去る。
　そんな事、本当に解っている。
　秋葉はもう、以前の秋葉じゃないんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――――――――――”
And yet I cannot bring the knife down.
What weakness.
Akiha will erase me without hesitation.
I know that.
Akiha is no longer the girl she was.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"--------------"
But still, for some reason, I can't bring down my knife.
How incredibly naive.
Akiha will kill me without hesitation.
I already know that.
Because Akiha, she's not the Akiha from before.

entries.japanese:
――――――それでも。
　　　　　　それでも、そんな事は。
　　　　　　できる筈が、なかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――――Even so.
Even so…
I could never do it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
------But still.
But still, such a thing.
I just can't, do it.

entries.japanese:
―――――――――――――――――ズキン
　……頭痛。
　散々これには悩まされたけど、今だけは感謝しないと。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――――――――――――Throb
The headache.
It has tormented me endlessly, but for this moment alone I must be grateful.
entries.mirrorMoon:
-----------------Throb
…… Headache.
It has bothered me many times, but I have to thank it this time.

entries.japanese:
……間違えてた。
　秋葉が人間でなくなったから、秋葉は以前の秋葉じゃないから、殺していいと思うなんて、どうかしてた。
　たとえどんなに変わってしまっても、秋葉は秋葉だ。
　俺を助けてくれて、ずっと待っていてくれた、大切な、妹なんだ。
――――それを。
　どうして、傷つける事が、できるだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
I was wrong.
To think I could kill Akiha merely because she was no longer human, because she was no longer the girl she had been—that was madness.
However much she changes, Akiha is Akiha.
My precious little sister, who saved me and waited for me all these years.
――――Her.
How could I ever hurt her?
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I was wrong.
Thinking that just because she isn't human, she isn't like the old Akiha, it's acceptable to kill her.
No matter how much she changes, Akiha is Akiha.
Always helping me, always waiting for me, my dear sister.
----That.
Why did I think I could hurt her?

entries.japanese:
……………………………………………ズキ、ン
　頭痛が消える。
　体の力も消えていく。
　ただナイフだけは秋葉に落ちないように、薄れていく意識の中で、必死に腕に力を込めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Throb
The headache vanishes.
The strength leaves my body too.
As my consciousness fades, I desperately tense my arm to keep the knife from falling onto Akiha.
entries.mirrorMoon:
……………………………… Thro, b
My headache disappears.
The strength in my body also disappears.
As my mind dims, I put all my strength into my arms so my knife will not descend on Akiha.

entries.japanese:
「どうして……殺さない、んですか」
　秋葉の声。
「私は血を吸う鬼なんでしょう……？
　夜になれば人の血を啜る怪物で、今も兄さんを殺すし、琥珀だってこの手にかけてしまった。
　なのにどうして――――そんな、哀しそうな顔をするん、ですか」
　奪われていく熱。
　……俺と違って、秋葉は本当に容赦がない。
　もう。
俺の体は、とっくに死んでいると思うぐらい、冷たく、なっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Why won’t you kill me?”
Akiha’s voice.
“I’m a blood-drinking fiend, aren’t I? A monster who feeds on people at night, who is killing you even now and killed Kohaku with these hands.
Then why――――do you look so sad?”
My heat is stolen away.
Unlike me, Akiha truly has no mercy.
Already. My body has grown so cold that it must have died some time ago.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Why…… won't you, kill me?"
Akiha's voice.
"I am a vampire, right……?
A monster that feeds on human blood at night; I'm trying to kill you right now and I even killed Kohaku.
So why----why do you have that sad look on your face?"
My heat is still being stolen.
…… Unlike me, Akiha really has no mercy.
Already.
My body feels cold, as if I already died.

entries.japanese:
「……やめてよ。
そんな顔で死ぬなんて、卑怯じゃない。
……私は悪いヤツなんだから、兄さんは最後まで秋葉を憎んで、よくも琥珀を殺したなって恨み言を言わないとおかしいでしょう？
　琥珀だって私が憎かった筈よ。
私は遠野槙久の娘で、琥珀の気持ちを知っていながら琥珀を屋敷に留めていたんだもの」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop it. Dying with that expression is unfair. I’m the villain, so you should hate me to the end and curse me for killing Kohaku, shouldn’t you?
Kohaku must have hated me too. I am Makihisa Tohno’s daughter, and though I knew how she felt, I kept her bound to this mansion.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Stop it.
It's not fair to die looking like that.
…… I'm the one to blame here, so you should hate me to the end.
Can't you even say that you hate me for killing Kohaku?
Kohaku had to hate me too.
I'm the daughter of Tohno Makihisa, and I kept her bound to the mansion while I knew her feelings."

entries.japanese:
「……だから琥珀にならいいと思ってた。
　あの子が遠野の家に復讐するっていうんなら、それに踊らされようって。
琥珀の血を飲んで、私がヒトでなくなってしまっても―――琥珀は私が憎いんだから、それは仕方がない事、なんだって」
―――そうか。
　秋葉も、俺と同じだったのか。
　知っていながら。
琥珀さんが俺たちを破滅させようって知っていながら、それでも―――
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s why I thought it would be all right, if it was Kohaku.
If she wanted revenge on the Tohno family, I would let her make a puppet of me. Even if drinking her blood meant losing my humanity―――Kohaku hated me, so I told myself it could not be helped.”
―――I see.
Akiha was the same as me.
She knew. She knew Kohaku meant to destroy us, and even so―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… That's why I thought it would be okay if it was Kohaku.
If she wanted revenge on the Tohno family, then I would play along.
Even if drinking her blood made me less than human---because she hated me, I thought it couldn't be helped."
---I see.
Akiha was the same as me.
She knew.
She knew that Kohaku-san plotted on our downfall, but still---

entries.japanese:
「だって仕方がないじゃない。
それぐらいしか、私は琥珀に償う方法がないんだもの。
　……琥珀が望んだなら、せめて私ぐらいは遠野の血族の中で、あの子の味方になってあげようって」
「……………………………違う」
　思いを口にして、驚いた。
　俺はまだ―――生きている、みたいだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“What else could I do? That was the only way I could atone to Kohaku.
If she wished it, then at least one person in the Tohno bloodline would take her side.”
“No”
The word escapes me, and I am astonished.
It seems I am still―――alive.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But it couldn't be helped, right?
I had no way of making it up to her.
…… If she wanted it, then the most I could do as a member of the Tohno blood was to support her."
"…………………… That's wrong."
I surprise myself as I voice my thoughts.
I'm still---alive, it seems.

entries.japanese:
「……なに？
　兄さん、よく聞こえない」
「……違う、秋葉。
琥珀さんは誰も憎んでなんかいない。
琥珀さんは、好きでこんなコトを望んだんじゃない」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What? Brother, I can’t hear you.”
“No, Akiha. Kohaku never hated anyone. None of this was something she truly wanted.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What?
Nii-san, I can't hear you well."
"…… That's wrong, Akiha.
Kohaku-san doesn't hate anyone.
She didn't wish for all this because she wanted to."

entries.japanese:
―――そう。
　ただ、そんな事しか目的がみつからなかったから、それを必死にこなしていただけなんだ。
　……あの人は、ただそれしか出来なかった。
　自分は生きる目的がある人間なんだと、自分自身を一生懸命に騙すような事しか、できなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Yes.
She found no other purpose, so she pursued this one with all her strength.
It was the only thing she could do.
The only thing she could do was desperately deceive herself into believing she had a reason to live.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---That's right.
It's just that she couldn't find any other purpose, so she only desperately acted out that plan.
…… That, that was all she could do.

All she could do was try with all her might to deceive herself into thinking that she had a purpose to live.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
俺はきっと、秋葉や琥珀さんに比べると、すごく、幸せだったと、思う。
　……だから、ごめんな。
俺には解らないんだ。
遠野の家に縛られた秋葉の苦しみも、何も憎んでいないのに、こんなコトをするしかなかった琥珀さんの苦しみも」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Compared with you and Kohaku, I think I was incredibly fortunate.
So I’m sorry. I cannot understand it. Not the pain that bound you to the Tohno family, nor Kohaku’s pain when, though she hated no one, this was the only thing she could make herself do.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
I think I led a happier life compared to you or Kohaku-san.
…… So, I'm sorry.
I don't know.
Neither your pain from being bound to the Tohno family, nor Kohaku-san's pain, where this was all she could do."

entries.japanese:
なんて、皮肉。
「……誰が。
誰が悪かったわけでもないんだ。
俺も、秋葉も、シキも、琥珀さんも。
……誰が悪かったワケでもない、のに――――」
　どうして俺たちは、こんな。
　互いを傷つける結果を、選んでしまったのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
How bitterly ironic.
“Who was? No one was at fault. Not me, not you, not SHIKI, not Kohaku. No one was at fault, and yet――――”
Why did we choose this?
An ending in which we could only wound one another.
entries.mirrorMoon:
How ironic.
"…… No one.
No one is to blame.
Not me, not you, not SHIKI, not Kohaku-san.
…… No one is to blame----"
So why?
Why did we end up choosing to kill each other?

entries.japanese:
「……兄さん。
まだ、間に合うんじゃ、ないかな」
　組み伏された秋葉は、ぼんやりと俺を見上げながら言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother. Maybe it isn’t too late.”
Pinned beneath me, Akiha gazes up in a daze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nii-san.
Maybe you can still make it."
Akiha still being pinned, she looks up at me aimlessly as she says this.

entries.japanese:
「……兄さんはもうすぐ死ぬわ。
けど私を殺せばまだ間に合うと思う。
……まあ、琥珀がいないから確実とは言えないんだけど」
　真剣な瞳をして、秋葉は俺を見上げている。
「……ね？
　だから早く、そのナイフを落としてください。
それで兄さんは助かるんです」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうに、とんでもない事を言ってくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’ll die soon. But if you kill me, I think you can still survive. I can’t promise it without Kohaku here, though.”
Akiha looks up at me with grave, unwavering eyes.
“Right? So hurry and bring that knife down. Then you’ll be saved.”
Akiha says something monstrous with an irritated frown.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You'll die soon, Nii-san.
But if you kill me, I think you can make it.
…… Well, Kohaku is no longer alive, so I can't say that for sure."
Her eyes turn serious as she looks up at me.
"…… Right?
So please hurry up and swing down your knife.
That will save you."
Akiha sulkily says those ridiculous words.

entries.japanese:
「…………………」
　……まったく。
それができたら、とっくにやっているんだって、言ってるのに。
「……もうっ、それが出来ないのなら私が生き残るだけよ。
　いいの？
　私、調子にのって明日からこの街を阿鼻叫喚の地獄絵図に変えちゃいますからね。
翡翠だけじゃなくて、兄さんの大事なお友達とかもひどい目に合わせちゃうんだから」
　……秋葉がかなり本気だという事は、それなりに伝わってきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
Honestly. I keep telling her that if I could do it, I would have done it already.
“Fine, if you cannot do it, then I will simply be the one who survives.
Is that what you want? Starting tomorrow, I’ll get carried away and turn this city into a screaming vision of hell. I’ll do terrible things not only to Hisui, but to all those precious friends of yours too.”
I can tell that Akiha is quite serious.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
…… Geez.
I'm saying that if I could do that, I would've already done it a long time ago.
"…… Fine, if you can't do that, then I will be the one who survives.
Okay?
Starting tomorrow, I will turn these streets into a painting of pure hell.
Not just Hisui, but I will make people like your dear friends suffer."
…… I can tell she's pretty serious.

entries.japanese:
「…………ばか。
そんな事したらよそから怖い人がやってきてタイヘンだぞ。
……きっとさ、吸血鬼専門の殺し屋とかがいて、秋葉はそういった連中と日夜戦い続けるハメになる」
　……だからまあ、地獄絵図にするのは止めなさい。
　出来る事なら、秋葉は―――苦しいだろうけど血を吸うのを我慢して、今まで通りに、暮らしていってほしいんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot. If you did that, frightening people would come from elsewhere and make your life miserable. There must be professional vampire killers somewhere, and you’d end up fighting them night after night.”
So please, do not turn the city into hell.
If at all possible, I want Akiha to―――though it will be painful, resist drinking blood and go on living as she always has.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……… Idiot.
If you did that, a scary person from somewhere would come and make things difficult.
…… I bet there's a skilled vampire hunter out there that would fight you both day and night."
…… So, don't think about painting a scene of pure hell.
If at all possible---I want her to resist sucking blood even though it might be hard, and just live like she did before all of this.

entries.japanese:
「――――どうして。
　どうしてそんな顔するんですか、兄さんは。
　……私はもう以前の秋葉じゃないんです。
こうしている今だって、兄さんの首筋に噛みつきたいって思ってる。
　私はシキと同じで、狂気に取り憑かれたただの怪物でしょ？
　ならさっきの兄さんに戻って、サクッと気持ち良く始末したほうがいいじゃない」
　秋葉は拗ねながら、まるで俺が悪いように責めたてる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――Why.
Why do you make that face, Brother.
I’m not the Akiha I was. Even now, all I can think about is sinking my teeth into your throat.
I’m no different from SHIKI, just another monster possessed by madness, am I? Then go back to the way you were a moment ago and finish me off in one clean stroke.”
Akiha sulks and berates me as if this were all my fault.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Why?
Why do you look at me like that, Nii-san?
…… I'm no longer the Akiha from before.
Even now, I want to bite into your neck.
Just like SHIKI, I'm a crazed, possessed monster, right?
Then you should return to how you were like before and kill me once and for all."
She pouts and looks as if it was all my fault.

entries.japanese:
……始末した方がいい、と秋葉は言う。
　それは確かにさっきまで自分を支配していた言葉だ。
　だが、そんなもの。
少しだって、よくはない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha says I ought to finish her off.
Those are the very words that ruled me only moments ago.
But there is nothing good about them. Nothing at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… She says I should kill her.
That's certainly my own words from before.
But, that.
That isn't good.

entries.japanese:
「――――できない。
俺には、秋葉は殺せない」
「以前の秋葉は、でしょう。
今の私は違うの。
兄さんの知ってる遠野秋葉じゃないんだってば」
「―――違う、そんなの関係ない。
　たとえおまえに憑き物がとり憑いていて、そいつを消すためだとしても―――遠野志貴は、遠野秋葉を傷つけることなんてできない」
　……この八年間、ずっと俺を許してくれていた黒髪の少女を、愛している。
　それが兄妹としての感情で、秋葉の感情とは違うとしても。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――I can’t. I can’t kill you, Akiha.”
“The old Akiha, you mean. I’m different now. I’m not the Akiha Tohno you knew.”
“―――No, that doesn’t matter.
Even if something has possessed you, even if hurting you is the only way to destroy it―――Shiki Tohno could never hurt Akiha Tohno.”
I love the black-haired girl who has gone on forgiving me for these past eight years.
Even if mine is only the love between a brother and sister, nothing like what she feels for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----I can't do it.
I can't kill you, Akiha."
"You're thinking about me from before?
But I'm different.
I'm not the Tohno Akiha you know."
"---No, that has nothing to do with it.
Even if you were possessed and it was to destroy that---as Tohno Shiki, I can't harm Tohno Akiha."
…… I love this black haired girl who forgave me so much these past eight years.
Even if I love her as a sister, different from the way she feels.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉は、俺にとって大切な人なんだよ。
その相手を―――傷つける事なんて、できない」
「―――――――――――」
　秋葉は目を見開いたあと。
　はあ、と肩をすくめて息を吐いた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“You’re precious to me, Akiha. I could never―――hurt someone I care about that much.”
“―――――――――――”
Her eyes widen.
Then her shoulders sink, and she breathes a long sigh.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha, you're my dear sister.
I can't---ever hurt you."
"-----------"
Akiha opens her eyes.
Her shoulders fall as she lets out a deep breath.

entries.japanese:
「……もうっ、なに言っているのよ。
私は兄さんには傷つけられてばかりだったわ。
そんな事にも気がついてくださらないなんて、本当に鈍感なのね」
　秋葉は優しい声で囁いた。
　その後。
止まったままの俺の手の平に、そっと、両手を重ねてきた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, what are you talking about? You’ve done nothing but hurt me. You never even noticed, did you? You really are hopelessly dense.”
Akiha whispers in a tender voice.
Then she gently lays both hands over my motionless palm.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… What are you saying?
You have always hurt me, Nii-san.
If you can't even realize that, then you really are dense, aren't you?"
Her whispered voice is very gentle.
And then, she brings both her hands on my stopped hand.

entries.japanese:
「――――――――――あ」
　それだけで、秋葉が何をするつもりなのか読み取れた。
　腕を離そうとしたが、腕には力が入らない。
　……秋葉の言うとおり。
俺の体は、とっくに俺の自由になるものでは、なくなっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――――――――”
That alone tells me what Akiha means to do.
I try to pull my arm away, but there is no strength left in it.
Akiha is right. My body has long since ceased to obey me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----------A…"
With just that, I can see her intentions.
I try to pull back, but I have no strength.
…… Just like she said, I lost the freedom to control my body a long time ago.

entries.japanese:
「やめ――――――やめろ、秋葉…………！」
　必死に声をあげた。
　秋葉は聞こえないふりをして、ニコリと笑った。
「……まったく。
だからこんな時まで、私は自分でしなくちゃいけないんです」
　そう、どこか嬉しげで、ひどく悲しそうな笑顔で。
　秋葉は、その両手に力を込めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Stop――――――stop, Akiha!”
I force out the words with everything I have.
Pretending not to hear, Akiha smiles.
“Honestly. Even at a time like this, I have to do everything myself.”
Her smile holds a trace of happiness and an unbearable sadness.
Then Akiha tightens both hands.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Sto------stop it, Akiha………!"
I frantically raise my voice.
Akiha pretends not to hear me and smiles.
"…… Geez.
That's why I have to do it all myself even now."
Her smile seems happy, but also full of sadness.
She puts power into her hands.

entries.japanese:
―――――――ナイフが落ちる。
　そこは線のある場所じゃない。
　ただの心臓。
刺されば激痛をともなう、ただの致死傷。
「あ―――――――あき、は……………！」
　腕は止まらない。
　俺には、秋葉の行為を止められない。
　こんな――――――こんな事って、あるか。
　俺は、結局。
　大切な二人を救おうとして、その二人を。
　自分の目の前で、失おうとしているなんて―――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――――――The knife falls.
No line runs there.
Only her heart. Nothing supernatural—a thrust there would merely be agonizing and fatal.
“A―――――――Akiha!”
My arm will not stop.
I cannot stop what Akiha is doing.
How――――――how can this be happening.
In the end.
Trying to save the two people dearest to me, I am about to.
Lose them both before my very eyes―――
entries.mirrorMoon:
-------The knife descends.
But that's not where the line is.
Just her heart.
If that is pierced, it will be fatal and painful.
"A-------Aki, ha…………!"
I can't stop my arm.
I can't prevent Akiha from doing this.
How-----how can this happen?
In the end.
I tried to save two people important to me.
Yet, I'm about to lose them before my very eyes---

entries.japanese:
「だめぇ――――――――！」
―――――――――？
　なんだ、ろう。
　腕が止まって、いる。
　俺の手に重なった秋葉の両手。
それを抱きかかえるように、誰かが覆い被さっていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“No――――――――!”
―――――――――What?
What happened?
My arm has stopped.
Akiha’s hands still cover mine. Someone is bent over us as though cradling them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Noooo---------!"
---------?
What is it?
My arm is stopped.
Akiha's two hands pressing down on my hand… As if embracing them, someone drapes over them as well.

entries.japanese:
秋葉は信じられないものを見るように、その人影を見つめている。
　俺は―――そう、きっと秋葉と同じぐらい、真っ白い貌をしていただろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha stares at that figure as though confronted with the impossible.
And I―――yes, I must look every bit as white as she does.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha looks disbelievingly at that figure.
I---just like Akiha, stare blankly.

entries.japanese:
「琥――――珀？」
「はい……！
　わたしです秋葉さま……！
　わたしですから、どうか―――この手をお放しください……！」
　琥珀さんは泣きそうな顔で、秋葉が握ったナイフを引き剥がした。
「…………………琥、珀」
　秋葉はぼんやりと。
まるで憑き物が落ちたみたいに呆然と琥珀さんを見つめている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ko――――haku?”
“Yes! It’s me, Miss Akiha! It’s me, so please―――let go!”
On the verge of tears, Kohaku pries the knife from Akiha’s grip.
“Kohaku”
Akiha stares blankly. As if the possessing spirit has suddenly left her, she gazes at Kohaku in a daze.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ko----haku?"
"Yes……!
Akiha-sama, it is me……!
It is me, so please---please let go……!"
With a face close to tears, Kohaku-san pulls the knife away from Akiha.
"……………… Ko, haku."
Akiha is in a daze.
As if the demon that caught a hold of her has completely left, she stares at Kohaku-san in surprise.

entries.japanese:
「………………そっか。
生きてたんだ、琥珀」
「――――はい。
秋葉さまはわたしの意識を落としてしまわれただけです。
　秋葉さまは最後の瞬間に、人を殺してしまわれる事をためらったんです」
「―――――――――」
　秋葉の瞳が悲しげに揺らいだ。
　……狂暴な想念に取り憑かれていた秋葉の無意識にあった、人間らしい最後の感情。
　それが―――琥珀さんと、秋葉を救ったものだった。
　ほう、と。
　大きく吐息を吐いて、秋葉は目蓋を閉じた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I see. You’re alive, Kohaku.”
“――――Yes. You only knocked me unconscious, Miss Akiha.
Miss Akiha hesitated at the final moment to take a human life.”
“―――――――――”
Sorrow trembles in Akiha’s eyes.
One last human feeling survives, buried beneath the violent obsession possessing her.
And that feeling―――is what saves both Kohaku and Akiha.
A sigh.
Akiha exhales deeply and closes her eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… I see.
You were alive, Kohaku."
"----Yes.
Akiha-sama, you only made me lose consciousness.
At that last instant, you held back from killing me."
"---------"
Her eyes flicker with sadness.
…… Even while possessed by fury, there was still humanity deep within Akiha.
That---was what saved Kohaku-san and Akiha.
Akiha sighs.
She closes her eyes as she lets out that breath.

entries.japanese:
「―――まいったなあ。
これじゃあ結局あなたの全勝って事じゃない。
琥珀は生きていて、遠野家の最後の血筋はここまでってコトでしょ？
　……でもまあ、それもいいかな。
私も正直、そろそろ休みたいって思ってたんだ」
　言って、秋葉は力なく両手をさげた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Well, this is awkward. It means you’ve won completely after all, doesn’t it? Kohaku is alive, and the last of the Tohno bloodline ends here.
Still, perhaps that’s for the best. To be honest, I was beginning to want a rest.”
With that, Akiha lets both hands fall limply.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Goodness.
I guess this means you've won everything.
You're alive, and this is the end of the Tohno bloodline.
…… But, maybe it's for the best.
To be honest, I was thinking of resting, too."
Her arms drop to her sides.

entries.japanese:
「さ、いいよ琥珀。
……兄さんは殺してくれなかったけど、琥珀ならやってくれるでしょ？
　私は琥珀を殺そうとしたんだし、あなたが嫌いな遠野槙久の娘なんだもの」
「…………………」
　琥珀さんはナイフを握ったまま、じっと秋葉を見つめて、当然のように、首を横にふった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Go ahead, Kohaku. My brother wouldn’t kill me, but you will, won’t you? I tried to kill you, and I’m the daughter of Makihisa Tohno, the man you hated.”
“―――――――――――”
Still holding the knife, Kohaku gazes steadily at Akiha and shakes her head as though the answer were self-evident.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, Kohaku.
…… Nii-san wasn't able to, but you can kill me, right?
I tried to kill you, and I am the daughter of the hated Tohno Makihisa."
"……………"
Kohaku-san holds the knife and stares at Akiha.
And she shakes her head.

entries.japanese:
――――すごく、静か。
　張り詰めていた氷が溶けていくように、ゆったりと、時間が流れていく。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Utterly still.
Time begins to flow again, slowly and gently, like ice melting after being drawn taut to the breaking point.!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
----It is, terribly quiet.
Like melting ice, time flows by calmly.

entries.japanese:
「……………………不思議ね。
どうして琥珀まで、私を殺してくれないのかな」
　瞼を閉じたまま。
まるで眠っているかのように、秋葉は呟いた。
「決まっています。
わたしは、秋葉さまが好きですから」
　からん、と。
　琥珀さんの手からナイフが落ちた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“How strange. Why won’t you kill me either, Kohaku?”
Her eyes remain closed. Akiha murmurs as though speaking in her sleep.
“The answer is simple. I love you, Miss Akiha.”
Clatter.
The knife falls from Kohaku’s hand.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"……………… That's strange.
I wonder why even Kohaku can't kill me."
With her eyes still closed, she speaks softly as if she was sleeping.
"Of course.
It is because I like you, Akiha-sama."
Clang.
The knife Kohaku-san was holding clatters to the ground.

entries.japanese:
「どんなに秋葉さまがわたしをお嫌いになられても、琥珀は、秋葉さまにずっとお仕えしたいんです。
　ですから秋葉さま―――どうかわたしを哀れと思うのなら、死なないでください。
このまま秋葉さまに死なれては、わたしは―――もとの琥珀に、戻ってしまいます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Even if Miss Akiha comes to hate me, I still want to remain in Miss Akiha’s service forever.
So please, Miss Akiha―――if you feel any pity for me at all, don’t die. If Miss Akiha dies now, I’ll become―――the Kohaku I used to be again.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"No matter how much you hate me, I want to always serve you.
So Akiha-sama---if you feel sorry for me at all, please do not die.
If you die like this, I---will go back to being the Kohaku from before."

entries.japanese:
「……………もう。
無茶なこと、言ってくれるんだから」
　はあ、という大きなため息。
　そうして、秋葉は拗ねるように視線をそらした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly. You ask the impossible.”
A long sigh.
Then Akiha turns her eyes away in a sulk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………… You're asking something pretty difficult."
A deep sigh.
Akiha averts her gaze as if she was pouting.

entries.japanese:
「けど仕方ないか。
琥珀にはさっきの借りがあるし、今はおとなしくしてあげる。
　……兄さんもね。
しょうがないけど、兄妹として愛してくれるならそれでいいかなぁって、思ってさしあげます」
――――秋葉の髪が流れていく。
　体に絡みついたモノは消えて、俺はそのまま、後ろに倒れこんだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“But I suppose I have no choice. I owe Kohaku for what happened earlier, so I’ll behave myself for now.
…And as for you, I suppose I’ll be gracious enough to accept being loved as your sister.”
――――Akiha’s hair streams away.
Whatever has been coiled around my body vanishes, and I collapse backward.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"But, I guess it can't be helped.
I owe you from before, so I won't do anything for now.
…… Same for you, Nii-san.
I will think that it's good enough for you to love me as your sister."
----Her hair flows.
The binding around my body disappears and I collapse to the floor.

entries.japanese:
いつのまにか、天は高く澄んでいた。
　銀色の月。
　青白い廊下には、もう赤い熱気は存在しない。
　秋葉の髪は赤いままだったが、秋葉本人が背負っていた蜃気楼はとうに失われていた。
　今は―――琥珀さんがついていてくれるから、秋葉もきっと大丈夫だ。
entries.maoEnglish:
At some point, the sky has become clear and boundlessly high.
A silver moon.
No trace of the crimson heat remains in the pallid corridor.
Akiha’s hair is still red, but the wavering mirage that cloaked her is long gone.
Now that Kohaku is beside her, Akiha will surely be all right.
entries.mirrorMoon:
At some point, the sky became deep and clear.
The silver moon.
The pale hallway now shows no trace of the fiery aura.
Akiha's hair is still red, but the mirage that burdened her is long gone.
Now---with Kohaku-san here, Akiha should be okay.

entries.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　意識が遠退く。
　冷めきった体が眠りに至ろうとする。
　その前に。
　今は安らかな月光を見て、ぼんやりと思った。
　月日がたって、遠野志貴が屋敷の生活に慣れた後も。
　きっと今のままで、幸せに過ごせているんだろうなんて、そんな都合のいいユメを――――
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――――――――”
Consciousness recedes.
My body, cold to its core, is sinking toward sleep.
Before that.
I gaze into the moonlight, peaceful now, and let the thought drift through my mind.
Even after months and years pass and Shiki Tohno grows accustomed to life at the mansion.
A convenient dream that we will all go on living happily just as we are――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
My mind starts to recede.
My cold body starts to drift towards sleep.
But before that,
I watch the peaceful moonlight and think.
After a while, after I've gotten used to living in the mansion.
I think selfishly that we'll be living happily like right now----

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、どうかお目覚めください、志貴さま」
　……声が聞こえる。
　もう、何度も何度も聞きなれた翡翠の声。
「もうお時間を過ぎています。
これ以上お眠りになられるのはどうかと存じますが」
　……控えめな翡翠の声。
　だが、そんな事では昨夜、嬉しくて中々眠れなかった俺を起こす事はできないのだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, please wake up, Master Shiki.”
A voice.
Hisui’s voice, familiar now from hearing it morning after morning.
“The appointed hour has already passed. I really cannot recommend sleeping any longer.”
Hisui’s voice remains characteristically restrained.
But no such gentle appeal can wake me after happiness kept me from falling asleep until late last night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please wake up.
Shiki-sama."
…… I hear a voice.
Hisui's voice that I have heard so many times.
"It is past time.
I do not think it is a good idea to keep sleeping like this."
…… Hisui's reserved voice.
But, with that, it's impossible to wake me up since I was so excited last night, I couldn't get to sleep.

entries.japanese:
「―――志貴さま。
いいかげんに起きてくださいませんと、秋葉さまにまたいじめられるだけだと思いますが」
―――刹那。
　まどろんでいた意識が、その一言で覚醒した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Master Shiki. If you do not get up soon, I believe Miss Akiha will only torment you again.”
―――In that instant.
Those words snap my drowsing mind awake.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Shiki-sama.
Please wake up or I think Akiha-sama will be mad at you again."
---That instant.
My mind snaps from its dozing.

entries.japanese:
「――――――っ！」
　ベットから跳ね起きる。
　翡翠は傍らでじっと、俺の慌てぶりを観察していた。
　外からはみーん、というセミの声が聞こえてくる。
　朝だっていうのに陽射しは強くて、寝巻は汗で濡れている。
　まあ、それは。
これ以上はないっていうぐらい、典型的な夏の朝だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“――――――!”
I shoot upright in bed.
Hisui stands beside me, calmly observing my panic.
Outside, cicadas whine in a ceaseless chorus.
The morning sun is already fierce, and my pajamas are soaked with sweat.
Well. It is the most perfectly ordinary summer morning imaginable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"-------!"
I jump up from bed.
Hisui stares at me from the side as I panic.
I can hear the voices of cicadas from outside.
It's still morning, but the sun is streaming in pretty strong, and my sweat drenches my pajamas.
Well, that is, it's a pretty typical summer morning.

entries.japanese:
「あ――――おはよう、翡翠」
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
　丁寧にお辞儀をする翡翠。
……その冷静ぶりが、逆に厭な予感をかきたてる。
「翡翠。
もしかして秋葉のヤツ、まだ出かけていないのか……？」
「はい。
志貴さまのお顔を見るまでは、と居間のほうでお待ちしております。
……そうですね、そろそろ一時間ほど経過すると思いますが」
「――――――――――！」
　時計を見る。
　時刻は午前十時を過ぎたあたり。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――good morning, Hisui.”
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bows with perfect courtesy. Somehow, her composure only deepens my sense of impending disaster.
“Hisui. Don’t tell me Akiha hasn’t left yet…?”
“She has not. She said she would wait in the sitting room until she had seen Master Shiki. I believe it has now been nearly an hour.”
“――――――――――!”
I look at the clock.
It is a little past ten in the morning.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----morning, Hisui."
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
Hisui gives a succinct bow…… She acts very calm, but I get a bad feeling about all this.
"Hisui.
Don't tell me Akiha hasn't left yet……?"
"Yes.
Akiha-sama is waiting in the sitting room until she sees your face, Shiki-sama…… That's right, I think she has been waiting for about an hour now."
"----------!"
I look at the clock.
It tells me it is around ten in the morning.

entries.japanese:
「くそ―――なんで今日にかぎってこんな時間まで残ってるんだよ、秋葉のヤツ……！」
「志貴さまがご旅行に出かける朝ですから。
秋葉さまがお見送りをしようとするのは当然の事だと思いますが」
「……………………う」
　なんだか翡翠の視線が痛い。
　……あの事は秘密の筈なんだけど、やっぱり翡翠と秋葉にはバレてしまっているんだろうか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Damn it―――why did she have to stay this late today of all days…!”
“Because this is the morning Master Shiki leaves on his trip. I think it only natural that Miss Akiha should wish to see you off.”
“Urk”
Hisui’s gaze feels painful.
That matter was supposed to be a secret, but have Hisui and Akiha seen through me after all?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Damn---why is she waiting around so late today, of all days……!?"
"Because it is the morning that you leave for your trip, Shiki-sama.
I think it is only natural for Akiha-sama to see you off."
"……………… Ah."
Her gaze is painful for some reason.
…… That is supposed to be a secret, but maybe Hisui and Akiha already know about it.

entries.japanese:
「……わかった。
とにかくすぐに居間に行くから。
翡翠は先に行っていてくれ」
「かしこまりました。
それでは失礼します」
　……翡翠は慇懃に退室していった。
　昨夜から用意してあった服に着替えた後、ショルダーバッグを肩にかけて部屋を後にした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…All right. I’ll go to the sitting room at once. You go on ahead.”
“Very well. Please excuse me.”
…Hisui withdrew with impeccable formality.
I changed into the clothes I had laid out the night before, slung my shoulder bag over one arm, and left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Got it.
Anyway, I'll go to the sitting room right away.
Please go there ahead of me."
"As you wish.
Then, excuse me."
…… Hisui courteously exits the room.
After changing into the clothes I got ready yesterday, I sling a bag over my shoulder and leave my room.

entries.japanese:
―――居間には。
ご機嫌ななめどころか垂直になりつつある秋葉の姿があった。
entries.maoEnglish: ―――In the sitting room. Akiha’s temper has gone well past sour and is rapidly approaching perpendicular.
entries.mirrorMoon: ---I see Akiha in the sitting room, and she really doesn't seem to be in a good mood.

entries.japanese:
「よっ。
おはよう、秋葉」
「おはよう兄さん。
ご旅行の朝にしては、またずいぶんとゆっくりした起床ですね」
　秋葉はねっとりとした視線を向けてくる。
「……悪かったな。
昨日は眠れなくて朝方まで起きてたんだ。
これでも早起きしたほうだぞ、俺」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hey. Morning, Akiha.”
“Good morning, Brother. You certainly slept late for someone leaving on a trip today.”
Akiha fixes me with a slow, clinging stare.
“Sorry. I couldn’t sleep last night and stayed awake until dawn. Believe it or not, this counts as getting up early for me.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, good morning, Akiha."
"Good morning, Nii-san.
You're taking things slow for the morning of a trip, aren't you?"
She looks at me with a sharp glance.
"…… Sorry.
I couldn't sleep last night and was awake till early morning.
This is still getting up early for me."

entries.japanese:
「ふーん。
旅行が楽しみで前日に眠れないなんて、ずいぶんと可愛い事をおっしゃるんですね。
　兄さん、そんなに乾さんと遊びに行く事が嬉しいんですか？」
「なんだよその言い方。
旅行は楽しみなものに決まってるだろ」
「そうですね。
兄さんの喜びようっていったらお酒を飲んだ栗鼠のようですから。
夏休みに入ってからというもの、ずっとこの日を待っていたんでしょう？
　乾さんと何処に行くかは知りませんけど、よっぽど旅行先にいいコトでも待っているんでしょうね」
entries.maoEnglish:
“How sweet. Too excited about your trip to sleep the night before.
Brother, are you truly that delighted to go gallivanting with Inui?”
“What’s with that tone? Of course I’m excited; trips are supposed to be fun.”
“Naturally. You’ve been carrying on like a drunken squirrel. You’ve waited for this day ever since summer vacation began, haven’t you? I have no idea where you and Inui are going, but something very special must be waiting for you there.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Oh?
Looking forward to a trip so much you couldn't sleep?
How cute.
