entries.japanese:
……何の根拠もない。
　なのに、ただ漠然と、あの人なら俺の悩みを解決してくれるかもしれないと思った。
「―――――」
　迷っている暇はない。
　自分一人でこんなモノを抱えることには、これ以上耐えられない。
「悪い、先に戻っていてくれ有彦！」
「ああ？
　先に戻ってろって、どこ行くんだよ遠野！」
entries.maoEnglish:
There is no reason to believe it.
Even so, I have the vague conviction that she might be able to resolve what is tormenting me.
“―――――”
There is no time to hesitate.
I can’t bear carrying this thing alone any longer.
“Sorry, Arihiko—go on back without me!”
“Huh? You want me to go back—but where are you going, Tohno?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I don't have any reason for it.
But I just have a vague feeling she might be the person able to help me with my troubles.
"-----"
There's no time to think.
I can't bear to keep this to myself any longer.
"Sorry, you go on ahead, Arihiko!"
"Huh?
'Go on ahead'?
Where are you going, Tohno!?"

entries.japanese:
……とにかく、もう怒られても仕方がないぐらいの強引さで、先輩を校舎裏に連れてきてしまった。
　五時限目はとっくに始まってしまっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I have practically dragged Ciel behind the school with enough force to deserve a scolding.
Fifth period is already well under way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Anyway, I get her to come to the rear of the school building so forcefully that it can't be helped if she gets mad at me.
Fifth period has already started.

entries.japanese:
「もう、いきなりこんなところに連れて来て、なんなんですか遠野くん」
　……先輩は怒っているというより呆れている。
「ごめん先輩。
けど、さっきの話をもう少し詳しく聞きたいんだ」
「さっきの話って、通り魔殺人の話ですか？」
「そう。
その、罪を罪と感じないっていうヤツ。
それって、ようするに無自覚で人殺しをしているっていう事なのかな」
　……例えば。
　自分は眠っているつもりでも、外に出て人殺しをしてしまっている、といったふうな。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, Tohno, why did you drag me out here without warning?”
Ciel sounds more exasperated than angry.
“Sorry, Ciel. But I need to hear more about what you said earlier.”
“About the street murders?”
“Yes. That part about not recognizing guilt as guilt. Does that mean the killer could be murdering people without knowing it?”
For example.
Someone might believe he was asleep while actually wandering outside and killing people.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, pulling me to a place like this, what is it Tohno-kun?"
…… Senpai is more amazed than angry.
"I'm sorry, senpai.
But, I wanted to hear more about what you were saying before."
"What I was saying before… you mean the serial killer?"
"Yes, that.
About the person who doesn't feel a crime is a crime.
Are you saying they kill people unconsciously?"
…… For example.
Like intending to sleep but instead going outside to commit murder.

entries.japanese:
「ちょっ、いたいです遠野くん。
ちゃんと話は聞きますから、手を離してください」
「あ―――ごめん」
　先輩から手を離す。
　……よっぽど俺は慌てていたらしい。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ow—Tohno, that hurts. I promise I’ll listen, so please let go of my hand.”
“Ah―――sorry.”
I release her.
I must be more frantic than I realized.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, that hurts, Tohno-kun.
I'll answer you, so please let go of me."
"Oh---I'm sorry."
I let her go.
…… It seems I was really worked up.

entries.japanese:
「はい、けっこうです。
えっと、通り魔殺人の犯人さんが無自覚で殺人を起こしているかどうか、というコトでしたね」
「うん―――どうしてもそれが聞きたいんだ」
「そんなの知りませんよ。
わたし、犯人さんじゃないんですから」
「な―――そ、それはそうだけど、先輩！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. Now, you were asking whether the killer might be unaware of committing the murders.”
“Yes―――I have to know.”
“How should I know? I’m not the murderer.”
“Wha―――well, no, but Ciel!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"It's alright.
Anyway, you were asking if the killer might be killing people unconsciously, right?"
"Yeah---I really want to know."
"Well, I don't know, because I'm not the killer."
"Wha---yes, that's true Senpai, but…!"

entries.japanese:
「はい、冗談です。
遠野くんがあんまりにも真剣だから、ちょっとからかっちゃおうかなって」
「……先輩、勘弁してくれ。
こっちは本当に大真面目なんだから」
「ええ、そうみたいですね。
だけどどうしたんです？
　通り魔事件の犯人のことなんて、遠野くんには関係ないじゃないですか」
「それは――――」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m joking. You looked so desperately serious that I couldn’t resist teasing you.”
“Please don’t. I really am serious.”
“Yes, I can see that. But what brought this on? The murderer has nothing to do with you.”
“That’s――――”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes, it's just a joke.
Since you seemed so serious Tohno-kun, I thought I'd be a little playful for a moment."
"…… Senpai, give me a break.
I'm really serious here."
"Yeah, it looks like it.
But, why?
The serial killer is none of your concern, is he, Tohno-kun?"
"That's----"

entries.japanese:
「それは、なんですか」
　……それは。
「俺が―――その犯人だっていったら、どうする？」
　意を決して、そう言った。
　だっていうのに。
　先輩は、できのいい冗談を聞いたような顔をして、くすくすと笑い出した。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s what?”
It is…
“What would you do if I―――if I told you I was the killer?”
I force myself to say it.
And yet.
Ciel looks as if she has just heard an excellent joke and begins to laugh softly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes?
What is it?"
…… That's.
"If---if I told you I was the killer, what would you do?"
I finally say it.
But.
Senpai's face lights up as if I said the funniest joke, and she bursts into laughter.

entries.japanese:
「先輩、冗談じゃないんだ。
俺は―――」
「ええ、遠野くんが本気だっていうことは分かってます。
けど、だからなんだかおかしくて。
だって自分が殺人鬼なんだって相談にくる殺人鬼なんて、普通いないじゃないですか」
「先輩―――――」
「それじゃわたしから聞きますけど、遠野くんはなんだってそんなふうに思うんです？」
「それは―――その、最近の俺、おかしいんだ。
……原因は判ってる。
たぶん、俺は吸血鬼に噛まれたんだ」
　……何かの比喩のように、そう言った。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, this isn’t a joke. I―――”
“I know you mean it. That’s what makes it funny. Murderers don’t ordinarily seek advice because they’re worried they might be murderers.”
“Ciel―――――”
“Then let me ask you: why do you think such a thing?”
“It’s―――well, I haven’t been myself lately. I know the cause. I think a vampire bit me.”
I say it as if it were some kind of metaphor.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, this is no joke, I'm---"
"Yes, I know you're serious.
But that's why it's funny.
Because the murderer doesn't usually come and ask for help because they're the murderer."
"Senpai-----"
"Then I will ask.
Why do you think so, Tohno-kun?"
"It's because---recently, I've been… strange.
I know why.
I was probably bitten by a vampire."
…… I say it frankly, as if it was a euphemism.

entries.japanese:
「―――どうぞ。
まだ続きがあるんでしょう？」
「……それ以来、なんかヘンなんだ。
突然自分が自分じゃないみたいになったり、人を殺してしまう夢を見たりする。
　昨日なんて、俺は眠っているつもりだったのに外に出歩いていたらしいんだ。
……その時見ていた夢も人を殺して、血を吸う夢だった」
「――――――」
　先輩は何も言わず、ただ俺の目を見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Go on. There is more, isn’t there?”
“Ever since then, something has been wrong with me; sometimes I suddenly feel like someone else. I dream about killing people.
Yesterday, I thought I was asleep, but apparently I went wandering outside. And in the dream I was having then, I killed someone and drank their blood.”
“――――――”
Ciel says nothing, only studies my eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Please, go on."
"…… Since then, it's been strange.
Suddenly I don't feel like myself, and I have dreams about killing people.
Last night, although I only intended to sleep, it seems that I went out.
And I had a dream in which I killed someone, and sucked blood."
"------"
Senpai says nothing, just watching me.

entries.japanese:
「……俺の親父は二重人格だったそうだし、もしかしすると俺本人が気がついていないだけで、人殺しの俺がいるのかもしれない。
でもそれを確かめるコトができなくて、俺は―――」
「それで遠野くんは犯人は無自覚なのか、なんて聞いてきたんですね」
　はあ、と先輩は呆れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“They say my father had two personalities, so perhaps there is a murderer inside me and I’m simply the one who doesn’t know. But I have no way to find out, and I―――”
“So that is why you asked whether the killer might be unaware.”
Ciel sighs in exasperation.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… My father had a split personality.
Maybe I just don't know about it, but there might be a killer in me.
But I have no way of finding out---"
"So that's why you came to ask if the killer was unconscious of his actions."
Senpai sighs in amazement.

entries.japanese:
「あのですね、もし遠野くんがその殺人鬼さんだとしたら、無自覚なんかじゃありませんよ。
夢として殺人の行為を見ている時点で、それは無自覚ではありませんから。
　けど、そんなことよりですね。
はっきり言ってしまうと、そんなのはただの夢です。
遠野くんがなにを不安がってるかは知りませんけど、遠野くんは遠野くんです」
「―――――」
　……そう言ってくれるのは、嬉しいけど。
　俺には先輩の言葉を鵜呑みできるものが、何一つだってありはしない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Listen: if you were the killer, you wouldn’t be unaware of it. The moment you witness the murders in your dreams, they are part of your awareness.
More importantly. They are only dreams. I don’t know what has frightened you so badly, but you are still you, Tohno.”
“―――――”
I’m grateful to hear it.
But I have no reason—none at all—to accept her reassurance on faith.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Um, if you were truly the killer, you would not be unconscious of yourself.
The point you're seeing it in your dreams makes it not unconscious.
But more importantly, it's just a dream.
I don't know what you're worried about, but Tohno-kun is Tohno-kun."
"-----"
…… I'm glad to hear that, but…
There's no reason for me to believe in any of Senpai's words.

entries.japanese:
「はあ。
よっぽど不安なんですね、遠野くん」
　言って。
　先輩はぽんぽん、と俺の頭をなでた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“My. You really are frightened, aren’t you, Tohno?”
With that.
Ciel pats me lightly on the head.
entries.mirrorMoon:
She sighs.
"You must be feeling really uneasy, Tohno-kun."
With that,
Senpai pats my head.

entries.japanese:
「―――大丈夫ですよ。
遠野くんは何の問題もありません。
他でもないわたしが保証するんですから、絶対に大丈夫です」
「あ――――はい」
　……自然に、心からうなずいていた。
　ただこうしている間だけだって分かっていても、心が休まる。
　こっちの不安を包み込むような、先輩の手の平が優しかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――You’ll be all right. There is nothing wrong with you. I am personally guaranteeing it, so you are absolutely going to be all right.”
“Ah――――okay.”
The nod comes naturally, from somewhere deep inside me.
Even knowing the relief will last only as long as this moment, I can finally breathe.
Her palm is gentle, as though it could cradle every fear I have.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---It's okay.
You have nothing to worry about, Tohno-kun.
I myself guarantee it, so it's definitely okay."
"Ah----okay."
…… Automatically, I nod in complete agreement.
Even if I know it's only while she's doing so, I feel at ease.
Like wrapping up my uneasiness, Senpai's hands are gentle.

entries.japanese:
放課後になった。
　秋葉の事や自分の事で混乱しながら、とりあえず一日が終わろうとしている。
「……帰るか」
　秋葉を迎えにいって、屋敷に帰ろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
School lets out.
Though my thoughts remain tangled around Akiha and myself, the day is finally drawing to a close.
“Time to go.”
I’ll collect Akiha, and we’ll head home.
entries.mirrorMoon:
School is over now.
I was confused about myself and Akiha, but today is about to end.
"…… Time to go home."
I should go get Akiha and go back to our mansion.

entries.japanese:
秋葉と一緒に帰路につく。
　……昼休みの時と同じように、二人きりになるとお互い会話が途絶えてしまった。
―――秋葉と話したいと思う反面、秋葉の顔を見るのが照れくさい。
「……まったく、中学生じゃあるまいし」
「……？
　何か言いましたか、兄さん？」
「あ―――いや、なんでもない。
ただの独り言」
　……はあ。
　ほんと、一体何をしているんだろう遠野志貴は。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I start home together.
Just as at lunch, the moment we are alone, conversation deserts us both.
―――I want to talk to her, yet somehow I’m too self-conscious even to look at her face.
“Honestly, I’m not a middle-schooler anymore.”
“Hm? Did you say something, Brother?”
“Ah―――no. Just talking to myself.”
Haaah.
What are you doing, Shiki Tohno?
entries.mirrorMoon:
I walk home together with Akiha.
…… Just like lunchtime, we grow quiet as soon as there are only the two of us.
---While I want to talk to Akiha, I also feel embarrassed looking at Akiha.
"…… Man, it's not like I'm a middle schooler."
"…?
Did you say something Nii-san?"
"Oh---no, it's nothing, just talking to myself."
…… *sigh*
Really, what the hell am I doing?

entries.japanese:
長い坂道につく。
　ここを登りきれば屋敷は目の前だ。
「兄さん。
屋敷に戻る前に、一つお聞きしたい事があります」
　ぴたり、と足を止めて、秋葉はまっすぐに俺を見据えてきた。
「―――――」
　そこにはさっきまでの、じれったいような沈黙はない。
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで俺を見ている。
entries.maoEnglish:
We reach the long slope.
Once we climb it, the estate will be directly ahead.
“Brother. Before we return to the estate, there is one thing I wish to ask you.”
Akiha stops dead and faces me squarely.
“―――――”
The awkward silence from before is gone.
Her gaze is grave and unwavering.
entries.mirrorMoon:
We reach the long hill.
Once we go up it, our mansion will be right there.
"Nii-san.
I would like to ask you one thing before we get home."
Akiha's feet stop and she looks straight at me.
"-----"
The kind of silence that was there before is gone.
Akiha looks at me seriously.

entries.japanese:
「いいよ。
聞きたい事ってなに？」
「……その、以前も聞きましたけど、兄さんはシエルをどう思っているんですか？」
「――――なんだ、なにかと思ったらまたそれか。
どう思ってるかも何も、先輩は先輩だよ。
なんでも相談できる頼りがいのある先輩だけど」
「……そうですね。
兄さんはなにか悩みごとがあるようでしたから。
今日の朝のことも、それが原因だったんでしょう？」
「―――――」
　……驚いた。
　秋葉は、俺が一人で悩んでいたことに気付いてたのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Sure. What do you want to ask?”
“I asked you once before; how do you feel about Ciel?”
“――――Oh, that again? Ciel is Ciel. She’s a dependable upperclassman I can talk to about anything.”
“Yes, I suppose she is. You seemed troubled about something. That was also the reason for what happened this morning, wasn’t it?”
“―――――”
I’m taken aback.
Akiha noticed that I’d been worrying alone.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Go ahead, what do you wanna ask about?"
"…… Um… I asked before, but, what do you think of Ciel?"
"----What, that again?
I don't think anything of her.
She's just my senpai.
She's a trustworthy senpai I can ask about anything, though."
"…… I see.
It seemed like something was bothering you; this morning was a result of it too, wasn't it?"
"-----"
…… I'm surprised.
Akiha knew that I was worrying about the problem by myself.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉……おまえ、気付いてたのか」
「あたりまえです。
私たちは兄妹なんですから、兄さんが落ち込んでいる事ぐらい感じ取れるわ。
　だっていうのに、どうして兄さんは私に相談してくれないんですか。
私よりあんな人のほうが信頼できるんですか、兄さんは」
「お―――おまえ、俺が先輩に相談するとこ、見てたのか……！？」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha—you knew?”
“Of course; we are brother and sister. I can at least tell when you are miserable.
And yet why wouldn’t you confide in me? Do you trust that woman more than your own sister?”
“Y-you―――you saw me talking to Ciel…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha… you noticed?"
"Of course.
We are brother and sister.
I can tell when you are depressed, Nii-san.
So, why didn't you just come and talk to me?
Do you trust that woman more than you trust me?"
"Y---you were watching me talk to Senpai…!?"

entries.japanese:
「ええ。
本当にあの時は我が目を疑ったわ。
兄さん、あの人の前ではすごく素直なんですから！」
　ふん、と顔を背ける秋葉。
「……違う。
俺が秋葉や琥珀さんに相談しなかったのは、その―――」
　今の自分の体を打ち明けて、嫌われたくなかったからなのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
“I did. I could hardly believe my eyes. Brother, you’re so open with her!”
Akiha turns away with an offended huff.
“That isn’t it. I didn’t tell you or Kohaku because―――”
Because I couldn’t bear for them to learn what my body had become and hate me for it.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.
I could hardly believe my eyes and ears.
You, being so honest in front of that person!"
With a "hmph", Akiha turns away.
"…… It's not like that.
I didn't talk to you or Kohaku-san, because---"
I didn't want to tell them about my body and have them hate me.

entries.japanese:
「その、なんですか。
言いたい事があるんでしたらはっきり言ってください」
「ばか、言えたらこんなに悩んだりするもんか！
　　俺は、秋葉たちのことが大事だから先輩に相談したんだ。
別におまえの事を信頼してなかったとか、そういう事じゃない」
「そんな言い訳、聞きたくないわ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Because what? If you have something to say, then say it plainly.”
“Idiot—if I could say it, I wouldn’t be suffering like this! I went to Ciel because you and the others matter to me. It isn’t because I don’t trust you.”
“I don’t want to hear your excuses.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Because of what?
If there's something you want to say, please, say it."
"Are you stupid?
I wouldn't worry this much if I could say it!
I asked Senpai since you guys are important to me.
It's not because I don't trust you or anything."
"I don't want to hear such excuses!"

entries.japanese:
「この際ですからはっきり言います。
　あの人と兄さんは釣り合いません。
……ですから、これ以上はあの人と親しくしないでください。
それは兄さんの為になりません」
「な────」
　あまりに唐突な言葉に声が出ない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Then I shall speak plainly.
You and that woman are ill-suited to one another. Do not grow any closer to her. It will bring you nothing good.”
“Wha────”
The words come so abruptly that they silence me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Fine, I'll come out and say it.
That person doesn't suit you.
So please, do not get any closer to her.
It is for your sake."
"Wha----"
It's so sudden I'm at a loss for words.

entries.japanese:
「秋葉。
それは、一般家庭の人間は遠野家には相応しくないっていう意味で言ってるのか」
「………………」
　秋葉は答えない。
　沈黙は、すなわちイエスだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. Are you saying someone from an ordinary family isn’t good enough for a Tohno?”
“………………”
She does not answer.
Her silence means yes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Are you saying that ordinary people are not suitable company for those of the Tohno house, then?"
"…………"
Akiha doesn't answer.
The silence means a yes.

entries.japanese:
「───そうか。
そうだよな、そりゃあ秋葉は遠野家の当主だもんな。
親父と同じで家柄や血筋が大事だっていうんだろ？」
「……兄さん、それは」
「いいよ、別に文句を言ってるわけじゃない。
秋葉を一人残して家を出たのは俺のほうだ。
本来ならさ、そういうふうに育てられたのは俺の方だったんだ。
だから、秋葉を悪く言ってるんじゃないんだ」
「…………………」
「でもな、今のは聞き流せない。
先輩のことを何もしらないクセに、相応しくないなんて、そんなコト言わないでくれ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“───I see; of course. You’re the head of the Tohno family, after all. Just like Father, you care about pedigree and bloodlines, is that it?”
“Brother, that isn’t—”
“It’s fine; I’m not criticizing you. I’m the one who left you alone and walked away from this family. I was the one who should have been raised that way. So I’m not blaming you.”
“…”
“But I can’t let what you just said pass. You know nothing about Ciel, so don’t say she isn’t good enough.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---I see.
Well, you are the head of the Tohno household.
You're saying that family and lineage is important like that old man, right?"
"…… Nii-san, that's…"
"It's fine.
I'm not really complaining.
I'm the one who left you alone in that house.
I should have been the one raised that way originally.
So, I'm not speaking badly of you."
"…………"
"But, I can't let what you said right now go.
Even though you don't know anything about Senpai, don't just say she's unsuitable."

entries.japanese:
秋葉はうつむいたままで何も言わない。
　しばらく、俺たちの間に言葉はなかった。
「…………のクセに」
「え───？」
「兄さんだって遠野家の事を何も知らないクセに、勝手な事を言わないで――！」
　苦しげに叫んで、秋葉は俺の前から離れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha remains bowed and silent.
For a while, neither of us speaks.
“When you don’t know anything either…”
“What───?”
“You don’t know anything about the Tohno family either, Brother, so stop saying whatever you please――!”
The cry tears out of her in pain, and she recoils from me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Looking down, Akiha says nothing.
For a while, we stand in silence.
"…… You don't…"
"Eh---?"
"Nii-san, You don't know anything about the Tohno house, don't say such selfish things!"
Crying out painfully, Akiha pulls away from me.

entries.japanese:
「───とにかく、あの人とは親しくしないで。
あの人は違う人です。
親しくすればするほど、兄さんが苦しくなるだけだわ」
　秋葉は坂道を駆け上がっていく。
「───なんだよ、それ」
　俺は呆然と、秋葉の後ろ姿を見つめることしかできなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“───In any case, stay away from that woman. She is not what you think. The closer you become, the more you will suffer.”
Akiha runs up the hill.
“───What the hell does that mean?”
All I can do is stare numbly after her.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Anyway, you mustn't get close to that person.
She's not like us.
If you get any closer to her, you're the one who would suffer."
Akiha runs up the hill.
"---What does that mean?"
All I can do is gaze up after her, aghast.

entries.japanese:
屋敷に戻ってきた。
　いつもなら何も考えずにロビーに入るのだが、今は中に入りづらい。
　……この屋敷に戻ってきて、俺はさんざん秋葉を怒らせてきたと思う。
　けど、さっきのは本物だ。
　俺は初めて、秋葉を本気で怒らせて、あんな苦しそうな声をあげさせてしまった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I arrive at the estate.
Usually I would walk straight into the foyer without thinking, but now I can’t bring myself to enter.
Since returning to the estate, I must have angered Akiha countless times.
But that was different.
For the first time, I truly hurt her—hurt her enough to make her cry out like that.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion.
Though I usually go into the lobby without thinking, right now it's hard to enter.
…… I have made Akiha angry many times since I came back to the mansion.
But, she was really mad back then.
For the first time, I really angered Akiha, and made her sound so hurt.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　さっきのはどっちが悪い、という問題じゃないと思う。
　ちゃんと時間が経てば秋葉も冷静になって、どうしてシエル先輩をあんなに嫌うのかを説明してくれるはずだ。
「……庭でも回るか」
　屋敷の中に入ると秋葉と顔を合わせるかもしれないし、しばらく庭を散歩しよう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“…”
I don’t think what happened can be reduced to which of us was wrong.
Once enough time passes, Akiha will calm down and explain why she hates Ciel so much.
“Maybe I’ll walk around the garden.”
If I go inside, I may run into Akiha, so I’ll walk around the garden for a while.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
I don't think it matters who was wrong.
I'm sure that in time Akiha will calm down and explain why she doesn't like Ciel-senpai.
"…… I could hang around the garden for a bit."
If I go into the mansion, I might face Akiha, so I'll take a walk in the garden for a while.

entries.japanese:
「あれ、琥珀さん……？」
　そこにいたのは琥珀さんだった。
　……こっちには気がついていないみたいだけど、林のほうへ行こうとしている。
　琥珀さんはこちらに気づいていない。
　何をしにいくんだろう、琥珀さんは森の中に入っていく。
「？」
　興味をひかれて、少しだけ後についていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Kohaku…?”
It is Kohaku.
She doesn’t seem to have noticed me, and she is heading toward the trees.
Kohaku has not noticed me.
I wonder what she is doing as she walks into the woods.
“?”
Curious, I follow her a little way.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Huh?
Kohaku-san?"
It's Kohaku-san.
She doesn't seem to have noticed me, and she's heading into the forest.
She hasn't noticed me.
I don't know what she's doing, but she disappears into the forest.
"?"
I'm curious, so I'll follow her.

entries.japanese:
琥珀さんが歩いていった先には、ちょっとした広場があるようだった。
「……？
　あんなところに広場なんて……」
　首をかしげて思い出そうとしてみるが、どうも記憶はあいまいだ。
　屋敷の森の中、木々をきりとったような広場が見える。
entries.maoEnglish:
Beyond the path Kohaku took lies a small clearing.
“What…? A clearing in a place like that…?”
I tilt my head and search my memory, but find only haze.
There it is among the estate woods, as though it had been cut out of the surrounding trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems there's a small clearing where Kohaku-san headed to.
"……… There's a clearing there……?"
Tilting my head to the side, I try to remember, but for some reason, my memory is a bit vague.
In the forest of the mansion, I can see a clearing as if the trees were cut there.

entries.japanese:
――――いや、見えるというのは正しくない。
　普通に歩いている分には決して見えなかったはずだ。
　琥珀さんがあそこに歩いて行かなければ、屋敷に住んでいながら一生気づかなかったぐらい隠れた、木々に囲まれた小さな広場。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――No—saying that I can see it isn’t quite right.
No ordinary path would ever have revealed it.
If Kohaku had not walked there, I might have lived in the estate my entire life without discovering that tiny clearing enclosed by trees.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---No, "can see" is not quite right.
If you walked by normally, you probably would never notice it.
If Kohaku-san didn't walk there, hidden enough by the surrounding trees as it is, I would never have noticed even if I lived here all my life.

entries.japanese:
「……あんな広場、あったかな……あったならかっこうの遊び場になってたはずなんだけど……」
　少なくとも森の中の広場で秋葉と遊んだ記憶はない。
――――ない、ような、気が、する。
「…………」
　少しだけ思案してから、その広場に入ってみることにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Was that clearing always there—if it was, it would have made the perfect playground.”
At least, I had no memory of ever playing with Akiha in a clearing in the woods.
――――I don’t think there was.
“…”
After a moment’s hesitation, I stepped into the clearing.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… There's a clearing there?
…… If so, we probably did play there as kids."
To say the least, I don't remember ever playing with Akiha in the clearing.

----I feel like I've never, been there, before.
"…………"
After thinking for a bit, I decide to go into the clearing.

entries.japanese:
……広場には特別なにもない。
　先に入っていった琥珀さんの姿もない。
「なんだ―――ただの空き地じゃないか」
　広場の真ん中へ歩いていく。
　広場は本当に、なんていうことはない空き地だった。
　きれいにまったいらにされた土の地面と、
　まわりを囲む深い森の木々。
entries.maoEnglish:
There is nothing unusual here.
Nor is there any sign of Kohaku, who entered before me.
“Oh―――it’s only an empty lot.”
I walk to its center.
It truly is nothing more than vacant ground.
Earth leveled smooth and flat,
surrounded by the trees of the deep wood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… The clearing doesn't strike me as anything out of the ordinary.
There's no sign of Kohaku-san, who entered before me.
"What's this---just an empty place."
I walk to the middle of the clearing.
This clearing really is just an empty space.
The perfectly level open ground.
The deep woods enclose the area.

entries.japanese:
蝉の声と。
　溶けるような、強い、夏の陽射し――――――
「え…………？」
　夏の、陽射し―――？
「い――――痛ぅ…………」
　胸の傷が痛む。
　まるで／ざくりと。
　包丁で胸を刺された／ような／この痛み。
entries.maoEnglish:
The cry of cicadas.
Fierce summer sunlight, hot enough to melt the world――――――
“What…?”
Summer sunlight—?
“Ah――――ow…”
The wound in my chest hurt.
As if / stabbed deep.
This pain / as if / a kitchen knife had been driven into my chest.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The voice of the cicadas.
And the strong, summer sunshine that feels like it could dissolve------

"Eh…………?"
Summer, sunshine---?
"Ou----ouch……"
The wound on my chest starts to hurt.
Like / Stabbing.
This pain  / that feels like  / a kitchen knife stabbing my chest.

entries.japanese:
みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん
　みーん　みんみん―――――
――――どこかで、蝉の声がしている。
　今はもう、秋なのに。
entries.maoEnglish:
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min
Miiin, min-min―――――
――――Somewhere, cicadas were screaming.
Though autumn has already come.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp.
Chiiirp.
Chirp Chirp-----
----From somewhere, I can hear the voice of cicadas.
But, it's autumn now.

entries.japanese:
――――白く溶けてしまいそうな夏の陽射し。
　遠くのそらには入道雲。
　見えるのは空蝉のこえ。
　足元には蝉のぬけがら。
　ぬけがら。
誰かの、ぬけがら。
entries.maoEnglish:
――――Summer light so white it seems to dissolve everything.
Thunderheads tower in the distant sky.
I see the voice of an empty cicada shell.
At my feet lies a cicada husk.
A husk. Someone’s discarded husk.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----The summer sunshine that bathes everything in white.
The columns of summer clouds in the far off sky.
I can practically see the voices.
At my feet, there are the discarded shells of cicadas.
Discarded shell.
Someone's--discarded shell.

entries.japanese:
……うずくまる誰かの影法師。
　　　近寄ってくる幼いあきはの足音。
　　　遠くの空には入道雲。
空蝉の青いそら。
entries.maoEnglish:
A person’s shadow crouches there.
Little Akiha’s footsteps come closer.
Thunderheads in the distance. A blue summer sky, hollow as a cicada shell.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Someone's crouching shadow.
Young Akiha's approaching footsteps.
Clouds high in the emptiness.
Cicadas in the blue sky.

entries.japanese:
ただ、夢中だった。
　　　あのままじゃあきはがころされてしまう。
　　　ほんとうに、それだけしかわからなかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Nothing else mattered.
At this rate Akiha would be killed.
That was truly all I understood.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I was just, in a trance.
Akiha would have been killed.
That was really all I knew.

entries.japanese:
ただ、走っていた。
　　　そんなことしかわからなかった。
　　　自分のほうがあぶないなんて、
　　　そんなコトどうでもよかった。
entries.maoEnglish:
I only ran.
That was all I knew how to do.
That I was the one in danger,
I did not care at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I just, ran.
That was all I understood.
As for the danger to myself,
I never even thought about it.

entries.japanese:
あきはをまもりたくて、
　　　あきはのかわりになっただけ。
entries.maoEnglish:
Wanting to protect Akiha,
I merely took her place.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I wanted to protect Akiha,
And I just took her place.

entries.japanese:
とおくで。
　　　セミの　なき声。
entries.maoEnglish:
Far away.
The cicadas crying.
entries.mirrorMoon:
In the distance.
The voices of the cicadas.

entries.japanese:
―――その後。
　　　胸を貫かれて殺されている俺の体と。
　　　俺の死体を呆然と見下ろす、
　　　もう一人の子供の姿―――――
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Afterward.
My body, lying dead with its chest pierced through.
And another child,
staring down in shock at my corpse―――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
---After that.
My body that died from having its chest pierced.
And a figure that looks down at my dead body in shock.
A figure of another child-----

entries.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ」
　胸がいたい。
　吐き気がする。
　胸の傷はとうのむかしに塞がっているはずなのに、どうしてこんなにも痛むのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――gh.”
My chest hurts.
I’m going to be sick.
The wound closed long ago, so why does it hurt this much?
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Ua---gh."
My chest hurts.
I feel sick.
The wound in my chest should have closed long ago, so why does it hurt now?

entries.japanese:
胸が　壊れてる。
　古傷が開いて　セキショクの染みが流れ出す。
――――なんてこと。
　俺の傷は、ぜんぜん癒えてなんかいない。
entries.maoEnglish:
My chest is broken.
The old wound splits open, and a RED stain spills out.
――――How could this be?
My wound never healed at all.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My chest, rips.
The old wound opens, and a crimson stream flows out.
----What is this?
My wound, it didn't heal at all.

entries.japanese:
イタイ。
　　　コワイ。
――――眩暈がする。
　　　　　コレガ、
　　　　　　　　死トイウ衝動カ。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
IT HURTS.
I’M SCARED.
――――The world spins.
IS THIS THE IMPULSE
CALLED DEATH?!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
It hurts.
I'm scared.
----I feel dizzy.
This is,
the impulse of Death.

entries.japanese:
意識が沈む。
　傷が痛む。
　どさり　と、自身の体が地面に倒れこむ音をきいた。
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
Consciousness sinks.
The wound aches.
I hear my own body strike the ground with a heavy thud.!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
Consciousness fades.
My wound aches.
I hear a thump as my body falls to the ground.

entries.japanese:
……話し声が聞こえてくる。
「秋葉さま、お医者さまをお呼びしないのですか？」
「馬鹿なことを言わないで翡翠。
呼べるわけないでしょう、兄さんの傷は普通の傷じゃないんだから……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
I could hear voices.
“Miss Akiha, shall I call a doctor?”
“Don’t be ridiculous, Hisui. We can’t call anyone because my brother’s wound isn’t an ordinary injury…!”
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… I can hear voices talking.
"Akiha-sama, are you not going to call for a doctor?"
"Don't be stupid, Hisui.
There's no way I could do that, since Nii-san's wound isn't normal…!"

entries.japanese:
……あきは　と　ひすい　が話している。
　ここは　シキの　部屋だ。
　どうやら　ベッドの上で　眠っている　らしい。
　やあ、と声をあげて起きようとしたけれど、体が思うように動かない。
　胸の痛みはもうないくせに、体は鉛のように重い。
　満足に動くのは、目と口だけのようだった。
entries.maoEnglish:
……akiha and hisui are talking
this is SHIKI’s room.
it seems i am asleep on the bed.
I tried to greet them and sit up, but my body refused to cooperate.
My chest no longer hurt, yet the rest of me weighed as much as lead.
Only my eyes and mouth seemed capable of moving properly.
entries.mirrorMoon:
…… Akiha   and   Hisui are talking.
This  is   SHIKI's room.
It looks   like   I am  sleeping  on the bed.
I planned to say "Yo!" and get out of bed, but I can't move at all.
My chest doesn't hurt anymore, but my body is as heavy as lead.
All I can move are my eyes and mouth.

entries.japanese:
「一体どういうつもりなの翡翠。
兄さんをあそこに近づけてはいけないって、あなたも知っているでしょうに……！」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝って済む問題じゃないわ。
あなたを兄さん付きの使用人にしたのは、こういう事態を避けさせるためでしょう？
　それを忘れて、あなたは何をやっていたっていうのよ……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“What were you thinking, Hisui? You knew you were never to let my brother near that place…!”
“I am—terribly sorry.”
“Sorry isn’t enough. I assigned you to my brother precisely to prevent this. Did you forget what you were supposed to be doing…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Just what were you thinking, Hisui.
Nii-san mustn't be allowed to go there, you know that…!"
"Please…… Forgive me."
"This can't be solved by apologizing.
You were assigned to serve Nii-san to avoid this kind of situation.
So what were you doing…!?"

entries.japanese:
秋葉は普段からでは考えられないぐらい、感情を剥き出しにして怒っている。
　叱られている翡翠はうつむいたままずっと黙っていた。
　……俺には、二人がどうしてこうなっているのか全然わからない。
　わからないけれど、翡翠が俺のせいで怒られている、という事ぐらいは読み取れた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s anger is more naked than I have ever seen it.
Hisui stands beneath the scolding with her head bowed, saying nothing.
I had no idea why the two of them had come to this.
But I could at least tell that Hisui was being blamed because of me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Completely different from her usual manner, Akiha gives full vent to her anger.
In comparison, Hisui is accepting the scolding silently, looking down.
…… I'm not sure how this all came about.
But I can at least tell Hisui is being yelled at because of me.

entries.japanese:
「答えなさい翡翠。
どうして兄さんはあの場所に行ってしまったの？」
　秋葉の質問に翡翠は答えない。
　二人の間の空気は段々と重苦しくなってくる。
　ぎゅっ、と唇をかみしめて、秋葉が翡翠に一歩だけ近寄る。
　……秋葉が、翡翠に手を上げようとしているのは、俺からでも読み取れた。
　翡翠も解っているだろうに、うつむいたままそれを黙って受け入れようとしている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Answer me, Hisui. Why did my brother go there?”
Hisui does not answer.
The air between them grows steadily more oppressive.
Akiha bites her lip and takes one step toward her.
Even from here, I can tell that Akiha is about to strike her.
Hisui must know it too, yet she keeps her head bowed and silently prepares to accept the blow.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Answer me, Hisui.
Why did Nii-san go there?"
Hisui does not answer Akiha's question.
The air between them is becoming heavy.
Biting her lip, Akiha takes a step closer to Hisui.
…… Even I can tell that she's about to raise a hand against her.
I'm sure Hisui knows too, but she's just looking down, accepting it.

entries.japanese:
「―――ちょっと待て秋葉」
「兄さん――気がついたんですか！？」
「ああ、秋葉があんまりにうるさいんで、いま目がさめた」
「あ…………」
　秋葉は気まずそうに視線をそらす。
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Wait, Akiha.”
“Brother――you’re awake!?”
“Yeah, Akiha was making so much noise that she woke me up.”
“Ah…”
Akiha averts her eyes, suddenly uncomfortable.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"----Hold on, Akiha."
"Nii-san--You're awake!?"
"Yeah, you were so loud, I woke up."
"Ah…………"
Akiha looks away uncomfortably.

entries.japanese:
「あのさ、あんまり翡翠にあたるなよ。
事情はしらないけど、ようするに俺が倒れたことでもめてるんだろ？
　なら翡翠に責任なんかないよ。
こんなの俺がかってに倒れただけなんだから」
　よっ、と腕に力をこめて、なんとか上半身だけベッドから起こした。
　今は、それだけでもう指一本だって動かせそうにない。
　けれど翡翠が落ち込んでいる手前、無理をしてでも元気なフリをしなくちゃいけない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Don’t take it out on Hisui. I don’t know the whole story, but this is about me collapsing, right? Then it isn’t her fault. I fell over all by myself.”
With a grunt, I forced enough strength into my arms to raise my upper body from the bed.
That alone left me unable to move so much as a finger.
But with Hisui looking so crushed, I had to pretend I was fine, no matter how much it cost me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"You know, you shouldn't let it out on Hisui.
I don't know the circumstances, but this has to do with me collapsing, right?
It's not her fault, I just collapsed on my own."
I strain hard and somehow manage to lift the upper half of my body off the bed.
But that's all I can manage, and I don't think I can even move an inch more.
But since Hisui is depressed, I have to force myself to act as fine as possible.

entries.japanese:
「……まったく、おまえも俺のコトなんかでケンカなんかするな。
大人びたように見えてまだ子供なんだな」
「でも――――兄さんはずっと気を失っていたんですよ？
　五時間以上も昏睡しているなんて、今までなかったはずです。
もし―――もし兄さんがあのまま目が覚めなかったら、私はどうすればいいんですか……！」
entries.maoEnglish:
“Honestly, don’t start fights over me. You look so grown-up, but you’re still a child after all.”
“But――――you were unconscious for hours! You’ve never been in a coma for more than five hours before. If―――if you had never woken up, what was I supposed to do…?”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Honestly, getting into a fight over me.
Even if you look like an adult, you're still a child."
"But----you were out for a long time, Nii-san.
You were out for more than five hours, and nothing like this has happened before.
What would I have done if you'd never woken up…!"

entries.japanese:
「ばか、縁起でもないこというなよ。
こんなのはただの貧血じゃないか。
……って、なんだ。
もう夜の十時をまわってるのか」
「……ええ。
兄さんは夕方から今まで、ずっと気を失っていたんです」
　遠慮がちに秋葉は語る。
「――――――」
　どっ、と体から力が抜けた。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Idiot, don’t say things like that. It was only anemia. Wait—what? It’s already past ten?”
“Yes. You have been unconscious since this afternoon.”
Akiha’s voice turns diffident.
“――――――”
All the strength leaves my body at once.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Idiot, don't say things like that.
This is just anemia.
…… eh?
It's ten o'clock already?"
"…… Yes.
Nii-san, you have been out all evening."
Akiha speaks reluctantly.
"------"
The strength flees from my body.

entries.japanese:
「……まいったな。
そんなに長く気絶してたなんて、小学校以来だ。
ああ、あの時は頻繁に倒れてたっけ。
有間の家になれなくってさ、神経がまいってたんだ」
　貧血の後遺症か、なんだかまだユメを見ているようだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
“That’s bad. I haven’t been out that long since elementary school. I used to collapse all the time back then. I couldn’t adjust to living with the Arimas, and my nerves were shot.”
Perhaps it is the aftereffect of the anemia, but I still feel half trapped in a dream.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Geez.
I haven't fainted for that long since elementary school.
Yeah, I used to faint all the time back then.
I wasn't used to the Arimas and my mind was always under stress."
It seems like I'm still dreaming, maybe an after-effect of the anemia attack.

entries.japanese:
「……おぼえてる。
有間の家の人たちはいい人ばかりで、俺を本当の子供みたいに扱ってくれた。
―――啓子さんは厳しいけど思いやりがある人で、俺を本当の子供なんだって自分に言い聞かせてた。
　……だから、俺も――本当の子供にならなくっちゃって、思ってたんだ」
entries.maoEnglish:
“I remember. Everyone in the Arima family was kind and treated me like their own child.
―――Keiko was strict but caring, and she kept telling herself I really was her son.
So I――I thought I had to become a real son too.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I remember.
The Arimas were all good people; they treated me like their own child."
---Keiko-san was strict but thoughtful and always treated me like I was her own son.
"…… So, I thought I had to become their real child, too."

entries.japanese:
「兄さん、無理はしないで。
ここは遠野の屋敷です。
兄さんがそんなコトを自分に言い聞かせる必要なんて、もうないんです……！」
「――――わかってる。
　けど、昔から、そう思ってた。
物心ついた時から、ずっと思ってたんだ。
　……有間の人たちも秋葉たちもいい人ばっかりで、だから、すごく、つらかった―――」
　……何を言っているんだろう、俺は。
　ぼんやりと天井をみながら、自分でも思い出せないぐらい昔の出来事を思い返して。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Brother, don’t force yourself. This is the Tohno estate. You no longer need to tell yourself anything like that.”
“――――I know.
But I’d always felt that way. Ever since I was old enough to remember, I had felt that way.
The Arimas and all of you are good people, so it hurt me terribly―――”
What am I talking about?
I stare vaguely at the ceiling, remembering things from so long ago I can no longer properly recall them.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Nii-san, don't push yourself.
This is the Tohno mansion.
You don't have to tell yourself that anymore…!"
"----I know.
But, for a long time, I thought that way.
From the beginning, I always thought that.
…… The Arimas, and you, you're all good people, so, it was so hard---"
…… What am I saying?
Gazing vacantly at the ceiling, thinking back to memories of long ago.

entries.japanese:
「……無理はなさらないで。
兄さんがここに帰ってきてまだ一週間です。
ですから、色々と疲れがたまっているんです」
「――そうかな。
……まあ、疲れは溜まっている、けど」
「でしょう？
　ですから、今日はもうこのままお休みください。
兄さんは人より体が不安定なんですから、たまには一日ゆっくり休まないと今日のように倒れてしまうんです」
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで見つめてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Please don’t overtax yourself. You’ve only been back for a week, Brother. Naturally, the strain has accumulated.”
“――Maybe. Well, I am tired, though.”
“Exactly, so please remain in bed tonight. Your health is less stable than other people’s. Unless you occasionally rest for an entire day, you’ll collapse again just as you did today.”
Akiha watches me with grave eyes.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Please, don't push yourself, Nii-san.
You've only been back here for a week.
So you must be tired."
"--Really.
Well, I'm tired, but…"
"Right?
So, please, just rest today.
Since your body's weaker than most people's, if you don't take a day to rest from time to time, you'll collapse like you did today."
Akiha looks at me seriously.

entries.japanese:
「………………」
　……たしかに、秋葉の言うとおりだ。
　何もかも忘れて。
　吸血鬼のことも自分のことも考えないで休まないと、本当に参ってしまう。
entries.maoEnglish:
“………………”
Akiha is right.
I need to forget everything.
Unless I rest without thinking about vampires or myself, I truly will break.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
…… Certainly, it's just as she says.
Forgetting about everything.
Unless I rest without thinking about vampires or about myself, I'll really be out of it.

entries.japanese:
「……そうだね。
秋葉の言うとおり、今日はおとなしく横になっているよ」
　言って、ベッドに体を横たえた。
「ほんとう……？
　あとになって部屋を抜け出したりするのもナシですよ？」
「なんだよそれ。
俺、そんなに信用ないのかな」
　……ああ、ないか。
　今まで散々、秋葉を放っておいたんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll take your advice and stay in bed tonight.”
I lower myself onto the mattress.
“You promise? You won’t sneak out later?”
“What’s that supposed to mean? Do you trust me that little?”
Ah—no, she doesn’t.
Not after I neglected her so thoroughly for all these years.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… You're right.
As you say, I'll just lie quietly today."
Saying so, I lie down again.
"Really…?
No more sneaking out of your room later, too?"
"What is that?
Am I that untrustworthy?"
…… Yeah, I guess so.
I've left Akiha alone for all this time.

entries.japanese:
「翡翠、琥珀に兄さんが目を覚ました事を伝えにいって。
兄さん、夕食はどうしますか？」
「……そっか。
いや、琥珀さんには悪いけど、食べられそうにない」
「……わかりました。
じゃあ翡翠、そう琥珀に伝えてきて」
　翡翠はうつむいたままコクン、とうなずいて部屋から出て行く。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Hisui, tell Kohaku that my brother has awakened. Brother, would you like dinner?”
“Oh. No, I’m sorry to Kohaku, but I don’t think I can eat.”
“I understand. Hisui, please tell Kohaku that as well.”
Still looking down, Hisui gives a small nod and leaves the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Hisui, tell Kohaku Nii-san is up.
Nii-san, what will you do about dinner?"
"…… I see.
Well, My apologies to Kohaku-san, but I don't feel like eating."
"…… I understand, Well, Hisui, please inform Kohaku."
Still looking down, Hisui nods in assent and leaves the room.

entries.japanese:
「さあ兄さん。
今夜はもうお休みになってください」
　すごく優しい声で秋葉は言う。
　けど、眠るのは。
　眠って、またあんな悪夢を見るのは恐い。
「いや、俺は―――」
「……お願いします、兄さん。
今日だけは私の言うことを聞いてくれるっていったでしょう……？」
　懇願するような、秋葉の目。
　……本当に心の底から、秋葉は俺のことを案じてくれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Now, Brother. Please sleep for the rest of the night.”
Akiha’s voice is remarkably gentle.
But sleep means dreaming.
The thought of seeing that nightmare again terrifies me.
“No, I―――”
“Please, Brother. You said that for today, at least, you would listen to me…”
Akiha’s eyes plead with me.
She truly is worried for me from the bottom of her heart.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Well, Nii-san.
Please go to sleep for tonight."
Akiha speaks in a very gentle tone.
But, to sleep…
I'm afraid that if I sleep, I'll see that nightmare.
"No, I---"
"Please, Nii-san.
Didn't you say you'll listen to what I say, just for today…?"
Akiha's eyes are pleading.
…… From the bottom of her heart, Akiha is really worried about me.

entries.japanese:
「わかった。
大人しく眠るよ」
「……はい。
ありがとうございます」
「ばか、なんでそこで礼なんか言うんだよ。
お礼を言いたいのはこっちのほうだ」
　……俺を。
　八年間もおまえを放っておいた俺を、この屋敷に呼び戻してくれたのはそっちのほうなんだから。
entries.maoEnglish:
“All right. I’ll go to sleep.”
“Yes. Thank you.”
“Idiot, why are you thanking me? I’m the one who should be grateful.”
Me.
After all, you are the one who brought me—who left you alone for eight years—back to this estate.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Alright.
I'll sleep quietly."
"…… Yes.
Thank you."
"Silly.
why are you thanking me?
I should be the one thanking you."
…… I.
Even though I neglected you for eight years, you're the one who called me back to this mansion.

entries.japanese:
「―――秋葉。
その、いろいろごめんな。
たしかに俺は身勝手で、秋葉のことを考えてやれなかった。
けど、これからは―――」
「いいんです。
兄さんは今までどおり兄さんのままでいてください。
　それに、謝らなくちゃいけないのは私のほうなんです。
……兄さんは私に謝らないでください。
そんなことをされたら、私は本当にいやな女になってしまいます」
entries.maoEnglish:
“―――Akiha. I’m sorry for everything. I was selfish and never stopped to think about you. But from now on―――”
“No. Please remain exactly as you have always been, Brother.
Besides, I am the one who owes an apology. Please don’t apologize to me. If you do, I’ll become a truly hateful woman.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
"---Akiha.
I'm, sorry for everything.
I'm selfish, and never thought about you.
But, from now on…"
"It's fine.
Please stay as you are, Nii-san.
And, I should be the one who's apologizing.
Please, don't apologize to me.
If you do, I'll feel like a really horrible person."

entries.japanese:
瞳に涙をためて、秋葉はじっと俺の手を握っている。
　……わからない。
　どうして秋葉がそんな事を言うのか。
　どうしてそんな―――ごめんなさいって、繰り返すのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Tears fill Akiha’s eyes as she holds tightly to my hand.
I don’t understand.
Why would she say such a thing?
Why does she keep repeating that word―――sorry?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Akiha grasps my hand, tears welling in her eyes.
…… I don't understand.
Why Akiha is saying such things.
Why she keeps repeating "I'm sorry".

entries.japanese:
「……眠くなってきた。
少し、眠る」
「―――はい。
おやすみなさい、兄さん」
!w2000
entries.maoEnglish:
“I’m getting sleepy. I think I’ll rest.”
“―――Yes. Good night, Brother.”!w2000
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… I'm, getting tired.
I'll… sleep for a bit."
"---Yes.
Good night, Nii-san."

entries.japanese:
暑い夏の日。
　血だらけのこどものすがた。
　不吉なことばかり積み重なっていく、遠野志貴の世界。
entries.maoEnglish:
A sweltering summer day.
A child drenched in blood.
Omen upon omen gathering in the world of Shiki Tohno.
entries.mirrorMoon:
A hot summer day.
A figure of a bloody child.
The world of Tohno Shiki, filled with ill omens.

entries.japanese:

　だっていうのに、静かだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
And yet it is quiet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
But, it's so quiet.

entries.japanese:

entries.maoEnglish:

My heart grows calm.
entries.mirrorMoon:

entries.japanese:

entries.maoEnglish:

entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.

entries.japanese:
―――とくん。
　本当に、静かだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――Thump.
It truly is quiet.
entries.mirrorMoon:
---Thump.
It's really quiet.

entries.japanese:
――とく、ん。
　そうして何日かぶりに、悪い夢を見ない穏やかな眠りに落ちていけた。
entries.maoEnglish:
――Thum, p.
And for the first time in days, I drift into a peaceful sleep untouched by nightmares.
entries.mirrorMoon:
--Thump.
And for the first time in days, I sleep calmly, untroubled by nightmares.

entries.japanese:
ひとり残されて、ベッドに横になった。
　八年ぶりの家。
　八年ぶりの肉親。
　なんだか、他人の家のように感じる自分。
「……はあ。
これからどうなるんだろ、俺」
　誰に聞かせるわけでもなくぼやいて、そのまま眠りへと落ちていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
Left alone, I lay down on the bed.
Home for the first time in eight years.
With my own family for the first time in eight years.
Yet I felt as though I were in a stranger’s house.
“God… what is going to happen to me now?”
With no one there to hear me complain, I drifted into sleep.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Left by myself, I lie on my bed.
This house from eight years ago…
My blood relative from eight years ago…
It feels a little like they belong to someone else.
*sigh*
"…… I wonder what's going to happen to me now?"
Grumbling to no one in particular, I fall asleep.

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
―――波の音のように、何かの声が聞こえてくる。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awooooooooooo.
―――A voice reaches me, rising and falling like the sea.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
---I hear the wave-like sound of something's voice.

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
―――なにかの遠吠え。
野犬にしては細く高い。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awoooooooooo.
―――Something is howling. Too thin and high to be a stray dog.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
---Something is howling.
It's too sharp and high-pitched to be a stray dog.

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
―――鼓膜に響く。
月にでも吠えているのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awoooooooooo.
―――It rings in my ears. Is it howling at the moon?
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
---It echoes in my eardrums.
Is it howling at the moon?

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
―――厭なにおい。
この獣の咆哮は、頭痛を招く。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awoooooooooo.
―――A foul smell. The beast’s cry brings on a headache.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
---This doesn't feel right.
The beastly howling is beginning to give me a headache.

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
―――音はやまない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Awoooooooooo.
―――The sound will not stop.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
---It doesn't stop.

entries.japanese:
オーーーーーーーーーン。
　オーーーーーーーーーン。
　オーーーーーーーーーン――――――――
entries.maoEnglish:
Awoooooooooo.
Awoooooooooo.
Awooooooooooo—
entries.mirrorMoon:
Awooooo.
Awooooo.
Awooooooooooooooo---

entries.japanese:
「……ああ、やかましいっ！」
　目が覚めた。
　窓の外からはワンワンと犬の鳴き声が聞こえてくる。
　時計は夜の十一時になったばかり。
　近所迷惑どころの話じゃない。
「くそ、こんなんじゃ眠れやしないじゃないか」
　犬の遠吠えは屋敷の塀の近くから聞こえてくる。
　……このままじゃ眠れそうにない。
entries.maoEnglish:
“God, shut up!”
I wake up.
Dogs are barking outside my window.
The clock has only just struck eleven.
This goes far beyond being a nuisance to the neighbors.
“Damn it, how am I supposed to sleep through this?”
The howling seems to come from somewhere near the estate wall.
There is no chance of getting back to sleep like this.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Argh, just shut up already!"
I wake up.
I can hear the sound of a dog barking outside the window.
The clock indicates it is just past eleven.
This is more than just a neighborhood nuisance.

"Damn, I can't sleep like this!"
The dog's howling comes from somewhere near the mansion's fence.
…… It doesn't seem like I can go back to sleep at this rate.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま、朝です。
お目覚めください」
　……聞きなれた声がする。
「志貴さま……どうかお目覚めください。
昨日に引き続き遅刻をなされると、秋葉さまとのお約束を破ることになってしまいます」
　……切迫しているのか落ち着いているのか、なかなかに判別がつきにくい声がする。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it’s morning. Please wake up.”
A familiar voice reaches me.
“Master Shiki—please wake up. If you are late again today, you will break your promise to Miss Akiha.”
The voice was somehow too composed to sound urgent and too urgent to sound composed.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, it is morning.
Please wake up."
…… I hear a familiar voice.

"Shiki-sama…… Please wake up.
If you are late like yesterday, you will break your promise with Akiha-sama."
…… A voice partly tense, partly relaxed.

entries.japanese:
「志貴さま。
よろしいのですね、今朝も秋葉さまにお叱りをうけるということで」
　……そんなの、よろしいハズがない。
「……起きる。
起きるから、ちょっと待って」
　シーツをかぶったままその返答をして、ゆっくりと目を覚ますことにした。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Am I to understand that you wish to be scolded by Miss Akiha again this morning?”
No, that is certainly not all right.
“I’m getting up. Just give me a minute.”
I answered from beneath the sheet and began the slow process of waking.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
Is it okay?
Akiha-sama will end up scolding you again."
…… No, it's not okay at all.
"…… I'm up.
I'm up, so hold on."
Still under the sheets, I respond as I slowly open my eyes.

entries.japanese:
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あい、おはよう」
　ねぼけた頭で挨拶を返して、メガネをかける。
　時刻は朝の七時すぎ。
　いつも通りの時間に翡翠が起こしにきて、めずらしく目を覚ました自分がいる。
「それでは朝食の支度をいたします。
着替えがすみしだい、食堂にいらしてください」
　一礼をして、翡翠は部屋から立ち去っていった。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Mornin’.”
I returned the greeting through the fog in my head and put on my glasses.
It was a little after seven.
Hisui had come to wake me at the usual time, and, unusually, I had actually awakened.
“I will prepare breakfast. Please come to the dining room once you have dressed.”
Hisui bowed and left the room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"Good morning, Shiki-sama."
"Ah, mornin'."
I give a sleepy greeting in response and put on my glasses.
It's past seven in the morning.
Hisui came at her usual time and managed to wake me.
"I will prepare your breakfast.
After changing, please head towards the dining room."
Hisui disappears from the room after a bow.

entries.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　大きく伸びをして、ベッドから置きあがる。
　制服に着替えて、ふと、机の上に視線を投げた。
　……机の上には、あれ以来使われる事のないナイフが置かれている。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
I gave one long stretch and climbed out of bed.
Once I had changed into my uniform, my eyes strayed to the desk.
The knife lay there, untouched since that night.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I give a big yawn.
After a nice stretch, I get up from bed.
I change into my school uniform and cast a glance at my desk.
…… On top is the knife I will not ever use again.

entries.japanese:
ふわり、とカーテンがゆらいだ。
　翡翠が開けていったのだろう、窓越しの空は気持ちいいぐらいに晴れあがっている。
　ただ、吹き込む風が肌寒い。
　窓を閉めようと、窓ガラスに近づいた。
entries.maoEnglish:
The curtains stirred softly.
Hisui must have opened the window; beyond it, the sky was brilliantly clear.
The breeze coming through was cold against my skin.
I walked over to close the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The curtains sway in the wind.
Hisui must have opened the window; the sky is refreshingly clear.
It's just a little cold though.
I approach the window to close it.

entries.japanese:
―――結局。
　あの後、俺が目を覚ましたのは自分の部屋だった。
entries.maoEnglish:
―――In the end.
After everything that happened, I woke in my own room.
entries.mirrorMoon:
----As it turned out,
I ended up waking in my own room.

entries.japanese:
先輩が運んでくれたらしく、幸いにも秋葉たちには俺が部屋を出ていったという事は知られていなかった。
　あの夜から一週間。
　遠野志貴の生活は、以前とまったく変わりがない。
entries.maoEnglish:
Apparently Ciel had carried me home without Akiha or the others ever discovering that I had left my room.
A week had passed since that night.
The life of Shiki Tohno was exactly as it had been before.
entries.mirrorMoon:
It seems Senpai carried me here.
Fortunately, Akiha and the others didn't know I left.
It's been one week since that night.
Tohno Shiki's life hasn't changed a bit from what it was before.

entries.japanese:
秋葉との関係は、多少、なんとなく気まずいものがあるものの、やっぱり兄と妹なわけで。
　学校のほうは渡り廊下を修理中という事を除けば以前と何一つ変わっていない。
　……いや、変わったか。
　学校には、シエルなんていう名前の先輩はどこにもいないし、誰も覚えてさえいない。
　街を騒がしていた通り魔事件もあれから一件だって起きていない。
犯人が捕まったわけではないので相変わらず夜の街は寂しいけれど、あと一ヶ月もすればもとの夜に戻るだろう。
entries.maoEnglish:
Things with Akiha were a little awkward in ways neither of us could quite name, but we were still brother and sister.
School was unchanged too, apart from the enclosed walkway being under repair.
No—something had changed.
There was no upperclassman named Ciel anywhere in the school, and no one even remembered her.
Nor had there been a single new killing in the series that had terrorized the city. The culprit had never been caught, so the streets remained deserted at night, but in another month they would probably return to normal.
entries.mirrorMoon:
My relationship with Akiha is a bit uneasy at times, but of course we're brother and sister.
Except for that passageway being repaired, the school has not changed at all.
…… No, it did change.
At school, there's no senpai called Ciel anywhere, nor does anyone remember her.
The instances of serial murders haven't occurred once since then.
Since there's been no official arrest, the city streets are still relatively empty at night, but it'll probably return to normal in a month.

entries.japanese:
俺は、結局。
　胸の中に埋めようのない穴を持ったまま、それでも以前のようにやっていけている。
　……というか、耐えていけている。
　時折、何の拍子もなく思い出してしまうとそれこそどうしようもなくなるけど、まだ気が触れる事はなさそうだ。
　いつか。
　この思いに耐えきれなくなってどうにかなってしまうのか、それともそれにさえ慣れて、普通に暮らしていけるようになるのか。
entries.maoEnglish:
And I was still here.
There was a hole in my chest that nothing could ever fill, yet somehow I continued living as before.
Or rather, I endured.
Sometimes a stray thought brought everything back and left me helpless—but I did not seem to be losing my mind just yet.
Someday, perhaps the grief would become unbearable and break me.
Or perhaps I would grow accustomed even to this and learn to live an ordinary life again.
entries.mirrorMoon:
As for me,
I carry an unfillable void in my heart, but I continue on as I did before.
…… Or rather, I can bear it all.
At times, I get overwhelmed when I am assailed by memories, but I don't think I'll go insane or anything for now.
Some day.
Will I go crazy after not being able to bear these memories or will I just return to living normally after getting used to them?

entries.japanese:
まあ、確率は半分半分だと思う。
―――ただ、それまでは。
　女々しいだろうけど、あいつとの最後の約束を毎日のように守っている自分がいたりするわけだ。
「――――秋も、じき終わりかな」
　外は、息がつまりそうなほど蒼い空。
　一度だけ大きく深呼吸をして、窓ガラスをぱたんと閉めた。
entries.maoEnglish:
I gave either outcome even odds.
―――But until then.
Pathetic as it might be, I found myself keeping my final promise to her almost every day.
“――――Autumn will soon be over.”
Outside, the sky was blue enough to steal my breath.
I drew one deep lungful of air, then gently shut the window.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Perhaps it's about a fifty-fifty chance.
----But until then,
even if it is a little girlish, I will keep the final promise I made with her every day.
"----Autumn is drawing to a close, isn't it?"
The blue sky outside is enough to take my breath away.
Taking a large, deep breath, I shut the window.

知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
entries.maoEnglish:
Bonjour!
This little feature is for our dear Tohno, who met a dead end one step from victory,
and now it’s time! “Teach Me, Ciel!” Class is in session!
entries.mirrorMoon:
Bonjour!
The hint corner for Tohno-kun, who has ended up in this Dead End with only a bit left to go,
It is time for "Teach me, Ciel-sensei!"

「注意が足りなかった、という所でしょうか。
　相手の武器がなんであるか。
この追及が超越種と呼ばれる類との戦闘における最優先事項です。
　まあ彼は気付いていながら、最後のツメを誤ったという所でしょう」
entries.maoEnglish:
Lesson five concerns combat with vampires.
Today we have invited Doctor Roa as our special guest.
Doctor Roa, what caused Tohno’s defeat this time?
“A lack of vigilance, I would say.
Determining the nature of one’s opponent’s weapon comes first. That is the foremost priority when fighting anything classed as a transcendent species.
He had, in fact, noticed it, but mishandled the final move.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
The fifth period is about battles with vampires.
I have brought Professor Roa as a special guest.
Professor Roa, what is the reason for Tohno-kun's loss this time?
"I have to say he was a bit careless.
Finding out about your enemy's weapon is the top priority in a battle against the transcendent race.
Well, in this case, I think that he knew about it but, didn't act very intelligently."

entries.japanese:
ははあ。
　ところで博士。
どうして博士とこっちのシキさんは容姿が違うんですか？
　わたし、ずっと疑問に思ってたんですけど。
「そうですね、趣味の問題ではないでしょうか。
　シキの意識が薄かった時はかつてのロアとしての嗜好が表立ち、こういった服装や髪型をしていましたが。
　シキ君の方では、とある理由によってシキ君の自我がほぼ完全に崩壊してしまっているので、人格を寄り代にするロアも表立って出現できなかった、というコトではないか、と」
entries.maoEnglish:
I see.
By the way, Doctor. Why do you and this SHIKI look different?
I’ve always wondered about that.
“A matter of taste, perhaps.
When SHIKI’s consciousness was faint, Roa’s former preferences came to the surface, producing this manner of dress and hairstyle.
In SHIKI’s case, however, his sense of self had almost entirely collapsed for certain reasons; since Roa uses the host personality as his vessel, he could not manifest openly either—or so I would surmise.”
entries.mirrorMoon:
I see.
Excuse me, Professor, but why does SHIKI-san in this route look different than you?
I've been wondering about this for a long time.
"Yes, I think it's just a difference in tastes.
When SHIKI's mind was weak, Roa's preferences surfaced and I dressed like this.
But in this case, SHIKI-kun completely lost his mind for some reason, and Roa could not come out since he relies on taking control of someone's mind.
That is my theory on what happened."

entries.japanese:

They say he resembles Tohno, but honestly―――they hardly look alike at all――――
entries.mirrorMoon:
Oh really?
So in Akiha-san's route, SHIKI-san is the real Tohno SHIKI.
…… They say Tohno-kun is like SHIKI-kun, but they're not alike at all……

entries.japanese:

　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　通常はトゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングと呼ばれますが、秋葉さんだけはノーマルエンディング、トゥルーエンディングと呼ばれています。

entries.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Akiha’s Normal Ending.
Each heroine—with one exception—has two endings.
Ordinarily they are called the True Ending and the Good Ending, but Akiha’s are instead called the Normal Ending and the True Ending.
Akiha’s route differs from the others: once you meet the affection requirement, neither ending has any additional special condition.
entries.mirrorMoon:
You have reached Akiha's Normal Ending.
Well done.
Each heroine (with one exception) has two different kinds of endings.
Usually, they are called "True Ending" and "Good Ending", but Akiha-san's are called "Normal Ending" and "True Ending".
Akiha-san's route is different from everyone else's in that how much Akiha-san likes you does not determine which ending you receive.

…… There are still a few guys and that close group of girls in here as well.

entries.japanese:
「………あれ？」
　今さら気がついた。
　女子の中で一番目立つ存在である弓塚さつきの姿が見えない。
「……欠席、か」
　クラスメイトの一人が休んでいた事を昼休みになって気がつくなんて、我ながら抜けていると思う。
entries.maoEnglish:
“Huh…?”
It takes me until now to notice.
Satsuki Yumizuka, easily the most conspicuous girl among them, is nowhere to be seen.
“Absent, then.”
Not realizing until lunch that one of my classmates is missing—pretty oblivious, even for me.
entries.mirrorMoon:
"…… Huh?"
I just noticed.
Yumizuka Satsuki, usually the most eye-catching of all the girls, is nowhere to be seen.
"…… She must be absent."
I must be pretty absent-minded to take until lunchtime to realize one of my own classmates isn't even here.

entries.japanese:
あいかわらず生徒で混雑している食堂で昼食をとることにした。
　うちの学食はどうしてか定食よりうどんやそばといった物のほうがおいしいので、自然にうどんを食べる事が定番になっている。
entries.maoEnglish:
I decide to eat in the cafeteria, as crowded with students as ever.
For some reason, our cafeteria’s udon and soba are much better than its set meals, so udon has naturally become my usual choice.
entries.mirrorMoon:
I decide to eat in the chaotic, student-filled cafeteria as usual.
For some reason, the udon and the soba are better than the meal sets at our school, so naturally I decide to have some udon.

entries.japanese:
テーブルに座って、たぬきうどんを食べる。
　食堂にあるテレビはニュースを映し出している。
　あのテレビはその日の朝のニュースやら昨夜のニュースやらを録画して、昼飯時に生徒たちに見せるという目的のものだ。
entries.maoEnglish:
I sit at a table with a bowl of tanuki udon.
The cafeteria television is showing the news.
It records the morning and late-night broadcasts, then plays them for students during lunch.
entries.mirrorMoon:
Sitting down at the table, I eat my tanuki udon.
The cafeteria's TV is showing the news.
The TV was set up so students can watch the recorded morning news during lunchtime.

entries.japanese:
ニュースは、例の連続殺人事件の特番だった。
　事件が始まってからじき一ヶ月ほど経過するというのに犯人像はまったく浮かび上がっていない。
　痕跡も動機もいっさいなし、という正体不明の殺人鬼。
　こんな狭い街だけで犠牲者が八人も出ているのにいまだ正体不明というのは、さすがにゾッとする、とニュースキャスターが喋っていた。
entries.maoEnglish:
Today it is airing a special on the serial murders.
Nearly a month has passed since they began, yet the police still have no picture of the culprit.
No evidence, no motive—an unidentified killer without so much as a shadow.
Eight people have died in this one small city, and the newsreader remarks that the killer’s continued anonymity is genuinely chilling.
entries.mirrorMoon:
The news is having a special feature on the serial killings.
It's been a whole month since the killings started, but no one yet has any idea who this killer is.
He is an unidentified killer, leaving no trace and acting with no motive.
His identity still remains a mystery, even though there has already been eight killings in our little town alone.
It's certainly very frightening, says the newscaster.
